This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g. operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-KBA 3004009 - The QR Code for Switzerland Does not Consider the Down Payment in the Customer Invoice Output Document.-Keywords-ByD2011; HFC02; Hotfix; SPS02; Hotfix Collection; 2011

Title: Purchase Order Returns To Not Delivered Status When a Return With Follow Up decision 'Credit Memo' is created.
Content: Symptom-When a Return with follow-up decision 'Credit Memo' is created for a purchase order item (all ordered quantity), the purchase order item is still not Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order).-Go to Items tab.-See that the Delivery Status is Not Delivered, and Invoicing Status is Not Invoiced.-Cause-Once the Return to Supplier is created and the Outbound Delivery is Released, the system updates the Purchase Order item status to Sent.-This is because returning delivered products does not mean finishing the order. It only means the delivered part (or all) is no longer needed. Delivery is still required for the returned part (or all).-This works the same for invoicing status.-Note: if Delivery Status OR Invoicing Status is Manually Finished after the return and credit memo are created, the status of the item will become Follow-up Document Created.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior. For this case, we suggest to manually Finish the Delivery and Invoice status of the purchase order. This can be done as per following steps:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and select the purchase order document you have returned.-Under the Items section choose the Finish button.-You have the option to select Invoice and Delivery in the Finish button.-Select the relevant option to manually finish Delivery and Invoice.-See Also- 2732939 - Purchase Order Available For Delivery After Supplier Return-Keywords-Purchase Order, Return to Supplier, Credit Memo, Not Delivered, Follow-up Document Created

Title: Number of Copies Setting is ignored in Production Task which is set in Uniform Content label Output Settings
Content: Symptom-You observe number of Copies setting is ignored in production task KLM which is set in Uniform Content label Output Settings as m, However we see no of copies showing as n.*KLM refers to production task id, *m refers to no of copies setting maintained in Output Management,*n refers to actual number of copies.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Production Control Work Center -Go to Task Control View-Search for KLM-Select Confirm-Select New Labels-We see number of copies as n although in output management it is maintained as m- To check the settings in Output Management-Go to  Application and User Management Work Center-Navigate to Input and Output Management View-Go to Output Channel Selection -Show Rule for: Uniform Content Labels -There is only one rule, please select it and then click the Edit button > Here the Number of Copies is m. However, this is not transferred to new labels.-Cause- As Determine Printer Settings was not performed in new label, Hence number of copies was not as per rule set for Uniform Content Label.-Resolution-Follow the below steps for Determine Printer Settings-Navigate to Production Control Work Center -Go to Task Control View-Search for KLM-Click on Confirm-Click on New Labels-We see number of copies as n although in output management it is maintained as m-Click on Determine Printer Settings button which will determine the number of copies.-Keywords-Number of Copies Setting is ignored in Production Task which is set in Uniform Content label Output Settings, As Determine Printer Settings was not performed in new label, number of copies was not as per rule set for Uniform Content Label

Title: Querysitelogisticstaskin webservice does not return Purchase Order number when there are multiple Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-You are trying to run Querysitelogisticstaskin web service, System does not return Purchase Order number when there are multiple Purchase Orders from a Putaway Task id KLM, However it returns Purchase Order number when  there is a single Purchase Order from a Putaway Task DEF.*KLM refers to Task id from Multiple Purchase Orders, *DEF refers to Task id from Single Purchase Order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Run via SoapUI-Cause-Currently the response of query web service is working as designed i.e. In case the Inbound Delivery Notification is created from 2 or more different Purchase Orders, the Purchase Order references are not returned, However in case Inbound Delivery Notification is created from a single Purchase Order, the Purchase Order is returned.-Resolution-This is the limitation of the web service and we request you  to raise an influence request because this shall be treated like a new requirement.-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Querysitelogisticstaskin web service does not return Purchase Order number when there are multiple Purchase Orders, You are trying to run Querysitelogisticstaskin web service, System does not return Purchase Order number when there are multiple Purchase Orders, However it returns Purchase Order number when  there is a single Purchase Order.

Title: Why Are Warehouse Confirmations Not Visible in The Display / Reverse Goods Activity And Confirmation OWL (Object Work List)
Content: Symptom-In the Goods And Activity Confirmation' view, all Goods and Activity Confirmations are listed.-However, warehouse confirmations are not found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Goods and Activity Confirmation view.-Search for Warehouse Confirmation document ABC (ABC represents Warehouse Confirmation ID)-System shows "No Records Found".-Cause-In the  Goods And Activity Confirmation view, only Goods and Activity Confirmations are displayed.-Warehouse Confirmations and Production Confirmations do not have a separate view.-These confirmation documents can only be viewed from their respective lots (Warehouse Order and Production Lot) or through the Confirmation Journal.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-See Also-Help document: Inventory Postings-Keywords-GAC; Display / Reverse Goods activity confirmation; Production confirmation; Warehouse confirmation

Title: Decoding of Bar Code Failed  Error During Execution of  webservice SiteLogisticsTaskBundleMaintainRequest
Content: Symptom-During execution of webservice 'SiteLogisticsTaskBundleMaintainRequest' for PutAway Task you will encounter the below error-Decoding of Bar Code Failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the Request XML for SiteLogisticsTaskBundleMaintainRequest-Cause-Error occurs despite the configuration of Automatic Configuration.- The issue is due to the missing configuration of the Application Identifiers for Barcode: Z_EAN128_O.- There is no Standard Identifier for a Product, which is 91 and thus the decoding does not take place.-Resolution-To maintain the missing Application Identifiers follow the below steps:-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter-2. Go to Overview view.-3. Select Configuration Element : Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128-4. For Bar Code Type: Z_EAN128_O you should maintain the standard Application Identifier 91 and other missing identifiers.-Keywords-Decoding, Bar code, Application, Identifier, Configuration, UCC/EAN 128

Title: Error in Intrastat Declaration Run: Invoice and Order not Found
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled intrastat declaration run but the run failed with errors even though all configurations are correctly maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center-Select view Intrastat Declaration Runs-Select the respective run ID-The status is inconsistent-Open the application log-Error recorded: Goods Movement ID(say XXX): Invoice and order not found or Company VAT number is missing or Company number is missing-Cause-The relevant Goods movement document is a Customer Return Delivery which does not have a follow up document (say a credit memo). Now the valuating Company VAT information is picked up from the follow up documents.-Resolution-Please create follow up documents to solve the issue and then trigger the Intrastat Valuation Run.-See Also-2764340 - Error in Intrastat Declaration run-3294132 - Intrastat Declaration not Created From Intrastat Runs-2736574 - Intrastat Declaration not created From Intrastat Declaration Runs-3038780 - Intrastat declaration not created or Few documents not appearing in the declaration-Keywords- Intrastat Declaration run, Error in Intrastat Declaration run,  Invoice and order not found, Company VAT number is missing, Company number is missing;Invoice and order not found or Company VAT number is missing or Company number is missing

Title: You are Unable to Delete a Catalog
Content: Symptom-You are trying to delete a released catalog but on selecting delete, the catalog does not get deleted and when you reopen it, you get error:"Editing Not Possible; Catalog already in use".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio-Select view Catalogs-Select the catalog ID which you want to delete-Select Delete-It disappears for a second but on refresh again shows up-Cause-Catalogs that have already been released and have been used in available documents cannot be deleted or modified.-Resolution-You can delete catalogs that are in the status "In Preparation".-See Also-2686289 - Unable to Delete Service Catalog-Keywords-Catalog deletion, unable to delete catalog, catalog, purchasing catalog

Title: Gross Price Field Does not Show While Creating new Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason: Duplicate of below KBA cause they have same cause and solution ,so i combined both KBAs.-KBA 2571938 - Prices tab/Gross price is missing under items tab of Purchase Order-You are creating a new purchase order however the Gross Price field does not display under items section.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Common Tasks -> New Purchase Order -Enter the necessary details-However Gross Price fields does not show-Cause- While creating new purchase order, you must enter the currency field to enable Gross Price, Net value/Limit fields.-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Common Tasks -> New Purchase Order -Enter Currency field-Now the Gross Price, Net value/Limit fields will be enabled-Keywords-Gross Price field missing; Net Value/Limit field missing in PO; Price field missing in PO; Price field missing in purchase order

Title: Approval Process Does Not Activate.
Content: Symptom-You have set up an approval process for your documents such as purchase orders or supplier invoice.-One of the approval steps of this process states that if a particular field of this document contains this data " ABC-DEF", an approver will be requested by the system.-However, and despite the correct field maintain with "ABC-DEF" in the document, the above approval process does not get triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Application and User Management.-Select the view Approval Processes.-Select the needed approval process and the specific step in it.-From here, you make sure that one condition defines that if a certain field contains " ABC-DEF", an approver will be requested by the system.-Now, you create a document and see that the needed field is correctly maintained with "ABC-DEF".-After completing and saving the document, you realize that this specific approval rule did not get triggered.-Cause-When maintaining specific conditions in your approval process rules, it is easy to avoid typo such as "ABC-DEG" instead of "ABC-DEF".-However, by mistake, an extra space can be added in the approval rules: " ABC-DEF" instead of "ABC-DEF".-This can be the reason why no approver get triggered in that case.-Resolution-Please make sure that no extra space is present in your approval processes rules when not needed.-Keywords-Approval Processes, Extra Space, Approvers, Approval Definition, Approval Rules

Title: Warehouse Request Run Does Not Work for Customer Returns
Content: Symptom-You have a Warehouse Request Run but it does not consider Customer Returns.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Warehouse Request Runs view.-Select Run ID XYZ (XYZ meaning the ID of the Warehouse Request Run).-Click on Schedule button.-Select Start Immediately and click on Save and Close.-After the run finishes, click on the Application Log.-No Customer Return documents are considered.-Cause-Since Customer Return Notifications are return documents which are created particularly including products for either repair or return, they are not covered to create Warehouse Run automatically.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Customer Return, Warehouse Request Run, does not consider, Warehouse Request

Title: How Tax Net Base Amount is Calculated?
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice and you feel the Tax Base amount is not correctly calculated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select New Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order or -Select Invoice Entry-> New Invoice (with respect to preceding document)-Enter the details and select Actions-> "Calculate Total Amount"-The Tax net base amount is not what you expected.-Cause-Tax net base amount is calculated in the following way:-Go to Supplier Invoice->"Deductions and Surcharges" tab->-Gross amount: X (e.g 100)-Item Gross Deduction-> Y (e.g. 30)-Total Tax Amount: Z (e.g. 20)-(100-30)=70(Resulting Item Gross Amount/ Effective Gross Amount)-(70-20)=50 (tax net base amount)-(X, Y, Z are all referring to amount)-Resolution-Please check in the "Deductions and Surcharges" tab to understand how the Tax net Base amount gets calculated.-Keywords-Tax Net Base Amount, supplier invoice, Deductions and Surcharges

Title: No Separate Field for House Number in the Purchase Order IDOC
Content: Symptom-No separate Field for House No. in the Purchase Order IDOC. So, if address has more than 35 characters in the Idoc, system cuts off all other characters.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order).-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Delivery sub-tab.-See that the House No./Street display on separate fields.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Communication Monitoring view.-Click on the Advanced filter.-Filter by All Business Messages and Document ID ABC.-Click on Go.-Select the Purchase Order ABC.-Click on the Arrow > Show Payload > IDOC.-Here the IDOC displays Street and House no. is in one Field (STRAS) and if the character limit is reached, then the system cuts off remaining characters.-Cause- Currently we only concatenate House ID and street Name and put it in the STRAS field.-Resolution-It is not guaranteed that IDOC maps all address fields available in the BYD XML payload to the IDOC payload.-For the address, the IDOC payload has only 2 fields capable of holding street address STRAS and STRS2 both of which are 35 char long. Whereas in ByD we have House ID, Street Name, Address line 1, address line 2 address line 3 and so on. So, it is not possible to get all the address info available in BYD into the IDOC fields.-Keywords-IDOC, Purchase Order, House number, Address, STRAS-

Title: Error appears "Calling production proposal","Quantity from RPM explosion negative or zero" when trying to create production proposal
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create production proposal for product KLM.Error appears *KLM refers to Product id,*l & *n refers to UoM-Proposal could not be created; check availability date-Creation of proposal for KLM on  for quantity  failed-Calling production proposal-Quantity from RPM explosion negative or zero-Creation of  proposals failed-Creation of production proposal  not possible on  with quantity  Nos-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Supply Planning Work Center-In Common tasks, Navigate to New planning proposal-Enter product id  as KLM Planning area id, Quantity, Availability Date-Select Save, Error appears-Cause-The quantity for By-Product:DEF in Production Model is in decimal places with l as UoM(Unit of Measure) and for By-Product CSMT314 master data, planning UoM is maintained as a different UoM as n with 0 quantity. Planning in Business by Design supports only 3 decimals places in Planning Unit of Measure (UoM).-Resolution-You will have to maintain the quantity for By-Product DEF, such that it is within 3 decimal places of UoM.-Keywords-Proposal could not be created; check availability date, Creation of proposal for on  for quantity  failed, Calling production proposal, Quantity from RPM explosion negative or zero, Creation of  proposals failed, Creation of production proposal  not possible on  with quantity  Nos

Title: Project Task (Project-based Item) Description Does Not Show in the Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-When you are adding the Project Task (Project-based Item) to a Sales Order, the system only displays the ID of the task and not the task description.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click Add Row button.-Enter ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the item).-Click the Value box for Project Task (Project-based Item).-Project Task Name shows values.-Select any value.-Once in the items table, no description is shown, just the ID.-Cause-The reason you don't see the description is because the task name will only show in the language of the logged user.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-Sales Order, Project Task (Project-based Item), Description, Item

Title: Outbound Delivery Missing for Over-the-Counter Sales with Sales Kits
Content: Symptom-You observe Outbound Delivery is missing for Over-the-Counter Sales KLM with Sales Kits when quantities are maintained in decimals.*KLM refers to Over-the-Counter Sales id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to  Over-the-Counter Sales Work Center -Go to Over-the-Counter Sales View-Find KLM-Select View All-Navigate to Document Flow tab-No Outbound Delivery created from KLM Over-the-Counter Sales-Cause-As Decimal places are passed in quantities for Over-the-Counter Sales in Sales Kits.-Resolution-This is expected behavior, decimal places are not permitted for Over-the-Counter Sales in Sales Kits.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery Missing for Over-the-Counter Sales with Sales Kits, Outbound Delivery is missing for Over-the-Counter Sales

Title: Error While Adding Logistics Use 'Cannot select project usage type; other usage type already exists'
Content: Symptom-While adding additional Logistics Use 'Project Stock' to the Logistics Area XYZ which already has other Logistics Use system throws error message -'Cannot select project usage type; other usage type already exists'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Choose Locations view.-Search for Site/Location.-Edit Layout -> Select Logistics Area ID XYZ(XYZ - represents the Logistics area with other Logistics Use already). -Enter additional Logistics Use  as Project Stock.-Cause-Logistics area with logistics use Project Stock only contains the stock that is assigned/allocated to project.-Hence, you will not be able to add Project Stock as additional Logistics Use for the Logistics Area XYZ which already has a different Logistics Use.-Resolution-Consider selecting a different Logistics Area other than Logistics Area XYZ.-Keywords-Logistics Use, Project Stock, Location,Logistics Area

Title: Error 'Change not permitted; identified stock type is not 03 or 04'
Content: Symptom-System throws following error while removing the value from identified stock type field of product ABC  --Change not permitted; identified stock type is not 03 or 04-Note: ABC represents product ID-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Product Portfolio work center-Go To Products View -> By Materials -> Enter ID ABC -> Edit -> Navigate to General Tab -> Remove the value from field Identified Stock  Type-AT this point, system throws error 'Change not permitted; identified stock type is not 03 or 04'-Cause-In the material master data of product ABC, go to Valuation tab, and you can see that the Valuation Level Type has been maintained as Product Specification.-As long as it is of this type, the Identified Stock type cannot be changed and hence the error.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. User will have to change the Valuation Level Type in case product do not have identified stock.-Keywords-Valuation Level Type, Identified Stock Type, Product Specification

Title: Inbound Delivery Notification Shows Inconsistent But With no Error
Content: Symptom-You create the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX using web service. It is created successfully in the system, however with status Inconsistent. When you open the Notification, no error is displayed.-XXX = Inbound Delivery Notification ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Find the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Open the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Click View All.-Click Check Consistency.-No error is displayed.-Cause-For the Inbound Delivery Notification line items, the Supplier ID is missing.-In the web service XML, you have used the <SellerPartyID> in the header of the message.-Resolution-You need to add <SellerPartyID> to every line item in the XML. So the Supplier ID will be fulfilled in the created Inbound Delivery Notification and it will be consistent.-Keywords- xml, web service, inconsistency

Title: Not All The Components Are Copied When Creating a Copy of The Selected BoM Variant to a New BoM
Content: Symptom-You are creating a copy of the existing BoM XYZ (XYZ represents the exact ID of the BoM) variant to a new BoM. However, the line item 30 (we will use this as an example to expain this behaviour) is not copied in the new BoM.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work centre "Planning and Production Master Data". -Select the View "Production Bills of Material".-Find the BoM XYZ. -Click the button "Copy". -Result: you can see that line item 30 is not present in the created copy of the BoM.-Cause-When you open the original BoM, you will see that there are two records for the line item 30. One of them is for the product ABC (ABC represents the exact ID of the product) and the other one for the product DEF (DEF represents the exact ID of the product). -The product ABC is assigned to a Variant 1 (which we want to copy) and the subsequently created product DEF is assigned to Variant 2.-In such cases, you need to create a new line item with the new product DEF because if you use the same line item ID for two different products, then the system will substitute the existing line item with the new one (product) even if same is still valid.-Resolution-This is the correct and expected behaviour of the system.-The product from the original variant will only be transferred to the new variant if no new product is added to its line ID.-Keywords-bill of materials, bom, production, copy

Title: Identified Stock Deletion which is in Active Status
Content: Symptom-You would like to know to delete Identified Stock KLM which is in Active Status.*KLM refers to Identified Stock Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data Work Center -Navigate to Identified Stock View-Search for any Identified Stock which is in Active Status-You see Delete Button is Grayed out-Cause-Deletion only possible as long as the identified stock is in status In Preparation-Resolution-Once the identified stock has been set to status Active, you can click Change Status and choose Block, Unblock, Set to Obsolete or Undo Obsolete as necessary in the Identified Stock view to make your identified stock available or unavailable for use. These functions are not available in the Identified Stock Limited Maintenance view.-Once you set the status to Activate, you cannot return to the In Preparation status.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2011/en-US/2de0b583722d1014b62af84e5f208ee0.html-Keywords-Identified Stock Deletion which is in Active Status, Deletion only possible as long as the identified stock is in status In Preparation, Once you set the status to Activate, you cannot return to the In Preparation status,You see Delete Button is Grayed out

Title: You are Unable to select Open Purchase Request when you use Group By Filter
Content: Symptom-When you select the view "Open Purchase Requests" and group them by certain criteria, then try to select few line items together, you are not able to select them together.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Requests-Select Open Purchase Requests-Select "Group By"(e.g select criteria Supplier ID)-Select few line items-You are unable to select them together-Cause-The group by functionality is used to group the documents based on the group by criteria used.-e.g. "Group By Supplier ID" means that purchase requests with same supplier id will be grouped together.-Hence line items  are grouped together in the system automatically which fulfill the criteria when we select this group by option.-The line items which you are trying to select yourself do not meet the group by criteria, hence you are unable to select them together.-Resolution--You can select line items which meet the "Group By" criteria.-Keywords-Group By, Open Purchase Requests

Title: Fixed Duration updated automatically while creating New Bill Of Operations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a New Bill Of Operations KLM with Resource NOP, You observe Fixed Duration updated automatically in Planning View.*KLM refers to Bill Of Operations id, NOP refers to Resource id, *XY refers to duration-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-In Common tasks, Navigate to New Bill of Operation-Maintain all Mandatory Fields in General Tab & Structure Tab-When we navigate to Planning View, you see fixed duration as XY for resource NOP although not maintained-Cause-As Resource Master NOP is configured for Scheduling Buffer as XY.The scheduling buffer is a part of planning operation scheduling. It is a fixed operation that is added to the lead time of the planning operation. It protects against fluctuations in the lead time due to unforeseen circumstances.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior when resource master NOP has certain duration set for Scheduling Buffer.In order to remove duration maintained in Scheduling Buffer, Follow the below steps-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Navigate to Resources View-Search and Select NOP-Select Edit-Navigate to Capacity and Scheduling Tab-Change or Remove the Duration maintained in  Scheduling Buffer -Keywords-Fixed Duration updated automatically while creating New Bill Of Operations,  Scheduling Buffer,

Title: Quantity Difference Between the Inbound Delivery and the Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-You have received Stock for a Product with an Inbound Delivery. However, when you check the Report "Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items" (Report ID: SCMCIDB03_Q0001), it is showing a wrong Quantity of the Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third Party Logistics work centre.-Go to the 3PL Inbound: Inbound Deliveries view.-Find and select the relevant Inbound Delivery ID.-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Line Items and search for the relevant Product ID.-You can see multiple rows of the Product in the Inbound Delivery.-Go to the Business Analytics work centre.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find the Report: Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items (Report ID: SCMCIDB03_Q0001).-Open the Report and enter the relevant Ship-to Location and Product ID.-Click Apply to execute Query.-The system returns a result which is at discrepancy with the Quantity received in the above mentioned Inbound Delivery.-Cause-You have not activated the Row "Inbound Delivery Item ID".-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed. To see all Quantity of the relevant Product in the Report, please activate the "Inbound Delivery Item ID" row. Please follow the steps below to do this:-Go to the Business Analytics work centre.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find the Report: Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items.-Open the Report and enter the relevant Ship-to Location and Product ID.-Click Apply to execute the Query.-Please click the View button and click the Add Row + symbol beside Add Row Fields.-Please find "Inbound Delivery Item ID" in the Row Selection screen, tick the checkbox.-Click the Ok button and execute the Query again.-Now you should see all the Line Items of the Inbound Delivery containing the Product appear with the correct Quantity.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, Report, Inbound Delivery Item ID

Title: Unexpected Process Communication Error in Intercompany Process
Content: Symptom-You have a Sales Order – Purchase Order – Sales Order intercompany scenario.-You are using a Sales Kit.-In the second Sales Order, the Sales Kit subitems have not been copied over thus causing a Process Communication Error between Purchae Order and Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new Sales Order.-Have fulfillment set to external.-Release sales order.-Order the automatically created Purchase Order.-Navigate to the automatically created Sales Order.-Go to the items tab.-Observe that only the sales kit header is here and the item type is Product – Delivery Based instead of Sales Kit – Header.   -Cause-The master data for the sales kit header has not been fully maintained in the system.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps:-Navigate to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center and Products view.-Search for the sales kit header.-Open up the sales kit header and navigate to sales.-Ensure that the sales unit in the second sales order is maintained under the sales tab.-Ensure that this business residence and the company it belongs to is maintained under the valuation tab.-Activate both of these.-Start the scenario again and the issue should no longer persist.-You will need to cancel the documents created before you fixed the master data. -Keywords-Process Communication Error；Intercompany Process; Sales Kit

Title: Error When Unchecking the Storage Location for Site
Content: Symptom-You would like to uncheck the box Storage Location for Location XXX, however you face an error.-XXX = Location ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center. -Select Locations view. -Search for Location XXX. -Select Location XXX. -Click Edit. -Uncheck the box Storage Location. -You receive the error:-Change storage-location-indicator not possible; location not empty-Cause-It is not possible to uncheck the Storage Location indicator once it is set. If ever there was stock in the past in that Location or Logistics Areas under that Location, it cannot be unset again.-Resolution-As the uncheck is not possible, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-Location, Site, setting

Title: Cannot choose serial number while consuming the goods related to project stock order
Content: Symptom- No  drop down  option to choose the serial numbers while  consuming the goods related  to project stock order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to projects view-Search for all projects-And open the desired project-Go to project stock orders tab-Select the  project stock order-Click on consume button-A  Pop up screen appears -Enter  serial number manually or upload them ,its working fine.-But there is no option to choose the serial numbers that were already delivered -Cause-In general business scenarios After goods are delivered related to project stock orders ,the ware house team receives all that is delivered but they will have to give  the project manager the serial numbers which they are dispatching for consumption . The reason why delivery can be different from Consumption is you can consume as and when you  require the goods.-In general after the goods have been delivered say 100, you will need to  know which  goods(for example 5) you are going to consume  and then use those serial numbers while you  enter the details in the project stock order by consuming so system will not know which are going to be dispatched out of 100, thus we expect it to manually entered.-Resolution-So we only allow you to manually enter or use the upload option if you have many serial numbers at a time.-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Cloud for Customer/ SAP Business ByDesign.--1.  If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-2.  If you are a customer:-Contact your the Account Executive-Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-        ByD : An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-  Remark : If you received the feedback that PDI Implementation is not possible then only “check the […] Ideas Forum to submit an idea…” is relevant.-  Keywords-Consume project stock order

Title: Unable to pull Historical data  for Resource Load Data Source  SCMRLU01 & SCM_RESOURCE_LOAD
Content: Symptom-You need to  know the detail of the historical of the resource load, However  data source SCMRLU01 & SCM_RESOURCE_LOAD  can`t find data of the last month, or of two month ago, etc.*XX& ZZ refers to Start Date & End Date-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Go to Design Data Sources View-Search Data Source  SCMRLU01 & SCM_RESOURCE_LOAD   -Click Preview-We are not able to pull older date like 2 months ago-Cause-As you did not select  filter  'Is between', system did not pull older data-Resolution-To get results as per your requirement-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Go to Design Data Sources View-Search Data Source  SCMRLU01 & SCM_RESOURCE_LOAD   -Click Preview-For operation date -> select 'Is between' -> Provide from date XX and to date as ZZ  and apply to get results for entire year.-Keywords-Unable to pull Historical data for  Resource Load  Data Source  SCMRLU01 & SCM_RESOURCE_LOAD, detail of the historical of the resource load, However  data source SCMRLU01 & SCM_RESOURCE_LOAD  can`t find data of the last month

Title: Web Services to create Stock Transfer Proposal
Content: Symptom- You would like to know which web services can be used to create Stock Transfer Proposal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to the Service Explorer view.-Search for the web service with description Manage Customer Requirements.-Choose the Check, Maintain or Read service as per your business requirement.-The description of how the payload should be structured is available in the Link against the field Documentation under details header.-The technical information of the above web service is mentioned below.-The A2X service II_MANAGE_CUST_REQ_IN will create stock transfer order and will also implicitly create stock transfer proposal. Also, the Business Object STOCK_TRANSFER_PROPOSAL is PSM released with read access. This BO is not write enabled and there are no plans for write enablement in the near future.-Note:Currently there is no web service  available which is meant only to create Stock Transfer Proposal.-Keywords-A2X, web-services, stock transfer proposal, stock transfer order, Web Service Name for Stock Transfer Proposal

Title: Production Make Task Confirmation Date and the Journal Entry created  date against the Production Confirmation do not match
Content: Symptom-You observe Posting Date of Journal entry on KLM  does not match with Source Document id as DEF(Production Make Task)*KLM refers to Journal entry Date,*DEF refers to Production Make task execution date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control  Work Center-Navigate to  By Order Header View-Search for relevant Production Order-Select Edit-Navigate to Document Flow-Select relevant Production Make Task -Click Confirm-Navigate to Instruction tab-We see Actual Start Date  as KLM-Cause-To have the Journal posted Date reflect in same date you have to manually Start the Production Tasks and maintain the Processed On date.-Resolution-Kindly maintain same date for the Start and also Finish and the Journal Entry created against the Confirmation has a Posting Date of the maintained Processed On date.-You can manually start the Task by following the below steps:- 1. Go to Production Control workcenter and Task Control view- 2. Select the Production Task and Confirm- 3. Click the Change Status button and select Start- In the popup window enter the start date, this date will be considered as the production start date.-Keywords-Production Make Task Confirmation Date and the Journal Entry created  date against the Production Confirmation do not match, Posting Date on KLM  for Source Document id as DEF(Production Make Task)

Title: Outbound Delivery Performance by Time Report is not allowing you to add more fields from "Order ID".
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add more fields from Field "Order id" from Report Outbound Delivery Performance by Time, However System is not listing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Go to Design Reports View-Search for Outbound Delivery Performance by Time-Run report-Switch to View-Try to add more fields by clicking on + symbol  (You see that you cannot expand the Order ID item to select more fields from Sales Order Header)-Cause- The Master Data reference of field  "Order ID" was removed in 2008 release.-Resolution-When this master data reference was in place data source will show only sales order deliveries, but stock transfer order, service order, and project stock orders etc. deliveries was not getting displayed.  Due to this issue, the master data reference for the "Order ID" field is removed. This is why "Order ID" field is not expandable in the report.-Keywords- add more fields from Field "Order id" from Report Outbound Delivery Performance by Time, Outbound Delivery Performance by Time Report is not allowing you to add more fields from "Order ID".

Title: Report Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity does not pull information for  partial shipments
Content: Symptom-When we run report Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity with  KLM as Shipment Date, nothing shows up for the sales order DEF.*KLM refers to Shipment Date,*DEF refers to Sales Order Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center -Navigate to Design Reports View -Search for Report Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity-When we select date KLM as Shipment Date, nothing shows for the sales order, then on the report when we pass Shipment date  as KLM the first line shows-Cause-Due too few filters on the key figures, the Sales Order DEF is not visible in the report data.-Resolution-Go to Business Analytics Work Center -Navigate to Design Reports View -Search for Report Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity-Navigate to the Keyfigures in the View Tab-Click the Value Filters-You will find that the below filters are active. Uncheck the first two filters.-Refresh the report. If the Sales order DEF is still not visible, select the other key figures as shown below.-Keywords-Report Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity does not pull information for  partial shipments, When we run report Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity with as Shipment Date, nothing shows up for the sales order,  Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity, Outbound Delivery Performance by Time

Title: Possible Duplicate Exception With Supplier Invoice Uploaded Via Excel
Content: Symptom- Supplier Invoices created via excel upload are displaying the exception 'Possible Duplicate'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memo view.-Search and open the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Supplier Invoice).-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Exceptions tab. -System displays the Exception 'Possible Duplicate' and it is already Obsoleted. Supplier Invoice status is then Ready for Posting.-Cause-In the Business Configuration activity 'Supplier Invoice Exceptions' > 'Possible Duplicate', the External Document ID - Similarity (%) is defined as 80%.-The External Document IDs of the Supplier Invoices that system is detecting as possible duplicate are very similar. Hence the exception is raised.-Resolution-We suggest to adjust the 'External Document ID - Similarity (%)' to 100% to prevent this exception from happening while uploading the Supplier Invoices via excel. The configuration can be maintained as per following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the Supplier Invoice Exceptions activity.-Select Possible Duplicate as Exception type.-Change the External Document ID - Similarity (%) field to 100%.-Once this configuration is maintained, the exception should not occur for these cases that the External Document ID is very similar.-Keywords-Possible Duplicate, Exception, Supplier Invoice, Excel-

Title: Key Figure Counter Missing in the Purchase Order Report
Content: Symptom-You have executed Monitoring purchase order report however the key figure Counter is not available for selection under key figure selection list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center -Go to the Design Reports view -Select Monitoring purchase order report-Execute the report and in the key figure section, Counter field is missing for selection -Cause-The key figure Counter is already added in the Monitoring Purchase Orders report however the key figure needs to be added manually from the below steps.-Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Go to the Design Reports view -Select the Monitoring Purchase Orders report-Edit With -Browser and execute the report -On the top right hand pane, you have the button called Configure-Click on the button Configure and select Add Fields-Click on key Figures tab -Select the Counter Field and select OK-Keywords-Counter field missing in the Purchase Order Report; Counter key figure; Counter; Counter field missing

Title: Project Purchase Request Not Converted to Purchase Request after Approval
Content: Symptom-You have approved a project purchase request, but it keeps in status Not Released and not converted to purchase request automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Open project ABC (ABC refers to project ID)-Go to Products tab, Purchase Request Approvals subtab, you see the approval process of project purchase request ABC-1 is already finished-Go to Products tab, Purchase Requests subtab-You see project purchase request ABC-1 is still in the list, not converted to purchase request, and the status is Not Released.-Cause-Project purchase request ABC-1 is saved as draft version.-Resolution-You need to finish the project purchase request by following steps.-Go to Products tab,  Purchase Requests subtab-Select any item of project purchase request ABC-1, press Edit-In the pop up window, press Finish-Save the change-Project purchase request ABC-1 will be released and converted to purchase request.-Keywords-Project Purchase Request, Not Convert, Purchase Request Not Generated,  Project Purchase Request Approval
