Content: EXTRACT_ERROR

Title: Error When Confirming Unload Task as Planned
Content: Symptom- You are trying to confirm as planned the Unload Task XXX. However an error is faced.-XXX = Unload Task ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Select Task Control view. -Search for task XXX. -Select task XXX. -Click Confirm as Planned. -You face the error:-None of 1 warehouse tasks confirmed-Cause- The Actual Delivery Date in the related Inbound Delivery is in the future. Hence Confirm as Planned is not possible.-Resolution-You need to confirm the Unload Task XXX manually:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Select Task Control view. -Search for task XXX. -Select task XXX. -Click Confirm. -Enter all the necessary information. -Click Save-Keywords-Task, confirmation, warehouse

Title: Unable to Complete Project due to Error "Cannot complete task ABC; sales order item not delivered"
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to change the status of a Project to Closed, error "Cannot complete task ABC; sales order item not delivered" is shown. (Where ABC represents the Project Task ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Open the Projects view.-Find and open Project DEF (Where DEF represents the Project ID).-Click the Project Plan tab.-Under Basic Data, change the status to Closed.-Error "Cannot complete task ABC; sales order item not delivered" will be shown.-Cause-In cases where the item type in the Sales Order is a Service, you might still need to manually complete the execution of the item in order to fulfill it's Delivery Status.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find and open Sales Order GHI (Where GHI represents the Sales Order ID).-Click on Submit and select Complete Service Execution. -Keywords-Project, Sales Order, Execution, Fulfillment, Delivery, Fulfillment, Task, Assignment, Unable

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2008 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following are the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2008 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 17th of October. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2008 HFC 3-Resolution-Cross – Area Topic-Analytics-When a parameter was added based on a compounded characteristic using the 'Add Fields' functionality of the analysis pattern, the compounding was not considered correctly, resulting in duplicates. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009832)-The error causing wrong selections related to addresses in supplier's financial data reports, has now been fixed in the FSI view. (Hotfix ID: 1000009066)-Information Lifecycle Management-The dump appearing in the Lifecycle Items view is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010881. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Installation Point-The issue with the number of records in the paging of the Registered Products Query web service is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009236)-Output Management-The latest version of Cloud Print Manager in download center is now updated. (Hotfix ID: 1000009127)-Service Control Center-In the Service Control Centre, Restore Point Deletion has now been optimized. (Hotfix ID: 1000008277)-Service Control Centre now shows the correct display of customer system. (Hotfix ID: 1000007276)-UI Client-While using the Quartz Dark theme, field color/CSS was appearing incorrectly for some fields. One such place/field was in the Change of Stock common task. For step 2, the Product On-Hand Quantity field was not readable because the incorrect cell background was being applied. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000002168)-When Maintenance Services and Service Cause by type O was used in a field, an error was shown to report the incident. This issue has been fixed and you can now type text in the field. (Hotfix ID: 1000009397)-The issue with opening the journal entry after refreshing the document flow, has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009397)-Scanning the QR code for Android app used to open the Apple Store link instead of the Google Play Store. This has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009397)-Workplace Embedded Knowledge Transfer-A new link has been added to the help center that details the information on the upcoming 2011 release. (Hotfix ID: 1000010365)-  Customer Relationship Management-Activity-The search function for My team's activities query and Customer Name has been fixed in My Activities and My team's activities query, for Activity Management mobile app. (Hotfix ID: 1000009546)-Customer Contract-When a contract is created as a follow-up from Quote for Contract, the corresponding Contract ID is now visible in the document flow. (Hotfix ID: 1000010611)-Customer Invoice-Customer Invoice cancellation was not getting saved when the initial posting date was blocked in accounting. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009222. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-This fix contains updates to the QR code as per the recent QR code procedure released by NIC. Now the QR code is verified using the official mobile application released by NIC. (Hotfix ID: 1000006106. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-A fix to fetch proper ship-to party and bill-to party state codes in India Customer Invoice Print Form. (Hotfix ID: 1000009144)-The following changes have been made to India E-Invoice schema v1.03:-Surcharges have been added to Total Amount as per the recent NIC validation on assessable amount.-The Issue with Total Amount calculation in Stock Transfer Delivery has been fixed.-Tax Collected at Source (TCS) changes that go-live on October 1st have been included.-Original invoice date on Debit Note from XML has been made available. (Hotfix ID: 1000009016. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-For Croatia, the issue of not being able to release the cancellation invoice for customer invoice is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000005568)-Customer Migration Template-Customer Migration Template has now been enhanced with South Korea tax number related fields. (Hotfix ID: 1000009925. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Customer Return-Customer return can be created out of inbound delivery with reference to sales orders that have external payment method. (Hotfix ID: 1000009079)-Incorrect exchange rate was being picked for first item of return created with reference to an invoice, when there are different exchange rates maintained in the system, on posting date of return and invoice date of the invoice. This issue is now fixed. The issue was occurring due to the incorrect pricing date determined for first item for a return document. (Hotfix ID: 1000011030)-Quotation-Workflow notifications were not getting created for processor of service quote documents, when the responsibility determination in workflow rule was set to processor. This issue is now fixed. The issue was caused due to the processor not getting determined for the responsibility determination. (Hotfix ID: 1000008249)-Sales Orders-Delivery priority update through A2X/OData service was failing for sales orders with cancelled items. Changes have now been made to ensure that cancelled sales order items update delivery priority from header to fix the issue. (Hotfix ID: 1000009166)-  Financial Management-Bank Statement-When the bank statement file format for ISO20022 was being uploaded in the system, the transaction related memo lines were not entirely mapped to the bank statement items. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010132)-Due Payment Run-The internal error for Due Payment Run during netting indicator updation is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009494)-Expense Report-If you have activated the scoping question Expense Reporting Previous Cost Assignment, you will now get an error message if the expense report purpose is missing. To switch this error message off, you must create an incident under AP-ERM-ER. (Hotfix ID: 1000008687)-Financial Accounting-The E-Bilanz Transfer client software has been incremented to version 31.7.8.0 to fix the errors with downloading.  (Hotfix ID: 1000011721)-General Ledger-Partner Company was not getting derived correctly for certain accounting document items (e.g. Cost Center ledger) for countries where Reconciliation Account derivation was being implemented. The ledger items where partner company was not being derived were mostly related to Cost Center/ Overhead Cost Ledger. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010313)-Inventory-Actual Cost Rollup was resulting in an error when there was a wider selection in input. The provided fix eliminates the error. (Hotfix ID: 1000007886)-Payment Management-For Japan Accounts that are set as invoice summary customers, payment terms field is now visible in Sales data section. Upon maintaining, the same gets determined in sales orders created against such accounts. (Hotfix ID: 1000011290)-Public Sector-In Public Sector Edition, financial reports were not handling the companies with reporting principle Grants & Fund with a split. The provided fix now enhances the current report logic and list companies with this reporting principles. (Hotfix ID: 1000007327)-In Public Sector enabled tenants, the fields Fund and Function ID were not displayed while creating Supplier Invoice, due to incorrect company ID generation in the code. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000008441)-Statutory Reporting-GL accounts provided as filter during MX eAccounting run were ignored. Due to this, the generated PDF file contained GL accounts outside the provided filter. It was leading to incorrectly calculated amounts in PDF file. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000011250)-Tax Declaration-The tax code 541 has now been removed from the default tax code for down payment request. (Hotfix ID: 1000011320)-For India, Tax Collected at Source (TCS) relevant tax codes for the supplier are now delivered. These are non-deductible taxes. (Hotfix ID: 1000004078. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The current validation logic for the RFC Number for Mexico country needed change as per the standard format for the Mexico RFC Number. The character 'Ñ' was not being accepted by the SAP Business ByDesign system until now. The provided fix enables the system to accept 'Ñ' as a valid character for a Mexico RFC Number. (Hotfix ID: 1000009716)-For Spain, a new tax code 504, Supply of Goods and Services, Reverse Charge, has been created to handle the reverse charge scenario. The subject of the new code is 'No exempt' with the tax rate as 0%. The document using this tax code gets reported in the 'Tax Return', 'Modelo 340', 'Modelo 340 - Substitution', and 'SII - Outgoing Invoices' tax returns. In all the tax returns except SII - Outgoing Invoices tax return, documents using tax code 504 get reported in the returns.-For the SII- Outgoing Invoices tax return, in addition to the reporting of the document, the mapping will be as follows:-On header level, the subject should be 'No exempt'. Tax type 'S2' or 'S3' is to be filled, depending on the content of the document. If all lines of the document are subject to reverse charge (in this case, tax event 504) the tax type must be 'S2'. If only some of the lines of the document are subject to reverse charge and others are not, the tax type must be 'S3'. If both the mentioned conditions are not applicable (all lines of the document are not subject to reverse charge), the existing tax type 'S1' will be filled.-On line item level, tax rate and tax amount are zero for the line items subject to reverse charge. There will be no automatic tax determination for this tax event. The end user will have to manually select the tax code 504 during creation of the document. (Hotfix ID: 1000008987)-The BE Tax event 485: EU Sale of Goods and Distance Selling, is now mapped to the Belgium VAT returns. (Hotfix ID: 1000010442)-The validation logic for VAT Registration Number of the country, Malta, has now been changed to comply with the standard format for that country (MT + 8 digits). A valid Malta VAT Registration Number in the standard format will henceforth be accepted by the SAP Business ByDesign system. (Hotfix ID: 1000008067)-  Human Resources-Analytics-Forecasted Utilization report now shows the correct aggregation for Forecasted Utilization key figures, in the Result Row for Employee. (Hotfix ID: 1000010204)-An extension field, 'Compensation Woc-Employees-Compensation File of Employee' has been added to the Deduction tab of Compensation details. The fields added can be viewed in the reports. (Hotfix ID: 1000009562. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  Project Management-Project-In SAP Cloud Applications Studio, when you create a web service based on the Business Object Project, you create or update the nodes TaskExpense or TaskRevenue. You can then update the element GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode. While executing the web service, the system responds with the error message "Changing GEN_LEDG_ACCOUNT_ALIAS_C-LIST_ID not possible; field is disabled” and rejects the creation or update. With this hotfix, the system processes the creation or update of TaskExpense or TaskRevenue successfully. (Hotfix ID: 1000010271)-The Project screen was showing incorrect titles, "Pane Header for Tab Strip" and "Pane Header for Tab". This issue has been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 1000000477)-BC scoping question 'Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on planned work specified at the task level of a project?' could not be activated as the field was read-only. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010332)-  Supply Chain Management-Analytics-SCMODPB01 data source was not displaying the stock transfer orders created while searching with the Order ID. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010871)-On querying the Stock Overview Data source SCMINVV02 with IdentifiedStock IDs, where their Product IDs had '/' character, the data source used to throw Invalid Istock reference error. The issue was with the existing logic in the invert selection mapping method of SCM_ISTOCK MDAV. This has now been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000011341)-Production Lot-The Production model now becomes inconsistent if you change Obsolete Bills of Material to Un-obsolete Bills of Material. This was caused because the Obsolete Bills of Material variant and Obsolete Bills of Operation checkboxes were not getting cleared when the change was being made in the production model. (Hotfix ID: 1000009026)-SerialNumberAssignment node of ProductionTask.ReferencedObject.ProductionLotConfirmationGroup.MaterialInput is now read-enabled for Public Solution Model. (Hotfix ID: 1000005917)-Write access is now enabled for Node SERVICE_PROD_CONSUMPTION in Production_Lot BO for the following fields:-ConfirmationCompletedIndicator-ConfirmServiceProductKey-ConfirmServiceProductQuantity-CurrentTotalConfirmedServiceProductQuantity-TotalConfirmedServiceProductQuantity (Hotfix ID: 1000002306)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Purchase Order-Price changes can now be made for Purchase Order Acknowledgements for Partially Invoice Purchase Orders. (Hotfix ID: 1000006866. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Supplier Invoice-The issue with synchronization of the vendor master data in invoice scanning caused due to escape character (\), has been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000010822. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g. operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2008; HFC03; Hotfix; SPS03; Hotfix Collection; 2008

Title: How to Upload Demand Final Forecast using Excel
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to upload Demand Final Forecast using Microsoft Excel.*DEF refers to Demand Plan Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To upload Demand Forecast key figure values, user has to follow the below steps-Step-1-Go To Demand Planning Work Center-Go To Demand Plans View-Find and Search for any Demand Plan-Click Upload-Fill The Data In Excel-Save The Excel Data-Step-2-Demand Plan need to be released after uploading the Demand Forecast Key Figure Values- User has to manually release the Demand Plan --Go To Demand Planning Work Center-Go To Demand Plans View-Find Demand Plan DEF-Select Release-  Step-3-To check the updated Key Figure Forecast values, Go Back To Business ByDesign System-Go To Supply Planning Work Center-Select Common Tasks-Select Maintain Demand Forecast-Choose The Product ID and select Period Type -Execute The Query-Forecast Values Updated Under Forecast Planning Table (for instance: Final Forecast)-Keywords-How to Upload Demand Final Forecast using Excel, To check the updated Key Figure Forecast values, Demand Plan need to release after uploading the Demand Forecast Key Figure Values

Title: Pick Task quantity & Delivery Request Quantity is higher than Requested Quantity of Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You observe Sales order KLM created for m quantity of product DEF, However in the delivery request and Pick Task Delivery Quantity is n.*KLM refers to Sales Order id, m refers to quantity defined in Sales Order, DEF refers to Product id, n refers to quantity populated in Delivery Request and Pick Task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Delivery Requests View-Search for Sales Order KLM -You observe Delivery Request  quantity is n, However Sales Order quantity is m-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Task Control View-Search for Pick Task-You observe Pick Task quantity is n, However Sales Order quantity is m-Cause-During confirmation of pick task User entered n quantity instead of m quantity which resulted in quantity populating n in Total Requested Quantity in Outbound Delivery Request  Warehouse Request, Warehouse Order & Pick Task.-Resolution-In Pick Task, User is allowed to enter over and above requested quantity, there is no hard stop here, Hence Pick Task quantity n & Delivery Request Quantity n is higher than Requested Quantity of Sales Order m. This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Pick Task quantity, Delivery Request Quantity,  higher, Sales Order, sales order quantity

Title: Error When Performing Consumption for Cost Center
Content: Symptom-When you are performing a Consumption for Cost Center for the Site XXX, the error is faced:-3PL site not allowed for the process-XXX = Site ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Select Consumption for Cost Center common task.-Enter the Site XXX-You receive the error:-3PL site not allowed for the process-Cause-Consumption for Cost Center is not allowed for 3PL Site.-Resolution-As the consumption is not allowed, the system is working as designed.-Keywords-Consumption, Third-Party, 3PL

Title: Check box: Specification of time duration in Payment terms
Content: Symptom-You want to  know how Specification of duration check box works-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to  implementation Projects view-Go to fine tune activity-Search for Activity Suppliers-Click on Define Payment Terms for Procurement-Click on Add row-Enter the  payment term ID starting with Z-Enter the description-You will see this check box available however if you click on enter button on your key board this check box gets disappeared- also- if you select the standard payment terms from 001 to 007 then you willsee that  this check box is enabled to be used. if you check mark it then you will se that  values  in the  fields"Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date" are disappeared.-Cause-This check box is used if don't want to enter in field"Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date but only  fixed day of month and additional month only is allowed.-Resolution- Currently you can only use the check box for standard payment terms 001 to 007-and also currently you cannot use  it in new Z payment terms as well-Keywords-unable to use Specification of time duration ,  issue while creating new payment term

Title: Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally Checkbox Greyed Out in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When adding an item with Item Type Additional Cost Debit Item to a Supplier Invoice, the checkbox Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally is automatically marked and grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the New Invoice Without Purchase Order common task.-Provide the mandatory details like Supplier, External Document ID, Invoice Date, Receipt Date and Posting Date.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-On the Basic Data sub-tab, select Type as Additional Cost Debit Item from the dropdown menu.-Go to the sub-tab Cost Distribution.-There you can see checkbox Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally checked and grayed out.-Cause-This is a standard behavior of the system. For Item Type Additional Costs Debit Item, the system does not to allow the removing of this checkbox.-Resolution-If you need to have the checkbox Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally unmarked, you can do the following workaround:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the New Invoice Without Purchase Order common task.-Provide the mandatory details like Supplier, External Document ID, Invoice Date, Receipt Date and Posting Date.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-On the Basic Data sub-tab, select Type as Invoice Item or Credit Memo Item.-See Also-2531871 - The Indicator Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally on Purchase Order is Automatically set to true value while creating Purchase Order via Web Services-Keywords-Distribute, Additional Costs, item, type, Debit Item, Supplier Invoice, checkbox, grayed out, marked, automatically

Title: You are Unable to Create Shopping Cart in SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App Without Selecting Items from Catalog
Content: Symptom-You have installed SAP Business ByDesign mobile app and you are trying to create a shopping cart. However, you are unable to select items like you do in standard system. You only have option to select items from catalog.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to Business ByDesign tenant using mobile Application-You will see a tile to create shopping cart-When you open this, it only gives you option to select items from catalog-You cannot add product without using catalog-Cause-Right now, only items from Catalog can be added via shopping cart mobile app.-Search on shopping cart mobile app only looks through products in published catalogs.-Resolution-Kindly create and publish a catalog to make use of shopping cart mobile app for SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-ByD shopping cart mobile app, catalog, unable to create shopping cart in mobile app

Title: Error appears "Restricted Serial Numbers are not allowed for product " when trying to create New Inbound Delivery from Customer Return Notification
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create New Return Inbound Delivery from Customer Return Notification KLM, Error appears.*KLM refers  to Return Notification id,*DEF refers to Serial Number, GHI refers to Product id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics Work Center -Navigate to Inbound Delivery Notifications View-Search for KLM-Click New Inbound Delivery-Maintain parameters like External Delivery Id, External Delivery Item id -For Serial Number DEF, Check Restricted -Error appears-Restricted Serial Numbers are not allowed for product GHI  -Cause-As Serial Number profile maintained for Product GHI is optional, Hence this error appears.-Note: Error appears even when Serial Number is changed to Mandatory on Transfer to /from Customers / Suppliers/Sites except Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Process.-Resolution-You will  have to switch serial number profile to "Mandatory on all Logistics and Production process"  for the product to make the  quantity as restricted for the new transaction.-Keywords-Restricted Serial Numbers are not allowed for product, You are trying to create New Return Inbound Delivery from Customer Return Notification, Error appears even when Serial Number is changed to Mandatory on Transfer to /from Customers / Suppliers/Sites except Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Process, Error appears "Restricted Serial Numbers are not allowed for product " when trying to create New Inbound Delivery from Customer Return Notification

Title: You are Getting Unexpected Error when Trying to Cancel a Supplier Invoice Associated with Project Task
Content: Symptom-You are trying to cancel a supplier invoice which has account assignment as Project Task, but you encounter error/dump whenever you try to take an action on the supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view and select All Documents-Search for the Supplier invoice in the search bar-Select respective supplier invoice associated with the project task-Select View All and click the "Cancel Document" Button or check-System dumps-Cause-There can be multiple reasons. In this case, please check the status of the project task which is associated with the supplier invoice.-Here, the status of the project task is closed, hence system will not allow you to take an action on the invoice.-Resolution-Please select "Revoke Closure" in the project task and header status.-You can do it in project plan->select the project header and then select respective task-> basic data-> project status.-Then you can take action on the invoice.-Keywords-Project task in supplier invoice, project task closed, cancel supplier invoice, revoke closure, dump in supplier invoice

Title: You are Unable to Post the Supplier Invoice after Changing Gross Amount
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice with multiple line items and have made changes in the header gross amount.-Then you tried to post the invoice but you receive an unexpected error/dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the respective supplier invoice-Select view all and under General tab, change the header gross amount-Select save and post-You receive an unexpected error/dump-Cause-You have manually changed the gross amount at header level in the supplier invoice without adjusting the item amounts. This has caused inconsistency in the invoice.-If you want to change the total gross amount, you have to adjust the item amounts so that they sum up to the same value.-Resolution-You can adjust the amounts on item level as per your required gross amount, then click action-> calculate total amount and then post the invoice.-Keywords-supplier invoice dump, gross amount, unexpected error

Title: You are Unable to Assign an Unassigned Supplier Invoice Exception Task
Content: Symptom-There is an unassigned task in Business Task Management: "Clarify Invoice Exception for Supplier Invoice".-You are trying to assign this task but you could not find any available employee in the value help.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Application and User Management-Select View Business Task Management-Show Unassigned Items-Select the Task with the following subject: Clarify Invoice Exception for Supplier Invoice-Click Actions -> Assign Items-Click the Value help for the To field-Execute the Query: No records found-Cause-You are unable to assign the task manually because the invoice document was voided before clearing the task, hence no employee is found in the value help.-Resolution-Please ensure to clear all open tasks before voiding the invoice document to avoid such deadlock situation.-Keywords-Clarify Invoice Exception for Supplier Invoice, unassigned task.

Title: The Project Purchase Request is Created with Assignment to Project Header instead of  Specific Project Task
Content: Symptom-You have created the Project Purchase Request and the request is created with account assignment to project header but not with specific project task assignment.-You have to manually update the Project Task in each line item in the purchase document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Navigate to Products tab-Select the product and create project purchase request-The account assignment in the purchase request and the follow-up purchase order shows the header project ID and not the project task ID-Cause-You are creating project purchase request for whole project, so available products will be picked for project purchase request creation and project header will be assigned in account assignment field.-Resolution-Please create project purchase request with respect to the particular project task.-You can do so in Project screen->products-> select product-> create purchase request with respect to released project task.-Keywords-Project Task, Project Purchase Request, Account assignment in project purchase request.

Title: "System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime" Error When Trying to Create a New List Price
Content: Symptom-Dump message "System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime" when trying to create a New List Price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the New List Price common task.-On the screen: 1 Define Settings, add the necessary data, including Supplier, Company and Product Category.-Click on Next button.-The system shows loading bubbles, and after 10 minutes loading it shows a dump message.-Cause-The error message shown is regarding a time-out issue. It is triggered because the Product Category selected on the scenario has a large number of Products related to it. Since there is a large amount of products trying to load to the next screen, the result is a time-out error.-Resolution- For this case, you can do the following work-around:-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the New List Price common task.-On the screen: 1 Define Settings, add the necessary data, leaving Product Category field empty.-Click on Next button.-On the screen: 2 Enter Price, enter the required Product ID.-This scenario should work if you wish to create a List Price for a limited number of products. If you wish to do a mass upload of all products under the Product Category, then you can use the Excel upload of the List Price, or a Web Service upload. Since these are channels better suited to handle a large volume of data, they will work better than entering the data on the UI.-Keywords-List Price, stuck, loading, dump, message, System Maintenance, Temporary System Downtime

Title: HSN Code Not Available in Supplier Invoice Excel Upload
Content: Symptom-HSN Code not available in Supplier Invoice Excel upload.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memo view.-Click on New > Import from Microsoft Excel.-Download the excel file.- HSN Code is not available in the file.-Cause-Currently in the system the HSN Code will be defaulted from the product or service master data for Excel upload.-For Free Text Items, it is necessary to select the HSN/SAC codes manually in the invoice.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. The HSN Code field is currently offered via webservice only so it is possible to create a custom Excel to upload via the webservice.-Keywords-HSN Code, Supplier Invoice, Excel

Title: Actual Sales Values Displayed in The Planning Board do Not Match With The Actual Sales Data From The System
Content: Symptom-You execute a Demand Plan and notice that the actual sales values do not match with the actual sales data from the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to the work centre Demand Planning. -View Demand Plans. -Select the Demand Plan ABC (ABC represents the ID of your Demand Plan). -Click the Plan button. -Click the Planning Board Layout button and select Maximal Layout. -Change the Function from Copy Actuals to Copy Statistical Forecast. -Click on Run Function. -Cause-The system currently excludes the Third-Party Outbound Deliveries from Demand Planning which may cause a mismatch between the actual sales data in Demand Planning and the one shown in the Sales Order Volume report.-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour of the system.-Keywords-demand plan, actual sales,

Title: Error in Credit Memo: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item
Content: Symptom-You encountered following error in Credit Memo even though the quantity or amount did not exceed the total quantity and amount of preceding supplier invoice:-"The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center -Select view: Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the Credit Memo which is in exception-Select View All-Navigate to Exceptions tab-Error: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item-Cause-In cost distribution of the credit memo, the reference item is invoice id-line item (e.g. XXX.1) Here XXX refers to preceding supplier invoice id and 1 refers to the line item.-In the supplier invoice cost distribution, the reference item (XXX.1) shows amount less than the amount in the credit memo.-This is why the error occurs in the credit memo.-Resolution-Please change the amount in the Credit Memo to the original reference amount as specified in the Supplier Invoice reference.-See Also-1961534 - Cannot Post Credit Memo. Error: "Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount".- 2745111 - Error: 'The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item' while Creating Supplier Invoice with Reduced Quantity-Keywords-Credit Memo exception, sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts, cost distribution

Title: Dump During Release of Third Party Delivery Notification XYZ
Content: Symptom-You would like to Release Third Party Delivery Notification XYZ but you encounter a system dump(where XYZ is the Third Party Delivery  Notification ID)-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Third-Party Order Fulfillment workcenter-2. Go to Third-Party Delivery Notifications view.-3. Search Third-Party Delivery Notifications  XYZ-4. Select Third-Party Delivery Notifications  XYZ and Release-Dump occurs-Cause-The error occurs after the "Undo Release" action is taken in Third-Party Delivery Notification and then the reference  documents are changed.-Now when the Third-Party Delivery Notification is released, the error occurs.-Resolution-This is a new bug that will be fixed in future releases, we have identified a workaround.-When you would like to make changes to a Third-Party Delivery Notification item, you need to add a new row and fill in the reference details and then cancel the item that you are changing.-You can then release the Third-Party Delivery Notification.-Keywords-Third-Party Delivery Notification, Release, Reference Document, Undo Release, dump

Title: Error Message: SAC for ABC not maintained
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice of country India due to error message:-SAC for ABC (ABC refers to a service product ID) not maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice and Credit Memos view-Open the supplier invoice-Go to Exception tab-You see the above error.-Cause-The tax country of the supplier invoice is India.-In country India, it is mandatory to maintain:-HSN code for materials.-SAC (Service Accounting Code) for services.-Resolution-You need to maintain the SAC code for service ABC.-Open the master data of service ABC-Go to General tab-Maintain the SAC code in field: Accounting Code of the Service-*If you cannot find the field in the service master data screen, you might have not scoped country India in your system yet. Please go to Business Configuration, add country India in your system scope.  Then perform above steps.-After the SAC maintained for service ABC, the error in supplier invoice will be obsoleted.-See Also-Help Document: Goods and Services Tax – India-Keywords-Service Accounting Code; SAC; SAC Not Maintained; Accounting Code of the Service; Supplier Invoice Exception

Title: How Can we Add The Deviation Reason in Physical Inventory Count Document Using  Microsoft Excel File
Content: Symptom-You would like to confirm Physical Inventory Count Document with Deviation Reason using  Microsoft Excel File .-But in the Excel template you do not find the field Deviation Reason.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-N/A-Cause-As per the current design behavior we do not support the feature of adding Deviation Reason using the Microsoft Excel template to confirm the Physical Inventory Count Document.-Resolution-Deviation Reason has to be updated manually in the UI for Physical Inventory Count Document-Keywords-Physical Inventory Count Document, Deviation Reason, Microsoft Excel, Template,

Title: In Supply to Production Task output form Line Items are not sorted
Content: Symptom-You observe Supply to Production Task KLM Output form is not sorted line items by the Source Logistics Area ID in ascending order.*KLM refers to Supply Task-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center-Navigate to Task Control View-Search and Select  Supply Task KLM  -Select Preview-Cause-Scoping Question "Do you want to sort your supply task list by logistics area in ascending order?" is not scoped.-Resolution-In order to scope, Follow the below steps-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Select relevant Implementation Project-Select Edit Project Scope-Select Next Thrice to arrive at Step 4: Questions-Select Scoping Element Production-Select Supply Task Sorting-Scope Question "Do you want to sort your supply task list by logistics area in ascending order?" -Select Next to Save the Changes-Keywords-Sorting sequence in Supply to Production Task output form, Do you want to sort your supply task list by logistics area in ascending order?

Title: How to retrieve Code List for the Element OutputRequestFormTemplateCode (ManageGoodTags) Using the Webservice II_QUERY_CODE_LIST_IN
Content: Symptom-You are using the web service "ManageGoodTags" to create labels, but you are unable to choose the output forms from the web service. However, you can see that there is an Element that is called "OutputRequestFormTemplateCode", but you cannot find any information about the values accepted by this tag.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There is a generic web service - II_QUERY_CODE_LIST_IN - to fetch the code list and its values. You can use the same to get the code list of the Element OutputRequestFormTemplateCode.-Resolution-A sample payload (for English language code) would be:-<n0:CodeListByIDQuery_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<CodeListSelectionByID>-<SelectionByCodeDataType>-<Name>OutputRequestFormTemplateCode</Name>-<NamespaceURI>http://sap.com/xi/AP/Common/GDT</NamespaceURI>-</SelectionByCodeDataType>-<SelectionByLanguageCode>EN</SelectionByLanguageCode>-</CodeListSelectionByID>-</n0:CodeListByIDQuery_sync>-You can find further explanation on how to use this query in this blog post: https://blogs.sap.com/2015/03/12/how-to-get-bydesign-code-lists-via-web-service/-See Also- How to get ByDesign Code Lists via Web Service QueryCodeListIn-Keywords-Label, Labels, Code List, GoodsTag, Production, Outbound Delivery, OutputRequestFormTemplateCode

Title: Cannot Add Location to Logistics Task Folder
Content: Symptom-You are unable to add the Location YYY to the Logistics Task Folder XXX.-XXX - Logistics Task Folder ID.-YYY - Location ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center. -Select Logistics Task Folders view. -Find Folder XXX. -Open the Folder XXX.-Click View All. -Select Task Assignment Criteria tab. -Select Storage Location. -Click Add Item for Included Items. -Enter the Location YYY. -Click Ok. -Nothing happens and the Location is not added. -Cause-The system cannot add the Location because the Location ID has leading zero. In the backend, the system tries to search for the Location ID without the leading zeros, so it fails.-Resolution-As the system cannot add the Location with leading zeros, the system is working as expected.-Creating Location ID with leading zeros is not advised.

Title: Purchase request ID not appearing for few or all respective purchase order items in report :Purchase  order history
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2774290***-In the standard report "Purchase  order history" we see that for few Purchase order items the respective Purchase request Id is not appearing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-currently there a limitation that this report "Purchase  order history" does not display Purchase request ID if the respective purchase order item has any follow up documents.-Resolution-You can proceed with using another Data Source "Purchase Order Delivery Reliability" or building a report on top of the data source to have these details.-Keywords-Purchase request item ID

Title: Error appears "Release not possible at item level of sales kit" when trying to release Customer Demand with Kit Item and Non Kit Item
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Release with Stock Check for  Customer Demand KLM by selecting all line items including Kit items(Header & Item) and Non Kit items, Error appears-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center -Navigate to Customer Demand View-Search for KLM -Select all line items including Kit items(Header & Item) and Non Kit items and select Release with Stock Check-Error appears-Release not possible at item level of sales kit-Cause-Release of Sales kit can only happen  at the header level – which is what the error message suggests – also, the ATP result is also available on the kit header.-Resolution-Hence, whenever user tries to release kit item he/she would encounter this error and release is possible only at header level  and not at item level.This is the expected behaviour as designed.-Keywords-Release not possible at item level of sales kit, by selecting all line items including Kit items(Header & Item) and Non Kit items

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2008 Hotfix Collection 2 Information
Content: Symptom-Following are the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 2 performed in 2008 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 18th of September. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2008 HFC 2-Resolution-Cross – Area Topic-Analytics-The csv download based on data sources now supports compounded characteristics. (Hotfix ID: 1000009603)-Account Management-When using multiple code list mapping for outbound processing of Accounts and Contacts with the Account IDOC services, the system was unable to determine which Code List Mapping to use. After this correction, the system now uses the one maintained in the corresponding communication arrangement. (Hotfix ID: 4500004468)-Business Configuration-Performance has been improved while opening and processing business configuration fine tuning views in remote change projects. (Hotfix ID: 4500008066)-Countries-For India, the region code list has been adopted based on the "THE DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI AND DAMAN AND DIU (MERGER OF UNION TERRITORIES) ACT, 2019".-Code 28 now comprises the complete merged territory. The description is maintained as "Dadra Nagar Daman Di".-Code 29 cannot be used any longer, and its description has been changed to obsolete. In the fine-tuning activity for regions, you can flag the code as obsolete, to prevent the code from appearing in value helps. (Hotfix ID: 1000008667)-Output Management-The download center is now updated with the latest Cloud Print Manager version. (Hotfix ID: 4500007648. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Transformation ID in Communication Arrangement business object is marked as PSM released. (Hotfix ID: 4500009341)-SAP Support Request Processing-When user adds a note for provider for an incident, and if the status is not changed to provider action for that incident, then an appropriate error message now gets displayed. (Hotfix ID: 4500010050)-Suppliers-On the Supplier business object, the attribute MinimumPurchaseOrder is now released for usage in the Cloud Application Studio. (Hotfix ID: 4500009496. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-UI Client-The issue with white text not appearing on a white background is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000008075)-When the filter was being used in the Payment Monitor view to execute a query, the result was coming up different from the one where filter was not used. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500006818)-The product description was not searchable in the report. The issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008119)-The issue with the new Quartz Dark theme is now fixed. Earlier, the key figures were lacking in visual contrast. (Hotfix ID: 4500008119)-Issues with the value help for cost assignment type in expense reports is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008119)-The alignment issues with the follow up documents section is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009612)-HTML mashup transfer of parameter error is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009003)-The Dark/Light Mode feature error is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009003)-The issue with the Pipeline bubble chart is now fixed. Earlier, showing sales phase code dimension appeared besides the bubble with the sales phase description. Now, it appears like a pipeline bar chart. (Hotfix ID: 4500008435)-URL Mashup was not getting included in the USERID as expected. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009700)-Tile alignment issue in SAP Business ByDesign mobile app is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009700)-  Customer Relationship Management-Cash Discount Terms-Z-prefix based CDT now defaults the net due date to baseline date, when the payment terms are left blank for the net discount section. (Hotfix ID: 4500009158. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Customer Contract-CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_ID-CONTENT and CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_ID are PSM read released for query QUERY_BY_DETERMINATION under ITEM_CUST_CONTR_OVERVIEW for BO CUSTOMER_CONTRACT. (Hotfix ID: 4500009008)-Customer Contract Renewal Agreement on Item Level is PSM released for read only access. (Hotfix ID: 4500006508)-Customer Invoice-When cancellation approval is scoped, invoice output history was not being generated. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009892. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-In a few scenarios, process control block was set, however, the invoices were getting released even if the posting date of invoice was falling within the process block timeline. This issue is now resolved. Now, the invoice does not get released if there exists a process block for the period pertaining to the posting date of the invoice. (Hotfix ID: 4500008318)-The Outbound Release can be now be cancelled if the invoice is cancelled. (Hotfix ID: 4500007833. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Pro Forma invoice can now be successfully generated and saved. The form template error coming up on clicking of Pro Forma Invoice on Sales Quote is resolved. (Hotfix ID: 4500007628. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Customer invoices can now get released successfully even with their previous action of previewing another invoice. (Hotfix ID: 4500008804)-The issue while removing an item after creating debit invoice request is now resolved. (Hotfix ID: 4500009680. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-For Italy, the release button is now enabled in Customer Request view. It also checks the validation for Italy while creating customer Invoices.-There are two legal validations:-Posting date should not be less than the last posted document.-The documents should be released in the sequence. (Hotfix ID: 1000009412)-For India, Generate IRN schema has been updated for v1.03 for India E-invoicing. (Hotfix ID: 1000009944. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-For India, the issue where users were unable to create/save customer invoices, is now fixed. For more information, see the document Flexible Document Numbering - India. (Hotfix ID: 4500010410. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Some XML files generated using XSLT Repository (for example e-invoicing) were generated using wrong codepage setup. This fix makes sure that files get codepage as defined in XSLT files. (Hotfix ID: 4500009404)-Payer Invoice exists validation is now enhanced with grouping unit. (Hotfix ID: 4500004128)-Closing date validation for outbound delivery invoice requests, while creating invoice requests as well as creating customer invoices is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500004128)-If invoice creation happens through the action Invoice-Advanced, newly entered invoice date gets considered for the calculation of closing date. This fixes that was coming up during the creation of customer invoice. (Hotfix ID: 4500004128)-The closing date now gets calculated from credit memo date instead of its referenced invoice’s date. (Hotfix ID: 4500004128)-India E-Invoice schema v1.03 includes the following changes:-Surcharges have been added to total amount as per the recent NIC validation on assessible amount.-Fix to total amount calculation in Stock Transfer Delivery.-TCS changes that go-live on October 1, 2020 have been included.-Original invoice date on debit note form XML has been made available. (Hotfix ID: 1000009016)-Customer Return-With this fix, if material/service/product exists with same product ID, then the customer return creation will not fail. (Hotfix ID: 4500006435)-Sales-An error was coming up for an existing payer invoice for a given closing date, when registering multiple over-the-counter sales using ManageOvertheCounterSaleRequestIn webservice. Changes have been made to load output history when the output history tab is clicked for the first time. (Hotfix ID: 1000008985)-The workflow notifications for quote and sales order were not getting created when user logon language was not English, and, when the profit margin percentage was an attribute in condition for notification trigger. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008516)-Sales Order query webservice that was failing on execution with a RABAX error has now been fixed and can be consumed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009168. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Product UUID of Item is added as a new parameter in public out port of sales order item so that it can be used in the newly added tab in item details. (Hotfix ID: 4500009653)-Service Confirmation-The overall status of service order items now gets completed once delivery and invoice processes are finished. It was not working in cases where Non-Billable indicator was marked manually in confirmation. (Hotfix ID: 4500009732)-Service Request-Persisted errors won't appear in application log of Information Lifecycle Management Deletion run, when all the documents considered for deletion are successfully deleted. (Hotfix ID: 4500008679)-  Financial Management-Accounting-For Korea, the rule-based activation for purchase accounting in the context of the statutory reporting requirements, has now been removed. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-For Italy, the entire journal report was not being generated in the single run. Also, a few entries were missing in the pdf file. This error is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500002328. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Accounting Lease Management-You can now restrict read or write access, based on company, on the lease contract worklist view of the lease contract management work center. (Hotfix ID: 1000008676)-Cashflow calculation was coming up incorrect while creating a new lease contract, that had a similar lease contract ID for other company. This issue is now fixed. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Customers can now create Manual Supplier invoice with Assignment as lease contract with released status and term completed contract. (Hotfix ID: 4500008237)-Analytics Content-The provided fix now solves the issue of missing function of expense data, such as profit and loss and other expenses in the reporting structures. (Hotfix ID: 4500009012. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Bank Statement-Enabling Post for bank statement created through a file upload. (Hotfix ID: 4500007847. Title: The Ship-To Address is Incorrect in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You have updated the address in the organizational management work center.-Then you created a shopping cart and entered the org unit which is marked as ship-to location.-The updated address is not displayed in the shopping cart.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select Self Services-> Shopping Cart(advanced)-Enter the employee name and enter ship-to location manually-The updated address is not correctly displayed on the shopping cart screen-Cause-The ship-to location address is not updated in the site master data.-Resolution-You can maintain this in the work center Supply chain Design Master data work center-> Locations view-> All sites-> search for the site and edit-OR-You can go to Organizational work center-> Edit Org Structures->search for the respective org unit-> Definitions tab-> Under Business Residence, select Associated Site and open the site hyperlink.-This will open the site master data where you can update the correct address.-See Also-2779030 - Error message:Location XXX not found as ship-to location -Keywords-ship-to address, shopping cart, Supply chain Design Master data, location, org structure, associated site

Title: Error appears "Calculation method Equal to Resource Utilization not permitted for service" while trying to change the Calculation Method for BoO
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the Calculation Method  as "'Equal to Resource Utilization" for BoO KLM, Error appears.*KLM refers to BoO id, DEF refers to Product Activity,MNO refers to Service Master id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to  Planning and Production Master Data  Work Center-Go to Production Bills Of Operation View-Search BoO KLM and select Edit-Select tab Structure, open Produce activity DEF-Select sub-tab Services in the below, we can see there is an active and default service MNO, its Calculation Method is Equal to Resource Utilization-Select button Check Consistency, system reports error -'Bill of Operation KLM not consistent'-'Calculation method Equal to Resource Utilization not permitted for service MNO at acty DEF in op. '-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Go to Resources View-Search MNO, click Edit-Select tab Services, we can see service MNO, also has Calculation Method 'Equal to Resource Utilization'-Cause-Service Master MNO  has the base UoM as "n"  Calculation method says equal to resource utilization and hence expects base UoM of the service MNO to be in same unit of measure maintained while maintaining Fixed Quantity and Variable Quantity.-Resolution-Navigate to  Planning and Production Master Data  Work Center-Go to Production Bills Of Operation View-Search  BOO_TMP_202009141248160496300  click Edit-Select tab Structure, open OP_001 > ACT_001-Maintain Fixed quantity and Variable quantity in hours-Now Select sub-tab Services in the below, we can see there is an active and default service TRSV0001_MK, now change Calculation Method is Equal to Resource Utilization-Click Save-Keywords-Bill of Operation  not consistent, Calculation method Equal to Resource Utilization not permitted for service  at acty, Calculation method

Title: Error while creating new payment term --Net due date is missing
Content: Symptom-You get this error while creating new payment term.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to  implementation Projects view-Go to fine tune activity-Search for Activity Suppliers-Click Define Payment Terms for Procurement-Click Add row-Enter the  payment term ID starting with Z-Enter the description-Enter the days in the field"Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date (1)" or in the field" Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date (2)" under discount rate 1 granted or discount rate 2 granted respectively.-Click Save-Cause-We understand that in the standard payment terms with description"End of Month of Invoice Date, XX days", you notice that details maintained under "Discount Rate 1 Granted" the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date(1) is maintained and under "net due price" , fixed day of month is maintained.-However it is currently a limitation as you cannot maintain the same in Z payment terms because we do not allow the calculation to be as "End of Month of Invoice Date, XX days".-Instead we do allow the format "XX days from Invoice Date, End of month"-Resolution-Currently in Z payment terms-If you enter details under discount rate with Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date, then it is mandatory to maintain the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date under 'net due price' as well.-If you enter details under discount rate with fixed day of month, then it is mandatory to maintain the fixed day of month under 'net due price' as well.-If you enter details under discount rate with additional month, then it is mandatory to maintain the additional month under 'net due price' as well.-You may refer the help document on how the calculation works in various scenarios of payment terms-https://help.sap.com/viewer/0635ec3491974ad988be05d6b1dcf734/2008/en-US/e7bd583ad81c4f12ba1cb535f4a8f2a2.html?q=Payment%20terms-Keywords-Issue while creating new payment term

Title: To Filter "Resource id " based on "Group By" filter in Production Order View
Content: Symptom-How to add a new filter selection "Resource ID" to "group by" filter in the Production order view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control  Work Center-Navigate to By Order Header View-In this screen, we could not find option to group by Resource ID-Cause-In screen  Production order view  we do not have the visibility of adding "group by " of "Resource".-Resolution-To group Production Orders by Resource ID, Follow the below steps-Go to Production Control Work Center-Navigate to  By Order Operations View-In this screen we have an option to  use Filter "Group By" with "Resource id"-Keywords-To Filter "Resource id " based on "Group By" filter in Production Order View, In OWL Production Control > Production order view  we do not have the visibility of adding "group by " of "Resource",  group Production Orders by Resource ID

Title: Serial Number Profile Changes the Generation of Production Tasks
Content: Symptom-You change the Serial Number Profile for one of your Input Products of a production to Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes. After this change, two Make Tasks are generated from Production Order XXX. As the Task-Generation Method set in Production Model is Operation including Reporting Point and there is no reporting point set, you expect only one Make Task.-Before the change in Serial Number Profile, only one Make Task was created.-XXX = Production Order ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Select Task Control view.-Search for Production Order ID XXX.-Notice that two Make Tasks are generated.-Cause-When the input products are assigned to a certain activity the confirmation is assigned as Backflush, then system will assign the components to the task which is having the reporting point (after that activity), as the backflush quantity is determined by reporting quantity.-The confirmation is assigned as Explicit, then system will assign the components to the task, which is having that activity.-When the products are not serialized and the confirmation method is maintained as the Backflush, system assigned the components to last task (which is associated with reporting point), independent of their individual assignments to activities in production model.-When we change the Serial Number Profile to Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes, components become serialized. Serialized products will always be considered as Explicit (even if in production model the confirmation method is maintained as Backflush), as system cannot backflush the quantities by auto determining Serial Numbers. Since they are considered Explicit, system respects the activity assignment in production model.-Resolution-As the Confirmation Method is different for serialized products, the system is working as designed.-Keywords-Serial, Number, Production

Title: Barcode error appears while creating Outbound Delivery from Delivery Proposal
Content: Symptom-Error appears "Identified stock KLM of label DEF not correct; identified stock NOP correct" when trying to create Outbound Delivery from  Delivery Proposal QRS.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Delivery Proposals View-Search and select Delivery Proposal QRS-Select Post Goods Issue-Navigate to Subtab BarCodeInput, Enter first Barcode and Press Enter-Enter second Barcode and press enter-Now select Accept by selecting first Barcode Input entered-Error appears as seen in Symptom section-Cause-We cannot input two barcodes corresponding to 2 different identified stock for the same line item.-Resolution-You will have to split the item for adding the second barcode.You can enter in the first barcode, then split the item, and for the new split item enter in the second barcode.Follow the below steps to solve the issue.-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Delivery Proposals View-Search and select Delivery Proposal QRS-Select Post Goods Issue-Navigate to Subtab BarCodeInput, Enter first Barcode and Press Enter-Select Add Sub Item to split into 2nd sub item-Now select the newly created sub item and Enter second Barcode and press enter-Now select Accept by selecting first Barcode Input entered-Similarly Select Accept by selecting second Barcode Input entered-Keywords-Identified stock  of label not correct; identified stock correct, Barcode error appears while creating Outbound Delivery from Delivery Proposal, We cannot input two barcodes corresponding to 2 different identified stock for the same line item.

Title: Purchase Order E-Mail Notification not Triggered to Purchase Order Approver
Content: Symptom-Buyer responsible has sent the purchase order for approval however the approver does not receive any E-Mail notifications in his/her Inbox.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view -Select the relevant Purchase order ID and select Order-It will go for an Approval to purchase order approver however no E-Mail notifications created for the same-Cause-In the E-Mail and Fax Settings activity you have defined as Send all e-mails to this address with Particular E-Mail ID.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to fix the issue;-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view-Select Open Activity List-Select the activity - E-Mail and Fax Settings-Under the secion E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System, select Send all e-mails to business partners-Select Save and Close-See Also-3276820 - E-Mail Notification for Purchase Order Approval Work Flow Triggered Multiple Times for the Same User-Keywords-Purchase order E-Mail notification; PO E-Mail notification; E-Mail and Fax Settings; PO approver not received any notifications,

Title: Error appears "Line item 1: Logistics area XXX not valid -----> Inventory in logistics area not available" when trying to confirm replenish task
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm a Replenishment Task for a requested quantity DEF (DEF refers to Replenish Task id), but system is displaying error even though Stock is available in Stock Overview for the relevant Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Internal Logistics work center-Go to Task Control View-Search for the relevant Task ID-Click the Confirm button-Enter the Actual quantity-The following error appears:-Line item 1: Logistics area XXX not valid------> Inventory in logistics area not available-Cause-This is a valid error as there is not sufficient stock available to confirm the replenishment task. We should also check stock situation in planning screen by calculating Total Demand - Total Supply to understand if the stock is available.-Resolution-You either have to cancel the existing allocated demand or you will have to have sufficient stock available to the confirm task.-Note: This error is applicable for all Site Logistics  & Internal Logistics Tasks.-Keywords-Logistics area XXX not valid, Inventory in logistics area not available, replenishment task

Title: Wrong option under 'You can also', when Purchase order is in status In revision
Content: Symptom-You’ll see 'Edit Output Setting for Created PO' under 'You can also' , when Purchase order is in status In revision.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Create purchase order and order it.-2. Add an item to the Purchase order, Send Update-->The Purchase order will be sent to Approval-3. Approver send the Purchase order back to Revision-->Now if you click Preview, you’ll see Changed Purchase order & Cancelled Purchase order-4.But if you click You Can Also, you’ll see Edit Output Setting for Created PO,which is wrong-5.however later if you click on Send Update-6.Approver approves-7. then you will that in the output history tab that changed purchase order is appearing as expected-Cause-Our developers confirmed that  this issue, where wrong option is appearing only under You can also is a limitation and thus cannot be changed currently.-Resolution-Since  Preview and also output form are having correct details we see no harm currently on your documents. so you can continue as usual.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords- You can also,

Title: Demand Exists in Product Planning Details Despite the Corresponding Production Request , Production Order and Production Lot are in Finished Status.
Content: Symptom-In Product Planning Details of PROD1/AREA1 you notice that the Production Request 999 still appears as demand although the corresponding Production Request , Production Order and Production Lot are in Finished Status (where PROD1 represents the Product ID ,  AREA1 represents the Supply Planning Area and 999 represents the Production Request ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Production Control Workcenter.-2.Navigate to Production Orders View.-3.Find corresponding Production Order.-4.Select View All.-5.Go to Document Flow tab and find the Production Lot.-6.Select Production Lot.-7.Click the document number link of the Production Lot.-8. Select View All and Select Close Lot.-Cause-Although the Production Lot is in Finished Status, it is still not Closed.  Hence, there has the discrepancy.-Resolution-To resolve the issue you need to close the Production Lot.-Follow the below steps:-1. Go to Production Control workcenter and Production Orders View.-2. Find corresponding Production Order and View All.-3. Go to Document Flow tab and find the Production Lot and select.-4. In the Production Lot View All and Close Lot.-Keywords-Product Planning, Production Request, Production Lot, Demand

Title: Supplier invoice exception: Missing Receipt/Return document
Content: Symptom-Though goods receipt / inbound delivery exists but still you get an exception in the supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The inbound delivery is already returned that is Outbound delivery is already done and thus there is no inbound delivery available for the invoice.-Resolution-You should reverse the outbound delivery(create an adjustment confirmation) then post the invoice and then you can create new outbound delivery again.- or-You can accept the exception in the invoice and post it.-Keywords-Unable to create invoice

Title: How to restrict access of an user from creating or seeing a document
Content: Symptom-You wanted to stop an user from seeing or creating a document like a Supplier Invoice or Purchase order which belongs to a particular Org Unit, or you wanted to stop an user from seeing and editing a project that was created by another user.- or- Want to know why a user cannot see a Particular project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Access restrictions-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search and select the user.-click on edit and choose access rights.-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Find the work center view SRM_invoice entry (Or any other view related to Supplier Invoice or Purchase order).-On the right-side you have two columns called Read Access and Write Access.-There you choose "restricted".-Then scroll down and go to sub tab detailed Restriction.-Under Access group column you will see all available Org Units.-For which ever access should be given, you have check mark the respective read and write access check box.-Which ever are not check marked, they will have no access.-Note: What ever appears under access group that is what is currently allowed to be used to restrict. For example, for Project you will see employee id's(Person responsible for project) appearing under access group and not companies.-See Also- 2839450 - How to Restrict Users from Accessing your Project? -3094553 - Access restriction is not working for projects-Keywords-remove access; stop creating; remove access of a user to create Purchase orders of particular company

Title: Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings is Not Supported for New Intelligent PDF Scanning Functionality
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Keyword settings for scanned invoice in the Business Configuration activity, however when you are scanning the PDF documents using the new intelligent PDF scanning functionality, data is not uploaded as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In Business Configuration, you have maintained keyword(e.g. document type as credit memo)-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoice Scanning-Scan the PDF document which is a credit memo and upload it-The invoice data is not uploaded as expected. You scanned a credit memo, but document is created as scanned invoice.-Cause-Keyword settings are only meant to be useful for extracting the data from the text file which is used when you upload the scanned invoice using collaboration tool where both text and PDF files are used.-Resolution-"Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings" is not supported for intelligent PDF scanning functionality.-Please use the collaboration window for scanning in such cases.-See Also- 2959747 - Credit memo not supported with new intelligent PDF scanning-Keywords-Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings, keywords not detected, intelligent PDF scanning

Title: Missing Party ID in Intrastat Declaration for UK
Content: Symptom-You have created the Intrastat Declaration ABC but you can see that for some lines, the Party ID is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Intrastat.-Select the view Intrastat Declarations.-Search and open the intrastat declaration ABC.-Go to Items tab.-From here you might see that for some lines, the field Party ID is empty.-Cause--1 -Party ID is never a part of Intrastat Declaration for UK as per specification.-If this is a legal change, please contact your partner.-The minimum required data that needs to be reported as part of the intrastat declaration includes:-VAT number-Whether intra-EU import or export-Commodity code-The partner Member State-Value and quantity of the goods-The nature of the transaction, e.g. direct sales, purchases, returns--2-However, if the nature of transaction is "Transactions having actual or intended change of ownership for a consideration", the field PartyID might get populated.-But if the nature of transaction is "Goods movements not relevant for VAT return (excise or fiscal warehouse)", the party ID field will not get populated.-Resolution-Please refer to this blog to check what fields are mandatory in your intrastat declaration in UK:-https://blogs.sap.com/2020/03/03/intrastat-declarations-in-sap-business-bydesign/-Keywords-Intrastat Declaration, UK, Party ID.

Title: Unable to Search Customer Demand in Supply Planning Based on Project ID
Content: Symptom-In Supply Planning when you search Customer Demand based on the Project ID XYZ(where XYZ is the Project ID), you will notice that the records are not displayed although a demand exists for the mentioned project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Planning workcenter and Customer Demand view-2. In the Search box search by Project ID XYZ-3. You will not find any records-Cause-As per the current behavior system does not search Customer Demand based on Project ID in the Search box.-Resolution-To search Customer Demand based on Project ID you can add Project ID in the OWL and then search in the Project ID Column.-Alternately in the Search box you can search with the Project ID suffixed with wildcharacter like XYZ* , in this case system searches based on PSO Line Item ID-Keywords-Project ID, Customer Demand, Supply Planning, Search

Title: Error while activating Bill of Operations "Multiple default sequences defined below branching"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to check the Consistency of the newly created BoO KLM, Error appears.*KLM refers to BoO id, *MNO refers to Branch Id-Bill of operations KLM not consistent------> Multiple default sequences defined below branching MNO-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-Navigate to Production Bills Of Operation View-Search and Select BoO ID KLM-Select Edit-Click Check Consistency-Error appears as shown in Symptom section-Cause-As you have checked "Relevant for Planning" indicator for multiple Element type Sequence.-Note:Only 1st Sequence which follows immediately after Branching  is relevant for Default Sequence and Relevant for Planning-Resolution-Uncheck "Relevant for Planning" indicator for multiple sequences except sequence which immediately follows branching-Keywords-Multiple default sequences defined below branching, Bill of operations not consistent,"Relevant for Planning" indicator for multiple Element type Sequence, "Relevant for Planning" indicator for multiple sequences except sequence

Title: Wrong Tax code in Inter company Supplier invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2335218***-You expect a different tax code in the intercompany supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Intercompany Invoice which was created automatically by system based on customer invoice-You can see that Tax Code is wrong-Cause-In general Intercompany supplier invoice details will be based on corresponding customer invoice.-When tax determination happens at supplier invoice end separately then Automatic tax determination flag is checked in supplier invoice.-As you know Tax Code = Tax Event + Tax type + TAX Rate Type + tax Deductibility. Where tax event is mainly depended on on Ship from and ship to .-In Intercompany supplier invoice, Ship From and Ship To address is fetched from Location address maintained in Supply chain design master data work center.-Resolution-Go to Supply chain design master data work center-Go to Locations view-Search for Ship from and later Ship to -Select and Click on edit-Enter the Address ,where Country and correct Postal code has to be maintained.-See Also-2335218 - Wrong tax Code in Intercompany Supplier Invoice- 2478712 - Tax Code is not Determined or Wrong Tax Code is Determined-  2763883 - Incorrect Tax Code and Tax Country Defaulted in Supplier Invoice for Service Item

Title: Error appears "Change logistics use not possible;logistics area not empty;Save could not be executed" while setting  logistics use as Not relevant for planning
Content: Symptom-When trying to set Logistics use as "Not Relevant for planning" for Logistics Area KLM, system throws the below error messages. (KLM refers to Logistics Area)-"Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty;"-"Save could not be executed"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Supply Chain Design Master Data Workcenter.-Go to Locations View.-Search for Logistics Area KLM.-Select Logistics Use as "Not relevant for planning".-Errors below appear:-"Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty;"-"Save could not be executed"-Cause-There could be 2 causes:-Stock still exists in Logistics Area KLM.-If any tasks from Workcenter (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics, Production Control, Quality Planning) which are open for Logistics area KLM.-Resolution-Stock needs to be moved from Logistics Area KLM to some other Logistics Area via (Internal Logistics -> Goods Movement).-Open Tasks that exist from Work center (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics, Production Control, Quality Planning) need to be processed.-To check any open tasks from Workcenter (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics):-Go to Outbound Logistics/Internal Logistics/Inbound Logistics Workcenter.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Select Open Advanced Filter.-Select Task Status as "Not Started" & "In Process".-Select Go.-Note: It is necessary to check for Inspection tasks and count tasks as well to make sure that the above mentioned error is not displayed.-See Also-3417212 - Unable to Add Logistics Use "Not Relevant for Planning" for a Logistics Area Due to Error "Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty".-Keywords-Change logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty, Save could not be executed, to set Logistics use as "Not Relevant for planning" for Logistics Area

Title: Approver Involved Party not listed in Approval facet
