Content: Symptom-You have added an Approver to the Involved Party of a Sales Quote but this party is not listed in Approval facet-Environment- SAP Sales Cloud-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales workcenter.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Open any Sales Quote.-Go to the facet Involved Parties.-Add a new party Approver.-Go to the Approval facet.-Result: the Approver party is not being added in the Approval facet.-Cause-The Approval facet only displays the Approvers maintained in the Approval Process, not the party Approver added via the Involved Parties.-Resolution-Please add any Approver required for the Approval Process in the Approval Processes under Administrator.-Keywords-approver, involved parties, approval process, sales quote

Title: How to configure and trigger E-mail  from Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-In an Inbound Delivery Notification when the Output Channel is maintained as E-mail the recipients E-mail ID is not fetched automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Inbound Delivery Notification KLM (KLM represents Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Choose Preview and select Edit Output Settings.-Under Output Details tab choose Send by as E-mail.-The recipient e-mail address is blank.-Cause-The E-mail ID is not maintained in the Account Master Data of the ship to party.-Resolution-To maintain the Email id in the Account master data, follow below steps-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Inbound Delivery Notification KLM (KLM represents Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Choose Edit.-Select and open the Ship-to Party Name under Organizational Information in General Tab.-Under Business Partner Roles, select and open Accounts.-Choose View All-Go to Communication Tab.-Under Addresses subtab maintain the E-mail ID.-Choose Save.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification; E-mail; Recipient; Output Settings; E-mail Address Blank; Address Master Data; Ship-to; Configure E-mail Address

Title: Accuracy of Intelligent Invoice Scanning
Content: Symptom-In the Invoice Scanning view of the Supplier Invoicing work center, you upload supplier invoice documents in PDF format for creating supplier invoices in the system. But some of the scanned value is not correctly recognized.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions Post 2008-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Click Upload-In the new screen, select Company and PDF file, Start Process-Go back to Invoice Scanning screen, wait till the status of the new invoice change to Scanning Completed-Click Create Invoice-You see some of the scanned values are not correctly recognized.-Cause-There are multiple reasons may cause accuracy issues.-1.The quality of the PDF file.-If the PDF file is blurred, it may cause accuracy issues when scanning.-2.The content of the invoice is unclear or too complex.-For example, since many different currencies use same symbol "$", if there is only symbol but no currency description maintained in the PDF invoice, system may propose a different currency than you expected.-3.Invoice scanning is based on a pre-trained model based on invoices we used to train the model.-As of now, the accuracy may varies between invoice to invoice and not necessarily 100%. Hence there is a provision for user to review and modify the scanned values before creating invoice.-The model will keep getting trained and the efforts will be on to increase the accuracy of scanned results.-Resolution-Please review the scanned invoice before creating invoice.-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Select the scanned invoice-Click Review-Here you can modify the scanned values.-See Also-Help Document Intelligent Invoice Scanning Quick Guide, Supported Languages and Countries-Keywords-Intelligent Invoice Scanning, PDF Scanning Invoice, PDF Invoice Scanning, PDF Supplier Invoice, Scanned Invoice

Title: Unable to search Stock Transfer Proposals based on Product Description
Content: Symptom-Unable to search Stock Transfer Proposals based on Product Description-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Control workcenter and Process Stock Transfer Proposals view.- 2. In the Search box find by product description-You will not find any records-Cause-As per the current system design it is not possible to search by product description in the Search box.-Resolution-As a workaround you can add Product Description field in the OWL and search in Product Description column.- Now proposals based on description will be displayed.-Keywords-Product Description, Stock Transfer Proposals, Supply Control,Search,

Title: ATP Shows Insufficient Quantity For a Product Which is Available on Stock
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order containing the Product ABC (ABC represent the Product ID) which has enough on-hand quantity to fulfill the demand. However, when you check the availability (by clicking the respective button) the ATP indicator is displayed in yellow, showing late delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Sales Orders. -Select the view Sales Orders. -Find the respective Sales Order. -Open it and go to the Items tab.-Click the button Check Availability.-Result:  Line Item 10 has an yellow ATP indicator: Late delivery; earliest delivery: XX.XX.XX (XX.XX.XX is the exact date in the future).-Cause-In the Product master data you have maintained an availability check scope: Stock. This means that the available stock is considered as available supply for the product availability check.-There is a Goods Issue Processing Time also maintained for the product ABC. For instance, it is set to 48:00:00. Now, you think that the system will consider 2 calendar days.  However, this is not the case, as here the Site calendar and operating hours are taken into consideration. -If the respective Site has operating hours with Start Time being maintained as 8:00 and End Time 17:00 (for example), this means 8 operating hours per day.-If you divide 48 (Goods Issue Processing Time) to 8 (Operating hours) this equals 6 working days. This 6 working days will be considered from the maintained Requested Date for the ATP to determine the earliest delivery for the product.-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour as per maintained product's master data.-You could review the maintained Goods Issue Processing Time for the product ABC.-Keywords-ATP, insufficient, quantity, available, product, goods issue processing time,

Title: Quantity To Be Invoiced Time Confirmations Are Showing Quantity To Be Written Off
Content: Symptom-You can see the Time Confirmations are shown as Quantity To Be Written Off. However you expected Quantity To Be Invoiced.-or-How to set the times  to appear automatically as  Time to Be Written off in Project invoice request or In Not invoiced time and expenses-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search and Select the Project XYZ(XYZ represents Project ID).-Select the Edit Time and Expenses button.-Here you can see the Time Confirmations are shown as Quantity To Be Written Off. However you expected them Quantity To Be Invoiced.-Cause-Cause 1: You have removed quantity in field Non billable hours while doing time confirmation.-or-Cause 2: You have not set the Billable flag for the time confirmations which are shown as To Be Written Off.-Resolution-For Cause 1:-Go to work center: Home-Go to Self-Service Overview-Edit Time Sheet-Maintain Duration for a particular day-Go to labour information tab-Ensure you enter Billable hours-For Cause 2:-If the Billable flag is set to true for the respective project task or work package, the time confirmations associated to the work package will be available for invoicing as To Be Invoiced. When the flag is unset, all the time confirmations done after this change will be available for invoicing as To Be Written-Off.-A) Steps to be followed to correct the existing entries:-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search and Select the Project XYZ.-Select the Edit Time and Expenses button.-Here you can maintain the Quantity To Be Invoiced or delete the Quantity To Be Written Off.-B) Steps to be followed to ensure future entries will not be written off:-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search and Select the Project XYZ.-Select the Edit Time and Expenses button.-Select the Edit Assignment Rules button.-Select View All Rules button.-Select the respective Rule.-Here set the To Be Written-Off flag is set untrue and maintain the rules accordingly. -Keywords-Time confirmation; Quantity; Written off; Billable; Invoice; Project; Expense

Title: The Error "The product is not valid for logistics area .The product must belong to the logistics area's allowed storage group" Appears While Confirming Put Away Task
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm a Put Away task and when you manually assign the Target Logistics Area, the system displays errors:-Line item: Logistics area DEF  not valid (DEF refers to Logistics Area id)- ---->The product is not valid for logistics area DEF. The product must belong to the logistics area's allowed storage group-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center-Go to the Task Control view-Find and select the relevant Putaway task-Click the Confirm button-Click Propose Quantities & Logistics Area-Error appears-Note: This errors also appear when you enter Serial Number and confirm it.-Cause-Allowed Logistics Units and Storage Groups rules maintained for the referenced Logistics Area under the Restrictions tab do not match with the Storage Group maintained in the Logistics tab of the Material master.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue,-You either have to remove the Storage Group rules maintained under the Logistics Area, or-You have to maintain same Storage Groups in both the Material master under the Logistics tab and in the referenced Logistics Area. -Keywords-The product is not valid for logistics area,The product must belong to the logistics area's allowed products group

Title: Error when selecting a Project Task in a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When you enter a project task in a Sales Order, you are facing this error message:-"Item A: Project task Z does not belong to project ID Y".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Work Center Sales Order-View Sales Order-Select the sales order you wish to edit (Example: Sales Order 1234).-Go to "Items" Tab-Click "Add Row"-Enter a Product ID-Under Details view, add the Project Task "Z".-No result displays, but if you force the entry, this error message will pop up:-"Item A: Project task ID Z does not belong to project ID Y".-Cause-You have maintained the project task Y on another Item on this Sales Order.-It is not possible to maintain 2 different project tasks on the same Sales Order as only one is permitted.-Resolution-You need to create a new Sales Order and maintain Project Task Z on it.-Keywords-Sales Order, Project Task, Error Message.

Title: No Invoice Created After Lease Contract Invoice Run Execution
Content: Symptom-Supplier invoice is not created after execution of Lease Contract Invoice Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Lease Contract Invoice Runs view.-Select the Run ID AAA (AAA means the Lease Contract Invoice Run ID) and open its application log.-Go to the Results tab and notice the message: No records found.-Cause-As of SAP Business ByDesign 2008 Release, a user will be able to create invoices from lease contract only for those companies for which he/she has authorization to Read and write.-The respective user who created the Run ID AAA does not have write permission to the Work Center View ID SRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS.-Resolution-Write permission to the Work Center View ID SRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS should be granted to the respective user, in Application and User Management work center > Business Users view > Edit > Access Rights.-See Also-What's New in Supplier Relationship Management for SAP Business ByDesign 2008 Release.-Keywords-lease contract invoice run; invoice; SRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS; write access

Title: Limit Purchase Order is still showing open in Invoice Entry Screen even Though it has been Manually Finished
Content: Symptom-You have created a limit purchase order and manually finished delivery and invoicing but it is still showing up as open for invoicing in Invoice entry screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders work center-Create a new Purchase order for limit item-Now create goods and service receipt for that item or-Open the order and manually finish the delivery and invoicing both.-The purchase order status is now Finished-Go to Invoice entry-> All Orders to Be Invoiced screen-The Purchase order limit item is still showing open for invoicing-Cause-Purchase order limit item is assigned to project task which has status as closed. Hence the system shows the purchase order limit item still open for invoicing.-Resolution-Please release the associated project tasks to resolve this issue.-Keywords-Limit Purchase Order open for invoicing, Project task closed

Title: Error appears "Under and Over Delivery not allowed for Stock Transfer Delivery" while creating 3PL Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery for partial quantity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create 3PL Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery for 3PL Inbound Delivery Notification KLM for partial quantity, error appears.*KLM refers to Inbound Delivery Notification Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third Party Logistics  Work Center-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications View-Search for Delivery Notification KLM-Select Inbound Delivery and Fill all the entries-Create the Inbound Delivery for partial quantity, Error appears "Under and Over Delivery not allowed for Stock Transfer Delivery"-Cause-From 2005 Upgrade onwards, For India Stock Transfer Order Scenario Partial Quantity confirmation while creating 3PL Inbound Delivery is not allowed for the sites which are based out of India.-Resolution-For India Stock Transfer Order scenario, While creating Stock Transfer Order 3PL  Inbound Delivery from 3PL  Inbound Delivery Notification KLM, you will have to maintain complete quantity as per Planned Quantity or Ordered Quantity.-See Also-2926736 - Error appears Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario when trying to create Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery with partial quantity-Keywords-Under and Over Delivery not allowed for Stock Transfer Delivery, Inbound Delivery is not allowed for the sites which are based out of India, For India Stock Transfer Order scenario,

Title: Recurring invoice are going for approvals after 2008 upgrade
Content: Symptom-You noticed that recurring invoices are going for approval, which were not going for approval earlier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to  supplier invoices and credit memos- Go to recurring runs view- Select respective run- Scroll down and select invoice history tab- Where you can see all invoices- Invoices created after 2008 version are going for approval-Cause-We have enabled approvals to be applicable for recurring invoices in 2008 version and thus like any other invoice they are also sent for approval.- Below is the what's new of SRM-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2008/en-US/9afff61e86611014b91ca2c9c39092bc.html-Resolution-If you don't want the approvals for recurring invoice then you should add one more condition in the approvals as given below-"entry method not equal to recurring invoice" using AND .-See Also-also refer the  complete what's new in  2008 version-https://blogs.sap.com/2020/08/02/sap-business-bydesign-whats-new-20.08/-after every upgrade you can find similar document

Title: Buyer Responsible did not Receive the E-Mail Notification Forwarded by Supplier Invoice Accountant for Exception Type Price Variance for Supplier Invoice ID
Content: Symptom-You as an account, forwarded the Price Variance exception to buyer responsible however he/she did not received the E-Mail notification forwarded by the invoice account for the task type- Clarify Invoice Exception: Price Variance for Supplier Invoice ID <Supplier Invoice ID>.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant invoice and navigate to Exceptions tab-Select Save Document and forward for clarification-Send the clarification to Buyer Responsible -Task got assigned, however no E-Mail notification received by the Buyer Responsible-Cause-Task - Clarify Invoice Exception Price Variance for Supplier Invoice is relevant for the below scenario. -Relevance:-The task is relevant to the processor entered by the accountant when forwarding the supplier invoice for clarification. The relevant processor receives this task in the Inbox sub view of the Work view of the Home work center. Which means, the buyer responsible must subscribe to the tasks in the Common Authorizations for Employees task element to receive the E-Mail notification for invoice exceptions.-Resolution-When the accountant forward the invoice price variance exception for clarification, the task gets assigned to the buyer responsible automatically as you defined in the Supplier Invoice Exceptions activity. Since the task is relevant in the Inbox section, the E-Mail notification subscription must be done under Common Authorizations for Employees in the Home task element. Then user will receive the E-Mail notification for this this type of exception.  To do so, you can follow the below steps;-Go to the Home work center -Go to the Inbox view and select Subscribe to Tasks -Select Home and Common Authorizations for Employees -Select the task -  Clarify Invoice Exception: Price Variance for Supplier Invoice ID <Supplier Invoice ID-Select E-Mail check box -Select Save and Close-Keywords-E-Mail notification for invoice exceptions; Supplier Invoice exceptions notification; Price variance exception email notification

Title: Customer Demand Determined Transport lane which is Generic Although more Specific Transport lane exist
Content: Symptom-You observe system determining wrong transport Lane KLM for Customer Demand DEF although more specific Transport Lane NOP with less  No of Shipping Duration lane exist.*KLM refers to Generic Tranpsort Lane id, *DEF refers to Customer Demand ID, NOP refers to Specific Transport Lane-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center-Navigate to Customer Demand View-Search for DEF-Select Edit-Navigate to Line Items Tab, Select any Line Item-Under Details, Select sub tab Alternative Sources-You observe  Transport lane KLM derived for Customer Demand DEF although more specific lane exist NOP-Cause-Transportation zone always considers the ship to location at the item level.-However when it comes to the source of supplies provided by the system based on the Transportation zones, it works differently as the sources will not have the address information.- Let us explain you how  sourcing or source of supply works and what is supported in the Business ByDesign system.-Transportation Zones are allowed  with specific to Regions, Postal codes, and Customers.-When we call the sourcing engine to fetch the 'source of supplies', sourcing engine will provide all the sources available in the system.-Detailed explanation as to how it works is as follows:-System will first fetch all the Transportation zones that are valid for the provided postal code or the customer Postal code or customer info are only available at this  Transportation zone level.- Note: There is no priority or filtering while getting the  Transportation zones. We cannot filter because it is functionally wrong as we have to provide all possible source of supply-   2. After determining the  Transportation zones, system will fetch all the Sources that come under these  Transportation zones.- Note: No postal code or customer info available on these Sources (sources may be Transport * production model, list price).So sorting not possible.-  3. Then System assigns the postal code from the ship-to address to these Sources. In this way all the Sources will have same Postal codes. Then the sourcing does the sorting based on some priorities and selects the default Source of Supply- System does not consider the duration, it considers the priorities maintained in the transportation lanes, and if nothing is maintained it will return the random transportation lane.-Resolution-In case if you are not ready to maintain the priority, please ensure  to be specific in one of the  transportation lane.-"Based on the transport zone, the system finds possible transport lanes for the product. If it finds more than one matching transport zone, it uses all of them to find transport lanes and then takes the transport lane with the highest priority. If it finds more than one transport zone but no priorities have been maintained for the transport lanes, it uses the one that is more specific. This means that a lane that is to be used to transport the product requested in the order would be preferred over a lane for all products. If no priorities are maintained and none of the transport lanes is more specific than the others, the system selects any of the transport lanes found. "-These  are the possible options available as per the system behavior.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2005/en-US/2ccf0229722d1014a85cafa214d51a43.html-Keywords-Customer Demand Determined Transport lane which is Generic Although more Specific Transport lane exist, You observe system determining wrong transport Lane for Customer Demand although more specific Transport Lane  with less  No of Shipping Duration lane exist.

Title: The Contract Item is in 'Inactive for sourcing' Status when Creating New Purchasing Contract
Content: Symptom-You are creating new Purchasing Contract under Sourcing and Contracting - Contracts work center view, but the contract item is always set as 'Inactive for Sourcing' status automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Select Contracts view-Select New Contract-Navigate to Items tab-The item shows "Inactive for Sourcing" status and "Activate for Sourcing" button is greyed out.-Cause-The item is not active for sourcing unless the contract is released.-Once it is released, the item will be automatically activated for sourcing.-Resolution-Please enter all necessary data and release the contract. Once the contract is in "Released" status, the item will be in "Active for Sourcing" status.-See Also- 1405851 - Contract item not active for sourcing-Keywords-Inactive for Sourcing, purchasing contract item, new contract, sourcing and contracting

Title: Error While Scheduling an Intrastat Declaration Run:  MDRO Instance is Not Active
Content: Symptom-You are trying to schedule an intrastat declaration run but you encounter the following error:-"MDRO instance is not active".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center-Select view: Intrastat Declaration Runs-Select the run ID and schedule it-Error: "MDRO instance is not active".-Cause-Error occurs because the respective Run ID is not activated.-If you select edit and check the status for Run ID, you will find the status is "In Preparation".-Resolution-Kindly set the intrastat run to active status and then schedule it.-Keywords-MDRO instance is not active, Intrastat declaration run, schedule intrastat declaration run

Title: Purchase Request Created from MRP Run is Not Going for Approval
Content: Symptom-You have set up an approval process for purchase request.-Then you initiated Material Requirement Planning(MRP) run in your system and purchase request got created through a supply planning proposal but it skipped approval.- or-Purchase request created via webservice not goes into approval.-or-Purchase request not created manually is not going for approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Requests(PR refers to purchase request)-Search for the purchase request created from MRP run-The PR did not go for approval and purchase order is already created from it.-Cause-In the scoping questions for purchase requests, you have scoped the following question:"Do you want to use an approval process for manual purchase requests?"-This means the approval process is only applicable for manually created Purchase Request.-The purchase request which is getting created from planning proposal is not a manual purchase request.-also the approval process for purchase request is not relevant for  for other ways of creating purchase request  like A2X, from projects, from sales order, from shopping cart, from Material Requirement Planning(MRP) run,  Web service etc).-Resolution-Create manual purchase request if you want to trigger approval for the same.- or-You may ask your Partners to help develop a new approval process that can be applied to Purchase requests not created manually.-Keywords-manual purchase request, planning proposal purchase request,Purchase Request, Approval, Webservice, API

Title: Error While Posting or Cancelling Goods and Service Receipt: Address Selected is Not a valid Ship-from Address
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to cancel a Goods and Service Receipt(GSR refers to Goods and service receipt) document but you encounter error while posting the cancellation document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Goods and service receipt work center-Select view Receipts and Returns-> show by documents-Search for respective GSR document-Select Cancel GSR document-Cancellation GSR document screen is opened-Select check-> no errors-Now select Post-Error:-Saving of PO changes not possible; changes inconsistent-Address selected is not a valid ship-from address-Cause-Supplier main address was changed recently in the supplier master data.-In the supplier master data, under Communication tab-> addresses, address row is empty but it is set as main and ship from location.-Resolution-Please set the main address correctly in the supplier master data under communication-> addresses tab and then you can process the GSR.-Keywords-goods and service receipt cancellation,  Address Selected is Not a valid Ship-from Address, supplier address-goods and service receipt cancellation,address not valid ship-from address

Title: Scheduled project invoice request is in status In preparation not released automatically
Content: Symptom-You want to know why the Invoice request is not released even though you have marked Automatic release in sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center- Go to Project invoice request view- Search and select relevant  Invoice request- You will see that check mark against the scheduled invoice is checked- But the status of invoice request is Inpreparation-Cause-If there are some expenses which are marked as “written-off” or which are deferred (also if some expense is written-off only partially) they cannot be assigned to any PIR item. Then automatic release is rejected because the user must have possibility to check whether these special expenses (or parts of expenses) should be really assigned to this PIR.-Resolution-So you will have to manually release such Project invoice requests-Keywords-Scheduled project invoice request not released, Scheduled project invoice request still in status In preparation

Title: Inbound Delivery Not Released Automatically Although Unload Task is Finished
Content: Symptom-When using a two step Logistics Model for receiving, after confirming the Unload task,  the Delivery Status of the corresponding Inbound Delivery is "In Process".-Note that the Inbound Delivery is created with not released status although the Unload task is in Finished Status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Inbound Deliveries View.-Search for desired Inbound Delivery ID. -The  Delivery Status of this Inbound Delivery is "In Process" and Release Status is "Not Released".-Cause-As Unload task DEF is confirmed partially and remaining quantities has been set as Deviation Reason: Missing part.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, need to perform Accept Deviation for remaining quantities which was set as Inbound Deviation in Unload Task.-Navigate to Inbound Logistics  Work Center.-Go to Work View.-Search for Unload task ID.-Select Accept Deviation button.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, Not Released Automatically, Unload Task, Finished, Deviation Reason, Status-although unload task is finished,inbound delivery not released,as unload task is confirmed partially,unload task is in finished status.,deviation reason: missing part, inbound,perform accept deviation for remaining

Title: Wrong tax amount
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know-How the tax amount is calculated.- or-Why tax amount appears different than expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase request and orders work center-Go to Purchase orders-Search and select relevant Purchase order-Click on Edit-Go to Items tab-Go to Taxes Sub tab-Cause-In general as we know Tax amount = Tax net base amount* tax rate-However we have additional logic 'Tax difference distribution'  that has caused the tax amount to be calculated differently.-Resolution-Create new document without copying an existing document and then check the below blog.-kindly refer the Blog   for all details https://blogs.sap.com/2018/04/05/rules-of-tax-difference-distribution-in-sap-business-bydesign/-Keywords-calculation of tax amount,tax amount decimals

Title: Variant 6 of Bill of Material BOM1 is not Displayed
Content: Symptom-Variant 6 of Bill of Material BOM1 is created (where BOM1 is the Bill of Material ID ).-However in the Input Products tab of BOM1 variant 6 is not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter and Production Bills Of Material view.-2. Find Bill of Matrerial ID BOM1 and select.-3. View All and go to Input Products tab, Variants from 1 to 5 are displayed but 6 is not displayed.-Cause-As per the system design only first 5 variants are displayed for Bill of Material.-Example if there are 8 variants in BOM1 only variants 1-5 will be displayed.-If variants 4 and 5 are deleted then variants 6 & 7 will be displayed in BOM1.-Resolution-Only first 5 variants are allowed in the Bill of Material.-Keywords-Bill of Material, Variant, Production Master Data, Planning,  Input Products, Display

Title: How to change Log on language of Technical users uploading documents via Soap UI
Content: Symptom-You wanted the Product description of the products of your documents to appear in desired language but currrently you see English.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently its known that Product Description appears as per log on language of the user who is creating the document.-If you are using SOAP UI then  you need set up the language in SOAP UI before uploading the document.-If you are using any other tool ensure you change the log on langauge before uploading the document.-Resolution-Log in to SOAP UI and follow steps to reach the request screen where you would enter the XML.-Click on button 'header' that is highlighted in below screen shot-Click on Add (+ symbol  highlighted in below screen)- a small pop up will appear-Enter"accept-Language"and click on save as highlighted in below screen- Enter the code of  your desired language, for example language german- DE refer below screen shot.- Continue  every thing else as  normal.-See Also-2735797 - Product Description appearing empty or wrong in any purchasing documents-Keywords-Language of  technical user

Title: Tax Number Does not Show in the Custom Report Created Based on Supplier Invoice Item Details Data Source
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report based on supplier invoice item details data source to display the tax number however the report shows # value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Go to the Design Reports view -Select the custom report -Search based on Supplier and press Enter-Tax number shows # value-Cause-Custom report is based on Supplier Invoice Item Details data source. When you run the report, the report is associated with supplier invoice and not based on supplier master data. Which means for those supplier invoices which does not have the tax number, it will show # value.-Resolution-You have to make sure that supplier invoices must contain tax number and then it will show in the custom report. Or else you can add data source Supplier Details to the custom report, so that tax number will be defaulted from the supplier master data.-Keywords-Tax number appears # in custom report; Supplier invoice item details data source; Tax number shows #

Title: Planned Quantity of 3PL Request changes dynamically as per Partial Delivered Quantity of 3PL Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-Planned Quantity of 3PL request KLM gets changed once 3PL Outbound Delivery  is created and released for Partial Delivery.KLM refers to 3PL Request id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third-Party Logistics Work Center -Navigate to 3PL Requests View-Search for KLM-You observe Before delivery (Requested Quantity = 2 EA, Planned Quantity = 2 EA, Delivered Quantity= 0 EA) *EA refers to UoM-After Partial Delivery of 1EA and 3PL Outbound Delivery release(Requested Quantity = 2 EA, Planned Quantity= 1 EA, Delivered Quantity= 1 EA)-Cause-The planned quantity gets updated inline with delivered quantities, once the Outbound Delivery is created and released.-Resolution-we always can refer to the Requested Quantity field for getting an understanding of quantity requested, instead of referring to planned quantity field.Requested quantity will never change.This is the standard design. Not just on 3PL request, even on Warehouse Request the behavior is same.-Keywords-Planned Quantity of 3PL Request changes dynamically, Partial Delivered Quantity of 3PL Outbound Delivery, Planned Quantity of 3PL request gets changed once 3PL Outbound Delivery  is created and released, 3PL Outbound Delivery  is created and released for Partial Delivery.

Title: Datasource Warehouse Request Items [SCMWREXE_V1] shows values for Field Purchase Order id (Predecessor Document) as "#"
Content: Symptom-You observe data source Warehouse Request Items [SCMWREXE_V1] does not show values for Field Purchase Order (Predecessor Document) although there is Purchase Order exists and visible in UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Navigate to Design Data Sources View-Select Data Source  Warehouse Request Items-In Selection Parameter Pass values for Warehouse Order id as  and Warehouse Request-Select Apply-we observe  Purchase Order (Predecessor Document) showing as # for all line items.-Cause-The report is meant to provide information for just the 'immediate' predecessor and not all in the document flow.-Resolution-Purchase order will be available as predecessor only when a direct Post Goods Receipt is performed from purchase order and in the other use case since Inbound Delivery Notification is created, the predecessor data will be available under the Inbound Delivery Notification in the report as well.-This is the expected behavior and not an issue.-Keywords-Datasource Warehouse Request Items [SCMWREXE_V1] shows values for  Field  Purchase Order id (Predecessor Document)as "#", Purchase Order (Predecessor Document) showing as # for all line items which is wrong, Datasource Warehouse Request Items [SCMWREXE_V1] does not show value for Purchase Order (Predecessor Document)

Title: Purchase order approval task is sent to wrong approver
Content: Symptom-Purchase order approval task isn't sent to the approver displays under Approval tab in the order, you think system sends task to wrong approver.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Open the affected purchase order.-View all and navigate to Approval tab, the approver showing there is ABC. (ABC represents the first approver displays under Approval tab)-However the approval task is sent to DEF instead. (DEF represents the user who receives the approval task)-Cause-Item level approval for Purchase Orders is in scope. User has changed item content which triggers the item level appoval.-Approver task is sent to the item level approver DEF in the first place, after item level approval done,  approval task will then be sent to header level approver ABC.-Resolution-If you open the order and navigate to Items tab - Approval sub-tab, you will see that the item level approver is displaying there.-System is working as expected.-Keywords-Item Level Approval, Purchase Order, Approval Task

Title: Assign Source of Supply button is disabled for released purchase request
Content: Symptom-Assign Source of Supply button is disabled for released purchase request-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Find the released purchase request in the list.-Click on it, you find the Assign Source of Supply button is disabled.-Cause-There is a calculation rule regarding approval status associated with the enablement of the Assign Source of Supply button.-If the purchase request is approved, then that document's data is approved and the purchase request released (with or without a source of supply assigned, depending on what the user has sent for approval).-This document is ready to have the purchase order created. Assign Source of Supply button will be disabled from purchase request screen. You are always able to assign source of supply when creating purchase order.-A purchase request that has been released without any approval process, hasn't been approved in that form thus editable before creating the purchase order.-Once the purchase order has been created, you cannot edit the source of supply on the purchase request.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Assign Source of Supply, Purchase Request

Title: Input Of Advanced Shipping Notification Communication Scenario Is Not Showing In The System
Content: Symptom-Input of Advanced Shipping Notification communication scenario is not showing in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Communication Scenarios view.-The Communication Scenario 'Input of Advanced Shipping Notification' is missing.-Cause-In the scoping of the implementation project, the following questions have to be marked on 'Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics' > 'Outbound Logistics' > 'Communication for Outbound Logistics.-Would you like to send advanced shipping notifications to your customers?-Do you want to send advanced shipping notifications electronically to your customers using electronic data exchange (EDX)?-Resolution-To scope the questions, go through following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your Implementation Project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Click on the Next button until step '4 Questions'.-Expand the Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Expand the Outbound Logistics.-Select the Communication for Outbound Logistics.-Then, scope the following questions:-Would you like to send advanced shipping notifications to your customers?-Do you want to send advanced shipping notifications electronically to your customers using electronic data exchange (EDX)?-Once these questions are scoped, you should be able to see the Input of Advanced Shipping Notification scenario.-Keywords- Input of Advanced Shipping Notification, communication scenario

Title: Product ID is not displayed as expected in Monitoring Invoices report
Content: Symptom-Product ID in the report is not corrrect. It shows ID.1 or ID.2 instead the ID itself.-For example, the product ID is ABC, it shows ABC.1 in the report Monitoring Invoices. (ABC represents the ID of the product)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Reports-Lists view.-Open the report Monitoring Invoices (SRMIV_B03_Q0020) and run it.-Shows Invoice and Product in the raw, you could see the Product shows ID ABC.1 for invoice XYZ. (XYZ represents the ID of invoice).-Open the product master data, the ID is ABC.-Open the invoice, the product ID is ABC as well.-Cause-The reason .1/.2 is coming back for Product IDs in the report is because it has materials and services created with the same IDs in the system.-In order to differentiate in the report, .1/.2 will be added if there is already a material and service created. System shows ABC.1 for material and ABC.2 for service.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Monitoring Invoices, Product ID, Supplier Invoice

Title: System Does not Determine Higher Level Cost Center Managers During Purchase Order Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You have defined the approval process for purchase order with rule Approval by all cost center managers by value limit of a project task, however system does not determine higher level cost center managers from the org structure hierarchy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order.-Go to the Approvals tab.-You can see that, approver determination is incomplete or incorrect.-Where you have defined the approval process for Purchase Order as Approval by all cost center managers by value limit of a project task and the corresponding Purchase Order is assigned to project task. If you open the project task, and navigate to Accounting you can see the responsible unit defined for the project task. Here system determined the cost center manager of the responsible unit assigned in the project task.-You expect system to find higher level managers from the Purchasing Approval Value Limit under Employee Work Distribution rule.-Cause-The cost center manager does not have any value limit maintained in the Purchasing Approval Value Limit section. In this case, system will give infinite approval limit to the user and assign the task to him.-Which means, system will not find any other higher level managers.-Resolution-You need to define the value limit for project cost center manager in the Purchasing Approval Value Limit from the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to Task Distribution view.-Select Employee Work Distribution.-Select Purchasing Approval Value Limit under the business area Purchasing.-Add Row and Maintained the Employee Responsible and define the Value Limit.-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-Higher Level Cost Center Managers, Approval by all cost center managers by value limit of a project task, project cost center manager

Title: Error Message 'Automatic Interval must always be numeric' When Editing Number Range of Purchaing Documents
Content: Symptom-The error "Automatic Interval must always be numeric" is displayed when editing the number range for a business object (for example: Operational Purchase Documents).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity: Number Ranges for Operational Purchase Documents (as example).-Select Purchase Orders.-Navigate to Interval for Purchase Orders.-Enter alphanumeric values for begin respectively end number.-Select Save.-The error "Automatic Interval must always be numeric" is displayed in the UI.-Example:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity: Number Ranges for Material.-Enter alphanumeric values for begin respectively end number of an existing or newly created automatic number range.-Select Save.-The error "Automatic Interval must always be numeric" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-In Business ByDesign system, it is only allowed to have numeric values for automatic number ranges.-It is a general prerequisite that automatic number ranges intervals must be purely numeric. That results from the requirement to get the numbers by always increasing them by one each time, which only works with numeric intervals.-Alphanumeric values may be used for example when creating orders via migration or webservice, but not for numbers that are automatically created by the system.-Resolution-This is the expected and designed system behavior.-Keywords-Number range, Purchase Order, Purchasing Contract, Interval, Material, Contract, Automatic Interval must always be numeric

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2005 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following are the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2005 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 18th of July. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Cross – Area Topic-Business Partner-Customer/Supplier Address Usage is now PSM enabled. (Hotfix ID: 4500008630)-UI Client-The issue with the keyboard not working in iPad is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008712. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Input value in search or selection bar was not working for iPad. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008044. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The help center now displays a further link that points to the latest hotfix collection information. (Hotfix ID: 4500007693)-  Customer Relationship Management-Activities-The phone call activity interface II_APFO_MANAGE_ACTV_PHNCL_IN has been enabled for extensions and can be consumed now by adding the extension fields to it. After you have added the extension fields to it, the WSDL can be downloaded from the Service Explorer view in the Application and User Management work center. (Hotfix ID: 4500007099)-Customer Quote-The error 'Pricing condition change not allowed' was appearing while deleting quote for contract with different price strategy during document deletion. It was occurring because quote for contract documents with different pricing strategy were being deleted together. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007639)-Customer Invoice-When numeric IDs were being used for locations to create a credit memo from return, or as a follow up document, there was an issue due to leading zeros. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008185)-Scheduled invoice request(s) created by releasing a contract with item(s) that have multiple invoice schedule dates outside the time horizon, now creates correct header amount value even after changing the contract's items' list price. (Hotfix ID: 4500008082)-Globalization fields for country version South Korea on Customer and Electronic Tax Invoice BOs related to Tax information are released for PSM. (Hotfix ID: 4500004125)-With this hotfix, in the India E-Invoicing request JSON file, the buyer email has been removed, and formatting of reference details section for credit memos is now enabled. (Hotfix ID: 4500003817)-Customer Return-An error was being displayed whenever an extension was performed on root of customer return document with a finished inbound status. The error was 'Change of party with role Freight Forwarder not permitted due to fulfillment status'. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007144)-Customer Contract-Customer Contract item query QUERY_BY_DETERMINATION query parameter APCRM_S_CTD_CC_IT_OV_DT_QRY_EL has been PSM released. (Hotfix ID: 4500007527)-Proforma Invoice-The dump appearing while saving Pro Forma Invoice using a sales quote is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007893)-Pricing-Discounts are no longer getting deleted from sales order after the release of an outbound delivery. (Hotfix ID: 4500007595. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Items of invoice schedule now show the correct amount and the respective percentage while creating customer contracts. Also, changing the list Price and reverting it back does not affect the amount value and percentage of the items in invoice schedule. (Hotfix ID: 4500007855)-Service Confirmation-The Manage Opportunity In web service now shows the Opportunity ID during update scenario. (Hotfix ID: 4500008162)-Service Orders-Goods and Service Acknowledgment (GSA) creation was not working in the mobile app as there were some issues in UI design modeling of the app. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007255. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  Financial Management-Accounting-The text for Account Determination Group was not visible in the languages that are not support by default such as Finnish. With this hotfix, the Account Determination Group is now visible in fallback language English. (Hotfix ID: 4500008440)-An inconsistency related to purchase account line item amount creation, in material-ledger relevant journal entries, is now fixed. The inconsistency appeared specifically in cases of multiple line items. (Hotfix ID: 4500001628)-Cost and Revenue-The issue with financial plan upload where incorrect functional areas were being derived for P&L accounts, is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007993)-When IFRS15 is scoped, for project-based items of type time and material, accrual method reverse deferrals and accruals (204) was not working as expected. The deferred revenue account and the accrued revenue account were not getting cleared. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008073)-Clearing Run-The clearing run was providing a log of 'No explanation item exists', but the actual issue was occurring due to the missing currency exchange rate for that open item. This error was not being caught during the logging. This issue is now fixed, and the appropriate error messages are displayed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007545)-Expense Report-You can now request the disabling of creation, change, and approval of new/existing Expense Reports in SAP Business ByDesign, if you are using SAP Business ByDesign - Concur Integration. You can request disabling by a corresponding customer incident. (Hotfix ID: 4500009080)-The Advisory Fuel Rates effective as of June 2020 are available and used while creating Expense Reports for employees in the UK. (Hotfix ID: 4500004027)-Lease Management-Migration of lease contract is now possible with either the Notices option or the Renewals option. (Hotfix ID: 4500008205)-Tax Calculation and Declaration-For Germany, two new rate type codes, 6 - Special Standard and 7- Special Reduced and the guidelines to configure them are now available. It is significant in case of existing documents such as contracts that have items both before and after 1 July 2020. These rate type codes assist in case you do not want to split the documents. (Hotfix ID: 4500008341. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-German Annual VAT return 2019 form template is now shipped. (Hotfix ID: 4500007656)-For Germany, tax rate for standard tax rate types 1 and 2 is now changed to 16% and 5% respectively, from 1 July 2020. (Hotfix ID: 4500007516. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-When the down payment request doesn't follow numbering in the output VAT domestic tax return form, clearing documents are appearing. As per the legal change, clearing invoice documents should appear in the form. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500005516)-In the GSTR1 tax return, import relevant data was not getting picked as per the legal change. Now, all the import relevant tax codes have been mapped to GSTR1 from GSTR2. (Hotfix ID: 4500009040)-Following errors have been fixed in the GB EC Sales List tax return file:-'HMRC_VAT_ESL_BULK_SUBMISSION_FILE' text now appears.-The company VAT number has 9 digits, the complete number, without 'GB' appearing at the beginning. The truncation issue is fixed.-The type of the file that is being generated out of the SAP Business ByDesign system is a .txt file. You must download the .txt file, save it in your system in the right file format (.csv or .xml or any other) before uploading it to the tax authority website. (Hotfix ID: 4500008055)-With this hotfix, the business configuration content for tax reporting has been deployed. It is required because of the rate change announced by Germany. (Hotfix ID: 4500000009)-For Austria, the VAT rate is being reduced to 5% for various services in the fields of gastronomy, tourism and culture. The new planned reduced rate for 5% is only for special services during the COVID-19 crisis. The new reduced tax rate is applicable in particular to the supply of food and beverages in restaurants, to tickets for cinemas, museums, theaters, music events, and to newspapers and other periodical publications.-The reduced tax rate is applicable for only a six months period, starting from 1 July, 2020 and ending on 31 December, 2020.-A new tax rate type Exceptional Reduced has been introduced as part of this legal change. You can create your own tax codes to use this new tax rate type. Note that no new tax code is being delivered for this change as it is only for a limited time period. The intention is to minimize the problems of retroactivity for entry into force on 1 July 2020. The Federal Ministry of Finance (BMF) informs that the corresponding VAT rate can be deposited in the cash register system as early as 1 July 2020, so that no subsequent correction of invoices and reclaims of VAT amounts is necessary. (Hotfix ID: 4500001216)-For Saudi Arabia, standard tax rate has been changed from 5% to 15%. This rate change is effective from 1 July 2020. (Hotfix ID: 4500005774. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-For Saudi Arabia, in case you want to select both the earlier rate of 5% and current Standard rate of 15% depending on the requirement (especially applicable in the case of old contracts that started before 1 July 2020), a new tax rate type Reduced has been introduced. (Hotfix ID: 4500008940)-  Human Resources-Time and Labor Management-Resource availability calendar now displays correct absence hours for service agents. (Hotfix ID: 4500007258. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-With this fix, the duplicates are not created, and it is ensured that only one holiday of a specific date is displayed in employee's time, in case where employees are assigned with temporary work schedule of type Short-Term Work. (Hotfix ID: 4500004668)-  Supply Chain Management-Analytics-The missing access context assignment to Customer Demand Details data source are now fixed. This will enable users to view only those customer demands in the data source / report which are relevant based on the access context and not all available instances.-However, as a consequence of this change:-Custom Data Sources based on SCMCDU01 might not work anymore-Reports based on SCMCDU01, that are assigned to an incompatible work center might not work anymore. (Hotfix ID: 4500006621)-Inventory-Discrepancy appearing between inventory and planning view of inventory because of Not Relevant for Planning logistics area type is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500004154. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Inbound Delivery-The serial number was not getting populated in the customer return notification screen within the Items tab, if you select a Sales Kit header (Kit item with serial numbers) and click Next. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007513)-Logistics Area-Extensibility support is enabled for logistics area to its object value selector. (Hotfix ID: 4500001328)-Production Bills of Material-The issue with creating on duplicate IDs in bills of material manage webservice is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008592)-Issue with deleted products being displayed in multilevel bottom up hierarchy is now addressed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007443)-Site Logistics-3PL outbound delivery data was missing in the data source warehouse request items. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008043)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Supplier Invoice-The system error during cancellation of Netherlands based Supplier Invoices is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007947)-Shopping Cart-RFQ action create with reference and location address reference in shopping cart is now PSM released. (Hotfix ID: 4500007529)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g. operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-BYD2005; HFC03; Hotfix; SPS03; Hotfix Collection; 2005

Title: Rolling Run Does Not Update Demand Plan
Content: Symptom-Rolling Run ABC (ABC represents the Rolling Run ID regarding the issue) is not impacting on the date for Demand Plan XYZ (XYZ represents the Demand Plan ID regarding the issue).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Demand Planning work center.-Go to the Rolling Runs view.-In the dropdown, select Active Rolling Runs.-Search for Rolling Run ABC.-In the dropdown, select Last 5 Logs.-You will see the Run ID ABC and the last Application Log ID. -Click the Application Log ID XXX (XXX represents the Log ID regarding the issue).-You will see that this Application Log ID is finished.-Go to the Demand Planning work center.-Go to the Demand Plans view.-Select Demand Plan XYZ.-Observing the Forecast Start Date, it should have moved to the next month. -Cause-You have to enter Demand Plan XYZ in the Run ID ABC. With this information, system will consider and update the correct Demand Plan.-Resolution-Go to the Demand Planning work center.-Search for Rolling Run ABC.-Select Run ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Under Selection Criteria Section, find the column Demand Plan ID From.-Click the selection box.-Enter The Demand Plan ID XYZ.-Click Save.-Keywords-Rolling Run, Demand Plan

Title: Forecasts are not showing up in planning screen although Forecasts are maintained and visible in Maintain Demand Forecast
Content: Symptom-Forecasts are not reflecting for KLM Material Master Data, planning area DEF in Planning screen, Although Material Master KLM is maintained as Demand Management Procedure and Demand Forecasts are maintained as weekly and saved.*KLM refers to Material Master id, DEF refers to planning area-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply planning work center-Navigate to Products View-Search for KLM/DEF-Select Open-Could not find forecasts in planning screen for week -Cause-Planning window will only display the unconsumed forecast quantity. To check unconsumed quantity follow the below steps-Go to Supply planning work center-In common task, select Maintain Demand Forecast-Enter Product id KLM and select period type as weekly-Select Go-Select an entry in Forecast Planning Table-You should be able to see unconsumed Forecast quantity-Resolution-This is expected behavior because for forecast maintained and is already consumed.-Keywords-Forecasts are not showing up in planning screen, Forecasts area maintained and visible in Maintain Demand Forecast

Title: Project not released after baseline is approved
Content: Symptom-Noticed that although a baseline is approved the project is not released automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Project is created. (A base line is created automatically or manually)-Then Base line is approved-But the Project is still in Planning status-Cause-Base line is just a document created to send for approval,( Base line is used to measure and assess project execution. Specifically, deviations from the original plan with respect to work planning and scheduling are tracked and monitored by the project manager and project stakeholders using baselines.)-So even after its approved you may decide to make some more changes in projects and create new Baseline again and thus we don't Release automatically.-also Project manager shall decide in general when to release the project.-Resolution-You may use the report :Project Variance by Project Structure Report  to see details of Baseline so that you can track Baseline status .-We accept that this could be required some times but we never had the updation of project status when Baseline is activated, thus its a new requirement for us.- So either- reach your Partners to help you achive your requirement.- or- Post all new requirements on Customer Influence Forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-  2938473 - Edited baseline details are not updated in the project-Keywords-Project baseline; PSM released for projects; Projects;

Title: Transport Lane Priority is not Working in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-For Transport Zone Zone1 there are two transport lanes Lane1  for Site1 and Lane2 for Site2 (where Zone1 is the Transport Zone ID , Lane1 and Lane2 are Transport Lane ID's, Site1 and Site 2 are Site ID's)-Lane1 & Lane2 are set with priority 1 and 2 respectively.-In a sales order 999 you expect that when there is no sufficient Stock in Site1, system should automatically propose Ship From as Site2 (999 is the Sales Order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Sales Order Workcenter and Sales Order View-2. Find Sales Order 999-3. Go to Line Items tab, Ship from is Site1-Cause-Transport lane priority is not based on stock availability.-Hence system does not automatically select the transport lane  with the Site where the stock exists for the product to fulfill the sales order.-Resolution-Transport lane priority  can be set based on product category/product but not on stock availability.-If the transport lane is made inactive or obsolete either temporarily /permanently for Business Reasons in which case the next priority of the transport lane is selected.-Keywords-Transport Zone, Transport Lane, Priority, Product Category, Sales Order, Ship From

Title: System triggers error "Negative Stock Not  Allowed" while confirmation of Pick Task
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm pick task  KLM, error appears "Negative stock not allowed in log. area DEF (prod. GHI identified stock MNO)",*KLM refers to Pick Task id., DEF refers to Logistics Area Id, GHI refers to Product id, MNO refers to Identified Stock id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Task Control View-Search for Pick Task KLM-Click Confirm-Select Propose Quantities and Logistics Area-Select Save-Error appears "Negative stock not allowed in log. area DEF (prod. GHI identified stock MNO)" -Cause-As there is not sufficient stock available to process this task, Hence this error is valid.-Resolution-Make sure that there is sufficient stock available in Warehouse and the process the task-Keywords-Negative stock not allowed in log. area (prod. identified stock), System triggers error "Negative Stock Not  Allowed" while confirmation of Pick Task, While confirmation of Pick Task error appears

Title: Purchase Order Item Status Cannot Be Added on Form Template
Content: Symptom-'Item status' field cannot be added on Purchase Order form template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order).-Click on the View All button.-Click on Preview > Created/Changed PO. -PDF file does not display the Item status.-Cause-The Item Status field is not available to be selected in the Purchase Order template.-Resolution-We advise to add the field via Extensibility or PDI solution by contacting the implementation partner or the SAP Service Center.-Keywords- PDF, Purchase Order Item Status, Item Status, Form Template, PO Template

Title: You cannot Complete Third-Party Logistics Integration Scenario due to the Error message: 'Invalid authentication method'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to implement the Third-Party Logistics Integration Scenario, and have set up the relevant Communication Arrangement. You select the Authentication Method: None, since your Third-Party Logistics Provider uses an Office 365 Webhook to collect the data, which does not require an authentication with either a certificate or username/password.-However, when you perform Check Completeness, the system displays the error message: 'Invalid Authentication Method'. Now you want to know if the Authentication Method “None” is a valid option for the Third-Party Logistics Integration Scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Communication Arrangements view.-Find and select the relevant Third-Party Logistics Integration Communication Scenario.-Click the Edit button.-Check Completeness, and the system displays the error message: Invalid authentication method.-Cause-The Authentication Method for Outbound Communication cannot be set to 'none'. There has to be one Authentication Method for Outbound Communication.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view and select the Communication Arrangements subview.-Find the relevant Communication Arrangement: Third-Party Logistics Integration.-Select and edit it.-Choose Check Completeness on the top of the screen.-System displays the error: Invalid Authentication Method.-Now go to the Technical Data tab and check under Outbound Communication: Basic Settings.-In the field Authentication Method, select either SSL Client Certificate or User ID and Password as per your business requirement.-Perform Save and reactivate the Communication Arrangement.-Keywords-Invalid, Authentication, Method, None, 3PL, Provider, Communication, Arrangements, Scenario

Title: Product Specification does not show for Input Products in Supply to Production Tab of Production Order
Content: Symptom-You observe Product Specification Id does not appear in Input Products of Supply To Production Tab for Production Order KLM. *KLM refers to Production Order Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Production Control  Work Center-Go to Production Orders-- By Order Header  View-Select  production order KLM-Select  Edit-Navigate to Products Tab-Navigate to sub tab - Supply to Production-We observe for Input Products Product Specification value did not populate-Cause-There could be multiple Causes why Product Specification did not appear-Product Specification of Input Product  is not maintained at Master Data Level.-Product Specification of Output Product is not maintained at Master Data Level.-Product Specification is not released for Output Product or Input Product-While creating Production Proposal, Product Specification of Output Product is not maintained.-Resolution-In order to resolve the error, Maintain Product Specification for Input Product or Output Product as mentioned below-Navigate to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center -Go to Product Specifications View-Maintain Product Specification id, Product ID-Select Release-Keywords-Product Specification does not show for Input Products in Supply to Production Tab of Production Order, When Product Specification of Input Product is not maintained at Master Data Level, Product Specification of Output Product is not maintained, While creating Production Proposal, Product Specification not maintained.

Title: Sales Kit with Identified Stock is Not Supported in Customer Return at Kit Header Level
Content: Symptom-An error message "Sales Kit with batch item not allowed" occurs when trying to create a New Customer Return Notification from a sales order using the kit header item as a reference.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Open New Customer Return Notification in Common Tasks.-Search for the Sales Order or the Outbound Delivery you wish.-Select the line of the kit head.-Choose Next, an error "Sales Kit with batch item not allowed" would appear.-Cause-During the shipping phase, the user splits the kit sub-item(s) to issue product(s) with different identified stocks. This alters the association between the kit head and its sub-items. As a result, the system does not permit the creation of Customer Return Notifications using kit heads in this situation, leading to the expected error.-Resolution-To create a Customer Return Notification for a Sales Kit, please select the individual sub-items with identified stocks instead of selecting the kit head.--When you create a customer return notification, a customer return is also created for these kit sub-items. Upon opening the customer return, you may encounter an error stating "Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" for each item.--To resolve this error, you can manually add product prices that match the kit by following these steps:-Go to the Pricing Tab.-Choose Add Row for the first line product.-Select "List Price" as the Price Component.-Enter the appropriate amount.-Repeat steps 2-4 for other line products.-Then the error would be resolved.-Keywords-Sales Kit with batch item not allowed, Kit Header, Identified Stock, Customer Return, Customer Return Notification

Title: Error When Creating Inventory Adjustment With Serial Numbers
Content: Symptom-While performing an Inventory Adjustment for Logistics Areas XXX and YYY with Serial Numbers, including Serial Number ZZZ, you face errors.-XXX = Logistics Area ID-YYY = Logistics Area ID-ZZZ = Serial Number ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select Physical Inventory work center. -Choose New Inventory Adjustment common task. -Fulfill the related Storage Location and Product ID. -Click Go. -Check the box for the Logistics Area XXX and YYY. -Click Next. -For the Logistics Area XXX, check the box Zero Quantity. -For the Logistics Area YYY, enter the Serial Number list, where ZZZ is the first one. -Click Next. -Click Finish. -You will receive the errors: -Save failed. Before continuing, you must close and then reopen the New Inventory Adjustment view.-Serial number ZZZ cannot be received to the logistics area-Save failed-Cause-One or more Serial Numbers in the list added to Logistics Area YYY is currently maintained in Logistics XXX. When you zero the quantity in Logistics Area XXX, system is trying to delete all the Serial Numbers in this Logistics Area. However you are also adding it to Logistics Area YYY. So system throws an error message.-Please note that the error can be misleading and it will only indicate the problem for the first Serial Number in the list, but this is not necessarily the Serial Number maintained in Logistics Area XXX.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can perform the Inventory Adjustment only for Logistics Area XXX first and then for Logistics Area YYY:-Select Physical Inventory work center. -Choose New Inventory Adjustment common task. -Fulfill the related Storage Location and Product ID. -Click Go. -Check the box for the Logistics Area XXX. -Click Next. -For the Logistics Area XXX, check the box Zero Quantity. -Click Next-Click Finish. -Select Physical Inventory work center.-Choose New Inventory Adjustment common task.-Fulfill the related Storage Location and Product ID.-Check the box for the Logistics Area YYY. -Click Next.-For the Logistics Area YYY, enter the Serial Number list. -Click Next.-Click Finish.-Keywords-Received, LoA, adjustment

Title: Unable to Block a Product From Being Shipped to a Particular Location.
Content: Symptom-Product 999 is blocked in Transport Lane for Ship From 111 and  Transport Zone 222(999 is the Product ID, 111 Ship From Site  and 222 is   the  Transport Zone ID).- However in the the Sales Order 123 it is possible to ship the Product 999 to Location that belongs to Transport Zone 222.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data workcenter and Transport Lanes view-2. Find Transport Lane 222-3. In the Allowed Products, Product 999 is blocked where Ship From is 111 and Transport Zone 222.-4. Go to Sales Order workcenter and Sales Order View-5. Find Sales Order 123-6. We can see that the product has ship from 111 and Ship to location belongs to Transport Zone 222.-It is still possible to Release the Sales Order and Ship the product-Cause-As per the system design active status precedes all other status.-For example if you select All Products as active, the system by default considers All Products as active status.-Despite this if one of the product is blocked it acts as a contradiction hence it system considers the product as active.-Resolution-Explicitly mention the products which have to be Active and Blocked( for the transport lane to stop it from being proposed in the source of supply list in Sales Order).-Also you can make use of product category option in transport lane.-Keywords-Blocked , Sales order  , Ship From  , Transport Lane  , Transport Zone

Title: Ship-From Details Section Appears Blank While Creating Project Stock Order With Item Type Consumption at Site
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are creating a new project stock order from project with item type Consumption at site however ship-from location does not show in the value help list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center and Projects view-Select the relevant Project and go to Products tab -Under Product Overview section, select Create Project Stock Order for Released Project Tasks -Select Item Type as Consumption at Site-Try to select Ship-From location from the value help-No records found-Cause- When you select Consumption at Site, in this scenario, the project consumes the materials from a particular site.-How Ship-From Determination happens in Project Stock Orders?-In the Consumption at Site scenario where the project consumes the materials from a particular site, the system takes the ship-from site from the project stock order. In the absence of a ship-from site, the system uses the address information of the ship-to party given in the project stock order to determine a matching transport zone, and finds a ship-from site based on the transport zone and transport lane information. The system always checks if a logistics area of logistics use Project Stock has been defined for the ship-from site before it uses it for a project stock order.-The reason why system does not show any value under the ship-from location because there is no stock at particular site for product. Hence when you select Consumption at site, no value comes under Ship-From location section.-Note:-In the Pre-delivery scenario where the materials are pre-delivered to the site of consumption, the system uses the address information of the ship-to party given in the project stock order to determine a matching transport zone. Based on the transport zone and transport lane information, it finds a ship-from site in the same way as described for sales orders and sales quotes.-Resolution-You need to create a stock for product at particular site. Make sure that you define the logistics area of logistics use Project Stock has been defined for the ship-from site before it uses it for a project stock order. Later you will be able to select Ship-From location details for consumption at site.-Keywords-Ship-from details blank in project stock order; Ship-from blank in PSO; Ship-From location missing; Ship-from location does not show in project stock order-ship-from details blank in project stock,ship-from location missing,ship-from location does not show in proj,ship-from blank in pso

Title: Blank Values in Fields  "Delivered Quantity" & "Promised Quantity" but it's not the same in the "Confirmed Quantity" field in the Standard Report : Customer Demand Details
Content: Symptom-You observe Blank values in Report: Customer Demand Details (SCMCDU01_Q0001) for Fields Delivered Quantity & Promised Quantity although Confirmed Quantity field has values.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Navigate to Design Reports View-Search for SCMCDU01_Q0001-Maintain Selection parameters as Order Category as 114, Delivery Status as 1, Created on "Current Week"-Click Apply-You observe "Delivered Quantity" & "Promised Quantity" contains blank fields-Cause-Fields Delivered quantity and Promised quantity is empty since their respective Fulfilled, Promised schedule lines unlike confirmed scheduled lines does not exist for this item.-Resolution- This is an expected behavior. The quantities will be blank when a particular schedule line does not exist. 0 quantity will be shown only if the schedule line exists and the quantity is 0.-Keywords-Blank Values in Fields  "Delivered Quantity" & "Promised Quantity", Blank Values in Fields  "Delivered Quantity" & "Promised Quantity" but it's not the same in the "Confirmed Quantity" field in the Standard Report: Customer Demand Details

Title: System Cannot Find Super Ordinate Cost Center Manager in the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-System could not find the approver when the approval rule is Supplier Invoice Approval By Superordinate Cost Center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing wotk center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to Approvals tab-You can see the message - No approver found; task is unassigned-Cause-The supplier invoice is assigned to project task and the responsible unit assigned in the project is ABC. The superordinate cost center is XYZ however, this org unit is not marked as cost center and hence system could not determine the cost center manager. (here ABC and XYZ refers to org units)-Resolution-If you expect system to determine any cost center manager of superordinate cost center, you need to mark the org unit as cost center under Definitons tab. Then system will determine the superordinate cost center manager.-Keywords-Super ordinate cost center manager; approval of supplier invoice; approval of scanned invoice; superordinate cost center manager

Title: Different Unit of Measure For The Lot Size And Lot Quantity Displayed in a Production Check Task
