Content: Symptom-You have created an inspection plan ABC (ABC represents the ID of the inspection plan) for product XYZ's (XYZ is the ID of the given product) production inspection, and set sample quantity as 100 meters (we will use this quantity as an example to describe the behaviour). Now, there is a check task XXX created with inspection plan ABC as reference. When confirming check task XXX, you find that the sample size is 1 ea. When entering a value in the Inspected Quantity field, system reports a warning that "Inspected quantity unit differs from the sample size unit".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Quality Control.-View Monitoring and select the Inspections sub-view.-Find the inspection DEF (DEF is the ID of the inspection).-Click the button Confirm task. -Enter a value for the Inspected Quantity field. -Click the Refresh button. -The system will display a warning message: Inspected quantity unit differs from the sample size unit-Cause-The reason for the lot quantity being displayed as 1 ea is because the lot quantity is expressed in the base unit of measure of the product for inspection. The lot size is the same amount expressed in the discrete unit of measure.-The lot quantity is in meters (since m-meter is the base unit of the product XYZ). Since there is no conversion maintained in the product master data for discrete unit of measure, by default the system takes 1 ea as the lot size.-The sample size is calculated based on the lot size.-As in our example the lot size is 1 ea, the sample size is also calculated as 1 ea.-Resolution-The warning message that you receive (Inspected quantity unit differs from the sample size unit), is a raised by the system to highlight that there are differences in the  quantities.-You can, anyway, complete the inspection with the actual quantities and this will work fine.-See Also-You can also refer to the help document Inspection Process-Keywords-lot size, lot quantity, inspection, inspected quantity, differs, sample size, unit

Title: Approval Notification Not Triggered To Processor When Ticket Is Approved By The Approver
Content: Symptom-When a ticket is approved by the Approver, the Processor of the ticket does not get a notification indicating that the ticket has been approved.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service work center.-Go to the Tickets view.-Open a Ticket XYZ (XYZ represents the ticket ID).-Send the ticket XYZ for Approval.-Log in as the Approver and approve the ticket XYZ.-The Processor of the ticket does not get a notification.-Cause-For tickets, we currently do not have notifications triggered from the Business Task Management framework as part of approval status change. Hence this is a new requirement.-Resolution-You need to create a workflow rule to trigger an automatic notification or e-mail to the processor when a ticket is approved.-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the Workflow Rules view.-Click New.-Select the Business Object as Ticket.-Select the Timing as 'On Every Save'.-Maintain the Conditions as 'Approval Status' (Before Object Change) Not Equal To 'Approved' AND 'Approval Status' = 'Approved'.-In the next step, maintain the Recipient as 'Agent Responsible for Ticket'.-See Also-2682061 - Workflow Rule Does Not Send E-mail Notification to Approver of Ticket-Keywords-ticket, approved, notification, approval, agent, processor, workflow, approver

Title: The Line Item List is Empty in Project Invoice Request and Cannot Be Edited
Content: Symptom-You have created and released a project invoice request with some expense items and later found that the line item list (CSV file) is empty.-It can no longer be edited or deleted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select view Project Invoicing-> Project Invoice Request-Search for the respective Project Invoice Request-Navigate to Items tab-Select Itemized List->select view and edit-The excel file ItemizedList.csv contains no record of the expense items-Cause-Whenever you create a new project invoice request, you should follow the steps from the guided activity:-1. General Data-2. Additional Data-3. Define Invoice Items-4. Select Time and Expenses-5. Refine Invoice Items-6. Refine Pricing-7. Confirmation-After the invoice items are defined in step 3, the time and expenses should be assigned in step 4.-But if you go directly to step 5 where the itemized list can be created manually, then this issue will occur.-That means, if you create the csv file before assigning the expenses to the invoice items, the csv file will not show expenses.-This is what has happened in this project invoice request.-Resolution-You should create CSV file(itemized list) after assignment of the expenses.-If the invoice request is already released, you cannot edit it, so if you still need to have the csv file populated, you need to cancel and re-create the project invoice request as per the above steps.-Keywords-Project invoice Request, Itemized List, CSV file, Expense Items

Title: Undo Cancellation of Production Order which is in Cancelled Status
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to reverse Canceled Production Order DEF which is  in Cancelled Status.*DEF refers to Production Order Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Production Control Work Center-Go to By Order Header View-Search for DEF Production Order -We see it is in Canceled Status-You do not find any option to reverse Cancellation of Production Order DEF-Cause-There is no option to Undo Cancel the Production Order DEF which is in Canceled Status.-Resolution-Since the Production Order DEF is canceled, corresponding production tasks are in Finished Status, You should be able to Create Order Action for the same Production Request again.Follow the below steps to create Production Order for the same Production Request-Navigate to Production Control Work Center -Go to Production Requests View-Select Create Order--> Full Quantity-Keywords-Undo Cancellation for Production Order which is in Canceled Status, Reversal of Production Order which is in Canceled Status, Undo Cancellation of Production Order

Title: Subscribed Task 'Provide Follow-Up Decision in Return to Supplier' is Not Sending The E-mail Notification to Responsible
Content: Symptom-Subscribed task 'Provide Follow-Up Decision in Return to Supplier' is not sending the e-mail notification.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Tasks and select the New Return to Supplier option.-Select the respective Inbound Delivery Item in the Step 1.-Click on Next button.-Fill out the necessary details for the Return to Supplier.-Click on Next until reaching the Confirmation step. -System generates a task 'Provide Follow-Up Decision in Return to Supplier', the task e-mail does not arrive to the person responsible.-Cause-By selecting the task for Return to Supplier ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Return to Supplier) in Application and User Management, then Bussiness Task Management and opening the respective Application Log, system display the result message: 'Unknown responsible with UUID DEF (Type )' (DEF represents the UUID for the Return to Supplier).-This is happening because the Org Unit for Return to Supplier ABC does not have any Employee or any Functions defined. The Org Unit can be found in the Ship From field of the Return to Supplier.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, it is necessary to have employees assigned in the Return to Supplier Org Unit and also functions defined. This can be done as per following steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Click on the Org Structures view.-Select the respective Org Unit.-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the OK button.-Go to the Employees tab.-Click on the Add button.-Add the employees.-Go to the Functions tab.-Define the functions according to the business need.-Click on the button Save.-Once this configuration is defined, the task should be assigned to the responsible person and this person can receive the e-mail notification.-Keywords- Return to Supplier, Org unit, Provide Follow-Up Decision in Return to Supplier, Unknown responsible with UUID

Title: New Demand Plan Created  with Weekly Bucket and Released did not update Planning screen with Weekly Forecasts
Content: Symptom-You have created and Released New Demand Plan KLM which is in Active status  with Weekly Bucket, However in Planning screen Forecasts maintained for Old Demand Plan DEF which is in Obsolete Status, Bucket Type Monthly is shown.*KLM refers to New Demand Plan, *DEF refers to Old Demand Plan-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Demand Planning Work Center-Go to Demand Plans View-Search for DEF & KLM-You Observe Old Demand Plan DEF is in Obsolete Status, and New Demand Plan KLM is in Active Status-Go to Supply Planning Work Center-Navigate to Products View-Search for Product PQR-In Product Planning Details Observe Forecast in Month although New Demand plan  Forecasts are in Week.-Cause-This is actually the expected behavior from the system,monthly buckets are already created in the system by older Demand Plan DEF which is now obsolete. Now since a new Demand Plan KLM is created with weekly bucket, system can not automatically change the bucket type for already created forecast from month to week or even vice versa.-Resolution-Hence solution would be before releasing new Demand Plan KLM with different bucket type you go to current forecast and delete the monthly forecast and then release the new Demand Plan with weekly bucket.-In order to Delete Old Forecasts, Follow the below steps-Go to Supply Planning Work Center-In Common tasks, Navigate to Maintain Demand Forecast-Enter Product ID and Period Type and Run the Query-Select the Forecasting in Forecasting Planning Table-Click Delete.-Keywords-New Demand Plan Created  with Weekly Bucket and Released did not update Planning screen,  Weekly Forecasts not updated in planning screen by New Demand Plan, Demand plan obsolete forecasts still exist

Title: Exception "The receipt document is missing or invalid" appears when posting intercompany supplier invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 1584460***-Exception "The receipt document is missing or invalid" appears when posting intercompany supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for respective supplier invoice-Go to Exceptions tab-You will see the exception: Missing Receipt or Return Document - Error Message "The receipt document is missing or invalid."-Cause-One of the reason for this exception is that there is a miscommunication happened in the system, making the Invoice has no receipt document, even though it was coming from a valid inbound delivery.-Resolution-You can correct the miscommunication by performing a dummy change in the invoice by doing following steps:-Open the supplier invoice that has the exception of receipt missing-View All-Go to Items tab-Select the item-Go to Basic Data sub tab-Scroll down to section “Buyer References”-There is no field “Goods Receipt ID” below the field “Order Migrated Code”, it should be there with the receipt document.-Now you change the field ‘Order Migrated Code’ from blank to ‘Not Migrated’ (don't save!)-Now you erase the ‘Not Migrated’ from the field leaving it blank again-Click anywhere in the screen-Then, the field “Goods Receipt ID” will show up with the related document (now you can save).-See Also-2594681 - Exception :Missing Receipt or Return Document-2736643 - Exception Appears While Processing Supplier Invoice Document-3232570 - The system has created an exception because the receipt document is missing or invalid. Process the corresponding exception-Keywords-Internal Intercompany Supplier Invoice, Missing Receipt or Return Document, The receipt document is missing or invalid

Title: The 'Ordering date' and 'Ordered on' date in Monitoring Purchase Order Report are not the same as 'Ordered on' date in purchase order.
Content: Symptom-The 'Ordering date' and 'Ordered on' date in Monitoring Purchase Order Report are not the same as 'Ordered on' date in purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Filter the list 'All Documents'.-Search and open the affected purchase order.-Navigate to items tab - Basic data sub tab, you will find the 'Ordered on' date of this particular item.-However, if you go to the report 'Monitoring Purchase Order' (Data source: SRMPO_B02), both the 'Ordering date' and 'Ordered on' date showing there are not the same as the one in the document.-Cause-'Ordered on' and 'Ordering date' in Monitoring Purchase Order point to Root Ordered Date.-Resolution-There is a characteristic called "Item Ordered On" which is not part of Montoring orders, but customer can click on Configure on the reports and Add fields to add into the report.-Keywords-Monitoring Purchase Orders report, SRMPO_B02, Ordering date, Ordered on

Title: Production Order Numbers are not Sequential or Continuous
Content: Symptom-During creation of Production Order you notice that the new production order is not sequential with the previously created   production order number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the work center Production Control.-2. Go to the view Production Order-3. Select Show All Production Orders-4. Sort by Production Order-You can notice some gaps from one Production Order to the next one.-Cause-If the production order is missing from the system, it means that production order must have been deleted when it was in 'In Preparation'  status.-Resolution-There is no gap control for production orders. Hence for production orders we do not guarantee sequential numbering or no gap numbering.-However, the number generation for Production  order permits the usage of buffers to avoid wastage of numbers.-Hence, if any production order is deleted, then this order ID can be used up in future for any new production order.-But there will be no duplicate numbering.-Hence you notice that the production order numbering is not sequential as per the creation date.-  Keywords-Production Order, Number, Sequential, Continuous, buffer, delete, In Preparation.

Title: Error appears " Serial Number xxx for Product cannot be issued" when trying to create and release Third-Party Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-While trying to create Third-Party Delivery Notification from Third-Party Purchase Order DEF with Serial Number xxx, Product KLM, click on Release button, following error appears:-Serial Number xxx for Product cannot be issued.-*xxx refers to serial Number, KLM refers to Product ID, DEF refers to Purchase Order ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Go to Third-Party Purchase Orders View.-Search for DEF.-Select New Third-party Delivery Notification.-Enter mandatory fields like Delivery Notification id, Serial Number.-Maintain Serial Number as "xxx".-Click on Release.-Then above error appears.-Cause-This is a Valid error, as Serial Number "xxx", Tagged Inventory Status is "Issued to Customer" which means the current serial number has already been issued to Customer and no longer exist in warehouse.-Resolution-As SerialNumber profile is set as "Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Processes" in Product Master and Tagged Inventory Status is "Issued to Customer" for a Serial Number.This is the expected behaviour.-Keywords-Serial Number for Product cannot be issued, Issued to Customer, Third-party Delivery Notification, Release

Title: Account Assignment Type cannot be edited when copying Item in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When copying an item in purchase order ABC, the Account Assignment Type is not editable-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Order work center.-Go to Purchase Order View.-Select All.-Search For Purchase Order ID.-Click Edit and View All.-Navigate to Items Tab.-Select one item for copying.-Click in Copy to create a new item.-Select this new created item.-Click the sub-tab Account Assignment.-From here the Account Assignment Type cannot be edited.-Cause-In purchase order ABC, an attempt is being made to copy an item with multiple cost assignments (MCA) and a reference to a Purchase Request.-In this case, we do not allow the change of assignment.-Resolution-As part of the design, the GSA items would be created based on the account assignment data in the case of MCA.-For example, if it is 90% CC1 and 10% CC2, then there would be 2 GSA items, and the posting would be made to Accounting.-Now changing the same in purchase order, per example from CC to PRO, would result in posting to different ledgers than that of what was requested as part of Shopping cart and/or Purchase Request. -The same issue would not occur when attempting to copy an item with only one Account Assignment-Keywords-Purchase Order, Account Assignment cannot be edited, Multiple Cost Assignment, Copying an Item.

Title: Service not found in the drop down in Work tab of Project task
Content: Symptom-You could not find the service in the dropdown/value help- or- You received error:-"Service product XXX is not valid. Only time-based service products are allowed. Maintain quantity conversions in time-based units such as hour in the service product master data."-where XXX is product ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to Project view-Search and open respective Project-Go to Project plan tab-Select respective Project task-Go to Work tab-Go to value help of Service field-You don't find respective Service- or-when you forcefully enter the service and click on enter button you shall get the above mentioned error-Cause-Only time-based service products are allowed in project.-Resolution-So either maintain quantity conversions in time-based units such as hour or maintain Base UOM in time-based units such as hour in the service product master data.-Keywords-Service not found, service  not appearing,  unable to choose service, service not available

Title: Purchase Order Item Updating The Product Category When a Contract is Triggered
Content: Symptom- Purchase Order item is updating the Product Category when a Contract is triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Task, New Purchase Order.-Complete the parameters.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Enter the Item.-Select the necessary quantity as defined in the Contract.-The Contract is triggered and the Product Category is updated to the one maintained in the Contract.-Cause-Even thought the Product Category is different between the Contract and Product/Service Master Data, once the Contract is triggered, system will take the Product Category maintained in the Contract.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Our suggestion for this scenario is to remove the line in the Contract and update with the expected Product Category.-Keywords-Contract, Product Category, Purchase Order

Title: Purchase Order is not Picked Up in Scheduled ERS run
Content: Symptom-You have created an Evaluated Receipt Settlement Run in Supplier Invoicing work center with Grouping Criterion: By Purchase Order and Selection: Supplier ID:XXX (XXX refers to supplier ID)-You have created a Purchase order with the same supplier and expect that the run will pick the purchase order but you see that even though the run is executed on the scheduled date, the purchase order is not picked up.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Evaluated Receipt Settlements-Create a run with Grouping Criterion: By Purchase Order and Selection: Supplier ID: XXX-Log is created but no supplier invoice is generated-Cause-There is a common run SAP_COMMON which is active in the system and creates invoice. This run is a generic one and runs for all suppliers.-The Purchase order is picked up in this run and invoice has been created. Hence, it is not picked up in the new run.-Resolution-Please keep the generic run as Obsolete as it includes all suppliers and might cause conflict with the manual runs. Then you can set up a manual run with various criteria and schedule the runs.-Keywords-Evaluated Receipt Settlements, Purchase Orders, Supplier Invoices

Title: Edited baseline details are not updated in the project
Content: Symptom-You have observed that despite making changes and activating the baseline details, it seems that they have not had any impact on the actual project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-A project is created. (A base line is created automatically or manually)-You need to make a change to the original project, so a new baseline is generated and sent to approval (at this time, there are 2 base lines one in approval and another with pending changes-In the new baseline the changes are not accepted but requires an additional change, so you withdraw he base line form approval and then new baseline is edited and resubmitted for approval.-The new baseline is activated and the other lines are obsolete.-A a new baseline is changed and activated it has no effect on the actual project-Cause-Specifically, deviations from the original plan with respect to work planning and scheduling are tracked and monitored by the project manager and project stakeholders using baselines. When you edit the baseline you shall not have the project base line same as  project, cause in general baseline is an external view of project that you want to get approval  from stakeholder so it may be different than project. Project manager shall decide in general what changes are required and also whether approvals is required or not to the base line.-Resolution-You may use the report :Project Variance by Project Structure Report  to see details of Baseline so that you can have track of such changes which did not reflect in project. We accept that  this could be required some times and we never had the updation of Baseline on to project thus its a new requirement for us. So either reach your Partners to help you- or- Post all new requirements on Customer Influence Forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-See Also-2945624 - Project not released after baseline is approved-Keywords-Edited baseline details are not updated in the project

Title: Material Planning on Multiple Sites
Content: Symptom-You have two different Sites where you store your Stock. You operate Site A as your main site and from there you ship Products to your customers. While Site B functions only as a storage location. Now you are looking for a way you can utilize the Stock levels of both Sites within your Material Planning run, so that when there is a Demand the following is executed:-When there is no stock available at Site A, an Availability check is triggered for the stock at Site B.-You want the system to create stock transfer proposals or purchase proposals from Site B to A based on your setting. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Find and select the relevant Product.-You can see the Product is assigned to the Sites A and B.-Select the Row with Site A.-Click the Open button to open the Product Planning Details screen.-You can see there is a Demand, but the Available Quantity is not sufficient.-Click Run Planning, and then choose Single BoM Level or Multi BoM Level.-Now you expect that the system creates Stock Transfer Proposals or Purchase Proposals based on your setting.-Resolution-The system does not consider whether there is sufficient stock at site B. As long as there is a valid transport lane from B to A, the system would create  stock transfer proposals instead of purchase proposals. In order to create a purchase proposal, you need to block the corresponding transport lane.-Keywords-ATP, MRP, Multiple, Location, Planning Area, Stock Transfer Proposals, Purchase Proposals, Production Proposals, Priority, Source, Supply

Title: While creating New Stock Transfer Order ATP Status shows as Red although Stock is available in Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a New Stock Transfer Order for Product DEF, ATP shows as Red  although Stock is available in Stock Overview and Planning Screen.*DEF refers to Product id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control -In common task Navigate to  New Stock transfer Order-In New Stock  Transfer Order screen Enter parameters like Ship from, Ship to & Product DEF, quantity etc-You observe ATP Status for Product DEF  as Red although Stock is available-Cause-In product planning details screen for Product DEF you observe stock is tagged to Sales Orders in Execution-Resolution-ATP showing red while creating Stock transfer Order is right behavior, There are 2 ways of resolving this issue-1)You will have to cancel Sales Orders in Execution to see ATP showing as green-OR-2)You will have to process Sales Orders in Execution for Post Goods Issue to have Stock picture right in Stock overview and Planning screen.-Keywords-While creating New Stock Transfer Order ATP Status shows as Red although Stock is available in Stock Overview, While creating New Stock Transfer Order ATP Status shows as Red although Stock is available in Planning screen

Title: Error Message: Istock type for product specification ABC not valid or does not exist
Content: Symptom-In project - materials tab, you are adding a material from stock but you are not able to select any product specification for it due to error message:-Istock type for product specification ABC not valid or does not exist. (ABC represents the product specification ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Project view-Find the project and click Edit-Go to Project Planning tab, Materials subtab-Add Row-Enter the material XYZ (XYZ represents the material ID), select From Stock indicator, the Product Specification column will be available-Select the product specification ABC from the value help, enter-You can see the above error message.-Cause-Although you have released product specification for material XYZ, in the material master data, you haven't defined the identified stock type for it.-Resolution-Please maintain an identifided stock type for the product as follows:-Open the master data of material XYZ-Go to General tab-Maintain the Identified Stock Type field. Select type Optional Specific Stock or Mandatory Specified Stock.-The Product Specification Enabled indicator will automatically checked when you select type Optional Specific Stock or Mandatory Specified Stock.-After the change saved, you will be able to select product specification for material XYZ in project.-Keywords-Project Material, Product Specification, Istock Type, Identified Stock Type

Title: Supplier Invoice Linked to Project Task Displays an Additional Approver
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoice linked to Project Task displays an additional Approver in the Approval task.-Approval Process defined is the 'Approval by Cost Assignment'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit mesmo view.-Search and open the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Supplier Invoice).-Click on the View All button.-Click on Approval tab.-System assigned the Approval Task to the Project Manager and another additional employee.-Cause-The unexpected employee is marked as Substitute in the respective Project.-Substitutes have the same authorization for the project as the project responsible. Therefore the approval tasks are also being assigned to that user.-Resolution-System behavior is correct, as the user is selected as Substitute. To unflag the Substitution checkbox, you can access the following path:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search and open the respective Project.-Go to Team and Staffing tab.-Unflag the Substitute checkbox for the user.-Once this is done, user will not receive the approval tasks anymore.-Keywords-Project Task, Approval Process, Approval, Supplier Invoice, Cost Assignment, Project, Substitution

Title: Issue With the Creation of Sub-items When Performing 'Post Goods Receipt' After the Upgrade to 2005 Release
Content: Symptom-You are trying to do a Post Goods Receipt against an Inbound Delivery Notification which contains Line Items with Identified Stock. When you try to Add Sub-Items in the 'Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt' screen, and choose the 'Add sub-item' button, the system issues a message informing you that the actual quantity is missing.-If you now enter the Actual Quantity and then proceed to click on 'Add Sub-Item' again, the system issues another message informing you that the value for the Identified Stock is missing.-Prior to the Upgrade to 2005 Release, you do not need to fill in the Actual quantity as well as the Identified stock fields if you are splitting the Line Items. Now you want to understand why the system is behaving this way after the Upgrade.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Find and select the relevant Purchase Order.-Click the Post Goods Receipt button.-In the new window (Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt), select the relevant Line Item, and click on the Add Sub-Item button.-The system returns the error message: Actual quantity missing; enter actual quantity.-Enter the Actual Quantity, and the system returns the error "Value for identified stock missing".-If you proceed to click the Add Sub-Item button, the system returns the messages:-Action failed.------> Value for identified stock missing.------> Value for identified stock missing.-Value for identified stock missing.-You expect to be able to split the Line Items without the system checking for Actual Quantity and Identified Stock ID.-Cause-We introduced the change with the 2005 release to establish parity between the Task Confirmation and the Post Goods Receipt processes.-If you notice, in the Task Confirmation UI, it is mandatory that you enter the Quantity, the Logistics Area and the Identified Stock ID (for products with mandatory identified stock profile) before you can split the Line Item.-In the Post Goods Receipt screen, along with this condition, we enable you to edit the details you enter originally.-Further, for your reference, we introduced this change also due to legal requirements in India.-Resolution-Henceforth, this is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Post, Goods, Receipt, Identified, Stock, Add, Sub-Item

Title: Extension field value has disappeared
Content: Symptom-For example Extension field value on Purchase request is getting disappeared when Supplier is chosen in Assign source of supply screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Other extension scenario is enabled. so value is being overwritten by one of the other extension scenarios.-Resolution-In the further usage of extension field in Purchase request, the below changes are required:-Since you want details entered in Purchase request to flow to other documents,so you have to check mark  relevant extension scenario given below only-Purchase request- Item    to     XXX - Root-All other scenarios scenarios appearing like ' XXX- Root      to      Purchase order-Root" has to be deactivated, cause system tried to pick from one of them and it finds no details.(where XXX can be other documents )-Note: Once all above changes are done, please create new Purchase order and Supplier invoices  so that changes can be reflected.-See Also-  KBA 2909846 - Extension field value not flown from one document to another

Title: Process type of Purchase order not found in  SDK
Content: Symptom-You want to develop a customer requirement, which requires to find the 'Process Type' within the purchase order to determine a certain result.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Process type in Purchase Order is a derived field. This is mainly derived from Direct Material Indicator and Third Party Process Indicator. Since PSM is not released you cannot find the field in SDK.-Resolution-We cannot Release PSM due to Technical reasons , however-Direct Material Indicator and Third Party Process Indicator can be used as they are already PSM released to derive the value of process type in SDK.-Various Process types in ByDesign are derived as given below:-To stock - Direct Material Indicator is set to true and Third Party Indicator is set to False-Third Party - Direct Material Indicator is set to false and Third Party Indicator is set to true-Non Stock - Direct Material Indicator is set to false and Third Party Indicator is set to False-Keywords-Process type not found

Title: Canceled purchase orders are not appearing in the Report: monitoring Purchase order,  view: Purchase  order tracking
Content: Symptom-You wanted to track the canceled Purchase orders in reports-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business analytics work center -Go to Design reports -Search and open report: monitoring Purchase order -On the top you can see view option -Choose Purchase order tracking -Go to Selection -Search for Purchase order status field -Choose Canceled -Click on apply -No results are appearing-Cause-The report Monitoring Purchase Orders is specifically designed to Monitor the Purchase Orders which are created with  follow up documents. Hence we exclude the canceled documents since they no longer are updated further.-Resolution-Its working with below:-Data Source: Purchase Order Header Data-Data Source: Purchase Order Item Details with Follow on Documents-Please create joined data source using above data source and Monitoring purchase order to  create new report.-Keywords-Cancelled Purchase order

Title: How to change time zone for 3PL Provider and for all 3PL transactions
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to change time zone for 3PL Provider and all 3PL transactions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third-Party Logistics Work Center-Go to Inbound Deliveries-Select and Choose any Inbound Delivery-You observe UTC time zone, you would like to change the time zone for a 3PL Inbound Delivery-Cause-At SAP  backend, Data always stored and communicated on date/time related information in ISO 8601 format UTC date/time along with the time zone. The date which gets displayed in the User Interface is also stored in the same way and is read from the exact same place as is sent out in the XML. Our User Interface Runtime reads the UTC date/time and Timezone information and renders the timezone date/time as displayed in the User Interface(UI).-Resolution-As 3PL provider is receiving both in UTC Time Stamp and Time Zone information, it should be normal to infer the actual date/time in time zone as displayed in the UI. This is in sync with standards followed globally.  The time stamp that 3PL provider is receiving is UTC time stamp and based on the timezone information they are receiving, 3PL provider need to convert the timestamp to that particular timezone. Timestamp is always meant to be in UTC in Business ByDesign, This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-to change time zone for 3PL Provider and for all 3PL transactions, UTC Time Stamp and Time Zone information in 3PL

Title: Material ABC Specification PQR In Planning Area 1234 Planned With Failures; Save And Check Results of Interactive Planning Log
Content: Symptom- Material ABC specification PQR in planning area 1234  planned with failures; save and check results of interactive planning log.-The above error is displayed when executing MRP for your product. Here ABC, PQR and 1234 represent the product, product specification and planning area respectively.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center. -Navigate to the Products view. -Search and select the relevant product, planning area and product specification combination.-Click the Open button. -In the planning screen, select the Run Planning button and choose either Single BoM Level or Multi BoM Level based on your business requirement.-The above reported error message is displayed.-Cause-The product you have selected has Procurement Type: In-house Production maintained in its Planning master data.-As a result of this setting, the system will look for a Released Planning Production Model for the Product and Planning area combination. -If the system does not find a production model for the above combination the system will display the above error message. -Resolution-Please create a Production Model by following the below given steps.-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center. -Navigate to the Production Models view. -Choose the New button. -Enter the Product and Planning Area under the Production Model Header chevron. -Proceed with entering the rest of the information to make the new production model consistent and then release the document for planning and execution. -You will be able to create supply once the above production model is released successfully for planning and execution.-Keywords-MRP error, Business ByDesign, ByD Planning error, product specification planning error, ByD product specification planning error, PRS error, planning error

Title: Form template variant Fixed Assets Purchase Order for language XXX, and country ABC cannot be found
Content: Symptom-You noticed that Output form is not sent successfully- or- Status Error in Output history tab of Purchase order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders work center -Go to Purchase orders view -Search and Edit respective Purchase order-Go to Output history tab -You will see that status is showing as Error-Click on Error , new screen opens-You will see message in Description section"Form template variant Fixed Assets Purchase Order for language XXX, and country ABC cannot be found"-where XXX is langauge and ABC is country.-Cause-Form template variant for language XXX and country ABC not maintained.-The language variant of the form template is determined by the system as follows:-Language maintained under Main communication section in General tab of Supplier master data.-If no language is maintained the system will use the logon language of the user creation the document.-The country variant of the form template is determined by the system as follows:-Tax country appearing in the Taxes tab-Delivery address under delivery tab( or Ship To Address)-Company address-Resolution-Create new form template variant :-Go to the Application and User Management workcenter. -Go the Business Flexibility view. -Open the Form Template Maintenance subview. -Select the Form Template: Fixed Assets Purchase Order -Click on Copy -> New Variant. -Add country as ABC and language as XXX. -Save and Publish the form template.- For already effected documents:-o to Purchase requests and orders work center -Go to Purchase orders view -Search and Edit respective Purchase order-Go to Output history tab -You will see that status is showing as Error-Click on Error , new screen opens-Click on rety or-Click on edit output history-Enter correct email address and click on Retry-Keywords-wrong form template,Output error

Title: How to Insert Graphical Instructions to Make Task
Content: Symptom-You would like to add an image to Graphical Instruction in the Make Tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Select Task Control view.-Search for relevant Make Task.-Click Confirm.-Select Instructions tab.-Here you have the Graphical Instruction, however no image is available.-Cause-You need to add the image to Production Model.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Production Models view.-Search the relevant Production Model.-Open the Production Model.-Click View All.-Select Bill of Operations tab.-Select BoB Structure subtab.-Find the Activity in which you would like to add the image.-Select Activity Attachments tab.-Click Add Link or File.-Select the Document Type Graphical Instruction.-Add the image file or address.-Click Add.-Save it.-Check Consistency.-Click Release Production Model For Planning and Execution.-Then create another production scenario with this new version. The image will be available in Make Task.-Keywords-Production, Instruction, Task

Title: How to Restrict User from Getting Exception Task?
Content: Symptom-You have assigned restricted access to few companies for one user.-You want user to get a notification on supplier invoice exception only for a particular company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select a Business User-Assign Supplier Invoicing work center access for the user, restricted for few companies-Now , go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Create supplier invoice for those companies-The exception tasks are raised and user receives email notification for all the tasks but user wants to get notification for only one particular company.-Cause-The task is relevant to all employees to whom the Work view of the Supplier Invoicing work center is assigned and who have authorization for this company/invoice.-Resolution-You can use exception forwarding to determine whether exception messages need to be forwarded manually by the accountant responsible, or whether they are forwarded automatically to specific business partners and the accountant responsible. You cannot change the defined business partners; however, exception messages can always be forwarded manually to another person for clarification.-You can also unsubscribe from task subscription if you do not want to get emails for task notification.-See Also-Help Documents:-Subscribe to Tasks-Configuration: Supplier Invoice Exceptions-Task - Clarify Exceptions for Supplier Invoice-Quick Guide for Work (in Supplier Invoicing)-Keywords-Supplier Invoice Exception Task, Task Subscription

Title: Extension Filed Is Read Only
Content: Symptom- An extension field is displayed as read only, while you have not set the read-only flag for the field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Outbound Delivery View. -Search and select the relevant outbound delivery. -Choose the Edit button. -You see that the relevant extension field is non-editable. You have not set the field as read-only while creating it.-Cause-The field is flagged as a calculated field.-Since there is calculations involved, the value will be updated via the formula maintained and not be available for manually updating value.-Resolution-The extension field for which calculations are maintained will be read-only even if you have not set the flag Read Only for the field while creating it.-See Also- 2831885 - Calculated Field Is Read Only-Keywords-not able to edit extension field, extension field is read only, Business ByDesign, ByD, extension field update error, extension field non-editable, calculated field is read only

Title: Purchase Order Created From Project Purchase Request is Changing the Unit of Measure.
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order created from Project Purchase Request is changing the Unit of Measure (UoM).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search and open the respective Project.-Click on the Product tab.-Select the Project Overview sub-tab.-Click on Create Purchase Request > For Whole Project.-Fill out the necessary information and click on Save button.-Save the Project.-Open the new Purchase Request.-Click on the Create Purchase Order task.-In the new Purchase Order screen, see that the Unit of Measure has changed.-Cause-Even though the Material master data has the Base UoM properly defined in the General tab, when selecting the Purchasing tab, 'Purchasing UoM' field displays a different Unit of Measure and the system takes this one during the Purchase Order creation.-Resolution-In order to have the same Unit of Measure selected during Purchase Order creation, it is necessary to change the 'Purchasing UoM' in the Purchasing tab of the Material Master Data. Check the below steps for reference.-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Search and select the respective material.-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Purchasing tab.-Select the desired Purchasing UoM.-Click on Save button.- Now the Purchase Orders for this material will have the Unit of Measure selected on the Purchasing screen.-Keywords-Purchase Request, Project, UoM, Unit of Measure, Purchase Order

Title: Individual material description is empty
Content: Symptom-You want to post supplier invoice for fixed asset scenario however when you select individual material, no description appears.-or-How to update the description of individual material.- or-Where to see the list of all individual materials.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed assets work center-Go to Fixed assets view-Choose All fixed assets-Select desired Fixed asset-Click on Edit button-Choose Master data-Go to respective Individual material-You may see description appearing -Then-Go to Supplier invoicing -Choose the task New supplier invoice without purchase order -Go to Items tab -Go to Cost distribution tab-Select Account Assigned type as ACC-Click on value help-Select respective Individual material -You will see that description is not appearing-Cause-There is an explicit implementation for user convenience in the Fixed Assets screens that will default individual material description entered when logged in with English. When you login with any other language, If you have not maintained any description when logged in using any other log on language, you have to maintain it manually.-Resolution-Go to Supplier invoicing -Choose task New supplier invoice without purchase order -Go to Items tab -Go to Cost distribution tab-Select Account Assigned type as ACC-Click on value help-Select a Individual material -You will see that description is not coming-Now double click on that material-In this screen you will see no description but you can click on edit and then update the description.-  or-Navigate to Fixed Assets work center-Go to Reports view-Select Inventory List-In the report,ensure to maintain the company and set of books.-Click the "configure" button in the top right of the screen.-Select Add Fields.-Select Material Details.-Select Individual Material-Select Individual Material ID-This will bring up all the available Material IDs.-You can maintain them by clicking on the Individual Material ID you are looking for, then selecting "Go To" (the last option.)-In the resultant screen, Now double click on that material-In this screen you will see no description but you can click on edit and then update the description.-So to match the currently logged in language and the description ensure-For example-If Log on language is German then description is expected to be in German-or-If Log on language is English then description is expected to be in English-See Also- 2927002 - How to update Individual material description-Keywords-individual material description is not visible, individual material; Individual material description is empty

Title: You get a Dump/Unexpected Error when you Try to Finish Purchase Order Manually
Content: Symptom-The Purchase Order is consistent and few items are already finished.-Now, you want to finish the complete purchase order manually but as soon as you click save after manually finishing each item, you get an error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders work center-Select Purchase Orders view-Search for the Purchase Order which you want to finish manually-Select Finish-> Delivery and Invoicing-Select Save-Dump/Unexpected error encountered-Cause-There can be many reasons but if purchase order is consistent, check the output channel once in "You can also" option in the purchase order.-In this case, you can see that the output channel is set as XML. XML is used when you have communication arrangement set up. However, all other output in the purchase order has been triggered via printer/email. So, XML is not the correct output channel here.-Resolution-You can change the output channel under "You can also" option and then finish the purchase order.-Kindly check the output channel of the purchase order once if you face similar issues in future.-Keywords-Output channel, manual finish in purchase order, purchase order dump, unexpected error, internal server error

Title: System triggers error "The product is not valid for logistics area XXX ,The product must belong to the logistics area's allowed products group" while Creating Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-While performing Post Goods Receipt for Inbound Delivery Notification DEF with Target Logistics Area XXX, Error appears.*DEF refers to Inbound Delivery Notification id, XXX refers to Logistics Area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Inbound Delivery Notifications View-Search for Inbound Delivery Notification DEF-Select Propose Quantities and Maintain Target Logistics Area as XXX-Click Save and Close, Error appears------> The product is not valid for logistics area XXX. The product must belong to the logistics area's allowed products group-         Save Failed-       Logistics area XXX not valid-Cause-The Product involved in Inbound Delivery Notification DEF is not defined as Allowed Products in Logistics Area XXX Restrictions Tab.-Resolution-Maintain Product as Allowed Products in Logistics Area XXX Restrictions Tab,Follow the below steps-Navigate to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Go to Locations View-Select relevant Location and Select Edit Layout-Select Logistics Area XXX-Navigate to Restrictions tab and Navigate to sub-tab Allowed Products-Maintain Product and Select Save-Keywords-The product is not valid for logistics area XXX. The product must belong to the logistics area's allowed products group,  Logistics area XXX not valid

Title: Purchase order approval task not visible in Managing my area
Content: Symptom-Purchase order approval task not visible in Managing my area but it may be visible in Home work center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing my area work center-Go to Approvals View-Search for respective Purchase order-Cause-You don't have relevant Access rights-Resolution-Go to Application user management work center-Go to Business users-Select and click on Edit-Go to Work center view assignment tab-Check mark the View MMA_OPERATIONALPURHASING-Click on Save-Keywords-You have  Purchase order wok center view but cannot  receive approval task, task not appearing in the managing my area work center

Title: Error Message When Deleting Proposal From Product Planning
Content: Symptom-For Product XXX (XXX means Product ID), when trying to delete the old proposal YYY (YYY means Product ID), it is showing an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Search for Product XXX.-Select Open.-Select the Proposal YYY.-Click Delete.-Error is faced 'Document change not allowed as retention is over; please contact your DPO'-Cause-The date of Proposal YYY is older than the Retention Period set in Business Configuration.-Resolution-You can change the Retention Period in Business Configuration or create a Deletion Run to delete all the irrelevant retention period over documents.-To change the Retention Period:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for activity Business Document Deletion – Retention Periods for Business Documents.-Open the activity.-Select Group Description Early Lifecycle Data-Change the Retention Period to include the date of the Proposal YYY.-Click Save and Close.-To create the Deletion Run:-Go to Information Lifecycle Management work center.-Select Deletion Runs view.-Select New.-Fulfill all the relevant information.-Click Save.-Click Set to Active.-Schedule the created run.-Keywords-DPO, Deletion, Retention

Title: Inventory Change Reason Field In The Confirmation Journal Report Displays Value As Not Assigned
Content: Symptom-The field Inventory Change Reason in the Confirmation Journal report displays value as Not Assigned. You want to understand why there is no value captured for all the confirmation document displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Reports view. -Search and select the report Confirmation Journal. -Once you enter the relevant details and execute the report, you see that there are entries against which the value in the field Inventory Change Reason is displayed as Not Assigned. -Cause-There are multiple confirmations created in the system when a logistics process is executed. The major type of confirmations created in the system are -Warehouse Confirmation.-Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Production Execution Confirmation.-The field Inventory Change Reason is supported only for Goods and Activity Confirmation (GAC) documents. All the other documents will have the value Not Assigned displayed in the field Inventory Change Reason. -Resolution- The system will continue to display values in the field Inventory Change Reason for goods and activity confirmation documents and for all the other confirmations value will be displayed as Not Assigned.-Keywords-inventory change reason, confirmation journal report, Business ByDesign, ByD, inventory change reason error ByD

Title: How to Change the Bill-To Address in Project Invoice Request?
Content: Symptom-You have maintained multiple addresses in the customer master data and created a new sales order and linked to the project.-You created a project invoice request and released it. Now you want to change the bill-to address but the field is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select subview "Sales Orders" under Project Invoicing view-Create new project invoice request and release it-Now go to Customer Invoicing-> Project Invoicing view->Project Invoice Requests-Search for the released project invoice request-Bill-to address is defaulted and now you are not able to change it.-Cause-You can change the address only when the project invoice request is "In Preparation" status.-Resolution-System will default the address which is marked as "main" address in master data.-But if you want to change the address, you can do so in "Involved Parties" tab in the project invoice request screen when the status of the project invoice request is "in preparation".-See Also-2276585 - While Creating A Customer Invoice Or Project Invoice Request You Want To Update The Bill To Address-Keywords-Bill-to address change, project invoice request, multiple address, involved parties

Title: Product Specification Grayed Out for Identified Stock
Content: Symptom-You want to edit the Product Specification for an Identified Stock ABC (ABC represents the Identified Stock ID), however the Product Specification field is grayed out.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Identified Stock view.-In the dropdown, select All Identified Stock.-Search for Identified Stock ABC.-Click Edit.-You notice that the Product Specification field is grayed out.-Cause-Once the Identified Stock is with status Active, it is no longer possible to edit the Product Specification.-Resolution-Customer needs to create a new Identified Stock with the relevant Product Specification to proceed with the scenario.-Keywords-Identified Stock, Product Specification, Active

Title: Product Availability Confirmed On Wrong Date
Content: Symptom-The system confirms availability of a product in sales order on a day earlier to the receipt of a product.-For e.g. You have a receipt on 4th June 09:00 Hrs, but the system confirms availability in the sales order for 3rd June to the customer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Navigate to the Customer Demand view. -Search and select customer demand for relevant sales order. -Under the sub-tab Schedule Lines you can see that the Delivery Date is 3rd June 2020.-If you check the product planning screen for the product in relevant sales order you can see that the purchase order is expected to be delivered only by 4th June 2020. -Why is the system calculating the delivery date as 3rd June 2020 instead of 4th June 2020?-PS: The dates 3rd June 2020 and 4th June 2020 are sample dates. The dates you see in your demand and supply documents will vary.-Cause-You have scoped the question in business configuration Do you want to receive availability confirmations for products at the start of the 24 hour cycle?.-The availability confirmation works on a 24 hour cycle which is from 12:00 Hrs to 12:00 Hrs. As an example one cycle or time bucket would be from 3rd June 12:00 Hrs to 4th June 12:00 Hrs. -If a product has its supply available on 4th June 09:00 Hrs, and you have scoped that the confirmation should be available on the start of the cycle, the system will give you ATP confirmation on 3rd June for the product in relevant demand/sales order. -If you have not scoped the question, Do you want to receive availability confirmations for products at the start of the 24 hour cycle?, for the above scenario the ATP will be confirmed for 4th June in the relevant demand/sales order.-Resolution-The decision to scope the question, Do you want to receive availability confirmations for products at the start of the 24 hour cycle? is a  business decision.-The business has to decide if the availability of the product should be confirmed on the start of the time bucket or at the end of the time bucket. -Based on the business decision, you can choose to either scope the question or not, and the system will behave as explained above based on the scoping choice the business makes.-Keywords-wrong inventory allocation, ATP wrong confirmation, ATP confirms sales orders on wrong date, ByD ATP Error, ByDesign ATP Error, Availability confirmation error in ByDesign

Title: Project Identifier And Project Name Fields Cannot Be Added to The Contracts Screen
Content: Symptom-'Project Identifier' and 'Project Name' cannot be added to the Contracts screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Select 'All Contracts' filter.-Click on the Avatar button.-Click on 'Start Personalization Mode' option.-Click on the Arrow for Contracts UI Element.-See that the fields 'Project Identifier' and 'Project Name' are greyed out.-Cause-When the 'All Contracts' filter is selected, it is necessary to execute the query to display the available contracts.-Resolution-Once the query is executed, the system allows to select the fields 'Project Identifier' and 'Project Name' from Personalization mode.-Keywords- Contracts, Project Identifier, Project Name

Title: How to Create Down Payment Request with Purchase Order  Reference via Standard Web-Service?
Content: Symptom-You are using standard supplier invoice web service to create down payment request with reference to purchase order(PO- refers to purchase order), however the reference is not updated in the down payment request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Download the WSDL for ManageSupplierInvoiceIn-Login to SOAP UI-Execute the web service request using the XML template for operation "create supplier invoice with reference" making necessary changes in the request to create supplier down payment with purchase order reference-Down Payment Request gets created but purchase order reference is missing.-Cause-Creating down payment request with respect to PO via standard web service is not supported in the current ByDesign system.-This is because Purchase Order reference in Down payment is just an information and no data is picked from it since it is not a predecessor.-Resolution--As a workaround, extension field can be created for purchase order ID, Item ID.-Note: This can be extended to web services as well from Further Usage option in Adaptation mode and the data for the same can be added in the XML request and pushed to Bydesign system. If you extend it to the web service, it will be in the WSDL directly, you can write down the PO ID and item ID there. But it will be only a text field.-If you want to make it as a link to the original PO, you can try it via PDI solution.-Keywords-Down payment request with PO reference via web service.

Title: Send Update Option is Disabled in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order and sent to supplier. Later you make changes to the purchase order, but you are not able to select "send update" option as the button is disabled in the purchase order. Hence, the purchase order re-approval is also not triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Search for a Purchase Order which is already in "Sent" status or "Follow-Up Document Created" status-Select View All-Make some changes in the order item and select "Send Update"-The "Send Update" button is disabled.-Cause-The purchase order items are assigned to project task and the relevant project tasks are in "stopped" status.-Hence, the "Send Update" button is disabled in the purchase order.-Resolution-You have to reopen the project task . You can do so under Project-> Project plan->Gantt Chart->select the task-> Project Status, select "Revoke Stopping" and save the changes . Then, the "send update" button will be enabled in the purchase order.-Keywords-Send Update disabled in purchase order, purchase order approval, project task stopped, Revoke Stopping.

Title: Why You Have to Maintain Value Limit for Certain Approval Rules?
Content: Symptom-You have set up an approval rule based on value limit but the approval is not triggered as expected. But once you maintained the value limit, the rule works correctly.-You want to know why you have to maintain value limit separately when you have already set up approval rule based on value limit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view Task Distribution-> Approval Processes-Create a new Approval Rule based on value limit for a purchasing document (e.g. supplier invoice, purchase order or shopping cart)-You create a purchasing document but the approval is not triggered as expected.-Now go to Task Distribution->Employee Work Distribution-Select Purchasing Approval Value Limit-Maintain the approval limit here for the respective managers-Create a new purchase document and the approval is triggered to the correct manager now.-Cause-Value Limit based approval rule is one of the approval rules which means based on the value limit specified for each approver, the approver will get the task.-For these rules to work, the value limit has to be maintained in the system.-This can be maintained in Employee Work Distribution or you can scope "Advanced Approval Limit" question and maintain the value limit in "Define advanced Approval Limit" view(this is valid for only cost center based approval rules)-Based on the value limit maintained, the system will trigger the approval for the respective manager who has the limit value to approve.-You can also maintain conditions in the approval process which determine the documents that are relevant for approval, otherwise all documents will go for approval.-Resolution-If you maintain value limit related approval rule in approval process, then you have to maintain the value limit correctly in Employee Work Distribution view or in Advanced Approval Limit based on your business scenario.-See Also-Reference Help Documents:-Approval Rules for Purchasing-Setting Up Approvals-Approval Processes-Defining Advanced Approval Limits-Purchase Order Approvals-Configuration: Purchase Order Approvals-Shopping Cart Approvals – Configuration Guide-Keywords-Approval Processes based On Value Limit, Value Limit, Employee Work Distribution, Advanced Approval Limit.

Title: Unable to create invoice  based on Purchase order or delivery
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find the Purchase order or inbound delivery while trying to create supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Show All orders to be invoiced.-Search for relevant purchase order.- or-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Show All deliveries to be invoiced.-Search for relevant  Goods and service receipt or inbound delivery.-Cause-You have not marked Invoice Expected check box in Purchase order. Hence the delivery document or purchase order does not appear for invoicing.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search and open the respective purchase orders-Go to Items tab-Go to Basic sub tab-Check mark the Invoice Expected-Keywords-Purchase order or delivery not available for invoicing

Title: Task ID is Displayed as # for Confirmation  in Confirmation Journal Report.
Content: Symptom-In Confirmation Journal(SCMCFJU01_Q0001) Report Task ID is displayed as # for Confirmation ID 999.- (here as reference "999" is the Confirmation ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics workcenter and Reports view.-2. Search and Find Report Confirmation Journal (SCMCFJU01_Q0001).-3. Filter the data by Confirmation ID 999.-You will notice that in the Task ID field # is displayed.-Cause-Confirmation ID 999 is not a Production Confirmation hence the data is not displayed in the report.-Resolution-The Task ID in Confirmation Journal report works only for Production Confirmations and not for Site Logistics, Physical Inventory and Internal Logistics.-Keywords-Confirmation Journal Report, SCMCFJU01_Q0001, Production confirmation, Business Analytics, Site Logistics, Physical Inventory.

Title: Contract Missing As Source Of Supply For Third Party Order Processing
Content: Symptom-You have created a contract with a supplier for third party order processing however when you create a sales order, the required Contract is missing from available sources of supply list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View and choose New Sales Order subview.-Enter all required details and go to items tab.-Choose Add Row and enter Product ID.-Under the Details section, go to sub-section Ship-from and select Fulfilment Type as External.-Now select Line item and choose Assign Source of Supply.-Here you find that the required Sourcing Contract for the Supplier is missing.-Cause-Item of the contract is of type Product Category without any Product ID therefore the system doesn't display contract.-In auto source determine, the system looks for contract for the contract with particular product and not based on the product category. Hence, not just in the TPOP scenario, even when you create a purchase order directly, the system does not auto-propose the contract based on the product category.-Resolution-Go to Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View and choose New Sales Order subview.-Enter all required details and go to the items tab.-Choose Add Row and enter a Product ID.-Under the Details section, go to field Ship-from and select Fulfilment Type as External.-Here enter required Supplier manually from value selection and check availability.-You get a warning message: The source of supply cannot be determined; Check the sourcing-relevant master data.-In this case, remove the Complete Indicator checkbox under the General tab.-Now ATP turns Green and performs save.-Note:-  Users can choose such applicable contracts (based on product category) manually in the document.-Keywords-Product category, Contract, Assign Source of Supply, Third party order processing, Fulfilment type, External, The source of supply cannot be determined; Check the sourcing-relevant master data

Title: Reference ID Missing For Put Away Task Against Stock Transfer Order
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find any Reference ID for Put Away task against Stock Transfer Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Task Control view.-Show All Tasks by Selection and find required Put Away Task ID.-Select it and under the Details section navigate to Execution Details.-Here under Column Reference, there is no order ID displayed.-Cause-Currently, the Reference field in the standard Put-Away task shows the ID of the purchase order.-Resolution-As in the stock transfer order, there is no purchase order is involved hence there is no reference ID available.This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Reference ID,   Put Away Task Against Stock Transfer Order,  Put Away Task, Inbound Logistics

Title: Incorrect Sales Order Delivery Status in Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-The Sales Order DEF (DEF represents the Sales Order ID) Delivery Status differs in Customer Demand ABC (ABC represents the Customer Demand ID).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for Sales Order DEF.-Open it.-Go to the Items tab.-In the Item for Product XXX (XXX represents the Product ID), the Delivery Status is In Process.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the Customer Demand ABC.-In the Item for Product XXX, the Delivery Status is Not Started.-Cause-The Delivery Status in the Customer Demand UI changes only when the actual delivery starts. Although both status are "Delivery Status", they are different status.-Resolution-System behavior is correct.-The Sales Order status changes to "In Process" when the Customer Demand is released. It is possible for a Customer Demand to be released even if it still has Delivery Status "Not Started", because the user context is different. -One is for the sales user and the other is for the delivery user. For the sales user the delivery has already started because the delivery user acknowledged the delivery (released the Customer Demand). However, for the delivery user, it has not started yet, because the warehouse steps still have to be executed.-Both status are correct and are there for their respective users.-See Also-KBA 2882542 - How Status Changes in Sales Order with Material and Respective Back End Message Flow-Keywords-Sales Order, Customer Demand, Delivery Status, Delivery, Not Finished

Title: Incorrect Currency While Creating Purchase Order via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are creating a purchase order via web service Managepurchaseorderin, but you find the purchase order is created in a different currency from which you mainatined in the web service request.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Service Explorer view-Search service ManagePurchaseOrderIn, Download WDSL -Log in Soap UI-Open the ManagePurchaseOrderIn WDSL file, ManagePurchaseOrderInMaintainBundle -Maintain the request content, giving supplier ABC (ABC refers to the supplier ID), currency DEF (DEF refers to a kind of currency)-Run the request, purchase order is created-Go back to ByD system, Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view, find the purchase order-You see the purchase order is created in a different currency, GHI.-GHI is the default purchasing currency maintained in the master data of supplier ABC. However you don't understand why system picks the supplier default purchasing currency instead of the currency you maintained in the web service request.-Cause-You forgot to maintain action code for element <PurchaseOrderMaintainBundle> in the web service request.-If you don’t maintain any action code, the default action code will be 04 (Save). With action code 04, the purchase order could be created in the system, but the currency information will not be reflected and system will automatically determine it. Hence the purchase order is created in the supplier default purchasing currency.-Resolution-Please use action code 01 (Create) :-<PurchaseOrderMaintainBundle actionCode="01">-Then the currency information maintained in the request will be reflected in the created purchase order.-See Also-Help Document: Inbound Service ManagePurchaseOrderIn-Keywords-Purchase Order Web Service, Wrong Currency, ManagePurchaseOrderIn, Purchasing Currency, 采购订单, 货币

Title: The Supplier Invoice Currency is Displayed Incorrectly in "Monitoring Invoices" Report
Content: Symptom-You have created a Supplier Invoice in currency XXX (XXX refers to the currency unit used in the invoice) but the currency is showing in YYY (YYY refers to currency unit used in report) in the report "Monitoring Invoices" for few key figures.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select Design Reports-Search for Report: Monitoring Invoices and open it-Select View tab-Under Column fields, select add button-Expand Key figure options-Add these fields: Net Amount in Company Currency/ Gross Amount in Company Currency/Tax Amount in Company Currency-Run the report-The currency shows YYY in the above key figure fields instead of the default currency XXX set in the company master data or in the supplier invoice.-Cause-The currency in the fields Net Amount in Company Currency/ Gross Amount in Company Currency/Tax Amount in Company Currency are picked up from the actual currency of the registered country of the company.-It is not based on the currency maintained by user in the company master data or the currency in which the invoice is created.-Resolution-The other key figures Net Amount/Gross Amount/Tax Amount show the currency of the invoice document as it takes the value from invoice but for the company currency dependent fields, the currency is picked from registered country's actual currency unit.-Keywords-Monitoring Invoices Report shows incorrect company currency; Net Amount in Company Currency; Gross Amount in Company Currency; Tax Amount in Company Currency

Title: Approval conditions not working
Content: Symptom-System is not considering the approval conditions and thus approvals is not working as expected-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In Approval conditions you have entered employee name as for example :Jack O'Donoghue against field for example :Created By-Cause-Usage of single quote/Apostrophe is currently a limitation for text values when specifying the values for any approval conditions.-Resolution-In this case enter values without quote/Apostrophe,for example Jack* or  *Donnoghue* or  jack or Donnoghue accordingly-See Also- 2705866 - Approval Condition: "Created By" in Purchase Order Approval Process-Keywords-Apostrophe,single quote,single quotation, created by not working

Title: Purchase Order not available in the service agent time sheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2525032*** -Purchase Order not found for Project Time Recording.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Services Overview view.-Click on Edit Time Sheet option.-Select the respective Week.-Select the respective Project Task.-Enter the Times worked on Project.-System displays a warning message that Purchase Order could not be determined.-Click on the Value Help of the Purchase Order field.-No Purchase Order found.-Cause-The Purchase Order is not being defaulted in the 'Edit Time Sheet' because its status is Finished. Once a Purchase Order is finished, no more activity on the Purchase Order is allowed.-Resolution-As the Purchase Order Delivery was manually finished, you can open it up again by using the Resume button, as per following steps:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders View.-Search and open the respective Purchase Order.-Click on View All.-Go to Items tab.-Click on Resume > Delivery.-Once status on the Purchase Order is changed, then the Purchase Order should be defaulted for the combination used on the time recording.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Time Recording, Project Time Recording;time recording for service agent, project purchase order,Purchase order not appearing in the time sheet,purchase order not found,Purchase order not appearing automatically-

Title: Different Actual Delivery Date When Confirming Put Awat Task
Content: Symptom-When confirming the Put Away Task XXX (XXX represents the Task ID), you expect the Actual Delivery Date to be the same as the one entered in the Inbound Delivery Notification. However it is not the same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Task Control view.-Search for Put Away Task XXX.-Click Confirm.-Select Administrative Information tab.-Notice that the Actual Delivery Date is different from the one set in Inbound Delivery Notification.-Cause-The Actual Delivery Date is not the same as you entered in Inbound Delivery Notification because Actual Execution Date is later than the Planned End Date.-If the Actual Execution Date is earlier than the Planned End Date, then system will populate the Actual Delivery Date as Actual Execution Date. The understanding here is that, even though the shipment is expected to come later, user might have received it earlier and hence he is recording it in system.-If the Actual Execution Date is later than the Planned End Date, then system will populate Actual Delivery Date as Planned End Date. The understanding here is that, maybe the shipment has come on time, but the user has not recorded in system earlier.-Resolution-The system is working as expected in this case, since the Actual Execution Date is later than the Planned End Date.-Keywords-Date, Putaway, put away, IDN, Inbound, Delivery, Notification
