Title: Report With Label and Stock Information
Content: Symptom- You want to create a report which has the product and the labels crated against the product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center. -Navigate to the Design Reports view. -You are not able to find a report with label and product stock information.-Cause-There are no reports or data sources which has both product stock and label information.-Resolution-You will have to create a custom data source and create a custom report on top of the custom data source to achieve your requirement.-Keywords-ByD Labels Report, Labels and Stock in report, label information stock information stock report, Business ByDesign Stock Report.

Title: Interactive forms not available
Content: Symptom-You could not find interactive forms or when you want to scope,the respective question is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center-Click on Implementation projects view-Select the respective Project-Click on Edit project scope-Go to Questions-Expand Sourcing-Expand Sourcing and contracting-Select Communication for sourcing and contracting-the question""Do you want to use interactive forms in the RFQ process?"-and question "you receive supplier quote using interactive forms"-both are grayed out and you select them and then click on Dependency tab-You will see that technical user has deselected it- or- Go to Application user management  work center- Go to Form template maintenance View- Search for interactive forms- You will not see any interactive forms-Cause- You didn't scope the "interactive Forms" itself.-Resolution-Go to Business configuration work center-Click on Implementation projects view-Select the respective Project-Click on Edit project scope-Go to Scoping-Expand Communication and Information Exchange -Expand Office and Desktop Integration-Check mark Interactive Forms-Keywords-Do you want to use interactive forms in the RFQ process,you receive supplier quote using interactive forms

Title: Default delivery date in Purchase order or manual Purchase request
Content: Symptom-While creating a new Purchase Order Manually or while creating a new manual Purchase Request , a delivery date is automatically proposed by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Common Tasks and select New Purchase Order-Enter the mandatory details-Go to Items section -Go to Delivery schedule tab-Delivery date is automatically proposed by the system -or, This is applicable while create a new Purchase order with reference a Purchase request and applicable for Manual Pruchase Request creation as well.-Cause-By considering the generic requirement from multiple customers, the system is designed to propose the delivery date as creation date +7 days. System will calculate the delivery date by default and propose this date suring the creation of the Purchase Order.-Resolution-The delivery date can always be changed manually or via Acknowledgment received.-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Automatic delivery date, wrong delivery date, delivery date exists, delivery date not empty, delivery date automatically proposed by the system while purchase order creation

Title: Error appears "Undo release of delivery XXX is not allowed due to India Stock Transfer" when you click on Undo Release of Stock Transfer Outbound Delivery.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Undo Release India Stock Transfer Outbound Delivery XXX, Error appears.*xxx refers to Outbound Delivery Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Outbound Deliveries View-Search for XXX-Click Undo Release-Error appears-Undo release of delivery XXX is not allowed due to India Stock Transfer-Inbound Delivery Notification is already in process-Cause-From 2005 Upgrade onwards you cannot Undo release India Stock Transfer Outbound Delivery when corresponding Inbound Delivery is in Released Status, As  Undo Release of Inbound Delivery is not allowed, Hence you cannot Undo release Outbound Delivery as well.-Note: From 2005 Upgrade onwards, Undo release will not be allowed in Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery-Resolution-You can perform the Undo Release action on an outbound delivery, only if the associated inbound delivery is not released.In case where Outbound Delivery is created and Inbound Delivery is in "Not Started" status.-See Also-2925614 - Error appears Undo release of Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery xxx not allowed when you click on Undo Release of Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery.-Keywords-Undo release of delivery XXX is not allowed due to India Stock Transfer, Unable to undo release STO Outbound Delivery, STO Outbound Undo release not allowed

Title: Shopping Cart Not Generating the Purchase Request. System Displays a Process Communication Error.
Content: Symptom-Shopping Cart is not generating the Purchase Request. System displays a Process Communication Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to Self Services view.-Select the Self Services Overview option.-Under Shopping, click on Track My Shopping Carts.-Open the respective Shopping Cart.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab. -System did not generate the Purchase Request and it displays a Process Communication Error.-Cause-The respective Shopping Cart has been created with following definition:-Item 1 - Currency pqr-Item 2 - Currency XYZ-Item 3 - Currency DEF-The Shopping Cart currency is defined as XYZ, the Purchase Request will have the currency of ABC based on the first item of the Shopping Cart. So, when the third item is entered, system would need the Exchange Rate from PQR to DEF.-Since no Exchange Rate is defined in the system from PQR to DEF, the Purchase Request could not be created and generated the Process Communication Error.-Resolution-To resolve this error, it is necessary to maintain the Exchange Rate between PQR and DEF in the following path:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Common Tasks and then 'Edit Exchange Rates'.-Maintain the Exchange Rate between PQR and DEF.-Save.-Once the Exchange Rate is maintained, please raise an incident to SAP, so the support can restart the process communication in the backend.-See Also-Internal KBA 2918531 - Error: 'Exchange Rate for ABC and DEF for Rate Type GHI does not exist for MM.DD.YYYY' in the Process Communication between Shopping Cart and Purchase Request-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Exchange Rate, Purchase Request

Title: Error appears "Undo release of Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery xxx not allowed" when you click on Undo Release of Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Undo Release Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery xxx, Error appears.*xxx refers to Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Inbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Inbound Deliveries View-Search for KLM-Click Undo Release-Error appears "Undo release of Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery xxx not allowed"-Cause-From 2005 Upgrade onwards, Undo release will not be allowed in Stock Transfer Order scenario as the Business Configuration settings is checked and the sites are based in India.-Resolution-You have scoped the stock transfer solution for India in Business Configuration, To check the configuration follow the below path.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and choose Edit Project Scope.-In the Questions section, select the checkbox In Scope against the question Do you want to use the new India stock transfer solution? from the path Start of the navigation path Built-in Services and Support -->Next navigation step Business Environment -->Next navigation step Tax Calculation--> Next navigation step Product and Service Tax Calculation End of the navigation path.-Check the scoping.-See Also-Keywords-Undo release of Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery  not allowed, Stock Transfer Order Undo release not allowed,

Title: In Project invoice request the time confirmations of an employee on a particular date shows more than 24 hours
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know why the time confirmations shows more than 24 hours in a day.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-when time confirmations are to be written off , system combines the hours of many  such time confirmations of an employee togerther and thus  the total hours may go  more than 24 hours.-Resolution-Since the value will be zero for written off entries you can  proceed with such project invoice request .

Title: In Production Request Fulfillment Report # is Displayed for Every Production Lot
Content: Symptom-In the standard report Production Request Fulfillment when we add the Input Product, Product Lot fields in the Row fields,-we notice that for every production lot there is additional line included for input product and # is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics workcenter and Design Reports view-2. Open Production Request Fulfillment report.-3. Run the Report.-4. Add the field Production Lot and Input product and check the values.-You will see the last record as # in the input product against every Production lot.-Cause-The underlying Data Source SCMPRFU01 is an union Data source of two data sources SCMPRFB01 and SCMPRFB02.-But input product id is mapped only from data source SCMPRFB01. Due to this for some rows where the data from  the second data source SCMPRFB02 is present input product id value will be '#'  since no value is available for this field in second data source.-Resolution-Data Source SCMPRFU01 is an union Data source of two data sources SCMPRFB01 and SCMPRFB02.-For some rows where the data from the second data source SCMPRFB02 is present input product id value will be '#'-Keywords-Production Request Fulfillment, SCMPRFB01, SCMPRFB02, SCMPRFU01, datasource, Production Lot

Title: Purchase Order not Available While Creating new Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-Purchase order not available while creating new down payment request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Common Tasks-Select New Down Payment Request-Navigate to Items tab-Search for purchase order ID-No records found. -Cause-Down Payment Request is necessary to make down payments prior to the delivery of goods or the provision of services. These down payment requests refer to purchase orders. When an accountant creates the final invoice, the system can automatically determine whether one or more down payments have been made for a purchase order and reduces the due amount of the final invoice, if necessary.-For the affected purchase order, you have already posted and paid the supplier invoices. Since the supplier invoices were already paid for this order, it will not be visible in new down payment request screen. You have to create down payment requests before goods receipt & supplier invoice creation process.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior. You need to create down payment requests before you initiate the goods receipts & invoice processing.-Keywords-PO not available in DPR; Open PO dont connect to down payment request; New down payment request; PO not visible in DPR

Title: Down Payment Requests are not Available in Down Payment Field in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a down payment request for a supplier and it is posted and paid. Now, you are creating a new supplier invoice for the same supplier but you are unable to find the down payment request ID in the down payment field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select "New Supplier Invoice without purchase order" from common tasks view or create a supplier invoice with reference to a Purchase Order from Invoice Entry view-Select View All-Navigate to General Tab->Payment Information sub-tab-Select Down Payments tab-Select Add Row-> click value help option-It says: No Records Found-Cause-There are filters added in the value help screen because of which the respective down payment is not showing up. Or another reason could be that down payment request is already assigned to supplier invoice.-Resolution-Select Filter icon in the value help option and clear the extra filters. Now you can search with the supplier id filter to display the available down payment request id.-Keywords-Down payment request not visible, supplier invoicing; Down payment requests not populate in supplier invoice

Title: RFQ Interactive form not found
Content: Symptom-This material explains how to enable the Request for Quotation (RFQ) Interactive Form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Go to Form Template Maintenance view. -Search for RFQ interactive form.-No records found. -Cause-The RFQ Interactive Form is currently not scoped. Therefore it isn't available. -Resolution-The steps to scope the RFQ Interactive Form is explained below: -Go to Business configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project.-Click on Edit Project Scope button. -Go to Questions.-Expand Sourcing.-Expand Sourcing and Contracting.-Select Communication for Sourcing and Contracting.-Check mark the question "Do you want to use interactive forms in the RFQ process?".-Click on Next.-Click on Finish.-See Also-KBA: 2926904 - Interactive forms not available-Keywords-RFQ Interactive Form, Request for Quotation, Form Template Maintenance

Title: Automatically Cancel Third Party Logistics Request
Content: Symptom-You want to cancel 3PL request via web service-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center. -Navigate to 3PL Requests view.-Search and select the relevant 3PL request. -You need an option to Reject this request via web service.-Cause-There is no web service available as a standard to cancel 3PL request.-Resolution-The Reject 3PL Request button is PSM enabled. You can develop a custom solution with the help of your partner to reject 3PL request automatically.-Keywords-reject 3PL request automatically, ByD, ByDesign, cancel 3PL request automatically, PSM enable Reject button

Title: How to Cancel Production Order which is in Released Status
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have released a Production Order, but have not confirmed any of its associated Tasks meaning they still have the status "Not Started", and so you want to know how to delete or cancel the Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Navigate to Production Order view.-Select the relevant Production Order with the Status "Released".-Select Cancel.-Cause-From 2005 Release Upgrade onwards, the "Cancel" Button will be enabled for Production Orders which are in "Released" Status, and if all of the associated Tasks are in Status "Not started".-Note: The "Cancel" button is not enabled for Production Orders which are in Status "Started","In Preparation" and "Finished".-Resolution-Once you cancel a Production Order, the respective Tasks are finished, and the corresponding Production Lot is closed. The Production Request is open again for the creation of a new Production Order.-See Also-KBA 2924609 - How to Cancel Production Order which is in Released Status-Keywords-Cancellation of Production Order which are in "Released" status, Cancel Button is enabled for Production Order.-cancel production order "released",cancel production order,production order in released status,production order cancel

Title: Report Project Plan/Actual Work is not showing in "Working days"
Content: Symptom-You expect unit of work to show in Working days but this report always shows in Hours-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to  Project work center- Go to  Projects- Search and open the respective project- Go to  project over view tab - Go to the report:Project Plan/Actual Work- You will see it  shows  work in hours - Then if you go to project plan tab - Go to Work tab - You will see that Unit of work is working days-Cause-It is not possible to show the report either in hours or in working days depending on the quantity unit maintained in the respective project.-So it would be necessary to show with both quantity units  buy that will not be acceptable by other customers .also we have majority customers using hours therefore the standard report will not be changed.-Resolution-You can create your own report based on the public data sources PROPTKB and PROBTKB and use it from the Business analytics->report-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Project Working days, Project report,project unit of measure

Title: Unable to mass create orders for multiple production requests due to an error
Content: Symptom-You would like to to perform the action Create Order for multiple Production Requests in the work center Production Control. However, this is not possible because of a system dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work center Production Control.-Select the View Production Requests.-Show Production Requests - Order Creation Not Started.-Select all of the Production Requests.-Click the button Create Order --> Full Quantity-Result: The system crashes with the following error:  -500 SAP Internal Server Error-  Cause-The reason fot this error is because for some of the Input Products have been manually changed in the Production Proposal, i.e. do not correspond to the Input Products maintained in the respective BoM, which leads to REPM explosion exception at the time of order creation.-Resolution-The identified Production Request should be excluded from order creation. It should be cancelled and a new Production Proposal for it should be created without altering the BoM Input Products.-Keywords-production request, create order, dump,

Title: Error During Creation of Inbound Delivery Using Webservice Inbounddeliveryexecutionin.
Content: Symptom-Error during creation of Inbound Delivery using webservice Inbounddeliveryexecutionin--Identified stock BATCH1 not valid(where BATCH1 is the identified stock).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Third-Party Logistics workcenter and Inbound Deliveries view.-2. Find Delivery ID 123(where 123 is the Delivery ID) and View All.-3. Check Consistency -Above error occurs-Cause-Unlike in the UI it is not possible to create Identified stock on the go using webservice during Inbound Delivery Confirmation.-Resolution-There are web services to create and query Identified stock --1. ManageIdentifiedStocksIn-2. QueryIdentifiedStocksIn-These are separate stand alone web services that don’t have any integration with Confirmation of Inbound Delivery process.-You can use these web services to create/query the Identified stock and then use it in Inbound Delivery web service.-Keywords-Identified Stock, webservice, Confirmed Inbound Delivery , Third Party Logistics, Inbounddeliveryexecutionin.

Title: Third-Party Outbound Delivery did not release automatically in TPOP & Intercompany TPOP Scenarios
Content: Symptom-You observe when Third Party Delivery Notification KLM is released,Outbound Delivery DEF did not release automatically in Third Party Scenario.*KLM refers to Third-Party Delivery Notification  id,*DEF refers to Third-Party Outbound Delivery ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Go to Third-Party Outbound Deliveries.-Search for Outbound Delivery DEF.-Outbound Delivery DEF Release Status is "Not Released" although Third Party Delivery Notification KLM is released.-Cause-In Business Configuration, As the  Scoping Element, Questions for Outbound Delivery is not scoped "Do you want to release outbound delivery automatically in third-party order processing scenario?", Hence Third Party Outbound Delivery did not release automatically.-Resolution-In order to release Third Party Outbound Delivery automatically, Follow the below steps-Navigate to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select relevant Implementation Project.-Select Edit Project Scope.-In Step-4  Questions under Scoping Element Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics for Outbound Delivery .-Scope Question "Do you want to release outbound delivery automatically in third-party order processing scenario?".-Select Next and Finish.-Keywords-Third-Party Outbound Delivery, not release automatically ,TPOP , Intercompany TPOP Scenario, Third-Party

Title: Third-Party Inbound Delivery Notification Web Service Is Creating An Inconsistent Third Party Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-User is trying tp create a Third-Party Inbound Delivery Notification using the web service 'ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn' and have maintained the XML Request accordingly. However, when user execute the request, a response XML with the following error/warnings is returned:-  One party with role category End Buyer must be assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer view.-Find the web service 'ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn'.-Select the Service 'ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn'.-Maintain the relevant details in the Request XML and execute the web service.-Now go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment (TPOP) work center, and then to the Third-Party Delivery Notifications view.-Find the newly created Third-Party Delivery Notification.-You can see the Consistency Status is showing as Inconsistent.-If you click the Check Consistency button, it returns the same messages in the Response XML you get when you executed the Request XML:-  - End buyer is missing.--Cause-Account ID will be blank once the TPOP IDN is created through web service. However, it is still possible to create a consistent TPOP IDN in the UI but EndBuyer Party Tag at the Item level should be explicitly mentioned in the web service to create a consistent TPOP IDN-Resolution-EndBuyer Party Tag should be used at the item level. E.g. <EndBuyerPartyID>Token</EndBuyerPartyID>-Keywords-TPOP IDN, web service, ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn, End buyer, inconsistent status

Title: Wrong Delivery Date Calculated In Stock Transfer Order
Content: Symptom-While creating stock transfer order, the system calculates delivery date by adding five working days to the current date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Choose the Common Tasks view and select the option New Stock Transfer Order. -Enter the product and quantity information without entering the requested date. -Choose the tab Schedule Lines and you can see that the Delivery Date is updated as five working days from current date. -Cause-You have maintained the Shipping Duration for the transport lane used by the stock transfer order as Zero. There should be at-least one minute maintained as the Shipping Duration in the transport lane for the system to consider the shipment duration correctly.-Resolution-Please follow the below given steps to maintain the Shipping Duration in your transport lane.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Transport Lanes view. -Search and select the transport lane with Ship-From Site ID and Ship-To Site ID matching the stock transfer orders. -Choose the Edit button and in the field Shipping Duration enter the time which is not zero. As an example you can maintain five minutes as 00:05:00 in the field.-Keywords-STO delivery date wrong, five days added to shipping duration, delivery date is wrong for STO

Title: Additional Row with Empty Values is Created Automatically in Project Work Tab
Content: Symptom-You found that a duplicate row with empty fields got generated under work tab in the project screen which cannot be deleted.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select view: Projects-Search for Project: XXX (XXX refers to project)-Select Edit and navigate to Gantt Chart-Select respective task-Goto Sub-tab Work-You can find 2 rows for this task, one with the team member name and actual work details and a duplicate row where team member field is empty and disabled and other fields show 0. Delete option is also disabled.-Cause-The additional work package with empty employee has been created by the system when the purchase request has been created.-The purchase request has service agent Y (Y refers to a service agent), whereas the work package with employee has service agent Z (Z refers to a service agent)maintained.-So the existing task service did not fit to the purchase request, therefore the system created automatically one empty row; the automatically created work packages are always with empty employee.-Resolution-Please maintain the correct service agent in purchase requisition and in the project work package so that there is no discrepancy and system does not create an additional work package.-Keywords-Duplicate row in project work, team member empty, actual work

Title: Error Custom Code 1 Missing in Inventory Notification.
Content: Symptom-During Creation of Inventory Notification there is below error-- Custom Code 1 Missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Third-Party Logistics workcenter and New Inventory Alignment with Externally-Managed Location view-2. Maintain the necessary fields and Save-Above error occurs.-Cause-Custom Code is Set to Mandatory in Business Configuration -> All Configuration Elements->Account Assignment Types->Maintain Account Assignment Types->Cost Center->CUSTOM_CODE1.-Error occurs since the Custom code 1 is not maintained.-Resolution-After the Cost Center is maintained in the Inventory Notification, Account Assignment sub tab is enabled in Details Sections.-Maintain the value for Custom Code 1.-Keywords-Inventory Notification, custom code, Account assignment types, cost center, Third Party Logistics

Title: Wrong Production Model Assigned to Production Proposal
Content: Symptom-System assigns wrong Production Model when a production proposal is created. The system assigns source of supply for the proposal as production model ABC, but you expect the system to assign source of supply XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center. -Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option New Planning Proposal. -In the New Planning Proposal screen, enter the relevant information to create a proposal. -You can see that the system assigns source of supply as production model ABC, but you expect the system to assign source of supply XYZ.-Cause-The system calculates Production Start Date based on the duration maintained in the production models. -The production model ABC and XYZ has two different Valid From dates. -The Valid From date of XYZ, the model you expect the system to pick up is on a date after the production start date and hence the system identifies XYZ as a production model which is not valid for this particular production. For example the production starts on 10th May 2020, but the production model is valid from 11th May 2020. -Resolution-You can choose to-Change the Valid From date of the production model XYZ. -Adjust the Availability Date of the output product so that the production start date is calculated to a date on or after the Valid From date of the production model XYZ. -Continue using the production model ABC for the current production scenario.-Keywords-source of supply wrong, production process has wrong source of supply, ByD, ByDesign, system picks up wrong production model, expected production model is picked up by the system, production model wrong production proposal

Title: How to change the status of Planning run from Obsolete to Active
Content: Symptom-When you choose the option Set to Active for a planning run that is Obsolete you see that the status changes to In Revision and not to Active.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center. -Navigate to the Automated Actions view and choose the subview Planning Runs.-Select the relevant Planning Run with the status Obsolete. -Choose the Actions button and select the option Set to Active.-You see that the status changes to In Revision, while you were expecting the status to change to Active.-Cause-The Status always changes from Obsolete to In Revision for the business user to review the settings maintained for the run. Once the business user is satisfied with the settings (s)he has to change the status to Set to Active again.-Resolution-Go to Supply Planning work center. -Navigate to the Automated Actions view and choose the subview Planning Runs.-Select the relevant Planning Run with the status Obsolete. -Choose the Actions button and select the option Set to Active.-You see that the status changed to In Revision. -Review the run from your end, choose the Actions button and select the option Set to Active again. -You see that the status of the run has changed to Active. You can continue to schedule your planning run without any errors.-Keywords-Planning run is not active, not able to change the planning run status to Active, MDRO change status to Active, automated run status to active, ByD Automated run status error, ByDesign Automated run status change error.

Title: Task Not Confirmed With Web Service
Content: Symptom- While using the web service to confirm a logistics task the system displays the response XML message as Saved Successfully. However, when you check the task in the UI you can see that the quantities are not saved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the web service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn. -The response XML message displays the message <Saved Successfully>. -When you check the task that you confirmed via the above XML in the system you can see that the task is not confirmed.-Cause-You have not scoped Automatic Identification and needs to be checked for task confirmation via web service.-Resolution-Follow the below given steps to scope Automatic Identification in your system.-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Select the relevant Implementation Project and choose Edit Project Scope button. -Navigate to the third step Scoping. -Under the element Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics expand Task Management and Automation. -Select the option Automatic Identification by marking the checkbox against it. -Choose Next, review and confirm the Implementation Project. -Once the above step is done you will be able to confirm your logistics tasks via web service.-Keywords-web service task not confirmed, successful message for task confirmation via API, API task confirmation, web service for put away task, web service for pick task, put away task web service not confirmed, pick task web service not confirmed, ByD API task confirmation issue, ByD API task confirmation error.

Title: How to create a new approval condition field
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know how to create a new approval condition field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Administrator work center-Go to the Approval Processes view-Select the an active Approval Process and click on Copy button-Under Process Steps, click on Add Row button-Select the recently created row and, under Conditions facet, click on Add Group button-A new screen called Edit Condition will appear-Notice that in the Field dropdown , desired field is not there-Cause-All the standard available condition fields will be there as default, you cannot directly add a new condition.-Resolution-However you  can create an extension field and then that extension field will automatically appear in the approval condition fields list.-You can either enter value in that extension field manually or take help of partners to help auto populate a desired value in to that extension field .-Keywords-new condition,new condition field, could not find condition

Title: Project times automatically appear as quantity to be written off
Content: Symptom-Employee has recorded actual working time. It was not intended to create a deviating entry for quantity to be invoiced, but the billable hours are different from duration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center: Home-Go to Self-Service Overview-Edit Time Sheet-Maintain and edit the Billable Hours and then Duration-Billable Hours are different than expected-Cause-The issue is caused by the sequence of actions. The employee maintained the field Billable Hours first. The manual change of the Billable Hours is denoted.-  Now user changes the duration and not the billable hours:-  The change of the duration will not affect the billable hours as they were originally maintained by the user. Therefore the billable hours will not be changed until the user specifically changes their value.-Resolution-If duration was entered first, then the billable hours would automatically be defaulted to the duration hours and remain until a user changes them again.-Keywords-deviation, in Rechnung stellen, tatsächliche Stunden erfasst, Non billable hours

Title: The value of  a field is doubled  or tripled etc in a report
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know why the value is not appearing correctly and also want to know how to  get it right.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-I shall explain with an example data source SRMIX_U01 - Supplier Invoice and Supplier Invoice Exception Analysis, However in this data source you will see that total gross amount value doubled than the actual value appearing in the supplier invoice.- So firstly follow the details of the KBA: 2918187 - Custom report shows value of a field as # or empty or unexpected value- SRMIX_U01 is a combined Data Source, based on 3 different data sources.- Involved data sources:- > SRMIX_B01 - Exception From Supplier Invoice Root- > SRMIX_B02 - Exception from Supplier Invoice Item- > SRM_B03 - Supplier Invoice Header without Exceptions- Counter represents the number of sources involved. that is explained below- case 1:-If the Supplier invoice has  3 exceptions  out that one is related to header and two related to item (where item  number appears in the exception).-> SRMIX_B01 - Exception From Supplier Invoice Root ,if  the invoice has such exception then Counter = 1-> SRMIX_B02 - Exception from Supplier Invoice Item, if  the invoice has such exception then Counter = 1-> SRM_B03 - Supplier Invoice Header without exceptions (0)- Here counter is 2-case 2:-> SRMIX_B01 - Exception From Supplier Invoice Root (0)-> SRMIX_B02 - Exception from Supplier Invoice Item (0)-> SRM_B03 - Supplier Invoice Header without exceptions (Counter = 2)- Why is the Counter 2 on SRM_B03…- It appears to take the 'Total Gross Amount' value from each item, so ifthere are two items, so it is taking gross amount from both items, meaning the counter is 2. If there were 3 items, the counter would be 3 etc.-You can see the value for the counter in the data source preview.- You should create a calculated key figure, with the calculation  as Total Gross Amount  divided by Counter, and add  it to the Data source SRMIX_U01.-Go to Business Analytics- Create Key Figure- Data Source: SRMIX_U01- Type: Calculated- Add Parameters- Total Gross Amount (Under Basic Key Figures)- DIV (under mathematical tab)- Counter- Calculate Result as 'Total'- You can open yoru customized report and then add the key figures Total Gross Amount, Counter and the newly calculated key figure, to check that the new customized key figure is configured correctly.-See Also-2918187 - Custom report shows value of a field as # or empty or unexpected value-Keywords-duubled value, tripled value,  Value multiplies

Title: Wrong Number of Decimals Displayed in Delivery Documents
Content: Symptom-The number of decimal numbers displayed in the delivery documents are more than what is maintained in Quantities and Units of Measure activity list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search and select the relevant outbound delivery document Id-Choose Edit button and navigate to the Items tab.-You can see that the Delivery Quantity displays more decimal numbers than what was maintained in the Quantities and Units of Measure activity list.-Cause-In delivery documents the display of decimal numbers setting is not considered. The actual conversion value will be displayed directly from the back end. This is why you see more number of decimals displayed in the delivery documents than what is maintained in the display setting of number of decimal places.-Resolution-The delivery documents will always display the values directly from the database without considering the display settings in Quantities and Units of Measure activity list.-Keywords-decimal number display wrong, wrong number of decimal displayed in delivery documents, incorrect number of decimal display, decimal is displayed incorrectly, The delivery documents will always display the values directly from the database without considering the display settings in Quantities and Units of Measure activity list.

Title: Custom report shows value of a field as # or empty or unexpected value
Content: Symptom-When you built a report you may see that few values are appearing as # or empty you wanted to know which data source is causing this issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Custom report is based on standard data  source but standard data source does not  display the results ,the reason for the same is explained below-Resolution-Let me explain with example field "purchase request ID" that has value # or  empty in your report against few Purchase orders  where-The report xxx is a customized report  that is based on customized data source YY-The report xxx is a customized report . that is based on customized data source YY-Go to Business analytics work center-> data sources view and select data source yy and click on edit.-Go to Joined data sources tab and then go to "Add from" option and choose each data source one at a time to find the field "Purchase request ID"-You will see that "Purchase request Id "is coming from data source ZZ-repeat the step 2 and 3-You will see that "Purchase request Id "is coming from data source SRMPO_U01-Go to Business analytics work center-> data sources view and select data source SRMPO_U01, but edit option is grayed out-This data source SRMPO_U01 is standard data source and a combined data source.-Go to Business analytics work center-> data sources view and select data source SRMPO_U01and then scroll to right and click on documentation link.-You will see that data source type is "Combined" and thus if you scroll down you will find the list of all data sources combined under "Involved data sources".-then scroll down to Element mapping, were you will see that there are various columns for each data sources Involved.-Find the field you are using that is "purchase request ID" , then check under which column the field is appearing.-Here the fields"Purchase request ID" appears under column"Purchase Order Items without Follow-Up Documents- SRMPO_B08"-That means that the value of this field Purchase request ID comes from that data source:SRMPO_B08.-Go to Business analytics work center-> data sources view and select data source SRMPO_B08-You cannot find the Data source SRMPO_B08 in data sources, so you cannot check where it gives you the results of the filed Purchase request ID or not .-Thus you just have to understand based on the description of the data source that is""Purchase Order Items without Follow-Up Documents"-which means data source"Purchase Order Items without Follow-Up Documents" only shows the Purchase orders without any follow up documents.-So purchas eorders with status - finished( it has follow up documents) and PO status - follow up document created has no purchase request ID visible in your report-You have to use different data source like SRMPO_B12 instead of SRMPO_U01.-Go to Business analytics work center-> data sources view and select data source SRMPO_B12 and click on preview to ensure  it gives you result of the field as expected- so while joining data sources  ensure that each data source will give you desired results in the preview for the fields  as required.-See Also-You can check the fields and their data sources in this  below link-https://help.sap.com/doc/0cb1a8377ed34291887409d02e183785/1908/en-US/E-MDAV-DOKU.pdf-Keywords-Joined data sources, customized data sources

Title: How is invoice quantity determined  while creating new invoice
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know how invoice quantity is determined while creating new invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to  Invoice entry view-Choose all orders to be invoiced-Search and select the Purchase order-Click on new invoice-In the invoice you wanted to know how the quantity is determined-Cause-Invoice quantity =  Total delivered quantity - Total invoiced quantity- if the above result in positive quantity then you will see the same as invoice quantity- if the above result in negative quantity then you will see the invoice quantity is zero-Resolution-Since we have cost distribution in supplier invoice and in general it should have reference to delivery thus system is designed accordingly as mentioned above to ensure it will only give the quantity that has a open delivery.-However you can enter the quantity as expected based on Purchase order quantity that is Invoice quantity= Total Purchase order quantity- total invoiced quantity-Keywords-[Enter your Keywords here...]

Title: Duplicate emails received via workflow rules
Content: Symptom-You have set up workflow rules to receive emails but you are receiving two emails for same document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You have maintained the email address twice for same person-Resolution-If the person is a Service agent:-Go to Business partner work center-Go to Service agents view-Search and select the respective person-Click on Edit button and choose Address-Where you see various Address type-You can select Address type(In-house address or Main Personal Address) and scroll down to see the email address maintained-Ensure that email address is unique in each Address type, if you have same email address then remove email addres from one of the address type.-If the person is internal employee:-Go to Personal administration work center-Go to Employee view-Search and select the respective person-Click on Edit button-Go to Personal data tab-Go to Private  contact data tab-Where you can see the email address maintained-Go to  Employment tab-Go to Work place contact data-Where you can see the email address maintained-Ensure the  email address in Private conatct data and work place  contact data is unique,if you have same email address then remove email address from one of the contact data-Keywords- Two emails received

Title: How to Enter the Inspection Indicator in Integration for Inventory Notification
Content: Symptom-You need to set the Inspection check when using Third-Party Integration for Inventory Notification. However, in the documentation the Inspection Indicator is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can set the Inspection Indicator using the InventoryStockStatusCode. It can have the value 1 (for Inspection checked) or do not enter the tag InventoryStockStatusCode.-In case you need to set the Inspection, you can use the tag below:-<InventoryStockStatusCode>1</InventoryStockStatusCode>-Keywords-Inspection, Indicator, web, service

Title: Blocked Service in Project
Content: Symptom-You have fully blocked the service ABC but you still can fetch it and add it in a project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Product and Service Portfolio-Search and open the service ABC (ABC being the ID of your service).-You are blocking this service from both the tabs Purchasing and Sales.-Now you enter one of your project-Go to the tab Project Plan >>sub-tab Gantt Chart-Select the under tab Work-Click "Add Row"-From here, you can find and add the service ABC in your project.-Cause-An information message will pop up once you will add the blocked service ABC to your project:-"Purchasing process for product ABC missing or not active"-Resolution-This is the normal system behavior.-You need to take note of the information message given by the system and not use this blocked service in your project or activate the used service.-Keywords-Blocked Service, Project.

Title: Shopping cart has skipped approval
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 3243930***-While creating shopping cart you may see the approver but after you submit , it does not go for approval also you cannot see the approver afterwards .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You would have used  the work distribution called "direct approver" In the approval process ,this work distribution has the below to be checked.-If the requestor, creator, or recipient is assigned as the direct approver, and if the approval process consists only of a single step involving direct approvers, then an approval task will not be created, and the shopping cart will be requested.-Resolution-However the details given above is checked by system only after you submit the shopping cart thus approver is removed after you submit, unfortunately there is a limitation with this work distribution of shopping cart alone to remove approver before submitting the shopping cart and thus you see the approver while creating shopping cart.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2002/en-US/2ce0fab3722d1014a50bd275e6a24c74.html?q=shopping%20cart%20approval-Keywords-approver disappeared in shopping cart,

Title: An Inbound Delivery is Finished Without Put-Away Task Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You are using a two step Logistics Model for receiving and you noticed that after you have confirmed the Unload task the Delivery Status of the corresponding Inbound Delivery has been changed to Finished.-You expect this status to be changed only after the Put-Away task has also been confirmed.-Furthermore, the corresponding Warehouse Request and Warehouse Order are both in a Started state (instead of Finished).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Inbound Logistics. -Select the view Inbound Deliveries. -Show All Inbound Deliveries By Selection.-Find the Inbound Delivery ABC (ABC represents the exact ID of the document). -Select it and click the button Edit. -You can see in the top left corner of the screen that the Delivery Status is Finished.-Navigate to the tab Document Flow. -Show Extended View. -Click on the anchor symbol displayed at the bottom of the Warehouse Order box.-Result: You will see that the Put-Away task DEF (DEF represents the exact ID of the task) is Not Started. However, the Inbound Delivery ABC is Released.-Cause-This is a Procure to Pay scenario where Inbound Delivery is released but Warehouse Order and Warehouse Request are still in Started state. The Inbound Delivery is released based on Unload Task Confirmation and without Put away task confirmation, which is the expected behavior.-Resolution-Since you are using a two step model for a standard inbound process, the Warehouse Request and Warehouse Order are expected to be in status Started only until the Put-Away task is complete.-(Execution process completes with the finish of the Put-Away task and then only the statuses of the Warehouse Request and Warehouse Order change to Finished)-This is the expected behavior for a two step Logistics Model.-Furthermore, in  the two step model, the Inbound Delivery gets released when the Unload Task is confirmed.-This is the expected behaviour of the system.-Keywords-inbound delivery, finished, put away task, not confirmed,

Title: Production Proposals Automatically Firmed By System
Content: Symptom-You observe that Production Proposals are sometimes "Firmed By System" and sometimes not. You want to know why does this happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supply Planning.-Select the view Resource Load. -Show All Resource Loads By Selection. -Find XYZ (XYZ represents the Resource ID). -Click the button Open. -Under the section Details (of Resource Load tab, sub-tab Load Table) you will see that there are Production Proposals with status "Firmed By System".  -Cause-Generally, the manually created (by user) Proposals are firmed and the ones create by MRP Run are not firmed.-However, the status "Firmed By System" applies for those Proposals where the Availability Date is earlier than the Planning Time Fence Period. In such cases the respective Proposal will be set to "Firmed By System" at Resource Load.-Planning Time Fence Period = System Date + Planning Time Fence (defined in the material's Master Data).-Resolution-The system works as designed and this is the expected behaviour.-See Also- 2839021 - Firm Status For Planning Proposals -Keywords-production proposal, firmed by system, resource load

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2002 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2002 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to your tenants during your planned maintenance downtime window after the 17th of April.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2002 HFC 3-Resolution-Cross – Area Topics-The calendar widget that was changing the time from PM to AM is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000005534)-The issue with adding the e-mail in the purchase order is now fixed. The error was coming up from an OVS attachment. (Hotfix ID: 1000002904)-The pen icon is now removed when User Personalization feature is disabled. Any dumps that may occur while running these web services are now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000007155)-The Template field on the communication details, in the migration template for supplier data is now disabled. Migrating data for this field leads to follow-up errors in the purchase order processing. (Hotfix ID: 1000006573)-Improvements have been made in handling the XSLT transformations in XSLT Repository. (Hotfix ID: 1000005087)-Customer Relationship Management-You can now hide/unhide the four section groups (two untitled, Account, and Contact) below the OWL list on the ActivityWithAccountRestirctionOWL screen. This error was caused due to the under or overpayment in receivables or payables type postings on a project-based sales order item. (Hotfix ID: 1000006672)-OBN navigation to PaymentAdvice BO factsheet from partner/customer custom BO screens are now working. (Hotfix ID: 1000006745)-The issue in the Microsoft Excel template for Journal Entry Voucher uploads has now been fixed. The issue was regarding translations for languages other than English. (Hotfix ID: 1000007894)-Cancellation of lease contract initiation and clearing posting run now cancels all the journal entries. (Hotfix ID: 1000006974)-For the tax code 47, description purchases, reverse charge, Art 283-1, standard rate, there is a mapping entry that has been provided for mapping of the payable tax line item into tax box 08T. It ensures that the tax amount on the Overview screen of the FR VAT return matches with the value on the output form of the FR VAT return. (Hotfix ID: 1000006712)-Submission and approval status to VAT Return OWL have now been added as personalized hidden fields on VAT Return OWL. The fields are relevant for Spain VAT Returns. Legal changes for year 2020 have been incorporated into US 1099 Misc Copy B form (Hotfix ID: 1000003743)-Spain: According to the latest law in Spain, output file for EC Sales List Return now have a blank instead of 'T' at position 58 in header. (Hotfix ID: 1000007893)-Italy: New depreciation code with special depreciation 11.5 % is now available for Italian customers. (Hotfix ID: 1000002365)-Change made in the form template for the FR VAT return to include the tax amount of tax box 9BT in the relevant section. The tax amount in tax box 9BT was not being considered earlier. Now, the tax amount of 9BT tax box gets considered. This ensures the tax amount on the Overview screen of the FR VAT return matches with the value on the output form of the FR VAT return. (Hotfix ID: 1000006506)-Belgium: Documents posted with Tax Event-040 (Domestic Purchase of Investments) and Tax Rate Type- 2 (Zero) are now mapped to Tax Box 83 for Return Type-1 (Periodic VAT Returns). (Hotfix ID: 1000006047)-Austria: Former Austrian MT940 Bank Statement processing issue for files including unsupported tag ABWE+ is now fixed. This tag is completely removed as official format documentation does not allow it. (Hotfix ID: 1000007990)-Spain:  The aggregation for ES 303 return is now enabled. (Hotfix ID: 1000007075)-Human Resources-The reports based on the data source HCMPAB01 (Headcount) now shows correct Phone number characteristic. The underlying data source HCMPAB01 (Headcount) pulls the Phone characteristic from another data source HCMEMPB (Employee Master Data) via Master data referencing. The restrictions in the underlying FSI Views has now been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 1000007494)-Time account rule visibility in employees time file has now been fixed. With this correction, time account rule field will be displayed in correct mode either editable or read only. (Hotfix ID: 1000007411)-Report the customer is using now has the correct values for the recorded times. In case of multiple internal comments being present for that time recording entry, only one of them is shown in the report. (Hotfix ID: 1000008001)-Project Management-If there are several items with the same product in a project invoice request, then an error "Quantity unit *** is not compatible with product ***" appears. Although there are no incompatible units. It happens because the corresponding check is expecting that every product is considered only once during the check. However, in this case several entries for same product can be sent for checking. (Hotfix ID: 1000006179)-Field Party ID in business object PRO_PROJECT has been PSM released with write access. (Hotfix ID: 1000007762)-An exception was thrown if an Org Unit was being added to the project. It happens if PPR items of the project have End Buyer party and quantity unit code that should be converted for determining price. It is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000005707)-The Process Communications errors that were coming up without any IDs are now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000000779)-Field BillablePercent of project expense list was not visible in OData services. Now it is marked as Replication allowed and after FSI reload (must be done manually by SAP support) it will be visible in OData repository. (Hotfix ID: 1000007231)-Field NotToBeInvoicedIndicator of project expense list was not visible in OData services. Now it is marked as Replication allowed and after FSI reload (must be done manually by SAP support) it will be visible in OData repository. (Hotfix ID: 1000006755)-Supply Chain Management-PSM Read release of the association from Production Order to Document Output Request. (Hotfix ID: 1000007136)-The CID item issue in data source SCMWREXE_V1 has now been addressed. (Hotfix ID: 1000008152)-Uploading for Serial Number functionality is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000006995)-Web Service confirmation of warehouse tasks with mandatory serial number and iStock for inbound process. (Hotfix ID: 1000007614)-The datatype of service order in the tracking tab of Registered Products has been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 1000003136)-The rounding issues problem in the Outbound Delivery Request for Sales Kit item is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000006196)-Export to excel for Third-Party Logistics request now has delivery type data as well. (Hotfix ID: 1000005598)-Issue of missing fields with Data report: Order fulfillment - on time in full - by order has now been addressed. (Hotfix ID: 1000008100)-The PSM write release for Description - Language Code has been addressed. (Hotfix ID: 1000007205)-The performance issue with PRS valuation level determination has now been addressed. (Hotfix ID: 1000005839)-Supplier Relationship Management-In interactive Purchase Order output form for service and expense items, the quantity is coming as 0 if its recorded in thousands on purchase order. (Hotfix ID: 1000007674)-If the employee responsible for purchase order is terminated or no longer valid, no further updates can be made on it such as delivery or invoicing and it cannot be set to finished status. A warning message now pops-up and the business won't get impacted. (Hotfix ID: 1000007006)-Keywords-BYD2002; HFC03; Hotfix; SPS03; Hotfix Collection; 2002

Title: The Timezone is Always Shown as UTC in Workflow Notifications
Content: Symptom-When a Notification is sent via Workflow, the Timezone is always displayed as UTC and not as the timezone maintained in the User Profile of the Recipient.-Environment-SAP Service Cloud / SAP Sales Cloud-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-Requisite: You have set up a Workflow Rule of the Type Notification, in which the text includes a Placeholder that reflects a timestamp-Perform the Action that triggers the Workflow Rule. -Log in to the system with the User who receives the Notification. -Select the Notifications button. -You can see that the Timezone is shown as UTC, although the logged in User has a different timezone maintained in their profile.-Cause-For the workflow rule of type notification, the system always shows the timestamp in UTC. This is the expected behaviour.-The subject of the task cannot be changed to show the timezone as per personalized time stamp, because at task level there is a possibility that for one task instance, there are multiple responsible employees. Actions performed by any of the responsible employees can modify the status of the task.-All the responsible employees can have different timezones maintained, so the subject can't be modified based on one particular responsible employee.-Resolution-This is the standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Workflow Rule Notification Placeholder Time zone Timezone UTC Profile logged in User

Title: Earliest Requirement Date Missing in Process Purchase Proposals View
Content: Symptom-When you go to Process Purchase Proposals view, the Earliest Requirement Date is missing in the OWL, although the field is fulfilled when you open the Purchase Proposal XXX.-XXX = Purchase Proposal ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control work center.-Select Process Purchase Proposals view.-Search for Purchase Proposal XXX.-Select the Purchase Proposal XXX.-Select Proposal Details tab.-Notice that the Earliest Requirement Date field is empty.-Open the Purchase Proposal XXX.-Notice that the Earliest Requirement Date exists when you open the document.-Cause-The Earliest Requirement Date is not displayed in the OWL due to avoid performance problems in the system.-Resolution-For performance issues, the system is working as expected in this case.-Keywords-OWL, OIF, missing

Title: No changes in Put Away Task Using Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm the Put Away task XXX using the web service MaintainSiteLogisticsTask. The response is successful, however the task is not changes in the system.-XXX = Task ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the SOAP UI.-Use the WSDL for web service MaintainSiteLogisticsTask.-Run the request XML based on the documentation.-The response is successful.-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Task Control view.-Search for Put Away Task XXX.-No changes in the task and no Confirmation created.-Cause-Automatic Identification is not enabled in the system under Business Configuration. If this is not enabled, web service call would be successful, however system will ignore the call.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Click Next to step 3 Scoping.-Expand Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics.-Expand Task Management and Automation.-Check the box for Automatic Identification.-Click Next to step 5 Review.-Select Finish.-Keywords-MaintainSiteLogisticsTask, Putaway, Webservice

Title: Supplier Invoice or  Purchase order Access Restriction by Company is Not Working
Content: Symptom-You would like to restrict the user from creating Supplier Invoices by Company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business User view.-Search and select the respective Business User.-Click on the Edit button.-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Select Read and Write Access as Restricted for 'Invoice Entry' and 'Invoices and Credit Memos'.-Select the Check box Read and Write access the Company you want to allow the user for creating invoices.-Leave the Check boxes for the companies you don't want the users to create Supplier Invoices.-Click on Save.-Now, go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the option New Supplier Invoice Without Purchase Order from Common Tasks.-Click on the value help for Buying Company.-The restricted companies are still displaying during the Supplier Invoice creation.-Cause- This feature is currently not available in the system.-Resolution-You may post it on Customer Influence Forum-or-Contact your partners to help develop it for you-See Also-2650386 - Supplier Access Restrictions by Company is Not Working-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Access Restriction, Company restriction

Title: Project is not Visible in the Document Flow of the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You created a Project from a Sales Order via the Create Project button. However, the Project is not visible in the Document Flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Click on the New button and select Sales Order. -Enter all required data. -Click on the Save button.-Click on the Create Project button.-In the New Project window enter the details for the Project Structure, Person Responsible, Responsible Unit etc..-Click OK.-You receive an information message that the Project ABC has been created. You can edit it as soon as you have saved the sales order. (ABC represents the Project ID).-Navigate to the Document Flow. -The Project is not visible. -Cause-The Sales Order is not Released.-The action necessary for document flow completion is releasing the sales order. It has technical reasons because project itself does not “know” the sales order but is referenced to a special technical document representing a copy of sales order but belonging to Project Invoicing. This copy is created only after releasing the sales order.-Resolution- You need to release the Sales Order via the Submit button and the Release Order option. The Project will then be visible in the Document Flow-Keywords-Project; Document Flow; Sales Order; missing; not visible

Title: Unexpected Tax Calculation for Belgium
Content: Symptom-You are selling  or receiving products with Belgium tax code and get incorrect tax calculations in respective invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Customer invoice-Navigate to the customer invoicing work center.-Go to invoice requests view-Search and select the respective invoice request-Click on invoice button-Enter product and customer master data and all other details-Select a net price of 100.-Navigate to the Items tab, Taxes subtab.-Tax Base Amount is displayed as 98 and not 100-Tax rate is 21%, so calculated amount is 20,58-- or- Supplier invoice-Navigate to the Supplier invoicing work center.-Go to invoice entry view-Search and select the respective purchase order or delivery-Click on invoice button-Enter product and supplier master data and all other details-Select a net price of 100.-Navigate to the Items tab, Taxes subtab.-Tax Base Amount is displayed as 98 and not 100-Tax rate is 21%, so calculated amount is 20,58-Cause-For Belgium the cash discount provided in your payment terms is considered in the tax base calculation.-When selecting payment terms with 2% cash discount for 14 days, the 2% will be deducted from the original value.-Even if the payment is done after 14 days, the tax is not reconsidered.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior in accordance with Belgium VAT law, articles 26 and 28.- If you do not want it then follow below steps:-Customer invoice:-Open the Product master data of product used in customer invoice-Navigate to the Sales tab-Select the respective Sales Organisation used in customer invoice-In the General Subtab, there is a check box Cash Discount Allowed-Uncheck this Box-Do this for each Sales Organisation required- Supplier invoice:-Navigate to the Supplier invoicing work center.-Search and open the respective supplier invoice-Go to Items tab-Go to Basic data tab-You will find cash discount relevant check box-Uncheck this Box-Do this for each Supplier invoice required-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Tax Base Amount, Calculation, Values Added Tax, Belgium, Cash Discount, Payment Term, Steuerberechnung, Umsatzsteuer, Belgien, Zahlungsbedingungen, Rabatt, wrong tax base amount , belgium

Title: Select items that can be grouped in a single purchase order
Content: Symptom-You will also see the error message given below-Select purchase request items with the same purchasing unit-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase request and orders work center-Select few Purchase requests-Click on new purchase order  or Click on bundle and order- By supplier-You will get the errors-Cause-As the error says, you cannot combine purchase requests  that has different Purchasing units.-Cause each purchase order can only have one purchasing unit.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to see the Purchasing unit of the purchasing request:-Go to Purchase request and orders work center-Select Purchase requests-Click on edit to open the purchase request-Select the respective item of purchase request -Then  go to  basic sub tab-Where you can see the Purchasing unit of respective item- Please follow above steps from 1 to 6 for all other purchase request items that you want to bundle in to single Purchase order- Now you know which are the purchasing units used in each purchase request so select only those purchasing request items having same purchasing unit to create one purchase order.- Note: You cannot change the purchasing unit in the purchase request once its released.

Title: Error :Unknown Party PQR
Content: Symptom-PQR is a Global Location Number.- You see a process communication error in  both Purchase order and purchase order acknowledgment.where you don't use Interactive form and the acknowledgment is sent by external system via communication arrangement-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application user managemeent work center-Go to Process communication error-Choose Open errors with incident-You will see entries with this error-Select  the entry and  scroll down to see the error details-Cause-In Purchase order if you double click on company it opens up Org Unit Overview-Under External Business Identifiers, Global Location Number is PQRS, but in payload supplier is sending it as PQR ,where S is missing.-Because of wrong value sent by external system, system could not find recipient party and fails to create Purchase Order Confirmation or acknowledgment.-Resolution-Contact  the person who has created the communication arrangement related to Purchase order acknowledgement to correct the Global location number once they fix it.-Please create incident and give us permission to cancel the stuck messages in back end, once done,you will have to send Purchase acknowledgment again with the correct values.-Keywords-Acknowledgement not received, Acknowledgement error

Title: System triggers error while performing Consumption for Cost Center, Posting Type Goods Return
Content: Symptom-You receive the error message "Creation of serial number XXXX failed" while you are performing Consumption for Cost Center (XXXX refers to Serial Number ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Internal Logistics work center.-Select the Common Task Consumption for Cost Center.-Select Goods Return for Posting Type.-Enter other variables like Site, Cost Center, Product, Logistics Area and Serial Number ID.-Click the Next button.-The system displays the error message "Creation of serial number XXXX failed".-Cause-For Return from Cost Center, we expect that the issue from Cost Center would have been previously done in the system.-Hence, we do not create Serial Number automatically in this case which is a valid behavior.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you should use Sarial Number previously issued from Cost Center. The Tagged Inventory Status of the Serial Number should be shown as  "Issued to Cost Center".-Note: In certain cases, you may have done the issue from Cost Center in your legacy system and now want to do the return from Cost Center in the ByDesign system. In that scenario, we recommend that you create the Registered Product via migration with the tagged inventory status Migrated - Issued to Cost Center.-Keywords-Creation of serial number XXXX failed, Consumption for Cost Center, Posting Type, Goods Return

Title: Warning Message "General: value XYZ in column Serial ID will be truncated; edit source value"
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Serial ID via Inventory into the system after validation, it throws below warning message:-General: value XYZ in column Serial ID will be truncated; edit source value-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Select the current project and choose the Open Activity List.-Navigate to Integrate and Extend tab and search for activity:Migration of Accounting Transaction Data -Select it and choose Open-Select option:Migration of Accounting Transaction Data using the migration tool-Select the respective migration file and perform Execute Migration.-In the guided activity, choose Migration Object as Inventory.-Select and choose Process File -Navigate to Next, here system throws above warning message. -Cause-The standard system behavior during Serial ID migration >30 bits is a truncation. During the migration validation step, the system throws a warning message is to notify users that Serial IDs will be truncated to 30 only if it is more than 30. Length is set as 30 in Migration template itself under Serial ID column.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Select the current project and choose the Open Activity List.-Navigate to Integrate and Extend tab and search for activity: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data -Select it and choose Open-Select option: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data using the migration tool-Select the respective migration file and edit the column Serial ID length to 30 only.-Upload the edited file again and Execute Migration.-Keywords-value in column Serial ID will be truncated; edit source value, value XYZ in column Serial ID will be truncated; edit source value, Migrate of Accounting Transaction Data, Inventory, Serial Numbers, Serial ID

Title: Over-The-Counter Sales Quantities Not Considered In Demand Planning
Content: Symptom-The sales quantities from Over-The-Counter Sales are not being shown in the Actuals sales quantities when the Demand Plan is rolled-forward-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Demand Planning Workcenter.-Go to Demand Plans View.-In the field Show, select All Demand Plans By Selection using dropdown.-Select the required Active Demand Plan ID-Choose Plan option.-Here New Window Opens up displaying all keyfigures.-Cause-Over-The-Counter Sales Quantities are not considered in Demand Planning because the Over-The-Counter was built in a different way not using the standard sales order / delivery documents.-Resolution-The Actuals key figure from Over-The-Counter Sales is not considered in demand forecasting-Keywords-demand planning, actuals keyfigure, OTCS, OTC sales,

Title: How to finish Purchase order
Content: Symptom-You have a Purchase Order and you want the status to change to finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for the Purchase Order-The status of the Purchase Order is not Finished -Resolution-To change the status of your purchase order to finished, you have three options available.-To complete the process, please follow these steps:-1. Generate an Inbound Delivery and Supplier Invoice for the remaining quantity. This will automatically update the status of the Purchase Order to Finished.-2. Adjust the quantity to match what has been delivered or invoiced. Then, click on the send update button.-3. To manually finish the items, click on the finish button at either the item level or the header level. Choose invoice and then delivery to complete them.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and select the Purchase Order document.-Under the Items section choose the Finish button.-You have the option to select Invoice and Delivery in the Finish button.-Select the relevant option to manually Finish Delivery and Invoice.-Keywords-Manual finish Purchase order, don't want to create deliveries , don't want to create invoices , how to complete Purchase order, change status of purchase order to finished

Title: Extension field value not flown from one document to another
Content: Symptom-For example you have enabled the extension scenario ,but still value is not flowing from Purchase order to supplier invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-All extension scenarios or more than one extension scenario is enabled. so value is being overwritten by one of the extension scenarios.-Resolution-In the further usage of extension field in Supplier invoice , the below changes are required:-Since you want details to flow from Purchase order to supplier invoice you have to check mark  relavent extension scenario given below-Purchase Order - Root    to     Supplier Invoice - Root-All other scenarios scenarios appearing like ' XXX- Root      to       supplier invoice-Root" has to be deactivated, cause system tried to pick from one of them and it finds no details.(where XXX can be other documents )-Note: Once all above changes are done, please create new Purchase order and Supplier invoices  so that changes can be reflected.-See Also- KBA 2936224 - Extension field value has disappeared-Keywords-Extension field value, extension field not reflecting ,

Title: User can Edit Layout of Site ABC Despite not Having Access to Site ABC
Content: Symptom-In the Access Restrictions user is not authorized to Site ABC (where ABC is a Site).-However user is able to Edit Layout for Site ABC despite not having access to Site ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data workcenter and  Locations view.-2. Find Site ABC and Edit.-3. User is able to maintain any field.-4. Click Edit Layout.-5. Click Add Child Logistics Area and maintain data and Save.-  Cause-Site level restrictions are designed based on Location Logistics Process control(LLPC) assigned for a site.-A site will generate an LLPC only when logistics relevant check box is set for the site(during activation of Supply Planning Area).-Resolution-Customers will not be able to read/write in any newly created site if we restrict the site based on LLPC.-Keywords-Edit Layout, Access, Restrict, Site, Supply Chain Design Master, Location, authorize

Title: Product specification details in purchase order
Content: Symptom-Product Properties and Notes of product specification are not visible in Purchase order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In standard ByDesign we do not show product specification property details on Purchase Order screen.-Resolution-We made this product specification BO (PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT_SPEC) PSM enabled.- So that you can configure the same from PDI studio.(Contact your partners to help you with it)- The path to be followed  to view product specification properties in PDI :- PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT_SPEC ( ProductRequirementSpecification ) -.- ROOT --- association --- SpecificationFolder --- association -- SpecificationFolderProductPropertyValuationList ( target node: SpecificationFolderProductPropertyValuationList ) --- association -- PropertyValuation --- association -- PropertyValuationPropertyValue( PRP_VLN_PRP_VAL )- The above details are PSM enabled only after your system is upgraded to version 2005-Keywords-Product specification, Property details

Title: Warehouse Requests For Cancelled Outbound Deliveries Have Different Status
Content: Symptom-You observe that some of the Warehouse Requests for already cancelled Outbound Deliveries are listed in the system with status Finished but others have a status: Cancelled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Outbound Delivery Control. -View Customer Demand. -Find the document ABC (ABC represents the exact ID of the document you are searching for). -Click the Edit button. -Navigate to the Document Flow tab. -Select the Extended View. -Result: you will see that some of the Warehouse Requests in the scenario are in status Finished and others are Cancelled, even though their respective Outbound Deliveries are Cancelled. -Cause-Once the Outbound Delivery is cancelled the Warehouse Order and Request go to Finished state.-Most importantly, after the Warehouse Request goes to Finished state and then the Warehouse Request is Rejected (by clicking Reject Request), the status of the Warehouse Request changes to Cancelled, therefore some of the documents have Finished status and others are displayed as Cancelled.-Resolution-This is the expected and correct behaviour of the system.-Keywords-warehouse request, different status, finished, cancelled, canceled

Title: Valuation of material in business residence failed - Planned Project Cost for Material
Content: Symptom-You have maintained material XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the material) in Project that has business residence ABC (ABC represents the ID of the business residence). You expect the material cost to be displayed in the Project Plan Values.
