However, the planned cost amount is Zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the Project.-Choose the View Plan Values button.-You can see here some of the project tasks are in Error status marked in Red color.-Choose project task and navigate to the Messages tab here you can see error message 'Valuation of material XYZ in business residence ABC failed on DD-MM-YYYY'.-Cause-Material XYZ is sourced from an External Supplier, The system was not able to derive a suitable Valuation Strategy to calculated the planned costs of this material.-According to help document Project Cost and Revenue Planning 5 Valuation Strategies are used in a priority sequence to determine the planned cost rate for a Material when sourced from an External Supplier:-Price from latest purchase order with reference to the project: If a purchase order with reference to the project exists, the system uses the price from that purchase order. If there is more than one purchase order for the same material, the system uses the price from the latest purchase order.-Price from latest purchase order without reference to the project: If no purchase order with reference to the project exists, the system uses the price from a purchase order that does not reference the project. If there is more than one purchase order for the same material, the system uses the price from the latest purchase order.-Price from fixed source of supply-Price from contract-Price from price list-Resolution-This is expected system design.-See Also-Help Document: Project Cost and Revenue Planning-KBA: 2831120 - The Project Planned Cost Shows Zero After Maintaining Material or service in the Project -Keywords-material cost rate, material planned cost, Service cost rate, service planned cost

Title: Cost could not be determined for materials / work packages of Project Task
Content: Symptom-After maintaining all planned values you press Valuate button.-A warning appears:-Cost could not be determined for some or all work packages of task.- or-Cost could not be determined for some or all materials of task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose project.-Press Edit.-On the top press Valuate.-The warning message 'Cost determined with errors for some or all materials of task' appears.-Cause-This error message can appear for various reasons, when the system is not able to derive all cost rates according to the applied Valuation Strategies.-Resolution-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Projects view and select the respective Project. -Press View Plan Values. -In the new screen you notice that some of the project tasks display a red Error Status.-Select one of the eroneous Project task and navigate to the Messages tab, where the error messages appear.-Solve the error according to the displayed error message. -  See Also- 2831120 - The Project Planned Cost Shows Zero After Maintaining Material or service in the Project -2907652 - Valuation of material XYZ in business residence ABC failed on DD-MM-YYYY -2165771 - Valuation Of Resource In Company Failed - Project Valuation-Project Cost and Revenue Planning-Keywords-material cost rate , material planned cost,Service cost rate, service planned cost

Title: Expense service product ABC not permitted
Content: Symptom-Try to enter a Service (which you marked as expense in service master data) in the project  in the work tab or expense tab you will get this error.-Where ABC is the service ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently in projects do not support service expense products, neither under work tab nor under expense tab.-Not as a work, because time confirmations are not allowed for expense products and not as an expense, because only expense accounts can be entered on tab “Expenses”currently.-Resolution-This was never developed in standard ByDesign system so we considered it as new requirement so submit all new requirements on Customer Influence Forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-To know if there is other way to achieve your requirement which may be other customers or partners or our developers can sujjest ,kindly submit all such consulting questions in SAP community at https://www.sap.com/community/tag.html?id=01200615320800000691-Keywords-Expense service; Service expense;

Title: Email address XXXX is not valid
Content: Symptom-When you order a Purchase order you would get this error.- You may notice that in the edit out put settings of purchase order you have chosen other out put channel other than email but you still see this error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The email address maintained in supplier master data is not valid.-Resolution-Please open the supplier master data and maintain the correct email address.-Keywords-email address error,

Title: Team member or service is empty under work tab of Project
Content: Symptom-After you do the time confirmation you expect the details to reflect in the work tab of project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to Projects view-Search and open the Project-Go to sub tab work-Where you may see only employee or service maintained in an entry and not both.-When a time confirmation is done by that employee you expect the service in time confirmation will appear here against  the employee.- or-when other employee does time confirmation against the service appearing here you would expect that employee to appear here against the service.-Cause-We don't change what was already maintained by you under work tab.-The correct work package for the assignment of a time confirmation is determined in the following order :-1. Same service and same team member-2. Same team member-3. Same service-also once this is done system does not fill the respective service or employee against the maintained work packages under work tab as per current development.-Resolution-The time confirmations will be assigned to work package as mentioned above and they would be visible under Display History tab.-Also if there is nothing maintained under work tab and when a time confirmation is done  then we see that Service appears under work tab and employee will be empty.-Keywords-Service empty, employee empty

Title: Unable to download IDOC/XML in Business Communication Monitoring
Content: Symptom-You cannot download the IDOC of a document in Business Communication Monitoring- or-Nothing happens when you click on download button of a message in Business Communication Monitoring-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Application user management work center-2.Go to Business Communication Monitoring view-3.Choose all Business messages-4.Search and select the document-5.Click on Download button-Nothing is downloaded-Cause-System generally archives and deletes old xml messages  greater than 42 days-Resolution-So we don't  allow download after 42 days-Keywords-cannot download XML, cannot down load IDoc, cannot download the message

Title: Error During Confirmation of Product Count Using Excel Tenmplate
Content: Symptom-When you confirm Product Count Task using Excel Template you will encounter error 'Addition of new product ABC in task 999 not allowed'-where ABC is the Product ID and 999 is the Count Task ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Physical Inventory workcenter and Task Control view-2. Select Task ID 999-3. Select Confirm with Microsoft Excel-4. Save the Excel and Enable Editing.-5. In the excel select the Fill Handle in the last row and last column of the active cell and drag one row.-6. Add new Product ID, logistics area and other relevant information.-7. Go to SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN tab-8. Log in-9. Save data to-You will encounter the above error.-Cause-Since the Count Method in the task is Product Count it is possible to only add existing product with a valid Logistics Area.-Resolution-You cannot add new product using excel or in UI once the task is created.-Keywords-Product Count, Physical Inventory, Count Method, Excel template, Confirm,Logistics Area

Title: Run Load Leveling is ineffective for Resource ABC
Content: Symptom-When you perform Run Load Leveling for Resource ABC(where ABC is resource ID) nothing happens and the resource is still overloaded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Planning workcenter and Resource Load view-2. Select Resource ABC and Open-3. Select the record for Start Date where the resource is overloaded i.e. >100%-4. Run Load Leveling and Input Start Date  and End Date and OK.-You will receive a message that Load Leveling is Finished but nothing changes-Cause-There are could be many production proposals that are in Firmed status which consume the resource on the overloaded date.-Since the proposals are in firm status the load levelling will not consider and not perform any changes.-  Resolution-Planner has to  revisit the Firmed Proposals and check whether they can Undo-firm those proposals and retry.-Steps to Undo-Firm the proposals--1. Go to Supply Control workcenter and Process Production Proposals view.-2. Select the Production Proposal ID and Open Product Planning Details-3. Select the proposal and Undo-Firm.-    Keywords-Production Proposal, Resource, Load Leveling, Overload,Firm, Un-firm,Supply Planning.

Title: Employee not found when sending notification or Alert related to work package
Content: Symptom-You could not find a user to whom you want to send a notification or Alert related to work packages-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project team work center-Go to Work packages view-Choose All work packages-Select one of them-Click on button New and choose notification or Alert-Go to To field  in the drop down you could not find desired employee-Cause-Employee does not have access to work packages view-Resolution-Go to Application user Management work center-Go to business users view-Search for the employee-Select and Click on button Edit and choose Access rights-Go to Work center and view assignment tab-Search and expand work center ID PRO_PROJECTTEAM-Check mark the work center View ID PRO_WORKPACKAGES-Keywords-could not find employee, unable to send notification ,unable to send alert

Title: Error Message: Accounts Payable Due Item Type Code Not Valid
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice due to error message:-Accounts payable due item type code not valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice and Credit Memos view-Open supplier invoice ABC (ABC refers to the supplier invoice ID)-Click Check button-You can see ther error message.-Cause-In the supplier invoice, General tab, you have selected a reconciliation account XYZ (XYZ refers to the reconciliation account ID) for supplier invoice ABC. But the reconciliation account is not marked as available for supplier invoice in configuration setting.-Resolution-You need to scope consolidation account XYZ for supplier invoice by following steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, open it-Maintain settings for reconciliation accounts-Find account XYZ, select Available in Supplier Invoice, save the change-After it, you will be able to post supplier invoice with reconciliation account XYZ.-Keywords-Accounts Payable Due Item Type Code, Reconciliation Account, Supplier Invoice, Cannot Post

Title: Country Name is missing in Ship-to Address  of Delivery Note
Content: Symptom-You observe Country Name is missing in address of  Ship-to in Delivery Note for Outbound Delivery KLM. *KLM refers to Outbound Delivery id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Outbound Deliveries View-Search for Outbound Delivery KLM-Select Preview--> Preview Delivery Note-You observe Country Name is missing in address of Ship-to in Delivery Note for Outbound Delivery KLM .-Cause-When goods movement occurs within the same country, Country name of  Ship-to Address  does not get populated in Delivery Note.-Resolution-Only when goods movement happens between 2 different countries, Country name is shown in ship-to address of Delivery Note.-Note:Irrespective of goods movement happens within Country or 2 different countries, In Ship-From Address  Country name is shown in Delivery Note.-Keywords-Country Name is missing in address  Ship-to  in Delivery Note, Country name of  Ship-to Address  does not get populated in Delivery Note.

Title: Cannot Post Ready for Posting Supplier Invoice, Error Message: Error Occurred While Trying to Evaluate Condition of A Process Step
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:Duplicate of KBA 2101312 - Error occurred while trying to evaluate condition of a process step-You cannot post a supplier invoice even the status is Ready for Posting, error messages:-Posting not possible; clarify exceptions first.-Error occurred while trying to evaluate condition of a process step.-Exchange Rate for ABC and DEF for Rate Type 001 does not exist for YYYYMMDD.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open supplier invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to the supplier invoice ID).-Click Check, there is no exception or error message, the status of the invoice is Ready for Posting.-Click Post.-You can see error messages:-Posting not possible; clarify exceptions first.-Error occurred while trying to evaluate condition of a process step.-Exchange Rate for ABC and DEF for Rate Type 001 does not exist for YYYYMMDD (ABC refers to a currency, DEF refers to the supplier invoice currency, YYYYMMDD refers to date).-You don't understand why the exchange rate between ABC and DEF is required.-Cause-In supplier invoice approval process, you have maintained one or more condition including currency ABC.-If there is no exchange rate maintained, system cannot compare hence the error messages raised.-Resolution-To post the supplier invoice, you need to maintain the exchange rate between ABC and DEF.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Open Common task: Edit Exchange Rates.-Add Row, maintain the exchange rate between ABC and DEF and save it.-The exchange rate valid from date must be before the date in the error message: YYYYMMDD.-After the exchange rate maintained, you will be able to post supplier invoice XYZ.-Keywords-Cannot Post Supplier Invoice, Evaluate Condition, Exchange Rate Not Exist, Ready for Posting

Title: Project Actual Hours are Not Displayed in Availability Calendar
Content: Symptom-Project actual hours are not showing up in availability calendar for some projects even though time recording has been submitted long back.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Select view: Projects-Select filter: All Projects and search for particular project say X(X represents a project)-Select edit and navigate to Team and Stuffing tab-Select a team member and click on button "show availability"-The calender opens and now select "navigate from" and enter the dates for which the team member has done time recording-Expand the team member tab. The project with actual hours is not displayed here-Repeat the same steps with another project say Y(Y represents a project)-You can see the project actual hours are showing in the calendar-Cause-The status of project X is closed. Therefore, the project actual hour details do not show up in the Availability Calendar, and the status of project Y is released. Hence, it will show up in the availability calender.-Resolution-Please maintain the project status as released to check the project actual hours information in the availability calendar.-Keywords-Actual Hours, Availability Calendar, Project

Title: Message "Action not Enabled" when releasing Customer Demand Without Stock Check
Content: Symptom-You want to release a Customer Demand XXX (XXX represents the Customer Demand ID) Without Stock Check, but you get the warning message "Action Not Enabled".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Select the Customer Demand view.-Search for Customer Demand XXX.-Click Release.-Click Without Stock Check.-You will see the error "Action not Enabled".-Cause-When releasing Without Stock Check, system will pick only not released confirmed lines and then perform ATP check again with stock as scope, then release the quantities available.-The error "Action Not Enabled" happens when you do not have any not released confirmed lines.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Release, Without Stock Check

Title: Error: E-Mail Address cannot be left blank While Creating or Approving a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Error: E-Mail Address cannot be left blank While Creating or Approving a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-A) Creating the Purchase Order:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Tasks.-Select New Purchase Order.-Complete the necessary details.-Click on the Order button.-Error: E-Mail Address cannot be left blank.-B) Approving the Purchase Order:-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Select the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order)-Click on the Approve button.- Error: E-Mail Address cannot be left blank.-Cause-The Output Channel Selection for the respective rule and Purchasing Unit is maintained as E-mail and no E-mail Address was maintained.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, please maintain the necessary information on following path:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management > Output Channel Selection.-Set the filter Show Rules For the respective output i.e. Changed Purchase Order.-Maintain the necessary details for the respective Purchasing Unit.-Once this configuration is maintained, system should allow to proceed with Purchase Order creation or approval.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Output Channel Selection-

Title: Account Assignment  Tab is missing in Purchase Order and in Supplier Invoice.
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new supplier invoice (SIV) with a purchase order (PO) and you can see that the Account Assignment is missing in both the SIV and PO.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Entry view.-Select a PO line and click New Invoice.-From the new invoice, go to Items tab and Coat Distribution sub-tab.-You can see that the Account Assignment information does not display bellow Cost Distribution Details.-Also, if you open the PO used to create this SIV, under Items tab, you will also see that the Account Assignment sub-tab does not display.-Cause- The product used in your PO is under the process type To-Stock.-Resolution-When you create a supplier invoice for a To-Stock Purchase Order, the system will fetch the account assignment details from the product master data.-It is the same for purchase order as well as you do not see the Account Assignment tab in To-Stock orders.-In this case, system will fetch the costs from respective account determination groups which are mapped in product master data and these accounts are mapped to general ledger accounts in financials.-Hence you do not see the Account Assignment tab for an invoice which has To-Stock items.-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Account Assignment tab missing, Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice, To-Stock Process Type.

Title: The Sales Order Price is Different from the Purchase Order Price in Inter-Company Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have created an inter-company Purchase order for certain price and then intercompany sales order is created out of this purchase order but the price in sales order shows slight variance from the purchase order price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Search for the intercompany purchase Order which has been created-The Net Price shows as 100 XYZ (XYZ refers to a sample currency)-Now, navigate to the document flow of the Purchase Order-Select the follow-up intercompany sales order which is created and open it-Navigate to Items tab and check the price here-The Net Price shows as 102 XYZ (XYZ refers to a sample currency)-Cause-Price is being picked from list price maintained. Here, list price is maintained in a different currency e.g DEF (DEF refers to a sample currency)-Hence, when the document gets created, currency conversion takes place because source and target currency is different. It is based on the exchange rate maintained in the system at the time of creation of the document.-Purchase Order is created on xx.yy.zzzz(sample date) and Sales Order is created on dd.ee.zzzz(sample date)-The exchange rate maintained between the Source Currency(DEF) and Target currency(XYZ) is different on the given dates.-So, the net price will be calculated by multiplying with exchange rate maintained on the date when purchase order/sales order got created, hence the net value is slightly different in these documents.-Resolution-Please maintain the exchange rate correctly or you can manually change the net value in the sales order.-Keywords-Purchase Order Net Price, Sales Order Net price

Title: Account Information Missing In Registered Product
Content: Symptom-You have issued serial numbers in your stock to customer via a Sales Order. You expect the customer information to be updated in the Account field of the relevant Registered Product automatically but the system does not update the account information.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements work center.-Navigate to the Registered Products view.-Search for the serial number you have issued to your customer and select it.-Choose the Edit button.-You can see that the Account field under the General tab is empty. You expect the details of Account to which the serial number was issued to be updated here.-Cause-You have not released the outbound delivery against which the serial number is issues. The Release Status of the outbound delivery is Not Released. -Resolution-You have to release the outbound delivery in which the serial number is present. Follow the below given steps to do so.-Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to Outbound Deliveries view. -Search and select the relevant outbound delivery. -Choose the Release button. -Once the above steps are performed you will be able to see that the Account information is updated in the Registered Products.-See Also-If your outbound delivery is released and Account Id is still not being updated in the Registered Products please refer the KBA : 2839280 - Account Details Missing In Registered Product.-Keywords-serial number account information missing, account details in serial number are missing, ByD, Business ByDesign, ByD Serial numbers account information not available, ByD registered products serial number account information not visible

Title: Error message:Product type is not compatible with quantity unit specified
Content: Symptom-You got this error while migrating Projects-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-While migrating projects using migration tool you will got this error.-Cause-You have used different UOM in Service master data( or not maintained quantity conversions) compared to what was mentioned in the Project Unit of work field.-Resolution-Please maintain Quantity conversion in the Service master data between Base UOM and the UOM used in the project Under Project Unit of  work.

Title: Unable change Person Responsible on project task
Content: Symptom-Unable change Person Responsible on project task-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Project management work center- Go to Projects view- Search for respective Project- Go to a Project task and scroll down- and you see that  Person responsible field is grayed out-Cause-There is no need to change person responsible if the Status of the particular task is not released thus we don't allow the change.-Resolution-If you still want to change it then change the status to released and then change person responsible.-Keywords-Person responsible field is grayed out,wrong person responsible cannot update, change of person responsible not possible,Person responsible field is grayed

Title: Source Logistics Area not determined automatically in Production Supply Task  although Material Flow rules were maintained
Content: Symptom-During confirmation of Supply Task DEF you observe Source Logistics area KLM did not determine automatically although Input Product GHI has sufficient On-hand stock and upon manually entering the Source Logistics Area KLM and Input Product GHI, You face  below errors. (*DEF refers  Supply Task id, KLM refers Source Logistics Area, GHI refers Input Product)-Source logistics area KLM is not valid for product GHI-Inventory in logistics area not available-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center-Go to Task Control View-Search for Production Supply Task DEF-Select Confirm-You observe Source Logistics area KLM did not determine automatically although Input Product GHI has sufficient On-hand stock and upon manually entering the Source Logistics Area KLM and Input Product GHI, You face errors.-Cause-As Input Product GHI On-hand stock is tagged to Inspection Stock, Hence this behavior is expected.-Note: Inspection stock cannot be used for consumption this is the  reason its not proposed by Source and Destination Determination (SDD).-Resolution-Remove Inspection Tag by using Change of Stock functionality in Internal Logistics WorkCenter.-Keywords-Source logistics area is not valid for product, Inventory in logistics area not available, Source Logistics Area not determined automatically in Production Supply Task  although Material Flow rules were maintained

Title: Journal Entry Not Created After Outbound Delivery Release
Content: Symptom-You are not able to see the journal entry postings of a goods and activity document created against an outbound delivery released for a service order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Outbound Deliveries view. -Search for the relevant outbound delivery created against the service order and choose the Edit button. -Navigate to the Document Flow tab and in extended View, you are not able to see the journal entry icon in the goods and activity confirmation document section. -Cause-Service confirmation document has not been created against the products that are pre-delivered to the relevant custodian. You will be able to see the products in stock overview with no Site value, but a value against the field Custodian ID will be updated. -Resolution-You have to create a service confirmation document against the service order for which the outbound delivery has been created.-Go to Field Service and Repair work center.-Navigate to the Order Pipeline view.-Search for the relevant Service Order against which the outbound delivery has been released and select it.-Choose the Confirm Execution button.-Update the relevant service execution information in the service confirmation document and Release the document.-Once the service confirmation is released successfully the journal entries will be updated for your Goods and Activity Confirmation document.-Creating the service confirmation indicates to the system that the service job is completed and the pre-delivered spare parts are consumed in the service job.-Keywords-No Journal Entry against goods and activity confirmation document, GAC does not have journal entry, predelivered item does not have journal entry for outbound delivery, product with no site information in stock overview

Title: Project Work Generates Duplicated Line After Creating Project Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-Project Work generates duplicated line after creating Project Purchase Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search and open the Project ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Project).-Select the respective Project Task.-Go to Work Tab.-Cause-System searches with the product of the Project Purchase Request item as service and the Service Agent of the Project Purchase Request item as team member to determine the appropriate work package of the project task.-Since the Project Purchase Request item does not have a Service Agent (you can see this by selecting the respective item in the Purchase Request and clicking on the Source of Supply), the system created a new work package with the Project Purchase Request item product as service, but without team member.-Resolution-The service agent can only be entered during the manual creation of a Project Purchase Request.-In case you are using Project Purchase Request Runs to create the Project Purchase Request, we suggest to plan the work packages in the project without service agent as team member. Then the project purchase request run still creates project purchase requests without service agent, but the requested/ordered quantities are assigned to the already existing work packages and do not create new ones.-You can also propose a system enhancement in the SAP Influence Channel: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign or contact your implementation partner for a customized solution.-Keywords- Project Purchase Request, Project, Project Purchase Request Run

Title: The Purpose and Implication of the 'Ignore Leading Zero' Indicator in Demand Planning
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Demand Plan and have maintained a Statistical Forecasting Model. When you select Forecasting Model Variant, you can see the field 'Ignore Leading Zero(s)' under the 'Model Variant Settings' section. Hovering over the question mark beside function with your mouse, you get a popup window with some information. However, you find this information is not sufficient, and so you would like to have detailed information regarding the purpose and implication of the function on the Statistical Forecast.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Demand Planning work center.-Go to the Demand Plans view.-Find and select the relevant Demand Plan.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Process Settings tab and the sub-tab "Forecasting Models".-Select the relevant Variant ID under the Forecasting Model Variants section.-In the sub-section 'Model Variant Settings', you can see the box 'Ignore Leading Zero(s)'.-If you hover over the Question Mark beside the said function above, the following information pops up in a window: 'Select if statistical forecasting should ignore leading zeros in the history horizon for products that were added recently'.-Now you would like to know the impact of activating this function on the Demand Plan/Statistics.-Resolution-Ignore Leading Zero(s) is primarily to handle a scenario where certain new launches of products might not have history. For example, if your Historical Horizon is one year: Let us say from February 2019 to January 2020, and the product got launched in August 2019; its obvious that you will not have historical Forecast for the Product from February 2019 to August 2019. In the system, this will be captured as zero, but does not mean that the product is not sold. It's just that the product is not available. Hence, in Statistical Forecasting, there is an option where the user can decide whether to consider leading zeros as a part of historical data or not.-If the leading zeros are indeed considered, then the statistical Forecast can be biased.-Keywords-Ignore, Leading, Zero, Forecasting, Demand, Plan

Title: Supplier Part Number Field Grayed Out in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom- Supplier Part Number Field Grayed Out in Shopping Cart-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks > Go Shopping.-Complete the necessary information.-Click on Next until the step 3.-Add the Supplier Part Number from Personalization mode.-'Supplier Part Number' field is greyed out.-Cause-For manual items it is expected to maintain Supplier Part Number information in Product Master data.-Resolution-Supplier Part Number can be maintained against a product and supplier combination in Product Master data and used in Shopping Cart. Later if required this can be changed during Purchase Order creation time before being sent to Supplier. This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords- Supplier Part Number, Shopping Cart

Title: ATP Green With No Stock For Product
Content: Symptom-When you check availability for a product which does not have stock, the system confirms the availability with Green status for ATP.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Choose New Sales Orders option under the Common Tasks view.-Enter the relevant information in General tab and key in the product information under Items tab.-When you enter the quantity requested by the customer, the system will give you a green status for ATP even when there is no stock for the product.-Cause-You have not maintained Availability Check Scope in product master data. If Availability Check Scope is not maintained  the system will confirm any quantity you enter in the sales order with green ATP, irrespective of the availability of stock.-Resolution-Follow the below given steps to maintain Availability Check Scope in your product master data.-Go to Product Data work center.-Navigate to Materials view.-Search for the relevant product and choose the Edit button.-Select View All button to view all the tabs in product master.-Navigate to the Availability Confirmation tab and select the relevant site from which the product will be shipped.-Under the section Product Availability Check select the dropdown against the field Availability Check Scope.-Select a value as per your business requirements. For example, If you want the system to consider only on-hand stock when availability check is triggered chose the option Stock.-Save the document.-Note: If  Product Availability Check section is not visible in the screen, you can personalize the screen and make the section visible for the business user.-Keywords-ATP Green, availability confirmation without stock, availability confirmed without stock, availability confirmation error, ATP Error, Business ByDesign ATP error, ByD ATP Error, ATP Green no stock

Title: Extension field not found
Content: Symptom-You created an extension field using Adaptation mode in a document A and extended  it to another document B, using extension scenarios in the Further usage tab of extension field settings, however when you go document B, ,where you expect the field to appear you donot see it.-Where A and B are any Bydesign documents.-Environment-SAP Businesss ByDesign-Cause-You have not Check marked the field to be visible in the Document B-Resolution- Go to Adaptation mode of Document B and then click on Add extension field appearing at the bottom- You will see the list of all such fields if exists- Check mark it and save- Click on Publish changes-Keywords-extension field not there, extension field not passed, extension field not flown, extension field value not passed

Title: Production Lot and Production Order is Closed Automatically on Changing the Status of Production Task to Finish
Content: Symptom-On Changing the status of production task to Finish the status of corresponding production lot and order is Closed automatically instead of Finish status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Production Control workcenter and Task Control view.-2. Find Task ID 9999(where 9999 is the production task ID) and Confirm.-3. Enter Confirmed Quantity and Save.-4. Change Status to Finish-You will notice that status of corresponding production lot/order 9999 is changed to Closed instead of Finish.-  Cause-The closure decision for the production lot/order is based on the Default Production Lot Closure Strategy maintained in Business Configuration.-Automatic closure of production lots closes the production lot immediately when the last production task is finished. Manual closure of production lots can be triggered from production lots or by defining a scheduled job.-Resolution-To change the Default Production Lot Closure Strategy to Manual follow the below steps:-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter-2. In Activities find Production Lot Closure Strategy-3. Change Default Production Lot Closure Strategy to B010 - Manual closure of production lot.-Keywords-Production, Task, Lot, Order, Default, Closure, Strategy, Automatic, Manual,Configuration, Finish.

Title: Wrong tax country In Purchase order or supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-You see a wrong Tax Code or wrong Tax Event appearing in the Purchase Order or Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Items tab.-Navigate to Taxes subtab.-You can see that incorrect tax code when the Automatic tax code determined check mark is there.-or-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for XYZ (XYZ is the order's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Items tab. -Navigate to Taxes subtab. -You can see that incorrect tax code when the Automatic tax code determined check mark is there.-Cause-The Tax Country field is used to determine the Country for tax reporting purposes when making acquisitions. It is not intended to show the specific country of the supplier, but rather the country where the purchase is being triggered. The tax country of a Purchase Order or Supplier Invoice is determined based on the following details, listed in order of priority:-Country manually updated under the delivery address;-Site;-Ship-to;-Recipient (only applicable for non-stock or third-party items);  -Company address.-The tax country is then used to determine the Tax Event, and once the Tax Code is determined, the Tax Country appearing under the Taxes tab controls the list of taxes available in the dropdown under the Tax Code field.-Note:-If a value is provided for the Recipient, the Delivery Address is copied from the Workplace Contact Data of the Employee Master Data;-If a value is provided for the Ship-to/Service Location, the Delivery Address is copied from the Site Address of the Supply Chain Design Master Data - Locations;-If values are entered for both Recipient and Ship-to/Service Location in a Purchase Order, the Delivery Address from the Ship-to/Service Location is selected.-Resolution-Please maintain the correct details. In case of a Purchase Order, maintain it in the Delivery subtab under Items tab. In case of a Supplier Invoice, maintain it in the Parties and Locations subtab under Items tab.-See Also-KBA: 2763883 - Incorrect Tax Code and Tax Country Defaulted in Supplier Invoice for Service Item-Keywords-Tax Country; Tax Code; Purchase Order; Supplier Invoice; Supplier; Recipient; Ship-to; Address; Site; Company

Title: Unassigned tasks related to shopping carts of an employee who left the organisation
Content: Symptom-If you have actions to be taken on Shopping carts of an employee who left organisation.-How to assign shopping cart to a different employee.-Unable assign the shopping cart task to an Employee under Application and User Management work center-> Business task management.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the Task Distribution view-Go to the Shopping Cart Management view-Select the relevant Shopping Cart ID and select Assign To-Search for desired employee and Save-See Also-2675644 - Error Appears While Trying to Assign the Shopping Cart to Another Employee-Keywords- Shopping cart, shopping cart management,

Title: Statistical Forecast is Incorrect for Product with Forecasting Model as Average
Content: Symptom-For periods without requirements at the start of the historical horizon, the calculation does not take place using the number of periods in the horizon but only as of the first period with demand. This will shorten the number of periods for the average value.-Example: Product A has forecast from Jan to Dec. Therefore the  historical horizon  is 12 months.-Say there is one-time consumption 5 pcs in Oct.  Monthly average for the forecast is calculated incorrectly as 5/3 = 1.667pcs/period.-Ideally Correct value is 5/12 = 0.417pcs/Period-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Demand Planning workcenter and Demand Plans view.-2. Find Demand Plan ID XX(where XX is the Demand Plan ID) and Plan.-3. Filter by product A(where A is the product)-You will notice that Statistical Forecast is 1.667 for the next Planning Horizon period.-Cause-Flag for Ignore Leading Zero(s) field is selected hence system ignores the periods without requirements until the first requirement in Oct month.-Resolution-To resolve the above error follow the below steps:-1. Go to Demand Planning workcenter and Demand Plans view.-2. Find Demand Plan XX and Edit.-2. Select Process Settings Tab and Forecasting Models subtab-3. Uncheck the flag for Ignore Leading Zero(s) field.-Keywords-Statistical Forecast, Average, Horizon, Planning, Leading, zero,Forecasting Models, Requirement

Title: Error message:Enter a product ID, product category, or G/L account for item 1.1; see Cost Distribution Details
Content: Symptom-While creating Supplier invoice you would get this error .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Since these fields are used to determine the financial postings details like GL account, so one of them is mandatory.-Resolution-So as per the error message, you must enter one of the fields-Keywords-tax code not determined purely based on supplier master data, why does the system ask for Product Id or category or GL account

Title: Unable to Edit Resource Capacity Unit of Measure (UoM)
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit the Resource Capacity UoM on existing Resource records, but the field is read-only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search and open the fine-tuning activity for Labor Resources.-Select a resource.-Click Edit.-The Resource Capacity UoM field remains read-only.-Cause-The Resource Capacity UoM is only writable during creation of the Resource master data. As with UoM fields on other master data types (Products, Services), it cannot be changed after the initial value is saved.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Resource Capacity UoM, Edit, Labor Resources

Title: Unable to select the Goods and Service Receipt Expected
Content: Symptom-Unable to select the Goods and Service Receipt Expected flag-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Go to Item tab.-You can see the Goods and Services Receipt Expected flag is selected.-Cause-Because the Goods and Service Receipt Expected Manual Change Not Allowed flag is selected-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Overview.-Select Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings.-Select the Item Type XYZ (material, expense) and Process Type (Direct, Non-Stock, To-Stock).-Disable the column Goods and Service Receipt Expected Manual Change Not Allowed.-Keywords-Goods and Service Receipt. Purchase Order.

Title: How to Delete a Standard Field from the Supplier Invoice Screen?
Content: Symptom-You have created supplier invoice from supplier invoice template screen, and you want to have entered cost center as the account assignment type.-Since you do not use G/L account option, you want to delete this option from the supplier invoice screen.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view: New Invoice Template-Enter the necessary fields and set account assignment type as Cost Center-You do not want to use the G/L account option under account assignment type and hence you want to delete this option-But you are not able to delete this field-Cause-You cannot delete any standard field from the system.-Resolution-As a work-around, you can go to Adaptation mode and then hide a particular field and publish the changes to stop users from seeing this field.-Keywords-Adaptation Mode, Delete standard field, Supplier Invoice, Account Assignment Type

Title: Identified Stock ID is not Displayed in Production Task Datasource
Content: Symptom-Identified Stock ID is not displayed in Production Task datasource or in report created based on this datasource.-# is displayed for Identified Stock ID in the Production Task datasource.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics workcenter and Data Source view-2. Find Production Task data source and Preview-3. In the report select production order 999 and Task ID 888 (where 999 is the production order ID and 888 is the Task ID)-4. Select relevant fields like identified stock , input product, output product-you will notice that identified stock id is displayed as #-Cause-The Identified Stock ID field in the report is mapped to the Input Product's Identified Stock ID not the Output Product.-Therefore it is not displayed in the data source.-Resolution-There is no other datasource that provides the information related to Identified Stock ID of the Output Product.-There is a workaround to find this information using webservice.-When we input Production Lot ID's to the webservice, It returns us with the tasks details which will have Istock values as well.-Keywords-Production task, Identified Stock, Input Product, Output Product

Title: Error appears while approving  Count Physical Inventory Item
Content: Symptom-You are tryiing to approve Count Line item Id XX , Status of the Line item id  is "Counted", Error appears-Product ID DEF serial number KLM cannot be received; issued to cost center -*XX refers to Count Line item Id, DEF refers to Product Id, KLM refers to Serial Number id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Physical Inventory Work Center-Go to By PI Count Item View-In Counted PI items Search for XX-Select on Approve Count -Error appears-Cause-As Serial Number KLM Tagged Inventory Status shows as  "Issued to Cost Center" , you would not be able make use of this serial Number, To know how to check the Tagged Inventory Status of Serial Number, Follow the below steps-Navigate to Service Entitelements Work Center-Go to Registered Products View-Search for  KLM-Navigate to General Tab (If Tagged Inventory Status not visible,you can personalize the screen and add this field)-Resolution-As Serial Number KLM is issued to Cost Center, Kindly make use of those some other serial numbers which are In Stock.-Keywords-Product ID  serial number  cannot be received; issued to cost center,Error appears while approving  Count Physical Inventory Item

Title: Error "Mark Description: missing key relationship for the following values" during migration of bills of operation
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Bills of Operation using the migration tool, however the system triggers an error in the validation step:-"Mark Description: missing key relationship for the following values"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open the activity Migration of Bill of Operations.-Open the Migration tool.-Select the migration file.-Click on Execute Migration.-Click on Step by Step.-In the validation step, the error is raised.-Cause-In the migration template sheet "Operation and Mark details", Branch ID and Sequence ID fields are filled with the same value as of the Mark ID and Operation ID fields.-The purpose of Branch and Sequence is to create an alternative path and simultaneous production path respectively.-Resolution-Remove the data for fields Branch ID and Sequence ID.-Keywords-Template, Excel, Tab

Title: You are Not Able to Add a Business User as an Approver in the SAP Business By Design System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:All details combined into one KBA 2344117 - Employee Not Visible in Direct Approver List ,cause they have same cause and solution except the document is different.-You have maintained all the necessary access rights for the user in the system. However, when you are trying to add the user as an approver under Approval process, system does not show the user name in the drop-down list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view Task Distribution & select Approval Process-Go to any approval process e.g. Purchase Order Approval Process-Copy the existing approval process and navigate to Direct Approvers step-Select Work Distribution and Edit-Search for respective user-No records found-Cause-The "Validity From/To" date is incorrectly maintained (previous date) in the Application and User Management-> Business Users list.-This issue can happen when you terminate/rehire a user and even though you maintain the dates correctly in personnel administration later, it is not updated in the Business Users view under Application and User Management work center.-Resolution-Kindly update the "Validity From/To" date correctly in Application and User Management-> User and Access Management->Business Users list view to resolve this issue.-Keywords-Validity From/To date, validity period, access rights, managing my area, approver not found

Title: Blocked/Obsolete Supplier is used in Purchasing Documents
Content: Symptom-The Supplier account is blocked/obsolete however it still being used in Purchasing Documents such as Purchase Orders and Supplier Invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The Supplier was set as Blocked or Obsolete by following the steps below:-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Search and Select respective supplier.-Click in Edit button.-Click In Change status button.-Choose 'Blocked' or 'Obsolete'.-Save it. -However when creating a Supplier Invoice or Purchase Order, the Supplier account can still be used.-Cause-There can be two reasons:-Cause 1: -When creating a manual Supplier Invoice, if an user forces the entry of the blocked Supplier ID, the system will triggers an warning message such as:-"Ship-from location with ID ABC blocked"-"Party Payee with ID ABC"-This warning message will inform the user that the supplier ABC is blocked. However it will not stop the creation of the Supplier Invoice with the blocked Supplier ABC.-Cause 2: -There is recurring invoice run that is still active:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Recurring Invoices view.-Use the filter "Active Recurring Invoices".-Search for Supplier ABC.-Navigate to Invoice History Tab.-The system has kept on creating Supplier Invoices for Supplier ABC after the date on which this Supplier was blocked. So, to stop the system to create new recurring supplier invoices with this blocked supplier, it is advised to click "Block" from this Recurring Invoice run.-Resolution-When a Supplier is Blocked/Obsolete, the system raises warning messages instead of error messages.-That's because there may be open documents (such as Invoices and Delivery documents) that may still need to be processed. Or even Purchase Orders in Sent status. If error messages were created in such cases, the user wouldn't be able to edit or create those documents.-That's why an warning message is triggered instead.-So it is up to the user to either create the document for a blocked Supplier even if the warning message is triggered OR to not create it.-If you want to change the behavior you can reach out to your implementation partner to eveluate the feasibility of achieving this via a custom Add-On (PDI).-Keywords-Recurring Invoice Run, Supplier Invoice, Obsolete Supplier, Blocked supplier

Title: Unable to Use Print Feature in Project Management
Content: Symptom-Unable to Use Print Feature in Project Management-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Search and select any project.-Click the Edit button and select Project Plan.-Go to the Gantt Chart subtab.-Click the Print button.- Project is comming unformatted in the PDF file.-Cause- Currently, the printing functionality is not available for Projects in ByDesign.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can download the project in Microsoft XML format and use an external tool for printing. There are a couple of project viewers that accept this format and may offer a printing capability.-Keywords- Project Management, Printing, Project

Title: Error Message "Enter a Customer" When Creating a New Registered Product
Content: Symptom-Error messages "Enter a Customer" and "Save Failed" are thrown when trying to create a new registered product.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Installed Base work center.-Go to the Registered Products view.-Click in Create.-Maintain fields but field Customer.-Click in Save.-Error messages "Enter a Customer" and "Save Failed" are thrown.-Cause-Currently the Customer field is mandatory when creating new Registered Products.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.--If this feature/functionality is required urgently, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.

Title: Plan Production Availability Date Outside Site Working Hours
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Production Planning Proposal, the system is considering Site Calendar for the Availability Date and Time, Instead of Resource Calendar.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Open New Planning Proposal under common task.-Enter the relevant Product and Planning Area details.-Enter an Availability Date and Time on which the Production Resource is available, but the Site is not working.-Choose Save.-The system automatically changes the Availability Date and Time according to the Site calendar.-Cause-The Resource Calendar checkbox is not selected in the master data of the Resource used for production.-When this indicator is not selected, the system does not consider the Resource Calendar for production planning.-Instead system considers the Site Calendar to determine the Availability date and time.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to enable the Resource Calendar checkbox in the Resource master data.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Resources view.-Search and select the relevant Resource ID XYZ used in the Production scenario. (XYZ represents the Resource ID)-Choose Edit.-In the General tab, select the Resource Calendar checkbox.-Choose Save and Close.-Once the Resource Calendar is checked, the newly created Production Proposals consider the Resource calendar instead of Site calendar.-Note: The Resource Calendar indicator cannot be changed if the resource is already used as a Resource Calendar in any released production model.-See Also-2768301 - Resource Calendar is Not Considered In Production Planning-Keywords-Production; Planning; Availability Date; Availability Time; Site Calendar; Planning Proposal; Resource Calendar; Supply Planning; Planning Area; Site; Checkbox; Resource

Title: Description is not Displayed in New Invoice Screen for Limit Item
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order with limit items. Now you are trying to create a supplier invoice for the limit item, but the limit item description is not showing up in the invoice screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoice and Credit Memos-Select view: Invoice Entry-Search for the purchase order with limit item-Here you can see the product description in the OWL screen-Now Select New Invoice-The product description field is empty-Cause-The supplier invoice expects the actual items to be invoiced from the delivery document i.e. goods and service receipt for limit items so that they are posted to the correct ledgers and before the delivery documents are created, these actual items for limit purchase order are not known.-Resolution-For limit items, please create a delivery document and then create invoice with reference to the delivery document. Then the number of goods receipt items will correspond to the items of the invoice.-Keywords-goods receipt, limit PO, limit items, product description, delivery document

Title: Cancelled Delivery Requests are still showing as Requested Cancellation in Outbound Logistics - Overview screen
Content: Symptom-You see Cancelled Delivery Requests  in Overview screen of Outbound Logistics as "Delivery Requests with Requested Cancellation" although corresponding  Outbound Delivery is cancelled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Delivery Work Center-Navigate to Overview View-On the Tile Delivery Control: Delivery Requests-Select Delivery Requests with Requested Cancellation-Outbound delivery requests listed in the table are in Requested Cancellation although Delivery Requests Cancellation Status are in "Cancelled" Status and corresponding Outbound Delivery is cancelled-Cause-As  corresponding Outbound Warehouse Requests  of Delivery Requests are not rejected, Delivery Requests are still showing up as  Requested Cancellation.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, Follow the below steps,-Navigate to the Outbound Delivery Work Center-Navigate to the Overview View-On the Tile Delivery Control: Delivery Requests, Select on Delivery Requests with Requested Cancellation-A table of Delivery Requests with Requested Cancellation is shown-Select Delivery Request and Select Edit -Navigate to Document Flow-Select the corresponding Warehouse Request of Outbound Delivery Request-Select Edit Outbound Warehouse Request-Select Reject Request -Select Save-Keywords-Canceled Delivery Requests  in Overview screen of Outbound Logistics as "Delivery Requests with Requested Cancellation", Delivery Requests with Requested Cancellation

Title: Goods receipt approval process not working as expected
Content: Symptom-Goods receipt going for approval though the conditions are not met-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If condition used in the approval process is :Account assignment different from PO-Then you have changed the name of Project task or Project itself  before creating goods receipt and after the Purchase order was  created.-Resolution-If you wish system to change this behavior like mentioned below:-1.Not to consider project name if the project task is used  in the account assignment-or-2.Consider project ID or project task ID rather than name-Please submit your  requirements on Customer Influence Forum at below link-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also- 1947478 - Huge list of Persons Responsible Determined for an Approval Task-Keywords-Account assignment different from PO, approval condition not met,

Title: Error While Creating NewEngineering Change Order
Content: Symptom-Unable to create new Engineering Change Order (ECO) due to error message - ECO ID must not be greater than the value entered-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-Go To Common Tasks -> New Engineering Change Order-Enter the ECO Type & ID-At this point, system throws error message 'ECO ID must not be greater than the value entered'-Cause-The ECO ID was greater than 500000000000.  The ECO ID should be smaller than 500000000000.-Resolution-The ECO ID should be between  '1' to '499999999999' (both inclusive).-Keywords-ECO ID, Engineering Change Order, Planning and Production Master Data

Title: Project Invoice Request Preview Not Working
Content: Symptom-Project Invoice Request Preview Not Working-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Invoice Preparation view.-Go to Project Invoice Requests subview.-Show All Project Invoice Requests and find the project invoice request ID to be preview.-Choose the Preview button here you can see preview doesnot generates.-Cause-Sender/Supplier country form template is missing.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance.-Choose the customer invoice template.-Select the Country same as sender/supplier country.-Keywords-Project invoice request-preview doesnot work-customer invoice

Title: Obsolete Fields Show In List of Field Values - Field selection In Routing Rules
Content: Symptom-While creating Routing Rules a number of obsolete field values are observed.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The same behaviour can be observed in other rule-sets.-Go to the Activity Planner work centre.-Go to the Routing Rules view.-Open any.-Navigate to the Conditions facet.-Click Add or edit.-Expand the list for 'Field'.-Actual Result:  you see many entries which are marked as 'obsolete'.-Cause-The dropdown shows the Obsolete values, (<name>- obsolete) and this is the standard behavior.--However, when obsolete value is selected, it results into error, preventing user from selecting this obsolete values.-Resolution-These values in the dropdown are populated during the system runtime, and as these fields might still be used by some few customers before they become obsolete, we will not be removing them from the list but mark them as Obsolete and prevent any new usage of the same.-Keywords-old fields, visible, cannot delete, list value

Title: Error Messages Appear While Performing A Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-You have defined the material flow rule for a Warehouse Location (Logistics Area) with the Source Determination based on the type Minimum Movements. You created a Sales Order and tried to post Goods Issue against this Demand. However, when you click the Post Goods Issue button, the system shows several warning messages and it does not propose a Source Logistics Area even though you have enough quantity of the Material in several Logistics Areas.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Delivery Proposals view.-Find the relevant Sales Order and select the corresponding Delivery Request.-Click the button Post Goods Issue.-In the Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue window, you can see the following warning messages triggered:-Action processed with warnings.------> Determination of source inventory failed for product XYZ (XYZ represent the Product ID).-----------> Inventory in logistics area not available.-Cause-You are getting the error messages while doing Post Goods Issue, because you have not maintained the relevant Logistics Area as Inventory Managed.-Resolution-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center and then to the Locations view.-Now expand the relevant Site and then select the Line Item for the affected Location and choose the Edit Layout button.-In the new screen, select the relevant Logistics Area and then in the General tab, you can find the field "Inventory-Managed".-Mark this checkbox and then select the Save button.-Now this Logistics Area becomes Inventory Managed and you can carry on the Post Goods Issue.-See Also-Keywords-Material Flow Rules, Post Goods Issue, Inventory Managed

Title: Sorting of Line Item ID is Not Working As Expected For Adjustment Confirmation
Content: Symptom-For Adjustment Confirmations, when you click on Sort Ascending on field Line Item ID, the order is like 1, 10, 11...19, 2, 20...;-And it is not the order you expect, your expected order is in ascending order of number, like 1, 2, 3, 4, 5...10,11...-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center- Click on Monitoring - By Warehouse Order view.- Highlight one Warehose Order and click on button "Edit".- Click on button "Adjustment Confirmation".- Sort Ascending on field Line Item ID-You find it is sorted like 1, 10, 11...19, 2, 20...; Instead of in ascending order of number.-Cause-Field Line Item ID is a set of characters instead of number.-Thus, when you sorting Line Item ID, it is NOT following ascending order of number.-Resolution-It is the system behavior.-The order of Line Item ID is in ascending order of characters.-Keywords- Sorting, Line Item ID, Characters

Title: Individual material XYZ does not exist or is invalid
Content: Symptom-While saving the Purchase Order system throws an error message as Individual material XYZ does not exist or is invalid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When the user cancels the item the system will try to mark the individual material XYZ as Obsolete.-But if the same individual material used for the other items  the system throws an error "Individual Material XYZ is either Obsolete or Blocked" occurred while saving the purchase order.-Resolution-Before canceling the item remove the individual material for an item by clicking 'Remove Individual Material' and then cancel the item.

Title: System Dumps While Creating Warehouse Request for Delivery Proposal or Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create Warehouse Request out of a Delivery Proposal or an Inbound Delivery Notification,you observe the system loads for some time and dumps in the User Interface(UI).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics/Inbound Logistics Work Center-Go to the Delivery Proposals/Inbound Delivery Notification View-Search and select the relevant Delivery Proposals/Inbound Delivery Notification-Click Create Warehouse Request-The system dumps in the UI with the "500 Internal SAP Error"-Cause-You have not maintained Form Template Selection Rule for the form group 'Move Lists' for the operation type related to (Pick/Put-away),while in the relevant Logistics Model you have maintained Automatic Task Printing on Creation.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, please kindly follow the below path to maintain the Template Selection Rule:-Navigate to the Application and User Management Work center-Go to the Input and Output Management view and select Form Template Selection-In the dropdown for Show Rules For: Select 'Move Lists'-Create New Rules for all the required template codes-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-APSLT_REQ_SLT_EXEC_FOR_OUTPUT, 500 Internal SAP Error, System dumps while creating warehouse request,System Dumps While Creating Warehouse Request for Delivery Proposal

Title: Difference in Recorded Hours between Timesheet and  Not invoiced time and expenses
Content: Symptom-For example you entered 8.45 hours in time sheet but 8.75 hours appears in Not invoiced time and expenses view of a project and a specific employee time confirmation.-Also after you release the time entry, 8.75 appears for field Quantity in time entry as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You enter hours and minutes in time sheet and that has to be converted to only hours in time an expenses which can be used in various documents like invocing for calculation of  amount.-For example 08:30 hours in time sheet means 8 hours and 30 mins which will be converted to 8.5 hours.-Cause 8*60 mins +30 mins =480+30= 510 minutes and 510 mins is converted to 8.5 in hours.-Resolution-So what you enter in Time sheet is Time and what appears in Not invoiced time and expenses view is Quantity-Keywords-Hours not matching, many decimals in hours

Title: Error : Authorization role missing for Service
Content: Symptom-Error appears while uploading Purchase order using a Business user in SOAP UI but no error when uploading supplier invoice using Business user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In general web services are meant to be used with Technical user maintained in the communication arrangement.-In some cases like for example Supplier invoice we have provided a Import from Excel feature. This Import from excel uses the same Web service operation and since Import from Excel can be done only by a business user these web services are allowed to use technical users as well as business users.-In case of the PO web service the import from excel of PO uses a different operation ManagePurchaseOrderExcelUpload so access to allow business users has been given only to this operation and not to the ManagePurchaseOrderInMaintainBundle operation.-Resolution-Kindly use the User maintained in the communication arrangement to avoid the error,We can take this as a requirement and allow business user access to Purchase order web service  even if they are not maintained in communication arrangement in a future release.- Please submit this requirement on Customer Influence Forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-error in soap UI

Title: You Cannot Change the Downtime Flag and the Overtime Flag in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-In Resource Deviation Code activity, you are trying to change the Downtime Flag and the Overtime Flag. However, the check boxes are grayed out and cannot be changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Find the activity Resource Deviation Code.-Open the activity Resource Deviation Code.-Click Assign a Resource Deviation Code.-Notice that the Downtime Flag and the Overtime Flag are grayed out and cannot be changed.-Cause-This is currently a system limitation, you cannot change the Downtime Flag and the Overtime Flag.-Resolution-This limitation will be fixed in a future release.-Keywords-Greyed-BC-Activity

Title: Project Manager is unable to View Time Recording Approval Task for Service Agent
Content: Symptom-The service agent has entered timesheet with respect to project task and released it. The timesheet status shows "In Approval". However, project manager is not able to view this task under Managing My Area-> Approvals view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center-Select view Approvals-There is no task for the service agent time recording approval in this view -Cause-The project time recording approval is not mapped to Managing My Area-> approvals work center.-The time recording approval with respect to project is visible only under Project Management->Approvals-> Time Recordings view.-Resolution-Please go to the above view and select the respective time recording and there you can select approve /reject option.-Keywords-Project Time Recording, Timesheet Approvals, service agent timesheet

Title: Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery Notification Closed With Partial Quantity
Content: Symptom-You have posted goods receipt for the stock transfer Inbound Delivery Notification XXX with a partial quantity, the Inbound Delivery Notification is closed and you cannot post goods receipt for the remaining quantity.-XXX = Inbound Delivery Notification ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Find the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Click Post Goods Receipt button.-Enter the Actual Quantity (less than the Planned Quantity).-Click Save and Close.-Notice that the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX is already Received and you cannot receive the remaining quantity.-Cause-In stock transfer scenario, when you release the Outbound Delivery for the full quantity, the Inbound Delivery Notification is automatically created for that quantity. If the Outbound Delivery and Inbound Delivery Notification are created for the full quantity, the Ship-From location has delivered the full quantity. Hence it is expected that you receive what was delivered, in this case only one Inbound Delivery is expected for the Inbound Delivery Notification, so the first Inbound Delivery created will close the Inbound Delivery Notification.-Resolution-As only one Inbound Delivery is expected, the system is working as designed.-Keywords-Post Goods Receipt, Inbound delivery Notification, Closed, Stock Transfer, Partial Quantity, Disabled,Inbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery, Full quantity

Title: Custom Form Templates are missing
Content: Symptom-Few users are not able to view the Custom Form Templates that are created by Business user .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and user management work center-Go to form template maintenance view-You would see only standard templates and not those created by affected user-Cause-You are a development user(because you have access to Partner development work center) and this will not allow you to have access to KUT or user maintained details.-Resolution-Kindly use users (key user or normal  Business user) .-Keywords-partner development, form template missing, custom templates

Title: Error appears when you enter Bar Code Input manually while creating Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-While creating  Inbound Delivery from Inbound Delivery Notification you enter Bar code Input Manually, system errors out-Decoding of bar code failed------> Bar code ]C1KLM does not contain a valid application identifier------> Bar code KLM decoding failed-*KLM refers to parameters entered manually-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center- Navigate to Inbound Delivery Notifications View- Search and Select the relevant Inbound Delivery Notification- Select Post Goods Receipt- Under Sub tab Bar code Input enter parameters manually and click enter- Error appears  as stated above-Cause-As the parameter entered manually is not according to the format as per the system expectation-Resolution-In order to resolve the error, Kindly follow the Application Identifier format  as per scoping in Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128.-To solve the error, follow the below steps- Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center- Navigate to Inbound Delivery Notifications View- Search and Select the relevant Inbound Delivery Notification- Select Post Goods Receipt- Under Sub tab Bar code Input enter parameters in this format 91DEF]C13002]C195EA, (91 refers to Product ID AI(Application Identifier) *DEF refers to product id, C1 refers to  delimiter, 30 refers to Quantity AI, 02 refers to quantity, 95 refers to Unit of Measure AI, EA refers to Unit of Measure.-Keywords-Decoding of bar code failed, Bar code KLM decoding failed, Bar code does not contain a valid application identifier

Title: How is Log on language determined for Business users uploading documents via excel
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know what will be log on language of users while uploading documents via excel-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-For the business user who is uploading the documents, the log on Language is maintained under Regional Settings.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the User and Access Management view-Go to the sub view Business Users-Select the relevant Business User-Select Edit and Edit Attributes-Go to the Regional Settings section-Change the Language to the relevant one-Select Save and Close-See Also-  2735797 - Product Description appearing empty or wrong in any purchasing documents -Keywords-Product Description Missing, product description missing in supplier invoice; item description missing during supplier invoice upload,log on language of Business user

Title: Update Storage Control Profile for Multiple Logistics Areas
Content: Symptom-You want to update value in Storage Control Profile field for multiple logistics areas.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Locations view.-Select the relevant Site or Location and choose the Edit Layout button.-In the edit layout screen you do not see an option to perform mass change on logistics areas and update the Storage Control Profile value.-Cause-This activity can be done through the Update Layout option.-Resolution-You can follow the below given steps to update Storage Control Profile in mass.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Locations view.-Select the relevant Site or Location and choose the Edit Layout button.-Choose an inventory managed Logistics Area in the top of the hierarchy for which you need to update the Storage Control Profile in mass.-Select the Update Layout button and choose the option Update Child Logistics Areas.-In Enter Parameters window, choose the Storage Control Profile ID you need to update for the logistics areas in the hierarchy and select the Ok button.-Save and Close the edit layout screen.-Keywords-ByD mass update logistics area, mass change storage control profile, update storage control profile for multiple logistics areas, mass change in logistics area profile, Mass change blocked for putaway

Title: Purchase Order Interactive Forms not Working
Content: Symptom-You have sent purchase order via interactive forms however the interactive form is not active for modifications.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and navigate to Output History tab-Select the link Purchase Order (Interactive) -The fields are not editable to accept or reject the order-Cause-For receiving PO Acknowledgments by Interactive Form, the output channel should be E-Mail. However you have sent the purchase order via Printer. Hence the fields were not editable. At Output Details tab, choose Purchase Order (Interactive) in Template Name and E-Mail in Send By, and fill in the e-mail addresses as required under E-mail Settings. When you order a purchase order and the status of the purchase order is Sent, the supplier receives an e-mail with the attachment Purchase Order Interactive.-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and select you can also link-Edit Output Settings for Create/Change PO-Select the template - Purchase Order (Interactive) / Changed Purchase Order (Interactive)-Select the Send by channel as E-Mail-Enter the E-Mail address -A supplier receives a purchase order as an interactive form and returns the corresponding PO acknowledgment electronically. This way fields are editable mode and you accept or reject the deviations.-Keywords-Purchase Order Interactive Forms not Working; Cannot accept PO via interactive form; Interactive form not active

Title: Content Error in 3PL Business Communication: "Missing parameter RecipientParty", "Invalid Internal ID"
Content: Symptom-You are using a Third Party to manage your Warehouse and have set up a Communication Arrangement to enhance communication between your system and that of your Warehouse Provider.
