However, when your Warehouse Provider sends an Inbound Message of the type "Process Inbound Delivery Execution Confirmation" to your ByD system to create and confirm the Inbound Delivery, the system does not process the message and triggers a content error. If you open the Message Details, the system shows the following message:  "Missing parameter RecipientParty", "Invalid Internal ID".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Go to Common Tasks and select Business Communication Monitoring.-If you filter for Business Document: Inbound Delivery, Operation: Process Inbound Delivery Execution Confirmation, you can see the relevant Incoming Message with the status Content Error.-Select the Message and go to the General tab.-You can see the Status Information: Errors reported by application: "Invalid Internal ID", "Error while processing inbound B2B communication".-Go to the Message Details tab.-You can see also: Missing parameter RecipientParty, Invalid Internal ID.-And if you go to the History tab, you can also see the information: Errors reported by application: "Invalid Internal ID", "Error while processing inbound B2B communication".-  Cause-The system cannot determine the Sender of the Message as the SenderParty information is missing in the Payload and you have also not maintained Identification information in the Business Partner Master Data of the Warehouse Provider.-If the SenderParty information is not sent in the IDEC (Inbound Delivery Execution Confirmation) payload Message Header section, then the system tries to identify the sender of the message based on the user specified for IDEC Inbound Service in the Communication Arrangement for Third-Party Logistics Integration with your Warehouse Provider.-However, in this scenario, for the system to correctly determine the Sender Party, some identification information, for example Data Universal Numbering System ID (DUNS) or Global Location Number (GLN) must be maintained in the Warehouse Provider's Business Partner master data. And if this is not available, the system returns the error "Invalid Internal ID".-About the other error message, "Missing parameter RecipientParty", this refers to the missing RecipientParty in the Message Header section of the payload. This is however a warning, not an error.-Resolution-You can either maintain valid identification in the master data as mentioned above, or ensure your Warehouse Provider includes the SenderParty information in the payload itself.-See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2017/06/15/documentation-on-idec-inbound-delivery-execution-confirmation/-Keywords-Invalid, Internal ID, Error, inbound, B2B, communication, Content, Inbound, Delivery, Execution, Confirmation, IDEC, 3PL

Title: Delivery status is 'Not delivered' though Goods and service Receipt is available
Content: Symptom-There is difference in Delivery status appearing in Purchase orders OWL and Invoice entry OWL.-Delivery Status and Invoice Status at Purchase Order-Delivery Status and Invoice Status at invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-After the Goods and Service receipt is created and saved(where status is In preparation) for entire quantity of the Purchase order then,-System shows the Delivery status as "completely delivered" which can be seen when you follow below steps:-Go to purchase order work center-Go to purchase orders-Show all purchase order-Search for respective Purchase order and select it-You will see delivery status in the column appearing in the table itself.-but system shows the Delivery status as "Not delivered" which can be seen when you follow below steps:-Go to Supplier invoicing-Go to invoice entry-Show All orders or Orders to be invoiced-Search for respective Purchase order and select it-You will see delivery status in the column appearing in the table itself.-The behavior is not same with supplier invoice,i.e if the invoice is saved(status is In preparation)then  Invoice status appears as "Invoiced"in both steps mentioned above.-Cause-At purchase order side in general as and when you create a goods receipt(for entire quantity of the Purchase order ) and save then it means you will not create any more goods receipts and thus system shows the Delivery status as "completely delivered".-At Invoice side in general it will have the reference of Goods receipt under the Cost distribution tab and if there is Goods receipts in status In preparation then an exception is raised in supplier invoice. Thus for system to raise exception system shows the Delivery status as "Not delivered" .-Resolution-Ensure the Goods and service receipt is Posted and then supplier invoice is also posted.- or- Accept the exception in the Supplier invoice and Post it, later ensure Goods and service receipt is Posted.-Keywords-Delivery status delivered,item delivery status, item invoice status, purchase order, purchase order status, delivery status, invoice status, status incorrect, delivery status incorrect, invoice status incorrect

Title: Error message "Item not consistent" appears while performing Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order
Content: Symptom- You are trying to perform Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order DEF (refers to Warehouse Order id) for a Returns Pick task, Error appears upon saving.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-By Warehouse Order View-Search for DEF -Select Adjustment Confirmation-Click on Enable Entry, Update the quantity difference in negative value-Click on Save-Error appears-        Item not consistent-       Save failed-       Location KLM is not maintained as ship-from location-Cause-As User has changed Source Logistics Area KLM to Obsolete, System is not able to identify Logistics area as it is marked as Obsolete. *KLM refers to Logistics Area Id-Resolution-You will have to change the Status of Logistics Area KLM to Active and then once the adjustment confirmation is completed you can change it to obsolete.-Keywords-Item not consistent, Location  is not maintained as ship-from location

Title: Sorting Of Run ID Not Working As Expected In Mass Data Runs
Content: Symptom-RUN IDs are not sorted ascending or descending as expected in Mass Data Runs-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-Go To Automated Actions View-Select Production Bills Of Material Mass Maintenance subview-Select All Runs -> Choose Column 'Run ID' -> Sort either Ascending or Descending-Cause-Sorting works on the numeric values only. If the Run IDs are Alpha-Numeric, sorting is not appropriate.-Resolution-Sorting is not applicable in case of Alpha-Numeric IDs. However, there can be others columns which are numeric where the sortings works appropriate.-Keywords-alpha-numeric, sorting, run id, mdr

Title: Wrong tax Code in Inter company Supplier Invoice(country US and DE)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2335218***-You expect a different tax code in the intercompany supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Intercompany Invoice which was created automatically by system based on customer invoice-You can see that Tax Code is wrong-Cause-Always intercompany supplier invoice details will be based on respective customer invoice.-As you know Tax Code = Tax Event + Tax type + TAX Rate Type + tax Deductibility.-Tax event used in customer invoice tax code determination will be used for determining the tax event to be used for determination of tax code of supplier invoice.-Resolution-Check the tax code used in customer invoice and then check the business configuration for respective tax event of that tax code.-Please refer the excel attached that shows standard mappings of tax events of sales side with purchase side tax events.-so check if mapping of tax event is there in the attachment,-If its there then the respective purhcasing tax event is used to determine the tax code in supplier invoice and thus Automatic tax determination flag is not checked in supplier invoice. also the tax country  in supplier invoice will be same as that of  respective customer invoice .-If its not there then system takes all details of the supplier invoice to determine the tax event ,tax country and  then tax code accordingly where you will see that Automatic tax determination flag is checked in supplier invoice.-See Also-  2335218 - Wrong tax Code in Intercompany Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Tax code in supplier invoice is wrong,wrong tax code, wrong tax country, wrong determination of tax

Title: Transport Zone View Missing In Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center
Content: Symptom-User is unable to see Transport Zone view in Supply Chain Design Master Data work center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center -> Transport Zones View missing-Cause-Issue is due to Access Rights. The user is not assigned to Transport Zones View under the Access Rights -> Work Center and View Assignment-Resolution-Transport Zones View should be assigned to the user under Access Rights-Go To Application and User Management Work Center-Go To User and Access Management-Navigate to Business Users -> Select the User -> Edit Access Rights -> Work Center and View Assignment-Assign the Work Center/View ID  SCM_TRANSPORTZONES (Transport Zones) by selecting a checkbox -> Save the changes-Keywords-Transport Zones, Access Rights, Work Center and View Assignment, Supply Chain Design Master Data

Title: Outbound Delivery for Customer Return Not Visible
Content: Symptom-You are using the In-House Repair scenario, and have repaired the Customer Return Product. Now you want to ship it back to the customer and so, from the Customer Return, you requested Outbound Delivery. However, the system did not create an Outbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to the Returns view.-Search for the relevant Customer Return document, select it and choose the Edit button.-In the Edit screen, choose the Request Outbound Delivery button.-After you have performed the above mentioned steps, you expect the system to create the Outbound Delivery, related to the above Return but this is not the case. -Cause-The Outbound Delivery will not be created with the Request Outbound Delivery button selected. The system only initiates the creation of the Outbound Delivery process by creating a new Delivery Proposal. You will have to create the Outbound Delivery from the new Delivery Proposal generated for the Customer Return. This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Delivery Control: Delivery Proposals view.-In the field Show, select Return to Customer Proposals, enter the relevant Return ID in the Find field and choose the Go button.-The system will display the Delivery Request ID which is created against the Customer Return.-Depending on your business settings and requirement, you can now create a Warehouse Request (if you are working with Warehouse Tasks), do a Post Goods Issue (if you are not working with Warehouse Task) or create the Outbound Delivery document by selecting the respective button.-Keywords- Return to Customer Proposals, Request Outbound Delivery

Title: Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create an incident" During Migration of Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The following error message is displayed during Purchase Order migration:-File Validation Failed. Create an incident-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and find the activity Migration of Purchase Orders.-Upload the migration file.-Choose Execute Migration button and choose Step-by-Step option.-Error: File Validation Failed. Create an incident-Cause-There are many causes of this issue. Few causes are given below:-Could be there is missing information in your migration file.-In the Migration Adaptation field, the migration type code should be always numeric.-A Purchase Order with Item Type 2 (Service Item) or 4 (Limit Item) may be migrated without a Product ID or Product Description being maintained for the item.-It is likely that the field Price Unit on the Items tab of the Migration of Purchase Orders file is mistaken to be e.g. a Currency or UOM field. The current value of the field Price Unit is not correct.-The Excel file must not contain more than 35 line items, as this is a system limitation during migration.-Resolution-Respective Action to be taken for above mentioned causes are given below:-At item level either enter value 'X' to To-Stock column or provide Account assignment details.-Enter 1 under Migration Adaptation field or place cursor on the field to see the other options available.-When Item Type is 2 (Service Item) or 4 (Limit Item), either Product ID or Product Description should be supplied, and it is mandatory to have one of them.-The field Price Unit expects a number (generally 1). It indicates the number of product units. This is to specify, for how many eaches/liters/kilograms (or whatever the UoM is) the indicated price applies.-The number of line items must always be kept below 35 in the excel file. If the file contains more than 35 line items split them into two separate files and create a Purchase Order.-If an error still occurs, the migration template details can be used to create a Manual Purchase Order. If incorrect or incomplete information is entered, the respective error will be displayed, which can then be used to correct the migration template details accordingly.-Keywords-Migration of Purchase Orders; Purchase Orders upload; Purchase Orders; Migration Adaptation; Error in migration of purchase order; File validation failed; Create an incident

Title: Project purchase request error message:Enter a valid number
Content: Symptom-In project purhcase request you cannot enter a net price more than 7 digits.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to  Project s view-Search and open the Project-Go to  product tab-Click on new Purchase request-In the pop up screen enter the net price-If you enter like 78475289,00 then you get this error.-Cause-This is limitation as per current ByDeisgn system.-Resolution-we do understand that in normal purchase order and purchase request we allow more than 7 digts and less than or equal to 17 digits, so you contact you partner to see if they can help to achive your requirement by considering what we allow for normal Purchase  order and pruchase request.-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Cloud for Customer/ SAP Business ByDesign.--1.  If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-2.  If you are a customer:-Contact your the Account Executive-Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-        ByD : An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-  Remark : If you received the feedback that PDI Implementation is not possible then only “check the […] Ideas Forum to submit an idea…” is relevant.-Keywords-only 7 numbers allowed, only 7 digits allowed in price,  price cannot exceed seven ,price cannot  cross  7

Title: How to specify Product Details in Limit Purchase Order for Item Type Material?
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order with item type 'Limit', so the process type automatically becomes Direct, and gives option to select only service items under Product ID field but you want to specify a material product id in the limit purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select option: New Purchase Order under Common Tasks view.-Navigate to Items tab and add row.-Select item Type as Limit.-The process type automatically changes to Direct.-Now if you open the value help under Product ID, system gives option to select only Service item and not material.-Cause-The concept of limit item is that it is used when you do not know the details of the product you want, So, system expects you to enter only a description and the limit value. This means that by default limit PO will consider process type as service, so it will look for account determination of service.-When you receive the items, then you can create delivery document where you can specify the item type and based on this selection system will determine the relevant account determination group for postings. The Direct process type is applicable only for service/expense items. Hence, system shows only these items under product id value help in the order.-Resolution-If you want to specify a material in limit PO, ﻿create a PO acknowledgment document where a sub-item can be created for this limit item by clicking the option "Specify Items for Limit". Here, you can specify the details of the material/service items to the limit item. This will be updated in related Purchase Order automatically.-Keywords-Limit Purchase Order, Limit PO, Item Type, Process Type, Acknowledgment, To-stock, Non-stock, Product ID

Title: How to Update Delivery Dates in Purchase Order Automatically?
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order and updated the delivery schedule dates, however, the goods is delivered on a different date and hence, you need to update the purchase order with the correct delivery dates, but you do not want to edit the order multiple times, hence you want to know how the delivery dates can be automatically updated in the order without editing the order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select New Purchase Order option under Common Tasks view-Enter the necessary details and navigate to Items-> sub-tab: Delivery Schedule-Add Row and enter the estimated delivery dates-Select Order-Purchase Order is sent to supplier-Now you receive the goods on a different date than the one mentioned in the purchase order document.-You want to know how the dates can be updated in purchase order without editing again.-Resolution-You can create a Purchase Order acknowledgment where you can enter the delivery dates under the tab Delivery schedule. Then you have to accept deviation, so that the new dates are updated in the related PO document.-If you reject the changes, the purchase order remains unchanged. If you accept the changes, the system updates the purchase order accordingly.-Keywords-Delivery Schedule, Purchase order acknowledgement, delivery dates

Title: Performance Issue enountered while creating Supplier Invoice with respect to Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are experiencing a lag of time while creating invoice for a purchase order, however you are able to create invoice for other purchase orders successfully.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view: Invoice entry-Select "All Orders to be Invoiced"-Search for Purchase Order A (A refers to a Purchase Order)-Select New Invoice-System takes lot of time to load and finally dumps-But you are able to create invoice with other purchase orders-Cause-The purchase order has a different currency A (A refers to order currency) and invoice has currency B (B refers to invoice currency).-This purchase order already has multiple invoices created for different deliveries and each with net value having 5 or more decimal places.-Now when you try to create another invoice, the system needs to check against the Purchase order and ensure that there is no over invoicing.-This leads to a large rounding loop while currency conversion and the rounding loop that occurs is timing out as it continues to round the 5 decimal places causing the time lag.-Resolution-Please do not use decimal places more than 5 since it would cause problem while distributing the cost in supplier invoice (Mostly happens in case of customers using custom currencies allowing multiple decimal places).-Keywords-Rounding difference, performance issue in supplier invoice, time lag, decimal places

Title: Internal comment not shown in the Goods and Activity Confirmation
Content: Symptom-The internal comment maintained at the Line Item level in Scrapping is not displayed in the Goods and Activity Confirmation (GAC).-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Internal Logistics work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view and select Scrapping.-Enter the relevant Site ID and then the relevant Product ID.-Enter the relevant Source Logistics Area ID and click the Next button.-Go to the Line Items tab and select the Notes sub-tab. Enter an internal Comment.-Enter the Quantity to be scrapped.-Click the Next button.-Click the Finish button to create the Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Open the created Confirmation ID. You can see that the Internal Comment maintained is not displayed in the Notes column (you may have to personalize the view to show the Notes column).-Cause-The issue with notes in factsheet items is that they are not displayed directly (as a note can have any number of characters and lines in it).-Instead, what we have is an icon on the item - which gets enabled if a note is maintained against it – and upon pressing this icon, the OIF (Object Instance Floorplan) of the document opens, from where the notes can be read.-However, as GAC does not have an OIF, this approach cannot be followed. This is a Limitation.-To display the internal comments, kindly follow the steps under Resolution below.-Resolution-Navigate to the Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Common Tasks and select 'Display/Reverse Goods and Activity Confirmations'.-Search and select the relevant Confirmation ID.-Select the Line Items tab and the Notes sub-tab and here you can see the Internal Comment displayed.-  Keywords-Scrapping, Notes, Internal Comment, Item, Confirmation, Position, Internes, Kommentar, Verschrottung, Rückmeldung

Title: During Advance Search Deleted Input Product is Displayed for Bill of Material
Content: Symptom-During Advance Search deleted Input Product PROD1 is displayed for Bill of Material BOM1 although Product PROD1 is deleted in Bill of Material BOM1.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter and Production Bills of Material- 2. Open advanced filter enter PROD1 in Input Product ID, click Go- 3. In the result Bill of Material  BOM1 is displayed click Edit- 4. Under the tab Input Products  PROD1 is not displayed.- 5. Select All for Filter Operation, PROD1 is displayed. Also the checkbox for Deleted is marked.-Cause-Although the Input Product is deleted it could still be valid if it is linked to an Engineering Change Order with a non-expiring valid-from date.-Resolution-Bill of Material results cannot be filtered based on the deleted Input Products.-Keywords-Bill of Material, Engineering Change Order, Input Products

Title: Confirm Task Button Disabled For Inspection Document
Content: Symptom-You have received an Inspection for your logistics process and when selecting the Inspection in Quality Control you see that the Confirm Task button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Control work center.-Navigate to the Inspections view.-Search for the relevant logistics inspection and select it.-You can see that the Confirm Task button is disabled.-Cause-There are no Inspection Tasks created for any of the logistics process like Receiving goods from Supplier, Issuing goods to Customer, Stock Transfer. None of these processes are tightly integrated to Inspection and as a result no inspection task will be created. The system will create an Inspection document in which you can record your results. Inspection tasks are created only for Production scenarios as production is integrated fully with inspection via check tasks.-Resolution-You can record your inspection results in the inspection document.-Keywords-Task for logistics process, inspection task confirm grayed out, not able to confirm supplier inspection task, not able to confirm logistics inspection task, ByD, ByD Inspection task confirm error.

Title: Total Demand In Planning Displayed As Zero
Content: Symptom-You see that the total demand for a product in planning screen is displayed as zero even though there is customer demand for the product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Products view.-Search for the relevant Product and Planning Area combination and select it.-Select the Open button.-In the planning screen under Demand Quantities head you can see that there is value against the field Customer Demand.-The Total Demand is displayed as Zero not considering the value in Customer Demand.-Cause-The value you have maintained in the field Demand Management Procedure under the Planning tab of the relevant material master is ADRF - All demand reduce forecast. When the demand management procedure is ADRF the system does not consider the customer demand via sales orders as demand because this might affect the planning. In ADRF the only demand considered is Forecast and Safety Stock. If you want the system to create supply based on only your forecast, which comes via Demand Planning you need to choose this option.-Resolution-The system is working as per the master data settings maintained. If you want the system to consider the customer demand via sales orders in planning to create supply you can change the value in Demand Management Procedure to any value other than ADRF - All demand reduce forecast.-Keywords-ByD ADRF, ByD Planning Error, Planning Error in Business ByDesign, Customer Demand is not considered in Planning, ByD, Planning for customer demand does not create Supply.

Title: Error while Editing Validity for Purchase Order Approval Process:"Enter Start/End time stamp that is later than current time stamp"
Content: Symptom-You have created a new approval process and now you want to activate it. However, when you select "Edit Validity" and enter Valid To/From Date, system throws error:Enter Start/End time stamp that is later than current time stamp.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view: Approval Processes-Copy and Create a New Approval Process and save as Draft-Now select the draft version and select Edit Validity button-Enter the Valid To and Valid From dates-Select Check button-System throws error:"Enter Start time stamp that is later than current time stamp/Enter End time stamp that is later than current time stamp"-Cause-The validity start/end time is not correctly set as per the timezone of the system.-e.g. if it is CST timezone set in the system, check what is the CST time with respect to your current timezone and then set it accordingly.- -You can also change the timezone of your system as per your time zone.-Select the user icon on the top right corner->select My Settings->Regional Settings.-Resolution-Please check the timezone in the system and maintain the time accordingly to avoid this error. Then the dates will be consistent.-Keywords-System Timezone, Edit Validity, approval process validity

Title: Unable to Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-You want to Post Goods Issue for a Product and perform an Outbound Delivery. You are not able to do so, despite you seem to have sufficient On-Hand Stock.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Delivery Proposals view.-Enter the Delivery Proposal ID ABC (ABC represents the Delivery Proposal ID).-Enter the Product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID within the Delivery Proposal).-Click Go.-Select the Delivery Proposal ABC.-Click Post Goods Issue.-You notice the Warning Message "Determination of source inventory failed for product XYZ".-Cause-The warning indicates that the system did not find Available Stock at any of the Locations. It may happen due to Product XYZ having a Safety Stock quantity assigned to it.-Resolution-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Search for Product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-Click the Product link to access its Master Data.-Click View All button.-Go to the Planning tab.-In Planning tab, you will see that there is a Safety Stock quantity set to this Product.-You can set it to a smaller quantity accordingly to the amount you need to perform the Outbound Delivery. Later, you can set it back to the original quantity for Safety Stock.-Keywords-Safety Stock; Outbound Delivery;

Title: Total Tax Amount is zero in Supplier invoice- US and Canada
Content: Symptom-You would open the Supplier invoice and notice that Total Tax Amount is zero though there is tax amount appearing at item level under taxes tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-A Use tax is a type of tax levied in the United States by numerous state governments and Cananda .It is essentially the same as a sales tax but is applied not where a product or service was sold but where a merchant bought a product or service and then converted it for its own use, without having paid tax when it was initially purchased. Use taxes are functionally equivalent to sales taxes. They are typically levied upon the use, storage, enjoyment, or other consumption in the state of tangible personal property that has not been subjected to a sales tax.-Thus the Total tax amount is zero at header level. If you require more information you may contact your financial team and legal team who can help you with country specific taxes explanation.-Resolution-For all those tax codes linked to the tax events 11,12,200 for country US and-For all those tax codes linked to the tax events 122,123,124,126,15,16,20,21 for country Canada.-Expected Behavior in system is that Total Tax amount at the header will be zero and also you cannot enter the tax amount at header manually as it is suppose to be zero as explained above.-See Also-In back end we have linked all above mentioned tax events to respective countries currently to Account tax type "Use Tax"(code is 4),like wise we have another Account tax type "Self-assessed VAT"(code is 5 ) that has same behavior as mentioned in resolution .-However this account tax type has huge list of tax events for many countries and thus I have attached the file under attachments that has all the events and their respective country.-  KBA :1648862 - Tax Code: Domestic Purchase of Freight Services and Domestic Purchase of Self Services Behaviour-Keywords-tax  is zero

Title: Unable to Descope The Question "Do you want to use unique identified stock numbers across the system?" While Creating a New Change Project
Content: Symptom-You would like to descope the question "Do you want to use unique identified stock numbers across the system?" when creating a New Change Project in order to use the same Identified Stock ID for a different product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Configuration. -View Implementation Projects. -Click the New button.-Go to the Review Questions section. -Show All Elements. -Select the scoping element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics. Click the arrow to expand it. -Select Tracking, Tracing and Identification. Click the arrow to expand it. -Select Identified Stock. -Under the Questions for Identified Stock section (on the right hand side of the screen) you will find the question "Do you want to use unique identified stock numbers across the system?". -Cause-The question "Do you want to use unique identified stock numbers across the system?" is protected question, meaning a decision has to be taken at the time of the go-live only and changing the scoping later can lead to inconsistencies in the system because of which the system does not allow this question to be descoped afterwards.-Resolution-As per the standard system behaviour it is not possible to descope the question "Do you want to use unique identified stock numbers across the system?".-Keywords-identified stock, solution-generated, unique numbers, descope, change project,

Title: Label Is Getting Queued Automatically  In The Print Queue Soon After Saving The Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-Label is getting queued automatically in the print queue soon after saving the inbound delivery-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To "Inbound Logistics" Work Center-Go To "Purchase Orders" View-> Search for any PO which is ordered-Enter the necessary details like Notification quantity & Actual quantity under Line Items Tab-Go To Labels Tab -> Select 'Propose Item Label' -> Enter Number of Labels as '1' -> Choose Printer Queue say 'DEFAULT'-Then Click on Save and Close.- Then, To check the Queued Labels,-Go To Application & User Management Work Center-Go To Input & Output Management View -> Print Queues-Queue ID -> DEFAULT ->Edit -> Label for Purchase Order is in the Queue-Cause-Since its a lean model, we do not have explicit option with respect to Post Goods Receipt screen, to not send it to the print queue.-Resolution- We do not have explicit option with respect to Post Goods Receipt screen, to not send it to the print queue.-Keywords-  Post Goods Receipt, Labels Queued, Inbound Delivery

Title: Supplier Invoice wrongly appearing in status Ready for posting in OWL
Content: Symptom-Supplier invoice is in status Ready for posting in OWL but after clicking on check button or try to post ,you see that status changes to exception as there is an exception to be processed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to invoices and credit memos view-Search and select respective Supplier invoice-Supplier invoice is in status Ready for posting in OWL-Click on Edit-Click on check button or try to post-You see that status changes to exception as there is an exception to be processed-Cause-While creating a Supplier invoice what status is there ,the same status will remain until some action is taken on the invoice.-Resolution-Consider an example where duplicate exception is raised. where duplication is due to same external reference ID.-Scenario  1:when many invoices having same external reference ID were created at the same time using external application(like excel or webservice) and there was already one invoice posted with same external reference ID, then all new invoices shall be in status Exception.-Cause the system will check the existing document while creating new document and then set the status accordingly.--Scenario 2:when many invoices having same external reference ID were created at the same time using external application(like excel or webservice) and there was no other invoice  posted earlier with same external reference ID then all new invoices shall be in status Ready for posting.-You can post one of them successfully and there after you will get the above mentioned status issue with all other invoices.-Cause the status was Ready for posting when the document was created and thus it will remain in this status-Some Action has to be taken which will allow system to re-fetch the current details and then change the status accordingly.-Action can even be by just clicking on check button or Post or doing a dummy change.-After clicking on check button or Post you see that status changes to exception and now you can save the document.-Keywords-Same external ID, cannot post the invoice,status changed to exception

Title: MRP run did not create Purchase Proposals
Content: Symptom-You have ran the MRP run for Product DEF and you observe system did not generate any  supply through purchase proposals. *DEF refers to Product Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products View-Search for Product DEF-Open Product Planning Details-Run planning -->Single BoM Level-Cause-System did not generate any additional supply through Purchase Proposals as Total Net Requirement is equal to Zero which is nothing but Total Demand is equal to Total Supply-Resolution-The objective of MRP run is to match Demand and Supply i.e Total Demand equal to Total Supply and  set Total Net Requirement  to Zero.-Keywords-MRP run did not create Purchase Proposals, Objective of MRP run is to match Demand and Supply i.e Total Demand equal to Total Supply and  set Total Net Requirement  to Zero.

Title: Reason for a Difference in Execution Start Date When Requested Delivery Date is Monday Midnight or one Minute Past Monday Midnight
Content: Symptom-You have created a Stock transfer Order and have maintained the Requested Delivery Date to be Midnight on a Monday (dd/mm/yy 00:00). When you perform Availability Check, the system calculates the Execution Start Date to be the Last working Day of your Site Calendar (a Friday). However, when you change the time to one minute past midnight on the same day Monday (dd/mm/yy 00:01), and perform Availability Check again, the system calculates the Execution Start Date of the same day (Monday).-Now you are wondering why the system is behaving this way and want to have an explanation. You also would like to know if there's a way to avoid this behaviour and set a time and date that is not 00:00 by default.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to the Customer Demand view.-Find and select the relevant Stock Transfer Order.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Line Items tab, and then to the General sub-tab.-Change the Requested Delivery Date to a Monday for example: 21.10.2019 00:00 (You can select a date of your choice, but make sure it is a Monday).-Check Availability.-Now navigate to the Line Items tab, and then to the Schedule Lines sub-tab.-You can see the Execution Start Date for the above Requested Delivery Date is 18.10.2019.-Go back to the Line Items tab, and then to the General sub-tab.-Now Change the Requested Delivery Date to: 21.10.2019 00:01.-Check Availability again.-And navigate again to the Schedule Lines sub-tab.-You can see that the system is showing the Execution Start Date of 21.10.2019.-What a difference 1 minute can make.-Cause-During date calculation via ATP check, a value of -1 second and +1 second (known as WriteGI index) is added to the requested execution start date. When the Requested Delivery Date is on a Monday, the previous day is taken into consideration to check if its a holiday. This is done to ensure that the execution doesn't start on a holiday. However, when it is a Tuesday, the previous day will still be a working day, hence Tuesday is proposed.-This is the reason for date variation when requested date is given on a Monday midnight.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-There is no option to default the time but you can change the time manually while creating the Stock Transfer Order, the Sales Order etc.-Keywords-Requested, Delivery, Date, Execution, Start, Date, WriteGI index, Availability, Check

Title: Task -Escalation: Create Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-User receives several of automated tasks notifications in his Home view, with subject "Escalation: Create Purchase Order" or "Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request" and can't turn off the notifications.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Show: Open Tasks.-Click in Go button.-The user can see several taks with this Escalation subject.-Cause-The system raises this escalation task because the due date of the task has been reached and the task is not completed. The system escalates the task because the planned ordering date maintained in the purchase request has been reached. The due date of this tasks in calculated from the Planned ordered date on the Purchase Request. This type of task always has high priority. The due date is always the same day.-Note: The planned ordered date is a calculated field and value of planned ordered date is derived as below:-Get default from supply chain and never change it-Get lead time from purchasing contract if assigned-Get lead time from product if available-Take five days before delivery period start date-Resolution-The task is relevant to the manager working in the operational purchasing org unit maintained in the purchase request or any alternative approver for the operational purchasing org unit or cost center. The relevant manager receives this task in the Inbox subview of the Work view of the Home work center. The alternative approvers receive this task in the Approvals view of the Managing My Area work center.-In case in purchase request you see under Basic details sub tab no purchasing unit is not available, then as a fall back rule system sends the task to all users who has access to Purchase request and order work center.-This fallback behavior to send task to all authorized users done by BTM (Business Task Management). This gets triggered only if we cannot provide BTM with a responsible person. Example Purchasing unit manager is not maintained or Purchasing unit is not maintained in the Purchase Request relevant to the task.-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center.-Got to New Purchase Request common task.-Click on View all button.-Go to Basic tab.-Select a valid Purchasing Unit.-See Also-Task – Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request-Keywords-Automatic, Task, Notification, Purchase Order, Escalation, Purchase Request, Purchasing Unit.

Title: Web Service is Creating an Inconsistent Third Party Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-You are trying tp create an Inbound Delivery Notification using the web service 'ManagestandardinbounddeliveryIn' and you have maintained the XML Request accordingly. However, when you execute the request, a response XML with the following errors/warnings is returned:-The address data is missing.-ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Location ID) and UUID XXX (XXX represents the UUID) differ in Location.-One party with role category End Buyer must be assigned.-One reference document from type Sales Order and item type Sales Item must be assigned.-And the system proceeds to create an inconsistent Inbound Delivery Notification of the type Third Party Order Processing (TPOP). Also, when you open the said Notification and click on the Check Consistency button, the system triggers error messages.--Further, when you create the TPOP Inbound Delivery Notification manually, using the same information as in the web service Request XML, the Notification is created without the inconsistency. Therefore, you would like to understand this difference in the system behaviour.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer view.-Find the web service 'ManagestandardinbounddeliveryIn'.-Select the Service 'ManageStandardInboundDeliveryNotificationIn'.-Maintain the relevant details in the Request XML and execute the web service.-Now go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center, and then to the Third-Party Delivery Notifications view.-Find the newly created Third-Party Delivery Notification.-You can see the Consistency Status is showing as Inconsistent.-If you click on the Check Consistency button, it returns the same messages in the Response XML you get when you executed the Request XML:-a. End buyer is missing.-b. Location XYZ does not exist or is not valid.-c. The address data is missing.-Cause-The web service 'ManagestandardinbounddeliveryIn' can only be used to create Supplier based Inbound Delivery Notifications.-Resolution-To create a TPOP Inbound Delivery Notifications, we recommend to use the web service 'ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn'. You can find the documentation in the Service Explorer under the Application and User Management work center.-Keywords-ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn, ManagestandardinbounddeliveryIn, TPOP, Web, Service, Address, Data, End, Buyer, missing, Location

Title: System triggers error when trying to set up a replenishment rule for Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set up a replenishment rule for Product Based under a Logistics Area KLM for Product DEF, Error appears-Rule for material DEF not valid; conflict with allowed materials (*KLM refers to Logistics Area, DEF refers to Product id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Navigate to Locations View-Search for Site DEF *DEF refers to Site id-Select Edit Layout and select Logistics Area KLM-Navigate to Under Details and Navigate to  Under sub-tab Replenishment and Removal Rules in Product Based Rules-Maintain Product DEF and other parameters-Select Save-Cause-In the tab Allowed Products a different product other than DEF has been maintained, hence you can  set up replenishment rule only for that product.Under allowed products it's  mentioned "You can specify the products that are allowed to be stored in this logistics area. If you do not enter anything on this tab page, all products can be stored in this logistics area."-Resolution-In order to set up replenishment rule for product DEF, you should maintain this product  under allowed products tab and then maintain product based rules.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Navigate to Locations View.-Search for Site DEF *DEF refers to Site id-Select Edit Layout and select Logistics Area KLM-Navigate to sub-tab Restrictions under Details and maintain Allowed Products-Maintain Product DEF and other parameters-Select Save-Keywords-Rule for material DEF not valid; conflict with allowed materials, replenishment rule for Product Based under a Logistics Area

Title: No Way of Editing a Business Task Management Subject
Content: Symptom-You would like to edit a Business Task Management (BTM) task subject or the body of the task e-mail message.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Currently there is no way to edit the subject or body of the business task message.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-As an alternative, you may use a workflow rule (if applicable in your business scenario) to send notification e-mails. This way it is possible to control the e-mail sent by the rule.-You can check the documentation for Workflow Rules in the See Also section of this KBA.-See Also-Workflow Rule Document for Cloud for Customer - Workflow Rule Help Guide.-Workflow Rule Document for Business ByDesign - Workflow Rules Quick Guide-Keywords-BTM, Subject, Body, Business Task Management, Notification, Template, Custom

Title: Invoice Date in Supplier Invoice is Not set Correctly when created via ERS Execution
Content: Symptom-You have created supplier invoice using ERS(Evaluated Receipt Settlements)run , and you are expecting the invoice date to be picked from the delivery document but the Invoice Date in Supplier Invoice is showing different date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view: Evaluated Receipt Settlements-Select the execution ID and check the invoice documents created out of that execution-Open the invoice-The invoice date shows the date same as ERS execution date.-Cause-In current bydesign system, if the supplier invoice is created out of ERS run, the invoice date will be same as per ERS run date.-It will not pick the date from delivery document.-Note: If the invoice is created via the default ERS run with run ID SAP_COMMON, then the time zone of the invoice date takes UTC time; if the invoice is created via ERS run created by user, time zone takes the user time zone.-Resolution-You can change invoice date if you create supplier invoice manually.-Keywords-ERS run, supplier invoice date

Title: The approval task does not show up in the substitute's approval list
Content: Symptom- The approval task does not show up in the substitute's approval list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Here you don't see the delegated approval task.-And-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Substitutions view.-You can see no substitution maintained between two users- or-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Task Substitutions view.-You can see  substitution maintained between two users-Cause-The substitution is not Active.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Task Substitutions view.-Search for Manager A.-Edit substitutions for Manager A.-Select the Activate check box and Save.-See Also- 2282930 - Substitution Manager not Able to View tasks of Actual Manager Under My Managing Area-Keywords-Approval task,Delegation,Substitution, No task

Title: ARCHIVED:Error: "File Validation failed; Create an incident." While Migrating Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-Archived reason:Similar incident raised earlier ,so i will merge the root cause and resolution on to one KBA:2874598 - Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create an incident" During Migration of Purchase Order-During Purchase Order migration you receive below error message.-File validation failed. Create an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to the Overview view-Find and Open the activity Migration of Purchase Orders-Upload the migration file-Select the Execute Migration button and choose the Step by Step option-You receive the error.-Cause-In the Migration Adaptation field the migration type code should be always numeric one (1).-Resolution-Modify the content of the template such that only numeric data is supplied for fields that are specified to be of type Number and proceed with the migration activity.-Keywords-Migration of Purchase Orders, Purchase Orders upload, Migrate Purchase Orders, Purchase Orders-Migration Adaptation

Title: System is Not Creating a BTM Task When the Project Invoice Request is Not Released
Content: Symptom-System is not creating a BTM Task when the Project Invoice Request is not Released.-The Business Configuration activity 'Business Task Management for Project Invoice Request Creation' is added to the Project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing > Project Invoice Requests view.-Search and open the Project Invoice Request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Project Invoice Request).-Go to the Document Flow.-Project Invoice Request is in preparation. No BTM task was created requesting to release the document.-Cause-For the Project Invoice Request ABC, open the related Sales Order, in the 'Pricing and Invoicing' tab and then 'Invoice Schedule' sub-tab. No Invoice Schedule has been maintained, this means that the Project Invoice Request ABC was created manually and for this case, no BTM Task is created.-Resolution-This is the system current behavior. The BTM task will only be created when the Project Invoice Request is created automatically via Invoice Schedule of the Sales Order.-See Also-Help Document: Task — Review and Release Project Invoice Request-Keywords-Project Invoice Request, Invoice Schedule, Business Task Management for Project Invoice Request Creation

Title: Approval task of supplier invoice is not appearing under Managing my area
Content: Symptom-Supplier approval task that is appearing under Business task management view with a person assigned to it ,but that person is not seeing this task in his managing my area work center. or if you want to find why the task is appearing unassigned under Business task management view-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to managing my area work center-Go to approvals view-No task appearing though you see it assigned to you under-Application user management work center-Business task management view -Select the respective task-Cause-The approver does not have the necessary Read and Write access to MMA_Managing my area-> Supplier invoice-Resolution-A.Follow below steps to find why the approval task is not appearing in managing my area of approver:-Go the Application and User Management work center-Go to the Task Distribution view-Select the Business Task Management view-Select  the respective Task and select Determine Assignment button-In the new screen you will see the reason with details about which all access righst to be granted.-Here the mandatory access right is Supplier invoice-B.So follow below steps to assign it:-Go to the Application and user Management work center-Go to the Business Users view-Show All Business Users and find respective User-Select the business user -Choose Edit button and select Access Rights-Navigate to work center and view assignment tab-Search for MMA_MANAGING MYAREA and expand it-Select MMA_SUPPLIER INVOICE and checkmark it-Go to Access Restrictions tab-Search for MMA_SUPPLIER INVOICE-Maintain Read and Write Access as unrestricted-Click on Save-See Also-Part A of the solution can be followed for any other document  that has this problem of task not appearing in the Managing my area or why unassigned task is appearing.-Keywords-Cannot see the task under approvals, not  appearing in mobile but not in managing my area, un assigned task is appearing, task is unassigned

Title: Supplier Invoice is going to "In Approval" status instead of "Posted" when Uploaded via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are using supplier invoice web service to upload and post the invoice directly, however invoices are going for approval instead of getting posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open SOAP UI-Run supplier invoice web service with post action-Now, go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view: Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the invoices created via web service-The invoices created via web service are all in "In Approval" status instead of "Posted" status-Cause-Based on the approval conditions maintained in the system, it will trigger approval for invoices.-Resolution-If approval of Supplier invoice is not needed in web service scenario, there is a finish data entry processing action on Supplier Invoice which is PSM released.-You can use this in PDI to post the invoice and if this action is used, the invoice will not go for approval even if approval conditions are maintained.-Keywords-supplier invoice web service, supplier invoice approval

Title: Purchasing Document Line Item ID and Supplier ID in Customer Demand Field Values are not getting populated
Content: Symptom-You observe fields Purchasing Document Line Item ID and Supplier ID in Customer Demand are not getting populated for Order DEF. *DEF refers to Order Line item id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center-Go to Customer Demand View-Search for Order DEF-You observe Field values of fields Purchasing Document Line Item ID and Supplier ID  are not getting populated.-Cause-'Purchasing Document Line Item ID and 'Supplier ID' field values gets populated only when purchasing comes in picture i.e only in case of Third Party Order(Drop Ship scenarios).--Resolution-For Project Stock Order (PSO) scenario &  Stock Transfer Order (STO) scenario  allocation and consumption happens through internal stock and -PSO & STO is for usage of internal stock, Hence the values  for 'Purchasing Document Line Item ID and 'Supplier ID'  wont populate which is right behavior.-Keywords-Field Values for Fields Purchasing Document Line Item ID and Supplier ID in Customer Demand are not getting populated, Fields Purchasing Document Line Item ID and Supplier ID are not getting populated

Title: Purchase Request is not created out of Project Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-Purchase Request is not created out of Project Purchase Request. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects sub-view.-Search for the relevant project.-Click in Edit button and select Products. -Navigate to Purchase Requests subtab.-Navigate to Document Flow.-The Purchase Request was not created. -Cause-The follow-up documents (Purchase Request and Purchase Order) are not being created because the Project or Project Task is not released yet.-Resolution-Once the Project or the Project Task is released, the system will create the follow-up documents automatically. -Note: the Purchasing Status will be changed to Released as well.-Keywords-Project Purchase Request, Project, Purchase Request, Document Flow

Title: Purchase Order document sent to Supplier multiple times
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order document sent to Supplier multiple times-or -Duplication of Documents sent-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Tasks section and select the Purchase Order.-Find the Purchase Order.-The system shows the Purchase Order Output History sent to multiple times to supplier-Cause-Changes made in Purchase order need to be communicated to supplier.-Resolution-Whenever you add the Note Type Remark for Supplier, system will send the updated document to supplier although the purchase order document status is Sent, Follow-Up Document Created, Invoiced, etc....-Keywords-Purchase order output history,Duplication of the purchase order,Sent to supplier,PO output history

Title: Error: Inventory exist for XXX (YYY) as Custodian Party or Owner Party
Content: Symptom-Unable to mark the status of account as obsolete. An error occurs. Error: Inventory exist for XXX (YYY) as Custodian Party or Owner Party (where XXX is the account ID and YYY is the account name).-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center-Click on Accounts view-Search for the account-Click on Change Status > Obsolete-Message: Inventory exist for XXX (YYY) as Custodian Party or Owner Party.-Cause-If there is an active inventory stock for any of the owner, then it is not allowed to set the status of the account to obsolete.-Resolution-You need to make sure that no inventory exists. It might be that the inventory is externally owned.-If no inventory exists, please create an incident.-Keywords-Mark customer as obsolete, obsolete account, inventory externally owned, no active inventory

Title: Unable to Change The Product Quantity While Confirming Count Tasks
Content: Symptom-You have created a product count for the product ABC (ABC represents the exact ID of the product) that currently does not have any stock available. While you are confirming the task, you want to change the Actual Quantity for the product. However, this is not possible as the respective field is inactive (greyed out).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work center Execution. -View Count Tasks. -Show Count Tasks by Selection and find task XYZ (XYZ represents the exact ID of the task). -Click the Confirm button. -Result: you will see that for product ABC (that is currently not available on stock) the Product Actual Quantity field has automatically proposed a quantity of 0 ea and this cannot be modified as the field is greyed out.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. It is not possible to change or enter any actual quantity in the Physical Inventory Count Task for the items which are not available on stock. However, the system allows you to check the box “Zero Quantity”.-Resolution-If you want to change the stock you should perform an Inventory Adjustment for the respective product and logistics area.--Go to the Work center Physical Inventory. -Select the Common Task New Inventory Adjustment.-Keywords-actual, product, quantity, count task, zero quantity, greyed out, grayed out, inventory adjustment

Title: Error When Posting Goods Receipt in Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have an intercompany scenario where both supplier and customer are in the same tenant of ByD. When returning this product using Serial Number YYY, errors are faced when posting goods receipt for Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-XXX = Inbound Delivery Notification ID-YYY = Serial Number-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Select Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Click Post Goods Receipt.-Select Serial Number subtab.-Select Confirm for Serial Number YYY.-You receive the errors:-Action failed------> Serial number YYY returned to supplier; cannot be received-Cause-To get the serial number back into the stock, the Owner mentioned in the Registered Product YYY should be same as the supplier from the Sales Order.-Resolution-To change the Owner of the Registered Product (Serial Number), you can follow the steps:-Go to Service Entitlements work center.-Select Registered Products view.-Search for Registered Product YYY.-Open the registered Product YYY.-Select View All.-Choose Involved Parties tab.-Select the Owner line.-Select Remove.-Click Add Row.-Choose the Owner which shows in the Sales Order .-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-Return-Supplier-Inventory

Title: Identified Stock ID With Leading Zero
Content: Symptom-You want to know why the system is not considering Leading Zeros when creating Identified Stock IDs either via manually or migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Either go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center or Planning and Production Master Data workcenter.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Choose the New Identified Stock sub view.-Enter all the required details.-Now enter Identified Stock ID manually starting with Leading Zero + Numeric Value for example:- 01234 ( i.e. here 01234 is an identified stock ID)-Perform Save.-Here you find that system saves Identified Stock ID as 1234 instead of 01234. ( i.e. here 01234 and 1234 are an identified stock ID)-Cause-The system does not consider leading 0 with Numeric ID. It only considers when there is Alphanumeric ID for any master data document i.e. Leading zero+ Numbers + Letters.- For example: 01234AB. (i.e. here 01234AB is an Identified Stock ID)-Resolution- Either go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center or Planning and Production Master Data work center.- Go to the Common Tasks view.- Choose the New Identified Stock subview.- Enter all the required details.- Now enter Identified Stock ID manually with Alphanumeric ID for example:-01234AB. (i.e. here 01234AB is an Identified Stock ID)- Perform Save.- Now, the system generates Identified Stock ID with Leading Zero correctly.-Keywords- Leading Zero, Alphanumeric ID, Identified Stock ID

Title: How to Create Over The Counter Sales
Content: Symptom-Over The Counter Sales are invoice requests with a follow up outbound processing to adjust for inventory.-They are used in sales scenarios which require inventory adjustments, but skip most of the sales process.-This Knowledge Base Article will explain the functionality of Over The Counter Sales in SAP Business ByDesign.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Pre-Requisites to use Over the Counter Sales.-Scoping-In order to use the OTC sales scenario, you will need to enable Scoping Element Sales - Customer Invoicing - Over-the-Counter Sales.--This will enable the workcenter Over-the-Counter Sales.--Inventory Site-Over the counter sales require an adjustment to the inventory sites.-Navigate to Supply Chan Design Master Data workcenter.-Open the Locations view.-Highlight your Location ID and click on Edit Layout.-Select the Logistics Area ID you want to use for OTC sales (only one Logistics Area ID feasible per Location ID).-Add Logistics Use 'Over The Counter Stock'.--New Over the Counter Sale-Navigate to the Over-The-Counter Sales workcenter and select new Over-the-Counter Sale view.-You will need to enter the necessary information as in a manual invoice request, in addition to the Ship-From Location.-The Ship From Location needs to be your adjusted Location ID with 'Over The Counter Stock' checkbox enabled.-The Ship-To address is optional.-Once you click on Save or Invoice an Outbound delivery will be created automatically.--You can also use the Manage Over The Counter Sales Requests web service to create OTC sales.-Further documentation on the web service can be accessed via the Service Explorer view in the Application and User Management Workcenter.--Outbound Delivery-Once the Over the Counter Sale is saved an internal message is triggered to automatically create the Outbound Delivery.-You can directly access the outbound delivery via the Outbound Deliveries view in the Over-The-Counter Sales workcenter.-If the Logistics Area ID is maintained correctly and sufficient stock is enabled, the Outbound delivery is automatically released.-See Also-2835811 - Over-the-Counter Sales Outbound Delivery Status in Document Flow is "Not Started"-2804926 - Overall Discount is Not Supported in OTC Web Service-2773182 - Cancel Outbound Delivery of Over-the-Counter Sales Order-2769620 - Over the Counter Sales Do Not Have Shipping Related Dates-2763440 - Location XXX (XXX Business Organisation) with Role Ship From Location is Incorrect-2711718 - Over-the-Counter Sale is not a Search Criteria in Invoice Requests View-2622828 - Over the Counter Sales ID missing from the Worklist-2614274 - Over-the-Counter Sales Transaction: Logistics Area is not Proposed in Outbound Delivery-2600061 - Over the Counter Sales Multiple Printer-2572324 - Invoice Block Does Not Prevent Customer Invoice Creation in Over-the-Counter Sale-2534698 - In a New Over-the-Counter Sale the Ship-To Party is Not Automatically Determined by the System-2502728 - External Reference Field is Greyout by Default in Over-the-Counter Sales-2483867 - Tax Payment Deferral For Over The Counter Invoices-1976374 - The "External Reference" field is Not Editable in Over-the-Counter Sale Transaction.-1893725 - The Ship-To party is not Shown on the "Over-the-Counter" overview-1892934 - You Want to Exclude Over-the-Counter Sales Documents From Invoice Runs-1870226 - The Login User is the Employee Responsible in Over-the-Counter Sales Orders-1812442 - You get an error message in Over-The-Counter Sale transaction "Logistics Area for Location XXX with role Ship From Location has no usage for XYZ sales"-Keywords-Over the Counter Sales, Ladenverkauf, How to, Guide

Title: Error During Migration Of Labor Resource
Content: Symptom-Error message triggered when migrating Labor Resources --Set of books 1234 is not valid (1234 represents Company ID)-Field Company UUID is mandatory-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Business Configuration Work Center-Go To Overview View-Search for Migration of Labor Resource-Select the Migration tool-Select the file to upload-Select Execute Migration -> Execute step by step-  Cause-The issue is caused as the Site ID is not getting filled in the payload while maintaining cost rates. When filling data in resource from the UI, the Site ID gets determined automatically and hence the issue doesn't happen there.-Resolution-Issue can be resolved by adding the Site ID when performing the migration.-Keywords-Migration of Labor Resources, Site ID, Labor Resource,

Title: Field is not Showing any Value in Move List Form Preview
Content: Symptom-A Replenish Task is confirmed and a Reason for Deviation for a List Item of said task is maintained. When you preview the PDF document of the task, you expect the system to show a value in the Dev.* column for the relevant Line Item, but the field is empty. Now you want to know why the field is empty and how to get it filled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Internal Logistics work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Open the Advanced filter.-Select the Operation Type: Replenish.-Click the Go button and select a relevant Task ID.-Click the Preview button and select Preview.-In the opened PDF document, you can see there is a column named: Dev.*.-At the bottom of the table, you can see in the footnote that this column should contain the Deviation Codes.-In the example provided, you have confirmed the Task with Deviation Reason as Missing part, but this is not reflected in the form generated.-Cause-The warehouse staff prints the Move Task form out, including pre-filled details like Open Quantity, Source Logistics Area, Material etc., and records the replenishment/removal. The warehouse staff records the actual quantity with deviation reasons (if any) in the printed paper, and then transfers the data filled in the printed form back into the system.-Resolution-Hence, the Deviation Reason column Dev* is empty. It is expected to be manually maintained by the warehouse staff on the paper and then recorded in the system during the confirmation of the Task. The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Dev.*, Move List, Preview, Form, Deviation, Reason, Missing, Part, Codes

Title: Sales Order does not consider dependent demand for ATP Calculation
Content: Symptom-You see ATP in Sales Order showing in Green although there is a dependent demand for product DEF *DEF refers to Product Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center-Navigate to Sales Order View-Search for DEF-Navigate to Items tab- You observe ATP showing green although there is  insufficient stock-Go to Supply Planning Work Center-Navigate to Products View-Search for Product Planning Details-Navigate to Supply and Demand Tab-You observe Available Stock is 1 ea, However there is a dependent demand of -1 ea.-Cause-Dependent demand (proposal) and dependent demand (request) are not considered during ATP calculation since these demands have zero confirmed quantities in Live Cache. When the confirmed quantity is zero, those demands will not be considered for ATP.-Resolution-ATP provides full confirmation by not considering the dependent demands available in Product Planning Details for product.-Keywords-ATP in Sales Order showing in Green although there is a dependent demand, Sales Order does not consider dependent demand for ATP Calculation

Title: Delivery Notification Quantity cannot accept zero quantity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create Supplier Deliver Notification with reference to Purchase Order by updating zero quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Inbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Purchase Orders View-Search for relevant Purchase Order-Select New Supplier Delivery Notification-Navigate to Items tab-Enter Delivery Notification quantity as 0 UoM-Error appears       -Save Failed -Quantity missing-Cause-In Supplier Delivery Notification we cannot set as zero quantity as  this document is a subsequent document of Purchase Order-Resolution-Create and Save Supplier Delivery Notification with the quantity as Purchase Order requested quantity.--Step-1-Create Warehouse request from Supplier Delivery Notification and subsequently create warehouse task i.e Putaway task.--Step-2-In Putaway task click confirm and set  line item as zero in actual quantity and maintain the deviation reason and click save.--See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Delivery Notification Quantity cannot accept zero quantity, update Supplier Deliver Notification with zero quantity, create Supplier Deliver Notification with reference to Purchase Order by updating zero quantity,Quantity missing

Title: Unable to move task id from one Task  Folder ID to another Task Folder ID
Content: Symptom-You are trying to move task from one  task folder 1  to another task folder 2 you observe 'Move task' & 'ReDispatch' task buttons are grayed out.-Note:Task here refers to any  logistics tasks load task, unload task,  replenishment task, removal task except production tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Internal Logistics Work Center -Go to Task Control View-Search for  any Task id which is in Finished Status-You observe 'Move task' & 'ReDispatch' task buttons are grayed out.-Cause-The tasks which are assigned to any specific folder cannot be moved or dispatched if the status is finished/completed. As a result of which the 'Move task' & 'ReDispatch' task buttons are grayed out.-Resolution-The tasks which are in status " Not started " can be moved to a different folder using 'Move task' & 'Redispatch' task, you can use any of these based on your requirement.--However for the tasks which are in status "In process" can be moved to a different folder using 'Move task'.-Keywords-Unable to move task id from one Task Folder ID to another Task Folder,'Move task' & 'ReDispatch' task buttons are grayed out

Title: Post Purchase Orders and Supplier Invoices without a tax code
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to post the Purchase Orders and Supplier Invoices without a tax code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The tax code is mandatory while creating the tax code.-Resolution-There is usually an exempted tax code which can be used which set tax amount to zero.-The tax exemptions can be maintained at supplier or product level and when you use these the tax code will be determined as exempted.-

Title: Purchase contract output history is empty
Content: Symptom-Once the Supplier contract is created you noticed that Output history is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Sourcing and Contracting-Go to Contracts-Select All Contracts and search for respective contract-Select it and click Edit-Go to Otput History tab-Cause-We have developed the system to send Output  to supplier only when you want to send it, and thus we expect you to click on the Sent to Supplier Button.-Resolution-Goto Sourcing and Contracting-Go to Contracts-Select All Contracts and search for respective contract-Select it and click Edit-Click on button Send To Supplier-Keywords-OutPut history is empty, contract output not generated

Title: Error Message When Proposing Quantities: Value for Identified Stock Missing
Content: Symptom-You change a Material which was previously Non Batch-Managed to Batch-Managed. Now, you would like to transfer the current Stock of the Material in your Inventory to another Logistics Area, but when you try to do Post Goods Issue, the system is asking you to maintain the Identified Stock ID. Even though you have created and activated an Identified Stock ID for the said Material, you cannot use it, as the system does not recognize the new Identified Stock ID for this Stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Delivery Proposal view.-Find and select the relevant Delivery Proposal ID.-Select Post Goods Issue.-In the now open Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue screen, select Propose Quantities.-The system triggers the error message "Value for identified stock missing".-Now click the value selector in the Identified Stock ID field.-The previously created and activated Identified Stock ID cannot be found.-Cause-Since the Product master data has Identified Stock Profile as Batch-Managed, you need to enter the Identified Stock for every execution process. This is the correct and expected behavior of the system. The error is correct in this case.-As the current Inventory is without Identified Stock ID, you need to perform a Change of Stock and assign an Identified Stock to it. Only then you will be able to use the Stock against a process.-Resolution-To do this, please follow the below process:-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Choose Change of Stock.-Enter the relevant Site ID.-Click Add Row and enter the relevant Product ID and Product Quantity.-Click the Next button.-Use the value selector in the field Changed Identified Stock ID to assign the relevant Identified Stock ID.-Click the Next button.-Review your entries and finish the Change of Stock by choosing the Finish button.-Now you can proceed with the Stock Transfer.-See Also-See also: 2599529 - How To Transfer Inventory From Old Material To New Material, From Old Logistics Area To New Logistics Area or Both-Keywords-Wert für identifizierten Bestand fehlt, Change, Stock

Title: Employee Missing Error In Goods Consumption For Project Screen
Content: Symptom-System throws error message 'Employee Missing' while processing Goods Consumption For Project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Delivery Proposals view-Select the desired Project Stock Order Proposal-Select the option Allocate-In the Goods Consumption for Project screen, Input Actual Quantity, Source Logistics Area-Save -> System throws error message 'Employee Missing'-  Cause-The field related to Employee doesn't exists in the Goods Consumption for Project screen. However, the user has maintained employee as a mandatory parameter in the Account Assignments for a Project Task in Business configuration -> Activity 'Account assignment Types'.-Resolution-Recommendation is to make employee parameter as Optional in the Account Assignments for a Project Task in Business configuration -> Activity 'Account assignment Types'.-Keywords-Employee missing, Goods Consumption for Project, Account assignment,

Title: Add Custom Activity Types for Bills of Operations
Content: Symptom-This document explains how to create a custom activity type to be used in your Equipment Resource master data or in your Bill of Operations.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center. -Navigate to the Resources view. -Search and select the relevant equipment resource. -Choose the Edit button and navigate to the Services tab-Choose the button Add Row. -In the drop-down list under Activity Type you see a list of standard values.-You want to create a few custom values to be displayed under the Activity Type drop down.-Cause-You can create custom Activity Types by configuring the Activity List of your implementation project.-Resolution-Follow below given steps to create customer Activity Types for Bills of Operations.-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Select the relevant Implementation Project and choose the button Open Activity List. -Under All Activities, search for the activity Activity Types for Bills of Operations and select it. -Choose the Open button. -In the Activity Types for Bills of Operations screen use the Add button to add custom activity types of your choice. -Once the custom activity types are added choose the Save and Close button. -You will be able to see the newly created Activity Type in the resource master data and also Bills of Operations master data.-Keywords-activity type in resource master data, create new activity type for bill of operation, ByD Activity type in resource master data, ByD activity type bill of operations
