Title: Cancellation Status of Warehouse Order shows as "Not Canceled" Although Adjustment Confirmation have been performed
Content: Symptom-After performing reversal action of Warehouse Order DEF, the Cancellation status of it showing as "Not Canceled". (DEF refers to Warehouse Order ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to By Warehouse Order.-Find for DEF.-Select Edit button.-Navigate to Confirmations Tab.-You observe Cancellation Status as "Not Canceled" although adjustment confirmation or reversal has been performed, all subsequent and preceding documents have been canceled.-Cause-During Adjustment Confirmation Cancellation status do not change to "Canceled" as the reversal document gets generated from Adjustment Confirmation.-Resolution-In order to change Cancellation status as "Canceled", perform following steps to Reverse Confirmation for a Warehouse Order which has status "Started".-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to By Warehouse Order.-Find for KLM. (KLM refers to Warehouse order ID which status is "Started")-Select Edit.-Navigate to Confirmations Tab.-Select Reverse Confirmation.-Keywords-Cancellation Status, Not Canceled, Warehouse Order,  Adjustment Confirmation, Reverse Confirmation

Title: Split by Shipment/Pickup Date Does Not Work in Outbound Delivery Run
Content: Symptom-You have created two Delivery Proposals with the same Shipment/Pickup Date. Although you have the Outbound Delivery Request Run XXX with the box Split by Shipment/Pickup Date checked, it created two different Warehouse Requests, one for each Delivery Proposal. (XXX represents Run ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Automated Actions: Outbound Delivery Requests view.-Search for Run XXX.-Open the Run XXX.-Notice that your have checked the box 'Split by Shipment/Pickup Date'. However the Run XXX created one Warehouse Request for each Delivery Proposal.-Cause-This checkbox Split by Shipment/Pickup Date is only applied to a same Delivery Proposal. It does not merge different Delivery Proposals into a Warehouse Request.-Resolution-As the system created two Warehouse Requests, the system is working as designed in this case.-Keywords-Run, Outbound, Delivery

Title: Currency not Translated in Form
Content: Symptom-In some languages which use symbols as characters the currency is not translated to the specific character from the idiom in the output form template. Example, for Japanese the currency which are represented by the "JPY", they are not appearing as the respective Japanese symbol "円".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Purchase Requests and Purchase Order.-Go to view Purchase Orders.-Search for Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ equals to the ID of the Purchase Order).-Select the Purchase Order XYZ.-Click on View All button.-Click on Preview button.-Click on Created PO button.-Cause-For Japanese location, the system will show the currency as "JPY" and not the expected symbol translated.-Resolution-That's a standard system behavior, in PO (Purchase Order) form is only printed the ISO code of currency and not the currency description or name. Example for a US form we print currency as USD and not as US Dollar. Similarly it will show JPY which is the ISO currency code and not Yen.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Translation, Japan, Form, Currency, Output.

Title: How to Restrict Users from Accessing your Project?
Content: Symptom-You have set access restrictions for other users and they have read/write restriction to project management work center . But user is still able to view and edit your project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view: Business Users-Search for the user for whom you want to restrict access to projects. You can also set Role Based restrictions.-Select Edit-> Access Rights-Navigate to Access Restrictions-Restrict read/write access for this user-But the user/users assigned with that role are still able to view and edit your project-Cause-There are conflicts in the access rights i.e the project work center is restricted but another view related/dependent to project is unrestricted for the user, in such cases user will be able to view /edit the project.- -You can check this access rights dependency in the Business user profile or for the Business Role under Edit Access Rights screen by clicking Actions->Check Access Rights Consistency-So, to restrict the users from accessing your project, you need to set the read and write access restriction for the dependent work center views .-Resolution-Individually, you can select each user profile and restrict access rights for all the views related to project for that user.-OR-If you have set up Role based access rights, you can open the Role assigned to the user, now select Access Restrictions-> select the work center view-Select Restriction Rule->You need to set the restriction for the project and all the dependent views here.-There are 2 options:-01 - Restrict to Employee->If you select "01 - Restrict to Employee", then each employee will be able to view and edit their own project and will be restricted from viewing other's projects.-99 - Define Specific Restrictions->If you want to set specific restrictions for each user, then select 99 - Define Specific Restrictions and add the restrictions accordingly.- -So, whoever is assigned to this role, will be restricted accordingly.-Keywords-Access Restrictions, Project Management, Restrict to Employee, Define Specific Restrictions, Role Based Restrictions

Title: Error appears when A2X web service ManageLogisticsLayoutExecutionViewIn is executed for Replenishment using Logistics Area ID and Product ID
Content: Symptom-You are executing web service ManageLogisticsLayoutExecutionViewIn for  Replenishment using Logistics Area ID DEF and Product ID KLM, *DEF refers to Logistics area id & KLM refers to Product id.-Error appears in response XML as-Proposed replenishment or removal quantity is zero-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-[Enter your Reproducing the Issue here...]-Cause-As Logistics Area DEF does not contain Replenishment and Removal rules maintained, this error appears.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, Maintain the Replenishment and Removal rules in Logistics Area.-Navigate to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Go to Locations View-Select the relevant site-Select Edit Layout and search for Logistics Area DEF-Select Logistics Area DEF and maintain Replenishment and Removal Rules-Select Save-See Also- https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/1905/en-US/2ccacdaa722d1014a5c28c91616ff1fa.html-Keywords-Proposed replenishment or removal quantity is zero, Replenishment using Logistics Area ID and Product ID web services,web service ManageLogisticsLayoutExecutionViewIn for  Replenishment using Logistics Area ID ,web service ManageLogisticsLayoutExecutionViewIn is executed for Replenishment using Logistics Area ID and Product ID

Title: Firm Status For Planning Proposals
Content: Symptom-You have created for example a production proposal for a material via webservice: Manage Production Proposal and you find created Proposal is Firmed by User. Hence you want to know how new production proposal is firmed in the system automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Products vew.-Select All Products by selection-Search for required Product ID with respective Planning Area.-Select and open it.-Find Proposal ID: ABC ( Here ABC is a Proposal ID). Here, you observe that newly created Proposal ID via webservice is automatically Firmed by user (Note: whether it is a Purchase Proposal ID, Production Proposal ID or Stock Transfer Proposal ID)-Cause-Any Planning Proposals becomes a firm proposal which means it is manually created. And here when you have created a proposal via webservice which created by a techincal user which is manual and not by MRP run hence it is firmed and displays as firmed by user.-Resolution-If you do not want proposals to be firmed, follow below steps :-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Products vew.-Select All Products by selection-Search for required Product ID with respective Planning Area.-Select and open it.-Here choose Run-> MRP.-Now new created Planning Proposals will not be firmed.-See Also-2590650 - Purchase Proposals Does not Show Earliest Requirement Dates.-Keywords-Planning Proposals, Firmed by User, Firmed, MRP Run.

Title: Project is Not Available for Reporting
Content: Symptom-You have created a project and now you are trying to extract the data for that project in report:"Project Plan Values". But in the value help of the report, you are unable to find the newly created project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select view: Reports-> List-Search for the report: Project Plan Values-Open the report-Under the field Project, select value help and search for the newly created project-The project is not available in value help-Cause-The Project is in "Started" status and not yet released.-Resolution-Kindly release the project first in order to extract a report for that project.-Keywords-Project status, report, project plan values

Title: Extension Field For Project Invoice Request Cannot Be Updated on Item Level via your PDI Solution
Content: Symptom-An Extension field on item level in a Project Invoice Request cannot be updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Your PDI solution is trying to update an Extension field in CustomerProjectInvoiceRequisition-Item.node but this is not possible due to the following error: Changing data not possible; data is read-only-Cause-In order to modify the item in a Project Invoice Request the system checks the Status/LifeCycleStatusCode. If the Status/LifeCycleStatusCode of the respective Project Invoice Request is not 1 (In Preparation) an update on the Item node is not allowed.-Resolution-You need to implement a check on the Status/LifeCycleStatusCode of the CustomerProjectInvoiceRequisition to ensure your PDI Solution will not execute the modification if the Status/LifeCycleStatusCode is not In Preparation.-See Also- 2610403 - Extension Field For Sales or Service Order Cannot Be Updated on Item Level via your PDI solution-Keywords-Read Only; Changing data not possible; data is read-only

Title: Inspection Document Missing Though Valid Inspection Plan Exists
Content: Symptom-You have created an inspection plan with Inspection Type as Receiving Inspection- Customer Return correctly. However, when post goods receipt gets created against an Inbound Delivery Notification, no Inspection Document is generated though inspection plan exists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Common Tasks view and choose New Customer Return Notification sub view.-Enter all required details as Sales Order ID or Outbound Delivery ID as reference.-Select the required row and navigate to next in the guided activity.-Enter valid Delivery Notification ID and Check Consistency of the document.-Navigate Next and choose Finish.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notificataion view and find new IDN ID:ABC (Here for reference, ABC is an Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Select it and choose Post Goods Receipt.-Propose Quantities and choose Save and close.-Once it is done, system creates an Inbound Delivery ID.-Now go to Inbound Deliveries view and find respective ID created against IDN: ABC (Here for reference, ABC is an Inbound Delivery Notification ID).\-Select and edit it.-Choose view all and navigate to Document Flow.-Open in Extended view, here you find no Inspection Document is generated though Inbound Delivery is created.-Cause-In an Inspection Plan, the product category maintained is X and for the Material it is maintained as Y which is different. Inspection Plan must have the same product category as product if it is specified. (Here for reference, X and Y each is a product category)-Resolution-Go to Quality Planning Work center.-Go to Common Tasks view-Choose New Inspection Plan sub view.-Create a New Inspection Plan with type: Receiving Inspection- Customer Return.-Here choose Product Category same as maintained in required Product Master Data.-Enter all required details and perform save.-Keywords-Receiving Inspection- Customer Return, Inspection Plan, Inspection Document missing, Product Category, Inbound Delivery Notification

Title: Scoping Question 'Do you use customer projects (without sales integration) with an automated project invoicing process?' Does Not Show In The System
Content: Symptom-Scoping Question 'Do you use customer projects (without sales integration) with an automated project invoicing process?' does not show in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation Project and click on Edit Project Scope button.-Click on Next button until you reach Step 4 'Questions'.-Expand: Project Management > Project Planning and Execution > Projects.- In the Group: Project Types, question 'Do you use customer projects (without sales integration) with an automated project invoicing process?' does not show in the system.-Cause-The scoping question 'Do you use customer projects (without sales integration) with an automated project invoicing process?' is obsolete and cannot be used anymore.-Instead, direct cost projects ('Do you use projects for direct costs?') can be used. As customer projects ('Do you use customer projects with an automated project invoicing process?') are already in scope, the direct cost projects are without sales integration.-Resolution-Here the steps to activate the scoping question 'Do you use projects for direct costs?':-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click on Edit Project Scope button.-Click on Next button until you reach Step 4 'Questions'.-Expand: Project Management > Project Planning and Execution > Projects.-Select the question 'Do you use projects for direct costs?'.-Once this is selected, you should be able to create projects without sales integration.-Keywords-Project, Project Management, Sales Integration, Project without Sales Integration, Projects for Direct Costs

Title: Item Description Not Copied from Customer Invoice to Supplier Invoice In An Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-In Intercompany scenarios, after changing the item description on the customer invoice, the updated description is not copied to the automatically created supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice in Common Tasks list.-Enter product and required information.-Change the description of one item.-Release the invoice.-Open ABC (ABC represents the released Customer Invoice ID).-Go to document flow tab.-Open Supplier Invoice.-The changed item description in customer invoice is not taken over to supplier invoice.-Cause-The description for the items in Supplier invoice is fetched from the product master data and not the customer invoice. This is applicable all intercompany scenarios like intercompany project, intercompany purchasing or third-party intercompany.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-When a free-text item is used on a customer invoice, its item description is automatically copied to the corresponding supplier invoice.-Keywords-Item description; Customer invoice; Supplier invoice; Intercompany scenario

Title: Request for Quotation in Error When Sent to Bidders
Content: Symptom-When sending a Request for Quotation (RFQ) to bidders, the system generates a dump error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Select RFQs and Quotes view. -Use the Filter "All RFQs".-Search for ABC (ABC is the RFQ ID).-Open it.-Click on View All button. -Click "Send to Bidders".-The system generates a dump error message.-Cause-The communication arrangement is not maintained for the Supplier.-Resolution-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Select the Suppliers view.-In the drop-down, select All Suppliers.-Search for XYZ (XYZ is the Supplier ID used in RFQ ABC). -Click Edit.-Navigate to Addresses tab.-Navigate to Collaboration subtab.-Select Request for Quotation.-Click Maintain XML Settings.-Maintain all the necessary details.-Activate.-Keywords-Request for Quotation, RFQ, Dump, Bidders, Send to Bidders, Supplier, Communication Arrangement

Title: Delete Exceptions In Product Planning Screen
Content: Symptom-You want to delete the exceptions that are visible against a Product and Planning Area combination in Supply Planning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Product view.-Search for the relevant product and planning area combination and select it. -In the Exceptions tab you will be able to see the exceptions raised for the product in planning.-Cause-The exceptions as raised by the system to inform the supply planner of any deviations in the planning like Stock Shortage, Availability Date in the past etc. The supply planner can either choose the Acknowledge the exception or Reset the status of the exception. The end user does not have the option to delete an exception. The exceptions will not have any effect in the material requirements planning of a product as it is used only as a mechanism to inform the planner of the status in planning.-Resolution-To Acknowledge or Reset an exception please follow the below given steps.-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Product view.-Search for the relevant product and planning area combination and select it. -Select the Exceptions tab and choose the exception you want to acknowledge. -Choose the button Acknowledge to acknowledge the exceptions or Reset to reset the exception. -Keywords-remove exceptions for product ByD, ByD exception delete, I want to delete exceptions in supply planning ByD, remove exceptions in planning

Title: Missing Data on Purchase Order History Report
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Purchase Order History and try to display some results using a purchase request (PR) ID and a purchase order (PO) ID in the report selection.-However, running this report with these criteria does not provide you all the expected results.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Select the view Report.-Open the Purchase Order History report.-Fill in the needed criteria.-The newly created report does not contain the expected result.-Cause-The Purchase Order History report is not designed to show results based on searching by purchase request.-Resolution-The best report for this type of search is the Purchase Request Tracking report.-Keywords-Purchase Order History Report, Purchase Request Tracking Report, Missing Data, Wrong Report, Purchase Request, Purchase Order.

Title: How to set CC Option in Email for Purchase Order Output by Default?
Content: Symptom-You have set Email as the output channel for purchase orders. Hence, the purchase order output is going to the supplier via email.-However, for purchase order output, you want to add the CC option in the email which is sent out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase orders-Create a new Purchase Order and select order-Purchase Order is sent to supplier via email-However, you would like to CC the same email to another person when the order is sent out-Resolution-You can do so in this fine tuning activity under Business Configuration work center:"Purchase Order Output Control Settings"-You have 2 options here:--Purchase Order Send Email Control Settings- Here, you can configure the e-mail ID settings for different party types, if the purchase order communication to supplier is via email.--Purchase Order Send Output Control Settings-You can also set the attributes. Changes to ordered purchase order is communicated to supplier (via email, fax or post) only if there is a change in the values of the attributes that are selected here.-Keywords-Purchase Order Output Control Settings, Purchase Order output, email

Title: Over-the-Counter Sales Outbound Delivery Status in Document Flow is "Not Started"
Content: Symptom-You have created Over-the-Counter Sales Outbound Delivery DEF and you could see the status in Document Flow is shown as "Not Started".*DEF refers to Over-the-Counter Sales Outbound Delivery id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales Work Center-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View-Search for Outbound Delivery DEF-Select Edit-Navigate to Document Flow-You observe Outbound Delivery DEF status as "Not started" in Document Flow.-Cause-As Outbound Delivery DEF is not consistent,Hence the Outbound Delivery DEF status is shown as "Not started" in Document Flow.-Resolution-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales Work Center-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View-Search for Outbound Delivery DEF-Select Edit-Select Check Consistency-Error appears, Once you Fix the error and perform check consistency to see Outbound Delivery to be Consistent, In Document Flow status of Outbound Delivery changes from "Not Started" to "Not Released".-Keywords-Consistency Status of Over-the-Counter Sales Outbound Delivery,Over-the-Counter Sales Outbound Delivery Status in Document Flow is wrong,In Document Flow status of Outbound Delivery changes from "Not Started" to "Not Released".

Title: Internal Comment Not Visible In Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You created a project invoice request but the internal comment is not visible for other users.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.  -Go to the view Projects. -Select the relevant project. -Click New and Project Invoice Request. -In the General Tab, enter an internal comment. -Release the project invoice request. -If you log on with a different user the internal comment is not visible anymore.-Cause-The internal comments for project invoice requests are dependent on the log on language. If you create the internal comment in English, it will not be visible anymore when you log on in German.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. This way it is possible to enter different internal comments for different languages.-Keywords-project, invoice, request, internal, comment, language, interner, Kommntar, Projektrechnungsanforderung, Sprache,

Title: Supplier Invoice is Not Getting Created from  ERS Run
Content: Symptom-You have created an ERS (Evaluated Receipt Settlement) run in the system and you have set necessary selection criteria to create supplier invoice, but invoices are not getting created after the run is executed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view: Evaluated Receipt Settlements-Select the manually created run which was executed last-Select "Show Log" under Execution Details-Open the log-No invoice is created and message shows: No purchasing documents found for selection criteria-Cause-You have not set the grouping criteria in the manually created ERS run.-Resolution-You have to specify the grouping criteria in the ERS run under Control Parameters-> Grouping Criterion.-Keywords-ERS run, supplier invoice, grouping criterion

Title: Withholding Tax code determination- Thailand
Content: Symptom-Withholding tax details are not populating under Withholding tax details tab in the supplier invoice document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to New Invoice Without Purchase Order common task.-Enter Supplier, Buying Company and Product which has valid withholding tax settings.-Click on View All.-View Items tab and navigate to Taxes tab.-View Withholding Tax Details subtab. It displays 'No records found'.-Cause-The automatic tax code determination for withholding tax will happen for Thailand only when the invoice net amount exceeds 999.999999 THB as the withholding taxes were to be applied by default only when the threshold amount is exceeded.-Resolution-When the net amount is greater than 999.999999 THB, the system automatically determine the withholding tax code and calculates the withholding tax amount. When the net amount is less than 999.999999 THB, you can select the withholding tax code manually and go ahead with the postings.-See Also-KBA:1817674 - Withholding Tax not Calculated Automatically-Keywords-Withholding Tax empty,  withholding tax not calculated, tax code not determined automatically,With holding tax,Withholding Tax not appearing; Withholding tax not calculated; WTH not populating

Title: Return to Supplier Document not Available for Credit Memo Creation in Supplier Invoice Entry View
Content: Symptom-You have created return to supplier document along with actual outbound delivery document. However the return document does not available for credit memo creation in the Invoice Entry view under Supplier Invoicing work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Entry view-Select the query All Returns to be Invoiced-Select the relevant Return to Supplier document-No records found-Cause-In order to create a credit memo, user can go to advanced filter and search based on purchase order ID. Then you will get the return to supplier document. Further if you go to actions button on the Invoice Entry screen, you can see that Add to List button is enabled, meaning some user has removed the return to supplier document from the list so that you can add now back to the list.-Note:-You need to search the corresponding Outbound Delivery ID instead of the Return to Supplier ID for searching. -If Supplier Invoice is not posted with reference to the Return to Supplier document, system will not allow you to create credit memo because return quantity will not be available for posting a credit memo. The follow-up decision which you have entered in the return to the supplier document has no bearing on Credit Memo creation in Invoice Entry view.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Entry view-Select the query All Returns to be Invoiced-Select Filter and search based on Purchase Order ID-You will get the Return to Supplier document for Credit Memo creation-Select New Credit Memo button and Post the document-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-RTS not available for credit memo; Return document missing for credit note; return document missing in Invoice Entry for credit memo; Return delivery missing

Title: Catalog Image is not Showing up in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You are adding product from catalog in shopping cart, but the product image is not visible in the shopping cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center or Project Management work center-Select Go Shopping or Go Shopping(Advanced)-Navigate to Select Products tab-Search for an item from catalog-The image does not show up for the relevant item-Cause-The link to the image is not correctly maintained in the external catalog.-Resolution-Please ask the supplier to maintain the image link/path correctly in the catalog.-Keywords-image, shopping cart, catalog

Title: Error message: 'Inbound Delivery XXX cannot update Customer Return' while processing Inbound Delivery during Customer Return
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message 'Inbound Delivery XXX cannot update Customer Return' (XXX represents the exact ID of the Inbound Delivery) while you are processing an Inbound Delivery during a Customer Return scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-View Inbound Deliveries.-Show All and search for the Inbound Delivery XXX.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Result: you will see the error under the Inbound Delivery XXX.-If you click on the error (small red exclamation mark icon), the following error information will be displayed: 'Inbound Delivery XXX cannot update Customer Return'.-Cause-In the material's master data the returned product in Inbound Delivery XXX has the Item Group: PMAT - Product - project based.-Currently we do not support the Item Group: PMAT Product - project based in the Customer Return scenario. This is planned to be implemented in the future releases of the system. SAP Support cannot provide you with any further details regarding the exact release date.-Resolution- To resolve the issue perform the actions outlined below:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Find Material ABC (ABC represents the ID of the returned product).-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Select the respective Sales Organization XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Organization) and Distribution Channel 01.-Change the Item Group from PMAT - Product - project based to NORM - Product - delivery - based.-Save your changes.-Once you have completed the above steps, please forward an incident to the SAP Cloud Product support for us to process the respective messages in the backend.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, cannot, update, Customer Return, error, PMAT, product, project based, NORM, delivery based

Title: Warning message appears while checking the consistency of  a Production Model
Content: Symptom-When checking the consistency of  Production Model DEF, Warning message appears.  *DEF refers to Production Model id, *DEF1 refers to Production Bill of Material id.-One or more line items from variant 1 of BoM DEF1 are not assigned to segment DEF-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Models view.-Select Production Model DEF and choose Edit button.-Select the Check Consistency button.-Warning messages appears-Cause-Under Product Assignment  tab in Production Model assignment of products to an activity (Example ACT_002) is missing. -Note : All the Products assigned to Make Operation should be Supply to Production, because the products in Make and Supply Task need to match.-Resolution-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Models view.-Select Production Model DEF and choose Edit button.-Navigate to Bill of Operation Tab and navigate to sub tab Product Assignment-Select any activity and select “Assign Line Item Group to Activity”. -Keywords-One or more line items from variant 1 of BoM DEF1 are not assigned to segment DEF, Warning message appears when checking the consistency

Title: Not Possible To Upload Time Recordings via Excel - "No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Consolidated in KBA 2821617***-You are trying to upload time recordings for a service agent with Excel but get the error message "No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Partner Data. -Select the view Service Agents. -Find the relevant service agent. -Click Actions and Record Times from Microsoft Excel. -Fill in the relevant data to the Excel file and log in to the Business ByDesign add-in. -Click Save data to. -Now the error message "No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy"-Cause-One reason for the error message is that the user you are logged in with does not have the relevant write access.-Resolution-Go to the work center Application and User Management. -Select Business Users. -Search for the relevant user. -Click Edit and Access Rights. -Go to the tab Access Restrictions. -Search for the Work Center View ID BPM_SERVICEAGENTS. -If the user has no access, they cannot upload times via the Excel add-in.-To upload time recordings via Excel the write access has to unrestricted. --See Also- 2821617 - Error Message "No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy" When Trying to Save Project Time Recordings via Excel Add-in-Keywords-time recording, Excel, Authorization, project time, service agent, Berechtigung, Erfassung der Zeiten, Mitarbeiter,

Title: How to post Supplier Invoice with Price/Quantity/Tax Variance ?
Content: Symptom-You are able to create a supplier invoice with net value/quantity more than that in preceding Purchase Order document/ delivery document.But system is throwing exception when you are trying to post the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoice Entry-Select "All Orders to be Invoiced" or "All Deliveries to be Invoiced"-Search for respective purchase order/delivery document for which you are trying to create an invoice-Select New Supplier invoice-Create an invoice and manually edit the net amount/quantity in the invoice-You are able to edit the net amount manually-But exception is raised when you try to post the invoice:"The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts. You need to adjust these amounts so that the balance is zero."-Cause-The net value/ qauntity is not matching with the preceding document.-Resolution-You can either correct the net amount by selecting Actions-> Calculate Total Amount in supplier invoice.-(OR)-To allow/restrict certain price variance, tolerance value can be maintained in the "Supplier Invoice Exceptions" fine tuning activity in Business Configuration.-Keywords-Tolerance value, price variance, supplier invoice exceptions, total gross amount

Title: Not Able To Download Serial Numbers From Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You want to download the inventory data displayed by the system in the Serial Inventory Overview. You see that the Export button is greyed out and are not able to download the data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and select the option Serial Inventory Overview.-Enter the Product along with additonal relevant information in the selection area and choose the button Go.-The system displays the Product and Serial Number information.-You see that the Export button is greyed out.-Cause-You have not selected any of the line item displayed in the Serial Inventory Overview.-Resolution-You will have to select atleast one line from the displayed result set to have the Export button enabled. Once the button is enabled you can export the displayed result set into an excel file.-Keywords-download serial inventory, not able to download serial inventory, how can i download serial inventory details, now able to download serial numbers from stock overview, export serial inventory overview data

Title: Exception in Supplier Invoice: Purchasing contract ABC not found or does not match invoice item
Content: Symptom-You have a supplier invoice cannot be posted due to exception:-Purchasing contract ABC not found or does not match invoice item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center, Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open Supplier invoice DEF (DEF refers to the supplier invoice ID) , click Check, system raises error message: Purchasing contract ABC not found or does not match invoice item. (ABC refers to the purchasing contract ID)-Cause-The relevant product in purchasing contract ABC is inactive for sourcing. But you have manually assign the contract item to supplier invoice DEF. Hence system raises the exception.-Resolution-You need to remove the purchasing contract from the supplier invoice.-If you still want to assign the contract to the supplier invoice, you need to set the relevant contract item status as active for sourcing by following steps:-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center, Contracts view.-Find Contract ABC, click Edit.-Go to Items tab, select the relevant item, click Activate For Sourcing.-Save.-Keywords-Purchasing Contract, Supplier Invoice, Inactive for Sourcing

Title: How to stop Internal Employees from Overbooking Time for Project Tasks?
Content: Symptom-For external employees(service agents) who are working on a project, the system throws an error message in timesheet when the value for the planned work for that user has been reached .-You want the system to trigger a hard stop for internal employees as well when they are trying to overbook time as it happens in case of external employees.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login as an Internal Employee-Go to Home work center-Select view Time-Select Edit Time Sheet-Enter the time recording for a project task where you have already completed time recording for total planned hours-System does not show any error-Cause-It is not possible to put a hard stop on the internal employees from overbooking time in the current ByDesign system.-Resolution-You can use the approval process for time recording, where approver can reject the additional time entries if required when the time sheet is sent for approval.-Alternately you can make use of the Overtime functionality in Business ByDesign system.-See Also-You can refer below help documents:-Configuration: Maintain Time Recording Profile-Employee Times: Overtime Overview-Keywords-Time Recording, Projects, Internal Employees, Overtime

Title: How to Remove Attachments from Posted Supplier Invoice?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2545451***-You have posted a supplier invoice with an attachment. Now you want to remove the attachment from the supplier invoice but you are unable to do so as the Delete/Replace button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Suplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the Posted invoice where you want to remove the attachment-Select View All-Navigate to Attachments tab-The Delete/Replace button is disabled-Cause-You cannot remove (delete or replace) attachments from a posted supplier invoice.-Resolution-You can remove attachments only when the supplier invoice is not posted yet. You can add a new attachment anytime in the invoice.-Keywords-Attachments, Delete, Replace, Supplier Invoice

Title: ERS Invoice Not Posted Due to Error Message: "Party of role responsible employee missing"
Content: Symptom-The supplier invoice created by ERS run is not automatically posted due to exception:-Party of role responsible employee missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center, Evaluated Receipt Settlements view.-Search run ABC (ABC refers to the run ID), you see the status is Error.-Show log, you see the run was created by Technical User DEF (DEF refers to the technical user name). -Open the corresponding supplier invoice, go to Exception tab, you see the error message: "Party of role responsible employee missing".-Cause-There is no employee responsible for supplier invoices maintained in the system and also the ERS run is created by a non-business user.-Resolution-Solution 1: Maintain the employee responsible for supplier invoices.-Go to Organizational Management work center, Employee Work Distribution view.-Go to Business Area: Purchasing.-Define Employee Responsible for Supplier Invoices.-Populate an employee in this rule based on invoicing unit( Where Invoicing unit is Bill To in Supplier invoice ).- or-Solution 2: Perform a dummy change to the ERS run to make a business user as the run creator.-Log in a business user account.-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center, Evaluated Receipt Settlements view.-Find the current Evaluated Receipt Settlement Run which created by a non-business user, click Actions: Set to Obsolete. The value in Created by field changes to the current business user name.-Click Actions: Undo Obsolete. The status of the ERS run changes to In Revision.-Click Actions: Set to Active. The status of the ERS run changes to Active, the current business user showing as the creator.-After performing one of the solutions, you should not receiving the error message after ERS run.-Note:If you followed both solutions mentioned above then priority is given to the Solution 1 by the system to determine the employee responsible-See Also- 2368445 - How to resolve exception in supplier invoice: Party of Role Responsible Employee Missing-Keywords-Party of role responsible employee missing, ERS Run, Evaluated Receipt Settlements, entry method"ERS run"

Title: Unable to Perform a Change of Stock
Content: Symptom-You want to perform a Change of Stock, but it is not possible due to error: "No matching inventory items found".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Internal Logistics work center.-Go to the Change of Stock common task.-Select the Site XXX (XXX represents the Site ID).-Select the Product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-Enter the Product Quantity in which you want to perform the Change of Stock.-Select the Logistics Area ABC (ABC represents the Logistics Area ID).-Check the Inspection box.-You notice the error "No matching inventory items found".-Cause-When you make a Change of Stock, if you let the “Inspection” box enabled, the system will search only for Products that are under inspection.-If that is not the case for Product XYZ, the system will not be able to find the Product.-Resolution-Go to the Internal Logistics work center.-Go to the Change of Stock common task.-Select the Site XXX (XXX represents the Site ID).-Select the Product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-Enter the Product Quantity in which you want to perform the Change of Stock.-Select the Logistics Area ABC (ABC represents the Logistics Area ID).-Let the Inspection box unchecked.-Click Next.-In case you want Product XYZ to be inspected, in this step you check the “Changed Inspection Status” box. In this way, system will consider that the Product XYZ is now under Inspection.-Please note this will happen only for the Product Quantity that you have entered in the previous step.-Keywords-Change of Stock; Inspection;

Title: Net Value is Incorrectly Calculated in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have maintained list price as 100 USD for Material A,then you create Purchase Order for material A with quantity as 10ea and the net value is calculated as 10 USD instead of 1000 USD.-or- You see net value is having wrong value in Purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select New Purchase Order-Create the order with material A and enter quantity as 10 ea-The price is picked up from list price automatically as 100USD-The net value is displayed as 10 USD instead of 1000 USD-or-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders ﻿Work Center.-Select the Purchase Orders View.-Search for the Purchase Order.-You can see that the Net Value is not as expected.-Cause-You have maintained the list price value as 100USD/100 ea instead of 100USD/1ea, hence the price of 1 ea (price per unit) will be 1 USD, hence the net value for 10ea will be (10*1)=10USD.- or-You have a price per unit maintained-Resolution-Please maintain the price per unit correctly in order to get the correct value as per your requirement.-Keywords-Purchase order net value, price per unit, gross price

Title: Planning Does not Allow More Than Three Decimal Places
Content: Symptom-In the element 'Quantities and Units of Measure' in Business Configuration work center, 8 decimal places are maintained for Unit of Measure. While creating a Bill of Material, you were able to enter a Quantity for the Input Products with more than 6 decimals for the said Unit of Measure. However, when you create a Proposal with this Unit of Measure, the system is showing the Quantity of that Unit of Measure with 3 decimals only.-Now you want to know why this is the case, and if there is a possibility to display the exact same Quantity in your Bill of Material as well as in the Production Proposal/Production Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Find and open the relevant Material.-Navigate to the relevant Planning Area (Product Planning Details).-Open any Production Request (or Production Proposal).-Go to the Request Structure tab.-Expand the Elements ID.-Find the Quantity of the Input Product with up to 3 decimal places.-The Quantity does not have the same amount of decimal places that are maintained in the Bill of Material.-  Cause-Planning allows maximum of 3 decimals. In cases where there are more than 3 decimals, rounding is done.-Resolution-The system is working as designed, and shows the same Quantity, but rounded.-Keywords-Planning, Decimal, Production, Proposal, Product, Details

Title: Latest Start of the Following Operation Earlier Than the Latest Start of the Preceding Operation
Content: Symptom-You have created a Production Order with multiple Operations. When you check the Order, you discover that the system has proposed a Latest Start date for an Operation, that is earlier than the Latest Start of the preceding Operation. You assume that the Operations should be started according to the sequence maintained. You would like to know why and how the system is calculating this date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view and select By Order Header.-Find and select the relevant Production Order.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Order Structure tab and Expand All.-You can see that the Operation ABC is followed by Operation XYZ (ABC and XYZ represent different Element IDs of the Operations).-However, when comparing the values in the Latest Start column, the Operation XYZ and its corresponding Activity have an earlier Latest Start date than the preceding Operation ABC and its corresponding Activity.-Cause-You have used connections in the Bill of Operations as can be seen in the Production Model. The Operations under connection will be executed in parallel to other Operations out of connection. This is the behavior when connection is used. This is the reason that the Operation under connection may have a Latest Start date prior to the first Operation out of connection.-If no Operation is under connection, then sequential execution takes place.-Resolution-System is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Connection, BoO, Production Model, Bill of Operation, Activity, Operation

Title: Assign User To Logistics Task Folders
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to assign a user to an existing Logistics Task Folder.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Logistics Task Folders view.-Search and select the task folder for which you want to assign the user for and choose the Edit button.-Select the Registration tab and choose the button Add Row to add the ID of the employee to whom you need to assign the folder to.-Choose the Save button.-Keywords-assign user to task folder, ByD, How do I assign a user to Logistics Task Folder in ByD, task folder, assign user, SAP ByD

Title: You are Unable to Post Italy Supplier invoice even though Invoice Status is "Ready for Posting"
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to post Italy supplier invoice, you get the following error: "Release not possible; release document in sequence starting with XXX" (XXX refers to sequence number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select view: Invoices and Credit Memos.-Search for particular Italy supplier invoice which is in "Ready for Posting" status.-Select Post.-Error encountered: "Release not possible; release document in sequence starting with XXX".-Cause-For Italy and French invoices, a sequential document number should get generated which is not happening in your case because you have not maintained the document number format for respective invoices.-When the user selects Save button for the Italy/French Supplier Invoice, a global document ID is generated.-This is not the Legal ID. The Legal Document ID will be generated only when the invoice is posted successfully. The legal ID is displayed on the General tab with the field name "Sequential Document Number".-This is a legal requirement for Italy and France.-Resolution-Hence, to generate this sequential id, you need to maintain the "Document Numbering Formats Specific to France and Italy". Please follow below steps to do so:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview and navigate to Fine tuning activity.-Select activity "Document Numbering formats for Supplier Invoicing" and maintain the necessary fields.-Select Save.-See Also-2592862 - Supplier Invoice Document Number for Italian Companies-1758121 - How to Configure Supplier Invoice Number Range in Sequence-Keywords-Italy Supplier invoice, Document Numbering Formats, Sequential Document Numbering

Title: Follow-up Decision Column Missing in Return to Supplier
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the Follow-up Decision column in return to supplier documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Open Common Task: New Return to Supplier.-In step 1, select the to be returned products, click Next.-In step 2, under Items tab, you cannot find the Follow-up Decision column.-Cause-Follow-up Decision column only visible when you access return to supplier documents from Purchase Request and Orders work center. If you access it from Outbound Logistics /Inbound Logistics /Third-Party Logistics work center, the column is not visible.-The reason is, only the procurement responsible people should have the authorization to decide the follow-up decision for returns. The warehouse responsible people should not have the authorization to decide it.-Resolution-To view/edit Follow-up Decision column, please access return to supplier documents from Purchase Request and Orders work center.-Keywords-Follow-up Decision, Return to Supplier, 后续决定, 退货至供应商, フォローアップ決定, サプライヤ返品

Title: Unable to Release New Request for Quotation
Content: Symptom-The user is trying to release a new Request for Quotation (RFQ) but the Propose Bidders Functionality is not working. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Click on New RFQ common task.-In Define General Information, fill all mandatory fields.-Click on Next.-In Define Items, select Product Category XYZ (XYZ represents the Product Category ID).-Click on Next.-Click on Propose Bidders button.-Error message is triggered: "No bidders found for specified product categories".-Cause-The Propose Bidders Functionality will look for any transactions for that specific Product Category, such as the purchasing history. Then the system analyzes all the register to find the best bidder. -If the Product Category selected was never used before, the system is unable to compare that on a RFQ. -Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea: Influence Opportunity Homepage - Customer Influence -See Also-Customer Influence: Influence Opportunity Homepage - Customer Influence -Keywords-New RFQ, Request For Quotation, Propose Bidders, Bidders, Product Category, Message

Title: Not Assigned Values in Project Product Data Report
Content: Symptom-When using Project Product Data Report or any report based on Data Source "Projects, Baselines, and Snapshots [PROPRJU05]", you find that there are "Not Assigned" values in the report results for some fields which can also appear as a duplicated line in the report results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Find and open the report Project Product Data (Report ID PROPRJU05_Q0007) or any report based on this Data Source.-Run the report including the relevant fields.-In the report column the results appear as Not Assigned values for field XYZ (XYZ Represents the affected field). -Cause-This issue can occur for one or more fields in the report. The data source PROPRJU05 is a complex data source including data on different levels: project task, work, material, time confirmation and others. They are combined; it means that without restrictions several entries from different sources would come: for example, one line for the project task, three lines for the work, two lines for the time confirmations.- -The reports based on the Data Source, Projects, Baselines, and Snapshots [PROPRJU05] includes Key Figures defined on each Project Task levels mentioned. These Key Figures (for example, Operative Actual Work (Task) have a restriction defining that the data should be only taken from the basic data source for the project tasks. Hence, if you use only Key Figures for the project task level only one line per project task will be delivered.- -However if you now try to add some key figure for example, Actual Work (h) which is defined on the work (service) level you can get more lines if there are several services for one task.-Resolution-Entry the required Key Figures in the Report results, those being: Actual Work (h), Planned Work (h), Remaining Work (h), Planned Quantity, Actual Quantity, Remaining Quantity-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Find and open the report Project Product Data (Report ID PROPRJU05_Q0007) or any report based on this Data Source.-Run the report including the relevant fields.-Select the option View.-Select the mentioned Key Figures above in the Column Fields.-Keywords-Not Assigned; Values; Project Product Data Report; Data Source; Wrong Values; Double Entries; Double Lines;

Title: Conversion error occurred while checking the consistency of  Production Model
Content: Symptom-When checking the consistency of  Production Model DEF, Following errors are shown.  *DEF refers to Production Model id  *DEF1 refers to Production Bill of Material id.-Conversion Production segment DEF not consistent------> Conversion of quantity of BoO to quantity of variants not possible------> One or more line items from variant 1 of BoM DEF1 are not assigned to segment DEF-Production model DEF not consistent-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center-Select the Production Models view-Select  Production Model DEF and choose Edit button-Select the Check Consistency button-Error messages appears-Cause-Unit of Measure(UoM) maintained in the Quantity field at the Bill of Operation details section in Production Model DEF is different from the Unit of Measure maintained at Production Bill of Material DEF1 Variant ID.-Resolution-You will have to maintain the same Unit of Measure(UoM) value in the Quantity field on the Bill of Operation Details section in Production Model DEF and at the Production Bill of Material DEF1 Variant ID Level.-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center-Select the Production Bill Of Material view-Search for the relevant Bill of Material DEF1 and select it-Choose Edit button-Navigate to General and Variants tab-Keywords-Conversion Production segment  not consistent, Conversion of quantity of BoO to quantity of variants not possible, One or more line items from variant  of BoM  are not assigned to segment,Production model  not consistent

Title: Maximum Supplier Quotes Number When Compare Quotes
Content: Symptom-You want to know what is the maximum quotes number when comparing received supplier quotes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to Requests for Quotation view.-Select RFQ ABC (ABC refers to the RFQ ID), click Compare Qutes.-You are navigated to the Compare Qutes screen, the available quotes are listed here. -Or,-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to Quotes view.-Select Quote DEF (DEF refers to the quote ID), click Compare Competing Quotes.-You are navigated to the Compare Qutes screen, too.-Cause-When comparing quotes, we recommand the quotes number not be more than 6.-After that the text in the screen will be too small to be compared.-Resolution-If you received more than 6 quotes against one RFQ, you can manually select the quotes to be compared to restrict the numbers.-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to Requests for Quotation view.-Open RFQ ABC, view all.-Under Quotes tab, manually select the quotes to be compared, make the number not more than 6.-Click Compare Quotes.-Keywords-Compare Quote, Request for Qutation, Supplier Quote, RFQ, 报价单, 比较报价，比价

Title: Cannot Create New Individual Material in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When you trying to create a new individual material in purchase order, you find the New Individual Material button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase request and orders work center.-Open Common Task: New Purchase Order.-View All, go to Items tab, add row, maintain required information.-Go to subtab Account Assignment, select Account Assignment Type as IMAT -Individual Material.-New Individual Material button appears but greyed out.-Cause-Please check if you have access rights to work center Fixed Assets ((FIN_FIXEDASSETS) and view Fixed Assets (FIN_FIXEDASSETSALL).-If not, you are not allowed to create new individual materials.-Resolution-Please assign the access rights following below steps.-Go to Application and User Management work center, Business Users view.-Select user ABC (ABC refers to your user ID), click Edit: Access Rights.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment tab, find work center Fixed Assets ((FIN_FIXEDASSETS) and view Fixed Assets (FIN_FIXEDASSETSALL), check Assigned to User checkbox.-Keywords-New Individual Material, Purchase Order, Access Right, 新建单一物料, 权限

Title: You are unable to Update an old item and Create a new item Simultaneously in Purchasing Contract via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Purchasing Contract with one item and released it via web service. Then you try to update the first item and add a new item at the same time.Response fails.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open SOAP UI-Run the web service request to create Purchasing contract with one item and release it-Now, run the  request XML to create new item and update old item in Purchasing contract simultaneously-Response is not successful-Cause-The current behavior of the system doesn't permit simultaneous update and create of items as a part of payload.-Resolution-So, you can make separate calls for creation of item and update for items.-Also, use Action Code as per the use case. Eg - 01 for create and 02 for update; Don't specify the attributes which are uneditable or read only.-Keywords-Purchasing Contract, web service, create , update

Title: You are able to Cancel Goods and Service Receipt document even when it has invoice for this Delivery Document
Content: Symptom-The user has created and posted the Goods and Services Receipt (GSR). The Supplier Invoice linked to this delivery document is also posted/paid.-The user is able to cancel the GSR without cancelling the invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work center. -Go to Receipts and Returns view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Goods and Services Receipt ID). -The button Cancel Document is enabled (not greyed out).-The GSR can be cancelled while the Supplier Invoice is not cancelled. -Cause-System allows to cancel the Goods and Services Receipt document even though the Supplier Invoice is not cancelled. -That is because in certain real-time scenarios, if the product needs to be exchanged, the delivery document can be cancelled and replaced with a new one. The Supplier Invoice doesn't have to be cancelled too. -Resolution-Once the user has cancelled the Goods and Services Receipt or the Goods Return, the document cannot be re-released or deleted.-To restore a cancelled GSR or Goods Return, the user has to recreate the document in the Purchase Orders to Be Delivered view.-See Also- KBA: 2485074 - Unable to Make Changes to Goods Receipt that is in Status Released and is also Invoiced -Keywords-Goods and services receipt, cancellation document, GSR, supplier invoice, invoiced

Title: How to add extension field in Compare Quotes Screen for Supplier Quote?
Content: Symptom-You have created extension field in supplier quote screen and you are trying to show extension field on "Compare Quotes" screen, but you are not able to do so as this screen is not accessible/customizable for adding extension field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Select view: RFQs and Quotes-Select sub view: Quotes-Filter with the RFQ ID (Request for Quotation)-You will see the available quotes for this RFQ-Select "Compare  Competing Quotes" button-On Compare Quotes screen, you can compare the quotes raised by the bidders(suppliers) and award any one of them-You are trying to add extension field in this screen but this screen is not customizable-Cause-It is not possible to add extension field  in "Compare Quotes" screen.-"Compare Quotes" screen is not exactly a standard screen but a factsheet screen where extension scenarios are not supported.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. You can add the extension field in supplier quote screen and extend them based on the available extension scenarios under Further Usage option.-Keywords-Extension fiels, supplier quote, RFQ, Compare Quotes

Title: Error "Selection of Multiple proposals for Consumption not allowed" when trying to select and allocate  inventory for multiple Project Stock Orders
Content: Symptom-System triggers error message when trying to consume stock for multiple Project Stock Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Delivery Proposals View-Select(Using Shift button) Delivery Requests EF, GH of reference type Project Stock Order(*EF & *GH represents Project Stock Order ids)-Select Allocate-Error appears Selection of Multiple proposals for Consumption not allowed-Cause-In case of Project Stock Orders, System can only allocate Stock for a single Project Stock Order as Goods Consumption cannot be done for multiple Projects at any given point of time.-Note: Although Project Stock Order's Planned  Shipment Date and ship-to party ID is same, It is still not possible to select multiple Project Stock Orders for allocation of inventory.-Resolution-Select individual Project Stock Order EF and perform Goods Consumption-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Delivery Proposals View-Select PSO EF-Select Allocate-A new window "Goods Consumption for Project" appears-Propose Quantities and Source Logistics Area-Select Save-Keywords-Selection of Multiple proposals for Consumption not allowed, when trying to allocate for multiple Project Stock Orders

Title: Date Not Valid Error When Creating Physical Inventory Count/Adjustment OR Any Inventory Postings
Content: Symptom-While creating a physical inventory count, such as Product Count, Logistics Area Count, New Inventory Adjustment or Any Other Inventory Postings, a Key Date older than 6 months ago is entered. An error message appears:-'Key date DD/MM/YYYY not valid; date should be between AA/MM/YYYY and BB/MM/YYYY' (DD/MM/YYYY represents the entered key date; AA/MM/YYYY and BB/MM/YYYY represent the time period when a confirmation can be made).-Note: This date check is applicable to all inventory change processes, where data entry is enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Choose any of the following from Common Task:-New Logistics Area Count.-New Inventory Adjustment.-New Product Count.-Enter Key Date XX/YY/ZZZZ, which is beyond 6 months in past. It shows an error message. (XX/YY/ZZ represents the exact Key Date).-Note: This date check is applicable to all inventory change processes, where data entry is enabled. Examples of such processes are:-Goods Issue in Outbound Process (Shipment Date).-Goods Receipt in Inbound Process (Actual Delivery Date).-Scrapping (Actual Execution on).-Unplanned goods movement (Actual Execution on).  -Consumption for cost center (Actual Execution on).-Consumption for project (Actual Execution on).-Change of Stock (Actual Execution on).-Cause-The purpose of this check is to provide data entry control. Even if the corresponding account period is open for operational postings, the key date cannot be used.-Resolution-The inventory posting period is now extended. Documents which are older than 6 months that are within past 24 months can now be posted in the inventory. Earlier, the posting was allowed only for the span of past 6 months.-The following configuration must be done to extend the posting period:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and click Edit Project Scope.-In the Scoping step, ensure that Inventory Postings is selected within Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics -> Inventory Management.-In the Questions step, expand the Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics scoping element and select Inventory Management.-Select Inventory Postings and check the In Scope box for the question Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months?--If the option to extend the posting period has not been configured, posting for past 6 months gets set by default.-Note: The extended posting is allowed only if the relevant set of books are open.-See Also-What's New in Supply Chain Management - 1908 Release-Keywords-Inventory Postings, Beyond 6 months, Key Date, Actual Delivery Date, Shipment Date, Actual Execution on;

Title: Customer Contract Details not Showing in Monitoring Purchase Order Report
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order with account assignment type customer contract however when you check the report Monitoring Purchase Orders, the contract field shows the value as #. (Not assigned)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Reports List view-Select the Monitoring Purchase Orders report-Search for the relevant Purchase Order ID-The Contract field shows the value as # (Not Assigned)-Cause-Monitoring Purchase Orders report, shows all purchase orders that have been created during a specified time period. The buyer can check the purchase order value, price, quantity, and status of the purchase order. Here the contract field refers to purchasing contract and not customer contract. Hence you see the value appeared as # and not assigned.-Resolution-You can use Purchase Orders per Account Assignment report and this shows all purchase orders per account assignment. The buyer can check the total values per account assignment and the status of the purchase order, for example, if it is approved or sent to the supplier. This report serves the purpose to see the purchase orders per account assignment.-Keywords-Monitoring Purchase Order Report; Customer Contract; Contract # value;

Title: Logistics Model Shows Error When Checking Consistency
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message when checking consistency of the Logistics Model XXX.-XXX = Logistics Model ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Select Logistics Models view.-Find the Logistics Model XXX.-Open the Logistics Model XXX.-Click View All.-Select Check Consistency.-You receive the error: You cannot release logistics model XXX because logistics model XXX with empty site and Standard Receiving already exists.-Cause-The system supports to have one Task Based (either one step or two step) and one No Task Logistics Model for a site. The same can be applied to a Logistics Model without the site too.-In this case, you already have a Logistics Model which is Task Based or No Task, so the system is showing error for the new Logistics Model which has the same approach.-Resolution-Since you cannot have two Logistics Models with the same approach (Task Based or No Task), the system is working as expected.-Keywords-Without-Task-With-Release

Title: How to read Stock in Projected Material Flow
Content: Symptom-To understand the complete stock picture from Projected Material Flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-In Common tasks, Navigate to Projected Material Flow-Maintain mandatory fields like Site Id & Product Id-Select Go-Resolution-If the product has multiple identified stock ids associated with it, we can see stock picture for all identified stock listed in the 2nd table.-In the projected material flow, we have below enlisted quantity  as described roles:- -1. Document quantity: Actual quantity in the inventory for the main inventory separating values (Identified stock is considered here) when the document type is 'Inventory'. In case when document type is either 'Production order' or 'Warehouse request', document quantity is the negative of allocated stock.- -2. Allocated stock for document: Quantity allocated to a certain document. The document generally will be a production order or a warehouse request.- -3. Projected stock: Values in Projected stock is the sum of "Document quantity" until that line (started counting from the top line).- -4. Allocated stock: The stock allocated for the particular document. The allocation is irrespective of the identified stocks. it is just a soft allocation on the total available stock.- -5. Available stock: The sum of actual inventory (Document quantity with Document type 'Inventory') until that line. Allocation has no effect on available quantity since these are soft allocations.-Keywords-To read stock in projected material flow, Projected Material Flow

Title: Automatic Snapshot Not Triggered after Project Task Status Changed
Content: Symptom-You have scoped automatic snapshot at status change. But system does not create new snapshot after you changed the status of a project task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center, Overview view.-Find and open activity Project Types.-Check the indicator Automatic Snapshot at Status Change for project type ABC (ABC refers to a project type).-Go to Project Management work center, Projects view.-Create a new Project XYZ (XYZ refers to project ID), select the type of project XYZ as ABC.-Release Project XYZ, the status of the project header changes from In Planning to Released.-Go to Project Management work center,  Snapshots view, you find a new snapshot be created for project XYZ.-Go back to Project XYZ, create a new child task XYZ-1, save it.-Release task XYZ-1, the status of the task changes from In Planning to Released.-Go to Project Management work center,  Snapshots view, you find no new snapshot be created for project XYZ.-Cause-The automatic snapshot creation works only for status changes of the project header level, but not for changes on sub-tasks level.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can schedule a Snapshot Run to have regular snapshots be created.-Keywords-Automatic Snapshot, Project, Status Change, 项目快照, 自动创建

Title: How values are determined in Report:Earned Value Analysis by Project Structure
Content: Symptom-You want to know how the values of the columns Budget at completion, Actual cost and Planned values are determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1.Budget at Completion (BAC)-These are the planned costs (work, material and expenses) for every task. But these costs are taken from the baseline, not from the project.also its not current active baseline, its the baseline that was active as on snapshot date.- If there are two snapshots on a day then only the last snapshot date and time is taken to check the  active baseline at that time cause only one date  wil appear in the report.-also you will see current date as snapshot date in addition to snapshot dates  as long as planned end date is in future.-2.Actual cost-When project is a customer project with sales order involvement where all expenses should be assigned to sales order items only then the Actual cost will reflect in this report.-These are the actual costs (work, material and expenses) that were available at the point of time when the snapshot was taken.-3. Planned value- It is the time-base proportion of the Budget of Completion. Means: If 50 % of the planned time frame of the task is over the planned value corresponds to 50 % of the Budget of Completion. It has nothing to do with the planned costs of the project. This is the reason why it is called "Planned Value" and not "Planned Costs". In contrast to the Planned Value the Earned Value is calculated based on the Budget of Completion and the selected PoC Type (e.g.Work Proportional).-Keywords-Budget at completion, Actual cost, Planned values,Planned cost,Snapshot,Baseline
