Title: Cannot Add New Input Product With Fixed Quantity Using Mass Maintenance Run
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add a new Input Product to a Bill of Material using Production Bill of Material Mass Maintenance Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Production Bills Of Material Mass Maintenance Run view.-Click New.-Select the BoM Mass Maintenance Option Add Input Product.-Notice that you cannot choose the Fixed Quantity, there is no option to select it.-Cause-In current release of ByD, it is not possible to add a new Input Product with Fixed Quantity using Production Bills Of Material Mass Maintenance Run. You need to do it manually.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Production Bills Of Material view.-Find the relevant Bill Of Material.-Open the relevant Bill Of Material.-Click View All.-Select Input Products tab.-Click Add Row.-Enter the Line Item Group ID.-Enter the Line Item ID.-Enter the Product ID.-Enter the Quantity.-Check the box Fixed Quantity.-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-BoM-Data-Run

Title: Error "Finishing of production tasks failed" appears when trying to change the Check Task Status to Finish with Zero quantity
Content: Symptom-When trying to confirm Check task with zero quantity and update the task status to "Finish", following errors occur:-Finishing of production tasks failed------> Finishing of confirmation group failed-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for the relevant tsak ID.-Select Change Status as "Finish".-A new Pop up screen appears "Input Parameters for Finish Task".-Check for "Set all Confirmation Finished Indicators" and Select OK.-Above errors occur.-Cause-As the proposed quantities that are based on inspection results are not transferred to production Lot, this is causing the issue.-(When the production order is released, the system creates a production lot and releases the corresponding inspection. The system also creates a production task of the type Check and links this to the inspection.)-Resolution-By choosing Finish Results Recording,the proposed quantities that are based on the results are then transferred to the production lot.- In order to solve the error and to change the Check Task Status to Finished with Zero quantity. Need to follow the below steps:-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for the relevant task ID.-Select Confirm.-Select Finish Results Recording.-Select Finish task.-Select Save.-Keywords-Finishing of production tasks failed, Finishing of confirmation group failed, Check Task, Production Task, Change Status, Finish

Title: Cannot Undo Quick Sourcing Request Action in Purchase Requests
Content: Symptom-The Quick Sourcing Request action was performed in a Purchase Request and it is not possible to find how to undo this action.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Search for the Purchase Request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Request).-Click on the Quick Sourcing Request button.-System displays the message 'Sourcing request created', but it does not provide a way to revert this action.-Cause-Once clicking on the Quick Sourcing Request button, the system creates a Sourcing Request in the Sourcing and Contracting work center, Sourcing Requests view. It is necessary to cancel this Sourcing Request to revert the Quick Sourcing Request action performed in the Purchase Request screen.-Resolution-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center. -Go to the Sourcing Requests view.-Filter by Sourcing Requests from Purchase Requests.-Search for the Purchase Request ABC.-Click on the Cancel Sourcing Request button.-The system will remove the Sourcing Request created and the button 'Quick Sourcing Request' will be enabled again in the Purchase Request screen.-Keywords-Quick Sourcing Request, Sourcing Request, Purchase Request

Title: How to  create a New Freight Forwarder from Supplier Master Data
Content: Symptom-You want to create a New Freight Forwarder Master Data from Supplier Master.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Navigate  to Supplier Base Work Center-In Common tasks,Navigate to New Supplier-Fill in all mandatory entries such as Supplier ID, Supplier Name etc.. -Scope Freight Forwarder under Additional Identifiers-Select Save-Keywords-New Freight Forwarder, Create Freight Forwarder from  New Supplier,How to  create a New Freight Forwarder from Supplier Master Data, to create a New Freight Forwarder Master Data from Supplier Master

Title: Error: PAF: Inbound Processing: System Failure When Migration Open Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You don't know why you receive an error when migrating open sales orders.-Error message: PAF: Inbound Processing: System Failure-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Overview-Search for Migration of Open Sales Orders and select it-Click on Open-Click on Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool-Select the appropriate file-Click on Execute Migration Step-by-Step-Click on Repeat Simulation > Simulate for all records-Statistics: Error detected during import simulation-Error detected in source record-PAF Inbound processing: System Failure-Cause-A possible cause might be that the data passed in the individual dates is not correct and that the total amount exceeds the item net value.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Overview-Search for Migration of Open Sales Orders and select it-Click on Open-Click on Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool-Select the appropriate file-Click on Execute Migration Step-by-Step-Click on Repeat Simulation > Simulate for all records-Click on Edit Source Record-Click on the second tab Items-Take note of the Net Value for the Sales Order ID and for the Line Item-Click on the tab Items Individual Dates-Calculate the amounts for the individual dates-Verify that the amount doesn't exceed the item Net Value-See Also-2033854 - Error: PAF Inbound Processing: System Failure During Migration of Projects-2987536 - Error: PAF: Inbound Processing: System Failure When Migration Open Sales Orders-Keywords-Migration von offenen Kundenaufträgen, Fehlermeldung PAF: Eingangsverarbeitung: Systemfehler, Meldungsnr. DMC_RT_MSG116, es ist ein Systemfehler beim Inbound Processing im Zielsystem aufgetreten, die Bearbeitung konnte für das Business Object nicht erfolgreich beendet werden, Hinweis auf Fehlerdump nicht nachvollziehbar, Fehleranalyse nicht möglich-paf: inbound processing: system failure

Title: Supplier Invoice Journal Entry Posting to a Balance Sheet Account
Content: Symptom-Expectation is that a journal entry for supplier invoice posts to a Costs or expenses account, however, it's posting to an Other liabilities account, which is a Balance Sheet account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view > Journal Entries subview.-Find the respective Journal Entry for Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC means the Supplier Invoice ID).-Under Details section, notice that the debit posting is being made to a Balance Sheet account (for example, a G/L Account of type Other liabilities), when the expectation is that the debit posting hits a Costs or expenses account, as per account determination setup. -Cause-In Supplier Invoice ABC the Order Migrated Code field has been set to Not Migrated. This should only be set for purchase orders which are not present in the system and are not yet migrated from third party systems. In this case the value has been set for existing purchase orders in the system as well.-Resolution-The Supplier Invoice ABC should be canceled and a new one created for the referred purchase order.-SAP development team is working to enhance the tooltip for Order Migrated Code field.-Keywords-supplier invoice; order migrated code; not migrated; journal entry; balance sheet; other liabilities; OLIAB; costs or expenses;

Title: Not invoiced time and expenses not assigned to Sales order automatically
Content: Symptom-You see that sales order column is highlighted in red as there is no sales order assigned automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to Not invoiced time and expenses view-Search and Select the respective project-Click on Edit expenses button- You will see that few time and expenses are not assigned to sales order automatically.-Cause-System has created default assignment rules as per the sales order items and thus will not suffice all types of time and expenses (goods receipt or invoice or goods issue or expense report) except time confirmation in general.-Resolution-Go to Project management work center-Go to Not invoiced time and expenses view-Search and Select the respective project-Click on Edit expenses button-Click on edit assignment rules button and choose View all rules-Select project task for which you saw that sales order was not assigned-Scroll down where you can see the Party parameters and Time and expenses Parameters options used.-To see the available options under Party parameters and Time and expenses Parameters follow below steps:-7.Click on Add row button, use the drop-down against the fields to see the options.- The available options are:- Party parameters: Employee party and Supplier ID- Time and expenses parameters: Service, material, product category and GL account-8. Go to the respective time and expenses that does not have the sales order and   scroll down where you can see the document ID-9.Open them and see which of the above parameters they have, cause they should match with the Assignment rule's parameters.-10.So add a new rule with same details of the default rule that exist for that project task you have problem with and change the party parameter a time and expenses parameter accordingly-11.also move the new rule to appear above the default rule of that project task by using Move Up and move down button-  Example 1: If you have time and expense with source document as goods and service receipt-Check if that goods receipt it has product master data that is either service ID or Product ID,-If yes, choose party parameter as Employee party and time and expenses parameter as Service or material accordingly-If no, check it should have product category so choose party parameter as Employee party and time and expenses parameter as Product category-Example 2: If you have time and expense with source document as Invoice-After following steps under example 1- If no product category is there then check it should have GL account and then choose party parameter as Employee party and time and expenses parameter as GL account.- Same way check the other types of documents Goods issue and expense report and adjust the party parameter and Time and expenses Parameters accordingly with new rules.-Keywords-Not invoiced time and expenses not assigned, time and expenses not assigned to Sales order, not assigned to Sales order automatically, time and expenses not assigned, time and expenses has no Sales order, assignment rules not working, Not invoiced time and expenses not assigned to Sales order automatically

Title: Inbound Delivery Notification is Created Automatically From Intercompany Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You want to know how Inbound Delivery Notification DEF (DEF refers to the Inbound Delivery Notification id) is generated automatically from an Intercompany Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to the Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Search for DEF.-Select Edit.-Navigate to the General tab.-You observe that the Inbound Delivery Notification is created automatically via A2A Message.-Cause-You have scoped Advanced Shipping Notification setting in the Collaboration tab of Account master (Normally Sender ID in Inbound Delivery Notification), hence Inbound Delivery Notification DEF is generated automatically via A2A Message.-Resolution-In order to stop Inbound Delivery Notification generation automatically via A2A messages, follow the below steps:-Go to the Account Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Accounts view.-Select the relevant account master data.-Navigate to the Communication tab.-Navigate to the sub tab Collaboration.-Descope the option Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound.-Select Save.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, created automatically, A2A messages, Intercompany, Intercompany Purchase Order, Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound, Colloboration , Account Management, Accounts, Communication.

Title: Error: Delivery Start Date Must Not Be In The Past When Awarding a Supplier Quote
Content: Symptom-You try to award a quote but system throws the following error messages:-Delivery Start Date Must not be in the Past.-Delivery End Date Must not be in the Past.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Click on Quotes view.-Filter for Submitted Quotes.-Select Quote ID XYZ (XYZ being the Quote ID).-Click on Edit.-Click on the Award or Check button.-You get one of the following error messages:-Delivery Start Date Must not be in the Past.-Delivery End Date Must not be in the Past. -Cause-This happens because you are trying to award a Quote that has Offered Service Period From or Requested Delivery Date set in the past.-You can see this while on Quote XYZ if you:-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Click on Quotes view.-Filter for Submitted Quote-Select Quote ID XYZ (XYZ being the Quote ID).-Click on Edit.-Click on the Items tab.-Click on the Delivery subtab.-Resolution-If the deadline from the Request for Quotation hasn't been reached yet, you can follow the steps bellow.-Go to Sourcing and Contracting Work Center.-Click on Quotes View.-Filter for Submitted Quotes.-Select Quote ID XYZ.-Click on Edit.-Click on Return.-Change the "Offered Service Period From" or "Requested Delivery Date" date to a valid one.-Save document.-If the deadline from the Request for Quotation has been reached:-You will need to cancel both Quote and Request for Quotation because returning the Quote will cause another inconsistency since the deadline from the Request for Quotation has already passed.-Keywords-Request Quotation, Supplier, Quote, Delivery Date, Start Date, End Date, Error Message

Title: Error during Goods and Service Receipt Approval: "Action Approve not possible; action is disabled"
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to approve Goods receipt where account assignment is project task, you are getting following error message:-"Action Approve not possible; action is disabled".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work centre-Select view Approvals-Search for the goods receipt approval task where account assignment is project task-Select Approve-Error message is displayed: "Action Approve not possible; action is disabled"-Cause-The approval fails because the project task against the Goods and Service Receipt(GSR) has been completed and Completed project task does not permit the posting of goods and services receipt.-Resolution-Please open the project task before triggering approval on the Goods receipt under consideration.- -If this does not work, please try sending it back to revision and ensure there are no errors on the document before sending for approval again.-Keywords-Goods and service receipt approval, project task, action id disabled

Title: Purchase order or Shopping cart not found
Content: Symptom-You are searching for a Purchase order or shopping cart and its not found in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Purchase request and orders work center- Go to Purchase order- Show all purchase orders- Search for respective purchase order-No results found.-or-Go to Home work center-Go to Self service view-Click on Track my shopping carts-Choose Shopping cart open, shopping carts-open for confirmation and shopping carts-completed, each one at a time and then-Search for respective shopping cart-No results found.-Cause-Purchase order was deleted when it was in status In preparation or In revision.-This details are applicable for shopping cart as well.-Resolution-When the Purchase Order document which was in the status In Preperation is deleted, it cannot be tracked in the system in any place or in any ways. The same applies to Shopping cart requests as well.-Keywords-Purchase order not found, deleted purchase order,shopping cart not found, deleted shopping cart,could not find shopping cart,could not find Purchase order, in preperation document deleted

Title: Project Invoice Request is Not Created for Multi-Customer Project
Content: Symptom-You have released sales order with respect to multi-customer project. But you are not able to create Project Invoice Request from Project based Sales Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select view: Project Invoicing-Select subview Sales Orders-Search for the respective project based sales order-The sales order is not available in this view-Cause-Multi-customer project does not support Project invoice requests.-For project invoice requests to be created, we have two prerequisites: 1.Item Type 2. Project type-So, if it is multi-customer project or if item type of the sales order item is without project (e.g.Service - fixed price), then it is not possible to create a project invoice request.--The item type of a sales order has to be one of the following so that the sales order item can be invoiced via project invoicing:-- Service - time and material (project)-- Service - fixed price (project)-- Expense - fixed price (project)-- Expense - time and material (project)-- Product - project-based-Resolution-Please create Customer Projects or billable Direct Cost Projects and sales orders having item type with respect to project as mentioned above.-For Multi-Customer projects, you can do Milestone Invoicing, where you need to set the milestone to complete.-Then the system creates a customer invoice request overnight.-The customer can also trigger this step manually in Customer Invoicing -> Invoice Requests.-See Also-For details, please refer to the help documents:-"Multi-Customer Projects"-"Milestone Invoicing for a Multi-Customer Projects"-"Revenue Recognition for Multi-Customer Projects"-Keywords-Multi-customer projects, milestone invoicing, revenue recognition for multi customer projects, Project Invoice Request is Not Created for Multi-Customer Project

Title: Planned Work shows Doubled value in Project Report
Content: Symptom-The user has maintained X hours as Planned Work in project (X represents number of hours).-However the field Planned Work shows doubled value (2X) in report "Team Member Work Analysis".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view. -Search for report "Team Member Work Analysis". -Filter for the relevant project.-Field "Planned Work" shows doubled value. -Cause-The key figure "Planned Work" gets its data both from the Project as well as from the Baseline. The X hours in the Project and the X hours in the Baseline are summed up to 2X hours in the report.-If the user adds an additional characteristic, such as "Baseline Task" (which gets its data only from the Baseline), the result is split up into two rows.-The key figure "Baseline Work (h)" can be used, since it shows only the work of the Baseline. -Resolution-Currently there is no such key figure available for Planned Work only from the Project. But the underlying data source PROPRJU04 (Projects, Baselines: Tasks and Staffing) will be enhanced with future release so that the user can build custom report based on this enhanced Data Source.-If the user needs a key figure already now, which shows only the planned work of the project, a custom report can be created in the Business Analytics work center based on the data source PROPRJU04. A new restricted key figure can be created with a fixed restriction on "Source of Data" to the value "Project Task Service".-Keywords-Planned Work, Project Report, Baseline Task, project report, planned hours, baseline

Title: Copy Extension Field from Invoice Template to Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have maintained some data in a supplier invoice template (say XXX).-However this data does not appear in a supplier invoice which has for reference document the invoice template XXX.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Select Invoice and Credit Memo.-Use the filter Template.-Select and open the template XXX.-From here you can see that this template is for the product say YYY.-This template contains an extension field "PPP" which is already filled with a value.-However,-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Select Invoice and credit memos view.-Search and open a supplier invoice that contains the product YYY.-From the General tab, you can see that the reference document is Invoice Template XXX.-When going to the Items tab, that the extension field "PPP" is present but does not contain any information, nothing has been fetched from the template XXX.-OR-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing work center-Select New Invoice without purchase order-On the New invoice screen, enter template ID XXX and click update template. -Navigate to Items tab and check the extension field.-The field is available but the content is not fetched from template to the invoice screen-Cause-For extension field value to be copied from an invoice template to an invoice, an extension scenario needs to be created between the invoice template and the supplier invoice.-This functionality currently does not exist.-Resolution-You can use the following work around:-Go to  supplier invoice work center->invoices and credit memos view->select templates from drop down->select the template id-> click on new document from template.-It will copy the extension field description.-You can also post this requirement in customer influence forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-This is our official channel to address all new requirements.If multiple customers vote for the same idea, our development team will check the feasibility of implementing this functionality in future.-You can track the idea and check the status of the idea in that forum.-Keywords-Invoice Template, Supplier Invoice, Extension Field, extension field value missing

Title: Wrong Status for Sales Order linked with a Project
Content: Symptom-You have a sales order (SO) linked with a project that should be under status "Finish Invoicing".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.-Select the Project view.-Search and open the project of your choice and click "View All".-Go to the Document Flow tab.-From here, you can see that the sales order is under status "In Process", when it should be "Finish Invoicing".-Cause-This issue could be due to an error in the associated Project Invoice Request (PIR).-If you open the PIR and click "Check", you might see these error messages:-Status of project task ABC (DEF not 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed')-Status of project task XYZ (Incidental Exp not 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed')-When checking from your project, you may see that these tasks are actually under the status "Closed", which makes the PIR inconsistent and block your SO from being under the status "Finish Invoicing".-Resolution-Go to the work center Project Management.-Select Invoice Preparation.-Select Project Invoice Request and search for your PIR.-Cancel the PIR.-This will also cancel the inconsistent invoice request in the 'Customer Invoicing' Work Center.-Then go to work center Customer Invoicing and go to Project Invoicing.-Go to the Sales Orders view and search for your SO.-Now you will be able to change the status of the SO to "Finishing Invoicing".-Keywords-Project, Project Invoice Request, Project Management, Sales Order, Finish Invoicing, Customer Invoicing.

Title: Purchase Order Approval is Not Triggered even though Approval Condition is Met
Content: Symptom-You have created a Purchase Order which meets the conditons defined in approval process and submitted the order , but it did not go for approval and was directly sent to supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center view-Select Approval Processes sub-view-Create a Purchase Order Approval Process with rule: Approval By Cost Assignment and maintain a condition as Total Net Value greater than 1000 XXX (XXX refers to currency)-Activate it-Now, go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select New Purchase Order-Create a Purchase Order with total net value greater than 1000 with currency YYY (YYY refers to currency)-Select Order-Purchase Order is sent to supplier without going for approval-Cause-The currency is different in the approval process and in the purchase order document.-1000 YYY is less than 1000 XXX, hence the condition is not met and system did not trigger approval.-Resolution-Kindly maintain the same currency in approval process and purchase document to avoid such situation or else enter a net value greater than the net value in the condition defined to trigger approval.-This solution also apply to other purchasing documents like purchasing contract.-Keywords-Purchase Order Approvals, Currency, Approval Processes, Total Net Value

Title: Total Cost For Material Not Getting Populated in Project
Content: Symptom-The Total Cost column in the Project's Material tab is not getting populated. Costs are properly assigned to Project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search for Project ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Project).-Click on Edit button.-Go to the Materials tab.-Click on the Avatar button.-Select the option Start Personalization Mode.-Expand Unnamed Table.-Mark the box for Total Cost field.-Click on Save button.-Click on the Avatar button.-Select the option Stop Personalization Mode.-Go to the Materials tab.-Total Cost column is not populated with any costs for materials.-Cause-Issue is happening due to not initiated the cost calculation manually.-Resolution-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search for Project ABC.-Click on Edit button.-Click on Valuate button.-This action will calculate the costs for entire project.-Keywords-Project, Costs, Total Cost, Project Cost

Title: System Allows You to Enter the Same Serial Number More Than Once
Content: Symptom-You received the same Serial Number YYY twice for the same Purchase Order XXX, in different Inbound Deliveries. You expect the system to display an error when the Serial Number already exists.-XXX = Purchase Order ID.-YYY = Serial Number ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Inbound Deliveries view.-Select the Advanced Search.-Enter the Purchase Order ID XXX.-Click Go.-You notice that you have two different Inbound Deliveries for the Purchase Order XXX. And in both Inbound Deliveries, you have entered the same Serial Number YYY.-Cause-Only the Serial Number Profile Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes ensures the uniqueness of the Serial Number for a product in the inventory. If you have selected other Serial Number Profile, the system will allow you to enter the same Serial Number more than once.-Resolution-As you did not select the Serial Number Profile Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-Serial-Duplicated-Stock

Title: Error Message:Total gross amount less than total down payment request amount
Content: Symptom-In Supplier Invoice ,that is linked to downpayment ,you got this error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Supplier invoicing work center-Go to invoice and credit memos  view-Open respective Supplier invoice -Click on check-You will see the error.-Cause-The allocated amount of downpayment in invoice is always same as Downpayment's total amount and in your case the Total gross amount of invoice is less than total down payment  amount that means that allocated amount of down payment isgreater than the total amount of invoice and thus system raised error.-Resolution-Go to General tab of invoice-Go to Payment information tab-Go to downpayments Sub tab-Navigate to column Assigned amount-Enter  amount same or less than Invoice amount-Keywords-Total gross amount less than total down payment request amount

Title: Error Message When Posting Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You created the Customer Return Delivery Notification XXX with an external reference (which does not exist in your ByD system). However, you encounter an error when entering the expired Identified Stock YYY-(XXX repesents Inbound Delivery Notification ID, YYY represents Identified Stock ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Select the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Click Post Goods Receipt.-Enter the Actual Quantity.-Enter the Identified Stock YYY.-The error message is thrown:-Identified stock YYY expired on DD.MM.YYYY-Cause-You can only use an expired Identified Stock if you select an existing reference in ByD. If you use an existing reference, the system will consider the Fulfilled Date in Customer Demand as reference to check if the Identified Stock is valid. In the case that you use an external reference, the system will consider the Planned Delivery Date in the Inbound Delivery Notification, hence the error message.-Resolution-As the system is using the Planned Delivery Date as a reference when you enter an external reference, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-IDN, IStock, Expiration

Title: Error: Serial number does not exist in inventory
Content: Symptom-You are trying to enter Serial Number while confirming post goods issue. However, system throws below message:- Serial number does not exist in inventory-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics WorkCenter.-Go to Delivery Proposals View and choose required Delivery Proposal ID with respect to Sales Order, Stock Transfer Order etc.-Select it and choose Confirm.-New Window opens up as Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue.-Now under Details Section, navigate to Serial Number subtab.-Here, you enter the Serial Number ID and system throws error message.-Cause-You have changed the old serial number profile to new serial number profile (i.e. Mandatory on All Logistics and Production Processes) in a required product master data and hence automated physical inventory count task generated. However, the count ID is not processed yet. You have to add required Serial Number ID which was tagged with old profile while confirming the count task to add it to a new serial inventory tagged with new profile.-Resolution-Go to Physical Inventory WorkCenter.-Go to Monitoring view and choose By PI Count Document sub view.-Show All PI Count Documents and choose advanced filter icon.-Select system generated checkbox and enter required Product ID.-Choose Go and now you can see automatic generated PI Count Document IDs.-Select and finish the task entering all required Serial Number IDs tagged with old serial number profile.-Once the PI Document ID is finished, you can use exists serial number ID while post goods issue.-Keywords-Serial number does not exist in inventory, Serial Number ,Mandatory on All Logistics and Production Processes, serial number profile

Title: Cannot see Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue Report View in the Projects
Content: Symptom-In the project document, you cannot see the Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue report details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Select the relevant Project and select Edit-Navigate to Project Overview tab and select sub tab Reports-You cannot see the Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue report details-Cause-The report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure (FINCACU04_Q0004) is not assigned to the work center view and hence you cannot see under reports tab of Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue details.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to assign the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report.-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Go to the Design Reports view-Select the report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure-Select Assignment Overview button-Select the report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure for Projects work center view-Select Save -Keywords-Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue missing; Project Cost and Revenue report; Project Cost and Revenue bar chart missing

Title: Tasks 'Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request' Are Going to Unexpected Persons Responsible
Content: Symptom-Tasks 'Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request' are being assigned to unexpected Persons Responsible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Work view.-Go to Inbox sub-view.-Open any 'Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request' task.-System is determining unexpected Persons Responsible for the tasks.-Cause-This Escalation Tasks are relevant to the manager working in the operational Purchasing Org Unit maintained in the Purchase Request or any alternative approver for the operational Purchasing Org Unit or Cost Center.-In case no Purchasing Unit is maintained in the Purchase Request, no Cost Center and no managers are defined to the Company in the Organization Management Work Center, then the task is sent to everyone by default so that someone can take an action on it and the task is not kept unassigned in the system.-Resolution-This is the current system expected behavior.-See Also-Help Document Task – Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request-Keywords-Escalation Task, Purchasing Unit, Purchase Request, Assign Supplier

Title: No Access on Invoices and Credit Memos
Content: Symptom-When trying to open invoices and credit memos in the Supplier Invoicing work center, the following error occurs: "You are not authorized to access to the data". This happens although all relevant access rights exist and the view SRM_SUPPLIERINVOICING is assigned to the relevant business user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue--1. Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-2. Select Invoices and Credit Memos subview-3. Select All Documents and find the relevant invoice-4. When trying to edit the invoice the error appears: "You are not authorized to access to the data"-Cause-This may happen in relation to purchase orders with multiple invoices with quantity variances. The issue appears after trying to approve all invoices at once. During approval, actual values of the first invoice get updated. This action effects the next invoice and creates a quantity variance exception. The document will nevertheless have an approved status.-Resolution-To avoid this issue, approve such invoices one by one.-To solve the issue, involve SAP Support and provide the permission to withdraw the affected invoices from approval in the backend.-Support will make these invoices available again. Then it will be possible to accept the variance, to approve the invoices one by one and to post them.-Keywords-Supplier Invoicing; Credit Memos; Invoices; SRM_SUPPLIERINVOICING

Title: Key Figure "Actual Work (d)" Shows Wrong Value in Report
Content: Symptom-You are working with the report Project Time Recordings and the key figure Actual Work (d). Now you notice that this key figure shows 0, even when work was recorded against this project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Search for the report Project Time Recordings and open it.-Set the variables as required and run the report.-Check the key figure Actual Work (d). It shows 0.-Cause-The Actual Work (d) key figure for a project in the mentioned report is calculated only if the field Hours per working Day has been entered for the respective project. You can find this field in the Project Plan, under the Work tab for the project root task.-Note: If you have defined the Unit of Work as Working Days then it is mandatory to fill in the Hours Per Working Day. If you have taken Hours as the unit of work, then you are not obliged to fill in this field.-Resolution-To make use of this key figure, please fill in a value in the Hours Per Working Day field in the project. Please note that this can only be done as long as no any time confirmations have been made for the project.-Keywords-PROPRJU05_Q0001, project time recordings, actual work, actual hours, istarbeit in tagen, report wrong, missing data, key figure shows 0,

Title: How to Clear Negative On-Hand Stock
Content: Symptom-You want to clear your On-Hand Stock, since there are negative quantities for Product XXX (XXX represents the Product ID) in Stock Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Stock Overview common tasks.-Search for Product ID XXX.-Click on Go button.-You notice that there is negative On-Hand Stock for Product XXX.-Cause-The negative quantity is appearing in Stock Overview because the quantity is still In-Transit.-You can perform an In-Transit Inventory Adjustment in order to remove the quantity.-Resolution-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select the Adjust In-Transit Stock view. -Select the line that you want to adjust.-Click Adjust In-Transit Stock to Zero button.-Please note that you need to do it for every product in which you want to clear the On-Hand Stock.-Keywords-Negative Stock; On-Hand Stock;

Title: Error in Intercompany Sales Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have created intercompany sales order from purchase order, however intercompany sales order is in error status.-Error - City in address of Bill-To party missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the Purchase Order 123 (123 is purchase order ID)-Select Edit and navigate to Document Flow-You can see the Intercompany Sales Order-Open the document & you can see the error message-Cause-In purchasing we treat Bill-To as an org and in sales order it is treated as a business partner. Hence it should fetch the address from address snap shot of functional unit and customer needs to maintain the address in org unit from Organizational Management work center.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center-Go to the Common Tasks and select Edit Org Structures-Select the relevant Org Unit and navigate to Addresses tab-Under Bill-To address section, you need to maintain the complete address-Select Activate & Activate Selected Structure-Select Save and Close-Keywords-City in address of Bill-To party missing; Error in IC Sales Order; IC PO; Bill-To party missing

Title: Error Occurs While Activating Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-You are trying to activate the Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders, however system shows the error message up on selecting Save and Activate button.-Error - Decision table not activated; default entry (*) missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Common Tasks view -Select Define Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders-Select Save and Activate-Error occurs-Cause-In order for auto create purchase order from purchase request, there needs to be a default row maintained always with below values. Without this rule there will be no fall back behavior and the creation may result in error which is why a check was introduced to make sure this fall back is maintained.-Company ID                      Supplier ID                       Origin Type              Product Category             Creating options-         *                                     *                                        *                                   *                            Create manually / Create automatically-Resolution-Irrespective of what other rules the user sets up, the above rule should mandatory be maintained as the last row of the rule table the creating options can be set as manual or automatic but all other attributes should have value.-See Also-You can also refer to Help Document:-Configuration: Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders-Keywords-Decision table not activated; default entry (*) missing; Error while activating decision table; Decision table

Title: Error: 'Employee with user name ABC not found' While Creating a Goods And Services Receipt Via Web Service
Content: Symptom-Error: 'Employee with user name ABC not found' while creating a Goods and Services Receipt via Web Service (ABC represents the User ID logged in the SOAP UI).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to SOAP UI-Click to create a new project.-Open the respective WSDL.-Expand the ManageGSAInMaintainBundle.-Double click on Request1.-Enter the XML with the Goods and Services Receipt to be created.-Run the XML.-System displays the error: Employee with user name ABC not found-Cause-The message which is displayed is an information message. The system basically tells if the created user is an employee or not. In this case , the communication arrangement user is a technical one and hence the warning message.-Resolution- This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords- SOAP UI, Goods and Services Receipt, Web Service

Title: Automatic ATP Check in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You want the system to immediately trigger an availability check when the product details are entered in the sales order. The ATP check should be triggered without you selecting the Check Availabiltiy button available in the order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the button New Sales Order.-In the New Sales Order screen you see that the the availability check will be triggered only when the Check Availability button is selected by the you.-You expect the ATP (availability check) to be triggered as soon as you finish entering the product quantity and requested date in the line items automatically.-Cause-You have not maintained the settings in Business Configuration for the system to automatically trigger the ATP check in sales order.-Resolution-Follow below given steps to make sure that the system perform synchronous ATP check in sales order when relevant item details are entered.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and choose the button Edit Project Scope.-Choose Next button to navigate to the Questions section.-Expand the element Sales and then sub-element Selling Products and Services.-Select the Sales Orders option under Selling Products and Services.-In the section Questions for Sales Orders, under the group Available to promise policy select the question Do you want to immediately confirm quantities and requested dates during sales order creation based on an availability check?-Chooese Next and Finish the review of the options selected.-Once the above steps are performed, availability check in sales orders will be triggered automatically when product quantity and requested date information is entered for a line item.-Keywords-ByD availability check, Automatic availability Check sales order ByD, Synchronous availability check ByD Sales Order, automatic availability check referesh in ByD Sales order

Title: You are Trying to Filter Customer Demand Line Items With Confirmed Execution Start Date Before or on a Certain Date.
Content: Symptom-You apply a filter to identify the goods that are ready to dispatch in the Customer Demand Advanced Filter view. You only want to see line items that are available for delivery (Confirmed Stock) on a particular date and maintain all parameters accordingly. But the system displays also line items with a confirmed date in the future.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to the Customer Demand view.-Show All Orders By Selection.-Select the Advanced filter.-Maintain the Availability Status field: Equals To: Confirmed insufficiently; Equals To: Confirmed Sufficiently; Equals To: Confirmation Pending.-Maintain the Release Status field: Equals To: Partially Released; Equals To: Not Released.-Maintain the Delivery Status field: Equals To: In Process; Equals To: Not started.-Maintain the Delivery Block Status field: 1 - Not Blocked (To show this field, you may need to personalize it).-Maintain the Cancellation Status: Not Canceled.-Maintain the Date Type: Confirmed Execution Start Date.-Restrict the Date: Less Than or Equals To dd/mm/yyyy (dd/mm/yyyy represents the required key date).-Execute the Query-Instead of showing only line items with Confirmed Execution Start Date before and on the date dd/mm/yyyy, the system displays also Demand Schedule Lines with confirmed Execution Start Date beyond the dd/mm/yyyy.-Cause-The system behavior is correct. When the Confirmed Execution Start Date is used on the Customer Demand Object Work List (OWL), it also considers confirmation schedule lines for which a fulfillment has already been posted. In case a schedule line has been fulfilled, the corresponding confirmation schedule line may have an Execution Start Date before the Key Date dd/mm/yyyy).-Hence the OWL behavior is correct. It is meant to query items and schedule lines based on the confirmed date – irrespective of whether the schedule lines have been fulfilled or not.-Resolution-In case you wish to check these dates to release the items for execution, you may use the Delivery Due List OWL. This OWL only considers schedule lines that haven’t been fulfilled. If you execute this OWL query for the same Document ID, Date Type and Date, you will not see the schedule lines that have a confirmation date beyond the key date of dd/mm/yyyy.-Keywords-Confirmed, Schedule, Line, Execution, start, date, Delivery, due, List, customer, demand

Title: Outbound Delivery Not Created
Content: Symptom-You have confirmed your pick task and the status of the task is updated to Finished. The outbound delivery document does not get created for the relevant task.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logisitcs work center. -Navigate to the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant task, select it and choose the Confirm button.-Choose the Save button after making the relevent entries for the task line items. -The status of the task is updated to Finished. -After performing the above steps you are not able to view an outbound delivery document in the Outbound Deliveries view under the same work center.-Cause-You have reported deviation for one or more of the line items via entering value in the field Deviation Reason in the relevant pick task screen. If a deviation is reported in a pick task, the warehouse manager has to either approve or reject the reported deviation. Once deviation is approved the relevant outbound delivery document will be created in the system.-Resolution-Follow below given steps to accept or reject the reported deviation.-Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Monitoring view and choose the option By Warehouse Order. -Search and select the warehouse order for the above mentioned pick task. -Choose the Edit button, navigate to the Operations tab.-You will be able to see the Deviation column having a Red traffic light against the line items for which deviations was reported. -You can choose either of the three options Accept Deviation, Accept Deviation and Reject Open Quantity or Reprocess Open Quantity as per your business use case. -If you choose Accept Deviation or Accept Deviation and Reject Open Quantity the system will create the outbound delivery without the items for which deviation was reported.-Keywords-No outbound delivery visible, ByD, Outbound delivery not created in ByD, report deviation in task, accepting deviation in pick task, accept deviaiton

Title: Supplier Email Address is Not Displayed in Purchase Order Form Template
Content: Symptom-You have customized a Purchase Order form template and trying to display the Supplier Email Address value in the form template but the field is not showing any value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Orders-Search for the existing Purchase Order-Select Preview-The Supplier Email address field is empty-Cause-The email address of the supplier was updated recently after the Purchase Order was created, hence for existing orders, system will not display the field in form template.-Resolution-Please create a new Purchase Order and now the fields will be correctly displayed in the form template.-Any changes done in the system will be effective only for newly created documents.-Keywords-Purchase Order Form Template, Supplier email address, preview, create form, change form

Title: Goods And Service Receipt Shows Yesterday's Date As Default Delivery Date
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new goods and service receipt and the default delivery date is shown as yesterday.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Goods and Service Receipts.-Go to the view Purchase Orders to be delivered.-Select Show by Documents.-Select the relevant purchase order.-Click New Goods and Service Receipt.-The default Delivery Date for the item is yesterday. You expect it to be automatically shown as today.-Cause-This is the current system behavior.-Resolution-A fix will be provided for this issue in a future release. For now the delivery date has to be changed manually.-Keywords-goods, service, receipt, delivery, date, yesterday, gestern, Servicebeleg,

Title: Supplier Invoice Approval Skipping Invoicing Unit Manager
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoice Approval is skipping Invoicing Unit manager and going to the next manager in Organization Chart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search and open the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of Supplier Invoice).-Click on View All button.-Go to Approval tab.-Approval is going to the next Org Unit manager instead of Invoicing Unit manager.-Cause-The Valid To Date of Invoicing Unit manager has expired. To see this, follow the steps below:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search and open the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of Supplier Invoice).-Click on View All button.-Click on Parties and Locations subtab.-Take a note on the Invoicing Unit ID.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures view.-Select the current date for Currently Selected Date field.-Click on Ok.-Click on Find button.-Search and select the Invoicing Unit ID.-Click on Locate.-Click on Timelines tab.-Organizational Unit Manager Valid To Date is expired.-Resolution-In order to extend the Valid To Date perform the following steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures view.-Select the current date for Currently Selected Date field.-Click on Ok.-Click on Find button.-Search and select the Invoicing Unit ID.-Click on Locate.-Click on Edit button.-Click on Ok on the select Effective-From Date screen.-Go to the General tab.-Enter a Org Unit Manager.-Click on Save.-Now Supplier Invoice Approval will go to Invoicing Unit Manager. -Keywords-Invoicing Unit Manager, Supplier Invoice Approval, Org Unit Manager

Title: Unable to preview Packing List in Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-Unable to find Preview button in Packing List for Outbound Delivery DEF (DEF refers to Outbound Delivery id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to  Outbound Deliveries View-Search for Outbound Delivery DEF-Select DEF and Select Packing button-You observe "Save and Print" Option is shown, However  preview button is missing.-Resolution-In order to preview Packing List, follow the below steps-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to  Outbound Deliveries View-Search for Outbound Delivery DEF-Select DEF and Select Packing button-Under the Packages View click Insert Package > Insert Top Package-Select the Logistics Unit ID and Select OK-Select on the Package ID from the General tab-You’ll find the Preview option on the top left corner-Note: You can only preview Packing List for Release status of type  "Not released" status Outbound Deliveries.-Keywords-Preview Packing List, Unable to preview packing list in Outbound Delivery, Unable to find Preview button in Packing List for Outbound Delivery,Save and Print" Option is shown, However  preview button is missing

Title: Same Fulfillment is Not Applied to All Line Items in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are changing the Fulfillment for one Line Item in the Sales Order XXX and you expect that the same Fulfillment be applied to all Line Items, however it doesn't happen. All the Line Items are in the same Delivery Group and Complete Delivery is checked.-XXX = Sales Order ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select Sales Orders view.-Search for Sales Order XXX.-Open the Sales Order XXX.-Select View All.-Choose Items tab.-Select any Line Item.-Change the Fulfillment to Internal or External.-Notice that the same Fulfillment is not applied to the other Line Items.-Cause-When we change the fulfillment type to Internal or External, system changes fulfillment type to external only for the selected line item. This is the expected system behavior because on change of fulfillment type, that particular Line Item will be moved to another Delivery Group. If Fulfillment type is not changed and Ship-from is changed manually for one line item, Ship From determination will be repeated for all the items and if the items are available from the Location.-Resolution-The system is working as expected, as the system will not apply the same Fulfillment for all Line Items.-Keywords-Determination-Source-Fulfillment

Title: IFRS16 - How to Complete Automatic Invoicing for Lease Contracts
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to complete automatic invoicing for Lease Contracts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There is a work center view titled Lease Contract Invoice Runs. This view is available to create and schedule runs for Lease Contract Automatic Invoicing.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the view Lease Contract Invoice Runs.-Here you can create and schedule a new run for specific criteria that you enter.-Keywords-IFRS16, Lease Contract, Automatic Invoicing, Invoice Runs, schedule run

Title: What determines the number of Purchase orders to be created when you bundle Purchase request line items
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know what is causing the creation of many Purchase orders when bundling Purchase request Items of same Purchase request.- or- Purchase order is not created as per Bundling rule you have chosen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Along with bundle and order option that you choose system also considers the currency of each Purchase request item to split as per currency and create Purchase orders separately for each currency.-Resolution-This is generic split rule existing in system currently.-See Also-2706196 - How the Currency of Purchase Order that is Created From Purchase Request is Determined-Keywords-Wrong Purchase order,  Purchase order created wrongly

Title: Workflow Rule 'On Create Only' Does Not Work In All Situations
Content: Symptom-Your workflow rule does not work as expected when you use the timing 'On Create Only'.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The same is true for many options. As example, you can have a workflow rule for the BO: Sales Orders, On Create Only. As Condition you are using Status=Open. Your plan is to have a field update triggered.-Cause-On Create Only: the rule is applied at every Create of the business object instance.-During creation, the object does not yet have a status. The status will be triggered on the save only.  At creation stage, this workflow rule cannot be called.-Resolution-Change the creation time to be after creation: scheduled.-See Also-SAP Cloud for Customer Help Portal: Configure Workflow Rules

Title: Updating the Deduction and Surcharges in Supplier Invoices via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are creating a supplier invoice (without a reference of purchase order) via a web service, you are unable to update the details under Deductions And Surcharges tab .-Environment-Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently system is not developed to support the creation of deductions and surcharges for supplier invoices via web service.-Resolution-You could add this requirement in our Customer Influence Forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Supplier Invoices; web servic; deductions and surcharges;

Title: Invoice Schedule Incorrect After Price Change
Content: Symptom-You adjust the pricing in a partially invoiced sales order with project binding.-You have not scoped late price changes in project based sales orders.-The Invoice Schedule is not correctly adjusted to the new price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order workcenter.-Open the Sales Order view.-Open Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Add line Item 10.-Add a list price of e.g. 100 Euro.-Create an Invoice schedule for line item 10 with 2 dates, invoicing 50 Euro on each date.-Release the Sales Order.-Invoice the first invoice schedule item.-Navigate to the Items tab and change the list price to e.g. 80 Euro.-Open the invoice schedule for line item 10.-The invoice schedule shows an invoiced amount of 40 Euro for the invoiced line, instead of 50.-Cause-This is currently a limitation on Price changes in partially invoiced, project based sales orders.-When adjusting the price of a line item, which is partially invoiced the already invoiced values in the invoice schedule are recalculated based on the new price.-This is adjusted in a future release, so that project based sales orders share the same behavior as sales orders without project base.-To prevent this behavior, you can scope late changes on project based sales orders if you would like to change prices on partially invoiced invoice schedules.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Open the Implementation Project view.-Select your Implementation Project and click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to 4. Questions.-Select scoping element Sales, Sell Project-Based Products and Services.-Tick the checkbox on question "Do you want to allow late changes to Quantity, Price and Ship-to for project-based services?".-With this question enabled, the adjustment of the invoice schedule in project based sales orders works as expected.-Keywords-Project based Sales Order, Invoice Schedule, Price Change, Invoiced Amount, Projektbasierende Kundenaufträge, Rechnungsterminplan, Preisänderung, Abgerechnete Summe

Title: How to edit return reason for new Return to Supplier
Content: Symptom-You want to add customized return reasons for new Return to Supplier document, and you are wondering where to edit it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to New Return to Supplier under Common Tasks section.-Select Inbound Delivery Items and click on "Next".-In the Edit Return to Supplier step, under items tab, you want to add new reasons for return in the dropdown value list.-Cause-You need to edit the new return reason from Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-Follow the steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Select "Activities" from the dropdown.-Search for activity "Return Reason Code".-Click on "Add Row".-You can delete and add new reasons for return start with Z, and edit your customized description.-Then if you create new Return to Supplier, the customized reasons will show in the value list.-Keywords-Return to Supplier, Return Reason, 退货至供应商

Title: Goods and Services Receipts stuck in inter-company scenario
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post or verify a Goods and Services Receipt but it appears to be stuck and no error message appears.-Also you see that Goods receipt is not linked to any of the existing invoices nor it is open for new invoice to be created.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) work center.-Select the Receipts and Returns view.-Select the filter "All Documents".-Search and open your GSR, click to "View All".-Click to "Check": nothing happens, no messages or warnings are displayed but you are still unable to post your GSR.-Cause-You have entered a negative amount in one of the expense report items.The system would create GSR for each expense report in intercompany scenario but we do not support negative values in GSR, this is a limitation in the intercompany scenario.-Resolution-So you need to cancel this expense report and create it with an amount which will be a positive value.-Keywords-Goods and service receipt, negative value in expense report, GSR stuck, GSA stuck, cannot invoice a goods and service receipt,  intercompany goods receipt,expense invoicing.

Title: The Field Origin Project is not available in any Standard Report or Data Source
Content: Symptom-When setting up Intercompany Projects, you can see this field “Origin project” information which is a standard field added recently.-But this field seems is missing in the project related reports and data sources.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select New Project-Create a new Intercompany Project . You can see this field "Origin Project" under Project Overview screen-Now navigate to Reports view or Business Analytics work center view-Select any Project related report or Data Source-You are unable to find this field "Origin Project" in any of the standard reports or data sources-Cause-The “origin project” information is  a new field available in the Intercompany projects, but it is not part of project management data sources and there is no standard report yet.-Resolution-In order to build the custom report, you need to create:-A joined data source and-The report with selections and views.-Kindly refer the following blog to find the exact steps to create the custom report:-https://blogs.sap.com/2019/04/25/how-to-report-on-intercompany-projects-and-their-origin-projects/-Keywords-Intercompany projects, Origin Project, data source, Reports

Title: Unable to Select the Output Channel for Purchase Order Reminder Letters
Content: Symptom-You are trying to implement purchase order reminder letter functionality; however, you cannot find the output channel to send for supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase requests and orders work center -Go to the Purchase Order Reminder Letters view-Go to the Purchase Order Reminder Letter Runs sub view-Cause-You have not defined the output channel for Purchase Order Reminder Letters under Output Channel Selection view of Application and User Management work center.-How the Purchase Order Reminder Letter functionality works?-Purchase Order Reminder Letters contains two sub views.-Purchase Order Reminder Letters runs-Purchase Order Reminder Letters proposals -The Purchase Order Reminder Letter Type can be of type acknowledgement or delivery. The purchase order reminder letter run, allows you to send reminder letters to supplier for delay in acknowledgement and delivery of purchase orders based on certain criteria. You need to schedule the run & once the run is executed, system will create reminder letter proposals from the run and it is visible under Purchase Order Reminder Letter Proposals view.-The form which picks up for this functionality is Purchase Order Reminder Letter form and it is available in Form Template Maintenance view under Application and user management work center. From the Purchase Order Reminder Letter proposals, you can - Issue reminder, Finish Reminder or Set to obsolete.-Resolution-You can define output channel for Purchase Order Reminder Letter from the below steps;-Go to the Application and User Management  work center-Go to the Input and Output Management view -Go to the Output Channel Selection sub view-Select Show Rules For Purchase Order Reminder Letter-Select Go and click on Edit-Define the Parameter Settings for Business Partner and select Add Row-Define Output Channel (E-Mail, Fax, Printer) -Select Save and Close-Keywords-Purchase Order Reminder Letter; Define output channel for reminder letter; reminder letter runs

Title: How To Create A Logistics Task Folder
Content: Symptom-You want to create a logistics task folder.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the work center Planning and Production Master Data.-Go to the view Logistics Task Folders.-Click New and View All.-Enter relevant data in the tabs General, Registration and Task Assignment Criteria.-Click Save and Close.-Keywords-Logistics task folder, registration, task assignment criteria

Title: Error when trying to create a credit memo
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a credit memo for a purchase order but end up with below error message:-Quantity ABC not assigned to goods and services receipt-Sum of cash discount relevant items is negative. You can only post the supplier invoice if the sum of the cash discount relevant items is positive. Change the cash discount relevant indicator of the supplier invoice items accordingly.-Balance is not equal zero:XYZ.-The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts. You need to adjust these amounts so that the balance is zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Navigate to the Invoice Entry View.-Search the Purchase OrderABC.-Click "New Credit Memo".-Enter a quantity.-Click "Check", then the above error message will appear.-Cause-The root cause of this issue is known and a fix will be ready in the future release.-In the mean time, there is an available workaround that can be found below.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Entry View.-Select 'All Returns to Be invoiced' and provide the Goods return ID to filter.-Click 'New Credit Memo' and you would get the proposed quantity as ABC as expected.-Keywords- Credit Memo, Purchase Order, Error message, Quantity, Supplier Invoicing.

Title: Inspection task not generated for a Production Order
Content: Symptom-Check task did not generate for Inspection Type: Final Inspections - Production following a Production Order DEF (DEF refers to Production Order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Production Control Work Center-Go to Production Orders --> By Orders View-Search for DEF-Select Edit-Navigate to Document Flow-You observe check task not generated for Production Order DEF.-Cause-Check task did not trigger in Production Order as one of the below 3 prerequisites has not be met:-The inspection type Final Inspections – Production was not selected during scoping-The inspection type of this inspection plan Final Inspection – Production could not be found-In Production Model, Operation Category Quality Check is missing-If these requirements are not met, the production order cannot be released and no inspection will be created-Resolution-In order to trigger check task in Production Order, Maintain the below settings.-In Questions step of Business Configuration, Go to the Quality Assurance business area and choose Quality Control -> Questions for Quality Control. Here,  check the question Do you want to inspect finished products at the end of production?-The inspection Plan Final Inspections – Production need to be created and to be activated-Production model should contain one operation of the category Quality Check with one activity of the category Final Inspection. This check operation is the final operation in the production model-Keywords-Check Task, Production Order, Final Inspections – Production

Title: Extension Fields Are Not Sent Via XML
Content: Symptom-You want to send an XML message which contains extension fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This applies to various scenarios but this example will explain the supplier delivery notification.- Navigate to the work center Third Party Logistics.- Enter the relevant purchase order.-Click New Supplier Delivery Notification.- The Inbound Delivery page has been modified with specific fields.-When the message is sent the WSDL does not contain the additional fields in the XML.-Cause-The adding of extension fields to a web service usually depends on the web service itself. Some web services allow us to add fields and others do not support this functionality.-Resolution-To determine whether or not it is possible to add extension fields to a web service you can follow these steps:-Click the user icon and select Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Select an extension field -Click "+ extension field".-Click Further Usage and Services.-You can see which web services are available to add fields, so check mark them by selecting them and clicking on 'Add field' button.-if there is no service, it is not possible to add a field.-See Also-1764460 - How to Add Extension Field in the From Templates?-Keywords-Extension Fields, Web Services, Supplier Delivery Notification, Inbound Delivery, XML, Third Party Logistics,

Title: Self-invoice Italy-Prerequisite step
Content: Symptom-You may face this error while creating self-invoice for Italy.-Supplier invoice Error message: Supplier must not be the same as buyer-Customer invoice Error message:Account and seller are identical; change one of them-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Supplier invoicing work center- Go to common task Create new invoice without reference to Purchase order- Enter all details and click on Post-or-Go to Customer invoicing work center-Go to common task New manual Invoice-Enter all details and click on Release.-You wil get the error.-Cause-For self-invoice you need to use dummy Supplier and customer.-Resolution-Please create dummy Supplier and dummy customer with same details of your Company (Do this one time activity for each company).-Then whenever you have Non-EU invoices for this company you have to create self-invoice for it, that is one supplier invoice (incoming self-invoice) and one customer invoice (outgoing self-invoice).-See Also-Also follow steps in below link of help document for all further details about self-invoice and then click on next and next to explore fully about this topic of self-1invoice.--https://help.sap.com/viewer/2e30d84496214461ad763692c3a0b4a5/1905/en-US /d9e39ce0f074467b9a52a2eb51ae14f2.html-Keywords-Self invoice, Self invoice Italy,Supplier must not be the same as buyer

Title: Error When Creating a New Customer Return Notification
Content: Symptom-The Product AAA was delivered to one site in Sales Order CCC, however you would like to return this product to another site BBB. However, you face the error:-Warehouse provider DDD differs from warehouse provider EEE for site BBB. Both warehouse providers must be the same.-AAA – Product ID.-BBB – Site ID.-CCC – Sales Order ID.-DDD – Warehouse Provider ID.-EEE – Warehouse Provider ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select New Customer Return Notification common task.-Click Next.-Enter the Delivery Notification ID.-Add Row.-Enter the Product ID AAA.-Enter the quantity.-Fulfill the Sales Order CCC and Sales Order Item ID.-Enter the Ship-to Party and Ship-to Location BBB.-The error is displayed:-Warehouse provider DDD differs from warehouse provider EEE for site BBB. Both warehouse providers must be the same.-Cause-As a workaround for this error, you can enter the Ship-to Party and Ship-to Location before adding the product.-Resolution-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select New Customer Return Notification common task.-Click Next.-Enter the Delivery Notification ID.-Enter the Ship-to Party and Ship-to Location BBB.-Add Row.-Enter the Product ID AAA.-Enter the quantity.-Fulfill the Sales Order CCC and Sales Order Item ID.-Click Next.-Select Finish.-Keywords-Notification-Return-Reference

Title: Identified Stock ID Not Permitted; ID is System Generated
Content: Symptom-While migrating identified stock id to your system via the migration tool you receive the below error message-Identified stock ID not permitted; ID is system-generated-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and choose the button Open Activity List.-Search and find the activity Migration of Identified Stock.-Choose the relevant file and slect the option Execute Migration Step by Step.-The reported error message is displayed.-Cause-You have maintained in the system business configuration that  the identified stock Id should be created automatically by the system. When you are migrating identified stock using migration template it is mandatory that you enter the identified stock IDs from your legacy system. It is expected that the identified stock ID's of your legacy systems are being uploaded and SAP will not generate the identified stock ID's for migrated identified stocks.-Resolution-To migrate the data without errors you will have to make the following changes to your business configuration document.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Project view.-Choose Edit Project Scope.-Go to Step 4 - Questions.-Select the Element: Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Then the sub-element: Tracking, Tracing, and Identification.-Select the option Identified Stock.-Scope the below given questions as Yes (in the check box)-Do you plan to enter batch numbers manually?-Do you plan to enter optional specified stock numbers manually?-Do you plan to enter mandatory specified stock numbers manually?-Once the above steps are performed and saved you will be able to migrate the identified stocks successfully in your system. After the migration is complete you can de-scope the above questions so that manual entry of Identified stock IDs are not possible via the end user.-Keywords-identified stock migration error, cannot migration identified stock, idnetified stock id not generated while migration, error when migrating identified stock.

Title: Purchase Order Approval Task Was Sent To A Lot Of Possible Approvers
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order which was sent to approval. The approval task went to a huge number of approvers and the systems behavior is unclear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Select the common task New Purchase Order.-Click View All and fill in the relevant information.-Click Order.-Go to the tab Approval.-You can see that the approval task has been sent to a huge number of possible approvers and also users it should not have gone to.-Cause-You have not maintained a requester in the purchase order.-If the requester is not maintained, the system sends the task to all functionally authorized users instead of keeping it unassigned.-When creating a purchase order you have to maintain the requester manually to prevent this behavior.-Resolution-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Select the common task New Purchase Order.-Click View All and fill in the relevant information.-Go to the tab Items.-Go to the subtab Delivery.-Here you have to maintain the requester manually.-Keywords-purchase, order, approval, approvers, many, approval task, requester

Title: Mark Several Items for Deletion in Goods and Services Receipts
Content: Symptom-You want to use the 1905 functionality "Mark Several Items for Deletion in Goods and Services Receipts".-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Cause-New functionality introduced with 1905 release.-Resolution- Go to the Goods and Service Receipts Work Center.- Go to the Purchase Orders to Be Delivered view.- Select Outstanding Purchase Orders and find a Purchase Order with more than one item to delivery.- Click " New Goods and Service Receipt".- Under items you are now able with press the Shift button to mark all items and click remove.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: What's New in Supplier Relationship Management-Keywords-New Goods and Service Receipt

Title: Leading Zeros Are Deleted When Saving A Serial Numbers
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Customer Return Notification, the system removes leading zeros from the Delivery Notification ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to New Customer Return Notification common task.-Enter all the mandatory information. -Select Next and go to Edit Customer Return Delivery Notification section.-Enter a Delivery Notification ID XYZ starting with a leading 0.-Select Next.-The Delivery Notification ID field displays ID excluding the leading zeros.-(XYZ represents Delivery Notification ID)-Cause-Leading zeros are not supported for Delivery Notification ID in SAP Business ByDesign. The system automatically removes leading zeros.-Resolution-To preserve the leading 0 in the Delivery Notification ID, use a valid special character before the leading 0.-Keywords-Leading zero; Delivery Notification; Special character; System Behavior; Automatically Remove; Not supported; Customer Return; Exclude

Title: Error message:Some sales orders cannot be released; check document status
Content: Symptom-While releasing customer demand of project related sales order you get this error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound logistics control work center-Go to Customer demand-Search for respective Sales Order-Select it and click on Release- You will get the error.-Cause-The respective project task of those sales order items is already completed and thus you are getting error, hence for those line items you cannot release sales order.-Resolution-Please release the respective Project tasks and then release Sales order.-Keywords-Unable to release sales order, project sales order has error, Project sales order is not released, Sales order project not released.

Title: Remaining Work Shows Incorrect Value in the Projects
