Content: Symptom-You have performed actual work however the remaining work shows incorrectly in the projects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Select the relevant Project ID-Navigate to Project Plan tab and select the relevant Project Task-Navigate to Work tab-Here you can see that Remaining Work shows incorrectly-Cause-In the Edit Period Plans section, you have unassigned entry. The marked line holds the planned, actual and remaining work that do not fall in a planned time frame of the period plan. Once the hours are assigned properly, system will minus the actual work from planned work & shows the remaining work correctly.-Resolution-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Select the relevant Project ID-Navigate to Project Plan tab and select the relevant Project Task-Navigate to Work tab and select the Service-Assign the unassigned Planned Work to Actual Work where you have recorded Actual Work-Select Save-Now system shows the correct value under Remaining Work-Keywords-Incorrect Remaining work; calculation erros on the number of hours remaing; number of hours remaining incorrect

Title: Down payment not linked to ERS run Supplier Invoice and recurring invoice
Content: Symptom-You have Eligible Downpayment, but it's not picked automatically in the ERS run Supplier invoice or recurring invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Supplier invoicing work center- Go to Invoices and credit memos- Go to advanced filter, Search for Invoice that has entry method as ERS Run or Recurring invoice- Go to General tab- Navigate to Payment information tab-where you can see no downpayment is appearing.-Cause-Since ERS run invoices and Recurring invoice are created automatically and posted, we don't allow any down payments to be linked.--also the downpayments if assigned they cannot be adjusted for partial amount to be used up in the Invoices. Thus, we don't allow currently.-Resolution-We think currently that even though we enable it, the functionality as explained above will not be complete.---Please submit your requirement on Customer Influence Forum at below link-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Downpayment not linked to ERS run Supplier Invoice,Downpayment not linked to Recurring Invoice, Downpayment not appearing in ERS run Supplier Invoice,Downpayment not appearing in recurring Invoice,Downpayment, ERS Run invoice,recurring invoice

Title: How Due Date is Determined in the Supplier invoice which is Uploaded via Excel?
Content: Symptom-Document due date is automatically filled in the supplier invoice when the invoice is uploaded via excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Select New-Select Import Via Microsoft Excel-Login to Bydesign system from the excel and enter the mandatory fields-Select Save to to upload the invoice in the system-The document Due Date is automatically filled in the uploaded invoice-Cause-The Due date of the invoice is taken from the Document Date field which is entered in the excel.-Resolution-Please fill this Document Date field correctly so that Due date is correctly filled in the uploaded invoice.-Note: Please ensure Payment Baseline Date column is not filled in the excel which may overwrite document due date .-Keywords-Document date, Due Date, Invoice date, excel upload

Title: Purchase Order Volume Report Does not Return any Results
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order Volume report shows records when accessed from "Business Analytics work center - Design Reports view".-However when tried to execute the same from "Purchase Requests and Orders work center - Reports view", message pops up: "No report data available to display; check the selection". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Reports view.-Search for report "Purchase Order Volume".-It does not display any data , message pops up: No report data available to display; check the selection-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for report "Purchase Order Volume".-Data is available with the same selection criteria. -Cause-There are two "Purchase Order Volume" reports available in the system. They are:-Mobile Report ID: SRMPO_B02_MQ0009-Standard (desktop/browser version) Report ID: SRMPO_B02_Q0009-The user has assigned both Mobile and Browser based reports in the system for the Purchase Requests and Orders work center. This causes conflicts in the system. -Resolution-As the desktop report works correctly in both work centers, the user has to unassign the Mobile report and just use the Desktop version only. This can be done by following the steps below: -Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for report "Purchase Order Volume".-Select Assign button.-Filter for work center "Purchase requests and Orders".-Uncheck the Mobile report.-Now the error message shouldn't be triggered anymore. -Keywords-Purchase order volume report, mobile based report, browser based report, standard report, Purchase order volume, No report data available to display, SRMPO_B02_MQ0009, SRMPO_B02_Q0009

Title: Purchase Request shows status "No Follow-up"， even if there is Purchase Order created.
Content: Symptom-You have created follow-up Purchase Orders against the Purchase Request, you are expecting the status of Purchase Request turns into "Purchase Order Created". However, it is still in status "No Follow-up".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Open the affected Purchase Request, you will find the status of Purchase Request is "No Follow-up".-However, if you navigate to document flow tab, you can see the follow-up Purchase Order has already been created and sent.-Cause-The status of Purchase Request item is set to  'Purchase Order Created' after the complete quantity in Purchase Request is consumed into Purchase Order(s).-If the Purchase Request is partially ordered, it will show the status "No Follow-up".-Resolution-This is a designed behavior. If the status is set to 'Purchase Order Created' on partially ordered Purchase Request, then the Purchase Request item which still has quantity yet to be consumed will no more appear in 'Open Purchase Requests' query and the corresponding 'Create Purchase Order' task will also be not active. Hence, system designed in this way.-Keywords-Purchase Request status, Purchase Order created, No Follow-up

Title: Assigned Project Work Package Is Not Visible on Add Time Entry Screen
Content: Symptom-When editing an time sheet, you are missing an assigned project work package in the list of Current Work Packages in Add Time Entry screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in with your user.-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view.-Click Edit Time Sheet.-Select the current week, click Add Time Entry.-In the list of Current Work Packages, you cannot find a work package of project task ABC (ABC refers to the project task ID), although it's already assigned to you.-Cause-The work package for project task ABC exists, but it is in an inactive or hidden status. You can check it via click Manage My Worklist, view Inactive Work Packages.-There could be mutiple reasons that can lead to an inactive or hidden status.-The user himself/herself deleted the work package from his/her active worklist by clicking on Manage My Worklist button in Edit Time Sheet screen.-After the project task has been completed, the system automatically hides the work package for the ease of access.-Resolution-You can manually make the work package active/visible in your worklist with following steps.-In Edit Time Sheet screen, click Manage My Worklist.-Change the view from Active Work Packages to Inactive Work Packages, find the respective work package.-Expand the window, click on the red traffic light under Visibility column.-The work package disappears from the list of Inactive Work Packages. If you change the view to Active Work Packages, it is showing there.-Save the changes and go back to the time sheet again.-Now you can find the work package in the list of Current Work Packages in Add Time Entry screen.-Note the following exception:-Projects assigned via the time sheet will not be retrieved if hidden, as it is assumed that they are no longer needed or will not be worked on. A clean-up of the work lists is executed, to maintain current work packages, to prevent excessive growth affecting performance, and also for usability issues. If the projects are required again by the employee, then they must be entered again manually. They will be carried forward to the following weeks up to end date of the project, or until they are hidden again by the employee.-Keywords-Project Work Package, Add Time Entry, Manage My Worklist, does, show up

Title: Connection error appears while checking the consistency of Bill of Operations
Content: Symptom-Error appears while checking consistency for Production Bill of Operations DEF (DEF refers to Bill of Operation id) after setting up a structure with Connection CONN_001 (CONN_001 refers to Connection id)-Bill of operations DEF not consistent-End reporting point must precede connection CONN_001-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-Go to Production Bills Of Operation View-Search for DEF BOO-Select Edit-Check consistency for structure-Error  appears-Bill of operations DEF not consistent-End reporting point must precede connection CONN_001-Cause-Reporting point is missing before connection element CONN_001 of Bill of Operations DEF.-Resolution-Maintain Reporting point before the connection.-- You will have to add a MARK before CONN_001 as reporting point. Follow the below steps-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-Go to Production Bills Of Operation View-Search for DEF BOO-Select Edit-Navigate to Structure tab-Select One step above to Connection element and select Insert Mark with Reporting Point Checked-Keywords-End reporting point must precede connection, Bill of operations  not consistent,Connection error appears while checking the consistency of Bill of Operations

Title: Planning Run is Not Creating Any Proposal for New Product
Content: Symptom-You created the Planning Run XXX, however it does not plan the brand new product which were never planned before.-XXX = Planning Run ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Planning Runs view.-Find the Run XXX.-Select Schedule.-Select Start Immediately.-Choose Save and Close.-The new Application Log created is successful, however the new product is not planned.-Cause-The system is working as designed, the Planning Run will not automatically plan the product for the first time. You need to do it manually and then the Planning Run will work normally.-Resolution-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Find the relevant new Product.-Select the new Product.-Click Open.-Select Run Planning.-Choose Single or Multi BoM Level.-Click Ok.-The proposal will be created manually.-See Also-2504532 - System Not Creating Planning Proposals via Automated Planning Run-Keywords-Planning-MRP-Run

Title: Supplier Invoice Cannot be Posted
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Supplier Invoice but while doing so you receive an error message: "The following errors have been addressed to your service provider - Supplier Invoice ABC cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting). Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically". (ABC represents the Supplier Invoice ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Select the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Search your Supplier Invoice ABC.-From the Document Flow tab, you can see a red open error icon displayed.-When you click it, you can see this error message: "The following errors have been addressed to your service provider - Supplier Invoice ABC cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting). Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically". -Cause-One of the reasons for this error message can be that the product category used in the Supplier Invoice is not enabled and therefore cannot be used to be assigned for any product in the system.-Resolution-To check the Product Category on the Supplier Invoice:-Open the Supplier Invoice ABC.-Go to Items tab and select the relevant Item.-On Basic Data sub-tab you will notice the Product Category.-Then to check if the Product Category is enabled:-Select the work center Product Data.-Select the view Product Categories.-Enable the product category you wish to use in your supplier invoice.-Keywords-Supplier invoice, product categories, error message.

Title: How to add extension field to Excel
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to add any Extension Field to the Microsoft Excel Template, as you have noticed that when opening the Supplier Invoice Excel Template, some of the fields are not displaying as expected or when updating an already maintained fields in the  Excel template, the values are not getting retrieved by the system for newly created entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Excel Template.-See that the expected field is not available.-Cause-Not all fields are available in the Standard Excel Template, the change need to be done by Partner. If you already added the field and is still not being displayed, the extended field could be mapped incorrectly in XML.-Resolution-Please contact your partners to go through the details given in the document attached to resolve this issue.-Restructure the excel mapping for extension field and try updating the same.-See Also-For more information on how to add an Extension Field in the Excel, please check the following Blog post: -How to Add Extension Field in Supplier Invoice Upload Excel Template?-Keywords-Add Extension Fields to Excel, Extension Field, Excel Add-in, Microsoft Excel

Title: No Input Details Displayed Against Production Order in NewReplenishment for Reference
Content: Symptom-You want to create a Replenishment task via reference of a Production Order however system does not display any input product data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Choose New Replenishment for Reference sub view.-In field Production Order ID, choose required order ID via value selection.-Choose Go.-Here system does not display any input data details though valid order exists.-Cause-The system does not propose an input product if it is already specified for use in a supply operation in the production order. You have marked the checkbox for Supply to Production under BoO Details in relevant Production Model created for a product.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Models view.-Choose All Production Models by selection and find relevant Production Model ID.-Select and edit it.-Navigate to Bill of Operations tab, go to BoO Details subtab.-Here you can see Supply to Production is Enabled.-Choose Enable/Disable button again to Disable the option.-Check Consistency and perform Save.-Release it for Planning and Execution.-Now for new Production Orders, system will allow to create Replenishment with reference of production order displaying all Input Products.-See Also-Help Document: Production Order Based Replenishment-Keywords-Replenishment task, New Replenishment for Reference, Supply to Production

Title: No “Subscribe to Email” icon in Notification.
Content: Symptom-When click to open Notification in the side menu, you find it doesn't have Subscribe/Unsubscribe icon that to subscribe notification to Email.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Login with a business user.-Click on Notification in the side menu.-You find each Notification doesn't have Subscribe/Unsubscribe icon.-Cause-User is unable to view Subscribe/Unsubscribe icon in notification since related scoping question under Business Configuration is not maintained.-Resolution-To activate this function, please ask your administrator to do the following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Edit Project Scope-Navigate to Questions step.-Click to open “Communication and Information Exchange”.-Select “Business Process Management” and open the first element.-Please check question “Do you want to use e-mail to notify business users about Business Task Management items?”-Keywords-Subscribe to Email; Subscribe; Unsubscribe; notification setting;

Title: Not Assigned (#) Values in Material Supply and Demand List Report
Content: Symptom-When reporting on Material Supply and Demand List data source, you noticed there are entries where characteristic fields "Document ID" and "Source" are displaying Not Assigned (#) value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Report work center view.-Search for the Material Supply and Demand List report (you can also open the data source in Preview mode from the Design Data Sources work center view).-Apply the relevant filters to the report in the Selection pane (make sure you insert filter into "Supply Planning Area ID" field, which is recommended).-Click on Apply to update the report results.-The entries belonging to category "Available Stock" are displaying Not Assigned (#) values for the characteristic fields "Document ID" and "Source".- Note that it is highly recommended to apply filters on "Supply Planning Area ID" field in report Selection, otherwise you may experience timeout issues.-Cause-The category "Available Stock" has no Document ID and Source data linked to it by default. This is the expected behavior from Supply Planning perspective. You can crosscheck that by following the below steps:-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products work center view.-Select the filter to display "All Products".-Search for the relevant Product (in the report it is named as "Material ID").-Select the relevant entry and click on "Open Product Planning Details" button.-In the Product Planning Details window, under Supply and Demand List section you can see that the category "Available Stock" has no Document ID and Source data linked to it.-Resolution-This is the correct behaviour when the data is not maintained.-See Also-2641874 - Sales Order Missing in Supply Planning 'Product Planning Details'-Keywords-Not Assigned Values; # in Material Supply and Demand List; Not Assigned Material Supply and Demand List;

Title: "Is Not" and "Contains Not" Conditions Not Working in Material Supply and Demand List Data Source
Content: Symptom-When using conditions like "Is Not" or "Contains Not" in data source Material Supply and Demand List, the report is bringing no results, when actually there are values to be retrieved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Sources work center view.-Search for the Material Supply and Demand List data source.-Click on the Preview button to open the data source in preview mode.-In the Selection pane, locate the field you want to filter by.-Click on the ">" symbol on the left hand side of the field. It will enable a drill-down box with the filtering conditions.-Select the condition "!= is not" or "!~ contains not".-Click on the value help icon, on the right hand side of the field.-In the value help window, select the entry you want to be excluded from report results.-Click on OK.-In the report Selection pane, click on Apply to update the report results.-No results are displayed at all.-Cause-The data source Material Supply and Demand List does not support using such conditions as "!= is not" or "!~ contains not".-Resolution-If using these conditions is mandatory for your specific business need, you can export the data source / report into an Excel file and apply filters from Excel to exclude the desired entries from the report table.- Note that it is highly recommended to apply filters on "Supply Planning Area ID" field in report Selection, otherwise you may experience timeout issues.-See Also-2780638 - Cannot Filter Dates in Material Supply and Demand List Data Source-Keywords-Conditions in Material Supply and Demand List; Conditions not working; Cannot use conditions;

Title: Cannot Filter Dates in Material Supply and Demand List Data Source
Content: Symptom-When reporting on data source Material Supply and Demand List, you are manually inserting values for field "Date" under Selection pane, however no values are retrieved in report results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data Sources work center view.-Search for Material Supply and Demand List data source.-Click on Preview button to open the data source in preview mode.-In the Selection pane, insert the desired time frame for field Date (e.g. DD/MM/YYYY).-Click on Apply button to update the data source results.-Go into View pane and insert relevant characteristics to the report Results.-See that report results are not retrieved for the provided time frame in field Date.-Cause-The time frame is being inserted in wrong format in field Date.-The correct Date format for this particular is YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.0000000. The Value help function is not available due to system performance reasons, since the same generally brings lots of entries, retrieving all the date related information from backend which could easily lead to time out issues. If you need to filter by Date field, the above date format should be used.-Resolution-In order to filter by field Date, you can insert the date using this example: 20.190.822.025.000,0000000 (In this example the date would be 22nd August 2019 at 02h50m00s). To retrieve data from a specific time range you can define a "Between" condition for this filter, as below:-In the Selection pane, click on the symbol ">" on the left hand side of field Date. It will enable a drill down box with filtering conditions.-Click on the drill down box to expand the filter conditions.-Select "[...] is between".-Another text box will appear for Date field in the Selection pane.-Insert the time range you are looking to filter by (e.g. 20.190.622.025.000,0000000 and 20.190.822.025.000,0000000).-Click on Apply button.-Report results will reflect the time range provided.- Note that it is highly recommended to apply filters on "Supply Planning Area ID" field in report Selection, otherwise you may experience timeout issues.-See Also-2780715 - Cannot Use "Is Not" Condition in Material Supply and Demand List Data Source-Keywords-Material Supply and Demand List; Date filter; Cannot Filter; Date Value Help;

Title: Sales Order Attachments are not visible in corresponding Project invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-Attachments are not getting copied from Sales Order to Project Invoice Requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the view Project invoicing.-Go to the Sales Orders sub view.-Search for the relevant Sales Order.-Create a Project invoice Request.-The attachment from Sales order has not been carried over to the Invoice Request-Cause-Attachments will not reflect from the Sales Order to the Project Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Alternatively, a new Improvement Request can be submitted on SAP Customer Influence website.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request, sales order, attachments

Title: Error Occurs While Confirming Unload Task in Spare Part Returns
Content: Symptom-When doing the confirmation for the unload task, system throws the error message:-Business residence cannot be determined. Check that the products have been posted to the custodian as you cannot post products from the custodian before they have been posted to the custodian. Or, check that your master data for the log. area is complete-and you are unable to complete the process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search and select the task ID.-Select the Confirm button. A new window opens.-Enter the quantity values and select Save button, system throws the error message.-Cause-There is no custodian stock for the product in stock overview. When performing a spare part return the system will check for an existing stock mapped against the custodian. Custodian is your customer who is returning the spare part. If there is no stock at custodian site the system will not be able to take the stock back from custodian. The reason why stock is not available against the custodian is because of either of the below mentioned reasons-You have consumed the stock at custodian site.-You have not sent the stock to custodian in the first place.-Resolution-Make sure that there is stock available against the custodian from whom you are receiving the spare parts. This data will be visible in Stock Overview. The column Custodian ID will be the same as the ID of the Sender in the Inbound Delivery Notification when the stock is viewed from the Stock Overview screen.-See Also-1907618 - Error Occurs While Confirming the Unload Task-Keywords-error in receiving spare parts, not able to receive spare parts, spare parts custodian error, no custodian information

Title: Hours Recorded in a Project Outside the Start/Finish Date of the Project
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that some users have recorded some hours in a project outside of its start/finish dates.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.-Go to the Project view.-Select and open the project of your choice.-Click Team and Staffing tab.-From here you can see that some hours have been recorded by one or some employees in the project outside of its start/finish dates.-Cause-In project header settings, you allowed time recording outside of planned period. Hence hours can be recorded in the project by an employee as long as the project status is either Released or Started.-Resolution-If you want to restrict project time recording outside of planned period, please follow below steps.-Open the project.-Go to Gantt Chart.-Select the project header, go to Project Settings subtab.-In Time Recording section, Outside of Planned Period field, you can select Not Allowed or Approval Required.-If here you select Not Allowed, then an error message would be raised in timesheet when any employee recording time for this project outside of planned period.-If here you select Approval Required, then approval process would be triggered when an employee recording time for this project outside of planned period.-See Also-Help Document:  Project Time Recording-Keywords-Time Recording, Project, Project Status, Start Date, Finish Date, Outside of Planned Period

Title: Error message:Location XXX not found as ship-to location
Content: Symptom-You are not able to choose desired ship to location while creating Purchase order and if you enter the Ship to and click on enter you get this error, where XXX is a Location ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for respective purchase order-Select it and click on Edit-Click on View all and go to Items tab-Then go to Deliveries Sub tab-If you search for desired Ship to in the Value help you will not find it and when you enter it and click on enter on your key board you get the error.-Cause-Since you haven't maintained the Location as a Ship to its not appearing.-Resolution-Go to Organizational work center-Select Edit Org Structures link under common tasks-Now find the respective org unit and navigate to Definitions tab-Select the Business Residence check box and select the Associated Site link-Under Roles check mark the Ship to Location and save-Keywords-Ship to not found, Ship to not appearing, Ship to not there, Ship to does not come up, Ship to  not available,Location not found as ship-to location,

Title: System Displays Restricted In-Transit Stock in Stock Overview Against An Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You want to know why the system is displaying +ve and -ve In-Transit stock against an outbound delivery though the process is completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center-Go to Common Tasks view -Choose New Stock Transfer Order-Enter Ship From as Non-3PL Site and Ship-to as 3PL Site.-Enter all the required details and perform save.-Now perform Goods Issue, complete Outbound Delivery, and Inbound Delivery processes.-Once it is done, go to Common Tasks view and check Stock Overview.-Here you find system displays In-Transit stock with +ve and -ve quantities against an Outbound Delivery-Cause-This is a 3PL stock transfer order scenario where Outbound Delivery is created from a non 3PL Site and Inbound Delivery is created for a 3PL Site with a restricted stock.On Release of Inbound Delivery, Goods amd Activity Confirmation gets created which moves the Stock from Restricted In-Transit to External Warehouse.-Therefore, in Stock Overview user can see +ve In-Transit-Unrestricted and -ve In-Transit Restricted.-User should perform Inbound for a Unrestricted Stock to avoid the negative In-Transit quantities.-Resolution-Case 1:-Go to Third Party Logistics work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select Adjust In-Transit Stock.-Using Advanced Filter, enter respective Outbound Delivery ID.-Select both +ve and -ve In-Transit stock row one by one and choose Adjust In-Transit Stock to Zero.-Case 2:-Go to Third Party Logistics work center.-Go to 3PL Inbound Deliveries view -Search respective 3PL Inbound Delivery ID.-Select and edit it.-Navigate to Line Items.-Perform Undo-Release of an Inbound Delivery ID.-Now here under Line Items, you can remove the quantity from the column: Restricted Quantity only.-Then Release the Inbound Delivery again.-It will remove +ve and -ve In-Transit stock from Stock Overview.-Keywords-In-Transit, Stock Overview, Outbound Delivery, 3PL Stock Transfer Order, Adjust In-Transit Stock

Title: Unable To Determine an Appropriate User to Whom the Items Can Be Distributed
Content: Symptom-You get the following diagnostic message from the system via health check.-Message:-The system cannot determine an appropriate user to whom the items can be distributed. As a result, the items do not appear in the worklists of any users, which can result in delays in the business processes affected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-The reason is that task cannot be assigned to the user. The validity of the user of this task is not maintained correctly or the user does not have sufficient access rights. Hence, the user cannot be determined.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-In Task Distribution, click Business Task Management subview.-Select Unassigned Items.-Look for items that has not been assigned to a user, select it, and open the most recent application log to determine why an item has not been assigned to a user.-Solve the issue by, for example, adjusting the work distribution settings or work center view assignments to ensure that the potential user responsible has the necessary work center assignment.-You can adjust the work distribution settings in Application and User Management > Employee Work Distribution.-You can also adjust the work center view assignments under Application and User Management > Business Users > Edit Access Rights.-After you have made the relevant changes, return to the Business Task Management view, select the relevant item, and choose Determine Assignment.-You can also manually assign the item to the employee responsible by selecting it in the Business Task Management view and clicking on Actions > Assign Item. For any task, you can assign the responsible user to the task or you can delete/cancel the task.-The system assigns the item according to your changes and removes it from the list.-See Also-Keywords-Health Check, unassigned items, business task management, task without responsible, business task inconsistent, no valid responsible person/ organization, unauthorized users not added as responsibles, employees without sufficient access rights for the item

Title: Order Creation Time mismatch between Planning screen and  Report Material Supply and Demand List
Content: Symptom-You see the Order DEF (DEF refers to Stock Transfer Order id) Creation Time in Planning screen and Order  DEF Creation Time in Report Material Supply and Demand List does not match.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Supply Planning-Go to View Products-Search for Product KLM (KLM refers to Product id)-Select Product KLM and Select Open-You observe  Order DEF Creation Time as XY(XY refers to Order time in planning screen)-Go to Work Center Business Analytics-Go to View Design Reports-Select Report Material Supply and Demand List-Enter Selection parameters and Select on Apply-You observe  Order DEF Creation Time as XX(XX refers to Order time in Report Material Supply and Demand List).-Cause-Reports will always reflect in UTC (UTC+0) time zone, Hence you see that there is a time difference between Order DEF time XY in Planning screen  and  Order DEF time XX in Report  Material Supply and Demand List. In Planning screen system has derived the time from time zone maintained as per Site Master Data.-Resolution-In order to confirm if there is a  common time generated between Order creation time in  Planning screen and Order creation time in  Report, Just add UTC + n (n refers to the time zone number) from Time zone maintained in Site Master Data to the Order creation Time which is shown in  Report Material Supply and Demand List, you will see  Order time in Planning screen and  Order time in Report Material Supply and Demand List is same.-Note:All Reports reflect in UTC time zone.-Keywords-mismatch between Planning screen and  Report time, Planning screen and Report screen time issues, Non sync between Planning screen and Report time,Order Creation Time mismatch between Planning screen and  Report Material Supply and Demand List

Title: No output communication updated after modification of purchase order
Content: Symptom-You are processing a purchase order. You have selected the option "Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected" from the purchase order Items tab. However, when the purchase order is changed, no result is visible from the output communication (fax, e-mail, print, xml).-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Request and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Order View.-Select the purchase order of your choice.-Select View All.-From the Items tab, the option Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected is selected.-After updating the purchase order, no visible result of this change appears on the output communication (fax, e-mail, print, xml).-Cause-No setting has been done from the button "You Can Also".-Resolution-Click "You Can Also" from the top right corner of your purchase order.-Select "Edit Output Settings for Change PO".-Edit the Output Setting with the configuration of your choice (fax, e-mail, print, xml).-Keywords-Purchase order, output communication, output history, purchase order acknowledgment expected, output settings.

Title: Workflow Rule Based On A Multivalued List Field Does Not Work
Content: Symptom-You are using a Multivalued List field in your workflow rule, but the rule is not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You have created a Multivalued List ABC (ABC represents the field name) field with values 111, 121 and 131 (numbers represent the field values).-The field is used in a workflow rule and the conditions created look as follows.-ABC Equal To 111-OR-ABC Equal To 121-OR-ABC Equal To 131-The expectation is, that the workflow rule gets triggered whenever a value gets added to an already existing one or when more than 1 value gets added.-Cause-Lets say the initial value of field ABC is 111. Now you add 121. The value in the backend is now maintained as 111, 121. If there is no condition ABC Equal to 111 AND 121 the workflow rule gets not triggered.-Resolution-You have to create a condition for every possible value combination.-For example:-ABC Equal To 111-OR-ABC Equal To 121-OR-ABC Equal To 131-OR-ABC Equal To 111 AND Equal To 121-OR-ABC Equal To 111 AND Equal To 131-Or-and so on.-Keywords-Workflow Rule, Multivalued List Field, KUT

Title: Error Messages when Activating Purchase Order Integration using SOAP/IDoc
Content: Symptom-You are trying to activate the purchase order integration using SOAP/IDoc but get the following error messages:-"Outbound deployment failed."-"Sender partner number missing."-"Error while reactivating communication arrangement."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Application and User Management.-Go to the view Input and Output Management.-Select Communication Arrangements.-Open Purchase Order Integration using SOAP/IDoc and click View All.-Choose Save and Reactivate.-Now system throws error messages as described above.-Cause-The customer ID on supplier side is missing for your company.-Resolution-Choose relevant business partner ID.-Choose View All in the new window.-Go to the tab Purchasing.-Add the customer ID for the supplier.-Save.-Now Save and Reactivate, the error messages does not appear, and the communication arrangement is being activated.-Keywords-IDOC; purchase order; SOAP; integration; communication; arrangement; sender partner number; outbound deployment;Outbound deployment failed, Sender partner number missing, Error while reactivating communication arrangement.-communication arrangement,outbound deployment

Title: Purchase Order Approval is Triggered for the Same Approver twice even though Skip Reapproval is Scoped
Content: Symptom-You use both Purchase Order Approval and Purchase Ordert Item Approval processes. You have flagged "Skip Reapproval" checkbox in both the approval processes.-When an item is added/updated in the purchase order, system triggers approval task twice for the same person.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Purchase Orders view-Select a Purchase Order which is already in "sent" status-Now make some item level changes (add/update price ,quantity or account assignment type) and select send update-The Purchase Order goes for Item level approval to person A (A is the approver) and he/she approves-The Purchase Order goes for header level approval to person A again-Cause-All the flags(skip approval, all approvals required etc) on an approval process work only for one approval process-Flag set on Purchase Order header approval rule will not work for Purchase Order item level approval rule.-If Purchase order item approval process has multiple steps with skip-reapproval set and same approver is determined in 2 steps, approver will receive task only once. Later if the purchase order goes for header approval and same person is determined as approver, they would receive the task again.-Resolution-You can descope item level approval if you do not want it or set a different person as approver for header and item approval processes.-Keywords-Purchase Order approval, purchase order item approval, skip reapproval

Title: Error appears when trying to change the Planning Run Recurrence for more than 60 days
Content: Symptom-System triggers error when you are trying to change the End date of recurrence for a Planning Run DEF (DEF refers to Planning Run id)-End Date should not be greater than KLM(KLM refers to Date and time)-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center-Navigate to Planning runs under Automated Actions View-Select Run DEF  and Select Schedule-In Schedule Job screen, Select Recurrence under Schedule-Select "By the Minute", Start date/time would be defaulted with Current Date and Time-Change "End date" for more than 60 days-Error appears as mentioned in symptom section-Cause-End date is mandatory for recurrent job and cannot be more than 60 days from start date.-Resolution-Set End Date as less than or equal to 60 days. By default end date will be set as 30 days from start date, if no input for end date is provided.-Note: Starting from 1902 Upgrade all Test Tenants will not have "No End Date" for  MDRO Jobs Recurrence Field, However currently this is not applicable for production  tenant i.e In Production Tenant for MDRO Jobs we still can set "No End Date" in Recurrence.-Keywords-End Date should not be greater than, Save failed, Recurrence End date/time,No End Date in Recurrence,Error appears when trying to change the Planning Run Recurrence for more than 60 days

Title: Error Occurs While Ordering Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-Error appears in the Purchase Order document.-Error:-Sum of items does not match total value in amount-Sum of items does not match total value in quantity-Total of all percentages must not be lower than 100%-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase requests and orders work center-Go to the Purchase orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit & click on Check button-Error appears-Cause-In the account assignment section, you have entered percentage less than 100% which is causing the problem where as in other line items have 100%.-Resolution-You need to update the percentage to 100 and then purchase order will be consistent for ordering. To do so;-Go to the Purchase requests and orders work center-Go to the Purchase orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-Select Account Assignment sub tab-Enter 100 % in the percentage section-Select check and purchase order will be consistent-Keywords-Sum of items does not match total value in amount; Total of all percentages must not be lower than 100%; Sum of items does not match total value in quantity; error in purchase order; Total % in PO less than 100%

Title: Exemption related Tax code is not determined in Purchase order or Supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-Tax exemption though maintained in Product master data, system is not considering it while determining tax code in the Purchase order, hence you see wrong tax code in purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders-Search for respective Purchase Order and click on edit-Go to Items tab-Navigate to Taxes tab-You will see a different tax code other than what you expected as per exemption that you maintained in Product master data.-Cause-Cause 1:-The region/ province/state  of tax exemption reason maintained in product master and the  region/ province/state in the Ship to address/Recipient address of the purchase order should match.-Cause 2: Tax rate type should be  "zero" in the  Product master Data-Resolution-1.-Go to Supply chain design master data work center-Go to Locations View-Search for the Ship to that is maintained in purchase order-Select it and Click on Edit-Scroll down and go to Site address section-Scroll down and Click on Additional fields-In the pop up enter the Region/state/ province-and-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Products view-Search for the respective Product-Go to Taxes tab-Click on Add row and enter all details and ensure you choose  same Region/Province that appears in the Ship to address/ Recipient address of the Purchase order or Supplier invoice-Click on save-2.Ensure you have maintained tax rate type as 'zero' in Product master-See Also-1785785 - Tax Rate Type Defaults to Zero in Purchase Order Although Taxes are Expected for the Transaction -Keywords-Wrong tax code , exemption reason not considered, tax code determined in Purchase order is wrong,correct tax code not determined.

Title: Production Date Missing in Uniform Content Label
Content: Symptom-You have created a label ABC (ABC represents the Label ID) against a Production Order and when you check the XML output data of the label, you expect the Production Date to be visible, but this is not the case. You compare this label with other labels and you can see that the Production Date is visible there. Now you want to know why the Production Date is not visible in the XML output of label ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to Common Tasks.-Select Label.-Select the label ABC and click the Preview button.-You can see that a date is shown on the label, but without any value.-If you open the XML data, you cannot find the Production Date tag.-Cause-This field relates to the Product Due Date which comes from planning and which informs about the date when this Output Material is required or must be manufactured.-When a new label is created against Production Orders with status In Preparation or Released (No confirmation has been created yet), it picks up this date and the same is visible on the label form. However, when the new label is created against Production Orders with status Started, Finished or Closed (meaning at least one Production Confirmation is done), it doesn’t pick this date. This field is planning relevant and once the execution is started (delayed or early), the date is not picked up by the label anymore.-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected. The Production Date is only visible on the form if no confirmation has been performed against the Production Order.-Keywords-Uniform, Content, Label, Form, GoodsTag, Production, Date, Confirmation, XML

Title: Purchase Order History Report Not Displaying Purchase Request for Some Records
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order History Report Not Displaying Purchase Request for Some Records.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to the Reports View.-Search and open the Purchase Order History report.-In the Selection tab, enter the respective fields.-Go to the View Tab.-Add the the Purchase Request ID to Row Fields.-Go back to the Selection Tab.-Click on the Apply button.-Some records display the Purchase Request ID as '#' while the Purchase Order has a Purchase Request.-Cause-The Purchase Request ID doesn't show for the rows corresponding to delivery items and invoice items for the Purchase Order because currently the Data Source only supports showing the Purchase Request ID for the Purchase Orders which don't have any follow-up document.-To double check this, open the respective Purchase Order and go to the Document Flow, if there is any document displaying after the Purchase Order, then the Purchase Request ID will not display in the report.-Resolution-You can proceed with using another Data Source "Purchase Order Delivery Reliability" or building a report on top of the data source to have the Purchase Request ID being displayed.-Keywords-Purchase Request ID, Purchase Order History, Purchase Order

Title: Chained Workflow Rules On Business Object Activity Task Not Executed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created an activity task on any business object via a workflow rule. A second workflow rule was created in order to make a change on the newly created activity task, but this is not working.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Activity task ABC (ABC represents the task ID) was created via workflow rule DEF (DEF represents the workflow rule ID of the first workflow rule).-Workflow rule GHI (GHI represents the workflow rule ID of the second workflow rule) should make a change on activity task ABC.-No workflow logs are created and no change is made to activity task ABC.-Resolution-The system is working as intended. This functionality is not supported to avoid recursion issues.-Keywords-Activity Task, Workflow Rule, Chain, Sequence

Title: Cancel Outbound Delivery of Over-the-Counter Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have created an Over-the-Counter sales document and released the delivery note. You do not see a cancel option in the delivery document and would want to know how to cancel the outbound delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Over-the-Counter Sale work center.-Navigate to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the outbound delivery document you want to cancel and select it.-Choose the Edit button and in the edit screen of the outbound delivery, you do not see an option to cancel the document.-Cause-The Cancellation Status of an Over-the-Counter outbound delivery document will be updated to Canceled when the corresponding Over-the-Counter sales document is canceled.-Resolution-Follow below given steps to cancel an Over-the-Counter sales document.-Go to Over-the-Counter Sale work center.-Search and select sales document against which the outbound delivery document you have to cancel is created.-Choose the Edit button and in the overview of sales document select the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab, select the line item(s) in the document which you need to cancel and choose the Cancel button.-Save and Close the document.-Once the above steps are performed you will be able to see that the line item(s) canceled in the above steps are canceled in the Outbound Delivery document as well.-Keywords-OTC delivery cancellation, Cancel Delivery note for OTC, Over-the-Counter sales delivery note cancellation, How to cancel Over-the-Counter delivery note

Title: Supplier Provisioning ID Field Is Greyed Out in Registered Products
Content: Symptom-You are creating a New Registered Product and you observe that under the section Supplier, the field Supplier Provisioning ID is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the New Registered Product common task.-Click on View All button.-Under the section Supplier, you can see the field Provisioning Supplier ID greyed out.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-The field Provisioning Supplier ID is used in all standard applicable processes where a Supplier is involved for example - Standard Inbound, Third-Party Operations, Returns to Supplier and similarly. This field is filled in case the product involved has serial number profile maintained as "Mandatory for all Logistics and Production processes".-This field is used in certain validations to ensure that the Registered Products are returned to the same supplier.-The Provisioning Supplier ID is filled by the standard process determination and hence is written disabled (greyed out in the UI).-Keywords-Registered Products ; Supplier ; Supplier Provisioning ID ; Greyed Out ; Serial Number.

Title: Lock issue during a cost distribution on supplier invoices
Content: Symptom-You are trying to distribute the cost between your invoices or credit memos.-However you are facing this error message: Lock not possible, reference doc ABC locked by user XYZ.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to Invoices and Credit memos.-Search and open your invoice.-Click View All.-Select the tab Items.-Click the tab Cost Distribution.-Click the blue link Distribute Among Other Invoices Or Credit Memos.-From here enter the invoice ID or item ID of your choice and you click Distribute.-A lock issue error message appears and disappears instantly.-Cause-Your goods and services receipt linked to your documents (supplier invoices, purchase orders...) contains over a hundred items.-Once the deliveries are released, the system updates the invoices and during this update you may face this lock error.-Resolution-We recommend you to create deliveries with no more than 100 items so that the cost distribution will be processed without delay.-Keywords-Lock issue, cost distribution, supplier invoice, SIV, goods and services receipt, credit memo

Title: How to resolve Error in Supplier Invoice : 'Follow-on item does not have predecessor and must be deleted'
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to post a supplier invoice, you get the error message saying "Follow-on item does not have predecessor and must be deleted".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Search for affected invoice-Select Post or Check button-Error appears:Follow-on item does not have predecessor and must be deleted-Cause-This happens mostly in case of invoices where return to supplier has been created for one or more items. The reference quantity has not been updated correctly in the cost distribution of that item for which return to supplier document has been created.-Resolution-You can remove the line item for which return document has been created and reenter the item, then the system will refresh the data and correctly update the reference quantity.-Keywords-Supplier invoice exception, reference quantity, cost distribution, follow-on item does not have predecessor

Title: Country Canada-Error message: Tax determination failed; invalid decision tree value
Content: Symptom-There is an exception in the Supplier Invoice and an error message when clicking in the Check button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Search for ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Click in Check button. -You get the error message: "Tax determination failed; invalid decision tree value". -Cause-This error message is specific for supplier invoices for country Canada. As per Canada decision tree in Purchasing scenarios,  the transaction should belong to either GST, PST, QST or HST. This is determined as per the Region/Province of the Ship-to party/Recipient of the Invoice or Purchase Order. So system checks whether the Region/Province of the Ship-to party/Recipient coincides with any of the above mentioned groups and if not found it throws error.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to correct the error message: -Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC.-Click in Edit button. -Click in View All button. -Navigate to Items tab. -Select the specific item. -Navigate to Parties and Locations subtab. -Under Organizational Management, please ensure that:-Recipient or Ship-to is maintained;-Address of Recipient and Ship-to has Region/Province maintained.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Decision Tree; Exception; Canada; GST; PST; QST; HST; Region; Ship-to; Recipient; Province; Purchase Order

Title: Exemption related Tax code is not determined in Purchase order or Supplier invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason: Combined this details in KBA   2774426 - Exemption related Tax code is not determined in Purchase order or Supplier invoice -Tax exemption though maintained in Product master data, system is not considering it while determining tax code in the Purchase order, hence you see wrong tax code in purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders-Search for respective Purchase Order and click on edit-Go to Items tab-Navigate to Taxes tab-You will see a different tax code other than what you expected as per exemption that you maintained in Product master data.-Cause-The region/ province /state of the Ship to party address /recipient address in Purchase order/ invoice is taken in to consideration for tax determination, so system searches for the exemption details you maintained in the product master for the respective region/province/state. If not found system does not consider the exemption .-Resolution-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Products view-Search for the respective Product-Go to Taxes tab-Click on Add row and enter all details and ensure you choose Region/Province that appears in the Ship to address/ Recipient address of the Purchase order or Supplier invoice-Click on save-See Also-Case document:2774426 - Exemption related Tax code is not determined in the Purchase Order-Keywords-Wrong tax code , exemption reason not considered, tax code determined in Purchase order is wrong,correct tax code not determined.

Title: Purchase Order Is Going Into Approval Again After Adding An Item
Content: Symptom-You have approved a purchase order and after that you add another item to the purchase order.-You have scoped the approval process for purchase orders at item level and expect just the item to go for approval.-Instead of just the item going into approval, the whole purchase order is going into approval again on header level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to the view Purchase Orders.-Search for a purchase order that has already been approved and click Edit.-Go to the tab Items and add an item.-Click Send Update.-Now the purchase order is submitted for approval on header level again even though you would expect only the new item to go into approval.-Cause-In the business configuration the questions "Do you want to use an approval process for purchase orders at item level?" and "Do you want to use the header re-approval process for purchase orders?" are connected.-If you scope the approval process for purchase orders at item level, the header re-approval process will be scoped automatically.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior as designed. It is not possible to select the approval process at item level without the header re-approval process.-Keywords-purchase order, approval, header level, item level, reapproval,

Title: Mandatory field not set - Project Plan Values Not as Expected
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Project Plan values report for Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID). The Planned Cost displayed are not as expected.-You check the Project Plan Values in the Cost and Revenue work center and notice an Error status (Red) for this project.-By checking further the error message "Mandatory field not set" appears for some Project Tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To see the errors on the Project Plan:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Select the Projects view. -Search and find Project XYZ.-Select the Plan Values view. -Select the Project Task ID XYZ-AA for which the error status is red (XYZ-AA represents the Project Task ID).-Select the Message sub tab, to display the error message "Mandatory field not set".-You verify the data in the respective Project task:-From the Projects view select Project XYZ and press Edit and then choose View All.-Find and select Project Task XYZ-AA.-Go to the Work tab.-Here, Employee Jane Doe is maintained in the Team Member column (Jane Doe represents the Employee Name).-You notice that there is no cost rate derived after pressing Valuate on the top. Instead, further error messages appear, such as "Cost could not be determined for some or all work packages of task XYZ-AA".-Cause-The planned project cost for an Employee are derived from the Labour Resource Cost rate associated with the Job that the Employee is assigned to.-If this resource, or its cost rate or the Job Assignment to the resource,  is not valid on the date of the Project task start date or the start date maintained for the employee in the Work Tab,  it is not possible to correctly derive a valid cost rate for the employee:-Go to the Projects view, either from the Cost and Revenue work center or through the Project Management work center.-Search and find Project XYZ.-Go to the Project Plan tab.-Select Project Task XYZ-AA.-Select the Work sub-tab.-The Cost Rate column is empty.-Navigate to the Scheduling Tab.-Verify the Earliest Start/Finish Dates and the Latest Start/Finish dates of this Project Task.-Now compare these date with the Labour Resource of the Job which Jane Doe is assigned to:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Resources view.-Open the Advanced Search and enter the Jane Doe's Job ID into the Job ID field (you can find the Job ID in the employee's personnel file).-Find the correct Resource - Cost center Combination, select it and press Edit.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-Here, check the Valid from Date of the Resource.-Also check the Valid from date of the Job Assignment setting underneath.-You will notice that the Validity of either the whole Labor Resource or the Job Assignment is after the Start date of the Project Task XYZ-AA or the start date of the Employee's assignment to the task in the Project Task's work tab.-Resolution-To resolve the error against the Project Plan you have two options:-Either amend the dates in the Scheduling tab in the project to be on or after the Valid From date of the Labor Resource.-Or-Amend the Valid from date of the Labor Resource to be the start date of the Project.-After the respective change revaluate the Project Costs of Project XYZ:-Enter Project XYZ as described above.  -Press Valuate. -Check the Work tab of Project task XYZ-AA. -This time, a costs rate (according to the associated Labour Resource) is derived for Jane Doe's planned work. -Also assign a Service to Jane Doe's planned work. -Press Save. -Result: No error message appears in the Project. No error appears in the Project Plan Values. The Error Status is now Green. -Keywords-Project Plan values, Project Cost Rate, Project Cost Rate differs to Project Plan Values,

Title: Finished Puchase Order Still Available for Time Recording
Content: Symptom-A finished purchase order is still available for time recording for a service agent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Partner Data-Go to the view Service Agents-Search for the relevant service agent and click Edit Time Sheet-Pick a project task and fill in all other required values-Open the value help for the purchase order-You see all purchase orders relevant for the service agents even the ones that are already finished.-Cause-The finished purchase order is still there because the Unlimited Over-Delivery checkbox is ticked in the purchase order.-Resolution-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders-Go to the view Purchase Orders-Search for the relevant finished purchase order-Click Edit-Go to the tab Items-Here you can see that the checkbox for Unlimited Over-Delivery is ticked-If you uncheck it, the finished purchase order will not be available for time recording anymore-Keywords-purchase order, time recording, service agent, time sheet, Bestellung, Zeiterfassung, unlimited over delivery,

Title: Resource Calendar is Not Considered In Production Planning
Content: Symptom-You have set the flag Resource Calendar in your resource used for production. However, when the production order is created, the system proposes the production start date based on the site working hours.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Navigate to the Production Order view.-Search for the relevant production order and choose the Edit button.-You see that the production order has been planned as per the site working hours and not as per your resource working hours.-Cause-The Released Execution Model (Production Model) has Supply Operation configured in it. This means that before the production begins the system will create a supply task which is a predecessor operation of the production tasks. The supply task does not prescribe to any production resource as it works similar to a pick task and hence can be scheduled only when the site is active.-Resolution-Remove the supply operation from production model and release the model for planning and execution. Please follow below given steps to remove the supply operation from your production model.-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Production Model view.-Search for the relevant production model, select it and choose the Edit button.-In the Bill of Operations tab under the BoO details sub-tab you can see the button Enable/Disable against the Supply to Production field.-Select the button to uncheck the Supply To Production field.-Choose the Check Consistency button.-Select the Release Production Model button and choose the option For Planning and Execution.-You will see that for any new production orders created with the production model without the supply task will have the order planned as per the resource calendar.-Keywords-operation starts earlier than production order, resource calendar not considered, Production order earliest start date error.

Title: Product Specification cannot be selected in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Unable to select a Product Specification for an item in Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work center.-Go to Common tasks.-Select New Purchase Order.-Select View All.-Go to Items tab.-Choose Add row.-Select-Item type as Material.-Process Type of To-Stock.-Select a Product ABC in the Product ID column (ABC represents Product ID).-Go to Product Specification field under Basic data sub-tab.-When trying to select from list, system shows "No records found".-Cause-The Product Specification ID is not linked to the Product.-Resolution-To check the status of the Product Specification, follow the steps below:-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to Product Specifications view.-Search for Product Specification XYZ (XYZ represents Product Specification ID).-Check the status of the Product Specification XYZ.-Case 1: If the status of the Product Specification is "In Process", the Product ID can still be added. To add a Product ID, continue the steps below:-Select Edit for the Product Specification XYZ.-In the Product ID field, the Product ID was not maintained.-Select the Product ABC in the Product ID field.-Select Save.-Choose Change status button.-Select Released.-Case 2: If the status is "Released", the Product ID can no longer be added, and a new Product Specification must be created. To create a new Product Specification for Product ABC, follow the below steps,-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks.-Select New Product Specification.-Maintain values for Product Specification ID and Product Specification Description fields.-Select the Product ABC in the Product ID field. -Select Save.-Choose Change status button.-Select Released.-See Also-1879665 - Product Specification Field Missing in Purchase Order - SAP for Me-Keywords-Product Specification; Purchase Order; No records found; Products

Title: Field "Document Description" is not available in the Supplier Invoice Work Center Overview
Content: Symptom-The field "Document Description" is not shown in the work center Supplier Invoicing even though you have that field in your supplier invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Here you can see that there is no column for the Document Description and you cannot add it in the personalization mode.-Cause-This issue occurs because you have not scoped it in your system.-Resolution-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Select a Project and click Edit Project Scope.-Click Next until you reach the tab Questions.-Under Built-In Services and Support go to System Management and User Interface List Mode.-Activate the question "Do you want to use the new enhanced and faster object work list based on Service Adaptation Definition Language (SADL)?".-Click Next and finish the change project.-Keywords-supplier invoice, document description, Beleg, Belegbeschreibung, SADL

Title: Supplier Invoice Sequential Document Numbers Gap
Content: Symptom-You are facing a gap in your supplier invoices (SIV) sequential document numbers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center and the  Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show all documents and sort them by Document ID.-You can see a gap in their sequential document numbering.-Cause-The sequential document number is only applicable for companies based in Italy.--Resolution-If your company is based in Italy according to the organizational structure, you should create an incident if you are facing this gap issue.-If your company is not based in Italy, the sequential document number is not applicable.-Keywords-Sequential numbers, Supplier Invoices, Gap, Numéro séquentiel, Document numbering, Numero progressivo.

Title: Purchase Order is Not getting Created from an Awarded Supplier Quote
Content: Symptom-You get an error in Supplier Quote: "Supplier Quote cannot create a Purchase Order", even though quote is already in Awarded status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Select view Quotes-Search for the respective quote-Navigate to Document Flow:-Error : Supplier Quote cannot create a Purchase Order-Cause-The email address is not maintained in the supplier(Bidder) master data.-Resolution-Please maintain email address in the supplier (bidder) master data.-Keywords-Output Channel, email address, Bidder, supplier master data, supplier quote, RFQ

Title: What is “Promised Quantity" and "Promised Delivery Date" in Report: Outbound delivery performance - Quick Analysis
Content: Symptom-You want to know what is “Promised Quantity" and "Promised Delivery Date" in Outbound delivery performance - Quick Analysis report-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Open Report "Outbound delivery performance - Quick Analysis"-You could see that two fields "Promised quantity" and "Promised Delivery date" are available.- You want to know where are they from , and in which document you could see these two fields.-Resolution-The two fields "Promised Quantity" and "Promised Delivery Date" of the Report 'Outbound Delivery Performance - Quick Analysis' are derived from the promised schedule line node of Customer Demand BO, which are not exposed in the Customer Demand UI.The promised schedule line indicates the first confirmation of the requested data, which is used only for reporting purpose. These fields are used only in reports and are not exposed in the Customer Demand UI.-The same explanation applies to the same fields in Report 'Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity' and Report 'Outbound Delivery Performance by Time'-Keywords-Outbound Delivery Performance

Title: Incorrect Tax Code and Tax Country Defaulted in Supplier Invoice for Service Item
Content: Symptom-System has created B2B Supplier Invoice and results in incorrect Tax Code and Tax Country defaulted for service item in the Supplier Invoice document.-Or Supplier Invoice picking up the wrong Tax Codes are appearing for the Supplier even though the Buying Company address and Bill To address is maintained correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Navigate to Items tab and select sub-tab Taxes.-You can see that incorrect Tax Code and Tax Country has been selected.-Cause-The system defaults the incorrect Tax Code and Tax Country due to the configurations set in the Fine-Tune Activity External Tax Determination for Goods and Services for service items. Additionally, it is important to verify the configuration item ID in the External Tax Determination for Goods and Services, as entering the Service Location incorrectly can also result in incorrect Tax Code determination.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to default correct the Tax Code and Tax Country in the Supplier Invoice:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine-Tune Activity.-Select the activity External Tax Determination for Goods and Services.-Enter the Configuration Item ID.-Enter all details along with the correct Service Location and select Save.-See Also-2891848 - Wrong tax code or Wrong tax event In Purchase order or supplier invoice-2335218 - Wrong tax Code in Intercompany Supplier Invoice-2478712 - Tax Code is not Determined or Wrong Tax Code is Determined-2959166 - Wrong Tax code in Inter company Supplier invoice-Keywords-incorrect tax code and tax country, wrong tax code in supplier invoice, wrong tax country in supplier invoice

Title: Error in Newly Created Supplier Invoice via Web Service: Supplier Not Found
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice via web service , however, when you check the invoice, you get following errors:-Supplier not found-Payee missing-Seller or supplier missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select View invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the newly created invoice which is in "In Process" status-You get the following errors in the invoice:-Supplier not found-Payee missing-Seller or supplier missing-Cause-System will allow creation of invoice with the data that you send in the web service request.-The supplier field is editable field, so you have the option to update this field before posting the invoice and hence even though invoice will get created, you cannot post it unless you update the supplier field with correct data.-The field "Buying Company" is a non-editable field, so if you enter incorrect or non-existing company ID in this field , then the web service will not create any invoice because you will not be able to change this data once the invoice gets created.-Resolution-Please ensure that the master data is correctly maintained in the system before creating any document via web service and also enter the correct data in the request XML file before running web service.-Keywords-Supplier Master Data, Supplier Invoice

Title: The Invoice Date Field is Greyed out in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are unable to edit the invoice date/ document date field in supplier invoice which is not yet posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and credit memos-Search for the respective invoice and select View All-The Invoice date field is greyed out-Cause-You have set the option "Document Date"  i.e Invoice Date as Year suffix selection date in the Business configuration activity "Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing" for that company.-Allowing a change on the invoice date may need a change in the generated number to uniquely identify the Supplier Invoice and hence it is kept read only to avoid any inconsistency.-Resolution-You have to set the fields correctly as per your requirement in the fine tuning activity "Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing" when you set up the business configuration settings to avoid this issue.-Keywords-Document date, Invoice Date, Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing

Title: Production Order Planned Quantity in Data Source Differs From Planned Quantity
Content: Symptom-The Data Source SCMPTV01 (Production Task) displays the Production Order Planned Quantity different from the Planned Quantity in Production Order XXX.-XXX = Production Order ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Data Sources view.-Find Data Source SCMPTV01.-Select the Data Source SCMPTV01.-Click Preview.-Fulfill the Production Order ID XXX.-Select Apply.-Notice that the Production Order Planned Quantity is 3 ea, as an example.-ea = each-Go to Production Control work center.-Select Production Orders view.-Search for the Production Order XXX.-Open the Production Order XXX.-The Planned Quantity is 1 ea, as an example.-Cause-In this example, you have 2 Input Products for Production Order XXX. The data source SCMPTV01 displays Input Product details in each line, hence each line has 1. To check this, you can follow the steps:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Data Sources view.-Find Data Source SCMPTV01.-Select the Data Source SCMPTV01.-Click Preview.-Fulfill the Production Order ID XXX.-Select Apply.-Click View.-Select Add Row Fields-Check the box Input Product-Click Ok.-There are 3 lines, as an example, with counter 1. Hence the Production Order Planned Quantity is 3 ea.-Resolution-As the system displays Input Product details in each line, it is working as expected.-Keywords-Planned ; Production ; Task

Title: Attachment from Sales Orders Missing in Project Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2780151***-You have attached some documents on your sales order and you expect to find them on your project invoice request (PIR).-However, they do not appear on your PIR.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have created a sales order from which you have attached some document (PDF, Word Doc, etc).-Go to the work center Customer Invoicing.-Go to the Project Invoice Requests view.-Open the PIR linked to the sales order.-Under the tab Attachments, you can see that the attachments from the sales order do not appear.-Cause-There is no such logic currently in the system that the attachments from the sales orders are automatically copied to the project invoice request.-Resolution-We are currently not planning to implement this, however if you wish to have such a logic, we would suggest you to use the improvement portal (https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886) to open an idea request.-However, if you want to have attachments inside the PIR, please upload them manually.-Keywords-Attachment missing, project Invoice Request, Sales Orders, Customer Invoicing, Attachement

Title: Unable to Upload List Price From Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload list price using Microsoft Excel and system shows an error message.-Error: The remote server returned an error. (500) internal server error-Total number of records Saved: 0-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center-Go to the List Prices view-Select New and List Prices from Microsoft Excel-Fill the mandatory details-Select Save Data To-Error occurs-Cause-The error occurs while uploading list price because some of the suppliers specified in the excel are in blocked status (and not active).-Resolution-You have to ensure that the suppliers used in the List Price excel is active and you can do so from the below steps;-Go to the Supplier Base work center-Go to the Suppliers view-Select the relevant Supplier-Select Change Status and Active-Keywords-The remote server returned an error. (500) internal server error; List price upload error; 500) internal server error

Title: Goods Receipt Processing Time Not Considered for Product In-house Production
