Content: Symptom-For the product XXX, you have maintained the Procurement Type as In-house Production and a Goods Receipt Processing Time. However, when planning the product XXX in planning area YYY, the Production Proposal ZZZ is created with the Start Date not considering the Goods Receipt Processing Time.-XXX = Product ID.-YYY = Planning Area ID.-ZZZ = Production Proposal ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Search for Product XXX.-Select the Product XXX for Planning Area YYY.-Click Open.-Select the Production Proposal ZZZ.-Click Open Material Flow.-Notice that the Start Date and the Availability Date are not considering the Goods Receipt Processing Time that you set in Product XXX master data.-Cause-The system calculates lead times for products in In-house Production and other Procurement Types differently. For in-house production products, the lead time is calculated as the sum of variable and fixed durations of planning operations that are available in the Production Model of the relevant product. The Goods Receipt Processing Time will not be considered for materials that are produced in-house.-Resolution-As the Goods Receipt Processing Time is not being considered in the calculation of the lead time, the system is working as designed.-Keywords-MRP ; Production ; Proposal

Title: Invoicing Status "Not Started" for Project Related Sales Order
Content: Symptom-A sales order related to a project is canceled but the invoicing status for the items in the sales order remains "Not Started".-For sales orders not related to a project the invoicing status changes to "Not Relevant" or "Finished" when canceling the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center view Sales Orders.-Search the relevant project related sales order.-Click Edit and View All.-Go to the Items tab.-Select a reason for rejection and save.-The sales order is canceled now but the invoicing status remains "Not Started".-Cause-As of today this is the implemented behaviour.-Resolution-The System works as designed. This feature has been added to our backlog and may be considered for a future release.-Keywords-Sales order, invoicing status, not started, project

Title: Error While Creating Intercompany Project: Select Project Structure Task for Intercompany Projects
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create an intercompany project out of a sales order due to the error message:-Select Project Structure Task for Intercompany Projects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center view Sales Orders.-Search for the relevant sales order.-Click Edit and View All.-Click Create Project.-Select "One Task For Each Item" for the project structure.-Select a responsible person.-Select a responsible unit.-Click Create.-The error message appears.-Cause-The intercompany project cannot be created because the project structure is not correct.-Resolution-To create an intercompany project select "Only Project Header" for the project structure.-Keywords-intercompany project, sales order, project summary task, project structure

Title: Ship To Not Determined Automatically in the Project Purchase Request Creation
Content: Symptom-Why Ship To location is not being determined automatically in the Project Purchase Request creation screen- or- How is the Delivery address determined in the Project Purchase Request creation screen-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Go to Projects View.-Search and open Project ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Project).-Click on Edit > Products.-Select the respective products and click on Create Purchase Request.-Ship to location is not being automatically determined.-Cause-The ship to location (site) is not referenced to the project. Even if there is only one location in the system it is not possible to see if the delivery address is determined by end buyer(Customer)  or recipient or from ship to location. So system does not default anything but give the user possibility to enter a location.-Resolution-When a Project Purchase Request is created, the delivery address is derived from fields 1st  is Recipient ,  second is Customer  and  finally ship-to location.-You have to enter ship-to location manually and then delivery address will be taken from the location.-Keywords-Wrong delivery address,

Title: Unable to Add Resources or Service For a Selected Activity While Confirming Production Tasks
Content: Symptom-You want to add a Resource or a Service during the confirmation of a Production Task. However, this is not possible as the respective button (Add Row) under the selected Activity is greyed out, i.e. inactive.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the task XYZ. (XYZ represents the exact task ID).-Select the task XYZ.-Press the Confirm button.-Go to the Confirmation tab.-Select the sub-tab Activities.-Go to the Resources (or Service) tab.-The Add Row button is greyed out.-Cause-This is the correct system behaviour as the system is expecting the quantities for the Output Product/s to be maintained.-Resolution-For the button to become active, you need to manually maintain the exact quantity for the Output Product/s.-To maintain the quantity during task confirmation, please follow the below steps:-Navigate to the Confirmations tab.-Select the sub-tab Output Products.-Enter a value for Quantity field (If the same is not active, you’ll need to uncheck the Confirmation Finished box).-Now the Add Row button under Resources (and Service) tab will become active. -Additional note: If the confirmation Method of the respective Activity (Activities sub-tab of Confirmation) is different than Backflush you may need to enter a value for Confirm Duration field (if the current one is 00:00:00) as well.-Keywords-add, resources, service, production, task, output products, activity, confirmations

Title: Project Invoicing Request Source Document Showing as Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You find the source document of a project invoicing request is showing as supplier invoice, but you don't understand why.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Project Invoice Requests view.-Open project invoice request ABC (ABC refers to the project invoice request ID), view all.-Go to Items tab, Invoice Items sub tab.-Select the item, scroll down and switch to Time and Expense Items tab, select the corresponding line and click Item Details button.-You see the source document is showing as Invoice DEF (DEF refers to the supplier invoice ID).-Cause-Supplier invoice DEF has no cost distribution reference, hence it is considered to be a separate expense and is proposed for project invoicing.-Resolution-To make the user case more clear, let's take an example.-In a customer project, you purchase a service from an external supplier, and the service agent who perform this service need to do time recording for it.-The service agent records 5 hours service against the project, and the time recording be approved by the project manager. A goods and service receipt of 5 hours is automatically created and posted for the same.-When invoicing the purchase order, the recorded 5 hours be automatically proposed and the goods and service receipt is the cost distribution reference.-However, here you manually change the supplier invoice item quantity to 8 hours without a cost distributiong reference. System raises an exception of Missing Receipt for the extra 3 hours, but you accept it and post the invoice.-Later, when you creat project invoice request for the project, you can see 2 items aganist the service. One is for the recorded 5 hours, the source document is time confirmation which the service agent did.The other is for the extra 3 hours which has no receipt, the source document is the supplier invoice.-For the supplier invoice item which has no cost distribution reference, system always consider it to be a separate expense and is proposed for project invoicing. It's the expected system behavior.-If you don't want to charge customer the extra hours, you can ignore the project invoicing request item.-Keywords-Project Invoicing Request, Source Document, Supplier Invoice, 项目开票申请

Title: Deactivation of Some Standard Tax Codes Starting 2019 [Italy Only]
Content: Symptom-You find that some standard tax codes are not available now in the system since from 2019. For example: tax code 22 for Domestic Purchase, ZeroRate.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In Italy it is required to include in Tax declarations (VAT Registers as well as in the  Spesometro/Esterometro) the VAT exempted invoices or partial exempted amounts in invoices, even if they are not relevant for VAT payment: the tax exempted invoices need to be reported with the specific reason of exemption, that is the Tax Law article that is usually reported in tax code description.-In particular this is the case of VAT Registers, where the tax code descriptions are reported for each invoice item.-For Spesometro/Esterometro the assignment of proper Tax code Nature is based on the Tax Event.-Nature code reflects the category of tax exemption.-There are 7 categories recognized for tax exemptions, which are reflected in 7 different Nature codes:-  N1 is for excluded Tax Art. 15-N2 is for Not subject to VAT-N3 is for Not taxable-N4 is for Exemption Tax Art. 10-N5 is for Ta special Regime-N6 is for Reverse Charge-N7 is for e-commerce, distant sales and MOSS Sales.-  Spesometro was introduced as legal requirement in 2017, and many of the current tax events/tax codes were already created for Italy, with a logic that was not completely consistent with Spesometro requirements.-  In order to do consistent Tax declarations, and considering that new tax events and tax codes have been created over time to better fit Italian legal requirements, in an effort of continuous improvement of the content, some tax codes have been deactivated starting 2019 in standard content, and the use of alternative tax codes is recommended.-See details in below list.-Tax Event TE-Description-Tax Code TC-Description-Alternative use-10-Domestic Purchase-22-Domestic Purchase, ZeroRate-use one of TC 8, 9, 26, 34 - 39, 51, 52, 73, 77-100-EU Goods Acquisition, Reverse Charge-41-EU Goods Acquisition, RevCharge, ZeroRate-there is no business case with RC 0%-150-NonEU Service Acquisition, Reverse Charge-47-NonEU Services Acquisition, RevCharge, ZeroRate-use of self invoice TC 90 (for outgoing, TC 590)-201-Import VAT from Outside EU (Customs Invoice)-53-Import VAT (Customs Inv), ZeroRate-there is no business case with import 0%-290-Purchases from SanMarino with VAT-59-Purchase from SanMarino, ZeroRate-use of self invoice TC 90 (for outgoing, TC 590)-291-Self-Assessed VAT after Purchase from SanMarino-65-Self-assd Purch from SanMarino, ZeroRate-use of self invoice TC 90 (for outgoing, TC 590)-310-Domestic Sale of Goods-513-Domestic Sale, ZeroRate-use one of TC 505, 506, 517, 545, 546, 547, 548, 532-350-Domestic Sale of Services-526-Domestic Sales of Services, ZeroRate-use one of TC 505, 506, 517, 545, 546, 547, 548, 532-542-VAT Split Payment EX DPR 633/72 Art. 17-Ter-553-VAT split payment ex dpr 633/72 art. 17-ter, reduced-low rate-use one of TC 505, 506, 517, 545, 546, 547, 548, 532-501-Sales of Goods to SanMarino-535-Sale of Goods to SanMarino, ZeroRate-use of TC 512-373-Sales with Exemption Letter-518-Sale with Exemption Certificate, Stnd.Rate-use of TC  516-373-Sales with Exemption Letter-519-Sale with Exemption Certificate, RedRate-use of TC  516-373-Sales with Exemption Letter-520-Sale with Exemption Certificate, RedLowRate-use of TC  516-  Resolution-Nevertheless the deactivated tax codes can be activated again in customer system, with proper Business Configuration activity.-Keywords-Spesometro, Tax Code, Italy, Tax Declarations

Title: More Than One Pick Task Created for Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The system automatically created two or more Pick Tasks for Sales Order XXX.-XXX = Sales Order ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Task Control view.-Search for Sales Order XXX.-Notice that there are more than one Pick Tasks.-Cause-In the used Logistics Model YYY the Activity Type is Move Per Destination. Activity Type determines the number of Task to be created for a given Warehouse Request. In this case the Target Logistics Area is different for each Pick Task, hence as the Move Per Destination Activity two or more tasks are created based on the Target Logistics Area.-YYY = Logistics Model ID.-Resolution-In order to ensure that there is only one Pick Task created, you can change the Activity Type in the Logistics Model to Move All by following the steps:-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Select Logistics Models view.-Find the Logistics Model YYY.-Open the Logistics Model YYY.-Select the Operation.-Click Change Activity Type.-Choose Move All.-Select Ok.-Select Save and Release.-Keywords-Pick ; Multiple ; Task

Title: Identified Stock Missing in Intercompany Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For an intercompany scenario, you have created an Outbound Delivery with split line item YYY: same product ID, but different Identified Stocks. When the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX is created, the system merges the line item YYY, and there is no Identified Stock assigned to it.-XXX = Outbound Delivery ID.-YYY = Outbound Delivery Line Item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Find the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Open the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Click View All.-Select the Line Items tab.-Notice that there is no Identified Stock for the Line Item YYY.-Cause-When you split the items into different Identified Stocks in the Outbound Delivery, the system does not pass it to the Inbound Delivery Notification. Merged line items with the same product ID do not show an Identified Stock ID in the Inbound Delivery Notification, even though in the Outbound Delivery, line items are split with the same product for different Identified Stocks in an intercompany scenario.-Resolution-Currently, ByD does not support splits with Identified Stocks in the case of intercompany stock movement; it is only supported in intracompany transfers. Therefore, in this case, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-IStock, Intercompany,  Inbound Delivery Notifications, Outbound Delivery

Title: Error Message: "Financial Data in Master of Supplier XYZ Incomplete for Company ABC"
Content: Symptom-Error when canceling the Purchase Order DEF (DEF represents the Purchase Order ID),-"Financial Data in Master of Supplier XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier ID) Incomplete for Company ABC (ABC represents the Company ID)".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Select All Purchase Orders from the drop-down.-Search for Purchase Order DEF.-Select Cancel Purchase Order button.-System throws error "Financial Data in Master of Supplier XYZ Incomplete for Company ABC"-Cause-Financial Details are missing in the Supplier Master Data for the related Supplier of the Purchase Order. Once these details are updated, the Purchase Order should work as expected.-Resolution-Go to Supplier Base Work Center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Select All Suppliers from the drop-down.-Search for Supplier XYZ.-Select Edit - General.-Go to Financial Data Tab.-Maintain the required details in the Sub tabs (Payment Data, Bank Data, Tax Data). -Select Save button.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Supplier; Financial Data

Title: Unexpected Invoice Created by Technical User SAP_SYSTEM for Project Related Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Customer Invoices Created by a Technical User Without a Run Maintained in the System.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work Center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Open Project Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ represents Project Invoice Request ID).-Go to the Changes tab.-You can see that the Invoice was created by SAP_SYSTEM.-Cause-In the Sales Order, View All screen, In General tab there is a Project Invoicing section. In that section there is a  field called 'Automatic Release', this indicator is set to true.-If you do not want invoices to be created automatically, this indicator should be set as false.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Order work Center.-Go to the view Sales Orders.-Select All Sales Orders and find the relevant Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Go to the General tab.-Go to the Project Invoicing section.-Find the indicator "Automatic release".-If the Invoice is not intended to be created automatically, this indicator should be set to false.-Keywords-Sales Order, Project Invoice Request, Customer Invoicing, Automatic release,

Title: Automatic Invoice Schedule Created for an Intercompany Sales Order
Content: Symptom-In an intercompany scenario the sales order is automatically created with an invoice schedule for six months.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center view Sales Orders.-Search for the relevant intercompany sales order.-Click edit and view all.-Go to the tab Pricing and Invoicing.-Go to the Subtab Invoice Schedule.-An invoice schedule has automatically been created for six months.-Cause-The automatic creation of an invoice schedule is configured in the business configuration and therefore the expected system behavior.-Resolution-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Search for the activity "Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders".-Here the occurrence for the invoice schedule is set to six months.-If the invoice schedule should not be created automatically the occurrences have to be set to 0.-Keywords-automatic invoice schedule, sales order, intercompany

Title: Unable to Create New Identified Stock at the time of Confirming Production Task
Content: Symptom-You cannot create New Identified Stock while confirming Production Task DEF (DEF refers to Production Task id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center-Navigate to Task Control View-Select Production Task DEF and Select Confirm-Select New to create New Indentified Stock-A pop Box appears, Maintain Identified Stock Description,Production Date Time and Expiration Date time-Select OK-Error appears--Create of identified stock failed--Production requirement Specification KLM (KLM refers to Production Specification id)is not release-Cause-As the Product Specification id KLM was not released,there is a validation set to use only the Released Product Specifications which are consistent while creating the identified stock.-Resolution-Release Product Specification KLM and then try to confirm Production Task DEF.-In order to release Product Specification KLM, Follow the below steps-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-Navigate to Product Specifications View-Search and Select Product Specification KLM-Select Change Status --> Released-Keywords-Create of identified stock failed, Production requirement Specification is not release, Unable to Create New Identified Stock at the time of Confirming Production Task

Title: Customer Order Number is Incorrect in Freight List Form
Content: Symptom-In Third Party Order processing scenario, the Customer Order Number in Freight List Form is sometimes Sales Order External Reference ID or Sales company Purchase Order number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter and Shipments view.-2. Select All Freight List by Selection and Find 999(where 999 is the Freight List ID)-3. Select Freight List and Preview.-Cause-When the Outbound Delivery(OD) of the Manufacturing company is created and released, system checks whether the Inbound Delivery Request(IDR) corresponding to the Purchase Order 99999(where 99999 is Purchase Order number) created in the Sales company already exists.-If it exists, then the External Reference ID is updated with that of the External Reference Purchase Order ID of the Sales company's Sales Order,-based on the Inbound Delivery Request.--In other cases, when there is a delay in creation of this IDR in the Sales company, system does not update the Outbound Delivery with this above mentioned information. Since the IDR was created and released after the OD, this information was not available to the OD.-Resolution-You should ensure that the Manufacturing company OD is Released(or created) only after the Sales company IDR is created.-This will ensure that the OD is updated with External Reference information of the Sales company's Sales Order's External Reference Purchase Order ID.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Request, Outbound Delivery, Freight List Form, Customer Order Number

Title: Error: 'The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item' while Creating Supplier Invoice with Reduced Quantity
Content: Symptom-After changing the quantity of the Supplier Invoice to a reduced amount, system displays following errors:-The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item-Item ABC: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item.-Item ABC: Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount-Item ABC: Credit quantity greater than invoiced delivery quantity-(ABC represents the Item ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Search and select the respective Purchase Order.-Click New Invoice.-Change the Quantity to a reduced amount.-System displays the errors:-The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item-Item ABC: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item.-Item ABC: Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount-Item ABC: Credit quantity greater than invoiced delivery quantity-Cause-The error happens for a Purchase Order followed by several Inbound Deliveries (or Goods Receipt) and a Return to Supplier (or Goods Return).-They are raised because the system can no longer match the Cost Distribution credit items to the respective debit items.-Whenever the invoice is created, the system proposes all the Inbound Deliveries (or Goods Receipts) including the Return to Supplier (or Goods Return).-Now when the Cost Distribution item referring to the Return to Supplier (or Goods Return) is present then the Inbound Delivery (or Goods Receipt) corresponding to the return should not be zero.--So, when the return has value greater than zero but the Inbound Delivery (or Goods Receipt) corresponding to the return has zero value. The reason behind this is the system tries to find these Inbound Deliveries (or Goods Receipts) for the returns in order to calculate the net effective quantity (sum of Inbound Delivery (or Goods Receipt)).-Resolution-To resolve this issue, it's necessary to adjust the amount of the Return to Supplier (or Goods Return) in the respective Inbound Delivery (or Goods Receipt), in the Cost Distribution tab. As following:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Search and select the respective Purchase Order.-Click New Invoice.-Change the Quantity to a reduced amount.-Go to the Items Tab.-Select the Item.-Go to the Cost Distribution Sub-tab.-Adjust the amount of the Inbound Delivery (or Goods Receipt) according to the linked Return to Supplier (or Goods Return).-Once this adjustment is completed, you should be able to post the Supplier Invoice with reduced quantity.-Keywords-cost distribution, credit amount, credit quantity, debit amount, debit quantity, supplier invoice

Title: Identified Stock Description in Multiple Languages
Content: Symptom-You want to see the description of an identified stock created in multiple languages-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Identified Stock view.-Search for the relevant Identified Stock.-You can see that the identified stock description can either be seen in one language.-Cause-You can maintain the identified stock description in multiple languages under the Identified Stock Description section of the identified stock edit screen.-Resolution-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Identified Stock view.-Search for the identified stock id, select it and choose the Edit button.-In the Identified Stock Description section choose the Add Row button.-Select value of the relevant language code in the column Language and enter the Description.-Choose the button Save and Close.-Keywords-iStock description language, iStock description in multiple languages, change iStock description language, change identified stock description language

Title: Cannot Create Intrastat Declaration With Item Type Service
Content: Symptom-You want to create Intrastat Declaration with item type Service however it looks not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declarations view-Select the relevant Intrastat Declaration ID-You cannot classify the declaration based on Item Type-Cause-In Intrastat Declaration processing the products should be of the type material and products of type services are not supported.-Resolution-Only Product type Material is supported, and this is an expected behavior.-Keywords-Intrastat Item Type; Product Type; Material type: service in Intrastat

Title: Country Name is not Displayed in Purchase Order Preview Form
Content: Symptom-The country name is not showing up in Purchase Order form under Ship-to and Bill-To address fields even though it is working fine in the other Purchase Order form with same ship-to country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Search for the Puchase Orderand select Preview -The country name is missing under Ship-to and Bill-To address fields in the form-Cause-The behaviour for the preview for address is, that the country name is printed when the sender and recipient are from different country. If both ship-to and ship-from locations are from same country, the country name will not be displayed in the form separately-Resolution-For other Purchase Order , the ship from and ship-to are from different countries , hence under Ship-to and Bill-to address, country name is displayed.This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Ship-from, ship-to, preview form, purchase order, country

Title: How to Set Unrestricted Stock as Restricted
Content: Symptom-You want to set certain quantity of a product in your warehouse as Restricted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option Stock Overview.-Enter the relevant Product information and choose the Go button.-You see that the flag Restrcited is not set for the product selected.-You want the flag to be set for the relevant product.-Resolution-Go to the Internal Logistics work center.-Select the Change of Stock option from the Common Tasks view.-Enter the Site and the planning area related information in the mandatory fields.-Choose the Add Row button and enter the Product and related information like identified stock quantity Unit of Measure etc, whose stock you need to mark as Restricted.-Choose the Next button.-Enter the quantity you need to mark as restricted in the field Changed Product Quantity and mark the flow Changed Restricted Status.-Choose the Next button and review the entries made.-Choose the Finish button.-You can see in stock overview that the value entered in the field Changed Product Quantity has been marked as Restricted.-Keywords-how to set restricted flag, restrcited flag not set, restrcited stock not visible

Title: Unit of measure X does not exist
Content: Symptom-You get above warning message while uploading Purchase orders through Excel, where X is a Unit of measure(UOM).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase orders and requests work center-Go to Purchase orders-Click on New button-Choose Import from Microsoft excel-In the excel file, click on SAP business ByDesign button-Log in and then enter the details-Click on Business ByDesign button and choose Save to data button-Cause-While uploading Purchase order through Excel what you entered is UOM symbol but what is allowed to be entered in Excel is Unit.-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation projects-Open Activity list-Go to Fine tune activity-Search for Quantities and Units of Measure-Click on any option for example "create and maintain physical units"--You can see three columns for each UOM,that is-Unit-UOM symbol-Description- Currently ByDesign is developed as mentioned above.-Resolution-However, after the Purchase order is created what you see is UOM symbol and not unit.- To avoid any confusion while entering details in Excel about the format of Unit of measure please follow below steps:-Go to Purchase orders and requests work center-Go to Purchase orders-Click on new-Choose Import from Microsoft excel-In the excel file-Click on the cell "Unit of measure"-Click on Business ByDesign button-Click Lookup button-You see a popup where you can choose the UOM based on Description-Keywords-Unit of measure does not exist

Title: Dump Occurs When Rejecting a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Unable to Reject a Purchase Order Approval Task due to "500 SAP Internal Server Error".- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To Reject the Purchase Order ABC, the approver has to follow the below steps:-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents Purchase Order ID).-Select Reject button.-System throws "500 SAP Internal Server Error".-Cause-Purchase Order has one or more items with the status "Canceled", due to which the rejection cannot be processed. -Resolution-In order to resolve this issue, first approve the Purchase Order and cancel it afterwards.-To complete the Approval process for Purchase Order ABC, approver has to follow the below steps:-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC.-Select Approve button.-To Cancel the Purchase Order, follow the steps below:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Select All Purchase Order from drop-down.-Search for Purchase Order ABC.-Select Cancel Purchase Order button.-Select Yes for the pop-up message "Are you sure you want to cancel the purchase order? "-The System displays "Purchase Order ID ABC is submitted for cancellation. Your entries have been saved."-Keywords-Purchase Order; Reject; Cancel; Dump; In Approval

Title: Purchase Order not available in the service agent time sheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2525032***-An external resource, Service Agent: 123 (123 represents the Service Agent name), was ordered for a customer project with a sales integration. 123 is also a Company Employee with the same ID/ name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-There are two options to reproduce this issue:-Go to the Time Administration Work Center.-Go to the Employee Time Records and find Employee 123.-Click Edit and Go to the Employee Times sub tab.-Choose the Entry date.-Go to the sub tab Labor Information.-You are not able to see any Purchase Order Information here OR you are not able a select any Purchase order.--or-Go to the Project management Work Center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select All Projects and find XYZ (XYZ represents the Project name).-Click Edit -> Projects Plan.-Go to the Products tab.-Go to the Purchase Orders sub-tab.-You can see here the assigned Purchase Order XYZ.-Cause-The Project configuration which is linked with the Sales Order was configured incorrectly. Time Recording is set as "not allowed", which needs to be changed. By making the change, we can expect the Purchase Order to be defaulted for Employee 123.-In our scenario, the Service Agent 123 is also an Employee.-The Project Manager cannot open "Edit Time Sheet" for Service Agents who are not Employees, because the "Time Sheet" is limited for internal employees. Employee 123 is an Internal employee with a role as Service Agent due to project assignment. Therefore, the Project Manager has that option.-Resolution-Go to the Project management Work Center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select All Projects and find XYZ.-Click Edit Projects Plan.-Scroll Down to the Basic Data Sub tab.-Change the field "Time Recording" to "Approval Required" or "No Approval Required".-You should now be able to see the assigned Purchase Order XYZ for Service Agent 123.-Keywords-Entry Activities, Service Agent, Employee, Project, Time Recording, Time Entry, Purchase Order,time recording for service agent, project purchase order,Purchase order not appearing in the time sheet,purchase order not found,Purchase order not appearing automatically

Title: Purchase Order Cannot be Automatically Released
Content: Symptom-For example you have released a third party sales order, the follow up purchase order is automatically created, but not released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesig-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-From Common Tasks, create a new sales order.-Under Items tab, maintain the Ship-From Fulfillment as External, and maintain a supplier.-Release sales order.-Go to document flow, you see the follow-up purchase order has been automatically created, but not released.-Cause-You have not defined the relevant rule for Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Open common task: Define Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders.-Please follow help document "Configuration: Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders", and define a rule for relevant buying company , suppliers,origin type, product category and Creation options-After the rule is correctly maintained, the newly created purchase order will be automatically released after the new sales orders are released.-Note: This is applicable for all types of Purchase order creations, that is Origin types like shopping cart,Planning proposal,Project,service order-See Also- 2867507 - Purchase Order is not Created Automatically from Purchase Request -Keywords-Purchase Order, Third Party, 3rd Party, 三方订单

Title: Customer Invoice is Created Manually for a Project Invoice Request, but in Sales Order, Invoice Status Displays as Open
Content: Symptom-Invoice Schedule Displays Invoice Status as Open even with a Project Invoice Request and Customer Invoice already created manually.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Open the respective Sales Order.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing > Invoice Schedule.-Invoice Status from Items displays as Open.-Go to the Document Flow Tab.-Project Invoice Request and Customer Invoice are already created.-Cause-Manually created Project Invoice Requests do not change status of scheduling items.-In case a manual Project Invoice Request has been created and the Sales Order is set for scheduling job, then system would create a new Project Invoice Request automatically leading to a duplicated document.-Resolution-If the Sales Order is set for scheduling job and a manual Project Invoice Request and Customer Invoice were created, system will create a new Project Invoice Request automatically with the scheduling job, then there are two alternatives:-A. Cancel the Project Invoice Request created with scheduling job and cancel open invoice scheduling items of the Sales Order.--B. If you want to keep Project Invoice Request created with scheduling job, then cancel the Project Invoice Request and Customer Invoice created manually.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request, scheduling job, Invoice Schedule

Title: Exception in Down Payment Request: Date for Maximum Discount Must be Before Other Payment Dates
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a down payment request dur to below exception:-Date for maximum discount must be before other payment dates.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find down payment request ABC (ABC refers to the down payment request ID).-Click Edit and View All.-Go to Exceptions tab, you see there is 1 Exception to be processed:-Date for maximum discount must be before other payment dates.-Go to General tab, you see the Maximum Cash Discount Due Date is after the Due Date. The fields are automatically populated and cannot be edited.-Cause-There is a payment term DEF (DEF refers to the payment term ID) maintained for down payment request ABC, and it is discount relevant.-Resolution-Please check the payment term definition by below steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Show All Configuration Elements and find activity Supplier.-Click View.-Open Define Payment Terms for Procurement.-Select the line for ID DEF, you can see the Calculate due date based on details.-Scrool down, you can see discount details.-For example, in case of the payment term is "14 days 2%, due net", Calculate due date based on receipt date. Discount Rate is 2% and the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date for Discount Rate is 14. And the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date for Net Price Due is 0.-In the down payment request which apply this payment term, the Due Date = Receipt date. The Maximum Cash Discount Due Date = Receipt date +14days. Hence the Maximum Cash Discount Due Date is 14 days after the Due Date, which should not be allowed. System will raise exception for this down payment request when posting.-To post the down payment request, you can change the payment term to another one which the calculated Maximum Cash Discount Due Date be before/eaqual to the down payment request Due date.-Or edit the existing payment term, make the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date for Net Price Due greater than the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date for Discount Rate.-See Also-Down Payment Request, Maximum Discount, Due Date, 最大折扣日期, 付款日期

Title: Logistics area ABC is not eligible for counting
Content: Symptom-Logistics area ABC is not eligible for counting.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory Work Center.-Go to Common task-Select New Logistics Area Count.-Enter Storage Location ID.-Show only Eligible for counting.-Enter Logistics Area ID: ABC.-Click Go.-No records found.-Cause-Logistics area ABC already exists in open PI count document. You could not create new PI count for this logistics area until the open existing PI count document is finished.-Resolution-You need to finish this open PI count first.-Keywords-PI count

Title: Check Digit Added to GTIN
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a 12 character length GTIN number in the Material Master, but when you preview or print the Delivery Note, the system is adding a checksum at the end of the barcode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Find and select the product ABC (ABC represents the Product ID).-Click the Edit button and then on View All.-Go to the General tab and then to the UoM Characteristics subtab.-Under the GTIN column you can see that a 12 digit GTIN code is maintained.-Now navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Find and select the relevant Outbound Delivery XYZ (XYZ represents the Outbound Delivery ID).-Click the Preview button to open the PDF document.-You can see the barcode of the Product ABC is displayed with 13 character length on the Delivery Note. The system has added a check digit at the end to make the code 13 character.-Cause-You are using an 'EAN13' type of barcode in your Delivery Note form template. 'EAN13' barcodes always add a checksum digit at the end. This is the standard behavior of 'EAN13' barcodes.-Resolution-For GTIN with 12, 13 and 14 digits, you can use a barcode type which does not add a check digit at the end of the barcode. In barcode type 'Code 128' for example, no checksum digit is added. -Keywords-barcode, product, products, outbound, number

Title: Unable to Upload List Prices With Excel
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to upload list prices using Excel due to the error "500 - Internal Server Error".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Excel File.-Log on to SAP ByDesign System Add-On.-Click on Save Data To.-The error message "500 - Internal Server Error" occurs. -Cause-One of the Suppliers used in the Excel Sheet has the Blocked status in the system. -Resolution-The steps to change Supplier's status are listed below: -Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Search for the Supplier ID. -Click on Change Status.-Select Active.-Save it. -Keywords-List Prices, Excel, Dump, Internal Server Error, Error 500, Supplier, Status

Title: Sales Order Still in Status Open After Creating Cancellation Invoice
Content: Symptom-The status of a sales order does not change back to “Open” after creating a cancellation invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Customer Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoice Documents.-Search for the relevant invoice.-Click Cancel.-Go to the work center view Sales Orders.-Search for the relevant sales order.-It still has the status "Finished".-Cause-The sales order is linked to a project.-The project invoice was canceled but the project invoice request was not.-Resolution-You have to cancel the project invoice request:-Go to the work center Customer Invoicing.-Select the view Project Invoicing.-Choose the subview Project Invoice Requests.-Search for the relevant project invoice request.-Click Cancel.-You can find the relevant project invoice request in the document flow of the Sales Order.-Keywords-Sales order, open status, cancellation invoice, project invoice request, cancelation, Kundenauftrag, Status, Offen, Stornorechnung, Projektrechnungsanforderung

Title: Error When Trying to Confirm a Pick Task as Planned
Content: Symptom-When you try to confirm the pick task XXX as planned, a system crash occurs.-XXX = Pick Task ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Find the task XXX.-Select the Task XXX.-Choose Confirm as Planned.-System crash occurs.-Cause-You have configured to send the send Advanced Shipping Notification as XML message for the Account. As you are using a one step Logistics Model, when you confirm the pick task, the Outbound Delivery will be automatically created. The system crash occurs because you have not maintained the Communication Arrangement for your partner YYY.-YYY = Communication Partner ID.-Resolution-In order to maintain the Communication Arrangement, please follow the steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Communication Arrangement view.-Click New.-Select the relevant Communication Scenario.-Fulfill the Business Partner ID YYY. -Click Next.-Fulfill the Host Name.-Click Finish.-Keywords-Partner-CA-ASN

Title: Cannot Delete Shift Template From a Shift Program
Content: Symptom-When you try to delete a Shift Template from the Shift Program XXX, nothing happens and the Shift Template is still there.-XXX = Shift Program ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select the Shift Programs view.-Find Shift Program XXX.-Open the Shift Program XXX.-Choose View All.-Select Shifts tab.-Select the Shift Template which you would like to delete.-Choose Remove.-Choose Delete.-The Shift Template is not deleted.-Cause-The Shift Program is assigned to a resource, hence the deletion is not possible.-Resolution-The system is working as designed, it does not allow the user to remove Shift Template from a Shift Program which is assigned to a resource.-Keywords-Resource-Shift-Program-Template

Title: Product Counted Quantity Column in Blank for Count Line Item
Content: Symptom-In Physical Inventory work center, the column Product Counted Quantity is not showing any data for Count Line Item XXX.-XXX = Count Line Item ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select Monitoring: By PI Count Item view.-Search for the Count Line Item XXX.-Notice that the Product Counted Quantity column is in blank.-Cause-The field Product Counted Quantity comes from Product Actual Quantity and it is only blank in PI Count Item if the Zero Quantity checkbox is checked in the relevant Count Task. If the task is not finished yet and the Zero Quantity is not checked, the field Product Counted Quantity will have value 0. However if the Zero Quantity is checked, the Product Actual Quantity is not populated and the Product Counted Quantity will be in blank.-Resolution-Since the Zero Quantity checkbox is checked, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-Physical; Inventory; PI

Title: Material Flow is Not Created After Migration of Location and Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-After successfully completing the migration process for Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool, the expected Material Flow is not created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Perform migration using the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.,-Select Open Activity List.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Location and Logistics Area.-Select Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool.-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen and Download Migration Template.-Fill the required and the mandatory fields in the migration file.-Upload the Migration File.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records.-Migration is successful.-To check if Material Flow is uploaded-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Search for the Locations which were part of the migration file that was imported.-Select Edit.-Go to Material Flow tab.-The data is not uploaded to the Source and Destination rules.-Cause-Migration of Location and Logistics Area supports only creation new records. Therefore, a new instance of Storage Location and/or Logistics Area can be created along with Material Flow Rules, Allowed Products and Descriptions-Since update scenarios are not supported, the Material Flow data was not migrated.-This is the expected behavior.-Resolution-Maintain the required Material Flow rules manually at the Storage Location.-As an alternative, model the Layout using multiple Storage Locations under a Site. In this setup, it is possible to create the required Location(s) directly through the Migration template along with the relevant Material Flow rules.---Keywords-Material Flow Rules; Locations; Migration of Location and Logistics Area; Site; Material Flow Rules Not Created; Storage Location; Successful Migration; Bydesign

Title: Data Duplication in Production Supply Task Extension Field
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field in the line Line Item table of the production supply task. When a value is entered in the extension field you see that the same value is getting copied to extension field of other line items also.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Navigate to the Task Control view.-Search and select the relevant supply task for which the information in extension field needs to be entered.-Choose the Confim button.-In the Line Items tab of the supply task enter a value, eg: ABC (ABC represents the value you enter) in the extension field available in the Items table of the task against one of the line items.-You see that this value gets copied to all the line items in the supply task item table.-Cause-This issue occurs due to a technical limitation in the system.-Resolution-The extenison field should be created not in the Line Items table of the supply task but in the Product Details section available under the General sub-tab of the same screen. When you create the extesnion field you will see two entries for the field Selected Business Context both of the them will have the value Production Lot - Output Product. You should select the second value and continue with creation of the extension field.-Keywords-duplication of extension field, supply task extension field value duplication, extension field value input duplication

Title: Tax Code Determination Error in Down Payment Requests created from Supplier invoice work center for China
Content: Symptom-The Tax Code is not automatically determined by the system in a Down Payment Requests and the following error message is displayed: The determination of tax code failed because tax rate is missing. Either select one manually or an error occurred in business configuration: APBCT_COMMON 607. Report an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-In the Common Tasks select the New Down Payment Request option-Enter the Company and Supplier of country China-The following error message is displayed: Tax code missing-Cause-For down payment requests no real products are used and therefore no product tax classification is available which can be used for the determination of the tax rate type to be used in tax calculation.-The tax rate type can be also determined by other special tax scenarios such as exemption but if such one is not applicable for a document, it can happen that no tax rate type and also no tax code can be determined by the system.-Therefore, for each country a default down payment tax code (one for Supplier Relationship Management, one for Customer Relationship Management) is configured in an internal tax table which helps in the determination of the tax code to be used in a down payment scenario. Usually these are a standard tax code for domestic sales / purchase. But these default down payment tax codes will only be used if no tax rate type can be determined and the determined tax attributes such as e.g. tax event also fit to these default tax codes for this scenario.- Since such default down payment tax code validity is expired you get the error.-Resolution-Follow below steps to extend the validity of the tax code:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Overview-Search for Activity: Tax on Goods and Services-Select Change Immediately-Select Define Tax Codes-Filter for Country=China-Here we can see Tax Code 12 = Exempted domestic purchase of products, down payment-We can see that the Valid to Date is expired-Update the Valid to Date-You save your changes in Business Configuration-Go back to the Down Payment Request and create a new-Keywords-Tax code missing,Tax Code Determination,Downpayment request

Title: Automatic Proposal of Identified Stock in Putaway Task
Content: Symptom-You want the system to automatically propose the identified stock when receving products via Putaway task or while performing Post Goods Receipt﻿.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Task Control view.-Search and select the task for which you want the system to propose identified stock automatically.-Choose the Confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen you see that the system does not automatically propose identified stock.-Cause-Put away tasks are created when the products are send to you via your supplier. In this case the system will not be able to automatically assume which is the identified stock that is send by your supplier. This will have to be manually entered or newly created via the task confirmation screen.-Resolution-You can enter an existing identified stock manually in the Inbound Delivery Notification or create a new identified stock from the confirmation screen of the Putaway task.-See Also-2637251 - Automatic Proposal of Identified Stock in Pick Task-Keywords-not able to propose identified stock automatically, Identified stock not proposed by the system, iStock proposal, iStock error

Title: Supplier Invoice Does not Show in the Document Flow of Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created and posted the supplier invoice with reference to purchase order. However invoice does not show in the document flow purchase order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Navigate to Document Flow tab-You cannot see the Supplier Invoice-Cause-If you open the document flow in extended mode, you can see two third party inbound deliveries created for purchase order. To see corresponding supplier invoices, you need to open the anchor button of third party inbound delivery document.  Then it will show the corresponding supplier invoices in the flow.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to see the missing supplier invoice in document flow;-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Navigate to Document Flow tab-By default, you can see the Third-Party Inbound Delivery and Supplier Invoice in the document flow-Click the anchor button of another Third-Party Inbound Delivery-Now system will show supplier invoice in the document flow-Keywords-Supplier invoice missing in document flow; Invoice missing in document flow; Invoice missing in PO document flow

Title: Exception Appears While Processing Supplier Invoice Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 1584460***-You are trying to post the supplier invoice and system shows the below exception.-Exception Type - Missing Receipt or Return Document-Error - The receipt document is missing or invalid-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to Exceptions tab-System displays Exception Type Missing Receipt or Return Document-Cause-You have created Supplier Invoice in advance before you create the Inbound Delivery. As a result, the references were not updated in the cost distribution of Supplier Invoice and hence created inbound delivery is not available in Supplier Invoice.-Resolution-You can update the Inbound Delivery references from the below steps and Post the Supplier Invoice:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-Remove the Order ID and Order Item reference-Reenter the Order ID and Order Item reference again-Now the document will be Ready for Posting and you can post the invoice-Keywords-Missing Receipt or Return Document, The receipt document is missing or invalid.

Title: Unable to Scrap the Material During Supplier Return Process
Content: Symptom-You have created the return to supplier document and would would like to scrap the material or goods without shipping back to supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Common Tasks view and select New Return to the Supplier-Select the relevant Supplier Delivery-Create new Return to the Supplier document-There is no option to scrap the material without being sent to supplier-Cause-In the current release there is no provision to scrap the material soon after you create supplier return. After you create supplier return, system always expects to send the material back to supplier using outbound delivery document and the entries will be visible in the Delivery Proposals view under Outbound Logistics work center.-Resolution-It is not possible to scrap the material after the return to supplier processing. The only option is to follow up decision like Replacement, Credit Memo and partial replacement and partial credit memo.-Keywords-Scrap the material after RTS; Scrap in RTS; Discard goods without shipping to supplier

Title: Ship-To and Bill-To Address Appears in Caps When you Preview US Purchase Order Forms
Content: Symptom-You are trying to preview the purchase order and noticed that Ship-To and Bill-To address appears in caps for US purchase order forms.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Preview-You can see that Ship-To and Bill-To location appears in caps-Cause-As per the postal regulations, it is necessary to maintain the postal address in caps only. You can check the website universal postal union for US, it is clearly mentioned that, on outward international items, the name of the country of destination must always be printed in capital letters. Hence it is mandate to have the postal address in caps only.-Resolution-It is expected to have caps for ship to and bill to address in purchase order forms for US as per the postal regulations.-See Also-KBA 3295250 -  Ship-To and Bill-To Address Appears in Caps When you Preview US Customer Invoice Documents-Keywords-Ship-To and Bill-To address appears in caps, Caps in PO forms

Title: You are able to create Project Purchase Request even though you do not have proper Access Rights
Content: Symptom-The user is able to create Project Purchase Request even though they do not have access to the Purchase Requests work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view-Search for the relevant Project. -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Products subtab.-Select Create Purchase Request for any product. -The Project Purchase Request can be created successfully. -Cause-The work center views are interdependent. Since the user has access to work center PRO_PROJECTS, they will get access to all views inside Projects work center. Therefore automatically the user gets access to create Purchasing documents related to Project directly from the Project under Products subtab.-Resolution-It is not possible to restrict users from activities related to project when they are already assigned to the Projects work center.-Keywords-PRO_PROJECTS, Project Purchase Request, Access Rights, Project

Title: You can see an Open Approval Task for a Voided Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-There is an open approval task for a supplier invoice document but the approver is not able to take any action on the task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Application and User Management work center-Select view Business Task Management-Search for a voided supplier invoice-There is an open approval task-Cause-Once you void a document, the corresponding approval tasks should get cleared off automatically.--But sometimes, if the approval task and the document is opened simultaneously, then a deadlock situation might occur causing approval tasks to not complete.-Resolution-If a document is in approval, please withdraw the document from approval first before you void the document.-Also for all such existing tasks, raise an incident giving us permission to remove these obsolete tasks from the back end.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Approval task, Void

Title: How to Capture Purchase Order Change log in a Standard Report?
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find Change log details in a standard Purchase Order report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select view Design Reports-Search for report:Monitoring Purchase Orders-There is no field to see the change log-Cause-There is no such data source currently which can capture the change log in purchase order.-Resolution-Under Key fields, you will get option to add changed by and changed on fields .-Keywords-Monitoring Purchase Orders report, Change log

Title: ERS Invoice Sequence Number is not Generated as per Numbering Format for Self Invoices
Content: Symptom-Numbering format is incorrect for self invoicing when it is created by copying from existing ERS( Evaluated Receipt Settlement).If we manually create the ERS invoice ,then the document number is correct.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select existing ERS document (self invoice having reverse charge tax code)-Select copy-The new document will not be created with the proper document number format which is maintained for self invoice-Now, goto Common Tasks-> New Manual ERS Invoice-The document number is correct as per Numbering format maintained in Business Configuration->Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing-Cause-When you copy a self invoice, the document numbering rules will not be applicable, as the invoice is treated as a normal supplier invoice.-Please refer Help Document: "Official Document Number for Self Invoice - India"-Resolution-Please create the invoice manually from Common tasks-> New Manual ERS Invoice-See Also-Please check this KBA:2537606 - Document Numbering for Self Invoice - India for more details on how to set up numbering rule for self invoicing-Keywords-New Manual ERS Invoice, Self Invoicing, Document Numbering

Title: Error Message:Form Template Code Mandatory
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:Duplicate of KBA 2982572 - Error :Form template is mandatory or Error Message:There's no Template Code in the Predefined Output Determination Rule -When you try to preview a document or click on post button on any document you get this error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to the Purchase Orders.-Open the affected purchase order.-Click on Preview, then select Changed PO.-You will receive the error "Form template code mandatory".-Cause-This is because currently there are no rules for this template.-Resolution-In order to adjust the reported behavior, please create a rule for this document.-Go to the Application and User Management.-Go to the Form Template Selection.-Search for the rule, e.g. Changed Purchase Order, credit memo-Click on Go button.-Create rules for it and save.-See Also-This details are applicable for most  of the doucuments on Bydesign if you get this same error-Keywords-Preview; Form; Template; Code; Mandatory; Purchase; Order; Error; Changed; Rule;

Title: Product Description appearing empty or wrong in any purchasing documents
Content: Symptom-Product description is not showing up in third party purchase request whereas it is showing up in preceding Sales Order document.- or- Product description is not appearing in the output form of purchase order.-or-How does system display the product description in Purchase order at item level or preview or output form.- or-You migrated purchase orders/purchasing contracts from your legacy system via the activity Migration of Purchase Orders/contracts in the Integrate and Extend phase for your current Implementation Project. For the Source Files, the Product Description appears in Language A (e.g. English). However in the migrated Purchase Orders, the Product Description appears in Language B (e.g. German) even when you are logged in using Language A.- or- You may upload purchase orders through excel and noticed that Product Description appears in Language B (e.g. German) even when you are logged in using Language A.- or-You may preview a Purchase order created manually and noticed that Product Description appears in Language B (e.g. German) even when you are logged in using Language A.-or-You are creating documents like Purchase order or supplier invoice or Supplier contract using technical user via Web Service and the Product Description is not pulled automatically from the  Material Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Requests-Search for the corresponding third-party purchase request which is created from planning proposal-The product description is missing for all the items-or-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Requests-Search for the corresponding purchase order-Click on preview button or out put history tab click on view.- or-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Requests-Search for the corresponding purchase request-Go to items tab and see the item description field-or-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to Contracts view-Show All Contracts-Find relevant contract-Select Edit-Go to Items tab-  Cause-The Product Description displayed is not retrieved from the Product Master Data at run time. Instead, the description is copied from the Product Master to the Purchase Order Item during the creation of the purchase order in the language in which you are logged in.-At Item level :(Applicable for all documents)-The description will be displayed based on Logon language and  respective description maintained in the master data at the time of creation of  Purchase request/ order.-The product description in master data is maintained in language (e.g. EN , EN refers to language) but the user who created this purchase request was logged in with different logon language other than EN , as a result when the Purchase request/ order was created ,system looked for the  product description in that logon language and since there was no product description maintained in that language, it saved the purchase request/order with blank product description.-In preview:(Applicable for all documents)-In the Output form or item level, for system to display the product description it takes the details saved at the time of creation of PO but in preview system takes   existing details,cause every time you click on preview button system can go to product master data to pick the respective description maintained in the master data for the  Supplier Langauge.If Supplier has no language maintained then it takes based on logon language.-In Output form:(Applicable for all Purchasing documents )-The description will be displayed based on Suppliers language,and  respective description maintained in the master data at the time of creation of  Document .If Supplier has no language maintained then it takes based on logon language.-Resolution-1.Go to respective product Master data, under General tab-> Select sub tab Other Languages-> here, you have to maintain description for all requied langauges then when you Log in using those languages the respective description will be displayed.-2.In Supplier Master data, under Communication tab->Address->here, you have to select each address and maintain language for them.-3.You need to log in to desired language before starting the upload of the migration or before creating a purchase order manually.also The default Log on language is english when we use webservice to upload any documents in ByDesign.(Even if the Description is in English in the Migration Template, the system will take into consideration the language you are logged in during migration. If you are logged in Language B (e.g. German) during migration, the description will always be in German even if logged in English.)-And kindly refer the excel atttached to this incident to know how the product description of product will appear in various scenarios based on supplier master data in various places when logged in using different log on languages.-See Also-2877915 - How is Log on language determined for Business users uploading documents via excel-2951384 - How to change Log on language of Technical users uploading documents via Soap UI-Keywords-Product Descriprion Missing, Third party Purchase Requests, Purchase Orders, Purchase order XML, Purchase order output form, No product description, product description empty,Product description in output form; Product description missing in the purchase request

Title: Cannot Change Process Type in a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Cannot change Process Type in a Purchase Order In Preparation. The field is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to the Purchase Orders View.-Search and open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID).-Click View All.-Go to the Items Tab.-Process Type is greyed out.-Cause-Scenario A: the Purchase Order is created from a Purchase Request which in turn is created from a Planning Purchase Proposal, the Process Type of the item will be always To-Stock.-Scenario B: the Purchase Order is created from a Purchase Request which is created from a sales order with items set for External Fulfillment, then the Process Type will be created as third party.-System allows Process Type changes only for Purchase Order items which do not have a predecessor process or if the predecessor process allows it. Creating manual Purchase Orders or adding a new item in an existing Purchase Order, System will allow change of process type.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Process Type, Purchase Order, Third Party, To Stock

Title: The Decimal Places in Supplier Invoice Net Value is Different  from that in Purchase Order Net Value
Content: Symptom-You have created a Purchase Order and then follow up delivery document is created and finally supplier invoice have been created.-The rounding value(decimal place) is same in Purchase Order and delivery document but not in supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-The net value in the Purchase Order is 100.09 USD(for reference)-Now go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select View Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the respective invoice w.r.t the Purchase Order or corresponding delivery document.-The net value in the supplier invoice shows 100.10 USD(for reference)-Note: The values(100.09 USD and 100.10 USD) are just for reference.-Cause-Since Purchase Order is initial document which does not have many complications, the calculation is fairly straight forward, which is quantity * net price.-Same is reflected in delivery document.-But, when it comes to Supplier Invoice, there could be many variations due to multiple deliveries or multiple partial invoicing.-Here's how we calculate Net amount in Supplier Invoice:-Net amount = (Invoiced Quantity) / (Ordered Quantity) * (Total Gross)-We always have to keep a track of amount and quantity that has been invoiced and that is remaining, using these criterion, system also proposes these when new Invoice is being created.-Resolution-You can manually change the Net Amount on the supplier invoice and trigger calculate total amounts, and then post the invoice.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice Net Value, Purchase Order, Inbound Delivery

Title: How to Change From Operating Time to Shift Program for an Equipment Resource
Content: Symptom-You migrate Equipment Resources using the migration template. In this template, you maintain "418 - Shift Program" in the column Active Operating Time Type. However, after the migration, the system defaultes this to "422 – Operating Time", and when you try to change this in the application, the system throws the error message: "Changing the time type not possible; delete the maintained data first".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Implementation Project and click the Open Activity List button.-Find and select the Migration of Equipment Resources Activity.-Click the Open button, to open the Migration tool.-Find and select the relevant Source File ABC (ABC represents the Name of the Source file).-Open the file ABC by clicking the Hyperlink.-Click Edit.-Go to the tab Std Operating Times.-Enter the code "418" in the sub-tab Active Operating Time Type.-Save and Execute the Migration.-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Resources view.-Find the relevant Resource XYZ (XYZ represents the Resource ID).-Click Edit.-Go to the Operating Times tab.-You can see that Operating Time Type is defaulted to "Operating Time" and when you change it to "Shift Program", you get the error message: "Changing the time type not possible; delete the maintained data first".-Cause-You are experiencing this because you have not deleted the maintained Operating Hours. You must first remove the maintained Recurrence Pattern.-Resolution-Please follow below steps for changing the Time Type from "Operating Time" to "Shift Program" for a Resource:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to the Resources view.-Find and select Resource XYZ.-Click Edit.-Go to the Operating Times tab.-Select the Recurrence Pattern and remove it.-Then select "Shift Program" instead of "Operating Time".-Save your changes.-Keywords-Recurrence Pattern, Supply Chain Design Master

Title: Purchase Order Available For Delivery After Supplier Return
Content: Symptom-You have returned the item received from your supplier via Supplier Return document. You expect the status of Purchase Order to not be available in Inbound Logistics for delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant purchase order.-You can see that the purchase order for which you have created supplier return is available for processing.-Cause-You have the option to receive goods for the purchase order again via the supplier. The supplier can choose to deliver replacement goods against the same purchase order and this is the reason why purchase order is available in Inbound Logistics. You can however, choose to manually Finish the Delivery and Invoice status of the purchase order.-Resolution-To manually finish the Delivery and Invoice status of the purchase order, follow the below given steps.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and select the purchase order document you have returned.-Under the Items section choose the Finish button.-You have the option to select Invoice and Delivery in the Finish button. Select the relevant option to manually finish Delivery and Invoice.-Once the above steps are performed the purchase order will not be available for receipt in Inbound Logistics.-Keywords-returend purchase order available for delivery, purchase order status error supplier return, Purchase Order Available For Delivery After Supplier Return

Title: Supply Planning Data Source and Report Shows No Data
Content: Symptom-The Supply Planning Product Exceptions [SCMEXCV01] Data Source, and reports created from this Data Source, does not return any data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data Source View.-Search and select the Data Source: "Supply Planning Product Exceptions".-Choose Preview.-Enter the Supply Planning Area ID: ABC. (ABC represents Supply Planning Area ID).-Choose Apply.-No results are displayed.-Cause-The Supply Planning Product Exceptions [SCMEXCV01] Data Source has a standard display limit of 5,000 exceptions. -If the number of exceptions exceeds this limit, no data is returned.-This is standard system behavior designed to prevent performance issues.-Resolution-Use additional filters while retrieving the data from the Data Source to narrow down the results.-Filter the Data Source using Supply Planning Area ID: ABC together with a Material ID: 123, the system successfully returns the corresponding Exception data.-(ABC represents Supply Planning Area ID, 123 represents Material ID)-Keywords-Material ID; Supply Planning Area ID; Report; Data Source; Supply Planning Product Exceptions; SCMEXCV01; Apply Filters; No Data; Exceptions

Title: Post Goods Issue Error In Stock Transfer Delivery Proposal
Content: Symptom-You receive error when choosing Post Goods Issue for a stock transfer proposal document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to Delivery Control: Delivery Proposals view.-Search for the relevant stock transfer proposal Id and select it.-Choose the Post Goods Issue button.-You receive the error below errors.-Error during warehouse request release.-Action failed.-Error during delivery update.-Technical error APDL_VAL 007; report an incident.-Cause-You have not enabled Stock Transfers option in your business configuration.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Choose the relevant implementation project and select the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Scoping section.-Expand the element Supply Chain Planning and Control and select the Logistics Control option to expand it.-You can see that the option Stock Transfers is not selected, select it.-Keywords-STO Error, not able to process stock transfer proposals, post goods issue error in stock transfers, why am i not able to post goods issue for stock transfer proposal?

Title: While creating New Customer Return Notification, Customer Invoice reference id is missing although Customer Invoice is generated
Content: Symptom-Customer Invoice id DEF (DEF refers to Customer Invoice id) is not shown under References while creating New Customer Return Notification although Customer Invoice DEF is generated and Posted successfully.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Inbound Delivery Work Center-In Common task, Go to New Customer Return Notification-In Step 1:Select Outbound Delivery Items, Search and Select the relevant Outbound Delivery Number-Select Next to Navigate to Step 2:Edit Customer Return Delivery Notification-Under Details, Navigate to Details tab-You observe under References Customer Invoice ID Field value is blank.-Cause-The field is not filled because the system does not keep track of the invoice during the customer return notification creation.-Resolution-In New Customer Return Notification reference to Invoice ID will not be displayed automatically,However we have provision to manually maintain Customer Invoice ID.-Keywords-Customer Invoice id is missing in New Customer Return Notification, the reference to Invoice ID will not be displayed automatically.
