Title: Error appears while performing Migration of Bills of material
Content: Symptom-System triggers an Error while performing Migration of Bills of material at Step 3: Simulate Import.-Error detected in source record DEF(DEF refers to BOM id)-Component DEF is locked-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Select Overview subview-Select Activities-Search for Activity Migration of Bills of Material-Select Migrate bills of material using the migration tool-Having file and Select execute migration step by step-Error appears at Step 3: Simulate Import-Error detected in source record DEF-Component DEF is locked-Cause-Lock error is being thrown on the records which have some of the input products in common.-While creating the instances the material will be in the lock mode due to parallel sessions, because of which the error occurs.-Some of the product KLM(KLM refers to product id) are common among BOM DEF.-Resolution-Split the file into 2 files by separating the records with the locking error and try migrating again.-Keywords-Migration, Bills of Material, BoM, Simulate Import, Error detected in source record, Component  is locked

Title: Project Time Recording is Not Going for Approval even though Project Set as Approval Required
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Combined with other duplicate  KBA: 2600134 - Project Time Recording Posted Without Approval-Project Time Recording is not Going for Approval even though Project set as Approval Required-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Select the relevant Employee.-Click on Edit-Navigate to Employee Times.-You can see the time entries are still active.-Cause-Below is the reason why the time recording did not go for the approval process.-The time recording is the same as the project manager-If the Project Manager does the time recording on behalf of an employee via time administration work center-If the Project Manager does the time recording on behalf of a service agent via service agent timesheet-If the Time Administrator does the time recording on behalf of an employee-Resolution-Ask the employee/ service agent to perform the time recording from the timesheet appearing in either home/ project team/ project manager work center-See Also--project time recording Active or released- Project Approval required-Without approval

Title: Error Message: Requesting Cost Center Only Permitted for Overhead Cost Projects
Content: Symptom-When migrating projects, you receive the error message:-Requesting cost center only permitted for overhead cost projects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search activity: Migration of Projects, open it.-Select Migrate projects using the migration tool.-Upload the project template you maintained.-Execute migration step by step, you get the error message as below:-Requesting cost center only permitted for overhead cost projects.-Cause-You have maintained reporting unit in the template under Project Plan sheet, but the reporting unit is only valid for project type: direct cost project.-If the project is maintained with other project types, system will raise the error.-Resolution-You need to remove the value of reporting unit if the project type is not direct cost project.-Or, according to your business case, you can keep the reporting unit but change the project type to direct cost project.-Keywords-Migration, Project, Overhead Cost Project, Project Type, 项目, 迁移，プロジェクト, 移行

Title: How to Add Specific Payee in Supplier Invoice?
Content: Symptom-Payee details are auto-populated and you are unable to select any payee from the value help under 'Parties and Locations' tab in supplier invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Under Common Tasks, select "new Supplier invoice without Purchase Order"-Select the supplier and goto "Parties and Locations" sub tab under General tab-The payee information is auto-populated as the supplier name . Now, Select value help, there are no other options available in the value help-Cause-As soon as you enter supplier name, the Invoicing Party and Payee fields will be automatically filled with the same data.-Resolution-If you want to specify a particular payee for that supplier, you can do so in the supplier master data.-Open the supplier master data of the particular supplier, select view all and navigate to Contacts tab-> Relationships-> select Relationship type as "Has the Payee", enter the Business Partner details--Then the system will pick that particular payee which you have maintained in the supplier master data.-Keywords-Payee, Invoicing Party, Supplier Master Data, Supplier Invoice

Title: Error Message:Total number of all individual materials in PO is restricted to 300
Content: Symptom-This error message appears when you try to add more individual materials in the purchase order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders work center-Click on new Purchase orders common task-Add all details for one or more-line items-Select each line item one after the other and click on button New individual material-Add individual items for each line item-Once you reach 300 individual materials in all items together system will throw this error-Cause-When Goods receipt is done details of these individual material are sent to Finance and more than 300 Individual materials in a XI message that is sent in back end to Finance causes performance issue at finance end and thus at purchase order itself we raise this error to avoid performance issues later.-Resolution-Create a new Purchase order for remaining items of purchase order for which you wanted to add individual Materials.-Keywords-Total number of all individual materials in PO is restricted to 300, error while adding Individual materials in Purchase order

Title: ARCHIVED:"File Validation Failed" when doing Migration of Purchase Order with Item of Service or Limit
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Similar incident raised earlier ,so i will merge the root cause and resolution on to one KBA:2874598 - Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create an incident" During Migration of Purchase Order-You are trying to do the Migration of Purchase Order with a Service Item Type or Limit Item Type but it is giving "File Validation Failed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-In the Overview, find the activity "Migration of Purchase Orders" and open it.-Click on "Migrate purchase orders using the migration tool".-Upload the file and then Execute Migration Step by Step.-It will give you "File Validation Failed".-Cause-This happens because you are trying to migrate a Purchase Order with Item Type 2 (Service Item) or 4 (Limit Item) and there is no Product ID or Product Description filled for it.-Resolution-When Item Type is 2 (Service Item) or 4 (Limit Item), either Product ID or Product Description should be supplied and it is mandatory to have one of them. Fill the Migration file with the required data and then proceed as usual.-Keywords-Migration; Purchase Order; File Validation; failed;

Title: Logistics Execution or Internal Comments in Notes of Pick Task is not Displayed in Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-During Logistics Process if Logistics Execution or Internal Comments are entered in Notes of Pick Task, the same is not displayed in corresponding Outbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter and Task Control view-2. Find Task 9999(where 9999 is the task ID) and View All-3. Go to Notes Tab and maintain internal comments-4. Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter and Outbound Delivery view-5. Select the corresponsing Outbound Delivery ID and go to Items Tab-You will notice that Notes is blank-Cause-The notes entered in the Site Logistics Tasks are not propagated to the Outbound Delivery as per the current design.-Resolution-To propagate notes till Outbound Delivery , suggest you to pass it from the starting document(In case of outbound process it should be sales order ).-Keywords-Notes, Internal Comments, Logistics Execution, Pick Task, Outbound Delivery

Title: XML is not Appearing Under Multi Output Channel Selection
Content: Symptom-You want to know why Output channel type XML is not available in the multiple channel selection under Application user management.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application user management work center-Click on Output channel selection view-In the Dropdown chose Created purchase order-Click on Go button-Click on Add button appearing under Field Output channel-  Cause-Due to possibilities of having multiple output channels present, calculating and populating this field has a performance hit.-The functionality is not changed or it's not that it’s not working, Its only to display multi-channel outputs we would have to use a table for Send by instead of a single field and using this table would be a performance hit.-  Resolution-For multi-channel output you can use the button you can also in purchase order and choose Edit output settings for example create Purchase order and view all the output channels selected here.-Also, you can set the multi-channel output in Supplier master data under Collaboration tab.-Keywords-XML is not there,Could not find XML,Multi channel

Title: Mismatch Between General Tab and Results Tab in Application Log
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled the Run XXX and the generated Application Log YYY has an error under General tab, however nothing is displayed under Results tab.-XXX = Run ID.-YYY = Application Log ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work Center and View which you can find the Run XXX.-Search for the Run XXX.-Select the Run XXX.-Find the Application Log YYY.-Open the Application Log YYY.-Under General tab, there is an error.-   6. Go to Results tab-There is no error and nothing is displayed.-Cause-You need to check the status mentioned on Results tab. Sometimes the system shows errors under General tab, however they are misleading errors.-Resolution-Check the status mentioned on Results tab. If Results tab shows only information message then there is no error during run.-Keywords-Run-Results-Error

Title: Price List not Found when Clicking Assign Source of Supply during Purchase Order Creation
Content: Symptom-Existing Price List is not found when Clicking on button Assign Source of Supply during Purchase Order Creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks > New Purchase Order.-Click Add Row.-Enter Product ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Product).-Go to Source of Supply tab.-Click Assign Source of Supply button.-Cause-To display the Source of Supply, it is necessary to fill out the Company ID in the UI and then only enter product ID and click Assign Source of Supply button.-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks > New Purchase Order.-Enter the Company ID.-Click Add Row.-Enter respective Product ID.-Go to Source of Supply tab.-Click Assign Source of Supply button.-System will display the available Price Lists maintained.-Keywords-Source of Supply, Purchase Order

Title: Set Labor Cost Rates Run to Obsolete
Content: Symptom-There is query of Obsolete Labor Cost Rate Run in view Labor Cost Rates of work center Cost and Revenue. But you do not know how to set a cost rate run to obsolete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center and view Labor Cost Rates. There is a query of Obsolete Labor Cost Rate Run.-However, there is no way to set a run to be obsolete.-Cause-There is no way to set a run to obsolete in UI.-Resolution-Please report an incident to us and we can help to set the run to obsolete in backend.-Keywords-Labor Cost Rate Run, Labor Cost Rate, 劳动力成本，劳动力成本批处理

Title: Custom Report on Project without Sales Order Shows Not Assigned Values
Content: Symptom-You want to create a report which will show the available Projects that do not contain Sales Orders.-You try to achieve this by creating a custom report based on a custom data source. For example, by joining the Projects, Baselines, and Snapshots (PROPRJU05) and the Sales Order Item (CRMSLOIB).-When you display the Project and Sales Order characteristics, on the report, you noticed that the Sales Order ID is shown as Not Assigned although the Project has a Sales Order linked to it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The behavior of the report is as designed.-Resolution-The reason you see the Sales Order as Not Assigned is because the link from the Project to the Sales Order occurs at Project Task Level.-By not showing the Project Task on the report you will not be able to see, at Project Level, whether the Sales Order is linked to it.--With the current functionalities, the only suggestion we can provide is to display the Project Tasks on the report then verify that none of these are linked to a Sales Order i.e. for all the tasks of a project, the Sales Order should be Not Assigned (#).--If the above does not fulfill your needs then a detailed feasibility study on your requirements and expectation would need to be done.-If you need this report urgently you may approach directly the Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by Cloud Service Center on https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html . You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page--Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.--Alternatively you can use the SAP Business ByDesign forums, available at: (https://www.sap.com/community/topic/business-bydesign.html) for further or future questions of this nature.-The forum is as great source of information and can be helpful to find answers to many questions regarding the implementation of SAP products. Alternatively, you may want to post questions that will then be answered by experts from the SAP Business ByDesign global community.--For long term request you may check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign.

Title: Unable to view the Payload SAP ESD data in Business Communication Monitor
Content: Symptom-You are trying to view the Payload of a Message Document Inbound delivery Notification DEF (DEF refers to Inbound Delivery Notification ID) but system is showing blank screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Business Communication Monitoring under Common Tasks.-Search for Document ID DEF.-Select the ID and Select button Show Payload, select sub-tab SAP ESD.-You observe blank screen, Content of the IDN is not displayed.-Cause-For messages that are received by the system successfully over one month ago, their payload will not be visible in the Business Communication Monitoring view.-Resolution-As the documents have already been created in the system with the information received from the messages, system is designed not to display the payload of such old messages to avoid any performance related issues.-Outgoing messages have same behavior.-Keywords-Payload, SAP ESD, Business Communication Monitoring

Title: Error message "Technical Error IPPM 057; report an incident" Appears when trying to Change the Validity of Production Model
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the validity of the Production Model DEF (DEF refers to Production Model id),Error appears-Technical error IPPM 057;report an incident-Save could not be executed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center-Go to the Production Models view-Select Production model DEF-Select Edit-Change the  Date value in Field Valid to-Select Save-Error message appears-Cause-Error is occurring as the corresponding  Product Specification  KLM (KLM refers to Product specification id) associated with Production Model DEF has been set to obsolete.-Resolution-Change the status of the  Product Specification KLM back to Released Status and then try to change the validity of the Production Model DEF.-Keywords-Technical error IPPM 057; report an incident, Save could not be executed, to change the validity of the Production Model DEF

Title: Available Sources of Supply is  Missing for a Product in a Sales Order Although Valid List Price Exist
Content: Symptom-You observe Available  Sources of supply does not show up any suppliers data while creating a New Sales Order although the product DEF(DEF refers to Product id) contain valid list price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center-In Common task,Select New Sales Order-Fill in all entries like Account, Product id DEF, Quantity etc.-Select Assign Source of supply by selecting the line item DEF-You observe that available sources of supply does not pull up any suppliers data although there is a valid list price.-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center-Navigate to List Price View-Search for DEF-You observe that there is a valid list price.-Cause-Requested date in Sales Order is beyond the List price Valid to Date, System is not able to find any  sources of supply for the given requested date, Hence system is not able to determine any sources of supply.-Resolution-We can resolve the issue in 2 different ways-Maintain the requested date in Sales Order within the timeframe of List Price Valid to or-Extend the Valid to date of List Price to a future date for the Product DEF -Keywords-Available Sources of Supply is Missing for Sales Order, Assign source of supply does not show up any suppliers data

Title: Decimals Places is Not Working Fine While Doing Calculation in the Total Gross Amount Field in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you are  doing say for example addition in Total Gross Amount Field of Supplier Invoice ,you see that the result is not having correct decimal place.-example: If you enter 1.1+1.1 it gives you result as 22,00 however you expect  2.2-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to common task New invoice without reference to Purchase order-Go to general tab-In the field total Gross amount-Enter for example 1.1+1.1 and click on enter button your key board-Cause-As per the settings you made for Decimal notation system is behaving accordingly.-Resolution-To see the settings you made ,please follow below steps:-Go to Right side top corner where you have your picture appearing, click on it-Choose My settings-Go to Regional settings-You will see the field Decimal Notation and  what is chosen in it.-Keywords-Decimal,Total Gross Amount Field in Supplier invoice, Calculation in the Total Gross Amount

Title: Due Date Greyed Out When Create New Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When creating a new supplier invoice, the Due Date field is automatically proposed and grayed out. You don't know how it's determined and how to edit it.- Or-Payment Due Date Not Calculated Correctly  as expected in Supplier Invoices-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view, find a to be invoiced purchase order.-Create a new invoice for it.-In the new screen, you can see the due date is automatically proposed and grayed out.-Cause-You have maintained a payment term for the supplier of the purchase order, and defined the due date calculation rule for the payment term.-Resolution-You can check the due date calculation rule for the payment term by following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open Activity List.-Open Fine tuning activity: Suppliers.-Open Define Payment Terms for Procurement.-Find payment term ABC, you can see the definition: Calculate due date based on *.-Due Date field is grayed out because system calculates according to the payment terms entered in the invoice.-In case you want to maintain a specific due date,  you need to remove the payment terms in the supplier invoice, then you will be able to manually enter the due date.-Keywords-Due Date, Supplier Invoice, Payment Term

Title: Unable to Download Demand Plan
Content: Symptom-You are trying to download a Demand Plan DEF(DEF refers to Demand Plan id),However you see Download button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Demand Plan Work Center.-Go to Demand Plans View.-Search for DEF.-Select Demand Plan DEF-You observe Download button is not active.-Cause-As Demand Plan DEF is in status "In Preparation", System is not allowing you to download the Demand Plan.-Note: Demand plan for statuses "Obsolete" and "Blocked",Download button would not be active.-Resolution-To Download a Demand Plan, Demand plan DEF should be in "Active" Status.-To activate Demand plan, Select a Demand Plan and Select Change Status --> Activate.-Keywords-Demand Plan not able to Download, Download button not active in Demand Plan

Title: Down Payment Request is not getting posted even though Document is Consistent
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a downpayment request even though there are no active exceptions,but it is throwing an error as "Posting not possible; clarify exceptions first".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for respective Down Payment Request-Select Post-System is throwing an error as "Posting not possible; clarify exceptions first", however, there are no exceptions in the document-Cause-The External Document Number is ending with special characters at the end which is not allowed-Resolution-Please enter valid external document number-Keywords-External Document Number, Special Characters, Supplier invoice, Down Ppayment request

Title: Error message appears when you are trying to assign a  resource to a Resource Group
Content: Symptom-While assigning a Resource DEF (DEF refers to resource id) to a New Resource Group KLM (KLM refers to resource group id),Error appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-In Common Tasks, Select New Resource Group-In General tab, Fill all relevant and mandatory entries-In Grouping tab, assign the relevant resource DEF-Select Save-Error appears as below-Cannot assign planning resource DEF to a planning resource group-Save Failed-Cause-Resource DEF is marked as Planning Relevant i.e "Resource Relevant for Capacity Planning" Flag is checked. If you want to assign a resource to a resource group, the resource must not be planning-relevant. This is causing the error.-Resolution-In order to resolve the error, Follow the below mentioned steps below.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Navigate to resources view-Search for DEF-Select Edit-Navigate to General tab-Descope the Option "Resource Relevant for Capacity Planning"-Select Save-Keywords-Cannot assign planning resource DEF to a planning resource group, Resource assignment to a New Resource Group, Resource Relevant for Capacity Planning,Cannot assign planning resource to a planning resource group

Title: Error message appears when trying to uncheck the Flag in Negative Stock Allowed for Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-While trying to uncheck the Flag Negative Stock Allowed in Logistics Area DEF (DEF refers to Logistics Area id),Error message appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center-Navigate to the Locations View-Select the Site ABC (ABC refers to Site id) and choose the option Edit Layout-In the Site Layout screen, choose the logistics area DEF-Uncheck the flag Negative Stock Allowed-Error message appears "Cannot disallow negative stock; negative stock exists".-Cause-As there is negative stock tagged to Logistics Area DEF, System is not allowing us to uncheck the Flag "Negative Stock Allowed" in Logistics Area DEF.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue. Perform Adjustment Confirmation for the material where negative sign is shown-Navigate to Physical Inventory Work Center-In Common tasks, Navigate to New Inventory Adjustment-Fill all the relevant entries in 1 Select Scope screen-In screen 2 Edit Inventory screen, Maintain Logistics Area, Product which has negative sign, Check Zero quantity-Select Next and Finish-Keywords-Cannot disallow negative stock; negative stock exists,System is not allowing us to uncheck the Flag "Negative Stock Allowed",As there is negative stock tagged to Logistics Area,System is not allowing us to uncheck the Flag "Negative Stock Allowed" in Logistics Area

Title: E-mails Are Sent in Different Idiom than Login Language
Content: Symptom-The user is receiving e-mail notifications in different idiom than login language.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log in English Language-Go to the Customer work center.-Go to the Accounts work view.-Open the Account 123 (123 defines the Account ID).-Go to the Activities facet.-Create a new task.-An e-mail notification is received by the user in another language.-Cause-E-mails sent by the system will check for the recipient's language maintained in Business Users and the e-mail will be delivered to the user in that language.-Resolution-In order to maintain the language for the user, you may follow the steps:-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the Users work view.-Select the Business Users subview.-Search for the user ABC (ABC defines the user ID).-Click Edit and select Attributes option.-Under Regional Settings maintain the Language.-The e-mail notifications sent will be received in that idiom.-Keywords-E-mail, Notification, Language,

Title: Error Message:Business Partner XXX not Found as Customer
Content: Symptom-You get this error while creating Purchase order, where XXX is a business partner.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase orders work center-Go to Purchase orders-Select and open respective Purchase order-Enter all relevent details-Click on order button-  Cause-We have a field on Purchase order UI which is labeled as Customer and you entered a business partner in that field, which does not have an account role.-Resolution-Go to Purchase orders work center-Go to Purchase orders-Select and open respective Purchase order-Click on view all-Go to Items tab-Go to Delivery Sub tab-Where you can see Customer field- So either remove the customer or maintain a valid customer-  Keywords-Business Partner not Found as Customer, Business Partner * not Found as Customer,Business Partner XXX not Found as Customer

Title: Header Task's Duration Not Updated Automatically After Child Task's Duration is Changed
Content: Symptom-When you change a Task duration you expect the header task of that Project to be updated accordingly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to Projects view-Search for respective Project-Open the Project- In the project plan in the Gantt chart, you see that  header task duration is Smaller than the highest duration task.-Cause-Since you maintained finish date as well as start date system cannot update the header task automatically because there is hard stop by mentioning finish date as to when the project has to finish.  So here finish date cannot change until you manually change it.-Resolution-If you want system to change the Header Task duration either mention only start date ( forward scheduling)or only finish date( backward scheduling).-Keywords-Project task Duration Not Updated, Project  task Duration Not changed

Title: Preview Button Disabled For Reason Code Transfer
Content: Symptom-You want to see the Preview of the Goods and Activity Confirmation ID with type as Transfer however the preview button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks and select Display / Reverse Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Show All Goods and Activity Confirmations.-Find required Goods and Activity Confirmation ID.-Select ID and choose Preview.-Here option Preview is disabled.-Cause-Since the scoping question: You will be able to print confirmation notification? is not Reviewed for Internal Logistics, preview option is disabled.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementations Projects view.-Navigate to guided activity and go Questions tab.-Expand All and select element: Manufacturing, Warehousing, Logistics-Choose sub-element: Internal Logistics and expand it.-Here choose Communication for Internal Logistics.-On right side, find question: You will be able to print confirmation notification.-Select and mark the checkbox as Reviewed.-Complete the guided activity and finish the scoping.-Once it is done, preview option will be enabled for Confirmation Type: Transfer.-Keywords-Transfer, Goods and Activity confirmation, Preview, Confirmation, Internal logistics

Title: How the Requestor/Recipient/Ship-To Location Fields are Filled in Goods and Service Receipt form XML
Content: Symptom-In UI Requestor/Recipient/Ship-To Location are filled at item level in all line items however they appear differently in XML which is explained below.-Environment-SAP Business ByDeisgn-Resolution-If Requestor is same at all items, then it is filled only at Header level, and not filled at Item level--If there are at least 2 different Requestors considering all items, then it is not filled at Header level and filled at each item level--The same behavior is applicable for Recipient/Ship-To Location fields also.--Keywords-Requestor in Goods and Service Receipt form XML,Recipient in Goods and Service Receipt form XML,Ship-To Location in Goods and Service Receipt form XML, Goods  and receipt XML, goods and receipt form

Title: Notifications of a Different User Shown For a User
Content: Symptom-In the Notification Center on the left side pane, you are unable to see the Notifications which belong to you, but instead see the Notifications belonging to a different user.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the system in either HTML5/Fiori-Click on the Notification Center on the Left Side Pane-The Notifications shown are that of a different user-Cause-The Notifications displayed are those of an impersonate user - the user who is used as proxy while using the 'Logon as Another User' functionality. This could occur because a business user or key user has been used to impersonate your business user previously.-Even if you remove the impersonate user entry from the 'Logon as Another User' screen, this would still be registered in the backend, causing this problem.-Resolution-It is recommended to never use a business user or key user to impersonate another user. Always create a KEYTEST user for this purpose. To remove the already registered entries from the backend, kindly reach out to SAP Support.-See Also-Logon as Another User - C4C Help Center-Keywords-notification, keytest, logon as another user, impersonate, missing

Title: In Workflow Rules The IncoTerms Location Field is Not Available for The Rule Type Field Update
Content: Symptom-When you are creating a workflow rule for the Sales Data business object, the Incoterms Location field is not available for the rule type Field Update.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the Workflow Rules view.-Select the New button.-Choose the business object Sales Data.-Go to the Define Actions tab.-Select the Rule Type Field Update.-Select the Add button.-Here the Incoterms Location field is not available for selection.-Cause-This is currently the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-Our development team have confirmed that this requirement cannot be done in the standard.-However you can try to achieve this via extensibility : PDI -> SAP Cloud Application Studio.

Title: New Parts Return Notification Task is Missing Under Common Tasks of Inbound Logistics Work Center
Content: Symptom-You want to do spare parts return but you do not have the relevant task to do it.-Environment-SAP Buiness ByDesign-Cause-You have not scoped Spare parts handling in Business configuration.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to scope Spare parts handling:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation projects-Click on Edit project scope-Go to Step 3 Scoping-Expand element Service-Expand Service and Repair-Select Spare Parts Handling and check mark it-Then go to next step Questions-Review all questions and  -Check mark them according to your business-  Keywords-New Custodian Goods Return Notification, Spare Parts Return

Title: Unable to Activate ERS Functionality Under Supplier Invoicing Work Center
Content: Symptom-You would like to create Evaluated Receipt Settlement (ERS) invoices. However, there is no corresponding view exists under Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-You cannot see Evaluated Receipt Settlement Runs View.-Cause-You need to scope and activate Automatic settlements checkbox in the scoping section under Business Configuration Work Center.-The Automatic Settlements business topic allows your accountant to set up evaluated receipt settlements (ERS) and recurring invoices. Automatic settlements enable you to automatically create invoices in your solution on behalf of your suppliers. Using ERS enables automatic creation of invoices based on existing purchase orders and goods and services receipts. Recurring invoices enables automatic creation of invoices based on an agreed payment plan, for example monthly rental payments.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to configure ERS Invoice functionality.-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Step 3 Scoping and select the scoping element Purchasing.-Select the sub-element Supplier Invoicing.-Select the checkbox for Automatic Settlements scoping element and select Next.-In Step 4,  select the scoping element Purchasing.-Select the sub-element Supplier Invoicing and Automatic Settlements scoping element.-Select the question 'Do you create invoices automatically on behalf of your supplier by using evaluated receipt settlements?' Yes.-Select Next and Finish the scoping.-Relog on the system once the scoping is finished. Then the Evaluated Receipt Settlement Runs view will be available under Supplier Invoicing work center provided user is assigned to work center view Evaluated Receipt Settlements.-Keywords-ERS Invoice functionality, Cannot create ERS invoice, Evaluated Receipt Settlement not Available

Title: Supplier Invoice Provision Date is not correct
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoice Provision Date is not same as the Posting Date of the Supplier Invoice in the Project Time and Expenses view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work center.-Select Time and Expenses view.-Select All items.-Search for Project ABC (ABC represents Project ID).-Filter the Supplier Invoice.-The invoice shows a Provision Date of XX.YY.ZZZZ, which is different from the Supplier Invoice Posting Date.-Cause-The Provision Date of the expenses from the Supplier Invoice for the Project is taken from the Service Period interval ("to"-date) of the invoice item.-In this case, the Service period for the two items is the Service period from/to date of the Supplier Invoice is communicated from the customer as delivery period start and end date.-If there is no Provision Date maintained at the item level pricing terms, so the Customer Invoice date is taken as the service start date.-Then a duration is set and a period is derived. A unit of one day is added to the invoice date and it is used as the service end date.-The time zones are in UTC. This is how the service start and end date is derived and passed on to the Supplier Invoice.-This is done as there is no Provision Date available at the item level, the invoice date was used to derive the delivery period.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords-Project expense Provision Date; Supplier Invoice

Title: In a New RFQ, When we Try to Enter the Buyer Responsible, In the Drop Down, Buyer Responsible is Not Found
Content: Symptom-You are searching for Buyer responsible to be entered in RFQ, but you do not find any.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-For the RFQ scenario, Buyer responsible's -Workplace Contact Data in the employee master details are mandatory,cause only then the RFQ bidders can contact the Buyer Responsible.-Resolution-To resolve this, you have to maintain relevant contact details for such buyer responsible persons.-Go to Personal Administrator work center-Go to Employees-Search for respective Employee ID and click on edit-Go to Employment tab-Go to Workplace Contact Data tab and update details-Keywords-Buyer responsible missing,Buyer responsible not found,Buyer responsible empty,Buyer responsible not there.

Title: You Have Maintained Values for Gross Weight and Volume in the Outbound Delivery, but they are Missing in the Label.
Content: Symptom-You have created an Outbound Delivery ODX (ODX represents the Outbound Delivery ID) and entered Gross Weight and Gross Volume, but in the corresponding Outbound Label LAB (LAB represents the Label ID), the values are not displayed. Now you would like to know how to obtain gross volume and weight on the Labels without entering them in the ‘new labels’ screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Find and select Outbound Delivery ODX.-Click the Edit button.-If you check the Logistics Details section of the Outbound Delivery, you can see that the values for the Gross weight and Gross Volume are displayed.-Now go to the Common Tasks and select Labels.-Find and open the Label ID LAB.-Click the View button.-Now in the Label Overview of Label LAB, you can see that in the Logistics Details, the Gross Weight and Gross Volume fields are empty.-Cause-The Gross Weight and Gross Volume are not shown in the Label created, because there is no Unit of Measure (UOM) Characteristics maintained in the Product Master Data (Net weight, length, width, height etc.) of the affected Material. This information is read from Product Master Data while creating new Label.-Resolution-Navigate to Product Data work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Find and Select Material MAT (MAT represent the Material ID).-Click the Edit button.-Go to the General tab, and then to the UOM Characteristics sub tab.-Maintain the desired UoM characteristics.-Save and close.-Now the values should propagate when you create new Labels once you have maintained them in the UoM Characteristics.-Keywords-UoM characteristics, Logistics, Details, Outbound, Delivery, Labels, Good, Tag

Title: Return to Supplier With Follow-Up Decision: Replacement is in Status- In Process
Content: Symptom-Return to Supplier with Follow-Up decision: Replacement is not in finished status but in In process status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Scenario 1:-Return to Supplier will be in status In process ,after doing outbound delivery, cause return is done on finished Purchase order, since Purchase order is not open you cannot do inbound delivery on it. hence to allow you to do inbound delivery the status of the Return is kept open.-Scenario 2:-Return to Supplier will be in status finished ,after doing outbound delivery (ensure outbound delivery is done completely for quantity as requested in return),cause return is done on Purchase orders in status follow up document created, since Purchase order is open you can do the inbound delivery on it.-Resolution-Scenario 1: Create inbound delivery and then status changes to Finished.-Scenario 2: Create inbound delivery and status remains as Finished.-Keywords-Return to Supplier,Follow-Up decision Replacement,Follow Up decision is Replacement,Return to Supplier  In process

Title: You are Unable to change the Number Range for Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-While defining number ranges for purchase orders, you are  getting following error:-Update from number SRMPO_PO_ECPO failed; interval is already in use-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Business Configuration work center-Select fine tuning activity: Number Ranges for Operational Purchase Documents-Select "Purchase Orders" under that-Select and change the Begin Number and End Number-Error encountered-Cause-Once the number range is already in use, system does not allow to change it to avoid number gaps and inconsistency. You can only set the current number within the End Number and not more than that.Hence, to avoid any inconsistency , we recommend to set the number range in the beginning itself when system is set up before any order is created.-Resolution-In your case, you can first change the end number as required e.g.XXX (XXX represents number range) and then change the current number which should be less than XXX. Then the new Purchase Order number will start from the next number(+1) i.e. XXX+1-You have to set the current number greater than the last created purchase order number in the system and it should be within end number range.-Note: Please remember once the purchase order is created with new number , you cannot again change the current number less than the latest order number-Keywords-Number Range, Purchase Orders, Current Number

Title: Withdraw From Approval Button is Grayed out in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You would like to withdraw the Shopping Cart from approval however Withdraw From Approval button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center-Go to the Self Services and select Self-Services Overview-Go to the Shppping and select Track My Shopping Carts-Open the relevant Shopping Cart-You can see that Withdraw From Approval button is grayed out-Cause-The relevant shopping cart is Rejecetd by approver. When approver reject a request, that request cannot be changed or resubmitted. The rejection is final. Hence the Withdraw From Approval button is grayed out.-Resolution-Approver can use Send back for Revision instead of Reject. If approver rejected the request, the employee who created is informed and the request for approval is removed from manager task list.-Note: The creator of the shopping cart receives this notification in the Inbox sub view of the Work view of the Home work center-Keywords-Withdraw From Approval button is grayed out in shopping cart , Withdraw From Approval

Title: Error Appears While Creating New Individual Materials in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating purchase order for fixed assets however when you select New Individual Material button, system shows an error message:-Error: Item 1 - Number of Individual Materials restricted to 100-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view -Select the relevant Purchase Order-Navigate to Items tab and select New Individual Material button-Error appears-Cause-Currently it is possible to create up to 100 individual materials for one purchase order item. At the same time, the total number of all individual materials in purchase order is restricted to 300.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior. As a work around, you can split the individual materials to 100 per purchase order and create them.-Keywords-Number of Individual Materials restricted to 100; Individual Material; Purchase Order

Title: Project Manager Cannot View Details in The Work Package Assignment E-mail
Content: Symptom-When project team member assign a work package to himself/herself, the project manager receives an e-mail, but the content is not clear.-You want to know how to make  the detailed information be shown in the e-mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the account of employee ABC (ABC refers to the employee name), ABC is the team member of project DEF (DEF refers to the project ID).-Go to Project Team - Work Packages view.-Search project DEF, select a unassigned project task, click Assign to me.-The project manager of DEF receive an e-mail to inform the assignment, the content is like below:-A work package has been assigned to a team member of the project.-This e-mail contains limited information. To see more details, please upload a valid certificate.-This is an automatically generated e-mail, please do not reply.-Cause-You have scoped the question "Do you want to use encryption and signature for e-mails?" in business configuration.-To view more details in the e-mail, you need to upload a S/MIME certificate or unscope question "Do you want to use encryption and signature for e-mails?".-Resolution-Solution A. Upload a S/MIME certificate-Go to Application And User Management, Business Users view.-Select the project manager user.-Click Manage Certificates.-In the new screen, click Upload S/MIME Certificate.-  Solution B.Unscope the question "Do you want to use encryption and signature for e-mails?"-Go to Business Configuration, Implementation Project view. -Edit the current project, go to Step 4, Questions.-Expand Built-in Service and Information Exchange -> System Management-> Security, find the question "Do you want to use encryption and signature for e-mails?", unscope it.-Finish the setting.-Whether you followed solution A or B, once the change done, the new email content will be changed to:-A work package has been assigned to a team member of the project.--The details are as follows:-Project: ***(Project Name)-Task: ***(Project task name)-Work Package: ***(Work package name)-Team Member: ***(Team member's name)--This is an automatically generated e-mail, please do not reply.-Keywords-Project, Work Package, Assignment, Email, 项目,  邮件, プロジェクト, メール

Title: ME11 is not a Valid Value for This Field. Enter a Valid Value
Content: Symptom-You Cannot Preview Production Confirmation. You are trying to preview Production Confirmation, and when you click the Preview button, the system triggers the following error messages:-- ME11 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.-- Action failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control Work center.-Go to the Monitoring view.-Find and select Production Lot ID ABC (ABC represents the Production Lot ID).-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Confirmations tab.-Open the Confirmation ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Production Confirmation ID) by clicking on the hyperlink link.-Click Preview, and then on Preview.-The following errors are displayed:-- ME11 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.-- Action failed.-You can see that the Preview is not generated.-Cause-This error occurred because ME11 which is a code as per Template Group does not exist in the system. It refers to ‘Confirmation Template’ which displays the preview for confirmations. To rectify this issue, we request you to please enable ‘print confirmation notification’ in Business Configuration settings under Implementation Projects in the First Implementation view. Once you have enabled the Scoping Question then please check rules for "Confirmation Template" under Form Template Selection subview in Input and Output Management View. It should be available now. Thereafter, you can navigate to the Form Template Maintenance and enter Template Group as ‘ME11’ to be able to select and publish the Confirmation Templates your business requires.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation Project and click Edit Project Scope.-Click the Next button until you get to step 4 Question.-Expand the Scoping Element ‘Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics’.-Expand Internal Logistics.-Select the Scoping Element ‘Communication for Internal Logistics’.-On the right side of the screen, please check the Question ‘You will be able to print confirmation notification.’ Under ‘Group: Print Confirmation Notification (1)’.-Now Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Go to the Form Template Selection view.-You should be able to find In the Show Rules for field ‘Confirmation Notification’-Click the Go button and the Confirmation Template should now be available.-You can now navigate to the Form Template Maintenance View.-Select the ‘Advanced’ view.-Enter ‘ME11’ in the Template Group field.-Now you can see the list of all Confirmation Templates.-Select a Confirmation Template of your choice and publish it as per your business requirement.-After maintaining all these settings, if you preview the Production Confirmation, the system should not throw any error message.-See Also-The attached Word document 'ConfirmationTemplates.docx' for your reference.-Keywords-Confirmation, Templates, Production, ME11

Title: Purchase Order not available in the service agent timesheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2525032*** -Purchase Order not available in the service agent timesheet-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-once the time sheet is launched.-Cause-In case of intercompany project scenarios, the sales order should be Open/Inprocess status and the intercompany project should be released then only the intercompany relevant purchase order will be available in the service agent time sheet.-Resolution-Release the intercompany relevant sales order and intercompany project which are created out of purchase order.-Keywords-time recording for service agent, project purchase order,Purchase order not appearing in the time sheet,purchase order not found,Purchase order not appearing automatically

Title: Error Message While Adding Resource to the Services tab of Bills of Operations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a row in the Services tab of a Bill of Operation, and when you click on check Consistency, the system returns the error message:------> Resource reqmt missing for res.LAB (LAB represents the Resource ID) of service reqmt at activity ACT (ACT represents the Activity ID), op.XZY (XYZ represents the Operation ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to the Production Bills of Operation view.-Find and select the Production Bill of Operation BOO (BOO represents the Bill of Operation ID).-Click the Edit button.-Click the Check Consistency button.-The system triggers the following error messages:-Bill of operations BOO not consistent------> Resource reqmt missing for res. LAB of service reqmt at activity ACT, op.XYZ (Service missing for service reqmt at activity ACT below operation XYZ).-Cause-Since you have not maintained the Resource LAB which is assigned to the Activity ACT as a Main Resource, this is causing the issue. You must add the Resource LAB as an Additional Resource of the Activity ACT to resolve the issue.-Resolution-Navigate to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to the Production Bills of Operation view.-Find and select the Production Bill of Operation BOO.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Structure tab.-Select the Activity ACT.-Now go to the Additional Resources sub-tab.-Click the Add Row button.-Add the Resource LAB.-After adding the Resource, now click on the Check Consistency button. The Bill of Operation should be consistent.-See Also-2664206 Error Message While Migrating Bills of Operations-Keywords-Resource, reqmt, missing, service, reqmt, activity, Operation

Title: Advanced Shipping Notification Not Sent For Outbound Deliveries
Content: Symptom-You have set up the Advanced Shipping Notification in Communication Arrangement and required settings for account as well however when you release an Outbound Delivery, system doesn't send an ASN document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Workcenter.-Go to 3PL Outbound view.-Go to Outbound Deliveries sub view.-Show All Outbound Deliveries by selection and find the required ID.-Select it and edit the required outbound delivery.-Navigate to Document Flow.-Here you see that system has created the ASN however it is with technical error: Solve Connectivity Issue.-Cause-Since you have not maintained the Authentication Method in communication arrangement which is a mandate field system is not able to connect to the right protocol.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Go to Input and Output Management view and select Communication Arrangements sub view.-Find the Communication Arrangements: Output of Advanced Shipping Notification.-Select and edit it.-Choose Check Completeness on the top of screen.-System throws error: Invalid Authentication Method.-Now go to tab: Technical Data and check under Outbound Communication: Basic Settings.-Under field Authentication Method, choose either SSL Client Certificate or User ID and Password as per business requirement.-Perform Save and Reactivate.-Keywords-Invalid Authentication Method, Advanced Shipping Notification, Outbound Delivery, SSL Client Certificate, Communication Arrangements, Output of Advanced Shipping Notification

Title: FewPurchase Orders not Appearing Using the WebSevice -QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn
Content: Symptom-You did not get the desired list of Purchase order using Webservice though you got  the same using Respective report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Because of specific 'timeZoneCode' value( ike UTC) passed via the query parameter related to 'Ordered Date Time'. so only those Purchase orders created with that time zone are appearing.-Resolution-Do not use the Time zone in the query.- For example:- If your requirement is to fetch the POs of current year, you can use the 'IntervalBoundaryTypeCode' as '9'( Greater Than or Equal to) and 'LowerBoundaryOrderedDate' as 1st January with no specific time zone mentioned.--As suggested below,--<IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>9</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>-<LowerBoundaryOrderedDate timeZoneCode="?">2018-01-01T00:00:00Z </LowerBoundaryOrderedDate>-Keywords-QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn, Purchase ordes missing, Webservice query  not working

Title: Error Appears While Creating new Purchase Order With Reference to Service Order for Repair Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have released the service order for intercompany repair scenario and purchase request got created. However when you create new purchase order from purchase request, system shows the error message-Error:-Item 1: Limit missing-Item 1: Limit value cannot be less than or equal to zero-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Requests view-Select All Purchase Requests query-Select the relevant Purchase Request created from Service Order-Select New Purchase Order and click on Check button-Cause-You have released the intercompany service order with net value Zero and the same has been carry forward to purchase request with Value Limit Zero. Hence the error message appears-Resolution-You can release the service order with non-zero value or you can enter the value limit either in purchase request or purchase order to fix the error-Keywords-Limit missing, Limit value cannot be less than or equal to zero

Title: Error: Conversion factor for quantity MASS not defined in Product definition; Action Failed.
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to confirm the Make Task, system throws below error messages :----->Conversion factor for quantity MASS not defined in Product definition; Action Failed.----->Save Failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Find required Task ID against respective Production Order.-Select and choose to confirm.-Mark the checkbox confirmation finished.-Here system throws above error messages.-Cause-For input products, in their respective product's master data, the base UoM is X and the logistics, planning, valuation UoM of the same product is Y. There is no conversion factor maintained in the product master between X and Y. ( i,e. here X and Y are Units of Measure)-Resolution-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center-Go to Products view -Search for a respective Product ID.-Select and edit it.-Choose View All-Under General tab, go to General sub tab.-Scroll down, under the Quantity Conversions section.-Maintain the Quantity Conversion factor between X and Y. ( i.e. here X and Y are Units of Measure)-Keywords-Units of Measure,Conversion factor for quantity MASS not defined in Product definition, Make Task

Title: Error: "The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident."
Content: Symptom-When trying to release an Inbound Delivery getting an below error message:-"The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, Report an incident."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Inbound Deliveries View.-Show All Deliveries and select the Delivery ID.-Choose option Release and it throws above error message.-Cause-The Warehouse Task is marked as Finished, but here not accepted the Deviation notification that is created for one of the line items in the pick task.-Resolution-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Monitoring view.-Go to Work subview.-Here find the relevant Notification ID created against the relevant Pick Task.-Select and choose Accept Deviation.-Once it is done, respective Inbound Delivery can be released.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, Accept Deviation, The action Release is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again, Not Released

Title: Completed Production Orders Still Displayed in Product Planning Details
Content: Symptom-Even though the Production Order has been completed there is still a Dependant Demand shown in the Product Planning which is in status: Production Started.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Work Center Supply Planning.-2. View Products.-3. Show All and Find ABC (ABC represents the Product ID).-4. Click Open.-Result: there is a Dependant Demand (Request) displayed in status: Production Started.-5. Click on the Document ID to open it.-6. Click View All button.-7. Go to Document Flow tab.-Result: Production Order DEF (DEF represents the Production Order ID) is Finished/Closed.-Cause-The Production Requisition status will be changed to "Production Finished" only when the Production Request is finished for both "Production Request Status" and "Production Order Creation Status".-Resolution-1. Go to Work Center Production Control.-2. View Production Requests.-3. Show All and Find the respective Production Request.-4. Select it and click "Set Complete" button-Keywords-Production Request, Production Order, Production Started, Dependant Demand, Product Planning, Finished

Title: System Triggers the Error Message 'Action PGR_BACKGROUND not possible; action is disabled' When Doing Post Goods Receipt with Custom Solution
Content: Symptom-You have created a Partner solution with a Custom User Interface to perform Post Goods Receipt as Planned for Stock Transfer Orders. However, when you try to execute the action, the system returns the error message  'Action PGR_BACKGROUND not possible; action is disabled'. Now you want to know how to resolve the issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the relevant Custom work center.-Go to the relevant Custom work center view.-Enter a valid value in the Field 'Stock Transfer Order ID'.-Click the Save button.-System returns the error message: Action PGR_BACKGROUND not possible; action is disabled.-Cause-Post Goods Receipt is not possible if the Status of the Inbound Delivery Notification is not Received.-Resolution-1. Set the Inbound Delivery Notification to Received status. The Action:ACKNOWLEDGE_DEL_NOTE at the Root of 'APDL_INBOUND_DELIVERY.Action' is already released.-2. Once the Inbound Delivery Notification is in Received status, the Action PGR_BACKGROUND at the Root of 'APDL_INBOUND_DELIVERY' shall be enabled for consistent Inbound Delivery Notifications only.-Keywords-Post, Goods, Receipt, as, Planned, Action, PGR_BACKGROUND, not possible, action, is, disabled, PDI

Title: The sales Order Requested Date is not reflected in Third-party Purchase Order if the Delivery date is Manually Changed in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In Purchase order, there is a column called "Purchase Order Delivery Date" . Third Party Purchase Order delivery date is by default the same as the request date in Sales Order. However, if you changed the delivery date in Purchase Order , it will show only the latest delivery date in the Purchase Order and not the initial request date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-Select New Sales Order-Create a Sales Order with External Fulfilment-Enter a Requested date which is the tentative delivery date in follow up document Purchase Order-Submit the Sales Order-Navigate to Document flow of sales order-The third-party Purchase Order is created out of the sales order-Open the relevant Purchase Order and you can see the requested date is showing in the delivery date column in the Purchase Order-Change the delivery date and send update-The updated date will be showing in the delivery date column now.The Initial requested date in Sales Order is no longer reflected in Purchase Order delivery date.-Cause-The Purchase order will always show the latest delivery date which is updated by the user , because that is the actual date on which the delivery of goods will take place.--This is the standard behavior.-Resolution-As a work around, you can create an extension field from Sales Order to Purchase Order to reflect the initial requested date as a new column in Purchase Order.-Keywords-Purchase Order Delivery Date, Third-Party Purchase Order Delivery Date, Sales Order Requested Date

Title: You are not authorized to access UI application /BYD_ODT/BC/BC_LINKS/CREATE_FORM_GENERIC_PROV_VAR.QA.uicomponent
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add Travel Assistants and received the error message You are not authorized to access UI application /BYD_ODT/BC/BC_LINKS/CREATE_FORM_GENERIC_PROV_VAR.QA.uicomponent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implimentation Projects view.-Click on Open Activity List.-Search for Activity Create New Country Version.-The error appears You are not authorized to access UI application /BYD_ODT/BC/BC_LINKS/CREATE_FORM_GENERIC_PROV_VAR.QA.uicomponent.-Cause-Generic Business Role is not assigned to the user.-Resolution-Login as an administrator.-Go to Application & User Management Work center.-Go to User & Access Management view.-Go to Business users & Find the User.-Click on Edit & then Select Access rights.-Go to Business Role Assignment.-Select the checkbox under Assigned to user for the Business Role Name Generic.-Keywords-You are not authorized to access UI-new country version, expense reports

Title: Purchase Request Not getting Automatically Created from  Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-Purchase Request is not automatically created from Shopping Cart even though you have scoped " You can receive purchase requests from shopping carts " in Business Configuration settings-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select Self Services Overview-Select Shopping Cart(Advanced) option-Create a Shopping cart and submit it-Now, open the relevant Shopping Cart and navigate to Document flow-The Purchase Request is not created from the shopping cart even though cart is in Requested status-Cause-You have made the changes in scoping questions in a Merged/Change Project. But you have not closed the fine tuning activity "Activate Solution Capabilities"-Resolution-In order to reflect the changes done, you need to confirm this activity "Activate Solution Capabilities" in the Business Configuration fine tuning activity, then the activity will get closed and the changes will be effective for any newly created document.-Keywords-Activate Solution Capabilities, scoping, Merge project, shopping cart, purchase request

Title: New Inventory Balance Report and Data Source
Content: Symptom-You can see that from 1808 release new data sources and report are introduced in Business ByDesign for Inventory Balance and Inventory Balance Details. These new data source and report is to replace the already existing Inventory Balance Report and Data Source.-The details of the new data source and report is provided below.-Data Source  / Report  Name Old Entities (Deprecated) New Entities-Inventory Balance Data Source  SCMINBU01 SCMINBU03-Inventory Balance Details Data Source SCMINBU02 SCMINBU04-Inventory Balance Report  SCMINBU01_Q0001 SCMINBU03_Q0001-Inventory Balance Details Report SCMINBU02_Q0001 SCMINBU04_Q0001-        Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Navigate to the view Design Reports.-Use the key word Inventory Balance and search for the available report.-You are able to see that the system displays reports with name Inventory Balance and Inventory Balance (deprecated).-The same is visible for Inventory Balance Details report also.-Cause-SAP wanted to improve the performance footprint of the existing Inventory Balance (SCMINBU01_Q0001) and Inventory Balance Details (SCMINBU02_Q0001) report. Since customers would have already created custom reports on the above mentioned data sources, any changes would disrupt the reports created. Inorder to negate this issue SAP created new Data Source and Reports for Inventory balance.-Resolution-You can continue to use the deprecated data sources, but there will be no new changes performed from SAP side for the deprecated data sources. The deprecated data sources will not be available for any changes for newly reported issues on them. SAP encourages the customers to make use of the new data source and reports for better performance of the Inventory Balance and Inventory Balance Details reports. Any further changes in the report and data sources will be performed only on the new data sources.-Keywords-Deprecated Inventory Balance Report, Deprecated Inventory Balance Details Report, Inventory Balance report duplication, Inventory Balance details report duplication, Why is the Inventory Balance report deprecated?

Title: Error message appears  when you are trying to Post Goods Receipt from Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you are trying to create Post Goods Receipt for an  Inbound Delivery Notification, system shows an error message.-Logistics area DEF not valid (DEF refers to Logistics Area ID)------> Usage of logistics area does not match allowed usages-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center-Navigate to the Purchase Orders View-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Click the Post Goods Receipt button-Select Propose Quantities and select the relevant Target Logistics Area ID-Select Save and Close-Error message appears:-Logistics area KLM not valid (KLM represents the Target Logistics Area ID).------> Usage of logistics area does not match allowed usages.-Save failed-Further when you click the Value Selector of the Target Logistics Area, a new window opens up. In the new window, select Result Type as "All results" and click the Go button.-You observe the selected Logistics Area in Target Logistics Area is Red in color under Result Type. When you hover your cursor on the red icon, you observe the message "Inventory retrieval or placement is not allowed, constraints not met".-Further, when you hover your cursor on the Red color under Logistics Use, you observe message "The logistics use must be the same logistics use you specified in the corresponding logistics model".-Cause-You have set Autonomic Inspection in the relevant Logistics Model, but have not set the Logistics Use "Inspection" in the relevant Logistics Area.-As the Logistics Use of the Logistics Area is at variance with the Logistics Use in the Logistics Model, the system is showing this error and also showing in red color for the Logistics Area in value selection of the Target Logistics Area.-Resolution-In order to resolve the Issue, please follow the below steps to Maintain Logistics Use in the Logistics Area.-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Navigate to the Locations View-Select the relevant Site and then click Edit Layout-Select the relevant Logistics Area-Under Logistics Use section, please click Add Row, and then maintain Inspection as Logistics Use-Keywords-Inventory retrieval or placement is not allowed, constraints not met, The logistics use must be the same logistics use you specified in the corresponding logistics model, Usage of Logistics Area does not match allowed usages, Logistics area not valid-logistics area not valid,inventory retreival or placement,usage of logistics area does not match,match allowed usages

Title: Approval is Not Triggered for Purchasing Document when Copied from Existing Document
Content: Symptom-When you create a Purchasing document(e.g. Purchase Order, Shopping Cart, Supplier Invoice) by copying from an older document, the new document is not going for approval-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Purchase  Requests and Orders work center-Select View Purchase Orders-Search for a previous Purchase Order which is already ordered-Select Copy and create a new Purchase Order-Select Order-Purchase Order is sent without going through approval process-Cause-The Approval Process was changed after the old Purchasing document was created and sent. So, when you copy from existing Purchase Order, the system will still look for the approval rule which was relevant for previous document and since it does not exist any more, the system did not trigger any approval for the new document-Resolution-Please create a new document from scratch whenever you make any changes in Bydesign system like approval processes, master data etc which might impact the purchasing document-Keywords-Approval process, Purchase Orders, Shopping Carts, Supplier Invoice, Copy-approval , purchase order, shopping cart,copy purchase order

Title: No Input Output Products Displayed in Make Tasks
Content: Symptom-You have configured a Production Model and as per that when production order is released, system has created multiple make tasks however when you try to confirm the Make tasks, Input and Output products are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the make or produce task against required Production Order ID, which you want to Confirm.-Select and choose Confirm-Under Confirmation tab, go to Input Products and Output Products sub tab.-Here no input and output products details are available.-Cause-The Task Generation Method defined in a production model is Operations including Reporting Points therefore tasks generated are based on operations, here reporting point is marked at the end of the last Make Task. Since there are multiple make tasks, system displays Input and Output product at the end of the Reporting Point.-Resolution-To mark the Reporting Point after every Operation (Produce) and to get the Input Output Product in each Make Task, follow below steps :-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Models view.-Search for the relevant production model.-Choose Edit button.-Select Bill of Operations tab.-Then select BoO Structure sub-tab.-Here select the relevant Make Operations one by one and choose Insert Mark via Insert option.-Mark the check box for Reporting Point.-Perform Check Consistency.-Release the production model by choosing Release Production Model--> For Planning and Execution.-Choose Save button.-Keywords-Make Tasks, Production Models, Bill of Operations, Input product missing, Output missing.

Title: Unexpected Approver Be Defined When Supplier Invoice Should Be Approved by Receipt
Content: Symptom-You defined the approval process for supplier invoice as Approval by Recipient.You expect the receipt of the supplier invoice should be the approver for it, but you find another employee also be defined as the approver besides the receipt.-Environment-SAP ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open supplier invoice ABC (ABC refers to supplier invoice ID) , view all.-Go to Items tab, Parties and Locations sub tab, you see the receipt is employee DEF (DEF referes to employee name).-Go to Approval tab, you see the defined approvers are employee DEF and GHI (GHI referes to employee name).-You don't know why GHI also be defined as the approver since he is not the receipt for supplier invoice ABC.-Cause-You have assigned a down payment request to this supplier invoice. Please check it by following steps:-Open supplier invoice ABC , view all.-Go to General tab, Payment Information: Down Payments sub tab. You can see the assigned down payment request here.-Open the down payment request, view all.-Go to Items tab, Parties and Locations sub tab, you see the receipt is employee GHI.-The receipt of the assigned down payment request will also be defined as the approver.-If there are mutiple down payment requests be assigned to the supplier invoice, all the receipts will be defined as the approver.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Approver, Down Payment Request, Receipt, 供应商发票，审批

Title: Cannot Output RFQ
Content: Symptom-The user has released a Request for Quotation (RFQ) with an attachment. However the output status is "Error".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Open Requests for Quotation view.-Search and open ABC (ABC refers to the RFQ ID).-Navigate to Output History.-The status is "Error"-Open the error.-The details are: -An output error occurred-No delivery to DEF (DEF refers to the receiver's email address).-Cause-The size of the attachment is over 10 MB.-Resolution-There is no particular limitation on the size of attachment inside RFQ.-However, if sent if email, the limitation is 10 MB.-Workaround: the user can upload the attachment to external netdisc. Then the URL can be attached in the RFQ.-Keywords-RFQ, Requests for Quotation, Attachment, 询价, Size

Title: Serial Number 1234567890 Cannot be Issued, Not Tagged to Inventory Manage Location
Content: Symptom-You are trying to issue serial number 1234567890 for a customer from your delivery request document. The system displays the above error message when you enter the serial number for the product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, ByD, SAP ByD-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Delivery Proposals view.-Search for the relevant Delivery Reqest ID, select it and choose the Post Goods Issue button.-In Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue screen select the relevant product and choose the sub-tab Serial Numbers.-Enter the serial number with id 1234567890.-The system displays the error message Serial Number 1234567890 Cannot be Issued, Not Tagged to Inventory Manage Location.-Cause-You have not maintained the correct Logistics Use value in the logistics area from which your products will be shipped. Please make sure that the Logistics Use in the logistics area should match the value in Source Logistics Use field of the corresponding Logistics Model in use for the Site.-Resolution-To maintain the Logistics Use value for a logistics area follow the below mentioned steps.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Locations view.-Select the Site or Location under which you have maintained the relevant logistics area and choose the Edit Layout button.-From the Site Layout screen select the Logistics Area from which you are shipping the product from.-In the General tab, under the section Logistcs Use choose the Add Row button.-Select the relevant Logistics Use value from the drop down list and choose the Save and Close button.-Once the above steps are performed you will be able to issue the serial numbers for your product without any errors.-Keywords-serial number error, not able to issue serial number, tagged inventory status error, goods issue for serial number error, issue of serial number not possible

Title: Multi Step Approval Task was not Triggered for Project Purchase Request as per Approval Process Configured in System
Content: Symptom-First level approval task by Project Manager was not triggered for Project Purchase Request. Also the task went to the second step approver directly.-Once the user approved the task, the document was released.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view. -Search for the relevant project. -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Products tab.-Navigate to Project Purchase Request Approvals subtab. -Select the respective Project Purchase Request.-Under Approvals tab, there is only one approval task completed (and not two tasks, as expected). -Cause-The other approver was set as substitute for the Project Manager when the Purchase request was created.-So, whatever Purchase Requests were created at that time, triggered the approval task for the substitution person and once the user approved it, the document got approved. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Project Purchase Request, Approval Tasks, Project Manager, Approval By Cost Assignment, Direct Approver

Title: System Failed to Update the Purchase Order Currency Based on Company ID
Content: Symptom-When a Buyer responsible creates a Purchase Order, the system automatically defaults the Buyer responsible’s Company and corresponding Currency in Purchase Order.
