When trying to change the Company details which has a different Currency, system does not change the Currency based on Company ID.-or-Purchase Order is not picking up the Currency maintained in the Supplier Master Data, while the default Currency of the Company is picked up while creating the Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work center.-Go to Common Tasks.-Select New Purchase Order.-System defaults the Company ID and Currency details.-Change the Company details.-System will not change the Currency to the new Company Currency.-Cause-System always defaults the Currency from the user's Company Currency who is logged in to the system.-Based on the user details, system picks the Company of the user in the Purchase Order and it will default the Company Currency.-Later if the user manually tries to change the Company details in the Purchase Order, system will not change the Currency to new Company Currency which user does not belong to.-Once Currency is determined, system will not change or update the Currency.-This is the standard system behaviour.-Resolution-This can be taken as a new request and kindly post the requirement in Influence Forum: (https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886)-As a workaround, user should manually change the Currency in the Purchase Order by following the below steps before ordering the Purchase Order,-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work center.-Go to Common Tasks.-Select New Purchase Order.-System defaults the Company ID and Currency details.-Change the Company and Currency details.-Select Save button.-Keywords-Default Currency for Purchase Order; Currency not picked from Supplier Master Data; Company Currency in Purchase Order

Title: Approval Task is not Triggered for Modified Timesheet Entry of Employee
Content: Symptom-When the Project Manager modifies the time for any employee, the time entry is not going for approval but getting directly released to accounting-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Select view Timesheet-Navigate to Time Entry-Make changes in the time recorded by employee and save-The changed entry gets released to accounting directly without going through approval-Cause-The Project Manager i,e Project responsible person himself is modifying the time , so it is not required to go through approval again.-Hence the time entry gets released directly to accounting-Resolution-Please ask the respective employee to make the necessary changes whenever required. Then the system will trigger approval task for Project manager before the modified value gets released-Keywords-Timesheet,Project Manager,Time Recording

Title: Self Approval did not Trigger Approval Task for Project Manager or Cost Center Manager who is also Buyer Responsible
Content: Symptom-Approval task is not going to Cost Center Manager or Project Manager X (X refers to Manager and Buyer Responsible) who is also Buyer Responsible Person even though Self-Approval is scoped.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Purchase Orders view-Select the respective Purchase Order-Select View All and navigate to Approvals tab-The approval task has been triggered for Reporting Line Unit Manager of the Project Manager/Buyer Responsible instead of Project manager himself.-Cause-You have maintained a filter in fine tuning activity :-"If you want that the buyer responsible or creator should not receive the approval task for purchase order and purchase order items, you can select the respective check boxes.-Buyer Responsible-Creator"-Resolution-Go to  Business Configuration work center-Search for Fine tuning activity: Purchase Order Approvals-Select "Purchase Order Approval Filter Specification"-Uncheck these filters to allow the system to automatically trigger approval task for Project manager who is also buyer responsible when self approval is scoped-Keywords-Self Approval, Project manager, Buyer Responsible, Cost Center Manager, Approval by Cost Assignment

Title: Input Product  Planned Quantity is Doubled in Production Request Fulfillment Report
Content: Symptom-In Production Request Fulfillment Report you noticed that quantity is doubled in  Input Product Planned Quantity, Input Product Fulfilled Quantity when compared to the Input Products in Product Lot 9999.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Check Input Product quantity in Production Lot.-1. Go to Production control workcenter and Production Orders view.-2. Find and select Production Lot 9999-3. View All and go to Products tab and Input Products sub tab-You notice that the Planned Quantity is say for example 10 ea.-Check Input Product quantity in Production Request Fulfillment report.-1. Go to Business Analytics workcenter and Design Reports view.-2. Search and select Production Request Fulfillment report-3. Filter the report for Production Lot 9999. In the Row fields select Input Product and  in the Column fields select Input Product Planned Quantity and Input Product Fulfilled Quantity.-You will notice that the Input Product Planned Quantity is 20 ea i.e. doubled compared to quantity in Production Lot.-Cause-System considers the Input Products in both Supply Operation and Make Operation of Production Lot 9999 hence the quantity is doubled.-Note: Counter field in the report indicates the number of fields combined to fetch the data.-In this case the counter value 2 indicates the Input products are combined from Supply Operation and Make Operation of the Production Lot.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-Keywords-Input Product  Planned Quantity, Input Product Fulfilled Quantity, Make Operation, Supply Operation, Production Request Fulfillment

Title: Product Not Picked Up in Cyclic Product Count Runs
Content: Symptom-You have added a Storage Location/Storage Group in the Cyclic Product Count document for which the system needs to create an automated count document. In the count document created you see that a few products in the Storage Location/Storage Group is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, ByD, SAP ByD-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center-Navigate to Monitoring view and choose the sub-view By PI Count Document-Search for the relevant PI Count Document ID, select it and choose the Edit button.-Select the Count Items tab.-You see that there are a few products in the Storage Location/Storage Group which are not visible in the count document.-Cause-The products that are not visible in the count document does not have any inventory in the system. If there is atleast one quantity of stock available the cyclic product count document will pick up the product for counting. If you add the product directly in the cyclic product count the system will not pick up the product for counting.-Keywords-automated product count error, product missing in count task, no product visible in product task, count error, missing product in count task

Title: Purchase Order Approval Task Is Unassigned
Content: Symptom-One task is successfully assigned to a person but another task which you expect to be sent for same person is unassigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select New Purchase Order-Fill in all the mandatory details-Go to Approval tab-  You will see one task is assigned and another is unassigned.-Cause-System fails to find an approver to a Purchase order due to below mentioned Business configuration setting as that person happens to be either requester or creator of the Purchase order and you chose to filter him out of approval process.- However, this setting is not applicable if the approver is triggered from approval step that has direct approver, hence, task is successfully assign in this case.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on over view-Show all activities-Search for Purchase Order Approvals-Click on view button-Click on Purchase Order Approval Filters-If you want that the buyer responsible or creator should not receive the approval task for purchase order and purchase order items, you can select the respective check boxes.-  Keywords-Unassigned task, Unassigned approval task,Purchase Order Approval Filters,Purchase Order Approvals

Title: You Cannot Update the List Prices via Excel Upload
Content: Symptom-You Cannot Update the List Prices via Excel.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work centre.-Go to List Prices.-Choose All List Prices and click execute the query.-(here you can see the List Prices)-Open the Excel document `XYZ.xlsx` (XYZ represents the document name).-Change the Prices for List Prices and save it.-Go to the SAP Business by Design Tab in Excel.-Log On with User Credentials and click Refresh.-RESULT: The new prices will not transfer to the system - the system overwrites the old prices in the excel document.-Cause-In the Product Portfolio work centre, List Prices is a view of the prices for products. If the Price Lists need to be updated, it has to be done via the Product and Service Portfolio work centre.-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work centre.-Navigate to Price Lists.-Here you can download the Excel template by clicking on Download. Then the relevant Price List information needs to be filled in this Excel template and then should be saved back to your Business by Design system.-Keywords-Price List, List Prices, Update via Excel, Product Portfolio,

Title: Output History Tab Missing in Not Migrated Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 3323729***-Although the purchase order is not created by migration, you find the Output History tab is missing for it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Open purchase order ABC (ABC refers to the purchase order ID).-View all.-You see the Output History tab is missing.-Cause-The Prevent Output indicator is checked in General tab.-If you checked this indicator, the purchase order will not be outputted and the supplier will not be notified automatically when the purchase order is ordered, changed, or cancelled.-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-The Prevent Output indicator is available at each purchase order document level, and it's unchecked by default.-When you create a new purchase order, you can manually check it.-If you want to stop using this indicator to avoid user mistake, you can hide this field via key user adaptation mode to make the field not published to end users.-See Also-For migrated purchase order, please refer to:-2579252 - Output History Tab Missing in the Purchase Order Document-Keywords-Purchase Order, Output History, Prevent Output

Title: How to Change the Default Output Channel for Purchase Order at Supplier Level
Content: Symptom-When you create new purchase orders for a particular supplier, you find the default output channel is printer (fax/email/etc). You want to know how is it determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Create New Purchase Order.-Select supplier ABC (ABC refers to the supplier ID) as the supplier, and fill all the mandatory fields. -Click You Can Also: Edit Output Settings for Create PO.-You can see, the default output channel is printer (fax/email/etc).-Cause-Output channel of a Purchase Order is determined in one of the below methods which are mentioned priority wise:-The output channel you manually selected in purchase order via You can also:Edit Output Settings for Created/Changed/Cancelled PO-The output channel you maintained for purchase order in the respective supplier master data-The output channel you maintained in Application and User Management, Output Channel Selection for Created/Changed/Cancelled PO-Resolution-1.If you manually changed the output channel in purchase order via You can also:Edit Output Settings for Created/Changed/Cancelled PO, system gives highest priority to it.-2.If no manual changes at purchase order level, system determines the output channel according to what you maintained for purchase order in the respective supplier master data, Communication tab, Collaboration subtab.-Note: in supplier master data, the output channel maintained for purchase order would valid to all of the Created/Changed/Cancelled PO. You can't specify channels separately.-3.If no output channels maintained for purchase order for the respective supplier, system determines the output channel according to the selection rule you maintained in Application and User Management, Output Channel Selection for Created/Changed/Cancelled PO.-See Also-Help Documents：-Purchase Order Processing-Create Output Channel Selection Rule for Purchase Order-Knowledge Base Articles:-1789176 - How is the Sender E-Mail Address of a Purchase Order Determined-2836163 - How to set CC Option in Email for Purchase Order Output by Default?-3395097 - Output Channel Selection Rule Not Working-Keywords-Purchase Order, Output Channel, 采购订单, 输出渠道, 購買発注, 出力チャネル

Title: Inspection error appears when trying to release the Production Order
Content: Symptom-When trying to release the Production Order inspection related error messages appear: "Creation of quality inspection failed."  "Inspection plan could not be determined." appear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view.-Select the respective production order in preparation and press Release. -Error messages appear:- "Creation of quality inspection failed."- "Inspection plan could not be determined."-Cause-Either-an inspection plan for the resource XYZ used in the production order is missing (XYZ refers to a resource id),-or the resource used in the production order and the Inspection plan differ: In the production order the resource used for the quality check is XYZ whereas in the inspection plan resource ABC is maintained (ABC represents a different resource ID).-Resolution-Create a New Inspection Plan of type Final Inspection - Production for resource XYZ:-In the Quality Planning work center go to the Common Tasks and select New Inspection Plan. -Select Inspection type Final inspection - production. -Under step 1 - Define Key Parameters maintain resource XYZ. -Complete all other relevant details and activate the inspection plan.-Now you can  release the production order.-Keywords-Creation of quality inspection failed, Inspection plan could not be determined,Inspection error appears when trying to release the Production Order

Title: Warning message appears "Conversion between planning UOM and Order UOM cannot be Batch dependent " while trying to create New Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to create a  New Sales Order a warning message appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work Center-In Common tasks, Create New Sales Order-Fill all the required entries like Account, Product, Employee Responsible etc.-You see a warning message appearing at the bottom of the screen.-Conversion between planning UOM and Order UOM cannot be Batch dependent-Cause-If we maintain the batch dependent conversions in the product master data, we cannot use the inventory UOM(Unit of Measure) as the ordered UOM.-This batch UOM will only be used when the identified stock is maintained in order to convert the planning or ordered UOM to the batch specific-UOM.-In order to check the Quantity conversions maintained-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center-Navigate to By Materials tab-Search for DEF(DEF refers to Material id)-Select Edit-Navigate to View all-Navigate to General Tab-Resolution-This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Conversion between planning UOM and Order UOM cannot be Batch dependent, Warning message appears "Conversion between planning UOM and Order UOM cannot be Batch dependent"

Title: Error Message:Product Not Available for Procurement
Content: Symptom-You get this error while creating new list price for a material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Products Portfolio-Go to List prices view-Click on button New and choose List Price-Enter respective supplier-Go to step 2-Click on Add row-Enter respective Product ID-You will get error.-Cause-The product is maintained both as Material and Service and the Service is blocked.-When we provide the Product ID, the system queries for the products (material and services), and since here it returns both where one of them is blocked system throws an error.-This is a valid use case.-Resolution-Go to Products Portfolio-Go to List prices view-Click on button New and choose List Price-Enter respective Supplier-Go to step 2-Click on Add row-There is column for field called Product type-If the filed is not there add it through personalization-Choose product type as Material-Enter Respective Product ID-Keywords-Product Not Available for Procurement, Unable to create list price

Title: Cost center is Displayed in Approval  Process Conditions Even though Cost Center is Inactive
Content: Symptom-You can see the Cost Center XXX in the conditions in Approval process even though the cost center is inactive or not yet created in organizational management work center-XXX refers to Cost Center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and user management work center-Select view Approval processes under Task Distribution-Search for Approval Process Overview for any Purchasing document(e.g. Shopping Cart, Purchase Order, Supplier invoice etc) which is active-Select relevant Step which has conditions-Under Conditions-> select the respective Group-You can see the Particular cost center XXX in that condition-Cause-When you create the condition, for Cost Center, as the context says “The cost center contains” or “does not contain”, so it means the input field there can contain any text with various patterns .--It is not a value help/drop-down from where you choose the name.It is just a text field where you can enter any text or matching patterns and system will compare the rules if the pattern or name matches.--You can also enter a totally Non Existing cost center which is also fine within the meaning of approval condition.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior-Keywords-Approval Process Conditions-Cost Center-Shopping Cart-Purchase Orders-Supplier Invoices

Title: Product ID Field is Disabled in Customs Duty Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you created customs duty invoice, you are unable to enter the Product ID, as the field is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Under Common Tasks->Select New Customs Duty Invoice option-Under Items tab, Product ID field is greyed out-Cause-It is not possible to enter Product ID in the customs duty invoice, so this field has been disabled.-Customs Duty Invoice is not for only one particular item but for a bulk of items.It is used to distribute the extra invoice amount across multiple items if the amount has exceeded the actual net amount, hence the description field is provided to enter a description.-Resolution-You can create the customs duty invoice, just by entering product description for your own reference.-Keywords-Custom Duty Invoice, Product ID

Title: Unable to Print the Packing List for a Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Print the Packing List from the Packing View of Outbound Delivery, However System did not generate a Print Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View-Select Outbound Delivery Release Status which is "Not Released" and Select Packing-Select on Save and Print-You observe  system shows that "Your entries have been saved" but no print-out was generated-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Navigate to Print Queues View-Select relevant Print Queue and Select Edit-Navigate to Queued Documents-You observe that System did not generate any Document to print-Cause-The Column "Select for Printing" is not checked in Pack Delivery Document of an Outbound delivery, Hence system did not generate a Print Document.-Resolution-In order to generate Print document for packing List from the packing view of Outbound delivery, Follow the below mentioned steps-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View-Select Outbound Delivery Release Status which is "Not Released" and click Packing-Select "Select for Printing" checkbox-Select Save-Keywords-Unable to Print the Packing List of an Outbound Delivery, System did not generate a Print Document for Packing List

Title: Cancelled Third Party Delivery Notification not visible in  Document Flow
Content: Symptom-You have Canceled Third Party Delivery Notification DEF(DEF refers to Delivery Notification id).-Delivery Notification is seen as Canceled in Third Party Delivery Notification View.-However it is not visible in the Document Flow of Third Party Purchase Order KLM (KLM refers to Purchase Order id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Go to Third-Party Purchase Orders-Search for KLM.-Select on View.-Navigate to Document Flow.-You observe that the Third-Party Delivery Notification  DEF  is not visible in document flow.-However you could see Delivery Notification DEF in Third-Party Delivery Notifications View  as Canceled.-Cause-If Third-Party Delivery Notification DEF is created in an Inconsistent state then the document continues to be Inconsistent even after Cancellation.-Resolution-As Third Party Delivery Notification DEF is Inconsistent it will not be displayed in the Document Flow.-This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Canceled Third Party Delivery Notification not visible in Document Flow, Cancelled Third Party Delivery Notification, Third Party Delivery Notification not visible in  Document Flow

Title: A leading zero is added to labels with odd numbers
Content: Symptom-When printing labels, the system is adding a leading zero to the form template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Labels common task-Select a label-Select Preview-Scan the barcode-See that a leading zero has been added-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-The 0 (Prefiix) is added in the SAP provided form template itself for the labels which have odd number of digits in its ID.--For instance: 100 -> 0100, 1234 -> 1234, 456-> 0456, 89->89.-Resolution-This is the expected logic of the system to keep the length of bar code even.-Keywords

Title: Deliver From Selected Source of Supply Button Disabled
Content: Symptom-You have a customer demand document which is not released and want to change the source of supply of one of your line items. While trying to switch the source of supply, the button Deliver From Selected Source of Supply is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant customer demand document, select it and choose the Edit button.-Select the Line Items tab and choose the sub-tab Alternative Sources.-You see there are multiple source of supply available for you to ship the Item from, but the button Deliver From Selected Source of Supply is disabled.-Cause-You have marked the sales order against the relevant customer demand for Complete Delivery. In Complete Delivery orders you will not be able to change the source of supply once the system has identified a source of supply.-Resolution-If it is an absolute necessity for your business that you have to change the source of supply from the customer demand, you can choose to switch off the Complete Delivery option temporarily for your customer demand and change the source of supply. Please follow below given steps to do so.-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant customer demand document, select it and choose the Edit button.-Select the Actions button and choose the option Temporarily Switch Off Complete Delivery.-Once the above steps is performed you will be able to change the source of supply for the relevant Item from your end. It is highly recommended that you do not choose the option Complete Delivery if there exists a business case where you have to change the source of supply via customer demand frequently.-Keywords-source of supply switch not possible in customer demand, change source of supply disabled, source of supply error, Internal & External Fulfillment switch error, not able to switch fulfillment type

Title: Gaps in Number Range of Outbound Delivery Numbers
Content: Symptom-Some Outbound Delivery numbers for the selected number range are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to  Outbound Deliveries View-Select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection.-Select Go.-Sort by Outbound Deliveries ID.-You observe some gaps from one Outbound delivery number to another Outbound delivery number.-Cause-Sometimes the user opens the User Interface to create the document but later does not save it.-Now the number created for  a new document is returned back as an unused number.-Later when another new document gets created the number range picks this unused number and use the same.-Resolution-The system will generate Outbound Delivery id as per the defined range however it does consider a chronological order when doing so.-This is the standard behavior as expected.-Keywords-Gaps in number range of Outbound delivery numbers, Outbound delivery number ranges are inconsistent.

Title: Unable to Find Assigned To Employee in Shopping Cart Management View
Content: Symptom-You searched for open shopping carts and assign them to another employee. However you cannot see to whom the shopping cart is assigned to-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the Task Distribution view-Go to the Shopping Cart Management view-Select the relevant Shopping Cart ID and select Assign To-On the screen you cannot see to whom the Shopping Cart is assigned to-Cause-System cannot display the Assigned To details because the data is protected and hence you do not see the details in the Shopping Cart Management view screen. This is an expected behavior-Resolution-Once you assign the open shopping carts to another employee, the additional employee to whom the shopping carts are now assigned will be able to view and process them. You can open the shopping cart and there is a hidden field called Additional Responsible under personalization. You can mark this field and see the Additional Responsible to whom it is assigned-Keywords-Shopping cart management view; Assigned to not visible

Title: Cannot Find Open Quantity to Create new Inbound Delivery for Replacement in Return to Supplier Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have created return to supplier document for the product with follow up decision as Replacement, however the replacement quantity is not available in the Inbound Logistics work center to create New Inbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Returns to Suppliers view-Select the relevant Returns to Supplier ID-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-You have given the Follow-up Decision as Replacement-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select Open Purchase Orders query and search for relevant Purchase Order-You can see that Open Purchase Quantity appears as Zero-Cause-You have created a credit memo with reference to purchase order and supplier invoice. When you create a credit memo for an invoice, the system changes both the quantity and the amount of the original invoice. If you only want to change the amount of the original invoice, create a subsequent credit. Hence there will be no open quantities further to create Inbound Delivery for the product.-Resolution-When you create a credit memo, it is expected that you will take a credit from supplier for the returned quantity. At the same time, if you create return to supplier with replacement, it is not practically correct. Because no supplier will accept to provide replacement as well as credit note. You can cancel the credit memo and then system proposes the replacement quantity Inbound Delivery creation-Keywords-Replacement quantity for Inbound Delivery; Follow up decision Replacement; Replacement quantity not available

Title: Error: "Material Quantity Unit Not Valid" in Migration of Inventory
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Inventory using the Migration Tool and receive the following error message: Material quantity unit not valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, all its version.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Inventory.-Click the link to Migrate inventory using the migration tool.-In the Migration Tool screen, upload your migration file.-Click Execute, then Execute Migration Step by Step.-Progress through the steps of the migration.-On step 3 (Simulation), the error message will be raised.-Cause-The reason for this error message is that you have maintained Quantity for some products in the Inventory tab, but have not maintained Quantity Type (e.g. each, box, piece). Without this information, the system will not be able to properly calculate quantities on future transactions.-Resolution-Please maintain Quantity Type for all records that have Quantity maintained.-Keywords-Inventory, Migration, Material Quantity Unit Not Valid

Title: Item Type in the Intercompany Sales Order Changed Automatically
Content: Symptom-Item type for the product changed automatically in the intercompany sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Search and Edit the sales order XYZ. (XYZ represents the Sales Order number)-Click View All and navigate to Items tab.-The Item Type maintained is DEF. (DEF represents the Item type of the Product in sales order XYZ)-Go to Sales Order view.-Search and Edit the sales order PQR. (PQR represents the intercompany Sales order number)-Click View All and navigate to Items tab.-The Item Type maintained is JKL. (JKL represents the Item type of the Product in sales order PQR)-You are expecting the system to maintain the same item type in both sales orders.-Cause-The prerequisite for determining the correct item type is-1.sales organization and distribution channel combination, which is maintained in the product master data under sales tab with correct Item Type (eg: if  sales order is related to project then item type should be related to projects)-or-2.For sales order to have correct Sales organization, the sales unit has to be determined correctly in sales order using determination rules.-Resolution-For Sales unit to be determined correctly you have to maintain determination rule.-For maintaining the determination rule, kindly follow the below steps-Go to Business Configuration - Overview-Search for Involved Parties for Sales Orders-Click Open-Select the Sales Unit and click Maintain Determinations-If you activate Responsibility  "Sales Unit for Sales", then maintain the details in the Work Distribution view as below.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Go to the Organizational Work Distribution subview.-Select Sales Unit for Sales.-Select the Edit button.-You can maintain the determination rule  for each company.-See Also- 2487134 - The Intercompany Project is not Created Automatically -Keywords-Intercompany Sales Order; SO-PO-SO; Service - time and material

Title: Error Appears when trying to Create Inbound Delivery from 3PL Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When trying to create Inbound Delivery from 3PL Inbound Delivery Notification, following errors occur:--Numbering formats must be maintained for warehouse provider.--Number range configuration not determined.--Save Failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics Work Center.-Select Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Select desired Delivery Notification ID.-Click on New Inbound Delivery button.-Fill the External Delivery ID under General tab and External Delivery Item ID under Line Items tab.-Click on Save button.-Above errors occur.-Cause-In the Activity "Document Numbering Formats for Inbound Delivery",  no Document type or the wrong one has been maintained. This caused those errors.-Resolution-Kindely check the and maintain the document numbering formats by following steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Project view.-Select the priject and open Activity List.-Search for "Document Numbering Formats for Inbound Delivery".-Select Open.-Select Add row.-Maintain all manadatory fields like Company ID, Document type, Prefix Value, etc and relevant fields.-Keywords-Numbering formats must be maintained for warehouse provider, Number range configuration not determined, Save Failed, Inbound Delivery, 3PL Inbound Delivery Notification

Title: Outbound Delivery ID Created With Incorrect Document Numbering Format for Intrastate Stock Transfer Order
Content: Symptom-In case of a  Intrastate Stock Transfer Order you notice that the Outbound Delivery ID is created with incorrect Document Numbering Format although you have maintained the Prefix for the same in Business Configuration.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Check the Outbound Delivery ID created for Intrastate Stock Transfer Order--1. Go to Outbound Logistics Control workcenter and Customer Demand view.-2. Find the Stock Transfer Order 9999 and View All.-3. In the Document Flow tab check the document number for Outbound Delivery ID.-Check whether the prefix XYZ for the Outbound Delivery Numbering Format is maintained or not--1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter and Overview-2. Select Activities-3. Find Document Numbering Formats for Outbound Delivery and select.-4. Check whether the rule for the Outbound Delivery for the Ship From Site is maintained for Intrastate.-Cause-In the Site Address of the Ship From Site of the Stock Transfer Order, the value for State is missing.-Note: It is required to maintain the value for State in address line for both business partners (Ship From and Ship To) which identifies if the shipment is either Interstate or Intrastate.-Resolution-1. Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data and Location View.-2. Find and Select the Ship From Site and View All.-3. Go to General tab and enter the value for State.-Keywords-Supply Chain Design Master Data, State, prefix, Intrastate, Document Numbering Formats for Outbound Delivery, Stock Transfer Order, Ship From

Title: Error While Adding New Records Via Migration of Bills of Operations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add new records using the Migration of Bills of Operations, however it shows the error message below:-"Type Final Inspection of activity XYZ not permitted for type Make of operation ABC" (XZY means the Activity ID and ABC means the Operation ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1805 and higher.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-The described error message occurs because, make operation can have the following activities types under it:-Produce.-Setup.-Tear down.-For an activity to be Final Inspection, the corresponding Operation must be of the type Check. However, the migration object does not support the migration of Check operation.-Keywords-Error Message, Migration of Bills of Operation, Final Inspection, Activity ID, Operation ID.

Title: Error message:Participant UUID or Party ID Missing
Content: Symptom-This error appears when you try to upload Supplier ID in the assignment rules screen of the not invoiced time and expenses.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to Not invoiced time and expenses-Search for respective Project-Click on Edit Time and expenses-Click on Edit assignment rules and choose View all rules-Go to respective line and select it and scroll down to Details-Enter Supplier ID under party parameters where source is Invoice-  Cause-The Supplier ID you tried is a Business Partner that exists in the business partner role Account only. It does not exist in the role Supplier.-Resolution-Follow below steps to add the role Supplier to the business partner.-Go to Business partner Data work center-Go to Business partners-Search for respective business partner-Select it and click on Create As and choose Supplier-  Keywords-Unable to add Supplier,Participant UUID or Party ID Missing-

Title: Error Message in 3PL Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-You would like to use the Outbound Delivery YYY as reference for the 3PL Inbound Delivery Notification XXX. However, the Inbound Delivery Notification is inconsistent.-XXX = Inbound Delivery Notification ID.-YYY = Outbound Delivery ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Open the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX.-Select View All.-Select Check Consistency.-You receive the error message:-One of the following references is missing: Sales order, customer invoice, or over-the-counter sale. Enter the missing data.-Cause-In order to process a Return Notification, it's necessary that the Outbound Delivery XXX you're using as a reference already exists in the system.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can use as reference the Sales Order ID. The system does not validate the Sales Order reference in the Return Notification because there are cases where it is necessary to take returns for a sale that was made before moving to SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Return, Notification, Reference, 3PL, Outbound Delivery, Return Notification, Inbound Delivery Notification

Title: System  Not  Displaying Customer Demand in Product Planning Screen
Content: Symptom-You have created multiple Sales Orders for a product in a system and want to get the same in Product Planning Screen for material planning. However, you are unable to find any sales order in a product planning screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Common Tasks View and choose New Sales Order sub view.-Create a Sales Order for a required Product: Z (* Z refers to a Product ID).-Submit the relevant Sales Order: X (*X refers to Sales Order ID).-Now go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to Customer Demand View.-Choose All Orders by Selection and find Sales Order: X (*X refers to Sales Order ID).-Select and choose Open Product Planning Details option.-New window opens i.e. Product Planning Details.-Under section: Supply and Demand List, you find that relevant Sales Order: X (*X refers to Sales Order ID) is not available though it is an actual demand and yet to be planned via MRP.-Cause-For Material Planning, scoping question: Do you want to consider the requirement date of the sales order during material planning? is not scoped. Therefore, system is not considering sales order demands which are based on requested schedule lines. During material planning, you have to decide whether the sales order demands are based on the confirmation schedule lines or requested schedule lines.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the required Project and choose Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the guided activity and move to guided step 4: Questions.-Under scoping element, select Supply Chain Planning and Control.-Select sub-element Supply Planning, expand it and choose option: Material Planning.-On the right side there are scoping questions, find section Group: Planning Date, .-Here select and mark the checkbox for question: Do you want to consider the requirement date of the sales order during material planning?-Keywords-Do you want to consider the requirement date of the sales order during material planning?, Open Product Planning, Sales Order,confirmation schedule lines, requested schedule lines.

Title: Dump When Adding End Date to Equipment Resource Downtime
Content: Symptom-A dump occurs while creating an equipment resource downtime, if the End Date field is filled before the Start Date field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1805 / 05-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Click and select the Overview view in pop-up menu.-Click the Equipment Resources button.-Choose a resource, e.g. equipment resource 123 (123 represents the ID of a resource).-Click the View All button.-Select the Operating Times tab.-Select the Downtimes and Additional Times sub tab.-Click the Add Row button.-Click into the End Date field and select a date.-Press Enter.-A dump occurs.-Cause-This is a known issue.-Resolution-Issue has been added to the backlog and is planned to be fixed in one of our future releases.-Keywords-Dump, End Date, Equipment Resource Downtime, Resource, Supply Chain Design Master Data.

Title: Report Team Member Work Analysis (PROPRJU04_Q0006) Shows no Data
Content: Symptom-You run the report Team Member Work Analysis (PROPRJU04_Q0006) and you receive the message: 'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Team work center.-Go to the Reports view, subview List and open the report Team Member Work Analysis (PROPRJU04_Q0006).  -Run the report.-You get the below message:-'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Cause-The field Task Responsible is set as a fixed value selection, and it is set to show the logged on user's data only. There is no data to be shown for this fixed value present in the system.-To verify this please check:-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Report View and Search For Report Team Member Work Analysis (PROPRJU04_Q0006).-From the New tab, select Report As Copy.-Go to step four (Characteristics Properties). -Click Set Fixed Value Selection.-Here you can see that the characteristic Task Responsible has the selection Employee - My User Name.-Resolution-There are two reports with same Name (Team Member Work Analysis) but they have different IDs:-PROPRJU04_Q0005 - no fixed value selection.-PROPRJU04_Q0006 - fixed value selection on the Task Responsible.-You can use the other report which has no fixed value set on the responsible employee.-Alternatively, if you would like to use the report Team Member Work Analysis (PROPRJU04_Q0006), create a report as a copy, and in step four (Characteristics Properties) change the Fixed Value to No Value Selection or Use Variable.-Keywords-Report, Fixed Value, Team Member Work Analysis, PROPRJU04_Q0006

Title: Error: 'Inventory in the logistics area is not available' While Confirming a Returns Pick Task
Content: Symptom-During the confirmation of a task of type Returns Pick, when you choose Propose Quantities and Logistics Areas button, the system shows an error 'Inventory in the logistics area is not available'.-However, in the Stock Overview it is showing that there is enough stock available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-2. Select Task Control view.-3. Select task XXX and choose Confirm. (XXX represents the task ID).-4. In the task confirmation screen choose Propose Logistic Area and Quantities button.-5. System does not propose Logistic Area and Actual Quantity and is showing an error message ''Inventory in the logistics area is not available'.-However, if you open Stock Overview it is showing that enough quantity is available.-1. Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-2. From the Common Task open Stock Overview.-Cause-When you are confirming any Supplier Return Pick task, system automatically selects 'Restricted' check box for the Logistics Area. It is designed like that, because normally when you get product from Supplier, you may want to mark product returns (e.g. damaged products) as 'Restricted' stock, in order to differentiate them from other products.-Even though, there is enough stock of the product available in the logistics area, this stock is not marked as 'Restricted' and that is why the system displays the above error.-Resolution-To confirm the task, de-select the 'Restricted' check box in the task confirmation screen and then you will be able to confirm it.--Please also note, that when the Logistics Use for the affected Logistics Area is defined as 'Storage' and in the corresponding Logistics Model for 'Goods Return Shipping' the Source Logistics Use is set as 'Restricted Stock', and as it is not hard constraint the system will allow the task to be confirmed but will show the following information messages:--'Logistics area XYZ  is no recommended, some constraints not met' (XYZ represents the ID iof the logistics area).-'Logistics area defined with exception usage Storage'.--See Also-Knowledge Base Article 2617361 - Error: 'Inventory in the logistics area is not available' While Confirming a Pick Task-  Keywords-error, inventory, logistics, area, not, available, returns, pick, task, confirm, restricted, stock

Title: Inventory Allocation Report Does Not Display Data
Content: Symptom-You have created a report from the data source Inventory Allocation. When executing the report the report is not showing the allocation of products for which customer demand is released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Navigate to the Design Data Sources veiw.-Search for the data source Inventory Allocation, select it and choose the Preview button.-You can see that the report does not display the details of a product for which you have released the customer demand.-The Issue can also be reproduced by executing the report created from the data soruce.-Cause-The Inventory Allocation report provides details of the allocated inventory at a Location and Logistics Area for a particular document. This means that if you have only released the customer demand for a product Inventory will not be allocated for the product. If ATP is confirmed for the product it only means that the relevant quantity is resereved for the product and not allocated.-Resolution-If you need the Inventory Allocation report to fetch data you will have to process the Logistics Process at your end via warehouse tasks. Once you create warhouse task for the Delivery Proposals created when the customer demand is released, you will see that the Inventory Allocation report is displaying the details of the product you expect to see in the report. If the report is not displaying the value of a product for which only customer demand is released then the system is working as designed.-Keywords-Inventory Allocation report Error, no data in inventory allocation data source, inventory allocation data source error, no value in inventory allocation data source, blank value in inventory allocation report.

Title: Error: "More Than One Entry Without Predecessor Exists Below Header" During the Migration of Bill of Operations
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Bill of Operations using the migration tool and you receive the following error messages:-"More than one entry without predecessor exists below header"-"Not all elements are connected to each other below header"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center, in Overview view.-Search for Migration of Bill of Operations and open the activity.-Select the template and click on Execute Migration, then click on Step by Step.-Receive the errors during the Simulation step.-Cause-This error is occurring because the IDs from Operation ID, Mark ID and Activity ID are not maintained in uppercase letters. Ideally all IDs should be maintained in the same way they are displayed in UI, always uppercase.-Resolution-To avoid the errors, you should maintain all IDs in uppercase letters.-Keywords-migration of bill of operations, error, operation and mark, activity

Title: Production Order Release Due Date is in Past
Content: Symptom-You have released and Finished some Production Orders with the Requested Start Date DD.MM.YYYY (DD.MM.YYYY represents the Requested Start Date of the Production Order), however if you go to the Work Center 'Production Control', and the view 'Production Orders', you notice that the listing is showing for the Production Orders in status 'Finished' the Production Order Release Due Date in the past, but you expect the Date to be same as the Requested Start Date of the Production Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view.-Show All Production Orders, and filter all Production Orders with Finished status.-You can see that the "Production Order Release Due Date" is showing 01.MM.YYYY, but you expect the Date to be same as the Requested Start: 02.MM.YYYY.-Cause-The Release Due date is calculated based on the Horizon in days maintained in the 'Production Order Release Strategy' in Business configuration. You have defined the horizon within which Production Orders should be released in Production Order Release Strategy in Business Configuration as one day, and that is the reason the Release Due Date is one day in the past.-Resolution-If you wish to have the Production Order Release Due Date to be same as the Requested Date, you will have to remove the value in 'Horizon in Days', and leave the field empty.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Project View.-Select First Implementation and the button Open Activity Lists.-Select All Activities from the Drop-Down menu, and search for ‘Production Order Release Strategy’.-Click the Open button.-Click on ‘Manual Production Order Release Strategy’.-You can see there is default available Production Order Release Strategy with Horizon in Days maintained as 1. Please remove this value and enter your own value according to your business needs. If you want to have the Requested Start Date of the Production Order and Production Order Release Due Date to be same, please keep the field empty and save your changes.-Please note that the Horizon in Days is effective even if you have not included the ‘Production Order Release Strategy’ Activity in your Project scope. To be able to change the value, you must therefore include the Activity in your Project Scope.-See Also-The following Help Center Documents:-Production Strategies.-Production Order Release Strategy — Configuration Guide.-Production Orders Quick Guide.-Keywords-Production, Order, Release Strategy, Release due Date, Requested Start Date

Title: Time Recording on Project Task by Employee Is Always Sent to Project Manager for Approval
Content: Symptom-An employee records times on project task and releases them. You find that these times recordings are always sent to project manager for approval, not to the Person Responsible (Task Responsible)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-All the time and expenses incurred on the project is always needed to be approved by the project manager, not by the person responsible.-Irrespective of the person responsible on the task level all the time recording will be sent to the project manager (who is responsible for the entire project)-Heance all the project time recording are always sent to project manager for approval.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Keywords-Time recording-Project-Approval-project manager

Title: PSM Release for the Account Field Under Registered Products
Content: Symptom-You have the requirement to modify the Account, that appears within the "Account" section in the Registered Products screen, using the Cloud Applications Studio (SDK). However you are not able to see it in the SDK.--Business Object:IndividualProduct-Node:CustodianParty-Element:PartyKey-PartyID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1805 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Select the New Registered Products from the Common Tasks.-Your requirement is to edit the Account under the Account and Contact section.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-You can follow the below path to have the modifications:-Read the IO_INDIVIDUAL_PRODUCT Node of /IBASE/INSTALL_POINT by following the navigation from PDM_INDIVIDUAL_PRODUCT ROOT node. The association is already read released.-From the Parent node id of this association, we can read the INSTALLED_OBJECT node of /IBASE/INSTALL_POINT.-The Root of this will be the Root node of /IBASE/INSTALL_POINT. Custodian party information is store in the PARTY_INFORMATION ->P ARTY_INFORMATION_PARTY -> PARTY_KEY -> PARTY_ID.-All the fields of the Installation Points Business Object are already write released. The custom logic can then modify this field accordingly for custodian party.-Keywords-PSM Release, CustodianParty, PartyID, Installation Point, New Registered Product.

Title: Approval Process Working Incorrectly
Content: Symptom-The approval process determination for a business document is not working correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The process flow of the approval process as per the system design is as follows:-The system first evaluates the Conditions maintained in the approval process.-Once the conditions are evaluated to True, the system checks the Work Distribution (e.g. Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager, Approval by Cost Assignment, etc...) associated with the corresponding condition. -Based on the Work Distribution maintained, system determines the person to whom the approval task must be generated and generates the same.-Note: If the system cannot determine the correct person responsible for assigning the approval task even if the conditions are met for approval, there will be an Unassigned task present in Business Task Management view under Application and User Management work center. The document still goes for approval. Approval of a document is triggered based on evaluation of Conditions.-The Work Distribution is used to find a relevant person responsible for approving.-If there is an Unassigned Task under Business Task Management present, the Administrator can assign to one of the users who has the access rights for completing the approval process.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Purchase Order, Shopping Cart, Approval, Approval Process, Approval Process Flow, Approver Determination

Title: Unable to see Shopping Cart Management View Under Application and User Management Work Center
Content: Symptom-You want to transfer the responsibility of Shopping Cart to another employee. However you are unable to see the Shopping Cart Management view under Application and User Management work center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the Task Distribution view-Shopping Cart Management view is missing-Cause-You are not assigned to the view Shopping Cart Management and hence you cannot see the Shopping Cart Management view-Resolution-You need to assign the view Shopping Cart Management from the below steps and will be able to see the expected view-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the User and Access Management view-Go to the Business Users sub view-Select the relevant Business User-Select Edit and Access Rights-Navigate to tab Work center and View Assignment-Select Work Center ID ITS_APPLICATIONUSERMANAGEMENT-Select the view SC_MANAGEMENT (Shopping Cart Management)-Select Save-Keywords-Shopping Cart Management view missing

Title: While Creating Project Invoice Request You See No Time and Expenses in Step 4
Content: Symptom-In Step 4 of Project invoice request you see no Time and expenses and when you click on check button you get below error.-Error message: Release of project invoice request not possible. Quantity of all project invoice request items is zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Click on Not Invoiced Time and Expenses-Search for all Projects-Select the respective project-Click on button new and choose manual invoice request-Click on next and enter all necessary details and go to step 4-Click on check button-Cause-Reason 1:-In the first step of creation of project invoice request--You have a field called Time and Expenses From/To with two fields.--By default, Field To date is always filled automatically with current date (Provided the  field above this field called Restrict time and expenses value chosen as Specific date)-The time confirmation provision date has to be within the Time and Expenses To date / should be as per the Restrict time and expenses type chosen and the corresponding Time and Expenses From/To date.-Reason 2:-In the third step of project invoice request you might have many items of sales orders which don't have not invoiced time and expenses currently and ignoring them you have moved to step 4 where you get error.-Steps to find the provision date of time recordings:-Go to Project Management work center-Click on Not Invoiced Time and Expenses-Search for all Projects-Click on Edit Time and Expenes-You can see a column called provision date for each entry-Resolution-In Step 1 of project invoice request chose the Time and Expenses From/To date and Restrict time and expenses type considering the provision date of Time recordings done.-also in step 3 remove all sales order items that do not have not invoiced time and expenses currently.-  Keywords-No Time and Expenses,Unable to create project invoice request

Title: Customer Demand is Automatically Released Unexpectedly
Content: Symptom-Customer demand is automatically released unexpectedly.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to Customer Demand view.-Search Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents Sales Order ID).-You can see that its customer demand is released. However, you did not manually release it.-Cause-Under Delivery Section, you can define a delivery priority for the sales order. For sales order XYZ, you choose "Immediate" for the delivery prority.  If you choose Immediate for the Delivery Priority, the sales order is treated as a rush order and is released to the execution department automatically. That is, this order is set to Released automatically in the Customer Demand view of the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior. You can change the delivery priority to others, if you don't want system to automatically release the customer demand.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Sales Order

Title: Error Message: “Conversion rate must not be greater than 24” While Migrating Projects
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate Projects, but you receive the below error during the Simulation step:-Conversion rate must not be greater than 24-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Projects-Select Migrate projects using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step-Cause-In the Project Plans sheet, you maintained data as below:-Unit of Work as Working days-Hours per Working Day as 365-For the field Hours per Working Day, if you use Working days as Unit of Work, enter the number of hours that add up to one working day. As we have 24 hours in a day, the field Hours per Working Day should contain value 24 or lesser.-Resolution-Correct the data in the Migration File and proceed with the migration activity.-Keywords-Unit of Work, Hours per Working Day, Migration of Projects, Conversion rate must not be greater than 24

Title: Error Message While Migrating Bills of Operations
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate Bills of Operations, but you receive the below error in the Simulation step:-Resource XYZ has status In Preparation and must not be used-Resource PQR must be relevant for scheduling-*XYZ and PQR represents the Resource-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Bills of Operations-Select Migrate bills of operations using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-You receive the error message mentioned in the Simulation step-Cause-In the work center Supply Chain Design Master Data, the Status of the Resource is In Preparation. Further, the Resource has not been relevant for scheduling.-Resolution-Change the Status of the Resource to Active and make them Relevant to Scheduling before you proceed with the migration.-Keywords-Migration of Bills of Operations, Bills of Operations, Resource has status In Preparation and must not be used, Resource must be relevant for scheduling

Title: Error Message While Migrating Bills of Operations
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate Bills of Operations, but you receive the below error in the Simulation step:-Bills of Operations XXXXX not consistent-Main resource flag set for several service reqmts at activity XYZ, op. XYZ-Resource reqmt missing for res.PQR of service reqmt at activity XYZ, op.XYZ-*XXXXX represents the Bills of Operations-XYZ represents the Activity-PQR represents the Resource-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Bills of Operations-Select Migrate bills of operations using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-You receive the error message mentioned in the Simulation step-Cause-The errors are related to the Resources and the Services maintained in the Resource master data.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center-Go to Resources view-Show All Resources By Selection-Find the Resources which are displayed in the error message in the migration activity. For example: PQR-Select Edit-Select View All-In the General tab, under the section Resource Use-i) All the Resources have the checkbox ticked for Main Production Resource.-ii) The checkbox Resource Relevant for Financials is unchecked for all relevant Resources.-It indicates that this Resource will have no costs for the Bill of Operations.-Resolution-As one of the error message indicates that the Main Resource flag is set for several Service requirements at activity XYZ, op.XYZ , you should tick the checkbox for Main Production Resource for only one Resource.-You should tick the checkbox Resource Relevant for Financials.-Correct the data in the system and proceed with the migration activity.-See Also-Migration of Bills of Operations, Bills of Operations, Bills of Operations not consistent, Main resource flag set for several service reqmts at activity, Resource reqmt missing for Resource of service reqmt at activity

Title: Supplier Part Number is missing in Purchase Order Web Service Request
Content: Symptom-Supplier Part Number field is not available in the response file when you run web service Managepurchaseorderin request-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the SOAP UI-Download from service explorer and Enter the WSDL: ManagePurchaseOrderInRead-Execute the Request XML file in SOAP UI-The Supplier Part Number is missing in the response file-Cause-Currently,we do not have "supplier part number" as standard field in the Purchase Order web service query-Resolution-You can create a custom field.-Keywords-Supplier Part Number, Purchase Order, Managepurchaseorderin

Title: Shopping Cart Cost Center is Incorrect
Content: Symptom-The cost center in the shopping cart is not the same as that of Requestor's cost center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select Self Services Overview-Select Track My Shopping Carts hyperlink-Open the shopping cart-Cost Center is A (A refers to cost center ID).-Cause-You expected the system to update the cost center as B (B refers to cost center ID) instead of A. Cost center in the shopping cart is picked up at the date of creation of the document. As a result, the system has defaulted the older cost center. The new cost center will not be updated.-Resolution-Once the shopping is released, cost center cannot be edited. This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-cost center, shopping cart, shopping cart cost center, cost center incorrect

Title: Project Time Recordings performed by Service Agent cannot be found in the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses View
Content: Symptom-Project Time Recordings performed by service agent cannot be found in the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses View-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Invoice Preparation view.-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses sub view.-Select the project ID and click on Edit Time and Expenses.-The same Time Recording is not available in this list.-Cause-The time recording should be Approved status.-Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: Unable to Delete /Cancel the Migrated Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have migrated the purchase order and you are unable to delete or cancel the order after the successful migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Delete and Cancel button is grayed out-Cause-If the migrated purchase order is in status Sent or Acknowledgement Received or Not Yet Acknowledged, only for such purchase orders Deletion is not allowed. And rest of purchase order status you cannot Delete them. If the migrated purchase order is in Follow-Up Document Created status ,which means you have also migrated the corresponding Inbound Delivery(goods receipt) and Supplier Invoice. Since the follow up documents were not available in ByDesign system, you cannot cancel them, thus you cannot cancel purchase order as well.-Resolution-You can only Delete the purchase orders which are in status In Preparation. You cancel purchase order which are in status Sent or Acknowledgement Received or Not Yet Acknowledged. If the migrated purchase order is in Follow-Up Document Created status, please Finish them manually and then create new purchase orders.-Keywords-Delete migrated purchase order, Delete Migrated PO,cancel migrated purchase order, cancel Migrated PO

Title: Task Types Are Greyed Out for Approval for Sales Quotes in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You would like to maintain task types for approval for sales quotes in Business Configuration, but you notice that they are greyed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects.-Open the activity list.-Open all activities.-Search and open 'Approval for Sales Quotes'.-Deselect one of the 3 task types (Sales Quote,Revise Sales Quote or Approve Sales Quote).-Observe that all task types are greyed out and cannot be maintained.-Cause-The activity cannot be changed, because a task always must be created when working with an approval process. -If the task is not created the approver would not know what task to approve without BTM (Business Task Management).-Activity is read-only and settings cannot be changed.--NOTE: System will allow you to change the frequency but do deactivate  them to avoid issues.The same approach works for sales order for example, it gives a possibility to change the priority/frequency etc...-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Approval Sale Quote, BTM,Frequency,Sales Quotes,Task Types,Priority

Title: Data Source Production Task  not Showing all Production Tasks as Shown in Production Order
Content: Symptom-Production Task Data Source SCMPTV01 does  not show all Production Tasks although Production Order DEF(DEF refers to Production Order id)  has multiple tasks K, L ,M (K,L,M refers to Production Task ids)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Productions Order by order header View.-Search for Production Order DEF.-Select  View all.-Go to Tab Execution Monitor.-We observe Task id's K ,L,M.-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to Design data sources View.-Search for Data Source SCMPTV01.-Select on Preview.-Enter DEF as Production Lot ID and Select on Apply.-We observe Task id K & M shown in the report.-Cause-The data source SCMPTV01 displays the tasks that has the Input material or Final output product.We observed that Task id K & M has Input & Output Material respectively However Task id L does not have input Materials assigned to it, Hence Task id L is not shown in  data source.-Resolution-This is the standard designed behavior.-Keywords-Data Source Production Task;  Not showing all Production; Tasks as shown in Production Order

Title: Mail Notification Is Not Triggerred For Work Package Assignment.
Content: Symptom-How does the check box Mail Notification in the Project Task work.- or- You expected an email when you added employee to the services or work packages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Search for respective Project-Go to Project Planning-Go to sub tab Basic Data-Here you can see this check box.-Cause-The work package was not assigned by the employee himself.-or-The Mail Notification will not be triggered to the project manager when the work packages are assigned to the team member by the project manager.-Resolution-In HTML , Please place your cursor on the small question mark within a circle that appears blue in color right next to the field Mail Notification.--That gives you details as given below:--Determines if a mail will be sent to the person responsible, on the assignment of work packages by a team member. The flag is inherited to all project tasks but can be deleted manually for each task.-That  means:-If the work packages are assigned by the team member using Assign to me button then the Mail Notification will be triggered to the person responsible for the task . If there is no person responsible for the task, the Mail Notification will be sent to the person responsible(project manager) of the parent task.-See Also-In HTML we have this question mark called tool tip against many fields that gives you all necessary information about the respective field.- 2902167 - Employee not found when sending notification or Alert related to work package -Keywords-Mail Notification, Tool Tip, Question mark

Title: Identification Type Field is empty in Communication Arrangement for Purchase Order Integration Scenario[90-90 KBA]
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a communication arrangement, however the dropdown for the field Identification Type does not show any entries to be selected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to the Communication Arrangements view.-Click on the New button.-Search for the Communication Scenario to be used (e.g. Purchase Order Integration).-Click on Next to go to step 2 - Define Business Data.-Select a business partner in the Business Partner ID field.-The drop-down for field Identification Type is empty-Cause-You have not maintained External Business Identifiers for the relevant Business Partner or Supplier in the master data.-Resolution-The external business identifiers need to be defined for the business partner being used.-To do so, please follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Enter the Account/Supplier view, depending on the business partner role.-Search for the business partner and select it.-Click on Edit, then click on General.-On the left side, click on the link for "Additional Identifiers".-Here the fields populated will be available in the communication arrangement creation screen.-See Also-SCN Blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2012/04/10/b2b-integration-of-bydesign-with-external-systems/-Keywords-Identification Type, External Business Identifiers, Org Structure, Communication Arrangement, B2B, Business Partner Data, Suppliers Master Data, Suppliers, Additional Identifiers

Title: Supplier Invoice Remians in Status 'Delayed Verification in Process'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 3108835***-After the Supplier invoice is posted it gets in to status Delayed Verification in Process, but you expect it to change to the status Posted after some time (after a couple of hours).-Note:The system takes time to link all deliveries and hence based on the number of Deliveries in the invoice system, it will need more time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the respective Supplier invoice.- The Invoice is in status Delayed Verification in Process for a long time.-Cause-The related documents like Purchase orders or Deliveries were locked (accessed by someone else) at that time.-Note: The system retries to post 7 times with some interval. Since in your case even the documents were locked even during the retry, the invoice(s) remain in this status.-Resolution-Please do a Dummy-change in the Invoice, as mentioned below:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the respective Supplier invoice.-Select it and click on Edit.-Remove the external document ID.-Click on the Check button.-Enter the External document ID.-Click on the Check button again.-Once done you can click the Post Button.-See Also-KBA - 3108835 - Supplier invoice keeps in status 'Delayed Verification in Process'-Keywords-Delayed Verification in Process, Invoice not posted, Wrong status of Invoice

Title: Dump When You Click on Exceptions Tab or Accepting Price Variance Exception in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-System thorws a dump while opening the Exception tab or Accept the Price variance exception is clicked in the Supplier Invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for respective Supplier invoice-Select it and click on Edit-Go to Exceptions tab ( You may get Dump here  itself)-Select the Exception of type Price Variance in status In Process-Click on Actions and choose Accept-System throws a dumps here-Cause-Dump is due to Permanent establishment not being determined.-Note: Permanent establishment is a fixed place of business which generally gives rise to income or value-added tax liability in a particular jurisdiction.-Resolution-In order to determine permanent establishment,we need the Ship To information to be maintained in Supplier invoice-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit memos view-Search for Respective Supplier invoice-Select it and click on Edit-Go to General tab -Go to Parties and Locations tab-Maintain the Ship To location-Note: If the invoice has third party items, where you have maintained the customer in the Purchase Order item under Delivery tab. In this case Ship To can be left blank.-See Also-Our Product management has added this to their back log so this issue will be addressed in one of the future releases.-Keywords-SRMAP/CL_SIV_PAF_MAP_TO_EXT==CM003, unexpected eror while accepting exception, Supplier invoice Dump in Exceptions tab, Unable to accept exceptions, dump in exceptions tab, supplier invoice dump

Title: Supplier Not Populated Automatically in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The Supplier is not populated automatically once the user selects the item from the custom catalog in the New Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select New Purchase Order under Common Tasks-Select the Start button after selecting the Catalog under the Add Items from Catalog section.-Once you select the items in the catalog, click on the button Transfer Selected Items button.-The supplier is not populated once the items from the catalog are transferred to the purchase order.-Cause-There is no source of supply present for the product transferred from the custom catalog onto the purchase order. As a result, the Supplier field is blank.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-The supplier will be updated and populated automatically only when there is a source of supply assigned to the product. If not, the supplier has to be manually maintained-Keywords-Supplier not populated; supplier field empty; po without supplier; catalog; custom catalog; new purchase order; supplier field blank

Title: Extension Field is Missing in Equipment Resource Migration Template
Content: Symptom-Extension field is missing in equipment resource migration template.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Configuration work center and view Overview.- Search Migration of Equipment Resource.- Select Migration of Equipment Resources using the migration tool.- Select You Can Also.- Click Download Migration Template.-Then you cannot find the extension field created in Resource - General level.-Cause-Currently we are not supporting extension fields in migration template of equipment resource since there is no webservice related to equipment resource till now in the system.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Equipment Resource Migration, Migration Template, Extension Field-equipment resource migration, migration template

Title: Error Message:Enter a Postal Code
