Content: Symptom-When opening a Project Invoice Request, the error "Enter a Postal Code" is displayed for the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Project Invoicing View.-Select the Project Invoice Requests sub View.-Filter for All Project Invoice Requests.-Search for the Project Invoice Request ABC (where ABC represents the Project Invoice Request ID).-Select Edit button.-Select Check button.-The error "Enter a Postal Code" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The error "Enter a Postal Code" occurs for the Project Invoice Request ABC because the address of a Party Role such as (Seller, Sales Unit, Account, etc) was carried out from the Sales Order EDF without a valid Postal Code maintained.-(where EDF represents the Sales Order ID)-Even though address information was updated in the Account Master Data or Org Units Master Data after the respective Sales Order EDF was created, the error message "Enter a Postal Code" should still occur for the Project Invoice Request because the information determined from Project Invoice Request does not occur based on the Account or Org Units Master Data. The information maintained for the Project Invoice Requests is carried out from the Sales Order document.-Therefore, if the address information was not properly maintained for the Account or Org Units Master Data when the Sales Order was created/released, it will not be possible to update the address information for the Sales Order afterwards, causing the follow up Project Invoice Request to be created inconsistent.-Resolution-In this case, to correct the scenario reported, it will be required to delete the Project Invoice Request ABC, cancel the Sales Order EDF and then maintain the full address in the Account Master Data or Org Units Master Data.-Afterwards, the Sales Order and follow up Project Invoice Request can be re-created with the correct addresses of Party Roles properly maintained.-See Also-KBA 1508411 - Changed Master Data Are Not Taken Over Dynamically In Existing Sales Documents And New Documents Created As A Follow-Up-Keywords-project invoice request, sales order, seller, sales unit, party role, enter a postal code, postal code

Title: Extension Fields in Create Label Screen
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new Label, and in the New Labels screen you want to be able to add an extension field. However, when you enter the Adaptation Mode, you are not able to find the option to add an Extension Field in the New Labels screen layout.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Adaptation Mode from Adapt option.-Go to Outbound Logistics view.-Show All Outbound Deliveries by selection.-Select the relevant Product ID PRD (PRD represents the Product ID).-Choose New Labels.-Choose Adapt and select Edit screen.-You can see under Screen layout that in Extension Field there is no Add option available to extend the field.-Or, second option:-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select Labels.-Click on the button New Labels.-Enter the Adaptation mode.-Click on Edit this screen.-Click on Extension fields.-You can see there is no option to Extend the field (Further Usage is not available).-Cause-Currently we do not support extensibility on Labels screen and thus there is no option to add the extensible fields on the New Labels screen.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Extension, field, new labels, outbound, Logistics, further usage

Title: Stock in Stock Overview not Assigned to a Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-While checking the Stock Overview, the Stock is showing for a Product MAT (MAT represents the Product ID), but this is not assigned to any Logistics Area, and the Stock is actually not available in your Warehouse. Now it is necessary to remove or correct the stock to zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Inbound Logistics.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view.-Select Stock Overview.-Enter the Product ID MAT.-Click the Go button.-There is an On-hand Stock for the Product ID MAT which is not assigned to any Logistics Area.-Cause-You have created a Stock Transfer Order STO (STO represents the Stock Transfer Order ID) and have completed the Goods Issue Process. However, the Goods have not been received at the receiving Warehouse, therefore the Stock is now In-Transit. To resolve the issue, it is necessary to post the goods receipt in the Inbound Logistics work center.-If you personalize the Stock Overview screen, you will be able to activate the Outbound Delivery Column to see the Outbound Delivery ID the Stock is assigned to. The Stock Type is also displayed as 'In-Transit' in the Stock Overview.-Resolution-Navigate to work center Inbound Logistics.-Go to the view Inbound Delivery Notifications.-Search for the relevant Inbound Delivery Notification XYZ (XYZ represents the document ID).-Depending on your business settings, you can now directly Post Goods Receipt, or Create a Warehouse Request, and then confirm the Warehouse Tasks if you are working with Warehouse Tasks.-After completing the Inbound Process, the Stock will no longer be displayed in Stock Overview.-Keywords-In-Transit, Stock Transfer Order, Logistics Area Missing, Stock Overview

Title: Mini Scenario for Supply Chain Management (SCM): Ship-From Site Determination in ATP
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Sales Order/Service Order, but the system is not able to determine Ship-From Site automatically or it is showing wrong Ship-From Site. This document explains the basic settings which are used by the system to determine the Ship-From Site.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Find and select the relevant Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Choose the Edit button.-In the new screen, choose the View All button.-Go to the Items tab, and select the relevant Line Item.-You can see in the Ship-From field there is no location determined or it is showing the wrong Ship-From Site.-Cause-The Ship-from is determined based on the Ship-to country Address, the Transport zone and Transport Lanes. If these data are not maintained, then system will not be able to determine the Ship-from Site.-Resolution-You can follow the below mentioned steps to verify the settings:-In Sales Order, check for the country/region/postal code for the ship-to party address at item level.-Go to the work center Supply Chain Design Master Data.-Go to the view Transport Zones and select the advance search-Enter the details which you got in step 1 e.g. Country. -Here you can see the list of the active Transport Zones for the entered searched terms.-Go to the view Transport Lanes, and select the Advance search for the Transport Lanes linked to the Transport Zones, you got in step 4.-Check the status, and ensure it is Active.-Now check which Company/Seller the Ship-from belongs to, because if the Seller belongs to another company, no Ship-from determination will happen.                   -How to check for the company of the Ship-from Site -Go to work center Supply Chain Design Master Data-Select the Locations view.-Find and select the relevant Ship-From Site XYZ (XYZ represents the Ship-from Site ID).-Choose the Edit button. -In the new screen you will find the company to which this site belongs.-How to check for the Seller Company-Navigate to the Sales orders work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Click view all.-Go to the Involved Parties tab.-Here you can check for Seller Company.-The Seller Company and the Company for the Ship-from Site must be the same.-Keywords-Ship-from, Site, ATP, Fulfillment, Sales Order

Title: Product Catalog De-Select All Items
Content: Symptom-When you are editing a Product Catalog, you have a category with only one item selected. As you de-select the category and select it again, all items are automatically selected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Services Portfolio work center.-Select the Product Catalog view.-Click the Edit button for ID ABC_01 (ABC_01 represents the ID of the Product Catalog).-Navigate to the Categories tab.-Expand DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Product Category ID).-Select the line DEF_01 (DEF_01 represents the ID of the Category subitem).-Only one item is selected Products in Category.-De-select the check for the subitem.-Select the checkbox again.-Now all of the items are selected under the Products in Category.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you would like to have only some of the items selected under the Products in Category, you have to manually de-select the unwanted items.-Keywords-Product Catalog, Category Items; De-Select;

Title: Warning Message Appears When Trying to Release Production Order Although Input Products Identified Stock is valid and has Sufficient Stock
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a Production Order, but the system showing some warning messages although Input Products have sufficient stock available.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Production Orders View.-Search for relevant Production Order.-Click the Release button.-The system displays warning messages as mentioned below:------> Determination of source inventory failed for product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).------->Inventory in logistics area not available.-Cause-If you check the planning details of the relevant input product, you can see that the available stock is already soft allocated to other demands and hence no enough stock for the new order.-Please follow the below steps to Check the Planning Details of the relevant Product:-Navigate to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products View.-Find and select the relevant Product.-Click the Open button.-You can see all Demands listed in the Supply and Demand table.-Resolution-Please increase the stock of the input product to resolve the issue.-Keywords-Determination of source inventory failed for product, Inventory in logistics area not available.

Title: Error Message:PO Acknowledgement With Up-to-Date Status Can not be Deleted
Content: Symptom-You get Error while deleting the Purchase order acknowledgement in status Up-to-Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase orders work center-Go to Purchase orders-Search for the Purchase order-Click on Acknowledgment received appearing under column PO Acknowledgement status-Select the Acknowledgment with status Up-to-Date-Click on Delete PO Acknowledgement button- You will get error.-Cause-Status Up-to-Date means : it is the last created Purchase Order Acknowledgement.-As the PO acknowledgement is done at least once , the details should be available in the system.--The delete button is provided in the system to delete only the Out of date PO acknowledgement documents.--This button cannot be disabled only for Up-to-Date acknowledgements as the UI is multi select enabled. So, if more than one acknowledgement is selected some of which are Out-of-Date, and the delete button for the one with Up-to-Date status cannot be disabled.--For this reason, button is enabled in general but the system throws error info message as per the status of the document.-Resolution-Please create correct PO acknowledgement and then you can delete the old acknowledgement with Out of date status.-Keywords-Up-to-Date, Unable to delete PO Acknowledgement

Title: Incorrect Number Range Allocated to Self-Invoice for an Unregistered Vendor (GST India)
Content: Symptom-You have procured goods and services from an unregistered vendor and saved / posted an Evaluated Receipt Settlements (ERS) invoice. However system did not allocate the number range defined as per the document numbering rule-Environment-1805-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Common Tasks and select New ERS Invoice-Enter the Company ID that belongs to India-Enter Supplier, Invoice Date and the External Document ID, and make sure that this ID is unique as it will help you locate the invoice-Navigate to Items tab and enter the Product ID-Enter the Tax code that is associated with GST RCM tax codes-Save or Post the Evaluated Receipt Settlements (ERS) invoice-Cause-You have activated the document numbering format for Self-Invoices on specific date. (For Example - 01.06.2018) However you have entered the posting date of self-invoice to back dates where there was no rule maintained. (For example - 04.04.2018) Since there was no rule activated during the backdates, system will not allocate the new number range when you save or post the invoice and hence the old number range will be defaulted. This is an expected behavior-Resolution-You need to enter the posting date of ERS invoice after the activation of self-invoice configuration. Later system will allocate the correct number range in the Evaluated Receipt Settlements (ERS) invoice-Keywords-Number range for ERS invoice, Self Invoice number range

Title: How to Create Self-Invoice for an Unregistered Vendor (GST India)
Content: Symptom-You have procured goods and services from an unregistered vendor and you want to know how to create self invoice for these unregistered vendors.-or- Wrong Supplier invoice ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation projects-Click on Activity List-Go to Fine tune-Search for Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing-The customer has the supplier invoicing series as per GST registration but system is not taking invoice series as per customized number range what they have defined for one single company-Resolution-In India, under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime, you need to create a self-invoice for all the goods and services procured from an unregistered vendor. This is handled through the Evaluated Receipt Settlements (ERS) invoice. You create an ERS invoice with relevant Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) tax codes. For these documents, an Official Document Number (ODN) is generated, based on the GST registration number and the annual year. You can follow the below steps to create self- invoices-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view-Select Open Activity List and navigate to Fine Tuning tab -Select Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing activity and click on Insert Row-Enter Company ID belongs to India and Document Type as Supplier Invoice-Fill the Tax Registration Number details from the list and press enter so that Self Invoice column will be marked as Yes-Define the Prefix Value and Separator-You can also define Calendar Year as Suffix, Year Suffix Selection Date & Start Document ID-Select Save-Now you can create Evaluated Receipt Settlements (ERS) invoice from the below steps;-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Common Tasks and select New ERS Invoice-Enter the Company ID that belongs to India-Enter Supplier, Invoice Date and the External Document ID, and make sure that this ID is unique as it will help you locate the invoice-Navigate to Items tab and enter the Product ID-Enter the Tax code that is associated with GST RCM tax codes-Save or Post the Evaluated Receipt Settlements (ERS) invoice-System creates the self-invoice and generates an Official Document Number (ODN) that adheres to the rules maintained in the business configuration-Note:-1. Currently, the tax codes associated with the GST RCM are as follows:-Tax Code     Tax Code Description-86               Import of Service (Reverse Charge – IGST)-89               Domestic Purchase Interstate (IGST) - Reverse Charge-90               Domestic Purchase Interstate (CGST & SGST) Reverse Charge-91               Domestic Purchase UT (CGST & UTGST) - Reverse Charge-2. When you copy a self-invoice, the document numbering rules will not be applicable, as this invoice is treated as a supplier invoice-Keywords-Self Invoice, Invoice for unregistered vendors, wrong invoice iD,  old invoice iD numbering, New numbering is not considered,Tax number,New  numbering

Title: Incorrect Planned and Requested Quantities of Input Product in Production Orders
Content: Symptom-You have created a Production Order PRO (PRO represents the Production Order ID) which contained an Input Product INP (INP represents the Input Product ID) with different UoMs. You have also maintained the correct Quantity Q of the Input Product INP required to produce the Quantity X of the Output Product OUP (OUP represents the Output Product ID) in the corresponding Production Model PMM (PMM represents the Production Model ID). However, when you are confirming the Make Task TSK (TSK represents the Make Task ID), you find that the system is showing Planned Quantity P of the Input Product INP which is a multiple of the expected Quantity Y.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view, and select By Order Header.-Find and select the Production Order PRO.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Order Structure tab, and Expand All.-You can see in the Supply Activity for the Product INP the Planned Quantity is X (the Quantity is displayed in the Planning UoM).-If you scroll down to the Make Activity for the same Product, you can see the Planned Quantity is P instead, but you expected Y (the Quantity is displayed in the Base UoM).-Since you have maintained Quantity Conversion, you expect the system to propose the correct Planned Quantity.-Cause-You have maintained in the Material Master of the Input Product INP a base Unit of Measure (UoM) 'Meter' and the Planning unit of Measure 'Each'. Even though you have also maintained Quantity Conversion between these Units, but you have maintained for the UoM zero Decimal Places. Since Planning always does upper rounding, hence anything with decimals places is rounded up to a whole number. This is why, in this case the Quantity X is rounded up also to a whole number.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find and select the Activity 'Quantities and Units of measure'.-Click on 'Change Immediately'. -Click on 'Create and Maintain trading units'.-Select the Unit of measure 'Each'.-You can see under the column 'Display Decimals' that the value maintained is zero.-Change this according to your needs and save your changes. -If you maintain decimals, the system does upper rounding based on decimals setting. Pleate note that only a Maximum of 3 decimal upper rounding is allowed.-See Also-Supply Operation, Base UoM, Planning UoM, Each, Meter, Production Order, Supply to Production, Supply Task, Make Task, Planned Quantity, Requested Quantity

Title: Error "Negative Stock not permitted in logistics area XXX, material YYY" When Doing Adjustment Confirmation for Inbound Delivery.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to do Adjustment Confirmation for an inbound delivery ID but the system throws the error message :-Negative Stock not permitted in logistics area XXX, material YYY.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Monitoring view and the By Warehouse Order sub view.-In the Show  field, choose All Warehouse Orders and search for the warehouse order XXX (XXX stands for warehouse order ID).-Edit the Warehouse order XXX, on the screen choose the Adjustment Confirmation button.-Select the Enable Entry button.-In the quantity field fill in the quantity with a minus sign.-Later select the Save button and system throws the error.-Cause-The error occurs as there is not enough stock available in the Source Logistics area YYY (YYY stands for source logistics area ID)and the Negative Stock Allowed flag is not checked for the logistics area in the location layout.-Resolution-In case if you want to further allow the negative stock in the inventory you can enable the option Negative stock enabled at Site/locationand the logistics area level using the following steps:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master data work center.-Select the Locations view.-Search for the Site/Location ZZZ (ZZZ stands for Site/Location ID).-Then choose Edit button. A window opens.-Check the box for Negative Stock Allowed and save it.-Now select the Edit Layout button.-Select the logistics area YYY and check the box for Negative Stock Allowed.-Then proceed with doing the Adjustment Confirmation, it will take the negative stock in the inventory.-Keywords-Adjustment Confirmation, Negative Stock

Title: Error Message:"Serialized Label not permitted for Serialized Product XXX"
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message :"Serialized Label not permitted for Serialized Product DEF" when trying to create a new label.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Go to Task Control View-Show all and search Task XXX (XXX stands for task ID).-Select Task XXX.-In the tool bar, click New Labels.-Select line with Product DEF (DEF stands for Product ID).-Change Label Type to "Serialized Product".-Navigate to Serial Number Tab.-Enter serial Number ABC (ABC stands for serial number).-Finally Click Create Serial Numbers.-Click Save.- You receive error message:"Serialized Label not permitted for Serialized Product DEF".-Cause-This is a valid error, because Product DEF has serial number profile:Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes. Previously before introduction of serial number profile: Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes, serialized labels were allowed. Now for serial number profile "Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes" labeling of serialized product is stopped.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-New Labels, Labelling, Serial Number, Serial Number Profile.

Title: Error:Save Rejected Because Field (XXXX)is Defined as Mandatory by Key User
Content: Symptom-This error will not allow you to proceed further or you cannot save the document as systems throws above error (where XXXX is Any field)in any view of any work center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When you click on check button or while saving any document in any screen you might get this error-Cause-In the adaptation mode you have made the field as mandatory and hence you  are getting the error-Resolution- Go to the particular screen where you can see the field XXXX- Choose Enter adaptation mode- Click on edit screen- Go to the particular field that is shown in the error- Select the field- Bottom you can see field Mandatory being marked- Deselect the field and click on publish-Keywords-Save Rejected Because Field,defined as mandatory by key user, field is mandatory

Title: Error Message: Technical error APSLL_RT 000; report an incident While Confirming the Warehouse Task
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to confirm the Pick Task using Logistics Unit, system throws below error messages :-         --> Technical error APSLL_RT 000; report an incident-      --> Conversion not possible for unspecified LU-      --> Quantity is not valid; enter valid quantity-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Task Control View.-Show All Warehouse Tasks by selection and find required Task ID.-Select and choose Confirm.-Under Line Items tab, choose Propose Quantities and Logistics Areas.-Now under subtab General, go to section Source,-In the field Logistics Unit, when you choose value selection system doesn't display required LU Unit ID.-Now you enter the required LU Unit ID manually and press enter.-System throws above error messages.-Cause-The Logistics Unit which is marked as Non-Inventory Managed with no Single Product. Hence it is an Unspecified LU and standard product cannot be assigned to an unspecified LU. If the Non-Inventory Managed indicator is marked, the LU is a 'documentary' LU, meaning this LU cannot be managed in inventory since its contained products do not have a fixed, known quantity. Therefore, these LUs can exist only in documents, such as outbound delivery. A user can use unspecified LUs in labels, which can then be assigned to the outbound delivery.-LU Unit ID can be assigned to Outbound Delivery via Packing and Labels.-Resolution-Go to Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Task Control view.-Select the required Task ID and choose Confirm.-Enter required details and perform Save.-Once Outbound Delivery gets created with status Not Released.-Select the relevant Outbound Delivery ID and choose Packing.-Under Packing tab, go to section: Packages and choose Insert Package.-Using Value Selection, choose the required Logistics Unit ID.-Perform Save.-Keywords-Logistics Unit, Unspecified Logistics Unit, Technical error APSLL_RT 000; report an incident, Quantity is not valid; enter valid quantity, Conversion not possible for unspecified LU

Title: User Not Appearing Under Direct Approver List in the Purchase Request Approval Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:All details combined into one KBA 2344117 - Employee Not Visible in Direct Approver List , cause they have same cause and solution except the document is different.-Direct Approver are not visible under the purchase request/Purchase order approval process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Select Approval Processes under Task Distribution View.-Select Approval process for Purchase Request-Select Copy.-Under Work Distribution select Direct Approvers.-Select Edit.-Search for employee user01 (user01 refers to the name of the employee)using the Filter icon.-You get the message No Records Found.-Cause-The user does not have access rights to managing my area related to Purchasing.-Resolution-1.Assign Work center view: 'MMA_OPERATIONALPURCHASING' for the users.-2.Also the user should be active/valid-3.also  the user should have corresponding Work center view assigned like Purchase request and orders work center-Go to Application and User Management-Go to Business Users view-Go to new and choose edit access rights-Keywords-Direct Approver,Purchase Request,Purhase order

Title: Written Off Times and Expenses of Direct Cost Project Appear as Not Invoiced
Content: Symptom-You create a Direct Cost Project and mark it as billable.-Later you decide to mark all work packages of the project as unbillable.-All incurred expenses have been written off from invoicing side by setting all hours as not billable.-However, you notice that the number of expenses still appear as Not invoiced in the Invoice Preparation - Not Invoiced Times and Expenses Object Worklist (OWL) in Project Management.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To mark a Direct Cost Project as billable:-In the Project Management work center go to the Common Task view and press New Project.-In Step 1- Enter Initial data select Project Type Direct Cost Project.-In the Source field, select None.-Press Next.-In step 3-Define Project, maintain all mandatory data and then, under Customer, mark the Billable box. After this all planned work packages defined in the project will be flagged as billable automatically.-Continue with steps 4 to 6 to set up the project.-To mark all work packages as not billable:-In the Project Management work center go to the Projects view.-Find your Direct cost project with ID DCPXX, for example, and open it (DCPXX represents the Direct Cost Project ID).-In the Project Plan- Gantt Chart, select the Project task for which you want to mark all work packages as not billable.-Navigate to the Work view.-Remove the flag in the Billable column for all work packages of the task.-To write off already recorded, billable hours:-Precondition - Every employee/ service agent who reported time on project DCPXX needs to log into SAP Business ByDesign.-In the Home work center go to the Self Services - Self-Services-Overview.-Under Time click on the Edit Time Sheet link.-Find all the time entries recorded for project DCPXX.-Click into each time recording and set the Billable hours to 00:00.-Press Actions - Release.-Proceed this way with all time entries.-Finally, press Save and Close.-After this all recorded, now unbillable times are automatically written off in terms of Customer invoicing (If you created a Project invoice request for project DCPXX all recorded, unbillable times will appear as Time to Be Written Off).-However, the written off time entries still appear as Not Invoiced in Project Management:-In the Project Management work center go to the Invoice Preparation - Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Find project DCPXX.-In the list you notice that the number of time entries appear in the Time and Expenses Not Invoiced section.-Cause-If a Direct Cost Project was initially marked as Billable, even if all work packages and recorded times have been marked as not-billable since, the Project will remain marked as Billable on header level:-In the Project Management workcenter - Projects view find project DCPXX.-You can see the project is flagged as Billable.-In this case all recorded, now written off times, will continue to appear as Not Invoiced times in Project Management.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior. It is recommended to use Customer Projects with Sales Integration when Project time recordings are to be invoiced to the customer.-Keywords-written off times, direct cost project, Not Invoiced Time and Expenses, Not Billable Times appear as Not Invoiced

Title: Consume Button is Greyed Out in Project Stock Order
Content: Symptom-Customer have pre-delivered a product to their customer through a Project Stock Order. But they failed to consume the delivered quantity from the project, Consume button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Navigate to the Projects view.-Search for Project ABC (ABC stands for Project Order ID), Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the sub-tab Project Stock Orders and expand the Project Stock Order XXX (XXX stands for Project Stock Order ID) .-When you select Product DEF (DEF stands for the Product ID).- You can see that the Consume button is greyed out.-Cause-The Project Stock Order is in completed status. Once it is completed, the consume button is greyed out.-Resolution-If you have manually completed the project stock order item, you need following below steps.-Open the project stock order.-Select the item.-Click Revoke Completion.-In Project Stock Order XXX, if product DEF has type "Consumption at Site". For such type, you have to bring the stock back via ad-hoc Goods Movement in Internal Logistics work center and then create a new project stock order.-Keywords-Project Stock Order, Consume, Complete.

Title: Logistics Unit is Not Visible in Packing Delivery
Content: Symptom-Logistics Unit is not available to select in packing delivery.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Outbound Delivery view.-Show All and Search Outbound Delivery XXX (XXX stands for Outbound Delivery ID).-Select it and Click Packing.-Click Insert Package - Insert Top Package.-Click Value help button for Logistics Unit ID.-You expect Logistics Unit ABC (ABC stands for Logistics Unit ID) is visible in the list and available to select. However, it is not in the list.-Cause-Only logistic unit that is "Non-Inventory -Mange" = Yes, and "Single product only" = No, can be used in packing delivery. Logistics Unit ABC does not meet such criteria.-Resolution-Logistics Unit ABC is already active, and attributes cannot be changed. You need to create a new one:-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to Logistics Units view.-Click New.-Select box "Non-Inventory-Manage", and deselect box "Single Product Only".-  Keywords-Logistics Unit, Packing Delivery

Title: How to Create a New Supplier Delivery Notification via Webservice
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to create a new supplier delivery notification via webservice.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Managment Work Center.-Go to Input and Output Management View.-Select Service Explorer View.-Show all and search "Delivery Notification".-No results returned.-Cause-Currently system does not support  to create inbound delivery notifications via webservice. There is only one, but it is specific for Returns to Supplier.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can automate the inbound delivery process:-Create Inbound Delivery Notifications from Inbound Logistics work center - Purchase order view. Then go to Inbound Logsitcs work center, Automated Action - Inbound Delivery Notification Runs view and create a run and schedule.-After the Logistics Task is created, you can use the Web Service "ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn" to confirm it.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, Webservice

Title: Target Logistics Area is Unchangeable for Replenish Task Created with Reference of Production Order
Content: Symptom-Target Logistics area is unchangeable for replenish task created with reference of Production Order.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Go to Task Control View.-Search task XXX (XXX stands for replenish task ID) and click confirm.- You can see the target logistics area is ABC (ABC stands for logistics area ID), and it is not changeable.-Cause-For replenish task created with reference of Production Order, the target logistics area is fetched from Production Order. Open Production Order, Click View all , Navigate to Products tab , select Input product tab, here you can see the logistics area for input products.-You have requested replenishment for logistics area ABC , which means this logistics area needs to be replenished. That is why system created replenishment task with target logistics area as ABC. Since replenishment is requested for Logistics Area ABC, so system does not allow to change the logistics area.-Resolution-Customer could the change the logistics area before release the production order. Once it is released, it could not be changed.-Keywords-Target Logistics Area, Replenish Task, Production Order

Title: Shopping Cart Self Approval
Content: Symptom-While approving Shopping cart, Approver is getting error: "Shopping cart approval not possible".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Search for the Shopping Cart's ID. -Select the approval task.-Click in Approve button.-You get the error message:-Shopping cart approval not possible.-Cause-The user that is trying to approve the Shopping Cart is the creator of the Shopping Cart, the Requester or the Recipient.-This user will only be able to approve it if the question "Do you want to allow self-approval for shopping cart approvals?" is scoped in the Business Configuration.-Also note that Self approval question only covers the cases where the task is generated against the creator or requester or receipeint of the Shopping cart via the Direct Approvers, however, if it is any other Work distribution this question is not applicable.-Resolution-Follow below steps to enable self-approval for Shopping carts:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Click on Edit Project Scope button. -Click in Next until reach 'Step 4 Questions'.-Expand Purchasing.-Expand Self-Service Procurement.-Select Shopping carts.-You will see the question at the end of the list ("Do you want to allow self-approval for shopping cart approvals?"). -Check mark it.-Complete the next steps.- You may follow similar steps for Purchase orders as well.-Keywords-Shopping Cart; Self-Approval, Business Configuration

Title: Source Logistics Area Not Proposed for Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-You are performing Post Goods Issue for a product. The product is not in stock, however you have enabled negative stock allowed flag for the relevant Logistics Area and hence expects the system should propose the Source Logistics Area in the Post Goods Issue screen.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go the Outbound Logistics work center.-2.Navigate to Delivery Control View.-3.Open Delivery Proposals View.-4.Select the Delivery Request XXX (XXX stands for Delivery Requeset ID).-5.Click the Post Goods Issue button.-In the Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue screen you see that the system has not proposed a relevant Source Logistics Area ABC (ABC stands for the Logistics Area ID), even though you have allowed negative stocks for the Logistics Area ABC.-Cause-The Business ByDesign system is designed in such a way that the Source Logistics Area will not be proposed, nor will be visible when selecting the value help button while confirming a task or performing Post Goods Issue, if the available stock for the relevant product is zero. The Logistics Area will be proposed when negative stock indicator is enabled for a particular Logistics Area, only when the Allocation Type and Allocation Scope is not be defined for the same and there is either a positive or a negative stock for the relevant product.-Resolution-The system is working as designed. As a workaround, you could manually input the logistics area ID.-Keywords-Source Logistics Area, Negative Stock Allowed, Post Goods Issue

Title: Input Product Quantity Doubled in the Released Planning Model
Content: Symptom-Input Product Quantity Doubled in Released Planning Model-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Go to Production Models View.-Show all and search Production Model ABC (ABC stands for Production Model ID).-Click Open Released Planning Model.-Click Structure Tab.-You can see that the input product DEF (DEF stands for product ID) has quantity equals to 2 ea.-However, if you check the Bill of Material XYZ of Production Model ABC (XYZ stands for Bill of Material ID), the input product DEF has quantity equals to 1 ea.-Cause-The Production Model has the scrap factor maintained as 10%, which leads to increase in Input Quantity: 1 ea / (1 - 10%) = 1.11111111...-Since Planning always rounds up the input quantity, according to your displayed decimal setting maitianed for Unit of Measure (i.e. for unit of measure "ea", the dispalyed decimal is 1) the instead of 1.1111111.. ea, its rounding off to 2 ea.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior if you want to maintain the scrap factor. Otherwise, you could remove the scrap factor in the production model.-Keywords-Input Product Quantity, Production Model, Released Planning Model

Title: Error message:Cancellation not possible; deviation quantity was accepted
Content: Symptom-You want to reverse a warehouse confirmation, but receive error message: "Cancellation not possible; deviation quantity was accepted."-Environment-SAP Business Bydeisgn All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Warehouse Order View.-Show all and search Warehouse Order XXX (XXX stands for Warehouse Order ID).-Click it and navigate to confirmation tab.-Select row with confirmation ID YYY (YYY stands for warehouse confirmation ID).-Click Reverse Confirmation.-Error message:Cancellation not possible; deviation quantity was accepted-Cause-In confirmation ID YYY,  you also confirm Product ABC (ABC stands for product ID)  with quantity zero and accepted the deviation already.-Resolution-Open warehouse order XXX.-Navigate to Operation Tab.-Select row for product ABC.-Click Reprocess Open Quantity.-After that, you could perform reverse confirmation again.-Keywords-Reverse warehouse confirmation

Title: MRP Creates Purchase Proposals with Wrong lot-sizing Method
Content: Symptom-For example, you expect that system would create one single supply for the demands within month while running Material Requirement Planning (MRP) for Product ABC (ABC stands for production ID) with Production Specification DEF (DEF stands for production specification ID). Then you maintain the planning procedure as "demand - driven", the lot-sizing method as "periodic lot-size" and period type as "month" in the Product Master Data.-However, system creates proposals for each demand, instead of creates as per your setting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products View.-Search for Product ABC with Production Specification DEF.-Click Open.-Click Run Planning - Single BoM level, then system would create proposals for each demand.-Cause-For Products with Production Specification, the lot sizing method "Lot-for-Lot" is automatically applied, other methods would be ignored.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-See Also-Help Portal: Material Planning Settings-Keywords-MRP, lot-sizing method, Proposals, Production Specification, Lot for Lot.

Title: Purchase Order Forms
Content: Symptom-Updated form is not picked up when you click on Resubmit button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Purchase Orders view-Search for the purchase order X (X represents purchase order ID)-Navigate to Output History tab-Click on Resubmit button-Cause-You have created a new version of the purchase order form. When you click the Resubmit button on the purchase order Output History tab, the system does not use the newly modified purchase order form. The system just tries to reprocess the form that was initially sent.-If you want the system to pick up the updated form, there must be an actual change done in the purchase order. After there is an actual change, when you click on Send Update, the newly updated Purchase Order Changed Form will be used.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-purchase order forms; forms; updated po forms; purchase order

Title: Default Transport Zone id  is missing in Supply Chain Design Master Data  Work Center
Content: Symptom-You see that Default Transport Zone DEF (DEF refers to Transport Zone id) is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Navigate to Transport Zone View-Search for Transport Zone DEF-You observe that Default Transport Zone is missing.-Cause-As you have not scoped question:Do you define a  single  global  distribution network including a global  transport zone? in Business Configuration settings, Hence the Default Transport Zone is not appearing.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue you will have to scope the question as mentioned in the below path- Go to the Business Configuration work center- Select the relevant project and choose Edit Project Scope button-Navigate to the tab 4-Questions-Navigate to Supply Chain Setup Management--> Supply Chain Design-->Supply Chain Network-Now on the right-hand side of the screen, you will find question: Do you define a  single  global  distribution network including a global  transport zone?-Scope this question and Select Next to save the changes-Logout and login again-Keywords-Transport Zone is missing, Default Transport Zone not reflecting, Default Transport Zone id  is missing in Supply Chain Design Master Data  Work Center

Title: Unable to Split Input Product in Production Task
Content: Symptom--When you try to Confirm Production Task 9999 with Input Products and select Split, system does not Split the Input Products.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Production Control workcenter and Task Control view-2. Find Task 9999 and Confirm-3. Go to Confirmation Tab and Input Products sub tab-4. Select any product Productxyz and click on Split-We do not see the split of Input Product.-Cause-This happens because of the current hierarchical design between confirmation group, activity and material input maintained in Production lot and its linkage with production task.-Resolution-The solution for this is not straight forward.-As a work around we suggest whenever you use Task Creation Strategy in Bill Of Operations as Operations Including Reporting Point or Activities Including Reporting Point, you should give Reporting Point after every operation in the Production Model.-Once this is done Split will work as expected.-Keywords-Production Task, Input Products, Split, Task Creation Strategy, Reporting Point

Title: Incorrect Quantity Displayed In Multi-Level Structure Of Bill Of Materials
Content: Symptom-You have created several Production Bill of Materials which have Input Products with Decimal Quantity. However, if you open the 'Multi-Level BoM Structure' screen, quantities are displayed incorrectly. You therefore would like to have an explanation of this quantity mismatch between the Input Product screen and the Multi-Level Structure view of the Bill Of Materials (BoM).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the WorkCenter Planning and Production Master Data.-Select the Production Bill Of Materials view.-Show 'All Production Bills of Material by Selection' and find the relevant Production BoM.-Select the BoM and click the Edit button.-Go to the Input Products tab if you are not there by default.-You can see the Quantity of the relevant Input Material is displayed in Decimals.-Now go back to the Production Bill Of Materials view, and choose Multi-Level Structure.-Click on the Expand button and select Expand All.-Here you see the Quantity of Input Material is rounded up to a whole non-decimal value.-You expect the system to display the same value in both screens.-Cause-In the 'Multi-Level BoM Structure' screen, quantities are displayed based on the 'Display Decimals' setting of the corresponding Unit of Measure (UoM). This setting is defined in the 'Fine Tuning' activity in 'Business Configuration'. The name of this fine tuning activity is 'Quantities and Units of Measure'.-Resolution-You have to maintain the values for 'Display Decimals' setting of the corresponding Unit of Measure (UoM) in 'Business Configuration' under the fine tuning activity 'Quantities and Units of Measure'. To do that, kindly follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Select the Overview view.-Show Activities and Find Quantities and Units of Measure.-Select Change Immediately.-Select Create and Maintain Trading Units.-Select the relevant Unit and enter the value for Display Decimals Value as per the Business requirement.-Save and Close.-Note: You may have to log out of the system for the changes to take effect!-Keywords-UoM, Display Decimals, Multi-Level Structure, BoM, Bill of Materials, Quantities and Units of Measure, Input Product

Title: You Cannot Accept Deviation for a Put Away Task, the System Returns the Error 'Cannot save document as inconsistent; document already released'
Content: Symptom-You have created an Inbound Delivery Notification ABC (ABC represents the Inbound Delivery notification ID) for an X Quantity of a Purchase Order, and have partially received the Quantity and Confirmed the remaining Quantity with 0 while maintaining a Deviation Reason. However, when you go to the Monitoring view of the the Inbound Logistics work center to accept the Deviation by clicking on 'Accept Deviation', the system returns multiple error messages, and you cannot complete the Delivery Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Monitoring view.-Find the relevant Task for the Inbound Delivery Notification ABC.-Click on the 'Accept Deviation' button.-The system then triggers the following error messages:-Cannot save document as inconsistent; document already released.-Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions.-Cannot create notification; items have different ship-to locations.-Cause-You have maintained a Ship-to Location LAB (LAB represents the Ship-to Location ID) in the Inbound Delivery Notification which is different from the Ship-To/Service Location LAA (LAA represents the Ship-To/Service Location ID) in the Purchase Order. To resolve the issue, you have to correct the Ship-To/Service Location in the Purchase Order.-Resolution-Navigate to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Order view.-Find and select the Purchase order XYZ (XYZ represents the Purchase order ID).-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Items tab.-Select the relevant Line items.-Change the Ship-To/Service Location.-Save your changes.-Now navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Monitoring view.-Find the relevant Task to the Inbound Delivery Notification ABC.-Click the 'Accept Deviation' button.-Now you should be able to close the Task without issue.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, Purchase Orders, items, different ship-to locations, Accept Deviation.

Title: How to Modify the Identified Stock Description
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to modify the Identified Stock Description of the Identified Stock IDs. But there is no Migration Mode to Modify already existing records.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Identified Stock-Select Migrate identified stock using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Select the Properties button-The option Modify Already Existing Records is not available on field Migration Mode-Cause-This is expected system behavior. Modify already existing records is not supported to update Identified Stock.-Resolution-You may modify the Identified Stock Description for the Identified Stock ID using the webservice: ManageIdentifiedStocksIn-Below is the sample payload for reference.-<n0:IdentifiedStockMaintainRequestMessage xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<IdentifiedStockMaintainBundle actionCode="02" DescriptionListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<IdentifiedStockID>XXXXX</IdentifiedStockID>-<Description actionCode="02">-<Description languageCode="EN">YYYYYYYYYY</Description>-</Description>-</IdentifiedStockMaintainBundle>-</n0:IdentifiedStockMaintainRequestMessage>-(where XXXXX represents the Identified Stock ID and YYYYYYYYYY represents the Identified Stock Description)-Keywords-Identified stock, Migration of Identified Stock, ManageIdentifiedStocksIn, Identified Stock Description

Title: Cannot View Attachments When Approving Shopping Carts
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 3415707***-You cannot find attachments when approving a shopping cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Find approval task: Approve Shopping Cart ABC (ABC refers to the shopping cart ID).-Although shopping cart ABC has a attachment, in the OWL, the content of attachment column is blank.-Open the approval task itself, you cannot find the attachment as well.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior. Attachments are not contained in the approval tasks for business documents in SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-In order to view the attachment, the approver needs to open the original documents.-Open the approval task for shopping cart ABC, click on the blue link for shopping cart ABC.-Click View All button on the top right.-Navigate to Attachments tab, you can see the attachments here.-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Approval Task, Attachment

Title: Error Message: “Identified stock ID XXXXX already exists for the product YYYYY; enter new ID” While Migrating the Identified Stock
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate Identified Stock for Products, but you receive the below error during the Simulation step:-Identified stock ID XXXXX already exists for the product YYYYY; enter new ID-*XXXXX represents the Identified Stock ID-*YYYYY represents the Product ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Identified Stock-Select Migrate identified stock using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step-Cause-Identified Stock ID: XXXXX with status Active/ In Preparation already exists for the Product ID: YYYYY-You may verify using the below steps:-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center-Go to Identified Stock view-Search for the Identified Stock ID: XXXXX-Resolution-Correct the data in the Migration File and proceed with the migration activity.-Keywords-Identified stock, Migration of Identified Stock, Warehousing and Logistics Master Data

Title: Expected values not there in Field Planned Work (Project Task) against a Team Member in Report Revenue byTeam Member
Content: Symptom-Report Revenue by Team Member does not give values as expected for field Planned work against a particular Team member-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The report Revenue by Team Member was designed to provide information about actual costs for each team member and about invoicing- of these costs.-Resolution-Each work package is assigned to some employee and there are can be several work packages under a project task .-Often only one work package would be there for a service project task and project task would be created without employee assignment and then several employees can make time recordings for this work package.-Where there is no any planned work per employee (even if some planned work has been entered on the project task level cause its not applicable for one employee).-So planned work cannot be derived in all existing cases and hence we show only summary of planned work on the project task level. I.e.for all employees involved in the work under a certain project task the same summary project task planned / actual/ remaining work is shown in this report- Planned / actual / remaining work is presented only on the project task level (this is also reflected in the names of the corresponding key figures: for example Planned Work (Project Task)).-Keywords-Report Revenue by Team Member,Planned Work (Project Task),Planned Work

Title: Error Appears While Posting Credit Memo Document
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post the credit memo document and system shows the below error message.-Example: Total gross amount missing; calculated amount is 656,71 EUR ; The balance is not equal zero: -656,71 EUR. The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts. You need to adjust these amounts so that the balance is zero-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view -Select the relevant Credit Memo document-Select Check and system shows the error message-Cause-The Tax Payable amount does not match the Tax Receivable amount. You can check this from the below steps;-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view -Select the relevant Credit Memo document-Navigate to General tab and sub tab Taxes-Under Tax Details section, you can check that the amounts differ-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the Credit Memo document-Go to the General tab and then the Taxes sub-tab-Change one tax amount to zero and press Enter-The taxes are recalculated and Payables equals to Receivables-The status of the invoice is Ready for Posting and Post the Credit Memo-Keywords-Total gross amount missing; calculated amount, The total gross amount differs from the sum, Balance 0,010000 Euro of the invoice is bigger than permitted

Title: Confirmation of Input Products not Visible in Production Tasks
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm a Production Task XYZ (XYZ represents the Production Task ID), but the Input products are not visible during the confirmation process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Select the Make Task XYZ.-Click on the Confirm button.-In the Confirm screen, navigate to the Confirmation Tab and choose the Input Products sub-tab.-You do not see any Input Products in this screen.-Cause-The behavior of the system is that the Input Products are visible only during the Confirmation of last Make task. If you require the Confirmation of Input Products at each Operation, please choose the Insert Mark option and select the Reporting Point checkbox. This should be done after each Operation in the Bill of Operations of the relevant Production Model. With this, you can confirm the Input Products at each Operation level.-Resolution-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Go to the Production Models View.-Show relevant Production Model ABC (ABC represents the Production Model ID).-Navigate to the Bill of Operations tab.-Navigate to the BoO Structure sub tab.-Select the relevant Operation OPE (OPE represents the Operation ID)-Click on the Insert button, and select 'Insert Mark'.-Maintain the Mark ID, and check the Reporting Point checkbox.-Save your changes.-Click Check Consistency button.-Release Production Model if the consistency check is positive, else correct the Inconsistency and Release again.-Keywords-Make Task, Input Products, Missing, empty, Production Task

Title: Values Are Not Showing In The Report
Content: Symptom-The report is not going to display any data or value.-For example: Few projects are not available in the report.-Environment-SAP Business by Desing-Reproducing the Issue-Execute any report and you see few values are missing.-Cause-If the user has a below Key Figure Settings then the report will not show the values if those values are Initial/Zero.-Suppress When All Values Equal Zero: For key figures, columns or rows containing zero values are not displayed.-Suppress When All Results Equal Zero: Result rows or result columns containing zero values are not displayed-Example: Project key figure values are Zero.-Resolution--Change the Key Figure Settings as Do Not Suppress-Go to Show Settings -> Key Figure-Now go to General Settings-Under section Zero Suppression-Change to Do Not Suppress-Keywords-Reports-No data-No values

Title: Recurring Invoices are not Created
Content: Symptom-Recurring Invoices were created successfully earlier but has stopped now. And even though now you create new Recurring Invoices runs the Invoices are still not created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Recurring Invoices view.-Select an active document.-Under details go to Invoice History tab.-Where you don't see Invoices as per the recurrence pattern you maintained; There is no Invoices at all; Few Invoices were created later Invoices are not getting created.-Cause-Cause 1:-Since no job exists the invoices are not getting created.-If you have selected the job run and click on cancel job, since the job is canceled it will not be visible under All Scheduled jobs anymore.-or-While rescheduling the job, if you choose schedule immediately or use any other option other than 'Recurrence' option then also job gets completed and will not visible anymore.-Cause 2:-If job already exists as mentioned above then run date and time is not yet reached or occurred.-Resolution-For Cause 1:-Job run will get created again by system automatically the next day if this issue happens in Production tenant only.-Once the job is available ensure that you never cancel it or ensure to reschedule the job only using recurrence option to avoid this issue in the future.-Please raise incident if you face this issue in test, development or demo tenant and we will create a job in backend manually.-For Cause 2:-Steps to check whether the job exists or not:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Background Jobs view.-Filter for All Scheduled Jobs.-Search for job run with description Recurring Invoice for All Buyers.-Steps to check Next start date/time of the run:-Go to application user management.-Go to  background jobs view.-Select Recurring invoicing for all buyers.-You see that it has date and time  of next job run.-The time zone is same as what you have set under personalize settings.- Steps to reschedule the Job run:-Go to Application User Management work center.-Go to Background Jobs view.-Select Recurring Invoices for All Buyers click on Reschedule button.-Choose checkbox Recurrence.-Enter date as next day and time as 00:30 in UTC (convert time 00:30 in UTC to your time zone same as your personalize settings and enter the time).-Or enter current date  and any time for example 5 mins more than your current time so that you will only have to wait for only 5 mins for the job run to happen.-See Also-2910570 - Error message:Creation date of next invoice is before current date-2135564 - Supplier Invoice not Created From A Recurring Invoice Maintained-Keywords-Recurring  Invoice, Invoice Job Not Appearing, Background Job Disappeared, Recurring invoices are highlighted in pink, Creation Date of Next Invoice

Title: To Generate Multiple Outbound Deliveries for a Single Pick Task using Split Quantities and Late Delivery Split
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to Confirm Partial quantity with Late Delivery split  and Split quantities in a Pick Task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In order to generate multiple outbound deliveries for a single pick task  by making use of  Late Delivery split  and Split quantities functionality-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Task Control View-Search for  Pick Task XYZ (XYZ refers to pick task no)-Select Confirm-Enter the Actual quantity (normally lesser than the planned quantity)-Select Split quantities, a new sub line item generates for the remaining quantity-Select a Sub line item and select Late Delivery Split-Select Save-A new Outbound delivery generates for the partial quantity confirmed, Now for the remaining quantity  Upon Confirmation of task a new Outbound delivery would be generated-Keywords-Multiple Outbound deliveries from Pick task, Late Delivery Split and Split quantities, Multiple Outbound Deliveries for a Single Pick Task using Split Quantities

Title: Not Receiving E-Mail Notifications for the Subscribed Tasks
Content: Symptom-You have subscribed to a task, but noticed that the e-mail notifications are not coming to the e-mail address you have maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Inbox view.-Select Subscribe to Tasks button.-Tick the checkbox for the tasks.-But the user XYZ is not receiving the e-mail notification (XYZ represents the name of the user executing this process).-Cause-E-mail notification is available only for the person responsible for this task. Since the user XYZ is not the person responsible for this task, they will not receive e-mail notification.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-subscribe to task, e-mail notification, not receiving

Title: Field Delivery Id  Value does not get Populated in Task Control Object Work List for a Pick Task Although Outbound Delivery is Generated
Content: Symptom-Delivery id Field value does not get populate for Pick Task DEF(DEF refers to Pick Task id) in Task Control Object Work List although respective Outbound delivery PQR(PQR refers to Outbound delivery id) is generated and Pick Task status is Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for Task DEF-You observe Pick Task DEF Field Delivery id value does not populate although Pick task status is finished and Outbound delivery PQR is generated.-Cause-In the Object Work List of Task Control, we only have the option to show just one Delivery ID even if many exist.-System assigns the outbound delivery associated with the first line item in the task.-Resolution-If the 1st line item of task is not fulfilled at all i.e 0 quantity,  then the ID remains blank.This is the Standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Field Delivery id is blank although Outbound delivery is generated, Pick Task Delivery id field value is blank in Task Control OWL

Title: Withholding Tax code determination- india
Content: Symptom-Withholding tax details are not populating under Withholding tax details tab in the supplier invoice document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit & navigate to Items tab-Select sub tab Taxes and then Withholding Tax Details-No Withholding Tax details are calculated-Cause-Withholding tax requires either tax number type of the 7 - Permanent Account Number or 5 - Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number to be maintained at tax authority level. Since no tax number have been maintained for tax number type 5 or 7 the withholding tax is not calculated-Resolution-You have to add the tax number types 7 - Permanent Account Number or 5 - Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number in the Tax Authority of the company and system will calculate the withholding taxes. To do so;-Go to the Tax Management work center-Go to the Tax Authority view and select the Company Tax Arrangements-Select the relevant Company and Edit-Navigate to Company Tax Arrangements tab and select sub tab Tax Numbers-Select Add Row & add Tax Number Type with 5 or 7-See Also- KBA:1817674 - Withholding Tax not Calculated Automatically-Keywords-Withholding Tax not appearing; Withholding tax not calculated; WTH not populating,Withholding Tax empty,  withholding tax not calculated, tax code not determined automatically,With holding tax

Title: Compare Operator for Custom Field in Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom field in cloud application studio. When edit condition in approval process for the field, only 'Contains' or 'Does not contain' are available in the Compare Operator drop down list.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-You have created a custom field in cloud application studio. The field is created at item level; the type of the field is numeric, such as Quantity or Amount.-Go to Administrator work center.-Go to Approval Processes work center view.-Select and Edit the Approval Process of the business object which contains the custom field.-In Conditions section, click on Edit Condition button.-In Field drop down list, select the custom field.-In Compare Operator drop down list, only 'Contains' or 'Does not contain' are available, while you expect 'Greater than', 'Less than' or 'Equal to' here.-Cause-The reason for which the operators such as 'Grater than', 'Less than' or 'Equal to' does not come up in the condition editor is because this attribute is created at the item level. Item is usually at a many association from the root. For attributes of such type ( [] - collection type ), only 'Contains' and 'Does not contain' are supported. It is not possible to compare a collection of values against a single value and this is not supported by the framework for evaluation as well.-Resolution-For the custom field created at item level (collection type attributes) only 'Contains' and 'Does not contain' are supported when Edit Condition in Approval Process for the field. This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-compare operator, contains, custom field, approval process, conditions

Title: System Triggers Material Flow Warning Messages While Performing Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You are trying to receive an Inbound Delivery from a Purchase Order, but when you click the Post Goods Receipt button, you receive warning messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Find and select the relevant Purchase Order.-Select the Post Goods Receipt button.-The system displays the below messages:- Action processed with warnings.- Determination of destination inventory failed for product KLM (KLM refers to the product id).- Sequence determination result for item X (X refers to the line item no) is missing.- Inventory in logistics area not available.- Determination of destination inventory failed for product KLM.- Sequence determination result for item X is missing.- Inventory in logistics area not available- Sequence determination result for item X is missing.-Cause-Material Flow is not maintained appropriately for the Site XYZ (XYZ refers to Site ID).-Resolution-You have to maintain the Material Flow settings for the relevant Site. Please follow the steps below to maintain the Material Flow settings:-Navigate to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Search for the relevant Site.-Select the Edit button.-Navigate to the Material Flow tab.-Navigate to the Destination sub-tab.-Maintain Logistics Area, Line Number and the Put-Away Strategy.-Select Save.-Keywords-Determination of destination inventory, Inventory in logistics area not available, Sequence determination result, Inventory in logistics area not available , Sequence determination result for item

Title: How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Click in View All button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the item line which is of type project based items like Service - fixed price (project), Service - time and material (project), etc.-You can see that the Reason for Rejection is no longer editable.-Cause-Cause 1: -The Sales Order cannot be canceled if it is invoiced or it is delivery finished. The Reason for rejection field of the sales order item could be set/editable only if the invoicing status is Not Started and delivery is not Finished.-Cause 2: -The Delivery status is finished as the relevant project tasks has the status Closed or Completed, you have to revoke the closure for the project and cancel the sales order.-Resolution-Resolution for Cause 1:-To revoke the Invoice status, you have to make Invoice Status as Not Started for that you have to cancel the follow-up documents like project invoice request and customer invoice.-To revoke the Delivery status, you need to edit the referenced project task, change the status back to Release by selecting Revoke Close/Completion.-Once these are done, the Reason for Rejection field will be enabled, and you can maintain a value to cancel the line.-If you want to cancel the entire sales order then you have to revert all the items Invoice Status as Not Started.-Please note, that are not able to revoke the completion status in project tasks if there are Project Invoice Requests with the status In Preparation. In this case you will have to delete these Project Invoice Requests first or Invoice them.-Resolution for Cause 2:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Find relevant project.-Go to Project Plan tab then select the Revoke Closure/revoke completion in Project Status.-Ensure the status of project task is released-Save.-After this, we expect the delivery status of the sales order to be in 'Not started' status ,so you can set the Reason for Rejection on item level of the sales order,and finish the Customer Invoice to complete the sales order.-Once done you can complete/close the project using same steps by selecting complete/close in Project status.-See Also-For cancellation of non-project based items in Sales Order, please refer to KBA 1755905 - You are not able to Cancel a Sales Order-Keywords-Project, Sales Order, Reason for Rejection, Revoke Closure

Title: Error Encountered when Delivery Date is changed to 31.12.9999 in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In New Purchase Order, When we enter the delivery date as 31.12.9999 and select Check, error message encountered:-End date must be after start date. Enter a new date for the delivery date, service period, or expense period for the selected item-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Common Task New Purchase Order-Enter all necessary details-Under Item Details, enter Delivery date as 31.12.9999-Error: End date must be after start date. Enter a new date for the delivery date, service period, or expense period for the selected item-Cause-When a Delivery Date(mapped to Start Date) is entered by user, we derive the Delivery End Date by adding 1 day to it(Considering- the Delivery Period of 24 Hrs).-In the reported usecase, since the Start Date itself is selected as 31.12.9999, the End Date calculation value is discarded, and the said error is thrown on Check.-Resolution-Enter a realistic date. Maximum date can be 30.12.9999-Keywords-Delivery Date-Purchase Order-

Title: Confirmed Quantity of Input Products is Higher Than the Planned Quantity for a Production Task
Content: Symptom-You have completed a Production Task and realized that the Confirmed Quantity for the Input Products is higher than the initial Planned Quantity.-Although you have confirmed a higher quantity for the Output Product, your expectation is the quantity for Input Products to remain unchanged no matter the confirmed quantity for the Output Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Select the Task ABC (ABC represents the Task ID).-Select the tab Input Products.-You can see that the Confirmed Quantities for all Input Products are higher than the Planned Quantity.-Cause-The issue is caused by a missing configuration in the Bill of Materials (BoM) for the Output Product.-When configuring the BoM, the flag Fixed Quantity is not checked. In order to ensure that the quantity of Input Products is not changed during the production, this indicator must be checked.-Resolution-To activate the Fixed Quantity indicator, a change must be done in the Bill of Materials (BoM).-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Bill of Materials view.-Find and select the BoM XYZ (XYZ represents the BoM ID) related to the production scenario you are executing.-Select Edit.-Go to the Input Products tab.-Select the desired Products and choose Change.-Check the box for Fixed Quantity.-Save the changes.-Please note that after changing the Bill of Materials, the Production Model must be released again for the changes to be activated during the production scenario.-Keywords-Fixed, Quantity, Indicator, Bill, of, Materials, BoM

Title: Howto handle Tax Details and  Withholding Tax Details in Recurring Invoice.
Content: Symptom-Where can we enter/change the Tax Details and Withholding Tax Details in Recurring Invoice?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When the supplier invoice is created out of the recurring invoice run the Tax Details and withholding tax details were filled by the system automatically.-Cause-The Tax Details and the Withholding tax details are taken from the Recurring Invoice Template-Resolution-Steps to enter and change the Tax Details and Withholding Tax Details in Recurring Invoice template.-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Choose the Recurring Invoices view-Find the Recurring Invoices and Edit-Navigate to the Step 6: Confirmation here you can see the hyperlink which says "Edit Invoice Template Details"-Choose this hyperlink it will open the  Invoice template where under Items table you can enter/change the Tax details and Withholding Tax details, the Tax code etc-Keywords-Recurring Invoice Template,Tax Details,Withholding Tax details-

Title: Multiple Selections not Possible in  Line Items of Post Goods Receipt Screen
Content: Symptom-When you try to select multiple line items in Post Goods Receipt screen,System would not allow you to perform the same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Purchase Orders View.-Search for Purchase Order DEF (DEF refers to Purchase Order id).-Select PO DEF and select Post Goods Receipt.-Navigate to Line items tab.-You observe that you will not be able to select multiple line items, However system allows only to select line item one by one.-Cause-The issue is that  Inbound User Interface screen is designed with Hierarchical list.-Resolution-Multiple selection is not possible with this design.This is a Limitation.-Keywords-Multiple selections not possible in  Line items of Post Goods Receipt screen,select multiple line items in Post Goods Receipt screen

Title: "The Address Data is Missing" Error Message for Inconsistent Third Party Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-Your Third Party Delivery Notification document has Consistency Status as Inconsistent. When you select the Check Consistency button system gives you the error message-"The address data is missing."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Order Fulfillment work center.-Navigate to the Third Party Delivery Notification view.-Search for the relevant third party delivery notification document which is Inconsistent.-Select it and choose the Edit button.-In the edit screen choose the button Check Consistency.-The above reported error message is displayed inspite of the fact that you have maintained address information for your Sender and Ship-To Party.-Cause-You have not maintained the Freight Forwarder information in the delivery notifiaction. Once you have maintained the Freight Forwarder information in the delivery notification document you will be able to make the document consistent.-Resolution-Go to Third Party Order Fulfillment work center.-Navigate to the Third Party Delivery Notification view.-Search for the relevant third party delivery notification document which is Inconsistent.-Select it and choose the Edit button.-In the field Freight Forwarder ID maintain the relevant freight forwarder information.-Choose the button Check Consistency.-You can see that the system does not display the error any more.-Keywords-TPOP notification error, TPOP inconsistency, Third party error, TPOP Error, inconsistent delivery notification, The Address Data is Missing

Title: Unable to Update Extension Fields Using Webservice DeliveryDespatchAdviceNotification
Content: Symptom-When you try to update the data/values for extension fields in Inbound/Supplier Delivery Notification via webservice DeliveryDespatchAdviceNotification, the values in the extension fields are not updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the Request XML for the webservice DeliveryDespatchAdviceNotification with relevant data for various key fields, extension fields in Inbound Delivery Notification.
