You will notice that the values in extension fields are not updated.-Cause-We cannot receive an extension field from the supplier and populate in Inbound Delivery Notification unless it is a customer return scenario.-We currently do not support this requirement.-Resolution-This is expected System Behavior-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification,  DeliveryDespatchAdviceNotification,  extension fields,  InboundDeliveryReplicationOut,  ManageCustomerReturnNotificationIn

Title: Unable to Delete or Edit Individual Material
Content: Symptom-While attempting to delete an individual material it's noticed that the IMAT is not linked to a fixed asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To find the individual material used in a purchase order account assignment:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Mark the relevant Purchase Order and choose Edit.-Choose View All and go to the Items tab.f-Go to the tab Account Assignment.-Find the Individual Material ID.-To find the Individual Material used in Supplier Invoice account assignment:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Mark the relevant supplier invoice and choose Edit.-Choose View All and go to the Items tab.-Go to the tab Account Assignment.-Find the Individual Material ID.-To check if the Individual Material is listed in the list of Fixed Assets:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Choose Show: All Fixed Assets.-Choose Advanced on the top right.-Enter the Individual Material ID as in the Purchase Order or Supplier Invoice.-Choose Go.-Error Message: No Fixed Asset is returned.-Cause-No deletions can be done on Material Data as they are considered as Master Data in the system and deletion might lead to data inconsistencies in Business Intelligence Reports, etc.-Resolution-As a workaround, the unwanted product can be kept in Blocked status so that it can't be used in any business process.--Steps to block a Product:-Go to the Product Data work center.-Select the Materials view.-Select the unwanted Material.-Click View All button.-Go to respective Business area tab (Purchasing and Sales).-Change the status from Active to Blocked.-If the IMAT is not showing in the results, create a case to SAP with permission to change the status to Blocked from backend.-See Also- 2747497 - How To Change the Status of an Individual Material in the Backend-Keywords-Fixed Assets, Individual Material ID,  Purchase order, Supplier Invoice.

Title: Automated Planning Run is Not Creating any Stock Transfer Proposals
Content: Symptom-You have created an Automated Planning Run in order to create proposals for all the products located in the Planning Area XYZ (XYZ represents the planning area ID). In addition, you have maintained Procurement Type as Internal Procurement for a product, however the Run is not creating any Stock Transfer Proposals.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Planning Runs, under Automated Actions view.-Select the desired Run.-Select the Schedule button.-Choose the option Single Run.-Enter a time and execute the run.-Go back to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Products view.-Select and open one the relevant products for the Planning Area XYZ. (XYZ represents the planning area ID).-See that no Stock Transfer Proposal is created.-Cause-There is no Transport Lane maintained for the Ship-To location corresponding to the planning area XYZ. Since the system is not able to find the Transport Lane as Source of Supply, it is not able to create Stock Transfer Proposal.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue it is necessary to maintain a Transport Lane for the Planning Area XYZ.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Transport Lanes view.-Select New.-Create the Transport Lane using the Ship-To site XYZ.-After performing these steps the Automated Planning Run will create the Proposals.-Keywords-automated, planning, run, not, creating, stock, transfer, proposal, internal, procurement, supply, planning

Title: Percentage Field is Disabled in Invoice Schedule tab in Sales Order for a Project
Content: Symptom-You are unable to enter the Percentage in Invoice Schedule sub-tab under Pricing and Invoicing tab on the Sales order screen for a project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-Select Sales Orders view-Navigate to Pricing and Invoicing tab-Select Invoice Schedule-The percentage field is disabled-Cause-The item type is not correctly assigned in the sales order-Resolution-The Item type in the sales order should be Service - fixed price(project) , only then you can distribute the percentage in the project for each milestone .-Under Invoice schedule, you can select Add date and distribute the percentage for the milestones.-Keywords-Invoice Schedule, Service - fixed price(project), Percentage distribution, Sales Order, Pricing and Invoicing

Title: Sales Order Missing in Supply Planning 'Product Planning Details'
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order XYZ  (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID) for a Product PPP (PPP represents the Product ID) which you currently do not have in your Warehouse, and have released the Sales Order to Logisitics Execution by forcing Confirmation, but when you go to the Supply Planning Work Center, and open the Product Planning Details view, you cannot find the Sales Order XYZ. As a result, the Customer Demand is not considered during a Planning Run, and hence no Proposal is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Find and select the Product PPP in the Planning Area MBA (MBA represents the Planning Area ID).-Click the Open button.-You can see that the Sales Order XYZ is missing in the Supply and Demand List. -Cause-Currently, you have set up the system to consider the Confirmation Date of the Sales Order during Material Planning. As the Sales Order XYZ did not get confirm (red traffic light), therefore it is not considered for Material Planning. To have the system consider this Demand for Material Planning, you must change the System Configuration to consider the Requirement Date instead.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your Implementation Project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to step 4 Questions by clicking the Next button-Expand the Scoping element ‘Supply Chain Planning and Control’.-Expand ‘Supply Planning’.-Select ‘Material Planning’.-On the right side of the screen, please check under the Group: Planning Date (2) the question ‘Do you want to consider the requirement date of the sales order during material planning?’. Please note that the question ‘Do you want to consider the confirmation date of the sales order during material planning?’ will be deselected through this action.-Save your changes.-Keywords-Supply, And, Demand, Matching, Sales, Order, Supply, Planning

Title: Project Time Recordings cannot be found in the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses View
Content: Symptom-The employee has perfomed the time recroding aganist project and these time cannot be found udner not invoiced time and expesnses view for invocing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Invoice Preparation view.-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Select the project ID and click on Edit Time and Expenses.-The same Time Recording is not available in this list.-Cause-The issue could have been caused by one of below case-Case 1 : The time recordings should be released Active/Approved status-Case 2 : The time recordings should have  Deleted or in Pending changes status-Case 3 : The time recording should be posted to accounting-You can check this under General Ledger -> Source Documents-Case 4 : For the posted time recording there should be a Customer Project Expense List created and posted to accounting-You can check this under General Ledger -> Source Documents-Case 5 : If everything looks fine then there should be backend issue for that you can also check the Process Communication error messages and create a incident to solve the issue.-Resolution-The system works as designed-Keywords-Project time entries-Project time recordings-not invoiced time and expense

Title: Blocked Product is Used in Project
Content: Symptom-Product is inactive for both purchasing and sales,but can still be used in Project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can use a material in the project as long as it is theoretically possible to buy, sell, or procure it from stock.--Since there is inventory master data maintained. Thus, you can still issue a consumption from stock using this material.-This is the standard system expected behavior.-Keywords-Product locked, Product blocked, Material blocked, Material locked,blocked material used in project

Title: Engineering Change Order Type Single Date Validity Order does Not allow to Change Valid From Date in Bill of Material
Content: Symptom-Unable to change the Valid from Date of Engineering Change Order  in Production Bill of Material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Product Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Production Bills of Material View.-Select XYZ (XYZ refers to BoM id).-Select Edit.-Navigate to Input Products tab.-Select ECO id KLM(KLM refers to ECO id).-Select View All.-Navigate to General tab.-We observe ECO Id KLM Valid from is grayed out to update.-Cause-As the ECO id KLM status is Completed, System will not allow us to change the Valid from Date, ECO id status should be  In-preparation to update the changes.-Resolution-In order to change the Valid from Date of the ECO id in Bill of Material, we need follow the below steps-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center-Navigate to View Engineering Change Orders-Select New-Select ECO type as Single-Date Validity Order, preceding ECO id-Also Fill in details like New ECO id DEF (DEF refers to New ECO id), Description, New Valid from Date(Date which need to be changed) which need to be incorprated in BoM-Select Save and Close-Select the same id created and select Edit-Navigate to Items tab-Click on Register Validity Update-Select Save and Close-Keywords-Engineering Change Order Type - Single-date Validity Order, Cannot Change Valid from Date in BoM, Single Date Validity Order does Not allow to Change Valid From Date in Bill of Material

Title: Error Message “Object currently locked by ABC; try again later” When Confirming a Put-Away Task
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message when trying to confirm the Put-Away task XXX saying that it is being locked by user ABC. However, the user ABC is confirming Put-Away task YYY.-XXX = Task ID.-YYY = Task ID.-ABC = User ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the task XXX.-Select the task XXX.-Choose Confirm.-You receive the error message:-Object currently locked by ABC; try again later-However, user ABC is confirming task YYY.-Cause-Put-away tasks XXX and YYY are for the same warehouse request. When processing a task, the user will acquire lock on the warehouse request instance to update it upon saving the task. The task XXX cannot acquire a lock on the same warehouse request instance in parallel, hence the locking error.-Resolution-This is the standard design in warehousing to avoid inconsistencies.-Keywords-Put-Away;-Task;-Lock;

Title: What is the Difference between 'Actual Delivery Date' and 'Actual Execution On' in the Put Away Task.
Content: Symptom-You want to know the difference between 'Actual Delivery Date' and 'Actual Execution On' in the put away task confirmation window.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Task Control View.-Show all and search Put Away Task ABC in not started status (ABC stands for Put Away Task ID).-Click Confirm.-Navigate to Administrative Information.-You can see 'Actual Delivery Date' and 'Actual Execution On'.-Cause-You want to know the difference between 'Actual Delivery Date' and 'Actual Execution On'.-Resolution-"Actual Execution On": The date at which the business document entry is made in the system.-By default, the Field 'Actual Execution On' will have the current date at which you have confirmed the warehouse task. But you can always edit it.-If the put away task is the first task of the inbound delivery notification, the 'Actual Delivery Date' shows the current date by default.-You can manually change 'Actual Delivery Date' to any past date. From the second task, the actual delivery date is carried from the same date maintained in the first task and cannot be changed.-"Actual Delivery Date": The date at which the delivery was physically done in the warehouse.-This date will be shown as the 'Business Transaction Date' in the warehouse confirmation and become the posting date of it.-The above functionality is provided as business flexibility since there would be scenarios when the business users would want to enter documents in the system for which the delivery has already been made on a later date.-Keywords-Put Away Task, Actual Delivery Date, Actual Execution On, Business Transaction Date

Title: Error message: Serial Numbers are not allowed for product XYZ
Content: Symptom-The below error occurs when creating an Outbound Delivery from a 3PL Request created for a Stock Transfer Order.-Error: Serial Numbers are not allowed for Product XYZ-(XYZ represents the Product ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center.-Go to 3PL Request view.-Search 3PL Request ABC (ABC represents the 3PL Request ID).-Choose New Outbound Delivery.-Go to line items tab.-In the Serial Number sub-tab, Enter Serial Number OPQ (OPQ represents the Serial Number).-Choose Check Consistency.-The error occurs,-Serial Numbers are not allowed for product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-Cause-The Serial Number Profile of Product XYZ is set to “Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers” in the Product Master Data.-The 3PL Request ABC is created for a Stock Transfer Order. Therefore, the preferred Serial Number Profile is “Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers, Suppliers and Sites.”-(XYZ represents the Product ID, ABC represents the 3PL Request ID)-Resolution-To maintain the Serial Number Profile to “Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers, Suppliers and Sites” follow the below steps:-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Materials view.-Search for the Product XYZ.-Choose Edit.-Choose View All.-In the General Tab, select Serial Number Profile as 'Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers, Suppliers and Sites'.-Choose Save.-(XYZ represents the Product ID)-Keywords-3PL Request; 3PL Outbound Delivery; Serial Number; Error message: Serial Numbers Are Not Allowed For Product; ByDesign; Serial Number Profile; Stock Transfer Order

Title: Cannot Accept Deviation for Purchase Order Acknowledgement
Content: Symptom-You cannot accept deviation for purchase order acknowledgement, system raises errors:-Saving of purchase order changes not possible; changes inconsistent.-No result returned by external provider.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center, Purchase Orders view.-Open purchase order ABC, you see there is a open task in the header:-Check Deviating Purchase Order Acknowledgment-Open the task, click accept deviation, system raises errors:-Saving of purchase order changes not possible; changes inconsistent.-No result returned by external provider.-Cause-Please check if you are using SSL certificate as the authentication method in the communication arrangement for Vertex.-If yes, exception comes in reading password class because the password field is empty.-Resolution-Please follow below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center, Communication Arrangements view.-Find the communication arrangement for Vertex.-Change the authentication method to User ID and Password and provide the user name and password there.-After it please try to accept deviation again, the error messages will disappear.-Keywords-Accept Deviation, Purchase Order Acknowledgement, Vertex

Title: Error Appears When User Changes Ship-To Location in an Ordered Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have sent purchase order document and received an acknowledgment from the supplier. Now user want to change the Site for this order and system shows an error message-Error:-Item 1: Ship-to location not valid for receiving site-Item 1: Ship-to location not assigned to receiving site-Determination of tax code failed- or- You may face same error in Supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Navigate to Items tab and select sub tab Delivery-Change Ship-To details and error message appears-Cause-Once the purchase order is sent to your supplier the system will not allow you to change the Site to which the product should be delivered.-The Ship-To location can be changed if a site have multiple Ship-To locations under it.-The reason why system does not allow the change site is because once the purchase order is sent to your supplier, the system will update and create various planning objects related to the site. If you change the site for an already sent line item to supplier planning related inconsistencies might occur. This will impact your product planning details the MRP and your ATP as well-Resolution-You can copy the line item for which you have to change the Site for and change the site and Ship-To location for the new copied line item. You can cancel the older line item and send the update of changed purchase order to your supplier. This will help update your planning side with the correct information related to the change in Site as well.-  or-Ensure to make changes with ship to in Purchase order and then you can void the invoice and create new invoice so that changes will reflect in it.-Keywords-Ship-to location not assigned to receiving site,Ship-to location not valid for receiving site

Title: Ship-To Location Not Defaulted While Creating Customer Return Notification For Third Party Order Processing
Content: Symptom-When you create New Customer Return Notification with Delivery Type as Third Party, Ship-to Location does not get updated by default. However, it gets updated if delivery type is Standard.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Choose New Customer Return Notification subview.-In section: Outbound Delivery Data, choose Delivery Type as Third Party via drop down.-Choose Go.-Select the required Delivery ID.-Navigate to next guided activity i.e. Edit Customer Return Delivery Notification.-Here you can see under section: Organizational Information, Ship-to Location is not defaulted automatically.-Cause-In case of Third Party Order Processing, there is no Ship-From Location exists, hence Ship-to Location is not defaulted.-However, with Delivery type as Standard process, Ship-to Location is proposed as the Ship-from Location defaulted of the Outbound Delivery.-Resolution-This is an Expected System behavior.-Keywords-Ship-to Location ,Inbound Logistics, New Customer Return Notification, Third Party Order Processing

Title: Approval Notes missing in the Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-The approval notes are missing in the sales documents(Sales Quote, Sales Order) even though you added the note while approving the document.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Manage My Area workcenter.-Go to Approvals View.-Show Open Tasks and select the approval task for the Sales Quote XXX(XXX is the ID of the Sales Quote).-Click on Actions Button and Select Add Notes option and add a internal note.-Now select Actions Button again and select the option Open Details.-In the new tab, navigate to notes tab and enter a text.-You expect both the notes which you added in the above steps to be present in the Sales Quote XXX.-Cause-This is system standard behavior. The Notes added in the Overview screen of the Approvals View in Manage My Area workcenter are the internal notes for the BTM task created for Approval of Sales Document and these notes will not be present in Sales Document.-Resolution-If you want to add the approval note which should be visible in the Sales document then please follow the below steps-Go to Manage My Area workcenter.-Go to Approval View-Show Open Tasks and select the approval task for the Sales Quote XXX(XXX is the ID of the Sales Quote).-Click on Edit Button and in the new screen, add the note in the empty text tab and Click on Approve.-The note added as per step 4 will be visible in the Sales Document-Keywords-Approval note missing, Approval note missing in sales quote;

Title: Effective Quantity In Confirmation Journal is Zero
Content: Symptom-You see that an entry against in your Confirmation Journal report has Effectlive Quantity value as Zero.-Environment-Business ByDesign Productive and Test Systems-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center-Navigate to the Reports view and choose the Lists option.-Select the report Confirmation Journal-Enter the relevant information like Product, Site etc.-Choose the Apply button to query the information.-You see that for a few line entries the system has displayed Effective Quantity value as Zero.-Cause-You will see Effective Quantity as Zero for Journal Entries in your confirmation journal document. If we take the example of warehouse confirmation documents, we see that the stock is reduced from the relevant logistics area, Stock Type: Logistics Area and moved Stock Type: Goods Issue. The Stock Type varies depending on the Conf.Document Type-For eg: If 2 qty is being delivered 2 qty will be reduced from Logistics Area and 2 qty will be added to Goods Issue. This means (+)2 will move into Stock Type Goods Issue and (-)2 will move out from  Stock Type Logistics Area. Effective quantity will be the total of this movement which is Zero.-If you want to see the movement of the movement of stock in the above described manner please add field Stock Type(mandatory) and Logistics Area ID(optional) in the Row Fields area of the confirmation journal report. This will split the Effective Quantity into the quantites moving in and out of Goods Issue and Logistics Area. Since both the movements happen for the same confirmation ID the effective quantity will be Zero.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-confirmation journal issue, confirmation journal error, zero quantity in confirmation journal, quantity missing in confirmation jounral

Title: Order Date Maintained in Purchase Order Migration Template is not Visible in the Purchase Oder under General Tab
Content: Symptom-The Ordered Date Time and its Time zone which is available to fill in Purchase Order Migration Template is for the 'Ordered Date Time' at PO Header level. But it's not available in the PO.- And the Order on date field appearing under Item tab->Basic details of PO Edit screen is not available in Migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This field though stored in backend, is NOT exposed on the UI currently- General Tab of the PO Edit screen. So you can make it visible in the Output forms through adobe lifecycle designer mapping of fields.-However ,the Item's Ordered On date is the date when migration has happened and not related to the 'Order Date' in Migration Template's General Tab.-Resolution-If you think you will require this field to be available in the PO general Tab or you want the item level field to appear in migration template  then-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Cloud for Customer/ SAP Business ByDesign.--1.  If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-2.  If you are a customer:-Contact your the Account Executive-Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-        ByD : An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886- Remark : If you received the feedback that PDI Implementation is not possible then only “check the […] Ideas Forum to submit an idea…” is relevant.-Keywords-Order date, Order on date

Title: Supplier Default From Catalogs While Creating Shopping Carts
Content: Symptom-You are creating new shopping cart & select the products using catalogs. You transfer the items from catalog and system defaults the supplier information automatically in to the shopping cart-Environment-1802-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services & select Self-Services Overview-Select the link Go Shopping (Advanced) under Shopping-Enter the Requester details and select Next to choose products from catalogs-Select the relevant Catalog and select the items-Select Transfer Selected Items and navigate to Edit Shopping Cart step-Here you can see that Supplier and Preferred Supplier details are filled-Cause-You have maintained the supplier details in the Define Catalog Defaults screen under Product Portfolio work center and hence system defaults the supplier information-You can go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Common Tasks view-Select Define Catalog Defaults-Resolution-For each catalog, you can define a supplier and a product category to be used in your business documents, if no such data is provided by the catalog. If the Catalog field is left blank, it acts like a wildcard. The system always uses the first matching entry that it finds, so ensure that the row with the wildcard is the last entry in the list. You can remove the supplier details, in case if you do not want system to default the supplier-Keywords-Supplier details filled automatically to shopping cart, supplier filled in shopping cart

Title: Error Appears While Posting Supplier Invoice / Credit Memo Document
Content: Symptom-Error appears while posting supplier invoice / credit memo document-Error - Post not possible; document blocked-Environment-1802-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Post & system shows the error message-Cause-Accountant has blocked the Supplier Invoice / Credit Memo document & hence the error message appears-Resolution-You can unblock and post the supplier invoice / credit memo document-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Go to Actions & select Unblock-Keywords-Post not possible; document blocked

Title: Automatic Proposal of Identified Stock in Pick Task
Content: Symptom-In the Confirm Pick Task screen, no value is populated in the Identified Stock field, even though the product is marked for mandatory Identified Stock selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search and select the Pick task DEF (where DEF is the relevant pick task).-Choose the Confirm button.-In the confirm pick task screen, Identified Stock field is not getting auto-populated.-Cause-Allocation Scope value has not been maintained for the logistics area from which the relevant product is being picked.-This configuration is necessary for the system to propose identified stock automatically. -Resolution-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Choose the relevant Site and select the Edit Layout.-Select the logistics area in which system should propose identified stock automatically in the Site Layout screen.-In the General tab, under the header Inventory-Managed Details, choose the value in the field Allocation Scope as "Specific Stock".-Choose Save and Close.-Once the above settings are maintained for a logistics area the system will propose identified stock automatically, provided proper material flow rules are maintained for the relevant site. This set up will work for Supply Tasks as well.-See Also-Logistics Source and Destination Services - Documentation-Keywords-identified stock proposal, system propose identified stock, assign identified stock automatically, propose identified stock automatically, supply task pick up identified stock automatically-identified stock automatic proposal,auto assign identified stock,assign identified stock automatically,assign istock automatically,istock proposal issue

Title: How to Change/Maintain the Withholding Tax Code in the Recurring Invoices?
Content: Symptom-The supplier invoices which are created out of recurring invoice run, already contains withholding tax details and you are unable to change it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Recurring Invoices-Select Runs-Create a run for free text items-Invoice created out of the run contains withholding tax-Cause-The withholding tax code was already maintained in the Invoice Template before the run started which was later assigned to the invoices created from the run.-If you wish to add/remove the tax code, you can do it in this template.-Resolution-Once the Recurring Invoice is released, there is a hyperlink which says "Edit Invoice Template Details" in Confirmation stage( Step 6 ).-Upon clicking on the same , this would open an Invoice template and under Items -> Taxes ->WithHolding Tax details, the Tax code can be maintained.-Keywords-Withholding tax code, recurring invoice run, supplier invoice

Title: The Amounts for Different Product Categories are Not Aggregated to Expense and Root evels in Report
Content: Symptom-In “Monitoring Suppliers” report , when trying to get report for a certain supplier, you found  that in some cases, the amounts-from different product categories do not aggregate to EXPENSE and ROOT levels, but works for some suppliers-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select Design Reports view-Search for "Monitoring invoices" Report-Choose view "Supplier dependency per Product Category"-The Amounts for Different Product Categories are Not Aggregated to EXPENSE and ROOT levels for few Suppliers-Cause-The net amount does not aggregate because the product category being used in number of Supplier Invoices have different currencies.-Resolution-Please maintain the same Unit of Measurement in order to get aggregate of the net amount of all Product Categories-Keywords-Supplier Invoice Net Amount-Montioring Invoices Report-Product Categories-UOM

Title: Project is still Showing up in the "Not Invoiced Time and Expenses" view even though Expense Items are Written Off
Content: Symptom-You have closed the project and written off the expenses. But the project is still showing up in the "Not Invoiced Time and Expenses" view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.-Go to the Invoice Preparation: Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Select respective Project ID and select "Edit Time and Expenses".-You can see the written-off time and expense items shown in "Not invoiced time and expenses".-Cause-If you filter with "Modified View - All Customer Projects with Unassigned Expenses", it will always display the project even if it is closed or expenses written off.-But system will throw error if you try to post the invoice request. This is the standard behavior.-This option is given because there are many customers who will have both actuals and written off expenses. So, the project will show up in this view to allow them to create invoice for both actual and written off values. The actuals will only be billed but written off values will also show up in the invoice.-Resolution-Please use filter "My Active Customer Projects",so that only active projects will come up.-See Also-Keywords-Not Invoiced Time and Expenses, Projects, All Customer Projects with Unassigned Expenses, written off expense

Title: Output Form Not Displaying in Newly Added Language
Content: Symptom-Output form of newly created form template which was created with newly added language is not displaying in that Language.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Find the Respective form template in language English.-Click on Copy button and choose As new variant.-Choose the newly added language.-Enter all other details and click on save.-You will notice that Form does not display any details in the language you have chosen.-Cause-For Non localized languages (added  through  Business Configuration Activity Additional Communication Languages)there is no predefined language translation that would display in out put forms.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Find the Respective form template for language English.-Download it and translate it in Adobe LiveCyle Designer and save it.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Find and select the same form chosen earlier as mentioned in the above steps.-Click on Upload button and choose As New Variant.-In pop up screen select the language you translated the form to.-Once you enter all necessary details and click on the save button.-  Keywords-Language is wrong in the output form, Language incorrect in form, Wrong language, incorrect language, Form template not displaying correct language, new template, Non localized language,Additional Communication Languages,New template related output form

Title: The Open Purchase Order quantity is  showing incorrectly in migrated Purchase Order in Inbound Logistics
Content: Symptom-Purchase orders were migrated and delivered quantity was entered for some orders in the migration template.-However, when we look into the purchase order in the tenant, open purchase order quantity is still the full amount of the purchase order without the reduction of delivered quantity.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center-View Purchase Orders-Select Open purchase orders-Search for relevant Purchase Order-You can see the open purchase order quantity is as it is for all items even though some quantity was delivered-Cause-As it is migrated Purchase order, the inbound side will not have any information about the delivered quantity and hence on 'inbound logistics' screen-the open purchase order quantity will not change-Resolution-Please create the Inbound delivery for rest of the open quantity in the migrated tenant and then manually finish the purchase order-Keywords-Migrated Purchase Order-Inbound Logistics-Delivered Quantity

Title: How To Change The UI Client That Opens From An E-Mail Subscription Link
Content: Symptom-You are using the E-mail subscription and the link from the e-mail is directing to Silverlight and you would like to be directed to HTML5.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The link constructed in the subscription mail is already smart to handle this. The link will redirect you to the client ( SL or HTML5 ) depending upon the default client configuration in the system. If the default client is SL then the link will open the system in SL client or vice versa.-Resolution-In case you would like to change it, you can change the default client under company settings to the desired UI.-Keywords-E-mail Subscription; Change Link

Title: Service Agents are Unable to Record Time for Project
Content: Symptom-Service agent User1 (User1 refers to service agent name) is unable to record times for the project X (X refers to project ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select Edit Time Sheet view.-Search for the project task.-The project is not available to perform time recording.-Cause-The service agent is unable to proceed with project time recording because the service agent's supplier is maintained as PQR (PQR refers to Supplier ID) and not updated to the current supplier. Since for intercompany projects the user will be a service agent. Thus, the system picks up the supplier PQR  for which the user is made a service agent.-Resolution-Change the supplier for the affected service agent and then reassign them to the project. Once this is done, the supplier will be updated and the service agent will be able to do the time recording correctly for the project. Please follow the below steps to change the supplier of the service agent:-Go to Project Management work center-Select Service Agents view-Search for the user User1-Now click Edit and change the supplier-Save and Close.-Keywords-Service agent time recording, project time recording, service agent project time recording, unable to record time for project

Title: Logistics Area Types Missing When Creating or Editing a Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You have created a Logistics Area ABC (ABC represents the Logistics Area ID) under Location XYZ (XYZ represents the Location ID). Now you are trying to edit the Logistics Area, and when you select the value help for the field 'Logistics Area Type', there is no other option available except ‘Warehouse’. You expect the system to display other Logistics Area Types like Production Area, Receiving Area, Shipping Area, and Storage Area, but only Warehouse is visible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to the Locations view.-Find and select the Location ID XYZ.-Click the Edit Layout button.-Select Logistics Area ABC.-Under the General tab, you can see that the Logistics Area Type is Warehouse. If you click on the value selection button to change the type, you can see that no other option is available for selection except Warehouse. You expect to be able to select other Logistics Area Types for the Logistics Area.-Cause-In Project Scoping, you have not checked the Question – ‘Do you have warehouses with bin management?’ in Business Configuration work center. You have to activate the Question – ‘Do you have warehouses with bin management?’ to resolve the issue.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation Project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Now, navigate to the Questions Phase of the Project Scope.-Select and expand the Scoping Element - 'Supply Chain Setup Management'.-Expand ‘Execution Design’ under Supply Chain Setup Management, and select 'Warehouse and Production Layout'.-On the Right Side, you can see the Questions for Warehouse and Production Layout.-Please activate the question ‘Do you have warehouses with bin management?’ under ‘Bin Management in Warehouse and Production Layout(2)’ by selecting the check box.-You will notice that once the aforesaid check box is selected, the following groups also get pre-selected: Staging areas, Bulk areas, Picking zones and so on.-Save your changes.-Now you should be able to select other Logistics Area Types.-Keywords-Logistics Area Types, Warehouse, Staging areas, Bulk areas, Picking zones, Bin Management in Warehouse and Production Layout

Title: Automatic Release Of Check Pending Production Models
Content: Symptom-You have a large number of Production Models in your system with the status Check Pending. You do not want to release all of them manually. You want the system to release the productions models automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-2. Navigate to the Production Models view.-3. You have a large number of production models available in this view with the Execution-Consistency Status and Planning-Consistency Status as Check Pending.-Cause-You can create a Production Model Run, in which you can select the option to make all inconsistent production models to consistent provided there are no errors in the production model.-Resolution-1. Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-2. Navigate to the Production Model Release Run view.-3. Select the button New, enter values in the mandatory fields and in the field Production Model Mass Release Options select the radio button All Check Pending & Inconsistent.-4. Choose the button Next to select the check pending and inconsistent production models, select the Next button.-5. In the Review screen choose the button Finish to create the run.-You can schedule the above run as per your requirement and the system will release all the Production Models with Check Pending and Inconsistent status if they do not have any errors.-Keywords-automatic, release, check, pending, production, model, inconsistent

Title: Warning Message: Quantity Less Than Minimum Order Quantity in Contract
Content: Symptom-You receive warning message when creating new purchase order with reference to contract:-Quantity less than minimum order quantity in contract.-You can still release the purchase order ignoring the warning message, but you want to make the message as an error message to avoid the purchase order be released in this situation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders, open common task: New purchase order. -View all and fill all madatory fields.-Go to Item tab, add product ABC.-In the Source of supply subtab, assign a contract DEF. In contract DEF, the minimum order quantity is 10 ea for product ABC.-Go back to line item, input any quantity less than 10 ea for product ABC.-Click Check, you see the warning message: Quantity less than minimum order quantity in contract.-Click Order, you can still release the purchase order ignoring the warning message.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-In the current release, there is no setting to make the warning message convert to an error message and avoid purchase orders be released when the quantity is less than the minimum order quantity in contract.-Keywords-Purchase order, Contract, Minimum order quantity

Title: Field Follow-On Status Missing When Exporting Purchase Requests to Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You exported purchase requests to Microsoft Excel, but when you open the file, you find the field Follow-On Status is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Sort some purchase requests.-Click Export: To Microsoft Excel®.-Open the downloaded file, you find the field Follow-On Status is missing.-Cause-Follow-On Status cannot be exported.-Instead, there is another field, Follow up Doc Status on the same screen, which showing the same data as Follow-On Status field.-Resolution-Please entry Personalization mode, add Follow up Doc Status field to this screen and save. Then the same data can be exported.-Keywords-Purchase request, Follow-On Status, Microsoft Excel

Title: Error Message: Task Already Has A Work Package For This Team Member And Service.
Content: Symptom-In Project Plan-Work, you want to schedule work packages for same service and employee in different period.-But when creating the second work package for the same service and same employee, system raises error:-'Task already has a work package for this team member and service.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center, Projects view.-Open Project ABC, navigate to Project Plan, select task DEF.-Scroll down and go to subtab: Work, you can see Service GHI has been assigned to team member XYZ.-Add Row, select service as GHI, team member as XYZ, you see system raises error message:-'Task already has a work package for this team member and service.'-ABC means the Project ID.-DEF means the Project Task ID.-GHI means the Service ID.-XYZ means the Team Member name.-Cause-System does not allow multiple work packages for the same service and same employee under same project task.-To schedule work packages for same employee in different period, you need to edit period plan for the existing work package for the employee, rather than schedule a new work package.-Resolution-Go to Project Plan, subtab Work, select the existing work package for the employee.-Click Edit Period Plans button.-Select the work package, scroll down, under Period Plan for the existing work package, add row to schedule the period plan for different periods.-Keywords-Project Plan, Work Package, Period

Title: Shopping Cart Approver Becomes Buyer Responsible in Follow up Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-When purchase requests created from a approved shopping cart, you find the last approver of the shopping cart becomes the buyer responsible person in the purchase request by default.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center, Self-services view.-Go Shopping, create a new shopping cart ABC (ABC stands for shopping cart ID), submit it.-In the shopping cart ABC, under approval details, you find the last approver for it is employee XYZ (XYZ stands for the employee ID).-After employee XYZ approves shopping cart ABC, the follow up purchase request DEF (DEF stands for purchase request ID) is automatically created.-Open purchase request DEF, you see the name of employee XYZ is showing in the buyer responsible field. -Cause-You have scoped question "Do you want to define defaulting of Purchasing Unit and Buyer Responsible for Purchase Request and Orders?" in Business Configuration work center, but you haven't maintain an employee responsible for purchase requests and orders under Organizational Management work center, Employee Work Distribution view.-In fine tuning activity, Involved Parties for Purchase Requests and Orders, system determine the buyer for purchase request according to the rules in below sequence by default.-Employee Work Distribution settings for Purchase Requests and Orders-Creator of Purchase Request(Approver of Shopping cart, Project Purchase request , Purchase proposal)-Any employee from purchasing unit (Provided Purchasing Unit  is determined)-If you don't maintain an employee responsible for purchase requests and orders, system always take the last approver of the shopping cart as the buyer responsible person in the purchase request by default. This is the expected behavior.-Resolution-If you do not want to define defaulting of Purchasing Unit and Buyer Responsible for Purchase Request and Orders, please go to Business Configuration work center, select the current project and click Edit Project Scope. Go to step 4: Question and expanding Purchasing, Purchase request, and find the question "Do you want to define defaulting of Purchasing Unit and Buyer Responsible for Purchase Request and Orders?", uncheck it,  finish it. Then, when new purchase request be created, the buyer responsible person will be blank by default.-If you want to define a particular responsible employee for purchase request, please maintain an employee responsible for purchase requests and orders under Organizational Management work center, Employee Work Distribution view. Then system will use the responsible employee in new created purchase requests and orders by default.-Meanwhile, even system proposed a fixed employee responsible for purchase requests according to the defined rule, you shall manually change the buyer responsible person in each purchase request.-See Also-2338159 - How to Default Purchasing Unit & Buyer Responsible in Purchase Requests Document-Keywords-Purchase Request, Shopping Cart, Buyer Responsible

Title: Leading Zeros in External Reference Field of Sales Orders or External Document ID of supplier invoice are Missing
Content: Symptom-You enter zero as leading numbers in the field External Reference in Sales Order or in the field External document ID in supplier invoice, and then you observe that those zeros are being removed or disappearing automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center-Select the Sales Orders view -Search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order)-Add 00 (zeros) in the External Reference field-Press Enter button- or- Go to Supplier Invoicing work center- Go to New supplier invoice without reference to Purchase order under common tasks- Add 00 (zeros) in the External document ID- Press Enter button-Cause-It happens because the values you entered in the External Reference field/ External document ID are containing only numbers. Also in general we do not expect any document numbers being generated with leading zeros when they contain only numbers and thus we remove them.-Resolution-In order to have the leading zeros you need to customize by creating new extension field and ask your partners to make the External Reference number to alpha numeric (contains number and characters). For example: 00123A. In this case, the leading zeros will not disappear after pressing Enter button.- or-You can add it to  as new requirement on Customer Influence Forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Leading Zeros ; External Reference ; Sales Order; Supplier invoice;External document ID

Title: Error Message in SOAP UI:Read Tme Out Error
Content: Symptom-While executing a XML in SOAP UI ,it loads for some time and you get Error Read time out error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If the payload is little huge with close to say 100 plus items then there is a read time out error due to socket time equal to 0 seconds.-Socket timeouts can occur when attempting to connect to a remote server, or during communication, especially long-lived ones. They can be caused by any connectivity problem on the network.-Resolution-Increase the socket timeout time in SOAP UI-Go to Under File-Choose Preferences-Go to HTTP settings-Maintain Socket Timeout field with 600000 ms-Keywords-Read time out error,SOAP UI error

Title: Error messsage:ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR
Content: Symptom-Technical error in Business communication monitoring view under Application user management work center with above mentioned error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You may check it further by following steps where you will see related error details--Go to Application user management work center-Go to Communication arrangement-Select the respective communication arrangement-Click on View all-Go to Advanced settings-Go to Technical data-Click on Outbound-Click on check connection you will see error given below-SRT: Processing error in Internet Communication Framework: ("ICF Error when receiving the response: ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR")--Cause-The certificate chain of the server host is missing in the certificate trust list  in your ByDesign system and thus this error occurred-Note: This is one of possible reasons for this error-Resolution-You need to contact the person who maintains the communication arrangements to upload the certificates--Please find below steps where we you have to upload the certificates in ByDesign-Go to Application user management work center-Go to common task Edit Certificate Trust List-Click on Upload-Keywords-Technical error in Business communication monitoring

Title: Duplicated Line Items in Delivery Request
Content: Symptom-When you open the Delivery Request XXX, you see that there are more line items than in the related Sales Order or Stock Transfer.-XXX = Delivery Request ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Delivery Requests view.-Search for the Delivery Request XXX.-Open the Delivery Request XXX.-Choose View All.-Select the Line Items tab.-Notice that some Line Items are duplicated.-Cause-The Delivery Request XXX is showing duplicated line items because each of the line items were initially rejected from the delivery request and once they were rejected, the customer demand for the products was released again. Then the system will not reopen the rejected item, it will create new line items.-Resolution-The system is working as designed, as the line items were rejected and then released again.-Keywords-Delivery Request;-Reject;-Rejected;

Title: How To Define Default Supplier ID and Product Category on External Catalog
Content: Symptom-You have configured a Supplier Catalog for a specific Supplier but the items being retrieved from it do not have the expected Supplier ID and/or Product Category maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home Workcenter.-Go to Self Services Overview.-Click Go Shopping (Advanced).-In the Select Products step, click the affected External Catalog and go to the Supplier's website.-Add the necessary product(s) to the shopping cart.-In the Supplier Website's shopping cart, click Submit.-Back in the SAP shopping cart, notice the missing/incorrect values.-Cause-This happens because you need to Configure and Scope into your Implementation Project the Activity Define Catalog Defaults.-This Activity complements the main activity External Catalogs.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Workcenter.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project and click Open Activity List.-In the new screen, go to Fine-Tune step and search for Default Values for Supplier Catalogs.-Open it and click Append.-On the new row, select the affected External Catalog and define the default Supplier ID and the default Product Category.-See Also-For further information on how to configure External Catalogs, please check the help document:-Configuration: External Catalogs-Keywords-External Catalog, Catalog, Shopping Cart, Supplier ID, Product Category, Supplier, Business Configuration, Activity List

Title: Party ID is Incorrectly Displayed in Intrastat Declaration
Content: Symptom--Item YY is showing party ID as ZZ in Intrastat Declaration-However, on checking the References ,the indicating party ID is actually XX-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center-Select Intrastat Declarations view-Search for particular Item YY-The party ID is showing as ZZ-Under Item Details, open the reference documents like supplier invoice or outbound delivery -The reference documents supplier invoice and outbound delivery shows ship-to is XX-Cause-The logic to determine the party information is to compare the Tax data.-Now, both the accounts Corporate accounts has the same VAT number--The tax number is matched against the master data and one of the parties is determined. Kindly note that we do not check the reference documents to determine the party.-Resolution-Please maintain unique VAT number for each account-Keywords-Intrastat-Intrastat Declaration-Ship-to Party-Intrastat Run

Title: Error Appears When Post Goods Receipt as Planned is Performed on a Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-When Post Goods Receipt as Planned is performed on an Inbound Delivery Notification for a batch managed product, Error appears-Action failed-Value for identified stock missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Search for ABC (ABC refers to Inbound Delivery Notification id)-Select on Post Goods Receipt as Planned-Error appears-Action failed-Value for identified stock missing-Cause-The Product DEF being used in Inbound Delivery Notification ABC is Batch Managed i.e Identified Stock type maintained in Product Master DEF is Batch managed.You cannot use Post Goods Receipt as Planned in case of batch managed products because the system doesn't propose any Identified stock.-Resolution-You can make use of  Post Goods Receipt option as you  can specify the Identified stock in the line items.This is the designed behavior.-Keywords-Action failed, Value for identified stock missing, Post Goods Receipt as Planned

Title: Warehouse Tasks Not Released in Data Sources
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a report based on warehouse tasks. You have checked all SCM Data Sources relevant for this information but you still can't find this information on Standard Data Sources, even though this is available in the System.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Cause-There are no released Standard Data Source for warehouse tasks. Development is still analyzing how to enhance this, however in the current version of the system this is not available in the Standard solution.-Resolution-Approach your implementation partner to reach this requirement.-This information is available if build on QuerySiteLogisticsTaskIn Web Service. Or using query the Warehouse Task Business Object in PDI to fetch the open task, using the information below:-Business Object: SiteLogisticsTask-Node:Root-Query: QueryByStatus-Query Parameter: ProcessingStatusCode-Keywords-warehouse tasks, open warehouse tasks, report warehouse tasks

Title: GST Relevant Taxcode is Not Determined Automatically in  Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-GST relevant Tax code for a product is not determined automatically in a purchase order though the HSN code is maintained in the Product master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The prerequisite for automatic GST relevant tax code determination is to not maintain the material tariff ID-Resolution-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Materials View -Search for respective material and open it-Go to General tab-Find the field Material Tariff ID-Remove this ID and Save-Note: If material tariff ID is not visible, enable it via adaptation mode-Keywords-GST Relevant Taxcode not determined, Tax code not determined for country india, Tax code is not fetched in Purchase order

Title: Data Missing in Report Compared to Work Center View
Content: Symptom-Report PROCPIU02_Q0001 misses data when compared to the Object Work List in the work center view.-For example, the standard report Customer Project Overview (PROCPIU02_Q0001) does not show all the Projects displayed in Project Management work center - Projects View, when both the report and the view are filtered by: In Planning, Started or Released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Show All Reports.-Find the report PROCPIU02_Q0001.-Open the report.-Filter by Project Status 1, 2, 3.-Select Apply.-The projects displayed in report PROCPIU02_Q0001 differ from the projects shown in Project Management work center > Projects View when filtering by In Planning, Started, and Released statuses.-Cause-The report uses Key Figures for which Zero Suppression is enabled in the Key Figure settings.-In the report PROCPIU02_Q0001, the projects that are not displayed have a value of 0 for the Key Figures Net Value - Ordered and Net Value - Invoiced.-As a result, documents with a zero value for these Key Figures are automatically excluded from the report output.-Resolution-Steps to check the Zero Suppression settings for Key Figures in the report with these steps:-Open the report PROCPIU02_Q0001.-Go to View.-Click More [...] next to Key Figure and select Key Figure Settings.-Go to the General tab.-In the section Zero Suppression, Apply Suppression to Rows is set by default as Suppress When All Values Equal Zero.-Change this setting to: `Do Not Suppress` to see all the documents with zero value for the Key Figures.-See Also-KBA 2650050 - Values Are Not Showing In The Report-Keywords-PROCPIU02_Q0001; Report; Key Figure; Zero, Value; Suppression, Projects missing in report; Zero Suppression; Do Not Suppress

Title: Creation of assignment failed (See Parameter MT_INVALID_BPA_UUID) Error in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Purchase Request from a Project for a Time-based Service.-When you create the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID) from the Purchase Request, you get the error Creation of assignment failed (see parameter MT_INVALID_BPA_UUID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Find ABC.-Select Edit.-Select Check. No error appears.-Select Order.-The following errors appear:-Save failed after performing action.-Creation of assignment failed (see parameter MT_INVALID_BPA_UUID).-Cause-In the Purchase Request created from the Project, the Time Recording Required is active. Upon creating the Purchase Order however, the checkbox is no longer marked because the Scoping in the Implementation Project doesn't allow Time recording on Purchase Orders.-Resolution-In order to check this scoping, you can:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select a Started Project and Edit Project Scope.-Go to Questions.-Open Purchasing - Purchase Request and Order Management - Goods and Services Receipts;-Find `Purchase Orders with Time Sheet Recordings for Projects`.-This question is not In Scope.--To scope this, you first need to scope the question `Do your project managers procure time-based services for projects?` under Project Management - Project Planning and Execution - Project Procurement.-You can then enable Purchase Orders with Time Sheet Recordings for Projects. You will need to close and reopen your system before creating the Purchase Order successfully.-Keywords-Purchase, Order, Request, Project, Service, Time-based, Time, Recording, Scoping, Question-purchase order,project,time recording,purchase request,see parameter mt_invalid_bpa_uuid,creation of assignment failed

Title: Health Check: 'System cannot assign BTM items of type XYZ' OR 'Assignment of type XYZ BTM items not possible'
Content: Symptom-You receive the following diagnostic message from the system via a health check.-Message: 'System cannot assign BTM items of type XYZ' (Where XYZ represents the task ID). Or: 'Assignment of type XYZ BTM items not possible'.-The system cannot determine an appropriate user to whom the items can be distributed. As a result, the items do not appear in the worklist of any users, which can result in delays in the business processes affected.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-These health check incidents are raised in case there are tasks which are in unassigned status, since the person responsible for the task cannot be determined.-Resolution-Generally, you can follow the steps below as resolution for these health check incidents.-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the Business Task Management view.-Select the query: Unassigned Items.-Click Go.-To determine why an item has not been assigned to a user, select it and open the most recent application log.-Solve the issue by, for example, adjusting the work distribution settings or work center view assignments to ensure that the potential user responsible has the necessary work center assignment.-You can adjust the work distribution settings under Administrator → General Settings → Employee Work Distribution.-You can also adjust the work center view assignments under User and Access Management → Business Users or User and Access Management → Support and Technical Users.-After you have made the relevant changes, return to the Business Task Management view, select the relevant item, and choose Determine Assignment.-You can also manually assign the item to the employee responsible by selecting it in the Business Task Management view and clicking on Actions → Assign Item. For any task, you can assign the responsible user to the task or you can delete/cancel the task.-The system assigns the item according to your changes and removes it from the list.-Note: If more than one key user has access to the Administrator work center, the full list of Tasks for which no user is responsible can be distributed between these key users.-Note: If you are still unable to solve the issue, report the incident to SAP.-In the incident, include the type of Business Task Management Item specified in the message text of the Health Check incident you received, as well as any further related information.-Do not forward the incident you received to SAP, since it is closed automatically if you assign the item manually.-To avoid delays in the business processes affected while the incident you have reported is being solved, you can manually assign the item(s) to the employee(s) responsible by selecting it and choosing Action and then Assign Item.-To effectively work with this view, your user needs to have the BTM work centre view assigned.-You find this under the work centre SEODADMINWCF – Administrator, the users need to have access to the view: BAS_BUSINESSTASKMANAGEMENT - Business Task Management (highlighted in: BTM_access_missing.jpg).-Keywords-btm task, system assign, CRM_SRQ_ALT_COMPL BTM, Business Task Management, Health Check, Unassigned items, 'Assignment of type XYZ BTM items not possible'

Title: Error "Service call failed" when Migrating Projects
Content: Symptom-When migrate huge number of projects using the migration tool, you receive error "Service call failed" in simulation phase.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Search for Migration of Projects activity.-3. Select Migrate projects using the migration tool.-4. Select Execute Migration Step by Step.--Then in step 3 simulation import, error occurred: Service call failed.-Cause-The issue might be due to high number of tasks that is used within that project.-Resolution-Please check the sizing assessment tool: https://partneredge.sap.com/en/library/assets/products/ent_mng/byd/sell/tools_assets/pp_form_byd_epq.html.--User can download it and enter the number of tasks part (4) Sizing "Maximum # of Tasks per project. --1.If the rating shows green color, the solution should fit. -2.If the rating shows yellow color, Performance drawbacks may expect. -3.If the rating shows red color, solution does not seem to fit.  --User should check the size and split the migration file accordingly.---Keywords-Migration of Projects, Service Call Failed, service call failed

Title: Purchase Order Search Screen Showing Empty Information, Such as Supplier Name
Content: Symptom-You notice that there is information missing on the Purchase Order view for specific POs, such as Supplier Name, for example.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Workcenter.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Search for the affected PO.-See that there is missing information, such as Supplier Name, for instance.-Cause-This happens due to a communication problem in the backend which needs to be corrected by SAP Support.-Resolution-Open an Incident explaining the issue.-Keywords-Missing Information, Supplier Name, Purchase Order

Title: Report For Stock Transfer Document
Content: Symptom-You want to create a report to view your Stock Transfer Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Navigate to the Design Data Sources view.-You search for data source for stock transfer orders and are not able to find them in the system.-Cause-The data source used to view stock transfer orders is SCMMSDVV02: Material Supply and Demand List.-Resolution-You can refer the help document titled Design Data Sources Quick Guide, for detailed explanation of how to create a report using a data srouce (SCMMSDVV02). Once the report is created with the data source SCMMSDVV02 you can filter the field category for following values.-Category ID Category Value-29 Stock Transfer Demand-30 Stock Transfer Demand in Execution-33 Stock Transfer Proposal-37 Stock Transfer Demand Proposal-Once the above filter is set for category in the report created you will be able to view the stock transfer created in your system.-Keywords-stock transfer report, cannot create report for stock transfer, data source for stock transfer report, how to create stock transfer report

Title: Error message :Item 1: Reference to Contract Items is not Allowed for Limit Items
Content: Symptom-While creating a limit item shopping cart you are unable to link contract to it as system throws you above error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create Shopping cart from project management work center in customer system-Go to Go shopping view-Click on next and go to step 3: Edit shopping cart-Change the item type to limit-Enter Contact ID by choosing it from drop down-You will notice that Contact ID is filled but not item ID-Note: Item ID will be filled automatically for other item types-Cause-For limit items in shopping cart we link only the purchasing contract header id and not the item id.-Resolution-Leave the item id blank.-System is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Shopping cart Limit item, Unable to link contract to Shopping cart

Title: Custom Payment Terms
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new custom Payment Term and you are not able to maintain both  'Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date' and 'Fixed Day of Month'  in same Payment term.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project line.-Click the Open Activity List button.-Search for the activity Accounts/Suppliers.-Select the activity.-Click the Open button.-Click the Maintain Payment Terms hyperlink.-Click the Add Row button.-Enter value for Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date.-Check the checkbox under Specification of time duration.-You can maintain Fixed Day of Month  and Additional Month, however, Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date changes the value to zero and it becomes grayed out.-Cause-You cannot combine 'Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date' and 'Fixed Day of Month' in one customized payment term.-Default payment terms(those that does not start with Z) like for example "45 days from Invoice Date, End of month" and "End of Month of Invoice Date, 45 days" are different as they were designed and delivered by SAP based on business rules ,so you cannot create new payment terms similar to them as thease are standard payment terms.-Resolution-Currently this is a new requirement for us please vote and comment of existing request in customer influence forum.-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/idea/218928-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/idea/227176-So Currently-There are only two options for you on the  custom Payment Terms:-a) If you check the option ‘Specification of time duration’:-You can set the fields: Discount Rate + Fixed Day of Month + Additional Month-b) If you do not check the option ‘Specification of time duration’:-You can combine: Discount Rate + Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date-Note: You may contact your partners to see if they can help-See Also-2151972 - Copy button is Grayed out for Payment Term IDs 1026 and 1027-1676638 - How to Add a New Payment Term And How To Change the Current Payment Terms--Help Center document 'Accounts — Configuration Guide' > session 'Maintain Payment Terms'-Keywords-Payment Terms; Accounts Activity; Custom; Number of Days; cannot add both Fixed Day of Month and Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date

Title: Error Appears While Migrating Location and Logistics area in Simulation Report Step
Content: Symptom-Error Company name missing for location XYZ appears at  simulation step during migration of location and Logistics areas.*XYZ refers to Location id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Select Overview View-Search and Open the migration activities Migration of Location and Logistics Area-Select the Migration file  with migration mode Add new records and Execute Migration Step by Step-In Step3: Simulate Report Error appears-Company name missing for Location XYZ-Cause-As Name Field is missing in Location tab, this error is caused. Name field is used for the company postal address (it is necessary since this Location is flagged as both Ship-To and Ship-From in the template) and it doesn't need to be the same name maintained internally.-Resolution-Maintain Name Field on Location tab in Migration template.-Keywords-Company name missing for Location,Name Field in Location tab, Error Company name missing for location  appears at  simulation step,migration of location and Logistics areas

Title: "Post Goods Receipt" button is greyed out.
Content: Symptom-Unable to do Post Goods Receipt for a Purchase Order XYZ.-(XYZ represents Purchase Order ID)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search and select the Purchase Order XYZ. -Post Goods Receipt button is greyed out.-(XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID)-Cause-The Supplier of Purchase Order XYZ belongs to Internal/ Buyer company.-For Purchase Orders supplied internally, an Inbound Delivery Notification needs to be created first.-Therefore, the Post Goods Receipt button is greyed out, while the New Supplier Delivery Notification button is enabled.-(XYZ represents the Purchase order ID)-Resolution-Create the Inbound Delivery Notification first, and proceed with Post Goods Receipt for the Purchase Order XYZ. -Follow the below steps to create Inbound Delivery Notification.-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search and select the Purchase Order XYZ. -Choose New Supplier Delivery Notification.-Enter the relevant mandatory details.-Choose Save.-(XYZ represents the Purchase order ID)-Keywords-Post Goods Receipt; Greyed Out; Purchase Order; Inbound Logistics; Internal; Buyer; Company; Supplier; Inbound Delivery Notification

Title: Error Message: Product XYZ in Planning Area ABC Planned with Failures
Content: Symptom-Error Message: Product XYZ in Planning Area ABC Planned with Failures; While Running Material Requirement Planning(MRP)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Products view.-Select All Products By Selection from Show drop down and select Advanced link.-Enter XYZ in the Product ID field and ABC in the Planning Area ID field.-Choose Go button.-Select the searched product and select Open button.-In the Product Planning Details screen, select either Single BoM Level or Multi BoM Level from Run Planning drop down. System shows error message: Product XYZ in Planning Area ABC Planned with Failures.-Cause-The valid from date of  production model for product XYZ is later than the execution date on date. e.g. Execution Start Date is March 23rd 2018, but production model is valid from Mar 24th 2018.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data.-Go to Production Models view.-Search the production model for product XYZ.-Click Edit.-Change the valid from date to the date earlier than execution start date.-Click Release Production Model for planning and execution.-Click Save.-Keywords-MRP, Production Models

Title: Cannot Select Production Specification in Goods Movement.
Content: Symptom-There is no production specification field available in Goods Movements.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Common Task - Goods movement.-Click Add row.-There is no field avaialbe for you to enter production specification.-Cause-Product specification is not supported for any types of internal movement scenarios.SAP Business Bydesign support Identified Stock / Batch which can be linked to the Production Specification.-Resolution-You can create an Identified Stock and linked it to the Production Specification, Identified Stock is supported in internal movement scenarios.-Keywords-Product Specification,  Internal Logistics, Goods Movement

Title: Production Task Was assigned to a Wrong Task Folder
Content: Symptom-Production Task was assigned to a Wrong Task Folder.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Show all and search for Task ABC (ABC means the Task ID).-The task ABC is in Task Folder XYZ (XYZ means Task Folder ID), however it should be assigned to Task Folder OPQ (OPQ means Task Folder).-Cause-It can be checked the Bill of Operations details in the corresponding Production Model, the Task - Generation Method is maintained as "Operation including Report Points". However, for Production Task folder OPQ, the type is maintained as "Activity". This means that only tasks that are generated per activity can be dispatched to the folder OPQ. But here tasks are created based on operations.-Resolution-In order to use task folder OPQ for production tasks, it is necessary to either remove the activity type values in the Assignment Criteria of the production task folders or change the Task-Generation Method in the bill of operation.-Keywords-Production Task Folder, Task Control,  Bill of Operations

Title: "Only store same inventory usability status" function did not work for goods movements.
Content: Symptom-"Only store same inventory usability status" function did not work for goods movements.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data.-2.Go to Locations View.-3.Select Site ID XYZ.-4.Click Edit Layout.-5.Select Logistics Area ABC.-6.Go to Restriction Tab.-7.You can see that the box "inventory Usability Status" is selected.-Then you perform good movements, move product XXX which has restricted use from Logistics Area OPQ to Logistics Area ABC. System allows the movements even Logistics Area ABC already contains stock with non-stricted use. You expect that system should not allow the movements as restriction is maintained at logistics area level.- Cause-Uniformity Checks for target logistics area  are triggered only for execution related objects like warehouse task and production supply task, during confirmation of the tasks or the action 'Post Goods Receipt'. For adhoc Process like Goods Movement, we don’t trigger uniformity checks on target logistics areas.The source and destination determination checks were only implemented for execution scenarios, replenishment, removal. It was never implemented for internal logistics. We don't restrict ad-hoc documents like Goods Movement, Count,..etc in the internal logsitics.-Resolution-This is system stardard behavior.-Keywords-Restriction, Internal Logisitics

Title: Cannot Select Logistics Unit During Packing in Outbound Logistics
Content: Symptom-Logistics units are not visible in value help during Packing in Outbound Logistics-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-2.Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-3.Search Outbound Delivery XYZ (XYZ stands for Outbound Delivery ID).-4.Click Packing.-5.Click Insert Package - Insert Top Package.-6.Click Value Help.-Logistics Unit ABC is not visible in the list even though it is active.-Cause-Logistics Unit ABC did not set flag "Non-Inventory Managment" as true- Resolution-You need to recreate a new Logistics Unit and set the flag "Non-Inventory Managment" as true since the existing one is active and could not be edited any more.-Keywords-Logistics Unit, Packing, Outbound Delivery

Title: Description is Missing for a Production Task
