Content: Symptom-Description is missing for a Production Task.-Environment-SAP Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control.-Show all and search Task XXX.-You can see that task description is missing.-Cause-Production task description depends on two settings in the corresponding Production Model:--1. Task Generation Method.-2. 'Element Description' maintained for Bill of Material.--The corresponding Production Model is using task generation strategy as 'Reporting Point including Operations and Activities' for this task generation method, whatever description is maintained for element type 'Reporting Point' should come in the task description.--In the corresponding production model , if you check the Bill of Operation structure, then you can see that there is only one element 'End' which is marked as 'Reporting Point'. Since no element description is maintained for this, task description is not coming.-Resolution-If you maintain task generation method as 'Reporting Point including Operations and Activities', then whatever description youmaintain for 'Reporting Point' will show as task description.-For method 'Activity including Reporting Point', description maintained for element type 'Activity' will show as task description.-For method 'Operation including Reporting points', description maintained for element type 'Operation' will show as task description.- Keywords-Production Task Description

Title: 3PL Stock Transfer Order Delivery Status in Finished Status Although Inbound delivery is not created and released
Content: Symptom-3PL Stock Transfer Order DEF Delivery Status populated as Finished status, However Inbound Delivery is not created and released.*DEF refers to Stock Transfer Order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-Navigate to Customer Demand View.-Select Stock Transfer Orders.-Search for DEF-You observe Stock Transfer Order DEF Delivery status in Finished status.-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries subview under 3PL Outbound View.-Search for Outbound delivery KLM(KLM refers to Outbound delivery id).--You observe Outbound Delivery KLM is  released and Inbound delivery Notification NOP  (NOP refers to Inbound delivery Notification id) in Advised status.-Cause-In 3PL Process Settings, All requests  is set as Automatic, upon creation and release of Outbound delivery, Stock Transfer Order Delivery status will be finished irrespective of whether Inbound delivery is created or not, Hence you see this behavior.-Resolution-In order to change the behavior. If we set 3PL process settings all requests  to manual, Stock transfer Order Delivery status will wait for Inbound delivery to be created and released. In order to perform the settings, follow the below steps-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center-Navigate to 3PL Process Settings View-Set All requests as Manual-Save the Changes-Keywords-3PL Stock Transfer Order Delivery status in Finished status, 3PL Stock Transfer Order  Inbound delivery not created but in Finished status

Title: System triggers Errors when performing Reverse Confirmation for a Production Lot
Content: Symptom-Unable to perform Reverse Confirmation  for Production Order KLM.*KLM refers to Production Order id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Production Control work Center- Navigate to Production Orders- Search for KLM- Navigate to Document Flow.- Access Production Confirmation DEF(DEF represents Confirmation id)- Select Edit.- Select Reverse Confirmation.-Error appears-Cannot cancel confirmation-A negative actual quantity is not permitted.-Cause-As user already performed reverse confirmation for product PQR (*PQR refers to Product id) and then the same product is again trying to get reversed for same quantity while doing reversal  which is not possible as it will end up in negative.-Resolution-Same product  PQR is again trying to get reversed for same quantity while doing reversal  which is not possible as it will end up in negative.This is the expected behavior as designed.-Keywords-Cannot cancel confirmation; A negative actual quantity is not permitted, System triggers Errors when performing Reverse Confirmation for a Production Lot, Unable to perform Reverse Confirmation  for Production Order

Title: where to view Clarification Requests Created By you or Received by you or Response received by You
Content: Symptom-Where to see the clarification requests created by you or sent to you by some one else or responses you received to your requests-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Clarifications created by you can be found by following below steps:-Go to Home work center-Select Delegation tasks-Choose Created by me-Click on Go-Clarifications send by some one else to you or response to your clarifications requests can be seen by following below steps:--Go to Home work center-Select Inbox-Choose Open items-Click on Go-Keywords-Clarification request not found, where to find Clarification Requests

Title: How To Restrict An User From Changing Serial Number Profiles in Product Master Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2622850***-You have set New Serial Number Profile i..e Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Processes for a Product DEF in a relevant product master data and updated the serial number inventory confirming the count tasks. However later sometime when you check the stock overview, no serial number inventory exists.*DEF refers to Product Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Go to Stock Overview.-Enter the relevant Product ID: DEF.-Choose Go.-Here you see that option Open Serial Inventory does not exists.-Also no relevant serial inventory exists associated with the required Product DEF.-Cause-User has changed the Serial Number Profile from New Profile: Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Processes to any other Old Profile hence no more association exists between serial numbers with inventory in the system.-Resolution-In order to restrict users to make changes to the product master data, follow below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter.-Under User and Access Management view, choose Business User subview.-Find required Business User ID, select it and choose Access Rights via Edit option.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab, find PMM_PRODUCTDATA and PMM_MATERIALS under Workcenter View ID.-Select these views and set the Access Restrictions i..e Write Access as No Access using drop down.-Choose Save.-Once it is done, user cannot make changes to any field in the product master data.-Keywords-Access Restrictions, Open Serial Inventory, product master data, Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Processes, PMM_PRODUCTDATA  PMM_MATERIALS

Title: How To Restrict An User From Changing Serial Number Profiles in Product Master Data?
Content: Symptom-A new Serial Number Profile has been set i.e. Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Processes for a Product in relevant product master data and updated the serial number inventory confirming the count tasks. However, later on, when the stock overview is checked, no serial number inventory exists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory Work center.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Go to Stock Overview.-Enter the relevant Product ID-Choose Go.-Here you see that option Open Serial Inventory does not exists.-Also, no relevant serial inventory exists associated with the required Product.-Cause-User has changed the Serial Number Profile from New Profile: Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Processes to any other Old Profile hence no more association exists between serial numbers with inventory in the system.-Resolution-In order to restrict users to make changes to the product master data, follow below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work center.-Under User and Access Management view, choose Business User sub view.-Find required Business User ID, select it and choose Access Rights via Edit option.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab, find PMM_PRODUCTDATA and PMM_MATERIALS under Work center View ID.-Select these views and set the Access Restrictions i.e. Write Access as No Access using drop down.-Choose Save.-Once it is done, user cannot make changes to any field in the product master data.-Keywords-Access Restrictions, Open Serial Inventory, product master data, Mandatory on all Logistics and Production Processes, PMM_PRODUCTDATA, PMM_MATERIALS, User is not authorized to change the data.

Title: Already Delivered Stock is Still Showing Up in Stock Overview
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For a product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product), you have already done outbound delivery of quantity XXX (XXX represents the exact quantity), but stock overview is still showing this quantity for the product. Also, stock overview is not showing any logistics area in which this quantity is present.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Choose Stock Overview from Common Tasks.-In the stock overview screen, enter product ID ABC and choose Go button.-Stock overview is showing quantity XXX for this product and it is not showing any value for logistics area.-Cause-The outbound delivery has been created but has not been released yet. Such stock type is Goods Issue. Since outbound delivery is already created, stock has been moved from the logistics area. That is why stock overview is not showing any logistics area.-But physically the stock is still in the site, for example loaded in a truck. That is why stock overview is still showing the quantity XXX for the product ABC.-Resolution-Once you release the outbound delivery, it will not be visible in stock overview. To release the outbound delivery:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the relevant outbound delivery and select it. -Select Release button.-Keywords-stock, showing, overview, logistics, area, release, outbound, delivery,

Title: System is Not Creating Any Warehouse Requests
Content: Symptom-You have set Outbound Delivery Run for releasing the delivery request IDs automatically to generate the warehouse requests but after executing the run ID, you found that there are no warehouse request documents created in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign [All Versions]-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Automated Actions view.-Select the Run ID and choose the Schedule button.-In the opened window, select the Schedule Immediately option and perform save.-In the Automated Actions view, you could see that the system has executed the run successfully and an application log ID has been generated for it.-Now go to the Warehouse Requests view.-You are not able to see any new warehouse request IDs generated after executing the run ID.-Cause-As the user who has scheduled the outbound delivery run does not have the Write access rights for the Automated Actions view, the Outbound Delivery Run has not created any warehouse request(s).-Note : When you check the job log for the run IDs, the jobs will shows the following information too:--Info: You are not authorized to execute mass data run XX-Resolution-You have to provide the user with Unrestricted Write access in Application and User Management work center for releasing the mass data run jobs.-Below are the steps to be followed-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view choose Business Users subview.-Search for the respective User ID and choose the Edit button and select the Access Rights option from it.-A window opens. Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Search for the Work Center Name Outbound Logistics and choose Enter button.-Select the Work Center View Name Automated Actions.-Under the Write Access column select Unrestricted option.-Perform Save.-Keywords-warehouse request, automated actions, access rights, outbound logistics

Title: 3PL Request in Finished Status when Partial Outbound Delivery is Released
Content: Symptom-3PL Request KLM in Finished status although Outbound Delivery DEF is Partially Released.*KLM refers to 3PL request id, *DEF refers to Outbound Delivery id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center-Navigate to 3PL requests subview under 3PL Outbound View-Search for 3PL request KLM-We observe 3PL request ABC is in Finished status-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries subview under 3PL Outbound View-Search for Outbound delivery DEF(DEF refers to Outbound Delivery id)- Outbound Delivery DEF is partially released.-Cause-In 3PL Process Settings, 3PL Request completion  is set as Automatic, upon creation of Outbound delivery Request will be finished irrespective of the quantity, hence you see that 3PL request status as "Finished".-Resolution-In order to change the behavior If we set 3PL Request completion to manual, 3PL request will go in finish state only when entire quantity is satisfied else it will go into Started.  -In order to perform the settings, follow the below steps-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center-Navigate to 3PL Process Settings View-Set 3PL Request Completion as Manual-Save the Changes-Keywords-3PL request in Finished for Partial Outbound delivery, Partial Quantity for 3PL cases, 3PL Request in Finished Status when Partial Outbound Delivery is Released

Title: How To Upload Supplier Invoices Using an External Application
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set up the upload of Supplier Invoices from an external application.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all systems.-Resolution-First you need to scope the question ‘Do you receive invoices from an external application automatically using electronic data exchange (EDX)?’ in the Implementation Project. (EDX represents Electronic Data Exchange)-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Highlight the relevant Implementation Project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Click Next until you reach step 4 Questions.-Show All Elements.-Extend the Scoping Elements Purchasing and Supplier Invoicing.-Select the Scoping Element Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos.-On the right side of the screen you can see the Questions for Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos.-Find the question ‘Do you receive invoices from an external application automatically using electronic data exchange (EDX)?’.-For this question mark the check box for ‘In Scope’.-Click Next and then Finish the Project Scope.-Now the Communication Arrangement ‘External Supplier Invoice Entry Integration’ is available for you to upload Supplier Invoices using an external application. To enable this communication arrangement please do the following:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select the Communication Arrangements view.-Show All Communication Arrangements and Find ‘External Supplier Invoice Entry Integration’.-Click on Edit Credentials.-Maintain the User ID, User Account and Password that the external application will need to use.-Close the Edit Communication Account screen.-Click on the Communication Scenario name ‘External Supplier Invoice Entry Integration’.-Highlight the service Manage Supplier Invoices.-Click on Download WSDL.-The File Explorer will open.-Choose where you want to save your WSDL file (e.g. Desktop).-This WSDL file and the User ID and Password maintained in the Communication Arrangement will now enable you to upload Supplier Invoices from your external application.-Keywords-How, To, Upload, Supplier, Invoices, Entry, Integration, Using, With, External, Application, EDX

Title: System Triggers a Dump When you are Trying to Edit an Inspection
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Edit an Inspection in the Quality Control work center, but when you select an Inspection and try to edit it, the system throws up a backend error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Quality Control work center.-Go to the view Monitoring, and select Inspections.-Show All Inspections and select the Inspection ABC (ABC represents the Inspection ID).-Click the Edit button.-A Backend error is triggered.-Cause-This issue occurs, because you have entered duplicate values for Inspection Stage IDs in Adaptive Sampling activity under Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-You must change and use unique Inspection Stage IDs for the customized Adaptive Sampling Rule XYZ (XYZ represents the Adaptive Sampling Rule ID) to resolve the issue. To do this, you need to select the Adaptive Sampling Rule XYZ, and delete all the "Inspection Stage IDs" and create new ones. Please note that the Inspection Stage IDs for Adaptive Sampling Rule must always be unique in the system.-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the view Overview.-Find and select the Activity "Adaptive Sampling".-Click the Open button.-If you check the 'user created' Adaptive Sampling Rule XYZ, and compare it with the system default ones, you can see that the ‘Inspection Stage IDs’ are same with the default ‘Adaptive Sampling Rule ID’.-Select the Adaptive Sampling Rule XYZ, and delete the Inspection Stage IDs’.-Create new unique ‘Inspection Stage IDs’ for the Adaptive Sampling Rule XYZ.-Keywords-Adaptive Sampling Rule, Inspection, Receiving inspection - supplier delivery, Dump, Duplicate entries in code list provider response (data type INSPECTION_STAGE_CODE)

Title: Stock and Demand Overview Button not Enabled in the Production Order
Content: Symptom-You want to check the Input Products availability of a Production Order using the Stock and Demand Overview button, but as the button is greyed out you are unable to check the statuses of the Input Product(s).-Now you want to know the reason why the button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders By Order Header view.-In the Show field, select All Production Orders from the drop down menu.-Search and select the relevant Production Order XXX (XXX represents the Production Order ID).-Click the Edit button.-You can see that the ﻿Stock and Demand Overview﻿ button is not enabled in the opened window.-Cause-As the Production Order has been released already, the Stock and Demand Overview button is not enabled. The Stock and Demand Overview button will only be visible if the production order has not yet been released (i.e. when the production order is in In Preparation status).-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Stock and Demand Overview, Production Order

Title: Ad-hoc Goods Movement  Between Logistics Areas Done Although Restriction With Storage Group is Set at Logistics Area Level
Content: Symptom-Ad hoc Goods Movement for Product DEF (DEF represents the Product ID) is performed from Source Logistics Area PQR (Restriction set with Storage Group - XY) to Target Logistics Area XYZ (Restriction set with Storage group - PQ), although the Destination  Logistics Area  has a different Storage group.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Internal Logistics work Center.-In Common tasks, select Goods Movement.-Fill in all fields like Source Logistics Area ID, Product ID, Target Logistics Area ID etc.-Finish creating the Goods Movement.-You can observe that the Product ABC allowed to move from Logistics Area PQR (restricted to Storage Group - XY) to Destination Logistics Area: XYZ (restricted to storage group - PQ), although Material - ABC is assigned with different  Storage Group - PQ.-Cause-Currently the restrictions on the Logistics Area like Uniformity, Storage Constrains (Storage Group, Product) etc. are checked via the Source and Destination Determination (SDD) Validation Engine.-SDD validations are triggered only for execution related objects like Warehouse Tasks (Inbound, Outbound & Internal) and Production Supply Task.-For an ad hoc Process like Goods Movement, SDD Validations are not triggered. However the basic restrictions like Status of Logistics Area are checked in Goods Movement.-Resolution-For ad hoc Process like  Goods Movement SDD Validation are not triggered. However the basic restrictions like Status of Logistics Area are checked in Goods Movement. This is the standard behavior as designed as per the current functionality-See Also-2611295 - Product Restriction Maintained In Logistics Area Not Considered-Keywords-Ad hoc Goods Movement between Logistics Area done although restriction is set at Logistics Area Level, Restrictions at Logistics Area Level is set and Goods movement is allowed

Title: Error Message: 'Movable Usage not Permitted with Logistics unit' While Editing a Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign logistics usage as Movable Storage to a logistics area, but you are getting error message: Movable Usage not Permitted with Logistics unit-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-2. Select the Locations view.-3. Select the relevant site or storage location choose Edit Layout button.-4. Navigate to the logistics area which you want to edit.-5. Select the General tab and choose Add Row button.-6. Select Movable Storage from the drop-down and choose Save button. System shows error message: Movable Usage not Permitted with Logistics unit-Cause-Since Movable Storage usage for a logistics area is used in service order pick scenario, it is not permitted to use it with logistics unit. For the particular logistics area Management of Logistics Unit has been maintained as Store Products With or Without Logistics Units and that is why system is showing the error message.-Resolution-To maintain Movable Storage as logistics usage for the logistics area you need to change the Management of Logistics Units to Only Store Products Without Logistics Units. To do so:-Go to the Supply Chain and Design Master Data work center.-Select the Locations view.-Select the relevant site or storage location choose Edit Layout button.-Navigate to the logistics area, which you want to edit.-Select the Restrictions tab and then the Allowed Logistics Units and Storage Groups sub-tab.-Here you can see that Management of Logistics Units is maintained as Store Products With or Without Logistics Units. Change it to Only Store Products Without Logistics Units and choose Save button.-Now you will be able to maintain logistics use as Movable Storage.-Keywords-movable, storage, usage, not permitted, logistics, unit, area

Title: Created By Field is Blank in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-The Created By field is blank in shopping cart X (X refers to shopping cart ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select Self Services Overview.-Select Track My Shopping Carts option.-Search for the shopping cart X.-Open the shopping cart X.-Created By field is blank-Cause-You have created the shopping cart through a web service. The user in the web service is a technical user. The Created By field will be filled only if the shopping cart is created by a business user.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-shopping cart, created by, shopping cart created by, created by field, SC created by, Created by is blank, Created by blank.

Title: Multi-value Field is Not Supported in Workflow Rule "And" Conditions
Content: Symptom-You have an extension field, which can be maintained with multi values. Now you define conditions in a workflow rule using "And" conditions in one group.-Then when the extension field is maintained with multi values, which meet the conditions in your workflow rule, the workflow rule cannot be triggered.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite:-You have created an extension field XYZ which can be maintained with multi values. (XYZ presents the extension field name)-You created a workflow rule, at the Define Conditions step, you define the conditions as below:-              Group 1:  XYZ Equal to Value AAA-                            And   XYZ Equal to Value BBB-   2.  Now in one document (the same BO with the workflow rule), the field XYZ is maintianed as multi-value field with the value: AAA+BBB, and the document meets every other conditions.-   3.  You find that the workflow rule is not triggered.-Cause-Multi values field cannot be used in workflow conditions. When a single value is maintained for the extension field in the document, you can use one value condition and the worflow rule can be triggered. Now in this scenario, we would do a comparison between a field which has two values with one value which is maintained in conditions. So comparison would fail and hence workflow rule would not get triggered.-Resolution-This function is currently not supported.-Keywords-workflow rule; multi value;  condition

Title: Outbound Delivery Created With Canceled Line Items
Content: Symptom-You created the Outbound Delivery XXX with the Ship-From Location ABC. However, the Outbound Delivery was created with canceled Line Items.-XXX = Outbound Delivery ID.-ABC = Location ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the Outbound Delivery XXX.-Open the Outbound Delivery XXX.-Choose View All.-Go to Line Items tab.-Notice that the Cancellation Status is Canceled.-Cause-System creates the Outbound Delivery with canceled Line Items when it is not possible to determine the Source Logistics Area by following the Material Flow rules defined for Location ABC. Outbound Delivery is created with Line Items canceled if the Material Flow rules maintained did not auto propose the Source Logistics Area.-Resolution-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Locations view.-Search for Site ABC.-Select Site ABC.-Choose Edit.-Select Material Flow tab.-Choose Advanced Rule.-Here you can define, change and create the Source Determination Rules which matches your business case.-Keywords-Canceled Outbound Delivery-Material Flow rules-Source LoA

Title: Error: 'Inventory in the logistics area is not available' While Confirming a Pick Task
Content: Symptom-During the confirmation of  a Pick task, when you choose Propose Quantities and Logistics Areas button, you get an error message 'Inventory in the logistics area is not available'.-However if you go to the Stock Overview it is showing that there is enough stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-2. Select Task Control view.-3. Select a task and choose Confirm.-4. In the task confirmation screen choose Propose Logistic Area and Quantities button.-5. System does not propose Logistic Area, Identified Stock and Quantity and it is showing error message ''Inventory in the logistics area is not available'.-However, if you open Stock Overview it is showing enough quantity is available.-1. Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-2. From the Common Task open Stock Overview.-Cause-All the available stock is assigned to an Identified Stock but it has been expired. If you open the Projected Material Flow screen, which is available in Common Tasks under Outbound Logistics work center, it will not show the stock as available stock for which Identified Stock is expired.-Resolution-System is working as designed. If you want to extend the expiration date of the Identified Stock then follow the below mentioned steps:-1. Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-2. Select Identified Stock view.-3. Search for the identified stock which should be selected to complete task.-4. Choose Edit.-5. Put a valid Expiration date.-6. Click Save and Close button.-Now the Identified Stock will be available for the Pick task and hence you will be able to confirm task.-See Also-KBA 2615118 - Error '-----> Identified stock XYZ at Input Product not valid' During Confirmation of a Make Task With Identified Stock-Keywords-inventory, logistics, area, not, available, error, confirm, pick, task, identified, stock, expired, propose, quantities

Title: Adaptive Sampling Missing in Inspection Plan
Content: Symptom-You have Scoped Adaptive Sampling in Businsess Configruation, but when you create an Inspection Plan, you cannot find the Adaptive Sampling section in the Inspection Plan.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work center Quality Planning.-Go to the Inspection Plans view.-Show All Inspection Plans.-Edit Inspection Plan ID XXX (XXX represents the Inspection Plan ID).-Select the sub tab Sample Data.-You expect to see the Adaptive Sampling section on the right side, but it is not visible.-Cause-You have not maintained the Business Configuration properly. You have to also scope the 'Inspection Types' Activity to make the Adaptive Sampling visible in your Inspection Plan.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation Project and click the Open Activity List button.-Go to the Fine-Tune phase.-Show All Activities and find the Activity 'Inspection Types'.-You can see the Activity is not scoped.-Click the Add to Project button.-Click the Open button to proceed to the Inspection Types view.-Click on 'Maintain Settings for Inspection Types'.-Select an Inspection Type.-Go to the Adaptive Sampling Criteria tab and maintain the criteria according to your business needs.-Save your changes.-Now you should be able to see the Adaptive Sampling in your Inspection Plan.-Keywords-Adaptive Sampling Configuration, Inspection Plan

Title: Purchase Order Approver is Unable to View the Attachments and Notes in the Approval Task Details
Content: Symptom-Approver user is unable to see the Purchase Order's Attachments in the "Attachments and Notes" view. -Note: the user is able to see the attachments by opening the Purchase Order itself > Attachments tab. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals tab.-Open the relevant Purchase Order approval task.-Navigate to Attachments tab.-No records found.-The user is unable to access the attachments and notes via the Task approval details screen. -Cause-Usually the Notes and Attachments at Header and Item level are hidden.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to enable the task approver to see the Attachments details:-Go to Managing My Area work center. -Go to Approvals view. -By clicking on the link appearing under subject column for Purchase Order, open the Approval UI (QAF).-In User Settings, click on 'Start Personalization Mode'.-In UI element, Enable the 'Unnamed Container' using the check box.-Where 1st & 2nd Unnamed Container indicates the notes & attachment at the header level, 3rd and 4th Unnamed Container indicates the notes and attachment at the item level.-Save it. -Now the approver should be able to see the Purchase Order's notes and attachments in the Task Details screen. -Keywords-Attachments, Notes, Purchase Order, Approval task, Approver

Title: Project Invoice Request Available For Invoicing After Cancellation of Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are cancelling a Project based Customer Invoice. You expect that after the cancellation of the Customer Invoice, the related Project Invoice Request will not reappear with the status To Be Invoiced in the Invoice Requests view of the Customer Invoicing work center, but only in the Project Invoice Requests view of the Project Management work center.-However, the Project Invoice Request does reappear in the Invoice Requests view of the Customer Invoicing work center with the status: To Be Invoiced. You are concerned that the Project Invoice Request could be invoiced again by mistake.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all systems.-Reproducing the Issue-You have cancelled the Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the relevant Customer Invoice ID).-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Show All Invoice Requests.-Find XXX (XXX represents the relevant Project Invoice Request ID).-You can see that Project Invoice Request XXX appears with status To Be Invoiced.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour. When a Project based Customer Invoice is cancelled, the relevant Project Invoice Request will show up in the Invoice Requests view of the Customer Invoicing work center with status `To Be Invoiced`.-Resolution-If you want to avoid that the Project Invoice Requested is invoiced again by mistake (e.g. by a user who is not aware that the related Customer Invoice has been cancelled), then you can cancel the Project Invoice before cancelling the Customer Invoice.-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Project Invoice Requests view.-Show All Project Invoice Requests.-Find XXX (XXX represents the relevant Project Invoice Request ID).-Click on Cancel.-Now go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Requests view.-Show All Invoice Requests.-Find Project Invoice Request XXX-The Project Invoice Request now shows up with status In Conflict. When you then cancel the Customer Invoice ABC, the Project Invoice Request XXX will show up with status Processed in the Invoice Requests view of the Customer Invoicing work center, and it will no longer be available for invoicing.-Keywords-Project, Customer, Invoice, Request, Cancelled, Cancel, Cancellation, After, Following, Available, For, Invoicing, To, Be, Invoiced, Status

Title: Simulation of Journal Entry in Delayed Verification Mode Not Possible
Content: Symptom-You face the error "Simulation of journal entry in delayed verification mode not possible" when you simulate the journal entry in supplier invoice X (X refers to supplier invoice ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the document X.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select Action -> Simulate Journal Entry button.-Cause-Simulation of Journal Entry is not possible when you have scoped Delayed Verification for Supplier Invoice posting because, the goods and service receipts document assignment is done at the background and also the posting of the supplier invoices are done at the background.-Resolution-The supplier Invoice delayed verification business option is relevant if you agree to shift time intensive logic to background processing and do not need change the goods receipt quantity distribution via Supplier Invoice entry manually.-Kindly descope the Delayed Verification if you want the Simulate Journal Entry to work.-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Simulation of journal entry, delayed verification simulation JE, delayed verification

Title: Filtering of Document does not Yeild Expected Results
Content: Symptom-Filtering of any Document that has symbol "-" in its ID is not giving you expected results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The below steps are just an example of one of the cases-Go to Cost and Revenue work center-Click on Projects view-Search for project A-XYZ-Select it and click on Project Plan values button-Then click on filter button and enter project task A-XYZ:P-And click on enter button--You expect only task A-XYZ:P to appear-however ,you will see many tasks that start with A.-Cause-This is the desired behavior as per the development done currently. That is "-" is used as a delimiter.-It is expected that column filter with value containing "-" will be split based on "-".-So system will consider it as "A*" and gives you the results.--Also, any change to the existing behavior of system will break the existing use cases and hence developers are not going to make changes to this behavior.-Resolution-Please  replace "-" with "*"-In this example "A*XYZ:P" has to be used to get the exact filter result.-This is applicable for all document ID's where symbol "-" is apppearing.-Keywords-Filtering is not working, filtering is not proper,filtering is giving wrong results,filtering isgiving many unneccessary results

Title: Operation not Permitted; Product has a Deviation
Content: Symptom-While trying to perform Late Delivery Split in a Pick task you get the error : Operation not Permitted; Product has a Deviation-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant task, select it and choose the Confirm button.-Enter the Actual Quantities value in the line items you need to deliver.-Choose the Late Delivery Split button.-You see the system displays the above reported error.-Cause-There is a line item in the task for which you have maintained Deviation Reason. This deviation reason has to be either Accepted or Rejected by your warehouse manager. This activity needs to be performed in the warehouse order mapped to the pick task for which you are trying to perform Late Delivery Split.-Resolution-Please follow the below given steps to process the deviation maintained in your pick task.-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Monitoring: By Warehouse Order view.-Select the warehouse order mapped to the pick task you are trying to perform Late Delivery Split.-Choose the Edit button and navigate to the Operations tab.-You will be able to see Red traffic line against the line item for which the deviation has to be processed.-Select the line item and choose Accept Deviation, Accept Deviation and Reject Open Quantity or Reprocess Open Quantity option as per your business requirement.-Once the above steps are performed you will be able to perform Late Delivery Split for your pick task.-Keywords-partial delivery of goods

Title: Missing Items in Intrastat Declaration
Content: Symptom-System created an Intrastat Declaration ID from the Intrastat Declaration Run, howevre items are not transferred to declaration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center-Go to Intrastat Declarations view-Select the relevant Intrastat Declaration -Select Edit and go to Items tab-Items that you expected are missing from the Intrastat Declaration-Cause-There are multiple causes for this, including the following:-The Supplier is an individual.-The Supplier's Tax Country is the same as the Country of Declaration of the Intrastat Declaration.-Resolution-You can find the detail of the documents analysed by the Intrastat Declaration Run by following these steps:-Go to Intrastat work center.-Go to Intrastat Declaration Runs view.-Find the run which created the Intrastat Declaration and select it.-Go to Execution Details tab.-Open the last application log by clicking on the ID.-Go to the Results tab.-See Also-2570318 - Inconsistent Delivery Terms in Intrastat Declaration for Italy-Keywords-Intrastat, Declaration, Run, Application, Log, Invoice, Missing, Goods, Movement, Item

Title: How To Return a Pre-delivered Stock to Warehouse stock
Content: Symptom-You want to return a Pre-delivered stock to your own stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If you have to use the above stock at your end, you will have to bring the stock back from your custodian.-To bring the stock back from your custodian, you will have to first remove the project that is tagged to the stock.-Please follow the below given steps to do so.-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select the option Change of Pre-Delivered Stock under Common Tasks view.-Maintain Custodian and choose the button Add Row to add the product details.-Enter the Product ID ABC and choose the Next button. (ABC indicates the exact Product ID).-In Enter Confirmation Details section, enter the Changed Product Quantity value as XXX (XXX represents product quantity) and click the Next button.-Review the details you have entered and click the Finish button.-If you check the stock overview for the above product you will not be able to see the Project ID tagged to the custodian stock.-Now you have to bring back the custodian stock from your customer site to your warehouse.-Please perform the below given steps to do so.-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the option New Custodian Goods Return Notification under the Common Task view.-In the New Custodian Goods Return Notification screen you need to enter the Ship-to Party ID, Ship-to Location ID (Company), Sender ID (Site) and Delivery Notification ID (Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Enter the Product details by choosing the Add Row button.-Once the necessary details are entered, select  Check Consistency button to make sure that there are no errors in the document.-You can choose to create a Warehouse Request to process the Inbound Delivery Notification via tasks, or save the Inbound Notification as it-is to perform a Post Goods Receipt.-Once the above steps are performed, the stock of XXX quantity at your custodian site will be updated back into your inventory.-Keywords-Pre-delivered, Custodian, Project

Title: Error '-----> Identified stock XYZ at Input Product not valid' During Confirmation of a Make Task With Identified Stock
Content: Symptom-When confirming a Make task, you are unable to select the Identified ID as the Result Type indicator is in red, showing a message 'Inventory Retrieval or placement  is not allowed, constraints not met'. In addition you get an error message saying: 'Identified stock XYZ at Input Product not valid'. (XYZ represents the ID of the Identified Stock). However, if you check the Stock Overview, it is showing enough on-hand stock for the selected Identified Stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Execution Workcenter-View Production Tasks-Find ABC (ABC represents the task ID)-Choose Confirm button-Go to Input Products tab-Choose the value selector of Identified Product ID-For Result Type select All Results-For Identified Stock ID field choose the value selector-Select the active Identified Stock ID-Choose Go-Result: Here see that the Result Type is in red and there's a message 'Inventory Retrieval or placement is not allowed, constraints not met'.-However, here open Stock Overview, it is showing that there's enough quantity available.-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-From the Common Task open Stock Overview.-Cause-All the available stock is assigned to an Identified Stock, but it has been expired.-Resolution-System is working as designed. If you want to extend the expiration date of the Identified Stock, then follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center-Select Identified Stock view-Search for the identified stock which should be selected to complete task-Choose Edit-Put a valid Expiration date-Save and Close-Now the Identified Stock will be available for selection for the Make task and hence you will be able to confirm the task.-See Also-KBA 2617361 - Error: 'Inventory in the logistics area is not available' While Confirming a Pick Task-Keywords-identified, stock, confirm, make, task, input, product, not valid, inventory, retrieval, placement, not allowed, constraints, not met, production, tasks

Title: Sequence of Source Does Not Work When Confirming a Pick Task
Content: Symptom-The system is ignoring the sequence of source defined in the Material Flow Rules for Logistics Area XXX. When trying to confirm the Pick Task ABC, the Target Logistics Area is XXX and the system is proposing Source Logistics Area ZZZ. However, there is another possible Source Logistics Area YYY which comes first in the sequence of source for Logistics Area XXX. Both Logistics Areas YYY and ZZZ have enough stock to fulfill the task and belong to two different Sites.-ABC = Task ID-XXX = Logistics Area ID-YYY = Logistics Area ID-ZZZ = Logistics Area ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Task Control view.-Search for Task ABC.-Select the Task ABC.-Choose Confirm.-Select the Line Item you want to confirm.-Notice that the Source Logistics Area being proposed is ZZZ.-  To check the sequence of source for Logistics Area XXX:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Locations view.-Search for the site where the Logistics Area XXX is in.-Select site where the Logistics Area XXX is in.-Choose Edit Layout.-Find the Logistics Area XXX.-Select the Logistics Area XXX.-Select Material Flow Rules.-Select Source.-Choose Search Sequence.-Here you can check that Logistics Area YYY comes before ZZZ to be chosen as source.-Cause-You have defined Material Flow Rules for Logistics Area XXX at Logistics Area level. Since Logistics Areas YYY and ZZZ belong to two different Sites and there is no Material Flow Rules defined at Site level, the proposed Logistics Area ZZZ is valid.-Resolution-You need to define Material Flow Rules for the Site where XXX is in, by selecting as Source the Sites of YYY and ZZZ. Since Logistics Areas YYY and ZZZ belong to two different Site, you need to define all at Site level.-Keywords-Search Sequence-Logistics Area-Pick Task

Title: Delivery Status is In Process for a Line Item of a Completed Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have completed a Sales Order, but the Sales Order is still visible in Supply Planning, and a Line Item is showing Delivery Status as In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the relevant Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID). Here you can see that the status of the Sales Order is Completed.-Now choose Edit button and then choose View All button.-Go to the Items tab. Here you can see that the Delivery Status of one of the line items is In Process.-Cause-You have canceled the Sales Order line item by maintaining Reason for Rejection. However, before the cancelation, sales order line item was already released to logistics execution and a Warehouse Request was created for it.  If Warehouse Request is already created, then only cancelling the Sales Order line item will not automatically cancel the Warehouse Request (and Warehouse Task). That is why if you check the Customer Demand view in Outbound Logistics Control for the Sales Order line item, it is showing Cancelation Status as Cancelation Requested.-Resolution-To cancel the Warehouse Request (and Warehouse Task), you need to reject the Warehouse Request. To do so, follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Warehouse Requests view.-Search for the Warehouse Request XYZ (XYZ represents the Warehouse Request ID) corresponding to the Sales Order line item.-Select the Line Item and choose Reject Request button.-Now if you check the Delivery Status of the Line Item, it will change to Finished.-Keywords-Cancellation Sales Order, Reason for Rejection, Cancellation Requested, Warehouse Task, In Process

Title: Over-the-Counter Sales Transaction: Logistics Area is not Proposed in Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You are creating an Over-the-counter Sales document, but the Logistics Area is not proposed in the Outbound Delivery, and the document is inconsistent. Since you have maintained a Logistics Area XYZ (XYZ represents the Logistics Area ID) with the Logistics Usage 'Over the Counter Stock', you expects the system to propose this Logistics Area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the `Over-the-Counter Sales` work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view and select the action "New Over-the-Counter Sale".-Enter the necessary Details.-Click the Invoice.-The  system creates the Over The Counter Sale document ABC (ABC represents the Over The Counter Sale ID).-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Find and select the Outbound Delivery ABC.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Line Items tab.-You can see that the Logistics Area ID column is empty.-Cause-The system is not proposing the Logistics Area, because there is no stock available.-Logistics Area determination works only if there is an existing inventory in the system which could be either positive or negative. For negative inventory, negative stock indicator must be set in the corresponding Logistics Area if inventory has to be consumed from this stock.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Over The Counter Sales, Outbound Delivery, Logistics Area missing

Title: Billable Hours Appears Incorrect When you Export the Time Recordings From Activity List
Content: Symptom-Hours and billable hours appears incorrect when you export the time recordings under activity list for project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view and select the relevant Project-Select Activity List and select the Period Selection (Date From / To)-Select Go under the Time Recordings section-You can see the Hours and Billable Hours are correct-Select Export To Microsoft Excel®-In the export excel, you will see the incorrect hours-Cause-The export data depends on the time format which you have selected in your personalization settings. If you have set the time format to 12 hrs., then you-will see the converted value in the hour's column of the exported excel-For Example:-You have 14 hrs entered in the time sheet and the same will appear in the Time Recordings section under Activity List. You have time format defined for 12 hrs. When you export the list, system will calculate the hours as below;-14 hrs. (Employee time) - 12 hrs. (Time format) = 2 hrs. (Display hours in the export excel)-Resolution-You must change the time format to 24 hrs. and then system will show the complete hours in the exported excel-Keywords-Export time recordings to excel from activity list; Export time recordings;

Title: Error Message: Log.model Inconsistent; Logistics use not Permitted
Content: Symptom-When you are checking a Logistics Model, you get the error message: Log.model inconsistent; Logistics use not permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to the Logistics Models view.-Open the Logistics Model XYZ (XYZ represents the Logistics Model ID).-Click the Check button.-The system shows the error message: '----------> Log. model inconsistent; Logistics use  not permitted'.-Cause-In the Logistics Models, you have selected Source or Destination Logistics Use as Over The Counter Stock for one of the Operation. This Logistics Usage is only relevant for Over-The-Counter scenario, for which no Logistics Model is required.-Resolution-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to the Logistics Models view.-Open the Logistics Model XYZ.-Select the relevant Operation and change the Source or Destination Logistics Use as per your business requirement like Storage.-Now if you Check the Logistics Model, it will be consistent and will not show any error message.-Keywords-Logistics Model, Logistics Use, Over-The-Counter scenario

Title: Deliver From Selected Source of Supply Button is Disabled in Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-You want to change the Source of Supply of a Customer Demand of a Sales Order, but the "Deliver From Selected Source of Supply" button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Select the Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant Customer Demand and click the Edit button.-Go to the Line Items tab.-Select Alternative Sources sub-tab.-Select the relevant Source of Supply - "Deliver From Selected Source of Supply" button is disabled, so you are not able to change the source of supply.-Cause-The sales order is a Complete Delivery Order. For a Complete Delivery Order, it is not possible to change the Source of Supply from the Customer Demand.-Resolution-You can temporarily switch off Complete Delivery and then change the Source of Supply. After this you need to again switch on Complete Delivery. To do so, follow the below steps:-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Select the Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant Customer Demand, select it and click the Edit button.-Go to the Line Items tab.-Choose Actions and select Temporarily Switch Off Complete Delivery from the drop-down menu.-Select Alternative Sources sub-tab.-Select the relevant Source of Supply and now Deliver From Select Source of Supply button is enabled. Change the Source of Supply.-Again switch on Complete Delivery by selecting Actions and Temporarily Switch On Complete Delivery.-Click Save and Close button.-Keywords-deliver from selected source of supply disabled, customer demand, complete delivery, order, button

Title: Error Messages When Trying to Enter a Serial Number in a Production Task
Content: Symptom-You are facing errors when confirming Production Tasks which contain Product with the Serial Number Profile: Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes, and you need to enter a Serial Number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Execution work center.-Select the Production Tasks view.-Search and select the relevant Production Task.-Select Confirm.-Select the Output Product.-Select Serial Number tab.-Enter a Serial Number of your choice.-The system displays the errors messages:-Serial number ABC does not exist in inventory -Serial number ABC cannot be received to the logistics area-(ABC represents the Serial Number ID you entered)-Cause-You cannot create a Serial Number when confirming the Task. You have to enter a Serial Number which already exists in the system.-Resolution-You can check the existing Serial Number by following the steps below:-Go to Production Control.-Select Serial Inventory Overview common task.-Search for the Output Product of the relevant Task.-Select Go.-Check the available Serial Numbers. You will be able to enter any of them in the Production Task.-Keywords-Serial number cannot be received to the logistics area-Production Task-Serial Number

Title: Payment Terms Field Empty in Purchase Order Output
Content: Symptom-You create the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID) for a foreign Supplier. The output is in another language.-In the output, the field Payment Terms displays no data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find ABC.-Select Edit.-Click Preview - Created PO.-The field for Payment Terms is empty in the Purchase Order output.-Cause-You have created custom Payment terms but have not maintained their description in the language used by the Purchase Order output.-Resolution-You can maintained the description of the custom Payment Terms in other languages by following these steps:-Log into the system in the desired language.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find the activity Suppliers.-Select Define Payment Terms for Procurement.-You can enter the missing descriptions and they will be populated in the Purchase Order output.-Keywords-Purchase, Order, Payment, Terms, Output-purchase order,output,payment terms

Title: Competitor Role is Missing in the Involved Party Determination for Registered Products
Content: Symptom-You are defining roles for the involved parties in registered products and see that the role competitor is missing.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Current Project.-Click on Open Activity List.-Select Fine Tune.-Search and Open Activity Involved Parties for Registered Product, Installed Base.-Select Add Row-Here you see that there is no possibility to add an involved party competitor.-Cause-We don't provide any standard role code corresponding to the competitor for registered products/installed base.-However, you can include another party role code in the business configuration activity party role definition and the role defined here can then be added to the involved parties for registered products and installed base.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-See Also-Defining New Involved Party Roles-Keywords-Party roles competitior

Title: Dump When Serial Number is Entered In Pick Task
Content: Symptom-While entering serial number with Id ABC for a product XYZ in the pick task you receive a dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign [All Versions]-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to Task Control view.-Search for the relevant pick task and choose the Confirm button. -In Confirm Pick Task screen select the product XYZ and enter the serial number ABC in Serial Numbers sub-tab-Cause-The serial number with Id ABC have been used for the same product XYZ in another line item of the same pick task. Since you cannot ship a product with same serial number more than once in the same delivery you receive the reported dump.-Resolution-You will have to use a different serial number other than ABC for the product XYZ in the pick task.-Keywords-serial number, pick task, dump

Title: Error Occurs When Checking Consistency of A Production Model
Content: Symptom-When checking the consistency of the production model, you receive an error message :-Line item group not assigned to bill of material variant Production segment not consistent-though the line items have been assigned in the Production BoM to the variant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign [All Versions]-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Model view and choose any Production Model ID and edit it.-In the opened window, go to the Bill of Operations -> Product Assignment tab, select an activity.-In the table below, under the Bill of Material tab, choose any Line Item Group ID,which has not been assigned to any activity yet.-Select the Open Bill Of Material button and then Edit the Bill of Material Variant.-In the opened window, unassign the Line Item Group ID from the BoM variant, check the consistency of the BoM and save it.-Now, go back to the Production Model from where you navigated to the Bill Of Material Variant and assign the Line Item Group ID to the activity.-Save the Production Model and close the window.-Open the production model ID again and do a Check Consistency, the system throws the error message now.- Note : Do not Close Production Model, while making changes in the Production BoM Variant.-Cause-The main cause for this issue is that the Product Assignment details of the Production Model does not get refreshed when we edit the Bill Of Material Variant of that Production Model in the same session.-Resolution-In order to make the Production Model consistent kindly follow the below mentioned steps:--Go to the Planning and production Master Data work center.-Edit the respective Production Model and go to the General tab.-Under the Details section remove the BoM variant ID and do the check consistency again.-Still the error occurs saying production BoM variant not assigned.-Now select the value help for the BoM variant ID field and choose the Production BoM.-Then go to the Bill of Operations tab -> Product Assignment sub-tab, choose the element ID and perform Assign line Item group to Activity for all the products.-Then do the Check Consistency again, the production model will be consistent now.-You can avoid this issue in future by refreshing the Production Model view after we save the changes in the Bill Of Materials Variant. You can refresh the Production Model by reopening the Production Model again.-Keywords-production model, consistency, Bill Of Materials Variant, Item group

Title: Serial Inventory Overview For a Product Not Visible
Content: Symptom-You see that the stock of the product is visible in Stock Overview  screen, but not visible in Serial Inventory Overview  screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Common Task view and choose the option Serial Inventory Overview.-Enter the value in Product ID field and choose the button Go.-You see that the search returns no result.-Cause-In the Product Master Data, the Serial Number Profile is set as Optional Serial Number Assignment instead of Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes.-This functionality is not valid for old serial number profile. Serial Inventory View is only valid for a product with profile: Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes.-To see Serial Inventory Overview, you must change the serial number profile to Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes. Once this is done the system will create an automated count task and this task should be manually confirmed by the warehouse worker. If this system generated count task is not processed from your end, the Serial Inventory Overview will not have any visibility of the stock. This is valid even if you are changing the serial number profile from an older one.-Resolution-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Navigate to the Monitoring view and choose the option By PI Count Document.-Choose the advanced filter option and select the checkbox System Generated.-Choose the Go button.-You will see the system generated count document, select the count document for the relevant product and process the count task against the document.-Once the count task is processed and approved, you will see the product information in Serial Inventory Overview.-Keywords-Serialized Inventory, Mandatory Serial Number, Serial number in stock, Serial Number

Title: No report data available to display; check the selection
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you run report Project Assignments by Employee you receive an information message as" No report data available to display; check the selection."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Report ID PROPRJU05_Q0004-Report Name Project Assignments by Employee-Data Source IDPROPRJU05-Data Source Name Projects, Baselines, and Snapshots-Cause-There is a global restriction in the report that enables it to show only data for project assignment of all employees which are managed by you (direct reports).-There are no employees assigned to the org unit you are manager for, therefore, the report won't display any data.--As a workaround, you can create a custom report to view the data which do not include any such restrictions.-Resolution-The behavior of the report is as designed.-Keywords-Project Assignments by Employee-Report

Title: Multiple Attachments for Purchase Order Item in OCI Integration
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Purchase Order by importing the Items from an External Catalog via OCI Integration. For one of the Purchase Order Items you are attaching two attachments. For the first attachment you use the field NEW_ITEM-ATTACHMENT[1] and for the second attachment you use the field NEW_ITEM-ATTACHMENT2[1].-The creation of the Purchase Order is successful but when you open the document in the system you can see that the second attachment is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all systems.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find XXX (XXX represents the Purchase Order ID that you have created).-Go to the Items tab.-Highlight Item Y (Y represents the ID of the Purchase Order Item for which you attached the two attachments).-Select the Attachments subtab.-You can see that the first attachment has been transferred correctly to the Item. However, the second attachment is missing.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour. The system only supports one attachment per Purchase Order Item.-Resolution-Please only attach one document per Item when you create a Purchase Order from an External Catalog via OCI Integration.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Creation, Item, OCI, Open, Catalog, Interface, ECC, Integration, Import, External, Provider, Attachment, Multiple, Missing, Not, Included, Found, Transferred

Title: The Invoice Date in Supplier Invoices Uploaded via SAP Collaboration Window is Wrong
Content: Symptom-You are uploading Supplier Invoices via the SAP Collaboration Window using TXT and PDF files for each Supplier Invoice.-The upload is successful and you can find the uploaded Supplier Invoices in the Invoices and Credit Memos view of the Supplier Invoicing work center.-However, in the uploaded Supplier Invoices the Invoice Date is not the same as in the original TXT file. Another date found in the TXT and PDF files, for example the Due On date, has been assigned as Invoice Date in the uploaded Supplier Invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all systems.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents and search for ABC (ABC represents the relevant Supplier Invoice ID).-Click Edit.-Click View All.-In the General tab, you can see that the Invoice Date is not the same as in the TXT file used for the upload. Instead another date found in these files, for example the Due On date, has been assigned as the Invoice Date.-Cause-In the Supplier Invoice upload via SAP Collaboration Window, the system only uses the TXT file to verify the Invoice Date and no keywords are used in this verification. Instead the system checks for various date formats, for example dd.mm.yyyy or dd.mm.yy, in the TXT file.-If the Invoice Date has several formats in the TXT file, and another date has only one consistent format, then the date with the consistent format will be picked as the Invoice Date for the uploaded Supplier Invoices.-Resolution-Please make sure that in the TXT file that you use for the upload, the Invoice Date has one consistent date format if it appears more than once.-Keywords-SAP, Collaboration, Window, Supplier, Invoice, Upload, Invoice, Date, Wrong, Not, Correct, Same, TXT, PDF, File

Title: Unable to Create Project Stock Order
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create the project stock order for the project X (X refers to project ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects view.-Search for the Project X.-Click Edit and navigate to Products tab.-Select Products Overview under Products tab.-Click on Create Project Stock Order button.-Select the option For Whole Project.-You don't see the materials you expected.-Cause-You expect to create a project stock order for the sales order materials created after the project is released.-You create a Sales Order A (A refers to sales order ID) and link it to project X. The details of the sales order will be present in the Sales Tracking tab. The materials of the stand-alone sales order A linked to the project XXX will not be updated under the Materials sub tab of the Project Plan screen.-Resolution-A project stock order can be created only for the materials present under the Materials sub tab of the Project Plan screen. If you want to create the project stock order for the materials of the stand-alone sales order which is linked to the project later, you need to maintain the materials manually under the Materials tab of the Project Plan screen.-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Project stock order, unable to create project stock order, sales order not updating items under project plan, materials

Title: System is Proposing Wrong Logistics Area While Doing Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You have defined destination rules in your Location layout. However, system is proposing wrong Logistics Area while doing Post Goods Receipt against a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to  Inbound Logistics work center.-2. Select Purchase Orders view.-3. Search for the relevant Purchase Order.-4. Choose Post Goods Receipt button.-5. In the new screen, system is suggesting some Logistics Area but as per the destination rules you have defined it is not the correct Logistics Area.-Cause-In the Location layout, you have a Location under the Site. You have defined the destination rule at Location level and not at Site level. The material flow rules at the Location level are redundant and are not considered for any destination determination.-For the inbound process, destination determination of Logistics Area happens based on material rule defined at the Site level. Since there is no rule defined at Site level, system is considering default put-away strategy, which is First Found. So system is proposing the Logistics Area based on this rule.-Resolution-To resolve the issue delete the destination rule which you have maintained at Location level and then maintain the same rule at Site level.-Keywords-wrong, logistics, area, post, goods, receipt, site, material, flow, rules, location

Title: Serial Inventory Overview For a Product Not Visible
Content: Symptom-You have a product with serial number profile Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes. You see that the stock of the product is visible in Stock Overview screen, but not visible in Serial Inventory Overview screen.-Environment-All Business ByDesign Environment-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Common Task view and choose the option Serial Inventory Overview.-Enter the value in Product ID field and choose the button Go.-You see that the search returns no result.-Cause-You have changed the Serial Number Profile field value to Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes after receving the product in your warehouse. Once the above change is done the system will create an automated count task and this task will have to be manually confirmed by the warehouse worker. If this system generated count task is not processed from your end, the Serial Inventory Overview will not have any visibility of the stock. This is valid even if you are changing the serial number profile from an older one.-Please note that you will not be able to perform any inventory related activity on the product unless you process the system generated count task and the same is approved by the warehouse manager.-Resolution-Go to Physical Inventory work center.-Navigate to the Monitoring view and choose the option By PI Count Document.-Choose the advanced filter option and select the check box System Generated.-Choose the Go button.-You will see the system generated count document, select the count document for the relevant product and process the count task against the document.-Once the count task is processed and approved, you will see the product information in Serial Inventory Overview.-Keywords-Serialzed Inventory, Mandatory Serial Number, Serial number in stock, Serial Number

Title: Purchase Order Status is Incorrect
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order status is Finished even if the Supplier Invoice is not Posted successfully. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant purchase order ID. -Its status is 'Finished'. -Now checking the Supplier Invoice linked to this Order: -Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant Invoice ID.-Its status is 'In Exception'. -It wasn't expected to have a Finished purchase order if its invoice is not Posted. -Cause-When the Supplier Invoice is created and saved/posted, an official entry has been made in the system for the corresponding Purchase Order. The Exception status occurs only when the user tries to post the Invoice with some incorrect data. This means that the official Invoice is created but due to some inconsistencies, the user is unable to post it. Once the inconsistencies are rectified, the Invoice will be posted.-If in case the Invoice has been cancelled or voided, then the Purchase Order status will be automatically set to Follow-Up Document Created (if the delivery is completed).-If the Purchase Order has been partially invoiced, its status is still Follow-Up Document Created (only because all the quantity is not used up for invoicing and there is no official document created for all the ordered and delivered quantities).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-PO status, Purchase order status, Finished, supplier invoice, in exception, exception

Title: Intrastat Declaration with Type Arrival Inconsistent
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release an Intrastat Declaration with type Arrival but you can see that one or more items are inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center.-Select Intrastat Declarations view.-Search for Intrastat Declaration XXX (XXX represents the relevant Intrastat Declaration ID).-Click on Edit.-Go to Items tab.-You can see that there are inconsistent Items and therefore you cannot release the Intrastat Declaration.-Cause-A possible reason for the inconsistency could be the missing value for the field Region of Destination.-You can ensure that this is the reason by performing the following steps:-Go to Intrastat work center.-Select Intrastat Declarations view.-Search for Intrastat Declaration XXX (XXX represents the relevant Intrastat Declaration ID).-Click on Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Highlight an affected item.-Go to the Basic Data tab.-Check if there is any value maintained in the Region of Destination field.-If there is no value maintained in this field then this is the reason for the inconsistency. The Region of Destination data should be pulled automatically by the system when creating an Invoice Declaration. However, if the state has not been maintained in the address of the relevant Ship-To/Service Location then the Region of Destination field does not get populated automatically in the Intrastat Declaration.-Resolution-In the Master Data of the relevant Ship-To/Service Location you have to add the respective state to the address data.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select the Locations view.-Select Active Sites.-Find and then highlight the relevant Site.-In the Details tab, Office Address sub tab, you can see that the State has not been maintained.-Click Edit.-Under Location Address click on Additional Fields.-Enter the respective State.-Click OK.-Click Save.-Please note that this will only affect future Intrastat Declarations but will not correct the inconsistent items in existing Intrastat Declarations.-In existing Intrastat Declarations, you need to add the Region of Destination manually to each inconsistent item.-Go to Intrastat work center.-Select Intrastat Declarations view.-Search for Intrastat Declaration XXX (XXX represents the relevant Intrastat Declaration ID).-Click on Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Highlight an affected item.-Go to the Basic Data tab.-Click on the arrow in the Region of Destination field-Select the respective state.-Click Save.-Once you have added the Region of Destination value for all inconsistent items you will be able to release the Intrastat Declaration.-Keywords-Intrastat, Declaration, Item, Error, Inconsistent, Release, Cannot, Not Able, Region, Of, Destination

Title: Ship-To Address in Shopping Cart is Incorrect
Content: Symptom-The updated Ship-To address in Organizational Management is not reflected in shopping cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select Self Services Overview view.-Select Go Shopping (Advanced).-Enter the Ship To location ID.-You can see the updated Ship To address is not picked up in shopping cart.-Cause-The Ship To location address is picked up from the Locations view of the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center. This is the Site address to where you want the goods to be delivered.-Any changes to the Ship To address made here, will be effective in the Ship To address in the shopping cart. It is the same case with the description as well.--If the specific site address is not mentioned, then the system will take the company address maintained in the Organizational Management work center.-Resolution-Kindly modify the Ship To location address and the Description and Site Name in the Locations view. Follow the below steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Locations view.-Search for the site.-Modify the details - the Ship To Location and also the Description.-Save and close.-This is the standard system behavior.-Note: this is the same behavior with respect to purchase orders as well.-Keywords-Ship To location, Ship to address, Ship To

Title: MRP Proposals Split for Each Demand
Content: Symptom-You notice that irrespective of the Lot Sizing Method maintained in Material/Product master data, MRP proposals are not consolidated into one Demand.-Instead, the system creates one proposal for each demand entry in the Planning screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Planning workcenter and Products view.-2. Show All Products by Selection and Find Product ABC.-3. Open Product Planning Details.-Here you will notice that system has created multiple Production Proposals for same date with different quantity,instead of consolidating all the requirement into one Production Proposal.-Cause-In case of product specification for the material, system will only consider Lot-for-Lot as the Lot Sizing Method.-Also if you have selected Demand-Driven Planning as your Planning procedure, all planning proposals are created by date and quantity for each requirement.-Resolution-This is expected System Behavior.-Keywords-MRP proposals, Lot Sizing Method, Lot-for-Lot,production proposal, Product Specification

Title: Error Message Regarding Missing Tax Classification for Product When Ordering a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to order a Purchase Order but the system triggers the following error message “Item XXX: Tax classification for product XYZ missing” (Item XXX represents the relevant Purchase Order Item ID).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Oder ABC (ABC represents the relevant Purchase Order ID).-Click on Order.-The Purchase Order ABC doesn't get ordered and the system displays the error message “Item XXX: Tax classification for product XYZ missing” (Item XXX represents the relevant Purchase Order Item ID).-Cause-You created the Purchase Order ABC with free text item but you have not set the Tax Classification for the relevant Product Category.-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Set Tax Classification from the Common Tasks menu.-Click on Add Row.-Enter the necessary data to set the Tax Classification for the relevant Product Category.-Click on Save and Activate.-Now you will be able to order the Purchase Order ABC.-Keywords-Purchase, Order, Item, Unable, Fail, Error, Message, Tax, Classification, Product, Missing

Title: System Triggers a Backend  Error While Confirming an Inbound Delivery Task
