Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm an Inbound Task, but after you have entered the necessary details, and click on Save, the system displays a backend error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Find and select the relevant Task ID.-Click the Confirm button.-Enter the necessary details (Quantity, Target Logistics Area, and so on).-Click the Save button.-The system shows a backend Dump.-Cause-The Error is triggered, because you have not maintained the Country Code for the Ship-To address. Maintaining Country Code for the Ship-to Location is mandatory when you scope Intrastat.-Note: This dump is also triggered if you have not maintained the Business Partner (Supplier) address.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, kindly edit the Location and maintain the Country Code for all Locations. You can do this by following the steps below:-Navigate to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations View.-Select the relevant Location.-Click the Edit button and maintain the Country of the Ship-To Location.-Keywords-Inbound Task, Countries not found, Location, Dump

Title: The Expected Discount in Supplier Invoice is not Correct
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a discounted Supplier Invoice and after you have provided the discount you are unable to see the expected Net Price.-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-2.Select New Invoice entry.-3.Select View All.-4.Select the General tab enter the Discount.-5.Go to Items Tab Enter the Invoice details and the items.-6.The Net Prices are not correct.--Cause-There is a high possibility the discount have been not correct maintained in the Supplier Invoice.-Resolution-You can enter all the Deduction/Discounts manually from:-1.Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-2.Select New Invoice entry.-3.Select View All.-4.Select Deduction and Surcharges Tab.-5.Select here your settings which you need.-6.Click the Actions button and choose Calculate Total Amounts.--This should show you the expected correct values in the Invoice.-Keywords-Discount, Supplier, Invoice, Deduction, Net, Amount, Price, Surcharges

Title: System  Crashes When Trying To Perform  Post Goods Receipt as Planned Against Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When you perform Post Goods Receipt as Planned against a purchase order, system throws an exception.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center-Go to Purchase Orders View-In the field, Show, choose Due and Overdue Purchase Orders via drop-down-Find and select relevant Purchase Order ID-choose option :Post Goods Receipt as Planned-System throws an exception.-Cause-There is no Logistics Model exists for Standard Receiving without task for relevant Site ID.-Resolution-Create Logistics Model for Standard Receiving without task using below steps:-Create Logistics Model for Standard Receiving without task using below steps:-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data Work center-Go to Logistics Models View-Choose New and select required Logistics Model Template ID as INB_NO_TASK_RECEIVING - Template for receiving without tasks-Then choose New Logistics Model ID name as per your requirement-Now select required Site ID using value selection for which you want to create logistics model without tasks-Once it is created, check the status it should be Consistent and enter all required details as per your business requirement-Perform release and save.-Keywords-post goods receipt, Standard Receiving without task, Inbound Logitics,Logistics model for Standard Receiving without task for site ID missing. Create a new logistics model for the site with the relevant template in the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center, Creation of inbound delivery failed, purchase order

Title: In the Sales Quote or Sales Order, a column for milestone invoicing is missing.
Content: Symptom-While creating the Sales Quote and Sales Order, a column for milestone invoicing is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business Work center-Select the New Sales Quote-Enter the required information-Now navigate to Pricing and Invoicing then Invoice Schedule sub tab-Here you can see the Milestone field is missing-Or-Go to Sales Order Work center-Select the New Sales Order-Enter the required information-Now navigate to Pricing and Invoicing then Invoice Schedule sub tab-Here you can see the Milestone field is missing-Cause-The Milestone invoicing is only supported for the project based items. The sales Quote or Sales Order item should be created as a project-based service and have a link to a project task.Once the project is liked the Milestone field will be shown under Invoice Schedule.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Keywords-milestone invoicing-Sales Order-Sales Quote

Title: Purchase Order Output Sent to Unexpected Email Address
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2571549***-In a Sent Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID), the email address of the Output is not the default address used by the Supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, All Versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find ABC.-Select Edit.-Go to Output History tab.-The Email To address is not the one present in the Supplier's Master data.-Cause-The Output settings can be temporarily changed just for one output via the button You can also - Edit Output Settings for Create PO. Once this output is sent, the settings revert back to the default.-The editor of the Purchase Order has changed the Purchase Order Output settings to another address, which can be seen in the Output History tab.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Purchase, Order, Output, History, Email, To, Edit, Output, Settings, Email, Address, Supplier

Title: Multi Customer Projects – Expnese are not available for Project Invoicing
Content: Symptom-Multi Customer Projects – recorded times are not available for Project Invoicing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Click on Not Invoiced Time and Expenses-Search for Multi Customer Project-Cause-In case of Multi-Customer Projects the creation of project invoice request is not supported hence you are unable to see the actual expense like time recording under “Not Invoiced Times and Expenses" view.-Resolution-You can Invoice Multi-Customer Projects through standard customer invoice request and also you can create Milestone Invoicing for a Multi-Customer Projects-Keywords-Multi Customer Projects-Project Invoicing

Title: While Migrating Location and Logistics Area through Migration Tool, Error Appears
Content: Symptom-Error message triggered  when migrating Location and Logistics Area.-The Sequence ID of advanced material flow should be unique every time-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Business Configuration Work Center.-Go To Overview View.-Search for Migration of Location and Logistics Area.-Select the Migration tool.-Select the file to upload.-Select Execute Migration -> Execute step by step-Cause-As per the standard, currently system does not support the material flow creation without the destination.-It is mandatory to maintain both the source and the destination for the material flow rules.-Resolution-In Location - Material Flow Tab, add the Destination for every source entry and change the Sequence IDs accordingly.-Keywords-The Sequence ID of advanced material flow, should be unique every time, The Sequence ID of advanced material flow should be unique every time

Title: Project Task not Available in Add Time Entry - Work Package Task Field
Content: Symptom-You are recording Time Entries for a Project Task. Although you are assigned to the Project Task, it doesn’t show up in the Work Package Task list in the Add Time Entry screen.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Click on Edit Time Sheet.-Select the desired date.-Click Add Time Entry.-In the Current Work Packages pane, you can see the Project Task ABC (ABC represents the relevant Project Task).-Click on value selection for the field Work Package Task.-The Project Task ABC is not listed.-Close value selection and enter Project Task ABC directly into the Work Package Task field.-No records found.-Cause-The duration of the relevant Project has been changed in the Project Management work center and the date you selected for the Time Entry is outside of the original duration of the Project. The Add Time Entry Work List has not yet synchronised the Project’s duration change and therefore the Project Task is not visible in the list.-The Current Work Package pane on the pop up Add Time Entry screen, shows all Project Tasks that you are assigned to, regardless of the duration of the Project or if the selected date is outside of the original duration of the Project. Therefore, Project Task ABC shows up in this pane.-Resolution-Please save the Edit Time Sheet screen once before you try to add the Time Entry. The Time Sheet will then synchronise the changes made to the duration of any Project that you are assigned to, and Project Task ABC will be available in the Work Package Task field.-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Click on Edit Time Sheet.-Click Save.-Keywords-Edit, Time, Sheet, Recording, Add, Entry, Work, Package, Task, Project, Missing, Not, Available

Title: Status of Shopping Cart Changes to Delivered Although Goods and Services Receipt has Only Been Saved
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Goods and Services Receipt for a Shopping Cart. You save the Goods and Service Receipt without delivering it. The status of the document is In Preparation but the status of the relevant Shopping Cart changes to Delivered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Choose the Self-Services overview.-Select Track my Shopping Carts.-Show Shopping Carts – Completed.-Find Shopping Cart ID ABC (ABC represents the relevant Shopping Cart ID).-Click on the Shopping Cart ID to open it.-Click on View All.-Go to Document Flow tab.-You can see that the Goods and Services Receipt ID XYZ (XYZ represents the relevant Goods and Services Receipt ID) has status In Preparation.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour. Once a Goods and Services Receipt is created for a Shopping Cart and saved with status In Preparation (but not released), then the status of the Shopping Cart changes to Delivered.-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Status, Delivered, Not Delivered, Goods and Services Receipt, In Preparation, Receipt

Title: Unable to Change the Status of a Resource Group to Block or Set to Obsolete due to an Error
Content: Symptom--You want to change the status of a Resource Group to Block or Set to Obsolete. However, when performing the change the system returns an error: At least one resource must be assigned to resource group ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Resource group).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Work Center Supply Chain Design Master Data.-2. Enter view Resources.-3. Show Resource Groups and Find ABC.-4. Click Edit.-5. Click Change Status button and select either Set to Obsolete or Block.-Result: The system will throw an error `At least one resource must be assigned to resource group ABC`.-Cause-This is an expected system behaviour. To change the status of a Resource Group you have to change the status of all its elements beforehand.-Resolution-1. Assign a Resource to the affected Resource Group ABC.--2. Save the change.--3. Change the Status of the Resource to Obsolete.--4. Save the change.--5. Now you'll be able to change the Status of the Resource Group to Obsolete as well.--6. Go back to the Resource and change its status to `Undo Obsolete` and `Unblock`. The Resource will be in status: Active again.-Keywords-Resource, Group, Set, Obsolete, Block,Status, Undo, Active, Change

Title: How to Pull Notes's Details for List of Purchase order
Content: Symptom-You require a report with all types of note's details mentioned in each Purchase order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Application and user management-Go to Data extraction view-Click on New button-Enter Run ID and then choose extraction object as Purchase order-Click on Add row button-Add purchase order under parameter name, choose operator as between and enter upper and Lower limit that is starting purchase order ID and last purchase order ID as required-Click on save button and then click on active button-Wait for some time (based on the amount of data it will take time)-Select the run ID and below when you scroll down you will see the extraction files-Download and then while saving, change the extension to XLS-  In the File you will see all note's details related to all purchase orders-Keywords-Notes in reports,notes of purchase orders in reports,Purchase order note's details in report

Title: You Cannot Maintain Seller or Invoicing Unit Field in Delivery Note Form Template
Content: Symptom-You are trying to maintain the Seller and / or Invoicing Unit for Delivery Notes, but when you enter a value and save the changes this is not reflected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work center Application and User Management.-Go to the view Form Template Selection.-In the Show Rules For box, select: Delivery Note.-Click the Go button.-Select the Form Template XYZ (XYZ represents the name of the Form template you want to edit).-Click the Edit button.-Maintain a value using Value Selector in the 'Seller / Invoicing Unit' field.-Click the button 'Save and Close' to save the change made.-Open the template again, and you can see that field is empty, the change made was not saved.-Cause-Delivery Note is not a business document that can be invoiced, hence Seller or Invoicing Unit cannot be seen from the Delivery notes.-Resolution-System is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Seller, Invoicing, Unit, Delivery Note, Form Template, Notes

Title: How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item for which the delivery and invoicing not yet started.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Search and Edit the Sales Order and click the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select line which is of type project based items like Service - fixed price (project), Service - time and material (project) etc.-You can see the Reason for Rejection is no more editable.-Cause-The Reason for rejection field is not editable if the relevant project or project task is set to complete-Resolution-To enable the Reason for Rejection field you have to revoke Project or Project Task status back to Released.-Follow steps mentioned below to revoke completion of the Project or Project Task status back to Released. This action needs to be performed by the Project Manager.-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects View.-Choose Project.-Edit --> Project Plan Button.-Navigate to Project Task.-Go to Basic Data tab.-Choose Project Task Status value help choose the Revoke Closure and Revoke Completion and Save.-Keywords-Reason for Rejection-Project Based Sales Order Item

Title: On-Hand Stock in Project Material Flow is Zero
Content: Symptom-On hand stock in project material flow is zero while it shows non-zero value in stock overview.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go the Internal Logistics work center.-Go to the Stock Overview view.-Enter Material ID XYZ (XYZ stands for material ID).-Enter Logisitcs area ABC (ABC stands for Logistics area ID).-Enter Identified Stock XXX (XXX stands for Identified Stock ID).-Click Go.-You can see that on-hand stock is YYY (e.g 20 ea).-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Project Material Flow view.-Enter the same paramenters.-Click Go.-You can see that on-hand stock is 0 ea.-Cause-Identified Stock XXX has already expired. Project Material Flow considered stock of expired identified stock as zero on-hand stock.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work center.-Go to Identified Stock View-Search Identified Stock XXX-Select it and Click Edit.-Change the expiration date to a future date.-Click Save and Close.-Keywords-Zero on-hand stock; Project Material Flow

Title: Production Task ID are not in Sequence
Content: Symptom-You created a Production Order, but notice that the Production Task IDs are not in sequence, for example the Supply Task ID and the Make Task ID are not in sequence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control workcenter.-Go to the Production Order view.-Find and select the relevant Production Order.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Order Structure tab.-You can see that the Supply Task ID and Make Task ID are not in sequence.-Cause-Task ID is proposed by system randomly during run time.-Resolution-You will have to follow the Start Feasibility in the Task control screen. This means you have to start with the Task with the green Start Feasibility symbol.-Once this Task is completed system will set the Start Feasibility for the next task in sequence to Green.-Keywords-Production Task, Production Order, Make Task, Supply Task, Start Feasibility, Sequence

Title: You Cannot Change the Posting Date in a Supplier Invoice In Process
Content: Symptom-You are creating and saving a New Supplier Invoice. The Supplier Invoice has the status In Process. You now want to change the Posting Date of the Supplier Invoice but this is not possible as the Posting Date field is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents.-Find Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC refers to the relevant Supplier Invoice ID).-Click Edit.-Although the Supplier Invoice ABC has the status In Process, the Posting Date cannot be changed as the field is greyed out.-Cause-In the scoping activity Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing, for Document Type Supplier Invoices and the relevant Company ID, you have maintained the Posting Date for Year Suffix Selection Date.-When creating and saving a new Supplier Invoice, the system assigns a document number to the Supplier Invoice based on the configuration maintained for Supplier Invoices and the relevant Company ID in the scoping activity Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing.-If the Posting Date is maintained for Year Suffix Selection Date, the Posting Date is an integral part of the number assigned to the Supplier Invoice, and cannot be changed after saving the Supplier Invoice, because in this case the Year Suffix would have to be changed as well and the whole document number would have to be regenerated.-Since Invoices are legal documents that in many countries by law have to be created and posted in sequence, the system doesn’t allow the change of the Posting Date after the Supplier Invoice has been saved if the Posting Date is configured as Year Suffix Selection Date.-If there is any invoice , whose ID  has year suffix, that is being determined from the posting date, the changes to Posting date will no longer be allowed once the invoice id has been generated and assigned to invoice irrespective of invoice status.-Which means once ID is generated even for in process invoice or invoices which have not yet been posted the posting date will be blocked for editing once the invoice is saved. This will be deployed in all  systems in 2005 release upgrade.-Which also means-Even within same year if they want to change the  posting date we don’t allow-Resolution-If your use case allows it and you don’t need the Posting Date to be configured as Year Suffix Selection Date, you can adjust the configuration of the scoping activity Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing accordingly.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select the relevant Implementation Project.-Click Open Activity List.-Select Fine Tune tab.-Show All Activities.-Find Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing.-Click Open.-Click Insert Row.-Select the relevant Company ID and for Document Type choose Supplier Invoice.-Enter a Prefix Value and select a Separator.-Check Calendar Year as Suffix and Restart Doc. ID Each Cal. Year.-Leave the Year Suffix Selection Date empty.-Click Move Up Row.-Click Save.-This newly created row will now determine the Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoices for the relevant Company ID. As Posting Date is not maintained as Year Suffix Selection Date, you will be able to change the Posting Date after creating and saving new Supplier Invoices for the same Company ID.- or-If you just want to change Posting date then only way is to void or cancel the existing invoice and create new one with correct posting date-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, New Supplier Invoice, Saved, In Process, Posting Date, cannot change, can't change, unable to change, cannot adjust, can't adjust, unable to adjust, cannot modify, can't modify, unable to modify, Posting Date field, greyed out

Title: Multiple Purchase Requests are Created Through Release Purchase Proposal Runs
Content: Symptom-Multiple Purchase Requests are Created for Product KLM through Release Purchase Proposal Runs at the same time interval.*KLM refers to Product Id*DEF refers to Planning Area id*XY, RS, PQ refers to Purchase Proposals-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products View.-Search for Product KLM, Planning area DEF-Select Open-We observe multiple purchase requests XY, RS, PQ created for Product KLM ,Planning Area DEF at same time interval.-Cause-For more details on how purchase proposals are created you can go to product planning details and then select the proposal and open-material flow to see for which demand proposal is created.-MRP run doesn't club all demands and create only one proposal.-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour. In order to check the assignments of Purchase Proposals we can follow the below steps.-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products View.-Search for Product KLM, Planning area DEF-Select Open-Navigate to Supply and Demand tab-Select Purchase request and select Open Material Flow tab to understand the picture. -Keywords-Multiple Purchase Requests are Created, Release Purchase Proposal Runs creates Multiple Purchase requests

Title: Document Approved by User Different From Designated Approver
Content: Symptom-A business document XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the business document) is In Approval following the multi-step approval process set-up.-For one step of that process, the User ABC (ABC represents the ID of the expected approver) receives the approval task but you can see that User DEF (DEF represents the ID of the unexpected approver) is the approver.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view.-Go to Track Shopping Carts.-Find XYZ.-Select Edit.-Click on Show Approval Details.-You can see that User DEF has approved the document XYZ.-Cause-Under the Task Substitution view, a substitution is maintained for User ABC to be substituted by User DEF.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Approval, Task substitution, Approval task, Wrong approver, shopping cart, purchase order, supplier invoice-purchase order,supplier invoice,approval,shopping cart,task substitution,wrong approver, approval task

Title: Supplier Invoice Document Number for Italian Companies
Content: Symptom-The Supplier Invoice Document Number for Italian companies is generated as 1, 2, etc... instead of the rule maintained under Document Numbering Format for Supplier Invoice under Business Configuration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the document XXX (XXX refers to invoice ID searched).-Cause-In order to overcome the challenges faced by the end users like sequential approving, sequential posting of the supplier invoice, cancellation of the document, a recent development is done on the feature.-A document number is generated when the document is saved for the first time. Once the legal document ID is generated for Italian Companies, they must be posted or approved in the sequential way.-Resolution-After the recent development, when the user clicks on Save button for the Supplier Invoice of Italian company, there is a global document ID generated. This is not the Legal ID. The Legal Document ID will be generated only when the invoice is posted successfully. The legal ID is displayed on the General tab with the field name Sequential Document Number.-Note: The Sequential Document Number follows the same rule maintained under Document Numbering Format for Supplier Invoice under Business Configuration work center.-See Also-2826742 - You are Unable to Post Italy Supplier invoice even though Invoice Status is "Ready for Posting"-1758121 - How to Configure Supplier Invoice Number Range in Sequence-Keywords-Supplier invoice; Italian Supplier Invoices; Document number for Italian invoices; Supplier Invoice ID; Supplier Invoice Document Number for Italy

Title: Cannot determine account origin for expense/income group General expenses in company
Content: Symptom-You will see this error in the project plan values related to expenses-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project name).-Choose the View Plan Values button.-You can see that some of the project tasks are in Error status marked in Red color.-Choose a project task and navigate to the Messages tab here you can see the error message.-Cause-The project valuation will be failed for the respective Expenses, if the account determination group is not maintained or if the account is not maintained.-Resolution-Kindly follow below steps to maintain the GL accounts for Account determination group for General expenses.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tune tab.-Search and choose Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Choose the Open button.-Choose the Account Determination then Go to Costs.-Choose the Account Determination Profile.-Choose the Costs and then choose General expenses tab and maintain the Account Determination Group for General Expenses and also mainatin the respective GL Account under general expense column.-Keywords-Error with expenses in project plan values,Cannot determine account origin for expense

Title: How to Delete or Remove Project Types
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Project. When choosing the Project Type you can see that many Project Types are available that you don't need.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects view.-Click on New and choose Project from the drop-down menu.-In the first step (Enter Initial Data) expand the drop down menu for the Project Type field.-You can see all available Project Types for project creation but there is no delete function that allows you to delete the Project Types you don't need.-Cause-This is expected system behavior. It is not possible to delete standard delivered project types.-Resolution-It is possible to set not needed Project Types as obsolete in the Business Configuration. Once a Project Type has been set as obsolete it will not show up in the drop-down menu while creating a new project.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project.-Click Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Show Activities in Project and Find Project Types.-Click Open.-You can mark the check box in the Obsolete column for every Project Type you no longer need.-Click Save and Close-Keywords-Project Type, Delete, Remove, Obsolete, New Project

Title: Reschedule Bottom-Up Action in Resources Does not Affect Production Proposal Dates
Content: Symptom-You are performing Reschedule Bottom-Up action on a production resource. You see that the Start Date of the proposals does not get rescheduled as you expect.-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to the Supply Planning work center.-2.Navigate to the Resource Load view.-3.Search for the relevant resource and choose the Open button.-4.In the Resource Planning Details screen, choose the Reschedule Bottom-Up button.- When you check your production proposals using the above resource you see that the Start Date of the proposals are not rescheduled.-Cause-Performing the Reschedule action on the resource will not change the Start Date of the proposals of a particular product. You have to perform the Reschedule Bottom-Up action for a product from the material Flow view of the product available in the lowest level of the production chain. This will make sure that all the proposals in the above top level are adjusted accordingly.-Resolution-1.Go to the Supply Planning work center.-2.Navigate to the Products view.-3.Search for the relevant product whose proposals you need to reschedule, select it and choose the button Open.-4.In the Product Planning Details screen, select the production proposal and choose the button Open Material Flow.-5.In the Material Flow screen you can perform the Reschedule Bottom-Up action for the product available in the lowest level of the production chain.- Performing the above steps will adjust all the proposals in the above level accordingly.-Keywords-Supply Planning, Production Proposal, Reschedule, Bottom-up, Resources, Product

Title: Significance of Goods Issue Processing Time
Content: Symptom-In the product master data, the Goods Issue Processing Time can be defined. What is the significance of this field?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to the Product Data work center.-2.Select the Materials view.-3.Search for a product.-4.Select it and choose Edit button.-5.In the new screen, choose View All button.-6.Go to the Availability Confirmation tab. Here you can define Good Issue Processing Time. You want to know what is the significance of this field.-Cause---Resolution-Goods Issue processing Time is considered during scheduling of customer order. Starting from the requested delivery date you enter in the sales order, service order, stock transfer order or sales quote and considering the shipping duration of the transport lane, the goods issue processing time of the product, and the working day calendar of the ship-from location, the system determines the requested execution start date at the ship-from location.-Note that no calendar is considered for the shipping duration. However, the working day calendar and the operating hours of the ship-from location are considered for the goods issue processing time. If you do not enter anything in the product data, the system uses a goods issue processing time of zero for scheduling.-Keywords-Availability, Confirmation, Goods, Issue, Processing, Time, Product, Significance

Title: Cannot Create New Logistics Area Using Migration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You need to create new logistics areas in your system using the migration activity Migration of Location and Logistics Area.-In the simulation step, you may receive an error or you may be able to complete the import, but even if no error is displayed, the logistics areas are not imported to the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Location and Logistics Area.-Select the option to use the Migration Tool.-Select the migration file and execute the migration.-An error occurs in simulation or no error occurs, however when checking the system, no logistics area has been migrated.-Cause-In case you already have a Location in the system and is trying to add new Logistics Areas to it, the migration will fail. No error message specific to this information will be triggered; however no data will be transferred to the system.-Resolution-When executing migration of Locations and Logistics Areas, it is necessary to migrate both Locations and Logistics Areas at the same time, on one go.The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Migration of Location and Logistics Area, Migration of Location, Migration of Logistics Areas, service call failed, report an case

Title: Physical Inventory Count Ignores Key Date
Content: Symptom-The issue will be explained by the following example, where all the provided values are for example purpouses only:-You are performing a Physical Inventory Count on 01.09.2018 (set as a Key Date) and you are entering the results on 09.09.2018. In the meantime (the period between 01.09 and 09.09) there are changes in stock and the system is considering those changes in the PI Count document. -You are expecting that you should be able to enter the Actual Quantity for the Key Date  and not for the date when the document is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue--1. Physical Inventory Count created with key date 01.09.2018.-Example material: ABC (ABC represents the Product ID) - 10EA on stock.-2. count task executed by employee 01.09.2018.-Example material: ABC - 8EA counted.-3. some customer ordered 5EA of material ABC; the order was processed and material shipped before 09.09.2016.-Example material: ABC - 5EA on stock.-4. count task finished 09.09.2018.-Example material: ABC - 8EA reported and finished.-There are still 5EA on stock.-5. Physical Inventory Count approved 09.09.2018.-Example material: ABC - 8EA on stock.--Result: Stock has changed from 5 to 8 which is +3 instead of -2 (actually 8 have been counted and 10 had been on stock).-Cause- The Physical Inventory Count is an inventory adjustment which works only on the current inventory snapshot.-When you do an inventory adjustment, it will always adjust the current inventory.-Resolution-When you do an inventory adjustment with a key date which is not current date, the system performs the adjustment to the current inventory snapshot but posts it at a different date.-Even though you have done the inventory adjustment with a different key date, it will adjust the current inventory only.-This is an expected system behaviour.

Title: Webservice InboundDeliveryProcessingDeliveryNotificationIn Fails When Processing Purchase Orders.
Content: Symptom-You are using the Webservice InboundDeliveryProcessingDeliveryNotificationIn to process deliveries for Purchase Orders. However for some of the purchase orders you are receiving the following error:-Operation not possible; purchase order does not exist.-The purchase order exists in the system, the error seems unjustified.-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Application and User Management Work Center-2.Go to Web Service Message Monitoring View-3.Select the filter Erroneous and execute the search-4.Select the failled message and see the error:- Operation not possible; purchase order does not exist.-Cause-The message seems unjustified because the purchase order exists in the system. The issue occurs due to the type of item you are using in the Purchase Order.-The webservice is valid only if To-Stock items are used in purchase orders, where inbound deliveries are involved. For Non-Stock items, where no inbound delivery is necessary, the webservice fails returning the given error.-Resolution-System is working as designed. The webservice InboundDeliveryProcessingDeliveryNotificationIn cannot process Purchases Orders containing only Non-Stock items.-Keywords-InboundDeliveryProcessingDeliveryNotificationIn, Purchase Order, Operation not possible, purchase order does not exist, webservice

Title: Purchase Proposals Does not Show Earliest Requirement Dates
Content: Symptom-Earliest Requirement Date is missing in Purchase Proposal KLM*KLM refers to Purchase Proposal Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control work center-Navigate to Process Purchase Proposal view-Select All proposals by selection-Search for Purchase Proposal KLM-Navigate to sub tab Proposal Details-You observe purchase proposal KLM earliest requirement date is missing for Material ID DEF.*DEF refers to Material Id-Cause-Purchase Proposal KLM is a firm proposal which means it is manually created. Firm Proposals will not have Earliest Requirement date.-Earliest Requirement is something related to proposals that are created by MRP run because of some demand, Demand may be like Sales-Order, Stock Transfer Order etc.-Resolution-Firm Proposals will not have Earliest Requirement date.-Earliest Requirement is something related to proposals that are created by MRP run because of some demand, Demand may be like Sales-Order, Stock Transfer Order etc.This is the standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Earliest Requirement Date is missing, Purchase Proposal does not contain Earliest Requirement Date.

Title: Unable to Assign Line Item Group To Activity to Products in a Production Model
Content: Symptom-You have created a Production Model via webservice . Now you want to Assign Line Item Group to Activity to products in a production model however there is no tag available to assign activity in a production model.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You are able to create a Production Model in a system via webservice however you are unable to assign product in a production model via webservice directly.-Cause-Currently it is not possible to assign product in a production model via webservice.-There is no tag to assign product in a production model therefore items cannot be assigned under the Product Assignment tab automatically.--However you have to perform the Assign Line Item Group to Activity for the BoM line items manually in the production model.-Resolution-Go to Production and Planning Masterdata workcenter.-Go to Production Model view.-Show All Production Models and find the relevant Production Model ID.-Select and Edit it.-Go to Bill of Operations tab and navigate to Product Assignment tab.-Under Bill of Material subtab, choose option: Assign Line Item Group to Activity.-Assign required Confirmation Method to Product as per activity.-Keywords-Assign Line Item Group to Activity, Production Model, Product Assigment, Web Service

Title: Customer Demand Missing in Supply Planning
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order NNN and ATP is red for line item XX of product ABC as the inventory is less.-When you look at the supply planning of product ABC, there is no customer demand entry for this sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-2. Go to Customer Demand View.-3. Show All Orders and find NNN.-4. Here you can see line item XX is with ATP Red.-Now click on Open Product Planning Details , here system does not display the sales order with line item XX which is having red ATP.-  Cause-Business configuration settings are not correctly maintained in the system.-Under Business configuration: Scoping -> Supply chain planning and control -> Supply Planning -> Material Planning -> Questions for Material Planning ->-Group: Planning Date (2)-Currently selected question is:-Do you want to consider the confirmation date of the sales order during material planning?-Resolution-Follow the below steps to resolve the issue--1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter and Implementation Projects-2. Edit Project Scope and go to Supply chain planning and control -> Supply Planning -> Material Planning -> Questions for Material Planning ->-Group: Planning Date (2)-3. De-select the below question--Do you want to consider the confirmation date of the sales order during material planning?-4. Select the below question--Do you want to consider the requirement date of the sales order during material planning?-Keywords-Sales Order, Customer Demand, Business Configuration, ATP , Requirement Date, Supply Planning, Material Planning

Title: Service Technician of a Ticket Does Not Receive Notification for Ticket Assignment
Content: Symptom-When a Service Technician is assigned to a Ticket, no notification is triggered to the Service Technician.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Workcenter-Navigate to Tickets View-Click on New and create a new Ticket or edit an existing Ticket-Assign this ticket to a Service Technician-No Notification is triggered to the Service Technician-Cause-The notification is only sent to the Assigned To (or the Service Agent) via Business Task Management tasks.-Resolution-To trigger notifications to other parties such as Service Technician, please configure a Workflow rule as below:--Go to Administrator Workcenter-Navigate to Workflow Rules View-Click on New-Enter the Workflow Name and Select the Business Object as Ticket-Maintain the necessary conditions as per your requirement-In the Define Actions step of the Workflow, enter Rule Type as Notification-Enter the Notification Subject-Maintain the Recipient Determination as Service Technician for Ticket-See Also-2485969 - Agent Did Not Receive Notification For Ticket Assignment-Keywords-notification, service technician, ticket assignment, assigned to

Title: Error Message: “Service call failed; report an incident” While Migrating Transport Lanes
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate the Transport Lanes. During the Simulation step, you receive the below error:-Service call failed; report an case.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Transport Lanes-Choose Migrate transport lanes using the migration tool-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step-Cause-Transport Lane migration is executed with no Allowed Product details in the Migration File.-The system prevents migration of Transport Lane without Allowed Products information in Active status.-Resolution-1.  If you want to create Transport Lane with Product or Product Hierarchy level restrictions, then the Migration File must be updated with Allowed Product details to execute Migration successfully.-2.  If you want to create Transport Lane for all Products, then the Transportation Lane should be created with In Preparation status, so that system will create default All Products entry for processing Transport Lane. Once the migration is completed, you may Activate the Transport Lanes using the below steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center-Go to Transport Lanes view-Select all the Transport Lanes with In Preparation status-Select Change Status button to Activate in mass -Keywords-Transport Lane, Migrate transport lanes, Allowed Product

Title: Party of role responsible employee missing
Content: Symptom- Supplier invoice does not get posted due to an exception: Party of role responsible employee missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Find relevant invoice-Select Edit-Select View All-Navigate to Exceptions tab-Error Message: Party of role responsible employee missing-Cause-For Intercompany Supplier Invoice, or normal Supplier Invoice, the Org Unit Responsible is missing or employee responsible is not maintained.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to maintain a default Supplier Invoicing organization-Go to the work center Organizational Management-Select the view Organizational Work Distribution-Select work category Supplier Invoicing-Here maintain the Org Unit Responsible along with the Buying Company and supplier.-Once the above changes are done in the system, the newly created intercompany supplier invoice will determine the Party of role responsible employee.- also you can set who can only post the Supplier invoices based on invoicing unit-Go to the work center Organizational Management-Select the view Employee Work Distribution-Employee Responsible for Supplier Invoices-Here maintain the employee responsible  for  invoicing unit.- If  above is not set, then any business user can Post the invoice.-Keywords-Party of role responsible employee missing, Supplier Invoicing, Intercompany Supplier Invoicing

Title: Output Products and Input Products are not Visible in Multiple Make Tasks
Content: Symptom-Multiple Produce Activity have been set up in Production Model, However Output Products and Input Products are not visible in Make task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for Make Tasks DEF & PQR(DEF,PQR refers to Task id's)-We observe-DEF Make task -- Output Product is not visible-PQR Make task -- Input Products is not visible-Cause-When you have 2 make tasks scenario setup in Production Model.-Output Product is missing in first make task DEF because system considers this a semi finished product is being produced as you have multiple make tasks.-Input product is missing in second make task PQR because system considers already would have considered the input product in first make task, Hence only Output product is only reflected.-Note : This behavior is expected only when we have multiple make tasks, However if we have single multiple task both input and output product is reflected.-Resolution-Note : This behavior is expected only when we have multiple make tasks, However if we have single multiple task both input and output product is reflected.This is the standard system behaviour as designed.-Keywords-Multiple Make tasks Output products and Input Products , Output Products and Input Products are not Visible

Title: External Catalog Items Not Transferred to SAP ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-Shopping cart is not generated in SAP ByDesign system after you transfer the items from the Amazon Catalog XYZ (XYZ refers to the catalog name).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view.-Select the Go Shopping option.-Select catalog XYZ.-Select the items.-Click on Submit button in the catalog.-Shopping cart is not generated.-Cause-The catalog parameters maintained are incorrect. You have maintained extra parameters that are not required for the transfer of items back to the SAP ByDesign system.-Resolution-For the Amazon catalog XYZ, only the following parameters are necessary to generate the shopping cart in the SAP ByDesign system automatically.-Username, Password, User Email ID, ~OkCode, ~target and ~caller.-Note : the HOOK_URL parameter need not be maintained as it's value is generated by ByDesign system when you trigger an external catalog.-See Also-KBA: 2588617 - External Catalog Is Not Accessible-Help Portal: Technical Information for Catalog Provider-Community: Purchasing Catalogs in Business ByDesign-Keywords-Shopping cart; External catalog; Amazon; Parameter

Title: You have changed the status of the supplier ABC to Blocked, however you are still able to enter its ID when creating a purchase order.
Content: Symptom-You have changed the status of the supplier ABC to Blocked, however you are still able to enter its ID when creating a Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to New Invoices Without Purchase Orders-you will get the below error message-Ship-from location with ID XYZ blocked-Party Payee with ID XYZ blocked-Party Invoicing Party with XYZ blocked-Party Seller with ID XYZ blocked-Cause-This is an expected system behavior. Even setting the status of a supplier as Blocked, the system still allows the users to create documents with inconsistent status.-Resolution-To prevent the users from creating purchase orders for determined supplier, you need check the box Purchasing Blocked in its master data.-Go to Supplier Base work center-Go to Suppliers view-Select the supplier ABC-Select the option Edit and then Purchasing-Check the box Purchasing Blocked-Save the changes-Now, the users of the system will not be able to post-purchase orders using the supplier ABC.-Note that this change will not prevent the user from entering the supplier when creating a supplier invoice. If the box is checked but the supplier's status is still Active, the supplier invoice can be posted.-To prevent users from posting purchase orders and supplier invoices, you need to change the status of the supplier to Blocked and check the box Purchasing Blocked.-You can also change the status of the supplier to Obsolete.-See Also-1687166 - Although the Status of the Business Partner is Blocked or Obsolete, It is still Available for Selection-1720980 - Blocked/Obsolete Suppliers are Still Available in Service Agents but not in Purchase Orders

Title: Error Occurs When Checking Production Model Consistency
Content: Symptom-When performing the Check Consistency of a Production Model, system throws the error: Conversion of quantity of BoO to quantity of variants not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Models view.-Search for the Production Model ID XYZ.-Choose Edit.-Choose Check Consistency.-System throws the following error,---->Conversion of quantity of BoO to quantity of variants not possible.-(XYZ represents Production Model ID)-Cause-The Unit of Measure (UoM) maintained in the Quantity field under General Tab of the Bill of Operation (BoO) is different from the UoM maintained for the Minimum Lot Size and Maximum Lot Size under the General tab of the Production Model.-Resolution-Maintain the same Unit of Measure(UoM) value in the Quantity field of the Bill of Operation and Lot Size fields of Production Model.-Steps,-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Models view.-Search for the Production Model ID XYZ.-Choose Edit.-Under the General tab, maintain the same Unit of Measure (UoM) used in the Quantity field of the corresponding Bill of Operation for Minimum Lot Size and Maximum Lot Size.-(XYZ represents Production Model ID)-Keywords-Production Model; Check Consistency; Unit of Measure; Bill of Operations; Lot Size; Maximum; Minimum; Conversion; Quantity;  Planning and Production Master Data

Title: Task Description Missing for a Production Task
Content: Symptom-Production task does not have task description even though element description is maintained in the Bill of Material.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Show all and search task XXX (XXX stands for the task ID).-You can see that task description is missing.-Cause-Production task description depends on two settings in the corresponding Production Model:--1. Task Generation Method.-2. 'Element Description' maintained for BoO.--If you maintain task generation method as 'Reporting Point including Operations and Activities', then whatever description you-maintain for 'Reporting Point' will show as task description.--For method 'Activity including Reporting Point', description maintained for element type 'Activity' will show as task description.--For method 'Operation including Reporting points', description maintained for element type 'Operation' will show as task-description.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Models view.-Show all and search revelant production model.-Click Edit.-Go to Bill of Operations tab.-Go to BoO strucuture sub-tab.-Maintain the element description according to the Task Generation Method you maintained for the production model-Click Save and Release the model again.-Keywords-Production Task, Task Description

Title: Filter for Basic Search in Resource Management Does Not Work As Expected
Content: Symptom-You are attempting to locate a specific resource in the Resource Search view of the Resource Management work center using the Basic search option, but multiple resources not directly related to the search term still show up in the result.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1711 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Resource Management.-Access the Resource Search view.-In the Basic search field, input a search term (e.g. the first name of an employee).-Click Go or press Enter.-Multiple results will be displayed, some apparently not related to the search term.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior. The Basic search in the Resource Search works on approximate string matching — also known as fuzzy string searching — which is a technique that matches a pattern approximately rather than exactly. Therefore, the search will pull up all resources that have any mention to the search term within their records.-Resolution-To execute a more exact query in the Resource Search view of the Resource Management work center, you can use the Advanced search option.-Keywords-Basic Search ; Resource Management ; Filter

Title: How to Reverse a Closed Production Lot
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform adjustment confirmation in a closed production lot DEF (DEF represents production lot ID) but the button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center-Go to Monitoring View-Search for Production Lot DEF-Select Edit.-You observe Adjustment Confirmation option is grayed out.-Cause-A closed production lot is not relevant to logistics, and therefore, no longer subject to any kind of change.-Resolution-All confirmation documents created for this lot are sent to financial accounting. This is the standard system behaviour as designed.-Keywords-Production Lot, Closed, Adjustment Confirmation, Grayed Out

Title: Error message: "Inventory in logistics area not available"
Content: Symptom-The Error below occurred while confirming the Warehouse Pick Task even though Source Logistics Area is flagged as Negative Stock Allowed.-Error: "Inventory in logistics area not available"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search for the Task ABC (ABC represents for the Warehouse Task ID).-Choose Confirm.-Enter Actual quantity and Source Logistics Area XYZ (XYZ represents the Source Logistics Area ID).-Choose Save.-The Error occurred: "Inventory in logistics area not available"-Cause-The Allocation Type and Allocation Scope settings are maintained for Logistics Area XYZ while the Negative Stock indicator is enabled.-This combination of settings is not supported.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to remove the Allocation Type and Allocation Scope settings,-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Location View.-Search for the relevant Site.-Choose Edit Layout.-Select Logistics Area XYZ.-Remove the values maintained in the Allocation Type and Allocation Scope.-Choose Save.-See Also-KBA: 1798141 - Error Message: Inventory in Logistics Area not Available - SAP for Me -Keywords-Negative Stock Allowed; Post Goods Issue; Warehouse Task; Pick Task; Error; Inventory in Logistics Area Not Available

Title: Error message: Purchase order item xxx-x (represents the PO item ID) cannot be confirmed. A goods and services receipt cannot be created for time and labor management items.
Content: Symptom-You cannot create a Goods and Services Receipt due to this error message-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders to Be Delivered view.-Select Show by Documents.-Find and select the relevant PO.-Select New Goods and Services Receipt you receive an above mentioned error.-Cause-If the Purchase Order item is enabled for Time Recording Required.-If the Purchase Order item source of supply is Contract in which the Time Recording Required is enabled.-Resolution-Like mentioned above, since the item is relevant for time and labor management, you can only perform the delivery through time recording and then the system automatically creates the Goods and Services Receipt.-Access Home work center.-Navigate to Self-Services -> Self-Services Overview.-Under the Time section, click on Edit Time Sheet.-Create a time recording information in the employee Time Sheet.-Click on Release and select one of the release options.-Keywords-Purchase Order item is enabled for Time Recording Required Goods and Services Receipt time and labor management items.

Title: Error Appears During Migration of Location and Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-Error: 'Logistics Area Parent Location Should be Inventory Managed' occurred while migrating location and logistics area in the data migration tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Navigate to the Overview View.-Search and Open the migration activities Migration of Location and Logistics Area.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-For the mentioned parent location, the Storage Location Indicator in the Location Sheet and the Inventory Managed Indicator in the LOA-General sheet are not marked well in the migration file.-Resolution-Please maintain X in the corresponding cells in the migration file.-Keywords-Logistics Area Parent Location Should be Inventory Managed, Migration of Location and Logistics Area

Title: Outbound Deliveries Displayed Under the Previous day's Delivery Date
Content: Symptom-Outbound Deliveries displayed under the Previous day's Delivery Date in datasource Outbound Delivery Item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Business Analytics Workcenter and Design Data Sources view.-2. Find Outbound Delivery Item Details and Preview.-3. In the report you will see that the Outbound Delivery with Delivery Date say DD/MM/YYYY at 00:00 hours CET will be displayed with Delivery Date of Previous Day in UTC.-Cause-The Delivery Date Time is stored in the backend in UTC.-You may have set the timezone to CET, which is UTC+1 on normal days, and UTC+2(daylight saving, usually starting from the last week of March to end of October) during summer. The Data Source works with UTC time.-Example: If you have performed a delivery on DD/MM/YYYY at 00:00:00 CET, this would be stored as a delivery for Previous day at 23:00:00 UTC in the backend. Thus, this delivery would not be selected when a query is performed for DD/MM/YYYY-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour.-As a workaround follow the below steps--1. You can personalize and set the timezone to CET and log off.-2. Go to Outbound Logistics and Outbound Deliveries View and in Advance Search.-3. Enter Delivery Date DD/MM/YYYY-You will be able to see the outbound delivery created on DD/MM/YYYY at 00:00 hrs CET.-  Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Delivery Date, time zone, data source

Title: No Activation of Warranty Assignment of Registered Product via Service Order
Content: Symptom-When you create a Service Order with a SHIP Spare Part with assigned Serial Number, there is no Assigment of Account and Warranty in the related Registered Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new Service Order.-Select a Spare Part with the Item Type SHIP.-Process the Service Order until you trigger the Spare Part Delivery.-Enter a Serial Number for created Spare Part that is referenced to Registered Product ABC. (ABC represents the Registered Product ID)-Release the Spare Part Delivery.-When You open the Master Data for Registered Product ABC, you see no Account Assignment and no Warranty Assignment as you would expect.-Cause-The Warranty and Account Assignment of Registered Products are designed to happen only in Over the Counter Sales, 3rd Party and stardard Outbound Deliveries. In a Spare Part delivery the assumption is that the delivered Spare Parts remain property of the selling/service executing company and no assignment takes place. This is the intended system behaviour.-Resolution-You can manually assign the Account and Warranty information in the Registered Product Master Data. You can also create a PDI solution to achieve an automatic assignment.-Keywords-Warranty Assignment Registered Products Service Order Spare Part Delivery Serial Number

Title: Purchase Order has Status Sent Although an Output Error Occurred and it was not Sent to Supplier
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Purchase Order and sending it to the Supplier. The status of the Purchase Order changes to Sent, however it is not sent because of an Output Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant Purchase Order ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID).-Status of the Purchase Order is Sent.-Click on Edit.-Go to Output History tab.-You can see that an Output Error occurred and the document was not sent to the Supplier.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour.-Resolution-In order to see the documents with an Output Error you can do the following:-Go to Application and User Management.-Input and Output Management / E-Mail and Fax Queues view.-Show All Documents and open the Advanced Filter option.-Choose the relevant dates and the Output Status Error.-Click Go.-After executing this action, you can see all the documents with an Output Error within the selected date range.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Purchase Order Status, Sent, Output Error, SAP Business ByDesign, SRM

Title: Wrong Name Displayed in Delivery Address Copied From Recipient in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Shopping Cart via Go Shopping (Advanced). You notice that under the Delivery Address copied from Recipient, the name of another user appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view.-Click Go Shopping (Advanced).-Under the Delivery Address copied from Recipient, the name of another user appears.-Cause-Address defaulting is a feature that helps the user retain the address change that was done while creating the last Shopping Cart. When creating a Shopping Cart, the address will be pulled from the master data. If you change data in the delivery address and request the Shopping Cart, the next time you try to create a Shopping Cart the same changed address will be defaulted.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-If you need the original name and address, you can remove the name from the Recipient, add it again and press Enter. This will refresh the defaulting and the address from master data would be displayed. Also, if there are changes done to address in master data user should follow same steps to overwrite default address.-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Go Shopping (Advanced), Delivery Address Copied From Recipient, User Name

Title: Error : Operation Not Possible; Purchase Order Already Being Processed
Content: Symptom-When you try to create a new goods and service receipt for the Purchase Order XYZ, you encounter the error message : "Operation not possible; purchase order XYZ already being processed"  (XYZ refers to purchase order ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipt work center.-Select Purchase Orders to be Delivered view.-Search for the Purchase Order XYZ.-Choose New Goods and Service Receipt button.-Cause-For the purchase order XYZ, another user is already processing/creating a new goods and service receipt in parallel. For that user, the document is locked in the buffer.-Resolution-Only one user can create a Goods and Service Receipt document for a purchase order at once. The system is behaving as expected.-Keywords-Unable to create GSR; Goods and Service Receipt, purchase order, locked, operation not possible, document cant be processed

Title: Edit Time and Expenses Button is Grayed out in the not Invoiced Time and Expenses View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2143680***-Edit Time and Expenses button is greyed out for the Project ABC in the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Invoice Preparation view-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses sub view-Select All Active Customer Projects-Search for Project ABC & you can see that Edit Time and Expenses button is greyed out-Cause-The Edit Time and Expenses button is enabled only for the customer projects that are integrated with a sales order-Resolution-You should create projects of type With Sales Integration and then Edit Time and Expenses button will be enabled for selection-Keywords-Edit Time and Expenses button is greyed out
