Title: Negative Stock Not Permitted in Logistics Area and Material While Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-When you try to perform Post Goods Issue against sales order with product ABC having enough stock, even though system throws below error message :-Negative stock not permitted in logistics area XYZ material ABC-Environment-Productive Enviroment-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Under Delivery Control View, navigate to Delivery Proposals subview.-Search for the relevant Delivery Request ID and select Go.-Select required ID.-Select Post Goods Issue and choose Propose Quantities.-Select Release.-Here system throws an error message as above though enough stock is available for required product.-Cause-In Stock Overview, since the available stock for a product is marked as Inspection, it is not available for execution.-Inspection Stock is only available for quality inspection purpose only and hence not available for execution.-Resolution-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Go to Change of Stock subview-Enter the required Site and Planning Area.-Choose Add Row, enter Product ID ABC and Logistics Area XYZ.-Navigate to next as per guided activity.-Remove Changed Inspection Status check box and enter required Changed Product Quantity.-Navigate to Next.-Review the required details.-Finally navigate to the Confirmation tab.-Once it is done, stock will be available for execution purpose.-Keywords-Internal Logistics, Change of stock, Negative stock, Post Goods Issue, Material, Negative stock not permitted in logistics area material

Title: You encounter Error in Supplier Invoice: Receipt Date is Before Document Date
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to post Supplier Invoice, you encounter error:"Receipt date is before document date".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the relevant invoice-Select Check or Post-Error encountered: Receipt date is before document date-Cause-The Receipt date should not be before the document date(invoice date).-Resolution-Enter the date that is on the invoice document received from the Invoicing party, which also means Receipt Date and Invoice Date should be same.-Keywords-Invoice date, Receipt date,Document Date,Exception

Title: Leading Zeros Pre-pended to the Product ID in the Web Service Response Message
Content: Symptom-The response XML of the Web service 'ProductAvailabilityDeterminationQuery'  returns product ID with the leading zeros pre-pended to it.-Eg: If the Product ID is 123456 in the Request XML; The Response XML will have the Product ID '0000000000000000000000000000000000123456'.-Reproducing the Issue-Compare the Request and Response XMLs of the web service 'ProductAvailabilityDeterminationQuery'--Request XML-<ProductAndSupplyPlanningArea>-<ProductInternalID schemeID="Token 1" schemeAgencyID="Token 2">430</ProductInternalID>-<ProductTypeCode>1</ProductTypeCode>-<SupplyPlanningAreaID schemeID="Token 9" schemeAgencyID="Token 10">SM11000</SupplyPlanningAreaID>-</ProductAndSupplyPlanningArea>-  Response XML-<ProductAvailabilityDeterminationResponse><ProductInternalID>0000000000000000000000000000000000000430</ProductInternalID>-<ProductTypeCode>1</ProductTypeCode>-<ProductTypeName languageCode="EN">Material </ProductTypeName>-<SupplyPlanningAreaID>SM11000</SupplyPlanningAreaID>-  Cause-The data type used for Product ID has 40 characters length. Therefore, in case of Numeric Data, system automatically fills the data field with preceding zeroes if Product ID is less than 40 characters. This does not happen in case the data is Alpha Numeric. The response XML will not have leading zeros for the Alpha Numeric Product IDs even though the Product ID is less than 40 characters.-Eg: If the Product ID is 123456 in the Request XML; The Response XML will have the Product ID '0000000000000000000000000000000000123456'.-     If the Product ID is LOG123 in the Request XML; The Response XML will have the Product ID 'LOG123'.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-leading zeros, product ID with leading zeros, web service, ProductAvailabilityDeterminationQuery

Title: 'Actual Execution On' Date and Time Incorrect in the Pick Task
Content: Symptom-Incorrect 'Actual Execution On' Date and Time selected automatically by the system in the Pick Task-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go To Task Control-Select the Pick Task ID ABC-Edit the Pick Task ID ABC-Navigate to Administrative Information-View the 'Actual Execution On' Date-Cause-'Actual Execution On' date captures the date & time when the pick task gets confirmed with the current date. If you change the 'Actual Execution On' date during the pick task confirmation, this will only reflect the Shipment date in the Outbound Delivery. The 'Actual Execution On' date determination happens at the save of the task, which will be the current date and time. For the administrative purpose, it is necessary to keep the 'Actual Execution On' date to the date when the save is performed on the task.-Resolution-The 'Actual Execution On' date in the Pick Task ID ABC will always be the current date and time when the user confirms the pick task. This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Actual Execution On date, Pick Task, Administrative Information, Current date

Title: User not able to Print the Production Task
Content: Symptom-In the Production Task, the Print Task button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Go to Task Control View.-Search and Open the Production Task ID: ABC. (ABC represents the Production Task ID).-The 'Print Task' button is disabled inside the Production Task Document.-Cause-For the Production Task with status 'In Process', 'Interrupted' and 'Finished', the Print Task button is disabled inside the document.-The Print Task button is enabled only for the Production Task which is in 'Not Started' Status.-This is expected system behavior.-Resolution-As a workaround, print the Production Task from the Task Control (OWL) screen. The Print Task button is enabled for all Production Tasks in the OWL screen.-Steps,-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search and select Production Task: ABC.-Choose the Print Task button.-Open the Production Task: ABC.-Go to Output History tab.-The generated document is listed in the Output History tab. The Send By field displays Printer, confirming that the document is printed successfully.- (ABC represents the Production Task ID)-Keywords-Production Task; Print Task; Unable To Print; Button Disabled; Not Started; In Process; Interrupted; Finished

Title: User Unable to Select Inspection Check Box While Performing Change of Stock Process
Content: Symptom-Inspection check box is disabled while performing the Change of Stock process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Quality Control Work Center-Navigate to Common Tasks -> Select Change of Stock-Select Site, Add Row for Line Items-Add Product, Unable to Select Inspection Check box-Cause-The issue is with the user access rights. The user is not assigned to the work center 'PLM_QUALITYPLANNING'.-Resolution-User need to be assigned with work center 'PLM_QUALITYPLANNING' and Work Center view 'PLM_INSPECTIONPLANS'. This access change will enable the Inspection check box in the UI.-Keywords-Change of Stock, Inspection Check box, PLM_QUALITYPLANNING, PLM_INSPECTIONPLANS, Quality Control

Title: Released Quantity Exceeds Target Quantity in Purchasing Contract
Content: Symptom-You create and send the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID) with the Purchasing Contract XYZ as a source of supply (XYZ represents the Purchasing Contract ID).-The Purchasing Contract XYZ contains an Item with a set Target Quantity and an Over-Delivery Tolerance of 0%.-This Item is used in the Purchase Order ABC and a quantity greater than the Target Quantity is ordered. The warning message Item W: Target quantity of contract exceeded appears but the Purchase Order is still sent (W represents the Purchase Order Item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find ABC.-Select Edit.-Select Check.-The warning message Item W : Target quantity of contract exceeded appears.-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to Contracts view.-Show All Contracts.-Find XYZ.-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-For the affected Item, the Released Purchase Quantity is greater than the Target Quantity and the Over-Delivery Tolerance is of 0%.-Cause-There is no hard restriction based on the check of Released Quantity and whether it exceeds the target quantity maintained. You can order more than the Target Quantity but a warning message will be raised to inform you.-Resolution-In standard system we only throw a warning message .-However if you want a hard stop  in releasing such orders then  contact your Partner to help develop an error message so that  system won't allow you to proceed further.-Keywords-Purchasing Contract, Purchase Order, Target quantity of contract exceeded, Target Quantity, Over-Delivery Tolerance, Released Quantity-purchasing contract,released quantity,over-delivery tolerance,target quantity,target quantity of contract exceeded,purchase order

Title: No Approver Found For Purchase Order Approval by Cost Assignment
Content: Symptom-The Purchase Order approval process uses the work distribution Approval of Purchase Order Item by Cost Assignment with no conditions.-Create the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID) and send it to approval.-The approval task is created but no employee is found. The Application Log contains the following information:-Searching for responsible in non-configurable work category: Approval of Purchase Order Item by Cost Assignment-Searching using method Approval of Purchase Order Item by Cost Assignment-Result:-No employee found-Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find ABC.-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Go to Approvals.-There is no valid user displayed here.-Cause-The Approval of Purchase Order Item by Cost Assignment picks the employee approving depending on the cost assignment, the approver can be the cost center manager or project manager.-There is no manager assigned to the Cost Center used in the Purchase Order item.-Resolution-Check if the Cost Center has a manager with the following steps:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find ABC.-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Account Assignment subtab.-Double-click on the Cost Center name.-In the Org Unit Overview screen, you can see the Manager ID and Manager Name fields are empty.-Edit this information in the Organizational Management work center - Org Structures view-Keywords-Approval of Purchase Order Item by Cost Assignment, Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization, Cost Center, Cost Center Manager, Purchase Order, Approval-purchase order,approval,cost assignment,cost center,no employee found,no valid responsible person

Title: Sample Size and lot Size Fields are Rounded up When Creating Inspections
Content: Symptom-During the creation of an Inspection, you realize that the fields Sample Size and Lot Size are being rounded by the system. You do not expect this behavior to occur.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Control Work Center.-Go to Monitoring: Inspections view.-Select New, then Inspection.-Enter the desired Product, Site and Supplier.-For Lot Quantity, enter a decimal value (for example X =5.53).-Select Next.-Lot Size field is rounded up (for example: X= 6).-Cause-Both Lot Size and Sample Size fields are supposed to be expressed in a discrete unit of measure.-Resolution-Due to this, the values for these fields are rounded, not using decimals.-Keywords-Lot Size, Sample Size, Rounding, Decimal, Unit, Measure, Inspection

Title: Pro Forma Invoice Button is Missing For Outbound Deliveries
Content: Symptom-The Pro Forma Invoice button is missing for Outbound Deliveries.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Select Show: All Outbound Deliveries by Selection and press the Go button.-The Pro Forma Invoice button is missing in the upper bar.-Cause-The Based on Outbound Delivery Question for Pro Forma Invoices is not in scope.-Resolution-You need to scope the question in the Business Configuration.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Show: All Open Projects.-Select the relevant project and press the Edit Project Scope button.-Press the Next button till you are on the Questions tab.-Expand the Sales, Customer Invoicing scoping elements.-Select Miscellaneous Invoicing scoping element.-In Group: Pro Forma Invoice scope the Based on Outbound Delivery question .-Press the Save Draft button.- The same also applies for Sales Orders and Sales Quotes.-Keywords-Pro Forma Invoice, Template, Missing, Sales Quote, Sales Order

Title: Identified stock is a Mandatory Field When Confirming an Unload Task Even Type is Maintained as Optional in Material's Master Data
Content: Symptom-Identified stock is a mandatory field when confirming an unload task, but type is maintained as "3 - optional identified stock" in material master data.-Environment-SAP Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Task Control view.-Show All and find task XXX (XX stands for load task ID).-Click Confirm.-For product ABC (ABC stands for the product ID), identified stock is a mandatory field-You expect that identified stock is an optional field because in product ABC's master data identified stock type is maintained as "3 - optional identified stock".-Cause-In the related purchase order YYY (YYY stands for purchase order ID), you have entered production specification for the product ABC , once production specification is enabled, the identified stock is mandatory in the unload task.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Identified Stock, Istock, Inbound Delivery

Title: While Creating a New Planning Proposal for a Product and Planning area, Error Appears
Content: Symptom-Multiple Errors when creating  new planning proposal for product KLM.*KLM  refers to Product id*DEF represents Planning area id,  *XX.YY.ZZZZ refers to Date-Proposal could not be created; check availability date.-Creation of all receipts not possible.-Transportation lane for KLM DEF on XX.YY.ZZZZ for quantity XY  not found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-In Common tasks click New Planning Proposal.-Enter Product KLM,Planning area DEF and quantity xy (xy represents quantity in no's) etc-Error appears-Proposal could not be created; check availability date.-Creation of all receipts not possible.-Transportation lane for ABC DEF on XX.YY.ZZZZ for quantity XY  not found.-Cause-Although the setting maintained for Product Master ABC Planning area DEF, Procurement type is internal procurement (stock transfer) in planning screen of product master data.-The transportation lane maintained  has only ship from site.-Resolution-In case of stock transfer scenario, ship to location need to be maintained in transportation Lane.-BoM / BoO / Production Model comes into picture if the setting maintained as: In-house production for procurement type in planning tab of Product Master data.-Keywords-Proposal could not be created; check availability date, Transportation lane for quantity  not found

Title: Supplier Invoice Verification Against Purchasing Contracts Not Allowed
Content: Symptom-You entered the purchasing contract ID ABC (ABC refers to the purchasing contract ID) as a buyer references to the supplier invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to the supplier invoice iID) and the error messag appears as below.-Item 1: Supplier invoice verification against purchasing contracts not allowed.-Environment-SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Create New Invoice without reference to purchase order.-Fill the mandatory fields in General tab and navigate to Items tab.-Select the sub tab Basic Data and find the field Buyer References.-Assign Purchasing Contract ID ABC.-System throws the addressed error message.-Cause-The contract-based supplier invoicing is not scoped in your system.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Under the Implementation Projects, select the active project and press Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the step Questions.-Under the Scoping Elements expand Purchasing, Supplier Invoicing, Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos.-Under the Questions for Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos, expand the Supplier Invoicing Types.-Select Yes for the question Do you use contract-based supplier invoicing?-Finish the editing in the scope.-Keywords-Supplier Invoicing, Contract

Title: Incorrect Follow-up Document Settings in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In the Business Configuration activity Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings, you have marked the following:-For Non-Stock: Goods and Services Receipt not expected and change is not allowed.-For Third-Party: Goods and Services Receipt is expected and change is not allowed.-Upon creating a new Purchase Order, when you change the process type in a Purchase Order Item the default settings are not retrieved after more than one change.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select New Purchase Order under Common Tasks. -Go to Items Tab.-Click Add row. The Goods and Services Receipt Expected field is not flagged by default for the process type Non-Stock.-Change the process type to Third Party. The Goods and Services Receipt Expected field is flagged by default for Third Party.-Change the process type back to Non-Stock.-The Goods and Services Receipt Expected field is flagged by default for Non-Stock despite the settings.-Cause-The system follows the default rules set up in the Business Configuration activity Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings only when the document or the item is created. If there is more than one manual change, this overwrites the default rules previously picked.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-You can remove the row and add it again to restore the default settings for the Follow-up Documents.-Keywords-Purchase order, Follow Up Document Settings, Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings, Business configuration,-purchase order,follow up document,goods and service receipt expected

Title: List Price not Visible in Source of Supply Window
Content: Symptom-After creating a New Planning Proposal you try to change the Source of Supply for the Proposal ID SSS (SSS represents the Proposal ID), system only displays the Released Planning Model as the available Source of Supply although there is a valid List Price available for the Product as a Source of Supply.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning  work center.-Go to the Products view, search and select Product ID PXP (PXP represents the Product ID).-Choose the Open button. The Product Planning Details window opens.-Go to Supply and Demand list, choose New Planning Proposal button.-Enter quantity value and choose the Enter button.-Now, select the Change Source of Supply button.-You can see that the Change Source of Supply window does not show List Price there.-Cause-The List Price is not shown as the Source of Supply, because it is not valid before the date DD.MM.YYYY (DD.MM.YYYY represents the Date). Furthermore, you have maintained for the product PXP in the Product Master Data Minimum Receipt days of Supply as 'N' days (N represents number of days); because of which if you select a date, for example today, then the shipment should start from the supplier side on (Today minus N days) and as the list price is not valid on (Today minus N days), the system is not showing the List Price in the Source of Supply window.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-Keywords-List Price, Source of Supply, New Planning Proposal

Title: Output History Tab Missing in the Purchase Order Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 3323729***-You have noticed that output history tab is missing in the purchase order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders work center-Search for relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and try to navigate to Output History tab-However the Output History tab is missing-Cause-For migrated purchase orders, the actual output would have already happened before the migration stage itself and hence does not get generated upon migration into ByDesign system-Resolution-Since supplier already received order outside of ByDesign, so no need of sending it again via Bydesign and every thing else you can continue as usual.-See Also-KBA: 2678785 - Output History Tab Missing in Not Migrated Purchase Order-KBA:3323729 - Output History Tab is Missing for Purchase Order-Keywords-Output history missing, Migrated purchase orders

Title: Error Appears While Creating new Purchase Order for Individual Materials
Content: Symptom-When creating new purchase order for fixed asset by selecting New Individual Materials, system shows error messages:-Owner party ID XYZ not valid; it is not active-Save failed after performing action-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Common Tasks and select New Purchase Order-Enter Supplier, Company and mandatory details-Navigate to Items tab-Create a New Individual Material-Select Order button and error appears-Cause-The business partner XYZ is blocked and hence the error message appears.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to fix the issue.-Go to the Business Partner Data work center-Go to the Business Partners view -Select All Business Partners & search for Business Partner XYZ -You can see that Business Partner is blocked-Select Change Status and select Active-Keywords-Owner party ID not valid; Save failed after performing action; Individual Material

Title: Cannot see Net Price / Unit Field in Purchase Order Approval Screen
Content: Symptom-Purchase order approver wants to see the field Net Price/Unit in the approval screen-Environment-1711-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant Purchase Order approval task-Select Edit and in the approval screen, you cannot see the field Net Price/unit-Resolution-This is a new requirement and the requested field will be available in one of the future releases of SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Net Price/Unit field missing in the purchase order approval screen, Net Price/Unit missing in the approval screen

Title: Webservice ManageCustomerReturnNotificationIn has Different ActionCode
Content: Symptom-You are creating an integration for Customer Service Processing where you need to consume Web Services to manage Customer Returns. You discovered that in the Web Service ‘ManageCustomerReturnNotificationIn’, the ‘actioncodes’ are spelled with a capital ‘A' as in ‘ActionCode’, whereas in all other Web Services it is spelled with a lower case ‘a’ as in ‘actionCode’.-Since you call different Web Services from the same instance in your system, you are worried this can potentially lead to many problems, because the ‘actioncodes’ are case sensitive.  You therefore want to know why the ‘actioncodes’ are spelled differently, and how you can circumvent the potential issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer view.-Find the Web Service ‘ManageCustomerReturnNotificationIn‘.-Click the button Open WSIL to open the Web Services Inspection Language file for the Web Service ‘ManageCustomerReturnNotificationIn’.-Find ‘*Code*’.-You can see that the Element ‘actioncode’ are spelled with a capital ‘A' as in ‘ActionCode’. -Resolution-There is no standard guideline followed for the Action Code field. Hence, it can be actionCode or ActionCode in different Webservices. These names are case sensitive. You have to use the same name as in the Webservice Web Services Description Language.-Keywords-Webservices, Webservice, Web Service, ActionCode Field, actionCode Field, Customer Return Notification, WSDL, WSIL, SOAP.

Title: Process Communication Error Owner party ID ABC not valid; it is not active
Content: Symptom-You create and post the Supplier Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice ID) which contains a Fixet Asset.-In the Document Flow of the Supplier Invoice, there is a process communication error. In the details, you can find the error message Owner party ID ABC not valid; it is not active. (ABC represents the Business Partner ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Process Communication Errors view.-Show Open Errors with Incidents.-For the Supplier Invoice XYZ, you can see the error message Owner party ID ABC not valid; it is not active.-Cause-The Owner party ID refers to the Business Partner ID. The status of this business partner is Blocked.-Resolution-To correct this issue, you can follow these steps:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-In the Business Partner view.-Select the Business Partner ABC.-Select the Change Status button and choose Active.-See Also-Owner party ID ABC not valid; it is not active, Supplier invoice, Fixet Asset, Business Partner-Keywords-business partner,fixet asset,supplier invoice,process communication error,owner party id not valid

Title: Multiple Errors Appears When Creating New Planning Proposals for  a Product
Content: Symptom-When new planning proposal is created for Product DEF for quantity XY,errors appears. ( here DEF refers to Product Id, XY refers to Quantities)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-In Common tasks, Navigate to New Planning Proposal.-Enter Product DEF, planning area id , quantity XY and other mandatory fields.-Error appears-Production model for DEF on  for quantity XY Uom not found.-Creation of all receipts not possible.-Creation of item not possible.-Cause-In Production Model DEF, maximum lot size is  PQR. ( Here PQR is the lot size value)-Resolution-Navigate to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Go to Production Models View.-Search for DEF-Select Edit-Navigate to General Tab, extend the value of maximum lot size.-Select Check Consistency.-Select Release Production Model --> For Planning and Execution.-Select Save.-Keywords-Creation of item not possible,Creation of all receipts not possible, Production Model not found,Production model for on  for quantity  Uom not found

Title: Error Occurs When Doing Adjustment Confirmation
Content: Symptom-When doing the adjustment confirmation for the inbound warehouse ID, system throws the error message :-The total negative quantity difference XX cannot be greater than YY, which is the sum of the fulfilled quantity for items from the same delivery and with the same stock separators.-(Here XX and YY is any Numeric Quantity)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.- Select the Monitoring view and By Warehouse Order sub-view.- In the Show field select the query Finished Warehouse Orders and search for the corresponding warehouse order ID.- Select the Edit button and in the newly opened window select the Adjustment Confirmation button.- Select the line item ID and choose Enable Entry button.- Enter the quantities and choose Save button.- Here system throws an error message.-Cause-System throws an error message when user tries to do the Adjustment Confirmation for the line item with ZERO fulfilled quantity.-Resolution-You have to do the adjustment for the line item which has the fulfilled quantity. Also while doing the Adjustment Confirmation make sure that you have enough stock available in the logistics area.-Keywords-Warehouse Order , Adjustment Confirmation, Enable Entry, Inbound Delivery

Title: You Cannot Schedule Data Flow Verification Run
Content: Symptom-You have created the Data Flow Verification Run XYZ (XYZ represents the Data Flow Verification Run ID) and you are trying to schedule it, but you find the Schedule button is greyed out, and you can only start the run manually.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the WoC Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Data Flow Verification Runs view.-Find and select the Run ID: XYZ.-You can see that the Schedule button is greyed out, and you cannot schedule the Run.-Cause-From 1708 release, the system does not allow scheduling of Data Flow Verification Runs if the option 'Only check the documents that have changed since the last verification' is not available, or available but not selected. When this option is selected the system automatically calculates the date based on the last successful execution of the Run. Only business documents that have changed or created after the calculated date will be considered for the next execution.-This has been done to help reduce the load on the system by preventing processing of already processed documents.-Resolution-You need to select the option: 'Only check the documents that have changed since the last verification' during the creation of the Run. For the case where this option is not available, you will need to manually start the Run.-Keywords-Data Flow Verification Run, Scheduling, Schedule, DFV RUN.

Title: Approver Notes Missing After Supplier Invoice was Send Back for Revision
Content: Symptom-You as an approver entered the notes in the supplier invoice approval missing after send back for revision for supplier invoice document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice Approval task-Select Edit and a new screen opens-Add notes in right bottom-After you select Send back for revision, system captures this comments under Notes tab with Note Type - Approval Note-Cause-The approver comments will not be visible if you had entered the notes in the below fashion;-Go to Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice Approval task-Go to the Actions and select Add Notes-  Go to Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice Approval task-Go to the Actions and select Open Details-Navigate to Note tab and enter the comments-Resolution-In order to see the Approver comments in the supplier invoice, please ask end users to Edit the approval task & enter the comments-Keywords-Approver notes missing in supplier invoice

Title: Error "Enter Either a Location ID or a Logistics Area ID for Sequence DESTINATION_XYZ"
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate Location and Logistics Area, you get one of the errors below in Simulate Import step.- "Enter either a location ID or a logistics area ID for sequence SOURCE_XYZ"- "Enter either a location ID or a logistics area ID for sequence DESTINATION_XYZ"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1711 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center;-Search for Migration of Location and Logistics Area;-Open the activity;-Click Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool;-Select the migration template;-Click Execute Migration and choose Step by Step;-Receive the error in Simulate step.-Cause-If the error is related to DESTINATION, it is because you only have records for Source in "Location - Material Flow" tab of your template. As per the standard behavior, currently system does not support the material flow creation without the destination rule maintained. The same applies if the error is related to SOURCE and you only have records for Destination in "Location - Material Flow" tab of your template.-It is mandatory to maintain both the Source & the Destination for the material flow rules.-Resolution-If you already have the Source record maintained in your template, you should also add the record for Destination. If you do not wish to have destination, you can do so by maintaining both the source and the destination during migration and delete the destination entries from the UI.-The same applies if you only have Destination record maintained, then you should also add the record for Source.-Keywords-migration of location and logistics area; error

Title: Transport Zones View Missing Under Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center
Content: Symptom-In the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center, Transport Zones view is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Transport Zones view is missing.-Cause-In the Business Configuration, the below scoping questions pertaining to the scoping element Supply Chain Network are not answered Yes.-Questions:-Do you only define a single global distribution network including a global transport zone?-Do you define some regional distribution networks including multiple transport zones?-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the scoping Questions.-Select the element Supply Chain Setup Management and select sub element Supply Chain Design.-Select Supply Chain Network. Answer both the questions as Yes.-Finish the scoping.-Keywords-Transport Zone, Missing, Supply, Chain, Design, Master Data

Title: You are unable to change the Customer details in Project with In planning status
Content: Symptom-You are unable to edit/change the Customer details in Project with In planning status-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Project view-Search for the Project XYZ-Choose Edit button and Project plan-Now navigate to Accounting section-Here you can see the Customer details are not editable-Cause-If the project is created from sales order the customer details are not editable.-If the project is associated with a sales order the customer details are not editable.-Resolution-If the project is not associated with a sales order, only then the customer details are editable. System works as deisgned.-Keywords-Project-sales order-customer

Title: Inbound Delivery Notification not Created for Customer Returns in Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-The system does not generate Inbound Delivery Notification after the Outbound Delivery for Return to Supplier has been released in your Intercompany Scenario.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center .-Create New Return to Supplier from under the Common Tasks view.-Navigate to the view Delivery Control: Delivery Proposals under Outbound Logistics work center.-In the field Show choose Return to Supplier Proposals, select the relevant proposal and choose Post Goods Issue button.-In the Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue screen enter the relevant details and choose the button Release to release the Outbound Delivery.-Once the outbound delivery is released the end user expects inbound delivery notification be created automatically for the return to supplier outbound delivery that was released. However the user is not able to find the inbound delivery notification for the goods returned to the supplier (Customer Return) .-Cause-In intercompany scenario the system will not create automatic inbound delivery notification for customer returns. This is expected system behaviour.-Resolution-You have to create an Inbound Delivery Notification manually and then proceed with further processing of your Customer Returns.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, Customer Return, Outbound Delivery, Intercompany Scenario

Title: Error Message: 'MDRO Instance Not Active', When Scheduling Confirmation Update Run.
Content: Symptom-When trying to schedule a Confirmation Update Run XYZ (XYZ represents the specified Run ID), system gives error message: 'MDRO instance is not active'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistic Control.-Select view Automated Actions - Confirmation Update Runs.-Show All Confirmation Update Run.-Search for Run ID XYZ and choose Edit.-In the Confirmation Update Run window, choose Set to Active to enable Schedule button.-In Schedule Job window, choose Save and got error message: 'MDRO instance is not active'.-Cause-Error occurs because Confirmation Update Run ID XYZ is not activated. If check the status for Run ID XYZ,  it is showing "In Preparation".-Resolution-To activate Confirmation Update Run XYZ, please follow below steps:-Go to work center Outbound Logistic Control.-Select view Automated Action - Confirmation Update Runs.-Show All Confirmation Update Run-Search for Run ID XYZ and choose Edit.-In the Confirmation Update Run window, choose Set to Active.-Choose Save to make sure activation is stored.-Choose Schedule and then Save it, there will be no error message.-Now go back to View Automated Action - Confirmation Update Runs and refresh it, the status will change to Active.-Keywords-Confirmation Update Run, MDRO, Instance, Active, Schedule, In Preparation

Title: Costing not possible; labor resource for team member XYZ not found” occurred while valuating project
Content: Symptom-Costing not possible; labor resource for team member XYZ not found” occurred while valuating project.-(XYZ is the team member/employee ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view-Search the project.-Choose the Valuate button.-Here you will see the mentioned error message.-Cause-It is not possible to post employee times when there is no Resource maintained. Labor resource assignment is required for Project Time Recording to calculate the project's internal costs based on labor resource cost rates.-To confirm there is no resource maintained:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees view.-Locate and select the relevant employee.-Click the Edit button.-In General tab of the employee's Personnel File, get the ID of the employee's Cost Center assignment.-Go to the Employment tab.-In the Organizational Assignment sub-tab, get the employee's Job and its validity.-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Master Data view.-Access the Resources subview.-Search for the employee's Cost Center from step 5.-Select and click Edit-Check whether the employee's Job (from step 7) is maintained or not, and what is the resource's validity.-Resolution-If no resource is maintained for the relevant job and cost center combination, you can create it as follows:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Master Data view.-Access the Resources subview.-Search for the relevant job.-Select and click the Edit button.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Under Cost Center Assignment, click Add Row.-Enter the relevant cost center.-Set the validity so that it encompasses the period in which the time recordings will be entered (i.e. Valid From date set before the time recording dates).-Click the Save button.-It might be the case that there's already a resource maintained for the job and cost center combination, but the issue is simply in the validity period. In this case, edit the resource and correct the Valid From or Valid To dates accordingly.-In case you do not want to use the resource cost rate, you can create labor resources without a cost rate which would assure that the service cost rate will be determined.-Keywords-resource cost rate, project

Title: Prices sub tab is Missing Under Items tab While Creating new Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new purchase order and add the material XYZ(represents material Id) under the Items tab. However, the sub-tab Prices is not visible.- or-You are creating a new purchase order however the Gross Price field does not display under items section.-or-Fields Net Price and Gross Price are missing when you create a new purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select the New Purchase Order link under the Common Tasks section-Select View All and navigate to Items tab-Select Add Row and enter the Material details-Gross Price fields does not show in Items table-Also Prices sub-tab is not visible under Items tab-Cause-Currency in the purchase order document under the General tab is missing.-Resolution-Enter the Currency in the purchase order document under the General tab  then all Prices related tabs and fields will be visible in Purchase order.-also to automatically populate currency in purchase order follow below steps.-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Show Suppliers view.-Select the supplier you input in the purchase order.-Navigate to Purchasing page.-Maintain purchase order currency.-Save and close. (Activate if possible.)-Keywords-Missing Prices tab in purchase order, Price tab missing in PO,Gross Price field missing; Net Value/Limit field missing in PO; Price field missing in PO; Price field missing in purchase order,Net Price missing, prices missing

Title: Error Appears While Posting Supplier Invoice: 'G/L account XYZ does not exist or is not permitted'
Content: Symptom-You create a new supplier invoice without reference to purchase order. When trying to post the invoice an error message appears for an invoice item: "G/L account XYZ does not exist or is not permitted." (XYZ represents the G/L account description)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Common Tasks section.-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Fill in the mandatory details and go to the Items tab.-Select Cost Distribution sub-tab and enter account determination group XYZ in the G/L account field. This is the account determination group that G/L account XYZ is assigned to.-Click Check or Post button.-Error message is thrown:-Item 1: G/L account XYZ does not exist or is not permitted-Cause-The account determination group XYZ that was selected in the supplier invoice is not allowed to use for supplier invoices.-Resolution-Mark account determination group XYZ as to be used in supplier invoices:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine-tune activity (either via Overview or via the Implementation project's activity list. -Press Edit Account Determination Groups.-Under Group Types by Ledgers expand Costs or General ledger.-Select Groups for General Expenses or Groups for Other Current Assets respectively.-Find group ID XYZ and mark the checkbox Available in Supplier Invoice.-Press Save and Close.-As a result, you should now be able to use G/L Account XYZ in supplier invoices.-Keywords-G/L account does not exist, G/L account is not permitted

Title: You Cannot do Negative Inventory Posting in Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-You are doing a Post Goods Issue and trying to post a negative stock, you receive the following error messages:-Logistics area XYZ (XYZ represents the Logistics Area ID) is not valid.-Inventory in logistics area not available.-Save failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound logistics work centre and then to Delivery Control view and select Delivery Proposals.-Now search for the Delivery Proposal and choose Post Goods Issue button.-In the Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue screen, enter the Actual Quantity and Source Logistics Area ID.-Hit enter and system shows the mentioned error messages.-Cause-You are not able to do negative inventory posting even though the Negative Stock Allowed is set up for the Logistics Area XYZ because you have set the Allocation Type.-When working with Negative Stock, it is not recommended to assign Allocation type and while setting the Allocation Type system gives warning message Selecting the Negative Stock Allowed Indicator with Allocation Type is not recommended.-The allocation should reserve stock in the Logistics area for a specific order consistently. In case you work with Allocation and Negative stock for the same Logistics Area, you will not be able work with negative stock since an allocation on negative stock will not be possible.-This is a standard system behaviour.-Resolution-Please follow the below mentioned steps to remove the Allocation type:-Go to the Supply Chain Design master data work centre and then to Locations view.-Now select the Location with Logistics Area XYZ and then choose Edit Layout button.-Now in Site Layout screen, select the Logistics Area ID XYZ and go to the General tab.-Here you can see that Allocation Type is selected and Negative Stock Allowed is checked.-Delete the Allocation Type and choose Save button.-Now reopen the Post Goods Issue screen and you will be able to complete it with negative stock.-Keywords-Allocation Type, Negative Stock Allowed, Post Goods Issue, Logistics Area.

Title: Purchasing Note Not Available in Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Shopping Cart for a product. In the product's master data, you have added a Purchasing Note. That note is visible on the item level of the Shopping Cart.-While checking the Purchase Request created from the Shopping Cart, the Purchase Note is not visible on item or header level.-When you create a Purchase Order from that Purchase Request, the Purchasing Note is available again on item level.-You expect the Purchasing Note to be visible in all documents of the process, including the Purchase Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work centre.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Show All Purchase Requests.-Find the document XYZ you created and select Edit ( XYZ represents the created Purchase Request).-Go to Items tab.-In the Details, go to Notes subtab.-There are no Purchasing Notes available.-Cause-The Purchase Request is an internal document and only an intermediate between the purchasing request and the order.-Resolution-This is an expected system behaviour. If you want the information to be available in the Purchase Request, you can add it as an Internal Note.-In the product master data, The Purchasing Note is available for the Shopping cart and the Purchase Order.-Hence, both the Purchasing team and the Supplier can have access to the information.-Keywords-Purchasing Note, Purchase Request, Shopping cart, Purchase Order.-purchasing note,purchase request,shopping cart,purchase order

Title: Error when Trying to Access Report "Monitoring Purchase Orders"
Content: Symptom-You encounter this error when trying to access a Purchase Order related report "You are not authorized to execute report: Monitoring Purchase Orders"-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select Design Reports view-Select the report Monitoring Purchase Orders-Error: You are not authorized to execute report: Monitoring Purchase Orders-Cause-The user does not have access to the relevant work center views which are assigned to the report-Resolution-Please ask administrator to assign necessary work center view access to the user-Keywords-Access rights, report, authorization error, purchase order report

Title: Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task Doesn't Check Project Cost Center Manager
Content: Symptom-The Supplier Invoice approval process set up uses one step with the rule Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task.-You create a Supplier invoice XYZ with the Cost assignment against a project header (XYZ represents the Supplier invoice ID).-You expect the approver to be the Cost Center Manager assigned to this project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work centre.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find XYZ.-Select Edit.-Go to Approvals tab.-Here you expect the approver to be the Cost Center Manager based on the project header, but the manager of the project responsible is the approver.-Cause-The rule Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task checks and assigns the approval task to the first person found based on the following checks:-Cost Center Manager by project task.-Project task Manager.-Project Manager.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior. The Cost Center Manager for the project header is not checked.-When you use the rule Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task in a multi-step approval process with another rule involving the Cost Center assignment, if the Skip Reapproval checkbox is ticked the second approval task sent to the same person will be skipped.-See Also-Knowledge Base Article 2512301 - Approver has to approve the same document Multiple times on the Skip Reapproval option.-Keywords-Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task, Supplier Invoice, Approval Task, Approver

Title: HSN/SAC field is Grayed out in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-During invoicing, HSN/SAC field is Greyed out for line items of Purchase order.-or- In Purchase oder, you see that HSN/SAC field is not fetched from Material master data.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoice Entry view-Search for Orders to be invoiced-Search for Purchase Order X (X refers to Purchase Order)-Select New Invoice-Select Post-Error encountered as missing HSN/SAC code-You are unable to edit HSN/SAC field as it is greyed out- or- Go to Purchase requests and order work centers- Go to Purchase orders view- Search for Order  and edit it- Go to items tab and select the item- You will see no value appearing for field HSN/SAC For India-Cause-The Purchase order was created before the HSN/SAC code was updated in product/service master data-Resolution-You can manually remove the line item and add it again , then the system will treat this as a new line item and will assign the HSN/SAC code from the product/service master data.-Keywords-Enable HSN code, HSN is greyed out, HSN not fetched from master data, Unable to enter HSN code in Supplier invoice,HSN code, SAC code, HSN, SAC

Title: Purchase Order Output Email is Not Sent to Supplier
Content: Symptom-Supplier is not getting Purchase Order output e-mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario 1: -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID). -Click in View All button. -Navigate to Output History tab. -The output history is successful and e-mail is triggered for a different e-mail address. -OR:-Scenario 2: -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID). -Click in View All button. -Navigate to Output History tab. -The Output Record is in 'Error' status. -OR-Click in You Can Also button and select 'Edit Output Settings'. -An error is raised that the e-mail ID is not maintained. -OR:-Scenario 3:  -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID). -Click in View All button. -Navigate to Output History tab. -The Output Record is in 'Pending' status. -Cause-Scenario 1 - Cause 1: It is maintained a different e-mail address in "General tab" and "Communication tab > Collaboration subtab" in Supplier Master Data. System will always give priority to the e-mail address which is maintained under Collaboration sub-tab in Supplier Master Data.-Scenario 1 - Cause 2: It is maintained 'Send To' checkbox only for Buyer Responsible in the Business Configuration activity: Purchase Order Output Control Settings -> E-mail ID Settings for Purchase Order Output. Consequently, for any newly created purchase orders, only the Buyer Responsible for the Purchase Order can receive the e-mail as per the setting. E-mail will not be sent to the Supplier.-Scenario 1 - Cause 3: The Output settings can be temporarily changed just for one output via the button You can also - Edit Output Settings for Create PO. Once this output is sent, the settings revert back to the default. The editor of the Purchase Order has changed the Purchase Order Output settings to another address, which can be seen in the Output History tab.-Cause for Scenario 2: In Business Configuration, the user has set "Send all e-mails/faxes to this address". However the e-mail address was not maintained.-Cause for Scenario 3: The Output Channel is not maintained for the Created/Changed/Canceled Purchase Order.-Resolution-Scenario 1 - Resolution for Cause 1: Please maintain the output channel in supplier master data correctly to resolve this issue.-Scenario 1 - Resolution for Cause 2: Please check 'Send To' checkbox for Supplier and click in Save button. Then system will send e-mail to the e-mail address which is maintained in the Supplier master data.-Scenario 1 - Resolution for Cause 3: System is working as expected.-Resolution for Scenario 2: -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view. -Choose Activity list. -Go to Fine Time. -Search for activity "E-mail and fax settings". -Under E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System/production System. -When choosing "Send all e-mails/faxes to this address", enter the address to be used for testing purposes in the empty field available below it.-Resolution for Scenario 3:  -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List and select Fine-Tune chevron.-Select the activity Process-Integrated Output Settings.-Go to Output Channel Selection view and select Maintain Output Channel Rules.-Select Created/Changed/Canceled Purchase Order from the dropdown list.-Select Edit and maintain Output Channel (for example: E-mail, Printer, Fax).-Click in Save and Close button.-OR:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Input and Output Management view.-Go to Output Channel Selection subview.-Select Created/Changed/Canceled Purchase Order from the dropdown list.-Select New and maintain Output Channel (for example: E-mail, Printer, Fax).-Click in Save and Close button. -See Also-KBA: 2678740 - How to Change the Default Output Channel for Purchase Order at Supplier Level-Keywords-Purchase Order; Output, e-mail, e-mail, collaboration, supplier master data, E-mail Address, 采购订单, 输出渠道, Purchase Order Output Control Settings

Title: Service Period is Displayed incorrectly in the Preview form of Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-Delivery Date or Service Period is displayed as +/- 1 Day in the Shopping Cart preview-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select view Self Services Overview-Select Sub-view My Requests-Open the relevant shopping cart-e.g.Delivery Date/Service Period From: 16.01.2018 00:00 CET-Delivery Date/Service Period To: 19.01.2018 00:00 CET-Now select Preview-Delivery Date/Service Period-Jan 16, 2018 - Jan18, 2018-Cause-This is because of the difference in time zone. e.g. If you maintain CET time zone in your personalized system, it will be converted to UTC time zone-i.e. UTC 19.01.2018 00:00 CET = 18.01.2018 23:00 UTC, hence date shows 18.01.2018-Resolution-You can set the time zone in Personalize mode under My Settings-Keywords-Time difference, time zone, delivery date, service period, preview

Title: Tax amount is not Displayed in Purchase Order Cancellation Form
Content: Symptom-The tax amount is not available in the Purchase Order cancellation form-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Select a cancelled Purchase Order-Select View All-Select Preview and select the cancellation form-Tax amount is not available in cancellation form-Cause-The Purchase order cancellation form does not have any tax field-If there is any such field in customer system, then it is a customized form and has to be checked by form creator-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior

Title: How to Restrict Users not to see Catalogs Belonging to Other Company
Content: Symptom-You are able to see all catalogs belonging to various companies while creating Shopping Cart-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select Self Services view-Select sub-view Self Services Overview-Select Go Shopping(Advanced)-Create a new shopping cart-When you select Products, you can see all catalogs-Cause-It is not possible to restrict users from seeing catalogs belonging to other company in shopping carts-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior-As an alternative, you can make use of Contracts, List Price, Fixed Source of Supply so that while creating the purchasing document like Purchase Order, system will pick the price from these source of supply.-This can be taken up as a new requirement . Please post this requirement in customer influence forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/-Keywords-Shopping cart, catalogs, restrict users

Title: Ship-To Location Description Not Visible In Purchasing Documents
Content: Symptom-Ship-To location description is not visible while creating purchasing documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For example,-Go to Home work center.-Select Self Services view.-Select Go Shopping (Advanced) under Shopping.-Enter the Ship-To Location.-You can see only the Ship-To location ID and not the Description.-Cause-Ship-To location Name is maintained in language X. Your login language is Y. You can see the Ship-To location ID but not the Ship-To location Name/Description.-Ship-To location Description is not maintained.-As a result only the Ship-To location ID is be displayed.-If Ship-To location Name is maintained in language X, the name will be displayed only when user logs in using language X.-Resolution-User has to maintain the Ship-To location Description to view in different login language.-Kindly follow the below steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center-Select Locations view-Search for the Site/Location XYZ (XYZ refers to Site ID)-Click Edit-Navigate to General tab-Maintain the Site Description-Click Save and Close-The Site Description will be displayed when the user logs in via a different language.-Keywords-Different Language Login, Site details, Ship-To, Ship-To details, Purchase order

Title: How to use the Document Event for the Production Task?
Content: Symptom-You have added some information by selecting the Document Event button under the Production Control work center. However you want to know how to and where to see this added information?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center-Go to the Task Control view-Select the Task and Confirm-Select Document Event button-Enter the notes and Save-Resolution-You can use the action Document Event to pass on important information to the production supervisor. For example; If you interrupt a production task, the system automatically creates an event in the Execution Monitor which can be accessed by the production supervisor in the Monitoring view of the Production Control work center. You also have the option of documenting the event and providing the supervisor with more detailed information about the reason for the interruption.-This information may be crucial for making informed decisions on how best to proceed.-Go to the Production Control work center-Go to the Monitoring view-Select the relevant Production Lot ID-Select Edit and go to the Execution Monitor tab-Select the relevant task-You can see the event type, which you have saved-Keywords-Document Event for the Production Task,  selecting the Document Event button under the Production Control work center, use the action Document Event to pass on important information to the production supervisor

Title: No Action Taken After Triggering an Action Reschedule Bottom-Up
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reschedule the Production Proposal XXX (XXX represents the Production Proposal's ID) by using the Reschedule Bottom-Up button. After performing the action there is no change in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to WoC Supply Planning.-2. View Products.-3. Show All Products by Selection.-4. Find and open ABC (ABC represents the Product ID).-5. Click on Document ID YYY in Supply and Demand List  (YYY represents the Document ID).-6. Click on Open Material Flow.-7. You click on Reschedule Bottom-Up button and choose From Reference Document.-8. See that the date for Production Proposal XXX is not changed.-Cause-If you have firmed the Purchase Proposal that prevents it from any changes made.-The button Reschedule bottom up will work only for all Production and Purchase Proposals which are not firmed.-Resolution-In order for the desired changes to take effect, you have to unfirm the Purchase Proposal.-Keywords-Reschedule Bottom-up, Purchase Proposal, Firmed, Firm

Title: Approver is unable to see the attachment while approving the Supplier Invoices
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2628721***-User or Approver is unable to find the attachments while approving the Supplier Invoices and gets the error No valid attachment type found for display.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Select Managing My Area work center and then Approvals view.-2. Select the link of the Approval Task.-3. Select Show Original Document and user gets the error No valid attachment type found for display.-Cause-In the Supplier Invoice, the attachment has document type as Standard Attachment. This was working fine even when the document type is Standard Attachment before 1711 release, but from 1711 release, this behaviour is changed and approver is able to view only attachments which have document type as Original Document.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, the document type of the attachment should be Original Document.- However, for the attachments with document type as Standard Attachment  user can follow the below workaround to view the document.-1. Select Managing My Area work center and then Approvals view.-2. Select the Approval Task.-3. In the same screen, scroll down and the standard attachment will be available for viewing.-Keywords-BusinessByDesign, SupplierInvoice, Approval

Title: Purchase Order Approval Filters does not works with Direct Approvers
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order Approval Filters:configuration does not works when the Work Distribution in the expected step is set as Direct Approvers.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Select Application and User Management Work Center and then Approval Processes View.-2. Select the active approval process for Purchase Order.-3. In the Approval Process, for the expected step, the Work Distribution is configured as Direct Approvers.-Cause-Purchase Order Approval Filters:configuration does not works when the Work Distribution in the expected step is set as Direct Approvers. This is expected system behaviour.-Resolution-Purchase Order Approval Filters:configuration does not works when the Work Distribution in the expected step is set as Direct Approvers. However it works fine with other Work Distributions.-Keywords-BusinessByDesign, PurchaseOrder, Approval-purchase order approval,byd po

Title: Supplier Invoice not Triggering Approval Task for Random Exception Check Percentage Condition
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoice is not going for an approval process, when the condition is defined as Random Exception Check Percentage.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center-Go to the Approval Processes View-Select the active approval process for Supplier Invoice-In the Approval Process, for the expected step, the Random Exception Check Percentage condition is configured-Cause-Random Exception Check Percentage condition works only for manually created Invoices.(Entry Method) If the invoices were created through any other methods (external applications, web services), the approval will not be triggered.-Resolution-The invoice has to be created manually with or without reference to purchase order in the system for the approval process to be triggered.-Keywords-BusinessByDesign, SupplierInvoice, Approval, Random Exception Check Percentage

Title: Error in Inventory Level Adjustment Runs
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled Inventory Level Adjustment Runs with regular interval.-   You notice that the job has failed with error-出现技术错误 /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA 033，请报告故障-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter and Background Jobs view.-Show All Failed Jobs-Select the failed job based on Run type and date and View Job Log.-Cause-Some/All  of the products in the Logistics Area are tagged to either Production Order or Warehouse Request.-Resolution-Removal run will only create a request if all the products under that LOA are not tagged to any Warehouse request or any other document apart from inventory.    -   You can check the same following the below steps--    1. Check stock overview with the Logistics Area id as parameter for products present in that Logistics Area.-    2. Check projected material flow, if the products have any tagging to them.-    3. Finish all the requests before the run.-  Keywords-Logistics Area, Production Order, Warehouse Request, Inventory Level Adjustment Runs,LIBRARY_ESA 033

Title: Not Able to Assign Product Specification to Multiple Products
Content: Symptom-Have created a product specification with Id XYZ which is already mapped to a product with Id ABC. When trying to create a new product specification XYZ, but assigned to a different product with Id PQR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Product Specifications view.-Select the New button and choose the option Product Specifications.-In the field Product ID, enter the product with Id PQR.-In the field Product Specification ID, enter the Id XYZ.-System displays the following error message: Product specification ID XYZ already exists; enter a unique ID-Cause-It is not supported to create a product specification with the same ID, if the product specification ID is already created for another product in the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-The scenarios when we see the same product specification assigned to multiple products is provided below.-In transactional documents, like sales orders if you have created the product specification without a product mapped to it. If you have not entered product Id in Step 4 of Reproducing the Issue section.-In Production scenarios when the input products have their Identified Stock Type value as Mandatory Specified Stock or Optional Specified Stock, the product specification-assigned to your output product will automatically get assigned to them in production orders and production tasks.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Product specification ID XYZ already exists; enter a unique ID, Product Specification Error, Product Specification Mapping Error

Title: System Trigger a Warning Message When MRP Run is Ran
Content: Symptom-When an MRP Run is performed for product XYZ, a warning message appears.(XYZ indicates Product id)-Product XYZ in planning area ABC planned with warnings. See interactive Planning Log for more details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Go to Products View.-Search for Product XYZ-Select Go.-Select Open.-Select Run Planning and select Multilevel BoM.-A warning message appears.-Product XYZ in planning area ABC planned with warnings. See interactive Planning Log for more details.-Cause-This warning message indicates that the product XYZ was planned, but that the planning run was not able to cover all demands on time. Dates have been violated.-Resolution-This is a generic message and as of now this is working as designed.-You can see more details under exceptions tab, by choosing the line item of product planning details.-Keywords-MRP Run, Product in planning area  planned with warnings. See interactive Planning Log for more details, When an MRP Run is performed for product , a warning message appears.

Title: Inconsistent Delivery Terms in Intrastat Declaration for Italy
Content: Symptom-You are creating an Intrastat Declaration ID for the country Italy however the Delivery Terms are inconsistent in the document and not recognised by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declarations view-Show All Declarations and find the relevant Declaration ID-Select Edit and go to the Items tab-Select an inconsistent line-Check the dropdown list for the Delivery Terms field-The value currently present in the Delivery Terms field is not available in the dropdown list. It has been wrongly created by the system.-Cause-Due to the specificity of Italian intrastat declarations, the Delivery Terms data is stored in a unique way for Italy. As the data is processed differently, the system marks it as inconsistent.-Resolution-The error you encountered will not hinder the release of the declaration. You have the option to release the declaration and utilize the Export function to generate the Excel file. In the case of Italy, the declaration file employs a single letter to represent the delivery terms. To ensure compatibility, you can manually modify the value in the Excel file to the first letter of the corresponding delivery term before saving it as a .CSV file. For instance, you would use `E` instead of `Ex works`.-See Also-2615342 - Missing Items in Intrastat Declaration-Keywords-Intrastat declaration, Italy, Delivery Terms, Inconsistent.-intrastat declaration,italy,delivery terms, inconsistent

Title: Production Requests Visible in Planning Screen, However not Visible in Production Control Work Center
Content: Symptom-Production Requests is visible in Planning Screen however not visible in the Production Requests view of the Production Control Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Go to Products View.-Search for Product DEF (DEF represents the Material ID).-Choose Open button.-Navigate to Supply and Demand tab.-We observe Production Request PRQ (PRQ represents the Production Request ID) is in status Requested.-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Go to Production requests View-Show All Product requests by selection and find the Production Request PRQ (*PRQ refers to Production Request ID)-You observe that the system does not list any Production Request.-Cause-You have created and merged a new Implementation Project, which is not complete yet. There is one more step which needs to be followed in order to activate all the Business Configuration changes.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select the Implementation Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Implementation Project Title).-Click the 'Open Activity List' button.-Show all Activities and search for 'Activate Solution Capabilities'.-Select and open Activate Solution Capabilities.-Click the confirm button.-See Also-Keywords-Production requests, Production Control, Production Requested, Production Request not shown in Production Requests view, Activate Solution Capabilities, Merged Project, Production Requests Visible in Planning Screen, However not Visible in Production Control Work Center

Title: How to Cancel/Delete a Released Production Order
Content: Symptom-A Production Order is in Released status, and it needs to be cancelled or deleted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The available actions for a Production Order depend on its current status:-A Production Order in In Preparation status can be deleted.-Only a Production Order in Released status can be cancelled.-A Production Order in Started status can be completed without confirming any quantity.-Resolution-To Cancel the Production Order follow the below steps:-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Production Orders view.-Search with Production Order: ABC. (ABC represents Production Order ID).-Choose Cancel.-Note: A Production Order can only be Cancelled with status 'Released'.-To finish the Production Order, without reporting any quantity follow the below steps:-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search with Production Order: ABC. (ABC represents Production Order ID)-Select the relevant Production Task.-Choose Change Status and Select Finish.-The Production Task is completed without confirming any quantity. The Production Order is set to Finished, the Production Request is closed.-Keywords-Cancel Delete; Production Order; Production Request; Release; Production Control; Create Order; Partial Quantity

Title: Error Message :Material Not Available For Consumption In Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2236212***-While consuming material the system throws an error message Material not available for consumption in project.-When you go to project stock order you can see the consume button is enabled but when you try to consume you receive the above error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Navigate to Projects view.-Show all and search for Project XYZ.-Choose Edit the projects.-Navigate to Products tab and Project Stock Orders sub tab.-Now choose Consume button you will see the error message Material not available for consumption in project.-Cause-Material not available for consumption in the project as there is no open delivered quantity to consume .-Resolution-Once stock is delivered you can consume it.-Note:Consume button is enabled because the  requested quantity is Open.

Title: PDF Icon for Outbound Delivery is Missing in The Document Flow
Content: Symptom-You enter the document flow of for example a Customer Invoice or an Outbound Delivery and encounter a missing PDF icon for the Outbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter any Customer Invoice with an Outbound Delivery or the Outbound Delivery itself.-Click on View All in top-right corner.-Navigate to the facet Document Flow.-In this example you see that the PDF icon is missing for the Outbound Delivery, while it is available for the Sales Order.-Cause-The PDF icon will only be displayed when the Outbound Delivery status is set to successful. In the screenshot above you can see that the status is on released but not on successful.-Resolution-Set the status of the Outbound Delivery to successful and the PDF icon will be displayed in the Document Flow.-Keywords-Outbound delivery, Output, status, ByDesign, status-outbound delivery,status,html5,bydesign,byd,icon,pdf,silverlight

Title: Unused Spare Parts From Service Order are not Assigned to any Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You are using Advanced Shipment scenario for the Service Order Spare Parts. You have completed the Service Order but you have not used all the Pre-Delivered Spare Parts in the Service Order. The unused Spare Parts are visible in the Stock Overview, but it is not assigned any Logistics Area. You are therefore not able to use these Spare Parts in any other Warehouse Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-2. Select Stock Overview from Common Tasks.-3. In the Stock Overview screen, enter the product ID of the Spare Part in the search field Product ID and choose the Go button.- The system is showing the unused Spare Parts but Stock is not assigned to any Logistics Area.-Cause-In case of Advance Shipment or Pre-Delivered scenario of Service Order Spare Parts, once the Outbound Delivery is released, the Stock will be moved to your Customer's Account used in the Service Order. Such Stock has Stock Type as Pre-Delivered. Since it is physically present at customer's place, it is not assigned to any Logistics Area. Once the Service Engineer performs the Service Confirmation, this Stock is reduced by the quantity entered in the Service Confirmation.-However, in case Service Engineer does not use all Pre-Delivered Spare Parts, then it will remain in customer's place. That is why Stock Overview is showing it without any Logistics Area assignment.-Resolution-You need to ship back the unused Spare Parts to your Warehouse using New Custodian Goods Return Notification. New Custodian Goods Return Notification is available in Inbound Logistics work center under Common Tasks. After completing the Inbound Delivery Process for this Notification, the Stock will move to your Site and hence will be assigned to a Logistics Area.-Keywords-Pre-Delivered, Stock Overview, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Spare Parts.

Title: Error Appears When Trying to Create Customer Return Notification
Content: Symptom-Error occurs Sender is missing or not valid; enter a valid sender at the time of creation of Customer Return Notification-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center-In Common tasks, Select New Customer Return Notification-On 1st screen Select Outbound delivery items-Select on Next-On 2nd screen Edit Customer Return Delivery Notification-Enter Delivery Notification id ABC (ABC refers to delivery notification id)-Select Enter-Error appears Sender is missing or not valid; enter a valid sender-Cause-Multiple validations are necessarily executed to ensure the correctness and completeness of data.-Resolution-Sender field is mandatory like you mentioned, and hence its value is being checked when modifications to data is made. As a result of this, the message comes up when it is not filled.This is the system designed behaviour.-Keywords-Sender is missing, Valid Sender, customer return notification, Error Appears When Trying to Create Customer Return Notification, Sender is missing or not valid; enter a valid sender

Title: Registered Product Warranty Assignment Is Not Removed Though The Goods Are Returned
