Content: Symptom-Serial Number Warranty Assignment is not removed when the goods are returned into stock from customer return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the Registered Products view.-Search for registered product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the registered product).-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Tracking tab.-The Warranty assignment is still visible, though the product is returned and posted to own stock.-Cause-For customer return - post to own stock, only the parties are removed, no change is done for warranty information.-The reason being, there could be multiple scenarios after return like repair and re-sell. The warranty for re-sold products may be different from the original warranty. Also new warranty may be dependent on the original warranty information. Different companies can have different ways to handle the warranty after return. Currently the system is not able to determine this information automatically. Hence the warranty assignment is not changed automatically.-Resolution-The removing of the warranty and the new assignment of warranty when re-selling have to be done manually.-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Warranty Assignment, Customer Return, Registered Product Warranty Assignment Is Not Removed Though The Goods Are Returned , Warranty assignment is still visible, though the product is returned and posted to own stock

Title: Unable to Print  Pro Forma Invoices for Multiple Outbound Deliveries or Sales Orders Simultaneously
Content: Symptom-You select multiple Outbound Deliveries or Sales Orders and try to print Pro Forma Invoices in batch.-  You will notice that you cannot print all the selected Pro Forma Invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The issue occurs both for Outbound Deliveries and Sales Orders. We will use the example of Outbound Deliveries:-Go to the Outbound Logistics workcenter and select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Select multiple outbound deliveries and click on Pro Forma Invoice.-   Pro Forma Invoices for all the selected outbound deliveries are not printed.-Resolution-The Pro Forma Invoice printout is based on the outbound delivery and combines data for the delivered goods and their prices. The same applies to Sales Orders.-   You can create a Pro Forma Invoice only based on one Outbound Delivery or based on one Sales Order.-Keywords-Pro Forma Invoice; Outbound Delivery; Sales Orders; Pro-Forma

Title: Error Message 'Financials assignment for Material ABC/business residence XYZ not specified'
Content: Symptom-You are creating and posting a Goods and Service Receipt DEF for a Purchase Order (DEF represents the Goods and Service Receipt ID).-Both of these documents have the business residence GHI as a ship-to location (GHI represents a Business Residence ID). In the ABC Material Master Data, the Valuation data is correctly maintained for the Business Residence GHI.-However, the Goods and Service Receipt DEF cannot be posted in accounting and is pending in Unposted Source Documents with the error: Financials assignment for Material ABC/business residence XYZ not specified. (ABC represents the Material ID and XYZ represents another Business Residence ID).-You cannot see a link between the purchasing documents and the business residence XYZ.-Supplier invoice creation scenario can have the same error message when clicking on Check or Post button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre General Ledger.-Go to the view Source Documents.-Show Unposted Source Documents and find DEF.-Select Source Document DEF.-The error message 'Financials assignment for Material ABC/business residence XYZ not specified' is shown in the Details.-Cause-In the purchase order preceding the Goods and Service Receipt DEF, the Account Assignment is done against a cost centre belonging to the business residence XYZ, or XYZ itself.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-In order to remove the error message, you can maintain the business residence XYZ in the Valuation tab of the ABC Material Master Data.-Alternatively, in the Org Structure view of the Organizational Management work centre, you can affect the cost centre to the business residence GHI instead of XYZ.-You are then able to post the business document in the Source Documents view of the General Ledger work centre.-Keywords-Financials assignment for Material ABC/business residence XYZ not specified, Financials assignment for Material/business residence not specified, Unposted Source Document, Goods and Service Receipt, Purchase Order-financials assignment for material,business residence not specified,unposted source document,goods and service receipt

Title: Data Source Production Model Element Details Shows Incorrect Fixed Duration and Variable Duration
Content: Symptom-Data Source Production Model Element Details shows incorrect Fixed Duration and Variable Duration of BoM-Environment-SAP Bydesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analysis work center-Select Data Source view.-Select Data Source Production Model Element Details, and select Preview.-You can see Fixed Duration of Bill of Material (BoM) XXX (XXX stands for BoM ID) is PTXXHXXMXXS, while Variable Duration is PTYYHYYMYYS.-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center and Production Models view.-Open Production Model ZZZ (ZZZ stands for Production Model ID).-Click View All-Navigate to Bill of Operations Tab and BoO structure sub tab-You can see that Fixed and Variable Duration maintained is different from the ones in data source.- Cause-The fixed duration is coming from the 'Planning view of BoO' under the BOO structure of the Production model-Resolution-Open Production Model ZZZ-Click View All-Navigate to  Bill of operations Tab and Planning View of BoO sub tab-You can see that the variable and fixed duration maintained here is the same as the one shown in data source.-The fixed duration is again calculated based on multiple attributes like the BoO base quantity, send ahead quantity, variable durations, number of recourses, buffer time of the resources etc.-You can compare the data source details with the planning view of BoO details for the durations.-Keywords

Title: Customer cannot Create Return to Supplier from Third Party Customer Return.
Content: Symptom-System displays no records while creating return to supplier against third party customer return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Orders and Request Work Center.-Select Common Task: New Return to Supplier view.-Enter the relevant Inbound delivery XXX (XXX stands for inbound delivery ID).-System returns "No records found".-Cause-For return to supplier for third party, verify conditions for inbound deliveries which needs to satisfy both of two below conditions.- 1. Processing type code should be customer return.- 2. The item external owned stock indicator should be true and the return follow up activity code should be return to supplier.- In this case for confirmed customer return inbound delivery XXX. The external owned stock indicator is false and the return follow up activity code is Post to Own Stock.-Thus, such inbound delivery cannot be found in new return to supplier screen-Resolution-First cancel Customer Return Delivery XXX.-Create a correct customer return delivery notification with Follow-Up Activity = Return to Supplier' and-Externally-Owned Stock = True. This is the only way to solve the issue.- Keywords-Third Party customer return, Third Party return to supplier, Externally owned stock, Follow up activity

Title: Error "Logistics Area ID in Sequence Item ABC\DESTINATION_XYZ\1 Not Defined or Not Valid"
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate Location and Logistics Area, you get one of the errors below in Simulate Import step.- "Logistics area ID in sequence item ABC\SOURCE_XYZ\1 not defined or not valid"- "Logistics area ID in sequence item ABC\DESTINATION_XYZ\1 not defined or not valid"-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter;-Search for Migration of Location and Logistics Area;-Open the activity;-Click Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool;-Select the migration template;-Click Execute Migration and choose Step by Step;-Receive the error in Simulate step.-Cause-This is the expected behaviour. When creating a Material Flow of Basic Rule type for Location, it is required to choose a Logistic Area. It is the same behavior when creating it in UI.-Resolution-In "Location - Material Flow" tab of your template, for records filled with 1 for Basic Rule in "Basic or Advanced" column (2), it is required to maintain the "Logistic Area ID", which is a hidden column (7).-Keywords

Title: Unable to Change the Description of Released Product Specification (PRS)
Content: Symptom-Changing the Description of Released Product Specification for a Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data-Navigate to Product Specifications View-Select  Product Specification XYZ (XYZ refers to PRS id)-Select Edit-You observe that Product Specification Description cannot be edited.-Cause-Once the Product Specification is released you cannot change the description as the data is already being used in various business documents.  However, you have an option to manually change the status of Product Specification to 'Obsolete'.-Resolution-Note:At the time of creating Product specification when the status is in "In process" PRS Description is editable.-This is the standard designed behaviour.-Keywords-Released Product Specification, Unable to Change the Description of Released Product Specification (PRS), Product Specification Description cannot be edited.

Title: The Characteristic ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORDER_ID no Longer Available in The Standard Data Source SCMPBOMU02
Content: Symptom-You have created reports base on the standard SAP Data Source SCMPBOMU02. Whenever you tried to open any of the Reports, the system displays the following error messages:-The following message applies to variable PAR_SEL_ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORD of Report ABC (Report ABC represents the name of your Report).-Characteristic ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORDER_ID is missing in mdav SCMPBOMU02; Report XYZ cannot be saved (Report XYZ represents the name of your Report).-The following message applies to Report ABC.-Characteristic ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORDER_ID is missing in MDAV SCMPBOMU02; restriction not possible-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work center Business Analytics.-Go to the view Design and Assign Reports and find Report ABC.-Open the Report by clicking on the hyperlink.-The following error messages are displayed:-The following message applies to variable PAR_SEL_ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORD of Report ABC (Report ABC represents the name of your Report).-Characteristic ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORDER_ID is missing in mdav SCMPBOMU02; Report XYZ cannot be saved (Report XYZ represents the name of your Report).-The following message applies to Report ABC.-Characteristic ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORDER_ID is missing in MDAV SCMPBOMU02; restriction not possible-Cause-The Data Source was updated by SAP.-Resolution-Navigate to the work center Business Analytics.-Go to the view Design Data Sources.-Find and select the Data source: SCMPBOMU02.-You can see under the General tab that this was changed by SAP.-Open the Documentation.-There you can see there's no Characteristics called ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORDER_ID. However, there's the Characteristic "ECO ID".-In the section Data source used in List, you can see the "Report ABC"  and "Report XYZ" listed.-Go to the view Design and Assign Reports and find "Report ABC".-Click the button Edit With Report Wizard.-Navigate to the tab "3 Select Characteristics".-Select the Characteristic ECO ID in the list and modify as your Business requires.-Save the changes and run the report again. This time the report should run without the error.-Keywords-Report, Data Source, Production Bills of Material Variant and Line Item Details, ENGINEERING_CHANGE_ORDER_ID, ECO ID.

Title: Error: "The source of supply cannot be determined; check the sourcing-relevant master data" , While Trying to Release Customer Demand Document Created Against a Project Stock Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When trying to release customer demand document created against a Project Stock Order, system displays the below error message.-The source of supply cannot be determined; check the sourcing-relevant master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant document, select it and choose Check Availability-The below error message is displayed-The source of supply cannot be determined; check the sourcing-relevant master data.-Cause-The Project Stock Order is created but ATP is not confirmed as there is no stock available.-Resolution-Maintain the stock in Logistics area to perform the Check Availability.-Keywords-The source of supply cannot be determined; check the sourcing-relevant master data, While Trying to Release Customer Demand Document Created Against a Project Stock Order

Title: Not Able to add Extension Fields in Stock Overview Screen.
Content: Symptom-User has added an extension field for a product in the Product Data work center and wants to include this field in the Stock Overview screen however it is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center and  Materials view.-Open any material and Choose View All-Enter Adaptation mode-Right Click on a field from the General Tab, then click on "+Extension Field"-Create a new field, or select an existing one, then click on "Further Usage"-Navigate to the Extension Scenarios tab-Here you can see the scenarios however no scenarios available to extend to stock overview.-Now,-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Stock Overview link under the heading Related Links.-Choose Adapt button on the top left corner and select the option Enter Adaptation Mode.-A window pops up asking for the confirmation, select Yes-Again choose Adapt button on the top left corner and select the option Edit This Screen.-Now select the heading Extension fields.-Under the section List of Fields, the field added in the product data screen is not visible here.-Cause-This is a standard system behaviour.-Resolution-In the current version of SAP Business ByDesign System, the Stock Overview screen is not extensible. Hence, no option shows up for adding the extension fields.-See Also-Refer Extension Scenarios | SAP Help Portal to know the areas in which extension fields are active and available.-Keywords-Stock Overview, Extension Fields, List of Fields, Extension scenarios;

Title: Production Model Will Not Be Released By Run
Content: Symptom-A Production Model Release Run is not releasing the Production Model ABC. But when try to release it manually, it works fine.-ABC = Production Model ID-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Production Model Release Run view.-Find the Run XXX.-Open the erroneous Application Log.-Go to Results tab.-Click Expand All.-Notice that there is an error message:-Production Models released unsuccessfully-Production Model: ABC-XXX = Run ID-Cause-The release run can be used after firstly releasing the Production Model for planning and execution if there are any changes made in the BoO or BOM. The Production model needs to be released manually for planning and execution and later the Run can be used to release it again after making any changes in BoO or BoM.-Resolution-You can release the Production Model ABC manually. To do so, follow the steps:-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Production Models view.-Find the Production Model ABC.-Open the Production Model ABC.-Click View All.-Select Release Production Model.-Select For Planning and Execution.-The Production Model ABC will be released successfully.-Keywords- Production Model Release Run, Production Model, Unsuccessfully

Title: Why there are several Released List Prices for same Product
Content: Symptom-You have created a new list price for the product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID) and set it to Released.-You are expecting this to cancel the release of the pre-existing list price for the same product, but it is still Released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work centre.-Go to List Prices view.-Find XYZ.-Several entries appear in Released status for the same product XYZ.-Cause-In the newly created list price, the Product Category differs from the one used in the existing list price.-If there is even a small difference in both then they are not identical.-Resolution-Since list prices are not identical, therefore creating a new one will not cancel the release of the old one.-Keywords-Product portfolio ,list price , Old list price not cancelled when new list price is created-release cancelled,released,list price,new list price

Title: Unable to Restrict Project Management Content by Company
Content: Symptom-You wish to restrict the content available for creating a new project under Project Management — specially the units available for selection in the Responsible Unit — by company assignment of the user who's creating the project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign, access restrictions depend on access contexts, which are set by default for each and every work center view. The access context that restricts access based on company is 1007 - Company; however, the access context used by the Project Management work center is 1001 - Project Management.--For the OVS (Object Value Selector) in use inside of the Project Management there will be no restrictions rule applied as the Access Context is the one valid for Project Management, in this case, 1001 - Project Management.-Resolution-If you need to restrict content in Project Management by company., you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the SAP Cloud Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by the Cloud Service Center on https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html .-You can contact the Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right-hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Restriction, Project, Company,

Title: Value in Extension Field Disappears When Physical Inventory Document Status is Changed.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to save data in Extension Fields in the Physical Inventory Business Object. You have created an Extension Field on Line Item of the Physical Inventory Count Document, but after the inventory adjustment is finished and the screen is closed, the data is not available in the field. You can also not find the values in a query in the repository explorer.-Environment-Business byDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Phyisical Inventory.-Select New Product Count in the Common Tasks View.-Select the Storage Location ID and click on next.-Enter relevant details and Click the Go button.-Select the Product to be counted by ticking the Checkbox.-Click the Finish button to create the Product Count Document XXX (XXX represents the Document ID of the Physical Inventory Count Document).-Open the Physical Inventory Count Document XXX and click View All.-Go to the Count Items tab and control the input in the relevant Extension Field. You can see that the value is available in the Extension Field.-Go to the Task Control View, and search for the Not Started Task to the Physical Inventory Count Document XXX.-Select the relevant Task ID ZZZ (ZZZ represents the Not Started Task which is to be confirmed).-Click the Confirm button and enter relevant details.-Click the Finish All Items button to finish the Task.-Open the Physical Inventory Count Document XXX again and go the Count Items tab.-You can see that the Value is no more available in the respective Extension Field.-Cause-The Physical Inventory Count Item has 3 node categories:-Count Inventory Items.-Approval Inventory Items.-Book Inventory Items.-When the key user adds the extension field to this node; the extension field is available on all the 3 node categories.-When the user enters the value in the Count task to this extension field; the value is present in the Count Inventory Item node instance. And when the user tries to see the Count Document - By Line Items; the user is viewing the Approval Inventory Item node instance in which the value was never added, but user expects the value to be passed on even if it’s same node but different instances through process scenario.-There is a technical limitation of extensibility where in the data cannot be passed on within the same node to different instances.-Resolution-This can be easily handled through PDI since Physical Inventory Count Business Object is released for Partners.-Please ask your Partner to address this via an Add-On where during the Before Save Event of Activity Node of Physical Inventory Count Business Object they do the following:-Do the Retrieve by association using OperationActivityCountInventory assocation from Activity Node.-Get all the Count Inventory Items using the association OperationActivityInventoryItem from Inventory Node.-Get all the Approval Inventory Items using the association ApprovalInventoryItem from Inventory Item Node. Copy the Extension Field value from the Count Inventory Item instance to its corresponding Approval Inventory Item instance.-Keywords-Physical Inventory Count, Extension Field, Not Started Task, Finished, Values Not Transferred

Title: Customer Invoices from Project Invoice Requests not Sent for Approval
Content: Symptom-You notice a difference in how Approvals for Invoices are processed depending on how they were created: Manual Customer Invoice creation or Customer Invoice coming from a Project Invoice request. For Manual Invoices, the approval process is triggered as expected however, for Customer Invoices coming from a Project Invoice request, the invoice is submitted automatically. You expect that any Customer Invoice should be sent for Approval first.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite: In Business Configuration, you have scoped Approval for Manual Customer Invoicing by answering Yes to Question: Do you want to set up approval process for manual customer invoices and credit memos?-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the New Manual Invoice View in Common Tasks.-Fill in the relevant information.-Save the invoice and release it.-Customer Invoice ABC is created (ABC stands for the manually created Customer Invoice).-Based on the defined scoping, it is sent for Approval and an Approval task is created.-Now, go to the Project Management work center.-Navigate to the Invoice Preparation view.-Select the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses.-Select the Project DEF (DEF represents the Project ID).-Select Create new project invoice request, fill in the relevant information and save it.-Project Invoice Request XXX is created (XXX represents the Project Invoice Request ID) .-Return to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Request view and search for Project Invoice Request XXX.-Click on the Invoice button.-Save and Release your Invoice.-Your Customer Invoice is not submitted for Approval and is released immediately.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. There is no Approval Processes for Customer Invoices other than when created manually. Hence, a Customer Invoice created from a Project Invoice Request which is part of the automated invoicing process is not sent for Approval.-Resolution-If you require Approval for all Business Processes ending in Customer Invoicing, you can set up Approvals earlier, on the Sales Order, for instance so that you can control the information that is derived on the Customer Invoice.-See Also-The following documents can help you understand the system behaviour when handling Approvals on Customer Invoices:-KBA: 2489387-Help Documents:-Approval for Manual Customer Invoice and Credit Memo-Project Invoice Requests Quick Guide-Create a Project Invoice Request for a Customer Project.-Keywords-Project Invoice request, approval, no approval task, no BTM task, Demande de Facture de Project, tâche d'approbation, approbation, Customer Invoice, Facture Client

Title: Supplier Invoice Blocked by Credit Amounts Greater Than Debit Amounts
Content: Symptom-You have created a Supplier Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice ID) for a Purchase Order followed by several Inbound Deliveries and a Return to Supplier.-When you change the quantity of an item in the Supplier invoice, you get the following errors:-'Item ABC: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item'.-'Item ABC: The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item'.-(ABC represents the Supplier Invoice Item ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find XYZ.-Select Edit.-Go to the Items Tab.-For Item ABC, reduce the quantity.-The following error messages appear:-'Item ABC: The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item'.-'Item ABC: The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item'.-Cause-The errors are raised because the system can no longer match the Cost Distribution credit items to the respective debit items.-In the Cost Distribution tab for Item ABC, item ABC.A is a credit memo item representing the Outbound Delivery in the document flow (ABC.A represents the credit memo Cost Distribution Item ID). The system created it to refund the company after the goods have been returned to the Supplier.-Outbound Delivery DEF follows Inbound Delivery GHI in the document flow (DEF represents the Outbound Delivery ID, GHI represents the Inbound Delivery ID).-When you change the quantity of Item ABC in the invoice, the quantity of item ABC.C for the Inbound Delivery GHI is reduced in Cost Distribution (ABC.C represents the invoice item Cost Distribution Item ID.) This is done because the system automatically picks the last document created to remove from the cost assignment.-However, as the Outbound Delivery DEF follows the Inbound Delivery GHI, when the quantity of item ABC.C is reduced, the system can no longer match the costs correctly and assign the credit from the Outbound Delivery to the respective Inbound Delivery.-Resolution-To solve this issue, you can manually change back the quantity of ABC.C to its original value and reduce the quantity of any other item by the desired reduction value.-Once it is done, click Check and the errors will disappear.-Keywords-The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item.-The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item.-supplier invoice,cost distribution,credit amount,credit quantity,debit quantity,debit amount

Title: Removal of not Released Inventory Notifications
Content: Symptom-How to Remove - Not Released Inventory Notifications in Notifications view in Third-Party Logistics Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1 Go to Work Center Third-Party Logistics.-2. Select View Inventory Notifications.-3. Show Not Released Inventory Notifications.-4. Here multiple results with Communication Status: Ok and Notification Status: Consistent.-Cause-Inventory Notifications reflect changes that have occurred in the externally-managed location such as a change of stock or scrapping. They are also used as a basis for the goods and activity confirmation, which in turn, updates inventory management, planning and financial management.-Resolution-It is not be possible  to delete the affected Inventory Notification once they are created in the system.-Retriggering of a cancellation message from the Warehouse provider cannot delete the messages as well.-The only option in this case would be to cancel the Line Items from the Inventory Notification.--To do that follow the below steps:  --1. Open the Inventory Notification ID ABC (ABC represents the number of the Inventory Notification).-2. Choose View All.-3. Select the Line Items tab.-4. Mark the each Item ID line.-5. Choose Cancel button.-Result: Now the Inventory Notification ABC will be in status Cancelled.-Keywords-Inventory Notifications, Not Released, Remove

Title: When you are Trying to Change the Status of the Stock for Externally Managed Stock,Error Appears
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the status of the stock of externally managed stock to Inspection status,Error appears,*XX refers to Item no- Item XX: Movement direction and reason code combination not permitted-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-In Common tasks select the option New Inventory Change in Externally Managed Location from the drop-down.-In the opened window, fill in the required fields under the General tab.-Go to the Line Items tab, select the Add Row, enter the Item ID, Reason as Disruptive Sampling and Movement Direction as Inventory Issue and other required details.-Enter values for Product and Quantity columns too.-Now, select Add Row button again, enter Item ID, Reason as Disruptive Sampling, Movement Direction as Inventory Receipt and fill in Product and Quantity columns too.-Select Check-Error appears- Item XX: Movement direction and reason code combination not permitted-Cause-For Inspection status you are not maintaining proper reason code and movement direction, Hence this is causing the error.-Resolution-You can follow steps below:-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-In Common tasks select the option New Inventory Change in Externally Managed Location from the drop-down.-In the opened window, fill in the required fields under the General tab.-Go to the Line Items tab, select the Add Row, enter the Item ID, Reason as Inventory Difference and Movement Direction as Inventory Issue and other required details.-Enter values for Product and Quantity columns too.-Now, select Add Row button again, enter Item ID, Reason as Inventory Difference, Movement Direction as Inventory Receipt and fill in Product and Quantity columns too.-For the second line item, you have to either select the stock as Inspection or enter an Identified Stock ID as you are doing a change of stock.-Then select Save, Release and save.-Keywords-Externally managed Stock, Change in status of externally managed stock,  Movement direction and reason code combination not permitted

Title: ATP is Still Showing Yellow in Sales Order Even Though Goods is Already Dispatched.
Content: Symptom-The Line Item of Sales Order has been dispatched, but the ATP is showing Late Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order XXX (XXX represents the number of the Sales Order).-Select the Sales Order and click on the Edit button.-Click the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Notice the ATP is showing yellow for the Sales Order Line Item.-Cause-It was created a Sales Order with Availability of the Product being initially yellow, and it was completely delivered the Item with Late Delivery as per the Requested Date. Hence, the system is showing yellow ATP even though it was completed the Delivery of the Line Item. This is an expected system behaviour.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-Keywords-ATP, Sales Order, Customer Demand.

Title: System Throws Errors While Confirming the Pick Task
Content: Symptom-When you try to confirm the pick task, system throws below errors:---->The action FINISH is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case.---->The total number of serial numbers must be the same as the delivery quantity for product xyz.-Environment-Productive Environment-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Task Control View.-Go to All Tasks by Selection and choose relevant Task ID.-Select and choose Confirm.-Choose line item with relevant product :xyz and enter serial number according to quantity.-Perform Save.-System throws above error messages.-Cause-The split for product (Optional serial number profile) has occurred, resulting in two lines in the task. Here you have chosen serial number profile as Optional Serial Number Assignment.-One of the lines have been confirmed with the serial numbers but other is not. It is valid only if both the lines have serial numbers or none.-Resolution-You have to reverse the confirmation and enter both lines either with serial number or without serial numbers.-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Monitoring-->Warehouse Order view.-Search for the relevant warehouse order.-Select the warehouse order and choose Edit button.-Go to the Confirmation tab. Here you can see that the Reverse Confirmation button is Enabled.-Make the required changes and perform save.-Keywords-Split, Serial Number, Task, Optional Serial Number,

Title: Serial Number Validation missing in Customer Return Notifications
Content: Symptom-There is a Serial Number/Registered Product N available for Product A.-You expect this serial number to be used.-However on creation of Customer Return Notification,  new Registered Product is created for Product A.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select New Customer Return Notification view.-Search for the Product ABC.-Select the Product ABC.-Click Next-Go to Serial Numbers-The existent Serial Number is not automatically suggested.-Cause-While creating new Customer Return Notifications,-there are no validations to verify if the Serial Number entered for an item is the same as that previously in the inventory.-This is to accommodate those cases where customers create new Customer Return Notifications with serial numbers,-referencing documents like Sales Orders or Outbound Deliveries without serial numbers.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-Keywords-Customer Return Notifications, Serial Number, Registered Product

Title: Incorrect Target Logistics Area Proposed in Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You are processing an Inbound Delivery and when you're proceeding with the Post Goods Receipt an incorrect Target Logistics Area (different from the Ship-To Location) is proposed by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Inbound Logistics.-View Purchase Orders.-Show All Purchase Orders and Find XXX (XXX represents the Purchase Order ID).-Click Post Goods Receipt button.-See that the Target Logistics Area ID is different from the Ship-To Location.-Cause-No Material Flow Rules for the affected Logistics Areas are maintained, therefore by default the system pulls the Logistic Area with basic rule 'First Found' under the Site.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you must maintain Material Flow Rules for the location you would like to be picked up as a Target Logistics Area. This material flow rule is a sequence of logistics areas and locations as well as picking and put away strategies which describe where and how the search is conducted.-Keywords-Target, Logistics, Area, Post, Goods,  Receipt, Ship-to, Location, Material Flow Rule

Title: Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create an Incident" While Migrating Purchasing Contracts
Content: Symptom-During the migration of Purchase Contracts, the error message is being triggered. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view. -Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Integrate and Extend tab.-Search and open the activity "Migration of Purchasing Contracts". -Select "Migrate Purchasing Contracts Using the Migration Tool". -Select the source file. -Choose Execute Migration.-The error message is triggered: "File Validation Failed. Create an Incident".-Cause-There could be many reasons that lead to this issue.-One of the causes could be the type of Data being entered in the migration template is incorrect. For example, if the type value maintained in field "Discount Value" is not a number (Item-Prices sheet). -Resolution-Maintain the correct Data type in the migration template. -For the field Discount Value, maintain the Type as Number or keep it blank. Then the user can re-execute the migration process.-Keywords-File validation failed, Migration, Purchasing contracts, Purchase contracts

Title: Catalog View in Work Center Product Portfolio Missing
Content: Symptom-Unable to locate the Catalogs view in Product Portfolio work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center.-Search for Catalogs View.-The Catalogs view is missing.-Cause-Cause 1: The Catalogs view is not visible in the Product Portfolio Work Center because the required Scoping Question is not selected in Business Configuration.--Cause 2: The CCM_CATALOGS view ID is not assigned to the Business User ID, resulting in the Catalogs view is not visible in the Product Portfolio Work Center.-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Choose Edit Project Scope.-Using Next button, Go to step 4: Questions.-Go to "General Business Data" Element.-Go to Products sub-element.-Select Catalogs.-Select the checkbox for the question “Do you import material or service catalogs from your suppliers into the system?”.-Select Next.-Choose Finish.-Resolution for Cause 2:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to User and Access Management view.-Go to Business Users sub-view.-Search for Business User XYZ (XYZ represent the Business User ID).-Choose Edit and select Access Rights.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment tab.-In SRM_PRODUCTPORTFOLIO work center/view ID select CCM_CATALOGS view ID.-Select the checkbox Assigned to user.-Choose Save.-The Catalogs view is available for the user.-Keywords-Catalogs view missing; Product portfolio; Scoping; Business Configuration; View access

Title: Stock Not Available During Return to Supplier Process
Content: Symptom-You are returning received goods to a supplier. During the process, you observe that the item you would like to return is not available, although the product is on stock in the relevant Logistics Area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Common Task Stock Overview.-2. Search for Product ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product) and Storage Location ID DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Storage Location).-3. See that the product is on stock and there are Warehouse Confirmations for it (XXX and YYY(YYY and XXX represents the Warehouse Confirmations ID).-4. Go to Work Center Inbound Logistics and enter the subview By Warehouse Order.-5. Show All Warehouse Orders and find ZZZ (ZZZ represents the actual number of the Warehouse Order).-6. See that it was processed correctly and the status is 'Finished'.-7. Go back to Work Center Inbound Logistics.-8. Select New Return to Supplier.-9. Show Supplier Delivery Items By Selection and find ABC.-10. See that no relevant item is displayed.-Cause-Incorrect Follow-Up Activity: 'Post to own Stock' was specified in the Customer Return Notification.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue you have to set the correct Follow-Up Activity: 'Return to Supplier'.-If you unrelease the Inbound Delivery it still won’t be possible to edit the Customer Return Notification and modify the Follow-Up Activity field.-You must cancel the Inbound Delivery first and create a correct Customer Return Notification with Follow-Up Activity 'Return to Supplier' and 'Externally-Owned Stock' equals to 'True'.-See Also-2245538 - Inventory Is Mapped To Inbound Deliveries After Customer Return Scenario Is Completed.-Keywords-return to supplier, stock not available, incorrect follow-up activity,

Title: Cannot Distribute Cost Among Other Invoices and Credit Memos When Import Supplier Invoices From Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-When importing supplier invoices from Microsoft Excel, you find there is no field in the template to distribute cost among other invoices and credit memos.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When you create a new supplier invoice without purchase order manually, you can distribute cost among other invoices and credit memos by following steps.-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Create a new suplier invoice without purchase order.-In the supplier invoice view, go to Item tab, Basic Data.-Select Type as Additional Cost Debit Item.-Go to Cost Distribution.-Click Distribute among other invoices or credit memos, you will be able to select an invoice to distribut cost.-However, when you import supplier invoices from Microsoft Excel, you cannot find a filed in the template to distribute cost among other invoices and credit memos.-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select New and Import from Microsoft Excel.-You can see in the excel template, you can choose item type as Additional Cost Debit Item, but you cannot find a field to distribute cost among other invoices and credit memos.-Cause-Currently,-case 1.It is not supported to distribute cost among other invoices and credit memos when import supplier invoices from Microsoft Excel template.-case 2. It is not supported to distribute cost among other invoices and credit memos when invoice is in status In Approval.-Resolution-case 1..For this kind of supplier invoice, you need to create it manually.-case 2.Ensure supplier invoice is approved fully-Keywords-Import Supplier Invoice, Distribute Cost, Dump while distributing cost

Title: Unable to Undo-Release Or Cancel 3PL Inventory Notification as option is Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-You have created 3PL Inventory Notification in the system for required products, later you want to change the quantity. However Undo-Release option is greyed out and user is unable to make changes in an inventory notification.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Workcenter.-Go to 3PL Inventory Managment View.-Go to Inventory Notifications View.-Show All Notifications and find required ID.-Select and you can see here Undo-Release option is Greyed out.-Cause-The reason code is maintained as inventory difference in inventory notification, therefore once it is released system does not allow to Cancel or perform Undo-Release for an item.-Inventory difference is taken as a count activity and any count activity cannot be reversed.-Resolution-You have to create New Inventory Change in Externally-Managed Location to reverse the required quantity with relevant movement type.-This is an expected system behavior.-  Keywords- 3PL Inventory Notification, Undo Release, Grayed Out, Disabled

Title: Goods and Service Receipt Cannot be Withdrawn From Approval
Content: Symptom-You have created the Goods and Service Receipt and posted it.-Before its posting, it was sent for approval. You wish to retrieve the Goods and Service Receipt but there is no Withdraw from approval option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work centre.-Go to Receipts and Returns view.-Go to Show by Documents subview.-Find Goods and Service Receipts document. -Select Edit.-The document is In Approval, there is no Withdraw from approval button available.-Cause-It is not possible to withdraw a Goods and Service receipt from approval in the UI.-Resolution-This is a system limitation. As a workaround, you can assign the approval task to another user, who can then send the Goods and Service receipt for revision. The employee responsible for the Goods and Service Receipt will then be able to amend the document according to the business needs.-In order to reassign the approval task, you can follow these steps:-Go to Application and User Management work centre.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Show All Items.-Find the approval task Approve Goods and Service Receipts document-Select the task.-Click Assign Item.-Enter the name of the new approver.-Click OK.-The task will be reassigned and made available for the new approver in the work centre Managing my Area - view Approvals. By selecting Send for revision, the Goods and Service Receipt will be editable once again.-Keywords-Goods and Service Receipts,Withdraw from approval

Title: Line Sequence of Pick List Form is Incorrect
Content: Symptom-Line Numbers in Pick List Form is not sequenced as per Pick Task Line items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Task Control  View-Search for Pick task DEF (where DEF refers to the Pick Task Number)-Select the task and select preview-We observe that Line items in PDF is not sequenced properly as per Pick task ABC Line item.-Cause-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Go to Implementation Projects View-Select Edit Project Scope-Select Next, Until you arrive at Scoping tab-Under Scoping tab Expand the node Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Expand sub node Outbound Logistics-Select Pick List Sorting-We observe Pick List sorting was scoped, this setting  will allow you to preview and print the pick list form in a sorted manner by logistics area. Hence you see that Line sequence in Pick List form was sequenced incorrectly as it was sorted based on Logistics area.-Resolution-Hence you see that Line sequence in Pick List form was sequenced incorrectly as it was sorted based on Logistics area.This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Line Sequence of Pick List Form is Incorrect, Line Numbers in Pick List Form is not sequenced

Title: Outbound Delivery Release Run Not Releasing Stock Transfers
Content: Symptom-You created an Outbound Delivery Release Run, however it is not releasing Outbound Deliveries of the type Stock Transfer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Outbound Delivery Release Run view.-Search for the Run XXX.-Select the Run XXX.-Click Schedule.-Select Save and Close.- To check if the Return to Supplier was released: -Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Outbound Deliveries.-Search for Return to Supplier ABC.-Notice that the Return to Supplier ABC is Not Released.-XXX = Run ID-ABC = Outbound Delivery of type Return to Supplier ID-Cause-You have maintained a Shipment/Delivery Date in the Outbound Delivery Release Run. There is no Delivery Date for Outbound Deliveries of type Return to Supplier, only a Shipment Date. Hence the Return to Supplier ABC will not get released.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can:-Release the Return to Supplier manually.-Create a New run and leave empty the field Shipment/Delivery Date.

Title: Unconsumed Forecast Quantity Still Showing in the Product Planning
Content: Symptom-When you delete a Demand Plan, the Unconsumed Forecast quantity is it still being shown in the Product Planning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Demand Planning work center.-Select Demand Plans view.-Select the Demand Plan ID XXX (XXX means the Demand Plan ID).-Click Change Status.-Select Set to Obsolete.-Select Delete.- To check if the quantity is being shown in the Product Planning:-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Search for Product ID ABC (ABC means the Product ID).-Click Open.-Notice that the quantity is still being shown in the Unconsumed Forecast.-Cause-When you delete a Demand Plan it will not be used anymore, however the quantity already created will still be considered in the Product Planning.-Resolution-To delete it from Product Planning, you need to follow the steps:-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select the Maintain Demand Plan common task.-Search for Product ID ABC.-Click Go.-Select the Product ID ABC.-Choose Delete.-Select Save and Close.-Thus, the quantity in Unconsumed Forecast will not appear in the Product Planning anymore.-Keywords-Demand Plan, Product, Product Planning, Forecast

Title: Wrong UoM proposed Post Goods Issue and Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You created a Sales Order or Purchase Order with UoM DEF. However, when you Post Goods Issue or Post Goods Receipt the system proposes the UoM ABC.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order XXX.-Select the Purchase Order XXX.-Click Post Goods Receipt.-Notice that the proposed UoM is ABC and not the DEF you have maintained in the Purchase Order XXX. -Alternative way to reproduce the issue: -Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Delivery Proposals view.-Search for the Sales Order YYY.-Select the Sales Order YYY.-Click Post Goods Issue.-Notice that the proposed UoM is ABC and not the DEF you have maintained in the Sales Order YYY. -XXX = Purchase Order ID-YYY = Sales Order ID-ABC = UoM-DEF = UoM-Cause-The UoM proposed when you post goods issue or receipt is the one maintained under Logistics tab in the Product Master Data. To check this, please follow the steps: -Open the Product master data.-Select View All.-Choose Logistics tab.-Select the Site.-Notice that the Inventory Valuation UoM maintained is ABC.-Resolution-The system is working as expected as the UoM maintained under Logistics tab is ABC.

Title: Cannot Delete Attachment From Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You need to delete an attachment from a Supplier Invoice although the Delete button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Select the affected Supplier Invoice and click Edit.-Go to Attachments tab.-Here you will see that the Delete button is grayed out.-Cause-The affected Supplier Invoice is currently in Paid or posted status. This means that all the Financial documents have already been sent. Hence, you will not be able to delete the attachment that is in the invoice.-Also, attachments are crucial information for invoice approval purposes and for future auditing. Hence, if the attachment is deleted after the Invoice is posted/paid, then critical information will be lost.-It is the standard system functionality that it will not allow you to Delete and Replace the attachments once the Invoice gets Posted or Paid. The Delete and Replace buttons will be grayed out in such cases.-However, it is possible to delete/replace the attachments when the supplier invoice is still In Process or In Approval status.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. It should not be possible to delete attachment in an invoice that is already posted since it could cause several inconsistencies.-If the Supplier Invoice is Paid or Posted, the Delete option for the attachements will be greyed out and it cannot be deleted. Hence , we suggest to cancel the Supplier Invoice and create a new Supplier Invoice with the valid attachments , if the attachements included are wrong or if there is any requirement to change the attachement.-Keywords-Cannot Delete Attachment From Supplier Invoice,  delete an attachment from a Supplier Invoice although the Delete button is grayed out, delete attachment in supplier invoice

Title: Net Value Already Invoiced isn't Reset After Credit Memo in Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have created the Project Invoice Request for the Project . Then Customer Invoice was created which was followed up by a Credit Memo.-Now, when you create a new Project Invoice Request for the same project, the Net Value Already Invoiced on the Item level reflects the previously released Customer Invoice without deducting the amount included in the Credit Memo.-You are expecting the Net Value Already Invoiced to be back to 0 after the Credit Memo was posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Find respective Project .-Select New - Automatic Invoice Request.-Click View All.-Go to Items tab.-In Items details, the Net Value Already Invoiced reflects data from Invoice for which Credit Memo was posted. The amount included in the Credit Memo has not been deducted.-Cause-The system does not deduct the amount of the Credit Memo from the Net Value Already Invoiced in Project Invoice Requests.-Resolution-If you wish the Customer Invoice amount to be deducted from the Net Value Already Invoiced, the invoice documents and the Project Invoice Request need to be cancelled. The Credit Memo does not revert the data.-We recommend that you always cancel the last document created first to ensure consistency in the system.-Note: You cannot cancel the customer invoices of country Italy  ,as per Italy legal requirement ,hence, you have no option but to just continue creating Project inovoice request  though you get warning message :Assigned total net value of invoice item  exceeds remaining total net value of sales order item.-Keywords-Net value already invoiced,Credit memo not considered

Title: Supplier Credit Memo Cannot be Posted Against Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Supplier Credit Memo against the Supplier Invoice.-This results in an unposted source document and the following business task: Automatic clearing of source document with posting date DD.MM.YYYY failed. Supplier Invoice ABC to be cleared has postings assigned with posting date DD.MM.YYYY. Create a new manual clearing containing only ABC and save the clearing. Then post the business transaction for accounting. (DD.MM.YYYY represents the posting date of the document)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work centre.-Go to Source Documents view.-Find Supplier Invoice ID.-You will find the business task related to the unposted Supplier Credit Memo blocked by the Supplier Invoice ABC and with the following error: Automatic clearing of source document with posting date DD.MM.YYYY failed. Supplier Invoice ABC to be cleared has postings assigned with posting date DD.MM.YYYY. Create a new manual clearing containing only ABC and save the clearing. Then post the business transaction for accounting.-Cause-The error appears as the Supplier Invoice ID as previously partially cleared with posting date DD.MM.XXXX. The credit memo now tries to automatically clear itself with the remaining open amount of the supplier invoice.-But as the credit memo’s posting date is before the most recent clearing date, the error appears.-Resolution-In order to solve this issue, you need to select the invoice in the Payables account and create a clearing containing only the invoice ID. You can follow these steps to do so:-Go to work center Payables.-Go to view Supplier Accounts.-Find Supplier from invoice ID.-Click View.-Go to tab Trade Payables.-Select the Credit Memo.-Click Clear Manually.-Click Save.-The clearing will be created and generate an ID. This way the credit memo will not try to match itself with the open invoice anymore but will appear as an on account item in the supplier account. After that, you can post the Credit Memo from the Unposted Source document. Once the credit memo is posted, it will appear as open item in the Trade Payables tab of the Supplier Account Monitor as well.-You can then reset the newly created clearing for the invoice so it is also open again in the Supplier Account Monitor.-Finally, the Supplier Invoice ID and the related Credit memo can be cleared manually.

Title: System Triggered Error When Trying to Release Third Party Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-When trying to release third party delivery Notification from Third Party Purchase Order, the following error appears-Error while creating or updating follow-up document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Go to Third party Purchase Orders View.-In Find DEF (DEF refers Third party purchase order number)-Select Go.-Select New Third Party Delivery Notification.-Fill all the required entries in General tab and Items tab.-Select Release.-The following error appears as mentioned below.-Error while creating or updating follow-up document.-Cause-The serial number for item XY(XY refers Item no)  has a special character, which is not a valid character.-Resolution-User need to remove the special character from Serial Number as this is not allowed.-Keywords-Error while creating or updating follow-up document, When trying to release third party delivery Notification from Third Party Purchase Order

Title: MRP Run will not Consider the Resource Capacity Overload While Creating Production Proposals
Content: Symptom-While running MRP for a given product and planning area, system does not consider the resource capacity resulting  in over scheduling of a resource during creating of production proposals.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Supply Planning Work Center.-Go To Resource Load View.-Show 'All Resource Loads By Selection' -> Find 'Resource ID ABC (ABC means the Resource ID)' -> Open.-Under Resource Load Tab, Select Load Table.-Check for 'Operation Start Date', 'Operation Start Time'.-Cause-System considers site working calendar and expects resource always available.-System doesn't check if the resource is already occupied by other demands on a particular day and this makes resource overloaded.-Resolution-To resolve the resource overload situation, after MRP run (proposals are not released), The user can distribute the work load by performing load levelling.-To achieve this, please follow the steps below:-Go To Supply Planning Work Center.-Go To Resource Load View.-Select the Resource -> Open the Resource Load.-Here, select 'Run Load Levelling', then select Planning Horizon(from date and to date) to distribute the work load.-Now the resource load is distributed. To propagate these load levelling changes, user has to do Top Down/Bottom Up scheduling based on the need.-You may refer to help document Load Leveling and Resource Load for detailed explanation.-Keywords-MRP, Resource Load, Resource, Supply Planning, Load Leveling.

Title: Add Column to Resource Scheduler
Content: Symptom-You wish to add a new column in the Resource Scheduler.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Resource Scheduler work center.-Go to the Resource Scheduler view.-Click on any of the columns on the left pane (demands).-Click on columns and check the list of displayed fields.-Result: The list does not contain the column you wish to add.-Cause-This is standard system behaviour.-Resolution-The feature described in this case is not available in the current release of SAP Cloud for Customer.-Keywords-Resource Scheduler , C4C , Cloud for Customer , add , column, resource

Title: Templates appear in XML Text in Silverlight
Content:
Symptom-When selecting a template in Silverlight, the test is shown in XML format.-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the Silverlight UI.-Go to Service work centre.-Go to Tickets view.-Open ticket ABC (being ABC the ticket where you want to reply a customer).-In the Interactions facet, click Template.-Select a template.-Result: The templates are shown in XML text.--Cause-The HTML client understands all HTML tags and will render them accordingly. However, Silverlight does not.-That is because HTML tags were developed for HTML and RUI clients and cannot be implemented in the Silverlight client.-Hence, the Silverlight client does not render the

tag.-Resolution-Use either HTML5 or RUI to work with templates.

Title: You Want to Maintain the Data Retention Deadline for a Business Partner of the Type Individual Customer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You cannot find any data retention rule for Business Partners of the type Individual Customers.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Click on Implementation Project.-Click on Activity List.-Choose Fine-Tuning.-Open Data Retention Rule for Private Accounts.-You cannot find any data retention rule for Business Partners of the type Individual Customers-Cause-For Business Partners (of type Individual Customers) the system queries for the sales quotes and orders created for the individual customer.-It then checks the validity dates of these Sales Quotes and Orders against the retention period configuration and then proceeds with the data destruction in case the retention period has expired.-Other transactional Business Objects don’t check the retention period because there haven’t been legal requirements.-  Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: The Multi-Selection of Unassociated Emails is not Possible
Content: Symptom-The multi-selection of an Unassociated Emails is not possible.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service work center.-Go to the Unassociated E-Mails view.-Try using Ctrl key to select more than one rows of unassociated email.-It is not allow to have multi-selection using Ctrl key. Also using RUI it does not allow to select more than 1 rows/records of unassociated email using the toggle option.-Cause-Currently we do not support multi-selection in this list but is a future request. Once the multi-selection option will be enable, then the functionality(action) of mass deletion of unassociated email will also be possible.-Resolution-This is the current behavior.-Keywords-Service, Unassociated E-Mails, toggle, multi-selection, RUI

Title: Purchase Order Screen is not Displayed in English
Content: Symptom-The Purchase Order screen is displayed in a different language other than the Logon Language of the user.-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Bydesign system with logon language as English-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select View Purchase Orders-Open any Purchase Order-The tabs and all other information are displayed in different language-Cause-The Preferred Language which is provided in the user profile is X, that is why user is seeing the documents in Y language.-Resolution-Please ask the administrator to change the preferred language as respective Language as per your convenience in order to view all documents in the preferred language-Steps to follow:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view User and Access Management-Select sub-view Business Users-Search with the respective user name-Select Edit-> Attributes-Please set the preferred Language under Regional Settings -> Language--Keywords-Purchase Order Language

Title: Sourced From Data of Customer Demand is Missing When Exported to Excel
Content: Symptom-While exporting the data from the Customer Demand view to Microsoft Excel, you observe that the Sourced From column is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control workcenter.-Navigate to Customer Demand view.-Click on Export -to Microsoft Excel. -Open the download excel, you notice that the exported file does not have column named Sourced From.-Cause-Sourced From is a calculated field on the UI and hence cannot be exported to Excel.-Resolution-Excel Export does not support calculated fields. System behaves as expected.-Keywords-Sourced, From, Microsoft, Excel, Report, Calculated, Field

Title: No Product Displayed in Published Products of Supplier Catalog
Content: Symptom-It was created a new Supplier Catalog ABC (ABC represents the Supplier Catalog ID) and it was imported and published successfully.-The products appear correctly when using the catalog in a shopping cart or purchase order.-However, cannot be seen the list of products under the Published Products tab in the Supplier Catalog master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the Catalogs view.-Show All Catalogs.-Find ABC.-Select Edit.-Go to Published Products tab.-No data is displayed here.-Cause-The products will be displayed in the catalog based on the category. Therefore, the field "Catalog Category Description" must be filled while importing the catalog though it is not a mandatory field in the file. However, the products in the catalog will be displayed irrespective of the category while creating the Purchase Order, which explains why the catalog is displayed correctly from the Purchase Order or Shopping Cart.-Resolution-It can be maintained the field "Catalog Category Description" in the import template and import the catalog again. Once it has been imported and published, It will be visible the products in the Published Products tab as expected.-Keywords-Catalog, Purchase Order, Shopping Cart.

Title: Unable to Hide the Add/New Button in the Ticket's Activity Facet for the Task
Content: Symptom-Unable to hide the Add/New button in the Ticket's Activity facet for the Task.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service work center.-Go to the Tickets view.-Open the Ticket XYZ (XYZ represents the Ticket ID).-Go to the Activities facet.-Go to the Task section.-Notice you can see the Add/New button.-Click on Adapt > Enter Adaptation mode and put your cursor on New/Add button.-There is no setting/option available to hide this button.-Cause-The necessary anchors/option to personalize the hiding of buttons in Task list have been added in a future release.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior in current release.

Title: Identified Stock ID is Not Displayed In Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-Identified Stock Value not visible in Customer Invoice DEF *DEF represents Invoice id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Navigate to Invoice Documents View.-Select and edit the invoice DEF -Select View all.-Navigate to Items tab.-Cause-Identified stock information is not displayed in the customer invoice document. The information related to identified stock will be visible only in logistics documents like pick task, outbound delivery, delivery note etc.-Resolution-As per the standard system behavior  it is not possible to get the identified stock ID automatically in the customer invoice. It is available only in the Delivery Note.-However, if you still want to see the Identified Stock ID in the customer invoice, you can do so using Extension Scenario.-You can create an extension field for Identified Stock ID to reflect in the customer invoice.- -Identified stock is supported in Over the counter sales scenario. If the invoicing is done over the counter sale process, then data would be passed and value can be persisted on Customer Invoice.-Keywords-Identified Stock Value not visible in Customer Invoice, Identified stock information is not displayed in the customer invoice document, Identified Stock, not visible in Customer Invoice

Title: Party Role Restriction not Available in Tickets
Content: Symptom-You cannot find Party Role in the Code List Restriction for Tickets.-Environment- SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Administrator workcenter.-Go to the General Settings view.-Click on Code list restrictions.-Click New.-Select the Business Object Ticket.-Result: Party Role is not shown in the field Code to Restrict.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. Party Role is not available in Tickets.-Resolution-Not all Business Objects offer the same restrictions.-Having the Party Role restriction in Tickets would be a new requirement.

Title: Multiple Errors Occured When Outbound Delivery Request MDRO is Scheduled to Run Immediately
Content: Symptom-Outbound Delivery Request MDRO ran with multiple errors.-Logistics model for Standard Shipping with task for site ID PQR missing( PQR represents site ID).Create a new logistics model for the site with the relevant template in the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Related site logs proc. model missing for request ID-Segment not found for request ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound delivery requests In automated actions.-Select Run id ABC. (ABC represents Run Id)-Select Application Log DEF in error. (DEF represents Log Id)-Navigate to tab results.-Drill down the nodes , until you find messages.-Under messages you an find error below.-Logistics model for Standard Shipping with task for site ID PQR missing.-Create a new logistics model for the site with the relevant template in the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Related site logs proc. model missing for request ID-Segment not found for request ID-Cause-As you are using Logistics Model without tasks for MDRO JOB, this error is occurred.-Resolution-MDRO Jobs only supports Logistics Model with tasks,Therefore make use of Logistics Model with tasks. This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Related site logs proc. model missing for request ID,Segment not found for request ID

Title: Output History Not Generated for Third Party Outbound Deliveries
Content: Symptom-You have released Third Party Outbound Delivery. When you check Output History, there is no pdf document updated under Output History tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Order Fulfillment Workcenter.-Go to Third-Party Outbound Deliveries View.-In the field Show, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection using drop down.-Enter the relevant ID and choose Release.-Edit the document and navigate to Output History tab.-Here you see, there is no pdf document generated and its empty.-Cause-This only happens in Third-Party Outbound Deliveries because the goods directly deliver from Supplier to Customer. So, the actual delivery note lies with supplier.-Therefore, if you need Delivery Note then it needs to be printed manually in TPOP case.-Resolution-Go to Third Party Order Fulfillment Workcenter.-Go to Third-Party Outbound Deliveries View.-In the field Show, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection using drop down.-Enter the relevant ID and choose Release.-Edit the Third Party Outbound Delivery.-Choose Print Delivery Note.-Now if you navigate to Output History tab, system has generated Output History as expected.-  Keywords-Third Party, Print Delivery Note, output history, Outbound Deliveries,

Title: IFRS 16 Leasing in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-IFRS 16 provides guidance on accounting for leases.-The standard becomes effective for fiscal years beginning on 1st January 2019 or during calendar year 2019.-The SAP Business ByDesign Development team are currently working on an adoption plan of the IFRS 16 principles, analyzing the implications for leasing providers (lessors) on the one hand and lessees on the other hand, into SAP Business ByDesign.-Early application of the IFRS 16 Leasing principle is permitted, which can, however, only be achieved through individual identification of a suitable solution and its respective implementation into SAP Business ByDesign.  -See Also-For Information on the IFRS 15 implementation please see:-2535927 - IFRS 15 /ASC606 Revenue from contracts with customers in SAP Business ByDesign

Title: Customer Demand is Blocked due to Sales Order Total is Zero and Credit Card is Used
Content: Symptom-There are sales orders with total value equals to zero. The orders are released successfully but in the Customer Demand, the Delivery Block is set to Blocked status. It is not possible to process the delivery process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of a sales order)-In the General tab, the Credit Card is selected as Payment Method and the Authorization Status is Authorized. There is no Delivery Block made on this order.-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to the Customer Demand view.-Search for this order, notice that the Delivery Block status is Blocked.-Cause-The sales order total is Zero amount, in this case the credit card authorization is performed only for Pre-Authorization.-Whenever credit card is associated with Sales Order, real authorization is needed to be performed in order to start with delivery process. Only preauthorization will block the delivery. Below are the steps to check the Authorization details.-Open the sales order ABC.-The check authorization status is Authorized.-Clicking on the link, system opens a pop up window which shows all the details regarding credit card authorization.-The Pre Authorization is set as Yes and also preauthorized amount is 1 USD. This is the reason that delivery block is set in customer demand.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior as designed.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Sales Order, Delivery Block, Payment Method

Title: Search for Customer ID on Involved Parties of Installation Points Does Not Work
Content: Symptom-When you add a customer to the involved parties on an installation point, the search does not work for the Customer ID.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Installed Base work center.-Go to the Installation Points view.-Open any installation point.-Go to the Involved Parties facet.-Go to Add.-Enter the Role: Customer.-For Party: Enter customer ID YYY (YYY represents the document ID).-Result: No return.-If you enter the customer name instead of the ID, the account is returned.-Cause-The basic search not only considers the ID but also other fields.-In case of accounts the fields considered are Account ID, External ID, Website, Country, City, and Postal Code.-The Advanced Search renders the exact result.-The party field value help on installation points starts a basic search.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.

Title: In a New Over-the-Counter Sale the Ship-To Party is Not Automatically Determined by the System
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Over-The-Counter Sale and entering an Account Name or ID, the Ship-To party field is not automatically filled and remains empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Select New Over-the-Counter Sale from the Common Tasks section.-Click on View All.-In the Name field for the account enter ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-The Payer and Bill-To parties are automatically determined as per the Determination of Involved Parties you maintained in Business Configuration, but the Ship-To party field remains empty.-You expected that the Ship-To party is also automatically determined by the system as maintained in your Business Configuration.-Cause-Over-The-Counter Sales function is different than the standard Sales Order process. It is the selling of goods to a customer in an Over-The-Counter Sales process with goods movement. The buyer obtains the goods in person and hence there is no Ship-To proposition.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-In case you need a Ship-To party you can enter it manually or select it from the value selection.-See Also-1893725 - The Ship-To party is not Shown on the "Over-the-Counter" overview-Keywords-determination,over the counter sale,ship to

Title: How to do a Product Count for a Product That has Zero On-hand Stock
Content: Symptom-You cannot do a Product Count for a Product that has zero On-Hand Stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory Work Center.-Select Common Task and then 'New Product Count'.-Enter the relevant Storage Location ID.-Enter the relevant Product ID.-Click the Go button.-Click the Next button.-The system throws up the error message: Action not permitted; no product selected. -Cause-Product Count works only if the Product has an On-Hand Quantity that is greater than zero.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can do an Inventory Adjustment for the product that has zero On-Hand Stock.-Go to the Physical Inventory Work Center.-Select Common Task and then 'New Inventory Adjustment'.-Enter the relevant Storage Location ID.-Enter the relevant Product ID.-Click the Go button.-Click the Next button.-Click Add Row button.-In step 6, you will not encounter the error message as before and you are now able to do an Inventory Adjustment.-  Keywords-Zero, On-Hand, Stock, Product, Count

Title: Belongs to Individual Material Field Does Not Add Extra Individual Materials to a Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You want to consider the acquisition cost of a fixed asset to be the value of two or more individual materials. Thus, when creating individual materials in the Purchase Order, you use the Belongs To Individual Material field to do such configuration. However, it does not add those individual materials to the fixed asset as expected.-Reproducing the Issue-When you open the Goods and Services Receipt document, the individual materials you have set to belong to individual material ABC are found with no fixed asset.-Go to Goods and Services Receipt Work Center.-Go to Receipts and Returns view.-Show by Document.-Choose Show All Documents.-Search for Goods and Services Receipt XYZ.-Highlight Goods and Services Receipt XYZ.-Click Edit button.-Go to Items tab.-Highlight one of the individual materials you have set to belong to individual material ABC.-Go to Basic Data tab.-If you check the field Belongs to Fixed Asset, you will find the message: 'Fixed asset does not exist'.-*ABC represents an Individual material ID.-*XYZ represents a Goods and Services Receipt ID.-Cause-The Purchase Request is preventing changes in the Purchase Order.
