If the Purchase Order was created manually, with no links to a Purchase Request, the Belongs To Individual Material field would work properly.-Resolution-To solve this issue, you should create two Purchase Orders from the Purchase Request: One PO for individual material ABC, and another PO for all the other individual materials that you want to be captured by ABC.-1) To create a PO for individual material ABC, follow the steps below:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Choose Show All Documents.-Search for Purchase Request GHI.-Highlight Purchase Request GHI.-Click New Purchase Order button.-Delete all the individual materials, except individual material ABC.-Click Order button.-2) To create a PO for the other individual materials, do the following steps:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Choose Show All Documents.-Search for Purchase Request GHI.-Highlight Purchase Request GHI.-Click New Purchase Order button.-Do not delete any material, except individual material ABC.-Now, you will be able to set these individual materials as belonging to individual material ABC.-*GHI represents a Purchase Request ID.

Title: Error When Trying to Add a Logistics Use to a Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message when trying to add the Logistics Use Over The Counter Stock to a Logistics Area.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Locations view.-Search for the Location XXX.-Select the Location XXX.-Choose Edit Layout.-Select the Logistics Area YYY.-Select General subtab.-Select Add Row.-On the new row, select Over The Counter Stock as Logistics Use.-Click Save.-You receive the error message:-'Over the counter usage already exists for logistics area ZZZ within storage location XXX. Only one "Over the counter" usage is permitted per site.'- XXX = Location ID-YYY = Logistics Area ID-ZZZ = Logistics Area ID-Cause-The system does not allow you to add more than one Logistics Area with Logistics Use Over The Counter Stock inside a Location.-Resolution-System is working as designed. However, the recommended is that you set up a separate site, to ensure that inventory reserved for Sales Orders is also not considered for Over-The-Counter Sales. Over-the-counter sales does not make an availability check and cannot consider existing reservations.

Title: System Failed to Create Purchase Order Automatically From Purchase Request Created Through Webservice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2867507***-You have defined the rule for automatic creation of Purchase Orders. When you create purchase request through web service, system failed to create purchase order automatically.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Common Tasks view-Select Define Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders-You have defined the creation options for Company, Supplier, Origin Type and Product Category-Now go to the Purchase Requests view-Select the relevant Purchase Request created from Web Service-You can see that Follow-On Status appears as No Follow-up-Cause-System will not create purchase orders automatically from the purchase request which were created through an external application like web service. The reason behind is; Buyer wants to enter the source of supply - Supplier, club few purchase requests in to one order for the same supplier, Delivery Date etc. and then create purchase order with multiple line items. Hence the flexibility has been given to buyer responsible to process purchase requests and then create orders manually.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior for purchase requests which were created through external application. (Web service)

Title: The Indicator Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally on Purchase Order is Automatically set to true value while creating Purchase Order via Web Services
Content: Symptom-The indicator Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally on Purchase Orders is automatically set to true (even if you have given false value in the payload against the attribute <CostDistributionIndicator>) while creating the Purchase Order via Web Services.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You execute the Purchase Order payload either from external system or via SOAP UI. Where in the payload, under <Items> node, you have explicitly given <CostDistributionIndicator>false</CostDistributionIndicator>.-After execution of the payload, still the Distribute Additional Costs Proportionally is marked on Purchase Order for the respective line item.-Cause-This is causing because under <Items> node, you have given the following value against <BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>-<BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>004</BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>-Here 004 is for Additional Costs Debit Item.-Resolution-Change the value against <BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode> to:-<BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>002</BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>-As 002 is for Invoice Items and 003 is for Credit Memo Items.-Keywords

Title: Forecast Not Available on MRP Screen
Content: Symptom-You have run the forecast demanding for a product, and there is unconsumed forecast for previous period. However, when you open Material Requirements Planning (MRP) for that product, you are not able to see those forecasts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Go to Products View.-Enter Product XXX (XXX represents product ID).-Click Open, and you can see that no forecast shown in the screen.-Cause-You maintained "ATOS_CPC - All demand Consumes Current Forecast" as demand management procedure for the product XXX. Thus, the system will only consider the forecast in current period, and if there is any unconsumed forecast before current period, it will not be shown in MRP. For example, there are unconsumed forecast in week 29 for a product, and you run the MRP in week 30. There won't be any forecast shown in MRP.-Resolution-It is a standard system behavior if you choose "ATOS_CPC - All demand Consumes Current Forecast" as demand management procedure for the product. If you want demand to consume the preceding forecast, then you have to change the demand management procedure by following steps:-Go to Product Data Work center.-Go to Materials View.-Enter Product XXX and select it.-Click Edit.-Click View All.-Go to Planning Tab.-Select ATOS_MPC - All demand consumes preceding forecasts as Demand Management Procedure.-Keywords-Forecast, MRP, Material Requirements Planning, Demand

Title: Outbound Delivery Record Missing in the Outbound Delivery Performance by Time Report
Content: Symptom-A sales order contains multiple outbound deliveries. Thus, you expect to see all the outbound deliveries recording in the report Outbound Delivery Performance by Time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Report - List View.-Open Report - Outbound Delivery Performance by Time.-Enter Product ID XXX (means Product ID).-Enter Sales Order ID YYY (means Sales Order ID).-Click Go.-Right click on Delivery Document ID.-Click Move to Rows, you can see that there are only two Outbound Deliveries shown in the report, however, there are three Outbound Deliveries referenced to Sales Order YYY.-Cause-Whenever there are multiple deliveries involved for an order, the report displays only the deliveries having deviation to requested date (i.e. Delivery Date is Oct 1st and Request Date is Oct 2nd) and not the ones which have no deviation(i.e. Delivery Date and Request Date is on the same day). In case all the deliveries have no deviation, the report displays all of them. To summarize, there are three situations:-All the deliveries have no deviation to requested date, then report displays all of deliveries.-All the deliveries have deviation to requested date, then report displays all of deliveries.-Among all the deliveries , some have deviation to requested date , and the else do not, then the report display only the deliveries that having the deviation.- Resolution-Hence for documents with multiple deliveries, if you have to view the deliveries with no deviation, you need to alter the key figures settings as below:-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Report - List View.-Open Report - Outbound Delivery Performance by Time.-Click Settings.-Select Key Figures.-Select the Delivered Quantity field.-Move the field to the right column.-Click Ok.-When you choose to display the delivered quantity, it displays the delivered quantity for every delivery involved and hence picking up the deliveries with no deviation also.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Report, Product, Sales Order

Title: Unable to Add Material to a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-A Material is blocked from Purchasing Processes in the Material Master Data; however, the same Material can still be added to a Supplier Invoice created without a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Select New Invoice without Purchase Order under Common tasks .-Go to Items tab.-Enter a Product ABC in the Product ID column (ABC represents Product ID)-Material/Product ABC can still be added even when the respective Material Master Data has the Purchasing Process blocked.-Cause-To the check whether the Product is blocked for Purchasing, follow the steps below:-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center.-Go to Products view.-Select All Materials from the drop-down.-Search for Product ABC.-Select Edit.-Choose View All.-Go to Purchasing tab, the status should be "Blocked".-This is because blocking the Purchasing process only prevents the Material from being added to documents such as Purchase Orders, Shopping Carts, etc., and does not prevent the Material from being used in the invoicing process.-Resolution-An alternative way is to descope the Question 'Do you receive invoices without reference to other purchase documents?' from the Business Configuration.--Follow the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select the Active Project.-Edit the Project Scope.-Go to Step 4-Questions.-Expand the below path.-Purchasing -> Supplier Invoicing -> Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos -> Group: Supplier Invoicing Types -> Do you receive invoices without reference to other purchase documents?-This question enables the creation of Supplier Invoices without any reference to other Purchase documents. Once this question is descoped, Supplier Invoices without a Purchase Order cannot be created in the system.-Keywords-Blocked Material; Purchasing Process; Supplier invoice; Purchase Order

Title: Unable to Find Fields Latitude and Longitude in the Custom ODATA Service for Installed Base
Content: Symptom-You have created custom ODATA service for Installed Base. You want to include the Location information and other fields like Latitude and Longitude, however you are not able to find the same.-Cause-Currently these fields are not available in the consumers of the Business Object like Web Services, ODATA services.-Further the Installed Base Object is also not avilable in the stanard ODATA service.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior. This functionality is added as a new requirement and will be available in one of the future releases.

Title: Approval Task isn't Sent to Person Responsible of the Project Task
Content: Symptom-You have recorded times against a Project Task. The person responsible for this Project Task didn't receive the approval tasks for the time recordings done on the tasks he's responsible for.-All the approvals go to the person responsible at project header level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work centre.-Go to Time Sheets view.-Find the employee who recorded the times.-Select Open Time Sheet.-Select the recorded time.-In the Details of the recorded time, the Approver maintained is the Project Manager from the header level and not the person responsible at the task level.-Cause-You have chosen time recording approver as' Project lead'-Resolution-Select the Project Header task and go to  tab 'Project settings' where you can choose either 'project lead' or 'task owner'- 'Project lead' is header task responsible person- 'Task owner' is respective task responsible person

Title: Error Message: “Service Call Failed; Report an Incident”, While Migrating Bill of Operation
Content: Symptom-You receive the below error when trying to migrate Bills Of Operation using the Migration Activity.-Error: "Service call failed; report an case"-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view-Search and Open the activity Migration of Bills of Operation-Choose Migrate Bills of Operation using the migration tool-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation steps-Cause-There could be many causes that may lead to this issue and one of the causes could be that in the template for an Activity, you have maintained the operation of type Final Inspection ,hence the operation applicable must be a Check operation. However the migration object does not support the migration of Check operation. Please refer to the Documentation tab of the migration template. It says that you cannot migrate Operation Type - Check.-Resolution-Remove the Operation Type - Check in the migration template and re-execute.-Keywords

Title: There is No Hierarchy Display in an Installation Point of Type as Functional Location
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The hierarchy is not displayed for an Installation Point of type Functional Location.-Environment- SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Installed Base work center.-Navigate to the Installation Points view.-Search for Installation Point ABC (where ABC is the Installation Point ID with category Functional Location) and open it.-Go to the Items facet and select the option Add Item.-Observe that there is no option to maintain hierarchy, i.e., the "Add at Lower-Level" option is not available.-Cause-This option is not available for the Installation Point of type as Functional Location, as it can be seen at Installed Base ->Item facet on adding an item.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior in current release.-See Also-Please refer the Help Center Document with name : Installation Point FAQ.-Keywords-Hierarchy, Installation Point, Functional Location

Title: System Crash When You Try to Post a New Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order, the system crashes when Post is selected, although the document passes the Check without errors. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Under Common Tasks, select New Invoice without Purchase Order.-Enter all the necessary data to create the new Supplier Invoice.-Select Check button.-System displays the Message "Check complete; document contains no errors".-Select Post.-System throws "500 SAP Internal Server Error"-Cause-In the Business Configuration Fine-Tune activity "Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing", two Document Numbering Formats are maintained for the same Company. This configuration is not allowed, even when different prefixes are assigned. -Resolution-There are two options to resolve the issue.-Resolution 1: Delete the unused Document Numbering Format-If the new Document Numbering Format has not been used, it can be removed.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project.-Select Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Select Show All Activities.-Search for Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing.-Select Open.-Check the Document Numbering Formats maintained for the same Company in the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Select the unused/new format.-Choose Delete Row.-Select Save.-Resolution 2: Configure the new Document Numbering Format for yearly numbering-If the new Document Numbering Format needs to be retained, configure yearly numbering for the format.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project.-Select Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Select Show All Activities.-Search for Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing.-Select Open.-Select the new Document Numbering Format.-Select the checkboxes "Calendar Year as Suffix" and "Restart Doc. ID Each Cal. Year".-Select Save.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order; Document Numbering Format for Supplier Invoicing; Dump; Supplier Invoice

Title: Key Figure Values Multiplied in Reports with Hierarchy
Content: Symptom-You are viewing a report that has a hierarchical structure and when filtering for specific values, you notice that the key figure values are multiplied - the value is shown for each node of the hierarchy, instead of just the lowest level (where the value comes from).-For example: You are viewing a report showing opportunities and territories. There is a hierarchy setting on the field Territory, and you have filtered for one specific opportunity. The key figure value for Expected Value for this opportunity is shown for the assigned territory, as well as for every node above this territory. As a result, the same expected value is shown multiple times.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the respective report from the assigned work center.-Add the required fields to the view (in our case Territory, Opportunity and the key figure Expected Value).-There is a hierarchy setting on the Territory: Go to Settings > Characteristics > column Display Hierarchy.-The Expected Value of the opportunity is shown for every single node in the territory hierarchy. As a sum, this results in the wrong value.-Cause-It would be wrong to show the Expected Value for the lowest level only because on collapsing the hierarchy, the value would disappear.-With an active hierarchy setting in the report, the key figure values always show the actual values from the respective documents, plus their sum on every subordinate hierarchy node. This is the correct behaviour.-Resolution-If you have a hierarchy set and you want to use the filter or selection, it is more helpful to filter on the hierarchical field, rather than on another one. In our case, you can filter for a specific territory ID, and see what the expected value is for this node. Please note that the top level node will always be a summation of the subordinate nodes.-If you need to see the values for one / several specific document(s), we would recommend to remove the hierarchy setting. To do so:-Open and run the report.-Go to Settings > Characteristics.-In the Display Hierarchy column, select the option Do Not Show.-Click on OK.

Title: What Content Appears in the Changes Tab of a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created the Purchase Order XXX (XXX represents the Purchase Order ID) on dd-mm-yyyy.-You have made changes to this Purchase Order on dd+1-mm-yyyy.-You expect all the data entered to be reflected in the Changes tab of the Purchase Order, including the initial data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find XXX.-Select Edit.-Go to the Changes Tab.-You can see the data recorded starts on dd+1-mm-yyyy. You expect data from the Purchase Order creation on dd.mm.yyyy to appear.-Cause-The Changes Tab only contains data entered after the first Save of the document. No data entered before that first Save is recorded. This is valid for all Business Documents.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.

Title: No Source of Supply Determined against Purchase Proposal Created Manually or via MRP Run
Content: Symptom-You have created Purchase Proposal manually and also via Planning Run for a required product. However, where you check the Purchase Proposal there is no Supplier maintained and no Source of Supply is determined by the system although valid Purchase Contracts are available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning WorkCenter.-Go to Products View.-Find and select the required Product ID and Planning Area.-Click the Open button.-Under Supply and Demand List section, choose New Planning Proposal and enter the required quantity.-System creates Purchase Proposal ID.-Here you find under column: Source, there is no Source of Supply determined.-Even when you run MRP, it is also blank.-Cause-Cause 1: Since the Minimum Order Quantity maintained in a required Purchase Contract is X and you have maintained quantity less than X in the Purchase Proposal. Hence, system is unable to determine the valid source of supply.-You have to maintain quantity equals to or more than the Minimum Order Quantity maintained in a contract to determine valid Source of Supply against Purchase Proposal.-Cause 2: Since you have maintained lead time in the Contract, you should not give a date of purchase proposal before this Lead time.-Lead period = Validity start date of the Contract + Lead Time maintained in the Contract.-Example: 10.12.2017 = 1.12.2017 + 10 days, so you should choose a date after 10.12.2017 for the Planning Proposal.-Resolution-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting workcenter.-Go to Contracts View.-Choose All Contracts using the dropdown and select the relevant Contract ID.-Choose and edit it.-Navigate to Items tab.-Choose line item with the required Product.-Go to Basic Data subtab and check Minimum Order Quantity maintained.-Again go to Supply Planning and choose products.-Now create Purchase Planning Proposal with quantity more than or equals to Minimum Order Quantity.-Also ensure that date given while creating Purchase proposal must be after the lead time.-Perform Save.-Keywords-Supplier ID, missing, Source of Supply

Title: Revoke Project Invoice Request cancelation status
Content: Symptom-The cancellation of a Project Invoice Request requires to be revoked in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Project Invoicing View.-Select the Project Invoice Requests Sub View.-Search for the Project Invoice Request XYZ. (where XYZ represents the Project Invoice Request ID)-The Project Invoice Request is displayed with one of the overall status: Release, Invoiced or Partially Invoiced.-Cancel the Project Invoice Request XYZ.-The status of the Project Invoice Request XYZ is changed to Canceled. However it is not possible to revoke the cancelation of the document.-Cause-Once a Project Invoice Request is canceled, it is not possible to revoke the cancellation and this is expected behavior in SAP Business ByDesign.-One benefit of this feature is: If you want to avoid that the Project Invoice Requested is invoiced again by mistake (for example: by a user who is not aware that the related Customer Invoice has been canceled), then you can cancel the Project Invoice before canceling the Customer Invoice.-Resolution-Recommended actions for the following scenarios:-If the Customer Invoice does not exist: Create a new Project Invoice Request -> Create the Customer Invoice.-If the Customer Invoice exist: Cancel the existing Customer Invoice -> Create a new Project Invoice Request -> Create the Customer Invoice.-Keywords-project invoice request, customer invoice, canceled, revoke, cancellation

Title: Sales Order Not Visible In Customer Demand View
Content: Symptom-A Sales Order was created, but it's not found when searching for it in Customer Demand view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant Sales Order document.-The Sales Order entry was not found in the Customer Demand view.-Cause-The Sales Order was not released to Customer Demand.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the relevant Sales Order.  -Select the order, choose the Actions button and select the option Release.-Once the order is successfully released it could be find in the Customer Demand view.-Keywords-Sales Order, Customer Demand, Release

Title: E-mail Notification not Received for Approval
Content: Symptom-The Customer is not able to receive e-mail notifications for Sales Quote Approval.-Environment-SAP Sales Cloud-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Sales work center.-2. Go to the Sales Quote view.-3. Open the Sales Quote ABC (where ABC represents the sales quote ID).-4. Go to Actions and then select Submit for Approval.-The e-mail notification for Sales Quote Approval is not received by the Approver.-Cause-This is because the Approver has not subscribed to e-mails for the Approval Notifications.-Resolution-When the Approver opens the notification popup, they will see an e-mail symbol on the right side of the Approval Notification.-Once they select this e-mail icon (=> subscribe to e-mail) they will receive emails for the approval notifications ongoing from that point (not for previous approvals).-Keywords-notification, approval, approval process, subscription, process, E-Mail,  not sent, e-mail,

Title: During Project Migration from Microsoft Project, system does not fetches Responsible Employee for Project Tasks from XML file
Content: Symptom-While migrating Project from Microsoft Project, system does not fetches the employee responsible for Project Tasks from Migration XML file.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Project Management work center and select Projects view.-2. Select New button and then Project.-3. Select Source as Microsoft Project, also select Project Type and Project Language and click on Next.-4. Upload the XML file and complete the wizard, where the XML file contains employee responsible for Project Tasks.-5. After Project creation, the employee responsible are not maintained.   -Cause-Resources in Microsoft Project is not uploaded when you upload a Project from XML using New Project Activity. This is a system limitation.-Resolution-You can use the Migration Template for Project Migrations. The migration template contains employee-responsible for every task.

Title: Error in Inspection Plan During Change of Status
Content: Symptom-  When you try to activate inspection Plan 9999 you encounter the following error--   Inspection plan is not consistent; activation not possible-   Catalog CatalogXYZ for code CodeXYZ not in validity period--  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-   1. Go to Quality Planning workcenter and Inspection Plans view.-    2. Show All Inspection Plans and Find Inspection Plan ID 9999.-    3. Select Inspection Plan ID 9999 and Change Status to Active.-    You encounter the above error.-  Cause-   Quality Codes of the Qualtity catalog used in the Inspection Plan are currently not Valid.-    You can check the Validity of the Quality Code in Quality Code Catalogs view.-Resolution-   Follow the below steps to create a new version of the catalog--    1. Go to Inspection Plan workcenter and Quality Code Catalogs view.-    2. Select the Catalog ID and create New Catalog Version.-    3. Set the relevant Valid From and Valid To date, Save and Close.-    Once the above steps are completed follow the below steps to Change Status of Inspection Plan--    1. Go to Quality Planning workcenter and Inspection Plans view.-    2. Show All Inspection Plans and Find Inspection Plan ID 9999 and Edit.-    3. Go to Quality Codes sub tab-    4. Select the Code ID and Remove and add it again using Add Row and Save.-    You should now be able to change the status of the inspection plan to Active without any errors.-Keywords-Inspection Plan, Quality Planning, Catalog ID, Catalog Version, Quality Code

Title: Apply Doesn't Work in Add Mashup Screen to Uncheck Visibility
Content: Symptom-You open the Add Mashup frame in any screen, uncheck the visibility checkbox of any Mashups that were previously checked and then press the Apply button to apply the changes, but nothing happens and the Add Mashup screen remains there unless you cancel it.-Reproducing the Issue-  Hover the mouse over an element of the screen to appear the Add Mashup button.-Click on the button to open the Add Mashup screen.-Uncheck visibility field of one or more Mashups that were previously checked.-Press the Apply button and nothing will happen.-Cause-The Add Mashup screen is to be used only to add new Mashups to the screen (check visibility option), so the option to remove them (uncheck visibility option) is not done through it, even though the checkbox is available to be unchecked.-In future releases (expected to be 1711) there will be enhancements to this function where mashups that were already added won't show up in the Add Mashup screen anymore.-Resolution-If you want to remove a Mashup from the screen, the correct procedure is the following:-Go to the screen where the mashup is added.-Enter Adaptation Mode.-Hover the mouse over the mashup to pop up the "X" option.- Click on the "X" option to remove it from the screen.-

Title: Fixed Amount is Not Supported in Standard Gross Procedure
Content: Symptom-You want to set the Overall Discount as Fixed Amount for Gross Procedure, but you find system defaults it to Percentage and does not allow the modification. However, it is possible to change from Percentage to Fixed Amount in Standard Procedure.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-In Business Configuration Search, find Configure Price Strategy. System searchs and displays the activity in the result table.-Click Configure Price Strategy to open the window, click Configure Pricing Procedure.-In the Configure Pricing Procedure screen, click Standard Procedure, select Overall Discount (%), it is possible to change the Calculation Rule between Fixed Amount and Precentage (of one hundred).-Click Standard Gross Procedure, the price component Gross Overall Discount (%) defaults Percentage (of one hundred) as Calculation Rule, and it is grayedout. You are not able to change it.-Cause-Currently, fixed amount is not supported in gross overall discount.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-See Also-related case document:-1950293 - You Received the following Error Message : "You cannot change Overall Discount (%), as document(s) already exist".

Title: Team Member and Service Fields Not Editable in a Project
Content: Symptom-You want to change the Team Member assigned to a Service in the Work tab of a Project but the Team Member field is grayed out and data cannot be changed or added.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Find ABC (ABC represents the Project ID).-Select Edit - Project Plan.-Go to the Work Tab.-The Team Member field is not editable.-Cause-It is not allowed to change the Team Member assignment for a Service if there are Time confirmations or Purchase Requests created for the same Project Task and Service.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour. A purchase request or time recording is assigned to that Service so no changes can be done to it.-You must cancel the purchase request or time recording in order to make it editable.

Title: Delivery Blocked in the Customer Demand for Sales Order With Payment by Credit Card
Content: Symptom-System throws an error saying that the Delivery is blocked while releasing the Customer Demand. However, the Payment by Credit Card has been Authorized.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Select Customer Demand view.-Search for Customer Demand XXX. (XXX means Customer Demand ID)-Select the Customer Demand XXX.-Click Release.-Receive the error message:-"Release of order not possible; Sales Order ZZZ item 10 blocked" (ZZZ means Sales Order ID)-Cause-The Delivery is blocked in the Customer Demand because the Delivery Date is beyond the Authorization Horizon maintained for the Credit Card. Note that the date being considered here is Delivery Date displayed in the ATP and not the Requested Delivery Date.- It can be checked the Authorization Horizon following the steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Credit Card Authorization and Settlement activity.-Open the Activity Credit Card Authorization and Settlement.-Click Edit credit card authorization profiles.-Notice that the Authorization Horizon for Preauthorization is YYY days. (YYY means Authorization Horizon (in days))-Resolution-As a workaround, it can be waited for the Delivery Date to be within the Authorization Horizon.-Keywords-Delivery Blocked, Customer Demand, Sales Order, Credit Card, Delivery Date

Title: Prevent User from Changing Price in Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are using a Product with a List Price maintained in Purchase Order XXX (XXX represents the Purchase Order ID).-Upon creating of the Purchase Order with this Product, the Price is automatically maintained.-However, this Price is editable.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find XXX.-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Go to the Items tab.-You can see here that the Price information is editable.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour. Users responsible for processing Purchase Orders should have the authority to change the price in the document if it is required.-Resolution-You can create a PDI solution to prevent the Price from being changed.

Title: Unable to Post Supplier Invoice Due to Error Message ‘Depreciation method missing for valuation view ABC set of books XYZ’
Content: Symptom-When you create a supplier invoice in which cost distritution is IMAT, error comes: "Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Depreciation method missing for valuation view ABC set of books XYZ".-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center and access Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Open the concerned invoice document and click View All.-Navigate to the Exceptions tab, you can see the error message:"Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Depreciation method missing for valuation view ABC (ABC stands for valuation view ID) set of books XYZ (XYZ stands for Set of Books ID)".-Cause-For the invoice items you have defined the account assignment as IMAT - Individual Material.In this scenario, the individual material is the cost object. Considering that this is an asset acquistion, the system will reach the Fixed Asset subledger with a G/L Account of type ASSET - Fixed assets and derive the fixed asset class for the sepcific product category. -However, you will the find depreciation method for the valuation view under the fixed asset class hasn't been maintained.-Resolution-In order to solve the issue , you can follow the steps below: -Go to Business Configuration work center and access the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List of the current project.-Show All Activities and find Fixed Asset Classes.-In the Fixed Asset Classes view ,click Asset Class Determination.-You will find the asset class LMN (LMN standards for asset class ID) of the product category for the fixed asset.-Close the current view and click Edit fixed asset classes in the Fixed Asset Classes.-In the current view , find the asset class LMN and maintain the depreciation method for the valuation view ABC.
