Title: Return to Supplier Document is not Available for Action Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-Return to Supplier is not available for action Post Goods issue in Outbound Logistics work center.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center-Select view Delivery Control-Select sub-view Delivery Proposals-Return to Supplier document is not available here to create Goods Issue-Cause-You have selected option Create Warehouse Request for this Return document from Delivery proposals view, hence system has created a warehouse request and warehouse task which is not yet confirmed, hence the Return document is not available for posting Goods Issue.-Resolution-You have to manually confirm this warehouse task.Then it will create Outbound delivery in turn.-Alternately, you can select Post Goods Issue directly for a Return document from the Outbound Logistics-> Delivery Proposals view, then the system will automatically finish the warehouse task and generate Outbound Delivery for this Return document.-Keywords-Return to Supplier; Warehouse Request; Outbound Delivery; Post Goods Issue

Title: The Recurring Invoice Description is not Reflected in the corresponding Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom- Recurring Invoice Description field is missing in Supplier Invoice-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supplier Invoicing-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the particular invoice-Recurring Invoice Description field is missing in Supplier invoice screen-Cause-In the current Bydesign system, the Recurring Invoice Description is not automatically taken into the resulting supplier invoice. You can manually add the description in the supplier invoice-Resolution-This is the Expected System behavior

Title: The Visit's Attendee List Shows all Contact, not Just Contact Related to Visit's Account
Content: Symptom-The Visit attendee list displays all contacts instead of only those related to the Visit account.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Visit work center.-Navigate to the Visit view and search for Visit ABC (where ABC is the visit name for account LMN).-Open account LMN and navigate to the Contacts facet.-  Observe that only a few contacts are listed. -Open Visit ABC and navigate to the Attendees facet.-Click on Add and open the value help for the Name field.-Result:-All contacts are displayed instead of only the contacts associated with account LMN.-Cause-The attendee list is not restricted to contacts associated with the Visit’s account by default. If the business requirement is to add only account-related contacts, they should be maintained under the Contacts facet instead of the Attendees facet.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Visit, Attendee, Contact, Account

Title: Unable to See Any Forecast Data for Product in Forecast Consumption Report though Foreacast Exists
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Forecast for the products in Demand Planning workcenter but when you run Forecast Consumption Report, system is not displaying any forecast data for the required product moreover they are missing in a report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Go to Forecast Consumption Report.-In the Forecast Consumption Report screen enter the product for which you have view the consumption report.-Choose Go.-Here no Forecast Data is being dispalyed for the required product.-Cause-Since you have not maintained any Demand Managment Procedure for the required product with combination of planning area in product master data, therefore it is not valid for Demand Planning and hence no data is available in Forecast Consumption report.-Resolution-Go to Product Data workcenter.-Go to Materials view.-Enter the required Product ID.-Select and choose Edit.-Go to View All and naviagte to Planning tab.-Here in the field:Demand Management Procedure.-Maintain required Demand Management Procedure as per your business requirement.-Perform Save.-Keywords- Forecast Consumption, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Forecast

Title: While Posting Supplier Invoice, You Get Error - 'Customer of project and sales order are different'
Content: Symptom-When checking or posting a Supplier Invoice, an error message raised:-Customer of project and sales order are different-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice and select Edit.-Select Check or Post button, the error message raised.   -Cause-The Purchase Order linked to the supplier invoice is created from a Project AAA, where as the Project AAA is created from a Sales Order BBB.-Reason 1-In Purchase Order for the respective line item, the Account Assignment is done for the same Project AAA but different Sales Order CCC.-Reason 2 -In the current Supplier Invoice, for the respective line item, the Cost Distribution is done for the same Project AAA but different Sales Order CCC.-Resolution-Correct the Sales Order ID in the Account Assignment of the Supplier Invoice or Purchase Order.  -Keywords-Customer of project and sales order are different; Supplier Invoice; Account Assignment; Cost Distribution

Title: Cannot Cancel Line Item From Purchase Order in Status 'In Revision'
Content: Symptom-Unable to cancel the line item from Purchase Order which is in status In Revision. This issue only occurs in Ordered Purchase Order and then later on new item is added to the Purchase Order, because of which a re-approval is triggered and the approver sends back the Purchase Order for Revision.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order.-Select the Edit button.-Navigate to the Items tab, see that Cancel Item button is Greyed out.-Cause-Check if there is any follow-up document created for the line item. For example, if the line item has been invoiced, then it cannot be directly cancelled.-Resolution-If the line item has been delivered or invoiced, then it is necessary to cancel the receipts or invoices first.-Keywords-Purchase order; Cancel; Item; In Revision

Title: System Dumps While Editing an Inspection ID
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to edit an Inspection ID, system throws a dump.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Control Workcenter.-Go to Monitoring View.-Go to Inspections subview.-Search for required Inspection ID.-Select and Edit it, now system crashes.-Cause-This issue occurs when there are duplicated entries for Inspection Stage IDs in adaptive sampling activity under Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Workcenter.-Go to Overview View.-Search for activity Adaptive Sampling and choose Open.-Check Adaptive Sampling Rule ID ex. XYZ and ABC.-If you check the Adaptive Sampling Rule IDs ex. XYZ (default by system) and ABC, you can see that the IDs for Inspection Stage are same in both.-You need to select the required rule, delete all the Inspection Stage IDs and create new ones, with different IDs.-     Note :These Inspection Stage IDs for adaptive sampling rule must be unique always.

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on Human Capital Management (HCM) – Integration
Content: Symptom-The Following are generic queries related to ByD HCM – Web Services and Integration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1.   What is the workcenter in SAP Business ByDesign with the information about Integration?-You will access it via Master Data Replication WoC.-2.   Can you make changes in the Personnel Administration Workcenter in ByDesign when you are using a integrated system?-No, the workcenter Personnel Administration is visible, but not editable. The data is editable only in the ECC system.-3.   Is it possible to change data of the Biographical Data in Master Data Replication > Employee > Employee Details?-Yes, you can Edit the Biographical Data of an Employee via SAP Business ByDesign.-4.   Is it possible to change data of Organizational Data in Master Data Replication > Employee > Organizational Data?-No, you cannot edit Organizational Data via Master Data Replication.-5.   Is it possible to map existing Employees/Users in SAP Bydesign and SuccessFactor?-This scenario is currently not supported, hence the mapping of existing employees is not possible. For further details please check the case document 2530553 - SAP BYD SF Integration Pre-requisites.-6.   Does the Holiday calendar replicate from ECC to ByDesign?-No, you have to maintain the information related to Holiday Calendar in both systems.-7.   What is the preconditions to have a Integration Between SuccessFactors and SAP Business ByDesign?-One Employee Central tenant is connected to one Business ByDesign tenant as the only source of employee replication.-ByD HCM application does not contain any (legacy) employee master data. A migration of those to the EC landscape is not supported.-All employees are maintained in Employee Central. No mixed scenarios like maintaining the employee data for one company in EC and for another one in ByD are supported.-If the PDI enhancements are used to also replicate service agents, no service agents may be maintained in ByD. This has to be ensured by means of the ByD authorization concept. -8.   You have a requirement to scope the integration between Success Factors and SAP Business ByDesign but during finalize step, system throws below error message:-System does not allow to finalize the scoping changes due to an error:-Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings of the productive data-The actual cause for the error could be that you are trying to unscope Payroll and there are payroll data exists in the system.-Actually, the Employee Central cannot be used as ByD Payroll is in scope.This is not supported. You can unscope payroll once when there is no payroll data created in the system.-For further details please check the case document 2324055 - Unable to Scope the question.-9. You are creating a PSM request to create Employees via web service managepersonnelhiringin the response after successfully creating an employee you expect the response to contain an Employee ID. This  Employee ID is necessary for the update in the chain of managing employees with manageemployeeIn in the next step for Query purpose.-According to the standard system behavior we do not get the Employee ID in the response, instead an UUID is generated in the response which is nothing but the UUID for the employee. You can provide the above UUID to find the employee ID / Info in BO. But, there is no Query by Identification with UUID so there is no way to identify the Employee Id here. Therefore, we request you to kindly add up your idea in the below Influence Portal Influence Opportunity Homepage - Customer Influence (sap.com)-10. In  PSM request is there any possibility of changing a Hire Date or Termination Date without having to actually terminate and rehire an employee to avoid unnecessary work agreements that would have a direct impact on the business analytics via web service.-No there is such possibility to change the Hire Date or Termination date. Therefore, we request you to kindly add up your idea in the below Influence Portal Influence Opportunity Homepage - Customer Influence (sap.com)-11. You want to change or update the Agreed Working Hour Rate of an Employee through web services.-When you get into your Cloud Studio of BYD system, navigate to Business Object HCF_WORKAGREEMENT ES NAME: WorkAgreement. This web services can help you in updating the working hour rate of an employee.-See Also-2324055 - Unable to Scope the question "You can integrate your solution with SuccessFactors Employee Central"-2530553 - SAP BYD SF Integration Pre-requisites-Keywords-Human Capital Management, HCM Integration, HCM FAQ, Human Capital Management Integration

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on HCM Reports and Data Sources
Content: Symptom-This document covers some basic and frequently asked questions regarding HCM Reports and Data Sources in SAP Business ByDesign-This document will keep being updated with new questions and topics according to system updates and new features added.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. Reports created upon HCM data sources are timing out/taking a long time to load.-This issue might be caused by several reasons, including incorrect data source modeling.-Based on the amount of data, also a selection to limit the data volume might be required.-Please check the Case Document 2444493.-Also check case documents 2393253 and 2366796.-2. Private contact data is not displayed in HCM reports.-This is a standard system behavior, as the HCM data sources store only their Workplace contact details.-Through the Personnel Administration work center it is possible to get a list of all Private Contact details. Check the Case Document 2038685.-3. You are unable to view Report: Headcount Data Source: HCMPAB01_Q9111 under Business Analytics workcenter.-Business Usecase: You need to select Reporting Line Unit and save those selections in order to use the different selections in different variations of the dashboard.You are not able to save those selections as a business administrator or in the Business Analytics workcenter.-How can you save those selections for the Dashboards?-This report is not appearing in Business Analytics as this MKFC is marked as - Is Technical Object.-You can create a similar Z report to achieve their desired functionality.-Refer : 2678720 - No Report Data Available in Corporate Performance Work Center-4. Your goal is to build a report for Holiday Accruals. You need certain indicators:-The monthly Target Hours-These values are in the master data of an employee (Time File), but these are not included in any report.-The Personnel Admin Report Internal Employee Details and the Workagreement Data View shows the average hours for each employee from the personnel file.--To see the planned times based on the Work Schedule,you can try and use Data Source HCMTLMU01 and build a custom report on top of this data source, and filter on characteristic Employee Time Planning Category.  -This will provide the planned times for a specific period.  -Work Schedule planned times on the Time File are Long term Plan and Temporary Work Schedules are short term plans.-If neither of these options fulfil the requirements, then please enter your requirement into the Influence portal:-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-5. While viewing the report of Recorded Employee time you want to see the "In Approval" status in the list of life cycle status-This is an Enhancement request , submit in influence form - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-6. Internal Employee details report is not working as expected as Access Restriction is not getting applied.-Standard Report:-In the standard report, we have noticed that all employees are visible despite access restrictions being in place. This anomaly occurs because the access restriction is set on a particular company code.-As this particular company code does not have any employees assigned to it.-As per the organizational structure, Org Unit serves as both the company and the RLU (Resource Labor Unit).-Since, there are no employees directly linked to this company code but there are sub org's under which there are employees, the access restriction fails to take effect for the standard report.-New Generated Report:-In the custom generated report no data is displayed.-This happens because the report was accessed by the user and the access context value for this report is 1007. This access context 1007 is associated with the company code.-Consequently, when attempting to fetch data with this access context, the report does not yield any results.-Having access context as asterisk (*) revealed that data was visible. However, to achieve the desired results, we applied a filter to check based on company code, which successfully displays the required and expected data.-The crux lies in the fact that company code is assigned to an access context 1007 that lacks employee data, leading to access restrictions which will not be functioning as intended.-7. The user cannot see the DATE in the Datasources, despite the DATE column appears to function correctly in the DataReport.-The below Data Sources are developed to provide the aggregated results based on the key figures NO_EMP_time , Recorded_quantity and Valuated_Quantity, hence, it outputs the single record.-HCMTLMU01 - Employee times-HCMTLMB07 - Employee Recorded Times-HCMTLMU03 - Employee Recorded Times for internal employee and service providers-This is the standard system behaviour. Our recommended is to use the Data Reports in order to fetch the individual time recording.-Keywords-HCM Reports, FAQ, HCMTLMU01,HCMTLMB07,HCMTLMU03

Title: A Tax Return With Zero Amount Does Not Update the Status to Completed
Content: Symptom-You expect the Status of a Tax Return with 0,00 value should have the status Completed, instead it remains in the status Reported.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select the Tax Returns View.-Choose the VAT Returns Sub View.-Show All Tax Returns and select Go.-Highlight Tax Return ID XX and press View.-Go to the Overview tab.-You can see that the Total Tax Amount equals 0,00 and status of Tax Return is Reported but should be Completed.-Cause-Please note that only Tax Returns with actual Non Zero Amounts can be moved to Completed status because Completed implies the Tax has been Paid or Received.-The concerned VAT Returns XX are of the Category Tax Return without Tax Items, as these do not have any Taxes to be Paid or Received.-For such Tax Returns the Status Reported is the final state.-Resolution-This is designed System Behavior. Please note that Tax Returns with Zero Amounts cannot be set to Completed.

Title: Employee Name in Advanced Search Changes to Employee ID
Content: Symptom-You want to perform a search of an employee support ticket via Advanced Search filtering by the Employee Name in the Employee field, but when the search is finished, the system displays the Employee ID in Advanced Search instead of the name.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service work center;-Go to Employee Support view;-Open Advanced Search;-In the Employee field, put ABC (ABC represents the employee name);-System recognizes the Employee, but changes the name to 123 (123 represents the employee ID).-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-If this feature/functionality is required urgently, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.

Title: Serial ID Can not be Changed
Content: Symptom-You have replicated Registered Products from ERP to C4C, after that you have updated the Serial ID of the registered product be message fails in C4C with error: 'Serial ID Can not be Changed`.-The same behavior happens when the registered products are created directly in C4C.-Reproducing the Issue-Replicate Registered Products to C4C from ERP then update/Change the Serial ID in ERP.-In Webservice Message Monitoring you have a failed message with the error: `Serial ID Can not be Changed`.-Cause-The issue is caused because you haven't scoped Serial ID Optional in Activities.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the relevant Activity List.-Search for the scoping activity Additional configuration for registered products.-Enter `Maintain Registered Product Categories`.-For the registered product category in question, flag the Serial ID Optional check box.-Perform the change and restart the message or replicate the Registered Product again.

Title: Data Workbench Import for Activity Planner Items not Reflecting in the System
Content: Symptom-When you import data for the object Activity Planner Items using Data Workbench, the imported records do not reflect in the system.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Data Workbench work center-Select the Import view-Select the radio button Individual Object Activity Planner Items-Upload the file-Select Next and complete the Import-After the file is successfully imported the data is not reflected in the system.-Cause-There could be many reasons for this issue, one of the reasons could be due to Type Code mis-match mentioned in the template.-The expected Type Code is 01 where as the imported Type Code was 1 (without the preceeding zero).--This could have happened due to the preceeding zeroes for the Type Code was not retained while importing.-Resolution-Format the Excel cell to retain zeros and you would be able to do a successful import.-Keywords-Activity Planner Items, Data Workbench, import, Type Code

Title: Warning Message Appears  While Checking the Consistency of a Production Model
Content: Symptom-Warning message appeared Product KLM not active for use in inventory while checking the consistency of a Production Model.*KLM refers to Product Id,XYZ refers to Planning Area id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Production Models View.-Search for KLM.-Select Go.-Select Edit.-Select Check Consistency.-Warning message appears-Product KLM not active for use in inventory.-Cause-The Production Model KLM is assigned to the Planning Area ID XYZ. However  there is no master data setup in the referenced products for the planning area XYZ.-Resolution-In order to solve the issue, maintain the missing product master data.-Keywords-Warning Message Appears  While Checking the Consistency of a Production Model, Product  not active for use in inventory.

Title: Error :Required Entry Field Product Tax Rate Type Code is not Filled
Content: Symptom-You have created and sent Purchase Order XXX (XXX represents the Purchase Order ID) but it led to a Process Communication Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Process Communication Errors view.-Show All errors with cases.-You can find the erroneous Purchase Order XXX with the error message Required entry field Product Tax Rate Type Code is not filled.-Cause-This message was raised because no Tax Classification has been set up for Free-Text Items of Product Category YYY (YYYrepresents the Product Category ID), used for the item in the Purchase Order XXX.-Resolution-To solve this issue, you should maintain the Tax Rate Type for the Product Category YYY in the Common Task Set Tax Classification which can be found in the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-To help you avoid this issue in the future, you can add a wildcard (*) row that will be picked by default if no specific Product Category setting is maintained. You can do this by following these steps:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Common Task Set Tax Classification.-Click Add row.-Add a value for the field Tax Rate Type.-Leave the Product Category field as "*".-Save.-Once this is done, you can open an case so that we can take action in back end by restarting the messages.-Keywords-Process communication error in PO, red mark error, error in document flow

Title: How to Export the Material Flow of a Sales Order in Product Planning Details Screen
Content: Symptom-Customer wants to know how to export the Material Flow of a Sales Order in Product Planning Details screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Show All and enter Product XYZ (XYZ means Product ID).-Click Open.-In Supply and Demand List, select row with Sales Order ID XXX (XXX means Sales Order ID).-Click Open Material Flow.-You expect that there is a way to export the content in the screen.-Cause-The Material flow is built 'on the fly' when Material Requirements Planning (MRP) runs and the data is not persisted anywhere. Also all the underlying Business Object's participating on building this flow are Live Cache based and hence Public Solution Model (PSM) cannot be released for the underlying business objects. Therefore, a PDI solution is not possible in this case either.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Product, Material Flow, Sales Order, MRP, Material Requirements Planning, PSM

Title: Proposals Created Without Considering Correct Safety Lead Time
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Safety Lead Time of XXX days (XXX means quantity of days) in Planning Master Data for a Product. However, you see that the date at which proposals are created for the product are wrong. Let's take the example of 10 days in this case instead of XXX.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to Products view.-Search the relevant Product and Planning Area combination and choose the button Open.-You have a demand on a future date DD-MM-YYYY.-You expect the supply proposal to be created 10 days before DD-MM-YYYY, since 10 days is your replenishment lead time. However, you see that the system has created proposal on a date which is beyond ten days from the demand date.-Cause-The system considers XXX working days based on your site working day calander. So if your Replenishment Lead Time has 10 days maintained then the system will exclude all weekends and public holidays as per your site calender. This is why you see that the system has reduced more than 10 days from your demand date. If you check you will see that the system has reduced 10 working days only.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Safety Lead Time, Proposal, Product, Planning Area, Supply Planning.

Title: System Not Creating Planning Proposals via Automated Planning Run
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Planning Runs for specified products with required settings but system is not taking any product/site combination into consideration while performing planning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Automated Actions view.-Go to Planning Runs sub view.-Select the relevant Run ID: XYZ (XYZ means Planning Run ID)-Schedule it as Immediately.-Perform Save and Close.-You see that system has not considered any product/planning area for planning.-Select generated log ID, system displays below message :-0  product/planning area combinations planned-Cause-In the Planning Run, you have marked the check box against the field Consider Net Change which states that only products within your selection criteria would be considered that have undergone a change relevant to material planning (known as net changes) since the last planning run.-If there are no relevant changes occurred with respect to supply or demand (for example, a new sales order, a modified planning proposal, or an updated production request from manufacturing), or changes to the product master (for example, the planning parameters, or the released production model) for the specified products, then no product/site combination will be considered in planning.-You can view the planning product's net change status via below steps :-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to Products view.-In the field Show, select All Products by Selection using drop down.-Enter the required Product ID: ABC (ABC means Product ID) with Site: DEF (DEF means Site ID)-Select and open it.-In Supply and Demand view, navigate to Product Information sub tab.-Here under section: Last Planning Run Data-You can see Net Change status updated as No.-This means there is no planning relevant changes happened.-  Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Planning Proposal, Planning Run, Automated Planning Run, Supply Planning.

Title: Custom Duty Invoice Does not Fetch Item Details From Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The Custom Duty Invoice does not fetch item details from Purchase Order reference.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supplier Invoicing work center and select New Customs Duty Invoice.-2. Select View All button.-3. Select Items tab.-4. Select Add Row button and enter the Purchase Order ID against the Order ID field.-5. Here you can see that no item details from Purchase Order is fetched into the Invoice.-Cause-This is a standard system behavior,  the Purchase Order is just a reference and thus is just for information purpose only. Also, nothing gets posted with reference to the Purchase Order in Accounting as well.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-distribute cost to purchase order, unable to distribute cost using Purchase order

Title: New Payment Run Overwrites Previous Payment Proposals
Content: Symptom-You have executed a new Payment Run in Payables or Receivables. When you check Payment Proposals for an earlier run with the same settings you notice that the Payment Proposal lists is now empty.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables workcentre.-Navigate to the Payment Run view.-Create a new Payment Run and maintain your settings as desired.-Execute the Run.-Once the Payment Run is finished, click on the View Payment Proposal button to access your payment list.-Go back to the Payment Run view.-Execute a new Payment Run.-Open the Payment Proposals list.-You notice that the earlier documents are now taken into this run as well, with new Payment IDs.-If you check the Payment Proposals for the earlier Run you can see that it is now empty.- Cause-This is the expected system behaviour, if you execute Payment Runs for the same set of suppliers or customers, the system overwrites the former Payment Proposals to keep the Payments updated.-Resolution-If you wish to keep separate Payment Proposals lists simultaneously, you can execute your Payment Runs for different sets of Suppliers or Customers. However, next time you execute a Payment Run for the same sets of Suppliers or Customers, former Payment Proposals will be overwritten again.-See Also-For further information on Payment Proposals, please consult the following Help Document: Create and Edit Payment Proposals for Payables.

Title: Purchase Order Item Completion Runs view Missing
Content: EXTRACT_ERROR

Title: The Project Task Calendar Field is Empty.
Content: Symptom-The Project Task Calendar Field is Empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Choose Show all-Find Project XYZ-Choose button Edit - Project Plan-Choose Project TAsk XYZ-1-Go to Scheduling sub tab calendar is empty-As expected, the Calendar should default to "<country> with X working days" but is blank.-Cause-The Calendar in the project defaults from the Business Configuration ->Fine Tune Activity Project Types -> Default Working Day Calender and it is used for setting calendar type for the whole Project.From there it influences the complete task hierarchy, without the need to copy the calendar to each task (implicit inheritance). The field on the Project Task level is used for setting calendar type deviating from the Project header calendar type.-If it is not filled it means that Calendar type maintained on the Project Header is valid. The field content is not filled by the system but can be set manually.--If the project is created before the calendar settings were maintained in Business Configuration ->Fine Tune Activity Project Types -> Default Working Day Calender. For newly created projects you should get calendar filled on the Project Header (and this will be valid for all tasks unless you enter some other calendars for them-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Intrastat Arrangement Declaration Not Available For Country X.
Content: Symptom-Intrastat Arrangement Declaration is only available for specific countries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center.-Go to Intrastat Arrangements view. -Click in New Intrastat Arrangement button.-Open the dropdown list for Country of Declaration.-There are only few countries listed (Austria, France, Germany, Italy and United Kingdom).-Cause-Currently the non-localized countries are not supported. The only countries supported are: Austria, France, Germany, Italy and United Kingdom.-Resolution-If it is needed the Intrastat Arrangement for another country, then please ask it for your development partner. You can create a custom solution from Partner Application Studio to support the creation of company Intrastat Arrangement for other countries.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Intrastat Declaration Runs Quick Guide-Keywords-Intrastat Declaration; Run; Country; Non-localized; Austria; France; Germany; Italy; United Kingdom

Title: Material ID incorrect for number range
Content: Symptom-You defined the manual number ranges for Materials in the fine-tuning phase of the project.-However, when entering some specific material IDs, the system raises an error message of incorrect ID.-Although the ID should be accepted, since it is between the minimum and the maximum value of the range, you are not able to proceed with the desired value.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-After defining a manual number range for Materials on the fine-tuning activity, Create a new Material following the below steps:-Access "Product Portfolio" Work center-Navigate to the Materials view-Click on "New"-Enter the ID of the material, and fulfill the needed information of the material-When trying to save, the error message appears: Material ID XXX not valid. It does not fall within the allowed range ABC - XYZ (XXX represents the Material ID, ABC represents the minimum range number and XYZ represents the maximum range number)-Cause-This issue happens because of the comparing method used by the system to fetch the ID entered and number range.-The comparison is made for each character, by converting it to the ASCII table value. After converting the characters of each position, the ID value needs to be greater than the minimum range value and lower than the maximum range value.-What happens is that if one of the IDs to be compared (either the range or the Material ID value) is shorter in length compared to the other, the missing positions of the comparison are replaced with blank spaces. The blank space has ASCII value of 32, being a lower value than any other common characters.-This comparison may cause the input ID to be denied upon validation.-Example-You have a range formatted as below:-From A000 to Z999-Now let’s consider the material ID C23 as the input.-As per the total value analysis, this ID should be valid.--By converting the Material range to ASCII codification, we receive the following code:-From 65 48 48 48 to 90 57 57 57-Now converting the input ID, we receive value 67 50 51--In this case, what will happen to the input is that the system will fulfill the remaining characters it needs to finish comparison with blank spaces, which are value 32 on ASCII. So, we will finish with this scenario:-Maximum range: 90 57 57 57-Input:                67 50 51 32(blank space)-Minimum range: 65 48 48 48-By lining up the input with the range and comparing each character, we can see that this input is not compatible with the range, since the 32 character (which is exactly the automatically fulfilled blank space) is not between the respective range values 48 and 57.-Resolution-In order to use the Material ranges properly, make sure that both ID inputs and number range have the same length.-If a shorter ID is needed, you can either use "0" characters to balance the length, or analyze whether the desired IDs will be accepted considering the validation process.-See Also- material ID, number range, incorrect number range

Title: Source of Supply Cannot Be Selected in Production Proposal
Content: Symptom-Source of Supply is missing and cannot be selected in the Production Proposal XXX (XXX means Production Proposal ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control work center.-Choose Process Production Proposals view.-Search for the Production Proposal XXX.-Open the Production Process XXX.-Click Change Source of Supply.-Notice that the Source of Supply ABC (ABC means Source of Supply ID)is missing and cannot be selected.-Cause-The Source of Supply ABC has a Product Specification which you have not added to the Production Proposal. Product Specifications enable you to define and store the configuration information that characterizes such a product variant, which uses a different Production Model. Hence the Source of Supply ABC will not be shown as an option in the Production Proposal.- To check the Product Specification, you can follow the steps:-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Source Determination view.-Search for the Output Product ID for the Production Proposal XXX.-Check if there is data in the Product Specification ID column.-If the Product Specification ID is not appearing, you can:-Click Personalize button (top of the screen, right-hand side).-Choose This Screen.-Select the Source Determination Section.-Check the field Product Specification ID.-Click Save button.-This action enables the Product Specification ID on the screen.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.-You cannot use a Source of Supply for a Product Specification if the Production Proposal has no Product Specification.-Keywords-Source of Supply, Production Proposal, Product Specification

Title: Approval Task is not triggered for relevant Cost Center Manager
Content: Symptom-You have set up a new approval process for purchase orders in your system. The rule is that all purchase orders go for approval to the relevant cost center manager.-When you create a new purchase order the approval task is not going to the correct person or remains unassigned.-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Order view.-Search for the relevant Purchase Order.-Select Edit.-Navigate to Approvals Tab.-The approval task is either unassigned or assigned to the top level executive for that cost center.-Cause-You have scoped Advanced Approval Limit in your system but you have not maintained any value limit. This is why the system will assign the approval task to the highest level manager in the Org. structure hierarchy or leave it unassigned.--The system will always give the first priority to Advanced Approval Limit even if it is inactive. It will not consider the limit value maintained in Employee Work Distribution Rule.-Resolution-You have to define the Advanced Approval Limit in your system:-Go to the work center Application and User Management.-Select the common task Define Approval Value Limit.-Click Add Row.-Click <Add> and define a value and a currency.-Click save and Activate.-Please note that the limit you define here is applicable for purchase orders as well as shopping carts.-If you want the approvals to go for cost center managers irrespective of value limit, then you can use the approval rule Approval by Cost Assignment-Keywords-Cost Center Manager, Purchase Order Approval, Advanced Approval Limit, approval task, unassigned

Title: Publish Button does not Trigger any action on Custom Catalog
Content: Symptom-The Rollback Publishing button is disabled and Publish button does not trigger any action when you select Publish on custom catalog-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Select view Catalogs-Show Catalogs to Be Published-Custom Catalog will be displayed-Select Publish button-No action triggered-Cause-When end user triggered publishing, same catalog was locked by another user which caused the process to halt in between.-You can see the lock happened due to which user by following below steps:- Go to Product portfolio work center- Go to Catalogs view- Select the Catalog and click on button 'View publication log'- Go to Results tab- Where you will see error -Locking object not possible; object locked by XXXX (name of employee).-Please note that there are many business objects involved in this process and one of the object got stuck in an inconsistent state which is responsible for changing the status and triggering background job for publishing catalog.-Due to this, publish action did not work and moreover,since the catalog status is either Started or Failed, rollback is also not allowed.-Resolution-You can import the entire data to a new catalog and use the new one and delete this old catalog.-Keywords-Catalog;Custom Catalog;Catalog import failed;Unable to publish; cannot publish catalog

Title: Project cannot process an update sent by a Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You receive a Process Communication Error in a document: Project X cannot process an update sent by a Expense Report-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center-Search for Sales Order Y-Navigate to Document Flow-In Project X, there is a Process Communication Error:-- Project X cannot process an update sent by a Expense Report-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.--Cause-The UOM which is maintained in the expense report document related to project X is in blocked status-Resolution-To unblock it, follow these steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select view Overview-Search for activity Quantities and Units of Measure-Select Change Immediately-Select  Physical Units of Measurement-Unblock the Unit-Select save-Keywords-Project Sales Order-Expense Report

Title: External Document ID is not Populated correctly in Scanned Invoice
Content: Symptom-External Document ID is not recognized correctly in Scanned Invoice document from .txt file even after defining the Keyword for External Document ID i.e. Document Number on Supplier Side in the Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Search for this activity Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings-Open Keyword: Document Number on Supplier Side-Keyword is activated-Now, Open SAP Collaboration Tool and upload the PDF and Text file-The External Reference Id is not recognized correctly in the resulting scanned invoice document-Cause-There can be 2 reasons-The keyword used in the text file for External Document ID field is referring to a different field in Keyword Settings and hence the system is populating the wrong data (OR)-The keyword for External Document ID is mentioned twice in the text file because of which the system is not able to pick the External Document ID field correctly.--Resolution-Please maintain a unique  keyword for External Document ID in the Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings and remove the duplicate keywords if any from the text file and then upload the scanned invoice

Title: Email notification not received in ByDesign for any incident updates.
Content: Symptom-You are not receiving any updates via email whenever SAP updates related to documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause- Respective Subscribe Tasks is not checkmarked-Resolution-Go to Home Work Center.-Go to Work View.-Go to Inbox sub view.-Click on Subscribe Tasks.-In the below screenshot you can see that the check box against the Tasks are unchecked.- NOTE: Email notifications will be sent only for those cases which are created after the changes have been made.-Accordingly you can check other options available and check mark them if necessary.-See Also-In case any thing that you are looking for is not there to check mark like Purchase order approved and you want notification to sent to the creator that its approved then follow below links to create new work flow rule-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/1905/en-US/2dd306f1722d10149fa9d590609d47e9.html-https://blogs.sap.com/2015/07/27/how-to-create-workflow-rule-to-send-email-and-notifications/-Keywords-Email Notification, Feedback email, key user-email notification,,feedback email

Title: System Updates Confirmation Method as Backflush instead of Explicit Method
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Confirmation Method as Explicit in relevant production model however while confirming the production task, you find confirmation method as Backflush instead of Explicit for input products.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Workcenter.-Go to Task Control View.-Show All Production Tasks by selection and find required TasK ID.-Select and choose Confirm.-Go to Confirmation tab and navigate to Input Products sub-tab.-Here you see that Confirmation Method is Backflush.-  Now go to Planning and Production Master Data Workcenter.-Go to Production Models View.-Using advanced search, find relevant Model ID using output product ID.-Select and Edit it.-Go to Bill of Operations tab and choose BoO Structure subtab.-Now select required Activity under relevant Operation.-Here you see that required activities under Operations are assigned to Confirmation Method as Explicit.-Cause-You have maintained Confirmation Method as Explicit for activity duration and not for input materials under Product Assignment tab.-If you check under Product Assignment tab, no confirmation method is maintained. However, if no confirmation method is maintained, system updates confirmation method as backflush by default for Input Materials.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Workcenter.-Go to Production Models View.-Using advanced search, find relevant Model ID using output product ID.-Select and Edit it.-Go to Bill of Operations tab and choose Product Assignment subtab.-Now select required Activity under relevant Operation.-Under Bill of Material subtab, choose option Assign Line item group to activity.-New Window opens up, select required Confirmation Method for relevant Input Materials.-Perform Save.-Note: You have to assign Confirmation Method for all Input Materials manually as per your requirement. This is purely a manual action to update confirmation method on the product, there is no way to update it automatically.-Currently, there is no way to update Confirmation Method via migration template.-  Keywords-Confirmation Method, Production Task, Input Product

Title: Error: 'Cancel not Possible; Down Payment Request Assigned to Supplier invoice'
Content: Symptom-Not able to cancel a DownPayment request due to the error message 'Cancel not possible; down payment request assigned to supplier invoice XXX'.-(XXX represents the supplier invoice ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers view and navigate to the Supplier Accounts subview.-Search for the Account XYZ.-Click View.-In the Trade Payables Tab, select the Invoices/Payments sub-tab.-Show Open Items.-Open the Down Payment ABC (ABC represents the Down Payment ID).-Click View All.-Press Cancel Document.-Or-Go to the Supplier Invoice work center and here to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Invoices.-Search for the Invoice XXX.-You see that the Status of the Invoice is Paid.-Click View All.-Under the General Tab go to the Payment Information.-Select the Down Payment subview.-You see the Down Payment ID ABC.-Double-click the Down Payment ID.-Click View All.-Press Cancel Document.-Error message is displayed: 'Cancel not possible; down payment request assigned to Supplier Invoice XXX'.-Cause-The Down payment Request ABC is already consumed with the Supplier Invoice XXX.-You can check as follows:-In the Supplier Invoicing Work Center go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Invoices.-Search for the Invoice XXX.-You see that the Status of the Invoice is Paid.-Click View All.-In the General Tab go to the Payment Information.-Select the Down Payment subview.-You can see that the Down Payment ABC is assigned to this Invoice. The Invoice is already in Paid Status.-Resolution-When the Supplier Invoice is in Paid Status, it is not possible to remove the references from the Invoice. If you want to cancel the DownPayment Request ABC, the corresponding Payments in the Supplier Invoice XXX has to be reversed first.-Once the Payments are reversed, the invoice status will be back to Posted. Now you can cancel the Supplier invoice and then the down payment would be automatically  Open again to be used in new invoices or  for cancelling the downpayment request.-See Also-1889180 - How to Cancel Down Payment Request-Keywords-Down Payment, Down Payment request, reverse, Supplier Invoice, Cancel not possible.

Title: Error on Material Flow Missing for Proposal
Content: Symptom-You have created the Purchase or a Production Proposal YYY but when you select the Material Flow, it does not exists.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center-Select Products View-Search for the product XXX in Planning Area ABC-Select Open-Select the Proposal YYY under Supply and Demand List-Choose Open Material Flow-The system opens an empty Material Flow with the messages:-Material flow does not exist for the reference order-Start planning run to create the material flow-Cause-You have created the Proposal YYY manually. The Material Flow only exists for Proposals created automatically by the Planning Run.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.

Title: How to Adjust Quantity of Goods and Service Receipt for a Left Over Service
Content: Symptom-You have a Goods and Service Receipt created for a Service, you have already Invoiced all the quantity you need and now you need to return or cancel what is left over.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center;-Go to Invoice Entry View;-Set the filter to All Deliveries to be Invoiced and search for the affected document.-See it has the status as Partially Invoiced.-Cause-There is no such document to return a service and you need to adjust the quantity of this Goods and Service Receipt to match the quantity you have already invoiced in order to complete the scenario.-Resolution-Since you did not create any Supplier Invoice for what is left in the Goods and Service Receipt, you can cancel it (Do not cancel any of the Supplier Invoices) and then create a new one from the Purchase Order with the correct amount.--After cancelling the original Goods and Service Receipt, the Supplier Invoices will show the reference as missing under Cost Distribution tab for the items.--Once creating this second Goods and Service Receipt, the reference will automatically become this new document and the whole scenario will be automatically completed.

Title: Production Confirmation Missing on Confirmation Journal Report
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Confirmation Journal and the production confirmation ABC for production order XXX is missing in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select Design Reports view-Search for Confirmation Journal-Open the Confirmation Journal report-Fill the Reference Document ID as XXX-Select Go-See the Production Confirmation ABC is missing-Cause-The report Confirmation Journal only displays documents which have any impact on inventory. If the Production Confirmation ABC has only scrapped quantity, it does not appear on this report.-Resolution-In this case, the system is working as expected. As a workaround, you can:-Fill the Confirmed Quantity with a negative quantity in the Production Confirmation. Doing this, there will be an inventory impact and the Confirmation will appear on report Confirmation Journal. (The prerequisite to confirm negative quantity for input product or output product is, its total confirmed quantity is positive.)-Use the report Yield And Scrap. It will show the Scrapped Quantity on confirmation ABC.-See Also-KBA:  2821131 - You Face an Error When Entering a Negative Quantity in Production Task-Keywords-Confirmation Journal, Production Confirmation, Scrapped Quantity

Title: Period Closure Run cancelled because of Locked User
Content: Symptom-A Period Closure Run finished with errors and you receive a Health Check case from the system. From the error log it seems that a user is locked. This you don't understand as, currently, you do not have any user locked.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Centre.-Go to the Background Job View.-Show: All Failed runs.-One or several Period Closure Runs are failed with Description Cancelled manually or by the system.-Select the relevant run and click on button View Job Log.-The following error emssage is displayed: Logon of user XYZ (where XYZ is the technical ID of the imapcted user) in client XXX failed when starting a step.-Cause-If a Health Check is created to address this issue, it is very likely that one of your users was locked at one time, even if you may not think so.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management Work Centre.-Go to the Busines Users view.-Show all, search for user XYZ.-The user is locked.-You can unlock it by clicking on the Unlock user button.-If this user is required to stay locked you need to reasign the run to another valid user.

Title: Standard objects cannot be translated via Adaption tool
Content: Symptom-You would like to translate standard report, view, key figure or data source names via language adaptation tool but you will not find them under report texts.-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to reproduce:-1. Goto Administrator Work Center-2. Select Language Adaptation>New-3. Fill the details Source and Target Language along with name and ID -4. Click Save and Open-5. Click on Edit-6. Select Get Analytical Repprt Texts (if you wish to translate report texts like views, selections, key figures, extension fields etc)-7. Click on Collect text-8. navigate to Report Texts tab after collection of texts-You will not find the names of standard reports, views, selections, characteristics or key figures in Source text to maintain translation.-Cause-The standard objects cannot be translated by end users or key users. They will be translated by default in the backend by SAP.-Resolution-Currently, this is the system designed behavior. You can only translate customized objects which are created by the key users.

Title: Cannot Change Site ID for a Resource.
Content: Symptom-You try to change the site ID for a resource, but receive an error message :" Resource used by REPM production segment."-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Select the Resource View.-Search the relevant resource and click Edit.-Change site ID to a new one.-Then you receive an error message: "Resource used by REPM production segment".-Cause-Once the resource is being used in any of the production model and the production model is released for execution , then it will not be possible to change the site ID in the “Resource” because this particular resource becomes dedicated to that site ID.-Resolution-It is standard system behavior.-Keywords

Title: Intrastat Declaration Run Didn't Pick Up Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-The Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID) was created on DD.MM.YYYY. You are expecting the Sales Order ABC with the Outbound Delivery XYZ (XYZ represents the Outbound Deliver ID) to be picked up in the Intrastat Declaration DEF (DEF represents the Intrastat Declaration ID) created for the month of April. However, when you filter by Goods Movement ID XYZ, you get the message No records found.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastats work center.-Go to Intrastat Declarations view.-Find Declaration DEF.-Select the Declaration DEF and click Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Selected Advanced search.-Filter by Goods Movement ID : XYZ.-You get the message No records found.-Cause-The Goods Movement ID is the Outbound Delivery ID related to the order.-The Goods Movement date taken into account for the Intrastat Declaration is the Shipment date of the Outbound Delivery.-Here, the Shipment date of the Outbound Delivery is DD.MM.YYYY at 00:46 CET, however the system stores all dates and times in the UTC time zone, which is CET - 1. Therefore, this Shipment Date is registered on DD-1.MM.YYYY at 23:46 UTC.-Resolution-If the Outbound Delivery XYZ was created before the Intrastat Declaration Run for March was executed, then the Goods Movement will be found in the Intrastat Declaration for the month of March.-If the Outbound Delivery XYZ was created after the Intrastat Declaration Run for March was executed, you can manually add the Items to the Intrastat Declaration. For this, you can follow these steps:-Go to Intrastats work center.-Go to Intrastat Declarations view.-Find Declaration DEF.-Select the Declaration DEF and click Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Click Add Items.-Here you can enter all the relevant data for the transaction to be included in the Intrastat Declaration.

Title: Fully Written Off Expense Cannot Be Assigned an Invoice Item ID in a Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-In a Project Invoice Request, all Time and Expense Items have been fully set either as To Be Invoiced or as To Be Written Off. To each item, an Invoice Item ID has been assigned. The Project Invoice Request was saved successfully and closed.-After opening the document again, the Time and Expense Items that were set as To Be Written Off for 100% of the quantity have lost all the assigned Invoice Item ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Project Invoice Request view.-Show All Project Invoice Requests.-Find ABC (ABC represents the Project Invoice Request ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Time and Expenses subtab.-All the items with 100% of Quantity to Be Written Off have no Invoice Item IDs despite being assigned one before saving the invoice request.-Cause-For a fully Written Off Expense, a Project Invoice Request item assignment is not needed. These Written Off Expenses get recorded to the Project Invoice Request as a whole and are not associated to any one item specifically.-Resolution-This is normal system behaviour.-Keywords

Title: Time Out Dump While performing Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-When trying to perform Post Goods Receipt or Post Goods Issue against required Inbound Delivery Notification or Delivery Pospal, system crashes.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When proforming Post Goods Receipt:-Go to Inbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Inbound Delivery NOtifiactions View-Find and select required Inbound Delivery Notification ID.-Select and choose Post Goods Receipt option.-System takes time and crashes.-When proforming Post Goods Issue:-Go to Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Delivery Proposal View-Find and select required Delivery Proposal ID.-Select and choose Post Goods Issue option.-System takes time and crashes.-Cause-Document contains huge number of line items while performing post goods reciept or post goods issue and hence system takes lot of time processing such a large data and may lead to time out errors. It is a known issue.-Resolution-In order to process such transactions, please follow given steps.-When proforming Post Goods Receipt:-Go to Inbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifiactions View-Find and select required Inbound Delivery Notification ID.-Choose Create Warehouse Request and process the line items using the Site Logistics Task.-When proforming Post Goods Issue:-Go to Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Delivery Proposal View-Find and select required Delivery Proposal ID.-Choose Create Warehouse Request and process the line items using the Site Logistics Task.-Keywords- Post Goods Receipt, Post Goods Issue,  system crashes, system dupmed, 500 error

Title: The Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project is not created.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2097351***-The Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project has not created automatically from Purchase Order. However, you can see the intercompany relevant Purchase Order is Sent to Supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Go to the Products tab.-Go to the Purchase Orders subtab.-Open the Purchase Order and go to the Document Flow tab here you can see the Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project are not created via B2B communication.-Cause-As the buying and selling company both are setup in the same system hence the purchase order output history should be always sent by XML then only the system creates the Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project is not created via B2B communication. If the output history is sent by Printer, E-mail, Fax etc then the system will fail to create the Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project are not created via B2B communication.You Can Also Edit Output Settings for Create Purchase Order and this was XML. Ensure that the settings are not changed to Printer or Email or Fax manually in the purchase order.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-See Also-2097351 - The Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project is not created.

Title: Negative Free Capacity for Resource Load
Content: Symptom-You notice that Resource Load ABC is calculating a negative free capacity, as the Capacity is 0.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to the Resources Tab.-Search for the Resource ABC.-Select the queried record.-Choose Edit button.-Navigate to the Operating Time Tab, you will learn the Recurrence Operation Days (Time).-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to the Resource Load View.-Search for the Resource Load ABC.-Select the queried record.-In the Load Graph Tab, you notice that the system is planning production on days which are not checked in Resource master data.-In the Load Table Tab, you see that for these days not checked in Resource master data, the system calculating negative Free Capacity.-Cause-Although you have maintained a different calendar for the location, the system only considers site working calendar to calculate resource load. The Location calendar and the resource calendar must be aligned in terms of working days and non-working days. In addition, the opening hours must be equivalent.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.-Keywords-Resource Load, Capacity, Negative, Free Capacity

Title: Unable to Make Changes to Goods Receipt that is in Status Released and is also Invoiced
Content: Symptom-Unable to make changes in a Goods Receipt which is in status Released also for which has an exisiting Invoice which is Posted( Invoice may be in any Status)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work center-Go to Receipts and Returns View-Select the relavent Goods receipt and select Edit-where you can see that status is released and system does not allow you to make any changes-Cause-Once the Goods receipt is Released(or Cancelled) it is not allowed for any changes to be made .-Resolution-You are allowed to Cancel the Goods receipt and then Create new Goods Receipt with correct details and then  auto  linking of  new Goods receipt to the Invoice in any Status shall happen.-Follow the below steps to Cancel the Invoice-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work center-Go to Receipts and Returns View-Select the relavent Goods receipt and select Edit-Select the button Cancel Goods and Service Receipt-Enter Posting Date and Delivery note ID and then select Post- Then Create New Goods Receipt in the same way you created the Goods receipt initially- Follow the below steps to Link the  new Goods Receipt to the desired Invoice-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos View-Select the relavent invoice and select Edit-Navigate to Items tab,then  go to  Cost Distribution Sub tab-Select Edit cost Distribution-Here you can enter the desired quantity against the desired Goods Receipt ID as appearing under Reference Item Column.-Keywords-why does system allow to cancel the Goods  receipt,

Title: Error Message Sales Kit Integrity Violated Appears when trying to Accept a Deviation for a Task XYZ.
Content: Symptom-System triggered error message when trying to accept a deviation for a task XYZ.(XYZ refers to Task Id, DE refers to Item ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to View Monitoring subview Work.-Find for task XYZ.-Select Go.-Select Accept deviation and reject open quantity.-Error message appears as mentioned below.-Error during delivery update-Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions-Sales kit integrity violated for item ID DE in site logistics request-Cause-You have confirmed some of the kit items and rejected some kit items with deviation reason.-This is not possible in Kit items.-Either Confirm or Reject all the kit items.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Error during delivery update, Sales kit integrity violated for item ID,site logistics request, accept deviation

Title: Error Message: “RFC Exception SYSTEM_FAILURE Raised; No More Memory Available to Extend an Internal Tab” Upon Executing a Data Extraction Run
Content: Symptom-You are attempting to execute a data extraction run, but the same fails with the error message: “RFC exception SYSTEM_FAILURE raised; No more memory available to extend an internal tab".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Data Extraction view.-Click New.-Fill in the mandatory fields.-Select the relevant extraction object.-Click Save, then Activate and Run.-Once the run is finished, select it under All Data Extractions.-At the bottom of the screen, select the tab Application Log.-Open the Application Log and go to the Results tab.-The mentioned error message is displayed.-Cause-The data selection is too large for the system to handle.-Resolution-You can follow the same steps for the Data extraction, however this time with the Active Package checkbox.-Access the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Data Extraction view.-Click New.-Fill in the mandatory fields.-Select the relevant extraction object.-Check the Package Active box under Control Parameters & set the Package Size as shown below:-Click Save, then Activate and Run.-Once the run is finished, select it under All Data Extractions.-At the bottom of the screen, check the tab for Application Log.-When setting up the Data Extraction run, check the Package Active box under Control Parameters and set the Package Size somewhere between 500 to 1,000 records (results may vary depending on the object selected). Furthermore, please schedule the data extractions to be executed in a time of least memory consumption, for example outside business hours, and avoid scheduling multiple data extractions simultaneously.-You can also use the Selection Criteria to further delimit the data selection.-Keywords-Data Extraction, RFC exception SYSTEM_FAILURE raised, No more memory available to extend an internal tab, Package Active, byd

Title: Open Purchase Orders not Included in Goods and Services Receipts run
Content: Symptom-You have created a Goods and Services Receipts Run to create several goods and services receipts based on open purchase orders, however no Goods and Services Receipts created after the run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts Run view-Select the Active Goods and Services Receipts Runs-Select the relevant Run ID and select Schedule-Go to the Receipts and Returns view-Select Show by Documents-You cannot find the Goods and Services Receipts created based on run-Cause-1.The goods and services receipt run allows you to create several goods and services receipts based on certain criteria on open purchase orders. The items in purchase orders, which has automatic goods and services receipts set, are only considered for the run. However, the relevant purchase order is not marked for Automatic Goods and Services Receipts check box and hence no goods and services receipts created from the run.- or-2. In the GSR run , you have not chosen  any value under Supplier or company or product or product category.-or-3.  In the GSR Run, if you choose planned delivery date as 0 then system will consider the PO's having delivery dates less than or equal to  date on which the run is done.-Resolution-1.Select the Automatic Goods and Services Receipts check box in the purchase order from the below steps and system will consider this purchase order for Goods and Services Receipts Run.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and View All-Navigate to Items tab and select Basic Data sub tab-Under Follow-Up Documents, select Automatic Goods and Services Receipts check box-Order the Purchase Order ﻿document-Note:-If Automatic Goods and Services Receipts check box is not available under Follow-Up Documents, you need to enable it from adaptation mode.- or-2. To choose a value under Supplier or company or product or product category- Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center- Go to the Goods and Services Receipts Run view- Select the respective  Active Goods and Services Receipts Runs- Select the relevant Run ID and click on edit- Go to  tab Supplier or company or product or product category.- Click on add row and add a  desired value or - for example, if you want to choose  all suppliers then enter value as *- Click on save- or-3.To choose a value  for  Planned delivery date- Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center- Go to the Goods and Services Receipts Run view- Select the respective  Active Goods and Services Receipts Runs- Select the relevant Run ID and click on edit-enter a value for field"Planned delivery date"-For example if you enter 10 then system  will consider the PO's having delivery dates  with next 10days from current date or from the date on which run is done.-Keywords- Goods and Services Receipts Run;  Automatic Goods and Services Receipts check box; PO not included in GSR run

Title: Wrong Approver Determined in Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:i am updating this solution in other KBA : 1888389 - Shopping Cart Approval with Work Distribution: Approval by Cost Center Manager by Value Limit-Wrong approver determined for supplier invoice approval for the condition Approval by Cost Center Manager by Value Limit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the invoice ABC. (ABC refers to supplier invoice ID)-Open the invoice.-Navigate to Approval tab.-The expected approver is not determined.-Cause-If the condition for supplier invoice approval is set as Approval by Cost Center Manager by Value Limit, ﻿and if the value limit is maintained in Define Approval Value Limit under Application and User Management work center the system will not create the approval tasks as expected.-Resolution-The Value Limit for approving the supplier invoices must be maintained in Employee Work Distribution sub-view under Application and User Management work center. Please follow the below steps to maintain the value limit for employees:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Employee Work Distribution under Task Distribution view.-Select Purchasing Approval Value Limit under Purchasing.-Select Edit.-Add the rule name, employee responsible and validity by selecting Add Rule button.-Maintain the value limit for each employee by select Add Item button under Value Limit tab.-Note: The option Define Approval Value Limit is applicable for Shopping Cart and Purchase Orders but not Supplier Invoices.-Keywords-supplier invoice approval, approval by value limit, supplier invoice, wrong approver in invoice, wrong approver determined

Title: How to delete an Item from an Installation Point
Content: Symptom-How to delete an Item from an Installation Point.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Installed Base work center.-Go to the Installation Point view.-In the Search field enter ABC (where ABC is Installation Point with category as Functional Location).-Open Installation Point ABC and go to the Items facet.-Select Item LMN (where LMN is item of type Functional Location or Registered Product with status as In Preparation).-There is no option to remove this item on selecting it .-Cause-Only item of with status as Obsolete can be removed. Hence ,if you want to remove the item please change the status to Obsolete.-Resolution-Click on the Item LMN to open it.-Now for Item LMN select Action button and change the status to Obsolete.-Go to the Installation Point view and open Installation Point ABC .-Go to the Items facet and select the Item LMN( where LMN is now with status as obsolete).-You will not be able to remove this item LMN from Installation Point ABC.

Title: Wrong Tax Country Determined While Ordering Intercompany Third-Party Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have created intercompany third-party purchase order document and system determines the wrong tax country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders work center.-Select the relevant Intercompany Third-Party Purchase Order.-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab.-Select Taxes sub tab and here you can see the wrong Tax Country.-Cause-In this scenario, the Purchase Order contains the process type Third-Party which cannot be supported by the standard taxation solution.-Note: In case, if the process type is To-Stock or Non-Stock, the expected Tax Country and the Tax Code will be determined based on activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Resolution-You can solve the issue by creating parameters for the external determination of incoming and outgoing tax events for product tax under the activity External Tax Determination for Goods and Services. Follow the below steps to configure the third-party tax elements.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view & select Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine Tuning.-Search for Activity - External Tax Determination for Goods and Services.-Here you can maintain the below Tax Elements to determine the right Tax Country for Third-Party taxation or Drop Shipment Scenario.-Valid-for Country-Enforce country as tax country-Tax Event Direction-Define Valid From / Valid To-Tax Event-Third-Party Deal (Check box)-Under Tax Code Details, you can use, dedicated Tax Code also.-Or You can determine the product tax event based on Ship-From and Ship-To locations.-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-External Tax Determination for Goods and Services,  change tax country determination

Title: Planning Proposal Deleted Automatically
Content: Symptom-The system created proposals for an existing demand of yours. When the MRP is executed again you see that the proposals already created have been deleted by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Products view.-Search for the relevant Product and Planning Area combination, choose Open button.-In Product Planning Details screen choose the button Run Planning and select the option Single BoM Level or Multi BoM Level depending on your business need.-You see that a few of the proposals which already exists are deleted by the system.-Cause-If the proposals are not released and are not Firm, the system will delete the existing proposal and create a new planning proposal depending on the current stock and demand situation for the product in the planning area when MRP is executed manually. You can identify if a proposal is firm by the Lock symbol visible agains the proposal.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Planning Proposal, MRP, Product, Proposal.

Title: Tickets Products Description in Different Language
Content: Symptom-When you log in the system in English language and tries to add a new Spare Part to Ticket 123 (123 represents the Ticket ID), the Description of the item is in German language.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Login with English language;-2. Go to Service work center -> Tickets view;-3. Open Ticket 123;-4. Go to Spare Parts facet;-5. Press Add -> Add from List;-6. The description appears in German for all items in the list.-Cause-The creator of the Ticket 123 created the Ticket logged in the system with German logon language.-The system takes in consideration the login language of the creator of the Ticket to display the description of Products in the Ticket screen.-If the User ABC (ABC represents the User ID) creates the Ticket 123 with logon language German, and the user XYZ (XYZ represents the User ID) opens the Ticket 123 with logon language German, the Product List in Ticket 123 appears in German eitherway, and vice-versa.-Currently this is the system expected behavior for any logon language.

Title: Error During Migration: 'Number of decimal places is not valid for currency XXX, amount YYY,YYY'
Content: Symptom-You try to migrate e.g. Fixed Assets using data migration template, you get the error message: 'Number of decimal places is not valid for currency XXX, amount YYY,YYY'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool-Select the respective migration unit and click Execute Migration-Select the Fixed Assets migration object and click Process File-You'll see the error message(s) at simulation step: 'Number of decimal places is not valid for currency XXX, amount YYY,YYY'-Cause-All currencies are predefined with the allowed number of decimal places according to ISO code list 4217 in your system.  In the fixed asset migration template, you have entered decimals places more than the allowed number of decimal places.-Resolution-You can use fine-tuning activity Currencies to view all currencies available in your system.-To view this activity, Follow the below steps.-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation project view.-Select the implementation project and click on Open activity list.-Go to Fine tune tab and search for the activity Currencies and open it.-Here you can review the predefined settings. According to this settings you will be allowed to enter the number of decimals in migration template although, the template column of the migration object allows 5 digits after decimals for cumulative historic depreciation.-Example : For the currency XXX display decimal field has value 02. Hence system will allow you to enter values only with 2 decimal places i.e. YYY,YY. If you enter 3 decimal i.e. YYY,YYY system will give you the error message.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-decimal places, currencies, migration.

Title: Multiple Errors appears when checking the consistency for Inbound Delivery Notification
