Content: Symptom-When checking the consistency of a Supplier Delivery Notification DEF (where DEF represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID), the system triggers multiple error messages.-Error: "Quantity missing"-          "Product at line item XYZ is not valid, Header Missing" (where XYZ represents the Line Item ID).-          "Product ID differs from Product in Purchase Order Item"-          "Product ID is missing; enter a Product ID"-          "Product Type Code not valid; must be Material"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Inbound Delivery Notification DEF (where DEF represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Choose Edit.-Choose Check Consistency.-The following error messages appear:-Error: Quantity missing-          Product at line item XYZ is not valid, Header Missing (where XYZ represents the Line Item ID)-          Product ID differs from Product in Purchase Order Item-          Product ID is missing; enter a Product ID-          Product Type Code not valid; must be Material-Cause-The Product at line item XYZ does not have an open quantity to be delivered (where XYZ represents the Line Item ID).-Resolution-Cancel line item XYZ from Inbound Delivery Notification DEF to avoid the error (where XYZ represents the Line Item ID and DEF represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-If the Supplier Delivery was created through a B2B message and is shown as inconsistent, the Supplier Delivery Notification Items in the XML payload need to correspond to the line items of the referenced Purchase Order. If the XML payload contains incorrect information, contact the 3PL provider and request the required data correction.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification; XML; B2B; Quantity Missing; Product At Line Item Is Not Valid; Header Missing; Product ID Differs From Product In Purchase Order Item; Product ID Is Missing; Enter a Product ID; Product Type Code Not Valid; Must Be Material; SAP Business ByDesign

Title: Customer Invoice Request's Status is With Conflict
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse the invoicing of a Customer Project. You have canceled the Customer Project Invoice Request and the Customer Invoice is still Released at this stage.-In the Invoice Request view of Customer Invoicing work center, the Customer Project Invoice Request's status is With Conflict.-You wish to correct this status before canceling the Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Navigate to the Invoice Requests View.-Select the option All Invoice Requests.-Select Customer Project Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ represents the Invoice Request ID).-The Status is With Conflict.-Click on the Check button.- The following error is displayed:-"Item XX: Conflict in item XX; cancellation requested but invoice already exists" (XX represent the line item number). -Cause-The Customer Project Invoice Request is in status with Conflict because the Project Invoice Request XYZ was cancelled but the Customer Project Invoice Request XYZ was previously invoiced with Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the Invoice ID) which was not cancelled. -Resolution-If you wish to correct the Customer Project Invoice Request's status and finish reversing the invoicing, you can cancel the related Customer Invoice. This will revert the Customer Project Invoice Request's status to Processed and the Item to Canceled.-Note: Once the Project Invoice Requests is canceled, we cannot revoke the cancellation. The system allows Project Invoice Requests to be canceled before canceling Customer Invoice to provide flexibility because both documents in general are handled by different departments on user side. In general, we recommend canceling the last document (Customer Invoice) first in order to avoid inconsistencies in the system. --Keywords-Conflict, Cancellation Requested but Invoice Already Exists, Customer Project Invoice Request-cpir is canceled before cancelling civ

Title: You cannot Add a Free Long Text Field to a Table View
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a free text field (such as Notes from an object) to a table view.-Reproducing the Issue-This is valid for any screen with a table view on it.-1) Navigate to a screen with a table view present;-2) Click in Adapt button;-3) Select Edit Master Layout;-4) Hover your mouse over a table view and click on the plus (+) button;-5) You notice that the Note field does not appear as possibility for adding in the table view.-Cause-Data types have different size limits and table views currently do not support this type of information, from Notes for example. Note is a datatype that cannot be showed in these circumstances, because it can hold much information that could compromise its visualization. For example long notes in the mobile version could require a lot of work scrolling down to do a task.-This is a limitation on table views, thus currently the system standard behavior.

Title: How to Show Total Amounts in the Sales Order Assignment Table of a Project?
Content: Symptom-In the Sales Tracking tab of projects, you wish to see the total Ordered Net Value and/or the total Ordered Quantity in the Sales Order Assignment table.-Where is this configured?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Find XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID)-Click Edit - Project Plan.-Go to the Sales Tracking tab.-Go to the Sales Order Assignment subtab.-You have a row containing the total Ordered Net Value and/or the total Ordered Quantity in the table.-Cause-This functionality is a calculated field which needs to be added by screen personalisation via Personalize for one single user or Adaptation mode ﻿for all users.-Resolution-To add this calculated field to the Sales Order Assignment table, you can follow the steps below from the Sales Order Assignment tab of a project:-Go to Personalize or Adapt - Enter Adaptation mode.-If you click Adapt: Go back to the Sales Tracking tab and click Adapt - Edit Screen.-In the sidebar, select the section Untitled Table.-Under Field Properties, click the hyperlink Configure Calculations.-Select the type of calculation you want for the column, eg. For Ordered Net Value, choose Sum to get the total amount ordered.-Check the box Display Result Rows at Top of Table.-Save and close.-A yellow line displaying the selected data will appear at the top of the table.-Keywords

Title: Exception Appears While Posting Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Exception appears while posting supplier invoice.-Error -Distributing overall deduction or surcharge not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Select Edit and navigate to Exceptions tab.-Cause-For item type - Subsequent Debit, Subsequent Credit, Additional Cost Credit, Additional Cost Debit items, the Discount, Surcharges and Reductions do not apply. The discounts must be applied in the original invoice document itself. From the business point of view, the discounts, surcharges, reductions are mainly applied for a particular product or an item in negotiation with the supplier by the Purchaser. Here the additional cost items or the Subsequent items (namely Credit/Debit) are being borne by the supplier and hence the discounts are not applicable.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior and kindly remove the Discounts/Surcharges from the Invoice document.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Select Edit and navigate to Deductions and Surcharges tab.-Remove the Overall Deductions and Surcharges.-Save the Supplier Invoice.

Title: Tax Base Amount Differs from Net Amount in VAT/Sales Tax Items Report
Content: Symptom-All VAT/Sales Tax Items with Journal report (Report ID FINTAXU10_Q0001): the Net Amount (Company Currency) differs from the Tax Base Amount (Tax Return Currency).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the List view.-Open report All VAT/Sales Tax Items with Journal.-Execute the report with the relevant selection criteria.-For a given invoice, the Net Amount (Company Currency) differs from the Tax Base Amount (Tax Return Currency).-Cause-The invoice has been created in a foreign currency. Nevertheless, the system used different exchange rates to convert the tax base amount.-The Tax Date on the invoice has been overridden and differs from the journal entry's posting date, hence the system used the Tax Date for currency conversion on tax base amount and tax calculation. In this case, there are different exchange rates for the posting date and tax date.-The exchange rates can be checked as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, click Edit Exchange Rates.-Resolution-It is the system designed behavior to use the tax date for tax currency conversions. In order to ensure that same exchange rate is used, you have to make sure that the posting date and tax date is the same.-See Also-FINTAXU10_Q0001; net amount; tax base amount

Title: Identified Stock Value Not Visible in Pick List
Content: Symptom-You have a pick list which is Not Started. You take a preview of the pick list and can see that the expected identified stock information is not available in the preview.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant pick task and choose the button Print Task. You can also choose Preview button and choose the option Preview.-The preview or print out does not have the identified stock information.-Cause-If the task is in Not Started status with no identified stock value in the field Identified stock, the identified stock related information will not be available in the print document.-If the task is In Process and atleast one quantity is filled of the Planned Quantity field along with identified stock, the identified stock information will be available in the print document.-Resolution-Please enter atleaste one quantity in Planned Quantity field and the identified stock value in the Identified Stock field.

Title: Warning message "Item XX partially released; confirmation of released part frozen"  when Stock availability is checked at the time of releasing Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-When Stock availability is checked at the time of releasing Customer Demand a warning message appears.*XX refers to Item id-Item XX partially released; confirmation of released part frozen-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-Go to Customer Demand View.-Search for Sales Order XYZ.-Select Go.-Select Order Line item XYZ-xx to check availability of Stock.-Select Actions --> select Check Availability.-Warning message appears-Item xx partially released; confirmation of released part frozen.-Cause-As the line item is partially released for delivery and as there is not enough stock available at a given point of time the warning message is triggered.-Resolution-We need to ensure that there is sufficient Stock available in Stock Overview or in Supply Planning screen before releasing the Demand in order to avoid the warning message.-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Item  partially released; confirmation of released part frozen, When Stock availability is checked at the time of releasing Customer Demand a warning message appears.

Title: What is the difference Planned dates, Scheduled dates and Actual dates in a Project?
Content: Symptom-You want to know the distinction between Planned dates, Scheduled dates and Actual dates in the Scheduling tab of a project.-You also want to understand Constraint dates and Constraint Types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Find any project.-Click Edit - Project Plan.-Go to Scheduling tab.-You will see these fields here.-Cause-These dates have different roles in the project's scheduling.-Resolution-Planned dates and Scheduled dates are the same dates. They are used to determine the time frame of the project and its tasks at the start of the project, during its creation or during the initial scheduling. They enable the project responsible to establish an estimated timeline.-Actual dates reflect the real-life situation. The Actual Start date is based on the first time recording and the Actual finish date reflects the date on which the project is completed and closed. These Actual dates are automatically calculated.-You cannot enter Actual dates before releasing the project task, therefore you cannot use the Actual dates to substitute the Planned dates.-The Constraint types are events that determine the rules to be applied to scheduling the Constraint dates in order to create a chronology. The Start Constraint Type impacts the Start Constraint Date and the Finish Constraint Type impacts the Finish Constraint Date.-The Constraint dates are only indicators for the project's timeline. Constraints are purely informational, they will have no impact on the system's behaviour in the sense that it will not block anything.-Keywords

Title: Third Party Purchase Orders Not Visible In Supply And Demand List
Content: Symptom-Sales Orders with external fulfillment i.e. Third Party Purchase Orders do not appear in the Supply and Demand list of the Product Planning Screen.-For Instance: You have created a Sales Order ZZZ of fulfillment type External, Third Party Purchase Order XYZ will be created for the Sales Order ZZZ.-(Where ZZZ represents Sales Order ID, XYZ represents Purchase Order ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Supply Planning Work Center-Go To Products View-Select Advanced Filter, Input values Product ID & Planning Area ID-Under Supply and Demand Tab -> Supply and Demand List -> Sales Order ZZZ & Third Party Purchase Order XYZ not visible-  Cause-Sales Order ZZZ has the fulfillment type External. Since, the planning site will be the external supplier site, Supply & Demand will not be visible in the Product Planning screen.-Resolution-Third Party Purchase Orders do not appear in the Supply and Demand list of the Product Planning Screen.-Keywords-TPOP, Supply & Demand List, Third Party Purchase Order, Product Planning

Title: Invoice Schedule Does Not Display Dates Outside the Validity of the Item for Migrated Contracts
Content: Symptom-You migrated customer contracts but only the invoice schedule dates within the contract item validity are visible.-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite: You migrated a customer contract with invoice schedule dates outside the contracts validity.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the contract).-Click on the Edit button. -Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Expand the line item XX (XX represents the number of the line item).-You can see that the invoice dates which are not within the start and end date of the contract item are missing for this item.- Cause-The system generates only those dates which lie within the validity of the item (contract item start and end date). Since missing invoice schedule dates are not within the contract item start and end date these dates are not generated in the invoice schedule.- Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-You can these invoice schedule dates manually in the contract:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the contract).-Click on the Edit button. -Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Expand the line item XX.-Click on the Add Date button.-Maintain the respective invoice date.

Title: Contract Renewal not Triggered
Content: Symptom-You noticed that after the contract expired no new contract was created, eventhough you maintained a renewal rule. No business task was created for the renewal either by the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contacts view.-Show all contracts and find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer contract).-Click on Edit.- Navigate to the General tab.-Select the the Renewal and Cancellation subtab.-Here you can see, that the renewal rule is maintained.-Go to the Items tab. -Select the relevant line item.-Here you can see that, that the line item is already expired since the end date was reached.-  Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Task Management view.-Show all tasks and enter XYZ the search  field (XYZ represents the ID of the customer contract).-No task are found.-Cause-The system automatically sends a renewal task before a contract expires. This task is sent based on the time period entered in the Reminder field of the customer contract. -When a new renewal rule is maintained after the contract has expired, the field reminder is not filled and no business task is triggered.-A task of this type is relevant if you work with customer contracts related to services, and require an automatic process to alert responsible employees that a contract is about to expire.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Production Lots/Orders are Not Shown in Product Lot Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-You observe that few of the Production lots/Orders are not shown in Product Lot Line Items Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Go to the Product Lot Line Items Report.-Give the selection Criteria Company ID,Set of Books, Production lots.-Click Go.-The Report does not show the Production lots/Orders.-Cause-Production Orders are not shown in Product Lot Line Items Report as the Production Orders are not posted to accounting.-You can follow the below steps:-Go to Production Control Work center.-Go to Production Orders view.-Show All Production Orders and Find Production Orders XXX and ZZZ.-Select the Production Order and Edit.-Go to Document Flow and you could see that the Production Confirmations are not posted to accounting and Business tasks are created.-Business task shows that Fiscal year is missing for Company.You have to create a new  Fiscal Year and then try posting the Production Confirmations.-Once the Production Confirmations are posted,the Production Orders are shown in the Report.-Resolution-This is the System behavior.-Keywords-Production Lots, Production orders missing, Product Lot Line Items Report

Title: E-Mail Notifications for Business Tasks Not Being Sent
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the automatic standard e-mail notifications for Business Task Management activities are not being sent.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The below is an example and can happen for other views as well. -Go to the Sales Workcenter.-Go to the Opportunities View.-Open the Opportunity ABC (where ABC represents an actual opportunity ID).-Select Actions.-Select Submit for Approval.-The Approver does not receive a standard notification e-mail.-Cause-The scoping option for the Business Task Management e-mail has not been scoped.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Project work center view.-Select the currently active project.-Click Edit Current Scope.-Navigate to step 4, Questions.-Expand Communication and information Exchange.-Next, expand Business Process Management.-Select Business Task Management.-In the right-hand pane, check the box for question “Do you want to use e-mail to notify business users about Business Task Management items?”-Then you will be able to subscribe to e-mail notifications when you receive a standard notification popup by selecting “Subscribe to e-mail.”-Keywords-Business Task, E-Mail, Notification

Title: No Extension Scenarios Visible In Stock Transfer Order
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field in a stock transfer order. You want to extend this field to successive documents like Outbound Delivery Request, Warehouse Request, Outbound Delivery etc. While trying to extend your extension field you do not see any Extension Scenario available for the filed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to Customer Demand view.-Select an existing Stock Transfer Order and choose Edit button.-Select the Adapt menu in the top right corner of the screen and choose Enter Adaptation Mode.-Select the extension field you have created and choose the Further Usage link.-Navigate to the Extension Scenarios tab.-You can see that there are no scenarios visible.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign extensibility is available only for customer demand with order category Sales Order or Service Order. This is the reason why you are not able to see any extension scenarios for stock transfer order directly.-Resolution-The system is working as designed. You can however, create an extension field in the Sales Order or Service Order and then extend this field to customer demand. This field can further be extended to warehouse request, pick task and outbound delivery. This field that is extended from sales order will be visible when you create stock transfer orders as well. You can choose to make this extended field invisible in your sales order screen as per your requirement.-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, Extension field, Sales Order, Service Order, Outbound Delivery Request, Warehouse Request, Outbound Delivery.

Title: Error "Action not enabled" appears when Customer Demand is Released with Stock Check.
Content: Symptom-When Customer Demand is Released with Stock Check for a Sales Order Line item ABC-XY, System triggered error.*ABC-XY refers to Sales Order Line Item-Action not enabled -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-Go to Customer Demand View.-Search for Sales Order ABC.-Select Go.-Select Line item ABC-XY to be released and Select Release with Stock Check.-Error appears Action not enabled -Cause-As there is no enough stock available for Confirmation of Demand, Hence this is causing the error.-Resolution-We need to ensure that there is sufficient Stock available in Stock Overview or in Supply planning Screen  before releasing the Demand in order to avoid the error.-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Action not enabled, Error "Action not enabled" appears when Customer Demand is Released with Stock Check

Title: Error Execution of Action Not Possible at the Moment in Production Order
Content: Symptom-When you edit Production Order 9999 where 9999 represents Production order ID with In Preparation Status and Add Row in Input Products you receive error message Execution of Action Not Possible at the Moment.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Production Control workcenter and Production Orders view.-2. Show All Production Orders and Find Production Order 9999 with In Preparation status.-3. Edit the Production Order 9999 and View All.-4. Go to Order Structure and Element ID-5. Go to Input Products sub tab and Add Row.-You will encounter the above error.-Cause-This exception is raised from backend to notify that there is blank entry in the Product ID in the new line which gets added when we click on Add Row.-Resolution-Enter a valid Product ID Productxyz.-After this, exception will dissapear and you can proceed to release Production Order.-Keywords-Production Order, Input Products, In Preparation, Add Row, Product ID.

Title: Error "Shipment Date Older Than The First Confirmation" received when trying to print Pro Forma Invoice from Outbound Delivery.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Print Pro Forma Invoice from Outbound Delivery DEF. System displays below error message*DEF refers to Outbound Delivery Id-Shipment Date Older Than The First Confirmation-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-In the field Show, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection using drop-down. -Search for relevant Outbound Delivery ID DEF.-Select Go.-Select Pro Forma Invoice.-New Screen appears: Pro Forma Invoice for Outbound Delivery: DEF ,Select Print Pro Forma Invoice.-Select Save.-The system displays the error message:-Shipment Date Older Than The First Confirmation-Cause-Since the Shipment Date maintained in the Outbound Delivery is an earlier date than the Actual Execution Date of the relevant Warehouse Confirmation ID, system triggers the error.-The Shipment Date must be the same as the Actual Execution On Date or greater than that of the Confirmation Date.-Resolution-In order to find the Actual Execution On Date as per Warehouse Confirmation against the Outbound Delivery, please follow the below steps:-Go to the Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Monitoring View and choose Warehouse Order sub view.-In the field Show, select All Warehouse Order by Selection using drop-down.-Using Advanced Search, enter the relevant Outbound Delivery ID in the section Delivery ID.-Choose Go, here you will find the relevant Warehouse Order ID against the Outbound Delivery.-Select the Order ID and Edit it, navigate to  Confirmations tab.-Here you can see the Confirmation ID with Actual Execution On.-Now follow the below steps in order to print Pro Forma Invoice from Outbound Delivery-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-In the field Show, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection using drop-down and find relevant Outbound Delivery ID DEF.-Select an Outbound Delivery DEF and Edit it.-In General tab, under section: Dates, change the shipment date to same as Actual Execution On Date as per warehouse confirmation or greater that this.-Then perform Check Consistency. Now Outbound Delivery should be consistent.-Then Print Pro Forma Invoice from Outbound Delivery and Save the Outbound Delivery.-Keywords-Shipment Date Older Than The First Confirmation, when trying to print Pro Forma Invoice from Outbound Delivery, The Shipment Date must be the same as the Actual Execution On Date

Title: Error: "Technical error RPMF_MESSAGE 13" when Production Model is released for Planning and Execution.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When checking the consistency of the production model it shows that the model is consistent, but when we try to release the production model for Planning and Execution system displays the below error messages:*DEF refers to Production Model-Creation of released planning model not possible;- -----> Create RPMs (number 1);- -----> Technical error RPMF_MESSAGE 13; Report an case;- -----> Technical error RPPM 063; Report an case- -----> Save Failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Production Models View.-Select the Production Model ID DEF and choose the Edit button.-Select the Check Consistency button, system shows that the production model is consistent.-Now select the Release Production Model button and choose the option Planning and Execution.-        The system displays the mentioned error messages:-           Creation of released planning model not possible;- -----> Create RPMs (number 1);- -----> Technical error RPMF_MESSAGE 13; Report an case;- -----> Technical error RPPM 063; Report an case- -----> Save Failed-Cause-The error is due to incomplete data maintained in the Production Model. In this case, Quantity and Unit of Measure for a By-product is not maintained.-Resolution-The error should be fixed once we provide the Quantity and Unit of Measure for the By-Products in the production Model.-Go to Planning and Production Master data Work Center.-Go to Production Models View.-Search and open Production Model DEF.-Select Edit.-Navigate to Bill of Operations tab.-Navigate to sub tab Product Assignment.-Find for a By-Product in any of the Produce Activity and select the activity.-Navigate to tab By-Products-Maintain the Quantity and Unit of Measure for the By-Products.-Keywords-Create RPMs, Technical error RPMF_MESSAGE 13; Report an case, Technical error RPPM 063; Report an case, Save Failed-technical error rpmf_message 13,technical error rppm 063

Title: Incoterms and Incoterms location not visible in the Third-Party Outbound Delivery Form.
Content: Symptom-Incoterms & Incoterms location is missing in the Third-Party Outbound Delivery DEF when previewed in PDF Form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work center.-Go to the Third-Party Outbound Deliveries View.-Select Third-Party Outbound Delivery DEF.-Select Preview-->Preview.-We observe that the Incoterms and Incoterms Location information is missing when previewed in Outbound delivery PDF.-Cause-The system does not support Incoterms and Incoterms location in case of Third Party Delivery Processing.-Hence the information will not be found in the PDF form.-Resolution-Hence the information will not be found in the PDF form.This is the standard behavior as designed.-Keywords-Incoterms and Incoterms location not visible in the Third-Party Outbound Delivery Form, system does not support Incoterms and Incoterms location in case of Third Party Delivery Processing

Title: To change the Ship-To Location other than the one which is different from Sales Order Ship-from Location, While Creating Customer Return Notification
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Create a Customer Return Notification with Change in ship-to Location DEF which is different from Sales Order XYZ Ship-From Location KLM, Error appears.*DEF refers to ship-to Location id, XYZ refers to Sales Order Id, KLM refers to Ship-From Location Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-In Common tasks, select New Customer Return Notification.-In 1 Select Outbound Delivery items.-Fill in all the required entries.-Click Next.-Error appears-The selling company KLM of the reference document for item XY differs from the company of the ship-to-location.-Either adjust the ship-to-location or the reference document (such as the outbound delivery ID).-Cause-As you are trying to create returns for a different Location other than the one on which the Sales Order was created the system triggers the errors preventing us from proceed.-Resolution-Customer Returns must be created for the Sales Order within the same company, It is highly recommended that Ship-to Location  which is copied from Sales Order Ship-From Location is not altered while Creating Customer Return Notification.-System always defaults the ship to on the customer return to where it was sourced from  the Sales Order.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-The selling company  of the reference document for item  differs from the company of the ship-to-location, Either adjust the ship-to-location or the reference document (such as the outbound delivery ID).

Title: The Tasks Created From Contacts are Missing Within the Contacts
Content: Symptom-You have created tasks within the contacts, but those tasks are not visible inside the contacts.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customers work center.-Go to the Contacts view.-Open the contact ABC (ABC represents the contact ID) -Go to the Activities facet.-Choose New button for task and create a new task.-After creation, the task is not displayed in the Tasks table within contacts. It is however, displayed in the Tasks view of Activities Workcenter.-Cause-The Primary Contact field on the Tasks quick create is not being determined to the existing contact during the task creation.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project XYZ and choose the Open Activity List button.(XYZ represents the project name)-In the Fine-Tune chevron, search and open Activities activity.-Select the Maintain the Involved Parties for Tasks link.-Set the Contact of Account party as Active and Save.-This will automatically determine the Primary contact during the task creation.-NOTE: The above behavior is valid for all the activity types such as Appointment etc.

Title: Error Message: "The action RELEASE is not possible; Refresh the screen and try again, If the problem persists, report an incident" While Trying to Release an Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-When trying to release an Inbound Delivery, but the system is showing you the error: 'The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Inbound Deliveries view.-Find and select the relevant Delivery ID.-Choose Release button.-The system shows the error message: The action RELEASE is not possible; Refresh the screen and try again, If the problem persists, report an case.-Cause-In Inbound Delivery Processing, it is not allowed to release the Inbound Delivery if the Delivery Status is not 'Finished'.-The Delivery Status is not Finished due to one of these three causes:-The Warehouse Tasks is not finished.-There is some deviation to be accepted in Warehouse Order.-The relevant Inbound Delivery is canceled already.-Resolution-To resolve the issue for these three scenarios:-a) For the case where the Warehouse Task (Put Away task) is not finished, please follow these steps:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Select Task Control view. -Search for the Tasks related to the relevant Inbound Delivery. -Confirm the Task.-b) For the case where there is some deviation to be accepted in Warehouse Order, please follow these steps:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Select Warehouse Orders view. -Search for the Warehouse Order related to the relevant Inbound Delivery. -Open the Warehouse Order. -Choose View All. -Go to Operations tab. -Choose option: Accept the Deviation. -c) For the case where the relevant Inbound Delivery is being canceled, the Release action is not allowed. This is the expected behavior.-See Also-2691994 - Error: "The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, Delivery Not Started, action, RELEASE is not possible, Refresh, screen, and try again, problem, persists, report, case, The action RELEASE is not possible; Refresh the screen and try again, If the problem persists, report an case, task, warehouse order.-inbound delivery,refresh the screen and try again,the action release is not possible,if the problem persists,delivery not started

Title: Error Mesage: Withholding Tax Items Not Supported For This Transaction
Content: Symptom-You see that in the supplier invoice , there is an exception message stating Withholding Tax Items not supported for this transaction displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Workcenter.-Navigate to the Supplier invoices and Credit memos view.-Select Invoice ID - XXX.-Under the Exceptions tab, you find that there is an exception Withholding Tax Items not supported for this transaction.-Cause-Cause 1:The error message is displayed as the Supplier invoice Item line doesn't have quantity, price unit and net price maintained.- or- Cause 2:You have not maintained correct tax code and thus respective withholding tax is also not valid for the transaction you used.-Resolution-Cause 1:-You have to maintain quantity, price unit and net price in the supplier invoice line item.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Navigate to the Supplier invoices and Credit memos view-Select Invoice ID - XXX-In the Items Tab, select the line item-Now enter the details quantity, price unit and net price and click on the save button.-Cause 2:-Maintain correct tax code and then this error would not come. For example if the company is India and supplier is US then if you use tax code 83 then you would get this error.  However as you know that 83 is related to domestic purchase and your transaction is import, so you have to use right tax code say for example 95 and then you will not get this error.-Keywords-WHT error

Title: Agreed Payment Method is Defaulted to Bank Transfer If Deviating Bank Information is Maintained in Supplier Invoices.
Content: Symptom-You have posted the Supplier Invoice XXX and observed that the Agreed Payment Method is shown as Domestic Bank Transfer in Supplier Account Monitor eventhough-the Payment Method on Supplier Master Data is maintained as Wire Transfer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Show All Supplier Accounts and Find Supplier ABC.-Go to Trade Payables view and Invoice/Payments Sub view.-Show Open Items and Find Document ID XXX.-Choose Item Details.-You could see that Agreed Payment Method is shown as Domestic Bank Transfer.-Cause-You have maintained Deviating Bank Information in Supplier Invoice XXX.-You can check by following the below steps:-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Invoices and Find Supplier Invoice XXX.-Edit the Supplier Invoice XXX.-Go to General Tab and then go to Payment Information.-You could see Deviating Bank Information maintained.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Agreed Payment Method, Bank transfer,  Deviating Bank Information

Title: How to Assign an Invalid Employee to a Past Project Task?
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add an employee to a project task in the past but the employee is no longer part of the company on the day of the change.-When entering the Employee's name, you get the message No records found in the Value selection. When you add the Employee's name directly and press enter, you get the error message Employee XYZ does not exist.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Show all.-Find ABC (ABC represents the Project ID).-Edit - Project Plan.-Go to Work tab.-Add a new line.-Enter XYZ in Team member field (XYZ represents the Employee's name).-You get the error message Employee XYZ does not exist.-Cause-When you enter an employee's name or a part of it, the system will search for a valid employee record for the current date (today). This search is performed regardless of the dates associated with the project task or service. It is important to note that if the employee is not employed on the current date, the system will not find them, as this is the expected behavior.-Resolution-You enter the Employee ID rather than the name to assign that employee to the task and service. The reason for this is that with the Employee ID, the checks are fulfilled using the project start date and not the current date.-Keywords-Invalid employee error; employee in project; No records found;

Title: Intercompany Purchase Order Price not Updated in the Sales Order Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-****Set to Archived status. The product list price in the intercompany sales order is not taken from the purchase order, it is determined from price lists. So the price change made on the pruchase order has no impact on the sales order price.******-You have changed the price in intercompany purchase order after the sales order got created & you expect system to update the latest price in the intercompany sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Intercompany Purchase Order with status Sent-Select Edit & navigate to Items tab-Change the Price & select Send Update button-Go to the Sales Orders work center-Go to the Sales Orders view-Select the relevant Sales Order-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-You can see that, Price is not updated in Sales Orders-Cause-Price changes are allowed only until the Invoicing status is Not Started on Sales Order item. Once invoice process is started, system does not allow any price changes to flow from purchase order to sales order document. This is a standard behavior.-Note:-For an item type, which is not a limit item on the purchase order, system do not change price on sales order as per changes done in purchase order. Instead a warning message is shown on the Sales Order document to depict how much percentage it deviates from the list price of the purchase order document.-Business configuration scoping selected to enable late price changes on Sales order enables the late price changes in manual update scenario.This business configuration scope does not affect the price change in Intercompany scenario as stated above.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior. As a workaround, you can manually update the latest purchase order price in the sales order document. Or You can contact partners to create an add-on, so that recently changed purchase order price gets reflected in the intercompany sales order document.

Title: Cannot Drag and Drop Demands in Resource Scheduler
Content: Symptom-You are unable to assign demands by dragging and dropping them to the Gantt Chart in the Resource Scheduler.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Resource Scheduler work center.-Go to the Resource Scheduler view.-Select the demand ABC from the list view on the left hand side.-Drag and drop the demand ABC onto the Gantt Chart.-The demand doesnt stay on the Gantt Chart and returns back to the list.-Cause-It is possible to assign demands onto the Gantt Chart only if there are emloyees available. There are no employees visible on the Gantt Chart because they are not assigned any working hours.-Resolution-To assign working hours to the employees, please follow the steps below:-Go to the People work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Open the employee ABC.-Navigate to the Working Hours facet.-On the Working Period table, choose Add Row.-Enter the details and Save.-Keywords-Gantt Chart, Employees

Title: How to remove favorites from My Launchpad
Content: Symptom-Unable to delete favorites / shortcuts from My Launchpad in Bydesign HTML.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to Bydesign in HTML client.-Navigate to My LaunchPad view.-Unable to remove or delete favorites from My Launchpad.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior, favorites have to be removed by initialising the Personalization mode.-Resolution-These favorites / shortcuts can only be Hidden and therefore is present in the background of My launchpad.--In order to Hide this shortcut / Favorite , please follow the below steps:--- Hover on the Personal settings & choose 'Start the personalisation mode'--- Navigate to Background Design UI which is available on the right side panel and select the (>) button on the screen.--- Scroll down to see the list of Favorites present, which you can hide /show by ticking the Visiblity button.--- Saves the changes--> Logout & Login once again to see these changes being reflected on the screen.

Title: Postings not Permitted For Project Task XYZ.
Content: Symptom-While posting the Payment allocation system displays an error message: "Postings not Permitted For Project Task XYZ".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If the relevant Project Task ID XYZ is Closed/Completed, ﻿the system will not allow the user to post the Payment allocation.-Resolution-You need to revoke completion of the Project Task XYZ-n status back to Released then post the Payment Allocation.-Follow steps mentioned below to revoke completion of the Project task XYZ status back to Released. This action needs to be performed by Project Manager.-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects View.-Search for project XYZ.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Project Plan tab.-Choose Project Task XYZ-n.-Navigate to Basic Data subtab.-In Project Task Status value, choose to Revoke Closure and Revoke Completion.-Save it.-Keywords-Project Task; Closure; Closed; Payment Allocation

Title: Not Able to Delete the Internal Comments in the Sales Tab in Materials
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to delete the Internal Comments which are maintained in the Sales tab in the Materials. But you are not able to see any option to Delete the Internal Comments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio workcenter-Go to Products view-Go to By Materials subview-Select any Material XYZ (where XYZ represents the Material)-Choose Edit-Select View All-Go to the Sales tab-In the Details section, go to the tab Internal Comments-Delete option is not available to delete the Internal Comments-Cause-Once the Internal Comments are maintained in the Purchasing tab and Sales tab in Materials, you will not be able to Delete them.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Internal Comments, Delete Internal Comments

Title: Purchase Request and Purchase Order is not Created Even After Project Purchase Request is Approved or released
Content: Symptom-Purchase Request and Purchase Order is not created even after the Project Purchase Request is approved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects Sub-View.-Search for project PRQ  (PQR refers to Project ID)-Select Edit -> Products.-Navigate to Purchase Requests sub-tab.-Navigate Document Flow and we see that no documents (Purchase Request and Purchase Order) being created-You see that the purchase request and purchase order is not created even after the Project Purchase Request is approved.-Cause-The activity Activate Solution Capabilities is not yet confirmed in Business Configuration work center. This has the effect, that all project management UIs are already there, but technical communication to other process components like purchasing is not yet active. After confirming Activate Solution Capabilities the communication is active, and for project purchase requests corresponding purchase requests in purchasing are created.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. In order to activate the technical communication, the Activate Solution Capabilities ﻿must be Confirmed. Please follow the below steps to confirm the Activate Solution Capabilities.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and select Open Activity List button.-Select All tab.-Search for Activate Solution Capabilities and Open it.-Select Confirm.-Note: The changes will be reflected only in the newly created project purchase requests.-Keywords-purchase request, purchase order, project purchase request, project purchase request approved, purchase request not created from PPR, no PO from project purchase request

Title: Exception Occurs While Posting Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post the Supplier Invoice due to the below exception.-Exception - Permanent establishment not determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Select Edit and navigate to Exceptions tab.-You can see the exceptions.-Cause-Supplier invoice is assigned to Account Assignment Type say Cost Center or a Project Task. You can check the cost center validity or in case of project, check the validity of Responsible Unit of the project assigned in the supplier invoice & check the Supplier Invoicing function for the Responsible Unit.-Resolution-You have to extend the validity of the Cost center or responsible unit used in the project. To do so, please follow the below steps;-Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks view & Select Edit Org Structures.-Search for relevant Org Unit.-Select Edit & navigate to Timelines tab.-Select the Attribute - Functions.-Under column Value, find Supplier Invoicing.-Here extend the Validity Date: Valid to Unlimited.-Select Save.-Select Check - Check Selected Structure.-Select Activate - Activate Selected Structure.-Save and Close.-Now do the dummy changes in the Invoice or re-enter the Cost Center or a Project Task. This should obsolete the exceptions & document will be ready for posting.

Title: Information Required for Purchasing And Projects Documents
Content: Symptom-In order to process and investigate issues in the area of purchasing and projects efficiently, we should gather the following information:-Case 1: Error in the document-Steps to reproduce along with Work center and View in which the issue occurs.-Document ID of the affected document as an example (shopping cart, purchase request, purchase order, goods and service receipt, supplier invoice, projects and project invoice request).-Error message that occurs and the action that triggered the error message.-Can this issue be reproducing and do we have the permission to reproduce this in your system.-In case of data change in productive system can this issue be reproducible in your test system and permission for the same.-Changes that were performed.-What is the actual result and what is the expected result.-Is this issue a general issue or does this only occur for a specific user (in this case please provide the user).-In case the issue occurs when data is uploaded to your system please provide the respective file (migration template, excel file or SOAP request and SOAP response) as an attachment in the case.-Business Impact the issue has on your company or for your users.-Case 2: Dump-Steps to reproduce along with Work center and View in which the issue occurs.-Document ID of the affected example like (shopping cart, purchase request, purchase order, goods and service receipt, supplier invoice, projects and project invoice request )-Is this issue occurring for all the documents or does this occurs for a specific document.-Is this issue a general issue or does this only occur for a specific user (in this case please provide the user).-Can this issue be reproducing and do we have the permission to reproduce this in your system in case data is changed or created (possibly in a test system). -In case of data change in productive system can this issue be reproducible in the test system and permission for the same.-Case 3: Unexpected System Behvaiour-What is not working.-What is the expected behaviour.-Steps to reproduce along with Work center and View in which you could see wrong behaviour.-Provide us an example which will help us to analyse and replicate the issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Report An case, BYD, SRM, Project Management

Title: Item Deduction Too High During Supplier Invoice Creation
Content: Symptom-You are creating the supplier invoice with a deduction or negative amount. However, there is an error message displayed, stating Item Deduction Too High.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Entry view.-Search for XYZ (XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID).-Select New Invoice button.-Select View All.-Navigate to Deductions and Surcharges tab.-Enter the Discount Percentage/Discount Amount.-Select Check/Post.-You get an error message: Item Deduction Too High.-Cause-The Net Amount is lesser than the Item Net Discount.-Resolution-The Item Net Discount must be lesser than the Net Amount for each item. In order to adjust the amount of the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the Supplier Invoice ID) ensure that the Item Net Discount is lesser than Net Amount. Instead of applying discount at header level, apply discount at item level.-If you previously entered a negative amount for the Item price, you will get the same error. The total amount on the Invoice should always be positive, it cannot be posted otherwise. There are various possibilities where you can fulfil your negative amount requirement:-Create an Invoice item and followed by a Credit Memo item in the same document such that overall amount has to be positive.-Create a Credit memo with respect to the Invoice with an amount greater than the Invoice item. In this case you will get an exception for Missing Invoice, which you can accept and post the invoice.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Credit Memo, Deduction Too High, Net Amount, Item Price, Negative Amount

Title: Logistics Area XYZ Parent Location Should be Inventory Managed
Content: Symptom-While adding Location and Logistics Area to the system through the Migration tool, you get the error message Logistics area XYZ Parent Location should be Inventory Managed (XYZ represents the ID of the Logistics Area).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click Overview view.-Search for Migration of Location and Logistics Area and click the link to the Activity.-On the next screen, click link to Migrate Location and Logistics area using the migration tool.-Then, Upload the appropriate migration template file and click button to Execute Migration Step by Step.-Proceed with the migration until Step 3 - Simulate Import.-Error occurs.-Cause-This issue happens due to inconsistencies in the configuration of the logistics area and its parent location.-Resolution-Configurations regarding Inventory should be consistent across all levels of the logistics hierarchy; as such, if the logistics area is flagged as Inventory Managed in the Inventory Managed Indicator field under the LOA - General tab, so must its parent location or parent logistics area. In the case of the parent location, however, there's no specific Inventory Managed field — instead, this is represented by the fields under the Roles section of the Location tab (Ship From Location Indicator, Ship to Location Indicator, etc.).-To solve the issue, then, please maintain one of the fields in the Role section of the Location tab.-See Also-2408838 - How migration of Logistics Areas works-2591259 - Cannot Create new Logistics Area Using Migration-Keywords-Migration, Logistics area, Inventory, Managed, Parent, Location

Title: Cannot Remove User Status From Registered Product
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set the User Status of a Registered Product as blank, but the system throws the error message “Status profile already exists and cannot be changed”.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Products work center;-Go to Registered Products view;-Open the Registered Product XYZ (XYZ represents the Registered Product ID);-Press “Edit”;-Try to delete the “User Status” fields;-Error message “Status profile already exists and cannot be changed” appears.-Cause-The User Status field is a mandatory field. If the status profile is set and hence the user will get an error message if it is not set. -This is the standard behavior for all mandatory fields.

Title: Error During Activation of an Org Unit After Assigning a Service Agent
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate an Org Unit after assigning a Service Agent to it, system throws below error messages:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY: employee(s) on org unit XYZ () must be below a cost center. It is also possible to flag the org unit to which the employee is assigned as a cost center.--DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY: employee(s) on org unit XYZ () must be below a reporting line unit. It is also possible to flag the org unit to which the employee is assigned as a reporting line unit.--DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY: employee(s) on org unit XYZ () must be below a business residence. It is also possible to flag the org unit to which the employee is assigned as a business residence.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Add a Service Agent to the respective Org Unit-Highlight the Org Unit.-Check or Activate it.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that you assign a Service Agent to an Org Unit which is not/under a Cost Center, Business Residence and Reporting Line Unit-Resolution-It is mandatory that you cannot assign a Service Agent/Employee to an Org Unit which is not (or under) a Cost Center, Business Residence and Reporting Line Unit.

Title: MRP does not considered forecast into account
Content: Symptom-When running the MRP you have noticed the system did not consider a particular forecast.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products View.-For a particular product select Run Planning --> Single Level BoM.-We observe that the system did not consider a particular Forecast and skipped it.-Cause-As the given forecast was firmed by an User, the system skipped it. The same behavior is applied for other documents such as Production Proposals.-Resolution-To have the Forecast considered, it is necessary to select the same and then select the option Undo Firm.-Keywords-MRP does not considered forecast into account, forecast was firmed by an User, the system skipped it, When running the MRP you have noticed the system did not consider a particular forecast

Title: New Identified Stock not available for 3PL Inbound Delivery.
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to create New Identified Stock at 3PL Inbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-Under 3PL Inbound View, Navigate to Purchase Orders Sub View.-Search for  Purchase Order XYZ.*XYZ refers to Purchase Order id-Select New Inbound delivery.-Navigate to Items tab.-Access Identified Stock Value Selection.-You do not have the option to create a new Identified Stock.-Cause-We are not able to create New Identified Stock as the functionality is not available.-Resolution-This is the standard system behaviour as of now.-Keywords-New Identified Stock not available for 3PL Inbound Delivery, create New Identified Stock at 3PL Inbound Delivery

Title: Purchase Order Currency From Supplier Master not Defaulted During the Excel Upload
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded purchase orders through Microsoft Excel keeping currency field in blank, however system defaults the company currency instead of supplier currency.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit-You can see the Company Currency in the uploaded Purchase Order document-Cause-When user creates purchase order document through Microsoft Excel, the user's data always takes preference over master data maintained in system. In the current design, system does not pull the Purchase Order Currency from Supplier master data when purchase order is created via excel. The Purchase Order Currency from Supplier master data is pulled only for manually created Purchase Order documents.-Resolution-You have to fill the correct purchase order currency during the excel upload and order to your supplier.

Title: Is it Possible to Migrate Contacts Without Linking it to Accounts Migration?
Content: Symptom-You Have a Requirement to Migrate Contacts Into the System but There is no Specific Activity for Contacts Migration Instead Contacts can be Migrated Only Through Accounts Migration by linking it With Specific Accounts.-Resolution-This Feature is now Available in our Current Release of C4C. We Recommend Customers to use the Service: ManageContactIn, by Following the Steps as Listed Below:-1. Administration WoC-2. Input and Output Management View-3. Service Explorer Sub-View

Title: Closed Quotes Showing Up in Quote Compare Screen
Content: Symptom-When quotes comparison happens it will show up closed quotes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Sourcing and Contracting work center-Select Requests for Quotation view-Select Show-All RFQs.-Find Quote XYZ.-Now select Compare Quotes.-Here you can see closed quotes will show up in the quote compare screen.-Cause-The current behavior is closed quotes will show up in the quote compare screen. But the award and decline actions will be disabled for the closed quotes so the system will not allow such a quote to be rewarded.-Resolution-System works as expected.-Keywords-Supplier Quote, Compare Quotes, Closed Quote

Title: How to Upload Scanned Invoice
Content: Symptom- You want to know how to upload scanned invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Scanned Invoice-You can scan the document that you received from your supplier and manually upload it as a pdf file to the SAP Business ByDesign system. You can then attach the uploaded file to the new invoice or credit memo. If your scanner software can also create txt files from scanned documents, the system can use the txt file to propose the invoice or credit memo details, which enables you to create invoices and credit memos more efficiently.-Refer help document: Configuration: Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings-[Disclaimer: Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems.  Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."]-How to Download Collaboration Tool-Goto Application and User Management wc-> Business Flexibility->Download Center- How to Upload Scanned Invoice?-There are 2 ways to upload a scanned invoice:-Directly from the ByDesign system-Using SAP Collaboration Window-Directly from the ByDesign system:-Pre-Requisites-You should have the PDF file-Goto Supplier Invoicing work center -> Common Tasks-> New Scanned Invoice/ New Scanned Credit Memo-OR-Goto Supplier Invoicing work center-> Invoice Entry-> New Scanned Invoice/Scanned Credit Memo-Select Scanned Invoice-> Add-> File-Browse for the PDF file and click ADD- Then select Extract Attachment Data so that all the fields are automatically filled in the invoice from PDF file.-Note-All the fields are editable when we upload scanned invoice in this manner-2.How to upload scanned invoice using Collaboration Tool?-Pre-Requisites-•You have activated the Automatic Upload Service in SAP Collaboration Window.-•You have defined the Observed folder for scanned invoices and credit memos.-•Your scanner software creates two files from a scanned document:-◦PDF file-◦TXT, RTF, or DOC file.-•Both files are named the same so that they are recognized as a pair-Steps:-Create a folder in your system-Place the PDF and Text file in the folder with the same name-Now, open the Collaboration tool and login-Flag the option Enable Service Scanned Invoices and uncheck Only Upload PDF files checkbox.-Browse for the relevant folder created-You can check whether the file is uploading in the below right corner of the screen-After upload is complete , right click on the upload symbol and check the log whether the upload was successful or not-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center and select the view Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for recently uploaded invoice by filtering with date or buying company etc-The supplier field and other fields will be empty-You can enter values as per your requirement-Note-Buying Company field will be no longer editable in this case.-Reference Help Documents:-Configuration: Supplier Invoice Scanning Keyword Settings-Create a Scanned Invoice or Credit Memo-Uploading Scanned Supplier Invoices Using Automatic Upload Service-Also refer the PDF attachment for more details.-You might see below options to upload the invoice using only PDF:-1.Through collaboration window->setting->invoice scanning->only upload PDF check mark-2.Manual invoice-> Add file -> extract attachment data-But at present, both of them are not supported.-See Also- Below is visible only to SAP employees-2876584 FAQs Regarding Scanned Invoice Upload-Keywords-extract attachment data, steps to upload scanned invoice,only upload PDF

Title: Higher Level Managers not Determined in the Supplier Invoice Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You have defined the work distribution rule as All Cost Center Approvers by Value Limit for the Supplier Invoice approval process, however system failed to determine the higher level managers based on cost centers.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Select Approval Process sub view.-Select Default Approval Process for Supplier Invoice.-Here you have defined the Work Distribution Rule as All Cost Center Approvers by Value Limit.-Now go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice & Post.-Invoice will go for an approval; however, it fails to determine the higher level managers based on cost centers.-Cause-In case of work distribution rule All Cost Center Approvers by Value Limit, Managers of all cost centers assigned to the supplier invoice have to approve. For managers for which the supplier invoice value exceeds the approval limit defined in employee work distribution, higher level managers are determined. Here system cannot find the higher level managers because the next level org unit is not a cost center. Hence system cannot find the manager for this unit.-Note: If there is no cost center assigned to the supplier invoice, the reporting line unit manager approves the invoice document.-Resolution-Based on business requirement, you can mark the org unit as a cost center & then system will determine the higher level cost centers with respective managers.

Title: Attachment In E-mail Rejected or removed due to SAP acceptable use policy
Content: Symptom-Attachments are rejected by Xpuregate, if sent by e-mail (both Inbound and Outbound) with reason: "550 REJECT dangerous.attachment".-OR-Email is received with the attachment name as "noname.txt" and content says "Attachment has been removed due to SAP acceptable use policy"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-E-mails with the following attachments are rejected and this change affects all users/domains:---ade, adp, app, asp, bas, bat, bhx, cab, ceo, chm, cmd, com, cpl, crt, csr, der, exe, fxp, hlp, hta, inf, ins,-isp, its, js, jse, lnk, mad, maf, mag, mam, mar, mas, mat, mde, mim, msc, msi, msp, mst, ole, pcd, pif, reg,-scr, sct, shb, shs, vb, vbe, vbmacros, vbs, vsw, wmd, wmz, ws, wsc, wsf, wsh, xxe, docm, xlsm-Note: This is true as well for certain archives: arj, cab, jar, lha, rar, tar, zip.-Resolution-Due to Malware threat, we cannot allow those extension files to keep in mail server. Recommendation is to avoid using mentioned file extensions.-Keywords-E-mail, Attachment, reject, remove, policy, acceptable

Title: Message: "Logistics area defined with exception usage Over The Counter Stock" triggered while confirming Pick Task.
Content: Symptom-We are trying to confirm a pick task PQR, but system is showing information message:-        Logistics area XYZ is not recommended; some constraints not met---->  Logistics area defined with exception usage Over The Counter Stock*PQR refers to Pick Task id, XYZ refers to Logistics Area id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant task PQR.-Select it and choose Confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen, enter Actual Quantity and then enter Source Logistics Area ID as XYZ. It shows information message:-      Logistics area XYZ is not recommended; some constraints not met;----> Logistics area defined with exception usage Over The Counter Stock-Cause-For pick task, the operation type is Pick. You have defined the logistics model for Standard Shipping for the relevant site.-In this model for operation type Pick  Source Logistics Use is defined as Storage.-However, in the Supply Chain and Design Master Data for logistics area XYZ, logistics usage is defined as Over The Counter Stock. Hence system gives this information message.-Resolution-You need to adapt the master data in case you intend to avoid the message.System is working as designed.-Keywords-Logistics area defined with exception usage Over The Counter Stock, Logistics area  is not recommended; some constraints not met

Title: In the Purchase Order, the Contract as a Source of Supply is not picked up Automatically
Content: Symptom-In the Purchase Order, the Contract as a Source of Supply is not picked up automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view. -Click in New button to create a Purchase Order for an item.-Navigate to Assign Source of Supply tab. -Here you can see the Contract as a Source of Supply is not picked up automatically. However there is a Contract item that is relevant, active and valid.-Cause-In case if there is minimum order quantity N maintained on the contract, the system works as follows.-Purchase Order item with quantity less than N it will not be assigned automatically; -Purchase order item with exactly equal to or more than the quantity N then the source of supply will be assigned automatically.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Contract; Source of Supply

Title: Using Migration of Purchase Orders, Not Able to Migrate Purchase Orders with Zero Price
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate purchase orders with Price as 0 (zero), error messages are triggered. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Search and open activity Migration of Purchase Orders.-Choose: Migrate purchase orders using the migration tool.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration file.-During the Simulation step, the error messages are triggered:-Price date and time missing-Document not submitted for approval; inconsistencies exist-Order not possible; entries missing or inconsistent-And warning message:-Price for item XYZ is more than n% lower than existing item XYZ in PO ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order ID; XYZ is the item number in Purchase order ABC).-Cause-Using the Migration tool, the user is able to upload only Purchase Orders with valid numeric price. It doesn't work for zero prices. -The error message received in the above steps cannot be avoided while migrating using the Migration tool.-Resolution-The user may import the Purchase Orders directly from predefined Microsoft Excel template and upload them to the system. Via Microsoft Excel the user should be able to upload the Orders with zero price. -Keywords-purchase order, purchase order migration, migration tool, zero price, price as zero, 0 price, price as 0, migrate po, po migration, Price date and time missing, document not submitted for approval, inconsistencies exist, Order not possible, entries missing or inconsistent,

Title: Error appears "No matching inventory items found" when trying to Scrap the Product
Content: Symptom-When we are trying to scrap product XYZ, an error message appears.*XYZ refers to Product id.-No matching inventory items found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View and select Scrapping subview.-Enter Site ID which is externally managed and Product ID details.-Choose Next using guided activity, system throws error message:  No matching inventory items found-The system displays the error message No Matching Inventory Items Found, even though stock is available for the product in stock overview.-Cause-The stock visible for the product in the stock overview screen is reserved for a warehouse order. Hence there is no free stock available for scrapping.-Resolution-We will be able to see the warehouse order for which the stock is reserved by making the warehouse order ID column visible in the stock overview screen via personalization option.The system is working as designed.-Keywords-No matching inventory items found, Scrapping, Stock Overview, Warehouse Order

Title: System  triggers an error message at the time of creation of New Identified Stock ID in production task.
Content: Symptom-When trying to create New Identified Stock ID during check task ID XYZ, system gives an error message.*XYZ refers to Check Task id-Entry in Identified Stock field is not valid; it does not match the Identified Stock in the assigned production lot.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Go to Task Control View.-Search for task ID XYZ.-Select on Confirm button.-In the new tab, Click on Finish Results Recording button.-Error message appears:  Entry in Identified Stock field is not valid; it does not match the Identified Stock in the assigned production lot.-Resolution-In order to create New Identified Stock in check task, kindly follow the steps below:- Go to Execution Work Center.- Go to Production Tasks View.- Search for Task ID XYZ and select it.- Select on Confirm button.- In the new tab, Select on You can Also and then, in New Identified Stock.- It will open a new window, where product data and product specification are automatically provided.- Enter the Identified Stock ID and description. Save it and then activate it.- After this, Select Save and Close button. This will take you back to confirm check task screen.- Now, open the value help for the Identified Stock ID, it will show you the newly created identified stock ID, which is linked with the product specification.-Keywords-System  triggers an error message at the time of creation of New Identified Stock ID in production task, Entry in Identified Stock field is not valid, it does not match the Identified Stock in the assigned production lot
