Title: Problem With Purchase Order Net Value
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:Duplicate of KBA 2828753 - Net Value is Incorrectly Calculated in Purchase Order-The Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ refers to purchase order ID) has the Net Value as 1.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders ﻿Work Center.-Select the Purchase Orders View.-Search for the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ refers to purchase order ID).-You can see that the Net Value is 1.-Cause-The Price Unit under Items Tab has wrong value maintained.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders ﻿Work Center.-Select the Purchase Orders View.-Search for the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ refers to purchase order ID).-Select Edit button.-Navigate to Prices Sub-Tab under Items Tab.-Change the Price Unit value to 1 and press enter.-Now you can see the correct calculation of the Net Value for the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ refers to purchase order ID).-Keywords-purchase order net value, problem with PO net value, net value

Title: Unable To Cancel the  Invoice That is Linked to Down Payment Invoice
Content: Symptom-Unable to Post cancellation invoice due to an Exception message Down payment XYZ already paid (XYZ refers to the down payment ID) -Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Search for the invoice XYZ(XYZ refers to the down payment ID).-Select Edit button and navigate to Exceptions Tab.-You see an exception message Down payment XYZ already paid. (XYZ refers to the down payment ID)-Cause-The Down Payment is already in Paid status. This means certain payment is already over and thus you need take action against the down payment  the invoice is linked with.-Resolution-There are 2 options that can be followed-Accept the exception for the Supplier Invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to the down payment ID) and Post the document.- OR- You can Reset the clearing of Downpayment so that you will not see the exception in Cancellation invoice .-Steps to be followed:-Go to Payables Work Center and select Supplier Accounts Sub-View.-Select All Documents and search for Supplier PQR (PQR refers to supplier ID) and select View.-Under Trade Payables Tab, navigate to Invoices/ Payment Sub-Tab.-Search for XYZ ﻿(XYZ refers to the down payment ID).-Select the Clearing ID present.-Select Reset Clearing.-Once you do either of the above steps, you will be able to post the Cancellation Invoice and also the Down payment will go back to Open status so that  it can be  utilized  for other invoices .-Keywords-Downpayment already paid , Cancellation invoice exception, Unable to post cancellation invoice,Downpayment paid

Title: Serial Numbers upload functionality not available for Third Party Delivery Notifications
Content: Symptom-Serial Numbers upload functionality is missing in Third Party Delivery Notifications.XYZ refers to Purchase Order id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Go to Third-Party Purchase Orders View.-In Find search for PO XYZ.-Select Go.-Select New Third-Party Delivery Notification.-Navigate to Line Items tab.-Navigate to sub tab Serial Numbers.-We observe Upload functionality missing in Serial Numbers for New Supplier Delivery Notification.-Resolution-The feature of uploading all serial numbers at one time in the serial numbers tab of new third party delivery notification is not available in the current release of the system.-This functionality will be available in 1708 release.-Keywords-Serial Numbers upload functionality not available for Third Party Delivery Notifications, Upload functionality missing in Serial Numbers for New Supplier Delivery Notification

Title: System Does Not Replicate Warranty Details From ERP to C4C Registered Product
Content: Symptom-You have replicated Registered Products along with Start and End Date (Warranty Details) from ERP to C4C but no warranty details are getting replicated.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Installed Base WorkCentre.-Go to Registered Products View.-Show All and find required ID, which are replicated from ECC to C4C.-Select and Open it.-Navigate to Overview, scroll down to section Warranty.-Here you can find that no details such as Start Date and End Date is replicated.- Interface Used :RegisteredProductReplicationInitiatedByExternalIn-Cause-The Warranty Start and End Date is calculated based on reference date of the registered product, (this becomes warranty start date) and the duration (Warranty End Date = Start date + Duration).-In the Standalone scenario of Registered Product you can maintain a warranty in C4C with details such as warranty duration etc. and this warranty can be used in a Registered Product .This warranty is then also considered in subsequent processes such as Service ticket.In this warranty Start/End Date is not editable.-In ERP integration scenario, it is possible to replicate the master warranty from ERP to C4C even though this ERP warranty does not exist in C4C. The reason you cannot see the warranty is because it is hidden field by default .In this scenario the warranty Start/End Date also is editable and come from ERP .This Warranty is not considered in Service Ticket because the corresponding warranty does not exists in C4C.-Resolution-In order to see Warranty Details replicated from ERP, follow below given steps :-Go to Installed Base WorkCentre.-Go to Registered Products View.-Show All and find required ID, which are replicated from ECC to C4C.-Select and Open it.-Navigate to Overview, scroll down to section Warranty.-Go to Personalize and make field External Warranty ID visible.-Perform Save.-Keywords-Not Replicate, Warranty Details, ERP to C4C, Registered Product

Title: Changed Purchase Order: Icon for new ite
Content: Symptom-Legend icon New Item not appearing in Purchase Order forms.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select required Purchase Order document and click Edit.-Select Output History tab and select the last sent Purchase Order PDF file-Open the Purchase Order PDF file, no New Item legend icon appears for the newly added line item-Cause-While adding the new line item, if the Purchase Order goes for re-approval, the system cannot compare the current image of Purchase Order (with newly added line item) with the previous image of the Purchase Order (without newly added line item). This is a technical system limitation and hence no legend icom for New Item appears against the newly added line added. This case is only valid if the Purchase Order goes for re-approval after addition of the new line item.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords

Title: The Scanned Supplier invoice is not created with Document type as Credit memo
Content: Symptom-Though a search term is maintained in Bussines configuration for credit memo and also the same search term is there in the text file still the invoice Document type is not Credit memo.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In general any special character except "(" and ")" is not allowed in the search terms-If maintained  it results in an invalid search pattern so by default the document type is set as Invoice.-Resolution-Please remove special character in all the search terms

Title: Error message: Conversion Rate is Missing for Other Currencies
Content: Symptom-You have set your Company Currency and Set of Books Currency as SEK. You have bank transactions to be done in USD, EUR, DKK, NOK, and GBP. The Exchange Rate Currency Conversion for the above currencies against SEK have been maintained.-You are created an Outgoing Bank Transfer in other currency DKK that is other than Company currency and the system throws an error message that Exchange Rate is missing for USD to DKK, EUR to DKK, NOK to DKK, GBP to DKK.-You want to know why is the error message shown despite maintaining the currency conversion between SEK to DKK.-Error Message: Conversion Rate missing for other Currencies(USD to DKK, EUR to DKK, NOK to DKK, GBP to DKK).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments and Find Payment XYZ.(Here XYZ is the Payment ID)-Open the document ID XYZ.-Click Check.-Error message is shown:-Conversion Rate missing for other Currencies-Cause-You are posting the transactions in different currency other than Company Currency.-Resolution-System works as designed. You have to maintain the Exchange Rate Currency Conversions between all the currencies maintained for banks and the currency in which the transaction takes place.-Keywords-Currencies, Conversion Rate missing, Exchange rates

Title: The Field Party cannot be added to the Advanced Search in  My Opportunities
Content: Symptom-When using the filter My Opportunities, the field ﻿Party﻿ cannot be added to the advanced search via ﻿Edit Master Layout-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales WoC.-Go to Opportunities view.-Search via My Opportunities.-Go the the Advanced Search.-Go into Edit Master Layout.-The field Party cannot be added as a searchable field.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour.-Resolution-The Party will be automatically pulled from the user that is logged in. Hence the parameter Party is only available for search in All Opportunities.

Title: Which User can Post a Supplier Invoice?
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Supplier Invoice but the system blocks the posting. The Supplier invoice stays in Ready for Posting status and you get the error message: The document was saved with the status Ready for Posting. Only accountants responsible (such as [User ID] ([User name])) can post the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work centre.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice ID)-Select Edit.-Select Post.-You get the message: The document was saved with the status Ready for Posting. Only accountants responsible (such as [User ID] ([User name])) can post the document.-Cause-Your user is not part of the invoicing unit involved in this Supplier Invoice.-The invoicing unit is a functional unit that is responsible for invoice verification. It is stored in the invoicing document for authorization purposes. The determination can be configured by the customer depending on the basis of buyers and suppliers. Except for global worklist, it is a mandatory party that is determined by the system and is not allowed to be changed by the user.-The employee responsible is an employee belonging to/being manager or working for the invoicing unit who is responsible for the invoicing documents and is allowed to post it . He is a mandatory party that is determined by the system and is not allowed to be changed by the user.-Resolution-Who is allowed to post Supplier invoices?-In order to be allowed to post Supplier Invoices, the current user is checked to see if it matches one of the following criteria :-The user is default for the current invoicing unit;-The user is an employee of the invoicing unit;-The user is a manager of the invoicing unit;-The user is an additional accountant of the invoicing unit.-If one of the criteria matches, the user is allowed to post invoices.-If none of the criteria match, the employee responsible is set to:-The default user of the invoicing unit in Organisational Management work centre, Employee Work Distribution view; or-The first employee of the invoicing unit; or-The first additional accountant of the invoicing unit; or-The manager of the invoicing unit.-See Also-See also SCN blog https://blogs.sap.com/2017/01/19/what-is-the-supplier-invoicing-unit-and-who-is-the-employee-responsible/-Keywords-Unbale to post invoice, invoice in status ready for Posting-how is employee responsible determined

Title: Pro-Forma Invoice Split based on an Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-When a pro-forma invoice is created, based on an outbound delivery the pro-forma invoice is split, based on the split criteria for the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Select outbound delivery XYZ(XYZ represents the ID of the outbound delivery).-Click on the Pro-Forma Invoice button.-You notice that the pro-forma invoice is split.-Cause-The issue occurs due to the difference in the Ship-To addresses maintained for the various line items.-The user changed the Ship-To address for some items and not for others. Therefore, the new Ship-To address is reflected for these line items. Whereas, for the remaining unchanged line items, the original Ship-To address remains. Since the Ship-To party is a split criteria the split occurs.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-"Pro-Forma Invoice", "Outbound Delivery"

Title: Suppression of error messages raised while Supplier invoice creation via ABSL scripting
Content: Symptom-How to suppress few errors that araise while document is created via ABSL scripting like given below-Error message:Item missing-but item gets created in later steps-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-We recommend you to use the A2X approach,-Go to Application user management work center-Navigate to :Service explorer and search for "ManageSupplierInvoiceIn"-Click on the documentation "Link" for more details--Steps required in PDI are given below:--1) Create an External Web Service Integration in PDI Add-On for SIV A2X create Service( refer to help document in ByD Studio on how to create the same ) . Please make sure the communication scenario with the communication arrangements are correctly created.----2) Write an ABSL script similar to below to trigger the Invoice creation with reference to a Purchase Order Item using SIV A2X.----import ABSL;--import AP.SupplierInvoicing.Global ;--var request: Library::SIV.MaintainBundle.Request;--var header: Library::SIV.MaintainBundle.Request.SupplierInvoiceBundleMa intainRequest_sync.SupplierInvoice;--var item :Library::SIV.MaintainBundle.Request.SupplierInvoiceBundleMaint ainRequest_sync.SupplierInvoice.Item;--header.BuyerParty.PartyKey.PartyID.content = "MC10000";--header.SellerParty.PartyKey.PartyID.content ="MC2000";--header.BusinessTransactionDocumentTypeCode.content = "004" ;--//header.Date = "2016-10-26" ;----item.BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode = "002" ;--item.PurchaseOrderReference.BusinessTransactionDocumentReference.ID.cont ent = "50";--item.PurchaseOrderReference.BusinessTransactionDocumentReference.TypeCod e.content = "001";--item.PurchaseOrderReference.BusinessTransactionDocumentReference.ItemID = "1" ;--header.Item.Add(item);--request.SupplierInvoiceBundleMaintainRequest_sync.SupplierInvoice.Add(he ader);--var response = Library::SIV.MaintainBundle(request, " ", "SIV_COMM");

Title: Guidelines For The Creation Of The Automatic Generation Of Project Invoice Request Itemized list PDF.
Content: Symptom-Guidelines for the creation of the automatic generation of project invoice request itemized list PDF.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Below are the guidelines for the creation of the automatic itemized list PDF.--Part A: Scoping required in Business Configuration work center.--Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Choose the required Project.-Click on Edit Project Scope tab.-Go to the Questions tab.-Go to the Sales Scoping Element and choose Customer Invoicing.-Select the option Communication for Customer Invoicing.-Select the Yes for the question Do you want to automatically generate the itemized list as a PDF document for a project invoice Request.-Part B: Steps to be performed in Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view.-Go to the Sales Orders subview.-Select the relevant sales order.-Select the New button and choose Manual Project Invoice Request.-While creating a manual project invoice you must reach to Step 5 where you can choose the button Itemized List as New PDF or New CSV.-Note: Before doing the above step, you should have assigned expenses to the invoice items as the itemized list is for assigned expenses.-- -Part C: Methods of re-ordering the fields that are displayed in the itemized list.--There are three ways of re-ordering the fields that are displayed in the itemized list, they are;-A: You can order the way the columns are displayed in the itemized list PDF by doing the following.-Go to the Application and Management work center.-Then go to the Business Flexibility view.-Select Form Template Maintenance sub view.-Select All Forms and choose Go button.-Select Itemized list for Expenses.-Choose Open and select Easy form editor.-Here the position of the column can be changed--B: If you require the grouping of data for Itemized list PDF, you can group it by doing the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-In Show choose Activities and find Grouping of Itemized List for Project Invoice Request.-Open the activity, here the expenses can be grouped.--Note: To use this option you need to have the itemized list scoped.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request; Itemized List; Business Configuration

Title: Error Message : XYZ must be assigned to logistics area with default supply and output area
Content: Symptom-When you assign Logistics Area to a Resource ID directly, system throws an error 'XYZ must be assigned to logistics area with default supply and output area'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to the Resources View.-Show All Resources By Selection using drop down and find required Resource ID.-Choose Go.-Select and Edit the Resource ID.-Under the General tab, go to the section: Resource Location Data.-In the field Logistics Area, enter the required ID as ABC using value selection, then the system would throw above error messsage.-Cause-Fixed Supply Area and Fixed Output Area are must be maintained during assign any Logistics Area to a Resource. The error occurs as expected.-Resolution-You have to assign Fixed Supply Area and Fixed Output Area to a Logistics Area under Site Layout, please follow below steps to do that.-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to the Locations View.-In the field Show, choose All Locations using drop-down and find required Site ID.-Select and Edit it, choose Edit Layout.-Find required Logistics Area ID: ABC from hierarchy.-Select and navigate to the Resources tab.-Here maintain Fixed Supply Area and Fixed Output Area.-Perform Save.-Now you can assign this Logistics Area: ABC to a Resource ID : XYZ directly.-Keywords-Must be Assigned to Logistics Area with Default Supply and Output Area, Resource, Location, Logistics Area, Fixed Supply Area, Fixed Output Area

Title: Few Purchase requests are excluded in the Bundling Run
Content: Symptom-After you Schedule a Purchase request Bundling Run, you would notice that it did not pick few Purchase requests-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-All PR's that has Account assignment as Service order are excluded by default while bundling of PR's through Run.-Resolution-We request you to manually bundle and order or Define Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders for all such Purchase categories used in PR’s--We have discussed with our developers and they informed that in one of the future release they will remove the restriction "Excluding: Equal to 117 - Service Order"--However we request you to submit an idea via Customer influence Forum:-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2f527e24f2bd44e09a4a96e660143526.html

Title: Error: XXX is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value
Content: Symptom-When you search for GL Account while creating Supplier invoice you will receive below error-G/L account XXX cannot be selected in Supplier Invoices-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work center-Go to Invoices and Credit memos view-Search for relevant Supplier invoice-Click Edit and then click on View All-Go to Items tab and then Navigate to Cost Distribution sub tab-For G/L Account click on the arrow to open drop down window-Search for GL account XXX-Account XXX is not on the list-Manually Enter XXX into the GL Account filed and choose ACC for Account Assignment Type-Cause-Account Determination Group for General Expenses is not maintained for XXX-Resolution-Go to Business configuration work center-Navigate to Overview-Now search for activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Go to Account determination and select the Costs-Navigate to General expenses Tab-Click on add row and add the XXX under column Account Determination Group for General Expense and column General expense and save -Keywords-G/L account error in supplier invoice,G/L account cannot be selected in Supplier Invoices

Title: Error Message: "Service Call Failed; Report an Incident", While Migrating Projects
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Projects, system throws below error message:-Service call failed; report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view or Overview view. -Search and Open the activity Migration of Projects.-Choose Migrate projects using the migration tool.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File.-You receive an error message during the Simulation step:-Service call failed; report an incident.-Cause-The system is facing a very high memory consumption while migrating the Project from a template due to high number of Information Messages that is raised.-Resolution-To avoid the error, please change the following in the given Project data, so that the migration can work even for a big Project.-1) Change the Project Task descriptions to text with a maximum length of 40 characters. This will avoid the Information Message which informs about the truncation of the text.-2) Please check the Duration given in the Task details. It does not match with the given date so that the Duration will be adopted during migration. This causes also, always an Information Message as the Duration will be adopted according to the given dates. Leave the Duration empty for each Project Task and let the system calculate it automatically.-3) In the tab Task Details, check how many project tasks are being maintained. Please try to not maintain more than 200 records. More than this and they system may not work reliably.-We are working on improvements to avoid this high memory consumption during Migration.-Keywords-Project; Migration Tool; Service Call; Duration; Task; Memory

Title: System crashes when you put the Project Task in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you try to put the Project Task in the Supplier Invoice XXX, the system crashes: -Unexpected error during backend processing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing-Select Invoices and Credit Memos-Seach for the Invoice XXX-Open the Invoice XXX-Select View All-Go to Items-Select the Line Item-Choose Cost Distribution -Fill the Project Task field-Press Enter-System throws the message: - Unexpected error during backend processing-Cause-The dump occurs because the Tax Code is missing for Withholding Tax Item. You should maintain the Withholding Tax Classifications for the Country of the Supplier.-Resolution-Go to Supplier Base-Select Suppliers-Select the Supplier of the Invoice XXX-Open the Supplier-Select View All-Go to Financial Data tab-Select Tax Data subtab-Under Withholding Tax Classifications, select Add Row-Select the Country of the Supplier, the Tax Type and the Tax Rate Type-Add another row if you want more than one Tax Type-Select Save

Title: Cannot Reschedule the Recurrence of WIP Clearing Runs
Content: Symptom-Unable to reschedule the recurrence of WIP Clearing Runs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Navigate to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to WIP clearing sub-view.-Select WIP Clearing run ID which is in Scheduled status and click on View Jobs.-Click Reschedule tab and select Recurrence radio button.-Notice that there is no option to select Daily in the dropdown list to reschedule the job for recurrence.-Cause-The reason is that WIP Clearing Run does not support recurrence pattern in Business ByDesign.-Reschedule the WIP Clearing run once for future date and it can be execute once.-Resolution-System works as designed.-The WIP Clearing Run can be rescheduled to future date and time, but cannot be rescheduled for recurrence.-Remarks:-As an alternative, use the standard web service Work In Process Clearing Run Create (Service Name: AccountingWIPClearingRun), available in Application and User Management - Service Explorer work center view. -The PSM Release of WIP Clearing Run BO (FIA_WIP_CLEARING_RUN) is not possible.-See Also-Inbound Service Work In Process Clearing Run Create-Solved: WIP clearing run -Automation - SAP Community-Keywords-Wip clearing; recurrence; MDRO; Work In Process Clearing Run Create; AccountingWIPClearingRun

Title: Wrong language on employee’s title in Purchase Order preview
Content: Symptom-When you preview the Purchase Order XXX, the name of the recipient appears with wrong language title.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders-Select Purchase Orders-Search for the Purchase Order XXX-Edit the Purchase Order XXX-Go to Preview-Select Changed PO-See the title language of the recipient is different than the other Delivery Information-Cause-User has logged in in title language and created shopping cart for the Purchase Order. Once the user created shopping cart, he manually changed the value. This value is the filled in Purchase Order.-Resolution-You can change the title manually following the steps below: -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders-Select Purchase Orders-Select the Purchase Order XXX-Open the Purchase Order XXX-Select View All-Go to Items tab-Select a Line Item-Go to Delivery sub-tab-Edit the field which is the name of the recipient under Delivery Address section-Click on Save

Title: The Invoice Expected field is Automatically Flagged/Unflagged in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The Invoice Expected field is automatically flagged/Unflagged when you are creating a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select New Purchase Order under Common Tasks-Enter mandatory fields like Company,Supplier,Product details-The Invoice Expected field is flagged/Unflagged by default.-Cause-You have scoped Invoice Expected in Business Configuration under Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings.-Resolution-You have to Uncheck/Check the Invoice Expected checkbox for the relevant Item Types and Process Types in Business Configuration as per your requirement.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Overview->Show Activities-Select Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings-Select Change Immediately-Uncheck/check the Invoice Expected checkbox for the relevant Item Types and Process Types as per your requirement-Select save and close.- Note:This settings are not applicable if you are creating Purchase orders through Excel upload or Webservice(A2X).-  Keywords-Invoice Expected, Purchase Order Item Follow Up, Invoice Expected Flag

Title: Customer Demand cannot be released: It is not possible to release Sales Order XXX item YY. Stock is not available for some items in the delivery group
Content: Symptom-When trying to Release Customer Demand ABC (ABC means Customer Demand ID) with available stock, the system throws the message below.-"It is not possible to release Sales Order XXX item YY. Stock is not available for some items in the delivery group" (XXX means Sales Order ID) and (YY means item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Customer Demand view.-Search for the Customer Demand ABC.-Select the item YY.-Select Release.-Select With Stock Check.-System throws the message:- "It is not possible to release Sales Order XXX item YY. Stock is not available for some items in the delivery group"-Cause-The product for the item YY has been maintained with the Availability Check Scope as Stock and released receipts in horizon for the Planning Area. Hence at the time of ATP confirmation, ATP considers stock + released receipts (this is the reason why there is the available stock).-Although when it is trying to Release the Customer Demand ABC With Stock Check, ATP checks if the quantity can be fulfilled against the actual stock availability in inventory (it does not consider released receipts). And since the released receipts stock has not yet come into the inventory, the demand cannot be fulfilled.-Resolution-The message is a warning message, so the Customer Demand can be released.  -Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Customer Demand view.-Search for the Customer Demand ABC.-Select the item YY.-Select Release.-Select Without Stock Check.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Sales Order, Delivery group, ATP.

Title: The Incurred Cost is Empty in the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Report
Content: Symptom-In the report Project Cost and Revenue by Project (Technical ID: FINCACU04_Q0003, Data source: FINCACU04 - Project Cost and Revenue - Aggregated), the field Incurred Cost is empty for one project despite the Time Recordings done.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management workcenter.-Go to Reports - List view.-Open the report Project Cost and Revenue by Project.-Remove data from the fields Project status and Project Type.-Change data in the field Accounting period to match the targeted period.-Enter Project ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID)-Select Go.-The field Period Incurred Cost or Total planned cost is empty-Cause-This issue is caused by the Unposted source documents for the related Time Confirmations attached to the Project.-Resolution-To solve this issue, the Time Confirmations must be posted in Accounting.-Go to General Ledger workcenter.-Go to Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source documents.-Open the Advanced Search tool.-In the field Related Source Document Type, select 170 - Employee Time Calendar.-Select Go.-All the Time Confirmations entered on Project XYZ appear here.-Check the error message in the Details and solve the issue to post the Source Document.-Once the document has been posted, the field  Incurred Cost will be filled.-Keywords-Project Cost and Revenue by Project; Incurred Cost; Report

Title: Error: 'Conversion of UoM no allowed for product DEF' during MDR run.
Content: Symptom-The Error Message 'Conversion of UoM no allowed for product DEF' (DEF represents the Product ID) appears during MDR run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Automated Actions View.-In Show, select Active Mass Replenishment Runs.-Select Application Log ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Application Log ID).-Go to Results tab.-In Description, expand Inventory Level Adjustment Run ID PQR (PQR represents the Inventory Level Adjustment Run ID), Logistic Area ID DEF (DEF represents the Logistic Area ID).-Expand Work package 1: Finished; messages raised.-Expand Messages.-You can see the Error Message: Conversion of UoM no allowed for Product DEF.-Cause-You have not maintained the Conversion Rules for the Product DEF. You have also maintained the Base UoM as XX (XX represents the ID of the Base UoM) and in the Replenishment/Removal Rule the UoM is maintained as YY (YY represent the UoM ID).-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, kindly maintain the Conversion Rules from XX to YY.-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center.-Go to By Materials View.-In Show: Select All Materials and Search for Product DEF.-Select Go.-Select Edit.-Select  View All.-Navigate to General tab.-Here you can maintain the Conversion Rules. -Save the changes.-Now you should be able to run the Inventory Adjustment Runs without errors.-Keywords-Active Mass Replenishment Runs, Inventory Level Adjustment Run, Replenishment, Removal, Conversion of UoM no allowed for product DEF

Title: Solve Configuration Issue in ID Mapping for Element InternalID with ID ABC
Content: Symptom-You got the error in web service message monotoring, Solve Configuration Issue in ID Mapping for Element InternalID with ID ABC with service interface BusinessPartnerERPAddressReplicationIn.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Web Service Message Monotoring.-Open the releveant XML message.-You got the error, Solve Configuration Issue in ID Mapping for Element InternalID with ID ABC  -Cause-You have not created an account with external id ABC but you are trying to create an address for that account which was not created yet.-Resolution-You must follow the sequence of below message types for integration:-1. DEBMAS (BusinessPartnerERPReplicationIn)-2. ADRMAS (BusinessPartnerERPAddressReplicationIn)-3. ADR3MAS (BusinessPartnerERPContactAddressReplicationIn)--Find attached file with the sequence in which you should perform the initial load (items 2a, 2b and 2c).--So basically you cannot replicate “Business Partner Address” before making sure the “Business Partner” itself is successful replicated.--This will make sure that all data you send from OnPremise system is processed successfully in C4C. To ensure this, if you are running a background job from OnPremise system then always run the job in this order sequence.--- You can set Collect IDOC's for the corresponding scenario.-- Then you need to setup the background job, where you can setup the correct sequence.-- Then DEBMAS must always be sent before the Address IDocs (ADRMAS).

Title: Error Message: Inventory cost cannot be maintained for future periods
Content: Symptom-You see that there exists inventory cost rates with a future start date in the material master data, however you are no able to manually create future dated entries due to error message.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center-Go to Materials view-Edit the relevant material-Go to the Valuation tab-Edit cost and make it valid from a future date for the current entries.-You'll see an error as follows: Inventory cost cannot be maintained for future periods-Cause-You were able to maintain the future valuation because it was migrated while not active in the system. For active materials, it is not allowed to change valuation in future periods as this would affect postings in the system.-It is recommended not to maintain future dates while migrating inactive materials (valuation in process) as it cannot be changed in the UI (User interface).-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.

Title: Self Approval for Project time entries not working.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason: The details in this KBA are wrong ,the correct details are appearing in below two KBAs- 2409103 - Project Time Recordings Submitted by Project Manager are not Going for Approval -1961411 - How To Remove Auto Approval of Project Time and Expenses Created by Project Manager-Times entered by Project Manager skip approval even with Self Approval De-scoped. You expect the approval task to be assigned to a different user.-Cause-The project manager is probably the only team member. Therefore, the system does not find anyone else to be the substitute to approve the project manager's entries, resulting in automatic self approval.-Resolution-Add someone else that you want to be the approver for the manager's hours to the team and also mark them as the Substitute for Project Responsible. Then the system will find the substitute and assign to them the approval task.

Title: You are unable to attach files to a Production Order.
Content: Symptom-There is no option to add attachments directly to a Production Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work center.-Go to Production Orders View.-Search for the relevant Production Order ID.-Choose Edit.-Open Attachments sub-tab under Miscellaneous Tab.-There is no option or button to add Attachments.-Cause-Attachments cannot be added directly in the Production Order, as the attachment section displays only the attachments maintained in the corresponding Production Model.-This is standard system behavior.-Resolution-Maintain the attachment in the corresponding Production Model to make it available in the newly created Production Order.-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Models view.-Search for the relevant Production Model.-Choose Edit.-Open Attachments Sub tab under General tab.-Choose Browse and Add the Attachment from the Local Device.-Choose Save.-Choose Release Production Model and select For Planning and Execution.-Once the Attachment is added into the Production Model, it is included in the newly created Production Order. -Keywords-Production Order; Production Model; Attachment; Add Attachment; Production Request; Unable To Add Attachment In Production Order; How To Add Attachments To Production Order

Title: Error Message: Postal code must have the length
Content: Symptom-Cannot create Project Invoice Requests for a Project with Sales order created against the Account of respective Country cause an error message occurs regarding the Postal code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work center-Go to Projects view-Find relevant Project-Choose the Icon next to Project number and select Create Manual Project Invoice Request-Press Next until you get to step 3 Define Invoice Items-In the Items tab, select Add Row-     You will get the above error.-Cause-Recently you have changed the postal code in the Account address, however, all those sales orders created prior to the change, has old postal code and now when you create Project invoice request for that sales order system thorws this error due to postal code mismatch.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to post the project invoice requests for affected sales orders:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview-Search for the configuration element Countries-Select it and Click on Open button-Click on Edit Countries-Filter for the relevant country-Go to Postal Attributes tab-Remove the flag for Street Address Postal Code Required-Click Save and close-Then, finish all affected project invoice requests and set back the Business configuration setting-by setting the flag again.-Keywords-Postal code must have the length

Title: Project Time Recordings Submitted by Project Manager are not Going for Approval
Content: Symptom-Any time recordings submitted by a person is restricted to self-approve and so is sent for approval of project manager, however when Project Manager himself is doing time recordings it does not go for approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Go to step Questions.-Navigate to Human Resources element and expand it.-Go to Time and Labor Management element and expand it.-Select Approvals element and go to Questions appearing towards your right.-You will see the below question is already checked:-Would you like to restrict users from self-approval of time recordings in the solution? *-Cause-The above scoping question holds good for all users except the Project manager of their project.-Resolution-There is a backend business configuration option that allows project time recording to be sent to the line manager for approval, even when the project manager does time recording for their own project. Currently, we only have the option to send it to the Reporting line unit manager. Please check in Business Configuration - Implementation Projects - Step 4, Questions to see if the option is already available. Click on Human Resources - Time and Labor Management - Approval and search for the question "Would you like to prevent automatic approval of project/task manager’s time recordings on their projects/tasks, and set their RLU manager as approver?" under Group: Self Approval for Time Recordings.-If the scoping question is not available, please forward the incident to us.-Keywords-self-approval; time recording; project manager; line manager; Project Time Recordings Submitted by Project Manager are not Going for Approval

Title: You cannot sort Tasks by a specific column
Content: Symptom-You are trying to sort Tasks by a specific column, but nothing happens.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Delivery-Select Task Control-Try to sort by the specific column-Nothing happens-Cause-The column which you are sorting by is a field with free text. It is the standard system behavior to not sort by fields of this type.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.

Title: The Report Project Variance by Project Structure Doesn't Show Any Data
Content: Symptom-The report Project Variance by Project Structure is not showing any data in a certain Project Baseline, but with other baseline the report show the data correctly.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Reports View > List Subview. -Search for report Project Variance by Project Structure.-Click the report name.-Fill all mandatory fields and enter a Baseline.-Press Go button.-The system throws the message No report data available to display; check the selection.-Cause-The report is not showing any data because the Project Baseline used is Obsolete in the system. Only one baseline can be active for a project. Once activated a baseline, the previous one automatically goes obsolete. Hence, this report will have no data to show anymore.-Resolution- Go to the Project Management Work Center-Change Management view > Baselines subview-Search for the Project and check if the baseline is active as the report only shows data for active baselines:-If it is not: you must use the active baseline for that project, since it is not possible to reactivate a baseline once it was set to Obsolete.-If it is Active, open an case for SAP Cloud Support.

Title: Journal Entry Posting for Supplier Invoice Linked to an Individual Material is Going to Unexpected G/L Account
Content: Symptom-A Supplier Invoice was created with a Product Category maintained for the Line Item and an already existing Individual Material in the Cost Distribution tab. However, Journal Entry posting went to a different G/L Account than the one maintained on activity Fixed Asset Classes for Product Category in the Business Configuration Work Center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Search and open Supplier Invoice ABC.-Go to Document Flow tab and click the Journal Entry.-System posted the document to an unexpected G/L Account.-Cause-In this case, system does not take into account the Product Category of the Line Item. Since the Line Item has the Cost Distribution as an existing Individual Material, system will always take the Product Category of Individual Material.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.

Title: Duration of Automatically Created Intercompany Project
Content: Symptom-The Intercompany Project ABC (ABC refers to ID of the project) has the duration defaulted to 1 Day.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Select Sales Order View.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ(XYZ refers to the sales order ID) that was created automatically from the intercompany relevant Purchase Order.-Select View All button.-Navigate to Document Flow.-Select the hyperlink of the Intercompany Project.-Navigate to the Intercompany Project ABC(ABC refers to ID of the project).-Go to Basic Data tab you can see the Duration is defaulted to 1 day.-Navigate to Scheduling tab you can see the Start Date and End Date being same.-Cause-As a standard system behaviour, When an intercompany project is automatically created, the system will automatically set its duration to one day and its start and finish dates to be the same.-However, you can overwrite the duration under Project Plan Tab.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-intercompany project duration, intercompany project, duration, project created automatically

Title: User is able to Modify Product Categories Although User has no Access Rights
Content: Symptom-An user is able to modify Product Categories although doesn't have write permission to Product Categories.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Products workcenter-2. Select Product Categories view-3. Find: Edit Product Categories: Standard Hierarchy-4. Click: Maintain Product Categories-5. User is able to tick/untick although he doesn't have write access-Steps to check the access restrictions-1. Go to Application and User Management workcenter-2. Select BUSINESS USERS view-3. Find the relevant business user-4. Click: Edit - Access Right - Acces Restrictions-5. Find: PMM_PRODUCTCATEGORIES-6. Write Access: No Access- Cause-The relevant Business User has access rights to Workcenter: Administrator--> View: General Settings.-This view requires read-write access to, among other things, Product Categories.-Resolution-Revoke the user access rights to Administrator->General Settings-1. Go to Application and User Management workcenter-2. Select BUSINESS USERS view-3. Find the relevant Business User-4. Click: Edit - Access Right - Work Center View-5. Find: SEOD_ADMIN_SETUP_WCVIEW-6. Uncheck the box Assigned User-

Title: When Invocing an Invoice Request, Tax Code is Not Editable if Down Payment is Assigned
Content: Symptom-You are going to invoicing an invoice request and would like to change the Tax Code for some items. You find the Tax Code is not editable. However, in most cases, it is possible to change the Tax Code when invoicing.-You want to know the reason why the tax code is not editable when invoicing an invoice request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select an invoice request and click Invoice button.-In the New Invoice screen, go to the Items tab.-Select one item line and go to Taxes sub tab, you find the Tax Code field is grayed out. However, you are able to change the tax code when invoicing some other invoice requests.-Cause-When there is a down payment that assigned to the invoice, it is not possible to change the tax information any more.-To check if there is a down payment assigned to the invoice, you can follow the steps below:-In the new invoice screen, go to Pricing tab.-In the Payment Details section, you can see the downpayment information if any.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior as designed.-Keywords-Invoice; Invoice Request; Payment; Pricing; Down Payment; Tax Code; Read only; Greyed Out; Grayed Out; not editable;

Title: Unable to create a Warehouse Request from Delivery Proposal XXX
Content: Symptom-The Supplier Return YYY is with Reason for Rejection and status Finished.-So you create another Supplier Return for the same Purchase Order and you are unable to create a Warehouse Request from the Delivery Proposal XXX. When you try to create a Warehouse Request for a Delivery Proposal XXX and the errors appear: -Return quantity exceeds delivered quantity by ABC kg-Return quantity exceeds delivered quantity by DEF kg-Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions-Forwarded quantity above tolerance-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics-Select Delivery Proposals-Search the Delivery Proposal XXX and select it-Click on Create Warehouse Request-Receive errors:-Return quantity exceeds delivered quantity by ABC kg-Return quantity exceeds delivered quantity by DEF kg-Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions-Forwarded quantity above tolerance-Cause-The Supplier Return YYY with Reason for Rejection is not canceled, although it is Finished.-Resolution-Undo Release the Outbound Delivery for the Return YYY, Adjustment Confirmation and cancel the Outbound Delivery. So the Supplier Return YYY  will be canceled and you will be able to create the Warehouse Request from the Delivery Proposal XXX.

Title: System throws error message: Invoice may be a duplicate of invoice XYZ when trying to post the Supplier Invoice.
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a Supplier Invoice. System throws error message when trying to post the document:-'Invoice may be a duplicate of invoice XYZ'-XYZ means the supplier invoice ID.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search and open the affected Supplier Invoice.-Click View All and go to Exceptions tab.-You will see the error message: 'Invoice may be a duplicate of invoice XYZ'.-Cause-The affected Supplier Invoice is unable to be forwarded due to this other document is exactly the same.-Therefore, system considers them the same and will not allow you to post it.-Resolution-To make the system understand that this is a new invoice document, please follow the steps below:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search and open the affected Supplier Invoice.-Click View All and go to Exceptions tab.-You will see the error message: 'Invoice may be a duplicate of invoice XYZ'.-Then click the button Treat as a New Document.-This would clarify the Exception and then you should be able to post the document.-Keywords- supplier invoice; siv; duplicate; new document; exception

Title: System crashes when trying to Add Multiple Logistics Areas to a Location XXX
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Add Multiple Logistics Areas to a Location XXX and the system crashes with the message below:- Unexpected error during backend processing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data-Select Locations-Search for the Location XXX-Edit the Location XXX-Select Edit Layout-Select a Logistics Area-Select Add Multiple Logistics Areas-Fill the fields-Choose Ok-System crashes showing the message:-Unexpected error during backend processing-Cause-The error occurs because there is too many Logistics Areas being added to the Location at the same time, on the fields From Logistics Area ID and To Logistics Area ID after choosing Add Multiple Logistics Areas.-Resolution-You can add theses Logistics Areas in batches instead of adding all at the same time. For example, add the Logistics Areas 1 to 100, then 101 to 200 and so on.

Title: An Error Occurs When Trying to Preview an Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You are trying to preview the Outbound Delivery XXX, however you are getting an unexpected error.-XXX = Outbound Delivery ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the Outbound Delivery XXX.-Select the Outbound Delivery XXX.-Choose Preview.-Select Preview.-You face the dump:-An error occurred-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case.-Cause-The Outbound Delivery XXX has never been Released and it is Canceled, hence there is no delivered quantity. The dump is raised as there is no material quantity to prepare the output data.-Resolution-Currently ByDesign does not have an error message for this case, hence the dump is the expected behavior from the system.-Keywords-Crash ; 500 SAP Internal Server Error ; Dump ; Cancelled

Title: Error: "Location XYZ already exists" when you are trying to create a New Location for Site.
Content: Symptom-When we are trying to create a New Location XYZ for Site KLM. System triggers error message as below.*XYZ refers ro Location id , KLM refers to Site id, PQR refers to Site id-- Location XYZ already exists.-- Save failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Go to Locations View.-Choose Site KLM and Select New Location.-Fill in all mandatory fields like Location ID, Location Name , Country etc-Select Save.-- Location XYZ already exists.-- Save failed.-Cause-As a Location XYZ already exists for Site PQR, System does not allow us to create another location with the same ID XYZ even if we are trying to create for different Site KLM.-Resolution-We need to maintain a unique Location ID.-Keywords-Location already exists, Save failed, when trying to create a New Location for Site.

Title: Unable to delete Location.
Content: Symptom-You have the following problem in the following two scenarios-You cannot delete an active location as the delete button is disabled.-An error ‘Update not possible; location already referenced as site’ occurs while setting status to Obsolete for an active location.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to the Locations View.-Select the active location as you wish, then you notice that the delete button is grayed out.-Choose Edit.-Choose Change Status - Set to Obsolete, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-These are the standard behaviors as designed. -A location can only be deleted when it is in the "In preparation" status.-When the Org. structure/unit is activated, the system generates the relevant location and establishes the connection between the business residence and the location, which cannot be obsoleted.-Resolution-It is not possible to delete or set the location to obsolete. The only solution is to block this location.-[Note] Ensure that all the related logistics tasks are completed before blocking the location.-See Also-SAP Community Q&A: Cannot set Location to Obsolete after having logistics areas-Keywords-Location, Site, Planning Area, Delete, Obsolete, Block, Business Residence, Update not possible; location already referenced as site.

Title: System Populates Default Payment Reference Type in Supplier Invoice.
Content: Symptom-System populates Default Payment Reference Type in Supplier Invoice for Countries - Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands or Switzerland.-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Select the Common Tasks New Supplier Invoice.-Under the General Tab the field Payment Reference Type is already filled with the default option.-Cause-Payment Reference Type option allows to create and receive payment reference details from suppliers and pay using the relevant coutry-speciifc payment process.--This option is automaticlly included in scoping if customer has selected following countries - Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands or Switzerland.-Resolution-If you prefer not to have the payment reference type value to be defaulted to for example: acceptgiro - netherlands when any Supplier/Company, who is in Netherlands is selected during Invoicing, it is necessary to descope the following question:--Do you use payments with reference for payables?--By doing so, the Payment Reference Type field will not be visible while creating a new Supplier Invoice.--Steps to descope the question:-Go To Business Configuration Work Center.-Go To Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project -> Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Questions.-Select the Scoping element - Cash Flow Management.-Select Payables and Receivables Processing.-Further Select Payments and Clearing.-On the right side questions tab, descope the question 'Do you use payments with reference for payables?'.

Title: First Article Inspection Use Case.
Content: Symptom-How to set up First Article Inspection Plan to automatically create an inspection for a product Productxyz or category the first time it is received from a Supplier.-Reproducing the Issue-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It is not possible to trigger First Article Inspection automatically for a product or category the first time it is received from a supplier.-In case of Planned Inspections where Inspection is fetched automatically on Receive of Goods via supplier, system shall always create Receiving Inspection – Supplier Delivery.-Resolution-As per the current behavior of system, you can create Receiving Inspection - First Article only via Adhoc/Unplanned inspections.-You will have to manually create Inspection in such cases if you wish to go with Receiving Inspection - First Article.-Keywords-First Article Inspection, Unplanned Inspections, Adhoc Inspections, Receiving Inspection.

Title: Missing Purchase order ID for Freight Invoice in Monitoring Invoice Report.
Content: Symptom-When you pull list of invoices through Monitoring Invoice Report, the Purchase order ID will not appear against frieght invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoice work center.-Select the Reports List view.-Search for Monitoring Invoice Report.-Open the report and filter with Product X.-You can see that against the document ID Y (Freight invoice) there is no Purchase Order appearing in the purchase order ID column however against the Supplier invoice Z (Normal Invoice) the Purchase order is appearing.-Cause-For the Freight Invoice the distribution of amount happens on the Items in the Cost Distribution (Internal items) and not on the External Items which is present in the Item List.-The reason why this is done is that the cost can be distributed to more than one Invoicesin this case and accordingly the amount gets adjusted. For an External item there can be more than one Internal items. Hence the references of the Purchase Order will be stored at the internal item level.-The report Monitoring Invoices report shows information based on the Item ID (External Item) which contains the actual amount of the Purchase Order to be Invoiced.-The internal items mainly the Cost Distribution which has happened among several goods, returns that are done against that PO item. It mainly contains the reference amounts.

Title: Error During Post Goods Issue.
Content: Symptom-During Post Goods Issue the below error is faced:-"Logistics model for Pickup Shipping without task for Site ID XYZ (XYZ means the Site ID) missing. Create a new logistics model for the site with the relevant template in the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Delivery Proposals view.-Show All Proposals by Selection and find Delivery Request ID ABC. (ABC means Delivery Request ID)-Click Post Goods Issue.-The above error is faced.-Cause-There is no Logistics Model Type for Pickup Shipping for Site XYZ in Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Resolution-Maintain Logistics Model Type for Pickup Shipping for Site XYZ in Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Keywords-Logistics Model, Pick Up, Shipping, Warehousing, Logistics Master Data, Post Goods Issue.

Title: Sales Order Lines Released Incrementally
Content: Symptom-When trying to release the Customer Demand against Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID), and when releasing the Order Line Item, the quantities are released partially even though it has enough of the affected Product in the Inventory to satisfy the Demand in a single delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control workcenter.-Customer Demand view.-Find Sales Order XYZ.-Select the Sales Order Line item.-In the Details section go to Schedule Lines.-It has been noticed that the Requested Quantity is N (N represents the Quantity requested in the Sales Order), but the Quantity Released or Confirmed are in partial Quantities like N1, N2, N3 (N1, N2, N3 represents sub sum of N) and so on.-Cause-It has been maintained the Delivery Rule for Individual line item of the Sales Order XYZ as Multiple Deliveries, therefore the Product is shipped in multiple times in smaller Quantities.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected. To receive the Line Item in Multiple Deliveries, it is necessary to change the Delivery Rule of the Line Item to Single Delivery-Full Quantity.-See Also-Kindly refer to the Help center document Sales Orders Quick Guide for more details.-Keywords-Sales Order, Customer Demand, Multiple Deliveries, Schedule Lines.

Title: System triggers a warning message when Demand plan is ran for model "Seasonal Trend Exponential Smoothing".
Content: Symptom-When the Demand Plan XYZ is ran using model Seasonal Trend Exponential Smoothing, a warning message appears,*XYZ refers to Demand Plan id- Historical data not sufficient-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Demand Planning Work Center.-Go to Demand Plans View.-Search for Demand Plan XYZ.-Select Go.-Select the Demand Plan XYZ and Select Plan.-Select Choose Planning Board Layout as Maximal Layout.-Select on Run Statistical Forecast.-We see a warning message appears:-Historical data not sufficient-Cause-History horizon data for previous months was maintained less than the defined History Horizon range.-Resolution-You need to maintain History Horizon data considering the range maintained in the plan. For instance, if you have defined a History Horizon of 57 months for Seasonal Trend Exponential Smoothing, the data relevant to it must be also maintained.-Keywords-Historical data not sufficient, "Seasonal Trend Exponential Smoothing", When the Demand Plan  is ran using model Seasonal Trend Exponential Smoothing, a warning message appears

Title: Partially Delivered 3PL request in Finished status.
Content: Symptom-3PL request DEF which is partially delivered for one of the line item XX appears as Finished Status.*DEF refers to 3PL request ID, XX refers to Item no,*PQR refers to Delivery Request id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Delivery Requests subview under 3PL Outbound View.-Search for PQR.-Select Go.  -Select Edit.-Navigate to Line items tab.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-In Show select Extended View.-The 3PL request DEF is showing as Finished Status, though Item XX  is partially delivered.-Cause-Since the current setting is set as Automatic for 3PL Request Completion, in 3PL Process Settings for Site DEF, System auto completes the 3PL Request on receipt of the first successful Outbound Delivery.-Resolution-We have to change the 3PL Request Completion to Manual for the involved site DEF.-This setting can be done as follows.-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-In Common tasks, Navigate to 3PL Process Settings.-Select the Site DEF and remove the entry which has 3PL Request Completion as Automatic.-Select Automatic.-A popup box appears, Choose 2 Manual.-Select OK.-Select Save.-Keywords-Partially Delivered, 3PL request,Finished,status, 3PL.

Title: How To Set Involved Parties For Tickets
Content: Symptom-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-How to set ﻿Involved Parties﻿ for ﻿Tickets﻿.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Select the relevant Implementation Project.-Make sure that the status is such, that you can edit it.-Open the ﻿Activity List.-Open either the Fine Tuning Activity Tickets for Customer Support or Tickets for Employee Support as needed.-Select the Maintain Involved Parties link.-You can decide which party roles you want to use in your application. However some party roles are set as mandatory by default and you cannot deactivate these.-Click Add Row to add a party.-[NOTE: to create custom parties, use the Fine Tune Activity: Party Role Definition.]-Click Save.-Use the Maintain Determinations button to decide how the role is assigned.-Save your entries.-For further information see Help Documentation Administration Guide > Party Processing (and following) > Add Party Roles to the Relevant Business Objects.-Further reference can be found in the SCN article Party Role Determination in a Sales Document despite this concentrating on sales documents.

Title: System trigger an error while creating Customer Return Notification.
Content: Symptom-System triggers an error while creating Customer Return Notification from Sales Order.-Delivery items with different account ids not permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-In Common tasks, Navigate to New Customer Return Notification.-Enter Sales Order Numbers as an input in Step 1: Select Outbound Delivery Items.-Select Go.-Select those line items which needs to be returned by checking the checkbox.-Select Next.-Enter Delivery Notification ID and select the relevant return reason from the drop-down in Step 2: Edit Customer Return Delivery Notification.-Select Next.-Select Finish in Step 3: Review.-Customer Return Notification XYZ is created with Inconsistent status.-Error appears: Delivery items with different account ids not permitted.-Cause-The error is triggered because one of the chosen Sales Order line items has a different account ID ABC than the Sales Order line items which has common account ID PQR.-Resolution-While creating Customer Return Notification we can combine different Sales Orders of different Line items but the Account ID or Account Name should be same.-To proceed, the user needs to cancel the line item for the one which has the different account ID ABC.-This can be done as follows.-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Inbound delivery Notifications View.-In Find search for Customer Return Notification XYZ.-Select Go.-Select Edit.-Navigate to Line Items tab.-Select the Line item which has account ID ABC.-Select Cancel item.-Select Save.-Keywords-Delivery items with different account ids not permitted, System triggers an error while creating Customer Return Notification from Sales Order.

Title: Error Message "500 Internal Server Error" While Trying to Create Journal Entry Voucher Using OData Services
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create Journal Entry Voucher Using OData services, system throws below error message:-Company missing-500 Internal Server Error-Reproducing the Issue-1. Login to Postman-2. Add the URL https://myXXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/customodata/AccountingEntryCollection-3. Select POST function-4. Pass the below sample payload-{-"d":{-"PostingDate":"2016-11-11T00:00:00",-"ID1":"000000000001111111",-"BusinessTransactionTypeCode":"22",-"AccountingClosingStepCode":"33,-"EntryDate":"2016-11-11T00:00:00",-"AccountingDocumentTypeCode":"55",-"AccountingEntryItem":[-{-"ChartOfAccountsCode": "XX",-"ChartOfAccountsItemCode":"11",-"DebitCreditCode":"1",-"TransactionCurrencyAmount": "11",-"currencyCode": "XX",-"ProfitCentreProfitCentre":-{-"ID":"22222222"-}-},-{-"ChartOfAccountsCode": "XX",-"ChartOfAccountsItemCode":"77",-"DebitCreditCode":"2",-"currencyCode": "XX",-"ProfitCentreProfitCentre":-{-"ID":"22222222"-}-}-]-}-}-Cause-The cause for this issue is Profit Center is a read only Business Object-Resolution-You can use SOAP webservices to create the Journal Entry Voucher with the Profit Center ID

Title: When MRP run is performed for product XYZ, a warning message appears.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When an MRP Run is performed for product XYZ, a warning message appears.*XYZ refers to Product id, KLM refers to Planning area-Product XYZ in planning area KLM planned with warnings. See interactive Planning Log for more details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Go to Products View.-Search for Product XYZ.-Select Go.-Select Open.-Select Run Planning and select Multilevel BoM.- A warning message appears.-Product XYZ in planning area ABC planned with warnings. See interactive Planning Log for more details.-Cause-This warning message indicates that the product XYZ is being planned, however the planning run is not able to cover all demands on time. Dates have been violated.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Product  in planning area planned with warnings.
