Title: Invoice details are not reflected in the report Project Cost and Revenue Details by Project
Content: Symptom-Customer Invoice Details are not displayed in the report Project Cost and Revenue Details by Project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select view Design Reports-Select report Project Cost and Revenue Details by Project-Filter report for any Project-The invoice and invoice item columns are empty-Cause-The default setting is set in such a way that this report will show only Cost incurred, not Revenue, and Invoice Details comes only for Revenue.-Resolution-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select view Design Reports-Select report Project Cost and Revenue Details by Project-Add Invoice and Invoice Item fields-Go to Settings->Key Figures-Select ITD Revenue and click OK-Keywords-Project Cost and Revenue, Invoice Item, ITD Revenue

Title: Purchase Order Approval not triggered for Header Level Approval after Modification of Purchase Order Item
Content: Symptom-After modifying Purchase Order item, approval task is not getting triggered for approver who is maintained in Approval Process for Purchase Order-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Open any Purchase order and select Edit-Navigate to Items tab-Modify any line item and select Send-Purchase Order is in In Approval status -Approval task is triggered for wrong approver-Cause-You have maintained Approval Process Overview: Purchase Order Item Approval , hence when you do any modification in the line item of a Purchase Order, the approval will go for Line Item Approver instead of Header Level Approver-Resolution-You have to uncheck the Scoping Question in Business Configuration--Do you want to use an approval process for purchase orders at item level?-Keywords-Purchase Order Item Approval

Title: Error triggered when trying to delete Labour Resource
Content: Symptom-You are currently unable to delete Labour Resource as the system displays the following error messages,*XYZ refers to Resource id, *PQR refers to Cost Centre id- Company for resource not found.- Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Resources View.-Search for XYZ.-Select Go.-Select Delete.- System triggers  error messages-Cause-The resource XYZ was assigned to cost centre PQR. Org unit PQR validity as a cost centre ended.- When User tries to delete this labour resource XYZ, system validates this cost centre, however it fails as the same is not valid anymore. As a result, the resource cannot be deleted.-Resolution-To resolve this particular issue, please set the org structure PQR as a cost centre once again.-Go to Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to Org Structures View.-Select date as Current Date and then select Sales Org PQR.-Select Edit and then choose tab Definition. Check the box for cost centre.-Save this and activate the org structure.-- You should be able to delete the labour resource successfully.-Keywords-Company for resource not found, Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions, Error triggered when trying to delete Labour Resource

Title: Error messages triggered when trying to release Production Model.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to release a Production Model XXX and the following errors are triggered: -technical_error_RPPM_message_13-technical_error_RPPM 063 appear: Save Failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center-Choose Production Model view-Select and edit the Production Model XXX-Select the option Release Production Model-Select the option For Planning and Execution-See the errors:-technical_error_RPPM_message_13-technical_error_RPPM 063 ﻿and Save Failed appearing-Cause-The issue occurs because the Base Unit of Measure (UoM) for one of the products is not the same as the maintained one on Product Master Data.-Resolution-Edit the Master Data for the product which is not with the same Base UoM and maintain unit of measure conversion under the section Quantity Conversion in the General tab.

Title: 3PL error when Outbound Delivery Execution Confirmation is processing
Content: Symptom-An error ‘Numbering formats must be maintained for warehouse provider. Number range configuration not determined.’ occurs while working on Third-Party Logistics business.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The error happens because the number range for inbound and outbound deliveries from your third-party logistics provider is not maintained in the Business Configuration.-In fine-tuning, the key user has maintained the document numbering formats to be used by your warehouse provider for both the inbound and outbound deliveries. These numbering formats are maintained in the two fine-tuning activities Number Range for Inbound Deliveries and Number Range for Outbound Deliveries. The maintenance of these numbering formats is mandatory for third-party logistics scenarios — they control the numbering of the documents that you receive from your warehouse provider in that you specify a prefix value and separator.-Resolution-To understand how to configure the document numbering formats, you can view below help portals:-Configuration: Document Numbering Formats for Inbound Delivery-Configuration: Document Numbering Formats for Outbound Delivery-Keywords-Numbering formats must be maintained for warehouse provider, Number range configuration not determined, 3PL, New Inbound Delivery, New Outbound Delivery

Title: Usage of Overdelivery Checkbox in Project Plan
Content: Symptom-Usage Of Overdelivery Checkbox in Project Plan workpackages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Show: All Projects.-Search for XYZ (XYZ is the Project's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Project Plan tab.-Select project task XYZ-1.-Navigate to Work tab.-The employee ABC has Planned Work next to that you can see the Overdelivery checkbox.-Cause-In case you expect that the quantity of service will be more than the quantity requested in the purchase request you can select the Over-Delivery Allowed checkbox in the project plan work package. This will allow the service agent to record time against requested service , even if it is more than the quantity entered on the project purchase request.-If you select Overdelivery checkbox for a work package, when the purchase request is created, the Over- Delivery Allowed checkbox will be selected by default for that purchase request item. You can also choose to edit this feature for each purchase request item if needed even though the Overdelivery checkbox is not selected for a work package.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Project; Overdelivery; Project Plan; Employee; Task

Title: Unable to Set Custom Status for Opportunities
Content: Symptom-Unable to set Custom Status for Opportunities-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Opportunities Work Center-Click in the Cog Icon-The option Set Custom Status is not appearing-Cause-Custom Status can be maintained in the Opportunities Activity within the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration.-Go to the Activities.-Go to fine tuning and search for Opportunity.-Select the activity Opportunity.-Select Custom status.-From here you can define your Custom Status.-Once you do this the option, it should become available.

Title: Purchase Order Search Filters do not work with Free Text search
Content: Symptom-You are trying to sort the columns in Purchase Order Overview List e.g. fields like PO Acknowledgment Status, Delivery Status, Invoicing Status  using wild cards or free text search but they are not getting sorted.-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Select Filter option and sort the columns PO acknowledgment status, Delivery Status and Invoicing status using wild cards like *Follow* or *Ack* etc.-However, we could see Sorting does not work- Cause-For Status and PO Acknowledgment Status columns, Filtering and Sorting will work fine if we enter the whole description of the status for example, like *Follow-Up Document Created* or *Deviation in Acknowledgement*-For  Delivery Status and Invoice Status columns, Filtering and Sorting do NOT work since these are calculated fields.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.

Title: Incorrect Payee Name in Bank Payment File
Content: Symptom-The outbound file in Liquidity Management is showing the incorrect Payee Name.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to File Management > Outbound Files view.-Search for the respective File ID and click to open it.-Click View All.-Download and open the respective file created by the system.-You can see that the Payee Name is incorrect the Payment File.-Cause-The reason due to address is not maintained for an employee in the Employee Master Data at the time of creating Payment File.-Resolution-You need to make sure that you have maintained the proper address for the Employee.-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the employee and choose Edit tab.-Go to Personal Data tab.-Choose Private Contact Data tab and maintain the correct address for the Employee.

Title: Supplier Invoice Missing External Information is to Automatically Forward to the Supplier For Clarification is Not Working
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoice exception not automatically forwarded to the supplier for clarification.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Settings: In the Business Configuration Activity following Supplier Invoice Exceptions type-Possible Duplicate-Missing / Wrong External Information is marked auto forwarded.-Missing / Wrong Internal Information-Missing Receipt or Return Document-Price Variance-Quantity Variance- Here you define whether an exception message is sent automatically. If you select automatic forwarding, the message is sent to a defined business partner, such as a supplier, buyer, or accountant, who deals with the exception. Manual forwarding of exception messages is always possible.-Steps:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the Invoice XYZ.-Select Post button then the system should forward the exception to the supplier.-Cause-Invoice Exception Clarification Output Channel is E-Mail and exceptions were not getting forwarded because the Supplier Master data the primary contact E-mail was not maintained-Resolution-Go to Supplier master data work center.-Open the Supplier XYZ under the General tab.-Main Communication here maintains the email address.-Save.-Then try to post the Supplier Invoice then the exception is auto forwarded to a supplier for clarification.

Title: Error Message: Tax Return Arrangement is Not Valid For Period DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new VAT Return Run and get the error message: Tax Return Arrangement ABC (ABC is the Tax Return Arrangement ID) is not valid for period from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY. Either change the validity period of the tax return arrangement or select a different From/To date.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work centre.-Go to the VAT Return Runs sub view in Periodic Tasks view.-Create a new Tax Return Run for Tax Return Arrangement ID with the relevant information:-Tax Return Arrangement ID is ABC for the Year YYYY and From DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY.-The Tax Authority is XXX (XXX stands for the Tax Authority) and the Company is PQR (PQR is the Company ID).-You get the error message:-'Tax Return Arrangement ABC is not valid for period from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY. Either change the validity period of the tax return arrangement or select a different From/To date. Save failed.'-Cause-You are getting the error message as the validity period of this Tax Return Arrangement has expired.-You can check this is as follows:-Go to the Tax Management work centre.-Go to the Tax Authorities sub view in Tax Authorities view.-Search and select the Tax Authority XXX.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-There is one or more Tax Return Arrangements for Company PQR, valid from DD.MM.YYYY+1 to unlimited.-For the same company, there are other Tax Return Arrangements including Tax Return Arrangement ABC with validity from DD.MM.YYYY- (minus) L (L stands for any number of years which can be substracted from the year YYYY) to DD.MM.YYYY.-Now navigate to the Tax Return Arrangements sub tab.-Here the validity of the Tax Return Arrangement ABC is maintained as from DD.MM.YYYY-L to  DD.MM.YYYY- (minus) 1.-Resolution-A VAT Return Run can only be scheduled within the time frame for which the Tax Return Arrangement is valid.-If the validity period of the Tax Return Arrangement is not extended or ammended, the Return Run cannot be scheduled for a date range beyond the validity period. The run will not get created because of the above mentioned error message.-You have to change the validity of the Tax Return Arrangement to allow the creation of a new VAT Return Run.

Title: Unexpected Error Appears While Releasing Outbound Delivery Document
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release the Outbound Delivery document XYZ and have received an unexpected error or system crash.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Select the Outbound Delivery XYZ.-Select Release.-The system crashes or an unexpected error appears.-Cause-The unexpected error appears because the Ship-From site is no longer active. In the Outbound Delivery XYZ, the Ship-From location is ABC.This site is inactive, and hence the inventory is not being determined at the goods issue location.-Resolution-You have to Activate the Site/Location ID & then release the Outbound Delivery document.-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select the relevant Site/Location ID ABC.-Select Edit and change the status to Active.-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Supply Chain Design, system crash

Title: Product Price is not Automatically Populated in new Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-Product price is not automatically populated when new Purchase Order is created-Reproducing the Issue-Goto work center Purchase Requests and Orders-Select view Purchase Orders-Select New and create a Purchase Order for an item with a purchase history-The gross price for that product is not picked by system automatically-Cause-You have not maintained any List Price or Fixed Source of Supply or Purchasing Contract.-Resolution-The system will pick the price automatically only when you have maintained either of these sources and display it in the open Purchase Order-Hierarchy:-1. First priority goes to Fixed source of supply-2. Second preference goes to Purchasing Contract-3. If none of the above are maintained, the system will choose from the List Price

Title: Remaining Work Not Calculated.
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Remaining work field is not updated in a Project Task for a team member after time confirmations have been recorded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the Project XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID). -Press Edit.-Select the project task in question and navigate to the Work tab.-Here you can see the Remaining Work not calculated for a team member. -Cause-When the project is in planning, remaining work is read only and is always equal to planned work.-When the project is released, the remaining work becomes editable.-However, if you change the planned work or remaining work field after project task release the Remaining work value is no longer updated automatically. You then need to update the Remaining work manually each time there have been changes to the Actual work amount. -Resolution-System works as expected.-See Also-2671737 - Remaining Planned Cost is Shown as Zero in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure Report-Keywords-project task, remaining work.

Title: Product Specification is not getting updated in Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-When Product Specification is updated in sales order line items, Customer Demand is not getting updated with that new Product Specification.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work center Outbound Logistics Control-Click on View Customer Demand-Open the order-Navigate to the Items tab-Product Specification is not updated-Cause-Product specification is reflected in Customer Demand only if the product specification is specified while creating the line items in the sales order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior-Keywords-Product Specification-Sales Order-Customer Demand

Title: Error : Valid From date must not be in the past; enter a new Valid From date
Content: Symptom-While uploading list price via Microsoft excel in the Bydesign system, system throws error message as Valid From date must not be in the past; enter a new Valid From date-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Product Portfolio work center-Select List Prices view-Select New-> List Prices from Microsoft Excel®-In the excel select SAP Bydesign Add-In and Logon using ByDesign credentials-Select "Save Data to you will see the above error.-Cause-For the list price system does not accept Valid From date in the past, the Valid-From date should be current date or future date.-Resolution- This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Error while creating Stock Transfer Order for Sales Kit
Content: Symptom-While creating Stock Transfer Order for Sales Kit you receive an error regarding planning data.*XX refers to Product Id, YY refers to Site Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-In Common tasks, Select New Stock Transfer Order.-Fill all the relevant fields Ship-from Site ID, Ship-to Site ID, Product ID etc.-Error appears at the bottom of the screen as mentioned below-No valid planning data exists for product XX in site YY.-Cause-Error occurs as Sales Kits are not supported on Stock Transfer Orders.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, Sales Kit, No valid planning data exists for product, Planning data

Title: Dialogue Box Blocks Side Bar
Content: Symptom-Opening a quick create bar blocks the side bar options as e.g. Help Center:-  Reproducing the Issue-The issue can be reproduced with any quick create window opened on the right hand side of the screen. As an example we will take the New Lead window.-Go the the Work Center Sales.-Open the Leads View.-Click on New, this will open the New Lead quick create window.-Open the Help Center from the side bar while the New Lead window is still open.-The Help Center is partly hidden behind the quick create window.-Cause- This is currently a limitation in the system. If a quick create window is opened and the side bar is opened at the same time, the side bar gets hidden by the dialogue.-Resolution-When the quick create window is opened after the side bar, the quick create window will position itself correctly.

Title: Unable to release Outbound Delivery as Release Button is disabled
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to release Outbound Delivery XYZ as the Release option is grayed out.*XYZ  refers to Outbound Delivery Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Select the filter All Outbound Deliveries by Selection.-Find the delivery XYZ.-Select it and see that the Release button is disabled.-Cause-Go to Outbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Select the filter All Outbound Deliveries by Selection.-Find the delivery XYZ.-Select the option Edit.-Select Check Consistency.-The following error is triggered: Only one party Freight Forwarder Party permitted.- The Outbound Delivery XYZ is inconsistent because of this error.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue and release the Outbound Delivery, please follow the steps below.-Go to Outbound Logistics Work center-Go to Outbound Deliveries view-Select  the filter All Outbound Deliveries by Selection-Find the delivery XYZ-Select and Edit the Outbound Delivery XYZ-Navigate to General Tab-Select the Freight Forwarder and remove the entry-Select the option Check Consistency-The Outbound Delivery should now be consistent-Select Save and Close-Now the Release option should be enabled.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery,release button,greyed out,disabled,Only one party Freight Forwarder Party permitted,Check Consistency

Title: Errors during migration of transport lanes.
Content: Symptom-While migrating Transport Lanes the system throws the following errors:-Error detected in source record with key value-Target location or target transportation zone missing.-You reviewed the migration template and confirmed that all mandatory and necessary fields are maintained in template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-In Find enter Transport Lanes.-Select Go.-Select  Transport Lanes Activity.-Select Migrate transport lanes using the migration tool.-Download the migration template for transport Lanes.-Fill in the data to be migrated in the excel template.-Upload the filled migration template.-Execute the migration using the option Step by Step.-Cause-Transportation Lanes do not support Ship-to-Site and Transportation Zone maintained together in template.-Resolution-We should either maintain combination of Ship-From site and ship-to Site, which will be used for stock transfer, or use the combination of Ship-From Site and a Transportation Zone.-This is the system designed behavior.-Keywords-Target location or target transportation zone missing, Error detected in source record with key value, Transportation Lanes do not support Ship-to-Site

Title: When excel is exported from Monitor Purchase Orders,  Fields ‘Delivery Due’ and ‘Supplier Acknowledgement’ are missing in excel.
Content: Symptom-When export to excel is performed from Monitor Purchase Orders View, you observe Fields Delivery Due and Supplier Acknowledgment are not part of the excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control Work Center-Go to Monitor Purchase Orders View-In Show choose Overdue Purchase Order Items-Click Go-Click Export-Choose To Microsoft Excel-Exported file is missing columns for Fields Delivery Due and Supplier Acknowledgment.-Cause-The fields Delivery Due and Supplier Acknowledgment are missing because they are calculated fields.-Resolution-Excel export does not support calculated fields. System behaves as expected.-Keywords-When excel is exported from Monitor Purchase Orders,  Fields ‘Delivery Due’ and ‘Supplier Acknowledgement’ are missing in excel, Exported file is missing columns for Fields Delivery Due and Supplier Acknowledgment.

Title: Third party Sales Order Fulfillment status being changed from External to Internal automatically.
Content: Symptom-Third party Sales Order Fulfillment category being changed from External to Internal automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center-Go to the View Sales Orders-Find & Select Sales Order  XYZ which is in status In Preparation and Fulfillment status as External-Click Go-Edit the Sales Order XYZ-Click View All-Navigate to Items tab-Click Add Row-Enter the Line Item and relevant fields-Click Enter-Check the Fulfillment status of  previous Line Item-Whenever a third party Sales Order with already existing Line item created as Fulfillment as External and saved in  In preparation status, When you try adding a 2nd line item system automatically changes from External to Internal.-This change applies to previous immediate line item, though the Fulfillment is maintained as  External earlier.-Cause-When we add an item the availability is determined at that instant itself.-As long as the Sales Order is  In Preparation and when you save the Sales Order with  In Preparation status.-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center-Go to the View Sales Orders-Find & Select Sales Order  XYZ which is in status  In Preparation and Fulfillment status as External-Click Go-Edit the Sales Order XYZ-Click View All-Navigate to Items tab-Select the relevant Item-Under Details, Navigate to Sub tab Confirmation Schedules-The ATP type will be Non- Binding Confirmation, which means that no reservation has been done for this item.-Therefore whenever we add a new item or do any update to the existing item then ATP check is run on all the items with ATP type Non-Binding and it will result in determining the best possible result which is always internal if internal is available.-Resolution-To avoid this behavior:-User can assign the fulfillment category and supplier from the Assign source of supply button. When the user does that then both the fulfillment and Supplier are determined by the user and it will not change on adding new item or modifying the existing one.-If the Sales Order is released then this will not happen because once the Sales Order is released, the Customer Demand will be generated and the reservation for the item will be done. When we add new item ATP check will not run on items having ATP type Reservation.-Keywords-Third party Sales Order Fulfillment category being changed from External to Internal automatically, User can assign the fulfillment category and supplier from the Assign source of supply button

Title: System Crashes When Trying to Create New Request Removal
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to create New Request Removal for a product system crashes though there is a sufficient On-Hand stock in a system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Go to New Removal Subview.-Enter the required Product ID and choose Go.-Here enter required Removal Quantity equals to On-Hand Stock.-Choose Request Removal.-System crashes.-Cause-Since the stock is Allocated to another Warehouse Request, system is unable to find the stock to create New Warehouse Request and dumps.You have to Reject the warehouse request created already to get the required stock.-Resolution-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Go to New Removal Subview.-Enter the required Product ID and choose Go.-Select the Row as per your requirement.-Under section: Details, go to Forecasted Documents subtab.-Here you can see Warehouse Request ID created for the Product with some quantity.-Open the warehouse request using hyperlink and Reject it.-Then again perform New Request Removal.

Title: Creating Several Inbound Deliveries for One Outbound Delivery in a Stock Transfer Scenario.
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to create several Inbound Deliveries for the same Outbound Delivery in a Stock Transfer scenario? -Use case: The Outbound Delivery was shipped in two parcels arriving at separate times. One of the parcels accidently got left behind. The Customer wants to process the two parcels separately, creating a first Inbound Delivery when the first parcel arrives, then a second Inbound Delivery when the second one arrives.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center, choose the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Show Not Released Delivery Notifications.-Find 123 (123 represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Click Post Goods Receipt.-In Items tab, click Propose Quantity.-Enter XX each (XX represents the quantity delivered in the first parcel).-Choose Save and Close.-Inbound Delivery 456 is created (456 represents the Inbound Delivery ID).-Inbound Delivery Notification 123 is no longer available in Not Released Delivery Notifications. The remaining goods cannot be posted.-Cause-It is not possible to create multiple Inbound Deliveries for one Stock Transfer Outbound Delivery. You can only associate one Inbound Delivery to an Outbound Delivery/Inbound Delivery Notification.-Resolution-To handle this scenario, you have to create several Stock Transfer Outbound Deliveries.-The existing Outbound Delivery can be adjusted and its quantity can be reduced. Then you can create another Outbound Delivery for the remaining quantity arriving in second parcel and create a new Inbound Delivery for this Outbound Delivery.

Title: Adaptation of Sections and Fields
Content: Symptom-You cannot move the custom section or fields to different location in the page.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Edit Master Layout.-Open any work center view for eg; Tickets and open any Ticket.-Hover on the overview tab and click on add section and save.-The section created will be found at the bottom of the screen.-Try to move this section to another location and this will not work.-Try moving the field from one section to another and it does not work.-Cause-Not all the TI's (Loading of Object / screen) allow you to move the section or fields to other locations. It depends on the Layout property type. Only TI of type Dynamic Grid layout type will allow this feature.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2017/01/18/faqs-on-page-layout/-Keywords-Layout, move section, Adaptation, different location

Title: Supporting Information for your Cloud Test and Productive System
Content: Symptom-SAP has kept the amount of possible restrictions during the upgrade to an absolute minimum.-Follow the below recommendations and restrictions during the upgrade of your test tenant and your productive tenantto allow for a smooth running upgrade:-No merge back for Change Projects possible while test tenants are upgraded and production tenants are not.-Do not terminate or request a test tenant or productive tenant during the time between the Test-Upgrade and Productive-Upgrade-Avoid a Go-Livescenario during the time between the Test-Upgrade and Productive-Upgrade-Do not apply SAP Cloud Applications Studio add-ons during the time between Test-Upgrade-No productive data transfer (migration) during productive upgrade week-end

Title: Error Appears While Creating Supplier Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You want to create supplier down payment request for two service items & each service item is subject to a different Tax Code. When you create supplier down payment request with two different tax codes, system shows the below error message.-Error: Item 1: Only items with the same tax code permitted-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Common Tasks-Select New Down Payment Request-Navigate to Items tab-Select Add Row and enter two Service line items with different Tax Codes-Error appears-Resolution-Down payment request allows only one tax code per document & you have to create separate down payment requests for different services items which has different tax codes. This is a standard behavior.

Title: Reports & Data Source for Physical Inventory Count Document
Content: Symptom-You want to know f there are any reports which can display Product Actual Quantity under the physical inventory count document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Go to the Monitoring By PI Count Document.-Select PI Count Finished.-Select the relevant document.-Select Edit & navigate to Count Items tab.-Here you see the Product Actual Quantity.-Resolution-In the current release there is no data source for Physical Inventory Count/Document & this functionality will be available in one of the future releases of SAP ByDesign.-Note: For the Business Object PhysicalInventoryCount relevant Node and attributes are already PSM Read Released. You can Build your own report in PDI, if required.

Title: How to Suppress Creation of Automatic Rules for Sales Order
Content: Symptom-How to Suppress Creation of Automatic Rules for Sales Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Managemnet work center.-Choose the Invoice Preparation view.-Choose the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Choose Project XYZ.-Chosoe the Edit Time and Expense button.-Choose  button Edit Assignment Rules and View All Rules-Here you can see automatic rules are created for project sales order-Cause-If you do not want a system to create automatic rules for sales order and don’t want to assign the automatic created rules to not invoiced time and expenses then you can suppress the creation of automatic rules for project sales order.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to configure the system accordingly.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab-Search for Project Types.-Choose project type Customer project with sales integration and enable the question Do not create automatic rules for sales order assignment for not yet invoiced time and expense.-Choose Save button.

Title: Missing Cost Center in Supplier Invoice's Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice with cost center information in the line item, however G/L Account posting in the journal entry is not allocated to the specified cost center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice and Credit Memos-Open the concenred invoice document and click View All-Jump to the Document Flow tab-Open the journal entry for this invoice.-You'll see that there is no cost center information, although it's specified in the invoice items.-Cause-For the invoice items you have defined the account assignment as IMAT - Individual Material and also specified a cost center. In this scenario, the individual material is the cost object. Considering that this is an asset acquistion, the system will reach the Fixed Asset subledger with a G/L Account of type ASSET - Fixed assets. ﻿The cost center assignment you made is caried out to the fixed asset master data and used in the Interval Assignment. -Furthermore, you can only allocate an amount to a cost center via G/L Account with type Cost or Expenses.-Resolution-In view of the described scenario, the system works as designed.

Title: Wrong tax Code in Intercompany Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-An unexpected tax code is determined in the Intercompany Supplier Invoice, which is automatically created from the Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the Intercompany Supplier Invoice ID). -Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Taxes sub-tab.-The Tax code is incorrect.-Cause-The details of the Intercompany Supplier Invoice are typically derived from the corresponding Customer Invoice. However, if the Tax Details for the Ship-to party have not been provided, an incorrect Tax Code might be picked by the system. This leads to the wrong Tax Code being used in both the Supplier Invoice and the related Customer Invoice document.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, maintain the tax details for the Ship-to party as per the steps below:-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Select Account XYZ of the Customer Invoice (XYZ represents the Account ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Financial Data tab.-Select Tax Data.-Choose Add Row button under Tax Numbers.-Maintain the necessary Tax Details.-Select Save.-Additional Information:-The Automatic Tax Determination flag is only checked in the Supplier Invoice when Tax Determination occurs at the Supplier Invoice stage.-In general, Intercompany Supplier Invoice details are based on the corresponding Customer Invoice.-Tax Code is determined by Tax Event, Tax Type, Tax Rate Type, and Tax Deductibility.-The Tax Event used in the Customer Invoice tax code determination is also used to determine the tax event for the Supplier Invoice tax code determination.-The Ship From and Ship To addresses in the Intercompany Supplier Invoice are fetched from the Location address maintained in the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Ensure that the Country and Postal Code are correctly maintained in the Ship From and Ship To addresses in the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Refer to the attached Excel file, which displays the standard mappings of tax events on the Sales side with tax events on the Purchase side (specifically for countries US and DE).-Keywords-Intercompany Supplier Invoice; Wrong Tax code; Wrong Tax country; Customer Invoice

Title: Error: Automatic Creation Of Registered Product For Serial Number XXX In Current Operation Is Not Possible. You Can Manually Create A Registered Product In The Registered Product Screen.
Content: Symptom-When trying to create Automatic Serial Numbers while performing Post Goods Issue by uploading the file, system does not generate any Serial Number ID and throws an error messsage :-Automatic creation of Registered Product for serial number XXX in current operation is not possible. You can manually create a Registered Product in the Registered Product screen. (XXX represents the Serial Number ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Delivery Control View and select Delivery Proposals sub view.-In the field Show, choose All Proposals by Selection by drop down.-Search for the required Delivery Request ID.-Select and choose Post Goods Issue button.-New Window opens up as Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue.-Now under Details Section, navigate to Serial Number subtab.-Then either enter any value or choose Upload button to upload serial numbers with excel or text file saved in your computer.-Here system throws you an above error message.-Cause-For automatic creation of serial numbers for Customer Delivery, maintain Serial Number Profile either as Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers or as Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes in a relevant Product master data.-Resolution-In order to maintain the required Serial Number Profile,please follow below given steps :-Go to the Product Portfolio Workcenter.-Go to Products View and choose By Materials subview.-In the field search, enter the required Product ID.-Select ID and choose Edit.-Navigate to View All and under General tab.-Under General subtab, in the field Serial Number Profile.-Using drop-down, choose Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers as a profile.-Perform Save.-Keywords-serial, number, profile, error, Automatic, Creation, Registered, Product, Current, Operation, Not Possible, Manually, Create, Screen

Title: Withholding Tax for United Kingdom is not Calculated
Content: Symptom-You have scoped withholding tax for UK and maintained the proper supplier, material and tax authority master data. Nevertheless, when creating a supplier invoice, the withholding tax is not calculated.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open your supplier invoice in View All mode.-Go to Items tab and check the Withholding Tax details.-You noticed that no tax is computed.-Cause-Although the master data seems correct, you did not maintain the required tax number type in the tax authority master data.-Resolution-In order to calculate withholding tax correctly, maintain the 5 - Accounts Office Reference tax number, as follows:-Go to Tax Management work center-Go to Tax Authorities view-Open the tax authority go to Company Tax Arrangements tab-Under Tax Numbers, maintain the 5 - Accounts Office Reference.

Title: Forecasting Models Tab Missing In Demand Plan.
Content: Symptom-Forecasting Models tab is missing under Process Settings sub-tab in the Demand Plan ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Demand Planning Work Center.-Go To Demand Plans View.-Find Demand Plan ID ABC and select Edit.-Go To Process Settings Tab.-Forecasting Models Sub-Tab is missing.-Cause-Forecasting can only be done based on the historic or past data. If you do not select the Statistical Forecasting Enabled option, there is no relevance of having the Forecasting Models. Hence, this Tab is hidden when the Statistical Forecasting Enabled radiobutton is not selected.-Resolution-Any fileds or tabs related to Forecasting Models will only be visible if the user choose Statistical Forecasting Enabled radiobutton under General tab of Demand Plan.-Keywords-ByD Demand Plan, Demand Plan Statistical Forecast, Forecasting Model Missing ByD, Error Forecast Model

Title: Approver Name Appears as # in the Monitoring Purchase Order Report
Content: Symptom-In the Monitoring Purchase Orders report, the approver name appears as "#".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Reports view.-Select the report Monitoring Purchase Orders.-View with Web Browser.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID).-Pull the key figure Approver.-Approver field appears with "#" value.-Cause-The Approver ID will be displayed for the Purchase Order in any status provided it is approved even once in the past or present.-The user can only see the approver who last approved the document at the time it was executed the report.-Resolution-Currently the standard reports are developed as mentioned above.-The user can create a new report using data source "Approval task details". It shows all the approver details for the documents in any status.-Note: Above details holds good for Supplier Invoice documents as well. -See Also-KBA: 2599498 - Approval Task Details data source-Keywords-Monitoring Purchase Orders report, approval task, approval name

Title: Purchase Request ID Missing When you Export Open Purchase Requests to Excel
Content: Symptom-You want to export open purchase requests to Microsoft Excel. However system failed to show the field Purchase Request ID in the excel sheet-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Requests view-Select the query Open Purchase Requests-Select Export & To Microsoft Excel-In the excel sheet, the field Purchase Request ID is missing-Cause-When you export the open purchase requests, we do not display the Purchase Request ID on the excel sheet. Because the purchase request ID is a combination field which joins purchase request ID and purchase request Item ID at runtime & hence it is not pulled into the excel sheet during export.-Resolution-There is a field called Purchase Request ID which is hidden in the personalization screen, you can enable this field on the purchase request screen & then export to excel. Now the Purchase Request ID will be visible in the excel sheet.-Go to the Personalize & select This Screen-Select Purchase Requests section-Go to the fields section & select the check box for Purchase Request ID-Select Save

Title: Invoice Volume Report does not show Down Payment Invoice
Content: Symptom-You cannot display released down payment invoices in report Invoice Volume-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Report View.-Open Report Invoice Volume-Select Go to run the report.-Add Field into Key Figure : Down Payment Amount.-You can see there is no Down Payment shown in the report.-Cause-The report Invoice Volume only shows the Value and quantity of Invoices, Credit memos and correction Invoices with Status released or release cancelled.-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour.-The report Invoice Volume does not show down payments. If you require a list of all Invoice documents which includes the Invoice Type down payment you could use the export to Microsoft Excel functionality in the OWL (Object Work List) of the Invoice Documents.-More Information on this report is available in the Help Center document Invoice Volume.-Keywords

Title: Same Attachment Copied to all Line Items of the Purchase Order Which was Created from a Sales Order.
Content: Symptom-The Attachments in the sales order header level are appearing in the intercompany Purchase order at item level on every item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-User has not Scoped the Business configuration question: Copy attachments from Sales Order header to Purchase Request header.-Resolution-Steps to maintain the above BC question:-Go to  Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects.-Select edit project scope.-Go to Questions section.-Expand purchasing element.-Further expand Purchase request and order management.-Select Purchase requests.-Check mark the question Copy of attachments from Sales Order header to Purchase Request header (in third party processing.-How it works:-If this option is unchecked Sales Order header attachments will be copied to Purchase Request item. Same is transferred to Purchase Order item during creation of Purchase Order from Purchase Request. In this case one Sales Order header attachment will be present in each of Purchase Order items leading to multiplication of attachments from Sales Order to Purchase Order.-If this option is selected, attachments from Sales Order header will be copied into Purchase Request header. On creation of Purchase Order from such Purchase Requests, attachments would be copied from Purchase Request root to Purchase Order header. In this case if the Purchase Order has items from multiple Sales Order, user would not know the Sales Order reference from which the attachment was copied. Header level attachments in Purchase Request is currently not shown in Purchase Request screens.

Title: Cannot Assign Customer for Project Type Customer Project Without Sales Integration.
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new project of project type Customer Project without Sales Integration and you want to assign a customer to this project. However the field Customer field is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks & select New Project.-Select Project Type as Customer project w/o sales integration.-Fill mandatory details & navigate to third step Define Project.-Customer field is missing.-Cause-In order to see the Customer field for project type Customer Project without Sales Integration, the business feature project management billable other direct cost projects should be scoped.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects & select Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Questions step & select Scoping Element Project Management.-Select Project Planning and Execution & select Projects.-Select the question - Do you want to create project invoices based on project actuals for internal projects? Yes.-Save and Finish the scoping.

Title: Deviating Bank Information tab Missing in the Supplier Invoice Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Deviating Bank Information tab is missing in the Posted supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select View All & navigate to General tab-Navigate to Payment Information subtab-Deviating Bank Information tab is missing-Cause-Deviating Bank Information tab will be hidden, if the document type is Credit Memo or in case the Payment Method is not maintained as Bank Transfer in the supplier master.- If invoice is created via webservice then 'Payment Form Code = 05 ( bank Transfer )' has to be entered in XML.-Resolution-Complete the 'Deviating Bank Information' tab with the bank details before post the supplier invoice. -Keywords-Deviating Bank Information; SIV Deviating; Bank information

Title: How to Send the Satisfaction Survey after Ticket Completion (Using Workflow Rules)
Content:
Symptom-Requirement: Once the status of the ticket is set to Completed & ticket is Saved, system should trigger an e-mail (with satisfaction survey) to the reporter of the ticket.-How to Achieve: Create a workflow rule for ticket & insert a survey in it.-Steps to create workflow rule:-1. Go to the Administrator work center.- 2. Go to the Workflow Rules view.-3. Click on New to create a Workflow Rule.-4. Add Description, Business Object (i.e. Ticket), Timing (i.e. On Every Save).-4. Click on Next to Define Conditions.-5. Click on Add Group button.-6. Define Conditions Status Equals to Value Complete or Lifecycle Status Equals to Value Complete.-7. Click on Next to Define Actions.-8. Select Rule Type: E-mail; Check Always Send E-Mail & Create Email Activity (if required); Add Sender; Subject (e.g. [Ticket: #TICKETID#] has been completed); Add the HTML template.-Note: the Sender E-mail address should always be the default e-mail maintained in E-Mail and Fax Settings activity.-Business Configuration work center -> Implementation Projects view -> Select the Project -> Click on Open Activity List button -> Fine-Tune tab ->-Open activity E-Mail and Fax Settings -> Click on E-Mail and Fax Settings link -> check the Default Sender Address (e.g. e-mail address: DoNotReply@my315185.mail.crm.ondemand.com)-8. Include Place Holders like Ticket ID & Survey ID (e.g. #TICKETID#, #SURVEY239#).-Note: You can create or reuse an existing Satisfaction Survey in the Surveys work center.-9. Add the recipient of the survey (e.g. Reported By of Ticket) under Recipient Determination.-10. You can also add Employee who will be recipient of the notification (Under Employee section).- 11. Click Next to Review your rule.-12. Click on Activate & then Finish.-13. Click Close button in Confirmation step.-Now with above rule, on completion of every ticket an E-mail workflow will be triggered for the Ticket Reporter and the Employee added in the rule.- Please find below Sample HTML Template Code for triggering e-mail (utf-8; save as .html):------

Hello

-

Your [Ticket: #TICKETID#] is complete

.- #SURVEY223# -

Regards, SAP Support

--

Title: Demand Plan Missing in Downloaded Excel Template.
Content: Symptom-You have downloaded all Active Demand Plans into an excel file using option Download to check and change the keyfigures but later you find that one of the Demand Plan:A is missing in a template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Demand Planning Workcenter.-Go to Demand Plans View.-In the field Show, select All Demand Plans By Selection using drop-down.-Select any Demand Plan ID.-Choose Download option.-Now system downloads all demand plans into an excel template.-Cause-Since there are no Actuals/Final Actuals exists against the required Active Demand Plan ID: A, the system has not downloaded the details againt the same. There must exists some keyfigures against the Demand Plan.-Resolution-Follow below mentioned steps to maintain Final Actuals againt the Demand Plan ID:-Go to the Demand Planning Workcenter.-Go to Demand Plans View.-In the field Show, select All Demand Plans By Selection using drop-down.-Select the required Active Demand Plan ID.-Choose Plan option.-Here New Window Opens up displaying all keyfigures.-Select Keyfigures :Final Actuals.-Maintain the Demand as per the time period selected.-Perform Save.-Now again try downloading the Demand Plans, you can see required Demand Plan ID:A in an excel template.

Title: Error in a Purchase Request Blocks the Execution of Purchase Request Bundle Run.
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled a Purchase Request Bundling Run to bundle several open purchase requests to create purchase orders. However due to a Blocking error on few Purchase Requests the whole run is resulting into an error.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requets and Orders Workcenter.-Select view Purchase Request Bundling Runs.-Show All Purchase Request Runs, search for Run ID XYZ.-In the Purchase Order Creation Run window, choose Set to Active to enable Schedule button.-Perform Save.-Then select Run ID with Active status.-Choose Schedule - Start Immediately.-Here when system generates the Application Log, it resulted into an error.-No purchase order gets created either due to blocking or any other error in a purchase request.-Error message with one example: Purchase Request X is blocked and cannot be processed.-Cause-System bundles and process purchase requets as per Work Package Size maintained for the Run.-By Default the package size is always 100 for one work package, therefore system considers all Purchase Requets in one package and hence if one purchase request is having an issue, the run faills and no purchase request is processed.-Resolution-You can reduce package size as per your requirement following below steps:-Go to the Personalize option on the top of the screen.-Under sections: select Control Parameters.-Under Fields: mark checkbox for Package Size.-On the right side, you can see by default package size is set as 100.-You can reduce and change the work package size as per your requirement.-Perform Save.

Title: Resource Scheduler Cannot Be Modified
Content: Symptom-The screen layout for the work centre Resource Scheduler cannot be modified currently.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Resource Scheduler.-Go to the view Resource Scheduler.-Click on Week.-Enter Adaptation Mode > Edit Master Layout.-Attempt to change the layout by size etc.-RESULT: changes cannot be made.-Cause-The work centre Resource Scheduler is using a Gantt chart. This is currently not open to any change or modification.-Resolution-This is current expected system behaviour.

Title: Cannot Find Migrated Purchase Order or Inbound Delivery Document for Return to Supplier Creation
Content: Symptom-You have migrated the purchase orders and inbound deliveries from your old legacy system. However you cannot find either purchase order nor inbound delivery while creating New Return to Supplier under Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Common Tasks view-Select New Return to Supplier-Select the query Supplier Delivery Items By Selection-You do not find either Purchase Order nor Inbound Delivery for return to supplier creation process-Cause-You cannot create Return to Supplier because both the purchase order and inbound delivery documents are migrated. Always Return to Supplier is created on the basis of inbound delivery document and in case of migrated inbound delivery, there is no real inbound delivery in the system. As a result purchase order/inbound delivery document is not available for Return to Supplier scenario.-Resolution-You can use migrated purchase orders however you have to create an actual inbound delivery in the system and then Return to Supplier can be created with reference to Supplier Delivery.-Keywords-RTS creation for migrated order; Supplier return for migrated PO, RTS creation

Title: Created on Date Missing in the Purchase Order Form
Content: Symptom-You have created a new purchase order, however when you do the preview the Created On date field is missing in the purchase order form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and Preview-In the from Created On field is missing-Cause-In Business ByDesign, we have two dates to display on purchase order forms. One is purchase order Creation Date and other one is Ordered Date.-When the Purchase order is in status"In preparation" then creation date is not there cause it is not yet sent to supplier I.e from a business point of view, the relevant creation date of the purchase order is when it is sent out to the supplier .-Resolution-In general to see the Created On date in the purchase order forms, you need to map it to attribute BuyerCreationDateTime via Adobe LiveCycle Designer. However in the the output form system will consider the Ordered Date only to display the created on date on the form.-So once the purchase order is posted, you can review the output in the Output History tab. There you can open the pdf file and you will see that the Created On field is filled.-For example: You create a purchase order on 13th June 2018 and Save it as In Preparation status & this will be the Creation Date. Then if you Order it on 15th June 2018, system will considered this date as Created on Date on the forms. For the supplier, the ordered date is more important than the actual creation date.Hence the creation date would appear same as order date  in the forms. since in your case Purchase order is still in status In preparation, the order date would not be there, hence, in the forms the creation date will be empty.-If you still think you need this date on form then contact your partners to add an extension field that will have exact creation date appearing in the PO and map it on to the  output form .-Keywords-Created On date field is missing in the purchase order form; Creation date in PO form; PO form creation date

Title: Error Appears While Doing Post Goods Receipt for Spare Part Return Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have created a spare part return notification and trying to create post goods receipt, however system shows the below error message.-Error: Neg. stock not permitted in custodian ABC material XYZ, identified stock PQR.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Select the query All Delivery Notifications by Selection.-Search for relevant Delivery Notification ID.-Select Post Goods Receipt button.-Error appears.-Resolution-The system does not allow Spare Part Returns after you have been Confirmed as fitted via a Service Confirmation & hence the error message appears.-Note:-The Custodian (Pre Delivered location) doesn't have stock to return, since the service confirmation of that product is already done. If the Service confirmation wasn't done and only the advanced shipment has been done to the pre delivered customer through outbound delivery; then the parts return will be possible; since the stock still exists in the Pre delivered location, error appears.

Title: Delivered Value is Zero in the Monitoring Purchase Orders Report.
Content: Symptom-You have created supplier delivery against a purchase order, now you want to see the Delivered Value (Cost of delivered value) in the Monitoring Purchase Order report. However when you open the Monitoring Purchase Order report, system shows the Delivered Value as 0,00 EUR.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Reports view and select List.-Select the report Monitoring Purchase Orders.-Select View With, then Web Browser.-Enter the Purchase Order ID field and select Go.-You can see that Delivered Value shows as 0,00 EUR.-Cause-Delivered value is Zero in Monitoring Purchase Orders report because the system only considers delivered value for non-stock purchase orders. This is not the case of the given purchase order, which has only to-stock items.-Resolution-System displays the price details only for Goods and Service Receipts document and the same is reflected in the report. The report does not show the Delivered Value for Inbound Delivery documents. Therefore the value is displayed as Zero.

Title: Missing Authorization for Partner Company Details
Content: Symptom-You have created an intercompany supplier invoice, however you are not authorized to view the partner company details through the journal entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice and Credit memos view-Edit the invoice and click View All-Select Document Flow Tab-Click journal entry icon in Supplier Invoice Box-Click the partner company hyperlink-You'll see the following warning: You are not able to open this link due to a missing work center view assignment-Cause-You do not have access to the Partner Companies view under General Ledger.-Resolution-In order to access the partner company details, you need to assign the Partner Companies view (FIN_PARTNERCOMPANIES) to your user.-In case this access right is not listed in the system, you need to scope this element in your implementation project. This access right is enabled once Consolidation Preparation is scoped, which you can find under Financial and Management Accounting -> General Ledger scoping elements.

Title: Performance of Inventory Balance Report
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Inventory Balance and you notice that this report is slow to run or even times out (error Report cannot be opened; report an case.).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Report List in the work center where this report is assigned to (for example work center Physical Inventory).-Open the report Inventory Balance, make a selection and click on Go.-The report loads for a long time and may result in the error Report cannot be opened; report an case.-Cause-The Inventory Balance report is different from other reports in that it retrieves snapshot details and all relevant confirmations for the selected period of time, and aggregates this information. The report basically works with historical transactional data, which can be millions of records (also depending on the amount of data in your system). This is why the loading times for this report are longer than usual.-Resolution-We are constantly working on improving the performance as much as possible considering the nature and the design of the report. In the meantime, please follow the following guidelines to get the required data:-Enter one or several specific products in the selection area.-Should this not be possible, please fill in the other variables like Site, Storage Location and Logistics Area.-The aim is to restrict the amount of data as much as possible.-Alternatively, you can set up a broadcast with this report and send it to the relevant employees via e-mail. This is done in the work center Business Analytics, view Broadcast. Set the format as XML and mark the ZIP checkbox. For details on broadcasts, please also see the help document Broadcasts Quick Guide.-  Keywords-Inventory Balance Report, Report cannot be opened; report an case

Title: Migration of Individual Customers not available
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate Individual Customers but you can't find the respective migration activity.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Select Implementation Projectc view-Open the activity list-The activity Migration of Individual Customer is not available-Cause-There is no specific activity to migrate individual customers-Resolution-You can migrate individual customers using the same activity Migration of Customers.-To define a customer as Individual, you have to set the field Private Account with 'X' in migration template.

Title: System does not accept decimal value during Change of Stock.
Content: Symptom-When performing Change of Stock, the system does not allow decimal value to be entered in the Changed Product Quantity field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Control workcenter.-Open Change of Stock under common task.-Enter the Site ID and other relevant information.-Choose Next.-In the Enter Confirmation Details section, enter decimal value in Changed Product Quantity field against the respective Product ID PQR and Logistics Area ID ABC.-Error message appear as,------>Enter a valid number.-(PQR represents Product ID and ABC represents Logistics Area ID)-Cause-In the Business Configuration Fine Tuning Activity: Quantities and Units of Measure, the field Display Decimals is set as 0 for Unit XY. Therefore system does not accept decimal value for the product with Unit of Measure XY.-(XY represents Unit of Measure)-Resolution-Follow the below steps to maintain Display Decimals in Business Configuration,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Change dropdown to Activities.-Search Quantities and Units of Measure-Choose Open.-Select Create and Maintain Trading Units.-Choose Unit XY and enter the value for Display Decimals as per the Business requirement.-Choose Save and Close.-(XY represents Unit of Measure)-Keywords-Decimal; Change of Stock; Changed Product Quantity field; Quality Control; Product; Quantity; Logistics Area; Valid number;  Business Configuration; Activities; Quantities and Units of Measure; Trading Units

Title: You are Unable to Add Future Activity Plans to a Routing Rule
Content: Symptom-When trying to add Activity Plans that start in the future to a ﻿Routing Rule, you cannot find them.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Suppose you have an Activity Plan DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Activity Plan) that starts tomorrow.-Go to the Activity Planner work center.-Go to the Routing Rules View.-Open Routing Rule XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Routing Rule).-Go to the tab Activity Plan.-Click on Add.-The Activity Plan DEF ﻿is not visible to be selected.-Cause-The Standard query for Activity Plans excludes future date ones.-Resolution-In order to solve this issue, please follow the below steps:-Activity Planner work center.-Go to Routing Rules View.-Open Routing Rule XYZ.-Go to the tab Activity Plan.-Click on Add.-Open the Advanced Search.-From the Valid From field, click on the more Options icon.-Under Options, replace Less than or equal with Greater than or equal.-Click on Go.-Future Activity Plans ﻿are now visible.-Keywords-Activity Plan, Future, Routing Rule

Title: You Can Save An Opportunity Which Has A Product Category But No Product
Content: Symptom-You are able to save an Opportunity although you have only added a Product Category, no an actual Product.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Sales.-Go to the view Opportunities.-Select an Opportunity ABC (ABC represents the name of the Opportunity).-Go to the facet Products.-Click Add to add a row for Products.-Select and add a Product Category 123 (123 represents the name of the Product Category).-Click Save.-Result-The save is successful.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour.-It is possible to add an item in an Opportunity by one of following three ways:-Add product-Add only product category-Add only description (user text)-This flexibilityis provided for users who may not always know the exact product that has to be sold.-

Title: Evaluated Receipt Settlement does not support Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have created a Purchase Order using a supplier for which you have set the Evaluated Receipt Settlement. However, when checking the Purchase Order you have noticed that the Evaluated Receipt Settlement box is unchecked and greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search and select the purchase order XYZ-Select Edit-Go to Items tab-Select the desired item-Under the Settings sections, the ERS box is unchecked and greyed out-Cause-The supplier in use on the purchase order is an intercompany supplier. The supplier is a company which belongs to the company which is creating the purchase order. This scenario is not supported on the system.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected. Intercompany scenario only supports the standard Supplier Invoice process.-Keywords-ERS check box grayed out; ERS check box not available in PO; ERS functionality for intercompany scenario-ers check box disabled in po,ers functionality for intercompany scena

Title: Sales Order Delivery And Invoice Status Are Set To Finished Even Though It Is Partially Delivered
Content: Symptom-In a Sales Order the Delivery Rule is set to Single Delivery - Full Quantity. You have delivered partial quantities instead of full quantities. The system set the Delivery Status and the Invoice Status to Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Sales Orders.-Search and open the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the affected Sales Order).-Go to the Items tab.-Check the affected Items. All of them have been delivered in partial quantities and not in full quantities. The Delivery and Invoice status are set to Finished.-Cause-The reason why the Sales Order has the status Completed even though the Products have been only partially delivered is because of the Delivery Rule you have set for the Sales Order.-The Delivery Rule for Sales Order line items is defined as Single Delivery - Full Quantity, this means that you are expecting/or you intend to delivery all the Products in the Sales Order only in a Single Delivery.-Therefore, once a single Outbound Delivery is created against the Sales Order with this Delivery Rule, the Delivery status of the Sales Order will be updated to Finished. Therefore, the status of the Sales Order is also Completed.-Resolution-If you still wish to deliver the remaining quantity for the line items in the Sales Order please follow the below given steps:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search the Outbound Delivery 123 (123 represents the ID of the affected Outbound Delivery).-Click the button Actions -> Undo Release.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Sales Orders.-Search and open the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the affected Sales Order).-Go to the Items tab.-Select any of the Products which has been partially delivered.-Change the Delivery Rule to "Multiple Deliveries". You should do this for all the Products you wish to deliver.-Save the Sales Order XYZ.-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search the Outbound Delivery 123.-Click the button Actions -> Release.-Once the above steps are performed, the respective line items for which you have changed the Delivery Rule will be available for release in Customer Demand view of Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Once you release these Customer Demands a new Delivery Proposal will be created and visible in Outbound Logistics work center. You can process this proposal with the usual Outbound Delivery processing.-Keywords-Sales Order, Delivery, Invoice Status, Finished

Title: D4C: How to Change The Account-Selection on a Phone Call Activity After Making The Initial Choice
Content: Symptom-You have selected an Account while creating a Phone Call Activity. Then you want to change the Account selection you made, but you cannot find any other Accounts in the drop down menu to do so.-Reproducing the Issue-Via the left menu pane, chose the quick create option for New Phone Call.-OR: Go to the work centre Activities and the view Phone Calls and select New to create a new phone call.-Enter the account XYZ (XYZ represents the account name).-NOTE: A Primary Contact DEF (DEF represents the Primary Contact's name)-Enter a date and time 123 (123 represenst the date and time).-Now go back to the field Account and attempt to change your selection with help from the drop down menu.-Result: Only the Account XYZ which you have already selected will show.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour:-When you select an Account XYZ, the Primary Contact DEF that Account is defaulted.-After making your first entry, te system is now searching only for Accounts which have the Primary Account DEF.-Resolution-You can change your Account selection by first clearing the field Primary Contact before using the Account value help.

Title: PO Item Obligatory For External Employee
Content: Symptom-While releasing the timesheet system throws an error message as follows-- PO item obligatory for external employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Update the times and select the Release button and choose Release All.-The system throws above error message.-Cause-The service agent should be assigned to the same supplier as purchase order supplier.-Resolution-Below are the steps to check and maintain the association between the service agent and supplier-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select the Service Agents View.-Search for the Service Agent XXX.-Select the Edit ->General button.-In the General tab find the Supplier and ensure if he belong to the same Supplier for which Purchase Order is created.

Title: PO Item Obligatory For External Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA:2525032 - Purchase Order not available in the service agent time sheet-While releasing the time sheet system throws an error message as following:-- PO item obligatory for external employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Update the times and select the Release button and choose Release All.-System throws above error message.-Cause-The project purchase order is not enabled for time recording.-Steps to check the Purchase Order.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose the Purchase Orders view.-Find and choose the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the PO).-Choose Edit button.-Go to Items tab.-Choose the service assigned to the service agent.-Here you can see the Time Recording Required field is not enabled or not available, if the field is not enabled for time recording the service agent will not be able to record the time against this project system throws above error message.- Note:If the Purchase order is created from the Project Management work center the Time Recording Required field will be enabled automatically, if the you are creating standalone Purchase request and Purchase Order from the Purchase Requests and Orders work center you have to enable the Time Recording Required field explicitly.-Resolution-Once the Purchase Order is released the system will not enable the selection of time Recording Required field, hence you can cancel the existing purchase order and re-create the purchase order with the time Recording Required field enabled.

Title: Unable to Uncheck Externally-Managed Location on a Activated Site
Content: Symptom-When trying to uncheck the checkbox externally-managed Location on a 3PL site, the below error messages are faced.-"Once activated, de-selecting externally-managed location is not possible"-"It is not possible to change the externally-managed location indicator. Documents related to inbound logistics, outbound logistics, and purchasing still exists for this location."-"Change externally-managed indicator not possible; location not empty"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Choose Locations view.-Select and edit site XYZ. (XYZ means Site ID)-Uncheck the checkbox Externally-Managed Location.-The above mentioned error messages are shown.-Cause-Once an externally-managed Site is activated, it cannot be converted to a internally managed site at a later point of time. At the time of activation an inventory image (snapshot) of the site is created in backend which is used as reference in all production and logistics processes.-Hence changing to external managed to internal managed will cause a lot of inconsistencies in the backend.-Resolution-The system behaves as designed. The recommendation is to create a new site as per the requirement needed and if required the existing externally-managed site can be obsolete.-Keywords-Once activated, de-selecting externally-managed location is not possible, Unable to uncheck the Externally-Managed Location on an Activated Site

Title: In the Sales Quote the Action Set as Won is Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-In a Sales Quote the Action Set as Won is greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Sales workcenter.-2. Go to the Sales Quotes view.-3. Open any Sales Quote with status In Process.-4. Click Actions.-Result: The action Set As Won is greyed out.-Cause-The action Set as Won will be available once the Quote is submitted.-This is also true if you had submitted the Quote before but you have applied a change; therefore it needs to be submitted again.- Resolution-Go to the Sales workcenter.-Go to the Sales Quote view and open the Sales Quote.-Click on Action and click Submit.-Now, you can further perform the Action Set as Won.-In case you do not wish to submit the Quote to the cusotmer after changing it, you have the option to create a document type for Sales Quotes with Direct Customer Acceptance as follows:-1. Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-2. Open the Implementation Project.-3. Open the Activity List.-4. Find and open the activity Sales Quotes.-5. Click Maintain Document Types.-6. Tick the box for Direct Customer Acceptance for the document Sales Quotes.-When you use this document type to create Sales Quotes, you will not need to submit them.

Title: Quantity To Be Invoiced Time Confirmations Are Showing Quantity To Be Written Off
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2956887***-You can see the Time Confirmations are shown as Quantity To Be Written Off. However you expected Quantity To Be Invoiced.-or-How to set the times  to appear automatically as  Time to Be Written off in Project invoice request or In Not invoiced time and expenses-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search and Select the Project XYZ(XYZ represents Project ID)-Select the Edit Time and Expenses button.-Here you can see the Time Confirmations are shown as Quantity To Be Written Off. However you expected them Quantity To Be Invoiced.-Cause-If the quantity To Be Written-Off flag is set true for the respective Assignment Rules, the time confirmations associated to that rule will be available for invoicing as Quantity To Be Written-Off.-Resolution-A)Steps to be followed to correct the existing entries:-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search and Select the Project XYZ.-Select the Edit Time and Expenses button.-Here you can maintain the Quantity To Be Invoiced or delete the Quantity To Be Written Off.-B)steps to be followed to ensure future entries will not be written off:-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search and Select the Project XYZ.-Select the Edit Time and Expenses button.-Select the Edit Assignment Rules button.-Select View All Rules button.-Select the respective Rule.-Here set the To Be Written-Off flag is set untrue and maintain the rules accordingly. -See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Non billable hours

Title: Catalog Gets Stuck In Process When User Tries To Import It To The System.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to import a Catalog to the system however the import gets stuck In Process.
