Later on the import faills.-When another end user try the same, the import is executed successfully.-Environment-SAP Business  ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center.-Go to Catalogs View.-Search for your catalog.-System still shows its import status as In Process.-After several minutes the import faills.-Cause-The import of the catalog is failling for you but not for other users due to the language you are using.-You are using a language that is not scoped in the system (eg: Arabic) while your colleagues use a language that is scoped in the system (eg: English).-Resolution-You need to change the language of your user in order to import the catalog successfully.-Select the option Personalize.-Select My Settings.-Change the language in use for one scoped in your system.-Save the changes.-Log off the system and Log into it again.-Now you should be able to import the catalog with no issue.-Keywords-Catalog import failed,

Title: Purchase Order Acknowledgment does not impact Overdue Status.
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that Purchase Order ABC is considered Overdue by the system, however as per the delivery dates defined in the Purchase Order Acknowledgment, the delivery should be overdue yet.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control Work Center.-Go to Monitor Purchase Orders view.-Search for the purchase order ABC.-System classified the purchase order as Overdue, however as per the dates agreed in the Purchase Order Acknowledgment, the order should not be Overdue yet.-Cause-The Overdue status is not determined by dates on the Purchase Order Acknowledgment. It only considers the Delivery Date entered in the Item information on the purchase order itself.-If this date is overdue, then the order will be classified as Overdue.-Resolution-System is working as expected.

Title: Inventory Is Mapped To Inbound Deliveries After Customer Return Scenario Is Completed.
Content: Symptom-It has been noticed that the Stock Overview query is still showing some items allocated to a particular Inbound Delivery. This Inbound Delivery is part of a Customer Return scenario, which was already completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Select the Common Task Stock Overview.-Search for the desired product.-See the stock for the given product is still allocated to an Inbound Delivery.-Cause-The issue occurs because there is a step on this scenario that is not yet executed.-This particular Customer Return occurs on a Third-Party scenario. For such scenario it has been selected the follow up activity Return to Supplier when processing the Customer Return.-When this option is selected, system expects the return of the product to the supplier once it is returned from the customer, therefore the stock will be allocated until the Return to Supplier is executed.-Resolution-Perform a Return to Supplier for the affected products, the stock will be returned to the supplier and will not be displayed as allocated on the Stock Overview query anymore.-See Also-KBA 2556838 - Stock Not Available During Return to Supplier Process-Keywords-Inventory Is Mapped To Inbound Deliveries After Customer Return Scenario Is Completed, Return to Supplier for the affected products

Title: Cannot find ‘Sales Office’ and ‘Sales Group’ in the Org Structure Functions tab.
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the Sales Office and Sales Group in the Org Structure Functions tab.-Environment-SAP Hyrbis Cloud for Customer (All Versions)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work centre.-Go to Org Structures view.-Select Org Unit XYZ (XYZ represents the Org Unit Name).-Go to the Facet Functions.-You will not be able to see Sales Office or Sales Group.-Cause-If you do not maintain the Sales Office or Sales Group you can get errors such as:-Enter the organiz. Functions Office, Sales in master data for sales office ABC (ABC) – (Where ABC represents the affected Sales Office)- Use another sales office, ABC (ABC) not valid for sales unit DEF (DEF) – (Where DEF represents the affected Sales Unit)-Resolution-You must maintain the Sales data in the Org Structures in order to use the Sales data in Sales Quotes etc.-In order to fix this issue, follow the below steps to maintain the Sales Data in the Organisational Management Work Centre:- Go to Organizational Management work centre-Go to Org Structures view-Select Org Unit XYZ (XYZ represents the Org Unit Name)-Select Adapt and Enter Adaptation Mode-Go to Facet Functions-Select Adapt again and Select Edit Screen-In Screen layout, Select Sales and Services-In the Fields section tick the box for Sales Office and Sales Group- After these steps you can now use these to maintain Sales data.-Keywords-Sales Group, Sales Office, Cannot See, Hidden, Not Visible, Cannot Find, Org Structure

Title: Rolling Demand Plan Does Not Change History And Forecast Dates
Content: Symptom-You are performing the action Roll on a demand plan. You see that the values in fields History Start Date, History End Date, Forecast Start Date and Forecast End Date do not change.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Demand Planning work center.-Navigate to Demand Plans view.-Select the demand plan you want to roll, select the button Roll and choose the option Roll Plan.-In Roll Demand Plan screen you see that the values available under History and Planning Horizon After Roll is the same as Current History and Planning Horizon.-You expect these values to be different.-Cause-The function of rolling a demand plan is to check if the rolling horizon/interval has passed and if so move the demand plan to current horizon dates. The Forecast Start Date of your demand plan is in the current period. Since your planning periods are in the current time period the system will not change these dates while rolling the demand plan.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Demand Plan, Roll, History Start Date, History End Date, Forecast Start Date, Forecast End Date

Title: Net Weight Appears as Zero in the Intrastat Declaration
Content: Symptom-System creates an Intrastat Declaration automatically based on Intrastat declaration run, however the Net Weight appears as zero in the Intrastat Declaration.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declarations view-Select the relevant Declaration-Select Edit & navigate to Items tab-You can see that, the Net Weight appears as Zero-Cause-You have not maintained the Net Weight in the material master data which forms the basis for net weight calculation.-Resolution-You have to maintain the Net Weight in the Material master data, before you create a delivery documents. As soon as delivery (Outbound & Inbound) documents are posted, information will be sent to Intrastat.-To know the product ID which is used in the Intrastat Declaration, please follow the below steps;-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declarations view-Select the relevant Declaration-Select Edit & navigate to Items tab-Select sub tab References & open the Goods Movement ID-From here, you can see which Product ID is used in the Intrastat Declaration item-To know where to maintain the Net Weight in Material master, please follow the below steps;-Open the corresponding Goods Movement ID-Open the Product ID-Navigate to General tab-Select UoM Charecteristics sub tab-Net Weight is not maintained-Select Add Row and maintain Net Weight-Select Save

Title: Change Receiving Site In Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created and sent the purchase order to your supplier. You want to be able to change the receiving site of a particular line item in the same purchase order.  -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option New Purchase Order.-Enter the relevant mandatory fields and choose the Order button.-Navigate to Items tab and choose the sub-tab Delivery.-Select the line item for which you have to change the receiving site.-You see that it is not possible to change the value in the field Site.-Cause-Once the purchase order is sent to your supplier the system will not allow you to change the Site to which the product should be delivered. The Ship-To location can be changed since a site can have multiple Ship-To locations under a site.-Resolution-Please follow the below given steps as a work around to change the receiving site of a line item in a purchase order which is already sent to supplier.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option New Purchase Order.-Navigate to Items tab and select the line item for which the receiving site needs to be changed.-Choose the button Copy.-In the newly create line item enter the Ship-To location which belongs to the Site which you wanted to update.-Select the line item from which you had copied the new line item and choose the Cancel button.-Choose the button Send Update to send the changed information to your supplier.

Title: The Extension Field Created in Sales order is not Updating the Values in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field in the Sales Order object, and extended the same to the Customer Invoice object. However the extension field is not updating the values in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Edit the Sales Order and select the View All button.-Go to the General tab and navigate to General section of the screen.-Here you will find the extension fields ABC (ABC represents the name of the extension field).-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search and open the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request created for the sales order XYZ.-The Outbound Delivery Invoice Request does not have the extension field at header or item level.-Cause-The extension fields can flow from Sales Order to Sales Order Invoice Request if the extension scenario Sales Order General Information -> Invoice Request General information is selected.-If you have selected the extension scenario Sales Order General Information -> Outbound Delivery Request then you should also select the scenario-Outbound Delivery General Information -> Invoice Request General Information so that the extension field is seen in Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-There are 2 options to pass the value of an extension field from Sales Order to the Invoice.-Option 1:-You want to pass the value directly from the Sales Order to the Invoice via the Invoice request, in this case:-Only activate the extension scenarios:-Sales Order General Information -> Invoice Request General information-Invoice Requests - General Information to Customer Invoice - General Information-This means that the value of the extension field is passed from the Sales Order to the Sales Order Invoice Request and when the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is Invoiced it will capture the value from the Sales Order Invoice Request. This is only possible if no other extension scenario is activated apart from Sales Order General Information -> Invoice Request General information and  Invoice Requests - General Information to Customer Invoice - General Information-  Option 2:-You would like to pass the value via the logistic documents in this case you can activate:-Sales Order General Information -> Invoice Request General information-Sales Order General Information -> Outbound Delivery Request General information-Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Outbound Delivery - Information-Outbound Delivery General Information -> Invoice Request General Information-Invoice Requests - General Information to Customer Invoice - General Information-Please note that the outbound delivery has priority over the sales order, the data from outbound delivery overwrites the data from the sales order.-See Also-KBA 2380268 - Extension Field Value is not Populating in Invoice Documents-Keywords-extension field, outbound delivery, invoice request, sales order invoice request

Title: Multiple Level of Hierarchy Cannot be Created at The Same Time During Migration of Installation Points
Content: Symptom-Multiple Level of Hierarchy Cannot be Created at The Same Time During Migration of Installation Points.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work center-Select the Implementation Projects View-Open Activity List-Navigate to Integrate and Extend Tab-Open the Actvity Migration of Installation Points-Enter the details and Execute the Migration-Go to Installed Base workcenter view-Open the ID for which you performed Migration-Go to Items Tab-You can notice that the Child item gets created before Parent is created-Cause-Multiple levels of hierarchy cannot be created at the same time, which is an expected system behavior.-Resolution-Users have to create all the items of hierarchy level 1. Then create the level below it giving the IDs of hierarchy level 1 as parent and so on.This is because of parallelization i.e., the system creates multiple Installation Points at the same time . If the excel has installation points of multiple hierarchies then it’s possible that the child gets created before the parent and hence the relationship cannot be maintained.-In order to control this and reduce the number of times we execute migration template to create hierarchies (which might have more than 2 or 3 levels), we can follow the below approach.-Create all installation points in the same level ( level 1 ) using the migration mode “Add new records”.-Leave the parent installation point field in the template blank-Depending on the installation point type, different data has to be maintained-Execute migration-All the installation points will be created in the same level in the Items tab in Installed Base-Take the same file which has been used for upload, copy it to create a new file. Choose migration mode as “Replace already existing records”-Keep all the data same as before, don’t modify any data. Add the data in the column “Parent Installation Point ID” as per hierarchy requirement.-Execute migration. Migration will be completed successfully.-Item hierarchy will be created as per the data maintained in the input file.-See Also-http://scn.sap.com/community/cloud-for-customer/blog/2015/11/12/how-to-create-installation-point-hierarchy-using-migration-template-

Title: E-Invoices for Switzerland
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-ARCHIVE REASON: the e-invoicing functionality is now available in ByDesign -In Switzerland, as of January 1, 2016, suppliers to the Federal Administration with sales documents valued at or above 5000 CHF will be required to utilize e-invoices.-Is this functionality available in SAP Business ByDesign?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The feature for e-invoicing is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-We have forwarded the request this functionality as feedback to our product planning process. We are continuously extending our products with new functions and appreciate your feedback. Unfortunately it is not possible for our Support Team to provide you additional information regarding the availability of this feature in a future release. For further information regarding your request please contact your sales contact (Account Manager/Customer Advocate/Solution Advisor).-If you would like to post a question to the On-Demand Solutions community or start a discussion with other customers, please access the "Community Forums" in the Business Center (http://www.sme.sap.com --> "Community & Learning").

Title: Purchasing Unit Not Determined from Contract in a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In a Contract, the Purchasing Unit is being maintained. When assigning the same Contract as a Source of Supply in a new Purchase Order, the same Purchasing Unit is not being determined. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Common Task view and select New Purchase Order.-Click in View All button.-Navigate to Items Tab.-Choose Add Row button.-Navigate to Source of Supply subtab.-Enter Contract ABC (ABC is the Contract ID).-Navigate to General Tab.-Purchasing Unit XYZ has not been determined automatically, even though it is being maintained in the Contract. -Cause-System does not pick up the reference of Purchasing Unit from a Contract to a Purchase Order.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-The user has to manually select the Purchasing Unit in the new Purchase Order document.-Keywords-Purchasing Unit, Contract, Purchase Order, Source of Supply

Title: Product Specification Of Output Product Is Automatically  Assigned To Input Product.
Content: Symptom-The Production Order has the Product Specification XYZ (XYZ means Product Specification) assigned to the output product. However, the specification XYZ is assigned to a few of the input products in the production order also.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Navigate to the Production Orders view.-Search for the relevant production order and choose the Edit button.-Navigate to the Products tab, under the Input Product sub-tab it can be seen that a few of the input products have product specification XYZ assigned to them.-Cause-The system will automatically assign product specification of the output product to input products also. However, for the system to assign product specification of the output product to the available input product the below condition should be met:-In master data of the input product, the Identified Stock Type field value should be selected as either Mandatory Specified Stock or Optional Specified Stock.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Production Specification, Production Order, Product, Identified Stock.

Title: Error Message : Cannot Derive FY/Period From Start Date DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2198823***-You are not able to see Planned Values for a project.-Environment-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue workcenter-Choose the Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Press View Planned Values.-Under the Messages tab you can see an error message Cannot derive FY/period from start date DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-The Start Date and End Date maintained for the project define an interval referring to a fiscal year not yet created in the system.-Example: The Start Date is set to the 01.01.2015 and the End Date to the 30.12.2020. If you have not created the Fiscal Year 2020 in the system yet, the error message will be reported.-Resolution-You need to create the relevant Fiscal Year for the Company.-Go to the General Ledger workcenter.-Choose the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Select the relavent Company and Set of Books.-Press Edit Fiscal Years.-Press New Fiscal Year.-Please note that you can have only three Financial Years open in the system at any given point of time.-If you have you define any fiscal year variant as year-specific you have to maintain the required periods in continuation.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose Implementation Projects view.-Choose your implementation project and choose Open Activity List.-Choose the activity Other Fiscal Year  from the activity list.-Choose the Fiscal Year Variants.-Under period details maintain the required periods in a continuation.-For instance start date of project is 01.01.2015 and end date is 30.12.2020, in this case all the accounting periods has to be maintain for year 2015, 2016, 2017,2018,2019 and 2020.-See Also

Title: Cannot Add Contract Item in a Service Order Item Line
Content: Symptom-You cannot add the contract item in a service order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Open service order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select line item XX (XX represents the number of the line item).-The field Contract Item is disabled and you are therefore not able to enter the contract ID and line item number to which you want to assign the line item.-Cause-The line item XX has been released to the service execution.-Once you have released an item to execution either via th Release Execution button or the Submit -> Release to Service Execution button the field Contract Item will be read only.-The reason for this restriction is the following:-Once Release Execution is performed in a service order, the item info has already been passed to the service confirmation/invoicing and therefore it is not possible to add a reference contract to service order as this will disrupt the complete process.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Restrict Duplicated Entries for Purchase Order Excel Upload.
Content: Symptom-User would like to restrict duplicated entries for Purchase Order using Excel Upload.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center, choose the Purchase Orders view-Select New button and choose Import from Microsoft Excel®-Import a Purchase Order using the ID of an already existent order-System changes the ID and import the document without any warning-Cause-When user creates a new Purchase Order using Excel Add-on, system will not give any message informing that the order is duplicated.-System will just change the Document ID number for the next available number and save the document to the system.-Resolution-The system has no feature which restricts duplicated entries for Purchase Order using Excel Add-on.

Title: In the output form of Purchase order,Phone number or fax or email or website is not displayed for the Ship To Location
Content: Symptom-While previewing the purchase order ABC the phone number or fax or email or website is not being displayed for the ship-to party XYZ-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select purchase order ABC (ABC is the identification of the purchase order).-Click the Edit button.-Click the Preview button.-In the ship-to section-Go to the Organizational Management work center-Go to the Org Structures view-Click the Find button-Select unit XYZ (XYZ is the identification of the organization unit).-Go to the General tab-The telephone number is maintained.-Cause-The ship-to party from the purchase order picks up the data from the corresponding location. The location gets created after creating the organization unit to it. In this case it was the organization unit XYZ.-Once the location has been created there is no update activity between the organization unit and the location.-If any new field is updated in the organization unit at a later date, it will not update the location as they are two different entities.-Hence it is very important to make sure that the organization unit has the correct address details and all data at the time of organization unit creation.-Resolution-The system is working as designed-Keywords-telephone, email address,

Title: Withholding Tax Related Work Center Views Are Not Visible For Non-Localized Countries
Content: Symptom-You have finished the setup to enable withholding tax for a non-localized country according to the Localization Toolkit documentation, however you cannot find the withholding tax related work center views under Tax Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center-Notice that the withholding tax work center views are missing (Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries, Withholding Tax Returns and Withholding Tax Return Runs).-Cause-The scoping of business topic Withholding Tax is controlled by country. Currently the enablement of this business topic is tied to the scoping of one of the countries for which SAP has delivered dedicated withholding tax content.-Resolution-In order to enable the withholding tax related views, in addition to your non-localized country already scoped you need to scope one of the countries for which there's dedicated withholding tax content available.-These countries are:-AU - Australia-BE - Belgium-BR - Brazil-CA - Canada-CN - China-EG - Egypt-ES - Spain-FR - France-GB - Great Britain-IN - India-IT - Italy-MX - Mexico-US - United States-Steps to be taken:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the First Implementation project and click Edit Project Scope-Under Country section click Edit Countries-From the Available Countries list, choose one country, select it and move to Selected Countries-Click OK-Logoff and logon again and you should start seeing the withholding tax related views.-Remark: the obligation to scope one of the above countries in order to enable the withholding tax views is being reviewed. With the Business ByDesign 1602 release (expected for February 2016) this obligation may no longer exist.-See Also-Localization Toolkit page within SAP Business Center: https://wiki.sme.sap.com/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?title=Localization+Toolkit&spaceKey=OnDemandWiki

Title: System Does Not Display Purchase Orders with Status Cancelled in Monitoring Purchase Orders Report
Content: Symptom-The user is unable to see the Purchase Orders with Cancelled status in report Monitoring Purchase Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center. -Go to Reports view and List sub-view.-Search for Monitoring Purchase Orders report.-Open it.-Choose Go.-The system does not display status Cancelled for any purchase orders under column Purchase Order Status.-Cause-The report Monitoring Purchase Orders do not display cancelled purchase orders. This is the expected behavior. -Resolution-In order to get Purchase Orders with Cancelled status in a report, the user has to create a new custom report using Data Source SRMPO_B02.-See Also-Help Portal: Monitoring Purchase Orders-Keywords-purchase order, cancelled purchase order, canceled purchase order, monitoring purchase orders, report, Purchase Order Status, SRMPO_B02

Title: Cancellation Of Third-Party Sales Order Does Not Reflect In Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-A third-party sales order was canceled. However, it has been noticed that the corresponding customer demand has the cancellation status as Cancelation Requested. It is expected that the cancellation status change to Canceled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to Customer Demand view.-Search for the sales order which it was canceled.-The cancellation status of customer demand document is Cancelation Requested.-Cause-When a third-party sales order document is released, system will create a third-party purchase order document as well. It was created a PO Acknowledgement against this third-party purchase order which has quantity deviations. These quantity deviations have not yet been accepted. Once these deviations are accepted the cancellation status of customer demand will be updated to Canceled.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to Purchase Orders view.-Search the relevant third-party purchase order, select it, and choose the Edit button.-In Edit screen of the purchase order, select the link Check Deviating Purchase Order Acknowledgment which is visible on the top left-hand side of the screen.-Choose Yes or No on the dialogue box that is displayed as per your business requirement.-In PO acknowledgement screen choose the button Accept Deviation.-The purchase order will be cancelled and also the cancelation status of customer demand document will be updated to Canceled.-Please note that the purchase order will be cancelled automatically only of the Supplier Status in PO Acknowledgement document is Rejected. If the Supplier Status is Accepted, it will have to explicitly cancel the purchase order document from your end. This will update the cancellation status of the customer demand.-Keywords-Third-party sales order, Cancelation Requested, PO Acknowledgement

Title: Time Accounts Weekly Report Shows Cumulative Data
Content: Symptom- In The Time Accounts Reports Weekly The Hours Being Shown Are Cummulative-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Time Administration-Select view Reports: List -Find the report Employee Times: Weekly-The data shows cumulative value and not in detail-Cause-The Posting Date and Time Account Type fields need to be added to the rows in the report to get the detailed report-Resolution-The System works as designed. This is the same behaviour in the Time Accounts Report - Monthly, Quarterly and Yearly

Title: Total Panned Cost is Showing as Zero in Project WIP Report
Content: Symptom-Planned cost in the Project WIP Report is supposed to reflect estimated cost for a given material based on the responsbile unit of the project.-All of the materials used have shown missing planned cost in this report inspite of current estiamted cost maintained in the Material Valuation view.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports View.-Find Project WIP Report and click on it.-Enter the required parameters and project in question.-You will observe that the Total Planned Cost is showing with value zero.-Cause-Go to Cost and Revnues work center-Select Projects view-Find the Project XYZ-Click on View Plan Values-Select Messages tab-You will see the messages with the error messages as-Valuation of material ABC in business residence 123 failed on DD.MM.YYYY-Valuation of material PQR in business residence 123 failed on DD.MM.YYYY-Resolution-Maintain the estimated cost of materials in the valuation view of the materials in question and if you do not want the total plan cost to show as zero.-Go to Cost and Revenues work center.-Select Projects view.-Find the project in question again.-Click on View Plan Values tab.-Select Valuate All button.-Now since you have maintained the estimated cost of materials the error status will turn green from red. Refresh the screens and reopen the report and now the total planned cost will be reflected correctly instead of zero.

Title: Project Cost And Revenue By Project Structure Report Error.
Content: Symptom-You have a sales order with multiple line items assigned to a project task. When you check the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report, you see that for one of your line items the report does not display value for Sales Order Cost Estimate coloumn correctly.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Navigate to Reports view and choose List sub-view.-Search for Project Cost And Revenue By Project Structure report and open it for the relevant sales order.-You see that the value for field Sales Order Cost Estimate for a line item AAA for the above sales order is not visible.-Cause-The reason why you are not able to see the Sales Order Cost Estimate value of the product in the sales order line item Id AAA is because you have rejected the line item from the sales order.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.

Title: Printing the whole Project
Content: Symptom-You want to print the whole Project with the  Project Overview, Project Tasks and other details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Search the Project ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Project).-Click the Edit button and select Project Plan.-Go to the Gantt Chart subtab.-Click the Print button.-You are only able to Print the Gantt Chart and not the whole Project.-Cause-In the current release it is not possible to print the whole Project.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-You are only able to Print the Gantt Chart as mentioned above.

Title: Creator Of Attachment On The Purchase Order Changes On The Goods And Service Receipt.
Content: Symptom-An attachment is created on the Purchase Order ABC by the user XXX.-When user YYY creates the Goods and Service Receipt for the Purchase Order ABC, system shows YYY as creator of the attachment.-You expect the system to show the user XXX as the creator of the attachment since XXX is the one who uploaded the attachment to the system at the first moment.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work center.-Go to Purchase Orders to be Delivered view.-Select the purchase order ABC.-Select New Goods and Services Receipt.-See that the creator of the attachment included in the receipt's item is shown as the creator of the receipt itself, not the user who uploaded the attachment on the purchase order.-Cause-When user YYY creates a goods and service receipt with reference to a purchase order, system copies the information from the purchase order, creating a new attachment.-Although the file is the same, it is a different instance, created by a different user, hence the system displays the user YYY as creator of the attachment on the receipt, not the user XXX who created it on the purchase order.-Resolution-System is working as expected.

Title: Tax Number of an Account is Not Displayed in the XML for Customer Contracts
Content: Symptom-The tax number of an account is not displayed in the XML file of the customer contracts.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Form Template Maintenance view.-Select the respective Customer Contract Confirmation form template.-Click on the Open button and select the Easy Form Editor option.-In the section Contact Information click on the Add button and select the Field option.-Navigate to FormCustomerContractNotification -> CustomerContract-You cannot find the element TaxationTerms -> BuyerTaxID (TaxationTerms-BuyerTaxID) to add it to the form template.-Cause-Unfortunately it is currently not possible to include the tax ID in the customer contract form template.-The customer tax ID is usually located under TaxationTerms in the form XML. TaxationTerms is a node of the contract Business Object but it is not currently part of the Message Form Type for customer contract and therefore cannot be added in the form template.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.

Title: In the Invoice Volume Report the Company (Sales Unit) for a Sales Unit is Displayed as Unassigned
Content: Symptom-In the Invoice Volume report the Company (Sales Unit) for sales unit ABC is displayed as Unassigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center. -Select the Reports view.-Open the Invoice Volume report.-Add Sales Unit in the Edit Selection section.-Enter the respective Time Frame.-Enter sales unit ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales unit)-Click on Go.-Add Company (Sales Unit) to the Rows.-You can see that in the column Company (Sales Unit) for sales unit ABC the system displays no value but instead # Not assigned for all invoices which were created with sales unit ABC. Invoices from other sales units are displayed correctly.-Cause-The column Sales Unit displays the value of the sales unit present in the invoice and the column Company(Sales Unit) displays the value of the company associated with the Invoicing Unit. If the invoicing unit is not marked as company in your Organizational Management the respective invoice will have no value assigned in the Company(Sales Unit) column in the report.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: A Task is not Visible in the Work Center Account Management
Content: Symptom-You create a task for an employee inside the Work Center Account, but this task does not appear in the queue.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management Work Center.-Click on Accounts.-Search for XYZ Account.-Click on New and then Task.-Create a task for someone.-Save.-Try to search for the same task in the Activities view.-You can’t find the task.-Cause-When you create a task for an employee, you are delegating this task, therefore it won’t appear in the Activities view.-Resolution-The task created appears on the following steps.-Go to Home Work Center.-Click on Delegated Tasks.-The task will be showing there.

Title: Cannot Order Intercompany Purchase Order XYZ due to an Error Message
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a new intercompany purchase order and trying to order it. However you have received the below error message.-Error:-Error during Purchase Order Output-Reactivate communication arrangement for company ABC business partner DEF.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders  work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the Purchase Order XYZ-Select Check or Order button-Error appears-Cause-This is an intercompany purchase order and you are communicating via Internal EDX. For this communicaiton type, you must have a valid communication arrangement which should be Active in your system. However the communication scenario -Purchase Order Integration using SOAP/IDoc is not Active in yet in your system for the business partner DEF and hence the error message appears.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to activate the communication scenario;-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the Input and Output Management view-Select Communication Arrangements-Select the Communication Scenario -Purchase Order Integration using SOAP/IDoc-Select Activate button

Title: Receiving Projects are Not Available While Creating New Distribution Rule
Content: Symptom-You are not able to select the project receivers while creating New Distribution Rule for Cost Centers.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue workcenter-Navigate to the Allocation view and here to the Distribution Rules subview.-Select New->New Distribution Rule for Cost Centers.-Enter the required parameters for Sender and Select Receiver Type is Projects/Project Tasks.-Go to Next Step: Select Receivers.-Here we can see no project is avialable to select under Available Projects table.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. You can only create Distribution Rules for the Project Type: Direct Cost projects. Other Project Types are not supported to create Distribution Rules for Cost Centers.

Title: Cancelation Invoice Shows in Wrong Period in the Invoice Volume Report
Content: Symptom-Cancelation Invoice shows in wrong period in the Invoice Volume Report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work center.-Select the Design Reports View-Search for the report Invoice Volume.-Give selection parameters and run the report-You see that cancelation invoice is shown in the wrong period.-Cause-The Invoice Volume report is run based on the invoice date not in the accounting post date.-Resolution-Since the Invoice Volume report is run based on the invoice date not the accounting post date you need to check always the invoice date of the document.-Example:-The cancellation credit memo XXX was invoiced in Jan 2015 and therefore appears in the report for Jan 2015 not in December of 2014. (XXX represents the ID of the cancellation credit memo)

Title: Purchase Order Status
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order status is displayed as "Sent", "Not Yet Acknowledged" or "Acknowledgment Received" after the Purchase Order is created and sent to the Supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents Purchase Order ID).-Select it.-The Purchase Order's status is "Sent", "Not Yet Acknowledged" or "Acknowledgment Received".-Cause-The Purchase Order status is Sent, Not Yet Acknowledged, or Acknowledgment Received based on the Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected checkbox selected during ordering.-To confirm this, follow the below steps,-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC.-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Basic data sub-tab.-Here, under the section "Follow-up Documents", the "Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected" checkbox is enabled.-The Purchase Order status is determined as follows:-Not Yet Acknowledged: The Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected flag is selected, but no acknowledgment has been received yet.-Acknowledgment Received: The Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected flag is selected and an acknowledgment has been received from the Supplier.-Sent: The Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected flag is not selected during ordering.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order Status; Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected; Sent; Not Yet Acknowledged; Acknowledgment Received

Title: Plan Values not Calculated - 'Cannot Derive FY/period From Start Date'
Content: Symptom-In the Projects view of the Cost and Revenue workcenter, no plan values are calculated for project XYZ. The error message displayed mentions that the fiscal year/period could not be derived:--'Cannot derive FY/period from start date DD.MM.YYYY (company ABC / SoB DEF)'.--This problem leads to not having the Total Planned Cost calculated under the Project Overview tab in the project.-XYZ means Project ID.-ABC means Company ID and Name.-DEF means Set of Books ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue workcenter.-Choose the Projects view.-Select project ID XYZ.-Click View Planned Values.-Under the Messages tab you can see an error message 'Cannot derive FY/period from start date DD.MM.YYYY (company ABC / SoB DEF)'.-Cause-The Start Date and End Date maintained for the project define an interval referring to a fiscal year not yet created in the system.-Example: The Start Date is set to the 28.07.2015 and the End Date to the 05.02.2016. If you have not created the Fiscal Year 2016 in the system yet, the error message will be generated.-Resolution-You need to create the relevant Fiscal Year for the Company and Set of Books mentioned in the error message, as follows:-Go to the General Ledger workcenter.-Choose the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Select the revelant Company and Set of Books.-Click Edit Fiscal Years.-Click New Fiscal Year.-Please note that you can have only three fiscal years open in the system at any given point of time.-If you have defined any fiscal year variant as year-specific you have to maintain the required periods in continuation, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose Implementation Projects view.-Choose your implementation project and choose Open Activity List.-Choose the activity Other Fiscal Year from the activity list.-Choose the Fiscal Year Variants.-Under period details maintain the required periods in a continuation.-For instance, if the start date of project is 01.01.2015 and end date is 30.12.2020, in this case all the accounting periods have to be maintained for years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2020.-See Also-Keywords-Plan values, Project, Fiscal year

Title: Profit Center Derivation Error Upon Posting Asset Acquisition
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice or goods and services receipt (GSR) with cost assignment to an individual material. Nevertheless the document cannot be posted due to errors concerning a profit center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-You find the concerned un-posted invoice or GSR with the following messages:-Define a default profit center for company <company ID> (<company name>) and subledger Fixed Assets-Profit center for posting derived from asset <company ID>-<asset ID> and posting date <date>-Defaulting profit center for Goods and Services Receipt <GSR ID> and subledger Fixed Assets-Cause-The profit center assignment validity to the fixed asset starts after the posting date of the supplier invoice or GSR document.-Therefore the document appears as unposted source document as the profit center assignment cannot be identified on the desired acquisition posting date.-Resolution-If the fixed asset has been created manually and there have not been any previous acquisition postings for this Fixed asset, meaning the fixed asset is not capitalized yet:-Either extend the profit center assignment interval start date in the Fixed Asset Master data:-1. In the fixed Asset navigate to the Master Data - Basic Data tab.-2. Press Add Row and maintain the Interval Start Date on or before the posting date of the supplier invoice/ GSR.-3. After this post the source document in the Source Documents view of the General Ledger via Actions - Post Business Transaction.-Or post the source document on or after the start date of the profit center assignment interval:-1. In the Source Documents view of the General Ledger choose Actions - Post Business Transaction to another period.-2. Enter an Alternative Posting Date on or after the interval start date.-3. Press OK.-If the Fixed asset has already been capitalized then the supplier invoice/ GSR can only be posted on or after the latest acquisition posting date of the fixed asset:-1. In the Values tab of the fixed asset go to the Journal sub-tab.-2. Here check the posting date of the latest acquisition.-3. The new supplier invoice/ GSR can only be posted on or after this posting date as described above.-Keywords-default profit center; subledger fixed assets; organizational assignment; profit center accounting; segment accounting

Title: Invoice Date in the Project Based Sales Order Item is Different Than the Date of Invoicing
Content: Symptom-The Invoice Date in the Project based sales order item is different than the date of invoicing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view and in the Find field search with ABC(where ABC is the sales order id).-Open Sales Order ABC and click on the Edit button and further on the View ALL button.-Go to the Items tab and in the Details Item section below.-Here you can for an item YY(where YY is the Project based Item) the Invoice Date is XX. YY. ZZZZ.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view and in the Find field search with reference to Sales Order ABC.-You can see there is a Customer Project Invoice Request with the reference to the item YY ,in which Invoice Date is showing as XX1. YY1. ZZZZ1.-Cause-The Invoice Date that you see in Sales Order ABC->Item YY is the proposed invoice date for that item.-We always default this date to the Creation-On date of the Sales Order ,which can be manually change in the follow-up document i. e. within Customer Project Invoice Request or Invoice Document and this will be consider as the actual invoice date.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Reference Documents Field Missing in the New Scanned Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-You are creating new scanned invoice from the Supplier Invoicing work center. However the field Reference Documents missing in the new scanned invoice screen and you cannot select the order references.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks section.-Select New Scanned Invoice.-You cannot see the standard field Reference Documents (Order ID).-Cause-You have not scoped the prerequisite i.e. Purchase Requests and Orders work center in your scoping and hence the field "Reference Documents" is not visible in the New Scanned Invoice screen. In order to enable this field, the Purchase Order must exist in the system.-Resolution-You need to scope the Purchase Requests and Orders work center in your scoping. Because always the reference document for the invoice will be the purchase order document and it is mandatory to have them in the system to enable the Reference Documents field. Once it is scoped, you should be able to see the Reference Documents field in the New Scanned Invoice screen.-Note: Under the Reference Documents field you can see a sub field Order ID and from here you need to select the relevant Purchase Order ID.-Keywords-New Scanned Invoice, Supplier Invoicing, Reference Documents, Missing

Title: Catalogs File Template Not Supported By 64 Bit MS Office
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload Catalogs to the system using the Microsoft Excel template, however you are not able to do so due to a message informing that the template must be in 64-bit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Catalogs view-Download the Catalog File Template-Open it-Receive the message-Cause-System is working as expected. Catalog templates do not support Office 64 bits.-Resolution-In order to use the templates it is necessary to use a 32 bits version of the Microsoft Office.

Title: Unable to Get Batch Specific Alternative Quantity for a Material in Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find Alternative Quantity for a material though you have Flagged the material as Batch Managed and maintained a conversion factor for an Identified Stock as well.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Choose Stock Overview.-Now Personalize the screen and make the field Alternative Quantity visible under section Untitled Table.-Enter the relevant Material ID which is Batch Managed and Conversion factor maintained for respective Identified Stock.-Choose Go.-Here you are unable to find any value in Alternative Quantity column for above Material ID in stock overview screen.-Cause-The system uses batch conversion to display quantities in Alternative Unit of Measurement. This helps to calculate the Alternate Quantity according to the UoM of your choice.-Resolution-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Choose Stock Overview.-Navigate to Personalize option on the top of the screen.-Go to section Display Settings and mark field Alternative Unit of Measure.-Perform Save.-Enter relevant Material ID and then navigate to section Display Settings in stock overview screen.-In the field Alternative unit of measure, using drop down select Unit of Measure as per your choice.-Choose Go.-Now system displays an alternative Quantity as required.

Title: How to Get Planning Proposal Details in a Report
Content: Symptom-How to create a report containing detailed information of all Planning Proposals-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-A new customized report can be created using the "Material Supply and Demand List" Data Source, which provides information for all Proposal types.-Resolution-Create a Customized Report using Data Source ID: SCMMSDVV02 with description Material Supply and Demand List.-Once the report is created, the proposal details can be obtained by filtering using the field Category using the below values-Purchase Proposal-Purchase Proposal (Firm)-Production Proposal-Firm Production Proposal-Dependent Demand (Proposal)-Production Request-Dependent Demand (Request)-Stock Transfer Demand-Stock Transfer Demand in Execution-Stock Transfer Proposal-Stock Transfer Demand Proposal-Note: The Data Source Material Supply and Demand List, provides more details related to planning using other Categories as well. -Keywords-Purchase Proposal; Category; Material Supply and Demand List; Production Proposal; Proposal; Stock Transfer; Purchase Proposal; SCMMSDVV02; Planning proposal

Title: Unit of Measure Conversion between Days and Months.
Content: Symptom-System converts a Month as 30,436875 Days in the business documents like Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center-Go To Purchase Requests View-Select the filter All Purchase Requests, search for the Purchase Request ABC-Create a Purchase Order from Purchase Request ABC-In the Items tab, the Quantity is changed to Days-While creating a Purchase Order, the Unit of Measure (UoM) is converted to Days and takes Months as "1 month = 30,436875 days" in the UoM field.-Cause-The reason being the months do not have always the same quantity of days. Also, the conversion between days and months is a known conversion and  is not necessary to maintain this conversion in the master data.-This is a business decision to have the definition of 1 month = 30,436875 days. This is based on the Gregorian calendar, where a month length is defined as 30.436875 days.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-In order to make number of days an integer (30 or 31 days), you will have to manually edit the data in the UoM field in the business document.

Title: Purchasing Quanity gets changed in the Warehouse Request and Task
Content: Symptom-Purchasing Quantity gets changed by system when you are creating Warehouse Request and Tasks. For Instance: You purchased 0.101 Tons and the Inbound Delivery Notification shows 0.101 Tons. However, when creating a warehouse request and task, the value gets changed to 0,09162565874 Tons.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-On the Purchase Order side, you have ordered a Product with Quantity of  Y: (Y represents the Quantity of the Product):-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Find and select the relevant Purchase Order.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Line Items tab.-You can see the Quantity Y.-When you check the Quantity in Warehouse Request or Warehouse Task (Put Away), the Quantity is different.-Go To Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go To Task Control View.-Find and select the relevant Warehouse Task.-You can see the Open Quantity is Z (Z represents the exact Open Quantity) , which is different from Purchase Order Quantity Y.-Cause-The Quantities are different, because you have maintained different Unit of Measure for Purchase and Inventory (Logistics) in the Product Master data. Warehouse Request and Task (Execution) always use the Inventory Unit of Measure.-For example, let us consider the following:-Purchase Unit of Measure is Ton (US) which is short ton, while Inventory Unit of Measure is Ton (metric).-1 Ton (metric) = 1000kg.-1 Ton (US) = 907,18474 kg.-If the Order Quantity is 0,101 Ton (US) for the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID),then:-0,101 Ton (US) = 91,62565874 kg-91,62565874 kg = 0,09162565874 Ton (metric).--Hence, the Quantity in the Warehouse Request and Task is 0,09162565874 Ton (metric).-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-To avoid any change in the Quantity, you have to maintain the same Unit of Measure for Purchase and Inventory in the Product Master Data.-Keywords-UoM, Conversion UoM, Purchase Order, Warehouse Request, Warehouse Task, Inventory

Title: Unable to locate Shipments View under Outbound Logistics Work Center
Content: Symptom-User is unable to locate Shipments View under Outbound Logistics Work Center-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Outbound Logistics Work Center-The Shipments View is missing-Cause-Shipments View is not assigned to the user in the Work Center and View Assignment under Application and User Management Work Center.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to assign the Shipments View, which will resolve the issue.-Go To Application and User Management Work Center-Go To Business Users subview under User and Access Management View-Search for the User-Select the User and click on Edit -> Access Rights-Go To Work Center and View Assignment Tab-Search for SCM_SHIPMENTS View-Check the box under Assigned Column-Save the transaction

Title: Custom Shortcut Names are Set Back to their Default Values
Content: Symptom-You have renamed the Shortcuts accessible via the Business ByDesign Taskbar on the left side of your screen. When logging in, all names are set back to their default values.-Reproducing the Issue-After logging in, open Shortcuts from the Business ByDesign Taskbar on the left-Right-Click on any Shortcut and rename it-Log out of your Business ByDesign System by clicking the Log Off-Button in the upper right corner-Log in again, but this time choose another language than before-You will notice that your Shortcuts have default names again. Even if you log in again using your usual language, only default names are shown.-Cause-If you rename one or more of your Shortcuts in current versions of SAP Business ByDesign, a 'Change Transaction' is created for your system and its current language in your systems backend. As currently only one Change Transaction can exist, it will be overwritten by default values once you log in in another language.-Resolution-As of now, this is a limitation of SAP Business ByDesign. We therefore recommend that you chose a default language and avoid logging in in another language. If you have to do so, you should take a note of your custom names for your system before, so you can set your old names again if required.

Title: Stores Cannot Be Created in SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-You want to create new stores, but the New button is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Stores work center.-Select the Stores view.-The New button for creating new stores is missing.-Cause-You don’t have the possibility to create stores in SAP Cloud for Customer because the entries are fetched from a third party system SAP Cloud for Customer is integrated with.-Resolution-This is the standard expected system behavior.-You have to integrate SAP Cloud for Customer with the necessary third party system in order to see data under the Stores work center.

Title: Cannot Assign Expense Item To Invoice Item Due To Incompatible Unit Of Measure (UoM)
Content: Symptom-While creating assigning not invoiced project expense to invoice items the system is throwing error message as Cannot assign expense item to invoice item due to incompatible units of measure (UoM). Check if the UoM can be converted. If conversion is not possible, assign the expense to another invoice item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Invoice Preparation view.-Choose Not Invoiced Time and Expenses sub-view.-Choose show All Active Customer Projects.-Search the Project XYZ.-Choose New button and Manual Project Invoice Request.-Navigate to  Define Invoice Item tab.-Choose Propose Invoice Items button and choose From Time and Expenses: Per Employee/Party and Sales Order Item.-Navigate to Select Time and Expenses tab.-Choose Propose Invoice Item Assignments button and choose For All Time and Expense Items system throws above error message.-Cause-There could be two reasons for the above mentioned error message.-If the Not Invoiced Time and Expense items UoM and the Sales Order Items UoM incompatible and if there is no quantity conversion is not maintained for that specific service in the master date .-If you are trying to assign the Not invoiced expense items to the Sales Order item type Service - time and material (project) or Expense - fixed price (project) due to incompatibility of the item type, in order to assign expense items to the Sales Order item type should be as Expense - time and material (project) or  Expense - fixed price (project) .  -Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: Error message:Cannot Determine Account Origin For Service XYZ in company XXX
Content: Symptom-Direct cost or Cost rate not showing in project, and you see below error:-'Cost could not be determined for some or all Materials of task' or 'Cost could not be determined for some or all Services of task'- or-'Planned cost and Cost rate not appearing in the Cost and revenue work center' and you see below error:-'Cannot determine account origin for service ABC in company DEF'-ABC means Service ID.-DEF means Company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose Project GHI (GHI means the Project ID).-Choose the Edit button.-Choose the Valuate button.-You get the message: 'Cost could not be determined for some or all Materials of task'-or-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the Project GHI.-Choose the View Plan Values button.-You can see here some of the project tasks are in Error status marked in Red color.-Choose project task and navigate to the Messages tab-You can see error message: 'Cannot determine account origin for service ABC in company DEF'- or-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose Project GHI.-Choose the Edit button.-Select project plan tab.-Go to work tab or Materials Tab.-Here you can see the cost rate is empty.-Cause-The project valuation will be failed for the respective services or materials, if the account determination group is not maintained or if the account is not maintained.-Resolution-A) Follow below steps to view the account determination group maintained for Product category of Service or Material.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search and choose Account Determination Group for Product Categories.-Choose Open button.-Choose the respective product category as maintained in the service/Material master data.-Check the account determination group for services or account determination group for material-B) Follow below steps to maintain the G/L accounts for Account determination group for Services:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search and choose Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Choose Open button.-Choose the Account Determination -> Costs.-Choose Account Determination Profile.-Choose the Costs and then choose Service tab and maintain the Account Determination Group for Service which was observed in the step A.-3) Follow below steps to maintain the G/L accounts for Account determination group for Material.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search and choose Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Choose Open button.-Choose the Account Determination -> Inventories.-Choose Account Determination Profile.-Choose the Inventories and then choose Inventory tab and maintain the Account Determination Group for Material which was observed in the step A.-Also in the Gains and Losses tab.-For respective Account Determination Group for Materials field, under Material Consumption column enter the G/L account for material cost posting.-Keywords-Cost rate is empty, Cost rate is wrong, Cost rate is not available

Title: E-mail Template for Balance Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You want to create a personalized e-mail template for Balance Confirmation documents-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management-View Form Template Maintenance-Select a template for Balance Confirmation documents-You maintain an e-mail template-The created template is not being used by system, instead the default template is taken-Cause-This is a current limitation for the system-Resolution-Currently, Balance Confirmation documents are not supporting HTML templates, therefore it will take always the standard template.

Title: How Does Customer Updated Field Notify Agents?
Content: Symptom-Customer updated field does not create notifications.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service work center.-Go to the Tickets view.-Open the ticket ABC.-Customer has updated the ticket and Customer Updated field is checked.-There is no notification for the service agent that the customer has updated the ticket.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-When the customer updates, then that ticket will appear at the top of the agent's queue. This is how the Agent will know to give priority to that ticket. Once the Agent responds, the Customer Updated checkbox resets.-Keywords-Ticket Notification.

Title: Invoice Request is not Available After Completing Execution of the Service
Content: Symptom-Invoice Request is not available after completing the execution of service.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work center.-Select New Sale Order view.-Create New Sales Order and fill the mandatory fields.-Submit the Sales Order and Release.-Open the Sales order and go to Item tab.-Select the Line Item and click on Complete Execution.-Click Save button.-Now go to Customer Invoicing Work center.-Invoice Requests View.-Search Invoice Request for respective sales order.-There is no Invoice Request for this sales order after completing execution of the service.-Cause-The problem is SALES_ORDER_PROCESSING is in scoping status Phase-in because of which the sales order item is not determined correctly. This usually happens when a Business Configuration change project is not activated and need to activate the change project.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project.-Click the Open Activity List button.-Select the Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and Open the activity Activate Solution Capabilities.-Activate it.

Title: Quantity To Be Invoiced Time Confirmations Are Showing Quantity To Be Written Off
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2956887***-You can see the Time Confirmations are shown as To Be Written Off. However, you expect them To Be Invoiced.- or-How to set the times  to appear automatically as  Time to Be Written off in Project invoice request or In Not invoiced time and expenses-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search and select the project XYZ.-Select the Edit Time and Expenses button.-Here you can see the Time Confirmations are shown as To Be Written Off. However you expected them To Be Invoiced.-Cause-You have not set the Billable flag for the time confirmations which are shown as To Be Written Off.-Resolution-If the Billable flag is set to true for the respective project task or work package, the time confirmations associated to the work package will be available for invoicing as To Be Invoiced. When the flag is unset, all the time confirmations done after this change will be available for invoicing as To Be Written-Off.-Keywords-Non billable hours

Title: Cannot find a Return to Supplier under the Invoice Entry view.
Content: Symptom-Unable to find the Return to Supplier(RTS) under the Invoice Entry view when attempting to create a Credit Memo.-   Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Select All Returns to Be Invoiced from drop-down.-Search for Return to Supplier ABC (ABC represents Return to Supplier ID).-System shows "No records found".-Cause-The Invoice Entry view shows a list of Return to Supplier Delivery documents such as Outbound Deliveries and not Return to Supplier documents. In order to create a Credit Memo, search using the Outbound Delivery ID instead of the Return to Supplier ID.-Resolution-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Select All Returns to Be Invoiced from drop-down.-Search for relevant Outbound Delivery XYZ (XYZ represents Outbound Delivery ID).-Select New Credit memo button.-Fill in the mandatory details.-Select Post.-Keywords-Return to Supplier; Outbound delivery; Invoice Entry view; Return missing; Credit memo

Title: Error message - Error During Currency Conversion from into for Default Exchange Rate Type at DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-When you create a new purchase order for the product ABC with supplier XYZ, you will get an error message-Error during currency conversion from into for Default Exchange Rate Type at DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Order work center.-Choose New Purchase Order view.-Input supplier as XYZ and product ID as ABC.-Input all mandatory information and choose ﻿Check.-Cause-List price currency is different from Purchase order currency-Resolution-The list price is available in XXX currency , even though in PO you maintain a manual price in YYY currency yet you should maintain a valid Exchange Rate maintained in the General Ledger work center between XXX and YYY.-Keywords

Title: Changing The Sales Order Reference In An Automatic Created Project Invoice Request Causes An Error Message
Content: Symptom-You want to change the sales order reference in an automatic created project invoice request but you get an error message 'Cannot update sales order reference; sales order items already assigned'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Invoice Preparation - Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Select project XYZ (XYZ is the identification of the project).-Click the New - Automatic Project Invoice Request button.-Navigate to the General tab.-Remove sales order ID ABC (ABC is the identification of the sales order) and insert sales order ID DEF (DEF is the identification of the sales order), then you will get the error.-Cause-The error message states that the line items mentioned in the project invoice request XYZ belong to the sales order which is currently maintained in the Sales Order field.-If you now try to change the sales order reference to DEF the system will first check the line items in the project invoice request and as they belong to the sales order ABC system will throw the error message.-Resolution-You first need to delete the line items in the Items tab for the project invoice request and then insert the sales order ID DEF in the General tab.-Keywords-Cannot Update Sales Order Reference, Sales Order Items Already Assigned, Project Invoice Request

Title: Project Sales Order Not Available For Invoicing.
Content: Symptom-When you try to create invoice request for a project sales order, you are not able to find the sale order in the Project Invocing view.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Project Invocing view.-Select Sales Orders sub view.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ(XYZ represents sales order id), you are unable to find the sales order.-Cause-The project sales order which you are trying to invoice is mapped to a Multi Customer Project. Project Invoice Requests are not supported for Multi Customer Project and hence, not available for project invoicing. However Multi Customer Project(MCP) offer standardized services to your customers so you can create Manual Invoice Request/ Scheduled Invoice Requests or Invoice directly using Sales Order.---Resolution-Steps to create manual Invoice Requests-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Requests view .-Select the option New Manual Invoice in the Common Tasks view.-

Title: Expense Types Are Not Shown in Value Help During Creation of an Expense Report by Travel Assistant.
Content: Symptom-You are logged in as a Travel Assistant and you are unable to see the Expense Types while claiming Expenses in Non-Travel Related Expense Report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses Work center.-Go to the Travel and Expenses view.-Choose Claim Non-Travel Related Expenses.-Choose Add Expense.-Expense Types are not shown in the value help.- Cause-Issue occurs if the Expense Reimbursement Group maintained in Expense Types under Fine Tune Activity Expense Reporting-Country Version does not contain Expense Reimbursement Group on Employee (Traveler) Master Data.-Resolution-Add the Expense Reimbursement Group of Employee under the Expense Reimbursement Group of Expense Type via the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune Activities.-Show All Activities and Find Expense Reporting-Country Version Activity.-Select Any Expense Type which should be available for the Traveler.-Go to Expense Reimbursement Group and Click on Add Row.-Add Expense Reimbursement Group which is on Employee Master Data.-Click on Save.-Once the above steps are configured, Expense Types will be available for Travel Assistant.-

Title: Error Message: Maintain Compensation Rate for Employee XX, Time Type YYYY, Premium Pay ZZZZ.
Content: Symptom-Time Entries from Source Docuemnt Employee Time Calendarar are not posted to General Ledger.-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, enter the Closing Cockpit and choose the Source Documents view-Filter for Related Source Document Type: 170 - Employee Time Calendar-Select Related Source Document ID XYZ.-Via Actions enter the Business Transaction for Accounting. -The following error message is shown:-Maintain Compensation Rate for Employee XX, Time Type YYYY, Premium Pay ZZZZ.-Cause-In order to clear these tasks from the Unposted Source Document, you must add a row for Hourly Rate in the Employee File.-Resolution-Before, find the Hourly Rate ID of the compensation component:-In the Compensation work center, choose the Compensation Component view.-Select the relevant Compensation component.-Click on Actions and select Time Type Mapping.-Select Country and find the Hourly Rate ID.-Now, maintain the Hourly Rate ID row in Employees view-In the Compensation work center, choose the Employees view-Select the Employee and click Edit-Select Compensation Details tab-Maintain a row for Hourly Rate as maintained in the Compensation Component.

Title: Void button is not available when executing a custom query.
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom query (filter) for the view Invoices and Credit Memos, under the Supplier Invoicing work center.-You have noticed that when you execute this query the Void button gets grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-For the Show field, select a custom query-Select any invoice-See that the Void button is grayed out-Cause-This issue occurs because the custom query was not created using the query All Documents as base.-Every button in the screen of the system represents an Event. In other words, when you click on Void, the system triggers the event Void and then the invoice will be voided, however for some queries these events are disabled.--One example is the standard query Invoices – Finished Last 7 Days.-For this one the Void event is disabled because this standard query shows only finished documents. In other words, documents that cannot be voided anymore.-Therefore if you create a custom query using this filter as base, the event will still be disabled, even if you change the query to show documents that can be voided.-Resolution-In order to have all the options available when executing a custom query, you need to create it using the query All Documents as base.

Title: Classified Materials Query Not Working Properly.
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Material Classification under the Intrastat work center when you notice that the results of Classified Materials does not match when using the filters All Materials and Classifications and Classified Materials.-This seems to be inconsistent since your expectation is that the first filter should show the same quantity of Classified Materials as the second one.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center.-Go to Material Classification view.-In the Show filter, select All Materials and Classifications.-System will return N entries with status Classified (Green) (where N is the number of results).-Change the filter by selecting the option Classified Materials.-System returns less entries than N.-Cause-The system show less classified entries when using the filter Classified Materials because this filter shows only  classified results that have a Commodity Catalog ID assigned to them.-Meanwhile, the filter All Materials and Classification also shows classified results that do not contain such assignment.-Resolution-System is working as designed.

Title: Project Time Recording is Going for Approval.
Content: Symptom-Project time recording going for approval, even though the status of Time Recording in project is set as No Approval Required.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Time Sheet view.-Select the Time Recording subview.-Select the Employee XYZ.-Select the Open TimeSheet button.-Here you can see the time recording are In Approval.-Cause-If the org unit is assigned to the project under Team and Staffing tab it will be an indirect assignment of all the employees of the org unit to the project.-If the employee indirect assignment is done to the project and status of Time Recording in project is set as No Approval Required , then the time recordings will be sent for approval if functions are not assigned to the respective org unit.-Resolution-Follow the steps to resolve this issue.-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Choose the Find button.-Enter the org unit  for which the employee belong to, which assigned to the project.-Choose Edit button.-Go to Function tab.-Here assign the function depends on you which function you want assign or depends on the employee belongs to which department.

Title: Maintenance Mode for SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense
Content: Symptom-The SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense solution is in maintenance mode as of the February 2015 version and the maintenance mode ended according to the product versions on Dec. 31st 2019.-The SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense solution is not supported in any S/4HANA environment.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense-Resolution-With the acquisition of Concur, SAP intends to offer Concur products as the go-forward travel and expense products in its portfolio under the Concur brand, incorporating the strengths of both companies.-Concur intends to deliver in accordance with their planned product roadmap and, wherever possible, plans to take advantage of SAP’s technology platform and resources in their continuous efforts to improve their products and services.-The SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense solution is in maintenance mode as of the February 2015 version. We will provide updates for technical improvements and legal changes as needed up to the planned end of the contract term. The end of maintenance has been reached Dec. 31st 2019. -Keywords- SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense, Maintenance Mode

Title: Valuation Of Resource In Company Failed - Project Valuation
