Content: Symptom-Planned cost not showing correctly in the project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view and select Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID). -Press Edit. -In the Project press Valuate.-The warning message 'Cost determined with errors for some or all workpackages /materials of task' appears.-OR-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the Project.-Choose the View Plan Values button.-You can see here some of the project tasks are in Error status marked in Red color.-Choose project task and navigate to the Messages tab here you can see error message Valuation Of Resource ABC In Comp AAA Failed On DD-MM-YYYY  (ABC represents the labour resource ID, AAA represents the Company ID).-Cause-When an internal employee is assigned to a project the cost will be picked from the labor resource cost rate associated with the Job assigned to the Employee. If there is no cost rate maintained for the labour resource the project valuation will fail on the project/ project task start date.-Resolution-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Master Data - Resources view.-Choose the Resource ABC.-Press Edit.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-Maintain the Cost Rate for the respective Cost Center that the employee is assigned to on or before the Project Task start date. -See Also-Project Cost and Revenue Planning-Keywords- Valuation Of Resource In Company Failed

Title: Unable To Consume Quantities Delivered through Project Stock Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-# Archieve Reason: The content is outdated. For the Project Stock Order in the current release, the user can choose "Revoke Completion" for the line item to consume the delivered material again. #-You have pre-delivered a product to your customer through a Project Stock Order. When you try to consume the delivered quantity from the project, Consume button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Navigate to the Projects view.-Search for the relevant project, choose the Edit button and select the option Products.-Navigate to the sub-tab Project Stock Orders and expand the project stock order against which you have to consume pre-delivered stock.-When you select line item with the product you can see that the Consume button is disabled.-Cause-You have changed status of the line item to Completed by selecting Complete button which is available in the Project Stock Orders sub-tab.-Resolution-Once the status of a project stock order is changed to Complete, there is no undo complete option available.  You will have to return the unconsumed quantities at the pre-delivered stock by performing a New Parts Return Notification. The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Project Stock Order, Delivered Quantity, Consume, Pre-delivered

Title: Intrastat Declaration - Export to MS Excel Button Grayed Out
Content: Symptom-You are trying to export the Intrastat declarations in excel format but the Export button is grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Intrastat work centre.-2. Go to Intrastat Declaration view.-3. In Show Enter All Intrastat Declarations.-4. Select the Intrastat ID.-5. Select the Edit button.-6. Navigate to the Items tab.-7. We can see the Export Button Disabled.-Cause-The Intrastat declarations that are in status Released will only have the option of Export to Excel at the items tab . The Intrastat declarations that are in status In Preparation or Release cancel will not have the option of export to excel for items.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.

Title: ISR Subscriber Number Is Wrongly Determined in the Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new supplier invoice, however the wrong ISR Subscriber Number ﻿is determined.-Note that Inpayment slip with reference (ISR) payment is specifically relevant for Switzerland. The subscriber number is issued to the supplier by the Swiss PostFiannce.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Edit the relevant invoice.-You notice that the ISR number being derived from the supplier's master is tied up to an invalid supplier's bank account, which, therefore, should not be used as you have a second valid bank record with a valid ISR.-Cause-The current system behavior is that the first bank account with a subscriber ID is taken for defaulting, hence, although the first bank details entry has a restricted validity, the ISR Subscriber ID is derived from it in the supplier invoice.-Resolution-In order for the system to default the ISR number from a valid bank account, you may delete the subscriber IDs that are not valid anymore, as numbered below:-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Suppliers views.-Select the supplier and click Edit -> Financial Data.-Go to Bank Data subtab.-Select the bank details that are not valid anymore.-Delete the ISR Subscriber Number.-After that, the subscriber ID of the next valid bank account will be taken.-Keywords-Inpayment Slip with Reference; ISR Number; ISR Subscriber ID; Supplier Invoice; Switzerland

Title: "Service call failed" Error Due to Unwrapped Text
Content: Symptom-This issue occurs for all migration objects by using any migration mode: Add, Enhance or Modify- you maintained all the data correctly and completely in your migration file, but the system still reports the Service call failed error when performing the migration.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Open (for example) the activity Migration of Purchase Orders.-Click Migrate Purchase Orders using the Migration Tool.-Upload your migration file and execute the migration step by step.-The Service Call Failed error occurs during the simulation step, nevertheless you checked your migration file previously and there are no inconsistencies, missing mandatory data, duplicates etc.-Cause-When maintaining the data in your migration file, you might have maintained longer texts for some of your key records, which are overlapping the upcoming cells on the right.-Resolution-Download the affected migration template.-Open the Excel file.-Check all the worksheets for entries with unwrapped text.-Highlight the cell.-Right-click the cell and select Format Cells.-Go to the Alignment tab.-Check the Wrap text box.-Click OK.-Rename the migration file and upload it again in your system.-The Service Call failed error does not occur anymore.-

Title: Unable to Show Project Based Items in Sales Order Invoicing Overview in Field Invoice Request and Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a Project based Invoice or an Invoice Request in the system. Now, you search for the items in the Sales Order Invoicing Overview and notice that the system does not display any results for the Invoice Request and Invoice.-Also in Sales Order Invoicing Overview, when query for the Sales Orders without Invoice Scheduled, no Invoice ID appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Order Invoicing Overview view.-In the drop-down menu select Sales Orders without Invoice Schedule.-The search returns no results in Invoice Request and Invoice.-Cause-The fields Invoice and Invoice Request will not be available for Project based Items as the invoicing in such cases is not done on the Sales Order site.-It means that, in case you have a Project Task assigned in the Sales Order, the Invoice ID will not appear. The use of this view "Sales Orders without Invoice Scheduled" is to show the Sales Orders without Invoice Schedule and without a Project assigned.-Resolution-Therefore, from a Sales Order side you won’t receive information about the Invoice. This is also the reason why you are not able to add the column Project Invoice Request.-Keywords-Scheduled invoice request, manual project invoice request, sales order, project based invoice

Title: Exporting all Accounts to new Target Group from Account Contact Data report
Content: Symptom-You want to know why not all Contacts for an Account get exported to the Target Group.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Go to the Design Reports view-Search for the report - Account Contact Data-Click on Go-Click on any Account and select the Export all Accounts to new Target Group option-Find that not all Contacts of the Account are visible in the Target Group.-Cause-When you export the Account to the Target Group only the Contact which has been selected as the Main Contact will be shown.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. Only the Main Contact will be shown in the Target Group. You can validate the Main Contact under the Relationships tab of that specific Account ﻿which can be found under ﻿Customers ﻿work center.-See Also-KBA 2564101 - Export all Contacts to New Target Group Does not Include All Contacts

Title: You are the responsible for the Account, however, you are not able to Open the Sales Quotes which Belongs to the Same Account.
Content: Symptom-You are the responsible for the Account, however, you are not able to Open the Sales Quotes which Belongs to the Same Account.-Reproducing the Issue-Try to open XYZ Sales Quotes which the employee responsible for the Account is the user.-Go to Sales Work center.-Click on Sales Quotes.-Select View all.-Select the Sales Quote which you are responsible for the Account.-The screen will show the following error: you are not authorized to view this Sales Quote.- Cause-Even if you are the responsible for the Account, it does not give you the authorization to view the Sales Quote-Resolution-The authorization to view the Sales Quotes can be achieved by introducing a z-role like key account manager in Business Configuration with the responsibility flag set. Add this party role also to the quote and maintain the responsible user for the Account for the  role in the Account Management.

Title: Data not Displayed Correctly in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure Report When Excluding G//L Account
Content: Symptom-You run the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure or Project Variance by Project Structure report.-You want to exclude a G/L account from the report and therefore apply a filter with the Exclude Function in the G/L Account field from the Edit Selection tab. After this the report displays some data incorrectly.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Project Management workcenter navigate to the Reports List in and open the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report.-In the report enter the Project ID (Alternatively you can access the report directly in the Project in the Project Overview tab).-Now add the G/L Account characteristic to the Selection by clicking Add Fields.-Open Dimension: Accounting.-Select Display in Selection Area for the G/L Account characteristic.-Execute the report and move the G/L Account characteristic from Not Currently Shown to Rows.-Check the result for a certain Project Task ID.-The result for G/L Account XXX and Project Task ID in the Period Planned Cost column is amount X.-Now exclude a specific G/L Account: In the Edit Selection tab click into the G/L Accounts field and exclude G/L Account YYY.-Alternatively you can enter !(YYY) directly into the field G/L Account.-The result for G/L Account XXX and Project Task ID in column Period Planned Cost changes to an amount different to amount X.-Cause-This issue occurs due to a combination of two settings: -You exclude a G/L account from the report in the Selection tab of the report.-In general the planned costs are derived from the Project Plan Expenses tab. Here you have defined an account determination group rather than the G/L account in the Expenses Group column: Open the project, navigate to the Project Plan tab and here to the-Expenses sub-tab.  In the report you can identify this setting by adding the G/L Account (Origin) characteristic to the rows: Instead of the G/L account ID # is shown.-This is a limitation on a personalized compounded field (here G/L Account) and only occurs when the Exclude function used in the Edit Selection tab of the report. The same issue happens when excluding values for the G/L Account (Origin) and Functional Area characteristics.-Resolution-In order to correctly display the values, even when filtering for specific results, you can first try to deselect G/L Account YYY from the Edit Filter tab instead of the Edit Selection tab in the report:-In the report navigate to the Edit Filter tab.-In the G/L Account field open the value selection.-Press Select All.-Then remove the selection for the G/L account YYY so that it doesn't appear in the report.-Should the result for G/L Account XXX still be displayed incorrectly use the following workaround: -Copy and adjust the report:-Open the  Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to the Design Reports view and search for the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report.-Click on the New - Report As Copy button.-Change the name of the report in Step 1 - Define Report and Select Data Source.-Go to Step 4 using the Next button.-Do not make any changes in Step 2 and 3.-In Step 4 - Characteristic Properties change the Value Selection for the Name G/L Account characteristic from No Value Selection to Using Variable.-Don't make any changes in Steps 5, 6 and 7.-Then save the report by pressing Finish.-If you run this report all planned data is displayed correctly regardless if it has been derived from the G/L account or from an account determination group.-The same workaround can be applied for the Project Variance by Project Structure report.

Title: Valuation Of Service Product XYZ In Comp AAA Failed On DD-MM-YYYY
Content: Symptom-You check the Project Plan values of a project and notice the red error status.-You check the respective Project task and see the message "Valuation Of Service Product XYZ In Comp AAA Failed On DD-MM-YYYY." (XYZ represents a Service ID, AAA represents the Company ID, DD-MM-YYYY is the start date of the Project task).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose project XYZ.-Choose the Edit button.-Choose the Valuate button.-Here you can see the planned cost not shown and you can see the warning message Cost determined with errors for some or all workpackages of task.-And-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the Project XYZ.-Choose the View Plan Values button.-For one (or some) project task(s) the Error status is red. -Choose project task and navigate to the Messages tab.  Here you can see error message "Valuation Of Service Product XYZ In Comp AAA Failed On DD-MM-YYYY."-Cause-For internal employees, the work is valued using the following valuation strategy:-Labor resource cost rate-Service cost rate-If you want the work to be valued with the service cost rate, simply make sure that no cost rate is defined for the labor resource.-If neither resource cost rate nor service cost rate are valid on the start date of the respective Project Task, the project valuation fails.-Resolution-Adjust the service cost rate's valuation master data:-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Choose the Services View.-Choose the service XYZ.-Press Edit.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-Choose the Company and press Edit Cost Rate.-Here maintain the Cost Rate,Cost Unit and Valid From. The Valid from date must be before or on the start date of the Project Task. -Keywords-valuation of service product failed, project plan values

Title: Cannot Export the Data From Stock & Demand Overview Screen of Production Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a new production order document and now you want to export the data from the Stock and Demand Overview screen of production order, however there is no export button to extract the data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center-Go to the Production Orders view-Select the relevant Production Order-Select Edit and then select the Stock and Demand Overview button-In the Stock and Demand Overview screen, Export buton is not available-Cause-System behaves as expected.-Resolution-In the current release, it is not possible to export the data from the Stock and Demand Overview screen. This feature would be available in one of the next releases of SAP ByDesign. -Note: Kindly post this requirement in Ideas Forum.-https://ideas.sap.com/SAPByDesign, https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886

Title: You Are Not Able To Create A Manual Credit Memo And Assign It To The Project Task Under Revenue Assignment Tab
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a manual credit memo and assign it to one of your projects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks View.-Click New Manual Credit Memo.-Choose the account ABC (ABC represents account ID).-Choose the button View All and go to the Items tab.-Add the product XYZ (XYZ represents product ID).-In the product details view, navigate to the Revenue Assignment subtab.-Enter the PRO-Project Task as Account Assignment Type.-Click the value help button for Project Task.-Here you cannot find any Project Tasks or the expected Project IDs are not displayed here.-Cause-Project Tasks are currently only displayed there for Projects with Project Type: Direct cost project.-Resolution-It is possible to create a manual credit memo or invoice and assign a project task (migrated or not) under revenue assignment but not for all types of projects. You can only use projects of type Direct cost project. System is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Credit Memo, Cannot Assign, Gutschrift, Project

Title: Return to Supplier Document not Available for Credit Memo Creation
Content: Symptom-You have posted Return to Supplier document with follow-up decision Credit Memo and want to create a credit memo for this return document. When you create a New Credit Memo from the Invoice Entry screen, system shows the below warning message and nothing comes up;-Warning: Nothing open for invoicing for purchase document XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Entry view-Select All Returns to be Invoiced-Select the relevant Return to Supplier document-Select New Credit Memo-Warning appears and no data populated-Cause-1.You have not posted any Supplier Invoice yet with reference to inbound delivery Related to this Return to Supplier document. If there are no posted supplier invoices, system will not allow you to create credit memo because return quantity will not be available for posting a credit memo.-Note: The follow-up decision which you have entered in the return to the supplier document has no bearing on Credit Memo creation in Invoice Entry view.-2. There are invoices that are not appearing in the item level or header level  document flow  tab of Purchase order.- You can  go to invoices and credit memos view and go to advanced filter and enter PO ID and pull  all invoices and then check if they appear in PO or not.-Resolution-In order to create a Credit Memo for the Return to Supplier document,-1.Posted Supplier Invoice should exist in the system and( So Post an invoice)-2.All invoices has to be properly linked to the purchase order as well.(Let us know via case and we shall fix the issue via back end)

Title: Automatic Project Invoice Request field Customer Information is greyed out
Content: Symptom- You want to create an Automatic Project Invoice Request and edit the field Customer Information but it is greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Invoice Preparation: Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view-Show All Active Customer Projects-Select the Project ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Project)-Click the New button and select Automatic Project Invoice Request.-Navigate to the General tab.-Here you are able to see the Customer Information field is greyed out.-Cause-If the created Automatic Project Invoice Request is inconsistent then the text field Customer Information will be greyed out.-Resolution-During the creation of the Project Invoice Request click the Check button.-Here you are able to see the error/ warning messages. Once you have solved these error/ warning messages the Project Invoice Request will be consistent and the Customer Information field will be editable.

Title: Error Appears While Updating Delivery Date in the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have changed the Delivery Date to future date in the purchase order, where system sets the price to zero and shows the below error message;-Error: Item 1: Price missing; price required for expected follow-up documents invoice or ERS.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Navigate to the Items tab-Update the Delivery Date-Select Check button-Cause-System sets the price to Zero, when you change the Delivery Date in the purchase order because the List Price maintained for the Product and Supplier combination is not active anymore for the updated Delivery Date. Since there is no active List Price in the system, Zero price has taken in to the purchase order. Further system will not allow the Zero price in the purchase order, if you expect a Supplier Invoice and hence the error message appears.-Resolution-You can create a new List Price with the Product and Supplier combination. Later pricing information will be taken automatically in to the purchase order and you can change the Delivery Date to future date in the purchase order.

Title: Error Message Appears While Posting Supplier Invoice for Third Party Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created supplier invoice for third party purchase order and the below error appears while posting.-Error: 'Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order XYZ, item XYZ-1 in accounting'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select All Deliveries to be Invoiced.-Select the relevant Delivery ID ABC.-Select New Invoice and fill mandatory details.-Click on Post.-Error Message: 'Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order XYZ, item XYZ-1 in accounting'-or-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center -Go to Invoices and Credit memos view -Search for the Supplier Invoice ID XYZ-Go to Exceptions tab -Exception says : 'Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order XYZ, item XYZ-1 in accounting'-Cause-The possible root causes are;-The corresponding Third Party Inbound Delivery is not Released yet and you are trying to Post the Supplier Invoices.-The corresponding Third Party Inbound Delivery is Canceled and you are trying to Post the Supplier Invoices.-Canceled Inbound Delivery is assigned as a reference in the Cost Distribution sub tab of the Supplier Invoices.-Resolution-Release the Third Party Inbound Delivery and then post the Supplier Invoice-If the Third Party Inbound Delivery is already Canceled, you can create a new Delivery and post the Supplier Invoice-Remove the Third Party Inbound Delivery which is already Canceled and post the Supplier Invoice-Keywords-third party purchase order, goods or service receipt, Invoice, Third Party Inbound Delivery, Invoice exception

Title: Account Assignment Field Appears Blank While Creating new Purchase Order.
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new purchase order and try to fill the account assignment details under Items tab, however the blank screen appears under Account Assignment tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Task view & select New Purchase Order.-Select View All and navigate to Items tab.-Select the sub tab Account Assignment.-A blank screen appears.-Cause-You have disabled the Account Assignment field via adaption mode, hence the system shows a blank screen.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to enable the Acount Assignment field via adaption mode.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Tasks and select New Purchase Order.-Fill the mandatory fields like Buying Company, Supplier and any other mandatory detail.-Select View All and navigate to Items tab.-Select Account Assignment sub tab.-Select Adapt button and then Enter Adaption Mode.-Navigate to Items tab and then to the sub tab Account Assignment.-Select Edit Screen.-Select the section Untitled Group.-You can see the field Account Assignment Type.-Select the Check Box.-Save and Publish.-Close the adaption mode.

Title: Submit is Missing in New Project Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-Submit option is missing in new Project Purchase Request screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects View.-Search for the relevant project ID. -Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Products tab. -Select the relevant product ID.-Choose Create Purchase Request and select For Released Project Tasks.-In the opened "New Purchase Request" screen, the Submit option is missing.-Cause-Since the Approval Process for Project Purchase Requests is not scoped, the Submit option is missing.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to activate an Approval Process for Project Purchase Requests.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the relevant implementation project.-Click in Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Questions.-Expand Project Management.-Expand Project Planning and Execution. -Select Project Procurement.-Scope the question "Do you want to receive a notification about project-related purchase orders?". -Finish scoping.-Keywords-Submit, Project Purchase Request, Product, Approval Process

Title: Invoiced Hours Are Not Available Under Not Invoiced Time and Expenses After Invoice Is Cancelled.
Content: Symptom-Previously invoiced hours are unavailable under Not Invoiced Time and Expenses after cancellation of the previous invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Choose the Project XYZ for which the invoice is canceled.-Choose the Edit Time and Expenses.-Here you are unable to see the cancelled hours.-Cause-The  Project Invoice Request is cancelled but the follow up document Customer Invoice is not yet cancelled it is still with Released status. Once the Customer Invoice is cancelled the previously invoiced hours will be available under Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view so that the hours can be invoiced once again.-Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: Cancellation not possible; In-Transit Quantity Exists - Error Message Received While Canceling A Warehouse Request.
Content: Symptom-You tried to reject a Warehouse Request, however you received the following errors:-a) Error while canceling confirmation item-b) Action failed-c) Cancellation not possible; in-transit quantity exists-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Warehouse Requests view.-Search for and select the desired Warehouse Request.-Choose Reject Request button.-Receive the errors.-Cause-You are unable to reject the warehouse request due to the existence of In-transit quantities that needs to be reversed first.-Resolution-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search and select the task related to the warehouse request you want to reject.-Select the option Confirm.-Change the actual quantity of the line items to Zero.-See that after changing the quantity to zero, the option to reverse the in-transit quantity will be shown.-Select the option Reverse.-Choose Save-Please note that during this process the system will trigger the message: Quantity update not possible; reverse in-transit quantities and save. This is an expected behavior and will vanish once the described process is applied for all line items of the task.-Keywords-Warehouse Request, Reject Request, Task, Reverse.

Title: Technical error RPPM 063; Report An Incident Occurs When Releasing Production Model.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When releasing a Production Model ABC for planning and execution, system returns the following error messages:-Creation of released planning model not possible-Create RPMs (number 1)-Technical error RPMF_MESSAGE 13; report a case-Technical error RPPM 063; report a case-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center-Go to Production Models view-Select the production model ABC-Select Edit-Choose the option Release, then the option For Planning and Execution-Receive the errors-Cause-The issue occurs because the input quantity is missing for one or more products in the relevant Production BoM which is to the Production Model. The issue occurs if the Site for which the Production Model is created for is not maintained in the Logistics or Planning tab of any one of the products in the Bill of Material.-Resolution-Under the Product Assignment tab, maintain the quantity for every product that is being used in the production model. If the quantity is missing in bill of material. -In the relevant product master date navigate to the Logistics or Planning tab in which the site is not maintained as Active and maintain the site as Active. -Keywords-Technical error RPMF_MESSAGE 13, Technical error RPPM 063-technical error rpmf_message 13,technical error rppm 063
