Title: Sort GL Account By Name In Supplier Invoice Screen
Content: Symptom-You are unable to sort the contents of the drop down list of GL Account field by GL account Name when creating a supplier invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the New Invoice with Out Purchase Order link in Common Tasks.-Enter the relevant fields.-You are unable to sort the drop down contents of the GL Account field by GL Account Name.-Cause-In Business ByDesign you do not have the option to sort GL Accounts by name in the Supplier Invoicing screen. They are sorted on the GL Account ID.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.

Title: Task – Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request or Escalation:Create Purchase order in purchase request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2858838***-System raises an escalation task Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request or escalation task Escalation:Create Purchase order in purchase request-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Got to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Requests view-Show Open Tasks and select Go-You can see the task with escalation status-Cause-The system raises this escalation task because the due date of the task has been reached and the task is not completed. The system escalates the task because the planned ordering date maintained in the purchase request has been reached. The due date of this tasks in calculated from the Planned ordered date on the Purchase Request. This type of task always has high priority. The due date is always the same day.-Note: The planned ordered date is a calculated field and value of planned ordered date is derived as below:-Get default from supply chain and never change it-Get lead time from purchasing contract if assigned-Get lead time from product if available-Take five days before delivery period start date-Resolution-The task is relevant for the manager who is working on the operational purchasing org unit maintained in the purchase request or any alternative approver for the operational purchasing org unit or cost center. The relevant manager receives this task in the Inbox subview of the Work view of the Home work center. The alternative approvers receive this task in the Approvals view of the Managing My Area work center.-In case in purchase request you see under Basic details sub tab no purchasing unit is not available  then as a fall back rule system sends the task to all users who has access to Purchase request and order work center .-Keywords-Assign Supplier to Purchase Request,  escalation task sent to many users, task sent to many,due date ,planned order date, Planned ordering date,Planned ordered date

Title: Change Immediately Option Not Available In Change Project Test Tenant
Content: Symptom-You want to perform an activity Immediate change but the button Change Immediate is disabled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview view.-Search by the activity XYZ.-Select the activity XYZ.-The Change Immediate button is disabled.-Cause-This a designed behavior.-The  immediate change option is available only in the production systems and for the project which is in status go-live.-Resolution-In order to proceed with the change , please perform it via change project activity list.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open Activity List for the project XYZ.-Search by the activity and make the changes.

Title: The Project Plan Values Report Does Not Display The Cost Rates According to the Service Valuation Master Data
Content: Symptom-You have created yearly cost rates for service XYZ.-You assign this service XYZ to project task ABC-XX with a start and end date within the time span of several years.-The Project Plan Values report (Report ID: FINCACU03_Q0001) only displays the cost rate which was valid on the start date of project task ABC-XX for each accounting period up until the end of the project task validity.-You expect that the report displays the different cost rates according to the cost rate intervals maintained in the valuation master data of service XYZ.-XYZ means the Service ID.-ABC-XX means the Project Task ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To maintain different cost rates for a service-In the Product and Service Portfolio workcenter navigate to the Services view.-Find service XYZ and press Edit.-Press View All and then navigate to the Valuation tab.-Edit the cost rates according to your needs, for example, different cost rate intervals per year.-To maintain the start and end date of a service for a project task-In the Project Management workcenter navigate to the Projects - Projects view.-Find project ABC and press Edit - Project Plan.-Find project task ABC-XX and then navigate down to the Work subtab.-Press Add Row.-In the Service column, select service XYZ.-Enter dates into the Start Date and End Date column. The duration is more than one year.-Then maintain a value in the Planned Work column, for example, 2000 hours.-To check the Project Plan values Report-In the Project Management workcenter navigate to the Reports: List view.-Open the Project Plan Values Report.-In the View field, select Project Plan values - Details.-Enter the Project ID and Set of Books.-Press Go.-You might also want to filter for the respective service product to simplify the view.-From the Not Currently Shown section, pull Accounting Period/ Year up into the Rows.-You notice that the cost rate is the same for each accounting period.-Cause-You need to maintain a period plan according to the cost intervals of the service valuation data. If there is no period plan maintained then the system assumes that the cost rate that was valid at the start date of the project task is valid throughout the whole project task duration.-Resolution-There are two ways for maintaining a period plan for a project task: You can either maintain the periods and planned work directly in the work tab of the project task. Or you use the Plan Period function:-To enter the periods in the work-view:-In the Project Management workcenter, navigate to the Projects - Projects view.-Find project ABC and press Edit - Project Plan.-Find project task ABC-XX and then navigate down to the Work subtab.-Press Add Row.-In the Service column, select service XYZ.-Enter dates into the Start Date and End Date column as per the first cost rate interval, for example, from 01.01.2014 to 31.12.2014.-In the Planned Work column maintained the scheduled work hours for this period.-Press Add row again, enter the same service XYZ as well as the start and end date of the next cost rate interval, for example, 01.01.2015 until 31.12.2015. Also enter the scheduled work hours in the Planned Work column.-Continue like this for the whole duration of the project task.-To enter the periods with the Plan Period function:-In the Project Management workcenter navigate to the Projects - Projects view.-Find project ABC and press Edit - Project Plan.-Find project task ABC-XX and then navigate down to the Work subtab.-Press Add Row.-In the Service column, select service XYZ.-Enter dates into the Start Date and End Date column. The duration is more than one year.-Then maintain a value in the Planned Work column, for example, 2000 hours.-Now press Plan Period.-In the pop-up window, you can either let the system automatically create a period plan via the Generate Period Plan button. Alternatively, you can create your own period plan manually.*-*The option via the Period Plan function can be a bit confusing: The Project Plan Values report lists in one hand the cost rate per planned period but, on the other hand, a second cost rate entry is shown, displaying the rate that is valid at the start day of the project task ABC-XX. Therefore the cleanest way here is to enter the period plan directly in the Work view of the project task.-Note - The same KBA is valid for Material Cost.-Keywords-project plan values; cost rate; service valuation

Title: User With Read Only Access Cannot View Purchase Order Tabs
Content: Symptom-You are not able to access any tab other than General tab of a Purchase Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests & Order Work center.-Go To Purchase Orders View-Show All Purchase Orders-Select any Purchase Order-Navigate to any tab other than General tab-It can be seen that system displays an error message You are not authorized to change the data.-Cause-User has no sufficient access rights. The user access rights can be checked here.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view.-Go to the Business Users sub view.-Show All Business users and mark the relevant employee.-Choose the Edit button and select Access Rights.-Switch to the Access Restrictions tab.-Select the work center view ID SRM_PURCHASEORDERS.-User has been assigned to work center view - SRM_PURCHASEORDERS with below access restrictions:--Read access - Unrestricted--Write access - No Access-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-As a workaround,the user concerned can use the Quick Edit button in the Purchase Orders view to navigate to respective tab for Purchase Order details.-Note: In case of Purchase Orders with Account Assignment, even in Quick Edit screen, if user directly opens Items tab, user might face the issue. With such Purchase Orders, user should first navigate to General/Notes/Attachments/Approvals/Document Flow tab and then finally come to Items tab.

Title: The Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project is not created.
Content: Symptom-The Intercompany Sales Order  and Intercompany Project is not getting created. However you can see the intercompany relevant Purchase Order is Sent to Supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Project's ID). -Navigate to Products tab.-Navigate to Purchase Orders subtab.-Open the related Purchase Order.-Navigate to the Purchase Order's Document Flow tab.-Here you can see the Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project are not created via B2B communication.-However you can see the intercompany relevant Purchase Order is Sent to Supplier.-Cause-Cause 1:-There is no output channel maintained as Electronic Data Exchange (EDX) for both Account and Supplier in respective master data.-Cause 2:-As the buying and selling company both are setup in the same system hence the purchase order output history should be always sent by XML then only the system creates the Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project is not created via B2B communication. If the output history is sent by Printer, E-mail, Fax etc then the system will fail to create the Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project are not created via B2B communication. You Can Also Edit Output Settings for Create Purchase Order and this was XML. Ensure that the settings are not changed to Printer or Email or Fax manually in the purchase order.-Resolution-Resolution for Cause 1: -To ensure that Sales Order Confirmations and Customer Invoices will be sent via Internal EDX (XML communication) to Purchasing Company and purchasing orders will be sent via Internal EDX (XML communication) to Supplying Company kindly follow the below steps.-Account:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center..-Choose the Accounts view-Search and Choose the Purchasing company 1111(where 1111 is the Purchasing company)-Choose Edit button-Go to Communication -> Collaboration-Here choose the  Business Documents Sales Order Confirmation and Customer Invoice / Credit Memo mark the Output Channel as Internal EDX.-Supplier:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Choose the Supplier view-Search and Choose the Supplying company 1111.-Choose Edit button-Go to Communication -> Collaboration-Here choose the  Business Documents Purchase Orders and mark the Output Channel as Internal EDX.-Resolution for Cause 2: -The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Intercompany; Sales Order; Project; Purchase Order; B2B; Output Channel; EDX; Account; Supplier; XML; Printer; Fax

Title: Deletion of Task Service Not Permitted Confirmations Already Exist
Content: Symptom-While deleting an assigned service in a Project, the system throws an error message Deletion of task service not permitted; confirmations already exist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view-Choose Projects subview-Choose the project XYZ and Edit -> Project Plan button-Go to the tab Work here you can see Delete button is enabled but when you choose the Delete button, system throws the error message Deletion of task service not permitted; confirmations already exist.-Cause-Ideally in case of Standard Projects when time confirmations (Actual Work) exist against a service the Delete button is grayed out for that service. However in order to delete the service the actual time confirmation performed against the service need to be cancelled. Once the time confirmations are canalled the Delete button will be enabled and you will be able to cancel the service.- In case of Migrated Project after the cancellation of time confirmations the Delete button will be enabled. However when you try to delete the service still system throws an error message Deletion of task service not permitted; confirmations already exist, because in case of migrated projects we cannot delete the service even if all time confirmations were cancelled.-To check the time confirmation cancelation follow the below given steps.-Go to Project management work center-Choose the Projects view-Choose Time and Expenses subview-Search for the  Project Task XYZ for which the service is assigned.-Here you can see Employee for which the service is assigned and associated time confirmations for which the Canceled check box is enabled-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Inbound Delivery Not Released After Confirming Put Away Task
Content: Symptom-You see that your Put-Away task is confirmed and the status of the task is Finished. However, the relevant inbound delivery document has the release status as Not Released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Delivery work center.-Select the Inbound Deliveries view.-Search and select the relevant Inbound Delivery ID.-You can see that the release status of your inbound delivery is Not Released.-Cause-The Put-Away task was confirmed by reporting deviation for the relevant items in the task.-Resolution-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select view Monitoring and subview By Warehouse Order and select Advanced button.-Select the relevant warehouse order and choose Edit button.-In the warehouse order screen, Go to Operations tab.-In the Operations tab , Select Accept Deviation and choose the button Close. -Go back to Inbound Delivery view and search for the Inbound delivery ID.-Select the relevant Inbound Delivery you can see that the release status of your inbound delivery is updated to Released.-Keywords-Undo Release Button Is Not Enabled For Inbound Delivery, Inbound delivery release error, not able to release inbound delivery, inbound delivery not releasing

Title: Availability Time For a Resource Not Editable
Content: Symptom-You are not able to maintain the Availability Time in the Availability Calendar of a particular resource.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Resource Management work center.-Navigate to the Resource Search view.-Search for the relevant resource select it and choose the Show Availability button.-Since the resource is Available, you select the resource name to expand the Availability Calendar and view the Target Capacity value of the resource.-You see that you are not able to maintain the time values for the resource in this screen.-Cause-You will be able to maintain time committed for your resource only when you have maintained his/her commitments for a particular period against a relevant project.-Resolution-Please follow the below given steps to maintain commitments for your resource.-Go to the Resource Management work center.-Navigate to the Resource Search view.-Search for the relevant Resource , and choose the button Show Availability.-In the Availability Calendar screen , choose the button Maintain Commitments.-The system will display Project Assignment screen for the resource. You should maintain committed work hours for the resource under a Project for the Time Frame you desire.-Choose Save and Close button.-The system will now display the committed work hours distributed evenly for the days in the time frame you have selected against the Project in the Availability Calendar screen. You will not be able to edit the distributed time in the calendar against the relevant project in this screen.

Title: Cost Rate For Resource XXX and Set of Books ABC Valid On DD.MM.YYYY is Missing
Content: Symptom-While posting an unposted source document  Employee Time Calendar the system displays an error message "Cost rate for resource XXX and set of books ABC valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing."-(XXX is the resource ID.)-(ABC is the set of books ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Choose the Closing Cockpit View.-Choose the Source Documents sub view.-In the Source Documents select the option Unposted Source Documents in the Show view and choose the Go button.-A list of all Unposted Source Documents will appear, select your unposted source document when you try to post the document system displays an error message "Cost rate for resource XXX and set of books YYY valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing."-Cause-There could be two reasons for the above error message.-Resource XXX could be Blocked or Obsoleted.-The Resource Cost Rate is not valid in the Set of Books ABC on the date DD.MM.YYYY.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to resolve the error:-a. Resource XXX could be Blocked or Obsoleted.-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Master Data view.-Choose the Resources subview.-Choose the Resource XXX (XXX represents the resource ID).-Choose Edit button.-Choose the Change Status button and Unblock or Undo Obsolete.-b. The resource Cost Rate is not valid in the Set of Books ABC on dated DD.MM.YYYY.-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Master Data view.-Choose the  Resources subview.-Choose the Resource XXX.-Choose Edit button.-Go to Valuation tab.-Choose the Set of Books ABC.-Choose the Maintain Cost Rate button -Here increase the Valid From and To Date for date on which you want to post the document.-Keywords-resource cost, employee time calendar

Title: Correctly Assigned Times and Expenses Are Missing in Not Invoiced Times and Expenses/ Project Invoicing
Content: Symptom-For your customer sales project several time and expense items, e.g. employee time confirmations or goods and service receipts,  were correctly posted and assigned to the respective project task and sales order item.-You now want to edit these items in the Not Invoiced Times and Expenses view.-Or-You want to create project invoice requests for these time and expense items.-You have verified that the items appear in the Projects: Times and Expenses view as well as in the Sales Accruals report in the Cost and Revenue workcenter and that they are correctly assigned to the respective sales order item and project task.-But in both cases, the times and expenses are not available for editing or invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Project Management workcenter navigate to Invoice Preparation- Not Invoices Times and Expenses.-Find the respective project and then press Edit Times and Expenses.-In the new screen you can find all the times and expenses assigned to this project.-Or if you want to create a project invoice request:-In the Customer Invoicing workcenter navigate to Project Invoicing - Projects.-Find the project and press New - Manual Project Invoice Request.-Press Next until step 3 - Define Invoice Items.-Under Items choose Propose Invoice Items - From Time and Expenses: Per Employee/Party and Sales Order item.-Two warning messages appear: No proposal exists for expenses; create invoice items manually; No time and expenses exist for selected option.-Cause-The times and expenses that you are looking for have been written off in previous project invoice requests of this project.-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing and there navigate to the Project Invoicing - Project Invoice Requests view.-In the Show field select All Project Invoice Requests and in the Find field enter the respective project ID.-The project invoice request(s) appear(s). Select on of them and click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab and there to the Time and Expenses sub-tab.-Here all times and expenses relevant for this project invoice request are listed.-In the top table select one Employee/Party.-In the table below (Time and Expense Items) you find all the times posted for this employee/ party.-Now compare the values of the columns Quantity Available to Be Invoiced and Quantity to Be Written Off.-If you don't see this column Quantity to Be Written Off in the table you need to add it via the Personalize function in the very top right corner of the screen.-You can see that the quantities to be invoices have been written off totally. Therefore they are not available anymore for invoicing or editing.-Check with the project manager why these items have been written off. If you came to the conclusion that they should be available for editing/invoicing you need to cancel the related project invoice requests and all follow-on documents, such as customer invoices and payments. Only then you will be able to edit/invoice these quantities again.

Title: Error Message When Trying to Release Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release Outbound Delivery. The system displays the below given error message:-Shipment Date Older Than The First Confirmation-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-In the field Show, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection using drop-down and Find relevant Outbound Delivery ID.-Select ID and choose option Release.-System will display the above mentioned error message.-Cause-Since the Shipment Date maintained in the Outbound Delivery is earlier date than the Actual Execution Date of the relevant Warehouse Confirmation ID. It must be same as actual execution on date or greater than that of the confirmation date.-Resolution-In order to find the Actual Execution On Date as per Warehouse Confirmation against the Outbound Delivery, please follow the below steps :-Go to the Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Monitoring View and choose Warehouse Order sub view.-In the field Show, select All Warehouse Order by Selection using drop-down.-Using Advanced Search, enter the relevant Outbound Delivery ID in the section Delivery ID.-Choose Go, here you will find the relevant Warehouse Order ID against the Outbound Delivery.-Select the Order ID and Edit it, navigate to the Confirmations tab.-Here you can see the Confirmation ID with Actual Execution On.-Now follow the below steps in order to release the Outbound Delivery:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-In the field Show, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection using drop-down and find relevant Outbound Delivery ID.-Select an Outbound Delivery and Edit it.-In General tab, under section: Dates, change the shipment date to same as Actual Execution On Date as per warehouse confirmation or greater that this.-Then perform Check Consistency. Now Outbound Delivery should be consistent.-Then Release Outbound Delivery.-Keywords-outbound, delivery, release, shipment, date, older, first, confirmation, error, actual, execution

Title: Invoice Item Procured as Individual Material is Requiring Account Determination for Product Category
Content: Symptom-You are procuring a material for a fixed asset via a supplier invoice, however the system informs that the account determination is missing for the selected product category, although it is assigned to an asset class.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Create a new supplier invoice with no reference to a purchase order.-Input the mandatory information and make the cost assignment to individual material.-With all the mandatory field populated accordingly, click Check.-The following error is raised: Account determination group is missing for product category <ID>-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-On the Common Task, click Edit Asset Class Determination. You'll see the selected product category assigned to a fixed asset class for the buying company.-Cause-The error is caused because the procured amount in the supplier invoice line item is less than the lower value of the capitalization threshold setup for the company's accounting principle, therefore, it goes via normal account determination for product category, directly to expense accounts.-Resolution-To post the transaction as a fixed asset, the amount of the line item must be higher that the minimum value set as threshold.-You can change this setup through the below steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find the activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets and click Change Immediately.-On the screen that opens, select the relevant accounting principle for you company and adjust the capitalization range.-Beware that the system will validate the logic at the line item level. This means that, even though the sum of all the line items with the cost assigned to IMAT is within the capitalization range, posting would still happen via normal account determination because the amount of each line item is below the given lower amount on Business Configuration.-Keywords-fixed asset; account determination group; individual material; imat

Title: Quantity Unit Cannot be Changed in Creating Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are not able to change the Quantity Unit of an item  while creating a manual Project Invoice Request from a preceding sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Go to the Projects sub view.-Choose the related project and select the Manual Project Invoice Request from the dropdown list of the New button.-After selecting the Propose Invoice Item button in Step 3, the Quantity Unit of an item cannot be changed from 'h' to 'ea' because it is greyed out.-Cause-The reason why you are unable to change the quantity unit for the item is because the item of the project invoice request which is getting created from the sales order item with quantity 1 will be considered as amount leading scenario. In this case, you will not be allowed to do any changes to the Quantity Unit.-Resolution-You can maintain quantities for such sales order items greater than or less than 1. However, for a released sales order you will not be able to edit line items and thus, you should add new line items or create a new sales order to maintain the quantity other than 1.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request, Quantity Unit

Title: Exception After Migrating Inventory - Cross Check Balances Preview for Migration
Content: Symptom-You migrate Inventory. The migration finishes successfully. But you notice, for example via the Material Inventories - Balance History that the inventories are not updated.-You then check the Cross-Check Balances Preview and notice and entry without G/L account reference. When extending the node you notice the message 'An exception was raised'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In Business Configuration navigate to the Activity List of your current project and there go to the Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity and choose  Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-In the new screen, in the top table, select the respective migration unit. Its status is Finished. Also the status of the Inventory migration file in the table below is in status Finished.-In the Inventory Valuation workcenter navigate to the Reports- List view and open the Material Inventories - Balance History report.-Enter all the mandatory fields and press Go.-You notice that the inventories are not updated according to the apparently finished migration.-Go back to the migration and select your migration unit.-Press the Cross-Check Balances Preview button.-There are entries visible for which no G/L account or local currency (LC) amount is displayed. Open these entries by clicking on the small downwards pointing arrow.-Now you can see several lines reporting an exception in the Messages column.-In the Source column, choose the Inventory link to check the posting details.-In the new screen, you can again see entries without G/L account and a 0,00 LC amount. -Press the downwards pointing arrow to check for which materials the inventory cost is missing. You find the material IDs in the Product ID column.-Then open all the other G/L accounts.-In the Messages tab there is an exception reported for each material: Exception occurred.-  Cause-As the posting preview suggests you have tried to migrate inventory values of 0,00 LC. But the value updating of inventory is based on material valuation data, meaning, the account determination as well as the inventory cost data valid on the migration posting date.-As for some materials there was no inventory cost maintained an exception was raised for all materials.-However, the migration could be finished and a Goods and Service Confirmation was created. But, this document could not be posted to accounting and appears as unposted source document in the Closing Cockpit of the General Ledger workcenter.-Resolution-In the Inventory Valuation workcenter navigate to the Master Data - Materials view. -Find the materials for which a 0,00 LC amount is displayed in the posting preview of the Inventory migration.-Select the material and press Maintain Valuation Data.-Maintain an inventory cost for the materials and make sure that this entry is valid on the date of the inventory migration.-After all the affected materials got updated navigate to General Ledger and there to Closing Cockpit - Source Documents:-Find the unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation with status In Process.-In the Messages section the missing value is reported: No value of subtransaction company, setofbooks ABC, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_GL_ACCOUNT.-Press Actions- Post Business Transaction.-Once the posting is completed validate the now fully completed migration, for example with the Material Inventories - Balance History report:-In the Inventory Valuation workcenter navigate to the Reports- List view and open the Material Inventories - Balance History report.-Enter all the mandatory fields and press Go.-The inventory values are updated.-Keywords-An exception was raised, inventory migration successful, no update, unposted goods and service confirmation

Title: Customs Duty Invoice Exception : Tax Code Missing.
Content: Symptom-While creating the Customs Duty Invoice an exception occurred Tax Code Missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Customs Duty Invoice under common task.-Fill in all the mandatory fields.-Choose the Check button.-System displays an exception Tax Code Missing.-Cause-In the Customs Duty Invoice there are 2 item types.-1. Import VAT Debit Item-If you select the item type as Import VAT Debit Item, for this item type the Tax Code is mandatory. This type of item contains the tax amount as a net amount.-2. Customs Duty Debit Item-If you select the item type as  Customs Duty Debit Item, this item type is not taxable. You need not enter tax code.-Resolution-Resolution for item type 1:-You have to enter the product description and  tax code that is classified as direct VAT and the Net Amount field, enter the amount of the import VAT.-The entered amount is posted as a tax amount in financial management and will be declared in a tax return. You do not have to enter a quantity or net price information.-Resolution for item type  2:-You have to enter the product description and the Net Amount field, enter an amount.-The entered amount is posted as a tax amount in financial management and will be declared in a tax return. You do not have to enter a quantity or net price information.

Title: Project Variance by Project Structure Report is not showing the Baseline Cost
Content: Symptom-In the Project Variance by Project Structure Report we can't see the Baseline Cost for some of the Baselines.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to the Reports view and click on List sub View.-Choose all reports in Show field and filter with Project Variance by Project Structure in the Find field.-Open the Project Variance by Project Structure in web browser.-Pull the Project, Project Task, Baseline in Row.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the for some baseline the baseline cost is not shown.-Or-Go to the Project Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Reports view and click on List sub view.-Choose all reports in Show field and filter with Project Variance by Project Structure in the Find field.-Open the Project Variance by Project Structure in web browser.-Pull the Project, Project Task, Baseline in Row.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the for some baseline the baseline cost is not shown.-Cause-The Project Variance by Project Structure report shows the Baseline Cost only for Active Baseline it will not show the Baseline Cost for the Obsoleted Baselines.-Resolution-The report is working fine as system designed behavior.-Keywords-Project Variance by Project Structure, FINCACU04_Q0006, Baseline Cost

Title: How to change the Customer Name in a Customer Project
Content: Symptom-Although the project status is In Planning the Customer name field in the Accounting tab is not editable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select the Project XYZ which is In Planning status (XYZ represents the project ID).-Click on the Edit button.-Select the Project Plan option.-Go to the Accounting sub tab.-The Customer field in the Customer section is read only.-Cause-The reason for this system behavior is that the corresponding sales order is in status Released.-As long as the corresponding sales order is in status In Preparation the customer name is editable in the project. After the Sales Order is submitted the customer field is no longer editable.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Suggested Workaround: If there are no follow up documents created you can create a new project based on the sales order. Keep the sales order In Preparation status and the Project In Planning status, double check the Customer name in both documents.-Keywords-Customer name in project

Title: Demand-Driven Planning Failed For ABC in PQR
Content: Symptom-You run Material Requirements Planning for a Product with ID ABC (ABC means Product ID) under the Planning Area with ID PQR (PQR means Planning Area ID). The system displays the below given error message.-Demand-driven planning failed for ABC in PQR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Products view.-Search for the Product ABC, which has the Planning Area assigned as PQR, select it and choose the button Open.-Choose the button Run Planning and select the option Single BoM Level or Multi BoM Level as per your business requirement.-The system displays the above mentioned error message.-Cause-You have maintained Safety Lead Time and Target Days of Supply in the Planning Master Data of your product ABC. If the difference between Safety Lead Time and Target Days of Supply is equal to zero or one, the Target Days of Supply would fall either one day short or equal to demand date time correspondingly. The system is designed so as to be on the safer side and the system does not create receipts within or equal to Safety Lead time. Ideally Target Days of Supply should be more than the Safety Lead Time and the difference between them should be greater than one.-Resolution-You can make the changes to your Safety lead Time of Target Days of Supply by following the below mentioned steps.-Go to Product Data work center.-Navigate to the Materials view.-Search for the Product ABC, select it and choose the button Edit.-Choose the View All button to see all the master data tabs.-Navigate to the Planning tab, select the line item that has the planning area with ID ABC maintained.-Change the value of Safety Lead Time and Target Days of Supply so that their difference is greater than one.-Keywords-Demand-driven planning, Material Requirements Planning, MRP, Run Planning, Product, Planning Area

Title: The Project Finish Date Not Auto Calculated for Migrated Projects.
Content: Symptom-The Projects Finish Date was not calculated automatically or it is incorrect  for migrated project. However the duration for project task was set.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select the Projects view-Select the Projects subview -Search for the Project ID XYZ-Edit the project-Go to Project plan tab, select the project header you see that the Start date and Finish date are same . However the project duration n days maintained.-Cause-The projects that are migrated with the released status may have incorrect Finish Date however you see that the duration is set. Based on the Start date and duration the Finish date will not automatically get adjusted. Once a project is in the released status, the scheduling requires the manager to manually Schedule the project to see the adjusted dates and duration. If the dates and duration are required to be automatically calculated, then the project has to be In planning. However, this would again mean that there is a manual release that the project manager is expected to do for every project.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.

Title: Wrong Profit Center Derivation in Invoice Based on Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Customer Invoice XYZ is based on Sales Order ABC. Sales Order ABC contains 2 line items, each for the same Product DEF. (ABC, DEF and XYZ stands for Sales Order ID, Product ID and Customer Invoice ID)-In line with the definitions made in the Business Configuration the expectation is that Profit Center A is pulled into the resulting journal entry for both invoice line-items XYZ-10 and XYZ-20.-When opening the invoice journal entry you notice that in the line-items representing the revenue posting, one item credits profit center B and the other profit center A.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this case the profit center should be derived from the product category.-To identify the product category:-Click the Product ID.-In the product master data, choose View All.-In tab General the Product Category is indicated-The definitions for the profit center allocation are made in:-Business Configuration work center.-Fine Tuning activity Profit Center Derivation.-Select  Profit Center Derivation by Product Category for Sales.-For the respective Company ID and Sales Unit ID you find the product category and the allocated Profit Center ID A.-Cause-Profit center B is already assigned in sales order item ABC-10. Initially when the sales order was created a different product/service has been provided in sales order item ABC-10. Consequently a different defined product category led to the deviating profit center derivation B. Only later the product has been changed.-It is a current system definition that the once executed profit center derivation will not happen again and remains the same.-Resolution-In case an affected sales order and/or invoice cannot be canceled a profit center re-assignment can be effected for sales order items.-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Enter the Sales Document Items view.-In the search field, select sales order ABC and select item ABC-10.-Via the button Reassign it is possible to specify the desired profit center A.--In order for profit center A to be perpetuated the invoice journal entry will have to be reposted. The financial period has to be re-opened in case it is closed by now.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Open the Closing Cockpit view and click Source Documents.-Select Show: All Source Documents.-Open the Advanced select option and specify 28 - Customer Invoice as Related Source Document Type and XYZ as Related Source Document ID.-Click Actions and choose View Business Transaction.-By choosing Reverse and Repost the correct profit center will be transferred into the journal entry and into financial reporting.-Keywords-profit center derivation; sales order; customer invoice; journal entry

Title: Error While Creating New Individual Material
Content: Symptom-System displays the error message The individual materials are inconsistent due to an inactive company. Remove the individual materials or activate the company, while creating a new individual material in a purchase order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Order and Requests work center.-Select the Purchase Order view.-Search for All Purchase Order under Show All and find the required purchase order.-Edit the Purchase Order and choose the button View All.-Navigate to Items tab.-Choose the relevant line item.-Select the button New Individual Material.-press Save.-System displays the below error message.-The individual materials are inconsistent due to an inactive company. Remove the individual materials or activate the company.-Cause-The associated Business Partner of the purchasing company has its status Blocked. This is the reason why the system displays the above error message.-Resolution-   1. Go to Organizational Management Work Center.-   2. Choose the Org Structure view.-   3. Search the relevant Company.-   4. Go to the Definition tab.-   5. Navigate to Legal Definitions->Country of Registration->Associated Business Partner.-   6. Open the corresponding Business Partner Organization.-   7. Change the status to Active.

Title: Disable Goods And Service Receipt Approvals
Content: Symptom-You want to disable the approval process for Goods And Service Receipts in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project.-Click in Edit Project Scope button.-In Edit Project Scope screen, navigate to the Questions step.-Expand the scoping element Purchasing.-Expand Purchase Request and Order Management.-Select Goods and Services Receipts.-Under Questions for Goods and Services Receipts, you see a question "Do you want to use an approval process for goods and services receipts?" . -Resolution-User can either disable the scoping question, or maintain conditions in the approval process which will never be satisfied.-Keywords-Goods and services receipt, approval process, scoping question, approval task

Title: Validation Check of GST Number for Country NZ Faild
Content: Symptom-You tried to maintain a GST Number in the account master data, but got error message:Invalid GST Number; check digit failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Edit one account and go to Financial Data tab.-Click Add Row and maintain Country as NZ - New Zealand, Tax Number Type as GST Number, Tax Number as for example 12345670.-You get error message: Invalid GST Number ; check digit failed.-Cause-There are some validation check for the GST number like:-Tax number should be between 10000000 and 150000000.-Length should be of 8 or 9 digit.-Last digit of the tax number should be equal to 11 - (first 8 digit * 32765432) mod 11 .-If the validation is not met, the system will throw corresponding error message. The number 12345670 doesn't meet the last check so it failed. According to that check the last digit is expected to be 4. So, 12345674 will be the valid number.-Resolution-You have to check and use a valid GST number.

Title: Journal Report Shows Cancelled Customer Invoice as Source Doc. Item
Content: Symptom-You have canceled a customer invoice. When you run the Journal report the system shows the canceled document as a valid one for the Source Doc. Item and you consider this behavior not correct.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Select the Design Reports view-Search for the Journal report and open it-Complete the necessary search details like Company, Set of Books, Posting Date-Click on Go button-On the right side of the screen extend the Not Currently Shown list-Select the Source Doc. ID option and with the right mouse button Move to Rows-The same you can do for Source Doc. Item-In the Source Doc. ID field type the current valid customer invoice cancellation ABC-And click on Go button-You can see the original and canceled customer invoice XYZ still linked on the report on the Source Doc. Item field- On your perspective this is not correct as the original document XYZ is canceled and hence should not appear anymore on the report.-Cause-Once we cancel a customer invoice the journal entry is reversed and for this action the system must register which is the direct document that was canceled.-In this case the Source Doc. Item will be the original one (even if it is canceled). It is the only way the system has to link the document-flow.-The scenario is working properly and the Source Doc. Item is directly depended on the Source Document ID they are not independent.-This is to ensure that the document-flow is tied with the chronologic document creation.

Title: Supplier Invoice Approval Task Unassigned
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice and it went for approval based on the approval rules that you set in Application and User Management work center. However the supplier invoice approval task is unassigned and determine assignment button did not work and leads to below application log.-Use action "Assign Item" to manually assign a responsible to the task.-Task belongs to parallel approval step, where all approvers are required.-Determination of assignments for such task not possible.-Use action "Assign Item" to manually assign a responsible to the task.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order.-Select New Invoice and fill the mandatory details.-Select Post and invoice went for approval.-Now go the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Select the Business Task Management view.-Select Unassigned Tasks and select Determine Assignment button.-Leads to above application log.-Cause-The issue is caused by the Flag All approvals required that you have setup in the Approval process. If such a flag is set in an applicable step, multiple tasks are created, one for each responsible that has been determined, so that an explicit individual approval from all responsible is required. The issue arises if no responsible are determined when the tasks are created. In that case only a single inconsistent task without any responsible is created which then needs to be manually assigned to a responsible. The affected supplier invoice is assigned to account assignment type (Cost center, Project task etc.) and relevant approver does not have sufficient authorizations to the work center view MMA_SUPPLIERINVOICING. Additionally the user is not assigned to any Org Unit or Company.-Note that if you had the Automatic Approval flag, the approval would have been bypassed in this case.-Resolution-In these case of approvals, if you select the "Automatic Approval" flag, the approval would have been bypassed. Always make sure the person responsible has sufficient authorizations, else task gets unassigned. In order to Post this supplier invoice, assign the person responsible to the work center view MMA_SUPPLIERINVOICING and then use Action -> "Assign Item" to manually assign a responsible to the task.

Title: Materials With Sales Status Block Displaying Under Incomplete Materials
Content: Symptom-You have blocked the Sales process of a particular Material and later observed that the Material is listed under Incomplete Material.-Reproducing the Issue-Block the Sales Process of a Material.-Go to Materials view.-Select Incomplete Materials, the above Material is listed here.-Cause-The materials are shown as part of Incomplete Materials if any of the processes are in status In Preparation or Blocked.-Resolution-If a Product is listed under Incomplete Materials, this implies that this product could be blocked either for Sales or Procurement but maybe Active for Supply Planning / Availability Confirmation / Inventory / Financials. The product can however be used in any SCM /SRM scenario but cannot be used in a Sales scenario. Likewise, if any one entry amongst the list of the Sales Organization & Distribution Channel status is maintained as Blocked, then this would up in Incomplete Materials.--This is expected system behavior.

Title: Error Message While Simulating Manual Posting - Acquistion for Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-Customer is receiving error message "Define a default profit center for company XXX and subledger Fixed Assets" when simulating an Manual Posting - Acquisition.--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to Fixed Assets View.-Click on Fixed Assets Sub-View.-Select the Fixed Asset.-Click on Manual Posting and then on Acquisition.-Define the Document Date and the Posting Date (for example, 31/07/2014).-Click on Simulate.-You'll receive error message "Define a default profit center for company XXX and subledger Fixed Assets".-Cause-Issue is happening because the Start Date for this Fixed Asset is for a date after the one selected on the Document Date and the Posting Date (for example, the Start Date is 01/08/2014).-You can check the Start Date by following the steps bellow:-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to Fixed Assets View.-Click on Fixed Assets Sub-View.-Open the Fixed Asset.-Click on View All.-Go to Master Data tab.-Go to Basic Data Sub-tab.-Resolution- There are two approaches for this issue:-You can try to anticipate the Start Date (to 31/07/2014 on the example) and then simulate the Manual Posting - Acquisition.-You can try to postpone the Document Date and the Posting Date (to 01/08/2014 on the example) and then simulate the Manual Posting - Acquisition.-By following one of this options, you should no longer receive the error message.

Title: Data Source Purchasing Contract Item Release Does not Show Any Data
Content: Symptom-When previewing Data Source Purchasing Contract Item Release, you receive the message: No report data available.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Search for the Purchasing Contract Item Release or SRMCT_B03.-Click on Preview.-You receive the message: No report data available﻿.-Cause-The data source Purchasing Contract Item Release is set on Item release anchor node. The Item Release node in the Contract only gets filled when the reference documents use the Contract (Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice, etc).-Resolution-You only see data when you use this Contract in reference Documents, such as Purchase Orders, Supplier Invoices and so on.

Title: Post Goods Receipt Button Disabled in the Inbound Logistics Work Center
Content: Symptom-A Purchase Order for a “To Stock” material was created, but the Post Goods Receipt button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search and Select the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID).-Observe that the Post Goods Receipt button is disabled.-Cause-The Purchase Order is an Intercompany Stock Transfer, so direct Goods Receipt posting is not allowed.-An Inbound Delivery Notification must be created to process the inbound delivery.-Note: If the Business Partner (Seller) is created as an Org Unit, the system treats it as an Intercompany Stock Transfer, and direct Goods Receipt posting is not allowed. The Post Goods Receipt option is therefore disabled to prevent duplicate processing.-To resolve this, either remove the Supplier as an Org Unit or create an Inbound Delivery Notification for the Purchase Order and then proceed with Goods Receipt.-Resolution-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search and select the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID).-Choose New Supplier Delivery Notification.-Enter the Delivery Notification ID.-Choose Save.--Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search and select the created Inbound Delivery Notification ABC (ABC represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Proceed with Post Goods Receipt against the Inbound Delivery Notification.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Intercompany, Post Goods Receipt, New Supplier Delivery Notification, Organization Structure, Post Goods Receipt Button Disabled

Title: Unposted Source Document Error: Account Determination Missing for Account Determination Group Production Costs
Content: Symptom-You have noticed an unposted source document and an error message which prevent the document being posted. The error message is Account determination missing for Account Determination Group Production Costs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Work view.-Show Open Tasks option.-You can see the subject error:-Account determination missing for Account Determination Group Production Costs.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents sub-view.-And search for your Source Document ID, in this case the Source Document is a Goods and Service Receipt.-Select the ID and under the Details session you can see this error:-Account determination missing for Account Determination Group Production Costs.-Cause-You are getting this error message as you have not maintained the account determination for account determination group production costs.-Resolution-Please maintain the configuration following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on View button.-Under Account Determination section select Costs.-Select your Account Determination Profile.-Go to General Expenses tab.-Click on Add Row button.-Maintain the Account Determination Group for General Expense.-Click on Save and Close.-Now you are able to post the Unposted Source Document:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Search for your Source Document ID, in this case the source document is Goods and Service Receipt.-Select the ID and click on Actions -> Post Business Transaction.-To determine the account determination group, check the Items -> Account Assignment tab in your Goods and Service Receipt and find the account determination group corresponding to them.

Title: Error Message "ID not permitted for process type Commande client; it is an external number"
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate the Open Sales Order, system throws below error message:-ID not permitted for process type Command client; it is an external number-ID missing-Document not available for data migration-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and open the migration activity Migration of Open Sales Orders-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-The cause for the issue is that current Implementation project might be already Live and hence, any changes to scoping, certain Migration activities should be performed only through a Change Project.-Resolution-In this case, you can perform the migration of Open Sales Orders only using a new Change Project.--The steps are as follows,--1. Create a New Change Project.-2. Include the activity Migration of Open Sales Orders into it.-3. Close the Activity.-4. Perform the merge of the Change Project. Now, the activity Migration of Open Sales Orders will be reopened automatically.-5. Perform the Migration.-6. Close the activity.-7. Close the change project.

Title: You receive the error "Externally-managed location XYZ cannot have a logistics area below it" when setting a Location as an Externally-Managed Location
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set the Location XYZ as an Externally-Managed Location, however when you check the box you receive the error Externally-managed location XYZ cannot have a logistics area below it.-You have set its child logistics areas below ﻿XYZ as Obsolete.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chan Design Master Data work center-Go to Locations view-Select the location XYZ-Select the option Edit-Check the box Externally-Managed Location-Receive the error message-Cause-It is not possible to set a location as an External Managed Warehouse once you add a child logistics area below it.-Setting the child logistics area as Obsolete will not change this behavior because you can revert obsolete status of the logistics area.-Resolution-System is working as expected.

Title: The Source of Supply Cannot be Determined; Check the Sourcing Relevant Master Data
Content: Symptom-When releasing customer demand document created against a Project Stock Order, system displays the below error message:-"The source of supply cannot be determined; check the sourcing-relevant master data."-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant document, select it and choose the Release button.-The above error message is displayed.-Cause-There isn't a logistics area with logistics use Project Stock under the site from which is planning to deliver the stock to the project.-Resolution-To create a logistics area with logistic use Project Stock, follow the steps below:-Go to the work center Supply Chain Design Master Data.-Navigate to the view Locations.-Select the relevant Site/Location ID and choose the button Edit Layout.-In the Site Layout screen, select the relevant location/logistics area and choose the button Add Child Logistics Area. You can also choose the button Add Logistics Area At Same Level depending on your site layout.-The logistic use for the new logistics area must be selected as Project Stock.-After performing the above steps it is allowed to release the relevant customer demand document.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Project Stock Order, Site, Location, Source of Supply.

Title: Migrated Purchase Orders Does not Show the Account Assignment
Content: Symptom-You have migrated the purchase orders and migration was successfully completed. However when you open the migrated purchase order under items tab, the account assignment field is blank.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects and select Open Activity List.-Navigate to Integrate and Extend tab.-Select the activity Migration of Purchase Orders.-Select Migrate purchase orders using the migration tool.-  Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the migrated Purchase Order.-Navigate to the Items tab and select Account Assignment sub tab.-The Account Assignment Type field is blank.-Cause-The migration template has two account assignments to the Purchase Order line item. For Example: Purchase order line item ABC-1 assigned to both cost center XYZ and Individual Material 100000000. This is not allowed.-Resolution-It is not possible to have two account assignments for one purchase order line item. For Example: The affected Purchase Order ABC has an account assignment to cost center XYZ and individual material 1000000. You need to assign only one account assignment for purchase order line item in the migration template and then it will reflect in the migrated purchase order successfully.

Title: No Data Shown in the Milestone Trend Analysis Report
Content: Symptom-When you are accessing the report Milestone Trend Analysis no data is shown and you are unable to select any Project for the selection.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center and access the view Reports List;-Open the report Milestone Trend Analysis;-Click on the value help for the characteristic Project, see that you can't select any Projects here.-If you copy a Project ID into the field you will be able to see this information in the value help, however, the report won't return any data.-Cause-The report Milestone Trend Analysis (PROPRJU01_Q0001) is based on the Data Source Project Snapshot (PROPRJU01), meaning that the report/data source will only return data if you have a Project Snapshot in your system.-Resolution-In order to show data in the Milestone Trend Analysis report, you will need to create a Project Snapshot Run, in order to do this, follow the steps below:-Go to the Project Management work center and access the view Snapshot Runs;-Click on New Snapshot Run;-In this new screen you will be able to select if you want the snapshot run to select a specific project or a specific project type, after defining all required information here, you can click on Save and then Set to Active;-Back to the Snapshot Runs view, select the newly created snapshot run and click on Start Immediately;-Your report should return data successfully now.

Title: System is not considering the ESR Prefix when creating Supplier Invoice IDs
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a ERS Prefix for an specific supplier but when you execute the Evaluated Receipt Settlement Run the resultant invoices does not contain the prefix in their ID's.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Evaluated Receipt Settlement view-Select one of the maintained runs-See in its logs that the invoices created are not containing the ERS Prefix maintained in the Supplier master data-To see the maintained prefix:-Go to Supplier Base work center-Go to Suppliers view-Select the desired supplier-Select the option Edit, then Purchasing-The prefix is maintained in the field ERS Invoice Number Prefix-Cause-The system is working as expected. The Supplier Invoices IDs are not defined based on the ERS Prefix.-The prefix is added to a specific field in the supplier invoice itself.-Resolution-To see the ERS Prefix in the supplier invoice, please follow the steps below:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Open the desired supplier invoice-See that under the General Information section, the field Sequential Document Number shows the ERS Prefix-PS: When cancelling an invoice created by an ERS Run, the resultant cancelation invoice ID will contain the defined Prefix.-The system is working as expected, only a cancelation invoice has the prefix in its ID.

Title: Error Message : Project stock order not created; all materials are non stock
Content: Symptom-While creating Project stock order system throws an error message Project stock order not created; all materials are non stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects View.-Choose Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Chose Edit -> Project Plan.-Go to the Products tab -> Products Overview sub tab.-Here choose the Product and click on the Create Project Stock Order button system throws an error message Project stock order not created; all materials are non stock .-Cause-From stock is not enabled in the planned material for which you want to create the Project stock order.-Project Stock consumption is not scoped.-Resolution-Cause 1 : From stock is not enabled-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects View.-Choose Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Chose Edit -> Project Plan.-Choose project header or project task .-Go to the Material subtab here you can see the From Stock check box should be enabled.-Cause 2 : Project Stock consumption is not scoped.-It means From Stock check box itself not available under material subtab.-CD 2034794 - From Stock Check Box is not Available.

Title: Error While Posting Supplier Invoices:Tax code only valid for import VAT items
Content: Symptom-An error appears while trying to post a Supplier Invoice : Tax code only valid for import VAT items.-Note: You have used the Tax Code specific to Imports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order.-Select New Invoice and fill the mandatory details.-Select Check.-The error "Tax code only valid for import VAT items" appears.-Cause-The Import VAT tax code is not valid for Item type : Invoice Items. It is only valid for import items.You can check the item type under Items-> Basic Data-> Item Type.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior. When you import goods and the billing of the goods for these items along with separate Tax, we can create a Customs Duty Invoice and assign the Tax code along with the Purchase Order Reference in the Items Tab. The customs duty invoices cannot be created with reference to a Purchase Order from the Invoice Entry screen.  You have to manually create the Supplier Invoice from the common tasks view.-Alternatively, you can create a Supplier invoice with items of Item Type Import VAT debit Item and use this tax code.-Keywords-Import VAT Item, tax code, supplier invoice, exception

Title: How to Show Up the SAP Business ByDesign tab in Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You have already installed the SAP Add In for Microsoft Excel successfully, however the SAP Business ByDesign tab is not displayed from the Excel menu.-Reproducing the Issue-Although you have already installed the SAP Add In for Microsoft Excel the Tab is not shown as below:- Cause-The Visual Studio Toll for Office file (.vsto) for the SAP Add-in is not started in the Excel Add-in setup. By consequence, the SAP Add-in does not start.- Resolution-In order to show up the SAP Business ByDesign tab in the Excel menu, you need to enable the Add-in in the COM Add-ins settings.-Open the Microsoft Excel-Click on File-Click on Options-In the Excel Options screen, select Add-ins menu-In the Manage drop down list, select COM Add-ins and click on Go- For the Add-ins list available, check the box SAP Add-in for Microsoft Excel-Click on Ok button-Restart the Microsoft Excel-

Title: From Stock  Check Box is not Available.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***Archived reason: duplicate of KB0876180***-In the Project From Stock  Check Box is not Available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects View.-Choose Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Chose Edit -> Project Plan.-Choose project header or project task .-Go to the Material subtab here you can see the From Stock check box is not available.-Cause-The scoping option Project Stock consumption question is not scoped and the question Do you want to use project stock orders to source material from stock, for consumption during a project?.-The Project Stock consumption business option allow you to source material consumed within the project from stock . if you want to consume a material form stock rather than buy from an external supplier, you have to create a project stock order from a project or a project task. The item in the project stock order can be of type consumption at site , pick up or pre delivery. Depending on the item type the handling on the logistic side varies.-To verify whether the Project Stock Consumption is scoped or not kindly follow the below steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Overview.-Under Business configuration search and find the  Project Stock Consumption here you can see the status of the Scoping Element.-Resolution-If you want to use project stock orders to source material from stock kindly follow the below steps to do the same.--1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Choose the Implementation Projects view.-3. Choose Project and Choose Edit Project Scope button.-4. Go to Step 3 - Scoping -> Project Management ->Project Planning and Execution->Project Stock Consumption here choose the Check Box to scope Project Stock Consumption.-5. Go to Step 4 - Questions -> here enable the question Do you want to use project stock orders to source material from stock, for consumption during a project?.-6. Complete all the steps until Confirm to save the changes made in system.--Once you scope this option in your system when you plan the material in the From Stock option will be  avilable.-
