Title: Missing Tax Code When Creating a New Manual VAT Tax Entry
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new manual VAT tax entry, however you are missing the tax code, for example: 14- Import VAT, standard rate (imposed by customs) 17%, even though it is maintained in the Fine-Tune activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Manual Tax Entries view and click VAT Entries subview.-Click New -> Tax Entry.-Fill in the necessary information.-When you open the Tax Code dropdown menu, tax code 14- Import VAT, standard rate (imposed by customs) 17%, for example, is missing.-Cause-The manual tax entry does not support entry of direct taxes such as Import VAT.-On the UI (User Interface) an import VAT tax code looks exactly like a regular tax code, but the functionality behind it is different.-For regular tax codes you enter a net amount (the value of the good you purchase/sell) which is the base amount for taxes.-In an import scenario you sometimes do not even know the base value, you just get an invoice from your customer authority stating how much import VAT you own. In this case you are unable to enter a base amount for calculating taxes. This is why the tax codes for import VAT behave differently. Technically the amount you enter is treated as a tax amount and not as a base amount for tax calculation. We call this a Direct VAT tax code as you enter the VAT directly.-These kinds of tax codes cannot be used in the manual tax entry.-The manual tax entry only allows regular tax codes to be used.-Resolution-In order to create such documents, you can refer to Customs Invoice.-When you import products from other countries, the products may be subject to taxes and duties. You create a customs invoice for these taxes and duties based on the invoice you received from your customs authorities.-You can create customs invoices in the Supplier Invoicing work center on Common Tasks or on Invoice Entry view.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Create a Customs Invoice-Keywords-Import Tax. VAT. Manual Tax Entry. Manual VAT Tax Entry. Tax Code.

Title: How to prevent users from creating Purchase Orders for Blocked Suppliers
Content: Symptom-You have changed the status of the supplier ABC to Blocked, however you are still able to enter its ID when creating a purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select the common task New Purchase Order-Enter the supplier ABC-You receive the warning message Party Seller with ID ABC blocked, however since it is a warning message, you are still able to post the document.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior. Even setting the status of a supplier as Blocked, the system still allows the users to create documents with inconsistent status.-Resolution-To prevent the users from creating purchase orders for determined supplier, you need check the box Purchasing Blocked in its master data.-Go to Supplier Base work center-Go to Suppliers view-Select the supplier ABC-Select the option Edit and then Purchasing-Check the box Purchasing Blocked-Save the changes-Now, the users of the system will not be able to post purchase orders using the supplier ABC.-Note that this change will not prevent the user from entering the supplier when creating a supplier invoice. If the box is checked but the supplier's status is still Active, the supplier invoice can be posted.-To prevent users from posting purchase orders and supplier invoices, you need to change the status of the supplier to Blocked and check the box Purchasing Blocked.-You can also change the status of the supplier to Obsolete.-See Also-1687166 - Although the Status of the Business Partner is Blocked or Obsolete, It is still Available for Selection-1720980 - Blocked/Obsolete Suppliers are Still Available in Service Agents but not in Purchase Orders-Keywords-Purchase Order，Supplier，Blocked,  Purchasing Blocked

Title: The Preview For Put Away Task Does Not Show Any Values in the Actual Quantity Column
Content: Symptom-When you are previewing the put-away task ID, the preview PDF does not display any values in the Actual Quantity column.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Select the Task ID and select the Preview button and choose the Preview option from it.-In the opened window, the system does not show any value in the actual quantity column.-Cause-In the Actual Quantity field, we enter the quantity values that has been received in the warehouse when doing the inbound logistics process or moved out from the warehouse when doing the outbound logistics process.-Further, when you enter any value in the actual quantity column, as soon as you save it, the entered quantity is removed from Open quantity field and is added to the Fulfilled quantity field. Thus, the actual quantity field never stores any quantity value and hence, no values gets displayed when previewing the task ID.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.

Title: Project Task Missing in the Employee Time Sheet
Content: Symptom-An user is assigned to a project task, however when accessing his/her timesheet, this task is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Time Sheet view-Search for the desired user-Select Open Time Sheet-Add a row for enter new times-Go to Labor Information tab-Open the value help window for field Project Task-Search for the project task XYZ ((XYZ refers to project ID)-No records found-Or,-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks view and select Edit Time Sheet subview.-Search for project XYZ using the Value Selection under Tasks column. Or in the Manage My Worklist you can see the project ﻿XYZ ﻿is not available.-Cause-1.The scheduling date of the project task is planned to a date before the current date.-There is a filter called Planned From/To in the help value window for the project task field.-This filter automatically fulfilled by system. The Planned From date is fulfilled with the current date.--2.In the project XYZ, the Time Recording under Basic Data Tab is set as Not Allowed. Hence, the project is not shown in the employee timesheet.-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1:-The user needs to change the Planned From date to a date where the project task is still valid.-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Time Sheet view-Search for the desired user-Select Open Time Sheet-Add a row for enter new times-Go to Labor Information tab-Open the value help window for field Project Task-Select Advanced to open the advanced search mode-Change the Planning From date to a date where the project task is valid-The desired task will be displayed in the search-Another approach that can be applied is to extend the scheduling dates for the project tasks under the Project Management Work Center, resulting in the tasks being shown in the search.--Resolution for cause 2:-Go to Project Management work center-Select Projects subview under Projects view.-Open the project XYZ -Navigate to Basic Data under Project Plan Tab.-Set the Time Recording as Approval Required/ No Approval Required.-Select Save.-The project XYZ is now available in the timesheet for time recording.-See Also-1626121 - Assigned Project Tasks are Missing in Time Sheet of an Employee-2563339 - Project Task Unavailable in Employees Timesheet-2598705 - Project Task not Available in Add Time Entry - Work Package Task Field-Keywords-Edit Time Sheet, Project Task Missing, Project Time Recording, Project Not Available

Title: Error Message : Period plan dates of work are inconsistent with that of task XYZ-N.
Content: Symptom-While trying to extend the project duration or changing the scheduled dates, the system throws an error message: Period plan dates of work are inconsistent with that of task XYZ-N (XYZ-N represents the Project task ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Project Management work center-Choose the Projects view-Choose the Projects subview-Choose the Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Choose the Edit -Project Plan button.-Choose the Project Task XYZ-N (XYZ-N represents the Project task ID). -Navigate to Scheduling Tab-> here try to extend the duration or enter the start date.-System throws an error message as "Period plan dates of work are inconsistent with that of task XYZ-N".-Cause-In the Project task XYZ-N, Period planned dates are earlier than the actual start date, hence the Period plan dates of work are inconsistent.-To check the period planned date, please follow the steps:-Choose the Project Task XYZ-N (XYZ-N represents the Project task ID). -Navigate to Work Tab here you can see the period planned dates are earlier than the actual project task start date.-Resolution-Change the Actual Start Date same as the Period Planned date then the task will become consistent.-To change the actual date please follow the below mentioned steps:-Choose the Project Task XYZ-N (XYZ-N represents the Project task ID). -Navigate to Scheduling Tab-> here enter the Actual start date same as the Period Planned date.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-project start date, project end date, Period plan dates of work are inconsistent with that of task

Title: You Are Not Able to Add the Approvals View to Your Home Work Center
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add the Approvals view to your Home Work Center. Where as you have an option to add the other views to Home under Personalize link.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Manage My Area Work Center and then to Approvals View.-Select the link Personalize from the top of the screen.-You do not find an option to add this view to your Home Work Center, Where as you have this option in other views.-Cause-The system is working as designed. The Approvals view of Manage My Area Work Center gets the tasks from various other Work Centers like Sales Orders and Purchase Requests and Orders etc. and moving this view to Home may cause data inconsistency.-Hence, it is decided that this view should not be added to the Home Work Center and this is why the option is not available to add this view to Home.-Resolution

Title: Supplier Information is not Displayed in Shopping Cart Item Details Data Source
Content: Symptom-You have built a report based on Data Source Shopping Cart Item Details  (SRMIR_B02) and the Supplier field is showing as Not Assigned (#) even though the Supplier information is maintained at Item level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the customized report.-Drag Supplier from Not Currently Shown to Rows.-The information will come as Not Assigned﻿. -Cause-As the Shopping Cart has not been taken from the catalog, the Data Source does not show the Supplier information for the item. However, for this case, the Data Source stores the same data inside characteristic Preferred Supplier.-Resolution-In order to show the Supplier information, please use the ﻿Preferred Supplier﻿ characteristic, which is present at ﻿Not Currently Shown﻿ area.-Keywords-SRMIR_B02, Shopping Cart Item Details, data source, supplier, #, unassigned, report, missing data, wrong report

Title: Report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Does Not Show Employee Information of  Expense Report Related to Project
Content: Symptom-You run report Report Project Cost and Revenue by Project to check the employee information of the expense reports with cost assignment to project XYZ.-But you find the field Employee shows as Not Assigned for all expense reports in the report.-Reproducing the Issue-The report Project Cost and Revenue by Project is located in work center Project Management.-Cause-Employee information is not displayed because this is not captured in accounting at all for Expense Reports.-If you look at the journal entry created for this expense report, you can see that employee information is not displayed in that as well. In fact, currently, employee information is not sent from Expense Management to Accounting at all.-Resolution-You can go to the Travel and Expense work center,  run report Expense Reports by Cost Object and select view as By Project. It should show the employee name. You can also run report Projects - Line Items from the Project Management work center for the employee information.

Title: Confirmation Journal Report Shows No Original Document For Stock Transfer
Content: Symptom-You run the Confirmation Journal report and find the fields Original Document Type and Original Document ID populated with # (not assigned) for a stock transfer transaction. You wonder what could be the reason because obviously every stock transfer is based on an original document (as seen in the document flow).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Reports List view.-Open the Confirmation Journal report.-Add Original Document Type, Original Document ID and Conf.ID to rows.-Cause-Please check if the following explanation is applicable to your issue:-The original document type is not displayed as stock transfer order for the warehouse confirmation is because it has been created on the inbound side of a different site (receiver side) than that of the stock transfer order.--Stock transfer is divided in two processes - outbound at sending site and inbound at receiving site. The document created at receiving site does not have references to documents created at sending site, in this case the stock transfer order.-Resolution-This is the expected and correct system behavior.

Title: Error Message : "Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed."
Content: Symptom-When the Project Manager approves or rejects time records against a project, the system shows the below error message when trying to save the time records:-Error: "Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes."-(DD.MM.YYYY represents the date)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Project Management work center-Choose the Approvals view-Choose the Time Recordings subview-Approve or Reject the time records against the project-Save-Error: "Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes"-Cause-The system will not allow to approve or reject the project time recording on the date DD.MM.YYYY., because this date is blocked for postings in financial accounting.-Resolution-Navigate to General Ledger work center-Choose Master Data view-Choose Set of books and assigned companies sub view-Select the Company and click on open and close period button-Select the respective period-If period is closed, kindly open the period by clicking on the Open period button-Also check the process control maintained for the period. If required, create a process control entry by following below steps:-Navigate to General Ledger work center-Choose Master Data view-Choose Companies sub view-Choose the Company ID with Set of Books ID-Choose Set Process Control button-Click on Add Row-Enter the values as below:-Process Control Status : 1 - Not Blocked-Business Process Group : 01 - All-From Posting Date :-To Posting Date :-The period of the From Posting Date / To Posting Date always refers to the posting date in the source document. The posting date of the document should be between From Posting Date and To Posting Date.-Entry Possible Until : The date in this field refers to the entry date in the source document. You can allow, for example, that a source document can still be entered for a period after the accounting period has been closed, as long as the document has a posting date within the accounting period.-See Also-Also check the help document Process Control for Operational Postings for further information.-Keywords-not possible, not allowed

Title: How To Restrict Price In Manual Project Invoice Request.
Content: Symptom-User can restrict the price in sales integration project for a fixed price Manual Project Invoice Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Project Invoicing sub view.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Select the sales order and Click on New.-Click on Manual Project Invoice Request.-Input the required details and click on next.-In Refine Invoice Items step.-System allows us to change the Price.-Cause-The reason is you have maintained as a Manual entry has priority for List Price in Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Click on Implementation activity.-Select your project.-Click on Open Activity list.-Search for Configure Price Strategy in Fine tune.-Edit and click on Pricing Procedure.-Select Standard Procedure for List Price.-Change Manual Change control to Not possible to process manually.-Save and close it.-See Also-Keywords-Price List restriction;

Title: System does not consider Currency when selecting List Price
Content: Symptom-You have created two List Prices for the supplier XYZ and product ABC, where each one is using a different currency (i.e. one using USD and other using EUR).-You expect the system to select the list based on the Currency of the Purchase Order, however this is not what is happening.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center-Click on the New Purchase Order common task-Enter the Supplier XYZ-Enter a Currency-Enter a Product ABC-The Price selected by the system is not the one that you were expecting-Cause-The system will consider the conversion of the currency, based on the maintained Exchange Rate.-Even if the purchase order is created in EUR, if after the conversion the List Price in dollar still has the lowest price, it will be the one selected by the system.-Resolution-System is working as designed.

Title: VAT Margin Scheme for UK
Content: Symptom-You want to apply the VAT Margin Scheme for UK in Business ByDesign as part of your VAT process.-Overview:--VAT margin schemes tax the difference between what you paid for an item and what you sold it for, rather than the full selling price.--You can choose to use a margin scheme when you sell:-second-hand goods-works of art-antiques-collectors’ items-You can’t use a margin scheme for:-any item you bought for which you were charged VAT-precious metals-investment gold-precious stones-Example:-You buy a work of art for £1,500 and sell it for £2,000. Using a margin scheme, you pay VAT (at the standard rate of 20%) on the difference: £500. This means you’ll pay £83.33.--Further details can be checked at: https://www.gov.uk/vat-margin-schemes- Resolution-The VAT Margin Scheme for UK is not supported in SAP Business ByDesign current release.-The only way to achieve this is to change the rate to reflect the reduction in the base amount for tax calculation.-Suppose the line item price is 100 and the standard tax rate is 20%. If you want the tax base amount to be 50 instead of 100, you can change the rate to 10% as the base amount cannot be changed in the system.-This will help in calculating the correct tax amount.--However, this workaround needs to be verified by your company with relation to audit regulations that such a change in tax rate to achieve VAT margin scheme is fine or not.

Title: While Approving Purchase Order You Receive An Error Message Action Not Enabled
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While you are trying to approving a Purchase Order system displays the error message - Action not enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center-Choose the Approvals view-Choose the Purchase Order ABC to be approved-Choose the Approve button, now the system throws an error message as "Action Not Enabled".-Cause-The Purchase Order was ordered with the Sales Order assigned to it and then the Purchase Order went in to In Approval. When the Purchase Order was In Approval, the Sales Order was completed. The user is trying to approve the Purchase Order after the Sales Order that was assigned to it was completed. This is the reason why the Approve action is failing for the purchase order. --Resolution-As a work around you can assign the Purchase Order to the different Sales Order which is in Open/In Process status and then approve the Purchase Order.-Keywords-Action Not Enabled, Purchase order approval error, error message

Title: Unable to Receive E-Mail Notifications for Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase request and no supplier is assigned yet. As a consequence, you expect system to send an E-Mail notification saying "Assign Supplier to Purchase Request" to your inbox. However you did not receive any E-Mail notifications.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Select the Open Tasks view.-You can see the task Assign Supplier to the Purchase Request.-However user not received any E-Mail notifications for this task.-Cause-You are not assigned to the Task Subscriptions in the Home work center.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to get the E-Mail notifications;-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Inbox view.-Select Subscribe to Tasks button.-Select Purchase Requests and Orders task element.-Select Purchase Request.-Select Assign Supplier to Purchase Request for E-Mail. (If required, kindly assign the task type, Escalation: Assign Supplier to Purchase Request also).-Save and Close the document.-Once the tasks are configured for E-Mail, users will receive the E-Mail notification in their inbox.

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice Due to Error Tax amount differs from calculated tax amount
Content: Symptom-You changed manually the Calculated Taxes for a supplier invoice in the tab General, sub-tab Taxes. Upon saving the change, you get an error: Tax amount ABC differs from calculated tax amount DEF.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Select the invoice and choose Edit.-Go to the tab General, sub-tab Taxes, sub-tab Tax Details.-Enter the desired Tax Amounts.-Choose Save or Check.-You get the error mentioned above and cannot post the invoice.-Cause-When you manually change the Tax Amounts, the Total Tax Amount is automatically adjusted. However you need to accept an exception of type Tax Variance before proceeding and post the invoice. As well, the Total Gross Amount needs to be changed manually so that the balance equals to zero.-Resolution-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Select the invoice and choose Edit.-Choose Show Exception or navigate to the tab Exceptions.-Select the Tax Variance exception and choose Accept Tax Variance.-The invoice status will change to Ready for Posting and you can post the invoice.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Tax amount differs from calculated tax amount.

Title: Is it Possible to Embed a Image in Form Templates Using Adobe Life Cycle Designer?
Content: Symptom-You have created a Form template using Adobe Life Cycle Designer and embedded a Image (either a uploaded a image or a weblink to that image) into it. When you upload the Form Template into Business ByDesign/Cloud for Customer system, neither the Image nor the link is not working.-Resolution-Links/URLs are not supported for Forms in Business ByDesign/Cloud for Customer. Because Link is an object in Interactive Forms but all form templates in Business ByDesign/Cloud for Customer are static forms.-The functionality doesn't exist in Business ByDesign/Cloud for Customer where, in Adobe Lifecycle designer, there is an option to Embed images into Form template. Please refer to the help section "Using image fields" in Life Cycle Designer for the details to use it.--Note: Even using this functionality you can add a image to a Form template but not to each product.-

Title: Is it possible to export Account master data Ship-To, Bill-To or Dunning received addresses?
Content: Symptom-In the Account Master Data you can maintain several addresses, and you can define if that is a Bill-To or Ship-To address.-Is there a way to export only the Ship-To address of Accounts?-Also is there a way to export only the Bill-To or Dunning received?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select account ABC and click on Edit.-Go to tab Communication and sub-tab Addresses.-Here the mentioned Ship-To, Bill-To and Dunning received addresses are maintained / respectively can be maintained.-Cause-The feature described in this case is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This has already been forwarded to our product planning process.-Keywords-Account Master Data, Address, Ship To, Bill To

Title: Contents of Field "Supplier Part Number" not Copied in Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The contents of field Supplier Part Number are not copied over to a new document when you use the Copy function.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the purchase order you want to copy-Click on Copy-Verify that the Supplier Part Number field is blank, even though it is maintained in the original document.-Cause-This field is a field for purchase order items whose data is retrieved from the product master data, not from the copied purchase order. In your case, there is no product associated (product description and category is not sufficient), in which case the system cannot fetch the information from the master data.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. You have to maintain the supplier part number information in the affected product's master data in order for the system to fill the field automatically.

Title: Task Period Planning not Reflected in Resource Availability Calendar
Content: Symptom-You maintained the Plan Period for a particular task and team member in a Project. When you check the Availability Calendar of the team member, you notice that the commitments are not broken down at project task level but at project header level only. As well, the quantities planned are not reflected in accordance to the periods. The quantities are spread evenly across the whole duration of the task.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Project Management.-Go to the view Projects.-Select the project and choose Edit.-Go to the tab Project Plan.-Select the project task and go to the tab Work.-Select a row and choose Plan Period.-Select Generate Period Plan.-Enter the Planned Work for the Periods.-Choose OK and then Save.-Go to the tab Team and Staffing.-Select the relevant team member and choose Show Availability.-The quantities are not distributed according to the previously generated Period Plan.-Cause-The Availability Calendar in Resource Management considers the commitments done at Project level and not at the Task level, hence you see the distribution at Project Header. Currently, the commitments done at Project Task level in Period Plan are not considered for Availability Calendar.-Resolution-This is a new feature and this has been taken up in our product backlog as a requirement to be developed in a future release. Unfortunately it is not possible for our Support Team to provide you additional information regarding the availability of this feature in a future release. For further information regarding your request please contact your sales contact (Account Manager/Customer Advocate/Solution Advisor).

Title: Project Tasks Of Account Assignment Should Belong To The Same Project
Content: Symptom-While splitting the Account Assignment for a single line item of Purchase Order between two Projects system throws an error message as  Project tasks of account assignment should belong to the same project.-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose the New Purchase Order under Common Tasks.-Create a Purchase Order.-Enter required mandatory details.-When you try to split the account assignment for a single line item of purchase order between two Projects the above mentioned error will be shown.-Cause-If you have multiple line items ABC and EFG in the purchase order you can assign one line item ABC to Project 1 and the line team EFG to Project 2.--Even you can split the account assignment for a purchase order single line item among two different Project Task but not between the two different Projects.-You cannot split the cost of single line team among two different projects and the system will throw an error message as Project tasks of account assignment should belong to the same project--For example, for line item ABC, the account assignment can be split as follows:-- 20% — Project Task 1-- 80% — Project Task 2-But both the project task should belong to the same Project.--Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: The Quantity Field is not Editable in Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a project related sales order for item type:Service - fixed price (project).For few items, the quantity is maintained as 1ea. ("ea" is a Unit of Measurement).-Now, you create a project invoice request and in the "Refine Invoice Items" tab, you are able to edit the quantity for all the items which have quantity greater than 1 ea but not for the line items with quantity 1 ea.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select the relevant project under "All Projects" view-Now select New-> Project Invoice Request->Create Manual/Automatic Project Invoice Request-Under tab "Define Invoice Items", propose invoice items – using sales order items-Navigate to tab "Refine Invoice Items", and try to edit the quantity where 1 ea is maintained-The field is grayed out. Other line items with quantity greater than 1 ea are editable-Cause-As per the standard Items with Fixed Price, invoicing method follows:-If the Reference Sales Order item Quantity is not equal to 1:-The quantity is relevant for the calculation of the net value. So, while creation of the New Project Invoice Request, the Quantity field is editable and you can manually change the quantity.-If the Reference Sales Order item Quantity is equal to 1:-The quantity is not relevant for the calculation of the net value. The amount is considered to be a lump sum for the service or expense. Hence, while creation of the New Project Invoice Request, the Quantity field is not editable and you cannot change the quantity.-Resolution-You can enter a quantity greater than 1 in preceding sales order document, then the quantity is relevant for the calculation of the net value and the field will be editable in project invoice request.-See Also-Refer Help Document: Create a Project Invoice Request for a Customer Project-Keywords-Project invoice Request, Refine Invoice Items, Service - fixed price (project), quantity

Title: Wrong Values in Report "Revenue by Team Member" for Key Figure "Net Value - Invoiced"
Content: Symptom-You notice incorrect amounts for the Key Figure Net Value - Invoiced. These amounts are too high in comparison to the product Net Price in customer invoicing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.-Go to the view Reports: List.-Select the report Revenue by Team Member.-Choose View With -> Web Browser.-The value in column Net Value - Invoiced is too high.-Cause-Net Value - Invoiced gives information on total invoiced value (for all team members). In order to check the employee revenue contribution, use Net Value - Invoiced Time and Expenses. This is the default Key Figure for the report and it shows the correct amounts.-Resolution

Title: How to Modify or Add Values to an Extension Field or a Pre-Delivered Field in General tab of Materials?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to modify a value or add a value to an Extension Field or a Pre-Delivered Field in General tab of Materials.-Because, it is not possible to Enhance a field through Migration and using Mass Change screen you can change only 999 Materials which is limited.-Resolution-The above requirement can be performed through Mass Data Maintenance and the steps are as follows:-1. Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-2. Select Link for Export Materials.-3. Add the required Materials and select Ok.-4. Go to General tab-5. Select <export> for the columns which needs change.-6. Select Export Data to CSV File button.-7. In the Excel file, change/add the values for those fields and save the changes, and close the file.-8. Close the Export of Materials screen.-9. Select Link for Import Materials in Mass Data Maintenance work center.-10. Upload the file and execute Date import.-Once, the validation and import gets completed, and then check the changes in the respective materials.-  Note:-In the Export Materials screen, you can find only 200 Materials this is due to technical constrains but Using the steps that are provided above, you can able perform this change for all the Materials.-In the place of step 3, select Go in the Export of Materials screen. You can find only 200 Materials in the screen but when you export, all the materials will be listed in the file.

Title: Is it Possible to Export GTIN for Materials?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to know the GTIN numbers of Materials and would like to know, whether this can be exported in an Excel or Report?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Search and Edit a Material.-Go to UoM characteristics tab to find the GTIN number.-Resolution-The feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Cannot Post Manual Credit Memo With Reference to Purchase Order for which there was no Goods Return
Content: Symptom-You want to post a manual credit memo with reference to a purchase order to reflect a decrease in price.-There was no goods movements after posting the corresponding supplier invoice for the purchase order (no Return to Supplier/Outbound Delivery).-You get the error: "The return document is missing or invalid. To post the credit memo, either go to the Exceptions tab and allow post without return document or wait until the goods return has been posted and then post the credit memo".-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoice Entry.-Choose Show: All Orders.-Search for the Purchase Order and choose New Credit Memo.-Enter all relevant data and press Check.-You get the error: The return document is missing or invalid. To post the credit memo, either go to the Exceptions tab and allow post without return document or wait until the goods return has been posted and then post the credit memo.-Go to the tab Items and sub-tab Cost Distribution.-Notice that the system looked for a reference to a delivery.-Cause-In case there were no goods movements after invoicing, you need to create a new Subsequent Credit for the invoice.-Resolution-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Search for the invoice and choose New -> Subsequent Credit.-Enter all relevant data and press Check.-The status of the credit memo is Ready for Posting.-Go to the tab Items and sub-tab Cost Distribution.-Notice that the costs are distributed against the previous supplier invoice this time (and not a delivery document).-Keywords-Credit Memo,  Reference to Purchase Order, Subsequent Credit.

Title: Wrong Date for Invoice Item in Activity 'Edit Time and Expenses'
Content: Symptom-You are editing the times and expenses for a project in preparation of a revenue recognition run. An Invoice item has a wrong date too far in the future, for example 07.MM.YYYY. When you open the supplier invoice, you notice that the Posting Date is the 30th of the previous month. You want the item to be part of the previous month for the revenue recognition as per the Posting Date on the invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.-Go to the view Invoice Preparation and sub-view Not Invoiced Times and Expenses.-Find the relevant Project ID and choose Edit Times and Expenses.-The Date for an Invoice item is for example 07.MM.YYYY. You expect the Date to be the 30th of the previous month as per the invoice's Posting Date.-Cause-The Delivery Date of the expense/service is passed onto Project, not the Posting Date of the invoice. If you check the Purchase Order associated with the supplier invoice, you will notice that the Delivery Date has been set 7 days after the Creation Date of the purchase order (this occurs automatically by default). There is additionally a Service/Expense Delivery Period of 24 hours, you can verify that in the sub-tab Basic Data of the tab Items, which leads to the date 07.MM.YYYY. As well you did not select the flag Goods and Services Receipt Expected or the delivery has been made on 07.MM.YYYY. Hence the date 07.MM.YYYY is shown in the view Not invoiced Times and Expenses.-Resolution-This is the desired behaviour of Business ByDesign. To have the times and expenses in the previous month, the solution is to cancel the invoice. The associated purchase order will become editable and you can amend the Delivery Date for the items. Then choose Send Update on Purchase Order and afterward create a new invoice. If there are deliveries associated with incorrect delivery dates (they take precedence on purchase order delivery dates), these need to be cancelled and recreated with correct delivery dates. Afterward create a new invoice.

Title: All the Projects not available or Team Member does not show the expenses in the Revenue by Team Member Report.
Content: Symptom-This case document contains two issues with respect to Revenue by Team Member Report.-Case 1: All the Projects available in the system will not be shown in the Revenue by Team Member report.-When you open the Revenue by Team Member report here you will be able to see all the Projects available in the system will not be shown in this report.-  Case 2: Team Member" - unassigned (#) in the Revenue by Team Member report.-When you open the Revenue by Team Member report you will be able see the Team Member does not show the Expenses, Team Member" does not display any data for the key figure "Net Value - Invoiced Time and Expenses" and the characteristic "Team Member" - unassigned (#) in this report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Case 1 :-  Go to Work Center Project Management.-Go to View Reports -> List.-Select the report Revenue by Team Member.-Here you can all the Projects available in the system will not be shown in the Revenue by Team Member report.-This can be verified from Project Management work center you can see all the listed projects.-Go to Project management work center.-Click on Projects view.-Select All Project in show field and click GO.-Here, you can see numerous projects listed.-Case 2:-Go to Work Center Project Management.-Go to View Reports -> List.-Select the report Revenue by Team Member.-Run the report and move the characteristics Invoice request ID and Invoice request item to rows.-Here you can see Team Member does not display any data for the key figure Net Value - Invoiced Time and Expenses and the characteristic Team Member - unassigned (#) in the Revenue by Team Member report with Invoice request items with Invoicing Method Fixed Price are not displayed.-Cause-Case 1 :-This Revenue by Team Member Report (PROCPIU03_Q0001) shows only those Projects which are linked to Sales Orders that are Released.-Case 2 :-The Revenue by Team Member Report ( PROCPIU03_Q0001)  does not show the expenses which are linked to Fixed Price Items because it is not possible to determine the revenue per employee for a fixed price appropriately it will  only show data related to project tasks which are linked to Sales order items which are of type Time and Material hence it is displaying the key figure "Net Value - Invoiced Time and Expenses - 0.00" and the characteristic "Team Member" - unassigned (#).-Revenue by Team Member is to be able to check estimated revenue per team member based on the expenses , time recordings, expense reports incurred or actuals by the team member. We can determine the revenue based on the quantity in case of time recordings and amounts in case of expense reports. This is possible for time and materials items, because the basis for time and material items is the actuals. However, for fixed price items  we have no appropriate mechanism to determine the estimated revenue per team member, because we do not associate actuals with fixed price items and without actuals, it is not possible to determine estimated revenue.-For fixed price items it is not possible for us to calculate the estimated Revenue per team member. Hence it is not possible for us to show the Expenses which might have been linked to Fixed Price Items, since you are going to invoices a fixed price and not the Incurred or Actuals.--Resolution-System is working fine as this is designed behavior. This is the current functionality in the report Revenue by Team Member Report (PROCPIU03_Q0001).

Title: You received the error "Item XX: Country missing in address of Employee ABC" when creating a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When creating a Purchase Order for a Non-Stock Material, system raises error message "Item XX: Country missing in address of Employee ABC".-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the purchase order)-Select Edit-Select Check-The error message appears-Cause-The employee ABC is selected as Recipient for the line item XX but no country was maintained in the delivery address.-Resolution-Follow below steps to maintain a country for the recipient.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the purchase order)-Select Edit-Go to Items tab-Select the line item XX-Go to the Delivery sub-tab-Enter a country for the field Country-Keywords-Country missing in address of Employee; Purchase Order; Error

Title: Cannot Process Purchase Order With Status Rejected
Content: Symptom-You want to edit the Purchase Order and send it for approval or cancel, however you cannot edit the document since the status is Rejected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to the view Purchase Orders.-Select the Purchase Order and click on Edit.-You cannot edit the Purchase Order or resubmit it.-Cause-Once a Purchase Order is rejected, it cannot be processed further. In the work center Managing My Area, view Approvals, the determined approver has selected Reject instead of Send Back for Revision for the approval task. The rejection of a Purchase Order cannot be revoked, and the its status Rejected is final and the document is no longer valid.-Also, for the rejected Purchase Order, system does not allow actions like canceling.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior. You can create a copy of the rejected Purchase Order, do the necessary changes and submit the new document for approval.-Keywords-Rejected Purchase Order, Cancel the rejected Purchase order, edit Rejected Purchase Order, Resubmit Rejected Purchase order, purchase order not editable, purchase order cannot be submitted again, purchase order status rejected, order button is disabled, all buttons are disabled

Title: Purchase Order Created and Sent Automatically Upon Selecting Award Against a Winning Quote/Bid
Content: Symptom-You have selected Create purchase order manually in the  Purchase request and orders  work center->common task activity Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders.-Later you have created a Request for Quotation for a Product category XYZ and received quote/bid from supplier.-However when you select Award against a winning Quote/Bid, Purchase Order is created automatically with status Sent or Not Yet Acknowledged or In Approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Select Requests for Quotation view.-Select Published RFQ ID XX and choose Compare Quotes button.-Choose Award button against the winning Quote/Bid.-Cause-This Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders allows your buyer whether a purchase order is created automatically or manually from a purchase request.-This setting doesn't apply for Request for Quotation.-Resolution-So scope the question" Do you want to create a purchase order with the In Preparation status from a supplier quote?"

Title: Rejected Return to Supplier Still Listed in Quick Link "Returns to Supplier Without Follow-Up Decision"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Reviewing the content reliability as currently we can't reproduce the behavior in any of the IRA systems, the hyperlink Returns to Supplier Without Follow-Up Decision always shown with 0, no document could be found through it.-One or several Return(s) to Supplier(s) are listed in the quick link Returns to Supplier Without Follow-Up Decision. However you cannot enter a Follow-Up Decision as the status of the Return(s) to Supplier(s) is Rejected.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the view Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to the view Overview.-You have the section Quick Links and on the right handside Returns to Suppliers.-Select the hyperlink Returns to Supplier Without Follow-Up Decision (X).-The Return to Supplier is Rejected and cannot be edited.-Resolution-This is a new requirement for us and we will exclude returns to suppliers that were rejected from the count of "Returns to Supplier Without Follow-Up Decision". We will provide a solution in one of our upcoming releases.-Unfortunately it is not possible for our Support Team to provide you additional information regarding the availability of this feature in a future release. For further information regarding your request please contact your sales contact (Account Manager/Customer Advocate/Solution Advisor).

Title: Report Shopping Carts Shows Incorrect Sum of the Result Line for All Shopping Carts
Content: Symptom-When you run the report Shopping Carts﻿, the value for the result line for all Shopping Carts is incorrect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for Shopping Carts and open it.-Click on Go.-You will notice that the result line at the end of the report is incorrect considering the value for Key Figures on each Shopping Cart.-Cause-The reason for such behavior is because this report cannot be used as a Line Item report as it was initially created with the purpose of data disclosure functionality of shopping carts. This report is not intended to show the total number of carts / items.-Resolution-In order to check on such values, you can create an own report using data source Shopping Cart Item Details (SRMIR_B02).-Keywords-shopping carts, wrong result, reporting, data source, key figure wrong

Title: How to Capture other Costs During Creation of Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You want to capture Freight or insurance or customs cost as planned cost during Purchase Order creation.-Environment-SAP Business  ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to New Purchase Order view.-Input Supplier and click View all.-Navigate to Items.-Click Add Row.-Input mandatory data Product ID, Ship-To/Service Location ID, Quantity, Price.-Go to item level price tab-Click on add row and choose Freight Cost and save-Keywords- Transportation cost-unplanned delivery cost,landing cost,delivery charge

Title: Cannot Approve Purchase Order of Another Employee with Purchase order approval not possible Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2608860***-You cannot approve a purchase order due to the error: Purchase order approval not possible.-You haven't scoped purchase order self-approval in Business Configuration settings, it is not possible to approve your own purchase orders. However you are not the creator of the purchase order, hence you expect you should be able to approve it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Managing My Area.-Go to the view Work.-Select Show Open Tasks.-Mark the approval task and choose Approve.-You get the error Purchase order approval not possible.-Cause-You have been entered as Buyer Responsible in the General tab of the Purchase Order or as Requester in the Items tab. These fields are taken into considerations during the approval compliance checks of the document.-Resolution-Another employee has to approve the Purchase Order. If required, the approval task can manually be assigned to a relevant employee. To do so, you can:-Go to the work center Application and User Management.-Go to the view Business Task Management.-Find the task and mark it.-Select Actions - Assign Item and enter the name of another user to set them as approver.-That user will find the approval task under the Approvals view of the Managing my Area work center.-  Or, you need to scope the purchase order self approval in Business Configuration settings:-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Go to the view Implementation Projects.-Edit Project Scope.-Go to step 4, Questions.-Expand Purchasing, Purchase Request and Order Management, Purchase Orders.-Scope the question "Do you want to allow self-approval for purchase order approvals?".-Go to next step and click Finish.-After the setting activated, system will allow self-approval for purchase orders.-Keywords-Purchase, Order, Approval, Error

Title: How to Export the Details Section of Materials?
Content: Symptom-You have added texts in the Details text box of many Materials and require the Details to be exported using Microsoft Excel or Report.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center-Go to Materials view-Go to Materials subview-Query All Materials-Search any Material ID-Choose Edit -You want to export the data from the Details field using Microsoft Excel or Report-Cause-The Export->To Microsoft Excel option which is available on the Materials Object Work List does not export the Details field of the Materials. Further, the reports which are associated with the Materials does not export the Details field of the Materials.-Resolution-You can export the data from the Details field of Materials using the below steps in your system:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter -Go to Data Extraction view -Select New -Run ID: XXXXX (where XXXXX represents the Run ID of Data Extraction) -Run Description: YYYYY (where YYYYY represents the Run Description of Data Extraction) -Select Extraction object: MATERIAL - Materials-Choose to Save -Select Activate and Run -Once the Run is Finished, at the bottom of the screen, in the Extraction Files, select the button Download File-Download the generated .XML file -Go to the sheet Detailed Descriptions-You will be able to see the Details of the Materials-Keywords-Material Details, Detailed Material Description, Data Extraction, Details of Materials

Title: Shopping Cart Approval Results in an Unassigned Task
Content: Symptom-You set up an approval process for shopping carts and created a cart which matches the conditions.-A suitable approver is correctly configured.-As a result, you expect the approval to take place.-An approval task is created but remains unassigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Under the Business Task Management header, The approval task for the cart appears under the "Unassigned Tasks" monitor instead of being assigned to the expected approver.-Cause-System automatically checks if the determined approver is either requestor, recipient or creator of the cart and filtering them out of the approval process.-As a result, if no other responsible is determined, the approval task will remain unassigned.-Resolution-If you want approval to take place, then you must make sure that either:-The approver is neither requestor, recipient or creator of the cart.-There are other approvers determined so the task can still be processed by them. (via the configuration of multiple responsible or substitution rule setup)-Keywords-Approver is not determied

Title: Project Baseline didn't go for Approval Process.
Content: Symptom-Project Baseline didn't go for approval process though it is submitted for approval.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Change Management view.-Search for the relevant project ID.-Select the relevant baseline ID. -Click in View button. -Confirm that the Baseline status is Active. It was expected "In Approval" status instead. -Note: when the Baseline is created, its status is Active. If the Baseline is send back to revision, its status is In Planning. -Cause-The Approval Process for Project Baseline is not scoped. -Resolution-The steps below show how to configure the Project Baseline Approval process: -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant implementation project.-Click in Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Questions.-Under Scoping Element, select "Project Management" and select "Choose Change Management". -Check the question "Do you want to use an approval process for project baseline?" for normal approval process; check the question "Do you want to use a multi-step approval process for project baselines?" for multi-step approval process. -Click Next and Finish Scoping.-Note: If the multi-step process is scoped, then only consider the "Application and User Management work center - Approvals Process view". -Keywords-Project baseline, Baseline approval

Title: Error Message: It is not possible to create a purchase request. The services are staffed only with employees belonging to the same company as the project."
Content: Symptom-While creating the purchase request system throws an error messages as-It is not possible to create a purchase request. The services are staffed only with employees belonging to the same company as the project.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose Projects view.-Choose Projects Subview.-Search and choose Project XYZ (represents the project ID).-Choose Edit -> Products and Purchasing button.-Go to Product Overview sub tab.-Choose required service .-Choose Create Purchase Request and For Service/Supplier button system will throw errors messages as below-          It is not possible to create a purchase request. The services are staffed only with employees belonging to the same company as the project.- Cause-The action Create Purchase Request->For Service/Supplier tries to create project purchase request items for Service/Supplier. The error message itself tells that all the services assigned to the project which is available in the product overview are staffed only with internal employees belonging to the same company project. To create the purchase request the service should be staffed external employees/service agents belonging to the different company.- Resolution-Staff the assigned services with external employees then tries to create the purchase request or if there is a mix of internal employees and external employees (service agents) please use the other options to Create Purchase Request->For Whole Project/For Released Project Tasks so that the project purchase request items are created.

Title: Unable to Edit or Delete the Project, Project Tasks ID and Project Phase ID in Released Project
Content: Symptom-Once the project is Started or Released the Project Tasks ID and Project Phase ID cannot be edited or deleted anymore as they will be read only.-When the project or project task in In Planning, these fields will be enable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Choose the Project XYZ (represents the project ID)-Edit the Project Plan of a project in status Released.-Select a project task ID or project Phase ID.-Here you cannot edit the project task ID or project Phase ID, they are read only and the Delete button is disabled.-Cause-If the Project is Started or Released we cannot change or delete the project or project task IDs.-When you set a project status to started or released, integration with other areas FIN, HCM, SRM, CRM is enabled along with responsible unit possibly the cost center so that any actual Time recording and expense on the task would be linked with cost center.-So changing or deleting of project, project task ID and project phase ID would lead to inconsistencies at the integrated areas so we cannot change or delete the project.-Resolution-System works as designed.-When a project status is on hold, stopped, or closed, the system automatically disables the integration with other business processes like posting a shopping cart, purchase request, Purchase order, time and expense recording, sales order to it.-Note that a closed or stopped Project Tasks ID can be easily re-opened though.-Keywords-Delete project, Project Task IDs, Released project.-

Title: Return to Supplier Item not Fetched in New Credit Memo
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:Duplicate of KBA  2132284 - Return to Supplier Document not Available for Credit Memo Creation-You create a new credit memo for a Return to Supplier and a relevant line item for a returned product is not defaulted into the credit memo. However the Return to Supplier is processed fully: all the warehouse tasks are completed and all transactions are processed in Accounting. If you try adding a line with the product, quantity, purchase order reference, etc.. manually, you get an error/exception that the goods return document is missing or invalid.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoice Entry.-Select Show: All Returns to Be Invoiced.-Choose New Credit Memo.-No line item for the product is defaulted.-Cause-The corresponding supplier invoice has not been posted yet. Hence the system will not allow you to claim credit to the supplier. You need to post the invoice first.-Resolution-Open the relevant Purchase Order item.-Go to the tab Items and sub-tab Document Flow.-Open the invoice. Fill in the missing data and solve the exceptions.-Post the invoice.-Afterward you can created a credit memo for the returned goods.

Title: System Does Not Display Allocated Stock in Projected Material Flow Report
Content: Symptom-You have ordered a Purchase Order POS (POS represents the Purchase Order ID) with Quantity X. When you monitor relevant Purchase Order, you found that the system is showing Open Quantity X with Site ABC (ABC represents the Site ID), hence Overdue and has not been delivered yet.-Now when you check the Allocated Stock for a Product PMS (PMS represents the Product ID), and expecting with respect to same Purchase Order using Projected Material Flow report, system shows Zero Allocated Stock in the Site ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control Work Center.-Select  Monitor Purchase Orders View.-Choose All Purchase Order Items By Selection in the field 'Show' using drop down menu.-Search for the relevant Purchase Order POS which you have ordered.-In the Overview Screen itself, you can see there is an Open Quantity X for a Product PMS against that Order.-Now navigate to Inbound Logistics Work Centre.-Select Project Material Flow sub view under Common Tasks View.-Choose Site ID ABC and Product ID PMS using value selection.-Select Go. -Here you can see On-Hand Stock quantity but system does not display Allocated Stock for the product with respect to the Site.-Cause-In the Projected Material Flow calculations, system includes the Inventory Allocations, as well as Inventory, Warehouse Request and Production Request Documents.-Since there is no Warehouse Request created for the Purchase Order therefore system unable to show an Allocated Stock in the Projected Material Flow screen.-Resolution-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Search for the relevant Purchase Orders in the field Show using drop down.-Select the Purchase Order ID POS.-Create Inbound Delivery Notification with Warehouse Request ID for the purchase order using the button New Supplier Delivery Notification.-Once you perform the above steps, Warehouse Request ID would get created and then the system will be able to show the Allocated Stock with Quantity X against the Warehouse Request in the Projected Material Flow Report.-See Also-2529210 - No Allocated Stock Displayed in Project Material Flow after Releasing One Sales Order-Keywords-Projected Material Flow, Allocated Stock, Warehouse Request, Production Order

Title: Cannot Post Credit Memo. Error: "Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount".
Content: Symptom-The user cannot post a Credit Memo because of the Exception "Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount, The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Search for the relevant Credit Memo ID. -Click in Edit button. -Click in Check button. -Error message is triggered: "Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount, The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item".-Cause-It is not allowed to claim back more amounts from the Supplier than what has been paid in the preceding Supplier Invoice.-Resolution-The user has to adjust the amounts manually for the credit memo items. Once adjusted, the Credit Memo can be further processed or posted. The steps to correct it are listed below: -Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Search for the relevant Credit Memo ID. -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Items tab. -Adjust the Price according to the corresponding Supplier Invoice item.-Click in Actions button and select Calculate Total Amounts.-The Credit Memo status is changed to Ready for Posting be and the relevant Exception is set as Obsolete status.-Keywords-Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount, Credit Memo, Exception, Calculate Total Amounts, Error, Supplier invoice

Title: Unable to Use Extension Field in Extension Scenarios Since Add Field Button is Grayed Out
Content: Symptom-You have created an Extension Field but you are not able to extend this Field in Extension Scenarios since the Add Field button is grayed out-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Edit an Material.-Select Adaptation Mode and go to Extension Fields section.-Highlight the Extension Field and select Further Usage link.-Where the Add Field button is grayed out-Cause-The reason that the button Add Field is grayed out for the Extension Field is that the extension field is already extended to all the available extension scenarios.-Resolution-Scroll down further in the screen to field the list of Extension Scenarios which uses this field. You can select the extension scenario and select Deactivate button to remove it.

Title: Health Check Name: Number Range Depletion for Materials
Content: Symptom-You have received a Health Check case stating the below details,-Diagnostic Information:--Health Check Component: Cross-Application Services--Health Check Name: Number Range Depletion---Description:--The system is running out of unique numbers for a particular number range. When this occurs, the system does not allow you to create a new business document or master data, depending on which number range is affected. You must extend your existing number range.---Error Information:--Number Range Profile Name: PRD--Number Range Type Name: PRD____MATERIAL-Number Range Object Name: PRD_MAT-Cause-The cause for triggering this health check is to inform you that the number range maintained for the Materials is almost completed, i.e., soon it may not be possible to create Materials with this number range and number range interval.-Resolution-In the fine tuning activity Number Ranges for Materials, extend the number range sufficiently, so that the materials can use the respective IDs.

Title: Intercompany Check box is not Available for Intercompany Projects.
Content: Symptom-When we open the intercopmany project the Intercompany check box itself not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center.-Choose Projects view.-Choose Projects sub view.-Edit any Intercompany project-Go to Project Plan and Accounting subtab here you can see the Intercompany project field itself not available for Intercompany Projects.-Cause-The intercompany check box is not available because Purchasing Between Partner Companies is not scoped in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-If you want to use intercompany scenario please scope the Purchasing Between Partner Companies in the system.-Purchasing Between Partner Companies can be scoped by following these steps in a system :-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Project and Choose Edit Project Scope button.-Go to Step 3 - Scoping -> Purchasing -> Purchase Request and Order -> Purchasing Between Partner Companies here choose the Check Box to scope Purchasing Between Partner Companies in the system.-Complete all the steps until Confirm to save the changes made in system.

Title: Sales Order is not created from Intercompany Purchase Order related to projects
Content: Symptom-After you release a purchase order the system does not create the corresponding sales order in the intercompany process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose the Purchase Orders view.-Find the Purchase Orders ABC (ABC represents the intercompany purchase order ID).-Click Edit.-Click the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Here you can see that system did not create the sales order.-Cause-The related project is not of the type Customer Projects with sales integration. Therefore the project is not integrated with sales and the system is unable to create the intercompany sales order out of the purchase order.-To view the project type follow the steps below:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Find the Project DEF (DEF represents the intercompany Project ID).-Click the Edit button.-Go to Project Plan tab.-In the Basic Data section you can see the project type.-Note: Once a project is released the Project Type cannot be changed and if you change the Process Variant after releasing the project the system will still not create a sales order.-To see which project type is assigned as an intercompany project follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project GHI (GHI represents the Implementation Project).-Click the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune tab.-Click on the Project Types activity hyperlink.-Navigate to row with the Name Intercompany Project.-Here you can see in the Process Variant column for an intercompany project that the process variant is Project Processing - For Customer Projects.-  Resolution-To create the Sales Order automatically during the intercompany purchase order process, the Process Variant for Intercompany Projects must be Customer Projects.

Title: Error Message: Postings Not Permitted; Company ABC Differs From Project Company XYZ.
Content: Symptom-While creating an Expense Report when you edit the Cost Assignment and assign certain percentage to a Project Task system throws an error message: Postings Not Permitted; Company ABC Differs From Project Company XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Choose Self-Services Overview view.-Choose the link New Expense Report.-Choose the link Edit Cost Assignment.-Choose Project Task in Account Assignment Type.-System throws error: Postings Not Permitted; Company ABC Differs From Project Company XYZ.-OR-Go to the Project Team work center.-Chose New Expense Report under Common Tasks.-Choose the link Edit Cost Assignment.-Choose Project Task in Account Assignment Type.-System throws error: Postings Not Permitted; Company ABC Differs From Project Company XYZ.-Cause-The reason here is the Intercompany Purchase Order is not created for the employee, who belongs to Company ABC. You are creating an Expense Report and assign a Project Task to the Project belongs to another Company XYZ, it requires purchase order.-Resolution-Please create the Purchase Order for required service from the partner company ABC and assign Purchase Order account assignment to Project Task (of a Project that belongs to another company XYZ). Once Purchase Order is created for Company XYZ, an automatic Sales Order and Intercompany Project gets created automatically at Company ABC. After this, the error message will not appear the service agent will be able to create the expense report against the project.-See Also- 1995482 - Error Postings Not Permitted; Company Differs from Project Company When Assigning Project Task to Expense Report-Keywords-Company different from Project company but no contract found

Title: Cannot Create a Negative Stock Using Inventory Adjustment.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post an Inventory Adjustment using a negative quantity, however the following error is occurring: Quantity of product XYZ not valid (Where XYZ is the ID of the product).-Your intention is to create a negative stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory-Click on the common task New Inventory Adjustment-Enter the Location ABC-Enter the Key Date and choose Next button.-Choose Add Row-Enter a logistics Area and the product XYZ-Enter a negative value for the field Actual Value and system shows the error message.-Cause-System is working as designed. It's not possible to create negative stock using Inventory Adjustment.-Resolution-You can use Scrapping to create negative stock. However, scrapping can only be performend in a Logistics Area that has a positive stock.-If the inventory quantity of the product is Zero, an Inventory Adjustment needs to be done first.-Go to Physical Inventory Work Center-Select the common task New Inventory Adjustment-Enter the Location ABC-Enter the Key Date and choose the Next button.-Choose Add Row-Enter a Logistics Area-Enter the Product XYZ-Enter 1 as Actual Value-Choose on Next and then Finish.-Now that there is a positive inventory of the product, so the Scrapping can be performed:-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center-Choose the common task Scrapping-Enter the Site ID ABC-For the field Actual Execution On, enter the same date used as Key Date in the Inventory Adjustment-Choose Next-Select the Product XYZ and enter the Product Scrapped Quantity, this quantity must be the negative stock you want to enter plus 1. (i. e. If you want to enter a negative stock of -100, you need to enter 101 as scrapped quantity).-Choose Next-Choose Finish -Now you will have a negative stock in the selected location-Note: If the location does not allow negative stock, the system will return an error message during the Scrapping process as well.-Keywords-Negative stock, Inventory Adjustment

Title: How to Add Extension Field "Invoice Description" to the Invoices and Credit Memos UI .
Content: Symptom-How to Add Extension Field Invoice Description to the Invoices and Credit Memos UI .-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center .-Select Invoices and Credit memos view.-Search for All Documents in Show .-Here You want to add an extension filed Invoice Description to the Invoices and Credit Memos UI .-Resolution-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center .-Select Invoices and credit Memos view.-Search for All Documents in Show . -Select Adapt -> Select Enter Adaptation Mode and then choose Edit Screen.-Select Invoices and CreditMemos section.-Select Extensions Field.-Select the Add button.-In the Add New Field pop-up screen, select the filed type as Text.-Add the Field Label e. g. Invoice Description -> Save.-Make the field Visible.-Save and Publish-Now You can  find and enter in the Invoice Description field on the Invoices and Credit Memos UI Screen .

Title: How to Replicate the Same Key Figure Results from a Key Figure Created as Copy
Content: Symptom-You want to create a calculated Key Figure which might show up the same results of an existing Key Figure.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Go to Common Task | New Key Figure-Select the desired Data Source ( e.g. SCMCFJU01)-Drag the desired Key Figure to the white board on the right-In the Next Step, You set as local calculation, one of the available options (e.g. Moving Average)-When you open the report face created on the top of the data source, the key figure results shown for your new Key Figure created are not the same as the standard Key Figure selected as copy.-Cause-The wrong results of your customized key figure occurs due to wrong local formula defined for your Key Figure.-Resolution-In order to solve this issue, You will need suppress the Local Calculation method, leaving the field blank, once your requirement is just keep a mirror of the Key Figures values.-See Also-For further explanation about the Local Calculation available, go through of Local Calculation documentation available in the byD Help Center.

Title: You are Not Able to See the Link New Recurring Invoice Template Eventhough It is Scoped Under Customer Invoicing
Content: Symptom- You are not able to view New Recurring Invoice Template in the system eventhough under customer invoicing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Common tasks view and New Recurring Invoice Template sub view.-New Recurring Invoice Template is not visible in customer system.-Cause-You are not able to see New Recurring Invoice Template in the system as the CRM_RECURRINGINVOICES access right is not assigned to the user.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select View User and Access Management and sub view Business Users.-Show all Find ABC (ABC represents the identifcation of the user).-Select ABC click on Edit navigate to Access Rights.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment.-Drill down CRM_CUSTOMERINVOICING.-Here you can see that CRM_RECURRINGINVOICES is not assigned to ABC user.-Once the check box is tick and save.-You are now able to see the link New Recurring Invoice Template in the system.

Title: When you try to Post Invoice you Receive an error Mid-Rate for exchange Rate is missing.
Content: Symptom-When you try to Post Supplier Invoice you receive an error Posting of Invoice not possible due to error in Financial accounting ;-Currency conversion failed; maintain exchange rate (Mid Rate) for US Dollar to Euro. How ever Middle Rate and validity period has maintained for US Dollar to Euro in Edit Exchange Rates tab in General Ledger Work Center .-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center .-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-earch and Edit  invoice “xxx “-Open View ALL-Navigate to Exceptions tab- Here you can see Exception type  for  Error during Simulation of Journal Entry  is  Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ;-Currency conversion failed; maintain exchange rate (Mid Rate) for US Dollar to Euro-Cause-Please change Invoicing date to Posting date.or else in Exchange Rates sub tab.Maintain exchange rate from USD to Euro you can post the invoice.-Resolution-Go to Supplier Invoicing  work center .-Select view  Invoices and Credit Memos-Search and Edit invoice  xxx- Go to Sub tab General Information Check both Posting date and Invoice date are different .-Please change the Invoicing date to Posting  date .-Click on Save ,Click on Post .- OR else .-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center .-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Search and Edit  invoice xxx .-Open View All Navigate to General tab ,Sub tab of Exchange Rates .-Click Add Row Maintain Unit currency Ex :-USD and Quoted currency Ex:-Euro and Exchange rate .-Click on Save and Click on Post .-Without any error you can Post the  Supplier Invoice .
