You are unable to see the time and expenses under Time and Expense Items tab since the expenses are not assigned to the sales order items.-2. Sales order item assigned to invoice item does not match, you would need to verify the sales order items and the invoice items.-3. The conversion rule is not maintained for the invoice items, you would need to verify the unit of measure of invoice item and sales order item.-Resolution-For cause 1 and 2.-1. The time and expenses doesn't exist under Time and Expense Items tab since the expenses are not assigned to Sales Order items.-2. Sales order item assigned to Invoice Item does not match to verify check the sales order items and the invoice items.-Navigate to Project Management work center.-Choose Invoice Preparation view.-Choose Not Invoiced Time and Expenses sub view.-Show  All Active Customer Projects and find for Project XXX ((XXX represents the ID of the project for which you want to create the project invoice request).-Choose  Edit Time and Expenses button.-Assign the expense to the relevant Sales Order line item.-for cause 2 check the sales order items and the invoice items check if both are same if not change the assignment to the relevant Sales Order item both the items should match.-For Cause 3.-The conversion rule not maintained for the invoice items check the unit of measure of invoice item and sales order item, is different or same. if the unit of measure is different not convertible maintain the convection rule. for example :In the sales order item quantity is in terms of each and in the invoice in terms of hours check the item(product) conversation rule is maintained or not.-Navigate to Product Data work center.-Choose Services View,-Choose the Service YYY (YYY represents the Sales order line item or invoice item service ID).-Choose Edit button.-Choose View All.-Under Quantity Conversions maintain the required conversion for the service and then try to ‘Propose Invoice Item Assignment’.

Title: Error Message : Project XYZ Cannot be Deleted; Project Assigned to Sales order or Sales Quote.
Content: Symptom-When trying to delete the Project XYZ system throwing an error message: Project XYZ cannot be deleted; project assigned to sales order or quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Project Management work center.-Choose Project view.-Find and choose project XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID).-Choose Delete Button-Here you can see system throwing error message Project XYZ cannot be deleted; project assigned to sales order or quote.-Cause-Once the project is released, it is now no longer be possible to delete or edit this project. So you cannot change anything in this project it will not allow you to edit once it is released. Only projects in the status In Planning can be deleted or edited. If the projects assigned to the Sales Order or Sales Quote it will now no longer be possible to delete this project. Once a project status is set to Started or Released, a baseline is automatically created, a snapshot is taken and project become Read-Only.-Resolution-System is working as designed.

Title: Error 'Cannot find account determination group for product category XYZ' when Posting Invoice for Low Value Assets
Content: Symptom-You enter a supplier invoice containing one or several lines representing the acquisition of low value-value fixed assets.-When attempting to post, the message Cannot find account determination group for product category XYZ shows.-Your expectation however is that the posting should succeed since Product Category XYZ is assigned to a fixed asset class.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Enter several invoicing items representing low-value fixed assets.-Press Post.-Cause-In the invoice several line-items are posted and therefore the system is prompted to create several fixed assets exhibiting corresponding individual materials.-In the fine tuning activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets for each Accounting Principle a Minimum Amount and Maximum Amount for low-value fixed assets is maintained.-In case a single item's net-value falls below the threshold, the account determination for fixed assets will not take effect resulting in the displayed error message.-Resolution-In compliance with the applied accounting principles 3 options can be evaluated.-Reduction of the minimum threshold for the acquisition of low-value fixed assets.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Edit the Fine Tuning activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-For the applied Accounting Principle, modify the value in the column Minimum Amount.-Posting of items directly against expense accounts instead of creating fixed assets. For this purpose an account determination for materials and for this product category would have to be maintained.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Edit the Fine Tuning activity Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories.-Here for Product Category ID XYZ an appropriate Default Account Determination Group for Materials has to be maintained.-Consolidation of invoice items in order to pass the low-value fixed asset threshold as outlined above.-Keywords-Supplier invoice, account determination, product category, Kontenfindungsgruppe für Produktkategorie nicht gefunden, Lieferantenrechnung

Title: Price Values Does Not Populate When Creating a New Invoice Without Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When you are creating a New Invoice without purchase order, you want the system to automatically populate the pricing values from the purchasing contracts or List Prices under the Net Price column and you want to know how to perform it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center,-Select the Invoice Entry view.-Select New -> Invoice without Purchase Order, a window opens.-Fill in the required fields and add the product ID, quantity value under the Items table.-You could see that the pricing values are not updated automatically.-Cause-Currently the purchasing contracts or list prices information are delivered from SIR to SIV. When there is no PO reference, there will not be SIR created from PO. Hence the information cannot be proposed when SIV has no PO reference.-Resolution-You can add this as new requirement in Customer Influence Forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886- or-Contact your Partner to develop it for you as all the relevant information are all PSM released.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Price is not auto populated, price is empty, price is not fetched, price is not appearing, price is not updated automatically-supplier invoice,net price value,purchase order

Title: Where do the Values for Key Figures Quantity – Used for Invoicing and Quantity - Not Yet Invoiced come from?
Content: Symptom-You find the Quantity – Used for Invoicing key figure and the Quantity - Not yet Invoiced key figure in project related reports (for example Revenue by Team Member or Customer Project Overview) and want to know where the values for this key figures come from.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management or Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose the Reports view.-Run the respective report.-Display key figure Quantity – Used for Invoicing or Quantity - Not Yet Invoiced.-Also display the characteristic Invoice Request ID.-Resolution-The key figure Quantity-Used for Invoicing comes from the Quantity to be Invoiced field for the expenses for which a Project Invoice Request Item has been assigned. You find this field in the Project Invoice Request, Items tab, Time and Expense Items subtab.-The key figure Quantity - Not yet Invoiced is calculated according to the formula: Quantity - To be Invoiced + Quantity - Deferred + Quantities in any invoice request for the related project.-The related project invoice request can be in the status In Preparation, Released or Invoiced.

Title: Individual Material Created Cannot be Deleted from the System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to delete the Individual Material from the system.-Cause-Individual Materials, irrespective of their status cannot be deleted from the UI nor in the backend.-Resolution- You can only flag the Individual Material from the UI to Obsolete or Blocked.-This is the standard system behavior.

Title: How to set up the Itemized List PDF in the Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-How to set up the itemized list PDF in the project invoice request-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view.-Go to the Project Invoice Requests subview.-Select any project invoice request and choose the Edit button.-Go to the Itemized List tab.-Select View and Edit.-Here View and Edit option is grayed out, hence you are not able to generate the PDF.-Cause-In order to generate the itemized list PDF automatically, you need to set the answer to Yes in Scoping for the Invoice Forms under the question Do you want to automatically generate the itemized list as a PDF document for a project invoice Request?-You have not scoped the automatic generation of the itemized list PDF in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Below are the guidelines for the creation of the automatic itemized list PDF.-Part A: Scoping required in Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Choose the required Project.-Click on Edit Project Scope tab.-Go to the Questions tab.-Go to the Sales Scoping Element and choose Customer Invoicing.-Select the option Communication for Customer Invoicing.-Select the Yes for the question Do you want to automatically generate the itemized list as a PDF document for a project invoice Request.- Part B: Steps to be performed in Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view.-Go to the Sales Orders subview.-Select the relevant sales order.-Select the New button and choose Manual Project Invoice Request.-While creating a manual project invoice you must reach to Step 5 where you can choose the button Itemized List as New PDF or New CSV.-Note: Before doing the above step, you should have assigned expenses to the invoice items as the itemized list is for assigned expenses.-Part C:  Methods of re-ordering the fields that are displayed in the itemized list.-There are three ways of re-ordering the fields that are displayed in the itemized list, they are;-I:  You can order the way the columns are displayed in the itemized list PDF by doing the following.-Go to the Application and Management work center.-Then go to the Business Flexibility view.-Select Form Template Maintenance  sub view.-Select All Forms and choose Go button.-Select Itemized list for Expenses.-Choose Open and select Easy form editor.-Here the position of the column can be changed.-II: If you require the grouping of data for Itemized list PDF, you can group it by doing the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-In Show choose Activities and find Grouping of Itemized List for Project Invoice Request.-Open the activity, here the expenses can be grouped.-Note: To use this option you need to have the itemized list scoped.-III: At present we don't provide any sorting option for the fields in the itemized list PDF.-

Title: Not Able to Select Add Row Button While Doing Product Count
Content: Symptom-You want to manually add a product while doing the product count but you are unable to do so as the Add Row button is disabled in the confirm count task screen.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Search for the Task ID and select Confirm button.-You could see that in the Confirm Count task screen, the Add Row button is disabled.-Cause-The Product Count is done specific to a product, hence adding any other product to it is not allowed; thus the Add Row button is disabled in the confirm count task screen.-Note : The Add Row button is enabled in the confirm task screen when performing Logistics Area Count, as it is not product specific and one can add many products to the count task.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.

Title: Additional Goods Receipt For Purchase Order Which is Received Completely
Content: Symptom-You have completely received your purchase order. However, you would like to receive more quantities of the product from the same purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If you would like to receive quantities for a purchase order whose delivery is completed, the system will allow you to do so, provided the line items have their process type To-Stock﻿.-Resolution-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the view Purchase Orders, search for the relevant purchase order, select it and choose the New Supplier Delivery Notification button or the Post Goods Receipt button depending on your business requirement.-You will be able to receive goods by processing the put-away tasks created from the delivery notification or by the Post Goods Receipt button available.-This option is available for 3PL purchase orders also. You can perform the above steps in the view 3PL Inbound: Purchase Orders under the work center Third-Party Logistics.-Keywords-New inbound delivery for purchase order with status completed.

Title: The Ship-To party is not Shown on the "Over-the-Counter" overview
Content: Symptom-You want the Ship-To party to appear on the Over-the-Counter overview screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-The-Counter work center.-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales view.-Show All Sales and press the Go button.-Select any of the documents listed.-Choose the Document ID to open the Overview screen.-You find the Ship-To party is missing in the Overview screen.-Cause-The Overview screen of the Over-the Counter sale is not designed to show the Ship-to party, however you can find the Ship-to details in the View All mode.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords

Title: Is There a Way to Create a Manual Invoice that is Non-Product Specific (e.g.. Freight)
Content: Symptom- Is there a way to create a manual invoice that is non-product specific (e.g.. Freight).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the New Manual Invoice under Common Tasks.-You want to create the invoice that is non-product specific (e.g. Freight), however, system do not allow the release of the invoice without a product.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign system do not allow creation of an invoice without a Product.-Resolution-The only possibility in this case is to create a product (e. g. freight), and add it in the invoice.-You cannot create the manual invoice without a product or service.--In invoicing only Down Payment Request can be created without the product.

Title: The Sales Order Uploaded via Excel is Inconsistent
Content: Symptom-The sales order uploaded via excel is inconsistent.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales orders view.-Select the New button and choose Sales Order from Microsoft Excel®.-Add mandatory details in the excel with:-Product as ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product).-Quantity as XXX (XXX represents the value of quantity).-UOM as XYZ (XYZ is the Unit of Measure of the quantity).-Upload the excel in Business ByDesign system.-The sales order created via excel has below inconsistency: -Error: Item : Distribution channel or sales organization missing-Error: XXX is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.-The quantity selected for the product is zero.-Cause-You have not set the master data correctly due to which system is not able to recognize the Sales Unit, Distribution Channel, Minimum Order Quantity and Unit of Measure (UOM).-No Organizational Work distribution rule is defined, hence after the upload of sales order, the sales order cannot pick the sales unit and result in error on product.-No Quantity Conversion defined for the product.-No Minimum Order Quantity is defined for the product.-Resolution-You can set up the automatic determination of Sales Unit and Distribution Channel in the sales order by following below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view -> Organizational Work Distribution subview.-Select Sales Unit for Sales under Business Area: Sales and Marketing.-Edit the Sales Unit for Sales option.-Select the Add Rule option.-You can add the rule depending upon your business requirement. This rule ensures automatic determination of sales unit in sales documents.-Follow the steps below to add Quantity Conversion and Minimum Order Quantity in the product.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Search for the product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product).-Select the product ABC and choose Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the General tab.-Add the quantity conversion (standard to XXX).-Go to the Sales tab.-Add the Minimum Order Quantity (this will ensure that quantity is not picked as 0 in the sales order).

Title: You Get an Error Message While Doing Revenue Assignment in a New Manual Invoice"Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107; report an incident"
Content: Symptom-You get an error message while doing Revenue Assignment in a New Manual Invoice: Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107; report an case.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work enter.-Create a New Manual Invoice from Common Tasks.-Add the customer account and other mandatory details.-Select the View All button and go to the Items tab.-Add a product.-Select the Revenue Assignment button.-Maintain the G/L account XYZ and choose Ok button (XYZ represents the ID of the G/L account).-Error message appears : Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107; report an case.-Cause-The error message is raised for the cost object ID. In general this can only be entered if the account assignment type CC is allowed for the corresponding business document.-In the Business Configuration activity Account Assignment Types, for the type CC you have not configured the Customer Invoice Request and Customer Invoice.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Account Assignment Types activity.-Open the activity and select the Account Assignment Type: CC.-Select the Add Row button and add Customer Invoice Request and Customer Invoicing.-Save your changes.-Now you can do Revenue Assignment in the New Manual Invoice without any error message.-Note: The Account Assignment Type activity is a read-only activity, you can only do the changes by creating a Change Project.

Title: Link to Journal Entry Missing in Document Flow of Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-In the tab Document Flow for the Supplier Invoice, the link to the Journal Entry is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Find the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Navigate to the tab Document Flow.-The link to the Journal Entry is missing.-Cause-A simple chart version is displayed. This happens automatically when the flow exceeds 50 documents or as well when you press the button Hide Details.-Resolution-Press the button Show Details to switch to a detailed version of the chart.

Title: Field calculation for Total Net Value of Purchase Requests
Content: Symptom-The field calculation for the total net value of all purchase requests is not working.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Requests view-Click on Show > All Purchase Requests and Go-Scroll down to the last results-Verify that the sum for Open Quantity is working, but the sum for Net Value is blank-Click on Personalize > This Screen-Click on Configure Calculations-Verify that the calculation is correctly configured for both Open Quantity and Net Value-Cause-The reason why the sum of net values for Purchase Requests is not displayed is due to the way the system was designed for this type of document. More precisely, the currency value of a Purchase Request is stored in two fields of an item: Net Amount and Limit. The field Net Value on the Purchase Request listing is then a collection of the contents of both fields at item level. The value displayed by the system is determined by a display rule; i.e., either the Net Amount is to be displayed, or the Limit amount. Since two fields are involved for Purchase Requests, the value is not displayed, as the Configure Calculation doesn't yield any response for this column.-Resolution-The system is working according to its intended design. You can verify that the Net Value sum works correctly in the Purchase Order listing, for example, because in that case only one field is mapped for this column (Total Net Amount).

Title: Disable Automatic Tax determination Flag in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You want to uncheck/disable 'Automatic Tax Determination' checkbox while creating a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to the view Common Task and select the option New Purchase Order.-Choose the button View All, Enter the Supplier details, navigate to the tab Items and choose the button 'Add Row'.-Under the sub-tab Taxes, you are able to see that the check box Automatic Tax Determination is flagged.-You are not able to make any changes to this field.-Cause-This is the basic functionality of the tax engine in the system and disabling this feature will render the tax engine calculations at risk. Hence the system will not allow you to disable the automatic tax determination functionality.-Resolution-You can choose to manually change the tax codes that are available in the Tax Code field in the purchase orders. Once you choose the Tax Code manually the Automatic Tax Determination flag will be turned off overriding user preference over the tax engine calculations.-Keywords-Dsiable, Checkbox, Automatic Tax Determination, Purchase Order, Creation.

Title: Unable to Search Product Using Extension Field Text
Content: Symptom-In the New Purchase Order screen, when you search for the product using the extension field description system does not give any search results for the product ID.-You want  to know how to perform search using the extension field description.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the New Purchase Order link under Common Tasks.-Fill in the required fields, select the Add Row button, under the Product Description column enter the description of the extension field.-The search does not display any results there.-Resolution-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign system, it is not possible to search for the product ID using the extension fields description.-You can use the Product Description maintained for the product while doing the search for the product in the New Purchase order screen instead of using an extension field description.

Title: Cannot Post Goods and Services Receipt. Error: "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in approval"
Content: Symptom-You cannot post existing Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) due to an error: Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in approval.-As well, you cannot create a new Goods and Services Receipt for a Purchase Order. The Purchase Order is not listed in the work center Goods and Services Receipts, in the view Purchase Orders to Be Delivered: Outstanding Purchase Orders.-Also you cannot perform any Time Recording via the Time Sheet. Reason is that a time confirmation creates a GSR, which in turn is not allowed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Goods and Services Receipts.-Go to the view Receipts and Returns.-Find the relevant receipt and chosose Edit.-Choose Post.-You get the error: Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in approval.-Cause-The purchase order has initially been sent out to the supplier (after approval or not) and goods and services receipts could be created. Afterward changes have been done on the order (Quantity, Price, Cost Assignment, Delivery Address, etc...) so that the order has been forwarded for approval (or re-approval).-Resolution-You need to wait for the Purchase Order to be approved before proceeding with the delivery.-See Also-Note that Goods Receipts can still be created via B2B even though the purchase order status has been set to In Approval.-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipt, GSR, Cannot Post, Posting Not Possible, Error

Title: Prospect Accounts are not Visible in Customer ID Field of Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Prospect accounts are not visible in Customer ID field of purchase order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Select Show- All Purchase Orders and choose Advance button.-Select value help for Customer ID field.-Here you are not able to find the Account although the account is Active and exists in the system.-Cause-Account is marked with the role Prospect.-Resolution-The Account is set up as a role Prospect which means the ‘possibility of future successes’ and is currently not a regular account and the company is not doing the business with it.-Please follow below steps to change the role of the account.-Go to Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search and select the Account ID and choose Edit button.-Under General tab，uncheck the Prospect field.-This will change the role of Account from prospect to current.

Title: Material IDs are not in Sequence
Content: Symptom-When you create a Material, the Material IDs are not in sequence.-For Example: From 1500000 to 1500022, material IDs are in sequence. But afterwards number range for materials is not in sequence.-Resolution-For performance reasons the drawing of numbers for products is buffered, i.e. when a new number is requested, 10 numbers are determined and reserved immediately. This helps to speed up mass creation of products significantly, but it has the side effect that after some time the reserved numbers in the buffer are invalidated and thus not used in scenarios where for a longer period no new numbers are needed.--So, in a productive scenario where usually lots of new products are created within the system within a short time, you barely notice any "missing" numbers while you profit from the performance improvement.

Title: Is it Possible to Enhance the Customers (Accounts) only With Address
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to enhance some of the Customers (Accounts) with Address details but even , if you change the Migration Mode to Enhance already existing records, system doesnt allow to enhance the Address.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to Overview view.-3. Search and open the activity Migration of Customers.-4. Select Migrate customers unsing migration tool-Resolution-The system works as designed.-In current release, Enhancing Address details of existing Customers are not supported using Migration Mode Enhance already existing records.--Please use the manual method (that is through the work center/view) to update the Address details.--you can enhance customer data using the following sheets of the migration template and other sheets are not supported.-Payment Data-Sales Data-Contacts-Tax Data-Tax Exemptions-For further details, you can refer to the documentation can be found using the help center document Configuration: Prepare for Data Migration in a Change Project.-Path:-Expand Task.-Expand Fill migration templates.-Section 3. Enhance already existing records-Select the link Customers — Enhance Records in a Change Project.-This misleading situation exists only in the current release and from next release, you will see that in enhancement mode the sheet for Attachments does not appear at all.

Title: Cannot Create New Return to Supplier due to an error message: Delivered quantities have been completely returned or rejected.
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create the Return to Supplier for the Inbound Delivery DEF because of an error message: Delivered quantities have been completely returned or rejected.*DEF refers to Inbound Delivery Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select the New Return to Supplier link in the common tasks-Select Supplier Delivery Items By Selection-Search for releavant Inbound Delivery-Select the checkbox against the Inbound Delivery DEF and select Next button-Error appears-Cause-There is one Return to Supplier created for full quantity of inbound delivery and saved without maintaining the Follow-up Decision.-Resolution-Once you create the Return to Supplier, Delivery Proposals gets created parallelly. When you save return to supplier the status changes to Released.-Maintain the Follow-up Decision and Save the document.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Return To Suppliers view.-Edit the Return to supplier you created.-Select the Follow-up Decision by using the drop-down list of Follow-up Decision.-Select Save button. -Now the status of the return to supplier changes to In Process. Create the Outbound Delivery with reference to Return to Supplier.-Go to Outbound Deliveries work center.-Select the Delivery proposals subview under the Delivery Control.-Select the Return to Supplier document and select Post Goods Issue button.-Fill in all mandatory fields.-Select Save button.-Once the Outbound Delivery is released the Return to Supplier status changes to Finished.-Keywords-Delivered quantities have been completely returned or rejected, Cannot Create New Return to Supplier due to an error message-delivered quantities have been,completely returned or rejected,cannot create new return to

Title: Error Message: Product Category is not set up for Accounting; Select Another Category During Creation of Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create a shopping cart due to an error 'product category is not set up for accounting; select another category' even though the product category ABC is assigned to service account determination group in Fine Tuning activity Default Account determinationgroups for Product categories.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home Work Center.-Select the Self Services Overview.-Select the Go Shopping link.-Select a product from a catalog.-Select Edit Shopping Carts phase.-Now you can see the item type as material by default and the above error message.-Cause-By default system selects the item type as material.-The item is assigned to Product category ABC and product category ABC is maintained with the account determination group for the Services, the system fails to determine the account determination group.-Hence system throws the above error message.-Resolution-System picks up the Item Type from the Product ID (for the internal products) and from the Custom Catalog - if the Product Id is mapped in the catalog.-If the Product ID is not mapped in the custom catalog,  then system would fail to pick the Item Type and defaults the itrem type as Material. In such situation you have to select the Item Type as Service.-Keywords-Product Category, Set Up for Accounting, Select Another Category, Shopping Cart, Create

Title: Projects Not Shown on a Reports Based on the Customer Projects Data Source
Content: Symptom-You open a custom or standard report based on the data source Customer Projects (PROCPIU02) and notice that some projects are not shown in the report although they are available in the system.-For example, when you check the Project Management Object Work-list (OWL) you can see the project. -Reproducing the Issue-Open a report based on the Customer Projects (PROCPIU02) data source.-From the selection screen enter the desired project for the Project field (either directly or via the value help).-Select Go.-You noticed that the desired project is not shown and the following message is shown:-No report data available to display; check variables-When you check from the Project Management object work list (OWL) you can regularly see the desired project.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed.-Resolution-The Customer Projects (PROCPIU02) data source has some restrictions and is built on top of multiple data sources which may affect the result of the report (what is shown and what not).-In this case the report did not show the projects which did not have a released sales order linked to it.-You can check this as follow:-Navigate to the desired project or select it from the Project Management work center then Projects view.-Open the project and select View All.-Go to Sales Tracking tab.-From the list you can see if a sales order was created and the status.-

Title: Product Specification Field Missing in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Product Specification field is not visible in the Basic Data sub-tab of the Items tab in Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents Purchase Order ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Under Basic Data sub-tab, Product Specification field is not present.-Cause-Product Specification field is only available for Item with Process Type, To-Stock. -For Non-Stock items, the Product Specification field is not available by default.-Resolution-If a field is not visible by default, it can be enabled or added to the screen by adapting/personalizing the screen. However, the Product Specification field is applicable only for To-Stock items. For other item types, the Product Specification value is not retrieved from the Product Specification Master Data.-Follow the below steps to search and enable the Product Specification field in the Adaptation mode,-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents Purchase Order ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Basic Data sub-tab-Select the Profile icon.-Go to Key user settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Select the arrow near the UI Element "General Information".-Search for Product Specification field.-Enable the checkbox.-Select save.-Select 3 dots icon.-Choose Publish.-A pop-up appears with checkbox "Overwrite individual personalization changes to this screen"-Enable the checkbox.-Select Publish.-See Also-2766908 - Product Specification Cannot be Selected in Purchase Order - SAP for Me-3641106 - Standard Field not Available in Personalization mode - SAP for Me-Keywords-Product Specification; Purchase Order; To-stock item

Title: Task Assignment Criteria Tab And Add Row Button Not Enabled For The System Generated Task Folder
Content: Symptom-When you try to do the assignment for system generated logistics task folder, system does not display the Task Assignment Criteria tab and also it does not allow to add the employees under Registration ﻿tab as the Add Row ﻿button is not enabled there.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data Work center.-Go to the Logistics Task Folder view.-In the Show field, select All Folders By Selection from the drop-down.-Search for the relevant Logistics Task Folder ID using Find option.-Select the Task Folder ID with certain Task Type say Production Task and Edit it.-You could see that there is no tab for Task Assignment Criteria available for the logistics task folder.-Now, go to the Registration tab, you find that the option Add Row is grayed out. -Cause-As the Logistics Task Folder is the system generated folder (i.e. a DEFAULT folder) it does not include the Task Assignment Criteria tab in it; and for the same reason the Add Row button is not enabled in the Registration tab.-Note: Only when you explicitly create a Logistics Task Folder in the system, the above option will be available. You can create a Logistics Task Folder using the following steps:-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data Work center.-Go to the Logistics Task Folder view.-Select the New button.A window opens.-Under Logistics Task Folder Data section, then enter the Task Folder ID and select Task Type.-Under Organizational Data section, enter the required Site ID.-And then perform Save.-Resolution-After creating the required task folder with task type, now you would be able to view Task Assignment Criteria Tab and Add Row button will be enabled under the Registration tab.This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Task Assignment Criteria Tab And Add Row Button Not Enabled For The System Generated Task Folder

Title: System Generates Purchase Proposals Intead of Production Proposals
Content: Symptom-When you run the Material Requirement Planning for a product ABC and a planning area XYZ, system generates Purchase Proposal instead of Production Proposal even though you have a valid Released Planning Production Model for the product ABC and a planning area XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning Work Center.-Go to the Products View.-In the field Show, select All Materials and search for the Product ID ABC and Planning Area XYZ.-Select the Open button. The Product Planning details screen opens.-Select the Run Planning -> Single BoM Level, you can see that system has generated the Purchase Proposal instead of Production Proposal.-Cause-In the product master data, as you have maintained the procurement type as External Procurement, that is why system has generated Purchase Proposal instead of Production Proposal.-Resolution-If you would like the system to generate the Production Proposal, then you have to change the procurement type for the product in the product master data. The steps to be carried out are:-Go to the Product Data Work center.-Go to the Products view.-Select All Materials in the field Show and search for the Product ID ABC.-Select the Product ID and select the Edit button.-In the new opened window, select the View All button.-Go to the Planning tab. Select the planning area XYZ.-Under the Procurement section, in the field Procurement Type, select the option In-House production or Source of Supply Priority Rule from the drop down list according to your business requirement.-Later perform Save.

Title: Search for Purchase Orders to Be Invoiced Returns Unexpected Results in Invoice Entry
Content: Symptom-You are performing a search for 'All Orders to Be Invoiced' and you receive unexpected results i.e. purchase orders in any status.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select Show: All Orders to Be Invoiced.-You may limit the search by providing a value in the Find field (not necessary).-Select the Go button.-Note that the search returns unexpected results (e.g. with status 'Invoiced').-Cause-In this worklist, the system displays also invoiced orders, as long as these are not yet fully delivered or not manually finished.-As long as a delivery is expected for a purchase order and not yet completed, the documents will still appear in this list. The background for this is while invoicing one should be able to keep an eye on these documents where the delivery is not yet completed/done.-Once the delivery is completed, or manually finished, the order will disappear from the list of 'All Orders to Be Invoiced'.-Resolution

Title: Product Description Missing in B2B Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You connected another system or tool to your Business ByDesign system that sends B2B message communication for supplier invoice. Upon opening the supplier invoice, you notice that the product description is missing for the items. You checked that for the Product ID, a description has been maintained in the master data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find the relevant B2B supplier invoice and choose Edit.-Go to the Items tab.-The field Product Description is empty.-Cause-If no language code is given in the XML message, the processing user of the XML will be used to determine a language code. At present the technical user has the default language code EN.-But for example, a German customer will not maintain a product description in English and thus the description remains empty in the supplier invoice created from the B2B message.-Resolution-For the items, you need to add the tag <Description languageCode="XX" /> just before the tags </Item>. "XX" being the language code: "DE", "FR", etc...

Title: Error Message: PO item obligatory for intercompany time recording
Content: Symptom-While trying to release a time sheet you see that the system displays error message as displayed below.-Not all recorded time entries were released.-PO item obligatory for intercompany time recording-PO item for intercompany time recording could not be determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Update the times and select the Release button and choose Release All.-The system throws an error message as follows below--Not all recorded time entries were released.--PO item obligatory for intercompany time recording--PO item for intercompany time recording could not be determined-Check if a sales order is created for an intercompany project or not.-Go to Project Management work center.-Select the projects view.-Select the project.-Select Edit button and select the Products and Purchasing-Go to Sales Tracking tab check whether sales order is created for a project or not.-Cause-The error messages raised due to one of the following reasons:-The employee's or service agent's company is different from the project's company, but you haven't create a purchase order for it. -You have created the intercompany related purchase order, but the respective intercompany relavent Sales Order and intercompany project are not created automatically because the output channel for both Account and Supplier in their respective master data does not have the value Electronic Data Exchange (EDX) maintained.-You have created the  intercompany related purchase order, but it is not enabled for time recording.-You have created the  intercompany related purchase order, but it is fully delivered or the purchase order delivery is manually completed then purchase order will not be available for time recording.-Resolution-Resolution for Cause 1:-When the employee's or service agent's company is different from the project's company, a purchase order is required to do the project time recording against the buying company project. The intercompany company related sales order and intercompany settlement project should be created out of the same purchase order. Once the intercompany sales order is Open status and the intercompany project released status the Purchase order will default when the employee does a time recording.-When you create project purchase request. Once it is released, a purchase order will be created out of this purchase request. A purchase order is for buying the company to purchase service from intercompany company/selling company. Once the purchase order is ordered, this led to the creation of a sales order on the intercompany company/selling company. The sales order is for the intercompany company to sell service to the account of the company. As a normal system behavior, if all the setting is configured correctly, once the sales order is created, the system should also automatically create an intercompany project on the intercompany company/selling company side. Creation of sales order and subsequently the intercompany project is an automatic process. Once this intercompany project on the intercompany company/selling company side is created, then the service agent belong to intercompany project/selling company procured by buying company can record times on the task of the project of the buying company.-The document flow as follows:-Project  -> Project Purchase Request  -> Purchase Request  -> Purchase Order  -> Sales Order  -> an Intercompany Project on intercompany project/selling company.-Note: if the sales order is created and the intercompany project is not created automatically out of the sales order due to some reason kindly create the intercompany project manually on intercompany company/selling company and make sure to release the Sales Order it should be in Open status.-Resolution for Cause 2:-In case of intercompany purchase order, the output of the purchase order should be XML. To ensure that Sales Order Confirmations and Customer Invoices will be sent via Internal EDX (XML communication) to Purchasing Company and purchasing orders will be sent via Internal EDX (XML communication) to supplying company. Please follow the below steps.-Account :-Go to the Business Partner Data work center..-Choose the Accounts view-Search and Choose the Purchasing company XXX-Choose Edit button-Go to Communication -> Collaboration-Here choose the  Business Documents Sales Order Confirmation and Customer Invoice / Credit Memo mark the Output Channel as Internal EDX.-Supplier :-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Choose the Supplier view-Search and Choose the Supplying company XXX-Choose Edit button-Go to Communication -> Collaboration-Here choose the  Business Documents Purchase Orders and mark the Output Channel as Internal EDX.-Resolution for Cause 3:-Steps to check the Purchase Order.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose the Purchase Orders view.-Find and choose the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the PO).-Choose Edit button.-Go to Items tab.-Choose the service assigned to the service agent.-Here you can see the Time Recording Required field is enabled or not-If the purchase order is created out of project purchase request the Time Recording Required field will be enabled automatically, if the you are creating the standalone Purchase request and Purchase Order explicitly from the Purchase Requests and Orders work center you have to manual enable the Time Recording Required field. To record time, you need to enable time recording and have open quantity in the purchase order.-Resolution for Cause 4:- If delivery is completed you cannot do new time confirmations- If the delivery  is manually finished then you can revoke the  delivery completion and then create time recordings-See Also-2097351- The Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project is not created-Keywords-Intercompany time recording, Intercompany company sales order, Intercompany company project, PO item obligatory

Title: Sourcing request cannot be created
Content: Symptom-Sourcing Request cannot be created because of an error message. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Request ID). -Select it. -Click on Quick Sourcing Request button.-Error is displayed: "Sourcing request cannot be created".-Cause-The Purchase Request contains one or more limit items.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-Limit items are not supported for any bidding processes. Therefore the system raises the error message. -Keywords-Sourcing Request Cannot be Created, Purchase Request, Quick Sourcing Request

Title: Sales Orders Status In Preparation or Not Linked to a Project are Not Shown in Project Reports
Content: Symptom-You open a custom or standard report based on the data source Customer Projects (PROCPIU02) and notice that some sales orders are not shown in the report although they are available in the system.-When you check further you notice that the sales orders not shown are either in status In Preparation or are not linked to a project.-Reproducing the Issue-Open a report based on the Customer Projects (PROCPIU02) data source.-Add the Sales Order characteristic to the rows-You notice that sales orders which are in In Preparation status are not shown in the report although they are linked to a Project.-You also notice that Sales Orders which are not linked to a project are not shown in the report.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed since there are restrictions on the data sources on what sales orders to show.-Resolution-The data source Customer Projects (PROCPIU02) is built on top of the below data sources which involve the Cust. Proj. Invoicing Agreement Item (PROCPIB04) which picks up only sales orders which are released and linked to a project.-All involved data sources:-PROCPIB02 Cust. Proj. Expense List Expense Document Item Split-PROCPIB03 Cust. Proj. Invoice Requisition Item-PROCPIB04 Cust. Proj. Invoicing Agreement Item-PROCPIB05 PROCPIB05-PROCPIB06 PROCPIB06-PROCPIB07 PROCPIB07

Title: Two Entries are visible in Business Communication Monitoring Per Expense Report Posting
Content: Symptom-After posting an expense report you observed two entries in Business Communication Monitoring are created you would like to know the reason for two entries.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Admin Work Center.-Press the link Business Communication.-From the Show dropdown select Modified View - All Messages.-Document ID.-You got two Outgoing message from Expense Report Business Document- Cause-If Expense Report contains the part of taxable amount then system will trigger two messages, for HCM ERP as well as FIN ERP systems.-Therefore duplicate entries are available in the Business Communication Monitoring.

Title: Fallback Language for the Determination of Form in your Sales Document
Content: Symptom-Fallback language for the Determination of Form in your Sales Document-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Document view.-Select Invoice Document XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the form).-Select Preview.-The template with the English language is selected.-Cause-The template is selected according to the language of the bill-to and the country of the Seller. In case there is no template for the language of the bill-to the fallback language used is ENGLISH.- Resolution-This is the normal system behaviour.

Title: Cannot Delete Price List or List price
Content: Symptom-You would like to delete a price list, discount list or list price but the option Delete is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the List price view.-Select a list price.-- or-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio-Click on the Price View-Select the Base Price List view -Cause-This is the standard behavior. In order to prevent inconsistences in the system, once a List Price, Price List or Discount List has been released (or partially released), it cannot be deleted anymore.-Resolution-However, you can cancel the release of the price list, what will result in the same effect.-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Price List view-Select a price list.-Click on Release, then select the option Cancel Release.- Once the release is canceled, the list price cannot be released again.-Keywords-delete; price list; product; discount list; list price;-grayed,disabled

Title: How To Release The Outbound Delivery Automatically
Content: Symptom-After related warehouse order finished, how to ensure system release the newly-created Outbound Delivery automatically?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In order to automatically release the Outbound Delivery, you have to select the option Automatically in the field Release Outbound Delivery for the Logistics Model Type : Standard Shipping (with tasks). The steps to be followed are as follows:-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to the Logistics Model View.-In the Show field, select All Logistics Model from the drop down list and search for respective Logistics Model ID.-Edit the Logistics Model ID. A new window opens .-Under the Details: Logistics Model section, select the Release Outbound Delivery field.-Here, select the option Automatically from the drop down and then perform Save.-See Also-3503755 - Error Information: You cannot automatically release an outbound delivery if the logistics model does not contain a task-Keywords-Release, Automatically, Outbound Delivery, Logistics Model

Title: Wrong FIFO Amount in Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-After ran the Material Cost Accumulation and setting the cost of your material as FIFO cost, you notice system is using the wrong FIFO cost amount in the Journal Entry created for the Warehouse Confirmation ID you received.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-These are your Warehouse Confirmations:-1º Warehouse Confirmation A = 1.500,00 USD _ Journal Entry X / 10 quantities-2º Warehouse Confirmation B = 4.500,00 USD _ Journal Entry Y / 20 quantities-3º Warehouse Confirmation C = 7.500,00 USD _ Journal Entry Z / 15 quantities-Your Sales Order has 17 units and you expect to see:-For the 10 first items the FIFO cost should be = 150,00 (1.500,00 / 10)-For the other 7 items the FIFO cost should be = 225,00 (4.500,00 / 20)-But system is using as FIFO cost the average of the Warehouse Confirmation:-7.500,00 + 4.500,00 + 1.500,00 / 45 = 300,00 USD-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Go to Material Cost Accumulation subview.-Show Material Cost Accumulation Runs in Update Mode.-Search for your Run ID, there are no errors.-Go to Execution Details tab-Click the Execution ID-Go to Processed Successfully tab-Source Document Item ID’s:-1º Warehouse Confirmation A = 1.500,00 USD _ Journal Entry X-2º Warehouse Confirmation B = 4.500,00 USD _ Journal Entry Y-3º Warehouse Confirmation C = 7.500,00 USD _ Journal Entry Z-  Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Master Data view.-Go to Material Unit Costs subview.-Filter your material ID.-It’s possible see the below Cost Type amounts:-Cost Type = Inventory Cost / 300,00 USD as the cost-Cost Type = Periodic FIFO Cost / 300,00 USD as the cost-Cause-System behavior is correct.-You have to distinguish between Perpetual Cost Method and FIFO Cost Determination. The system has two different kinds of Perpetual Cost Methods, Standard and Moving Average.-These methods are the basis of the maintenance of inventory costs. The perpetual cost method has strong impact of the valuation of goods movement.-System will always execute the valuated based on the inventory cost and never based on FIFO costs. FIFO Cost Determination is a periodical run with which FIFO Cost for materials can be set. This is statistical in the first place.-However, FIFO Costs can be used as new Inventory Costs via Update Inventory Cost.-Then the whole stock quantity is revaluated and adjusted to the FIFO Cost as new Inventory Cost. If you want to do this it is recommended to change your Perpetual Cost Method to Standard.-Resolution-In this case, the posting done over the Journal Entry is correct as it is not possible to use FIFO to valuate the goods movements. For this you would need FIFO as a perpetual cost method and in SAP Business ByDesign, FIFO is not a Perpetual Cost Method.-Keywords-FIFO; First In; First Out; inventory valuation method; cost type; material

Title: Catalogs view missing from Product Portfolio work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA   2557046 - Catalog View in Work Center Product Portfolio Missing-View Catalogs is missing from the Product Portfolio work center, even though scoping decisions have been made according to what is explained on the Catalogs entry of the Help Center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center-Hover the mouse cursor over the menu entry and verify that the Catalogs view is not displayed-Cause-An essential question was missed during scoping.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Section 4 (Questions).-Select scoping element Catalogs (under General Business Data > Products).-Add question Do you import material or service catalogs from your suppliers into the system to the scope.-Finish scoping.

Title: Logistics Area ID not Available in the Value Help While Confirming Pick Task
Content: Symptom-You have maintained source logistic area determination runle, but while confirming a pick task system is not proposing any logistics area.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Execution work center.-Go to the Outbound Warehouse Tasks view.-Select the relevant task.-Select Confirm button.-Move to Source Logistics Area ID field.-Select Value Help.-No records found.-Cause-There is no stock available in the system for the requested product in the pick task, that is why system is not able to propose it automatically.-Resolution-System is working as designed.

Title: Supplier not Found when Typing its Name in New List Price
Content: Symptom-When creating a List Price, the user is unable to select the wanted Supplier in the field. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Common Task view and select New List Price task. -Enter the first letters of the Supplier name.-The system doesn't find the supplier even though it does exist in the Supplier Master Data.-Cause-The field is based on the Legal Competence Indicator. If the Supplier doesn't have this indicator set, then the help filter will not suggest it. -Resolution-The steps to maintain the indicator checked for the Supplier is listed below: -Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Search for the Supplier ID.-Click on View All button.-Navigate to General tab.-Under Details section, check the box for Legal Competence. -Save it. -Keywords-List Price, Supplier, Legal Competence, Supplier Base

Title: No Assessable Value field in Supplier Invoice for Excise Duty
Content: Symptom-You cannot find a field Assessable Value on Supplier Invoice to calculate the Excise Duty. On Customer Invoice, the field is available. Since Tax Base Amount and Excise Duty differ, you cannot input the invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Find the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Choose View All.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes sub-tab.-There is no field Assessable Value.-Cause-In supplier invoice, there is no such field planned. However you can also change the Excise Duty on the General tab.-Resolution-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Find the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Choose View All.-Go to the General tab.-Go to the Taxes sub-tab and then Taxes Details.-There you can change the Tax Amount to another amount than the Calculated Tax Amount.

Title: Incorrect approvers in tasks for Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-User can see two sets of approval tasks in Business Task Management.-One set with the correct approvers but a second one with different approvers which do not seem to follow the defined approval process.-Reproducing the Issue-Under Application and User Management/ Task distribution / Business Task Management-The user can see two tasks with types: Approval Process Definition and Supplier Invoice-For the first task, approvers are as expected.-For the second, the list of approvers is different and the user does not know how these are determined.-Cause-There are two sets of approval processes at play:  The standard approval process and the stochastic approval process.-The standard approval process is governed by the Approval Process rules as defined in the Supplier Invoice Approval Process in Application and User Management/ Task Distribution/ Approval Processes-The stochastic approval process creates random check tasks that come into play when supplier invoices go into exceptions (only for Price Variance, Quantity Variance, and Possible Duplicate) and the exceptions are accepted.-Depending on the settings in Business Configuration, such approval tasks will be created which will be sent to a set responsible as an additional security.-Prerequisites for these random checks are :-Answering the scoping question Under Invoice Exception Processing: "Do you require a random check of supplier invoices with accepted exceptions?" as Yes.-Configuring the Fine tune activity: Random Invoice Check with the percentage of invoices that should go for approval.-Responsibles : At the moment, the responsible for such tasks cannot be configured as it is hard coded. The manager of the invoicing unit assigned to the Supplier Invoice has to approve. In case no approver is defined in that way, the reporting line manager of the employee responsible for the Supplier Invoice is the approver.-Note that from release 1305, the stochastic approval will be added in the MultiStepApproval, so it will be possible to configure it there and define a responsible for this task as well.-Resolution-If such random additional checks are not required then the scoping question should be disabled.-For more information, see the Help document : "Configuration: Random Invoice Check"

Title: Intercompany Project  is not available.
Content: Symptom-When creating the new project the project type Intercompany Project is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management workcenter.-Select New Project under Common Tasks.-Go to Project Type under Enter Initial Data tab -Under Project Type drop down you cannot see the Intercompany Project type.-Cause-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List.-Go to Fine Tune tab.-Find and Select Project Types activity.-Select Open.-Here you can see the available all project types, for a project type an Intercompany Indicator is checked this project type will not be available under project types drop down menu when you are trying to create a new project from Project Management UI is because this project type is with the Intercompany indicator checkbox selected. It means that is an intercompany project type and is not possible to create an Intercompany Project type manually.  The intercompany project will be created automatically from a Sales Order.-Note: You can check only one project type as the intercompany project at a time.-Resolution-When the intercompany indicator is checked for project type, this project type will not be available under project types drop down menu when you are trying to create new project under Project Management workcenter because this intercompany project will not be created manual it will be created automatically from the intercompany sales order.-Keywords-Project; Intercompany; Sales Order

Title: Delivery Date Field for Materials not Available in the Migration Template for Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-The field Delivery Date is not available in the template provided for Migration of Purchase Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Show Activities.-Find activity Migration of Purchase Orders.-Open hyperlink: Migrate purchase orders using the migration tool.-Select 'You can also'-Download Migration template.-The field "Delivery Date" is not available. -Cause-In the migration template, it has the fields "Delivery Start Date" and "Delivery End Date". These two fields are used to specify the delivery period for a Service.-However, in context of Purchase Orders with Materials, the Purchase Order migration template is designed in a manner that the "Delivery Start Date" will work as equivalent to the "Delivery Date".-Resolution-Use the "Delivery Start Date" field to populate the values of "Delivery Date" during migration.-Keywords-Purchase Orders Migration, Delivery Date, Material, Migration of Purchase Orders, migration tool, Delivery Start Date

Title: Error Message: File Upload Error, While Uploading Migration File
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload a Migration File through any of the Migration activity, system throws below error message:-File Upload Error-File name already exists in unit; choose a different file name-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Search and open any Migration activity.-Select Upload button.-Select Browse and select Upload button.-Cause-The issue might be because of inconsistency in the Migration file.-Resolution-To overcome the issue, download the Migration Template again and copy the data from the old migration file to new migration file.-In case, if the issue persists again, Please report an case.

Title: Tolerance percentage on Purchase Order is not copied from Purchasing Contract
Content: Symptom-You have set the over-delivery tolerance on a contract, but the over-delivery tolerance carried over to a purchase order originating from a project is different from the defined percentage.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Open the affected document.-Verify the over-delivery tolerance.-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open the associated contract.-Verify the over-delivery tolerance is different from that of the Purchase Order.-Cause-The purchase request of the associated purchase order has a reference to a project purchase request so Project purhcase order details should be given priority as it is the preceding document.-Resolution-If the purchase request of the affected purchase order has a reference to a project purchase request, the over-delivery tolerances are copied from the purchase request, and not from the contract.-Keywords-tolerance per supplier, tolerance for each product  and supplier

Title: Unable to Change the Project Type While Creating Customer Project from a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When you try to create the project from sales order the system will create the project with default type as customer project with sales integration, unable to select different Project Type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can reproduce this scenario via two ways: -(A) If it is a New Sales Order-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the view Sales Orders.-Create a New Sales Order under the view Common Tasks.-Choose View All.-Navigate to Item Tab.-Choose Create Project.-In the pop-up screen for the New Project, enter below details:  Project Structure: One task for each item, Person Responsible, Responsible Unit.-Select Go.-Under Project, Project Task field you can view Customer project is created. Ex: CPSOXXX.- (B) If it is an existing Sales Order.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the view Sales Orders.-In the field Show choose option All Orders and find XXX sales order.-Edit the sales order ID XXX.-Choose View All.-Navigate to Item Tab.-Choose Create Project.-In the pop-up screen for the New Project, enter below details:  Project Structure: One task for each item, Person Responsible, Responsible Unit.-Select Go.-Under Project, Project Task field you can view Customer project is created. Ex: CPSOXXX.-Cause-While creating the project from Sales Order, system will create the project with default type as Customer Project with sales integration. Ex: CPSOXYZ. There are no business configuration option to change this type of project, since this is SAP By Design system Standard Behavior. However if you want to change the default project type to some different customer project type, this can be done as newly created project will have the status as In Planning,you can change its project type by navigating to Project Management work center.-Resolution-Steps to change the project type from default to some other different customer project type:- Go to the Project Management work center.- Choose the view Project.- In the field  Show  select the option All Projects and find XXX project (XXX represents the ID of the project).- Choose the project ID XXX.- Choose Edit and select the task Project Plan.- Navigate to Basic Data tab.- Here you will find a field called Project Type.- From here you can change the required Customer Project Type by selecting from drop down menu. -Keywords-Project; Sales Order; Customer; Sales Integration; Project Type

Title: Inconsistent Status In Choosing Approve in Different Views
Content: Symptom-You notice the status for Approval Task is inconsistent in choosing Approve on the overview of UI and editable view.-Once you choose the Approve button on the overview for approval task, the status for this task will change from New to Completed, when you first Edit this task then choose the Approve button in edit mode, the status for this task will not change.-Eventually this task will disappear if you navigate to the over all view again.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Show Supply Invoice Approval Tasks.-Select the relevant task then choose the Edit button.-Select the Approval button.-You notice the status for this task did not change. Once you navigate to the overview again,this task appear.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior. From technical perspective, once you choose edit the task then approve it, on the edit mode it has its own session which does not influence the screen session,that is why the status will not change.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Keywords-Supply Invoice, Approval Task

Title: How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2644606***-You want to close the sales order which is linked to a project, the Invoice Status on sales order is Not Started,Delivery status on the  sales order is finished  . You find the Reason for Rejection on both item and header level is grayed out, hence it is not possible to set the Reason for Rejection and change the status of the sales order as Completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the relevant sales order.-Select the Edit button and choose View All.-You find the Reason for Rejection is not editable on both header and item level.-Cause-The Delievery status is finished as the relevant project in Closed status, you have to revoke the closure for the project and cancel the sales order.-Resolution-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Find relevant project.-Go to Project Plan tab then select the Revoke Closure/revoke completion in Project Status.-Ensure the status of project task is released-Save.-After this, we expect delivery status fo the sales order to be in 'Not started' status ,so you can set the Reason for Rejection on item level of the sales order,and finish the Customer Invoice to complete the sales order.-Once done you can complete/close the project using same steps by selecting complete/close in Project status-See Also-   2644606 - How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item-Keywords-Project sales order,Reason for Rejection,Close sales order, cancel sales order line item,cancel sales order

Title: Cannot Reverse Closure of Purchasing Contract
Content: Symptom-Want to reverse the status of a Contract that is set to "Closed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Choose the Contracts view.-Show: All Contracts and click button Go.-The result list displays : All Contracts.-Choose Contract X from the result list. (X refers to contract ID)-Click button Edit.-Click button Close Contract.-Status is set on Closed.-Cause-It is not possible to reverse a closed contract.-Resolution-It is only suggested to create a new contract while copying the closed contract.-Follow the below steps to copy the closed contract:-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Choose the Contracts view.-Show All Contracts and Go.-The result list displays : All Contracts.-Choose Contract X from the result list.-Click button Copy.-Edit the details accordingly.-Release the contract.- Note : It is not possible to activate the closed contracts from the backend as well.-See Also-KBA   2300994 - Purchasing Contract Status set to Expired-Keywords-reverse purchase contract, purchase contract, contract, contract reversal, reverse closure of contract,contract closed automatically

Title: How to Delete or Remove The Cost Assignments In Purchase Order Item.
Content: Symptom-To edit current cost assignment in a Purchase order Item, the Add Row or Remove buttons are inactive.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Order view-Select the Purchase Order XYZ (purchase order ID).-Choose Edit  Button-Go to Items tab.-Go to Account Assignment sub tab.-The Add Row and Remove buttons are grayed out.-Resolution-It is not allowed to Add or Delete the Account Assignments once the Purchase Order is ordered. This is the desired behavior of the system and hence no change is planned in future releases.

Title: Copy Button is Inactive in the Approval Process Screen
Content: Symptom-You need to modify the default approval process for purchase order and supplier invoice. However the Copy button is inactive and you cannot create a new set of approval rules for the business documents.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Go to the Fine Tuning section.-Select the Activity, Purchase Order Approvals and Supplier Invoice Approvals.-Copy button is inactive.-Cause-You do not have access rights to the work center / view name Approval Processes under Application and User Management.--Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view.-Select Business Users.-Select the relevant user.-Navigate to the tab, Work Center and View Assignment.-Search for Work Center / View ID -> ITS_APPLICATIONUSERMANAGEMENT.-Select the check box for View ID APPROVALPROCESSES_WCVIEW.-Select Save.

Title: How to Delete a Service Confirmation Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You want to Delete the Service Confirmation Invoice Request from the Invoice Requests View under the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Select the Invoice Requests View.-Find the Service Confirmation Invoice Request ID XYZ which has to be deleted (where XYZ represents the Service Confirmation Invoice Request ID).-There is no option to Delete the Invoice Request.-Cause-The Service Confirmation Invoice Request XYZ is created from the Service Confirmation XXX (where XXX represents the Service Confirmation ID) and hence unless you revoke the Service Confirmation XXX the Invoice Request XYZ will not get canceled.-Resolution-In order to cancel the Service Confirmation Invoice Request first you have to cancel the Service Confirmation.-Following are the steps to cancel the Service Confirmation:-Go to the Field Service and Repair Work Center.-Select the Service Confirmations View.-Find the Service Confirmation ID XXX and Select it.-Choose the Button Edit.-Choose the Button View All under General Tab enter the Reason for Rejection.-Choose the Save button.-The Invoice Request XYZ created will automatically get canceled, also the Sales Order is updated accordingly based on the Confirmation.-See Also-Keywords- delete, service confirmation invoice request, service confirmation, service, invoice request, cancelled

Title: Cannot release Purchase proposal due to error: "Release failed for proposal X; PRS usage in SRM not configured in BC"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to manually release a Purchase Proposal but the action fails with the error 'Release failed for proposal X; PRS usage in SRM not configured in BC'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Create a New Planning Proposal selecting a product with specification.-Choose Save then Release.-Error occurs and you cannot release the Proposal into a Purchase Request.-Cause-The error refers to the configuration of Product Specification for SRM in Business Configuration. PRS (Purchase Requirement Specification) is not scoped.-Resolution-Product Specification must be enabled. This is actually found under the Sales Scoping element. To enable it:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to view Implementation Projects.-Select the title First Implementation and click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to step 3 - Scoping.-Under Scoping Element, go to Sales and expand.-Select the option Product and Service Portfolio for Sales.-Select the option Sell Specified Products and confirm the changes.-Keywords-Supply Planning, Planning Proposal, Purchase Requirement Specification, Product Specification

Title: Task Execution Error while Selecting the Task "Delivered Quantity Adjusted for PO with Returns to Supplier"
Content: Symptom-You get An Error Message while selecting the task Delivery Quantity Adjusted for PO with Returns. The Error message states: Error while taking over the task as a substitute for user XYZ. XYZ represents the logged in user ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Choose the Purchase Orders view-Select Show: Open Tasks then choose Go-Find the relevant Purchase Order-Select the link Delivery Quantity Adjusted for PO with Returns to Supplier-This error occurs: Error while taking over the task as a substitute for user XYZ-Cause-You did not maintain correctly the substitutions in the system.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Choose the Task Distribution view-Select the Task Substitution:User Selection sub view-Find the relevant user. In this case, find user name who is responsible for the Purchase Order-Choose the Edit Substitution button-Choose Add Row button and maintain necessary information for Substitutions-Choose Save-Keywords-Delivery Quantity Adjusted for PO with Returns; Error while taking over the task as a substitute; error while acknowledging task-delivery quantity adjusted for po with,error while taking over the task substit,you cannot edit element

Title: Adding New Item In An Intercompany Purchase Order Does Not Update Existing Sales Order
