Content: Symptom-In an Intercompany Scenario (A2A/B2B), adding a new item in the purchase order does not update the existing sales order.-The sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID) is created from purchase order ABC (ABC represents the purchase order ID).-When you update the purchase order ABC with a new item DEF (DEF represents the new item ID), the sales order XYZ is not updated automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Order work center.-Go to the Purchase Order view.-Find the purchase order ABC.-Select Edit.-Go to the Items tab.-Add the item DEF to the purchase order.-Select Save.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Find the sales order XYZ.-Select Edit.-Go to the Items tab.-You cannot find the item DEF in the list of Items.-Cause-Item DEF is not displayed because it would make the sales order inconsistent. There is no price maintained in a price list that can be pulled for item DEF.-Any Update that would make the sales order inconsistent will not be saved, it will be rejected. Hence the update in the sales order is not processed. Furthermore, the change has caused a process communication error.-Resolution-To solve the issue a price for item DEF has to be maintained in a respective price list in the master data. You can follow these steps to update the Price List:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing view.-Go to the Price Lists subview.-Select the relevant price list, for example the Base Price List, or create a new price list.-Go to the Items tab.-Add the item DEF.-Release the item DEF.-Save the price list.-If a price list already exists, you need to ensure that it is consistent and item DEF is maintained only once in it. If it contains any errors, it will not update the price of the item in the sales order. Furthermore, it will not correct the process communication error.-Keywords-Sales Order, Purchase Order, Intercompany, Item not updated, Item missing, process communication error, mandatory price list missing

Title: You Have Scoped The Approval Process For Sales Order And Your Customer Demand is in Status 'Delivery Blocked'
Content: Symptom-You have scoped the approval process for Sales Order and your Customer Demand is in status Delivery Blocked.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite : You have scoped the approval process for Sales Order with a threshold of YYY $ (YYY represents the maintained amount value).-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Edit the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of your sales order).-Go to the Items tab.-Select Items 10 and update the quantity.-Go to the Outbound Delivery Logistic work center.-Select the Customer Demand view.-Select the Row for the Sales Order XYZ and Item 10 (XYZ - 10).-You can see in the detail information that a delivery block is set up. However, you do not expect this block as the total price of the Sales Order did not exceed YYY $.-Cause-This is the normal system behavior. When the sales order approval process is scoped, in case you update an existing order that would affect the pricing (total, net value,...), the corresponding Customer Demand for the sales order item will be set up to delivery block.-In order to remove the block you would have to select the action: Submit for Approval on the Sales Order. Once you have trigger this action:-if the total amount of the order does not exceed the threshold value (YYY $ in our example), the order will be in status Approval not necessary and the delivery block will be removed in the customer demand.-if the total amount of the order exceed the threshold value, the order will go to approval according to the rules you have set up.-if there is no threshold value, however there is the profit and replacement delivery settings and you have changed the item quantity or UoM. -Resolution-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Select the Order XYZ.-Edit the Order and Select the Action > Submit to Approval-See Also-KBA 2619643 - Sales Order blocked-Keywords-sales order, customer demand, delivery, block, approval, process

Title: New PO Acknowledgement and Quick PO Acknowledgement Buttons Missing inThe Purchase Orders View Screen
Content: Symptom-You are trying to acknowledge the purchase order, however the buttons New PO Acknowledgement and Quick PO acknowledgement are missing in the purchase orders view screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order, you notice that the Acknowledgement buttons are missing.-Cause-The scoping element Purchase Order Acknowledgements are not in scope under Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-Switch on the element Purchase Order Acknowledgments under Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate the Implementation Projects view.-Select the button Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to third step i. e. Scoping.-Select the element Purchasing.-Select Purchase Request and Order Management.-Select the check box Purchase Order Acknowledgments.-Select the Finish button to complete the scoping.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Acknowledgement, Business Configuration, Missing.

Title: Supplier Data  Not Updated in Purchase Proposals
Content: Symptom-The supplier data is not updated in the purchase proposals created by the system even though you have maintained list price for the relevant product.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supply Planning.-Navigate to the view Process Purchase Proposals.-Search for the relevant purchase proposal, select it and choose the Edit button.-In the new screen you can see that there is no Supplier Data available in the document.-Cause-The validity of the List Price maintained for the product in the proposal is not valid on the Planned Order Date of the proposal. This is why the system is not able to determine the source of supply from the list price available.-Resolution-Update the Valid To date of the List Price so that it is active on the Planned Order Date of the proposal. Please follow the below given steps to do the same.-Go to the work center Product Portfolio.-Navigate to the view List Prices.-Search for the relevant List Price,  select it and choose the Edit button.-In the edit screen change the value in the field Valid To to a future date so that the List Price is active on the Planned Order Date of the proposal.-Choose the button Save.-The supplier data will be updated for all new purchase proposals created by the system after the above mentioned steps are performed.

Title: How to Edit Logo in any Form template
Content: Symptom-You want to modify the Logo on any form template or preview of any document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Application and user Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Select the Master Template Maintenance view.-Select Form Master Templates.-Select the required form template like Changed Purchase Order.-You can assign it to required company or orgunit or output channel-Click on edit and then you can make changes to logo or upload new logo-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-chnage Logo, edit logo, new logo, different logo for each company, logo based on output channel, Logo size, header , footer, email disclaimer,Sender address

Title: Cannot Disable Purchase Order Tasks
Content: Symptom-You want to disable all tasks related to Purchase Orders.-Cause-It is not at all possible to disable all tasks related to Purchase Orders in the system currently, due to its architecture.-Resolution-The only tasks that can be disabled are the ones included in the Business Task Management for Purchase Request and Order Management activity. To do so:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Overview view-Search for and select task Business Task Management for Purchase Request and Order Management and click on Change Immediately-Perform the desired changes to the tasks notifications

Title: How to set up the Substitute for a Project
Content: Symptom-You want to set a substitute for a Project that you are responsible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You added a Employee substitution for your user but the employee cannot see any project in the work list.-Cause-Employee substitution for your user will only be responsible for receiving the Task assigned to the original user. Substituted employee user will not be responsible for Project activity.-Resolution-To assign the substituted user as a employee responsible, follow the below steps :-Go to work center Project Management.-Go to view Projects.-Select the concerned Project from OWL.-Click on button Edit.-Navigate to Team and Staffing tab.-Maintain Project screen opens.-Click on button Add Row and add the user in column Team Member.-Select the user as substitute by selecting the check box Substitute.-Maintain the Start and Finish date for substitution.-Click on button Save to retain the changes.-If you maintain an employee as a substitute by following the above steps , then only your substitute will be able to work on the project.-Keywords-Substitute; Project; Employee; Task

Title: Supplier Invoice Exception: Missing Order Reference
Content: Symptom-System displays an exception: "Missing Order Reference" when a Supplier Invoice is created without a reference to Purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select New Invoice Without Reference to Purchase Order link.-Fill in all the mandatory fields.-Save/Post the document.System displays an exception: Missing order reference.-Cause-The exception Missing Order Reference is displayed always in case of supplier invoice without Purchase order.--System always checks available list of purchase orders based on seller & product ID/category with respect to the details maintained in the invoice.-Resolution-You can bypass the option of assigning the Purchase order reference to Supplier Invoice by selecting the Confirm button on the Exception screen without selecting any Purchase order that the system has populated.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Serch for the Supplier Invoice ID.-Go to the Exceptions tab in the invoice.-Go to sub tab Missing Order Reference.-Here you can see the Confirm button , select this button to confirm the exception.-Invoice can be saved / posted with this action. -Keywords-Supplier invoice exception, invoice without purchase order, missing order reference

Title: Multiple Values Shown for the Schedule Line Delivery Date on the Delivery Reliability Report
Content: Symptom-The Schedule Line Delivery Date characteristic, on the Delivery Reliability standard report, shows two different delivery dates although when you check the respective Purchase Order Item details you see that only one delivery date is shown.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Show all and search for standard report Delivery Reliability (technical ID SRMPO_U02_Q0001).-Run the report and add the desired characteristics and Key figures. For example: Supplier, Purchase Order ID, PO Item, Ordering Date, Schedule Line Delivery Date, Last Actual delivery date, Ordered Qty & Delivered Qty.-From the Schedule Line Delivery Date column for a specific Purchase Order and related items you see two sets of dates although the customer expects to see only one; as shown from the respective Purchase Order under item details then delivery date.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour and it is working as designed.-Resolution-The reason why you see multiple dates for the characteristic Schedule Line Delivery Date is because the data source the Delivery Reliability report is built on is a union/combined data source and it shows the data from several basic data sources like Purchase Order Item with Goods and Service Receipts Item (SRMPO_B04), Purchase Order with Confirmed Inbound Delivery Items (SRMPO_B06), Purchase Order with Outbound Delivery Items (SRMPO_B07) and Purchase Order Schedule Lines (SRMPO_B09).--In this case, for the Purchase Order analyzed, the Scheduled Delivery Start Date on the Purchase Order Item is different from the one on the Goods and Services Acknowledgement.--In Order to display both the planned Purchase Order and actual Goods and Service Acknowledgement delivery dates two lines are created. One line in the report is showing the delivery date and quantity of the Goods and Service Acknowledgement and the other line is showing that of the Purchase Order.-Note: For some Purchase Order both the planned and actual delivery dates can be the same so you see only one line as there's no need to split the data.-See Also-More information about this behaviour is available in the Knowledge Base Article 2488796 - Multiple Lines in Combined Data Sources.-Keywords-SRMPO_B09; SRMPO_B07; SRMPO_B06; SRMPO_B04; Schedule Line Delivery Date; multiple lines; combined data source; -SRMPO_U02_Q0001; Purchase Order Delivery Reliability; SRMPO_U02

Title: Can not issue a PI Count by Logistics Area in Physical Inventory
Content: Symptom-When you try to perform a physical inventory count (PI Count) for required logistics area ID, you get the message:-Logistics area has stock that is being processed and cannot be counted. Complete the stock's processing before you conduct a count of the entire storage location's stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center.-Select Common Tasks view-Go to New Logistics Area Count-Storage Location ID: ABC  ( Here ABC is a Storage Location)-Select Split Tasks as No Split Task-Enter required Logistics Area ID-Error: Logistics area has stock that is being processed and cannot be counted. Complete the stock's processing before you conduct a count of the entire storage location's stock.-Cause-The message is giving the information that there is some stock which is in process.-While initiating the count, warehouse manager has to ensure that all open logistics tasks are finished in the logistics area/warehouse.-Resolution-Kindly check for inbound and outbound warehouse orders in process and any related open tasks. Once you find any, complete the process and finish it.-You need to finish these tasks before initiating the count. Always check Stock Overview with Stock Type and warehouse orders associated with it.-Note : Additionally, you can set the logistics area status to Block if you want to prevent an active logistics area from being used in logistics processes during PI counting.-Once you have blocked a logistics area, it is not available for any newly started logistics processes.-Keywords-Inbound, Outbound, tasks, Logistics area has stock that is being processed and cannot be counted,-inbound,outbound,tasks,logistics area has stock that is being,complete the stock's processing before y

Title: No Attachment Shown in Object Work List Purchase Requests
Content: Symptom-The purchase request items contain attachments, however this is not shown under the paperclip icon in the object work list Purchase Requests.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the view Purchase Requests.-Choose Show: Open Tasks.-Mark the relevant purchase request and choose Edit.-Go to the Items tab and then Attachments sub-tab.-You can see some attachments.-Cause-The Object Work Lists in Business ByDesign are standard across the different business documents. The paperclip icon column only indicates if there are attachments on Header level.-For example, for Purchase Order, you have a tab Attachments on header level. If there is an attachment on header level, the paperclip icon column will indicate it. However if the attachment is on Item level only, there will be no indication.-On Purchase Requests, attachments are only on Item level. So the paperclip icon should be ignored or otherwise hidden in the Adaptation Mode.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the software.

Title: Responsible Contact Information on Purchase Order Template is Different from the Business partner Data Detail.
Content: Symptom-The responsible contact information displayed when the purchase order is previewed is different of the maintained information you have under Business partner Data Detail.-Reproducing the Issue-  Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the view Purchase Orders.-Search and select the Purchase order and press the Edit button.-Click on the Preview button.-The Information displayed is different from the information you have maintained under Business Partner Work Center.-Cause-This is the standard behavior , the information displayed is collected out of the Personnel Administration work center.-Resolution-Please maintain the information:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the responsible user and click on Edit button.-Save and Close it.--The new information will only be displayed for new purchase order created.

Title: Cannot Update Different Addresses While Creating Project Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-You want to select different addresses in the project invoice requests, as the same way in manual invoice requests. While creating a manual invoice request, you you can manually enter the addresses using the Address Details hyperlink. However this is not possible in project invoice requests.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Common Tasks section.-Select New Manual Invoice.-Navigate to the General tab and enter the account.-In the address section click on the Address Details hyperlink.-Here you can update the address manually.-  Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view.-Select the Projects sub view.-Select the relevant project.-Select the New button and choose Manual Project Invoice Request option.-Enter Employee Responsible and navigate to the second step Additional Data.-You can see that the Address Details hyperlink is missing.-Hence you expect a common behavior in both the invoice requests.-Cause-This is the current system behaviour.-Resolution-The feature will be available in a future release of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Cancellation Invoice Posting Created Task in Accounting due to an Error Message: Posting date DD:MM:YYYY of reversal must not be before original posting date DD:MM:YYYY
Content: Symptom-Unsuccessful cancelation invoice posting created a task in the General Ledger work center with an error message: Posting date DD:MM:YYYY (Ex:05.10.2012) of reversal must not be before original posting date DD:MM:YYYY (Ex: 29.11.2012).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Source Documents sub view under Closing Cockpit view .-Select the Task created for the cancelation invoice.-Select the View Business Transaction option from the drop down list of Actions button.-Here you can see the error message: Posting date DD:MM:YYYY of reversal must not be before original posting date DD:MM:YYYY-Cause-The cancellation Supplier invoice is posted on (Ex:05.10.2012) which is before the Goods and service receipt posting date (Ex 29.11.2012).-Resolution-Post the cancellation invoice just with Posting Date after DD:MM:YYYY (Ex: 29.11.2012).

Title: System Shows Wrong Planning Costs in the Report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure
Content: Symptom-You had validated the materials and planned in the project. However planned costs for materials is showing as zero in the report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure under Project Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Select the report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure.-Select the relevant Project.-Drag the key figure Product.-You can see that system lists out few products where planned costs appears as Zero.-Cause-Material cost planning in the report is wrong because the system cannot find a price for this material. This is a brand new system and we could not find any Purchase Orders, Contracts or List Price exist so far in the system--Note: Planned Costs for a material included in a project are calculated based on the following ways;-Material price is taken from a Purchase Order which contains this material & has been raised against this Project Task.-If this project task does NOT have any purchase order raised against it, then the price is taken from any Purchase Order which contains this material.-If no such Purchase Order exists, the price is copied from any Contract which contains this Material. Contracts can be seen in the Sourcing & Contracting work center.-If no such Contract exists, the price is copied from the List Price. This can also be maintained from the Sourcing & Contracting work center.-Resolution-We would suggest you to create a dummy contract from the Sourcing & Contracting work center & maintain the price of all the materials included in this project. Please ensure that the contract starts on/before the Project Start Date. We would not advise trying to maintain a List Price now since prices cannot be maintained from a past date in this. Once this contract is maintained, valuation of this project can be triggered from the Cost & Revenue work center under the Projects View. The planned costs for these materials will be calculated successfully.

Title: Difference Purchase Order Status Between Purchase Requests and Orders and Invoice Entry View
Content: Symptom-The Delivery status of the Purchase Order is displayed as Completely Delivered in the Purchase Requests and Orders work center but in Invoice Entry view of Supplier Invoicing work center it is displayed as Partially Delivered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view. Here the Delivery Status is displayed as Completely Delivered.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Here the Delivery Status of the Purchase Order is displayed as Partially Delivered.-Resolution-Once the delivery(GSR) is Posted, The Delivery Status in the Purchase Requests and Orders work center is displayed as Completely Delivered even though the GSA is only routed for approval (status: In Approval) but in Invoice Entry view of Supplier Invoicing work center, the status change will be updated only when the Delivery (GSA) status is changed to Released.-Keywords

Title: You get an error message in Over-The-Counter Sale transaction "Logistics Area for Location XXX with role Ship From Location has no usage for XYZ sales"
Content: Symptom-After assigning Ship-From location in Over-The-Counter Sale you get an error message Logistics Area for Location XXX with role Ship From Location has no usage for XYZ sales.-Note: XXX represents name of the location-        XYZ represents name of the Logistic Area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sale work center.-Select the New Over The-Counter Sale in Common Tasks.-Assign Employee Responsible, then assign XYZ as Ship-From Location.-Error occurs: Logistics Area for Location XXX with role Ship From Location has no usage for XYZ sales-Note:XXX represents name of the location.-       XYZ represents name of the Logistic Area.-Cause-No child location is identified for the Ship-From Location.-Resolution-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select the Locations view.-Search for the ID XXX (XXX represents name of the location).-Click the Edit Layout button.-Click the Add Child Logistics Ares button-Navigate to the General tab under Details.-Check the checkbox at Inventory-Managed.-A table titled Logistics Use appears at the bottom of the screen.-Click the Add Row button.-Select the Over The Counter Stock option.-Click the Change Status button and select the Activate, in order to activate the Logistic Use.-Save your changes.- Keywords-over the counter, logistics area, ship from location, role, no usage,

Title: Cannot Add the Fields 'Surcharges' and 'Discounts' in form Purchase Order on Item Level
Content: Symptom-You are adapting the standard form for Purchase Order and want to display the surcharges and discounts for the items. In Easy Form Editor, you cannot find the fields. In Adobe LiveCycle Designer, there is no binding available.-Cause-The fields are not part of the current standard solution.-Resolution

Title: Logistics Model Removal Template ID Missing
Content: Symptom-You want to create a new  logistics model Removal but cannot find the template ID INT_1STEP_REMOVAL.-Reproducing the Issue-  Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to Logistics Models view.-Click on the New button.-Expand the combo box from Logistics Model Template ID.-Here you can see that the template INT_1STEP_REMOVAL will not be displayed.- Cause-The template INT_1STEP_REMOVAL is not maintained under the logistic model activity.-Resolution-  Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view and select the project.-Open the activity list.-Go to Integrate and Extend Phase-Search by the activity Logistics Models and open it.-Click on the New button and create the new Logistics Model Template ID INT_1STEP_REMOVAL.- If you cannot find the template INT_1STEP_REMOVAL under the activity, follow the steps bellow to scope it.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view and select the project.-Open the Edit Project Scope.-Go to Scoping Phase.-Expand Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Expand Internal Logistics.-Select Removal scoping element.

Title: Button 'Accept Deviation' Triggers Output During Purchase Order Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You create a new purchase order acknowledgment (POA) for a purchase order (PO). The acknowledged quantity or the delivery schedule differs from the original purchase order.-Upon clicking Accept Deviation, an output to supplier is triggered. You want to avoid such an output.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to the view Purchase Orders.-Choose Show: Purchase Orders not yet (Fully) Acknowledged.-Mark a purchase order and choose New PO Acknowledgment.-Enter a deviation and press Accept Deviation.-You have a confirmation message: Purchase order acknowledgment XYZ created for purchase order XYZ.-Open the purchase order and choose View All.-Go to the tab Output History.-There is a new output: Changed Purchase Order XYZ.-Cause-This is the desired behavior of SAP Business ByDesign. Upon clicking the button Accept Deviation, the system automatically updates the PO with the changes. And at present, as soon as there is a PO change that is saved (via the POA or directly on the PO), an output is triggered.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords

Title: Extension Field not Populated in Extension Scenario "Sales Order - Item to Purchase Request - Item"
Content: Symptom-You added in the Adaptation Mode an extension field to the Sales Order on Item level. And in Further Usage of Extension Field, you then activated the extension scenario "Sales Order - Item to Purchase Request - Item".-The details for the Extension Scenario are:-"Sales Order - Item" to "Customer Demand - Order Line Item"-"Customer Demand - Order Line Item" to "Purchase Request Planning Details - Item"-"Purchase Request Planning Details" - Item to "Purchase Request - Item"-However, when you create a new Sales Order, the field value is correctly passed on to the Customer Demand, but it does not propagate to the Purchase Request Planning Details nor to the Purchase Request.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-At present, the propagation of extension fields is not supported for Planning documents. The Business Objects in the Planning Area are dynamic, therefore, it is not possible to definitely match the Demand with the Supply.-So, even if the Sales Order Material Flow shows the Purchase Request with Pegged Quantity, this cannot be propagated. The pegging relation is dynamic and can be changed if the MRP is re-run.-Note that in the case of Third-party Order Processing, the propagation of the extension field value from the Third-Party Sales Order to the Purchase Request is working as this does not involve Planning.-Resolution-The system is working as designed behavior.-Keywords-Extension Field, Sales Order - Item to Purchase Request - Item

Title: Project Cost and Revenue by Project Report Shows Data Not Assigned to Projects
Content: Symptom-You run the Project Cost and revenue by Project report with a specific selection.-You notice that some row attributes, such as Project, Project task and Project Status display Not Assigned (#) although the respective key figures, like ITD Planned Cost/ Revenue, ITD Incurred Cost and ITD Incurred Cost Variance, are showing some amounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Project Cost and Revenue by Project (ID FINCACU04_Q0003) report, for example from the Business Analytics work center, in the Design Reports view.-From the variable selection enter the mandatory fields, such as Company, Set of Books, Accounting Period/Year.-In the Project Status selection field remove all values or choose # - Not Assigned.-Choose the Attributes which you would like to check, such as Project, Project Task, Project Status, or even Business Transaction, Customer.-Choose the Key Figures of your interest, such as ITD Planned Cost, ITD Planned Revenue, ITD Incurred Cost, Invoiced Revenue.-You notice that some rows display # - Not Assigned for the chosen attributes (such as Project, Project Task, Business Transaction, Sales Order, Customer) in the Key Figures columns,  like ITD Planned Revenue, ITD Incurred Costs.-Cause-Currently, the Project Cost and Revenue by Project report cannot fully generate consistent data when the Project Status selection field is either empty or is maintained as # - Not Assigned. Instead, it shows every transaction available in the involved data sources, such as FINCACB01 (Cost Center - Line Items) or FINPRFU24 (Sales Ledger Line Items). The project will then also show not project related values which possibly can cause a distorted report result.-Resolution-To view data not related to projects use reports based on the data sources FINCACB01 and  FINPRFU24, filtering for the characteristics of your choice (such as G/L Account, Business Transaction, Customer).The Project Cost and Revenue by Project report is not reliable for this purpose.-The Project Cost and Revenue by Project report can currently only be used when selecting an actual Project status (such as 1- In Planning, 5-Started, 3- Released, 3- Stopped, 6- Completed, 4 - Closed).-Keywords-Project Cost and Revenue; not project based data; #; Not Assigned; not project related data; FINCACB01; FINPRFU24; FINCACU04_Q0003-project cost and revenue,not project based data,#,not assigned,fincacb01,not project related data,finprfu24,fincacu04_q0003

Title: How to Enable In-House Production for a Material?
Content: Symptom-How to enable In-House Production for a Material?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To enable the In-House Production for a Material, which should be checked in the Material Overview, the Material should be assigned to a Production Model.--This can be performed as follows:-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select New production Model from Common Tasks.-Complete the Production Model for the respective Product.-This will enable the In-House Production for the Material.-Further Explanation:-For any Material, if the Procurement Type in Planning tab is selected as In-house Production, the Material will be available for Production Model. If a Production Model is created for this Material in the Planning and production Master Data work center, then the checkbox for In-house Production gets selected automatically for this Material.-See Also-KBA 1568583 - A Material is shown as "Purchased" in material view but it is displayed as "In house Production" in tab "Planning" of that material.-Keywords-In House, production model, purchased

Title: Error Message During Upload of List Price Template
Content: Symptom-You receive error message "Changing key fields not permitted; record already exists" when uploading a list price template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Fill in the data in the list price template and upload the file to the system.-Cause-You are using the exact same file previously used to upload (successfully) list price data into the system.-After the Excel template is used to upload data, a few technical fields (columns B, C and D), which are hidden by default, are filled in the Excel file. When this file is saved to your local machine, it is saved with these technical fields filled in. When you reuse this file to upload data, the new modifications made by you are passed to the system's backend alongside these technical details, which triggers the reported error.-Resolution-If you still want to use the same file to upload data, you first have to unhide the above mentioned columns, delete the technical values in the fields and then upload it.-Keywords

Title: Purchase Request is Not Generated from Third Party Sales Order Due to Process Communication Error
Content: Symptom-You have created a third party sales order but while checking the document flow of the corresponding customer demand to find the Purchase Request ID, you received the Process Communication Error that "Purchase request Planning Details Cannot Create a Purchase Request".-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-Select view Sales Orders-Open the third party Sales order-Navigate to document flow-Open the customer demand-> document flow-There is a process communication error-Purchase request Planning Details Cannot Create a Purchase Request-Cause-Issue can be caused due to following error.-Error: Exchange Rate for XXX and YYY (XXX and YYY refer to currencies) for Rate Type does not exist for dd.mm.yyyy (refers to date)-Resolution-Please maintain the corresponding exchange rate and send the case to SAP so that we can reprocess the failing messages from backend.-See Also- 2903725 - Error Message Exchange Rate does not exist while Posting Supplier Invoice -2900774 - Cannot Post Ready for Posting Supplier Invoice, Error Message: Error Occurred While Trying to Evaluate Condition of A Process Step -Keywords- third party purchase request not created, process communication error, Purchase request Planning Details

Title: Employee name is not visible in the list of Direct Approvers of the Supplier Invoice Approval Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:All details combined into one KBA 2344117 - Employee Not Visible in Direct Approver List ,cause they have same cause and solution except the document is different.-You are creating Supplier Invoice Approval Process but employee name is not visible while selecting in the list of Direct Approvers work distribution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Select the Activities & find Supplier Invoice Approvals.-Press View button.-Select the Default approval process for Supplier Invoice.-Once the screen opens press Copy button.-Select the Work Distribution as Direct Approvers and press Edit button.-Employee name ABC is not visible to whom you would like to define Direct Approver.-Cause-Employee is not visible in the list of Direct Approvers because access rights of Supplier Invoicing related to Managing My Area Work Center is not assigned to the employee. with-Resolution-You can assign the access rights of Supplier Invoicing to the employee ABC with following steps.-1. Go to the Application & User Management Work Center.-2. Under the Business Users, select the employee ABC.-3. Press the button Edit & Access Rights.-4. Under the Work Centers and Views Assignment; check the option Supplier Invoicing (MMA_SUPPLIERINVOICING).-5. Save & Close.--After assigning the required access right, employee will be visible in the Direct Approvers of the Supplier Invoice Approval Process.

Title: Dump Occurs When Releasing the Production Model for Planning and Execution
Content: Symptom-When checking the consistency of the production model it shows the model is consistent but when you try to release the production model for Planning and Execution it throws a dump message.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Models view.-Select the Production Model ID  and choose the Edit button.-Select the Check Consistency button, the system shows the production model is consistent.-Now select the Run Planning button and choose the option For Planning and Execution from it.-The system displays the dump message.-Cause-The Unit of Measure for the input product ID of the Production BoM is different from the Unit of Measure maintained in the Planning tab for the product, hence when you release the production model for execution it throws the error.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps in order to resolve the error:-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center. -Select the Production Bills of Material view.-Search for the Bill of Materials ID and select Edit button.-In the opened window, go to the Input Products tab, select the corresponding line item and uncheck the Variants check boxes for that input product ID.-Add a new line item for the same input product and maintain correct Unit of Measure for it. You have to create a new Engineering Change Order for this Input Product or you can an existing In Process ECO.-Choose Save button.-Select the line item and choose on ECO button and then select Complete action. Now assign this new line item to variants of the BoM.-Check the consistency of the BoM and select Save button.-After performing the above steps you will be able to release the Production Model without any issues.

Title: Approval Workflow Missing in tab Approval for Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You want to check who has approved a purchase order. You open the tab Approval and there is no information.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Find the relevant purchase order and choose Edit.-Go to the tab Approval.-There is the message: No records found.-Cause-You have changed the approval process for purchase orders after ordering the particular purchase order. You have now configured multiple process steps in the Business Configuration. As the new process differs a lot from the old one, the information about the approval cannot be displayed anymore.-Resolution-You can check who approved the purchase order with these steps:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Find the relevant purchase order and choose Edit.-Go to the Changes tab.-Choose Attribute = Status and then click Go.-You can see the time of approval and the approver.

Title: Product Count is not Allowing to Report Inventory Found in a New Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-The inventory of a product is available in logistics area ABC. When doing product count for this product, you found that it is also available in another logistics area XYZ. But system is not allowing to report inventory found in logistics area XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Select All Count Tasks by Selection from Show drop-down and select Advanced link.-Enter product count document ID in the PI Count Document ID field and choose Go button.-Select the searched task and choose on Confirm button.-In the confirm count task screen, it is only showing entry for logistics area ABC. Also, Add Row button is disabled, so it is not possible to report inventory found in logistics area XYZ.-Cause-There are three possible ways to report physical inventory, (available under Physical Inventory work center):-1. Logistics Area Count-2. Inventory Adjustment-3. Product Count-However, in product count reporting new inventory is not possible. The reason for this is that there is a chance that another employee is supposed to count this material also in a different count document.-Resolution-Reporting new inventory (i.e. inventory with book quantity equal to zero) is possible in Logistics Area Count and Inventory Adjustment. So if you want to report inventory found in a new logistics area, use Logistics Area Count or Inventory Adjustment method.

Title: Error Message: Inventory in Logistics Area not Available
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm a Logistics Task (for example a Pick Task) and when you enter the relevant Source Logistics Area ID, the system is showing the error message: Inventory in Logistics Area not Available. However, when you check the Stock Overview, it is showing enough On-Hand Quantity in the respective Logistics Area for the requested Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant Pick Task.-Choose the Confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen, enter the Actual Quantity.-Then enter the relevant Source Logistics Area ID and choose Save button. The system displays the error message: Inventory in Logistics Area not Available.-Now go to Common Tasks and select Stock Overview. -Check the stock of the requested Product in the relevant Logistics Area, you can see the system is showing enough On-Hand Quantity.-Cause-The Stock of the requested Product in the relevant Logistics Area has already been allocated to some other Warehouse Request. That is the reason the system is not able to find any stock when you try to confirm the Task. To check the Allocation of the Stock, please use the Projected Material Flow link. Please follow the below steps to do same:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Projected Material Flow link under Common Tasks.-Enter the relevant Site and Product IDs.-Choose the Go button.-Here you can see On-Hand Stock and Allocated Stock.-Available Stock is equal to On-Hand Stock minus Allocated Stock. Since in this case, On-Hand Stock and Allocated Stock are equal, Available Stock is zero.-Further you can also check the Document ID column to see the Warehouse Request ID the stock is allocated to.--Resolution-If you want to use the relevant Product in the current Task, then you need to cancel the Allocation. Please proceed as follows:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Select All Warehouse Tasks by Selection from the Show drop down and open the Advance search.-In the Request ID field, enter the Warehouse Request ID, to which the stock is allocated.-Choose Go button.-Select the relevant Task and choose the Confirm button.-Select the line item of the requested Product ID and click the 'Cancel Allocation' button.-If you do not want to confirm this particular Task, please ensure to enter zero quantity as Actual Quantity for all the other Line Items before saving your changes. Otherwise, the system will confirm the quantities for these other Line Items.-Finally, choose the Save button. This will cancel the allocation, and you will be able to confirm the current Task.-Please note: The scenario in this article also applies to Inbound as well as Internal Logisitics Tasks. It is not limited to Outbound Logisitics Task. The Outbound Logistics Pick Task is only exemplary.-See Also-KBA 2586600 -Error message: "Inventory in logistics area not available"-Attached Word document for reference.-Keywords-Allocated, Stock, Replenish, Warehouse, Request, Cancel Allocation

Title: Unable to Do Adjustment Confirmation for Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You want to do the Adjustment Confirmation for an outbound delivery ID. But when you select the Enable Entry button in the corresponding warehouse order, the quantity field is not enabled and you are unable to proceed further.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Monitoring -> By Warehouse Order view.-Search for the Warehouse Order ID and select Edit button.-In the opened window, choose Adjustment Confirmation button.-Under the Line Items tabs, select the line and select Enable Entry button.-You could see that the Quantity Difference column is not enabled.-Cause-During the outbound delivery process, you used serial numbers for confirming the quantity. So you cannot enter the quantity difference manually. That is why the field is not enabled.-Resolution-To do the Adjustment Confirmation for the warehouse order ID, kindly follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Click By Warehouse Order view.-Search for the relevant Warehouse Order.-Edit the Warehouse Order.-In the opened window, select Adjustment Confirmation button.-Select the Enable Entry button for the line item.-Go to the Serial Numbers tab.-Remove the serial number.-You can see that in the Quantity difference column, the quantity with minus value has been entered automatically.-Later perform Save.-Note: The registered product which has been created for this outbound delivery will be still visible in the Registered products view in Service Entitlements work center. You can decide upon whether you need the registered product or you can change the status of the registered product accordingly.--Keywords-Adjustment Confirmation; Serial Number; Warehouse Order

Title: Need a Button Which Auto Proposes the Quantity Value & Source Logistics Area ID
Content: Symptom-When confirming the supply task you want the system to propose the quantities and the source logistics area for the line items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Select a task ID of type Supply and select the Confirm button.-In the opened window, there is no button on the screen which suggests the quantities & logistics area for the line items.-Resolution-In the task confirmation screen, if you use the Confirm as Planned button then system automatically proposes the quantity values for the line items. But, in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign system, it is not be possible to have a button which auto proposes the source logistics area ID.-Keywords-source loa proposal in supply task

Title: Contracts are not Available to be Selected in the New Service Request
Content: Symptom-Contracts are not available to be selected in the New Service Request.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Select New Service Request under Common Tasks.-Add the account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service request).-Add other mandatory details like Sales Unit.-Select the View All button and go to the General tab -> More Information subtab.-No data available in the Value Help for the field Reference Contract Item.-However you have already created contracts for the account ABC:-Go to the Service Entitlement work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Select the Contracts subview.-Search for the contracts created for the account ABC.-You can find contracts are already available.-Cause-In the Service Request the system proposes items only from those Contracts that have entitled product items.--Please go through the Help Document: Determine Contracts in a Service Request for more details on determination of contracts in a service request.-Resolution-Go to the Service Entitlement work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Select the Contracts subview.-Create a new contract XYZ for the account ABC and add an Entitled product in it (XYZ represents the ID of the contract).-Save the contract.-Now the contract will be available for selection in the service request created for the account ABC.

Title: Inbound Delivery Missing in Document Flow of Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have completed the receipt of an Inbound Delivery XXX (XXX represents the Inbound Delivery ID). However, when you check the Purchase Order YYY (YYY represents the Purchase Order ID), it still shows an In Process status.  In addition, the Inbound Delivery  is not visible in the Document Flow of the related Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order YYY-Open the Purchase Order.-Select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Inbound Delivery XXX is missing.-Cause-There are two possible reasons for the Inbound Delivery not being assigned to a Purchase Order:-Case 1:--The Inbound Delivery XXX is not in status Released. It appears in the Document Flow of the Purchase Order YYY if it is Released.-Case 2:--The Inbound Delivery Notification related to the Inbound Delivery XXX has a zero Quantity. This means, the Notification has been created, although no goods have been received yet.-Since no actual goods is being received, Inbound Delivery XXX does not get updated in Purchase Order YYY.-Resolution- To complete the scenario without receiving any quantity, perform undo-release of the respective Inbound Delivery.- Then cancel the Inbound Delivery Notification against it.- Once it is done, cancel the PO via option Cancel Purchase Order, only if you do not wish to receive any quantity against it. - It cancels the PO and no open quantity exists.-Note :The Inbound Delivery XXX is shown only in the Purchase Order Document Flow, once the Inbound Delivery is released with a Quantity different than zero.-Keywords-Purchase, Order, ID, Inbound, Supplier, Delivery, Bestellung, Belegfluss, Anlieferung,  no document flow, delivery

Title: Extension Fields Are Not Visible When Previewing the Released Execution Model
Content: Symptom-You have added an extension field in the Production Bills of Material screen and selected the respective extension scenario for the Released Execution Model, but when you previewing Released Execution Model, the pdf does not display the extension fields.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Bills of Material view and edit a BoM ID, a window opens.-Select Adapt button and choose the option Enter Adaptation Mode.-Select the Adapt button again and choose the option Edit Screen from it.-Choose the Extension Fields button and select the Further Usage link.-Go to the Extension Scenario tab, you could see that you have selected the extension scenario Production Bill of Material - Line Item Change Details to Released Execution Model (REM) - Input Product.-Now, select the Production Models view and select the respective production model ID.-Open the Released Execution Model for the production model.-In the opened window, select the Preview button, it does not show the extension field added in the production BoM in the preview pdf.-Resolution-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign system, it is not possible to display the extension fields in the preview of released execution model.

Title: System allows to Use the Same Serialized label More than Once During Warehouse Execution
Content: Symptom-You have completed the outbound logistics process for a product ID using serial numbers, (a registered product has been created for product in the system already) and have created the outbound delivery for it.  Now, while confirming another warehouse task for the same product ID with the same serial number, the system allows to confirm the execution without any issues.--You do not want the system to take the same serial number and do the confirmation for the product which has been shipped already and you want to know how to avoid this.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Select the relevant task ID and choose the Confirm button.-In the opened window, go to the Serial Numbers tab.-In the Next Serial Number field, enter the serial number ID for example say SN_001 and select Enter button.-The system updates one quantity value under the Actual Quantity column.-Choose Save button and close the window.-Now, open another warehouse task ID for the same product and perform the steps as above.-Use the same serial number for confirmation, you could see that system adds the quantity value without any issues.-Cause-Only the Serial Number Profile Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes ensures the uniqueness of the Serial Number for a product in the inventory. If you have selected other Serial Number Profile, the system will allow you to enter the same Serial Number more than once.-Resolution-It is possible to use the same serial number for the outbound process,In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign other than Serial Number profile "Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes".-Keywords-System allows to Use the Same Serialized label More than Once During Warehouse Execution, system to take the same serial number and do the confirmation for the product which has been shipped already and you want to know how to avoid this.-same serial number used,serial number

Title: Travel OnDemand - Optical Character Recognition (OCR) Provided by OpenText Not Available on Productive System
Content: Symptom-Since Wave 4 SAP Travel OnDemand supports integration with a central receipt scanning service to import scanned documents and attach them to expense reports thereby simplifying and automating the process of creating expense reports. The service is actually provided by third-party Optical Character Recognition (OCR) web services from OpenText.-Due to technical reasons, the interface for OCR via the partner solution cannot be provided to you for productive usage at the moment. SAP will inform you as soon as the service is available on your productive system.-Resolution-The interface will be provided again as soon as possible.-See Also-See also SAP Travel OnDemand Integration Guide 1.03: Chapter 10 Integrating SAP Travel OnDemand with Smart Receipt Recognition Services.

Title: Alternative Approver for Purchase Orders does not Receive Approval Tasks
Content: Symptom-The alternative approver for the purchase orders does not receive the approval tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To verify the Defined Work Assignment for Employee Work Distribution, you can navigate that way:-Go to the work center Organizational Management.-Go to the view Work Distribution.-Go to the sub-view Employee Work Distribution.-Expand the section Business Area: Purchasing.-Mark the Work Category Alternative Approver for Purchase Orders.-Verify that the user is responsible for the approval of purchase orders.-Cause-You have activated the new activity Purchase Order Approvals in the work center Business Configuration.-Resolution-This Purchase order approvals being scoped enables the multi-steps approvals functionality for the purchase orders. Hence system makes the employee work distribution rule for purchase orders as obsolete.-so-Please go through the below SCN blogs, to see if there is work distribution that helps to suit your requirement.-https://blogs.sap.com/2018/12/23/overview-of-approval-process-for-shopping-carts-and-purchase-orders-in-sap-business-bydesign/-https://blogs.sap.com/2018/12/27/overview-of-approval-process-for-goods-and-service-receipts-and-supplier-invoice-in-sap-business-bydesign/-If non matches then-1.You can descope the Approval for Purchase orders and then Alternative approvers will get task.- or-2. Ask your partner to develop custom approvals that can make use of alternative approvers.-See Also-3213917 - Alternative Approver for Supplier invoice does not Receive Approval Tasks-Keywords-Alternative Approver for Purchase Orders not working; Alternative approver

Title: Unable to do Time Recording due to Error Message: Project task XYZ-1 of the external company A1 is not possible
Content: Symptom-You are unable to record time for a service performed on a project XYZ  because of an error message: Project task XYZ-1 of the external company A1 is not possible .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select  Self Services Overview  view.-Select Edit Time Sheet under Time header.-Cause-There are two companies set up in work center Organizational Management: A1 and A2.-An employee of Company A2 is the responsible person for project task XYZ and the responsible person for project task ABC is employee of company A1.-By default only internal employee of Company A1 is allowed to record time on this task.-You belong to Company A2 , So system displays the error message that you cannot record times for the external project .-Resolution-To overcome this error message, the employee who want to record the times has to be a service agent of company A1.-The service agent should be assigned to the company A1.-Then system allows the employee to record the times for the project task assigned to company A1.-Go to Business partners data work center-Go to Business partners-Search for employee-Click on create as an choose Service agent and enter all details-and save-Keywords-Unable to do time confirmation

Title: Tax Rate Type Defaults to Zero in Purchase Order Although Taxes are Expected for the Transaction
Content: Symptom-You create a Purchase Order and the Tax Rate defaults to 0% even though there should be no tax exemption reason. You checked the master data for the Product, the Product Category and the Supplier and there are no exemption reasons maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Mark the relevant purchase order and choose Edit.-Go to the tab Items and then sub-tab Taxes.-Tax Rate Type is Zero.-Cause-There is a Tax Exemption Reason defined on the Ship-To Account party role for your company.-Resolution-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partner view.-Find the relevant Business Partner (Ship-To party) and mark it.-At the bottom, under Business Partner Roles, you will notice the Account role.-Click on the link and choose View All.-Go to the tab Financial Data and sub-tab Tax Data.-Under Tax Exemptions, check for an exemption reason and maintain it if required.-Keywords-vat,domestic

Title: No Fixed Asset Created After Posting Goods Receipt. Message: Fixed asset does not exist
Content: Symptom-A Purchase Order is created with assigned individual materials. Upon posting the goods and services receipt, it is expected a fixed asset to be generated. However no fixed assets are created, and the following message is displayed: Fixed asset does not exist.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Goods and Services Receipts.-Go to the view Receipts and Returns.-Open the goods receipt.-Go to the tab Items and then the sub-tab Basic Data.-For the field Belongs to Fixed Asset, there is only a message: Fixed asset does not exist.-Cause-The system could not determine an Asset Class from the combination Item Product Category and Buying Company on Purchase Order. The setting is missing in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the view Overview.-Find the Fine-Tuning Activity Fixed Asset Classes.-Choose Change Immediately.-Select Asset Class Determination.-Choose Add Row.-Enter the Company ID as per the Buying Company on the purchase order.-Enter a Product Category ID as per the one on the purchase order item.-Choose Save and Close.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, does not exist-creation,imat

Title: Sales Quote has not Triggered the Approval Procedure
Content: Symptom-You have set the threshold for Sales Quote as Max Net Value w/o Freight XXX (XXX represents Value of the threshold) in the Business Configuration Work Center.-Once you create a Sales Quote XYZ(XYZ represents ID of the Sales Quote), Values of the Sales Quote already exceeds XXX, it means this Sales Quote XYZ should trigger Approval procedure, but it does not.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business Work Center.-Navigate to the Sales Quotes view.-Show All Quotes and Find XYZ (XYZ represents name of the sales quote).-Select the Go button and Edit the sales quote XYZ.-You can see the Approval Status:Approval not Necessary though the values of Sales Quote XYZ exceeds XXX setting at the Business Configuration work center.-Cause-You have set the Max Net Value w/o Freight XXX in the Business Configuration work center, it means the Threshold Value is only effective for the sales quote with Net Value as it's strategy.-For the sales quote XYZ, strategy is Gross. Therefore, the sales quote XYZ with gross values as strategy will not go through the approval procedure as expected.-Note: You could choose Personalize ->This Screen -> Select the View All button -> select General tab then add the Price In field -> Save and come out of the Personalization mode -> strategy of Sales Quote will appear on user interface as:Net or Gross.-Resolution-You can choose Net as strategy on the sales quote XYZ then the Threshold Values will be effective for it:-Go to the New Business Work Center.-Go to the Sales Quotes View.-Show All Quotes and Find XYZ (XYZ represents name of the sales quote).-Select the Go button and Edit the sales quote XYZ.-Go to the General tab.-Make the Price In field visible via Personalization.-Choose the Net for the Price In field.-Save the sales quote XYZ.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Approval Procedure, Threshold, Strategy

Title: Cannot Select Evaluated Receipt Settlement for Purchase Order Item. Error: You cannot change the data in Evaluated Receipt Settlement
Content: Symptom-The Evaluated Receipt Settlement checkbox cannot be selected for a purchase order item.-Error "Cannot change the data in Evaluated Receipt Settlement. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report a case." is displayed, even though Evaluated Receipt Settlement is enabled in the supplier master data under the Purchasing tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Common tasks New Purchase Order.-Fill the details.-Go to Basic Data sub-tab under Items Tab.-In the section Settings, check the checkbox Evaluated Receipt Settlement.- Error: You cannot change the data in Evaluated Receipt Settlement. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case.-Cause-The scoping for Evaluated Receipt Settlement is not enabled in the Business configuration work center.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select Show: All Open Projects.-Select the relevant project and choose Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Step 4: Questions.-Expand Purchasing and then Supplier Invoicing.-Mark the Scoping Element Automatic Settlements.-Answer Yes to the question: "Do you create invoices automatically on behalf of your supplier by using evaluated receipt settlements?"-Keywords-You cannot change the data in Evaluated Receipt Settlement. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case; Evaluated Receipt Settlement; Purchase Order

Title: You Get an Error Message While Releasing the Customer Demand: "Request for complete delivery not valid for all ordered products"
Content: Symptom-An error message is faced while releasing the Customer Demand:-"Request for Complete delivery not valid for all ordered Products."-It cannot release the Customer Demand due to this error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistic Control work center.-Go to the Customer Demand view.-Find the customer demand XYZ (XYZ represents ID of the Customer Demand) then choose Release button.-Error message above is faced.-Cause-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-The Complete Delivery indicator has been selected in the sales order, this means when it is being requested to deliver all items together from the ship-from location. So if the requested date is same for all items then all those are assigned to same delivery group and this information is sent to supply chain management to perform the ATP check accordingly.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Find the sales order DEF (DEF represents the ID of the sales orders for which customer demand XYZ is created)-Edit the sales order and choose the View All button.-Revoke the checkbox of Complete Delivery in General tab.-Save the sales order.- Now release the Customer Demand in Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Products, Complete Delivery, ATP, Delivery Group.

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice for Fixed Asset Procurement Due to Technical Error
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice for fixed asset procurement due to a technical error  /SRMAP/LSIV_SIV 393. As well if you select the button Actions -> Simulate Journal Entries, you get an exception screen or the system hangs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Mark the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Choose Check.-You get the error:  A technical error occurred: /SRMAP/LSIV_SIV 393. Report an case.-Cause-A possible reason is that for the asset class, valuation views for the relevant company are missing.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Show: All Open Projects.-Select the relevant project and choose Open Activity List.-Go to the tab Fine-Tune.-Choose the activity Fixed Asset Classes and choose Open.-Mark the relevant Asset Class.-In the tab Default Valuation Settings, choose Add Row.-Enter the missing valuation views and choose Save and Close.-Keywords

Title: Purchase Order Not Visible in the Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work Center
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales order to be fulfilled from external source of supply and have ordered it. Now, when you go to the Third-Party Purchase Orders view, you are not able to see the purchase order relevant to the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Under the Common Tasks view, select the link New Sales Order.-Create a sales order and order it.-Now, go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center.-Select the Third-Party Purchase Orders view and search for the purchase order ID by using the reference sales order ID.-The system does not display any results.-Cause-As you have not created any purchase order from the purchase request in the Purchase Requests and Orders work center, the third-party purchase order is not visible in the Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center.-Resolution-You have to create a Purchase Order from the purchase request ID in the Purchase Requests and Orders work center. Once you create the purchase order you will be able to see the Third-Party purchase order accordingly.-Please note that it is possible to define automatic creation of purchase order. You can do this from Common Task-Define Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders, available under Purchase Requests and Orders work center. If you define this, then system automatically creates purchase order based on the purchase request.

Title: How to Default Exemption Tax Code in Purchase Order for Free-text Item per Product Category
Content: Symptom-You create a purchase order for free-text items with a product category assigned. You want to make that product category exempt of taxes. However you cannot find a way to configure it in the system and you have to change the tax code manually for all items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose the activity New Purchase Order.-Enter a free-text item with desired Product Category ID.-Change the Tax Code field to the desired value manually.-Cause-Only if you order products with a master data (Material ID or Service ID), the tax code is determined based on the definition maintained there.-Resolution-In the case of free-text items, we suggest to maintain a tax exemption per country and product category.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose the activity Set Tax Classifications.-Select the relevant Product Category, Tax Rate Type, Tax Exemption Reason and Country.-Choose Save and Activate.-Keywords-standard,freetext,resale,exempted,non-taxable,taxable,sales,excluded

Title: Is it Possible to Export Material Parameters to Excel?
Content: Symptom-You would like to know, whether it is possible to export the Material Parameters into Microsoft Excel such as Planning Data, UoM Characteristics and so on.-Resolution-1. Is it possible to export Material Planning Data?-It is not possible to export Material Planning Data in the current release of Business ByDesign. This feature was provided as new requirement for future releases.-2. Is it possible to export the the Material ID, Description, Product Category ID, Product Category Description and Base UoM?--The steps are,--1. Go to Product Data work center.-2. Select Materials view.-3. Select All Materials or the specific materials.-4. Select Export button and choose To Microsoft Excel®.--Note: if you want add or remove a column, please use personalize to add the column.-3. Is it possible to export UoM Characteristics of list of Materials such as Height, Weight and Length?-It is not possible to export UoM Characteristicsin the current release of Business ByDesign. This feature was provided as new requirement for future releases.

Title: Material Cost Estimate does not Contain Input Products as in the Associated Bill of Material
Content: Symptom-You create a new Material Cost Estimate for material XYZ that also represents a Production Bill of Material (BoM).-When you execute or simulate the Cost Estimate, it does not contain all input items that are contained in the latest version of the BoM for material XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Material Cost Estimates view.-Create a new Cost Estimate via the button New and specify parameters accordingly.-Choose Estimate or Simulate in order to execute the Cost Estimate.-Expand the relevant nodes of the Costed Object list.-You are comparing the input items with the latest Production BoM.-Go to Planning and Production Master Data.-Navigate to view Production Bills of Material.-Choose the BoM ID which represents material XYZ.-Choose Edit to see the input items in tab Input Products.-You notice that one input product available in the Production Bill of Material is missing in the calculated material cost estimate.-Cause-The version of the applied Released Execution Model variant for the Material Cost Estimate does not contain the missing input product for material XYZ before releasing the Production Model and therefore was not effective at the time of the Material Cost Estimate.-The General Tab of the relevant Cost Estimate indicates the Version of the Released Execution Model variant ABC. You can access the Released Execution Model variant by following the hyper-link and expand the corresponding Make Operations, Produce Activities and the associated Input Products. Alternatively you can navigate to Work Center Planning and Production Master Data / Production Bills of Material / Production Models and edit the applied Production Model ID and access the Open Released Execution Models for ABC for the Bill of Operation (BoO) via the named button. Here you can see released versions and expand their Operations, Activities and their Input Products.-Resolution-The Material Cost Estimate has to be performed for a Released Execution Model version which contains the expected input products. Make sure that the input materials are checked for the relevant variant in the named columns of the Production BoM for material XYZ.-Keywords-Material Cost EStimate, Bill of Material, Production Model, Missing Input Product.

Title: Error Message: Specify Sample Size, Occurs When Doing Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-When you are performing the Post Goods Receipt for a purchase order ID, the system throws the error message :-Specify Sample Size-and you are not able to complete the receipt for that purchase order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Select a purchase order ID and choose Post Goods Receipt button.-Enter the quantity value under the Actual Quantity column and select Enter button.-The system throws error message.-Cause-As you have not defined the Sampling Size for the company specific sampling scheme, the system resulted in error message when confirming the task.-Resolution-When the Actual quantity of the product is more than 90 quantity and if the product has an Inspection associated to it, in this case you have to define the sampling size in the Acceptance sampling fine tune activity.-Kindly maintain the code letters F/G for the lot size more than 90 for the company specific sampling scheme using the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button and go to the Fine Tune chevron.-Search for the activity Acceptance Sampling and select the Edit button.-In the opened window, select the company specific sampling scheme.-Under Details section go to the tab Normal and maintain the code letter value and sample size there.-Then save it.

Title: Purchase Order Aprroval task unassigned after changing approval process
Content: Symptom-You changed the Purchase Order approval process. Still the approval task is not sent out to the employee responsible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The new approval process is only valid for newly created purchase orders.-Resolution-You can trigger the workflow process once more for the already existing purchase order in approval:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Go to the Business Task Management sub-view.-Mark the relevant approval task for the previously created purchase order.-Choose Determine Assignment.-Keywords

Title: How to Remove Down Payment Request from Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You create a new supplier invoice and it automatically references down payment requests for the supplier. You cannot find a way to remove these references if they are not relevant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Mark the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Under the section Reference Documents, you find the references to the down payment requests.-These references are read-only and you cannot suppress them.-Cause-This is the desired behavior. These references are automatically fetched in order to avoid a manual mistake where down payments are omitted. However these references can still be manually removed.-Resolution-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Mark the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Select View All in the top right corner.-In the tab General, go to the sub-tab Payment Information, then go to the sub-tab Down Payments.-Mark the relevant down payment and chose Remove.-Keywords

Title: User is Directly Responsible for a Account but he/she Cannot see any account in 'Accounts' View of the 'Account Management' work Center
Content: Symptom-User is directly responsible for an account but he/she Cannot see any account in Accounts view of the Account Management work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue:-Log in to the SAP Business ByDesign system with user ABC (ABC represents the ID of the user).-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and choose the Go button.-No account is shown for the query.-Follow the steps below to check responsibility of the user in one of the account:-Log in to the SAP Business ByDesign system with user ABC.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the account).-Select the Go button.-Edit the account XYZ and go to the tab Contacts.-Select the Relationships and Responsibilities subtab.-You can see that the user ABC is directly assigned to the account XYZ.-Cause-The user is directly responsible for the account XYZ, but he/she has no Read/Write access for his/her employee ID.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view.-Go to the Business Users subview.-Show All Business Users and Find ABC.-Select the user ABC and choose Edit -> Access Rights button.-At top you can observe the employee ID of the user is XXX (XXX represents the employee ID of the user XXX).-Go to the Access Restriction tab.-Select the work center view ID BPM_Accounts.-Below under access restriction the employee ID XXX is maintained under the org unit DEF (DEF represents the ID of the org unit where employee ID XXX belongs to).-Here the employee ID XXX does not have Read/Write access due to which he/she cannot see any account in the query.-Assign Read/Write access to the employee ID XXX.-Now the user ABC can see the account XYZ for the All Accounts query of the Accounts view.-Keywords-Accounts, Contacts, Account Management

Title: How Purchase Orders are Created Automatically
Content: Symptom-After receiving demand for a product you have run the MRP(Material Requirement Planning) for it. The system has created purchase proposals and you have released the proposal to generate the purchase request.-Now, when you again open the product planning details screen and check for the purchase request ID, you could see that the system has created purchase order for it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Products view.-Select the product ID and choose Open button.-You could see that the system has created Purchase Orders IDs.-Cause-In the Purchase Requests and Orders work center, under Common Tasks as you have defined the option Automatic Creation of Purchase Orders for all the product categories, the system has created the purchase orders automatically after receiving the purchase request in the work center.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-See Also-Keywords- MRP, Purchase Orders, Purchase Proposals, Purchase Request

Title: Supplier Invoice Fetches Goods and Services Receipts with Service Period Later than Invoice Date
Content: Symptom-You create a supplier invoice for a service item with a particular Invoice Date. You notice that the invoice contains references to Goods Receipts with a service period later than the Invoice Date. You only want to invoice goods and services confirmations up to the invoice date.
