You expect the system to only fetch the Goods Receipts with a service period up to the Invoice Date.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-In the General tab, under the section General Information, you can find the Invoice Date.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can find the referenced Services Receipt IDs.-Open a particular Receipt from there.-Go to the Items tab and then the Delivery sub-tab.-Under the section Service Period, you notice that the Period is later than the Invoice Date.-Cause-This is the desired behavior. The invoice will fetch all the valid goods receipts corresponding to the service item in order to match the invoice quantity. This is regardless of the service period for the Goods Receipts.-You can remove manually a Goods Receipt (see below). However it could lead to an exception of quantity variance between the invoiced quantity and the delivered quantity. Afterward the exception for quantity variance could be accepted and approved.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Go to the Items tab and then the Cost Distribution sub-tab.-Under Cost Distribution Details, you can adjust a quantity to 0 for a particular goods receipt.-Choose Save.-Go to the Document Flow tab and choose Refresh.-You notice that the Goods Receipt is gone.-To accept a possible exception of missing goods receipt, proceed as follows:-Go to the tab Exceptions.-Mark the exception of type Quantity Variance.-Choose Accept.-

Content: EXTRACT_ERROR

Title: Contract ID Missing in Report Purchase Order History
Content: Symptom-In the report Purchase Order History, you notice that the Contract ID is missing. However a purchasing contract has been defined for the relevant supplier.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the view Reports -> List.-Find the report Purchase Order History and choose View With and then Web Browser.-Add the characteristic Contract ID to the report.-Choose Go.-Contract ID is empty (#).-Cause-The Contract ID field will be shown in the Purchase Order History report only if it is assigned to the purchase order. You can open the purchase order from the report. Then for an item, you can check the sub-tab Source of Supply. There you can verify that no contract ID was assigned at the time the order was placed.-Resolution

Title: Planned Revenues Missing in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Report
Content: Symptom-In the report  Project Cost and Revenue by Project (Report ID: FINCACU04_Q0003) you are missing the planned project revenues of your project, even though you have maintained planned revenues for several project tasks.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Project Management workcenter choose the Projects view and open the project plan via Edit - Project Plan.-In the project plan select a project task and then navigate to the Revenues tab. Here you have maintained an account determination group under Income Group and a planned revenue for this task.-Now navigate back to the Project Management workcenter and open the Reports view.-Open the Project Cost and Revenue by Project report and select the project you have maintained planned revenues for.-In the Total Planned Revenue column there is no value displayed for your project task.- Cause-The account determination group maintained under Income Group that is maintained for the planned revenue in the project task is not assigned to any G/L Account in Fine Tuning.- Resolution-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Fine Tuning activity Chart Of Accounts, Financial Reporting structures,Account determination, either from the Overview view or from the Implementation Projects view.-Go to Account Determination  and choose the Sales link-Select the Account determination profile and then go to the Other Income tab.  -Here maintain your account determination group for Other income and assign a G/L account respectively.-Refresh the project plan once(by making a dummy change and saving it once more).-The report should now display the planned revenues.

Title: No navigation targets available from Confirmation Journal report
Content: Symptom- The Confirmation Journal report provides the characteristics Original Document ID, Reference Document ID and Conf.ID.- You notice that the navigation targets for above characteristics are not always available. For example, you try to find the navigation target for a particular Original Document ID by clicking on the triangular next to the ID but the message No navigation targets available is displayed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work Center Physical Inventory-Go the View Reports > Lists-Find the Confirmation Journal report and open it-In the report display the characteristics Original Document ID, Reference Document ID and Conf.ID-Try to navigate to any of the documents by clicking on the triangular next to the ID-You might receive the message No navigation targets available.-Cause-The Confirmation Journal report navigation always works in accordance to the Document type available in the previous column of the reporting.-For example, you might have the Reference Document type followed by the Reference Document ID in the Rows section and thus when clicking on the Ref Doc ID in the reporting Display Reference Document Details is displayed which navigates to the document itself. But if the Document Type is missing before the actual document ID then the message No navigation targets available is displayed under the document ID.-Resolution-In order to be able to navigate to a document ID make sure you have the characteristic document type displayed just before the document ID. For example, you need to display-Original Document Type previous to Original Document ID-Reference Document Type previous to Reference Document ID-Conf.Document Type previous to Conf.ID-

Title: Creating a New Sales Order, the Only Payment Method Options Available in the Drop-Down are Credit Card and Direct Debit
Content: Symptom-Creating a new sales order, the only payment methods available in the drop-down list are Credit Card and Direct Debit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Account view.-In the Find field enter ABC (where ABC represents the account name).-Select Account ABC and click on the Edit->Financial Data option.-Select sub tab Payment Data and go to the section Payment Methods. You can see the Payment Method other than Credit Card (for e.g :Check ,Bank Transfer) are also maintained.-Go to the Sales Order work center .-From the Common Task create New Sales Order .-In New Sales Order screen enter the Account ABC and click on the View All button.-In the General tab go to the section Payment.-For the field Payment Method, click on the drop-down option.-You can see the only Payment Methods listed are Credit Card and Direct Debit.-Cause-In Sales Orders only Credit Card and Direct Debit are supported payment methods.-  Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-See Also-KBA 2624381 - Payment Method Direct Debit Not Available in Sales Orders-KBA 2494505 - Payment Method not displaying in the Sales Orders.-KBA 2666325 - Payment Method Direct Debit not showing in Sales Orders.-Keywords-Payment Method; Sales Order; Credit Card; Direct Debit; Bill of Exchange; Bank Transfer; Check;

Title: Purchase Orders Missing in Report "Purchase Orders per Account Assignment"
Content: Symptom-When executing report Purchase Orders per Account Assignment, some purchase orders are missing in the results list even though no filters maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Reports -> List view.-Open report Purchase Orders per Account Assignment.-Execute.-In the results list, some Purchase Orders are missing.-Cause-The purchase orders are for To-Stock items. -In To-Stock procurement scenario, no account assignment is done to a cost center or any other cost object like sales order, project, etc... In such a case, the postings happen to the G/L accounts according to the account determination group maintained for the corresponding material and supplier. The costs are not explicitly incurred against any cost object and hence one does not see the cost object ID in the Journal Entry. The postings happen to the inventory account of the business residence where the material is going to be stocked.-Hence the purchase orders for To-Stock items are excluded from the report. -Resolution-Expected behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Orders per Account Assignment; Purchase Order; Report Data Missing

Title: How to Setup FIFO Rule for Identified Stock Consumption in Production Task
Content: Symptom-You are using identified stock in production. You want to consume identified stock based on FIFO rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Material Flow rule is not applicable in the make task. Consumption of goods in make task happens based on the Fixed Supply Area and Fixed Output Area of the logistics area, which is assigned to main production resource. So in general it is not possible to configure FIFO rule in make task.-Resolution-However if you use Supply to Production process, then you can configure FIFO rule in production process, because source logistics area determination in supply task supports the material flow rule that are maintained at the site. So supply task will pick the identified stock from the source logistics areas based on FIFO rule. Then the target logistics area of the supply task will be the source logistics area (Fixed Supply Area) for the make task. This means that if FIFO rule is configured at site level for a supply task, this will be automatically propagated to the make task as well.-To maintain FIFO rule for the site follow the below steps.-Navigate to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select the view Locations.-Select the relevant Site/Location and choose the Edit Layout button.-Choose the tab Material Flow and select the radio button Advanced Rule.-Under the sub-tab Source, Enter, Sequence ID and choose Logistics Area Use as Storage.-Under the header Details choose the button Add Row, enter the relevant details for the columns available. Select the value FIFO for the column Picking Strategy.-Save the changes, and close the Edit page.- You have successfully setup FIFO rule for identified stock consumption in production task.-See Also-Please refer the KBA 2637251 - Automatic Proposal of Identified Stock in Pick Task, to familiarize yourself with how you can configure the system to automatically propose the identified stock in a supply task. The title of the document says Pick Task, but the setting will work for Supply Task also.-Keywords-FIFO for iStock in production, FIFO in production ByD, material flow rules for FIFO in production

Title: Not Able to Set A Personalized Query As Default Query
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***To Be Archived***-Reason: KBA no longer valid, custom queries can be set as default-You have created a personalized query for the Identified Stock field in the Confirm Pick task window and you want to know how to default this query option.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Choose a Task ID and then select the Confirm button.-In the opened window, press on the value help window for the Identified Stock field.-Fill in the required fields and press on the Save Query button.-Now Select the Organize Queries button, in the there is no option to set the personalized query as a default option.-Resolution-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign system, it is not possible to set the personalized query as a default query.-The system is behaving as designed.

Title: The Customer Part Number is not Displayed in the Product Description of the Form
Content: Symptom-The Customer Part Number is not displayed in the product description of the Form-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Enter all the mandatory fields.-Select View All button and go to the Items tab.-Add the product ABC in the Items table (ABC represents the ID of the product).-After clicking the ﻿Preview﻿ button, the product description does not display the Customer Part Number.--Cause-The product description field in the sales order shows the combination of Product ID and the Description maintained in the product master data, it does not show the Customer Part Number automatically.-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business By Design system.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to change the description field for the product:-1. Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-2. Go to the Products view.-3. Show All Products and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product).-4. Edit the product and select the View All button.-5. Go the Sales tab and select the Customer Part Number subtab.-6. Add the Customer Part Number manually.-Now the Customer Part Number will appear if you add product ABC in the sales order preview.

Title: Account Assignment Type not Filled Automatically While Creating Supplier Invoice for Specific Product ID
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA 3221176 - Account Assignment Data Missing Exception For Supplier Invoice-You are creating a supplier invoice and entered Product Details in the Items tab. When the Product ID is entered, the system is not able to automatically pick the Account Assignment Type value and gives an error message Item 1: Account assignment data missing for item 1.1; see Cost Distribution.--You are looking for Business Configuration settings to fill Account Assignment Type automatically when Product ID is entered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Under the Common Tasks select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Fill all mandatory details and enter the Product Id.-Account Assignment Type value is not filled automatically.-Select the Save or Check button.-An error message appears Item 1: Account assignment data missing for item 1.1; see Cost Distribution.-Resolution-As per current system behavior Account Assignment Type cannot be configured for a specific Product ID. The functionality will be available in the future releases of SAP ByDesign.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Account Assignment Type, Account assignment data missing for item.

Title: Cannot Save or Post Purchase Order Due to Error Message “Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters.”
Content: Symptom-An error message: "Enter a value with no more than 40 characters." is displayed when attempting to save a purchase order with a Product Description exceeding 40 characters, preventing the purchase order from being saved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select New Purchase Order in Common Tasks list.-Select View All.-Enter all required information.-Go to Items tab.-Add an item by clicking Add Row.-Enter more than 40 characters in description field.-Choose Save.-Error message: "Enter a value with no more than 40 characters."-Cause-Currently this is not possible to have Purchase Orders with Product Description which is more than 40 characters.-Resolution-It is recommended to use a meaningful abbreviation or a more generic Product Description with less than 40 characters.-Keywords-Item description; Purchase Order; Free text item; More than 40 characters

Title: Sales tax - cross-border goods movement
Content: Symptom-Change to obligation to produce supporting documents for intra-community deliveries as of October 01, 2013 (confirmation of arrival)-On March 22, 2013, the Federal Council decided to approve the 11th regulation, which is to be released by German Federal Finance Ministry, for the change to the ordinance regulating sales/purchases tax.-For details, refer to the publication by the German Federal Ministry of Finance. To access this, go to www.bundesfinanzministerium.de and enter the search term "Gelangensbestätigung" (EN: confirmation of arrival).-Also note the alternative supporting documents for confirmation of receipt. For further details, refer to the document "Umsatzsteuer; Beleg- und Buchnachweispflichten bei der Steuerbefreiung für innergemeinschaftliche Lieferungen (§ 4 Nr. 1 Buchstabe b, § 6a UStG); Änderungen der §§ 17a und 74a UStDV durch die Elfte Verordnung zur Änderung der Umsatzsteuer-Durchführungsverordnung" (EN: Sales/purchases tax: Obligation to produce supporting documents and records for tax exemption for intra-Community supplies (article 4(1)(b), article 6a of the sales/purchases tax law); amendments to articles 17a and 74 a of the ordinance regulating sales/purchases tax by the eleventh regulation for the amendment of the ordinance regulating sales/purchases tax). See the attachment or the following link:-http://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Downloads/BMF_Schreiben/Steuerarten/Umsatzsteuer/Umsatzsteuer-Anwendungserlass/2013-09-16-innergemeinschaftliche-lieferungen.html-For more information, see:-http://www.haufe.de/steuern/gesetzgebung_politik/Erleichterungen-mit-Blick-auf-die-Gelangensbestaetigung-verabschiedet_168_171180.html?chorid=00511434&newsletter=news%2FPortal-Newsletter%2FSteuern%2F53%2F00511434%2F2013-03-26%2FTop-News%3A%20Erleichterungen-mit-Blick-auf-die-Gelangensbestaetigung-verabschiedet&ecmId=9473&ecmUid=3107204 German only-We recommend that you attach the documents for the statement of tax-exempt intra-community deliveries to the goods issue in every case so that this information for the complete process is available via the document flow.-Resolution:-SAP Business ByDesign does not provide any integrated standard solution for the creation of the confirmation of arrival, but has decided to provide samples in English for the forms of the confirmation of arrival (1. supplying company/2. shipping company) – for the most up-to-date form templates, see the Web site for the German Federal Finance Ministry. Generate these forms based on the delivery note using Adobe LifeCycle Editor, and assign the forms to the work center view.-See Embedded Objects for the sample for the confirmation of arrival.-The documentation for the creation of the forms in SAP Business ByDesign is available in the online help. Enter "Formularvorlagenverwaltung – Quick Guide" (EN: form template maintenance - quick guide) as the search term and choose "Start". Click the relevant link under "Help resources". In the section for the management background, select "Adjust form templates".--     Resolution-Since the changed statement rules are still being criticized by German companies, there is a chance that the legal rules with change in the medium term. SAP Business ByDesign does not provide any integrated standard solution for the creation of the confirmation of arrival, but has decided to provide samples in English for the forms of the confirmation of arrival (1. supplying company/2. shipping company) – for the most up-to-date form templates, see the Web site for the German Federal Finance Ministry. Generate these forms based on the delivery note using Adobe LifeCycle Editor, and assign the forms to the work center view.-See Embedded Objects for the sample for the confirmation of arrival.-The documentation for the creation of the forms in SAP Business ByDesign is available in the online help. Enter "Formularvorlagenverwaltung – Quick Guide" (EN: form template maintenance - quick guide) as the search term and choose "Start". Click the relevant link under "Help resources". In the section for the management background, select "Adjust form templates".-

Title: Site/Location Name is not Changing After Changing the Business Residence Name in Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-You have changed the Org Unit/Business Residence name and activated the Org Structure. But the Site name doesn’t updated with the changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In Principle, a Site will be created at the time of activating the Business Residence and the Site will take all the datas (org unit 1d, org unit name, etc,.) from the Business Residence. But if you make any changes in the Org unit after activating it as a Business Residence, Site will not be updated with the info. But you can change any data in the Site directly. If you wants to change the Site name/location name, then follow the below steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Highlight the Site and select Edit button.-Change the site name.-Select Save button.-Note: In the above screen, you can also verify that the Business Residence name, which was changed and activated.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Keywords-Site, Location, Business Residence, Organizational Structure, Name.

Title: A technical error  in Supplier invoice: /SRMAP/LSIV_SIV 393. Report an incident.
Content: Symptom-You cannot post an invoice that contains withholding taxes for India. You get an error: A technical error occurred: /SRMAP/LSIV_SIV 393. Report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the relevant invoice.-Choose Post.-You get an error: A technical error occurred: /SRMAP/LSIV_SIV 393. Report an case.-Cause-One of the Tax Code is mapped to a Tax Event which is assigned with a Tax Type for which no Tax Rate is defined in the Fine-Tuning (= 0%).-To verify the cause above:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the relevant invoice.-Go to the General tab and then the Withholding Taxes subtab.-You notice that for some Tax Code/Tax Type combinations, the Tax Rate is 0%.-Alternatively, you can simulate the journal entries:-Choose the button Actions -> Simulate Journal Entries.-You get an exception: Unexpected error during backend processing:-Fatal Runtime Exception triggered by component 'AP-RC-GEN-PAT'.-Please see Application Info section in the dump for more details.-CM_FIA_ACC_INVACC_IB_AGENT at-Program: SAPMHTTP-Include:-Line: 0-Text: Supplier Invoice : Required entry field Withholding Tax Item Withholding Tax Rate Type Code is not filled-Resolution-In case the supplier invoice tax amount is correct which means that no Surcharge / EC / SHEC on Income Tax is expected (only Withholding Income Tax), then the Tax Code should be mapped to a Tax Event that is only assigned to the tax type 'Withholding Income Tax'.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Choose a current project (alternatively, create a new one).-Choose Open Activity List and then go to Fine-Tune.-Open the activity Withholding Tax - India.-Select the relevant Tax Code.-Select a Tax Event for it that does not have Surcharge, EC and SHEC.-Choose Save.-Keywords

Title: Cannot Give Access Restrictions on Organizational Unit Level for Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-You want to give Read/Write access rights on purchase orders to users for only particular purchasing units of a company. However when editing the rights of a user, the only access groups available are on company level. On the contrary, for sales orders, you can define a restriction on org unit level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the User and Access Management view-Go to the Business Users subview-Find the relevant user and choose Edit -> Access Rights-Go to the tab Access Restrictions-Mark the Work Center Name Purchase Requests and Orders-In the columns Read Access and/or Write Access, you selected Restricted-You notice that the Access Context is: 1007 - Company-Furthermore, in the subtab Detailed Restrictions, you cannot add an Access Group ID that corresponds to a purchasing unit-Cause-The access context for Purchase Order can be given only at Company level and it cannot be provided on Org Unit level.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-Keywords-Purchase order access restrictions; Access restriction for PO; Restrict PO Access at org unit level;

Title: Part of the Material Description as Key Words Cannot Search Out the Material
Content: Symptom-As a Chinese customer, you have a material with the description 'AA-BB-CC-DD', however, you cannot use the key words 'AA-BB' or 'BB-CC' or 'CC-DD' to search out the material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Go to the By Material sub view.-Use the key words 'BB-CC' to search out the material 'AA-BB-CC-DD', but fails.-Cause-Generally, the issue is due to that Chinese '—' is not the same as English '-' in the system though they look remarkably similar.-Resolution-The original '—' which is used in the material description should be selected in the key words to search for the material.-Keywords

Title: Error in Migration of Projects due to Missing Project Type in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-The data migration of projects ends up in an error 'Errors detected during import simulation, Error detected in source record with key value 'XYZ' displayed in the log section'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project First Implementation.-Select Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend Phase.-Select Migration of Projects activity.-Select Migrate projects using the migration tool.-In the new window that opens, select Upload and upload the completed project migration template ABC.-Select the row corresponding to File Name ABC and select Execute Migration.-The migration process stops at validate file phase with errors.-Cause-This error is due to missing project type in Project Types activity in Fine-Tune phase of the project.-Resolution-Maintain the missing project type in the activity Project Types by following the below mentioned steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation project.-Select Open Activity List.-Select Fine-Tune phase.-Select Project Types activity.-Select Add Row and enter the details for missing project type in the new row.-Save your entries.-Now you have maintained the missing project type in the system and you can proceed with the migration of projects.-Keywords-Errors Detected, During Import Simulation, Source Record, key Value Displayed in the Log Section, Business Configuration, Project Type.

Title: How-to Change Released List Price Product's Supplier
Content: Symptom-User creates a new list price for Product XXX. So you change the Valid To date of the old list price from Day A to Day B to disable this list price. But when on this day, Valid To date change back the Day A automatically.-(Here XXX refers Product, A and B referring a Day)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can follow the below steps to reproduce the error.-Go to work center Inventory Valuation and select view List Prices.-Choose New – List price.-Input new supplier name and other information, click Next.-Input product information and choose valid form Day B.-Tick the Release field and click Finish.-Then search for the old list price for Product XXX.-Go to work center Inventory Valuation and select view List Prices.-Change the Valid To date to Day B and click Save.-On Day B, you check this list price; you will find Valid To date change back to Day A.-Cause-The process to change list price is wrong. When you try to update a released list price, the system creates a new list price by default. You do not need to create a new list price by yourself.-Resolution-To update the list price, please follow the below steps:-In the Product Portfolio work center, select List Prices view,-Search for the released list price and choose Edit.-If you want to update the list price description and/or price scales, check the indicator Change Past List Price.-If you want to update the validity period of the list price along with the description or price scales, uncheck the Change Past List Price indicator.-Update relevant information and click Save.-A new list price is created and released. The Valid To date in the old list price is automatically set to the date prior to the Valid From date in the new list price.-If you want to change the supplier, then you need to cancel release and create a new one.-In the Product Portfolio work center, select List Prices view,-Search for the released list price and select Cancel Release.-Keywords-Change list, list price, Cancel release, released list price change

Title: Unable to Change the Sales Organizations for Materials Using Mass Change
Content: Symptom-You have requirement to change the Sales Organization for a set of materials but you’re not able to perform the change using Mass Change functionality, since the default row for Sales Organization column is greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select list of Materials and select Mass Change button.-In the Mass Change screen, select Sales in Show field.-Cause-It is not possible to change the Sales Organization for Materials using Mass Change because, each Material may have multiple Sales Organizations with different status and hence, assigning a Sales Organization and activating the status should be done manually for each Material.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: How to Delete an Employee and its respective Business User in a Lean HCM Scoped System?
Content: Symptom-You, as a Key User, would like to know whether it is possible to delete an Employee and its respective Business User.-Resolution-It is not possible to delete an employee because it is a Transactional Process document which must remain in the system, to avoid inconsistencies. From a technical and functional standpoint, the closest alternative would be to make the relevant employee inactive.-Steps to make an employee inactive (Lean HCM)-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for the relevant employee-Select it and click Edit-In the Valid To field, change the date to match employee's Valid From date — this would essentially make it so that the employee has a null validity period, which would make him unavailable for any business processes in the system.-Select Save and Close button.-Now, select Active Employees in Show field. Here you can no longer view this employee, but you can still check its data of this employee if you search in All Employees.-Business Users:--Once an employee is made inactive as per the above steps, his/her Business User validity will also be ended so he/she can no longer log into the system.

Title: ARCHIVED:Project Name & Project Task Fields are not Visible under Adaption Mode
Content: Symptom-You would like to adapt Project Information fields i. e. Project Task & Project Name on the Purchase Order List but you can't find these fields during Adaption Mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Request & Orders work center.-Select Adapt link. -Select Enter Adaptation Mode link.-Select Edit Screen.-Select the Title: Purchase Order & scroll down Fields value.- But Project Task & Project Name fields are not available.-Cause-Project Task & Project Name fields are available under the item level during adaption mode.-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Request & Orders work center.-Select Adapt link. -Select Enter Adaptation Mode link.-Select Edit Screen.-Select the Title Items: Purchase Order & scroll down.-You will find the fields Project Task & Project Name.-Select Save & Publish.- Keywords

Title: Unable to Sort the Columns in Mass Change of Materials
Content: Symptom-When you try to sort the column for any parameter in Mass Change screen for Materials, no sorting happens-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select list of Materials and select Mass Change button.-Cause-Sorting in Mass Change screen is disabled because, sorting of columns will include the Default Row (the row, where you enter the new value which needs to mass changed) and it will result in inconsistency.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Note: We have already added this as a new requirement for future release.-Special Case:-In the Material view, you have sorted the Material ID column, select some Materials, select Mass Change. In the Mass Change screen, the Material ID is unsorted.-On clicking of Mass Change button, the order of the Material IDs is changing since the column Material ID is not a sorted column. Sorting cannot be enabled for this since after sorting is enabled, the mass change row which is the first row in the Mass Change screen would move to the last row which would be confusing.--This is already a known limitation and the behavior cannot be changed.

Title: System triggers error message "Value for identified stock missing" while confirming a make task
Content: Symptom-When trying to confirm  Make Task, error appears "Value for identified stock missing".-However in the product master data for product ID XYZ, you maintained Identified Stock Type as Optional Specified Stock.*XYZ refers to product id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Select the Task and choose button Confirm.-Go to the Confirmation tab.-Select Save button.-Error message appears "Value for identified stock missing"-Cause-The identified stock is optional only if there is no Product Specification. In this case, a product specification is used, hence the identified stock becomes mandatory.-Resolution-Kindly maintain Identified stock during confirmation of  Make Task as it is mandatory to maintain when Product Specification is used.-Note:This error is valid for all logistics and production process.-Keywords-Value for identified stock missing for Optional Identified Stock when Product Specification is enabled, Identified stock is mandatory when product specification is enabled.

Title: Unable to Post a Supplier Invoice Due to an Error Message: Balance sheet account is not permitted with cost centers
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a supplier invoice because of an error message: Balance sheet account is not permitted with cost centers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Fill in all the details and select the Post button.-Resolution-The system never allows posting of a supplier invoice to Account Assignment Type: Cost Center and Projects Task to Balance Sheet Accounts.-The line item of the supplier invoice is assigned to a G /L Account: Prepaid Expenses which is of type other assets, which is a balance sheet account.-Normally the balance sheet accounts are of types Assets and Liabilities.-Users need to change the G/L Account and try to post the supplier invoice.-Keywords-Balance sheet account is not permitted with cost centers; Supplier Invoice; G/L Account

Title: How to add field Fixed Asset Life Cycle Status to report
Content: Symptom-How to add field Fixed Asset Life Cycle Status to the report Fixed Asset - Trial Balance.-Resolution-1.Goto Work Center Fixed Assets.-2. Goto View Reports  List.-3. Open Report  Fixed Asset – Trial balance-4. Click on Add Fields.-5. Expand the Characteristic  Fixed Asset.-6. Select the field Fixed Asset Life Cycle Status and mark the options Display in the report and Display variable(as required) and click Ok.-7. Now the field Fixed Asset Life Cycle Status will be available in the list of  Not currently shown fields.-8. You can then drag and drop the field Fixed Asset Life Cycle Status to the Rows to display in the report.

Title: Unable to Post the Supplier Invoice due to Unposted Cancelled Goods and Services Receipt
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post the supplier invoice because of an error message: Cannot find goods or service receipt XYZ for Purchase Order ABC, item 1 in accounting .The Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) displayed in the Error message is  already canceled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the invoice you want to post and select the Edit button.-Select Post button system displays the error message.-Cause-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents sub-view.-Search for the source document with the GSR document ID XYZ .-Select the source document and select the action View Business Transaction from the drop down list of Actions button.-On the new screen you will see the issue description under the column Message:Cannot find account determination group for product category .-Resolution- Maintain the account determination for the product category by following the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Activity list view.-Go to Fine-tune step.-Select activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures,Account Determination.-Under section Account determination go to respective tab.-Maintain the account determination here.-  You can post the document successfully by posting the task created for the GSR:-- Go to General Ledger work center.- Go to Closing Cockpit view.- Go to Source Documents sub view.- Select the GSR XYZ.- Select the option View Business Transaction from the drop down list of Actions button.- Select Post button.-Once you post the tasks for both the canceled and cancelation GSR, you can post the supplier invoice successfully.-

Title: How to Add a New Unit of Measure for Quantities
Content: Symptom-How to Add a New Units of Measure for Quantities-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Work Center Business Configuration.-Go to the View Implementation Projects.-Select Show All Open Projects.-Select the relevant project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Go to the Fine Tune phase.-Show All Activities and find for Quantities and Units of Measure.-Select the Activity Quantities and Units of Measure and click on Open button.-Click on the link Create and Maintain Trading Units/Create and Maintain Physical Units(based on your requirement).-Click on the Add Row button.-Fill in the following fields: Unit, UoM Symbol , Description and Reference UoM(for a Physical Unit).-And then set Activation status to Released.-Click on Save.-Note:-The field Unit must start with letter ‘Z’.--Only UoM with the Status Released will be shown on the Interface.-Any New Physical UoM that you create must reference another predefined Physical UoM.-Keywords-Unit of Measure, UoM, Product, Material

Title: You Require a New Withholding Tax Rate while creating Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You require a new Withholding Tax Rate while creating Supplier Invoices for the supplier <XYZ>-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Select the action New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-On the new screen, enter the supplier XYZ and further mandatory details.-Click on the option View All.-Navigate to the tab Items.-Enter the item and Enter the navigate to the tab Withholding Taxes.-Select the Withholding Tax Code and the system display the tax Rate <X%>-You require <Y%> instead of <X%> for the same Withholding Tax Code.-Cause-Withholding Tax Rate is maintained in the business configuration and the specific tax rate is derived based on the settings in Business Configuration and the Tax Rate type maintained in the Master data of the supplier.- Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and Perform the action Open Activity List.-Select the activity Withholding Tax - India.-Select the activity Check withholding tax rates schedules.-Enter the tax rate <Y%> for the required Withholding Tax Rate Type.-Perform the action Save and Close.-Select the activity Check withholding tax codes.-Enter a new Withholding Tax code <ZX> for the same Tax Event.-Under Details Section, Add the Tax Type and the required Tax Rate Type.-Perform the action Save and Close.-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Supplier view.-Select the supplier <XYZ> and perform the action Edit Financial Data.-Navigate to the tab Tax Data.-Select the Tax Numbers for the specific Country.-Under Withholding Tax Classifications, perform the action Add Row and enter the Tax Type and Tax Rate Type.-This Tax Rate Type should be same as the Tax Rate Type maintained for Withholding Tax Code.-Create a New Supplier Invoice for the supplier <XYZ>-On the new invoice, navigate to the tab Items and later to the tab Withholding Taxes.-Select the newly created Withholding Tax Code <ZX>.-You will be able to see the Tax Rate correctly fetched as per the configuration.

Title: Supplier not Recognized in Scanned Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You scanned a new invoice that you received from your supplier. However the supplier is not fetched in the new scanned invoice. Upon checking the master data, you can see that the supplier is maintained and active in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Login to the SAP Collaboration Window.-2. Copy the supplier invoice files to the upload folder (Menu -> Invoice Scanning Settings -> Observed Folder).-3. Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-4. Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-5. Find the new scanned invoice and choose Edit.-6. The field Supplier is empty.-Cause-The city is part of the supplier name which causes the supplier not to be recognized.-Resolution-Remove the city from the supplier name in the master data:-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view-Mark the relevant supplier and choose Edit.-Maintain the Supplier Name field.-Choose Save.

Title: Cannot Open Implementation Projects After Go-Live
Content: Symptom-Cannot edit the activities in Fine Tuning as there is no Implementation projects found in Business Configuration.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Select view Implementation Projects-There will be no Implementation projects available to edit the activities in Fine Tuning-Cause-Go-Live activity has been completed for the First Implementation project.-Resolution-You can edit the activity by Change Immediately or Add To New Change Project:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Go to Overview-Find the desired activity which you need to edit-Highlight the activity;-If the button Change Immediately is active, you can edit the activity by pressing the button-If the activity cannot be edited by Change Immediately, you can create a new change project by clicking on the button Add To New Change Project

Title: Cannot Change Responsible Unit Of A Released Project/Project task
Content: Symptom-You are unable to change the Responsible Unit of a released Project/Project task in the Project Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view, sub view Projects.-Show All Projects.-Find the project XYZ.-Click Edit and select Project Plan tab.-In the sub tab Accounting, observe the field Responsible unit.- You see that the field Responsible unit is grayed out.-Cause-Once a project is set to the status of "Started" or "Released," a baseline is automatically created and a snapshot is taken. At this point, certain fields become "Read-Only," including the project ID, project type, responsible unit, organizational assignments, and the billable field, which includes customer information. The profit center displayed in the project or project task is derived from the responsible unit or cost center once the project status is set to "Started" or "Released." After this point, the responsible unit becomes "Read-Only."-Additionally, when a project is created, the system sends a snapshot for accounting purposes, and the profit center we see on the user interface reflects this snapshot. Since the project snapshot has already been sent to accounting, it cannot be updated later. Therefore, we do not allow changes to be made at a later time. Furthermore, once a project or project task is released, it is communicated to various applications and objects such as FIN, HCM, SRM, and CRM, with the responsible unit. This ensures that any actuals, such as time recording, expenses, procurement, and sales, on the task are linked with the cost center. The reporting unit is directly linked to the financial accounting object, which is why the system does not allow you to change the reporting unit once the project is released.-Respective cost center and profit center which is associated to the Responsible unit will be picked up automatically.-Resolution-It is necessary to double-check the project settings while it is still in planning and before starting/releasing it. Since the responsible unit cannot be changed anymore once the Project task is started / released, the only option is to cancel the existing project and create a new project.-or-You may consider to create new tasks  after completing the existing tasks where you can add desired responsible unit of existing projects.-Note: A change in the backend of your system is not an option since it would lead to inconsistencies from an accounting point of view.-See Also-For more information on this topic please refer to the article "Project Status and Integration" in the Help Center of your SAP Business ByDesign system.-Keywords-change responsible unit, change profit center, change requesting unit, change cost center, change project type

Title: How to Create Purchase Order With Zero Price Line Item
Content: Symptom-You create Purchase Order with Zero Price ,system display an the error message :-Price missing; price required for expected follow-up documents invoice or ERS.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Under the common task select New Purchase Order.-Select the button View All.-Fill all the mandatory ,but price is zero-Select the button Check.-  Cause-As per standard system behavior it is not possible to create a Purchase Order with  Invoice Expected and Price zero.-Also when the item price has been filled, either Invoice Expected or ERS flag should be set, other wise system will throw this error.-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to  Purchase Orders view.-Under the common task select New Purchase Order.-Select the button View All.-Fill all the necessary details with price zero.-Navigate to the sub-tab Basic Data.-Remove the flag (if any) for the checkbox Invoice Expected or Evaluated Receipt Settlement.-Click the button Check.-You will get the warning message The purchase order value is too low.-But system will allow you to post the Purchase Order.  -Keywords-Invoice Expected selection missing,  How to create PO with zero price

Title: Error Message When Deselecting To-Stock Process Type While Creating New Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new purchase order for stock items and you deselect the To-Stock Process Type. When you deselect the To-Stock Process Type, the system shows an error message: Select To-Stock indicator or enter account assignment details.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Tasks section and select New Purchase Order.-Go to the Items and select Add Row button.-Select the Process Type Non-Stock.-Select Stock Item in the Product ID column.-System shows the error message. For Example: Item 1: Select to-stock process type or enter account assignment details.-Resolution-You have to define the account assignment details for this purchase order and it will hit the corresponding financial accountings. For Example: Cost Center, Project Task etc. Otherwise if you deselect the To-Stock process type, the system will check the Account Determination Group and it will post to corresponding Set of Books ID.

Title: Cannot Change the Default Delivery Date of Seven Days in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You created a new purchase order from scratch and when you select the Add Row button, the system defines the Delivery Date to 7 days lead time by default. You want to change the default delivery date in purchase orders via fine-tuning activity but you cannot find any options to define the Delivery Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Common Tasks section view-Select New Purchase Order link-Select Add Row button and go to the Delivery Date field under Items-You can see that system defaults the Delivery Date with 7 days lead time-For Example: You created a Purchase Order on 12.12.2011 and the system determines the Delivery Date as 19.12.2011 by default.-Cause-The delivery date with seven days is pre-defined in the ByDesign system and hence cannot be configured anymore in the Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-The default calculation of delivery date is 7 days from the creation date and you can always change delivery date manually.-Note:-If you are a partner: you can develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-See Also-Keywords-change delivery date; delivery date with seven days is pre-defined

Title: Functionality of Mass Change For Some Fields In Purchase Order Fact Sheet
Content: Symptom-You created a purchase order for multiple line items and you saved the purchase order. You would like to do a mass change for some fields like Delivery Date and Ship-To/Service Location ID. But you can't see any options to modify the purchase order for mass change.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Tasks section and select New Purchase Order.-Fill the mandatory details and go to the Items tab.-Add multiple Line Items to the Purchase Order.-Now you would like to do a mass change for some fields like Delivery Date and Ship To/Service Location ID.-You can't see any options to do a mass change for the addressed fields.-Cause-Mass change for purchase order items are not supported in current release.-Resolution-We already have this requirement in our backlogs requests list for the functionality of Mass change of some fields in Purchase Order fact sheet and will consider it in the future plan.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Mass Update; Mass Change

Title: Cannot Enter G/L Account in Cost Distribution of Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are creating an invoice for delivered goods. However the field G/L Account is grayed out in the tab Cost Distribution for the purchase order items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select the relevant purchase order and choose New Invoice.-Choose View All.-Go to the Items tab and then the Cost Distribution sub-tab.-The field G/L Account is disabled.-Cause-When a Product ID or Product Category has been entered  in the corresponding purchase order item, the system automatically determines the corresponding G/L Account and shows it on the respective item of Supplier invoice automatically.-Resolution-In order to check which G/L Accounts are determined:-Resolve all errors in the invoice (you can choose the Check button to know what data are missing or wrong).-Choose Actions -> Simulate Journal Entry.-In the Journal Entry screen, you can see which G/L Accounts are determined.-Keywords

Title: Error Message "Use personnel administration to hire and maintain employees", When Creating an Employee from a Business Partner Person
Content: Symptom-You as an Administrator, when you try to create an Employee from a Business Partner Person, system throws below error message:-Use personnel administration to hire and maintain employees-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Business Partner view.-Highlight the Business Partner.-Select Create As button and choose Employee option.-In the new window, Enter First & Last name.-In the Organization Unit field, select the value help and choose a Org unit.-Cause-If Human Capital Management (HCM) is scoped in the system then employees can only be created and maintained in the Personal Administration work center. The link Create As Employee in the business partner is enabled is a side effect, if the user has the Partner Development work center assigned to him. Because with this work center assignment the authorization concept gets disabled, which might also have an impact on a lot of other scenarios.-But in the case of Lean HCM scoped system, there will not be any error message.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Error Message 'No Support for Recurring Compensation Component Type' in Payroll Processing
Content: Symptom-For an employee, you have assigned Compensation Component with Recurrence Type as Recurring with Fixed Due Dates but during Payroll Processing, the below error is shown:-No Support for Recurring Compensation Component Type-Reproducing the Issue-Step 1: Creation of Compensation Component can be done in the Compensation work center.-Step 2: Assign the Compensation Component to the employee:-Go to the Compensation work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the respective employee and select the Edit button.-Go to the Compensation Details tab and select the Earnings sub-tab.-Select the Add Row button, here you can add the Compensation Component created with Recurrence Type as Recurring with Fixed Due Dates.-Step 3: To reproduce the issue:-Go to the Payroll Processing work center.-Select the Payroll Run view.-Highlight the respective Payroll Group,-Select the View Payroll Process Data link under the Further Details.-Go to the Employee Data tab and the All Employees sub-tab.-Select the employee, then you can see the Error Description and Error Location.-Cause-The recurrence possibilities offered by SAP Business ByDesign Compensation are very flexible and it provides the following options:-No support of recurring Compensation Component Type-Partial support of recurring Compensation Component Type-Complete support of recurring Compensation Component Type-But these may not be all supported by some third-party payroll providers.-If your payroll provider is DATEV and the corresponding compensation component is not supported by it, then system will show the above error message.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Product Category Tax Classification in Purchase Order or Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-Wrong tax rate type determined in tax calculation even though a tax classification is maintained for this product category in the common task Tax Classification for Free-Text Items (work center Purchase Requests and Orders).-Cause-More than one rule in the product category tax classification is applicable in a scenario. This can occur in case a rule for a specific product category exists and in parallel a general rule for the same country (wildcard for product category).-Depending on the order of these rules, the last applicable rule will overwrite the tax classification of the rules processed before.-  Example:-Customer specific rule for reduced tax rate for Product Category "Exhibition Stand Building" and standard rule defined for country Germany.-Seq. Product Category Tax Rate Type Tax Exemption Reason Taxable Service Point Country Region Tax Type-1 EQ(Exhibition Stand Building) Reduced   False Germany   Value Added Tax-2 * Standard   False Germany   Value Added Tax-Purchase Order with two free-text items created, item 10 with product category "Exhibition Stand Building" and item 20 with product category "Office":-For item 10 (product category "Exhibition Stand Building"), both rules stated above apply. Due to the processing order, the tax rate is first set to "reduced" (rule 1), and then again to "standard" (rule 2).-For item 20 (product category "Office"), only rule 2 applies.- Resolution-Due to the mixing of the product category tax classification with the general standard tax classification (not visible to the user), the "standard" rule delivered by SAP is not necessary any more.-In case a standard rule for a country in the product category tax classifications leads to several rules being applicable in a scenario, see example above for product category "Exhibition Stand Building", the meanwhile superfluous standard rule can be deleted.-  Example:-Customer specific rule for reduced tax rate for Product Category "Exhibition Stand Building" and standard rule defined for country Germany.--> Solution: Delete standard rule (#2).-Seq. Product Category Tax Rate Type Tax Exemption Reason Taxable Service Point Country Region Tax Type-1 EQ(Exhibition Stand Building) Reduced   False Germany   Value Added Tax-2 * Standard   False Germany   Value Added Tax-Purchase Order with two free-text items created, item 10 with product category "Exhibition Stand Building" and item 20 with product category "Office":-For item 10 (product category "Exhibition Stand Building"), the tax rate will be determined as "Reduced rate".-For item 20 (product category "Office"), no rule from above applies, hence the default standard tax classification applies with the "standard rate".-

Title: Bill-To Address is Wrong or not appearing in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You create a new purchase order and the Bill-To Address is not fetched and the company main address is populated instead. or Bill-To Party field is not having all desired org units  or it shows wrong org units.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Click on the relevant purchase order ID-Go to field Bill to under general tab and click on value help-Cause-The bill-to address of the company org unit is not applicable for its underlying org units . Therefore it is not available as bill-to party. Also you have not marked the respective org unit for supplier invoicing.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center-Choose the common task Edit Org Structures-Select the relevant org unit-Go to Functions tab-Check mark Supplier Invoicing-Choose Save-Choose Activate -> Activate Selected and Dependent Org Units-Keywords-Bill to in Purchase order, how to define Bil to, how to set the Bill to; Bill To unit not appearing in PO

Title: Error Message: Cannot Change Cost Center XYZ (Cost Center Name); It Is Assigned to Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate an Org Structure after making some changes, system throws below error message:-"Cannot change cost center XYZ (Cost Center Name); it is assigned to fixed asset"-"Cannot change timeline of cost center; cost center is used by financial accounting"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All option.-Cause-There are different causes that lead to this issue,-If you have a fixed asset assigned to a cost center and delimiting the cost center validity to a past date.-If you have a fixed asset assigned to a cost center and deleting the cost center.-If you have a fixed asset for a particular combination on profit center and cost center, and assigning another org unit as a profit center which disturbs the above combination. Because for a fixed asset, a profit center is derived based on the cost center.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-If you have a fixed asset with the status Capitalized then the validity of the cost center or cost center/profit center combination should not be changed.-If you have deleted these Org units in the planning area, then follow the below steps:-Go to the Planning Area of the Org Structure.-Perform Roll Back. PLEASE NOTE: Once you perform the rollback all the inactive changes will be deleted and the Org Structure will be back to its last active version.-System alerts with the message "Are you sure you want to roll back all pending organizational changes? Roll Back deletes all changes made to the organizational structure, and returns to the currently active version. It deletes organizational units that have not yet been activated. This action has system-wide consequences and also affects org structures and units that are not currently shown on the screen. This action cannot be undone. To roll back click OK. To return to the previous screen click Cancel."-Now, perform the changes in the Org Units which ever is required.-Continue with the activation.-Now, try to delimit the validities of the Org Units and activate again.-Keywords-error message, cannot change cost center, cost center, assigned to fixed asset, fixed asset, organizational structure, org structures

Title: Unable to Maintain Financial Data for the Employees in Lean HCM Scoped System
Content: Symptom-You are a using Lean HCM without Personal administration work center, when creating a new employee, it is not possible to maintain the payment data via Business partner work center. Because of this it is not possible to create financial outgoing payments for employees via bank transfer.-Resolution-If the processes like financial outgoing employee payments via bank transfer are essential for you then you have take Human Capital Management in your system scope. The maintenance of employee financial data is not (should not be) supported if HCM is not in scope - even if you are able to migrate such data.-This is general system behavior.-Note: Lean HCM scoped system only supports to pay employees via petty cash

Title: Tax Calculation not Triggered in Supplier Invoice for Sales and Use Tax (US)
Content: Symptom-You create a supplier invoice and the calculated tax amount remains 0,00 USD after selecting the tax code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-In tab General, subtab Taxes, the Tax rate is 0% and the Calculated Tax Amount remains 0,00 USD.-Cause-The determination of the tax rates is done based on the available address information of the related parties in your invoice document. In the supplier invoice, there is no tax jurisdiction code defined for the Ship-From and Ship-To parties. Furthermore, in the Business Configuration (activity Tax on Goods and Services -> US Sales Tax Rate Schedules), the tax rates on US state level (for example, CA - California) for Sales and Use Tax are not defined. Consequently, the correct tax rate cannot be retrieved from the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-Go to the Items tab, then the Partners subtab.-Maintain a Tax Jurisdiction Code for the Ship-From Address and the Ship-To Address.-Select Actions -> Calculate Total Amounts.-Alternatively, you can define a tax rate on US state level:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Show: All Open Projects.-Select the relevant project and then Open Activity List.-Select the Fine-Tune chevron.-Select the activity Tax on Goods and Services and then Open.-Choose US Sales Tax Rate Schedules.-Maintain a tax rate on US state level (for example, CA - California)-To maintain a tax jurisdiction code for a party:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partners view.-Select the relevant party and choose Edit -> Addresses.-Go to the General tab.-Maintain a Tax Jurisdiction Code.- Keywords

Title: Unable to Finsh the GR/IR Clearing due to Error Message:Cost center ABC not found
Content: Symptom-User is unable to finish the Goods Receipt and Invoice Receipt Clearing (GR/IR Clearing) because of an error message: Cost Center ABC not found-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select the GR/IR Clearing sub view under the Period Tasks view.-Select the Run ID and select View button.-Go to Processed With Errors tab.-Details tab shows the error message: Cost center ABC not found-Cause-The cost center is active when the purchase order and follow up documents are created but the cost center is delimited after a month. so system raises an error message at the time of GR/IR clearing.-Resolution-As a work around follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures link under Common Tasks.-Select DD:MM:YYYY (Ex: 01.01.2011) in the Effective From field.-Select Find button.-Locate the Org unit ABC and select Timelines tab.-Change the Date in Valid To  field to future date for the Attribute: Org Unit , Value: Org Unit Timeline.-Select Check Selected Structure option from the drop down list of Check button.-Select the Activate Selected Structure from the drop down list of Activate button.-Select Save and Close button.-Now the GR/IR run can be finished with out any error.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing Run, Cost Center.

Title: Cannot Default Correct List Price as Source of Supply for a Purchase Request on Company/Site/Plant Level
Content: Symptom-You have multiple companies in your system. You defined different list prices per supplier for the same product. You release a purchase proposal after a MRP run. You entered a planning area that correspond to a particular company. You expect that the supplier corresponding to the location of your company is fetched. However in the purchase request the wrong list price with wrong supplier is assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Select the relevant purchase request and choose Edit.-Mark the relevant item.-Select the tab Prices.-The incorrect list price has been assigned.-Select the tab Source of Supply.-The incorrect supplier has been assigned.-Cause-This is the standard behavior of SAP Business ByDesign. The feature will be available in a future release.-Resolution-As a workaround, you need to manually maintain the supplier in the Purchase Requests or define different Product IDs.

Title: Cannot Reverse Purchase Order Created From Multiple Purchase Requests
Content: Symptom-You selected multiple purchase requests and created a new purchase order from these purchase requests. By mistake you selected a wrong purchase request and you need to reverse the purchase order so that the wrongly selected purchase request will be deselected from the purchase order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Select multiple Purchase Requests and select the button New Purchase Order.-Purchase Order created from the Purchase Request.-You would like to know how to reverse the Purchase Order so that irrelevant Purchase Request can be removed from the Purchase Order.-Resolution-The corresponding purchase order is still in In Preparation status and you can remove the line item from the purchase order for the wrong purchase request. After that the Follow-On status of the purchase request document will be changed to No Follow Up. Means purchase request will be available for creating New Purchase Order.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Order view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order and select Edit.-Go to the Items tab and select the relevant Line Item created for wrong Purchase Request.-Select the button Cancel Item and Save the Purchase Order.-Check the relevant purchase request and will be available for creating New Purchase Order.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Select the relevant Purchase Request.-Select the button New Purchase Order.(Active)-You can create New Purchase Order for this Purchase Request.

Title: Credit Card Settlement Run is not Returning any Results
Content: Symptom-You have an incoming payment card payment which is confirmed, but the invoice is still open.-Credit Card Settlement Run is not returning any results.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Go to Credit Card Settlement Runs.-Select the credit card settlement run which you already scheduled.-Select the Application Log ID from the Execution Details.-On the new screen, you are not seeing any data under Results.-Cause-Payments which are confirmed will not be selected in the Credit Card Settlement Runs. Incoming payment card payment in status Confirmed.-This means that the payment is already confirmed and you did this via Bank statement.-Resolution-This payment is already settled. But there is Post Processing required for this bank statement since the payment allocation is not successful yet.-Due to this your customer invoice is also open.-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment allocation view and select the exact Payment allocation.-On the new screen navigate to the Customer/Supplier Tab.-Here you can put the Customer/Supplier ID and the exact amount and perform the action Release.-You will be able to release the payment allocation which will clear the open invoice for that customer.-SAP recommend to trigger an incoming payment card payment via the below step and in this case the payment allocation will not be pending like above.--Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts sub view.-Select the customer account and perform the action View.-Under Trade Receivables select the open Invoice and perform the action Pay Manually By Other Payment methods.-You can pay using Incoming Credit Card Payment.-Here the allocation will happen automatically.---

Title: Total Tax Amount is zero in Supplier invoice - China
Content: Symptom-You create a new supplier invoice with the Tax code Domestic purchase of freight services but the system is showing the total tax amount as 0 CNY at header lvel though the tax amount appears in Item level as expected.- or-If you manually enter the Tax amount as ABC then system displays the error message:Balance is not equal zero: XYZ CNY. The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts. You need to adjust these amounts so that the balance is zero.-Environment-SAP Business  ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice with out Purchase Order link under Common Tasks.-Fill in all the details and select the Tax code as:Domestic Purchase Of Freight Services-Input the tax amount-System displays the above mentioned error message.-Cause-The tax code 11  and  tax event 51 are going to be made obsolete-Resolution-So we request you to use tax code 18 and tax event 52 instead.-See Also-2864846 - Total Tax Amount is zero in Supplier invoice- US and Canada-Keywords-Total Tax Amount is zero in Supplier invoice,

Title: How to Avoid the Default Selection of 'Time Recording Expected' Checkbox in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-How to avoid the default selection of Time Recording Expected flag in the purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select New Purchase Order link under Common Tasks.-Fill in all the mandatory details and select the Project Task in the account assignment field.-Cause-When the purchase order is created out of a project purchase request for the service item the system automatically sets the Time Recording Required flag as the project service delivery will be performed via time recording.-The Goods and Services Receipt Expected flag is depended on the Time Recording Required flag and when the service delivery is performed via time recording then the Goods and Services Receipt gets created automatically based on the times recording.-Resolution-As per the system design behavior currently, it is no possible to deselect the time recording flag for the purchase order linked to the project purchase request.-However, as a workaround, you can cancel the existing purchasing documents linked to project purchase request and create a new purchase order out of shopping cart or standalone purchase order and assign the account assignment to project this will avoid the default selection of Time Recording Required checkbox in the purchase order.-Keywords-Time Recording Expected checkbox in Purchase order-Time Recording Expected flag in Purchase order

Title: Sum of ordered quantities in the Purchase Order History report
Content: Symptom-For the Ordered Quantity column in the Purchase Order History report, shows as results a sum figure equal to the average Ordered Quantity instead of the total sum ordered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Orders WorkCenter-Go to the View Reports-Go to the View List-Open the report: Purchase Order History-Set these layout changes:-Move to the Rows View, these following characteristics:-Purchase Order ID-Purchase Order Status-Purchase Order Item-Document ID-Document Type-Document Item-Supplier--Cause-In the very special customer’s use case, its really could make sense calculate the result as total (and not as average). Presumed that you only uses POs / PO-Items containing the same product and that only exactly one Inbound Delivery (CID) per item exists. But whenever you have more than one deliveries, the use is questionable.-For this and other reasons, the system is working as designed.-Resolution-In order to achieve the sum of ordered quantities:-First option:-The user can launch the report Purchase Orders per Product in order to cover this requirement mentioned.-Second option:-The customer can creates a new key Figure for Ordered Quantity and use it in a new report, as copy from the Purchase Order History.-This involve basically three task to be performed from the customer side:-Create a new key figure for Ordered Quantity;-Create a new report as a copy, using the new key figure created;-Setup the report in order to show the new key figure instead of the old one;-Third Option:-  Export the current report: Purchase Order History to excel and use the AutoSum feature from excel.

Title: Error Message: Product Specification not confirmed; confirm product specification
Content: Symptom-You are unable to order the Purchase Order due to error message: Item X: Product specification not confirmed; confirm product specification.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select New Purchase Order link under Common Tasks.-Fill in all the mandatory fields and select Order button.-System displays error message: Item 1: Product specification not confirmed; confirm product specification.-Cause-The Product Specification for the product used in the Purchase order is not released.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the respective Purchase order and select Edit button.-Select the Confirm Product Specification option from the dropdown list of Actions button.-Now you can order the Purchase order.-Keywords-Product specification not confirmed, confirm product specification.

Title: Credit value greater than invoiced order value or limit
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post Cancellation Invoice due to this error message or below error message.-or-You are unable to post credit memo Invoice due to this error message or below error message.-or-Credit memo value is greater than invoice value. There is a discrepancy between the value of the order item or limit item in the purchase documents.-or-"credit amount greater than invoiced order amount"-"credit Quantity greater than invoiced order Quantity"-"credit amount greater than invoiced delivered amount"-"credit Quantity greater than invoiced delivered Quantity"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the invoice which is to be canceled.-Select Cancel Document button.-Select Post button.-Cause-Cause 1:-The supplier invoice is created with currency ABC , But the Purchase order is created with currency PQR.-Here currency in Purchase order and Invoice is different and thus exchange rate is required.-Since Currency Conversion is done according to the posting date of the supplier invoice DD:MM:YYYY (say aa:bb:xxxx).  please consider below two types.-Type 1.-If the posting date in  Invoice and cancellation invoice is same  but exchange rate is In active  on that date and now you have a new exchange rate with same  rate-If Currency Exchange Rate for the currencies PQR and ABC is maintained as XX  valid on  DD:MM:YYYY (say aa:bb:xxxx).-later a new Currency exchange rate is maintained on DD:MM:YYYY (say ee:gg:yyyy) for PQR and ABC as ZZ.-When an invoice is being canceled the whole history of the purchase order is being checked; the invoiced value of the PO is not allowed to be smaller than the value to be canceled.-All values to be compared are being converted to the PO currency (PQR).-The value of the cancellation item is now also converted for the date aa:bb:xxxx but the rate had been changed to ZZ which leads to the error message.-Type 2.-If the posting date in cancellation invoice and  original invoice  are different and there is  difference in  exchange rates on those dates.-Cause  2:-The actual invoice is not linked properly to purchase order, that is its not appearing in the document flow of Purchase order, thus due to this inconsistency error appears in the invoice cancellation document.-Cause 3: The credit amount is greater than original invoice linked to it.-Cause 4: Ensure that original invoice is not paid before posting cancellation invoice-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1:-Type 1:-Change the posting date of the cancellation invoice to DD:MM:YYYY (ex ee:gg:yyyy) or later in cancellation invoice.-Type 2:-Change the exchange rate  to same as what was there on the Posting date of Original invoice- or-Change  the posting date of cancellation invoice/credit memo same as original invoice-Resolution for cause 2:- kindly raise case and we shall fix it in back end-Resolution for cause 3:-In the cost distribution tab of cancellation invoice/credit memo you can see the  original invoice linked  to it, ensure that both invoices amounts are matching-Resolution for cause 4:- Cancel the payment on Original invoice and then try to cancel it.-Keywords-Value greater,  invoice cancellation,Credit amount greater than invoiced order amount or limit,Credit quantity greater than invoiced order quantity, Credit quantity greater than invoiced delivery quantity, Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount,Credit value greater than invoiced delivery value

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice Due to Error Message: The receipt document is missing or invalid
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers.
