Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 1584460***-You are unable to post Supplier invoice created with reference to purchase order due to error message: The receipt document is missing or invalid. To post the document,either-go to the Exceptions tab and allow post without receipt document or wait until the receipt document has been posted and then post the document. Even though Goods and Services Receipt is created already.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select  Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the invoice ABC and select Edit button.-Select Post button.-Cause-There is already an invoice created for all the line items(for entire quantity) of purchase order with respect to Goods and Services Receipt .So when you try to create a new invoice for the same items of purchase order(for extra quantity not maintained in the purchase order) for which there is no delivery done, system raises the exception.-Resolution-You can select the button Allow Post without Receipt Document in the Exceptions tab of supplier invoice to post the supplier invoice.-See Also-For another reason refer KBA  1584460 - Cannot Post Supplier Invoice Due to Error Message: The receipt document is missing or invalid

Title: Unable to Add Multiple Discounts in Percentage to Contract Item
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add multiple discounts in percentage to a contract item but you got the error message: Record for type Discount (Percent) in the period of time already exists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Create a New contract.-Go to Items tab and click on Add Row.-Go to the Prices tab and add the multiple discounts.-You will get the error message: Record for type Discount (Percent) in the period of time already exists.-Cause-Error message is shown because you have defined two discounts for same line item having validity overlap.-Resolution-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Create a New contract-Go to Items tab and click on Add Row.-Go to the Prices tab and add the discounts.-Enter the valid to date in first row.-Add another row with different discount but Valid From date must be greater than previous discount.-

Title: Interactive Forms not Selected in Purchasing After Scoping Them and Maintaining the Output Channel
Content: Symptom-You set up the system via the work center Application and User Management to have interactive forms used when creating purchase orders (POs). As well the output channel is correctly set to Mail.-However in a new PO, when checking the output settings for the PO form, the standard PO form is defaulted instead of the interactive one.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the task New Purchase Order.-Fill in all mandatory data.-Select You Can Also and then Edit Output Settings in the top right corner.-The standard purchase order form is defaulted instead of the interactive one.-Cause-The setting Purchase Order Acknowledgement Expected (POA Expected) is not selected for the PO items.-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant purchase order and choose Edit.-Go to the Items tab and then the Basic Data subtab.-Mark the items and choose POA Expected.-Choose Save.-Furthermore, you can default the setting POA Expected on the supplier record to automate more the purchasing process:-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Select the relevant supplier and choose Edit.-Go to the tab Purchasing.-For the field Purchase Order Acknowledgement Expected, select Expected.

Title: Is There any Report Existing for an Employee to View his/her own Time Recording
Content: Symptom-Is there any Report existing for an employee to view his/her own time recording?-Resolution-The described issue is currently not supported in Business ByDesign.-The usage of Time Reporting for Employee Self Services purpose is a new requirement which we will add to our future requirements.-Additionally it is not possible to restrict the usage of the available reports to only one employee because the authority is managed per company. So once assigned to the Time Administration work center a user is allowed to see all data for his company.  The only possibility is in Employee Self Service Time Sheet and the Activity report.

Title: Error Message: Account determination group is missing for product category While Assigning Expense Type to a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When you assign a Material as an Expense Item to a Purchase Order, system throws below error message:-Account determination group is missing for product category XYZ(where XYZ represents the product category ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Order work center.-Select Purchase order view.-Select New Purchase Order.-Select Add Row button under Items section, and select item type as Expense.-Select a Product, system throws above error message-Cause-you have not maintained the account determination group for product category XYZ of the Product.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Fine Tune chevron-Search for the activity Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories and select Open button.-Select add row button and add the required product category Id and its respective account determination group.-Select save and close button.

Title: Internal Comments Maintained in a Sales Order are Missing in the Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When creating a Project Invoice Request from a Sales Order, the Internal Comment maintained in the Sales Order is missing in the Project Invoice Request whereas the Customer Information is available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Project Invoicing view and select the Sales Order sub view.-Highlight a Sales Order and select the New button and choose Project Invoice requests.-Here the Internal Comment is missing in the New Project Invoice Request screen.-Cause-The notes entered in the Customer Information of the Sales Order will be displayed in the Project Invoice Request because this information needs to be passed on to the Invoice. Whereas the notes entered in the Internal Comments are specific to the business document. If you enter an internal comment in a Sales Order then it is specific to the Sales Order and if you enter an Internal Comment in an Invoice Request then it is specific to the Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is a expected system behavior.-Keywords-Internal comments, Sales Order, Project Invoice Request, Notes

Title: Assigned Project Tasks are Missing in Time Sheet of an Employee
Content: Symptom-You did record time for a particular project in the past. However, now the project task is missing in the Time Sheet.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select Edit Time Sheet.-Record time for a particular project task for a defined period.-Save and release the time.-When you access the Time Sheet again, the project task name is missing in the Project Task column.-Resolution-The general system behavior is as follows:-The visibility of the activity depends on the logon language. If your activity is in German language and if you are logged in with English, then it is possible that the activity may not appear in the Time Sheet.-The visibility of the task depends on the project language. If your project and project tasks are maintained in German language and if you are logged in with English, then it is possible that the project/project task’s name may not appear in the Time Sheet.

Title: Project Uploaded from Microsoft Project Shows Different Milestone Dates
Content: Symptom-You as a Project Manager, upload a new project created on Microsoft Projects (XML file), whereas the milestone dates were not replicated to the original dates on the XML upload file.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that, in the XML file the milestones might have a duration greater than zero and in the projects (SAP Business ByDesign) the milestones have no duration.-Resolution-As a result, for each milestone in a Microsoft Project with a duration greater than zero, two project tasks are created in the SAP Business ByDesign solution; a new task and a new milestone, and the duration is assigned to the new task. Both the new task and the milestone have the same name as the milestone in Microsoft Project.

Title: Error While Posting Supplier Invoice for Migrated Purchase Orders: Assignment of goods and service acknowledgement not possible
Content: Symptom-System shows an error message while posting supplier invoices against the migrated purchase orders which have open goods and service receipts. Error message: Assignment of goods and service acknowledgement not possible.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend chevron.-Search for the activity Migration of Purchase Orders.-Select the link Migrate Purchase Orders Using The Migration Tool. -A new window opens and select a file to upload.-Select Execute Migration button.-After the migration check the supplier invoices via below steps.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice and select Edit.-Select Check button and system shows an error message.-Note: System also shows an exception: The Goods Receipts/Returns has not been Posted yet- Cause-You migrated the purchase orders, but did not migrate the corresponding goods receipts. Consequently it is missing in the system and it gives an error message while trying to post the supplier invoices against the purchase orders.-Resolution-You have to migrate the corresponding goods and service receipts to avoid inconsistencies.-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend chevron.-Search for the activity Migration of Open Goods Receipts.-Select the link Migrate Open Goods Receipts Using the Migration Tool.-Select Execute Migration.

Title: Information Message: Logistics Area Defined with Exception Usage Storage; While Doing Confirming Customer Return Put Away Task
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm a put away task for customer return, but system is showing information message:-'Logistics area XYZ is not recommended; some constraints not met;  Logistics area defined with exception usage Storage'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant task.-Select it and choose Confirm button.-Enter Actual Quantity and then enter Target Logistics Area ID as XYZ, then the message would occur.-Cause-System would check the logistics use of the target logistics area (or source logistics area, depends on which logistics business) maintained in the corresponding logistics model when doing any logistics business.-However, the logistics use of the Logistics Area XYZ you filled out does not match the logistics use maintained in the corresponding logistics model, resulting in this error reporting.-Take this case as the example, Goods Return Receiving in the corresponding logistics Model Type.-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to the Logistics Models View.-Open the Advanced Filter.-Select the Logistics Model Type as Goods Return Receiving, select Site ID based on your business.-Choose Go.-Since the scenario mentioned in this case is task-specific. So we need to select the record which Without Tasks is not ticked.-Choose Edit.-Select the line of Element Operation, then you can see the maintained Destination Logistics Use.-Open the Master Data of Logistics Area XYZ, then you will understand that the maintained Destination Logistics Use in the Logistics Model doesn't exist in the list of the logistics use for the Logistics Area. -That is why system gives information message.-NOTE: Such errors in any other logistics business can be checked in the steps described above.-Resolution-To solve this error, you can align the Logistics Use in your logistics model or add a new logistics use for the selected logistics area based on your own business.-Keywords-Logistics Area, Recommended, Some Constraints Not Met;  Logistics Area Defined with Exception Usage

Title: No Automatic Generation of Customer Return Notification
Content: Symptom-You have done stock transfer between two sites using the Inter-Company Stock Transfer scenario and now when doing a Return to Supplier, the system does not generate the Customer Return Notification automatically on the other site.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the New Return to Supplier Request under Common Tasks.-Fill in the required fields, choose the next buttons and finish the activity.-Now go to the Inbound Delivery Notification view, and search for the Delivery Notification ID using the outbound delivery ID the system returns no results.-Cause-The system does not create the Customer Return Notification automatically when doing a return to supplier. You have to manually create the notifications in the system.-Resolution-You can create a New Customer Return Notification under common tasks in Inbound Logistics work center for the delivery ID of the type return to supplier and then do the post goods receipt for that notification ID.-The system works as designed.

Title: Unable to Post Supplier Invoice due to Exception
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post supplier invoice because of an exception: The balance is not equal zero:XYZ. The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts. you need to adjust these amounts so that the balance is zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing  work center-Select New Invoice without Purchase Order link under Common Tasks-Fill up all the details and then select Post button-System raises an exception-Cause-The error message itself indicates that the total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant invoice and choose Edit.-In the new screen, Select Calculate Total Amounts option from the drop-down list of Actions button.-Select Check button.-Now system allows you to post the invoice.-Keywords-Supplier Invoices, The balance is not equal zero, Total gross amount differs., Exceptions in supplier invoice

Title: Error Message: Confirmation not possible; positing on XX.YY.ZZZZ is blocked by accounting, While Performing Inventory Adjustment
Content: Symptom-You are trying to do inventory adjustment, but system is showing error message:-Confirmation not possible; positing on XX.YY.ZZZZ is blocked by accounting (XX.YY.ZZZZ represents the Date of the blocked Accounting Period).-Save Failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select New Inventory Adjustment link, available under Common Tasks.-In the new screen, enter relevant Storage Location ID and Key Date as XX.YY.ZZZZ.-Choose Next button. Then choose Add Row button.-Enter Logistics Area ID and choose OK button.-Enter Product ID and Product Actual Quantity and choose Next button.-Now choose Finish All Items. System shows error message:-Confirmation not possible; positing on XX.YY.ZZZZ is blocked by accounting, While doing Inventory Adjustment.-Save failed.-Cause-Accounting period relevant for the date XX.YY.ZZZZ has Period Status as Blocked. This is the reason the system is showing the error message.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you need to open relevant accounting period. To do so:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Master Data: Companies view.-Select the relevant company ID and choose Open and Close Period button.-Search for the accounting period relevant for date XX.YY.ZZZZ. Here you can see that the Period Status of this period is Blocked.-Now select the period and choose Open Periods button.-Finally choose Save button.-If you do not want to open the accounting period, then you can use Set Process Control and then choose to post to some other open accounting period. Please refer to the Knowledge Base Article 1648199 - How to Post Reverse Warehouse Confirmation Without Opening the Relevant Accounting for details.-  See Also-1648199 - How to Post Reverse Warehouse Confirmation Without Opening the Relevant Accounting.-Keywords-Release Outbound Delivery, Accounting Period Blocked, Set Process Control.

Title: Error While Accessing Employee Self Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to access the Employee Self-Services, but system is raising error message: “Technical Users are not authorized to access Employee Self-Services.”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Service view and the Self-Services Overview subview.-Cause-The employee corresponding to the business user has been terminated in Personnel Administration work center, but the validity of the business user was extended in the Application and User Management work center.-Resolution-A business user is a user type meant to be used by employees. Once an employee is terminated, the business user's validity is ended in the same date, as the user should not remain valid if the employee will no longer be part of the company.-If the validity of the business user was extended, the validity of the employee must be corrected to reflect that this employee is still part of the company, so that the user can continue to use employee features such as the Self-Services Overview.-Keywords-Technical User, Access, Employee Self-Services

Title: Dump When Edit a Form Template With Adobe LifeCycle Designer
Content: Symptom-You encounter a dump when you try to online edit a form template with Adobe Lifecycle Designer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Application and User Management-Go View Business Flexibility -Go to sub-view Form Template Maintanence-Select a form template-Choose Edit-Select Open with Adobe Lifecycle Designer-Choose Save -     You will see the Dump.--Cause-This issue may be because the URL of the Bydesign system is not in the Trusted sides list of your IE.-Resolution-Please add the Bydesign system URL into the Trusted sites list in Internet Explorer and retry.--To do so , please:-Open Internet Explorer Tools  -Choose Internet Options  -Choose Security tab  Select Trusted Sites zone -Click on Sites -Enter the URL in the text box-Re-open the Bydesign system, the protected mode should have the status as Off.-Then, the issue may be fixed.-

Title: Cannot Create New Goods and Service Receipt Against a Purchase Order for Contract Item
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new purchase order based on the contract and you sent the purchase order to the supplier. You would like to do a goods receipt for the delivery against the purchase order but the button New Goods and Service Receipt is grayed out in the purchase order screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the task New Purchase Order under the Common Tasks.-Select Add Row button.-Select the Contract ID/Item ID under Material Item Details field.-Fill the mandatory details.-Select Order to send the purchase order document to the supplier.-You received a delivery against this purchase order and you would like to do goods and service receipt for these ordered items.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant purchase order.-In the purchase order screen the button New Goods and Services Receipt is grayed out.-Cause-In the contract, you do not expect Goods and Services Receipt and hence the button is grayed out. Because in the purchase order, the system will consider a follow-up delivery flag from the contract. The Goods and Service Acknowledgment can be created only if the flag is set in the purchase order. If the flag is not set in purchase order, it is not possible to create a Goods Receipt for this Order.-Resolution-If you are expecting the goods and service receipts acknowledgement against the purchasing order, you have to select the checkbox Goods and Services Receipt Expected in the contract.-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Select the relevant Contract and select Edit.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Basic Data tab and select the checkbox Goods and Services Receipt Expected.-Select Save.-Keywords-Cannot Create Goods and Service Receipt; Purchase Order; Purchase Contract

Title: Error Message "On dd/mm/yyyy duration of absences 16 h exceeds planned working time 8 h" during New Leave Request
Content: Symptom-When you try to create a leave request, system throws the below error message:-On dd/mm/yyyy duration of absences 16 h exceeds planned working time 8 h.-Times with time types <XYZ> and <XYZ> collide for period DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self Service Overview view.-Select the New Leave Request link under the Time section.-Select the date and enter all the details.-Select the Save button.-System throws the above error message.-Cause-The error message is caused by that you have already applied for the leave on that day and it has been approved by the manager. So it is not possible to request for the leave on the same date.-Resolution-You can check your applied leaves/absences as follows:-Check Absence Overview:-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the View Absenses link under the Time section. -Check Time Sheet:-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Go to the respective date, where you can find the details of time recording, including leave.-Keywords-Leave Request; Absences; Planned Working

Title: Cannot Print Checks
Content: Symptom-You are unable to print check as the button Print Check Form is grey out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Payment Monitor View.-Select the All Payments option.-Choose line items and select Actions for Checks, and choose Print Check Form in the drop down list. However, the choice is grey.-Cause-The checks you try to print are in status In Transfer. It means that these checks have already been printed and therefore cannot be printed again. Only the checks in status Ready for Transfer could be printed.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to print the check again:-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Payment Monitor View.-Select the check you want to print, with status In Transfer.-Select Actions for Checks, and select Set to Not Transferred. Then the check's status changes back to Ready to Transfer.-Now you can select Print Check Form from the Actions for Checks drop downlist.-After the print, the status will be changed to In Transfer.-Keywords-Print, Check, Form, Payment Management, In Transfer, Actions for checks.

Title: Error Message "Project task XYZ associated with item ABC cannot be used"
Content: Symptom-You as a Project manager, you could find below error message while opening an Project Invoice request:-Project task XYZ associated with item ABC cannot be used. The project task is either in planning, stopped, closed, or blocked. To release the invoice request, select another project task.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Project Invoice Requests view.-Select All Invoice Requests in Show field.-Select an invoice request and select Edit button.-Where you could find the above error messages.-Cause-The line item ABC in invoice request is associated with the Project XYZ. But the Project might be in the status Blocked or Stopped. Hence the error message and also it is not possible to release the invoice.--Resolution-To resolve the issue and to release the invoice, the status of the project or the project task needs to be Released.-Steps are as follows:-Go to Project management work center.-Select Projects view.-Highlight the project.-Select Edit button and choose Project Plan option.-Select Release option in the field Project Status.-Select Save button.

Title: Customer Invoice and Supplier Invoice Show Different Status After Being Posted To Accounting
Content: Symptom-You are in the work center Customer Invoicing and you posted an invoice document and the customer invoice changed to status Released. Now you moved to supplier invoicing work center and you posted an invoice document. But supplier invoice changed to status Posted. Can we have a single status of description for invoices?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the Customer Invoice which was already posted.-Customer invoice status is Released.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the Supplier Invoice which was already posted.-Supplier Invoice Status is Posted.-Cause-Customer Invoicing: The reason using the status Released in the Customer Invoice is that, if an invoice is finished it is communicated to the Customer. In general the customer invoice is send e.g. as printout or email to the customer. With this the receivable gets valid. The main focus of customer invoice is to release the invoice to a customer.-Supplier Invoicing: The reason using the status Posted in Supplier Invoice is that, if an invoice is finished, it is communicated to Accounting and not to customer. Hence the main focus of supplier invoice is to post them in Accounting.--Resolution-Customer Invoice processing and Supplier Invoice processing are two different business transactions and hence the related terms are used.

Title: Time Recording on Project Task by Service Agent Is Always Sent to Project Manager for Approval
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:Combined with Duplicate KBA: 2537424 - Unexpected Approval Task for Time Recording on Project-Service agent records some times on project task and releases them. You find that these times are always sent to the project manager for approval even Mandatory Time Approval is not selected for the project in Project Management.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Select the Edit button.-Select the Project Plan tab.-Select the Basic Data sub tab.-Note that the Mandatory Time Approval box is not checked.-Cause-The Mandatory Time Approval setting is relevant for time recordings of internal employees only.-Resolution-Time recordings on project task by service agents are always sent for approval to the project manager regardless of the project's approval setting.

Title: Error Message: “No Supplier matches service agent” while creating a Purchase Request from a Project
Content: Symptom-The user (Project Manager) tries to create a Purchase Request from Project with a particular Service Agent. However error message is triggered. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Select the relevant project ID. -Click in Edit button and choose Work and Requests.-Select Create Purchase Request button. -Select Service Agent XYZ in Preferred Service Agent field (XYZ is the Service Agent ID). -System triggers error message:-No Supplier matches service agent-Cause-There is no supplier assigned to Service Agent XYZ in "Supplier base / Business Partner Data" work center. Therefore the error message is triggered. -Resolution-If the Supplier is assigned to the Service Agent, then the reported error will be resolved.-But a question may raise, why the field Supplier is not marked as mandatory while creating or updating a service agent?-A service agent does not necessarily have a linked Supplier, therefore it is correct not to mark the supplier field as mandatory.-Keywords-Service Agent, Project Manager, Project, Purchase Request, Supplier

Title: Error Message Appears While Adding Price Scales Of Contract Price
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new contract for the supplier and adding price scales for service/material in ascending order. For example: A consultant worked more than the agreed hours and you want to maintain a higher price per hour for the additional time. However the system shows an error message: Scale amounts are not in descending order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to the Contracts View-Select the relevant Contract and choose Edit-Go to the Items tab and select Line Item-Go to the sub tab Prices-Select Add Row under table Price Scales of Contract Price-Enter the Price Scale in ascending order and select the button Check-Cause-Ascending price scales are not suitable to consider higher prices for overtime – even in the simple case where a user enters times per day in time and labor management.-For example: Let’s assume there is a surcharge, if you work more than 8 hrs/day. Assume you specify 10 USD from Zero hours and 12 USD from 8 hrs/day. If you work for 9 hrs/day, you should get 8*10 USD + 1*12 USD = 92 USD. But the system would calculate 9*12 USD = 108 USD. As the issue will be more complex for many use cases, it is not recommended to remove the check for descending price scales.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior and system is working as designed.

Title: Cannot Match Supplier Part Numbers for Line Items During the Preview of Purchase Order (PDF) Document
Content: Symptom-You created a purchase order and you previewed it on a PDF to print the document. You noticed that supplier part number of Line item B moved to Line Item A.-For Example:-In the preview of the purchase order document, supplier part numbers are moved upwards, i.e. Item A is displayed with supplier part number of item B; item B with supplier part number of item C and item C has no supplier part number.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-2. Go to the Products view and choose By Materials subview.-3. Select the relevant material and press the Edit button.-4. Go to the Purchasing tab and select the Supplier Part Number subtab.-5. You maintained the Supplier Part Number as XYZ for this Supplier.-1. Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-2. Go to the Purchase Orders view.-3. Select the relevant Purchase Order and press the Edit button.-4. Select View All and Choose the Preview button.-5. You noticed that Supplier Part Number of Line Item B moved to Line Item A.-Cause-You are using your own adapted form which differs from the standard SAP one. Any changes/corrections made later by SAP will not be adopted.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center and choose the Activities view.-Go to the Fine-Tune chevron and select the activity Form Adaption.-Select the form for Created Purchase Order.-You can see that the form for Country and Language was changed.-Choose the button Reset To Original.-You can adapt the form once again afterward.

Title: Posting Supplier Invoices not possible for canceled Purchase Orders. Error: Purchase Document Canceled
Content: Symptom-Although a Purchase Order item has been canceled, the corresponding Inbound Delivery has been received and accepted.-In this case, it is not possible to create the Supplier Invoice with reference to this Purchase Order item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cancel a Purchase Order that has already been ordered.-Post the Inbound Delivery.-Create the Supplier Invoice with reference to this Purchase Order.-You get an error: Item X: Purchase document xyz canceled. (xyz represents Purchase Order ID).-Cause-Revoking the cancellation of Purchase Orders is not supported.-Resolution-If you want to keep the materials delivered, but the corresponding Purchase Order has already been canceled, you need to post a Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order reference. The delivery might still appear in the work center view "All Deliveries to be Invoiced". Then select the corresponding delivery and remove it from the list via action button.-The material inventory account will later have to be debited for the Supplier Invoice value.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Canceled Purchase Order, Inbound Delivery, Supplier Invoice

Title: Cancellation of Cancelled Invoices
Content: Symptom-Invoices were cancelled with the wrong date. Thats why they are shown in the report Invoice Volume with different date than the original invoice. How can the date be changed?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Reports.-Open the Invoice Volume report.-It shows the original invoice shows a different date than the cancellation date. This can be in different month and therefore different periods.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the cancellation invoice and look for the Cancellation button.-It is greyed out which means a cancellation of a cancelled invoice is not possible.-Cause-This is the normal system behavior.-Resolution-Wrongly used date for cancelation can not be changed anymore.-The report Invoice Volume in Customer Invoicing work center shows the different posting date for original invoice and cancelation invoice.-A cancelation invoice gets automatically posted to the same day as the original invoice. If this period is closed already or if there is a process control setup to restrict the posting then its get posted into the period of the cancelation invoice. That's why in general the report Journal in General Ledger workcenter shows that the posting date for original journal entry matches exactly with the one for cancelation journal entry which means from financial side everything is okay, no problems in the Profit and Loss statement or in the balance sheet either.-To see that do the following:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents subview.-Filter for Customer Invoice.-Find customer invoice ID and check for Proposed Posting Date.-Find reversal customer invoice and check for Proposed Posting Date.-They should be the same.

Title: Unable to Post Supplier Invoice due to Unresolved Exceptions
Content: Symptom-You created a supplier invoice for multiple line items and trying to post the invoice document but it ends up with multiple exceptions. Later you accepted all the exceptions, however still system does not allow you to post the invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant invoice and select Edit button.-Select View All button and go to the Exceptions tab. -You Accepted all the Exceptions but still you cannot post the Supplier Invoice.-Cause-You accepted the exceptions only for a few items and not all of them.-Resolution-You have to accept all the pending exceptions for all the line items. Select the Check button to know the consistency of the supplier invoice document before posting.-How to check for pending exceptions:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant invoice and press the Edit button.-Select View All button and go to Exceptions tab.-Select Action Log button.-Here you can see that, few line items are still under Exceptions.

Title: Calculated Average List Price Error When Creating new Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new supplier invoice without purchase order and the system shows an error message when you try to post the invoice. For Example: Item 1: The calculated average price 100.00 USD for 1 ea is greater than the list price 90.00 USD. Rounding differences are possible.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the New Invoice without Purchase Order link under the Common Tasks.-Fill the mandatory details.-In the field Net Price, enter a price greater than value of List Price. (For Example 45.00 USD)-Select the Check button and system shows an error message.-Cause-You already maintained the list price for this product in the product portfolio work center for the respective supplier.-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Select the List Prices view.-Select the relevant Product ID.-You can see the defined price for a Product per Supplier.-Resolution-Save the Supplier Invoice.-Status of Supplier Invoice changed to In Exception.-Go to Exceptions tab.-Select Accept Price Variance or Reject Price Variance.-Select Accept Price Variance to post the Supplier Invoice.

Title: Error When Importing Supplier Catalog in Product Portfolio Work Center. File Format Not Supported
Content: Symptom-You are importing supplier catalogs from the Product Portfolio work center. But during the upload, you received the error message: Catalog upload not possible; file format not supported.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the Catalogs view.-Choose New Supplier Catalog under Common Tasks.-Fill in all the necessary fields and choose the Browse option.-Choose a file (for example, an Excel document) and select the Import button.-You get the error message: Catalog upload not possible; file format not supported.-Cause-System only supports these file formats to upload the supplier catalogs: BMEcat XML files and CSV files.-Resolution-You need to import the Supplier catalogs using the following file formats: CSV or BMEcat.-Note:-BMEcat is a widely-accepted format developed to standardize and simplify the exchange of product catalog data between buyers and suppliers. Most large suppliers can provide you a file in this format. This file type is mainly used for supplier catalogs.-CSV file is a comma separated values (CSV) file, an especially formatted text file that stores spreadsheet data in a very simple format. Each line contains one record, and each field within that record is separated by a character, such as a comma, semi-colon, or slash. Since the CSV-file format is not an industry standard and the creation of CSV file can be difficult, a template is provided in the Catalogs view of the Product Portfolio work center.  You can easily create a file with catalog information in the template by entering mandatory and optional information. When you are done, you can generate the file, which is saved in a user-defined location. You can then create a new catalog into which you can import the CSV file that you just created.

Title: Error Message: "Cost center XYZ (Cost center name)/set of bks (Set of bks name); At least 1 period total unequal 0 in DD/MM/YYYY-DD/MM/YYYY"
Content: Symptom-You as a Organizational Manager, When you try to delimit a particular org unit. System throws below error message:-Cost center XYZ (Cost center name)/set of bks (Set of bks name); At least 1 period total unequal 0 in DD/MM/YYYY-DD/MM/YYYY-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight an Org unit.-Go to Definitions tab.-Uncheck the cost center attribute.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-If there are postings to the cost centers XYZ, then it is not possible to delimit these cost centers. The cost centers must remain valid until the end of the accounting period due to possible period closing postings in this period.

Title: Is It Possible to Hide a Specific Report from a Particular User in a Particular Work Center?
Content: Symptom-You, as a Project Manager, may have a requirement to hide a particular report from a particular user in the Project Management work center.-Resolution-In current release, it is not possible to hide a report from a specific user in a work center. The user assigned to particular view of a work center can run all the reports in the view.

Title: Unable to Display Time Frame and Date Characteristics in the Team Member Work Analysis Report
Content: Symptom-You opened the Team Member Work Analysis report (technical ID PROPRJU04_Q0005). But you are not able to add any characteristics related to time frame and date in the report.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Reports view.-Open the Team Member Work Analysis report (ID PROPRJU04_Q0005).-Run the report.-Go to the report view and try to add time related characteristics.-You will notice that the specific characteristics are not available.-Cause-Various dates are available in the report as attributes of characteristic. Therefore, these are not available when you try to add fields to the row.-Resolution-In the report following dates are available as attributes of characteristics:-Characteristic: Project Task-Attributes: Created On, Changed On, Latest Start Date, Latest Finish Date, Earliest Finish Date, Earliest Start Date-Characteristic: Project-Attributes: Earliest Finish Date, Latest Start Date, Latest Finish Date-Characteristic: Service-Attributes: Changes On, Created On-Perform following steps to add these attributes in the report.-Open the Team Member Work Analysis report.-Select the Settings button and choose Characteristics.-Select the value help corresponding to required characteristic in the attribute shown column.-Choose required date from left side column and add it to right side column by clicking single right arrow.-Select the OK button.-Keywords-PROPRJU04_Q0005, attributes, time characteristics not available

Title: How to Make a Cost Center Inactive Which is Assigned to an Org Unit?
Content: Symptom-You as a org unit Manager, would like to know how to make a cost center inactive which is assigned to an particular org unit?-Resolution-Follow the below steps in order to make an cost center inactive without affecting other parameters of the org unit.--1. Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-2. Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-3. Select the required org unit.-4. Go to Timelines tab.-5. Change the Valid to date of the Cost center attibute to earlier date (If you want the org unit as non-cost center from today, the the valid to date will be yesterday's date).-6. Choose Check button and select Check selected Structure option.-7. Choose Activate button and select Activate Selected structure button.-8. Choose Save and Close button.-9. Go to Active area and input today's date in Effective from field and select Go button.-You could see that the org unit will not be a cost center.

Title: No Data is Displayed for the My Projects Report Which is Available on Overview of Home Work Center
Content: Symptom-No data is displayed for the My Projects report which is available on Overview of Home work center. But you can find list of projects in the My Projects link of Overview of Project Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Overview view.-You view the My Projects report which does not show any data.-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Overview view.-Select the My Projects link.-It shows a list of projects in which Person Responsible is your name.-Cause-My Projects link on Project Management-> Overview work center shows a list of projects where person responsible is your user.-The My Projects report in Home -> Overview shows the confirmed times of the last 6 month, which the team members of a line manager (=your user if you are manager) have performed for projects assigned to the reporting line of the line manager. Confirmed times,that employees of other reporting lines contributed to the same projects, are not contained in the report.-Briefly, a line manager would say: My Projects shows the confirmed times, which my people performed for all projects in my line within the last 6 month. The report is deployed in the Managing My Area work center -> My Department - My Projects. Hence , if your user is not a manager of any organizational unit, then data will not displayed in the My Projects report.

Title: Cannot Invoice Material Items with Accounting on the Product Category Only
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice for material items. You are asked to enter accounting information like a cost center or a GL account. However you entered a product category ID already for accounting purposes.-In the profitability reports, you do not want the materials to be assigned to a cost center or GL account. You want the materials to be assigned to the product categories IDs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-2. Select the New Invoice Without Purchase Order link under the Common Tasks section.-3. Enter material items with product category IDs and all remaining mandatory info.-4. Press Check. You get an error such as: Item 1: Accounting data missing.-Cause-This is possible to create such invoices without account assignment (cost distribution). However this is only possible when the invoice is a follow-up document of a purchase orders with to-stock materials. In this case, you will find a reference to an inbound delivery in the Cost Distribution subtab of the Items tab.-Resolution-Refrain from creating invoices from scratch for to-stock material items. Otherwise, enter a cost center or GL account.-Keywords

Title: Project Manager Cannot Edit Time Sheet for Some of Service Agents
Content: Symptom-You, as a project manager, try to record times for service agents in your team. But you see that the Edit Time Sheet option is disabled in Time Sheet.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Resources view.-Select the Service Agents.-Where you find that the Edit Time Sheet option is disabled for some service agents.-Cause-The Edit Time Sheet is disabled under the following circumstances:--1. The scoping question Purchase order with time sheet recordings for projects is answered No.-2. The service agent is an internal employee or there exists no time sheet for the service agent.--Resolution-For scoping question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to Step 4 Review Questions.-Under Purchasing, select Goods and service receipts.-Select Yes for question Purchase order with time sheet recordings for projects.-For specific service agent:-Below steps can be followed in order to enable the time sheet for a service agent.--Service Agent (not an internal employee):-To create a time sheet for a service agent (not an internal employee) the service agent has to be staffed on a released project or a purchase order for him/her is needed. The purchase order needs to be relevant for time recording and the status of the time recording should be active.--Service Agent (internal employee):-For internal employees the time hire task should be finished. To confirm times on behalf the employee, either the employee's line manager or the time administrator are able to do so.

Title: Unable to Create New Shopping Cart because All Options in New Shopping Cart Are Disabled
Content: Symptom-You, as a project manager, want to create a shopping cart in Project Management. But all the options in New Shopping Cart window are greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the New shopping cart under Common Tasks. A new window opens up.-Where all options are greyed out.-Cause-The cause is the scoping question for procurement for project management is answer No.-Resolution-If the below scoping question is answered No, it is not possible for you to use shopping cart in project:-Do your project managers procure materials and services for projects using self-service procurement?-Note that in the Home work center you are not able to see the New Shopping Cart link but you can see it in the Project Management work center. It is a limitation in current release that the New Shopping cart link will appear in Project Management work center even though the above scoping question is answered No. This issue will be corrected in the next immediate release.-Follow the below steps to reach the scoping question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Select the Change your scoping link.-Go to the Questions.-Select Project Management and the Project Procurement.-Select Yes for question Do your project managers procure materials and services for projects using self-service procurement?

Title: Error Message "Delete not possible; product category XYZ used in <Business Area name>"
Content: Symptom-When you try to delete a Product Category, System throws below error message:-Delete not possible; product category XYZ used in <Business Area name>-Example: Delete not possible; product category XYZ used in SRM-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Product Data work center.-2. Go to the Product Categories view.-3. Select Maintain Product Categories button.-4. Choose the item you don't need, and Select Actions - Delete button.-System throws above error message.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-Product Category is a master data. If the master data is used in transactional data, then the master data can't be changed or deleted, else it would create a data inconsistency in the system.

Title: Unable to Reset Safety Stock, Target Stock, Fixed Lot Size or Reorder Point to 0 Using the Mass Change Functionality
Content: Symptom-When you try to reset Safety Stock, Fixed Lot Size, Reorder Point or Target Stock to 0 using the Mass Change function, The 0 disappears from the field and no changes are being done. There is no error or warning message.-But there is no issue when you change the value from 0 to a higher number.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data workcenter.-Select Materials view.-Select the Materials and select Mass Change button. A new screen opens.-Select 2 Planning in Show fiels.-Enter 0 in column Safety Stock, Target Stock, Fixed Lot Size or Reorder Point.-Select Apply Mass Change button and choose All Items.-The 0 then disappears from the field and no changes are being done. There is no error or warning message.-Cause-The system is working as designed.-Resolution-Few more points in mass change,-Change a field value from A to B (e.g 0 to 3) - This is considered as a change and on calling mass change shall be applied to all materials.-Field value is blank or initial (0 is initial value for quantity) - This is not a change, so mass change will not be applied. This is same like open the mass change screen and apply mass change when all values in default line is initial. This will not apply.-This limitation is known and the screen will be adapted in next higher releases.

Title: Employee List in Suppliers View of Payables only Show Fraction of Employees
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find all the employees in Supplier Accounts view of Payables work center. Instead, system only shows a few employees in the list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the Supplier Accounts view.-Select All Employees in dropdown menu of Show field.-Only a few employees are visible in the list.-Cause-This is correct system behaviour. In employee list in Supplier Accounts view of Payables work center, system only shows the list of employees who have pending payout transaction (employee creates an expense report, it is approved by the manager but the amount has not been paid to the employee).-Resolution-System behaves as designed.-Keywords-employee; expense report; supplier accounts; No Reimbursement Requested; payout to employee; outstanding reimbursement

Title: Is it Possible to Upload Bulk of Images Using Mass Change Functionality?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to upload bulk of images using mass change functionality? since uploading images one by one consuming more time.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-Mass change does not support this feature in the current release.-This new requirement has been considered for the next higher releases.

Title: Unable to Remove a Company Added to a Suppliers Since "Remove" Button is Inactive
Content: Symptom-Remove button is inactive, when you try to delete a company which was added to a supplier account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data workcenter.-Select Suppliers view.-Select Supplier ID.-Select Edit button and choose Financial Data option.-Select the company, where Remove button is inactive.-Resolution-You cannot remove the Company if financial postings are posted to that Company.-But the feature of deleting a company added to a supplier account where there is no financial positing is enabled.

Title: Error Message "Org unit XYZ does not exist" when Add Org Unit to Project Task
Content: Symptom-You, as a project manager, want to assign a particular org unit to a project task. System may throw the below error message:-Org unit XYZ does not exist-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  the Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view.-Search and highlight the respective project.-Select the Edit button and choose the Team and Staffing option.-Under section Organizational Units, select Add Row button to add a new row.-Type the Org unit name or ID in the new row the press Enter.-System may throw the above error message.-Cause-Org unit cell contains an auto-complete dropdown list so you can input part of org unit ID or name and system will automatically look up the org units whose name or ID contains the same typed ahead string. But system will not automatically selet the entry even the list only contains one row. You have to manually select it by clicking the entry or using arrow key.-Resolution-After typing the org unit ID or name in the auto-complete dropdownlist, you should select the option from the dropdown list by arrow key then press Enter.-Or, you can use value help option to choose the required org unit from the list.

Title: Project Task Missing in the Time Sheet While Recording Time Against a Project
Content: Symptom-You as an Employee, When recording Time against a project in time sheet. You couldnt able to find the Project Task.-Scenario:-The system was first implemented ByD system without HCM in scope. Administrator created and maintained login users in Business Configuration and/or Business Partner Data. Note that these users don’t have HCM data associated (personnel file, time file and time data, compensation file and payroll data etc), administrator only can maintain basic data and assign authorizations. Now you wants to ‘upscope’ the system to include HCM module.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management workcenter.-Select Edit Time Sheet under Common Tasks.-Select value help for the column Task.-Required Project task is missing.-Cause-As mentioned in the Description, If you wants to upscope the system to include HCM module. Then you need to migrate these users to employees with all necessary HCM data. Which can be done through Migration of Employee Data activity. If the activty was not fully completed, then it will results in below cases,-1. The reason why you are not able to find the project task in the system is may there are two entities for your employment, one is in Personnel Administration workcenter and one is in Business Partner Data – Business Partner.--2. This is because, Migartion of employee data is not yet performed after upscoping to HR (HCM). Therefore some employees are missing in the personnel administration. But you are able to see those employees in the workcenter business partner data.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue, The Activity Migration of Employee Data in Business Configuration workcenter needs to be performed completely. This activity can be performed by the owner of the activity.

Title: Project Phase Numbering Starts as a Continuation of the Master Project's Last Phase
Content: Symptom-You as a Project Manager, Created a New Project which is copied from another existing Project (Status:Release). When adding a new Phase to the new project, the Phase numbering starts with the continuation of the source project instead of 1.-Reproducing the Issue-New project is created from another existing project with the status Released.-Adding Phase to a new Project:-Go to Project Management workcenter.-Select Project view.-Select Edit button and choose Project Plan option.-Select Add button and choose Phase.-Highlight the newly added phase.-In Basic Data sub-tab, you could find that the Project Phase numbering starts as a continuation of the master project's last phase-Cause-The system is working as designed.-Resolution-Since the new project is created from a already existing project, all the phases in the master phase also got copied into the new project. So by default, the project phase numbering will start from the continuation of the master project's last phase.-Note: Even if you delete the copied phase, the new phase will again start from continuation of the master project's last phase

Title: How To Create Supplier Invoices Without Import Tax Calculation On Items for a Supplier Abroad (as default).
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**TO BE ARCHIVED**-The steps present in the KBA were no longer valid to create the Tax Exempt.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-2. Select the New Invoice Without Purchase Order link under the Common Tasks section.-3. Select a non domestic supplier and add a line item.-4. Select the View All button.-5. Go to the Items tab and then the Taxes subtab.-6. The Tax Code is defaulted to 'Import use tax'.-Cause-This is the desired standard behavior of the system.-Resolution-To define a tax code for this particular tax event:-1. Go to the Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to the Implementation Projects view.-3. Select Show: All Open Projects.-4. Select the relevant project and press the Open Activity List button.-5. Select the Fine-Tune chevron.-6. Select the Tax on Goods and Services activity and press the Open button.-7. Select the Define Tax Codes link.-8. Select the Add Row button.-9. Enter the tax event that is related to the import of goods from abroad. Enter your country, a tax code, a description, a validity period.-10. In the Details section, press the Add Row button.-11. Enter the relevant Tax Type and Tax Rate Type as 'Exempt'.-12. Press the Save button.

Title: Report: Plan/Actual Work Shows Incorrect Value
Content: Symptom-The report Plan/Actual Work in Project Overview shows wrong value for Remaining Work-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects view.-Select the Project.-Select Edit button and choose Project Overview option.-Wher the report Plan/Actual work shows incorrect Remaining work-Cause-The System working as designed. The remaining work shown in the graph is the sum of Remaining Work and Forcast Exceeds.-Refer below section for further details.-Resolution-It is not possible to have the graph like remaining hours with the forecast exceeds and remaining hours without the forecast exceeds value in the system, it's only the remaining work and it follows the rules outlined above.-There is only one remaining work value in the system, and note that the equation remaining work = planned work - actual work is not always fullfilled. There are two simple ways to break this equation:-You can confirm more work than originally planned. Which is possible and allowed, and since the remaining work is always greater or equal zero it does no longer fit. Mathematically it becomes non-linear.-You can still adjust manually the remaining work. That is possible for released work packages. So you can create a constellation like planned work = XY h, actual work = YZ h, remaining work = XZ h. This can be set for each work package (found on the tab Work on the details for a task; each work package is a line there. And then the amount of work gets aggregated over the task hierachy, but as well on employee level, so in case you have this situation you have to look on the values carefully to understand this. The system follows the rule remaining = planned - actual as long as it can, but it will reach a border sooner or later.-Regarding the remaining hours and forecast exceeds : on the tab Team and Staffing the forecast is calculated as actual + remaining work. Then it is compared against the committed work. This is meant as a help for the project manager; but since entering the committed work is optional it is very often the case that the forecast becomes red.

Title: Cancellation invoice has not cleared
Content: Symptom-You may have cancelled a supplier invoice; but you have not seen any posting in accounting against the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to work center Suppler Invoicing.-2. Select Invoices and credit Memos view from the left pane.-3. Select All Documents from the show drop down list.-4. Find the document ID XXX.-5. You should be able to view the Document stated as,-  a. Status: Posted-  b. Document Type: Cancellation Invoice-  c. Document ID: XXX-Cause--The reason you don’t see any posting against cancellation invoice XXX is that its parent invoice YYY is yet to be posted.-Resolution-1. Go to the General Ledger work center.-2. Select the view Closing Cockpit and Click the radio button Closing-Relevant Tasks.-3. Enter the Source Document Id – XXX and select Go button.-4. You will get the task relevant to the document; now select the button View.-5. In the task you will get the below details.-The accounting period of the fiscal year is closed for postings usingthis closing step.-Either choose another closing step for which the accounting period is still open or choose another posting date to post to another open accounting period.-Now to proceed with the posting for document XXX follow the steps below.-6. Again select the view Closing Cockpit and select the radiobutton Source Document.-7. Select the source document type Supplier invoice and fill the parent invoice XXX.-8. Select the task relevant to invoice and click the button view Business transaction.-9. Now select the button Post or Post to Another period according to your requirement.-Once you finish the posting of invoice XXX follow the same steps for the cancellation invoice YYY.-This will solve the issue.

Title: Not Able to Confirm the Inbound Task and Close the Supplier Invoice Due to an Error 'Actual Delivery Date must be between XYZ and today'
Content: Symptom-Error occurs when a confirmation of task is triggered. While you're saving an inbound task confirmation the system shows an error 'Actual Delivery Date must be between XYZ and today'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You go to the Inbound Logistics work center and then to Task Control view.-Search for your task and then select Confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen, select the Save button.-System Behavior: Following error message appears:-Actual Delivery Date must be between XYZ and today. (XYZ represents the exact date in the past)-Cause-Due to data control check it is not possible to post the goods receipt for a receipt that took place before the last six months. To get this process finished and close your supplier invoice you need to cancel the already started process, change the date of the inbound and finally confirm the goods receipt again.--Resolution-Please follow the below mentioned steps to finish the process:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center and then to Monitoring -> By Warehouse Order view.-Search for the relevant Warehouse Order ID and select Edit button.-In the new window choose the tab Confirmation.-Now select the button Reverse Confirmation.-Now go to Inbound Delivery Notifications work center view.-Search for the relevant Inbound delivery notification and choose Edit button.-In the new window change the planned delivery date to any date less than 6 months from today's date.-Now choose Save and Create Warehouse Request.-Confirm the complete quantity again that automatically will close the process with a released Inbound Delivery.--See Also-Kindly note that the same system behavior is displayed when you try to create a new Inbound Delivery without any task confirmation against the Purchase Order Item XXX. (XXX represents the Purchase Order Item ID).

Title: Cannot reopen a purchase order with status Canceled
Content: Symptom-You have mistakenly canceled a purchase order (PO). You cannot revoke the cancellation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-2. Go to the Purchase Orders view and select a PO with status Canceled. There you have no possibilities to reopen the PO.-3. Press the Edit button to open the PO in edit mode. There you have no possibilities to reopen the PO.-Cause-It is not possible to reopen a PO after it was canceled.-Resolution-You can recreate an identical PO using the Copy function in the Purchase Orders view.-Before you need to cancel the follow-up documents for the canceled PO and complete all the associated tasks.-To find the follow-up documents, open the canceled PO and go to the Document Flow tab.-To find any associated tasks, open the Application and User Manangement work center, select the Task Distribution view, select the Business Task Management sub-view.-Keywords-####,##,###

Title: Cannot Select Organizational Unit in Project Team and Staffing Tab
Content: Symptom-You want to assign an Organizational Unit to a project so that all the employees in this particular Organizational Unit can be allocated as project team member and record time on the respective project. But in Project Management work center you may not be able to find the desired Organizational Unit under project Team and Staffing tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Goto work center Project Management.-Select view Projects.-Select a project and select Edit button.-Select tab Team and Staffing.-Under Section Organizational Units, select F4 value help.-You may not find the required Organizational Unit.-Cause-Currently projects support only Functional Unit but not Organizational Unit as "assigned units". Functional Unit (FU) is any organizational unit which has at least one business function like purchasing or sales assigned. The reason for this is that the original assumption for functional unit was that "people work there". This means that we expect employees are assigned to FU only. People are not assigned to Cost Centers because Cost Centers are legal entities, in the same way like Companies or Sites - of course people work on a site, but the Organizational Management Site is meant as the legal site and not the workplace.-So the organizational unit without business function 'purchasing' or 'sales' assigned cannot be selected in project Team and Staffing.-Resolution-Unfortunately it turns out that the original assumption "people work in functional units only and never in organizational units with legal characteristics" is not met in reality. What we didn't consider is that we-Do not provide all necessary business functions, so that in certain circumstances it is simply not possible to use this approach.-Even if matching business functions are present in the system it is not mandatory to use them if the customer's use case does not require it for certain reasons (work distribution etc).-As a consequence we will allow to assign any org unit to project Team and Staffing in the upcoming release.-Workaround:--Assign the team members explicitly to the project as per below steps,--1. Go to Project Management workcenter.-2. Select Projects view.-3. Select and edit the project.-4. Go to tab team and staffing-5. Under the section team Members, add the team members explicitly.

Title: Customer address as delivery address in a purchase order.
Content: Symptom-You would like to have a delivery of a purchase order at a customer address. However, the delivery address you like to have is different from the one the system is proposing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the work center 'Purchase Requests and Orders'.-2. Select the link 'New Purchase Order' under 'Common Task'.-3. A new window would open for the purchase order.-4. Fill all the necessary details in the header and the item for the purchase order.-5. To maintain customer address as delivery address:- a. Select the item and navigate to the subtab 'Delivery'.- b. Select the customer ID from the value help of the field 'Customer'.- c. The delivery address 'A' is copied from the customer ID.- d. You need to deliver the items at address 'B'  for the customer.-Cause-The system populates the delivery address based on the data maintained in the corresponding account for the customer.-Resolution-You may look for the value help functionality for different ship-to location of your customer. However, SAP ByD does not support such functionality in its current release. You need to manually modify the delivery address for the customer.-See Also-You cannot deliver a purchase order stock item at your customer address. If the purchase order item is ticked for 'To Stock', you donot see the 'Customer' field to select for delivery address. Once you untick the 'To-Stock' for the purchase order item, the customer field will be visible in the delivery tab.-Unticking the 'To-Stock' field does not make any business difference to the process. Since you are anyway making the delivery to the customer location, you need not to use the central warehouse functionality by ticking 'To-stock' option for the item.

Title: Jurisdiction code missing warning; Financial data of Product ABC is incomplete for company XYZ
Content: Symptom-While creating a purchase order, you may see the below warning messages:-Jurisdiction Code missing in address of Company <XYZ>; default state.-Item 1: Financial data in product <ABC> is incomplete for company <xyz>.-(i.e. Here XYZ refers Company, ABC refers Product ID, PQR refers default state)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Click on New Purchase Order under Common Tasks.-In the opened window, fill in the required fields such as supplier ID, buying company XYZ, product ABC and so on.-Click the button Check.-It displays the warning message mentioned above.-Cause-Jurisdiction Code missing in address of Company XYZ; default state PQR.-The reason for warning message of Jurisdiction code is that you have not maintained the jurisdiction code in the address details of your company XYZ.-Financial data of Product <ABC> is incomplete for company <XYZ>.-The reason for the above warning message is that you have not activated the valuation of the product ABC for your company XYZ. Moreover, the account determination group is also not maintained for the material.-Resolution-To maintain the jurisdiction code in the address details for your company:-Go to the Work Center 'Organizational Management'.-Go to Edit Org Structures sub-view.-Select your company <XYZ> in the graphical view or tabular view.-Go to the tab Addresses.-Select the hyperlink Additional Fields.-A window for Main Address would pop-up.-You would see a field Tax Jurisdiction Code-You need to fill the tax jurisdiction code details for your company.-To activate the valuation of the product ABC for company XYZ;-Go to the Work Center Product Data-Go to the View Materials.-Select the product ABC.-Click the button Edit.-A new window would pop-up for the details of the material.-Click the button View All-Go to the tab Valuation.-You would see that the status of the product is In Preparation against company XYZ-Change the status of the material to Active and save it.-Moreover, account determination group is also not maintained for the material.-See Also-The account determination group is very important for direct material or stock material. Based on account determination group assigned, the G/L account is determined for stock material. The system has given warning message because no accounting is hit during the creation of purchase order. However, the system will not allow you to post the follow-on documents.-Keywords-Purchase order; Jurisdiction Code missing; Purchase order warning messages;

Title: MRP is not Creating any Proposal Against Dependent Demand
Content: Symptom-A product has dependent demand. You run the MRP for this product to create corresponding supply, however MRP is not creating any proposal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Products view.-Search for relevant product.-Select the searched product and choose Open button.-In the Product Planning Details screen, you can see that there is dependent demand.-Run MRP by clicking on Single BoM Level or Multi BoM Level from Run Planning drop down.-It is not creating any proposal.-Cause-In the master data for this product you have maintained Demand Management Procedure as ADRF-All demand reduce forecast. In this procedure, only forecast will be considered as demand. No other demand like dependent demand, actual demand like sales order will be considered. That is why system is not creating any supply. In the Product Planning Details screen, you can also see that such demand will not be reflected in the projected stock.-Resolution-Change the correct Demand Management Procedure like ATOS_CPC-Dependent demand and sales consume current forecast, ATOS_MPC-Dependent demand and sales consume preceding forecast or ATOS_SPC-Dependent demand and sales consume adjacent forecast based on your business requirement.-To do so, follow the steps below:-Go to the Product Data work center.-Select the Materials view.-Search for the relevant product.-Select the searched product and choose Edit button.-In the material screen, choose View All button.-Go to Planning tab. Here select the appropriate Demand Management Procedure from the dropdown.-If you do not maintain any value for Demand Management Procedure then also, MRP will create proposal for dependent demand and it will be considered in Projected Stock calculation. For that you need to manually delete the value of Demand Management Procedure.-Keywords-MRP, Dependent Demand, Demand Management Procedure, Product Planning Details.-dependent demand projected stock

Title: Error Message:" The action CONFIRM_PAYMENT is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident."
Content: Symptom-When you try to release a Payment Allocation, the error  The action CONFIRM_PAYMENT is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case. is shown and the release of the Payment Allocation cannot occur. allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work centre.-Go to the Payment Allocations view.-Select the Payment Allocation and press the Edit button.-Press the Release button.-The error message The action CONFIRM_PAYMENT is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case is shown and the release of the payment allocation cannot happen.-Cause-Some of the Payment Orders assigned to the payment allocation and which should be confirmed by the release of the payment allocation are not set to "In Transfer" in the Payment Monitor.-Resolution-You have to set the Payments Orders in transfer in the payment monitor.-Go to Payment Management work centre.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Select from the Show filter 'Payments Ready for Transfer'.-select the payment order to be set In Transfer.-Press the Actions for Bank Transactions button select the value set as manually created.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Select the concerned Payment Allocation and press the Edit button.-Press the Release button.-Keywords-The action CONFIRM_PAYMENT is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case.

Title: The Actual Work and the Remaining Work in the project is not updated even after the time recorded in Goods Receipt on the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The Actual Work and the Remaining Work in the project is not updated even after the time recorded for external service agent in Goods Receipt on the Purchase Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center ‘Project Management’.-Select view ‘Projects’. -Select 'All Projects' from the dropdown menu of 'Show' field. -Select the project <xyz> and Select 'Edit' button. -Navigate to ‘Project Plan’ tab and select ‘Gantt Chart’ sub-tab. -Select task <abc> in below ‘Details pane’ and select tab ‘Work’. -Check for the ‘Actual Work’ and ‘Remaining Work’.-Cause-The Actual Work reflects only the time confirmations made from the time sheet entry for a project task in a project. -The time recorded as quantity in the Goods and Services Receipt are treated as expenses on the project task and they appear under the 'Project Expenses' view as expense items.-Resolution-In work center 'Projects', the Actual Work reflects only the time confirmations made from the time sheet entry for a project task.  -This is the expected behavior.  -The time recorded as quantity in the 'Goods and Services Receipt' are treated as expenses on the project task and they appear under the 'Project Expenses' view as expense items.-There are 2 scenarios depending on how you want to treat working time confirmations for employees or external service agents.-Project based time confirmations must be entered in the timesheet, either directly from the external service agent or on behalf. This will then update the project and trigger GSAs etc. in the purchasing module. And it can be invoiced to the project customer. This scenario can be followed by flagging the option "Time Recording Required" while creating purchase order.-You can use the project as a cost object for a goods receipt, so the project is only used as a cost collector, but the GSAs for the time items are not relevant which is called either as "time confirmation expected" or "goods receipt expected". In this scenario the times are bypassing the project, but not the costs - they are still assigned to the project, which means you can invoice them identically to scenario 1. The only thing missing is the update of the actual and remaining work in the project. Note that you cannot use the time sheet and the GSA alternatively so you have to make sure in advance that you are using the correct scenario.-Note: It is not possible in the system to merge the above two scenarios.

Title: 'Confirmation Update Run' is Not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-In the Confirmation Update Run view, it was defined sorting criteria as ascending order of Requested Delivery Date.
