So when you Edit the closed tasks, original document attachment will not be visible. The reason is, the attachment was added in the supplier invoice document and not in the approval task. Since there is no attachment added in the approval task, it is not visible to approvers for closed tasks.-Resolution-Approvers can still see the original document attachment at the bottom of the screen. You can go to;-Go to the Managing my Area work center-Go to the Approval View and select Closed Tasks-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice Approval Task-At the bottom you can see the attachment-Keywords-Original Document Attachment not Visible to Approver; Original document attachment; Closed tasks

Title: Scanned Supplier Invoice Document Number is created with Suffix as Current Year
Content: Symptom-It was created a supplier invoice which has Posting Date in the previous year however the Invoice Document ID has the current year as its suffix.-For example: Posting date is "31.12.2023" but in the Invoice ID the suffix is "2024".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Scanning view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Scanned Invoice's ID). -Click in Create Invoice button. -Insert the Posting Date as "31.12.2023".-Click in Save button.-It is created a Supplier invoice with Suffix *2024 (not *2023). -Cause-Even though in Business Configuration is is maintained the "Year Suffix Selection Date: Posting Date" in the "Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing" activity, this does not apply for scanned invoices. Scanned invoices are the invoices that were uploaded via Collaboration Window as well.-There is a code line in the system which ensures the suffix year for scanned invoices will always take the system date (the current date).-Resolution-To ensure that the right year is taken in the Invoice Document ID, please manually create the supplier invoice in the system.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Scanning, Scanned Invoice, Posting Date, Current Year

Title: Post Button is Greyed out in Goods and Service Receipts
Content: Symptom-You're unable to Post the Goods and Service Receipts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center. -Go to Show by Documents view. -Search for the ID of your Purchase Order. -Select the document. -Click in 'New Goods and Services Receipt' button. -In an item, set the Delivered Quantity as zero. -You see that the Post button is grayed out.-Click in the Check button. -No message is shown. Not even 'Check complete; goods and services receipt contains no errors' is displayed.-Cause-You're unable to Post a Goods and Services Receipt if there is an item with null quantity.-Resolution-You can exclude the item which has the null quantity by clicking in the 'Delete Item' button.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Goods and Services Receipt; Post; Check

Title: You Receive Internal Server Error When You Try to Edit Quality Inspection
Content: Symptom-System is crashing when you try to open a Quality Inspection to edit same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Quality Control work center. -Go to the Inspections view.-Select All inspections and choose any Inspection document.-Click Edit.-System dumps. -Cause-You have maintained duplicate entries under Adaptive Sampling Inspection Stages.-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center. -Go to the Implementation Projects view. -Find and select the relevant Implementation project.-Click Open Activity List and find 'Adaptive Sampling'.-Open the Activity: Adaptive Sampling.-If you go through the Adaptive Sampling Rules, you can see you have maintained the same Inspection Stage ID for multiple Adaptive Sampling Rules which should not happen, hence the dump.-Resolution-You need to maintain different/unique inspection stage names for each adaptive rule.-Keywords-Duplicate entries in code list provider response (data type INSPECTION_STAGE_CODE)-Runtime Errors:         MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT-ABAP Program:           CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP

Title: wrong approvals in supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-Approvals are not rechecked when extension fields are filled up with values in supplier invoice- or-Though extension field is filled up the Supplier invoice still goes for approval-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites-1.Create extension field.-2.Approvals conditions are set such that invoice goes for approval if extension field is empty.- Steps to reproduce:-Invoice 1 created without values in extension field thus as expected it goes for approval-Invoice 2 enter values in extension field  but it is  still going  for approval wrongly-also  if you  invoice 1 and enter the values for extension fields but it is still going  for approval  wrongly.-Cause-currently system is developed where supplier invoices don't support this extension field values for triggering approvals.- if you take same example for Goods receipts you will see that  its works as expected. so  the issue exist in Supplier invoice but that is the way system was developed from the beginning-Resolution-Kindly ask your partners to help fix the issue in supplier invoice approvals.-Keywords-why approval, wrongly approver

Title: Two Standard Reports "Outbound Delivery Detailed Line Items" and "Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity" Show Different Result of Delivered Quantity
Content: Symptom-For a specific product, within a period, total delivered quantity in report  "Outbound Delivery Detailed Line Items" is bigger than the same field in report "Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view.-Search report "Outbound Delivery Detailed Line Items", click "Edit with Web Browser".-Search product ABC in Ship-from Location DEF on a specific Delivery Month , in the result the total delivered quantity is XXX.-Open report "Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity", set same filter, the total delivered quantity is YYY. YYY is a number bigger than XXX.-Cause-Report "Outbound Delivery Detailed Line Items" shows all not canceled outbound deliveries no matter whether they are released or not, while report "Outbound Delivery Performance by Quantity" only shows released outbound deliveries.-Resolution-System standard behavior. We should use the two reports for different usages.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Report, Delivered Quantity

Title: When Changing the Start Time of a Production Proposal, System Changes it to a Later Time Automatically
Content: Symptom-When changing start time to a early time like 01:30 for a production proposal, system always changes it to a later time like 09:00 automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control work center.-Go to Process Production Proposals view.-Search XYZ (XZY represents the ID of a production proposal), click Edit.-Under tab General, change the time of start date to an early time like 01:30, system will change it back to a later time like 09:00 automatically.-Cause-If the start time of site operation hours is 09:00, then for corresponding production proposal, it is impossible to set its start time earlier than 09:00.-Resolution-Standard system behavior. Customer can change the start time of site operation hours if they would like to use earlier times in production proposal.-Keywords-Production Proposal, Start Date, Change

Title: When Migrating BoM, Error Triggered "Variant 1 of XYZ not consistent", "No released item change state assigned to variant 1".
Content: Symptom-When migrating BOM through migration tool, in step 3 "Simulate Import", error triggered "Variant 1 of XYZ not consistent", "No released item change state assigned to variant 1".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view. -Search under activity list "Migration of Bills of Material", and click Open.-Click "Migrate bills of material using the migration tool".-In the new window, select the file you want to migrate, click Execute Migration - Execute Migration Step by Step.-On Step 3 "Simulate Import", there are errors:-"Variant 1 of BOM XYZ (XYZ represents the BOM ID) not consistent."-"No released item change state assigned to variant 1."-Cause-In this migration file, ECC used for BOM XYZ is in process status instead of completed.-Resolution-You need to use completed ECC in migration file.-Keywords-BOM, migration, ECC, Variant

Title: Production Request and Production Order not shown on Production Control Work Center although Production Request is seen on Supply Control Work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-# Archived Reason: Invalid KBA#-Production Requests which are created for product DEF are not visible as mentioned below*DEF refers to Product id, *KLM refers to Resource ID, * GHI refers to Production Request Id-Check Production Control - Production Orders >> No Production order is created-Check Production Control - Production Requests >> No Production Request is shown-Check Supply Control - Monitor Production Requests >> Production Request is shown-Production Control - Production Orders >> No Production order is created-Check Production Control - Production Requests >> No Production Request is shown-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center-Navigate to Production Requests View-Production Request GHI is not seen-Go to Supply Control Work Center-Navigate to Monitor Production Request-You see Production Request GHI-Cause-We see Production Request corresponding  Production Bill of Operation's Resource KLM's Shift Program Recur Every entry is missing.-Resolution-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center -Navigate to Resources View-Search for Resource KLM and select Edit-Navigate to Operating Times tab-Select Operating Time Type and double-click Shift program-Select Recurrence and maintain recurrence every value-Select Save-See Also-Keywords-Production Request and Production Order not shown on Production Control Work Center, Production Request and Production Order not shown on Production Control Work Center although Production Request is seen on Supply Control Work center, Operating Time Type, recurrence every, Shift program,

Title: Start Feasibility Function not following the sequence while executing Production Tasks
Content: Symptom-You are trying to make use of Start feasibility function during production task execution and as per the list Green color one's is used to judge production tasks as executable and actionable, but some orders do not yet have a supply task, but the lower operations or tasks shows that the task can be started,which is confusing for users to follow the sequence according to the feasibility in green-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center-Navigate to Task Control View-Search for Production Order-System lists all Production Tasks with Start Feasibility as green randomly, yellow for few and red for few tasks-Resolution-Start Feasibility indicator does not check the sequence as such but checks if that individual task can be started or not.. System will check the dates, the availability of products.-Note: In order to follow the sequence of tasks in an order, follow the below steps-Go to Production Control Work Center-Go to by Orders via Production Orders View-Search for relevant Production Order-Select Edit-Navigate to Order Structure-You can follow the sequence listed as per tasks listed in Order sequence tab -Keywords-Start Feasibility Function not following the sequence while executing Production Tasks , Start feasibility function during production task execution and as per the list Green color one's is used to judge production tasks as executable, Production Tasks with Start Feasibility as green randomly, yellow for few and red for few tasks,

Title: Storage Constraints is Red for a Specific Logistics Area When Selecting Source Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-When confirming a put-away task and selecting Source Logistics Area, Storage Constraints is red for a specific Logistics Area.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search task XXX, click Confirm.-Under tab Line Items, select a line item whose product is ABC, click on the selection button of Source Logistics Area.-In the pop-up window, select All results for Result Type, click Go, we can see for logistics area XYZ, Storage Constraints is red.-Cause-In the master data of logistics area XYZ, under tab Restrictions - Allowed Products, the product ABC is not in the list.-Resolution-Add product ABC in the Allowed Products of logistics area XYZ.-Keywords-Storage Constraints, Logistics Area, Allowed Products

Title: Inbound Delivery Notification Can Not Be Opened And Can Not Be Found in Document Flow And under Inbound Delivery Notification View
Content: Symptom-It was noticed that the font of the Inbound Delivery Notification(IDN) ID is dummy for some documents and cannot be opened.-Moreover IDN cannot be found in document flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Inbound Deliveries View.-Search for Inbound Delivery ABC (ABC means Inbound Delivery ID), notice that the font of the corresponding IDN ID is dummy and the IDN cannot be opened.-Edit Inbound Delivery ABC.-Go to Document Flow Tab, notice that there is not IDN document.-Cause-When Posts Goods Receipt directly based on Purchase Order, instead of creating Inbound Delivery Notification and Posting Goods Receipt based on it, the IDN document is not created.-If chooses Post Goods Receipt instead of New Supplier Delivery Notification after selecting the Purchase Order under Inbound Logistics - Purchase Orders View, IDN will not be created.-Although the system requires to fill in the Delivery Notification ID while creating Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipts, it is only for recording purposes and does not create a corresponding IDN document for it.-Resolution-It's an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification; ID; Dummy; Document Flow.

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2111 Hotfix Collection 2 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 2 performed in 2111 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 11th of December. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2111 HFC 2-Resolution-Cross - Area Topic-Business Configuration Tools-Internal logging functions have been enhanced for remote merge of Business Configuration change projects. (Hotfix ID: 1000012995)-Business Partner-In the private account UI of the SAP Cloud Application Studio, it is now possible to add your own embedded component under the section, 'Tax Data'. (Hotfix ID: 4500015801)-Business Task Management-The step name for multi-step approval process was not visible in Managing My Area screen for Approval Task. With the fix provided, step name is now visible. (Hotfix ID: 1000015345. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-UI Client-In Reports, the issue with the missing icons such as the calendar, value help, and down arrows have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500014514)-The following issues have now been fixed:-Empty value on tooltip of annotation-The number of visible rows for a table on pop-ups was different.-In any Advanced List Pane, if you move the horizontal scroll bar up or down (if it was visible) to reduce/increase the number of rows shown, the scroll bar was disappearing when you move it halfway up a row. (Hotfix ID: 1000016222)-The following issues have been fixed:-Managing My Area Approval due date is not the same as Approval due date when you enter the specific document for approval.-The new Drag and Drop feature for attachments was not present on all work centers.-The tables were appearing in different colors making it difficult to read.-When using the print function on an opportunity, multiple header records on the PDF were seen, instead of the single line that used to exist.-When updating the deviating cost assignment to include the intercompany task on an expense report, there was an SAP internal error. (Hotfix ID: 1000011506)-In Microsoft Teams Application for SAP Business ByDesign, it was not possible to click the Save button after the object or object list was selected. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000014526. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Application errors in the Overview screen of the Project Management work center have now been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000015277. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Google Maps Mashup was failing due to issues. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000016300)-When using the value help to search for a keyword in the Hebrew UI, the pop-up suggestion list was not displayed. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000012575. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The mobile app version of SAP Business ByDesign is now consistent with the desktop version. (Hotfix ID: 1000016041. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The following issues have now been fixed.-In any Advanced List Pane, if you move the horizontal scroll bar up to reduce, then the scroll bar was disappearing when you move it halfway up a row.-When accessing SAP Business ByDesing using the browser, Safari (version 15), the work center menus were appearing blank or broken. (Hotfix ID: 1000013638)-Analytics Tools & Frameworks-In case, a Non-SAP standard language is implemented, the relative selects were not correctly working. With this fix, in case a translation is missing, the English translation is now used as fallback. (Hotfix ID: 1000012207)-Key User Translation-With the fix provided, critical business features are introduced to the Language Adaptation Tool (LAT) which increase the scope of language coverage with LAT significantly. The new elements introduced are:-In LAT, when collecting message texts for translation, selection of a new flag 'Get All Messages' result in the collection of all user relevant system messages available, into a single text pool. It is advised for reasons of easier handling going forward, to create one text pool where messages are exclusively translated and collected and not include message collection into multiple text pools.-Texts in tiles contained in the overview/quick link pages are now included in LAT. This implies that the quick link texts are all covered as well as most of the tile header titles. Some limitations exist if tiles contain analytical report data, and these tiles may not yet be fully translated.-In the closing cockpit, the list of task type/activity names that are proposed by the system at the creation of a new closing cockpit activity (created anew without reference to existing closing cockpit activities) is now translated with LAT. (Hotfix ID:4500014976)-SAP Intelligent Robotic Process Automation-You cannot subscribe/unsubscribe to IRPA application if you have activated or requested a restore point from your tenant, or if you do not have a valid user license for SAP Business ByDesign. (Hotfix ID: 4500011779, 4500016070)-In IRPA Provisioning, a mandatory check for email ID is now applicable only for a business user and not for a technical user. (Hotfix ID: 1000016140. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.) -Suppliers-This issue with the field, 'Tax Exemption Reason' during migration of supplier data has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000016321)-  Customer Relationship Management-Product Category Hierarchy-The Product Category ID for entitlement products has been PSM read-released. This enables you to change the Product Category ID in bulk by using OData as there is no mass data maintenance for entitlement products. (Hotfix ID: 4500014621)-Service Desk-The Country dialing code was not editable while trying to update the phone number of a Buyer party through service request A2X. This has been fixed by excluding the changes for country dialing code as it gets determined based on the country in Business Configuration fine-tuning activity. (Hotfix ID: 1000016900)-Customer Invoice-When the shipping condition entered in a sales order was copied to an invoice request, it was resulting in an error due to missing incoterms and the status was changing to inconsistent. This has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000014906)-Material-It is no longer possible to provide UoM characteristics such as weight, volume, length, width, and height for sales kit headers. (Hotfix ID: 1000015205. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Customer Contract-In a customer contract, any change to the Customer Contract ID of an item was not getting updated in the Revenue Accounting Contract (RAC). This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013115)-  Financial Management-Financial Accounting-Sales orders were failing after coming to Accounting due to a memory issue and the Outbound Delivery and Third-Party Delivery Notifications were not getting released in the system. This issue is fixed now. (Hotfix ID 1000012166. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Processing a retry on a failed message was resulting in an application error on the Message Monitor. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000012779)-The fix provided corrects the Switzerland QR Bill attributes mapping for the supplier invoice scanning scenario. (Hotfix ID: 1000015024)-The issue with user authorization in Central Bank Reporting -> Determine Central Bank Codes, has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000011333. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Currency-The Venezuelan Bolívar Soberano (VES) is now redenominated by removing six zeros from the denominations. A new currency code VED/926 representing the new valuation (1,000,000 times old VES/928) was introduced in October 2021 for any internal needs during the redenomination process but is not replacing VES as the official currency code. The Central Bank of Venezuela is not adopting the new codes in the local system and VES/928 remains in use. The actual currency code VES/928 remains the valid code from 1 October 2021, for use in any future transactions to indicate the redenominated Bolívar Soberano. Until further notice, VES/928 and VED/926 remain on the 'List one: Currency, fund and precious metal codes'. (Hotfix ID: 1000016040)-Treasury Intelligence Solutions-In the Treasury Intelligence Solutions (TIS) XML Payment batch file for Ukraine, the reason code is no longer defaulted to '999999'. (Hotfix ID: 4500014443)-Expense Report-It was not possible to use the business object ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT, node ITINERARY_SEGMENT, field STY_LOC_EXP_REP_PER_DIM_REG in the Partner Development Infrastructure (PDI) solution as its subcomponents, LIST_ID and CONTENT had not been released for public write access yet. These are now released with the fix provided. (Hotfix ID: 4500014765)-You can now use custom tax code in Expense Reporting for United Kingdom (UK) by scoping the question, 'Custom Tax code Configuration in Expense Report-United Kingdom'. Note that, only those tax codes created with the tax events already supported for UK are visible in the Expense Reports. (Hotfix ID: 1000014225)-Inventory-The fix provided avoids the locking of the copy of Sales and Service Document for Accounting during Actual Cost Allocation run. (Hotfix ID: 4500013558)-Goods and activity confirmations can be processed along with product specification even after scoping Consignment in the system. (Hotfix ID: 1000014108)-Payment Processing-Issues related to Excel export for change log of Outgoing Bank Transfer payment method have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500016050)-The fix provided ensures that, the inclusion of Addenda Record in the US ACH CCD/PPD file format does not cause any inconsistency when the files are submitted to the banks for processing. (Hotfix ID: 1000015935. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Payment File Format-For Japan, in case of the company name was updated, for domestic / foreign payment file format, the updated company name was not always reflected during the payment file generation. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000012073)-Payment Card-The Digital Payment add-on, which is available on select systems (controlled availability) was having a problem during the card registration. The currency code for the PSP determination was not passed to the Digital Payment system due to which the merchant was not determined. This issue has now been fixed by passing the currency code. (Hotfix ID: 1000016681)-Payment Management-With this fix, the system retrieves the valid Employee Identification Number in the US CCD/CTX payment file. (Hotfix ID: 1000016840)-The Payment document was showing the incorrect status in the Payment Monitor view of the Payment Management work center when the payment is sent for a cancellation approval. This issue was occurring only for the outgoing payment methods (e.g., Bank Transfers) and has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000015714)-For Israel, the fix provided includes general improvements and correction for the amount spelling in the printing of the Outgoing Check and Bank-to-Bank Transfer forms. Both forms now get the amount spelled with proper concatenated words (if applicable for a language) between integer and decimal word parts, and the currency sub-unit text gets added automatically in the form itself depending on the language and payment currency. In the Outgoing Check form, the hidden label for adding the currency sub-unit text has been removed and is now contained in the script-logic directly itself including language and currency dependency. Furthermore, the Outgoing Check form for country Israel was improved with respect to layout, labeling, and field mapping. For easier checking / form adaptation, look out for tags #CURRENCY, #LANGUAGE in the script comments of the print forms mentioned. (Hotfix ID: 1000013048)-Travel & Expense Management-For Denmark, new tax-free rates for mileage and meals allowance for the year 2022 are now updated in the system. (Hotfix ID: 4500013653)-for United Kingdom (UK) Expense Reporting, new fuel rates are now available for the month of December 2021. (Hotfix ID: 4500013155)-Communities in Austria undergo constant change as the per law of the 9 federal states in Austria. Each community has its own code and whenever a community is newly founded or merged with others, the code changes. Hence, codes 70327 Matrei am Brenner, 70330 Mühlbachl, and 70341 Pfons, are delimited to December 31, 2021, and the new community code, 70370 Matrei am Brenner is valid from January 1, 2202. (Hotfix ID: 4500013967)-Statutory Reporting-Unified Report while submitted at tax authority portal was resulting in some errors in the simulator. The fix provided relates to Payment confirmation involving documents with Outgoing Bank Transfer as the payment mode. Previously, the document number and party number were not appearing, which has also been fixed now. (Hotfix ID: 1000013737)-The fix provided ensures that, in Journal - France report, the clearing date is not be filled in the attachment without a proper clearing document. For the unpaid invoices/documents, the clearing date is left empty. (Hotfix ID: 1000011568)-Tax Declaration & Management-The fix provided includes legal changes for German Monthly Form 2022. (Hotfix ID: 4500013967)-VAT On Cash (VoC) invoices amount and payment against the VoC invoices is now captured in 347 return and withholding tax documents are excluded from the return. (Hotfix ID: 4500014651)-With this fix, for tax basic countries all the One-Stop Shop (OSS) relevant documents is only be picked up with the partner has implemented OSS tax return type. (Hotfix ID: 4500013647)-Cancellation Invoices with VAT on Cash (VoC) and cancellation invoice of Non-EU supplier without a tax number in master data are rejected by the tax authority due to incorrect period and invalid tax ID respectively. (Hotfix ID: 1000013009)-The 1099 Non-Employee Compensation (NEC) files have been modified as per the IRS specification for the year, 2021. (Hotfix ID 1000012167)-For Germany, the VAT Yearly form for the year 2021 is updated as per the legal specifications. (Hotfix ID: 1000015515)-Payment Times Reporting functionality was providing the wrong bank value for some entries- predicted date instead of the actual bank statement date. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000015421)-One-Stop Shop (OSS) Tax code is not relevant for private accounts in the Canary Island because of the extra-community territory status of Canary Islands. With the fix provided, the system now auto-determines either the tax code with zero rate or an exempt tax code based on the extra-community territory setting. (Hotfix ID: 1000013829)-For Italy, Spesometro is no longer applicable for supplier invoices with reverse charge and for self-invoices posted from January 1, 2022. It is now replaced by an XML file that is generated with each of the invoice posted. The XML file generated, is to be sent to the tax authority for VAT declaration purposes. (Hotfix ID: 1000011178)-With this hotfix, the changes related to 1099 MISC files as per latest IRS specification for 2021 are provided. (Hotfix ID: 1000013929)-The configuration for External Tax Event Determination has been enhanced with two additional parameters relating to Incoterms and the Incoterms Location to facilitate better differentiation between tax locations and events. The parameter Incoterm Location in the configuration is only evaluated if the parameter Incoterms is also entered. It may however be left empty in the configuration as well such that only Incoterms are required to match. The evaluation of the parameter match during tax event determination is executed by retrieving the corresponding parameter values from the source documents. This has been enabled for the following source documents- outgoing documents, sales orders, customer invoice request as well as customer invoice, incoming documents, purchase order and supplier invoice request. The document type supplier invoice itself does not carry information related to Incoterms and the parameter match is however constituted by checking for the Incoterms information on the referenced supplier invoice request to allow for a consistent tax event determination across the entire document chain using the configuration. (Hotfix ID: 1000014694)-  Project Management-Project Processing-When a project invoice request was being created or processed, and the addresses of several languages were entered, some party names or addresses were shown in a language different from the logon language. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013415)-  Human Capital Management-Inventory-In the Stock Overview data source and reports created from this data source, if the Owner ID field was viewed from the list of characteristics, the associated Party ID was shown instead of the Business Partner ID. As the Owner refers to the Business Partner and not the Party, a new characteristic 'Owner (Business Partner ID)' is now provided, which shows the Business Partner correctly. The existing characteristic 'Owner' has not been changed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013827)-Time & Labour Management-During scanning of expense receipts via the expense receipt scanning functionalities, there were situations where the date, country, and city were not extracted accurately by the automatic extraction process. This was because of a check, which always ensured to extract values if they pass the minimum score of 50% accuracy. However, if was found, if the minimum score threshold is removed, there is a positive impact on the overall accuracy for scanning. The fix provided ensures that these threshold conditions are removed to prevent some correct values from being extracted for having a lesser score than 50%. (Hotfix ID: 4500011969)-With the Employee Central integration with SAP Business ByDesign, there were cases where some queried employees were found to have concurrent employment which was not supported in SAP Business ByDesign. However, it is possible to change the replication requests after querying and avoid such employments manually. After these changes in the replication requests, the employees can be replicated. This fix ensures that such employee replication requests from Employee Central are not skipped but staged in the SAP Business ByDesign system and marked as not relevant for replication automatically. Such requests can be manually changed and replicated by the user. (Hotfix ID: 1000016381. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Due to an issue, it was not possible to perform employee termination. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID:1000015175. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-When an employee requests for leave, the employee absence is usually reflected in the resource calendar. However, there were some scenarios where cancelled leaves were not reflected. This fix ensures that such cancelled leaves are also accounted for and reflected correctly in the resource calendar. (Hotfix ID: 1000016030)-  Supply Chain Management-Product Lot-Production Lot UUID has now been enabled as a query parameter on the standard Query Production Lot web service. (Hotfix ID: 1000014553)-Inventory Processing-The web service InventoryProcessingGoodsAndActivityConfirmation-> GoodsConsumptionForProject was resulting in an application error when the Project Reference ID was passed. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000014204. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Logistics Task folder-The query on the Logistics Task folder was not working due to a lot of data for which a new query was added previously. However, there was an issue with the query and the Item Receipt Date was not working correctly. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000012369. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Demand Plan-The node SupplyPlanningAreaScope of the business object DemandPlan is now PSM write-released. (Hotfix ID: 1000014757)-Analytics-Customer Consignment Report was showing an incorrect Custodian Party. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013247)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Purchase Order-Kit information attributes is now PSM-released for purchase orders at the item level. (Hotfix ID: 1000011826)-You can now edit the Product Requirement Specification (PRS) for items created or updated after the purchase order is sent. (Hotfix ID: 1000013555. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Supplier Invoice-In supplier invoice approval task, the approver can now see the currency in the subject line of Managing My Area work center. (Hotfix ID: 4500014685. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-With this fix, sequential numbering per supplier for Evaluated Receipt Settlement (ERS) Belgium has been enabled on the system. (Hotfix ID: 1000014028)-With this fix, the correct supplier invoice numbering rule is chosen, even in case of a business partner address change. Previously, this was not getting reflected in the supplier invoice. (Hotfix ID: 1000013796)-The fix provided stops budget checks for down payment requests. (Hotfix ID: 1000015054)-In supplier invoice approval task, the approver can now see the currency in the subject line of Managing My Area work center. (Hotfix ID: 1000008588. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g., operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2111; HFC02; Hotfix; SPS02; Hotfix Collection; 2111

Title: How to initially load Stock type pre-delivered or Custodian Stock
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to load stock type pre-delivered/custodian for a Product KLM.*KLM refers to Product id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Navigate to Overview View-Select from drop down as Activities-Search for *Inventory*-Select Inventory and Open-Select Manually enter inventory-Select Stock type as "Stock at Customer"-Maintain Site id , Product ID KLM, Custodian ID , quantity-Select Save-Note:Kindly make sure you do not have any pre-delivered stock available before performing these steps.-Keywords-Pre-Delivered stock adjustment, Custodian stock adjustment, Custodian stock load

Title: Error in Supplier Invoice:Quantity not assigned to goods and services receipt
Content: Symptom-You have a supplier invoice where you get the following error or exception: Quantity not assigned to goods and services receipt. This exception was not there when the invoice got posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Open the respective paid or posted invoice-Navigate to exceptions tab or select "Check"-Error is displayed-Cause-The supplier invoice is created with respect to delivery documents which got generated from time recording.-If you open any of the active time entry related goods and services receipt, you cannot cancel it directly.-In this case, you have canceled time entry after invoice was posted and/or paid which is why the follow-up delivery(goods receipt) documents got canceled later and now it is throwing new errors in the invoice.-Resolution-You should submit the time entries for the relevant project task, purchase order and service agent in the system again and then it will automatically create the delivery documents from them and system will assign them to the respective supplier invoice.-It is always suggested to release the delivery documents first and then invoicing should be done w.r.t the delivery document to avoid such issues.-You should not cancel any related documents once invoice is posted. If you have to cancel, you should cancel the documents in reverse order starting from the last document as per the document flow.-Keywords-quantity not assigned to goods and services receipt, time recording, time recording goods receipt, canceled time entry, exception in supplier invoice

Title: The Outstanding quantity or hours on the time-sheet is different compared to the Remaining Hours in Project
Content: Symptom-You are entering timesheet for a project and remaining quantity or hours is incorrect and not as expected. But in project view, you can see remaining quantity/hours is correct as per planned hours.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in as service agent-Go to Home work center-Select Edit timesheet view-Select the project task and respective purchase order.-The remaining quantity shows X+1 h (X refers to hours/quantity)-Cause-In the project task, the remaining quantity is X hours, however you have manually changed the actual quantity in the associated purchase order which got created from project purchase request. When time sheet is updated, you also assign respective purchase order along with the project task, hence the remaining hours/quantity shows a different value compared to what is there on project screen.-Resolution-You should manually correct the purchase order quantity or maintain the same data in project and associated purchase order to avoid such issue.-Keywords-Outstanding quantity on the time-sheet is incorrect, remaining hours in project and time sheet quantity, purchase order hours/quantity, remaining hours

Title: Open Supplier Invoice Approval task exist though Invoice status is posted or paid
Content: Symptom-You are unable to approve the Supplier invoice and you noticed hat invoice is already posted or paid.-Environment-SAp Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Approval process and its conditions:-Step 1 Supplier invoice with PO reference - Approver A-Step 2 Supplier invoice w/o PO reference -  Approver B-Steps to create documents:-Create  new PO and approve it  -create Invoice with respect to the PO you created and save-later remove the PO reference in invoice and accept  all exceptions and  sent for approval  -Go to approval tab you will see only step 1 approvers only-Approve using Approver A.-You will see that invoice is posted but the task is still appearing under business task management view.-Go to approval tab of invoice you will see step 2 appearing that is approver B- This new task sent for B is open and thus is not allowed to be approved-Steps that approver would follow:- Go to Managing my area work center- Go to Approvals view- Select the supplier invoice approval task- Click on approval task-approve button is grayed out-Cause-Due to technical limitation currently condition "Reference to Purchase Order[] Does not Contain " is not working  fine in your scenario,-where you removed the Purchase order reference manually in invoice.-Resolution-1.We request  you to use the rule "Item Without Purchase Order" equal to "No/Yes" instead. once changes are made in approval process then all future invoices created newly will have no such open tasks.-2. Please check if you have such open tasks and give us the list in excel so that we can manually complete them in back end.-Keywords-wrong approval task; open approval task, unable to  approve, why new task is triggered, again task is triggered, task is not complete

Title: Two Inbound Delivery Notifications with Same ID
Content: Symptom-You find that two inbound delivery notifications (IDN) have the same ID and that they correspond to different documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Search for IDN XXX.-You will find two Inbound Delivery Notifications with same ID XXX.-Cause-It is a coincidence that the intercompany Outbound Delivery (OD) ID already has an IDN created in the system with the same ID.-This is limitation in the system and can be reproduced in the following steps,-Create an intercompany scenario，e.g. an internal sales order after a purchase order.-Process the Sales Order to OD but do not release it.-Create a standard Purchase Order.-Create an IDN from the standard Purchase Order with the same ID as the intercompany OD ID.-Release intercompany OD.-This will create a second IDN with the same ID as in an intercompany scenario, the IDN is create with the same ID as the intercompany OD.-Resolution-In terms of existing issue, it's a good way that roll back the intercompany scenario and cancel the OD and create a new one.-Two ways to prevent this from happening in the future.-Set up number formatting for the companies used in intercompany scenario, this would add a prefix to the OD automatically created. Meaning, there would be no previous IDN with the same ID. OD number formatting can be done in the Business Configuration setting "Document Numbering Formats for Outbound Delivery". How to configure it is detailed in the Configuration: Document Numbering Formats for Outbound Delivery.-Add a prefix to the notification ID when creating an IDN for Purchase Order manually.-See Also-3262076 - Same Inbound Delivery Notification ID for Different Purchase Orders-Configuration: Document Numbering Formats for Outbound Delivery-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notifications; Same ID; intercompany.

Title: The Due Date of the Purchase Order Approval Task is not as expected
Content: Symptom-You have a purchase order approval task where the due date of the task is not as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view Business Task Management-Click Task icon on the task:Approve Purchase Order X(X refers to purchase order ID)-Due date shows a different date than expected one.-Cause-There's a due date setting in Business configuration Activity 'Business Task Management for Purchase Request and Order Management'. Here, you have set the due date to a different date.-Resolution-You can manually change the due date in this fine tuning activity as per your requirement.-Keywords-Business Task Management, Approve Purchase Order, purchase order approval task, Business Task Management for Purchase Request and Order Management, The Due Date of the Purchase Order Approval Task

Title: Error Appears While Trying to Migrate the Project
Content: Symptom-Error appears while trying to migrate the project ABC.-Error:-Employee Y does not exist-External team member added. Review the approval settings-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center -Go to the Overview and Select Migration of Projects activity -Migrate projects using the migration tool-Execute migration step by step-Error appears-Cause-During the project migration when you select Execute Migration Step by Step, you will find next step i.e. Convert Values. Here if you select the rule "Edit Value Conversion for Employee ID", you will see that the employee X (Source Value) which is used in the template is mapped to employee Y (Target Value) which does not exist. Hence the error message appears.-Resolution-You need to enter a valid employee ID in the Target Value section and later simulation can be executed successfully.-Keywords-Employee Y does not exist; External team member added. Review the approval settings; Project Migration; Migration of projects

Title: Error while Assigning shopping cart: Total gross/net amount differs from sum of item amounts
Content: Symptom-The shopping cart creator has left the company and there is an open task in the system, so you are trying to assign the cart to another user to complete the task, but you get following error:-Total gross/net amount differs from sum of item amounts.-Save failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view: Task Distribution-Select  Shopping Cart Management subview-Select the shopping cart and assign to another user-Error: Total gross/net amount differs from sum of item amounts.-Cause-The error is due to exchange rate issue. There are 2 different currencies maintained in the shopping cart under (price)  and under (Net value/limit) and exchange rate is not maintained between them.-Resolution-Please maintain the exchange rate in this path: General Ledger-> Common tasks-> Edit Exchange Rate and ensure that the validity dates are relevant to shopping cart.-Keywords-Shopping Cart Management, open task for shopping cart, Total gross/net amount differs from sum of item amounts, exchange rate, assign shopping cart

Title: Follow-up Document related Fields are missing in Purchase Order Items
Content: Symptom- You have created a purchase order but you are unable to find the follow up document check box like "Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected" under Items tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Order-Open the relevant purchase order and navigate to items tab-Select one line item and under Basic sub-tab following follow up document related check box are missing-Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected/Goods and Services Receipt Expected/Invoice Expected.-Cause-You have not configured the fine tuning activity options for "Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings".-Resolution-Please maintain the settings in Business Configuration work center-> fine tuning activity: Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings.-Keywords-follow up document fields missing in purchase order, check box are missing in purchase order items, Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected, Goods and Services Receipt Expected, Invoice Expected check box missing in purchase order.

Title: Field Actual Quantity value is not populated in Pick List Form
Content: Symptom-In PDF generated Pick List form, you see field actual quantity is missing although the corresponding Pick Task KLM status is Finished and field actual quantity has a value.*KLM refers to Pick Task no-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Task Control View-Search for KLM-Click Confirm-Click Preview-You see Actual quantity is missing on the preview PDF-Cause-The pick list form is used to inform the warehouse worker how much quantity should be picked from where. Once the task is confirmed or the status is in "Finished" status which means that the open quantity is zero and no more quantity needs to be fulfilled.This is the reason why pick list form will not display the fulfilled quantity or actual quantity.-Resolution-Actual Business Scenario: The pick list form is printed out to the warehouse worker with the quantity that needs to be picked (Open quantity) and the warehouse worker updates manually how much quantity is picked (Actual Quantity) in the pick list form.The outbound delivery will be generated for the same.This is the designed behavior.-Keywords-Fulfilled quantity is not populated in Pick List Form, Pick List form  fulfilled quantity is not showing up although the corresponding Pick Task KLM status is Finished

Title: Intercompany Supplier Invoice Is Not Getting Generated
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2677533***-Intercompany Supplier Invoice is not generated from Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search and open the respective Sales Order.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-See that after the Customer Invoice, no Supplier Invoice has been generated.-Cause-One of the reasons is that in the Customer Invoice Template, there is a special character, such as '/' which is not supported, hence the Supplier Invoice does not get created.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, please edit the template through the following steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Form Template Maintanance view.-Search for the respective template used for the Customer Invoices.-Remove the Special Characters from the Form Template Name and upload it again.-Once this is done, please create a new document and the Supplier Invoice should be generated.-In case necessary, for existing documents please report an incident to SAP in order to retrigger the Supplier Invoice from the backend.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Supplier Invoice, Intercompany Supplier Invoice, Intercompany scenario

Title: Purchase Order Header Discount Is Applied To Cancelled Items
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order Header Discount is applied to Cancelled Items.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the respective Purchase Order.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Prices tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-Select 'Overall Discount (Value)'.-Enter an Amount.-Go to the Items tab.-Select the Cancelled Item.-Click on the Prices sub-tab.-See that the Overall Discount (Value) is displayed for this Canceled item. -Cause-The header level of the Purchase Order takes into account the net price of the cancelled item as well. So, this is the expected behavior for the scenario, the cancelled item is also considered for the Header discount calculation.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior for the scenario, the cancelled item is also considered for the Header discount calculation.-Keywords-Discount, Purchase Order, Price

Title: The Quantity of Proposed Purchase Proposal is Less Than Demand
Content: Symptom-You executed Material Planning for a Product and you expected the system to create a Purchase Proposal with the Quantity X and on the date dd/mm/yyyy. However, the system created the Purchase Proposal with a lesser quantity than the expected Quantity X and a second Purchase Proposal with Quantity Y on a date later than dd/mm/yyyy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center. -Go to the Products view. -Find and select the relevant Product.-Click the Open button to open the Product Planning Details.-Perform a Planning Run.-You can see that there are 2 Purchase Proposals with different Availability Dates.-You expected the system to create just one purchase Proposal.-Cause-The system has created the 2 Purchase Proposals, because there are 2 Dependent Demands of different dates. Since the Availability Dates of the Demands are outside of the same bucket as defined in your material master Planning tab, the system has created the 2 Proposals.-Resolution-You cannot get a single proposal if the Demand dates are of different buckets. This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Lot-Sizing Method, Periodic lot-size, Period Type, WEE - Week

Title: Migration of Purchase Orders Does Not Create Goods And Services Receipt
Content: Symptom-The Migration of Purchase Orders does not create Goods and Services Receipt.-In the Migration file, the fields 'Delivered Quantity' and 'Delivered Quantity - UOM' are fulfilled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click on Open Activity List button.-Go to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Search and open the activity "Migration of Accounting Transaction Data".-Click on the Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the Migration Unit with title 'EN_Purchase_Oders2xml.xml'.-Click on the 'Execute Migration' button.-Click on the 'Execute Migration Step by Step'.-Execute the Import.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the Purchase Order migrated.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-See that the system did not create the Goods and Services Receipt, there is a document there but it is not clickable.-Cause-The Goods and Services Receipt is not created when migrating Purchase Orders. The option is available when there is already a Goods and Services Receipt in the legacy system, so the Supplier Invoice Document can be created in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Once the Purchase Order is migrated with the delivery document, the Supplier Invoice can be created via the Supplier Invoicing work center > Invoice Entry > All Orders to be Invoiced > Enter the Purchase Order ID.-See Also-Help Document: Configuration: Migration of Open Goods Receipts-Help Document: Configuration: Migration of Purchase Orders-Keywords-Purchase Orders, Migration, Goods and Services Receipt

Title: Planning Area And Planning Group Not Appearing For Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order Planning Area and Planning Group not appearing for Purchase Orders without Purchase Requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the respective Purchase Order.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Planning sub-tab.-See that the Planning Area and Planning Group fields are blank.-Cause-The Planning Area and Planning Group are displayed if the Purchase Order was created by a Purchase Proposal and then a Purchase Request.-In case the Purchase Order is created manually, the reference will not display. In order to see this reference, the Purchase Order should be created from the SCM part as well.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-2877138 - Manually Created Purchase Request is Not Visible in Either the Product Planning Screen (Supply Planning) or Monitor Purchase Requests Screen (Supply Control)-Keywords-Planning Area, Planning Group, Purchase Order, Purchase Request, Purchase Proposal

Title: Service Call Error when Trying to Upload a Migration File
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate a location in Logistics Layout under a site, you got an error message 'Service call error; report incident'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Workcenter.-Go to Overview.-In Business Configuration Search, select All configuration Elements.-Search for Migration of Location and Logistics Area in Type: Activity.-Select Migration of Location and Logistics Area.-Click Open.-Click Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool.-Upload the desired file to migrate it.--The error message 'Service call error; report incident' appears.-Cause-The issue is happening due to an incorrect fulfillment of the Storage Control Profile column in the migration file, filling it with the ID and a description.-When upload the migration file, it is necessary to fill the Storage Control Profile only with the ID, as this column does not support additional descriptions which leads to the error.-Resolution-In your migration file, fill the column Storage Control Profile with the ID only.-Keywords-migration file, migration, service call error, Migration of Location and Logistics Area, logistics layout, Storage Control Profile

Title: Cannot Use Product For an Outbound Pick Task
Content: Symptom-You are not able to use a stock for a outbound pick task, allocate it, consume it, change the status or anything else with this stock. This is happening even considering that the Warehouse Order and Customer return document are finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Stock Overview subview.-Search for the desired product ID and enter its respective Logistics Area.-Click Go.-Go to the Document Flow.-You notice that it is still tagged to an Inbound Delivery, even considering that the Warehouse order and Customer return document related were all finished.-Cause-Checking the Customer Return Delivery Notification, the setted Follow-up Activity is Return to Supplier. This lead to the delivery tag to be present across the stock even after the Inbound Delivery is release and the Customer Return completed, as the system expects a Return to Supplier to be created after the Inbound Delivery is completed.-This is an expected scenario and hence the tagging of the Inbound Delivery is valid.-Resolution-You can cancel the Inbound Delivery and Inbound Delivery Notification and create a new notification with a different follow up activity.-Keywords-outbound pick task, inbound delivery, stock

Title: System Dumps when Posting Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-System keeps loading the Goods Receipt for long time when you are trying to post it, resulting in a dump error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter.-Then select the Purchase Orders view.-Select the desired Purchase Order.-Click Post Goods Receipt.-After several minutes, a time-out dump appears.-Cause-The destination strategy maintained at the Logistics Site is Material Driven. In the Material Driven strategy, the last used Logistics Area is picked up when stock separators are present. In case no stock separators are there, the system proposes a Logistics Area randomly. This is the normal system behavior.-If there are not further rules maintained in the storage location and the Material Driven strategy is used for all the stock separators combination, it causes the time consuming process, leading to the dump.-Resolution-Setting the material flow rule accordingly to your business needs, avoiding to use the Material Driven strategy for all the stock separators combination.-Keywords-goods receipt, posting goods receipt, dump, time out error, material flow rule, material driven

Title: System Dumps While Trying to Approve Cycle Count Task
Content: Symptom-When trying to approve a Cycle Count task, a 500 SAP Internal Server Error appears.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory Workcenter.-Go to Monitory view.-Go to Work subview.-Select a task to approve.-Click button Approve Count.-The message error 500 SAP Internal Server Error appears.-Cause-The dump is faced because there are related Logistics Areas in the Physical Inventory Count that are currently marked as Obsolete.-Resolution-You can set the related Logistics Areas status to Active and proceed with the Approve Count of the document, then finish it approving the count. Once done, you can set the Logistics Areas back to Obsolete status again.-Keywords- approve cycle count task, cycle count task, dump, internal server error

Title: Post Action is Disabled in Goods and Services Receipt
Content: Symptom-You have created a new delivery document and entered all the necessary fields and trying to post a goods receipt but the post button is disabled or grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center- Select view Receipts and Returns- Select Show by Documents and open the delivery document id- Post button is disabled.-Cause-You have not entered any quantity in one of the line items in the delivery document, which is why the post action is disabled because delivery document must contain a quantity that needs to be delivered.-Resolution-Please enter a valid quantity in the delivery document for all line items and then try to post.-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipt, post action disabled in Goods and Services Receipt. post button grayed out in goods receipt, unable to post GSR

Title: System triggers error message "Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 30 characters" while trying to create New Registered Product ID
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new Registered Product ID  which exceeds 30 characters or more,error appears-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements Work Center -Navigate to Registered Products View-Select New --> Registered Product-Maintain the Registered Product id more than 30 characters-System triggers error message-"Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 30 characters"-Cause-This is the expected behavior Serial ID has to be less than or equal to 30 characters-Resolution-Currently we do not have any Business Configuration setting to extend the characters of Serial Number over and above 30. The feature to configure the Serial ID length is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-error message "Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 30 characters", System triggers error message "Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 30 characters" while trying to maintain Registered Product nomenclature

Title: Automatic Goods And Services Receipts Flag Missing On The Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-Automatic Goods and Services Receipts flag is missing on the Purchase Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the New Purchase Order common task.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-Select a Product ID.-See that on the Basic Data tab, Follow-up Documents section, the flag 'Automatic Goods and Services Receipts' is missing.-Cause-The field does not appear because it has to be selected in the Personalization/Adaptation mode.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, execute the following steps:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the New Purchase Order common task.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Click on the Avatar button.-Click on the Start Personalization Mode option.-Click on the Follow Documents option.-Mark the Automatic Goods and Services Receipts UI element as Visible.-Click on the Save button.-This selection can also be done via the Key User settings > Start Adaptation mode.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Automatic Goods and Services Receipts, Adaptation, Personalization

Title: Error 'Buyer Party no permitted for overhead cost projects' While Uploading Migration Of Multi-Customer Projects
Content: Symptom-Error Message 'Buyer Party no permitted for overhead cost projects' while Uploading Migration Of Projects-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Go to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Search and open the activity 'Migration of Projects'.-Click on the 'Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool' link.-Select the respective Migration Unit.-Click on the 'Execute Migration' button.-Click on the 'Execute Migration Step by Step'.-Click on the Next button until the Simulate Import.-System displays the error 'Buyer Party no permitted for overhead cost projects'.-Cause-The columns for "Account ID" or/and "Customer" are fulfilled and these fields are not used for Multi-Customer Projects.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, the fields belonging to Customer (Account) should be cleared.-Alternatively, the project type can be changed to "Customer project with sales integration" (Project Type 25) or "Direct cost project" (Project Type 20) and then the error should disappear.-Keywords-Migration of Projects, Multi-Customer Project, Customer, Account

Title: Delivery Schedule tab not available in migrated purchase orders
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the “Delivery Schedule” tab is not visible in the migrated POs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase order work center-Go to Purchase order view-Search and open the purchase order that was created via migration-Go to items tab-You don't find the delivery schedule tab-Cause-Currently we have not enabled this feature for the Purchase order which are created through migration.-Resolution-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-1.If you are a partner: you can  try and help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2.If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.  -Or      -a.
