Seems the restriction is not working for the user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application ans User Management work center.-Go to Business User view.-Edit Access Rights for user A.-Navigate to work center view ID: PRO_PROJECTS.-Set read access restricted to only one access group: user A, and write access with no access.-Then, log in user A.-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Filter the list All Projects.-User A can still see all the projects in the system.-Cause-User is assigned to PDI work centers.-Please separate the authorizations of business users and development users.-Resolution-Remove PDI work centers for the user, the access restriction of projects will work.-Keywords-Access restriction, Projects, PRO_PROJECTS, Project Management, Read access, Access group

Title: State of Taiwan supplier is not displaying in purchase order output form
Content: Symptom-You find that the state of Taiwan supplier in not displaying in purchase order output form-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Open purchase order ABC (ABC represents for the purchase order ID).-Navigate to General tab, you can see the state field has value in the order itself.-However, click on Preview button for created purchase order, there is no state information for supplier in the form template.-Cause-This is due to the address format is not defined for country Taiwan.-The state value is not fetched in the Address column in supplier master data.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Activity:  Countries/Regions.-Go to Edit Countries/Regions.-Filter TW and navigate to Postal Attributes.-See the Address Formatting Routine is blank.-Please enter 022 - China in the field.-Then go back to supplier master data, you will see that state value is fetched automatically.-Keywords-State, Purchase order, Output form template, Taiwan, Address formatting routine, Countries/Regions

Title: Which Date is Taken Into Consideration For Financial Postings When Confirming Put-Away Tasks?
Content: Symptom-You want to know which date is taken into consideration when confirming Put-Away tasks - the Actual Execution Date or the Actual Delivery Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the task XXX.-Select the task XXX.-Choose Confirm.--*XXX represents the Task ID.-Resolution-For two step inbound process:-In case of an Unload task, the business transaction date time actually comes from the Actual Delivery Date of the confirmed inbound delivery – this date is editable on the task (Admin section) until the first confirmation is posted. Once the first confirmation is posted, the field is no longer editable – it signifies the delivery was first received on the date specified for the first confirmation.-For a Put-Away task, the business transaction date time is mapped to the Actual Execution On date as here the goods are being moved from receiving staging area to another logistic area within the warehouse.-Keywords-put away task, actual delivery date, actual execution on

Title: While Confriming Production Task, System Not Considering Input Scrap Percentage
Content: Symptom-You have added Input Scrap Percentage in Production Model however when you confirm the production task system does not calculate the input product quantity including scrap percentage.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data WorkCentre.-Navigate to Production Models View.-Search for relevant Production Model ID and edit it.-View All then go to Bill of Operations tab, select Product Assignment subtab.-Verify if Input Scrap% is maintained.-Now Go to Production Control WorkCentre.-Go to the Task Control WorkCentre, search for relevant Task ID.-Select and click on Confirm, navigate to Input Products tab.-Here verify that if planned quantity is equal to BoM quantity + Scrap factor% (i.e., maintained in the relevant Production Model).-Now go to Output Products tab, enter the full Confirmed Quantity for Confirmation.-Again now when you check in Input Products tab, you can see only the BoM input quantities are present i.e. excluding scrap%.-System has not added scrap% while calculating Input products quantities.-Cause-System is not fetching the scrap details while confirming the task because user has entered the quantity manually. As per the design, this functionality of scrap only works if the button "Confirm as planned" is pressed while confirming the task.-If it is entered manually, it will be considered as explicit confirmation and consider the quantity as per BOM only.-Resolution-This functionality with input scrap works when user confirms the task using option Confirmed as Planned.-Keywords-Input Scrap, Confirm, production task, Production Input Scrap not working, Input Product Scrap, Confirm as Planned, input scrap, production model input scrap.

Title: Error: Negative stock not permitted in logistic area ABC, material XYZ.
Content: Symptom-When creating an Adjustment Confirmation, the system reports an error "Negative stock not permitted in logistic area ABC, material XYZ."-*ABC represents the logistic area's ID, while XYZ represents the ID of the material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work centre Inbound Logistics.-Select the View Warehouse Orders.-Search for the respective Warehouse Order.-Click Edit.-Click on the Adjustment Confirmation button.-Select the line with the product XYZ.-Click on the Enable Entry button.-Maintain Quantity Difference for the respective quantity, for example: - (minus) 5 ea.-Click on Save. --Result: The system shows the following errors-Inspection XXX is already cancelled so the identified stock or quantity cannot be changed. You should create new inspections.-(*XXX is the ID of the Inspection).-Negative stock not permitted in logistic area ABC, material XYZ-Save failed-Cause-Since this Warehouse Order is integrated with a Receiving Inspection, the system will look for stock with Inspection flag set.-However, there is no such stock available at the time of creating the Adjustment Confirmation.-Resolution-You need to perform a Change of Stock in order to set the Inspection flag for 5 ea of the product in question in logistic area ABC.-Keywords-adjustment confirmation,  Negative stock not permitted in logistic area ABC, material XYZ., Inspection XXX is already cancelled so the identified stock or quantity cannot be changed. You should create new inspections.

Title: Customer Name Not Available In Approval Project Time Recordings
Content: Symptom- Customer Name is not available in Project Time Approval.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Time Recordings view.-Filter for Task - Totals.-System shows no records found.-Open the Adaptation mode.-It is not possible to add a field for customer name.-Cause-It is a system behavior.-Resolution-You can search the task using the Project ID-Keywords-Customer Name; Time Recording; Project; Task;

Title: Inventory Balance Report Showing Wrong Ending Quantity
Content: Symptom-You have performed an Inventory Adjustment to zero the Quantity of a Product at a particular Site with a Key Date in the past. However, when you run the Inventory Balance report for the Product and enter the Actual Execution On Date as the Key Date of the Inventory Adjustment, you find that the Ending Quantity of the Product is not the expected Zero Quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Open the Inventory Balance report-Enter the Actual execution on date as same as the Key Date maintained in the Inventory Adjustment.-Enter the relevant Product ID.-Enter the relevant Site ID.-Click on Apply.-In the result, you can see the Ending Quantity is not zero. You expected the Quantity to be zero, and so you want to know why the system is behaving this way. -Cause-The available Inventory Quantity on the Key Date is greater than the adjusted available Inventory Quantity on the Created On date of the Inventory Adjustment.-On the said Key Date, the Opening Quantity for the Product is X whereas on the Created On date of the Inventory Adjustment, the Quantity available in the Inventory for Adjustment is Y. Therefore, when you performed the Adjustment, you only reduced the available Quantity Y to zero. However, between the Key Date you maintained in the Inventory Adjustment and the Date you created the document, you have consumed the Quantity m in a Sales Order. Hence, when you execute the report, the system is rightfully showing the Ending Quantity as the difference between the Opening Quantity X and the adjusted Quantity Y which is the Quantity m consumed in a Sales Order between the 2 dates.-This is the reason the Ending Quantity is not zero.-Resolution- The system is behaving correctly.-Keywords- Inventory Balance report, Inventory Adjustment, Zero Quantity

Title: Custom Tax code is Missing in Taxes dropdown in Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: As per incident 416346 / 2022- Non Z starting tax codes are appearing under supplier invoice or down payment request, so this KBA is no more valid.-You have created a custom tax code but it is not available for selection in supplier invoice item level tax code dropdown even though it is properly mapped to the tax type, tax rate type and income type.- Note:Supplier invoice could be credit memo or down payment or customs invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos or Invoice entry view-Create/Open the invoice-Select View All-Navigate to Items tab-Under Taxes, select Tax or withholding tax tab->Tax Code-> search in the dropdown-The custom tax code is not available for selection.-Cause-The custom tax code does not start with 'Z'.-Resolution-Please create a tax code name starting with 'Z' and then check the same in the invoice tax code selection.-Keywords-custom tax code missing, supplier invoice tax, withholding tax, tax code missing in supplier invoice taxes dropdown

Title: Error received in View "User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services"
Content: Symptom-Error when trying to PING Service for the SCANNED_SIV_INTEGRATION web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Go to User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services view. -In Services section, select Service Provider 'SCANNED_SIV_INTEGRATION'.-In Registered Users for Service section, select the employee.-Click in Ping Service button.-You get the error messages:-Cannot find entry /OAUTH20/CLIENT/USR_R/00163EC345301EEBB8811C3952BA in secure store SECSTORE E 023-Access context missing for account 00163EC345301EEBB8811C3952BA7BD8, please run access grant procedure-Cause-Upon ping of service, there might be an issue due to authorizations because the credentials are never exposed due to privacy issues since the service for Invoice scanning is not charged and SAP is bearing the costs here.-You can check if the credentials are successful by analyzing if the Master Data Synchronization is successful (Go to Application and User Management work center and Master Data Synchronization view).-Resolution-In case the Master Data Synchronization is successful, you can ignore those error messages and upload the scanned invoices with your user. You shouldn't face any issues.-Keywords-Invoice Scanning, Web Services, SCANNED_SIV_INTEGRATION, Master Data Synchronization

Title: Fields are showing as mandatory in Supplier Invoice "Basic" view and as not mandatory in Supplier Invoice "View All" screen.
Content: Symptom-Fields "Official Invoice ID" and "Approved On" are showing as mandatory in Mexico Supplier Invoice Overview and as not mandatory in Supplier Invoice "View All" screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Invoice Without Purchase Order-System shows the "Official Invoice ID" and "Approved On" fields as mandatory.-Click "View All"-System shows the "Official Invoice ID" and "Approved On" fields as not mandatory.-Cause-You have set the fields as mandatory on "basic" view from Adaptation mode.-But on "View All" screen, the option is unmarked.-Resolution-You need to mark mandatory on both "Basic" and "View All" screens from Adaptation mode as they are technically different screens.-Keywords-Official Invoice ID, Approved On, Mexico Supplier Invoice, adaptation mode, basic view, view all

Title: Created by Field is Blank in Goods and Service Receipt Document Created by Technical User
Content: Symptom-Created by field is blank in Goods and Services Receipts document created by technical user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Service Receipt work center-Go to the Receipts and Returns view -Select  the relevant Goods and Service Receipt-You can see that created by field is Blank-Cause-System will not show the created by field, if the goods receipts were created by technical users using web services. The created by field will be filled in only if it is created by business users.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior. The receipts were created by external application using technical users and hence the technical users name will not be shown in the created by field.-Keywords-Created by field blank in GR; Created by field blank in GSR; Created by field blank

Title: Customized Document Name for Pick Lists Not Carried Forward to The Target Document
Content: Symptom-You maintain a customized Document Name for Pick List (Move List) but this seems not to work.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Application and User Management. -Select the view Form Template Maintenance. -Open the Advanced Filter.-Select Pick List for the Template Name field.-Click Go. -Click on the Actions button and select Maintain Document Name from the drop-down menu. - Maintain a custom Document Name (for example SAP test) and click OK. -Now go to the Outbound Logistics work centre. -Select the Task Control view. -Select an open task with Operation Type: Pick. -Click on the Preview button and select Edit Output Settings. -Under the Output Details, change the Template Name to Pick List and then click Apply. -Now click on the Confirm button.-Print task. -Go to the Output History tab. -Result: you will see that the Document Name was not carried forward.-Cause-This behaviour is due to the forms being under the old architecture.-Resolution-This is the expected current behaviour of the system.-If you want to have this feature included, please  submit your requirement as an idea via the Customer Influence Platform.-All new ideas are regularly checked by our product development team and could be included for future release.-Keywords-document name, not carried forward, old architecture, pick list, move list

Title: How does BC activity "Automatic Accept Deviation on Purchase Order Acknowledgement" work
Content: Symptom-You may see default values appearing in this activity or you may change the values and want to know how they work.- or-You think that settings are not working as expected with deviation created or Deviation accepted automatically.- or-You want to know why a deviation was accepted automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Price Variance:-Variance Higher than (Percentage) is 10 that means:-If positive change percentage is under 10% that will be marked as tolerance not exceeded, thus auto accept of deviation happens.-If positive change percentage is over 10% that will be marked as tolerance exceeded, thus manual acceptance is needed.- OR/AND-Variance Higher Than (Net Price) is that means:-If positive change in price is under 150 that will be marked as tolerance not exceeded, thus auto accept of deviation happens.-If positive change in price is over 150 that will be marked as tolerance exceeded, thus manual acceptance is needed.-Variance Lower Than (Percentage) is 10 that means:-If negative change percentage is under 10% that will be marked as tolerance not exceeded, thus auto accept of deviation happens.-If negative change percentage is over 10% that will be marked as tolerance exceeded, thus manual acceptance is needed.-OR/AND-Variance Lower Than (Net Price) is that means:-If negative change in price is under 100 that will be marked as tolerance not exceeded, thus auto accept of deviation happens.-If negative change in price is over 100 that will be marked as tolerance exceeded, thus manual acceptance is needed.-Quantity Variance:-Variance Higher than (Percentage) is 10 that means:-If change percentage is under 10% that will be marked as tolerance not exceeded, thus auto accept of deviation happens.-If change percentage is over 10% that will be marked as tolerance exceeded, thus manual acceptance is needed.-Delivery Date Variance:-If Variance Higher Than (Days) is 10 that means:-If positive change in days is under the next 10 days that will be marked as tolerance not exceeded, thus auto accept of deviation happens.-If positive change in days is over next 10 days that will be marked as tolerance exceeded, thus manual acceptance is needed.-If Variance Lower Than (Days) is 5 that means:-If negative change in days is under the past 5 days that will be marked as tolerance not exceeded, thus auto accept of deviation happens.-If negative change in days is earlier than the past 5 days that will be marked as tolerance exceeded,thus manual acceptance is needed.-Note 1: Even if one of the above criteria is outside tolerance then deviation acknowledgment is created and has to be manually accepted.-Note 2: If you don't want any of the above criteria to be considered for accepting deviation automatically then change all criteria values to 0.-See Also- 2676869 - Determination of Requested Date in the Sales Orders -Keywords-Deviation wrongly accepted.

Title: You Are Not Able to Modify/Update Existing Recordings for Kit Item Lists via Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You have created some kit item lists and want to update them via migration tool, but the migration tool reports error:An active sales kit item list already exists for the sales kit ID ABC.-(ABC represents the ID ls sales kit ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view-Locate and open fine-tuning activity Migration of Kit Item List.-Click the link to "Migrate kit item list using the migration tool".-In the new screen, select the migration file. The migration mode is Modify already existing records.-Click Execute Migration, then select Execute Migration Step by Step.-Proceed until step 3 - Simulate Import to see the error message: An active sales kit item list already exists for the sales kit ID ABC.  -Cause- You can only create Kits using the migration tool - they can't be updated using the migration tool.-Resolution-Designed behavior.-Keywords-Migrate kit item list; migration tool; An active sales kit item list already exists for the sales kit

Title: What service will be regarded as incomplete service
Content: Symptom-A service is not completed. However, this service is missing when display incomplete service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Services view.-Display incomplete service.-The target service is missing.-Cause-This is the system designed behavior. System has its own logic to determine if a service is complete or not.-Resolution-Only when one of the status of purchase/sales/valuation is not Active/Initial/Empty, system will regard the service as incomplete.-Keywords-Incomplete Service, Status, Active, Initial, Empty

Title: Unable to Maintain or Edit Second Last Name for an Employee
Content: Symptom-In the Personnel File of an Employee, the Second Last Name of e.g. a Danish Employee cannot be maintained or edited. This is possible for First and Last Name only. There is no field for Second Last Name, not even via Personalization/Key User Tools.-This happens, even after the Employee was migrated via Migration template in Business Configuration and a value for Second Last Name field was maintained in the import file.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for and find the employee -Click on Edit-Navigate to the Personal Data tab-Navigate to Biographical Data subtab-There is no option to see or edit the Second Last Name-Cause-According to the info in the standard migration template, Second Last Name is only relevant in some countries.-The employee is associated with a country where only one last name is allowed-Resolution-Check the correctness of the names provided, and verify the possibilities offered by the law of the respective country, like e.g. combining last names with a hyphen, to make it one name.-Keywords-not possible, import, not available

Title: Error Message: "Length of IBAN not valid" When Updating Supplier Bank Details in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-When updating the bank details for a supplier in the Supplier Master Data, the following error is encountered: "Length of IBAN not valid."-This issue occurs even though the IBAN is valid when verified externally.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Supplier Master Data in SAP Business ByDesign.-Select a supplier and go to the Financial Data tab.-Under the Bank Data subtab, input the following details:-Bank Country/Region: A country (e.g., GB - United Kingdom).-IBAN: An IBAN from a different country (e.g., CH - Switzerland).-Attempt to save the changes.-The system displays the error: "Length of IBAN not valid."-Cause-IBANs (International Bank Account Numbers) follow country-specific rules, with each country having a unique IBAN structure and length. For example:-GB (United Kingdom) IBANs have a length of 22 characters.-CH (Switzerland) IBANs have a length of 21 characters.-The system validates the IBAN against the country associated with the bank. If the IBAN belongs to a different country than the one specified for the bank, or if the IBAN length does not match the expected format for that country, the error will be triggered.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, ensure the IBAN corresponds to the country of the bank:-Use the correct IBAN for the bank's country:-If the bank is located in a specific country (e.g., GB), the IBAN must comply with the IBAN structure for that country (e.g., GB IBAN with 22 characters).-Verify and update the bank’s country:-If the IBAN is from another country, ensure that the bank's country is correctly set to match the IBAN (e.g., use a CH IBAN for a Swiss bank).-By aligning the IBAN with the country of the bank, the system will accept the IBAN without triggering the error.-Keywords-IBAN, Length of IBAN, Supplier Bank Data, Bank Account, SAP Business ByDesign, Error Message, Country Code Mismatch, Bank Country, IBAN Structure.

Title: Price Unit in Purchase Request "Prices" Tab on Item Level is the Same as Contract Price Unit
Content: Symptom-Create a purchase request with reference to a contract.-Price unit in the contract is maintained as A.-In the purchase request, maintain price unit for the line item as B.-Go to Prices tab on item level, it is displayed as A with converted amount, which is expected to be B.-(A and B represents different price units.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create contract XXX for a product with price unit "ea". -Create purchase request YYY for the same product. -Under Source of Supply in the purchase request, select contract XXX.-See that the price unit of the line item in purchase request YYY is automatically updated to "ea".-Navigate to Prices tab of the item. See that price unit is EA now.-Edit the price unit for the item, for example, "box". Maintain prices accordingly.-Click on Check button.-Navigate to Prices tab again. See that price unit is still "ea" but it is expected to be "box".-Cause-Purchasing will be recorded in the reference contracts. If a purchase request uses a contract as source of supply, then the purchasing will be recorded with the same price unit in the contract.-It's possible to update price unit for certain item in purchase requests as per requirement, but price unit under Prices tab is not editable and will only be the same as in contracts. This is the current system design.-Resolution-Currently system design.-Keywords-Contract; Price Unit; Purchase Request; Source of Supply

Title: Incorrect Form Template Selected for Dunning Letter During Preview
Content: Symptom-The form template displayed during the dunning letter preview does not correspond to the dunning levels defined in the form template selection rule, instead displays an incorrect template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Dunning view.-Select the Dunning ABC (where ABC refers to the Dunning ID).-Click on Preview.-Click on Dunning Letter.-The incorrect form is displayed in the preview.-Cause-In the Form Template Selection for the Dunning Letter, the rules are not maintained in the correct sequence.-Resolution-To maintain the rules for Dunning Level 0, follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to the Form Template Selection view.-Search for the rule titled "Dunning Letter".-Select New.-Enter the form template code as "Reminder Letter" and choose the dunning strategy.-Click on Save and Close.-To maintain the rules for Dunning Levels 1 and 2, follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to the Form Template Selection view.-Search for the rule titled "Dunning Letter".-Select New.-Enter the form template code as "Dunning Letter" and choose the dunning strategy.-Check the box for "Dunning Notice Legally Effective".-Set the Max Dunning Level to either 1 or 2.-Click on Save and Close.-The preview of the Dunning Letter ABC will display the correct template.-See Also-3359289 - Wrong Form Template is picked for Dunning in Preview-Keywords-Dunning Level, Reminder Letter, Dunning Letter, Form Template, Preview, Form Template Selection

Title: Partially Delivered Customer Demand Order Item is Canceled, But Remains With The Cancellation Status: Cancellation Requested
Content: Symptom-You have cancelled a Project Stock Order Item, but the Cancellation Status of the Customer Demand Order Item remains as "Cancellation Requested" and you want to know why this is the case.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center 'Outbound Logistics Control'.-Go to the 'Customer Demand' view.-Find the relevant Customer Demand.-Select the relevant Order Item.-You can see the Cancellation Status is Cancellation Requested.-Cause-You have partially delivered the Project Stock Order Item.-When you partially deliver the Order Item and then cancel the open quantity, the Cancellation status of the Order Item will remain as Cancellation Requested and the Delivery status will become Finished.-Note : The Cancellation status of the relevant line item will be updated to cancelled only when the partially delivered quantities has been cancelled as well. However, this is a decision you have to take after discussing with your business. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Cancellation status, Cancellation Requested, Project Stock Order, Sales Order

Title: E-Mail Notification for Opportunity Workflow Task Triggered Multiple Times for the Same User
Content: Symptom-You have defined the workflow rules for Opportunities. When the condition is met, the system triggers the E-Mail notifications multiple times to the same user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Workflow Rules view.-Find the Workflow Rule ABC (Where ABC represents the Workflow Rule for the Opportunity Business Object) and check the conditions.-Go to the Home work center Inbox view.-You see that multiple e-mail notifications have been triggered for this same Workflow Rule ABC when the conditions are met.-Cause-You have maintained multiple E-Mail addresses in several places. For example, in the business partner itself, as the employee workplace address, as a service performer in the business partner etc. The E-Mail notifications are sent to all maintained E-Mail addresses, so this results in multiple E-Mails being sent to the same E-mail address.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. In order to avoid this, do not maintain the same E-Mail address multiple times for the same business user.-Keywords-Workflow Rule, Work Flow, Notification, Email, Emails, Multiple, Duplicated, Duplicate, Opportunity, Opportunities, Triggered, Trigger.

Title: Process Error: Purchase Order Logistics Details cannot process an update sent by a Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-In a Third Party Order Processing scenario, there are Process Communication Errors as below:--- Purchase Order cannot update Purchase Order Logistics Details .-- Purchase Order Logistics Details cannot process an update sent by a Purchase Order.-- Logistics Execution Request cannot process an update sent by a Inbound Delivery Request.-- Customer reference for item purchase requisition missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Business Data Consistency view.-Go to Process Communication Errors sub view.-Select Open Errors with Incidents.-You find above process errors.-Cause-In Third Party Order Processing Scenario, there is a message failing from IDP -> LER because there is a missing sales order reference in the EPTR_PVPO business object.-Resolution-Note : In case you get similar case, kindly forward this ticket to development component :AP-EPT-PVP.-Pre-checks: -It should be a TPOP scenario.-In BO, EPTR_PVPO, for the PO Root, in the BTD_REF node there is no entry for Sales Order (BTD Reference Type Code 114)-Backend Correction steps:-Backend screen 1: Go to TCode SESFTS --> BO EPTR_PVPO --> Query PO --> Root --> BTD_REF --> no entry for Sales Order (BTD Reference Type Code 114)-In another screen, Go to TCode SESFTS --> EPTR_PVPO --> Query PO --> Root--> Item --> Select all items and go to ITEM_BTD_REF --> You will see entry for Sales Order (BTD Reference Type Code 114)-Check if the Sales Order ID mentioned in the backend is the same as the one in the Document Flow in the UI.-In Backend screen 1, Root --> BTD_REF, create a new entry, maintain Sales Order ID (Sales Order ID found in Step 2), Sales Order UUID (Sales Order UUID found in Step 2), Reference Type Code Type code as 114, Relationship Role Code as 01.-Restart the failed message.-If Restart doesn’t work, then reconcile the failed message.-Post-Checks:-Confirm that the PCE is no longer appearing in the UI.-Keywords-Application and User Management, Business Data Consistency, Third Party Order Processing, Purchase Order cannot update Purchase Order Logistics Details, Customer reference for item purchase requisition missing, Purchase Order Logistics Details cannot process an update sent by a Purchase Order.

Title: How to add Product Specification ID for input products in a bill of material via migration.
Content: Symptom-Unable to add Product Specification ID (PRS ID) for input products via migration in required Bill Of Material (BOM)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Bills Of Material view.-Edit required BOM.-Under General and Variants Tab, Production specification ID is available.-Also for Input Products, Production specification ID is available.-Now, go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Activities view-Select Migration of Bills of Material template.-Now select one completed files, it displays only the Production specification ID from General and Variants Tab-However, not reflecting in the Input Variants-There is no option available to add PRS ID for input products via migration.-Cause-Currently, there is a limitation/ no alternative method available to add PRS ID for input product using the migration template.- Resolution-It must be added manually in the system directly while creating BoM.-Additionally, it is recommended to post query in Influence Forum via Customer Influence Forum, at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Input product, product specification ID, migration template, bill of material

Title: Creation of Multiple Down Payment Requests via Same Webservice Call Not Possible
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create more than one Down Payment Request through the same webservice call using ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn, however, one or more of the Down Payment Requests are Inconsistent upon creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Run the payload for creation of multiple Down Payment Requests in the same Webservice call.-Now, checking the created documents, some of them are inconsistent: -Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Requests view. -Find Down Payment Invoice Request ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of one of the Down Payment Requests created via Webservice).-You see that the status of the document is 'Inconsistent'.-Highlight the Down Payment Invoice Request and click the Check button.-The following errors are displayed: --Error in business configuration for processing type code; report incident.--Error in business configuration for property movement direction code.-Cause-At the moment, it is not possible to create multiple Down Payment Invoice Requests through the same Webservice call. This will result in inconsistencies in some of the Requests.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour currently. This has been taken as an enhancement request and will be tracked internally to be enhanced in a future system version.-Keywords-Web Service, Down Payment, ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn, DownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestBundleMaintainReqiest, Inconsistent, Incorrect, Communication Error, PCE, Error in business configuration for processing type code, Error in business configuration for property movement direction code, API, SOAP, REST.

Title: Automatic Clearing With Discount Failed With Error 'Posting not possible; clearing inconsistent'
Content: Symptom-Unable to create automatic clearing using the ManageBankAdviceIn web service due to the error 'Posting not possible; clearing inconsistent'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open SOAP UI software. -Enter the relevant xml details.-Start the upload.-Receive the response as: posting not possible; clearing inconsistent.-However, the respective customer invoice remains open. The bank advice is posted as an open item and a clearing is also generated with proposed status.-Cause-The error is being raised because of the clearing strategy maintained in the system.-Refer to the steps below to validate the configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the clearing strategies activity.-Click maintain clearing strategies.-Check the amount maintained in clearing strategy -> payment tolerance types -> absolute amount for each transaction.-The amount maintained here is less than the discount amount in the xml file, that's why automatic clearing does not happen.-Resolution-Correct the settings to make sure the discount amount in the xml file is lower than the maintained tolerant amount in the system.-See Also-3037543 - Automatic Partial Clearing of Bank Advices Failed With Error 'Posting not possible; clearing inconsistent'-Keywords-ManageBankAdviceIn, Web Service, Invoice, Business Partner, Automatic Clearing, Clearing Strategies, Discount

Title: Payment Allocation Error 'The action NOTIFY_OF_PAYMENT_EXEC is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.'
Content: Symptom-Error message is displayed upon trying to post payment allocation: 'The action NOTIFY_OF_PAYMENT_EXEC is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Select All Payment Allocations.-Search for Payment Allocation ID AAA (AAA represents the payment allocation ID).-Click View All. -Click Actions button --> Create Proposal.-Click Post button.-Error message is displayed: 'The action NOTIFY_OF_PAYMENT_EXEC is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.'. -Cause-The Payment Batch of this payment may be in the status Ready For Transfer. Due to that, it is not allowing to confirm the payment from the bank statement.-Resolution-Send the Payment batch first and then post the payment allocation.-If after submitting the payment batch or for some reason the payment batch has ben canceled, and the error message is still occurring, open a case to SAP Support with authorization for backend correction.-Keywords- Payment Allocation; NOTIFY_OF_PAYMENT_EXEC; Payment; report an incident; The action NOTIFY_OF_PAYMENT_EXEC is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident;

Title: Error "During run for company XXX, set of books XXX, the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred" in Lease Posting Run
Content: Symptom-Error "During run for company XXX, set of books XXX, the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred" in Lease Posting Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to Lease Posting Run view.-Click on New Lease Contract Posting Run.-Select lease contract ABC(ABC represents the lease contract ID).-Select 'Closure' in Control Parameters.-Execute the run and error occurs.-Cause-One of the reason is that the relevant accounting period is blocked. By default the lease posting run for closure of a lease will try to post to the last period of the lease ended. Check the accounting period and see it is blocked or the allowed step is not '010 - Operational postings'.-Resolution-Set the relevant accounting period to '1 - Not Blocked' and change the allowed step to '010 - Operational postings'. Then perform the lease posting run again.-Keywords-Application runtime exception, Lease posting run, Dump, Closure

Title: Remark for Supplier Notes Missing in the Third-Party Purchase Order Header Level
Content: Symptom-Added remarks for Supplier Notes are missing in Third Party Purchase Order header level in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party order fulfillment work center.-Go to Third Party Purchase Order view. -Find required purchase order ID.-Select and edit it.-Here under Notes tab.-No notes/ remarks are available.-Cause-Since the reference order is service order instead of sales order. As a result, the notes are not being copied to the Third Party Order Header Level. -Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Supplier notes, remarks, third party purchase order, purchase order header level.

Title: Error "Invoice schedule processing failed for Invoice Request (Action not possible; document is inconsistent)" Raised in Invoice Schedule Processing Logs
Content: Symptom-In the Invoice Schedule Processing Logs view, you see one or more "Invoice schedule processing failed for Invoice Request (Action not possible; document is inconsistent)" errors in the Application Log and would like to know how to correct the inconsistency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Schedule Processing Logs view.-Click on the Application Log ID ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Application Log where the issue happened).-Navigate to the Results tab -One or more results display error "Invoice schedule processing failed for Invoice Request DEF (Action not possible; document is inconsistent)" (Where DEF Represents the Invoice Request ID).-Cause-Invoice Schedule Processing Logs are only created if there is an error during the creation of the Scheduled Invoice Requests due to an inconsistent Invoice Request. In this case, we have to find the Inconsistent Invoice Request and correct the error causing the inconsistency.-Resolution-In order to find the Inconsistent Invoice Request and see the error causing the inconsistency, follow these steps: -Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Open the Invoice Requests view.-Find Invoice Request DEF.-Highlight the Inconsistent Invoice Request and click the Check button -In the Identified Issues screen, you can see the error that is causing the inconsistency. Once the underlying error is corrected, click the Redetermine All button in the Identified Issues screen.-This will then clear the inconsistency in the Invoice Request.-See Also-2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-Keywords-Invoice Schedule Processing Logs, Inconsistent, Incorrect, Erroneous, Application Log, Process Communication Error, Issue, Invoice Request, Scheduled.

Title: Unsecure Navigation Pop-up Appears While Completing Case
Content: Symptom-While completing the case you will get pop up message "Unsecure Navigation".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to the Cases view.-Find the Case you want to complete.-Select the Complete button.-In the Confirm Completion popup window 'Do you want to set the status of the incident to Complete?' choose Yes.-As a result, Case status will change to Completed and a new popup window Confirm Navigation will show up: "Unsecure Navigation".-Cause-The cause for this behavior might be the browser which you are using.-Resolution-We would recommend to clear the cache of the browser & check whether anti-virus installed in the system or not. After performing above changes you can retry to complete the case.-See Also-3233474 - How To Access the Satisfaction Survey For a Support Incident - SAP Business ByDesign Built-In Support-Keywords-Unsecure Navigation, Closing Case, Browser settings

Title: How to handle rework process in production?
Content: Symptom-The process of handling rework in production.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center-Go to Task Control view-Find required production task -There is no way to skip the task quantity recording in rework process.-Cause-Currently there is a limitation in recording production without confirming the make task, as its a new production order, it's in turn increases the stock/quantity. Whenever a production order is being created with planned quantity, it gets recorded enhancing the finished good quantity once it is finished.- Resolution-It is recommended to post query in Influence Forum so that Development Colleagues can look in to this.-Register your requirement for this feature on Customer Influence Forum, at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886- Keywords-rework production, limitation, customer influence forum, production

Title: No Postings Generated by WIP Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-A WIP clearing run has been performed, and postings were expected to be created. However, no postings have been generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select the WIP Clearing view.-Open the Application Log of the respective run.-Navigate to the Postings tab: You notice that there are no postings, even though Production Lots were successfully completed in the period.-Cause-There is no amount to be posted into WIP which needs clearing. Hence, there are no Journal Entries created by WIP Clearing.-Resolution-Open the Production Confirmation AA or BB of the Production Lot DEF which was processed by the WIP Clearing Run ABC (ABC represents the WIP Clearing Run) and check the Journal Entries. It will be observed that all posted 0.00 LC to the WIP Account. If there are no or zero amounts posted, no Journal Entry will be created by the WIP Clearing Run (AA and BB represent Production Confirmation IDs, DEF represents a Production Lot ID, LC stands for Local Currency).-Also, for the WIP clearing generate postings, the run needs to be executed for the same period in which the Production Confirmations got posted  and the Production Lots completed.-In addition, it is possible to check if any Business Tasks are open for the Production Lot, and if any Production Confirmations appear as unposted Source Documents in the General Ledger work center. Only once the respective tasks are resolved and the documents are posted can the WIP clearing run consider these transactions.-See Also-2110238 - No Postings In The WIP Clearing For The Production Lot ABC-Help Document: Production Lots-Keywords-WIP Clearing, Journal Entry, Production Lot, Production Confirmation, WIP Clearing Run, Postings, Line Items

Title: How to Check the Extension Field Number Limit?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--How to check the extension field number limit?-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Reproducing the Issue-As a prerequisite, partner have previously:-Created a custom add-on in SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Created an extension of standard Business Object (.xbo).-Created extension fields under some BO-Node combination.-Attempted to activate the solution.-The following errors show up.-Maximum length reached for BO 'ABC' node 'DEF'"-Delete extension/KUT fields from other PDI solution for BO 'ABC' node 'DEF'" (where ABC refers to the name of Standard BO, and DEF refers to the BO node)-Resolution-Open backend T code SE24-Open Class CL_PDI_BODL_TREE_WALKER-Open Method VERIFY_NODE_REST_ACT-Put breakpoint at line 496, 499, 530 and 532-Open backend T code 1o-Click on "Assign Developer to Default Partner" button-Open backend T code SE38-Fill value PDI_BC_LM_EXECUTE_OLD_SUPP for program-Provide the .xbo path in the field-Select EXTENSION_ENTITY for Content Type-For field Mode, fill value D for in development solution or fill value U for deployed solution -Click Execute (F8) button-If field count is 745 or more, the breakpoint for line 496 will be hit-This method might be triggered several times as this XBO may have several nodes-Put field MS_BO_RT-EXTENDING-PROXY_BO_KEY-NAME and LR_NODE->NODE_ELEMENTS-KEY-NAME in the variables for identifying the execution of our target node   -Put the field lc_field_count_max_limit_xbo  and  lv_total_ext_fld_count_tenant in the variables when hit line 499-Rough Required field number = lv_total_ext_fld_count_tenant- lc_field_count_max_limit_xbo-Please note that the exact number depends on the data type given for each extension field. Therefore, please delete few more extension fields than the number which is calculated in the above steo for having the buffer.-If the node size is 15000 bytes or more, the breakpoint for line 530 will be hit-This method might be triggered several times as this XBO may have several nodes-Put field MS_BO_RT-EXTENDING-PROXY_BO_KEY-NAME and LR_NODE->NODE_ELEMENTS-KEY-NAME in the variables for identifying the execution of our target node  -Put the field lv_ext_field_size_tenant  and  lc_fields_max_kb_lim_xbo in the variables when hit line 532-Required field bytes = lv_ext_field_size_tenant - lc_fields_max_kb_lim_xbo-Please note that the customer needs to delete (few hundreds bytes+ required field bytes) for leaving the buffer. -Please kindly use one of the following solutions. -         Required field number/Required bytes of KUT fields for the same BO-NODE combination needs to be deleted in the fronted UI.-         or -         When the tenant is test tenant, Required field number ÷(divide) 2 or Required bytes ÷(divide) 2 of PDI fields for the same BO-NODE combination needs to be deleted.-         Please note that the extension fields get doubled when the patch is cre­ated.-         or -         When the tenant is production tenant, Required field number/Required bytes of PDI fields for the same BO-NODE combination needs to be deleted.-See Also-3149599 - Maximum length reached for BO-3149615 - Maximum length reached for BO (Custom BO)-2830190 - Error: Maximum length reached for BO 'ABC' node 'DEF'-Keywords-PDI, SDK, maximum, length, reached, BO, node, delete, extension, field, solution, number, limit

Title: Number Range for Optional Specified Stock - System Generated
Content: Symptom-There is an discrepancy in the number range for optional specified stock which is system generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Choose implementation projects view.-Choose Activity list: First implementation-Search : Number Ranges for Identified Stock-Choose Optional Specified Stock - System Generated -New number range is maintained-However system is not fetching new number range for specified stock.-Cause-The new Number Range configuration is applied to newly identified stock created with the new product. However, for products where the identified stock has already been created, it still refers to the older configuration. This is because the Sub-Object for this product was created with an older number range configuration, so the system refers to the Sub-object and its corresponding number range.-Resolution-It is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Optional Specified stock, Number Range configuration, Optional Specified Stock - System Generated,

Title: Sales Order is Not Automatically Released in a Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-The Purchase Order document was created and released for a intercompany scenario, however the follow up Sales Order document is created but not automatically released.-The Sales Order is created with the status "In Preparation".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign---Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-In the search field, search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Select View All. -The following error messages are displayed in the document:-Organizational data missing-Party with role Sales Unit missing-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again-Item: Distribution channel or sales organization missing-The Sales Order ABC was created as a follow up document from the Purchase Order, however the status of the Sales Order is "In Preparation".-Cause-An intercompany Sales Order is only automatically released if the Sales Order is consistent.-Due to the mentioned errors the Sales Order is not consistent and therefore it is not released automatically when it is created.-The errors in the Sales Order ABC are displayed because the Parties Sales Unit, Sales Organization and Distribution Channel cannot be determined automatically in the system as per your set up and therefore no Sales Unit, Sales Organization and Distribution Channel are maintained in the Organizational Assignment section of the Sales Order.-Resolution-You need to ensure that the Parties Sales Unit, Sales Organization and Distribution Channel are determined automatically.-See Also-See also the following Blog for more details: Party Role Determination in a Sales Document  (Link: https://blogs.sap.com/2016/05/16/party-role-determination-in-a-sales-document/)-KBA 1892958 - Automatic Determination of Sales Unit is not as Expected in the Sales Order Even After Maintaining the Work Distribution Rule-KBA 3215948 - The following Error occurs in a Document :Party with role XYZ missing (XYZ represents the Party Role)-KBA 2744399 - Manual Clearing Error: Error while recalculating the withholding tax: Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again Amounts on Invoice ABC are inconsistent-KBA 3215892 - In a Sales Document the Error occurs: Distribution channel or sales organization missing-Keywords-intercompany, purchase order, sales order, in preparation, released; status; Inter company; Party; error; inconsistent; Open; In Process; Release;

Title: Extension Field Content not Displayed in Invoice Entry Screen: All Deliveries to Be Invoiced
Content: Symptom-The following extension scenarios have been activated in the system:-Purchase Order-Item -> Supplier Invoice-Item-Purchase Order-Item -> Goods and Services Receipt-Item-Goods and Services Receipt-Item -> Supplier Invoice Request-Item-However, in Invoice Entry screen, the extension field appears to be empty in All Deliveries to Be Invoiced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It is current system design that content in extension scenario cannot be passed from both purchase orders and goods and services receipts to Invoice Entry screen. Therefore, Invoice Entry screen does not support the following scenarios:-Purchase Order-Item -> Supplier Invoice-Item-Goods and Services Receipt-Item -> Supplier Invoice Request-Item-Resolution-To make content in the extension field be displayed in Invoice Entry - All Deliveries to Be Invoiced, maintain the below scenario:-Goods and Services Receipt-Item -> Supplier Invoice Request-Item-Note: Extension field can only be taken to supplier invoices from purchase orders by using "Purchase Order-Item -> Supplier Invoice-Item" rather than goods and services receipts. It is necessary to create a new extension field and activate "Purchase Order-Item -> Supplier Invoice-Item" for it.-See Also-KBA 3102899  - Extension Field Value is not Passed from Purchase Order to Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Extension Field; Invoice Entry; All Deliveries to Be Invoiced; All Orders to Be Invoiced

Title: Bank Charges Option is Missing in the Dropdown for Payment Difference Reason
Content: Symptom-Bank Charges option in the dropdown for Payment Difference Reason is not available while posting an Outgoing Bank Transfer for a Non-Localized Country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier XYZ, and then click View. (XYZ represents Supplier ID).-Choose required Open Item and then choose Pay Manually By -> Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Enter the Relevant Details.-Click Apply Discount or Credit.-It is noted that  Bank Charges in the dropdown for Payment Difference Reason is not available.-Cause-Bank Charges option has not been added in the Business Configuration under Payment Difference Reason. Since it is a Non-Localized country, Bank charges option needs to be added manually.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view. -Choose the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune tab and search for Reasons for Payment Differences for Non-Localized Countries activity.-Choose Open tab and select the Non-Localized Country ABC (ABC represents Country Name).-Click Add Row tab under Assigned Payment Difference Reasons.-Select 11 - Bank charges option in the Dropdown for the Payment Difference Reason.-Choose Save button.-Now, Bank Charges option will be available in the Dropdown for Payment Difference Reason while posting Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Keywords-Non-Localized Country, Bank charges, Payment Difference Reason, Outgoing bank transfer

Title: Employee Names are Displaying as "No text for UUID {}" in Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When access certain reports, instead of Employee Name reports shows the message as "No text for UUID {}". For Example: No Text for UUID {00163e14-b7ab-1ee6-aca9-e2a765dd963e} .-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This issue could occur in any reports such as Project Cost and Revenue Details or Financials related reports or even in custom reports.-Cause-In certain reports, it is expected to see an Employee ID or perhaps as unassigned (#) ID but instead, it shows the following (example) - No Text for UUID{00163abc-d123-1def-ab45-678c1a762734} .-The root cause is not yet found but there is an issue on the HCM side with the ACL (access control list) of the Employee BO.-Resolution-Steps to confirm if there is an inconsistency:-Go to the Transaction SESFTS.-Load Employee BO.-Load by Query-> Identification Query by Employee Attributes and Fill the Employee ID /Content field and search.-Navigate to root.-Navigate from Root -> ACCESS_CONTROL_LIST node.-Navigate to ENTRY there will be no record here.-NOTE: Do not execute the below program instead send the incident to SRD-HR-TLM development. This is to identify the root cause of the issue-Steps to resolve:-To correct this issue, go to Transaction SE38 and load the program 'AP_PAD_ADJUST_ACL_ENTRIES'.-IMPORTANT NOTE:-Discuss with ByD Technology PAL if there is any need to execute this report.-Later, Execute for one employee in Test Mode to verify whether the result is correct.-DO NOT attempt to execute the report for All Employees.-Finally, -Execute the report and check the Steps 1 to 6 again - there should be records now, on the UI, the actual values should appear rather than the long UUID string.-Keywords-No text for UUID, employee ID, employee name, # of employees, report

Title: Process Communication Error: "Supplier Invoice YYY / YYY-1.1; Coding Block Assignment can not be changed" occurred in the Supplier Invoice.
Content: Symptom-There is a Customer Project Expense List XXX that contains a reference to Supplier Invoice YYY that is stuck in the Source Documents saying that Supplier Invoice YYY has not been posted in accounting. When checking the relevant Supplier Invoice YYY, under the Document Flow there is a red icon showing a Process Communication Error.-('XXX' refers to Customer Project Expense List ID, 'YYY' to Supplier Invoice ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents sub view.-Filter for Unposted Source Documents.-Search for the Customer Project Expense List Document XXX.- An error message is shown: "Cannot process Customer Project Expense List XXX because Supplier Invoice YYY not yet posted in accounting. As Customer Project Expense List XXX contains a reference to Supplier Invoice YYY but Supplier Invoice YYY has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Customer Project Expense List XXX. Check why Supplier Invoice YYY has not been posted."-When checking the relevant Supplier Invoice YYY, under the Document Flow there is a red icon showing a Process Communication Error.- Cause-Cost Distribution is incorrectly maintained in the Supplier Invoice YYY.-Process Communication Error shows the following message:  "Supplier Invoice YYY / YYY-1.1; Coding Block Assignment can not be changed."-It can also be seen by going to General Ledger work center, Source Documents view and searching for the Supplier Invoice YYY.-Checking Item 1.1 in the Supplier Invoice YYY, it can be noted that it has the flag: Distribute Additional Costs, but it is not distributed to the Invoice item correctly.-('YYY-1.1' refers to Line Item under the Supplier Invoice)- Resolution-The only possible solution is to cancel this Supplier Invoice YYY and create a new Invoice with accurate Cost Distribution, so that the new Supplier Invoice will be posted to accounting without any error messages.-Keywords-Cost Distribution, Supplier Invoice, CPEL, Process Communication Error, Additional Cost, Coding Block Assignment.

Title: Error: Sales kit integrity violated for item ID in site logistics request; save failed
Content: Symptom-When trying to perform Adjustment Confirmation for required items to cancel respective Outbound Delivery, system throws following errors:--Error during delivery update-Sales kit integrity violated for item ID in site logistics request-Save failed-Quantity inconsistent for kit product, parent line item -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Monitoring view, choose by warehouse order view -Find relevant warehouse order ID-Select it and choose adjustment confirmation-Choose Enable Entry-Select line item and enter required quantity -Choose save -System throws above errors.-Cause-Since required item is a part of a sales kit item, it is necessary to adjust all components of the sales kit.-This is because the required item is a part of the sales kit item, and adjusting only one item in the kit system results in errors.-Resolution-Perform adjustment of all components exists in a sales kit at the same time.-Keywords-Sales kit, adjustment confirmation, enable entry, Error during delivery update,  Sales kit integrity violated for item ID in site logistics request, Quantity inconsistent for kit product, parent line item

Title: Bank Statement Import Format Not Showing In The Dropdown List For Inbound Files
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Import the Inbound File for a Bank Statement, where you observe that the required Import Format is not showing in the Dropdown list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Navigate to File Management view and select Inbound File.-Select New and then select Inbound File.-Fill the required  Details for File Type, Company, Bank ID.-Under the Import Format We see there are records to select. --Cause-The configuration for a company and Bank account ID is missing in Business configuration-You can validate by navigating with the help of below steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Search for the activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Select Assign import formats for bank statements.-You can observe that the company and Bank account ID  is missing.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Search for the activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements. -Select Assign import formats for bank statements. -Maintain the Company and Bank ID in the configuration and then proceed.-     Keywords-Inbound File, Import Format, Automatically Generated Bank Statements,

Title: Cannot Migrate Inspection Operation for Bill of Operation
Content: Symptom-You are migrating a Bill of Operation and in the XML template you have put an Operation of type Inspection. The BoO is created successfully, but the Inspection Operation is missing.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select Business Configuration work center.-Choose Overview view.-Search and Open activity of Migration of Bills of Operations.-Click Migrate bills of operations using the migration tool.-Select the respective migration unit and click Execute Migration.-The migration is Finished without any error and the BoO is created. However, when you open the BoO migrated, the operation of the inspection is missing.-Cause-ByD does not allow you to migrate any operation of type Make, hence you cannot have an operation of type Inspection.-Resolution-The system is working as designed in this case, as it is not supported migrating operation of type Inspection.-Keywords- Inspection, Inspection Operation, Bills of Operations, BoO, Migration of Bills of Operations,

Title: Central case Processing CHD and CCC Scenarios in ByD and C4C
Content: Symptom-In a normal customer scenario, case created by the end user can be tracked by the key user in the case work center view. The key user can forward the case to SAP Support. Due to the flexible architecture, it is also possible to implement other variants of the process.-We distinguish the following additional scenarios:-CHD (Central Help Desk scenario)-CCC (Customer Competence Center scenario)-CHD Scenario:-In the CHD scenario, all case which are reported by a user in a tenant are automatically forwarded to another tenant. In the other tenant, a key-user can track the cases from multiple tenants. He still can forward the cases to a Service Provider which is normally SAP Support -(exception in the CCC scenario)-How new Built-in Support works in CHD Scenario?-End User tenant is not enabled with DSX and the cases are sent to Central Key User Tenant-Central Key User Tenant is enabled with DSX and the cases are sent to SAP Support-CCC Scenario:-The CCC scenario works similarly to the normal customer scenarios: cases are created in a tenant and checked internally in that same tenant by the key user. However, when an case is forwarded to the Service Provider by the key user, it is not sent directly to the SAP Support. Instead, it is sent to another ByD tenant which acts as a "Central Help Desk" system for multiple key users.-In the CCC scenario, the recipient system is another ByD tenant (a central help desk).-How new Built-in Support works in CCC Scenario?-End User tenant / Key User tenant is not enabled with DSX and the cases are sent to Central Key User Tenant-Central Key User Tenant is enabled with DSX and the cases are sent to SAP Support-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Requesting CHD/CCC via an Case-In order to get the setup established just follow the steps:-Create an case with the short text "CHD Setup required" or "CCC Setup required"; most customers have the Central Help Desk-(CHD) scenario in use.-Add the template with the details like tenant which you want to use as Central Sytem for case processing & Client from which cases will be forwarded to Central System.-*************** template start - do not copy ***************--Dear Cloud Support,--We would like to get our test/migration tenants connected to the central case processing tenant-Central system URL is: -The client to be connected is: -Requestor Name, Email ID & Contact details.-*************** template end - do not copy ****************-See Also-Note: After the activation is done, this feature will be applicable only for the next new cases. Previously created cases will not be transported to the central system.-Keywords-CCC, CHD, case Processing, Customer Help Desk, Customer Competence Center, Central Processing-chd setup,ccc setup,central incident processing,chd server

Title: Reverse Payment Allocation Leads to Manual Clearing Errors
Content: Symptom-You are trying to cancel a payment allocation or clearing that follows a bank statement. Nevertheless, errors are raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center-Go to Payment Allocation view-Open the posted payment allocation you want to reverse.-Click Reverse.-Error: 'Payment manually cleared on account of company <company ID> and partner <business partner account>'-Open the associated manual clearing-Click Reset Clearing-Error: 'Business transaction for accounting has already been posted for Clearing <Clearing ID>. This source document can be posted only once'-Cause-For this payment allocation, you allocated the payment via Customer/Supplier tab to several different business partners account. You have clicked on Actions and accepted all the payment differences at once for the assigned accounts and did not clear any open item. Hence for all the items you see the Other Discount/Credit column filled. Therefore, once payment allocation is posted, the system automatically clears the payment and no open item in the customer/supplier account is created for further clearing, since the discount has already been given.-Nevertheless, for one of the accounts (added after the discounts were applied) the payment has been made on account (See the Remaining Balance column), which created an open item payment in the customer/supplier account. This open payment has been further cleared against another manual clearing.-Resolution-When attempting to reverse the payment allocation, note down the business partner ID that is mentioned in the error message. You'll see that in the Open Items section of this payment allocation, a payment has been made on the given account.-After identifying the account:-Go to Payables work center-Go to Supplier Accounts view-Find the concerned supplier ID and open the supplier account monitor.-Find the on account payment made by the payment allocation (usually ID has format as <statement ID>/<transaction ID> e.g.: 24/7)-In the Clearing ID column, open the clearing and click Reset Clearing. Note that this is the clearing the cleared the on account payment against another open item e.g.: payment, invoice, credit/debit memos, discounts-Click Reset Clearing. The payment will be open again in the account monitor along with the items that it cleared.-After that, you will be able to go back to the payment allocation and reverse it.-Keywords-Reverse, clearing, payment allocation, bank statement, Business transaction, accounting

Title: Missing Tax Code Field in New Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You are creating a New Expense Report and in Step 2, when you select Add Row, the Tax Code Field is not visible in the available fields for filling.-Reproducing the Issue-Travel and Expenses work center.-Expense Report view.-Select button New, then Expense Report On Behalf option.-Fill all the mandatory fields for this Step 1.-Press button Next.-Select Add Row.-Can see that the Tax Code Field, below Private Expenses field, is not being showed.-Cause-This behavior can happen for two configuration reasons in activity Tax Activation - Generic Country/Region Version, in option Activate Tax Calculation.-1) The Tax Calculation Active option is marked with option NO. This way the tax calculation will be inactive for the Expenses Reports created.-2) The Tax Calculation Start Date is filled with a date after the Expense Report date. Tax calculation is only active in Expense Reports after the Tax Calculation Start Date, so for Expense Reports with earlier dates, the Tax Code won't be available.-Resolution-For each cause, follow the resolutions below, respectively:-1) To activate Tax Calculation:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Search for activity Tax Activation - Generic Country/Region Version.-Select option Activate tax calculation.-Select the row for the Tax Calculation you want to activate.-Chose Activate Tax Calculaiton button.-2) To change the Tax Calculation Start Date:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Search for activity Tax Activation - Generic Country/Region Version.-Select option Activate tax calculation.-In the other window, enter the new Tax Code group as well as the Tax Calulation Start nad End Date and the other fields.-In the end, chose Activate Tax Calculaiton button.-The start date can only be configured as a date after the last end date of the latest Expense Report created in the system.-Also, it is not allowed to change/activate the tax calculation for already existing Expense Reports.

Title: VERTEX Add-on Installation
Content: Symptom-You need to install VERTEX SMB add-on on your system-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-VERTEX is a external service to calculate tax rates and tax returns for US and Canada.-Once it is installed, all the transactional documents (sales order, purchase orders and so on) will use add-on to calculate Sales and Use tax rates.-Activation of the add-on is now done via scoping, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Edit Project Scope.-Go to Questions step.-Under Built-in Services and Support, choose Business Environment then select Tax Calculation.-Select the question 'Do you want to use the services provided by Vertex to determine tax rates for US?'-Save and implement the scope changes.-See Also-Please check help center document About Tax Rate Determination Service Provider Vertex SMB for further information.-Please see also the following Blogs for further information:-Taxation in SAP Business ByDesign with third party vendors-Avalara and Vertex Integration in SAP Business ByDesign-Vertex Configuration in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Vertex; Integration; External; Taxation; Tax determination; Tax Rate

Title: Customer Invoice Journal Entry - Incorrect Profit Center
Content: Symptom-A customer invoice has been posted and in the journal entry the profit center picked is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view and select the respective Invoice ID.-Click Edit and navigate to the Document Flow.-Click the Anchor button and view the journal entry.-In the journal entry, the profit center derived is not the expected one.-Cause-If profit center accounting and segment reporting for a set of books has been selected, the profit center and segment are automatically entered in the line items of journal entries created from source documents.-In this case, the source document is the sales order, the system uses the profit center that is assigned to the associated sales unit in the organizational structure.-Resolution-When the customer invoice is associated to sales order, the profit center is picked from the associated sales order item. The profit center of these sales order items should be checked in the Sales Document Items view, in the Cost and Revenue work center.-Also, in case there is a change in the sales unit for a sales order then this lead to the redetermination of profit center for some of the items. Automatic profit center redetermination (on change of sales unit) would happen only if there are no postings for that item already.-In case postings exist, it is expected to be handled manually (if needed). For instance for an item 10, there were prior postings and then the profit center will not change. For item 20, there were no postings yet when the sales unit is changed then the profit center get re-determined.-See Also-KBA 2065258 - Wrong Profit Center Derivation in Invoice Based on Sales Order-SAP Help Portal: Derivation of Profit Center and Segments-Keywords-profit center determination in the customer invoice, journal entry,-profit center in customer invoice

Title: Error in OData Editor by an PDI Extension Field
Content: Symptom-You are getting an error while saving Custom ODATA.- "XYZOData.xodata :element "PDI Type_SDK" is removed or re-named or data-type changed in BO extension. Adjust OData service extension" -Where XYZ is the extension name.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Cloud for Customer-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cloud Application Studio-Open Solution - YABC1234 ( YABC1234 stands of Y namespace for solution)-Open the associated xodata, here lets take an example of XYZ - /YYABC1234 /Y_MAIN/SRC/XYZOData.xodata-Login with developer user in UI.-Check in ODATA editor, the field "PDI Type_SDK" is not there, here ("PDI Type_SDK" is an extension PDI field)-Try to save error appears.                                                                                                                   -Cause-If any PDI property is added to OData extension and if removed from XBO needs to be adjusted in OData extension (.xodata) as well. This is to maintain the consistencies of the OData and associated service.-Resolution-Go to Administrator work center-Go to OData Service view-Show Custom OData Services-Open your PDI created OData service-Ensure that the extended fields do exists in Extension BO and OData services -If in case, its removed from BODL then please remove the field from the XOData service as well. -Note: This is valid also for renaming or change of Data -type of extension field from Cloud Application Studio.-In the event the field is not present in the UI or if the custom OData or extended SAP OData service then please raise a case in component AP-RC-ODF and request further assistance. -Keywords-Odata; Adjust OData service;Removed,Renamed,Change of Datatype

Title: How to Create Recurring Invoice job in the Back end
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to create recurring invoice run in the backend when the run which was there earlier is disappeared.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Go to Background Jobs view.-Search for "Recurring invoicing for all buyers".-The search does not return any result. -Cause-Healthcheck run does not happen on any tenant other than Production tenant, because we don't want health check incidents to be created on any tenant other than Production tenant and currently this Healthcheck run is also used to create Recurring job as well. Recurring invoice run can disappear after user clicking on "Start Immediately". So we have to create this Recurring invoice job manually in other tenants like test, demo and development tenant.-Resolution-Log into backend with L6 authorization and go to transaction SESFTS-Provide the BO name /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV_RUN and click Enter-Click on the arrow for Load by Query and choose Root - Select All from the dropdown menu-Click on Ok-Note down the Node ID-Now open new screen and go to transaction SESFTS, provide the BO name BACKGROUND_JOB_SCHEDULE and click Enter-Click on Actions and select SCHEDULE_MDRO from the dropdown menu-Provide the following parameters-ResponsibleIdentityID/content: SAP_SYSTEM-ScheduleDescription: Recurring Invoice for All Buyers-StartDateTime: 07.08.2020 00:30:00.0000000 Z (Tomorrow date in dd.mm.yyyy and time is always 00:30 UTC)-EndDateTime: 31.12.9999 23:59:59.0000000 Z-RecurrenceFrequencyCode: 4-RecurrenceFrequencyValue: 1-Click on Execute-In the appearing pop up click on the create icon-Provide BO name: /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV_RUN; BO Node Name: ROOT; Node Instance: (Copied Node ID from BO /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV_RUN)-Click on Execute to create the run instance-Click on Save-See Also- 2648081 - Recurring Invoices are not Created-Keywords-Supplier Invoicing Run, Recurring Invoice Run, Recurring Invoices,  Recurring invoice Job

Title: Price Differences from GR/IR Clearing Being Accounted as Cost of Goods Sold
Content: Symptom-You have executed GR/IR for a given purchasing document, nevertheless, the system posted eventual price differences to a COGS - Cost of Goods Sold accounts rather than to a Differences account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to GR/IR Clearing Run view.-Open the executed run and navigate to the Processed Successfully tab.-Select the concerned purchasing document row with price differences.-You realize that the offset account chosen by the system concerns a COGS account for Cost of Sales in the Sales ledger, instead of an account for Differences in the Inventory ledger.-Cause-The purchasing document has assignment to a Service Order or Sale Order. The Service Order or Sale Order in question requires certain items to be bought in in order to do the repairs.
