Because this is a third party scenario, i.e. the materials are bought by your company and then sold on again to your customer getting repairs done, this transaction counts as a sale. Therefore, since this is a sale rather than a to-stock purchase, the Inventories ledger is not determined, only the Sales ledger, thus the price differences get posted to a Cost of Goods Sold account.-Check path:-Open the Purchase Order.-Click View all.-Click Items tab.-Click Basic Data sub-tab: Process Type field maintained as "Third-Party" and Click Account Assignment sub-tab: Account Assignment Type maintained as Sales Order or Service Order.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior given the scenario.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing; Purchase Price Difference; Offsetting Account; Cost of Sales

Title: How to prevent approval for Purchase Orders with reference to Purchasing Contracts
Content: Symptom-Customer already has approved his purchasing contracts.-He therefore does not require for all Puchase Orders issued from these contracts to go for approval again but according to the approval process, all POs, including those with reference to a contract go for approval.-The customer requires a way to disable approval in this particular case.-Cause-The customer has not setup conditions to control Purchase Order approvals.-Resolution-By default all Purchase Orders go for approval. The customer must configure the approval process conditions to cater for his specific needs.-There is an attribute called : "Reference to Purchasing Contract[]" in the PO approval process options. This attribute can be used to qualify a condition in the approval process. In general, if a condition is fulfilled, then approval will occur.-Since we do not want approval to occur we should setup approval so that only if the attribute is not fulfilled approval should occur.-We do this by adding a condition and setting "Reference to Purchasing Contract[]" "Does not contain" *.--This way, we are telling the system that approval should only occur if there is no reference to a purchasing contract in the PO.--For the POs which are already in approval, the customer can either process the already existing tasks or modify the approval process as per the instructions above then withdraw the POs from approval and reorder them. This should cancel the original tasks and the POs should go through without approval the second time.

Title: The Tax Exemption Reason Does not Appear in the Invoice Form
Content: Symptom-Tax exemption reason missing in invoice form created for the Italian customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account for which invoice).-Edit the account and select Financial Data tab-Select the Tax Data subtab.-You find that the exemption reason is already maintained.-Now go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the customer invoice XYZ and choose Preview button.-The Tax Exemption Reason is not available in the PDF form. -  Cause-The ReasonName field of the Tax Exemption is not mapped in the Customer Invoice form.-Resolution-In the form template to get the value of Tax Exception, you can map the field ReasonName:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view -> Form Template Maintenance subview.-Open the Customer Invoice form template in the Easy Form Editor.-Select the Tax Exemption Table section -> Select Columns.-Select the Add button -> Select Column.-Under Available Fields -> Select FormInvoiceRequest -> CustomerInvoice -> ProductTaxDetails[*] -> TaxExemption -> Add the ReasonName field.-Save your changes.-Now the Tax Exemption Reason will be shown in the invoice form.-

Title: Address Duplicates After Migration of Supplier
Content: Symptom-The supplier's address was duplicated after the Supplier Migration process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search for Migration of Suppliers-Migrate the suppliers using the Migration of Supplier activity.-Access the Supplier Base work center and select the Supplier view.-Select a supplier from the list.-Select View All in the top right corner.-Go to the Address tab under Communication.-You will notice that the address is duplicated, showing both the main address and the duplicate address.-Cause-For the supplier, one entry has been maintained in the Addresses tab of the migration template, which has a time zone of UTC+1.-In the Contacts tab, contact persons have been entered with business addresses, where the time zone is noted as UTC+01 (please note the difference between these two time zone entries).-The program logic compares the addresses in the Addresses tab with the business addresses maintained for the contacts. If the addresses are identical, only one entry will be created. The comparison is based on the following fields:-COUNTRY-HOUSE_NUMBER-STREET (multiple entries)-CITY-REGION_STATE-POSTAL_ZIP_CODE-DISTRICT-TIME_ZONE-In this example, since the time zones do not match, a second address is created. The value codes for the two time zones are different, leading the logic to determine that the addresses are not equal, which results in the creation of a second address line. This differentiation is technically necessary.-Resolution-It is essential to use identical time zones in the addresses within the Migration of Supplier template.-Keywords-Migration of Supplier, Timezone, AddressDuplicated

Title: Sales Order Employee Responsible Reported as Not Assigned
Content: Symptom-You are trying to retrieve the Employee Responsible information for each Sales Order Item, but the report returns the Employee Responsible column as Not Assigned for some Items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Report view.-Open the Sales Order Volume report.-Enter the Employee Responsible as Rows and other relevants Columns and Rows.-Execute the report.-On the Rows to Employee Responsible the data for some Items is diplayed as Not Assigned.-Cause-Reporting uses the Employee Responsible on Item Level as the Data Source since the Employee Responsible could differ on Header and on Item level. Nevertheless, there are some items which are not assigned to an Employee Responsible at all because these are Expense Items which are not counted as volume for an Employee. Therefore, there is no technical issue. It works as designed as Expense Items are explicitly maintained as items without an Employee Responsible.-The Employee Responsible is displayed as Not Assigned for Expense Items since for Expense Items, an Employee Responsible is determined from the actual Expenses that is recorded and invoiced to the customer.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order; Report; Not Assigned; CRMSLOIB_Q0001;CRMSLOIB; Employee Responsible

Title: How to Post Entries from SAP Payroll System to SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You need to post payroll results from an external system to SAP Business ByDesign but cannot find the required integration scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can use the Postings from SAP Payroll system integrated scenario. This Web service enables the integration of the SAP payroll (onPremise and OnDemand) into the solution SAP Business ByDesign. It eliminates the need to manually transfer the results from the payroll process to the Financials system.-This scenario is available in Application and User Management work center as Payroll Integration communication scenario.-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Under Input and Output Management, open the Communication Scenarios view.-Look for the Payroll Integration scenario, which will allow you to enable and configure payroll postings from external SAP payroll systems.-Keywords-Integration, Payroll, Web Service, External System

Title: Tax Details Missing in the Delivery Note for Stock Transfer Invoice (Indian specific scenario after GST Implementation)
Content: Symptom-When you preview the Delivery Note for a stock transfer order, you are not able to see the tax amount details under GST columns.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-In the Show field, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection option from the drop down.-Search for the relevant Delivery ID.-Select the Delivery ID and choose the Preview button.-In the preview pdf of the delivery note, you could see that the system does not display tax amount details under GST columns.-Cause-You are transferring the stock within the state(Intrastate) and tax is not applicate for Intrastate stock transfer. Hence, delivery note will not display the tax details under GST columns.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Missing Tax details, Delivery Note, Stock Transfer Order, Intrastate

Title: Unable to create a Credit Memo due to the Error: "Manual Invoice Processing for Reference Document not Permitted".
Content: Symptom-Unable to create a credit memo from the customer invoice, due to the following error: Manual Invoice Processing for Reference Document not Permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select customer invoice DEF (DEF represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Click on the Follow-Up button and select the Manual Credit Memo option.-The following error occurs: Manual Invoice Processing for Reference Document not Permitted.-Cause-Customer invoice DEF was created via the Follow-Up function from customer invoice ABC (ABC represents the original customer invoice ID). Creating a Follow-Up credit memo from an invoice which was created as a follow-up document is not supported. This is the reason for the error message "Manual Invoice Processing for Reference Document not Permitted".-You can check if an invoice was created as a follow-up document as follows:-Open customer invoice DEF.-Navigate to the the Document Flow tab.-You can see that for the respective invoice request e.g. an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request the customer invoice XYZ was created. Then, a Manual Invoice Request was created as a follow-up is created which was invoiced with customer invoice DEF.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Instead of create credit memo for the invoice, you can cancel the invoice. The invoiced amount will be deducted from the customer balance.-Keywords-"Manual Invoice", "Credit Memo"; Manual invoice processing for reference document not permitted; follow up.

Title: Limitation on number of Items in CRM documents (Sales orders, Service Orders, Contracts, Quotes, Invoice...)
Content: Symptom-You want to know if system has limitation or recommended number of line items in CRM documents (Sales orders, Service Orders, Contracts, Quotes, ...) when you create it manually / via excel upload / via migration / via webservices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-System does not work reliably (dumps/times out) if number of items in CRM documents exceed more than 100 items.-Resolution-For better performance and reliable system behavior the recommendation is 100 line items or less. Creating documents with more than 100 items is strongly discouraged as the system performance degrades as more items are added. Less than 100 line items would be better for performance and follow up processes to run smoothly.-In addition, it is not possible to specify the performance issues that could occur whenever more than 100 lines items are maintained in a sales document, as the system does not behave in a consistent manner.-Please Notes: In case scripts of custom PDI solutions are integrated in the process you might face performance issues with less than 100 line items. -See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Sizing Assessment Tool-KBA 2891575 - Find the Cause for 500 Error during Excel Upload-KBA 2938699 - Unable to Upload Price List Via Excel-KBA 3146505 - 500 Internal Server Error When Creating New Quote or New Sales Order via Microsoft Excel-KBA 2956449 - Limitation on Number of Items in ByDesign Documents-Keywords-maximum, line items, sales orders, sales document, performance, slowness, slow, items, invoice, dump, time out-limitation,line items,maximum,sales documents,performance,limit,item,order

Title: Automatic Creation of Registered Product For Serial Number ABC In Current Operation Is Not Possible. You Can Manually Create A Registered Product In The Registered Product Screen
Content: Symptom-When trying to create Automatic Serial Numbers while confirming the Warehouse Task  though serial number profile maintained as Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers in a relevant product master data, system does not generate any Serial Number ID and throws an error messsage :-Automatic creation of registered product for serial number X in current operation is not possible. You can manually create a registered product in the registered product screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics WorkCenter.-Select Task Control View.-In the field Show, choose All Warehouse Tasks using drop down.-Search for the relevant Task ID and choose Confirm button.-Now under Details Section, navigate to Serial Number subtab.-Choose Add Row and enter Serial Number ID.-Here system throws above error message and values displays under Barcode Input tab instead of serial number subtab.-Cause-Since the task which has to be confirmed is a Return Put Away task which is a customer return and therefore Automatic Serial Number creation is not possible.-Resolution-In order to record the serial number for Return Put Away Task, please follow below given steps :-Go to the Inbound Logistics Workenter.-Choose Common Tasks View.-Select New Registered Product subview.-Here create a New Registered Product ID : ABC for the relevant Product.-Now change the status to Active.-Again go to the Warehouse Tasks subview.-Search for the relevant Task ID and choose Confirm button.-Now under Details Section, navigate to Serial Number subtab.-Choose Add Row and enter Serial Number ID which you have created above : ABC.-System will accept this Serial Number ID without throwing any errors.-This KBA also applies to Post Goods Receipt against inbound delivery notification (Delivery Type: Customer Return).-Keywords-Serial Number, Registered Product, Automatic Creation, Inbound Logistics, Warehouse Task, Post Goods Receipt, Inbound Delivery Notification

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Error: Cost Center XYZ not found
Content: Symptom-After executed GR/IR Clearing Run, which resulted in the following errors:-'Cost center XYZ not found'.-'Define a default profit center for company ABC and subledger Cost Centers'.-XYZ represents Cost Center ID.-ABC repesents Company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to GR/IR Clearing view.-Open the run that was executed.-Go to tab Processed with Errors.-The mentioned error messages are displayed.-Cause-Supplier Invoice and/or Goods and Services Receipt that was not processed has account assignment to a Cost Center that is no longer valid.-To check the account assignment please go to the source document and check it.-Check the current valid cost centers on:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Cost Centers view.-Find the Cost Center XYZ that was mentioned on the error message of the GR/IR Clearing.-Or Check it on the Organizational Structure:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Organizational Structure view.-Find the Cost Center XYZ.-Go to tab Timelines.-Check attribute Managerial - Cost Center.-See the valid to date is not valid on the moment that GR/IR Clearing was executed.-Resolution-In order to adjust the validity of the cost center, please follow below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Organizational Structures view.-Click Find, search for Cost Center XYZ and click Locate.-Click Edit.-Go to Timelines tab.-Here adjust the valid to date accordingly. It is necessary that cost center is valid on the day that GR/IR Clearing Run is executed.-Make sure all the parent orgs are within the validity as well. Or else an error message would show: A timeline must lie within the timeline of its parent.-Execute GR/IR Clearing Run again for the source documents not processed.-In case do not want to use the cost center XYZ and hence do not want to extend its validity, a different one must be assigned on the source documents which were not processed.-Keywords-GR/IR, Clearing Run, Org. Unit.

Title: Error Message "Error while updating employee's organizational assignment"
Content: Symptom-Error message "An error occurred while updating the employee's organizational assignment" is triggered when trying to modify the hire date of an employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Personnel Administration work center and select the Employees view.-Open the required Employee ID.-Go to the Employment tab and select the Work Agreement subtab.-Click the Change Hire Date button.-Enter a past date in the hire date field.-Click Save.-Error Messages:-[!] Save failed-[!] An error occurred while updating the employee's organizational assignment.-Cause-The employee was initially hired as a Service Agent and later transitioned to an Internal Employee.-Resolution-An employee was hired as a service agent in the system with Org Unit: 9999 and Job: Job1 on 05.07.2013.-The service agent underwent a job change on 03.02.2014; consequently, while the Org Unit remained 9999, the Job was updated to Job2-Eventually, the service agent was hired as an internal employee, effective 01.08.2014, while maintaining the same Org Unit and Job combination as outlined in step 2.-A request has been made to change the internal employee's hire date to 01.10.2010; however, this is not supported because the employee served as a service agent from 05.07.2013 to 31.07.2014, with their internal employee tenure starting on 01.08.2014.-Such a backdated change in the hire date would effectively erase the employee's tenure as a service agent.-If there is a need to reflect the employee's seniority in the company for reasons such as qualifying for senior employee benefits, this can be accomplished by updating the Service Start Date in the Personnel File-Keywords-Personnel File, Service Agent, Service Start Date, Hire Date

Title: All Demand Consumes Preceding Forecast Procedure Does not Consume Forecast From Preceding Time Buckets
Content: Symptom-The Demand Management Procedure is being maintained for the product as All Demand Consumes Preceding Forecasts. However, the demand for the product is not consumed from the preceding time bucket but from the current time bucket.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks and select the option Forecast Consumption Report.-In the Forecast Consumption Report screen enter the product to view the consumption report.-here an existing demand for the product is consumed by the forecast in the current  time bucket, now the consumed quantity under the column Consumed Forecast Quantity is available.-Cause-The Demand Management Procedure, All Demand Consumes Preceding Forecasts behaves as follows. If any available demand exists for a time frame, then system consumes and fulfils the demand from the current forecast and for the demand that is not fulfilled from the current forecast the preceding forecast is used. For example – If there is a forecast of two quantity for October and two quantity for November. A demand of three quantity is available via customer demand for November. As per the Consumption in Preceding Buckets procedure the system consumes the forecast of November first and then consumes the remaining forecast from October. Then it gets displayed as an Unconsumed Forecast Quantity of one quantity in October and zero quantity in November.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Forecast, unconsumed forecast, Forecast Consumption Report, Demand Consumes Preceding Forecast Procedure

Title: Troubleshooting Issues with Customized Functionalities and Fields - SDI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This case document is a central case document to help you troubleshoot issues with customized data.-Reproducing the Issue-You identify that the field or functionality is different than the one in IRA test system.-For example, you find out that the facet XYZ is shown in the opportunity.-Go to the Sales work center.-Go to Opportunity view.-Select the Opportunity ABC (ABC represents the identification of the opportunity).-The customer is reporting an issue with the Facet XYX which is not a standard Facet.-  Cause-The functionality can have been customized-by the business partner via an Add-On (PDI Solution).-by the Service Center via a Service Center Add-On.-by the customer via the KUT (Key User Tool).-by the Customer Object Functionality.-by the Language Adaptation Functionality.-Resolution-1) Identify if the fields has been changed via the Key User Tool-Go to the ADMINISTRATOR work center and select Layout Change History.-To filter your search use the advance search :-CT Type  : e.g. AddPageLayoutCondition, AddCondition, ChangeNavigationItemTitle,...-Changed UI (technical name of the UI) : e.g. /BYD_COD/SalesOnDemand/Opportunity/UI/COD_Opportunity_TI.TI.uicomponent-If you are not able to retrieve the correct data you can also use the backend report => 2082533 - Report to see the Change Transaction of Certain UI Element in the Backend-2) Identify if the fields or functionality has been modified via a Business Partner Add-on (PDI) or a Service Center Add-On-2.1) List of deployed Add-On from SAP Incight. The description would give you a good indication on which Add-On is currently deployed.-2.2) Table SDI_REGISTRY in the backend to see the complete list of Deployed Add-Ons along with the details of who create the Add-On (Service Center or PDI Developer)-2.3) [Expert Support] Breakpoint in the PDI determination class.-CL_PDI_SFW_AS_ACCESS and method EXF_EXEC-CM_ESI_T100 and the constructor (for messages)-More information in 1981270 - The Message "Changing data not possible; data is read-only" is Raised for a Failed XI Message-2.4) [Expert Support] Find more information about Custom Object in : https://sap.emea.pgiconnect.com/p7gcqzmll39/-3) Identify if the fields has been changed via the Language Adaptation- Go to the ADMINISTRATOR work center and select Language Adaptation.- You would need to check each variant to see if the fields or label were updated or translated.-More information on language adaptation  : https://sap.emea.pgiconnect.com/p96dsqcgtyw/-

Title: How to Influence the Status of an External Invoice Request Created via the Web Service
Content: Symptom-An External Customer Invoice Request is being uploaded via the web service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn. The system successfully uploads these External Customer Invoice Requests, but it is desired to know how the status e.g. To Be Invoiced can be influenced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The SettlementPriorityCode influences the creation and release of an invoice from an invoice request. By setting the settlement priority code the creation of a customer invoice is triggered for the customer invoice request.--If the code is 2 then the system will first check if a down payment request exists before invoicing the invoice request. If a down payment exists, the customer invoice request will be created with the status To Be Invoiced. If it does not the system will directly create an invoice and the External Customer Invoice Request will have the status Processed.--If code 1 is selected, if the invoice request is consistent an invoice will be created and released immediately without checking for a down payment request and the External Customer Invoice Request will have the status Processed.--If the SettlementPriorityCode is not passed at all the system will create the External Customer Invoice Request with the status To Be Invoiced. So, if it is needed to create just the External Customer Invoice Request in status To Be Invoiced, the SettlementPriorityCode have to be removed from the XML.-Keywords-Release; Invoice; Web Service; automatic; Invoice Request

Title: Down Payment Invoice Requests Cannot be Merged into Single Invoice
Content: Symptom-You created multiple down payment invoice requests from one single sales order. When you try to invoice these invoice requests, they are split without giving any split analysis and you are not able to merge them into one invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select some down payment invoice requests which were created from one sales order.-Click Invoice. In the creation window, you could see these invoice requests are split. Each invoice requrest is creating one invoice. You are not able to merge these invoice requests into single even if they have the same sales data.-Cause-Multiple Down Payments requests cannot be merged to create a single Down Payment Invoice.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior as designed.-Keywords-Down Payment Invoice request; Split; Down payment; Invoice split; Consolidate invoice

Title: Revenue Recognition Error Message: Doc. Item /: The line Item Currency Could not be Derived
Content: Symptom-The revenue recognition run finishes with the error message "Doc. item /: The line item currency could not be derived."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks - Revenue Recognition view.-Click on the Revenue Recognition ID you need.-Go to the Messages tab.-You can see the error message: Doc. item /: The line item currency could not be derived.-Go to the Processed with Errors tab , search for Sales Document Item ID XYZ-XX (XYZ-XX represents the affected sales order item ID).-Click on the ID XYZ-XX.-Press View All.-Go to the Items tab. -Here we can see the sales order items are cancelled.-Cause-All items of the sales order are cancelled.  Therefore,  no cost/revenue can be incurred/ accumulated. However, the cancellation date of the items is higher than the revenue recognition posting date.-Example:-If the sales order item is cancelled on 20.08.YYYY.-The revenue recognition posting date is 31.05.YYYY.-Resolution-If deferrals/accruals exist for the sales order item/s you could execute the run after its cancellation date, derived from it's requested date.-Or, if the balance sheet values must be cleared before, you can send a case to the Technical Support team to adjust the cancellation date of the sales order item from the backend.-Keywords-line item currency could not be derived, revenue recognition, cancelled sales order item

Title: Message 'Insufficient money on bank account XYZ' When Posting Outgoing Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-Although checked the current balance of the bank account under Liquidity Management / Bank Statements, system disaplays a message 'Insufficient money on bank account XYZ' when attempting to post an outgoing bank transfer.-XYZ means the Bank Account ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go go the Payment Management work center.-Under Common Tasks choose New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-For bank account XYZ, enter a debit amount which does not exceed the balance as shown as closing balance in the last entered bank statement for this account.-Upon posting you retrieve the message: 'Insufficient money on bank account XYZ'.-Cause-Per default a liquidity check is applied when trying to post outgoing payments others than tax payments and cash transfers.-The system adds the transaction amount to the confirmed balance and the planned liquidity of bank account XYZ and checks this against the Overdraft Limit as defined in the bank account editor. Hence possible reasons leading to a message indicating insufficient liquidity on bank account XYZ are:-When entering a new outgoing bank transfer the checkbox Liquidity/Allocation not Required is left blank. This activates the liquidity check as described above.-There are relevant payments recorded which are not confirmed yet. In the Payment Monitor such payments would be in status Ready For Transfer or In Transfer. Those are entering the liquidity status of a bank account according to their value date.-The applied Overdraft Limit does not allow for any more outgoing payments considering the current liquidity status as defined above. -Resolution-Depending on the applicable reason you would have to take the following action:-In case do not want a liquidity check to be applied for an outgoing bank transfer, tick the checkbox Liquidity/Allocation not Required in the document form.-Consider the liquidity status of bank account XYZ on a particular day also including all relevant payments which are not confirmed yet. This can be checked in the Payment Monitor in work center Payment Management or Liquidity Management. Then check the liquidity status by selecting 'Export - To Micosoft Excel'.-Revise the applied Overdraft Limit for bank account XYZ as defined in the bank account editor taking into account the current liquidity status as defined above. -Keywords-insufficient money; bank account; liquidity allocation; overdraft limit

Title: Production Order with Started status not available in a report
Content: Symptom-In Production Request Fulfillment report, system is not fetching production orders with started status-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work center.-Select Production Orders view.-Search Production Orders-Search Production Orders status which is in started.-      Now,-Go to Business Analytics Work center.-Select Data Sources view.-Search Production Request Fulfillment  with data source: SCMPRFU01.-Choose preview.-Enter the Production lot id with status started.-System is not showing any data.-Cause-This report displays production orders with status finished and canceled only. It provides transaction data of production request fulfillment, including planned and actual quantities, and dates.-Resolution-This is a system standard behavior.-Keywords-Production Request Fulfillment , SCMPRFU01, report, started, finished, canceled, production order

Title: When Creating a New Sales Order, The UI Displays a Warning Message Stating "Communication error during ATP Check,"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Following the refresh of the test tenant from the production environment, customers are seeing a "Communication error during ATP Check" message when trying to create orders, which is causing these orders to not show up in the customer demand view for release.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center-In the Common Tasks, Select New Sales Order-Select View All-In the Account Section, Enter the any Account-Navigate to the Items tab-Select Add Row Button-In the field Product, Enter any Product-The warning message "Communication error during ATP Check" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The issue is related to Live Cache, which was causing the "Communication error during ATP Check" and preventing orders from appearing in the customer demand view.-Resolution-Create a Incident to the Operation team, to clear the cache.-Keywords-Communication error,  ATP Check, Sales order

Title: Error On DATEV Export Internal Error: Error At Creation Of Result BO Instance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You perform the DATEV Export run and the run ended in error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the DATEV Export sub view.-Select the Run ID XXX (XXX stands for the Run ID).-Select the Application Log ID: XYZ (XYZ stands for the Application Log ID).-Select the Results tab.-There is the Internal error: Error at creation of Result BO instance.-Cause-The error is due to the huge amount of data the run has to process at once. Probably you have performed the run for a period of six months or above. -Resolution-To solve the error, split and perform the run for a period of 2 months.-Keywords-DATEV Export, Interner Fehler: Error at creation of Result BO, Internal error: Error at creation of Result BO instance.

Title: Payment Method as Cash is Not Supported in ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn API
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use Payment Method as Cash in Customer invoice request API, but it is not successful.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-N/A-Cause-Currently, customer invoice request API (ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn) does not support the payment method cash. However, you can utilize Over-the-Counter (OTC) API, which allows for cash as payment method.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn; External Invoice Request; Over The Counter Sales; OTC; Customer Invoice; Petty Cash ID

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Payables Error: During Run for Company, Set of Books, the Error 'Application Runtime Exception; Report an Incident' Occurred
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run ABC (ABC is the run ID) for payables ended with the error message:-"During Run for Company DEF, Set of Books HIJ, the Error 'Application Runtime Exception; Report an Incident' Occurred."-(DEF is the company ID.)-(HIJ is the set of books ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Foreign currency remeasurement run sub view.-Search for the Run ID ABC and select it. -Select the log results.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-The error message is,-During run for company, set of books, the error Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred -Cause-The Foreign currency remeasurement run for the Payables will be dump in the backend.-Dump details from the Transaction code: ST22-Runtime Errors         MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT-ABAP Program           CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP-Application Component BC-ESI-ESF-ABA-Triggering application component: AP-ACC-  Active calls/events: - 19 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003    66-    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR- 18 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001    24-    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR- 17 METHOD       CL_FAI2D_PRIMARY_CHECK========CP    CL_FAI2D_PRIMARY_CHECK========CM001   458-    CL_FAI2D_PRIMARY_CHECK=>IF_FAI2D_STEP_ACDOC_1~DO_IT- 16 METHOD       CL_FAI2D_ACDOC_RUNTIME========CP    CL_FAI2D_ACDOC_RUNTIME========CM001   325-    CL_FAI2D_ACDOC_RUNTIME=>CHECK- 15 METHOD       CL_FAI2D_ENTRY_SECONDARY======CP    CL_FAI2D_ENTRY_SECONDARY======CM001    20-    CL_FAI2D_ENTRY_SECONDARY=>CHECK- 14 METHOD       CL_FIA_ARPLA_BOPF_FCURRREM_ACTCP    CL_FIA_ARPLA_BOPF_FCURRREM_ACTCM008    10-    CL_FIA_ARPLA_BOPF_FCURRREM_ACT=>CHECK_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT- 13 METHOD       CL_FIA_ARPLA_BOPF_FCURRREM_ACTCP    CL_FIA_ARPLA_BOPF_FCURRREM_ACTCM002   926-    CL_FIA_ARPLA_BOPF_FCURRREM_ACT=>/BOPF/IF_FRW_ACTION~EXECUTE- 12 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CM00Z   596-    /BOPF/CL_FRW=>DO_ACTION- 11 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CM00W    59-    /BOPF/CL_FRW=>/BOPF/IF_FRW_SERVICE_LAYER~DO_ACTION- 10 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_SP_SERVICE_PROVIDER==CP    /BOPF/CL_SP_SERVICE_PROVIDER==CM00I   183-    /BOPF/CL_SP_SERVICE_PROVIDER=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACTION~EXECUTE_ACTION--Reason for the dump: Two Supplier Invoices for Supplier MNO were connected to one Payment ID, which is in In-Preparation status. Because of this no transaction or Payment allocation was got triggered.-If you check the master data for Supplier MNO, you can see that Payment Method and the Bank Data seems incomplete.-So, the Open Item for Supplier MNO is neither in Open status nor being considered as Cleared or Partially Cleared and this is stopping the proper execution of the foreign currency remeasurement run for Payables.-  (MNO - Refers to Supplier ID).-Resolution-You have to complete the Payment ID with the in-preparation status for the Payment allocation to get it triggered. Title: Multiple GSTN for Single Supplier/Customer - India
Content: Symptom-Suppliers may have GST registrations across different states in India, and all GST numbers need to be tracked in the supplier master. However, the current system only allows one GST Identification Number per country in the tax data of the supplier master.-How can multiple GST registration numbers for a single supplier be maintained?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Search for the relevant Supplier ID and click Edit > Financial Data.-Navigate to the Tax Data sub-tab.-The system does not allow allow adding multiple GST Identification Numbers (Tax number type) for a single supplier.-Cause-There is no functionality to maintain multiple GSTN for single business partner.-Resolution-Users need to create different supplier/customer master for each GST registration number of the same supplier/customer.-Keywords-GST Registration Number, GSTN, GST Identification Number, Goods and Service Tax India, Multiple, Supplier, Tax Data

Title: Error - "During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error ' application runtime exception, report an incident' occurred " in Actual Cost Rollup Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***RELEASED INTERNALLY***-Error: "During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error ' application runtime exception, report an incident' occurred " in Actual Cost Rollup Run.-ABC -Refers to Company.-DEF -Refers to Set of Books.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to Actual Cost Rollup sub-view.-Find run ABC.-View the log of it.-Go to tab Messages.-You will see Error: During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error 'application runtime exception, report an incident' occurred.-To check the dump information from backend:-Log on to Backend via STFK.-Run Transaction ST22.-Find the dump.-In the detailed information, you will see,-Application Information:-    1 Triggering application component: AP-COS-    2 CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program: CL_FIA_ACTUAL_COSTING_SERVICE=CP, Include:CL_FIA_ACTUAL_COSTING_SE-    3 Info: An exception with the type CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB occurred, but was neither handled locally-    4 CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB, Program:CL_FIA_ACTUAL_COSTING_SERVICE=CP, Include:CL_FIA_ACTUAL_COSTING_S-    5 Info: The range of the statement to be passed to the database is too wide-Cause-This dump is due to high number of materials captured in the Actual cost rollup run.-Resolution-You have to apply more filters like Product category, Material and splitting time to 15 days.-These are some of the options you can apply filters and try to do the Actual cost rollup run. To do that you can follow the below steps,-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to Actual Cost Rollup sub-view.-Select new.-Try to give all the mandatory details.-Under selection criteria, give the data in materials, product category and split the time to 15 days to reduce the high number of materials.-After applying filters try to do the Actual cost rollup run again, the system won't give error message now.-See Also-"KBA - https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3123539"-Keywords-Actual cost Rollup Run, Dump, Material, Filters, CL_FIA_ACTUAL_COSTING_SERVICE=CP, Inventory valuation.

Title: Supplier Invoices sent to approval without any approval rules
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoices approval tasks are triggered , without any active approval process being set up in the system. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice entry view-Create an invoice with respect to desired Purchase order -Once the Supplier Invoice is successfully created, an approval task it triggered-This Invoice was created on date DD.MM.YYYY-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. -The invoice creation date is DD.MM.YYYY-In Application and User Management work center -> Approval Processes view -> All Processes -> search for the Supplier Invoice ID -> the Supplier Invoice default approval process was modified on DD.MM.YYYY and it was activate on that day. On the same date the Supplier Invoices were created. Hence , the Invoices created in the active duration of the approval process were sent to approval. -Resolution-As the approval process was active on date DD.MM.YYYY , the date on which Invoices were created, approval task is triggered. This is the expected behavior. -Keywords-Approval task triggered for supplier invoice, approval task created without active approval process, supplier invoice approval task created

Title: Unable to edit the Cash flow key in the Bank statement
Content: Symptom-Unale to edit Cash flow key in Bank Statement 'AA' which is already in posted status.-'AA' - refers to the Bank statement ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements sub view.-Search the relevant Bank Statement 'AA'.-Select the statement ID-Give view all.-Navigate to the Transactions tab.-Here the field cash flow key is not editable.-You want to know how to change it if user have selected incorrect key.-Cause-You see SAP pre-delivered cash flow keys in the Bank Statements which is already posted are not editable. This is current system behavior.-Resolution-Ideally after posting the Bank statement 'AA', it is not possible to edit Cash flow key hence it is not editable.-In case if you have selected the wrong cash flow code in the Bank Statement 'AA' which is already posted then you can reverse the Bank statement 'AA'.-After this while creating the new Bank Statement try to give to correct Cash flow key it will be selected from your default cash flow key settings as well.-See Also-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3143930"-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3114588"-Keywords-Bank statement, Cash flow key, Posted, Liquidity Management, Reversal, Transactions.

Title: Error Occurs When Adding Custom File Structure ID to Payment Medium Format 5 - US ACH - CCD/PPD Domestic Payment
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs while trying to add the custom Z File Structure ID to the Payment Medium Format 5 - US ACH - CCD/PPD Domestic Payment:-"Value 5 is not valid"-"Value in field Payment Medium Format Code must start with Z"-"Value in field Payment Medium Format Code must be equal to one of the following values:1, 17, 18, 20, 23, 34, 35, 36, 52, 59, 61, 65, 73,"-"Save failed"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Activity Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Click Edit assignment of payment file structures to the payment medium formats link.-Click Add Row.-In Payment Medium Format, input "5 - US ACH - CCD/PPD Domestic Payment"-In File Structure ID column, input the custom Z file structure ID.-Click Save and the following error occurs:-"Value 5 is not valid"-"Value in field Payment Medium Format Code must start with Z"-"Value in field Payment Medium Format Code must be equal to one of the following values:1, 17, 18, 20, 23, 34, 35, 36, 52, 59, 61, 65, 73,"-"Save failed"-Cause-The Payment Medium Format Code "5-US ACH - CCD/PPD Domestic Payment" is write-protected. This protection prevents it from being assigned to custom payment file structures.-Resolution-This is the desired system behavior.-Users can copy the properties of Payment Medium Format code '5-US ACH - CCD/PPD Domestic Payment' into the custom Payment Medium Format which is intended for the actual use of payment flexibility.  -Keywords-5-US ACH - CCD/PPD Domestic Payment, Payment Medium Format, Customer File Structure ID, Value 5 is not valid, Z file structure

Title: Error Occurs While Trying to Update the Quantity Conversion in the Material Master Data
Content: Symptom-Error occurs while trying to update the quantity conversion in the master data.-Error - “Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open supplier return requests”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Products and By Materials view-Select the relevant Material-Select Edit and navigate to General tab-Under Quantity Conversions section, change the value-Error appears-Cause-The relevant material or service is already used in one or more documents. The reason for this error is that the business documents which are using this material would end up in inconsistency if the change is allowed. The veto check executed is not at quantity conversion level, but rather at material/service level. If that material/service is being used in a document, even if the quantity conversion used is one other than the one you intend to delete or change, the system will still block the action.-Resolution-Since the quantity conversions are already used in the Returns to Supplier, system will not allow the changes at master data level. Allowing the master data changes to the released documents are not allowed. Changes to the quantity conversion directly in the backend are also not supported by SAP. As a workaround, SAP advises to create a new material with the same details as the existing one, maintaining the correct quantity conversions, then blocking the previous material/service for further use.-Keywords-Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open supplier return requests

Title: No Data is Displayed in Forecast Utilization Data Source
Content: Symptom-You are using the Forecast Utilization data source, however you notice that no data is displayed in the results after running the data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Enter the Data Sources view.-Search for the data source Forecast Utilization-Click on the Preview button.-Setup a selection for the data source.-Click on the Apply button-Here you see that no data is displayed in the results table.-Cause-The Forecast Utilization data source contains mandatory selection parameters due to interdependencies between such parameters. Such mandatory selections are only available in the Forecast Utilization report, so it is expected that the data source will not produce any results.-Resolution-The system works as expected. It is suggested to use the Forecast Utilization report from the Design Reports view of the Business Analytics work center instead.-See Also-2157310 - No Data Shown in Financial Data Source Preview-Keywords-Resource, ds

Title: Data Inconsistency in Inventory and Supply Planning Post System Copy
Content: Symptom-After a system copy, a discrepancy is noticed in the available stocks for Product ABC in the supply planning and the stock overview.-(here ABC refers to a product ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the inventory overview work center.-Check the available stock for a material.-Navigate to the supply planning work center.-Check the available stock for the same material.-Observe the discrepancy in the available stock data.-Cause-The cause of the issue is identified as the absence of a Data Flow Verification (DFV) run post system copy.-Resolution-Initiate a Data Flow Verification (DFV) run for the respected tenant-Verify that the issue is resolved and data inconsistency is removed.-In the future, perform a DFV run after every tenant refresh to prevent similar inconsistencies.-Keywords-System copy, Data inconsistency, Inventory, Supply planning, Data Flow Verification, DFV run, Test tenants.

Title: Credit Memo Cannot be Released due to Warning "Document not possible to invoice due to preceeding document status"
Content: Symptom-In a scenario where a Credit Memo was created for a Contract, the warning "Document not possible to invoice due to preceeding document status" is raised when trying to Release the Credit Memo.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find and Highlight Credit Memo ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Credit Memo affected by the issue).-Click the Release button -The Credit Memo is not released due to warning "Document not possible to invoice due to preceeding document status".-Cause-This happens when the Contract related to the Credit Memo is Completed and the Line Items are fully cancelled before the Credit Memo itself is Released. Due to this, the Credit memo is cannot be Released.-Resolution-In order to Release Credit Memo ABC, the related Contract Line Items have to be reopened.-Keywords-Credit Memo, Release, Unable, Impossible, Not Able, Releasing, Submit, Contract, Cancelled, Cancel.

Title: Error - "Price change interval (MM. YYYY) has closed periods in company set of books" while changing the planning group of the material 'ABC'
Content: Symptom-Not able to change the planning group of the material 'ABC' due to the error:-Price change interval (MM. YYYY) has closed periods in company set of books.-MM refers to the Month.-YYYY refers to the Year.-'ABC' refers to the Material ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products sub view.-Search for the relevant material 'ABC' and navigate to the "Planning" tab.-Select the Planning Area and try to change the planning group id from 'AAA' to 'BBB'-Give "Save".-The error appears.-Error: Price change interval (MM. YYYY) has closed periods in company set of books.-Cause-This error usually occurs due to that particular material where you do not have stock you may have able to change the material cost and validity. But for material which still have stock during the mentioned periods, the stock has to be revaluated with new cost and the revaluation will create Journal Entry in the system. Currently all those periods are closed for posting -And the suggestion for the periods which have been already closed is to open it again, but if in case the accounting period/year mentioned in the error message is two or three years past from the current year and you don't want to open the previous years because for that year financial statements have been audited and completed already and opening that year again may affect the G/L balances.-In this case changing the planning group of the material 'ABC' is not possible from the UI.- Resolution-You have to create a case to SAP Technical Support with your permission in order to change the Planning group for the material 'ABC' by skipping the revaluation method from the backend without any inconsistencies.-Once the correction done from the backend, the planning group of the material 'ABC' will be changed in UI without any errors. -Please note: This correction applies only if you don't want to open the past years.-See Also-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2920511"-Keywords-Price Change interval, Material, Planning group, Revaluation, Accounting period/year.

Title: Extension Field is not Extended From Service to Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-Extension field is not displaying any data when extended to the Purchase Request. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Search for: ABC (ABC is the Purchase Request's ID).-For column XYZ, the value is blank (XYZ is the Extension Field). It was expected a data there instead. -Cause-It is not possible to extend the extension field from the Service master data to the Purchase Request. -This can be confirmed by following the steps below:-Start the Adaptation Mode.-Select extension field XYZ. -Go to Further Usage. -Navigate to Extension Scenarios tab. -There is no option "Service - General Information to Purchase Request - Item".-Resolution-System is working as designed. -If you want this feature to be implemented in ByDesign, you can request it in our Influence Platform -> SAP Business ByDesign Idea Place: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 -See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Idea Place: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 -Keywords-Extension Field, Purchase Request, Service, Service Master Data, Extension Scenario

Title: Custom Discount is Not Carried from Sales Order to Sales Order Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom discount list based on extension field on item level. The discount is determined in the sales order, but is not carried into the following sales order invoice request.-Note: Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center view.-Create a new sales order and maintain the necessary data in General tabl.-Go to the Items tab, enter a service product with item type as "Service - fixed price without actuals", the product discount is determined as -30% for example.-Save and complete this sales order ABC. (ABC represents the sales order ID)-Go to the Customer Invoicing and Invoice Requests view.-Open the sales order invoice request ABC, you find the item discount is empty, it is not copied from the sales order. -Cause-The custom discount list is based on an extension field on sales order item level. But the extension scenario 'Sales Order - Item to Invoice Request - Item' is not enabled  for the extension field. The custom discount is then removed in the sales order invoice request.-Resolution-It is needed to enabled the extension scenario 'Sales Order - Item to Invoice Request - Item'. -In the sales order Items tab.-Start Adaptation Mode. -Click Extension Fields to open the Custom Fields screen.-Select the extension field and click Show Further Usage.-Go to Extension Scenarios tab, select row 'Sales Order - Item to Invoice Requests - Item', click Add Field. The scenario is then added. -See Also-3012126 - Discount Not the Same Between Sales Order and Customer Invoice-Keywords-custom discount list; product discount; not in invoice request; sales order.

Title: Error message when running Inventory Ageing report: Report Cannot be Opened / Failed to Open Report
Content: Symptom-When trying to run a report/data source in the web browser and receive one of the following error message after the report loaded for some time:-"Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics Work center.-2. Select Design Reports view.-3. Search Inventory Ageing (SCMINVAGV04_Q0001)-4. Choose Apply.-5. System taking some time and trigger an error.-Cause-Huge data volume and complicated design of the standard SCM data source and Report-Resolution-This is an expected error message when the data volume is huge-Data must be passed with appropriate filters in order to reduce the data volume and execute the report without any memory dumps.-In this case filter on site or material to narrow down the report results, and also add other fields in the selection to reduce the data.-See Also-1926357 - Error message when running report: Report Cannot be Opened / Failed to Open Report-Keywords-Report cannot be opened, Report a case, analytics, time out, Inventory Ageing (SCMINVAGV04_Q0001).

Title: Product Description Language Not Changed with Logon Language
Content: Symptom-Log into system in language A and create a purchase order, see that Product Description field is in language A as expected. Log off.-Log into system in language B. Open the purchase order, see that the Product Description field is not displayed in language B but still in language A.-(A and B represents different languages.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Use EN and CN as an example.-Log into system in English (EN), create purchase order XXX (XXX stands for the ID).-See that in Product Description field, the content is displayed in English as expected.-Log off the system and log into it with another language, CN in this case.-Open purchase order XXX, see that Product Description field is still displayed in English not Chinese.-Cause-Different from UI language, system stores Product Description field language according to the language in which purchase order is created.-Resolution-Current system design.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Product Description; Language; Logon

Title: System Picking Wrong Ship From Location in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-While creation of a Sales Order, the different Ship-From Location ABC is proposed by default, instead of the Ship-From Location XYZ.-(ABC and XYZ represents Ship-From Location ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Under Common task, Select New Sales Order.-Enter all the mandatory details Account, Employee Responsible, Sales Unit, Materials and Price.-Under Items tab, perform Availability Check for the relevant line item.-Observe the system proposes the Fulfillment Location ABC instead of Location XYZ.-(ABC and XYZ represents Ship-From Location ID.)-Cause-Based on the Transport Zone, the system determines the possible Transport Lanes for a Material.-If multiple matching Transport Zones are found, the system evaluates all corresponding Transport Lanes and selects the one with the highest priority.-If multiple Transport Lanes are found but no priorities are maintained, the system selects the more specific lane.-For example, a Transport Lane defined for a specific product will be preferred over a Transport Lane defined for all products-If no priorities are maintained and none of the Transport Lane is more specific than the others, the system will select any one of the available Transport Lane.-Resolution-The preferred Ship-From Location must be selected manually while creating the Sales Order or the priorities can be assigned to the Transport Lanes:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Transport Lanes view.-Search and select the relevant Transport Lane.-Choose Edit Priority.-Select the required Location and enter the desired priority with 1 being higher than 2.-See Also-Ship-From Determination and Shipment Scheduling for Customer Demand - Documentation-Transport Lanes Quick Guide - Documentation-Keywords-Ship-From, Sales Order, Default, Location, transport lanes, transport zones

Title: Warehouse Confirmation (Customer Return) Has No Associated Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-No journal entry created for warehouse confirmation (customer return) in a third-party order + inter-company transaction document flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Inbound Logistics.-Access view Task Control.-Search task ABC, open warehouse request DEF in the below.-Select tab Document Flow, this task has a following warehouse confirmation WARE_CONF which has no journal entry.-*ABC, DEF, WARE_CONF represent document ID.-Cause-This is a third-party order + inter-company transaction document flow. In the inbound delivery notification (customer return) before warehouse request DEF, Follow-up Activity is maintained as Return to Supplier; Externally-Owned Stock is ticked. Hence, in warehouse confirmation WARE_CONF, all line items have same owner ID which is the account in the document flow, therefore there is no impact to financial data. These received stock should be returned to supplier later (Return to Supplier needs to be created manually) and cannot be used for other purposes.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Warehouse Confirmation, Journal Entry, Inter-company, Third-Party Order, Customer Return

Title: Lease Contract posting to wrong G/L account: Retained Earnings Brought Forward
Content: Symptom-You have created the Lease posting run and when you checked the postings tab you can be able to see that certain amount is getting posted to the G/L account: Retained Earnings Brought Forward which is unexpected, and you want to know the reason.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Lease contract management work center.-Go to the Lease postings run sub view.-Search for the relevant Run 'ABC'.-Navigate to the postings tab.-You will see the amount 100.000,50 EUR will be credited to the G/L account: Retained Earnings Brought Forward-Note: The amounts mentioned in this KBA is just for reference.-'ABC' refers to Lease Posting run ID.- Cause-In the Lease posting run 'ABC', take the note Lease contract 'AA'-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to the Lease Contract sub view.-Search for the Lease Contract 'AA'-Select the general tab.-Under transition, you can be able to see Transition Type as Retrospective.-The Lease contract 'AA' of company 'BB' is the transition contract with transition type as 'Retrospective' because of which the cashflow calculations happened completely based on the start date and end date of the contract and as per the condition value given in contract 'AA'.-For example: The Lease Contract transition date is 31.12.2023 for company 'BB' the lease liability opening balance for the contract on the transition date as per the cashflow report will go to the Lease liability G/L account which is 200.000,50 EUR and the balance amount of Right of Use asset will be going to Retained earnings G/L account which is 100.000,50 EUR and now if you check the Right of Use asset opening balance calculated on the transition date is 300.001,00 EUR (200.000,50 EUR + 100.000,50 EUR). -You can check the RoU asset Opening balance in the Report: Lease Contract valuation Cash flow.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected. -For more details check: Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow -  Keywords-Retained earnings, Lease Contract, Lease Posting run, RoU Asset, Transition Type, Lease Contract valuation Cash flow.

Title: Inconsistency in Employee Master Data Fields Visibility in ByD System
Content: Symptom-Biographical Data tab in Employee File does not show the same amount of standard fields and tabs for every employee.-Certain standard fields or tabs are not available for some employees, even when they are assigned to the same org unit.-Standard Fields or tabs are also not available for selection via Personalisation and Key User Adaption mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Personnel Administration work center-Select Employees view -Edit an Employee-Navigate to Personal Data > Biographical Data.-Observe that certain fields or tabs are visible.-Repeat steps 3-5 for another Employee-Observe that certain fields or tabs are not visible.-Cause-The availability of standard fields and tabs is country specific. The employees may have different County/Region assignments. These assignments are visible in the Employees view (as far as not deselected via Personalisation/Key User Adaption Mode).-Resolution-Check the Hire Employee option to find the relevant fields and tabs for each Country.-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select the country. -Select Hire Employee.-Check the available fields and tabs.-Keywords-Employee Master Data, ByD system, extension field, standard field, inconsistency, visibility, Nokia ID, Biographical Data, Personnel Administration, Social Insurance number, CSN.

Title: Source column missing for export in planning
Content: Symptom-The 'Source' column is missing when exporting excel sheet from product planning details-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning WoC-Select Products -Open the selected product-Choose Export-The 'Source' column is not available in the exported Excel sheet-Cause-The 'Source' column is a calculated field on the UI and hence cannot be exported to Excel.-Resolution-Excel Export does not support calculated fields. The system behaves as expected.-Keywords- Export, Missing Column, Source Column, Excel Export, Calculated Field, System Behavior

Title: Incorrect Data Appearing in Resource Calendar Data Source When Filtering for Job
Content: Symptom-You are using the Resource Calendar data source while filtering for a specific job. You notice that certain employees appear, even though they are not currently assigned to the job which is being filtered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Enter the Data Sources view.-Search for the data source Resource Calendar.-Click on Preview.-Use the Job field to filter for a specific job.-Click on the Apply button.-Switch to the View section of the data source.-Add a new Row field for Employee.-Here you can see certain employees being listed, even though they are not assigned to the specified job.-Cause-By default, the Resource Calendar data source does not consider a key date for the data being pulled.-This means that if there is no specific date being filtered together with the desired job, any employee that was assigned to the specified job at any point in time will be pulled by the data source.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-In order to pull only the employees who are currently assigned to the job, please use the Calendar Month, Calendar Day or Calendar Year fields in the selection section of the data source to limit the time frame of the selection.-Keywords-Resource Search, Employee, Service Agent, Job ID

Title: Unable to Change the Currency in Purchasing Contract
Content: Symptom-You have created and released the purchasing contract however you are unable to change the currency for the contract. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to Contracts view-Select the relevant Purchasing Contract-Select Edit and you want to change the currency here-Cause-Purchasing contract is already released and for released contracts it is not possible to change the currency. -Resolution-Since there are no follow up documents created with reference to this contract, you can close the contract and recreate a new contract with the correct currency. -Keywords-Unable to Change the Currency in Purchasing Contract

Title: BYD2408 Sales order to demand plan not working
Content: Symptom-You are unable to process project based Sales Order according to the customer demand plan. However, the status is showing as open with no error indication given. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center. -Go to the Customer Demand view. -Find and select the relevant Sales Orders.-You can see the Orders have the Status In Process. -Click Edit and then View All.-Go to the Items tab. -Select any of the Items in each Order.-You can see the Item Type is Product - project-based.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see there is a Project created against the Sales Order.-Open the respective Project.-Go the Products tab and select Project Stock Orders sub-tab.-You can see part of the Material has been Requested via the Project Stock Order and Delivered via an Outbound Delivery.-If you expand the relevant Project Stock Order and select the row with the Line Item, you can see under the Basic Data sub tab, that this Item Type is Pre-Delivery.-If you move further to the Document Flow sub-tab and show Extended View, you can see all relevant Warehouse Execution documents.-Cause-As this is a Sales Order with Item Type Project-based, no customer Demand will be created. The Material will be supplied to the Project through the Project Stock Order.-You can create the Project Stock Order in the respective Project assigned to the Sales Order.--Resolution-System is therefore working as designed.-See Also-Sales Order, Product - project-based, project, stock order, customer demand

Title: Incorrect Mapping of Fields in Excel Template File for Manual VAT Entries
Content: Symptom-In the excel file template used for uploading manual VAT entries, two headers are incorrectly mapped: the value set in the file for the field Posting Date goes to the field Tax Due Date in the manual VAT entry, and the value set in Account Assignment Type goes to Posting Date in the manual VAT entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2408-Reproducing the Issue-A) Download the excel template file for uploading manual VAT entries:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Manual Tax Entries view, VAT Entries subview.-Click New, Tax Entry from Microsoft Excel®.-Select Template Name Manual Tax Entries Upload and click Download.-B) Open the excel template file and enter data:-Open the excel template file.-Enter mandatory data and values in the fields Posting Date (enter a date) and Account Assignment Type (enter a date).-Upload the file to the system.-Check the VAT entry created in the system: the value entered for Posting Date in the excel file is reflected in the field Tax Due Date in the manual VAT entry, and the value entered for Account Assignment Type in the excel file is reflected in the field Posting Date in the manual VAT entry.-Cause-The issue is caused by incorrect mapping of Excel cells in the standard Microsoft Excel template Manual Tax Entries Upload.-Resolution-A permanent fix will be created, tested, and delivered by SAP in a future SAP Business ByDesign release. Meanwhile, the following workaround can be used:-Download the Excel file in English language.-Change the Header names: change Posting Date by Tax Due Date; change Account Assignment Type by Posting Date.-Save the file.-To upload the modified file, go to work center Application and User Management, view Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance.-Select Template Group: Manual Tax Entries Upload.-Find the template for language English.-Click Upload and click Replace Existing Language Variant.-Select the new template file and click ok.-Click Publish.-Now, the new template variant will be downloaded when clicking New, Tax Entry from Microsoft Excel® and selecting Manual Tax Entries Upload in Tax Management work center, Manual Tax Entries view, VAT Entries subview.-See Also-Keywords-Excel, Manual VAT Entries, Incorrect Mapping, Tax Management, Posting Date, Account Assignment Type, Tax Due Date, JIRA Item BYDDEV-13501, Workaround, Office Template Maintenance, Upload

Title: Add Input Product Through New Production Bill of Material Mass Maintenance Run, Line Item Group ID and Line Item ID Are Not Number.
Content: Symptom-In common task New Production Bill of Material Mass Maintenance Run, for option Add Input Product, new line item group ID is by default INS_ITG, new line item group item ID is by default INS_ITM, which are not expected number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Planning and Production Master Data,-Access common task New Production Bill of Material Mass Maintenance Run.-Select Add Input Product for BoM Mass Maintenance Options.-Maintain all mandatory fields , leave fields Proposed Item Group and Proposed Item Group Item as blank, click Next.-For any BoM variant, Proposed Item Group is INS_ITG, Proposed Item Group Item is INS_ITM by default.-Cause-This is system standard behavior.-Resolution-Change Proposed Item Group and Proposed Item Group Item to number manually.-Keywords-New Production Bill of Material Mass Maintenance Run, Proposed Item Group, Proposed Item Group Item
