Title: Not Possible to Remove Account Responsible Massively
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to massively remove account responsible employees from accounts, however you notice that there is no such option through Mass Data Maintenance or Migration Tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently it is not possible to remove account responsible employees to multiple accounts at the same time.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-master data, delete, MDM, Enhance already existing records

Title: System crashes while trying to do the reset clearing action for Payables along with the error message 'A table or list is being reloaded. Please wait or try again later; this may take up to a few minutes'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to do the reset clearing action for the clearing 'ABC' under payables, but system giving dump.-'ABC' refers to reset clearing ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier accounts sub view.-Search for the relevant Supplier account.-Under Trade payables, filter the line item with cleared items.-Search for the relevant clearing 'ABC' and select that.-As soon as you selected you will receive this error message: -A table or list is being reloaded. Please wait or try again later; this may take up to a few minutes. -Now give view all, try to give reset clearing.-Give the posting date.-Dump occurs.-Cause-Dump details for reference from the backend mentioned below.-Transaction code: ST22-Application Information-     1 Triggering application component: AP-ACC-     2 CM_FSI_QUERY, Program:CL_FSI_SERVICE_PROVIDER=======CP, Include:CL_FSI_SERVICE_PROVIDER=====-     3 Info: A table or list is being reloaded. Please wait or try again later; this may take up to-The error message as well as dump is caused due to inconsistency of the FSI views related to the FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT Business Object.-Resolution-Try to login to the Backend.-Give the Transaction code as GFSSTM.-Enter Business Object FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT.-Select Execute.-Navigate to the Load Status.-You can be able to see that business object FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT is showing in red.-Now try to expand the BO: FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT-Select the ROOT Node and give persistence.-It will take few minutes.-Once it's done, give refresh.-Now in the UI, try to do the reset clearing action for the clearing 'ABC' it should work without any dump/error message.-See Also-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3109303"-Keywords-FSI reload, Dump, CL_FSI_SERVICE_PROVIDER, Rest Clearing, FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT, Supplier accounts.

Title: Single Sign-On (SSO) Issues with SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App
Content: Symptom-Users are unable to login via Single Sign-On (SSO) using the SAP Business ByDesign mobile app.-The issue is observed on both iOS and Android platforms.-The error message received during the login attempt is not specified.-SSO login works correctly when accessed via a browser.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the SAP Business ByDesign mobile app using SSO credentials.-Observe the error message and inability to login.-Resolution-Verify the SSO configuration in the SAP Business ByDesign mobile app.-Check the SSO URL used for login.-Ensure the user has the required access rights and the correct business role assigned.-If the issue persists, consider logging in via the browser on the phone using the same URL as a workaround.-Additional point:-We are unable to offer the .apk file.-See Also-3305414 - Cannot Login ByD Mobile APP via Identity Provider using SSO.-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3305414-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Mobile App, Single Sign-On, SSO, Login Issue, Access Issue, Authentication, iOS, Android, Workaround.

Title: Non deductible Tax Amounts considered in Tax Return Details.
Content: Symptom-A VAT Return for Germany is generated, however the Total Tax Payable (as example) amount differs from the amount in details list item.-Environment-Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns view.-Open the reported VAT return.-Go to Tax Returns tab.-Here for e.g. for Formbox 66 (can be also a different Formbox).-Note down the amount.-Open the Details List.-Click Export -> To Microsoft Excel.-Open the exported Excel-File-Create Total for Tax Amounts Column.-You noticed that the Total Tax amount from the exported details list is different to the amount in Formbox 66.-Cause-This happens due to non-deductible items being considered in the run. The total tax amount you see in Tax Return tab is always aggregated one, it contains all calculated tax items regardless of whether the tax is deducted or not.-Resolution-If you want to see the deductible amounts follow:-Open the return in Tax Return Tab.-Navigate to Details.-Go to personalisation mode and check the field Deductible Tax Amount.-This enables the field in the Details screen and added a new column "Deductible Tax Amount". Then you can export the list to Microsoft Excel, create the Totals and the Total of the Column "Deductible Tax Amount" is equal to Amount in Formbox 66 (in this example).-See Also-Germany; Tax Return; Tax Management; Deductible Tax Amount

Title: Incorrect Ship-to Address in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The system selects a different ship-to address to what is expected when creating a new sales order for a given account with a business partner arrangement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Sales Orders.-Select view Sales Order.-New -> Sales Order.-Add a given account.-Observe the Ship-to address.-The address selected is outdated and has since been changed via the Main Address on the General tab of the account.-Cause-For the account in question there has been a new address maintained within main address on the General tab, however there is a relationship type 'Is Ship-To Party Of' maintained relating to the business partner which still has the outdated address.-Resolution-Navigate to work center Account Management.-Select the view Accounts.-Search for the relevant account.-Select Edit -> General.-Navigate to the Contacts tab, then the Relationships subtab.-Update the address for the relationship type 'Is Ship-To Party Of' relating to relevant business partner.-Keywords-Sales Order, Ship-to Address, Incorrect Address, Account Management, Business Partner, Relationship Type, Address Update

Title: How to Release Production Model Through Web Service
Content: Symptom-How to release production model to planning and execution via web service ManageProdModelIn?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently web service ManageProdModelIn and other standard web services don't support release production model to planning and execution.-Resolution-Release production model to planning and execution from frontend UI manually.-Keywords-Production Model, Release, Web Service, ManageProdModelIn

Title: Product ID not displaying in value help while creating Manual Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-Facing error "Determining product not possible" when creating manual customer invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the customer invoicing work center.-Create new customer invoice.-In the New Manual Invoice Request screen, enter account and sales unit -In Items section, add row and enter product ID will not be shown in the item selection value help -force enter the product ID, get error "Determining product not possible ".-Cause-The account was not configured for the distribution channel "Service"  -Resolution-The account should be configured both sales unit and distribution channel "Direct Sales" and also distribution channel "Service"  -See Also-https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2776354

Title: Error - 'Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery 'ABC')' occurs in the Warehouse Confirmation
Content: Symptom-A number of Warehouse Confirmation appears as Unposted Source Document with the Error 'Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery 'ABC')'.-'ABC' - refers to the Inbound delivery ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the source documents sub view.-Filter for Unposted Source Documents.-Search for the relevant Warehouse Confirmations.- The error message: Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery 'ABC').-Cause-When checked in the UI, The documents seem consistent with Inbound delivery is in released status and Customer return is in completed status, but the company utilized in the Warehouse confirmations 'AAA' differs from the company in Customer returns 'BBB'--For example, in the Warehouse Confirmation 'AAA', we are getting the error "Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery 'ABC') " because related Customer return 'BBB' created with company 'A00' which is different from the Warehouse Confirmation company 'B00' and because of this the Warehouse confirmation documents are not getting posted.-'AAA' - refers to the Warehouse Confirmation ID.-'BBB' - refers to Customer Return ID-'A00' - Company ID for Customer Return-'B00' - Company ID for Warehouse Confirmation-Resolution-It is not possible to post the Warehouse confirmation 'AAA' and Customer Return 'BBB' utilizing the different companies.--Cancel the Customer returns 'BBB' and create new Customer return providing the proper company ids to resolve this error.-To cancel the Customer returns, follow the steps mentioned in the KBA 2936830 - How to Cancel a Customer Return -See Also-KBA 2936830 - How to Cancel a Customer Return.-KBA 2609702 - Cancellation of Inbound Delivery Does Not Cancel Customer Return.-Keywords-Warehouse Confirmation, Customer return, Unposted source documents, Company, Inbound Delivery, Cancellation.

Title: System always picks the latest Purchase Order price of the non stock material while creating the Project
Content: Symptom-In the Materials tab of the new Project creation, system always picks the latest Purchase Order price of the non stock material, irrespective of the price maintained in the Project Period Plan. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is the system standard behaviour. -Resolution-As per the current design :-  1. Price from latest Purchase Order with reference to the Project - -If a Purchase Order with reference to the Project exists, the system uses the price from that Purchase Order. If there is more than one Purchase Order for the same material, the system uses the price from the latest Purchase Order.-  2. Price from latest Purchase Order without reference to the Project --If there is no Purchase Order with reference to the Project, the system uses the price from a Purchase Order that does not have a reference to the Project. If there is more than one Purchase Order for the same material, the system uses the price from the latest Purchase Order.-Keywords-Purchase order price picked for material in project, period plan price not considered, latest purchase order price considered for material, non stock material in project

Title: Cancelled Sales Order Visible In Planning View
Content: Symptom-A sales order has been cancelled and its status has been updated to Completed.-Despite the cancellation, the customer demand is still visible in the Planning view of the product.-The customer demand line item has the status Cancellation Requested, indicating a succeeding document which has not been processed completely.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Products View.-Search for the relevant Product and Planning Area combination and choose the Open button.-In the planning screen, the customer demand ID of the cancelled sales orders can be seen.-Cause-The deviation reported in warehouse tasks have not been accepted in the relevant warehouse order.-Once the deviations are processed and Accepted, the line items in customer demand will be updated with the correct Cancellation Status.-Resolution-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Monitoring view and choose the option By Warehouse Order.-Search and select the relevant warehouse order for which the deviations need to be accepted.-Choose the Edit button.-Navigate to the Operations tab.-Deviations reported for the line items can be seen, select the relevant deviation.-Choose any of the available options <Accept Deviation>, <Accept Deviation and Reject Open Quantity> or <Reprocess Open Quantity>-How you choose to process the deviations should be discussed and agreed with your business. -See Also-Help Document : Accept or Reprocess Outbound Deviation available in link here-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Stock Reservation, Canceled Sales Order, Customer Demand, Supply Planning, Outbound Logistics, Warehouse Order, Deviation Processing.

Title: Error in Posting Mapping Account Determination to Employee in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-During the migration of account determination groups to an employee in SAP Business ByDesign, an error occurs stating that the employee ID does not exist in the SAP cloud solution.-The employee ID is already created in SAP BYD, but the system fails to recognize it during the migration process.-The error message is "Employee 'XXXXX' is missing; create or migrate employee first"(XXXXX refers Employee ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Access Activities view-Select Migration of Suppliers.-Go to Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool.-Upload required migration file.-The error message "Employee 'XXXXX' is missing; create or migrate employee first" appears.-Cause-The problem occurs because the system fails to recognize the existing employee ID during the migration, which has created an initial space in the Employee ID, causing inconsistencies.-Resolution-To Resolve this issue follow the below steps.-Terminate the Employee.-To start the termination process follow the below steps-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Select Termination.-Ensure you include an asterisk (*) before the employee number XXXXX when inputting it. -After terminating the employee, you can rehire them, but assign a new employee ID. Although the rehire functionality allows for the same employee to be rehired with their original ID, using the same ID may result in space-related issues.-Keywords-Employee ID, Migration, Account Determination, Error, Termination, Rehire, Personnel Administration, Space Issue.

Title: Unable to Update VAT Number of Accounts via Web Service
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to change the VAT number for accounts via the SOAP API managecustomerin1.-The issue arises when attempting to update a VAT number, for example, changing the France VAT number for a customer to a new value.-Despite receiving a positive response from the API, the VAT number does not change.-No error message is associated with this issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Attempt to update the VAT number for a customer using the SOAP API managecustomerin1.-Observe that despite receiving a positive response from the API, the VAT number of the account does not change in the UI.-Cause-The issue may be due to the absence of a tax number action code in the SOAP request or due to an incorrect payload format.-Resolution-Use below example payload for country France and ensure that the correct account ID and tax ID is used: -<n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<BasicMessageHeader/>- <Customer actionCode="04">-  <InternalID>ABC</InternalID>-  <TaxNumber actionCode="04">-   <CountryCode>FR</CountryCode>-   <TaxIdentificationNumberTypeCode listID="FR">1</TaxIdentificationNumberTypeCode>-   <PartyTaxID>FR168XXXXXXXX</PartyTaxID>-  </TaxNumber>- </Customer>-</n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-(ABC represents the Internal ID of an account, FR represents a Country Code and FR168XXXXXXXX represents a Party Tax ID)-Keywords-SAP BYD, SOAP API, managecustomerin1, VAT number update, tax number action code, payload verification, fails, not updated,

Title: Case Note Not Updated to Provider (SAP)
Content: Symptom-Some notes in case are not updated to Provider (SAP).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Application and User Management.-Access view Cases -Open an open case, click Edit.-There are some notes in this case which SAP Support team seems don't receive.-Cause-These notes are with type "Note from Requester" which will not be updated to Provider (SAP).-Resolution-Please use note with type "Note for Provider" to communication with SAP.-See Also-Please refer to help document "Cases Quick Guide (Application and User Management)": https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2dd37281722d1014a5e89c88098dda0a.html-Keywords-Case, Note, Note from Requester, Note for Provider

Title: System Generated Inventory Notification Open For Product
Content: Symptom-System throws following error while approving PI Count Document- 'System generated inventory notification open for product ABC (ABC represents product ID).'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Physical Inventory Work Center.-Navigate to Monitoring - By PI Count Document View.-Search for the count Document.-Choose Approve Count button, then the mentioned error would occur.    -Cause-The error is caused by an Inventory Notification document for product ABC that has not been released. The user changed the Serial Number Profile to Mandatory for all Logistics & Production Processes, resulting in a system-generated Inventory Notification that has not been released.-Resolution-The user needs to release the Inventory Notification document for product ABC. Afterward, the user will be able to approve PI Count Document.-See Also-Switching between Serial Number Profiles -Keywords-Approve Count, Inventory Notification, Serial Number Profile, Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes,System generated inventory notification

Title: Material Cannot Be Deleted From Project Task
Content: Symptom-Delete button is grayed for material in Project Task. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view. -Search for ABC (ABC is the Project's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Project Plan tab. -Navigate to Gantt Chart subtab. -Select task ABC-N (ABC-N is the ID of the task). -Navigate to Materials sub subtab. -In Material column filter for XYZ (XYZ is the Material's ID).-There are two or more entries for the same material. -Select entry with unit of measure PQR (PQR is the unit of measure of the specific entry).  -Delete button is grayed out. The material cannot be deleted. -Cause-Ther are Consumption Confirmations linked to the Material to be deleted. That’s why the system is preventing this material from being deleted. -Resolution-Please follow the steps below to check the documents linked to the Material that needs to be deleted: -Follow the steps in 'Steps to Reproduce' section. -Click in Display History button. -The pop-up screen shows all the Consumption Confirmations that are linked to the Material. If these documents are canceled, then the material can be deleted afterwards. -Keywords-Project Task; Unit of Measure; Material; Delete; Consumption Confirmation

Title: Facing Error "The search did not return any documents" While Searching Under Community in Help Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-searching for results under community in Help center you face error "The search did not return any documents"-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-In Launch pad -Go to Help Center-Search for "ABC" -You will get search result-under Help Topics  & Knowledge Base Articles (KBAs) -But Under "Community " - It shows "The search did not return any documents "  No search result found -If you check the same thing under :-https://community.sap.com/-Search for "ABC" you get around XX results-Cause-Due to certificate issue they are not able to activate the RFC "COMMUNITY_ELASTIC_SEARCH_AUTH-Resolution-Send it to our operation team for activating and renew the certificate of Community search RFC -Keywords-community search not working , Community, The search did not return any documents

Title: No Results are Displayed When Searching for a Specific Service/Spare Part ID in the Service Order Processing View
Content: Symptom-The search field in the Service Orders view does not return results when searching for a specific Service/Spare Part ID. No results are displayed even though the Service/Spare Part ID is currently maintained in a Service Order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders Work Center.-Go to the Service Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-In the Search field, search for the Service ABC (where ABC represents the Service ID).-No results are displayed in the UI.-Cause-The Service/Spare Part ID is not utilized as a parameter for the search in the Service Orders Processing View. As a result, the system does not return any results when searching for the Service/Spare Part IDs.-The same behavior also occurs for other views such as Sales Quotes, Service Quotes, Sales Orders and Service Confirmations.-Note: If the Service/Spare Part ID is maintained in a Description or External Reference field, then document will be displayed in the UI when the search is performed. This occurs because the Description and External Reference field are utilized as a parameter for the search in the OWL.-Resolution-Go to the Service Orders Work Center.-Go to the Service Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-Select the Advance Filter Icon.-Locate the Item section.-In the Product ID field, enter the Service ABC.-Select Go.-The Service Orders with the Service ABC will be displayed.-The same process can also be applied for other views such as Sales Quotes, Service Quotes, Sales Orders and Service Confirmations.-Keywords-service orders, product ID, spare part ID, search field, no results, advance filter

Title: Field missing in custom datasource
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -The customer added new fields to a custom data source but cannot locate them in the UI data source report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login in to SDK.-Navigate to path /Y12345678_MAIN/SRC/Name1.ds -The "New1" Field is present.-Open UI and go to the Data Source-Search "Name1" data source.-Click Documentation button-Search for "New1 "field, no result are found.-Cause-The "New1" field is missing in the Data Source "Name1."-There is an inconsistency in the Data Source due to the recently added extension fields.-The  main reason for the issue is that the metadata is referencing an older version of the Data Source, which did not contain the "New1" field.-Resolution-Active Data Souce  /Y12345678_MAIN/SRC/Name1.ds by SE38 from backend.-2980177 - SE38 - Activating Pdi solution files in the backend-Notice: This issue has been identified and will result in pushing another patch version. Therefore, activation is required for the TEST, QA, and PROD tenants as well. -See Also-2980177 - SE38 - Activating Pdi solution files in the backend-Keywords-Data Source, Missing field,ds,extension fields.

Title: Cannot Pass the Value of an Extension Field from Over-the-Counter Sale to Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-The value of an extension field cannot be passed from the Over-the-Counter Sale document to the Outbound Delivery document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently there is no Extension Scenario available from Over-the-Counter Sale (Invoice Request) to Outbound Delivery.-Hence, it is currently not possible to pass the value of an extension field for the Over-the-Counter Sale document to the Outbound Delivery document.-Resolution-The feature/functionality is currently not part of the SAP Business ByDesign product, as outlined in our Product Documentation.-In this case the following options are available:-In order to directly get in contact with the decision makers in SAP Product Management, please submit the enhancement request via the following SAP Continuous Influence sites: SAP Business ByDesign-This program is related to Products and Solutions. Ideas are reviewed by SAP Product Management. Votes help to prioritize ideas along with other important selection criteria such as:-DESIRABILITY: How many customers voted for this? How many customers will benefit from it?-VIABILITY: Is this Improvement Request globally relevant? Is this in alignment with SAP’s strategy for the product?-FEASIBILITY: Is the development effort realistic? Is this request achievable within the product’s architecture?-All ideas are welcome and valuable. However please note that the volume of ideas will usually be much higher than the scope of what we can accomplish on our product development roadmap.-Keywords-OTC; Over the Counter; Extension Field; Extension Scenario; Over the Counter Sales to Outbound Delivery

Title: Customer invoice with Down payment request not generating the Journal entry due to Process communication error - 'For more details, see the dump in the "Application Info" section'
Content: Symptom-No journal entry is getting created for the Customer invoices, when you checked the document flow of that Customer invoice 'ABC' you can be able to see the Process Communication error icon in the Customer invoice 'ABC'.-  'ABC' - refers to the Customer Invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents sub view.-Open the relevant Customer Invoice 'ABC'.-Navigate to the Document Flow-You can see that no Journal Entry was created for this Customer Invoice 'ABC'.-Along with that you can be able to see the Process communication error icon.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Process Communication Errors sub view.-Search with the Sending document as Customer Invoice.-You can see the Main error as 'For more details, see the dump in the "Application Info" section' -Cause-One of the reasons for the dump might be that Customer invoice 'ABC' is having Down-Payment-Request which is connected to it doesn't have G/L account posting block settings as allowed.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice documents sub view.-Search for the Customer invoice 'ABC'.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Go to the Payment details sub tab.-Here you can be able to see that the down payment received is considering the G/L account: 'DEF'--But this G/L-Account 'DEF' has its Posting-Block attribute is set to "No Postings Allowed", follow the below steps to check that-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview.-Search for the Chart of Accounts activity.-Go to the Edit Chart of accounts and select the relevant Chart of accounts ID.-Below under details, you can be able to see all the G/L accounts assigned to this Chart of accounts ID.-Search for the G/L account: 'DEF', you can see that Posting-Block attribute is set to "No Postings Allowed".-Due to this reason, postings i.e., Journal Entry can't be posted to the accounting side.-Resolution-For the involved G/L-Account setting you have to set the Posting Block attribute to "All postings allowed" for the creation of Journal entry.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview.-Search for the Chart of Accounts activity.-Go to the Edit Chart of accounts and select the relevant Chart of accounts ID.-Below under details, you can be able to see all the G/L accounts assigned to this Chart of accounts ID.-Search for the G/L account: 'DEF' and set the Posting-Block attribute to "All Postings Allowed"-It should now create the journal entry for the Customer Invoice 'ABC'.-If it still not created, you have to create the case to SAP Technical Support to restart the failed XI message from the backend. Once the failed XI message delivered successfully from the backend then Customer Invoice will be posted with the Journal entry.-Keywords-Process Communication error, Customer Invoice, Customer Invoice, G/L account, Down Payment Request, Posting-Block, Chart of Accounts.

Title: System Triggers The Error "Cannot change status; mass data run xxx is scheduled" When Trying to Set MDRO Status as Obsolete
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set a mass data run (MDRO) as Obsolete, but the system is returning the error message:-Cannot change status; mass data run ABC is scheduled (ABC represents the Run ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will take as example the Production Control work center - Order Release Run view, but this applies to any run in the system.-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Order Release Run view.-Search for the Run ID: ABC.-Click Actions and select "Set To Obsolete".-The mentioned error appears: "Cannot change status; mass data run ABC is scheduled".-Cause-You have not cancelled the Background Job under Background Jobs view.-Resolution-There are two methods to cancel the job:-Option 1:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Background Jobs view.-Find and select the required Run ID in the Scheduled query filter.-Click Cancel Job.-If you do not find the Scheduled job, please click the Advanced Filter.-Change Status to Completed.-Click Go.-Locate the Run ID and click Cancel Job.--Option 2:-Go to Production Control - Order Creation Run view.-Select the Run ID and Click View Jobs.-Keep Scheduled Jobs in query, and click on Advanced Filter.-Change Status to Completed, click Go.-Select the job and click Cancel Job.-Now you can set the run as obsolete:-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Order Release Run view.-Select the Run ID.-Click Actions and select "Set To Obsolete".--Note: These resolution steps apply to all runs in the system.-Keywords-Cannot change status; mass data run  is scheduled, MDRO status as Obsolete,-cannot change status;,mass data run is scheduled,mdro status as obsolete,cannot change status; mass data run norm,normal_allsites is scheduled

Title: Supplier ID and Supplier Name Fields not populating in the Process Purchase Proposals view
Content: Symptom-Supplier ID and Supplier Name Fields are empty for many of the Rows in the Process Purchase Proposals View within the Supply Control Workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control Work Center.-Go to Process Purchase Proposals View.-Filter by All Proposals by Selection.-You will notice that there are many examples of Purchase Proposals that do not show any information for Supplier ID and Supplier Name.-Cause-The affected Proposals do not have a valid Source available.-When you open a Proposal that includes both the Supplier ID and Supplier Name, you will find the Source of Supply and the List Price maintained.-Conversely, if you open a Proposal that does not include the Supplier ID and Supplier Name, you will notice that there is no maintained Source of Supply.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue ensure there is a valid Source of Supply for the Requirement Date. The System will pick the Source and maintain the Supplier ID and Supplier Name.-Keywords-Process Purchase Proposals, Supplier ID, Supplier Name, Missing, Supply Control

Title: Event Notification Entity ID of Employee Attachment cannot be used in OData Service
Content: Symptom-An Event Notification is triggered when a modification of employee attachment happens. However, the entity ID in the payload of notification cannot be used in custom Odata Service of employee attachment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Business Object node in event notification of employee attachment is "AttachmentFolder.Root". However, for Odata, the Business Object node is "AttachmentFolder.Document".-Resolution-This is a system limitation for employee attachment notification. There is no option to choose other node in Event Notification. For Event Notification, the access is only on Root level instead of Document level.-Keywords-Event Notification, Odata Service, ID, AttachmentFolder.Root, AttachmentFolder.Document

Title: The Source System ID is Not showing While Creating the Restore Point
Content: Symptom-While triggering the Restore Point from the service Control Center the source system ID is not displaying.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customers-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center.-Go to Systems view.-Choose Restore Point.-Select Request Restore Point.-Cause-The selection of System ID is not being made properly.-Resolution-Select the respective System ID which is needed to request a Restore Point then Request Restore Point.-Keywords-Restore Point, Request Restore Point

Title: Posting of Invoice Not Possible Due to Error in Financial Accounting ; Financials Assignment for Material/ Business Residence Not Specified
Content: Symptom-An error occurs while creating supplier invoice based on a purchase order.-'Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Financials assignment for Material MM/business residence BR not specified'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Navigate to Invoice Entry View.-Filter for All Orders to Be Invoiced.-Search for the purchase order you wish and select the line.-Choose New Invoice button.-Click on check button, then the mentioned error would occur.- Cause-You are performing a business scenario that is not supported by the current system.-Open the Purchase order.-Go to the General Tab, then you notice that the buying company is BC.-Go to the Items Tab.-Select the line of the material MM.-Navigate to the Delivery Sub-tab and observe that the Requester OR is from the buying company BC, while the Recipient IR belongs to the business residence BR of Business Partner BP.-Open the master data for the material MM.-Go to the Valuation Tab and understand that the buying company BC can only be linked to its own business residences, not other business residences like BR of Business Partner BP.-From Financial perspective, posting supplier invoice is based on the valuation data available in the material for the company and business residence combination. Therefore, the mentioned error occurs as expected.-Resolution-Although this scenario is created without errors during the new purchase order phase, it is not supported in Financials. Therefore, please ensure that both the Recipient and the Requester are employees of the buying company in the purchase order.-See Also-2068664 - "Financials assignment for Material XYZ/business residence ABC(ABC Description) not specified"-Keywords-Posting, Invoice, Not Possible, Accounting, Financial, Assignment, Material, Business Residence, Specified, Buying Company, Recipient, Requester

Title: System Calculation of Due Dates in New Charge/Credit Screen for Customer and Supplier Accounts
Content: Symptom-How does the system calculate the due date in the New Charge/Credit screen for Customer and Supplier accounts?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Select the respective Customer Account ID and click View.-Select the document in question and click on New Charge/Credit.-The due date is populated automatically.-Resolution-The due date is automatically calculated based on the document date. However, since this is an editable field, you can modify the due date as needed, provided that it is equal to or later than the document date.-Keywords-Due Date, New Charge/Credit, Customer Accounts, Document Date

Title: How to Set Default Target Logistics Area for Input Product or Out Product in a Production Order?
Content: Symptom-When creating a production order without supply production task, how to set the default target logistics area for input product or output product in this production order?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The production make task does not apply for the Material Flow Rules. The default target logistics area for input product or output product is determined by the resource location of the main resource for this production order.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to maintain the default target logistics area for input product or output product:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Locations view.-Search for the relevant site for resource location.-Click on Edit Layout button.-Find the Logistics Area for the resource location.-Go to Resource tab, Production Supply and Output Details subtab.-Maintain the Fixed Supply Area and Fixed Output Area fields.-After done above actions, the maintained Fixed Supply Area and Fixed Output Area will be displayed on the target logistics area for input product and output product respectively.-Keywords-Target logistics area, Input product, Output product, Production order, Location, Resource, Production Model

Title: Error while changing Internal indicator for Fixed Asset Settings in the Set of Books Activity
Content: Symptom-Error 'Set of books AA, company 123: journal entries already exist' occurs while trying to change the Internal indicator for Valuation View ID in the Set of Books activity.-Note:-AA refers to the Set of Books ID-123 refers to the Company ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find activity Set Of Books and click Open.-Select the Set of Books ID AA.-Click Edit and navigate to the Fixed Asset Settings tab.-An internal flag is already set for a Valuation View.-Remove the internal flag from the current Valuation View and set it for another Valuation View.-Click Save.-Error 'Set of books AA, company 123: journal entries already exist' occurs.-Cause-Journal Entries already exists for Set of Books AA and Company 123. It is not possible to change the 'Internal' indicator even if postings are reversed or fixed assets are retired.-Resolution-Changes to a set of books can only be made if there are no existing journal entries in that set of books. If journal entries exist, you can only change settings that are not specific to accounting principles.-See Also-Configuration: Set of Books | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Valuation View, Set of Books activity, Fixed Asset Settings, Internal, Indicator, journal entries already exist

Title: Customer Invoice Requests are Not being Invoiced from the Invoice Run
Content: Symptom-The Invoice Run was created, however, the Invoice Run is not releasing some of the Invoice Requests as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Runs view.-Select the Invoice Run ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Run).-Click the Schedule button.-Select one of the Schedule options.-Click the Save and Close button.-Navigate to the Invoice Requests view.-Some of the Invoice Requests which were expected to be released by the run, are still with the To Be Invoiced status.-Cause-The Invoice Requests are being processed for invoicing but dump occurred with error "Document change not allowed as retention is over; please contact your DPO".-Checking Document Retention Status for the Invoice Requests in "Information Lifecycle Management Work Center - Lifecycle Items View", the status is shown as "End of Retention".-Resolution-Document Retention Status for the Invoice Requests must be corrected and along with other documents where issue is occurring.-See Also-KBA 2773173 - Invoice Run not Releasing all Documents-KBA 1892909 - Customer Invoice Has Not Been Created for the Contract Even though the Invoice Run Has Been Executed Successfully-Keywords-Invoice Run; Invoice Request; Not Released; To Be Invoiced; Document Retention Status

Title: System is not allowing to create a Subsequent Credit with multiple Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-While attempting to create a Subsequent Credit by combining multiple Supplier Invoices, system picks the items from only 1st or the last Invoice which is selected. All the items from all the invoices are not picked. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit memos view-Select all the invoices for which Subsequent credit should be created-Click on New and then select Subsequent Credit-Cause-Multiple Invoices cannot be clubbed together to create a Subsequent credit . -Resolution-System will consider the items from only the first or the last invoice selected when a Subsequent Credit is created by choosing multiple invoices. This is the expected system behavior. Subsequent credit can be created only for single Supplier Invoice at a time. -In order to apply the discount for all the items in the Subsequent Credit document created, make sure that the document is created with single Supplier Invoice , as the system does not allow to combine multiple Invoices . Hence discounts also cannot be applied in a single Subsequent Credit for multiple items from different Supplier Invoices. -Hence, create different Subsequent credit for different Supplier Invoices and add the desired discounts as applicable. -See Also-Create a Subsequent credit or debit-Keywords-Subsequent credit for multiple invoices, Discount on items from different supplier invoices in a subsequent credit

Title: Error 'Association SAP_CreationIdentity to IDENTITY. is missing in business object *' during Solution Deployment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Internal Use Only-Error 'Association SAP_CreationIdentity to XXXXX, or Service provider CL_PDI_1O_SDI_PROVIDER checks indicate errors (component AP-RC-BDS-1O)-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Cloud For Customer Addins-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Application Studio-Open PDI solution YABC-Click on Upload -Browse ZIP file-Click on Continue -Error appears-Association SAP_CreationIdentity to IDENTITY. is missing in business object *-Patch is not compatible-Service provider CL_PDI_1O_SDI_PROVIDER checks indicate errors (component AP-RC-BDS-1O)-Patch is not compatible-Cause-This error message usually happens, if the Busienss Objects have different DeploymentUnit annotations in the different versions.-When there is some change in the given business object *(shown in error messag) from the previous patch version.-For Example : Partner is trying to upload solution version 15 and from version 14 he had deleted annotation from the business object *, which means business object in version 14 will have annotation (or any content) and version 15 it got deleted.-In such cases backend will check and thrown this error message.-Resolution-Please check change details for the mentioned BO * from the backend using tcode XREP, below are the steps :-Login to Backend-Open tcode XREP-Open All folders-Open Y (affected solution) solution, YABC_Main-Open Previous solution version (here in example case, version 14)-Check mentioned BO* content-Now Open current solution version (here in example case, version 15)-Check mentioned BO* content-Here you will find some changes (example annotation deletion..etc)-Inform partner to add the deleted content again by creating a new patch solution version-Perform upload in the target tenant -In case, parter cannot fix it, in order to resolve this issue, we would need to skip the check through which the error is getting raised and import the solution for the partner.-Following this, our development would activate the solution  from our end in the timeframe provided by the customer.-Keywords-Solution deployment, PDI, Upload error, Association, missing in business object

Title: Manual adjustment in Time Account is not reflected correctly
Content: Symptom-After manually add the balance to a Time Account, the added balance is shown in another Time Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Edit employee XYZ (XYZ represents the employee name).-Go to Time Account Balance.-Select Time Account AAA.-Go to Adjustment.-Add row -> Add the amount of balance.-The added balance is shown in Time Account BBB.-(AAA and BBB represent different time account IDs.)-Cause-This is the system designed behavior. Time Account AAA and Time Account BBB are overlapped.-Resolution-If the following three situations are satisfied, the time record posted in Time Account BBB will be moved to Time Account AAA which causes the added balance in Time Account AAA is used and the same amount of balance in Time Account BBB is released.-Time Account AAA and Time Account BBB are overlapped.-Time Account AAA ranks higher then Time Account BBB in the post order.-The date of time record in Time Account BBB falls in the period in which Time Account AAA and Time Account BBB are overlapped.-Keywords-Manual Adjustment, Time Account, Balance, Not Increase, Incorrectly Reflect

Title: Error 'Clearing object already exists for : ABC, Item: ABC-1' in GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The following error occurs in GR/IR Clearing run:-'Clearing object already exists for : ABC, Item: ABC-1'-'During run the error 'Save failed; report an incident' occurred.'-Note:-ABC refers to the Purchase Order ID.-ABC-1 refers to the Purchase Order line item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Management work center.-Go to the GR/IR Clearing view.-Search for the Goods Receipt and Invoice Receipt Clearing ID in question and click on Log Result.-Navigate to the Messages tab. The run has the following errors:-Clearing object already exists for : ABC, Item: ABC-1-During run the error 'Save failed; report an incident' occurred.-Cause-The error occurs due to inconsistencies in the back-end data caused by an unusual sequence of events for Purchase Order ABC, an extra clearing object was generated for one of the line items in inbound delivery. This inbound delivery was created with reference to the Purchase Order line item ABC-1. Additionally, Supplier Invoice YYY ('YYY' refers to the Supplier Invoice ID) with a failed XI can be identified in the backend that encountered the same error.-Resolution-Create an incident to development team with the permission to perform backend correction. -Keywords-Clearing object already exists for, GR/IR error, Save failed; report an incident, Clearing.

Title: Error: 'No Time Agreement Exists for Employee' When Trying to Upload Time Recordings via Excel Add-In
Content: Symptom-You are trying upload the Employee Time recordings via Excel Add-In, however you get the error message as "No time agreement exists for employee"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Click on Actions - Record Employee Times from Microsoft Excel-Open Excel template and enter the mandatory data-Click on Save Data -Excel Add-in may throw error "No time agreement exists for employee"-Cause-There may be some extra space in the excel file or when creating the employee, you might have accidentally added extra spaces to the Employee ID.-Ex: Employee ID might be in excel is xyz and Employee ID might be in the system is xyz# Or tis could be Other way around.-Note: abc referred as Employee ID & # referred as space.-Resolution-One reason for this error could be the presence of a space before or after the employee ID #xyz#, which may be stored as such in the backend of the system. To verify if there is a space before or after the employee ID, please search for the Employee ID in the Employee Personal Administration or Employee Time file. If the search does not work, try using *xyz* to find the employee. This will confirm whether there is a space before or after the Employee ID. Once confirmed, make the necessary changes to the excel file and update the Time recording accordingly.-See Also-1404035 - Error 'No time agreement exists for employee' When Trying to Save Time Recordings via Excel Add-in for a Project -Keywords-Excel Add-in, Time Agreement, Time Recording, Time Recording via Excel, No Time Agreement, SRD-HR-TLM, BYD, Excel, Excel Upload of Time, No time agreement exists for employee, Employee Time Recording.

Title: Payment Terms Are Not Taken Over Into The Cancellation Invoice.
Content: Symptom-When creating a cancellation invoice, the payment terms are not taken over from the original document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Choose any invoice document in status released and click on cancel.-In the new Cancellation invoice, there are no payment terms taken over and payment terms cannot be entered.-Cause-There is no need from a business perspective for payment terms in a cancellation invoice as there is no payment taking place.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-cancellation invoice, payment terms, Storno, Zahlungsbedingung, invoice, Rechnung-payment terms,cancellation invoice

Title: Error "Cannot change cost rate of service XYZ; it was used in valuation after DD.MM.YYYY" When Updating Cost Rate of Service XYZ
Content: Symptom-Error is displayed upon updating cost rate for a service:-"Cannot change cost rate of service XYZ; it was used in valuation after DD.MM.YYYY" when updating the cost rate of the service. (XYZ stands for the service ID, while DD.MM.YYYY stands for the valid from date of the cost rate.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Services view.-Edit service XYZ.-Go to the Valuation tab, and click Edit Cost Rate. -Update the cost rate with valid from date as DD.MM.YYYY.-Press Enter, error is thrown:-"Cannot change cost rate of service XYZ; it was used in valuation after DD.MM.YYYY".-Cause-The error occurs as there are postings for this service after DD.MM.YYYY.-This can be viewed via the G/L Accounts - Line Items report, as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Open the report G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Input company, set of books, and Journal Entry Type as Internal Service Confirmation. -Run the report.-Add field Service (Product) and filter with service XYZ: the postings are displayed.-Resolution-If the cost rate needs to be changed with the validity from DD.MM.YYYY, the postings after the date need to be reversed first to allow this.-Keywords-Service Cost Rate, Valuation, Internal Service Confirmation

Title: Details of SAP Admin, Support and Technical Users
Content: Symptom-This KBA describes each type of SAP Admin, Support and Technical Users in the system and their functionality.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-1. Why so many SAP users are necessary?-- As this is a cloud based product, these users are available for different sets of user groups (for example, Basis Administrators use ADMIN* users and the Customer Support team SUPP* users). As it is not feasible to create users for each of the basis admins in the team, it was created users for groups instead of per user. The rest is used for different activities, for example monitoring/update/upgrade/other provisioning related activities.-2. Which authorizations they have?-- Each user group has different set of authorizations and the system have different security policies for them. This information is available in the UI to be checked. Business related activities are restricted and basis administration authorizations are provided as per the audit compliance. --3. Why the validity is unlimited?-Even if the validity is unlimited, the users will be locked and will be unlocked based on the requirement. Each user request is tracked and is part of an audit.--4. Is there a differentiation possible between dialog and non-dialog users?-Yes, there is a differentiation. Not all users are dialog.-5. When can support users request an access?-If support users receive a case and realize that the support team has to access the customer system in order to analyze the problem (for example, it is not possible to replicate the scenario in the internal test or development systems). In this case, the Cloud Access Manager (CAM) tool is used to generate a temporary access to the corresponding customer system. Support users are not allowed to share these details. The CAM tool keeps a log of which user generated which support user at what date and time. So it is always possible to link a generic support user back to the real person.-Resolution-Dialog Users:-SAP_ADMIN001-SAP_ADMIN005 -> Operation Admin Users.-SAP_SUPP001 - SAP_SUPP010 -> Support Users.--For these users there are many access levels from L2 to L7 (basic log configuration to full system access). The minimal basic requirements have to be selected depending on the support tasks required.--Service Users:-SAP_ADEM001-SAP_ADEM005 -> Fallback Users for Operation Team.-SAP_SUEM001-SAP_SUEM005 -> Fallback Users for Support Team.--Non-dialog users (Technical):-SAPH0M3 - This user belongs to User Account SAP_SPC, which is related to the system_setup.-DDIC - for installation, software logistics, Initial System, Setup Lifecycle Management, Database Statistics Batch Jobs, TP Import Jobs and the ABAP dictionary (SAP_ALL).-SAP_BGRFCSUP - for background RFC connections.-SAP_DOCFSI - fast search index.-SAP_IAMLGN – health check/monitoring.-SAP_LMADM - for provisioning (SAP_ALL).-SAP_LMPRV - for provisioning.-SAP_LMUPD - for provisioning.-SAP_PDIOCS - for PDI.-SAP_SBB - bgRFC communication user.-SAP_SMDMON - for monitoring.-SAP_SMTP_IN - SMTP inbound communication.-SAP_SPC - automated SPC user self service.-SAP_SYSTEM - for job scheduling.-SAP_TLM - transactional user (RFC).-SAP_TREXADM - for TREX (FSI).-SAP_WSRT - communication user for webservice.-SAP* - superuser for client and system installation (SAP_ALL).-TMSADM - for transports.-XIB2BCONNECT - communication user to XI system.-DELAY_LOGON - Message based web service authentication.-SAP_PRELOADER - Generating the XREP and Runtime loads.-Aside from these users, the system creates a technical user whenever a communication arrangement is created. In case the arrangement is removed, the user remains in the system with status blocked.-See Also-Follow-up FAQ KBA: 2757453 - Frequently Asked Question on Type of Users Available in the System-Help Document: User Types-Keywords-Technical, User, Business, End, SAP, Admin, Supp, Authorization, Access, Rights, DELAY_LOGON

Title: In Report "Inspection Analysis", Field "Acceptance Rate in %" Is Either Blank or 100%.
Content: Symptom-In report "Inspection Analysis", field "Acceptance Rate in %" is either blank or 100%, but you expect that it should calculate like this: Acceptance Rate in % = (Inspected Quantity - Nonconforming Units) / Inspected Quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have a "Final inspection - production" inspection ABC (ABC represents inspection ID), you have maintained inspected quantity and nonconforming units, result is recorded , and you have maintain an accepted option (like "Accepted - minor deviations - QS 80") for Quality Decision.-In report "Inspection Analysis" (PLMQINU01_Q0002), check inspection ABC, in key figure "Acceptance Rate in %", it is 100%.-Cause-There are two key figures in report Inspection Analysis, they are "Acceptance Rate in %" and "Rejection Rate in %". If an inspection has "Accepted" Quality Decision, then it has 100% in "Acceptance Rate in %"; if an inspection has "Rejected" Quality Decision, then it has 100% in "Rejection Rate in %". Hence, there are only two possibilities. The rates have no relationship with the inspected quantity, destructed quantity or nonconforming units.-For inspection ABC, since its Quality Decision is "Accepted - minor deviations - QS 80", hence it has 100% in "Acceptance Rate in %".-Resolution-System standard behavior-Keywords-Inspection Analysis, Acceptance Rate in %

Title: Unable to Synchronize Contacts and Accounts From Business ByDesign to Outlook Add-In
Content: Symptom-Accounts and contacts from SAP Business ByDesign system are not synchronized with the Outlook Add-In.-Disclaimer: "Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In Outlook, log on to SAP Business ByDesign using the Outlook add-in -Go to Settings-Navigate to Contacts-Select Download Contacts-Observe that the Contacts and Accounts are not synchronized-Cause-Contacts are not synchronized with the Outlook add-in because the contact information is not maintained in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-The account is not synchronized because Groupware Synchronization is not scoped in the system.-Resolution-As a pre-requisite for downloading contacts to Outlook from SAP Business ByDesign, the Groupware Synchronization checkbox provided in the Account Management work center, needs to be selected.-Groupware synchronization of contacts with Outlook is possible only if Responsibilities for Contacts business option is selected in solution configuration. Follow the below steps to scope the question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Choose the Implementation Projects view-Edit Project Scope-In the Scoping step of the project, ensure that Business Partners is selected within General Business Data-In the Questions step, expand the General Business Data scoping element and select Business Partners-Select Handling of Business Partners and scope the question, Do you want to maintain direct responsibilities for contacts? in Group: Responsibilities for Contacts-Account must exist and have the relationship with Contact to get synchronized with. Follow the below steps for Account Synchronization:-Go to Account Management work center-Go to Accounts view-Select the account where the contact should belong and get synchronized-Select Edit - Addresses-Select Assign Contact.-Note: The Contact must be assigned via ‘Assign Contact’ button-Select the value help and choose the contact-Save-      Follow the below steps for Contact Synchronization:-Go to Account Management workcenter-Go to Contacts view-Select the contact that should be synchronized-Select Edit - General-Navigate to the Relationships tab-Navigate to the sub tab Responsibilities-Select Add Row and maintain the Employee/Customer detail on whose Account the contact needs to be replicated to Outlook -Select the Party Role as "Additional Contact Responsible"-Save-        To Synchronize the Contact/Account in Outlook, follow the below steps:-Open Outlook Add-In-Login to SAP Business ByDesign-Go to Settings-Select Synchronize Contact Automatically checkbox as seen in the below screenshots and select OK-This will synchronize both the Account and Contact information in Outlook-                Note:-Accounts synchronized can be checked via Email Sync pop-up function and all the Account related to the Customer can be seen /searched (as shown in screenshot above).--Contacts synchronized will be available under My Contact -> In Outlook.-See Also-SAP Help Portal - Quick Guide for Microsoft Outlook® Integration-Keywords-Contacts, Accounts, Outlook Add-In, Synchronize issues, Contact Responsible, Account Management, Outlook

Title: Updating Pricing Completely Does Not Work for Customer Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When invoicing an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request and selecting the Update Pricing Completely in the Pricing tab, nothing changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request).-Click on Invoice button.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Click on Update Pricing button and then Completely.-The line item price will not change, even if a new Price List with valid dates is set up.-Cause-This happens because in the invoicing scenario, the system will take the Pricing Date of a Invoice Request from the source document, it means the Pricing Date of a Sales Order. Once the Pricing Date is set for the day before of the starting day of a valid Price List, the system will not trigger the update action.-Resolution-To be able to update the prices in the Invoice Request document, the Pricing Date needs to be changed in the source document for the date where the new Price List starts to be valid. After that the Updating Pricing Completely action can be performed again for the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request, and it will change as expected.-Keywords-Update Pricing ; Invoice Request ; Price List; Outbound Delivery Invoice Request

Title: Error When Trying to Invoice a Sales Order or Canceling a Contract
Content: Symptom-Error when trying to Invoice a Sales Order or performing the cancelation of a Contract:-The data of the selected business partner cannot be displayed anymore for data privacy reasons.-It might be that the data is blocked for usage, depersonalized or deleted.-Please approach your data privacy team.-Or:-Using business partner XYZ not permitted; status in master data Not Active (KBA:2927824)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Then go to the Contracts view.-Show All Contracts.-Search for the affected Contract ID.-Click Edit and go to Renewal and Cancellation tab.-Under Cancellation section, set the details to cancel the contract.-Click Save.-Error occurs.-Cause-The error message is occurring because the Business Partner was Obsoleted by the Data Protection and Privacy functionality.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior, as the Business Partner is obsolete the mentioned error message will appear.-In order to fix this error, you can either change the Business Partner in the document or maintain the Business Partner active again by following the steps below:-Go to the Information Lifecycle Management work center.-Then go to the Business Partners view.-Search for the  required ID. -Click the link with the ID.-Click View All.-Change Status > Active.-See Also-2927824-Keywords-Error, Cannot, Edit, Sales Order, Contract, The data of the selected business partner cannot be displayed anymore for data privacy reasons, It might be that the data is blocked for usage, depersonalized or deleted, Please approach your data privacy team, Using business partner, not permitted, status in master data not active.

Title: How to View Multiple Companies Balance Summary in One Report?
Content: Symptom-Which is the report for multiple companies to fetch the data via report ? -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports view.-Search Material Inventories - Balance Summary (Datasource: FININVU14_Q0001).-Select Edit with and Choose Web browser.-In the field company, choose value help.-There is an option to select only one company.-However, there is a need to see multiple companies' stock in a single report.-Cause-Since each company consist of different quantities/stock information, to get all the information of multiple companies with all sites in one report is not available.-There is only one report available :Material Inventories - Balance Summary (FININVU14_Q0001).-Resolution-It is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Material Inventories - Balance Summary, Design Reports, companies' stock, FININVU14_Q0001, balance summary, stock,

Title: Error When Trying to Change the Time Type Category
Content: Symptom-Error when trying to edit the Time Type Category in the Time Types Activity:-"Category change not possible; employee time still uses time type: XYZ (KBA: 1512998)"-*XYZ means the Time Type ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Then go to the Implementation Projects.-Select the First Implementation Project.-Click Open activity list.-Then search for the activity Time Types - Country and open it.-Click Maintain Employee Time Types.-Select the Code Time Type Code XYZ and perform the required changes.-When trying to save it, system shows the error.-Resolution-In order to solve this error, please follow the steps below:-Go to Time type XYZ in Business Configuration in Edit mode.-Perform the require change in the Time Type.-This adjustment will effectively resolve the issue.-See Also-1512998 - Error Message: Category change not possible; employee time still uses time type: XYZ, when Trying to Change Pre-delivered Time Types-Keywords-Cannot Change, Time Type Category, Category change not possible, employee time still uses time type, Business Configuration, Time Types.

Title: You Cannot Release the Order to Logistics Execution. Order XXX Item YYY is Locked by User ZZZ
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Error "You cannot release the order to logistics execution. Order XXX (Where XXX is Order ID) item YYY (Where YYY is item ID) is locked by user ZZZ (Where ZZZ is user ID)" occurs when releasing a Customer Demand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-Navigate to Customer Demand View.-Search for Customer Demand XXX.-Choose Edit button.-Select Line Item YYY.-Choose Release button, then the error occurs. -Cause-Temp persistence lock created by affected user ZZZ for reported Customer Demand document XXX-YYY.--More than likely this was caused by duplicate sessions open for same user and document, this can happen if they have duplicated the tab.-Resolution-Normally these locks delete from the system after 24hrs, deletion is always advised from Dev side once lock is identified. Please create an incident with Highest priority and forward it to AP-CR-CR for the deletion.-Keywords-Release; Customer Demand; Lock.

Title: The value of Price Component for Cancelled Invoice is Incorrect in Customer Invoice Volume with Price Component Report
Content: Symptom-In the Customer Invoice Volume with Price Component Report, the Price Component for Cancelled Invoice is Positive. You expect this to be negative.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Reports view.-Search for report: Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components. -Open the Report.-In the Selection, enter ABC for the characteristic Invoice (ABC represents the ID of your customer invoice).-Run the Report.-Cause-When a Customer Invoice is cancelled, the customer invoice volume with price component report will show the value of the document, thus the value for the Cancellation Invoice will not turn negative. A cancellation document does not return the same behavior as a credit memo.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-You can add the field Cancellation Invoice Indicator to the Report which will indicate that this is a cancellation document.- See Also-KBA 3074658 - How to Show Cancelled Invoice ID in the Invoice Volume Report-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Report, Price Component; Cancellation Invoice;

Title: Release Button Greyed Out For Stock Transfer Delivery From India
Content: Symptom-When trying to release a stock transfer delivery document the Release button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the relevant stock transfer outbound delivery and select it.-Here the Release button is grayed out, even though not canceled the document via adjustment confirmation.-Note: Here observed this behavior is only when the Ship-From and Ship-To locations are in India.-Cause-An end user has performed Undo Release on the stock transfer order earlier. Since in India electronic invoicing is available for Stock Transfer Orders the below guidelines are followed to ensure consistency of data.-Perform Undo Release action on an outbound delivery, only if the associated inbound delivery is not released.-If Undo Release action is executed on an outbound delivery, you cannot re-release it.-Resolution-If the document released again, please create an case and send to SAP Technical Support. Please make sure to use the component <AP-ODP-OD-GLO> in the Case.-See Also-The above is explained in SAP Help document titled Posting of Stock Transfer Order – India-Keywords-stock transfer outbound delivery, release button, grey out, unable release, otbound delivery, India, stock transfer order

Title: TREX-ERROR in Report
Content: Symptom-When running a report you get the following error message:-TREX-ERROR (2626): executor timeout/[Request Info: Object Name = "HANADB".".c003:1fs:jdx_fsp_pro_cpel_edis", FM Name = TREX_DBS_SEARCH_CELL_TABLE]-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the required report from the respective work center.-Enter the selection parameters.-Click on Go.-You will get the above error. In some scenarios, you will also get this error without any selection parameters or on opening the report.-Cause-This error is usually caused by too much data in this report.-Resolution-There are several actions possible to reduce the data volume:-Enter additional selection parameters. For example, if you are requesting data for a whole year, reduce it to 6 months, or monthly.-If it is a custom report, change the report and / or data source design to enable a better peformance. Please check the KBA mentioned below.-See Also-2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling Data Sources and Reports - Performance-2393253 - Performance in HCM reports  (ByDesign only)-Keywords-time out, TREX, data volume, huge data, reporting

Title: Down Payment Request Ignores the Approval Process When Selecting the Release button, but not When Selecting Save as Invoice Button.
Content: Symptom-Down Payment Request ignores the approval process when the Release button is selected, but not when the Save as Invoice button is selected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Create New Down Payment Request from the Common Tasks.-Enter all the necessary details.-Click on Release button.-In this case, the approval status changes to In Approval, but the document is released.-The scenario only occurs only when selecting the Release button directly during the creation of the Down Payment Invoice. If the Save as Invoice button is selected and then the release of the Down Payment Invoice occurs, the approval process is triggered as expected.-Cause-Using extension fields as the conditions to determine the approval process causes the approval process to be ignored. This means a down payment that should go to approval will simply be released if the release button is selected.-Resolution-For the approval processes for the down payments to work as expected, it is required to either change the conditions to not include extension fields, or always save the created Down Payment Requests as invoices first using the Save as Invoice button in the Down Payment Invoice Request.-Keywords-Down payment; Approval process; Down payment request; Release; Save as Invoice

Title: Invoice AAA is Not Considered in Invoice Summary Run
Content: Symptom-Create invoice AAA(AAA represents the ID of the invoice).-Execute invoice summary run.-However, invoice AAA is not included in any monthly invoice, or no monthly invoice is created for the account BBB(BBB represents the account of invoice AAA).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Invoice Summary Runs view.-Search the run in question and view Log tab.-Click on the log in question.-Cannot find the monthly invoice for account BBB, or invoce AAA is not included in the monthly invoice of account BBB.-Cause-The issue is because the currency used in the invoice (for example, "USD") is not "JPY". It's necessary to use "JPY" in the base transaction documents.-System works as designed.-Resolution-Cancel the invoices and create new invoices with correct currency code. Then recreate the summary invoice for the related time periods.-See Also-KBA 3247998   Invoice AAA is Not Considered in Invoice Summary Run-KBA 2870283 - Invoice AAA Should Not Be Included in Monthly Invoice BBB-Help document: Summary Invoice Document-Keywords-Invoice Sumamry, Monthly Invoice, Summary Invoice, Invoice Summary Relevancy, Currency, JPY

Title: TREX-ERROR (1987): invalid hexadecimal data detected in query table on column ENT_UUID
Content: Symptom-Error is noticed at the time executing report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics.-Open Design Reports and execute the affected report.-An error is seen at the bottom of the screen as :--          TREX-ERROR (1987): invalid hexadecimal data detected in query table on column ENT_UUID-          TREX error occurred-Cause-Wrong Mapping is done in the data source used for this report-Resolution-Check and Edit the data source.-Make changes in the mapping by either removing it (if this is a combined data source) or select another field (if it is join data source)-Save the data source-Execute the report-See Also- 2356785 - TREX-ERROR (1987): invalid hexadecimal data detected in query table on column UUID-Keywords-TREX-ERROR (1987), Error in report , invalid hexadecimal

Title: Dunning Letter/Proposal Not Generated After Executing Dunning Run
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Dunning Run. But you cannot see the Dunning Proposal generated by the system.-OR-You have selected the checkbox -  Include Items Not Overdue in the Dunning Strategies Finetune activity. However, you cannot see any Dunning Proposal generated by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Settings in Dunning Strategies finetune activity:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview.-Search for the Finetune activity - Dunning Strategies (or access the activity through the activity list of your First Implementation project).-Press Edit Dunning Strategies.-Select the Dunning Strategies.-In the Details section you have selected the Include Items Not Overdue checkbox.-Dunning Run Execution:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Navigate to the Dunning Run view.-Click on New - Dunning Run.-Enter the data as per your requirement.-Schedule the run immediately.-Once the execution is finished, you cannot see the dunning proposal generated under Dunning view.-Cause-There are two reasons:-System checks for Due Item(s) for the customer account. In case there is no due item then system will not generate a Dunning Proposal.-If you have selected the Include Items Not Overdue  checkbox and you expect  the system to generate the Dunning Proposal for the open items with a Net Due Date in the future, then there will be no Dunning Proposal generated either as at least one Overdue item should be available in the customer account to generate a Dunning Proposal / Letter. -Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-If you want to create a Dunning Letter for not due items, you can use the Balance Confirmation functionality. Please check the help center document Create Balance Confirmation Run.-As the Dunning Letter is a legal document, there will be no Dunning Letter generated for open items with a Net Due Date in future. The Balance Confirmation is not a legal document and can therefore be sent to customers with only Open items, also with a Net Due date in future.-The not due items are not available in a Dunning Proposal. They are displayed in the Dunning Letter preview only where due items as well as all open items are listed. -See Also-Help Document: Create Balance Confirmation Run-Keywords-Dunning Letter, Dunning Proposal, Dunning letter not showing customer invoice

Title: Unexpected Tax Amount in Expense Report
Content: Symptom-An extension field in the details of expense item is created to display the tax amount. However, the tax amount is not as expected.-For example, enter an expense amount of 100 USD.-The tax rate is 1%.-The expected tax amount is 1 USD, but it turns out to be 0.99 USD.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter Adatpion Mode.-Go to Travel and Expense work center and Expense Reports view.-Select an expense report and select Edit.-Go to Expenses tab and select one expense item.-Create an extension field.-Set Calculation Rule as 'TaxAmount'.-Save and publish.-Enter an expense amount as 100 USD.-See the tax amount is 0.99 USD.-Cause-The expense amount is the gross amount. The calculation logic is as follows:-100/(1+1%)*1%=0.99 USD-Resolution- This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Expense Report, Tax Amount, Tax Code, Extension Field, Tax Rate, Calculation,

Title: Error During Analytics Upload: Data Type of Data Source Field is Not Available
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-****INTERNAL USE ONLY****-When using Transport Management to transport a report / data source from a source system into a target system you face the error message 'Data Type of Data Source Field ABC (ABC represents the analytical extension of the field) is Not Available'. This error usually indicates that the extension field is not present in the target system (see KBA 2514737), however in this case you have checked and it is already in the system. The error does not seem justified.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the target system.-Go to Administration --> Transport Management.-Search for the affected transport.-Search the logs to see the errors.-You will get the above error message. The analytical extension will either start with /1AN... (for KUT fields) or Y (for PDI fields).-Cause-The extension field is present in the target system, however it is inconsistent. This is why the data type is not available.-Resolution-You will need to repair the affected extension field. To do so, get the permission from the customer and then follow the steps in the KBA 2548941. You should see one or several red extension fields in the transaction ANAST.-Additional Note: In most cases, the customer can repair the extension field from their side too. This is done in the adaptation mode, by editing the field and clicking on Repair. However, there are a few cases where the field is not shown as inconsistent in the frontend, even though it is red in the backend. If in doubt, repair the field in the backend.-See Also-2514737 - Upload of Report Fails: Data Type of Data Source Field Is Not Available-2548941 - How to Check and Repair Inconsistent Extension Fields From Backend-Keywords-extension field, data source, upload, download, report, business analytics, import, export, pdi, transport management, administration

Title: Field at business object, node does not exist
