Content: Symptom-After uploading a custom solution in the Cloud Applications Studio, the activation fails with the below error:-Failed to activate items of type ReferencestoCustomer-SpecificFields-Field MyField1 at business object BO, node NODE does not exist (where MyField1 is a KUT extension field name; BO is the Business Object and NODE is the node name)-Error when processing class /EXT/CL_PDI_REF_LIFE_CYCLE of component BC-DWB-REP-EXT-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio(SDK) of the affected tenant.-Upload the solution .zip file.-Perform solution Activation once the solution upload is successful.-Solution activation fails with below error messages.-Cause-This error message occurs when you have key user extension fields (e.g. MyField1) created via adaptation mode in your source tenant, but not in the target tenant.-And the same extension field (e.g. MyField1) is used in your PDI solution.-Resolution-C4C System :-Create the extension field on the target tenant, the same way it was created in the source tenant.-or,-Move the field from one tenant to the other using the Transport Management functionality.-  ByD System :-Create an Extension Field in the Target as mentioned above as there is no Transport Management option available.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, C4C, BYD, Activation, Failed, Error, when, Specific, Fields, References, Customer-

Title: Common Issues and Troubleshooting with SAP Excel Add-in for Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-Errors or issues while installing SAP Excel Add-in.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-1. What is the error: “problem with this Windows Installer package. A program required for this install to complete could not be run. Contact your support personnel or package vendor” during SAP Excel Add-in installation ?   - -This error is due to a missing file from .NET Framework please try to reinstall .NET Framework (you can download it here)and after it try to install the SAP Excel Add-in.-FOR WINDOWS 10 USERS:-Windows 10 has built-in .NET version 4.6.2 but sometimes some of the necessary files for the add-in to work are not present so you can do the following steps to try to fix this-1) Go to Control Panel in your PC-2) Open Program and Features-3) Open Turn Windows Features on and off-4) Check .NET Framework 3.5 (includes .NET 2.0 and 3.0)-5) Press Ok-6) Windows will download a small .cab application from Windows Update – install it and try again to install the SAP Excel Add-in-  2. After installation I don’t see the SAP Excel Add-in tab within Excel?-Some times Microsoft Office doesn’t enable the new Add-in to be visible. To make the tab visible please follow the steps below:-1) Open Excel-2) Go to File-3) Open Options-4) Go to Add-ins section-5) In Manage section please select COM Add-ins-6) Click Go-7) Check the entry SAP Add-in for Microsoft Excel-8) Press Ok-But there might be the possibility that you still cannot get the excel Add-in tab visible, especially when you install the Add-in after you upgrade your operation system or you get a new laptop and install the Add-in.-In such a case, try the following steps:-1) Open Excel-2) Go to File-3) Open Options-4) Go to Add-ins section-5) In Manage section please select Disabled Add-ins-6) Click Go-7) Check the entry SAP Add-in for Microsoft Excel--8) Press Enable and then OK., then you can follow the steps mentioned above.-3. What is the error: “Unable to cast COM object of type ‘Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook.ApplicationClass’ to interface type ‘Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook._Application’. This operation failed because the QueryInterface call on the COM component for the interface with IID ‘{00063001-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}’ failed due to the following error: Library not registered.” ?-The error is caused by a wrong registry file, this happens when you downgrade the version of Microsoft Office. e.g. 2010 to 2007.-Registry Key: HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\TypeLib{00062FFF-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}-Here you will see that you have for example folders with numbers: 9.3, 9.4 or 9.5 – it depends of the versions of the Microsoft Package.-Outlook 2007      9.3-Outlook 2010      9.4-Outlook 2013      9.5-So when you downgrade, these folders are not deleted, if you went from Office 2010 the 9.4 will be present together with 9.3 from Office 2007.-You can delete the folder related to the Microsoft Office which IS NOT installed in the computer.-Example:-If you have the 9.4 folder (from Office 2010) and you are using Office 2007 (folder 9.3). You should delete the folder 9.4, related to the Office 2010 that you do not have installed in your computer, inside the registry key.-4. What is the error: “Invalid credentials; check your user and password” during SAP Excel Add-in Logon?- Please perform the following checks:-  1) Check if system URL is correct under SAP System URL. some users by mistake type the URL and it has a blank space in the end.-  2) Check if your username and password are correct.-  3) Check with your administrator (also known as Key User) if your password is not blocked.-     (After the 3rd attempt or based in your company settings – the password will be locked in the system so the administrator will need to unlock it for you).-  4) Check if your Proxy Settings are correct.-  5) If do you use the Single Sign On feature check if the Certificate selected under Select Certificate is correct.-5. You have the following error when the report opens “Starting SAP Report……..”:-1)Open Excel-2)Go to File-3)Open Options-4)Go to Trust Center-5)Open Trust Center Settings-6)Go to Protected View-7)Uncheck Enable Protected View for files originating from the Internet and Enable Protected View for files located in potentially unsafe locations.-8)Press OK-9) Try to open again the report from the system-6. You trying to log via SSO in Excel Add-in and have the follow error:-Note: The SSO needs to be configured in the system itself (via the activities in the Application and User Management Workcenter in SAP Business ByDesign or in Administration Workcenter for SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer) if not properly setup the SSO environment this behavior will be shown in Excel Add-in during the Log On.-7. You are working with a template and you dont see the option “Save data to”:-This behavior can have multiple causes the most common are:-1)You are using a old template (from a past system release and not the current):-Please download the latest template from system.-2)You are not using the latest Excel Add-in plugin:-Please update the SAP Excel Add-in plugin to latest version-Keywords-excel, excel add-in, add-in, addin, addon, add-on , sap excel add-in, trouble shooting, common issues on SAP excel add-in

Title: Error Message: 'Cannot post this document as Tax amount in transaction currency US Dollar 0'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to manually clear an invoice against an e.g. down payment, however an error is raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the related customer account monitor.-Highlight the invoice and the down payment.-Click Clear Manually.-Fill in the required missing data in the clearing.-The system raised the following error: 'Cannot post this document as Tax amount in transaction currency US Dollar 0'-Cause-There is a tax difference since the invoice and down payment are in a foreign currency.-Example:-Company Currency: MXN.-Transaction Currency: USD.-The invoice amount is 533.60 USD and the down payment amount is 533.59 USD. Hence, this is a partial clearing of the invoice.-The system checks the left over amount that is 0.01 USD for which the taxes will be zero USD. Nevertheless, due to significant exchange rate between USD and MXN, the same tax amount which is zero in USD becomes non-zero in MXN, causing an inconsistency in the tax amounts in both currencies.-Resolution-Ideally, you need to clear the tax amount fully. The small amounts for the tax become zero in one currency and non zero in other currency cannot be left uncleared.-You may also Apply Discount on the invoice for 0.01 USD and put the Payment Difference Reason as "97 - Currency exchange differences" and then clear the documents.-See Also-KBA 3283170 - Error: 'Cannot post this document as tax amount in transaction currency ABC is 0'-Keywords-Accounts Receivable, Partial Clearing, Tax Amount, Exchange Rate, Down Payment, 0.01, Clear Manually, T100 Error ID - FOP_TAXRPREG015, T100 Error ID -FOP_TAXRPREG071

Title: Error on Creating Data Source - Join Pair is Not Used
Content: Symptom-You have created a joined data source consisting of 3 or more data sources. You are sure that the join conditions are correct, however the Check of the data source returns the following error messages:-Join member pair on right side not supported-Join Pair JOIN_PAIR_01 is not used-Join Pair JOIN_PAIR_02 is not used-Operands of join condition JOIN_CONDITION_01 need to be part of join pair JOIN_PAIR_01-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Data Sources.-Click on New > Joined Data Source.-Add some data sources. For this example, let us assume you want to join Account Master Data, Territory Team, Account Contact Data and Territory Account Mapping. Add these data sources in this order.-Set the join conditions on the account and territory fields.-Click on Check.-You will get the errors mentioned above.-Cause-The first 2 data sources you added were Account Master Data and Territory Team. They have no join conditions between them, i.e. Territory Team is only linked to Territory Account Mapping. It is important to add the data sources in the sequence in which there is some join to the previously added data source. Otherwise, while building the join conditions in the backend, some join pairs may go wrong and the error message will be raised.-Resolution-You can use the same data sources and join conditions for your data source, however please add the data source in a different order: Choose a sequence in which there is some join to the previously added data source. In case of an inner join this will not make a difference to the displayed content, but it will make sure all joins can be built correctly. In case of a left outer join, you can leave the anchor data source as it is, and arrange the sequence accordingly. For screenshots to illustrate this, please check the attachment of this document.-See Also-A different scenario would be that you receive the error messages 'Invalid source of field' and 'Save failed' when creating new joined data sources with more than two data sources. In this case please add the first two data sources, set up the join condition and save. Afterwards please add the third data source and maintain the other joined conditions. Then save the data source again.-Keywords-Operands of join condition JOIN_CONDITION need to be part of join pair JOIN_PAIR, Join member pair on right side not supported, left outer join, inner join, data source, analytics, reporting, error message, save failed, invalid source of field

Title: Error Message : Serial Number Recording not Possible/Permitted
Content: Symptom-Changing the Serial Number Profile from No Serial Number Assignment to Optional Serial Number Assignment, the error appears :-Serial number recording not possible/permitted. To enable serial number recording the Base UoM must be equal to or convertible to eaches.-Serial number recording not possible/permitted. To enable serial number recording the Inventory Valuation UoM must be eaches.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Product Data Work Center.-Go to Materials View.-Select All Materials from the Show drop down and find one material.-Choose Edit button and select View All.-In General tab change Serial Number Profile to Optional Serial Number Assignment.-Press enter, you will get the above errors.-Cause-The cause for the errors are:-1)  The Base UoM is neither maintained as each (Ea) nor converted to each.-2) Inventory valuation UoM is not maintained as each.- Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-1. While creating a new material you should either maintain the base UoM as Each or maintain the Quantity Conversions for converting to Ea, if you wish to have Optional serial Number Assignment before activating the Valuation.-2. Once the valuation is activated it is not possible to change the Inventory Valuation UoM, so you have to create a new material in case if you like to use the serial number option. If the valuation is in preparation stage, you change the base UoM system will automatically changes the Inventory Valuation UoM.-Keywords-Serial Number Profile, No Serial Number Assignment, Optional Serial Number Assignment, Valuation, Material Master Data.

Title: Find the Cause for 500 Error during Supplier Invoice or purchase order Excel upload
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL ONLY *** -Customer is getting a 500 Internal Server Error when uploading Supplier Invoices via Excel.-These instructions are aimed at Expert Support Logistics to help them find out what caused this generic error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The customer successfully downloaded the Excel template from Supplier Invoicing > Invoice Entry > New > Import from Microsoft Excel®. They populated the data in the template and connected to their system via the add-in. Then, they selected "Save Data to" to send the data over and create the invoices. However, the import process starts but unfortunately encounters a 500 internal Error. (see print screen 1) The error message does not provide specific details about the issue.-Cause-Some of the data sent across to the system is either missing or not formatted correctly. Unfortunately, technically, not all issues can be fed back to the UI to let the user know what needs to be corrected. In this case, support has to connect to the backend to see what the issue was and inform the customer of what he needs to do for the upload to be successful.-Resolution-Connect to the customer system backend.-In transaction SRT_UTIL you can check for raised error messages during the excel upload.-By default, we see only the errors from today.-Click re-select and set the correct date and remove the user and execute.-Scroll to the right to see the interface name and sort by interface name.-The interface we are looking for is II_SRM_SI_SI_MBO(supplier invoice) or II_SRM_PO_MBO(purchase order)-If there was an error during the upload you should see a message mentioning the field in question and the reason for the fail. (see print screen 2)- or-If you cannot directly find the field in the upload file to advise the customer, open the Standard Excel template and select the Developer tab (see print screen 3)-Under this tab, go to Source. A panel called XML SOURCE will open on the right-hand side.-You will have to manually search for the field mentioned in the error you found in SRT_UTIL (no automatic search feature)-Once you find it, clicking on it will highlight the corresponding field in the template.-Compare with the customer file. (make sure you have the original full file uploaded by the customer to compare)-This field might have been left empty or might have been populated incorrectly (again, the error in SRT_UTIL should tell you this)-Inform the customer accordingly.-See Also-3018592 - Dump Message When Uploading Supplier Invoices Using Excel Upload-Keywords-error, 500, excel, upload, save data to, supplier, invoices,Error Appears While Uploading Supplier Invoices,  Supplier invoice Excel template,  Supplier invoice excel upload

Title: Preview Button is not Working in HTML5 of a Custom Screen
Content: Symptom-You are trying to click on Preview button which you have configured for a custom form in a custom screen created via SDK.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the custom work center created.-Open a record.-Click on the Preview button in the Thing Inspector screen.-Form is not appeared.-Cause-This issues occurs in HTML5 and RUI, if you check in Silverlight the preview will be working.-This case occurs if the Lazy Load property is set as true in the TI screen.-Resolution-You need to set the Lazy Load property to false to get the Preview button work. You can follow the below mentioned steps:-Login to SDK and open the respective solution.-Navigate and open the TI.uicomponent where you have configured the Preview button.-Go to Controller tab.-Expand Model Dialogs and double click on the Preview button you have configured for the Preview.-Go to Properties tab.-Under Behavior section you can see the property Lazy Load which is set as true.-Change it to False.-Save and Activate.-If this does not work in first attempt. Please try to activate  metadata from UI designer then activate and Deploy Business Configuration of BAC.-Keywords-Preview not Working-Preview button in HTML5-Preview in Custom Screen-SDK, PDI, UI Designer

Title: How to change the Cost Center Assignment of a Fixed Asset/ Right of Use Asset from the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Lease Posting Run or the Depreciation run reports an error in regards to missing org assignment for a right of use asset -Or it is not possible to modify the validity of an organizational unit due to unlimited fixed asset assignments to the org unit (Error, for example: "Cannot change Cost Center XYZ (Cost Center Name); It Is Assigned to Fixed Asset". However, when trying to retire the associated individual material the error message "Retirement not possible. Individual Material XYZ obsolete" appears (XYZ represents an individual material ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For example, a new lease contract version is created, extending an right of use asset's lifetime. But, due to an inconsistency the asset's cost center assignment did not get extended: -In the Fixed Assets work center go to the Fixed Assets view and find right of use (ROU) asset ABC (ABC represents the ROU's ID). -Press Edit and choose Master Data. -In the Basic Data tab you notice, the cost center assignment's Valid To date is not extended according to the extended lease contract. Therefore, the Depreciation run finishes with errors regarding the missing org assignment.-Resolution-Verify thoroughly that the cost center assignment of a ROU or fixed asset cannot be modified in the user interface (through a retirement posting, reverting of org unit changes etc.). Consult a senior support engineer if you are unsure if backend modification really is the only option to solve the issue.-For Lease contracts, verify that the ROU cost center center is the same as the cost center assigned to the new extended lease contract version.-Ask the customer for permission to reduce (usually, in case of org unit changes) or extend (in case of missing ROU cost center assignment update) the fixed/right of use assets cost center assignment. -Request a L6 support user with permission to change customer data. -Perform the following steps: -In stfk-go to sesfts:-Enter BO: FIA_FIXED_ASSET-Load query, ROOT-BY_MASTER_DATA,-enter FA ID into key/master/fixedassetIID/contend field,-enter company ID into CompanyID field.-Press OK.-Navigate to ORG_ASSIGNMENT.-Note down the NODE_ID.-Also note down the current valid to date, just to record what is to be changed.-  Enter Org Assignment table for FA:-Choose transaction /nSE16.-table: FIAD_ORG_ASSIGN-Press Enter.-In the DB_KEY field press the value help and enter the NODE_ID you noted down.-Press Execute.-Press Execute again.-Click on the glasses sign.-In the transaction field on top enter /H and press Enter.-Press Enter again to enter Debugger.-In the Debugger- use Desktop 3:-Double- click on c_code so it appears on the right side.-Press on the Edit symbol (pencil) and change from SHOW to EDIT.-Press F8 or Debugger Continue.-Change End date to 31.12.9999 (to extend) or change the date to an earlier date in case of org unit assignment issues). -Press Save.-  Reload FSI:-/nGFSSTM:-select BO and enter FIA_FIXED_ASSET.-Node: ROOT.-In the Query Service field click on the little distribution symbol.-select BY_MASTER_DATA and then OK.-Press Execute.-extend the FSI view node.-select ORG_ASSIGNMENT.-press Persistence.-  5. check the ROU/ fixed asset in the UI:-open the ROU/ fixed asset and check the cost center assignment in the Master Data - Basic Data tab.  The Valid To date should be changed according to your changes. -Press Save, just to ensure the ROU/fixed asset is consistent.-If no error appears, you can inform the customer. -See Also-1657418 - Error Message: Cannot Change Cost Center XYZ (Cost Center Name); It Is Assigned to Fixed Asset-Keywords-cost center assigment ROU, right of use asset, fixed asset validity

Title: How to Take Trace in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK)
Content: Symptom-If you are unsure if there is PDI code involved in an issue/dump that you are receiving on the UI, you can use the tracing tool in the SDK to find out.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-Please note, to use the tracing tool in the SDK, you do not need to know the custom solution name/ID, and you do not need to open any custom solution before you start tracing.-Log in to the front end system first (i.e C4C or ByD).-Make sure you have SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK) installed. If you do not, please refer to this KBA: 1937930 - How to download the SAP Cloud Applications Studio from the SAP Downloads Center -Open the Cloud Applications Studio.-Once it has loaded, select the Start Tracing icon.-If you cannot see this icon, you can also find it here:-Go to the frontend, and reproduce the issue.-When you are finished reproducing the issue, select the Stop Tracing icon.-If you cannot see this icon, you can also find it here:-Now select the Trace Explorer icon.-If you cannot see this icon, you can also find it here:-The Trace Explorer window will appear, and you can highlight the trace you took, and select Get Trace Details. (If you cannot see the trace you have taken, select the refresh icon).-If there is PDI involvement, you can see PDI solution name along with the path from SDK.-If there is no PDI involvement, nothing will appear in the trace details.-Once you get PDI solution name and path, you can put the breakpoints and debug further your code to understand the exact cause for the error/dump.-For more details about debugging and tracing please refer to SAP Help portal links:-Run a Trace for a Business User-Debugging a Solution-See Also-You can also check the blog  Performance ABSL Trace – New functionality in 2005 Release which will help you to identify the exact time take to execute your custom script.-Keywords-SDK trace, Dump error, Frontend error, Debugging

Title: Assigned Project Expenses not realized by Revenue Recognition Run
Content: Symptom-You notice that certain expenses on Customer Sales Project XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID) are not realized on the respective Expense account. They are still deferred.-You check the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses screen in Project Management and confirm that these expenses are all correctly assigned to Sales Order items.-You check the Sales Accruals report again and verify that these expenses correctly appear as assigned to Sales Order items. However, they appear as Deferred Costs of Goods sold.-As the expenses, such as supplier invoice items, internal or external time recordings or expense reports, are assigned to Sales Order items they should have been recognized and realized; either immediately- if no accrual method is assigned to the Sales Order item - or by the Revenue Recognition run - in case an accrual method is assigned to the Sales Order item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the Sales Accruals Report after the Revenue Recognition run:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Reports: List view.-Find and open the Sales Accruals report.-Filter for Project XYZ and press Go.-In the Deferrals (Cost) Amount column you notice an amount.-Add further characteristics to the report, such as G/L Account and G/L Account (Origin) as well as Associated Source Document Type and Associated Source Document ID.-Expenses which should have been cleared and realized still appear as Deferred Costs.-Keep the report open-To verify the Expense Assignment in Project Management:-In the Project Management work center go to the Invoice Preparation: Not invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Find Project XYZ and press Go.-In the OWL you see that there is nothing displayed in the Time and Expenses Not Assigned column.-Just to be safe, click Edit Time and Expenses.-All expenses appear here and are assigned to Sales Order items.-To verify the Expense Assignment in the Sales Accruals report:-Add the Associated Sales Order and Item as well as Business Transaction Type to the report.-Pull the Associated Source Document ID characteristic in front of the Business Transaction Type to see which transactions are displayed for which expense.-You verify that for each expense in question an Expense Assignment to Sales Documents transaction exists. This means all expenses are correctly assigned to a Sales Order item.-Even after the Revenue Recognition run these expenses stay deferred.-Cause-The expenses of the invoices were not picked up by the Revenue Recognition Run because they are marked as Deferred. This can be verified in Project Management:-In the Project Management work center go to the Invoice Preparation: Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Find and select Project XYZ.-Click Edit Time and Expenses Screen.-In the Time and Expense Items table select one of the items.-Then navigate to the Quantity and Expense Details sub-tab: Here you can see that the total quantity of this item appears as Quantity to be deferred.-Resolution-If you need to recognize some or the whole quantity of the selected expense the respective quantity needs to be made available for Invoicing:-Remain in the Quantity and Expense Details sub-tab.-Then enter the quantity which you want to realize in the Quantity to be Invoiced field.-Press Save and Close.-If an accrual method is assigned to the Sales Order item execute the Revenue Recognition run again. This time the expense associated with the sales order item will be recognized and realized (depending on the Accrual method logic).-Keywords-Project expense not realized, assigned expense deferred cost of goods sold

Title: Unassigned Values (#) Not Shown In Report Filter
Content: Symptom-You are using the report filter to try and select only the Unassigned values (#) for a particular field. However when you open the value help of the filter, the # values are not listed.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For this example, let us assume that you are using the report Lean Tickets, and the field Service Category ID.-Open and start the report-Go to Edit Filter-Open the value help for Service Category ID-# is not listed.-Cause-The Service Category ID is a field of type ID. For these fields, unfortunately the filter cannot currently show # values.-Resolution-We are checking if this can be enabled in a future release of the product. In the meantime, you can use filter fields that contain the same information but have a different type, e.g. Service Category instead of Service Category ID. Please note however, that we would recommend to use these fields for the report view (and filter) only - for the report selection, ID fields should be used.-Keywords-Report, Filter, Selection, Unassigned, #

Title: How to Show Cancelled Invoice ID in the Invoice Volume Report
Content: Symptom-In the invoice documents view, there is a field called 'Cancelled/Corrected Invoice ID' showing the related cancellation / correction invoice information. You want to know how to show it in the report: Invoice Volume.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-It shows the field 'Cancelled/Corrected Invoice ID' in the OWL. for example, invoice ABC row contains Cancelled/Corrected Invoice ID DEF. (ABC and DEF represent the invoice ID)-Go to the Reports Lists view.-Open the report Invoice Volume and try to find the invoice ABC, you are not able to see Cancelled/Corrected Invoice ID field.-Cause-Cancelled/Corrected Invoice ID field is not available in the report and data source.-Resolution-You can enable the following fields in the report to show the expected information.-Cancellation Invoice Indicator-Reference Invoice Type-Reference Invoice-See Also-KBA 3290272 - The value of Price Component for Cancelled Invoice is Incorrect in Customer Invoice Volume with Price Component Report-Keywords-Invoice Volume; Cancelled/Corrected Invoice ID; Customer Invoice; Reference Invoice Type

Title: Unable to Maintain Exchange Rate in Valid From Field
Content: Symptom-When maintaining Exchange Rates, date and time in the Valid From field cannot be updated. Error message: "A data set XYZ, rate type Default Exchange Rate Type already exists - Adjust quotation date DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM UTC+n" is displayed on the screen.-(XYZ stands for the Data Set ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Edit Exchange Rates View.-Select Source and Target Currency.-Change the Bid Rate.-Click on Valid From field and Select the date and time.-The system displays the error message: 'A data set XYZ, rate type Default Exchange Rate Type already exists - Adjust quotation date DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM UTC+n'-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. It is not possible to change the date of a row to a previous period.-Resolution-If an Exchange Rate for a specific date is required, the Add Row button may be used instead for updating the same row.-Keywords-exchange rate, data set, default exchange rate type

Title: Customer will get error "Logoff only performed locally and not at the identity provider" while performing SSO Logout
Content: Symptom-While Logging out of the system, using SSO ( Single Sign-On ),system throws an error "Logoff only performed locally and not at the identity provider" ( see Below ) instead of normal system logout screen.-      Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Using SSO, just Logout of the system.-Cause-If you are using ADFS, it could be a setting problem in ADFS configuration.-ADFS: Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) is a software component developed by Microsoft that can be installed on Windows Server operating systems to provide users with single sign-on access to systems and applications located across organizational boundaries. It uses a claims-based access control authorization model to maintain application security.-Resolution-The response URL needs to be updated to a landing URL appropriate for you. This is done in ADFS configuration:-Example URL that should be there in the Response URL section: HTTPS://myXXXX-sso.crm.ondemand.com/sap/public/byd/runtime?logoff=2 You may change the system details according to the system that is affected-Here is an example screen in ADFS:-  Keywords-SSO, LOGOFF

Title: Error Message RBAM: No authorization for 'Action <default> Select' on Instance XYZ
Content: Symptom-When the User XYZ try to Edit the Org Structure, system throws below error message:-RBAM: No authorization for 'Action <default> Select' on Instance 'xyz'-RBAM: Skip Operation 'Action <default> Select' on 'BoNode xyz'-You are not authorized to change the data-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Cause-The cause for the error message, when the user XYZ try to change the Org Structure is that for this user there is no access to change/edit the Org Structure.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you should provide the unrestricted access to write as stated below,-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Users view.-Select the user XYZ and select Edit and choose Access Rights option.-Go to Access Restrictions tab.-Under Assigned Work Center Views section, highlight the row MOM_ORGSTRUCTURES for Work Center View ID.-Here you can change the No Access to Unrestricted for Write Access column.-This KBA is specific to SAP Business byDesign and scenario explained above is an example. Ideally, this error message indicates that the user is missing in write authorization to access/edit the document/screen. Check the respective authorization and fix it accordingly-Keywords-write, rbam, action, authorization, skip

Title: Selection for Unassigned Does Not Work in Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to filter (#) unassigned values out of a report, so unassigned items do not appear. But the filtering does not work as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work centre.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the Report XYZ (XYZ represents the report name).-Enter Selection !(#) (This values represents do not show all values that hold the value #).-Select Go to run the report with your filter selection.-Unassigned values # still appear on the report.-Cause-There is an inconsistency in the data source.-Resolution-You need to clear the cache in the backend transaction MDRS.-Log into the backend of the related system.-Open the report in MDRS.-Load the required report.-Goto Utilities -> Invalidate Runtime Object-Done-This will clear the cache and once you run the report again with the !(#) filter added, the # values will not appear.-Keywords-Selection, unassigned, filter

Title: Creating Joined Data Source With Join Condition on Key Figure Results Not Possible
Content: Symptom-You want to create a Join Data Source (Inner Join or Left Outer Join) with a Join Condition on a Key Figure, however the system throws an exception.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Click on New -> Joined Data Sources button.-On the new screen, use your desired Data Sources and create a Join Condition by mapping Key Figures on both Data Sources.-Click on Check.-You will face an exception.-Cause-The system prevents you from creating an inconsistent data source. The reason behind this is due to the fact you cannot create a join condition (dependency) on a calculated element (Key Figure) because it is not a constant and it can change depending on other key figures/characteristics values.-Therefore, join conditions cannot be created on ﻿key figures.-Resolution-This is the correct behaviour. You can create a join condition on characteristics that are common for all involved data sources and that present the same granularity (not m * n, for example).-Keywords-data source, error message, join condition, key figures, not possible, dump, crash

Title: DATEV Export Run Error - ORIGINAL_ENTRY_DOCUMENT_DATE Missing
Content: Symptom-The DATEV Export run finishes with errors. In the application log you notice the error ORIGINAL_ENTRY_DOCUMENT_DATE missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and here to the DATEV Export subview.-Enter a run description and fill all the mandatory fields.-Press Set to Active.-Then press Schedule, then Start Immediately.-Press Save and Close.-Back in the DATEV Export  view you notice that the run finished with errors.-Press Display Log to view the application log of the run.-In the Results tab you notice the error ORIGINAL_ENTRY_DOCUMENT_DATE missing.-Cause-The DATEV runs has identified a journal entry voucher for which no source document, i.e. document date has been maintained. For journal entry vouchers it is not mandatory to define the document date. You can identify the respective posting(s) in the Journal report.-Resolution-To identify the respective journal entry voucher-Navigate to the General Ledger workcenter and here to the Reports- List view.-Open the Journal report.-Remove the default value in the Closing Step field.-In the Posting Date field, select the same time period as defined in the DATEV export run.-Press Go.-Now add the Source Doc. Date characteristic from the Not Currently Shown list to the Rows.-In the Edit Filter tab navigate to the Source Doc. Date field and enter #.-Press Go.-This way all journal entries, i.e. Journal Entry Vouchers for which the Source Document Date is missing are displayed.-After you have identified the postings open the respective posting periods in the General Ledger:-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Master Data - Set of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Press Open and Close Periods and open the respective periods for the involved set of books.*-*Please note: the period closing steps need to be maintained according to the closing steps of the journal entry vouchers.-Now reverse the respective journal entry vouchers and create them again:- In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Journal Entries - Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Find the respective journal entry voucher (s) and highlight it (them).-Press Edit.-Press Reverse.-In the Pop-up window, enter the Reversal Posting date.-Press OK.-Back in the Journal Entry Vouchers view make sure that the now canceled journal entry voucher is still highlighted.-Press New - Journal Entry Voucher with Reference.-This way the data of the journal entry voucher is copied into the new journal entry voucher.-The Document Date is automatically maintained.-Press Post.-Execute the DATEV Export run again.-The error message will still appear, this time also for the journal entry voucher cancellation. However, the new journal entry voucher is now included in the extraction list. The data is now complete and can be downloaded.-See Also-3456542 Error Message: "Journal entry ABC: Original Entry Document Date missing"-Keywords-Original Entry Document Date Missing, DATEV Export Run, Journal Entry Voucher.

Title: Liquidity Forecast does not allocate invoices to particular bank accounts.
Content: Symptom-In your customer and supplier master data you have defined payment methods. In the Business Configuration / Global Settings for Payments / Prioritize bank accounts and payment methods you associated payment methods with bank account. Consequently your expectation is that in the Liquidity Forecast customer and supplier invoices are shown for a particular bank account. However, you notice that those documents are not allocated under Receivables/Payables for a particular bank account but under the category Not assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Liquidity Forecasts view-Select a suitable Liquidity Forecast ID and View Details.-Choose an appropriate date range.-You notice the customer and/or supplier invoices are shown under Not Assigned -Cause-This is a system definition. The connection between payment method and bank account is not taken into consideration when allocating invoices to a particular bank account as this connection is not considered as sufficiently clear. Only actual payments are assigned to the corresponding bank account in the Liquidity Forecast. The settings made under Business Configuration / Global Settings for Payments / Prioritize bank accounts and payment methods also relate to payments and their allocation to a bank account.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-Liquidity forecast, my bank, not assigned

Title: Manual Payment Clearing - Posting Date Not Permitted - Posting Date Can't be Edited
Content: Symptom-After uploading bank statement X (X is the bank statement ID) a payment is allocated to supplier account XYZ (XYZ is the supplier account ID) containing the bank statement posting date DDMMYYYY. When trying to clear the payment against an invoice with a posting date DDMMYYYY-1, you receive the error: Posting date DDMMYYYY not permitted. The item to be cleared already has postings assigned to it with posting date DDMMYYYY +1. Enter a posting date equal to or after DDMMYYYY +1.-When trying to adjust the posting date of the manual clearing you notice that the field Posting Date is not editable.-For example:-An uploaded bank statement has the posting date 13.02.2013. Both payment allocation and payment clearing in status In preparation have the posting date 13.02.0213. In the manual payment clearing an invoice with the posting date 01.02.2013 shall be cleared. You receive the error: Posting date 13.02.2013 not permitted. The item to be cleared already has postings assigned to it with posting date 25.02.2013. Enter a posting date equal to or after 25.02.2013.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can enter the manual payment clearing directly by entering the Payables work center and navigating to the-Payment Clearing View.-You can also access the payment clearing via the uploaded bank statement.-1. Go to Liquidity Management work center and navigate to Bank Statements view.-2. Select the bank statement X. Since the payment is not cleared yet the value in field Postprocessing will be Required.-3. When following the link you can access the relevant transactions and the relevant clearing respectively.-Usually a corresponding task of type Review and Clear Bank Statement X/A (A is the Item ID of the bank statement) in the Closing Relevant Tasks view in the General Ledger work center will be generated from which the manual payment allocation is also accessible.-Cause-At least one of the to-be-cleared transaction has associated transactions with a posting date DDMMYYYY +1 (i.e. 25.02.2013).-Also refer to KBA: 1806279 - Error Message: 'Posting date must be after or the same as dd.mm.yyyy' in a payment allocation.-Since in this case the posting date of the payment clearing is already determined by the bank statement posting date, it is not possible to adjust the posting date in the manual payment clearing.-Resolution-In case the posting date of the clearing cannot be modified you can create a payment on account and then clear the invoice in the Supplier Account Monitor.-In the clearing grid of the manual payment clearing deselect the assigned invoice.-Create an account payment by pressing the button Assign On Account Payment.-In Payables work center navigate to the supplier account monitor and the Trade Payables tab.-Highlight the candidate transactions and press Clear Manually.-In the New Manual Clearing document, you can adjust the posting date to DDMMYYYY +1 (i.e. 25.02.2013) and successfully clear the involved transactions.-     Keywords-payment allocation. Zahlungszuordnung; "Buchungsdatum nicht zulässig. Dem auszugleichenden Posten sind bereits Buchungen mit dem Buchungsdatum und Belegnr. (Ausgleich) zugeordnet. Geben Sie ein Buchungsdatum ein, das am oder danach liegt."; Manual Payment Clearing; Posting Date Not Permitted; Posting Date Can't be Edited;

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Tab Missing
Content: Symptom-After GoLive you notice that the Migration tab of Fixed Assets can't be accessed anymore in your productive system.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Fixed Assets work center, navigate to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for all Fixed Assets for which a Yes is marked in the Migrated Asset column.-Select one of them and press Edit.-You can only see the options General, Master Data and Values.-Also, when opening the Fixed Asset, the Migration tab is missing.-Cause-In general, the Migration tab is not visible after the system is Live.-If this tab was still enabled, you could edit the previously migrated data: you could reverse migration transactions via the Reverse Migration button, for instance. It is not advised to make any migration related changes after GoLive as this could cause data inconsistencies.-Resolution-Should you still need to access the Migration tab in fixed assets you can create a change project in your live system:-Create a New Change Project in the Business Configuration work center and open its Activity List.-In the new change project navigate to the Integrate and Extend phase activity called Migration of Accounting Transaction Data and select Add To Project.-Close this activity.-Merge the change project.-Now, this activity's status is Open. Therefore, the Migration tab will be available in the Fixed Assets.-Keywords-fixed asset, migration tab, missing

Title: When Adding a New Price Agreement in Contract Item, You Get Error:List Price with key 101 already exists.
Content: Symptom-You are going to add a new price agreement into the contract, but system reports an error message:List Price with key 101 already exists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open one certain contract and go to the Items tab.-Select one item, in the Price Agreements sub tab, click Add Row button.-System shows the error message:List Price with key 101 already exists.-Cause-When you add a new row the default dates is from today to unlimited, however, in the existing price agreement, the Valid To date is Unliminted already. So there is an overlap between these 2 price agreements and hence the error reports.-Resolution-In order to remove the error, you will need to adjust the Valid To date in the existing row. For example, change the Unliminted to 08.08.2016. Then in the newly added row, make the Valid From date as 09.08.2016.-  Keywords-Contract; Error; Agreement; List Price; key; already exists.

Title: Company Does Not Appear For Selection In Set Of Books Activity
Content: Symptom-You have created a new company in the Org structure in the Organizational Management work center. You would like to assign a set of books to this company. However this company does not appear in the value help in the Set of books activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Select Implementation Projects View.-Select the project and click on Open Activity List.-Go to Integrate and Extend tab.-Find the activity Set of Books and open the activity.-Select the set of books and click on Edit.-Navigate to Company Settings tab.-Click on Value help for the field Company.-Here you will notice that the company which you have created in the Organizational Management work center is not appearing for selection.-Cause-The company which you have created in the system has the Activation date or Effective from date set in future. Since the company / Org Structure is not active, you are not able to find the company in the value help for the company field.-Resolution-Activation date of the org. structure is set in Future. Hence the company/ Org structure does not appear in the Value help. However, you could still manually enter the Company ID in the Company field.-To view the company in the value help, you need to change the activation date of the respective Org Structure. Follow these steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Edit Org Structures view.-Maintain a current date and click ok.-Click Find and search for the affected Org Unit ID.-Click Activate > Activate Selected Structure or Activate Selected and Dependent Org Units.-See Also-Create and Edit the Org Structure | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Set Of Books Activity, Company Settings, Org Structures, Organizational Management, Company ID, does not appear, not present.

Title: Business users cannot be seen in Application and User Management work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer reports the issue that, although they can still log in the system, one or more business users have vanished.-Business users cannot be seen in Application and User Management work center, view: Business Users.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work Center Application and User Management.-Go to View: Business Users.-Input the user ID or employee name on the Find field and press Enter.-There will be no results returned. Message displayed: No results found.-Even though this user can log on into the system, some functionalities don't work, e.g.: can't create incidents. In addition the user is not visible at the Business Users view.-Cause-The cause is most likely an FSI inconsistency. You can check the cause by following the below steps:-Go to the system backend.-Open transaction SE38-Type FIA_CHECK_BO_PERSISTENCIES-On the Business Object Proxy Name field, input: IDENTITY-Check the box Check immediately and Execute(Press F8)-The results will show clear error counts if there are inconsistencies. If any, the recommended course of action is to perform an FSI reload of the BO.-Note:-For BOs with a high number of records, it may take more time than usual.-If 'Check immediate' option is not selected, the results shown will be from last run of FIA_CHECK_BO_PERSISTENCIES report for this BO and not the current status.-If you attempt to cancel the report mid-runtime it may show inconsistent results.-Resolution-Please forward the incident to Expert Support - Technology and Architecture with your findings for further analysis.-

Title: Accrual Method Recognize At Completed Contract (Revenues Only) - Posting Logic
Content: Symptom-You have posted a customer invoice for the project-based sales order items with the accrual method Recognize At Completed Contract (Revenues Only) but you observe that the revenues are not deferred any more but immediately realized to the respective Revenue account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center and choose the Journal Entries view.-Open the Advanced filter and search for Journal Entry 00025 - Customer Invoice to find the respecitve journal entry for your customer project invoice XXX.-You notice that the Revenue has not been deferred but realized directly to the revenue account.-Cause-The status of the project task or milestone has been set to complete manually before the creation of the customer invoice.-Resolution-If this accrual method is assigned to the sales order item, the revenues for each project task/ milestone will be deferred until the task/milestone is finished (completed-contract method). Costs will no longer be deferred either.-When the status of the task/milestone is set to Completed, Closed, or Stopped, no further deferrals of revenues or costs take place.-Keywords-Revenue not deferred, Project-based sales order item, Recognize At Completed Contract, Accrual method, Realized, Revenue account

Title: The Service Order Remains in "In Process" Status Though the Line Item in the Related Service Confirmation are Already Canceled
Content: Symptom-The Service Order remains in In Process status though the line item in the related Service Confirmation are already Canceled.-You expect the status of the Service Order to be Completed.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Search and opem the service order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Select the Edit button.-Select the View All button.-Go to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Line item XX has the following status (XX indicates the sequence number of the line item):-Status: In Process-Service Status: Released-Delivery Status: Finished-Invoice Status: Not Started-Cancellation Status: Not Cancelled-Line item YY has the following status (YY indicates the sequence number of the line item):-Status: Completed-Service Status: Not Relevant-Delivery Status: In Process-Invoice Status: Not Relevant-Cancellation Status: Cancelled-Go to the Document Flow.-Open the service confirmation ABC (ABC indicates the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the View All button.-Go to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-For Line XX and YY you see the following status:-Status: Finished-Invoicing Status: Not Relevant-Cancellation Status: Cancelled-For Line XX there is an Actual Duration maintained-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the invoice requests created for the service order XYZ.-You can find the Invoice Request DEF in the To be Invoiced status whichh has the line item XX of the service order.-Yout expect the Service Order status to be Completed.-Cause-Regarding the invoice request, one of the line items is currently in "To be Invoiced" status. As a result, the service order's status remains as "In Process."-Resolution-Create a invoice for invoice request DEF and then cancel the new invoice, this will update the invoicing status in service order for line item XX and you will be able to set Reason for Rejection for the same item in the service order.-After setting Reason for Rejection for line item XX & saving the service order, it will get completed.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search and select the invoice request DEF (DEF represents the ID of the invoice request).-The status of the invoice request is To be Invoiced.-Select the Invoice Request and choose Invoice button.-Release the Customer Invoice.-Cancel the Customer Invoice created.-This will update the status of the invoicing in the service order, and you can set the Reason for Rejection for the line item XX.-Save the service order after setting the Reason for Rejection.-The status of the service order will now be Completed.-Keywords-Service order; In Process; Service Confirmation; Canceled; Line Item; Invoice Request; Reason for Rejection; Completed

Title: Sales Order Confirmation Is Not Created When Created Using WebServices
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order, using a Web-Service. However, the Output History is not generated and the Sales Order Confirmation is not sent via e-mail, inspite of maintaining it in the Account Master-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work-center and Sales Order view.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ. (XYZ refers to the Sales Order ID)-Click on Edit and View All.-Navigate to the Output History and it is blank.-Cause-The release of Sales Order and Send order confirmation to account actions are controlled via the Business Configuration scoping for the web service.- The tag 'ReleaseCustomerRequest' is not for releasing the Sales Order, it is for the visibility of the Sales Order on UI. Only when this is set to true, you will be able to see the created Sales Order on UI.-Resolution-For Send Order Confirmation to account to happen automatically,please check the scoping as below:-Go to the Business Configuration.-Choose the required Project and Navigate to the Questions.-Go to Sales -> Selling Products and Services -> E-Selling.-Under Group: Submit Order Confirmation Automatically for E-Shop (1) , please select the below scoping question:"Do you want the solution to automatically send an order confirmation to the customer when a sales order that originates from an E-Shop is released?"- Once this is done, issue will be resolved.-Keywords-"Webservice", "Sales Order Confirmation", "Sales Order"-sales order,web services,sales order confirmation

Title: Price Component Cost Is Missing In Manual Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-You create a manual invoice request or a follow up invoice, but the price component cost is not added.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Create a new invoice request.-Select relevant master data.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-There is no price component Cost added to the Invoice Request.-Cause-Costs are tracked from sales documents created in Business ByDesign.-Manual invoice requests have no cost attribution in the invoice.-Follow up invoices do not take costs, as the cost was tracked in the original invoice.-Credit memos from the customer return scenario have costs attributed, because the cost reversion happens due to the return, when items are posted back to stock.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Kundenrechnung, Kosten, Retoure, Folgerechnung, Customer Invoice, Cost, Return, Follow up invoice

Title: The Process Communication Error "Party 123 does not exist or not valid for this role" is displayed for a Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The following Process Communication Errors are displayed for a Sales Order document in the UI:-Party 123 does not exist or not valid for this role (where 123 represents the Employee ID)-SalesAndPurchasingAccountingNotification ABC: Business partner 123 does not exist (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Open, Select View All. -Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Process Communication Errors are displayed for the Sales Order ABC.-Cause-The Process Communication Errors occurs for the Sales Order ABC because the Employee Responsible 123 maintained in the Sales Order is not a valid Employee ID in the system.-Go to the Transaction SEFTS.-Search for the BO name -> SALES_ORDER.-Select the arrow in the folder Icon.- Select the option Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the "ID/content" field, insert the Sales Order ID ABC.- Select Confirm.- In the BO Instance Structure Column, Right click the Sales Order ABC.- Select Message Monitoring -> Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow.-The following failed XI messages are displayed:-Sender: SalesOrderProcessing-Receiver: CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn-Error: Party 123 does not exist or not valid for this role-Sender: SalesOrderProcessing-Receiver: AccountingSalesAndPurchasingAccountingIn-Error: SalesAndPurchasingAccountingNotification ABC: Business partner 123 does not exist-Resolution-To correct the Process Communication Errors a valid Employee Responsible ID requires to be maintained in the Sales Order ABC.-For this process the following steps can be performed:-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Change Employee Responsible Party Role to a valid employee.-Select Save button.-After a valid Employee Responsible ID is maintained in the Sales Order document, a reconcile action can be performed each failed XI message in order to properly deliver them.-Please ensure to check if a new XI message was created and delivered properly.-Note: If the original failed XI message is still not properly delivered, after the new XI message is created and delivered, then it is required to cancel the original failing XI message.-Keywords-salesandpurchasingaccountingnotification, business partner, does not exist, party, does not exist or not valid for this role, sales order

Title: Unable to add account assignment for the shopping cart in the ByD App
Content: Symptom-In the SAP BYD application, the shopping cart does not have an option to set the account assignment to the project task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log-in to SAP ByD App-Select "Create shopping cart"-Select the products available from catalog-There is no "Account Assignment Type" tab available-Cause-Standard System behavior-Resolution-The ByD App only has a "Go Shopping" feature, which allows for quick ordering in the shopping cart. As a result, the option to add an "Account Assignment Type" is not available.-To add an "Account Assignment Type," create it using the "Go Shopping (Advanced)" feature, which is available in the system.-Keywords-Account Assignment Type for shopping cart in ByD App; Shopping cart; ByD App;

Title: Project Invoice Request is Inconsistent with the error "Tax not yet Calculated"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Project Invoice Request is showing the error 'Tax not yet Calculated' and has inconsistent Items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Show Inconsistent Invoice Requests and search for the Invoice Request ID OPQ (OPQ represents the document ID).-Select the document.-Click on the Check button.-You can see the Error: Tax not yet calculated.-Open the Project Invoice Request.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Items are shown as inconsistent.-Cause-This inconsistency is caused when External Tax Rate Determination is set and the Status of the Items is not updated once Tax is Calculated.-Resolution-To correct the Status and make the documents consistent a backend correction from development side is necessary, which must be approved by the customer.-Keywords-external, tax, error, calculated, status, inconsistent.

Title: SSO Usage in the SAP Business ByDesign Mobile
Content: Symptom-You would like to know if the SSO is supported in the SAP Business ByDesign Mobile.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-You can download the app in your work profile if your company allows it. However, Single Sign-On (SSO) won't function within your work profile or even if you download the app in your personal space.-Additionally, the app utilizes the Cordova plugin in-app browser, which means it cannot be opened with other browsers.-If you wish to access it via a browser, we have a 'mobilclient.html' URL available, which is:-https://myXXXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/public/ap/ui/repository/SAP_UI/HTMLOBERON5/mobileClient.html-Please change the XXXXXX to the Tenant URL accordingly.-Resolution-Currently, this is the expected system behavior.-See Also-3226460 - Frequently Asked Questions on ByD Security Topics-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, App, Mobile, SSO, Usage, Supported, Not Working, Configuration.

Title: Demand Plan Figures Not Updated to Maintain Demand Forecast Report
Content: Symptom-The demand plan figures is maintained however the values are not fully transferred to maintain demand forecast report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Demand Planning workcenter.-Go to Demand Plans view and choose Demand Plan ID-Open "Planning Board" by button "Plan" and and scroll down to line having required Material-All Periods have data for Key Figure "Final Forecast"-==========================================================================-Go to Work Center Supply Planning -Maintain Demand Forecast-Search respective Material-Here no values are populated in the demand forecast report-Cause-The current selected Demand Management Procedure method is not relevant to the capability that maintain demand forecast report.-Resolution-Try using All Demand Consumes Forecast, both the forecast and the actual demand become visible in supply planning. This enhances visibility and supports short-term plan adjustments. For example, if you have forecast demands for two products; one that underestimates actual demand and the other that overestimates actual demand, the supply planner can shift production from the overestimated to the underestimated product.--To change the Demand Management Procedure:-Go to the Product Data work center.-Select the Materials view.-Search for the relevant product.-Select the searched product and choose Edit button.-In the material screen, choose View All button.-Go to Planning tab. Here, select the appropriate Demand Management Procedure from the dropdown.-      Keywords-demand forecast report, Demand Management Procedure, All Demand Consumes Forecast

Title: Output For Customer Invoices Are Sent to Incorrect E-mail Address.
Content: Symptom-You have set up the Account Master Data with the correct E-mail address, however when you check the Output History of the sales document, it was sent to a different E-mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the invoice ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice).-Edit the Invoice and go to the Output History tab.-The E-mail of the output document is wrong.-Cause-Notice that for the Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice). The Bill-To is different and if you click on the address details of Bill-To you can see that system have picked email address based on the Bill-To address.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Bill-to, E-mail, Sales Orders, Invoice, Output

Title: Unable to Upload Customer Invoice Using File Input Workcenter View
Content: Symptom-You are using the File Input method to upload Customer Invoice File. The XML file has been successfully uploaded however the Customer Invoice request in Customer Invoicing workcenter has not been created after the upload.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User management workcenter-Select File Input and Select New-Enter Service Interface Code as Customer Invoice Processing Request Invoicing In-Select the required XML and Import-Cause-This issue could occur due to the payload that you are attempting to upload. The error which is causing the invoice upload to fail could relate to the pricing information being sent XLM file.-i.e. The Currency Code maintained for the Product is JPY, however in the payload you are using YEN because which the invoice request is not created successfully.-Resolution-Make sure that the Currency Code maintained for the product is matching with the Currency Code entered in the XML file.-Keywords-File Input, Customer invoice, File upload issue, Customer Invoice not created after upload

Title: Tax Jurisdiction Rule for Ship From
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-THIS CASE DOCUMENT IS RESERVED FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY.--The Tax jurisdiction does not match with Sales Order's Ship From-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order-Select the Sales Order view-Search for Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the relevant sales order)-Navigate to Item tab-On items details navigate to Tax-The system is showing the Tax Jurisdiction from different country than Sales Order ship from (e.g Ship from in sales order item is CA but in the Tax details view it was seted as NY)-Cause-If you have differents ship from's for different items,the system will check if there is a rule maintained under Define Tax Jurisdictions in Business COnfiguration.-If yes, even though if have just one item with different ship from and this Tax Jurisdiction is best ranked than other than the Tax Jursdiction determined for all other items with same Ship-from ,the system will take the best ranked Tax Jurisdiction.-Resolution-You should check the rule maintained in Business Configuration activity Tax on Goods and Services - US and under Define Tax Jursidictions section and set the rules according to your business process..

Title: SII Error Code 2006 - La Factura Contiene un Desglose a Nivel de Factura Cuando le Corresponde un Desglose a Nivel de Operacin, Por no Ser Factura Simplificada ni Asiento Resumen y la Contraparte Contiene un IdOtro o Tiene un NIF Que Empiece por N
Content: Symptom-SII VAT Return is Partially Approved.-Some invoices in the SII VAT Return have the Acceptance Status as Accepted with Errors.-Error Description for above invoices is:-'La factura contiene un desglose a nivel de factura cuando le corresponde un desglose a nivel de operación, por no ser factura simplificada ni asiento resumen y la contraparte contiene un IdOtro o tiene un NIF que empiece por N'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Go to the VAT Returns subview.-Find the relevant VAT Return.-Click View.-Open the Tax Return tab.-Note: Some invoices have the Acceptance Status as Accepted with Errors. The Error Code is 2006.-Cause-The affected invoices are posted for non ES/EU suppliers. The Tax Code used for the line items in these invoices is wrong.-The correct Tax Codes are:-314 - Supply of Goods - EU W/O VAT Reg. / Non Residents with First Letter N in NIF-315 - Supply of Services - EU W/O VAT Reg. / Non Residents with First Letter N in NIF-Resolution-You need to cancel the affected invoices and create new ones using the correct Tax Code.-Keywords-Factura; Invoice; Nivel; Desglose; Breakdown; Partially Approved; Tax; VAT; Return; Run; Tax Code; Simplificada; Errors, SII, Error Code 2006,-la factura contiene un desglose,sii,nif

Title: Scoping Questions Are Grayed Out Under Territory Management In Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to scope particular questions under Territory Management which are currently grayed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select respective implementation project.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Step 4: Questions tab.-Open scoping element Sales > Account and Activity management > Territory Management.-Select the group: Transaction Documents Territory Change.-Result: Questions about Transaction Document Territory Change are grayed out.-Cause-These questions have dependency on the scoping question maintained under Account – Territory Association.-If you select the scoping question “Do you want to assign an account to more than one territory?”, you will not be able to scope the questions Transaction Document Territory Change.-Resolution-In order to scope the two questions under Territory Management, the question under Account – Territory Association needs to be de-scoped.-However, there is pre-requisite when you de-scope the below question: You must ensure that all the already existing accounts do not have more than one territory assigned.-Keywords-Scoping Questions, Territory management, Dependencies, multiple territories

Title: How the Replace Product Functionality Works in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how the Replace Product functionality works in the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select a New Sales Order under Common Tasks.-Select View All button and go to the Items tab.-Add a material.-The Replace Product is available on the screen.-Cause-This is a new functionality added in the SAP Business ByDesign to enable you to search and replace the added product with another alternative.-Resolution-Here is a general description about the button Replace Product:--You can choose the action Replace Product to search for alternatives products, product specifications, or ship-from locations, in order to-replace the selected item based on projected product quantities. For the search you can maintain the Horizon, that represents the time frame for-which the projected product quantity is calculated. The Projected quantity is calculated by the available stock plus supply minus demand,-considering the horizon set (without considering the transport times and without considering the replenishment lead time).--The system defaults the product, the product specification (if available), the ship-from, and the horizon from the item to the-selection parameters of the popup. The button Replace product is not active in fast-entry mode, i. e. after you have pressed Fast Entry in the sales order screen.

Title: Dump When Releasing A Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a Customer Invoice, but face a dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the invoice: DEF. (DEF represents the Invoice Document ID)-Click on the Release Button.-A dump occurs.-Cause-One of the possible cause is Multiple currencies which are maintained for the same item in the invoice. The List Price currency maintained differs from the Net Price.-Resolution-A uniform currency should be maintained for the List Price of the product, so that the list price and net value will reflect the same currency.-Keywords-"Dump", "Invoice", "Currency"

Title: While Selecting the Print Pro Forma Invoice From a Sales Order, the System is Selecting a Different Form Layout
Content: Symptom-When you select the Print Pro Forma Invoice from a Sales Order, the system is selecting a different form template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the Sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order number).-Select Print Pro Forma Invoice.-In the new window select Print Pro Forma Invoice button.-System showing a different Business Document like Down Payment Request /Customer Credit Memo-Cause-The rule for Pro Forma Invoice in Form Template Selection is not maintained and hence system picks the last default form for Customer Invoice.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Input and Output Management view and select Form Template Selection Sub view.-Select Customer Invoice from value help.-Select New and select Form template code as Customer Invoice.-Select Business Document as Pro Forma Invoice and select Save and Close.-See Also-KBA  2038600 - While Selecting the Print Pro Forma Invoice From a Sales Order, the System is Selecting a Different Form Layout-Keywords-Pro Forma Invoice,Form Template rule,system selecting different form template-system selecting different form template,pro forma invoice,form template rule,customer invoice pro forma,sales order pro forma

Title: Account Name Showing in the ﻿Customer Invoice ﻿Document is Not The Expected One
Content: Symptom-The system displays the old Account Name in the Customer Invoice instead of the newly updated Account Name maintained in the Account Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Navigate to the Invoice Documents view.-From the dropdown list, select All Invoice Documents and search for Invoice XYZ. (XYZ represents the Invoice ID).-Edit Invoice XYZ.-Observe that the Account Name displayed in the invoice is different from the Account Name maintained in the Account Master Data under the Account Management work center.-Cause-The Account Name was changed after the preceding documents for invoice XYZ were created. The system retrieves the Account Name maintained in the preceding documents and does not retrieve the updated Account Name from the Account Master Data.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-If the newly updated Account Name needs to be reflected in the Customer Invoicing Document, all preceding documents must be cancelled and recreated.- Keywords-Account Name; Old Account Name; Updated Account Name; Customer Invoicing; Invoice Document; Account Master Data; Preceding Documents; Account Information; Invoice Data

Title: The Error "Date For Maximum Discount Must Be Before Other Payment Dates" is Displayed in a Sales Order Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When invoicing an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request, the invoice creation screen is displayed in blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Requests View.-Filter for All Invoice Requests.-Search for the Sales Order Invoice Request ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order Invoice Request ID).-Mark the Sales Order Invoice Request ABC.-Select Check button.-Select Redetermine button.-The error message "Date for Maximum Discount Must Be Before Other Payment Dates" is not removed.-Cause-Even though the corrected Payment Terms are maintained in the Business Configuration, the redetermination for the maximum discount date did not happen due to certain inconsistencies.-Resolution-A dummy modification must be triggered on the Sales Order document, so that the correct Cash Discount terms data gets determined for the document.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Navigate to the General tab.-In the Payment Terms field, change to a different Payment Term.-Select Save button.-In the Payment Terms field, change to the previous Payment Term maintained.-Select Save button.-Now the redetermination for the Sales Order Invoice Request ABC will occur successfully in the system and the invoicing of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request should occur without any errors.-See Also-KBA 1817669 - The Error Message "Invoice request XYZ item ABC not possible; reference document inconsistent" is Triggered--KBA 1718618 - Invoice Request Inconsistent Due To Error: "Date for maximum discount must be before other payment dates"-KBA 2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-Keywords-sales order invoice request, payment terms, business configuration, invoice request;-vor anderen zahlungsbedingungen,datum für max. rabatt

Title: Error: Check for Pending System Requests - Technical Error Occurred. Please Create an Incident
Content: Symptom-You are unable to merge the change project with the production system. The following error occurs in the merge report:-Error Message: Check for pending system requests - Technical error occurred. Please create an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Implementation Projects-Select the appropriate project-Click on Open Activity List-Select Merge Changes-Click on Open-Click on Start Merge-Cause-This can be caused by many reasons. The most frequent case is that an open remote change project exists that was not merged with the production system and that was moved to the test system. When you go to Service Control Center > Systems, you will find that the test system has been terminated in the meantime. Also a refreshed target test system can lead to the situation. In both cases  the change project does not exist anymore in the target system. It might still being visible as sent to the test system in the source system.-Resolution-Please create a SAP Support Case and provide the permission to correct the issue.  SAP needs to check the application logs in the backend. Based on this, the backend old reference to the terminated test system will be deleted.-After that, you can try to merge the change project with the production system again. It should then find the new test system.-In some instances, you might need to delete the change project and create a new change project.-Keywords-Auf ausstehende Systemanforderungen prüfen, technischer Fehler aufgetreten, melden Sie einen Vorfall, bei Übernahme der Änderungen aus dem erstellten Änderungsprojekt technischer Fehler aufgetreten-logic port

Title: Error Message: "For this item, a credit memo is not permitted since no supplier invoice is expected for the corresponding purchase order item"
