Content: Symptom-When maintaining the Follow-up Decision in return to supplier, error message raised:-For this item, a credit memo is not permitted since no supplier invoice is expected for the corresponding purchase order item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Returns to Suppliers view-Open return to supplier ABC (ABC refers to the return to supplier document ID)-Maintain the Follow-up Decision as [Credit Memo] or [Partial Credit Memo & Replacement]-Error message raised-  Cause-In the corresponding purchase order item Follow-up Documents setting, the item is marked as invoice not expected.-User can check the setting follow below steps.-Open the purchase order-Go to Items tab-Select the corresponding purchase order item-Go to Basic Data subtab-Under Follow-up Documents, you can find the checkbox of [Invoice Expected]-When the checkbox not ticked, no follow-up supplier invoice required for the purchase order item. Hence credit memo also not required.-Resolution-In the return to supplier, you can choose [Replacement] as the follow-up decision for no-invoice-expected item.-Exception:-In case of Third Party purchasing, [Replacement] option is not supported.-To get the return to supplier document completed, please follow below steps:-Cancel current Return to Supplier document-Go back to the corresponding purchase order, use positive integer for Purchase Order price and set it to invoice expected-Create a new return to supplier document -Now, credit memo can be selected as the follow-up decision without error.-Keywords-Return to Supplier; Follow-up Decision; Credit Memo; 0 Price; Zero Price

Title: System Not Automatically Proposing Source Logistics Area When Replenishment Task is Created
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are creating Replenishment Task and have set up your Master Data (Logistics Model and Inventory-Managed Details) in order for the system to propose particular Source Logistics Areas when the Task is created. When you tried the set up in the test system, the solution was working very well. However, when you tried same in your production environment, the system is not automatically proposing the Source Logistics Areas when Confirming the Replenishment Task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Internal Logistics work center. -Go to the Task Control view. -Find and select the relevant Task ID.-Click Confirm.-You can see the Source Logistics Area is blank.-You expected the system to automatically propose the Source Logistics Area since you have the batch managed Material available in multiple Logistics Areas.-Cause-You have maintained the Logistics Area and not the Location in the Material Flow Rules of the Logistics Area.-Resolution-In the Material Flow Rule for the Logistics Area, you need to maintain the Location and not the Logistics Area for the system to propose the Logistics Area.-Please proceed as follows:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to the Locations view. -Find and select the relevant Site/Location.-Click Edit Layout and locate the relevant Logistics Area.-Go to the Material Flow Rules tab.-Go to the Source Sub-tab and select the relevant Sequence ID.-Click Add Row to maintain "Assigned Locations/Logistics Areas".-Maintain the Line Number, Location and Picking Strategy (the FIFO strategy is recommended for batch-managed Material).-Save.-     - --See Also-https://community.sap.com/t5/enterprise-resource-planning-q-a/replenish-task-for-production-order/qaq-p/12084363-Logistics Source and Destination Services-Simple Location Layout Creation-Complex Location Layout Creation-Create and Edit a Location-Logistics Models-Logistics Models Quick Guide-3346164- How Does FIFO Strategy Work

Title: Crash when attempting to clear a supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-When attempting to clear a Supplier Invoice, you experience a crash.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Select Supplier Accounts.-Filter for all Suppliers.-Search for ID XXX(XXX represents the ID of the Supplier).-Click on View.-Filter for External reference YYYY(YYY represents the ID of the Supplier Invoice External Reference).-Click on clear manually.-Result: A crash happens.-Cause-A potential cause would be that you did not maintain the default address for the corresponding Supplier.-The system is checking for the default address of the Supplier during tax calculation. -Resolution-Please maintain the Supplier address by following those steps:-Go to the Supplier Base Work Center.-Select Suppliers.-Filter for All Suppliers and search for XXX.-Click on Edit and then Addresses.-Maintain an address and save.-Now you can attempt the clearing again.-   Keywords-Supplier address missing

Title: Multiple Tax Numbers Are Not Shown in XML of Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When opening the XML of purchase order, it was expected to shown all the Tax Numbers maintained in the Supplier Master Data. However system is only picking one Tax Number. -Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for: ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID). -Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Output History tab.-Click in View Original XML button.-In the XML you can see that it is shown only one Tax Number, and not all that are maintained in the Supplier Master Data.-Cause-Because of technical reasons, having multiple taxation terms on root is not possible in the system. It means that can be only one Tax Number and one Buyer on a document.-Resolution-System is working as designed. -Keywords-Purchase Order, Tax Number, Supplier, PAN, GST, Permanent Account Number, Identification Number

Title: Unable to Release Service Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When clicking on the Release button in a Service Confirmation, the Service Confirmation is saved but not released. The status remains as Not Started.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Service Confirmations View.-Open the Service Confirmation ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Confirmation).-Click on the Release button.-The Service Confirmation closes automatically but is not released and the status remains as Not Started.-Cause-The Service Confirmations cannot be released due to an issue with the Approval Process for Service Confirmations.-1. Simulate the Approval Process via the backend (see also KBA 2491406 - How to Troubleshoot Approval Process at Backend)-Backend Transaction sesfts.-BO: SERVICE_CONFIRMATION.-Query Service Confirmation ABC.-Copy Node I (in our example : F9F9D7394A511EEF8FD0F1CC5D57645E).-Backend transaction: SE38-SLPE_DEMO_PROCESS_PREVIEW-Enter:-Business Object Node: SERVICE_CONFIRMATION-ROOT.-Node ID: (copied from sesfts e.g. F9F9D7394A511EEF8FD0F1CC5D57645E).-Click on Execute.-Following error is displayed:-Error occurred while trying to evaluate condition of a process step-Affected process: 'Default approval process for Service Confirmation' / step 'Default step'-This indicates that there is an issue with the condition in the Approval Process.-2. Check the Approval Process in the UI:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Approval Process view.-Select Active Approval Process for Service Confirmation.-Click on Copy.-In the Conditions for Group 1 click on the Edit button.-You can see that there is no value in the Field but there is a compare operator and a value maintained. This indicates that when the Approval Process was created an Extension field was selected in the field Field.-3. Check the value of the Field attribute in the Approval Process via the Backend:-Backend Transaction sesfts:-BO: APPROVAL_PROCESS_DEFINITION.-Query on VERSION_NAME→Select All.-Remove the restriction of 200 and enter a -1.-Now search for the specific version name as copied from UI.-Select the version name and navigate to parent.-Navigate to Step -> WorkflowCondition -> Expression -> Term.-You can see the value maintained in the field Field under ATTRIBUTE_ID e.g in our example the ATTRIBUTE_ID is EXT-/BYD/A13CYP00048F95243A2CF -4. Check if the Extension Field exists in the Service Confirmation on Root in the backend transaction  /N/EXT/FIELD:-Please note that you need to change the value EXT-/BYD/A13CYP00048F95243A2CF to EXT-/BYD/A13CYF00048F95243A2CF -If it does not exist you can check if it was deleted in the backend transaction /N/EXT/RECOVERY (see also KBA 2775506 - Deleted Extension Fields)-If the field appears and the indicator for completely delete is true, the field was deleted. -You can check the deletion of the extension field in the UI as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Flexibility Change Log view.-All Changed Objects.-Advanced Search.-Enter Changed Object /BYD/A13CYF00048F95243A2CF.-Click on Go.-Select Changed Object /BYD/A13CYF00048F95243A2CF with the Name Test_Service Performer3.-Click on the Change History button.-You can see that the field was deleted with the details of the date/time stamp and the user.-Since the extension field was deleted the Approval Process cannot be executed and therefore the Service Confirmation cannot be released.-Resolution-Inform the customer that the Service Confirmations cannot be released due to the Approval Process they set up in their system for Service Confirmations.-If an Approval Process is in scope and you click on the Release button, the Approval Process is automatically triggered and then pending on the approval condition the Service Confirmation goes into Approval or not. Once the Approval Process is completed, the Service Confirmation is automatically released.-However, in the customers system the Approval Process for Service Confirmations is using an extension field as a Condition which has been deleted.-The customer can solve the issue by either un-scoping the Approval Process for Service Confirmations or change/create a new approval process with a valid condition.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Release, SAP Business ByDesign, Field Service and Repair, Error, Not Started, not released, nothing happens,

Title: Error 'Cost object AAA is not valid for company BBB and date YYYYMMDD. Choose another cost object.'
Content: Symptom-Exception raised when trying to post a Supplier Invoice 123 'Cost object AAA is not valid for company BBB and date YYYYMMDD. Choose another cost object'.-(123 represents the Supplier Invoice ID; AAA represents the Cost object ID; BBB represents the company ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the Invoice 123.-Navigate to Exceptions tab.-See exception: 'Cost object AAA is not valid for company BBB and date YYYYMMDD. Choose another cost object'.-Cause-The cost object type of the selected cost object is not assigned to the selected Account Assignment Type.-Follow the below steps to check the cost object type of the selected cost object for the invoice item.-Open the invoice and navigate to the Items tab.-Select the item.-Under the Cost Distribution subtab, see the Cost Object ID is AAA.-Open the cost object AAA and see the Cost Object Type is CCC.-Follow the below steps to check the selected Account Assignment Type for the invoice item.-Open the invoice and navigate to the Items tab -> Cost Distribution subtab.-See Account Assignment Type XXX.-Then follow the below steps to check the settings for Account Assignment Type XXX.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for activity: 'Account Assignment Types' and open it.-Click 'Maintain Account Assignment Types'.-See that for Account Assignment Type XXX, the Account Assignment is not Cost Object Type CCC.-(CCC represents the Cost Object Type for the cost object AAA; XXX represents the Account Assignment Type.)-Resolution-Either change the Account Assignment to CCC for the current Account Assignment Type XXX, or create a new Account Assignment Type with account assignment CCC and select the new Account Assignment Type for the invoice item.-Keywords- Account Assignment Type, Cost Object, Cost Object Type,

Title: Time Recording Not Showing in New Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When creating a Project Invoice Request, not all the booked Time and Expenses for the Employees in specific Project are being carried out. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center. -Go to Projects view. -Search for ABC (ABC is the Project's ID).-Click in New button and select Manual Invoice Request. -Navigate to Items tab. -Navigate to Time and Expenses tab. -It is missing times for employees. -Cause-The time entries were already invoiced in another Project Invoice Request. -Firstly, confirm that the time recordings are not invoiceable by following the steps below:-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view-Search for ABC.-Click in Edit Time and Expenses button.-Check the if the missing time recordings are shown here. -Now that it is confirmed that the times are not available to be invoiced, the user can check where those time entries are. -Now the user checks the time recording information:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for OPQ (OPQ is the employee's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Employee Times tab. -Make notes of the information such as quantity, project task, start and end dates. -As the final step, the user checks the Project Invoice Requests created for project ABC.-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Project Invoice Requests view.-Open the Advanced Filter. -Insert 'Reference Project ID: ABC'. -Click in Go button. -Open the first Project Invoice Request. -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Items tab.-Navigate to Time and Expenses tab.-In Employee/Party select OPQ. -In Time and Expense Items section, check if the time recording is here (based in the Project task, Quantity and Provision Date). -If the time is not here, the user can check the other Project Invoice Requests until find the one that has the expected time entry. -Resolution-System is working as designed. -Keywords-Project, Project Invoice Request, Time Recording, Time Entry, Time Entries, Time and Expenses, Employee

Title: Migration of Balances of Bank Accounts Unsuccessful For Chinese Companies
Content: Symptom-When migrating Balances of Bank Accounts, the migration shows successful, but the migrated balance is not posted due to the bank statement is not posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First check whether the migration happens successfully:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Open Migration Tool.-Balances of Bank Accounts completes successfully.-Then check the bank statement status:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Can find the bank statement status is In Preparation. The migrated balance is not Posted due to the bank statement is not posted.-Click edit, can see warning: Item 1 Cash flow key missing; Use of cash flow key is mandatory for Chinese companies when Direct Cash Flow Statement is scoped. -Cause-Use of cash flow key is mandatory for Chinese companies when Direct Cash Flow Statement is scoped. As this is missing, the bank statement is not posted and the migration is unsuccessful.-Resolution-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to Bank Statements view-Can find the bank statement status is In Preparation. The migrated balance is not Posted due to the bank statement is not posted.-Click edit, can see warning: Item 1 Cash flow key missing; Use of cash flow key is mandatory for Chinese companies when Direct Cash Flow Statement is scoped. -Enter the cash flow key manually in the bank statement, and click save.-The bank statement should post, and the migration should complete as well.-There will be a pertinent Jira to correct the issue.-Keywords-Balances of Bank Accounts, cash flow key

Title: Unable to export data to excel due to error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to export data to Microsoft Excel from a custom view, you face either the below errors:-FATAL ERROR: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'LANGUAGE_FORMATTED_NAME')-The template you requested does not exist; report an incident-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the custom work center.-Open the custom work center view.-In the OWL (object work list) screen, click on Export > To Microsoft Excel button.-The error is shown.-Cause-The custom Microsoft excel template was not correctly generated during the OWL screen creation.-Resolution-To fix the issue you will need to generate the custom template by using function module (FM) EXCEL_EXPORT_GET_GROUP_ID on SE37.-This FM uses two parameters:--- IV_PROXY: This is the proxy name of the BO connected to the OWL screen. You can use MDRS to find the proxy BO name e.g. YABCDEFGY_XYZ123ABC456-- IV_UI_NAME: This is the OWL screen file name. You need to provide only the last part of the file.-E.g. In case the OWL file path is: /YABCDEFGY_MAIN/SRC/CustomBO/MyBO/OnlyTheLastPart_OWL.OWL.uicomponent, then you need to provide as parameter: OnlyTheLastPart_OWL-Once you have these parameters values, you can:-Go to 1O and click on "Assign Developer to Default Partner" button-Go to SE37-Execute (F8) the FM EXCEL_EXPORT_GET_GROUP_ID -Provide the parameters values-Check the Uppercase/Lowercase checkbox-Execute-In case the export works for your support user after this fix, but the customer informs that the issue still persists for their user, then it will be required to copy the access rights of the business user into the support user in CAM, and execute above steps again.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, export, microsoft, excel, error, data, BO, custom, screen, OWL, TypeError, fatal, cannot, read, properties, of, undefined, reading 'LANGUAGE_FORMATTED_NAME', the, template, you, requested, does, not, exist, report, an, incident, export to EXCEL

Title: Unable to add an Attachment in the Custom Workcenter
Content: Symptom-In a custom workcenter, you are encountering an issue where attachments are not being successfully added to the attachment facet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-For example,-Go to Sales workcenter-Go to the Custom workcenter view-Select Order ID: ABC-Navigate to the Attachment facet-Add any attachment -Notice after saving, the attachment does not get added to the attachment facet.-Cause-You have added both C4C and BYD attachment embedded component.-Resolution-Below is the attachment embedded component to be used in C4C and BYD system.-C4C (Specific to Sales workcenter) - /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/crm/pas/SalesPriceList_OIF_ECO.OIF.uicomponent-BYD - /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/Reuse/Attachments/documentlist.EC.uicomponent-   Keywords-Embedded Component, Attachment, Custom BO, Custom Workcenter

Title: How to adapt the RFQ Delivery Date'.
Content: Symptom-The Delivery Date for RFQ for Purchase Order should automatically be 30 days.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Click on New RFQ common task.-Enter the Submission Deadline.-Select the RFQ Type as RFQ for Purchase Order.-Click on Next and Add Row.-See that the Delivery Date is automatically defined to 7 days from the current day.-Cause-The Delivery Date change under RFQ category from 7 to 30 days does not have any available configuration settings. In the backend, there is a class that maintains and sets the determination of the delivery date as 7 days. The code checks if the delivery day is initially provided or not. Since no value is initially provided, it sets the default delivery lead day as 7 days.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior which will be applicable for any RFQ creation. So if we make the alterations to the standard code, this will be impacting other RFQs and other customers as well.-As there are no active configuration settings available to control the Delivery Date Lead Time and standard code changes would impact other RFQs, our recommendation is to handle this field manually as the Delivery Date Lead time is editable.-Keywords-RFQ, Delivery Date, Delivery Date Lead Time

Title: Breakpoints Are Missing After Logging Off From Cloud Applications Studio (SDK)
Content: Symptom-You have inserted breakpoints in a .absl file within SAP Cloud Applications Studio and noticed that they disappear after logging off and logging back on.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open your Solution.-Navigate to a .absl file.-Insert a breakpoint.-Log off from SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Log back in and open the Solution.-Navigate to the .absl file.-Observe that the previously inserted breakpoints are now missing.-Cause-The SAP Cloud Applications Studio does not support the persistent saving of breakpoints. This behavior is by design and is not a feature currently available in the system. -Resolution-We always advise you to re-add these breakpoints. For better usage,  you can maintain a documented list of your breakpoints in a separate file or within your project notes. When you log back in, you can quickly refer to this list to reapply the necessary breakpoints. -See Also-Debugging Quick Guide-Keywords-breakpoint, SDK, cloud applications studio, debugging, log off, log in, logging off, logging on, missing breakpoint, script, absl

Title: Custom Tooltip in an Extension Field cannot be displayed
Content: Symptom-An extension field with custom tooltip is added to the UI, but the custom tooltip cannot be displayed. Instead, the system displays the standard tooltip.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the UI screen where the extension field is added.-Move the cursor to the extension field.-Hold the cursor on the extension field.-The system shows the standard tooltip instead of custom one.-Cause-This is the system designed behavior.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. If an extension field with custom tooltip is added to a table or any custom tooltip is maintained for table column fields, only the standard tooltip will display. The restriction is only for the table-level column fields. -If any additional information needs to be populated in table, it is possible to give the text in the explanation button.-Keywords-Custom Tooltip, Cannot Display, Table-level Column Field

Title: Approver Name Removed After Approval Task Manually Completed in Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The user tried to execute an approval task of a sales order, but it was not allowed and get error message: Action not enabled. This is due to the status of the sales order is completed or cancelled, so the further change is not allowed on it.-Since all the processes are done, no further action is needed, after agreeing with the customer, you manually completed the approval task in the backend. see steps in KBA: 3455712 - How to Complete or Cancel a BTM Task from Backend? -However, after completed the task in the backend, the approver name disappeared from the Approval Process tab in the order. -"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-n/a-Cause-Once the approval task was completed manually in backend, the approval task in UI will changed to completed status.-Since the execution is done in backend by support user, the approver name removed in the Approval Process tab. This is the current system behavior. -Resolution-Before you performing the manual action to complete an approval task of a sales order, please confirm this with customer and get agreement.-If the action is done but customer wants to have the approver to be displayed, then the order has to be re-open again. So the user can withdraw the approval and release it again to trigger the approval process again.-Then the approver will be filled again based on the new approval process. And the user has to complete the approval process and then complete the order following the standard process.-See Also-3455712 - How to Complete or Cancel a BTM Task from Backend?-Keywords-approval task; approver disappeared; blank; BTM; manually complete. action not enabled;

Title: Button Reverse Confirmation is Disabled in Production Confirmation
Content: Symptom-In the edit screen of production confirmation ABC (ABC represents confirmation ID), Button Reverse Confirmation is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Audit, access view Production Lots. -Search DEF (DEF represents production lot ID), click View, click Edit.-Select tab Confirmations, open confirmation ABC, click Edit. The button Reverse Confirmation is disabled.-Cause-Once a production lot is closed, no further processing is possible, including reverse confirmation.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Production Confirmation, Reverse Confirmation, Production Lot, Disabled, Greyed Out

Title: Inability to Modify Number Range for Product Definition in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-An end or begin number in the Number Range for Product Definition activity is not editable.-The error occurs during the configuration process in the Business Configuration work center.-The issue arises when attempting to change the number range or swap the internal and external number range.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view or Overview.-Select Open Activity and then Fine-Tune tab in First Implementation Project, or search for Activities in Overview.-Open activity Number Range for Product Definition.-Open this activity and find the standard number range.-Try to adapt the begin number pf the internal number range, or the end number of the external number range.-The number cannot be edited.-Cause-The Internal - Begin Number and External - End Number are not editable by default.-It is not possible to perform the intended update of the numbers. -Such a change is also not possible in the backend.-Resolution-It is only possible to change the External - Begin Number and Internal - End Number in the intervals. -A change of this standard system behaviour can be proposed via Continuous Influence Session.- Keywords-Number Range, Product Definition, SAP Business ByDesign, Internal- End Number, External - Begin Number, Non-editable fields, Configuration, Implementation Project, Fine-Tune, unable, cannot, can't, not able,

Title: Not Being Able to Add an Editable Extension Field in Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-An editable extension field has been created in the customer demand of a sales order. However, despite the field being marked as editable, it is not possible to make any changes to it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open a sales order.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Click on Extended View.-Select the Customer Demand ID.-Click on View All.-In the General tab, locate the KUT field (extension field).-Please note that this field, along with other KUT fields on the screen, cannot be updated.-Cause-Since the screen in question is view-only, editing is not permitted.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-Extension field, Unable, Customer Demand, KUT

Title: Duplicate Payloads Generated When 3PL Inbound Delivery Notification Is Cancelled
Content: Symptom-You haven cancelled you 3PL stock transfer outbound delivery. -You see there are 2 payloads send to your warehouse provider when the cancellation is triggered. -Once message has the same IDN information and the second message has cancellation information. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center. -Navigate to the 3PL Inbound view and choose the  Inbound Delivery Notifications sub-view-Search for the relevant delivery notification, select it and choose the Edit button. -Navigate to the document flow tab and in extended view you can see there are two DDAN messages send at the same time. -Once with cancellation and one without cancellation.-The business user wants to understand why two messages were send. -Cause-First payload is triggered when the reference outbound delivery is Undo Released. -Second payload is triggered when the cancellation of outbound delivery is Cancelled. -Resolution-The mentioned behavior is not a bug, the behavior occurs as explained above. -See Also-duplicate IDN messages in 3PL

Title: Slow Performance or Time Out Error When Copying any Approval Process
Content: Symptom-When copying any approval process, you observe a slow tenant performance or there is a time out error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Approval processes view-Select the approval step Default Approval Process for Supplier Invoice-Select Copy-Adding any new step or condition-Now Save and Close-Notice, the approval process will get time out/Performance error then the system dumps.-Cause-The system dump is caused by the large number of steps and conditions defined in the approval process.-Resolution-To ensure better performance and stable system behavior,-It is recommended to limit the steps and conditions to 5000 line items only  or below and also better to limit to 200 steps and maximum 25 conditions for each step.-Keywords-approval, process, btm, copy, performance

Title: Unable to Modify the Product Once the Follow-up Sales Quote is Saved
Content: Symptom-In a follow-up Sales Quote the possibility of changing product is missing. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business - Sales Quotes -Select one Sales Quote from the list -Click on Follow-up -> Sales Quote-Save the New Sales Quote-Now you are unable to modify the products which are copied from previous sales quote. -Cause-When saving a new follow-up Sales Quote, the line items are automatically mapped between both sales quotes. This means that it is not possible to change the product using value help.-Resolution-You need to change the product before saving the sales quote or you can remove the line item completely. -This is a system standard behavior. -Keywords-searching products is missing,

Title: Long response times when preview a business document
Content: Symptom-When preview a business document, the system is slow and a long response time is needed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. The response time of previewing depends on the size of the runtime XML which is sent from the tenant to the form template. The larger the size of the XML is, the more response time is needed. For example, if the XML size is 30KB, the response time is 3s while the response time is around 30s if the XML size is 500KB.-Keywords-Preview, Response Time, XML Size

Title: Error 'Tax number type GST Identification Number has already been assigned to country/region IN' while adding Tax Number Type GSTIN in Tax Data for India
Content: Symptom-The error 'Tax number type GST Identification Number has already been assigned to country/region IN' appears when trying to add the GST Identification Number as the tax number type for India in the Supplier Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Select the respective supplier ID and click Edit > Financial Data.-Navigate to the Tax Data sub-tab.-Enter the Tax number type as GST Identification Number for Country India.-The error 'Tax number type GST Identification Number has already been assigned to country/region IN' occurs.-Cause-A line item with the Tax Number Type 'GST Identification Number' for India already exists.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-GST Identification Number, Supplier Master Data, Tax number type, India GSTIN

Title: The Error "554 5.0.0 Message rejected: Email address is not verified" is Displayed for An E-mail Output
Content: Symptom-When outputting documents via e-mail in SAP Business ByDesign, the status of the output shows an error, and raises the following message:-"554 5.0.0 Message rejected: Email address is not verified. The following identities failed the check in region X: Y" (where X represents a datacenter region, and Y represents the sender e-mail address)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This issue can happen in any e-mail sent through the SAP Business ByDesign system. A Purchase Order document will be used in the following example: -Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Enter the Purchase Orders view.-Open a Purchase Order ABC (where ABC refers to the Purchase Order ID).-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-The output document is displayed with the status as Error and the following message is displayed in the Error Message field.-"554 5.0.0 Message rejected: Email address is not verified. The following identities failed the check in region X: Y"-Cause-The domain being used in the sender e-mail address has not been activated for DKIM. This is a mandatory setup for e-mail domains used in SAP Business ByDesign systems.-Resolution-To activate DKIM for the email domain, open a SAP case and request the DKIM activation for the domain of the email that is sending the output document with error.-See Also-Refer to the below KBA for the DKIM activation process:-KBA 2937666 - DKIM Key Activation for sending the Business Emails in SAP Business ByDesign (ByD)-Keywords-email, queue, AWS, DKIM, Output History, domain

Title: Planning Inventory Is Not Updated After Ad-Hoc Goods Movement
Content: Symptom-You have performed an ad-hoc goods movement from one logistics area to another logistics area. -Both the logistics areas are under the same site. -You expect the information of stock movement to be updated at the site level as soon as the movement is completed. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Common Tasks view. -Choose the Goods Movement task.-Enter the relevant information for goods movement and save the entries. -Once the goods movement is completed when you check the Supply Planning screen you see there is no change in the total available stock.-Cause-When materials are moved within the site, the planning view will not be updated because planning always checks for stock at the site level.-If stocks are moved within the same site, the system does not need to update the planning view as the stock is moved between logistics areas under the same site.-Users may face stock differences in the stock overview and planning view of inventory if the logistics area from which the stock is moved has a logistics use that does not allow planning to access the available stock.-An example of this is the logistics use Project Stock. If the business user moves stock from a logistics area with the logistics use Project Stock to a logistics area with the logistics use Storage, the quantity of material moved from the logistics area with Project Stock usage will not be immediately updated in planning due to the reasons mentioned above.-The data flow verification run, which already exists in the system, will identify and fix this issue frequently. However, if the user checks the planning view before the DFV run is executed, they will see this difference.-Resolution-You can create data flow verification runs specific to Planning view and Inventory and execute them to run every day if this goods movement is frequent at your end due to your business process. You can refer the below KBAs to know details of how the same can be done. -2794944 - Difference Between Stock Overview and Product Planning-2974717 - How to schedule Data Flow Verification runs to correct the discrepancy between Planning screen and Stock Overview-See Also-SAP Help Document - Create a Data Flow Verification Run-Keywords-planning view different from inventory, data flow verification run, data not updated in planning, quantity not same in planning and inventory

Title: Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is not Created for Consignment Issue Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The system did not create the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request after the consignment issue sales order ABC was released, and it is not possible to invoice it (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go into the Invoice Requests view.-Click on Advanced Filter.-On the Preceding Document section, select the ID ABC.-Select Document Type Sales Order.-Click on Go.-The Outbound Delivery Invoice Request was not created for the sales order with Product-Consignment-Issue items.-There is only a Sales Order Invoice Request displayed as 'Processed', which is not relevant in this scenario.-Cause-The Outbound Delivery for sales order ABC is with status Not Released.-Due to an inconsistency, it is not automatically released after the Sales Order is released. Hence, the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is not created, and it is impossible to invoice the document.-Resolution-The outbound delivery must be released manually. To do that, perform the following steps:-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection.-Click on Advanced Filter.-In the Reference Data section, enter the Sales Order ID ABC.-Click on Go.-The Outbound Delivery is Not Released. Click on Release button.-Now, the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request should be created automatically and it will be possible to invoice it through the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-See Also-Consignment Issue and Invoicing Process - SAP Help Portal (Documentation)-Keywords-consignment, stock, consignment issue, outbound delivery invoice request, invoice, product-consignment-issue, sales order, customer invoicing, item type.

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-  You are trying to change the Invoice date and Posting date in the Supplier Invoice ABC, but system crashes while attempting to change.-Remark: Same issue also happens when you are trying to post the Supplier Invoice.-'ABC' refers to Supplier Invoice ID.-'DEF' refers to Purchase order ID.-Environment-SAP Business Invoice date and Posting date.-After some time, you see the System crashes.-Cause-When you checked in the backend, you can able to see the dump details.-Transaction code: ST22-Give the executed-on date when you tried to post the Supplier invoice and give execute.-Dump details: -Triggering application component: AP-ACC-METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CL_FAI2D_FCD_EXITS_PO=========CP    CL_FAI2D_FCD_EXITS_PO=========CM00A 93-      CL_FAI2D_FCD_EXITS_PO=>IF_FAI2D_FCD_EXITS~GET_CLEARING-METHOD       CL_FAI2D_FCD_CREATE_ITEMS_CLR=CP Title: Incorrect Header Position in Edit Time Sheet View in Self-Services
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-• The view of the Edit Time Sheet in the Home work center has a technical issue.-• The header 'Time Entries from ... to ...' overlaps with the calendar.-• The issue affects all users.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2408-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Navigate to Self-Services Overview.-Open the Edit Time Sheet view.-Observe the incorrect header position in UI. -Cause-The issue is a regression problem that was not reported earlier.-Resolution-The development team has identified the root cause. The code fix is planned to be implemented end of September 2024.
