Title: Fixed Assets Migration Error "No period defined for dd.mm.yyyy in fisc. year var. of company ABC set of books 1234"
Content: Symptom-Fixed Assets Migration Error "No period defined for dd.mm.yyyy in fisc. year var. of company ABC set of books 1234" (dd.mm.yyyy represents a date, ABC represents company ID, 1234 represents Set of Books ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity Migration of Material Valuation Data.-Click to migrate using the migration tool.-Create a migration unit and execute a Migration Step-by-Step.-In the simulate step, an error is raised as follows: No period defined for dd.mm.yyyy in fisc. year var. of company ABC set of books 1234 -Cause-The error occurs because the Auto Completion Method was maintained as "3 - Calculate Historically", hence the system tries to calculate the Depreciation Values from the Initial Capitalization Date.-Since there are Fixed Assets with Initial Capitalization Date with Fiscal Years that don't exist in the system the error is raised.-Resolution-In order to proceed with the migration review settings for Auto Complete method. -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the view overview.-Search and find the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select the option: Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration file.-Select Execute Migration.-Select the Fixed Asset Migration Object.-Select Process File.-Go to section "b" Convert Values.-Select either  '2' (Copy exclusive current year depreciation) or '4' (Copy inclusive current year depreciation) to be maintained. -Now complete the migration.-Here we can see that Settings for Auto Complete Method is set at 3 - Calculate Historically-Company 1 is only set for Fiscal Year 2024 Since there are Fixed Assets with Initial Capitalization Date with Fiscal Years that don't exist in the system the error is raised.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Migration, No period defined

Title: 500 Error when Releasing/Submitting a Sales Quote
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-During the Release/Submit of a Sales Quote document, the change does not go through due to a 500 Error (Dump).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Open the Sales Quotes view.-Find Sales Quote ABC (Where ABC Represents the Sales Quote ID).-Edit the Sales Quote and click on View All.-Click the Submit button.-After a few minutes, the system will show a 500 Error and the Submit action will not go through.-Checking in ST22, these are the details of the Dump: -Error: TSV_TNEW_BLOCKS_NO_ROLL_MEMORY-Terminated Program: /DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR==CP-ID: 2323F9330B5E46ABA5F5A58BE957945A-Short Text: No roll storage space of length 1093960 available for internal storage.-Active Calls/Events: -  16 METHOD       /DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR==CP    /DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR==CM011    63-     /DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR=>REPLACE_PLACEHOLDERS_IN_HTML-  15 METHOD       /DOC/CL_OM_DOR_BEFORE_SAVE====CP    /DOC/CL_OM_DOR_BEFORE_SAVE====CM001   286-     /DOC/CL_OM_DOR_BEFORE_SAVE=>IF_ESF_SRVMGR_BEFORE_SAVE~ON_BEFORE_SAVE-Application Notes: -The termination was triggered in function "tsvPageAdminResize"-of the SAP kernel, in line 2775 of the module- "//bas/804_REL/src/krn/abap/runt/abtsv.c#9".-The internal operation just processed is "TAPP".-Internal mode was started at 20240903154203.-Cause-A possible cause for this particular error is the incorrect usage of a placeholder tag in the E-Mail Subject. This causes an infinite loop consuming all the memory storage space available, causing the error.-Two examples of incorrect usage of Placeholder tags would be:-Inserting spaces inside the tag (E.g. "[ PLACEHOLDER ]" would be incorrect, while "[PLACEHOLDER]" is expected).-Using an invalid tag (E.g. "[TEXT]" when "TEXT" does not correspond to a path in the XML of the document).-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Form Template Maintenance View.-Find the relevant Sales Quote Template.-Highlight it and click the Actions button.-Select the Maintain E-mail Subject option.-Correct the Placeholder usage in the E-mail Subject.-After correcting the usage of placeholder tags in the E-mail subject, the Sales Quote can be Submitted.-See Also-3089571 - How to create HTML email templates, Document names and email subjects based on the respective XML Root-Keywords-Sales Quote, Dump, Error, 500, TSV_TNEW_BLOCKS_NO_ROLL_MEMORY, E-mail, Email, Mail, Placeholder, Tag, XML

Title: External Customer Invoice Request Inconsistent
Content: Symptom-External Customer Invoice Request is inconsistent due to following error message:-Error: Sales data for product 123 missing for sales org. and distr. channel (Where 123 represents the Product or Service ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select Invoice Requests view-In the drop-down menu, select All Invoice Requests-Search for External Customer Invoice Request ABC (Where ABC represents the External Customer Invoice Request ID)-Click in Check-The following error is shown:-Error: Sales data for product 123 missing for sales org. and distr. channel-Cause-The error "Sales data for product 123 missing for sales org. and distr. channel" might occur due to the following reasons:-The Service or Product ID are currently under status Blocked.-The Sales Organization and Distribution Channel under the Sales Tab in the Product/Service Master Data are under status Blocked.-The creation of the External Customer Invoice Request has occurred while one of the above options were set to Blocked.-Resolution-To solve this issue, please make sure that the status of the Product/Service ID are set to "Active" and the respective Sales Organization and Distribution Channel are also set to "Active" and correctly maintained under the Sales tab in the Product/Service Master Data.-Once the above data is correctly maintained, send an update to the payload by setting the Action Code as 2 or 4 so the system can clear the inconsistency in the UI.-Keywords-Webservice, Payload, error, not maintained, missing, invoice.

Title: How is the Person Responsible Derived for an Intercompany Project?
Content: Symptom-The Person Responsible/ Project Manager for the intercompany project ICPXYZ is employee ABC. You wonder why this employee is assigned as the project's project manager (ICPXYZ represents an intercompany project ID; ABC represents an employee ID/name) as the user neither created the connected sales order, nor the initial purchase order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Project Management work center go to the Project view. -Find project ICPXYZ in the table.-Underneath, in the Details section you notice employee ABC appearing in the Person Responsible field. -Cause-The intercompany project's person responsible is always the reporting line manager of the intercompany sales order's Employee Responsible derived from the purchase order's Buyer Responsible.-Resolution-To identify the intercompany project's sales order-open the project and go to the Sales Tracking tab. -Click on the sales order ID. -On the very top of the sales order you notice the Employee Responsible field where employee ABC appears. -To identify the Buyer Responsible of the  initial Purchase Order: -In the sales order press View All and go to the Document flow tab. -Take note of the Purchase Order DEF (DEF represents the purchase order ID). -Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center and here navigate to the Purchase Orders view. -Find and open purchase order DEF. -Here, under General Information (Overview or General tab) you'll find employee DEF entered as Buyer Responsible. -To identify the responsible buyer's reporting line manager-In the Buyer Responsible field click on employee DEF.-In the next screen, under Organizational data find the Reports To field. Here, employee ABC is maintained. -Keywords-intercompany project manager, person responsible

Title: SAF- T Report - Extension of Additional sections of XML file feature is not available in scope.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to extend the additional sections of XML file for SAF- T Report, but it is not in current scope through the standard implementation in the Business byDesign system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select SAF-T Report under Periodic Tasks.-Click New Create Run.-Enter all the mandatory details. Click Save or Save and Close.-In General Ledger – SAF-T screen, select the run you created from the list and click on Generate (It generates the XML file once Process is successfully completed) or action can be scheduled using the schedule button. You can choose Generate to generate the XML.-Click View Results.-Under the General tab, the system displays all the data and settings you made when defining the report run.-Under the Attachments tab, the system lists the generated XML files.-On the View Results screen, Application Log displays errors that indicate the success or failure of any action that is scheduled.-Issue: You want to add additional sections of XML file which is actually not a part of the current scope.-Cause-As per the pre-defined scope in the system, it would actually require a header section in the XML file, and this is generated from the standard implementation.-So, to add the additional sections of the XML file in the SAF- T Report, initially this should be scoped in the system. But this enablement is not a part of current scope.-Resolution-If you are trying to add some additional fields to the XML file through BADI but as per the existing system setup, there is no provision to add new fields.-You can only update the existing fields which is possible via BADI. -Please note: Adding the new fields in the XML cannot be done through BADI.-For such new feature requests, please use the Influence forum:  https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 -See Also-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2515160"-Documentation link: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2e30d84496214461ad763692c3a0b4a5/bfd13d243d874fa1999c566f967fa948.html#prerequisites-Keywords-SAF- T Report, XML File, BADI, General Ledger, Extension fields.

Title: Customer Invoice Cannot be Released Due To a Dump
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***      -A Customer Invoice XYZ cannot be released due to a dump (XYZ represents the Invoice ID).XYZ-The error message "Exception 'CX_SXMLP' caught by class 'CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER'" is displayed.-The issue arises due to an unrecognized character in the Customer Information on the General tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Open Customer Invoice XYZ.-Click on the Release button.-The system dump occurs.-ST22-Application Information:-Termination: Exception 'CX_SXMLP' caught by class 'CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER' [CL_SXMLP_DATA_ST==============CM005:52]-Triggering application component: BC-ESI-WS-ABA-  Exception chain:- 1. Info: Cannot convert character sets for one or more characters, CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE, Program:/1SAI/SASCB5F0D9475E1A83F2676=XT, Include:/1SAI/SASCB5F0D9475E1A83F2676=XT, Position:37- 2. Info: An error occurred during serialization in the simple transformation program /1SAI/SASCB5F0D9475E1A83F2676, CX_ST_SERIALIZATION_ERROR, Program:CL_SXMLP_DATA_ST==============CP, Include:CL_SXMLP_DATA_ST==============CM005, Position:22- 3. Info: XSLT exception, CX_SXMLP, Program:CL_SXMLP_DATA_ST==============CP, Include:CL_SXMLP_DATA_ST==============CM005, Position:52- 4. Info: An error of type 'CX_SXMLP' has been caught. Error text reads: 'XSLT exception', CM_SPAF_CTRL_RUNTIME_ERROR, Program:SAPMHTTP, Include:, Position:0-Cause-The error occurs because the document contains a character that is not part of the code page.-In our example of Customer Invoice XYZ, the error is raised due to a symbol e.g.  🏠 or 🚚  in the Customer Information on the General tab.-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Open Customer Invoice XYZ.-Navigate to the General tab.-Select the Customer Information sub tab.-Remove the symbol.-Click on Save.-Now, the Customer Invoice XYZ can be released.-See Also-Keywords-Invoice; Release, Dump, CX_SXMLP, Unrecognized Character, Customer Invoicing, Code Page, Customer Information, CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE, CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER .

Title: Open Production Order displayed in Removal screen
Content: Symptom-During creation of a New Removal Task by product you will notice that system is displaying the Production Orders which are  not Finished(i.e. Production Orders in Preparation, In Process, Started).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter-2. Go to Common Tasks:New Removal view.-3. Search by Product Ex: 123(where 123 is Product ID)-you will be able to see Open Production Orders-Cause-As part of the flexibility allowed in the production floor, production orders that are Not Finished are displayed in the Removal Screen.-You can set up the task priorly with reference to an order.-The task will complete when there is stock of the product in the production floor.- -Once the production is completed you can move it out - -Note: Unless there is stock in the production floor you will not be able to confirm the task .- Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-Keywords-Removal Task, Stock Overview, Internal Logistics, Production Order, Output product, production floor

Title: Multiple Purchase Orders being linked to Supplier Invoice after Distributing Additional Costs
Content: Symptom-A Supplier Invoice is created with the Item Type as Additional Cost Debit Item, and an attempt is made to distribute the cost among other Invoices or Credit Memos by entering the Purchase Order ID; however, this adds an unwanted Purchase Order to the Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order common task.-Add all the relevant information (such as Supplier, External Document ID, Invoice Date).-Navigate to Items tab.-Change the Item type to Additional Cost Debit Item.-Add the information abou the item (such as Description, Tax Code, Quantity, Net Price).-Select Cost Distribution sub-tab.-Click on the link Distribute among other invoices or credit memos.-Search for a Purchase Order ID.-Click on Distribute.-Click on OK.-Navigate to General tab.-In General tab see that the there is some unwanted Purchase Orders added to this Invoice.-Cause-This function is used to distribute the cost among the Supplier Invoice, this is why is selecting all the Invoice items, since not all the items in this document are from the same Purchase Order, the system will add all the Purchase Orders IDs in the New Supplier Invoice.-To exclude lines from other Purchase Orders during cost distribution, directly search by Invoice ID or Item ID and select only the necessary items.-Resolution-System behavior-Keywords-Distribute among other invoices or credit memos, Supplier Invoice, Credit Memos, Purchase Order, Cost Distribution

Title: Error "No user found with alias '<userID>' (format: unspecified)" when trying to log in using Single Sign-On
Content: Symptom-When trying to log in using Single Sign-On the following error is displayed:-No user found with alias <userID>' (format: unspecified)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Try to log in using SSO-Error appears-Cause-This error typically occurs when the Business User information stored in the Identity Provider (IDP) does not match the user information maintained in SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Verify the information in the Identity Provider (IDP) and confirm that it matches the information maintained in SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Alias, IDP, SSO, Single Sign-On, Identity Provider

Title: Error "Removal of material for logistics area not possible; Requested quantity exceeds the available quantity in the logistics area"
Content: Symptom-When creating New Removal, following error occurs:--Removal of material for logistics area not possible--Requested quantity exceeds the available quantity in the logistics area-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Work center-Select New Removal view under Common Tasks list.-Search for the desired product ID.-Select the line item and maintain the removal quantity for this entry.-Click on Request Removal button.-Above errors occur.-Cause-In Projected Material Flow, search for relevant product ID and Site ID, all on-hand stock have been allocated to the warehouse request and the available stock is zero.-The Warehouse task which is for the same product under the same logistic area is in unfinished status.-Resolution-Finish the relevant warehouse task then the stock will be consumed.-Keywords- Request Removal, New Removal, Material, Logistics Area, Requested Quantity, Available Quantity

Title: Process Communication Error From PurchaseOrderProcessing to SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn occurs: "Mandatory List Price missing"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-In an Intercompany Sales Order scenario, a Process Communication Error has happened between Purchase Order and Sales Order. When checking in the backend, you see an erroneous XI message from PurchaseOrderProcessing to SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn with error "Update of sales order not possible; change is not allowed: Mandatory List Price missing. List price must be maintained or a pric"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In SRT_MONI, you find the following XI Message for the Process Communication Error: -Sender: PurchaseOrderProcessing-Receiver: SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn-Error: Update of sales order not possible; change is not allowed: Mandatory List Price missing. List price must be maintained or a pric-Restart does not solve the issue.-Cause-One of the reasons for this error to be raised is when an item of type "Expense - Time and Material (Project)" or "Service - Time and material (Project)" is added to the Sales Order after it is already Released/In Process. -This happens because once an A2A Sales Order is Released, adding items of those two types is not allowed, even if the maintained Price List is valid. This can only be accomplished when the Sales Order is with the "In Preparation" status.-Resolution-In order to solve this issue, the item(s) added to the Purchase Order after the Sales Order has been Released need to be cancelled. Afterwards, the stuck XI Message can be cancelled.-See Also-2930057 - Process Communication Error for Intercompany Sales Order regarding Mandatory List Price Missing-1753786 - You Receive the Error Message : "Item XX : Mandatory List Price missing" in an Intercompany Scenario-Keywords-Sales Order, Purchase Order, Intercompany, Price List, Missing, XI Message, Error, Erroneous, Stuck, SRT_MONI, SESFTS, Backend, Restart, Cancel, Service, Time and Material, Expense, Project.

Title: Approver unable to approve or reject due to Error:' Action not enabled'
Content: Symptom-Approver is unable to reject or approve the purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-After the Purchase order was sent for approval, changes were made, such as the respective project being closed.-Resolution-Ask approver to send for revision and then click on check button on order, you will see errors if any-For example: error is displayed "Status of project task XXX (not 'Started' or 'Released')-So first release the project  task and take action on this Purchase order, then close the project again.-See Also-2206101 - Purchase Order Withdrawal From Approval is Disabled or Greyed out-2216473 - Error message received "Action not Enabled" while Approving Goods & Service Receipt -Keywords-Cannot reject; unable to reject; Cannot approve; unable to approve;

Title: SAP Collaboration Window is not uploading PDF invoices after 30 Minutes inactivity
Content: Symptom-The SAP Collaboration window stops working after 30 Minutes inactivity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-After logging into the SAP Collaboration Window its possible to upload a supplier invoice successfully.-Now, after 30 Minutes, the following invoice is not processed anymore.-Cause-This is Standard behaviour of the application, as this is related to updating the ICM cache for 30-minute active users only.-Resolution-Ensure that the Collaboration window is not inactive for more then 30 Minutes.-Keywords-Collaboration Window, Supplier Invoice upload, Invoice Scan.

Title: Desired country is missing in the nationality field of personal data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When edit the personal data of an employee, desired country like Kosovo is missing in the nationality field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration -> Employees.-Choose any employee.-Edit Personnel File.-Go to Personal Data.-In nationality field, desired country cannot be selected.-Cause-The country is not maintain in Activity County/Region. Before a country can be used in the tenant, it should be maintained in County/Region.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration -> Overview.-Search for Countries/Regions.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Edit Countries/Regions. -Add Row.-Maintain the entries for the new country.-Save.-Keywords-Missing Country, Nationality, Personal Data, Countries/Regions.

Title: Data workbench error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***  -The BO supplied with the message does not match the BO of the current service call; within a service call, it is not allowed to raise messages for other BOs-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-There are many ways such a dump can occur. The steps will be made available by the affected customer.-In the dump the script and line number will be provided in Active Calls section of the dump-Double click on the custom script from the stack to view-Cause-Custom logic is attempting to raise an error for a BO that is not part of the current service call-Resolution-If it is desired to have the message attempted to be raised at this point, then it will need to be placed in another script suited to the process at that time - the partner will be required to determine this.

Title: Revenue Recognition Run for Multi Customer Projects - Error Message - Account determination missing for item type Deferred Sales Revenue
Content: Symptom-The revenue recognition run for multi-customer projects finishes with the error message 'Account determination missing for item type Deferred Sales Revenue'. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition view. -Press New and choose Revenue Recognition.-Enter all mandatory data.-In the Sales Object Type field select Multi-Customer Project,-Either leave the Projects field empty or select a specific multi-customer project. -Start the run.-The run finishes with the error message 'Account determination missing for item type Deferred Sales Revenue'. -Cause-In the Account Determination fine tune activity there is a setting missing for all customer account determination groups. -Multi-Customer Projects can be relevant for different projects, associated with different account determination groups. Therefore, a setting without specified customer account determination group is necessary. -Resolution-Access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity. -Go to Account Determination and select Sales. -Select the relevant accounting determination profile. -Navigate to the Revenue Recognition - Deferrals tab. -Press Add Row.-Select a G/L account in the Deferred Net Value field but leave the Account Determination Group for Customers field empty.-Press Save and close. -The revenue recognition run is now able to process revenue postings for multi-customer projects. -Keywords-multi-customer project, account determination missing for item type Deferred Sales Revenue, deferred revenue

Title: Field Changed Product Quantity is Disabled During Change of Stock
Content: Symptom-During Change of Stock, in second step, field Changed Product Quantity is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Access common task Change of Stock.-Select ABC (ABC represents site ID) for Site.-Click Add Row, maintain DEF (DEF represents product ID) for Product ID, click Next.-In the second step, select a row, field Changed Product Quantity is Disabled.-Cause-Since the inventory of product DEF in site ABC are all serial inventory, during Change of Stock the field Changed Product Quantity cannot be maintained directly.-Resolution-Maintain serial numbers that need to be changed in the second step of Change of Stock.-Keywords-Change of Stock, Changed Product Quantity, Disabled

Title: Not able to End Validity of Org Unit "SYSGEN-000000000000X"
Content: Symptom-How to end validity of org unit SYSGEN-000000000000X (SYSGEN is standard Org Unit ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Find and locate the desired org unit ID which starts with "SYSGEN-000000000000X"-Choose Edit-Choose Edit Org Unit-Select End validity.-Not able to end validity of Org Unit "SYSGEN-000000000000X"-Cause-Delete Org Unit-Resolution-Follow below steps to Delete Org Unit ,-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Find and locate the desired org unit ID which starts with "SYSGEN-000000000000X"-Select org unit ID-Choose Edit-Select effective from date.-Choose Edit org unit -Choose delete-Select Save-Choose Activate -Select Activate org structure -Keywords-SYSGEN, unable to end validity of org unit, Replication shows org unit data which is no more valid

Title: Customer Return is Not Created as a Follow up From the Inbound Delivery Document
Content: Symptom-The Customer Return document was not created as a follow up from the Inbound Delivery Notification document.-In addtion, the error "Referenced customer return not found (Inbound delivery EDF)" is being displayed when filtering for the Inbound Delivery EDF in the Source Documents View. -(Where EDF represents the Inbound Delivery ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to the Inbound Deliveries View.-Filter for All Inbound Deliveries by Selection.-In the search field, search for the Inbound Delivery EDF (Where EDF represents the Inbound Delivery ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Inbound Delivery is released, however no Customer Return document was created.-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Source Documents View.-Filter for All Source Documents.-In the search field, search for the Inbound Delivery EDF.-The error message "Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery EDF)" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The Customer Return is not created as a follow up from the Inbound Delivery document because the configuration for automatic determination of Party Roles for the Return document is not being properly maintained in the system.-Therefore, as the system cannot automatically identify the Party Roles to create the Customer Return document the error "Referenced customer return not found" is displayed in the Source Documents View for the Inbound Delivery document.-Resolution-Kindly ensure that the set up to automatically determine Parties Roles for the Return documents is properly maintained in the system.- See Also-Kindly check the below documentations for further reference regarding the set up for the Party Roles determination for Sales Documents in the system:-Party Role Determination in a Sales Document -2852861 - Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-Keywords-customer return, inbound delivery, referenced customer return not found, create, creation

Title: Restrict Material Master Data Based on Company Level
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to restrict the material master data based on company?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-This is standard system behavior. It is impossible to restrict the material master data based on company level in most cases. When edit the access restriction of material view under work center like Product Development or Product Data, the access context is NONE - <None>, which means that the read access cannot be restricted and the write access can be only set as No Access or Unrestricted.-This is only possible for the financial aspects. In the work center Inventory Valuation or Audit, Company based restrictions can be applied for material.-Keywords-Restrict material master data, Restrictions based on company level

Title: Can Not Add Attachments in The Charge/Credit
Content: Symptom-When trying to add an attachment in the Charge/Credit for a Supplier it is observed that the Add button is greyed out. The same scenario applies to the Customer Accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work Center.-Go to Supplier Accounts View.-Search for the Supplier XYZ (where XYZ refers to the name of the supplier).-Select the Supplier XYZ.-Click on View.-Open an existing Charge/Credit document.-Click View All.-Go to Attachments tab.-The Add button is grey out.-Cause-Currently, it is not possible to add attachments in the Charge/Credit documents after it is created/posted. It is only possible to add attachments during the creation of the document.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-add, attachment, charge, credit, supplier, customer, grey, gray, account, suppliers

Title: Unable to Locate the Business Residence Field in the Material Valuation Collection Using OData Service
Content: Symptom-OData service which is created for Material Valuation with a view to obtain prices changes per location/business residence but unable to locate the Business Residence field in the Material Valuation collection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Under Input and Output Management view, select OData Services subview.-In the drop-down menu, select Custom OData Services.-Select service Material Valuation.-Choose Edit button.-Under the OData Service, Business Residence is missing.-Cause-The MaterialLedgerAccountItem node is missing in the OData service for Material Valuation.-Resolution-The material/business residence fall under the node MaterialLedgerAccountItem, so add this node and modify the OData call to take this node into account.-You can refer below blog for creating or updating OData Services:-OData Example: Create and Update Product Data in SAP Business ByDesign | SAP Blogs-See Also-OData Example: Create and Update Product Data in SAP Business ByDesign | SAP Blogs-Keywords-OData Service, Material Valuation, Business residence, creating or updating OData Services.

Title: Error Message Asset val.view : Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount When Posting Business Transaction for Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-When trying to execute a fixed asset acquisition posting, such as a individual material transfer, a manual write down or write up, a supplier invoice or a goods receipt the following errors are raised, either directly when trying to post or through an exception in supplier invoice documents*.-"An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset ABC"-"Asset ABC val.view X: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount"-"Error occurred while determining values to be posted for fixed asset ABC"-"Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated"-(ABC represents a Fixed Asset ID, X represents a fixed asset valuation view).-*After accepting the exception the business transaction is sent to accounting which then causes it to appear as unposted source document in the General Ledger, reporting the same errors again. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When creating manual fixed asset postings: -In the Fixed Assets work center go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for Fixed Asset ABC.-Press Manual Postings and select the respective transaction, for example, Complete Transfer of Individual Material.-Fill all the mandatory data and press Post or Simulate. -The errors "An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset ABC"-"Asset ABC val.view X: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount"-"Error occurred while determining values to be posted for fixed asset ABC"-"Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated/posted " appear. -When trying to post a supplier invoice distributed to an individual material: -In the Supplier Invoicing work center, in the Invoices and Credit Memos  find the supplier invoice in question.-Press Post. -The supplier invoice is not posted but in Exception status.-In the Exceptions tab you find the error "An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset ABC ; Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Asset ABC val.view X: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount". -Accept the exception.-The supplier invoice now appears as unposted source document in the General Ledger reporting the same error. -Cause-A Revaluation posting has been generated for one or more, but not all valuation views of fixed asset ABC.-Due to a code change in SAP Business ByDesign 2405 a verification check has been introduced which triggers the said error message when the acquisition cost is not synchronised between all the asset's valuation views. -In the example of fixed asset ABC, the revaluation was posted for valuation view A but not for valuation view X. -You can check this situation as follows: -In the Fixed Assets work center go to the  Fixed Assets view.-Search and open Fixed Asset ABC's Values tab.-Select valuation view X.-In the Book Values sub-tab, take note of the total closing balance.-Then select Valuation View A. You notice, the total closing balance is different to the balance for valuation view X.-Navigate to the Journal tab of Valuation View A.-There is a Revaluation Journal Entry Voucher that was posted only to Valuation View X.-The mentioned code change is being reviewed currently. -Resolution-As long as the code change is in place, send on a case to technical support and request and permit SAP to post the respective business transaction by bypassing the valuation view acquisition cost verification check*.-*Alternatively, and only if it suits your business needs, you can create revaluation postings for all valuation views of fixed asset ABC and manually synchronize the asset's acquisition cost this way before posting the business transaction.-Keywords-complete transfer, individual material, valuation view, acquisition cost

Title: Tax Amount is not being summed in the Net Value of the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When creating a Purchase Order, the expectation is that the Tax be summed up in the Total Net Value. However, only the items' value is being added, and not the tax.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant document and open it.-In the View All navigate to Items tab.-Select Taxes sub-tab.-See that Tax Amount is not reflecting in the Total Net Value.-Resolution-System is working as expected.--Since the Purchase Order is not an accounting relevant document the value displayed is the Net Value, meaning that is the value without the tax. -The tax will be only displayed in the Supplier Invoice and Journal Entry (that is the entry in the accounting), in which the value displayed will be the Gross Amount, that is the value of the Purchase Order (Net Value) with the Tax Amount summed.-Gross means the total or whole amount, whereas net means what remains from the whole after certain deductions are made. -Keywords-Purchase Order, Tax Amount, Tax, Total Net Value

Title: DFV Result Error : Logistics Execution Requisition item schedule line does not exist
Content: Symptom-When performing Data Verification flow run for Logistics Execution Request with Outbound Delivery Request for stock transfer scenario below error occurs:--Outbound Delivery Request cannot process an update sent by a Logistics Execution Request --Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Data Verification Results View.-Show Open Results with Differences, find the respective document-Cause-The Data Flow Verification Results gives above Process Communication Error if ship-to-location is blocked.-Resolution-Turn on the Ship-to-location feature and perform the data flow validation.-Keywords-DFV, Data flow verification results, ,Stock transfer, Outbound Delivery Request cannot process an update sent by a Logistics Execution Request

Title: Error: 'Character set UTF-8 not valid' When Uploading a Bank Statement.
Content: Symptom-An attempt to upload a Bank Statement results in an error message: 'Character set UTF-8 not valid'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center. -Go to Bank Statements view. -Click "New" button > Bank Statement Upload. -Fill with the all required parameters.-Click "Add" button > File. -Import the desired file. -Click "Start File Upload" button. -The following error message will be displayed:-'Character set UTF-8 not valid'.-Cause-One possible reason is that a file not encoded in UTF-8 is being uploaded.-Resolution-To check the encoding of the file, open it using the tool Notepad++.-The encoding is displayed at the bottom right of the task bar, for example, "ISO ANSI" or another format. Using the same tool, the encoding can be converted to UTF-8 by navigating to Menu -> Encoding -> Convert to UTF-8. Save the file and upload it again into the Business ByDesign system.-It is recommended to verify whether files are being received from different banks or from the same bank through different methods, as this may result in a different file encoding. Note that the system allows only one encoding per import format.-Keywords-Bank Statement, UTF-8, Upload, Character set UTF-8 not valid, File

Title: BTM Tasks are Not Being Created to Notify the Processor of the Service Request or Service Order That the Due Dates are Overdue
Content: Symptom-The BTM task is not being created to notify the processor of the documents when the Due Dates of a Service Request or Service Order document is overdue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk Work Center.-Select the Service Requests View.-Select New button.-In the dropdown, Select New Service Request.-Fill the mandatory fields.-When any of the Due Dates are expired, no BTM task is created to notify the Processor.-Cause-The BTM tasks are not created because the Service Level and Service Level determination were not maintained in the system in order to notify the processor when any of the Due Dates are expired in a Service Request or Service Order document.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps in order to review and properly set up the Service Level and Service Level determination for the Service Request or Service Order document:-1. Select the 3 checkboxes for the Business Task Management for Field Service and Repair -Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search for Business Task Management for Field Service and Repair.-Select Open Button.- In the Due Date Escalation for Service Orders (3) section, mark the checkbox for the following options:-- Arrival at Customer Overdue: Check Service Order <Identifier of the Service Order>, <Name of the buyer party>, <Identifier of the Service Level Objective>-- Completion Overdue: Check Service Order <Identifier of the Service Order>, <Name of the buyer party>, <Identifier of the Service Level Objective>-- Initial Response Overdue: Check Service Order <Identifier of the Service Order>, <Name of the buyer party>, <Identifier of the Service Level Objective>-These are required to be selected in order to create the BTM task for when any Due Date are Overdue. -2. Create a Service Level in the system-Go to the Service Entitlements Work Center.-Go to the Service Level View.-Select New Button.-In the dropdown, Select Service Level.-Fill the mandatory field in the General tab.-Navigate to the Reactions Times tab.-In the Milestone section, Select Add Row button.-In the Details for Milestones section, Select Add Row.-In this sections, it will be possible to define which Milestone will be created, determine the document in which the Milestone will be applied and also determine the times for each Milestone based on the priority.-The following Milestones will be available:-- Due Date for Arrival at Customer-- Due Date for Completion-- Due Date for Initial Response-The Milestones can be applied for Service Orders or Service Requests documents.-Note: If the Processor of the Service Order or Service Request document is required to be notified when the Due Dates are overdue, then it will be required to fill the checkbox 'Alert When Overdue'.-In addition, to properly set the Service Level in the system it will be required to fill the information of the Operating Hours tab. -After all the information is properly maintained, the Service Level can be saved and activated in the system.-3. Set the Configuration in the Determine Service Levels common task-Go to the Service Entitlements Work Center.-Go to the Service Level View.-Select the Determine Service Levels common task.-Select Add Row button.-In the Service Level column, Select <Add>.-In the Enter Value field, select the Service Level ID created.-Select Ok.-Select Save and Activate.-The Service Level created should be applied for the new Service Order or Service Request documents, according to the type of document that was previously maintained during the Service Level creation.-In the Determine Service Levels common task, it is also possible to set the parameters which will be entered in the document that can determine Service Level. This can be configure in case different Service Levels are needed in the system.-After all the above configuration is set, the BTM task should be properly created in the Inbox View to notify the processor when any of the Due Dates are expired in a Service Request or Service Order document.-Keywords-service request, service order, btm tasks, overdue, task, processor, notify, due dates

Title: Inbound Delivery Document Number not getting generated in correct sequence
Content: Symptom-While creating an inbound delivery document it is noticed that the document number id that is being created is not in correct sequence.-For example :-Previous created inbound delivery document is A-Next created inbound delivery document is C-Ideally the next created inbound delivery document should be B.-(Here A,B,C refers to Inbound delivery document )-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work center-Choose Third-Party Inbound Deliveries -Search for document id's with prefix name*-It is noticed that some document number id's have been skipped.-Cause-The chance that a number is being missed could be caused by a change in the format of the number range or by a problem with the system buffer, which occurs when numbers are in the system buffer but another application launches in parallel. The number range selects this unused number and uses it later on when a new document is created.-Resolution-The system takes into account a chronological order while generating the Inbound Delivery ID, however it will be within the specified range.-See Also-2675078 - Gaps in Number Range of Outbound Delivery Numbers-3421070-Sales Order Numbering Gap-Keywords-Inbound delivery , Number range, Number range format, Inbound delivery document

Title: Exception about Purchase Order or Third-Party Purchase Order Item reference
Content: Symptom-Error message received while posting the document with Supplier Invoice with reference to a Third-Party Purchase Order or Purchase Order: "The item does not have a reference to a purchase order or third-party purchase order. Go to the exception and check whether the item should have a reference to order".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant document and open in.-Navigate to Items tab.-Click on Check.-See the error message: "Item ABC: The item does not have a reference to a purchase order or third-party purchase order. Go to the exception and check whether the item should have a reference to order XYZ." (ABC represents the Item ID and XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID).-Navigate to Exceptions tab.-See the message: The item does not have a reference to a purchase order or third-party purchase order. Go to the exception and check whether the item should have a reference to order XYZ. ; The item does not have a reference to a purchase order or third-party purchase order. Go to the exception and check whether the item should have a reference to order XYZ.-Cause-It seems like, the Purchase Order reference was not properly stored on the Invoice screen, hence the error message got triggered.-In this case a refresh of Purchase Order details on the Invoice screen is necessary.-Resolution-To correct this please follow the below steps:-Go to the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Click on Edit.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the affected line item.-Click on Remove.-Select Add Row.-Enter the Purchase Order ID and Purchase Order Item ID.-Hit enter.-Now system refresh the Purchase Order details.-Click on check.-See that the Invoice is Ready for Posting.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Exception, Purchase Order, Third-Party Purchase Order

Title: Time Account Balances report (HCMTLMU06_Q0001) only delivers data if there are postings on this day/selected period.
Content: Symptom-Regardless of the selection, the Time Account Balances report (HCMTLMU06_Q0001) shows only a balance in case there is a posting on the key-date.-Your expectation is to see the remaining balance for all employees regardless if there is a posting on the keydate or not.-Example:-An employee XYZ has a specific amount of days remaining leave on a specific date, but no posting entry on that specific date.-In the Time Account Balances report (HCMTLMU06_Q0001), if you select this Employee, you cannot call the report.-If you select a period larger than this, the values are displayed correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Time Account Balance Report (HCMTLMU06_Q0001) will only show employees who have a posting on the specific 'Date From/To' filtered dates. This is the expected behavior of the report.-Resolution-If the Date From/To selection dates are wide enough i.e. 1.1.2020 - 31.12.2020, then on the basis that most employees will have had activity on the account, the balance should appear.-However there is another data source HCMTLMU02 that can be used to create a new report which might meet your requirements better.  The data source can be found via the following path: Business Analytics >Design Data Sources and look for 'Employee Time Accounts'.-Keywords-daily subtotal, Time Account Type, TypeType, and the KeyFigure Daily

Title: Inconsistent Invoice Request Due to Error 'Postal Code Region Mismatch'
Content: Symptom-Sales order invoice request has Inconsistent status with an error stating "Postal Code Region Mismatch".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Filter for Inconsistent Invoice Requests.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of invoice request).-Click on Check button.-Issues are found. Issue Description: Postal Code Region Mismatch.-Cause-The integration scenario (External Tax Determination + Vertex) is not supported.-Example: An external tax determination rule for state CA (in country US) is set up, where jurisdiction rule is set as ST (Ship To). Additionally Vertex activated in the system.-In the sales order, the sales unit is in State/Country=CA/US and ship to country is in Brazil. This triggers the external tax determination and leads to consider Brazil, but with Vertex this will not work.-Resolution-The external tax determination rule set up in sales order must be removed, and the errors Redetermined in Invoice Request view.-Follow below steps to remove the external tax determination rule:-Navigate to the Sales Orders workcenter.-Go into the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID).-Open the document.-Go to the Items tab.-For each Item on the Sales Order, follow the steps 6 and 7.-Go to the Taxes sub tab.-Locate and unmark the External Tax Rate Determination checkbox.-Click on Save.-Now, the errors in the Invoice Request view must be redetermined. To do that, follow the steps:-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go into the Invoice Requests view.-Filter for Inconsistent Invoice Requests.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click on Check.-Click on Redetermine All.-The errors will be cleared.-Keywords-Postal Code Region Mismatch; External Tax Determination; Vertex; Taxes; Sales Order Invoice Request

Title: How The system Calculates a Percentage of The Taxes For Price Components like Packaging, Insurance Charges and Freight
Content: Symptom-You expect that for example the the freight costs should only be calculated at the overall item level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order ID XYZ.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Pricing tab.-You do not see any possibility to have different tax rates separately for the different price components like Freight.-Cause-When you add the header level price component, the tax amount will be distributed across the items.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Keywords-Freight; Taxes; Shipment; Charges; Price Component;

Title: Error 'Previous Action Failed; Inconsistent Data Cannot Be Saved' Occurs When Creating Cash Payments Through Web Service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn
Content: Symptom-Create an on account incoming cash payment ABC(ABC represents the ID of the payment) through web service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn. Error 'Previous action failed; inconsistent data cannot be saved' occurs when requesting. No cash payment is cretaed.-Check the upload payload and no inconsistency is found. It is expected that an on account payment ABC will be created to the account of the entered BusinessPartnerID DEF(DEF represents the BusinessPartnerID in the payload).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Request through web service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn in SOAPUI to create an on account incoming cash payment.-After requesting, no cash payment is created.-And receive an error message 'Previous action failed; inconsistent data cannot be saved'.-Cause-One of the reasons that this error could occur while creating an incoming cash payment via webservice is that there is only one credit memo open in the customer account.-Resolution-Make sure there is not just one open credit memo.-Alternatively, it is possible to propose a clearing for this credit memo through manual clearing first. Then this credit memo would not be picked while creating an incoming cash payment.-Steps as follows:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Find the Customer Account DEF(DEF represents Customer Account).-Choose the Customer Account and Choose View.-Go to Trade Receivables view and then to Invoices/Payments Subview.-Select the uncleared credit memo and click 'Clear Manually'.-Enter the required data and save.-Keywords-Web Service, ManageCashPaymentOrderIn, Incoming Cash Payment

Title: Create Sales Order Is Not Enabled In The Sales Order
Content: Symptom-In Sales Order the Create Project button is not enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Sales Orders work center.-Choose Sales Orders view.-Find and choose sales order XYZ (Represents the sales order ID).-Choose Edit button.-Choose View All button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Here you can see the Create Project button is not enabled.   -Cause-Create Project button will be enabled for the following mentioned conditions:-A sales order can be linked to the a single project task or single project check the sales order is linked to the project task. You can check this in the sales order items tab, check if the Project Task field is assigned to another project task. If it is linked to the project task the Create Project button will not be enabled. If the project task is removed form the project task field Create Project button will be enabled.-The Product Type should be Service then only the Create Project button button is enabled.-In the intercompany process system automatically generates the Sales Order and the Intercompany Project with status In preparation and In planning for the partner company out of intercompany Purchase Order, the Sales Order is system generated and it is automatically liked to the system generated  Intercompany Project hence the Create Project button is not enabled.- In this case the customer was using intercompany scenario hence the Create Project button is not enabled.-Resolution-This is current system design.

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-System throws below error in the Purchase order with the status "follow up document created":-G/L Account information missing / Cost center missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-1. Title: Consignment Scenario: Outbound Delivery is Not Created for Sales Order Issued for the Customer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The Sales Order ABC is created and released with Items of Item Type Product-Consignment Issue. The system did not create the Outbound Delivery after the Sales Order was released (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Find and select Order ID: ABC. The document has the Status: In Process.-Click on Edit and then View All.-Go to the Items tab.-You can see for all Items that the Allocation status is Allocated, and Item Type is: Product-Consignment issue.-Further, the Delivery Status is: Not relevant.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see no other document has been created. -Cause-Scoping status for the Business Process Variant Type OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_PROCESSING_FOR_CONSIGNMENT was showing as "OFF" in the Back-end. Ideally it should be "Productive" as it has been scoped.-The status can be checked by following the below steps:-Logon to Backend.-Enter the transaction MDRS.-Select Metadata Repository option on the Left side menu.-Select Process Component.-Enter OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_PROCESSING.-Click on ODP_FOR_CONSIGNMENT under Business Process Variant Types.-On the right side, Scoping is OFF.-Resolution-Forward the incident to Dev team AP-ODP-OD to activate the scoping for BPVT  ODP_FOR_CONSIGNMENT with report MDRS_RTLC_SWITCH_BOARD in the backend.-Once the scoping is activated in the backend, ask the customer to cancel the existing Sales Order and create a New Sales Order.-See Also- 3056607 - Consignment Scenario: Outbound Delivery is Not Created for Sales Order Issued for the Customer-Keywords-Consignment; Stock; Sales Order; Outbound Delivery; Invoice Request; Consignment issue; Product-Consignment issue;

Title: Not Being Able to Assign the Work Center WoC MMA_EXPANDREIMBMANAGEMENT to an User
Content: Symptom-You are trying to access the work center MMA_EXPANDREIMBMANAGEMENT for a specific User, however the system shows a warning message and the work center is not assigned at all.-Warning message:-View MMA_EXPANDREIMBMANAGEMENT can't be assigned since no restrictions could be determined -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center and Business Users view.-             Search for the affected User.-             Click Edit > Access Rights.-             Go to the Work Center and View Assignment tab.-             Click Find and search for MMA_EXPANDREIMBMANAGEMENT.-            Assign it to the user.-The warning message will appear.-Cause-The view MMA_EXPANDREIMBMANAGEMENT is restricted to access context level 1003-Management of restricted rule '01 - Restrict to Org Unit Manager', this restricts access to the org units for which the employee is the reporting line unit manager.-The above rule Restricts the access to org units for which the employee is the reporting line unit manager, here the affected user is not a Reporting Line Unit Manager.-Due to that, the system can not able to find the restriction and view cannot be assigned to user.-Resolution-You can assign the affected User as the Manager of the Reporting Line Unit and the warning message won't appear.-To assign a user as the manager of the RLU org unit, follow these steps-Go to Organizational management work center -Go to Org structure view-Select the RLU org unit -Edit the org unit from the effective date-Navigate to General tab-Assign the user in the Org Unit Manager field.-See Also-2749403 - Work Center Or Work Center View Missing for A Business User-Keywords-View, MMA_EXPANDREIMBMANAGEMENT, can't be assigned since no restrictions could be determined, Access Rights, Access Restrictions.

Title: Transaction Currency Missing in Financial Report / Journal Entry Line Item
Content: Symptom-You are checking a financial report, such as the Reconciliation Report or the G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-You notice that some transactions are displayed without transaction currency.-You check the respective journal entry and notice that the posting is not recorded with transaction currency. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open a financial report, such as the Reconciliation report or the G/L Accounts - Line Items report, for example from the Reports view in the General Ledger work center.-You observe that the transaction currency amount is not recorded for some transactions.-Add the Journal Entry ID to the report and navigate to the respective journal entry.-You notice that the posting line is not recorded with transaction currency.-Cause-Not every posting is recorded with line item/transaction currency amount:-If a business trantransaction affects the income statement then amounts are to be documented in line item/transaction currency (invoice postings for example) in the Accounting Document/ Journal Entry.-If the transaction 'only' documents quantities (material movements for instance), the transaction currency amount will not be displayed in the journal entry.-Usually, when a business transaction cannot be directly paid it is not recorded with transaction currency.-Period-end closing relevant transactions are recorded in company currency only.  -Resolution-For the following transaction types the transaction currency amount is not filled:-301: Goods Receipt from Supplier-302: Customer Return-303: Goods Receipt from Production-304: Goods Receipt without Reference-305: Goods Receipt from Transit-306: Return of Non consumed Goods-309: Third Party Return-341: Goods Issue for Customer-342: Goods Issue to Transit-343: Return to Supplier-344: Goods Issue for Production-345: Goods Issue for Consumption-346: Goods Issue without Reference-349: Goods Issue for Customer (Third Party)-381: Goods Transfer-403: Internal Service Confirmation-501: Create/Change/Delete Purchase Order-502: Create/Change/Delete Production Lot-503: Create/Change/Delete Sales Order-504: Create/Change/Delete Customer Return-505: Create/Change/Delete Service Order-506: Create/Change/Delete Service Contract-507: Create/Change/Delete Service Confirmation-508: Create/change/delete Service Request-509: Create/Change/Delete Overhead Cost Proj.-510: Create/Change/Delete Customer Complaint-511: Create/Change/Delete Direct Cost Project-512: Created/Changed/Del. Cust. Inv. Request-555: Expense Assignment to Sales Order for internal service confirmations/ deliveries only-604: Balance Carry forward-605: Manual Depreciation of Fixed Asset-606: Periodic Fixed Asset Valuation-607: Manual Change of Material Cost-608: Automatic Change of Material Cost-609: Settlement of Asset under Construction-610: Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt Clearing-612: Work in Process Clearing-617: Foreign Currency Remeasurement-619: Change of Service Cost Rate-620: Change of Resource Cost Rate-621: Distribution-623: Revenue Recognition-635: Manual Planning-640: Transfer Posting of Fixed Asset Balance-641: Manual Revaluation of Fixed Asset-642:Write-Up on Fixed Asset-643: Manual Posting of Acquisition Costs-644: Fixed Asset Retirement Without Revenue-645: Transfer of Fixed Asset Values-646: Retro Capitalization of Fixed Assets-647: Transfer of Current-Year Acq Costs-Keywords-Transaction Currency Amount, Line Item Currency Amount, Local Currency Amount, Reconciliation report

Title: Error Message: Action not possible; life-cycle process locked by software change
Content: Symptom-When trying to perform a Lifecycle Management (LM) process for a PDI solution, e.g. a solution deployment, and you receive an error message:-"Action not possible; life-cycle process locked by software change".-Environment-Cloud for Customer-Business ByDesign-Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio.-Try to perform a solution deployment.-Error Received: "Action not possible; life-cycle process locked by software change".-Cause-This error message is raised when you are trying to perform a lifecycle management activity while the system is currently being maintained by the Hosting/Operations team. The maintenance can be a upload of a software correction, internal maintenance, system upgrade, etc.-Resolution-As the system is being maintained you won't be able to do any activities on the system until the maintenance is completed. You would need to wait until the maintenance is finished and then proceed with the lifecycle management activity again.-If it exceeds more than Contractual Maintenance Period, then you can raise an incident asking to unclock the same.

Title: A Contract Item is Already Invoiced and Has the End Date Expired But the Fulfillment is Not Started Still
Content: Symptom-When a contract item has the End Date Expired and the item is invoiced, you expect the item line to be fullfillment finished. But it stays Not Started.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Contracts View.-Search for Contract OPQ (OPQ represents the Contract ID).-Open, view all.-Navigate to the Items Tab.-Fulfillment Status is Not Started. However the Invoice Status is Finished.-Cause-This is the system behavior for item type "Service - fixed price without actuals".  There is not an automatic setting to finish Fulfillment in a Contract.-Resolution-You need to manually click the button 'Finish - Fulfillment' on the item line in order to finish the fulfillment status.-Keywords-Fulfillment, contract item, finish, Service - fixed price without actuals.

Title: Product Specification for Item in a Sales Order is not Mandatory Even Though the Product has the Identified Stock Type is 04 - Mandatory Specified Stock
Content: Symptom-The Product Specification for Item in a Sales Order is not mandatory even though the Product has the Identified Stock Type is 04 - Mandatory Specified Stock maintained in the Product Master Data.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Open Product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Product).-In the General tab you can see that the Identified Stock Type is 04 - Mandatory Specified Stock.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Navigate to the items tab.-Select Line Item XX (XX represents the line item for product ABC).-You can see that for ABD in the General sub tab the Product Specification is not maintained and the field is not mandatory.-Cause-The Product Specification is visible for the Item in the Sales Order if the Identified Stock Type is either 03 - Optional Specified Stock or 04 - Mandatory Specified Stock.-However, the system will not enforce the entering of Product Specification in the Sales Order. The enforcement of the Product Specification with the Identified Stock Type "04 - Mandatory Specified Stock" is only relevant in Logistics processes.-The field is not set as a mandatory field and has to be maintained manually.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-To request a change in the existing behavior you can consult KBA 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-product specification, sales order, product, identified stock type, mandatory specified stock

Title: Error: 'No Financial Companies Found In The System. Check Fin Company Set Up'
Content: Symptom-Following errors occur during the execution of a financial report:-'No Financial companies found in the system. Check Fin company set up'-'Report inconsistent. It cannot be started.'-This error may occur for the following reports:-Earned Profit Overview for Dashboard-Earned Profit Overview for KPI-Order Profit Overview for Dashboards-Profit Analysis - Company-Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme-Profit Overview by Key Figure-Net Revenue-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Go to the Design Reports view-Search and open the related report.-The error messages are displayed.-Cause-For the mentioned reports, Contribution Margin Scheme is mandatory field. The system will determine this field from the activity Set of Books. In this activity, the Contribution Margin Scheme field has not been maintained, and the system is unable to determine it. Hence while opening the report system gives the error.-Resolution-Setting the Contribution Margin Scheme is not allowed if any of the following reporting principles are used:-Profit Center and segment-Profit Center or Segment with balancing-Profit Center or segment with clearing-Contribution Margin Scheme field is only allowed if the Reporting Principle of the Set Of Books includes cost related reporting.-If the cost-related reporting principle is used, please follow the steps mentioned below to resolve the issue.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click on Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Search and open the activity Set of Books.-Select the corresponding Set of Books and click on Edit button.-Go to the Company Settings tab.-In the field Contribution Margin Scheme, select a value from the dropdown list.-Save the changes.-See Also-In case of an error while changing the reporting principle for the set of books, please refer to the KBA: 1828324 - Unable To Change Reporting Principle For The Set Of Books-Keywords-Financial Companies, Check Fin company set up, report, FINPRFU30

Title: Error: Cannot delete cost center 9999; it is the responsible unit of a project
Content: Symptom-When trying to activate the Org Structure, the below error message is displayed:-"Cannot delete cost center 9999; it is the responsible unit of a project."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Org Structure view.-Select the required Org Unit and Edit.-In the Planning Area, make required changes in the Org Unit and Activate.-The above error message is displayed.-Cause-The organizational unit 9999 is available in the Active Area with an 'Unlimited' status. However, this organizational unit was delimited in the Planning Area as of DD.MM.YYYY in the past.-Resolution-Update the Org Unit: 9999 again as Cost Center and Delimit it with a future date.-Keywords-Impossible, Cost Center, Activate Org Structure, Unable, Remove

Title: Cannot Update Timesheet Using Webservice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-* ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** *-The customer receives the following error message when trying to update the timesheet using the web service:-"No time file or org. assignment without gaps found".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-As a result, the dates used in the timesheet creation may fall outside this validity period, preventing the timesheet from being updated for the user with the expired UUID.-To check the validity of the UUID:-Log in to the backend system.-Open the TestShell SESFTS tool.-Navigate to the BO Name: IDENTITY.-Query by Node: Enter the Employee ID.-Verify the validity of the UUID for the employee. -Resolution-Request the customer to use the logic to select the current UUID for the employee that is not expired.-Keywords-Payload, Timesheet, Unable, Change, Web service
