Title: You Are Not Able To Edit The Subject/Description Of Approval Tasks
Content: Symptom-You are not able to edit the subject/description of approval tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Enter the mandatory details in the sales order and save it.-Submit the sales order for approval.-You want to change the subject/description of the task created for the sales order.-Cause-It is not possible to change the Subject/Description of the approval task created for any business document. This is the designed behavior of the system.-Resolution-This is the expected system behvaior.

Title: Error SP CL_XREP_PROVIDER_UICOMP failed to process file in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT
Content: Symptom-Case 1:-You are trying to create a Business Configuration View for your Business Configuration Object (.bco) and you are facing the following error message:--"Unable to perform the content operation for user XXXXXXXXXX in client 123"-"Unable to save the content for file /Y12345678_BC/SRC/ABCDEF/XXX_abcde.QA.uicomponent in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT"-"SP CL_XREP_PROVIDER_UICOMP failed to process file /Y12345678_BC/SRC/ABCDEF/XXX_abcde.QA.uicomponent in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT"-"An exception was raised."-Case 2:-You are trying to create Custom Screens for your Custom Business Object and you see a similar message:-"SP CL_XREP_PROVIDER_UICOMP failed to process file /Y12345678_MAIN/SRC/ABCDEF/abcde_OWL.OWL.uicomponent in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT"-(XXXXXXXXXX represents the User ID / Y12345678_ represents the solution ID)-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Right-click on a custom business object(.bo).-Select Create Screens.-Select any Screen Creation option and click OK.-Cause-Case 1:-This issue happens when you have used special characters (*"?/#$%&) in the Description of the BCO which you are trying to use to create the BC Views.-Case 2:-This error is also known to happen if you have maintained other special characters (<>) in the Label annotation of the Extension Fields in your Custom Business Object. The special character will cause issues particularly if the labels have been maintained before triggering the automatic creation of screens.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, remove all the special characters from the Description / Label and try the steps again.-Keywords-SDK, PDI, BCView, BC, BCC, special character, BO

Title: How to use sticky notes, favorites, flags and tags in custom screens
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom BO and custom screens in your custom solution from SAP Cloud Applications Studio and you would like to enable sticky notes, favorites, flags and tags options.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-Create a query (.qry) for your custom BO with the Enterprise Search option enabled.-Open the custom screen in UI Designer.-Click on Properties tab.-Set the Data Binding for the Notes to /Root.-Set the following proprieties to False: Favorites Disabled, Flags Disabled, Stickynotes Disabled, Tags Disabled.-See Also-SAP Community Blog:-https://blogs.sap.com/2015/07/11/how-to-use-sticky-notes-in-own-screens/-Keywords-PDI, SDK, UI, screen, OWL, OIF, QA, sticky, notes, favorites, tags, enabled, disabled

Title: Error While Updating Change Project in Production System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer is trying to merge a change project to production tenant and while trying to update the Scoping & Fine-Tuning from Production, he receives the error message below:--Unauthorized  SOAP:1,048 SRT: HTTP error: ("HTTP Code 401: Unauthorized - Details see in error log of transactionSRTUTIL")-Error when processing Web service call; processing terminated; for more information, see the systemlog or error log files-An exception occurred in include CL_SOAP_RUNTIME_CLIENT========CM005 in line 065-Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: HTTP error: ("HTTP Code 401: Unauthorized - Detailssee in error log of transacti"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Implementation Project view.-Select the Change Project.-Select Update Scoping and Fine-Tuning From Production.-Start Update.-     Above error message appears on the screen.-Cause-The merge of the Business Configuration Change Project fails as the connection between the Test System and the Productive System is broken.-The issue occurr due to Technical User maintained in Productive Tenant is password locked. As it is locked, the connection between Test and Production becomes unauthorized, throwing the errors.--Resolution-Backend correction required from Hosting Team to unlock Technical User Password.-See Also- You can also refer rge KBA:  1846200 - Central Case Document for Issues Related to Merge Failed While Merging a Change Project-Keywords-Change Project, Update CHange Project, Fine-tuning, Unauthorized, HTTP Code 401, Technical User, Hosting, BYD

Title: How to create HTML email templates, Document names and email subjects based on the respective XML Root
Content: Symptom-Your created a document name logic or an output e-mail template with a placeholder, however it does not work as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and user Management work center.-Select the view Form template Maintenance.-Search and find the required form template.-Click on actions and chose "Maintain Document Name" or "Maintain E-mail Template" and enter your text and html placeholder.-After saving the template, you notice that the placeholders are still appearing in the document name/e-mail template.-Cause-For output templates, placeholders need to be set up with the entire path of the field required.-Resolution-Taking as an example the below document name with placeholders for a Customer Invoice document:-TEST_[TaxationTerms-SellerCountryCode]_[ProductRecipientParty-FormAddress-CountryCode]-The placeholders used in the template do not contain the entire path to the desired field, so they will not be replaced by the respective information of the document.-The correct path in the above example would be:-TEST_[CustomerInvoice-TaxationTerms-SellerCountryCode]_[CustomerInvoice-ProductRecipientParty-FormAddress-CountryCode]-It's essential that the placeholder path should contain the complete path, starting from the root element of the document. This path is based off the XML file used to generate the final document. Note that the root element is the element after the part <MessageHeader>. For example, the following is a part of the XML file. The placefolder should be [TradeReceivablesPayablesAccountStatement-...].-<n0:FormTradeReceivablesPayablesAccountStatementNotification ......>-    <MessageHeader>-        <CreationDateTime/>-    </MessageHeader>-    <TradeReceivablesPayablesAccountStatement>-        <CompanyID>......</CompanyID>-This XML can be accessed for some documents by navigating to the Output History tab, then selecting an output entry and clicking on "View XML Data".-The same logic is valid for html e-mail templates and also or e-mail subject modifications shown under Actions.-See Also-3090471 - Placeholder in Email Subject is Showing the Invoice ID Twice-Keywords-html e-mail template, Change document name, E-mail Subject, Html

Title: Connection to WebDAV Folder Not Working
Content: Symptom-When attempting to configure the WebDAV Folder on a local PC, the credentials are being requested by the system. Despite providing the correct credentials, the connection to the WebDAV Folder cannot be established.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to File Input View.-Copy Direct File Access (WebDAV) link for Inbound File (for example: https://myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/a1s/cd/fileio/docs/in).-Go to My Computer at the local machine, Choose Add a network location.-Maintain the former copied direct file access.-A pop up to enter the credentials to connect to the WebDAV Folder will be displayed.-Enter the credentials and again a pop up for Username and Password will be displayed.-The connection to the WebDAV Folder cannot be properly established.-Or the below error message is displayed:-\myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com@SSL\DavWWWRoot\sap\a1s\cd\fileio\docs\in is not accessible. You might not have permission to use this network resource. Contact the administrator of this server to find out if you have access permissions.-A device attached to the system is not functioning.-Cause-Even though credentials are being used, the WebDAV location requires the ByDesign Certificate. However, a valid certificate is not installed on the local PC.-Resolution-The certificate for the WebDAV connection needs to be downloaded by following the below steps.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Select the Communication Arrangements subview.-Select the Communication Arrangement Access Documents via WebDAV.-Select Edit Credentials.-Select the tab Certificate.-Select Create and Download Key Pair.-Choose a location and filename for the exported Certificate.-Set a password to protect the exported Certificate.-Then the certificate must be imported to the computer by following the below steps.-In the Windows Search bar field, insert Internet Options.-Select the Content tab.-Click on Certificates.-Click on Import.-Follow the steps in the Certificate Import Wizard and Choose the previously exported Certificate file.-The certificate will be properly imported.-Then perform the connection again to the WebDAV Folder, a prompt for certificate selection should appear. Ignore the Prompt and then enter the Credentials. The connection will be properly set.-Keywords-WebDAV, Certificate, Credentials, Communication Arrangement Access Documents via WebDAV, connection

Title: How to Invoice Completed Contracts With Open Scheduled Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-A contract has been canceled, but all the open scheduled invoice request items must be invoiced before they are due in the invoice schedule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order workcenter.-Open the Contracts view.-Open the contract ABC (ABC represents the contract ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select a Cancellation Reason.-Select Invoice Cancellation: Keep Invoice Requests.-Save the contract.-Once the cancellation task is processed, the contract is set to status Completed.-Open the contract ABC.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoice Schedule subtab.-All Fields in the invoice schedule are grayed out.-The dates for the Invoice Schedule cannot be changed anymore.-Cause-Once the contract is set to status Completed, the Pricing Data in the contract cannot be altered anymore.-The invoice schedule cannot be adjusted anymore and it is not possible to set the dates.-To create all invoice requests from the invoice schedule, a workaround is necessary.-To cancel all open invoice schedules for the item, it is possible to select the Action Cancel Open Dates in the invoice schedule.-Resolution-How to create all invoice requests from the invoice schedule:-Open the Business Configuration workcenter.-Open fine tuning activity Time Horizon for Scheduled Invoice Requests Run.-Select a value for days, that includes the latest day of the invoice schedule.-Save the fine tuning activity.-Trigger the scheduled invoice requests (follow KBA 2707172 - How to Manually Trigger Sales Order Invoice Schedule).-Open the fine tuning activity and set the horizon back to the original value.-This solution also works with an invoice schedule in a completed sales order.-How to cancel all open invoice schedules for an item:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contract view.-Open Contract ABC.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab-Go to the Invoice Schedule sub tab.-Select line item YY (YY represents the ID of the desired Line Item on the Contract).-Click on the Action button-Select the Cancel open dates option.-All open dates for this item are then canceled.-See Also-KBA 2707172 - How to Manually Trigger Sales Order Invoice Schedule-Keywords-Invoice Schedule, Cancellation Reason, Keep Invoice Requests, Time Horizon, Scheduled Invoice Requests, Rechnungsterminplan, Absagegrund, Rechnungsanforderung beibehalten, cancel, Rechnung stornieren, Vertrag, Kundenauftrag, Contract, Sales Order

Title: Cannot Remove Sales Contact From Account
Content: Symptom-Cannot remove sales contact from account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the account).-Edit the account XYZ and select the Contacts tab.-Select the Relationship and Responsibilities tab.-Select the employee ABC added under Contacts (ABC represents the employee ID).-Remove button is grayed out.-Cause-The employee ABC is indirect responsible for the account XYZ.-Only direct responsible can be maintained (created or deleted) in the account interface, the indirect responsibilities are maintained in the Application and User Management work center -> Employee Work Distribution view. There it is maintained that the employee ID ABC is responsible for sales for the country DEF (DEF represents the country ID). As the account XYZ has an address in DEF, employee ID ABC is shown as indirect responsible.-If this is not expected, the responsibility rules in the work distribution must be adapted accordingly.--To check the above description follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Employee Work Distribution view.-Edit the Employee Responsible for Sales.-Select the employee ABC.-Select the Country subtab.-Here country DEF is also maintained.-Note:-DEF represents the country ID.-XYZ represents the account ID.-ABC represents the employee ID.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign. The indirect and direct responsibilities for the accounts need to be maintained as per the requirement of the business case.-Keywords-sales contact, responsibilities, employee responsible, remove, account, country, employee work distribution

Title: Release Of Tax Return Failed With Error Messages
Content: Symptom-When trying to release VAT Return AAA in the VAT Return view of the Tax Management workcenter three error messages appear:-Tax payable amount for ABC not correct.-Amount DEF in cover document GHI unequal to amount JKL in tax return AAA.-Release of tax return AAA failed.-AAA means the Tax Return ID.-ABC means the combination of Country/Region, Tax Type and Tax Code Description.-DEF means the amount in cover document.-GHI means the cover document ID.-JKL means the amount in Tax Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management workcenter.-Open the VAT Returns view.-Try to release Tax Return ID AAA.-Receive error messages:-Tax payable amount for ABC not correct-Amount DEF in cover document GHI unequal to amount JKL in tax return AAA-Release of tax return AAA failed-Cause-This is caused by different Tax Due Dates for the Supplier Invoice and the Supplier Invoice Item. The system always takes the Tax Due Date with the highest priority. In this case, the one maintained on the Supplier Invoice Item.-If there is no Tax Due Date maintained on the Supplier Invoice item, then the header Supplier Invoice Tax Due Date is used.-In the case there is also no Tax Due Date maintained. Then the posting date is applied.-If the Purchase Order has a Tax Due Date maintained on the item node, this is getting copied to the Supplier Invoice - Item node.-The Supplier Invoice might contain several items with different Purchase Order and therefore different Tax Due Dates references.-This lead to problematic Tax Return - processing.-Resolution-At the moment, this can only be fixed with a backend correction in the Tax Register for the Tax Due Date maintained the Supplier Invoice - Item node.-After the backend correction, cancel VAT Return-ID AAA and reschedule the VAT Return Run BBB (BBB means the VAT Return Run ID) to create a new VAT Return.-To avoid this issue in the future, use the Tax Due Date - functionality in the Supplier Invoice, as this is much more consistent. Check in all connected Purchase Orders for maintained Tax Due Dates on the item node and delete them.-SAP Product Support can correct instances with a specific backend script. Please open a case and refer to this Knowledge Base Article (KBA).-See Also-For country India, please refer to the KBA 2996716 Error - Amount ABC in Cover Document YYYY Unequal to Amount DEF in Tax Return XX, While Releasing Withholding Tax Return for Country India-Keywords-VAT Return; Tax Return; Cover Document; Release Failed-vat return,tax return,cover document,release failed

Title: Unable To Change Reporting Principle For The Set Of Books
Content: Symptom-Changing the reporting principle of a set of books to Profit Center or Segment with clearing results in the following error messages.-'Save Failed.'-'Contribution margin scheme only allowed with CoS reporting principle.'-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the implementation project and click on Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search for activity Set Of Books and open the activity.-Select the appropriate set of books and click on Edit.-Navigate to General tab and change the value of field Reporting Principle from the dropdown list.-Click on Save.-Cause-A value has been maintained in the Contribution Margin Scheme field, which is not allowed with the reporting principle Profit Center or Segment with clearing.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the implementation project and click on Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search for activity Set Of Books and open the activity.-Select the appropriate set of books and click on Edit.-Navigate to Company Settings tab and remove the value from the field Contribution Margin Scheme for all the companies.-Navigate to General tab and change the value of reporting principle to Profit center or segment with clearing.-Click on Save.-Keywords-Change, Reporting Principle, Set of Books, Profit Center, Segment, Clearing

Title: Change Expense Report Status from Not Submitted to Released for Reimbursement
Content: Symptom-Expense Report has been put back to status Not Submitted but has already been cleared (Journal Entry posted). No changes were done to the report and the aim is to put it back to status Released for Reimbursement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select All Expense Reports from the dropdown menu.-Find the relevant Expense Report in question.-The report will display a status of Not Submitted.-Cause-The reason why the Expense Report has a Not Submitted status is because it was sent back for revision (Return for Revision action was taken).-This action is taken in case the Expense Report needs to be changed for any reason, and new expenses need to be considered in the same report.-However, in this case it's not wanted to change it and just wanted to put it back to the status Released for Reimbursement.-Resolution-To resubmit the Expense Report, follow the steps below:-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select All Expense Reports from the dropdown menu.-Find the respective expense report that needs to be resubmitted.-Click Edit button.-Click Submit button.-As a result, the approval process will be restarted. After the Expense Report is approved, if the amount was not changed, the system will recognize the previous amount and just set the report to status Released for Reimbursement.-Keywords-Expense Reports, Not Submitted, Released for Reimbursement, Change Expense Report status.

Title: Bank Balance Migration Error
Content: Symptom-You migrate Accounting Transaction Data: Bank Balance. In the simulation step, you receive the error message:-.Bank statement ID 0 for bank account ID rejected.-.No b.acct. active on dd.mm.yyyy for IBAN <IBAN>, nat.b.c. <national bank code>, and currency <currency> found..-.Bank account missing or cannot be determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Show All Configuration Elements.-Search for the activity "Migration of accounting transaction data".-Open the activity.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration instance XXX (XXX stand for the migration instance).-Select Execute Migration.-Select the file ABC (ABC stands for the source file to be migrated).-Select Process File.-In the simulation step, you have the error messages:-.Bank statement ID 0 for bank account ID rejected.-.No b.acct. active on dd.mm.yyyy for IBAN <IBAN>, nat.b.c. <national bank code>, and currency <currency> found.-.Bank account missing or cannot be determined.-Cause-There are two possible reasons:-1. There are inconsistencies with the data maintained in the migration file with the data maintained in the Bank Directory. Most probably, you have maintained the BIC in the column National Bank Code in the file.-Or-2. There are several line items have the same bank account number.-Resolution-1. Ensure that all data such as the IBAN or the National Bank Code maintained in the migration file are the one maintained in the Bank Directory.-2. A unique identifier for the bank account number is needed, which can be achived by appending the currency/other identifiers in English to these same bank account numbers.-See Also-2558477 - Bank Statement Upload: Bank Account Missing or Cannot be Determined-Keywords-Bank Balance Migration, National Bank Code, Bank Account, Extrait de Compte, Compte Bancaire Manquant.

Title: Not Able to Pass Extension Field from Sales Order Header to Purchase Request in a Third Party Scenario
Content: Symptom-You want to be able to extend an Extension Field from Sales Order header to Purchase Order Request in a Third Party Scenario, however, the relevant option is not available in the Extension Scenarios.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Open any Sales Order.-Click your Profile Picture in the top-right side of the screen.-Hover the mouse over Key User Settings.-Click Start Adaptation Mode.-Click the Plus sign (+) In the bottom left of the screen.-Select Extension Fields.-Select the extension field that you want to extend to the Purchase Order Request in the Third Party scenario.-Click Show Further Usage.-Go to the tab Extension Scenarios.-You will see that it is not possible to extend this field to the Purchase Order Request.-Cause-It is currently not possible to pass an extension field from Sales Order Header to Purchase Request in a third party scenario. Currently this is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-As a workaround, it's possible to pass extension fields that are in the item level of a Sales Order to the item level in a Purchase Request Third Party Scenario.-To do so, follow these steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Open any Sales Order.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click your Profile Picture in the top-right side of the screen.-Hover the mouse over Key User Settings.-Click Start Adaptation Mode.-Click the Plus sign (+) In the bottom left of the screen.-Select Extension Fields.-Select the extension field that you want to extend to the Purchase Order Request in the Third Party scenario.-Click Show Further Usage.-Go to the tab Extension Scenarios.-Here, activate the following extension scenario:-Sales Order - Item to Purchase Request - Item.-If you want to extend this to the Supplier Invoice item, activate the following extension scenarios in addition to the previous one:-Purchase Request - Item to Purchase Order - Item.-Purchase Order - Item to Supplier Invoice - Item.-And in order to extend to the Customer Invoice, activate the following extension scenarios:-Purchase Order - Item to Purchase Order Logistics Details - Line Item.-Inbound Delivery Notification - Line Item to Inbound Delivery - Line Item.-Inbound Delivery - Line Item to Outbound Delivery - Line Item.-Outbound Delivery - Item to Invoice Requests - Item.-See Also-1808919 - Extension Field not Populated in Extension Scenario "Sales Order - Item to Purchase Request - Item"-Keywords-Extension Field ; Sales Order ; Purchase Request ; Purchase Order ; Supplier Invoice ; Customer Invoice ; Third Party ;

Title: Error in Invoice Scanning - Error Occured while Processing the PDF
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-[INTERNAL USE ONLY]-You have done the scanning of PDF file, however if you look at the scanning view, system shows an error message.-Error - Error Occured while Processing the PDF-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Select the relevant file -You can see the error status-Cause-The error occurs usually when the master data synchronization is failed.-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Master Data Synchronization view-Click start synchronization for the company OR You see that Start Synchronization button is grayed out with the error message-Error - No valid OAuth registration found; please contact SAP-Follow below steps to understand which team you have to send  and with what details:-  Log in to SPC tool-Go to Provision and navigate to Service Execution view (From 2308 release, it should be Service Execution View instead of Service Request)-Ensure that status field is empty-Enter Origin ID BYD_ML_DOX (From 2308 release, it should be Origin ID instead of Service Request ID)-Enter Customer ID ABC (Customer ID will be the ID that you see in CAM tool)-Select Go-Look for process ID(XXX) under Process Management sub tab based on latest date-You will see the status in Completed or Error or In Process status -Resolution-Option 1: Create an incident and send it to component AP-LM-PRV-BLR component, with below details.-In SPC,  found that the latest process ID: XXX is completed for customer:ABC and service request ID:BYD_ML_DOX-Option 2: Send to operations (click routing in CSS and choose involve operations and choose incident management), with below details-(Note: In Service Now, please choose service offering “SPC” and cloose Incident management “SAAS BYD C4C OPS L2 - ByD C4C Cloud Operations)-In SPC, found that the latest process ID: XXX in status ‘in process’ for customer:ABC and service request ID:BYD_ML_DOX-Keywords-Error Occured while Processing the PDF; No valid OAuth registration found; please contact SAP; BYD_ML_DOX9

Title: Cannot Process Customer Project Expense List Because Supplier Invoice Not Yet Posted in Accounting
Content: Symptom-You have posted a customer sales project expense, such as a supplier invoice, a goods receipt or an employee time calendar.-The relevant, expense assignment to sales order, the Customer Project Expense List (CPEL) is stuck in the Unposted Source Documents list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view select Unposted Source Documents showlist.-CPEL documents are stuck with the error:-'Cannot process Customer Project Expense List because Supplier Invoice not yet posted in accounting. As Customer Project Expense List contains a reference to Supplier Invoice but Supplier Invoice has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Customer Project Expense List. Check why Supplier Invoice has not been posted.'-Cause-It can happen that the CPELs are being processed faster in Accounting than the associsted expense document.-Once an expense item has been processed its CPEL is being generated. However, if there are further expense items to be processed, then it might take a few seconds until the source document and its journal entry get generated in accounting while the CPELs for each item have already reached accounting. -Resolution-We are working on improving the posting sequence of customer project expenses and their connected CPELs. -In the meantime, post the CPEL manually, once you verified that the project expense is posted in accounting. -To post manually, select the CPEL in the General Ledger's Source Documents view. -Press Actions and choose Post Business Transaction. -Keywords-Customer Project Expense List; CPEL; Unposted;Cannot Process Customer Project Expense List; because not yet posted in accouning.

Title: Goods And Services Receipt or Supplier Invoice For Fixed Asset: No Organizational Assignment Valid
Content: Symptom-A Goods and Services Receipt or a Supplier Invoice for a Fixed Asset acquisition appears as Unposted Source Document with the error:-'No organizational assignment valid on DD.MM.YYYY for AAA; profit center accounting is active'-'No org. assignment valid on DD.MM.YYYY for AAA; segment accounting active'.-(DD.MM.YYYY means the Proposed Posting Date of the Goods and Services Receipt.)-(AAA represents the Fixed Asset ID.)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center go to the Source Documents view. -Find the Goods and Services Receipt or the Supplier Invoice ID.-In the Details section you see the errors-'No organizational assignment valid on DD.MM.YYYY for AAA; profit center accounting is active'-'No org. assignment valid on DD.MM.YYYY for AAA; segment accounting active'-Cause-The Organizational Assignment of Fixed Asset AAA is not valid on the Good and Service receipt or Supplier Invoice Proposed Posting Date.-Resolution-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Find Fixed Asset AAA.-Press Edit and select Master Data.-Navigate to the Basic Data tab.-In the All Assignment Intervals table, press Adjust Time Intervals.-Maintain the correct Start Date and Valid To dates which is within the time range of the Goods and Services Receipt or Supplier Invoice posting date. -Save all  changes.-Post the Goods and Services Receipt or the Supplier Invoice from the Source Document view. -Keywords- No organizational assignment valid on, profit center accounting is active, segment accounting active-segment accounting active, no organizational assignment valid on,profit center accounting is active

Title: Incorrect Depreciation Calculation
Content: Symptom-For a Fixed Asset, you expect and maintain the depreciation to be calculated over a period of 3 years. After the depreciation run, you notice that the depreciation is calculated over 6 years instead of the 3 years maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The depreciation is calculated over a period of 6 years because you have maintained for the depreciation, both the Useful Life Years and Periods fields. You have maintained this as follow:-Useful Life Years / Periods: 3 / 36-Check field Useful Life Years / Periods as follows:-Open the Fixed Asset.-Click View All.-Click Masrter Data Tab.-Click Asset Valuation Sub-tab.-Click Current Valuation View Seetings Sub-tab.-Resolution-For the depreciation to be calculated as expected over 3 years, you must only fill one of the fields. Either, you fill the Useful Life Years as 3 years, or you fill the Periods as 36.-Note: Useful Life Years / Periods: 3 / 36 is just an example.-Keywords-Depreciation calculation, Calcul d'Amortissement, Useful Life Periods, Durée d'Amortissement.

Title: How to Create a Positive Tax Payment
Content: Symptom-Error while creating a New Tax Payment with positive amount: 'Tax payment must be outgoing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Click New Tax Payment sub view.-Choose Tax Payment as Tax Payment Type.-Select any Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Fill in any other mandatory data if required.-Click Check button.-Error 'Tax payment must be outgoing' appears.-Cause-The steps to create a tax payment as outlined in the Reproducing the Issue section of this KBA will only work for negative tax amount, for positive tax amount the steps described in the next KBA section Resolution should be followed.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center-Click New Incoming Check under Common Task.-In Payer field, select the ID of the relevant Tax Authority.-Click Post.-Consequence: it will automatically create a tax payment because a Payer which is a Tax Authority has been selected.-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Click Tax Payments view.-Result: the incoming check created is found, can now be matched against a positive value return and can be successfully posted.-See Also-KBA 2646729 - 'Tax payment must be outgoing' Error In New Tax Payment-Keywords-Positive Tax, Montant positif, Tax Payment,

Title: Actual Cost Rollup Run Failed With Error Messages: Cost Center Has No Cost
Content: Symptom-While executing Actual Cost Rollup Run, error occurs:-Error: Cost Center XYZ has no Cost(XYZ represent Cost center ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > Acutal Cost Rollup view.-Show All Runs and find the Run ID ABC(ABC represents the Run ID).-Select the Run ABC and navigate to the Log Result.-Open the Log and navigate to the Messages tab.-Message 'Cost center XYZ has no cost' is displayed (XYZ represent Cost center ID).-Cause-The issue is that there has already been an Allocation run DEF against this cost center XYZ(DEF represents the Actual Cost Allocation Run ID). This can be checked in the Cost Centers - Line Items report after adding the views "Business Transaction Type" and "Source Doc. ID".-Steps:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Reports > List view.-Select and open the Cost Centers - Line Items report.-Enter Cost Center XYZ.-Navigate to the View tab.-Add views "Business Transaction Type" and "Source Doc. ID".-See that there has already been an Allocation run DEF against this cost center XYZ.-Resolution-System works as designed. Once an allocation run has been posted against a Cost Center, it can't be reprocessed.-See Also-2720022 - 'Revaluation is already done, Action Post_Adjustment not permitted' Warning Message in Actual Cost Allocation Run-Keywords-Cost Center, Acutal Cost Rollup Run, Actual Cost Allocation Run

Title: Error Appears When Entering a Correct Postal Code for an Account
Content: Symptom-When assigning a postal code to an account, system returns errors such as:-"Postal code XYZ must have length XXX."-"Postal code XYZ can only contain numbers."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Account view.-Show All Accounts and find the respective account.-Choose Edit and select the General tab.-In the Main Address section, enter a new Postal Code.-Choose Save.-The system throws one of the mentioned errors.-Cause-This may happen when the Postal Code format of a specific country changes, and during a transition time the old and the new format are valid. The standard settings of the system will be adapted to the new format at one point.-Resolution-In the meantime and as long as both formats are valid, you can change the country specific settings for the Postal Code in the Fine-Tune activity.-1. Go to the Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to the Implementation Projects view.-3. Choose Open Activity List.-4. Go to the Fine-Tune step.-5. Open the Countries activity.-6. Select Edit Countries.-7. Mark the row of the respective country and select tab Postal Attributes.-8. Change Postal Code Check Rule to 1 - Maximum value length, without gaps.-Keywords-Zip code, Country, Postal code, Unable, Add

Title: Fixed Asset Supplier Invoice Cancellation Error During Depreciation Calculation - Acquisition Cost Negative
Content: Symptom-You create a Fixed Asset via Supplier Invoice procurement.-In the invoice you maintain an Item Net Discount in the Deductions and Surcharges tab.-The Fixed Asset is generated.-Later you need to cancel the Supplier Invoice.-This activity results in an unposted Business Transaction of the cancellation invoice reporting an error:-An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ-X.-- Asset XYZ val.view Z (Z stands for the valuation view ID): Acquisition cost negative.-XYZ represents the fixed asset ID.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Source Documents view.-Find Cancellation invoice DEF (DEF stands for the ID of the cancellation supplier invoice).-An error is displayed: An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ-X. - Asset XYZ val.view Z (Z stands for the valuation view ID): Acquisition cost negative.-When checking the original invoice you identify an Item Net Discount:-In the Supplier Invoicing workcenter navigate to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find the original supplier invoice ABC (ABC represents the supplier invoice ID) and open it.-In the Deductions and Surcharges tab you notice an Item Net Discount updating the effective Net Amount of the Invoice as well as the Net Value of the generated Fixed Asset XYZ-X.-Cause-The original Supplier Invoice ABC was posted with both, an Acquisition cost posting line as well as a Discount posting line.-Both are affecting the Net Book Value of the generated Fixed Asset where the Discount Amount appears as a negative posting.-During the reversal posting, however, the original posting line with the full Fixed Asset Acquisition, i.e. Capitalization amount of the original invoice ABC is being considered first triggering the error as the actual Fixed Asset Net Book Value is lower due to the Item Net Discount.-Currently, the Valuation check, if activated, considers every posting line separately and not altogether, creating the possibility of the above error.-Resolution-This is current system behaviour.-But there is a workaround: It is possible to deactivate the Valuation Check Settings field for all Valuation views of the respective fixed asset.-After this, as there is no check of each posting line, the reversal invoice DEF can be posted:-To deactivate the Valuation Check:-In the Fixed Asset workcenter navigate to the Fixed Assets view.-Find Fixed Asset XYZ-X and press Edit- Master Data.-Navigate to the Asset Valuation sub-tab.-Under Current Valuation View Settings go to the Additional Parameters.-Here in the Valuation Check Settings select 3-No checks.-Proceed like this for all Valuation views of the Fixed Asset.-Then press Save.-To post the invoice reversal:-In the General Ledger navigate to the Source Documents view.-Find Cancellation invoice DEF (DEF stands for the ID of the cancellation supplier invoice).-Press Actions - Post Business Transaction.-This time the reversal of the Fixed Asset supplier invoice will be posted to reduce the Fixed Asset Net Book value by the Effective Net Amount of the Original Supplier Invoice.-Keywords-Acquisition cost negative; Item Net Discount; supplier invoice cancellation; fixed asset

Title: Customer Statement And Report Aging List For Receivables Show Different Results For The Same Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You create a Customer Statement and compare the result for Customer Invoice XXX to the result of the Report Aging List for Receivables.-The results are different and you suspect that it is a system error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center > Balance Confirmation view-Select Balance Confirmation XXX-Click Preview - Print-You see that Customer Invoice YYY is being shown under header 30 day*-* This is only one example, the same applies to the fields Current, 30 day, 60 day, 90 day, 120 day-  Open Receivables Work Center-Go to Reports - List and select the Report Aging List for Receivables-Enter the key date of the Customer Statement as Cut-Off Date-Enter the Customer ID-Run the Report-Move the fields Due Date, Proposed Posting Date and Customer Invoice ID from Not Currently Shown to Rows-You see that Customer Invoice YYY is shown as Not Due Amount-Cause-The Customer Statement and the Report Aging List for Receivables follow different logics.-  Logic for Customer Statement:-The logic takes the document date as the reference date and subtracts it from the key date.-(This is the date which is shown in column Date in the PDF File Customer Statement.)-If the difference is >= 0 and <= 29, it adds the amount to the value under the column Current.-If the difference is >=30 and <= 59, it adds the amount to the value under the column 30 Day.-If the difference is >=60 and <= 89, it adds the amount to the value under the column 60 Day.-If the difference is >=90 and <= 119, it adds the amount to the value under the column 90 Day.-If the difference is >=120, it adds the amount to the value under the column 120 Day.-  Logic for Report Aging List for Receivables:-The periods are calculated from the specified Cut-Off Date.-In the default display, the period structure is as follows:-1st Due Period in Days: 30-2nd Due Period in Days: 60-3rd Due Period in Days: 90-4th Due Period in Days: 120-This means, for example, that period 2 displays the overdue Receivables with a Due Date between 31 and 60 days in the past, regardless of whether they are cleared on the current date.-These are the default values and can be changed.-Resolution-The System Behavior is correct.-Keywords-balance confirmation, receivables, customer statement

Title: Cannot process Customer Project Expense List because Expense is not yet posted in accounting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer created an expense for a Customer Project with Sales Integration, for example an Internal or External Time Recording, an Expense Report, a Supplier Invoice or a Goods and Services Receipt. In this case each expense posting triggers an Expense Assignment to Sales Document, the generation of the Customer Project Expense list (CPEL).-Later the expense gets canceled, or marked as irrelevant. As the original expense is not relevant anymore, the CPEL is not relevant anymore.-However, the CPEL now appears as Unposted Source Document in the Source Documents view of the General Ledger workcenter stating 'Cannot process Customer Project Expense List XYZ because [For Example: Employee Time Calendar, Expense Report, Supplier Invoice, Goods and Services Receipt] is not yet posted in accounting' [...]-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Closing Cockpit - Source Documents view.-Here you notice at least 2 versions of a source document of type 555-Customer Project Expense List in status In Process.-In the Messages table below an Error is displayed: Cannot process Customer Project Expense List XYZ because Employee Time Calendar (or Expense Report or Supplier Invoice or Goods and Services Receipt) ABC not yet posted in accounting. As Customer Project Expense List XYZ contains a reference to Employee Time Calendar (or other as above) ABC but Employee Time Calendar (or other as above ABC has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Customer Expense List XYZ. Check why Employee Time Calendar (or other as above) ABC has not been posted.-You have checked the expense and notice that it has been cancelled or marked as irrelevant. Therefore the CPEL is no longer relevant either.-However, the option of marking this CPEL as Not Relevant is not available.-Cause-When Customer Sales Project Expenses are cancelled or marked as irrelevant the system does not automatically reverse the respective CPEL. Instead, a further version of the CPEL is being generated which then appears together with all previous versions as Unposted Source Document in the General Ledger. As there is no Reversal document they cannot be marked as irrelevant by the End User.-Resolution-Pre- Conditions:-Verify that the Original Expense/s really are either cancelled or marked as irrelevant. -Ask the Customer for permission to set the respective CPELs as Not Relevant from the Backend, should the Customer not have noted this in the incident already. -Request a Support User with L6 Access level with Backend and all workcenter access.-Open the Frontend and navigate to the Source Documents view of the General Ledger to identify all the involved CPELs.-Identify CPELs: -If there are numerous unposted CPELs you might want to identify all the affected, original expense documents first: -  Access STFK and enter transaction SE38.-  In the Program field enter FIA_FIND_UNPOSTED_CPELS.-  Press Execute and press Execute again to sort the report by CPEL ID.-The table displays all the unposted CPEL IDs in the Source Document ID column. In the Original Source Document ID and Original Source Document Type columns you find all the original expense document IDs and types.-Mark CPELs as Irrelevant: -Use the ZFIA_MARK_UNPOSTED_CPEL_IRREL report to mark the respective CPEL(s) as Irrelevant):-In STFK access Transaction SE38.-In the Program field enter ZFIA_MARK_UNPOSTED_CPEL_IRREL.-First enter a valid irrelevance reason: -Press Display.-Press Edit (The glasses and pencil icon).  -Go to row 91 and change the irrelevance reason. Include the the case ID (XXXX/YYYY) so your case can be easily found in case of any follow-up issues (XXXX represents the case ID, YYYY represents the year the case was opened). -Press Save. -Go back. -Now press Activate (the little magic wand icon) to activate your changes. -Press Execute.*-If there is no record, it means the report is not yet created in the system, follow the steps in 'Create the Report' section below first. -In the S_OPD field, enter the CPEL ID, if there is only one CPEL to be marked as irrelevant. If there are more than, say 5, CPELs to be marked, it is a good idea to first paste all the IDs into an Excel sheet from where you can copy them.-This time, in the S_OPD field maintain any value, for example 1.-Then click on the Multiple Selection button.-A pop-up window, called Multiple Selection for S_OPD opens.-Go to your Excel sheet select and copy all the CPEL IDs. -Then, back in the Multiple selection pop-up window, in the Select Single Values tab, click on the Upload-from-clipboard button (left beside the red X). All copied values appear in the table. -Press Execute.-Then, back in the main view press Execute again.-After this all selected CPELs are marked as irrelevant. There will be no further message displayed here. -Now change the irrelevance reason back to the generic reason: -Press Display.-Press Edit (The glasses and pencil icon).  -Go to row 91 and change the irrelevance reason back to 'project expense irrelevant'.-Press Save. -Go back. -Press Activate (the little magic wand icon) to activate your changes.-Verify your changes: -Open the Customer System and go to the Source Documents view of the General Ledger.-Select all Source Documents.-Search for one of the marked CPELs.-Result: It now appears with Relevance Status Irrelevant and Irrelevance Reason: Project expense irrelevant SAP.-*Create the Report: -If this report is not yet created in the system do the following:-In the Program field enter ZFIA_MARK_UNPOSTED_CPEL_IRREL.-Press Create.-In the ABAP: Program Attributes window enter ZFIA_MARK_UNPOSTED_CPEL_IRREL, in the Title field enter ZFIA_MARK_UNPOSTED_CPEL_IRREL.-Press Save. -In the Create Object Directory Entry window press Local Object.-Select all the content and delete it.-Then copy and paste the content of the attached ZFIA_MARK_UNPOSTED_CPEL_IRREL.txt file here.-Press Save.-Press Activate.-Go back to the SE38 initial screen.-Select the report and press Execute.-Continue with Step 4 under Mark CPELs as Irrelevant. -Keywords-555, customer project expense list, CPEL, mark as not relevant, Cannot process Customer Project Expense List because Expense is not yet posted in accounting

Title: Cannot Access Document with Restriction Rule 1
Content: Symptom-You have maintained access restriction with access context 1016 and restriction rule 1  (Access based on the employee, territory assignment, and involvement of employees reporting to user in organizational unit (including sub-units)) for a document for the user ABC (ABC represents the user ID), but the user is not able to access any of the documents that belong to the organizational unit that he is assigned.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-As an example, in this document it will be considered that the restriction is used for accounts.-Login as user ABC.-Go to the Customers work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Search for the account XXX (XXX represents the account ID that you expect to see with restriction rule 1).-The user ABC cannot access the account XXX.-Cause-The restriction rule 1 is used for managers and the user ABC is not the manager of the organizational unit that he is assigned.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-For employees that are not managers and need to access documents assigned to other employees that are in the same organizational unit than them, use the restriction rule 10.-Keywords-Customers work center,restriction rule,access documents assigned to other employees

Title: Invalid Work Center View Error for Business Role XYZ
Content: Symptom-You observe that for a particular business role, the work center view shows error: 'Invalid work center view'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Roles view.-Click on All Business Roles and search for Business Role XYZ(XYZ represents Business Role ID).-Click on Edit.-Go to Work center and View Assignments tab-Under work center/View ID, FIN_GENERALLEDGER, all the views are with Error: (Invalid Work Center View).-Cause-This happens when the concur integration for financials in not scoped. So even if the cost center and employee replication is allowed, financial data would not be handled.-Resolution-You have to scope the system for Concur Financials.-In case, if there are no projects open, you will have to create a change project and scope Concur. Later merge with the main work space.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/a3103b7f36d448118907c43686720329/019787a49f50442e8009e106b4d5fcdf.html-Keywords-Invalid Work Center View, Concur Integration

Title: On creation of a new Sales Quote , the ID generated are not in the sequence
Content: Symptom-On creation of a new Sales Quote, the ID's generated are not in the sequence.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Select the button New and create a new sales quote.-Maintain all mandatory details and save the sales quote.-The sales quote ID generates is NNN (where NNN is the sales quote ID, lets say the number/value of this sales quote id is 110).-Repeat the same step 3 and 4 and create new sales quote .-You will see the sales quote ID generate now is MMM (where MMM is sales quote ID which is created after NNN but have smaller number, lets say the number/value of this sales quote ID is 100 i. e. could be any number below 110).-This behaviour also occurs for other sales documents, like opportunities.-Cause-The service is buffered. Various servers get different parts of the number range buffered and draw the number from it. So server A can gets 1-10 and server B can gets 11-20. So it's clear, that no sequence (from time point of view) will result from it.-Resolution-This an expected behavior in current release.-This expected behaviour also occurs for other sales documents, like opportunities, leads, sales order.-Keywords-Number Range, Sequence, Sales Quotes, Opportunities

Title: OVS Input Field is Displaying Code Instead of the Description
Content: Symptom-On UI Designer, you have added a OVS to a screen, and you expect the Description to be shown, but its showing the code.-*Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-UI Designer-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If presentation Mode is "DescriptionOnly" and the Text field is missing, then the ID will be shown on UI.-Resolution-Text property should be set for Description, as presentation Mode "DescriptionOnly" will receive the value from the field set in Text property. If this property is missing, the ID will be shown.-See Also-https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-blogs-by-members/how-to-add-a-value-help-to-an-extension-field/ba-p/13290915-Keywords-"DescriptionOnly";-"OVS";-"Code instead of Description"

Title: How to Check Form Determination via Backend SE24 Transaction
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA would help you to check the form that the system backend is requesting to be used in a form document - In case of any question please reach your any colleague from Client Infrastructure.-This KBA also covers how to check the company that is being considered for Master Form Template determination, and the output channel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To check the form template determination, please follow the below steps:-Open system backend.-Run transaction SE24.-Type class /DOC/CL_DOR_FORM_TPL_HELPER.-Select Display.-Double click to open method GET_FORM_TPL_INFO.-Add breakpoint in row VALIDATE_FORM.-Execute the document preview in the frontend.-This will trigger the debugger.-In this code, the variables that contain useful information are the following:-IV_FORM_TPL_CODE:  Shows the form code. For example, C41 (which refers to the form template for Customer Invoice)-IV_FORM_TPL_L_CODE: Shows the language code. For example, E (which is English).-IV_SENDER_COUNTRY_CODE: Shows the country code. For example, US (United Stated).-To check the company being determined (which is relevant for master template assignment and output channel), please proceed with the following steps:-Follow the same steps listed above until step #4.-Double click to open method GET_MASTER_TPL_INFO.-Place a breakpoint in the first executable line of code.-Go to the system frontend and execute the document preview.-This will trigger the debugger.-In this code, the double clicks or type in the variable viewer ES_MASTER_TPL_INFO.-Double click on the name of the variable on the variable viewer to open it.-Inside the structure viewer, you can see the company being determined in the property COMPANY_ID.-In the same structure, the property CHANNEL_TYPE will hold the information of the output channel.-Keywords-Form, Template, Variant, Determination, SE24, master template-/doc/cl_dor_form_tpl_helper,form country selection,language,sender country,get_form_tpl_info,form selection in backend

Title: Data not Shown When Customer Account Statement Spans across Two Fiscal Years - South Africa
Content: Symptom-You are running customer account statement where the data is spanning two fiscal years and there is no content in the output data.-In South Africa, it is a legal requirement for companies to send regular account statements to their customers in order to receive due payments.-For each customer, the statement is generated as a PDF file and shows a summary of the opening and due amounts and balance for each included business document, such as customer invoices or credit memos.-The generated statement also shows the amounts overdue by timeframes of 30, 60, 90, and more than 120 days.-You can configure your output settings so that each generated statement is automatically e-mailed to the customer.-Country: South Africa-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Account Statement view.-Select the Run ID XYZ (XYZ represents Run ID)and click open the View Report Run Results.-Go to the tab Data Prepared for Export which is empty.-However, there are documents which the Run XYZ should have picked and this can be checked from the below path.-Copy the Customer ID and go to Receivables workcenter.-Go to the Customer account and open the copied Customer Id.-Go to Trade Receivables tab and then Postings tab.-Here add the Posting Date From/To as per the selection criteria in the customer account statement Run XYZ and click Go.-You see there are documents which are across two fiscal year.-Ideally, the opening balance should have been 0.-The Debit amount=sum of invoices & Credit amount=sum of payments-Cause-Currently, this is the system behavior when the documents are spanning across two different fiscal years.-Resolution-As a work around, you need to create two different runs for two different fiscal year.-This way each run will pick the documents for that fiscal year.-Keywords-Customer Account Statement, South Africa

Title: How to use Fonts in Form Templates Which are not Supported by Business ByDesign or C4C
Content: Symptom-There is a requirement to use a Font (EX: Verdana) which is not supported by SAP Business ByDesign or C4C in Form Templates. Because, ByDesign/C4C supports a limited number of Fonts for the Forms by default.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications-Resolution-Prerequisite: Fonts has to be licensed.-The following file or information must be provided to SAP with the support case.-Provide the fonts file in .OTF or TTF format.-If the font is a free font, provide the confirmation that the font is free style (ex: URL of the font). -If the font has been purchased under a dedicated license, provide a document that proves the purchase of the font.-After receive the information, operation team will install the font in the ADS server and then the support team will modify the backend of the tenant to guarantee that the font can be used in document output. Note: In generally, the font installation should be happened in each tenant.-The font in PDF output has two status:-Non-embedded: The font will be used in PDF. But if the PDF is opened in a device where the particular font is not installed, the font may be displayed in a wrong way.-Embedded: The font will be embedded in PDF. Not matter if the particular font is installed in the device or not, the font will be displayed when view the PDF.-Usually, the default status is not Non-embedded. If the Embedded is necessary, please mention in the case and support team will enable the job profile to embed the font.-See Also-Font Types Compatible with Forms-Keywords-Font, Form template, Adobe Live Cycle Designer, Custom Font, New Font, Embedded, Job Profile.

Title: Why Direct Debit or Automatic Debit is not Available as a Supplier Payment Method.
Content: Symptom-You want to set up a supplier payment method as direct debit or automatic debit however this option is not available for selection in the supplier payment methods list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Base work centre.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Select the supplier for which you want to change the payment method, select the Edit button and choose the Financial Data option.-On the Payment Data subview in the Payment Method area select the Add Row button.-At the new row, select the down arrow: among the option in payment methods list Direct Debit or Automatic Debit is not available.-Cause-The payment method table for supplier is only for self-initiated payments, that mean payments that you initiate.-If you pay your supplier by direct debit you are not the one who initiates the payment but your supplier is.-Resolution-If you collect money from a supplier via direct debit, in other words if this supplier is also one of your customer, you should create a customer account via the Account Management work centre and add the payment method direct debit on the customer account.--If it is your supplier who collects money from you, in other words you pay your supplier via direct debit, then you don't have to enter the debit procedure in the supplier financial master data. Additionally to avoid problem with the payment run and this supplier you should block the supplier for payments. In this case the payment run doesn't try to process the open items for this supplier.--Keywords-Supplier, Payment Method, Direct Debit.

Title: The Contract Status is not Completed, Even After the Items are Fulfilled and Invoiced
Content: Symptom-The Contract status is not Completed, even after Contract->Items are Fulfilled and Invoiced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Contracts and search with Contract ID ABC(where ABC is contract id).-Select the Contract and click on the View All button and go to the Items tab.-Here you can see for line-item YY the Fulfillment Status and Invoice Status is Finished, but Contract ABC is still with status as In Process.-Cause-The Contract ABC is still in status as Active. The Contract will have overall status as Completed when:-Fulfillment status is Finished .-Invoice Status is Finished , and-Contract is Expired.-Contract item works in the same way. When the contract item fulfillment is finished, invoice is finished and the date is expired, then the contract item is set to Completed.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Contract status; Contract Item status; In Process; Completed.

Title: Error Message: 'Enter Account Determination Group for Customer ABC, Company XYZ' while Executing Revenue Recognition Run
Content: Symptom-When running a Revenue Recognition, you receive the error message:- 'Enter account determination group for customer ABC (where ABC stands for the customer ID), company XYZ (where XYZ stands for the company ID)'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Select Revenue Recognition subview.-Click on the relevant Revenue Recognition ID.-Go to tab Processed with Errors.-Select the respective Sales Order and you can see the error message:- 'Enter account determination group for customer ABC, company XYZ'-Cause-The reason is that you have not maintained the account determination group in the customer's master data.-Resolution-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customers View.-Go to Customer subview.-Search for the Customer: ABC.-Select Edit-> Financial Data Tab.-Select the Company XYZ and go to Payment Data sub-tab.-Click on Add Row ﻿button.-Maintain Account Determination group and other relevant information.-Choose Save button.-  Keywords-Payment allocation, account determination group, sales order, revenue recognition run

Title: How To Check CTI BADIs Enhancement for Inbound Calls via Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The inbound CTI calls are not behaving the way they should, and you want to understand how to check if there is any CTI BADI Enhancement implemented for Inbound Calls in Customer's system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You start an Inbound Call with Local CTI Adapter or Widget Integration-The caller is not Identified correctly-The search results in Live Activity Screen are not correct-Cause-The customer has applied Custom BADIs into their Phone Call handling-Resolution-Log into the back-end of the relevant system.-Enter the SE20 transaction code.-Click the Enter key or the Enter icon.-Enter ES_COD_CTI_CALL_HANDLING in the Enhancement Spot field-Click the Display icon-Expand the BADI Definitions for 'CTI_CALL_EXIT', 'CTI_CUSTOMER_IDENTIFICATION', 'CTI_CUSTOMER_SEARCH' and 'CTI_WIDGET_URL'-If the Enhancement is under CTI_CALL_EXIT, it will affect the way that the payload is sent C4C-If it is under CTI_CUSTOMER_IDENTIFICATION, it will change the way that the caller is Identified in the Phone Call Notification-If it is under CTI_CUSTOMER_SEARCH, it will affect the results shown in the Live Activity Screen-And if it is under CTI_WIDGET_URL, it will affect the way that the Phone Call Widget behaves-double click on Implementations for all of them.-8. If you observe the name of a PDI Solution, like the one in the above screenshot it means that Inbound Calls behavior is enhanced.-9. In order to check if the Solution is active you have to double click on the entry.-10. Under the Runtime Behaviour section you will see the status of the custom solution.- 11. If you want to see the Class of this Custom Enhancement, navigate to "Technical Details" tab-12. If you want to see the name of the Enhancement, double click over the Class listed under "Changed Object"-13. Double Click on the Method that will show up-14. Look for 'iv_enh_impl_esr_name'-This Enhancemnet ESR name can be provided to the customer for further checking on their side-Keywords-Live Activity, BADI, Enhancement, Inbound Call-cti enhancement for inbound calls

Title: 'Tax payment must be outgoing' Error In New Tax Payment
Content: Symptom-While creating a New Tax Payment error 'Tax payment must be outgoing' appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Click New Tax Payment sub view.-Choose Tax Payment as Tax Payment Type.-Select any Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Fill in any other mandatory data if required.-Click Check button.-Error 'Tax payment must be outgoing' appears.-Cause-Ideally the Tax Payable amount should be in negative. If the Tax Payable amount is positive then this error appears. Also the Tax Receivable should be positive.-Resolution-Make sure that the Tax Payable amount is in negative and the Tax Receivable amount is in positive.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Click New Tax Payment sub view.-Choose Tax Payment as Tax Payment Type.-Select any Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Click View All.-Go to the Tax return tab.-Make sure that the Tax Payable should be Payable and the amount to be in negative.-See Also-KBA 2737819 - How to Create a Positive Tax Payment-Keywords-Tax Payment Must be Outgoing, Tax Payment Error

Title: Error "HTTP 500 (InternalServerError)" Appears while Executing Query QueryByGroupCode of Business Object SalesPriceList in the Repository Explorer
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message "HTTP 500 (InternalServerError- Dump or unhandled exception in backend)" when you execute the query QueryByGroupCode of Business Object SalesPriceList in Repository Explorer.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Go to View -> Repository Explorer.-Select and expand business object SalesPriceList.-Select the query QueryByGroupCode and run operation Execute Query.-After running "Execute Query", the "Query Parameter Selection" window pops up.-Click OK.-Error message "HTTP 500 (InternalServerError- Dump or unhandled exception in backend)" appears.-Cause-SalesPriceList is a generic BO which stores both Price and Discounts. Therefore, you need to use SalesPriceList BO to fire the query. As this BO stores both price and discount, it is mandatory to initialize the BO with the related groud cope and then execute your query.-You can initialize the BO by using query -> Query By Group Code. The below codes are:-PLPRICE1 - If you want to query price lists.-PLDISC1 - If you want to query discount lists.-PLALL1 - It will initialize with both, so you can query either discounts or prices.-Resolution-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Go to View-> Repository Explorer.-Select and expand business object SalesPriceList.-Select the query "QueryByGroupCode" and run operation Execute Query.-Fill in PLPRICE1, PLDISC1 or PLALL1 in the "Lower Boundary Value" field from the pop-up window.-Click OK.-After performing these steps, you are then be able to run the query you were initially trying to.-Note: Executing the SelectAll query does not require any parameters.-See Also-https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-q-a/how-to-query-discountlist-on-overall-customer-discounts-in-sap-c4c/qaq-p/549804-Keywords-QueryByGroupCode, SalesPriceList, Repository, Explorer, (PRC_SALES_PS, ROOT), A technical error occurred, (No business configuration to process the request):, PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 109

Title: Access Context Code Supported for Custom Business Object
Content: Symptom-You would like to know the access context code supported for custom business object.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-According to the SAP Cloud Applications Studio Help Documentation "Access Control Context (Business Object)", only Employee (1010) or EmployeeOrTerritory (1015) or SalesOrganization (9001)(C4C Only) can be used for PDI purposes:- "... the access context can only be either Employee or EmployeeOrTerritory or SalesOrganization..."-Resolution-This is the current system behavior. Please refer the SAP Cloud Application Studio Help Documentation for further references.-If the feature/functionality is needed as a matter of urgency, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.-See Also-SAP Cloud Application Studio Help Documentation-Keywords-Custom BO; Access Context Code; Access Restrictions; 1015; 1010; 9001

Title: Profit Center Is Missing In Journal Entry Of Supplier Invoice of Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-Profit center is missing in the journal entry of business transaction for intercompany.-You create a Supplier Invoice against an external party and have made the buying company as parent company ABC (ABC stands for the buying company).But, you charge it to the subsidiary company DEF (DEF stands for the subsidiary company). By doing this the parent company will receive the Account Payable and the subsidiary will receive the expense and the intercompany accounts will go on either side. The issue is that the credit side of the journal entry for company DEF will not get any profit center attached to it.-Meanwhile, you have assigned a default profit center against company DEF in the configuration and set the reporting principle as one of below:-Profit center and segment.-Profit center and segment, balancing.-Profit center and segment, clearing.-Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg.-Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg, balancing.-Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg, clearing.-Fund, profit center and segment, clearing.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find Supplier Invoice XYZ (XYZ stands for the supplier invoice ID).-Select Edit.-Select Actions > Simulate Journal Entry-On the Page Simulated, select the <simulated> for company DEF.-In the credit side of the journal entry, the profit center is missing under 'Item Details: General' and in the field 'Profit Center ID'.-Cause-Profit center derivation for clearing items on receiving company is not supported. The process works as intercompany clearing items are split based on taxitemgrp (tax item group) of purchase order item for leading company, the intercompany clearing items replaces the purchase order items of receiving company. So with this in the Journal Entry for receiving company profit center derivation would be based on the leading company which is not supported even though you have maintained the default profit center for the receiving company.-When you open the page 'Default Profit Center' in the Activity: Profit Center Derivation, for each company, you have maintained which profit center is derived by default for journal entry line items. You specify a default profit center for each subledger. The system applies the particular default profit center whenever it cannot automatically derive a profit center from the data stored in the source document.-However, in the scenario mentioned above, the profit center cannot be derived.-Resolution-This is the designed system behaviour.There is no profit center derived for journal entry of supplier invoices of intercompany scenario.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Profit Center, Intercompany Journal Entry, Journal Entry, Profit Center Missing.

Title: Tax Calculation for Applied Discounts on Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You created a Customer Invoice with Applied Discounts. Once the Journal Entry for this Invoice is posted, you notice that the system is calculating Tax for the applied discount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger WoC.-Open the Journal Entries view.-Search for the Journal Entry XYZ (ID of the Journal Entry created for the Customer Invoice).-Open the Journal Entry.-Check its Line Items, you will see that besides of the expected rows, there are 4 additional rows:-Two for the Applied discounts/penalties/sales discounts;-Two for Tax calculation on the discounts.-The postings(Journal Entry Line Items), is similar to the following lines:-(Amounts which are being used are for example purposes only)-Line 1: 1,806.41 Debit for Accounts Receivable Clearing Account-Line 2: 1,312.50 Credit for Accounts Receivable Domestic-Line 3: 643.91 Credit for Accounts Receivable Domestic-Line 4: 95.24 Debit for Penalties - Customer Invoice-Line 5: 47.62 Debit for Penalties - Customer Invoice-Line 6: 4.76 Debit for VAT (Sales and Use Tax Payable)-Line 7: 2.38 Debit for VAT (Sales and Use Tax Payable)- -Total Debit: 1,956.41-Total Credit: 1,956.41-Line Items details:-150 from Applied Discounts and Credits (Line 4 + Line 5), are from Incoming Check ABC. This value is being divided as the following:-Penalties - Customer Invoice: 95.24 (Line 4)-Penalties - Customer Invoice: 47.62 (Line 5)-95.24 + 47.62 = 142.86-VAT (Sales and Use Tax Payable): 4.76 (Line 6)-VAT (Sales and Use Tax Payable): 2.38 (Line 7)-4.76 + 2.38 = 7.14-You are not expecting a tax calculation for this Sales Discounts/ Penalties. Hence, the last two rows, are not wanted. The expected scenario, would be something like the following lines:-Line 1: 1,806.41 Debit for Accounts Receivable Clearing Account-Line 2: 1,312.50 Credit for Accounts Receivable Domestic-Line 3: 643.91 Credit for Accounts Receivable Domestic-Line 4: 100 Debit for Penalties - Customer Invoice (95.24 + 4.76 = 100)-Line 5: 50 Credit for Penalties - Customer Invoice  (47.62 + 2.38 = 50)- -Total Debit: 1.956,41-Total Credit: 1.956,41-  Cause-You are expecting a Net Procedure posting logic, however system is posting using Gross Procedure Logic, and that is the corrected behavior.-When a customer invoice is paid, the deducted cash discount is posted using the gross procedure. The VAT is corrected automatically for the payment date of the invoice. Cash discounts are always posted to a separate account for granted cash discounts.-Hence, it's the reason why there are postings on the Tax Accounts.-Gross Procedure:-If cash discount is taken from the gross amount also the tax amount has to be corrected when the cash discount is taken.-Net Procedure:-If cash discount is taken from the net amount, the tax amount is not discounted, therefore there is no correction of the tax amount required.-Resolution-If you want to decide whether for the country a backdated tax calculation should be processed or not, or to choose the account for cash discounts on costs and revenues, using the account determination, or even in case you want to change the Account Determination. You can do it by creating your own deduction reasons for Cash Discounts in the Work Center Business Configuration.-Steps to create your Deduction Reasons:-Go to Work Center Business Configuration.-Choose overview.-Open the Activity Reasons for Payment Differences.-Under Deduction Categories for Country DEF, choose the option Cash Discount.-You will find the activities for all countries for which you did your scoping.-Assign the deduction category Cash Discount to tax type Value Added Tax (VAT) in the work center Business Configuration.-Steps to Assign the Deduction Category:-Go to Work Center Business Configuration.-Choose Overview.-Open the Activity Tax Adjustments for Payment Differences.-You can now define for each Tax Country how the VAT is corrected if a Cash Discount is posted.-See Also-Discounts: Cash Discounts and Bonuses-Cash Discounts for Receivables in Financials-Keywords-Cash Discounts, Applied Discounts, Tax Calculation, Journal Entry, General Ledger, Customer Invoice, Sales Discounts, Receivables.

Title: Error SP CL_XREP_PROVIDER_UICOMP failed to process file in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create screens for your custom business object and you are facing the following error message:-Unable to save the content for file /Y1234567_MAIN/SRC/PQR /XXXX /XXXX_TT.TT.uidataobject in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT-Error SP CL_XREP_PROVIDER_UICOMP failed to process file in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT-Where (Y1234567 refers solution name) and ( PQR is the custom BO).-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign; SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Application Studio.-Open Solution Y1234567.-Open the respective custom business Object - Y1234567_MAIN/SRC/PQR.bo-Right click and choose create screens.-Select Thing Based Navigation and give some short text ID.-Error appears.-Cause-This issue happens when you have used special characters (&*"?/#$%) in the Definition of the business Object for which you are trying to create UI screens.-Resolution-In order to solve the issue, you need remove all special characters from your business object defination and activate the custom BO. After successfull activation it should be possible to create screens without any issues.-Keywords-SP CL_XREP_PROVIDER_UICOMP; Unable to create screens.

Title: Custom Change History Does Not Work
Content: Symptom-You have enabled the Change History for a Custom Business Object you created on SAP Cloud Applications Studio and you realized it stopped working.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer - All its versions-SAP Business ByDesign - All its versions-SAP Cloud Applications Studio - All its versions-Reproducing the Issue-For the Custom Business Object you have created a screen. In this screen, the following scenario is reproducible:--1. Modify one of the fields you configured as relevant for the Change History.-2. Save the document/screen by clicking on button Save.-3. Check the Change History tab.-4. You will see no change logs registered for the changes you have just done.-Cause-This can happen due to mis-communication issues between SAP Cloud Applications Studio and the Backend.-Resolution-On SAP Cloud Applications Studio, take the following steps:--1. Open your Custom Solution.-2. Activate the Custom Business Object responsible for this Custom Change History.-3.
