Deploy Business Configuration of this Solution by right-clicking on the Solution name -> Deploy Business Configuration.--This will resolve the miscommunication issues and the Change History may work normally afterwards.-See Also-Blog post: Change History for Custom Objects -https://blogs.sap.com/2017/05/22/change-history-for-custom-objects/-Keywords-Change; History; SDK; Cloud; Applications; Studio;

Title: FQDN being overwritten and deleted from step 2.1 Define HTTP Connectivity of infrastructure preparation - SAP Solution Manager 7.2
Content: Symptom- FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) being overwritten and deleted from step 2.1 Define HTTP Connectivity of infrastructure preparation.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Two instances on one host-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Solution Manager-Go to SOLMAN_SETUP-Select Infrastructure Preparation-Go to Step 2.1 Define HTTP Connectivity-Cause-There are two instances on one host and FQDNs are not set up properly.-Resolution-If there are two (or more) instances on one host please ensure that FQDNs are defined correctly in the instance profile. Multiple FQDN's defined causes outside discovery to switch them.-See Also- Diagnostics Agent 7.2 Outside Discovery Troubleshooting: https://wiki.scn.sap.com/wiki/x/Px-eGw

Title: How to Add an E-Mail with the Recipient Type CC or BCC to the E-Mail Output of a Document
Content: Symptom-Additional e-mail address needs to be added to the output e-mail of a document as CC or BCC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There are 2 ways to setup new e-mail addresses as To, Cc or Bcc for a business document:-By editing the output settings of the document and manually adding the E-mail addresses.-By inserting the E-mail addresses in the recipient business partner communication settings.-Resolution-For the first option of inserting the addresses manually for a single document, follow the steps below (in these steps, we will take as an example a Sales Order document):-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search and open the concerned document.-Click on the View All button.-Click on You Can Also.-Click on Edit Output Settings.-Here you will be able to insert new recipient e-mail address for this particular document.-  For the second option of setting up additional recipient addresses on the business partner level, which ensures that all documents sent to a particular business partner will also be sent to the desired additional e-mails, follow the steps below (in these steps, we will take as an example an Account):-Navigate to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search and open the Account ABC (ABC represents Account ID).-Navigate to the Communication tab.-Select the Collaboration sub tab.-Select the respective Business Document for which the output rule is being set up (for example, Sales Order Confirmation).-Ensure that in the below section, Output Channel Settings, the channel is selected as E-mail.-A new table will appear below, where you can add an E-Mail address and define the recipient Type, such as Cc or Bcc.-  For the third option of setting up an e-mail address for the recipient type "To" by maintaining additional recipient addresses at the business partner level, which ensures that all documents sent to a particular business partner are also sent to the required additional e-mail addresses, follow the steps below (the example below uses an Account):-Navigate to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for and open Account JKL (JKL represents the Account ID).-Go to the Communication tab.-Open the Collaboration subtab.-In the Customer Invoice / Credit Memo section, verify that no data is maintained.-In the Output Channel Settings section, ensure that the output channel is set to E-mail.-A new table appears, where an additional e-mail address can be added and the recipient type can be defined as "To".-Keywords-Output, Selection, Supplier, Account, Purchase Order, PO, Sales Order, SO, Sales Quote, Quote, Service Order, CC, BCC, E-mail, Customer Invoice, Credit Memo, Account

Title: India Withholding Tax Return: Different States and Address in Supplier Invoice Line Items
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release Withholding Tax Return XXX (where XXX represents the withholding tax return ID) for India.-An error related to a Supplier Invoice appears: "Source document ABC (where ABC represents the Supplier Invoice) reported in Tax Return XXX not posted".-You verify that the Supplier invoice is posted (for example via the Document Flow by checking the Journal Entry icon). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center - Withholding Tax Returns view.-Show Tax Returns in Preparation.-Highlight Tax Return ID XXX and press Release.-The Error Message "Source document ABC reported in Tax Return XXX not posted" appears.-Cause-In the Supplier Invoice line items exist with different Ship-To and the Delivery Address details. For India, all Invoice items must have the same location details.Also, make sure all the line items of the invoice should contain Ship-to value as it is mandatory.-Resolution-You have to cancel Supplier Invoice ABC and create two separate invoices per Ship-To and Delivery Address. -After the different invoices are posted, cancel the existing Withholding Tax Return XXX.-Schedule the Withholding Tax Return run again to create a new Withholding Tax Return ID YYY (where YYY represents the new Withholding Tax Return ID).-Release the newly created Withholding Tax Return ID YYY.-The Error Message no longer appears.-Keywords-India Withholding Tax, State, Ship To and Delivery Address Different, release Withholding Tax Return for India, Source document in Tax Return not posted

Title: Error: Kit Product not valid for Manual Purchase Requests
Content: Symptom-When creating a purchase request and adding a kit item head, error message "Kit Product not valid for Manual Purchase Requests" is triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Open New Purchase Request (Manual) common task.-In the New Purchase Request screen, navigate to Items tab.-Add a product which is kit head item.-See that error "Kit Product not valid for Manual Purchase Requests" is triggered.-Cause-Kit items are not supported in manual purchase request creation scenario.-Resolution-It is allowed to create purchase orders purchasing kit items. -System also allows third-party kit item procurement.-See Also-2464112 - Error Appears in the Purchase Order Containing kit Items-Keywords-Kit Item; Purchase Request

Title: Inbound Delivery Notification Still Displays in the Product Planning Details Screen While Following Inbound Delivery Has Been Released
Content: Symptom-In a product planning screen, there is an inbound delivery notification with status "Inbound Delivery Received", however, its following inbound delivery has been released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supply Planning.-Access view Products.-Search product ABC in planning area DEF, click Open.-In the screen "Product Planning Details: ABC/DEF", there is an inbound delivery notification IDN_1. Open it, it is not released and delivery not started.-Go to work center Inbound Logistics.-Access view Inbound Deliveries.-Open advanced filter, enter IDN_1 into filter Delivery Notification ID, click Go, in the result there is inbound delivery which is delivery finished and released.-Cause-Same inbound delivery notification ID is used twice by mistake: once when create new inbound delivery notification against purchase order, once when perform post goods receipt against the same purchase order.-The reproducing steps of this behavior:-Create inbound delivery notification IDN_1 against the purchase order. -Post goods receipt against this purchase order while maintain same ID IDN_1 as delivery notification ID.-or-Create inbound delivery notification IDN_1 against the purchase order. -Cancel IDN_1.-Post goods receipt against this purchase order while maintain same ID IDN_1 as delivery notification ID.-Undo cancellation for IDN_1.-After that, the inbound delivery notification IDN_1 becomes duplicated, and it has no following documents.-Resolution-Since delivery has been finished for related purchase order line items, inbound delivery notification IDN_1 can be canceled if no more goods receiving needed. After that, IDN_1 will disappear from product planning screen.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, Inbound Delivery, Product Planning

Title: Replace Product Button Grayed Out On The Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use the "Replace Product" functionality, but find the button grayed out in the Sales Orders-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Search for XYZ. (XYZ refers to the Sales Order ID)-Click on Edit and View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Replace Product Button is Grayed out for a Line Item.-Cause- Replace Product functionality is not provided, for line item types which are Project Based. For other item types, please find the status below:-Delivery Status Replace Product Functionality-Not Started Available-In Process Grayed Out-Finished Grayed Out-Resolution-Replace Product Button Functionality is available for all line item types except Project Based Item Types. The Replace Product button is grayed out for the Project based item Items. This is the current system behavior.-See Also-1725958 - How the Replace Product Functionality Works in the Sales Order-2694525 - Unable To Use Replace Product Functionality In Sales Orders -Keywords-"Sales Order", "Project","Replace Product"-sales order,project,replace product

Title: Duplicate Sales Order Confirmations
Content: Symptom-You send out sales order confirmations to customers.-Once a sales order confirmation is sent, the button is grayed out until the pricing information changes in the sales order.-In some cases you can generate the same sales order confirmation without any change.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order workcenter.-Select the Sales Order view.-Open sales order ABC (ABC represents the sales order ID).-Send Order Confirmation.-Do a dummy change on the sales order:-E.g.: Change the quantity from the original value to 0 and back.-You can now send another order confirmation.-Cause-The button is grayed out after a sales order confirmation is sent out.-It is set to active once there is a change in the sales order.-It includes dummy changes and extends to Mass Data Runs with dummy changes, e.g. Confirmation Update Run.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-See Also-1780437 - There Is No Document in the Output History for a Sales Order -Keywords-Sales Order Confirmation, Send Order Confirmation, Duplicate, Changes, Auftragsbestätigung, Duplikat, Änderungen

Title: Due Date Calculated Wrongly in the Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-Incorrect due date in the follow up credit memo. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice documents.-Search for Invoice ABC (ABC represents the Invoice ID).-Select the Invoice and click on Follow-up -> Manual Credit Memo.-In the new credit memo, the Due Date is taken over from the original invoice ABC instead of calculating it based on the Invoice Date mentioned in the new Credit Memo.-Cause-The due date for the follow up credit memo is picked from the original invoice document. -Resolution-This the current system design.-You can update the due date by making the dummy change to the Invoice Date in the credit memo or manually change the Payment Terms.-Keywords-due date; follow up credit memo; incorrect.

Title: Dump occurs during GST Return Reversal - India
Content: Symptom-The system's tax run calculation is different from GST portal's calculation. So, the VAT Return has to be reversed.-However, an error occurs when attempting to reverse the VAT Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Select the Tax Return ID 123 (123 refers to the Tax Return ID).-Click Reverse and the dump occurs.-Cause-The dump occurs because the VAT Return being reversed was already released for a previous month, and Tax Adjustments have been created for the subsequent month.-For example, the Tax Return 123 was released for April, and tax adjustments 1 and 2 were created in the system for the following month, May.-Resolution-To reverse Tax Return 123 for April, you must first reverse the tax adjustments created for May. Additionally, the tax return for May needs to be reversed before you can proceed with reversing the tax return for April.-To cancel the Tax Adjustments, follow these steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Adjustment sub view.-Select the Tax Adjustments 1 and 2.-Click Action —> Cancel to cancel the tax adjustment.-Note: It is a chain of events and the same issue might occur while trying to reverse the return for May month and the same follows for all the subsequent months. So, the same steps mentioned above has to be followed.-See Also-Tax Adjustments Quick Guide – India | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Dump, Error, Tax Return, Reverse VAT Return, GST Return Run, Tax Adjustment

Title: State code missing in JSON file
Content: Symptom-Unable to generate IRN in an Invoice Document due to State code missing in JSON file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select Invoice Documents view-In the drop-down select All Invoice Documents-Search for Invoice ID ABC (Where ABC represents the Invoice ID)-Click in Edit and View All-Go to Attachments section and open the JSON file-State code appears as NIL: "Stcd": "NI"-Legal Approval Status is still In Approval-Cause-When checking the account master data we can see that the State is maintained, however, when checking the Changes tab, we can see that the State has been deleted before the creation of the Customer Invoice, as a result the system cannot fetch the XML. -Resolution-To solve the issue, kindly change the JSON file to add the State Code and proceed with Legal Approval Process.-Keywords-Missing, NIL, India, does not appear, invoice, not available, does not exist.

Title: Preview of Statutory Report Journal Entry Voucher - China Shows Null For G/L Account Description
Content: Symptom-The preview of statutory report Journal Entry Voucher - China shows G/L Account description as null.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center General Ledger and view Periodic Tasks.-Go to subview Statutory Report and select Journal Entry Voucher - China.-Select any run, and select Next, can see there are entries in the running result showing correctly.-Select Preview, Journal Entry Voucher - China shows G/L Account description as null.-Cause-For the particular G/L Accounts, account description is not maintained in Chinese language, or the log on language is selected as 'EN'.-So when generating the preview of PDF, null value is getting displayed.-Resolution-Log on the system by selecting 'CN' language, and maintain G/L Accounts description in Chinese, and the preview would display correctly. -Keywords-preview statutory report, Journal Entry Voucher - China, null

Title: Invoice Summary Documents Are Showing Different IDs
Content: Symptom-Invoice Summary Runs creates two types of Invoices: Monthly Invoice and Payer Invoice.-They are both generated according to the following format: <account_id>-<Number of the Invoice for the Summary Invoice type>-<Year of creation> and have the same Number of the Invoice, both for Monthly and Payer Invoice.-However, it is noted that eventually the number generated for Monthly and Payer Invoice no longer match for the same period.-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Open Invoice Summary Documents view.-Notice that for the same Invoicing Period and for the same Account, the Invoice ID is different for Monthly and Payer Invoices, like in this hypothetical example below:-AAAAA-0000025-YYYY, for Payer Invoice-AAAAA-0000026-YYYY, for Monthly Invoice-(AAAAA stands for the Account ID, YYYY for the Year of Creation of it)-Cause-Parallel execution of more than one Invoice Summary Run can cause such documents to be generated with different IDs for the same period. It is recommended to avoid such practices.-Resolution-Open a case so that Product Support can evaluate the feasibility of a backend correction in order to fix the numbering sequence of the Invoice Summary generation.-See Also-2734176 - Summary Invoice Numbering Format Japan-Keywords-Invoice Summary, Japan, Numbering

Title: Wrong Price List Selected in the Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-Wrong price list is selected in the Sales Quote. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business - Sales Quotes work center view.-Click New -> Sales Quote.-Click on View All and navigate to Items tab.-Add a product, and you find the Price list selected is not the expected one.-Cause-The sales quote is created based on Gross Price and therefore system will consider the price from the Price list (Gross) maintained under Product and Service Portfolio. -Resolution-Go to New Business - Sales Quotes work center view.-Click New -> Sales Quote.-click Start Personalization Mode from top right menu.-Under General tab, select "Price in" field. This field is then added into the quote in General tab.-You can see, the Price In is Gross. -Price list selection in the document is based on this Price in value maintained. If the Price in is maintained as Gross, then system will consider only the gross price of price list and not the net price list.-See Also-This logic applies for other sales and service documents expect for Sales Quotes. -Keywords-Logic for Price list selection; unexpected price list; Price In; Gross; Sales Quote.

Title: Error While Unchecking Storage Location Indicator
Content: Symptom-The system throws an error message while unchecking the Storage Location indicator for location ID ABC (ABC represents the Location ID).-The error message reads: "Location must be inventory-managed because it has logistics areas".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Search for and Select Location ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Uncheck the Storage Location option under Roles.-The system throws the error "Location must be inventory-managed because it has logistics areas".-Cause-The error occurs because location ID: ABC has multiple logistics areas associated with it, even though their status is marked as Obsolete. Once logistics areas have been created and activated for a location, the Storage Location indicator cannot be unchecked, regardless of the logistics areas' current status.-Resolution-This behaviour is expected and designed in the system. To manage this situation, you can mark the location as Obsolete if it is no longer needed for active logistics processes.-Keywords-Storage Location Indicator, Uncheck, Error, Obsolete, Location,

Title: Missing Fixed Assets Causing Numbering Gap in Remaining Assets
Content: Symptom-A Fixed Asset XX (XX refers to the Fixed Asset ID) is missing.-The missing Fixed Asset XX (where XX refers to the Fixed Asset ID) is causing a gap in the numbering of the remaining fixed assets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Under All Fixed Assets, search for the Fixed Asset ID XX.-This Fixed Asset is missing causing a gap.-Cause-Fixed Asset XX might have been deleted, causing a gap in the numbering. -Resolution-Deleting a fixed asset will produce a gap in the numbering of the remaining fixed assets.-See Also-Fixed Assets Quick Guide | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Fixed Assets, Missing, Order, Deleted, Gap, Numbering

Title: Error Message: 'Account Determination is Missing for Item Type Purchase Account' while Posting Warehouse Confirmation
Content: Symptom-Error while trying to post Unposted Source Document ABC and the error is shown as:-Account Determination is missing for Item Type Purchase Account.-Specify Account Determination in Charts of Accounts: Chart of Accounts and Account Determination Profile.-Column Path Inventories->Purchase Account->Purchase Account, Item Type Purchase Account.-(Here ABC refers to Source document ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Select the Source document id ABC.-Error message shown-Account determination is missing for item type Purchase Account. Specify account determination in chart of accounts Chart of Account and account determination profile. Column Path Inventories->Purchase Account->Purchase Account, Item Type Purchase Account.-Cause-The error is due the missing Account determination for the combination of Account determination group for Materials and Account determination group for Suppliers.- Resolution-You need to maintain the combination of Account determination group for Materials and Account determination group for Suppliers. in the Business Configuration in the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune Activities.-Show All Activities and Find Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Choose the relevant Account Determination Profile,  Change Subledger to Inventories.-Go to the Purchase Account tab.-Enter Account determination group for Materials and Account determination group for Suppliers and maintain the G/L account under Purchase Account and Purchase Offsetting Account.-Now, you are able to post the document from unposted source document.-Keywords-Purchase Account, Item Type Purchase Account, account determination, Warehouse confirmation, unposted source documents

Title: Price List Is Not Triggered Automatically in Opportunity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an Opportunity but the Price List is not triggered Automatically-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the New Opportunity common task.-Fill up with the mandatory fields.-Add the Product ABC (ABC represents the Product ID).-Update the Extension Field.-Price is not determined automatically.-You have the Product ABC added in a Price List which created based on the Extension Field. However, the Price List is not triggered as expected.-Cause-The activity Configure Price Strategy allows the user to customize pricing behavior by manipulating various content.-Once you navigate inside the activity, you notice that there are two Pricing Procedures available for this activity: Standard Procedure and Standard Gross Procedure. These procedures are only used in CRM and by documents starting from Quote. This implies that any customizing option (such as maintaining Pricing Tables, Access Context, Extension Fields to influence Pricing) only apply to these procedures.-In the case of Opportunity, since the Pricing Procedure is 'Opportunity Procedure', the prices are computed based on Standard Price Lists only and no customization will be applied here (like pricing based on Extension Fields).-Resolution-If the user wants the Price List to be picked up for other CRM documents, then it's necessary to maintain data for any of the Standard Price Lists (Base Price Lists, Customer Specific Price List and so on).-See Also-KBA 2629779 - Price Manually Maintained on Opportunity Not Derived to Following Sales Quote or Sales Order-Keywords-Price List, Opportunity, Extension Field, Custom, Pricing Procedure, Base Price List

Title: Unable to Assign the Service Quote Approval Task to a User
Content: Symptom-System not showing the user while trying to manually assign the service quote approval task.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Go to the Business Task Management sub view.-Select the approval task for Service Quote ABC (ABC represents the Service Quote ID)-Click on Assign Item button-Search for the User XYZ (XYZ represents the Business User ID)-System shows No Record Found-Cause-The approver does not have the necessary Read and Write accesses to approve the Service Quote ABC created with the Service unit DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Service Unit).-Resolution-You can assign the work center view CRM_OPP_SRVQUO to the employee XYZ  using the following steps;-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Select the user XYZ .-Click on the Edit button and select the  Access Rights option.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Assign the work center view CRM_OPP_SRVQUO  to this user.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-For CRM_OPP_SRVQUO, ensure that both Read Access and Write Access are enabled for the corresponding service unit.-Save your changes.-See Also-KBA 2258753 - Employee Does not Appear in the Direct Approvers List of the Sales Quote or Sales Order Approval Process-Keywords-Manual task assignment, task unassigned,

Title: Expense Amount is Zero in Report Expense Reports - Expenses and Reimbursements
Content: Symptom-The key figure 'Expense Amount (excl. tax)' is zero for all items in report Expense Reports - Expenses and Reimbursements(FINERMU01_Q0002).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to List view.-Open report Expense Reports - Expenses and Reimbursements.-Select Country/Region Version: AAA and Company: BBB.-Apply and see the key figure 'Expense Amount (excl. tax)' is zero for all items.-(AAA represents the Country/Region Version ID. BBB represents the company ID.)-Cause-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for activity: Expense Reporting - Generic Country/Region Version-Click on Edit expense types.-Select the Country / Region Version AAA.-Under Definition tab, see that the field Payment / Taxation is filled with e.g. 'Payment Specified Individually per Expense (Flat Rate Tax)'.-For this value the key figure Reimbursement Amount in the report is not filled by design. Only Amounts, that are real Payments are calculated as reimbursement amounts. It is only filled for the following values that refer to real payments:-01           Reimbursement Amount (Payment, No Taxation)-03           Taxable Benefit Amount (Payment, Taxation)-06           Payment Specified Individually per Expense (No Taxation)-07           Payment Specified Individually per Expense (Taxation)-Resolution-Change the configuration for the expense types of country / region version AAA to one of the above values. Then the reimbursement amount will be filled in reporting.-Keywords-Expense report, Expense amount, Zero, No value, FINERMU01_Q0002

Title: Planned Quantity in Production Order Report Does Not Match BOM Quantity
Content: Symptom-In the report 'Production Orders by Header input,' the planned quantity does not match the Bill of Materials (BOM) quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Access view Design Data Sources. -Search "Production Orders By Header Input Products", click Preview.-Maintain Production Order ID.-Maintain Material ID.-Click Apply.-In the View Section, maintain the following:-Under Key Figures in Column fields, add:-'Planned Quantity'-'Fulfilled Quantity'-You will notice that the resulting report shows a Planned Quantity that differs from the Planned Quantity shown in the BOM.-Cause-The report aggregates the material from both the Supply Operation and the Make Operation, resulting in the discrepancy.-To better understand the breakdown, apply a filter within the report to display the Operation ID, which should illustrate the split.-Resolution-This is the system's expected behavior. The report's aggregation method combines quantities from multiple operations, which may result in the observed difference.-Keywords-Planned Quantity-BoM-Production Orders by Header input-Difference

Title: In OData Editor no Nodes in PlannedMaterialFlow Standard Business Object
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Custom OData for Business Object PlannedMaterialFlow but there are no nodes available for selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application and User Management workcenter and OData service view-2. Select Custom OData Services and click on New -3. Create a service and click on Select Business Object, Give BO Name: PlannedMaterialFlow-4. In BO Node Name you will encounter "No records found" -Cause-PlannedMaterialFlow BO doesn't have FSI foot print, hence it isn't available in OData nodes editor. -Resolution-Due to technical constraints on this BO, one can't build an OData service on this BO.-See Also-Material Flow, Supply Planning, Planned Material Flow, Custom Odata

Title: Recognize based on manual amounts - Previously Realized Revenue Deferred After Revenue Recognition run for Project Based Sales Order item after
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The revenue for sales order item XYZ-XX, net value 1500,00 LC,  is to be realised staggered via accrual method 106-Recognize based on manual amounts (XYX-XX represents a sales order item ID, LC stands for local currency). -You enter:-Valid From: 01.01.YYYY; Valid To: 31.01.YYYY; Recognized Revenue: 500,00 LC (accounting period 001/YYYY)-Valid From: 01.02.YYYY; Valid To: 28.02.YYYY; Recognized Revenue: 1500,00 LC (accounting period 002/YYYY). -The sales order item has been fully invoiced. -The associated project is closed. -The revenue is realised on the Sales Revenue account in period 002/YYYY. -When executing the revenue recognition run for period 003/YYYY, all the previously realised revenue is cleared again and posted back to the Deferred Revenue account. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Line items view. -Find item XYZ-XX. -Choose Reports and select Sales Document - Line Items for Project. -In the report you can see that all the manual revenue is realised up until period 002.YYYY (credited to the Sales Revenue account). -In period 003.YYYY the revenue is debited from the Sales Revenue account and credited to Deferred Revenue. -Cause-Sales Order item XYZ-XX is not completed for financial accounting (In the Sales Document Items view go to the Dates tab. Here, the Final Delivery date appears, because the project is closed, but the Final Delivery or Invoice Date field is empty). Therefore, all manual data is still considered by the revenue recognition run. -As the last manual revenue amount is only valid until 28.02.YYYY, the revenue is no longer to be realised from 01.03.YYYY, so that the revenue recognition run debits the sales revenue account and offsets the amount as deferred revenue (in case the item has been invoiced already) or accrued revenue (if no invoice exists yet). -Resolution-Either complete the sales order item for customer invoicing or-extend the validity of the last manual revenue entry to a date after the last day of the revenue recognition run's selected accounting period; You can also enter Unlimited (31.12.9999) to always consider this last entry until the sales order item is fully completed (final delivery or invoice date set). -To complete the item for invoicing: -In the Customer Invoicing work center go to the Project Invoicing - Sales Orders view. -Find sales order XYZ. -Press Change status and select Finish Invoicing. -After the sales order item is completed in finance all actual values (costs as well as invoices revenue) are realised and all deferrals and accruals are cleared. -To extend the manual revenue amount to unlimited: -In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view. -Find sales order item XYZ-XX. -Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and choose Recognized Costs and Revenues.-For the last Recognized Revenue enter Valid To date 31.12.9999 or Unlimited. -Press Save and close. -As long as the sales order item is not fully completed, the revenue recognition run will consider this last entry. -See Also- 3215064 - Revenue Recognition Run Does Not Consider Manual POC and Recognizes 100% Revenue Instead  - 2642788 - Revenue Recognition Run Does Not Realise Manual Revenue Recognition Data in Subsequent Periods- 2941250 - Manual Revenue Recognition Data Not Considered By Revenue Recognition Run-Keywords-recognize based on manual amounts, revenue not relialized

Title: Document Type "Cancellation Invoice" does not appear under Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing for countries Peru and Colombia
Content: Symptom-Unable to define a document numbering format for countries Peru and Colombia.-    Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing activity.-Open the activity.-Select Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing.-Click on the Define document numbering formats for other countries hyperlink.-In the drop-down list of the field Document Type the option "Cancellation Invoice" is not available for countries Peru and Colombia.-Cause-Since Document Type "Cancellation Invoice" is not a mandatory legal requirement, this feature/functionality is currently not available in the system for the countries Peru and Colombia.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-If you need the feature provided by SAP, it has to be submitted in the Customer Influence portal.-Keywords-Invoice, missing, not available, new request, does not exist.

Title: Service Order with Cancelled Item Still Shows under Order Pipeline View
Content: Symptom-Service Order is still visible under Field Service and Repair - Order Pipeline View, even if the execution status for each item is Finished or Release Cancelled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Field Service and Repair Work Center.-Navigate to Order Pipeline View.-Select Option All Orders to be Executed.-Search for the Service Order, then the record can be found. You can see the Service Order is in status In Process.-Select the record and go to Services and Spare Parts Tab under the view, you understand that the execution status for each item is Finished or Release Cancelled.-Cause-If a Service Order is still in the "In Process" status, it will continue to be shown in the Order Pipeline under the following conditions:-The Delivery Status of the Item is not "Finished"-The Status of the Service Order is not "Completed"-Therefore, if an item is cancelled in a Service Order, the Delivery Status will be "Not Started" and the Service Order will still be displayed in the Order Pipeline.-Resolution-The Service Order with the cancelled item will be removed from the Order Pipeline View only when the Service Order has the "Completed" status at the header level. This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-3364624 - Service Order status in Order Pipeline View of Field and Service Repair work center is not as expected-Keywords-Service Order, Order Pipeline, Release, Cancelled, Delivery Status

Title: Gaps on Data Extraction - Open Items Receivables / Payables
Content: Symptom-The open Items Receivables/ Payables Data Extraction worksheet has a large number of data gaps in the Withholding Tax Data tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Click on Data Extraction view.-Click New.-Select Extraction Object - OPEN_ITMS_RECEIVABLE - Open Items Receivable or OPEN_ITMS_PAYABLE - Open Items Payable. -Mark the Check-box "Package Active", and enter the Package Size (Instance).-Click "Active and Run".-Open the XML file in the Excel Microsoft application. -Go to the "Withholding Tax Data" tab. -Here you will find all the companies with data and a large number of data gaps in the sheet. -Cause-This happens when no company code is selected in the data extraction run Selection Criteria. In this case, the system will extract data from all companies that have data to be extracted.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The Data extraction must have at most two companies selected as Selection Criteria when creating the run. If more than two companies are selected due to a huge amount of data the system creates these gaps. -See Also-KBA: 3329524 - Data Extraction - Open Items Receivable / Payables -Keywords-Data Extraction - Open Items Receivable, Data Extraction - Open Items Payables, Gaps, Empty Fields, Missing Data, Withholding Tax Data

Title: How to Check the Payment Baseline Date in a Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-In some cases, you are getting error message that "payment baseline date should be same as or after document date". So you want to know how the PaymentBaseLineDate is set in CRM documents, like customer invoice. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-n/a-Cause-PaymentBaseLineDate is only visible in backend. it is not displayed in UI.  The error is caused mainly by the following 2 scenarios.-case 1, the Invoice was created out of another existing invoice and the PaymentBaseLineDate has been carried over from the previous document by the System without updating the Invoice Date. -case 2, This might have happened due to a delay when importing the document with a web service into ByDesign. -Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-In case you face error about PaymentBaseLineDate, you may create a support case to SAP.-See Also-3235096 - "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date" Error Raised in Customer Invoice-Keywords-Baseline Date After Document Date; Unposted Customer Invoice; Process Communication error baseline date; Payment Baseline Date.

Title: Mass Data Maintenance: Import/Export Suppliers option not available
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the Mass Data Maintenance work center the Supplier options Import & Export are not available.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-The options to Import/Export Customers and Materials are available but the option for Suppliers is missing.-Cause-The processing Business User is missing the work center Supplier Bank Details Authorization BPM_SUPP_EDIT_BANK Access Restriction.-Resolution-If a Business User needs access to Import/Export Suppliers in Mass Data Maintenance, the Business User requires the work center Supplier Bank Details Authorization.-This work center allows editing of Supplier Bank Details, and it is currently not possible to allow Mass Data Maintenance of Suppliers while restricting the Business User's ability to edit Supplier Bank Details.-Keywords-Supplier Bank Details Authorization; BPM_SUPP_EDIT_BANK; Supplier; Import; Export-work center supplier bank details,supplier options import & export,mdm

Title: Error Occurs While Trying to Change the end Date of the Project Task
Content: Symptom-An error occur when attempting to change the end date of the project task to DD.MM.YYYY. -Error - End date of work must be before earliest finish date of task-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Project Management work center-2. Go to Projects view-3. Choose the relevant Project and select the Project Task -5. Navigate to the Work tab-6. Change the End Date -7. The error appears-Cause-In order to enter the end date of the project task, you have to enter the Finish Constraint Date and then click on Schedule button. Now system schedules Earliest Finish date and later you can Change the end date. -Resolution-You can follow the below steps to maintain the end date. -1. Go to Project Management work center-2. Select Projects view-3. Choose the relevant Project -4. Go to the project plan tab-5. Select the relevant Project Task -6. Go to the Scheduling sub tab-7. Enter Finish Constraint Date and click on Schedule button-9. The system schedules Earliest Finish date -10. Go back to Work tab-11. Change the End Date -12. Select Save-Keywords-Project Management, Project Task, End Date, Error, Earliest Finish Date, Schedule, Work Tab, Finish Constraint Date; End date of work must be before earliest finish date of task

Title: Multiple Registered Products Can be Created With the Same ID
Content: Symptom-It is possible to create two or more Registered Products with the same ID when they are related to different Reference Products.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Service Entitlements Work Center.-Go into Registered Products View.-Click on New -> Registered Product.-On the Registered Product ID Field, enter ID DEF (DEF represents the ID of an existing Registered Product).-Enter a Reference Product (It must be different than the Reference Product for the Registered Product DEF).-Click on Save.-The system allows the creation of duplicated Registered Products IDs for different Registered Products, and it is successfully saved.- Cause-The definition of same Registered Product ID is allowed to components with different Reference Products, Since the ID is made up of both Reference and Registered Product.-Therefore, the system will only trigger an error message when trying to create two Registered Products with the same ID and same Reference Product.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -See Also-SAP Help Portal: Registered Products Quick Guide - "Register a product" section, item 5:-Register a Product-Keywords-registered product, id, duplicated, multiple, reference product, products, register, service entitlements, byd.

Title: Error Reported by Application: Creation of Service Confirmation Not Possible; Inconsistent Reference
Content: Symptom-"Error reported by application: Creation of service confirmation not possible; inconsistent reference" while sending webservice to create service confirmation. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management - Business Communication Monitoring.-Select Business Messages with Error.-Select the line with Content error.-The Message Status Information shows as below:-Error reported by application: Creation of service confirmation not possible; inconsistent reference.-Cause-The service confirmation cannot be created via webservice because the reference contract ABC is Completed/Expired. (ABC represents the reference contract ID for which the service confirmation need to be created)-Resolution-Once the reference contract is Completed/Expired, then it is not possible to create a service confirmation from the contract. You can mark the Business Communication message as complete and contact the responsible person for the inbound communication service Customer Contracts - Managed Service consumption Integration. And inform that the reference to a completed/Expired contract should be excluded in the calling program.  - Keywords-service confirmation; Creation of Service Confirmation Not Possible; creation failed; web service.

Title: PDI solution check items dump.
Content: Symptom-When checking items in PDI solution check fails with below error.-HTTP 500 (internalServerError) - Dump or unhandled exception in backend.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Login into Cloud Application Studio.-Open PDI solution.-Under Repository explorer right click on PDI solution.-Check All Items.-Check failed with below error.-     HTTP 500 (internalServerError) - Dump or unhandled exception in backend.-   Cause-PDI solution being Huge.-Resolution-To perform the Check for huge Solution it is recommended to perform 'Enable Background Mode' and then do Solution Check.-1. Login to SDK.-2. Open Solution.-3. Right-click on the Solution in Solution Explorer.-4. Click on Check > Enable Background Mode.-5. You can perform the solution level check now.-6. To find the logs of the check you can click on 'Display Logs'.-Please note It may take hours to run the solution check as the solution is huge.-Keywords-PDI, http 500, Solution, huge, Enable Background Mode, Check items

Title: Technical error AP_SPRQ_T100_MSG 085
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Technical error AP_SPRQ_T100_MSG 085.-ABC = Customer Demand ID.-Environment-Source: byd-Type: Productive System-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign 2311-System managed by: SAP Cloud Tenant--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control WoC.-Go to Customer Demand View.-Search for Customer Demand ABC.-Select the Desired Customer Demand Line.-Click Actions >> Check Availability.-The User Receives the below Errors:-  "Saving supply planning requirement not possible; internal inconsistencies"-"Technical error AP_SPRQ_T100_MSG 085; report an incident"-"Errors during activation of supply planning requirement item"-"Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions"- Cause-The issue was caused by live cache problem for SPRs(Supply Planning Records).- Resolution-To Correct the Error you need to Create an Incident where the Development team (AP-CR-ATP) will Correct this issue via Backend report APSPR_DEL_PROV_AVAIL_CONF_ITEM.-This Corrects the Caching Issue.-Keywords-Check Availability AP_SPRQ_T100_MSG 085 internal inconsistencies

Title: Cambodian Khmer Fonts are not Shown Correctly
Content: Symptom-After providing e.g. Cambodian Khmer fonts, the Preview still does not show the correct fonts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The Support of Sinhalese and South East Asian languages (Khmer, Lao and Burmese) on Adobe Document Services is very limited, and the behaviour seen in the output will remain uncertain for the complex characters.-Resolution-As of now, there is a limited support for Sinhalese and South East Asian languages (Khmer, Lao and Burmese).-   Keywords-Cambodia Fonts, Asian Fonts, Preview, Vorschau.

Title: Error in Purchase Request : Account determination group is missing for product category
Content: Symptom-Error: Account determination group is missing for product category , in the Purchase Request-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Search for Purchase Request. -Select all the items present in the Purchase Request individually and add the desired Product Category.-Click on check to see the error : Account determination group is missing for product category.-Cause-Item Type of Items in the Purchase request are Material, but in the fine-tune activity - Default Account Determination Groups for Product Categories, for the product category used in Purchase request, the maintained default account determination group is for services but not for materials. -Hence the error is thrown. -Resolution-Follow below steps to view and modify the account determination group maintained for Product category of Service or Material :-Then go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Overview view.-Select the fine-tune activity Default Account Determination Groups for Product Categories.-Choose View.-Here we can view the Product Category ID, Product Category Description , Default Account Determination groups for Materials and Services. -Account determination groups can be added / updated for the Materials or Services here.-     See Also-1597417 - Error: Account determination group is missing for product category-Keywords-Account determination group is missing for product category, account determination for services, account determination for materials

Title: Project Invoice Request can be Created Even Though Sales Order is in Approval
Content: Symptom-It is possible to create and release a Project Invoice Request even though the preceding Sales Order is in Approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Select Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales order which is linked to the Project).-The Approval Status is In Approval.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Project Invoicing view.-Select the Sales Orders sub view.-Select Sales Order ABC.-Click on New -> Manual Project Invoice Request.-Enter the respective data.-Click Finished. -Click on the Release Project Invoice Request DEF and close hyperlink (DEF represents the ID of the Project Invoice Request you created). -The creation and release of the Project Invoice Request is allowed even though the Sales Order is in Approval.-Cause-It is currently possible to create and release a Project Invoice Request even though the Sales Order is in Approval since there is no check on Project Invoice Request side implemented that checks for the Approval Status of the related Sales Order. -Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-This requirement has been added to the Product Backlog in order to enhance the functionality with this feature in one of the future product releases.-Please note that we cannot make binding statements in regard to the scope of this development and when it will become available.-Good to know: New feature requests can be placed in the Influence Place: SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-project invoice request, approval, approval process, sales order, status, changes, pir, project, in approval, approval status

Title: Release of returns 'With Credit Memo' Button Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-You Release a Customer Return and notice that the 'With Credit Memo' Button is Greyed Out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to Returns View.-Search for and Select Return XYZ (XYZ represents the Return ID).-Click Edit.-Click Release (To see Dropdown options).-You will see that 'With Credit Memo' Option is greyed out.-   Cause-The reason that the customer can not see the option is because the Invoice Requests have already been created for this return.-Resolution-The customer can see the Invoice requests via the Customer invoicing Work Center and Invoice Requests View.-Keywords-With Credit Memo, Customer Return, Invoice Request, Greyed out, Sales Order

Title: Cancel Tax Return with Completed Status
Content: Symptom-An error is discovered in a VAT Return that has a status of Completed. This VAT Return needs to be canceled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Select the Tax Return ID 123 (123 refers to the Tax Return ID).-The Tax Return Status is 'Completed'.-Due to an error in the tax return, cancellation of the tax return is necessary.-Cause-A VAT return with the status Completed, for which an externally-initiated tax payment has already been triggered, can only be canceled if the payment allocation in the Payment Management work center is removed. However, a VAT return cannot be canceled if payment clearing has already been completed.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-VAT Returns Quick Guide | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-VAT Return, Status, Completed, Canceled, Tax Return

Title: Error: 'Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported' Occurs When Entering a Service into a Service Order
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs when entering a Service into a Service Order:-Item XX: Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Click on New and select Service Order.-Enter the respective account.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add Service XYZ (XYZ represents the Service ID).-The following error message occurs:-Item XX: Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported-Cause-In order to use the item type RSTM - External Service – Time and Material in a Service Order the following scoping question needs to be answered with Yes:-Do you want to integrate with purchasing processes for externally fulfilled service and expense items in service orders?-Resolution-You can find the scoping question as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the step Questions.-Expand the following elements:-Service -> Service and Repair -> Service Order-In the section Third Party Field Service and Repair the respective question is: Do you want to integrate with purchasing processes for externally fulfilled service and expense items in service orders?-See Also-KBA 3216002 - Error: Item XX: Products with item group XYZ not supported-Keywords-RSTM; Service; item type; item group; time and material; external service; not supported;

Title: Unable To Find Custom Form Template In The Form Template Maintenance Work Center
Content: Symptom-Custom form template is not available in the Form Template Maintenance work center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to the Form Template Maintenance view.-Select Advanced filter & Search for the Template Group.-Select Go.-No results found.-Cause-The cause for the behavior is the corresponding language is not scoped.-Resolution-The resolution for this issue is to scope the corresponding language for the custom form template.-For example if the language is spanish, follow below steps:--1. Go to the Business Configuration work center.-2. Select relevant project.-3. Choose on edit project scope.-4. Select next & navigate to questions section.-5. Drill down to Built-in Services and Support and then further to Business Environment.-6. Select Addresses and Languages element.-7. Under the Questions for Addresses and Languages select: Do you need Spanish as a solution language? -8. Scope the option & save the changes.-Keywords-Custom Form Template, Unable to find, Displaying in the UI

Title: Product Specification Field Not Available in Service Documents
Content: Symptom-Product specification field is missing in service documents (service request, service quote, service order).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders - Service Order Processing work center view.-Edit the Service Order ABC (ABC represents the service order ID).-Under Items tab, the Product specification field is not enabled. -Cause-Currently Product specification field is enabled only under sales documents and production documents-Therefore Product specification field is not available under service desk and service order functionality. -Resolution-The feature/functionality is currently not part of the SAP product you have subscribed to, as outlined in our Product Documentation.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-product specification; product specification not enabled; service quote; service order; service desk.

Title: Code list values from drop down field is missing on the UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have built a .codelist or BCO used as data type for a field and the drop down values are missing during runtime.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Select the content element of your bound field in the data model tab from the UI Designer screen and change the Codelist Type property from static to dynamic.-Then save and activate the screen in the UI Designer.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, code, list, drop, down, field, values, missing

Title: Following Error Occurs when Adding an Item or Changing the Quantity in a Sales Order: Item XX: Could not calculate result; result exceeds defined value range
Content: Symptom-Following Error Occurs when adding an item or changing the quantity of an item in Sales Order ABC: Item XX: Could not calculate result; result exceeds defined value range (ABC represents the Sales Order ID and XX represents the Line Item Number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order ABC.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Line Item XX-Change the quantity to 10 (10 is used as an example).-The following error occurs: Item XX: Could not calculate result; result exceeds defined value range-Cause-This error occurs because an extension field with type Decimal is set up in the system as a calculated field and the result of the calculated value exceeds the length for which it is set up for.-In our example when changing the quantity of Line Item XX to 10 the error "Item XX: Could not calculate result; result exceeds defined value range" is caused by the  extension field XYZ (XYZ represents the ESR Name of the extension field).-This error occurs because extension field XYZ is a calculated field and with type Decimal in your system that is set up for a totally length of 5 (this includes the number of decimals) and decimals of 2 but the value in this field if, you select the quantity 10 for line item XX, is determined as 1151.04 which has a length of 6 and therefore exceeds the length 5.- Resolution-Since the length of an extension field cannot be changed the solution is:-  - either ensure that no value that has a greater length of 5 is passed.-- or you need to remove the extension field and create a new extension field with a greater length as per the customers requirement.-Keywords-KUT; Extension Field; PDI; Decimal; Calculated Field; Calculation; Length; greater than; exceeds

Title: Activity which supports change immediately cannot be changed immediately
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When opening an activity which can be changed immediately, the system throws the message "Activity is read only. To edit this activity, add it to your project" and the activity cannot be edited directly.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration -> Overview.-Open the issued activity which is marked as Immediate Change Possible like Return Reason Code.-Click Change immediately or Open the activity.-Cause-The activity is missing from backend table BCTD_WSACTIVITY. -Resolution-Access the backend of the issue tenant.-T-code SE16.-Input BCTD_WSACTIVITY and press Enter.-Click Execute (F8).-Here, find the ELEMENT_ID of the issued activity.-The field IS_WORKITEM is empty which means that the Business Activity was not added to main workspace.-Select the issued activity and click Change (F6).-Change the value in field IS_WORKITEM as X.-Save-Keywords-Immediate Change Possible, SE16, BCTD_WSACTIVITY, IS_WORKITEM, Activity is read only

Title: Invoice Reference Number (IRN) Field is Not Visible in Customer Invoice Header Data Source
Content: Symptom-Invoice reference number (IRN) field is not shown in "Customer Invoice Header" Data sources. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics - Design Data Sources-Select "Customer Invoice Header" Data source -Execute the report with Invoice ID-Search for Invoice Reference Number field-Invoice Reference Number field is missing in the data source-Cause-Invoice reference number is linked with Legal Approval Number in the data source. -Resolution-You need to use "Legal Approval Number" field in the data source to fetch the Invoice reference number (IRN) of the Invoice. -Keywords-Invoice reference Number 'IRN' field; IRN; Customer Invoice Header; Customer Invoice Item; Data Source.

Title: 'Exchange Rate Country Currency/Currency on DD/MM/YYYY missing for currency conversion' in Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are trying to invoice an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request, however you are unable because the Sales Order Invoice Request in Inconsistent due to the error: 'Exchange Rate Country Currency/Currency on DD/MM/YYYY missing for currency conversion'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use the following currencies: Turkish Lira and Netherlands Euro.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Select the Sales Order Invoice Request ABC.-Status: Inconsistent.-Click Check.-Error: Exchange rate Turkish Lira/Euro on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion.-Cause-The system is determining Euro from the Tax Country.-The Tax Country is determined based on the Ship-From party.-In this example, since the ship-from is based on the Netherlands, the system automatically determined the Tax Country as Netherlands and Netherlands uses Euro as currency.-Therefore you are not able to invoice as Tax Country is also taken to the Invoice document and Tax Country is used for the currency conversion.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In order to correct this, please perform one of the following:-You have to maintain Exchange rate for the target currencies, in this example it is Turkish Lira/Euro.-or-Another option would be changing the Tax Country for the relevant Sales Order, if the Tax Country cannot be changed, you need to maintain Exchange rate.-See Also-2638285 - Error While Releasing a Sales Order: 'Exchange rate US Dollar/Tenge on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion'-2829011 - "Exchange rate XXX / YYY on ZZ/ZZ/ZZZZ missing for currency conversion" Error In Intercompany Scenario.-1961446 - Error Message: Exchange rate Country/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion-Keywords-Sales Order, Invoice Request, Exchange Rate, Missing, Currency Conversion, Exchange, Rate, Currency, Euro, Dollar, Ship-From

Title: You can Change the Address of the Ship-to Location, however, You are Not Permitted to Change the Country
Content: Symptom-A document flow for Third-Party Inter Company has been created. The user cancels release and re-release  the standard Outbound Delivery due to actual business needs. However, an unexpected error occurs as below when re-releasing the Third-Party Delivery Notification (TPOP IDN).-'You can change the address of the ship-to location, however, you are not permitted to change the country;-The ship-to party must be located in the same country as the ship-to party.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Navigate to the Third-Party Delivery Notifications View.-Search for the inbound delivery notification.-Click on Release, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-In the first Sales Order of the Third-party Inter company scenario, the Name of Ship-To is maintained as a Contact Person for the Account and the Contact Person only has a Business Address.-Open the first Sales Order.-Open the master data of the field Name of Ship- To in General Tab.-Navigate to Relationships - Relationships Subtab, it is notice that it's a contact person for the business partner, the account in the Sales Order.-Navigate to Address Tab, it is notice that the business address comes from the account.-In this scenario, when the ship to location is changed during the action release and undo release of TPOP IDN, the address of the ship to party is deleted, causing inconsistency in TPOP IDN.-Resolution-The development team is aware of the issue and has created an internal incident to fix it in a future release. However, we cannot provide a specific timeframe at the moment.-Adding a main person address to the contact person is NOT recommended as a workaround. Although it may prevent the system from reporting the error when releasing the TPOP IDN, it will change the ship-to address to the main personal address. This is not aligned with the actual business needs, as the main personal address and the business address should be different. Therefore, it is not suitable for the business requirements.-Since this is a rare scenario, before the issue is fixed from code side, the Best and Only way to correct this issue is through backend correction, please submit a case and authorize SAP to release the TPOP IDN and its follow-up documents by backend correction.-See Also-2852086 - Third Party Inter Company Scenario-Keywords-Ship-to Party, Ship-to Location, Country, Third-party Inter company, Third-Party Delivery Notifications, Release, Contact Person, Account, Business Partner, Business Address, Main Personal Address, Change, Address.

Title: Old documents are picked up in the new Tax Return Run
Content: Symptom-You notice some old documents from previous period included in the VAT Return. You expect that only documents from the periods informed in the VAT Return run to be picked up.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center > VAT Returns view-Search for the Tax Return ID "123" and open it-Click View All-Go to Tax Return tab-Select the Tax Box Code "X" and click Details-You notice documents from previous periods included in the VAT Return-"123" refers to the Tax Return ID-"X" refers to the Tax Box Code ID-Cause-Since the previous VAT Returns are still In Preparation status, the system is considering the pending amount in new VAT Return.-Go to Tax Management Work Center > VAT Return Runs view-Search for the Run ID "ABC"-Under Details, select "All Logs"-Click the Application Log ID "DEF" hyperlink-Go to Results tab-You see the message "Corrected items found and included in the current return"-"ABC" refers to the Run ID-"DEF" refers to the Application log ID-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Since the previous VAT Returns are still in "In Preparation" status, the documents are included in the current run.-See Also-KBA 2560467 - Old Tax Return Items Are Picked up in New Tax Return Run in Country UK -Keywords-VAT return, run, items, pick, include, picked, included

Title: Right of Use Asset Depreciation Run Message: For the selected fixed assets, posting not required in set of books
Content: Symptom-A depreciation run, executed for a Right Of Use Asset (RoU Asset) finished with info message: 'For the selected fixed assets, posting not required in set of books ABC' (ABC represents the Set of Books ID).-When checking the ROU asset's depreciation overview there are no depreciation values displayed.-However, the Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow report correctly calculates depreciation values for each period of the lease contract's life time. -You cannot trigger a recalculation adjustment for the ROU asset as the option is greyed out. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Depreciation view.-Find and open the respective run ID. executed for ROU asset XYZ (XYZ represents the ROU asset's ID). -Go to the Messages tab. -Notice the information message 'For the selected fixed assets, posting not required in set of books ABC'-You check the associated lease contract's cash flow to verify the depreciation calculation: -In the Lease Contract Management work center go to the Lease Contract view. -Find lease contract DEF (DEF represents the lease contract ID) and select it.-Press Reports and choose Cash Flows. -In the report check the Depreciation Company Currency column. -Here, the expected depreciation values appear for each period of the lease contract's/ ROU asset's life time. -However, in the ROU asset master data, the depreciation values are not displayed: -In the Fixed Assets work center go to the Fixed Assets view. -Find ROU XYZ (or access the ROU from the lease contract's lease Objects tab)-Press Edit and choose Values. -In the Depreciation Overview tab there are no depreciation values displayed. The 'No records found message' appears. -You try to trigger a recalculation for the ROU asset:-In the Fixed Assets work center go to the Fixed Assets view. -Find ROU XYZ (or access the ROU from the lease contract's lease Objects tab)-Press Edit and choose Values. -Under Valuation Values per Set of Books press Values: Here. the Recalculate Adjustment option is greyed out. -Cause-An inconsistency exists for the ROU asset that prevented the lease management accounting application to store the depreciation values into the ROU asset. -For ROU assets the Recalculate Adjustment option is not available in the user interface. -Resolution-Send a case to Support to request a recalculation adjustment from the backend. -Keywords-RoU asset; right of use asset, depreciation missing, ROU asset no depreciation, depreciation overview no records found

Title: Row Fields are not available for Selection in Custom DataSource
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Row Fields are not available under Row Selection while trying to View a Data Source-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer Add ins -Reproducing the Issue- Login to Frontend UI-Navigate to Business Analytics WorkCentre-Open Design Data Sources WorkCentre View-Search for the Custom Data Source and then Click on Preview-Click on View and then Click + for Row Fields-No Fields available for selection-Cause-There is a technical inconsistency in the Data Source.--Resolution-Firstly, Confirm if the Fields are available in the backend:--Copy the Data Source ID from the Documentation ( In the UI, Search For the Data Source > Click on Documentation)--MDRS:-MDAV > Search for the Data Source ID > Double Click on it-   -1.
