If they are available perform the below steps:--Utilities > Invalidate Runtime Object.-See Also-2593082 - Error in Report: Message E R7 245 Cannot Be Processed In Plug-in Mode HTTPS-Keywords-DataSource Fields Unavailable, MDAV, Row Fields Issue

Title: Error "Bank details alr. used in ABC paymts, for instance in paymt XYZ" While Replicating Employee
Content: Symptom- *** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -• User encounter the error  "Bank details alr. used in ABC paymts, for instance in paymt XYZ" While Replicating Employee -(ABC represents the number of payments, and XYZ represents one of the payment names) during employee replication. -• Image / Data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the employee name.-Check the log of user created replication request.-Observe the error "Bank details alr. used in ABC paymts, for instance in paymt XYZ".-Cause-An existing bank ID for the employee is already used in payments like XYZ, visible in the Payment Management work center under the Payment Monitor view.-A different bank ID is sent to ByD via the replication request, which does not include the bank already existing in ByD. -During replication, the system attempts to create the new bank from the replication request and delete the existing bank. However, the deletion fails because the existing bank details are already used in payments. -Replication requests treat any details not included in the request as a delete action. -Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-bank ID error, employee replication, payment monitor, replication request, bank details conflict, ByD system behavior, payment error, employee data replication, bank ID mismatch, payment management, replication failure, bank deletion error, system replication, bank ID validation, employee data error

Title: Error "Base amount and tax amount have different sign" Shows in the External Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You created one external invoice request through web service. In the ByDesign system, the external invoice request is inconsistent status with error:Base amount and tax amount have different sign. However, the total amount of the invoice is zero. You want to know why the error triggers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to customer invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select invoice request ABC. It is an external invoice request with inconsistent status.-Open the invoice request ABC and click View All, you see the error "Base amount and tax amount have different sign".-ABC represents the ID of the external invoice request.-Cause-The external invoice request was created with Credit Memo Item and Invoice Item. Even though the gross total is zero, system still calculates the base amount (Item Net Value) and tax amount, and check the amount sign. In case the different sign found, system reports the error. -In case here, the sum of the Item Net Value is 0.01 and the sum of item Value Added Tax (%) is -0.01.-Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-You will need to ensure the base amount and tax amount are having same sign. Or you can split the credit memo item and invoice item into 2 different payloads, it will create 2 external invoice request, and no diff sign will be found in one document.-Keywords-External Invoice Request; Credit Memo Item; Invoice Item; Different sign; Base amount and tax amount have different sign.

Title: Maximum number of Budget Categories in SAP ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-For implementing the active budget control functionality, it is important to know if there is a maximum limit on the number of budget categories that can be created in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Budget Queries.-Click on Edit G/L account groups for reporting.-You want to know the maximum number of Budget Categories that can be added.-Resolution-There is no technical limit on the number of budget categories that can be created in SAP Business ByDesign. However, from a business perspective, creating an excessive number of budget categories may lead to confusion.-See Also-Active Budget Control in SAP Business ByDesign – B... - SAP Community-Keywords-Budget Categories, Maximum number of budget categories, Limit, Budget Queries.

Title: Inability to Filter by Return to Supplier Number in Customer Return Notification Screen
Content: Symptom-Users are unable to filter by the Return to Supplier number in the "New Customer Return Notification" screen when attempting to process inter-company returns. Despite entering the Return to Supplier number in various fields, no results appear.-'ABC' = Return to Supplier ID. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select "New Customer Return Notification" under Common Tasks.-Enter Return to Supplier ID ABC in the Outbound Delivery ID field.-Click "Go."-Observe that no results appear.-Cause-This functionality is not currently possible within the system.-Since the two companies act as separate entities within the system in the inter-company scenario, the Customer Return cannot be linked with the Return to Supplier of the other company.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Inter-Company-Customer Return Notification-Return to Supplier-Error

Title: Unable to change the Person Responsible in the Project due to an Error
Content: Symptom-System error in the project when they changed the person responsible.-Error "Employee XXX is not employed by company YYY at project start date"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Search for relevant project-Choose Edit-Change the name in "Person Responsible " -Cause-Standard System Behavior-Resolution-If the service agent needs to be assigned as the 'Person Responsible' for the project, it is important to ensure that the supplier of the service agent is not the same as the project company.- Keywords-Employee is not employed by company at project start date; Error in project; change of person responsible in project;

Title: Depreciation Calculation with Depreciation Method L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0
Content: Symptom-For the Fixed Asset ABC, Depreciation starts from the year YYYY.-A Manual Write Down for Fixed Asset ABC by defining Depreciation Method L010 - Str.-line from acq.value to 0 is posted reducing the amount of Useful Life Years from YYYY+5 to YYYY+3 (if the Useful Life is 5 years).-So, the Depreciation Method L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0 is used because the revaluations considered earlier than in the last year of the asset's useful life is needed and the useful life of a Fixed Asset is not affected by a revaluation. Now, the depreciation is until YYYY+5.-The depreciation rate is decreased.-ABC refers to the Fixed Asset ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the Find Fixed Asset BAC and click Edit - Values.-Navigate to the Depreciation Overview sub-tab.-The Depreciation is till the year YYYY+2.-Create a Write-Down posting via the Manual Postings functionality. -The amount of Useful Life Years is reduced.-So, the Depreciation Method L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0 is used. The depreciation rate is decreased from the remaining useful life.-Cause-The write downs with depreciation method L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0 results in the reduction of depreciation rate per accounting period.-Resolution-Depreciation is calculated automatically based on the asset's planned useful life and the depreciation method. When choosing the straight-line depreciation of the net book value over the remaining useful life, the depreciation rate is determined for each year from the remaining useful life.-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-Depreciation Methods | SAP Help Portal-Example 4 in the help document: L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0-Keywords-L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0, Manual Write Down, Depreciation, Useful Life, Depreciation Method, L010

Title: Error: "No Valid Access Token Could Be Determined For User" With ByD Concur Integration
Content: Symptom-User has setup ByD -Concur integration for employee replication, but receives an error message as below:-"Messages (Count: 1)"-"No valid access token could be determined for user ABC."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication-Go to Replication to Concur work center view-Select the Application Log ID: DEF-Navigate to Results tab and notice the error:-"Messages (Count: 1)"-"No valid access token could be determined for user ABC."- Cause-Incorrect credentials are used while establishing the Concur connection.-Resolution-The Implementation Partner has to set up Concur connections by following the steps given in the SAP help documentation.-Link: SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide -> Set Up Communication Arrangement-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide-Keywords-Concur connections, ByD Concur Integration, Access Token, Communication Arrangement, Master Data Replication

Title: Delivered Material Doesn't show in Delivery Goods and Activity Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -For project stock order (PSO),  an error "Material not available for consumption in project " occurs while consuming the delivered product. More important that the item of delivered material  doesn't exist in the delivery Goods and Activity Confirmation(GAC) of document flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Navigate to Project Stock Orders View.-Search for the project stock order ABC.-Choose Edit button.-Select the item of delivered material you want to consume.-Choose Consume button, then the mentioned error would occur.-Navigate to Document Flow Tab.-Open all the delivery GAC, then you find that the delivered item doesn't exist in any delivery GAC.-Cause-When doing allocate for delivery proposal of PSO, for some items, the on-hand stock of specified Logistics Area cannot fulfill the planned/ actual qty. An expected error "Negative stock not permitted in logistics area XXX, material YYY " would occur while saving the document. Then the user removes the item of material YYY and save again. System will create a delivery GAC without the material YYY. But if opening the PSO, the item shows as delivered with requested qty. -The development team has resolved this issue in the 2408 release. It will not occur in future releases.-Resolution-To resolve the affected document, our development team needs to manually open the open quantity of the Outbound Delivery Request (ODR) and reject the delivered item. This will update the corresponding line item in Customer Demand to 'Not Released' and 'Not Started'. Once this is done, the item can be released again in Customer Demand, allocated in ODR, and consumed in the PSO. Please obtain permission from our customer to proceed with these actions. Afterward, create an incident and forward it to component AP-ODP-OD. - Keywords-Project, Project Stock Order, Consume, Allocate, Goods and Activity Confirmation, GAC, Material, Available.

Title: Release Button Greyed Out in Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-In the Customer Demand view, the Release Button is greyed out, preventing the release of items. There are no error messages displayed, causing confusion about why the items cannot be released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-Go to Customer Demand View.-Search for and Click Edit on Customer Demand ID ABC (ABC represents the Customer Demand ID).-Navigate to the Line Items Tab.-Observe that the item is not Released and the Release Button is Greyed Out.-Cause-The customer demand item cannot be released because there is insufficient stock at the site from which the shipment is being prepared. The stock overview for Product ID 123 shows zero availability (123 represents the Product ID). Additionally, the product planning screen confirms that there is no stock available for this product at the required site.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, ensure that there is sufficient stock at the site from which you are shipping. This may involve transferring stock from another location or ordering additional stock to fulfill the customer demand.-Once the stock is available at the required site, the Release Button will be enabled, allowing the customer demand item to be released.-Keywords-Greyed Out, Customer Demand, Release Button, Outbound Logistics

Title: How To Change Background Image For Login Page
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to change the background image for login page.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-It is not possible to customize the background image for login page in Business ByDesign, it is default.

Title: Error: 'Cannot Process Customer Project Expense List XYZ Because Supplier Invoice DEF Not Yet Posted in Accounting'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer Project Expense List is shown as unposted Source document because of the following error message:-'Cannot process Customer Project Expense List XYZ because Supplier Invoice DEF not yet posted in accounting. As Customer Project Expense List XYZ contains a reference to Supplier Invoice DEF but Supplier Invoice DEF has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Customer Project Expense List XYZ. Check why Supplier Invoice DEF has not been posted.'-(XYZ represents the Customer Project Expense List)-(DEF represents the Supplier Invoice)-Currently, this scenario is very specific to the customer: "Lloyds Register Group Services Limited".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work center-Go to Closing Cockpit View-Go to Source Documents Subview-Show Unposted Source Documents and find the erroneous Customer Project Expense List XYZ.-The error message is being shown:-'Cannot process Customer Project Expense List XYZ because Supplier Invoice DEF not yet posted in accounting. As Customer Project Expense List XYZ contains a reference to Supplier Invoice DEF but Supplier Invoice DEF has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Customer Project Expense List XYZ. Check why Supplier Invoice DEF has not been posted.'-Cause-The Customer Project Expense List XYZ is interconnected to a Credit Memo which is again connected to another Credit Memo and it has an invoice which has Cost distribution reference item 'Missing'. Follow the steps below to check the same:-1) First we need to open the erroneous Customer Project Expense List XYZ, and check the related Source Document ID: Credit Memo XYZ-A.XX in the General Information Section.-(A represents the Item ID) and (XX represents the Account Assignment).-2) Search for the mentioned Credit Memo:-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Source Documents subview. -Select "All Source Documents". -Search for Supplier Invoice/ Credit Memo XYZ and open it. -Click "View All". -Go to the Items tab > Select the Item ID A > Go to the Cost Distribution subtab > Search for Account Assignment A.XX. -In the "Reference Item" column there is another Credit Memo XYZ-A.XX. -3) Follow the same steps as described above in reference to another Credit Memo:-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Source Documents subview. -Select "All Source Documents". -Search for Supplier Invoice/ Credit Memo XYZ and open it. -Click "View All". -Go to the Items tab > Select the Item ID A > Go to the Cost Distribution subtab > Search for Account Assignment A.XX. -Now in the "Reference Item" column there is an Invoice reference XYZ-A.XX instead of a Credit Memo. -4) Check the "Reference Item" for the mentioned Invoice XYZ-A.XX:-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Source Documents subview. -Select "All Source Documents". -Search for Supplier Invoice/ Credit Memo XYZ and open it. -Click "View All". -Go to the Items tab > Select the Item ID A > Go to the Cost Distribution subtab > Search for Account Assignment A.XX. -In the "Reference Item" column there is the following message: 'Missing'. -Resolution-Expected system behavior.-The SAP Business By Design cannot handle these cases in which the Customer Project Expense List is interconnected with other Credit Memos.-Keywords-Customer Project Expense List, Lloyds Register, Credit Memo, Supplier Invoice, Cost Distribution, Reference Item, Missing,

Title: General Ledger Account Description Missing In Journal France Report
Content: Symptom-You run the legal report Journal France and notice that the General Ledger account description is missing in the report. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Statutory Reports subview. -Select the Report Name Journal-France.-Select the Run Name: XXX (XXX stands for the run name).-Open the generated file.-The field "CompteLib" is empty.-Cause-The General Ledger Account is maintained in the system without description. To check this:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the General Ledger Accounts view.-Open the Advanced Filter and maintain the respective Company ID and Set of Books ID.-In the G/L Account field, look for the G/L Account in the report.-The G/L Account does not have a description.-Resolution-Maintain a description for the General Ledger Account in the system and rerun the report for the General Ledger Account description to be populated in the report. -Keywords-Journal France, FEC report, Fichier FEC, Statutory Report France.

Title: In Which Order the SellerTaxIdentificationNumbers are Maintained in the Customer Invoice Output XML
Content: Symptom-You noticed multiple SellerTaxIdentificationNumbers are maintained in the Output XML of Customer Invoice and you would like to know in which order the SellerTaxIdentificationNumbers are maintained in the XML.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing -> Invoice Documents -Search for invoice ABC (ABC represents the Invoice ID)-Click View All-Navigate to Output History-View Data XML -Search for SellerTaxIdentificationNumber-The Seller Tax Number is maintained more than once. - Resolution-The Seller BP Tax Number will be displayed first and followed by company tax arrangements.-Keywords-customer invoice; output; XML; SellerTaxIdentificationNumber.

Title: Error "Period not valid; parent node only valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY" when Transferring the Employee
Content: Symptom-When transferring the employee, system throws the below error:-'Update to organizational structure currently not possible. Period not valid; parent node only valid from DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to DD2.MM2.YYYY2.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration -> Regular Tasks.-Transfer Employee.-Input the mandatory fields. -Save.-Error happens.-Cause-The org unit which the employee is transferred to is valid only during a certain period. When transferring an employee to a new org unit, the new org unit assignment will be valid from the day of transferring to unlimited. If the valid to date of the target org unit is not unlimited, the transferring will be failed.-Resolution-Transfer to another org unit whose valid to date is unlimited or extend the valid to date of the target org unit to unlimited.-Keywords-Transfer employee, parent node, Employee, Period not valid

Title: Cannot Use Data Source "PROCPIR_U03" to Check Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-Cannot use data source "PROCPIR_U03" to check invoice requests because it's not displayed in the Business Analytics work center- Data Sources view. However, this data source is used in report "Customer Project Invoice Requests". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center, Design Data Sources view.-Search for PROCPIR_U03 and there is no result.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for report "Customer Project Invoice Requests".-Open the report and see that data source PROCPIR_U03 is used in the report: -Report ID    PROCPIR_U03_Q0001-Report Name    Customer Project Invoice Requests-Data Source ID    PROCPIR_U03-Data Source Name    Customer Project Invoice Requests-Cause-Data source "Customer Project Invoice Requests (ID: PROCPIR_U03)" is intentionally not marked as "Public MDAV" because this may be involved in a union MDAV. Hence it is not possible to publicly released and available in frontend.-Resolution-As data source "PROCPIR_U03" is not visible in the UI, the workaround is to use data source with ID "PROCPIU02" as per requirement for checking invoice requests. -Keywords-Data Source; Project Invoice Request; PROCPIR_U03

Title: “No Valid Offsetting Acct Found For Source Account Annual Leave” While performing Period Day Closure
Content: Symptom-In Time Administration Work Center, the Day Closure for an employee fails and the following error message appears:-"No Valid Offsetting Acct Found For Source Account Annual Leave"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to  Regular Tasks view-Select Run Day Closure-Choose the employee and set the period closure date-Choose save-System raises error message “No Valid Offsetting Acct Found For Source Account Annual Leave”-Cause-An issue has arisen with a time account (ZZZZZZ) for YYYY1, where the balance that should carry forward to YYYY2 is encountering an error due to the absence of a designated target account. [ZZZZZZ refers to the Time account]-Resolution-Add a target account in YYYY2 then the Balance will be carry forwarded from YYYY1 to YYYY2.-Then try to perform period day closure.-Steps to be performed: --Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employee view-Choose Emp ID-Go to Time Profile tab [Select start and end date of DD.MM.YYYY2 to DD.MM.YYYY2]-Go to time account Rules-Add row-Time Account (ZZZZZZ)-Go to period end rules and select adjust rules then change the First rule Posting type to set to zero and save.-Now check the Time Account Balances there will be a new Annual leave YYYY2 account added will the carry forward balance.-Steps to perform day closure run: --Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Regular tasks view-Select Run day closure for one employee-Give employee name and-Choose action “set period closure date.”-Give date DD.MM.YYYY1 and save.-Repeat the same action give date as-DD.MM.YYYY2[Last year’s Jan Month] save.-DD.MM.YYYY2[last year’s Dec month] save.-DD.MM.YYYY3 [Current Date] save.-See Also-2338743 - Error Message 'Sufficient Quota Required for Posting on DD.MM.YYYY to Account ABC' in Day Closure Run-Keywords-No, Valid, Offsetting Acct, Source Account, Annual Leave

Title: No Option is Displayed When Selecting the Value Help for the Address Field of a Contact Maintained as a Party Role in a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When entering a Contact as a Party Role in a Sales Order document and selecting the value help for address of the Party Role, no option is displayed in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign- --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Select the value help for the address of Contact maintained as a Party Role.-No option is displayed in the pop up window.-Cause-When a Contact is entered as a Party Role in a Sales Order document, the address determined is based on the address maintained for the Contact in the Master Data of the Account.-As the address is always determined from the Contact information in the Master Data of the Account, no options will be displayed when selecting the value help in Involved Parties tab of the Sales Order. -Additionally, if a contact is maintained for multiples Accounts, the system will determine the address information for the Party Role based on the Account that was entered in the Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior for when a contact is added as a Party Role in a Sales Order.-If it is required to change/add a different address for a Contact in a Sales Order, the following steps can be performed:-Go to the Account Management Work Center.-Go to the Accounts View.-Filter for All Accounts.-Search for the Account EDF (where EDF represents the Account ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Communication tab.-Select the Addresses sub tab.-Maintain a new Address information for the Account.-Select Save.-Navigate to the Contacts tab.-Mark the Contact MNO (where MNO represents the Contact ID).-Select the value help in the Address field.-Select the new address maintained.-Select Save button.-Now when creating a new Sales Order and maintaining the Contact as a Party Role, the new address maintained for the Contact in the Master Data of the Account will be displayed.-Keywords-contact, sales order, party role, address, account, master data, involved parties, no address

Title: Calculated Value Field is Blank in Valuated Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-The calculated value field in the Valuated Stock Overview is blank.-Company ID: ABC-Site ID: 123-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select Valuated Stock Overview under Common Tasks.-Enter "ABC" in the Company ID field.-Enter "123" in the Site ID field.-Click "Go."-Observe that the Valuated Calculation field is not populated.-Cause-The problem occurs because the large amount of data being requested using these filters is causing a memory dump in the backend.-This memory allocation dump prevents the calculated data from being updated in the stock overview-Resolution-Narrow down the selection criteria to reduce the amount of data fetched. This will allow the calculated value to be displayed.-Alternatively, Use the report "Material Inventories – Balance Summary," which shows the quantities and values of the material inventory for a key date.-Keywords-Calculated Value-Blank-Valuated Stock Overview-Valuated Calculation

Title: Is It Possible To Generate Output of Form Templates In Word Format ?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to generate output of form templates as Word format instead of PDF format.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-For example customer invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Navigate to the Invoice Request view.-Select & Open any Invoice.-Go to the Output tab.-Here PDF format is used for the output document. There is no option to use Microsoft Word or Excel instead.-Cause-The cause for this behavior is system won't support any other formats except PDF format.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Currently system will only support PDF format for accessing form templates because as we render the document via Adobe document server.-Recommendation is to post this as an enhancement idea over influence platform.-The same is monitored by product management team, and posts are considered for next releases of the system.-Influence forum link: SAP Influence Forum-For more info on influence forum please check the link : New Customer Request for Additional Feature or Function in SAP standard software-See Also-SAP Influence Forum-New Customer Request for Additional Feature or Function in SAP standard software-Keywords-Output document, PDF Format, Word Format, Form Templates

Title: Newly Created Company is Not Displayed in 'Sets of Books and Assigned Companies' and 'Companies' View of General Ledger Work Center
Content: Symptom-Company ABC (ABC refers to the ID of the Company) has been created and activated. However, although the Company is consistent, it does not appear in the General Ledger work center, Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view or Companies View.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view or Companies view.-Search for Company ABC.-No results are found.-Cause-There is no set of books being assigned to company ABC.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to assign a set of books to company ABC.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview.-Search for the activity Set of Books.-Select a set of books and go to Company Settings tab.-Add company ABC in the list.-Save the changes.-See Also-KBA 3134584 - Newly Created Company Name is Not Displayed in Companies View of General Ledger Work Center-Keywords-New Company, Display, Sets of Books and Assigned Companies, General Ledger

Title: Error Message: Tax Exemption Reason Missing in the Tax Data of Business Partner and Country Poland
Content: Symptom-While trying to add a tax exemption reason for a business partner and country Poland you get the error message "Tax exemption reason missing".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customers subview.-Search for Customer ABC (ABC is the customer ID) and select it.-Click Edit and select Financial Data.-Navigate to the Tax Data subtab.-Tax Number for Country Poland has been entered.-Under Tax Exemptions.-Click Add Row to enter Country Poland and Tax Type for example VAT.-You get the error message "Tax exemption reason missing".-Cause-Currently there are no tax exemption reasons/ codes available for selection for business partners for country Poland.-Resolution-System is behaving correctly. There are no tax exemption reasons/ codes available for selection for business partners for country Poland.-See Also-3388229 - Localization - Countries/Regions Where SAP Delivers Tax Content for SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords- tax exemption, Steuerbefreiungsgrund, Kunde, Geschäftspartner, customer, business partner

Title: System Displays Tax Code ABC even if It has been Delimited to a Past Date DD.MM.YY
Content: Symptom-Invalid tax code ABC is still displayed in the drop-down list when creating new expense reports, even if the 'Valid To Date' has been set to a date in the past DD.MM.YY. (ABC represents a tax code ID in China; DD.MM.YY represents a date in the past.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Set the 'Valid To Date' for Tax Code ABC to DD.MM.YY in the system.-Go to Business Configuration - Overview.-Search for Activity: Tax on Goods and Services.-SelectDefine Tax Codes.-Filter 'CN - China' in the Country/Region field.-Select Tax Code ABC and change the 'Valid To Date' to DD.MM.YY.-Save the changes.-Then try to create a new expense report.-Go to work center Travel and Expenses.-Go to common task New Expense Report on Behalf.-Input required parameters in step 1.-Click on Next.-Click on Add Row.-Enter Expense Date >= DD.MM.YY.-Then see that Tax Code ABCis still displayed in the drop-down list.-And an error 'VAT code ABC not valid' occurs.-Cause-The Tax Code ABC will always be displayed in the drop-down list in Expense Reports as long as it complies with legal requirements.-Resolution-If the Tax Code ABC is no longer relevant to the business, it's possible to set a validity end date to DD.MM.YY. Although the tax code is still available as part of the list, it cannot be used in Expense Reports.-Keywords-Tax Code, Valid To Date, Expense Report, Dropdown List

Content: Symptom-Check below the frequently asked questions and their answers related to IT contacts for SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-How To Create a Commercial Contact , IT Contact or SAP Store Buyer Contact.--2101230 - How To Create a Commercial Contact , IT Contact or SAP Store Buyer contact-After including the IT contact information for an employee ABC, there is a discrepancy in the name, as it conflicts with that of another employee, XYZ.--3438554 - The Displayed Name for the IT Contact is Incorrect--When creating a new IT Contact , system throws below error message:-"You cannot assign this contact as the e-mail address is mandatory for the selected contact type"--3400102 - Error " You Cannot Assign This Contact as the E-mail Address is Mandatory for the Selected Contact Type" While Creating IT Contact--User wants to edit existing IT contact name.--3400083 - Not Able to Edit IT Contact Name via Service Control Center WorkCenter---Users who are no longer IT Contacts receive Email Notifications from SAP about planned and unplanned downtimes.--3357848 - Users who are no longer IT Contacts receive Email Notifications from SAP--Error Message "You cannot edit the details of a contact that is a key user.
