Title: Expense Report Missing from System
Content: Symptom-An Expense Report is missing and cannot be found in the Expense Reports view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select All Expense Reports from the dropdown menu.-Search for the Expense Report ID 123 (123 refers to the Expense Report ID).-The report is missing from the system.-Cause-The Expense report 123 might have been deleted from the system.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-If you need to identify the user who deleted the Expense Report, our development team can assist with this analysis. To proceed, please create a case with SAP Product Support and provide the following details:-When or in which timeframe was the Expense Report created?-Who were the related travelers? (Please provide the Employee ID or User ID)-Who created or last changed the Expense Report? (Was it the traveler themselves or an auditor on their behalf? If an auditor, please provide the Employee ID or User ID of the user who created/last changed the report.)-What was the description of the Expense Report?-What was the reimbursement amount and currency?-Keywords-Expense Reports, Missing, Travel and expenses, Deleted.

Title: Ship From is Not Determined in the Migrated Open Sales Orders Even Though the Supply Chain Master Data is Maintained
Content: Symptom-In the migrated sales orders, you find the Ship-From is not determined on items, it is blank. However, if you manually add a new row with the same product, the Ship-From could be determined automatically. This proves that the supply chain master data is maintained in the system, but it could not be determined in the migrated sales orders. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center view.-Open the sales order ABC which is a migrated order. (ABC represents the ID of the sales order) -In the items tab, select line 10, the ship-from is empty and not editable.-Cause-The approval process for sales order is scoped in the system. When you scoped the approval process for Sales Orders, all migrated Sales Orders will be created with status "In Preparation" and once it is released and approved then only ship from is determined by the system for the migrated sales orders.-Resolution-Once the approval process is descoped then system will determine Ship from during creation of the sales order through migration and status of migrated sales order will be "Open". -See Also-2748660 - Ship-From is Empty and Not Editable in a Migrated Sales Order -2730098 - Migrated Sales Orders Have Open Status-Keywords-Migration of Open Sales Orders; migrated sales order; ship-from; fulfillment; source of supply; empty; not determined; approval process.

Title: How to Mass Scrape Capitalized Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-How to do a mass complete scrapping of capitalized fixed assets through a manual journal entry voucher.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-To mass scrape capitalized fixed assets, either:-* Select multiple fixed assets and click the 'Manual Posting - Complete Scrapping' button, or-* Select one fixed asset and click the 'Manual Posting - Complete Scrapping' button, then add more fixed assets by adding rows in the Manual Posting – Complete Scrapping view.-See Also-Help Documents:-Fixed Assets-Manual Postings in Fixed Assets-Keywords-Mass Scrapping, Fixed Asset, Batch, Complete Scrapping

Title: How to select and apply Actions to all or multiple Business Users
Content: Symptom-When trying to make changes, such as Security Policy, from the Business Users view it is not possible to select multiple users/lines.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Open Business Users view.-There is no obvious method to select and apply changes to multiple users.-Resolution-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Open the Business Users view.-To select all or multiple users highlight the first required user/line, then hold Shift and select another user. This will highlight all users between the two (inclusive). Hold Ctrl, instead of Shift, to select individual users to highlight and add to the selection.-Complete the intended action, such as changing the Security Policy.-Check the results and observe that all highlighted users will have been changed accordinly.-Keywords-Application and User Management, Mass Change,

Title: How to Remove an Extension Field in an Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You want to keep only standard conditions in the approval process but the extension fields are shown in the drop-down. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view. -Select approval process ABC (ABC is the approval process' ID). -Click in Copy button.-Select process step DEF (DEF is the process step's ID).-In Conditions section, click in Add Group button. -Select field GHI in the drop-down (GHI is the extension field).-You want to remove the extension field from the drop-down so there is only Standard fields. -Cause-If you want to remove permanently the extension field from the drop-down of the approval process' conditions, you need to disable the extension field in the document's screen (Purchase Order, for example). Otherwise the extension field will keep being shown in the drop-down. It is not possible to maintain the extension field in the document's screen but not in the approval process. -Resolution-If you want to disable the extension field in your tenant, firstly copy the current approval process and create a new one with Standard fields only (manually remove the conditions with the extension fields). Only then you disable the extension field in the document's screen. Please do it in this order to not generate inconsistencies in your tenant. -If you do not want to disable the extension field in your tenant, you can only remove it from the approval process by editing the approval process. You need to manually remove each condition with the extension field.  -Keywords-Approval process, Extension field, Condition

Title: Purchasing Contract HTML E-mail Template Not Supported in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-When trying to upload a HTML e-mail Template for Purchasing Contract, the below error message is displayed.-"E-mail templates not supported for this form template group"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work centre.-Go to the Form template Maintenance view and search for Purchasing Contract Form Template group.-Select the required form and click on Action. -Click on Create E-Mail template.-Upload the HTML e-mail template required.-The error message below is displayed:-"E-mail templates not supported for this form template group"-Cause-E-mail templates are not supported for Purchasing Contract Form Template group.-Resolution-This is an expected system behaviour in SAP Business ByDesign.-Consider posting this feature on the SAP Customer Influence Platform, as this would be a Product enhance feature.-Keywords-Purchasing Contracts, html, email, template, form, group

Title: How to Mass Upload Stock Transfer Order
Content: Symptom-There are a lot of stock transfer orders need to be created in SAP Business ByDesign system with big volume of items, however, there is no migration template for stock transfer order in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Currently SAP Business ByDesign doesn't support migration of stock transfer order through Business Configuration activity.-However, as workaround, there is a standard web service ManageCustomerRequirementIn can be used to create intercompany stock transfer orders. -Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, Migrate, Migration, Mass Upload, Template

Title: 'Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident.' Error in Material Inventories - Reconciliation Report
Content: Symptom-Error is thrown when running the Material Inventories - Reconciliation report: 'Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Search and open the report Material Inventories - Reconciliation (Report ID FININVU08).-Enter Company ABC, Set of Book GHI, Key Date DD.MM.YYYY (where ABC stands for Company ID and GHI stands for Set of Books ID)-Click Apply.-After loading for a while, error is thrown: 'Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident.'-Cause-The error "Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident" comes when there is large amount of data. By giving the key date, the report tries to fetch all the data from the beginning until the key date provided.-Resolution-As a workaround, data can be fetched in the MDAV by providing the date intervals for which the data is wanted.-To fetch data from the MDAV:-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Data Sources View.-Search for FININVU08.-Click Preview.-In the MDAV, enter the details: Company ABC, Set of Books GHI; Change the selection of Proposed Posting date from 'Equal to' to 'In Between' and enter the start and end date for which the details are wanted ('Key Date' in report is mapped to 'Proposed Posting Date' in the MDAV.).-Click Apply.-This should fetch the data between given periods.-Remark: the data cannot be previewed by the support account. The above steps are to be followed from your end with business user accounts.-Keywords-'Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident.'; Material Inventories - Reconciliation; 物料库存对账; “打开报表“内部服务器错误”失败，请报告故障.

Title: Unable to add Extension Field in Mass Change Contact Data
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add an extension field to the Mass Change Contact Data view, but are unable to find this option in the Adaptation Mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management Workcenter-Go to Mass Change Contact Data view-Select the Profile icon-Go to the Key User Settings-Select Start Adaptation Mode-Select the (+) action to add adaptation-There's no option to add Extension fields, only Mashups option is available-Cause-The Mass Change Contact Data does not support Extension Fields.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system. Currently there is no functionality to add the Extension Fields in the Mass Change Contact Data.-If the feature/functionality is needed as a matter of urgency, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.-Keywords-Mass Change Contact Data, Extension Fields, Adaptation Mode

Title: Mobile App: No Tiles on Launchpad - Home
Content: Symptom-No tiles appear for a Business User on the Mobile App.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign Mobile Application-Reproducing the Issue-Login to ByDesign Mobile App.-No tiles appear on the Launchpad - Home.-Cause-Business User may have PDI related permissions.-PDI related permissions on the Business User can interfere with the Mobile App, and prevent the tiles generating correctly.-Resolution-Remove the PDI permissions from the Business User, login to the Mobile App and everything should load as expected.-Once the system has successfully generated the Home tiles, the PDI permissions can be restored and should now load correctly.-Please note that this issue can occur in two scenarios;-When a Business User has changes made to their Permissions that involve both PDI and non PDI Permissions.-When major system changes are made, including the quarterly Upgrades to ByDesign.-As such we would recommend having a specific non-PDI Business Role available to easily resolve the issue.-See Also-KBA: 3361001   Mobile App Users are redirected to the Desktop UI Screen-Keywords-not, possible, visible, missing, access restrictions, Business role, tiles, blank, launchpad, homepage, PDI,

Title: You Would Like to Know Why System Shows "No Relevant Change Documents Were Found" Under Changes Tab Details
Content: Symptom-No relevant change documents were found shows under changes tab details. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders - Sales Orders.-Edit Sales Order ABC and click on View All (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to changes tab.-Select the change log.-Under Details it shows No relevant change documents were found.-Cause-This change/modifications are done in the corresponding documents which are linked to this sales order. Due to that the details are not shown under sales order change tab. -Resolution-Kindly check the corresponding documents (Eg: Customer Invoice) and there you will be able to see the change details. -Keywords-unable to see values in Changes Tab; No Relevant Information in Changes Tab;

Title: Error when adding attachment to Purchase Order: The action CREATE_FILE is not possible
Content: Symptom-You cannot add an attachment to a Purchase Order. The following error occurs: CREATE_FILE not possible. Refresh the screen. Try again. If problem persists open an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Purchase Requests and Orders -> Purchase Orders-Find and select a PO-Select Edit > View All > Attachments > Add -> File and browse to the file to attach-Click on Add-The error : "The action CREATE_FILE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case." appears at the bottom of the screen.-The Add button is then disabled.-Cause-The reason the error occurs is because the Purchase Order is in status: In Approval.-No activity is allowed on a PO that is in approval except APPROVE, REJECT and SEND BACK FOR REVISION.-It is not possible to add an attachment when the PO is in this status.--It was considered to change the User Interface so that the option would not be available at all but it was decided this is a non urgent development and considering the development effort that would be required it is unlikely to be implemented in the short or even medium term.-Resolution-If one needs to add an attachment to a PO before it gets approved, the PO must first be withdrawn from approval using the Actions->Withdraw from Approval so it goes back to the editable status  "In preparation".-It will then be possible to add the attachment.-Keywords-The action CREATE_FILE is not possible; Purchase Order; Attachment

Title: Managers are Able to View Employees Address Information
Content: Symptom--It is not possible to select the option "Would you like to restrict your managers from viewing the confidential data of their team members?" in Business Configuration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration-Select Implementation Projects.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Reach till the Questions step.-Select Human Resource.-Select Personnel File.-Unable to mark the option "Would you like to restrict your managers from viewing the confidential data of their team members?".- Cause-The system is not allowing to hide Private Contact Data when Master Data Replication is scoped-in.-Resolution-This is a standard system behaviour.

Title: Horizontal Scroll bar Not Appearing in Report
Content: Symptom-You are working with a report and want to view the line items, however, horizontal scroll bar is not appearing in the report in order to scroll left and right to view the complete data.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the required report in the web browser.-Execute the report and move the required fields to the view.-Although the report loads fine, the horizontal scroll bar is not visible at the bottom of the report.-Cause-The root cause of this behavior is because of the setting maintained in the Table Settings of the report.-Resolution-Please follow the below mentioned steps to change the setting and hence the horizontal scroll bar will appear.--1. Open the involved report from the Business Analytics work center.-2. Choose the view that you want to load/run the report and click OK.-3. Now, click on Settings button and select option Table.-4.  New window opens for Table Settings. Here, check for the field Freeze Header.-5. In order to view Horizontal scroll bar in the report, the Freeze Header field should be un-checked. Click OK and save the view again.-The reason for providing this field in the setting is to give the flexibility to restrict the header columns that they expect to view on the report screen without moving the fields out of report.--Note:-These setting are general setting and not specific to any report.-These setting should be maintained for each of the customer created views in the report.

Title: BREXIT Tax Code and Tax Country Determination Northern Ireland
Content: Symptom-If you have customer and suppliers in GB and in particular Northern Ireland regions you will have to check and maintain correct postal codes. The system will be using postal codes to determine if good shipment is happening to Northern Island Regions for Tax determinations.-For this the System has a new Tax Number Type Northern Ireland Protocol: VAT Reg. No which you as a customer will have to maintain in case you have business transactions in Northern Ireland regions. It will same similar validations as GB VAT Tax Number.-If an order/invoice/transaction is from or to a customer/supplier who has an address with country GB, system will further check postal codes to determine if it should be treated as EU or Export/Import Transaction.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Please find below 4 examples on how the Tax Code and Tax Country is determined if the Ship-From Party is located in a Country within the EU and the Ship-To Party is located in either Northern Ireland or in the United Kingdom but not Northern Ireland.-We will use the Ship-From location as Germany, a Material and the Sales Document Sales Order in this example.-Resolution-Example 1:-For an Account which has a postal code in Northern Ireland the system but has not maintained a VAT Registration Number and not a Northern Ireland Protocol: VAT Reg. No. and the Ship-From is e.g. Germany and the Seller is registered in the UK.-  The Tax Decision tree is then as follows:-Decision Tree: AP_PT_DE7 TXDT 000000000003-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a sale of goods? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in DE? -> true-Test: Is ship-to in DE? -> false-Northern Ireland continues to be a part of EU for goods transactions-Test: Is ship-to in other EU member state? -> true-Test: Is ship-to an extra-community territory? -> false-Test: Is customer VAT registered in ship-to country? -> false-Test: Is seller VAT registered in ship-to country? -> true-Result: not taxable in DE-Configuration result: No result obtained for bus. partner country GB.-Decision Tree: AP_PT_GB4 TXDT 000000000004-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a good? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in GB? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in GB? -> true-Test: Is Ship-To in XI ? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in another EU member state? -> true-Test: Is customer VAT registered in the ship-to country? -> false-Test: Is supplier registered in the ship-to country? -> true-Test: Is good subject to reverse charge? -> false-Result: Distance selling (Taxable in GB)-  In this case the System will determine Tax Country GB - United Kingdom and Tax Code 511 - EU Distance Sale of Goods, Standard Rate.--Example 2:-For an Account which has a postal code in Northern Ireland the system but has not maintained a VAT Registration Number and not a Northern Ireland Protocol: VAT Reg. No. and the Ship-From is e.g. Germany and the Seller is not registered in the UK.-  The Tax Decision tree is then as follows:-Decision Tree: AP_PT_DE7 TXDT 000000000003-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a sale of goods? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in DE? -> true-Test: Is ship-to in DE? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in DE? -> false-Northern Ireland continues to be a part of EU for goods transactions-Test: Is ship-to in other EU member state? -> true-Test: Is ship-to an extra-community territory? -> false-Test: Is customer VAT registered in ship-to country? -> false-Test: Is seller VAT registered in ship-to country? -> false-Result: Domestic sale-Configuration result: No result obtained for bus. partner country GB.-Decision Tree: AP_PT_GB4 TXDT 000000000004-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a good? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in GB? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in GB? -> true-Test: Is Ship-To in XI ? -> true-Test: Is buyer a company ? -> true-Result: Distance selling (Taxable in GB)-Result: Not taxable in GB-In this case the System will determine Tax Country DE - Germany and Tax Code 501 - Domestic Supply (Standard Rate).-  Example 3:-For an Account which has a postal code in Northern Ireland the system, a VAT Registration Number and a Northern Ireland Protocol: VAT Reg. No. was maintained and the Ship-From is e.g. Germany.-  The Tax Decision tree is then as follows:-Decision Tree: AP_PT_DE7 TXDT 000000000003-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a sale of goods? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in DE? -> true-Test: Is ship-to in DE? -> false-Northern Ireland continues to be a part of EU for goods transactions-Test: Is ship-to in other EU member state? -> true-Test: Is ship-to an extra-community territory? -> false-Test: Is customer VAT registered in ship-to country? -> true-Test: Is customer VAT registered in ship-from country? -> false-Result: Intra-community supply-Configuration result: No result obtained for bus. partner country GB.-Decision Tree: AP_PT_GB4 TXDT 000000000004-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a good? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in GB? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in GB? -> true-Test: Is Ship-To in XI ? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in another EU member state? -> true-Test: Is customer VAT registered in the ship-to country? -> true-Result: Not taxable in GB-  In this case the System will determine Tax Country DE - Germany and Tax Code 507 - Intra-Community Supply.-  Example 4:-For an Account which has a postal code in Great Britain the system, a VAT Registration Number was not maintained and the Ship-From is e.g. Germany and the Seller is registered in the UK.-  The Tax Decision tree is then as follows:-Decision Tree: AP_PT_DE7 TXDT 000000000003-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a sale of goods? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in DE? -> true-Test: Is ship-to in DE? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in other EU member state? -> false-Test: Is this an over the counter sale? -> false-Result: Export to third country-Configuration result: No result obtained for bus. partner country GB.-Decision Tree: AP_PT_GB4 TXDT 000000000004-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a good? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in GB? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in GB? -> true-Test: Is Ship-To in XI ? -> false-Test: Is ship-from in Isle of Man (IM)? -> false-Test: Is customer VAT registered in the ship-to country? -> false-Test: Is supplier registered in the ship-to country? -> true-Amount  used for threshold comparison-Test: Is net amount below 135 GBP ? -> true-Result: Domestic sale of goods-  In this case the System will determine Tax Country GB - United Kingdom and Tax Code 501 - Domestic Sale of Goods, Standard Rate.--Example 5:-For an Account which has a postal code in Great Britain the system, a VAT Registration Number was not maintained and the Ship-From is e.g. Germany and the Seller is not registered in the UK.-  The Tax Decision tree is then as follows:-Decision Tree: AP_PT_DE7 TXDT 000000000003-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a sale of goods? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in DE? -> true-Test: Is ship-to in DE? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in other EU member state? -> false-Test: Is this an over the counter sale? -> false-Result: Export to third country-Configuration result: No result obtained for bus. partner country GB.-Decision Tree: AP_PT_GB4 TXDT 000000000004-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a good? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in GB? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in GB? -> true-Test: Is Ship-To in XI ? -> false-Test: Is ship-from in Isle of Man (IM)? -> false-Test: Is customer VAT registered in the ship-to country? -> false-Test: Is supplier registered in the ship-to country? -> true-Amount  used for threshold comparison-Test: Is net amount below 135 GBP ? -> true-Result: Domestic sale of goods-  In this case the System will determine Tax Country GB - United Kingdom and Tax Code 501 - Domestic Sale of Goods, Standard Rate.-  Example 6:-For an Account which has a postal code in Great Britain the system, a VAT Registration Number was maintained and the Ship-From is e.g. Germany.-  Decision Tree: AP_PT_DE7 TXDT 000000000003-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a sale of goods? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in DE? -> true-Test: Is ship-to in DE? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in other EU member state? -> false-Test: Is this an over the counter sale? -> false-Result: Export to third country-Configuration result: No result obtained for bus. partner country GB.-Decision Tree: AP_PT_GB4 TXDT 000000000004-Test: Is it a sale? -> true-Test: Is it a good? -> true-Test: Is ship-from in GB? -> false-Test: Is ship-to in GB? -> true-Test: Is Ship-To in XI ? -> false-Test: Is ship-from in Isle of Man (IM)? -> false-Test: Is customer VAT registered in the ship-to country? -> true-Result: Not taxable in GB-  In this case the System will determine Tax Country DE - Germany and Tax Code 508 - Export To Third Country.-  See Also-Blog: SAP Business ByDesign – Impact due to Brexit updated 8th January 2021-Keywords-Brexit; Tax Code; 507; EU; Northern Ireland Protocol

Title: How to Delete Business User Sessions
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to close sessions of a business user.-This can be relevant when a user may have forgot to logoff in a certain device, or to avoid possible locks in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Steps for deleting the user sessions:-Click on the user avatar icon on the top right of the system screen.-Select option Key User Settings.-Click on User Session Settings.-A list will be displayed with the sessions currently active in the tenant. You can use the trash can button to delete sessions.-Keywords-locked,user sessions, login, business user, KUT

Title: Wrong Form Template is picked for Dunning in Preview
Content: Symptom-Wrong form template is selected during the preview when the user has created a Dunning Strategy and want to use a separate form template for dunning letter for whom this dunning strategy is used.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work center.-Go to Dunning view.-Select the Dunning ABC (where ABC refers to the dunning ID).-Click Preview.-Observe incorrect form template picked in the preview.-Cause-The same dunning level is not maintained in the parameter settings for the form template under the form template selection rule as in the dunning level value of Receivables - Dunning Items.-Resolution-Maintain the same dunning level in the Form Template Selection rule that is maintained in the dunning level value of Receivables - Dunning items.-Navigation to the Dunning items is as below:-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Dunning view.-Select the Dunning ABC (where ABC refers to the dunning ID).-Navigate to the Dunning Items tab.-The dunning level is displayed.-Keywords-dunning, receivables, preview, form template, level

Title: How to Change the Subject Text of the Email Output Automatically for a Business Document
Content: Symptom-How to change the subject text of the email output automatically for a business document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open any sales order with In Process status in edit mode.-Select You can also -> Edit Output Settings.-Change Send By field to E-Mail and go to tab E-Mail Text.-You want to change the format automatically depending upon type of the order.--Cause-In the standard email template, their is no possibility to change the header/subject automatically.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Keywords-Output Settings , E-Mail

Title: Inversion of Exchange Rate Does not Work as Expected
Content: Symptom-The system has been set up to invert the exchange rates. The currency pair rate has also been maintained for e.g. EUR to USD with recent and updated values and also an old/outdated entry for USD to EUR (entry not invalidated yet).-A source document in USD (transaction currency) has been created with the expectation that the system will invert the quotation of EUR to USD using the most recent rate. However, the old entry for USD to EUR was derived by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-The system will only invert an exchange rate if the required rate is not available. In the above example, since EUR to USD is maintained and valid, this entry is used.--In the Help documentation Configuration: Exchange Rate Types the following is quoted:--"If you select this checkbox, inverted exchange rates will be used for currency conversion if the required exchange rate is not available.--For example, if conversion from USD to EUR is required but only the EUR to USD exchange rate is available, the system will invert the EUR to USD exchange rate and use the resulting inverted exchange rate in the currency conversion."-Resolution-In this example, for the system to use the inverse rate of EUR to USD, the exchange rate for USD to EUR needs to be removed.-See Also-Configuration: Exchange Rate Types-Keywords-Exchange Rate. Mid Rate. Invert.

Title: The Login User is the Employee Responsible in Over-the-Counter Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-When creating an Over-the-Counter sales order, you find the Employee Responsible is not the expected one which is defined in the Employee Work Distribution Rules. Instead, system uses the current login user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Click New Over-the-Counter Sales task.-In the creation window, enter the account then you find the Employee Responsible is the current login user.-Go to the Sales Orders workc enter view.-Click New Sales Order, and enter the same account, you can see the Employee Responsible is XYZ which is determined from the employee work distribution rule properly. (XYZ represents the employee ID)-Cause-For Over-the-Counter sales, customers walks into the shop, buy and pay for the goods directly. So the employee responsible is the user who logged in and handled this sales transaction.-Resolution-This is the intended system behavior as design.-Keywords-OTC;over the counter; employee responsible; work distribution; login user, user.

Title: The Business Feature Is Missing, Even Though You Have Scoped The Question Which Is Related To The Feature
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have scoped the question "Do you want to execute tasks and surveys during phone calls?" in the UI, but still the feature related to the question is missing in the system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Edit the current project.-Go to Step 4: Questions.-Select the Scoping Question: "Do you want to execute tasks and surveys during phone calls?".-Cause-For the scoped business feature, scoping status is "Off" which means it is not scoped in the backend.--Resolution-Re-deploy the workspace using "Advance Deploy" from backend by following the below steps, then this feature scoping status will change to "Productive" as expected. -Log in to the backend.-Use the T-code BCTADM.-Select Advance Deploy tab.-Select the relevant workspace.-Execute.-See Also- 3032667 - How To Check Scoping Questions Dependencies on the Backend-Keywords-Business feature, Scoping status, Re -deploy, Scoped Question

Title: Sales Order is Inconsistent With Process Communication Error 'Sales Order Cannot Update Customer Demand'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Sales order is inconsistent with process communication error Sales Order cannot update Customer Demand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-The sales order ABC has error symbol.-Open the error message from the sales order ABC: Sales Order ABC cannot update the Customer Demand DEF (DEF represents the ID of the customer demand).-Cause-XML message from the Sales Order to Customer Demand is in erroneous status (Connection Closed). The connection close error occurred due to the temporary connection problem of the server.-Log in to the backend system.-Go to the transaction SRT_MONI or SXMB_MONI.-Search for the Erroneous messages with a date range (date range should the period when the sales order has been released for the customer demand).-Put sender party as SalesOrderProcessing and Receiver Interface as CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn.-Execute.-You can find the XML message for the sales order is in error status (Error Message: Connection Closed).-  Resolution-Log in to the backend system.-Go to the transaction SRT_MONI or SXMB_MONI.-Search for the Erroneous messages with a date range (date range should the period when the sales order has been released for the customer demand).-Put sender party as SalesOrderProcessing and Receiver Interface as CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn.-Execute.-Select the Action button and Restart the message.-This will resend the failed message to customer demand and solve the error on the sales order ABC.-      Keywords-sales order, process communication error, pce, customer demand, document flow.

Title: The Error "Item XX: Gross amount must not be negative" Occurs When Cancelling a Line Item in a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are unable to set a reason for rejection for line item XX in a Sales Order document due to the following error:-"Item XX: Gross amount must not be negative"-(Where XX refers to the line item number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select the Sales Order view.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (Where ABC refers to the Sales Order ID).-Click on Edit and View All.-Go to Items tab and select line item XX.-Maintain a reason for rejection for the line item XX.-The following error occurs:-Item XX: Gross amount must not be negative.-Cause-The overall discount on Sales Order ABC is too high and by setting a reason for rejection of line item XX, the total gross amount becomes negative.-Negative gross amount in a Sales Order is not yet available for ByD as the system logic prevents the value from being negative. To proceed with the business flow, the gross amount must be equal or higher than 0.-See the following example:-For Sales Order ABC, the total item gross value is 10.76. This is calculated after summing up all item gross prices. Since 2 line items are cancelled, they are not considered in the total and all other item prices sum up to 10.76.-Total = Total Item gross value - Discount (if any)-In this case:-Total = 10.76 - 8.15 = 2.61.-When you try to cancel line item XX, the total item gross value calculation happens again. This time it will ignore the item XX price since it was cancelled.-New total item gross value = 10.76 - 2.79 => 7.97.-New Total = new Total item gross value - discount-New total = 7.97 - 8.15 => -0.18-Due to the cancellation of the last item, the manually added discount amount turns out to be more than the sum. Hence the errors are being thrown.-This is the system behavior as we cannot have negative prices in Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the standard system behaviour.-Keywords-reason for rejection, sales order, gross amount, negative, item, overall discount

Title: Default Account Assignment for General Ledger Accounts is not Considered for Business Transaction Posting
Content: Symptom-In the Default Account Assignment for General Ledger Accounts you define a specific setting for a G/L Account, a cost center assignment or a free cost object assignment for example.-But when viewing the journal entry of a business transaction (such as a supplier or customer invoice), posting to the selected G/L Account, the defined setting is not derived.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center go to the Companies view.-Select Company XYZ and press Actions - Set Defaults for G/L Accounts (XYZ represents the Company ID). -In the activity,make a default assignment for G/L Account ABC, for example Free Cost Object ID DEF (ABC represents the G/L Account ID, DEF represents the Free Cost Object ID). -Create a business transaction, such as a supplier or customer invoice.-Access the journal entry of this business transaction (for example from the document view). -You notice a line item for G/L Account ABC but for the posting Free Cost Object DEF was not derived.  -Cause-The Default Account Assignments for General Ledger Accounts activity is not relevant for general business transactions. For business transaction postings G/L Accounts are derived based on the relevant sub-ledger account determination groups.-In SAP Business ByDesign the only option to directly select a G/L account in a posting is by creating a Manual Journal Entry Voucher. The activity is only relevant for such manual correction postings in the General Ledger where you might want to ensure that a specific assignment is in place (to a cost center, free cost object or project task) when making a direct, manual posting to the respective G/L account.-Resolution-For business transactions that are to debit or credit G/L accounts used for other income or general expense Account Determination groups you can define mandatory account assignment types in the Mandatory Account Assignments  fine tune activity.-Keywords-default account assignments for general ledger account, free cost object missing

Title: Not able to post Goods and Service Receipt Cancellation - Posting date must be after last retrmt date of fixed asset
Content: Symptom-You want to post a cancellation of Goods and Service Receipt, however you are not able to proceed with this because of an error message, which says: Posting date XX/XX/XX must be after last retrmt date XX/XX/XX of fixed asset ABC-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Source Documents view.-Select the respective Goods and Service Cancellation.-You see the error message: Posting date XX/XX/XX must be after last retrmt date xx/xx/xxxx of fixed asset ABC.-Cause-The cancellation Goods and Activity Receipt comes after the complete transfer or retirement of the individual material. Hence, the documents are stuck in accounting with errors.-Resolution-You will have to reverse the transfer/retirement posting and then post the cancellation Goods and Service Receipt in order to resolve the issue as once the complete transfer/retirement is posted the Individual Material status on the source Fixed Asset is also retired.-Keywords-fixed asset. retirement. manual posting. complete transfer.  Posting date must be after last retrmt date of fixed asset.

Title: How to Create Single Payment File for Multiple Transactions Using Custom Payment File Structure
Content: Symptom-For a custom payment file structure, you notice that system creates different payment files for each transaction when you create the output file. -However, you expect that payment ID's are pooled together into a single payment file. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search for Payments In Transfer.-Search for document ID 123 and select the document ID's in transfer.(123 represents the Document ID)-You can see the outbound file ID's are different.-or-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search for Payments In Transfer.-Search for document ID 123 and select the document ID's in transfer.-You can see the Outbound File ID's are different.-Cause-The payment medium format does not allow multiple payments.-For the payment medium format there is no logical granularity setting to bundle specific payments together.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration workcenter access the Outgoing Bank Transfers fine tune activity. -Choose Edit payment medium formats.-Highlight the concerned payment medium format. -Go to the General tab and select the Multiple Payments Allowed check box.-Navigate to the  Sort Sequence and Granularity of payments tab. -Select the 'Open new Logical Message / Batch' check box. Define for which payments within the payment file a logical message should be generated.-Save your changes. -Now re-create the bank transfers and generate the outbound file.-Keywords-Payment file, payment medium format, Single file

Title: Manual Revenue Recognition Data Not Considered By Revenue Recognition Run
Content: Symptom-You invoiced Sales Order Item XYZ-XX (XYZ-YY represents the Sales Order item ID). -You maintain manual Revenue Recognition data for the Sales Order item. -After executing the Revenue Recognition run you notice that the run did not consider the maintained value. As a result, the invoiced revenue remains deferred. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view and find item XYZ-XX.-Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and select Recognized Costs and Revenues. -Select any Set of Books. -Under Edit Manual Recognized Costs and Revenues you verify that the Valid from and Valid To date are maintained correctly. -In the Recognized Revenue / Recognized Costs column a value is maintained, for example 5000,00.-Cause-The amount to be recognized is maintained without Currency.-Resolution-In the Edit Recognized Costs and Revenues screen ensure that for the maintained amounts (Recognized Revenue / Recognized Costs) the Currency column is filled.-Keywords-Manual Revenue Recognition Data not realized, Recognize based on manual Amounts

Title: Master Form Template Logo Size
Content: Symptom-After uploading a logo to the master form template, the Logo Width is set to a value larger than 40 mm or the Logo Height is set to a value larger than 20 mm. However, after saving, the logo size remains fixed at 40 × 20 mm. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application And user Management work Center.-Go to sub-view Master Template Maintenance.-Select a Form Master Template, and Select Edit button.-Upload a logo.-Change the Logo Width larger than 40 mm or Logo Height larger than 20 mm.-Select Save and Close button.-Reopen the template and verify the logo size remains at 40 x 20 mm-Cause-The Bydesign system is designed to restrict Master Form Template logos to a maximum of 40 x 20 mm. Larger sizes are not supported. .-Resolution-As a workaround, the logo for a specific form template can be edited locally using Adobe LiveCycle Designer. First, decouple the specific form template from the master templates. Then, perform the layout editing for the individual template using Adobe LiveCycle Designer. -If this feature/functionality is required urgently, please refer to KBA -SAP NoteKBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.-Keywords-Logo, Master template, Master Form Template, Master Template Maintenance

Title: Not Enough Characters for Payment Reference Number
Content: Symptom-You notice that the field 'Payment Reference Number' when creating a new Supplier Invoice is limited to 30 characters only. The error message "Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 30 characters." appears.-However, you may want to enter a Payment Reference Number with more than 30 characters e.g. including spaces in order for it to be readable by a reader device.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select the New Invoice Without Purchase Order sub view.-Enter a value into the Payment Reference Number field with more than 30 characters (spaces included).-The system issues the following error message: Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 30 characters.-Cause-The maximal length of the ISR payment reference number is 27 characters. Currently it is not possible to enter a value into the payment reference number field with more than 30 characters (spaces included).-Resolution-If you want to scan the Payment Reference Number we suggest you to use the machine readable coding line, between the characters ">" and "+" at the bottom of the payment slip.-Keywords- Supplier Invoicing ,Payment Reference Number-zahlungsschein,zahlungsreferenznummer,digits, supplier invoicing,payment reference number

Title: Cannot Find Fixed Asset Corresponding to Individual Material (IMAT)
Content: Symptom-In account assignment for a purchase order item or a supplier invoice item, you can select a particular Individual Material ID. However you cannot find which fixed asset relates to the individual material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To find the individual material used in purchase order account assignment:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Mark the relevant purchase order and choose Edit.-Choose View All and go to the Items tab.-Go to the tab Account Assignment.-Find the individual material ID.-To find the individual material used in supplier invoice account assignment:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Mark the relevant supplier invoice and choose Edit.-Choose View All and go to the Items tab.-Go to the tab Account Assignment.-Find the individual material ID.-To check if the individual material is listed in the list of fixed assets:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Choose Show: All Fixed Assets.-Choose Advanced on the top right.-Enter the Individual Material ID as in the purchase order or supplier invoice.-Choose Go.-No Fixed Asset is returned.-Cause-The individual material is an independent item created directly from a supplier invoice without referencing a purchase order. In this type of supplier invoice, for the account assignment type Individual Material, you will notice a "New" button. The individual material was generated on the spot using this feature. So, the status of the individual material updates in accordance with the status of the supplier invoice.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-Individual Materia, Fixed Asset, Missing, Supplier Invoice, Purchase Order-imat,procurement,product does not exist or is retired,individual material missing

Title: How to Mass Assign Roles to an Existing Business Partner
Content: Symptom-You want to assign the Supplier role to existing business partners within a mass change. But you cannot find any possibility to perform such a change.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partners work center.-Select Business Partners view.-Highlight any Business Partner.-Select the button Create As -> Supplier.-You have the requirement to do this action for several business partners at the same time which is not possible.-Resolution-This functionality is not available using standard migration tools. However, it is available using web service 'Manage Suppliers'.-With this web service you can assign the role Supplier to existing business partners (like accounts)-Here an excerpt from the documentation:-"The element CreateFromBusinessPartnerIndicator can be used to assign the role supplier to existing business partners.-If this element is supplied with value true, then the following constraints have to be considered:-The actionCode attribute in message node Supplier shall have value "02" (Update) or "04" (Save), otherwise an error message is returned.-If the actionCode attribute in message node Supplier has value "02" or "04" and the elements InternalID or the UUID are filled, then the system assigns the role supplier to the business partner with the given InternalID or UUID.-If the actionCode attribute in message node Supplier has value "04" and the elements InternalID and UUID are both empty, then the system creates a new supplier using internal numbering."-Full documentation about the web service can be found following the steps below:-Go to Application and User Management-Go to the Service Explorer view-Search for Manage Suppliers-Click on the Link to check the documentation-Keywords-Manage Suppliers,business partners,mass assign-manage suppliers,business partners,mass update

Title: No Cost Center Assignment for Fixed Asset Scrapping
Content: Symptom-A manual posting to scrap a Fixed Asset is executed. The journal entry created with the posting did not derive the cost center to which the Fixed Asset has been assigned.-This information is highly relevant for cost center accounting.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Navigate to the Fixed Assets subview.-Select the respective Fixed Asset.-Click Edit.-Choose the Manual Postings button and select Complete Scrapping.-Confirm with Post.-Checking the Journal Entry, no cost center has been assigned.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-Expenses from scrapping are intentionally not posted to the cost center. The reason for this is that the cost center accounting has a periodic character and it is not considered reasonable to inflate expenses in one special period in which the scrapping takes place.-Resolution-In order to post the debited Fixed Asset Disposal or Loss of Assets Valuation to a cost center, follow the workaround described below:-Open the General Ledger Work Center.-Select New Journal Entry Voucher.-Maintain the necessary information and click Add Row.-Enter the respective amount in the field Debit in Transaction Currency.-Assign the Cost Center to which the fixed asset has been assigned.-Click Add Row.-Enter the same amount in the field Credit in Transaction Currency without assigning a cost center.-Confirm with Post.-This will post the expenses in connection with the fixed asset to the respective cost center.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Scrapping, Cost Center

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on SAP Business ByDesign Tenant Lifecycle Management
Content: Symptom-Frequently Asked Questions on SAP Business ByDesign Tenant Lifecycle Management.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1) Question: In a standard package, how many tenants are allowed for customers?-Answer: In standard package only one Test Tenant and one Productive Tenant are available for customers.-For details, refer to KBA: 2196301.-In the standard package, a new test system cannot be requested, it is due to the limit being reached. Either test system must be deleted first or a new system must be purchased for the request to be performed. Test systems in Maintenance Mode do not count to tenant availability and therefore can be ignored.-2) Question: How to request the decommissioning of a Production tenant?-Answer: The deletion of productive systems from the work center Service Control Center is not possible due to security reasons.--For details, refer to KBA: 2741988.-The deletion request of a LIVE productive system must be via a case (SRD-CC-CI-CCS).-3) Question: How to request the decommissioning of a Test tenant?-Answer: Follow the below steps:-Go to Service Control Center work center.-Go to Systems view.-Choose Active Systems.-select the system that you want to decommission.-Select Request Termination.-If decommissioning of an existing test tenant is not feasible then the customer should purchase the additional test tenant by contacting the account manager, SAP Customer Advocate/Project Manager.-4) Question: What are the Guidelines while requesting Test Tenants (After Go-Live)?-It is essential and very important that you provide us with a valid solution profile (change project) when requesting a new test tenant and/or solution profile copy from the Service Control Center.  If you do not provide us with a valid solution profile / change project, we cannot process your request.-More information about how to prepare a change project can be found in the Help Center documentation, in Prepare a Change Project.-A specific solution profile ID represents an according change project and is assigned with one change project.-There may be non-valid solution profiles available in the value help. Therefore, you must choose exactly the solution profile for the new change project created.-To provide you with a new test tenant, it is necessary that you create a new change project first if you want to merge back the new changes of the Business Configuration in this requested test tenant.-  5) Question: Once the customer signs up with SAP, which tenant is delivered to the customer?-Answer: The initial tenant provided to the customer is the Test Tenant. Once the relevant stage is reached in implementation, the Production Tenant can be requested from the Service Control Center Workcenter -> Systems view.--6) Question: How to request the termination of tenant?-Only test tenants can be terminated from Service Control Center work center.-The termination cannot be submitted for a tenant that the customer is logged on.-At least one tenant has to remain per solution and customer.-Proceed with caution: Partner solutions in the terminated tenant cannot be retrieved after termination.-Decommissioning is started immediately with physical deletion occurring in 14 days.-Once submitted, the termination request cannot be retracted via the UI; instead, open a very high incident (if physical deletion has not yet occurred).-Once the termination request is submitted, the tenant no longer counts towards the customer’s tenant allotment. -  7) Question: What are the restrictions during tenant upgrade?-Do not terminate or request a test tenant or productive tenant during the time between Test-Upgrade and Productive-Upgrade.-Avoid a Go-Live during this phase during the time between Test-Upgrade and Productive-Upgrade.-Avoid applying SAP Cloud Applications Studio add-ons during the time between Test-Upgrade and Productive-Upgrade.-No productive data transfer (migration) during productive upgrade weekend. Therefore, do not perform any migration activities during the upgrade weekend.-When system upgrades are planned for test and production system, do not request new tenants (2 days before the start of the test system upgrade and 2 weeks before the upgrade of production system).-Business Configuration is possible at any time in both test and productive tenant but without data transfer between the tenants.-Cases will no longer be closed as part of the upgrade process.-No merge back for Change Projects possible while test tenants are upgraded, and production tenants are not.-8) Question: Will extra fees be required for the new tenant if the production tenant is terminated and a new one is requested?-Answer: If the production tenant is terminated and a new one is requested, no extra fees will be charged.-9) Question: Is it possible to revert a Tenant Refresh that was performed mistakenly?-Answer: No, once the Tenant Refresh is performed, it's not possible to revert it.-10) Question: Does SAP Business ByDesign tenants support IPv6/Changing the environment variable to use IPv6?-Answer: Currently the SAP Business ByDesign tenants don't support IPV6 and it supports only IPv4.-11) Requirements:-• Possibility of hosting our financial data in India for compliance to government agencies (declaration of data localisation while filing ROC etc) and organisational policies.  -• Reference of India company utilizing SAP Business ByDesign for understanding their compliance and adherence to the laws while using the solution with in India.-Below is our recommendation:-“Our recommendation would be to use analytical reports (G/L line item, Journal, etc.) which can be also accessed via the broadcast functionality (Business analytics >>> Broadcast) should contain all data needed, and customers should be able to schedule and store these locally”.-12) Question: Is it possible to reschedule the system upgrade cycle?-Answer: The system upgrade cycle can only be rescheduled if the tenant belongs to a single tenant environment/system.-13) Question: How does system upgrade impact with the restore point? -The restore point will not be valid because it will be deleted after the system upgrade. The restore point created before an upgrade cannot be used to reset a restore point after the upgrade.-14) Question: Is it possible to delete all data in your production system or roll back the system to initial status?-Answer: It is not possible to delete all data. your requirement can be achieved with an empty tenant refresh request, refer the KBA: 2340655 for more details.-15) Question: Does SAP Provide the details about IP Address of user who logged into Tenant?-Answer: As per the SAP standard parameters maintained in SAP server we do not have the information at the user level hence details about IP Address of user who logged into Tenant is not available to provide.-16) Question: Difference between Database Storage Size and Tenant Size.-Answer:-Database Storage Size: This refers to the Database storage size of system. Database size is calculated at system level hence this information cannot be shared with customers (especially of public systems) as the system will be shared with co-hosting tenants from multiple customers.-Tenant Size: This is a relative size metric of a particular customer tenant. Which can be shared to customer on request.-17) Question: User planned a web service integration with a system from an external provider hence they want to change their IP addresses.-Answer: From SAP Business ByDesign end there are no blocks for any external IP address hence user can change IP address and configure them properly, and there should be no issues.-No action is required from SAP end here.-18) How much storage capacity is offered by SAP and what is the database size? Can we increase the database size and if we do, does it have a positive effect on the response time when working with the system?-Answer: SAP does not share the Database or storage size details used in each tenant. According to your contract SAP has a right to enforce a 10 GB / user limit, and we will inform you in advance in case you would approach this limit so we can take corrective action. Additional storage is available for purchase in case you additional space is needed.-Queries related Tenant URL:-1. Is it possible to Mask an URL?-Refer to KBA - 2737096-2. Is SAP Business ByDesign FQDN the same as the Tenant URL? For example: myxxxxxx.businessbydesign.cloud.sap-Answer: Fully Qualified Domain Names [FQDN] would be sapbydesign.com-Keywords-Terminate tenant, decommission tenant, delete tenant, initial tenant, Tenant Refresh, Service Control Center, faq, tenant request

Title: Cannot Find Product Image Added Through Migration of Materials
Content: Symptom-The Product Image was uploaded through the Migration of Materials, but it was noticed that the image is not being displayed in the UI.- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Access the Materials work center view.-Select a material that has been migrated into the system and click Edit.-In the material's screen, click the View All button.-In the General tab, where the image should be displayed, nothing is shown. -Cause-The only way to migrate product images into the system using the migration tool is by adding the same as an attachment with document type "Product Image".-As such, this record is maintained in the Attachments tab.-Resolution-Displayable product images can only be maintained manually by doing the following:-Go to the Product Data work center.-Access the Materials work center view.-Select the relevant material and click Edit.-In the material screen, click View All.-Click the Image button, then Add.-In the pop-up, click Browse to select the image to be upload.-Click Ok.-Keywords-Product Image, Migration of Materials, product data, attachment, byd

Title: Unexpected postings in the Purchase Accounts
Content: Symptom-You notice some unexpected postings in the Purchase Accounts in the Journal Entry type "00029 - Goods Receipt from Supplier" and Source Document type "119 - Warehouse Confirmation" and you wonder why these postings are created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center > Journal Entries view-Select All postings-Search for the Journal Entry ID: "XYZ"-Click Go-Open the Journal Entry-You notice some unexpected postings in the Purchase Accounts-XYZ means the Journal Entry ID-Cause-The Accounting Principle assigned for the set of book is maintained in the Activate Purchase Account Management for Additional Countries activity.-Resolution-Review the configuration in the Activate Purchase Account Management for Additional Countries activity and if required, remove the Accounting principle that is assigned for the Set of Book from this activity.-Configuration: Purchase Account Management-Keywords-purchase account, journal entry, warehouse confirmation

Title: Revenue Recognition Does Not Consider Journal Entry Voucher of Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You create a journal entry voucher of type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents for a customer project with sales integration.-After you execute the revenue recognition run you notice that the manual posting has not been considered to update the cost of sales or revenue of the project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center go to the Journal Entries - Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Find the manual journal entry XX. It is of type  00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents (XX represents the Journal Entry Vouchers ID).-This manual posting is to update the sales project's costs of sales/ revenue. You expect the run to realize these values on the respective expense/ revenue account.-Instead, the run does not consider the manual posting:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find the run and check the application log.-In the Postings tab of the run you cannot identify any postings to the expected Expense/Revenue account with the values maintained in the journal entry voucher.-Cause-For your Manual Entry for Sales Documents you used Screen Variant 633 - Man. Adjusting Entry for Sales Documents.-However, the revenue recognition functionality only considers journal entry vouchers for sales with screen variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Document.-The screen variant 633 - Man. Adjusting Entry for Sales Documents is used as a final adjustment on a sales document, to directly realize or update costs of sales / revenue on the respective accounts. It is recommended to created manual postings of this type only after executing the Revenue Recognition run as this run is not designed to consider such final postings.-Resolution-If there is no other way to update the cost of sales or the revenues for a customer project with sales integration (actual expense/revenue postings from time recordings, expense reports, supplier invoices, customer invoices/ credit memos etc.) but you need to revenue recognition run to still consider the update,  you can use a Manual Entry for Sales Documents, but with the Screen Variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Document.-Keywords-Revenue recognition, manual journal entry voucher, 收入确认，手工凭证

Title: "Length of IBAN not valid" Error During Master Data Replication for an Employee
Content: Symptom-Error during Master Data Replication for an employee:-"Length of IBAN not valid".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Go to the Employee Lists Report view.-Search for the Employee and edit it.-Observe that the Replication status of the employee is Failed with an error message: "Length of the IBAN not Valid".-Cause-The length of the IBAN entered in the bank account of the employee is not matching to the standard country IBAN account number.-Resolution-The length of the IBAN should be changed accordingly in Success Factors and a new replication request for the affected Employee with the correct details should be created.-Keywords-IBAN, Master Data Replication, Bank Account-iban,master data replication,bank account,length of iban,length of the iban not valid

Title: BYD2408 Patch creation is not happening
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Partner is unable to create a patch.  -After clicking create patch, the status briefly changes from 'Deployed' to 'In Patch Creation' and then reverts back to 'Deployed,' without creating the patch.-SLG1 logs will show something like this: -@5B\QInformation@    Product creation starts: Y12ABCDEF_-...-@5B\QInformation@    Creating dev top level folder of: Y12ABCDEF_-@5B\QInformation@    Activating content in XREP: Y12ABCDEF_-@5B\QInformation@    Creating Folder: /Y12ABCDEF_MAIN/SRC-@5B\QInformation@    Creating Folder : /Y12ABCDEF_MAIN/GEN-@5B\QInformation@    Creating Folder under root path: /Y12ABCDEF_MAIN/Assembly-@5B\QInformation@    Activating XREP path Y12ABCDEF_-@5B\QInformation@    Activate the layerst of: /Y12ABCDEF_MAIN/Assembly-@5C\QError@    An exception was raised-@5C\QError@    Top level folder deleted for file /SAP_BYD_UI_FLEX in CHECK_FILE_PATH_FOR_CREATION.-@5B\QInformation@    SDI_REGISTRY_HIST table updated with status UNDEPLOY -> SUCCESSED-@5B\QInformation@    SDI_REGISTRY_CDEP_HIST table updated with status UNDEPLOY -> SUCCESSED-@5B\QInformation@    Trying to Revert the Creation of Product: Y12ABCDEF_ .-Environment-Cloud Application Studio -SAP Backend -Reproducing the Issue-1. Open Solution in Cloud Studio and click 'Create patch' in Implementation Manager -2. After clicking create patch, the status briefly changes from 'Deployed' to 'In Patch Creation' and then reverts back to 'Deployed,' without creating the patch.-Cause-The patch creation for the solution YEKS1TSSY_ has failed.-As a result of which some inconsistent artifacts got created.-Resolution-SAP Development have to clean these artifacts and then retrigger patch creation.-For this first we need permissions from the customer to create a patch and cleanup the inconsistent artifacts.

Title: Posting Date of Cancellation Invoice is Grayed Out
Content: Symptom-You are not able to change the Posting Date of a Cancellation Invoice because the field is grayed out.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Search for Invoice ABC.-Click Edit button.-Click Cancel button.-Click View All button.-You notice that the Posting Date field is grayed out.-Cause-The Posting Date of the Cancellation Invoice is "Read Only" if the Accounting Period of the canceled Invoice is open.-This feature intends to make sure the Invoice and the Cancellation Invoice fall into the same Accounting Period.-This behavior also applies for countries with sequential numbering rules, e.g. Italy.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you want to cancel an invoice without closing the accounting periods of that invoice, you can use a follow up credit memo.-See Also-KBA 2168704 - Posting Date Field Not Enabled in Cancellation Invoice-Keywords-Posting Date, Buchungsdatum, Cancellation Invoice, Cancelation, Stornorechnung, Greyed Out, Grayed Out, Impossible, Change, Unable, Edit.

Title: Error "Authorization Role Missing for Service "ServiceInterface XYZ" When Using Webservices
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Customer reports that they are using a service interface from a communication arrangement, however are receiving the following error:-"Authorization role missing for service "ServiceInterface XYZ" (where XYZ represents the endpoint of the service interface).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Authorization role (also known as PCIA policies) is not generated for the service interface affected.-Resolution-To solve the issue, first delete the related communication arrangement and communication scenario. Then recreate the communication arrangement and communication scenario. This will refresh the technical user and assign the necessary authorization.-If the above method does not work, follow the steps below:-Open the backend of the system affected.-Enter transaction SE38.-Enter AP_A2X_ENDPOINT_ACTIVATION in Program field.-Click on the Execute button (alternatively, press F8 on the keyboard).-Change Scope to All Endpoints in the specific list.-Enter the technical name of Interface XYZ (e.g II_TIMX_MANAGE_EMPLOYEE_TIME_I).-Click on button deactivate once.-A new screen will show a list of the enpoints temporarily deactivated. Click on the Back button.-Now click on button activate again.-Again the system will show a list of the endpoints activated, confirming that the activation was successful.-This should generate the authorizations for interface.-Keywords-web service, manage, query, SOAP, system, scenario-soap

Title: Overhead Distribution Run Error - Rule Does not Contain any Receivers in Overhead Distribution run
Content: Symptom-When executing an overhead distribution run a warning appears stating "Rule XYZ does not contain any receivers" (XYZ represents a distribution rule).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Periodic Tasks view and here the Overhead Distribution subview.-Select the respective overhead distribution run and select Log Results.-In the run select the Messages tab.-Cause-Scenario 1:-In the distribution rule XYZ, the distribution amount determination is based on G/L account (origin), defined for account ABC (ABC represents a G/L account (Origin)ID).-For the period specified in the overhead distribution run however, there are no postings made originating from G/L account ABC.-To verify the postings to the cost center and G/L account (origin) combination the selected period, execute the Cost Center - Line Items report. ---Scenario 2:-In the distribution rule XYZ, the distribution factor is Based on costs.-This means that the shares for the distribution to the receiving cost centers are calculated based on the costs on each receiving cost center.-There are no costs on the relevant cost centers for the specific period checked.-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected.-Keywords-rule does not contain any receivers in overhead distribution run

Title: Error: Item XX: Products with item group XYZ not supported
Content: Symptom-When you add an Item with in a Sales Document you receive the error message: Item XX: Products with item group XYZ not supported (XX represents the line item number and XYZ the Item type).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The item type is either not supported for that particular Sales Document or you did not activate the respective scoping question.-Please see the resolution part for the different scenarios for Item Types and Sales Documents.-Resolution-Sales Order:-2580384 - Products With Item Group Expense-Fixed Price Without Actuals not Supported-2671094 - Error When Adding Product to Sales Order: Products with item group Spare part - direct goods issue not supported-2440195 - Item Type for a Service is missing in a Sales Order and the Service Master Data for selection-3509486 - Error: 'Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported' Occurs When Entering a Service into a Sales Order-  Opportunity:-2910573 - Sales Kit is Not Supported in Opportunities-  Contract:-2557788 - Project Based Services are not Supported in Contract-3774948 - Sales Kit is Not Supported in Contracts-  Service Order:-3215920 - Error: Item XX: Products w/ item group ABC not supported for location of srv provision XYZ-3509521- Error: 'Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported' Occurs When Entering a Service into a Service Order-Keywords-item group; item type; not supported; scoping; srv provision; CL_CDA_DOCIT; 114; 104

Title: Finished Warehouse Order in Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-A Finished Warehouse Order is still being shown in the Stock Overview, hence the On-Hand Stock is not reduced and the quantity is still being considered as Available. As the Warehouse Order is Finished and the Outbound Delivery is Released, you do not expect this quantity in the stock anymore.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Stock Overview common task.-Fill the Product ID ABC (ABC means Product ID) and Planning Area ID DEF (DEF means Planning Area ID).-Notice that the Finished Warehouse Order XXX (XXX means Warehouse Order ID) is still being shown.-Cause-The Finished Warehouse Order is being shown in the Stock Overview because when Outbound Delivery is released, Goods Issue Confirmation has not created due communication errors between these two documents. Therefore, the On-Hand Stock is not updated.-Resolution-To take the Warehouse Order off from the Stock Overview, the Goods Issue Confirmation need to be created. There are two options to do so:-Release the Outbound Delivery again. If choose this option, please pay attention to opened accounting period.-Cancel the Outbound Delivery by doing the Adjustment Confirmation. In this way, the On-Hand Stock will be updated.-Keywords-Warehouse Order, Stock Overview, Product, Outbound Delivery, On-Hand Stock

Title: How To Add a Company Logo In SAP Business ByDesign HTML5
Content: Symptom-In SAP Business ByDesign Silverlight UI you have the Company Branding Imagens that allows you add Company Logo and Title Bar and Background. In HTML5 UI the same option is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently the Company Branding Imagens feature is not available in HTML5 Client, this is a system expected behavior. Another option is available to add a company logo in HTML5.-Resolution-You can add a company logo in SAP Business ByDesign HTML5 by adaptation mode following the steps below:-Go to Home Work Center-Click on your profile icon-Go to Key User Settings then Start Adaptation Mode-Give a right click in My Launchpad area-A window will pop up with an option Change Company Logo-Select the company logo-Then Save and Publish your change-Keywords-Company Logo,My Launchpad, adaptaion mode

Title: Extended Text Limitation in OData
Content: Symptom-You are working with OData Extraction in your system and for some characteristics which displays texts with more than 60 characters, you use the Extended Text functionality to see all characters in the report. However, when extraction the report to OData, you notice that the data is displayed using the limit of 60 characters.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Analytics work center.-Navigate to Design Reports work center view.-Open any report in the list.-Execute the report.-Click on the Settings button.-Check the box for the option Display Extended Text.-Save the changes and close the report.-Generate the OData query and execute it.-See the values.-Cause-This is experienced due to a technical limitation in the current OData Framework used in the extraction and in the OData functionality itself.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-If the feature/functionality is needed as a matter of urgency, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.-Keywords-OData; Extended Text; Characters; Limitation; Characters Limit; 60 Characters; Analytics; OData Integration; Business Analytics;

Title: Illnesses View Shows Times on Leave and Vacation in Time File
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, open the employee's time file and want to check the sick leave of the employee. You select the Illnesses in the Employee Times tab and find that system returns time entries on leave and vacation time type as well as times on illness time type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the respective employee and select the Edit button.-Select the Employee Times tab.-Select the Illnesses checkbox.-The system also shows time entries on leave and vacation time types.-Cause-System works as designed.-Resolution-The Illnesses view is designed not to display only illnesses, but to analyze illnesses (absence). Therefore all absences are shown and especially those which are close to the illnesses.-If you need check only times for Illness, you can filter the list by Category.-However if some time types do not appear in the Category dropdown list, follow the steps below to activate them for Illness:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the project and select the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune tab and find the activity Time Types - <country name>.-Open the activity and select the Activate for Time Recording Services link.-Select the Illness view﻿ tab and add your required time types to Activated Time Types.-Keywords-Illnesses,absence,leave,Time Administrator-illnesses,leave
