Content: Symptom-Full data load from SAP Business ByDesign(ByD) to SAP NetWeaver Business Warehouse via Operational Data Provisioning (ODP) fails with the following error message in BW:- On backend side of the ByD tenant a TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED dump happens and the call stack information looks like the following:-23 METHOD       CL_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA_FSI======CP    CL_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA_FSI======CM00K  1724-    CL_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA_FSI=>READ_INTERNAL- 22 METHOD       CL_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA==========CP    CL_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA==========CM00B   207-    CL_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA=>IF_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA~FETCH- 21 METHOD       CL_MDRS_MDAV_READ_API=========CP    CL_MDRS_MDAV_READ_API=========CM001   221-    CL_MDRS_MDAV_READ_API=>FETCH- 20 METHOD       CL_MDRS_MVEL_ODP_IMPL=========CP    CL_MDRS_MVEL_ODP_IMPL=========CM002   306-    CL_MDRS_MVEL_ODP_IMPL=>GET_DATA- 19 METHOD       CL_RODPS_SIMPLE_CONTEXT=======CP    CL_RODPS_SIMPLE_CONTEXT=======CCIMP   817-    LCL_CURSOR=>GET_NEXT_PACKAGE- 18 METHOD       CL_RODPS_SIMPLE_CONTEXT=======CP    CL_RODPS_SIMPLE_CONTEXT=======CCIMP   691-    LCL_CURSOR=>IF_RODPS_ODP_CURSOR~FETCH_NEXT_PACKAGE- 17 FUNCTION     SAPLRODPS_REPL                      LRODPS_REPLU01                        144-    RODPS_REPL_ODP_READ_DIRECT_XML- 16 METHOD       CL_II_RODPS_ODP===============CP    CL_II_RODPS_ODP===============CM009    43-    CL_II_RODPS_ODP=>II_RODPS_ODP~FETCH_DATA_DIRECT-Environment-SAP NetWeaver-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Full load of data without restriction from ByD tenant to BW system via ODP API.-Cause-Since too much data is requested Memory allocation dump is happening. In the ODP scenario with ByD, Pagination via ODP for C4C & ByDesign customers is not supported below release 1705 SPS02.-Resolution-ODP extraction via packaging/pagination works for ByDesign systems.- See Also- Othere errors such as TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED can also show.-Keywords-Operational Data Provisioning, Cloud for Customer, SoapFaultCodeName, RABAX, pagination, c4c, bydesign, TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED, dump, st22, tenant, 1705, sps2, sap business bydesign, sap, bw, business warehouse

Title: Missing Deviating Bank Information on Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You create a new Supplier Invoice with or without Purchase Order and can see that under Payment Information the Deviating Bank Information.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Entry.-Create a new Invoice.-Go to View All.-In General tab select Payment Information sub-tab.-See that the tab Deviating Bank Information is missing.-Cause-System behavior-Resolution-In the new upgrade the system need to have the Payment Method as Bank Transfer in the Supplier Invoice to activate the Deviating Bank Information.-Keywords-Payment Method, Payment Information, Supplier Invoice, Deviating Bank Information

Title: In the Sales Order you Cannot Cancel the Open Invoice Schedule Item
Content: Symptom-You are not able to cancel the open Invoice Schedule item in Sales order.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Select any sales order and Edit.-Click in View All button.-Go to Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Click in Invoice Schedule tab.-Here you will see the items of the open invoice schedule view cannot be cancel. The button is greyed out.-Cause-The system is working as designed. The button cancel is Greyed out because schedule invoice requests have not been created for theses dates.-Resolution-Since Invoice requests are not created for these dates, you cannot cancel these items. However If you don't want to invoice on these dates then you can simply remove these items using the action Remove following the steps below:-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales orders view.-Select any sales order and Edit.-Click in View All button.-Go to Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Navigate to Invoice Schedule sub-tab.-Select the desired Invoice Schedule item line and click in Remove button.-The Invoice Schedule Item will be deleted.-  Keywords-Sales Order; Invoice Schedule; Open; Status; Remove; Cancel; Greyed Out

Title: How to Reply to Customer in the Service Request
Content: Symptom-How to reply to customer in the service request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Go to the Service Requests view.-Show All Service Requests.-Select the Service Request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service request).-Select the Edit button.-You want to reply to customer in Service Request ABC. -Cause-The functionality is available in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Select the Service Requests View.-Select the Service Request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service request).-Select the Edit button.-Go to the case Description tab and input the contents.-Select the Submit button.-After this you will find the input will be successfully appear in Notes and History as reply to customer.-Keywords-Service Request; Reply; Notes; History

Title: Personalize This Screen Not Available
Content: Symptom-When clicking on Personalize, the option for this Screen is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click Personalize.-The option This Screen ﻿is missing.-Cause-This option can be enabled or disabled by a Key User ﻿via ﻿Adaptation Mode.-Resolution-Click Adapt.-Choose ﻿Company Setting View.-On section Personalization Settings, check or uncheck the box for Disable User Personalization Features.-Click Save and Close.-Keywords-Personalize, this screen,

Title: Due Date Compliance (Service Requests) Report does not Display any Data
Content: Symptom-You are looking forward to use the Report Due Date Compliance (Service Requests) in your system and notice that it does not display any data even though there are Service Requests being maintained in the system.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for the report Due Date Compliance (Service Requests).-Select the report and open it.-Run the report.-Notice that the warning message No report data available to display. Check the selection is raised.-Cause-This scenario is experienced due to an internal filtering condition which is set for this standard report.-In a backend perspective, this report only display Service Requests which have the status Closed, however, the system now is working with the status Completed for Service Requests, due to that, it does not displays the current number of Service Requests as expected.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-If the feature/functionality is needed as a matter of urgency, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.-Keywords-Report; Service Request; Due Date Compliance; Analytics; Data Source; Business byDesign; ByD;-crmsrqhb_q0005

Title: Receiving Company is not visible in New Bank-to-Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-You try to create an intercompany bank transfer,  but it is not possible to select the required Company in the To Company field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select New Bank-to-Bank Transfer from the Common Tasks.-In the From Company field select company ABC (ABC represents the sending Partner Company's ID). -Open the Value help in the To Company field.-It is not possible to select any Company other than Company ABC. -Cause-The involved partner companies are not net enabled for the intercompany process.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for the activity "Direct Posting to Partner Companies". -Under Intercompany Bank-to-Bank Transfer choose Enable Companies.-Press Add row. -In the Leading Company column, select the sending company ABC. -In the Partner Company column, select the receiving company DEF (DEF represents the ID of the receiving company. -In the Enabled column select True. -Note: If you keep the initial setting, displaying an asterix in the Leading and Partner Company column and just set the Enabled column to True, then any combinations of sending and receiving Company (from ABC to DEF as well as DEF to ABC) are possible.-See Also-Intercompany Bank-to-Bank Transfer-Keywords-Intercompany Bank-to-Bank Transfer, select Company, inter-company

Title: Inactive Exchange Rates are Shown as Current Exchange Rates Under General Ledger
Content: Symptom-Inactive exchange rates are being shown in the Current Exchange Rates view. It was expected that in this view only active rates were shown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, click Edit Exchange Rate.-The system is showing the rates that were removed/inactive as Current Exchange Rates.-It was expected that the Inactive rates would not be seen in this view. Only via View Exchange Rate History.-Cause-This screen shows the exchange rates with the latest Valid From date. It can have multiple records in following cases:-If there are multiple records for the same currency pair with the same Valid from date.-If the pair with the latest Valid From date has been made inactive and the pair with a Valid From date before that is active.-Resolution-The above description is the design system behavior. Note that even though the inactive rates are shown, the system only picks up exchange rates that are active.-Keywords-Exchange Rate. Inactive. Current Exchange Rates.

Title: No Journal Entry Created for Goods and Services Receipt
Content: Symptom-There is no Journal Entry created for the released Goods and Services Receipt.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to the Receipts and Returns view.-Select the Goods and Services Receipt in question and click Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Journal Entry is not created for the Goods and Service Confirmation.-Cause-The Goods and Services Receipt is created with reference to Purchase Order with Zero price.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-No journal entry will be created if Purchase Order has zero price. For free items, accounting entries are not relevant.-See Also-KBA 3081658 - Journal Entry Missing for Goods and Service Receipt-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipt, Goods and Activity Confirmation, Journal Entry, Not Created, goods and services receipts

Title: Message When Uploading HTML File to System: 'Documents With This MIME type are Not Allowed to be Uploaded According to the Settings Made in Your Solution Configuration'
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload an HTML file to a workflow rule, you get the below error message:-'The document you want to upload has the MIME type text/html. Documents with this MIME type are not allowed to be uploaded according to the settings made in your solution configuration.'-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Workflow Rules view.-Select New.-Input all mandatory information and navigate to Define Actions.-Choose Rule Type as E-Mail.-Select Browse to upload the relevant email template and select the html file.-Result: You get the message: 'The document you want to upload has the MIME type text/html. Documents with this MIME type are not allowed to be uploaded according to the settings made in your solution configuration.'-Cause-HTML document upload is not supported in the system by default.-Resolution-You need to scope the system to allow HTML files into your system by following scoping steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity List.-Select the Fine-tune step.-Choose to view All Activities.-Find the Allowed Mime Types For Document Upload activity and open it.-Set the MIME type code 10082, Text/HTML document, as allowed. -Save and Close.-Keywords-html, text/html, MIME type, type code 10082-documents mime type are not allowed,not allowed to be uploaded,type code 10082,mime type

Title: Error "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item" Raised when Changing Employee Responsible in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Error message "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item 30 (KBA: 2927063) " occurs when you change the Employee responsible in a Sales Order for which a follow up Contract is created.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center-Go to Sales Orders View-Search for Sales Order XYZ(XYZ represents the Sales Order ID)-Edit the sales order and navigate to General Tab-Change the Employee Responsible assigned to Sales Order. -You will get the error :"Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item XX(KBA: 2927063) " (XX represents the line item ID).-Cause-In this case, the change of Employee Responsible is also resulting in a change/update the Sales Unit. The system has a validation which checks if a Contract is created as a follow up of the sales order, then such modifications will not be allowed. In this case, there is a Contract which is created as follow-up of the Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior-Keywords-Sales Order, Party, Parties, Employee Responsible, Sales Unit, Unable, Impossible, Error, Already Exists;

Title: Error message while posting Payment Allocation - Save rejected. Please try again.
Content: Symptom-You are posting the payment allocation and getting the error - Save rejected. Please try again.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click on Payment Allocation View.-Search for the Payment Allocation.-Click on Edit -->Post.-You see the error - Save rejected. Please try again.-Cause-Due to the technical issue the error is not reproducible on all the payment allocations. The error occurs randomly Hence, the cause is not yet identified and fixed.-Resolution-At the moment, you can suggest the below work-around to avoid the error and post the payment allocation:-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click on Payment Allocation View.-Search for the Payment Allocation.-Open the Payment Allocation.-Click View All.-Remove the Posting Date and press Enter.-Enter the posting date.-Click on Post.-System will allow you to post without error. -Keywords-Payment Allocation Error, Save rejected. Please try again

Title: Form Template Maintenance Less or More Records
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When opening Form Template Maintenance screen, more/less templates are seen in comparison to other users.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management.-View Form Template Maintenance.-The amount of templates differs from the amount other users can see.-Cause-The involved busines user is assigned to a different layer strategy.-Resolution-To check the same, first go to transaction SE16-Input table APXR_SETTINGS-Enter the desired user > Check the layer assigned-In order to change the same to test with support user, go to:-Transaction XREP-On menu bar click on Environment-Switch Layer St.

Title: Release a Sales Order Automatically via the Web Service
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You created a sales order via the web service and want to release the sales order automatically via the web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the SOAP request the ReleaseCustomerRequest is set to TRUE (tag <ReleaseCustomerRequest>true</ReleaseCustomerRequest>) but the sales order is still in status In Preparation. You expected that the sales order would be release via this action.-Cause-The tag <ReleaseCustomerRequest> only controls the technical status and has nothing to do with the actual releasing of a sales order (Submit->Release order on the UI) which changes the status of the order from In Preparation to Open. This is controlled by the setting in the Business Configuration.-It is not possible to fist create the sales order via the web service (ManageSalesOrder). Then to update sales order via the web service in a second request and in a third request release the sales order via the web service. At this point the sales order can only be released via the UI by a user.-Resolution-You can check the Business Configuration scoping questions for the Sales Order Release Procedures for E-Selling as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select you First Implementation project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Select the scoping element Sales -> Selling Products and Services -> E-Selling.-In the section Questions: Sales Order Release Procedures you can find the question:-Would you like your employees to control the release of sales orders that originate from an E-Shop in order to initiate order processing?-If you select Yes: This means that when a sales order is created the Request Release Status will be Not Released . This will change to Released when the operation SalesOrderActionIn -> ReleaseCustomerRequest is executed. By sending a second request with the tag:-<ReleaseCustomerRequest>true</ReleaseCustomerRequest> (See KBA: 1757249 - Sales Volume Report Show Incorrect Data)-NOTE: The operation SalesOrderActionIn -> ReleaseCustomerRequest has to be to be executed from the web shop (web service), this means customer has to release the customer request in the web shop itself. Unless this is executed the sales order will not appear on the user interface of ByDesign.-  See Also-1837774 - How to find a Sales Order in ByD Created from a Webshop with ReleaseCustomerRequest set to False-1757249 - Sales Volume Report Show Incorrect Data-2626296 - Sales Order Created via Web Service Not Automatically Released-1840866 - You Are Not Able to Find your Sales Order created from your E-Shop in the ByD system-Keywords-ReleaseCustomerRequest; Sales Order; E-Commerce; E-Selling; Web Service

Title: Message "Bank and account number for payment method 'Bank Transfer' missing" on Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Message "Bank and account number for payment method 'Bank Transfer' missing" occurs when clicking the Check button in Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents Supplier Invoice ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Create a new invoice.-Enter all the relevant data.-Select Bank Transfer as Payment Method.-Select Check button.-Message: Bank and account number for payment method 'Bank Transfer' missing.-Cause-This feature was introduced with release 2408, allowing the Payment Method to be selected directly within the Supplier Invoice.-Resolution-To avoid this message when Bank Transfer is selected as the payment method, the bank details must be maintained as follows:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search Invoice ABC.-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Go to Payment Information sub-tab.-Select Deviating Bank Information.-Enter the required details in the Bank ID field.-See Also-KBA 3779768 - Payment Method Field Values Cleared after Posting Supplier Invoice - SAP for Me-Keywords-Bank Information, Bank Transfer, Payment Method, Supplier Invoice

Title: Unable to Update Personal Address of Contacts of Existing Customers Using the Migration of Customers
Content: Symptom-When updating the Personnel Address (such as Mobile Number, Phone Number and Fax Number) of the Contacts of existing Customers, the system throws the below error messages:-Net update with data in tab: Contacts - Personal Addresses field: Fax is not supported-Net update with data in tab: Contacts - Personal Addresses field: Phone is not supported-Net update with data in tab: Contacts - Personal Addresses field: Mobile is not supported-or-Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER-CONTACT_PERSON with key UUID-CONTENT = `XYZ` does not exist” (Where XYZ refers to the Account UUID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview View.-In the search field, insert Migration of Customers.-Click Migration of Customers.-Click Migrate customers using the migration tool.-Select the respective file.-Click Execute Migration.-Click Execute Migration Step-by-Step.-The below error messages are displayed:-Net update with data in tab: Contacts - Personal Addresses field: Fax is not supported-Net update with data in tab: Contacts - Personal Addresses field: Phone is not supported-Net update with data in tab: Contacts - Personal Addresses field: Mobile is not supported-NOTE: Migration Mode is Modify already existing records.-Cause- Modify or Enhance is not supported for Mobile Number, Phone Number and Fax Number of the Contacts.-Resolution-The phone number is together with the mobile number in one structure and for this structure, if the phone number is updated, the mobile number will be deleted and vice versa. To prevent data loss, this feature is not supported.-NOTE: Mass Data Maintenance is a part of data Migration and the concept remains same.-Keywords-Contacts, Personal Addresses, Fax, Mobile, Phone, Account, Customer, BC, Migration, byd

Title: Not Possible To Change Time Zone For Technical User
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to change the time zone of the technical user ABC from, for example, UTC+00:00 (Burkina Faso) to UTC-06:00 (central time Mexico City).-ABC refers to the Technical user ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently it's not possible to change the time zone of Technical Users.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Technical User, Time zone, User, ByDesign, Burkina Faso, (UTC+00:00),  UTC -06:00 (central time Mexico City)

Title: In a Return the Error Occurs: Currency not maintained in Account
Content: Symptom-While editing a return either of the following error occurs:-Currency not maintained in Account.-Currency missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Open return XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the return).-Click on View All.-The following error occurs: Currency not maintained in Account-Cause-The Currency is not maintained in the Account Masterdata for the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel maintained in the Return. -The error occurs due to an inconsistency. Eventhough, all the required data is maintained in the return and the account master data, the error still occurs e.g. because the Currency was maintained in the Account after the Return was created. -Resolution-Ensure that the Currency is maintained in the account master data using the below steps:-Go to the Account Management work center .-Select the Accounts view.-Open the respective account.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Ensure that for the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel maintained in the Return the Currency is maintained. -Click on Save.-Follow the below steps, to resolve the error:-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Return view.-Open return XYZ and click on View All.-Navigate to the General tab-In the field Sales Unit select the value help.-Select a different Sales Unit.-Select the value help again.-Enter the same entry back via the value help and save the changes.-The error will be removed.- Keywords-Currency missing; Return; Currency not maintained; Currency not maintained in account; inconsistent.

Title: Is it Possible to Mass Upload Hundreds of Employees Phone or Mobile Numbers in Business ByDesign system
Content: Symptom-You require to upload hundreds of Employees Phone or Mobile numbers in the Workplace Address and want to know if there a possibility to Mass update.-Resolution-There is one approach where the Mass update of Phone and Mobile numbers can be accomplished. You may create a user-defined OData Service in the ODataServices view in Application and User Management work center. Thereafter, call this Service from a service consumer.-You may seek assitance from your Business Partner, using partner developed solution (PDI) or you may contact SAP Cloud Service Center team.-If the feature/functionality is needed as a matter of urgency, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available.

Title: Error When Adding Product to Sales Order: Products with item group Spare part - direct goods issue not supported
Content: Symptom-The following error message occurs when adding a product with item type DIGI to a Sales Order: 'Item XX: Products with item group Spare part - direct goods issue not supported (XX represents the line item number)'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click on New button and select Sales Order.-Enter the Account ABC (where ABC represents the Account ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add Product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-The following error message occurs:-Item XX: Products with item group Spare part - direct goods issue not supported-Cause-The item group DIGI - Spare part - direct goods issue is designed for the Spare Parts Handling scenario. When executing a service order, the service engineers can perform a direct goods issue by entering a logistic area for the spare parts used. This item group is only supported in the Service scenario (Service Orders) and not in the Sales scenario (Sales Order).-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-If your requirement is to use the same product in both Sales and Service scenarios.-The only way you would be able to use the same Product in both the Sales and Service scenarios would be via different Distribution Chains for the Sales and Service scenarios in the Sales tab of the Product Master Data. When you open the product and navigate to the Sales tab you are able to add a Sales Organization and a Distribution Channel. In the Sales sub tab you can then maintain the item group. It is possible to maintain multiple Sales Organizations with different Distribution Channels and these can then have different item groups.-For example:-You add  Sales Organization A with Distribution Channel Direct Sales and maintain for this the item group DIGI.-Then you add Sales Organization B with Distribution Channel Direct Sales and maintain for this the item group NORM.-In a Sales Order you would need to select a Sales Unit belonging to Sales Organization B. When you then add the product the item type NORM will be determined in the Sales Order.-In a Service Order you would need to select a Sales Unit belonging to Sales Organization A. When you then add the product the item type DIGI will be determined in the Service Order.-Alternatively you could also use the same Sales Organization but different distribution Channels for the Sales and Service scenarios.-Keywords-digi; spare part; direct goods issue; sales order; item type; item group; sales organization

Title: GR/IR Clearing run Error Message: Account determination Missing for Material
Content: Symptom-The GR/IR clearing run finishes with the error message 'Account determination missing for material'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the GR/IR Clearing sub-view.-Select the target run ID, and choose View.-Go to the Processed With Errors tab.-Navigate to the line item of the purchasing document in question: You can see the error message at the bottom of the screen 'Account determination missing for material'.-Cause-There is a difference between the purchasing price and the invoice price, either due to an actual price difference or due to exchange rate differences (for example, if the goods receipt is posted in company currency CC whereas the supplier invoice is posted in a different foreign currency, FC.-For these differences no G/L account are defined in fine tuning. -Resolution-Maintain the missing account determination setting in the fine tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination - Account Determination before executing the next GR/IR clearing run:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine tune activity, either through the implementation project's activity list or in the Overview section. -Select Account Determination and navigate to Inventory.-Select the respective Account Determination profile and select the subledger Inventories.-Navigate to the Differences tab.-Maintain the G/L accounts for Gain/Loss from Purchasing Price Differences, and Gain/Loss from Exchange Rate Differences for the account determination group associated with the material.---Keywords-account determination missing for material, GR/IR clearing run error

Title: Wrong Segment Derivation for Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-For sales order item XYZ-XX profit center ABC is derived which is also defined as segment (XYZ-XX represents a sales order item ID, ABC represents a profit center and segment ID).-However, the assigned segment is not ABC but DEF (DEF represents a segment ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view. -Find sales order item XYZ-XX. -In the Datails section underneath the table go to the General tab and check the Organizational Data. -Here, org unit ABC is assigned as profit center. -You expect org unit ABC to be assigned as segment as well. However, segment DEF is assigned. -Cause-Org unit ABC is not valid as segment on the sales order item's posting date. Therefore it could not be derived automatically from the profit center. -To verify: -Check the sales order item's posting date: -In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view. -Find sales order item XYZ-XX. -In the Details section underneath the table go to the Dates tab.-Take note of the Source Document Item Date (which is the item's posting date), for example 02.02.YYYY. -To check the segment validity of org unit ABC: -In the Organizational Management work center go the Org Structures view. -Find org unit ABC and select it. -In the Details section underneath the structure go to the Time Lines tab. -Under Managerial- Segment you can see the Valid From date is after the sales order item's posting date, for example 05.05.YYYY.-Resolution-When the sales order item's posting date is before the segment validity start date, the segment cannot be derived automatically from the profit center. -You can trigger the correct segment derivation with a dummy change by reassigning profit center ABC: -In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view. -Find sales order item XYZ-XX. -Press Reassign and select Profit Center. -Select profit center ABC. -Press OK. -In the General tab check the Organizational Data section: This time, org unit ABC is now also assigned as Segment.-See Also-Profit Center Derivation-Keywords-sales order item, segment wrong, segment derivation

Title: Restrict Access to ByDesign in Specific Network
Content: Symptom-How to restrict user access to ByDesign in specific network, e.g. the network of the company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There is an option called IP filtering option but it is only available only for Private edition customers.-IP filtering is a technique which can restrict the access of a given URL / all the URLs / set of URLs of a system to be accessible only from a specific network. Requests coming from any other network will be terminated and the caller will get a 403 error.-As of today, this functionality is only offtered for Private Edition systems (PE) or in other words, for Single Customer Systems.-See Also-3307155 - How to Check if a Customer Tenant is Located in a Multi-Tenant system or in a Private Tenant System in the Cloud Reporting Tool-Keywords-IP Filtering, Access Restriction, 登录网络限制

Title: Error Message "The file is corrupt and cannot be opened" While Downloading Migration Template
Content: Symptom-When you are downloading Migration Template system throws below error message:-The file is corrupt and cannot be opened-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-3. Search and Open any Migration Activity.-4. Select You Can Also-5. Select Download Migration Template-Cause-Extension fields description must be containing the symbols like >, <. The Migration Template will get saved as a XML, and backend it will be having tags like <, >. System will treat them as XML tags and therefore, template gets corrupted.-Resolution-In order to fix this scenario,you need to delete the symbols <, > in the field descriptions by using the Adaptation Mode in the UI. After deleting it then readapt the extensions fields. After that you should be able to download the Migration Template.-Keywords-The file is corrupt and cannot be opened, Migration Tool, Cannot, Download, Migration, Template.

Title: Unposted Goods and Services Receipt - Subseq. Acquisition Not Permitted In Calc.Proc
Content: Symptom-You notice an unposted Goods and Services Receipt due to the error "An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ. Subseq. Acquisition Not Permitted In Calc.Proc" in the General Ledger.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view and go to the Source Documents subview.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Select the not posted goods and services receipt document in question.-In the Messages section you notice the errors "An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ. Subseq. Acquisition Not Permitted In Calc.Proc". (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset for which an acquisition is to be posted through the goods receipt). -Cause-Fixed Asset XYZ is maintained as Low Value fixed asset. It was acquired in a previous, now closed fiscal year. But the proposed posting date of the unposted goods receipt is in the current fiscal year. -By default, depreciation methods associated with low value assets, such as 0100 or L200, allow acquisitions only in the fiscal year of capitalization. -This can be validated as follows:-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open activity list button.-Select Fine-Tune tab.-Select Depreciation Methods activity.-Find the used depreciation method, for example LVA - 100% complete depreciation. -Under Calculation Parameters, the Acquisition Only in Fiscal Year of Capitalization Allowed indicator is set.-Resolution-The ideal way would be to cancel the goods receipt and to not go ahead with the posting:-Cancel the goods receipt.-The cancellation document will also appear as unposted source document in the Source Documents view of the General Ledger workcenter.-Highlight the cancellation and press Actions - View business transaction.-In the next screen press Mark as Irrelevant.-This will mark the goods receipt cancellation as well as its original as irrelevant for accounting. -However, if you need to go ahead with the posting you could:-change the depreciation method of the fixed asset temporarily, to, for example L010 - Str.-line from acq.value to 0 or-deselect the Acquisition Only in Fiscal Year of Capitalization Allowed indicator for the used depreciation method, if you want to allow additional acquisitions in the subsequent years also whenever this particular depreciation method is assigned to a fixed asset.-After this the source document can be posted.-However, these options are not officially recommended.-Keywords-Subseq. Acquisition Not Permitted In Calc.Proc; unposted goods receipt, low value fixed asset, Asset val.view Subseq. acquisition not permitted in calc.proc.
