Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to check when the tenant was created or last modified.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Go to Cloud Landscape Work Center.-Go to Tenants View.-Enter the tenant URL.-Click on Go.-Go to Change Log.-Keywords-Tenant Details in SPC, Change Log, Tenant modified, Tenant Created-change log,tenant details

Title: Payables Payment Run: Cash Discount Not Calculated For Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice XYZ with payment terms allowing a cash discount deduction when the payment is made in a certain period, for example, X days Y%, Z days due net. The Maxium Cash discount date is DD.MM.YYYY (the last day of the cash discount period) (XYZ represents a supplier invoice ID).-The payment strategy that the respective supplier is maintained as follows:-Preferred Payment time: Pay with any available Cash discount on latest possible date-Grace days: B (B represents the number of grace days).-Payables payment run ABC has been scheduled including the supplier for which the invoice was created (ABC represents the payables payment run. -Together with the grace days the payment date still falls into the cash discount period.  -Therefore, you expect the run to automatically apply the respective cash discount. Instead, you find invoice XYZ in the generated payment proposal list but without the expected cash discount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check if supplier invoice XYZ has been selected for payment with cash discount:-In the Payables work center navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and here to the Payment Runs subview.-Select payment run ABC and under Execution Details highlight the respective application log.-Press View Payment Proposals.-In the Payment Proposal List find supplier invoice XYZ.-To check the applied Payment Terms and the Maximum Cash Discount Date add these characteristics to the table via the Personalize function.-You verify that the correct payment terms have been used (X days Y%, Z days due net).-The Maximum Cash Discount Date is DD.MM.YYYY.-Together with the B grace days the payment date still falls into the cash discount period, meaning, between DD.MM.YYYY and DD.MM.YYYY+B).-But you notice that the amount in the Cash Discount column displays 0,00 LC. You expected Y% of the Proposed Payment Amount.-Cause-The payment run selects all open items for which the Maximum Cash Discount Due Date plus Grace Days would have expired before the next expected payment run execution.-However, the grace days don't affect the calculation of the cash discount itself if the actual cash discount period (period until the Maximum Cash Discount Due Date excluding the Grace Days) has already expired on the day of the payment run.-In this case, the invoice is still being selected for payment as the whole cash discount period (including the grace days) will be expired before the next expected run.-But the user is requested to manually enter the cash discount.-To check the next expected payment run execution date:-In the Payables work center navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and here to the Payment Runs subview.-Select payment run ABC and under Execution Details highlight the respective application log.-Press on the Application Log ID.-In the Settings tab check the last row.-The Next expected payment run execution date is DD.MM.YYYY+ C, a date after DD.MM.YYYY+B (the Maximum Cash Discount Due Date of invoice XYZ plus B Grace days).-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Only if you maintain 0 Grace Days in the applied payment strategy then the payment run will select the open items within the cash discount period (period until the Maximum Cash Discount Due Date) and automatically apply the respective cash discount.-Keywords-Payables, Grace days, 0, zero, supplier invoice, payment, cash discount

Title: Project task ABC not valid for customer XYZ
Content: Symptom-When trying to assign a project to a sales order system throws error message: "Project task ABC not valid for customer XYZ(where ABC is task ID and XYZ is customer name)".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Choose Sales Orders view-Choose the target Sales Order.-Click on Edit button.-Go to the Items tab under Project task drop down field find the project ABC you will not be able to see the Project ABC, when you enter manually the system throws an error message and the project will not be saved.-Cause-If the customer project and the sales order are assigned  to two different customers, then the system will not allow you to assign the customer project to sales order which doesn't belongs to the same customer.-Resolution-Please search and assign project tasks of same customer.-See Also-2032526 - Error Message:Item XX : Project task ID MCP not assigned to a customer-Keywords-Project task not valid for customer, project task not found, Unable to assign project task to sales order

Title: Unable to Post Expense Report: Account Determination is Missing for Item Type Input Tax
Content: Symptom-You have posted an expense report, however it says that the account determination is missing for taxes, even though you have set the account determination for the country/region of the expense report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find the related expense report.-You see the error: 'Account determination is missing for item type Input Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts <Chart of Accounts ID/Name> and account determination profile <Account Determination Profile ID>. Column Path Tax->Input Tax->Input Tax, Item Type Input Tax.'-Cause-For this specific case, the employee's work agreement is, for example, Canadian and the company the employee is employed is a US company.-Note that during the hire process this mismatch in country/regions is highlighted in a warning/information message. For example, employee hired in Canada but assigned to a US org. structure.-To check the work agreement's country/region, you may search for the employee under Personnel Administration -> Employees. Refer to the country/region column within the list or use the Advanced search.-To check the company's country/region, you may open the Org. Structure and check the Org. Unit representing the company in the expense report.-Resolution-To post this expense report, you need to maintain the additional configuration for the tax account determination to the company's country/region.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Tax under the Account Determination section.-Select the relevant combination of account determination profile and chart of accounts.-Go to the Input Tax tab.-In the Select country/region dropdown, select the country/region of the org. unit the employee is assigned or Country-Independent.-Maintain the account determination accordingly.-After saving the changes, you may post the source document via Source Documents view.-Keywords-Expense Report, Employment, Organizational Management, Globalization, Cross-country, Account Determination, Tax Rate, Tax Type.

Title: Not Able to Create External Customer Invoice Request with Customized UoM in Item Line
Content: Symptom-In the service master data ABC, you select the Base UoM as XYZ which is a customized UoM, and maintained quantity conversion: 1 XYZ = 1 Hour(s).  (ABC represents the ID of service item; XYZ represents the ID of the UoM)-When creating new invoice request manually in UI, you are able to select XYZ as the quantity UoM in the item line. But, when creating external customer invoice request via web service, you are not able to set XYZ as the Quantity Unit Code due to error. Hence, not able to set XYZ as quantity UoM in the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-By using the following codes in the paylaod, it creates external invoice reuqest with item quantity=18, quantity UoM=h-Hour(s), list price=150 USD.-<Quantity unitCode="HUR">18</Quantity>-<QuantityTypeCode >TIME</QuantityTypeCode>-<PriceAndTax>-<PriceComponent>-<TypeCode>7PR1</TypeCode>-<Rate>-<DecimalValue>150</DecimalValue>-<CurrencyCode>USD</CurrencyCode>-<BaseDecimalValue>1</BaseDecimalValue>-<BaseMeasureUnitCode>HUR</BaseMeasureUnitCode>-</Rate>-</PriceComponent>-While, you want to set the quantity UoM to XYZ in the invoice request. You then use the following code.-<Quantity unitCode="XYZ">18</Quantity>-<QuantityTypeCode>TIME</QuantityTypeCode>-The created external customer invoice request is then inconsistent status due to error:Combination of product and quantity unit does not exist.-Cause-Customized UoM is not accepted Quantity Unit Code. You are not able to use customized UoM in external customer invoice request.-Resolution-You need to check the accepted Quantity Unit Code and Quantity Type Code in KBA 2788104 - Quantity Unit Error When Uploading Customer Invoice.-Review your XML structure and correct the units passed.-Keywords-web service; quantity unit code; quantity type code; UoM; Unit of Measure;

Title: Error Message When Deleting a Custom UI Component (screen)
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the below error message when trying to delete some custom UI components (WCF, QA, TT, TI,...):-File /YABCDEFG_MAIN/SRC/FOLDER/TICOMPONENTNAME_TI.TI.uicomponent can not be cleanup because it is refered by file /YABCDEFG_MAIN/SRC/STABLE_ ANCHORS/EmbeddingAnchor/acbdefghijkelmnoprstuv.uianchor-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio and open your custom solution.-Right click on the UI component (screen) that you want to delete and select Delete.-Errors come up-Cause-There are multiple causes for those error message messages:-Cause 1:-When you create a custom Object-Based navigation or Thing-Based navigation, a sequence of UI components (WCF, WCView, OWL, QA, TT, TI....) are created together with some dependencies and references between those UI components. If you try to delete some UI component that is depended or referenced by another UI component, the system will not allow the deletion in order to avoid inconsistency on your UI navigation structure.-For example: OWL will have a reference in WCVIEW which in turn will be referred by Work Center (WCF).-You need to first remove the dependencies and references manually and then delete the UI component. Normally, the UI component are referenced on the following order:-WCF -> WCVIEW -> OWL -> QC/QA -> QV/QT -> TI/OIF -> TT/PTP-Cause 2:-You still have a Custom Change Transaction (Created via UI designer) on the UI component that you are trying to delete and all Change Transaction bounded to the current UI component should be removed manually first.-Resolution-For Cause 1:-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio and open your custom solution.-Open the UI component that referenced the UI component that you want to delete.-Remove the dependencies with the UI component that you want to delete.-Or-If you want to delete all navigation structure, delete the UI components on the following order:-WCF -> WCVIEW -> OWL -> QC/QA -> QV/QT -> TI/OIF -> TT/PTP-For Cause 2:-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio and open your custom solution.-Open the UI component that you want to delete on UI Designer.-Remove All Change Transactions bound to this UI Component.-In case, you tried those approaches, but you are still receiving the error messages, open a case for SAP Technical Support providing the following details:-Names and Path of the UI component that you want to delete;-Error message (With screenshot if possible);-Your explicit written authorization to delete the UI component on our side if needed.-See Also-For SAP Technical Support:- 2182459 - Error When Deleting an UI Component of a Solution from SDK - SAP for Me -Keywords-PDI, SDK, CT, UI, Component, Delete, UI, component, can, not, be, cleanup, because, it, is, referred, by, file, Change, Transaction, UI Designer

Title: Error Message in VERTEX Scenario: Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again
Content: Symptom-While creating a sales order, the tax calculation is not done and the error message Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again is noticed.-VERTEX add-on is activated in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select the Sales Order with the error message and click on Edit-When the affected document is opened, the error message Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again can be seen.-This can also be observed in a Service Order or any transactional document with Sales and Use Tax for US.-A variation of this error message is also shown: No Results Returned by External Provider-Cause-As VERTEX is enabled, during tax rate determination the webservice call fails and tax rate is not determined because of an error with communication arrangements created for the service.-Resolution-Check the connection with the webservice following the steps below:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Communication Arrangements view.-Select the Communication Scenario created for VERTEX.-Click on Edit.-Select the Outbound Communication.-Click on Check Connection.-The communication would be correctly set up when no errors are shown for this checking.-Keywords-Sales Order, Tax calculation failed, VERTEX, Communication Arrangement, No Results Returned by External Provider

Title: How to Maintain New Tax Rate Schedules
Content: Symptom-You want a new tax rate schedule according to legal requirements. The required Tax rate schedule is currently not available in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Click the Change Immediately button.-Click the Define Tax Rate Schedules link.-Search for Country ABC (ABC is the country name).-The new tax rate is not available.-Resolution-The new Tax Rate Schedules for country ABC can be added as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Click on the Change Immediately button.-Click on the Define Tax Rate Schedules link.-Click on the Add Row button and enter country as ABC.-Enter the date from which the tax rate is valid and the enter the tax rate percentage.-Click Save.-See Also-Help Document: Tax on Goods and Services - Configuration Guide-Keywords-tax rate schedule, Steuersatztabellen, Steuer, tax on goods and services, tax rate percentage

Title: "No delivery to Email ID: XYZ, as recipient unknown" Error After Document Submission
Content: Symptom-While working with a document which is to be sent via e-mail, the document was submitted and the output status displayed an error, with the following message in the details:-"No delivery to Email ID: XYZ, as recipient unknown" (where XYZ represents the e-mail address to which the document is to be sent)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This scenario can happen for any document which contains an output document. In the below example, a Purchase Order will be used. -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Enter the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the purchase order and select it.-Select the Edit button.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-The error status can be seen for an output entry.-      Cause-In AWS, specifically within the context of Amazon SES or any other email service providers for that matter of fact, an email address might be placed on a suppression list for several reasons:-Bounce Rate: If emails sent to a particular address bounce repeatedly (due to a non-existent email address, mailbox full, etc.), the address may be added to a suppression list to prevent further attempts to send emails to it. This helps maintain sender reputation and reduces the likelihood of being flagged as a spammer.-Complaints: If recipients mark emails as spam or complain about receiving unsolicited emails, their email addresses can be added to a suppression list. This protects sender reputation and ensures compliance with anti-spam regulations.-Hard Bounces: Emails that consistently bounce due to permanent errors (for example, domain does not exist) are typically added to a suppression list automatically to prevent further attempts to send to those addresses.-Suppression lists are crucial for maintaining email deliverability and sender reputation. They help ensure that emails are only sent to recipients who are likely to engage with them and who have explicitly opted in to receive communications. This practice not only improves deliverability rates but also reduces the risk of being flagged as a spammer, which can have serious consequences for email senders.-Resolution-Open a case with SAP Support informing about the error message "No delivery to Email ID: XYZ, as recipient unknown" and the email addresses of the recipients who are not receiving the emails properly.-The receivers email addresses need to be removed from the suppression list by our infrastructure (operations) team.-See Also-SAP Community - Next-Generation Cloud Delivery transition - New Business ByDesign E-mail Infrastructure-Keywords-submit, email, Unknown email, Suppress List, No delivery, e-mail

Title: Daily Scheduled Runs Are Not Working for Employee Replication
Content: Symptom-You have observed that our daily scheduled runs are not working as expected. Even after leaving them for over 48 hours, there appears to be no visible progress or successful completion of the tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication Work Center.-Go to Employees View.-You can find no errors here or errors such as:-- Company of position must be company of employment;-- Company from leading org assignment must be the same with Company from employment" for employees.-Cause-One potential reason for this could be that in a old record the employee is being rehired, and there are changes occurring within organizational units as well.-Resolution-To address this issue, manually correct and replicate the data, or create the relevant record in such a way that the system can recognize the updated information during the next replication cycle.-Keywords-Daily Run, Employment, Replication, Company, Employee, Master Data Replication, Company of position must be company of employment, Company from leading org assignment must be the same with Company from employment" for employees.

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-After adding a newly created Embedded Component (EC) to a screen, the system dumps with a 500 SAP Internal Server Error when attempting to open that screen.-The following error message is displayed:-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report a case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new Embedded Component in SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Add the EC to a screen.-Navigate to the screen where the EC was added.-The system dumps with a 500 SAP Internal Server Error.-Cause-During the creation of the EC, an inconsistency occurred and the EC did not bind to the Business Object (BO) correctly in the backend.-This can be confirmed in the backend via transaction ST22. In the Application Information section of the dump, the BO name and namespace are empty:-Unable to get descriptor for BO and namespace (ESR notation)-The Active Calls/Events stack shows the error propagating through CX_OBERON_DEPLOYMENT_EXCEPTION into CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION via the UI exception handler chain.-At first glance, it seems there is no involvement with PDI, but when unbinding the newly added EC, the dump stops occurring.-During the creation of this EC, an inconsistency happened and the EC didn't bind to the BO correctly in the backend, hence there is no BO name in the Application Information dump.-Resolution-Open the backend and navigate to transaction ST22.-Locate the dump and check the Application Information section. Confirm the BO name and namespace fields are empty — this indicates the EC did not bind to the BO correctly.-Ask the Customer to unbind the problematic EC from the screen. This stops the dump from occurring.-Instruct the customer to re-create the EC.-After re-creating the EC, add it back to the screen and verify the screen opens without errors.-Keywords-Embedded Component, EC, dump, 500 Internal Server Error, CX_OBERON_DEPLOYMENT_EXCEPTION, BO binding, SDK, PDI

Title: Extension Fields in Customer Invoice Request are Blank When You Create Them via File Input
Content: Symptom-Extension fields values are not added to the invoice requests when you create the customer invoice requests via File Input run, even though you have added the extension field to the File Input Upload Excel and to the service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Access the File Input work center view.-Under Active Runs, select the respective run from the Service Interface CustomerInvoiceProcessingRequestInvoicingIn.-Navigate to the Execution Details tab.-In the generated customer invoice request, you can see the extension field values are blank-Cause-The File Input for customer invoices does not use the standard webservice Managecustomerinvoicerequestin. -Resolution-In order to add the extension field to the webservice used in the File Input for customer invoices, you need to extend the extension field to be used from:-- <BusinessObject> -> CustomerInvoiceRequest. -For example, you need to enable the extension scenario: Sales Order - General Information to Invoice Requests - General Information. If you enable this extension scenario, the extension fields will be automatically added to the correct webservice used in the File Input.-Keywords-File Input; Extension fields; not; populate; visible; customer; invoice; requests; Maintaincustomerinvoicerequestin; Managecustomerinvoicerequestin;

Title: Cancelled document still added in the Payment Run
Content: Symptom-You have a Credit Memo or Supplier Invoice with the status In Cancellation and then when you create a Payment Run this document is still being added to be paid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant document.-See that it is In Cancellation status.-Go to Payables work center.-Select Payment Runs view.-Create a New Run.-Click on View Payment Proposals.-See that the documents that are In Cancellation on the Invoices view are added to this Payment Proposal List.-Cause-This is a system behavior, since the document is not completely cancelled yet the Journal Entry for the cancellation is not created, so from Financial side the document is still open to be paid.-Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-In Cancellation, Payment Run, Payment Proposal

Title: Error External Transaction Code Selected Debit/Credit Value Not Permitted For Payment Method
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to create a new External Transaction Code in Business Configuration Activity "Automatically Generated Bank Statements".-However you get an Error upon Creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center - Overview view.-Search for Activity "Automatically Generated Bank Statements" and open it.-Press "Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements".-Select Import Format XXX (where XXX is the Import Format).-Press Add Row.-Enter External Transaction Code YYY (where YYY is the External Transaction Code).-Enter Description ABC (where ABC is the Description).-Select Payment Method DEF (where DEF is the Payment Method).-Press Save.-You get the following Error Messages: -- Error occurred with External Transaction Code YYY:-- Selected Debit/Credit value is not permitted for payment method DEF.-- Save failed.-Cause-You have not maintained a suitable Debit/Credit value in the respective column.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center - Overview view.-Search for Activity "Automatically Generated Bank Statements" and open it.-Press "Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements".-Select Import Format XXX (where XXX is the Import Format).-Press Add Row.-Enter External Transaction Code YYY (where YYY is the External Transaction Code).-Enter Description ABC (where ABC is the Description).-Now enter a value "Increase" or "Decrease" in the column "Debit/Credit".-Select Payment Method DEF (where DEF is the Payment Method).-Press Save.-Now there is no Error Message anymore.-Keywords-Automatically generated bank statements, external transaction code, debit/credit value is not permitted, payment method

Title: Opportunity Created by an Employee is Not Visible for a User
Content: Symptom- Opportunity created by an employee XYZ is not visible for the user PQR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business - Opportunities.-Search for the Opportunity ABC (ABC represents the Opportunity ID).-System shows: No Record Found.-Cause-For the user PQR, the employee XYZ who created the opportunity is not selected under access restriction. Therefore the user doesn't have the authorization to view the opportunties created by the employee XYZ.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center - Business Users view-Select the User PQR (PQR represents the User ID)-Click on Edit -> Access Rights-Naviagte to Access Restrictions tab-Search for the CRM_OPPORTUNITYTABLEVIEW under Work Center View ID-Under Detailed Restrictions, select the employee XYZ (XYZ represents the Employee ID)-Enable relevant Read and Write access-Click on Save. -Keywords-CRM_OPPORTUNITYTABLEVIEW; User; Employee; Access Rights; No records found; Opporrunity

Title: Planned Working Hours are not Displayed on Report
Content: Symptom-You are running the Employee Recorded Hours report, and notice that the Planned Working Hours field is displaying as 0 after a certain date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Enter the Design Reports view.-Search for the "Employee Recorded Times" report and open it.-Filter the report for the required employee.-Click on the Apply button.-In the results, you see the Planned Working Hours as 0 after a certain date.-Cause-The Period Closure Date for the employee is set as the same date from which the report starts showing 0.-Resolution-In order to fix the issue, perform a Day Closure Run for the employee and re-set the Period Closure Date.-To perform this process, follow the below steps:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Regular Tasks view.-Click on Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Here you can select the employee, and re-set the Period Closure Date.-Keywords-HCMTLMU01, HCMTLMU01_Q0007, HCMTLMU01_Q0002, Report, Planned Working Hours, 0, zero, Employee Recorded Times.

Title: How to decide the Data Center of the tenant
Content: Symptom-Due to the local policy or customer's private demand, the customer wants to specify the Data Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Some customers want to specify the Data Center by themselves.-Resolution-The customer can specify the Data Center by themselves when signing the contract if there is no local policy which limited the location of data storing. For example, a China customer cannot select the Data Center by themselves but a Japanese or a Vietnam customer can select the Data Center by themselves. If the customer already has a tenant in a certain Data Center and needs to change it, an additional contract is needed instead of requesting it in the incident. The detail information please discuss with the customer's CSP (Customer Success Partner) or the contract related team.-See Also-How do I find the Customer Success Partner (CSP) or Customer Engagement Executive (CEE) for a customer?-Keywords-Data Center, Contract, Specify, Change Data Center

Title: Sales Order Invoicing Schedule Percentages not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-When creating a sales order the invoicing schedule percentages are not working as expected when alternating between either two or three individual dates.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Select New -> Sales Order.-Add a product/service.-Maintain a list price (for this example 111.00 of a given currency).-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab, then the Invoice Schedule subtab.-Add the Item, then two dates.-For one date input a percentage of 33.33%, then the other 66.67%.-The overall percentage reads as 100%.-Now add another date, removing the existing percentages.-For two dates input the percentage of 33.33%, then the third as 33.34%-The overall percentage reads as 100.009%.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. Invoice schedule percentages in the backend round to 5 decimal points.-Resolution-There are two methods of amending this:-Solution 1:-Simply select the amount of the item which deviates from the others, amend the amount to the same as the other two and it will make all three percentages uniform. -Solution 2:-On the Invoice Schedule subtab, select Edit Invoicing Time Frame-Add Row -> Recurrence Type: Individual Dates-Add three dates then apply them to the line item in question-Once complete it will uniformly spread the invoice percentage across the dates.-Keywords-invoice schedule, percentage, dates, time frame, Recurrence Type, Individual Dates, incorrect overall percentage.

Title: Account data extension fields do not appear in invoice requests created via ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn or File Input
Content: Symptom-Account's header extension field is not carried over into an invoice request, which is generated either via file input or the webservice ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create an extension field in an account as follows:-Got to the Account Management work center.-Open the Accounts view.-Select an account.-Edit -> General.-Key User Settings -> Enter Adaptation Mode.-Account -> Extension Fields.-Create a new extension field.-With the new extension field selected, Show Further Usage.-Go to Extension Scenario tab and enable the following extension scenarios:-Account - General Information to Invoice Request - General Information-Business Partner - General Information to Customer Invoice Request - General Information-Publish your changes.-Enter a value in the extension field and Save.-Once these have been enabled, create an invoice request via the webservice or file input. Once the External Customer Invoice Request has been created check the following:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Requests view.-Open the externally created customer invoice request.-Click on the Edit button and then the View All button.-In the General tab you can see that the extension field has no value.-Cause-The extension scenario “Account - General Information to Invoice Request - General Information” and “Business Partner - General Information to Customer Invoice Request - General Information” are currently not supported for External Customer Invoice Request created via the webservice ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn or the file input.-Resolution-This is the system behaviour prior to Release 2605.-With Release 2605 the extension scenario “Account - General Information to Invoice Request - General Information” and “Business Partner - General Information to Customer Invoice Request - General Information” is also supported for External Customer Invoice Request created via the webservice ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-Keywords-Extension Field, ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn, webservice, Excel, file upload, file input, external customer invoice request, not supported.

Title: Payment Method Not Updated While Using ManageEmployeeIn WebService
Content: Symptom-You are using the ManageEmployeeIn service interface to update Payment Method of employees. Although the request is successful, no changes are done to the employee in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There are might be two causes for this scenario:-The bank details and payment information was not updated because two identification nodes were passed and in the second identification node, the employee identification was initial or empty.-There is no Identity XML elements in your payload which actually allows the webservice to identify the employee that is to be updated-Resolution-For cause 1:-The second Identification node corresponds to employee for whom data has to updated. It is always passed with action code '06' for employee ID.-Please find below an example of correct payload:-<glob:EmployeeDataBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-<EmployeeData actionCode="04" identificationListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>***</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-<ChangeStateID>*********</ChangeStateID>-<UUID>*****************</UUID>-<InternalID>***********</InternalID>-<Identification actionCode="06">-<ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>Identity</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-<PartyIdentifierTypeCode>HCM001</PartyIdentifierTypeCode>-<BusinessPartnerID>000000000000****</BusinessPartnerID>-<ValidityPeriod>-<StartDate>YYYY-MM-DD</StartDate>-<EndDate>YYYY-MM-DD</EndDate>-</ValidityPeriod>-<EmployeeID>****</EmployeeID>-</Identification>-<PaymentInformation>-<ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>***</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-<PaymentFormCode>05</PaymentFormCode>-<BankDetails actionCode="04">-<ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>***</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-<ID>**</ID>-<BankInternalID>***</BankInternalID>-<BankAccountID>*************</BankAccountID>-<BankAccountTypeCode>**</BankAccountTypeCode>-<BankAccountHolderName>********</BankAccountHolderName>-<Name>******</Name>-<MainBankIndicator>true</MainBankIndicator>-</BankDetails>-</PaymentInformation>-</EmployeeData>-</glob:EmployeeDataBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-For Cause 2:-You need to change the Action Code to allow an update of the Bank Details and include the Identification tags to achieve the requirement-Below is a sample for identity XML tag in the request payload:-Keywords-ManageEmployeeIn, Payment Method, bank details, identification nodes, Web Service.

Title: The Error "No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between and" is Displayed When Releasing a Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-When releasing the Service Confirmation with Order Completion, the error "No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between and" is being displayed in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders Work Center.-Go to the Service Order Processing View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Service Order ABC (where ABC represents the Service Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Click Confirm Service Execution button.-In the new Service Confirmation EFG screen, click Release with Order Completion button (where EFG stands for service confirmation ID).-The Error "No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between and" is displayed.-Cause-Scenario 1:-The functionality that automatically creates time entries for Service Confirmations is currently "In Scope" in the system. Therefore, the question "Do you want automatic time recording for service orders?" under the Questions Step for the Service and Repair Business Topic has been scoped.-However, at the same time the Time and Labor Management is not scoped in the system, so the employees do not have a time file and the error "No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between and" is displayed when releasing the  Service Confirmation.-Scenario 2:-The employee maintained in the Service Confirmation EFG is missing in the Employees View of Personnel Administration Work Center, therefore the error "No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between and" will also be displayed when releasing the Service Confirmation.-Scenario 3:-The functionality that automatically creates time entries for Service Confirmations is currently "In Scope" in the system. Therefore, the question "Do you want automatic time recording for service orders?" under the Questions Step for the Service and Repair Business Topic has been scoped. However,  no time entry exists for the Service Performer. -In this scenario, in order to release the Service Confirmation, a Time Entry will be required to be recorded for the Service Performed (Employee or Service Agent) maintained in the Service Confirmation document.-The Service Performer for the Service Confirmation will be carried our from the preceding documents, however it can be altered in the Service Confirmation before the Time Entry is recorded in the system.-When the Scoping Question "Do you want automatic time recording for service orders?" is "Not Scoped" in the system, then the Service Performer (Service Agent) will not be mandatory to be maintained. This occurs because the system does not require a Time Record for either the Employee or the Service Agent when the Scoping Question "Do you want automatic time recording for service orders?" is "Not Scoped".- Resolution-Scenario 1:-If the Time and Labor Management is not required in the system, this functionality should be descoped in the system.-Scenario 2:-Make the employee available in the Employees View of Personnel Administration Work Center. The employees maintained in the Service Confirmation should be available for time recording in this scenario.-Scenario 3:-Ensure a time entry is recorded for the Employee or Service Agent.-See Also-Enterprise Resource Planning Blogs by SAP-KBA 2058364 - Employee Missing in the Employees View of Personnel Administration-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Personnel Administration, Employees, Time and Labor Management

Title: Deferred Costs in the G/L Account Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-Time entries were mistakenly entered into an incorrectly created project.-These time entries were later corrected and reassigned to the appropriate project.-The reversal of the timesheet changes did not process correctly through the system.-This resulted in deferred costs and service expenses being stuck.-There are no unposted source documents or Customer Project Expense Lists (CPEL) to be cleared for the affected company.-The "Not Invoiced Time and Expenses" screen does not show any time or expenses waiting to be assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports view-Select the G/L accounts - Line items report-Enter the details like Company, Set of Books, Posting Date and G/L Account in the Data Selection.-Change the report view to "Deferred Costs - Project View".-Click on Apply.-You can see a Deferred Cost amount in the Balance Company Currency field for the Project AAA(AAA refers to the Project ID).-Navigate to the Sales Document – Line Item Report from the navigation target to see the Associated Source Document IDs that is causing the deferred costs.-Cause-When checking the document flow of Project AAA, you can observe that there is one PIR (Project Invoice Request Document) with an "In Preparation" status. It can be noticed that even though there is no quantity to be invoiced for some expenses, quantities were manually entered, which were then considered as Deferred quantities.-Additionally, this Project Invoice Request document is inconsistent and contains some validation errors, such as:-"Customer Invoicing not possible; posting to financial accounting is blocked on xxx" (xxx refers to the accounting period/year).-"Status of project task AAA is not 'Started', 'Released', or 'Completed'.-Furthermore, employees associated with the project and PIR have canceled time confirmations.-You can check this by following these steps:-In the Project Management work center, go to the Time and Expenses view.-Search for the Project AAA.-You will observe that the Time Confirmation is canceled on dd.mm.yyyy for the employees.-The Project Invoice Request with deferred quantity due to the cancellation of the time confirmation for the respective source document is causing an issue on the accounting side. These deferred expenses were included/assigned in the Project Invoice Request document as Deferred quantities.-This issue occurs because the Project Invoice Request was created first, and later, the employees associated with that Project and PIR canceled their time confirmations. At this point, no messages were triggered from Customer Project Invoice Preparation to Cost Object Expense Account Notification because these time confirmation expenses were already assigned in the existing PIR document. Hence, these expenses are shown as deferred costs in the G/L Account Line Items report and the Project Invoice Request.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, kindly delete the inconsistent PIR document.-The deletion of the PIR will trigger a message to Finance, and the canceled time confirmation source ID will be reversed/canceled.-After reversing the source document of CPEL on the Finance side, no deferred costs will be shown in the report.- Keywords-Deferred Costs, G/L Account Line Items report, Project, Project Invoice Request, Time Confirmation, Employees, CPEL

Title: Driver Requirement for Cloud Print Manager
Content: Symptom-You are using Cloud Print Manager, and would like to know what driver is recommended for your printer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Business ByDesign and the Cloud Print Manager tool do not affect the required driver for a printer device.-SAP recommends to always use the latest driver version from the printer manufacturer. It is suggested to install the manufacturer driver over the standard Windows driver.-Keywords-Cloud Print Manager, Driver, Printer, Printer Driver, CPM

Title: Sales Order Volume Report not Showing Partially Cancelled Items
Content: Symptom-The cancellation status of a item is showing Canceled in the Sales Order Volume report even though the line item is partially canceled in the Sales Order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Select the Reports View.-Open Sales Order Volume report.-Filter for the Cancellation Status of the items in the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-In the Sales Order Volume report the Cancellation status of the item XX is showing as Canceled instead of Partially Canceled (where XX represents the Line Item Number).-Cause-In the report, the filter Cancellation status will consider the item status and once the Cancellation status was entered, the report will show the item as Canceled.-For the Sales Order Volume report, the system will consider the Item XX as Canceled because a Reason for Rejection was set for the Item in the Sales Order ABC. However for the Sales Order ABC document, the Item XX will be consider as Partially Canceled.-Resolution-You will be able to see the part of the order which was delivered in the Delivered Quantity field.-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-cancellation status, item, partially canceled, sales order, sales order volume report

Title: "Found nothing to import" Error When Using Third-Party Logistics Integration Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are using Third-Party Logistics Integration service interfact through a SOAP client, however the below error occurs.-"Found nothing to import in XYZ" (where XYZ represents the service path)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Communication Arrangement view.-Find the arrangement for Third-Party Logistics Integration.-Click Third-Party Logistics Integration communication scenario link.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Technical Data tab.-Click on the Edit Advanced Settings button.-Navigate to the Outbound subtab.-Select the Inbound Delivery Notification Replication.-Click on Download WSDL.-After downloading the WSDL, try to open it in a SOAP client such as SOAPUI.-Here the error message is raised when trying to open the WSDL.-Cause-The endpoint URL in the WSDL is not present for outbound scenarios. SOAP clients are meant to test Business ByDesign inbound web services.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-SOAP, integration, webservice, Found nothing to import in, WSDL,Third party

Title: Unexpected Delay Between Manual Business Partner Deletion
Content: Symptom-You are deleting business partners in the Information Lifecycle Management work center, and notice a delay before being able to perform the next deletion.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Information Lifecycle Management work center.-Enter the Business Partner view.-Select a business partner with Disclosure Status shown as Disclosed.-Click View and Delete Disclosed Data.-Click on Delete Disclosed Data.-Confirm the Deletion of the Business Partner.-After the deletion, you need to wait before the next business partner can be deleted.-Cause-Each business partner deletion starts a deletion run in the backend. Only after the completion of  this run the next deletion can be started-Resolution-The system works as expected.-You may refer to the application log to verify related errors / in case a deletion run is not completed.-Keywords-ILM, obsolete, deletion blocked, disclose

Title: Unposted Supplier Invoice Due to Error Message: "Cannot Find Goods or Service Receipt XYZ-1 For Purchase Order AAA, Item AAA-2 in Accounting". And Task Message: "Referenced Item CBBB-10 of Contract CBBB Not Found".
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*﻿INTERNAL USE ONLY*-You have an Unposted Supplier Invoice with the error message:-'Cannot find goods or service receipt XYZ-1 for Purchase Order AAA, item AAA-2 in accounting'.--XYZ-1 stands for the Goods or Service Receipt ID, item 1.--AAA stands for the Purchase Order.--AAA-2 stands for the item 2 of the Purchase Order AAA.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Document subview.-Select the Unposted Source Document ID: ABC (ABC stands for the Supplier Invoice ID).-The error message 'Cannot find goods or service receipt XYZ-1 for Purchase Order AAA, item AAA-2 in accounting' appears.-Select the button Actions > View Business Transaction. Here the task message 'Referenced item CBBB-10 of Contract CBBB not found' is displayed.--CBBB represents a Customer Contract ID.--CBBB represents a Customer Contract Item ID.-Cause-The issue might be due to a failing XI message of the Customer Contract BO.-Should all XI messages be delivered successfully, Development need to check the issue further.-Resolution-To check which Development Component should check on the issue:-Log into SESFTS.-Load BO: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT.-Load by query ROOT -> QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Fill the contract ID (without the item) into the field: ID/content.-Once loaded, navigate to node ITEM by clicking on Navigate button on the top and then select 'ITEM'. Count the items here.-Next, load BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC.-Load by query ROOT -> QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Fill the contract ID (without the item) into the field: OperationalDocumentReference/FormattedID.-Once loaded, navigate to node ITEM. Count the items here.-Action:-If the item count on both BOs is the same, send the incident to the component AP-ACC-PUR for further analysis.-However, if the item count is different, do the following:-In the backend, open the transaction SE38.-Go to the report: FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI.-Check for any failing XI messages of type 1092 with the contract ID.-If all the XI messages have been delivered (no failing XI messages and an accounting notification exists), please send the incident to component AP-CCP and ask them to reconcile the message from CustomerContractProcessing to accounting for this contract - this should create the missing item(s).-If there is a failing message, Support Engineer can try to analyze from their side why it has failed and attempt to restart it. Should the issue persists forward to AP-CCP. -  Keywords-Unposted Source Document, Supplier Invoice, Goods or Service Receipt, Contract, Purchase Order, Item, Accounting.

Title: [INTERNAL] Handling results of cloud customers penetration testing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Questions from customer about security/vulnerability issues through conducting tests commonly known as penetration tests.-Who to reach out to in case there is a security/vulnerability issue reported by a customer after conducting a penetration test.-Note:  SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Marketing (RMK) and SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Management (RCM) has another KBA 2253232 where specific handling instructions are included.-Environment-SAP SuccessFactors-SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)-SAP Cloud for Customer (C4C)-SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)-SAP Enable Now-SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud (HEC)-SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP)-SAP Jam-SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (S4H)-SAP Customer Data Cloud/ Gigya-SAP Ariba-SAP Business ByDesign (ByD)-SAP Commerce Cloud-SAP Sales Cloud (Callidus)-Resolution-DO NOT close the case using a KBA such as 2249479 - Vulnerability Management - Vulnerability / Penetration Test, or 3080379 - Customer Penetration Request Process-If the request has come from any CSM/CEE on behalf of a customer, please request the CSM/CEE to ask the customers to open up a new support ticket and state the security/vulnerability issues clearly-Confirm with customer the issue(s) they want SAP to look at. Customers are highly recommended to submit one security issue per support ticket for proper tracking and communication.-We expect the customer will follow the process and request approval to complete a penetration test on their cloud product outlined in KBA 3080379 - Customer Penetration Request Process.-Note: it is becoming popular for customers to conduct high-level, unspecific security scans. Vendors like Qualys and Fortify-on-Demand are popular choices among our customers. These reports are long and unspecific. It will include a lot of security warnings and risk descriptions. Nonetheless, these scanning tools are producing generic results and are prone to false-positives.-Please understand why the customer is conducting a high-level security scan. Please share with customer that information on cloud security, privacy and compliance can be found on SAP Trust Center. Furthermore, SAP also routinely completes internal security evaluation on our cloud products. Customers can find more information on the audit reports, along with certifications, on Compliance Document Finder | SAP Trust Center-For customer reports on security vulnerabilities discovered via a penetration test, please follow the recommendations, based on common scenarios:-Scenario 1: Customer reports security vulnerability(ies):-1. Penetration test reports will include recommended action on security vulnerabilities.-What are the recommended actions?   -Did the customer take action on the recommendations?-Search the KBA, since some security topics are documented already.-If the recommended actions relate to configuration changes, please-Provide information to the customer to enable on their own-Or, direct to the responsible team(s) to apply the recommendations to set-up/enable on the customer’s cloud infrastructure or application(s).-2.  If the customer is reporting security vulnerabilities related to our products or you are unclear how to handle the customer query, please follow the steps below to create a Product Security Vulnerability (PSV) ticket in ServiceNow:-Open the customer case in ServiceNow-Click on the three dots, and select Create Product Security Vulnerability-Enter the information as explained below and submit your request:-External ID: Enter an ID of the issue if given by the customer; this is often the case if the customer refers to a finding from a larger assessment.-Component: Do not change! It is prefilled with the component set in the customer ticket.-Security Note Required: Make a choice only if you are sure whether a Security Note will be required or not.-Priority: You cannot change the priority directly, but only through the CVSS Rating (see below). Default is High if no CVSS Rating is available.-Vulnerability type: Choose the vulnerability type, that fits best.-Source: IMPORTANT: Change it to "Customer" as the default value is wrong and PSRT would not pick it up.-Source code owned by: Make a choice only if you are sure whether the root cause is in source code owned by SAP or not.-Due date: Enter a date only if the customer has given a deadline, e.g for an upcoming Go Live. This date, however, is only an information to the processor of the PSV; it does not have impact on the SLAs.-Requested by: Do not change! It is prefilled with the ID of the customer ticket.-Note: PSI ticket in BCP is obsolete since the Go Live of the new "Product Security Vulnerability" record type in ServiceNow on December 2, 2023.-Note: you can find more information on PSV in How to create a Product Security Vulnerability (PSV) ticket in ServiceNow? - Security Response - Wiki@SAP (int.sap)-Scenario 2: Customer may escalate and demand to speak to someone of authority at SAP to respond to the penetration test findings:-Customers, often through CSM/CEE or account executives, may escalate and demand to speak directly with someone of authority at SAP in regard to the penetration test findings.-If CSM/CEE is already involved, you may refer the CSM/CEE to our BISO network-CSM/CEE can contact the BISO office directly within the LoB of concern, for escalations and clarifications.-Keywords-Security, Vulnerabilities, Penetration Test, Customer Penetration Test, Customer Vulnerability Assessment, Security Assessment, pentest

Title: "Additional Message Generated; See Help for More Information" Error While Updating Suppliers Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add contacts to Suppliers using Mass Data Maintenance, However the update is failing with the error messages below:-"Additional message generated; see help for more information"-"Update not possible; specified data for SUPPLIER-CONTACT_PERSON with key CATEGORY_CODE-CONTENT = `XXXXXX`  AND FIRST_BUSINESS_PARTNER_UUID-CONTENT = `YYYYYYY` AND SECOND_BUSI" (where XXXXXX represents the CATEGORY_CODE-CONTENT and YYYYYYY represents the FIRST_BUSINESS_PARTNER_UUID-CONTENT)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Enter the Mass Data Maintenance view.-Click on the Import Suppliers option.-Upload the CSV template.-In the Import Data to Tab field, select the Contacts tab.-Click on Execute Data import.-After the validation, you can see suppliers with status Failed.-Cause-In Mass Data Maintenance for Suppliers it is not possible to add new contacts to an existing supplier. The Mass Data Maintenance tool is meant to be used solely to edit attributes for contact persons that are already assigned to this supplier.-Resolution-In order to assign new contacts to suppliers, you can use the migration of Contact Persons with the mode "Enhance Already Existing Records". In the tab "Contact Details" you can maintain suppliers for which the contact is a contact person.-Keywords-update suppliers, mass data maintenance, status failed, add contacts-additional message generated,update supplier,mass data maintenance,supplier-contact_person

Title: The Error "Vertex Error: SOAP:1,044 SRT: Consumer is temporarily isolated.No processing is allowed" is displayed for a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When opening a Sales Order in the system the error message "Vertex Error: SOAP:1,044 SRT: Consumer is temporarily isolated.No processing is allowed" is displayed in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center-Go to the Sales Orders View. -Filter for All Orders.-Select the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-The error message "Vertex Error: SOAP:1,044 SRT: Consumer is temporarily isolated.No processing is allowed" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-When communication arrangements are copied from Productive systems they are set to "Isolation", which is to make sure that Test system of ByD do not communicate to a productive third party system (for example if outbound deliveries are set up in third party then both Test and Productive now will have same communication arrangements and start communicating to a productive third party system).-When communication arrangements are copied API keys are also cleared.-Resolution- You should be able to clear this scenario from your side by following these steps:-Go to the Application and User Management workcenter. -Open the Communication Arrangements view.-Find Communication Arrangement "Request tax rates from Vertex" and Highlight it.-Click the "Edit API Keys".-Click again "Edit API Keys" in the following screen to input the expected value.-Select Save button.-Find Communication Arrangement "Request tax rates from Vertex" and Highlight it.-Click the "De-Isolate" button (A Reactivate might be necessary).-Keywords-service temporarily unavailable; vertex error, no processing is allowed, communication arrangement, sales order, isolation, consumer is temporarily isolated

Title: Custom Tax Code not Selected in Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You have created a Tax Code for a Tax Event in the Business Configuration Fine Tune settings but this Tax Code is not determined by the Automatic Tax Determination in Sales Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Tax on Goods and Services Activity.-Select Open button. -Open Define Tax Codes hyperlink.-Create a new Tax Code ABC for Tax Event XYZ (where ABC represents the Tax Code ID and XYZ represents the Tax Event ID).-When you create a new sales order and a product is selected for the respective tax event, the standard tax code is selected and not Tax Code ABC.-Cause-You have not set the standard Tax Code to be invalid. So it is still considered for the Automatic Tax Determination. If there are multiple Tax Codes for a single Tax Event, the system uses the following logic to determine the Tax Code:-The Decision tree will determine the relevant Tax Event for the transaction involved.-For each Tax Event, you can maintain multiple Tax Codes in the system in the Tax on Goods and Services Activity.-If only one Tax Code is mapped to a Tax Event it is automatically derived in the Sales Order.-If multiple Tax Codes are mapped to a Tax Event, system picks the appropropriate one by checking the Tax Rate Type Code and Deductibility Code maintained. A more specific tax code takes preference, e.g. with maintained Tax Rate Type or Deductibility Code.-If there are multiple Tax Codes maintained with the same set up for one single Tax Event with the same details, as Tax Rate Type and Deductibility Code, the earliest maintained Tax Code is selected.-In the described issue, Tax Code ABC has the same setup as the standard Tax Code from SAP. Thus, the system selects the standard Tax Code, as it was maintained earlier than the custom Tax Code.--Note: Using Tax Deductibility is only supported for Purchasing scenarios. Setting up Sales Tax Codes with Tax Deducibility will result in them not being determined.-Resolution-Change the validity setting for the standard Tax Code, so that only one Tax Code is valid with the same settings for one Tax Event.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Tax on Goods and Services Activity.-Select Open button. -Open Define Tax Codes hyperlink.-Find the Standard Tax Code for Tax Event XYZ that you try to replace and change the Valid To Date to the current date.-Now, there will be only one valid Tax Code for this particular Tax Event for the Automatic Tax Determination in Sales Orders.-Keywords-Tax, Code, Sales Order, Determination, 501, 511, 301, Rate VAT, Steuern, Steuercode, Kundenauftrag, Bestimmung, Umsatzsteuer-ID

Title: Scoping Question "You can plan financial statements, cost centers and profit centers" Missing
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find the Scoping Question: 'You can plan financial statements, cost centers and profit centers'-Environment-SAP Busines ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Project view.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Under Questions tab follow the path: Financial and Management Accounting -> Management Accounting -> Financial Planning. You are not able to see the scoping question 'You can plan financial statements, cost centers and profit centers'.-Cause-The scoping question 'You can plan financial statements, cost centers and profit centers' is no longer valid. After the migration of ByDesign to use the HANA database, we have a new planning solution.-For any new tenants, you will not see the original scoping question but will only see the question 'You allow third-party software to create financial planning data'. Financial plans will be imported into ByDesign from Excel.-For existing/old tenants, the two scoping questions will still be displayed and are mutually exclusive.-Resolution-System works as designed.-See Also-KBA 2284255  - You Want to Plan Financial Statements, Cost Centers and Profit Centers-Keywords-Financial Planning, Scoping Question, You can plan financial statements, cost centers and profit centers, Business Configuration.

Title: Employee is Able to Edit Time Recordings After Releasing it
Content: Symptom-After executing a time recording in the employee Time Sheet, the employees are still able to edit the information even after release.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access Home work center.-Navigate to Self-Services -> Self-Services Overview.-Under the Time section, click on Edit Time Sheet.-Create a time recording information in the employee Time Sheet.-Click on Release and select one of the release options.-After the release, the employee is still able to edit the time recorded.-Cause-This behavior occurs because the time recordings can be modified in all stages of the release and approval process.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you need this functionality urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the SAP Cloud Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by the Cloud Service Center.-You can contact the Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right-hand side of Cloud Service Center, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea in Customer Influence.-Keywords-Time Recording, Employee Time Sheet, Modify, Change, Can Edit, is being able to, Edit.

Title: A2X Sales Order with External Payment Cannot be Changed
Content: Symptom-Item details such as quantity, price etc. cannot be changed for an A2X Sales Order (created via the web service) which has the payment method external payment. It is not possible to remove an item and when adding an item the following warning message is displayed: Manual addition of items not allowed for external payment-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open the Sales Order XYZ (where XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the General tab.-You can see that the Payment Method is External Payment.-Go to the Items tab.-You can see that the quantity and list price is read only and cannot be changed.-Further the Remove button is also not enabled.-When you add an item the following warning message is displayed: Manual addition of items not allowed for external payment.-Cause-A2X sales orders with external payments cannot be edited, because in this case the items have already been paid externally. In this case it is not allowed to change any pricing relevant details in the sales order such as quantity, list price, discount etc since the sales order and sales order item amount needs to match the external payment.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-You have to ensure that the sales order is created with the correct data via the web service.-If the sales order XYZ was created with incorrect data it can only be cancelled via the reason for rejection.-See Also-KBA ﻿2411693 - For External Payment Sales Order, There is no Possibility to Change the Price Components-Keywords-A2X, external payment, grayed out, remove, sales order, web service, cannot change

Title: New Leave Request does not Deduct the Quota of Time Account
Content: Symptom-You applied for Leave through New Leave request (half day or full day). You also observed that the Leave is approved but there is no deduction in the respective Time Account assigned to the Employee-Or-Vacation Times are not posted against the Time Account Balance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Step 1: Apply Leave-Go to Home work center-Select Self Service Overview view-Select New Leave Request under Time-Select the date and Finish the process.-Step 2: Check in Time File -> Time Account Balances-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search and Edit the Employee-Go to Time Account Balances tab-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you have not maintained the Work Schedule / Time Model in the Time File of the Employee for the leaves to get deducted correctly and for the quantity to be evaluated.-Resolution-Maintain the Work Schedule / Time Model for the respective Employee, so that the leaves get deducted correctly and for the quantity to be evaluated.-Assign a work schedule to an employee by the following steps:-1. Go to Time Administration work center-2. Select Employees view.-3. Search for the employee and select the employee.-4. Click Edit button.-5. Select Time Profile tab.-6. Select the sub tab Work Schedule in the below details pane.-7. There the user can assign either predefined or an individual work schedule.-=>For individual one, select Handle Holidays as Average Values from drop down menu and click Add Row button in Individual Work Schedule to assign work schedule.-=>For predefined one, select a Time Model. If there is no predefined time model available follow the below steps:-==>Go to View Time Models.-==>Create at least one periodical model that can be used.-8. Click Save button to save the work schedule in the time file of the employee then vacation account balance can be changed with the posting.--Note:-Also, kindly check the Collision Rules available for Employee Time Types and uncheck Automatically Remove option for planned absence---Keywords-Leave Request, Not Deducting, does not, Deduct, Quota of Time Account, Deduction, Time Account, Vacation, not posted, Time Account Balance

Title: Supplier Cannot be Chosen as Invoicing Party in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-For Supplier A (A represents the Supplier ID), you have maintained several other Suppliers as Has Invoicing Party in the Supplier Master Data, under the Contacts tab, Relationships subtab.-When you create a new Supplier invoice for Supplier A, you can choose the Invoicing party you want the invoice to be allocated to.-However, Supplier A is not available in the list of available Invoicing parties.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Common task - New invoice.-Enter Supplier A.-Open the Value Selection tool for the field Invoicing Party.-The other suppliers maintained appear but not Supplier A.-Cause-Supplier A doesn't appear in the Value Selection tool, this is a system limitation.-Resolution-You can manually enter the Supplier ID in the field Invoicing Party and press Enter.-Supplier A's name will appear and will be taken into account as the Invoicing party.-Keywords-Supplier, Business Partner, Cannot be, Chose, Selected, found, Invoicing Party, Supplier Invoice.

Title: Newly Created Premium Pay Types do not Appear in Time Sheet
Content: Symptom-You create new premium pay types in order to use them in the time sheet of an employee. However, they do not appear on the time sheet as an option when booking employee times. Only the default premium pay types provided by SAP are available.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Enter the activity Premium Pay - XYZ (where XYZ represents the country).-Click on Maintain Premium Pay Type.-Maintain settings for a new Premium Pay.-Click on Save and Close.-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Time Sheet view.-Select an employee.-Click Edit Time Sheet-The newly created premium pay type is not available as an option under Premium Pay column-Cause-In order to get newly added premium pay types via fine tuning during time recording, you need to maintain the corresponding time type mapping in compensation.-Resolution-In order to maintain a mapping of the premium pay in compensation, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Compensation work center.-Enter the Compensation Components view.-Select a relevant compensation component.-Click on Actions.-Click on Maintain Time Type Mapping.-Click on Add Row.-Create mapping with a result Compensation Component ID.-Once you complete the mapping, the new premium pay types will be available as an option in the time  sheet.-Keywords-premium pay, time type, time account, time recording, time profile, time file

Title: For External Payment Sales Order, There is no Possibility to Change the Price Components
Content: Symptom-You are creating sales orders via web service and using External Payment as Payment Method.-When you try to update the Discount or another Price Component via web service, you find the system does not add the discount into the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You first create the sales order via the web service with External Payment information and system successfully creates the order.-Then, you execute the second web service to update the order discount, however the discount cannot be updated in the order.-Note: Updating the Price Component works if External Payment is not used in the first creation web service.-Cause-For external payment sales order there is no possibility to change the price components either through another webservice call or manually on the sales order.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-See Also-KBA 2239770 - A2X Sales Order with External Payment Cannot be Changed-Keywords-webservice, web shop, e-shop, price component, price list, list price, manual, open, status, update, pricing

Title: What to do if your Certification Authority for your SSO is not listed in SAP Security Guide page
Content: Symptom-You will not find your Certification Authority in SAP Security guide (Page 32-34). Assuming that SSO functionality will break if Certification authority is not present in security guide.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Cause-The trust list provided in the security guide is only about the list of-default CAs added into the list. Customers can have their own CAs added-to the trust list from Administration -> Edit Certificate Trust list.-This is to facilitate the customers run their business with requirements-to use certificates from different CAs-Resolution-Add your Certificates to Administration -> Edit Certificate Trust list.-Keywords-Certification Authority, SSO, Single Sign-On, Not Appearing, Not Available, not listed, SAP Security Guide, SAP Documentation.

Title: Cancellation of Line item in Sales Order is not Possible due to the Error "Different Fulfillment type assigned to items in delivery group Y"
Content: Symptom-When trying to set a Reason for Rejection for a Line Item in the Sales Order document, the error "Different Fulfillment type assigned to items in delivery group Y" is displayed in the UI. (where Y represents Delivery Group Number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents Sales Order ID).-Click on Edit and Select View All.-Navigate to Items Tab.-Select the Line Item XX and Enter the Reason for Rejection in the Item Details (where XX represents the Line Item Number).- The error "Different Fulfillment type assigned to items in delivery group Y" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-In the Sales Order header level, the complete delivery for the line items checked. This means that all the line items are supposed to be delivered on the same date and hence they will have a same requested date.-Now, if at the item level the delivery rule was set to Single Delivery - full quantity, this results to a not confirmed ATP, because of which a delivery group issue occurs.-Resolution-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Click on Edit and Select View All.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the Line Item XX for which you want to enter the Reason for Rejection in the Item Details.-Under the Item Details section, change the Delivery Rule to Multiple Deliveries.-This change will lead to the status change of ATP to Confirmed Sufficiently which allows you to set the Reason for Rejection.-Keywords-Different Fulfillment type assigned to items in delivery group, Sales Order, Error, Complete Delivery, Different Fulfillment, Delivery Group, ATP

Title: How to Access the Mass Maintenance from the Account Details and Account Responsibility Data reports by selecting Mass Change Data of All Accounts
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to access the mass maintenance from the Account Details and Account Responsibility Data reports by selecting Mass Change Data of All Accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Go to Account Management work center.-Navigate to Reports view and List subview.-Select the report Account Details from the list.-Report: Account Details will open in a new tab.-Once the report gets executed, click on a particular Account ID or Description under field Account.-The Navigation target will open where you can see the link Mass Change Data of All Accounts.-Select this Navigation link to launch the Mass Change Account Data.-The similar steps can be followed for Account Responsibility Data report as well.-Keywords-mass maintenance, Account Details, Account Responsibility Data, report, Mass Change Data, Accounts.

Title: How to Update/Enhance Details of Existing Supplier Master Data
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to update or Enhance some of the details of existing Supplier Master Data and would like to know possible ways to do that.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Option 1 (Manual method to update/enhance)-Manually updating or enhancing the Supplier Master Data one by one in the Suppliers view.-Option 2 (Excel Upload to update/enhance)-If the Supplier is uploaded using MS Excel, then it is possible to update and enhance only those Supplier using the Excel and the steps are as follows,-Go to Business Partner Data or Supplier Base work center.-Select Suppliers view.-Select New button and choose Supplier form MS Excel.-Update the Supplier ID and details which needs to updated.-Save the Excel to Byd system.-Option 3 (Using Migration Template - Only Enhance)-it is also possible to Enhance the existing Supplier Master Data using Migration Template and the steps are as follows,-Step 1:-Search in the Help Center section using the title Prepare for Data Migration in a Change Project and open the link.-Expand Tasks section.-Expand Fill migration templates section.-Select Suppliers — Enhance Records in a Change Project link under section 3. Enhance already existing records:.-Here you can find the details which can be enhanced using Migration Template.-Step 2:-Download the Migration template for Suppliers from the Migration Suppliers activity.-After upload, highlight the file and select Properties button.-Select Advanced link and select Migration Mode as Enhance already existing records-Keywords-Mass, Update, Change, Edit, Enhance, Supplier, Master Data, Migration Tool.

Title: Incorrect Price List is picked by the system when determining the List Price in the Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-When you enter a product in the sales order or any other sales document, the price determined by the system is not the expected one. You have maintained the list price in the Customer Specific Price List and Company Specific Price List for that particular product but the list price is selected from Company Specific Price List.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order under Common Tasks.-Enter the Account and Distribution Channel.-Select the Items tab.-Select Add Row to add new item XX (where XX represents the ID of the Product).-The List price determined by the system for the Product XX is not the expected one.-For the Product XX, you have maintained the list price as 10 EUR in Customer Specific Pricelist and 15 EUR in the Company Specific Pricelist. The system determined 10 EUR as List Price in the Sales Order but you are expecting that the system should determine 15 EUR.-Cause-The Company Specific Price List has priority over the Customer Specific Price List in the system and hence the price determined by the system is the price maintained in the Company Specific Price List. The system will check the Access Sequence in the fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy to determine which Price List has the highest priority. You can check the Access Sequence as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Go to the Fine-Tune phase.-Select the activity Configure Price Strategy.-Select the Access Sequence hyperlink.-Select the access sequence Price List on Header Level.-Under Pricing Tables, you can see the list of Price Lists.-Resolution-The sequence of entries in the Access Sequence is used by the price engine to determine the price.
