However, report Access Rights Change Log will only show the change logs related to Work Center and View Assignment and Access Restrictions. The change logs of Business Role Assignment will be shown in report Role Assignment Changes.-Keywords-Report, Missing Entries, Access Right, Business Role, Change Log

Title: Tax Exemption is not Picked up by the system while creating a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Tax exemption maintained in the Supplier Master data is not automatically applied during Supplier Invoice creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search Supplier Invoice ID ABC (ABC represents Supplier Invoice ID).-Go to Taxes subtab under the Items tab.-The tax exemption details are not being automatically populated in the invoice.- Cause-Supplier master data level tax deductions cannot be achieved as per the current system design.-Tax deductions must be maintained in Product level master data, in order to pick the deductions in the Supplier Invoice creation. -Resolution-For purchases involving a foreign country (based on the Ship-To Address or Supplier Address), tax exemptions must be maintained either:-In the Product Master Data, or -By manually updating the Tax Code in the Supplier Invoice.-To maintain the tax details in the Product Master Data:-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Products - By Materials view.-Open the Material.-Select Taxes tab.-Fill the tax details.-Tax determination based on the Supplier Master Data is currently not supported. -If you would like this functionality to be considered in a future release, please submit it as a new requirement in the Influence forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Tax exemption; Supplier Master Data; Product Master Data; Supplier Invoice; Tax Code; Taxes

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Warning: Costs without assignment to a sales order exists for project
Content: Symptom-The revenue recognition run finishes with the warning 'Costs without assignment to a sales order exists for project XYZ' (XYZ represents a customer project ID). -When checking the Edit Time and Expenses screen for the project, all expenses are assigned. -You verified that all costs, posted in previous and the current accounting period are assigned on or before the revenue recognition run's posting date. -Why does the warning still appear? -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the revenue recognition run: -In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find the run in question.-Go to the Messages tab. -Here, the warning 'Costs without assignment to a sales order exists for project XYZ' appears.-To verify that all project expenses are assigned: -In the Project Managment work center go to the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view. -Search for project XYZ. -Press Edit Time and Expenses. -There is a sales order item assigned to each expense. -To verify that all project expenses are assigned and posted on or before the posting date of the revenue recognition run, use the Sales Documents - Line Items report, for example as follows: -In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Open the Advanced search. -In the Project ID field enter XYZ and press Go.-The associated sales order items appear.-Choose Reports and select Sales Document - Line Items for Project. -Add the Accounting Period/Year attribute and move it to the top of the rows. -Ensure that no expense is posted in a period/on a day after the posting date of the revenue recognition run. -Cause-If all expenses are assigned to a sales order item and if the expenses are not posted after the revenue recognition run's posting date, it is possible that some assigned expenses are marked as deferred:-In the Project Managment work center go to the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view. -Search for project XYZ. -Press Edit Time and Expenses. -All the assigned expenses appear. -Via the Personalization mode add the Quantity to be Deferred and Expenses to be Deferred to the screen. -You now notice that there is an expense appearing as Quantity/Expense to be Deferred.-Every time, when a project expense is marked as deferred, a reversing expense assignment version is generated. The expense then appears as unassigned and a warning is reported by the revenue recognition run to remind the business user to check this situation.-Resolution-To clear the unassigned amount you need to decide if the expense is to be invoiced or credited (in case of an expense reversal after it already got invoiced) to the customer:-In this case mark the expense as expense to be invoiced: -In the Edit Time and Expenses screen select the respective expense.-Under the table, go to the Quantity And Expense Details tab.-Here, enter the deferred amount as Quantity to be Invoiced. -Or, if the expense is not to be invoiced to the customer, you can mark the expense as written off: -In the same sub-tab, Quantity And Expense Details, enter the Quantity/ Expense as to be written off. -Either way, upon saving the changes, another expense assignment version will be generated to reassign the value again, so that it can be cleared fully with the next revenue recognition run.-Keywords-deferred unassigned cost, expense assignment reversal unclear, costs without assignment to a sales order exists

Title: Business Configuration Search Element is not Displayed in the Business Configuration Work Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The UI element Business Configuration Search is not displayed in the Business Configuration Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-The UI element Business Configuration Search is not displayed.-Click on the User Icon on the top right corner.-Click on Key User Settings.-Click on Start Adaptation Mode.-Under UI Element the Business Configuration Search option is not displayed. Hence, it is not possible to search for the activities in the Overview.-Cause-The UI Element Business Configuration Search was removed of the UI.-Resolution-Check the Change Transactions Analyzer in the backend with the UI component of the Business Configuration Search, by following the below steps.-Go to the Transaction SE38.-In the Program Field, insert AP_UI_XTS_CT_OVERVIEW.-Click on Execute.-In the field UI Component Selection, insert /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/BCTools/WorkCentre/BusinessConfiguration_Overview_WCView_html5.WCVIEW.uiwocview-In the End User field, insert *.-Click on Execute.-The Change Transactions list will be displayed.-One of the listed change transactions is of the Type "Remove". This change transaction should be deleted to undo the modification that removed the UI element.-Open an incident with the AP-RC-UIF-RT-B development team to confirm which CT should be deleted.-Request the customer approval to perform the deletion of the Change Transaction mentioned by development team.-After confirming the correct CT to be deleted and receiving the approval of the customer, perform the deletion by following the steps below.-Go to the Transaction SE38.-In the Program Field, insert AP_UI_XTS_CT_OVERVIEW.-Click on Execute.-In the field UI Component Selection, insert /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/BCTools/WorkCentre/BusinessConfiguration_Overview_WCView_html5.WCVIEW.uiwocview-In the End User field, insert *.-Click on Execute.-The Change Transactions list will be displayed.-Select the change transaction of the type "Remove" required.-Click on Delete CT.-The Business Configuration Search will be correctly displayed in the UI.-See Also-3146202 - Delete End User Change Transaction On Backend For Production Tenants-Keywords-Business Configuration Search, UI element, CT, se38,  AP_UI_XTS_CT_OVERVIEW

Title: Time Account Initial Balance not appearing for a specific Time Account type
Content: Symptom-The Time Account Initial Balance is not appearing for a specific Time Account type for all employees associated with the Time Account type in the current period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center and enter the Employees view.-Search for the affected employee, highlight and Edit-Navigate to Time Account Balances tab.-Find earliest entry for the affected Time Account type. No Initial Balance has been maintained.-Cause-Below are the potential causes:-The Time Account Minimum Balance Limit is not maintained for the current period. -Service start date is prior to the Accrual start date. Hence Initial Balance field is disabled.-Resolution-Solution for the first cause:-Maintain a Minimum Balance Limit. -Solution for the second cause:-To enable the Initial Balance, first change the Service Start Date to match the Hire Date. Then the Initial Balance field will be enabled so that user can update the value in Hours.-See Also-2354434 - Approved Leave Hours not Reflecting in Time Account Balance-Keywords-Minimum Balance Limit; Time Account; Time Administration; Initial balance disabled; Service start date; Hire date; Opening Balance;

Title: Migration of Materials Shows all Records with Error, However There is no Error message displayed
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Materials through Migration, the simulation / import is failing but there is no error message. Also, the number of error records have number of materials which have error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Search and Open the Migration of Materials activity-Upload the migration file and proceed as per guidlines-Cause-In Migration file under Financial Organizations sheet Company X is mapped against Business Residence C. However in Organizational Management, company X's Business residences are A and B.-Resolution-The Business Residence and Company would be intact as defined in Org Structures.-Correct the data in the migration file and simulate / import the file again-Keywords-material, migration, error records, failing, simulation, financial data, company, business residence

Title: ISO20022 pain.001.001.09 XML-based Message Format Is Missing for Netherlands
Content: Symptom-For the Netherlands currently there is no ISO20022 pain.001.001.09 payment format available for SEPA Payments.-As a result, payment files generated in SAP Business ByDesign are not accepted by Dutch banks.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign product management is working to update the latest version for the ISO20022 (which means, version V9 or "pain.001.001.09").-In the meantime, the electronic file generation should be done using the XSL transformation framework in SAP Business ByDesign (also called XSLT Payment Flexibility Tool).-With this feature there's no dependency on SAP updates.-A complete step by step document is available here: Generation of Custom Payment File Using XSL Transformation Repository-A guide on how to deploy an XSLT transformation is attached to this KBA (refer to "XSLT_PAYMENT_FLEXIBILITY.docx").-XSLT templates differ for relevant house-banks (for example: ABN AMRO). Please log a referenced support case in order to avail of a bespoke house-bank specific XSLT template. -Keywords-ISO20022, pain.001.001.09, XSLT Payment Flexibility Tool, XSL, Transformation

Title: Allocation Number Field is Missing In Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-The allocation number field is not available for customer invoices created for Israel, where the total net amount exceeds 25,000 ILS.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work center-Go to Invoice Documents View-Select Invoice XYZ which is in status Not Released.(XYZ is the ID of the Customer Invoice)-Edit the Invoice and go to the General tab.-Allocation Number field is not present.-Cause-The system enables the Allocation Number when the following criteria meets:-1. Invoice was created after the implementation change.-2. Source document was created after the implementation change.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.- Keywords-Allocation Invoice, Israel, E-invoicing, customer invoice, Invoice, Allocation Number Field.

Title: Error: Ref ID for Return DEF is not valid. Enter a valid ref ID.
Content: Symptom-While opening the Customer Return, system shows the error messages-"Sales Order reference with ID ABC not valid" (ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-"Ref ID for Return DEF is not valid. Enter a valid ref ID." (DEF represents the Return ID)-Item XX: Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Product - project-based to missing (XX represents the line item number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to the Sales Orders -> Returns. -2) Edit Return DEF -error messages-"Sales Order reference with ID ABC not valid"-"Ref ID for Return DEF is not valid. Enter a valid ref ID."-"Item XX: Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Product - project-based to missing"-Cause-Business ByDesign does not support Item Type PMAT - Product - Project based in the Customer Return scenario and the Customer return DEF is created based on the Outbound Delivery. And the Outbound Delivery is created from Project Stock Order with Item Type Pre-Delivery. In order to return a pre-delivered product to the warehouse which is related to a project, you have to remove the link to the project in inventory first and then only create a Customer Return. -Resolution-To solve the issue you need to:-Make the Return consistent by assigning an external Reference. -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Open return DEF.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Line Item and press the Assign Reference button.-In the Assign Reference window activate the External Indicator.-Enter the Reference Type Sales Order, a Reference ID and a Reference Line.-Press the OK button.--Cancel the Return. -You can follow the steps provided in KBA "2936830 - How to Cancel a Customer Return" --Remove the link to the project in inventory first and then create a new Customer Return. -You can refer to the blog "Product returns from projects to inventory" (Product returns from projects to inventory | SAP Blogs )-See Also-Product returns from projects to inventory | SAP Blogs-2936830 - How to Cancel a Customer Return-Keywords-PMAT; Return; configuration from Product - project-based to missing; Project Stock Order; Reference; invalid; not valid; Enter a valid ref ID; Project; Sales Order;

Title: Unable to Save Replication Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY*** --After making changes to the external business partner number assignment within the "Master Data Replication" section under the "Edit Number Assignment for Integration" WorkCenter, any efforts to upload the external personnel number XYZ through the "Master Data Replication" throws the below error:-"Replication request EC-Integration : XYZ needs to be processed first"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Go to Employee View-Search for the employee ID XYZ-Select  Edit.-After making changes you are unable to save as you are getting below error-"Replication request EC-Integration : XYZ needs to be processed first"-Cause-After the data upload from Employee Central it is executed twice as result of which two replication requests are created in system.-Resolution-This requires a backend correction. Ensure to seek customer's permission before sending it to AP-HMD-RPL development , there will be no execution in the system or processing of any replication request.-The two replication request's status has to be changed to Irrelevant . -Keywords-Master Data Replication, Edit Number Assignment for Integration, Replication request EC-Integration

Title: Extension Field Data is shown Report as 'Not Assigned'
Content: Symptom-Maintained Extension field data is not visible in report as expected -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example : Account Details Report-Go to Account Management WorkCenter-Navigate to Accounts View-Choose Account ID-Confirm the Extension Field created by user has a Value entered.-Navigate to Business Analytics WorkCenter-Select Design Reports view-Choose Account Details Report  -Select 'Click here to Start the report"-Extension field value is shown as 'Not Assigned' in Extracted report.-Cause-Created Extension Filed should be extended to Reports using extension scenario.-Resolution-Maintain Data source and reports field via Further Usage of Extension Field (Adaptation Mode) -Go to Account Management Workcenter-Select Account ID-Choose Created Extension field -Start Adaptation Mode-Choose created Extension Filed-Navigate to Further Usage of Extension Field (Adaptation Mode)-Go to Data Source and Report Tab-Add field 'Account Details"-Scroll down and Select Add Field and Edit under "Reports: Account Details " section.-User will be navigated to reports view.-Choose view-Choose Add row-Enable selected Extension filed to shown in report-Execute report-User will be able to see the maintained value for Extension field in report once created Extension Field is extended to Reports.-See Also-https://me.sap.com/notes/2727775-https://me.sap.com/notes/2905703-Keywords-Not Assigned, value not shown in report, extension field, business analytics

Title: Error: "Inventory ABC already exists; Enter a different Inventory ID"
Content: Symptom-When trying to change and save Inventory ID ABC for Fixed Asset DEF, an error message is being raised:-"Save Failed"-"Inventory ABC already exists; Enter a different Inventory ID"-ABC means Inventory ID.-DEF means Fixed Asset ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Filter for All Fixed Assets.-Search for Fixed Asset DEF and select edit.-Go to Master Data tab.-Go to Individual Material sub-tab.-On List of Individual Materials section, we can see Inventory ID ABC.-Try to change Inventory ID XYZ to Inventory ID ABC and click save.-The following error messages will be raised:-"Save Failed"-"Inventory ABC already exists; Enter a different Inventory ID"-XYZ means the Inventory ID that is being changed.-Cause-Inventory ID ABC already exist for another Individual Material.-Resolution-Inventory ID ABC is already assigned to an Individual Material and is possible to see that for this Individual Material, there's not any Fixed Asset assigned, that's the reason why it does not appear in frontend system.-In this case, it's not possible to use this Inventory ID to any other Individual Materials and system will not allow to change the Inventory ID.-See Also-Individual Materials and Acquisitions-Keywords-Individual Material, Inventory ID, Fixed Asset, "Inventory ABC already exists Enter a different Inventory ID", "Save Failed", change

Title: "Install Additional Software" Option Is Not Available In Self-Service Overview
Content: Symptom-User notice Install Additional Software option is not visible under self-service overview-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home Workcenter-Navigate to Self-Service Overview -Under My Computer view "Install Additional Software" option is not available.-Cause-User do not have access to Download Center-Resolution-Follow below steps to provide access to download center for user,-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter-Navigate to Business User View-Choose User ID -Edit Access Rights of User-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment-Expand Work Center / View ID "ITS_APPLICATIONUSERMANAGEMENT "-Assign  Work Center / View Name "Download Center" to User.- Keywords-not able to download, unable to access download center, unable to download, Install Additional Software

Title: User is unable to Edit Tax code field in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order and trying to edit the tax code, however the field is disabled. But you are able to edit it in "Quick Create" screen.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Select View All-Navigate to Items tab-Add an item-Go to Taxes tab-> Tax code-Try to edit the tax code field but the field is disabled-But you can edit it if you create purchase order from Common Tasks->New Purchase Order: Quick Create  view.-Cause-User has customized the tax code field on the purchase order item level.-Under adaptation mode, the field "Tax code" is set as Read Only. Under Adaptation Mode on purchase order item screen-> select "section group"-> select the respective field-> right click-> it is set as "Read Only" mode.-The same standard fields  are not customized on the  purchase order "quick create" screen , hence they are editable there.-Resolution-Please remove the "Read-Only" flag from the Tax code field in your system.-Then create a new document from scratch and check.-Keywords-unable to edit tax code on purchase order screen, quick create, tax code field is disabled, read only field

Title: Not Possible to Enter a Note in Inspection
Content: Symptom-You are working with an Inspection, and notice that in the Results tab it is not possible to enter a note, as the Notes field is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Quality Control work center.-Enter the Inspections view.-Search for the inspection.-Select it and click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Results tab.-Here you can see that the Notes field is disabled by default.-Cause-Notes require an inspection defect entry.-Resolution-In order to insert a note, you must click on the Add Row button in the Inspection Defects section.-Keywords-Decisions, Note

Title: Unable to add Prefix Zero in Identified Stock
Content: Symptom-Leading zeros maintained in the Business Configuration work center Fine Tuning Activity 'Number Ranges for Identified Stock are removed when a new Identified Stock number is generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List.-Select All Activities in the drop-down.-Choose 'Number Ranges for Identified Stock'.-Choose Open.-Select the Prefix as Static and Enter the value as 0.-Choose Save.--Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data Work center.-Open New Identified Stock under Common Tasks.-Enter the Product ID ABC (ABC represents Product ID).-Choose Change status.-Select Activate.-Choose Save.-The Identified Stock ID is displayed incorrectly and does not add '0' at the beginning of the Identified Stock .-  Cause-The Identified Stock ID is system-generated, and the leading number must be a numeric value greater than or equal to 1.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Prefix Zero; Identified Stock; Number Range Identified Stock; SAP Business ByDesign; 0; Static; Leading Zero; Istock; Business Configuration; Not Generated; Fine Tuning Activity

Title: Process Communication Error in Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-There is a process communication error in the document flow between Logistics Execution Request and Outbound Delivery Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Go to Customer Demand view. -Search for the Sales Order: ABC. (ABC represents Sales Order ID)-Choose Edit.-Go to Document Flow tab.-There is process communication error between Logistics Execution Request and Outbound Delivery Request:-Logistics Execution Request cannot process an update sent by a Outbound Delivery Request.-Outbound Delivery Request cannot update Logistics Execution Request.-Cause-There is a stuck message in the backend with below details,-Sender Party: OutboundDeliveryProcessing-Receiver Interface name: LogisticsExecutionControlFulfilmentIn-Error: Business transaction document item reference missing for confirmation item-Resolution-Try restarting the stuck messages.-If restart doesn't work, create an Incident to AP-LEC-LER component.-Keywords-Process Communication Error; Logistics Execution Request; Outbound Delivery Request; Stuck Message: Sender Party: OutboundDeliveryProcessing; Receiver Interface Name: LogisticsExecutionControlFulfilmentIn; Business Transaction Document Item Reference Missing For Confirmation Item

Title: System triggers error message "Invoice request is inconsistent; serial number validation failed for xxx" while creating New Over-the Counter Sales Document
Content: Symptom-When creating new Over-the-Counter Sales document, system triggers error message although Serial Number KLM tagged inventory status is "In Stock" and there is enough stock for Serial Number KLM.*KLM refers to Serial Number ID, *GHI refers to Product ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Access common task New Over-the-Counter Sales.-Select Account, Sales Unit, Ship from location Opérations, Product GHI, Identfied Stock ID.-Under TAB Serial Number, add serial number KLM.-Click Check-Error occurs: Invoice request is inconsistent; serial number validation failed for GHI.-Cause-There are two possible casues for this error:-a) The logistics area where this serial number stored has no Logistics Use "Over the Counter Stock".-b) The serial number is restricted.-Resolution-In case of above root casue a, move the serial number KLM from Source Logistics Area to Target Logistics Area whose Logistics use maintained as "Over the counter stock":-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Access common task Goods Movement.-Enter all the parameters like Source LOA, Product, Istock id, Target Logistics Area whose Logistics use is "Over the counter stock" etc-Once Goods Movement process is completed you can add it into Over-the-Count Sales document again.-Note: The error stated in title section is valid only for serialized products, if in case the product is not a serialized product the cause stated above is not applicable as system allows to create OTC document even if the product Logistics Area's Logistics Usage is other than "Over the Counter Stock".-In case of above root cause b, remove the restriction indicator of the serial number through common task Change of Stock and add it into Over-the-Count Sales document again.-Keywords-Invoice request is inconsistent; serial number validation failed for, New Over-the Counter Sales Document

Title: Define Bank Accounts to be Included in PEPPOL
Content: Symptom-During the outgoing of invoices from SAP Business ByDesign to Peppol, the XML shows all bank account available for ABC company. (ABC represents the ID of the company)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Cause-Prior to Release 2408, SAP Business ByDesign did not have any setting/feature which allows the definition of Bank Accounts being used in the XML for Peppol.-All bank accounts maintained for a given company which are active and not blocked are shown in the outgoing xml payload.-With Release 2408 a the Check Box Peppol Relevant for Validating the Active Bank Account has been introduced.-Resolution-With Release 2408 you can now select the Peppol Relevant check box to validate the active bank account to be included in the customer invoice.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the My Banks view.-Open the respective My Bank ID.-Navigate to the Bank Accounts tab and select the respective Bank Account Number.-Activate the Peppol Relevant check box in the columns.-Please note: You can make the Peppol Relevant column visible via the Adaptation mode should it not be visible.-If no Peppol Relevant check box checked in Liquidity Management-My Bank-Bank Account, then all the bank accounts will be considered for customer invoicing.-If you deselect active check box in document compliance configuration with source document type as Customer Invoice, then the Peppol Relevant check box will not be visible in Liquidity Management-My Bank-Bank Account.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and choose Open Activity List.-Under Fine-Tune activities, select All Activities and search for Document Compliance Configuration and open it.-The Active check box needs to be selected for 28 - Customer Invoice.  -This feature is available for all Peppol relevant countries to validate the bank accounts that need to be added in the customer invoice.-Keywords-XML, Outgoing, Bank Account, Payload, Peppol, Document Compliance Monitor, Customer Invoice, Sent to Sender Access Point

Title: Installation of SAP ByD Add-In for Microsoft Excel in MS 365
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-• It is not clear how to install SAP ByD Add-In for Microsoft Excel after a system transition to MS 365.-• The Add-In cannot be located in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In case the link to the Add-In does not work, the issue might be caused by a certificate problem in the backend.-Resolution-1. Title: Reports using Data Source HCMTLMB07 show outdated information
Content: Symptom-Standard and Custom Reports using Data Source HCMTLMB07 show outdated data in "Reporting Line Unit" and "Job" fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center and open the Design Reports View.-Search for relevant HCMTLMB07 report and open.-Find entries for the relevant Employee and you will find "Reporting Line Unit" and "Job" columns have outdated data.-Cause-This is caused by a backend inconsistency.-Resolution-Please create a ticket with Support to have the Inconsistencies cleared from the Backend.-Keywords-HCMTLMB07; incorrect; wrong; Recorded Employee Times; Reporting Line Unit; job; Personnel File ; Organisational Assignment; out of date;

Title: VAT Return - Tax Box Code 221B is negative in the system and positive in the XML file
Content: Symptom-You have executed the VAT Return and noticed the amount of the Tax Box Code 221B is negative, i.e. -1000.00 CHF, however, in the generated XML file, the amount is positive.-You wonder why the amount is negative in the system and positive in the XML file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center > VAT Returns view-Select "All Tax Returns"-Search for the respective Tax Return ID -Open the VAT Return-click View All-Go to Tax Return tab-For the Tax Box Code 221B, the amount is negative, i.e. -1000.00 CHF-Go to Attachments tab and download the file-Open the XML file-It shows the following information-<eCH-0217:suppliesAbroad>1000.00</eCH-0217:suppliesAbroad>-Here, you can see that the value is positive-Cause-There is a code mapping in the backend which will change the sign from Negative to Positive for tax box code 221B and update the same in XML file.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.- Keywords-eCH-0217:suppliesAbroad, tax return, VAT, Switzerland

Title: Unable to perform Partial Transfer of Fixed Asset due to Account Determination missing error
Content: Symptom-While you are trying to execute a Partial Transfer of Fixed Asset, the system shows the following error message.-Account determination is missing for item type Proportionally Accumulated Regular Depreciation. Specify account determination in chart of accounts 'ABC' and account determination profile 'DEF' .Column Path Fixed Assets->Depreciation->Accumulated Depreciation, Item Type Proportionally Accumulated Regular Depreciation.-ABC refers to Chart of Accounts-DEF refers to Account determination profile. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Asset work center.-Search for the Fixed Asset MM. ('MM' refers to Fixed Asset ID)-Select Manual postings.-You will see Partial Transfer for Fixed Asset, select that and give the required inputs. -Click Post or Simulate button.-You will see the below error message,-Account determination is missing for item type Proportionally Accumulated Regular Depreciation. Specify account determination in chart of accounts 'ABC' and account determination profile 'DEF' . Column Path Fixed Assets->Depreciation->Accumulated Depreciation, Item Type Proportionally Accumulated Regular Depreciation.-  Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated.-Cause-The fixed Asset for which you are trying to perform the Partial Transfer of Fixed Asset uses an Account Determination Group, where account determination is missing for item type Proportionally Accumulated Regular Depreciation.-You have already maintained Accumulated depreciation for one of the missing Account Determination group for fixed assets by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Fixed Assets under Account Determination.-Go to the Depreciation tab.-Maintain the missing accumulated depreciation for the missing one. -Even after maintaining this configuration, you are still facing the above mentioned error message.-Resolution-If you check in the Business Configuration side based on those Assets 'AAA'(Transfer starts with) and Asset 'BBB'(receiving part),-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Fixed Assets under Account Determination.-Go to the Depreciation tab.-Under Accumulated Depreciation, you will see the G/L account maintained for Historic Cost & depreciation correctly for sending part(Acct. Determination group 2001) whereas the G/L account is not maintained for receiving part(Acct. Determination group 2002)   -Because of this you are getting this configuration error message. Also adding in, if the Asset 'BBB' at receiver end is AuC Asset class, this means it's not a complete Fixed asset. So it is not recommended to transfer the values of IMAT from completed Fixed Asset to AuC. -See Also-" KBA - 2135076 -  Unable to Perform a Complete Transfer of Individual Material due to Account Determination Missing"-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Partial Transfer of Fixed Asset, Manual Posting, Account Determination, Depreciation, Accumulated Depreciation.

Title: Inbound Delivery Notifications Missing for 3PL Location Belonging to a New Entity
Content: Symptom-You have created a new entity with a new 3PL Location to fulfil Third Party Order. However, when you release the 3PL Outbound Delivery, the system is failing to create the corresponding Inbound Delivery Notification.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Third-Party Logistics work center. -Go to the 3PL Requests view. -Find and select the relevant 3PL Request.-You can see the Processing Status is: Finished.-Click Edit.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see the Outbound Delivery has the Status Released.-You expected the system to create an Inbound Delivery Notification against the Released Outbound Delivery.-Cause-You have not maintained the Communication Settings for the relevant Entity/Corporate account.-Resolution-Please open the respective Account's Master Data and set the "Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound" to Active under the Collaboration tab.-Also ensure to maintain the Output Channel as "Internal EDX".-Keywords-"Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound", Collaboration tab, EDX, 3PL, Inbound Delivery Notification

Title: Error Message: 'Update for tax register failed for' while Clearing Full Down Payment
Content: Symptom-During full Down Payment Clearing, system displays the errors 'Update for tax register failed for' and 'Document ID 123 not found in receivables payables register'.-(Here 123 refers to Downpayment ID)-Valid for Country: India-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Go to the Suppliers > Supplier Accounts View.-Search and select the respective Account ID.-Click View button.-Select Document ID to be cleared.-Click Clear Manually.-Select the Down Payment and Supplier Invoice.-Set the Posting Date and Document Date.-Click Clear.-Error message:-Update for tax register failed for-Document ID 123 not found in receivables payables register-Cause-You are using reverse charge (Tax code:86 - Import of Service (Reverse Charge - IGST)) with zero rate for taxes which involves deferred tax related G/L account. Hence, system is showing the error message and this is the current system behavour.-Resolution-You need to post a down payment with different tax code other than reverse charge with zero rate and clear the invoice manually.-See Also-   2696553 - Error: 'Update for tax register failed for' while Clearing a Down Payment -Keywords-Update failed for tax registration for; full amount Clearing; Down Payment, Document ID not found in receivables payables register.

Title: How to Check the Employee Data from Success Factors During Employee Replication?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document provides you the details step to find the Employee Data from Success Factors to ByD through Replication. The Data which you will find is before it saves on Employee Replication Staging area-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Resolution-Please Note: Make sure that with support user, you should not have any UI save authorization, so that when you query the employee from EC ,then it will not create any employee replication request.-Goto transaction SE24-Enter the class name as ‘CL_ECINT_ADQRY_ACT_EXECUTE_CEQ’  and Click on ‘Display’.-And search for method ‘CALL_EMP_COMP_SERVICE’ and click on this method.-Goto line number 138 and put an external break-point. This call SF employee compound API and get the data from successfactor on querying the employee from BYD. After execution of this method , The parameter ‘lt_data_tab_advanced’  will return the employee data from SF side.-When you query an employee from BYD side using action ‘Upload from Employee Central’ .-  It will stop at line number 138.Then you execute ‘F6’.Then click on ‘Lt_data_tab_advanced’.-The highlighted column will have employment history info from SF :-Column ‘EMP_JOB_INFO_T’ will have all the job and RLU assignment for the employment record.-Keywords-SF, success factors, payload, replication, employee

Title: Not able to Delete Service Agent from Employee List in Org Structure
Content: Symptom-Service Agent can't be deleted from Employee List in Org Structure-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Navigate to Edit Org Structures view-Highlight the Org Structure.-Select Org Unit ID-Navigate under Employee tab-Choose Service Agent-Select Delete-Action not possible as button is greyed out -Cause-It is not possible to delete service agent from org structure due to data inconsistency.-Resolution-Go to Business Partner work center-Navigate to Service Agents view-Select Service Agent-Choose Edit-Navigate to General tab-Navigate under Organizational Assignment tab-Remove Organizational Unit and Job Assignment-Choose Save-For service agents in EC integration enabled systems, reporting line unit is mandatory, and the service agent will be assigned to both, org unit and reporting line unit in org structures. It is not possible to remove the service agent from only reporting line unit. In this case, above steps may fail with 'Organizational Unit %1 must be a Cost Center' error. In such a case, open a SAP support case and request to remove the service agent from org unit and reporting line unit in org structure in backend, and provide effective date. Otherwise, continue as follows:-Check the employee assignment in org unit structure by following below provided steps-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Navigate to Edit Org Structures view-Highlight the Org Structure.-Select Org Unit ID-Navigate under Employee tab-Choose Service Agent-Select Delete-Now it should be possible to delete service agent from org unit.-Further, again perform below steps to maintain organizational unit and job assignment,-Go to Business Partner work center-Navigate to Service Agents view-Select Service Agent-Choose Edit-Navigate to General tab-Navigate under Organizational Assignment tab-Add Organizational Unit and Job Assignment-Choose Save-Keywords-Service agent entry shows twice , delete service agent ,org structure, org management, Organizational Unit %1 must be a Cost Center

Title: Time Account for Current Year missing for an Employee
Content: Symptom-Time Account for the current year is not appearing in an employee's Time Account Balances.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Open the Employees view.-Search for the affected employee and Edit.-In Time Account Balances tab the current year is not visible despite previous years being completed.-Cause-This can be caused by a Partial Day Absence on a Public Holiday.-This can cause issues when an unscheduled Public Holiday occurs. i.e. one that was not planned at the start of the calendar year.--You can follow the below steps to confirm:-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select the Regular Tasks view-Under the section Time Valuations, select the link Administer Day Closure Runs-Logs will be failing for affected Employees-Resolution-Remove the Partial Day Absence on the unscheduled Public Holiday.-The next Day Closure Run should correct everything over night. Otherwise perform a manual Day Closure Run for the affected Employee with a Start Time Valuation date as the start of the Time Account.-See Also-1467022 - Error Message "Partial Day Absences Not Allowed as No Planned Working Time" When Trying to Release or Approve Time-Keywords-19/09/2022; The Queen; Partial Day Absence; Time Valuations; Time Account; Time Account Balance; Public Holiday;

Title: The Third Party Inbound Delivery Notification ID with _1 in format
Content: Symptom-In third party order with internal company scenario, after releasing the relevant Outbound Delivery ABC, the following created Inbound Delivery Notification ABC_1 with _1 in format which is not same as the standard Outbound Delivery ID. (ABC represent for the Outbound Delivery ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center.-Go to Third-Party Delivery Notifications view.-Choose All Delivery Notifications by Selection from down list.-Search for ABC*.-See that the Third-Party Delivery Notification ABC_1 is different with the standard Outbound Delivery ABC.-Cause-If there already has a standard Inbound Delivery Notification ABC present in system, then in third party order with internal company scenario, after releasing standard Outbound Delivery ABC, system will assign a new desired Third Party Inbound Delivery Notification ID with _1 or _2 or _3 to distinguish them.-Resolution-It is a standard system behavior.-To avoid this issue, either, the number range of Inbound Delivery Notification should not be similar with Outbound Delivery, or it should be defined some different number range to Outbound Delivery early.-Keywords-Third party order and internal company scenario, standard Outbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery, Third Party IDN, Third Party Inbound Delivery Notification, ID, _1

Title: Error Message "Update of sales order not possible due to currency/ UOM mismatch" is Displayed After the UoM of an Item is Changed in a Sales Order With a Project Scenario
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The error "Update of sales order not possible due to currency/ UOM mismatch" is displayed in the document flow of a Sales Order document. -The error message is displayed after the change in a UoM of a Project Item maintained in the Sales Order document. This change is performed after the invoice process has already started for the Project Line Item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.- Go to the Sales Orders View.- In the search field, Search for Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).- Select View All.- Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Sales Order XYZ document displays an error icon, if selected the following message is displayed in the UI:-"Error: Update of sales order not possible due to currency/ UOM mismatch"-Cause-Go to the Backend.-Locate the XI Message with the Error Message.-Select the XI Message Line with the Error Message.-Select Technical View Button.-Double click the Message Body option-Select the Original XML button -In the XML file, one of the Project Line Items maintained in the Sales Order XYZ will have a different UoM or a different currency from the one maintained in the UI. (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Summarizing:-If the issue occurs due to the unit of measure:-In the Backend:-Project Line Item XX will display the UoM "YY" (XX is the Project Line Item ID, and YY is the UoM in the backend).-In the UI:-Project Line Item XX will display the UoM "ZZ" (XX is the Project Line Item ID, and ZZ is the UoM in the UI).-Since the UoM of the Project Line Item XX was changed in the Sales Order XYZ after the item was invoiced, the system cannot identify correct UoM to be used in order continue the sales process. Therefore this will cause the error message "Update of sales order not possible due to currency/ UOM mismatch"" to be displayed in the UI.-If the issue occurs due to the currency: -The currencyCode in the payload of the process message is different to the Currency maintained in the General tab of the Sales Order. -You need to check if the Sales Order in the Project Invoicing view and Sales Order sub view of the Customer Invoicing work center has the same currency as the Sales Order in the Sales Orders work center. -Resolution-If the issue is caused by the Unit Of Measure: -Request the customer to revert change in the UoM of the Project Line Item in the Sales Order, once the change is performed from the customer side restart the message from the backend.-After this process, kindly inform the customer that once an Project Line Item is created in a Sales Order, no further changes should be performed in UoM of this item as it can lead to a inconsistency in the system.-If the issue is caused by the Currency: -If the Sales Order in the Sales Orders work center and the Sales Order in the Project Invoicing view and Sales Order sub view of the Customer Invoicing work center have the same currency, you can reconcile the message. If it does not, the customer needs to change the currency in the Sales Order and then you can restart the process message. -Keywords-uom, change, update of sales order not possible due to currency/uom mismatch, project, project line item, backend, mismatch, document flow

Title: Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order Bot Gets Stuck
Content: Symptom-You are using the bot Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order, however during the execution the bot stops at a certain step, not continuing with the normal execution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This issue can be caused by the amount of data being loaded into the bot (generally, during the Document Information Extraction execution step) for the generation of the log file at the end of the execution.-Resolution-In order to address such issues in the generation of the log file, the version 2C1 of the bot was deployed to the RPA store, and should be used in case the 1C1 version gets stuck during processing.-Keywords-BPA, iRPA, RPA, Process, Automation, DOX

Title: How is Tax Calculation Date Derived in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are checking your Output Form and noticed a mismatch in the currency rate.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents work center.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Document).-Click Preview.-Exchange rate is not as expected.-Also you can see that the Invoice Date under general tab and Tax date under Item tabs are different-Cause-For Customer Invoice, there are three ways to determine the Tax Calculation Date:-Material delivery based: The shipment date of Outbound Delivery is used as Tax calculation (Tax date in Items tab, Taxes sub tab).-Services:-For a Service of Item Type SECO – Service - Time and Material, the Tax Date is taken over from the Tax Date of the Service Confirmation.-For a Service of Item Type SEFL – Service Fixed - Price without actuals and SERV – Service - Fixed Price, the Tax Date is taken over from the Tax Date of the preceeding Sales Documents.-Manual Invoice: The invoice date is used for Tax calculation.-Scheduled Invoice Request: The invoice date in the invoice schedule of the contract or sales order is used for Tax calculation.-These dates are also used for the calculation of currency amounts.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-2902263 - How System Defines the Tax Date on Sales Order-2943472 - Tax Date Cannot Be Changed When Invoicing a Scheduled Invoice Request-Keywords-Tax Calculation; Customer Invoice; Exchange Rates; Currency, Amounts, Mismatch

Title: Default values appearing in Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You have created a New Journal Entry Voucher, and want to know why certain values appear in the fields: Company, Set of Books, Journal Entry Type & Screen Variant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select New Journal Entry Voucher.-Values appear under the fields, Company, Set of Books, Journal Entry Type, Transaction currency, Screen Variant, and Posting Date.-These fields are not empty to allow selecting the required values.-Cause-The values that appear in the fields Company, Set of Books, Journal Entry Type, Transaction currency, Screen Variant, and Posting Date are the values that were in the last Journal Entry Voucher that was posted.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour-Keywords-JEV, Journal Entry Voucher, default, values,

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error upon Uploading file in Mass Data Maintenance - Internal Info
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-• When uploading a CSV file to the Mass Data Maintenance tool, the tool navigates to a "500 Internal Server Error" page after clicking the upload button.-• The backend dump, accessed via transaction ST22, displays the following details:-Category               ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors         REFI_WRONG_SECTION-Except.                CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS-ABAP Program           CL_DMC_PARSER_EXCEL_SPREADSHT=CP-Application Component  LOD-LE-MIG-MWB-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Enter the Mass Data Maintenance view.-Select any of the import links (Customers, Materials or Supplier-Choose File button.-Select the CSV template to be uploaded.-Choose the Upload button.-Observe that "500 Internal Server Error" displays.-Cause-• The user has maintained (") quotes as text qualifiers during upload.-• The same character is also used in the data from the template (e.g., in description fields). -• The text qualifier selected during the upload cannot be part of the data being imported.-Resolution-Open the source file to be uploaded and check if any quotes (") are present.-Remove the respective character from the content of the CSV file.-Alternatively, select a different text qualifier during the import. -See Also- SAP Note 2993676 - 500 SAP Internal Server Error When Uploading Files In Mass Data Maintenance-Keywords-500 Internal Server Error, Mass Data Maintenance, MDM, CSV upload error, text qualifier issue, data import error, ByDesign, LOD-LE-MIG-MWB, REFI_WRONG_SECTION, CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, ST22, upload failure, import links

Title: 'Different fiscal year variants exist for the assigned sets of books' Error While Executing a GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom- Error message is thrown upon execution of GR/IR Clearing Run:-'Different fiscal year variants exist for the assigned sets of books'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the GR/IR Clearing view.-Click New --> GR/IR Clearing Run.-Fill in mandatory fields (such as Company ID) and leave Set of Books empty.-Click Start Now.-Error is thrown:-'Different fiscal year variants exist for the assigned sets of books'-Along with the error message, there's also an info message displayed:-'Select one set of books only'.-Cause-When a company is assigned to multiple sets of books, and these sets of books are assigned to different fiscal year variants, it's not possible to execute a single GR/IR Clearing Run for all sets of books.-For example:-Company ABC is assigned to Set of Books DEF and GHI (ABC represents Company ID, DEF and GHI represents Set of Books).-Set of Books DEF is tied to Fiscal Year Variant AAA (AAA represents Fiscal Year Variant).-Set of Books GHI is tied to Fiscal Year Variant BBB (BBB represents Fiscal Year Variant).-It's not possible to execute a GR/IR Clearing Run for Company ABC leaving the Set of Books field empty, as this implies the run would be executed for DEF and GHI.-Resolution-Perform GR/IR Clearing Run for each Set of Books seperately as following:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the GR/IR Clearing view.-Click New --> GR/IR Clearing Run.-Fill mandatory fields (i.e. Company ID) and fill in Set of Books (i.e. DEF or GHI).-Click Start Now.-Keywords- gr/ir clearing run; set of books; fiscal year variant; sob; fyv

Title: Error Message: 'No Expense Arrangement Found for Employee 123' When Creating Expense Report
Content: Symptom-Error message shown while creating Expense Report.-Expense arrangement not found-No expense arrangement found for employee ID 123. (Here, 123 represents the Employee ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Click on New -> Expense Report on Behalf.-Choose an Employee and you can see the error meesage:-Expense arrangement not found-No expense arrangement found for employee ID 123. (Here, 123 represents the Employee ID)-Cause-The error is due to there is no Expnese Arrangement created for the Employee:-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Arrangements view.-Search for Employee 123.-Not able to find any active Expense Arrangment for the Employee.-In the current ByDesign version, it is not possible to directly create expense arrangements for other countries than standard countries.-Resolution-As a workaround,  first create a own country version for ABC via Generic Country Version. (Here, ABC refers Country)-It must be scoped the scoping question "Do you want to use the generic country version for Expense and Reimbursement Management?"-You can follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Show All Current Projects and Find Project and Choose "Edit Project Scope".-Go to the Questions.-Go to the Travel and Expenses Work center>Expense and Reimburse management>Expense reporting.-Select the checkbox against this question.-It is required to create a new country version by following the below steps :-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and Choose Fine Tune Activity List.-Show All Activities and Find Activity "Create New Country/Region Version".-Create a new country version and save it.-Show All Activities and Find Activity "Expense Reporting - Generic Country Version"-You can configure the Expense types, Per diems, Expense Reimbursement groups and all required field according to your requirement.-Once you create Expense Arrangement, it should be able to create Expense report for the Employee.-See Also-https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/sap/support/notes/0003442882-Keywords-Expense arrangement not found, ERM, Expense reporting, Expense Arrangement, No Country/Region Version For Exists In ERM

Title: Item Document Description column in the uploaded Bank Statement file shows strange characters instead of Thai word
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -The Item Document Description column in the uploaded MT940 UK Bank Statement file shows strange characters like ×*×©×•×Ÿ $"ž instead of Thai word.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Open the relevant Bank Statement.-The Item Document Description column in the Transactions section shows strange characters.-Cause-For MT940 UK Bank Statement files the system expects an encoding ISO-8859-1 which does not contain Thai characters, this is why the wrong characters are displayed instead.- Resolution-Login to the backend.-Enter the T-code BCE.-Select Configuration Workspaces from the dropdown menu.-Enter the BCSet ID BC_A1S_FIN_FIO_BKST_GB_MT940 and click enter.-Expand the Initial Implementation section and in the Objectname Loaded BC Sets, search for the BCSet ID BC_A1S_FIN_FIO_BKST_GB_MT940.-Double click on it and select the Node ID A1S_FIN_FIO_BKSTGLO_C_FIO_BK_3 from the dropdown menu and note that the Charset_Code iso-8859-1 is mapped to the respective Format_Code.-Click on Display <-> Change and change the Charset_Code from iso-8859-1 to UTF-8.-Click save.-Ask the customer to upload the file again either after reversing the earlier statement or try with a new but similar file.- See Also-2790677 - Item Description Document Column in Uploaded Bank Statement Shows Strange Characters Instead of Data in Hebrew-Keywords-Bank Statement, Thai, Strange Characters, Incorrect, Upload, File, MT940 UK, Item Document Description.

Title: Migration of Customers Imported Successfully but the Data is not Updated in the UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-The migration of customer was successfully imported without any errors, however the data is not reflected when verified in Accounts view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management workcenter-Go to Accounts view-Search for Account: ABC -Navigate to the Contacts tab-Notice the migrated contact data is not reflected in the UI-Cause-The issue is with the Account ID conversion during migration. This is because there's mapping (Convert Value Step) for account ABC  to target account DEF. Hence after successful update, the contact data is displayed in target value. -Resolution-NOTE: This change is applicable only for Account ID. Before proceeding with the below changes, get the confirmation from the customer what is the target value required.-Kindly follow the below steps to correct the Target value data in the backend:-Go to backend transaction: MWB_SRVC_CENTER-Under Migration Object select CUSTOMERS- Select Test Data Import icon-Under Staging Area field select the XML-Go to Translation Object tab-Select Account ID and then you can see the Source and Target Value-Now select Edit icon-Change the Target Value to ABC-Save-Keywords-Account Management, Contacts, Migration of Customers, Account ID

Title: Last Digit of the Production Order Number Missing While Scanning the Bar Code
Content: Symptom-System displays an incomplete order number where last digit is missing either while previewing the production order Or after scanning the barcode of the order number, -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to Production Orders view.-Show All and search for the respective document ID.-Select and Open required order ID.-Select and choose Preview > Preview.-PDF is generated.-Here the last digit is missing of the production order number.-For example: the barcode should show ABCD, however when scanning it, it shows as ABC instead. -(Here ABCD and ABCD refers to Production Order ID.)-Cause-This is how the template is set up, SAP currently using 128SSCC barcode format which is visible in the form, and at the same time SAP has hidden the barcode format 128B in Business ByDesign.-(Here 128SSCC and 128B refers to Barcode Format)-Resolution-As a workaround, create the custom form with the help of the XML source and hide the format 128SSCC then unhide the format 128B already available in the XML source of standard template.- Keywords-Production order bar code, Scanning the bar code, missing, last digit missing, 128SSCC, 128B

Title: Email Not Delivered to Recipient: No delivery to Email ID: XYZ, as recipient unknown
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Emails sent out from SAP Business ByDesign systems are not received by the recipient and the error message displayed is "No delivery to Email ID: XYZ, as recipient unknown".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The causes could be following:-Email ID doesn't exist.-Email ID inbox might be full.-Temporary/Permanent Bounce back.-Email ID's may be registered under suppression list.-Resolution-When receiving cases with the description informing "Emails not received by the recipient" or with the above error message perform the following checks and take the below actions.-Check the details of the affected users Email ID's.-Check whether the DKIM Key is activated for the sender domains.-Login to the customer backend system and check the Outbox SCOT & filter the Email ID's.-Check SOIN for any bounce back for those affected Email ID's.-Check attachment Delivery Status Notification.-If in the attachment Delivery Status Notification, the information displayed is "Diagnostic-Code: Amazon SES did not send the message to this address because it is on the suppression list for your account. For more information about removing addresses from the suppression list", it indicates that the receiver email address is on the suppression list. This typically happens when the recipient's email address has been bouncing or marking the emails as spam.-Open an incident for the Operations team (with Handover Service as SAAS_BYD_C4C_PROVISIONING_L2) to remove the Email ID's from the Suppression list and also request the operations team to attach the detailed reason (SNS Notification e-mail) in the incident for the mentioned e-mail IDs.-Below is the list of errors customer can get and what action is required and by whom:-Error Action Required Who is responsible to take action on this (Customer/SAP)-Error - 550.5.7 remote server returned not permitted to relay-> 550.5.7.1 <versantis@wespipartner.ch> relaying denied Above error occurs due to the sender address is not recognized by the Outgoing Mail Server or the Recipient Policy of the recipient domain blocks the emails from the sender domain. Recipient is blocking the SAP Business ByDesign. Customer to check with Recipient -See Also-Amazon SES Developer Guide-MIME Cast Error Codes-Keywords-Emails, Email ID, Suppression List, SES, Email not Received.

Title: Unable to Release Tax Return due to Error Message: Payment amount not equal to total of tax items to be cleared
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new correction tax return, however when releasing it the following errors occur:-'Delete tax return <ID> and reschedule tax return run <ID>'-'Payment amount not equal to total of tax items to be cleared'-You have already deleted the correction return and rescheduled it, but the errors are still being raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Return view.-Select the relevant correction run.-Click Release.-The above mentioned errors are raised.-Cause-You are creating the original tax returns for overlapping periods. Since the correction return is then also created for the overlapping period, the Carry forward amount is calculated wrongly by summing up all the amount from previous tax returns and hence error is occurring.-See example below:-VAT Return ID Period-For Jan: ID-1 01.01.2022 to 31.01.2022-For Feb: ID-2 01.01.2022 to 28.02.2022-For Mar: ID-3 01.01.2022 to 31.03.2022-And so on  -When you release a correction run for (for example) return 3, the errors are raised, since original tax returns were executed with overlapping periods.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior for correction runs, which only work for tax return with no overlapping period. Therefore, either you can create monthly/quarterly/yearly returns (without overlapping period) and then create the correction run for that period, OR you should keep creating runs with overlapping period to account for any differences.-See Also-2296199 - VAT Return Release Errors: 'Delete tax return PQR and reschedule tax return run XYZ' and 'Payment amount not equal to total of tax items to be cleared'-Keywords-Tax Return. Correction Run.

Title: Duplicate Service Requests Created via Outlook Addin
Content: Symptom-You are using the outlook addin to generate Service Requests in ByDesign.-In some cases more than one Service Request is generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Use the Outlook Addin and select an email.-Click Create service request.-Click Create service request again.-You will now have two service requests from this email.-Cause-In the current addin it is not possible to prevent the creation of multiple service requests from the same email.-There are multiple locations, where a service request can be generated and for each click the respective button.-In some cases the generation of service requests can vary depending on system load.-Each click will generate a message and once the message is processed, the service request will be in the tenant.-Resolution-Do not click the Create service request button more than once, even if the service request is not directly visible.-In case multiple service requests were created, delete one of the service requests.-See Also-2025807 - E-mail Text in Edit Output Settings for Service Request is Read Only-2036320 - E-Mail, Phone and Fax of the Processor in the Output Document of a Service Request is Not the Expected One-3345865 - How to Create Service Request via Microsoft Outlook-Configuration: Creating Service Requests From Incoming E-Mails-Create Service Requests from E-Mails-Keywords-Outlook AddIn, Service Request, Duplicate, Serviceanfrage, Doppelt, ﻿Not Created, From, Email

Title: Product Category Not Available For Document Type Time Confirmation under Not Invoiced Time and Expenses
Content: Symptom-Product category is not populated on the general tab of Not Invoiced time and expenses.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work center-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses View-Search for the relevant project-Choose Edit Time and Expenses-Navigate to Edit Assignment Rules-Choose View All Rules-You can see for Time and Expenses Type: Product Category, Product Category is mentioned-Navigate back to General tab of Project Task  -Product Category is empty-Cause-For time and expenses, the product category does not get considered.-This is the current system behaviour.-Resolution-It can be taken as a new requirement and you can post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. This is our official channel to address all new requirements.-Keywords-Product Category; Product category empty in Not Invoiced time and expenses; Assignment Rules for Time Confirmation-product category,assigment rules for time confirmation,product category empty in not invoiced t

Title: Error Message: Cannot Close All Periods in Fiscal Year YYYY; Bal.Car.Fwd. Not Finished
Content: Symptom-Error occurs when trying to close the accouting period AAA of the current year YYYY. (AAA represents the accounting period. YYYY represents the current fiscal year.).-Error: Cannot close all periods in fiscal year YYYY ; Bal.Car.Fwd. not finished-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose Open and Close Period under Common Tasks.-Filter for the relevant company and set of books.-See that period AAA of fiscal year YYYY is opened, and all the other accounting periods of fiscal year YYYY are closed.-Select fiscal year YYYY, period AAA and click 'Close Period'.-System gives error message: "Cannot close all periods in fiscal year YYYY; Bal.Car.Fwd. not finished".-Cause-The reason is that the Balance Carryforward Run for year YYYY has not been performed. Therefore, it's not possible to close all the periods in fiscal year YYYY. At least one accounting period need to be opened for fiscal year YYYY.-Resolution-It's not possible to close all the periods in fiscal year YYYY.-In order to close period AAA and open another accounting period CCC in fiscal year YYYY, first need to open all the periods between AAA and CCC. Then close all the other periods except for the accounting period CCC.(CCC represents another accounting period).-See Also-1787760 - Cannot Open Fiscal Period-Keywords-fiscal year, open and close period, balance carryforward

Title: Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is in Status Blocked
Content: Symptom-In the Invoice Requests view an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is in status Blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select Outbound Delivery Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ refers to the ID of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request).-The status of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is displayed as Blocked.-Cause-The relevant sales order is blocked for invoicing.-You scoped the Approval Process for Sales Orders and the Approval status of the Sales Order is Not Started and therefore needs to be triggered in the Sales Order. -The Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is already invoiced but the status of the Outbound Delivery was changed to Not Released afterwards.-Resolution-If the Sales Order is blocked for invoicing follow the below steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Sales Orders view.-Find relevant sales order.-Navigate to the General tab.-Remove the value entered in the field Invoice Block.-Save your changes.-If the Sales Order Approval process needs to be triggered:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC.-Edit the sales order -> Select - Submit for Approval.-If the conditions of the Approval process are not met the Approval status will change to Approval not Necessary and the Invoice Request will be again changed to To Be Invoiced. -If the conditions are met the approval will be sent to the respective approver.-Once approved the Approval status will change to Approved and the Invoice Request will be again changed to To Be Invoiced. -If the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request was already invoiced and the status of the Outbound Delivery was changed to Not Released afterwards you need to either release the Outbound Delivery again or cancel the Customer Invoice. -See Also-2194102 - Customer Invoices Request is Blocked-1757278 - Customer Invoice Request For The Sales Order Is In Blocked Status-Keywords-Outbound Delivery; Invoice Request; Blocked; Block; Status

Title: How to Locate Failing XI Messages for a BO in the Backend via the Report APCRM_GET_ERR_PCES
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-How to locate failing XI Messages for a BO in the backend via the Report: APCRM_GET_ERR_PCES-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently the methods we have are:-SESFTS -> message viewer (not possible for all BO's)-SRT_MONI -> Searching for XI message / date and time / process group etc ( Can have a large amount to view ).-SRT_MONI -> BO Search (Not always reliable).-DB tables in SE16 -> SPAF_ERR_MSG / SPAF_BDOCVIEW (can take some time).-Resolution-The Report APCRM_GET_ERR_PCES is available with Release  2202-The Report can be used for any BO.-In our example you would like to find a failed XI message for Customer Invoice C97-  Logon to the backend system-Go to Backend Transaction SESFTS-Load BO By Proxy Name APCI_CUSTOMER_INVOICE-Load by Query -> CUSTOMER_INVOICE...QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-In the ID/content field enter C97-Copy the UUID- In our example  UUID: 00163EAC8FA11EDC9ECB75AAB6F7242A-Go to Backend Transaction SE38-Enter the Report APCRM_GET_ERR_PCES in the Program field-Click on Execute (F8)-         You have 5 possibilities to find the failed XI messages:-Entering Just a BO Name and hitting execute: -Entering just a BO Name will do a search for all XI messages linked to that specific BO in the system.--Entering a BO Name and receiver/sender UUID: -This will search for specific instance.--Entering just a Receiver UUID:-This will search for that specific instance.--Entering just a Sender UUID:-This will search for that specific instance.--Entering just SHOW ALL FAILED MSGS:-This will show ALL failed messages in the system -> Caution as this could lead to long loading times!-NOTE: If just you are using sender / receiver UUID, do not enter the value into both fields. If you are using BO Name, you can enter the value into multiple fields.-Examples:-In the field BO Name enter the BO e.g. in our example since it is a Customer Invoice the BO is APCI_CUSTOMER_INVOICE-In the field Sender BO Node UUID or the field Receiver BO Node UUID enter the UUID you copied e.g. in our example 00163EAC8FA11EDC9ECB75AAB6F7242A-In the result table you can see the following:-Message UUID-Sender Details of message-Receiver Details of message-When the error was created in SPAF BO.-Log Item details / Fatal Message-If you would like to see all failed XI messages for a specific BO you can maintain the BO Name and leave the fields Sender BO Node UUID and Receiver BO Node UUID emptly.-If you would like to see all failed XI messages you can leave the fields BO Name, Sender BO Node UUID and Receiver BO Node UUID emptly and Activate the indicator Show All failed MSGs-You can then check the failed XI message by copying the Message UUID and enter it in SRT_Moni-Keywords-Process Communication Error; PCE; Sender Interface; Receiver Interface; SRT_MONI, SE38, SESFTS, XI Messages, Failed, Error, BO

Title: Fixed Asset Acquisition Posting Error: Posting date DD.MM.YYYY must be in fiscal year AAAA for fixed asset BBB
Content: Symptom-A manual Fixed Asset posting of type Acquisition is created. When trying to post, the error: "Posting date DD.MM.YYYY must be in fiscal year AAAA for fixed asset BBB" appears.-(DD.MM.YYYY stands for Posting Date, AAAA for Different Fiscal Year from Posting Date and BBB for Fixed Asset ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select Fixed Asset BBB.-Click Manual Postings Manual - Acquisition.-Input Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY.-Add remaining needed data.-Click Post.-The error 'Posting date DD.MM.YYYY must be in fiscal year AAAA for fixed asset BBB' appears.-Cause-The Capitalization Date of the Fixed Asset is in a fiscal year after the fiscal year of the Posting Date.-Resolution-If the posting needs to be done on the Date DD.MM.YYYY, the Capitalization Date needs to be set to this Date as well.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select Fixed Asset BBB.-Click Edit - Master Data.-Go to the Life Cycle Data tab.-Change the Capitalization Date to DD.MM.YYYY.-Press Save.-This time, no error will be raised when posting the acquisition. -Keywords- Fixed Asset, Acquisition, Posting Date, Must Be in Fiscal Year-fixed asset,acquisition,posting date,must be in fiscal year

Title: Lease Posting Run Error : Posting Date Must not be before Initial Migration Date
Content: Symptom-You have executed Lease Posting Run Error and end up with error: Posting date must not be before initial migration date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Lease Posting Run.-Select the Run ID ABC(ABC denotes run ID).-View the Log Details.-Navigate to Messages tab.-Posting date must not be before initial migration date.-Cause-Posting date in the Lease Posting Run should not be blank but should be filled with date equal to initial migration date.-Resolution-When the lease start dates are before to the initial migration date, use the personalization option in the lease posting run and tick the posting date button and save.-Please add via the Personalization or Adaptation Mode the Posting Date field in the Lease Posting Run. In case your migration date is the XX-1 please enter the XX-1 as the Posting Date in the Lease Posting Run-Keywords-Lease Posting Run Error, posting date, Initial Migration Date-posting date,lease posting run error,initial migration date

Title: Error Message: Priority Must Be a Numeric Value Greater Than Zero
Content: Symptom-Error occurs when trying to create a prioritize bank accounts and payment methods.-- The action could not be performed. An error has occured.-- Priority must be a numeric value greater than zero.-- Save failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Activity: Global Settings for Payment and open it.-Select Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods.-Click 'Add Row' and enter the required data.-Then save the entry and system gives error messages:-- The action could not be performed. An error has occured.-- Priority must be a numeric value greater than zero.-- Save failed.-Cause-The field 'Priority' cannot be left blank.-Resolution-It's mandatory to enter an integer value which is greater than zero in the field 'Priority'. If the field 'Priority' is not in the view, please check if the field is hidden or is not marked visible in the interface.-If the field is not visible, follows the steps below to make it available via Adaptation Mode:-Go to Adaptation mode.-Go to Unnamed Table.-You will see the 'Priority' field.-Check mark it and save.-Click on Publish changes.-Keywords-Priority Must Be a Numeric Value Greater Than Zero, Global Settings for Payment, Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods

Title: Error Message: Inventory ID Already Exists; Enter a Different Inventory ID
Content: Symptom-When you try to assign Inventory ID PQR to Fixed Asset XYZ-0, an error message appears:-"Save failed-Inventory PQR already exists; Enter a different inventory ID".
