(PQR represents the Inventory ID, XYZ-0 represents the Fixed Asset ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for Fixed Asset XYZ-0.-Press Edit, then select the Master Data tab.-Select the Individual Material sub-tab.-In the Inventory ID field, enter PQR.-Press Save.-An error message appears:-"Save failed.-Inventory PQR already exists; Enter a different inventory ID."-Cause-The Inventory ID PQR is already used for another Individual Material. This Individual Material might also be with status In Preparation. Since Inventory ID must be unique the system raises the error message.-To check which Individual Material is assigned to the Inventory ID PQR-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Open the advanced search.-In the Inventory ID field, click in the value help.-Type PQR in the search field.-Execute the search.-You can now see the Individual Material ABC (ABC refers to the ID of the Individual Material) that is assigned to Inventory ID PQR.-Resolution-You can delete the Inventory ID using the steps:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the New Invoice Without Purchase Order common task.-Select the item with row ID 1.-Maintain Account Assignment Type as IMAT - Individual Material.-In the Individual Material field, type ABC.-Double-click the Individual Material ABC.-Select Edit.-Remove the Inventory ID.-Press Save.-Now you will be able to add the same Inventory ID in the Fixed Asset.-Keywords-Inventory ID, Fixed Asset, already exists, error, Individual Material

Title: Cancellation Date Indicator in Customer Invoice and Posting Date on Cancellation Invoice Cannot be Changed via oData Service
Content: Symptom-You would like to maintain the Invoice Date and Posting Date in a Cancellation Invoice via OData but the CustomerInvoiceCancellationDate indicator in Customer Invoice and DeviatingPostingDate on cancellation invoice is not available in the oData service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Currently the CustomerInvoiceCancellationDate indicator and DeviatingPostingDate on cancellation invoice are not added in the oData service.--If you have a business requirement to add these fields you can add the requirement in SAP Business ByDesign Continuous Influence site.-Keywords-CustomerInvoiceCancellationDate, DeviatingPostingDate, Posting Date, Invoice Date, OData

Title: Error Message : Postings in Company, Set of Books, Year Prevent Bal. Carryforward while Reversing Balance Carryforward Run
Content: Symptom-You reverse a Balance Carryforward Reversal Run but it finishes with the error message "Postings in company PQR, set of books XYZ, year YYYY prevent bal. carryforward." (PQR represents the company ID, XYZ represents the set of books ID, YYYY represents the year that was carried forward)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks - Balance Carryforward view.-Open the Balance Carryforward Reversal run and click on Log Result.-Go to the Messages tab and you can see the error message "Postings in company PQR, set of books XYZ, year YYYY prevent bal. carryforward."-Cause-When a reversal of a Balance Carryforward run is executed, it will use the closing step settings of the original run. Company/Set of Books the original run used. If these changed between the orignal run and the reversal then the error appears.-The following settings are recommended to successfully execute the Balance Carryforward run:-Period 012.YYYY:-First Allowed Step: 990- Closing Balance-Last Allowed Step: 991 - Profit and loss calculation of retained earning-Period 001.YYYY+1:-First Allowed Step: 001 - Opening balance-Last Allowed Step: 991 - Profit and loss calculation of retained earning (or) 010 - Operational Postings.-Resolution-To execute the Balance carryforward reversal run, first verify the Closing Steps settings that were maintained when the original balance carryforward run was executed:-In the application log of the original Balance Carryforward run go to the General tab and take note of the Executed On date and time. -In the General Ledger go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view. -Select Company PQR and the set of books and press Open and Close Periods (Alternatively use the Common task section in the General Ledger work center). -In the new screen go to the Changes tab and press go. -Check for and take note of the closing step for period 012.YYYY and 001.YYYY+1. For example, the first allowed closing step of period 012.YYYY was changed from 990- Closing Balance to 020-Closing Entries after the original balance carryforward run. -Once you have clarified the closing steps that were maintained for the original run change them accordingly, here from 020-Closing Entries back to 990-Closing Balance. -Now you will be able to execute Balance Carryforward Reversal run without this error message.-Same KBA can be useful during Error message: Run processing failed for reversal run as well.-Keywords-Reverse balance carryforward, Balance Carryforward Reversal run, Prevent bal. carryforward, Posting periods, Run processing failed

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error When Uploading Files In Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a file in Mass Data Maintenance, but the upload fails with error: 500 SAP Internal Server Error.-Environment- SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the link Import ABC (where ABC is the relevant business object for this operation).-Upload the relevant CSV file.-Error occurs.-Cause-Special characters like comma, question mark, period etc. may have been used in the upload file.-As the system identifies some of these characters as separators in a CSV (comma-separated values) file, this might cause the file to "break" into a wrong format, which leads to the mentioned technical exception.-Or, for example, quotes are maintained as text qualifier during upload and quotes are also used in the file data  (for example in description fields). But the text qualifier which is selected during the upload cannot be part of the data being imported.-Resolution-Review the CSV file for values in incorrect formatting and correct the file.-See Also-2204393 - Common Issues With CSV Files in Data Workbench and Mass Data Maintenance-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, problem, does not work, failing

Title: How To Regenerate RBAM Policy for "You Are Not Authorized to Access UI Application" Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-It is necessary to regenerate the RBAM Policy for a view. This may be required when a business user receives an authorization error for a view, although this user has all required access rights, no related access restrictions exist and also, an update of the access rights (where feasible) did not solve the issue. Such authorization errors usually start with: "You are not authorized to access UI application" with or without further error text.-Example: in SAP Business ByDesign, a user receives the following error when trying to copy any approval process:-"You are not authorized to access UI application /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/MSA/ApprovalProcessDefinitionQAF_ECO_Edit_Process.QA.uicomponent'"-Note: The error might not be reproducible for a SAP User.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The access right has not been updated properly in backend.-The RBAM Policy needs to be regenerated.-Resolution-The process is similar in SAP Cloud for Customer and SAP Business ByDesign. However, some details specific for the given example are only valid for Business ByDesign.-The issue also happens because the access right has not been updated properly in backend. Therefore, first try to update the access right as following:-Go to Business Users work center view.-Search for the issued business user.-Click on Edit > Access Rights.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Remove the issued work center assignment and click save.-Assign the issued work center again and click save.-Go back to Business Users work center view.-Click Update Access Right.-If the update of access right cannot solve the problem, RBAM regeneration is necessary.-In case the relevant Work Center View Name is known, use the following steps to find the required Work Center View ID:-Go to Business Users work center view.-In SAP Cloud for Customer, under the Administrator work center.-In SAP Business ByDesign, under the Application and User Management work center.-Search a business user which is known to have access rights for the relevant view.-Click on Edit > Access Rights.-Go to the Work Center and View Assignment tab.-In the Work Center / View Name column, filter for the name of the view (in this example, Approval Processes)-Check the Work Center / View ID column for this record to find the ID of this view (in this case, APPROVALPROCESSES_WCVIEW).-To regenerate the RBAM Policy for the Work Center View ID, perform the below steps:-In the backend, go to transaction SRBAM.-Click RBAM Policy Generation.-Ensure that Generate, Send and Wait are available under Action.-Ensure that All Policies are available under Scope.-Click in the field XRepository - Short Name.-Maintain the ID of the view (in this case, APPROVALPROCESSES_WCVIEW).-Click on the Tool icon to Generate Test Policies.-Press F8 or click the clock icon to Execute.-In case the Work Center View Name or ID which is associated with the floorplan/path is unknown, use the report "Workcenter view using the floorplan" in the IAM_TOOLS transaction. Just provide the floorplan (in our example, /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/MSA/ApprovalProcessDefinitionQAF_ECO_Edit_Process.QA.uicomponent) and the report will return all the work center views to which the floorplan is added. Then perform the steps to regenerate the policy for the corresponding work center view by using the short ID from the output of the report.-In some cases, the floorplan is unknown and the error still happens after regenerating the RBAM policy of the related Work Center View. This may be that the issued page is related to several different Work Center Views and there is a data inconsistency problem between table and table. In the case, it is required to regenerate the RBAM policy of all the Work Center Views. This case often happens when PDI is involved since PDI often has an extended table.-Important: The report may terminate related active sessions in the system. Ensure that the customer provides the approval to perform the backend correction. If possible, perform outside business hours or clarify the situation with the customer.-See Also-See also the following KBA which has been created for the customer:-2827381 - Copy of Approval Process Fails With Access Authorization Error-If the issue is not related to a single view, all policies may be attempted to be regenerated. Here an agreement of the customer and a regeneration outside business hours is indispensable. See for example:-2626120 - Error While Accessing Groupware Integration View Under Work Center Email Integration-Keywords-backend correction, not authorized, UI application, rbam policy generation

Title: All Users Able To Log Via SSO Regardless Security Policy
Content: Symptom-You have some of your business users which don't use SSO set to Security Policy S_BUSINESS_USER and others with S_BUSINESS_USER_WITHOUT_PASSWORD which are using SSO.-However the users which have S_BUSINESS_USER policy are also able to log using SSO if they add the tag "-sso" to the application URL (e.g. https://myXXXXXX-sso.crm.ondemand.com / https://myXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com).-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administration (C4C) or Application and User Management (ByD).-Go to Business Users.-Enter any business user.-Click to Edit. -In Security Policy field select policy S_BUSINESS_USER.-Save the user. -Log off the system.-Attempt to log with the user using the tag "-sso" in the URL.-User will be able to login. -Cause-None of the available policies disables the SSO for any user. The S_BUSINESS_USER_WITHOUT_PASSWORD policy can be used when you want only SSO to be used for an user, but vice versa is not possible.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-If the feature/functionality is needed as a matter of urgency, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-SSO; Policies; Security; Logon;

Title: Unable to Generate New Password From the Forgot Password Link
Content: Symptom-When using the password reset self-service, you expect the system to send a token to the user's e-mail address, in order to set up a new password. However, no token is sent to the e-mail address provided.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the system's log-on screen.-Click the link Forgot your Password? (ByD) or Forgot password? (C4C).-A popup screen will come up, requesting to enter your e-mail address.-Automatically a new popup will request you to enter the token that was sent to your e-mail address. -Cause-There might be several causes related to this issue. Some of them are listed below, with their resolution.-Resolution-The e-mail address of the user is not maintained in the system-For Business ByDesign:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Regular Tasks views.-Select option Change Workplace Contact Data.-Search for the Employee to be edited.-Maintain e-mail address under Communication Data. -For Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Administrator work center.-Access the Employee view.-Search and select the employee to be edited.-Click Edit.-The employee's TI will open in Edit mode, where you can change the e-mail address.-It is worth noting that the e-mail address for the business user needs to be unique. If the same address is maintained for multiple users, the system is not able to determine which user needs to be reset, and the token is not sent.-Check the E-Mail and Fax Settings fine-tuning activity-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Search and open activity E-Mail and Fax Settings.-In the next screen, click the E-Mail and Fax Settings link.-Under the section E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System, check if option "Send all e-mails to this address" is selected.-When this configuration is maintained, all outbound e-mails from the system will be sent to the e-mail address determined in the field underneath it, so that the administrator can check how the e-mails are displayed before using them in productive circumstances. Since all outbound e-mails are routed to the e-mail address maintained in this fine-tuning activity, this includes password reset tokens.-Please set this option to "Send all e-mails to business partners" so that the users receive their password reset tokens as expected.-Note: this functionality is only available in test systems.-The user has been manually locked by an administrator-If a user has been manually locked by an administrator, it will not be able to log in even if the password is correct. Additionally, the "Forgot Password" functionality won't work as well.-To check if this is the case, please do the following:-Go to the Business Users work center view.-In Business ByDesign, under the Application and User Management work center.-In Cloud for Customer, under the Administrator work center.-Search for the affected user.-The user will have the checkbox under the User Locked column checked.-To unlock the user, select it in the list and click the Unlock User button in this same screen.-Check or configure S/MIME certificate-Please check the following:-Go to the Common Tasks work center view. -In Business ByDesign, under the Application and User Management work center.-In Cloud for Customer, under the Administrator work center.-Access the option Configure S/MIME.-Navigate to the Outgoing E-Mail tab. -Check if the certificate has expired in the system.-Click Renew S/MIME Certificate. -Save your changes and test the scenario again. -Check encryption for outgoing e-mails-Go to Configure S/MIME (see above) and navigate to tab Activate S/MIME. -Check if Encrypt Outgoing E-Mails is selected. -If yes, the system is expecting user's S/MIME certificate to send an encrypted e-mail while trying to reset password. Therefore, uncheck/unselect this option and then test the Forgot Password feature again. -In case all settings are fine and the issue remains, open an SAP support case (see KBA 1296527) and confirm that the settings as mentioned in this KBA have been checked and are correct. SAP needs then to perform further checks in the backend.-Keywords-Forgot Password, New Password, Token Not Received, No e-mail was sent as user has no e-mail address

Title: Error Message: “Mandatory Currency is Missing” While Migrating the Discount Lists
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate the Discount Lists, the following error occurs during simulation:-Mandatory currency is missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Discount Lists.-Choose Migrate discount lists using the migration tool.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File.-The error "Mandatory currency is missing" appears during the simulation step.-Cause-The error may be due to one of the following reasons:-If the Discount List Type Code used is 7PL2, the Account ID field is missing in the General tab of the migration file.-The Discount List Type Code has been maintained incorrectly.-If the Discount List Type Code used is 7PL4, the Account ID was maintained at the Item level.-Resolution-Resolution for Cause 1:-If the Discount List Type Code is 7PL2, ensure the following:-Fill the Account ID field in the General tab of the migration file.-In the Items tab, enter the Product ID and leave the Account ID, Customer Group, and Product Category ID fields empty.-Resolution for Cause 2:-For Discount List Type Code 7PL4, the Account ID should be maintained at the header level.-Resolution for Cause 3:-The correct Discount List Type Code for an Account Hierarchy-Specific Discount List is 7PL1.-See Also-2487654 - How to Fill the Discount List Information in Migration of Discount Lists Template?-Keywords-Discount List, Migration of Discount List, 7PL2, 7PL4, 7PL1

Title: RCA-Downtime Notification Policy - Communication
Content: Symptom-RCA-Downtime Notification Policy -Communication-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The process of delivering downtime notifications and root cause analysis (RCA) to our customers IT contacts for outages and severe service degradations experienced with the SAP Cloud for Customer & SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-We will inform our customers about unplanned downtimes of test and productive systems.--• A series of notification emails are sent to inform the customer about the downtime status.-• These notification emails are sent to the customer’s registered IT contacts.-• In case of an unplanned system downtime, first  downtime notification is sent.The customers will also receive interim update notifications about system status for downtimes that last more than 1 hour.-• In case the issue can be resolved immediately then “Issue Identified and Resolved” notification is sent. The customers will also receive interim update notifications about system status for downtimes that last more than 1 hour.-• Once the system reverts to normal behavior, customers are notified about restoration of normal service.-For all productive systems, root cause analysis (RCA) will be communicated to customers as soon as the root cause is identified.-However, the investigation takes sometime, you should receive the RCA on the next 14 days or sooner via the standard communication channel.-There is no need to open an case requesting it, as it is an automatic process.-Keywords-RCA, Root Cause Analysis, Unplanned downtime notifications.

Title: Unposted Purchase Order with error message "Only one ItemAccountingCodingBlockDistribution.ROOT permitted"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Unposted Purchase Order with error message: Only one ItemAccountingCodingBlockDistribution.ROOT permitted.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center > Source Documents view.-Select "Unposted Source Documents"-Search for Purchase Order XXX and select it (XXX means the Purchase Order ID).-The following error message is displayed:-Only one ItemAccountingCodingBlockDistribution.ROOT permitted-Cause-This is a known issue that was corrected by a Hotfix a few years ago (November 2014), however, if the customer copies and old Purchase Order affected by the original issue, the same error message is raised and the document cannot be posted.-Resolution-After having secured approval from the customer for backend corrections, you can correct the issue by executing a ZReport in transaction SE38:-Connect to the backend of the customer's system.-Open transaction SE38.-In Program, click the Value Help.-Search for report ZUPDATE_FAV_PO_CB and select it.-Check the Syntax (Ctrl+F2).-Activate the Report (Shift+F9).-Execute the Report (F8).-On the new screen, maintain the ID of impacted Purchase Order XXX.-Click Execute again.-A line appears for each Line item of the Purchase Order corrected:- "corrected purchase order XXX"-The information will not have changed in the Frontend and the customer will still see the same error message, however, they should now be able to post the document without any issue.-Please, advise them to avoid copying old Purchase Orders that were previously impacted as the issue will keep on occurring on the copies.-See Also-If ZReport ZUPDATE_FAV_PO_CB is not available in SE38, please consult document ZReport_OnlyOneItemAccountingCodingBlockDistribution.ROOT.docx attached to this document for a step by step guide on how to create it.-If the customer reports issue with the posting after the corrections, you can refer them to this KBA that gives further guidelines on to post them:-2319124 - Un-posted Purchase Order Error Message: Business transaction for accounting for Purchase Order XXXX, version YY with alternate posting date not processed. Not relevant to journal entry creation.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Unposted, Item Accounting, Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 133; report an incident

Title: Warning: Supplier was not Updated as Tax Rate not Available for Shaam Group
Content: Symptom-In Israel, businesses need to periodically check with the tax authorities the accurate withholding tax percentage or rate, that must be deducted before paying the supplier.-So when you are uploading the file received from Israel Tax Authority into the SAP Business ByDesign system, you encounter a warning.-Supplier XYZ(represents Supplier ID) was not updated as Tax Rate not available for Shaam Group.-This should normally update the relevant fields with the updated withholding tax percentage, validation date, and so on in the company database.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to File Input view and show Active Runs.-Select the Active Run Id and check the Execution Details.-Go to the Result Tab.-You see warning  Supplier XYZ was not Updated as Tax Rate not Available for Shaam Group-Cause-For all such Supplier XYZ the Shaam group is not maintained.-Maintaining the Shaam group is a Pre-requisite before carrying out the Shaam Upload activity.-Resolution-In the Withholding Tax Classification, you have to maintain the Shaam group.-Go to Supplier Work center.-Go to Supplier View.-Search and Click on Edit for Supplier XYZ.-Go to Financial Data and then to Tax Data tab.-Under Withholding Tax Classifications, maintain the Shaam Group.-See Also-Maarechet 1000 and Mivzak Files - Israel-Keywords-Israel, Shaam Group, Withholding tax

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Warning Message: 'Purchase Order item delivery/invoice item: purchase in transit item in future'
Content: Symptom-GR/IR Clearing run has been successfully executed for the current period, except there are some warnings in the log file, such as: 'Purchase Order item delivery/invoice item: purchase in transit item in future'.-Also, when G/L Account for Purchase in Transit and Unbilled Payables are checked, they are not set to zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the GR/IR Clearing subview.-Select the target run ID, and choose View.-Go to the Messages tab.-Warning message is displayed: 'Purchase Order item delivery/invoice item: purchase in transit item in future'.-Cause-For the supplier invoice in question, it has the last day of the month as the posting date, however, the GR/IR clearing run has been executed for the current period before the month end, so the system then uses the current date as the run date, which is also the posting date for the run. The run processes all data up to and including the specified date, so it is not able to process the supplier invoice in question, and gives the warning message.-Resolution-If the GR/IR Clearing run is executed on or after the supplier invoice posting date, system should be able to process the supplier invoice, and will not give the warning message.-Keywords-WE/RE Lauf, Lieferantenrechnung

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Error: Posting: Leads to Different Acquisition Cost Amount
Content: Symptom-The extended migration template for migration of fixed assets is being used (for example, more than one valuation view or set of books in your legacy system).-Upon simulation an error shows as Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount when migrate fixed asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The issue can be reproduced with following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and select Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend.-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity and click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration unit and select Execute Migration.-Simulate the migration, the error: Asset val.view: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount is raised.-Cause-Not all the combination of set of books and valuation views are included in the xml file for migration.-Resolution-Maintain the migration data for all combination of set of books and valuation views created in system.-See Also-To identify which combinations of set of books and valuation views are missing, consult KBA 2565738 - How To Solve the Fixed Asset Migration Error: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount.-Keywords-fixed assets migration; extended template; valuation view; acquisition; cost amount

Title: Field Forecast Show No Data in Report Financial Statements - Plan/Actual/Forecast
Content: Symptom-Field Forecast shows no data in report Financial Statements - Plan/Actual/Forecast.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center and Reports view.-Open report Financial Statements - Plan/Actual/Forecast.-Run the report.-You will notice that the field "Forecast" is empty.-Cause-You can't find the data because financial forecasting has not yet been scoped.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the view Implementation Projects.-Go to the  "Questions" step.-Select the section under Financial and Management Accounting.-Select the section Management Accounting.-Select the section Financial Planning you will see that the question for financial forecast is not in scope.-Resolution-Scope the question "Do you want to use financial forecast for procurement?".-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and select Edit Project Scope.-Select Next to the step of Questions.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting->Management Accounting->Financial Planning.-Check the flag of question "Do you want to use financial forecast for procurement?".-Save your changes.-Keywords-Financial Forecast

Title: Due Category of Tax in NewCharge/Credit of Supplier Is Receivable
Content: Symptom-Due Catetory of tax in new Charge or Credit of supplier is Receivable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payable work center and view Supplier Account.-Select Supplier Account XYZ(XYZ Refers to supplier account) and select View.-Select New Charge/Credit.-Input G/L account, amount and all required input parameters.-Select a tax code. In Tax Totals, you can see the Due Category is 2 - Receivable. However, this is an payable scenario, so you think it should be Payables.-Cause-The 'Due Category' under 'Tax Totals' is from the tax code classification. The Due category 2-Receivable means that you can deduct the tax (get the tax from the tax authority). This is correct this way.-This does not change even for Supplier charge or for credit.-Resolution-Once you post these documents, you see the difference in the journal entries.-For supplier credit > The input tax amount is posted to debit (A/P on Credit, Income /expense on Debit)-For supplier charge > The input tax amount is posted to credit. (A/P on Debit, Income /expense on Credit)-Keywords-Due Catetory, Tax Total, 税额总计, 到期类别

Title: Unable to see the Data Export Logs in Read Access Logging View in Data Protection and Privacy Work Center
Content: Symptom-You have scoped the required question to switch on the Read Access Logging for personal sensitive data in the project scope in Business Configuration work center. Your requirement is to understand if any Business User exported the data like Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Leads, etc. from the OWL (Object Work List) of respective workcenter views into Microsoft Excel. You are unable to see any logs in Read Access Logging for any of the mass data exports performed by the Business Users in your system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-To export data:-Go to XYZ work center (where XYZ represents the work center example Customers, Sales, Service etc.)-Go to the respective view (example Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Leads etc.)-Show all the records in the OWL (Object Work List)-Select the gear icon and choose Export to Microsoft Excel-Choose any language in the dialog box-Download the Microsoft Excel-To check if logs are generated for the export:-Go to Data Protection and Privacy work center-Go to Read Access Logging view-Go to Log Display-No logs are available-Cause-The data exported into the Microsoft Excel is not the personal sensitive data. Therefore, the log is not generated.-Resolution-The Read Access Logging only logs the access of personal sensitive data. It only tracks if person related and protection relevant data (for example the tax number) was accessed. There is a background job to periodically transfer the data into the log format. Hence, export log will be generated only for the export of personal sensitive data.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Data Protection and Privacy, Log Display, Read Access Logging, Personal Sensitive Data

Title: How to Assign Sales Kit and Products View in Product and Service Portfolio Work Center
Content: Symptom-New Product and New Kit subviews under Product and Service Portfolio WorkCenter cannot be found despite the required settings being maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Products and Service Portfolio Work center.-Go to View: Common Tasks.-The subviews New Product and New Kit are not available to create a product or a kit.-Cause-The scoping element "Materials" under the General Business Data has not been scoped in the implementation project under the Business Configuration Work Center.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation Project.-Click on Edit Project Scope.-In Guided Activity, navigate to the step Scoping.-Under Scoping Elements, expand the element General Business Data.-Expand the element Products.-Mark the checkbox for Materials.-Complete the guided activity and finish the process.-The Products View and the subviews New Product and New Kit will be available in the system.-NOTE: In case of a change project, it will be required to finish the merge process for the Views and subviews to be available in the tenant.-Keywords-Sales Kit, Products View, Products and Service Portfolio, Materials, General Business Data

Title: Error During Changing the G/L Account Type
Content: Symptom-The G/L Account Type cannot be changed due to below error messages:-'Value XYZ in setting ABC must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts by Account Type and Posting'-'Error for Account XYZ in Chart of Accounts DEF and acct det. profile GHI:'-'Account type PQR of acct XYZ does not match usage in account determination.'-'Save failed'-XYZ represents the G/L Account ID;-ABC represents the Account Determination;-DEF represents the Chart of Accounts;-GHI represents the Account Determination Profile;-PQR represents the G/L Account Type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select a G/L Account in question and go to the view G/L Account Type and change the required G/L Account Type.-Click Save button and below error occurs:-'Value XYZ in setting ABC must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts by Account Type and Posting'-'Error for Account XYZ in Chart of Accounts DEF and acct det. profile DEF:'-'Account type PQR of acct XYZ does not match usage in account determination.'-'Save failed'-Cause-The error is due to the respective G/L account being used in account determination ABC and hence postings hitting this account cannot be prohibited before removing the account from account determination.-Resolution-First it's needed to find out where this G/L account is used in account determination, by using the Where-Used List functionality. It must be removed or replaced by another G/L account in account determination before the G/L account type can be changed:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select a G/L Account in question and click Where-Used List button.-Expand Account Determination and take note of the path.-Then this G/L account must be removed from the account determination.-Steps to follow:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Open the respective subledger under Account Determination section (for example, Fixed Assets).-Navigate to the respective tab (for example, Others) and delete the assignment of the G/L Account with the Account Determination Group.-Once the changes are saved, it should be possible to change the G/L Account Type.-See Also-Help Documents:-Display and Edit Chart of Accounts-Account Type-KBA 2316367 - G/L Account Posting Block Cannot Be Changed Due to Error: 'Value XXX in setting YYY must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts by Account Type'-Keywords-Posting Block, Account Determination, G/L Account.

Title: VAT Return Release Errors: 'Delete tax return PQR and reschedule tax return run XYZ' and 'Payment amount not equal to total of tax items to be cleared'
Content: Symptom-Errors messages are thrown upon Release action for a Tax Return:-'Delete tax return PQR and reschedule tax return run XYZ' (PQR and XYZ stands for Tax Return and Tax Return Run IDs)-'Payment amount not equal to total of tax items to be cleared'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view of the respective tax return type, for example: VAT Returns.-Select the respective Tax Return and click Release.-Errors are displayed.-Cause-When the Tax Return has status In Preparation, if some additional tax relevant documents are posted which are valid for the reporting period, the errors will be raised since the Applicable Tax Amount and Total Tax Amount do not match.-Resolution-Open the report Open VAT / Sales Tax Items, fill the selection and execute it: the Applicable Tax Amount calculated in this report and the Total Tax Amount shown for tax return PQR do not match.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view of the respective tax return type, for example, VAT Returns.-Select the Tax Return PQR and click Delete.-Navigate back to VAT Return Run XYZ and reschedule the run.-Now the total Total Tax Amount shown in the new VAT Return and the Applicable Tax Amount shown in the Open VAT / Sales Tax Items report match.-In case the errors still occur and tax-effective documents for the relevant time-frame in both reports Reported VAT / Sales Tax Items AND Open VAT / Sales Tax Items are found, please report a case to SAP Support.-Keywords-tax return; tax return run; payment amount

Title: Period Closed for Operational Postings When Releasing VAT Return
Content: Symptom-When trying to release a new VAT Return a period lock error is raised, even though the period in the reporting company is open.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work center.-Go to the VAT Return View.-Highlight the relevant Tax Return.-Click Release.-The error messages are shown as follows:-'Release of tax return <ID> failed'-'Period <accounting period> in fiscal year <year> closed for closing step Operational postings'-Cause-The period for one of the companies mentioned under the Company Result tab is blocked, hence the error message is raised.-Resolution-The related companies in the VAT return need to be checked and the period needs to be determined as to which one it is closed.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return view.-Open the relevant return.-Click View All.-Go to the Companies Results tab.-Make sure that the concerned period is open in all the related companies of this tab. After that, the period lock error is not raised.-Keywords-VAT Return, Operational Postings, Tax Management, Period Lock

Title: Error: Alternate Posting Date for Business Transaction for Accounting of Goods and Activity Confirmation XX, version Y must be After Proposed Posting Date
Content: Symptom-When trying to Reverse and Repost a Goods and Activity Confirmation XX to another period, the following errors are raised:-"Save failed."-"Alternate Posting Date for Business Transaction for Accounting of Goods and Activity Confirmation XX, version Y must be After Proposed Posting Date."-(XX represents Goods and Activity Confirmation ID, Y represents the version ID of the document).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger - Source Documents-Search for Goods and Activity Confirmation XX and select it.-Click on Actions and View Business Transaction.-Click on Reverse and Report to another Period.-Errors are raised.-Cause-The reason of that is due to the fact that in order to change the date, a new document flow will create a new outbound delivery that will have as a creation date the current date. And as the delivery cannot be set in the past, it will block the intent on planning it on the date to be changed.-Resolution-The posting date of the Goods and Activity Confirmation cannot be changed once the posting is done. This is the standard system behavior for this scenario.-Keywords-Goods and Activity Confirmation, Proposed Posting Date, Alternate Posting Date,

Title: Cancelled Purchase Order Went for Approval
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- INTERNAL USE ONLY-Cancelled Purchase order went for approval and approver is unable to take any action.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It started happening after 1802 upgrade.-When the Purchase Order is sent for approval, an approval task will be created. Later the Purchase order will be cancelled before the approval is completed, and the status of the Purchase order will change to Cancelled while the Approval task still remains open, which cannot be actioned by the assigned approver.-This open approval task needs to be completed from backend, as it cannot be actioned from front end.-Resolution-The software correction has been done in all systems by 9.4.2018  through Hot Fix : 76551.-Our expectation: Documents cancelled on or after 9.4.2018 not to be sent for approval at all.-Action required:  For all such Purchase orders (ensure all line items of Purchase order are cancelled) then-Log in to back end follow below steps:-Go to back end transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL-Enter Node ID taken from SESFTS transaction and BO name :/SRMAP/LPURX_PO-Execute-Select the task which is in status in progress or new-Click on Complete button or click on flag symbol-See Also-Refer the KBA for the detailed steps :-3475402 - How to complete approval tasks for Purchase Order and Supplier Invoice from Backend?-Keywords-Unable to approve,  cancelled purchase order going for approval,  cannot approve ,   cannot approve cancelled purchase order, why did cancelled purchase order go for approval

Title: Error Message: Service call failed; report an case, While Migrating Open Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-When migrating Open Sales Order, system throws below error message:-Service call failed; report an case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find the Migration of Open Sales Orders activity.-Select Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool.-Execute Migration Step by Step.-Cause-The cause for the behavior might be:-The Products assigned in the Sales Order is not activated for Sales.-The Accounts assigned in the Sales Order doesn't exist in the system.-The Accounts assigned in the Sales Order is in status Blocked.-The Accounts assigned in the Sales Order is Active but there is no Address maintained in the Communication tab of the Account.-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1: -For any Sales Order if you are assigning an Account then the Account should be Active. So, in order to complete the migration of above Sales Orders (Status: Blocked), the status should be Active.-Resolution for cause 2: -For any Sales Order if you are assigning an Account then the Account should be Active and also the Account should have a valid Address. Maintain the address for the Account (tab Communication; sub tab Addresses)-Resolution for cause 3: -For any Sales Order if you are assigning a Product then the Product should have the Sales enabled.-Resolution for cause 4: -Maintain an Address in the Communication tab of the Account.-Keywords-Migration, Unable, Sales, ByD

Title: Error Message 'You are not authorized to execute report XYZ' When Executing The Broadcast
Content: Symptom-You are facing the error message 'You are not authorized to execute report XYZ' when you are trying to run a broadcast, even if it has been scheduled to run automatically or manually. And the e-mails are not being sent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center and Broadcasts view-Show All and Find Daily XT Issues Report broadcast-click on Start Now button-See the error message: You are not authorized to execute report XYZ.-Cause-When you send a report via broadcast, the system performs an authorization check, so it checks if the report and the user are assigned to the same work center. The issue can occur in the following cases:-There is no Work Center assigned to the report XYZ, it means that no business user has access to it.-The report is assigned, but the recipient (if the broadcast is user specific) or the broadcast creator (if the broadcast is not user specific) have no access to the report.-Resolution-Go to Business Analytics work center and Design Reports view-Show All and Find the report XYZ-Click on Assign button-Check the checkbox for the work centers that you want to have assigned to this report.-If your broadcast is user specific, ensure that the recipients are also assigned to at least one of the selected work center views to which report is assigned.-If your broadcast is not user specific, ensure that the creator of the broadcast is assigned to at least one of the selected work center views to -Keywords-Broadcast, You are not authorized to execute report, manually, automatic, error creating document-report unassigned,broadcast not sent,broadcast not assigned,broadcast unassigned

Title: Extension Fields for Contacts are Not Available in Migration Template
Content: Symptom-Extension fields were added to business partner contacts. However, when downloading the migration template for suppliers, the extension fields are not present on the Contacts sheet as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview.-Click on the Activity List tab.-In Show field, select All Activities.-Search and open the Migration of Suppliers activity.-Select Migrate Suppliers using the Migration Tool.-Choose View All.-Download and open Migration Template.-Check the Contacts sheet.-No columns for the existing extension fields exist.-Cause-The extension fields for Contacts are not reflected in the template for Migration of Suppliers.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-To migrate Supplier Contacts that include customer extension fields, please follow these two steps:-Migrate Contacts: Use the "Migration of Business Partners" template, where you can include the extension fields.-Migrate Suppliers: After the contacts have been migrated, use the "Migration of Suppliers" template, making sure to enter the IDs of the previously created contacts in the Contacts sheet.-Keywords-Missing, KUT, Display, Migration

Title: The Following Number Range Error Message is Triggered 'Interval with start number XXX and end number YYY must not overlap'
Content: Symptom-When maintaining number range intervals in one of your BC Views, you get the error message Interval with start number XXX and end number YYY must not overlap, in which XXX and YYY stand for the begin and end number of one of your maintained intervals.-Cause-Intervals are considered overlapping if they are part of the same number range object and are overlapping in nature. As no duplicate numbers should exist for the same number range object, overlapping interval definitions are not allowed and will lead to the overlap error message.-The following examples give you an insight into how this overlap check works.  Note that for each number range type, a number length is defined. In the following examples a length of 4 is assumed.-  Example 1:  -Interval1:   1000  – 2000-Interval2:   1500  – 2700-For these two intervals, an overlap exists for the numbers between 1500 and 2000.-Result: interval overlap, hence the overlap error message.-  Example 2:-Interval1:  1000 – 1999-Interval2:  2000 – ZZZZ-As the second interval contains alphanumeric characters (“Z”), a lexicographic check will be performed.-Result:  the intervals do not overlap.-  Example 3:-Interval1   1      – 999-Interval2   1000 – 9999-In case the interval boundaries do not use the complete length of characters and only contain numeric characters, the string will be filled up accordingly till the complete defined length is used.-In this example, the representation of the intervals internally looks as follows:-Interval1 0001 – 0999-Interval2 1000 – 9999-Result: the intervals do not overlap.-  Example 4:-Interval1   1-     – Z99-Interval2   1000 – 9999-Note that this example is very similar to example 3, but ID with Non-numeric characters will get trailing spaces up to the maximum length as defined by the number range type, which leads to the following internal representation of the intervals as follows:-Interval1   1-<space><space> – Z99<space>-Interval2   1000 – 9999-As the first interval contains alphanumeric characters (“-” and “Z”), a lexicographic check will be performed from left to right, with the result that the boundary 1000 of Interval2 lies within Interval1, and thus meaning an overlap!-Result: interval overlap, hence the overlap error message.-Resolution-In case you get this overlap error message, have a look at your defined intervals and adapt your begin / end numbers to resolve this overlap.-In the very rare case, that you get this error message when trying to access your Business Configuration and your implementation project is shown as inconsistent and thus not editable anymore by you as the user, please create an case and get in contact with the Support to resolve this error.-See Also-See also case documents-1468023 on the overlap of number ranges for employees and service agents-1466567 on how to define an Employee ID using alphanumeric characters

Title: Invoice Request Inconsistent Due To Error: "Date for maximum discount must be before other payment dates"
Content: Symptom-When checking a inconsistent Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ represents the invoice request ID) the following error message is shown:-"Date for maximum discount must be before other payment dates".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select Invoice Request XYZ.-You can see that the status is inconsistent.-Click the Check button.-The following error message appears: "Date for maximum discount must be before other payment dates".-Cause-The reference document is inconsistent because not all data has been maintained in the Payment Term in the Business Configuration.--The Net Due Date is missing for the Payment Term ZZZ hence the successor documents are inconsistent (ZZZ represents the number of the payment term).-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and press the Open Activity List button.-Open the activity Accounts.-Select the Maintain Payment Terms hyperlink. -Select the Payment Term ID ZZZ.-In the Net Price Due section, maintain the respective value for the Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date.-Select the Save button. -Once the value has been maintained, the reference document requires to be corrected as follows:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select the inconsistent invoice request XYZ and press the Check button.-Press the Redetermine All button.-The error message does not occur anymore, the outbound delivery can be invoiced.-See Also-KBA: 2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-Keywords-date for maximum discount must be before other payment dates, invoice, inconsistent, invoice request

Title: How to Add an Employee and His/Her Responsibilities for an Account
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to add an Employee name and his/her Responsibility for an Account in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-In the field Show, select All Accounts from the drop down list.-Search for an Account ID using Find option.-Select the Account ID hyperlink, a new window opens.-In the General tab, under section Responsibilities.-Here you would observe that required Employee Name and his/her Responsibilities are not visible.-Cause-Since you have not maintained the required Employee Name and his/her Responsibilities for an Account in the system, they are not visible on the Account Overview screen.-Resolution-Follow below steps to view the Employee details and the relevant Responsibilities on an account overview screen:-Go to the Account Management Work Center.-Go to the Accounts view.-In the field Show, select All Accounts from the drop down list and search for the particular Account ID.-Select the Account ID and go to the option Contacts linked under the Edit button.-In the new opened screen, go to the Contacts sub tab and add New Contact using Add Row button and then do the Assignment for the contact using Assign Contact button.-Go to the Relationships and Responsibilities subtab.-Under Responsibilities subtab, add an employee using Add Row button and assign the Party Role and Responsibility as per your requirement and then select the Save button.-Then go to the Accounts main screen and directly open the relevant Customer Account Hyperlink, under section Responsibilities you can see all the added details of an employee on the particular Corporate Account Overview screen.-Keywords-How To, Add, Employee, Responsability, Responsabilities, Account, Relationship, Relationships, Account Management, General.

Title: Broadcast Processing Did Not Finish After 60 Minutes
Content: Symptom-You have set up a number of broadcasts, the majority of which are running every day. Many of them fail with the message-"Broadcast processing did not finish after 60 minutes".-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Broadcasts.-Search for the respective broadcast and click on the Last Broadcast Run tab.-Here you will see the message mentioned above.-This happens for many broadcasts in your system.-Cause-When you schedule a broadcast, a background job picks up all broadcasts that are scheduled for a certain time. This job places all broadcasts in a queue, to be executed one after the other. However the background job times out after 60 minutes, since this is the time of the potential next job. All broadcasts that were not executed within this hour fail with this message.-The reason why some broadcasts are not executed within one hour is a high number of scheduled broadcasts, set up for the same time.-In some cases, the message may come up for a single or a few broadcasts, when for example the broadcasted report is custom and not created according to best practices for data sources and reports. If the running time of a report is extremely long, it may not be finished within the hour.-Please note that the error is not specific to custom reports with too much data, standard reports with too much data can also trigger this error message.-Resolution-Please divide the broadcasts into several batches and schedule them in a way that spreads the execution over several hours.-Additionally please ensure that you follow the guidelines for creating custom data sources and reports as per the KBA 2366796, and use appropriate report selections to reduce the data volume.-See Also-2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling and Handling Data Sources and Reports - Performance-Keywords-broadcast; 60 minutes; Broadcast processing did not finish after 60 minutes; execution; number of broadcasts; multiple broadcasts, batch, same time-broadcast time out

Title: Materials are Created With the IDs Which are Out of the Range Maintained in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a particular Number Range for the Materials but you are able to create Materials with ID which is more than the length maintained in the Business Configuration.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Highlight the Implementation Project or Change Project and select Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine Tune phase.-Search and open fine tuning activity Number Range for Materials.-Here, for example: you have maintained Begin: M00000001; End: M99999999.-But while creating a Material, you can able to create material with IDs like M000000011, M00000001123, M00000001732727.-Resolution-The below explanation is based on the above example number range.-An alphanumeric interval has been defined with the begin number as M00000001 and end number as M99999999.-For alphanumeric intervals, the check is a lexicographic check, meaning that the id is checked character by character from left to right. And in case one number has more characters than the other number, the missing characters will be charged by following rules:-If the number is not an alphanumeric number, it will get leading zeros up to the maximum length.-If the number is an alphanumeric number, it will get trailing spaces up to the maximum length.-So when checking whether ID M000000010 lies within interval M00000001 - M99999999, this looks as follows--M00000001<space>-M000000010-M99999999<space>--Check of M000000010 against the boundary M00000001: lexicographic check on M00000001<space> against M00000001. When comparing them character by character from left to right, these "numbers" are identical till geting to the last character.-At the end, compare the character <space> against character "1", and according to the ascii table the character <space> has a smaller value than the character "1" (see also http://www.asciitable.com/). Hence M00000001 is smaller than M00000001.--Check of M000000010 against boundary M99999999<space> shows that M000000010 is smaller than the end boundary.--Result of the lexicographic check: M00000001 < M000000010 < M99999999--Hence ID M000000010 lies within the defined interval and is a valid ID!--So in case of intervals which are not purely numeric, please take note of these peculiarities of the lexicographic check!--Due to the lexicographic check for this alphanumeric interval entering a product id with more characters than the you wants is possible, as long as the check determines that the ID is still within the defined range.--Regarding the number of characters used within his ID, the lexicographic check checks that the ID does not exceed the total length defined for this number range type. So, IDs for products (i.e. materials, entitlements, service and individual material) cannot be larger than 40 characters.--So the concept behind this is different to what has been identified as a issue.--In case, if you want to have not more than 10 characters used as ID for his products, we would currently recommend that the user has to manually check at your end.-Keywords- Number Range, Alphanumeric Interval

Title: Process Type in the Purchase Order is Incorrect
Content: Symptom-When creating a purchase order for product A, entering product A's ID, system defaults the process type as Non-Stock. But process type To-Stock is expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Select the relevant Material A.-Go to the Logistics tab.-You can see that one or few logistic areas are In Preparation status.-  Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Tasks section.-Select New Purchase Order.-Enter the Material A.-System defaults the Process Type to Non-Stock.-Cause-Not all the proposed logistics area are activated and there are a few logistics area which are left as In Preparation.-Logic: A Material is automatically assigned to the Process Type Non-Stock if one or several Logistics areas are not activated in the Product Data. If all the Logistics areas are activated , the Process Type for the material would automatically be filled as To-Stock.-Resolution-Activate all the Logistics units/areas of the material and the corresponding Process Type in the purchase orders will be selected as To-Stock.-Keywords-Process Type, Purchase Order, Non-Stock, To-Stock

Title: Account Determination is Missing for Position Type Material Consumption
Content: Symptom-After receiving the ordered consumables, you record the delivery in the system using a goods and services receipt document. But when you try to post the goods and services receipt document to accounting, the system gives the following error message: 'Account determination is missing for position type Material Consumption'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Closing-Relevant Tasks subview.-You can find there is a task that has the subject Account determination is missing for position type Material Consumption.-Select the task and you can see the following description: Edit your account determination in chart of accounts XYZ (XYZ represents the chart of account) Chart of Accounts and account determination profile <ZIAS> in configuration for column path Inventories -> Gains and Losses-> Material Consumption and position type Material Consumption.-Meanwhile, go to the Source Documents subview.-Select the not posted goods and services receipt document in question.-Choose View Business Transaction, you can see the same error message: 'Account determination is missing for position type Material Consumption'.-Cause-When you try to post the goods receipt for the ordered consumables to accounting, the posting record for this business transaction would be debiting Material Costs and crediting Unbilled Payables. Posting to which G/L account for material cost is controlled by means of account determination group that allows you to specify any number of G/L accounts for material costs and to use them for different materials. From the product, the system determines the Account Determination Group for Materials, if you have only specified a product category but not the product, the system uses the product category to determine the account determination group.-As you only specify product category in the purchase order, the system first determines the account determination group by the product category, and then tries to find the assigned Material Consumption G/L account, but in fact there is no G/L account maintained, so the system gives the error message: 'Account Determination is Missing for Position Type Material Consumption'.-Resolution-To successfully post the goods and services receipt document to accounting, first of all, you have to identify the Account Determination Group for Materials for the specified product category:-In the Goods and Services Receipts work center, choose the Receipts and Returns view. -Open the not posted goods and services receipt document.-Check the Product Category ID of the ordered material.-Go to the Product Data work center and choose the Product Categories view.-You can see the Product Category of the ordered material is ABC (ABC represents the Product Category ID).-Go to the Business Configuration work center and choose the Activity List view.-Select the All Activities subview.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the "Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination" activity.-Choose Edit Account Determination Group.-Choose Inventory, and you can see the Groups for Materials ID for Product Category ABC, which is DEF (DEF represents the Group ID).-Then you need to maintain a Material Consumption G/L account for the account determination group DEF:-Still in the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity, choose Inventories under the Account Determination section. -In the Gains and Losses tab, choose Add.-In the Account Determination Group for Materials field, enter DEF.-In the Material Consumption field, enter the G/L account for material cost posting.-Finally, repost the not posted goods and services receipt document:-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Select the not posted goods and services receipt document in question.-Choose View Business Transaction, and choose Post.-The not posted goods and services receipt document should be posted successfully.-Keywords-Account Determination, Missing, position type, Material Consumption, G/L account

Title: Restricted Limit on Bank Account Number
Content: Symptom-What is Restricted Limit in the Bank Account Number Field-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration Work Center.-Choose Employees View.-Select option show active employees of countries (Austria, Australia, Germany, Netherlands and Spain).-Now choose one of the active employees and click the edit button.-Choose the Personal data tab-Find the Payment information sub tab.-Select the payment method option.-Add a row in the bank accounts and once we choose the bank-We get an error message 'Length of Bank Account must not exceed 10 characters'.-Cause-For countries Austria, Australia, Germany, Netherlands and Spain, When we enter more than 10 characters in the Bank account number field, we get an error message 'Length of Bank Account must not exceed 10 characters'. This is due to the legal requirement in these countries.-Resolution-The Restricted limit of the Bank account number field is 35 characters with an exception of countries Austria, Australia, Germany, Netherlands and Spain(maximum 10 characters only) due to legal the requirements in these countries.-Keywords-Length of Bank Account,

Title: Unexpected Error Occurs When Specific User Creates Shopping Cart
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Unexpected Dump error occurs when user ABC creates shopping cart.-Even the user has already been assigned with the access authorization to shopping cart, user ABC cannot create shopping cart by himself.-Dump details are:-   1 Triggering application component: AP-RC-ADR-   2 CX_ADDR_FATAL_EXCEPTION, Program:SAPMHTTP, Include:, Position:0-   3 Info: An exception occurred- 43 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003    66-    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR- 42 METHOD CL_SP_USED_ADDRESS_LOCAL=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACCESS~RETRIEVE_BY_ASSOCIATION- 37 METHOD       CL_SP_USED_ADDRESS_BUFFER=====CP    CL_SP_USED_ADDRESS_BUFFER=====CM007     3-    CL_SP_USED_ADDRESS_BUFFER=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACCESS~RETRIEVE_BY_ASSOCIATION- 36 METHOD       CL_RC_SLB_ACCESS==============CP    CL_RC_SLB_ACCESS==============CM006   212-
