CL_SP_USED_ADDRESS=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACCESS~RETRIEVE_BY_ASSOCIATION- 34 METHOD       CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CP    CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CM00H   190-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to user ABC’s account.-Go to Home work center, Self Service Overview subview.-Navigate to Go Shopping.-In the first step Select Products, system raise an unexpected error:-Unexpected error during backend processing.-An error occurred. Try resuming your issues. If you still face issues, open an incident.-Cause-When user creates a shopping cart for the first time, system picks address from master data and it will be stored in the table 'SPERS_OBJ' in case user updates the address. Then next time when the same user creates shopping cart it will be picked from table 'SPERS_OBJ' but not from 'Master' table.-However, if the employee master data gets updated from employee central integration, the address snapshot UUID stored in table 'SPERS_OBJ' will no longer be valid, as that UUID will be updated with new node ID for the user in 'Master' table. Hence system dumps when the user creates shopping cart.-Resolution-Please check the dump trace and ask SRM experts to process the issue if it matches current case.-For SRM experts, you need to delete the entry in table 'SPERS_OBJ' for user ABC. From next time when the user creates shopping cart, address will be fetched from Master table.-Following are steps to be followed to delete the entry from table 'SPERS_OBJ' from backend:-Go to SE16 t-code.-Give table name 'SPERS_OBJ'.-Click 'Table Contents(F7)'.-Give user technical ID in the field 'OBJECT_ID'. -Execute(F8).-The entry for the user will be listed, select the entry that  contains 'ADDR' under column "PERS_KEY" and click Display(F7).-Enter /h in the t-code area, Press ENTER button so that debugging will be switched on.-Again press ENTER button, that will trigger the debug.-In debugging screen, double click on C_CODE,-Under Variables tab, click on edit symbol and change the value from 'SHOW' to 'DELE', press Enter. -Click Cancel (F12).-Click on the new button Delete Entry in the tool bar.-Then go back (F3).-Click Refresh.-The entry for the user should not be available as you deleted it.-The user will be able to create shopping cart after you delete the entry from backend.-Keywords-Shopping cart dump, 500 internal server error, unexpected error

Title: Automatic Determination of Sales Unit is not as Expected in the Sales Order Even After Maintaining the Work Distribution Rule
Content: Symptom-You have created a Work Distribution Rule for Sales Unit for Sales to enable the automatic determination of the sales unit in the sales order, however, a new sales order is still not determining the sales unit automatically determines a different Sales Unit than expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Add the Account in the sales order.-You find that the Sales Unit is not picked automatically in the sales order or a different Sales Unit than expected is determined.-Follow the steps below to check if the Work Distribution Rule (Sales Unit for Sales) is maintained:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Go to the Organizational Work Distribution subview.-Select Sales Unit for Sales.-Select the Edit button.-You find that the required rule is already maintained. -Cause-In the Work Distribution rule (i. e. Sales Unit for Sales) created, you have added the condition of company,-according to rule if the seller company in the sales order is XYZ then pick the sales unit ABC (XYZ represents the ID of seller company and ABC represents the ID of the sales unit).--If you try to create the sales order and add the Seller company manually in the Involved Party tab then the sales unit ABC will be picked automatically (as the rule suggest if company = XYZ, then pick sales unit = ABC).--Now you may have a question that why Seller company is not getting picked in the sales order first, follow the below steps to understand this point:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Involved Parties for Sales Orders activity.-Open the activity and select Seller -> Select Maintain Determination button.-You can see the determination selected is based on Company of Sales Unit.-Due to the above configuration whenever you try to create the sales order, system will only pick the Seller if the Sales Unit is added.-But due to the rule maintained in the Work Distribution (Sales Unit for Sales), the Sales Unit will only be picked in the order if Company (Seller) is available in the sales order.-Resolution-To clear this deadlock situation, you can remove the condition for Company from the Work Distribution rule (Sales Unit for Sales) and maintain a different condition that applies for your scenario:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Go to the Organizational Work Distribution subview.-Select the Sales Unit for Sales.-Select the Edit button.-Remove the company condition from Company subtab.-Save your changes.-Or alternatively ensure that the company is determined first and not based on the Sales Unit in the Involved Parties for Sales Orders activity by activating step Step 5 -> Company of Logged on User for the Seller Party.-With the above changes, now if you create a sales order, the sales unit will be determined as expected.-See Also-See also the following Blog for more details: Party Role Determination in a Sales Document -Keywords-Seller; Company; Sales Unit; Work Distribution Rule; wrong; determined; incorrect

Title: Maximum Number of Line Items Recommended in a Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-What is the recommended maximum number of line items that can be included in a manual Journal Entry Voucher?-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select New Journal Entry Voucher under Common Tasks view.-To add line items in a manual journal entry voucher, select Add Row.-Resolution-Based on performance tests, the recommended maximum number of line items for a Manual Journal Entry Voucher is 3,500 rows.-For detailed information on all ByDesign documents, please visit the following link:-https://partneredge.sap.com/en/library/assets/products/ent_mng/byd/sell/tools_assets/pp_form_byd_epq.html-Download the SAP Business ByDesign Sizing Assessment Tool and input the number of line items for the document in the provided Excel spreadsheet. The traffic button will adjust accordingly, with green indicating that it’s acceptable and red indicating that it’s not recommended.-For further details regarding these limitations, please contact your Customer Engagement Executive or Account Executive.-See Also-2956449 - Limitation on Number of Items in ByDesign Documents-Keywords-Maximum, Line items, Manual Journal Entry Voucher, Recommended, Limit.

Title: Error Message: DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; profit center XYZ must be below a segment. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit.
Content: Symptom-When trying to activate the Organizational Structure, the system throws the below error message:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; profit center XYZ must be below a segment. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit. (Where XYZ refers to the Org Unit Name).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All.-Cause-The cause for the above error message is that the Org Unit XYZ is marked as Profit Center from DD.MM.YYYY which is not allowed because there is an Org unit below which is a Segment.-Resolution-A Profit Center should be always below the Segment.-It is either for the Org Unit XYZ to be marked as Segment from DD.MM.YYYY or for the Profit Center option to be unchecked for Org Unit XYZ from DD.MM.YYYY.-Keywords-Segment, Org Unit, Profit center, common tasks, Org Structures

Title: Error Message "Asset ABC Valuation View X : Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount" While Migrating Accounting Transaction Data
Content: Symptom-When migrating Leads, system throws below error message:-"Asset ABC Valuation View X: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount"-(ABC stands for the Fixed Asset ID, X for the Valuation View ID)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File.-Cause-The acquisition values across different valuation views are different.-Resolution-The postings were done for just one valuation view and not for other valuation views. It is needed to maintain valuation for all of them.-Keywords-leads, migration, fixed assets

Title: Exception Thrown while clicking on Preview for an Outgoing Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-System dumps when Advice for an outgoing bank transfer XYZ(represents Outgoing Bank Transfer Id) is previewed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Click Payment Monitor view.-Search for the Outgoing Bank Transfer XYZ which is in Ready for Transfer status.-Select it and click Preview and select Advice.-After sometime system dumps(Runtime error).-Cause-The dump occurs because Workplace Contact Data is not maintained for the involved Business Partner Contact.-Resolution-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Click Payment Monitor view.-Search for the Outgoing Bank Transfer XYZ which is in Ready for Transfer status.-Copy the Business Partner Name.-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for the copied Business Partner Name.-Click Edit and go to Employment tab.-Maintain the details under Workplace Contact Data.-Keywords-Payment Advice, Preview, Dump, Exception

Title: There is no Option to set a Default Requested Date for the New Sales Quotes In the Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-In the Business Configuration, there is no option to set a default Requested Date for the New Sales Quotes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and click on the button Open Activity List.-In the Activity List screen, go to the Fine-Tune tab.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Activities and in the Find field search with Date Profiles.-In the Date Profile screen under the Sales Quote section, their is an option to set a default Quote Validity = Creation Date + Number of days. There is no option to set a default Requested Date.-Cause-Based on the Number of Days you set in the Date Profile of Business Configuration, it fetches the Valid To date in the New Sales Quote. The system will consider this default Valid To date also as New Sales Quote's Requested date, which you can manually change.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior.-Keywords-sales quote, requested date, field, date profiles, determination, days, new sales quote

Title: Why is the "Complete Delivery" Option Selected by Default When Creating a New Account and Adding a Sales Organization?
Content: Symptom-When creating a new account and adding a sales organization, the "Complete Delivery" checkbox is enabled by default.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select New Corporate Account under Common Task.-Fill the mandatory fields and go to Sales Data tab.-In Sales Data section, select Add Row button.-Select a Sales Organization and appropriate Distribution Channel.-Cause-The default setting for "Complete Delivery" is enabled because it is expected to be the most common scenario.-Resolution-This default setting cannot be changed.-Keywords-Delivery option, Sales, Tick box

Title: Error When Activating Process Extension Scenario: Process Extension Scenario already shipped. No changes allowed
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the extension scenario in patch Solution, while saving you get the error: Process Extension Scenario /YPQR_MAIN/SRC/Common/ExtensionScenario/XYZ.xs already shipped. No changes allowed.-Where YPQR is the patch namespace and XYZ is the process extension scenario file name.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Solution YPQR-Select the relevant .XS file-Select the Process view from the Scenario view-Click on activate, error appears.-Cause-This message generally comes when you try to change the extension scenario in patch solution that has been assembled in a previous version of the Solution. You are not allowed to do the changes because existing data will become inconsistent if you modify an existing extension scenario.-Resolution-You can create an additonal Process Extension Scenario and add it to the element annotation:-[Scenario(<scenario_name1>,<scenario_name2>)] element XXXX : data_type;-Keywords-Process Extension Scenario not able to extend, cannot change PES file, PES in patch, XS-cannot activate pes,proess extension scenario error

Title: Missing Customer invoices in Tax Return - South Korea
Content: Symptom-One or several Customer invoices are not being picked up when creating a Tax Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select VAT Returns View.-Search and open the relevant ID XX(XX represents the ID of the VAT Return).-Click View All-Go to Tax Return tab-Select the required Tax Event and click Details button-Result: Invoice AA and BB were not included in this Tax Return(AA and BB represents the ID of the invoices).-Cause-The Electronic Tax Invoice run was not made for those specific invoices.-Steps to check if the Electronic Tax Invoice was created for the specific invoice following the below steps:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select Electronic Tax Invoice Documents view-Go to the Advanced Search-Enter the Invoice ID under the option "Customer Invoice ID"-Click Go-If there is no result, it means that the Electronic Tax Invoice run was not executed for those invoices-Resolution-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select Electronic Tax Invoice Runs.-Click New and then New ETax Invoice Run.-Fill in the criteria, Save and Set To Active.-Once the run is completed, create the Tax Return again.-Result:This time the invoices will be picked up in the Tax Return.-See Also-Electronic Tax Invoice – South Korea-KBA 3419571 - Electronic Tax Invoice documents are not getting created for a Credit Memo.-Keywords-South Korea; VAT Return Invoices; Electronic Tax Invoice; missing invoice, pick, not pick

Title: Broadcast failure
Content: Symptom-You have created the Broadcast XYZ in your system and, after running it, you notice that even though the Broadcast is configured correctly as many others, it has failed in sending the Report for example to the users assigned to this Broadcast.-It only shows that the Broadcast Failed, not showing an appropriate error message or the root cause for the failure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-This Broadcast behavior might be related to the User who created the Broadcast initially, as it might fail since the user who created it doesn't have access to the workcenter view that the report is assigned to.-Resolution-In order to correct the behavior and prevent that the Broadcast fail again, you may check into the Access Rights of the user ABC who created Broadcast XYZ and see if he has access to the workcenter view that the report (Broadcasted) is assigned to.-In order to check which workcenter view the report is assigned to, you may follow the steps below:-Access your system.-Go to Business Analytics workcenter.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for the Report ZYX.-Select the Report and click on Assign button.-Check the workcenter views which the user ABC is assigned to.-In case you check into the Access Rights of user ABC and it doesn't have access to the workcenter views the Report ZYX is assigned to, the Broadcast XYZ won't work as expected.-Make sure to maintain these access rights consistent when creating Broadcasts in your system to avoid possible failures.-See Also-You may also check the details of the Blog regarding Broadcasting in Business by Design: https://blogs.sap.com/2015/12/01/using-the-broadcasting-feature-to-email-reports-in-sap-business-bydesign/-Keywords-Broadcast; Report; Analytics; Business Analytics; Broadcast Failure; Email

Title: Business Residence appearing as # in Data Source Material Valuation Data
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the Business Residence for some entries in Data Source Material Valuation Data is appearing as #.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Select Design data source.-Search for Data Source Material Valuation Data .-Click on Preview.-Run the report.-Add Business Residence in Row.-Result: For some entries, the Business Residence will show as #.- Cause-In the data source Material Valuation Data, the Business Residences which are having expired validity dates will reflect as "#". -Resolution-Standard System behavior.

Title: Release Due Deliveries Run with Error Description "Cancelled Manually or by the System"
Content: Symptom-The Release Due Deliveries Run jobs status is failed with error "Cancelled manually or by the system".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Workcenter.-Open Release Due Deliveries Runs view.-Search for Run ID XXX. (XXX represents the Run ID).-Click View Jobs button and see the scheduled jobs is Released.-Select Run jobs in down list.-Note the jobs status is failed with error: "Cancelled manually or by the system"-Cause-The User YYY who created this job has been locked in the system (YYY represents the User ID).-Resolution-Follow the below steps to unlock User YYY:-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business User view under User and Access Management tab.-In search field, search for "YYY".-Click Unlock User button.-Then the Run ID XXX will work as normal.-Keywords-User locked, Release Due Deliveries Runs, Unlock User, Cancelled manually or by the system

Title: Employee Does Not Appear in the Direct Approvers List of the Service Order Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You are creating a service order approval process with the work distribution rule Direct Approvers, however the employees name is not available for selection in the list of Direct Approvers work distribution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Select the Task Distribution view and the Approval Process sub view.-Select the Default approval process for Service Order.-Click on the Copy button.-In the Work Distribution field select Direct Approvers from the drop down list.-Click on the Edit button.-The employee ABC is not available for selection in the list for the Direct Approver (ABC represents the name of the employee).-Cause-The user has only the Unrestricted access to view CRM_SERVICEORDERPROCESSING, but not assigned to MMA_CUSTOMERSERVICE.-To make the employee available as direct approver of the service order documents, the access MMA_CUSTOMERSERVICE with Unrestricted access on Read and Write is needed. If the user does not have this work center view assigned or this work center view has only Read Access and no Write Access, the user is not displayed as one of the probable persons who can participate in the approval process as Direct Approver.-Resolution-You can assign the work center view MMA_CUSTOMERSERVICE to the employee ABC using the following steps;-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Select the user ABC.-Click on the Edit button and select the Access Rights option.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Assign the work center view MMA_CUSTOMERSERVICE to this user.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-Ensure that both Read Access and Write Access for the work center view MMA_CUSTOMERSERVICE are Unrestricted.-Save your changes.-The employee ABC can now be selected as Direct Approver in the approval process for service orders.-Keywords-service order approval process; direct approver; MMA_CUSTOMERSERVICE.

Title: Dump During Creation of Production Order from Production Request
Content: Symptom-When you try to create Production Order with Full Quantity from Production Request 999(where 999 is the Production Request ID) you will encounter a dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Production Control workcenter and Production Requests view.-2. Find and select Production Request 999  and click on Create Order - Full Quantity.-You will encounter a dump.-Cause-This error occurs when input products in the Bill of Materials and Production Proposal/Request are different.-Resolution-Ideal process to change the input product is:-1. Create new production proposal-2. Go to Supply control workcenter and production proposal view.-3. Edit production proposal.-4. Go to Products tab and Input products sub tab-5. Select the product and Delete-6. Click on Add Row to add new product -7. Save & Release.-Keywords-Production Order, Production Request, Production Proposal, Full quantity, Bill of Material, Production Control

Title: How to Create a Production Bill of Material From Product Designs With Input Products.
Content: Symptom-You would like to use the product design functionality to create a Bill of Materials (BOM) before releasing it to production. You are creating a product design under the Product Development Work Center and Product Designs view and when you go to the Detailed Structure option and click "Add Row", the components are not being pulled from the master data.-You would like to know how the functionality works.-Environment-my356189.sapbydesign.com-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Development work center-Go to the Product Designs view.-Select New and choose Product Design.-Enter relevant Details.-Under the Detailed Structure table, click Add Row.-You expect the system to pull the Input Material from the Material Master. -Resolution-On the General tab, in the Detailed Structure table, when you click "Add Row", the components are not going to be pulled from the master data. You have to enter other product designs that are components of this product design which you want to convert to PBOM.-How the process works is well documented in the below help document: -Product Designs Quick Guide-- --Keywords-Product Design, Production Bill of Material, PBOM, BOM

Title: Service Order Item is Delivery Finished Even After the Service Confirmation is Cancelled
Content: Symptom-The service order item was fully delivered in the service confirmation and the delivery status is finished.-You have cancelled the service confirmation and expect the delivery status of the reference service order line could be reverted back to In Process status, but it is still Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders - Service Order Processing work center view.-Open the service order. -Go to the Service and Spare parts tab, the item 10 is delivery=Finished.-Go to the Document Flow tab, open the follow-up service confirmation and find the confirmation is actually Cancelled. -You expect the delivery status of the service order item to be In process instead of Finished.-Cause-The service order item was complete execution performed so the delivery status is finished.-Once the complete execution is executed, it is not able to be reverted. -Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-See Also-3476839 - Complete Execution Button Reversal-Keywords-service order; delivery status; finished; not able to revert; service confirmation cancelled.

Title: Ongoing 'Tested' Status Post Go-Live of the Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Even after go live, the status of the project is remained in Tested status.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Navigate to Activity List: First Implementation-Project is in Tested Status- Cause-The Go-Live related activities (BO_A1S_CRT_GOLIVE_CHECK_SWITCH - Go Live, BO_A1S_FND_CMCPIM - Close Project) are shown deleted as per the activity history table BCTD_WSACTIVITYH.-This could be one of the reasons that the tenant did not Go-Live instead stopped at status 'Tested.-Both "Confirm Go live" and "Close project" are in a closed status because they are currently inaccessible.-Resolution-Create a Incident to AP-RC-BCT to remove the inconsistency.-Keywords-Tested status, Go live, Confirm Go live, Close project

Title: BYD2405 [PTOM] Customer Demand cannot be released - User blocks Item
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-** INTERNAL USE ONLY**-While releasing line Items in Customer Demand, the action fails with the error message: You cannot release the order to logistics execution. Order 123 item AB is locked by user XYZ.-(123 represents the Sales Order ID, AB represents the Line Item ID, XYZ represents the User ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Go to Customer Demand view. -Search for Sales Order ID: 123.-Select the Line item AB.-Choose Release.-The action failed with the error message: You cannot release the order to logistics execution. Order 123 item AB is locked by user XYZ.-(123 represents the Sales Order ID)-(AB represents the Line Item ID)-(XYZ represents the User ID)-Cause-Duplicate sessions are opened by the same user for the document.-This resulted in a process communication error and stuck message in the backend.-Sender Party: SalesOrderProcessing   -Receiver Interface Name: CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn   -Error info: Operation not possible; business document locked (Vorgang nicht möglich; Geschäftsbeleg gesperrt)-Resolution-Try restarting the stuck message. If restart fails, create an incident to AP-CR-CR.-Keywords-Customer Demand, process communication error, sales order, duplicate session, you cannot release the order to logistics execution, SalesOrderProcessing, CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn, AP-CR-CR

Title: How to Transmit the Data from SAP Business byDesign to Power BI.
Content: Symptom-To make a connection between SAP Business ByDesign to power BI, this in order to be able to obtain all the information in real time and to be able to create reports from Power BI.-For example: The Empty Logistics areas needed within a report to be required to send to Power BI from SAP Business ByDesign. --To achieve this, is there any possibility to transmit the data from SAP ByDesign to PowerBI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory-Go to the new Logistic area count sub view under the common task view.-Enter Storage Location ID in respective field.-Choose Empty Logistics Area-Select "GO" option.-system you can able to see all Empty logistics areas.-Empty Logistics areas within a report must be sent to Power BI from SAP Business ByDesign. -Resolution-To export the data to Microsoft Excel, use Odata services to obtain all the information in real time.-See Also-https://community.sap.com/t5/enterprise-resource-planning-q-a/sap-bydesign-power-bi/qaq-p/12650460-https://community.sap.com/t5/enterprise-resource-planning-blogs-by-sap/odata-for-sap-business-bydesign-analytics/ba-p/13142748-For more details, refer blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2015/03/10/odata-for-sap-business-bydesign-analytics/.-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign to Power BI, Empty Logistics Area, Data Transfer.

Title: Statutory report - Journal Italy is not printed in Italian language
Content: Symptom-Statutory report - Journal Italy is printed out in English language even when using the system in Italian Language-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system using the Italian Language-Go to General Ledger Work Center > Statutory Report view-Click Journal - Italy-Select your run and click View Printed Results-Click the document name hyperlink to open the document-The document is in English language instead of Italian language-Cause-The status of the run is not Released.--Resolution-The document is printed in the respective language after releasing the document.-Refer to the below steps to Release the run and print out the document in Italian language:-Go to General Ledger Work Center > Statutory Reports view-Click Journal - Italy-Select your run and click View-Click Next-Click Release-Click Finish-Click Print Results-It will create a new document in Italian language-Click View Printed Results-Click the document name hyperlink to open the document -See Also-KBA 3212434 - Journal - Italy: PDF File Is Missing -Statutory Reports Quick Guide-Quick Guide for Journal Reporting – Italy-Keywords-statutory, report, journal, Italy, pdf, document, Italian

Title: Payment Run Error: 'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have executed the Payment Run and it finished with the error:--Work package ID XYZ error while saving; report an incident-(XYZ represents the Work package ID) -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work Center > Payment Runs view-Select All Payment Runs-Search for the respective Run ID with error-Under Execution Details, click the Application Log ID 123 (123 means the Application Log ID)-The error is shown:-Work package ID XYZ error while saving; report an incident-Go to Results tab-The message error is shown:-Conversion rate for ABC and DEF missing on DD.MM.YYYY--ABC means the source currency-DEF means the target currency---Cause-There is no exchange rate maintained for the source currency ABC and target currency DEF on DD.MM.YYYY-Resolution-Maintain the exchange rate for source currency and target currency for the date DD.MM.YYYY-See Also-KBA 3374080 - Payment Run Error "Work package ID system error; report an incident"-KBA 3429957 - Payment Run Error: 'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.-KBA 3321628 - Payment Run Error: 'Work package ID <id> system error; report an incident' -Keywords-payment run, Work package, exchange rate, system error

Title: When Output Product Has No Inventory Cost, Can System Prevent Production Model From Being Released?
Content: Symptom-Does system support prevent production model from being released if its output product has no inventory cost?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign doesn't support prevent production model from being released if its output product has no inventory cost. However, when the production order created with this model is released, an error message will be triggered: Valuation status for product ABC at business residence DEF is not active.-Keywords-Production Mode, Inventory Cost, Valuation

Title: Total Surcharge Value Added not Appearing in the Supplier Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-You have added a Manual Surcharge Value in the purchase order. However when you create supplier invoice, system did not capture the surcharge value under Deduction and Surcharges tab of supplier invoice. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to Purchase Orders view -Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-Go to Prices sub tab and click on Add Row-Add the pricing component Manual Surcharge (Value)-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center -Go to Invoice Entry view-Select All Orders to be Invoiced-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Click on New Invoice-Total Discounts and Surcharges are not updated in the Deduction and Surcharges tab of supplier invoice-Cause-In the current release, the pricing components added in the purchase order, will not be displayed under Deduction and Surcharges tab of supplier invoice. -Resolution-The request can be taken as a new requirement and you can post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -Keywords-Manual Surcharge value not updated in supplier invoice

Title: Employee status is displayed as Not Available in Managing my Area
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use***-Team member status incorrectly displayed as "Not available" in the planning overview. -Environment-Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area Work center-Go to My Teams View-Under planning overview for Employee XYZ time shows as not available -Cause-Inconsistent start and end dates in the Availability periods of the Resource Calendar due to discrepancies in the work agreement setup.-Resolution-The above Inconsistency can be identified by following the below steps.-Disclaimer - The Dates mentioned in KBA are real time, it is used to explain the issue better. --Steps to check in the Backend-Enter the Tcode SESFTS-Go to BO - HCM_EMPLOYEE_SUPP_CO -Locate the affected employee-In the Node BO Work Agreement, the latest work agreement dates are 01.01.2024 to 31.12.9999. So initially the internal employee got hired in 01.02.2023 through success factors replication. -In the Node Bo Employee Type, the employee type shows 01.02.2023 to 31.12.9999-  In the Node B0 Resource Calendar-Availability Period  -The start and End dates are 01.01.2022 to 30.11.2022. Actual dates should be from 01.02.2023 to 31.12.9999.-Because of these records it is throwing error while adding row in Availability period for work assignment. (Error: Availability period cannot be created because a work agreement exists for 01.02.2023 – 31.12.9999.) Please see the Internal blog for more information on this.-Backend correction has to be performed, change the start and end date to 01.02.2023 to 31.12.9999 and delete the other record in Resource Calendar-->Availability period.-After changing we can see the records in Availability period for work assignment and the data will get populated in Managing my area-->My teams.-Note: Take the permission of the User and send it to SRD-HR-TLM development to make the correction.-Keywords-Managing My Area, My Teams, Resource Planning, work agreement, planning overview.

Title: Error Message: "No sales order exists for purchase order reference *"
Content: Symptom-You are using the webservice ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotifcationIn to create Inbound Delivery Notification but you are getting the error message "No sales order exists for purchase order reference 123" (123 represents the Sales Order ID) even though this purchase order does have sales order associated to it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer view.-Find the web service 'ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotifcationIn'.-Select the Service 'ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotifcationIn' and open the documentation of the Web Service.-Copy the example and adjust the relevant details to your requirement in the Request XML.-Open MDRS and consume the Request Payload.-You can see the system is responding with the following Note in the Response payload: <Note>No sales order exists for purchase order reference 123</Note>.-Navigate to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center. -Go to the Purchase Orders view. -Find and select the relevant Purchase Order.-Click Edit and View All.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see there is indeed a Sales Order associated to the Purchase Order.-  Try to create the Inbound Delivery Notification from the Front-End, and: -Go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center, and then to the Third-Party Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the relevant Purchase Order.-The system finds no records.-Cause-You are trying to confirm Goods Receipt at an externally managed Warehouse using the ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotifcationIn web service for an inter company scenario. As there is no Third Party Sales Order in the system, the system is correctly reporting the same. -The Sales Order created against the Purchase Order is an Intercompany Sales Order and not a Drop-Shipment Sales Order.- Resolution-You have to use the web service Inbound Delivery Execution In (Inbound Delivery Execution Confirmation(IDEC)) to confirm the Receipt of the Items at your Warehouse Provider.-The system is therefore working as designed.-See Also-Inter company, TPOP, 3PL

Title: Cash discount is not automatically applied on the payment run for some invoices
Content: Symptom-You execute a payment run of Payables and on one of the payment proposals, the cash discount of the open items are not calculated automatically even though Payment Term, for example, 10 days 2% cash discount, 20 days net is assigned to these open invoices. You are sure that the payment date for this payment proposal is within 10 days from at least some invoice dates.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work Center > Payment Runs view-Search for the Run ID: XYZ (XYZ is the Run ID)-Under Execution details, Click View Payment Proposals-Select the Payment ID ABC (ABC is the payment ID), the cash discount is not applied for the invoice-Cause-The issue lies on Supplier Invoice side.-On the item level of the supplier invoice, there is a check box option called Cash Discount Relevant. If Cash Discount Relevant is checked, a discount is allowed for the item. If it is not checked, no discount is allowed on the item.-Therefore if the check box on the item level is not checked, no possible cash discount will be considered even if the payment terms conditions suggest a potential discount if the invoice is paid within the timeframe defined in the payment terms.-Resolution-To have the possible discount from the payment terms conditions to be visible as Cash Discount on the payment proposal, the check box Cash Discount Relevant on the item level in the Supplier invoice needs to be flagged.-As it is not possible to alter an already posted supplier invoice, you have to cancel the existing invoice and create a new one with the check box flagged.-See Also-KBA 2184550 - Payables Payment Run: Cash Discount Not Calculated For Supplier Invoice -KBA 1686007 - Cash Discount is Not Automatically Applied on the Automatic Payment Created by Payment Run -Keywords-cash discount, payment run, automatic, payment, applied, payment proposal, calculated

Title: Switzerland Vat return XML UID tag does not have the correct format
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the UID in Switzerland Tax return XML file does not correspond to what is maintained in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select the VAT Returns view.-Search for VAT return ID XXX(XX represents the ID of the Vat return).-Go to the attachments tab and open TAXDECL-XXXXX.xml.--Result: When you look for UID tag in the XML, it shows with a leading 0 instead of what is maintained in the system(starts by a 1).-Cause-The CH UID number in the Company Tax Arrangement needs to be maintained with hyphens and dots. After that, the value will appear correctly in the tag. The value maintained is CHEXXXXXXXXX HR/MWST. You should maintain it as CHE-XXX.XXX.XXX HR/MWST.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select Tax Authorities.-Select the relevant Tax Authority and click on Edit Company Tax Arrangements.-Click on Tax Numbers tab.-For the field 2 - UID Number, change the value from format CHEXXXXXXXXX HR/MWST to CHE-XXX.XXX.XXX HR/MWST.-Keywords-Swiss UID

Title: Screen Freezes While trying to Access Goods Movement View
Content: Symptom-When Trying to access Goods movement Screen, system crashes with below error:--Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-Details-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal logistics Work Center.-Select Goods movement View.-Enter the site id.-Choose next.-System takes some time and crashes.-Cause-Huge amount of data in Logistic ID and Site ID.-Resolution-Select the required product ID's, Logistic ID and Site ID then process it.-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Goods movement, Site ID, System dump, Product id.

Title: Check availability grayed out for customer demand
Content: Symptom-Check availability button of a customer demand is grayed out and due to that, the availability cannot be checked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Customer Demand view.-Find Customer Demand ABC (ABC means Customer Demand ID).-Notice that Actions button is grayed out.-With Action button grayed out, Check Availability button is also grayed out.-Cause-The product without quantity available stock was selected instead of the correct one.-Resolution-It is necessary to check under Products View in Supply Planning work center if there are more products with a different Supply Planning Area, and if the correct one was selected when the order was created. Sometimes the product with 0 quantity availability stock might be chosen, instead of the product with available stock, so check availability will not work. If this happens, it’s necessary to cancel this order and create another with the correct product.-Keywords-Check availability grayed out, Products, Customer Demand, Supply Planning Area.

Title: System Crashes While Uploading ISO20022 Bank Statement XML File
Content: Symptom-System crashes while uploading a new bank statement XML file in ISO20022 Bank Statement format (Camt.053.001.02).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Click New and click Bank Statement File Upload.-Enter Company, Bank and Import Format ISO20022 Bank Statement.-Click Add, click File.-Add the respective XML file.-Click Start File Upload.-System crashes.-Cause-The XML file has not been formatted according to ISO-Standards, which results in a system crash (backend dump).-Example of common errors:-1) In file header, tag <BkToCstmrStmtV02> is present.-Correct tag: <BkToCstmrStmt> -2) Date denomination in the statement transactions is incorrect (MMDD), for example:-<BookgDt><Dt>0724</Dt></BookgDt>-Correct date denomination to be used is YYYY-MM-DD: <BookgDt><Dt>2024-07-24</Dt></BookgDt>-3) Format of <ValDt><Dt> is YYYYMMDD: <Dt>240724</Dt>-Correct format to be used is YYYY-MM-DD: <Dt>2024-07-24</Dt>-Resolution-The ISO20022 Bank Statement XML file should be corrected as per above instructions. Once the changes are done, the new XML file could be successfully uploaded in the system.-Keywords-CAMT.053.001.02; bank statement; <BkToCstmrStmt>; <BkToCstmrStmtV02>; <BookgDt>; <ValDt><Dt>

Title: System Failed to Determine the Higher Level Cost Center Manager in the Shopping Cart Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a shopping cart and submitted for approval. However system could not determine the relevant approver. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self Services overview-Select Track Shopping carts -Select the relevant Shopping Cart-Select show Approval Process section-You can see that no approver found-Cause-System is unable to determine the approver because you have defined the approval rule as - Approval by Next Level Reporting Line Unit Manager. From the determination perspective, system finds the manager of requester however system cannot find the Next Level Reporting manager in the org structure. -Resolution-As per the rule, if user contains any reporting manager, then system will determine the specific employee from org structure. If no manager maintained, system will create an unassigned business task. It needs to be manually assign to a valid employee and get it approved. -Keywords-Shopping cart approval; Approval by Next Level Reporting Line Unit Manager.

Title: Incorrect Numbering Format Pick Up While Creating New Supplier Invoice For a Company
Content: Symptom-System picks incorrect numbering format while creating supplier invoice for a particular company. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Invoice-You can see that, numbering format is different -Cause-You have activated the numbering rule for self invoices and Self-Invoice/ERS is marked as Yes. You can define the tax registration number for Self Invoices and not for regular invoices. -The Self Invoice Numbering Rule will be active only for ERS (Evaluated Receipt Settlement) Invoices and no other type of invoices. As a result, the Self Invoice Numbering rule maintained in Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing under Business Configuration is not picked up.-Note - When you copy a self invoice, the document numbering rules will not be applicable, as the invoice is treated as a normal supplier invoice.--Resolution-If you do not use the self invoices, you can delete the current numbering format and try to create a new rule with out tax registration number. Later system will create an invoice with proper prefix. -See Also-Refer Help Document: "Official Document Number for Self Invoice - India"-Refer to case document -2736088 - ERS Invoice Sequence Number is not Generated as per Numbering Format for Self Invoices-Keywords-Supplier Invoice numbering rule; Supplier invoice numbering format issue;

Title: How to do Mass Change in Goods Movement?
Content: Symptom-You have a huge number of items you would like to move from Warehouse A to Warehouse B. However, it seems that you could only an add item one by one in Goods Movement.-You are now looking for a way to do mass change with Goods Movement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Not relevant.-Cause-Not relevant.-Resolution-This is possible through Web service so kindly follow the below steps to to do mass change in goods movement.-Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Choose Service Explorer under Input and Output Management view.-Select All synchronous inbound operation and search for Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Select the Operation Description: Create goods and activity confirmations for goods movements.-Click the Documentation Link to open documentation of the Inbound Service Create Goods and Activity Confirmations for Goods Movements.-You can find sample payload in the documentation that provide guidance.-Using this web service, you should be able do mass change for Goods Movement.-See Also-https://api.sap.com/api/PSM_ISI_R_II_A1S_IP_GAC_QUERY_BO/overview-https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2405/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_APGACFM_GOODS_MOVEMENT_IN.html-Keywords-mass change, warehouse, Webservice, Goods and activity confirmations, Goods Movement.

Title: Error "Pay. procedure Direct Debit of account ABC not permitted for payments from AA to BB" occurs while posting New Incoming Direct Debit
Content: Symptom-A new Incoming Direct Debit cannot be posted for a Customer Account due to the following error messages:-"Payment method details are not determined-Pay. procedure Direct Debit of account ABC not permitted for payments from AA to BB"-Note:-ABC refers to the Bank Account ID.-AA and BB refers to two different countries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the relevant Customer Account ID and click on View.-In the Trade Payables tab, select Pay manually by Direct Debit. -In the New Incoming Direct Debit screen, enter the Bank Account ID ABC and click on Complete Bank Data.-The following error occurs:-"Payment method details are not determined"-"Pay. procedure Direct Debit of account ABC not permitted for payments from AA to BB" -Cause-Direct Debit is restricted to domestic transactions, limited to within a country or a designated payment area (e.g., the EURO-SEPA Zone). As a result, the system does not allow direct debit payments between AA and BB.-No self-initiated customer payments (i.e., Incoming Direct Debit) are permitted from AA to BB.-Resolution-Use a non-self-initiated payment method for transactions between AA and BB, such as: Incoming Bank Transfer, Wire Transfer or Incoming Check.-Keywords-New Incoming Direct Debit, Customer Account, Complete Bank Data, Bank Account ID, Payment method details, Pay. procedure Direct Debit of account not permitted for payments.

Title: Dump "500 SAP Internal Server Error ''during Data extraction of Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-User trying to extract organizational structure data using Data Extraction ,system throws dump after execution of run for several hours.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter -Navigate to Data Extraction view-Create New Run by Selecting "New" option-Enter Run ID .-Choose Extraction Object as "Organizational Structure"-Enable Control Parameters if required.-Choose "Activate and Run"-System throws dump after execution of run for several hours.-Cause-Inconsistent entries in Organizational Units-Resolution-To remove the inconsistency user should Activate  whole Organizational structure so that all the unwanted entries will be removed.-Follow below steps to activate Organizational structure-Go to Organizational management Workcenter.-Go to Org structures view.-Enter an effective date and click on Ok.-Select the org unit to be activated.-Select Activate button.-From the drop down list, select Activate Selected Dependent Org Units .-Once Organizational Structure is activated ,User can execute Data Extraction for Organizational Structure.-Keywords-Data Extraction Dump, Data Extraction run fail

Title: Employee Responsible in the Customer Invoice is Taken from the Contract Administrator Value in Customer Contract Process
Content: Symptom-There are 2 roles in the customer contract, they are Employee Responsible role and Contract Administrator role. You find the Employee Responsible in the following customer invoices is not the same filled in the contract, the value is taken from contract administrator field instead.-For example, in the contract the Employee Responsible is ABC, and the Contract Administrator is XYZ. In the following customer invoice, the Employee Responsible in the item level is XYZ instead of ABC.-ABC, XYZ represent the ID of an employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open one contract and notice that the Employee Responsible is ABC, and the Contract Administrator is XYZ. -Go to the Document Flow tab, and open the customer invoice document.-In the Items tab, You find the Employee Responsible of item line is XYZ which is Contract Administrator in the reference contract.-Cause-When an invoice request created from the customer contract, the Employee Responsible is taken from the Contract Administrator value instead of the Employee Responsible value, so the Employee Responsible in the invoice request is XYZ.-When further invoicing this invoice request, Employee Responsible XYZ is then copied into the customer document available on the item level as reference information. -Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior.-The Employee Responsible value in invoice document and customer invoice document is not editable. If you want to change the value, you will need to change the Contract Administrator in the reference contract document before invoicing.-Keywords-customer contract invoice request; employee responsible; contract administrator; customer contract.

Title: New Expense Report Picks a Wrong Country/Region
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-During expense report creation, the wrong Country/Region field is derived by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Travel and expense work center.-Create New expense report on behalf of, use Relevant User ID and fill mandatory data.-Notice that a wrong country is derived by the system in the Country/Region field.-Cause-Evnthough the personal file, employment details and org structure is maintained as a right country code, the expense report picks a wrong one.-Resolution-The country assignment for employee ID is the one picked in expense report (BO ERM_EXPENSE_ARRANGEMENT and HCF_EMPLOYMENT), and as a consequence currency for that country is used in expense reports. To have this employee under right employment, a rehire of this employee under Work Center Personnel Administration must be performed.-See Also- KBA 2644245 - Wrong Default Country/Region in Expense Report-Keywords-Expense report, Country/Region

Title: Change Log by Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM) in Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 2 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY**-You find there is a change log without details in a Project, changed by Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM), user ID SAP_SYSTEM. You want to know why there is the log.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Go to Project View.-Find Project ABC (ABC represents the project ID).-Edit.-Go to Project Overview tab.-Select the Changes sub tab.-Show all Change Log-You find there is a change log changed by Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM), user ID SAP_SYSTEM. But no details available.-Cause-Not all change details for projects are shown in frontend.-Resolution-You can find the change details in backend via below steps.-Open T code: SESFTS-Open BO Project: PRO_PROJECT-Load By Query: ROOT-QU_BY_ELEMENTS-Maintain ProjectID/content with the project ID-Note down the Node ID of the project: ABCDEFG-Open BO Change Document: /ISPCD/CHANGE_DOCUMENT-Load By Query: ROOT-QUERY_BY_OBJECT_TYPE_COD-In the set query options window, maintain ObjectTypeCode/content with 231 (the object type code of Project), maintain ObjectNodeTechnicalID with project node ID ABCDEFG, and adjust the timeframe, press OK-The change document of the project get opened-Navigate to CHANGE_DOCUMENT_RECORD, change to Table view-You can see what elements had been changed, the old values and new values-For example:-You see AccessGroupKey/GroupingAccessContextCode 1003 has been removed.-To understand what the code 1003 is, you can follow below steps.-Go to T code: MDRS-Open BO Project: PRO_PROJECT-Expand Root >> AccessControlList.ROOT >>AccessControlLost.ENTRY-Double click on RBAMPRX_ACCESS_CONTEXT_CODE-Go to Runtime Code list, here you see 1003 refers to Management. This change log is caused by organization update run.-Keywords-PROJECT; CHANGE LOG; SAP_SYSTEM; Project, Changes, Change Log

Title: Error Ship-to Location Does not Belong to Ordering Company While Ordering Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-You have created a Purchase Order however you are unable to order due to the below error. -Error - Item 1: Ship-to location does not belong to ordering company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order and select Edit-Click on Check  button-Error appears-Cause-System shows the error in the Purchase Order document because the process type is To-Stock. When you assign the product with process type To-Stock, system will try to fetch the account determinations from the material master data where company assignments will be mapped. -Resolution-If you want to Order the Purchase document, you need to change the process type from To-Stock to Non-Stock and add the account assignment details to item 1. Then the purchase order will be consistent and Ready for ordering. -Keywords-Ship-to location does not belong to ordering company

Title: Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: HTTP error: ("HTTP Code 400: Bad Request - Details see in error log of transaction SRTUTIL")
Content: Symptom-Error occurs while sending the Output history to the Supplier , post the creation of the purchase order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-After the creation of Purchase order, output history is not sent to the supplier. Output history Status is Error. -To check the error, follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center -Go to Business Communication Monitoring view -Search for the created PO-Select the PO line and go to Message details to see the error : "Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: HTTP error: ("HTTP Code 400: Bad Request - Details see in error log of transaction SRTUTIL")" -Cause-Server URL is not maintained correctly in the Communication Arrangements. -Go To Application and user management work center -> communication arrangements view -> Search for the Purchase Order integration scenario -> click on edit -> go to technical data tab and Outbound sub tab -> click on check connection -> we see an error "Checking connection failed"-This means that the server URL maintained cannot be reached by the BYD system as it might be wrong or corrupted or not accessible. -Resolution-Kindly check the Server URL maintained in communication arrangements. Maintain the correct URL and save the changes. And then create the Purchase order, this should ideally generate the output history and send it to the supplier without any error. -Keywords-HTTP Code 400: Bad Request - Details see in error log of transaction SRTUTIL, output history error, incorrect server URL, communication arrangement connection error

Title: Unable to Decouple Goods and Service Receipts Check box When Time Recording Required Check box is Selected
Content: Symptom-In the Third-Party process type unchecking the "Time Recording Required" check box will automatically remove the check from "Goods and Service Receipts" expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Third-Party Purchase Order -Navigate to Items tab-Under Basic Data, you can see that Time Recording Required check box will automatically select for Third-Party Purchase Order -Cause-Once the time entry is released, GSR will be created automatically and then you can create supplier invoice with respect to that GSR. In the "third-party" process type unchecking the "time recording required" will automatically remove the check from "goods and service receipt expected".-In the Business Configuration work center -> Overview -> Activities -> Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings -> Here you can see for Process Type - Third-Party and Item Type Service, Goods and Service Expected check box is defaulted. Which means, for project based services with third party, it is expected to do time recording and based on released time sheets, system, will create goods and service receipt.-Resolution-For standalone Third Party Purchase Order, the use is able to deselect Time Recording Required, while the Goods and Services Receipt Expected Indicator stays selected. For Third Party Purchase Orders created via Project Purchase request will always deselect Goods and Services Reciept Expected indicator if Time Recording Required is deselected by the user. The Goods and Service Receipts for purchase orders created via project for third party scenarios will always only be created via Time Recording process.-As a standard behaviour, unchecking the "Time recording required" will automatically remove the check box from "Goods and service receipt expected". If you have any feedback, please share the idea in influence forum -https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Time Recording Required in third party order; Time Recording Required; Goods and Services Receipt Expected Indicator; Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings;

Title: Error: "Company AAA already exists as company of another company tax arrangement with a tax return arrangement for tax return type XYZ"
Content: Symptom-While adding Subsidiary Company in the Company Tax Arrangement, an error message is being raised:-"Company AAA already exists as company of another company tax arrangement with a tax return arrangement for tax return type XYZ"-AAA means the Subsidiary Company ID-XYZ means Tax Return Type, for example, WHT Return - 102, WHT Return - 856, etc.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Click on Tax Authority View.-Select the Tax Authority and click on Edit.-Go to Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Select the Company BBB (BBB means the parent Company ID).-Go to Subsidiaries tab.-Click on Add Row.-Enter the Company AAA and Valid From date.-Click on Save.-Error Messages appear: "Company AAA already exists as company of another company tax arrangement with a tax return arrangement for tax return type XYZ".-Cause-The Parent Company BBB has the Tax Return Arrangement for Tax Return Type XYZ. Now, while trying to add company AAA as Subsidiary to BBB, it is expected to give error.-Basically, the Subsidiary Company AAA has the Tax Return Arrangement for Tax Return Type XYZ, in the same Tax Authority. It is not possible or not necessary to add a Subsidiary with a Tax Return Arrangement which already exists in the Parent Company BBB.-Resolution-A case has to be raised to SAP. The Subsidiary Company will be updated from backend system by SAP Support.-Keywords-Company AAA already exists as company of another company tax arrangement with a tax return arrangement for tax return type, Subsidiaries, Company Tax Arrangement, Tax Authority

Title: How to set Approval Process for Purchase Order Cancellation?
Content: Symptom-You want system to trigger an approval process for Purchase Order when user cancels it and hence would like to know process to set up the rules.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order which you want to Cancel -Cause-You need to enable the scoping question - Do you want to allow approval process for Purchase Order Cancellation? in Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-When you cancel the purchase order, system will trigger an approval process before it gets cancelled. It works only at header level and not at item level. Once you scope the question, you have to define the condition for the field, Cancellation Status = Cancellation Requested in the approval process for purchase order.-Keywords-Approval Process for Purchase Order Cancellation; purchase order approval process for cancellation; PO cancellation;

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have received a request to descope TIS from SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-For the scoping questions that were set up and follow up activities that were created, Refer to the KBA 2938583 - How to Activate communication arrangement with partner Treasury Intelligence Solutions. Title: Delivery and Invoice Documents Were not Picked From Intrastat Item Worklist for Intrastat Declaration
Content: Symptom-You have created an Intrastat Declaration however relevant documents were not picked from Intrastat Item Worklist for declaration. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center-Go to Intrastat Declaration view-Select the relevant Intrastat Declaration ID -Only few documents were picked up from the intrastat declaration run-Cause-The declarations are done based on delivery items and not invoice. If you check one of the reference document Customer Invoice, it was created based on Third Party Outbound Delivery. In case of third party scenario, you do not own the actual stock at your end, so it will not be consider third party documents in declaration run.-Resolution-In the current version, the third party scenario is not supported. You need to manually add the reference items in the declaration document and submit to the statistical authorities. -Keywords-Invoice Documents Were not Picked From Intrastat Item Worklist; Intrastat Item Worklist

Title: Issue with the Calculated Company Currency Amount based on Exchange Rate
Content: Symptom-You are facing a discrepancy between the expected and actual currency conversion values for Supplier Invoice ABC.-The expected conversion, based on the defined exchange rate in the system, should result in XXX CNY (For example, CNY = GBP). However, upon checking the Journal entry for the invoice, it shows a value of YYY CNY (For example CNY, = GBP).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select All Documents from the dropdown and search for the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice ID).-Click on view all-In the General Tab navigate to the Exchange Rates sub tab-The Supplier Invoice is for XYZ CNY (For example, CNY = AED).-Navigate to the document flow tab and open the Journal entry for Supplier Invoice ABC. You can notice that the Company Currency Amount is YYY CNY (CNY = GBP).-Cause-The system behavior is as expected.-In the Journal Entry ID screen, click on 'You Can Also' and select 'View Business Transaction for Accounting'.-Click on 'View All' and navigate to the Exchange Rates Tab-You can see that the Source Currency is GBP and the Transaction Currency is AED and the Exchange Rate is abc. Hence, when we calculate exchange rate, YYY GBP * abc = XYZ AED -Consider following the example mentioned below for in-detail explanation:-In the Supplier Invoice ABC, click on view all and navigate to the exchange rates sub-tab in the General Tab. You can observe that Unit Currency is GBP and the Quoted Currency is AED. According to the definition, -Unit Currency:-The unit currency is the base currency or the currency against which exchange rates are quoted. It is the currency in which the amounts are initially entered or stored.  -Quoted Currency:-The quoted currency is the currency in which the exchange rate is expressed concerning the unit currency. When you look at an exchange rate, you will see how much of the quoted currency you would get or need for one unit of the unit currency. Quoted currency is often referred to as the "transaction currency."-If the unit currency is GBP (Pound Sterling) and the quoted currency is AED (United Arab Emirates Dirham), and you want to calculate the amount in GBP for a given amount in AED, the calculation will be:-Amount in GBP = Amount in AED/Exchange Rate -Given the amount 26,250.00 AED:-Amount in AED = 26,250.00 AED-Exchange Rate (AED to GBP) = 0.2199-Substitute these values into the formula:-Amount in GBP=26,250 AED/0.2199-Calculating this:-Amount in GBP=119,372.44 GBP-Therefore, if you have 26,250 AED with an exchange rate of 0.2199 (AED to GBP), the equivalent amount in GBP would be approximately 119,372.44 GBP.-Resolution-You need to enter the correct Unit Currency and Quoted Currency in the exchange rates sub-tab in the Supplier Invoice which is causing the discrepancy.-Keywords-Exchange rate, Journal Entry, Unit Currency, Quoted Currency, Supplier Invoice, Company Currency, Transaction Currency

Title: Updating Supplier Collaboration Data Using Web Services
Content: Symptom-How to utilize webservices to update supplier collaboration data -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Open SOAP UI-Update the Supplier -Cause-The webservice managesupplierin is used to update collaboration data of supplier.-Resolution-In payload it is required to pass all channels for a document type via "Complete Transmission Indicator" in the web service. This means, existing entries will be ignored (deleted) and the sent list will be newly created.-Sample payload would look something like this:-<n0:SupplierBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<BasicMessageHeader></BasicMessageHeader>-<Supplier actionCode="02" >-<InternalID>XXXX</InternalID>-<CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel actionCode="04" communicationChannelListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<CompoundServiceInterfaceCode>11</CompoundServiceInterfaceCode>-<EnabledIndicator>true</EnabledIndicator>-<CommunicationChannel communicationEmailListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<CommunicationMediumTypeCode>INT</CommunicationMediumTypeCode>-<CommunicationEmail>-<EmailURI>Email ID</EmailURI>-<RecipientFieldTypeCode>TO</RecipientFieldTypeCode>-</CommunicationEmail>-</CommunicationChannel>-</CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel>-</Supplier>-</n0:SupplierBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-This web service call will add/change for a supplier's collaboration for remittances with email. Otherwise, for now, only the manual update via the UI is possible.-Keywords-webservice, collaboration data, supplier, managesupplierin

Title: Report 'WIP Inventories - Balance Summary' shows Zero Value in Valuation Quantity column
Content: Symptom-When running the 'WIP Inventories - Balance Summary' report, the Valuation Quantity column is filled with zeros.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Analytics work center and Open the report "WIP Inventories - Balance Summary".-Set the Relevant material-Set the date and currency date (e.g., 12/03/2024).-Run the report.-Cause-The 'WIP Inventories - Balance Summary' report shows the value of work-in-process inventories for materials and production lots. Data is only shown under the WIP column, not on the valuation level.-Resolution-For valuation related data, refer to other reports such as "Production Lots - Line Items". This would give desired results.-Keywords-Inventory Valuation, WIP Inventories - Balance Summary, Zero Valuation Quantity, Production Lots - Line Items.

Title: Expense Report not Available in the Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-Expense report is not available in the project invoice request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Project Invoice Requests view-Select the relevant Project Invoice Request -Select Edit button and Expense Report is not present in Project Invoice Request-Cause-You have created expense report with tax code 28 however it is not able to invoice the expense report in project invoicing because;-You have used tax code 28 which is used for import duty relevant items-When tax code 28 is used, entire line item amount will be taken in as tax amount-Resolution-If entire amount is taken it as tax amount than there will be no line item amount for invoicing that's why the expense report will not come up while project invoicing. You must not use import duty relevant tax code in an expense report, if you want to invoice it. You can delete this expense report and create a new expense report with correct tax code.-Keywords-Expense Report; Project Invoice Request; PIR

Title: An Error is Raised When Saving the Fixed Asset: 'The action RECALCULATE_VALUE_ADJUST is not possible'
Content: Symptom-You tried to remove the Last Retirement Date of an asset as an attempt to enable the Deactivation Date, which is grayed out. However, upon saving an error message is raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Open the related Retired asset.-Go to Master Data -> Life Cycle Data.-The Deactivation Date is disabled. You remove the Last Retirement Date as an attempt to enable the field again.-Click Save.-The following error is raised: 'The action RECALCULATE_VALUE_ADJUST is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident'-Cause-The asset in this scenario is a legacy/migrated asset, which has been scrapped via manual postings. Once the migrate asset is retired, the Deactivation Date is set and remains grayed out while migration is enabled in the system.-Resolution-If you wish to turn the asset back to Capitalized status, you need to reverse the retirement posting. The posting can be found via Value tab -> Journal.-Alternatively, if you wish to remove the Deactivation Date, you may disable the fixed asset migration object, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and search for Disable Data Migration per Object.-Open the activity and unmark the checkbox for Fixed Assets and Fixed Assets (extended) migration objects.-Save and Close.-After that, you shall be able to remove the Deactivation Date without the error message being raised.-See Also-2717075-Keywords-Fixed Assets, Migration, Deactivation Date, Last Retirement Date, Depreciation, Migration.

Title: Error in CL_RC_FDQ_FI_AA_MONITOR=======CP during job TMW_RC_FDQ_DATA_COLL
Content: Symptom-Job(s) TMW_RC_FDQ_DATA_COLL as well as parent job RC_COLLECT_ANALYSIS_DATA were canceled.-In the job log, the error message:-Internal session terminated with a runtime error SAPSQL_PARSE_ERROR (see ST22) -For the runtime error a dump was written:-Category ABAP Programming Error-Runtime Errors SAPSQL_PARSE_ERROR-Except. CX_SY_DYNAMIC_OSQL_SEMANTICS-ABAP Program CL_RC_FDQ_FI_AA_MONITOR=======CP-Application Component SV-SMG-DVM-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|Short Text |-| An error has occurred while parsing a dynamic entry. |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|What happened? |-| Error in the ABAP Application Program |-| |-| The current ABAP program "CL_RC_FDQ_FI_AA_MONITOR=======CP" had to be |-| terminated because it has |-| come across a statement that unfortunately cannot be executed.-Reproducing the Issue-Running RC_COLLECT_ANALYSIS_DATA with activated Financial Data Quality check-Cause-The reports: FIN_CORR_RECONCILE (from SAP Note 2755360) and FI_AA_CORR_RECONCILE (from SAP Note 2896400) are to check the financial data consistency in SAP ERP 6.0 systems.-They are valid for systems with components SAP_APPL 600 to 616 or SAP_FIN 617 to 618.-The reports mentioned above were not designed or intended for SFIN 2.0 or S/4HANA systems-Resolution-Please note that the reconciliation report that should be started are valid for systems with SAP_APPL 600 to 616 or SAP_FIN 617 to 618. The mentioned reports were not designed or intended for SFIN or S/4HANA systems.-Thus, if the system is not in the described scope, you cannot use the SAP note 2972792 and it is better to not implement it.-See Also-KBA 2968380 - SAP Readiness Check Report 2.0 - troubleshooting guide-KBA 3333027 - Transport errors with note 2972792 in program CL_RC_FDQ*-SAP NOTE 2896400 - Reconciliation of Asset Accounting Inconsistencies in ECC prior to S/4HANA Conversion-SAP NOTE 2755360 - Reconciliation prior to S/4HANA Conversion-Keywords- TMW_RC_FDQ_DATA_COLL, FIN_CORR_RECONCILE, CL_RC_FDQ_FI_AA_MONITOR=======CP, RC_COLLECT_ANALYSIS_DATA, SAPSQL_PARSE_ERROR, canceled

Title: Error Message "Error detected in source record with key value XXXX. Combination of ZZZZ already exists for product YYYY" During Migration of Services
Content: Symptom-While migrating Services using Data Migration tool the system throws below error message:-Error detected in source record with key value XXXX. Combination of ZZZZ already exists for product YYYY (Where X represents digits in the Service ID, Z stands for Company ID and Y represents Product ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Business Configuration work center-2.Go to Overview sub view-3.Find the Activity Migration of services-4.Select Migrate services using the migration tool.-5.Upload the filled migration template.-6.Execute the migration using the option step by step.-Cause-The combination of Service ID, Supplier ID, and Supplier Part Number, respectively of Service ID, Customer ID, and Customer Product ID on the Supplier Product Numbers sheet and on the Customer Product IDs sheet must be unique.-Resolution-Before migration verify respective ID types in the migration template and compare it with the ID format maintained in the system. Do not assign e.g. the same Supplier Part Number to the same Supplier ID, or the same Customer Product ID to the same Customer ID more than once.-Keywords-Migration of Services, Product ID, Customer Product ID, Supplier ID, Error detected in source record with key value, Combination of, already exists for product.

Title: Getting started with Custom Code Analytics based on EWA
Content: Symptom-Custom Code Analytics 2.0 (CCA 2.0) comes with an automated Early Watch Alert (EWA) based data collection. It gives an overview about the custom code footprint of your ABAP systems and provides insights on quantity, quality, complexity and usage of your Custom Code.-This KBA explains the prerequisites for the automated EWA based data collection.-CCA used to be available as an SAP for Me application, which was sunset on December 31st, 2025. However, CCA data collection continues to run in the background.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP S/4 HANA -- SAP Cloud ALM-Resolution-The Custom Code Analytics (CCA) application is no longer available via SAP for Me, as it was sunset on December 31, 2025. Data is no longer being transmitted to SAP for Me.-CCA data collection continues to run in the background and is required as a data source to feed the RISE with SAP Methodology dashboard in SAP Cloud ALM.-For more information please check KBA:-3688588 - End of Maintenance for the Custom Code Analytics (CCA) App: Customer Transition Steps-Additionally, Ensure that Early Watch Alert is configured.-Please check below note: 1257308 - FAQ: Using EarlyWatch Alert-Additionally, Please check the following RTCCTOOL Recommendations too:--Activate Online collectors for data collection:-Please ensure that Online Data Collectors are allowed. They are read-only and digitally signed online collectors for SDCCN data (e.g. Early Watch Alert). the Digital content verification is active.
