Please check SAP Note 69455 for further details.-To check whether Online Data collectors are allowed, please run the report RTCCTOOL via transaction SE38 open the menu GOTO -> Online Collectors that the online collectors are allowed:-Activate Digital Signatures content verification:-Please ensure that the Digital content verification is active. Please check SAP note 69455 for further details.-To check whether Digital signatures content verification is active please run the report RTCCTOOL via transaction SE38 and ensure that the note " Switch on digital content verification" is implemented as below:-By ensuring the above recommendation you can enable the  Custom Code Analytics(CCA) based on EWA.-See Also-KBA - 1511008 - How to add or change S-user ID authorizations - SAP for Me -KBA - 1257308 - FAQ: Using EarlyWatch Alert-KBA 3688588 - End of Maintenance for the Custom Code Analytics (CCA) App: Customer Transition Steps-Keywords-Custom Code Analytics, 2.0 SAP for Me, online, data, collectors, EWA, s-user, custom code, CCA, Custom Code Analytics based on EWA, Sunset

Title: Error "Similar Entry for Supply Planning Area Already Exists" While Trying to Migrate Materials
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Materials via Migration Tool, however you are receiving the error message below:-"Similar Entry for Supply Planning area already exists"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Materials.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File.-Cause- The error message is related to the Convert Values step, there are Planning Areas that were converted to the same target value and therefore the system shows the error message.-Resolution-You need to check the conversion of the respective Planning Areas in the Convert Values step of the Migration of Materials and in the case the conversion is incorrect, you have to correct these values.-You can find the incorrect values in the second step of the Migration Tool, named as Convert Values.-Keywords-Migration of Materials, Error Message, Similar Entry for Supply Planning area already exists.

Title: Time Recordings Missing In Project Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL ONLY ***-You are creating a project invoice request for a project and notice that time recordings that are already recorded (and approved) are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.-Go to the view Projects.-Search for the relevant project and click New.-Select Project Invoice Request and Create Automatic Project Invoice Request.-In the project invoice request under the Items tab in the subtab Time and Expenses you notice that for some dates the time recordings are missing.-Cause-There could be messages in the backend which are not processed correctly.-Resolution-Logon to the backend.-Open SRT_MONI.-Enter the date for which the recordings are missing.-For Processing Status Group, select Incomplete Processing.-Under Sender Information enter TimeAndLabourManagement.-Execute.-If you see failed messages here you can restart them. If the restart is successful the messages are green now and the time recordings will be shown in the project invoice request.-Keywords-project, invoice, request, time, recording, missing, not shown, Projektzeiten, Zeiterfassung, Projektrechnungsanforderung

Title: Export Payment XML File for Treasury Intelligence Solutions (TIS)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-Customer requests for us to export payment XML file for TIS.-The reason they request this is because when they try and get the XML file from the UI they are getting the message “Save Failed”.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the view Payment Batch.-Search and find the Payment Batch ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Batch ID that is in error).-Select Send Batch.-Error appears "Save Failed". -Resolution-To export the XML file without this error you must follow the below steps.-Login to the customers backend.-Select transaction code: SE 80.-Select Repository Browser.-Select Class / Interface.-Select to show Class and input class ID CL_FOP_SEND_PAYBATCH_TO_TIS (if it is not in the list, just copy and paste it in).-Select the folder Methods.-Then select the option.-Select the option ASSEMBLE_XML_COLL_PAYORD_REQ.-Double click the class, it will show class details in the right pane.-Set an External Breakpoint at line 251.-Scroll down to line 251 and highlight the line.-Then select the icon  Set/Delete External Brake Point - from the toolbar.-Select the menu option: More-Select the options Utilities -> Settings.-Select the Tab Debugging.-Here make sure that the USER is the same User as you have logged in.-Execute the corresponding TIS payment from the UI (Customer frontend).-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the view Payment Batches.-Search and find the Payment Batch that the customer is requesting the XML file for.-Select Actions -> Send Batch.-The backend will open directly for you (because of the brake point that you have entered).-The debugger shall stop at the breakpoint.-Select the tab Standard.-Then click F5 button ONCE.-Click F6 button to perform TIS message assembly. Press the F6 button again until you land on line 18 (highlighted in the below screenshot).-Select the Locals tab. This can be found in the area on the right hand side of the screen.-Under the column VAL. on the XML line - this appears empty, click into the field once. Then click F6.-Once you have clicked F6, values will appear in this field.-Now select XML under the Variable Name column.-Double click XML under the Variable Names tab.-This will open a new screen and you will see the XML message.-Click on the last logo on the right and then select Save to Local File and save it as an XML file.-File that has been created can be sent to the customer.-Remove all External Brake points and exit Debugger correctly.-  Keywords-XML, Payment Batch, TIS

Title: How to Approve a Payment From The Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have a payment in status In Approval but the user that should approve the payment has not receive an approval task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Select the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments and search for Document ID:  XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the payment). -The payment is in status In Approval.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Select the Business Task management subview.-There is no approval task created for the payment.-Resolution-In some cases, the document need to be approved via the backend. Suppport engineer needs to check the root cause of the issue with Development colleagues and see if the backend approval is the only option to approve the document.-In CAM, request a user with L6 Authorization and open STFK.-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Open BO FOPXP_PAYORD.-Go to Load By Query and select PAYORDRO –QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter the below parameters:-.ID-CONTENT = Document ID of the payment on UI eg XXX.-.COMP_ID = Company ID.-.BUSINESS_PART_ID = Payer/Payee ID on UI under Payer Data (In some case, the Payer/Payee is also an employee of the company and has two ID. Use the ID under Payer Data).-Once the instance is loaded in SESFTS, select Actions > APPROVE.-This triggers the creation of AccountingDocument, AccountingNotification, BankPaymentOrder and PaymentAllocation.-The approval status of payment order changes to 4 ie Approved and the STATUS-PAYORD_LIFECYCLE_STAT_CODE changes to 3 ie Released.-Save the instance after you ensure these changes.-Keywords-Payment Approval

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on Product Master Data and Service Master Data
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article lists some of the most frequently asked questions related to Product Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. What is the maximum number of Material we can have in ByDesign before seeing a potential performance drop?-There is no limit in creating and maintaining Materials in ByD. In case of huge Materials, there may be delay when Search for Materials in the Material screen. In these cases, please apply filters to narrow down the search.-2. Are the Material with the obsolete status considered in this limit ? Or can we consider that if a Material is obsolete it will not impact the performance ?-It is not possible to set the header status of Material to Obsolete. In case one of the processes if a Material is blocked then those Materials are also considered when you choose "All Materials"-3. How to add Serial Number Profile in Material view?-You have scoped Registered Products in you system but cannot see Serial Number Profile in Material view.- Follow the solution below:-Go to Product Data workcenter.-Select Material view.-Open any Material.-Enter Adaptation Mode.-Open the UI Element Unnamed Group.-You can see field Serial Number Profile with the Visible checkbox which is unchecked.-Check this option and you will be able to see the field Serial Number Profile in UI.- 4. How to add required colors to the fields for Product Master Data?- You can add the color of the Product Master Data using Adaptation Mode. Enter Adaptation Mode, you can edit required field and add desired color information.- 5. Is replication of weights and volumes supported through Service - Replicate Material From Matmas IDoc In ?- The replication of weights and volumes through Service - Replicate Material From Matmas IDoc In is not supported. - You can transfer the Quantity related data to ByDesign using the ByDesign Material Web Services ManageMaterialIn.- - Please follow the below blog for reference :- - https://archive.sap.com/discussions/thread/3700821-6. Is it possible to delete the Root Level of the Product Category Hierarchy?-Once you create and save the root level (Product Category), it is not possible to delete it. The reason for not allowing deletion of the root level is that it will generate inconsistencies in the system.-7. Delete or Rename a Sub Product Category Hierarchy?-It is possible to rename and delete a Product Category and its sub category, once it is saved.-For more details refer the KBA: 1576686-8. Is it possible to delete a Material or Service Product Master Data?-You cannot delete a Material or Service Product Master Data.-For more details refer KBA: 1411361-9. Is it possible to create more than one Root Product Category Hierarchy?-It is not possible to create more than one Product Category Hierarchy.-10. Is it possible to change the ID of a Product or Material?-It is not possible to change the ID of a Product or Material. You can block them and create new Product or Material.-11.  Is it possible to increase the length of Material Description above 40 characters?-It is not possible to have more than 40 characters in the Material Description field. But you can maintain additional information about the material in the field details.-For details refer KBA: 1602248-12. Is it possible to change Base UoM for Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation and Valuation of a Material?-Once you activate the Base UoM for Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation, and Valuation, then it is not possible to change the value.-13. is it possible to add a new Unit of Measure for Quantities?-Yes it is possible to add a new Unit of Measure for Quantities.-For details refer KBA: 1675834-14. Is it possible to create Materials with same description and product category?-Yes, you can create number of materials with same description and product category because Services which ever created in the system are identified based on the service ID but not using Service description and Product category.-15. Why you are unable block Planning Area in Logistics, Planning and Availability Confirmation for a Material?-Once a product is activated for a planning area/site in Planning, Logistics and Availability Confirmation, it is not possible to remove it or make it inactive. If the status is still In Preparation then you can delete the planning area from the product data.-For more details refer KBA: 1617513-16. There are change in the Material and Service where the date and Changed By are available but there is no information about the source/channel through which the changes are performed-It is not possible to locate/identify the source for the changes. if you are able to find the Changed By, check with respective user for the changes.-17. Is it possible to Mass Change Attachments?-No, it is not possible. Instead, you can replace the attachment manually in each product master data-18. Can we delete HSN Code ? Any material in General Tab-No It is not Possible to delete the HSN Code on the screen, You can Only remove and keep the entry as null and save.-Even the code is in the mass data maintenance, Even HSN code is there, it is not possible to nullify a field through mass data maintenance.-1989198 - Is it Possible to Nullify a Value in a Field in Material Master Data [KBA for reference.]-19. Is it possible to enhance Detailed Description of a Material / Service?-No, The Detailed Description of a Material / Service can only be created (Migration Mode: Add New Records) using Migration Workbench and cannot be updated using Mass Data Maintenance.-To update/create use either the UI or can be changed using OData services.-The field 'Text content' in TextCollection (Detailed Description) is PSM released and should be available to update from OData.-20. Why is the material appearing in the Incomplete Materials query?-The Incomplete Materials tab in the Product Data -> Products view shows materials which have at least one status entry as not active. These status entries could be inside the Sales, Valuation, Planning or other tabs inside a given material.-Once all status entries are set to active, the materials should be complete and not appear in the Incomplete Materials query anymore.-See Also- 2595692 - Frequently Asked Questions on Accounts and Suppliers Data -Keywords-FAQ, Product Data, Material

Title: Journal Entry of Bank Credit Advice/Bank Debit Advice is Without Employee Details
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have posted Bank Credit Advice along with the employee details filled but the resulted journal entry doesn't show the employee information enterted during the advice creation.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Bank Payment Advices.-Fill the selection and from Personalized settings add employee details and fill the employee id.-Click on save.-Resulted journal entry will be posted without employee details.-Cause-The employee id in the Journal Entry of Bank Payment advice is not supported by the system as of now.-Resolution-Therefore, ask the customers to put this idea in the SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence Forum and it will get reviewed by the product management team and will do this requirement in the future release accordingly if possible.-Keywords-Employee details missing in bank credit advice.-employee details in bank credit advice

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on Copy Solution Profile
Content: Symptom-Below are some commonly asked questions and their answers on Copy Solution Profile in below scenario:-You created a new test system from an existing productive system. The scenario used is Copy Of Source System (Copy Solution Profile). Now, the change project exists in the test system but is missing in the productive system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Scenario: You created a new test system from an existing productive system. The scenario used is Copy Of Source System (Copy Solution Profile). Now, the change project exists in the test system but is missing in the productive system.-1.   Is this expected behavior?-Yes, requesting a new test tenant as copy of the productive system with additional copy solution profile is the recommended way to request a new remote test system for a change project. After the import into the new test tenant, the change project is deleted in the productive tenant (which is the standard behavior for a remote change project).-2.   Is merge back supported in this scenario?-Yes, when the SPC process runs through successfully, the connections between both tenants should be established and a merge back should be possible.-3.   For this change project the field Created By in the test system shows Technical User (SAP_LMPRV) instead of the actual user who created this project in the productive system. Is this as expected?-This is added into development's product backlog for future releases.-4.   It is expected that, when creating a new test system as copy of production, all the change projects (regardless of their status) will be copied from productive system into the test system. But there the customer cannot open a canceled project.-Yes, as it is a full tenant copy all workspaces (Projects) are copied regardless of their status. We also think that this is confusing and we are considering to delete the non-relevant workspaces after the copy has been done. This is added into development's product backlog for future releases.-5.   Will all the PDI solution add-ons be copied over from the production tenant automatically?-PDI solutions deployed in the Productive tenant have to be uploaded again in the test tenant and scoped in business configuration. They are not copied automatically.-6.   Which data will be copied in this scenario?-Business configuration settings (scoping and fine tuning data) - Yes, the settings from the particular solution profile selected.-Master data - Yes, full master data-Flexibility data (customization such as extension fields) - Yes-7.   Personalisation on Home Launchpad Lost After System Resfresh-With a refresh activity, the url will remain the same, but user personalization settings will be removed. This is the standard system behavior, caused by a required isolation between source and target system, so Restore the customization/personalization settings.-8.   You are unable to access Business Configuration work center through Overview tab.Upgrade failed. Some technical issues and inconsistencies have been found in your solution profile. Please find additional information below. You can close this screen and come back later, restart the upgrade or create an incident.Technical error-There are inconsistencies in your solution. The inconsistencies might be related to a PDI solution, so to find out the nature of the inconsistencies, the backend logs need to be checked. Please open an incident.-9.   When accessing the Service Control Center to check the Solution Profile of a new requested tenant, the field Solution Profile ID is blank.-The system only shows the Solution Profile ID assigned to the tenant in the tenant from which the user is acessing the Service Control Center, so This is the expected system behavior.For the other systems that are displayed in the list of the view, the Solution Profile ID is displayed as blank.-Keywords-FAQ, Solution Profile Copy, FAQ on Solution Profile Copy

Title: Manager is Not Able to See Cases Processed by Subordinates
Content: Symptom-Manager is not able to see cases processed by subordinates.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to cases and Service Tasks view.-Go to cases sub-view.-Show My Team's Open cases and select Go.-Resolution-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign, it is not possible for the Manager to see cases processed by subordinates. This functionality will be implemented in one of the future releases of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-manager not able to see incidents/case

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on SAP Business ByDesign Organizational Management
Content: Symptom-Following are frequent queries related to Org Structures under ﻿Organizational Management ﻿work center for SAP Business ByDesign System.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. Is it possible to PSM release the Organization Center Business Object?-No, Organization Center BO can't be enabled for read or write PSM release.-Reason being the Organization center is the core BO and changes may lead to inconsistencies.-As the Applications & Customers work with the projections, not with Organizational Centers, the parent is a semantical question, for example, a company has no Parent the Org unit being a Company may have.-Net of semantic free Org units can't be used without projections. On all projections the OrgCentreAssignment is released and all semantic parents are available with OrgCentreAssignmentNode.-An Org Unit needs to be semantically called, for example, as a projection BO, and then that node is obtained using the projections and the OrgCentreAssignmentNode.-2. Can Org Units be mass deleted in the application from standard OWL?-Action for deletion is only offered in OWL for single Org Unit (only leaves are allowed to be deleted; no mass deletion).-3. If an employee has a Primary Org Unit and a Secondary Org Unit, which Org Unit is used for transactional documents?                                                           -Primary Org Unit of an employee is used for all transactional documents.-4. How many Primary and Secondary Org Unit assignments are possible for an employee?-An employee can be assigned to only one Primary Org Unit at a time and any number of Secondary Org Units.-5. Does ByDesign Org Structure have Staging Area?-Yes, Org Structure in ByDesign system has both Staging and & Planning area.-6. Why is an Org Unit able to be seen in Active Area but missing from Planning Area?-The Org Unit is deleted in Planning Area but the changes are not activated, hence the Org Unit can be seen in Active Area, but not in Planning Area. The changes made in this Org Unit can be seen via Changes tab in Active Area.-7. Is it possible to re-align the Org units?-Re-alignment of Org unit is possible only if there are no dependent data existing for the Org unit in the system.-Example: Sales Order and Fixed Assets assigned to the Org unit could be the dependent data, which prevents the re-alignment of the Org unit.-8. Is it possible to build OData Services directly on the business object Organizational Center?-SAP Business ByDesign does not offer any possibilities to build OData Services directly on the BO Organizational Center. Part of the desired data is available in MDAVs (Analytics). It is possible to build OData Services on the MDAVs.-Refer to the blogs below:-OData for SAP Business ByDesign Analytics-Using Filter and Selection Parameter in ByD OData for Analytics-9. What are the approaches to export the Org Structures?-Webservice: QueryOrganisationalCentreIn to retrieve the Org structure data through a webservice. Refer to the documentation: Query Organisational Centers-In the Org Structures view, use the Export->To Microsoft Excel option to export the Org structure into an excel.-Extract the Organizational Management information through the Data Extraction view in Application and User Management workcenter, choose the extraction object: ORG_CENTER - Organizational Structure and run the data extraction.-10. Unable to Active Org Structure for a large number of Org Units.-This happens due to time out issue. The error message displayed is, for example, "Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident."-Activate the Org Units with the option " Activate Selected and Dependent org Units in Background" with Top to bottom approach.-11. Why is an Org Unit unable to be seen in both Active and Planning Area?-You are trying to search the Org Unit Effective From past date. If the Org Unit is valid from DD.MM.YYYY, then it cannot be searched it before this date in Active or Planning Area. Hence, select relevant Effective From date in Org Structure screen.-12. The error "Cannot edit org. unit, the org. unit is currently being edited by user SAP_SYSTEM." is received when an attempt is made to edit and activate an org unit.-One of the reasons for the above error is because during the night, the replication of employees from EC to BYD is executed by user SAP_SYSTEM. The user will lock the org structure every time an employee is assigned to the org structure. This lock can be raised for quite some time especially in case of higher level managers. If this interferes with the maintenance of the org structure in the morning, the replication jobs could be scheduled to an earlier time in the night.-13. Is it possible to maintain the org unit name in multiple languages (for example, English when logging in with language English, German when logging in with language German)?-No. The org unit names are not logon language dependent. This means that whatever is entered as the org unit's name will be displayed in the same language of creation across all logon languages.-14. Is it possible to extend the length of the org unit name for more than 40 characters?-No. The restriction of Org Unit Name to 40 characters is in place because this name is also used in other business areas where name is restricted to 40 characters. For example: when creating the org unit a Company, it will create an Account or Supplier, and for these objects the Name field is restricted to 40 characters.-15. Does SAP offer a service where the SAP can update the Organization Structure, to insert a ROOT Org Unit at the very top of an existing Org Structure above the Company level Org Unit?-Business Use Case: Org Structure should have an initial Org Unit that is considered ROOT and not a true business entity. The ROOT Org Unit function allows to add new parent companies above an existing top-level parent company code.-To create an initial Root Org Unit without any business character, follow the below steps:-Go to Organizational management workcenter.-Go to Org structures view.-Edit requirement Org Structure.-Select New then select Org Structure (Check that the date is in line with the existing Org Structure).-Fill in the detail for the top Org Unit Root node (id and name) and Activate.-Select Cut option to move the existing top level Company Org Structure and Paste it below the new top Org Unit Root node created.-Activate.-With the above steps the customer should be able to create a parent unit that is not a business entity.-16. The Org Unit ID of the Group Parent Company is required to be changed from XYZ to ABC due to the change in company's legal status. -It is not possible to change the Org Unit ID of the company even from the backend. We recommend the following steps.-  1.Create a new Org Unit with the desired ID on the same level of the old company.-  2.Cut all org units under the old company and paste under the new company.-  3.Delimit the old company.--On activation, veto checks could happen if the Company is referred in business documents. It is required to resolve all inconsistencies to activate the new org structure.-17. Is it possible to roll back deleted Org units?-The Roll Back feature can be used before activation to restore deleted org units. Once the Org units are deleted and activated, they cannot be restored.-18. Is there a limit on the number of Org Units can be maintained in the Org Structure?-There is no hard limit, however it is recommended to stay below three thousand.-19. The Job Definitions cannot be translated using the Language Adaptation Tool in the organizational work center.-The Job's name cannot be translated in the Job Definition using the Language Adaptation Tool. Hence, it will show only in English.-20. Can multiple Cost Center Managers be Assigned in the Org Structure or suggest if there are any Work around for this requirement?-It is not possible to maintain multiple Cost Center Managers. It is only possible to maintain one Manager per Cost Center in Organizational Management, as per the standard system design.-Keywords-Org Structure, Organizational Management, FAQ, FAQ Org, Org unit faq, org unit, frequently asked question, cannot edit ORG unit, the ORG unit is currently being edited by user SAP_SYSTEM

Title: How to Find Retention Time of Application Logs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The application logs are automatically deleted after a certain period of time for the performance improvement. You want to know the retention time of the application logs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For example, error 'Application log information for this run is not available' occurs when displaying log of outbound file because it's automatically deleted for the performance improvement.-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Outbound Files view.-Show All Outbound Files and find XXX(XXX represents the file ID).-Click on File ID XXX.-Click on View All.-Click on Display Log button.-Error 'Application log information for this run is not available’ occurs.-Then, you would like to know the retention time of the application logs.-Resolution-There is a table (APPLOG_D_DET_DES) which stores information about retention time of application logs. Based on Object Type Code we can search for the retention period of that particular document.-Go to backend and execute transaction SE16.-Enter the Table Name APPLOG_D_DET_DES.-Click on Display Contents(F7) button.-Enter the OBJECT_TYPE_CODE YYY(YYY represents the object type code) and click on Execute(F8) button.-You can see, for OBJECT_TYPE_CODE YYY, M_MONTHSDUR is ZZ(ZZ represents the number of MONTHS), which means the retention period is ZZ months.-Keywords-Application logs, retention

Title: Download/Export Cases or Content from a System
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--You want download or export the cases & its content including attachemnts in any of the form like Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PDF and etc.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-The SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer systems currently does not have such a functionality or report where you can download the cases content & attachement.-However you can dowload/export the cases into Excel format from your SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer systems.-To Export cases from the SAP Business ByDesign System please follow the below steps:-Login to your system-Go to Application User and Management work center (In SAP Business ByDesign)-Go to Administrator work center (In SAP Cloud for Customer)-Click on cases view-Set the filters as per your requirement & Click on Go-Click Export button to export the data into Excel sheet-Other way to download this excel sheet is from the SAP for Me (S User is required to login to SAP for Me tool)-You can login to the SAP for Me-Set the filters based on your requirement-Click on Download-Exported excel sheet will have the data for these fields: Status, Internal case ID, Priority, Subject, Reported On, Provider Solution, Requester, Company, Processor, External Reference ID, Partner ID, Partner Name, Partner SOlution Status, System URL and etc. as shown below-If you want to download the case content, the only way possible way is from SAP for Me. Follow the below steps:-You can login to the SAP for Me-Set the filters based on your requirement-Select the case and Open it-Click on PDF icon and it will be downloaded accordingly-See Also-Download the case Content in the PDF format-Blogs:-All About case in SAP Business by Design(ByD)-All About case in SAP Cloud for Customer(C4C)-Keywords-Download case, Export case, Export case Content, Download case Content, case Content, case Attachment, ByD, C4C

Title: Payment Allocation Posting Failed Because it is Locked
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -After the customer reports a dump while posting a Payment Allocation, you notice that the posting button is greyed out in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Payment Management Workcenter.-2. Go to the Payment Allocations View.-3. Search for Payment Allocation XYZ ( XYZ stands for the Payment Allocation ID) with status in Preparation.-You can see that the payment amount is allocated completely but the Post button is greyed out.-Resolution-Log into the Backend.-Load transaction SESFTS.-Load BO by Proxy Name : FOPXP_PAYAL.-Click on Load by Query and then Load FOPXP_PAYALHD - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Search for Payment Allocation XYZ.-Click on Actions and choose Allocate.-The following error message is raised 'Action Release not possible; action is disabled'.-Now load transaction SM12.-Click on the List button.-Check if Payment Allocation XYZ is locked.-Select the locked Payment Allocation XYZ and click on the Delete button.-Go back to the user interface and check if the payment allocation is available for posting again.-Keywords-Payment Allocation, In Preparation, Status, Posting, Locked, Allocate

Title: Error Message for Payable Payment Run: Technical error FOP_MDRO 001; report an incident
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-After you execute a payment run in the Payables work center, you check the application log, and find the error message: Technical error FOP_MDRO 001; report an incident.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Payment Runs subview.-Search the payment run in question, and check the Execution Details.-Click the Application Log ID, and open it up.  -You can see the error message mentioned above.-Resolution-The error message itself does not give you any solution advice, you may check the batch job of the run, and see if there is any information provided there:-First of all, take note of the Technical ID of in the Created By field.-Log on to the backend.-Execute Transaction Code: SM37.-In the User name field, enter the Technical ID for the user.-In the Job start condition, specify the From and To date accordingly.-Execute the selection.-Tick the run that is canceled, and click Job log.-You could see the error message: Payment is not possible: payment data missing for XYZ (XYZ represents the supplier ID).-Go to the master data of the supplier XYZ, and check the Financial Data.-Under Payment Data, you could see that no Payment Method is maintained, and this is the root cause.   -You need to maintain the Payment Method here, and execute the payment run again.- So when the error message in the application log of a payment run is too technical, you can check the run details via SM37.-Keywords-payables; payment run; Technical error FOP_MDRO 001

Title: Tax Exemption Reason Maintained at Product Master Data is Not Considered In Sales Order For Country-CH
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the tax exemption reason in the product master for country CH for respective Regioen, however the ystem still selects default tax on the product in Sales Order without sonsidering the tax exemption.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Sales Orders.-Choose the view Sales Orders.-Search for Sales Order ABC (ABC represents sales order ID)-Open the order and go to View All.-Navigate to tab Items and sub-tab Taxes.-Here it can be seen that the system chose an default Tax Rate for the product.-Cause-If you go to the material master data here you can see that the field Region is maintained. Please keep this field empty as we don’t have region based tax calculation for CH - all regions have same rate and same behavior. if the region is maintained, then the system cannot determine the tax code properly. If you keep this field empty, it will do.-Resolution-Go to the product and Service portfolio work center.-Choose Products view-Find the Product.-Choose edit button and open it.-Open it in mode View All.-Navigate to the tab Taxes.-Here under Product tax classification view remove the Region field.-Keywords-Sales Order, Tax Exemption region, Product master data, Region.

Title: Error message on Sales Order:" Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Account permitted"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Items cannot be removed from a Sales Order: using the remove button provokes a dump.-The Sales Order cannot be canceled.-Several error messages are displayed:--Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Account permitted-Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Ship-To permitted-Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Seller permitted-Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Sales Unit permitted-Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Payer permitted-Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Employee Responsible permitted-Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Bill-To permitted-(Where XX represents the Sales Order Items IDs)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Open the Sales Order AAA (AAA stand for the impacted Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Line Item XX and Remove it.-A dump is triggered.-Error messages for each party role are displayed: "Item XX: No more than 1 business partners of role Account permitted"-Re-open the Sales Order AAA.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Only one line is maintained for each role.-Cause-Roles are duplicated in the backend:-Open Transaction SESFTS.-Maintain SALES_ORDER as Business Object.-Navigate to Root - Query By Element-Maintain the Sales Order ID in Field ID/Content.-Select Form View to have all data on one line.-Use the Navigate button and go to ITEM.-Navigate to the ITEM_PARTY node.-Click execute on the prompt.-In PartyKey/PartyTypeode, you can see that roles are duplicated.-Resolution-If the Delivery Status and Invoice Status is Not Started for Line Item XX, then inform customer to remove the line item XX and add a new Line Item with same product details.-Else check with Development Component AP-SLO-SO if the Sales Order can be corrected or canceled.-Keywords-sales orders, party role, duplicate, BO test shell, item node, ITEM, item party, item_party, dump, business partners, return

Title: The Reason for Rejection Field is not Editable on the Sales Order Header
Content: Symptom-The Reason for Rejection field is not editable on the sales order header-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the General tab.-The Reason for Rejection field is not editable, hence the sales order cannot be canceled at header level.-Cause-The Reason for rejection field at header of the sales order could be set/editable only if the delivery status for all items is Not Started, else it remains un-editable and items need to be canceled individually.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Select each item individually and set the Reason for Rejection.-Save your changes, this will set the status of the Sales Order to Completed.-Keywords-Sales Order, Reason for rejection, Header level;

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-Below are a few commonly asked questions and their answers on Mass Data Maintenance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Following are the generic queries on Mass Data Maintenance:-Can you delete a file which has been imported in Mass Data Maintenance?--No, you cannot delete a file once it has been uploaded and processed in Mass Data Maintenance.--You are processing files using Mass Data Maintenance and there is no Delete button to delete an unsuccessful file. You want to understand if there is an option to delete the failed files.--No, it is not possible to delete any unsuccessful or failed files from Mass Data Maintenance.--Can you re-use the file which has errors during import in Mass Data Maintenance?--Yes, you can re-use the file which has errors while importing the data. You can perform the required changes and re-import the same file.--Can we use control characters in Mass Data Maintenance import file?--No, C4C does not support control characters. Hence, the text  following the control characters are skipped in the UI. Example: "", /, etc.--How to display special characters in .csv export file?--Special characters are not supported in unicode and CSV files are generated with unicode encoding. Open the exported file in text format in a notepad to show the special characters properly.--How to change Mobile number or Phone number in Address facet of Accounts?--You can use Mass Data Maintenance. However, if you have to change any of the fields using Mass Data Maintenance, you need to fill all the existing values for Mobile, Fax and E-mail in the import template as they are connected with single node. Else, the existing values can be lost from the master data.--I have removed the file header, why can't I use it?--The header in files downloaded from Mass Data Maintenance is used to identify if these files are valid for use in this tool. If you remove the header, the file cannot be used anymore.--Is it possible to use decimal notation and csv delimiter as the same character?--No. If the decimal notation is the same as the csv delimiter, then the mass data maintenance will try to delimit the values with the decimal notation, resulting in an error with the csv.--You are unable to update extension fields in Material Object via Mass Data Maintenance. Import is successful but no records updated.--There are a few mandatory fields that need to be filled in this template:-General: Language-General: Product Category ID-General: Base UoM-Error in backend: Processing canceled due to data inconsistency.---What is the maximum number of records for any given operation in Mass Data Maintenance?--Since the Mass Data Maintenance tool utilizes SOAP webservices to execute the update operations, it has the same constraints of the service interface in terms of timeout and amount of data that can be processed in a single request.-Based on this, the maximum number of records will vary by the business object being operated, as well as the amount of data being modified (for example, a file updating only an ID and a single text field will likely support more records than a file updating several text, numerical and ID fields).--For most operations, it is possible to take 5000 as the baseline for the maximum amount of records in a single Mass Data Maintenance run.--How to change the position of field in Mass Data Maintenance?--Left click the field that needs to be moved and hold on the left click. Then the position of the field can be adjusted.-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, FAQ on MDM, frequently asked questions on Mass Data Maintenance, mdm FAQ

Title: You are not Able to Release the Customer Demand Due to Error Message: 'Release order not possible,Sales order ABC Item XYZ Blocked'
Content: Symptom-You are not able to release the Customer Demand due to the error message: Release order not possible,Sale order ABC (ABC represents the Sales OrderID) Item XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order Line Item ID) Blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to the Customer Demand view.-Find the Customer Demand ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order for which the Customer Demand has been created).-Select the Release button.-The system triggers the error: Release of order not possible,Sales Order ABC item XYZ blocked.-Cause-You have maintained in the Sales Order the Payment method as Credit card, but the credit card information is not maintained for the account for which the Sales Order has been created.-Hence the Authorization of the credit card maintained in the Sales Order cannot be triggered, which results in the Delivery Block of the Item.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Find the Account DEF (DEF represents the Account ID).-Select the Edit button and select General button.-Go to the Financial Data tab and select the Payment Data subtab.-In Payment Methods heading, select the Add Row button and choose payment method as Credit Card.-Go to the Bank Data subtab.-Select the Assign button under Credit Cards heading and maintain the credit card information.-Save the Account.-Keywords-Delivery Block, Customer Demand, Credit Card, Payment Method

Title: Error Message "Similar Entry for Supply Planning area already exists"
Content: Symptom-When you try to perform migration mode Enhance Existing Records for Material migration, system throws below error message:-Similar Entry for Supply Planning area already exists-Note: The Enhancement is for Planning Area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Materials-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-If you are trying to enhance the existing Planning Area with the Planning Area details then it is not possible.-The Structure is as follows,--The structure is like this:----> Planning tab----->Planning Area ** Child to Planning------>Planning Area details ** Child to Planning Area .--The 2nd level child node can not be maintained until data is being maintained for 1st level child in the same file.--If the Planning Area is already maintained then Enhancement of Planning Area details cannot be done through Migration.-Resolution-You can use Mass Data Maintenance to Modify the Planning Area details.-Keywords-Error Message, Error, Similar Entry for Supply Planning area already exists, Migration of Materials, Enhance, Materials,

Title: Custom form of Balance Sheet and Income Statement is not considered
Content: Symptom-After creating custom form for the form template group Balance Sheet and Income Statement named e.g. "New Balance Sheet", the form is not considered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the workcenter Application and User Management.-Open  the view Form Template Maintenance.-Here search for the group of forms Balance Sheet and Income Statement. -Upload your custom form named e.g. "New Balance Sheet".-Now setup a rule for the new Form variant:-Open  the view Form Template Selection and chose a rule in the section Balance Sheet and Income Statement.-Configure the form rule for template e.g. "New Balance Sheet".-This configuration should pick only the new form "New Balance Sheet" now.-To create the report: -Go to workcenter General Ledger.-Open  the view Statutory Reports and chose Report Balance Sheet and Income Statement and fill it out as needed.-Preview the report.-Only  the standard report form Balance Sheet and Income Statement is pulled regardless what you configure.-Cause-This is a reuse UI. Only Standard forms with name Balance Sheet and Income Statement will be picked.-Resolution-In case you want to use your own form, overwrite the existing SAP standard form and the changed form as you desire will be picked.-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Balance Sheet and Income Statement, Forms, Form Template Selection.

Title: Access Restriction on Workcenter View: Activities with Account Restriction
Content: Symptom-You want to set the access restriction on work center view:Activities with Account Restriction, but you find there is no option to set it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business User view.-Find one certain user and click Edit - Access Rights.-Go to the Access Restriction tab and find Work Center View ID:CRM_ACTIVITIES_1.-You find the Access Context is NONE, you cannot set restriction based on employee.-Cause-The restrictions as applied at BPM_ACCOUNTS will automatically be applicable for CRM_ACTIVITIES_1. That is why no separate maintenance is allowed for CRM_ACTIVITIES_1.-Resolution-You can set the access restriction on work center view BPM_ACCOUNTS. This restriction will be applied to CRM_ACTIVITIES_1 automatically.-Keywords-Business User, Application and User Management, Access Rights, BPM_ACCOUNTS, CRM_ACTIVITIES, Access Context.

Title: Error Message: Technical Error in Payment Authorization, Report an Case
Content: Symptom-You execute a payment and you receive below error messages:-Technical error in payment authorization; report a case.-Authorization failed.-Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions.---Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Select the credit card payment which is in status In Preparation.-Perform the action Execute Payment.-You get the error message: -Technical error in payment authorization; report a case.-Authorization failed.-Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions.-Cause-This is the problem with the M-User certificate validation on the service provider side.-Resolution-Contact the Payment Service Provider informing the details of the M-User Certification and the Payment Reference ID-I. Download the M-User Certificate-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Go to the Communication Arrangements subview.-Select the Communication Scenario (for example: Computop).-Click the Communication Scenario Hyperlink.-Perform the action Download Certificate to download the certificate to your local system.-Save the file with extension <.cer>.-II. Get the Provider Reference-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Select the Payment which is in status In preparation.-View the Payment and navigate to the Document Flow.-Get the customer invoice from the document flow.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select the Invoice and perform the action Edit.-In General tab under Payment click the hyperlink Authorized for Authorization Status.-From the opened screen, get the Provider Reference ID from the field Provider Reference.-Keywords-Credit card, Payment, Computop, Customer Account, Authorization, Report a case.

Title: Extension Fields of Type Amount, Quantity or Decimal Cannot be Assigned to a Data Source/Report
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field, of type Amount, Quantity or Decimal. However when you try to add your field to the respective data source or report via the further usage you get the message 'No data sources found'-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the Adaptation mode.-Add an extension field of type Amount, Quantity or Decimal.-Select the field and click the Show Further Usage link.-Click the Data Sources and Reports tab.-Instead of the list of the available Data sources and reports you get the following message: No data sources found.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed.-Resolution-The system only allows you to add an extension field as a key figure to a data source and to corresponding reports when the aggregation of the key figure and data source match. The system prevents incorrect results from being displayed in reports.-See Also-In SAP Business ByDesign: From the help center (search) you may use the following documents to find out what extension field can be added to a data source.-Data Sources Enabled for Extension Fields-Extension Fields as Key Figures-Keywords-data source, no reports found, no reports and data sources found, extension field, key figure, characteristic, not possible to add field, business analytics, extensibility, 'No reports and data sources found

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run Error
Content: Symptom-You ran a Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run and got the following error message:--"During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error 'Application runtime exception; report a case' occurred."-(ABC is the company ID.)-(DEF is the set of books ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can create Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs for payables, receivables and cash.--In the Payables work center (Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs for payables):-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Click New and select Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run.-Select the relevant Company, Set of Books and Period/Year.-Select closing step as 020 - Closing entries.-Click Start Now.-After few seconds you'll see the messages "Run XXX" finished with errors and also "Your entries have been saved" (XXX is the run ID).-Click Display Log.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-You get the message  "During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error 'Application runtime exception; report a case' occurred."--In Receivables work center (Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs for receivables):-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Search and select the relevant Run ID.-Click View-Navigate to the Messages tab.-You get the message  "During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error 'Application runtime exception; report a case' occurred."-In the Payment Management work center (Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs for cash):-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Search and select the relevant Run ID.-Click View-Navigate to the Messages tab.-You get the message  "During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error 'Application runtime exception; report a case' occurred."-Cause-There are two reasons for this issue:-The period you are running the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run should be open for closing step '020 - Closing entries'.-You have not maintained the relevant G/L Accounts and the required currencies in the Business configuration work center under Exchange Rate Differences tab.-Resolution-For the involved Period, set the allowed step as '020 - Closing entries':-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Open and Close Periods subview in the Common Tasks view.-Select Company ABC, Set of Books DEF and the Period.-Open the period for closing step '020 - Closing entries'.-Maintain the relevant G/L Accounts under Exchange Rate Differences tab in Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Click Open activity list.-Click the Fine-Tune tab.-Search for the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account determination activity.-Click Open.-Select Account Payable/ Account Receivable/ Cash under Account Determination.-Select the Account Determination Profile.-Navigate to the Exchange Rate Differences tab.-Click Add Row to maintain G/L Accounts for Gain from Foreign Currency Remeasurement and Loss from Foreign Currency Remeasurement. -In case of Cash Ledger, add the relevant Currency and maintain the relevant G/L Accounts.-See Also-KBA 2926722 - Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash Error: During Run for Company, Set of Books, the Error 'Application Runtime Exception; Report a case' Occurred-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run

Title: How to skip the pending audit step in expense reporting
Content: Symptom-You would like to skip the pending audit step in expense reporting for expense reports to go straight to in approval status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Overview.-Search for the activity Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement and open it.-Click on Edit audit and approval scenarios.-Here you can untick the Audit Required box for the desired country version.-

Title: Error 'Work package terminated due to internal error; set result' in GR/IR Run
Content: Symptom-The error "Work package terminated due to internal error; set result" occurs during the GR/IR Clearing Run for a company code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Inventory Valuation work center.-2. Select GR/IR Clearing.-3. Run the Goods Receipt and Invoice Receipt Clearing-4. The error "Work package terminated due to internal error; set result" occurs.-Cause-The issue is due to one Inactive Set of books for company code and Run was created without explicitly mentioning Set of books and system tried creating it to all Set of Books of company.-Resolution-It's Recommended to create Runs Separately for all the active Set of Books, so issue won't occur-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing Run, Error, Work package terminated

Title: Account Determination Fixed Asset Sale Gain/ Loss for Country France
Content: Symptom-In the  Fine Tune activity Account Determination you are maintaining G/L accounts for Fixed Asset Sale/Scrapping.-In the Book Value at Retirement (Gain) column you want to maintain an expense account of type COSEXP. But you can only select a revenue account of type REVGAN here.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Implementation Projects view. Here select the respective project and then click Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune phase and there search for the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination (In case your system is live already navigate to the Overview view and search for this activity. Then click Change immediately to access it).-Now go to Account determination and select Fixed Assets.-In the next screen select the respective account determination profile and then navigate to the Fixed Asset Sale/Scrapping tab.-In the Book Value at Retirement (Gain) column you want to maintain an expense account of type COSEXP;-It is, however, only possible to select a revenue account of type REVGAN here.-Cause-The system works correctly here.--Resolution-In the French accounting system the posting logic is as follows for fixed asset sale/srapping:-In case of a fixed asset sale with revenue (gain) the account determination for fixed asset always uses the G/L account maintained in Revenue from Sales of Asset (gain)  as well as the G/L account maintained under Book Value at Retirement (gain). According to the French law only  G/L accounts of type REVGAN (Revenue/Gain) have to be used here.-In case of a fixed asset sale with loss the account determination for fixed asset always derives the G/L accounts maintained in Revenue from Sale of Asset (Loss) as well as Book Value at Retirement (Loss). According to the French law G/L accounts of type COSEXP (cost/expense) have to be used in this case.-There are examples, such as the US system, where in both cases, asset sale with loss as well as asset sale with revenue, you can only use revenue accounts of type REVGAN. But in the French accounting system this is not possible. Here you have to post assets sale with loss to COSEXP accounts and asset sale with revenue to REVGAN accounts.-Keywords-Account Determination, Fixed Asset, France, REVGAN, COSEXP, Fixed Asset Sale/Scrapping

Title: Error While Migrating the Sales Notes for Materials
Content: Symptom-The system throws below error while adding sales notes through the migration of materials-"Update not possible; specified data for MATERIAL-SALES with key INTERNAL_INDICATOR = `` AND LANGUAGE_CODE = `F` does not exist"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search activity Migration of Materials.-Choose migrate materials using the migration tool.-Execute migration for the respective migration file with migration mode modify already existing records.-Error "Update not possible; specified data for MATERIAL-SALES with key INTERNAL_INDICATOR = `` AND LANGUAGE_CODE = `F` does not exist" during the simulation step.-Cause-It is not possible to use migration mode modify already existing records to add sales notes for existing materials.-Resolution-In order to add the sales notes for the existing materials, use the migration approach with migration mode enhance already existing records or Mass Data Maintenance tool.-Keywords-Migration of Materials, Sales Notes, Error, Update not possible, Mass Data Maintenance.

Title: Unable to Update the Business Communication Field in Service Agent records
Content: Symptom-Updating Business Communication fields for a service agent is not possible as the fields are greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partners Workcenter.Select the subview "Service Agents."-Change the view to "Show All."-Search for the desired Service Agent.-Click "Edit" button.-In the General tab, the Business Communication fields are greyed out.-Cause-The Business Communication fields are greyed out because the Main Address for the Service Agent is not maintained.-Resolution-To enable updating of Business Communication, please maintain the Main Address for the Service Agent.-Navigate to the Business Partner Data Workcenter.-Select the Subview "Service Agent."-Choose the desired Service Agent.-Click "Edit" button.-Navigate to the "Addresses" tab.-Select "Add Row" and enter the required address details to maintain a Main Address.-Once this is completed, the Business Communication fields will be editable.-Keywords-Business Partners, Service Agent, Business Communication

Title: Error Message: Sales Organization missing in the organizational Structure, While Activating an Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-When you try to Check or Activate an Organizational Structure, system throws below error message:-Sales Organization missing in the organizational Structure-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Check or Activate the org Structure.-Cause-The cause for the error message is that you have scoped your system for Sales but there is no Sales Organization in the Org Structures.-Resolution-So, it is required that you should have a Sales Organization defined in the Org Structure.

Title: Employee Replication Fails With Error Message: Custom Code 1 Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are performing Employee Master Data replication from a legacy system and get the following error messages:-Replication failed for remote Employee XX(XX represents Employee ID) from system HCI(HCI is a Legacy System).-Save failed.-Custom code 1 missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work centre.-Go to the Employees sub view in the Import view.-Select Remote Employee ID XX and click Edit.-In the Employee Replication Request: XX, click on the Replicate button.-The error messages are:-Replication failed for remote employee XX from system HCI.-Save failed.-Custom code 1 missing.-Cause-Custom Codes has been set to mandatory in the below path.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview.-Click open the Activity: Account Assignment Types.-Click on Maintain Account Assignment Types.-For Account Assignment Type: ACC, the Available Account Assignments:CUSTOM_CODE1 - Custom Code 1 is maintained as 1 - Mandatory in the Data Input Control field.-As a consequence, values for Custom Codes are mandatory during maintenance of any Cost Assignment. But Custom Codes are not supported in Expense Arrangement Cost Assignment UI. Since Expense Arrangement is maintained in background during employee replication, the replication fails with error message, Custom Code 1 missing.-Resolution-Open backend-Start SE16 t-code.-Enter Table HCF_I_SUP_PROC.-Create entry APERM SEACB with value ‘X’ or set value to ‘X’ if this entry already exists.-How to know if the entry exists or not:-Press the Table of contents icon-Click on Execute-Message: No entries found-How to create the new entry:-Enter Table HCF_I_SUP_PROC-Click on Create entry icon-For GroupID enter APERM-For SemID enter SEACB-Value enter X-Press Save-Effect: Creation of Cost Assignment is suppressed during creation of Expense Arrangement.-As a consequence, there is no default Cost Assignment during creation of Expense Reports and cost assignment must be entered manually for each Expense Report.-See Also-2075468 - Generic Custom Code As Deviating Cost Assignment Is Missing During Expense Report Creation-Keywords-Employee Replication, Custom Code, Account Assignment

Title: E-mail Notification Cannot be Read Due to Unknown Characters
Content: Symptom-You are receiving incident notification from SAP with the subject in your own language, but the text content is in foreign language (oriental encoding).-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This behavior is related to Content conversion, Mailbox Transport Delivery service on Mailbox Server.-Resolution-You must to check outlook encoding.-Click on “file”.-Select “option” and go to “advanced” view.-Scroll down the page until “international options”.-You can check the attached screenshot to take as reference how to configure it.-  Keywords-E-mail Notificiation, Encoding , Unknown Characters , Oriental

Title: Payment Document ID Reset to One (1) With New Calendar Year
Content: Symptom-Payment document number is reset to one (1) for the documents posted in new calendar year.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view and check the latest payment posting Document ID.-The document IDs of new payments created in the new calendar year are restarted to one (1).-Cause-The system resets the Payment Document IDs with change of every calendar year.-Resolution-System behavior is built in such a way that the payment document IDs are reset with the change of every calendar year, irrespective of whether the fiscal year variant is the same as calendar year or not.-System behaves as expected.-Keywords-Payment document id is reset to 1, payment document id is reset with new calendar year.

Title: Process Communication Error in Outbound Delivery Request INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***     -You notice that although Sales Order / Sales Kit XYZ has been released, Delivery Proposal has not been created. (XYZ means Sales kit ID)-There is a Process Communication Error Outbound Delivery Request NNN cannot process an update sent by a Logistics Execution Request. (NNN means Outbound Delivery Request ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Delivery Requests view.-Find Delivery Request NNN and View All.-In the Document Flow you will notice that there is an error in Outbound Delivery Request.-Cause-Check in the backend using T-code SRT_MONI if there are any unprocessed messages with below details:-Sender Party: LogisticsExecutionControl-Receiver Interface name: OutboundDeliveryProcessingFulfilmentIn-Error: Start dates mismatch for sales kit header XX and items.-Resolution-Try to restart the above message.
