Title: Error: Same IBAN is Maintained for Different Bank Accounts
Content: Symptom-When updating a supplier's bank details, an error message stating "The same IBAN is maintained for different bank accounts" appears, despite setting the old bank details to an old date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Navigate to the Supplier View.-Select the supplier and click on Edit.-Go to the Financial Data tab and choose the Bank Data sub-tab.-Add two different bank accounts with the same IBAN, ensuring the first bank account is delimited.-When trying to add a new row, you receive the error message: "The same IBAN is maintained for different bank accounts."-Cause-Currently, there is a constraint that makes it impossible to maintain the same IBAN for different bank instances.-(Note: "Instance" here refers to two records for the bank directory entry, which you maintain under Liquidity Management > Master Data > Bank Directory.)-Resolution-To remove/delete the bank entry from the supplier, create a new line. For audit reasons, this change will be visible in the change history, thereby sufficing audit requirements. -Additionally, consider using the same instance of the bank directory entry by updating it with the new details (such as the name, etc.)-Keywords-IBAN, Bank Accounts,

Title: Not Able to Complete the Migration due to an Exception During Import
Content: Symptom-You require to complete the Migration of any Object XYZ (where XYZ represents the Migration Object for example Migration of Employee and User Data). But you receive an exception during the Import:-A system error occurred during inbound processing in the target system-System Response Processing for this business object did not complete successfully-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Migration of XYZ.-Choose Migrate XYZ using the migration tool.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File.-You receive the error message in the Import step.-Cause-Issue may have been due to the number of instances being processed at a time. The Migration File size being more than 100 MB may have resulted in the performance issue. If the number of records in the Migration File are more, the performance will be relatively slow and the system will throw the exception.-Resolution-In case of such slow execution and exception, it is always advisable to optimize the Migration File. For a better performance of the migration tool, we recommend to upload the Migration File which does not exceed 100 MB.-Reduce the number of records in the Migration File and split the records into different files such that each file is not more than 100 MB and test the behavior of the file upload and execution in the migration tool.-Keywords-Inbound processing, System Response Processing

Title: Individual Materials Subtab Missing in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In purchase order, Items tab, you maintain products with account assignment as individual material.-However, you see the Individual Materials subtab is available in some purchase order (items) while some not. -Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase request and orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Open Purchase Order ABC, view All.-Go to Items tab, select an item.-Go to subtab Account Assignment, user see Account Assignment Type as IMAT -Individual Material, but cannot find the subtab Individual Materials.-Cause-When creating a new purchase order, there are 2 ways to maintain new individual material.-Option 1-Go to Items tab, maintain required information.-Go to subtab Account Assignment, select Account Assignment Type as IMAT -Individual Material.-New Individual Material button appears and create new IMAT from here.--> In this way, subtab Individual Material will not appear.-Option 2-Go to Items tab, maintain required information.-Select the item, click the New Individual Materials button above the item details--> In this way, subtab Individual Material will appear.-Resolution-If user needs to see the Individual Materials subtab, please follow the steps of Option 2.-Keywords-Individual Material, Purchase Order, Missing Tab

Title: User Who Has No Write Access To Bank Directory View Can Modify The Value
Content: Symptom-The user ABC who has Restricted or Unrestricted write access to Suppliers can modify the supplier Bank Directory data, even if there is no write access to Bank Directory view (ABC represents the user ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for user ID ABC.-Click Edit , Access Rights.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-See that user ABC has Restricted or Unrestricted write access to Suppliers view and has no write access to Bank Directory view.- Then,-Log on with user ABC.-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Select any supplier and click on Edit-Financial Data.-Under Bank Data subtab, double click on the bank ID.-In the Bank Directory Entry view, it is possible to edit the bank information.-Cause-The behavior occurs when the Supplier Bank Details authorization is still assigned to the business user through the relevant business role and work center and view assignment settings.-To verify this, navigate to Application and User Management and check whether the Supplier Bank Details authorization has been removed from the relevant business user's access rights and business role assignments.-If the authorization is assigned (checkbox selected), the user is allowed to maintain and edit supplier bank details. If the authorization is not assigned (checkbox cleared), the user is not allowed to edit supplier bank details.-Resolution-Option 1: Verify Access Rights Through Work Center and View Assignment-1. Go to Application and User Management work center.-2. Navigate to the Business Users view.-3. Select the relevant business user.-4. Choose Edit , Access Rights.-5. Open the Work Center and View Assignment subview.-6. select the relevant work center, such as Supplier Base.-7. Expand the available views and select Supplier Bank Details.-8. Check the Assigned to User checkbox status:-   - If the checkbox is selected, the user is authorized to edit supplier bank details.-   - If the checkbox is cleared, the user is not authorized to edit supplier bank details.--If the Assigned to User checkbox is greyed out or cannot be modified in the Work Center and View Assignment view, follow option 2.-Option 2: Verify Access Through Business Role Assignment-1. Go to Application and User Management work center.-2. Navigate to the Business Users view.-3. Select the relevant business user.-4. Choose Edit , Access Rights.-5. Open the Business Role Assignment view.-6. Identify and select the business role that should be reviewed.-7. Open the business role and choose View All.-8. Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment within the business role.-9. select the Supplier Base work center.-10. Find the Supplier Bank Details authorization.-11. Review the assignment:-    - If the checkbox is selected, the business role grants authorization to edit supplier bank details.-    - If the checkbox is cleared, the business role does not grant authorization to edit supplier bank details.-After adjusting the authorization settings as required, the system behavior will align with the configured access restrictions.-Keywords-Bank Directory, Write Access, Supplier Base

Title: Broadcast does not show report filter
Content: Symptom-The broadcast does not show the report filter set in the selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the report and create the filter via the Additional Filters feature.-Save the filter in the selection.-Go to the broadcast view of the same work center.-Create a new broadcast.-Maintain the mandatory fields including the selection you just created.-Start the broadcast.-The broadcast will show the selection that you made without the maintained filter.-Cause-The Additional Filter is not considered by the broadcast because this is a different technical layer.-Resolution-You need to maintain the variable in the selection.-Keywords-broadcast, selection, filter, additional AP-RC-ANA, not shown, not considered,

Title: Sales Item : Logistics area * not inventory managed
Content: Symptom-You have created a Point of Sales Transaction, but the Sales Transaction is inconsistent and when you perform a check, the system displays the error "Sales Item ABC: Logistics area XYZ not inventory managed".-ABC represent the Sales Item ID.-XYZ represents the Logistics Area ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Point-of Sales Transactions.-Select the Sales Transactions sub view.-Filter for all Sales Transactions.-Search for the relevant Sales Transaction.-Select Check button.-The system displays the following error message is displayed:-Sales Item *: Logistics area * not inventory managed.-Cause-Error message is correct.-Navigate to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center. -Go to the Locations view. -Find and select the relevant Location ID.-Click Edit Layout.-Expand the Location.-Select the relevant Logistics Area.-You can see the Inventory-Managed flag is not set for the Logistics Area. -This means the Logistics Area is indeed not inventory managed. The error message is therefore justified and correct.-Resolution-Ensure to activate the Inventory-Managed flag for the relevant Logistics Area. -System working as designed.- Keywords-POS, Point of Sales, Transaction, Inventory, managed

Title: Error "Incompatible Source File (*.csv)" during Migration Upload
Content: Symptom-Error "Incompatible Source File (*.csv)" during migration upload-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search for respective Migration activity.-Open the respective Migration activity.-Upload a *.csv file using the type of file as Upload from Text File.-Resolution-There are couple of causes that might end up in this issue. Find below the causes and steps to overcome the issue.-Case 1:-The downloaded template was originally an actual Migration Template that was later converted to a CSV file.-However, this approach will not work correctly. It is necessary to either upload the Migration Template (*.XML) or the original text file (*.CSV).-Case 2:-If the *.CSV file contains header lines or if the headers do not match the data lines.-Then remove the header lines and upload the *.CSV file without them.-Keywords-.csv, .xml , incompatible source file

Title: Suspected Data Breach
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Suspected data breach from within a customer tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-You receive an incident that pertains to a suspected data breach. Examples below:-An employee no longer with the company somehow accesses the system either from inside the company or an outside source.-An employee gives their access details to an outside source.-Resolution-SAP do not hold the transaction logs or login details for an extended amount of time. Cloud Support does not have access to this information.-It is not possible to obtain IP addresses associated to logons that are older than 24 hours.-Send the incident to the hosting queue - SAAS_BYD_C4C_CLOUD_OPERATIONS and ask them to involve our security experts to gain more information for the customer or to speak with the customer directly.-Keywords-Fraud, Breach, Data breach, suspected,

address of the account XYZ by following the below steps:-Go to Account Management Work Center.-Go to Accounts view.-In the dropdown, select All Accounts.-In the search field, insert XYZ.-Select the account XYZ.-Click on Edit button.-Click on Addresses.-Select the address line with empty data.-Click on Remove button.-Click on Save.-When changing the name of the account the dump error will no longer be displayed.-However, if it's not possible to remove the empty line address through the UI, create an incident with the AP-BP-BPT development team for the line address with empty data to be removed in the backend.-Keywords-account name, address, empty, blank, Internal Server Error, 500, byd

Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.***-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can use this to check when you can expect a new system, restore point, or copy of your solution profile to be delivered.-Go to Service Control Center Work center.-Go to Systems and Service Requests view.-Click on Service requests.                      -In the above screenshot you will see, Request ID, Request Type, Created On, Scheduled On, Status, Process ID(PID) along with the Requestor Details as highlighted in the screenshot.-Keywords-Service Request ID, Request ID, Requestor Details, Request Type

Title: How to Change Logon Language while Using SSO?
Content: Symptom-You are logging into Business ByDesign using SSO, and notice that there is no option to change the logon language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the SSO URL of your system in the browser bar.-You will automatically logon in your system.-Cause-While using SSO, the logon language is determined by the default language of the browser where the certificate is maintained, rather than the language configured in Business ByDesign.-The language setting in My Settings or in the business user's attributes do not apply as the logon languages. These languages are taken when, for example, the system sends an e-mail to the user.-Resolution-To set the logon language when using SSO login you can follow the below steps in your respective browser:-Case 1: In Internet Explorer-Go to Tools option.-Select Internet Options.-Now select Languages and select Language Preference.-Maintain here your preferred Language.-Click Ok.-Restart the browser.-Case 2: In Chrome:-Go to Settings Options in Chrome.-Click on Advanced option.-Add the required language and set this to default.-Restart the browser.-Case 3: In Mozilla Firefox:-Go to Options.-Select Content.-Under the heading Language, click the button Choose.-Now select the Language to add from the dropdown.-Click on Ok.-Restart the browser.-If the steps above do not resolve the reported issue, you can try the following steps:-Open the Business ByDesign tenant without SSO.-Select English in the logon screen and then log on to the system.-Click on the user avatar icon on the top-right of the screen.-Click on My Settings.-Click on Manage Certificates.-Click on Assign Logon Certificate.-This procedure will install a new certificate in your browser with the required language.-Keywords-Logon language, SSO, Default SSO logon, single sign-on

Title: 'AAA not assigned to any cost object on YYYY-MM-DD; excluded from calculations' Info Message Upon Execution of Depreciation Run
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Depreciation Run which finished with an Information message:-'AAA not assigned to any cost object on YYYY-MM-DD; excluded from calculations'-AAA means the Fixed Asset ID.-YYYY-MM-DD means a date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks and select the Depreciation view.-Find Depreciation Run BBB (BBB means the Depreciation Run ID).-Click Log Result hyperlink.-Go to the Messages tab.-Information message is displayed:-'AAA not assigned to any cost object on YYYY-MM-DD; excluded from calculations'-Cause-The issue happens due to the validity of the assignment interval of the referred asset AAA to its cost object.-For any asset to be included in the Fixed Asset Depreciation Run or in the fixed asset reports (for example Depreciation report), the asset's org. assignment should be valid as on the period end date.-Scenario 1:-For example: If you execute the Depreciation Run for period 012/2023, the assignment of the asset to its cost object (for example, a cost center) should be valid until 31.12.2023, not before (for example, 15.12.2023).-As a result, the asset AAA, which has pending depreciation to be posted, was excluded from the depreciation run.-Since the pending depreciation was not posted you'll come across error messages while trying to perform fiscal year closing activities, such as Balance Carryforward Step 1:-'The balance carryforward is not possible. Execute Depreciation under Fixed Assets'-'Closing of XXXX not possible. Perform depreciation run for fixed asset AAA' (XXXX means the fiscal year that you are trying to close.)--Scenario 2:-For example: If you execute the Depreciation Run for period 012/2023 for the fixed asset AAA.- Go to Fixed Assets Work Centre.- Go to Fixed Assets view and go to Fixed Assets subview.- Search for Fixed Asset ID- AAA and open it.- Go to Master Data tab and select the item and move to the Basic data - Under the All Assignments Interval- Start Date  - 01.01.2024, Valid To - Unlimited, Cost Centre - UUUU, Profit Centre - VVVV- Start Date  - 01.01.2023, Valid To - 04.01.2023, Cost Centre - UUUU, Profit Centre - VVVV- Here the Assignment Interval is missing between 2023/01/04 and 2023/12/31 for Cost Centre - UUUU, Profit Centre - VVVV- (UUUU represents Cost Centre name and VVVV represents Profit Centre name)-Resolution-For Scenario 1:-You should extend the validity of the assignment interval for fixed asset AAA and its cost object to be valid as on the period end date.-Afterwards, you should execute a new Depreciation Run, which will post the pending depreciation amount for the asset.-Finally you should be able to execute the Balance Carryforward Step 1 successfully.---For Scenario 2:-You should assign the missing interval to the Fixed Asset AAA. If the add option is greyed out, then this has to be done by SAP Support: please create a case to SAP Support with your upfront approval to perform the necessary action.-Once the missing interval is added successfully, then the Depreciation Run can be performed for the fixed asset AAA.-Finally you should be able to execute the Balance Carryforward Step 1 successfully.-Note: If you are dealing with Right of Use assets, these are tied to lease contracts. The org assignment is not defined in the asset, rather it is copied over from the relevant lease. In the Leased Objects tab, you'll see an org assignment table, which is where you should add the new org assignment validity.-Keywords-Fixed Assets; Depreciation Run; Error message; Interval missing

Title: Approval task is not displayed for the approver
Content: Symptom-A user who is the approver for the expense report cannot see the approval task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Select View Approvals.-Show Open Tasks.-Result: The approval task for expense report ID XXX(XXX represents the expense report assigned to the approver) is not showing even though the expense report is in pending audit status.-Cause-The root cause for the missing approval task is that the expense report is still in status 2 Pending Audit. In this status only the Review Expense Report task exists which must be executed first by any auditor. Only if any auditor has executed this Review Expense Report Task and accepted the expense report then the status will be in status 3 Pending Approval and the Approval Task will be created and sent to the approver’s work center Managing May Area. -Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. You first need to accept the Expense Report and the approval task will appear.-Keywords-pending audit.

Title: Derivation of debtor ID in Journal Entry Voucher Upload via Excel
Content: Symptom-You uploaded a Journal Entry Voucher from Excel and notice it is showing debtor ID data in the corresponding Journal Entry even though this field is not maintained in the Excel file.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Select Journal Entry Vouchers.-Search for ID XXX(XXX represents the ID of the Journal Entry Voucher) and open it.-Click on the Journal Entry link.-Result: The Field debtor ID is filled in.- Cause-In this specific case, the debtor ID is derived from the project.-To find debtor details you can follow the below navigation:-Click on Project ID >> Sales Tracking >> Document flow >> Sales Order (In the sales order, under the Account details: Debtor name is mentioned).-Or Project ID >> Customer details, it is showing the debtor details.-Resolution-Standard system behaviour. Consult the Cause section for the understanding of the derivation.-Keywords-Debtor derivation

Title: Error "Business partner X already exists" When Trying to Create a Supplier
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a Supplier, the system shows an error message stating: "Business partner X already exists" (where X represents the Business Partner ID). Despite searching for the ID in the Suppliers View using the 'All Suppliers' option, it was not possible to find the business partner with the same ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner work center.-Enter Suppliers View.-Click 'New' button and select 'Supplier'.-In supplier ID field provide the desired ID.-Fulfill the field 'Name". -Click Save.-The error message "Business partner X already exists"  is displayed. -Cause-The supplier ID X was created, but it was not approved. As a result, it is currently listed under the potential supplier menu. However, even though it is listed under the Potential Suppliers menu, the ID is not triggered when using the "All suppliers" selection filter in the Business Partner Work Center - Supplier View. This is because its status is different from that of active suppliers.-  In the procurement process, suppliers typically progress through stages from potential to active. Supplier ID X, displaying in the potential supplier menu, indicates that it has not yet completed the necessary steps to transition into an active supplier status. It remains in a potential supplier until it is formally submitted for approval and subsequently approved. Only after these steps have been completed does X transition into a fully-fledged supplier.- Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-ID, Creation, BP, Supplier, ID, ByD

Title: Outbound Delivery Invoice Request Displays the Price in as Net Even Though the Related Sales Order has the Price in Gross
Content: Symptom-When you open Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC via the Edit Button, the Price in is displayed as Net even though the related Sales Order XYZ has the Price in Gross.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center. -Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC (ABC represents the Invoice Request ID).-Click on the Edit button.-In the General tab of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC you can see that the Price in is selected as Net even though the Sales Order XYZ on which the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is based on has the Price in Gross (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-For Outbound Delivery Invoice Requests, the price information is determined from Sales Order Invoice Requests, when invoicing the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.  -This is also the reason why there is no price information displayed in the Invoice Requests OWL (Object Work List). The reason why you see the Price In Net displayed when you edit the Outbound Delivery Invoice Requests even though the Sales Order was created with the Price in Gross, is because the Invoice Requests have the Price in Net set as a default. You can see this also if you create a New Manual Invoice Request in the General tab before you enter any data.-Resolution-You can therefore ignore the Price in Net setting in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC.-When you invoice Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC the pricing information is taken over from the Sales Order Invoice Request XYZ and the Invoice will have the Price in Gross.-Keywords-Price in; Gross; Net; Pricing; Invoice Request; Gross Price; Net Price; Gross Value; Net Value

Title: Cost Distribution adjustment does not reflect in Services Receipt ID/Item of Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When creating a Supplier Invoice and adjusting the Cost Distribution, you have noticed that the Services Receipt ID does not match what you have done under Cost Distribution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example:-You have created a Purchase Order (PO) ABC with Service maintained under Item Type. This PO contains 15 hours of billable work.-Now you create 3 Goods and Service Receipt (GSR) against this PO and release them. Their ID's are 111, 222 and 333.-Create a Supplier Invoice via Supplier Invoicing -> Invoice Entry and select "All Orders to be invoiced" and search the PO ABC. Click "New Invoice"-Under Items tab -> Cost Distribution sub-tab -> Remove the 1st and 3rd GSR's and keep only the 2nd one (222).-Under Items tab, select Basic data sub-tab: You will notice that the field "Services Receipt ID/Item" shows the wrong GSR ID 111 instead of 222.--Cause-You have created a SIV against a PO. When doing so, all the related GSR's linked with the PO will be present in the SIV under Cost Distribution.-Resolution-In order to synchronize the Data in the field "Services Receipt ID/Item", you need to select the sub-tab Cost Distribution and click "Add Open Items".-The original line entries with the 3 GSR will come back and the breakdown will be displayed as per your selection such as :-GSR111: 0%-GSR222: 100%-GSR333: 0%-After doing so, you can save the document, the field "Services Receipt ID/Item" will be updated with the correct GSR ID (222).-Please note, this synchronization can be done before or after posting the SIV. When doing so after posting the SIV, a related log entry will be created and visible in the Changes tab of the SIV.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Purchase Order; Cost Distribution; Services Receipt ID/Item; Goods and Service Receipt

Title: Project Incurred Cost Is Posted To Wrong G/L Account
Content: Symptom-In the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report the ITD Planned Cost is posted to the G/L Account External Activities but ITD Incurred Cost is posted to the G/L Account Cost of Sales.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Reports List view.-Select the Report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure.-Open the report and run with the Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Pull the G/L Account into the rows here and you will see ITD Incurred Cost is posted to the G/L Account Cost of Sales instead G/L Account External Activities.-Cause-New Posting Logic in the Scoping which direct the system - Do you want to post the costs for sales documents to expense accounts instead of Cost of Goods Sold?-That is the reason it is still getting posted to the Cost of Sales account i.e. Cost of Goods Sold account.--Steps to correct the posting Logic:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center > Implementation Projects view-Select your Implementation Project and click Edit Project Scope-Go to step 4 -Questions-Under Scoping Elements, navigate Financial and Management Accounting > General Ledger > General Ledger-Select the Question 'Do you want to post the costs for sales documents to expense accounts instead of Cost of Goods Sold?'  - Check it and then finally click the Confirmation button.-Once the above mentioned changes are performed you can see in the report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure project expense ITD Incurred Cost is posted to the G/L Account Cost of Sales instead G/L Account External Activities.-Resolution-Standard system behavior.-See Also-KBA 2599581 - Cost Of Sales Tab Missing In The Subledger Sales-Sales Information for Income Statement by Nature of Expense (Posting to COGS Accounts)-Keywords-Project, ITD Incurred Cost

Title: Field Missing in Mass Change Functionality
Content: Symptom-You are trying to massively update objects in the system using the Mass Change functionality, however you notice that some fields are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this case, we will take the Materials object as an example:-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Enter the By Materials view.-Perform the desired query for materials to be changed.-Click on the Mass Change button.-Here you notice that a specific field is missing.-Cause-The field may be hidden via adaptation.-Resolution-In order to check all fields available for mass change, and control which fields appear, you can follow the below steps:-Note: These steps will also consider the Material object as an example.-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Enter the By Materials view.-Perform the desired query for materials to be changed.-Click on the Mass Change button.-Click on the avatar icon on the top-right of the screen.-Click on Key User Settings.-Click on Start Adaptation Mode.-On the right panel, enter the Unamed Table section of the screen.-Here you can control the fields which appear in the mass change screen for this specific object.-Keywords-Material, Account, Employee, Modify

Title: Unable to remove Quantity Conversion due to Error "Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists"
Content: Symptom-When you try to modify or delete a Quantity Conversion in a Material, system throws below error-Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Master Data work center-Go to Materials view-Edit a Material-Modify or remove the quantity conversion-System throws below error-Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists-Cause-You can check whether the material is used in any price list-However, even if you used the material once in a Procurement price list then it is not possible to change or delete the quantity conversion of the material. Importantly if the status of the Purchasing tab is Active or Blocked.-Resolution-Explained above is the current behavior-Only option is to create a new material or continue with the same material without changing the quantity conversion-Keywords-Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists, material, quantity conversion

Title: Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Inventories >Differences >Gain from Exchange Rate Differences - GR/IR Run
Content: Symptom-You are running the GR/IR Clearing Run and the error message is shown as:--Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Differences ->Gain from Exchange Rate Differences-XYZ means the Account Determination Group ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work center > Periodic Tasks > GR/IR Clearing Run view-Show All GR/IR Clearing Run and search for the respective Run ID-Select the Run ID and Go to Details: Log files-Click Log Result hyperlink-Go to Messages tab-The error is shown: Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Differences ->Gain from Exchange Rate Differences-Cause-G/L Account should be maintained for Gain from Exchange Rate Differences for Account Determination Group XYZ under Inventories Subledger.-Resolution-You should maintain the G/L Account for Gain from Exchange Rate Differences for Account Determination Group XYZ under Inventories Subledger by the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center > Overview View-Search and open Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity-Go to Account Determination and then to Inventories-Select the Account Determination Profile-Go to Differences tab-Maintain G/L Accounts for Gain from Exchange Rate Differences and Loss from Exchange Rate Differences for Account Determination Group XYZ.-Once you have configured the above steps, execute the GR/IR Clearing Run again, as it should finished successfully.-See Also-KBA 2085478 - 'Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Costs>Exchange Rate Differences>Gain from Exchange Rate Differences.' Error Message in GR/IR Clearing Run-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing Run, account determination group, G/L acct missing for Inventories, Exchange Rate, Account determination group G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Differences ->Gain from Exchange Rate Diffe...

Title: The Skip Approval Option is Grayed Out in a Customer Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-When selecting the Legal Approval button in the Customer Invoice ABC, the Skip Approval option is grayed out.-(where ABC represents the Customer Invoice ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Filter for All Invoice Documents.-Search for the Customer Invoice ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Select the Legal Approval button.-The Skip Approval option is grayed out.-Cause-The Customer Invoice ABC was created as a follow up from a previous Invoice in which the Legal Approval Process was completed.-Once a Legal Approval process is completed for a Customer Invoice, all follow up Credit Memos or Manual Invoices created from this Invoice should have the Legal Approval process performed. Therefore, it is not possible to perform the Skip Approval action in this scenario. -Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-See Also-Refer to the following help document for further details regarding the Legal Approval process for Electronic Invoicing in India:-Electronic Invoicing - India--Keywords-invoice, skip approval, india, legal approval, grayed out, credit memo, manual invoice

Title: How to Perform RTLC Scope Synchronization
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer is receiving the error message "Check for current merge of another project: Technical error occurred. Please create an incident" when attempting to perform a merge. Upon checking in SLG1, the following log is displayed:-"RTLC state on product tenant not finalize, project XYZ (Change Project name) merge reject."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Open the Backend.-Navigate to the BCTADM transaction.-Go to the Advanced Deploy tab.-In the Workspace ID field, select the main project.-Note: The main project should always be selected, even if it is closed.-Select the radio button Activate NW content.-Check the option Synchronize RTLC Scope.-Execute by pressing F8.-See Also-1846200 - Central Case Document for Issues Related to Merge Failed While Merging a Change Project-Keywords-Merge, Failed, Occured

Title: Error Message: 'Account Determination Missing for Item Type Tax Payables: Withholding Tax' while Releasing the Withholding Tax Return
Content: Symptom-When trying to release Withholding Tax Return but the system gives the below error message:-Account determination is missing for item type Tax Payables: Withholding Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts DEF and account determination profile . Column Path Tax->Tax Payments->Withholding Tax Payable, Item Type Tax Payables: Withholding Tax.-Release of tax return failed-(Here DEF is Account Determination Profile)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Withholding Tax Returns view.-Select your Tax Return ID and click Release.-Error message: Account determination is missing for item type Tax Payables: Withholding Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts DEF and account determination profile . Column Path Tax->Tax Payments->Withholding Tax Payable, Item Type Tax Payables: Withholding Tax.-Release of tax return failed-    Cause-The reason is that you have not maintained the G/L account for Withholding Tax Payable to the respective Account Determination Profile DEF.-Resolution-You need to maintain G/L account for Withholding Tax Payable to the respective Account Determination Profile by following below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on View button.-Under Account Determination section select Tax.-Select your Account Determination Profile DEF.-Go to the Tax Payments tab.-Click on Add Row button.-Maintain the G/L accounts for Withholding Tax Payable.-Click on Save and Close.-Now, you will be able to release the Withholding Tax Returns.-Keywords-Withholding tax return release, Account Determination Missing for Item Type Tax Payables, Withholding tax return, Release of tax return failed

Title: A Material is shown as Purchased in material view but it is displayed as In-house Production in Planning tab of that material.
Content: Symptom-The material XYZ is shown as Purchased in material but it is displayed as In-house Production in tab Planning of the material (XYZ represents the ID of the material).-Disclaimer: "Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Search for the material XYZ and notice that the Purchased checkbox is checked.-Select Edit button after highlighting the material and select View All button.-Go to Planning tab, where Procurement type is displayed as In-house production.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-In the search window, the Purchased status is checked if the Purchasing status is Active (meaning Material is active for purchasing). And the In-house is checked if the material is assigned to a Production model.-This is not to be related to the status shown in Planning tab -> Procurement Type field -> In-House Production.-See Also-Refer to KBA 1807041 - How to Enable In-House Production for a Material? for more details-Keywords-In House, production model, purchased

Title: Error "Service call failed; report an case" While Migrating Services
Content: Symptom-When Migrating Service, system throws below error message:-"Service call failed; report an case"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search for the Migration of Services activity-Choose Migrate services using the migration tool-Highlight the file to be migrated -Choose Execute Migration Step by Step-Error "Service call failed; report an case" is thrown at simulation step-Cause-There could be multiple causes for this issue. One possible cause is entering the same Company ID more than once in the Valuation sheet.-Resolution-To overcome the issue, it is advised to clean source data by ensuring that only one entry for each company is present in the template. By doing so, the migration process can be carried out smoothly without encountering any problems.-Keywords-"Service call failed; report an case", Migration, BYD

Title: No Certificate Available when Assigning Logon Certificate
Content: Symptom-When assigning a Logon Certificate, it shows error "No Certificate Available" although the browser setting is correct.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click the icon in the upper right corner.-Click My Settings -> Manage Certificates.-Click Assign Logon Certificate and see error messages.-Cause-The used client certificate does not come from a trusted certificate authority so that ByD doesn't recognize the issuer of the certificate.-Resolution-Use a valid client certificate from a trusted certificate authority. The trusted certificate authority is listed in Logon Using Client Certificate (X.509). If achieving a valid client certificate is impossible, an SAP Passport can be requested and works in this case.-See Also-3351213 - How to Download and Setup Certificate-Based Logon-1296615 - How to install the SAP Passport browser certificate - SAP for Me-Keywords-Logon Certificate, No Certificate Available, Trusted certificate authority

Title: Sales Kit Cost of Sales Associated with Wrong Profit Center
Content: Symptom-The revenue of sales kit sales order item XYZ-XX is associated with the sales kit product's profit center ABC,  derived from its product category (XYZ-XX represents the sales kit sales order item ID; ABC represents the profit center ID associated with the sales kit's header product). -However, the cost of sales are associated with different profit centers, derived from the kit's product's product categories.-You expect the cost of sales to be associated with the sales kit header's profit center. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Reports view. -Find the Sales Documents - Line items report. -In the report selection enter the sales kit's sales order ID XYZ into the Associated Sales Order field and press Apply. -Add Associated Sales order and item as well as Profit Center to the Row fields.-You notice, the sales kit's customer invoice is posted to profit center ABC, associated with the sales kit header's product. -However, the incurred costs are posted to different profit centers, for example DEF and GHI (DEF and GHI represents different profit center IDs). -You expect the cost of sales to be posted to the sales kit header's profit center XYZ. -Cause-The cost of sales for sales kits can only be derived from the kit's separate product valuation/s. -Sales kit deliveries can only be created for the sales kit's separate products. Sales Kits can never be valuated as single products. -Therefore, it is not possible to automatically divert a sales kit's incurred costs from the involved products' profit centers over to the sales kit header's profit center. -Due to the complex nature of sales kits automatic revenue (and cost) recognition, in general,  is not supported for sales kit products. -Resolution-The only way to achieve posting a sales kits cost of sales to the sales kit header's profit center is by manually assigning the sales kit items to the respective profit center before creating any deliveries: -In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Find the sales kit's sales order.-When you now select the sales order items you can see the different profit centers assigned to them in the General tab.-Press Reassign and select Profit center. -Then assign the sales kit header's profit center, here ABC to all the involved items. -If you now create a goods receipt/inbound delivery for the sales kit's products the cost of sales are all associated with profit center ABC. -Keywords-sales kit, profit center, cost of sales, sales kit's cost of sales wrong profit center

Title: Incorrect License User Types to The User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The license types of the service control center do not match the license assigned to the user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business User view-Edit the user-Go to Work center and view assignments-Expand any view assignment-User Type is XYZ Old user type (where XYZ refers to the license types, for example: SCM Enterprise User, CRM Sales team User, etc.)-However, when checking in the Service Control Center with the below steps:-Go to Service Control Center work center-Go to User Subscriptions view-The license types are categorized as:-Self Service-Core-Advanced-Cause-Customer's license model not being synced with the Central Tenant Instance (NZA System).-Resolution-In this scenario, create an incident to the development team to add the Extension 'BYD_LICENSE_MODEL=SIMPLE' to the NZA System and to the Customer Local Tenant.-Keywords-SCM Enterprise User, CRM Sales team User, Self Service, Core, Advanced, User type, License

Title: Code Correction Feature Disabled After Merging Change Project
Content: Symptom-After performing a system copy from the Production to the Test tenant, users are unable to perform hotfixes in the Test tenant. The buttons "Create Correction" and "Close Correction" in PDI for the Test tenant are disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to SDK-Navigate to Options-Notice, Create correction and Close correction buttons are disabled.-Cause-The system logic checks the tenant's role before enabling features, and it will not enable the Production bug fix functionality in any tenant other than a productive or Pre-Production tenant. This depends on the following two factors for a test tenant:-Tenant Type: Test (Role Code: 7)-System Purpose: Pre-Production (System Purpose: 03)-Since the tenant has been copied, the system purpose of the test tenant has changed, causing the production fix feature to be lost.-Resolution-In order to have the Code Correction Feature, the respective tenant should be in First Implementation project with Started status. -Important Points to Consider Before Requesting a Change of System Purpose:-Avoid Frequent Switching: It is not advisable to frequently switch between a remote test tenant and a standalone test tenant, as this can create inconsistencies.-Standalone to Remote Test Tenant: If you have a standalone test tenant and need a remote test tenant, it is recommended to purchase a new test tenant. In rare cases where test tenants are not in use and you want to reuse them, backend corrections can be made.-Change Project Status: The current change project, if closed, can be set to status "started" and decoupled from the production tenant, making it a standalone test tenant. This tenant can no longer be used for remote change projects.-Future Remote Change Projects: If you need a remote change project in the future, it is advisable to request a new test tenant for this purpose and make the necessary adjustments.-Note: This change is not recommended; changing system purpose frequently may lead to inconsistent behavior in the system. Please use the system as recommended.-See Also-3398559 - FAQs Related to Code Correction Feature That is Lost After Merging the Change Project-Keywords-Change Project, Remote Change Project, Local Change Project, Standalone Tenant, Code Correction Feature, Pre-Production, First Implementation Project, Business Configuration

Title: Multiple Languages are Displayed for an Corporate Account in Account Details Report
Content: Symptom-Multiple languages are retrieved for an Account in Account Details report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management workcenter-Go to Reports view-Select Account Details report-Notice Account: ABC has German and English language for example.-Cause-Multiple addresses are maintained for the account. You can verify this by following these steps:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Navigate to the Accounts views.-Select the Corporate Account: ABC.-Select Edit-Under the Communication tab, multiple addresses are displayed, and each address record has a language information maintained.-  Resolution-This is the expected standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Account Details Report, Account, Corporate Account, Languages, Addresses, Communication

Title: Error Message "Communication Arrangement Has Not Been Configured; Contact Your Key User" While Creating or Editing a New Corporate Account

Contact Your Key User"-Cause-The issue of receiving the error message "Communication Arrangement Has Not Been Configured; Contact Your Key User" while creating or editing a new corporate account persists, even after checking the KBA 2352446.-There is an issue due to an inconsistency in the configuration saved in the tenant.- Resolution-To resolve the inconsistency, follow the steps below.-Login to backend-Go to T-code SE16-Search for table SPAF_PA_CONF -In field AGENT_NAME , enter value REPLICATE*-Execute -If these three entries are present REPLICATE_ADR3MAS_OUT , REPLICATE_ADRMAS_OUT ,REPLICATE_DEBMAS_OUT, the issue is due to inconsistency-Now, go to Tcode SE38-Create a report "ZZ_BUP_CORRECT_SPAF_PS_CONF"-Enter the Title "ZZ_BUP_CORRECT_SPAF_PS_CONF"as shown in below screenshot and choose save-Choose Enter key in the keyboard-Then choose local object-Enter below code in report as shown in below screenshot-data: lt_spaf_pa_conf type table of spaf_pa_conf.-data: lt_agents type PRX_R3NAMES.--lt_agents = VALUE #( ( 'REPLICATE_ADR3MAS_OUT' )-( 'REPLICATE_ADRMAS_OUT' )-( 'REPLICATE_DEBMAS_OUT' )-).--SELECT * FROM SPAF_PA_CONF into table lt_spaf_pa_conf for all entries in lt_agents where agent_name = lt_agents-table_line.--LOOP at lt_spaf_pa_conf into data(ls_spaf_pa_conf).-DELETE spaf_pa_conf from ls_spaf_pa_conf.-ENDLOOP.-  Choose check(Ctrl +F2) -Execute (F8) - Direct Processing-DO NOT SAVE OR ACTIVATE this code in the tenant. -See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Integration Scenarios at SAP Help Portal-2352446 - Error Message "Communication Arrangement Has Not Been Configured; Title: Payments which is having the Posting date that exceeds the given Statement date are showing up in the Bank Statement
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to create the Bank Statement with a Statement Date as of 31.01.9999, but when you are trying to mark all the payments to be posted within that date range transactions, you see that Posting Date of 01.02.9999 was showing up. Here you are expecting to see the transactions that were processed and have Posting dates on or before the Bank statement date.-Please note: Above mentioned dates are for example.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the New bank statement sub view.-Try to create a new bank statement by giving the mandatory details under step:1 - General data.-Now go to the step:2 - Select Items.-Here you see that certain number of document ID's(Payments) are not selected.-The issue is that the given statement date was 31.01.9999, but the payment with the posting date 01.02.9999 was showing up.-Cause-While creating the Bank Statement during the step: 2 -  Select items, the payments with the posting date 01.02.9999 are showing up because the Issue date and the Posting date was not synching. -If you check under the Advices, number of documents ID's have not been checked because the Issue date and Posting date was not synching. So system is not selecting those particular payments which was having Posting date after the given Statement state.-Apart from this all the other payments within the time frame of Statement date 31.01.9999 for both Issue date and Posting date will be selected.-Resolution-Here the system is behaving as expected.-System only consider the payments which is having the time frame within or exact date of the given Statement date. When the Posting dates getting exceeded than the Statement date then it won't be selected for the confirmation.-Also these not selected payments which was supposed to be get posted on the next month of the Statement date will also be visible under Select Items but won't be checked because if you check the Issue date it will be coming under the time frame of Statement date 31.01.9999.-Keywords-Bank Statement, Outgoing Bank Transfer, Posting Date, Issue Date, Statement Date, Liquidity Management

Title: Product Searching Gives Different Result When Logging in the System With Different Languages
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When searching the product in a sales document, i.e. sales quote, you find the keywords you enter does not give any result in the product drop down list in EN lanaguage while it gives result when using JP.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login the system in EN lanaguage.-Create a new sales quote and add a new produce row.-In Product field, enter keywords 'ABC', no result found.-Then login again using JP langauge.-Create a new sales quote and add a new produce row.-In Product field, enter keywords 'ABC', there are several products found and you can select them.-ABC represents the keywords you enter in the product field.-Cause-You have maintained different product descriptions for EN ang JP lanaguage.-In the product master data, the EN langauge product description is maintained as 'XYZ', and the description for JP language is maintained as 'ABC'.-When accessing to the system in EN, system searches the product description in EN language, so the keyword ABC does not return the product. -XYZ represents the product description in EN language.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-Keywords-product not displayed; value help; search keywords; product description; language.

Title: Geolocation Not Allowed in HTML Mashups
Content: Symptom-You created an HTML mashup which needs to get the user's geolocation, but it is coming back with the message of "Error accessing geolocation: Geolocation has been disabled in this document by permissions policy.". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Mashup Authoring view.-Select the HTML Mashup you created.-Click Edit.-Click the Preview button and will see:-"Retrieving your location...-Please allow access to your location when prompted."-Open browser console, here take Chrome for example, open Developer Tools and go to Console tab.-Will see error: "Error accessing geolocation: Geolocation has been disabled in this document by permissions policy.". -Cause-HTML mashups in ByD are nested inside not one but two iframe elements. The permissions on the parent page are ok, and the permissions on the innermost iframe allow requesting of the user's geolocation (the opening iframe tag includes 'allow="geolocation *;"', which enables access to geolocation). However, this is then nested inside another iframe, and this outer iframe doesn't include this attribute, which then blocks access to geolocation.-To include the 'allow="geolocation *;"' property in the outer iframe would introduce a new feature for iframes, potentially violating security constraints. Hence currently it is not supported in ByD.-Resolution-You can register this requirement in Customer Influence for SAP Business ByDesign at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 so that our development can look into it. -Keywords-Geolocation, HTML Mashup

Title: Error "Internal Error During SAML2 Processing" While Logging Into Customer Tenant Using SSO URL
Content: Symptom-User unable to login via Single Sign On (SSO). The following messages are displayed:-The validation of message 'Response' failed. -Error in ST program SAML2_ASSERTION when importing XML data.-Diagnosis Signer/Recipient certificate is expired or not yet valid.-Signature verification failed (for signer) or Envelope failed (for recipient)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Tenant Via SSO URL-User will see Error message "Internal Error During SAML2 Processing"-Cause-Issue is with IDP certificate.-Resolution-Configuration at the IDP side should be checked thoroughly. -It is necessary to import the certificate that is used to sign the XML message (SAML Response) from the Identity Provider.-User has to download certificate and re-upload certificate again.-Contact your IDP vendor for support in acquiring the correct certificate that signs its assertions.-Refer Blog :Single Sign-On (SSO) with SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-SSO login error, internal error, certificate error, login issue

Title: Manual Posting for a Right of Use (RoU) Asset error
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform a manual posting (i.e. Write-Down) for a Right of Use (RoU) asset, however the following error occurs:-Posting not possible on valuation view XYZ; allowed for statistical view-  XYZ means the valuation view ID--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center > Fixed Assets view-Search for the required Fixed Asset ID-Click Manual Posting > Write-up / Write-Down-Enter the required information-Click Post or Simulate-Error:-Posting not possible on valuation view XYZ; allowed for statistical view-Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated-Resolution-The changes in the RoU asset depend on what you want to achieve. The changes in the RoU asset are done via changes in the corresponding lease contract. To retire this asset, you need to cancel the lease contract. A change in the depreciation amounts can only happen via a change in the lease agreement. In this case, you need to create a new lease contract version. This is to ensure that the lease contract and the RoU asset are always in sync. The base for the depreciation calculation of a ROU asset is given by the lease contract cash flow, not by any depreciation calculation within the RoU asset.-See Also-KBA 3022007 - Reverse/Change Depreciation from Right of Use (RoU) Asset-Lease Contract Quick Guide-Keywords-Manual posting, depreciation, rou, RoU, fixed asset, lease contract,

Title: Unable to Delete a Communication System after Performing a Tenant Copy
Content: Symptom-After performing a tenant copy from a productive to a test tenant, you are now unable to delete communication systems from the test tenant using the Delete button.-An error(s) will occur, for example:-Business System ABC can not be deleted. It is used in Org. Replication-Business instance ABC cannot be deleted. ID mapping exists.-(ABC represents a Communication System)-   Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management-Go to the Communication Systems view-Select the desired communication system-Try to use the Delete button-Error occurs-Cause-This is standard system behavior. -In instances where a copy has been performed from a productive tenant, there is VETO check in the test tenant prohibiting copied communication systems from being deleted.- Resolution-The solution is to make the communication system in the test system Obsolete.-Select the desired communication system-Select Edit -Select Actions-Set to Obsolete-This prohibits the communication system from being used further.-Keywords-Communication System, Delete, Tenant Copy, Test, Test System, Communication Arrangement, System can not be deleted, Instance cannot be deleted, Obsolete

Title: Error "The quantity type ABC is not permitted for the Product XYZ" is Displayed When Creating a Sales Transaction Through Web Service with a Custom Unit of Measure with Reference UoM as Liter
Content: Symptom-The following errors are displayed for a Sales Transaction document created via web service in the system.-The quantity type ZABC is not permitted for the Product XYZ-Quantity type ZABC not valid-(Where ZABC represents a Custom Unit of Measure and XYZ represents the Product ID)-Note: The Custom UoM ZABC was created with reference UoM as Liter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Point-of-Sales Transaction View.-Select the Sales Transaction sub view.-Search for Sales Transaction EDF. (where EDF represents the Sales Transaction ID)-Select Check button.-The following errors are displayed in the UI:-The quantity type ZABC is not permitted for the Product XYZ. -Quantity type ZABC not valid.-Cause-When creating a Sales Transaction through web service the Items must be passed to the system with the appropriate Quantity unitCode and Quantity TypeCode.-In case a Custom UoM with reference UoM as Liter is to be used to determine the Quantity unitCode of the Items in a Sales Transaction, then VOLUME must be used as the Quantity TypeCode-For example, the correct information to be passed in the payload should be:-<Quantity unitCode="ZABC">1</Quantity>-<QuantityTypeCode>VOLUME</QuantityTypeCode>-Note: In case the Quantity unitCode requires to be passed as l (standard UoM for Liter) for the Items in the payload, then Quantity TypeCode should also be used as VOLUME.-Resolution-This is the design system behavior.-See Also-KBA 3142954 - Point-of-Sale Transactions is Inconsistent with the Error the Quantity type ABC is not permitted for the product-Keywords-Sales Transactions, Liter, Custom UoM, Payload, POS, Point-of Sales, Quantity unitCode, Quantity TypeCode

Title: Unable to Find The Financial Payment Data Entity Set in Newly Created Custom ODATA Service
Content: Symptom-A new custom ODATA service created by using Customer Account business object.-In that ODATA services, however it is not possible to find the financial payment data entity set.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User Management work center -Go to ODATA editor view-Search for Custom OData-Edit and View all-Here the Financial Payment Data Entity Set like,-Company ID, Account Determination Group, Payment Block Reason, Payment Block Expiry Date, Dunning Block Reason, Dunning Block Expiry Date, Payment Strategy, Dunning Strategy.-  Cause-The financial payment details are associated with the customer business object.-Resolution-Financial Payment Data Entity gets stored in the 3 Business Objects.-It needs 3 BO as follows,-BO : FIA_ARP_LEDGER_ACCOUNT -> Node : Root-BO : FOPXD_TRPACCT ->Node : Root-BO : FOPXF_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT ->Node : Payment Block-All these details are coming from different Objects, so it is not possible to have it in one BO.-Contact the partner on the same as it is a custom one.-Keywords-OData, Financial Payment Data Entity Set, unable, find, company ID, FIA_ARP_LEDGER_ACCOUNT,  FOPXD_TRPACCT , FOPXF_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT

Title: Error "Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist" When Trying to Replicate Employee between SAP Business ByDesign and Success Factors.
Content: Symptom-You have started an Employee Replication Run between SAP Business ByDesign and Success Factors, however the system is returning the error below:-"Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Then go to the Employees view.-Press actions > Upload data from employee central.-Press upload data > fill in employee ID and maintain current date.-The integration now retrieves the latest data from SF for employee.-Open the employee replication file by pressing edit.-Press Replicate.-System shows the mentioned error message.-Cause-The reason for the issue is that, when we tried to query or upload an employee from the success factor to SAP Business ByDesign, we discovered that only one employment record was being retrieved from the success factor side to BYD.-In normal case, it should show 2 records in the employment section.-When we debug the issue, we found that only one employment record is coming from success factor side and same record is showing in the UI.-We simulated the identical situation within our internal system as well. Here, we are receiving all of the employment data from the success factor, and the same records it is showing in the UI as well.-Resolution-Please raise a case to the Success Factor Support team for further investigation.-Keywords-Error, Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist, Replicate, Employee, SAP Business ByDesign, Success Factors, Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible, Employee Times Exist, Master Data Replication, Upload data from employee central.

Title: The Delivery Status and Invoice Status are Displayed as Finished After a Reason for Rejection is Maintained for a Item in Sales Order or Service Order
Content: Symptom-When maintaining a reason for rejection for a item in a Sales Order or Service Order, the Delivery Status and Invoice Status of the Item automatically changes to Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Item tab.-Mark the Line Item XX (where XX represents the Line Item number).-Maintain a Reason for Rejection for the Item.-Select Save.-Close the Sales Order ABC.-Open the Sales Order ABC again.-Navigate to the Item tab.-The Delivery and Invoice status of the Item XX is displayed with status as "Finished".-Cause-Once a Item is rejected via reason for rejection in a Sales Order or Service Order with status as In Progress or Open, the Delivery and Invoice status of the Item automatically changes to Finished as per the system behavior.-Please note that there are exceptions for this scenario, for example when there is a 3PL Request document in the Sales Process, however for most of the scenarios the Delivery and Invoice status of the Item will change to Finished once a reason for rejection is set for the item.-Additional note: if a Item is canceled in a Sales Order or Service Order with status as In Preparation, then this Item will remain with status as Not Started and will not change to Finished.-Resolution-This is the current designed system behavior.-Keywords-sales order, service order, finished, item, status, in progress, not started, open, delivery status, invoice status

Title: Other Outgoing Or Incoming Payment Despite Payment Method Mapping in Bank Statement Format MT940 DE
Content: Symptom-You are adding additional External Transaction Codes for bank statement files that are based on SWIFT bank statement format MT940 DE (Germany). -Business Configuration work center.-Activity:     Automatically Generated Bank Statements / Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Format:     01 - MT940 DE-Here, for example, External Transaction Code XYZ has been assigned Debit/Credit 'Decrease' and is mapped to Payment Method 'Payment Processing - Of Outgoing Bank Transfer'.-When processing the bank statement, however, the derived Payment Method shows as Other Outgoing Payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Navigate to the uploaded bank statement via Bank Statements view.-Select the relevant bank statement and transaction.-Cause-The problem is not the application of a custom External Transaction Code and mapping to a designated payment method per se - but the conformity of the content of payment explanation blog :86: in format MT940 DE.-Here fields are delineated by characters ?00 ?20 ?30 and others. -The first field is reserved for a 3-digit External Transactions Code, others for memo-text, Payer IBAN, Business Partner Names and others. -If this is not followed and instead of ?00 any other or special character is provided - the External Transaction Code will not be interpreted and the Payment Method Mapping will not take effect. -In the absence of a mapped payment method the only information available is the Payment Direction and Amount, hence Other Incoming/Outgoing Payment. -For example: -The following content will not parse External Transaction Code XYZ in format MT940 DE:-:86:XYZ^00Text -Resolution-Adhere to pertinent specifications for SWIFT format MT940 DE. -The following content will parse External Transaction Code XYZ and the payment method mapping will take effect.-:86:XYZ?00Text -You can verify/maintain the External Transaction code as follow:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Implementation projects view-Select your Implementation Project and click Open Activity List-Search for the "Automatically Generated Bank Statements" activity and open it-Click Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements-Select the Import Format, i.e.: 01 - MT940 DE-Check if the External Transaction Code is maintained, if not, click Add Row and enter the new External transaction code-Click Save-Keywords-Bank Statement -MT940 DE-External Transaction Code

Title: Error "SAP backend is currently not available and to try later in one hour" While Creating a New Tenant Request.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When trying to create a new tenant request via Service Control Center the error "SAP backend is currently not available and to try later in one hour" is being displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Select the Systems view.-Select Request System.-Choose the required tenant request scenario.-Fill details and click ok.-Error : SAP backend is currently not available and to try later in one hour-Cause-Issue might be caused due to inconsistency in Entitlement set entry.-Resolution-This error occurs when there is duplicate Entitlement set ID entry .-For one tenant one Entitlement set ID should be assigned, but in this case there might be two Entitlement set ID assignment with the same details, hence request is failing .-Reach out to SRD-CC-CI-CCS Development team to check further and remove duplicate Entitlement Set ID entry.-Keywords-unable to create new tenant request, entitlement set ID issue, duplicate Entitlement set ID entry

Title: Product Category Showing 'Not Assigned' in the Report Profit Overview by Key Figure
Content: Symptom-You run the report Profit Overview by Key Figure for a specific period/year and notice that for some products, the Product Category are showing Not Assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Workcenter.-Go to Reports.-Find and open report Profit Overview by Key Figure.-In the Selection, enter all the required information.-Run the report.-You will see, for some Products, the Product Category are showing Not Assigned.-Cause-For the business transaction which has Overhead Costs line item, the product category is derived from cost center market segment. Here product category has to be maintained in cost center master data.-For the business transaction which has Other Direct Cost line item, the product category is derived from Market Segment of the Project.-For the rest of business transaction which does not has above two(OC & ODC line items), Product category is derived from Material/Product master data.-For manually posted JE's, product category is not derived.-Resolution-The product category will show Not Assigned in the report Profit Overview by Key Figure when the business transactions meet point 4 in the Cause or don't meet the requirements of point 1 to 3-Keywords-Profit Overview by Key Figure; Product Category; Not Assigned; 利润总览 - 按关键值; 产品类别；未分配。

Title: Case Shows Incorrect Status
Content: Symptom-You opened a case from your tenant, but have not received any reply from SAP Support yet. When you check the status of the case via SAP for Me, it does not match the status in your tenant and some notes are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the case in C4C or ByD built in support in the case sub view and check the status.-Open the same case from SAP for Me.-You will notice that the case status is not the same.-For example: the case status in a tenant shows “In process-sent to provider”.-Open the same case via SAP for Me and it shows “solution proposed” and the note from SAP is only visible in SAP for Me.-Cause-The replication of the case between the tenant and the SAP support system has failed.-Resolution-The replication between a tenant and the SAP support system runs every 10 minutes, adding a new note, will trigger the replication of notes and status change.-If this fails, please open a new case from your tenant or in SAP for Me using the component SRD-CC-CI-CCS.-Keywords-incorrect status, status not correct, case replication, case issue, SRD-CC-CI-CCS, case stuck

Title: SAP Business ByDesign Email Issues and Responsible Teams
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This document describes the issues related Email and the teams responsible to handle those issues.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Issues Development/support (AP-RC-OUT) ByD OPS (Support Component AP-RC-OUT) Application C4C OPS (Support Component LOD-CRM-ADM)-Email Configuration (UI)   Configuration such as SMTP, BSMTP in SCOT, Email infra configuration(Kronus)   Configuration such as SMTP, BSMTP in SCOT, Email infra configuration(postfix, cisco, episerver)-Error while sending Emails   Error while sending email due to configuration issue and email infra issue   Error while sending email due to configuration issue and email infra issue-Email not received by receiver Support / Ops.  Support has to check if the domain is DKIM signed or not as Support has access to DKIM tracker.  Outbound emails are not received by receiver due to email infra issue. Ops to check if the DKIM is verified or not   Outbound emails are not received by receiver due to email infra issue.--If no issues found at C4C side , We may request support to check the settings at customer side,-Also Support has to check if the mentioned IP as per the blog is whitelisted by the customer. check if the recipient is part of Suppression List and to delete the same.    -Email Domain issues Support has to check if the domain is DKIM signed or not as Support has access to DKIM tracker.  After the initial analysis, Ops to check if the DKIM is verified or not.   If required then send it to OPS.-- May require support team involvement to coordinate with customer – Eg : DKIM signing for the domain etc-Inbound-Support has to provide original email, logs from customer end which shows mail has reached ByD.-In case of any bounce, the bounce mail has to be shared.-Ops team need to check and analyze the logs – SCOT settings, SOIN, further analyze the issue with S4 team. OM have provided 2 email inbound handler classes which are  /DOC/CL_IM_DSN_HANDLER & /DOC/CL_IM_IFORM_HANDLER Inbound emails are not received by C4C application. Ops team need to check and analyze the logs – Cisco CES , Cisco ESA , Respective postfix logs and SCOT settings.-Application can also create their own handler classes by implementing interface IF_BCS_INBOUND  -Attachment Size in the email / large Email 20 MB outbound     Limitation on email infra and C4C application-Support has to check-For inbound in email size we are also not sure what's the max allowed size.-However OM have provided 2 email inbound handler classes which are  /DOC/CL_IM_DSN_HANDLER & /DOC/CL_IM_IFORM_HANDLER-Email and Fax setting Activity  How-To Question   Issues while consuming the setting should be checked by respective Application Area and Customer  -Email Content and formatting     Respective Application Area  Should be with Support / Development-Email sent but no entry in SOST     Respective Application Area  -Email received with delay   Ops to check the reason for delay (Cronus logs with S4 team)   The delay caused by C4C email infra -Auth issue, Account issue, SASL issue   Based on the scenario send it to Ops   If required then send it to OPS-DNS issue   Ops to check the reason for DNS issues   Email failed delivery due to DNS issue (MX records, A records, LDAP)-Email display issue on C4C application     Respective Application Area Should be with Support / Development-Email security issue   Based on the scenario send it to Ops   SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Anti-virus-If required then send it to OPS-Bulk mail issues Support to check if the bulk mail domains are DKIM verified After the initial analysis, Ops to check BSMTP / configuration settings. Further check with S4 team if required    -Cross check in the Email and Fax Settings page if the domains are added
