Title: Ops Notification Contacts for SAP Business ByDesign & SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- This KBA will help you to get a details on the Ops Notification contacts and Cloud System Notification Subscriptions (CSNS).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Cloud System Notification Subscriptions application allows SAP Cloud Customers to configure, customize, and subscribe to the SAP Cloud Service notifications.-Within Cloud System Notification Subscriptions, you can set your preferences for which types of notifications you would like to receive in case of planned and unplanned downtimes as well as customer communication notifications. You can manage the existing subscriptions, add new ones, and set notification recipients.-Manage the existing subscriptions for each cloud service in your portfolio.-Add and configure new subscriptions to receive notifications most relevant for you.-See and edit the notification recipients for each cloud service individually (given the super admin rights).-FAQ’s:-Who can access CSNS?-Ans: User who have S-User ID can access CSNS.-How/Where customer can access CSNS?-Ans: Customer can access CSNS from  SAP ONE Support Launchpad or Cloud Availability Center or CSNS Direct Link.-What can I expect to see on the Cloud System Notification Subscriptions application?-Ans: Cloud System Notification Subscriptions (CSNS) allows SAP Cloud customers to configure, customize, and subscribe to various SAP Cloud Service notifications.-Within CSNS, you can set your preferences for which types of notifications you would like to receive for cases of both planned and unplanned downtimes, as well as customer communication notifications.-You can manage the existing subscriptions and add new ones. Super administrators can also specify additional notification recipients.-Can customer subscribe Notifications for multiple Products and different type of Notifications?-Ans: Yes, customer can subscribe for multiple products/solutions and different type notifications also.-Where can we find these Subscribed contacts?-Ans: When we login to the SPC, under customer contact details we can find these Subscribed Contacts with the Relationship Category as “ONC001-Ops Notification Contact”.-Who can remove these Ops Notification Contacts?-Ans: CSNS is designed as Self Service, so the customer will have to maintain it or remove it from their end.-If we receive any incidents with a concern and requesting for more details about CSNS to which team we need to send the incident?-Ans: Cloud Availability Contact:XX-SER-SAPSMP-CAC we can also contact team via Email: sapcloudavailabilitycenter@sap.com.-Whether CEE/CSM/AE can remove these contacts?-Ans: No, since these contacts are maintained by customer, So customer need to remove it from their end.-Note: CAC team can remove these contacts only if customer is unable to do it from their end.-Does these subscriptions are based on the User level or Customer Account level?-Ans: The subscription is based on user level (S User required) that is assigned to a specific customer.-Does customer can maintain multiple Ops notification contacts?-Ans: Yes.-See Also-KBA’s:-2900069 - How S-Users can manage their own Cloud Notifications in the CSNS - SAP ONE Support Launchpad-2896942 - How Super and Cloud Administrators manage Cloud Notifications for other users in the CSNS - SAP ONE Support Launchpad-Support Portal link: https://support.sap.com/en/my-support/systems-installations/cac.html#section_copy_387467770-JAM Group link: https://jam4.sapjam.com/groups/BLtqX2nEUyajKHDqGj63Lr/documents/Gl1X7OM4kcoJtamMUHCFWq/slide_viewer-Keywords-CSNS, Ops Notification Contact, ONC001, Cloud Availability Center.

Title: When an Email get Soft Bounce and Hard Bounce?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This is KBA is to provide detailed explanation about Email Bounces due to various reasons-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In general, If an email cannot be delivered to recipient, it will always be bounced back to the sender. For example: tenant will receive a bounced email to inform the failed delivery.-There are 2 types of bounces:-Soft Bounce-Soft bounce means that the email address was valid and the email message reached the recipient’s mail server. However, common reasons it bounced back could be:-The mailbox was full (the user is over their quota).-The server was down.-The message was too large for the recipient’s inbox.-The network was down.-Content Rejected: The recipient mail server doesn't allow the content of the email. You can try to resolve this type of bounce by modifying the content of your email.-Attachment Rejected: The email contains an unacceptable attachment. Some email providers block emails with attachments of a certain file type or large attachments. After you remove or modify your email attachments, you can try to send the email to this recipient again.-Generally soft bounce means soft issue that the issue may recover potentially soon, Soft bounce normally have error code: 4XX-In the case of Soft bounce, SAP email infrastructure will queue the email, and retry the delivery in a calculated time interval, if all retries failed, after 3 days (72 hours) timeout, the email will be bounced back to the sender.-Hard Bounce-Hard bounce occurs when the message has been permanently rejected either because:-The email address is invalid.-The email addresses doesn’t exist.-No DNS records.-Attachment exceeded the limitation Mail size can be maximum of 25MB including attachments (since in SAP Business ByDesign application it is 25 mb mentioned in blog, and Amazon ses V2 it is 40 mb).-Hard bounce normally have error code:5XX-In the case of Hard bounce, SAP email infrastructure will bounce the email to the sender immediately.-Q & A-In the case of attempts to send messages that exceed the maximum size, invalid account or domain, how the system behaves?--SAP email infrastructure will bounce the email back to tenant immediately.--Other delivery problems at the destination, how the system responds when:-The site is temporarily not operational (technical cause, maintenance)--SAP email infrastructure will queue the email for 3 days, and retry to delivery, 3days later, will soft bounce the email.-The site refuses the connection (antivirus/antispam mechanism)--In this case, the bounce activity was not done by SAP email infrastructure, the bounce activity was done by the recipient email infrastructure.-See Also-SMTP and ESMTP error code list-Next-Generation Cloud Delivery transition - New Business ByDesign E-mail Infrastructure-Keywords-bounce, deliver failed, sender, receiver, dkim

Title: Modifying the Rounding Value for Currencies not Possible
Content: Symptom-While trying to edit Currencies from Fine Tuning activity to modify the rounding values for currencies it is noted that there is no option to edit currencies and therefore the Rounding Value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Open the Activity: Currencies.-While trying to modify the Rounding Value for Currency AAA there is no option to edit Decimals and/or to modify the Rounding Value.-(AAA means the Currency Code)-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign, currencies are standardized according to ISO code list 4217. This level of standardization is technically necessary to support the data exchange between different On-Demand Solutions.-Resolution-This system behavior is as designed. The possibility to change the decimals for currencies Swiss Francs (CHF), Indian Rupee (INR) and New Taiwan Dollar (TWD) represent exceptions from the described system definition.-Keywords-decimals; currency; arrondi; devise; décimales

Title: How to Define Multiple Channels for Document Output
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to define multiple output channels for your output documents, for example a Customer Invoice / Credit Memo.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can enable Multichannel for Document Output by activating scoping question: "Do you want to send the process-integrated output documents via multiple output channels?".-It is worth noting that this scoping question is protected, so one this functionality is activated and goes live, it cannot be changed back. We highly suggest testing this scenario in a test system.-The activation of the questions can be done by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select your project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the step 4 of the wizard:Questions.-Expand the following path: Communication and Information Exchange -> Business Process Management -> Process-Integrated Input and Output Management.-On the right panel, under the group Enabling Multichannel for Document Output, you can activate the question: "Do you want to send the process-integrated output documents via multiple output channels?"-Please note:-On selecting the multichannel output option, you can process the output documents via multiple output channels. In the FDT configuration of the output channel selection, if you have maintained more than one channel for the same condition, all channels will be picked up in case of multichannel scenario. In case of multichannel option not scoped, first channel meeting the condition will be picked.-Adaptation for partners:-With multi-channel, the changes to the storage of channel information in communication arrangement BO (/DOC/OM_COMM_ARRANGEMENT) has been moved from ‘Root’ node to the child node – ‘CommunicationChannel’ (COMM_CHANNEL). Before the multi-channel functionality was introduced, the output channel information was stored at the root node of the communication arrangement BO, and partners used to access the root node to fetch the channel details. Once the multi-channel is scoped in the system, partners need to adapt their solution to fetch the channel information from the communication channel node than from the root node.-After the scoping question is activated, the multichannel can be enabled for document output following the below steps:-Note: In these steps, we will take an Account as an example.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Enter the Accounts view.-Open the respective Account.-Navigate to the Communication tab.-Enter the Collaboration sub-tab.-Select the respective Business Document.-In the section Output Channel Settings panel below, you can add multiple Output Channels via the Add-Row button.-See Also-Please Note: In the Output Channel Settings for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo of your Account Master Data of the respective Account you need to maintained the Output Channel Internal EDX in the first position. See also:-2764303 - Supplier Invoice is not created from Customer Invoice due to the Error in Output of a Customer Invoice: Invalid Chanel Type Code IDX-https://itsm.services.sap/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0752979-Keywords-multiple output documents, multiple, output channel, Additional, E-Mail, XML, Printer

Title: Process to Handle Standalone Tenant Requests
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This is an internal KBA to explain the process to handle customer requests to change a tenant into standalone tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Process and Options to consider when a customer request for changing a tenant into a standalone tenant.-****Internal version****-Option 1 (Recommended)-In case the test tenant is a remote change test tenant and the main workspace is at least a merged remote change project (6/80). Then this tenant can be converted from a remote change test tenant to a standalone tenant. Usually for this we convert the merged (6/80) or closed (6/70) remote change project to a First Implementation project (3/20).-If we do this, the test tenant cannot be used as remote change test tenant anymore.-  Option 2 (not preferred)-Usually, in standalone test tenants the system purpose of the First Implementation is 3 (pre-production) and the user can directly change the Scoping and Finetuning in the First Implementation project.-We can manually change the system purpose to 4 (Live) and the status to 60 (Live). Then the customer can create local change projects.-But, we need to ask the customer why do they really want to create local change projects in the test tenant. Local change projects are usually used in production tenants after the customer went live. Automatic Go Live can only be performed by the customer in production tenants.-That is the reason this option is never given to customer instead the first option is the only choice.-  ****Customer version****-We have checked the local change request issue with the relevant teams and in order to achieve your requirement. Here we have 2 options –-Option 1 – Reopen the first implementation and convert the test system (Dev in your case) into standalone system. With the first implementation the changes made will be deployed directly in the same system. You cannot close the first implementation in this case. Furthermore another down side is that this system cannot be used as a remote change test system after activating this. Which means you cannot copy a change project from Production to this system.-Here is the sequence:-Request for system refresh from Source to target from Service Control Center.-Once the process is complete, open a new case to make the test tenant as standalone as per above option.-Option 2 – Close the first implementation (done in the backend) and change this as a Live tenant but standalone. So you will be able to create local change projects. Please bear in mind that Local change projects are usually used in production tenants after the customer went live. Go Live can only be performed by the customer in production tenants. In order to reflect any changes, it will be a 3 step process –-Create Change project-Perform the changes-Merge the change in the project to the same tenant.-Please note that this is a special request and is not provided as standard.-  Additional Questions and Answers:-Your Test Tenant was refreshed from a Production Tenant which is already live. After that the "New" button to create Change Project is enabled in the test tenant.--If the test tenant was refreshed with a full copy of the production tenant.  Then the status of the workspaces are copied and therefore the "New" button is enabled. This is expected system behavior.--After the refresh of a test tenant with the production tenant as source the customer can have the following situations:--A. After the refresh, the “First Implementation Project” in the test tenant has status “Live” (due to full copy of production tenant). The customer can use it as standalone tenant and have to create local change projects in the test tenant.--B. If the customer wants to use the refreshed test tenant as standalone tenant but not want to create local change projects, the customer has to create a case and ask SAP to set the status of the “First Implementation Project “ to pre-Production (3/20). Then customer can make changes directly in the “First Implementation Project” without using local change projects.--C. In case (A) the customer can copy a solution profile (change project) from production to test automatically via Service Control Center.  In this case the test tenant is converted into a remote change test tenant and cannot be used as standalone tenant anymore. Local change projects are not possible in the test tenant.-  In general a DEV tenant should only be a standalone tenant.  As prerequisite for the remote change project scenario the PDI solutions and their versions have to be the same in the production tenant and the target test tenant.-Usually the PDI solutions and their versions are not the same in production and development tenants.-  So we strongly recommend to have a standalone development tenant and a test tenant that can be used as remote change test tenant (with a connection to production tenant).-Keywords-standalone, dev tenant, test tenant, tenant refresh, full copy

Title: How To Reverse Depreciation Postings For Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-How to reverse the depreciation postings for an asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Go to Fixed Asset work center-Select Fixed Asset view-Search for the asset for which you would like to reverse the deprecation-Click on Edit and select Master Data-Navigate to Asset Valuation sub-tab-Select the row with the Set of Books and Valuation View combination-Under the Current Valuation View Parameters section change the depreciation method to 0000 - No automatic depreciation-If required change the Depreciation Method for other Valuation Views-Click on Save.-Note that the depreciation method is time-based.-For reversing an automatic depreciation for a specific period of time, create a new Valuation Interval with depreciation method to 0000 - No automatic depreciation. Once depreciation is execution for the Valuation Interval with 0000 - No automatic depreciation then the corresponding depreciation is reversed.-Execute the depreciation run again for the fixed asset. Ensure that you provide the same fiscal year and period for which the depreciation was originally posted and needs to be reversed. With this new run, the system will reverse the depreciation posted for the asset.-Keywords-Reverse Depreciation. Depreciation Run. Fixed Asset.

Title: Not Able to Change the Validity of an Employee's Bank Details e.g. in Order to Post Historical Payments
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to record historical payments of expenses to employees. When you create a payment to an employee (for example Outgoing Bank Transfer) with a Document Date that is prior to the employee's Start Date of Bank Details you get the error message 'Account of payer/payee XYZ with requested ID ABC is not valid', which is expected (XYZ represents the payer/payee ID and ABC represents the requested ID). However, you don't know how to change the Start Date of Bank Details of this employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to Suppliers and here to the Supplier Accounts view.-Show All Employees.-Select the respective employee and click View.-Select any open invoice.-Click Pay Manually By > Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Change the Document Date to a date before the employee's Start Date of Bank Details.-The error message is thrown: Account of payer/payee XYZ with requested ID ABC is not valid.-Cause-The error message is thrown since the Document Date which you have selected is before the respective employee's Start Date of Bank Details. Usually, employees are migrated on a certain date DD.MM.YYYY and therefore their Bank Details Start Date is also taken as DD.MM.YYYY, so you cannot post expenses for dates earlier than DD.MM.YYYY.-Resolution-You need to adjust the Start Date of Bank Details for the respective employee, but this is currently not reachable in the User Interface.-Report a case to SAP providing the list of employees for whom you would like to change the Start Date of Bank Details and also the new date to be applied. This change can be done in the backend of the system based on your written approval.-Keywords-Account of payer/payee with requested ID is not valid; historical payment to employee; period; web service; webservice; unable; from; to; 1901-01-01; 9999-12-31;

Title: Request of initial test tenant is not possible

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--You want to request a new initial Test tenant but get the error message "Creation of Initial System using Solution Profile XYZ (name of profile )not supported"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center Work Center-Select the view Systems-Select Request Creation-Choose System Type: Test Tenant -  Data Source: Copy of Source System (Copy Solution Profile) - Source Solution Profile ID: XYZ (name of profile )-Error message appears: "Creation of Initial System using Solution Profile XYZ (name of profile )not supported"-  Cause-Customer already went live-Go To SPC.-Search for customer tenant.-"Customer is Live" is ticket.-This is expected system behavior.-Resolution-As request of Initial System (Copy Solution Profile) is not possible, please request a Copy of Source System (Copy Solution Profile)-Keywords-error message "Creation of Initial System using Solution Profile XYZ (name of profile )not supported", Service Control Center, BYD, C4C

Title: How To Solve E-Mails From Campaigns That Are Not Received
Content: Symptom-You are sending out E-Mail Campaigns, but no e-mails arrive on recipient side.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite: You have created and executed an E-Mail Sales Campaign ABC (ABC represents the name) for a Target Group 123. The contacts of Target Group 123 have valid e-mail addresses.-Go to the Sales Campaign work centre.-Go to the Campaigns view.-Open the relevant Sales Campaign ABC.-You can see that it was successfully executed.-Go to the Execution Details facet.-The system says that the number of Contacted (sent e-mails) amounts to the expected contacts from the Target Group.-RESULT: None of the recipients receives the e-mail.-Cause-There are several possible causes. In order to rule out the most common causes, please check the following:-The E-Mail and Fax settings in your system are set so that all e-mails are only sent to one address and or you did not maintain the domain.-You did not maintain the DKIM.-You did not request for Mass E-Mail to be activated for your tenant.-  Resolution-1. To change the E-Mail and Fax settings:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the relevant project ABC (ABC represents project name).-Click the Open Activity List link.-Search and open the Fine Tune activity E-Mail and Fax Settings.-Open E-Mail and Fax Settings.-Under the section Domain, maintain the domain as needed.-Under the section E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System -> E-Mail, select Send all e-mails to business partners.-2. To maintain the DKIM:- To activate the Mass E-Mail Features you must first adjust the Business Configuration (area E-Mail and Fax Settings > Activation of Mass E-Mail) accordingly. This also includes storing the public DKIM key in your domain name system (DNS). The public DKIM key and a description of how you add this can be found in the Documentation for Activation of Mass E-Mail. The documentation is in the fine tuning activity E-Mail and Fax Settings.--3. To request for Mass E-Mail to be activated for your tenant (this needs to be done for each tenant) you will need to first maintain the DKIM and then open an case with the SAP Cloud Product support providing us the following information:--Sub-domain:-What is the mailing type? Alarm/ News/ Updates? --Who are the recipients? Customers? Partners? Interested people? --Estimated mail volume per month? --Tenant ID:--  Keywords-Mass E-mail, DKIM, Campaigns, Recipients

Title: Field "HSN Code for India" is not Available When Using Mass Data Maintenance Work Center
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to mass Enhance/Modify the field HSN Code for India however the field does not appear when downloading a CSV file for Materials in the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Enter the Mass Data Maintenance view.-Select Export Materials link.-Insert a material ID.-Click on the Go button.-Click on the Export Data to CSV file button.-Cause-Field HSN Code for India is not released for Migration update or Mass Data Maintenance.-Resolution-In order to perform a mass change of HSN codes, you can use the Mass Change feature by following the below steps:-Go to Product Data Work Center. -Enter the Materials View.-Select the materials that need to be changed.-Click on the Mass Change button.-Keywords-HSN Code , Mass Data Maintenance , Modify HSN Code for Material

Title: Summary Invoice Numbering Format Japan
Content: Symptom-This document shows how the numbering format of the Summary Invoices for Japan works.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Numbering for Summary and Monthly invoice documents is hard-coded in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Therefore the number ranges cannot be defined manually or changes be made.-The Summary Invoice ID format is: <account_id>-<Number of the Invoice for the Summary Invoice type>-<Year of creation>-If the Summary Invoice is generated via Invoice Summary Initialization Run, the first Summary Invoice generated will have the number 1 as the Invoice ID. -See Also-For more information, please refer to the help document Configuration Guide: Invoice Summary Processing — Japan.-Keywords-Summary, Invoice, Monthly, Japan, Numbering, Format, Rule, Customer, Receivables, Document,

Title: Error Message: "Service Call Failed; Report an Incident" While Migrating Locations and Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-Error "Service Call Failed; Report an Incident" While Migrating Locations and Logistics Area-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Search for Migration of Location and Logistics Area-Choose Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool-Select your migration template-Execute Migration step by step-Error "Service Call Failed; Report an Incident" in simulation step-Cause-The service call failed error has many possible causes. One of them may be that the Location ID and Parent Location ID fields have been filled with the same information.-Resolution-The parent location ID should always be filled with a site ID. A Site can be created in the Organizational Management work center on the Org Structures view by activating the Business Residence in the structure. To create Locations and Logistics Areas, use the Migration option.-Keywords-Migration, Migration tool, Locations, Service call failed, Migration of Location and Logistics Area

Title: Issues with Holiday Calendar
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-There could be two scenarios here:-Scenario 1: When the customer tries to open the Holiday Calendar for a specific Employee, system shows the following error message.-"DD.MM.YYYY is a missing holiday.-Please perform the correction run via regular task."-Scenario 2: A Holiday Calendar was not transferred to all Employees' profiles. As a result, for example, a leave day was deducted for each Employee on a day that should be a public holiday.--Scenario 3: A duplicate holiday is appearing in the employee's time profile.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-For scenario 1:-Go to the Time Administration Work Center.-Then go to the Employees view.-Search for the Employee.-Click "Edit."-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Click "Show Holiday calendar".-System shows the error message.-For scenario 2:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for the Employee.-Click "Edit".-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Go to the relevant Time Account.-You will see a deduction on the holiday date.-For scenario 3:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Time Sheet view.-Search for the Employee.-Click "Open Time Sheet."-Go to the Time Entry tab and click "Show Holiday Calendar."-You will see that the holiday appears twice.-Cause-A Run Day Closure is required or there is a possible inconsistency in backend.-Resolution-The first try should be to perform a Run Day Closure. In case this does not resolve the error:-Execute the backend correction as shown in the Internal Memo/Attachments.-Perform the Run Day Closure for the Employee(s).-Execute the backend correction as shown in the Internal Memo/Attachments.-See Also-2669288 - Holiday Calendar not Reflected in Employee Times After Day Closure Run-Keywords-Error, is a missing holiday, Please perform the correction run via regular task, Show Holiday Calendar, holiday calendar not transferred, holiday calendar missing, public holiday, public holiday calendar, no holiday calendar for employee, deduction from holiday, holiday deducted, vacation deducted on holiday, vacation-Search for the Employee.

Title: Error "Item for Product ID XXXX already exists", When Migrating Price Lists
Content: Symptom-Error "Item for Product ID XXXX already exists" while migrating price lists-* XXXX represents the Product ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Search activity Migration of Price Lists-Choose migrate price lists using the migration tool-Choose the migration mode add new records-Execute Migration Step by Step-Error "Item for Product ID XXXX already exists" in simulation step-Cause-There can be many reasons for this error. One of the reasons can be that, there are two items associated with the same product - XXXX in the system for that Price List.-Go to Products work center-Go to Price List view-Choose the price list-Go to edit-Go to items tab-Search with the product ID-There are two entries for the same Product, one with status Released and the other Not Released -Resolution-Delete the item associated with the product XXXX, which is in Not Released status before executing the migration.-To delete the items follow the below steps:-Go to Products work center-Go to Price List view-Select the price list-Go to Edit-Go to the items tab-In the find field search with the product ID-There are two entries for the same product-Choose the entry with status Not Released-Choose remove button to delete it-Save the price list-Keywords-Migration of Price List, Product ID exists, Price List-item for product id already exists,migration of price list

Title: Unable to Assign AuC in Settlement Rule Assignments for Projects
Content: Symptom-You have created a fixed asset under construction (AuC) 123. You try to assign this asset under AuC Assignment in the Settlement Rule. You observe that the asset is not shown under the dropdown list when you click on the button Assign AuC and under the value help of AuC ID.-(123 represents the fixed asset under construction (AuC) ID)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenues work center.-Select Projects.-Select the project ABC (ABC represents the project ID) which is bearing the cost of asset under construction.-Click on Assign AuC or Settlement Rule.-Select the button AuC Assignment and click on Assign AuC and in the new popup box search for AuC ID 123.-No records found or this AuC is not found which you are trying to select.-Cause-The Fixed Asset Class used in the fixed asset is not Flagged as Asset Under Construction ﻿in the fine-tune activity Asset Classes, so the asset that you have created is not considered as Asset Under Construction but as Asset only.-Resolution-Since the asset is still with the status In Process you delete the asset if you want to use the same fixed asset class and if you have any other fixed asset using the same asset class then create a new fixed asset class-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Project view.-Select a change project, and select Open Activity List.-In tab Fine-Tuning, search for activity Fixed Asset Class, and Open it.-Open activity Edit Fixed Asset Class.-Select a Fixed Asset Class and Flag the box Asset Under Construction-When you choose to accumulate project costs till settlement, you have to create a default class where all assets under construction are created. You can either mark the standard available fixed asset class 4000 as the default class to create asset under construction or create a custom fixed asset class and Flag it as Asset Under Construction-Keywords-AuC, Fixed Asset, asset under construction, project

Title: Test Tenant Request with Time Overlap in SAP Business ByDesign (BYD)
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--When requesting a new test tenant so far, the precedent test tenant had to be terminated immediately. Now you can defer the termination by up to three weeks, during which you can temporarily use both test tenants in parallel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. Go to Service Control Center.-2. Go to Systems View.-3. Select the Test tenant.-4. Click on Terminate System.- 5. New window pops up, in which you can enter the termination date of the test tenant.- 6. You will receive a message "Termination Scheduled".-Once the termination of the test tenant is scheduled, then you can request a new test tenant from service control center.-Please Note:-This process is only applicable for test tenants.-This process is only applicable for SAP Business ByDesign.-Test tenant which is scheduled for termination, will be terminated on the given date. -Termination date can only be set withing 3 weeks. -You will not be able to input termination date after 3 weeks from the current date.-You cannot re-schedule the termination date of a termination scheduled test tenant. (it is a one time activity).-SAP only provides tenants based on the contractual aggreements.-  Keywords-BYD, Test Tenant, 3 Weeks, Schedule Termination.

Content: Symptom-You are trying to request to terminate your productive system, however the button "Terminate System" is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-For security reasons you are unable to terminate productive systems via Service Control Center requests.-Resolution-In order to terminate your existing production tenant. Please create a Case from your test tenant with the details like, Production tenant ID, Production Tenant URL and Reason for the termination.-See Also-2136036 - How to request a New Tenant for SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer from Service Control Center-Tenant Creation Scenarios – ByD/C4C-Keywords-BYD, C4C, How, Delete, Productive Tenant, Terminattion, Terminate.

Title: SSF error while performing digital signature
Content: Symptom-When a document with a signature strategy assigned is signed, the following error is displayed:-"SSF information for SAP user not found"--"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SOLDOC-Navigate to the document with the signature strategy assigned-Trigger the signature process by choosing one of the document editing options-Change the status of the document -Sign the document -The following error is displayed:-Cause-This is because the signature strategy defined is with either of the following methods:-User Signature with ext. Security Product W/O verification-User Signature with ext. Security Product with verification-Resolution-The above two signature methods only work with SAP GUI but not with Webdynpro (as SOLDOC is)-To resolve the issue: In the view cluster "VC_TC85", select the method "System Signature with Authorization by SAP UserID/Password"--See Also-2444251 - Usage of Digital Signature Tool Functionality in SAP Fiori and SAP UI5 - Current Constraints-Keywords-SSF error, digital signature

Title: Multiple Tenants Appear in the Systems View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer was just handed over the first system for the project. However, the Systems view of the Service Control Center shows multiple tenants already.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center.-Go to Systems view.-More than one tenant is displayed.-Cause-The possibility is that the customer has signed more than one contract of a solution with SAP. This has to be clarified with the customer or with the provisioning team.-The Service Control Center was designed to show the overall customer’s data. Therefore all tenants of a single solution (BYD, COD) belonging to the customer are getting displayed. If the customer has a BYD and a COD contract, then being logged on to the BYD tenant only all tenants of all BYD contracts are getting displayed.-This also applies for the total number of systems a customer may have. In this case the customer may have one test tenant as part of the standard systems package.-Since there are no further test tenants purchasable for a standard ByDesign customer, every additional test tenant has to be ordered via an exceptional process asking for permission through an incident with the following details:-Source Tenant URL[not required if initial system is required]-Solution Profile ID[if a solution profile copy is needed]-Decommisioning date of either the new tenant or the existing test tenant.[should not exceed 90 days from the request for new system]-Reason for additional test system-Downtime for creation[window of four hours] apart from the contractual maintenance window.-Resolution-This is the system behavior.

Title: How to Change the Company Address and Communication Details
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-On this KBA you will find how to change the data maintained on the "Company Address and Communication Details" or the "Communication Details at Company Level", from the Cloud for Customer and Business ByDesign products.-This information is used only by SAP for the purpose of delivering services. Customer have to be ensured that these details are correct.--"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the below path to check this information on the system:-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Open the Contact Details View.-Click on Active Contacts hyperlink.-Click on "View Company Details" button.-Resolution-If a customer requests to update or maintain any data on the Company Details screen, please follow the steps below:-Go to Unified Ticketing.-Select Create Ticket.-On Description field, Insert "Change the Company Address and Communication Details".-On the Ticket Type field, Select SALESdirect.-On the Category field, Select Account Name & Address Update.-On the Region field, choose the customer region.-On the Priority field, Select High.-On the Issue Description field, insert the Description Field Template filling it with customer data.-Afterwards, a SALESdirect colleague will contact you and provide further information regarding this process, as well as any necessary actions to be performed by your side to complete the request.-Description Field Template-----Hi Colleagues,-I've received the below Case where customer is requesting to change the Company Address and Communication Details in their Business ByDesign tenant.-Details as follows:-Case Title:<Paste the Case Title>-Case URL:<Paste the Case URL>-As per KBA below, we were redirected to open a ticket requesting it for you:-2668491 - How to Change the Company Address and Communication Details-Customer has requested to update the Company Address and Communication Details in their system to:-New Company Address and Communication Details: <Paste the new Address and Communication Details> -Kindly advise if any action needs to be performed by the customer side.-Best Regards,-----Keywords-data, information, modify, alter, details, update, company, address, communication details, change, view company details

Title: The User Gets The Error "You are not authorized to access the data" When Searching For/Editing A CRM Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The user has unrestricted access to CRM documents, for example service orders. But when he try to edit service order ABC, system opens the screen and shows messages that "You are not authorized to access the data".-ABC represents the ID of the service order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users view.-Select the user and click Edit Access Rights.-In Access Restrictions tab, for service order processing view, the user has Unrestricted access with both Read and Write.-However, when the user searches for or tries to edit service order ABC, they get the error "You are not authorized to access the data" .-Cause-Login to the backend.-Enter the T Code SESFTS.-Enter the BO "SERVICE_ORDER".-Click Load By Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS and enter the service order ABC under ID/Content.-Expand the nodes and double click AccessControlList node. You will find there is no record in this node.-This means that the ACL is missing in the service order ABC, therefore access restrictions do not work here. -There are 2 scenarios:-Open the Document in the UI and navigate to the General tab. -The Sales Organization and Distribution Channel is not maintained or was not determined from the Sales Unit.-The Sales Organization and Distribution Channel is maintained. -Resolution-In case of scenario 1:-Get the approval from the customer to maintain a Sales Organization and Distribution Channel or in case the Sales Unit was determined perform a dummy change on the Sales Unit to determine the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel. (This can only performed by a technical user and not a business user.)-After maintaining the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel and saving the changes check in the backend if the ACL was created. -If the node was not created forward the case to development. -In case of scenario 2:-Get the approval from the customer to perform a dummy change on the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel.-After the dummy change and saving the changes,  check in the backend if the ACL was created. -If the node was not created forward the case to development. -Keywords-You are not authorized to access the data; cannot access; access denied; ACL; AccessControlList; Unable to edit service order; Service order not editable

Title: Aging List For Payables Report with Journal Entry Details is not found
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Aging List For Receivables includes a report with Journal Entry Details, the Aging List for Payables does not contain journal entry details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for the report Aging List for Payables.-The report for Journal Entry details is missing.-Cause-The absence of journal entry details in the Aging List for Payables can be attributed to differences in the underlying Data Sources. Moreover, the Aging List for Payables (Data Source: FINDUEU04_Q0006) and Aging List For Receivables With Journal Entry Details (Data Source: FINGLAU29_Q0001) serve different purposes and cannot be directly compared.-Resolution-The Report Aging List For Receivables With Journal Entry Details is based on Accounting And Trade Receivables Payables Register which provides an aging list containing all overdue open receivables listed by due date along with accounting data whereas, the report Aging List for Payables is based on Trade Receivables Payables Register, providing an aging list containing all overdue open payables listed by due date.-You can also refer to the Help Center Document to know the available Data sources: Overview of Data Sources in Financial Management | SAP Help Portal-See Also-Data sources available in Financial Management: Overview of Data Sources in Financial Management | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Aging List for Payables, Report, Data source, Aging List for Receivables, Journal Entry Details

Title: New Requirements in Reporting for Analytics
Content: Symptom-Our analysis has categorized your inquiry as a new requirement or also called new feature request, meaning it pertains to a How-to question rather than to a technical, product related issue. It is beyond the scope of our SAP Cloud Support services.-Within some examples of consulting queries in Analytics we might list:-Requests to add a particular field from the system to a data source.-Requests to add a functionality or feature to the reporting capabilities.-Requests to create customized key figure structures.-Requests to add extension fields to data sources that does not match with its business context or even when the data source is not enabled for extensibility.-Request to access UI fields via Cloud Studio in order to add to data sources that are not visible in the tool.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Sales-SAP Cloud for Service-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Further details can be found at Support Workflow material (outlined from slides 4 to 9)-If the feature/functionality is needed as a matter of urgency, please refer to KBA 3475641 - Functionality Currently not Available-See Also- Product Defect means: feature of function not working as described in the official product documentation.-SAP Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer offer some standard fields to be used for reporting. Such fields (characteristics and key figures) are extended and visible in the Data Sources embedded in the system. However, not all fields available in the UI are published to Data Sources due to technical designing, therefore you might come across a situation where the desired field is not available for reporting. To check which fields are available, you can make use of the following KBAs:-For Business ByDesign: 1830749 - Complete Data Sources and Characteristics Documentation-For Cloud for Customer: 2850666 - SAP Cloud for Customer: Complete Data Source Documentation- Keywords-new requirement, analytics, reports, data source, field missing, not available in reporting, business analytics, new field, characteristic, key figure-add field to report,reports,new requirement,analytics
