Title: Dump Occurs When you try to Release an Intercompany Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Only***-Dump occurs when you try to release an Intercompany Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order.-Select the Release button.-Dump occurs.-Dump Details:-Terminated Program: CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CP-Transaction ID: 00163E0B4BA31ED4AA8D274AED17D13C-Error Message: CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL:"Shortcut not available: SalesOrderProcessing / 0002100000 / CO_APCRM_SO_ORDER_OB / BUPA_NOT_FOUND"[SAPMHTTP:0]-Cause-The Internal EDX selected in Account is not recognized by the system. You have added this entry manually because the drop down does not propose any value.-The main reason for the missing entry in the dropdown is because communication sceario Output of Sales Orders Using EDX is not deployed in the backend.-Follow below steps to check if the communication sceario Output of Sales Orders Using EDX is scoped in the system:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Edit Project Scope button.-Show All Elements.-Expand Sales -> Expand Selling Products and Services.-Select Communication for Selling Products and Services.-Question Do you want to receive sales orders electronically from your customers using Electronic Data Exchange? is already checked/scoped.- Please note for Customer Invoices the scoping question can be found under the path: Sales -> Customer Invoicing -> Communication for Customer Invoicing-Do you want to transmit invoice documents to your customers electronically using Electronic Data Exchange?-An important check is as the service is scoped, the scenario should has the communication arrangement setup for the business partner.-It is important make sure that the Communication arrangement is set to this business partner to avoid dumps.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to deploy the communication scenario for Output of Sales Orders Using EDX:-Login to the backend system.-Go to the SE16 transaction.-Enter the table name /DOC/C_OM_SOCST and view the Table Contents.-Select the Execute button in the next screen.-Find if the code 27 (i.e. for Output of Sales Orders Using EDX) is available.-Since the Internal EDX has already been selected in the Business Configuration Scoping, ideally the /DOC/C_OM_SOCST table should contain code 27, but in this case it is missing.-The issue could be with deployment of the scenario in backend, please forward the incident to AP-RC-CEC-B2B componnet to check the inconsistency further and if required deploy the code manually in the backend.-Once the code 27 is deployed to the backend, you can select the Internal EDX for the Sales Order Output in the Account.-See Also-3064071 - Exception (Dump) When Sending Order Confirmation to Account-KBA 2765615 - Dump CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL: Local Shortcut Call Failed-Keywords-Dump, Error, 500, Sales Order, EDX, Internal, Send Order Confirmation to Account

Title: The Already Paid Supplier Invoice is Still Shown as Not Posted Source Document
Content: Symptom-There is one supplier invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to supplier invoice) that is Paid, but later on, the invoice shows up in the Unposted Source Documents list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents.-Search the supplier invoice XYZ.-Notice that the status of this supplier invoice is Paid.-Then go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Supplier invoice XYZ is on the list.-Choose View Business Transaction.-     Error message is displayed: Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY is closed for closing step Operational postings.-XXX refers to the accounting period.-YYYY refers to the fiscal year.-Cause-From the document flow of the supplier invoice XYZ, there are several Goods and Service Receipt documents created, most of which are created after the supplier invoice XYZ.-If the supplier invoice is created before the goods and service receipt document, the supplier invoice items are linked to the purchase order first. Then whenever a new goods receipt is released, an update is sent to the supplier invoice. An internal posting inside the purchase ledger account (Operational Posting) is triggered to reassign the supplier invoice item to the goods receipt item, which is necessary for the GR/IR Clearing later.-Normally, these updates are tried to be posted to the same posting period as the original journal entry of supplier invoice. If that does not work, a task is created and the supplier invoice is shown as not posted source document.-Because the supplier invoice XYZ is originally posted to fiscal year YYYY, but it is closed, this is why supplier invoice is shown as not posted source document.-Resolution-To finish the operational posting task, either open the already closed fiscal year period, or repost the business transaction to another period. As the fiscal year is already closed, the posting can only be made to another period. The detailed steps are as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Not Posted Source Documents.-Search for the source supplier invoice XYZ.-Choose View Business Transaction.-Then, choose Post to Another Period to repost the business transaction to another period.--The supplier invoice XYZ should not be on the Unposted Source Documents list anymore.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Unposted source documents, Period close

Title: Error Message When Trying to Allocate Payment to Customer Project
Content: Symptom-In a payment allocation you attempt to allocate a transaction to a customer project task. When you try to post the allocation you are presented with the error message:-"For customer projects, a project-based sales order item has to be entered".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Select the relevant Payment Allocation.-Click Allocation to G/L Account tab.-In the transaction grid, enter respective G/L Account and Project Task.-Click Post.-Error message is displayed: For customer projects, a project-based sales order item has to be entered.-Note - This KBA is also valid for New Outgoing Bank Transfer and for Petty Cash Payments.-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click on New Outgoing Bank Transfer. -Enter the Company ID & Payee Data.-Select the Option - Direct Posting to G/L Account.-Enter the G/L Account and Project Task.-Press Enter.-Error message is displayed: For customer projects, a project-based sales order item has to be entered.-Cause-To facilitate an unambiguous allocation from a cost and revenue perspective it is mandatory to also provide a specific sales order item in addition to the chosen customer project task.-Resolution-The Sales Order Item field is not available in the default view. You should make it visible by following the steps below:-On top of the screen, right-hand side, click the avatar icon and click Start Personalization Mode.-Find the UI Element for the transaction grid by hovering the mouse over the UI Elements. Expand the UI Element.-Mark the Visible checkbox for Sales Order Item.-Click Save.-Click the avatar icon again and click Stop Personalization Mode.-In the value help of Sales Order Item choose a valid sales order item.-Post the payment allocation / Outgoing Bank Transfer / Petty Cash Payment.-Keywords-payment allocation; personalization mode; project task; sales order item;

Title: Studio Crashes While Creation of Communication Scenario
Content: Symptom-The SAP Cloud Applications Studio crashes while creating a Communication Scenario.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open Solution YA12345678 ( YA12345678 stands for solution name)-Go to Solution Explorer.-Choose the WSID file and right click.-Click on Create Communication Scenario and click next.-Once you click on finish studio crashes.-Cause-The WSDL which is used for creating the external webservice is inconsistent. It does not contains any end point url and also does not contain required information.-Resolution-The WSDL should have all the information like host name , port name , path and port.-In the studio, in the Solution Explorer, open your solution and click Add New Item .-In the Add New Item dialog, select External Web Service Integration, enter the name and click Add.-The External Web Service Integration Wizard opens.-In the Enter Web Service Name and Type, select the web service type REST, and click Next.-In the Enter End Point of REST Service step, enter the URL of the REST Web service and click Next.-Define Communication Scenario and then press Finish.-Once you update all the information WSDL will be  consistent and then you can create Communication scenario without any error message.-See Also-You can refer the  SAP Cloud Applications Studio help documentation section 8.15.4 External Webservice Integration.-#mce_temp_url#-Keywords-Crash; Communcation Scenario; WSDL

Title: Bank Statement Postprocessing Status
Content: Symptom-Significance of Postprocessing status in Bank Statements.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-From the Show list, select All Bank Statements.-Select/highlight any Statement ID and notice that at any given point of time a bank statement would have either of the Postprocessing status, meaning In Process, Required, Not Required or Not Relevant.-Cause-System shows whether postprocessing is required in the bank statements overview. Postprocessing status could be influenced by user depending on the requirement.-Resolution-If an item in a bank statement requires postprocessing, for example, payment allocation or clearing, the user can navigate directly to the item or to an overview of the bank statement if more than one item requires postprocessing. The overview also shows if the payment allocation or clearing process is in progress.-Postprocessing statuses:-In Process: when the Postprocessing status is In Process it means that the ByDesign system is trying to post process the bank statement automatically in the background. The status In Process could take some time to change to Required only if a post processing is required or else the status would come to Not Required. The status In Process could take few minutes to change to other status depending on the number of items in the bank statement.  The user could also influence the status In Process by navigating the corresponding allocations and release them and then after the status will change to Not Required. If the status In Process does not change automatically for more than an hour, the user can report a case.-Required: this status implies that a Postprocessing is required for example, payment allocation or clearing need to be done.-Not Required: when the Postprocessing status is Not Required it means that the required payment allocation or clearing had happened. No further action needs to be taken on the statement.-Not Relevant: when the Postprocessing status is Not Relevant, the bank statement Status is either Canceled or In Preparation. For Canceled statements, no Postprocessing is required. If the statement is In Preparation then the Consistency Status would be Inconsistent, so the statement does require a Postprocessing.-See Also-KBA 2050083 - Bank Statement Postprocessing Status Remains In Process-Keywords-Payment allocation, Postprocessing, required

Title: Error message: "ABC is not a valid value for this field"
Content: Symptom-When trying to add Account Determination Group in General Expenses tab, an error message is being raised:-"ABC is not a valid value for this field"--(ABC means Account Determination Group ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination section, select Costs.-In Costs tab, select Add Row button, and fill with the required information as Account Determination Group ID and General Expenses ID.-When trying to save it, an error message is being raised.-"ABC is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value"-Cause-Account Determination Group is not defined in Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Resolution-In order to solve it, the steps below should be followed:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Activity Chart of Accounts: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Go to Account Determination Groups.-Go to Edit Account Determination Groups.-Go to Costs.-Go to General Expenses.-Select Add Row button.-Add the required Account Determination ID.-Specify the description.-Set Column "Available in Receipt".-Keywords-is not a valid value for this field, Account Determination, General Expenses, costs

Title: How to Enable Only SSO Login for Business Users
Content: Symptom-The system was configured for the SSO login. It is requested to ensure that only the SSO login method and SSO Uniform Resource Locator (URL) are allowed for the Business Users. This is to avoid the use of Non-SSO URL, and the login method User and Password.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Enter your system URL, for example 'https://myXXXXXX.crm.ondemand.com' (SAP Cloud for Customer), 'https://myXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com' (SAP Business ByDesign) (XXXXXX represents the individual system ID).-The login mask appears.-The Business User can log in with their User and Password credentials.-Cause-By default all cloud systems are configured to handle both SSO login as well as Non-SSO login method automatically. The key user can determine if the system allows purely SSO or Non-SSO login or both.-Resolution-Solution in SAP Business ByDesign:- I. Configure which URL should be allow:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the Configure Single Sign-On sub-view.-Go to the My System tab.-In the URL Sent to Employee dropdown list, specify which URL should be used by the employee to logon to the system. Choose between the following options:-Non-SSO URL - The system sends only the normal system URL to the employee. The employee cannot log on using SSO, and must use password or certificate instead.-SSO URL - The system sends only the SSO URL to the employee. The employee can log on using SSO. Authentication request is redirected through the IdP.-Automatic Selection - If SSO is not active, the system sends the normal system URL to the employee. If SSO is active, the system checks whether the employee has a password. If a password is available, both SSO URL and Non-SSO URL are sent to the employee. However, if the employee has no password, only the SSO URL is sent to the employee.-   6. Press Save.- II. Configure the login method:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the Edit Security Policies subview.-Either assign the default policy S_BUSINESS_USER_WITHOUT_PASSWORD to the Business Users.-Or create a new security policy from a copy of S_BUSINESS_USER_WITHOUT_PASSWORD.-Go to the System Logon Password: Easy Password section.-Ensure the option PolicyPassword Logon Enabled is not active. This will deactivate the capability of the system to allow User and Password login method.-Press Save.-Solution in SAP Cloud for Customer-I. Configure the URL to be used:-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the sub menu and select Common Tasks subview.-Go to the Configure Single Sign-On section.-Go to the My System tab.-In the URL Sent to Employee dropdown list, specify which URL should be used by the employee to logon to the system. Choose between the following options:-Non-SSO URL - The system sends only the normal system URL to the employee. The employee cannot log on using SSO, and must use password or certificate instead.-SSO URL - The system sends only the SSO URL to the employee. The employee can log on using SSO. Authentication request is redirected through the IdP.-Automatic Selection - If SSO is not active, the system sends the normal system URL to the employee. If SSO is active, the system checks whether the employee has a password. If a password is available, both SSO URL and Non-SSO URL are sent to the employee. However, if the employee has no password, only the SSO URL is sent to the employee.-   6. Press Save.-II. Configure which login method to use:-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the sub menu and select Common Tasks subview.-Go to the Edit Security Policies section.-Either assign the default policy S_BUSINESS_USER_WITHOUT_PASSWORD to the Business Users.-Or create a new security policy from a copy of S_BUSINESS_USER_WITHOUT_PASSWORD.-Go to the System Logon Password: Easy Password section.-Ensure the option PolicyPassword Logon Enabled is not active. This will deactivate the capability of the system to allow User and Password login method.-Press Save.-Keywords-SSO login, No Password, Login method-no password,login method

Title: System Does Not Re-read The Data of Credit Limit Check When Account is Changed in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-While changing the Account in new sales order and clicking on Check Credit Limit button it displays the incorrect data-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order work center.-Select the Sales orders view.-Create a new sales order.-Enter the account ABC and click on credit limit check (ABC represents the Account ID).-Change the account to XYZ and click on credit limit check, even though account XYZ has the limit it shows that it has exceeded the limit (XYZ represents the Account ID).-Cause-In Business configuration, the "Check Current Document" option is not selected under Credit limit check activity.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue the following changes needs to be made in the Business Configuration:-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Choose First Implementation and click on Open activity list button.-Under Fine Tune tab, search for "Credit Limit Check"-Open the Credit Limit check.-Select the 1st radio button (Check Current Document).-Save the changes.-Keywords-Credit Limit Check; Exceeded; Sales Order; Business Configuration; Account

Title: Cannot Select Extension Node in Sensitive Personal Data file
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sensitive Personal Data file in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK). You have created extension nodes, but they are not avaialble to be selected in the Sensitive Personal Data file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the affected solution.-Open the Solution Explorer section.-Select the Add New Item icon.-Select Data Protection and Privacy.-Select Sensitive Personal Data.-Select the Add button.-Select Sensitive Personal Data, and select the Next button.-Select the Add button in the Extension Fields section.-You can select a standard Business Object, but you will not be able to select an extension node.-Cause-This is currently expected system behaviour of the framework in the Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-This is part of SAPs backlog for future releases.-Keywords-Extension Node, PSD, Sensitive Personal Data file, GDPR, Cloud Application Studio, SDK-extension node,psd,sensitive personal data

Title: Liquidity Forecast Run with Empty Results
Content: Symptom-A Liquidity Forecast Run has been executed, but the results are blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Liquidity Management.-Select the Subview Liquidity Forecast Runs.-Select Run ID XXX (XXX represents the number of the Run).-Results appear on the bottom of the screen.-The Liquidity Run XXX does not display any details, however it was expected results to appear as the Liquidity Run completed without error.-Cause-The report results are empty because there is no data to be fetched and displayed.-Resolution-Whenever any liquidity forecast is run, data collection happens from four sources:-Tax receivables payables register.-Trade receivables payables register.-Payment register.-Expected Liquidity Item.-If any data is collected from four sources then the same is visible in liquidity forecast report through forecast ID.-If no data is collected from the above sources then the report will result in no data displayed.-See Also-Liquidity Forecast-Keywords-Liquidity Forecast, empty, blank

Title: The Error Message 'Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107' is Triggered in your Business Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-The Error Message Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107 is Triggered in your Business Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We can take the example of a sales order :-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Edit the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the order).-Submit > Release the sales order.-The Error Message Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107 is Triggered.-Cause-The technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107 is raised by a partner Add-on. This message is typically raised when a partner tries to modify extension elements of ByD BOs that are set to read-only. In general such error should be fixed by the Add-on creator. The Add-on creator has to make sure to only modify extension elements when the BO is in a writable state. The information when a BO is writable has to be provided by ByD application development. This typically depends on some state elements of the BO.-Resolution-The customer needs to contact the Author of the Add-On to check and correct the Add-On logic.-See Also-You can identify the Add-On, BO, Node, Method and the Extension Field the PDI Solution is trying to update by following the steps in the KBA 2424439 - How to Troubleshoot and Debug the error: 'Changing data not possible; data is read-only'-Keywords-Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 107-technical error ap_esi_common 107,ap_esi_common 107,pdi,add-on,ap_esi_common_107

Title: Netting Functionality: For a Mixed Account The Supplier Invoices Are Not Displayed as Open Items In The Customer Account Monitor And The Opposite Is Also True
Content: Symptom-Netting of Payables and Receivables functionality has been scoped and a business partner has been defined as both Account (customer) and Supplier, what is called a Mixed Account.-After such setup, it was expected that for this business partner, supplier invoices released should be visible as open items under Customer Account Monitor and also the opposite (meaning customer invoices released will be visible as open items under Supplier Account Monitor), however, this is not happening.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Select the respective Account ID and click View.-Under Trade Receivables tab, show Open Items and notice that the respective supplier invoices are not displayed.-Cause-This is the system expected behavior. The Netting for Payables and Receivables functionality for Mixed accounts allows the clearing of Payables against Receivables, however only invoices of the other part are visible when a new manual clearing is started from the Customer Account Monitor or Supplier Account Monitor.-Resolution-To take advantage of the netting functionality for a mixed account a manual clearing should be initiated from either the Customer Account Monitor or the Supplier Account Monitor.-For example:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Select the respective Account ID and click View.-Under Trade Receivables tab, show Open Items.-Select an open item (for example, customer invoice) and click Clear Manually.-On the New Manual Clearing screen, the payables are visible (for example, supplier invoices) and can be matched with receivables to do the clearing.-Keywords-netting; mixed account; open items; payables; receivables; netting

Title: Reconciliation Run throws the warning message: 'Tax amount manually overridden for journal entry XYZ'.
Content: Symptom-You are running the Reconciliation Run in the course of your month-end-closing activities.-For tax-related journals you are receiving a warning message titled:- 'Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for journal entry XYZ' where XYZ stands for the journal entry ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the log of the relevant Reconciliation Run.-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Under Periodic Tasks / Reconciliation, choose the relevant Reconciliation Run and click View.-Under Tab Messages you find messages relating to general ledger accounts and tax ledger accounts.-Cause-The warning message 'Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for journal entry XYZ' is merely an indication that for a certain journal entry the calculated tax of the document does not match with the position amount which is tax-relevant.-This happens when the manual entered tax amount is different from the calculated tax amount.-This can be seen by opening the Supplier Invoice related to the Journal Entry and under General Tab, go to Taxes and then Tax Details. Here it is possible to see the Tax Amount and Calculated Tax Amount.-Resolution-In the Reconciliation Run, the warning is displayed for such cases (where the tax amount was manually changed) only to bring this point to the attention of the Financial Accountant. In case the tax amount change is valid, the accountant does not need to take any action. But in case they are suspicious the accountant has to check why the tax amount was manually changed by someone.-The absolute differences that you see are due to rounding and whenever there is a difference of more than 4 X(please see the following explanation for details), the status will show in red and that is just to draw the attention.-*The system sets a threshold and it is 4 X (display decimal precision or rounding value). That is, for example, for JPY as the display decimal is zero - precision is 1 thus threshold is 4 X 1 = 4 JPY; for EUR display is 0.01 thus threshold is 4 X 0.01 = 0.04 EUR.-Keywords-reconciliation run, tax differences, Abstimmungslauf Fehler, Der berechnete Steuerbetrag unterscheidet sich vom gebuchten Steuerbetrag für den Buchungsbeleg

Title: Error When Trying to Maintain a Time Entry as Sales Order Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer is receiving  an error when maintaining a Time Entry for a particular Service Confirmation. System shows the following error message:-"Company of Service Order ABC does not match employee XYZ".-ABC reflects the Service Order and XYZ reflects the Employee ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration Work Center-Go to the Time Sheet View.-Show Active Employees.-Search for the Employee ID.-Click Open Time Sheet.-Add Row.-Maintain any date and Time Type as Working hours.-Go to the Labor Information tab.-Confirmation Type maintain as Sales Order Confirmation.-Sales Order maintain the affected ID.-Save.-Error occurs.-Cause-The root cause is related to an inconsistency in the BO related to the Times in the Service Orders.-In this BO for the seller party, we see PARTY_KEY_ID  and PARTY_UUID are blank whereas these are maintained in BO SERVICE_ORDER.-A backend correction is required for this scenario.-Resolution-In order to fix this scenario we must maintain the PARTY_ID-CONTENT and PARTY_UUID in TIMX_VIEW_OF_SERVICE_DOC.-Steps: -Access the system's backend.-Enter in the Transaction Code SESFTS.-Maintain the Object TIMX_VIEW_OF_SERVICE_DOC.-Query the Service Order ID in content ID tab.-Now navigate to the Party node.-Here we see no details for party id and party UUID. -We need to maintain it from the service order BO-Keywords-Error, Add, Maintain, Time Entry, Sales Order Confirmation, Service Order, Time Sheet, Company of Service Order, does not match employee.

Title: Error Message in GR/IR Clearing Run: 'Transaction contradicts net book value rule'
Content: Symptom-You have completed a GR/IR clearing run however this run has finished with errors.-In the Processed with Errors tab of the Log Result you notice the following error messages:-'An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset ABC' (ABC represents the ID of the Fixed Asset)-'Asset ABC val.view 1: Transaction contradicts net book value rule'-'Asset ABC val.view 10: Transaction contradicts net book value rule'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Inventory Valuation workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and select GR/IR Clearing.-Press New -> GR/IR Clearing run.-Enter all the respective mandatory data and press Start Now to immediately execute the run.-After a few moments a message appears notifying that the run finished with errors.-Press on the Display Log button. In the Log go to the Processed with Errors tab and you will see the following:-'An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset ABC'-'Asset A val.view 1: Transaction contradicts net book value rule'-'Asset A val.view 10: Transaction contradicts net book value rule'-Cause-Please note: the years and months are used as examples only.-Fixed Asset ABC is a Low Value Asset created in 2023 and the depreciation method is 0100 - LVA 100% complete depreciation.-This asset was created using purchase order DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Purchase Order) and Goods- and Service Receipt GHI (GHI represents the ID of the Goods and Service Receipt).-This Purchase Order was invoiced in January 2024, however in December 2023 the Fixed Asset was depreciated to Net book Value = Zero.--In such case, the GR/IR clearing posting leads to the negative value which is not allowed so error messages are triggered.-As, Fiscal year 2023 is already closed therefore to reverse the depreciation posting is not an option.-Resolution-The following options available to solve the error message:-Option 1:-Open up the previous fiscal years and then post the GR/IR in those respective fiscal years.-or-Reverse the depreciation values and then post the GR/IR in the currently chosen period.-Option 2:-Set the Valuation Check Settings:-Go to the Fixed Asset work center.-Select Fixed Asset ABC.-Go to the Master Data tab.-Then go to Asset Valuation and choose Additional Parameters section to "3 - No Checks".-Execute the GR/IR clearing run again.-This prevents the system from checking the values being posted and allows the affected fixed assets to accept negative net book value.-Option 3:-Post a write up of values for the fixed asset for the affected valuation views thereby reducing the accumulated depreciation values posted in the previous fiscal years.-After that the GR/IR run gets posted normally.-Keywords-GR/IR Run, WE/RE Lauf, contradicts net book value

Title: ByD Mobile Android Push Notification is not Working
Content: Symptom-Android Push notifications for ByD Mobile App would not work post 21st Jun 2024.  Users won’t receive the alert notification in their android phones when app is in background mode for various approvals and time recording. Apart from the notification rest other functionality of the app would remain as it is and works fine.-Cause-Firebase deprecated the legacy FCM HTTP link and replaced it with HTTPS V.1-Resolution-Users can still open the app and see the pending tasks and perform all operations.  -Respective team is working on a workaround and Notifications feature would not be working till further communication.- Keywords-Android Push notifications, ByD Mobile App ,Firebase

Title: How to set-up an Approval Process for Customer Returns
Content: Symptom-You want to set up an approval process for Customer Return in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Select the Return ID AAA (AAA represents the ID of the return).-Click the Edit button.-Click the Release button and select the option With Credit Memo or Without Credit Memo from the dropdown list. -You find that the document is released directly and no approval process is triggered.-Cause-Since you have not maintained any approval process for the customer return, the document is released directly.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, choose the pre-requisite Question under Scoping and maintain a Threshold Value.-Follow below steps under Scoping to select the mandatory Question:-Go to Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Scoping (3rd step).-Expand the Sales business area.-Expand the Selling Products and Services option.-Select the business topic Customer Returns.-  Navigate to Questions (4th step).-Expand the Sales business area.-Expand the Selling Products and Services option.-Select the business topic Customer Returns.-Select the question Do you want to set up an approval process for your returns? -Choose Next and Finish Scoping.-Follow the below steps under Activity list to maintain a Threshold value:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project and click the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune phase.-Select the All Activities under the Show dropdown list.-Search for the activity Approval for Customer Returns.-Click the activity hyperlink.-Click the hyperlink Maintain Threshold Value.-Enter a value against Threshold Value.-Save and Close.-If the defined threshold for return approval is reached, the system automatically sets an approval status in your customer returns header. And the approval task is sent to the line manager of the employee responsible.-You can also assign an alternative approver. The alternative approver is an employee who can process customer return approvals in addition to the-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Employee Work Distribution view.-Select Employee Work Distribution.-Select Group By Business area.-Scroll to Business Area: Sales and Marketing.-Click Alternative Approver for Customer Returns.-Click Edit and click Add Rule.-Select Employee Responsible and Rule Valid From/Rule Valid To date and click Save.-See Also-Help Document: Quick Guide for Returns (in Sales Orders)-Keywords-Customer Return Approval; alternative approver, approver, organizational management, employee, work distribution, rule,

Title: Error During Deployment of Implementation Project
Content: Symptom-While deploying a PDI solution you received the error message "Error During Deployment of Implementation Project. Report an incident" during "Data Update" phase.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Upload and activate the PDI solution in SDK.-Check the status in the Implementation Manager.-You will see the error message during "Data Update" phase.-Cause-Solution deployment needs to be able to change content in the main workspace. If there are no Open Projects or the open project is in draft status in the Business Configuration, those changes cannot be applied, causing the Data Update failure.-Resolution-Create a Change Project if there is no open project or delete the draft if the open project is in draft status in the Business Configuration Work Center, which will allow the content to be deployed. If the issue persists, open an Incident with AP-RC-BDS-BC.-Keywords-PDI, Deploy, Business Configuration, config, upgrade, SDK, upload, activate,

Title: Changes in Sales Order after Approval Process
Content: Symptom-After the Approval Process, the tab Changes in Sales Order shows that a user changes the price, quantity, item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Sales Orders work center.-Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC refers to Sales Order ID).-Navigate to Changes tab.-You will be able to see that a user has changed the item, the quantity and the price.-Cause-This is because the scope question "Do you want to immediately confirm quantities and requested dates during sales order creation based on an availability check?" is in scope. So after approval of a Sales Order, all items get deleted and created again due to availability update from Customer Demand to Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-Keywords-Sales Order ; Approval Process ; Changes; ATP.

Title: Stock Overview Does Not Show the Products With Zero Quantity
Content: Symptom-It is expected that Stock Overview screen displays the products even when the on-hand quantity for that product is zero so that it's known whether the stock is available for this product or not.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign system, it is not possible to display the results for non-existing stock items.-It has been designed so, lets say, when enter a product ID and no stock item exists for that product in all the warehouses for this product. Then it is required to show a line for that product for every combination i.e. for site, location, logistics area, identified stock with quantity equal to zero. This would result in more number of lines and it would not be readable anymore, because of this, the stock overview only shows all the existing stock items.-Further when a product is not shown in the stock overview, it displays the information 'No inventory data found'.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Stock Overview, Product, Supply Planning.

Title: Error: Profit Center Acctg Not Active For Set Of Books XXXX And Profit Center YYYY
Content: Symptom-Error message 'Profit center acctg not active for set of books XXXX and profit center YYYY' occurs while posting Journal Entry Voucher.-XXXX Refers to Set of Books-YYYY Refers to Profit Center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Click on New Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter the relevant details and profit center.-Click on post.-Error message - Profit center acctg not active for set of books XXXX and profit center YYYY is seen.-Cause-For the set of books XXXX, the reporting principle used in the fine tune activity - Set of Books is "Function of Expense".-If profit center has to be used, then the reporting principle used must be one of the below:-Profit center and segment-Profit center and segment, balancing-Profit center and segment, clearing-Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg-Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg, balancing-Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg, clearing-Fund, Profit center and segment, clearing-Resolution-Follow the below steps and maintain one of the above reporting principle:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview.-Search for the activity - Set of Books.-Select the Set of Books and click on Edit.-Select the reporting principle from the list mentioned under Cause.-After changing above settings, Journal Entry Voucher can be posted without error.-Keywords-Error in Journal Entry Voucher, Unable to post JEV because of profit center

Title: Quantity Not Restricted in Logistics Area With Logistics Use Restricted Stock
Content: Symptom-There is a Logistics Area ABC only for restricted stock, hence the Logistics Use of ABC was set as Restricted Stock. However, a quantity of product XXX on Logistics Area ABC is not restricted.-ABC = Logistics Area ID.-XXX = Product ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Stock Overview common task.-Enter the Product XXX.-Select Go.-Notice that there is a quantity in Logistics Area ABC and this quantity is not with the Restricted box checked.-To check if the Logistics Area is for Restricted Stock:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select the Locations view.-Search for the Site which the Logistics Area ABC is in.-Select the Site which the Logistics Area ABC is in.-Choose Edit Layout.-Find the Logistics Area ABC.-Select the Logistics Area ABC.-Notice that the unique Logistics Use set for Logistics Area ABC is Restricted Stock.-Cause-In the Location layout, the Logistics Use could be defined as Restricted Stock for the Logistics Area ABC. The Logistics Use definition is for the purpose of logical division only. It will not make any product in Logistics Area ABC as restricted stock automatically.-Resolution-Whenever perform Post Goods Receipt, select the option as Yes for the Restricted Stock field to make the stock as restricted and unavailable for usage.-Keywords-Logistics Area, Restricted, Available, Stock, Logistics Use-restricted,loa,location

Title: Freight Forwarder Party has not Been Picked Automatically in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales order where the value for the party role has not been picked automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Involved Parties tab.-The value for the party role Freight Forwarder has not been picked automatically..-Cause-The determination of the party role Freight Forwarder depends upon the rule maintained in the Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity Involved Parties for Sales Orders.-Open the activity and select the Party Role Freight Forwarder.-Select the Maintain Determinations button.-You will see below rules are activated for the determination:-Business partner relationship of Ship-To.-Business partner relationship of Account.-This means that the system will try to identify the Freight Forwarder first from Ship-to party, if it is not available in Ship-to then system will try to identify it from Account.-If it is not available in both Ship-to and Account, then the Freight Forwarder will not be populated in the sales order, in this case you can add this party manually.--Explanation on why the Freight Forwarder has not been picked automatically in the sales order XYZ:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the Involved Parties tab.-Select and open the Ship-to party ABC, this will open the Business Partner Organization Overview: ABC (ABC represents the ID of the ship-to party).-Under the Business Partner Role, Select Account, this will open the screen of Account (of role ship-to party).-Select the View All button and go to the Contacts tab, then select Relationships and Responsibilities subtab.-No data is maintained for the Freight Forwarder party under Relationships.-Hence the Freight Forwarder cannot be picked from ship-to as no relationship is maintained.-Now as per the Business Configuration rule for the determination of Freight Forwarder, the system will look for the relationship in the Account of the sales order XYZ.-Go to the Involved Parties tab of the sales order XYZ,.-Select and open the screen of the Account ID.-The Account ID is same as Ship-to account, where no relationship is maintained for the Freight Forwarder.-So as per the rule from Business Configuration , the Freight Forwarder in the sales order XYZ is not picked because there is no Freight Forwarder maintained under Relationships of the ship-to or account.-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign system is behaving as expected. If you want the Freight Forwarder to be picked automatically in the sales order then the Freight Forwarder party need to be maintained in the Ship-to or Account party of the sales order (as explained in the steps provided in the Cause section).-Keywords-Sales Order, Involved Parties, Freight Forwarder

Title: How to Offset Open Items Payables with Open Items Receivables
Content: Symptom-A business partner with both the Customer and Supplier roles was maintained in the system.-A Customer Invoice and a Supplier invoice of the same amount was created for this business partner.-Now, it is desired to clear both open items against each other.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Receivables workcenter navigate to the Customers view and there to the  Customer Accounts subview.-Select the relevant customer and choose  View to access the Trade Receivables - Invoices/Payments Tab of the customer account monitor. Here the open customer invoice can be seen.-In the Payables workcenter navigate to the Suppliers view and there to the Supplier Accounts view.-Select the relevant supplier and choose View to access the Trade Payables -Invoices/Payments Tab. Notice the open supplier invoice with the same amount as the customer invoice in the receivables account.-Now, it is desired to clear both open items against each other.-Resolution-It is possible to scope the Netting of payables and receivables functionality. This functionality enables the manual clearing of open payables with open receivables items from either the customer account or the supplier account monitor.-To enable the Netting of payables and receivables function, follow the steps below:-Open the Solution profile.-Navigate to phase 4- Questions.-Expand Cash Flow Management.-Then expand Payables and Receivables Processing.-Select Payments and Clearing.-Under Group: Netting of payables and receivables mark the question Do you want to enable Netting of payables and receivables as In Scope.-After the scoping has been updated, it will be possible to manually clear open payables with open receivables.-  See Also-2348231 - Netting Functionality: For a Mixed Account The Supplier Invoices Are Not Displayed as Open Items In The Customer Account Monitor And The Opposite Is Also True-Keywords-Netting, Clearing, Supplier, Customer
