Title: Goods and Activity Confirmation Named "Returns of Non-Consumed Goods Confirmation"
Content: Symptom-Where does Goods and Activity Confirmation (GAC) named "Returns of Non-Consumed Goods Confirmation" come from?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Access common task Display / Reverse Goods And Activity Confirmations.-Search ABC (ABC represents GAC ID), select tab Document Flow, it is a stand-alone document.-Open this GAC, its name is "Returns of Non-Consumed Goods Confirmation ABC".-Resolution-For GAC named "Returns of Non-Consumed Goods Confirmation", usually it is result from common task Consumption for Project/Consumption for Cost Center (Posting Type: Goods Return).-If it is result from common task Consumption for Project, fields Project ID and Project Task ID should have value in the GAC.-If it is result from common task Consumption for Cost Center, field Cost Center ID should have value in the GAC.-Keywords-Returns of Non-Consumed Goods Confirmation, GAC, Consumption for Cost Center, Consumption for Project

Title: Bank Account for Tax Payments Cannot Be Changed
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Tax Payment and you cannot choose which bank account to use.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Go to the Tax Returns View.-Go to the Sales and Use Tax Returns Subview.-Show Reported Tax Returns.-Select the tax return you want to pay.-Click Pay.-It will open a new screen for a new Tax Payment.-There is no option to select the bank account.-Cause-For internally initiated tax payments the bank account to be used is determined automatically by the system and cannot be entered manually.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search and open the activity Global Settings for Payment.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods.-There it can be specified in which order the bank accounts should be considered.-With the same method, the bank account for the tax payments is also determined.-Note: Liquidity Check is being done for tax payments and hence a bank account with better liquidity position is chosen even though you maintain the prioritization of bank account.-After maintaining the prioritization, if the wrong bank account is derived, you can use one of the following workarounds:-You can temporarily block the bank accounts that should not be derived leaving unblocked only the one that is to be used for the tax payment. Once the payment is created, unblock the bank accounts. (or)-As an alternative, you may also create the tax payment externally (outside Tax Management work center) via Payment Managements -> New e.g. Outgoing Bank Transfer. Within this new payment, you specify the Tax Authority and payee and define the required amounts. It is not required to specify any open item reference at this moment, once this payment is posted, the system understands that the payee is a tax authority and creates the Tax Payment accordingly for you to match with your tax returns via Tax Management -> Tax Payments.-The same can be done when there is a receivable amount from the tax authority by creating an incoming payment with the tax authority as payer.-Keywords-Tax payment, Bank Account, wrong bank account in tax payment.

Title: Restricted Key Figure Breaches Restrictions
Content: Symptom-You have created a restricted key figure. However when you open the report and check the key figure value you realise the restriction is not applied correctly. For example you have taken key figure ABC (ABC represent the key figure name) and restricted it to status = completed, but in the report this is not taken into account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Report from the respective work center.-Execute the report.-Check the value of your restricted key figure.-You identify that the key figure value is not restricted correctly.-Cause-This can happen in 2 scenarios:-When the restricted key figure is based on another key figure which is calculated. For example, the restricted key figure is based on a calculated key figure DEF.-When the restricted key figure is based on another key figure which is restricted. For example, the restricted key figure is based on a restricted key figure GHI.-Scenario 1:-The calculated key figure has a formula X+Y. In such cases the restriction will be applied to the formula in the Calculated Key figure DEF first. The resultant value of the calculation will be displayed for the Key figure ABC.-Scenario 2:-The restricted key figure GHI has a restriction on a specific characteristic, for example status = completed; closed. In your own custom key figure, you are again using the same characteristic to restrict it, in our example status = completed. If you use the same characteristic, the restrictions will be merkged rather than being applied on top of each other. In our example, it will display the status Completed AND Closed AND Completed, and it will not be restricted to Completed only.-Resolution-This is an expected system behaviour.-For scenario 2, you can apply the following workaround: In the key figure wizard (step 2), instead of selecting the values you want to restrict the key figure to, exclude the values you do not want to see. So for example, instead of selecting the status Completed, exclude the value Closed.-See Also-You can check the setup of the standard key figure you are using via the following steps:-Go to the work center Business Analytics, View Design Key Figures.-Search for the key figure you want to restrict.-Click on the magnifying glass in the column Documentation.-In the new window, you can check how this key figure is restricted or calculated.-Keywords-key figure, restricted key figure, report, data source, analytics, wrong report content, restriction not working-key figure does not work

Title: Metadata: ACL Missing or Incomplete in View Error During Query Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom Business Object in the Cloud Applications Studio (SDK). You are now trying to activate this Business Object, but activation is failing with the following errors:-Metadata: ACL missing or incomplete in view.-Error During Query Maintenance.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Open the relevant solution.-Activate the Solution/ Activate the query.-Metadata error occurs.-Cause-This issue occurs when you have defined the association AccessControl with the Access control annotation, however if you fail to select any field from the Association this error will occur.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the relevant solution.-Navigate to the business object where you have added RelevantForAccessControl, association to any standard business object.-Open the affected .qry file.-Open the Query fields tab and select at least one field from the BO to which the association is made.-Save and activate-Keywords-AP-RC-BDS-ANA error while activating the query file in SDK-Metadata error while activating the solution-ACL is throwing error-

Title: Business user can access employee's Compensation File without Compensation work center assigned
Content: Symptom-Business user can access employee's Compensation File from Time Administration work center without Compensation work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select any employee and click Edit.-Click button "You can Also" -> Open Compensation File.-Cause-The business user has been assigned with view Clearing Runs. If the business user has both Time administration work center and Clearing Runs view, it is possible to access employee's Compensation File.-Resolution-Removing view Clearing Runs will avoid this issue and it can be removed by following methods.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business User View.-Select the issued business user and click Edit -> Access Rights.-Go to Work Centers and Views Assignment.-Click Find and search for Clearing Runs.-Uncheck the view.-Save and close.-Keywords-Compensation File, Clearing Runs, unexpected access

Title: Error Message "Invalid UID number" While UID for an Account
Content: Symptom-When you try save an Account with new UID number, system throws below error message:-Invalid UID number-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Edit an Account.-Maintain a UID number and save the changes.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that the format that you have entered for the UID number is incorrect.--There is an algorithm which checks if the UID entered is a valid UID just like there is an algorithm for 16 digit Credit card number.-Resolution-Please enter only the valid UID number and then, you can able to save the Accounts.-Keywords-Invalid UID number, Invalid, ID, Account, Save, Error.

Title: Label Printed Does not fit the Size of the Page
Content: Symptom-The labels are printed small and does not fit to the size of the label. However the preview works as expected, but when printed through the print manager it is printed smaller.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistic workcenter-Go to Labels view-Select Print Label-Now notice the label that is printed via Print Manager does not fit the page.-Cause-In Adobe LiveCycle Designer, an incorrect Page Type is defined.-Resolution-User must maintain the Page Type in Adobe LiveCycle Designer, select the Paper Type and re-upload it in the Form Template Maintenance. Follow the steps listed below to do so:-Below steps are to be performed in Adobe LiveCycle Designer-Go to Adobe LiveCycle Designer and open the .xdp file-Now Select the form in the Design View-On the right hand side, select the Master Page subtab-In the Paper Type field, select Custom option-Enter the Height and Width as per the requirement-Save the .xdp file-Below steps are to be performed in Business ByDesign:-Go to Application and User Management-Go to Form Template Maintenance view-Select the required form template -Select Upload and choose To Replace Existing Variant-Publish it-Keywords-Print Label, Print Queue, Size, Print Manager, ALD

Title: Unable to Enter Fixed Asset ID in the Fixed Assets Migration Template
Content: Symptom-While migrating fixed assets, the field to enter the fixed asset ID in the migration template is missing.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Overview > Show > Activities and search for Prepare for Data Migration and click on it.-Select Download migration templates.-Search for Fixed Assets or Fixed Assets (extended) and click on Download and open the template.-Inventory ID instead of Fixed Asset ID to enter is seen.-Cause-The entry under Inventory ID is automatically assigned to the fixed asset, which allows to uniquely identify a physical object in an inventory especially for legacy assets with an existing ID in the source system. Enter the unique alphanumeric number used to identify the fixed asset.-Resolution-For the Fixed Asset IDs, the prefix 00 is assigned to each predefined fixed asset class. This means that the first fixed asset is assigned the number: 1, the next 2, and so on.-If different number ranges for each fixed asset class is needed, then it can be adjusted via the Number Range. For example, for the number 10000000001, enter 01 in the Number Range.--So, based on asset class that needs to be assigned in the template and the number range which is set, the fixed asset ID will be assigned by the system automatically to the chosen range in this setting.-Keywords-inventory id in fixed asset template, fixed asset id missing in fixed asset template.-fixed asset id missing in template,fixed asset template

Title: Key Figures in Joined Data Sources Show Multiplied Values
Content: Symptom-You have created a joined data source which includes some key figures. When you preview the data source or the report built on top of it, you notice that the key figure values are in some cases multiplied, for example when you add specific characteristics or selection variables.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Data Sources.-Search for your joined data source and click on Preview.-Let us assume that you are checking the values for the key figure ABC (ABC stands for the key figure name). In the initial view and selection, this key figure shows the value 1000 USD for example.-Now perform one of the following actions: Add a characteristic to the view (e.g. Contact) or add a variable in the selection (e.g. select some specific Contacts to the selection).-Execute the report again.-The key figure value is multiplied. If you added a characteristic to the view, the key figure is broken down into several values, but their total is more than 1000 USD. If you added a selection variable, the key figure shows a value higher than 1000 USD.-Cause-The join conditions of this data source are the cause for this behaviour.-For example, you have created a numeric extension field on the account screen and you have added this field to the Account Master Data data source. Then you create a join between the data sources Account Master Data and Account Contact Data, joining them on the Account characteristic.-The extension field will show 1 value per account, since it was create on an account level. However, there may be more than 1 contact per account. So in a join like this, the key figure from the account will be displayed once per contact, which will result in a wrong value overall.-Resolution-This is the correct system behaviour. Adding fields from a header level (Account in this case) to an item level (Contact in this case) will result in multiplied values. For more information, you can also check the help center article called 'Add Extension Fields as Key Figures'.-You would need to redesign the join of your data source if you need a different result. Please use the channels for consulting queries should you require assistance with your particular business scenario. Please note that the Support Team cannot provide consulting of this kind.-Alternatively, you can check if restricted key figures fulfill your business scenario. For example, a fixed or variable restriction on the key figure ABC will give you the desired result, without having to add the characteristic (Contact in our example) to the view to break down the values correctly. For more information on creating such key figures, you can also check the help center article 'Create and Edit a Key Figure'.-See Also-2588157 - Counter in Custom Data Sources is Wrong-Keywords-Joined Data Source, Key Figures Inconsistent, Values are Multiplied, wrong values, analytics, report, data source

Title: The Project Task/Phase Has Incorrect.Total Duration
Content: Symptom-After a change in schedule of a Project Task/Phase, the Project Task/Phase total duration is not updated automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Select Projects View.-Choose the Project and click on Edit.-Select the respective Project Task/Phase and go to Scheduling Tab.-Here you see the Duration is incorrect.-Cause-While the status of the project is In planning, the system automatically calculates the total duration of the project task/phase.-While status of the project to Started or Released .The total duration will not be calculated automatically. To trigger the system to recalculate the project schedule, click the Schedule button in the Project Plan view-Resolution-In this case to trigger the system to recalculate the project schedule, follow the below steps:-Go to Project Management work center -Go to Projects view and search for respective Project ID ABC-Select the Project Plan tab-Go to Gantt chart sub tab and click on More(>>) and then Options-Select the Schedule tab. This will automatically schedule the Phase duration based on the Task duration. -Keywords-Project Phase duration, project task duration, manual project schedule

Title: Exchange Rate Attribute Missing in Aging List for Payables Report
Content: Symptom-Exchange rate attribute is missing in the Aging List for Payables report.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Reports > List view.-Open the Aging List for Payables report.-The Exchange Rate attribute cannot be added to the Selection or Rows of the report.-Cause-The report displays transactions based on the defined currency in the Display Currency field.-Resolution-By default, the Aging List report displays values in Transaction Currency. Every document can be in a different currency (A Supplier Invoice can be displayed in USD, another invoice in EUR etc).-Display Currency can be maintained to see all these transaction in one currency based on a specific Currency Conversion date.--Example: Open Items, such as Supplier invoices with Transaction Currencies USD or EUR or INR can be viewed in GBP, if GBP is maintained as Display Currency, according to the given Currency Conversion Date.-Keywords-exchange rate, Aging List for Payables

Title: Unable to Approve Sales Quote from ByD Mobile APP
Content: Symptom-When you try to approve a Sales Quote from ByD Mobile APP, system throws below error but you are able to approve the same Sales Quote from UI without any issues-Enter an e-mail address in output settings-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business Work center-Go to Sales Quotes View-Search for Sales quote ID -Select sales quote ID and send for approval-Log on to SAP Business Bydesign Mobile app, try to approve the sales quote and you can see the error "Enter an e-mail address in the output settings" and the sales quote is not approved.-Cause-In ByD UI it is system behavior that it is allowed to support mass approval (Selecting and approving multiple sales quote and all other documents) which Ignore the validation errors.-However, in mobile mass approval process is not there hence the behavior is different in Mobile and UI. If there is any error during the sales quote approval in mobile then the error should be resolved by the user-Resolution-This is expected current system behavior.-In case if then expectation is to have ByD UI behavior same as Mobile UI, then provide your feedback in Customer Influence forum https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -Keywords-sales quote approval, mobile, byd ui, output settings

Title: Sales Order Confirmation Is Not Set To Successful When You Use Output Channel As XML And The Status Remains Pending
Content: Symptom-Sales Order Confirmation is not set to successful when you use output channel as XML and the status remains Pending always and you have another output channel as Email. For Email output the status is set as successful.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center-Go to Sales Orders View-Search for Sales Order XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Sales Order)  -Edit the Sales Order and click on View All-Navigate to Output History-You can see two line, one is Email with status as Successful and XML output is set as Pending.-Cause-You have maintained two output channels in the Account Master data and XML is not maintained at the top of the sequence which is causing the issue. The XML channel should always at the first place.-Resolution-You need to change the output channel selection sequence at Account Master Data as 'XML' is a first place. Please follow the below steps:-Go to Account Management Work center.-Go to Accounts View-Search for Account used in the Sales Order-Edit the Account and click on View All-Navigate to Communication Tab-Go to Collaboration Tab, you can see there two output channels for Sales Order Confirmation and XML is at second place.-Kindly ensure to maintain the XML at first place followed by the other channel such as Email.-Save your changes.-Performing above steps will resolve the issue for newly created sales orders, for existing Sales Orders you might to perform the dummy change to Output channels in Sales Order, by removing and adding the output channels again.-Keywords-Sales Order, Output channel, XML, status, Pending;

Title: Unexpected Status of Background Job Run "Service Order Release to Execution Run"
Content: Symptom-When checking the status of Background Job "Service Order Release to Execution Run", you see that the Error Description shows "No Error occurred", however, when checking the Application Log, you see the Application Log Overall Status "Errors occurred".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Background Jobs view.-Find a Run of Job "Service Order Release to Execution Run" (ReleaseToExecSORun).-You see that the Error Description of the Job is "No error occurred".-Now, click the View Application Log button.-You see that the Application Log Overall Status is "Errors occurred".-Cause-In Background Runs, errors are classified as "Errors", "Warnings", and "Information" messages. The error displayed is a Warning Message, not an Error message. However, since Warnings are also treated as errors in the Application Log View, the Overall status shows "Errors occurred". -In contrast, the "Service Order Release to Execution Run" Job in the Background Jobs only checks for Errors, ignoring Warnings and Information messages. Therefore, the status shows "No error occurred" as there are only Warning messages.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Background Job, Status, Incorrect, Unexpected, Erroneous, Error, SO_RELEASE_TO_EX_RUN, Service Order Release to Execution Run, ReleaseToExecSORun

Title: Error Message "Active exception for key figure already exists" While Saving The Report View
Content: Symptom-When the customer tries to save the view, they get the below error message.-'Active exception for key figure already exists'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Business Analytics.-2.Go to Design Reports.-3.Choose the report Profit Overview by Key Figure.-4.Choose 'Click here to the start the report'.-5. Go to the view section.-6. Under Column fields ->Key Figure -> (...) More -> Conditional Formatting.-7. You will have more than one active condition.-Cause-You have more than one active exception or condition on a key figure maintained.-Resolution-Only one exception or condition per key figure can be active. -The other exceptions and conditions must be set to inactive. -See Also-2728215 - Report Upload Error due to Key Figure Settings - SAP for Me -Keywords-Active Exception, condition, exception, key figure, conditions, exceptions, Profit overview, Report view, Save, More than one, Already exists

Title: Custom Code Category In Quality Code Catalogue
Content: Symptom-The user is not able to create new Code Category to be used in Quality Code Catalogue. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Planning work center. -Navigate to the Quality Code Catalogs view-Choose the New button and select the option Catalog-In the new Quality Code Catalogue screen you have a drop down field Code Category. -The user wants to be able to add more values in this drop down. -Cause-There is no option available to add custom code category in ByDesign.-Resolution-The option to create custom Code Category is a new requirement. You can choose to-Create a custom enhancement with the help of your partner to achieve your requirement. -Post your requirement in SAP's Ideas Forum available via the link <https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886>

Title: Warehouse Requests are not Automatically Created in case of Customer Return Scenario
Content: Symptom-Warehouse requests are not automatically created when an incoming delivery notification is generated through the ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn web service despite defining the Automatic actions in Inbound Logistics workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter. -Go to Inbound delivery Notifications view.-Find and select relevant Inbound Delivery Notification ID: AA.-Go to Document Flow, here notice that Warehouse Request is not created.-(Here *AA is the Customer Return Delivery Notification ID )-Cause-In the scheduled Run ID, relevant Ship -To site is not being included as well as Reference type Outbound delivery is also missing.-Resolution-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.- Go to Automated Actions view.-Choose Warehouse Request Runs sub view.-Find and Edit relevant Run ID.-Specify the parameters for Ship To site and include the Reference Type as Outbound Delivery.-Keywords-Customer Return, Inbound Delivery Notification, Warehouse Request Run, Inbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery, Ship-To , automatic runs.

Title: 'No amount exists on bank AAA, cash loc ABC, currency DEF for these accounts' Error Posting Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-Error message is thrown upon attempting to post a journal entry voucher with journal entry type 00083 - Manual Entry for Cash:-'No amount exists on bank AAA, cash loc ABC, currency DEF for these accounts'.-AAA means My Bank ID.-ABC means Bank Account ID.-DEF means Transaction Currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Find the respective journal entry voucher.-Click Post.-Error is displayed:-'No amount exists on bank AAA, cash loc ABC, currency DEF for these accounts'.-Cause-In the journal entry voucher, Bank Account ID ABC is being specified in at least one of the journal entry voucher line items, but there's no balance on Bank Account ID ABC since the first bank statement posting the initial balance has not been created and posted yet.-Since the first bank statement (bank statement ID 0) has not been created/posted yet, no entry in the register nor the ledger is made. -Resolution-Create the first bank statement for Bank Account ID ABC, loading an initial balance to the bank account, so the journal entry voucher could be posted.-Keywords-jev; bs; bank statement; Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Cash; manual entry for cash

Title: Service Order Remains in the "Completed" Status Even After the Cancelation of Follow-up Documents Like Service Confirmation In Third Party Scenario.
Content: Symptom-The Service Order remains in Completed status though the line item in the related Service Confirmation are already Canceled.-You expect the status of the Service Order to be In Process in the Third Party Repair Process.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders work center-Go to Service Order Processing and search for order XYZ(XYZ is The ID of the Service Order)-You can see the service order is completed, with service status is finished-However, the corresponding Service Confirmation YYY is cancelled with reason for rejection and the same is not updated in the Service Order.(YYY is the ID of the Service Confirmation)-Cause-In Third Party Service scenario, cancelling the Service Confirmation will not update cancellation status in Service Order unless you cancel the corresponding Purchase Order.-Resolution-Kindly cancel the corresponding Purchase Order, post which the Service Order delivery status will be updated to In Process and Service Order status will be set to In Process from Completed.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Cancel, reason for rejection, third party

Title: Unable to Change the Size of the Footer When Working with Master Templates
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit the size of the Footer by changing it's Font, however you are not finding the option to do so.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management or Administrator  work center.-Go to the Master Template Maintenance.-In the Master Template Maintenance view, select Form Master Templates from the Show menu.-Select the master template you want to edit and click Edit.-There is no option to edit the Font size.-Resolution-Currently, this is the expected system behavior. When adding more text in the footer it will get small.-See Also-1775458 - The Form Preview of the Customer Invoice Uses the Header and Footer of the Master Template-3023486 - Supported Fonts Types in Form Templates-2946723 - Font is Different In Output Preview Than When Editing Form Template with Adobe LifeCycle Designer-3454712 - How to identify which font types are used in PDF files-Keywords-Master Template, Usage, Font, Footer, Cannot, Unable, Not being able to, Change, Edit, Application and User Management, Administrator, Master Template Maintenance.

Title: Revenue Recognition History Report Shows Total Earned Revenue Amount as Current Earned Revenue Amount
Content: Symptom-For Sales Order item XYZ-XX  the revenue recognition run realises revenue is different accounting periods (XYZ represents the sales order item ID). -Each run recognized a Current Earned Revenue amount and calculates the Total Earned Revenue amount:-Example:-Previously earned revenue in period 002.YYYY: 200,00 CC (CC represents the company currency).-Revenue recognition run for period 003.YYYY:-Current Earned revenue: 100,00 CC -Total Earned revenue: 300,00 CC (Previous total earned revenue amount plus Current Earned Revenue). -You execute a run for a new period, for example, 004.YYYY after accumulating another 100,00 CC of revenue: -The runs displays the following: -Current Earned Revenue is: 400,00 CC-Total Earned Revenue is: 400,00 CC.-You expect the run to show  a Current Earned Revenue figure of 100,00 LC as this is the difference between the previous Total Earned Revenue, 300,00 CC, and the new Total Earned Revenue: 400,00 CC. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document items view.-Find item XYZ-XX.-Choose Revenue Recognition and select Revenue Recognition History.-Check run for period 003.YYYY with Current Earned Revenue, 100,00 CC and Total Earned Revenue 300,00 CC. -Check run for period 004.YYYY with Current Earned Revenue 400,00 CC and Total Earned Revenue 400,00 CC.-Why does the run not show Current Earned Revenue 100,00 CC and Total Earned Revenue: 400,00 CC? -Cause-There was an account determination change in the relevant master data, such as the Service account determination group or the Customer Account Determination group, causing the revenue recognition run to transfer all the revenue over to a new G/L account. --Example: -Up until period 003.YYYY the sales order's customer is assigned to account determination group ABC (ABC represents an account determination group): -But before the revenue recognition run for period 004.YYYY, the customer's account determination group changes to DEF (DEF represents a different account determination group). -In the Account Master data go to the Changes tab and identify the account determination group change. - To check the Account Determination Master data check the G/L Accounts assigned to the account determination groups ABC and DEF: -In Fine Tuning, go to the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination  activity.-Select Account Determination - Sales:-For account determination group ABC G/L account AAA is assigned as Sales Revenue account.-For account determination group DEF G/L account BBB is assigned as Sales Revenue account. -Resolution-The system works as designed: As the G/L account to realise the earned revenue, changes in period 004.YYYY, the revenue recognition run debits all the previously realised revenue (300,00 CC) to the original account AAA and realises all the revenue as Current Earned Revenue on the new account BBB, 400,00 CC, so that the Current Earned Revenue amount equals the Total Earned Revenue amount.

Title: Unable to remove Quantity Conversion due to Error "Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists"
Content: Symptom-When you try to modify or delete a Quantity Conversion in a Material, system throws below error-Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Master Data work center-Go to Materials view-Edit a Material-Modify or remove the quantity conversion-System throws below error-Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists-Cause-You can check whether the material is used in any price list-However, even if you used the material once in a Procurement price list then it is not possible to change or delete the quantity conversion of the material. Importantly if the status of the Purchasing tab is Active or Blocked.-Resolution-Explained above is the current behavior-Only option is to create a new material or continue with the same material without changing the quantity conversion-Keywords-Conversion is used by one or more open procurement price lists, material, quantity conversion

Title: Access Restrictions not Working for Liquidity Forecast View
Content: Symptom-Access restrictions are not working for liquidity forecast view-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work center-Go to Liquidity Forecasts view  -Business users with company restrictions are able to access data that is not assigned to them -Cause-The business role is currently assigned to the Corporate Performance Work Center. However, the financials in this Work Center do not have any restrictions. This means that all business users with access to this Work Center can view the financials of every company.-Resolution-Remove the Corporate Performance Work Center assignment for the business role by following the below steps.-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Go to Business Roles View-Search for the Business Role-Choose Edit-Go to the Work Center and View Assignments tab-Go to Available Work Centers and Views-In the search field, insert CPM_CORPORATEPERFORMANCE-Select the first line-Choose Locate-Unmark the assignment for the CPM_CORPORATEPERFORMANCE Work Center ID-Choose Save.-Keywords- liquidity forecast view, access restrictions, CPM_CORPORATEPERFORMANCE, financials , company restrictions

Title: Custom Data Source Referring to Data Soure From Original Solution
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom data source via Design Data Sources work center view based on a PDI Data Source created on Original Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_). Then, you have created a Patch Solution (e.g. Y12345678_) into tenant and you can still see custom data source referring to Original Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_).-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics > Design Data Sources work center view.-Click on New.-Insert a Name.-Insert a PDI Data Source created on Original Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_).-Save it.-Go SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Create a Patch Solution for Original Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_).-Go to Business Analytics > Design Data Sources work center view.-The created data source still refers to Original Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_). instead of refers to newly Patch Solution (e.g. Y12345678_) created.-Cause-This is the system expected behavior. The system does not overwrite configuration done on custom data source created via Design Data Sources work center view. That's reason why you still it referencing PDI Data Source created on Original Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_)-Resolution-You need to update custom data source created via Design Data Sources work center view manually. You can follow these steps:-Go to Business Analytics > Design Data Sources work center view.-Select Data Source.-Click to Edit.-Remove PDI Data Source having Original Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_) namespace.-Add PDI Data Source having Patch Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_) namespace.-Save it.--Now, the custom data source is using PDI Data Source having Patch Solution (e.g. YABCDEFGH_) namespace. -Keywords-data source, pdi, original solution, patch solution, patch data source, custom data source, pdi data source

Title: Cost Center Manager is updated under Direct Approvers in Shopping cart request
Content: Symptom-On completing the 2nd level of approval, the 1st level approver (who is the cost center manager) appears grouped with 2nd level approvers (direct approvers).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Scenario of the Approval process :-3 level of approvers : Cost Center, Direct Approver, Direct Approver -Below is the steps to reproduce the issue :-Go to Managing My Area work center-Go to Approvals view-1st level of approver search and approve the Shopping cart request -Shopping cart goes for 2nd level of approval , where it is sent for revision -Shopping cart is modified and then approved by the cost center manager (who is the 1st level approver) -1st level approver name is now visible in both 1st and 2nd level of approvers in the Approvals tab of the shopping cart -Cause-Cost center manager is assigned with Admin access rights, which will enable them to approve the Shopping cart post modification. Which would be the reason for the cost center manager to be shown as the direct approver in the Approvals tab. -Resolution-As the cost center manager(1st level of approver) has admin access, approval process was performed after modifying the Shopping cart , which was actually the 2nd round of approval. Hence cost center manager name is showing up in the direct approvers list (2nd level of approval) in the Approvals tab after completion of all the levels of approval.-Keywords-cost center manager with admin access, cost center manager is updated as direct manager, shopping cart approval

Title: Error Message: You are not authorized to change the data.
Content: Symptom-While trying to approve or reject the Project time records, system throws an error message: "You are not authorized to change the data".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Choose Confirm Time Recording view under Common Task.-Choose Approve button the system throws an error message: "You are not authorized to change the data and the time record will not get approved".-Or-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Approvals view.-Choose Time Recordings sub view.-Choose Approve button and the system throws an error message: "You are not authorized to change the data and the time record will not get approved".-Cause-User does not have sufficient write access authorization for My Project and My Team work centers to approve the time records.-Resolution-Go to Application And User Management work center.-Choose User and Access Management view.-Choose Business Users sub view.-Choose the User.-Choose the Edit and Access Rights button.-Go to Access Restrictions tab, Unrestricted the Read Access and Write Access to My Team and My Projects work centers.-Keywords-Access rights, authorized, user

Title: No Customer Demand created after the Release of Sales Orders
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-No Customer Demand created after the Release of Sales Orders-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center. -Go to the Sales Orders view. -Find and select Sales Order-You can see the Sales Order has the Status Open.-Click Edit and View All.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Show "Extended View".-You can see there is no Customer Demand.-Cause-Cause for the issue is that the process component CUSTOMER_REQUIREMENT_PROC was Phase OUT-Resolution-The process component CUSTOMER_REQUIREMENT_PROC should be ON-This should be performed through the report MDRS_RTLC_SWITCH_BOARD to generate the required entry in table MDRS_D_RTLC_STAT-Keywords-No Customer Demand created after the Release of Sales Orders

Title: How to Process Failed Event Notification in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You would like to know the varies options to process failed Event Notifications in SAP Business byDesign-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management work center-Go to Event Notification Monitoring View-Filter with Status as Failed-Click Go-Resolution-There are two ways to process the failed Event Notifications -Manually by using the Resend option in the Event Notification Monitoring-Automatically where the system automatically resend failed events. The system attempts to auto-resend up to 7 times for failed events.-Keywords-resend, failed, event notification, monitoring

Title: Third Party Purchase Order item is not transferred to Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Item in the third party Purchase Order is not transferred to the corresponding Sales Order -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for the Purchase Order and open the items tab to see the number of items  -Go to document flow and open the corresponding Sales Order created-Navigate to items tab , all the items from Sales Order are not present -Also, the Sales Order contains an active process communication error / a process communication error which was cancelled from the backend. -Cause-List price was initially not maintained for the Product used in the Purchase Order, which caused a process communication error on the Sales Order. As a result the product which did not contain list price was not passed on to the Sales Order items.  -Resolution-Remove the line item from the Purchase Order ,with the Product whose List price is not maintained and caused the process communication error on Sales Order and save. Maintain the list price in the product and add it in the Purchase Order and then save/order. This product details will now be updated in the Sales Order (only if the Sales order is in In progress status). -Please make sure to maintain the list price for the product before adding it in the Purchase Order, in order to avoid the issue further. -Keywords-Item not transferred from purchase order to sales order, list price not maintained , sales order item missing

Title: When Confirm Check Task, After Click Finish Results Recording, How System Proposes Value Into Confirmed Quantity in Reporting Point?
Content: Symptom-When Confirm a check task, after maintaining all mandatory fields under tab Inspection, click button Finish Results Recording, the screen goes to tab Confirmation automatically, a value is proposed into the field "Confirmed Quantity" in reporting point, how this value is calculated?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Access view Task Control.-Select a Check Task, click Confirm.-Maintain all mandatory fields under tab Inspection.-Click button Finish Results Recording.-The screen goes to tab Confirmation automatically, a value displays in the field "Confirmed Quantity" in reporting point.-Resolution-System standard behavior is:-1) If the make task before the check task is not finished, then when confirming the check task, after click Finish Results Recording, system calculates automatically: confirmed quantity = inspected quantity - nonconforming units.-2) If the make task before the check tasks is finished, then when confirming the check task, after click Finish Results Recording, system calculates automatically: confirmed quantity = the confirmed quantity in the last reporting point before this check task - nonconforming units.-When you use custom API to call action FinishResultsRecording, the behavior is the same.-Keywords-Check Task, Inspection, Confirmed Quantity, Finish Results Recording, FinishResultsRecording

Title: When Perform Consumption for Cost Center (Goods Issue), Error Triggered: No matching inventory items found.
Content: Symptom-When perform Consumption for Cost Center (Goods Issue), error triggered: No matching inventory items found. However, there is Corresponding on-hand stock in Stock Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open common task Stock Overview.-Enter ABC in filter Product ID, enter DEF in filter Site ID, click Go.-In the result, there is on-hand stock with Stock Type "Warehouse".-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Access common task Consumption for Cost Center.-Select Goods Issue in Posting Type.-Enter DEF in filter Site, enter GHI in filter Cost Center.-In the below click Add Row, enter ABC in Product ID.-Click Next, error triggered: No matching inventory items found.-Cause-In Stock Overview, add fields "Owner ID" and "Inbound Delivery ID" into the table through personalization mode, for this on-hand stock, owner is an account, inbound delivery ID is CID_1, open this inbound delivery, open its preceding Customer Return Delivery Notification IDN_1, follow-up activity is "Return to Supplier", "Externally-Owned Stock" is checked.-This is third-party order scenario, since this on-hand stock is owner by account and "Returned to Supplier" is the Follow-Up Activity in inbound delivery notification, you cannot consume it.-Resolution-You can only return this stock back to supplier. Please refer to help document Third-Party Order Processing — Customer Return | SAP Help Portal -See Also-3041636 - Stock is Not Available in Supply Planning After the Customer Return is Completed. -3145324 - Unable to Perform Change of Stock for Externally-Owned Stock-Keywords-Consumption for Cost Center, No matching inventory items found, Stock Overview, On-hand Stock, Owner, Inbound Delivery, Inbound Delivery Notification, Return to Supplier, Externally-Owned Stock

Title: Not Able to Access the Self-Service Area
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error “Technical Users are not authorized to access Employee Self-Services.” when trying to access self-service area - Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center-Select the Self-Service view -Navigate to Self-Services Overview subview-Error “Technical Users are not authorized to access Employee Self-Services.” -Cause-There is some inconsistency in employee type start date .In the backend employee type start date is future date. -Login to backend-Go to T-code SESFTS-Input HCM_EMPLOYEE_SUPP_CO in Load BO by Proxy Name -Search for the Employee ID-Navigate to Employee Type -Validity period start date is in future-Login to backend-Go to T-code SESFTS-Input HCM_EMPLOYEE_SUPP_CO in Load BO by Proxy Name -Search for the Employee ID-Navigate to workagreement node-Navigate to Position -Validity period start date is different -Now, Login to UI-Go to Personnal Administration work center-Search for employee-In general tab , the employee hire date is different -In workagreement and frontend the validity date is correct , but in employee type node it is not correct-   Resolution-Login to backend-Go to T-code SESFTS-Input HCM_EMPLOYEE_SUPP_CO in Load BO by Proxy Name -Search for the Employee ID-Navigate to Employee Type -Validity period start date is in future-Go to Edit -Change the date to correct value( correct value of date is work agreement date and Hire date )-Keywords-employee start date , hire date , work agreement , self service area, Technical users, no access

Title: Some Field Values are not Displayed During the Output Document Preview
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Certain fields do not appear in the output document preview; however, upon checking in Adobe LiveCycle Designer, the information is displayed as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The scenario described in the example below could also apply to other output documents or previews.-Go to Production Control Wok Center-Go to Production Orders View-In the dropdown, select All Production Orders-Select the ID: ABC-Choose Edit-Navigate to Miscellaneous tab-Select Output History-When open the output document and notice some fields in the template is not displayed. -Cause-The field values are not displayed during the preview because the custom font is used in the form template.-Resolution-In SAP cloud solution you can use the font types in forms as per the SAP Help Documentation: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/d0ccf70030584d24b5ca75ec264f2776.html-To identify the font type in Adobe LiveCycle Designer (ALD):-Open the XDP file in ALD.-Press Ctrl+D.-Navigate to the Fonts tab to see the font type.-See Also-Preview, Field Missing, Adobe LiveCycle Designer, ALD, Forms, Font Type, Output Document

Title: Does the "New" Outlook UI supports the SAP Add-In like outlook ?
Content: Symptom-You want to know if the "New" Outlook UI supports the SAP Add-In like outlook?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Any Third-party add-in (which include all other Add-ins - Apart from Microsoft) has this limitation in New-Outlook. -Resolution-SAP recommends to use the Desktop Outlook Version until further updates from Microsoft are released on the new Outlook UI, to ensure a the Plugin functionality.-Keywords-New Outlook, Outlook 2025, Add-In
