Title: "Cannot find HOUSE_BANK_ACC_ID" Error During Value Mapping Task in the Migration Tool
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer encounters the error message "Cannot find HOUSE_BANK_ACC_ID" while performing a value mapping task in the Migration Tool for Open Outgoing Checks.-The error appears after saving the mappings during the Convert Values step.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search and open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select Migrate Accounting Transaction Data Using the Migration Tool.-Select the migration unit and click on Execute Migration.-Select the row for Open Outgoing Checks and click on Process File.-In the Convert Values steps, click on the activity to convert Bank Account.-Perform the mapping of the values normally.-Select the Confirm All button.-Select the Save and Close button.-Here the error message appears.-Cause-This issue can occur due to temporary connectivity disruptions or when the browser page is refreshed during the execution of the migration tool.-Resolution-Close and reopen the Migration Tool, then repeat the same steps to perform the value mapping task. Ensure that no page refresh is performed during the process, as refreshing the page may interrupt the activity and cause inconsistencies. Following these steps without refreshing the screen allows the value mapping task to complete successfully. -Keywords--value mapping error, SAP Business ByDesign, migration tool issue, Open Outgoing Checks, HOUSE_BANK_ACC_ID error, accounting transaction migration, connectivity issue, browser refresh error, migration tool troubleshooting, error during value mapping, migration tool error, SAP migration error, accounting data migration, error message HOUSE_BANK_ACC_ID, troubleshooting migration tool, SAP error resolution

Title: How to exclude the Down payments in the Dunning run
Content: Symptom-You wonder how to exclude the Down Payments when executing the Dunning Run-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You would like to exclude the Down Payments when executing a dunning run-Resolution-Go to Receivables Work Center > Dunning Runs view-Click New > Dunning Run-Click the "User" icon and Click Start Personalization Mode-Click OK-Under Personalization, Click ">" under Selection Data-Tick the check box for the Exclude Down Payments-Click Save-Click OK to Confirm the changes-Click the "User" icon and click Stop Personalization Mode-When creating a new Dunning run, if the check box for Exclude Down Payments is ticked, the dunning run will not consider the down payments-See Also-KBA 2045063 - Dunning Run No Dunning Proposals As Payables Exceed Receivables -Keywords-dunning run, down payment, DP, exclude, remove

Title: Incorrect Total Amount in Customer Return
Content: Symptom-In the customer return document, the total amount is incorrect.-For example, the return line 10 has list price 10 USD, quantity is 2 ea. The line net value is 20 USD. You except the return total amount is -20 USD. However, document total amount shows 80 USD instead.-ABC represents the customer return ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Open the return ABC and go to Pricing tab.-You can see the line 10: net value is -20 USD, but the document total is 80 USD.-Cause-The return ABC line 10 is referenced to customer invoice XYZ. The customer invoice XYZ contains a overall discount with amount -100 USD. When creating the return, the pricing information was carried from the reference invoice into the return including the overall discount. -In the Pricing tab of the return ABC, we can see overall discount amount 100 USD in total pricing part. So the return total because 80 USD (-20+100=80).-XYZ represents the customer invoice ID.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior.-To correct the return total, you can manually remove the overall discount price component from Total Pricing part.-Keywords-customer return; total amount; document total; overall discount; incorrect.

Title: Actual Utilization Field Showing 0% When Project View is Added
Content: Symptom-When you load the standard Actual Utilization report with a Project View, you observe that the Actual Utilization field is displaying 0%.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Access the Design Reports work center view.-Locate and open the Actual Utilization report.-Input the mandatory key figures.-Run the report.-Actual Utilization % is displayed as expected for respective employees.-Now add Project field  in Row field.-Run the report-Value for Actual Utilization column is displaying as 0%.-Cause-The Actual Utilization formula is calculated only when the project field is not selected in the selection/filter.-Resolution-This is a Standard system behavior-Keywords-Actual Utilization, report , Project , 0%

Title: Error message " Action not possible; transfer records exist for selected work agreement"
Content: Symptom-Error message while trying to change the hire date of an employee.-"Action not possible; transfer records exist for selected work agreement"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to view Employees-Search for employee ID XYZ-Select line for employee XYZ and edit-Navigate to Work Agreement under Employment-Change hire date and Select  Save button.-Error Message occurs "Action not possible; transfer records exist for selected work agreement " -Cause-You have provided the same date for both the hiring date and transfer date. Therefore, system will not allow to change the hire date to a future date that is later than the first transfer date.-Resolution-The change hire date functionality has below restrictions.--1. Changed hire date should be more than that of Initial Hire Date-2. Changed hire date should be less than that of start date of very first Transfer record since hiring.-3. Changed hire date should not be falling between any transfer validity dates -This is a Standard system behavior-Keywords-Change Hire date, Transfer date, Work Agreement

Title: Incorrect VAT Tax Declaration XML File for Switzerland
Content: Symptom-The VAT tax declaration XML file for Switzerland contains an error: the UID included in the XML file is incorrect by one digit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Tax Management work center. -2. Go to VAT Returns subview. -3. Search for Tax Return ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Tax Return ID). -4. Go to Attachments tab and download the XML file. -  The following information is included in the XML-File:-<eCH-0097:uidOrganisationIdCategorie>CHE</eCH-0097:uidOrganisationIdCategorie>-<eCH-0097:uidOrganisationId>023456789</eCH-0097:uidOrganisationId>-  Nevertheless the following information should be included in the XML:-<eCH-0097:uidOrganisationIdCategorie>CHE</eCH-0097:uidOrganisationIdCategorie>-<eCH-0097:uidOrganisationId>123456789</eCH-0097:uidOrganisationId>-  (023456789 represents the wrong UID Number).-(123456789 represents the correct UID Number).-Cause-The cause of this behavior is that the UID Number was maintained without hyphens and dots in the Company Tax Arrangement. Check the same by following the steps below:-Open the related Tax Authority. -Go to the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Select the Company ID: 123 (123 represents the Company ID). -Go to the "Overview" subtab. -The UID Number was maintained here without hyphens and dots (CHE123456789 HR/MWST).-Resolution-The CH UID number in the Company Tax Arrangement must be maintained with hyphens and dots. Then, the value will appear correctly in the tag. The value maintained is CHE123456789 HR/MWST. We could maintain it as 'CHE-123.456.789 HR/MWST'.)-See Also-Keywords-VAT Return, XML, incorrect, UID, Switzerland.

Title: Duplicate Lines Exist for An Input Product in Supply Task
Content: Symptom-When confirming the supply to production task, you may observe that there are two lines shown for an input product. One line includes the source logistics area data, while the other does not. It is crucial to comprehend that the total planned quantity of both lines corresponds to the actual required quantity. This quantity is determined by the required quantity of the output product and the input product in the Bill of Materials (BoM).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for the production task.-Choose Confirm Button, then you will find the mentioned scenario in Line Items Tab.-Cause-A material flow rule has been set up for source determination rules at the site level. This rule automatically populates the source logistics area and actual quantity when confirming the supply task. Additionally, if the quantity in the source logistics area is not enough to fulfill the full planned quantity, a new line item is created for the remaining planned quantity of the product.-Resolution-This is the standard and expected behavior of the system.-Keywords-Duplicate, Supply Task, Confirm, Lines, Input Product, Material Flow Rules.

Title: The User is Not Able Close the Service Confirmation Screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The user is unable to close the service confirmation screen when he/she has no authorization to it. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Requests view.-Search and found the service confirmation invoice request ABC.-Click the ABC hyperlink to open the service confirmation.-Click view all, system shows error 'You are not authorized to access the data '. This is correct as the user has no access to this document. -Then the user try to close the page, but failed. The page always loading, not able to close the screen.-ABC represents the ID of the service confirmation.-Cause-This behavior is due to that fact that data is restricting to perform any actions in the service confirmation since user doesn't have access to that page.-When unauthorized user opens the document, the calls are triggering which are searching for data and getting failed since because of restrictions on that users which leads to restrict the actions on the page. So the user is unable to close or perform any other action in that screen. -Resolution-This is a system behavior.-Keywords-IAM; not able to close a screen; no authorization.

Title: How to link an existing Opportunity to an existing Sales Quote via SOAPUI
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to link an existing Opportunity ID to an existing Sales Quote via ManageOpportunityIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Based on the Help Center Documentation, please check section - Business Transaction Document References:-In general, with the Business Transaction Document Reference, the opportunity can be linked to other business documents like an activity or a campaign. To create or update a business transaction document reference, the ID (or UUID), TypeCode of the related business document as well as the RoleCode of the business document within the relationship shall be provided.-CustomerQuoteSuccessorBusinessTransactionDocumentReference: A customer quote as related business document is a successor to the opportunity. The type code of Customer Quote is 30.-Resolution-Please refer to below payload to successfully link both document ID's:-  <Opportunity actionCode="02" custQteSuccssrBusTransactionDocumentReferenceListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-            <ID>1071</ID>-            <CustomerQuoteSuccessorBusinessTransactionDocumentReference actionCode="02">-               <ID>13952</ID>-               <TypeCode>30</TypeCode>-            </CustomerQuoteSuccessorBusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-         </Opportunity>-See Also-KBA: 3464394 - How to Maintain Sales Activities by Using API ManageOpportunityIn-Inbound Service ManageOpportunityIn-Keywords-Webservice, ManageOpportunityIn, sales activities, opportunity API.

Title: Reverse Charge is Not Working When Using a PDI Tax Code in a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-A custom tax code created for a non-localized country via PDI Solution (SAP Cloud Applications Studio) is being used in a supplier invoice. -The expectation is that it works with reverse charge mechanism, in such a way that two lines appear under Taxes, one with Due Category Receivable and the other with Payable, but this is not happening: only one line with Due Category Receivable is displayed. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find and open the respective supplier invoice.-Click View All.-Open Items tab.-Open Taxes sub-tab.-Notice that tax code YXZ is selected (YXZ means a custom tax code created via a PDI Solution).-Notice that under Taxes there's just one line displayed, with Due Category Receivable, when the expectation was a second line with Due Category Payable as well, meaning the Reverse Charge tax calculation.-Cause-The tax code XYZ has been assigned to tax event ABC (ABC means the tax event), also created via PDI Solution.-The tax event ABC was configured for reverse charge, but an entry in the BC Set Accounting Tax Attributes (Business Configuration Object AttributesforTaxEventTaxType) was not created.-Resolution-For the custom tax code XYZ to work as a Reverse Charge tax code in a supplier invoice, an entry has to be created in BC set Accounting Tax Attributes (Business Configuration Object AttributesforTaxEventTaxType) against the Tax Event ABC with "ACC_TAX_TYPE = "5    Self-assessed VAT" (this is the AccountingTaxTypeCode). Only once this is maintained the custom tax will start to work as a Reverse Charge tax code in a supplier invoice.-See Also-Refer to attached PDF file "Create Tax Content for NonLocalized Countries in SAP Cloud Applications Studio", from page 17 onwards.-Keywords-reverse charge; bc set; bco; AttributesforTaxEventTaxType; Self-assessed VAT; ACC_TAX_TYPE; SAP Cloud Applications Studio

Title: Customer Invoice is Not Posted Due to Error: 'Tax Jurisdiction ** does not exist'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have released the customer invoice XYZ but it is not posted in accounting. In the Unposted Sources documents view, you find this unposted invoice, the error is 'Tax Jurisdiction ABC does not exist' .-XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice. -ABC represents the Tax Jurisdiction Code ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledge work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Select the unposted invoice XYZ, the error shows:  'Tax Jurisdiction ABC does not exist' . -Cause-In this case, when we checking the address information in the involved parties, we find the Tax Jurisdiction Code on Ship-to party in the preceding sales order is incorrect.-For example, the sales order ship to address is in state CA, while the Tax Jurisdiction Code is given as CO. The state and Tax Jurisdiction Code does not match.-Resolution-Since the customer demand is released for the sales order line and this cannot be reverted. It is not possible to change the item ship-to address any more.-The user has to cancel the sales order (as well as the invoice and outbound deliveries).-Then create a new sales order with correct state and Tax Jurisdiction Code in the ship-to address.-See Also-3109596 - Journal Entry for customer Invoice is not Created due to Process Communication Error Tax Jurisdiction XYZ does not exist-Keywords-Tax Jurisdiction Code; does not exist; unposted source document; State; State Code;

Title: Create Remittance Advice option has been greyed out for the Payment 'ABC'
Content: Symptom-You want to create the Remittance Advice for the Payment 'ABC' which was executed but you see that the option Remittance Advice was greyed out.-'ABC' refers to Payment ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor sub view.-Search for the Payment ABC.-Select the Payment and above you will see the option Create Remittance Advice was greyed out.-Also the Set to in transfer status is greyed out as well.-If you check the same Payment under Payment Proposal list, Its been already in completed status.-Cause-There are two issues here.-1. You are expecting to do the Create Remittance Advice for the payment which is in preparation status. Because the option to Create a Remittance Advice will be available only when the payment is in Ready for Transfer (or) In Transfer status. -Please Note: The option to Create Remittance Advice will not be available for Manually created Payment with Payment Method Other Outgoing Payments. The 'create remittance advice' action on the payment monitor, will create outgoing advices (advices that you intend to send to your debtors).-So this action is only enabled for outgoing payment types and for the following incoming payment types:-Incoming credit card payment-Incoming direct debit-No other incoming payment types can have advices created from the payment monitor, as these advices are sent externally to the parties that owe us (the creator of the advice) money. However, if you navigate to the 'remittance advice' Work center view itself, there you can create remittance advices for any incoming payments that you are expecting to receive.-Advices created here are for your own (the party who is owed money) records. These are not sent externally to debtors. So to summarize, remittance advices can be created for incoming payments but not all of them can be created by the action on the payment monitor. For some, you must go to the remittance advice Work Center view and create them there.-2. When you check the Payment 'ABC' under the Payment monitor it is under the In preparation status again if you check the same Payment under Payment Proposal list, Its been already in completed status.-This is due to status inconsistency. -Resolution-Here the Payment initially have the status inconsistency which was not updated correctly.-You have to provide the permission in the incident to Support team to fix this status inconsistency from backend by performing the Release action of the relevant Payment order which was initially not released from your end.-Once this action have been performed from the Backend, then in the UI you can set the Payment 'ABC' in the In Transfer status and can able to create the Remittance Advice for this Payment 'ABC'.-Keywords-Remittance Advice, Payment Monitor, Payment Proposal List, Set to in Transfer, Completed, Payment, Payment order, Action, Release.

Title: Assembling and Deploying a Single Object of PDI Solution
Content: Symptom-You are seeking information on how to assemble and deploy single objects of a PDI solution from a source to a target tenant.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open Your PDI Solution.-Try to Assemble Single Object.-You can not find such option.-Cause-Such transport is not supported by the system. The system only allows the complete PDI solution to be assembled and transported.-Resolution-If necessary, the entire solution must be transported to the Quality or Production tenant. This can be accomplished using Transport Management or directly through the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-See Also-Activate, Assemble, and Download a Solution-Select and Add Transport Objects to Transport Request, Add-On Solutions-Keywords-transport single PDI object, transport single xbo, transport partial solution, assemble single xbo, assemble single pdi, partially assembled

Title: Multiple currencies displayed in Report : Purchase Order History
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order History report shows 2 currencies under the column "Invoice column in company currency" -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Select All from drop down, Search for Purchase Order History report -Add the required filters and Apply to generate the report-Cause-There could be multiple currencies used in the different process of the Company for which the report is being generated. It is advised to choose the Currency for display while creating the report in order to avoid discrepancies in the data. -Resolution-Kindly maintain the desired Currency under Selection , in the field Display Currency and click on Apply. Once the report is generated, the selected Currency will be displayed for all the items in the report. -Keywords-Multiple currencies displayed, Purchase order history report, 2 currencies in report

Title: Unable to Preview the Output Document due to 'No Records Found'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to preview the output document, while generating the preview the system details - No Data Found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The scenario described in the example below could also apply to other output previews.-Go to Sales work center-Go to Sales Quote view-Select Sales quote ID-Choose Actions-Select Preview-Notice PDF will not be generated.-Cause-The template with the country and language variant is not maintained in the Form Template Maintenance view.-Resolution-Below are the troubleshooting steps to identify the steps:-Logon to backend-Go to SE24 transaction-Enter Object Type: /DOC/CL_DOR_FORM_TPL_HELPER-Select Method: GET_FORM_TPL_INFO-Put external breakpoint in Line 7-Execute the action in UI-Select Preview-Double click on Code:  iv_form_tpl_l_code to get the Language variant-Double click on Code:  iv_form_tpl_l_code  to get the Country variant, this would help identify which variant the system is looking-Then maintain the form in the Form Template Maintenance view with the required language and country variant-Publish-The system should now preview the document as expected.-Keywords-Template, Form Template Maintenance, Preview, Language, Country, No Records Found

Title: Error: 'Value is longer than the maximum allowed length 40' in Outlook Add-In
Content: Symptom-The user scheduled a meeting and synchronized it with Outlook. In the Outlook calendar, they added a room, but since the room name exceeded 40 characters, an error occurred. They deleted the meeting in both Outlook and SAP, but the error persists when they connect to the Outlook Add-in.-Error: Value is longer than the maximum allowed length of 40.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Web Service Monitoring view-Check the Service Interface: ManageAppointmentActivityIn -The Application Error has occurred: Value is longer than the maximum allowed length 40: "<Meeting Room Description>"-Cause-In the payload, the Location Name maintained is more than 40 characters.-Resolution-User has to maintain the meeting room description less than 40 characters, as per the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Outlook Add-In, Error, ManageAppointmentActivityIn, Web Service Monitoring, 40 characters

Title: Purchase Order Approval Task is not Sent to Substitute
Content: Symptom-The original approver has set his/her substitute under User and Access management view in Application and User management work center but the substitute is not receiving the purchase order approval task in his inbox even though he/she has all the necessary access rights.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view Business Task Management view-Open the respective purchase order task-The responsible person only shows original approver name, not substitute.-Cause-The substitute was not assigned under Task substitution for the actual responsible person.-Resolution-To set any user as substitute to get the task , the user need to do it in this path: Application and User Management -> Task Distribution-> Task Substitutions.-Additionally, if you want to manually assign the task to any user with proper access rights , then you have to follow these steps:-Application and User Management - Business Task Management-> search for the respective task-> then select the task-> select "Assign Item" option-> then enter the user id -> click OK.-Keywords-substitute not getting approval task, task substitution

Title: Is It Possible to Create External Invoice Requests Using OData?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to create External Invoice Requests, and want to know if this can be done via OData.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It is currently not possible to create External Invoice Requests via OData in Business ByDesign. This is because some elements necessary for the creation of External Invoice Requests are not available for OData.-Resolution-It is recommended to use the Webservice API Manage Customer Invoice Requests in order to create External Invoice Requests in Business ByDesign. This API provides you with the possibility to create and change External Invoice Requests, including prices and external payments, and you can furthermore trigger invoicing directly.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign: OData API Examples-Keywords-OData, External Invoice Request, Possible, Unable, Allowed.

Title: Incorrect data displayed in the Earned Profit Overview for KPI Report
Content: Symptom-The Report Earned Profit Overview for KPI (FINPRFU30_Q0003) shows sales order from the previous years though the Accounting Period/Year is entered as 'Year to Date' in the data selection field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Open the Report Earned Profit Overview for KPI (FINPRFU30_Q0003).-Enter the Company ID and select the Account Period/Year as 'Year to Date' and click on Apply.-Change the report view to Operating Profit by Profit Center and Sales or Service Unit.-Select the Row Fields, Profit Center and Sales Document ID in the view section.-Expand the Profit Center ID in the column Profit Center/Sales Document ID/Cost Center/Customer/Project-A Sales Order 123 (123 is the Sales Order ID) from the previous years is displayed. -Cause-The associated Invoice Status was changed from 'In Process' to 'Completed' and the Sales Order's status was changed from 'In Process' to 'Finished' in the current year.-Resolution-To check the changes:-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Select the sales order 123 and navigate to the Changes tab.-You can notice the changes made to the sales order and the invoice status in the current fiscal year.-Therefore, the report includes this sales order from the previous year even though the Accounting Period/Year is entered as 'Year to Date' in the Data Selection field because it has accounting entries in the current fiscal year. -Keywords-Earned Profit Overview for KPI Report, Sales Order, Changes, Incorrect, Invoice, accounting period, fiscal year

Title: Solution cannot be opened in SDK after deployment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Error "The project file or web cannot be found" shown when opening Solution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-In XREP, there are references to the Patch namespace in the below Solution files:-/YABC1234Y_MAIN/SRC/YABC1234Y.myproj-    <Name>YXYZ6789Y</Name>-    <RootNamespace>YXYZ6789Y</RootNamespace>-/YABC1234Y_MAIN/SRC/YABC1234Y_.sln-Project("{XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX}") = "MySolution (In Development)", "YXYZ6789Y.myproj", "{XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX}"-This discrepancy caused the solution to not load in Solution Explorer in the SDK.-Resolution-Forward to AP-RC-BDS-SOL DEV team with the analysis.-They will update the .sln file, correcting the solution name in the XML. -Keywords-not found,project file,cannot be found,PDI, SDK, ,(unavailable), deploy, deployed, activate, activated,sln

Title: Actual Cost Rollup Run Error: Production lot XXX has no items
Content: Symptom-After executed Actual Cost Rollup Run, it ended up with error：-Production lot XXX has no items (XXX represents the production lot ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select Actual Cost Rollup view.-Find the executed Actual Cost Rollup run in error.-Navigate to the Messages tab, see error: Production lot XXX has no items.-Cause-Actual Cost Rollup Run on production lot is cross-period revaluation, and revaluation of cross-period production lots using the explicit confirmation method is not supported.-All cost incurred within the evaluated period are allocated to the material output in this period. Actual costing does not consider an opening balance for production lots.-This can be verified using the Production Lots - Line Items report.-For example, production confirmation document is posted on Period A, and Actual Cost Roll Up Run is posted on Period A+1 (A represents the period number).-Resolution-System behavior.-For more information, refer to help doc: <Actual Costing>.-Keywords-Actual Cost Rollup Run, Production lot, no items

Title: Incorrect Tax Base Amount In The Sales Order.
Content: Symptom-Incorrect Tax base amount is calculated in the sales order. If you enter the List price as 100 EUR and the tax rate is 18%, you can see the tax base amount 84,75 EUR and you expect it to be 100 EUR.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work center-Go to Sales Orders View-Search for Sales Order XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Sales Order)-Edit the Sales Order and Navigate to Items Tab-Select the Line Item 10-You can see the list price is 100 EUR-Go to Taxes Sub tab, you can see the tax rate is 18% and  Tax base Amount as 84,75 EUR -You expect  100 EUR as Tax base amount.-Cause-You are using Gross Pricing in the Sales order XYZ. The List price is inclusive of the tax amount. For example, If you enter the List price as 100 EUR and the tax rate is 18%, then the gross price 100 EUR has the net amount 84,75 EUR plus the tax 15,25 EUR.-Resolution-This is current system behavior. if you do not wish to use the Gross Pricing, you can change to net pricing when you create a new sales order by selecting the Net indicator in the Price In field in General tab of the Sales Order. Price In is a hidden field. You must select these via Personalize on the General tab. -Additionally, you can check if you have  set up default gross pricing. You can check by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select your Implementation Project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tuning Tab and open the Fine Tuning Activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Default Gross Pricing hyperlink.-Here you can see if default the pricing procedure is set up as Gross based on distribution channel.-Keywords-Tax base amount, sales order, price in.

Title: How to revert the SAP standard form template to a previous version
Content: Symptom-How to revert the SAP standard form template to a previous version.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Select an SAP standard form template.-Click Versions button.-The Revert To button is gray.-Cause-The SAP standard form template has been modified.-Resolution-It is impossible to revert the SAP standard form template after modifying. But it is possible to use the pervious SAP standard form template as a new custom form template by followings:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Select the form template needed to be reverted.-Click Version and then select the previous version.-Click download.-Extract the download ZIP file.-Go back to the system and click upload. If choosing As New Variant, system will create a new template under the same group with the selected template. While if choosing To Replace Existing Variant, system will overwrite the selected template and create a new version.-Choose and upload the extracted XDP file.-Publish the uploaded template.-See Also-How to Use Default Template for In Form Template Maintenance - BYD Query | SAP Community-Keywords-Modify, SAP standard form template, Revert

Title: Gross Capacity Value Displayed on Public Holidays in Resource Calendar
Content: Symptom-User notices gross capacity value displayed on Public Holidays in resource Calendar view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Resource Management WorkCenter-Navigate to Resource Search view-Select and Open Employee ID-Navigate to Resource Availability view-User notice Gross Capacity value displayed on Public Holidays.-Cause-Gross Capacity Data updation failed due to backend inconsistency.-Resolution-Kindly update Holiday calendar for affected Employee by following below steps,-Go to Time Administration work center-Navigate to Regular Tasks View-Select Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar-Enter details like Employee ID, start Date, End Date .-Choose the public holiday calendar from the list.-Select save and close.-Keywords-Resource Search, Resource Calendar,Public Holiday,Gross Capacity

Title: Performance Issue While Creating Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a project invoice request and you receive an info message. -- Due to the large amount of non-invoiced time and expense items (currently XXX), the selection of expenses has been restricted to a reduced time frame to improve performance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view-Select the relevant Project-Click on New - Manual Project Invoice Request-Info message appears-Cause-We suggest you assign expenses to the fixed price sales order items. However please find the limitations in the below section. -Resolution-To improve the performance of project invoicing, the following rules apply in case of a large amount of non-invoiced time and expense items:-1. If there are more than 5.000 non-invoiced time and expense items, the expense restriction period will be defined by the system so that only 5.000 items fall within this period. A message informs the user about this restriction.-2. If the user enhances the period so that more than 5.000, but less than 20.000 items, fall within this period, a warning asks the user to define a smaller period.-3. If the user enhances the period so that more than 20.000 items fall within this period, this change is rejected by the system.-4. If a project invoice request is based on an invoice schedule, and if there are more than 20.000 non-invoiced time and expense items, the project invoice request is not created automatically.-Instead, the user is informed via the work list that the project invoice request cannot be created due to too many non-invoiced time and expense items. The user then needs to cancel the relevant invoice schedule item and create the project invoice request manually.-See Also-Refer to Internal Memo-Keywords-Performance Issue While Creating Project Invoice Request; creating customer project invoice request (CPIR) takes a long time

Title: BYD: Inconsistent POS Invoice "Customer for sales transactions with invoice item missing" from CCO
Content: Symptom-A POS transaction invoice in SAP Business byDesign (BYD) is inconsistent with error-"Sales Transaction XXX: Customer for sales transactions with invoice item missing"-The POS transaction got transmitted from SAP Customer Checkout (CCO).-Environment-SAP Customer Checkout-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-First name missing in (dummy) customer record-Resolution-The First Name in the (dummy) Customer record needs to be populated in SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Error: Account assignment PROFIT_CENTRE_ID is not allowed for primary account assign. 7
Content: Symptom-Error when adding the Account Assignment "Profit Center" in the Account Assignment Type "ACC"-Error: Account assignment PROFIT_CENTRE_ID is not allowed for primary account assign. 7-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Overview -Search for the activity "Account Assignment Types" and open it-Click Maintain Account Assignment Types-Select the Account Assignment Type "ACC"-Under Account Assignment tab, click Add Row-Select the Available Account Assignment "Profit Center" and Select "2 - Optional" in the Data Input Control-Click Save-Error: Account assignment PROFIT_CENTRE_ID is not allowed for primary account assign. 7-Cause-The assignment of Profit Center to Account Assignment Type 'ACC - General Ledger Account only' is currently not possible.-Resolution-System Behavior-See Also-Configuration: Account Assignment Types--KBA 2065095 - How to Create a Primary Account Assignment For Account Assignment Types-Keywords-PROFIT_CENTRE_ID, profit center, account, assignment, type

Title: Approval is WronglyTriggered for Condition: "Total Net Value Change Percentage"
Content: Symptom-In Approval Process for Purchase Order, the condition "Total Net Value Change Percentage" is defined. It should be triggered for reapproval, but in actual purchase order creation scenario, it is triggered when the purchase order is created for the first time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view.-Define approval process for purchase orders like:-Step 1: Total Net Value Greater than 1.500,00 EUR-     AND Total Net Value Change Percentage Greater than or equal to 10.-Create a purchase order whose total net value is greater than 1.500,00 EUR.-Navigate to Approval tab, approval is triggered for step1.-Cause-As per current logic, Total Net Value Change Percentage is being updated to a default value of 999 when a new PO is created, which is why every time approval is being triggered on PO creation if condition is defined with "Greater than" operator.-Resolution-The workaround here will be to define 2 conditions together.-If "Greater Than" operator to be used-Total Net Value Change Percentage > X  (X can be any value here)-AND-Total Net Value Change Percentage Not equal to 999-If "Less Than" operator to be used-Total Net Value Change Percentage < X  (X can be any value here)-AND-Total Net Value Change Percentage Not equal to 0 -See Also-KBA 3395467 - System Trigger Incorrect Approver When you set the Condition Total Net Value Change Percentage-Keywords-Approval; Purchase Order; Reapproval; Total Net Value Change Percentage

Title: The Error Message "Something Went Wrong" Appears Whenever Tries to Cancel The Sales Order.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal Use Only ***-When attempts to cancel the sales order have been ongoing for months, but the process consistently fails with the error message "something went wrong."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center-Go to Sales Orders view-Show: All Orders-Search for Sales Order ID 9999 (9999 Indicates the sales order ID)-Edit Sales Order-Go to Items tab-Under Details section, set a Reason for Rejection.- The system loads for a couple of minutes then dumps as mentioned in the symptom.-Cause-This is due to the multiple output history created in the backend, -Resolution-To clear the inconsistency, Kindly create an Incident to AP-RC-OUT. -Keywords-something went wrong, Sales order, Output History

Title: Freight Forwarder Doesn't Appear in Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-In an outbound delivery, under tab General, it is blank in the field "Freight Forwarder".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Access view Outbound Deliveries.-Open outbound delivery XYZ.-Select tab General, scroll down to the Freight Forwarder field, it is blank.-Cause-There are several ways to maintain Freight Forwarder in outbound delivery.-If determines of Freight Forwarder in Business Configuration Activity "Involved Parties for Sales Orders" and Freight Forwarder relationship in related account master data are both maintained, then party Freight Forwarder will be automatically maintained when a sales order is created. This Freight Forwarder will be brought to following logistics documents, like outbound delivery. Please refer to KBA 1864760 - Freight Forwarder Party has not Been Picked Automatically in the Sales Order: https://me.sap.com/notes/1864760 -If Freight Forwarder is not maintained automatically in sales order, it can be maintained manually under tab Involved Parties in sales order.-In delivery proposal, unreleased outbound delivery, and during post goods issue, field Freight Forwarder can be maintain manually.-Resolution-Please either make settings so that Freight Forwarder can be maintained automatically in sales order (point 1 in Cause), or maintain it manually in sales order/delivery proposal/unreleased outbound delivery, or during post goods issue (point 2 and 3 in Cause).-See Also-KBA 1864760 - Freight Forwarder Party has not Been Picked Automatically in the Sales Order: https://me.sap.com/notes/1864760 -Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Freight Forwarder

Title: Sales Order associated with Supplier Invoice is not reflecting in Standard Invoicing Report
Content: Symptom-Supplier invoice is created for third party process but the reference sales order is not showing in standard supplier invoice report like "Monitoring Invoices". But sales order reference is showing for some supplier invoices.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select view Design Reports-Open the standard report "Monitoring Invoices"-Open the respective supplier invoice associated with the third party sales order-The column for sales order appear as # in the report -Cause-The supplier invoice is assigned to reference purchase order item.-Sales order ID is displayed as # for some supplier invoices because it is referring purchase order in the cost distribution and not delivery document , this is the reason system has not fetched the sales order data because supplier invoice is not created with reference to inbound delivery which has the sales order reference.-You can see in this path: open the supplier invoice->navigate to Items tab --> Cost Distribution ---> Reference Item is purchase order-If supplier invoice is created with respect to inbound delivery , then it will fetch the sales order data as expected.-Resolution-Go to supplier invoicing work center, select invoice entry and filter for "all deliveries to be invoiced" option and click on New invoice and go to items tab in cost distribution, check if the reference is showing inbound delivery, then it will fetch the sales order details in report.-Keywords-sales order related to supplier invoice is not showing in report, monitoring invoices report, third party supplier invoice, cost distribution, delivery reference missing in supplier invoice

Title: Error during currency conversion from ABC to DEF when trying to create a payment through the ManageCashPaymentOrderIn web service
Content: Symptom-When creating a payment through the ManageCashPaymentOrderIn web service and referencing it to an invoice, an error message is received:--               <TypeID>006(/FOP_DUE_CLR_BL/)</TypeID>-               <Note>Error during currency conversion from ABC to DEF</Note>--ABC means the source currency-DEF means the target currency-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the ManageCashPaymentOrderIn web service-As response, it shows the error:-<TypeID>006(/FOP_DUE_CLR_BL/)</TypeID>-<CategoryCode>INC.BOI</CategoryCode>-<SeverityCode>3</SeverityCode>-<Note>Error during currency conversion from ABC to DEF</Note> -Cause-A possible cause of the error is an incorrect configuration in the Clearing strategies activity-Resolution-Make sure that the correct currency is maintained in the Clearing Strategies activity-Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Overview view-Search for the "Clearing Strategies" activity-Click Change Immediately-Click Maintain clearing strategies-Select your Clearing strategy key-Make sure that the correct currency is maintained under the Payment Tolerance Types- See Also-Configuration: Clearing Strategies-Keywords-ManageCashPaymentOrderIn, webservice, clearing, payment, cash payment

Title: Health Check Process
Content: Symptom-This article outlines what is a health check case and the necessary actions that is required to process health check cases.-What is Health check: -C4C Sales and Service cloud is a SaaS solution & as per current design of C4C, one of the prominent factors for critical issue is Infrastructure auto scalability.-SAP Cloud Operation team has various monitoring tools which monitors health of all Customer systems and flag the different parameters which can impact their health. -If the threshold is breached there would be a huge impact on the infrastructure which affects the respective customer tenant causing the issue and also other Customers on same system.-An alert is raised where immediate action is required from Customer/Partner to mitigate the issue.-As part of this process SAP Product Support team will create an incident and reach out to the Customer's point of contact(Admin/IT contact) via e-mail with issue details and actions/steps to resolve the issue.-Sample email subject:" SAP Alert : ****Issue description*** - INC*******(Incident id)"-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign--Resolution-Expectations from Customer: -Customer has to acknowledge the mail once communicated from SAP Product Support expert.-Take immediate action with the steps provided by support to resolve the issue. Incase if it is related to PDI/Custom development, then Customer has to reach out to their partner developer.-Confirm the Product Support expert once actions are completed.-Follow the process and close the Health Check Case when the issue is solved.-Note: -These health checks would be very critical which affects your system and all other customers who are on the same system(In-case of multi-tenant only).-Such issues might lead to Server overload, Database crash, complete system down scenarios and major degradation issues. -Hence its recommended to performed the required above steps to resolve such alerts.-See Also-We recommend you to maintain right IT contacts which would be helpful for us to communicate in a feasible manner.-KBA 2502589 - Modify IT Contact Information in C4C-Kindly refer below KBAs/Blogs for self help to improve/optimize system for better performance,-Customers using Custom development should refer below:-Performance ABSL Trace - New functionality in 2005 Release. -KBA 3107452 - SAP Cloud Applications Studio: Performance Check-Admins working with reports:-KBA 2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling and Handling Data Sources and Reports - Performance -Admins/partner refer below blogs for Overall system performance:-C4C Performance 101 | SAP Blogs-KBA 2657095 - Actions to Take Prior to Sending an Initial Load of Data to C4C from SAP ERP Systems-Keywords-SAP Alert, Health check, degradation, health check case.

Title: Error in Document Output"Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: HTTP error: ("HTTP Code 500: Internal Server Error)"

Introducing changes in this situation may lead to errors -Resolution-If changes are necessary to the communication scenario when a communication arrangement exists, it is recommended to delete and recreate the communication arrangement.-Keywords-HTTP Code 500, communication arrangement , business communication monitoring , document output, Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: HTTP error, SRT: HTTP error, SOAP Runtime functions

Title: Pick Task Created Although Stock Is Not Available
Content: Symptom-You observed that Pick Task is being created against the Released Demand for a particular Material. However, the Inventory for this Product is currently zero. You want to understand why the system is allowing the creation of the Warehouse Tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Go to the Customer Demand view. -Find the relevant Sales Order ID.-Filter for the relevant Product ID.-You can see the Order Items are Released, but Delivery Status is Not started.-Click Edit.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Show Extended View.-You can see the Pick Tasks have been created against the Order Line Item although there is no Stock for this Item.-Cause-If you check the relevant Material Master, you can observe that the Availability check Scope has been maintained as: "All released supply except PO".-If you then open the Product Planning Details screen of the affected Material, you can see there is a Purchase Order Acknowledged with certain Quantity. -As a result, although the ATP shows late Delivery for the Material, you are able to release the Demand on the basis of the Availability check scope maintained in Material Master.-Since the Demand has been Released, your Employee was able to create the Warehouse Requests. And this led to the Pick Tasks being automatically created in line with the setting in the relevant Logistics Model (Automatic Generation of Tasks).- Resolution-From the foregoing, we can see that the system is behaving appropriately in this regard. If you do not wish to have the Pick Tasks generated against an expected future Receipt, then you have to maintain your Availability Check Scope accordingly.-You may also consider removing the check of the box "Automatic Generation of Tasks" in the Logistics Model. -Keywords-All released supply except PO, Availability Check Scope, ATP, Warehouse Task, Pick Task

Title: Upgrade SAML Certificate Button Not Visible in Configure Single Sign-On View
Content: Symptom-Upgrade SAML Certificate button is not visible in the Configure Single Sign-On view-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-C4C:-Go to Administrator Work center-Go to Common Tasks view-Navigate to Configure Single Sign-On-The Upgrade SAML Certificates button is not visible-ByD:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Common Tasks view-Navigate to Configure Single Sign-On-The Upgrade SAML Certificates button is not visible-Cause-The signing algorithm is already upgraded to SHA256 -Resolution-Tenants which already have SAML certificates with SHA256 RSA signing algorithm and 2048 bits key, the new button will not be available on the Configure Single-Sign On UI.- Keywords- SAML certificates, SHA256,  RSA signing algorithm,2048 bits key , configure SSO

Title: Available Stock in Product Planning Screen Differs With On-hand Stock in Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-For a customer demand line item, open product planning screen, available stock is zero. However, there is positive on-hand stock in Stock Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistics Control.-Access view Customer Demand.-Search the customer demand ID, select an line item, click Open Product Planning Details.-In the screen "Product Planning Details: Product_ID/Product_Specification_ID_1/Site_ID", available stock is zero.-Open common task Stock Overview, search product Product_ID, there is positive on-hand stock for product Product_ID in site Site_ID.-Cause-In Stock Overview, the on-hand stock has another product specification ID Product_Specification_ID_2, hence it won't be displayed in the screen "Product Planning Details: Product_ID/Product_Specification_ID_1/Site_ID", and it cannot be used to fulfilled the requested quantity of this customer demand.-Resolution-System works as designed.-See Also-KBA: 3466808 - You Cannot Release Customer Demand, Because Available Stock is Zero, But Stock Overview is Showing There is Stock -https://me.sap.com/notes/3466808-Keywords-On-hand Stock, Available Stock, Product Planning, Stock Overview, Product Specification, Customer Demand

Title: How to Clear Purchase Order Notification Task from Inbox
Content: Symptom-The user has already approved the purchase order but still a new notification task with subject "Approved Purchase Order Changed" is created by system and sent to the user's inbox.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select view Inbox-A new notification task about an already approved purchase order is showing here.-Cause-A standard notification task is raised by the system if a purchase order is changed after getting approved once.-Resolution-To complete the notification and remove it from the worklist, you can acknowledge it as follows:-Go to the Home work center ->Work view ->Inbox sub-view.-Select the notification.-Click Actions and acknowledge the notification.-OR- The system automatically cancels the notification after 30 days. The user can acknowledge it or wait for 30 days and system should cancel it automatically.-See Also-Reference help document:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2dcb52ad722d1014b8c4eccb5ceba233.html?version=2305-Keywords-notification task, approved purchase order changed, how to clear notification from inbox, purchase order notification

Title: Servcie Order Item with Type as DIGI is Not Delivery Finished Status After Service Confirmation Released for it
Content: Symptom-In the service order ABC, the line 10 is with item type as 'Spare part - direct goods issue' (DIGI). You have created and released the service confirmation for this line 10, but the delivery status is still Not Started.-ABC represents the ID of the service order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Open the order ABC, in Services and Spare Parts tab, select line 10 and you can see the delivery status is Not Started.-Go to the Document Flow tab, open the service confirmation DEF. (DEF represents the ID of the service confirmation), it is Finished status.-In Services and Spare Parts tab, the line is referenced to to the service order ABC line 10 correctly.-You want to know why the delivery status in the service order is not updated.-Cause-For item with type 'Spare part - direct goods issue', the delivery status is updated when the line is completely finished. Since the service confirmation was released without completion, the delivery status is not get updated.-Resolution-You can complete the line by release the confirmation with completion.-Open the service confirmation DEF.-Click Release - With Order Completion.-The delivery status in service order ABC line 10 is then updated to Finished.-Keywords-service order; Spare part - direct goods issue; delivery status; release with order completion.

Title: Add Row Button is Still Available for the Finished Count Task
Content: Symptom-Add Row button is still available for the finished count Task. As the consequence, the PI Document is still "In-Process" Status and the user cannot do any actions to resolve it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory Work Center.-Navigate to By PI Count Document View.-Search for the count document, you notice that it's in process status.-Choose Edit.-Go to Count Item Tab, you notice that a line item without ID exists for a specific Logistics Area is in Not Started Status.-Go to Count Tasks Tab, open the count task which is Finished, you notice that the line item exists in the task and the fields of this line can be edited even if the task is Finished.-Choose Remove.-Choose Close.-Choose Yes, then system would crash.-Cause-While this is not a bug or issue on the application side, our development team believes this can be explored as a useful suggestion to disable the add row button after the finish all items. This will require in depth analysis to determine the impact to any possible existing business processes and thorough regression testing. Hence this will have to be done as part of a planned development.-Resolution-The only way to resolve this issue is to delete the added line item in the task from backend.-Please report a case and authorize SAP can delete it from backend.-Keywords-Attempt made in retrieve state to write data or to use transactional methods, Add Row, Count Task, Finished, Crash, Dump, 500 Internal Error.

Title: Scalable Add-On's / Hybrid Add-On's (SAP Business ByDesign)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -How to troubleshoot and analyse issues reported for Scalable Add-On's  / Hybrid Add-On's.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Known Issues-During the refresh, copy or creation of a new test tenant, the scalable add-on is either,-Deactivated - All artifacts (local and standard) are available, but the add-on is switched off.-Partially Active-The standard artifacts are available and active, however local artifacts are not activated resulting in dumps.-The standard artifacts are available and active, however local artifacts are not available resulting in dumps.-Incorrectly Activated-Activation of a historical scalable add-on (incomplete cleanup) resulting in dumps for another customer-Cleanup of a scalable add-on was incomplete after tenant decommissioning, resulting in dumps for another customer or partner-  Cause-History-At the onset of SAP Business ByDesign, extensibility and cloud application studio (PDI) were in their early stages of development. Hence not all capabilities required by partners and customers were available. Therefore, extensions required for business processes were technically achieved by a combination of backend extensibility, cloud application studio and custom code in ABAP. These types of add-ons were known as Scalable or Hybrid Add-Ons and were packaged and deployed using cloud application studio.-During the deployment of the add-on the package structure would constitute a combination of locally generated content (parts managed via cloud application studio) and standard packages (delivered by service center as custom code in ABAP). The lifecycle of these were managed by cloud application studio and service center development landscape respectively.-However, with the move of ByDesign to HanaDB, the lifecycle management support for scalable add-ons was withdrawn by C4C as this was deemed incompatible. Subsequently, service center was reorganized and it was decided by SAP to support these addons via the standard development paradigm. As such all relevant metadata of these add-ons was ported over to the standard development landscape. These add-ons have a specific naming convention, starting with *SFL000*. Hence all Packages, XREP content, DDIC and MDRS entities which follow the previously outlined naming convention belong to the scalable add-on.-Assumptions-While porting over the meta-data and packages to the development landscape a few assumptions were made which would ensure the technical consistency.-All the technical artifacts which were generated locally and present in the respective customer test and production tenant would not be overwritten by the standard delivery.-All the technical artifacts which were generated locally and present in the respective customer test and production tenant would be copied over as part of the standard tenant / system copy and refresh processes.-The switch framework which supports the activation and deactivation of a PDI add-on would continue to function as desired.-Deployment and activation of scalable addon (either via cloud application studio or manually) would not be possible.-No enhancements would be performed or supported for any of these add-ons.-The productive tenants of these customers should never be changed.-Assumptions-While porting over the meta-data and packages to the development landscape a few assumptions were made which would ensure the technical consistency.-All the technical artifacts which were generated locally and present in the respective customer test and production tenant would not be overwritten by the standard delivery.-All the technical artifacts which were generated locally and present in the respective customer test and production tenant would be copied over as part of the standard tenant / system copy and refresh processes.-The switch framework which supports the activation and deactivation of a PDI add-on would continue to function as desired.-Deployment and activation of scalable addon (either via cloud application studio or manually) would not be possible.-No enhancements would be performed or supported for any of these add-ons.-The productive tenants of these customers should never be changed.-Current Facts-Over the last 10 years, 3 out of the 6 aforementioned assumptions (1-3) have been nullified and we have had to come up with ways to continue supporting the customers. This support comprises of manual intervention via backend reports, existing classes and local artifact generation.-You can find a list of the 21 customers which have scalable addons deployed in their production environment in the WIKI under section Current Facts.-Resolution-Current Demand for Support-Of the 21 customers-10 customers do not have the addon available in their test system for the past 4+ years. And they have also not reported any issue. Hence it is an informed assumption that they do not make use of this addon anymore. -We have not gone back to these customers to validate as most of the time they do not even have the background of what these are about and what they do.-Of the remaining 11 customers-6 customers have not reported any issue for the past 4+ years. Looking at the known issues with lifecycle of these add-ons, it is a safe assumption that they do not make use of this addon anymore.-We have not gone back to these customers to validate as most of the time they do not even have the background of what these are about and what they do.-5 customers regularly report issues and request active support for these scalable add-ons.-Eternis Fine Chemicals UK  Limited-TCB Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH-WLP Holding CORP-Numerical Algorithms Group Limited-Hilti Aktiengesellschaft Hauptverwaltung-  Please find the steps for diagnosis that should be done on Support side in the WIKI under section Steps for Diagnosis.-Here it is outlined what steps should be taken for the 3 different sceanrios mentioned in the Known Issues section.-For scenario 1 and 2 and 3a) the provided steps should lead to a soluton.-For scenario 3b):-If all the switches are inactive, but still the obsolete addon is causing issues, then the corresponding technical artifacts have to be manually deleted. A typical example is dangling addon element which was extending a standard SAP delivered MDRS data type.-Before undertaking such a deletion, a complete check must be performed to ensure that the customer whose addon is causing the issue is not part of the System in question. This should not be done by Support. You need to create an incident for your case under the component SRD-CCS and the case should stay on your name under the respective application component.-Note: Do not change the component of the service now case to SRD-CCS !-    See Also-Please find the following wiki for trouble shooting and analysis of issues with Scalable Add-On's:-Scalable Addons (SAP Business ByDesign) - ByD Development-Please see following KBA with details where these Add-On's were delivered:-KBA 1798477 - AddOns Delivered by Service Center for FP3.5 And Later Releases-Keywords-Hybrid; Scalable; Service Center; Add-On; Solution; /SFL0001 ; /SFL0002; /SFL0003; SFL0000Z; SFL0000Y; *SFL000*; SRD-CCS; /SFL000XX/SFL000XX_MAIN; HYBRID_ADDON_GEN_ARTIFACTS; SC_HILTI_*; $SFL000XX_;

Title: Crash when attempting to pay a VAT Return
Content: Symptom-When attempting to pay a Vat Return, you experience a dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select VAT Returns.-Filter for All Vat Returns.-Search for ID XXX(XXX represents the ID of the Vat Return).-Click on Pay.-     Result: The system crashes.-Cause-In the corresponding Tax Authority, the QR IBAN field is empty.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select Tax Authorities.-Search for Tax Authority YYY(YYY represents the Tax Authority ID).-Open it and click on View All.-Navigate to Financial Data tab.-Select Bank Data sub tab.-Maintain the missing data for QR IBAN.-p.s. Please wait or try again later; this may take up to a few minutes.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator workcenter -Go to Business Task Management view-Select Query to All Items-Observe the below error is displayed: -A table or list is being reloaded. Title: Employee Time Profile Report Entry Appear Twice for an Employee
Content: Symptom-User notice multiple entries for Employees on Particular days In Employee Time Profile Report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time administration Work Center-Navigate to reports View-Choose Report Type "Employee Time Profile"-Select "Click here to start the report"-Employee Time Profile Report Entry Appear Twice for an Employee on Particular days.-Cause-This is the standard system design when Work Schedule is not maintained in correct form.-Resolution-Go to Time Administrator Work Center.-Navigate to Employees View-Choose affected Employee ID-Select Edit-Navigate to Time Profile View-Choose Valid Time Profile-Go to Work Schedule Tab-Navigate under Individual Work Schedule and check work scheduled maintained for Employee-Potential Scenario:-If Employee has maintained work schedule as Daily model for two weeks which consists of 14 days then in the report entries are shown twice for an employee on particular date.-There is no other way to restrict the multiple records shown in report, if user is maintaining Daily model for more than a week.-Keywords-Daily Model, work schedule, entries shown twice

Title: Badge Count Not Correct in SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App
Content: Symptom-Badge count is not correct in SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Log into mobile device (Android/IOS)-Badge count for SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App is there on the display screen of device-Go to SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App ,no new tasks found in App-Cause-The issue is due to Cache and Background App Refresh is not enabled.-Resolution-You need to clear the mobile app cache and enable the app background refresh option.-IOS: iPhones don’t have a straightforward option to clear the app cache, the only way forward is to delete the app and reinstall it when needed.-     How to enable background app refresh for SAP Business ByDesign App?-Go to Settings-Go to General-Search for Background App refresh-Turn it on -Enable it for SAP Business ByDesign App-Android: How to clear cache?-Go to Settings-Search for Apps-Select the App-Go to Storage-Choose Clear cache-    How to enable background app refresh for SAP Business ByDesign App?-Open Settings, then tap Connections-Select Data usage-Scroll down to the Mobile section and tap Mobile data usage-Select the SAP Business ByDesign App from below the usage graph-Turn on Allow background data usage-See Also-3251587 - Frequently Asked Questions on ByD Mobile APPs-KB0654417 - How To Enable Push Notifications for SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App -Help Document: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/c2b8fa5cd62c43949816853d4c303572.html?version=2108-Keywords-Badge count, background app refresh, App, notification, notifications, IOS, Android, bydesign, mobile, time, push, release, you have released,

Title: Event Notification Monitoring Failed Due To Error "500 Native SSL error"
Content: Symptom-User find Event Notification Monitoring failed due to 500 Native SSL error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter.-Navigate to Event Notification Monitoring View.-Choose "Failed" Event Notification Monitoring from dropdown.-Select Failed Task.-Navigate to HTTP Status Reason of Failed Task.-Task is failed due to 500 Native SSL error-Cause-User has to maintain Authentication Method as SSL Client Certificate.-Resolution-Follow below steps to maintain Authentication Method as SSL Client Certificate,-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter.-Navigate to Event Notification Monitoring View.-Choose "Failed" Event Notification Monitoring from dropdown.-Select and Open Failed Task.-Choose Authentication Method "SSL Client Certificate" from dropdown-Select Edit credentials-Choose "SAP Business ByDesign System Key Pair" from Dropdown-Keywords-500 SSL error, Event Notification Monitoring ,Notification Monitoring Failed

Title: Solution Activation is Failing due to Failed to Activate Items
Content: Symptom-Errors while activating Uploaded PDI solution.-Failed to activate items of type ReferencestoCustomer-SpecificFields-Type of field XXX does not match (expected: ABC, found: PQR)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cloud Application Studio-Open affected solution Y123AXXX - (Y123AXXX stands for PDI solution)-Click on activate-Error appears-      Failed to activate items of type ReferencestoCustomer-SpecificFields-     Type of field XXX does not match (expected: ABC, found: PQR)- Cause-The source system has the data type of (ABC) where as the target system has the data type of (PQR).Hence, being the reason why the conflict of data type this error is coming.The source system has the data type of (ABC) where as the target system has the data type of (PQR).Hence, being the reason why the conflict of data type this error is coming.-Resolution-Ideally, partner should not change the field's data type. To fix this issue both source and target of the affected fields should be with same DATATYPE.- OPTION 1-1. Create a new patch in the source system .-2. Uncheck this field from the .ref file in the source system.-3. Perform check consistency and then   -4. Perform a complete assembly of this new patch in the source system.-5. Deploy the new patch in the target system.-6. Delete and re-create the KUT field in the target system with (ABC)-7. Create another patch in the source system.-8. Check this field in the .ref file in the source system.-9. Ensure the field is with no exist.-10.Perform a complete assembly of this final patch in the source system.-11.And finally deploy the new patch in the target system.-OPTION 2. -Revert the data type in the source system to (PQR) by deleting and re-creating the field.-If they want to go with this approach, they will have to :-1. create a new patch in the source system .-2. uncheck this field from the .ref file in the source system.-3. Delete and re-create the KUT field in the source system with (PQR)-4. Perform a complete assembly of this new patch in the source system.-5. Deploy the new patch in the target system.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_CLOUD_APPLICATIONS_STUDIO/cbcebe3cfb1647a8b0322c18dbb0b481/759b4cbf73e21014a35ef9d0e04a7f3e.html-Keywords-Activation failed;KUT;DATATYPE, ReferencestoCustomer-SpecificFields.

Title: When Releasing an Inbound Delivery the Following Error Message appears "The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident."
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to Release an Inbound Delivery, the following error message appears "The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Cener.-Go to Inbound Deliveries View.-Search for and Select Inbound Delivery ABC. (ABC = Inbound Delivery ID).-Click Release.-Error appears.-"The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident."- Cause-The issue occurs because you have not completed the Inbound Delivery Process. This means that-You have not created a warehouse task from the existing warehouse order. -If the Task is already created, it is In Process or Not Started Status -You need to confirm the task to have the Inbound Delivery document released. -Resolution-First, note the Inbound Warehouse Request ID XYZ. (XYZ = The Warehouse Request ID associated with Inbound Delivery ID ABC).-To proceed, you need to create a Warehouse Task for the Inbound Warehouse Request ID XYZ and confirm it to complete the receiving process for the delivery.-Ensure that you have completed the Put Away Confirmation process. This step is crucial for releasing the Inbound Delivery.-In summary, the system is functioning correctly. The key is to ensure that you have fully completed the Put Away Confirmation process to enable the release of the Inbound Delivery.-Keywords-Release, Inbound Delivery, Error, Warehouse Request, action RELEASE, not possible

Title: Time Zone of Shipment Date and Delivery Date in Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-The time zones for the shipment date and delivery date in the outbound delivery are different. You would like to understand how the system takes into account the time zone for these two fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for outbound delivery XXX.-Edit it and you find that the time zones between shipment date and delivery date are different.-Resolution-The Shipment Date is determined based on the time zone of the Site Calendar.-However, the Delivery Date is based on the time zone of the Ship-to-location, not the user's account time zone.-Additionally, the Delivery Date is stored in UTC in the backend, which is why reports display dates in UTC format instead of the user's preferred time format.-See Also-2585738 - Outbound Deliveries Displayed Under the Previous day's Delivery Date-2768328 - The Calculation of Shipment and Execution Start Dates-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Time Zone, Shipment Date, Delivery Date, Report

Content: Symptom-Error "RFC Message: No more memory available to extend an internal table." when trying to start a MDRO job-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Create a new run for the Custom MDRO-Schedule the MDR-Go to Results tab-Error "RFC Message: No more memory available to extend an internal table."-Cause-Large number of MDRO runs are being created and scheduled to run only once. -Resolution-To clear memory for creating new runs, delete any unwanted execution instances and obsolete previous MDRO runs.-Keywords-RFC Message, Custom MDR, memory issue, results tab, custom work center, MDRO

Title: Error Message: 'No Expense Arrangement Found for Employee 123' When Creating Expense Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***  -You are receiving an error while creating expense report after creating an Expense Arrangement.-You have already followed this KBA  3270680 - Error Message: 'No Expense Arrangement Found for Employee 123' When Creating Expense Report  to create expense arrangement and still receiving the below error:-Expense arrangement not found-No expense arrangement found for employee ID 123 (Here 123 refers Employee ID)-Country: Colombia-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Click on New -> Expense Report on Behalf.-Choose an Employee:123 and you can see the error message:-Expense arrangement not found (KBA: 3270680) -Message Strip Error-No expense arrangement found for employee ID 123-  Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Arrangements view.-Search for Employee 123.-You cannot find any active Expense Arrangement for the Employee.-Cause-The cause for the missing creation of expense arrangements is due to master data replication has been enabled in the system.-This means that creation of expense arrangements works only in Master Data Replication (MDR) context, but neither outside this context nor manually created in frontend.  -In general, in case of creation of a new Generic Country / Region Version the related expense arrangements are created after Deployment Exit that calls the MDCI (Master Data Change Interface).  Since in this after deployment exit the Master Data Replication (MDR) context is not given, the MDCI rejects the creation of expense arrangements if master data replication has been activated in this system.-Resolution-Development team have to temporarily set a backend switch to enable creation of expense arrangements outside master data replication context since master data replication has been enabled in the system. You need to forward the Incident to SRD-FIN-ERM component.--See Also-  3270680 - Error Message: 'No Expense Arrangement Found for Employee 123' When Creating Expense Report -Keywords-Expense arrangement not found, ERM, Expense reporting, Expense Arrangement, No Country/Region Version For Exists In ERM

Title: Error Message: 'Referenced Purchase Order not found'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are unable to post the Supplier invoice as there is an error message 'Referenced Purchase Order not found'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center General Ledger.-Select the Source Documents subview of Closing Cockpit  view.-Now select the Supplier Invoice XYZ(XYZ refers to the Supplier invoice ID).-There is an error message:-Referenced Purchase Order PQR (PQR refers to the Purchase order ID) not found.-Or,-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select the to be invoiced purchase order and create new invoice.-In the new invoice, maintain mandatory data and press Check.-There are 2 error messages:-Referenced Purchase Order PQR (PQR refers to the Purchase order ID) not found.-Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting.-Cause-The purchase order PQR is stuck in the backend of the system and the XI message has to be restarted.--Resolution-Go to backend.-Open the BO SE38.-Enter program FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI.-Choose the Operational Document Type as 001- Purchase order and the Operational Document ID with the Purchase order ID and execute.-Choose the restart option and then the XI message will be delivered.-You can now post the supplier invoice document in the UI and it will be posted successfully.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Purchase Order, Referenced, Source Document, General Ledger, not found,
