Title: The system defaults the Tax Code for Mileage Expense Reports
Content: Symptom-When you create an Expense Report 123, system defaults the tax code to "Out of Scope Purchases" and you want to change it.-(Here 123 refers Expense Report ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Search for Expense report 123 and click on edit.-Navigate to the Expenses tab and the system has defaulted the tax code to "Out of Scope Purchases".-Cause-The non-fuel element of the mileage allowance would be treated as outside the scope of VAT.-Resolution-The defaulted Tax Code "Out of Scope Purchases" is correct and there is no need to change it.-For a clear clarification, here is the explanation with a scenario as to why the tax code is 'Out of Scope'.-Using the following example, How to Calculate VAT Reclaim on Mileage:-An employee with a petrol car:-The car is over 1400c but under 2000c. The car has less than 10,000 miles.-Of the 45p per mile mileage allowance, 15p is for fuel.-The VAT rate is currently 20%. Therefore, we need to calculate 20% of 15p.-15p is 120% (100% plus 20% of VAT).-The VAT element is 15/120*20 = 2.5p-So for every business mile, you can reclaim 2.5p back on VAT.-So, the non-fuel element of the mileage allowance (that is, the 30p of the 45p quoted in this example) would be treated as ‘Outside the Scope of VAT’.-Keywords-Default Tax Code, Mileage Expense Report, Out of Scope Purchases

Title: The Address of the Contact is Not Updated in the Preview of a Sales Order Document
Content: Symptom-The changes in the address of a Contact in the Account Master Data are not being carried out to the Preview of a Sales Order document in the system.     -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the General tab.-Select Preview button.-The Contact XYZ address is displayed as XYZ/YYYYY/123456 in the Sales Order Confirmation Template. (Where XYZ represents the Contact Name).-However, this is currently not the address maintained for the Contact XYZ in the Account Master Data.-Cause-Changes in the address of the Contact XYZ are not dynamically updated to the Preview of the Sales Order document. In this case a dummy change will be required to be performed in order to properly change the address of the Contact in the Sales Order preview according to the Account Master Data.-Resolution-In order to perform the dummy change to update the address of the Contact XYZ in the Sales Order ABC, the following steps should be performed:-Go to the Account Management Work Center.-Go to the Accounts View.-Search for the Account EDF (Where EDF represents the Account ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Contacts tab-Mark the Contact ID XYZ (Where XYZ represents the Contact Name).-In the field Address, Select the Value Box.-Choose the desired address.-Select Save button.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the General tab.-In the Contact field, remove the Contact XYZ.-Select Save button.-In the Contact field, Enter the Contact XYZ again.-Select Save button.-Close the Sales Order ABC.-Open the Sales Order ABC again.-Select Preview button.-The updated Contact Address in the Master Data will be displayed for Sales Order preview.-Note: This solution is only applicable for the standard Sales Order Confirmation Template.-Keywords-address, contact, sales order, preview, sales order confirmation template, master data

Title: Task in Personal Administration cannot be completed
Content: Symptom-Tasks in Personal Administration work center cannot be completed although all the necessary information is inputted and the confirmation is completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personal Administration work center.-Go to Regular Work View.-Open task ABC whose status is New or In Process.-Input the necessary information.-Click Finish.-Cause-The issued task related to an employee who is already terminated in the tenant.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior. The task related to a terminated employee cannot be completed from frontend. Open a case to SAP with the permission to complete or cancel the issued task from backend.-Keywords-Task, Personal Administration, Cannot Complete

Title: Return To Supplier Not Picking Correct Quantity
Content: Symptom-When creating a New Supplier Return for a batch-managed material received against multiple identified stock IDs, the system determines an incorrect return quantity.-Additionally the system does not allow the return quantity to be manually adjusted to the required quantity and displays the following error message:-Error: "The Quantity to be returned must not be greater than XX. This is the quantity of the confirmed inbound delivery that has not yet been returned" (where XX represent the Quantity in the Line Item)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Choose New and select Purchase Order.-Enter all the required details in the Purchase order.-Choose Order.--Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Search for the Purchase Order ABC.-Choose Post Goods Receipt.-Choose Add Sub Item to add 4 rows.-Enter different Identified stock IDs and quantity against each sub item.-Choose Save and Close.--Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Open New Return To Supplier under Common Tasks.-Enter the Purchase Order ID ABC.-Select the rows for all the Identified Stock IDs that was received from the Inbound Delivery DEF.-Choose Next.-The quantity fetched by the system is wrong.-Manually change the quantities and error occurs.-Error: The Quantity to be returned must not be greater than XX. This is the quantity of the confirmed inbound delivery that has not yet been returned.-(Where ABC represents the Purchase Order ID, DEF represent the Inbound Delivery ID, XX represent the Quantity in the Line Item)-Cause-Currently, the system considers only the Item ID and does not consider the corresponding Identified Stock IDs when creating a Return to Supplier.-Due to this, the system determines an incorrect return quantity when a single item is received as multiple sub-items with different Identified Stock IDs.-Resolution-An internal ticket has been created to address the reported issue. The fix is planned for delivery in a future release, following comprehensive testing across various scenarios to ensure the fix meets the required quality and stability standards.-As a workaround, create an Inbound Delivery Notification and split the item into multiple line items, assigning a different Identified Stock ID to each line item by following the below steps-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ABC (where ABC represents the Purchase Order ID).-Choose New Supplier Delivery Notification.-Enter the Delivery Notification ID in General Tab.-In the Line Items tab choose Add Row and spilt the product into multiple items with different Identified Stock.-Choose Save.-Based on this Inbound Delivery Notification, the system correctly considers the line-item quantity when creating a Return to Supplier, regardless of whether the goods are posted directly or through a warehouse task.-Keywords-Return To Supplier; Quantity; Sub-Items; Identified Stock; Inbound Delivery Notification; The Quantity To Be Returned Must Not Be Greater Than; This Is The Quantity Of The Confirmed Inbound Delivery That Has Not Yet Been Returned; SAP Business ByDesign

Title: Searching Product ID within Production Orders View does not return matches with Input Products.
Content: Symptom-You use the search function within the Production Orders View using a Product ID and notice that it only returns results where the Output Product ID matches the Query and does not include Production Orders where the Query Product ID was used as an Input Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Go to Production Orders View.-Use the standard search to search for Product ID ABC (ABC represents the Production Order ID).-Click Go.-You will notice that the query only returns results where the Output Product ID matches the Query and does not include Production Orders where the Query Product ID was used as an Input Product.-Cause-This functionality was changed during the new 2402 upgrade and no longer returns the Production Orders where the query matches the Input Product.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Production Order, Search, Input Product , Output Product

Title: How the Net Value and Net Price for the Items are Calculated in a Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-When navigating in a Customer Invoice, the Net Price and Net Value for each Item are displayed in the document.-This documentation aims to provide further details regarding how the Net Value and Net Price for the items are calculated in a Customer Invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Filter for All Invoice Document.-Search for the Invoice XYZ (where XYZ represents the Invoice ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-The Net Value and Net Price amount are displayed for the Line Item XX (where XX represents the Line Item Number).  -Resolution-The calculation of the Net Value and Net Price occurs in the following order:-First the system calculates the Price Component Value (List Price) using the below equation:-Price Component Value (List Price) = Line Item Quantity x Unit Price (Amount)-After the Price Component Value (List Price) is obtained, the system calculates the Net Value for the Item using the following equation:-Net Value = Price Component Value (List Price) + Addition Price Components-Note: The Addition Price Components are optional for each Item (for example a Surcharge, Quality Loss Fee, Freight, etc.).-Then, the system uses the Net Value for the Item in the below equation to obtain the Net Price value:-Net Price = Net Value/ Line Item Quantity-Note that currency conversions in the Sales Orders and rounding are required to be taken into consideration for the values displayed for each Price Component.-See Also-KBA 2250861 - Is it Possible to Change the Default Decimal Notation for Currencies?-Keywords-Net Value, Net Price, Invoice, Sales Order, Item, Items, byd

Title: Error "Migration Terminated; Contact Your Service Adviser" While Migrating Accounting Transaction Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Error message while performing Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-"Migration terminated; contact your service adviser"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view or Overview view.-Search and Open the migration activity "Migration of Accounting Transaction Data".-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool option.-Select the Source file.-Click on Execute Migration.-Select the migration object.-Click on Process File.-At Simulate Import stage the below error is displayed:-"Error detected Migration terminated; contact your service adviser"-Cause-This is caused by inconsistencies with the migration object in the backend.-To determine if this is the case, go to backend transaction SLG1 and execute(select it and press F8 or click the "Execute" button at the top).-If the check failed with the below error message, it indicates that there is an inconsistency with the migration object.-"Error while generating runtime objects for XXXXXX-Syntax error in function module XXXX-Error message: The field "XXXXXX" is unknown, but there is a field with the similar name "XXXXXX""-Resolution-Go to backend transaction DMC_INC_CORR, use the value help of the Migration Object field to select the object (BANK_STATEMENTS001 is being used in the example) and execute the Check Object Consistency routine (select it and press F8 or click the "Execute" button at the top).-If the check failed with the below error message, it confirms that there is an inconsistency with the migration object (if the check completes successfully, check SLG1 transaction for additional error logs, as issue might be related to application content).-The first step after confirming the runtime object is invalid is to attempt regenerating the runtime object by running the Generate Run Time Object routine.-In case this completes successfully, it might have been enough to address the issue—please verify in the frontend if the issue is no longer occurring.-In case this fails with below errors, it can also be solved by the DMC_INC_CORR transaction.-"Error while generating runtime objects for XXXXXX-Syntax error in function module XXXX-Error message: The field "XXXXXX" is unknown, but there is a field with the similar name "XXXXXX""-Execute the below in the DMC_INC_CORR transaction:-Select "Zero reference error" and press F8 or click the "Execute" button at the top. Wait until process complete, once done move to next step.-Select "Execute Cleanup report" press F8 or click the "Execute" button at the top. Wait until process complete, once done move to next step.-Execute "Check Object Inconsistency" to check if migration object is consistent.-Generate Runtime Object.-If above 4 steps failed, forward incident to SRD-CC-MIG-DMC Development component to check inconsistency further.-See Also-KBA - 3198065 - File Validation Issues in Any Migration Service -Keywords-Migration of Accounting Transaction Data ,G/L account,Bank statement,LV_count,GV_count,runtime object error-migration of accounting transaction data,g/l account,bank statement,lv_count,gv_count,runtime object error

Title: Error "You are not Authorized to Make These Changes" When Trying to Block a Material
Content: Symptom-System throws an error when trying to block a material below-You are not authorized to make these changes-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Product work center-Go to Product Administration work center view-Search for and open the relevant product-Select "Action" button-Choose "block" button-Error appears : You are not authorized to make these changes-Cause-The access group ID is not maintained for the access context-  Resolution-To resolve this issue, the access group ID needs to be added either in the access context or in the Org structure.-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the General Settings View.-Choose the Business Users link.-Select the business user-Choose the button Edit - Access Rights.-Navigate to the Access Restrictions tab.-Search for the Product Administration Work Center View Name -In the Write Access drop-down, select- Restricted-Add the access context group ID-See Also-2813039 - System Time Out or Unresponsive when choosing the Restriction Rule - '99 - Define Specific Restriction'-Keywords-Access Context, Access Group ID, Block, Material, Action , You are not authorized to make these changes, authorization error

Title: Extension Fields Not Copied From Sales Order to Down Payment Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You created an Extension Field in the Sales Order but the value is not copied when creating a Down Payment Invoice Request from the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There is no extension scenario from Sales Order to Down Payment Invoice Request available.-The Extension Scenario Sales Order - General Information to Invoice Requests - General Information can be only used for Invoice Requests based on a Sales Order such as a Sales Order Invoice Request-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-See Also-KBA 2834449 - Extension Field Information is not Passed from Sales Order to Down Payment Invoice Request via Extension Scenario-Keywords-Down Payment Request; Extension field; Value; Sales Order; Invoice Request; Extension Scenario

Title: How to Forward a Customer Case to Operations/ Hosting/ Provisioning team??
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -How to escalate customer case to the Operations/Hosting/Provisioning team?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Resolution-You cannot forward the case directly to hosting team since they are currently not in ServiceNOW. -You need to create an internal Incident from the case and forward the incident to concern hosting team. -Open the case in ServiceNOW-Navigate to Incidents tab-Choose the New button-Go to the Initial Description section and add Subject: #Customer Incident (before the original description of the case)-Add a Description-If required, add the Business Impact  -Choose Save-In the New Incident Choose "Assign to Me" button-Under Details section Enter Service Offering as "SPC Operation"-Now enter the Handover Service-For Incident management “SAAS_BYD_C4C_Cloud_Operations”-For Provisioning “SAAS_BYD_C4C_PROVISIONING_L2”-Under Compose section, add Provider Info-Choose Save.   -Keywords-Web Service, Demand Forecasts, delete

Title: Missing Sales Orders From Sales Target Plan
Content: Symptom-You are using the Sales Target Plan to view the created Sales Orders, however, some of the documents you have created are not showing under the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Select the Sales Planning subview.-Click on New button.-Enter the expected parameter.-Sales Order ABC does reflect its value under the Net Value(Incoming Sales Orders) but not under the Net Value (Invoiced Sales Orders) (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Cause-The Sales Order ABC contains project based items.-For project based items, the invoicing happens via Project Invoice Request, hence for such scenarios, the report does not retrieve the information of the invoicing amount on the sales orders.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Sales Target Plan, Sales Order, Net Value, Amount

Title: No Application logs In The Scheduled Run
Content: Symptom-The Application Log for the Mass Data Runs is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator WC.-Check the Mass Data Run view.-Check the RUN ID.-Check the Application Log.-Go to the Results tab.-No details found.-Cause-If there are no instances to execute the action on, there will be nothing to write in the application log as well.-Resolution-Make sure the MDRO’s selection parameters retrieve at least 1 BO instance and process this to get the log recorded in the system.-See Also- You can refer to the SAP Cloud Application Studio help documentation MDRO section for more details.-Keywords- MDRO;JOB;INPROCESS;FAILED JOB

Title: Tax Code XX is not Determined as Expected for a Sales Order Document in the System
Content: Symptom-The Tax Code determination in a Sales Order is not occurring as expected. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC. (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Tax Sub tab.-The Tax Code is displayed as XX. (where XX represents the Tax Code number)-Cause-Note: Please kindly search the scoping question below according to the External system (Avalara or Vertex) that you currently use.-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-In the search field, search for "Do you want to use the services provided by Avalara to determine tax rates for US?".-In the search field, search for "Do you want to use the services provided by Vertex to determine tax rates for US?".-In case you use the External system Avalara, the scoping question "Do you want to use the services provided by Avalara to determine tax rates for US?" is displayed as "In Scope".-In case you use the External system Vertex, the scoping question "Do you want to use the services provided by Vertex to determine tax rates for US?" is displayed as "In Scope".-Once one of scoping questions mentioned above is "In Scope" in the system, the Tax Determination will be defined in the External system and carried our to the Business ByDesign system.-Therefore in the scenario of the Sales Order ABC, the Business ByDesign system is sending a Tax Request to the External system (Avalara or Vertex) and receiving a response (without the Business ByDesign system affecting the Tax determination sent by the External system)-Resolution- As the Tax determination is occurring through a External system, we kindly ask you to contact the Avalara or Vertex team in order to check if the correct Tax Details are being sent correctly to the Business ByDesign system.-See Also-Please kindly also check the below KBAs for related scenarios:-KBA 2888148 - How to Activate Avalara or Vertex-KBA  3346923 - You are Not Able to Release Customer Invoice due to Avalara Error-Keywords-Tax Code, Determine, Incorrectly, Avalara, Vertex, Business ByDesign, In Scope

Title: Unable to submit case in BYD Tenant
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to create a case, you are getting the below Error :-Your required contact details are not maintained , Your E-mail or telephone contact details are not maintained(Both are required),if you want to send a case to the provider-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to BYD tenant-Go to Help center-Click on Report case-Enter the Details.-Click on Submit-Error: Your required contact details are not maintained ,Your E-mail or telephone contact details are not maintained(Both are required),if you want to send a case to the provider-Cause-Email ID and Phone Number has to be maintained-Resolution-Logon to BYD tenant-Click on Business Partner Data WorkCenter-Navigate to Service Agents-Select User who is facing error.-Click on edit and select General.-Update phone number and email ID under In-House Communication tab as shown in below screenshot.-Example Screenshot:-NOTE: Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems or sample data.-Once you update the phone number and Email ID , you will be able to submit case to SAP.-Keywords-Error sending case , update phone number, update Email ID-error while sending incident to sap,srd-cc-ci-ccs,unable to forward incident to sap,unable to submit incident,update phone number,update contact details in byd, e-mail or telephone contact details

Title: The extension fields automatically fulfilled when creating a new Bills Of Material
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Bills Of Material and maintaining the Input Products, the extension field will be automatically fulfilled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Choose Production Bills Of Material view.-Click new->BoM.-Click add row under Input Products.-Input the Line Item Group ID.-Input any contents in the extension field ABC.-Click add row again and input the same Line Item Group ID.-The extension field ABC in the second row will be automatically fulfilled.-Cause-It is the expected behavior. If the extension field is created under business content "Production Bill of Material - Line Item Group", the value of this field will keep the same when the Line Item Group ID is the same.-Resolution-There are two ways to avoid this problem.-When adding a new row in the Input Products, use different Line Group Item ID so that the extension field will not be synchronized.-Use an extension field created under business content "Production Bill of Material - Line Item Change Details" and then the extension field will not be synchronized even if the Line Group Item ID is the same. But in this case, it is necessary to input Line item ID so that the extension field will be active. And under the same Line Group Item ID, the Line item ID cannot be repeated.-Keywords-Bill of Material, Extension Field, Automatically fulfilled, Line Group Item ID

Title: Physical Inventory Attachment is Missing after Approval.
Content: Symptom-After approving a Count Task ID from the Physical Inventory > Monitoring > Work View, you notice there is no longer any way to view the attachments you have added.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory Work Center.-Go to Monitoring >> Work View.-You will see a list of PI Count Tasks available.-Select the desired PI Count Task ID.-Click Actions >> Add Attachments.-Add an Attachment.-Click Save and Close.-Click Approve Count on the PI Count Task for which you have added the attachment.-You will notice you can no longer see that line in this View.-Navigate to the Physical Inventory Work Center select By PI Count Item View.-Search for the PI Count Task ID there.-You will see that it is in approved status.-However, you cannot find the attachment anywhere.-   Cause-The current design restricts the visibility of attachments and notes solely to approvers during the approval process. Once approved, these attachments are not directly accessible to customers within the system within any View.-Resolution-This is standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Physical Inventory, Notes, Missing, Attachment, Count

Title: The Error "Deleting data not possible; deletion disabled" is Displayed in the Payload Response When Updating a Sales Order Document via Web Service
Content: Symptom-When updating a Sales Order document via web service, the error "Deleting data not possible; deletion disabled" is displayed in the response.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The reason for the error message "Deleting data not possible; deletion disabled" to be displayed in the response of the payload is because the UUID for the corresponding item price component was not maintained in the payload in order to update the specific pricing component of the document.-Resolution-This is currently a standard system behavior.-When updating the item price component via web Service, you should always provide the UUID for the corresponding item price component in the payload for the web service to identify the right price component.-The UUID of the item price component can be obtained by executing the "QuerySalesOrderIn" service.-See Also-Please kindly check the below documentation under the section "Update Header Price Component" for further insights regarding the scenario reported:-Inbound Service Manage Sales Orders-Keywords-sales order, deleting data not possible; deletion disabled, uuid,  item price component, payload

Title: Error Message: 'Data missing in field BusinessPartnerBankDetailsID' While Editing Expense Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are receiving an error message when editing the expense report.-Data missing in field BusinessPartnerBankDetailsID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Search for Expense Report ID.-Click on Edit.-Error shows: Data missing in field BusinessPartnerBankDetailsID-Cause-The reason is that Bank account details and Validity start date is showing later date, after the Expense report creation date or Expense date.-Ex: Bank Validity start date is 24.08.2023 and Expense report for the Expense date:29.06.2023. --Resolution-You can check validity of the bank account from backend. Steps to check the Valid period or Start date of the bank account from Backend.-Login into Backend.-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO EMPLOYEE.-Select LOAD BY ALTERNATIVE KEY->IDENTIFICATION – EMPLOYEE_ID.-Enter Employee ID and Enter.-Navigate to PARENT.-Navigate to BUSINESS_PARTNER.-Navigate to PAYMENT_AGREEMENT.-Navigate to BANK_TRANSFER_DETAILS.-Click on More Functions -> Switch Attibute Names -> Display Names.-You can view ValidityPeriod/StartDate and ValidityPeriod/EndDate-Keywords- Data missing, BusinessPartnerBankDetailsID, Expense report error

Title: Dump Occurs When Opening Custom UI Screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Dump occurs when opening custom UI screen.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite: Custom UI screen exists in solution (PDI)-Open custom UI screen where customer is facing dump.-Dump occurs-Cause-There is a metadata inconsistency.-The backend dump (ST22) will include:-Info: Element 'NODE_ID' of BO node 'YXXXXXX_XXXXXXXXXXX-ROOT" not replicated. ('YXXXXXX_XXXXXXXXXXX-ROOT" represents solution)-Resolution-Ask the customer to go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio and carry out following steps:-Re-activate the BO that contains the UI screen-Click update metadata button for the corresponding UI-> Save and activate-Deploy Business configuration-Test it again.-Keywords-500 SAP internal server error;not replicated;Dump

Title: Error: Registration for OAUTH not found for user SAP_SUPP00*
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to post a Concur Expense Report and receive an error - Registration for OAUTH not found for user SAP_SUPP00*.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur View.-Go to the Expense Reports subview.-Select the Expense Report XYZ (XYZ represents Expense Report ID).-Click Post-Error: Registration for OAUTH not found for user SAP_SUPP00*.-The error can occur while scheduling Concur runs too.-Cause-The user is not registered for OAUTH webservices.-Resolution-Take approval from the customer to maintain SAP_SUPP00* users in the system.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to User and Access Management view.-Click User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services.-Select CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH.-Copy the Client ID.-Click Switch Edit Mode.-Paste the copied Client ID under Client Secret and click OK.-This makes all the buttons enabled.-Click Add Row.-Add SAP_SUPP00* in both the fields and click OK.-The user added here now has access to work with Expense Reports or to schedule runs.-The traffic light in the column Access Permission Status turns green after this user has successfully triggered the data exchange the first time.-Remark: there might be cases where Client Secret is no longer equal to Client ID. In these cases, along with the approval from customer to maintain SAP_SUPP00* users in the system the Client Secret should also be asked to the customer.-Keywords- OAUTH, Concur, Registration

Title: Html Email Template for Interactive Form Template
Content: Symptom-You want to create a html e-mail template for any interactive form but the button "Action" is inactive.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to Form Template Maintenance view.-Filter for template type "Interactive".-You see the action button to maintain email templates/ email subject etc., is inactive.-Cause-Interactive forms do not support html email templates.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Html email templates, Interactive Forms, Form templates.

Title: The Error Message "Business partner Service and Support Team ID XYZ must have organizational role code Customer Service" is Displayed When Changing the Service and Support team in a Service Order
Content: Symptom-When changing the Service and Support team in the Service Order ABC, the error message "Business partner Service and Support Team ID XYZ must have organizational role code Customer Service" is displayed in the UI.-(where ABC represents the Service Order ID and XYZ represents the Org Unit ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Order Work Center.-Go to the Service Order Processing View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Service Order ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the General tab.-In the Service and Support team field, enter the Org Unit XYZ.-The error message "Business partner Service and Support Team ID XYZ must have organizational role code Customer Service" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The error message "Business partner Service and Support Team ID XYZ must have organizational role code Customer Service" is displayed for the document because the Service Order ABC was created before the Org Unit XYZ was valid in the system.-Following are the steps to check the Org Unit validity:  -Go to the Organizational Management Work Center-Go to the Org Structure View-In the Currently selected date field, enter today's date-Select Ok button-Select the Find button-In the search field, enter XYZ-Select Locate button-Navigate to the General tab-The Valid From date of the Org Unit XYZ is after the creation date of the Service Order ABC.-Resolution-In this case, we kindly recommend to change the Valid From date of the Org Unit XYZ to a date before the creation of the Service Order ABC.-Following is the process in order to change the Valid From date of the Org Unit in the system: -Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to the Org Structure View.-In the Currently selected date field, enter today's date.-Select Ok button.-Select the Find button.-In the search field, enter XYZ. (where XYZ represents the Org Unit ID)-Select Locate button.-Select Edit button.-In the Currently selected date field, enter today's date.-Select Ok button.-Navigate to the Timelines tab.-In the Valid From column, change all dates to a date before the creation of the Service Order ABC. (where ABC represents the Service Order ID)-Select Activate button.-In the dropdown, select Activate Selected Structure.-A message indicating that the activation was completed will be displayed, and the Valid From in the General tab will be changed to the desired date.-After this process, we kindly ask you to maintain the Org Unit XYZ as the Service and Support Team in the Service Order document and then perform the Save action.-Keywords-Service Order, Org Unit, Service and Support Team, Business partner Service and Support Team ID, must have organizational role

Title: Get Error "Service Issue category missing" While Doing Migration of Knowledge Base Data
Content: Symptom-You are going to migrate Knowledge Base Articles (KBA) into system via Migration Tool. In the simulation step, you got error: Service Issue category missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open activity: Migration of Knowledge Base Data.-Click Migrate knowledge base data using the migration tool.-Select the migration file, and click Migrate step by step.-In the step 3 - Simulation, you get error:Service Issue category missing.-Cause-You have maintained value in Version column. It is an administration information and cannot be maintained manually in KBA.-Resolution-Remove the Version value in the migration file.-Keywords-Migration of Knowledge Base Data; Version; Service Issue category missing

Title: Possibility Of Port Access In Add Mashup
Content: Symptom-What is the possibility of port access to add mashup in the Service Control Center work center?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Mashup Authoring view.-Now navigate to New - HTML Mashup.-Under Port Binding Type, select Port Binding.-Here add the HTML mashup.-Now go to Service Control Center work center.-Go to Systems view and navigate to the profile icon.-Start Personalization mode and navigate under Section group.-Here, no HTML mashup is available to add.-Cause-It is not possible to move the HTML mashup which is added to the system page on the top under the Service Control Center work center.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Mashup, Port Binding, Mashup Authoring, Service Control Center Work Center-mashup,portbinding,mashup authoring,service control work centre

Title: Html E-Mail Template Shows Additional Information
Content: Symptom-You created a html e-mail template and are surprised to see more than the content of your template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to Form Template Maintenance view. Here, search for example for a customer invoice.-Click on the action button and "Create Email Template" for uploading.-Your html e-mail template contains 4 rows but if you send the email out, in the received email you will see more then the 4 lines from your email template.-You want to know why.-Cause-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to Master Template Maintenance view and edit the Master Template.-Here you will see a facet called "E-mail Disclaimer".-As the name says, this will always be added to the e-mail text body as E-mail Disclaimer.-Resolution-The behavior is expected.-Keywords-Email template, Html email template, Master template.

Title: Application Area Field Position Has Changed in the Case Creation Screen
Content: Symptom-After you have activated the CHD Configuration for the affected tenant, you noticed that the Forward to Provider option is not available anymore.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2302 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the cases view.-Create a New case.-Cause-Once the CHD Configuration is enabled, the Application Area Field is moved and it's no longer mandatory. Such change occurs due to the changes of the screen itself.-Resolution-Currently, this is the expect system behavior. If the CHD Configuration is enabled, the Forward To Provider option is not available anymore. As the system screen is dynamic so it acquires the space of Forward to provider and application area moves to that position.-See Also-2611988 - Central case Processing CHD and CCC Scenarios in ByD and C4C-Keywords-CHD Configuration, Application Area, Field, Position, Forward to Provider, case, Application and User Management.

Title: Data Extraction - Open Items Receivable / Payables (Partially Cleared Invoice scenario)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are Extracting the Partially cleared Invoices using Data Extraction Objects - OPEN_ITMS_RECEIVABLE - Open Items Receivable or OPEN_ITMS_PAYABLE - Open Items Payable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Click on Data Extraction view.-Click New.-Select Extraction Object - OPEN_ITMS_RECEIVABLE - Open Items Receivable or OPEN_ITMS_PAYABLE - Open Items Payable. -Resolution-When you extract partially cleared invoice then the system fetches the Open Amount as it is in the Extracted excel - Open Items Sheet. The system does not recaluclate the Tax Amount after Partially clearing and hence the data extraction also fetches the original Tax Amount in the Extracted excel - Tax Data sheet.-For example:Customer Invoice with Total Amount = 100 EUR and Tax Amount = 15.97 EUR. The invoice is Partially cleared with Payment of 50.00 EUR.-In the Customer Account Monitor, you can find the Partially Cleared Invoice.-Extracted excel - Open Items tab:-Extracted excel - Tax Data tab:-Note:-1) Due to the current system design, the system is unable to split the Tax Amount w.r.t partially cleared amount. There is scope of future enhancement. -2) The above observation applies to Open Items Payables also.-See Also-3329524 - Data Extraction - Open Items Receivable / Payables-Keywords-Data Extraction - Open Items, Partially Cleared Invoice, Payables, Receivables.

Title: System Shows 500 Internal Server Error When Trying to Save/Post a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-System shows 500 internal server error when trying to save/post a Supplier Invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Invoices and Credit Memos view-Open the relevant Invoice-Enter the Invoice Date to previous date-Try to Post or Save the invoice-The error occurs-Cause-The invoice date is prior than the valid from date of Company Tax Arrangements. Hence system shows error message.-Resolution-The invoice date must be equal or later than the valid from date of Company Tax Arrangements-You can check the valid from date of Company Tax Arrangements as follows:-Go to Tax management Wc > Company Tax Arrangements view-Select the desired Company Tax Arrangement and check the Valid from date-See Also-Multiple Tax Registration – India-Keywords-dump, error, 500, check, post, save, invoice, CL_FAI2D_CHECK_ACNTF_IGITAX=>IF_FAI2D_CHECK_ACNTF~CHECK_ACNTF;  1 Consumer Fault!Tax Reporting Unit is mandatory for India. Triggering application component: AP-SRM-FND

Title: SDK Logon Language Warning Message While Login to SDK
Content: Symptom-You will receive below warning message while logon to Cloud Applications Studio tool with the user who have other than English Language assigned.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Application Studio-Enter System Details-Enter Username and Password-Warning Message Appears 'Your current logon language is not English.'-Cause-Solution artifacts gets generated for all other languages if the user is assigned other than English language and those artifacts create inconsistencies from the backend.-To avoid such inconsistencies we have implemented this as a check in 2005 release during logon.-Resolution-To resolve this message you have to update your default laguage to English.-To do this, you can click on Help button as shown in warning message and you will be navigated to the help document which explains the steps.-Below are the steps :-Log on to the frontend UI with your development user.-From the user profile menu, navigate to Settings My Settings.-In the Language field, select English from the dropdown menu.-Save your setting.-Log off and then log on again for your changes to take effect.-See Also-You can also refer PDI Help Document > User Setup Guide for the same.-Help Document for Update Your Language Preference.-Keywords-Language setting, November 2020, set your language to English Immediately

Title: You Get Error 'Net Price of item exceeds Golden Tax maximum amount' in the Sales Order or Invoice
Content: Symptom-When creating a sales order or invoice, you add an item line and put the product and list price, then system reports an error saying that 'Net Price of item ABC exceeds Golden Tax maximum amount'. (ABC represents the line ID of the sales order)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This applies to both Sales Orders or Invoices and we will use the example of a Sales Order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Click New to create a new sales order, enter Account and necessary information in General tab. -Go to Items tab, add a new raw, enter product ID and List Price.-System reports the error 'Net Price of item 10 exceeds Golden Tax maximum amount'. You are able to save the order but not able to release it due to the error.-Cause-This is because you have enabled Golden Tax Invoice function and maintained the Golden Tax Maximum Invoice Amount in the relevant Tax Authority.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Open the Tax Authority relevant to the sales order.-Go to Company Tax Arrangements view, select the corresponding company, in the below Golden Tax sub tab, you can see the Golden Tax Maximum Invoice Amount is maintained.-Once the Sales Order item Net Price exceeds the amount, system does not allow to release the order.-Resolution-This is currently the system design.-See Also-KBA: 2525296 - Golden Tax Invoice Not Split due to Error Message: Item XX: Net Value of item XX exceeds Golden Tax maximum amount YYY-Keywords-Golden Tax Invoice; Golden Tax maximum amount; Sales Order; Golden Tax Maximum Invoice Amount

Title: Error: Error While Processing Employee ID XXX (YYY); Runtime Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You notice that the period closure of an employee cannot be executed. An error occurs. Error: Error while processing employee ID XXX (while XXX is the employee ID) (YYY) (while YYY is the employee name); runtime error.-You may also notice that a SAP 500 Internal Server error occurred when executing period closure for the employee via Regular Tasks view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To reproduce the error Error: Error While Processing Employee ID XXX  (YYY); runtime error:-Go to Time Administration work center-Click on Regular Tasks view-Click on Administer Day Closure Runs-Click on Application Log ID-Click on Results-Expand Execution details-To reproduce the dump:-Go to Time Administration work center-Click on Regular Tasks view-Click on Run Day Closure for one employee-Search for the relevant employee-Select Start Time Valuation-Click on Run-Cause-Potential Cause for the issue:-There are locks by your own user affecting the time valuation for the employee. When the employee tried to release time, a valuation was required. But one valuation lock already existed with your user. Therefore, the dump occurred.-Difference in Posting Type of Period End Rules maintained in Time Account (Employee Time File) and Fine tuning (Time Account Rules)-To verify:-Go to Time Administration ->Time Profile->Time Account Rules->in Period End Rules posting type was SET TO ZERO (example) for the Time Account (ex: VACATION(DE0010))-Go to Business Configuration -> Time Accounts Fine tuning -> Time Account Rules -> for Time Account (ex: DE0010 - VACATION) the in Period End Rules the posting type was CARRY FORWARD (example)-Resolution-Resolution 1:-Removing locks could lead to data corruption of all sorts. In particular, it can lead to data corruption when the valuation is involved. Removing the wrong lock can be very dangerous if for example a valuation run is being performed. Therefore, it is recommended to forward the incident with this issue to TLM development.-Development should cross check the issue with information pertaining to the employee.-Resolution 2:-Period End Rule maintained in the Time Profile of the Employee Time File should be in sync which is same as the rule maintained in the Business Configuration.-Keywords-Benutzersperre, Tagesabschluss, Period Closure run, user lock,

Title: Extension Field Information is not Passed from Sales Order to Down Payment Invoice Request via Extension Scenario
Content: Symptom-After configuring an Extension Scenario from Sales Order to Invoice Request, you notice that the value from the Extension Field is not passed from Sales Order to Down Payment Invoice Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find and Open Sales Order ABC (ABC Represents the Sales Order ID), which has a Down Payment Invoice Request created for it.-Open it and click View All.-You notice that the extension field has a value different from its default.-Now, navigate to the Document Flow tab and change the selection to Extended View.-Open any Down Payment Invoice Request assigned on the Document Flow.-You notice that the extension field has its default value.-However, you have the correct settings for the Extension Scenario to Invoice Request:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open any Sales Order.-Hover over Key User Settings and click Start Adaptation Mode.-In the top-right of the screen, click on the button with your profile picture.-Go into Adaptation Mode.-In the side bar, scroll down until you see a plus ('+') sign.-Click on it and select Extension Fields.-Highlight the extension field that is you want to extend to Invoice Requests.-Click on Further Usage.-Go to the tab Extension Scenario.-The option "Sales Order - General Information to Customer Invoice Request - General Information" is among the selected.-Cause-This happens because when using the extension scenario for Sales Order to Customer Invoice Request, this is a communication via A2A (Application-to-Application).  This means that for the extension scenario to transfer the field entry in the Sales Order, it must have a backend communication message sent in order for the extension fields entry to pass to Invoice Request.- -However, when creating a Down Payment from the Sales Order OWL (Object Work List) screen, this is an action that is executed which sends a reference to the Sales Order.-This means that the extension field values are not passed to Down payment invoice request when using this function as there is no backend communication sent.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-See Also-KBA 3003015 - Extension Fields Not Copied From Sales Order to Down Payment Invoice Request-Keywords-Sales Order ; Extension Scenario ; Invoice Request ; Down Payment; Value

Title: Data Source Missing When Editing Extension Field
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field (PDI or KUT) and you would like to add it to a data source. However when you are in the adaptation screen, the data source you are looking for is not offered.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to your system or the SDK studio.-Navigate to the field and edit it (in the adaptation mode, if you are in the system).-In the further usage details, go to the 'Data Sources and Reports' tab.-Here you will either see no data sources, or the one you are looking for is missing from the list.-Cause-There are 3 potential causes:-When you create an extension field (PDI or KUT) and try to add it to a data source, the system checks the business context of the field (i.e. on which screen it was created) and the access context of each data source. Only those data sources whose context matches the context of the extension field will be listed and available to be extended. In your case, the data source you are looking for and the extension field have different business context and they cannot be matched.-Even if the business contexts match, some data sources are not extensible with key figures. An extension field will be a key figure, if it is of type Amount, Quantity or Decimal.-Some data sources are not extendible for technical reasons, so no extension field can be added to them irrespective of the business context of the field.-Resolution-Please create your field in another business context. For example, if you require to see your extension field in account related data source, check if you can use the Account - Overview section. If you would like a particular data source to be enabled for extension in a new business context, you can make use of the Influence Session to suggest such an enhancement.-This is the correct behavior. You can see more details in the KBA 1628631 - Extension Fields of Type Amount, Quantity or Decimal Cannot be Assigned to a Data Source/Report.-You can request an enhancement of the product by logging your requirement on the Influence Portal.-Keywords-no data sources found, extension field, data source, report, missing, extending, add field to data source, business context, custom field, adapt, adaptation-adaptation,adapt

Title: Assignment to is Not Permitted
Content: Symptom-You are trying to invoice an Invoice Request, however, you are receiving the error 'Item XX: Assignment to  is not permitted'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Request view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Click on the Invoice button.-Cause- The error is being raised, as the expected business transaction, in this case ID 28 - Customer Invoice, has not being maintained under the activity Account Assignment Types.-Resolution-This is the system standard behavior.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the activity Account Assignment Types.-Click the  Maintain  Account Assignment Types hyperlink.-Select the Account Assignment Type being used.-Click on the Assignment to Business Transactions subtab.-Click Add Row button.-Add 28 - Customer Invoice.-Click Save.-See Also-2585705 - Purchase Order not Available for Creation of Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Customer Invoice; Assignment; Not; Permitted; Account Assignment Types;

Afterwards certificates are not displayed in the 'Edit Trusted Certificates' list.-When trying to upload the certificates, the system issues the error message: 'Certificate already exists'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The system behavior may be due to an inconsistency that occurs in some cases.-Resolution-Please open a SAP case.
