Title: Bank Processing Date Behavior When Creating Payment Files
Content: Symptom-After created bank transfers via Payment Run or manual payment and wish to create the corresponding payment media for file exchange, nevertheless the Bank Processing Date is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Find the concerned payment and click Actions for Bank Transactions -> Create Payment File.-The Bank Processing Date is populated but it's not the expected one. It either dates on the present date or today +1 or blank.-Cause-The bank processing date may vary if there was a previous payment file for the payment or not.-Considering this, the following is the scenarios and respective behavior for the bank processing date:-1. When making payments with the bank processing date as greater than today's date (future dated):-For very first time when generating the payment file, the bank processing date is same as what set.-But when discarding the payment file the system will not make any change nor when creating the payment file for the second(2nd) time as well.-2. When discarding a payment file by setting the payment to not transferred, the system will make the Bank Processing Date initial if it is backdated or corresponds to today's date.-3. If the Bank Processing Date is greater than today (future date) the system does not make it initial. After discarding the file and creating it again, the system checks if the bank processing date is initial (blank), then it will take today's date, add 1 working day and assign it to the Bank Processing Date.-Resolution-The above behavior is the design.-Whenever changing the status of payment from" In Transfer" to "Ready for Transfer", make sure the bank processing date should be at least a date after the current date (greater than today's date). So then only the bank processing date will be displayed with value (date) with disabled mode.-Keywords-Bank Processing Date, Payment, Run, Manual Payment, Payment File

Title: Error: Instance With the Same Key Already Exists During Translation of Multiple Records
Content: Symptom-You will receive an error while trying to maintain the translations of multiple records for PDI created business configuration objects.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to frontend of the system.-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Click on the button Open Activity List.-Select the Fine Tuning tab.-Find the relevant fine tuning activity created from SDK and click on open.-Click on the button Translate.-Select the target language and provide the target language description for multiple records available.-Click on the button OK.-Error message appears.-Cause-Maintaining translations for multiple entries is currently a technical limitation for the PDI created business configuration objects.-Resolution-This issue occurs only for multiple translations of PDI created pre-delivered values and do not occur for multiple translations of Fine Tuning created values on PDI created BC Sets or for SAP created pre-delivered values.--Only workaround available here is to edit the translation entities one by one.-Keywords-Translation error-Multiple translations instances-translation error,multiple translations instances,instance with the same key already exist

Title: Unable to Approve Clearing Task: The Posting Date is not Permitted
Content: Symptom-When trying to approve an under/over payment task for a partially cleared invoice, the system does not agree with the proposed posting date for the clearing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Find the task Approve Clearing of Under-/Overpayment by Customer - <Clearing ID> - <Customer name> - <Amount and Currency>.-Click Approve.-The following error message is raised: Posting date <clearing date to be approved> not permitted. The item to be cleared already has postings assigned to it with posting date <existing clearing date>. Enter a posting date equal to or after <existing clearing date>.-Cause-This approval task is triggered when clearing item with discounts/credits is submitted for clearing of receivables by the receivables accountant. The discount/credit must be approved before this clearing item can be cleared. Tasks of this type are decision tasks, which can be approved, sent back for revision, or rejected.-Along with this approval task, the error message is raised. Reason being that a user tried to clear the remaining balance of a partially cleared document, however this second created clearing, which is under approval, has a posting date before the posting date of the previous clearing that cleared the first part of the amount. Therefore, the approval of the clearing is not possible, since there are posting for these invoices for a later date.-Resolution-In order to approve the clearing, enter a posting date equal or after the posting date of existing clearing.-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-View the concerned account.-Select the related invoice document and click Multiple IDs, in the Clearing ID column.-The Clearing Information screen will be open. This screen displays a list of all clearings related to the document that was selected. The Clearing Date of the Completed clearing is after the date set for the current In Approval document.-Click the clearing ID, which is In Approval and to which the error during approval was raised.-Enter a posting date equal or after the posting date of the Completed clearing.-In order to change the posting date, either send the task back for revision or withdraw the clearing from approval.-Keywords-clearing, approval, posting date

Title: Bank Statement Postprocessing Status Remains In Process
Content: Symptom-When you post the bank statement the Postprocessing status does not change to Required or Not Required. Instead it stays in status In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Select All Bank Statements.-Search for the bank statement.-Here you will notice that bank statement Postprocessing status is still In Process.-Cause-When the bank statement is posted, the system will try to create and post the allocations. Now this action is performed via background Job. This background job will try to search for the respective transactions in the system and match that transaction in the payment allocation. When the system usage is unusually high, at times background jobs to process the payment allocation can get stuck and hence the bank statement does not change the status to Required or Not Required as expected.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Select All Bank Statements.-Search for the bank statement.-Select the line.-Click Restart Payment Allocation Processing button.-After Restarting the payment allocation processing, please wait for some time (15-30 Minutes) before checking the Postprocessing status. It is recommended to perform this action when system usage is minimal (ideally outside business hours) so that it gets completed successfully.-If the above action does not manage to update the Postprocessing status from In Process to either Required or Not Required, please proceed with Refresh Postprocessing Status option.-Open the respective bank statement.-Select View All.-Select You Can Also.-Select Refresh Postprocessing Status.-Close the Bank Statement and return to the Bank Statement overview screen.-Select Refresh, if the above steps were successful then you will see the Postprocessing Status Update.-If even in this way the Postprocessing status does not get updated, please Report a case to SAP Support.-See Also-KBA: 1619973 - Bank Statement Postprocessing Status-Help Document: Monitoring Payment Allocation Processing-Keywords-bank statement, postprocessing, in process; Refresh Postprocessing Status; Restart Payment Allocation Processing

Title: Error: Copy not Allowed; Source System ABC has add ons, but Target System XYZ not
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform a copy solution profile between tenants, however the following error message appears:-Copy not allowed; source system ABC has add ons, but target system XYZ not (where ABC and XYZ represent the tenant IDs)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center.-Enter the Systems view.-Select the Source System for the solution profile copy.-Click on the Copy Solution Profile button.-Select the Profile ID and Target System for the solution profile copy.-Click on the OK button.-Cause-The reason is that the add-on composition of the two tenants are not the same, which is a requisite for the copy solution profile process.-This can be verified in the "Service Control Center" work center, inside the "Systems" view, by selecting the tenant and clicking in "view" button. Then you can compare the partner solutions maintained for both the tenants in the "Partner Solutions in System" session.-Steps to check it:-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Then go to the Overview view.-Click Active Systems.-Highlighted the required Tenant URL/ID.-Click View.-Check the PDI details in the section Partner Solutions in System.-Resolution-Please contact the partner responsible for the concerned add-ons and ensure that both tenants have the same setup of add-ons.-Keywords-Copy not Allowed, Source System has add ons, Copy Solution Profile, PDI.

Title: Automatic Payment Allocation After Posting Manual Bank Statement Throws Error Message 'Business Partner Missing'
Content: Symptom-You create a manual Bank Statement. You maintain the Payment Methods and the Customer/Supplier references to the Open Documents. After posting, the items of the Bank Statement still show as Postprocessing Required. You need to conduct the Payment Allocations manually.-You get also an error message 'Business Partner missing' in the Payment Allocation itself.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You create the Bank Statement in the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Click New and choose Bank Statement.-Maintain a Bank Account, a Date and the Balances.-In step 2 Select Items assign the Open Payments.-In step 3 Create and Edit Items maintain the Payment Transactions.-Post the Bank Statement.-Access the Payment Allocation via the column Postprocessing in the posted Bank Statement. Alternatively you can see it in the Payment Management Work Center - Payment Allocation View.-You can see an Error Message: 'Business Partner missing'.-Cause-The Conditions for an automatic Payment Allocation are not met. You can see this in the following example:-Outgoing Bank Transfer:-You create a Payment XYZ of the type Outgoing Bank Transfer via a Payables Payment run (where XYZ is the Payment). This Payment is in status In Transfer.-You confirm the Payment in a manual Bank Statement and you assign it in step 2 Select Items.-In step 3 Create and Edit Items you choose the Payment Method Other Outgoing Payments.-An automatic Payment Allocation does not happen since the Payment Method in the Payment and in the Bank Statement differ. The Payment XYZ has the Bank Account ABC (where ABC represents the first Bank Account). But the Bank Statement has the Bank Account DEF (where DEF represents the second Bank Account). The system does not conduct an automatic Payment Allocation and shows an error message since both Bank Accounts are different.-Resolution-The Bank Account Data in the existing Payment and in the Bank Statement Transaction need to be the same. -The Payment Method in the Bank Statement has to match the Payment Method assigned in the existing Payment.-Step A:-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to the Payment Monitor View.-Show All Payments, find Payment XYZ and press Edit.-Here you can see the Payment Method JKL (where JKL is the Payment Method). You can see as well Bank Account ABC.-Step B:-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Go to the Payment Allocations View.-Search for the Payment Allocation XXX (where XXX is the Payment Allocation) and open it.-Maintain the Payment Method JKL which has to match the Payment Method JKL from the Payment in Step A.-Under Bank Account the same Bank Account ABC as in Step A has to be maintained.-When you post the Payment Allocation, you can see no error message anymore.-Keywords-Business Partner missing Payment Allocation; Payment Allocation not Posted automatically; Geschäftspartner fehlt; Zahlungszuordnung nicht automatisch

Title: Error on Employee Outbound Run: 'Missing Required Field: Custom21'
Content: Symptom-Error appears on Employee Outbound Runs: 'Missing Required Field: Custom21'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Go to the Employee Outbound Runs view.-Click relevant Application Log ID.-Go to the Results tab.-Error: 'Missing Required Field: Custom21'-Cause-This happens because the field Custom21 was set as mandatory in SAP Concur.-Resolution-The fields CUSTOM21 and LEDGER_KEY should be set as not mandatory in SAP Concur, this is mentioned on the SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide in Item 3.2.2. (Page 24)-See Also-Help Document - SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide.-Keywords-Missing Required Field, Custom21, Employee Outbound Runs, Master Data Replication, LEDGER_KEY-missing required field,custom21,employee outbound runs,master data replication

Title: Incorrect Tax Rate Type determination for Country Spain when using Tax Code 315 - Supply of Services - EU w/o VAT Reg. / Non-Residents with First Letter N in NIF
Content: Symptom-Tax Rate Type is incorrectly determined by the system when creating sales documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-In the Common task column, select the New Manual Invoice.-Select View All button.-In the Account field, enter XYZ (where XYZ represents Account ID).-Fill the other mandatory fields.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Add Row button.-Add the Service ID ABC (where ABC represents Product ID).-Select the Taxes sub tab.-Change the Tax Code manually to 315 - Supply of Services - EU w/o VAT Reg. / Non-Residents with First Letter N in NIF.- The Tax Rate Type is automatically determined as Standard.- Cause-When checking the Service Master data, the Tax Country is set as Spain and Tax Rate Type is maintained as Reduced.-While creating a sales document such as an Invoice Request via the UI or even via Webservice via ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn for example, the system automatically determines the Tax Code as 310 - Supply of Goods and Services and the Tax Rate Type as Reduced.-When the tax code is automatically determined, the system first determines the Tax Rate Type from the product master, which is Reduced.-However, when manually changing the Tax Code to 315 - Supply of Services - EU w/o VAT Reg. / Non-Residents with First Letter N in NIF, the system automatically determines the Tax Rate Type as Standard.-When a tax code is manually entered, the system determines by default Tax Rate Type Standard which is defined against Country and Tax Type.-  Note: If tax code is being passed in WS payload, system would consider it as manually entered.-  When a manual change is executed for Tax Codes 316 - Domestic Supply of Goods and Services, Reduced Rate, Simplified/Summary Invoices and 317 - Domestic Supply of Goods and Services, Super Reduced,Simplified/Summary Invoices, the system determines the Tax Rate Type as Reduced and Super Reduced.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-Keywords-Wrong, not correct, missing.

Title: Element CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator cannot be passed via SOAPUI
Content: Symptom-According to Help Center Documentation Inbound Service ManageCustomerQuoteIn, CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator is available for the webservice CustomerQuoteBundleMaintainRequest, however, when executing the payload, the element does not appear in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour and the Help Center Documentation will be corrected in one of the future releases. -Keywords-Missing, Not available, not passing, not visible, UI.

Title: Report "Supplier Details" Does Not Show All Suppliers
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the Supplier Details report does not show the entire list of suppliers in the system.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Access the Design Reports work center view.-Locate and open the Supplier Details standard report.----Execute the report with no filters.-Click the View button-Remove all Row Fields.-For the Column Fields, enable only the Key Figure "Counter"----Execute the report; count will show the number of total records in the report.--Now:-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Access the Suppliers work center view.-Set the selection to All Suppliers.-Execute a query without setting any filters.-Click the scroll bar and hold; system will show the total number of suppliers and it is higher than the one shown in the report.--Cause-The data source BPSPPB - Supplier Details upon which this report is built was designed to provide "an overview of supplier master data, including the supplier name and ID and address data along with information that is required in the purchasing process, such as the purchase order currency, the Incoterms, the customer ID at the supplier, and the expected purchase order acknowledgement. In addition, the report also shows financial data, such as bank and tax data."-Hence, it only shows suppliers that have Financial/Payment Data maintained, which is why the number of suppliers shown in the report will be lower than the total number of suppliers in the system if there are suppliers with incomplete Financial/Payment Data.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-If you need a report that shows all available suppliers in the system, you can create a custom report based on the SUPPLIER - Supplier Master Data data source. For more information on how to create reports, check the See Also section.-See Also-Working with Reports Using the Report Wizard, at SAP Help Portal.

Title: How to download the SAP Cloud Applications Studio from the SAP Downloads Center
Content: Symptom-The SAP Cloud Applications Studio is a software development kit (SDK) that enables SAP Partners, SAP Resellers and SAP Customers to adapt, enhance, and personalize their solution capabilities for SAP Cloud for Customer / SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP for Me > SAP Software Center-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Please follow the help document from the SAP Help Portal: Home > SAP Cloud Applications Studio > SAP Cloud Applications Studio > Getting Started > First Steps > Installing and Updating the SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Go to the SAP Software Downloads Center via SAP for Me > SAP Software Center-Filter for Downloads-Search for Cloud Studio-Locate the required version-Open the category Maintenance Software Component-Download the Installer-Note:-Your S-user ID must have Software Download authorization. Use the self-service request if needed (see KBA 2891528).-Ensure that your contract has the proper license for the SAP Cloud Applications Studio. For help with this, please directly contact your SAP Account Executive (see KBA 2626344 for correct contact details) or SAP Order Management (see KBA 1660069). IMPORTANT: Licensing issues cannot be resolved through regular support channels.-If you face any other issue during the download, use the Contact Us button in the Software Download Center page, or create a case for component XX-SER-FORME. -Keywords-Cloud, Applications, Studio, Cloud, APP, Studio, Download, SDK, Launchpad, CIC, auth, authorization-cloud studio,sdk,download

Title: Reclassification of Receivables Run Error: 'Account determination for acct <ABCD> <XYZ> not defined for reclassification'
Content: Symptom-When executing a Reclassification Run for Receivables, the run finishes with errors. In the Messages tab, the following message is displayed: 'Account determination for acct <ABCD> <XYZ> not defined for reclassification' (where ABCD stands for the Charts of Account and XYZ for the impacted G/L account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Receivables Work Centre.-Navigate to the Periodic Tasks View.-Select Reclassification of Receivables.-Search and select the relevant Reclassification Run.-In the Run details it was finished with errors.-Click on the View button, navigate to the Messages tab.-The following error message is displayed: 'Account determination for acct <ABCD> <XYZ> not defined for reclassification'.-Navigate to the Postings tab and see that G/L accounts UVW and XYZ are used. Both are Receivables G/L accounts.-Cause-As indicated by the error message, it is raised because configuration for Reclassification of Receivables is not done properly in Business Configuration Activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination. Either G/L accounts are missing or incorrect or Reclassification Ranges are not maintained as expected.-Resolution-Open the Business Configuration Work Centre.-Select the First Implementation View.-Select the relevant Implementation Project, Open the Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-tune tab, search for the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity-Navigate to Account Determination and open the Subledger Account Receivables and then the Reclassification tab-There, find G/L Accounts UVW and XYZ-Make sure that both of them are maintained as Receivables Accounts and Reclassification Accounts with the proper Reclassification Ranges for Debit and Credit for each:-Receivables Account Reclassification Range Reclassification Account-UVW C0012 - Credit Balance, 0 - 12 months XYZ-UVW C1260 - Credit Balance, 12 - 60 months XYZ-UVW C6099 - Credit Balance, 60 - 99 months XYZ-UVW D0012 - Debit Balance, 0 -12 months XYZ-UVW D1260 - Debit Balance, 12 - 60 months XYZ-UVW D6099 - Debit Balance, 60 - 99 months XYZ-XYZ C0012 - Credit Balance, 0 - 12 months UVW-XYZ C1260 - Credit Balance, 12 - 60 months UVW-XYZ C6099 - Credit Balance, 60 - 99 months UVW-XYZ D0012 - Debit Balance, 0 -12 months UVW-XYZ D1260 - Debit Balance, 12 - 60 months UVW-XYZ D6099 - Debit Balance, 60 - 99 months UVW-Once the proper Reclassification Ranges has been maintained, execute Reclassification of Receivables Run again, the run should now finish without errors.-Note - The above solution is valid for Reclassification of Payables as well.-See Also-For more information on this functionality, please refer to the following Help Documents:-Reclassification of Receivables Quick Guide-Reclassification of Payables Quick Guide-Reclassification-Keywords-Reclassification of Receivables, Reclassification of Payables, Reclassification Range, Account determination for acct, not defined for reclassification

Title: Mismatch Between the Imported Records and the Imported Template File Data in Mass Data Maintenance View
Content: Symptom-There is a mismatch between the number of imported records and the number of records in the template when updating customer data in the Mass Data Maintenance View.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance Work Center.-Click on Mass Data Maintenance View.-In the dropdown under File Overview, select Successfully Finished Files.-Select the file YYY (where YYY refers to file name).-You can see in the column "Imported Records" that the number is different from the number of records maintained in the template file.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-In the mass data maintenance when importing a file to update customer data, the "Imported records" column count is based on the number of unique Account IDs maintained in the template and not on the number of lines in the template imported.-Resolution-To verify the number of records maintained in the template it is required to open the template in the mass data maintenance tool.-To check follow the below steps.-Go to Mass Data Maintenance Work Center.-Click on Mass Data Maintenance View.-In the dropdown under File Overview, select Successfully Finished Files.-Click on the file YYY.-All the records maintained in the template will be displayed in the mass data maintenance tool.-See Also-3416030 - Few Records Missing After Mass Data Maintenance Import-Keywords-mass data maintenance, customer, imported records, mismatch, account.

Title: Subsequent Credit Is not the Same as Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-Scenario example:-In purchase order, 10 pieces of products are ordered. Then 3 pieces should be returned. A Return to Supplier is created and a Credit Memo is expected. However, only 2 pieces are included in the Credit Memo. The third one is created as a Subsequent Credit Item. As a result, the quantity that credit memo should be created is still "1", which is expected to be "0".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When creating credit memo for returned item (for example, 3 ea):-Create credit memo for 2 ea and select "Credit Memo Item".-Create credit memo for the rest 1 ea and select "Subsequent Credit Item".-The status of the purchase order is not Completely Invoiced. There is still "1 ea" to create credit memo.-Cause-Different from Credit Memo, Subsequent Credit only changes the amount of the original credit memo. It cannot change quantity. So Subsequent Credit is only used as a follow-up document that refers to a posted credit memo and increases the credit on the credit memo.-Note: Subsequent Invoices works the same but in an opposite way.-Resolution-To change quantity of the original credit memo item, it is necessary to create a credit memo.  -See Also-Help Document: Create a Subsequent Credit or Debit-Keywords-Credit Memo; Subsequent Credit; Supplier Invoice; Purchase Order; Return

Title: Transport request failed due to PDI files being locked by user.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When doing a Transport request it fails and throws error.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Administration Work centre.-Navigate to Transport Management view.-Open transport request ABC.-Activate transport request ABC.-It will show the below errors.-Failed to activate transport object type Add-on Solutions.-Failed to deploy add-on solution Y123456_--Custom Enhancement.-Activation failed.-Cause-The issue is being caused as the corresponding PDI files is locked by a user and as a result if you try to activate it wont allow you and throw the errors listed Below.-  Failed to activate transport object type Add-on Solutions.-Failed to deploy add-on solution Y123456_--Custom Enhancement.-Activation failed.-Resolution-There are two ways to remove locks, please see below:-Ask Partner to Delete locks in Cloud Applications studio.-or-Open XREP transaction.-Click on "List Locks" button.-With the customer's permission, delete the locks.-Keywords-Transport, activate, Lock, object type, Add-on Solutions, user

Title: 'Account determination for inventories is missing for Acct Det. Group ABC' Error in WIP Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-WIP Clearing Run finishes with error:-'Account determination for inventories is missing for Acct Det. Group ABC'.-ABC means the Account Determination Group.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the WIP Clearing view-Find and open the respective Run ID.-Move to Messages tab.-Notice the error:-'Account determination for inventories is missing for Acct Det. Group ABC'.-Cause-For account determination group ABC, the account determination is missing in Inventories subledger -> Differences tab -> Loss from Production Differences.-Resolution-Maintain the account determination in Business Configuration activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Open Inventories subledger.-Select Differences tab.-Maintain a G/L Account under Loss from Production Differences and save the changes.-Execute the WIP Clearing Run again.-Keywords-wip clearing; work-in-process; Inventories; differences; production lot; adgr; account determination; Loss from Production Differences

Title: Intrastat Declaration Run References Two Months in the Application Log
Content: Symptom-Two periods are taken in consideration in Intrastat Declaration Run. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center.-Go to Intrastat Declaration Runs view.-Select run ID ABC (ABC is the run ID). -Navigate to Execution Details tab.-Open application log XYZ (XYZ is the ID of the application log).-Navigate to Settings tab.-Click in Expand All button.-You can see that:-Selected Reference Period: Year-Month and Year-Month(II). -Why is it showing two months in the period, instead of only one month? -Cause-When the configuration in the run for 'Reference year/month' is maintained blank, the system works as default. For country France, the reference period is defaulted to 2 months. For other countries, the reference period is defaulted to 1 month only.-Resolution-System is working as designed. -See Also-SAP Help Portal: Intrastat Declaration Runs Quick Guide-Keywords-Intrastat; Declaration; Run; France; Reference; Application Log

Title: System Crashes When Posting a Payment Assigned to a Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-System crashes when posting a payment (for example, an outgoing bank transfer) which has a down payment request assigned under Open Items section.-Remark: same issue also happens when trying to approve the payment, in case an approval process is set up.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Find and open the respective payment.-Click Execute Payment.-System crashes.-Cause-The payment has a down payment request assigned to it under Open Items section.-This down payment request, in turn, has Reference Item to a purchase order, under Items -> Cost Distribution tab.-Finally, the respective purchase order is unposted in General Ledger - Source Documents work center view.-The system crashes because the purchase order is unposted.- Resolution-Post the respective purchase order by solving the error that prevented its posting (for example, accounting period blocked error).-Once this is done, the payment could be posted.-Keywords-CL_FIA_FVPUR_RELATED_SERV=>GET_CB_DATA_FROM_PO_MIRROR; payment; system crash; dump

Title: System Crashes While Selecting Company ABC in Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-The system crashes when selecting Company ABC (ABC is the Company ID) in a New Journal Entry Voucher screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Journal Entry Voucher sub-view.-Enter Company ABC.-System crashes.-Cause-The company ABC is a newly created company and hasn't been assigned to a set of books yet.-Resolution-Assign company to a set of books in the Business Configuration activity Set of Books. After that, the journal entry voucher creation should be possible.-Keywords-"COMPANY_NOT_ASSIGNED_TO_SOB"; jev; sob; set of books; journal entry voucher; CL_FIA_SETOFBKS=>GET_DEFAULT_SET_OF_BOOKS

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Error: "Asset XXX val.view 1: Acquisition cost negative"
Content: Symptom-GR/IR Clearing Run processed with the following errors:-An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset XXX -Asset XXX val.view 1: Acquisition cost negative-XXX refers to the Fixed Asset ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to the GR/IR Clearing View.-Search for the run ID YYY (YYY refers to the GR/IR Clearing Run ID).-Click on the Log Result.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-The following errors are found:-An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset XXX-Asset XXX val.view 1: Acquisition cost negative-Cause-The errors are occurring because of checks being run on the fixed asset XXX during the GR/IR Clearing.-Resolution-To avoid these errors, please update the settings the following in all valuation views:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for fixed asset ID XXX.-Click Edit and navigate to the Master Data.-Go to the Asset Valuation tab.-For Valuation View and the respective Set of Books ID, under Additional Parameters section change the Valuation Check Settings to 3 - No checks.-Then perform the GR/IR Run in Test Mode first. Once you have confirmed the results are as expected, proceed to execute it in Update Mode. -See Also-2055569 - GR/IR Clearing Run Processed With Errors: "Asset XYZ Val.View 1: Acquisition Cost Negative"-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing Run, Fixed Asset, Asset Valuation View, Valuation Check Settings

Title: Expiration Date of Payment File appearing as "00000000"
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom payment file. After creation of the outbound file, you noticed that the Expiration date of the payment file comes as "00000000".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Select Outbound Files.-Search for all and ID XXX(XXX represents the ID of the outbound file).-Download the file and open it.-Result: You will notice that the expiration date comes as "00000000".-Cause-The Data Source "Expiration Date of Payment File" in Business ByDesign is a field that was intended for usage in UK specific custom files, for BACS payments. This Data source will therefore only work when a custom BACS structure is created and assigned to the standard BACS payment format.-Resolution-A potential alternative would be to use a different Data Source: "Expected Payment Value Date at Payer/Payee".-Keywords-Custom file; Expiration date

Title: Error "Changing Project Task not possible; field is read-only" While Migrating Open Sales Order
Content: Symptom-While migrating open sales orders below errors are displayed. -Changing Project Task not possible; field is read-only-Changing UUID not possible; field is read-only-Changing Project Task ID not possible; field is read-only-Project task missing-Project missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration - Overview-Migration of Open Sales Orders-Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool-Execute the migration file-System shows Below error:-Changing Project Task not possible; field is read-only-Changing UUID not possible; field is read-only-Changing Project Task ID not possible; field is read-only-Project task missing-Project missing-   Cause-Under Items Project Task (Cost and Revenue Assignment) is maintained. -Resolution-Project Task (Cost and Revenue Assignment) is used for multi customer project or a direct cost project, but the project task assigned is "Service - time and material (project)" (For instance). Those are meant for customer projects with sales integration only. -Remove the values in Project Task (Cost and Revenue Assignment) and migrate the sales order list.- Keywords-error; migrate open sales orders; Changing Project Task not possible; field is read-only; Project task missing.

Title: Active Budget Control and Budget Check not Enabled for Certain Scenarios
Content: Symptom-The Active Budget Control is scoped, and the Budget Check is enabled, but the system does not check the budget limit (i.e., no error/warning messages indicating the budget has been exceeded) for the following scenarios:-New Charge/Credit (Payables and Receivables).-Sales Order-Journal Entry Voucher.-New Expense Report.-Consumption for Return from a Cost Center.-Recurring Journal Entry Vouchers.-Petty Cash - Outgoing / Incoming Cash Payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Below is an example scenario where you observe that the Active Budget Control is not triggered:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the New Sales Order common task.-Enter the required information and click on 'Release'.-The system does not trigger any error/warning message indicating that the Budget limit has exceeded.-Cause-Budget Check is only available in the following scenarios:-A purchase order comes up for approval or is ordered. Budget check is not performed when a purchase order is saved.-The quantity or purchase price of an ordered purchase order is changed.-A deviation in the supplier invoice is entered in the system.-Multiple items affecting the same cost center/project task and/or budget category are entered in the system.-A manual suppler invoice without purchase order invoice is created.-Resolution-While the Budget Check cannot be activated for the above-mentioned scenarios, activating the scoping question "Active Budget Control" will not help perform the budget check for sales orders, expense reports, petty cash, payables, and receivables, as this functionality is not available.-Currently, the budget check is implemented in the standard offering in the procurement and supplier invoice areas for cost centers and a selected set of project types within overhead cost management.-There is a published ‘Active Budget Control API’: Method CheckBudgetAvailability under Class ActiveBudgetControlUtilities. This API can be accessed as ActiveBudgetControlUtilities.CheckBudgetAvailability() by partners to extend and enrich the scenarios in the context of Active Budget Control.-See Also-3088505 - Budget Category and Budget Check in Expense Reports-Active Budget Control | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Active Budget Control, Budget Check, Expense Report, Sales Order

Title: Approval Process: "All Approvals Required" Checkbox not Selectable
Content: Symptom-When setting approval process for a purchase order, there are multiple records for the same step. Select different "Direct Approver" but the checkbox "All Approvals Required" is greyed out and cannot be selected per step.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view.-Copy the currently active approval process for purchase order.-In the new process approval screen, create more than one "Step 1".-For each step 1, select "Direct Approvers" as work distribution and choose only one business user as the approver.-See that the checkbox "All Approvals Required" is greyed out and not available.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior. For each step, if only one approver is determined, the checkbox is unavailable because only one approval is required.-Resolution-It is possible to select multiple approvers for a certain step so that "All Approvals Required" checkbox can be selected.-Keywords-Approval; Approval Process; Purchase Order; Multiple

Title: Cannot Determine Taxes for Guernsey; Business Configuration Does not Exist
Content: Symptom-When trying to release an invoice request, the system is showing a warning message and / or an error message as it expects a tax configuration for the country Guernsey.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Document is Inconsistent-Click Check-Warning: Cannot determine taxes for Guernsey; business configuration does not exist-Error: Tax event(s) could not be determined--Or any of the following error messages:-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again (KBA: 2744399)-Tax event determination failed; invalid decision tree value-Tax event determination for partner decision tree for country Guernsey failed-Cause-The reason the system is requiring the determination of GG - Guernsey, is because-A. One of the party roles involved in the sale is based in Guernsey-or-B. there is an account under the Purchase Order of the scenario which is based in Guernsey.-To check A navigate to the Involved Parties tab of the Invoice Request. -To check B follow the below steps:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ID ABC (This is the invoice request from the Service Order).-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Copy the ID of the Purchase Order HIJ (HIJ represents the ID of the Purchase Order).--Navigate to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Search for ID HIJ.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Expand and open the Goods and Services Receipt XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Goods and Services Receipt).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Delivery subtab.-Under the Involved Parties section, the Customer being used belongs to the country GG - Guernsey.- Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -Please contact your implementation partner to assist in the implementation of Tax contents using PDI solution (Cloud Application Studio).-See Also-3388229 - Localization - Countries/Regions Where SAP Delivers Tax Content for SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Cannot determine taxes for Guernsey; business configuration does not exist, Tax, Country, Determination, Wrong, Error

Title: System Dumps when Approving Manual Payments
Content: Symptom-System dumps when approving manual payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Select the payment task and click on Approve.-System dumps.-Cause-One possible reason is that the payment is created for supplier invoice AAA which has withholding tax code 123 for country XXX. However, the withholding tax code 123 does not exist in the system now. (AAA represents the invoice ID. 123 represents the withholding tax ID. XXX represents the country abbreviation.)-Steps to check the withholding tax code:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for activity Withholding Tax - XXX.-Open the activity and go to the Check withholding tax codes.-Here withholding tax code 123 is not in the list.-Resolution-The resolution would be to either recreate the missing withholding tax code 123 for country XXX again or create a new invoice and discard the current invoices, then create new payments for the new invoices.-Keywords-Dump, Crash, 500 Error, Approve Payments

Title: Wrong Payment Format is used in Outgoing Bank Transfer for the Payment of an Expense Report
Content: Symptom-When you generate the payment for an employee via payment run, You expect the payment to be generated as SEPA Credit Transfer. -However payment run generates the payment using different payment method than the expected SEPA Credit Transfer. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Select Payment Run view.-Select the Payment Run.-Click on View Payment Proposal.-Show all payment proposal and search for the payment.-Here you can see the payment method used to generate the payment is different to the expected SEPA Credit Transfer.-You checked already the following settings:-Go to the Personnel Administration work centre.-Go to the Employees sub view.-Find Employee GHI and click Edit (GHI represents the respective Employee).-Navigate to the Personal Data tab.-Here the respective Country under Private Contact Data is maintained.-When you create a new Outgoing Bank Transfer for this employee still the wrong Payment Method is used.-Cause-In order to use the correct Payment Method by the System it is important that the address and country are maintained in the  Business Partner data of the employee.-Resolution-Go to Business Partner Work Center.-Go to Business Partners view.-Search for Employee GHI and click Edit. (GHI represents the Employee ID).-Navigate to the Address Data tab.-Maintain the respective Country and the Address.-When you create a new Outgoing Bank Transfer the correct Payment Method will be used.-See Also-2684542 - Wrong Payment Method is Used in Outgoing Bank Transfer - SAP for Me-2000144 - Automatic Payment Generated with the Wrong Payment Method - SAP for Me-Keywords-wrong payment method, Employee, Expense Report, Outgoing Bank Transfer

Title: Exchange Rate Error: 'Bid rate <= middle rate, which must be <= ask rate for XYZ-DEF dated dd.mm.yyy hh:mm:ss UTC'.
Content: Symptom-Receiving the following error message: 'Bid rate <= middle rate, which must be <= ask rate for XYZ-DEF dated dd.mm.yyy hh:mm:ss UTC' when maintaining new exchange rate for a currency. -(XYZ represents the source currency)-(DEF represents the target currency)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this scenario, we will use "EUR" for the Source currency, and "USD" for the Target currency, but the same can be applied to other currencies as well:-Go to General Ledger work center. -Click "Edit Exchange Rates" Common Tasks. -Click "Add Row" button. -Here maintain the following details:-Select EUR to USD: -Bid Rate: 1,16 USD -Mid Rate: 1,14 USD-Ask Rate: 1,14 USD-Valid From: dd.mm.yyy hh:mm-Click enter.-Receiving the following error message:-'Bid rate <= middle rate, which must be <= ask rate for Euro-US Dollar dated dd.mm.yyy hh:mm:ss UTC'- Cause-The buying exchange rate maintained by the system must not be larger than the middle exchange rate, and the middle exchange rate must not be greater than the ask rate, and for clearing and payment scenarios only Mid-Rate is considered. Ask-Rate and Bid-Rate are not.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -If you need this behavior in the system, we suggest you to create an idea in the Continuous Influence Session for ByDesign. Improvement requests need 20 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis twice a year, with the results being communicated in the corresponding review blog post. You can find the link for the "Continuous Influence Session" in the "See Also" section below. - See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Continuous Influence session-Keywords-Exchange Rates, Bid rate <= middle rate, ask rate, Currency.

Title: Sourcing Request not Created From Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-No Sourcing Request is created from Purchase Request ABC (ABC refers to Purchase Request ID) when selecting Quick Sourcing Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Select the relevant Purchase Request ABC.-Select Edit button.-Select document flow tab.-No sourcing request created-Cause-In the Business Configuration work center under scoping questions - "Do you want to create sourcing requests from purchase requests to use as proposals in RFx documents?" is scoped.-The Sourcing Requests from Purchase Requests business option enables your purchasing department to receive proposals based on purchase requests with no source of supply to create RFx documents. So this business option is relevant if you create RFx documents that are based on purchase requests with no source of supply.-Hence no sourcing requested separately. If you check the document flow of purchase request, the status appears as RFQRequest Created.-Resolution-Descope the question by following the below steps so that system will not create RFQ Request-Go to the business configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select View Active scope button.-Go to Scoping questions and go to the element Sourcing-Select Sourcing and Contracting and Sourcing Requests -De-scope the question and finish the scoping activity-Keywords-Sourcing Request not Created from Purchase Request; Sourcing Requests view

Title: Specific Employee Time Type Activated Without Approval
Content: Symptom-According to the system configuration, employee times of a specific type require approval. However, the employee time has been activated without undergoing the approval process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-A possible reason could be that no manager is assigned to the relevant org unit of the employee (reporting line unit manager), resulting in no approver being determined.-Resolution-In cases where an employee records or cancels times, but no approver can be determined, the employee's time might be activated without approval. Refer to the open task for the relevant employee and time frame in the Time Administration work center, Work view. The task message states:-"Employee times of this type have been configured for approval. However, no approver has been determined, and the employee's time has been activated without approval. This could be due to the employee's entry by the organization's head or a missing reporting line."-Keywords-Missing, Reach, Gone Through, Times, Recorded, Canceled, Approver

Title: Error: File /SAP_BYD/Financials/Templates/XLS_FIN_JEV_UPLOAD.F has been removed in comparison to previous version
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The below error is shown when trying to upload a PDI solution:-File /SAP_BYD/Financials/Templates/XLS_FIN_JEV_UPLOAD.F has been removed in comparison to previous version-Checks after import indicate that solution YABCDEFY_ cannot be imported-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-The standard form template has been edited by a PDI developer user.-This causes inconsistencies on deployment.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, please follow below steps:-Go to XREP transaction-Select Environment > Switch Layer St. on the upper tool bar-Select the Layer Strategy of the PDI being deployed. E.g. YABCDEFY_DEV-Navigate to folder /SAP_BYD/Financials/Templates/XLS_FIN_JEV_UPLOAD.FLDR-Here you can find more folders and files. Expand the folders to reveal the files.-Once you double click on the xl07tmpl file, look at the Version History tab-You have to find a file whose the content in Version History tab has a PDI entry. The entry SAP_BYD should always be there.-Usually the file whose have a PDI branch entry on Version History tab is: /SAP_BYD/Financials/Templates/XLS_FIN_JEV_UPLOAD.FLDR/8EDF16C846194DBBA5965289A3F96CEE.TMPL/W_F00048__ES.xl07tmpl-Once you are on PDI_DEV layer and located the affected file, press on Clean Up button-You can now inform the customer to upload the PDI again.

Title: Incorrect Time Recording Profile
Content: Symptom-Newly created Employees shows different Time Recording Method in Time Sheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for the New Employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button and navigate to the Time File tab.-In the Time Recording Profile tab, verify that the selected Time Recording Method is Positive Recording.--Now, for the second part:--Navigate to the Time Recording Work Center.-Select the Time Recording - Time sheet view.-Search for the same Employee.-In the Object Worklist (OWL), you can observe that the Time Recording Method shows Exception-based.-There is descrepancy in both the views.-Cause-Newly created Employees are active for Time Recording from mid of the Time Sheet reporting week.-Hence, the Time Recording Method shows as the default of Exception until the Time Sheet Reporting Period covers a complete week for given employees.-Resolution-Any recording completed by these employees will be valuated as a Positive Time Recorder.-Keywords-Time Recording Profile, Time Recording Method, Positive Time Recording, Timesheet

Title: How to Change Technical User Date & Time Format Settings ?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 1 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Encountering below error while attempting to modify the date and time format settings for the technical user.-"You are not authorized to access UI application"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login using technical user ID -Go to my settings-Navigate to regional settings-Try to change the date or time format-System throws an error 'You are not authorized to access UI application'-Cause-Certain technical users lack the authorization to alter date and time format settings-  Resolution-Follow below steps to modify the date and time format setting for technical user:-Login to backend-Go to transaction code SESFTS-Search for BO IDENTITY -Navigate to "Load by Query"-Select ROOT - QUERY_BY_ID-Input the user ID in ID/Content field-Display in table view-Go to Navigate button-Select BASIC_SETTINGS-Change the DATE_FORMAT_CODE or TIME_FORMAT_CODE  field value in edit mode-   Keywords-time format , date format, technical user , communication user , regional settings, Settings, You are not authorized to access UI application

Title: Error While Creating Production Order
Content: Symptom-System throws below error while creating production order:--Production model for product on Dated for quantity not found-Creation of production order not possible-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to production Control work center.-Go to Common tasks view and choose New Production Order -Enter required product ID and site ID with required quantity.-Press enter, system throws above mentioned error.-Cause-Since the minimum and maximum lot  size is not maintained in a production model.- Resolution-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Model view.-Find and select the relevant production model.-Choose Edit.-In the Production Model screen, navigate to the General tab.-Here update the Maximum and minimum Lot Size to a quantity as per your requirement.-Choose Release Production Model drop down and then select For Planning and Execution.-Keywords-Production model for product on Dated for quantity not found,  Creation of production order not possible, production order, production model, minimum lot size, maximum lot size.

Title: Service Order is in Process Even Though it was Cancelled via a Reason for Rejection in the General tab
Content: Symptom-The Service Order XYZ is still in Process even though the Service Confirmation ABC was cancelled and the Service Order XYZ was cancelled via a Reason for Rejection in the General tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite:-Service Confirmation ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Confirmation) was initially released with Order Completion.-The items in the Service Confirmation ABC has been cancelled via a Reason for Rejection.--Go to the Service Orders work center. -Select the Service Order Processing view. -Open Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Service Order).-Go to the General Tab and the Main Information sub tab.-A Reason for Rejection e.g. Other Reason is maintained.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-You can see that Line Item XX is in status Completed and the Reason for Rejection was taken over from the General tab.-But Line Item YY is in Process and Not Cancelled. The Reason for Rejection for line item YY is greyed out.-Cause-The Reason for Rejection in the General tab of the Service Order is only available if the Invoice and/or Delivery Status of at least one line items is not Finished. And the Reason for Rejection on the General tab is only passed on to the Items which for which the Invoice and/or Delivery Status is not Finished. -The Service Confirmation was released with Order Completion. This changed the Delivery Status of the Items to Finished in the Service Order. -The Delivery Status for line item XX which has the item type SECO (Service - time and material) is set back to In Process but the Delivery Status for line item YY which has the item type SERV (Service - fixed price) is still in status Finished after the Service Confirmation was cancelled. -Since the Delivery Status of line item YY is Finished the Reason for Rejection on the General tab was not passed to the Item.-Resolution-We added the issue that the Delivery Status of an item with item type SERV (Service - fixed price) is not changed to In Process when the item is cancelled in the Service Confirmation to our product backlog to be corrected in a future release.-In the meantime you can use the following workaround to complete the Service Order:-Go to the Service Orders work center. -Select the Service Order Processing view. -In the General tab remove the Reason for Rejection. -Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab. -Enter the Reason for Rejection for each item. -Save your changes. -The Service Order is then in status Completed. -Keywords-Reason for Rejection; Cancelled; Item, greyed out; read only; disabled; cancellation; fixed price; Service; Service Order; Status; Delivery Status; Fulfillment; Revoked;

Title: Multiple Warehouse Requests are Created during Creating New Replenishment Task
Content: Symptom-When creating a new replenishment task for a product in different logistic areas, expecting there only one warehouse request would be created after selecting multiple lines for the product and clicking on Request Replenishment button. However, multiple warehouse requests are created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to New Replenishment under Common Task list.-Enter product XXX and click Go button (XXX represents the product ID).-Select multiple Line items.-Enter Replenishment Quantity as needed for each line item.-Click Request Replenishment button.-Navigate to Warehouse Requests.-Search for product XXX, multiple warehouse requests are created.-Cause-Products in one warehouse request must have the same logistics area ID. If products have the same Logistics Area ID, they can be bundled into one replenishment task. But if the Logistics Area IDs of the products are different from each other, even though all the products are selected which require replenishment in the same warehouse request, multiple warehouse requests would be created instead of one. -Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Logistics Area ID; Warehouse Request; Products Bundle; New Replenishment Task; Multiple products

Title: Unable to Reject an Time Entry in the Employee Times
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reject a Time Entry in the Employee Times tab, however the system is showing the following error message:-Posting results in insufficient quota for account Vacation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Then go to the Employees view.-Search for the affected Employee.-Then click Edit button.-Go to Employee Times tab.-Search for a required Time/Date, which is under 'In Approval' status.-Click Actions > Reject.-Error occurs.-Cause-We have identified that overbookings in the Vacation time account are causing this issue.-Once you try to reject a time recording, the system checks for consistency in the whole Time Profile, not only on the specific time recording/time account being affected.-Resolution-In order to fix this error, you would need to perform manual adjustments for the affected Vacation (Time Account) to resolve the inconsistency.-Please follow the steps below to perform manual adjustments:-Go to Time Administration Work Center.-Then go to the Employee view.-Search for the affected Employee.-Click Edit button.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Select Vacation (Time Account) and go to Adjustments tab.-For the affected date posting do the changes to quantity from the negative value (e.g -3) to 0.-Save the changes.-After the steps above, please try to reject the Time Entry once again.-See Also-2863186 - Error “Posting results in insufficient quota for account Vacation” While Creating a New Leave Request-2949519 - Error Message "Posting results in insufficient quota for account Vacation" When Extending the Time Profile Date to a Past Date-Keywords-Posting results in insufficient quota for account Vacation, Time Administration, Employee, Employee Times, Error, Cannot, Unable, Reject, Approve, Actions.

Title: Error "G/L acc. ABC (chart of acc. DEF) is assigned to more than one account group" Is Raised When Assigning a Budget Category
Content: Symptom-When trying to add G/L Account ABC to Budget Category XYZ, error message is raised: "G/L acc. ABC (chart of acc. DEF) is assigned to more than one account group"-(ABC, DEF and XYZ represents G/L Account number, Chart of Accounts name and Budget Category ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Open Overview view.-Search for Budget Queries Activity.-Click on Edit G/L account groups for reporting.-On G/L Account Group GHI, click on Add Row. (GHI stands for the G/L Account Group ID)-Select Chart of Accounts XYZ and select G/L Account ABC.-Click on Save.-Error is raised.-Cause-It is not allowed to have the same G/L Account maintained for more than one Budget Category in the Budget Queries activity.-Resolution-System behaves as designed. -See Also-3246163 - Error Message: Combination of Budget Category PQR and G/L Account 123 Does Not Exit-Keywords-Budget Queries, Budget Categories, Financial Planning

Title: PSM Write Release for the New Recurring Invoice Entry Screen
Content: Symptom-PSM write release for the new recurring invoice entry screen-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Recurring Invoice view.-Choose on New-You want to make development in this screen but unable to make.-Cause-PSM write access is not released for recurring Invoice view. This is the current system behaviour.-Resolution-It can be taken as a new requirement and you can post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. This is our official channel to address all new requirements.-Keywords-PSM; Supplier recurring invoice; Write release for supplier recurring invoice-psm,supplier recurring invoice,write release for supplier recurring inv

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error Dump Occurs on Saving the Account Workflow Rule
Content: Symptom-Below dump occurs on saving the Account workflow rule. -'500 SAP Internal Server Error'-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Below is an example for Account workflow rule:-Go to Administration workcenter-Go to Workflow Rules view-Open Workflow Description- "ABC" -Chose Edit -Navigate to Define conditions-Add condition by ADD Group -Group 2 ABC Classification > Equal to > A-Account.-Add Sales Organization ID > Contains-Add Recommended Visit Frequency > Equal to-Go to Review step > Click Finish-Dump Occurs.-Cause-Workflow condition is throwing a dump on creating condition with field "RecommendedVisitingFrequencyDuration" which is of type "Duration".-Resolution-The Duration Type is not supported. Remove condition 'Recommended Visit Frequency' from the workflow creation.-Keywords-Dump, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, Workflow, Duration Type, Recommended Visit Frequency

Title: Production Models Released Unsuccessfully by Production Model Release Run
Content: Symptom-Production Model Release Run ID XXX releases the Production Model ID YYY with error: "Production Models released unsuccessfully ". (XXX represents the Production Model Release Run ID; YYY represents the Production Model ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Production Model Release Run view.-Search for Run ID XXX.-Open the Application Log with error.-Go to Results tab.-Click Expand All.-See error message: "Production Models released unsuccessfully".-Cause-The Production Model ID YYY already has a Released Execution Model and some changes have been made to the corresponding BOO or BOM later. But the Release Production Model checkbox has not been checked when creating the run in first step. If the indicator is not selected, the production models get checked for consistency and would not be released. -Resolution-Follow the below steps to check the checkbox of Release Production Model in Production Model Release Run XXX:-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Production Models view.-Search for the Production Model YYY.-Click Edit button.-Check the checkbox of Release Production Model under Bill Of Operation subtab.-See Also-2566949 - Production Model Will Not Be Released By Run-Keywords-Production Models, Unsuccessfully, Production Model Release Run, Release Production Model

Title: Error: 'Descoping of Planned landed costs not permitted; Purchase orders exist' during Merge
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The merge of a change project is not possible. It fails with error message:  'Descoping of Planned landed costs not permitted; Purchase orders exist'.-This happens although there aren't any open landed cost documents in the system and actual costing is not selected in the active scope.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Open Implementation Projects view-Select the relevant change project-Open Activity List-Select Go Live step-Select Merge activity-Perform merge-It fails and the merge report shows below info:--Write back the project workspace-Details :-issue found during the technical merge-Technical Details :-Descoping of Planned landed costs not permitted; Purchase orders exist-Cause-A veto check in the backend prevents the merge.-As soon as the functionality has been used in a document it can no longer be descoped. It is irrelevant whether the document has ben cancelled or not.-Resolution-This is the designed system behaviour.-See Also- See comment in   Enterprise Resource Planning Blogs by SAP-Keywords-unable, descope, descoping,

Title: Accrual method of doc. item must not be removed for set of books
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to unassign the accrual method from a sales document item.  The error message "Accrual method of doc. item XYZ/XYZ-XX must not be removed for set of books" appears (XYZ represents a sales document, XYZ-XX represents a sales document item). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Find item XYZ-XX. -Press Unassign and choose Accrual Method. -In the RemoveAccrualMethod pop-up window press OK. -The error message "Accrual method of doc. item XYZ/XYZ-XX must not be removed for set of books" appears. -Cause-There are already costs or revenues posted to the sales document item. Once any business transactions exist for sales document items it is no longer possible to remove their accrual method.  -Resolution-The only way would be to assign accrual method Reverse Deferrals and Accruals to the sales order item and to realise all costs and revenues through the revenue recognition run. -You could create a new sales document item and transfer all values over to the new item with a journal entry voucher for sales documents after which the original sales order item XYX-XX could be cancelled. -Keywords-unassign accrual method, remove accrual method
