Title: VAT Return Preview Company Name Is Different From The Reporting Company Name
Content: Symptom-A VAT return has reporting company name input as A. However, when opening the preview of the VAT return, the address maintained in the file is not A, but B instead.-(A and B represents different company names.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Navigate to the Tax Returns - VAT Returns view.-Select the respective VAT return, and the reporting company name is A.-Press Preview, in the PDF file, the company name under address is B.-Cause-The company name in main address is incorrect.-Resolution-Change the company name in the main address for the selected reporting company as follows:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Select the relevant org unit.-Go to the Addresses tab, and maintain the correct company name.-See Also-VAT return, company name, preview tax return

Title: OData Version in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -You want to know which Odata Framework version is used in SAP Business ByDesign, and whether it can be updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Currently the Odata framework used in Business ByDesign is version 2.0 (Odata v2).-At the moment, there are no plans from development team to move to a higher framework level. This is also valid for the metadata version of the Odata services.-It is worth noting that the Odata version is the same for SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer.-Keywords-level, support, supports, change, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, V1, V2, V3, V4, interface

Title: Error 'Changing Unit not Possible; Field is Read Only' During Migration of Materials
Content: Symptom-Error 'Changing unit not possible; field is read only' during migration of materials-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search for "Migration of Materials" activity-Upload migration file-Execute migration -Error is thrown at simulation step 'Changing unit not possible; field is read only' - Cause-When the value of the status field is set to active under the planning tab, the planning UOM field becomes read only.-Resolution-The planning UOM under the planning tab in the migration template should be removed and the simulation step should be re-executed.-See Also-1970359 - Tab is Missing in the Migration Template -Keywords-Changing Unit not Possible; Field is Read Only, migration of material, planning UOM, UOM, Active

Title: Errors When Uploading 6111 Form To The Israel Tax Authority (ITA)
Content: Symptom-Cannot submit 6111 form to ITA due to errors: -Code AAAA expected value is negative.-Code BBBB is not equal to Code AAAA.-Code CCCC expected value is positive.-(AAAA, BBBB, CCCC represents the 6111 form code number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Choose Form 6111 – Israel from Periodic Tasks.-Click Download to download the generated 6111 form.-Upload the 6111 form to the Israel Tax Authority , and errors occur:-Code AAAA expected value is negative.-Code BBBB is not equal to Code AAAA.-Code CCCC expected value is positive.-Cause-Changes to Switch Sign(+/-) in financial structure, different from SAP shipped templates(ZIL8 and ZIL9) will lead to incorrect results.-Incorrect assignment of G/L Account under sections like Assets, Liabilities, Equities may lead to errors in Israel Tax Authority web site.-For example, check the balances of codes under 8888, the “Assets” were in “-ve” and reason for the same is code 8315 is in “-ve”.-If further check the G/L account mappings for 8315, the “Liability” type of G/L Account is mapped to “Asset” type of code.-Resolution-As of 2102 release, SAP has pre-delivered the following financial reporting structure templates for Form 6111:-ZIL8 - IL-6111 Balance Sheet-ZIL9 - IL-6111 I/S Nature of Expense-When using custom chart of accounts, it is necessary to copy the ZIL8 and ZIL9 financial structure templates and manually map the G/L accounts. Also make sure mapping to G/L Account is the correct section code.-Keywords-6111 Form, Israel Tax Authority, ZIL8, ZIL9

Title: Error message: "Target group has more than 10,000 addressable members: execution not possible"
Content: Symptom-While executing the Campaign, system shows the error message: "Target group has more than 10,000 addressable members: execution not possible"- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Marketing - Campaigns -Select Campaign ABC (ABC represents the campaign ID)-Edit and click on execute-Error message: Target group has more than 10,000 addressable members: execution not possible -   Cause-If the target group has more than 10,000 addressable members, the system will terminate the execution and raise an error. This is to ensure that the campaign execution does not encounter severe performance issues.-In the case of a campaign type "Letter using file export", if the target group has more than 10,000 addressable members, system will raise the error. -In the case of a campaign type "E-Mail using file export", if the target group has more than 10,000 members with E-mail maintained, system will raise the error. -Resolution-Kindly maintain the target group which is having less than 10,000 members to execute the campaign. -Keywords-Warning message: "Target group has more than 10,000 members; execution may not be possible"

Title: Netherlands G-Account Chain Liability
Content: Symptom-When creating a Supplier Invoice for the same Supplier, it's not possible to see an indicator for the Chain Liability Relevance Tick box.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base Work Center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Search for Supplier ABC (ABC means the Supplier ID) and Open it.-Go to View All.-Go to General tab.-Go to Supplier/Bidder section.-Here Chan Liability Relevant indicator is visible.-Cause-The Supplier is in Netherlands, but the companies as maintained in the Financial Data - Payment Data, are located outside Netherlands. Hence, the filed for the defaulting of the Netherlands Chain Liability Percentage on this tab is not visible.-Resolution-Netherlands Chain Liability process is only supported for transactions within Netherlands, that is Supplier and company are located in Netherlands.-Keywords-Netherlands, Chain Liability, Supplier Invoice, Tick box, Chan Liability Relevant

Title: APIs in What's New Links Redirecting to Incorrect Page
Content: Symptom-When accessing What's New - APIs in Help Center, the link redirects to incorrect page which shows APIs not found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Help Center.-Click What's New.-Select APIs.-It will redirect to incorrect page which is not showing what's new in APIs for the latest version.-Resolution-The issue will be fixed in upcoming release.-Currently you can use below external link as workaround:-What's New in APIs-Keywords-APIs, What's New, 2405 release

Title: Profit Center ID is not derived in the Journal Entry Line Items
Content: Symptom-Certain General Ledger accounts are not deriving profit centers making it challenging to identify which entity does the transactions belong to within a specific company, especially for various types of transactions such as cash disbursements, balance carry forwards, supplier invoices, and manual posting Journal Entry Vouchers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Search for Journal Entry ID 123 (123 refers to the Journal Entry ID) and click on view.-Under the line items, you can observe that there is no Profit center assigned to the G/L Account XXX (XXX refers to the G/L Account ID).-Cause-The default profit center is not maintained for the particular subledger.-When maintaining a default profit center in the Business Configuration, it is expected that a subledger is specified too. -Resolution-Steps to maintain the Default Profit Centers for Subledgers:-Go to the Business configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Activity Profit center derivation and click on View-Click on the link Edit Default Profit Center.-Maintain the Default profit center for all the subledgers.-For example, if you have maintained the Profit Center AAA (AAA refers to the Profit Center ID) for the subledger Cash, then for any cash ledger line items created in a journal entry that cannot derive a profit center, this default Profit Center AAA will be chosen as default.-It is advised to maintain the default profit center for every subledger, including the "Without Subledger" option. This will prevent further issues with documents posted after this configuration is appropriately maintained.-For already posted documents, follow the below workaround: -Reverse and repost the document from the source documents to check if the profit center is derived.-Note that this is not a cancellation but a reverse and repost action. The initial journal entry will be reversed with the same values, and a new journal will be created for the same posting date with the same values, and the profit center will be derived correctly (Try this workaround in your TEST System first).-Keywords-Default Profit Center, Subledger, Journal Entry, G/L Account

Title: Replication of Cases Notes for the Tenant is not Working
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When accessing a case in SAP Business ByDesign systems, the last notes sent from service now are not replicated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Cases View.-In the dropdown, select All Cases.-In the search field, insert ABC (where ABC refers to the Case ID in the tenant).-Select the Case ABC.-Click on Edit.-The note sent from service now was not replicated to the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Cause-The replication in the SAP Business ByDesign system is performed through the job APCRM_SSR_LP_INCIDENT_SYNC every 10 minutes. If a user has the case screen opened in the SAP Business ByDesign when the Job is running, the user will perform a lock and the replication will not occur.-Resolution-The case screen must be closed for the replication to occur properly when the job APCRM_SSR_LP_INCIDENT_SYNC is running, therefore, to ensure that the replication occur in the system, close the case screen in the SAP Business ByDesign tenant and wait for at least 10 minutes for the replication to be properly executed.-Furthermore, the report APCRM_SSR_LP_INCIDENT_SYNC can be manually executed by following the steps of the KBA 3154262 - Case Updates From SAP not Visible to the Customer, with the case screen closed to perform the immediate replication of the case notes.-NOTE: You can check the "Originally Created On" date on the right side of the provider info in the SAP Business ByDesign case to refer to when the case note was sent from the service now, in order to compare when the notes were sent from the service now and received in the tenant.-See Also-3154262 - Case Updates From SAP not Visible to the Customer-3374589  - Case External Reference ID is Not Generated-Keywords-replication, byd, APCRM_SSR_LP_INCIDENT_SYNC, case, note

Title: The Error "Incoterms for item missing" is Displayed for a Credit Memo Created as a Follow up From a Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY**-When creating a follow up Credit Memo from a Customer Invoice, the error "Incoterms for item missing" is displayed for the new document created. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Filter for All Invoice Documents.-Search for the Customer Invoice ABC (where ABC represents the Invoice ID).-Mark the Invoice Document ABC.-Select Follow up button.-Select Manual Credit Memo option.-The new follow up Credit Memo is displayed and the error message "Incoterms for item missing" appears in the UI.-Cause-Cause 1:-The error occurs for the follow up Credit Memo because the information in Shipping Condition field has not being properly carried out from the Sales Order to the line items of the Invoice document.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Filter for All Invoice Documents.-Search for the Customer Invoice ABC (where ABC represents the the Invoice ID).-Open and select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Mark the Line Item XX (where XX represents the the Line Item Number).-The Shipping Condition field is empty.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ (where XYZ represents the the Sales Order ID).-Open and select View All.-Navigate to the General tab.-The Shipping Condition field is filled with a respective value.-Cause 2:-In a third party scenario when the Shipping Condition filed is maintained in the Sales Order, the system expects the value to be maintained also for the field Incoterms.-When the field Incoterms is not maintained the Shipping Condition value is not passed on to the respective customer invoice. -This check for the Incoterms and Shipping Condition is performed while creating a follow up Credit Memo for the respective Customer Invoice, hence the system raises the error. -Resolution-A backend correction will be required to be preformed by the development team to the Customer Invoice. This will remove the mismatch between the documents.-Kindly open a incident with the development team with the required details for the backend correction. -Once the backend correction is done, the error "Incoterms for item missing" will not be displayed whenever a Credit Memo is created from a Invoice.-See Also-KBA 3803346 - "Incoterms for item missing" Error while Creating a Follow up Credit Memo From an invoice-Keywords-incoterms for item missing, invoice, incoterms, sales order, invoice, customer invoice, manual invoice, manual credit memo, credit memo

Title: Error While Recalculating the Withholding Tax for Non-Localized Country
Content: Symptom-You have enabled withholding taxes for a non-localized country. When creating a payment for an invoice with withholding taxes calculated, errors while recalculating the withholding tax are raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the related supplier account monitor.-Select the relevant open item with custom withholding tax calculation.-Click Pay Manually By and choose the payment method.-On the payment screen, the following errors are raised:-'Amounts on Invoice <ID> are inconsistent.'-'The assigned payment amount for the item must not be zero. You can only clear items with deductions or discounts manually.'-'The payment is not used for clearing of any item. To perform a clearing without the payment, clear on account.'-'Error while recalculating the withholding tax.'-'Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again'-Cause-When the payment is created for the invoice, the system recalculates the withholding taxes. Upon recalculation, a unique withholding tax code must be determined comparing the withholding tax type, rate type and income type.-In this case, you have set up the withholding tax data so that there are multiple tax codes with the same tax type, rate type and income type.-Additionally, for non-localized countries, the system does not support multiple withholding tax types. Only single withholding tax type is supported for calculation during payment. Hence if you have multiple withholding tax types, during payment, the withholding amount is not calculated correctly.-Resolution-Ensure that only one withholding tax code is determined based on the combination of withholding tax type, rate type and income type. Also consider that the system does not support multiple withholding tax types for non-localized countries.-Keywords-Non-localized. Pre-localized. Tax basic. Withholding tax. income Type. PDI. Add-on. Tax Rate schedule.

Title: Invoice is not created by the Invoice Run for an Invoice Request with a Down Payment assigned
Content: Symptom-Invoice is not created by the Invoice Run for an Invoice Request with a Down Payment assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Run view.-Select Invoice Run XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Run).-In the Details section, select Execution Details.-Open Application Log XXX (XXX represents the number of the Log)-Go to the Results tab.-You can see the following warning:-Invoice request ABC type Outbound Delivery has assigned down payment request EFG (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request and EFG represents the ID of the Down Payment Request).-The Invoice Request ABC is still in status To Be Invoiced and was not captured and invoiced by the Invoice Run.-Cause-In the Invoice Run under the section Invoice Properties you can see an indicator (checkbox) for Down Payment Transfer.  This indicator transfers invoice requests with assignable down payment requests into invoice documents. In Invoice Run XYZ this indicator is not active and therefore the invoice request ABC is not invoiced.-Resolution-Sent Invoice Run XYZ to Obsolete and create a new Invoice Run with the same parameter and also activate the Down Payment Transfer indicator.-Keywords-Down Payment; Invoice Run; Not Invoiced;For Outbound Delivery Invoice Request; one or more down payment requests exist and can be assigned;

Title: Error occurred while executing Balance Confirmation Runs - Known Limitation
Content: Symptom-You release a Balance Confirmation Run and it ends in error:-"Work package ID ABC system error; report an incident (ABC represents the Work Package ID).-No balance confirmation created."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables or Payables work center.-Select the view Balance Confirmation Run.-Search and find Run ID 123 (123 represents that Run ID).-Select All Logs under Execution Details.-Select Log 123456 (123456 represents the Log ID).-We can see the details:-Work package ID ABC system error; report an incident (ABC represents the Work Package ID).-No balance confirmation created.-Cause-The work package error appears because two documents with the same document ID have appeared on the Balance Confirmation Run.-Business ByDesign framework can’t handle duplicate document ID during balance confirmation run. This is product limitation currently as we don’t have the composite key combination to uniquely identify documents and we cant change standard mapping object.-Resolution-In such cases, for now we advise to try and identify the duplicate documents:-Go to the Receivables/Payables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Search and find A123 (A123 represents the Account ID).-Looking through all the open items - identify any documents that have the same Document ID.-We suggest to clear manually the one or more duplicate documents which are currently causing the error. Then schedule the balance confirmation run again.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation, Work Package, Error, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, AR, AP

Title: Error Appears While Trying to Post Goods and Service Receipt
Content: Symptom-Unable to post Goods and Service Receipt due to error message. -Error -XYZ of item type External Service - Time and Material cannot be confirmed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center-Go to Receipts and Returns view -Select Show by Documents -Select the relevant Goods and Service Receipt -Click on Edit button and select Check-Error appears-Cause-The error occurred because the wrong Item Type is used in the Goods and Services Receipt. Products that belong to RSTM - External Service – Time and Material group cannot be processed. When the Goods and Service Receipt is created against the product, at this point of time it is known which items/services have been consumed for the purchase order so actual items should be added and not items of the type RSTM. This item type is only used when it is not yet known which services will be needed for the order. -Resolution-You have to Cancel the existing Goods and Service Receipt document with error message and create a New Goods and Services Receipt with correct item type. You can update item type SECO -Service Time and Material in the service master data while creating the documents. -See Also-KBA 2331481 - You Get Process Communication Error: "Product X of item type SVRM cannot be confirmed"-Keywords-XYZ of item type External Service - Time and Material cannot be confirmed; item type External Service - Time and Material cannot be confirmed;

Title: Task "Revise Supplier Invoice" Cannot be Assigned
Content: Symptom-The approver has sent a supplier invoice back for revision. However, the approver doesn't receive task: "Revise Supplier Invoice XXX". The task cannot be assigned even by Determine Assignment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Assume that user A is an approver for supplier invoices.-Log on with user A.-Go to Managing My Areas work center.-There is one supplier invoice XXX awaiting approval.-Click Send back for Revision button and the invoice will be in revision status.-However, no one (including the approver) receives a task named "Revise Supplier Invoice XXX...".-Then go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-At Unassigned Items screen, the task "Revise Supplier Invoice XXX..." is among unassigned items.-Select it and click Determine Assignment, there will be message: "0 item assigned".-Open the triggered application log, it can be seen that the relevant employee is found with message "No employee has sufficient access rights".-Cause-This is because after the approver sending the invoice back for revision, the employee's responsible will be overwritten and he/she will become the approver. Then he/she should receive the task "Revise Supplier Invoice XXX". This is current system design.-But the approver is not assigned Supplier Invoicing work center, so he/she has no access to the invoice. The task "Revise Supplier Invoice" should be sent to the user who has access to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Resolution-Based on the system design, the approver should have access to Supplier Invoicing work center.-See Also-KBA 2896654 - The Employee Responsible of Supplier Invoice Be Overwritten after Send Back for Revision or Revise Supplier Invoice task is sent to approver himself -Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Approver, Task, Revise Supplier Invoice

Title: Unable to Create an Extension Field in the Work Schedule Tab
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an extension field in the Work Schedule tab, under Time Profile view, however there is no option to Add Extension Field. Icon "+" is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work center;-Employee view.-Open an Employee.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Then go to the Work Schedule sub tab.-Enter in adaptation mode.-Button to add extension field is not available.-Cause-It's not possible to add an Extension Filed in the Work Schedule tab, under Time Profile view.-Resolution-Currently, this is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Extension Field, Add, Icon, +, Missing, Time Profile, Work Schedule, not available, not present, Unable.

Title: The Updated Ship-to on the General Tab Does Not Update to Item Level in Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-The Ship-to party in sales order general tab is updated to value XYZ, but you find in item level, the ship-to party is still ABC. The update made on the general tab does not update in item level.-ABC, XYZ represents the business partner ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center view.-Open the sales order.-In General tab, the Ship-to party is XYZ.-Go to the Items tab, and select the item line, you notice the Ship-to party is ABC.-Cause-When creating a new sales order manually, the Ship-to on General tab will be copied into Item lines. If you change the Ship-to in the item line manually, then the further change made on General tab will not be updated into the modified line. -When you creating a sales order copying it from an existing sales order, then system checks the header and item ship-to value.-If the header and item ship-to has same value, it is considerred as not modified, the change on header ship-to will be copied into item level. -If the header and item ship-to has different value, it is considered as modified, then the change made on the header ship=to will not be copied into item level.-Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior.-Keywords-sales order; ship-to; change on header; not update item level.

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error While Trying to Close the Project
Content: Symptom-You are trying to close one of the project however system shows 500 Internal Server Error. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center -Go to Projects view-Select the relevant Project-Click on Edit and navigate to Project Status field-Change it to Complete and Close-System shows 500 SAP Internal Server Error-Cause-There are project tasks services without having service product and it is leading to error message. -Resolution-You need to Delete the Services under these project tasks and then try to Complete and Close the Project.-Keywords-500 SAP Internal Server Error While Trying to Close the Project; Close project; Dump occurs while closing project

Title: System Crashes while Creating Warehouse Request for Outbound Delivery Proposal
Content: Symptom-When the Create Warehouse Request button is clicked for an outbound delivery proposal, the system crashes and a dialog appears with a 500 internal error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Delivery Proposals View.-Search for the outbound delivery proposal and select the line.-Choose Create Warehouse Request, then system would dump.-Cause-The "Autonomic Inspection" feature is enabled for the Inspection Process in the logistics model with warehouse task. This means that the system will attempt to create an Inspection when creating the warehouse request.-However, there is a limitation in the code where the sample size in the Inspection Plan is assigned to an integer variable. This variable can only store a maximum value of 2,147,483,647. If the sample size exceeds this maximum value, it will cause an overflow and result in a system dump.-Resolution-Typically, having a sample size above this maximum limit is not realistic in daily business.-To ensure that the sample size does not exceed the maximum limit, it is necessary to adjust the inspection scope in the inspection plan. -Keywords-Create Warehouse Request, Inspection, Dump, Crash.

Title: New Bank Payment Advice Cannot be Released Due to Error Message: Debit Payment Balance Not Yet Assigned To Accounts
Content: Symptom-Fail to release a new bank payment advice, and the system gives an error message: Debit Payment Balance Not Yet Assigned To Accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select New Bank Payment Advice under Common Tasks.-Enter the necessary information such as Company, Payer, and tick 'Posting Advice'.-Enter the Payment Amount XXX (XXX means the Payment Amount).-Choose Release.-   The system gives an error message: Debit payment balance of XXX not yet assigned to accounts.-Cause-The reason is that Assign On Account Payment button is not clicked before releasing the bank payment advice.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to resolve the error:-In the Open Items table, click the Assign On Account Payment button.-In the Customer/Supplier ID field, select the customer.-Set the Account Type as Receivable.-Enter the Payment Amount.-Specify Credit or Debit. -Choose OK, and then Release.-In this way, the amount is assigned on account, and the bank payment advice can be released.-See Also-1685541 - Incoming Check Cannot be Released Due to Error Message: Credit payment balance not yet assigned to accounts-Keywords-bank payment advice, debit payment balance, not yet assigned to accounts

Title: Unable to Edit the Values in the Activity Create New Country/Region Version
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit a value, e.g Currency, however the value is greyed out in the activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity "Create New Country/Region Version".-Open it.-Check the Country/Region Version related to the affected Country.-Notice that it's not possible to edit the value.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-Once the data is maintained in the activity, you cannot edit the values anymore. However, you can delete the entry and insert it again by maintaining the right data.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity "Create New Country/Region Version".-Open it.-Highlight the affected Country.-Click Delete.-Click Add.-Maintain the required data.-Keywords-Business Configuration, Create New Country/Region Version, Unable, Cannot, Edit, greyed out, Delete, Add.

Title: Tax exemption is not determined by Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -  The Tax Exemption defined in the Supplier Master Data is not being picked up when creating the Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for document ID ABC (ABC represents Supplier Invoice ID).-Go to Taxes subtab under Items tab.-The Tax Exemption details are not being automatically populated in the Supplier Invoice.-Cause-Tax Exemption is not maintained at the Service master data level.-When a product or product category is added, the system identifies the sale or purchase type and retrieves the relevant product/service classification required for decision tree processing.-This parsing results in tax events, are mandatory for determination of the tax code.-Without the details of the product/service being sold or purchased, the decision tree parsing or tax event determination cannot happen and therefore tax code determination cannot happen.-Tax Code = Tax Event + Tax Type + Rate Type + Deductibility.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to maintain the tax in Service level:-Go to Product and Service portfolio work center.-Select Products/Services view.-Search for the Product/Service to be tax exempted and open.-Go to taxes tab.-Add all the relevant details under Product Tax Classification and Withholding Tax Classification.-Select Save. -Tax exemption should be maintained at both Supplier and Product/Service master data level. -Keywords-Tax exemption; Product master data; Supplier invoice; Wrong tax code; Product portfolio; Products; Service; Taxes; Service Master data

Title: Invoice Volume Report Showing Incorrect Value Due to Missing Invoice
Content: Symptom-Monthly Invoice volume report showing incorrect value due to missing cancellation invoice. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders - List -Select the Sales Order Volume Report-Execute the report for DEF month (DEF represents a month)-The Invoice XYZ missing in the report (XYZ represents the Invoice document ID)-The total value showing is incorrect due to missing invoice XYZ, which is created in the DEF month. -Cause-Report will show the invoice document values based on the invoice date. -Resolution-Even though the Invoice XYZ is created in DEF month, the invoice date is maintained from a different month. -You need to maintain the same month in the invoice date, so that system will fetch the invoices for that month. -Keywords-fehlender Rechnungs;

Title: How To Enable Push Notifications for SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App?
Content: Symptom-How To Enable Push Notifications for SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP ByDesign Mobile App-Go to manager approvals tile-Tasks for approval are present in App but no push notification received on device(IOS/Android)-Cause-The push notifications on the device are not enabled.-Resolution-HOW TO ENABLE PUSH NOTIFICATIONS:-For Android OS:-From the device’s home screen, open the “Settings” app (looks like a gear).-Tap “Apps”, “Applications”, or “Applications Manager” (Terms and steps vary by device).-The list of the downloaded apps onto device is displayed. Scrolling through the list, tapping on the desired app will enable push notifications.-To enable push notifications, simply tap on “Show Notifications” from this screen. A check mark will be visible, indicating that push notifications for this app have been enabled.-iPhone®/iPad® OS:-From device’s home screen, tap the “Settings” icon.-From the “Settings” menu, tap “Notifications”.- From here, locate the desired app for which push notifications are required- From here, tap “Allow Notifications” and then choose desired options- -a.  Show in Notification Center: The push notifications will also appear in the device's Notification Center.-b.  Sounds: A sound will be received on the device every time a push notification is received.-c.  Badge App Icon: There will be a small number icon next to the app's icon, indicating the number of unread push notifications for that app.-d.  Show on Lock Screen: All unread push notifications on device's locked screen will be displayed.- -Finally, select the alert style for the received notifications when the device is unlocked:- -a.  None: Push notifications for this app will not be received when the device is unlocked.-b.  Banners: A slim notification pane slides into view along the top of the screen before disappearing a few seconds later. The banner can be ignored, the full Notification Center can be revealed by pulling it down, or it can be tapped to jump to the message, calendar event, or app that requires attention.-c.  Alerts:A pop-up window halts the ongoing activity on the device and presents the notification details. The alerts demand attention and require either opening or closing before continuing with the task.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App-What's New: Mobile- Keywords-Push Notifications, Alert, Banner, IOS , Android, Badge App Icon, Show on lock screen

Title: Remaining Contract Liabilities or Contract Assets After all Sales Document Items of a RAC got Completed
Content: Symptom-After all sales document items are completed (fully delivered, fully invoiced, final delivery or invoice date set in accounting) there are still contract assets or contract liabilities remaining for a RAC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items tab. -In the search filter enter XYZ (XYZ represents a revenue accounting contract (RAC) ID.-All sales document items connected to the RAC appear. -In the Dates tab you verify that the Final Delivery or Invoice Date is set (indicating that the sales order items are completed). -Press Reports and choose one of the report to check all business transactions on the respective sales document item.-You notice contract asset or liability amount which should be cleared as the item's are completed.-Cause-After the IFRS15/ ASC 606 functionality got implemented into SAP Business ByDesign several functional improvements have taken place. These improvements automatically take effect for all RACs created after their deployment. All data created before might need to be refreshed manually to allow the improvements to take effect. -Resolution-Perform dummy changes on the affected RAC: -In the RAC go to the Manual changes tab-set/remove the No Allocation indicator and press save. Then remove/set the No Allocation indicator again and press save.-enter a manual Standalone Selling Price (SSP) in thd change Standalone Selling price field and press save. Then remove the value again and press save. -Or remove the manual SSP, press save and enter it again. -After this perform a revenue recognition run in test mode to check if the contract assets/liabilities are getting cleared. If so, perform an update run. -Should the values not be cleared, send a case to Technical Support for further analysis.-Keywords-contract assets, contract liabilities for completed RAC, completed project remaining deferrals, assets, liabilities

Title: Dump While Releasing the Sales Order.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Dump while releasing the Sales Order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders - Sales Orders -Select the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the sales order ID)-Edit and click on Submit -> Release Order-System shows dump error-In backend ST22 the below Active Calls/Events is shown for the dump-21 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001    24-    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR- 20 METHOD       CL_APCRM_SO_FINACC_OB_AGENT===CP    CL_APCRM_SO_FINACC_OB_AGENT===CM00B   137-    CL_APCRM_SO_FINACC_OB_AGENT=>IF_APCRM_OUTB_PROCESS_CONTEXT~SET_END_AGENT_PROCESSING- 19 METHOD       CL_APCRM_GEN_PROCESS_AGENT====CP    CL_APCRM_GEN_PROCESS_AGENT====CM001   796-    CL_APCRM_GEN_PROCESS_AGENT=>EVALUATE_CONDITIONS- Cause-Issue is due to inconsistency on the Item_Service_Terms node. -Go to SESFTS and load the SALES_ORDER BO for Sales Order ABC -Navigate to ITEMS -> ITEM_SERVICE_TERMS-The Item XX is linked to ProjectTaskUUID, but the product Item Type is not Project. (Item XX represents the Item ID)-This was probably due to the item initially having an item type related to Project, but then it was changed in the UI. But the value in backend did not get removed.-Resolution-If the Item Type field is not enabled then kindly request the customer to add a temporary reason for rejection on line item XX and then remove it. This will make the line item type available for modification. Then make a dummy change in the Item Type field to a project type, then switch back to the original item type and save it.

Title: OData Query for Data Sources Does Not Work
Content: Symptom-The OData query that was created via the Build OData Queries in data sources does not work. It results in the error message 'The request URI is not valid' (in Chrome only).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Make sure that your system is set up for this OData service as described in the help center article 'OData API for Data Sources'.-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Data Sources.-Search for your data source and make sure that it is exposed.-Click on Build OData Queries.-Make the required selections and set filters if needed and click on Generate Data Query.-Copy the link the is displayed in the OData Query box and paste it into a browser.-The link will not work. In Chrome, you will see the error message 'The request URI is not valid'.-Cause-Your user is a business user, however this service is only enabled for technical users.-Resolution-When logging into OData, make sure that you use the technical user defined in the communication arrangement (see step 2 of the mentioned help center article).-After this make sure to save and reactivate the communication arrangement-See Also-Help Center: Extract Data from Data Sources Using OData-Keywords-OData, data source, analytics, generate data query, generate metadata query, the request URI is not valid-the request url is not valid

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Inconsistent.-Click Check.-Error: Reference document for determining invoice quantity or unit not found.-- Open the Backend.-Go to the BO Test Shell (SESFTS).-Open the Sales_Order business Title: Deferred Tax Indicator Is Set Automatically In Sales Documents For Malaysia
Content: Symptom-Deferred Tax indicator is automatically set for Tax Country Malaysia when you create a Sales Order and add a item type of Service.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center-Select New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Enter all the relevant information such as Account, Sales Unit, Invoicing Unit etc-Click on View All and Navigate to Items Tab-Add a Item of Type Service-Navigate to Taxes Tab, and you can see the deferred tax indicator is set.-Cause-The Deferred Tax indicator will be set automatically in sales documents when the Product type is Service and the Tax type = 4 (Service Tax) is used in the sales documents. Currently the tax codes 900, 910, 930 and 990 for country Malaysia are mapped to Tax Type as Service Tax in the system. -Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Deferred tax, Sales Order, Malaysia;

Title: Missing G/L Accounts In Overhead Distribution Run Between Cost Centers.
Content: Symptom-After performing an Overhead Distribution Run between Cost Centers, some G/L accounts are missing in the "Postings" tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Overhead Distribution subview.-Search for Run ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Run ID). -Click "View" button, or "Log Result".-Go to Postings tab.-Some G/L accounts are missing. -Cause-A possible reason is because in the Distribution Rule that was used in the Run, some cost centers were selected for both "Senders" and "Receivers", but during the execution of the Run the system did not find any cost center within the postings of that G/L account for that period in which it was selected in both the Run and the Distribution Rule. Please follow the steps below to check the same: -Go to Cost and Revenue work center. -Go to Distribution Rules subview. -Search for Distribution Rule ID: DEF (DEF represents the Distribution Rule ID). -Click "Edit" button. -Go to "Senders" tab and select the "Assignment Valid On" according to the period that you are performing the Overhead Distribution Run. -Here the system will show the valid Cost Center. -Use the "G/L Accounts - Line Items" report to check if the Cost Center is present in the postings of the missing G/L account in the period where the Overhead Distribution Run was performed. -The system will always check in the Distribution Rule if is active the "Account Determination Group", the "Distribution Basis" type, the "Account Structure" that was selected, and the "Group of Accounts" that was defined in the Account Structure. An important detail that must be taken into consideration is whether the "Account Determination Group" is active or not. If you do not select an account determination group, the original expense accounts are used (that is, the accounts you specified when you entered the distribution values). This is also called primary cost distribution. For more information, please refer to the Help Documents in the "See Also" section. -Resolution-Expected system behavior. -See Also-Overhead Distribution Quick Guide-Overhead Distribution Between Cost Centers-Overhead Distribution (Account Determination)-Keywords-Cost Center, Missing G/L Accounts, Overhead Distribution Run, Distribution Rule.

Title: Error" Please try resuming your work .If you still face issue.Report an Incident " while using Text Adaptation Tool
Content: Symptom-While you are translating using text adaptation tool system throws below dump:-An error Occurred-please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident-Class name:-sap. b. controller. event. Post Request-Method Name:-Post-Response:-SAP Business Cloud for Customer - Currently not available-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management work center-Navigate to Text Pool Administration -Select any text pool ID & Edit it-Go to View Translation tab-Search for relevant source text & text type -Select & Edit target text -You will get below error-"Please try resuming your work .If you still face issue. Report an Incident"-Cause-This is a known issue in the UI framework due to the limitations of the list view for large lists in conjunction with the column-based filtering function. -When you are requesting for the large data list view, you will get above dump. It is not a generic problem of the tool, but caused by the limitations of the list view for large lists. This is what you have on the view Text Elements, as this list shows all element instances on the business object via direct association in conjunction with the column-based filters. These should not be used.-Resolution-User has to go to the “Search Translations tab” and search for the selective target text using the query parameters instead of searching the target text directly in the “View Translations tab” by filtering. -To adjust the texts, follow below steps:-1.    Go to Application & User Management Work Center.-2.    Navigate to Text Pool Administration.-3.    Select any Text Pool Id & Edit it.-4.    Go to ‘View Translations tab’ and click on ‘Search Translations’.-5.    Go to ‘Search Translations tab’ & search with specific text directly using the query parameters.-6.    Select the resulted record & click on ‘Edit target Text’.-Please Note: The Search Translations is at the top of the View Translations tab and should not confused with the Search Texts tab.-Keywords-Text Pool Administration ,System Dumps, SAP Business Cloud for Customer - Currently not available

Title: You Receive an Error Message that a City Name Should Be Maintained for Your Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message that a city name should be maintained for your Sales Order : City in address of Account missing.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Edit Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of a sales order).-Save and Release the sales order-You receive the following error message : City in address of Account missing-Cause-This is the normal system behaviour.-  Resolution-A complete address should be maintained for the Bill-to address, Ship-to address and Account Address.-A complete address means the following :--The Country should be maintained, The City should be maintained and at least one of the following field should be maintained :-Street-Postal Code-P.O. Box-P.O. Box City-Company Postal Code-Keywords-City; Master Data; Account; Sales Document; Missing

Title: Cannot Save UDYAM Tax Number
Content: Symptom-You maintain a supplier UDYAM tax number. On action 'Save', error occurs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to The Payables work center. -Go to the Suppliers view.-Select Suppliers sub view.-Select supplier ID: XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the supplier).-Select Edit > Financial Data tab.-Select Tax Data sub tab.-Add Row and select country India-In the field Tax Number Type, select UDYAM Registration Number.-Maintain your Tax Number as UDYAM-UP-00-0123456 (UDYAM-UP-00-0123456 is an example).-Select Save -Error occurs: -Invalid UDYAM Registration Number; enter alphabets and/or numbers only.-Cause-UDYAM Registration Number in Business ByDesign should be maintained without space and special characters.-Resolution-In Business ByDesign, the UDYAM Registration Number should be maintained with number and alphabets only and must be 19 characters. Space and special characters are not allowed. -Keywords-UDYAM Registration Number, Tax, India.

Title: Supplier Name not Visible in Invoice Scanning View
Content: Symptom-When the completed Scanned Invoices are exported to Excel, Supplier Column in the exported data does not show the Supplier Name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Select Scanning complete option from the drop down-Click on Export to export the data into excel-In the exported excel, the Supplier colum has the value Supplier ID - Supplier ID-Cause-This was a planned change due to new functionality of "Export to Excel" delivered in recent 2211 upgrade.Export to Excel does not work for fields where CCTS type is ID and Description such as the Supplier field. When Exported to Excel, this shows duplicate value as Supplier ID - Supplier ID. While in the system , we can see that the Supplier field shows the value as Supplier ID - Supplier Name-Resolution- This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Supplier name missing; Invoice Scanning; Supplier ID;

Title: Unable to Fetch Data via SOAP/OData in Event Notification Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have an integration setup from ByDesign to an external system using Odata event notification for Tasks. However you notice that even though the even notification end point is called correctly, it is not possible to fetch the Task data yet through SOAP/Odata.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Cause-When an event occurs in Business ByDesign, the respective event notification is called. It then determines the list of external endpoints to which the event has to be triggered, builds the payload to be sent, and makes an asynchronous call to those endpoints with the payload information.-The delay until the Task data can be fetched happens due to the asynchronous nature of the request.-Resolution-The system works as expected. After a short delay, the Task information should be fetchable.-Keywords-event notification, data, fetch, performance, business task, BTM

Title: Error "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item" Raised when Changing Employee Responsible in Active Contract
Content: Symptom-When changing the Employee Responsible of a Contract, error "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item" is raised and the Contract becomes Inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Contracts view.-Find Contract ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Contract you wish to change the Employee Responsible from).-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Change the Employee Responsible assigned to the Contract.-Error "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item" is raised.-Cause-In this case, the change of Employee Responsible is also resulting in a change/update the Sales Unit. The system has a validation which checks if a Contract already exists before allowing such modification, and this causes the error.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Contract, Party, Parties, Employee Responsible, Sales Unit, Unable, Impossible, Error, Already Exists.

Title: Error Message: "Journal entry ABC: Original Entry Document Date missing"
Content: Symptom-While checking the Execution Details of a DATEV Export run the warning message "Journal entry ABC: Original Entry Document Date missing" is shown on the Results tab --(ABC means Journal Entry Voucher ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the DATEV Export sub-view.-Search for DATEV Run ID DEF (DEF means DATEV Run ID).-Go to Execution Details tab, select "all logs" and open Application log ID XYZ (XYZ means the Application Log ID).-Go to Results tab.-An error message will be raised on the screen:-"Journal entry ABC: Original Entry Document Date missing" -Cause-The posting date for all DATEV runs is not the same as the creation date. These documents are actually created after the DATEV run posting.--These dates can be checked following the steps below:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Select "All Journal Entry Vouchers", and search for Journal Entry Voucher ABC.-Open it, and go to "General Information" tab.-Here, Posting Date and Creation Date can be seen.-Resolution-While creating the Journal Entry Voucher ABC, the Document Date should me maintained.-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, DATEV, Export, run, Date, error, Journal entry: Original Entry Document Date missing

Title: How To Restrict User To Access Organization Chart On The Self-Services Screen
Content: Symptom-You want to prevent some users from accessing the Organization Chart in Home page.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select Self-Services Overview view.-Select Browse Organization Chart under Company Address Book.-Cause-The user has no restriction on accessing the Organization Chart.-Resolution-You can assign a Business Role that hide the links on the self-services screen for that user.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Roles view.-Edit Business Role / Create a new Business Role.-Select UI Switches tab.-Add Row.-Select Identifier Disable Browse Organization Chart.-Then you could Disable Browse Organization Chart Selection.-See Also-Help Document <Modify the Self-Services Overview>-Keywords-Organization Chart, Self-Services

Title: Fine Tuning Activity "Create New Country Version" cannot be closed
Content: Symptom-The 'Create New Country Version' activity is not intended to be used. You need to either close this activity for Go-Live or remove it from your project. However, closing the activity is not possible without completing Fine Tuning.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select First Implementation Project and Open Activity List.-Search the Activity Create New Country Version.-Select Close option under Change button.-The error message appears: Activity Create New Country Version cannot be closed, you must perform the activity first.-When you select Remove Project from Scope, error message appears: Activity Create New Country Version is mandatory and cannot be removed from Project.-Cause-The activity 'Create New Country Version' is flagged with the activity type 'Create' in the standard By Design system. Therefore, it can only be closed if fine-tuning has been completed. Additionally, the activity type is marked as mandatory, so it cannot be removed from the project.-Therefore, the observed error message is justified.-Resolution-The activity is linked to the scoping question 'Do you want to use the generic country version for Expense and Reimbursement Management?', once this scoping question is checked, Fine Tuning is mandatory for the activity. If you do not require a generic country version, you can deactivate this scoping question to remove the activity from the list.-Therefore, you must either deactivate the mentioned scoping question or maintain Fine Tuning for the corresponding activity.-To deactivate the scoping question, follow this path-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation Project view.-Select First Implementation project and Edit Project Scope.-Navigate till Questions step and select Travel and Expenses .-Open Expense and Reimbursement Management.-Select Expense Reporting.-Deselect question Do you want to use the generic country version for Expense and Reimbursement Management?-See Also-New Country, Version, Fine Tuning

Title: Unable To Update Supplier Remittance Email Address at Supplier Collaboration Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update supplier remittance Email Address at Supplier Collaboration using Mass Data Maintenance but while doing that you receive the error below or the data is not updated in the system:-"Specified data for SUPPLIER-COMMUNICATION_ARRANGEMENT with key SIF_CODE-CONTENT = 'XYZ' does not exist" (XYZ represents the ID or name of the Business Document Name)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is a standard system behavior. Currently, it's not possible to update Supplier Email Address at Supplier Collaboration using Mass Data Maintanance.-Resolution-To update the Email Address at Supplier Collaboration you can use the Migration of Supplies using the mode of Enhance already existing records.--Steps to do the Migration of Supplies:-Go to Business Configuration Overview.-Search for Migration of Suppliers.-Click on the Activity and then "Migrate suppliers using the migration tool".-After that you will open the Migration Tool and click on "You Can Also" > Download Migration Template.-After downloading the file, you need to open the file.-In the CSV file, the tab Collaboration will be as Hide, so click with the right button on the Tabs > Unhide > Choose Collaboration.-Go to the Tab Collaboration and Fill the fields with the required changes.-Then go to the Migration Tool and click on Upload > Data from Migration Template.-In Browse choose the Template that you filled and click on Upload.-Then click on the Properties Button and change the Migration Mode to Enhance already existing records.-Click on Execute Migration > Execute Migration Step by Step.-Then click on next, maybe you need to confirm the Value of Business Document Name.-Next and finish the steps of Execute Import and Confirmation.-Important:You can change records using the Migration > Enhance Mode ONLY if no collaboration data exist at all, then you will be able to add records via the enhancement migration. While migrating suppliers and using internal numbering, it is mandatory to first migrate the suppliers and in a second step (with enhancement mode) the collaboration data.

Title: Referenced Data Sources Tab is empty in Design Data Sources view
Content: Symptom--When you select a data source in Design Data Sources the "Referenced Data Sources" tab at bottom of the screen is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics.-Go to Design Data Sources.-Search for any data source e.g. G/L Account Items.-Click on tab Referenced Data Sources.-It will not show any reference data sources.-Cause-Development have disabled this feature due to performance issues. -Resolution-There is a workaround to see the reference data sources.-In Design Data Sources View.-Search for your data source.-Open the documentation.-In the documentation there are 2 columns "Master Data - Data Source" and "Master Data - Characteristic"-Both of these fields will show the referenced data sources.-We are discussing with development to either restore this feature to its original state or to remove it to avoid confusion.-Keywords-referenced data sources, empty, missing, design data sources, Master Data - Data Source, Master Data - Characteristic

Title: OData Report Has Wrong or Missing Data
Content: Symptom-You try to retrieve a report via an OData statement. The statement returns no data or wrong data (e.g. missing entries, too many entries etc).-When running the report via the web browser the report returns data as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-When you run an OData query for a report, the OData query will always consider the Initial selection of a report, not the default one. The Initial selection of your report may have more or less variables in the selection than the default one in the browser, so OData may show more or less entries.-For example: you may have defined a report selection, with a variable on Employee Responsible = My User Name. You have made this selection the default, so when you open it in the browser, this variable is considered by default.-However in the selection Initial, this variable is not maintained. Hence when you run an OData query for this report, the data will not be filtered by your user and the result will be different from the browser report.-Resolution-You can overwrite variables in the Initial selection by passing OData filters in the query (operator $filter). Note that it is not possible to remove the value of a variable - you will need to overwrite it by replacing it with another, specific value.-Alternatively, you would need to add missing filters to your OData query so that all variables are the same in the browser and the OData report.-If you would like to change the Initial selection in the browser report, you have the following options:-For standard reports, create a copy of the report via the Business Analytics work center and the Design Reports view. Any default values that you maintain in step 5 of the report wizard, will be part of the Initial selection.-For custom reports, edit your report with the report wizard and adjust the default values in step 5. The default values maintained here will be part of the Initial selection. -See Also-For further details on setting up your OData report query, you can also check the OData blog here.-Keywords-odata, report, wrong data, missing, odata not working, analytics-no results,odata not working

Title: Error : CANCEL_PAYMENT action is not possible, when trying to reverse the Bank Credit Advice
Content: Symptom-When you try to cancel the Bank Credit Advice XXX,('XXX' refers to Bank Credit Advice) you get the error message "CANCEL_PAYMENT action is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-2) Go to Payment Control sub-view.-3) Search for Document XXX and press Reverse. ('XXX' refers to Bank Credit Advice)-4) The error message "CANCEL_PAYMENT action is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-Action failed due to previous error in other instance."-Cause-You try to reverse a bank payment advice after documents involved in the respective clearing have already been reversed: --Example: -Customer Invoice XYZ is cancelled on 01/01/YYYY ('XYZ' refers to Customer Invoice ID).-The corresponding clearing ABC is cancelled on 01/01/9999 (ABC' refers to Clearing ID).-However, the associated due payment, payment allocation as well as bank payment advice XXX are in Completed/Posted/Released status.-You are trying to Reverse the Payment Advice on a later date, which is at 10/01/9999. -Resolution-The only way to cancel the bank payment advice in this situation is: Send an Incident to Support to request and grant permission to reverse the bank payment advice from the backend.-To prevent the situation:-A bank payment advice should be cancelled before cancelling the connected invoice and clearing. -Otherwise, the payment functionality identifies the clearing as Cancelled and therefore assumes that the respective payment has been already cancelled. -Keywords-Reversal of Bank Credit Advice, Payment Advice, CANCEL_PAYMENT, Clearing.

Title: Remark for Supplier Notes Missing in the Third-Party Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In the third-party sales order, you have added the note type Remark for Supplier however it is not transferred to the purchase order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center-Go to Sales Orders view -Select the relevant Sales Order-Select Edit and navigate to General tab-Here you can see that Remark for supplier is added-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and navigate to Notes tab-Notes Remark for Supplier is not visible -Cause-In the Business configuration work center under scoping questions, the question is not scoped. Do you want to copy notes & attachments from sales order header to purchase request header in third party processing? -If this business option is selected, notes & attachments from sales order header will be copied into purchase request header. On creation of purchase order from such purchase requests, notes & attachments would be copied from purchase request root to purchase order header. In this case, if the purchase order has items from multiple sales order, user would not know the sales order reference from which the notes & attachment was copied.-If this business option is not selected sales order header notes & attachments will be copied to purchase request item. Same is transferred to purchase order item during creation of purchase order from purchase request. This implies that sales order header notes & attachments will be present in each of the purchase order items leading to multiplication of attachments from sales order to purchase order.-Resolution-You can select the scoping question - Do you want to copy notes & attachments from sales order header to purchase request header in third party processing? and Finish the scoping. From then onwards, with the new third party sales order, system will copy the remarks for supplier information to the purchase order. -You can follow the below steps;-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects and select Edit Project scope-Select Scoping questions and select the scoping element Purchasing-Select Purchase Request and Order Management and Purchase Requests-Mark the scoping question and complete the scoping-Note:-This business option is relevant to control the flow of notes & attachments from sales order header to purchase request header. On creation of purchase order from purchase request, notes & attachments would be copied from purchase request header to purchase order header.-Keywords-Remark for Supplier Notes Missing in the Third-Party Purchase Order; Remark for Supplier Notes Missing; Remark for Supplier missing in Purchase Order-

Title: Org Unit ABC not Appearing as Bill-To Unit in Purchase order Document
Content: Symptom-You have an org unit which is marked as Bill-To unit, however org unit is not available while creating a purchase order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and order work center-Go to New Purchase order view-Enter the Supplier and enter the Buying company -Go to Bill-To field and enter the Org Unit ABC which is marked as Bill-To-Org Unit ABC is not appearing in the value help-Cause-In general, if supplier invoicing function is assigned to an org unit ABC, it must be visible as Bill-To. There could be an inconsistency in the relevant org unit and the assigned functions which needs to be refresh. -Resolution-You can follow the below steps to fix the problem; -Go to Organization Management work center -Go to Org structures view-Select the relevant Org Unit ABC and select Edit-Under the Functions tab, uncheck the Supplier Invoicing checkbox-Click on Activate -> Activate selected and dependent org units-Log off the system to refresh and login again-For the same org unit ABC enable the Supplier Invoicing function and click on Activate -> Activate selected and dependent org units-Then check the org unit ABC is available in Bill-To while creating new purchase order.-Keywords-Org Unit not Appearing as Bill-To Unit in Purchase order Document; Bill-To unit not appearing; Unit is not appearing for Bill-To in Purchase order

Title: Data source "Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details" (SRMPO_U01) is not displaying all purchase orders
Content: Symptom-Few purchase orders are not appearing-Environment--SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue---> Go to business analytics work center--> Go to design data sources--> Search for "SRMPO_U01" and preview it--> Click on value help (or enter value manually) for Purchase order ID-Cause--This data source is only relevant to Purchase Orders with Deliveries.( Purchase Order Items with delivery Tracking Details)-if you look at the documentation for the union data source.-You will see the involved data sources.-The PO's that are located in BRMPO_B08 (Purchase Order Items without Follow-Up Documents) will not be considered if their delivery status is 'not relevant' cause they will never have deliveries.- Union DS:-SRMPO_U01 Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details-Involved DS:-SRMPO_B04 Purchase Order Item with Goods and Service Receipts Item-SRMPO_B05 Purchase Order Item with Supplier Invoice Data-SRMPO_B06 Purchase Order with Confirmed Inbound Delivery Items-SRMPO_B07  Purchase Order with Outbound Delivery Items-SRMPO_B08 Purchase Order Items without Follow-Up Documents-Resolution--So only those PO's having delivery status  other than 'Not relevant' will appear in this report.- open the Purchase order- goto to items tab- go to basic data tab- where you can see delivery tab-Keywords-purchase orders are not appearing

Title: Mismatch between number of Time Entries awaiting approval under Project Time Approvals
Content: Symptom-You are a project manager and you can see there is a mismatch between number of time entries in Project Time Approvals filters.-Under Project Management -> Time Approvals -> All Time Recordings -> you can see time entries of X Employees.(X represents number of entries)-But, if you switch the Group By filter to “Project Tasks”, you can see multiple time entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Project Management-Select view Time Approvals-Select All Time Recordings-you can see time entries of X Employees.-But, if you switch the filter above the table to “Project Tasks”, you can see more time entries say X+1-Cause-By default, The Group By filter shows Team Member and it shows X entries.-Now change filter to Task and it shows X+1 entries.-This is because it has grouped the entries for each task and these added the extra rows.The actual tasks are same, only the rows showing the task name have added to the original entry list.-Resolution-You can change the filter layout as per your convenience.-Please refer this help document:  Approve Time Recordings.-Keywords-Project Time Approvals, All Time Recordings, Approve Time Recordings, mismatch in the number of approval tasks

Title: How to disable "Release Without Stock Check" in Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to disable  "Release Without Stock Check" in Customer Demand KLM.*KLM refers to Customer Demand Id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center -Go to Customer Demand View-Search for KLM -You see option Release Without Stock Check-You would like to know how to disable this option -Resolution-In order to disable "Release without check option" in Customer Demand, follow the below steps-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Navigate to Implementation project View and Select Edit Project Scope-In the Questions  step of the project, Select Supply Chain Planning and Control and expand the node-Select scoping element Demand Management and Order Confirmation and expand the node-Select  Product Availability Check Under  Group: Stock-Based Availability Check -De-select  the question "Do you want to perform a stock-based availability check while releasing Customer Demand-Select Next and Finish to save the changes.-Keywords- "Release Without Stock Check" in Customer Demand, how to disable  "Release Without Stock Check" in Customer Demand

Title: Project Task Displaying On The Manage My Worklist From Edit Time Sheet Before The Start Date Defined In The Work tab of Project Task
Content: Symptom-Project Task displaying on the Manage My Worklist from Edit Time Sheet before the Start Date defined in the Project Work tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Open the respective Project.-Click on the View All button.-Select the respective Project Task.-Go to the Work sub-tab.-Enter the Employee.-Select a Start/End Date.-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self Services Overview view.-Click on the Edit Time Sheet button.-Click on the Manage My Worklist button.-See that the Project Task displays on a date that is before the date selected on the Work tab of the Project Task .-Cause-When selecting a Start Date in the Work tab of the Project Task, it will be displayed in the Manage My Worklist screen with following colors for the Visibility column:-1. Green - Project task is valid on the selected date and it will appear in the time sheet worklist.-2. Yellow - Project task is not valid on the selected date and it will not appear in the time sheet worklist-3. Red - Project task will not be available in time sheet worklist-If the user has manually assigned the Project Task using the Show or Hide from the Actions button in Manage My Worklist screen, then it can be only removed or added manually by the same user with the respective actions.-Resolution-System behavior is correct.-See Also-2779229 - Hours Recorded in a Project Outside the Start/Finish Date of the Project-Help Document: Edit Time Sheet-Keywords-Project Task, Manage My Worklist, Project, Time Recording, Time Sheet, Project Time

Title: Invoice Scanning Is Not Picking Up The Purchase Order Information
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 3148602***-The Invoice Scanning is not picking up the Purchase Order information such as the Supplier and Product details.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Scanning view.-Search and select the respective ID.-Click on the Create Invoice button.- See that the information from the Purchase Order is not being picked.-Cause-The Scoping Question "Do you want to compare scanning invoice items with purchase order items?" has been selected.-This Scoping Question is relevant when the Product ID is available in the PDF file, then the system compares the items and if they are satisfied in the system, the Purchase Order information will be displayed in the New Invoice.-If the flag is not scoped, then when the Purchase Order is scanned from the PDF and upon creating the New Invoice, then entire information including the Supplier is determined from the Purchase Order.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, please de-select the "Do you want to compare scanning invoice items with purchase order items?" Scoping Question as per following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Click on the Next button until Step 4 Questions.-Expand Purchasing > Supplier Invoicing > Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos.-De-Select the Scoping Question "Do you want to compare scanning invoice items with purchase order items?".-Click on the Next button until Step 5 Review.-Click on the Finish button.-Once this is de-selected, then the Purchase Order details should be picked up with Supplier Invoice Scanned.-Keywords-Invoice Scanning, Supplier Invoice, Purchase Order; purchase order field blank while selecting create invoice button

Title: Goods Receipt Processing Time Not Considered In Stock Transfer Receipt
Content: Symptom-Goods Receipt Processing Time is not considered when the procurement type is Internal Procurement for a product in MRP.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Search for the relevant Product.-Select the required combination of product and planning area-Click Open.-Select the proposal created by the system.-Click Open Material Flow.-Notice that the Start Date and the Availability Date are not considering the Goods Receipt Processing Time that you set in product master data.-Cause-The Goods Receipt Processing Time is considered for External Procurement along with lead time from product master, or from the purchasing contract. -The Internal Procurement procurement type will not consider Goods Receipt Processing Time for calculating lead time.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-See Also- 2755840 - Goods Receipt Processing Time Not Considered for Product In-house Production-Keywords-MRP error, planning error for stock transfer, supply planning error for stock transfer order, goods receipt time error, stock transfer

Title: Outbound Delivery Created From Rejected 3PL Request
Content: Symptom-You are able to created outbound delivery from rejected third-party logistics requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Third-party Logistics requests view. -Search for the relevant 3PL request which is rejected, select it and choose the button New Outbound Delivery. -Once the relevant mandatory fields are updated, you can see that the outbound delivery against the rejected 3PL request can be created without any errors.-Cause-The system will allow you to create outbound delivery against a rejected 3PL request allowing business user the flexibility in logistics process. It could happen that the warehouse provider has already shipped the order before the rejection was updated to the provider. In such a scenario we will have to create the outbound delivery against the rejected 3PL request and then return the item against the created outbound delivery.-Resolution-The reported behavior is as designed.-Keywords-3PL outbound delivery error, rejected 3PL request, rejected request delivery

Title: Error: Determination of withholding tax code failed for country ABC tax event DEF to Withholding
Content: Symptom-System displays the Exception 'Determination of withholding tax code failed for country ABC tax event DEF ' (ABC represents the Country, DEF represents the Tax Event ID) in the Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memo view.-Search and open the respective Supplier Invoice.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Exceptions tab.-Cause-There is one of more custom Withholding Tax Codes duplicated from an Standard Tax Code.-The Business ByDesign system does not support duplicate tax codes.-Resolution-To resolve the issue of auto determination of the Withholding Tax Codes, kindly remove the duplicate z-tax codes from the system as per the following path:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click on Open Activity List button.-Search and select the Activity 'Withholding Tax'.( select  the one specific if exist for your tax country)-Click on the Open button.-Click on the 'Check withholding tax codes' link.-Select the respective Z Tax Codes.-Click on the Delete button.- Auto-determination will happen correctly once Withholding Tax Codes are consistent.-See Also- 2019198 - Error Message : Determination Of Withholding Tax Code Failed for Country India Tax Event Withholding.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Codes, Withholding Tax, Supplier Invoice

Title: Taxes Not Determined In Invoice Scanning
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers.
