Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 3080722***-The taxes are not determined in invoice scanning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for ABC and click on New Scanned Invoice button (ABC represents the Document ID).-System is not taking the Taxes for the Product ID.-Cause-System behavior.-Resolution-It is not possible to determine the tax code when using a free text item for scanned supplier invoices.-When creating a supplier invoice with a product ID, we would have certain information that would allow us to make a decision on what is the tax event and tax code for this scenario. In the case of free text, none of this information is present and as such, the system cannot determine the tax code.-That means that is need to enter manually or through a PDI.-Keywords-Scanned Invoice; Tax; Invoice Scanning; Taxes;

Title: Saved Successfully Message When Confirming Pick Task Via Web Service But no Confirmation is Created
Content: Symptom-You are using the web service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn to confirm the Pick Task XXX with Deviation Reason. The message Saved Successfully is returned, however no confirmation is created in UI. Instead, the quantities are going to In-Transit.-XXX = Pick Task ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Service Explorer view. -Find web service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn.-Click Download WSDL.-Use this WSDL in SOAP UI.-Execute the XML. -The message is returned: -Saved Successfully-Cause-For the quantities to be confirmed, you need to specify the quantity in the Material Output tag and the Deviation Reason needs to be in Material Input tag.-Resolution-The correct format to confirm the Pick Task task XXX is the following:- <SiteLogisticsTask>-  <SiteLogisticTaskID>XXX</SiteLogisticTaskID>-  <SiteLogisticTaskUUID>YYY</SiteLogisticTaskUUID>-  <ReferenceObject>-   <ReferenceObjectUUID>YYY</ReferenceObjectUUID>-   <OperationActivity>-    <OperationActivityUUID>YYY</OperationActivityUUID>-    <MaterialInput>-     <MaterialInputUUID>YYY</MaterialInputUUID>-     <ProductID>YYY</ProductID>-     <SourceLogisticsAreaID>YYY</SourceLogisticsAreaID>-     <LogisticsDeviationReasonCode>YYY</LogisticsDeviationReasonCode>-    </MaterialInput>-    <MaterialOutput>-     <MaterialOutputUUID>YYY</MaterialOutputUUID>-     <ProductID>YYY</ProductID>-     <ActualQuantity unitCode="YYY">YYY</ActualQuantity>-     <LogisticsDeviationReasonCode>YYY</LogisticsDeviationReasonCode>-    </MaterialOutput>-   </OperationActivity>-  </ReferenceObject>- </SiteLogisticsTask>-Keywords-WS; webservice; payload

Title: Supplier Invoice In Exception
Content: Symptom-An exception with the error message "Ship-To or Product missing" in credit memo/supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos.-Filter for All Documents.-Search for ABC, open it and click on View All button (ABC represents the Document ID).-Navigate to Exception tab.-The status is Exception and the error message is Ship-To or Product Recipient missing.-Cause-The Recipient needs to be a person and the Ship-To needs to be a company.-Resolution-When it is a company, it needs to maintain the Ship-To field and when it is a person, it needs to maintain the Recipient field. You can maintain either or both fields.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Credit Memo; Execption; Recipient; Ship-To;

Title: Wrong Price Calculation In Purchase Order/Invoice
Content: Symptom-Wrong price calculation in Purchase Order as well and in Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoice work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for ABC and check the Total Net Value (ABC represents the Document ID).-Click on New Invoice button.-The Total Gross Amount is the same as Total Net Value.-Sum of all items amount it is different than the Total Net Value.-Cause- System is using a rounding default.-Resolution-The system is calculating correctly, you can check the report.-To change the value, it needs to be changed manually for some item.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Purchase Order; Wrong Price; Total;

Title: Project Name is Not Displayed in the Response file on Executing QueryProjectIn web service
Content: Symptom-You have downloaded the standard web service WSDL for QueryProjectIn but on executing the request XML, the project name is not available in the response message.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select Input and Output Management view-Select Service Explorer option-Download the WSDL for QueryProjectIn web service.-Open SoapUI-Execute the Request XML file  -The Response message does not show project name.-Cause-In the project model, project itself is simultaneously considered as the root task. Name is modeled on the tasks, hence for the root task as well.-In this web service, project name is delivered but not within the fields corresponding to the project but in the task information.-Resolution-If you take the table ProjectTask and select a task with initial ParentTaskUUID (or with ProjectElementID which is equal to ProjectID) you will get the name of project as TaskName.-If you still want to modify the functionality, kindly post on influence forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-This is our official channel to address all new requirements.-Keywords-project name, QueryProjectIn, Inbound Service QueryProjectIn, web service, ProjectProcessing, project name missing

Title: Unable to Change The Maintained Value of The "Selection of" Field in an Outbound Delivery Run
Content: Symptom-You want to change the initially maintained value for the "Selection of" field in the Outbound Delivery Request run ABC (ABC represents the ID of the run) from "Pick-ups and Shipments" to "Shipments".-However, this is not possible as the system automatically switches it back to "Pickups and Shipments" after saving the changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work centre Outbound Logistics.-Select the View Automated Actions --> Outbound Delivery Requests.-Search for ABC.-Click Edit.-Change the already maintained value in the field "Selection of" from "Pick-ups and Shipments" to "Shipments" only.-Click on Save.-Click on Save and Close.-Refresh the page.-Select ABC and click on Edit. ->> You can see that the field "Selection of" is again showing the old value - "Pick-ups and Shipments".-Cause-When you want to change the initially maintained value of the field "Selection of" it is mandatory to maintain the respective data in the field "Planned shipment/pickup date in past and within next" too.-Please refer to the help document "Quick guide for release dues deliveries run" (section Tasks - Create a Release Due Deliveries Run - point 3.a) for more details. -You can find the URL to this document in the See Also section.-Resolution- Maintain the required data in the field "Planned Shipment/Pickup Date in Past and Within Next" as per the above instructions.-See Also- Help document: Quick guide for release dues deliveries run-Keywords-selection of, outbound delivery request, run, shipment, pick-ups

Title: Search Filter is Displaying Multiple Items instead of Specific Item
Content: Symptom-You are searching for a product with the product name or id in the basic search filter in List price view, but system displays multiple records instead of specific product.-However in advanced filter, it displays only specific record.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Select view List Prices-Filter with all list prices-Search with a product name or id-System displays the correct product along with multiple other records.-Cause-The Basic search works on approximate string matching which is also known as fuzzy string searching which is a technique that matches a pattern approximately rather than exactly. Therefore, the search will pull up all items that have any mention to the search term within their records.-The basic search field is not referring to any specific field like product id or supplier id etc, here you can enter any text and search. It will try to find the matching records.-But in advanced filter, the fields are specific, so when you enter specific product id in the relevant field, it will search only for that product.-Resolution--Please use the advanced filter to get the exact product because here the search criteria is based on specific fields.-See Also--2587216 - Filter for Basic Search in Resource Management Does Not Work As Expected-Keywords-basic search, advanced filter, list price search not working, search field is not working as expected

Title: Cancel Purchase Order button is greyed out in Purchase order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2874145***-The Purchase order cancellation cannot be completed since the "Cancel Purchase Order" button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Search for respective Purchase Order ID.-The "Cancel Purchase Order" button is grayed out.-Cause-The status of the purchase order indicates that a follow-up document has been created, signifying that the required documents have already been posted.-Resolution-To cancel the Released, Posted or Paid documents such as Goods Receipts, Inbound Deliveries, and Invoices, please ensure that the cancellation documents are all posted. Once this is completed, the status of the purchase order will automatically change to sent, and the "Cancel Purchase Order" button will be enabled.-Keywords-Cancellation button grayed out, Purchase Order

Title: System triggers time out error on the UI when trying to expand the node of Location
Content: Symptom-You are trying to expand the node Location KLM, system loads for a long time and Time out error appears after some time(System dumps).*KLM refers to Location id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Master Data Work Center-Navigate to Locations View-Search for KLM-Click the Node to expand and list out sub locations.-System loads for a lot of time and dumps after few minutes-Cause-The general recommendation is to not have more than 1000 LOAs under one parent Logistics Area.-Resolution-For example, under the Location (KLM), create  parent Logistics Areas (KLM-01 to KLM-05) and in each parent Logistics Area  create thousand main Logistics Areas.-This will not throw any problems and will resolve the current issue and will also help avoid any future performance issues.-Note:Creating more than 1000 LOAs(Logistics Areas) under one parent LOA might have  subsequent impact during task confirmation processes, although system allow to create more than 1000 Logistics Areas.-Keywords-System triggers time out error on the UI,  when trying to expand the node of Location, System dumps when trying to expand Location

Title: Product Category Not Determined In Scanned Invoices
Content: Symptom-The Product Category is not being determined in Invoice Scanning in case of free text item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Scanning view.-Select ID ABC (ABC represents the Scanning document ID).-Select Create Invoice button.-Select view all.-Go to Items tab.-The Product Category was not determined.-Cause-When using Scanned Invoice document, system will only recognize the Product Category if there is a Product ID maintained and, that will be picked from product master data.-If it is a free text item, then system will not recognize the product category ID because the free text item won't have any master data details in the system.-Resolution-This is a expected system behavior.--For free-text items, maintain the product category either by manually entering it in the Supplier Invoice document or by implementing an solution through a partner development.-Keywords-Scanned Invoice; Free text item; Supplier Invoices; Product Category

Title: Tax Code Not Determined In Scanned Invoices
Content: Symptom-The taxes are not being determined in Invoice Scanning in case of free text.-Environment-Sap Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Scanning view.-Select Scan ID ABC (ABC represents the Scan ID document).-Click on Create Invoice button.-See the Tax Code is in blank.-Cause-It is a system behavior.-It is not possible to determine Tax Code when using a free text item for Scanned Supplier Invoices.-Resolution-When using the Scanned Invoice document, system will only recognize the taxes if there is a Product ID maintained, if it is a case of free text, then system will not maintain the tax because it won't be able to recognize it.-As a workaround, you can enter it manually or through a PDI.-Keywords-Scanned Invoice; Free Text; Supplier Invoices; Tax Code;

Title: Error: "Change logistics area status not possible; logistics area not empty" When Trying to Set a Logistics Area to Obsolete
Content: Symptom-You want to change the status of a Logistics Area to obsolete, however this is not possible due to the error: - Change logistics area status not possible; logistics area not empty-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Work centre Supply Chain Design Master Data.-Select the Locations view.-Select the Site ABC (ABC represents the Site ID) and click on Edit Layout.-Expand the Logistics Area DEF (DEF represents the Logistics Area ID).-Select the child Logistics Area XX (XX is the ID of the child Logistics Area).-Click on the Change Status button --> Set to Obsolete. -Result: Change logistics area status not possible; logistics area not empty-Cause-The error text here is kind of misleading, as the obsolescence of the Logistics Area fails not due to the Logistics Area having inventory, but due to the fact that not all the underlying Logistics Areas are obsolete – the parent Logistics Area can be marked as obsolete only if all the underlying child Logistics Areas (that are Inventory-Managed) are obsolete.--Resolution-Firstly you will need to mark all the underlying Logistics Areas as obsolete, so that you can then set the parent Logistics Area as obsolete too.

Title: Error:Technical error CFM_MESSAGES 128 has occurred; create support request
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to confirm the make task, the system throws below error message:-Technical error CFM_MESSAGES 128 has occurred; create support request-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Workcenter.-Go to Task Control view.-Show All tasks by selection and find relevant Task ID.-Select and choose Confirm.-Under the Confirmation tab, go to the Output Products sub-tab.-Here enter Target Logistics Area ID manually.-The system throws error mentioned error message.-Cause-Since the user is entering Target Logistics Area manually which doesn't even available in value selection itself.-The system fetches the target logistics area automatically while confirming the make task via assigned Main Resource ID itself.-Resolution-Go to Production Control Workcenter.-Go to Task Control view.-Show All tasks by selection and find relevant Make Task ID.-Select and choose Confirm.-Under the Confirmation tab, go to the Output Products sub-tab.-Here system fetches the Target Logistics Area automatically via assigned Main Resource from Bill Of Operations Master Data.-There is no need to add Target Logistics Area manually while confirming it.-Keywords- CFM_MESSAGES 128, Technical error CFM_MESSAGES 128 has occurred; create support request, Target Logistics Area, Make Task, Production Control

Title: Error in Purchase Request : Only one supplier permitted
Content: Symptom-You are creating a purchase request and you get the following error:-Only one supplier permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders-Select Manual purchase request-Enter Buyer Responsible-Add Supplier-Select item that has list price and enter quantity.-Select check-Error: Only one supplier permitted and Only one contact person permitted-The error occurs when you enter the supplier before entering product details.-Cause-Error is only reproducible when adding supplier first, because the Product already has a supplier maintained & will be automatically determined.-(source of supply maintained e.g. a Contract or List Price or fixed source of supply)-So, when a supplier has already been entered manually, and the system attempts to determine the supplier from source of supply again on entering product details which has list price/contract etc, there is already an entry in the backend table and hence error occurs.-Resolution-If you remove the supplier, the document will become consistent again.-If you enter the product details and then enter supplier, then error will not occur.-Keywords-Only one supplier permitted, Only one contact person permitted, purchase request error, supplier error

Title: Product Specification ID Field Greyed out in Adaptation Mode of Purchase Order Screen
Content: Symptom-Product specification ID field is greyed out in the Adaptation Mode while creating new Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center. -Go to Common tasks view and select New Purchase Order. -Enter the necessary information (such as Supplier and Company). -Navigate to Items tab. -Open the Adaptation Mode. -You can see that the Product Specification ID field is greyed out and cannot be selected.-Cause-Product Specification field is only available for To-Stock item. For Non-Stock item it is not available.-The Product Specification field is dependent on other fields (especially SCM -Supply Chain related work).-You have to scope other work center (for example sell specified stocks) and then you will be able to add the field successfully in the Purchase Order (which is a SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) related field.-Sell Specified Products-The Sell Specified Products business topic allows you to sell products that are individually manufactured for a particular customer according to the customer’s specifications.-Relevance-The Sell Specified Products business topic is relevant if your company sells products specially made to the customer’s specifications.-Resolution-To scope the above question, please follow the steps below:-Go to Business configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the current project.-Click in Edit Project Scope button. -Click in Next button until you reach "Step 3 Scoping".-Expand Sales.-Expand Product and Service Portfolio for Sales. -Select Sell Specified Products.-Click in Next button until reach "Step 4 Questions". -Follow the same steps as in 7 and 8 and 9. -Scope the question: You will be able to sell products made to the customer's specifications. -Click in Finish button.

Title: Few Purchase Orders are missing in Purchase Order History Report
Content: Symptom-You are running "Purchase Order History" report, but you are unable to see few purchase orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select view Design Reports-Select report Purchase Order History-Run the report-Few purchase orders are missing in the report-Cause-The Purchase orders which are missing in this report are in "in preparation" or "canceled" status.-Resolution-You can use "Monitoring Purchase orders" report to view all purchase orders except canceled purchase orders.-See Also- 2935515 - Canceled purchase orders are not appearing in the Report: monitoring Purchase order,  view: Purchase  order tracking-Keywords-purchase orders missing in purchase order history report, purchase order history, in preparation purchase order

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2105 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2105 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 17th of July. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2105 HFC 3-Resolution-Cross – Area Topic-UI Client-The following issues have been fixed:-In the Launchpad view, if a text updated via Personalization mode contained a backslash, an application error was occurring.  -The Chart view was not showing the commas in the numerical values present in the graph, as shown in the Table Report view. (Hotfix ID: 4500012803)-In sales orders, even if the field Requested Date was set as mandatory, the sales order could be saved and released. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix: 4500012293)-In the SAP Business ByDesign mobile apps for Android and iOS, there were issues with the scroll bar and the time recording functionality. This has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500014071. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The following issues have been fixed:-Sales orders could not be released if the basis for recording sales was the shipping standard (automatic).-For a mandatory extension field KUT, if the value entered was 0, the system was showing an error that the mandatory field was missing. (Hotfix ID: 4500012975. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-In Business Analytics-> Design Reports, when the variables on Employee Responsible and Time Frame were removed and the report was run, the screen was partially cut-off. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500012038)-Service Control Center-In the Service Control Center, there was a possibility that the user licenses were calculated incorrectly. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500013823)-Analytics Language Adaptation Tool-Custom translations generated by the Language Adaptation tool were not covering selected menu items and associated work center views for some work centers. Also, an existing enhancement that was delivered to rectify this was causing errors in some systems. With this fix, the errors have been corrected and the translatability of all menu items via the Language Adaptation Tool has been ensured. (Hotfix: 4500013101. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Output Management-The fix provided includes corrections to the Preview functionality in customer invoicing. (Hotfix ID:4500000806)-Mobile Framework-With this fix, the Manager Approvals and Time Recording tile in the SAP Business ByDesign mobile app now loads faster when clicked. (Hotfix ID: 4500008875)-Account Management-An additional data source has now been added for Account Contact Data, to allow the display of emails marked as invalid, on the Business Communication section. (Hotfix ID: 4500009886)-On the Account list, the field 'Representative Name' used in Korea, in conjunction with tax numbers, can now be added to the result. (Hotfix ID: 4500014100)-  Customer Relationship Management-Customer Invoicing-The Outbound delivery item was not getting displayed for the invoice of third-party sales orders, in the data source CRMCIVIPATCB. This has been fixed now. (Hotfix ID: 4500013951)-Anew income type, 'Fish Purchase for Resale' has been added for 1099 Miscellaneous returns of US withholding taxes. All the tax line items corresponding to this type must be reported under Form Box 11. (Hotfix ID: 4500014130)-For India customer invoices, it should now be possible to release the invoices which are in legal approval status, 'Approval Not Necessary' and approval status 'Approved'. (Hotfix ID: 4500012585)-Default Query execution on Exchange Rate history will no longer happen automatically. This has been done to enable configuring of query parameters for less data volume. (Hotfix ID: 4500012964)-Sales Orders-Idempotency (retries producing the same result) was not working for sales order maintain bundle A2X web service. This has been fixed now. (Hotfix ID: 4500012202)-Tax Calculation-The issue with filling the Seller tax number for OSS tax events in customer invoice documents has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500013792. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The tax amount, tax rate, and tax net base amount of TaxCalculation.ITEM_WITHOLDING_TAX_DET and DueCategoryCode for TaxCalculation.ITEM_PRODUCT_TAX_DETAILS nodes, have now been PSM read-enabled. (Hotfix ID: 4500005463)-Pricing-For a sales order created as a follow-up of a contract, which contains a price agreement for a material, the price agreement will now not be considered in the price calculation of the sales order.  (Hotfix ID:4500014241)                                           -Analytics-In the Customer Invoice Volume report, the conversion to the reporting currency was not happening when the amount value was zero. This has been fixed now. (Hotfix ID: 4500012586)-  Financial Management-Accounting Lease Management-The Org Assignment Start date was not being determined correctly for the Migration template. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500013461. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Cost and Revenue-Through the fix provided, journal entries can now be filtered with an exclusion condition as well on the field Related Source Document type.  (Hotfix: 4500006318)- Travel and Expense Management-The last Expense report of an employee for Austria could not be deleted in some cases as it led to application errors. This has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009594)-Payment Management-The ISO 3166-1 Code list used for foreign payments in the IT CBI Foreign Payment format for Italy has now been updated. The data conversion for payment amounts has also been updated to include a comma in place of a dot. (Hotfix ID: 4500011507)-The fix provided includes corrections to the existing system behavior of ISO20022 payments, when the Clearing System Member ID is required for payments, and when PDI is used to customize the generic ISO20022. (Hotfix ID: 4500014171)-The issues found in the Payment Media run and Print Check form action have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500013204. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-For Switzerland, the payment file format CH ISO20022 was not correct and the tag <Ustrd> was missing. With this fix, the tags under <RmtInf> are corrected in the payment file. (Hotfix ID: 4500013892)-The fix provided contains corrections to the assignment of the SWIFT/BIC in the ISO20022 Payment file, for transactions with business partners with US Banks. (Hotfix ID: 4500012284. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Payment method determination is now possible through different combinations of the domain and proprietary tags in ISO 20022 file format of Bank Statement. (Hotfix ID: 4500002138)-With this fix, UI texts have been added to the data source GLOISJPU01 (Clearing Status Report for Japan). The columns which have the same names represent the same columns and can be added only once in the UI report. (Hotfix ID: 4500014230)-Tax Management and Declaration-The One Stop Shop (OSS) Tax Events 476 & 480 have now been added to the Business Configuration for Germany so that the corresponding OSS documents are included during German Monthly VAT Return Filing. (Hotfix: 4500010827)-In the Business Object 'Tax Declaration Profile', it was found that the Mini One Stop Shop (MOSS) return indicator was enabled for partners when it was not supposed to be. This has now been corrected. (Hotfix ID:4500014012)-The tax type 49, Agri. India. Dev. Cess has now been added to the Customs Duty tax codes to facilitate the posting of Customs duty documents. (Hotfix ID: 4500003576. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix provided includes validation checks for creating a company tax arrangement for the OSS relevant Tax returns. Along with this, the field OSS_RETURN_INDICATOR in Tax declaration Business Configuration Object has been PSM write-enabled. (Hotfix ID: 4500014032)-For Israel, the Withholding tax return (102, 856, and 857) clearing documents were being considered in a few cases, which was legally incorrect. With this fix, corrections have been done such that these clearing documents are never considered in the withholding tax returns. (Hotfix ID: 4500006698)-For SAP Business ByDesign for Switzerland, the Input tax correction scenario for the Mixed Usage Scenario acc. to Art. 30 VAT Act has now been enabled. Previously, for input tax corrections, for tax box 415, only the Self Supply Scenario was available. For certain cases, a mixed usage is also possible. In this specific case, acc. to Art. 66 lit. e-VAT Ordinance, a flat-rate method is allowed. The Input tax correction scenario works analogously to the already provided Input tax reduction scenario.-The following changes have been provided for this scenario:-A new tax event 8 (Input tax correction), tax code 58 that is mapped to the above tax event, tax rate type 6 (Input tax correction with tax rate value 0.07%), and tax reporting for the above tax event in the Periodic VAT Returns tax return in tax box 415T - for the new tax event in combination with all available tax rate types for Switzerland including Standard, Reduced, Special, Zero, Input tax reduction, and Input tax correction.-This will also enable the scenario for reporting when a custom tax code (beginning with Z*) is created, mapped to the above tax event, and any of the aforementioned tax rate types.-The output VAT tax return form reflects the values in tax box 415 for documents posted with this tax code. The output file of the VAT tax return reports the amounts in the relevant sections of the output file of the tax return. (Hotfix ID: 4500012102)-Cash and Liquidity Management-The fix provided resolves the repeated bank name issue in the Bank Directory sheet. (Hotfix ID: 4500012912. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Financial Accounting-The fix provided adapts the DATEV standard tax code mapping for OSS based on guidance. (Hotfix ID: 4500000805)-Inventory-GR/IR (goods receipt/ invoice receipt) run was resulting in application errors because, after Goods and Services Receipt posting to IMAT, goods return was posted which changes the status of IMAT but the cancellation of GR did not change the status back again. These errors have now been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 4500012714)-Coding Block-The fix provided ensures that in the default fund and function ID generation in a supplier invoice, if a newly created individual material is provided in the cost distribution, and the cost center details are also entered, the default fund and function ID gets generated based on the cost center value as Individual material is new. (Hotfix ID: 4500014290)-  Project Management-Project-Consumption messages from Project Stock Orders in the pre-delivery scenario were not reflected correctly in Logistics, as the Custodian Party was not provided. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500012592)-If you create a consumption in Project Stock order with a quantity unit that is different from the base UoM of the material, the error 'Material not available for consumption' might appear. This issue has now been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 4500013631)-Customer Project Invoice Requisition-Project time recordings maintained in minutes could lead to a quantity with more than 14 decimals. There was a possibility that the resulting rounding differences lead to an application error in the further process (invoicing or time recording cancellation). The fix provided ensures that this error does not occur. (Hotfix ID: 4500013434)-  Human Resources Management-Time and Labour Management-There was a high memory usage during the activation of Excel uploaded time entries in the system. The fix provided helps improve the performance during the activation process. (Hotfix ID: 4500011336)-Lifecycle analysis run ensures that all documents in the systems are connected to the right process chain. The fix provided helps improve the performance of the lifecycle analysis run. (Hotfix ID: 4500013482)-For Belgium, the Holiday calendar has now been updated. Currently, Christmas is set as a guaranteed holiday and when it falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the replacement holiday is the next working day. The replacement day rule that is set, is subject to change in the future. (Hotfix ID: 4500014440)-  Supply Chain Management-Customer Requirement-Customer Demand can now be queried with relative date combinations like selecting a date type. For example, using Confirmed Delivery Date, and the fields, 'Within last day(s)' or 'Within next day(s)'. This has been done to allow fetching of a list of customer demands with varied selection criteria. (Hotfix ID: 4500012412)-Outbound Logistics-For India, when multiple assessable values are maintained for a product over a period of time, the assessable value was appearing incorrectly in the outbound delivery form when the documents were posted with a past date. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500010489)-Inventory-In the Physical Inventory work center -> Consignment Stock Overview work center view, providing a numeric Fill-up site ID (such as 10200000) was not fetching any data. This has now been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 4500012593. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Inbound Delivery-The Inbound Delivery Notification creation through the standard web service for products with Product Specification was not working. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500011236)-Custodian Goods Return Notification work center was not visible when Spare Parts were not in scope. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500011047)-Service ManageCustomerReturnNotificationIn is now available in SAP Could Applications Studio. (Hotfix ID: 4500011679)-Production Task-The fix provided resolves Production Task system errors, that were occurring while checking if there are any residual negative quantities due to unit conversions. (Hotfix ID: 4500013425)-Production Order-The field names Material UUID and Material Text UUID of the Material master data source have now been changed to Material and Material Text respectively to resolve issues occurring on Excel-based reports. (Hotfix ID: 4500011766)-Goods and Activity Confirmation-In the Identified Stock Maintenance Run work center view, in case there are multiple products with expired Identified Stock IDs present at multiple sites, the run for these products was failing. This issue has now been fixed, with separate confirmation documents created for each site. The fix does not change the stock to restricted and this would function as usual. (Hotfix ID: 4500012669)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Purchase Requests-Purchase requests created from Project Purchase Requests are now split into two different items based on the currency from two different suppliers. Subsequently, two Purchase orders are created. (Hotfix ID: 4500011517)-Supplier Invoice-The fix provided ensures that, when a supplier invoice is created through a collaboration window, the buyer company validation is successful only if the scanned buyer company is valid. (Hotfix ID: 4500012413)-The fix provided resolves the issue of incorrect document numbering of supplier invoices created through Recurring invoices. (Hotfix ID: 4500012997)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g. operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2105; HFC03; Hotfix; SPS03; Hotfix Collection; 2105

Title: Supplier Is Not Displayed in Shopping Carts
Content: Symptom-The Supplier is not displayed in the Shopping Carts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Go Shopping Common Tasks.-Fill the fields with all information.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Filter for All Purchase Orders and open the Advanced Filter.-Search for Shopping Cart ID ABC and open the document (ABC represents the Shopping Cart ID)-Navigate to Document Flow tab, open the Shopping Cart ABC and click on View All button.-The Supplier is not displayed.-Cause-There is no catalogs maintained in the system, so the Shopping Cart has not been taken from any catalog.-Resolution-To show the Supplier in the Shopping Cart, you can use the Preferred Supplier field. If this field is not displayed for you, please follow the steps bellow:-Click on your user/picture.-Select Start Personalization Mode and OK.-Expand the Items.-Mark the checkbox for Preferred Supplier.-Save and Close the Personalization Mode.-Keywords-Supplier; Shopping Cart; Catalog; Preferred Supplier;

Title: System triggers error " Creation of resource utilisation not possible" when trying to execute webservices ManageProductionLotsIn
Content: Symptom-You are trying to execute webservices ManageProductionLotsIn with the help of Request XML ,you face below errors-Creation of resource utilisation not possible-Modification failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-SOAP UI-Cause-Error "Creation of resource utilisation not possible" appears if any of the UUID's (Production Lot UUID, Confirmation Group UUID, Activity UUID) passed wrongly.-One of the reasons for error "Modification failed" is when MaterialOutputUUID is not passed in the Request XML.-Resolution- Kindly check and pass the right UUID's (Production Lot UUID, Confirmation Group UUID, Activity UUID) in the Request XML.- Kindly pass the right Material Output UUID in the Request XML.-Keywords-Modification failed;Creation of resource utilisation not possible; Modification failed;</ProductionLotLog>

Title: The Created By Field Is Not Populated In the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Username is not populated in Created By field for Supplier Invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select Advanced Filter.-Select B2B Message in Entry Method field.-Select Go.-Choose any entry.-The Created By field is not populated.-Cause-When the Supplier Invoice entry method as B2B message, the Created By field will not be populated.-Resolution-This is a expected system behavior when the supplier invoice created through B2B method.-Keywords-Created By; Supplier Invoice; User; B2B

Title: System Does Not Consider Serial Number And Barcode Input Entered Manually
Content: Symptom-System does not consider serial number and barcode input entered manually while performing Post Goods Reciept-Environment-SAP Business ByDesing [All versions]-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Inbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Purchase Orders VieW-Search for Purchase Order ID & Select the row-Click on Post Goods Reciept-Navigate to Sub-tab Serial Numbers-Enter Serial Number-Click Enter-System does not save Serial Number-Navigate to Sub-tab Bar Code Input-Enter the Barcode value-System does not save Barcode as Input-Cause-The Barcode isn't scoped in Business Configuration in the tenant-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you need to scope bar code by selecting Automatic Identification option in the business configuration.-You can find this option in the scoping by navigating to Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics--> Task Management and Automation-->Automatic Identification. Select this element into your scope. Finish the selection and deploy the solution.-After that,user can try again to post the goods receipt.-Keywords-barcode; Automatic Identification; serial number; PGR; post goods receipt;

Title: System Throws Exception When Trying To Release Third-Party Delivery Notifications
Content: Symptom- System Throws Exception/Dump When Trying To Release Third-Party Delivery Notifications.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign [All versions]-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Third Party Order Fulfillment work center-2. Go to Third-Party Delivery Notifications view-3. Select Delivery Notification ID-4. Click on Release button-Cause-The issue is because the registered product is not scoped in Business Configuration in the tenant.-Resolution-User has to scope the registered products in Business Configuration with the steps provided below --1. Go to the Business Configuration work center-2. Go to the Implementation Projects view-3. Select the active project-4. Click on the Edit Project Scope button-5. Click on the button Next until you get to the session Scoping-6. Expand Service, then Entitlement Management-7. Mark the checkbox for Registered Products-8. Click on the button Next until you get to the session Confirmation-9. Click on the Finish button-Keywords-registered products; third party delivery notification; TP IDN;

Title: Conversion Between Order UOM And Planning UOM Cannot Be Batch Dependent
Content: Symptom-Conversion between Order UOM and Planning UOM cannot be batch dependent error message in customer demand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to Customer Demand view.-Search for the relevant customer demand, select a line item and choose Edit button.-Choose the line item which you need to release and from the Actions button select the option Check Availability. -The reported error message is displayed.-Cause-ATP shall not consider batches while giving confirmations and ATP uses planning UOM as the basis for its confirmation.-Since the ATP considers only stock independent of batch for availability confirmation, the unit of measure maintained in planning and the unit of measure used in sales order should not be batch dependent. -Resolution-System behavior is the result of incompatible setting maintained in product master data. This is not a bug in the system.-See Also-Blog explaining Batch Specific Conversions in SAP BusinessByDesign-Keywords-Conversion between planning UOM and Order UOM cannot be Batch dependent, Warning message appears "Conversion between planning UOM and Order UOM cannot be Batch dependent"

Title: Approval is not Triggered for Purchase Request or Purchase Order with Condition Product Category contains or does not contain
Content: Symptom-You have set the approval condition as product category contains A (A refers to product category) but you are still getting this message on purchase request or purchase order although the condition is matching.-"An approver could not be determined. Either approval is not relevant or the task is unassigned. Please contact your system administrator."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have set up an approval rule with condition Product Category[] contains A (A refers to product category)-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Requests (Manual)-The approval tab does not show any approver-Select view: Purchase Orders-The approval tab does not show any approver-Message: An approver could not be determined. Either approval is not relevant or the task is unassigned. Please contact your system administrator.-Cause-When you create the condition, as the approval rule condition context says “ contains” or “does not contain”, it means that the input field can contain any text with various patterns (wild card entry).-It is not a value help/drop-down from where you choose the exact name. It is just a text field where you can enter any text or matching patterns and system will compare the rules if the pattern or name matches.-Resolution-Kindly enter the text with * and it will work.-e.g. *A*.-See Also-2677788 - Cost center is Displayed in Approval  Process Conditions Even though Cost Center is Inactive-Keywords-Product Category[] contains, Product Category[] does not contain, product category, An approver could not be determined. Either approval is not relevant or the task is unassigned. Please contact your system administrator.

Title: Task description is missing for production task
Content: Symptom-The corresponding production model is using 'Reporting Point including Operations and Activities' for task generation method. However, task description is still missing for the production task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Production Models view.-Open production model ABC (ABC represents the production model ID).-Go to Bill of Operations tab, and navigate to BoO Details sub-tab.-You can see the Task Generation Method is maintained as 'Reporting Point including Operations and Activities'.-And navigate to BoO structure sub-tab, you can see description is maintained for the latest version of the production model ABC.-However, task description is still missing for the production task.-Cause-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Production Orders view.-Open production order DEF (DEF represents the production order ID) where the task is assigned, see the Released Execution Model is ABC Version: X (X represents the version of production model).-Click and open it, you can see there is no Element Description maintained in version X for Reporting Points.-That's why no description can be carried to production task with this production order.-Resolution-Only production tasks with production order created from the updated version of production model can have the maintained description.-See Also-2624611 - Description is Missing for a Production Task-2587336 - Task Description Missing for a Production Task-Keywords-Task description, Production task, Description missing, Released Execution Model, Production order, Task Generation Method, Reporting Point including Operations and Activities, Production model

Title: Incorrect task description of production task
Content: Symptom-You have maintained task generation method as Reporting Point including Operations and Activities.-However, you find one of the production tasks doesn't take the description you maintained in element type Reporting Point.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Show all and search task ABC (ABC represents the task ID).-You find the task description is not the one you maintained in element type Reporting Point.-Instead, system takes the description of Quality Check Activity from Bill of Operation structure in the corresponding production model.-Cause-This is a quality check task, this is independent of the task generation method. It is always created as the last operation in the Bill of Operations.-No further operation can be created after this operation and it always consists of only one activity.-Hence, system takes the description of its activity and maps it to the production task.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Task description, Production task, Quality check task, Task generation method, Bill of Operations, Production model, Reporting point, Reporting Point including Operations and Activities

Title: Wrong Identified Stock Proposed by The System When Posting Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-While posting a goods issue, the system automatically proposes the identified stock which has the earliest expiration date. For that purpose a Material Flow Rule is being created for the Source Determination at Logistics Area level with the FIFO strategy.-However, the system is proposing a different identified stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Outbound Logistics.-Select the Delivery Proposals view.-Search for the respective Reference ID. -Choose Post Goods Issue. -> The proposed identified stock is not the one with the earliest expiration date.-Cause-In the Location Layout, a Material Flow Rule is being maintained for Source Determination only at Logistics Area level with the FIFO strategy. However, when the system allocates the Identified Stock / Logistics Area, it does this at Site level.-Resolution-Maintain the FIFO Picking Strategy at Site level and not only for the Logistics Area.-See Also-KBA: 2528425 - System is not Working as per FIFO rule,Wrong Identified Stock Selected in Goods Issue Screen-Keywords-identified stock, earliest expiration, fifo, post goods issue

Title: Copy Function For Resource Master Does Not Work Correctly
Content: Symptom- Copy function for resource master does not work correctly-Environment-SAP Business Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the resources view.-Search and select the resource you want to copy and choose the Copy button. -Enter any random Resource ID and In the field Site change the site value to your choosing from existing one. -Choose the value help from Logistics Area field. -You can see the logistics areas displayed are from earlier site and not the one you selected right now.  -The user expects the logistics areas of newly entered site and not of the site removed while copying.-Cause-This is a UI issue which is planned to be fixed in a future release of Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The below work-around can be followed for resolving the issue.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the resources view.-Search and select the resource you want to copy and choose the Copy button.-Enter any random Resource ID and In the field Site change the site value to your choosing from existing one.-Save and close the UI-Open the resource again and you will be able to see the logistics area of the changed logistics area.

Title: How to delete an approval process
Content: Symptom-You cannot delete an approval process of a document because the delete button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Application user management work center- Go to Approval process view- Select the Approval process- You see that Delete button is disabled-Cause-This approval process may be showing created by SAP, but it was created because respective scoping question was scoped by  one of your users- Go to Business configuration work center- Go to Reports view- click on Configuration change history- Go to Questions- Here you will see as to who scoped it and also the path-Resolution-Please uncheck the respective business configuration question.- Go to business configuration - Go to  Implementation projects view- Select the project and click on edit Project scoping( if its not possible then  mostly a change project is required to make this change, so contact the respective person in your team who does such change projects.)- Go to question step and navigate  to the path you  got  wit steps under cause section- Click on uncheck the respective question and save-See Also-  1805255 - Unable to edit approval process cause edit Button is Greyed out -2656825 - Cannot Edit Approval Processes

Title: Error Message: To-stock process type not possible; supply planning data missing
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release purchase order ABC (ABC represents the purchase order ID) but the Order button greyed out, and system raising error message:-- Item X: To-stock process type not possible; supply planning data missing. (X represents the purchase order item ID)-OR-You are trying to release purchase order ABC via migration tool，you receive the error messages during simulation stage：-- Ordering purchase order not possible; supply planning data missing.-- Document not submitted for approval; inconsistencies exist.-- Order not possible; entries missing or inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request And Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view. -Find purchase order ABC and open it.-Click Check button, system raising error message:-Item X: To-stock process type not possible; supply planning data missing.-OR-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview view.-Search and Find and Open the activity Migration of Purchase Orders.-Upload the migration file.-Select the Execute Migration button and choose the Step by Step option.-You receive the error messages during simulation stage:-Ordering purchase order not possible; supply planning data missing.-Document not submitted for approval; inconsistencies exist.-Order not possible; entries missing or inconsistent.-Cause-The ship-to location which you have entered in the purchase order is not maintained under the Planning tab of the corresponding product master data.-Resolution-Please open the product master data, add a row under the Planning tab for the ship-to location and activate it.-Once this is done and saved, you can go back and check the purchase order.-You will no longer face the error and will be able to order it in the system or via migration tool.-See Also-2584478 - How to Solve Error :To-stock process type not possible; inventory data in product missing ; supply planning data missing ?-2631761 - Error Message: To-stock Process Type Not Possible; Inventory Data in Product Missing-Keywords-To-stock process type not possible; supply planning data missing, Ordering purchase order not possible; supply planning data missing, The To-Stock indicator is selected and there is no supply planning data for the selected product, Document not submitted for approval; inconsistencies exist, Order not possible; entries missing or inconsistent, Purchase order, Migration

Title: Negative Stock Not Permitted For Logistics Area Under Storage Location ABC
Content: Symptom-Error Message : Negative stock not permitted for logistics area under storage location ABC displayed when Negative Stock Allowed flag is selected. ABC represents sample Id of site.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to Locations view. -Search and select the location with id ABC, choose the Edit Layout button. -Select the relevant logistics area and choose the Negative Stock Allowed flag.-System displays the above reported error message.-Cause-Site ABC does not have the flag enabled. -If a logistics area should have negative stock enabled, then the site under which the storage location is located needs to be marked for enabling negative stock.-Resolution-Mark the Site ABC under which the logistics area is located to Negative Stock enabled.-Keywords-not able to mark negative stock for logistics area, negative stock error

Title: Error:The value XXXXX of the field tax code(1) is invalid
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload supplier invoice via excel/webservices  and you encounter following error: "The value XXXXX of the field withholding tax code(1) is invalid."- or-"The value XXXXX of the field tax code(1) is invalid."-Here XXXXX refers to custom tax code.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Open the supplier invoice excel- Log in to  ByDesign  add on- Enter the details with custom tax code- Select "save to" on the excel- Error encountered-Cause-For the field WithholdingTaxationCharacteristicsCode, in the standard excel template, max length is restricted to 4 char and hence user is getting error on trying to save.-You can check this in the following way:-1. Change the extension of template to .zip instead of .xlsx-2. Unzip it, you will get folder with same name-3. Open xmlmaps.xml file-4. Search for WithholdingTaxationCharacteristicsCode, you can see max length is 4.-Same is applicable for tax code as well .-also you would get same errors while uploading supplier invoice via webservices.-Resolution-We do not support PDI/custom withholding tax(nomal tax code) with the name being longer than 4 chars in the standard field.--You must change name of custom tax code to a 4 char (or) contact partner to create extension fields and make use of PDI to populate this value in the excel.-See Also-2190717 - Error Appears While Uploading Supplier Invoices via Microsoft Excel-Keywords-error with custom tax code, excel upload error, The value of the field withholding tax code is invalid, WithholdingTaxationCharacteristicsCode

Title: Extension Field values maintained while creation of Freight Document disappears
Content: Symptom-While trying to create a New Freight Document with reference to  Outbound Delivery KLM, Extension field values are maintained, After saving Freight Document we do not  see Extension Field values.*KLM refers to Outbound Delivery id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center -Navigate to Shipments View -Select New -Select a delivery ID KLM-Click Next-In 2.Edit Details, Maintain all the necessary fields and also the extension fields-Select Next and Finish.-A new Freight List is created, Extension field values goes missing.-Cause-Extension fields has the extension scenario "Outbound Delivery - General Information to Shipments - General Information". This means that they are sourced from the Outbound Delivery.Although in Outbound Delivery - General Information, Extension fields are seen it does not contain values for these fields. Extension field  values maintained in Freight document will not send and save the value to the original screen i.e Outbound Delivery-General Information.  Hence we cannot maintain the extension field  values and save in Freight List as the values are originating from Outbound Delivery.-Resolution-You will have to maintain extension field values in Outbound Delivery - General Information  before releasing Outbound Delivery, Once Outbound Delivery is released and after creation of freight document the extension field value flows from  Outbound Delivery - General Information to Shipments - General Information.This is the expected behavior.-Keywords-Extension Field values maintained while creation of Freight Document disappears, Extension Field values maintained while creation of Freight Document, Extension Field values maintained while creation of Freight Document

Title: System considers all input products while creating production order although only few input products  are ticked for Variant
Content: Symptom-You have created Production Order KLM for which in corresponding Bill of Material DEF you have selected(or ticked) few input products for Variant GHI, However you see Production Order KLM has all the input products which includes (ticked and non-ticked.)*KLM refers to Production Order id, *DEF refrers to Production BoM, *GHI refers to Variant id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Planning and Production Master Work Center- Go to Production BoM- Select BoM DEF and edit- Tick few input products for Variant GHI and Save -Cause-We could see in BoM DEF, User had ticked Required check box which indicates that "Assign a line item from each line item  group to each variant that you create , to ensure that you do not leave out any input products in your variant".-Resolution-Request you to Untick Required field in  BoM DEF save the changes in BoM, and the save and release the production model, this should consider only the ticked input products.-Keywords-System considers all input products while creating production order,  although only few input products  are ticked for Variant, Untick Required field in  BoM , Ticked Variants, Unticked variants

Title: Forecast goes missing for when Demand Management Procedure is being maintained as ADRF - All demand reduce forecast
Content: Symptom-Forecast goes missing for  Product/Planning area combination KLM/DEF when Demand Management Procedure is being maintained as ADRF - All demand reduce forecast, However when Demand Management procedure is changed to All Demand consumes Current Forecast, Forecast is being shown.*KLM/DEF refers to Product/planning area combination-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Supply Planning work center- Go to Products view- Search for Product ID KLM for planning area DEF-Click Open-Observed Forecasts are missing when  Demand Management Procedure is being maintained as ADRF - All demand reduce forecast, -Cause-Forecast goes missing for  when Demand Management Procedure is being maintained as ADRF - All demand reduce forecast, However when Demand Management procedure is changed to All Demand consumes Current Forecast, Forecast is being shown-Resolution-As User selected option ADRF - All demand reduce forecast in Demand Management Procedure for product KLM, that means it can consume all the nearby forecast irrespective of time period. Hence forecast is not visible because the forecast is already consumed by different orders (Stock Transfer Demands in this case).-With option "All Demand consumes Current Forecast" at material->Planning->Demand Management Procedure: System checks if complete forecast is consumed within that period only or not. If not, remaining forecast is displayed. This is expected behavior-Keywords-Forecast goes missing for when Demand Management Procedure,  is being maintained as ADRF - All demand reduce forecast, Forecast goes missing

Title: How to choose other Ship To address maintained in Account master data in Sales order
Content: Symptom-In Account master data you can only maintain one ship to address as standard and thus when you create sales order with this account the standard address will appear as ship to by default, however you may want to manually change the address to other address that are not marked as standard in account master.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales order work center-Click on new sales order-Click on view all-Under General tab you can see  the Ship  to address-click on drop down of field Name, but  you don't see  those address here-Resolution-Go to Sales order work center-Click on new sales order-Click on view all-Under General tab you can see  the Ship  to address-Under that you will see Address details,click on it -You get a drop down in field Address where you can choose various address maintained in master data-Keywords-change Ship To, change Ship-to

Title: G/L account missing in the account assignment tab of Supplier invoice or Goods and service receipt
Content: Symptom-You expect GL account to be passed on from Purchase order to Goods and service receipt(GSR) and then from GSR to Supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Purchase requests and orders workcenter-2. Purchase orders-3. Select the Purchase order-4. Navigate to the items tab and further to the account assignment tab-5. Here you will see G/L account appearing-6. Go to document flow tab and open the follow up documents- Where G/L account in the GSR or the Supplier invoice of this purchase order is empty-Cause-Currently for supplier invoice the base document is Purchase Order and  the Account account information flows from purchase order to GSR.-However if GSR was not manually created but via time confirmation then currently we have a technical limitation to send GL account from PO to GSR in case the GSR is created automatically from a time confirmation.-Resolution-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-however this can be achieved by Partner add-ons ,who can read the info from Purchase order when the GSR is created from time recording to populate G/L accounts in GSR and invoice.-1.If you are a partner: you can help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2.If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.  -Or      -a. Contact your the Account Executive-b. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us -3. An alternative option may be to check the Customer Influence Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-See Also- 2536409 - Account Assignment Details not Appearing in Supplier Invoice -3221176 - Account Assignment Data Missing Exception For Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Account; Supplier Invoice; Exception; Data Missing;GL account; Account assignment missing;cost distribution details missing

Title: Material Description Missing In The Custom Report
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report using datasource: SCMPOHDROPU01 however material description is missing in a report.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view and find a Custom Report created using data source: SCMPOHDROPU01.-Select and open using a web browser.-Enter required Material ID and choose Apply.-Here you can see the Material Description column is Blank.-Cause-Since Product ID contains an alphanumeric conversion issues. It occurs only for other languages except for English.-Resolution-Create a new report using data source SCMPOHDROPU01 and use the field Material_UUID in the new report instead of material ID.-Keywords-SCMPOHDROPU01, Material_UUID, alphanumeric, Material ID, Material Description

Title: Account ID Missing in Registered Product
Content: Symptom-You have the Registered Product XXX which was used in a Service Order and you check the Account ID, it is missing.-XXX = Registered Product ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements work center. -Select Registered Products view. -Find Registered Product XXX. -Notice that the Account ID is missing. -Cause-In the service scenario, the Account is not attached for Register Product after Outbound Delivery is released. Because the Outbound Delivery does not update the account name on the Registered Product in a Service Order scenario, only in a Sales Order scenario.-This account assignment to the Registered Product is not currently supported for the Service Order scenario.-Resolution-As this is not supported in service scenario, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-serial, number, accounting

Title: Error " Service Call Failed" appears in Simulation Step while migrating Location and Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Location and Logistics Area, you face error in Simulation step.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Navigate to Overview-Choose Migration of Location and Logistics-Execute step by step-Cause-As there are only few storage groups maintained in system and the migration template can only be used to migration location and logistics area (and not storage groups).-Resolution-It is necessary to manually create the storage groups in the system and then migrate file.Once the storage groups are in the system, and the same value is maintained in the migration file, it should go through.-Note:In migration file, we cannot have different storage group for each logistics area.-Keywords-Error " Service Call Failed" appears,  while migrating Location and Logistics Area, Error " Service Call Failed" appears in Simulation Step

Title: Business Document Difference Entry Not Removed
Content: Symptom-Business Document Difference entry not removed even after peforming Start Repeat Check and Start Document synchronization for the business document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Data Consistency view.-Select Business Document Differences subview.-Select All Differences via drop-down and via the advanced filter-Select Business Document One: Logistics Execution Request and Business Document Two: Outbound Delivery Request-Choose Go.-Here you can see the results of all documents with differences.-Select the line with differences having error: ODR item party of type Freight Forwarder Party does not exist-Click the button Start Document Synchronization, the difference still exists.-Cause-The system raised this error as Freight Forwarder Party details are not maintained. User must maintain the freight forwarder party details in relevant document.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Data Consistency view.-Select Data Flow Verification Results subview.-Select All Differences via drop-down and via the advanced filter-Select Business Document One: Logistics Execution Request and Business Document Two: Outbound Delivery Request-Choose Go.-Here you can see the results of all documents with differences.-Select the line with differences having error: ODR item party of type Freight Forwarder Party does not exist-Click button Start Repeat Check, error does not exist anymore.-Now check the relevant Outbound Delivery Request ID if Freight Forwarder Party is maintained.-Once the document is verified however entry still exists.-Select and Choose Change status to Closed.-Keywords-ODR item party of type Freight Forwarder Party does not exist, Logistics Execution Request, Outbound Delivery Request,Start Repeat Check,Change status to Closed,Freight Forwarder Party

Title: Warranty Not Updated To Registered Product Automatically While Inbound
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the Warranty details under the Sales tab of Reference Product ID's: ABC master data  (i.e. ABC refers to a Product ID). However, it doesn't update to a Registered Product:XYZ (i.e. XYZ refers to a registered product ID) in the system automatically when Inbound Delivery Notification and Inbound Delivery gets generated.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to Registered Products view.-Show All Registered Products via drop-down and find ID:XYZ (i.e. XYZ refers to a registered product ID)-Edit and under section: Warranty Assignment-You find that system has not updated the Warranty Details as per Reference Product ID: ABC-Cause-Inbound Delivery Notification and Inbound Delivery creation doesn't assign a warranty from the reference product's warranty data automatically. User can assign a warranty manually for the relevant Registered Product.-Resolution-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to Registered Products view.-Show All Registered Products via drop-down and find ID:XYZ (i.e. XYZ refers to a registered product ID)-Edit and under section: Warranty Assignment-Update Warranty Assignment details manually for registered product ID:XYZ (i.e. XYZ refers to a registered product ID)-      This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Registered Product, Warranty, Reference Product Warranty, Start Date, end date, Reference product, Warranty Assignment

Title: standard  data source:Purchase Request Item Details (SRMPR_02) is not showing all  Purchase orders of a purchase request
Content: Symptom-In the Purchase Request Tracking report, not all Purchase Order IDs associated with a Purchase Request Item are visible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business analytics work center.-Go to Data sources view.-Search and open 'Purchase Request Item Details'.-Enter the respective purchase request id.-For example, if there are two Purchase orders on the same PR line item, then this data source is not showing both Purchase orders.-However, if one Purchase Order exists against Purchase Request line item 1 and another Purchase Order exists against purchase request item 2, then this data source will show both Purchase orders.-Cause-The system currently has a technical limitation that prevents the display of both Purchase Orders using the Purchase Request ID.-Resolution-So kindly join Purchase Order Item Details (SRMPO_02) with other data sources using the PR ID and Item ID.-Keywords-Purchase Orders not visible, Purchase Request, Tracking Report

Title: You can still add rows on finished stock transfer order
Content: Symptom-A finished Stock Transfer Order still allows adding new line items and creating new Outbound Deliveries for those items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to Customer Demand view.-Search for Stock Transfer Order ABC (ABC represents the Stock Transfer Order ID).-Choose Edit.-Choose Add Rows.-Enter relevant fields Product ID, Quantity, Requested Date.-Choose Save.-System allows adding a new line item to a Finished Stock Transfer Order and creating an Outbound Delivery for the newly added item.-Cause-As Stock Transfer Orders are internal documents, the system allows new line items to be added even after the Stock Transfer Order reaches the Finished status, providing flexibility to continue processing without creating a new order.-This behavior differs from Sales Orders and Purchase Orders, which are external-facing documents. Once those documents are finished, adding new line items is not supported.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order; Finished; Canceled; Add Row; Outbound Delivery; Sales Order; Purchase Order; Internal Documents; Customer Demand; New Line Items

Title: Difference Of Planned Quantity For The Same Material in Different Production Orders
Content: Symptom-Difference of Planned Quantity for the same material in 2 different Production Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view.-Filter for All Production Orders.-Search for ABC and DEF, open it and click on View All button (ABC and DEF represents the Production Orders IDs).-Navigate to Products tab.-Navigate to Input Products.-Choose the same line item for both Production Orders.-The Planned Quantity for the same item is different in both Production Orders.-Cause-It is a system behavior.-Resolution-As the input can depends on other inputs, which rely on other inputs, the system, at some point, can round out the broken amounts.-For example: If the broken value is 1081,08, at some point, the system can round, so, in one production order it can round down (1080,00) and for other production order, the system can round up (1082,00).-Also, it is possible to change the display decimals for all units that are being used:-Go to the Business Configuration.-Search for Quantities and Units of Measure.-Change the decimals.-The more decimals being used, the more difficult it will be for different rounding to happen.-Keywords-Decimals; Planned Quantity; Input; Material; Round; Quantity; Production Order; Item;

Title: Not Able To Change The Ship-To Or The  Delivery Address For Purchase Order When Kits Are Involved
Content: Symptom-The Delivery Address for a Purchase Order is grayed out for kits materials.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Filter for All Purchase Orders.-Search for ABC, open it (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID) and click on View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select any line which is not the header.-The Ship-To and Delivery Address are grayed out.-Cause- It is a system default.-Resolution-When it is a kit material, just the header will be able to change the Ship-To or the Delivery Address in the Purchase Order and changing the header will also change for other items.-If a material from kit needs to have a different Ship-To or Delivery Address, it will be necessary to create a new individual material in the system.-Keywords-Kit; Kits; Materials; Ship-To; Delivery Address; Purchase Order;

Title: Error "Negative inventory for consignment stock of XXX not allowed"  appear when trying to perform adjustment confirmation of Consignment stock
Content: Symptom-While performing adjustment confirmation of Consignment stock with negative quantity for Product KLM, Error appears *KLM refers to Product id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Physical Inventory Work Center-In common tasks, navigate to New Consignment Stock Adjustment-Fill in all the required fields like Fill-up Site id, Custodian id, Product etc-Maintain negative quantity for product KLM-Error appears "Negative inventory for consignment stock of KLM not allowed"-Cause-While performing adjustment confirmation of consignment stock, system does not allow negative quantities, Hence the error is triggered.-Resolution-System does not allow negative quantities while performing adjustment confirmation of consignment stock although Site, Location and Logistics Area has Negative Stock Allowed indicator ticked.-Keywords-Negative inventory for consignment stock of XXX not allowed, adjustment confirmation,Consignment stock,negative quantity

Title: Wrong Sequential Order in Print Queue for Tasks
Content: Symptom-You create Production Tasks, however when you go to Print Queue XXX, they are not in sequential order.-XXX = Print Queue-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Managament work center.-Go to Print Queue view.-Search for queue XXX.-Edit the Print Queue.-Go to Queue Documents.-Cause-The Production Task ID is proposed by system randomly during run time.-In this case when it is sent to the print queue it sends all the data together, ordering of the tasks depends on the submitted time which could have a different time (some second difference). This submitted time would be the result of it's size and the load during the process which is a system behaviour.-Resolution-As it depends in submitted time, the system is working expected.-Keywords-task, production, print

Title: Extension Field is in Blank When Posting Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You have an Extension Field in Purchase Order and you have extended it to Post Goods Receipt screen, however it has no value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Select Purchase Orders view. -Find the Purchase Order. -Select Post Goods Receipt. -Notice that the Extension Field does not have value. -Cause-Fields that contain calculated values cannot be extended to other documents, therefore the field from the Purchase Order cannot be extended to the Goods Receipt Posting.-See Also-2635211 - Extension Field Not Allowing Further Usage with Error Message-Keywords-extension, inbound, PO

Title: Incorrect Inventory Days of Supply as 9999 Days
Content: Symptom- In Product Planning XXX/YYY, you have the Inventory Days of Supply as 9999 Days and you would like to know it is being calculated.-XXX = Product ID-YYY = Planning Area-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center. -Select Products view. -Select for Product Planning XXX/YYY.-Click Open.-Notice that the Inventory Days of Supply is 9999 Days. -Cause-The Inventory Days of Supply in Product Planning is basically the number of days which the sum of all your demand is covered by current material available in stock. The purpose of this field is to generate exceptions if it goes below minimum set in Product master data (Minimum Days of Supply field in Planning tab). If you have not set the Minimum Days of Supply in material master data, then the “Inventory Days of Supply” is just an indicator.-As an example, if you have 0 demand and 0 available stock, then your “Inventory Days of Supply” will be the maximum 9999 days. Or if you have the Available Stock covering the Total Demand, it will be 9999 days as well.-Resolution-As the Inventory Days of Supply considers the sum of demand and available stock, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-MRP, stock, planning

Title: Fulfilled Quantity in Production Order And Production Confirmations Does Not Align
