The new Outbound Delivery will only post taxes for the unit that you are actually going to receive at the receiving site and therefore keep the system compliant in reference to the Inventory and Taxes.-See Also-2926736 - Error appears "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario" when trying to create Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery with partial quantity.-2925668 - Error appears "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario" when trying to confirm put away task for partial quantity.-Keywords-Over Delivery, Under Delivery, Partial Confirmation, India, Stock Transfer Order, 2005 Upgrade

Title: Cannot Find Shipping Date in The WDSL of ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn Webservice.
Content: Symptom- Cannot Find Shipping Date field in The WDSL of ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn Webservice.-Environment- SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer view.-Search and select the webservice ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn.-Click on the Documentation link.- See that the Shipping Date field is not displayed.-Cause- The field is not available for usage via webservice.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. Shipping Date field is not supported via webservice.-Keywords-Shipping Date, Webservice, ManageThirdPartyOrderDeliveryNotificationIn

Title: 500 Error When Opening The Material Flow For a Product
Content: Symptom-When you are opening the Material Flow for a specific product, system crashes with 500 Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Filter for All Products with Exceptions By Selection.-Search for ABC and click on Open button (ABC represents the Product ID).-Select the line and click on Open Material Flow button.-System crashes with 500 Error.-Cause-This issue occurs when the main product has many input products, which can have more intern products model and so on. This can occur when there are more than 10-12 levels.-Resolution-Our recommendation to view the Material Flow is to check all input products individually.-Keywords-500 Error; Dump; Crash; Material Flow; open material flow; Supply Planning; internal server error

Title: "Purchase order ID ABC sent to supplier DEF" - Purchase Order Message Sent To Supplier Even When The Output History Is Sent To Printer
Content: Symptom-When ordering the Purchase Order, you note discrepancies between the system message and the output history for the same supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Filter for Purchase Orders in Preparation.-Select a Purchase Order ABC, open it and click on View All button (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID).-Click on Order button.-System shows: Purchase order ID ABC sent to supplier DEF (DEF represents the Supplier ID).-Open the Purchase Order and go to Output History and check is Sent By Printer.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. When is allowed for multiple Outputs and not specified, system will shows "Purchase Order sent to Supplier". When is used just 1 Output, then the system shows the message for the exact one.-Resolution-If you want to avoid sending the Purchase Order to multiple channels, you can make sure that the following steps are taken:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and click on Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 (Questions). -Select the Communication and Information Exchange -> Business Process Management -> Process-Integrated Input and Output Management.-Make sure that the question "Do you want to send the process-integrated output documents via multiple output channels?" is not marked in scope.-Finish the Edit Project Scope.-See Also-KBA: 2571549 - Purchase Order Output Email is Not Sent to Supplier-Keywords-Purchase Order; Output History; Sent to Supplier; Sent to Printer;

Title: System Dumps When Trying to do an Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform an Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order XYZ (XYZ refers to the Document ID of the Warehouse Order) due to a system dump. You may also see that the button Split Quantities is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the By Warehouse Order view.-Search and open the Warehouse Order XYZ.-Click on the Adjustment Confirmation button.-In the Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order screen, select the relevant Line Item for operation type Unload.-Click on the Enable Entry button.-Update the Quantity Difference of the Unload Task, for example, if the quantity is currently A, the Quantity Difference should be -A.-At this point, you may notice that the button Split Quantities is grayed out.-Click in the Save button. -System crashes.-Cause-This is a designed behavior in the system that prevents the data from being split for the Unload Task when deviation has been maintained.-Resolution-You can do the following workaround to avoid this issue: Perform a Goods Movement from the same Logistic Area of the Put-Away Task to the Logistics Area of the Unload task, and then perform the Adjustment without a Split in Quantities on the Unload Task.-Keywords-Dump, Warehouse Order, Unload, Split Quantities, system crash

Title: Self-Approval Occurring for Purchase Order However it is Not Scoped
Content: Symptom-Self-approval occurring for Purchase Order XXX and User YYY when it should not because it is not scoped.-XXX = Purchase Order ID-YYY = User ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view. -Find Purchase Order XXX.-Open Purchase Order XXX.-Click View All.-Go to Approval tab. -Notice that there is a task for user YYY, which is the buyer responsible. --Cause-In Approval Process, you are using direct approver. In this case the filtering does not work because Business Task Management directly assigns the task to user without providing exit to application.-Resolution-As the direct approver is being used, the system is working as expected in this case.

Title: No Production Request Matches Production Requisition
Content: Symptom-You have created a Production Proposal and released same. However, the system does not create a Production Request. And when you check in Business Document with Differences, the system is reporting: "No production request matches production requisition " for the Production Proposal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Document Differences view.-Find and select the row with the Business Document One ID which is the relevant Production Proposal.-You can see the error description: No production request matches production requisition XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the relevant Production Proposal).-If you open the relevant Product Planning Details in Supply Planning work center, you can see the Production Request XYZ has the status Requested.-If you open the Production Request XYZ, and go to the Document flow tab, you can see the Production Request Planning Details XYZ, but there's no Production Request.-If you go to the Production Requests view of the Production Control work center, you also cannot find the Production Request listed.-Also, if you perform a Start Repeat Check and Start document synchronisation, the issue remains unresolved.-Cause-The Input Product of the affected Production Proposal is different from the Input Product in the relevant Released Planning Model (RPM).-You have replaced the Input Product in the Production Proposal with another Input Product without deleting the row of the Input Products to be replaced first, and creating a new row with the new Input Product. This has lead to the Release message failing in the back-end.-Resolution-The correct way to change the Input Product of a Production Proposal is to delete the row of the existing Input Product first, and create a new row with the new required Input Products.-Create a new Production Proposal.-Go to Supply Control work center.-Go to the Process Production Proposals view.-Find and select the relevant Production Proposal.-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to Products tab, and then to the Input Product sub-tab.-Delete the row of the existing relevant Input Product.-Add a new row and enter the new Input Product according to your requirement.-Save.-Keywords-Open differences in BO pair ProductionRequisition ProductionRequest

Title: System Dumps When Trying to Release a Third-Party Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release the Third-Pary Delivery Notification XYZ (XYZ refers to the Document ID of the Third-Party Delivery Notification), but the system shows a dump message before releasing the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Pary Order Fulfillment work center.-Go to the Third-Party Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Third-Party Delivery Notification XYZ.-Select the line of the Third-Party Delivery Notification XYZ.-Click on the Release button.-System shows a dump message.-Cause-This issue happens because the Registered Products are not scoped in the system.-Resolution- To solve this issue, you need to scope Registered Products in the Business Configuration.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the active project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Click on the button Next until you get to the session Scoping.-Expand Service, then Entitlement Management.-Mark the checkbox for Registered Products. -Click on the button Next until you get to the session Confirmation.-Click on the Finish button.-Then you will be able to release the Third-Party Delivery Notification.-Keywords-Dump, Third-Party, release, Delivery Notification, order, crash

Title: Return items are not showing up in new Credit Memo for Return to be Invoiced
Content: Symptom-When trying to invoice a return document under invoice entry, the return status shows invoiced and on selecting "New Credit Memo", system does not propose any item.-OR-System does not propose all items available in the return document for invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select invoice entry view.-Select All Returns to Be Invoiced.-Enter the Outbound Delivery document created for the return.-The status shows invoiced instead of "Not Invoiced".-Now select "New Credit Memo".-No items are proposed by the system.-Or only few items are proposed for invoicing.-Cause-The Supplier Invoice is generated after the Return to Supplier (RTS) and Outbound Delivery are created. Consequently, the RTS is created without any invoiced items, making it impossible to claim any credit. The quantity in the Invoice is calculated by subtracting the return quantity from the Inbound Delivery. However, the cost distribution links both the Inbound and Outbound Deliveries. As a result, when attempting to create a Credit Memo, the system does not propose any items, and the status remains invoiced instead of not invoiced.-Resolution-You can create Credit Memo to the Purchase Order and enter the items manually. Alternatively you can cancel the follow-up documents and create the documents in order:-Purchase Order -> Delivery document -> Supplier Invoice -> Return to Supplier -> Outbound delivery -> Credit Memo.-See Also-3008983 - You are Unable to Find the Return to Supplier Document under Invoice Entry screen-2834640 - Return to Supplier Document not Available for Credit Memo Creation in Supplier Invoice Entry View-Keywords-Return items are not showing up in new Credit Memo for return to be invoiced, return to be invoiced, no items in new credit memo, unable to invoice return to supplier, return items not available for creating credit memo, return status invoiced

Title: You are Getting Error on Supplier Invoice: "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval"
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post supplier invoice for purchase orders which are open for invoicing due to error:"Posting not possible; referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval", although there are no purchase orders in approval status.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoice Entry view-Select Orders to be Invoiced-Create new invoice-Error: "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval".-OR, when an invoice is already created but the invoice is having the exception : Posting not possible; referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for the Invoice ABC -In exceptions tab , error is "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval"-Cause-This error may occur due to lock issue. A business task gets created for that purchase order: "Solve Lock Issue in Order Supplier Invoice Request to Process Invoicing Due Notification Sent by Purchase Order".-If the user related to that purchase document (e.g. creator/buyer responsible etc) are locked, such errors can occur.-Resolution-Kindly unlock the users and then try to create the invoice.-To avoid such issues in future, please do not lock the relevant users until the purchase process is completed.-Keywords-Referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval, Solve Lock Issue in Order Supplier Invoice Request to Process Invoicing Due Notification Sent by Purchase Order, user locked, business document locked, Posting not possible; referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval

Title: You are Unable to Import Supplier Catalog
Content: Symptom-You are trying to import a catalog under Product Portfolio work center but the import shows failed status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Select view Catalogs-Import status is failed-Cause-Data is not correctly entered in the import file/excel e.g. the product id does not belong to the product category added or product id does not exist in the system, or the product description is incorrect or product details have not been filled or date format is incorrect.-Resolution-Kindly check all the fields and enter the correct data so that system can identify and the file can be imported successfully.-See Also-2500299 - Publish Button does not Trigger any action on Custom Catalog-2119066 - Editing Not Possible; Catalog Already In Use - Error Message Received While Editing A Supplier Catalog.-2246473 - Catalog Gets Stuck In Process When User Tries To Import It To The System.-Keywords-supplier catalog import failed, catalog import, product portfolio

Title: Revise Purchase Order Notification is Triggered for Multiple Users
Content: Symptom-Multiple users are receiving "Revise Purchase Order" notification even though they are not buyer responsible or approver or creator of the purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Open tasks view -Or Go to Home work center->Inbox view to find the task -Cause-Revise Purchase Order task is raised because an approver returns a purchase order for revision to the employee responsible.-The task is relevant to all employees to whom the Purchase Orders view is assigned and who have authorization for this purchase order. So, all users who have access to this purchase order will get this notification.-Resolution-The user receives this task  under Purchase Requests and Orders work center->purchase orders view-> open tasks.- If you don't want to receive the task then you can restrict the purchase order read/write access under "Access Restrictions" in Application and User Management - Business Users-> Edit Access Rights.-See Also- Refer Help Document:Task – Revise Purchase Order-Keywords-Revise Purchase Order task, e-mail notification for purchase order

Title: How To Add Multiple Services To Your Resource Or Resource Group
Content: Symptom-How to add multiple Services to your Resource or Resource Group.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You can add multiple Services in Equipment Resource and/or Resource Group master data.-Resolution-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center. -Navigate to the Resources view. -Search and select the relevant Resource or Resource Group. -Choose Edit button. -Navigate to Services tab and choose the Add Row button. -You can add multiple Services to the relevant Resource or Resource Group in this screen. -See Also- 2698473 - Error Message While Adding Resource to the Services tab of Bills of Operations-Keywords-multiple services help. resource group, services, services error, resource service error

Title: Migration of Location And Logistics Areas: Logistics Relevance Indicator
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Logistics Areas and you want to know if you can set the "Logistics Relevance Indicator" in the Migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You cannot migrate a Site using the migration tool.-You have to create the Site using the Organizational Management work center.-If you want to create an inventory managed logistics then you have to maintain the Location as a Storage Location.-If you want to create a Location then you have to maintain the Site to be logistics relevant.-You have to set the Site to be logistics relevant before you start with the migration. The "Logistics Relevance Indicator" is not available in the Migration template since you cannot migrate a Site. Hence, you cannot set it in the template.-See Also-2408838 - How Migration of Logistics Areas Works-Keywords-Logistics Relevance Indicator, Migration, Location and Logistics Area, Migration of Location and Logistics Areas, Update, Modify, Create, Site, Location

Title: Service Call Failed; Report An Incident Error During Location Migration
Content: Symptom-Service Call Failed; Report an incident error message displayed while migrating logistics area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Navigate to the view Overview. -Search for activity Migration of Location and Logistics Area and select the activity link. -Choose the link Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool-Choose the relevant file and select option Execute Migration Step by Step from the Execute Migration button. -Cause-There are more than one thousand logistics areas being uploaded under a single Location.-Uploading more than 1000 logistics areas under a location is not recommended as this may cause memory related errors during migration. -Resolution-Please refer to the blog Location and Logistics Area Volume Considerations for SAP Business ByDesign for size recommendations.-As mentioned in the blog, please do not maintain more than one thousand logistics areas under each top-level hierarchy.-See Also-2540242 - Error: "service call failed, report an incident" While Uploading Logistical Area in Data Migration-2508834 - Error Message: "Service Call Failed; Report an Incident" While Migrating Locations and Logistics Area-Keywords-migration error, not able to migrate logistics areas, LOA migration error, service call error in LOA migration

Title: Error "Not All Elements Are Connected To Each Other Below Header" During Migration of Bills Of Operations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to import bills of operations into the system using the migration tool, however system throws error messages:-More than one entry without predecessor exists below header-Not all elements are connected to each other below header-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Access the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Bill of Operations and open the fine-tuning activity.-Select the relevant template and click Execute Migration, then click Execute Migration Step by Step.-The errors occur in step 3 - Simulate Import.-Cause-One or more sheets in the migration template have Row Number column values that are not maintained in sequence.-Resolution-The Row Number column values must be in sequence across all template sheets in order for the migration to complete successfully.-See Also-2667407 - Error: "More Than One Entry Without Predecessor Exists Below Header" During the Migration of Bill of Operations-Keywords-Bill of Operations migration error, BoO migration error, import error for BoO, import of BoO failed, failed bill of operation migration, not able to migrate BoO, More than one entry without predecessor exists below header, not able to migrate bill of operations,

Title: Data Flow Verification Result Errors Between Inbound and Outbound Deliveries
Content: Symptom-Data Flow Verification Result displays following errors:-Outb.deliv. itm qty XX of type Delivery Quantity differs from inb.deliv. item qty-Quantity types differ; XX for outb. deliv. item / YY for inb. deliv. item-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Data Flow Verification Results view.-Search for the respective Data Flow Verification Result.-Open the Application Log ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Application Log).-It is possible to see the errors between Outbound Delivery and Inbound Delivery.-Note: If you go to the Business Document Differences view and select the document with the difference and then click on Start Document Synchronisation, the system dumps.-Cause-No outbound delivery item matches inbound delivery item XX:-This is expected system behavior, the Outbound Delivery has one item that uses two or more identified stocks is split into two or more items for the Inbound Delivery Notification.-Outb.deliv. itm qty XX of type Delivery Quantity differs from inb.deliv. item qty.-Quantity types differ; XX for outb. deliv. item / YY for inb. deliv. item.-This is also expected behavior, the Inbound Delivery Notification was created using different UoM than the Outbound Delivery.-Resolution-Since the 'Start Document Synchronization' is not supposed to correct any data, the Data Flow Verification Result can be set to Close.-Keywords-Data Flow Verification Result, DFVR, Inbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery, ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY, CL_DFV_TRIGGER_RECON==========CP, 1  /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/itsam/appmngt/dfv/ObjectDifferencesOWLECO_OWL.OWL.uicompone

Title: Process Communication Error "Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again" in Purchase Order/shopping cart
Content: Symptom-You have a Purchase Order ABC (ABC refers to the Purchase Order ID) with a Process Communication Error, and the Main Error is "Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again".- or you may see same process communication error in shopping cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open Purchase Order ABC.-Click on View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-or- Open the Shopping cart and go to document flow-Here you can see a red icon indicating that there is a Process Communication Error assigned to this Purchase Order/shopping cart-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Process Communication Errors view.-Select, from the dropdown menu, Open Errors with Incidents.-Select the line where Receiving Document ID is ABC.  or Sender is internal request(Shopping cart)-You can see here that the Main Error is "Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again"-Cause-The system is not able to update the document because there is an Exchange Rate error in the Purchase Order ABC.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open Purchase Order ABC.-Click on View All button.-Click on Check button.-The system will trigger an error: "Exchange rate X/Y on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion" (where X refers to the Supplier's currency, Y refers to the Company's currency, and DD.MM.YYY refers to the creation date of the Purchase Order ABC).-Resolution-To solve this issue, you need to maintain an Exchange Rate between the currencies X and Y. The steps to maintain the Exchange Rate can be seen in the KBA 2370139 - Error: Exchange Rate X/Y on date DD.MM.YYYY Missing for Currency Conversion.-See Also-2370139 - Error: Exchange Rate X/Y on date DD.MM.YYYY Missing for Currency Conversion.-Keywords-Process Communication Error, Purchase Order, Tax calculation, tax, failed, calculation, trigger.-red mark in document flow

Title: Extension Field's Language Node is Missing From Delivery Note XML
Content: Symptom-Upon checking the XML for Delivery Note you are unable to find the language node for your extension field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Outbound Logistics.-View Outbound Deliveries.-Find the respective Delivery document.-Click on Edit.-Go to the Output History tab.-Click on the View Data XML button.-Cause-Currently there is no logic for language conversion for extension fields of type Quantity.-Resolution-This is the current expected behavior of the system.-If this is a feature that you would like to see in the future releases, we would recommend you to submit your requirement as an idea via the Customer Influence Platform.-All new ideas are regularly checked by our product development team and could be included for future release.

Title: Error: Kit item(s) return with follow-up activity Return to Supplier not allowed
Content: Symptom-System triggers below error when creating a Customer Return Notification with the follow-up activity Return to Supplier for a Third-Party Sales Order containing Kit Items.-Error: Kit item(s) return with follow-up activity Return to Supplier not allowed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Open New Customer Return Notification under Common Tasks.-Enter ABC in the Sales Order ID field. (ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Choose Go.-Select the Kit headers in Sales order ABC. (ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Choose Next.-Enter the Delivery Notification ID.-Choose Next.-The following error appears,-Kit item(s) return with follow-up activity Return to Supplier not allowed-Cause-The follow-up activity Return to Supplier is not supported for Sales Kits in Third-Party Sales Order scenarios.-Resolution-Post the requirement for the “Return to Supplier” follow-up activity for Sales Kits on the Customer influence Forum.-As a workaround refer the below process,-Scenario 1: In Third-Party Order Fulfillment-Return the stock back to supplier outside the system.-Create the Credit Memo manually without reference to Outbound Delivery.-Note: If the Credit Memo gives an exception, the user must accept the exception and post it.-Scenario 2: In Third-party Intercompany-Perform Customer Return with follow-up activity "Post to Own Stock" for the Third-Party Sales Order.-Once the stock is received created an intercompany to return the stock back to the supplier.-Keywords-Kit Item(s) Return With Follow-up Activity Return to Supplier Not Allowed; Return to Supplier; Customer Return; Follow-up Activity; Sales Kit; Kit Items; Third-party Sales Order; TPOP; Third-Party Intercompany; TPOP Intercompany; Return; Kit Return; Influence Forum; Business ByDesign

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2102 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2102 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 17th of April. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2102 HFC 3-Resolution-Cross – Area Topic-UI Client-The issue occurring while changing to the Serbo-Croatian language has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000011994)-In the SAP Business ByDesign mobile app, a message to upgrade the version was shown each time the app was opened. This issue was caused due to the wrong version number of the app, which has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013075. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-When there were multiple KPIs on the launchpad with Refresh buttons, clicking one Refresh button immediately after the other was causing the second refresh to fail functionally, although the KPI seemed to have loaded. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009099)-When reviewing a Stock overview report and adding the line items table, it was possible to add a consignment and sales order ID field to the report. Due to an issue, these options were not appearing on the report in Personalization or Key user adaptation mode. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000011867)-Transformation Repository-Due to an issue, XML files generated using XSLT Repository (eInvoicing, Tax, Payments) were not being validated correctly. In some cases, the validation was rejecting properly formatted files. This validation has now been temporarily disabled and a new one will be delivered in the upcoming release. (Hotfix ID: 1000008826. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Common Master Data Transformation Repository had an issue with authority check during deletion of obsoleted transformations, causing application errors. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010638. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Identity and Access Management-When a custom joined data source based on data source CCARUSRLOG was created, and the number of users in the system exceeded 8000, the custom report execution was resulting in an exception. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000011412. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Analytics-The issue with reporting values in specific formats of Date and Time has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010679)-Service Control Center-With the fix provided, the Self-service user type in the Simple license model has been enhanced to approve shopping carts. (Hotfix ID: 1000009174)-Service Control Center-The fix provided ensures that the web service 'Find Accounts' now returns the status information of contact persons, including those that are 'blocked' for further usage from the Information and Lifecycle Management work center. (Hotfix ID: 1000010306)-  Customer Relationship Management-Customer Invoicing-Project OIF screen shows titles 'Pane Header for Tab Strip' and 'Pane Header for Tab'. This has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013311. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix is provided for determination of the Tax Reporting Unit (Business Residence) in Customer Return Invoice Requests of South Korea.-The fix also ensures that intrastate invoices in Assam (India) have the suffix 'EX', which has the basis for reimbursement under the state notified scheme. (Hotfix ID: 1000012431) -Sales Orders-While using the Partner libraries for Parties Determined in CRM documents, as part of Extension Business Object (XBO) exit calls, saving Standard documents was resulting in application errors. This issue has been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000013041)-When a consignment issue item was added for an account with a numeric ID and price calculation is triggered for the same using Update Pricing, the error 'Costs not determined: Field Consignee ID of QueryItemSubject has invalid format' was thrown on cost valuation of consignment issue item. This has now been is resolved. (Hotfix ID: 4500010555)-Opportunity-The fix provided ensures that if all mandatory activities are completed in an Opportunity then its Sales phase can be changed without any error. (Hotfix ID: 1000011727)-Registered Product-When a registered product is added to a Service confirmation for a non-serialized product and released, then navigating to the registered product was resulting in an application error. This issue has been resolved. (Hotfix ID:1000002929. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)           -                                                                      Financial Management-General Ledger-The fix provided is relevant only for SAP Business ByDesign Public Sector edition. Point-of-sale transactions have now been enabled to accept funds and functions as inputs to relevant integration scenarios. The corresponding Journal entries also contain the funds and functions passed through the scenarios. (Hotfix ID: 1000011397)-Cost and Revenue-At the Revenue accounting contract level, if it was determined that Contract Liabilities were to be posted, an issue was causing Contract Assets to be posted or vice-versa. This was occurring when a revenue recognition run was performed for multiple documents. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013541)-The fix provided ensures that the Final accrual indicator is set on relevant multi-customer projects correctly, thereby improving the performance of Revenue recognition runs. (Hotfix ID: 1000013151)-Payment Management-For Switzerland, in the case of a Supplier invoice with payment reference type QR-bill, or payment reference number generated, or no additional information filled, the payment file contained a superfluous tag- AddtlRmtInf. With the fix provided, the tag has been removed from the payment file. (Hotfix ID: 1000010636)-For Japan, the issue with the Payment amount being wrongly set to 0, when one payment clears several Supplier invoices in the Outgoing file of an International Bank Transfer has now been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000013481)-The fix provided ensures that the Payment file generated for externally initiated tax Payments has the payment amounts on the Payment Explanation node. (Hotfix ID: 1000011747)-Payment Processing-With the ISO20022 file upload for Bank statements, the transaction details in the file including fields like Payment information, Account service references, End-to-end ID, and so on, were not getting reflected on the corresponding memo line of the Bank Statement item. The fix provided ensures that the fields are mapped to memo lines. (Hotfix ID: 1000009409)-For UK, the fix provided ensures that MT940 GB bank statement format now correctly considers the SWIFT code as the identification value for the relevant bank account. (Hotfix ID:1000012742. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Tax Management and Declaration-In the IT CU PDF output form, for withholding tax code 27 tax special regime, the base amount was incorrectly appearing in the 'Base amount' field instead of the 'Other amounts not subject to withholding' field. This has now been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 1000006098)-For Sale transactions to customers in Palestine, the external reference document ID was being reported in the PCN874 tax form rather than the internal document reference ID generated by the SAP Business ByDesign. This issue has now been fixed.  (Hotfix ID: 1000012233)-In Italy, Law Art. 124 C.2 DL 34 introduced a special Reduced rate of 5% to buy and sell protective products. With the fix provided, a new tax event 592 'Domestic Sale Art. 124 C.2 DL 34' and a new tax code 592 'Domestic Sale Art. 124 C.2 DL 34' have been created for this purpose. On the purchase side, tax code 77 can be reused. Documents created with this new tax code are to be reported in the 'Summary Register', 'Output VAT Domestic Register', and 'Quarterly VAT Return' tax returns for Italy.  (Hotfix ID: 1000013471. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-With the fix provided, the following tax number types have been added for the respective countries:-• Oman (OM) - VAT Registration Number-• Oman (OM) - Tax Card Number-• Niger (NE) - VAT Registration Number-• Niger (NE) - Tax Identification Number-• Malawi (MW) - Taxpayer Identification Number-• Malawi (MW) - VAT Registration Number-• Uganda (UG) - Tax Identification Number-• Zambia (ZM) - VAT Registration Number-• Nigeria (NG) - VAT Registration Number- (Hotfix ID: 1000012002. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The GB VAT Return could not be executed for a quarterly period. The execution was prevented due to mapping entries that were introduced for the tax event 340 with Valid From date being the start date of the quarterly period. With this fix, the adjustment has been made in the Valid From date of the mapping entries for the tax event 340 to enable successful execution of a GB VAT Return tax return run for a quarterly period. (Hotfix ID: 1000010739)-Amounts in the German VAT forms for form boxes 21 and 45 were displayed with a negative (-) sign. This issue has now been fixed.  (Hotfix ID: 1000012194)-Statutory Reporting-The issue preventing the creation of a new report based on the data source GLOGLAU06 has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000012395)-Accounting-When creating a Sales order with an account starting with a digit, the creation of Goods and Activity Confirmation was failing with an error. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000013630)-  Project Management-Project-In the SAP Business ByDesign Public Sector edition, when projects are created via the activity Migration of Projects, and the option Migrate Projects using Migration Tool is used,  the system does not correctly process the numerical Fund IDs and Grant IDs defined in the migration template. Due to this issue, such projects could not be used as cost assignments in documents like Supplier invoices, and the error message 'Fund not allowed for project task' was shown. Also, the currency of the migrated Financing sources was empty and could not be set by the user. The fix provided ensures that numerical Fund IDs and Grant IDs are processed correctly by the system during migration, and the currency of the migrated Financing sources is derived correctly based on the project's company.  (Hotfix ID: 1000012525)-When a project 'In Planning' status was deleted, all baselines belonging to this project get deleted by the system. In some cases, if a baseline had just been created in another screen, it may not get deleted by the system. This issue could prevent the creation of a new project with the same ID as the deleted one. This has been addressed in the fix provided. The system now deletes all baselines belonging to the deleted project.  (Hotfix ID: 1000013670)-  Human Resources Management-Time and Labor Management-Employee replication via Employee Central Query takes employees and managers from Employee Central and processes them simultaneously. Also, if a manager was already pending for processing, the system allowed duplicate requests of managers to remain. With the fix provided, managers are processed first, followed by employees, and the system checks if a request already exists for a manager for processing. If yes, then duplication of requests for that manager is prevented. Also, if there is any change in the data for that manager, the request is still allowed to remain. (Hotfix ID: 1000011107)-  Supply Chain Management-Physical Inventory-In the Execution work center, when a folder was selected and a task was to be assigned to another user, the value help of advanced filter to select the user was resulting in an application error. The issue causing this error has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000011837)-Goods and Activity Confirmation-Consignment issue allocation, the issues occurring when the ordering UoM and the inventory UoM were different have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000009673)-Inbound Delivery-In the case of Third-Party Order Fulfillment (TPOP), if the sales order contained external reference and the TPOP Inbound Delivery Notification (IDN) was created through web service, the external reference was not getting copied to the IDN. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000010905. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Outbound Delivery-With the fix provided the SiteLogisticsLot association on the Outbound Delivery has been deprecated, as this association was causing application errors in SAP Cloud Application Studio and was also not being implemented. (Hotfix ID: 1000011835)-Request Outbound Delivery Execution Run-The fix provided ensures that Outbound Delivery Requests Runs do not release Stock transfer proposals when they have been set to exclude them. (Hotfix ID: 1000007819. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Production Planning Order-The issue regarding the rejection of the Obsolete variant of BOM and BOO in the Production model of SAP Business ByDesign has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000012534. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Resource Data Management-Resource Floor Plan is now enabled for extension field using SAP Cloud Application Studio. (Hotfix ID: 1000012383)-Production Task-The error occurring during the mass confirmation of production tasks, using action 'Confirmed as planned' has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000001801)-Production Lot-The issue with the extension fields on business object ‘Production Lot’ and node 'Operation Activity' has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000000322)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Purchase Requests and Orders-With this fix, anchors have been added to certain actions, so that the key users can prevent users from accidentally pressing the Finish button. (Hotfix ID: 1000012085)-Request for Quote-The fix provided ensures that Supplier Quote Notes can be created using SDK. (Hotfix ID: 1000011256)-Supplier Invoice-With the fix provided, creating Supplier invoices for Free Text items is possible, and searching the product ID based on the product description would not end abruptly. (Hotfix ID: 1000012821)-The fix provided resolves inconsistencies in Exceptions without any predecessor Supplier invoice.  (Hotfix ID: 1000006244. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g. operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2102; HFC03; Hotfix; SPS03; Hotfix Collection; 2102

Title: Spaces or Gaps before and in between Serial Number in Inbound Deliveries and Inbound  Delivery Notifications
Content: Symptom-You observe system triggers error whenever there is a space before (spaceZ3) and in between Serial Number (Zspace1) in an Inbound Delivery/Inbound Delivery Notification.*Z refers to Serial Number id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Inbound Logistics Work Center-In common tasks, select Customer return notification-Click Next-Maintain Relevant Delivery Notification id  enter product id for all 3 line items -Maintain Serial numbers for all 3 line items as for example (Zspace1, Z2space, spaceZ3)-Click Check Consistency-Error appears-Serial ID Z 1 not valid-Serial ID Z3 not valid-  Resolution-This is not allowed.This is how the system is designed not to consider the spaces entered before and no space is allowed in between as well.-Note: For case Space after Serial Number, System  does not show up as an error since the space is removed in the back end before the validity of the serial number is checked.- Therefore, the validation encounters no issues so no error appears.- This is expected behavior.-Keywords-Serial ID  not valid, Spaces or Gaps before and in between Serial Number,Gaps before and in between Serial Number in Inbound Deliveries and Inbound  Delivery Notifications

Title: Attachments /Notes added by approver in Managing my area work centre is not appearing in the purchase order .
Content: Symptom-Expect the notes or attachments added by approver should appear in Purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to managing my area work center-Select respective  purchase order approve task-Go to action button and choose add an attachment/add notes( and  add some attachment or notes)-Click on save and close-Now send Purchase order for revision-Open Purchase order and check the attachments /Notes both at header and item level-You will not find any attachments/notes-Cause-This is standard behaviour, cause notes or attachments maintained in managing my area screen are for approvers reference only as they are at task level thus will not flow to Purchase order .-Resolution-kindly add all such attachments/notes in the Purchase order-Keywords-Approver added attachments not Shown in purchase order; Notes not Shown in purchas order; Approver attachements

Title: System does Not Propose Identified Stock ID in Over The Counter Sales
Content: Symptom-You are creating an Over The Counter Sales Order, and have set up the relevant Logistics Area to be Inventory-Managed with specified Stock Allocation (Material Flow rules). However, when you create an Over The Counter Sales Order, the system does not propose the Logistics Area with the Identified Stock ID.-You believe this is a system bug, and you want it to be corrected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center, and under common Tasks, select New Over-the-Counter Sale.-Enter in the field "Ship-From Location" the relevant Location ID.-Enter the relevant Product ID.-The system shows the following error message: Item *: Identified Stock ID is mandatory; material * is batch managed (* acts as a place holder for the relevant Item ID and Material ID respectively).-You expect the system to automatically propose the Identification Stock ID as:-You have maintained all necessary details in the Site and Logistics Area.-You have the Material in stock at the relevant Logistics Area.-Cause-This is a known limitation. The Material Flow Rules are used in Source and Destination Determination (SDD) in Site Logistics (task based and lean screens) and in the Production Processes.-The Source and Destination Determination is not supported by the Over-the-counter Sales and Projects screens/processes and therefore it is not working in these scenarios.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-See Also-The Influence request: "Over-the-counter - Allow several Logistics Areas". Please cast your vote and discuss with other customers to drum up support in the community forum.-Keywords-Over the counter, Identified Stock, Source Determination, FIFO, Picking strategy, Specified Stock, Logistics Use

Title: System Does Not Generate PI Count Document By Storage Group via Cyclic Product Count Runs
Content: Symptom-You have added a control parameter as Split by Storage Group in Cyclic Product Count Runs, however system has not created any PI Count Document for relevant products.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center-Go to Automated Actions view-Find Run ID: X ( i.e X refers to Run ID)-Edit and under Control Parameters-> Split Tasks as Split by Storage Group-Product Inventory Status as Include Both Products with and without Inventory-Under Split Criteria:- Enter required Storage Location ID under Storage Location tab and Storage Group ID under Storage Group tab-Choose Set to Active and perform Save and Close-Now select the Run ID and choose Schedule-Choose Start Immediately-You find that in generated Application Log ID, system has not included any product ID and hence PI Count Document is not generated -Cause-You have not maintained Cycle Count days in relevant product master data and is Blank. Some value greater than zero must be maintained in Days.-Resolution-Go to Product Portfolio workcenter-Go to Products view and choose By Materials view-Select All Materials via drop down and enter required Product ID-Edit it and choose View All-Navigate to Logistics tab-Select required Site ID under Sites view-Under Details section, enter Cycle Count Days greater than zero-Keywords-Product Cyclic Run, Storage Group, PI Count Document, Automated Actions

Title: The role restriction of location is not working when confirming pick tasks
Content: Symptom-The role restriction of location is not working when confirming pick tasks-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Edit location ABC (ABC represents the name of the location).-Define this location as only ship-to and storage location, de-select role of ship-from.-However when confirming pick tasks, system is still proposing logistic areas under location ABC, and you are able to confirm the task with this logistic area, no error will be raised by the system.-Cause-The selection or de-selection of the ship-from will not have an impact while selecting the logistics area during the confirmation of the task, as this check is not being considered.-As the ATP check takes place at the site level with the quantities being considered at the site level and not at the level below where these indicators are maintained. And the checks need to be consistent in ATP as well as planning.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-Keywords-role of location; role restriction; ship-from; confirm task; logistic area

Title: Automatically created notes "Remarks for Supplier" in the shopping cart when catalogs are used.
Content: Symptom-During shopping cart creation, after selecting an item from a catalog, system automatically creates "Remarks for Supplier" in the shopping cart. The content in the "Remarks for Supplier" is the same content in the catalog template called "Additional product information"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently this is expected behavior-Resolution-Also may be there are other customers who use this and thus we cannot remove it currently.-So check SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum and submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Shopping cart creates notes "Remarks for supplier"; "Remarks for supplier"; Shopping cart

Title: Serial Number ABC Cannot Be Received, Does Not Exist At Custodian.
Content: Symptom-While trying to receive a serial number during Spare Parts Return below errors are reports by the system.-Serial number ABC cannot be received, does not exist at custodian.-Serial number ABC already issued to a customer; cannot be received.-ABC represents the serial number entered and is a dummy value mentioned for the purpose of this document. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to Inbound Delivery Notifications view. -Search for the relevant notification, select it and choose Post Goods Receipt button. -In the Serial Numbers sub-tab, enter the serial number ABC and Save the document. -The reported error is displayed.-Cause-You have created a Spare Parts return notification. In this scenario the system expects the stock to be tagged to a custodian.-You have consumed the spare parts with serial number ABC that was already delivered at the custodian via service confirmation.-As a result of you will not be able to receive the same serial number unless the service confirmation document is cancelled/reversed.-Resolution-You will have to cancel relevant confirmation documents which could include invoice documents and confirmation documents for the above product with serial number ABC. -You will have to check with your CRM team to make sure if the above is feasible at your end and proceed. -Keywords-serial number parts return error, not able to return serial number for spare parts, spare parts return error in serial number.

Title: Not Able To Post Beyond Six Months In The Past
Content: Symptom-The option to select scoping question Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months? is disabled in Business Configuration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Navigate to the Implementation Projects view. -Search and select the relevant Implementation Project. -Select the button Edit Project Scope. -Navigate to the chevron Questions and expand the element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics. -Expand sub-element Inventory management and select the option Inventory Postings. -Under questions option you can see that the checkbox against the above mentioned question is disabled.-Cause-The above question has dependency with Quantity Control. -You will have to scope Quality Assurance element to enable the checkbox for inventory postings beyond six months in the past. -Resolution-Please follow below given steps to select Quality Assurance.-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Navigate to the Implementation Projects view. -Search and select the relevant Implementation Project. -Select the button Edit Project Scope. -Navigate to the chevron Scoping and select the element Quality Assurance under Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics. -Choose Next. -You can see that the checkbox against the question Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months? is enabled now.-See Also- 2823591 - Date Not Valid Error When Creating Physical Inventory Count/Adjustment OR Any Inventory Postings-Keywords-inventory postings beyond six months in the past, inventory postings question disabled, disabled inventory postings.

Title: Automatic Proposal of Identified Stock while confirming Supply Task
Content: Symptom-You want the system to automatically propose the identified stock while confirming Supply Task as per FIFO strategy maintained at Site Level following Material Flow Rules. However, system does not propose an identified stock itself for the product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Workcenter-Go to Task Control view.-Search and select the task for which you want the system to propose identified stock automatically.-Choose the Confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen, you see that the system does not automatically propose identified stock along with Source Logistics Area.-In the Task screen, you do not see any value populated in the Identified Stock field even though the product is marked for mandatory identified stock selection. You expect the system to propose the identified stock automatically along with stock allocation.-Cause-You have not maintained the Allocation Scope and Allocation Type value for the logistics area from which you are picking the relevant product.-Resolution-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Locations view.-Choose your Site and select the Edit Layout button.-Select the logistics area in which you expect the system to propose identified stock automatically in the Site Layout screen.-In the General tab, under the header Inventory-Managed Details choose the value in the field Allocation Scope as Specific Stock and Allocation Type as Immediate Stock Allocation.-Choose Save and Close button.-Once the above settings are maintained for a logistics area the system will propose identified stock automatically, provided proper material flow rules are maintained for the relevant site. -Keywords-Supply Task, Identified Stock, Batch ID, Automatic Proposal, FIFO, FIFO rule, material flow rules

Title: How to show Item type as Down Payment Item in Down Payment Request created via Web Service?
Content: Symptom-You are creating down payment request using web service ManageSupplierInvoiceIn and BusinessTransactionDocumentTypeCode is set as 817 which successfully creates a downpayment request in the system, however the line items are created as "Invoice Item" instead of "Downpayment Item" as in standard system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the down payment request created from the web service.-Select View All-Navigate to Items tab-Under Basic sub-tab, the item type shows invoice item instead of Down payment Item-Cause-You have not added the attribute BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode in the request XML file.-Resolution-You should add this attribute in order to get the down payment item type:-<BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>80</BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>.-Keywords-down payment request item, ManageSupplierInvoiceIn, BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode, BusinessTransactionDocumentTypeCode

Title: Error appears "Negative stock not allowed in log. area identified stock" when trying to perform reverse confirmation for Inbound task
Content: Symptom-When trying to perform reverse confirmation for a warehouse confirmation against a inbound warehouse task, following errors appear.-Negative stock not allowed in log. area  (prod.  identified stock)-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to By Warehouse Order.-Search for desired warehouse order ID.-Click Edit.-Navigate to Confirmations tab.-Select the dsired warehouse confirmation.-Perform Reverse Confirmation, above errors occur.-Cause-As there is no stock for this product in this particular Logistics Area, meanwhile, the Negative stock allowed is unchecked for this Logistics Area.-Resolution-There has to be stock in the relevant Logistics Area for this product.-Keywords-Negative stock not allowed in log. area, reverse confirmation, warehouse confirmation, Negative stock, Warehouse Order

Title: Error in Project Overview: Parameter Accounting Period/Year should not contain empty selection
Content: Symptom-You are  unable to see the graph in project overview screen:-Errors:--Query View missing--Parameter Accounting Period/Year should not contain empty selection-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select view Projects-Select the respective project ID -Select view all and Navigate to overview tab-The report graphs show error: Parameter Accounting Period/Year should not contain empty selection-Cause-You are using fiscal year variant which is year specific. The fiscal year has ended before current date.-Resolution-Please maintain fiscal year definition till the current year / date.-This is required to derive the fiscal year and period for the current / today's date.-Keywords-Parameter Accounting Period/Year should not contain empty selection, Query View missing

Title: Purchase order output Emails not sent to Supplier
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2571549***-All suppliers are not receiving purchase orders through email.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open a purchase order-Go to Output History tab-The output record is in status 'Error'-Or,-Open a purchase order-Press You Can Also-Edit Output settings-An error raised that email ID is not maintained-Cause-In business configuration, user has set "Send all e-mails/faxes to this address" but did not maintain an email address.-Resolution-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to  implementation projects-Choose activity list-Go to fine time-Search for activity"E-mail and fax settings"-Under  E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System/production System-When choosing "Send all e-mails/faxes to this address", enter the address to be used for testing purposes in the empty field available below it-Keywords-Purchase Order Output; Email Not Sent; No Output

Title: The "Evaluated Receipt Settlement" flag is Unchecked Automatically when Item Type is Changed to "Expense" in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Supplier master data is flagged with "Evaluated Receipt Settlement" (ERS). If a purchase order is created for that supplier, and the Item type is changed to "Expense", the flag of "Evaluated Receipt Settlement" is unchecked automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Select new Purchase Order(PO) and create a PO for that supplier which is relevant for "Evaluated Receipt Settlement"-Under Items tab, change item type to expense-ERS flag is unchecked automatically-Cause-For ERS(Evaluated Receipt Settlement) invoicing, this is the current system behavior. For expense Items, ERS is more likely not to be used, so it is defaulted as "Unchecked".-Resolution-You can manually flag the checkbox while creating the purchase order.-See Also-2580173 - Incorrect Follow-up Document Settings in Purchase Order-2415028 - The Invoice Expected field is Automatically Flagged/Unflagged in Purchase Order-Keywords-Evaluated Receipt Settlement, purchase order, expense item, ERS, purchase order follow up document

Title: No Receiving Inspection Document Created in Inbound Logistics
Content: Symptom-You expect a receiving inspection document should be created after inbound warehouse order in inbound logistics scenario but actually there is not.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select work center Inbound Logistics, open view Purchase Orders.-Search Purchase order XXX (XXX stands for Purchase Order ID), click View.-Select tab Document Flow, select Extended Field in drop-down, click anchor on corresponding inbound warehouse order YYY (YYY stands for Warehouse Order ID), there is no following receiving inspection document.-You have checked below settings:-Select work center Business Configuration, open view Implementation Projects. Select corresponding project, click Edit Project Scope, click Next until "4 Questions", expand Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics > Quality Assurance > Quality Control, the option "Do you want to inspect incoming material or products delivered by suppliers, or send quality assurance documents to your suppliers?" has been in scope already.-Select work center Quality Planning, open view Inspection Plans, there is a corresponding inspection plan (Inspection Type: Receiving inspection - supplier delivery) for corresponding site has been active.-Select work center Warehousing and Logistics Master Data, open view Logistics Models, find corresponding standard receiving logistics model XYZ (XYZ stands for Logistics Model ID), click Edit, Autonomic Inspection has been maintained in Inspection Process.-Cause-You have maintained Autonomic Inspection in Inspection Process in logistics model XYZ but have not released it yet.-Select work center Warehousing and Logistics Master Data, open view Logistics Models.-Select logistics model XYZ, click button Open Released Logistics Model, you can see for the active version, Autonomic Inspection is not displaying in the screen.-Resolution-In corresponding logistics model, ensure Autonomic Inspection has been maintained in Inspection Process, click button Save and Release.-Keywords-Inspection, Receiving, Inbound, Logistics Model, Autonomic Inspection, 检验，收货，物流模型

Title: Error : The identified stock must not be assigned to a product specification
Content: Symptom-While Post Goods Receipt against purchase order when a user enters an Identified Stock, system throws below error:-The identified stock must not be assigned to a product specification-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view and search relevant Purchase Order ID.-Select and choose Post Goods Receipt.-Choose Propose Quantities and then choose Identified stock ID via value selection.-However, you find that it displays no results though Istock exists for a relevant product.-Now enter Identified Stock ID manually and press enter.-Here system throws an error: "The identified stock must not be assigned to a product specification"-Cause-Since relevant Identified Stock ID is assigned to a Product Specification ID, it is not listed in value selection and also not allowed by the system to be used during the Post Good Receipt process. Use an Identified Stock ID without any PRS ID associated with it during the inbound process.-Resolution-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view and choose the New IDentified Stock subview.-Enter relevant Product ID and required details without any PRS ID.-Perform Save, new Identified Stock ID gets generated.-Once a new ID gets generated now Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view and search relevant Purchase Order ID.-Select and choose Post Goods Receipt.-Choose Propose Quantities and then choose Identified stock ID via value selection as it is listed.-Select it and perform save without any error message.-Keywords-Post Goods receipt, Identified Stock, PRS, Product Specification , IStock, The identified stock must not be assigned to a product specification, inbound

Title: The Final Production's Output Product is Not Marked as Under Inspection
Content: Symptom-You have finished the production process for the product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product) and you expect its status to be set to "Inspection" or "Restricted" after the production's quality confirmation. For that purpose you have not checked the parameter "Do not Categorize tock as Inspection Stock" in the respective Inspection Plan.-However, the finished product ABC does not have the status "Inspection" or "Restricted" in the Stock Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Quality Control.-Select the view Inspections.-Find the respective Inspection's ID. -Result: You will see that the Inspection is in status Results Recorded and the production process is completed.-Now go to the work centre Physical Inventory and select the common task Stock Overview.-Search for the product ABC.-Click the button Go. -Result: The product does not have the "Restricted" or "Inspection" indicator checked.-Cause-The Inspection stock option in the rule of the Inspection Plan is valid only for the Inbound process and not for Production.-It is not possible for the standard Production Confirmation to mark the stock as under Inspection upon confirmation of the Production Task as the Inspection indicator is not even enabled on the Production Confirmation business object.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system.-You may consider creating a PDI add-on which posts a Goods and Activity Confirmation of type Goods Movement to mark the inventory as "Inspection".-See Also-Inspection Plans Quick Guide-Create an Inspection Plan-Keywords-Production, Inspection, Inspection Plan

Title: Intrastat declaration not created or Few documents not appearing in the declaration
Content: Symptom- Intrastat declaration not created from the Intrastat Declaration runs.-Environment-SAP  Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declaration runs view-Select the relevant Declaration Run ID-You can see that job has been executed with warnings  or errors and no declarations created- or-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declarations view-Select the relevant Declaration ID-Navigate to Items tab-You do not see the Supplier Invoice which is expected to be picked up for declarations under References tab-Cause-Lead document for country Germany, France, Austria and UK is Delivery-But for country Italy the lead document is Invoice.-Resolution-kindly check the inbound deliveries or invoices accordingly to understand which meet the conditions given below to appear in the declaration-The conditions are:-•Country from which goods are sent (dispatching country) is EU Country.-•Country to which goods are sent (recipient country) is EU Country.-•Goods sender country (dispatcher) is not the same as goods receiving country (receiver)-•Products should be of the type material (products of type services are not supported)-See Also- 2736574 - Intrastat Declaration not created From Intrastat Declaration Runs -Keywords-Intrastat items not picked for declaration, Intrastat declaration not created, Following items are not relevant for declarations,Supplier invoice not picked up in Intrastat, Goods receipt not picked for Intrastat

Title: Default the Shipment Date to a Timezone Different Than UTC When Creating New Outbound Deliveries From 3PL Requests
Content: Symptom-You want to default the Shipment Date timezone to a different one than the standard UTC timezone which is displayed when creating a new Outbound Delivery from a 3PL Requests in the Third-Party Logistics work centre.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Third-Party Logistics.-Select the view 3PL Outbound and click on the sub-view 3PL Requests. -Select the 3PL request you would like to process.-Click the button New Outbound Delivery.-Select a date for the Shipment Date field under the General tab.-Result: the date will be displayed in UTC format by default.-Cause-Currently this is not a supported feature.-Resolution-The default timezone will be displayed in the UTC format by default.-If you would like this behaviour to be changed, please submit this requirement as new idea via the Customer Influence Platform.-All new ideas are regularly checked by the product development team and could be included for future release.-Keywords-default timezone, UTC, 3PL request, outbound delivery

Title: Confirmed Delivery Date in Customer Demand is Different from Product Planning
Content: Symptom-Confirmed Delivery Date in Customer Demand is Different from Product Planning-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Search and open the respective Product planning.-Click on the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Customer Demand of the Sales Order).-Go to the Line Items tab.-See that for the Confirmed Delivery Date is DD.MM.YYYY.-Go back to the Product Planning.-See Purchase Order Acknowledged DEF has the Date as DD.MM.YYYY + 1.-This can behavior can also happen for any Delivery document, including proposals.-Cause-The ATP check works based on a 24 hour cycle. However, this cycle is from 12:00 to 12:00 of the site time zone converted to UTC, meaning its 12:00 of the current day to 12:00 of the next day (and not 00:00 to 24:00 of the same day).-ATP by default works on the progressive bucketing logic, which means the receipts are booked to the start of the receipt bucket.-However, we also support conservative bucketing with which the receipts can be booked to the end of the receipt bucket.-Resolution-In case you would like to opt for the conservative bucketing, please uncheck the checkbox for following Business Configuration scoping question:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select respective Implementation Project and click on Edit Project Scope button.-Click on next until Step 4 - Questions.-Expand: Supply Chain Planning and Control -> Demand Management and Order Confirmation -> Product Availability Check.-Unflag the question "Do you want to receive availability confirmations for products at the start of the 24 hour cycle?"-Keywords- Product Planning, Customer Demand, Delivery Date-

Title: Error:Exactly one channel must be Original for this country. You cannot have more than one channel as original for this country
Content: Symptom-While creating Purchase order or while approving a purchase order you may see this error.-or-You have created a new purchase order however system shows the error message when you click on order button.- or- In the  edit output settings screen when you click on apply you get this error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to purchase request and orders work center-Go to Purchase orders-Click on Order button-You will get this error- or-Go to Purchase order and -Go to you can also button-Click on edit output settings-Click on apply and you will get this error-Cause-You have two Output channels and not maintained which is original in Supplier master data.-Resolution- Go to Supplier base work center- Go to suppliers view- Search and open respective Supplier master- Go to view all- Go to  Communication tab- Go to  Collaboration  tab- Select Purchase order- There are two or more Output channels but none are marked as duplicate- or more than one are not marked as Duplicate- Ensure you mark all as duplicates except one channel.-Once done all newly created Purchase orders will show no error-For the effected purchase orders :-Go to Purchase order and -Go to you can also button-Click on edit output settings-Check mark them as duplicate except one .-Keywords-Unable to approve Purchase order,  unable to save order

Title: Payment Terms Not Being Picked Up When Selecting Two Purchase Orders in The Invoice Entry Screen
Content: Symptom-Payment Terms not being picked up when selecting two Purchase Orders in the Invoice Entry screen-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Search and select two Purchase Orders for the same Supplier.-Click on New Invoice button.-System does not select any Payment Terms.-Cause-For creating the Supplier Invoice for two or more Purchase Orders in the Invoice Entry screen, it is necessary to have the Payment Terms maintained in the Supplier Master Data.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, please maintain the Payment Terms in Supplier Master Data as per following steps:-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Search and open the respective Supplier.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Purchasing tab.-Enter a Payment Term in the Payment Terms field.-Once this is maintained you should be able to create a Supplier Invoice using two or more Purchase Ordersf or the same Supplier with the Payment Term field completed.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice, Supplier, Payment Terms
