This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500010026)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Supplier Invoice-The fix provided ensures that the quantity and amount values from scanned documents are taken when Invoice is created with reference to a Purchase order. (Hotfix ID: 4500011124)-With the fix provided, you can now avoid the creation of Supplier invoice exceptions without any reference to a predecessor Supplier invoice. (Hotfix ID: 4500012650)-Purchase Order-The fix provided ensures correct calculation of Overdue Days when the Delivery/Acknowledgement date is greater than the Reminder Proposal date. (Hotfix ID: 4500012561)-*Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g. operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2102; HFC02; Hotfix; SPS02; Hotfix Collection; 2102

Title: Cannot Change The Responsible Unit once Project Task is Released
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason: Duplicate of KBA  1668261 - Cannot Change Responsible Unit Of A Released Project/Project task-Cannot change the Responsible Unit once Project Task is Released-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search and open the Project ABC (ABC represents the Project ID).-Click on the View All button.-Select the respective Project Task.-Go to the Accounting tab. -Responsible Unit field is greyed out.-Cause-Once the Task is Released, there is no possibility to maintain it from UI and neither from the backend, because this information is replicable in Costing (Financials) and hence it is not possible to perform the change.-Resolution-We suggest for this case to close the Project Task and create a new one with the correct responsible unit.-Keywords-Project Task, Responsible Unit, Project

Title: System triggers error "An inbound delivery with reference to  inbound delivery notification already exists.Enter a New Inbound Delivery Notification ID" when trying to create 3PL Inbound Delivery from Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-Error appears when you try to create New 3PL Inbound Delivery against the Inbound Delivery Notification KLM (KLM represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to the Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Find and select the Inbound Delivery Notification KLM.-Click New Inbound Delivery.-Maintain External Delivery ID and External Delivery Item ID as required.-Click Check Consistency-The system displays the error message: An inbound delivery with reference to the inbound delivery notification KLM already exists. Enter a new inbound delivery notification ID.-Cause-This is the expected behavior. When you check consistency during creation of the inbound delivery, there is a validation which queries all Confirmed Inbound Deliveries and checks the BTD reference to see if any have the Inbound Delivery Notification "KLM".-Resolution-Follow the below steps to find the duplicate Inbound Delivery Notification(s):-Navigate to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Inbound Deliveries view and search for the Inbound Delivery Notification "KLM" (if the system does return any record, open the Advanced Filter and enter the value directly into the Delivery Notification ID field and click Go).-You will see that there are Confirmed Inbound Delivery with this reference.- You have to cancel the Inbound Delivery Notification KLM and create a new Inbound Delivery Notification with a different ID so you can process the order.-Keywords-An inbound delivery with reference to  inbound delivery notification already exists. Enter a New Inbound Delivery Notification ID, An inbound delivery with reference to the inbound delivery notification KLM already exists. Enter a new inbound delivery notification ID.

Title: How to Bundle and Assign Multiple Purchase Request Tasks from Purchase Requests view?
Content: Symptom-You want to bundle and assign multiple purchase request open tasks to one user from purchase requests view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Requests-Filter with "Open Tasks"-Here you want to bundle multiple tasks and assign to one user.-Cause-You cannot bundle open tasks and assign to a person from Purchase requests Screen.-Here you can bundle the purchase requests based on certain criteria to create purchase order.-Resolution-If you want to assign tasks to a person, you can do so in Application and User Management work center - Business Task Management view-> search for the tasks here. If the tasks are available in this view, then you can select the tasks and assign them manually.-Keywords- purchase request open task, assign to single user

Title: The Webservice ManageSiteLogisticsTask is Not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm a Pick/Putaway Task partially using the web service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn (II_MANAGE_SLT_IN). However, when you consume the Request payload (XML), you get a response which suggest that the Warehouse Task (Site Logistics Task) has been "Saved successfully". When you check the Task in the system, you see the change did not reach the document.-You also cannot find any error with the structure and integrity of your XML payload.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You have not scoped Automatic Identification in your Business Configuration. Internally, the web service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn works and post the modification via Barcodes.-Resolution-Therefore, you need to scope Automatic Identification Business Option for web service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn to work. To scope the Automatic Identification, please do as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation Project or the relevant Implementation Project.-Choose Edit Project Scope button.-Choose Next until you arrive at '3 Scoping'.-Expand the Scoping Element 'Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics'.-Expand the Element 'Task Management and Automation'.-You can see the Element 'Automatic Identification' is not scoped.-Please scope the element and save your changes.-You may also want to scope 'Mobile Devices' if it is also not scoped.-Keywords-Barcode, II_MANAGE_SLT_IN, Saved Successfully, II_QUERY_SLT_IN, web service, pick task error, put away task error, success message in task webservice but task not confirmed

Title: Unable to Print Inspection Results
Content: Symptom-You would like to print the Inspection Results for the Inspection ABC (ABC represents the ID of the document), however you are unable to find the output document under the Output History tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work centre Quality Control.-View Monitoring --> Sub-view Inspections. -Show All Inspections. -Search for Inspection ID: ABC.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Miscellaneous tab and then select the sub-tab Output History.-Result: The Inspection Results output is not displayed. -Cause-This functionality is currently not available.-Resolution-If you would like this behaviour to be changed, we would recommend you to submit this requirement as an idea via the Customer Influence Platform.-All new ideas are regularly checked by our product development team and could be included for future release.-Keywords-inspection results, output

Title: Material Not Available For Consumption in Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2236212*** -You are trying to consume a Material in Project XYZ (XYZ refers to the Project ID), but system shows error message "Material not available for consumption in project"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search for Project XYZ.-Click on Edit button.-Go to the Products tab.-Go to the Project Stock Orders sub-tab.-Expand the relevant Project Stock Order.-Select any Line Item.-Click on the Consume button.-Click on the OK button.-System shows an error message saying "Material not available for consumption in project".-Cause-This issue is caused because of the Logistics Area of the material. If you search in the Stock Overview for the Material you are trying to consume and open its respective Logistics Area, you will see that Inventory-Managed field is set as "No".-Resolution-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Stock Overview common task.-Search for the Material you are trying to consume.-Click on its Logistics Area.-Click on the Edit button.-Select the Logistics Area.-Mark the checkbox "Inventory-Managed".-See Also-3232950 - Material not available for consumption in project-Keywords-material, consumption, consume, project, not available-

Title: Output Product ABC in BoM Variant Causes Recursion
Content: Symptom-Output product ABC in BoM variant causes recursion.-ABC represents the output product entered and is a dummy value mentioned for the purpose of this document.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center. -Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option New Production Bill of Material.-Enter the relevant information and try to save the BoM. -The system displays the error: Output product ABC in BoM variant causes recursion.-You get the above reported error message.-Cause-There is already a bill of material in the system where the Output product ABC is used as the Input product to create an Input product which is used in the new BoM which you are trying to save.-This error is also triggered if you include the Output product ABC as an Input Product of the Production BoM you are trying to create.-The reported error will be displayed even if the already existing BoM is in Obsolete Status or if you have deleted the Input Product from the existing BoM.-The system consideres this because there are always options for the business user to Undo Obsolete the BoM or add the same Input Product later. -Resolution-This recursive scenario is not supported in ByDesign.-See Also-Keywords-BoM error, Bill of Material save error, Bill of material error, error while saving Bill of Material, Migration of Bills of Material

Title: Error while Running Migration of Bill of Operations
Content: Symptom-Migration of Bill of Operations fails with error:-Error while changing bill of operations (Consumer fault on OPERATION_CHG 00163E939B491EDA8F9CCF5B9D5D9ED3 SIMULTANEOUSLY_USED_RESOURCES-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Go to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Search and open the activity "Migration of Accounting Transaction Data".-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the respective Migration Unit.-Click on the Execute Migration button.-Click on 'Execute Migration Step by Step'.-Error while changing bill of operations (Consumer fault on OPERATION_CHG 00163EA97C861EDBA0875ACEA082A11D SIMULTANEOUSLY_USED_RESOURCES)-Cause-In the migration template, the field Number of Resources corresponding to quality operation has been maintained.-Resolution-Leave the field Number of Resources corresponding to quality operation as blank.-Keywords-Migration, Bill of Operations, Resources, Migration of Bill of Operations

Title: Supplier Invoice ID not as per numbering format
Content: Symptom-You notice that Invoice ID is not starting with the starting document number maintained in the BC activity 'Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently if one table entry already exists for the combination of company, document type and any separator then a second entry with same combination will not take the defined starting document number rather it will pick from where it was left for the previous combination.-Resolution-This is a known restriction issue in the system. In normal circumstances, the system should not allow a second entry for the same combination of company and document type. However in the current version this restriction is not applied.-This causes the newly created table entry to be ignored. This is planned to be adjusted in a future release of the system.

Title: Wrong quantity in Not invoiced time and expenses screen
Content: Symptom-The time confirmation or invoice etc which has missing quantity or wrong quantity in the Not invoiced time and expenses screen of a project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to Not invoiced time and expenses view-Search for respective Project-Choose on edit  time and expenses-Cause-There are project invoices requests created earlier for the missing quantity/ partial quantity-Resolution-Go to Project management work center-Go to Not invoiced time and expenses view-Search with respective Project-Choose on edit  time and expenses-select respective entry-scroll down-Go to Quantity and expenses details tab-where you can see Quantity previously invoiced and quantity previously Written off-Then-Go to Project management work center-Go to Project invoice requests view-Search with respective Project-Get all existing Project invoice requests-Keywords-Wrong written off quantity; wrong Quantity available to be invoiced; Project not invoiced time and expense

Title: Error:Project ID ABC already assigned to another project
Content: Symptom-While creating a new Project you are getting this error though there is no such project ID in the system. where ABC is the Project ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Project ID and Project task ID has to be unique and  in your case project task ID ABC already exists in the system thus you cannot use it as project ID.-Resolution-One can search for existing project tasks(Project ID or Project task ID) by using any value help for project tasks in the system-For example-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Time and Expenses view-Choose all items-Open advanced filter-Search for project task ID field-Click on Value help of this field-In the pop up screen,Enter the Task ID and search-This shows that project task ABC exists in project XYZ(where XYZ is project ID of other project)-Keywords-Project ID not found, unable to use a project ID,assigned to other project

Title: Base Amount in Product Tax Header Tag of PO Output XML Is Not Being Calculated Correctly
Content: Symptom-Base Amount in Product Tax Header tag of PO Output XML is not being calculated correctly.-Services are being overruled by Materials.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order).-Click on the View All button.-Go to Items tab.-See that this PO has Material and Service items.-Click on Preview > Changed PO.-Base Amount for Taxes is not displaying the amount from the Service Items. The same can be seen in the Product Tax Header tag of PO Output XML.-Cause-Since the Product Tax code is within the Header, the system expects only one form of Product Tax and grouping is done based on type code and rate type.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior, our suggestions for this case are the following:-Create separate POs for Material and Service Items.-Read the item information and derive the base amounts from there and later sum up if needed.-A change in this logic is currently not possible as this could have repercussions when, in future, other customers create custom forms as the XML logic will be changed.-Keywords-Base Amount, Product Tax, Tax Base Amount, Purchase Order, Tax

Title: Why purchase order changes are sent to Supplier? or how  to configure particular Purchase order changes to be sent to Supplier
Content: Symptom-You have changed the some value in purchase order acknowledgement or directly in purchase order, then system triggers an E-Mail to the vendor about the changes in the order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select New PO Acknowledgement button -Adjust some value (like Delivery Date) and Save the acknowledgement-You see there is a new output sent to the supplier under the purchase order - Output History tab.-Cause-There is a business configuration setting called Purchase Order Output Control Settings. Here you can maintain Purchase Order Send Output Control Settings;-1. Purchase Order Send Email Control Settings-2. Purchase Order Send Output Control Settings-In the Purchase Order Send Email Control Settings, You can configure the e-mail ID settings for different party types, if the purchase order communication to supplier is via email. Here you can see that Email ID Settings for Purchase Order Output is set as Supplier under Send to column. Which means any changes in the purchase order will inform the Send To party i.e Supplier. Hence the changes has been informed to the supplier.-Similarly Purchase Order Send Output Control Settings will be triggered, when changes to ordered purchase order is communicated to supplier (via email, fax or post) only if there is a change in the values of the attributes that are selected below. You also need to take care of dependent attributes. For example, when you change quantity, it automatically leads to a change in net value and taxes at item and header. These settings will not be applicable in case ordered purchase order is updated and approval is triggered.-Under the available Nodes heading, you can select Item and on the right hand side you can see Available Attributes.-Here you have selected the Delivery Date check box. So any changes to Delivery Date attribute, will be communicated to supplier.-Resolution-If you do not want system to communicate the changes to the supplier, you can deselect the attribute Delivery Date and save the settings.-also check the changes tab of Purchase order to see other fields that also gets changed when you make changes and uncheck them as well in Purchase Order Send Output Control Settings.-Keywords-Purchase Order Change; Changes to delivery date communicates to supplier;  purchase order acknowledgement change; Purchase Order Send Email Control Settings; Purchase Order Send Output Control Settings

Title: Supplier Invoice Amount is not Reflected in Project Not Invoiced Time and Expenses
Content: Symptom-You have a supplier invoice which has higher value than the Goods and Service Receipt(GSR). You have done a GR/IR clearing and expect that Not Invoiced Time and Expenses should show the value from the invoice but it shows only Goods Receipt value.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select view: Not Invoiced Time and Expenses-The Goods receipt amount(say X) is showing up.-The Supplier invoice amount is (say X+1) but it is not reflecting -After GR/IR run, Project Management - Not Invoiced Time and Expenses still shows only GSR amount-Cause-If a supplier invoice item is based on a goods receipt item it is not considered to be expense relevant – however the goods receipt item is expense relevant. That is why the mentioned invoice does not appear in the list of not invoiced times and expenses.-For example, if supplier invoice does not have reference to a goods receipt and can been seen in the list of not invoiced times and expenses.-A special case: if you have for example a goods receipt item with  quantity 1 and price 100Z(Z refers to currency) referring to the purchase order say PO1 and create a supplier invoice item with quantity 3 for the same PO1 then you will see two documents in the list of not invoiced times and expenses; one of them (with quantity 1) will refer to the goods receipt and another (with quantity 2) to the supplier invoice.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Not invoiced time and expense, supplier invoice amount not showing in project not invoiced time and expense

Title: Approval Process Is Not Getting Triggered
Content: Symptom-An approval process which contains specified currencies is not getting triggered.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-There is no one specific method to reproduce this issue, it can happen for several objects, in many variations.-For example:-You created an approval process which contains conditions relating to one or more currencies.-However, when you create an object and maintain the settings to match the conditions, no approval is triggered.-Cause-The issue is related to missing exchange rates in relation to the approval process. The system will always check the entire approval pocesss - which may have many steps - and each Step may have many conditions.-For the system to decide whether a particular condition satisfies your object's details or not, the system will need exchange rates maintained.-For the approval conditions to be correctly evaluated, there should be a currency conversion maintained between the currency used in the object the approval is for, and all currencies mentioned in the respective approval process. The exchange rates should be maintained in both directions for all currencies.-The system compares each approval step's conditions with that of the document so we need all the exchange rates combinations to be available.-Resolution-Please check if the Exchange rates are configured properly.-Go to the Administration work centre.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select 'Exchange Rate For Foreign Currencies'.-Perform the set-up as per your requirements. -See Also-SAP Help Portal:-Currency Conversion Rates-Configure Currencies, Measurement Units and Values

Title: Advanced Search for Customer Demand Not Working As Expected
Content: Symptom-In Advanced Search, the Date and Time Zone to filter the order by date XX.XX.XXXX and Time Zone YYY however the system is returning different values, although the time zone in the order is the same YYY.-*XX.XX.XXXX = Requested Delivery Date.-*YYY = Time Zone.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Select Customer Demand view. -Select the Advanced Search. -Enter the Date Type ads Requested Delivery Date: XX.XX.XXXX and Time Zone YYY. -Choose Go. -Notice that orders with Requested Date different from XX.XX.XXXX is returned. -Cause-The user is configured with a different Time Zone who is fetching the results.-Although the time zone in the order is YYY, the time zone displayed in the results is being used with the time zone set for the user.-Resolution-As the query shows the date based in the configuration of your user, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-Time, zone, query, filter

Title: Contract belonging to other company is used in Purchase order.
Content: Symptom-You expect that system should not allow to use a contract that belongs to other company in Purchase order .-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Purchase request and orders work center- Go to Puchase orders View- Search and edit respective Purchase order- Go to source of supply tab- Enter a contract that belongs to other company.- You see no error or warning or information message raised.-Cause-While creating a list price its not currently a mandate to provide company. Now if errors should be thrown then we need to add this additional check related to company there fore we need to forcefully ask customers to add company in list prices. which is a new change.So we cannot consider it as wrong behavior.-Resolution-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign ,so we allow the Contract belonging to other company is used in Purchase order.-1.If you are a partner: you can help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2.If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.-Or      -a. Contact your the Account Executive-b. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-3. An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886

Title: Sales order not appearing in the Project under sales tracking tab
Content: Symptom-Sales order is linked to the project but still you cannot see the sales order in the Project.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management Work center-Go to projects-Search and open respective project-Go to Sales tracking tab-Go to Document Flow tab-You cannot see the sales order-Go to sales order assignment tab -You can see the documents-Cause-The sales tracking tab is built on sales order data that is sent to project management.-Resolution-So the document flow shows the sales order depending on its status:-If status is “In Process”, so it has been submitted and communicated to other areas for further processing so such sales orders will be visible  in project-If status is “In Preparation”, due to this status it has not been communicated to other areas yet so such sales orders will be visible  in project-See Also-Same is applicable for sales quote as well

Title: Approvals not triggered as expected(applicable for all SRM approvals other than Purchase order)
Content: Symptom-You noticed that  one item of invoice has Purchase order reference and other item does not have Purchase order reference ,the approval is not triggered for the one that has Purchase order reference though all conditions are met.- or- You notice one item has  particular cost center and other has some other cost center and approval is not triggered for the one  that has  particular cost center and not for the other.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In approval process of Supplier invoice you have a approval step/steps that has below conditions together or separate.-1.Item Without Purchase Order is Yes-2.Item Without Purchase Order is No-Then create a supplier invoice with one item having Purchase order reference and other having no Purchase order reference.-You will notice that approval is not triggered for the one that has Purchase order reference though both conditions are met.-Cause-Currently we don't support Item level approval for Approvals related to SRM documents like Shopping carts,goods receipts, purhase requests, Request for quotation ,supplier invoice etc except purchase orders.- The documnet details are considered as whole and not item wise individually.-Thus currently only when details of all items together meet the group of conditions of particular approval step , only then approval is triggered for that approval step as expected.-Example related to supplier invoice is given below:-General logic for current behavior as to why one particular approval step works and not the other is given below:-1.In general regarding this condition related to PO reference ,we expect approval when Item has no purchase order reference and thus system checks if the Item has no Purchase order reference to trigger approval, once approval is triggered then even if other conditions exist that will be ignored.-2. In general Regarding the condition Related to Account assignment like cost center ,we expect approval when has that particular cost center and thus  system checks if the item has this cost center to trigger approval,once approval is triggered then even if other conditions exist that will be ignored.-Resolution-This feature to of taking individual item in to consideration  to trigger approvals is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-1.If you are a partner: you can help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2.If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.-Or      -a. Contact your the Account Executive-b. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-3. An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Supplier invoice, approval,Cost center approval not triggered, Item having Purchase order, item not having cost center

Title: Error in Activate Tax trace: Application log information for this run is not available
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase document and activated the tax trace but when you display the tax trace, you get an error:-Application log information for this run is not available.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select New Purchase Order under Common Tasks.-Enter all details and select Actions-> Activate Tax trace.-Save.-Now select "Display Tax Trace" at items level-> taxes tab.-Error: Application log information for this run is not available.-Cause-You have changed the tax code manually. If you manually change the tax code, then the tax decision tree will not work.-Resolution-Please do not make manual changes in the tax code which is automatically determined by the system, then the tax trace will display the tax decision tree to show how the tax has been determined.-See Also-2427419 - How to use Activate Tax Trace-Keywords-Activate tax trace, Application log information for this run is not available, tax decision tree

Title: System triggers error "Requesting purchase proposal number  not possible" when trying to release purchase proposal
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release purchase proposal XYZ, Error appears*XYZ refers to purchase proposal id-Material XYZ is not active for purchasing-Requesting purchase proposal number not possible-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control Work Center-In common tasks, Navigate to  New planning proposal-Maintain product, UoM, quantity and planning area-Select  Release-Error appears-Cause-In Material Master XYZ of  purchasing tab, Status has been set as Blocked.-Resolution-To resolve, You will have to activate the status of Material in XYZ of Purchasing tab-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center-Navigate to By Materials-Search for XYZ-Select and Edit XYZ-Navigate to Purchasing tab -Select Active-Select Save-Keywords-Requesting purchase proposal number not possible, Material  is not active for purchasing, when trying to release purchase proposal

Title: Project Invoice Request ID not found in Revenue Contribution [PROCPIU03] data source.
Content: Symptom-Project invoice request not found-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Project Management work center-2. Go to Project Invoice Request work center view-3. Filter by desired Request Invoice Request-4. You can see it-  5. Go to Business Analytics work center-6. Go to Design Data Sources work center view-7. Search for the 'Revenue Contribution' data source-8. Click on Preview-9. Filter by same ID on 'Project Invoice Request ID'-10. You can see no results-Cause-The given data source PROCPIU03 does not show all cancelled customer project invoice requests (it shows cancelled CPIRs that are still invoiced, but it does not show cancelled CPIRs that are not invoiced or invoicing is cancelled ), because the purpose of the data source is not to provide a list of all CPIRs, but  information with regards to team members that can be invoiced or is already invoiced.-Resolution-So cancelled CPIRs and those  cancelled CPIR's that  are not  invoiced ,are not relevant thus they don't appear in this report

Title: Shipping Duration and Transport Lane Priority are Missing When Exported to Excel from Transport Lane.
Content: Symptom-When export to excel is performed from Transport Lane view, you observe Fields  like Shipping Duration and Transport Lane Priority are not part of the excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data workcenter-2. Go to Transport Lanes view.-3. Select Export to Microsoft Excel.-3. In the Excel you will notice that  shipping durations & the transport lane priority are not exported to excel.-Cause-Shipping durations & the transport lane priority are calculated fields on the UI and hence cannot be exported to Excel.-  Resolution-Excel Export does not support calculated fields. System behaves as expected.-Keywords-Transport Lane, Export to Microsoft Excel, Shipping Duration, Priority.

Title: How to get Tax Amount, Net Amount and Gross Amount in the Purchase Order Report?
Content: Symptom-You have a business need to see the report or data source for purchase order which shows net value, gross value and tax amount for line items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Go to the Design Reports or Design Data Sources-Search for a report which provides Gross Amount and Tax Amount-No direct reports or data sources available-Cause-You can use the data source Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details or Purchase Order Item Details to get the required fields in the purchase order reports.-Resolution-The Tax Amount field and Gross Amount field is stored with in Adapt mode and you need to enable it. To do so;-You can go to Business Analytics work centerand select Design Data Sources view-Search for Data Source Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details or Purchase Order Item Details -Select Adapt button -You can see the TaxAmount field and Add field Name as Tax Amount-Gross Amount is a calculated based on the List Unit Price. Select the field ListUnitPrice/Amount and name it as Gross Price or List Unit Price-Now select Add button and selectc Close-Now you can build a report based on this data source or you can use the existing report which is based on the above mentioned data sources-Keywords-purchase order report gross price; purchase order report tax amount; Report for tax amount; Net Amount report; PO tax amount report; PO Gross Amount report;

Title: How to Cancel Stock Transfer Delivery Notification when all subsequent documents are cancelled
Content: Symptom-What are the steps to cancel Stock Transfer Delivery Notification when all subsequent and preceding documents are canceled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to the Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Search and Select the relevant Stock Transfer Delivery Notification. -The Inbound Delivery Notification is in status "Received". -Cause-The Inbound Delivery Notification must be with status "Advised" for cancellation.-Resolution-To cancel the Stock Transfer Delivery Notification, kindly follow the below steps-Go to the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to the Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Set the relevant Stock Transfer Delivery Notification (by choosing Actions button) to "Advised".-Perform Undo Cancellation on the relevant Stock Transfer Outbound Delivery. -Choose Save.-Choose Cancel and Save the changes.-Now the Stock Transfer Delivery Notification is updated to Canceled state.-Keywords-How to Cancel Stock Transfer Delivery Notification, Stock Transfer  Delivery Notification  as Canceled, Inbound Delivery Notification shows as received, Stock Transfer Delivery Notification  as "Set to Advised", cancel, IDN, 3PL IDN, received, status

Title: Error while Posting Supplier Invoice: Document date too old ; Receipt date must not be more than 10 years in the past
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a supplier invoice but receive the following error:-Document date too old; Receipt date must not be more than 10 years in the past.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Select the respective Invoice-Click Check-Error: "Document date too old; Receipt date must not be more than 10 years in the past"-Cause-If the document(invoice) date/ receipt date is more than 10 years old, it is not possible to post it with that old document/receipt date.-Resolution-You can change the document/receipt date to later date so that it is within 10 years and then you can post it.-If you still want to post the document with the old document date, then you can include the old invoices on the Open Items Payable migration (Business Configuration->Migration of Accounting Transaction Data). It will create a version of the invoice that has a posting date same as migration date, but you can maintain the old document date and it will show up on the aging list as such. There'll be no "source document" created, i.e. if you try to open the invoice on the UI it will not show anything, but there'll be an accounting posting for it and it will be a document that is represented in the system, even though an old one. If there's taxes, they can also be included via the template.-Keywords-Document date too old; Receipt date must not be more than 10 years in the past, unable to post supplier invoice

Title: error message:Product ID missing; enter product ID
Content: Symptom-In Purchasing contract you will receive this error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When item type is either material or service then product Id is mandatory though you have Product category already maintained.-Resolution-So you can either enter Product ID or change item type to Product category.-See Also- Product ID missing; enter product ID or product category ID

Title: Wrong Input Product Quantity calculation in Production Task on The Basis of Changed Planned Quantity in Production Order
Content: Symptom-You sometimes as per your business requirement have to change the Planned Quantity of the Input Materials in the Production Order before it is released. However, whenever you perform this change, you discover that the system does not calculate the Input Products Quantity during the Confirmation of the Make Task on the basis of the Input Material ratio you have maintained in the relevant Bill of Material. Instead, the system is basing the Input Products Quantity on the changed value of the Planned Quantity in the Production Order.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Orders view and select By Order Header.-Find and select the relevant Production Order with the Status: In Preparation.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Products tab, and then to the Input Products sub-tab.-Select the relevant Input Products and reduce the Planned Quantity according to your business requirement.-Save and Release the Production Order.-Finish the Supply Task if relevant.-Now open the Make Task and click the Confirm button.-Enter your required Quantity in the Confirmed Quantity field under the Confirmation tab and hit the return key on your keyboard.-Navigate to the Input Products sub-tab.-You can see that the system is calculating the Quantity of the Input Products that you have changed their Planned Quantity in the Production Order as a fraction of the new Planned Quantity of the Production Order instead of the Quantity ratio maintained in the Bill Of Materials (BoM).-You expected the system to use the Input Product to Output Product ratio maintained in the BoM to calculate the Quantity instead of the changed Planned Quantity from the Production Order.-Cause-It is expected behavior from the task to calculate the input products quantity based on Planned Quantity in Production order. In the Production Order, we give the flexibility to change the Planned quantity.-If such changes are made, then the Task will calculate the quantities as per the changed Planned Quantity.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-See Also- 2531650 - New Customer Request for Additional Feature or Function in SAP standard software.-Keywords-Input Products, Planned Quantity, Confirmed Quantity, BoM, Production Order

Title: Production Task ID Are Not in Sequence. Task With Setup Activity is Assigned the First Task ID.
Content: Symptom-You created a Production Order based on a Master Data with a Supply Task, and multiple Make Tasks. When you release the Production Order, and the Tasks are generated, you notice that the Production Task IDs are not in sequence. For example, the Supply Task which is the first Task has the ID: B and the second Task which is the first Make Task the ID: C, while the third Task which is the second Make Task has the ID: A. However, you expect the Supply Task to be A. The first make Task to be B. And the third Task which is the second Make Task to be C.-A, B, and C represents the Task IDs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control workcenter.-Go to the Production Order view.-Find and select the relevant Production Order.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Order Structure tab.-You can see that the Supply Task ID and Make Task ID are not in sequence.-Cause-For the relevant Production Order, you have maintained the Operation in the third Task as a Setup Activity. When the system creates the Tasks, it assigns the first available Task Number to the Operation having a Setup Activity, because it is not dependent on any other Operation (SUPPLY_001).-Resolution-This is an expected behavior. If your issue is related to sequencing and you want the Tasks in sequence as in the Bill of Operation (BOO), then you should change the Activity Type to ‘Produce’ instead of ‘Setup’, and the system would generate the Tasks in order.-See Also-2597520 - Production Task ID are not in Sequence-Keywords-Setup, Tasks, Sequence Production Task, Operation, Activity, Production Order, Make Task, Supply Task

Title: Total Gross Amount and Total tax Amount details are not copied While Creating New Invoice From Intelligent Invoice Scanning
Content: Symptom-Total gross amount and total tax amount details are not copied from the intelligent scanned document while creating new invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Scanning view and select relevant ID-Select Review button-You can see Total Tax Amount and Total Gross Amount in the Scanned Values and Reviewed Values -However when you select Create Invoice, Total Gross Amount and Total Tax Amount does not fill-Cause-Currently when the Purchase Order is scanned and taken over into Invoice, all the information is picked from Purchase Order and the scanned values are ignored. This is currently as part of our roadmap backlog topic and considering for future releases.-Resolution-If you want system to pick the scanned values, you can remove the Purchase Order in review screen and then click on Create Invoice. This way system will pick up the Total gross amount and total tax amount details in the new invoice screen. Later you can add the Purchase Order references but this would again overwrite some of the values once Purchase Order is added. Also please note that the removal of Purchase Order needs to be done, before the First Invoice for the PDF is created.-Keywords-Intelligent invoice scanning; Total gross amount and total tax amount; Total gross amount; total tax amount; Create invoice

Title: The Diference Between Destructed Quantity and Nonconforming Units in Inspection
Content: Symptom-You have activated the Inspection process in your configuration, and you would like to understand the difference between Destructed Quantity, and Nonconforming Units in an Inspection. You think the help document "Process an Inspection" does not provide enough information.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Quality Control work center.-Go to the Inspections view.-Find and select the relevant Inspection document.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Results tab if you are not already there.-You can see the fields "Destructed Quantity" and "Nonconforming Units".-Now you want to understand the difference between these 2 terms.-Resolution-Destructed Quantity: From functional standpoint, refers to the numbers of units that got destructed as a part of inspection. For example, for testing tensile strength of items, sometimes, you inspect the material to the point of breaking the item. These Specimen are destructed Quantity.-Nonconforming Units: These refer to the Inspection Units which are not conforming to the inspection standards. These could be quantities, which might be destroyed or not destroyed or may be intended to be destroyed later.-Keywords-Quality Control, Inspection, Destructed Quantity, Nonconforming Units

Title: Posting of Supplier Invoice via Webservice With More Than one Cost Distribution is not Supported
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post the supplier invoice via Web Service API - ManageSupplierInvoiceIn with more than one cost distribution assignment. However system creates only one cost assignment with 100% distribution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the SOAP UI and load the Payload Request -Call the Web Service API - ManageSupplierInvoiceIn -Login and execute the web service-In the Payload you can see two Cost Distributions with Percentage assignment-After execution, system creates Supplier Invoice with one Cost Distribution and 100% assignment-Cause-In the current release, we do not support multiple account assignment distribution when creating supplier invoices through web service.-Resolution-This can be taken as a new requirement and kindly post the idea in influence forum- https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886.-Create multiple account assignments for a single item is possible in Purchase Order and not in Supplier Invoice.-In Supplier invoiceCost Distribution items are those items which refer to multiple Goods and Service Receipts items created for a single Purchase Order item where the ordered quantity is split to multiple deliveries. So action Add Assignment does not support the action parameters of adding percentage and amount.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice Cost Distribution; Supplier Invoice Cost Distribution via web service; Distribution of costs in Supplier invoice

Title: Error 'Proposed quantity not possible. The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments' appears during Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-System throws the following error messages when proposing quantities during Post Goods Issue.-"Action failed;Proposed quantity not possible. The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Delivery Proposals View.-Search for Delivery Request XXX and select it.-Choose Post Goods Issue button.-Select line item and choose Propose Quantities button, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-Due to no active Barcode selected in Business Configuration, the mentioned error occurs as expected.-For using Serial Numbers, it is necessary to enable Bar Code functionality in Business Configuration and to maintain the correct Application Identifier relevant for your Bar Code scanning.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to resolve the issue.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Navigate to Implementation Project view.-Select the relevant Implementation Project.-Choose Edit Project Scope button.-Go to Step 3: Scoping.-Expand element Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Expand element Task Management and Automation.-Make sure that the indicator of Automatic Identification is marked.-Go to Step 4: Questions.-Mark sure that the question "Do you plan to work with UCC/EAN 128 bar codes? " is scoped for element Automatic Identification.-Choose Next button and Accept Preselected Answers button.-Choose Open Activity List button.-In the Activity list, Show All Activities and search for Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128.-Select it and choose Open button.-In the Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128 screen, we recommend that you use the provided standard EAN128 Bar Code type which contains all relevant Application Identifiers including 21 for Serial Numbers.-Once you set the EAN128 Bar Code type active, you should be able to Post Goods Issue/ Receipt with Serial Number without the error.-After saving your changes, you may need to log out of the system for these to take effect. -[Note: This solution is also suitable for inbound logistics scenario. ]-See Also-2440113 - Error message 'The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments' appears during Post Goods -Keywords-Post Goods Issue,Post Goods Receipt, Business Configuration, Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128, Serial Number, Automatic Identification, Application Identifier, Quantity Differs.

Title: Outbound Deliveries Can be Released even Mandatory Fields Not Maintained
Content: Symptom-Outbound Deliveries can be released even if the mandatory fields are not maintained.-or-The G/L Account field is designated as mandatory, but a Purchase Order can still be generated when the Account Assignment is inputted as Cost Center, without necessarily setting the G/L Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Open a not released outbound delivery ABC (ABC refers to the outbound delivery ID), view all.-Go to General tab, you see there is an extension field DEF marked as mandatory by key user, but not maintained yet.-Release it, you see error: Save rejected because field (DEF) is defined as mandatory by key user. -Close the document (Object Instance Floorplan (OIF) screen).-Go back to Outbound Deliveries view (Object Work List (OWL) screen).-Select outbound delivery ABC, release it.-Outbound delivery ABC could be release without any errors, this is not expected.-Cause-If the key user marks an extension field as mandatory, there will be a validation check when you release the Outbound Delivery or Purchase Order within the document screen (OIF screen).-If the mandatory field value is missing, there is a UI error that prevents the Outbound Delivery or Purchase Order from being released. However, the UI error is specific to the OIF screen. There is no such validation check from the Outbound Delivery or Purchase Order screen (OWL screen). Hence, when you release Outbound Delivery or Purchase Order from OWL screen, even though the mandatory field value is missing, no error would be raised and the document can be released successfully.-Resolution-To enable validation check on OWL screen, you can create a custom solution (PDI Add-on) which validates if the value existing for mandatory extension fields on save.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Extension Field, Mandatory Field, Value Missing, Purchase Order, Object Instance Floorplan

Title: How to Change Number Range of Identified Stock
Content: Symptom-System generates the following error message when changing the number range of Identified Stock in Business Configuration.-Error: "Update for from number UNIIST_INTERVAL failed; interval is already in use."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open activity Number Ranges for Identified Stock.-Change the Prefix from ABC to DEF.-Change the Begin Number from XXX to YYY.-Change the End Number from ZZZ to PPP.-Choose Save.-System throws the error-Error: Update for from number UNIIST_INTERVAL failed; interval is already in use.-(ABC is the old Prefix, DEF is the new Prefix, XXX is the old Begin Number, YYY is the new Begin Number, ZZZ is the old End Number, PPP is the new End Number)-Cause-Changes can be made to the Number Range for Identified Stock as long as no Identified Stock has been created in the system.-Once the first Identified Stock is created, only the End Number and Prefix can be modified; the Begin Number cannot be changed.-Note: The End Number can be modified only to a value greater than the last generated Identified Stock ID; it cannot be set to a value less than or equal to the last generated ID.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Identified Stock; IStock; Number; Range; Numbering; Prefix; End Number; Begin Number; Identified Stock ID; Update For From Number UNIIST_INTERVALFfailed; Interval Is Already In Use; SAP Business ByDesign

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2011 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2011 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 16th of January. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2011 HFC 3-Resolution-Cross – Area Topic-UI Client-With the fix provided, the following issues have been resolved.-Mismatch of Hebrew and English letters and numbers in materials, in the Purchase and Sales UIs.-Blank space shown on clicking the Calculator icon in the table row, while using macOS Big Sur and Safari 14.-(Hotfix ID: 4500009986. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Errors detected due to inconsistencies in the bgRFC (background Remote Function Call) tenant runtime environment, with destination DEFAULT, have now been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 4500009117)-The fix provided resolves the following issues.-Checkbox selection-Error popup when opening a QA page causing it to close quickly-Incorrect title of Payment Proposal export-(Hotfix ID: 4500009073)-The issue with the alignment of amounts caused due to the UI5 grade has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500010892)-Analytics-The fixed provided reduces the memory consumption of the analytical framework during the execution of broadcasts. (Hotfix ID: 4500008449)-In the report Supplier Details within the Supplier Base work center, the industry sector was displayed without the corresponding text. The fix provided ensures that the text is displayed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009624)-Account Management-In Account Management, when creating a new contact and navigating via the View All button to the contact's details, an issue was causing an error message to appear, preventing any further action. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500007379)-Through the fix provided changes of attachments to business partners, including creation and deletion, are now displayed in the corresponding change log. (Hotfix ID: 4500010093)-Business Partner-The fix provided resolves the issue with the Favorites tab and allows marking of business partners including accounts, contacts, and suppliers as favorites, along with navigation from the Favorites tab in the UI. (Hotfix ID: 4500009744. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Customer Relationship Management-Customer Quote-When creating a sales quote with reference to a project, the quantities were transferred but with the wrong unit of measure (UoM). The fix provided resolves this issue and ensures that the UoM is copied correctly from the project. (Hotfix ID: 4500007914)-Customer Invoicing-The fix provided ensures that, while creating invoice schedules for sales orders and customer contracts, the invoice schedule amounts are calculated based on occurrences for distributed invoice schedule types, and not on the percentage. (Hotfix ID: 4500010563)-In Customer Invoice Request items, relevant for India and South Korea invoices, when additional items were added on a sales order, the Tax Reporting Unit was not getting determined. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009694. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix provided resolves the following issues for India e-invoice request file generation. -HSN code determination for invoices with individual item products wherein the issue with IsService field determination for individual item products is resolved. -Export of pin codes containing special characters (export pin codes). -Support for currency conversion to INR for foreign currencies. (Hotfix ID: 4500008889. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-For Switzerland, the QR code now takes into account the down payment for customer invoices. (Hotfix ID: 4500010284/ EP ID: 10168. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Sales Orders-Delivery priority update for partially delivered sales orders was not possible due to error. With the fix provided, you can now update the delivery priority of sales orders at the header level through MBF and Odata services, when some of the sales order items are already delivered. (Hotfix ID: 4500003378)-Leads-The Microsoft Excel upload of leads was creating leads without the passed values in the respective extension fields. This was caused because the web service ManageLeadIn used for the Excel upload was not available in the Further Usage screen to add the created extension fields to the service and perform mapping in the Excel template. (Hotfix ID:4500011231)-Financial Management-Financial Planning-When the Microsoft Excel upload of a financial plan contained a combination of valid and invalid General Ledger (GL) accounts, an issue was causing the Excel upload error log to display all the GL accounts as invalid. This caused difficulties in identifying the actual invalid GL accounts. The fix provided resolves this issue and ensures that only the actual invalid GL accounts are displayed in the error log. (Hotfix ID: 4500008105)-Bank Statement-The fix provided facilitates the mapping of payment method through a proprietary set of tags when ISO 20022 file format is used for creating Bank Statements. (Hotfix ID: 4500008817)-Due to an error in file mapping, some payment advice Camt.054 files were being rejected by the system, particularly when the date field, <FrToDt> was not filled. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500009317)-In the payment service provider, Treasury Intelligence Solutions (TIS), the payment batch file contained a Central Bank Reporting structure- value 999999, a default value that should not be included in the batch payment for non-localized countries. This issue occurred post the availability of Payment Reason codes for all scoped countries in the November 2020 release of SAP Business ByDesign. With the fix provided, this issue has been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 4500009347. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-General Ledger-The fix provided ensures that, when an extraction run for financial data is executed with a split indicator and the files are merged while downloading, the merging of the split files happens in the correct sequence, so that the header is always at the top. (Hotfix ID: 4500008989)-Cost and Revenue-An issue was causing the Revenue Recognition Run for a canceled customer contract item to fail with a rounding difference error. The error was occurring when an invoice was created and cancelled and the net value is 0 (as seen in sales document items OWL), and the overall invoiced amount at the revenue accounting contract level was higher than what could be billable when the run was executed. This issue has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500011140)-When a revenue recognition run was performed for multiple documents, an issue at the revenue accounting contract level was causing contract Assets to be posted when it was determined that contract liabilities were to be posted, and vice-versa. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500010991)-Payment Management-In the Foreign Payment format - Japan, the Bank Account Type field was displaying the payee's bank account type instead of the company's bank account type. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500000859)-Tax Management and Declaration-Issues with the creation of 1099-NEC (Non-employee Compensation) return, have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500011133. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The Non-employee Compensation income type has been removed from the 1099-MISC return as it should be reported only under the 1099-NEC return from 2020 onwards. (Hotfix IDs: 4500010414, 4500009692. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix provided ensures that the payment explanation item containing the net and gross amounts which was being sent only for tax prepayment is now also sent for the regular tax due payment so that the information is available to the remittance advice as well. (Hotfix ID: 4500008226)-It was not possible to execute the Annual Returns tax return for Austria from January 1, 2020, as the valid From date for the tax rate type 5 (exceptional reduced) and its corresponding tax return mapping entries started from July 1, 2020. A fix is provided to address this issue, wherein the valid From date for tax rate type 5 is advanced to January 1, 2020, from the earlier July 1, 2020. This is purely a technical workaround to enable the execution of the Annual Returns tax return from January 1, 2020. (Hotfix ID: 4500009745)-New Natura codes introduced with the law 20/04/20 (regulatory implementation art. 1 d.Lgs. n. 127/15), have been made mandatory starting from January 2021. The new codes are 4 positions long instead of the previous length of 2 positions. This change impacts the Italy Spesometro-Outgoing and Italy Spesometro-Incoming tax return files, with the Natura node in these files taking in the new 4-character natura codes. The fix provided ensures that the new codes are available by the middle of January. (Hotfix ID: 4500010353)-The fix provided ensures Tax Reporting Unit determination for the line items on India and South Korea-based customer contracts, created via the web service. (Hotfix ID: 4500011610. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix provided contains changes for VAT, applicable from January 1, 2022, for Qatar and from April 1, 2021, for Oman. (Hotfix ID: 4500009337. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix provided contains the following changes:-The number of spaces in the B-record has been adjusted as per the official IRS notification for 1099-NEC.-Vendors with no amounts are not visible on the 1099-NEC form. (Hotfix ID: 4500010651. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix provided contains tax rate changes for Germany. Due to COVID-19, the standard VAT rate had been changed to 16% from 19%, and the reduced VAT rate to 5% from 7%, from July 1, 2020. The tax rates have now been reverted to 19% and 7% respectively, starting from January 1, 2021. (Hotfix ID:4500009722. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Financial Accounting-The fix provided ensures that E-Bilanz taxonomy DEGP10 is working as expected for the language DE (German). (Hotfix ID:4500008528.)-Expense Management and Report-The fix provided includes updates to Meals Per Diem (including Deductions) and Lodging Per Diem Rates for Expense Reports in Germany, from January 1, 2021, according to-https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Downloads/BMF_Schreiben/Steuerarten/Lohnsteuer/2020-12-03-steuerliche-behandlung-reisekosten-reisekostenverguetungen-2021.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=2 and-https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Downloads/BMF_Schreiben/Steuerarten/Lohnsteuer/2020-12-28-Lohnsteuerliche-Behandlung-unentgeltlichen-verbilligten-Mahlzeiten-Arbeitnehmer-Kalenderjahr-2020.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=4-(Hotfix ID: 4500009109)-The legal change for Great Britain (GB) fuel rates effective as of January 2021, has now been updated. (Hotfix ID: 4500007925. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The fix provided includes updates to Standard Mileage Rates for Expense Reports in the U.S. from January 1, 2021, according to-https://www.irs.gov/tax-professionals/standard-mileage-rates-https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/irs-issues-standard-mileage-rates-for-2021-(Hotfix ID: 4500010415)-The fix provided includes updates to Denmark (DK) Meals and Mileage rates. (Hotfix ID: 4500009187.This fix has already been delivered as a patch)-Brexit Changes-The fix provided includes SII tax return adjustments for the new changes of Brexit law. From January 1, 2021, any goods transaction between Spain and Mainland UK is considered as non-European Union (EU), and that between Spain and Northern Ireland (NI) is considered as EU, whereas the services transaction is considered as non-EU. (Hotfix ID: 4500009009. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Human Resources-Time and Labor Management-The fix provided includes SII tax return adjustments for the new changes of Brexit law. From January 1, 2021, any goods transaction between Spain and Mainland UK is considered as non-European Union (EU), and that between Spain and Northern Ireland (NI) is considered as EU, whereas the services transaction is considered as non-EU. (Hotfix ID: 4500009009. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Extension Field1, available under the ITEM node of TIMX_EMPLOYEE_TIME business object, has now been write-enabled for the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 4500009125. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-People Management-The issues caused while launching the Overview view of the Managing My Area work center, have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500008269)-  Supply Chain Management-Production Model Management-Hierarchical View node in Bill of Operations (BoO) is now enabled for the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 4500010741)-Actions on the Production Model have been enabled for the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 4500010794. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Production Lot-Event association has been read-enabled for the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 4500010585)-Inbound Delivery Request-For an inbound delivery, the External Document Indicator in the item node has now been write-enabled for the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 4500011370)-Supplier Relationship Management-Intrastat Valuation and Declaration-The fix provided includes Intrastat Adoption to support the United Kingdom (UK) leaving the European Union (EU). (Hotfix ID: 4500008278. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Supplier Invoicing-The runtime error caused during the creation of supplier invoices through India purchase orders and down payment requests has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500010572)-The fix provided includes changes to ensure that feedback values are sent to the Machine Learning (ML) service for improving accuracy and faster retraining. (Hotfix ID: 4500009578. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)--*Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g. operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2011; HFC03; Hotfix; SPS03; Hotfix Collection; 2011

Title: Value Displayed In The Field Main Output Identified Stock Type.
Content: Symptom-You want to know when does system populate value in the field Main Output Identified Stock Type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Production Control work center.-Navigate to the Production Orders view-Select the relevant production order and choose the Edit button.-Under the General tab you can see field Main Output Identified Stock Type with no values updated in the same. -Cause-The value of identified stock type of output product will displayed when an identified stock Id is maintained in the production order for the output product.-Resolution-To maintain identified stock id for output product in the production order follow the below given steps.-Go to Production Control work center. -Navigate to the Production Orders view-Select the relevant production order and choose the Edit button. -Under Products tab, select the Output Product sub-tab. -You can select the output product and maintain the identified stock Id for the output product here. -Choose the Save button. -Navigate to the General tab and you can see the value of Identified stock type visible in the field Main Output Identified Stock Type.-Keywords-value in the field-Main Output Identified Stock Type, -Main Output Identified Stock Type value

Title: Warehouse Order Missing in Inventory Allocation Data Source
Content: Symptom-You have created the Pick Task for the Warehouse Order XXX and even so, the document is missing in Inventory Allocation data source.-XXX = Warehouse Order ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center. -Go to Design Data Sources view.-Search for the Inventory Allocation data source. -Click Preview. -Go to View.-Click Add Fields to Row.-Add Warehouse Order ID field.-You can see there is no Warehouse Order ID XXX.-Cause-The data source Inventory Allocation only displays the allocation information for the outbound process against Logistics Areas where the stock exists.-In case of Warehouse Order XXX, the relevant material is allocated against a Logistics Area which does not have any stock, and hence this Logistics Area and the Warehouse Order is not displayed in the result.-Resolution-As the report only displays the allocation for Logistics Area where the stock exists, the system is working as expected.-See Also-2669137 - Inventory Allocation Report Does Not Display Data-Keywords-SCMINVALLOC, report, allocated

Title: Inconsistency in 3PL Inventory Notification With Error "Corresponding Transfer Item is Not Unique or Does Not Exist"
Content: Symptom-You have a Third-Party Inventory Notification inconsistent, and when you click on Check Consistency button, error message Item XXX-YY: Corresponding transfer item is not unique or does not exist (XXX meaning the Internal Notification ID and YY the Item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Go to the 3PL Inventory Management view and select Inventory Notifications sub-view.-Search for XXX.-See that Notification Status is Inconsistent.-Click on the Check Consistency button.-Error message appears: Item XXX-YY: Corresponding transfer item is not unique or does not exist.-Cause-The product at Line YY has just a line with Movement Direction as Inventory Issue for Item Group XYZ (XYZ meaning the Item Group ID), and no line with Movement Direction as Inventory Receipt for the same.-Resolution-To solve the issue, you can follow the steps below:-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Go to the 3PL Inventory Management view and select Inventory Notifications sub-view.-Search for the Inventory Notification XXX.-Click on the Edit button.-Go to the Line Items tab, select the Add Row button, enter Item ID, Reason - Transfer, Movement Direction - Inventory Receipt. Here you have to enter the same values for Item Group ID which you have entered in the line item ID YY and fill in Product and Quantity columns too.-Either select the stock as restricted or enter a identified stock ID as you are doing a change of stock.-Later perform Check operation, the notification document will be consistent.-Keywords-Transfer Item, inconsistent, Inventory Notification, Third-Party, 3PL, Notification, not unique

Title: Not Able To Enable Externally-Managed Location Flag For A Site
Content: Symptom-While trying to select the Externally Managed Location flag for a Site you get the error - It is not possible to change the externally managed location indicator. Documents related to inbound logistics, outbound logistics, and purchasing still exists for this location.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Locations view.-Search for the relevant site/location which you want to uncheck and choose the Edit button.-In the Edit screen, check the Externally Managed Location flag.-You get the following error message, It is not possible to change the externally managed location indicator. Documents related to inbound logistics, outbound logistics, and purchasing still exists for this location. -Cause-When a site needs to be marked as externally managed (3PL) there are certain restrictions that apply to the site.-The site cannot have Location Layout nor a Storage Location below it.-When you select the relevant site, you can see that the Edit Layout button is enabled. This means that there is a location under the selected site.-As there is location layout for the site, you will not be able to enable the Externally Managed Location flag for the site. -Resolution-You have to create a new Site and have the Externally Managed Location enabled for the same.-Keywords-3PL site error, It is not possible to change the externally managed location indicator. Documents related to inbound logistics, outbound logistics, and purchasing still exists for this location, uncheck 3PL site, enable 3PL for a site

Title: Cannot Confirm Pick Task Using Web Service
Content: Symptom-When confirming the Pick Task XXX using web service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn, you receive the response "Saved Successfully", however no confirmation is created in the UI.-XXX = Task ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the Task ID XXX.-Select the Conirmations tab-Notice that no confirmation is created.-Cause-You are confirming a Pick Task which uses both Identified Stock and Serial Number and you are not passing the information in the xml request correctly.-Resolution-As the Serial Number is linked to the Identified Stock, in the xml you need to pass first the Identified Stock and then the Serial Number, in separated <MaterialOutput>. You can use the xml below as example:- <SiteLogisticsTask>-  <SiteLogisticTaskID>XXX</SiteLogisticTaskID>-  <SiteLogisticTaskUUID>000</SiteLogisticTaskUUID>-  <ReferenceObject>-   <ReferenceObjectUUID>000</ReferenceObjectUUID>-   <OperationActivity>-    <OperationActivityUUID>000</OperationActivityUUID>-    <MaterialOutput>-     <MaterialOutputUUID>000</MaterialOutputUUID>-     <ProductID>000</ProductID>-     <IdentifiedStockID>000</IdentifiedStockID>-    </MaterialOutput>-    <MaterialOutput>-     <MaterialOutputUUID>000</MaterialOutputUUID>-     <ProductID>000</ProductID>-     <SerialNumber>-      <SerialID>000</SerialID>-     </SerialNumber>-    </MaterialOutput>-   </OperationActivity>-  </ReferenceObject>- </SiteLogisticsTask>-Keywords-web; service; logistics; site

Title: Changes to Communication Arrangement Endpoints by a SAP-USER
Content: Symptom-You noticed that changes were made to your Communication Arrangement by a SAP technical user (SAP_LMPRV). Since the changes were not from you, now you are wondering what happened, and want an explanation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work centre.-Go to the Communication Arrangements view.-Find and select the Business Scenario "Third-Party Logistics Integration" with the relevant Business Partner.-Click the Edit button, and navigate to the Changes tab-Execute the query.-When you go through the Result, you can see that changes were made by the Technical User (SAP_LMPRV) at a given date.-Cause-You have requested a Tenant Refresh during the time frame. For any tenant refresh, Mail Configuration will run via this user.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-See Also-2757453 - Frequently Asked Question on Type of Users Available in the System.-2613056 - Details of SAP Admin, Support and Technical Users.-Keywords-SAP_LMPRV, Technical User, communication, Scenario, Arrangement

Title: How to automate the Product specification confirmation in Purchase order
Content: Symptom-How to do automatic Product specification confirmation while creating the purchase order from Bundle and Order screen or purchase order that was created from sales order automatically(Thirdparty  scenario) or Purchase order created via webservice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase request and orders-Go to Purchase requests View-Select  respective line-Click on Bundle and Order-Choose By Supplier-Click on Edit-Choose More options-Click on Confirm Product specification- or- Go to Purchase request and orders- Go to Purchase requests- Search and open relevant Purchase order- Click on Order button- You will see  below error- Item X: Product specification not confirmed; confirm product specification.- You confirm it and then order PO  but you want automatic creation of order without this manual confirmation-Cause-Currently not possible in standard system.-Resolution-Confirm Product Specification is binded to BO Action of Finish Data Entry Processing which is already PSM released. Kindly ask the partner to use the same and help achieve your requirement.-1.  If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-2.  If you are a customer:-Contact your the Account Executive-Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us

Title: Exchange rate X/Y on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion
Content: Symptom-While creating the Supplier Invoice the system throws an error message as Exchange rate ABC/DEF on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion(ABC represents Tax Currency and DEF represents Country Default Currency).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order under Common Tasks.-Create a supplier invoice with or without a purchase order reference.-Enter the required invoice details.-Choose Check.-The system displays the following error message:-"Exchange rate ABC/DEF on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion."-Cause-An Exchange Rate is required between:-Scenario 1 : Document Currency and Tax Country Currency.-Scenario 2 : Document Currency and Approval Process Condition Currency.-The error occurs when one of the above exchange rates is not maintained for the relevant posting date.-Scenario 1: Tax Country Currency:-The system requires an exchange rate between the supplier invoice document currency and the currency maintained for the tax country.-Steps to Check the Tax Country:-Open the Supplier Invoice document.-Navigate to the General tab.-Open the Taxes subtab.-Tax Country/Region field is maintained as XYZ.-Steps to Check the Tax Country Currency:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview.-Search for the fine-tuning activity Countries/Regions.-Open Edit Countries/Regions.-Select Country/Region XYZ.-The default currency for Country/Region XYZ is maintained as DEF.-Scenario 2: Approval Process Condition Currency:-The system may also require an exchange rate when an active supplier invoice approval process contains amount-based conditions using a specific currency.-Steps to Check the Approval Process:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Approval Processes view.-Open the active approval process for Supplier Invoice.-Review all approval steps and conditions to determine whether a currency-specific amount is maintained.-For example, an approval step may be configured with the condition:-Total Net Amount > 100 USD.-In this case, the system requires an
