exchange rate between the supplier invoice document currency ABC and USD for condition evaluation.-Resolution-Scenario 1:-Resolution 1: Maintain the Required Exchange Rate:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, select Edit Exchange Rates.-Maintain a valid exchange rate between currencies ABC and DEF for the date DD.MM.YYYY.-Save the changes.-The error in the affected supplier invoice should be resolved after maintaining the required exchange rate.-Resolution 2: Correct the Tax Country Currency:-If the default currency maintained in the Countries/Regions fine-tuning activity is not the expected currency for the respective tax country, update it accordingly.-After correcting the country currency, ensure that the required exchange rates are available.-Scenario 2:-Follow the steps provided in the below KBA for resolution.-KBA: 2101312 - Error Occurred While Trying to Evaluate Condition of a Process Step - SAP for Me-Keywords-Exchange rate error; Currency conversion error; Wrong exchange rate; Countries/Regions; Exchange rate; Approval Process; Condition Currency; General Ledger;

Title: Output channel: XML not available in Supplier master data
Content: Symptom-You have set up communication arrangement but XML option is not appearing in supplier master-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier base work center-Go to Suppliers-Search and open desired supplier-Go to communications tab-Go to collaboration tab-for Purchase Order the output channel "XML",  is not available in the drop down list-Cause-1.A scoping question is not selected."Do you want to send purchase orders electronically to your suppliers using electronic data exchange (EDX)?"-2. No communication arrangement is set up for this supplier-Resolution-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation projects view-Click on Edit scoping-Go to Step Questions-Go to Purchasing-Go to Purchase request and orders-Go to Communication for Purchase Request and Order Management-Select the question-Do you want to send purchase orders electronically to your suppliers using electronic data exchange (EDX)?-Save-Keywords- enable intercompany settings

Title: After 2011- System loading for long time while creating invoices
Content: Symptom-You may notice that system freezes or takes really long time while creating invoices-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to new invoice without Purchase order-Enter all details-Click on check or calculate totals or save -Cause-In the Business configuration activity:Supplier invoice exception under Possible Duplicate  the  External Document ID - Similarity (%) is set low like 1% to 20% and you have many invoices  that can become duplicates as they have 1% to 20% matching external ID. Then system tries to put all such invoices on to  exceptions tab of invoice as duplicates and if the number is huge it takes long time accordingly and if it takes way too long then system might even dump or freeze due to time out error.-Resolution-Please check the exceptions tab and  you can understand if the loading is due to Duplicate invoices or not.-So we suggest to maintain a more sustainable % such as 50% or above in general.-Keywords- Unabke tocrate invoice

Title: Time entry Error:Purchase Order Mandatory for Project of a Different Company
Content: Symptom-Purchase order not available in the service agent's timesheet or "Purchase order item not valid".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for the specific employee and select them.-Click on Edit.-Go to the Employee Times tab.-Add a new row to input time entry details.-Add a Project Task and fill in other required details, then click Enter.-At this point, you receive an error message: "Purchase Order Mandatory for Project of a Different Company."-When you open the Purchase Order dropdown menu, no options are available.-If you manually enter a Purchase Order ID, you encounter a new error: "Purchase order item not valid."-Cause-Cause 1: The project task is not used as the account assignment in the purchase order.-Cause 2: The employee is hired for Company XX, which can be verified by navigating to Time Administration > Employees > General or in Personal Profile > General Tab > Organizational Data.-However, on the Service Agent screen, the Supplier is listed as YY and Service Performer for is also YY. This information can be found in:-Supplier Base Work Center > Service Agent View.-Search for the Service Agent and open it.-Go to Relationships Tab.-By checking the "Is Service Performer For", you can see that it is set to YY.-Since neither the Supplier nor Service Performer for is listed as XX—and the Purchase Order (PO) specifies Supplier XX—the employee is unable to use this PO.-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1: -Ensure the use of a Purchase Order created from the project.-OR-Ensure the account assignment is set to "Project Task" when creating a manual Purchase Order, and that the Purchase Order is used in the timesheet.-Resolution for cause 2:-Go to the Supplier Base work center > Service Agent view > Relationships Tab and change Service Performer For to XX (the Supplier may be YY).-OR-Go to the Supplier Base work center > Service Agent view > General Tab and change Supplier to XX (this is the ideal approach since the employee is hired for Company XX). Also, in the Relationships Tab, change Service Performer For to XX.-Keywords-Not valid, Missing, Purchase order, Project, Time sheet

Title: How to action on Data Flow Verification results/why DFV is still open.
Content: Symptom-You have received email with below information:-Health Check Component: Data Flow Verification-Health Check Name: Problematic DFV-Runs detected-or you want to know why the Data Flow Verificationis still open.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Data Flow Verification Results View.-Find and select the respective Result ID.-Click on start document synchronization button if enabled.-If the repeat check button is enabled, then click on it to generate new action log which will shows current errors. Take action as per the errors and then click on Repeat check button. Follow this steps until no errors occurs. (If error still exists, search for help documents for those erros in help center to solve the errors)-Once done again do the synchronization and repeat check.-Also check if there are open tasks which respective users can restart  as mentioned in the KBA 2834513 - How to Restart a Process Communication Message in the User Interface -Also check the errors under application user management work center> process communication errors view> Open errors with incidents, then take action ad per the errors-Restart the stuck messages as per the details mentioned in above KBA.-Once done again do the synchronization and repeat check,  if still unable to resolve the error, kindly raise an incident for each unique error.-If the DFV has no errors or Repeat check is disabled, that means no action is required, please manually click on button"change status to closed" after confirming no error for the DFV.-Keywords-Health Check, Data Flow Verification, DFV, Problematic DFV-Runs detected

Title: Source Logistics Area is Not Proposed Automatically While Confirming Supply Task
Content: Symptom-Source Logistics Area is Not Proposed Automatically For the Product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the affected product) when confirming Production Supply Task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Work Centre Production Control. -View Task Control.-Search for the task XXX (XXX represents the exact ID of the task). -Click the button Confirm. -Search for the product ABC. -Result: You see that no Logistics Area is proposed by default.-Cause-Since the Target Logistics Area is same with Source Logistics Area, system will not propose the Source Logistics Area (as stock will be already present in the Target location specified).-Once an Order is released, system will move the values of the Logistics Area to the Task.-Resolution-This is the standard and expected behaviour of the system.-Keywords-Source Logistics Area, Not Proposed, Automatically, Task Confirmation, Production, Target Logistics Area

Title: Resource Load Does Not Update Changed Dates of Production Orders
Content: Symptom-You have changed the dates of a Production Order, however the dates of the Resource Load did not get updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view.-Search and select the relevant Production Order.-Click on Edit button.-Change the date on the field Earliest Start or Latest End.-Click on Save button.-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Resource Load view.-Search and open the relevant Resource Load.-You will see that the dates are not updated.-Cause-Currently, any changes on Production Order dates or quantities are not updated on the Resource Load. This is a standard behavior of the system.-Resolution-Since this is a standard behavior of the system, the dates will not be updated. As a workaround, you can make reschedulements on the Resource Load itself.-Keywords-Resource Load, Production Order, date, update, does not, changed

Title: Error :Form template is mandatory or  Error Message:There's no Template Code in the Predefined Output Determination Rule
Content: Symptom-Error occurs while trying to modify the quantity in the purchase order and click on Send Update button.-Error:-There’s no template code in the predefined output determination rule (KBA: 2982572)-Form template is mandatory. (KBA: 2982572)-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Search for the affected purchase order-Edit it and click on Check button or Click on Preview-Error appears-Cause-There is no determination rule maintained for the created purchase order or changed purchase order or cancelled purchase  order. Meaning the rule for changed purchase orders or interactive changed purchase orders or created purchase orders or canceled purchase orders is missing.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to maintain the form template selection rule;-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Form Template selection view-Select Show Rules For; Created Purchase Order/Changed Purchase Order / Cancelled Purchase Order-Select Go -Then enter a rule for desired combination of Company, Supplier, Purchasing Unit, Interactive process with required form template code, or enter fall back rule at the end with company, supplier, purchasing unit, interactive process as * with required form template code.-We recommend to maintain default rule for all other form templates like changed purchase order, canceled purchase order, customer invoice etc.-See Also-KBAs:-2769117 - In Purchase Order Out put history the Template Registered Products is appearing-2949502 - Error Template Code XXXX is Not Valid in the Output History-2845516 - No Template Code in the Predefined Output Determination Rule Error on Customer Invoice-Keywords-There's no template code in the predefined output determination rule; Form template is mandatory. (KBA: 2982572)

Title: Error During Creation of New Labels for Sales Kit
Content: Symptom-You would like to create New Labels for the Sales Kit KIT1 (where KIT1 is the Sales Kit's ID).- However, you encounter the below errors:-Action failed-Creating labels for sales kit not permitted-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work centre.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view-Find the Outbound Delivery OD1 (where OD1 is the Outbound Delivery corresponding to the Sales Kit KIT1).-Click on the New Labels button.-Click on Save.-The above errors are displayed.-Cause-It is not possible to print the Sales Kit header.-Resolution-This is expected behavior.-To print Labels for the Sales Kit items, remove the kit header row and then select the product and click on Save and Close.-This will generate the label for the product.-Keywords-Sales Kit, Sales Kit Header, New Labels, Outbound Deliveries, Print

Title: How to schedule  Data Flow Verification  runs to correct the discrepancy between Planning screen and Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You notice that the reported Quantity for a Product XXX (XXX represents the Product ID) in the Planning Area YYY (YYY represents the Planning Area ID) in the Stock Overview and in the Product Planning Details screens do not match. Now you would like to know how to schedule a Data Flow Verification run to synchronize the Quantity between the 2 views.-Data Flow Verification (DFV) compares pairs of business documents that are related to each other in a Data Flow Verification run. Data Flow Verification is available for a defined set of business document pairs covering the different applications in SAP Business ByDesign. The business documents contain the same data, if the system is running correctly and all data has been maintained correctly in the business documents. If the data is not correct, data flow verification finds differences in the data when comparing the business documents and collects the differences in the data flow verification result and the associated Application Log.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If you notice a difference in the reported Available Quantity in the Product Planning Details view and the On-Hand Quantity in the Stock Overview, you can create Data Flow Verification Run to address the issue. In order to correct the Inventory, you have to schedule a Data Flow Verification Run and this Run will update the inventory difference:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select Data Flow Verification Runs view.-Choose the Button 'New' and system opens a New Screen.-Enter the RUN ID and Description.-Choose next here and enter Planning View of Inventory as Business Document One.-Enter Inventory as Business Document Two.-Choose Next button.-Select product ID as Equal to and enter the relevant Product ID.-Similarly enter planning area ID as Equal to and enter the relevant Planning Area ID.-Choose next button, and select Automatically correct differences (recommended) checkbox and next-Choose next button and again next Review. Schedule the time to execute the job and then click confirm.-See Also- 2794944 - Difference Between Stock Overview and Product Planning-Keywords-Data Flow Verification runs, synchronize between stock overview and Planning screen, How to schedule DFV runs in ByDesign

Title: How to create or change the email text sent to Suppliers with output document
Content: Symptom-By default some format in email sent to Suppliers is appearing so you wanted to change it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Order-Select Purchase order-Click on copy-Click on You can also -> Edit output settings.-Choose sent by as e-mail-Go to E-mail text tab-Cause-You have to create email template and upload.-Resolution-Go to Application user management work center-Go to form template maintenance view-Select the required form-Click on Action button-Choose 'create email template 'option-Browse and add the HTML template- Once done ,all new Purchase order created will have the new template-Note: if you want help with creation of HTML template contact your partner.-Keywords-wrong text in email

Title: How to Exclude a Particular Approver who created the Purchase Order from getting the Approval Task?
Content: Symptom-Person A have created a Purchase Order and A is also assigned as the Direct Approver. But you do not want the approval to be triggered to A because he has created the order.-(A refers to the purchase order creator/approver)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Approval Processes view.-Select the Approval Process Overview: Purchase Order.-Set up a rule where approver is person A and set the condition to trigger approval when "requester is not equal to A"-Now log in as the person A and create a Purchase Order.-The order goes for approval to the same person A.-Cause-System will trigger approval based on the rule defined.-Here, there is no field called "requester" in purchase order screen, so system has triggered the approval based on the rule defined.-Currently there is no business option either to skip the approval or no approval required for the Direct Approver if approver himself creates the Purchase Order.-Resolution-For this usecase, you can set up a condition saying "created by does not match pattern *A*" (A refers to the name of the creator/approver).-Keywords-created by, purchase order approval, created by does not match pattern'

Title: System triggers error message "Transaction date must be between XXXX and today" when trying to perform Goods Movement
Content: Symptom-You are trying to enter date which is beyond past 6 months in Actual Execution on while performing Goods Movement.Error appears-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Internal Logistics Work Center-In Common tasks, Navigate to Goods Movement-Enter Site id, Planning Area and Actual Execution date which is beyond past 6 months from current date -Press Enter Key-Error appears "Transaction date must be between XXXX and today"*XXXX refers to Date which is beyond past 6 months -Cause-This is due to the legal compliance, it is not possible to perform any transaction which took place beyond past six months. The purpose of this check is to provide data entry control.-Resolution-However, if you want to post this transaction beyond past 6 months, please follow the steps provided in the KBA: 2823591 - Date Not Valid Error When Creating Physical Inventory Count/Adjustment OR Any Inventory Postings-See Also- 3042843 - Not Able To Post Beyond Six Months In The Past-Keywords-Transaction date must be between and today, Actual Execution date which is 6 months beyond from current date

Title: How to add extension fields into purchase order migration template
Content: Symptom-You want to add an extension field into purchase order migration template and you are wondering how to do that.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Filter the list 'All Documents', search and open purchase order ABC (ABC represents for the purchase order ID).-You have an extension field on the purchase order, you want to know how to extend this field into purchase order migration template.-Resolution-What you need to do is to extend the field into Service: Manage Purchase Orders when editing Further Usage of Extension Field.-Then next time you open the migration tool, you will receive a pop-up message with the below information:-There are new field extensions available. Your migration object will be adapted automatically.-Select OK to adapt the migration object.-Then you will see the field display in the migration template.-See Also-1842942  How to add an extension field in the data migration template-Keywords-Extension fields, Purchase Order, Migration Template, Manage Purchase Orders

Title: Project Invoice Request Not Created For a Sales Order With Project Milestone
Content: Symptom-No Project Invoice Request is appearing for Sales Orders related to Project having Milestones. But directly an Invoice Request is created.-No Invoice Request is created at all through scheduled invoice.-When creating a Scheduled Invoice Request for a Milestone the following error message occurs: Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoice Request view.-Choose All Project Invoice Requests.-Click on Advanced.-Enter the Reference as Sales Order or Project.-Click on Go button.-No details are appearing.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Choose All Invoice Requests.-Enter Project ID.-Click on Go button.-You get the Invoice Request. -All sales order seems to be linked to project task because-Go to the items tab of Sales Order. -Go to Cost and Revenue Assignment.-You will see Project Task appearing.-Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found.-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view and then the Projects sub view.-Show All Projects and click the Go button.-Select the Project ABC (ABC represents the project name).-Click the Project Identifier icon, which is displayed under the Project ID column.-Choose Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request.-While creating the Scheduled Invoice Request error message occurs: Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found.-Cause-The behavior is happening because of one of the following reasons:-Sales Order item type is not Project Based as mentioned on Milestone Invoicing for Customer Projects -The error message occurs, because the Status of the Milestone to be invoiced is not set to Completed and  thus you cannot create a Scheduled Invoice Request-For every project it is allowed to have only one project invoice having status “In Preparation”. If there is another Project Invoice Request already added to the Project and this document has status In Preparation, the system will not create a new Project Invoice Request.-Resolution-Solution for above causes respectively:-In new Sales Orders, change your project type to 'Service fixed price - Project' or a type that has 'Project' in it.-For existing Sales Orders, you cannot make changes to item type so either leave them as they are or cancel and create new Sales Orders.-To maintain the Status of the Milestone you can use the following steps:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view and then the Projects sub view.-Show All Projects and click the Go button.-Select the Project ABC.-Click the Edit button and choose Project Plan.-Select Milestone XYZ (XYZ represents the milestone name).-Set the Status to Completed.-Save changes.- Now you shall not see error message when creating  a  Scheduled Invoice Request.-If you already have a Project Invoice Request with status "In Preparation", complete this first document and then create the new Project Invoice Request.-See Also-2032526 - Error Message:Item XX : Project task ID MCP not assigned to a customer-2482459 - Scheduled Project Invoice Request is not Created automatically-Keywords-Milestone invoicing, no project invoice request, not created, automatically, milestone, project, Project Invoice Request Not Created For a Sales Order

Title: Default mandatory fields has no value in Supplier invoice but we could save the invoice why?
Content: Symptom- You want to know why we allow saving of invoice even though default mandatory fields are not maintained/entered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-2. Go to New Invoice Without Purchase Order view.-3. Enter all details but for example field "Invoice date" keep it empty-4. Click on check and you will see error as expected-5. But when you click on Save button.-Supplier Invoice is saved and document number is generated.-Cause-You are allowed to save document,cause you can edit the document any time later before posting.-This is applicable for most of the documents in ByDesign.-Resolution-To save supplier invoice ,you must enter at least Company cause system uses company to generate the document number as per the settings made in Business configuration Activity"Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing"-also in Business configuration Activity ,if you set "Year suffix selection date" either as document date or posting date, then you must enter Invoice date or Posting date respectively in the invoice.-All default mandatory fields though not filled we allow to save the document. offourse we don't allow to post when any mandatory field is not maintained.-This feature of setting a field as mandatory for saving is not supported in the current release of SAP Cloud for Customer/ SAP Business ByDesign.-1.  If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder -2.  If you are a customer:             -a. Contact your the Account Executive-b. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us -        ByD : An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Remark : If you received the feedback that PDI Implementation is not possible then only “check the Ideas Forum to submit an idea.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]

Title: The value of extension field doesn't update from material master data to purchase order as expected
Content: Symptom-The value of extension field doesn't update from material master data to purchase order as expected-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have added extension fields with value under the General tab of material DEF (DEF represents for the material ID). However, when you select material DEF in purchase order item, you find the value doesn't update from master data to purchase order.-Cause-The extension scenario is not selected correctly.-Resolution-Go to extension field Further Usage on purchase order item level.-Navigate to Extension Scenarios tab.-Check and extend the field to scenario: Material - General Information to Purchase Order - Item.-Then, system will carry the value maintained in material master data into purchase order.-See Also-2936224 - Extension field value has disappeared-2909846 - Extension field value not flown from one document to another-Keywords-Extension field, Master data, Purchase order, Extension scenario, 拓展字段

Title: Supplier invoice bypass the approval and directly posted, though self-approval is enabled
Content: Symptom-You have already enabled the business configuration question "Do you want to allow self-approval for supplier invoice approvals?", you have no idea why supplier invoice bypass the approval and directly gets posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to New Invoice Without Purchase Order under common Tasks view.-Fill in all the mandatory information, and the invoice turns into 'Ready for Posting' status.-Navigate to Approval tab, you find the approver is determined as B (B represents for the approver name).-However if you click on Post button, the invoice doesn't go into approval. Instead, it is posted directly.-Cause-"Do you want to allow self-approval for supplier invoice approvals?" applies when the person gets the task, and he/she is also the employee responsible on that supplier invoice in approval. So, if person A creates a supplier invoice, and the employee responsible is person B (under general, involved parties, employee responsible: person B). The approver is also determined as person B.-Person A posts the supplier invoice. Supplier invoice goes into approval. Person B gets the task, and he/she is also the employee responsible of that supplier invoice. Now person B goes to approve the supplier invoice.-If "Do you want to allow self-approval for supplier invoice approvals?" is scoped, the supplier invoice will get posted successfully. However, if it is not scoped, they will get an error "Supplier invoice self approval not possible". If, person A appears to be the same user as person B. Instead of person A posting, it is person B posts the invoice.-Therefore, system doesn't generate approval task and the invoice gets posted directly.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-See Also-KBA: 2608860 - Cannot Approve Purchase Order - Error: Purchase Order Approval Not Possible-Help Portal: Approval Rules in Supplier Invoicing-Keywords-Self-approval, Supplier invoice, Employee responsible, Bypass approval, Supplier invoice self approval not possible, Approval

Title: Unassigned approval task in Purchase order with Process type To stock
Content: Symptom-As per approval conditions you don't expect Un assigned approval task- or-Purchase order with Process type To stock should not go for Account assignment related work distribution approvals- or-"-Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization-Searching for responsible in non-configurable work category:-"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application user mangement work center- Go to Business task management View- Where you see a un assigned task- Select it and scroll down- where you can see action log with below details-"Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization-Searching for responsible in non-configurable work category:XXXXXXXXXX-"-where XXXXXXXXXX is work distribution related to account assignment-Cause-1.You have used Process type :To stock on Purchase orders and thus it will not have any accounting Assignment and  so approver is not found.-2.also-You have used account assignment type does not contain Project task but system will consider as "Purchase  order does not contain Project task",-since in your case there is no Project task  the condition becomes true, so approaval task is triggered-or-You have used account assignment type does not contain cost center but system will consider as "Purchase  order does not contain cost center",-since in your case there is no cost center the condition becomes true, so approaval task is triggered-Resolution-In approval conditions Add one more condition as Process type contains Non stock with AND,so that  only if the Purchase order is non stock this condition is applicable-Keywords-To stock ,

Title: How to complete the task Goods Returned to Supplier; Change Purchase Order if Required
Content: Symptom-There is one open task Goods Returned to Supplier; Change Purchase Order if Required in Open Tasks list of Purchase Orders view, you want to know how to complete/clear this task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-You can find the task in Open Tasks list.-Cause-This is a task to tell user that goods have been returned to a supplier for one or more purchase order items using an outbound delivery or a goods return.-Resolution-To complete/clear this task, there are 4 options:-Finish the delivery of the purchase order item, since all the quantities are returned and invoice amounts are cleared.-Create new inbound delivery against this item, so that the actual confirmed delivery quantity is updated.-And sometimes, this task can arise when returned quantity is less than delivered quantity. For example, you ordered 5 ea, delivered 5 ea, returned 2 ea. System raise this task. You could now adjust the quantity in purchase order from 5 ea to 3 ea, then click on send update. This will also be a way to complete this task.-You can also cancel the purchase order or purchase order items after all the follow-up documents are canceled.-See Also-2949685 -  Not able to complete notification: Delivered Quantity Adjusted for Purchase Order with Return to Supplier-Keywords-Goods Returned to Supplier; Change Purchase Order if Required, Purchase order, Return to supplier, Goods return, Open task

Title: Approver cannot access attachment when approving purchase requests/orders
Content: Symptom-Approver cannot access attachment when approving purchase requests or purchase orders, while the attachment appears inside the document and inside mobile app.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Select and open task: Approve Purchase Request/Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of purchase request/order).-There is no details of attachment by clicking on attachment icon.-Cause-The attachment icon which presents in the approval screen of the purchase request/order is there only for 'warning' purpose, to let the approver know that there is an attachment in the purchase request/order in case they want to take a look before approving it.-The icon is not a hyperlink , so you are not able to open the attachment through clicking on it.-Resolution-To view the attachment you can go to the business document itself and navigate to Attachments tab and then open it.-OR-Follow this KBA to enable the hidden fields: 2616243 - Purchase Order Approver is Unable to View the Attachments and Notes in the Approval Task Details.-See Also-KBA: 2616243 - Purchase Order Approver is Unable to View the Attachments and Notes in the Approval Task Details-Keywords-Attachment, Approve, Purchase Request, Purchase Order, purchase order approval task attachment

Title: Not able to complete notification: Delivered Quantity Adjusted for Purchase Order with Return to Supplier
Content: Symptom-You are not able to complete this notification. You receive error:-- User/Organization 'ABC' is not responsible for task 'Delivered Quantity Adjusted for Purchase Order...' (ABC represents your user ID)-- Save failed.-Or-- Cannot edit element ROOT: DEF. (DEF represents the root ID of this notification) Locked by other session.-- Save Failed.-- Action cancelled. Data is changed by another user simultaneously.- OR- If employee responsible is not determined-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Find the open task: Delivered Quantity Adjusted for Purchase Order XYZ with Return to Supplier. (XYZ represents the purchase order ID)-Click on Action: Complete.-You receive the errors.-Cause-Only the responsible employee of the purchase order can edit this notification.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-You can check the responsible employee for this notification here.-Please note only this user has the edit right for this notification. Other users only have read right.-Resolution-Please ask the responsible employee of the purchase order to complete the notification.- If you don't see the responsible person then-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-select the task-Click on determine assignment button-Under"Assignment Redetermination Results"  you will see the employee responsible-You will see action log under General tab-Open the latest action log and you will see missing access rights if any-so assign the access rights to the user and he will then receive this task inhis inbox where he can action on it.-Keywords-Delivered Quantity Adjusted for Purchase Order with Return to Supplier, Not Responsible for Task, Locked by Other Session, Action Cancelled, Data is Changed by Another User Simultaneously, 您无法编辑元素ROOT, 被其他会话锁定, 保存失败, 已取消操作, 另一用户已同时更改数据

Title: Error appears " An error situation has occurred where the agent had to create a fault message, but this has failed" while executing Manage Engineering Change Order webservice
Content: Symptom-When you execute the web service ManageEngineeringChangeOrderIn, you encounter the following message:-An error situation has occurred where the agent had to create a fault message, but this has failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Web service Executed via SOAP.-Cause-This is a generic error which appears for multiple reasons:-If the Engineering Change Order parameter passed in the web service contains too many special characters.-If the Engineering Change Order ID is missing in the web service.-If the parameter Start Date is not passed.-if the parameter CancelledIndicator does not contain either true or false.-Sometimes even if there are small syntax errors in the web service.-Resolution-Kindly make sure the points mentioned in the Cause section are maintained accurately. Always refer to the helpcenter documentation for the structure of web service. You can follow the below steps to see the documentation of the web service Manage Engineering Change Order:-Application and User Management Work Center.-Service Explorer view.-Search for ManageEngineeringChangeOrderIn.-Access the Documentation Link.-Keywords-An error situation has occurred where the agent had to create a fault message, but this has failed, Engineering Change Order id is missing in web service,  CancelledIndicator does not contain either true or false, Change Order parameter passed in web service contains too many special characters

Title: Scrap Quantity Not Considered in Production Order as The Open Quantity Displayed in The Header Differs From The One in The Confirmation Screen
Content: Symptom-You have confirmed Scrap Quantity in a Production Task which still has the status In Process, but when you check the Open Quantity in the Production Order header, the Open Quantity displayed is different from the Open Quantity in the Task Confirmation screen. You observe that the Total Scrap Quantity confirmed in the Task is not considered in the Open Quantity on the Production Order Header. Hence, you are convinced this is an Application error and would like to have this corrected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Navigate to the Production Orders view and choose By Order Header.-Find the relevant Production Order.-You can see the Open Quantity is displayed as X (X represents the number of the Open Quantity).-Go to the Tasks sub-tab.-Select and open the relevant Make Task.-Click the Confirm button.-Go to the Confirmations tab.-You can see that the Open Quantity is less than the Open Quantity X above. You can also see that Total Confirmed Scrap Y (Y represents the number of the Total Confirmed Scrap Quantity) is equal to the difference between the two Open Quantities.-Cause-Confirmed Scrap Quantity is only considered at Task level, and that is the reason the Task is showing less Open Quantity. The Confirmed Scrap Quantity will not be updated on Production Order level.-If the Task is still In Process after confirming the Scrap Quantity, you have the flexibility to confirm that Scrap Quantity extra so that you can fulfill the Total Planned Quantity.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.-See Also-2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-Open Quantity, Scrap Quantity, Production Order, Confirmation, Make, Task

Title: Unable to approve the Project Baseline
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 3138976***-Unable to approve the project baseline as system throws error as "action approve not possible"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to managing my area work center-Go to  approvals-Select the task related  project base line -Click on approve-Cause-The Project status is stopped and thus you cannot approve the base line. when Project is stopped which means no activities are expected with project and thus we don't allow to approve.-Resolution-Go to  project-Go to project plan-Select the header task-Go to  basic data sub tab-Choose revoke stop in field project status-click on save- Then you can approve the base line

Title: Purchase Order for Service Agent is Not Correctly Determined in Timesheet
Content: Symptom-A service agent is trying to enter timesheet for project task but the system is determining no purchase order or incorrect purchase order (PO refers to Purchase Order).-or-You get a warning message: "Purchase order item for intercompany time record could not be determined".- or- When forcibly entering, you get an error: "Purchase order not valid".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview.-Select Edit Time Sheet button. -Select the project task.-Enter the time.-The system automatically determines a purchase order. However it is not the correct purchase order or the system does not determine any Purchase Order at all.-Cause-Determination of default Purchase Order/Item for a time entry follows a sequence of steps. System searches for most specific Purchase Order/Item and if not found, then it goes towards finding less specific Purchase Order/Item.-Generally, Purchase order items are proposed according to priorities as explained below:-If Service Agent is maintained in the Purchase Order and the Purchase order item is assigned to the selected task and Product;-If Service Agent is maintained in the Purchase Order and the Purchase order item is assigned to the selected task;-If the Purchase order item is assigned to the selected task and Product.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID. -Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the line item.-Navigate to Source of Supply (under Item details).-In Service Agent field, please maintain the Service Agent.-Save it.-or-So  there should be a Purchase order with task and service that you use in Time Sheet. Also you can use the  task and service in Time Sheet of any Service Agent and use the Purchase Order ID though you have not maintained the service agent in the Purchase order.-Keywords-Time Recording, Time Confirmation, Service Agent, Project, Purchase Order, Time Sheet

Title: Automatic Standard E-Mail Notifications for Business Task Management Activities are Sent Without Additional Subscription
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the automatic standard e-mail notifications for Business Task Management(BTM) activities without additional subscription to the e-mail notification-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Click the Notifications icon.-Select any standard notification in the inbox.-You will see that option "Subscribe to E-mail" is not selected.-Still, the standard BTM notification is sent to your e-mail address.-Cause-You have activated the relevant scoping question in the business configuration-Resolution-Go to Work center Business Configuration.-Go to the View Overview.-Select the Tab View Current Scope.-Go to step Questions.-Expand Communication and information Exchange.-Select Business Process Management.-Select Business Task Management.-Deactivate the Question "Do you want to notify business users using e-mail without additional subcription about Business Task Management items?"-Review and Save-Keywords-BTM, automatic email, task, notification, subscribe

Title: Error appears "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario" when trying to create Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery with partial quantity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery from an Inbound Delivery Notification with partial quantity for India Stock Transfer Order Scenario, but the system is not allowing you to do this and displaying error appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Find and select the relevant Delivery Notification ID. -Click Post Goods Receipt.-Enter a partial quantity in the Actual Quantity field on the "Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt" screen and click Save and Close.-System shows the following error message: "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario", "Save Failed".-Cause-From 2005 Upgrade onwards, Partial Quantity confirmation is no longer allowed for India Stock Transfer Order Scenario.-Resolution-When creating Stock Transfer Order Inbound Delivery from an Inbound Delivery Notification for India Stock Transfer Order scenario, you will have to maintain complete quantity as per the Planned or Ordered Quantity.-See Also-2925668 - Error appears "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario" when trying to confirm put away task for partial quantity-Keywords-Partial Confirmation not possible for India STO scenario, "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario" when trying to create Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery with partial Quantity

Title: Error appears "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario" when trying to confirm put away task for partial quantity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm the Put Away Task for an India Stock Transfer Order Scenario, but the system is not allowing this and showing error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Find and select the relevant Put Away Task. -Click Confirm.-Enter a partial quantity in the Actual Quantity field and click Save.-The system displays the following error message: "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario".-Cause-From 2005 Upgrade onwards, Partial Quantity confirmation is no longer allowed for India Stock Transfer Order Scenario.-Resolution-System is working as designed. Partial Confirmation no longer allowed for Indian Stock Transfer process.-See Also-2926736 - Error appears "Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario" when trying to create Stock Transfer Inbound Delivery with partial quantity.-Keywords-Partial confirmation not possible for India STO scenario, Partial Confirmation not allowed for STO Put away task

Title: How to Resolve Validity Error in List Price Excel Upload?
Content: Symptom-You are unable to upload list price via excel due to validity error even though you have entered correct date.-Error:"The value of the field "Valid From/To(MM-DD-YYYY) is invalid"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to SAP Business ByDesign system-Select Product Portfolio work center-Select List prices view-Select New-Open "List Prices from Microsoft Excel"-Now log in to Byd system from excel using Byd add-on-Enter the Valid from as current date and To date in future-Select save to-Error encountered: "The value of the field "Valid From/To(MM-DD-YYYY) is invalid"-Cause-If you are entering current date as Valid From date, and still error is encountered, your timezone might be different.-In back-end, system timezone is always UTC, hence it can create conflict with your regional timezone settings and in back-end, system assumes that you entered a past date.- Hence error occurs.-Resolution-Please enter the Valid From date as future date in the excel instead of current date or maintain your system regional timezone settings appropriately to avoid any conflict with UTC timezone.-Also, from your Excel file, select the Home tab, click the Text droping Menu and click on "More Number Formats..."-From the new window, select Date: you will find different format of Date.-Make sure the one you are using in the Excel file is the same as the one maintain here.-Keywords-Validity error, list price excel upload, Date Format

Title: How to Cancel /return Goods and Activity Confirmation Document Created Against Project
Content: Symptom- You want to know how to cancel/return Goods and Activity Confirmation document which is created against Project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Choose Consumption for Project subview.-In the open guided activity, choose posting type as Goods issue.-Enter all the required details and complete the guided activity.-Cause-Since these are adhoc Goods and Activity Confirmation Documents Created Against Project,  You can either cancel or return.-Resolution-To cancel/reverse:-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Choose Display/Reverse Goods and Activity Confirmation subview.-Enter required Goods and Activity Confirmation ID.-Click on Reverse Confirmation  button.- To return:-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Choose Consumption for Project subview.-In the open guided activity, choose posting type as Goods Return.-Enter all the required details and complete the guided activity.-See Also-For more project return usecases, refer Blog: Product returns from projects to inventory | SAP Blogs-Keywords-Reverse goods and service confirmation

Title: Cannot Create Manual Purchase Request for Service item or Non-Stock Product
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create manual purchase request for a service item or non-stock product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to the Purchase Request view-Select New Purchase Request or go to Common Tasks and create Manual Purchase Request-By default, system proposes the process type as To-Stock and Material as Item type-Cause-In the current release the process type allowed is To-Stock and Item-Type allowed is material.-Resolution-For non stock materials or service, you cannot create manual purchase request however you can create it from the shopping cart document.-Keywords-Manual purchase request; New Purchase Request; Item Type material; Process Type To-Stock

Title: Bar Code Does not Contain a Valid Application Identifier
Content: Symptom-You are performing Post Goods Receipt for Serialized Products, and you enter a valid Serial Number, but the system triggers the above error message among others.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Find and select a relevant Purchase Order.-Click the Post Goods Receipt button.-In the opened 'Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt' screen, go to the Serial Numbers sub-tab.-Enter a valid Serial Number for example '123456789' and press the Return/Enter key on your keyboard.-The system displays the following error messages:-Decoding of bar code failed------> Bar code ]C121123456789 does not contain a valid application identifier------> Bar code 123456789 decoding failed-Cause-For using Serial Numbers, it is necessary to enable Bar Code (i.e. Automatic Identification) functionality in the Business Configuration and to maintain the correct -Application Identifier relevant for your Bar Code scanning. You have not maintained the Application Identifier relevant for Serial Numbers which is 21 in ‘Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128’ screen. The system was expecting the Application Identifier 21 as seen in the error message above (see the 2 digits right before the Serial Number you have entered).-Resolution-Navigate to Business Configuration work centre.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the relevant Implementation Project and click on the Open Activity List button.-In the Activity list, Show All Activities and search for ‘Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128’ (ensure it is scoped).-Select the Activity ‘Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128’ and click on the Open button.-In the ‘Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128’ screen, you can see the activated Bar Code Type is a customized one and the Application Identifier used is ‘00’ (Skip field).-We recommend that you use the provided standard EAN128 Bar Code type which contains all relevant Application Identifiers including 21 for Serial Numbers.-Once you set the EAN128 Bar Code type active, you should be able to post the goods receipt with Serial Number without the error.-After saving your changes, you may need to log out of the system for these to take effect.-See Also-1916905 - Error Message: Decoding of Bar Code Failed, While Doing Post Goods Issue-Keywords-Application Identifier, 21, Serial Number, Bar Code Type, EAN128

Title: How to Maintain Budget in the Project Screen?
Content: Symptom-You want to enter budget in the project screen directly but there is no such option in project screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view.-Select any project and click Edit.-You are unable to find any option to enter budget on the project screen.-Cause-As of now, there is no such field in project screen where you can enter budget directly.-Resolution-You can analyze the planned costs and revenues for the project in detail as follows:-In the Cost and Revenue work center, Projects view.-In the Project Plan Values report.-See Also-Please go through the help document Project Cost and Revenue Planning.-Keywords-Project Budget, Project cost and revenue, project planning

Title: Error message:Creation date of next invoice is before current date
Content: Symptom-While creating new recurring invoice you see an error when you give current date in recurring invoice as start date.- or- When ever the next creation date is current date and the job run date is also current date and time in UTC, that is not yet happened then you will see this error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to recurring invoices view-Select an Active document-Under General tab-Red mark appears against the field Creation date of next invoice-Cause-Cause 1.While creating a Recurring Run you will see below.-The Job run has already occurred on current day in UTC & the next creation date of invoice is current day so the system knows that the supplier invoice cannot create on current day.Thus you will see the error.- or-Cause 2. On a Recurring Run created earlier you will see the below always- The Job run is yet to occur on current date and time in UTC & the next creation date of invoice is current day so the system considers  that the supplier invoice did not create on current day till the Job run is occurred on the current day. Thus till the Job run occurs you will see the error always.-Resolution-Resolution 1:( to avoid Cause 1 )-Mention next day date or above, in the start date field of the recurring run and also reschedule the job run with Job run date as next day and time as 00:30(time zone same as your personalize settings).- or-Resolution 2.( to avoid Cause 1 )-If you want to give today's date in the start date field of the recurring run then first reschedule the job run with run date as current date and time as current time+X mins(where X is expected to be minimun 5 mins(within this time you can create new recurring run or change the existing recurring run))(time zone same as your personalize settings).-Resolution 3.( to avoid Cause 1  and Cause 2)-You will still see the error if you follow Resolution 2, as explained in the  cause 2.-So we request you to create manual recurring invoice for current date and then follow Resolution 1.- How to reschedule the Job run?-Go to application user management-Go to  background jobs view-Select"Recurring invoicing for all buyers" click on Reschedule button-Enter date as next day and time as 00:30 in UTC ( convert time 00:30 in UTC to your time zone same as your personalize settings and enter the time).-See Also-For more  details refer the details in the KBA:2648081 - Recurring Invoices are not Getting Created-Keywords-Red mark appears against the field Creation date of next invoice; recurring invoices not created though creation date is given correctly;Creation Date of Next Invoice is Before Current Date (Incident has been created automatically);The creation date of the next invoice is earlier than the current date

Title: Product Specification Description not shown in Stock Overview although Product Specification Description is maintained
Content: Symptom-You observe Product Specification Description is missing in Stock Overview for the Product DEF (DEF represents the Product ID) although Product Specification ID is released and Product Specification Description is maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to the Stock Overview.-Run Query for Product DEF.-You observe Product specification description is missing for the Product DEF although it is maintained.-You can verify  the same by following below mentioned steps:-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center. -Navigate to Product Specifications View.-Search for Product DEF.-You observe Product specification description maintained for Product DEF and the corresponding Product Specification ID is released.-Cause-You have maintained the Product Specification description in another language other than the English Language. SAP cannot convert it to any other language as conversion may not always be meaningful.-To see the description in English you should explicitly maintain the description in English language as well. Then when you logon to the system you will be able to see the description.-Resolution-You need to maintain Product specification description explicitly for the login language.-Keywords-Product specification description not shown in stock overview although Product Specification Description is maintained, Product specification description is maintained for Product DEF and corresponding PRS id is released.

Title: You get "Possible Duplicate" error  when you create a New Invoice with the Same Data from an Old Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice by copying or manually entering same data from a previous invoice and get the error: "Invoice may be a possible duplicate".-You have also set the field (External Document ID - Similarity(%)) to zero in the fine-tuning activity:Supplier Invoice Exceptions, to avoid the system from checking duplicate for external document id.(also all other options also has no value maintained)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the respective invoice and copy-A new invoice is created -Error: Invoice may be a possible duplicate-Cause-Default criteria : Same Supplier, External ID  matched 80% or above and Invoice date + or - 7 days.-Additional criteria :what you set in BC activity "Supplier invoice exception "-Firstly system will check and need all Default criteria to match between both invoices to raise exception.-When all or one of the elements in default criteria does not match then only system will check for additional criteria other wise it will not check for them.-System will check and need all additional criteria to match between both invoices to raise exception-and also system will check for one more criteria that is PO reference matched or not  only when additional criteria is used by system.-Resolution-System will always check for default criteria first and if all matches then exception is raised accordingly.-if not it will check for additional criteria and if all matches then exception is raised accordingly.-Note:-System will throw duplicate "warning" if the previous invoice is not posted/paid invoice cause you can void the previous invoice.-System will throw duplicate "error" if the previous invoice is posted/paid invoice.-See Also-Refer help document for more details: "Configuration: Supplier Invoice Exceptions".-KBA 3017709 - Possible Duplicate exception is not appearing in an invoice-Keywords-Possible Duplicate error in supplier invoice, supplier invoice, supplier invoice exceptions, external document id

Title: Unable to change a Project Task Assignment
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change a project task assignment between Project ABC to Project DEF but the selected task always goes back to project ABC.- or-You may get error 'All expense items are ignored because they cannot be reassigned'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Work center Project Management.-Select "Not Invoiced Time and Expense".-Search the project ABC.-Select any project task line and click "Change Project task Assignment".-In the newly open window, select the project DEF and click "Save"-In the next 10min, the selected Project task status will remain as "Marked for Reassignment".-After this delay, the project task selected is automatically reassigned to the original project (ABC) under the Reassignment Status: "Finished with error".-When clicking on the error icon, we can find this error message:-"Diff. billable quantity prohibits posting to a non-billable project DEF"-Cause-This kind of reassignment from “Billable Project” to a “Non-billable Project” is typically not used by customers.-Reassignment of Project Task Confirmations functionality is mostly used to transfer time from “Non-billable Project” to a “Billable Project” or from one “Billable Project” to another “Billable Project”.-Since source project “ABC” is a billable project and the field “Billable Hours” is modified by you, the reassignment to a non-billable project is not possible.-Resolution-You are advised to manually clear off the field “Billable Hours” and change the project task manually to “DEF” from Time Administrator screen.-Keywords-Change Project task Assignment, Billable Hours, Billable Project, Non-billable Project, Diff. billable quantity prohibits posting to a non-billable project.

Title: The Employee Responsible of Supplier Invoice Be Overwritten after Send Back for Revision or Revise Supplier Invoice task is sent to approver himself
Content: Symptom-After approver send a supplier invoice back for revision, the employee responsible in the invoice is overwritten to the approver. Revise Supplier Invoice task is sent to approver himself.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open supplier invoice ABC (ABC refers to the supplier invoice ID). You can see the status of it is In Approval,-Go to General tab and then sub tab Parties and locations tab. You would see employee responsible is D, and the responsible approver is E (D and E refers to name of employees).-Log in approver E's account.-Go to Manage My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Find the approval task for supplier invoice ABC, click Send Back for Revision.-Repeat steps 1-4 to check Supplier invoice ABC.-You can see the status of the invoice changed to In Revision, and the Employee Responsible changed from D to the approver E.-As a consequence of the above, you can also see that the Person Responsible for the relevant task "Revise Supplier Invoice ABC" is assigned to E, instead of D.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Search task "Revise Supplier Invoice ABC". -You can see the Person Responsible for the task is assigned to the new responsible employee, approver E.-Cause-Currently this is the behaviour and its a limitation from our end to change  the behaviour.-Resolution-In current release, it is not possible to keep the employee responsible in invoice unchanged after send back to revision.-In order to notify the initial employee responsible of the revise request, approver E can forward the task manually to employee D by following steps.-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to Tasks-Search and select respective task-Click on Actions button and choose Forward-Also, if employee D will make change in supplier invoice ABC and submit it for approval again, the employee resposbile will change back to D automatically-Keywords-Send Back for Revision, Supplier Invoice, Employee Responsible, Approver, Wrong Person Responsible,Revise Supplier Invoice , Revise Sent to WrongP erson, Revise Task Not Sent

Title: How to set up an E-Mail notification for Tasks that are not appearing under Task Subscription
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**To be archived**-Reason: Behavior consolidated in KBA 3224248 - Task not Available in Subscribe to Tasks List-For example you wanted to set up email notifications to be sent when purchase orders are approved.- or you did not find the task available in task subscriptions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You have to set up work flow rules for those scenarios that  does not exist under Home ->Subscribe to tasks-Resolution-Go to Application user management work center-Go to work flow rules view-Follow steps  given in SCN community blog  in below link-https://blogs.sap.com/2015/07/27/how-to-create-workflow-rule-to-send-email-and-notifications/-If you have not found  what you are looking for then contact your partners to help develop it for you.-See Also-Refee the help center document-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/1905/en-US/2dd306f1722d10149fa9d590609d47e9.html-also refer KBA :   2658668 - How to set up an E-Mail notification for Tasks-Keywords-Work flow rule, task subscription, email notification, task notification,new notification

Title: How to handle Unassigned Task/Approver is getting error" You are not authorised to change the data"
Content: Symptom-You will see error:No approver found; task is unassigned-or-You will see an unassigned task in the business task management view-or-You receive automatic system generated incident with subject:-Health Check Component: Business Task Management-Health Check Name: Task without responsible- or- Approver is getting error"You are not authorised to change the data"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center (SAP Business ByDesign) or the Administration work centre (SAP Cloud for Customer).-In the Task Distribution, click Business Task Management (SAP Business ByDesign) or, go to the Business Task Management view (SAP Cloud for Customer).-Select Unassigned Items.-Cause-This happens when system is unable to assign the task to the responsible person.-e.g. if the responsible person does not have the relevant access rights to complete the task, then system is unable to assign the task to that person.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center (SAP Business ByDesign) or the Administration work centre (SAP Cloud for Customer).-In Task Distribution, click Business Task Management (SAP Business ByDesign) or, go to the Business Task Management view (SAP Cloud for Customer).-Select Unassigned Items/ All items-Search and select  the respective document-Click determine assignment button-You will see action log created and  appearing when you scroll down-Click the action log ID to open it-Refer the general, results tab for detailed information to understand the reason for the unassignment-Take necessary action accordingly and then try the same steps again from 1 to 5-Note:This details are applicable for any task unassigned in Business Bydesign.-See Also- KBA 2939021 - Health Check Assignment of type CRM_SRQ_ALT_COMPL BTM items not possible-Keywords-Unassigned task reason, why unassigned task, no approver, approver not found approver empty, Unassigned Task, authorised to change

Title: Manually Created Purchase Request is Not Visible in Either the Product Planning Screen (Supply Planning) or Monitor Purchase Requests Screen (Supply Control)
Content: Symptom-You have created a Purchase Request manually in the work center Purchase Requests and Orders. Now you go to the Supply Planning work center and open the relevant Product Planning details, but the Purchase Request is not displayed. You also navigate to the Supply Control work center and try to find the relevant Purchase Request via the Monitor Purchase Requests view, but here also, the Request is not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Click the New button and select Purchase Request.-Enter relevant details and click the Release button.-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Enter the relevant Product ID and the Planning Area ID (Ship To Location).-Select the relevant Product and Supply Planning Area combination and click the Open button to open the relevant Product Planning Details.-You can see the Purchase Request you created before is not displayed.-Cause-Currently, manual Purchase Request is reflected in planning screen only on the creation of the corresponding Purchase Order. Releasing the manual Purchase Request will not reflect in Supply Planning.-Resolution-Once you create the Purchase Order for the manual Purchase Request, the Purchase Order ID will be visible in the Product Planning screen.-Keywords-Supply planning, Product Planning screen, manual Purchase Request, Purchase Order, MRP, Supply Control, Monitor Purchase Requests, Planning Run

Title: Preferred Supplier Entered in Shopping Cart is not Displayed as a Supplier in the Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a shopping cart and you have selected a preferred supplier in it.-However, when creating a purchase request linked to this shopping cart, the system ask you to "Assign Supplier to Purchase Request".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have created a shopping cart ABC and you have selected a preferred supplier in it.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Requests view.-Open the advance filter and select ABC under Shopping Cart ID.-Click New > Purchase Request.-A new window shows the Purchase Request 123 with the information message "Assign Supplier to Purchase Request".-Click this information message.-From here you can see that the preferred supplier selected in the shopping cart has not been forwarded in your purchase request.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior cause the preferred supplier in the Shopping Cart is only a proposal from the requester to the purchaser.-Resolution-Once you have selected a preferred supplier in your shopping cart, you can chose different option in your purchase request.-You can click "Accept Preferred Supplier", you can select the "Quick Sourcing Request" option, but you can also select manually another supplier.-Selecting a preferred supplier in your shopping cart can be accepted from your purchase request but does not force this supplier to be automatically present on this purchase request.-Keywords-Missing Supplier, Shopping Cart, Purchase Request, Prefered Supplier

Title: Migration of Third-Party Sales Order and Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You would like to migrate Third-Party Sales Order and Purchase Order. Also, you wanted to understand whether third party Sales Order and Purchase Order would get connected via document flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center -Go to the Implementation Projects and select the Project-Select Open Activity List and navigate to Integrate and Extend tab-Select Migration of Purchase Orders activity -Select Migrate purchase orders using the migration tool -In the migration file go to Items Data tab -Mark Third Party indicator by entering Sales Order reference under account assignment and Account Details-However, system does not connect third party orders in document flow -Cause-Migration of third-party purchase orders is not supported.  If you migrate the open sales orders, system will create a new Purchase Request and Purchase Order with reference to this sales order. Hence it is not possible to link the sales order with the already migrated purchase order. The link will not work because technically speaking the migrated purchase orders will have a separate message numbers and sales orders will have a separate number. These two documents cannot be interlinked.-In purchase order migration template, third-party deal indicator is set for items in purchase order which are procured for customers. (Meaning purchase orders which were not created from sales order by setting fulfillment as external). If the product is to be booked to a third-party account, you can mark the migration as X. Account ID field has to be filled in order to determine the third-party delivery address.  If the purchase order is for an external service provider with account assignment to a sales order or service order in a third- party business, enter the customer ID. Then, the system uses the customer address to define the delivery address. This does not link the third-party sales order & purchase order via document flow. Hence linking of third-party sales orders and purchase orders is not supported.-Resolution-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-1.If you are a partner: you can help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2.If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.-Or      -a. Contact your the Account Executive-b. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-3. An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Migrate Third-Party Sales Order and Purchase Order; Migration of third-party purchase orders; Migration of third-party sales orders; Third-party order migration

Title: Wrong Process type in new line item created by copy button in Purchase order.
Content: Symptom-Process type is not same as  the item you selected while creating new line item using Copy button in Purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario 1:- Go to Purchase order work center- Go to Create new Purchase order in common task- Click on Add row button under items- Now you will see by default it has  Process type Non stock- If you enter a To stock material in 1st row and then automatically the Process type changes to To stock- If you manually change the process type to non stock in 1st row- Then click on Copy button by selecting 1st row- You will see that  new item has Process type To stock.-Scenario 2:- Go to Purchase order work center- Go to Create new Purchase order in common task- Click on Add row button under items- Now you will see by default it has Process type Non stock- If you enter a Non stock material in 1st row- If you manually change the process type to To stock in 1st row- Then click on Copy button by selecting 1st row- You will see that new item has Process type Non stock.(currently it shows as To stock but it will be fixed in one of the future releases.)- You expect that since you used Copy button you want system to blindly copy the copied line item details on to new line item.-Cause-Scenario 1:While creating second row we again have to read material master and the material master tells us this is a To stock material so we will default the process as To stock-Scenario 2:While creating second row we again have to read material master and the material master tells us this is a Non stock material so we will default the process as Non stock-Resolution-You may change manually the process type as per your requirement.-See Also-Note:  wedo not allow a Non stock material to be used as To stock by manually changing the process type cause in the material master you do not have planning and logistics data available. so we request you to not change the Non stock material  manually to process type :To stock.--If you try to proceed after making such manual change then system will throw you errors as well that you cannot use process type as  To stock.-Keywords-Copy function not working, new line item has wrong process type,

Title: Third Party Inter Company Scenario
Content: Symptom-This KBA provides an overview for the Third party Inter-Company-Process for Sales within SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The Third party Inter Company Process within Business ByDesign allows the setup of a sales process, where a company can sell products of another company (Partner Company). This scenario includes both companies sales process, the purchase process between both companies, and the delivery and invoicing for both companies. The system utilizes an internal web service, which was generated for this scenario to be used within one Business ByDesign System or between two Business ByDesign systems.-In order to use the Inter Company Process, you have certain Setups to make within your tenant.-The complete process looks as follows:-Company A: Selling Company-Company B: Product Owner-Buyer: Customer and Product Recipient-Company A creates a Sales Order with the Buyer, selecting Company B as the Source of Supply.-This will trigger a Purchase Request from Company A to Company B.-Company A processes the Purchase Request and creates a Purchase Order.-The Purchase Order will automatically create a Sales Order for company B.-Company B updates and processes the Sales Order with the normal Outbound Delivery process and Customer Invoice.-The Outbound Delivery from Company B will create a Third-Party Delivery Notification.-The Customer Invoice from Company B will automatically create a Supplier Invoice for Company A.-Company A releases the Third Party Delivery Notification, creating a Third Party Outbound Delivery.-Finally a Customer Invoice from the Third Party Outbound Delivery is created, completing the Third Party process.-Here you can see the detailed process steps.-This process is also available in a Repair Scenario via Service Orders and for Inter Company Projects.-See Also-2837037 Item Description Not Copied from Customer Invoice to Supplier Invoice In An Intercompany Scenario-2821916 Error City in address of Bill-To party missing in Intercompany Sales Order-2774106 Remarks for Supplier not Showing in Sales Order-2764303 Supplier Invoice is not created from Customer Invoice due to the Error in Output of a Customer Invoice: Invalid Chanel Type Code IDX-2743996 A2A Sales Orders are Released Automatically-2696383 Error Appears While Creating new Purchase Order With Reference to Service Order for Repair Scenario-2677533 Intercompany Supplier Invoice not Created Automatically From Customer Invoice Document-2674223 Item Type in the Intercompany Sales Order Changed Automatically-2662519 Error: Costs Not Determined: Required Entry Field ID Of QueryItem Not Filled-2633213 Intercompany Sales Order Cannot Be Released Due To Errors-2596560 Empty Source of Supply in Intercompany Sales Order-2588947 Party of role responsible employee missing-2558184 Unexpected, Automatic Fright Forwarder Selection in an Intercompany Sales Order-2506730 Determination of the Source of Supply in Intercompany Sales Orders-2487134 The Intercompany Project is not Created Automatically-2450401 Intercompany Purchase Order Price not Updated in the Sales Order Document-2408854 Duration of Automatically Created Intercompany Project-2335218 Wrong tax Code in the Intercompany Supplier Invoice Document-2321745 Same Attachment Copied to all Line Items of the Purchase Order Which was Created from a Sales Order.-2250670 The Intercompany Project is not created automatically.-2238192 Intercompany Project Scenario Wrong Ship-To Address Is Determined On Sales Order.-2184903 Intercompany Indicator Is Missing In The Project Types Activity.-2154720 Intercompany Sales Order is Not Created-2097351 The Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project is not created.-2004909 Project Type Intercompany Project is Missing-1972897 Cannot Post Supplier Invoice Due to Exception The item net amount is greater than the open XYZ of goods and services receipt ABC-1961472 Sales Order is not Created During Intercompany Purchase Order Process-1942217 The Status of the Customer Invoice Output Remains Pending in the Intercompany Scenario-1933722 In Sales Order the Create Project Button is not Enabled.-1929614 In an Intercompany Scenario, Adding a New Item in the Purchase Order Does Not Update the Existing Sales Order-1913203 In an Intercompany Scenario Wrong Ship-to Party is Updated on the Sales Order Header-1913197 How To Cancel Sales Order Created Via
