Intercompany Process-1867399 Intercompany Project  is not available.-1846544 Adding New Item In An Intercompany Purchase Order Does Not Update Existing Sales Order-1757256 Error in Tax Calculation in Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company XYZ in an Intercompany Scenario-1658313 Sales Order Approval is Not Supported for B2B and A2A Orders-3250053 - Purchase Request Not Created Title: A completely delivered purchase order item available for time recording.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2768424***-A completely delivered purchase order item available for the service agent time recording.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view-Go to Edit Time Sheet.-Select Add row.-Enter the Project Task ID.-Click on the Purchase Order Value Selection the system defaults the purchase order item which is completely delivered.-Cause-The completely delivered/finished purchase order item is enabled for Unlimited Over-Delivery in the purchase order hence it is available for over-delivery (time recording).-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant finished purchase order line item.-Go to Basic Data tab -Disable the Unlimited Over-Delivery checkbox.-Choose the Save button.-Once the above changes are carried out the completely delivered/finished purchase order line item will not be available for further time recordings.-Keywords-Purchase order finished item,Finished purchase order,PO,Time Recording,Old Purchase order,Service agent,Time Sheet,Project Time Recording

Title: Project Stock Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Intercompany Project Stock Order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-During the execution of a project, you can only source materials from your own inventories (material from stock) company. It means Intercompany Project Stock Order not supported.-The system allows you to plan the Material and you can enable From Stock, however, during the planning phase, the system will not check the availability of the stock.-while creating the project stock order you should enter the correct location from where you are going to ship the material from.-Keywords

Title: Account Details Missing In Registered Product
Content: Symptom-You have issued serial numbers in your stock to customer via an Outbound Delivery. You expect the customer information to be updated in the Account field of the relevant Registered Product automatically but the system does not update the account information.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements work center.-Navigate to the Registered Products view.-Search for the serial number you have issued to your customer and select it.-Choose the Edit button.-You can see that the Account field under the General tab is empty. You expect the details of Account to which the serial number was issued to be updated here.-Cause-You have not scoped Automatic Product Registration in your Implementation Project. If your implementation project is already completed, you will have to create a new Change Project and merge the changes to your implementation project.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Search for the relevant project and choose the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions tab.-Expand the scoping element Service, under the service element select Entitlement Management and choose the Registered Products option.-Under the Questions for Registered Products section, mark the question Do you want the solution to automatically record registered products sold during the outbound delivery process? as In Scope.-Complete the review and Finish confirming the project.-See Also-You can refer to the KBA  1922087 - How to Create a Change Project and Its Lifecycle to understand how to create a change project and merge it with an already completed project.-If you have scoped the above question in your system and the Account Id is still not being updated in the Registered Products please refer the KBA : 2895533 - Account Information Missing In Registered Product-Keywords-serial number account information missing, account details in serial number are missing, ByD, Business ByDesign, ByD Serial numbers account information not available, ByD registered products serial number account information not visible, Location Data Missing for Registered Products, automatic installation point creation

Title: Error During the Migration of Location Along with Material Flow Rules and Logistics Areas
Content: Symptom-You get the error ''MIGRATION TERMINATED, CONTACT YOUR SERVICE ADVISER'' while trying to import Location and Logistics Area data into the system using the migration tool. You also receive error messages like:-"UUID for logistics area ID LOA and site ID SIT not found" (where LOA represents the Logistics Area ID and SIT represents the Site ID).-"Location LOC already exists" (where LOC represents the Location ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview.-Select Activities.-Find and select the Activity 'Migration of Location and Logistics Area'.-Click the Open button.-Click on 'Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool'.-Select the relevant XML file.-Click Execute Migration, then select Execute Migration Step by Step.-Click the Next button until step 3 Simulate Import.-Here the system is logging several errors as stated under symptom above, and the migration is aborted.-Cause-The error is due to the source data. You are trying to migrate the Location along with Material Flow Rules and Logistics Areas.- -During the Migration process, system first creates Location, then the Material Flow Rule for the created Location, and subsequently it creates the Logistics Areas under this Location.-In this case however, a Logistics Area is defined in the Material Flow Rules of the Location. The system therefore tries to access the said Logistics Area which is not yet created and this results in an error.- -Example:--In the case of the Location LOC, two Material Flow rules DESTINATION_ABC (DESTINATION_ABC represents the ID of the Destination Rule) and SOURCE_XYZ (SOURCE_XYZ represents the ID of the Source Rule) are maintained. In the rule SOURCE_XYZ, the source is mentioned as Logistics Area LOA. However, this Logistics Area is yet to be created by the system. Hence, the errors occur and the Migration is aborted.-Resolution-Do not define a Logistics Area in the Material Flow Rules of a Location as the system would try to access the Logistics Area. Since the Logistics Area is not yet created, the system will quit with the above errors.-Kindly maintain your template appropriately.-Keywords-Migration, Location, Logistics Area, Template, Material, Flow, Rule

Title: Performance Issues when Opening the Value Help in the Production Task Data Source
Content: Symptom-You are opening the value help for the characteristic Business Partner Name in the virtual data source Production Task (technical ID SCMPTV01) or a report based on it and receive an error message.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Data Sources.-Show all the data sources and search for the data source Production Task (technical ID SCMPTV01).-Go to the Selection tab and open the value help for characteristic Business Partner Name.-You will receive an error message saying Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident. (same error message appears when you open the value help in a report based on top of this data source)-Cause-The Production Task data source is a virtual data source. This issue occurs due to performance issues. When the value help is selected the program tries to execute data for all the different production tasks.-Resolution-Please use the other available characteristics for the selection such as Task ID, Order ID, Product ID, Request ID, Resource ID or any other ID field.-Our developers are aware of this behaviour and will try to improve it in future releases.-See Also-To improve the performance and as a workaround please create a new selection for the frequently used values in your customized report.-Keywords- SCMPTV01, production task, value help, data source,

Title: How to Restart a Process Communication Message in the User Interface
Content: Symptom-You notice a process communication error in a business document such as for example a Sales Order. You would like to know the reason for the error and if you can restart the process once the error is corrected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of a process communication error from the Sending Document Customer Demand and the Receiving Document Sales Order with the error: Error while processing inbound third party communication and the BTM Task Subject: Solve Service Contract Violation for Sales Order in Process Warehouse Confirmation sent by Outbound Delivery.-Cause-For most process communication errors a Business Task (BTM Task) is created. This BTM task is then assigned to the responsible employee. In our example of a Sales Order the BTM task is assigned to the Employee Responsible.-Please note that these Tasks are assigned to the responsible employee (in our example the Employee Responsible of the Sales Order). Should this Employee Responsible not have the respective access rights for the work center Application and User Management and the Process Communication Error view, you can find these BTM tasks in the work center Application and User Management and the Business Task Management view under the Unassigned Items. You can then assign them to a User who has sufficient access rights.-Resolution-Please note that only the user to which these BTM tasks are assigned to can see these tasks.-Go to the Application and User Management work center. -Select the Process Communication Errors view. -In the drop-down list select Open Errors with Tasks.-Select the respective Task in our example with the subject: Solve Service Contract Violation for Sales Order in Process Warehouse Confirmation sent by Outbound Delivery.-Click on the Task Details button.-Click on the Details hyperlink under Related Document.-You can see the respective error messages in the section Related Errors.-In our example the error messages are as follows:-Saving not possible due to status of document-Mandatory List Price missing. List price must be maintained or a price must be entered manually.-Error while processing inbound third party communication-You need to resolve the issues which caused the error. -Once the issues are resolved you can restart the process by clicking on the Action button and select the option Restart Process.-The message will then be restarted and can be delivered. The BTM task with then also be completed.  -In case the issue is not resolved please create a support incident with the details regarding the affected documents, the process communication error and the steps you took to resolve the issue. Details required to create an incident for the respective area can be found in the Knowledge Base Article 2443337 - Information Required to Answer Your Question-See Also-Blog: How to Restart a Process Communication Message in the User Interface-2443337 - Information Required to Answer Your Question-  2992831 - How to action on Data Flow Verification results/why DFV is still open-Keywords-Restart Process Communication Error,manual restart, restart errors in UI

Title: work flow rules with fields other than available in standard list
Content: Symptom-You could not find the field while creating work flow rule-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application user management work center-Go to work flow rules view-Click on new button-In the second step click on add group-In the drop down you did not find desired field-Cause-Only selected fields are currently added in the Workflow rule. You need to create extension field and map the value.-Resolution-For example: You wanted to create a workflow rule that send an email when an order has been Acknowledged.- Follow below steps  to create extension field:-Go to purchase request and order work center-Go to Purchase orders view-Choose all Purchase orders-Decide whether you want to use column "Status" value(Acknowledgement Received) or the column" PO acknowledgement status" value(Acknowledged)-Then using adaptation mode  create one extension field,-In the pop up screen where you enter details of Extension field you have one check box "Calculated", check mark it.-You can see new field "Calculation rule" choose either Status (Status/PurchaseOrderLifeCycleStatusCode) or PO Acknowledgment Status (Status/PurchaseOrderConfirmationStatusCode) as per the decision made earlier and save it-Later click on save button in the adaptation screen and then publish the changes on adaptation screen.- Then-Go to Application user management work center-Go to work flow rules view-Click on new button-In the second step click on add group-In the drop down you can see the extension field- Note: Ensure that extension field is appearing in the document for which you are creating work flow rule.-Keywords-extension field not appearing

Title: Check Deviating Purchase Order Acknowledgment Task  is not created When Changes to Delivery Date or price or quantity are received
Content: Symptom-You have received the purchase order acknowledgement from supplier and there is a deviation in quantity or price or Delivery Date. However system failed to create a Task – Check Deviating Purchase Order Acknowledgment .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select New PO Acknowledgment button-Enter the Acknowledged Delivery Date / Service Period-System did not create any deviation task-Cause-In general if the price, delivery date, or quantity of the PO acknowledgment is different to those in the purchase order, the system creates a task. However in Business Configuration work center there is an activity called Automatic Accept Deviation on Purchase Order Acknowledgement. Here you have defined Deviation Criteria for  price , quantity and Delivery Date Variance. [Variance Higher Than (Days) and Variance Lower Than (Days)]. Based on the variances you have maintained, system accepts the deviation directly and does not create any deviation tasks.-Resolution-Please change variance  limits if required in fine tune activity Automatic Accept Deviation on Purchase Order Acknowledgement and system shall behave accordingly.-See Also-KBA 3089553 - How does BC activity "Automatic Accept Deviation on Purchase Order Acknowledgement" work-Keywords-Check Deviating Purchase Order Acknowledgment; Task - Deviation task; Deviation Criteria for Delivery Date Variance; PO acknowledgment; Automatic Accept Deviation on Purchase Order Acknowledgement, deviation was accepted automatically, Acknowledgment was accepted automatically,

Title: Default Process Type in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When you adding a material to purchase order, system automatically propose a default process type. You want to know how it be determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Open common task: New Purchase Order, view all.-Go to Items tab, click Add Row, maintain a material ABC (ABC refers to the material ID).-You can see system automatically propose a default process type as To-Stock or Non-Stock.-Cause-Please open the master data of material ABC, go to Planning tab.-If any planning area is set as active, the default purchase order process type for the material always be To-Stock. Even if there are some other planning areas that are still with In Preparation status.-If no planning area is set as active, the default purchase order process type for the material always be Non-Stock.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Process Type, Purchase Order, Default Setting, 流程类型, 采购订单,購買発注

Title: Warning Message Appears While Trying to Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create scheduled project invoice request for sales order and project combination, however system shows the warning message.-Warning - Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found- or-Receives message: Action triggered; verify result in Work view in a few minutes but nothing happens after that.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Select the relevant Project ID-Select New and Project Invoice Request - Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request-Warning message appears- or-Follow the below steps to see the task if any-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Choose the Work View.-Choose the relevant task associated to our project or sales order-You can see the task Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request - Creation of project invoice request failed.-Choose the Edit button.-You will see the application log XXXXX (XXXXXX represents the application log ID).-Go to Results tab here you can see the error-Cause-If the project has another sales order which also has the invoice scheduled on the same date as your current sales order then system will raise the warning message. cause at any given point of time for a project system can create one invoice request only to avoid the duplication of time and expenses.-So there is an open task being created in work sub view of Invoice Preparation view under project management work center and you need to take actions on this task. If you open the task, you will come to know the error from the application log.-Task - Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request-Application Log:-Project invoice request not created-Cannot create; project used in open request of another sales order-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to create scheduled project invoice request manually-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Invoice Preparation view-Select the Work view-Search the Open Task based on Sales Order ID-You will get an Open Task stating - Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request-Complete the Task from Actions button(complete all tasks related to the project)-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Select the relevant Project ID-Select New and Project Invoice Request - Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request- In future to avoid this issue, please schedule the invoice schedule dates of sales orders differently that belong to same project.-Keywords-Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found; Project invoice request not created; Cannot create; project used in open request of another sales order

Title: Error: "Released List prices exist for Product XXX", While Trying to Update Product Category for Materials
Content: Symptom-You would like to change the Product Category of a material or of a product, but you receive the below error message:-Save failed-Released List prices exist for Product XXX (where XXX represents product ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to e.g. Product Data work center-Select e.g. Materials view-Select required ID and select Edit-Change the Product Category as required and select Save-Upon saving you receive the above mentioned error-Cause-This relates to a check introduced with 1905 release. As the released list prices would be used up in the purchasing documents, the list prices would become invalid when there is a change in the product category. If the product category change was allowed, then creating new list prices would not cancel the existing ones automatically.-Resolution-This check has been modified in 2105 release and once your system is upgraded to 2105 version, you can change the product category directly in product master data without any error.-Keywords-Update Product Category, Product Category, Released List prices exist for Product, Fehlermeldung Listpreis muss storniert werden, Produktkategorie ändern, bestehenden Listpreis stornieren, Listpreis ist aktiv-product category update,list price product category

Title: Difference Between Stock Overview and Product Planning
Content: Symptom-It was noticed that the reported Quantity for a Product XXX (XXX represents the Product ID) in the Planning Area YYY (YYY represents the Planning Area ID) in the Stock Overview and in the Product Planning Details screens do not match. The On-Hand Stock and the Available Stock are not the same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the On-Hand Stock, follow the below steps:-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Stock Overview under Common Tasks.-Enter the relevant Product ID.-Enter the relevant Supply Planning Area ID.-Click Go.-There is an X On-Hand Quantity displayed.-To check the Available Stock, follow the below steps:-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Products view.-Select the Advanced Search.-Enter the relevant Product ID.-Enter the relevant Supply Planning Area ID.-Click Go.-The Available Quantity is displayed as Y which is different from the Quantity X displayed as On-Hand Stock in the Stock Overview.-Cause-Sometimes when finishing an Outbound Delivery, an Inbound Delivery or a Warehouse Order, and the quantity is only updated in one of these views, it generates this inconsistency.-Resolution-It can be created a Data Flow Verification Run to fix the inconsistency:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Data Flow Verification Runs view.-Select New.-Enter the Run ID.-Select the Evaluation Two specific business documents.-Click Next.-Select the Business Document One: Inventory.-Select the Business Document Two: Planning View of Inventory.-Click Next.-Enter the Product ID as equal to XXX.-Enter the Supply Planning Area ID as equal to YYY.-Click Next.-Check the box "Automatically correct differences (recommended)".-Click Next.-Click Finish.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Data Flow Verification Runs view.-Find the Run ID which you just created.-Select Change Status.-Choose Set to Active.-Select Schedule.-Choose the Schedule Start Immediately.-Select Save and Close. -Keywords-Quantity, mismatch, difference, Overview, Product, Planning, Details, Supply, Available, Stock, On-Hand

Title: Unable to Create Automatic Serial Number While Confirming a Pick Task
Content: Symptom-For a product, a serial number is maintained as being "Mandatory on transfer to/from customers". When confirming the pick task, you expect to be able to auto-create a registered product by entering the serial numbers in the Next Serial Number field. Alternatively, you also expect to be able to use the Upload function. However, whenever you enter the serial number, the system does not register the input. Uploading the serial numbers also leads to the same result.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Find and select the relevant task.-Click the Confirm button.-Go to the Serial Numbers tab.-Select the row with the relevant product.-Enter a serial number (e.g. 1234 or any other value) in the Next Serial Number field.-Hit the Enter key.-The system does not register the serial input. It is also not possible to use the +Upload button to upload the serial numbers.-Cause-The usage of barcode (Element: Automatic Identification) is not scoped in your Implementation Project/Change Project. Next Serial Number and Upload work via barcodes. A serial number is converted into the barcode format and then posted into the system.-Resolution-Please scope the element Automatic Identification into the system by following the below steps:-Navigate to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Find and activate the element Automatic Identification.-Save your changes.-You may need to restart the system to activate the changes.-See Also-See also:-Help Document: Working with Serial Numbers-Knowledge Base Article: 2263995 - Unable to Create Automatic Serial Number While Post Goods Issue-Keywords-Serial, Number, Confirm, Pick, Task, not able to enter serial number manually, manual entry serial number error.

Title: Errors when creating a document using external catalog
Content: Symptom-While creating a shopping cart using an external catalog-You get  error:Product category XXX does not exist,where XXX is product categoryID-or-You get error:Unit of measure YY does not exist, where YY is Unit of measure symbol-or-Product ID not filled when you transfer the products from external catalog to shopping cart document / Purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Homework center-Go to Advanced shopping view-Enter all necessary details in step 1 and step2- You will get error.-Cause-Product category and Unit of measure comes from external catalog,-since it does not exist in ByDesign, hence the error is thrown.- or-Product ID or product description in catalog is not mapped with what is there in ByDesign-Resolution-There is a BADI where we allow mapping of external catalog details like Product id ,Product description, Product category and Unit  of measure with ByDeisgn details like Product id , product category and Unit of measure.-So you have to contact your Partner to implement this BADI using PDI studio.--Please pass on the below details to your Partners so that they can take further action to solve this issue.--BADI is meant for such cases, to map values from external catalog to their corresponding values in ByDesign system.-Here are the BADI details:--Enhancement Spot :- /SRMAP/LREQ_ENHANCEMENT_SPOT-BADI Definition :- /SRMAP/LREQ_IR_OCI_BADI-Interface :- /SRMAP/IF_LREQX_IR_OCI_BADI-Keywords-Product category does not exist,Unit of measure does not exist, Product ID is empty, Unit of measure is empty,product category is missing,Unit of measure is missing,Unit of measure is grayed out,Product ID from external catalog

Title: The Calculation of Shipment and Execution Start Dates
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order and maintained a Requested Date. You released the same to Logistics Execution. However, when you check the schedule lines of the Customer Demand, you notice that there is a difference between the Requested Delivery Date in the Sales Order and the Execution Start and the Shipping/Pickup Dates proposed by the system. You are wondering where the difference is coming from, since you have not maintained any Shipping Duration in the Transport Lane, nor Goods Issue Processing Time in the Material Master of the related Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Find and select the related Sales Order.-Click the Edit button and then View All.-Go to the Items tab.-You can see a Customer Requested Date on Item level.-Go to the Confirmation Schedules sub-tab.-Go to the Document Flow tab and show the Extended View.-Open the Logistics Details of the related Customer Demand/Sales Order.-Go to the Line Items tab and then to the Schedule Lines sub-tab.-You can see that the Requested and Confirmed Execution Start Date and Shipment/Pickup/Issue Dates are different from the Requested Date in the Sales Order.-You check the relevant Transport Lane and you can see that there's no Shipping Duration/Lead time maintained.-You also check the Material Master of the Product and the Goods Issue Processing Time is maintained as zero.-And  when you check the Calendar of the Site, the Site Calendar has 5 Working Days which does not allow Weekend Execution of Delivery.-Cause-The calculation of Shipment and Execution Start Dates is explained as follows:-Shipment Date is Requested Date minus Shipping Duration.-It considers the working days of the Site Calendar. If Goods Issue (GI) Processing Time is maintained, it also considers the Operating Hours of the Site.-Execution Start Date is Shipment Date minus Goods Issue Processing Time.-It considers the working days of Site Calendar. The Time Zones are also taken into consideration during the calculation of dates.-The Site and the User who created/released the Sales Order are in different Time Zones and the difference in the Dates arises from the conversion of the date of the Site to the User Time Zone.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior. Date calculation takes the user and the Site time zones into consideration.-See Also-1950241 - Why there is A Difference In Shipment Date And Delivery Date-Keywords-Requested Delivery Date, Execution Start Date, Shipping/Pickup Date, Delivery Date, Time Zone, Goods Issue, Transport Lane.

Title: Unable to change Price on Purchase Order Line Items
Content: Symptom-The price field is grayed out in Purchase Order line item-or-The fields under Prices tab are grayed out-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view: Purchase Orders-Search for the respective Purchase Order-Select View All-Navigate to Items tab-Select the relevant item for which you want to change the price-Here you can see that the Price field is grayed out-Go to Prices tab and you will see that Add row is grayed out-Cause-If the invoice document is not yet created for the Purchase Order , then the price/details under prices tab can be updated/added in the Purchase Order. So once invoice is created you cannot edit the prices on purchase order.-Resolution-1.kindly complete the existing Purchase order if its partially invoiced and then click on Actions button and choose"finish invoice"- later you can create new Purchase order for remaining quantity with all changes required.-or-2. Cancel or Void, the existing supplier invoices, then you can make changes as required.-Keywords-PO Price, sent, follow up document created, unable to change discount or surcharge,unable to add discount or surcharge,The fields under Prices tab are greyed out,price field is greyed out in Purchase Order line item

Title: Error in Intrastat Declaration run: Goods Movement and Invoice; Company VAT ID Missing
Content: Symptom-You have created the Intrastat Declaration Run for arrival scenario and the application log shows the error message:-Goods movement; Company VAT ID missing-Goods movement; Company ID missing-Goods movement and invoice; Company VAT ID not valid-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declaration Runs view-Select the relevant Run ID-Go to the Execution Details tab-Check the Application Log ID-Navigate to Results tab-Under General Messages, you can see entry for Transfer to declaration failed for the following items.-Cause-The goods movement used in the declaration run is a standard inbound delivery document for to-stock purchase order or a Third-Party Inbound Delivery document.-If you check the account master data for Buying Company, VAT number or tax number is not maintained.-Resolution-You can maintain the VAT number or tax number and then create the Intrastat Declaration Run again.-This will pick up the Goods movement or Third-Party Inbound Delivery to Intrastat Declaration runs and items will be passed to Intrastat Declaration.-Go to the Accounting Management work center-Go to the Accounts view-Select the relevant Account-Navigate to Financial Data tab and select sub-tab Tax Data-Select Add Row and define the Tax Number-See Also-2998123 - Error in Intrastat Declaration Run: Invoice and Order not Found-2011967 - Cannot Issue Intrastat Declaration File for Country Italy-2605164 - Intrastat Declaration with Type Arrival Inconsistent-2850070 - Error in Intrastat Declaration for Italy-Keywords-Goods movement; Company VAT ID missing; Goods movement; Company ID missing; Intrastat Error

Title: Error: 'Goods movement ABC; invoice and order not found' While Creating Intrastat Declaration for France
Content: Symptom-Error: 'Goods movement ABC; invoice and order not found' while creating Intrastat Declaration (ABC represents the ID of the Delivery Document).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Intrastat work center.-Go to the Intrastat Declaration Runs view.-Search and select the Run ID DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Run).-Click Execution Details tab.-Click the Log ID.-Go to the Results tab.-Click Expand All button.-Cause-Delivery Document is created in the same month as that of the Declaration being created.- or-Invoice is not yet created for the Delivery.-Resolution-For country France, if any one of the above two causes are satisfied then system abort the creation of Declaration as per legal specifications.-Keywords-invoice and order not found, Intrastat, Intrastat Declaration, Goods Movement, /SCO0INTR/CM_VAL_BO:004,Intrastat France is not allowed in the same month

Title: How to Track Tasks Sent by You
Content: Symptom-From multiple screen, you can create a new task and send it to another user, but you don't know how to find it after sent out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Take Supplier Invoicing work center as an example.-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Work view.-Click New: Task.-Maintain the content, save it.-You receive successful message "Task sent", but you don't know where to find and track it.-Cause-You can track the task sent by you in Home work center, Delegated Tasks view.-Resolution-Go to Home work center.-Go to Work: Delegated Tasks view.-Here you can filter all the sent tasks with Created By Me or Forwarded By Me.-Keywords-Task, Delegated Task, 已发送任务, 委派的任务,タスク

Title: Intrastat Declaration not created From Intrastat Declaration Runs
Content: Symptom-Intrastat declaration not created from the Intrastat Declaration runs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declaration runs view-Select the relevant Declaration Run ID-You can see that job has been executed with warnings  or errors and no declarations created- or-Go to the Intrastat work center-Go to the Intrastat Declarations view-Select the relevant Declaration ID-Navigate to Items tab-You do not see the Supplier Invoice which is expected to be picked up for declarations under References tab-or-Go to the Intrastat work center.-Go to the Intrastat Declaration Runs view.-Select the relevant Run ID.-Go to the Execution Details tab.-Select the Application Log ID and navigate to Results tab.-Here you can see the Description as below:-Transfer to declaration not relevant for the following items:-Goods mov. and inv.; entry not relev.; partner is an individual-Cause-1.If you go to the error log or application log it says - "Following items are not relevant for declarations". The reason being is , there is no tax data maintained in the Supplier master data which is used in the purchase order and supplier invoice. Because of this, the business partner tax id is not determined and the system treats the company as a natural person/individual and not as a company/business partner and thereby the documents are not picked for declaration.-2. System failed to pick up the invoices in the Intrastat declaration run because both Company an Supplier located in the same European Country.-The data, which qualify is given below that is conditions from various EU transaction documents, are pushed into Intrastat and shown in Intrastat item work list.--The conditions are:-•Country from which goods are sent (dispatching country) is EU Country.-•Country to which goods are sent (recipient country) is EU Country.-•Goods sender country (dispatcher) is not the same as goods receiving country (receiver)-•Products should be of the type material (products of type services are not supported)-Resolution-You can maintain the tax details for seller from the below steps and system will pick up the invoice data in Intrastat for future instances-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Select the relevant supplier.-Navigate to Financial Data tab and select Tax Data sub tab.-Under Tax Numbers, you must maintain Country, Tax Number Type and Tax Number.-Select Save.-Note: If the declaration is already created, you need to add the items manually to declaration and process them manually.-See Also- 3038780 - Intrastat declaration not created or Few documents not appearing in the declaration-Keywords-Intrastat items not picked for declaration, Intrastat declaration not created, Following items are not relevant for declarations,Supplier invoice not picked up in Intrastat, Goods receipt not picked for Intrastat

Title: Error message:Mapping of Unit of Measure XXX not Possible; Missing Mapping
Content: Symptom-You see this error with incoming Invoices or Purchase orders in the Business communication monitoring view.-Where XXX is Unit of measure-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User Management work center-Go to Business Communication Monitoring-Show Business Messages with errors-Select the document with content error-Scroll down to Message details-Under Additional errors you can see this error- To view the XML select the  content error and on top you have download payload button so click on it andsave it.-Cause-You have used a unit of measure that is visible in the XML of incoming message that is not defined in ByDesign system under business configuration activity called code list mapping.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Choose Overview-Show all activities and search for Code List Mapping-Select it and click on change immediately button-Under Code list mapping definition  select the Local data type name as MeasureUnitCode-Scroll down to Code list mapping rule-Click on Add row-Choose map individual codes from value help-Scroll down to Code list mapping-Add the details for missing Unit of measure XXX, i.e enter External code  as XXX and choose the corresponding Local code from Drop down.-Click on Save-Keywords-unit of measure missing, unit of measure mapping missing, Item Mapping of unit of measure not possible; missing mapping

Title: Error Message:E-mail address is invalid: Not listed in allowed email domain
Content: Symptom-When last approver tries to approve the Purchase order you get the above error.-or-You have created a new purchase order however system shows the error message when you click on order button.- or-When you try to navigate the document flow of the purchase order, system crashes.- or- In the edit output settings  of purchase order  click on apply, you will see same error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to managing my area work center-Click on approvals-Select the respective Purchase order-Click on approve button- You will get error- Second time you click on Approve button the approval is successful but when you check the output history of such Purchase orders it will be empty.- or-Go to the Purchase Reqests and Orders work center.-Choose Purchase Orders view.-Choose the respective Purchase Order ID-Choose Save button.-System throws error messages.-or-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders and find the required Purchase Order ID.-Select and Edit it.-Choose View All and navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Here system crashes.-Cause-System is not generating output for relevant Purchase Order, since you have not maintained email address domain of the Sender's Email.- Sender is maintained in field Buyer responsible in purchase order general tab.-Resolution-The sender email address appears in the edit output history screen at the very bottom of the screen.-Add email Domain under Business configuration activity: Email and Fax settings using below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center-Go to Overview-Choose All Configuration Elements using drop down-Search activity: E-Mail and Fax Settings-Under section: Allowed Sender E-Mail Domains-Choose on Add Row and maintain Domain (details appearing after @ in an Email address) which you have maintained for Sender's Email Address-Perform Save-Going forward when you create new purchase orders no error shall appear.-Keywords-E-mail address is invalid: Not listed in allowed email domain,  Purchase order Out history is empty,Purchase order Output not generated,invalid e-mail address: not listed in authorized e-mail domain

Title: How to Perform Adjustment Confirmation for a Warehouse Order Involving  Two Step Receiving Process (Unload and putaway operation)
Content: Symptom-To perform Adjustment Confirmation for a Warehouse Order involving two step receiving process (Unload and put-away operation).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to By Warehouse Order sub view under Monitoring view.-Search for the Warehouse Order ABC. (ABC represents Warehouse Order ID)-Choose Edit.-In Warehouse Order screen, Choose Adjustment Confirmation.-In the Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order screen, select the row with the Operation Type Unload.-Choose Enable Entry.-Choose Split Quantities.-Update the Quantity Difference field in the new split line item with minus of Planned Quantity. Example: If the Planned Quantity is 10 ea, update Quantity Difference with -10 ea.-In the same new split line item, change the Target Logistics Area  to 123. If the Target Logistics Area is not changed, then the stock will stay in 456.-Note that Adjustment is only possible for Unload operation, not at Put away operation.-Choose Save.-Remarks to Serialized Product:-To adjust the Confirmation of a Warehouse Order involving a Serialized Product in a two step receiving process:-Perform Goods movement for the Serial product XYZ from Logistic Area 123 to 456. -Perform Adjustment without Split Quantities on Unload Task by removing the Serial Number XYZ.-(123 represents the Target logistics area of the put away task)-(456 represents the Source logistics area of the put away task)-(XYZ represents the relevant Serial ID of the product)-See Also-1850511 - How to Perform Adjustment Confirmation for a Warehouse Order Involving two Step Shipping Process-Keywords-Warehouse Order; Adjustment Confirmation; Two Step Adjustment Confirmation for receiving process; Two Steps Delivery Process Cancellation; Inbound Delivery Adjustment Confirmation; Inbound Delivery Adjustment Confirmation; Two Step Cancellation Put-away and Unload; Serial Number

Title: How the Currency of Purchase Order that is Created From Purchase Request is Determined
Content: Symptom-How is the currency determined in Purchase Order created from the Purchase Request-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Purchase Request can have many items with different currencies, the Purchase Request's header currency gets copied from Purchase Request's 1st line item currency. That is, the currency maintained in the 1st line item will become the Purchase Request's header currency.-Resolution-When a Purchase Order (where only single currency is possible) is created from a Purchase Request, the header currency of Purchase Order is copied from header currency of Purchase Request.-Any change to above logic is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-1. If you are a partner: you can help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2. If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.-OR-A. Contact your the Account Executive-B. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-3. Alternatively you may check the Customer Influence Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-See Also-  KBA 2912560 - How the currency is derived in manual Purchase request-Keywords-Purchase order currency, currency wrong,  PO currency wrong,determination of Purchase order currency

Title: You created a custom report on data source Procurement Price Specification Details (technical ID SRMPRC_B01) and the Key figure Amount shows *
Content: Symptom-You run your custom report on data source Procurement Price Specification Details and notice that the key figure Amount displays * instead of a value for some products.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work Center Business Analytics, View Design Reports.-Search for your customized report.-Open your report and run it with your maintained selection.-Add the Characteristic Product to the Report View.-You noticed that the key figure Amount shows * for some products.-Cause-The key figure Amount displays * because for this product there are multiple list prices with different currencies maintained. This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-If you want to show the different currencies and a value for Amount, please add the characteristics Valid From and Valid To to your report view. Now it will display the values with different currencies.-Keywords-multiple price lists, SRMPRC_B01, custom report, Amount, different currencies, no values, no data

Title: You are not Able to Mark Only One Component for Supply to Production in a Production Model
Content: Symptom-You have created a Production Model, which has multiple Input Products (or components). You want to enable only one of the Input Products for Supply to Production, but system is only allowing you to select either all or none.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Models view.-Search for the relevant Production Model.-Select the searched Production Model and select the Edit button.-In the production model screen, select the tab Bill of Operations and the sub-tab Product Assignment. Then navigate to the relevant Activity to which you have assigned the Input Products.-Here, you can see that Supply to Production is enabled for the Input Products. If you de-select Supply to Production for one of them, then the system de-selects for all the Input Products. Now, if you again select only one Input Product for Supply to Production, then the system automatically selects all the Input Products. So, it is not possible to assign only one Product for Supply to Production.-Cause-Selection/de-selection of the Input Products for Supply to Production happens at Line Item Group level. Since in this case all Input Products belong to same Line Item Group, system is allowing to select either all Input Products or none of them for Supply to Production.-Resolution-If you want to assign only one Product for Supply to Production, then you need to change the corresponding Bills of Material (BoM) accordingly and assign different line item Group IDs to the Input Products. To do so:-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Bills of Materials view.-Search for the relevant Production Bills of Material.-Select the searched BoM and choose the Edit button.-In the Production BoM screen, select the tab Input Products. Here, you can see that the Input products are assigned to the same Line Item Group ID.-Select any one of the Line Item and un-assign it from the relevant variant.-Choose the Add Row button.-Enter the Input Product which you have selected in step 6, in column Product ID.-Maintain the Line Item Group ID for this product which is different than other Input Products.-Maintain all other entries and choose Save button.-After making all the changes, go back to the Production Model screen and choose the Input Product which you want to enable for Supply to Production.-Note: You need to create a new Engineering Change Order (ECO) for step 10. Creation of ECO is not covered in this document.-Keywords-Supply, To, Production, Input, Product, Production, Model, BoM, Bill, of, Materials

Title: Unassigned Approval Task
Content: Symptom-Approver is appearing in the  document, however he is not getting Approval Task,- or- tasks appear as unassigned tasks under Business Task Management work center.- or- Approver is getting some error while approving the document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Approver does not have sufficient access right for the Approval Task to be assigned automatically.-Resolution-Go to Application user management work center-Go to Business Task Management View-Select the respective unassigned task-At the bottom you can see Action Logs(if don't see Action log then click on determine assignment button)-Click on recent Action Log-You will see that User needs to have few work center views assigned (with write access if its MMA  related work centers)-Assign the same to that User-Keywords-Unassigned approval task,Unassigned task,Un assigned approval task,Un assigned task

Title: System Crashes While Creating Outbound Delivery Directly
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to create an Outbound Delivery with Release or Without Release using option Create Outbound Delivery, system crashes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Delivery Control view and the subview Delivery Proposal.-Select All Delivery Proposals from the Show dropdown.-Find and select the relevant Delivery Proposal ID for which you want to create an Outbound Delivery.-Choose the Create Outbound Delivery with/without release button.-System crashes every time.-Cause-Here the Delivery Type is Return to Supplier therefore system checks for restricted stock in the Return to Supplier scenario and since this is not available it is unable to propose the logistics area and proceed thus resulting in system crash in consecutive processing.-Using option Create Outbound Delivery with/without release directly, the system creates the OD in the background.-So when no logistics area is proposed it is unable to continue though there is a stock in the inventory however it is not restricted stock.-When you get a product from supplier and you want to return the material for some reasons hence need to mark products which must be returned (e.g. damaged products) as Restricted stock to differentiate between product returns from other products.-Resolution-Go to Internal Logistics Work center.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Choose Change of Stock.-Enter the required Site and Product ID.-Enter the quantity and go to next guided step.-Mark the checkbox as Restricted for required quantity with required logistics area.-Perform Save.-Once it is done, outbound delivery can be created.-Keywords-Return to Supplier, Goods Issue, Restricted stock, Logistics Area, Inventory, A CIT SL BTDR without ID exists for Inbound Delivery Request

Title: System Releases Outbound Delivery Automatically
Content: Symptom-You have created a warehouse task and once it gets confirmed, system creates an Outbound Delivery with status Released automatically. However, you want to release the Outbound Delivery manually as per your business requirement.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Select the required Task ID and click on the Confirm button.-Enter all required details and save.-Now to go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Show All Outbound Deliveries by selection and find the required ID.-Here you see that the Outbound Delivery is already in status Released.-Cause-You have marked the option Release Outbound Delivery as Automatically for the relevant Logistics Model ID for Standard Shipping with tasks in the system.-Resolution-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to the Logistics Model ID view.-Select All Logistics Models by Selection and find the relevant Logistics Model ID for the required Site ID.-Filter the Model ID via Logistics Model Type as Standard Shipping with description : Template for one-step shipping with pick lists.-Select and edit the Logistics Model ID.-Under the Details section of the selected Logistics Model find the field: Release Outbound Delivery and select the option Manually.-Click on the Check button to verify that the Logistics Model is consistent.-Click Save and Release.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery Release, Automatically, Manually, Logistics Model,Template for one-step shipping with pick lists, standard shipping.

Title: System triggers warning message while checking the consistency of Customer Return Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-Warning message appears "Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item xx (xx refers to item no) in outbound delivery DEF"(DEF refers to Outbound delivery id)while checking the consistency of Customer Return Delivery Notification KLM (KLM refers to Customer Return Delivery Notification id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Inbound delivery Notifications View-Select Customer Return Delivery Notification KLM-Select on Edit-Select Check Consistency-A warning message appears "Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item xx in outbound delivery DEF"-Cause-In the document flow of the Outbound Delivery DEF, you observe that there is a already existing  Customer Return Delivery  Notification NOP (NOP refers to Customer Return Delivery Notification id) associated with Outbound delivery DEF.  Now the Customer Return Delivery Notification KLM  is again trying to start a return, Hence the warning message is triggered.-Resolution-The warning message is valid and expected behvaiour.-Keywords-Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item in outbound delivery,Warning message appears  when checked the consistency of Customer Return Delivery Notification

Title: "Service call failed; report an incident" While Migrating Serialized Inventory
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate Serialized Inventory in the system and hence entered all required data i.e. Site ID, Product ID, Quantity and Serial Numbers etc. but you receive the below error during the Simulation step:-"Service call failed; Report an incident"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Upload the Migration File.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records.-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step.-Cause-The error is caused due to one of the below reasons:-Since you have not maintained Quantity Type (i.e. Unit of Measure) for the products in the template therefore system is unable to set up the relationship with Serial Numbers with quantity.-There are a lot of Serial Numbers (Example: 100k) causing memory exceptions in the backend.-Resolution-Correct the data and maintain required Quantity Type for all products in the migration file and proceed with the simulation.-If there are a lot of Serial Numbers, split the content to multiple files and proceed with the migration activity.-Keywords-Migration of Accounting Transaction Data., Inventory, serial Numbers, Quantity tYpe, Service call failed; report an incident, Serial Numbers: missing key relationship.
