Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 3198606***-What are the Access rights required to approve the shopping carts and purchase orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-User can approve Shopping carts if any of the below are assigned.-MMA_MYPROJECTS-MMA_MYTEAM-MMA_MYORGANIZATION-PRO_CMPCTXT_EXPENSESANDPURCHAS-PRO_EXPENSESANDPURCHASES-  User can approve Purchase orders when the below is assigned.-MMA_OPERATIONALPURCHASING-  Keywords-Un assigned task, approver not triggered, access rights required for approving, unable to add approver, approver not found

Title: All project tasks are not Appearing in Report : Revenue by Team Member
Content: Symptom-All tasks available in a project are not appearing in this report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business analytics work center-Go to Design Reports-Search for  reportRevenue by Team Member-Filter with  respective project ID-In rows add Project, Project task and Team member-and execute you will see that few taks are missing- However if you go to Report ID: PROPRJU05_Q0001 and do same filtering and rows and columns  mentioned above, you will see all project tasks are not appearing.-Cause-The purpose of both reports are different:-Report PROPRJU05_Q0001 Project Time Recordings is project based.-Report PROCPIU03_Q0001 Revenue by Team Member is expense based.-In general all Project tasks are shown for which expenses exist,but above reports or respective data source has a restriction that  they would excludes expenses that are assigned to  sales orders with  item type: fixed price, cause we do not calculate a revenue for these expenses.-Resolution-In case all project tasks are needed we recommend you to create your own report .i.e you  can create join data source using one data source PROCPIU03 - Revenue Contribution and other data source where the desired data exist.-Keywords-Project tasks missing in report,Revenue by team member report not pulling all tasks,fixed price tasks not appearing

Title: Error message: Period XXX in Fiscal Year YYYY Closed for Closing Step Operational Postings
Content: Symptom-Error in Supplier invoice when you simulate Journal Entry, click Post button or try to Approve a supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Click Invoices and Credit memos view.-Search for respective supplier invoice and open it.-Click Actions button and choose Simulate Journal Entry.-Error message is raised:-'Period XXX in Fiscal Year YYYY Closed for Closing Step Operational Postings'-XXX means the accounting period.-YYYY means the fiscal year.-Cause-After submitting the invoice for approval you have made changes in the Open and Close Periods by changing the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step from Operational postings in the period within which you maintained the posting date of the invoice.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center-Choose the Open and Close Periods subview under Common Tasks view.-Select the respective Set of Books and Company ID.-Choose the row of Accounting Period ID XXX, and set the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step to 010-Operational postings.-Scroll down where you can see posting allowed dates and make sure that the period is not Blocked considering the posting date for invoice.-If you made the corrections when the supplier invoice is already In Approval status and you are still unable to approve the document (for example, the approve button is disabled), then kindly withdraw the invoice from approval, check consistency and then resubmit.-See Also-2668839 - Approve Button disabled /Greyed out on Supplier invoice Approval Task-Keywords-Period in Fiscal Year Closed for Closing Step Operational Postings; accounting period; 010-operational postings; first allowed step; last allowed step; closing step

Title: Error While Checking Connection in the Custom Web Service Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-You are getting the below error when you click on Check Connection in the Communication Arrangement of Custom Webservice.-Ping Failed.-Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: No Web service configuration for this access path: PQR.-Where PQR is the path you have provided in the URL path.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio.-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the frontend UI.-Navigate to the Administrator work center.-Select Communication Arrangement subview.-Open the Communication Arrangement that you have created from SDK.-Navigate to the Technical Data.-Click on the button Edit Advanced Settings.-Select the service and click on the button Check Connection.-Error Appears.-Cause-The URL you have provided in the field Path is incorrect or incomplete.-Resolution-In order to get the right path, you have to follow the below steps:--Open the WSDL that you have downloaded or open the WSDL in SDK.-Search with the term Service in the WSDL.-Copy the value starting from “sap/ till the rest of the url in to the field Path.-Save and Activate.-Click on Check Connection.-You can see the message Ping Successful.-Note: You should ensure that the solution is activated and scoped as a pre-requisite.-See Also-3008211 - Error While Checking Connection in the Custom Web Service Communication Arrangement -2660652 - Error While Checking Connection in the Custom Web Service Communication Arrangement -Keywords-Error in Communication Arrangement,Custom webservice error,Ping failed,Error while receiving by HTTP (error code: 407 , error text: ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR)-ping failed,check connection error

Title: System is Rounding up Quantity for the UoM 'each' in the Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order SAO (SAO represents the Sales Order ID) with a Quantity of the Product PRD (PRD represents the Product ID) in the Unit of Measure 'each' in decimal and you have released the Customer Demand to execution. Now when you go to Supply Planning work center, and open the Product Planning Details of PRD, you can see that the Available Quantity is correctly displayed with the decimal places. However, in Stock Overview, the Quantity is rounded up.-You do not see any reason why the system should be showing rounded Quantity and cutting off the Decimal Places.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Find and select the Product PRD.-You can see the Available Stock Quantity is X.y.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Select Stock Overview.-Enter the Product PRD.-Click the Go button.-You can see that the system has rounded up the On-Hand Stock value to a whole number X with no decimal places.-Cause-You have maintained zero decimal places in Business configuration under the Activity 'Quantities and Units of Measure' for the Unit of Measure used in the Product Master Data.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find and select the Activity 'Quantities and Units of measure'.-Click on 'Change Immediately'. -Click on 'Create and Maintain trading units'.-Select the Unit of measure 'Each'.-You can see under the column 'Display Decimals' that the value maintained is zero.-Change this according to your needs and save your changes. -You may have to log out and back into the system for the changes to take effect.-If you maintain decimals, the system does upper rounding based on decimals setting. Please note that only a Maximum of 3 decimal upper rounding is allowed.-Keywords-UoM, Rounding, Availability, On-Hand, Decimal Places

Title: Automatic Conversion Not Happened When Changing Currency in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You manually changed purchase order currency under General tab, but system doesn't convert the price amount automatically even though the exchange rate already maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders work center, Purchase Orders view.-Open purchase order ABC (ABC refers to the purchase order ID), the total amount is 100 USD.-View all and go to General tab, change the currency from USD to EUR.-You expect the system will convert the amount to a new value automatically according to the exchange rate you maintained, but the value does not change and the total amount becomes 100 EUR.-Cause-This is the current system behavior. During update of puechase order, automatic currency conversion is not supported, only the currency unit changes will be reflected in header currency.-Resolution-Please update the value manually also you may consider the below:-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-1.If you are a partner: you can help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2.If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.-Or      -a. Contact your the Account Executive-b. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us-3. An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Purchase Order, Currency Conversion, Automatic Conversion,Purchase order price not changed

Title: Error: Ship To Location Is Not Within The Receiving Site
Content: Symptom-System displays an error message 'Ship to location is not within the receiving site' while you are performing Post Goods Receipt.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistic work center.-Select Purchase Order sub view.-Choose Open Purchase Orders from the Show field.-Enter the Purchase Order ID.-Select the Purchase Order and click on Post Goods Receipt.-System displays an error message: 'Ship to location is not within the receiving site'.-Cause-In the Supply Chain Design Master Data the Logistic Use for the affected Logistics Area was not maintained, therefore system throws this error message.-The system will also display this error if you try to change the Ship-To Location to a different Site order than the one maintained in the Purchase Order.-Resolution-Go to Supply Chain Master Data Work Center.-Choose Locations.-Select the affected Site/Location ID.  -Click on Edit layout.-Select the Logistics Area ID.-Under General tab maintain Logistics Use as per your Business scenario.-See Also-2410818 - Cannot Create Notification; Items Have Different Ship-to Locations-Keywords-ship to, location, not, within, receiving site, error, post, goods, receipt, logistics use, change

Title: System  Proposes Wrong  Source and Target Logistics Area While Confirming Make Task
Content: Symptom-When you confirm the Make Task, system proposes Source and Target Logistics Area X instead of Y. (here X and Y represents Logistics Area IDs)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Workcenter.-Go to Task Control View.-In the field Show, select All Tasks by Selection using drop-down and choose Go.-Now find the required Make Task ID.-Select the required Make Task ID and choose Confirm.-Navigate to Confirmation tab.-Under Output Products sub tab, you see that system proposes Target Logistics Area as X instead of Y. (here *X and Y represents the Logistics Area IDs)-Cause-In Make Task, Target Logistics Area is proposed as per the logistics area maintained for the Main Resource maintained at the Operation(Make).-When a production model is created, Logistics Area at the operation will be automatically picked up from Main Resource Logistics area which is maintained at Make Operation. So, Logistics Area at both Resource and Operation should always be the same.-Resolution-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data Workcenter.-Go to Production Bills of Operation View.-Find the required Bills of Operation ID against the Output Product.-Select and edit it.-Go to Structure tab, expand all operations and select required Make Operation.-Here you can find Main Resource set for the operation.-Now in Details section, under subtab Operation Details, you see the Logistics Area ID is being used as Target Logistics Area.-Here using Value Selection, enter new Logistics Area which is required.-Perform Check Consistency and Save.-Next,-From BoO itself, double click on hyperlink of Resource ID.-In the resource window, in General tab under Resource Location Data, Logistics Area ID is maintained.-Here now the set the new Logistics Area ID same as maintained at Operation Level in BoO.-Once it is done, perform Save.-Now open the Logistics Area ID via hyperlink from Resource ID window itself.-Edit the relevant Logistics Area ID.-Find the Logistics Area ID in the hierarchy.-Choose and navigate to Resources tab.-Here in section: Production Supply and Output Details.-Choose required Fixed Supply Area and Fixed Supply Area as per your requirement.-Perform Save and Close.-Next,-Once all these data changes have been done.-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data Work center.-Go to Production Models View.-Show All Production Models and find the required Production Model ID.-It should be status Check Pending.-Edit and choose Check Consistency.-Then choose Release Production Model selecting For Planning and Execution.-Perform Save.-Once all these steps are completed, then create a Production Order and Tasks to have new logistics area to be fetched by the system.-Note: Production Tasks which were already created will not have the new Supply and Target Logistics Area IDs.-Keywords-Target Logistics Area, Make Task, Production Task Confirm, Resources, Main Resources, Production Control

Title: Intrastat Declaration run did not Pick Invoice Documents
Content: Symptom-You have created Intrastat declaration run but system did not pick the reference items during the run.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center -Select Intrastat Declaration Run view-Check the log-The run shows error log-Now go to Intrastat Item Worklist view-Here you can see corresponding document references are customer/supplier invoice and third party return document.-Cause-System does not consider the items only with reference to standalone invoices.--The declarations are done based on delivery items and not invoice. In the case of these invoices, there are no deliveries.-In case of third party scenario, you do not own the actual stock at your end, so it will not be consider third party return documents in declaration run.-Resolution-Please create delivery document to run intrastat declaration successfully.-Keywords- Intrastat declaration run, invoice document, declaration run failed

Title: Error Message while Packing an Outbound Delivery Into logistic unit: 'Creation of package failed'
Content: Symptom-You try to pack into an Outbound Delivery into logistic units but you receive the following error messages:-Creation of package failed------> Load package data failed------> Inner package same as parent package-Environment-Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Open Work centre Outbound Logistics and then choose: Outbound Deliveries.-Find and select Outbound Delivery ABC ( ABC represents the Outbound Deliver ID).-Click Packing.-Insert a Top Package DEF (DEF represents the Logistic Unit).-Insert a second package XYZ (XYZ being another Logistic Unit).-Cause-One of the reason this error message appear is because the question 'Do you want to pack into logistics units creating package IDs based on outbound deliveries?' is not scoped in your Implementation Project.-Resolution-You need to scope the Question ‘Do you want to pack into logistics units creating package IDs based on outbound deliveries?’. It can be found on the path:-Go to Business Configuration - Implementation Projects.-Edit your Project Scope.-Go to the 4th tab ‘Question’.-Expand ‘Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics’.-Expand ‘Tracking, Tracing, and Identification’.-Select ‘Handling and Logistics Units’.-Add ‘Do you want to pack into logistics units creating package IDs based on outbound deliveries?’ to your scope, and save it.-Keywords-Creation, package, failed,  Load, data, Inner, parent, Outbound Delivery, Packing

Title: Supplier Currency is not reflected in Purchase Order from  Master Data
Content: Symptom-When user create a Purchase order for Supplier the currency in Purchase Order is not derived from supplier master data-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create an Material Requirement Planning(MRP) Run-Purchase Proposal will be created , in turn Purchase Request is created and then Purchase Order is created out of it-The currency is not picked from supplier master data in the corresponding Purchase Order-But when Purchase Order is directly created as in Non-Stock Process, the currency is taken form supplier master data-Cause-When MRP run is done, the currency in Purchase Order is picked up from the preceding documents and in the preceding documents like Purchase request where the supplier may not be maintained.--The Currency can be picked based on the source of supply (contract/fixed source of supply/list price etc) as well.-If No Source of Supply is available for those products during the creation of Purchase Order then Purchasing-Currency is defaulted from your Company Currency-Resolution-This is expected system behavior-Keywords-Currency-Purchase Order-MRP Run-Source of Supply

Title: Notification - One or More Items in Shopping Cart Canceled by Buyer
Content: Symptom-System creates a notification for the shopping cart which has been already submitted-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center-Go to the Work view & select Inbox subview-You can see a notification for the relevant shopping cart-Cause-The notification is raised, because one or more shopping cart items were canceled by the responsible buyer. The notification informs the creator of the shopping cart that the buyer canceled the assigned purchase request items.-Note: The default priority of this type of notification is medium but can be configured. The notification is canceled automatically by the system after 30 days.-Resolution-The notification is relevant to the creator of the shopping cart.-The creator of the shopping cart receives this notification in the Inbox subview of the Work view of the Home work center.-Shopping cart creator can contact buyer responsible to know more details regarding cancellation.-To complete the notification and remove it from the work list, user can follow the below steps:-Go to the Home work center-Go to the Work view & select Inbox subview-Select the relevant notification-Select Actions & acknowledge the notification-See Also-3243540 - Incident : Assignment of type /SRMAP/REQ_IR_NTF_CANCEL_PR BTM items not possible-Keywords-One or More Items in Shopping Cart Canceled by Buyer

Title: You Cannot Use 'Opportunity Approval Date' Field when Do Custom Development due to PSM Disabled
Content: Symptom-You would like to use the field of 'Opportunity Approval Date' when do custom development, but the field cannot be used due to PSM disabled.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Where the field can be found from frontend:-Go to Opportunities work center view.-Open one opprotunity and in the Header place, you can find the field 'Opportunity Approval Date'.-Also, if you go to Approval tab, there is a field called "Changed On", which shows the same data with 'Opportunity Approval Date'.-Cause-Opportunity approval date comes from the 'Changed On' of the corresponding BTM task.This is not an opportunity BO field to be PSM released.-As the approval data comes from "tasks/notifications" (BTM task) and currently there is no way to read that information for a custom solution, also there is no such external API from BTM/NGAP side.-BO Task is not part of PSM released and this is not going to be changed, So customer currently cannot use this field in their custom solution.-Resolution-This is standard design.-This is the same for Sales Quote/Order-Keywords-Opportunity Approval Date ; Changed On ; Opportunity ;  PSM

Title: Error:Posting date should not be less than DD.MM.YY, Not later than todays date
Content: Symptom-when you post or approve a supplier invoice where buying company is in Italy, you may get this error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently we have a legal requirement in Italy to have a sequence in the way invoices are posted based on posting date of invoice and thus we have developed system accordingly.-Explanation of system behavior with an example is given below:--Say last invoice posted in customer system is A with posting date as 18.3.2018 and today's date is 21.3.2018.-Now customer created two invoices later one Called B with 19.3.2018 and another Called C with 20.3.2018.-Case 1:--Both invoices B and C went for approval and approver first approves C and it gets approved successfully cause system checks based on last posted invoice posting date and in this case it is 18.3.2018, Now when he tries to approve B he gets error: Posting date should not be less than 20.03.2018, Not later than today’s date.--Case 2:-Both invoices B and C are just saved (no approval is there in this case)-If customer first posted the invoice C it gets successfully posted cause system checks based on last posted invoice posting date and in this case it is 18.3.2018, Now when he tries to post B he gets error: Posting date should not be less than 20.03.2018, Not later than today’s date.-Note: A,B,C are Supplier invoice IDs-Resolution-If you do not want system throwing error and if you still want the legal requirement fulfilled as well then you can follow below steps. where posting date is changed to current date automatically.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Choose Implementation Projects-Click on Edit Project Scope-Click Next until you reach Questions tab-Expand Scoping Element Purchasing-Expand Supplier Invoicing-Select Supplier Invoice and Credit Memo-Find question Do you want to enable automatic proposal of posting date based on system date? -For the existing effected documents-If they go for approval then withdraw the Invoices from approval  and then edit them as mentioned below-If they don't go for approval,as per the error  change posting date to a  date that is equal to or  greater thanDD.MM.YY, and less than than or equal to today's date-Keywords-Posting date should not be less than, Not later than today's date, Automatic posting date for Italy.

Title: Post Supplier Invoice - You Cannot Post the Invoice - Date is Blocked for Posting in Financial Accounting
Content: Symptom-When creating a Supplier Invoice using a date from the past. You are unable to post it due to error message 'You cannot post the invoice on DD:MM:YYYY; this date is blocked for posting in financial accounting'.-In the General Ledger you verified that the relevant period's status is not blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Under Common Tasks select New Invoice without Purchase Order.-Fill in all the mandatory details and press Post.-Cause-The Supplier invoice cannot be posted because of missing process control settings for the posting date of the invoice.-In the process control area it is organized how to process source documents in specific time periods and posting dates.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Companies view.-Select the Company ID of the buying company in the invoice and press Set Process Control.-In the General Data tab, press Add to add a new Process Control item with Business Process Group: Supplier Invoicing.-Define dates in the Entry Possible Until, From Posting Date, To Posting Date fields, ensuring that date invoice's posting date DD.MM.YYYY is within the defined time span.-Press Save and Close.-Once you have maintained a Process Control for, at least source documents of type Supplier Invoice, you will be able to post the supplier invoice on DD.MM.YYYY.-Please note that, for supplier invoice posting, please ensure the First Allowed Step is set to 010 - Operational postings.-See Also- 2677140 - Posting Date Blocking Error Although Period is not Blocked-Keywords-Process Control, Blocked for posting, Period Not Blocked, General Ledger, Supplier Invoice, date is blocked, You cannot post the invoice on, this date is blocked for posting in financial accounting

Title: Project Stock Order Ship From 3PL Site Not Possible
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User cannot choose 3PL site as Ship-from Location in order to fulfill a Project Stock Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When the user create a project stock order --Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects View -> Find Project ABC (ABC represents the Project's ID). -Select the Project ABC -> Edit Products. -Select the To-Stock Product -> Select New Project Stock Order.-In the new pop-up window, under the Ship From Location, the user is unable to find the 3PL Site in the drop down.-Cause-SAP Business Bydesign does not support Project stock orders for 3PL sites. 3PL site cannot have a layout with logistics area as the site is not physically present in the company but created virtually in the system for inventory management. For a project stock order, there should be a logistics area which has the usage type as 'Project Stock'. Since, it is not possible to configure this for a 3PL site the user will have to choose an internal warehouse.-Resolution-Internal Warehosue can be selected as a Ship-From Location.-Keywords-project stock order, 3PL site, project stock

Title: Product Restriction Maintained In Logistics Area Not Considered
Content: Symptom-You have maintained that only the product ABC (ABC represents the exact product's ID) is allowed to be stored in logistics area with Id PQR (PQR represents the logistics' area ID). However, when you perform an ad-hoc Goods Movement of product XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of another product) to the logistics area PQR, you see that the system allows to place the product XYZ in the logistics area PQR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Internal Logistics work center.-Select the option Goods Movement from Common Task view.-In the Goods Movement screen enter the site details and choose the button Add Row.-Enter the product XYZ and the quantity you have to move to the logistics area PQR and then choose the button Next.-In Enter Confirmation Details screen select Target Logistics Area value as ABC and choose the button Next.-Review the details entered and choose the Finish button.-You can see that even if we have restricted the storage of product XYZ in logistics area PQR, the system allows you to move the stock.-Cause-Goods Movement is not considered in the restriction of a Logistic Area and user is allowed to store a material which does not belong to the restricted storage group. Goods movement represents after fact activities and not planned ones. Hence, Goods Movement is the only available option via which the warehouse rules can be overridden to reflect the actual warehouse situation.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-See Also-2619163 - Ad-hoc Goods Movement Between Logistics Areas Done Although Restriction With Storage Group is Set at Logistics Area Level-Keywords-goods modement, ad-hoc goods movement, restricted storage group

Title: Cannot Approve Purchase Order - Error: Purchase Order Approval Not Possible
Content: Symptom-The user cannot approve a Purchase Order because of the error message: "Purchase order approval not possible".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Search for the relevant purchase order.-Select Edit.-Select Approve.-The error message is triggered: "Purchase order approval not possible".-Cause-There some possible causes for this error message:-[1] The user is the creator of the Purchase Order;-[2] The user is the Buyer Responsible of the Purchase Order or the Requester (in Items tab). -In case [1] the user is unable to approve the purchase order because the question "Do you want to allow self-approval for purchase order approvals?" is not scoped in the Business Configuration of your system. That's why the self-approval is not possible.-The following steps show whether this setting is scoped: -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project. -Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Questions tab by clicking Next.-Expand Purchasing.-Select Purchase Orders.-Find and select the Question "Do you want to allow self-approval for purchase order approvals?".-Click Next and Finish.-In case [2], the fields "Buyer Responsible" and "Requester" are taken into considerations during the approval compliance checks of the document.-[3] The buyer responsible and approver for the purchase order is the same person.-Therefore, the user has created a change project and scoped the Self-Approval of Purchase Orders. Once the user selects this feature, the buyer responsible or the creator of a Purchase Order can approve the same Purchase Order. However Activate Solution Capabilities is not confirmed; as a result, the Self-Approval functionality is not activated in the system yet.-Resolution-For both scenarios ([1] and [2]), the resolution is the same.-The user can scope the question "Do you want to allow self-approval for purchase order approvals?".-Or if the setting cannot be changed, then the approval task has to be forward to another user. The approval task can manually be assigned to a relevant employee by following below steps:-Go to center Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Find the task and mark it.-Select Actions - Assign Item and enter the name of another user to set them as approver.-That user will find the approval task under the "Managing my Area work center - Approvals view".-For scenario [3], please follow the steps below: -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Change Project.-Select Open Activity List.-Navigate to All tab.-Open Activate Solution Capabilities.-Select Confirm.-Once the user confirms, the system activates the adaptations within your project and now Self-Approval functionality has been activated successfully.-Keywords-Purchase order, approval, self-approval, error

Title: Supplier Invoice Item Type Import VAT Debit or Credit Item
Content: Symptom-You can use the item type as Import VAT Item under regular supplier invoice and also Custom Duty invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order view under Common Tasks.-Enter the details.-Navigate to Items tab-Under Basic Data tab, select the Type as Import VAT Debit or Credit Item.-Resolution-You can create the Custom Duty invoice with the same Item Type - Import VAT Debit Item.-Note: If you use the item type as Import VAT Debit/Credit Item in regular supplier invoice, it will be treated as a Custom Duty Invoice.-See Also-  2057097 - Tax Amount Is The Same As Net Amount In Supplier Invoice -Keywords-Import VAT Debit/Credit Item, Custom duty invoice, Supplier invoice, Invoice Item Type, Import vat debit item, import vat item, wrong gross amount, wrong total gross amount

Title: Unable to Preview the Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have ordered purchase order however the Preview button is disabled and you cannot see the pdf document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-You can see that, Preview button is grayed out and output history not created-Cause-User has selected Prevent Output check box under general tab and hence the preview button is disabled. If user selects this check box, supplier is not notified automatically when the purchase order is ordered, changed or canceled. Further Output History will not be created. This is an expected behavior.-Resolution-You can cancel the relevant purchase order & create a new order by deselecting Prevent Output check box. This will solve the problem-Keywords-Preview button disabled in PO, Output History not created

Title: Errors in Approval Task Details Data Source
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-You are previewing the data source Approval Task Details or using a report based on it. You receive the following errors in the data source or report:-'Either the user does not have the relevant authorizations to execute the report or there are no approval task instances to display'-'No report data available to display; check the selection'-'Error reading the data of datasource'-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Data Sources.-Search for Approval Task Details.-Click Preview.-You face the above errors.-Cause-The data source Approval Task Details must always be used as a joined data source along with application created data source. Application created data source should act as an anchor data source. Approval Task Details data source should never be consumed independently since it does not show any data on its own. Also, if the business documents are not enabled for Multi-Step Approval process, then the report will never work.-For example:-Purchase order and supplier invoice are registered for Multi-Step Approval and the corresponding data source for the same is listed below, which should be set as an anchor data source.-Approval of Purchase orders – Data source available for Purchase order header data.-Approval of non-PO invoices – Data source available for Supplier invoice header data.-Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics work center, Design Data Sources view- Create a joined data source-Add Purchase Order Header Data source as anchor and select the necessary fields required for constructing the report as shown below-    Once the anchor data source is added, add the Approval Task Details data source and choose the necessary fields which must be displayed in the report as shown below-  Remove the UUID attribute of the Approval Task Details data source-Create a join between the Purchase Order ID (UUID) and the UUID from the Approval Task Details data source:-On the created data source, create a report which will fetch all approval tasks for the purchase order(s).-Go to Business Analytics work center, Design Reports view.-After you have created the new report face (e.g. Purchase Order Approval Task), select all the required key, characteristics and complete the report creation guided activity-Execute the report to fetch the approval tasks for the purchase orders, where you can find all the necessary details.-See Also-Background of this data source:-When conditions in the approval process step(s) are met, task(s) are created for the employee(s) responsible, which the employee responsible can then approve/reject. You would like to analyze the time it takes at each step to approve a document and explore the possibility to reduce the time taken. Scenarios could include:-Who are the approvers who take more time to approve the document?-Who needs a follow-up?-What percentage of approvals get rejected?-How many approvals get corrected before getting approved?-This can be achieved by using the Approval Task Details data source.-Keywords-Approval Task, data source, report, Either the user does not have the relevant authorizations to execute the report or there are no approval task instances to display, no report data, error reading the data of data source, BTMAPPV01-user does not have the relevant authorization,  approval task instances to display, error reading the data of data source, btmappv01

Title: Exception :Missing Receipt or Return Document
Content: Symptom-Intercompany Supplier Invoices may have this exception though there is a Goods and Service Receipt or an Inbound delivery existing.-"The goods receipt/return has not been posted yet"-"The receipt document is missing or invalid"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supplier Invoice work center.-2. Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-3. Search for Respective Supplier Invoice.-4. Go to Exceptions tab.-The Exception message will be displayed-5. Go to Items tab.-6. Navigate to cost distribution Tab.-The system will display two entries: one with a reference item but no quantity, and the other with no reference item but having a quantity.-Cause-In any Intercompany scenario (where Purchase order has created a sales order automatically),  we expect that delivery received from sales order has to be the reference for the inbound delivery created. Thus we expect " Delivery notification ID" field in inbound delivery same as outbound delivery ID that was created for the Sales order.-When creating Inbound deliveries or GSR manually, accuracy is essential to prevent the expected appearance of this exception. This guideline applies to any scenario involving Intercompany transactions. For example:-Sales Order -> Purchase Order ->Sales Order.-Purchase Order ->Sales Order ->Purchase Order.-Sales Order -> Purchase Order ->Sales Order ->Purchase Order.-Purchase Order->Sales Order->Purchase Order->Sales Order.-Resolution-For the existing effected Supplier invoices:-Go to items tab.-Go to cost and distribution tab.-Ensure that quantity exists against the Inbound delivery ID under reference Item column.-or-Click on Add open items button.-Click on check button.-Ensure that quantity exists against the Inbound delivery ID under reference Item column.-Remove any empty rows that lack quantity or a reference item as they are considered missing.-To avoid this issue in future while creating Inbound delivery or GSR manually:->>While creating manual Inbound delivery or Third party inbound delivery for the PO, ensure to enter value in "Delivery notification ID" field same as outbound delivery ID that was created for the Sales Order.-Keywords-Intercompany invoices, exception, Cost distribution, Quantity zero, Inbound delivery

Title: Error: Shipment Date Too Far in The Future While Saving a Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Post Goods Issue for a Delivery Proposal but this is not possible because the system shows an error - Shipment date too far in the future.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Outbound Logistics.-View Delivery Control - Subview Delivery Proposals.-Show All Proposals By Selections and Find XXX (XXX represents the Delivery Proposal's ID).-Select the first line and click Post Goods Issue.-Maintain a date in the future as a Shipment Date.-Click Save and Close button (without clicking Release).-Result: an error - Shipment date too far in future will appear-Cause-This is an expected system behaviour, as the system is not allowing a date which is more than one month in the future (or more than 6 months in the past) to be specified as a Shipment Date.-Please note that one month in the future does not always mean 30 days.--We will try to explain this behaviour by the following example:--Let us assume that you would like to Post Goods Issue on 01.02.  The following month March has 31 days which means that you will be able to specify a Shipment Date up to 31.03.-Resolution-You must specify a Shipment Date only within the timeframe from 6 months in the past up to 1 month in the future, in order to be able to Save the changes for the Shipment Date while creating a Post Goods Issue.-Keywords-shipment, date, too, far, future, post, goods, issue, error,
