Title: Employee Not Visible in Direct Approver List of the Request for Quotation/Purchasing contract Approval Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:All details combined into one KBA 2344117 - Employee Not Visible in Direct Approver List ,cause they have same cause and solution except the document is different.-You are creating request for quotation/Purchasing contract approval process but the employee ABC (ABC refers to the employee name) is not visible while selecting in the list of direct approvers work distribution. Even the access rights of Sourcing and Contracting and Manage My Area work center has already been assigned to ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Approval Process view.-Select the approval process for request for quotation .-Once the screen opens, press Copy button.-Select the Work Distribution as Direct Approvers and press Edit button.-Employee ABC is not visible.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Open Business Users subview under User and Access Management view.-Search for employee ABC and select Edit:Access Rights option.-Navigate to Access Restrictions Tab.-You find the access rights of both Sourcing and Contracting and Manage My Area work centers has already been assigned to ABC.-Cause-You had not assigned the access right of MMA_STRATEGICPURCHASING (Strategic Purchasing) view to the employee ABC.-Resolution-You can assign the access right of MMA_STRATEGICPURCHASING view to the employee ABC with following steps.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Open Business Users subview under User and Access Management view.-Search for employee ABC and select Edit:Access Rights option.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-Expand MMA_MANAGINGMYAREA (Manage My Area) work center, find MMA_STRATEGICPURCHASING (Strategic Purchasing) view, assign it to ABC.-Save.-After assigning the required access right, employee ABC will be visible in the direct approvers of the request for quotation approval process.-Keywords-Direct Approver, RFQ, Request for Quotation, user not found,purchasing contract

Title: Approver Notes Missing in the Supplier Invoice Document After You Select Send Back for Revision
Content: Symptom-As an approver, you have received a supplier invoice approval task and due to some reasons, you have select Send Back for Revision with approver notes. However, the notes entered by you is missing in the supplier invoice document-Environment-1711-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice approval task-Select Actions and select Add Notes button-Enter the notes under Internal Comments section-Select Save and Close-Select Send Back for Revision-Cause-The approver comments will not be visible in the Notes tab of Supplier Invoice, if you add through Add Notes button-Resolution-The approver comments will be visible in the Notes tab of supplier invoice document only if you enter the comments from the below steps;--Go to the Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice Approval task-Select Edit and add notes in the right bottom-After you select Send Back for Revision, system captures this comments under Notes tab with Note Type - Approval Note-This is a standard behavior-Keywords-Approver notes missing in Supplier invoice, Approver notes missing after send back for revision

Title: Product Planning Details Screen is Showing Canceled Line Item of a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Canceled Line Item in Sales Order XYZ is still showing in the Product Planning Details screen thus creating a demand under the Supply and Demand list.-(XYZ represents Sales Order ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to Customer Demand view.-Search the Sales Order ID XYZ.  -Select the canceled Sales Order Line Item AB.-Under General tab, the Cancelation Status is 'Cancelation Requested'.-Choose Open Product Planning Details.-In the Product Planning Details screen, the canceled Sales Order Line Item AB is still visible as Demand under the Supply and Demand list.-(XYZ represents the Sales Order ID, AB represents Line item of Sales Order XYZ)-Cause-The Sales Order Line Item AB was canceled, after the corresponding Customer Demand had been released for Execution from the Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Once Customer Demand is released and Warehouse Request is created, system cannot cancel the Customer Demand and the Execution process automatically.-It needs to be canceled manually.-As the Execution is still in process, the Product Planning Details is showing the canceled Sales Order Line Item.-(AB represents Line item of Sales Order)-Resolution-Follow the below mentioned steps to cancel the Execution process,-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search with the Sales Order ID XYZ.-The corresponding Warehouse Task is In Process status.-Select the task and choose Confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen, go to Line Items tab.-The entries are enabled only for the canceled line item, because other line items have already been confirmed.-Select the line item and enter zero in the Actual Quantity field.-Select Deviation reason from the Deviation Reason drop down.-Choose Save.-The status of the task changed from In Process to Finished.-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select By Warehouse Order sub view under Monitoring view.-Select All Warehouse Orders from the drop down.-Search with the Sales Order ID XYZ.-The corresponding Warehouse Order is in Started status with Deviation column showing red indicator.-Select the Warehouse Order and choose Edit button.-In the Warehouse Order screen, select the Operations tab.-Select the Line Item, with Deviation Status in red.-Choose Accept Deviation.-The Warehouse Order status changed to Finished.-Now, the corresponding Customer Demand does not show in the product planning details screen. Also, Customer Demand in the Outbound Logistics Control work center, shows Cancelation Status as Canceled.-(XYZ represents Sales Order ID)-Keywords-Sales Order; Completed; Customer Demand; Supply and Demand List; Cancellation; Warehouse Order; Warehouse Request; In process; Monitoring; Deviation; Product Planning; Cancelation Requested; Execution; Outbound Logistics Control; Deviation Reason; Outbound Logistics

Title: How to Ensure That Cancelled Sales Order Line Items are not Visible in the Product Planning Details Screen
Content: Symptom-You have canceled a Sales Order Line Item. However, it is still visible in the Product Planning Details screen. You may want to know how to ensure that Canceled Sales Order Line Items are not visible in Product Planning Details screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If the corresponding Warehouse Request has already been created for the Customer Demand corresponding to the Sales Order Line Item, then cancelling Sales Order Line Item will not automatically cancel the Warehouse Request. Hence such Line Item will be visible in the Product Planning Details screen.-Please note that when you cancel any such Line Ltem in the Sales Order screen, for which corresponding Customer Demand has already been released to Execution, system will give you a warning message saying Cancelation requires additional attention in order to stop the Delivery.-Also, if you check the corresponding Customer Demand in the Outbound Logistics Control work center, it will show the Cancelation Status as Cancelation Requested. To check this, please follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Select view the Customer Demand.-Select All Orders By Selection from Show drop down.-Enter Sales Order ID XXX (XXX represents the ID of the Sales Order) in the Find field and choose Go button.-Select the Sales Order Line Item, which you have canceled at Sales Order level.-Scroll down and select the General tab. Here, you can see that the Cancelation Status is showing Cancelation Requested-Resolution-To remove such Line Item, you need to cancel the Warehouse Request. For doing so:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Warehouse Requests view.-Search for the corresponding Warehouse Request and then choose Reject Warehouse Request button. After that the Line Item will not be visible in the Product Planning Details screen.-However, if Warehouse Request has not been created yet, then only cancelling the Line Item from Sales Order is sufficient.-Note: The above solution is only valid if the corresponding Warehouse Task has not been started. This document does not explain the case where Task has already been started. For this case, please refer to the Knowledge Base Article 2575686 - Product Planning Details Screen is Showing Canceled Line Item of a Sales Order.-See Also-2575686 - Product Planning Details Screen is Showing Canceled Line Item of a Sales Order.-Keywords-Sales Order, Reason for Rejection, Cancellation, Customer Demand, Product Planning Screen.

Title: Third Party Logistics Requests are not Sent to Your External Warehouse Provider
Content: Symptom-User have created a 3PL Request against a Sales Order. However, you see that the system has not sent the 3PL Request to your External Warehouse provider even though all the Communication Arrangements are set up correctly. You also do not see any errors in the Business Communication Monitor screen as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Navigate to the 3PL Outbound: Delivery Proposals view.-Search for the relevant Delivery Request, select it and choose the Create 3PL Request button.-In the Third-Party Logistics Requests view you can see that the above 3PL Request is not sent to your warehouse provider, as the Communication Status of the request is Grey.-Cause-In the master data settings of your 3PL warehouse provider you have not maintained the Communication Channel for the Third Party Logistics Outbound Request as XML. Once you maintain this value as XML, the system will start sending your 3PL requests to the supplier via the Communication Arrangements you have set up.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Navigate to the Suppliers view.-Search for your 3PL Warehouse Provider select it and choose the option Addresses from the Edit button.-In the edit screen navigate to the sub-tab Collaboration, under the tab Communication.-Maintain the Output Channel value as XML against the Third Party Logistics Outbound Request business document name.-Once the above setting is maintained, the system will start sending the newly created 3PL requests to your external warehouse provider.-Keywords-3rd party, logistics, requests, not sent, external, warehouse, provider,No messages, 3PL request, ODER

Title: Multiple Errors Appears when Third Party Delivery Notification is Released
Content: Symptom-Error appears when Third Party Delivery Notification is released though the Document is Consistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Go to Third-Party Delivery Notifications View.-Search for Delivery Notification DEF (DEF refers to Delivery Notification number).-Select Release.-Error appears as below:-Planned delivery date lies in the past.-Error while creating or updating follow-up document.-Delivery Notification DEF includes items from different sales orders. Please check if the warranty assigned automatically is correct.-All items must have same buyer.-Cause-The Inbound Delivery Notification has two different buyers involved (Accounts A and B). Although the ship to information is same for both accounts, but they resemble two different customers (buyers in this case).-Resolution-This Inbound Delivery Notification should be cancelled and a separate Notification created for each separate Account. This is standard behaviour as designed, the error message is therefore valid.-Keywords-Third Party Delivery Notification, All items must have same buyer,Error while creating or updating follow-up document, All items must have same buyer,Delivery Notification  includes items from different sales orders

Title: How to Mass Update Production Bills of Materials
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to update the values for a Production Bill of Materials and how the system can check the consistency of the Production Bill of Materials & Production Model and release the model for Planning and Execution automatically so that the overhead of navigating between the different views is reduced for the user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can use Production Bill of Material Mass Maintenance Run option available under Common Tasks or Automated Actions view in order to update the values in the Production Bill of Materials and to check the consistency of the Production Bill of Materials & Production Model and to release the model automatically in the system. The steps to be followed are as follows:-Go to the Planning & Production Master Data work center.-Under Automated actions ,select MDRO Production Bills Of Material Mass Maintenance View-Create a new MDRO by selecting  New button -In the opened window fill in the required fields - Run ID, and select the BoM Mass Maintenance Options as per your need. As per the selection there might be certain fields which are necessary to be filled.-Mark the check boxes for the Check Production Model and Release Production Model fields, this will make the system to automatically check the consistency of the model and will release it for Planning and Execution.-Select the Next button, check the indicator corresponding to the Bill of Materials variant for which you like to update the changes for the Production Bill of Materials.-Select the Next button and finish the activity.-Later you can schedule the run as per your needs.-Keywords-Production Bill of Materials, Production Model,  Release, Mass update of BoM, Update Quantity, Update Input product , Replace Input product

Title: Supplier Invoice is not Posted and is in Status Delayed Verification in Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 3108835***-After posting the Supplier invoice it went in to status Delayed Verification in Process- or-You have created a Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order and when you post it, the status goes to:"Delayed Check in Progress".- or- Error:Document  will be posted in background processing after delayed check. Time-intensive checks and possible assignments of deliveries to background processing are postponed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select New Invoice without Purchase Order-Create a new invoice and Select post-Cause-You have  activated scoping question:Do you want to use delayed verification as supplier invoice entry capability?- or-System would pop-up a screen when you select greater than or equal to 100 deliveries ( deliveries could be within a Single PO or different Purchase Orders for the same Supplier), where you clicked on New Invoice with Delayed Verification option.-Resolution-Please descope this activity in Business Configuration settings  by following below steps-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project and choose Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the scoping activity Questions and expand the element Purchasing.-Select and expand the scoping element Supplier Invoicing to select Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos business option.-Select the question Do you want to use delayed verification as supplier invoice entry capability?.-Choose the Next button and in the Review and Complete page choose the button Finish to confirm scoping changes.-Note: If this question is scoped ,all  the invoice documents you create will be with the status "Delayed Verification in Process" even if it has less than hundred deliveries(within a Single PO or in different Purchase Orders for the same Supplier) .In this case the system assigns the delivery items to the invoice items in the background after we post the Invoice and thus time to create an Invoice is reduced.-See Also-2096678 - Selected Records are Too High. Please Select Less than 1000-Keywords-Delayed Verification, supplier invoice

Title: Duplicate Outbound Deliveries Created via 3PL Integration.
Content: Symptom-You are using Third-Party Logistics (3PL) integration.The system is allowing to create duplicate Outbound Deliveries for the same 3PL Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select the 3PL Outbound: Third-Party Logistics Requests view.-Search for the released 3PL Request XXX (XXX represents the 3PL Request ID).-Now go to the Deliveries tab in the Details section. Here you can see two Outbound Deliveries. When you open these Outbound Deliveries, you found that both the Outbound Deliveries are created for the same Sales Order Line Item and with same Quantity.-Cause-Your 3PL Warehouse Provider has sent two outbound deliveries for the same 3PL Requests and for each Outbound Deliveries different External Delivery ID are used.-In the SAP Business ByDesign, system prevents duplicate deliveries if same External Delivery ID is sent for a 3PL Request. However, in this case different External Delivery IDs are sent for the same 3PL request, that is why it created two Outbound Deliveries.-Please note that in general in SAP Business ByDesign, Over Delivery is allowed.-Resolution-System is working as designed. You need to check with your 3PL Warehouse Provider why different External Delivery IDs were sent against the same 3PL request.-If you want to cancel the duplicate outbound delivery, then follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select the 3PL Outbound: Third-Party Logistics Requests view.-Search the 3PL Request using the Sales Order ID XYZ. (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID)-Now select the Deliveries tab. It will show both the Outbound Deliveries.-Open the duplicate Delivery ID XYZ.-Select View All button.-Click the Actions button, and then select Undo Release.-Thereafter click the Actions button, and select Cancel button.-Select Save and Close button. This will cancel the Outbound Delivery.-If you check the Processing Status of the 3PL request, it will show Started and further if you select tab Line Items, here you can see that it is showing Planned Quantity double than the Requested Quantity in the Sales Order. To correct it and to change the status of the 3PL Request to Finished you need to reject the 3PL Request. Please note that this will not reject the entire 3PL Request. It will only reject the extra quantity. To do so:-From the 3PL Outbound: Third-Party Logistics Requests view, choose Reject 3PL Request button. Now the status of the 3PL Request will change to Finished status and if you again check the Planned Quantity, it will now show correct quantity.-Now select the 3PL Outbound: Delivery Proposals view. Again, search the Proposal using the Sales Order ID XYZ.-Go to the Schedule Lines tab and Reject it. This will reject the extra Quantity. After this the Quantities will be corrected in the Customer Demand as well.-Keywords-3PL Request Duplicate, Outbound Deliveries, Duplicate Quantities, Manual 3PL Release, Automated 3PL Release, Sales Order.

Title: How to add Overall Freight charges to the Purchase Order?
Content: Symptom-You are unable to add overall Freight charges in Purchase Order-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Create New Purchase Order-It is not possible to add overall Freight charges-Cause-Freight charges can be added at item level only and not at header level.-You can only add overall discount in Purchase Orders at header level from 1711 Bydesign release.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.

Title: How to Create Outbound Delivery for Partially Confirmed Line Items in a Pick Task
Content: Symptom-You have a pick task with multiple line items. You only want to confirm a few of the line items, and you want to create Outbound Delivery for the confirmed line items. You want to know how to do so.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Task Control view.-Search for the pick task ID you want to confirm, select it and choose the confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen enter the same actual quantity as the open quantity for the items that have stock and enter 0 (zero) for the line items that do not have stock.-Click the Save button.-You can see that there is no Outbound Delivery created for the items that have been confirmed with the same actual quantity as the open quantity.-Cause-You need to choose the Late Delivery Split button (which is available in the task confirmation screen) to create Outbound Delivery for the confirmed line items in the task.-Resolution-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant task you want to confirm and select it.-Choose the Confirm button.-In the task confirmation screen enter the same actual quantity as the open quantity for the items that have stock and 0 (zero) for the line items that do not have stock.-Choose the Late Delivery Split button and finally, select the Save button.-An Outbound Delivery is created for all the confirmed line items with the reported quantity.-Keywords-Pick Task, Late Delivery Split, Outbound Delivery, Partially confirmed, to Create Outbound Delivery for Partially Confirmed Line Items in a Pick Task-pick task, late delivery split,,outbound delivery, partially confirmed

Title: System Triggers an Error When Trying to Cancel an Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-The following error appears when trying to cancel Outbound Delivery.-"You cannot cancel the outbound delivery as it contains confirmed quantities."-"You first have to reverse the related confirmations or create adjustment confirmations to cancel the delivery" when trying to cancel Outbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Select the Outbound Delivery KLM (KLM refers to Outbound Delivery ID).-Navigate to Actions and Select Cancel.-An error appears as mentioned below:-You cannot cancel the outbound delivery as it contains confirmed quantities.-You first have to reverse the related confirmations or create adjustment confirmations to cancel the delivery-Cause-The error is displayed because you are trying to cancel the Outbound Delivery before an adjustment confirmation is being made for the corresponding Warehouse Request.-Resolution-First you need to un-release the Outbound Delivery. For that go to  the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the relevant Outbound Delivery, which you want to cancel.-Select the Outbound Delivery and from the Action button drop down, choose Undo Release.-Now select the Monitoring view and the sub-view By Warehouse Order.-Select All Warehouse Orders from the Show drop down and click on the Advanced filter.-Enter the outbound delivery ID in the Delivery ID field and press the Go button.-In the Warehouse Order screen, select the Adjustment Confirmation button.-In the Adjustment Confirmation for the Warehouse Order, select the respective line item and click the Enable Entry button.-In the Quantity Difference field, enter a negative value of the fulfilled quantity. For example, if the fulfilled quantity is 20, then enter -20 in the Quantity Difference field.-Click the Save button.-Now you will be able to cancel the Outbound Delivery. For that purpouse, select the Outbound Delivery view once again.-Search for the relevant Outbound Delivery.-Select the Outbound Delivery and from the Action button drop down, choose Cancel.-Keywords-You cannot cancel the outbound delivery as it contains confirmed quantities, You first have to reverse the related confirmations or create adjustment confirmations to cancel the delivery

Title: Cannot Find Web Service for Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You would like to trigger the Available Stock information for a particular product from ByDesign system by integrating it to an external system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Go to the Input and Output Management view and the Service Explorer sub-view.-3. Show All Synchronous Inbound Operations, and find a Service to consume Stock Overview.-4. You cannot find an appropriate Web Service for your Integration Project.-Cause-This is an expected behavior of SAP ByDesign system as there is no ready-made web service to access the Stock Overview data for an integration project.-Resolution-As a workaround please use the following web service:--Service Name: ProductAvailabilityDeterminationIn-Service Description: Determine Availability of Products-Please keep in mind that this is not a direct view for Stock Overview, but it shows if the Stock would be available for delivery on a particular date. This is based on Available To Promise (ATP) check.-Keywords-Web Service, Stock Overview, Available Stock, API

Title: Wrong Identified Stock Proposed in Warehouse Task
Content: Symptom-You are posting a Goods Issue against a Sales Order, and you notice that the system is proposing the Identified Stock ID AAA (AAA represents the Identified Stock ID) in the Warehouse Task ID YYY (YYY represents the Warehouse Task ID), but you expect the Quantity to be fulfilled from the Identified Stock ﻿BBB (BBB represents another, different than AAA Identified Stock ID) which has an older Expiry Date, and the remaining Quantity from the Identified Stock AAA.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Find and select the Warehouse Task ID YYY.-Go to the Execution Details tab under the Details section.-You can see the Identified Stock ID AAA is picked.-Cause-Although you have maintained the Material Flow Rule at the Location level with Picking Strategy FIFO (First In First Out), you have not maintained it at the Site level, and as you can see from the Schedule Lines sub tab of the corresponding Sales Order, the Product Quantity is sourced from the Site, hence the Material Flow Rules are searched starting from the Site and not in the location, and since there’s no Strategy maintained, the default strategy Minimum Movement is taken into consideration.-Resolution-Please maintain the same Material Flow Rule at the Site Level. For the already existing Tasks, you need to cancel the allocation for all the Items in the Task by clicking on the button Cancel Allocation and then select all the Items and click on the button `Propose Quantities and Logistics Areas`.-For the new Tasks, once you maintain the FIFO strategy at site level, it will work fine.-Keywords-Identified Stock, Warehouse Task, Material Flow Rule, Picking Strategy FIFO, First In First Out

Title: Project Task Unavailable in Employee's Timesheet
Content: Symptom-You create the Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID), in which you assign an Organizational Unit in the Team and Staffing tab.-An employee ABC (ABC represents the Employee ID) who is part of this Organizational Unit wants to record time against the Project XYZ. When they search for Project tasks belonging to the Project XYZ in the time sheet, only the header is displayed in the Value Selection.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Sheet view.-Search for ABC.-Click Open Time Sheet.-Select the date.-Click Add Row.-Enter the General Data.-Go to Labor Information tab.-Click on the Value Selection for the field Project Task.-Only the Project header is displayed for Project XYZ, not the Project tasks.-Cause-The system shows the list of project tasks in value selection of the Project Task field according to the following criteria:- The employee is defined as team member;-In the Project Management work center and the Projects view, select the project, choose the Edit button. In Maintain Project, select the Team and Staffing tab. In the Team subtab there are employees defined in Team Members.-The employees are assigned to the team's Organizational Units;-In Maintain Project, select the Team and Staffing tab and Team subtab. You can see Organizational Units under Team Members. The project header task will appear in the value help of Task for all employees in org units (you can see org unit's employee list in the Organizational Management work center).-The tasks of work package which the employee belongs to;-In Maintain Project, select the Project Plan tab and Gantt Chart subtab, select the below Work tab. Here you can define a row with team member and service, one row corresponds to a work package.-The tasks manually assigned in Adjust Worklist;-In Edit Time Sheet, you can select the Adjust Worklist button to add tasks where you are not team member or for which you do not belong to the work package.-Resolution-As a workaround, if the Employee knows the Project Task ID, they can enter it manually in time sheet and press Enter.-Keywords-Time recording, Time entry, Time sheet, Project header, Project Task, Project task ID, Project task missing in time sheet, Org unit, Organizational unit-time recording,time entry,time sheet, project header,project task,project task id,project task missing in time sheet,org unit,organizational unit

Title: Inbound Delivery With Zero Quantity
Content: Symptom-You are able to save Inbound Delivery document with zero quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the relevant delivery notification document and select it.-Choose the Post Goods Receipt button.-In Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt screen under the field Actual Quantity enter the value Zero and save the document.-The system will allow you to save the Inbound delivery document without errors.-Cause-In scenarios where there are multiple items requested from the supplier and there are a few items which are not delivered by the supplier you need to be able to save your inbound delivery document with zero quantities for the not delivered items. If this option is not available you will not be able to receive the items which are sent by the supplier.-You can choose to create another Inbound document at a later time when the supplier decides to deliver the items to you.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Inbound delivery no quantity, Inbound Delivery zero quantity no error.

Title: Access Restriction Does Not Work for Bill of Materials
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Access Restriction for Bill of Material. However, when you check in Planning and Production Master Data work center, the functionality does not work for User ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Users view.-Search for the User ABC.-Select the User ABC.-Click Edit.-Choose Access Rights.-Select Access Restrictions tab.-Here you have maintained restrictions for Bill of Operation, Bill of Material or Production Model. However, the restriction does not work for Bill of Materials.-Logged in with User ABC:-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select Bill of Material view.-Notice that the user ABC has access to the restricted data-ABC is dummy data used to represent User ID -Cause-Access restrictions in SCM area works and are applied on a Site level. Bill of Material does not have site information and is generic to company level, hence no restrictions can be implemented on it.-Resolution-Access Restriction currently is not available for Bill of Material as it exists independent of site.-Keywords- Bill of Material Access Restrictions Error, Access restrictions does not work for Bill of Material, BoM Access Restrictions Error, Access restrictions does not work for BoM

Title: Official Invoice ID is empty in Data Source: Supplier Invoice Item Details
Content: Symptom-You are using the data source Supplier Invoice Item Details (SRMIV_B03) and have added the field Official Invoice ID to Rows.-The field displays # and you are expecting it to display the Supplier Invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Data Source view.-Show All data sources and find SRMIV_B03.-Select the data source Supplier Invoice Item Details.-Move the field Official Invoice ID from Not Currently Shown to Rows;-You can see # is displayed instead of data in the field Official Invoice ID.-Cause-The field Official Invoice ID isn't returning any data because it is specific to Mexican invoices.-Resolution-So only for Supplier Invoices created for company in mexican country ,system will pull the data from the data maintained by the user in the system in that specific field.-Keywords-invoice ID is not appearing, Invoice ID is  not found, invoice Id is #

Title: Customer Account Name of Opportunity Incorrect in Opportunity Pipeline Report
Content: Symptom-The account name used in opportunity XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Opportunity) is different to the account name displayed in the Opportunity Pipeline report.- Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue- Got to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities View.-Show: All Opportunities and Select Opportunity XYZ.-Account name is shown as ABC (ABC represents the name of the account).-Then:-Got to the New Business work center.-Go to the Reports- List View.-Show: All and in the Search field enter Opportunity Pipeline.-Open and run the Opportunity Pipeline report. -Under Not currently shown, add Opportunity and Account to the rows.-Search for Opportunity XYZ.-The account name shown for the Opportunity XYZ is DEF.- Cause-At the time when opportunity XYZ was created, the name of the used account was ABC. After the creation of the opportunity, the account name was updated to DEF in the account master data .-The difference occurs as the opportunity pipeline report derives account names from the current master data whereas the actual opportunity, and the underlying business object, is based on the transactional data used at the time of the opportunity creation.-Resolution-This is correct, expected system behaviour.-The Opportunity Pipeline report will always display account names according to the existing master data rather than deriving them from the transactional data used at point of opportunity creation.-Keywords-opportunity, pipe line. report, creation,

Title: System is not Working as per FIFO rule,Wrong Identified Stock Selected in Goods Issue Screen
Content: Symptom-When posting goods issue against the delivery proposal XYZ, the system is proposing identified stock ID AA however expected one is ﻿BB.-*XYZ refers to the Delivery Proposal Id, *AA & *BB refer to the Identified Stock Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Choose the Delivery Proposals View.-Select the Delivery Proposal XYZ and click the Post Goods Issue button.-Cause-As per FIFO rule system sorts the oldest stock according to the identified stock expiration date, identified stock production date and last putaway date. The exact order in which the sorting happens once the system retrieves all available inventories for the relevant product is as follows.-The stock is sorted based on putaway date first, this helps with getting FIFO information for all the stocks which does not have iStock. -Stock with iStock is sorted additionally based on Expiration Date and/or Production Date.  -Resolution-Note: If all the identified stocks have the same dates for all the above parameters, then one of them is picked in random order.-This is the standard system behavior and system behaves as designed.-See Also-KBA:  3075450 - Wrong Identified Stock Proposed by The System When Posting Goods Issue-Keywords-System is not Working as per FIFO rule, Wrong Identified Stock Selected in Goods Issue Screen, Identified stock expiration Date,  Identified stock production date

Title: Tax Amount is zero in Monitoring Invoices Report
Content: Symptom-You see that Tax Amount in the Monitoring Invoices report is 0 for few invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Monitoring Invoices report :-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Lists under Reports view-Open the Monitoring Invoices report-Enter the  Invoice ID-The Tax Amount is 0.-Also-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for the  Invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to custom duty invoice ID)-Navigate to items tab-Select item and go to basic data sub tab-Item type is Import VAT Debit Item or Customs Duty Debit Item-Cause-For the  Item types Import VAT Debit Item or Customs Duty Debit Item, Currently the tax amount present in the report is calculated with following formula at the backend is :-Gross Amount - Net Amount = Tax Amount.-Since the Gross Amount and Net Amount in this invoice items is same, the tax amount in the report is being calculated as 0.-To see the tax amount in the invoice, kindly follow the below steps :-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for the Custom Duty Invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to custom duty invoice ID)-Navigate to General tab-Here the tax amount is not 0.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below details to get the tax amount onto the report as present in the Custom Duty Invoice.-Create a Custom data source on the Supplier Invoice Item including the Tax Amount attribute (Tax Amount field is PSM Released). Join the standard data source (Monitoring Invoices) with the newly created custom data source. Once this is done, the tax amount will be updated for the custom duty invoices like other invoices.-Keywords-tax amount in report, custom duty tax report, custom duty amount in report, tax amount in report, Invoice Report does not show tax amount

Title: Tax Exemption from Supplier Master Data not Applied in Purchase order or Supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-In Supplier Master Data, a Tax Exemption for Country X is maintained.-However, when creating a Purchase Order or Supplier Invoice, for the Supplier with Tax Country X, Tax is still applied and the Tax Exemption isn't taken into account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Find Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Taxes tab of Item details-A Taxable tax code is selected by the system, despite a Tax Exemption being maintained in the Supplier Master Data, Financial Data - Tax Data.-Cause-Cause 1-The purchase is not a pure domestic trade. The Tax Exemptions set up in the Supplier Master Data are only applicable for domestic transactions in most of the countries. Except a few countries like Canada.-Cause 2-For Tax country United Kingdom, 'State' should not be maintained in Supplier master data, Financial Data - Tax Data for Tax Exemptions.-Cause 3-For Tax country India, system cannot pick exemption related tax code automatically. Manual entry is always required. -For Tax country China, Tax Exemption Reason 'Small Scale Trader' currently cannot be recognized by the system. Development team is working on a permanent resolution but until it manual change on the tax code is required.-Resolution-Cause 1-If the purchase involves a foreign country (ship to address or Supplier address), the Tax exemptions need to be maintained-either in the Product Master Data.-or in the Purchase Order by changing the Tax code manually.-or-For example countries like Canada, an alternative is the functionality of External Tax Determination.-More details about the configuration of the External Tax Determination can be found below:-External Tax Determination for Goods and Services - Configuration Guide-Cause 2-Remove the State information from the Supplier master data, Financial Data - Tax Data for Tax Exemptions.-Cause 3-The Tax exemptions need to be maintained-either in the Product Master Data.-or in the Purchase Order by changing the Tax code manually.-See Also-1785785 - Tax Rate Type Defaults to Zero in Purchase Order Although Taxes are Expected for the Transaction -2774426 - Exemption related Tax code is not determined in Purchase order or Supplier invoice -Keywords-Exemption reason, exempt, Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice, Zero Tax Rate

Title: Error: Operation Not Possible; Inventory Item Locked By Another User, Inventory Update For Inventory Notification Failed
Content: Symptom-When we are trying to check the status of the failed Inventory Notifications in Business Communication Monitoring following error message is shown.-Operation not possible; inventory item locked by another user XYZ (XYZ represents the user ID).-Inventory update for inventory notification failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third party Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Business Communication Monitoring View.-We observed following error messages as mentioned below-Operation not possible; inventory item locked by another user XYZ.-Inventory update for inventory notification failed.-Cause-The inventory lock issue crops up because multiple messages are trying to acquire lock at a certain time, and that’s because these messages are triggered with very little time interval between them.-Resolution-You need to ensure that there is proper time interval between the Release of the documents/message so that inventory lock is taken care of.-If the message in BCM has the status Long Running, you can choose to Restart the message to trigger system processing the message again. -Keywords- Operation not possible; inventory item locked by another user, Inventory update for inventory notification failed, Operation not possible; inventory item locked by another user

Title: Unable to Create Inbound Delivery Against Manually Finished Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have Manually Finished the delivery of line items in a purchase order and hence when you try to perform post goods receipt, Open Purchase Order Quantity becomes zero and hence unable to create Inbound Delivery against it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Workcenter.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders and find the required Order ID.-Select and Edit it.-Go to View All and navigate to Items tab.-Select the required Line item and  Goto Basic Data tab and there  under Settings section-You can see Delivery Completed status as Manually Finished-Now when you go to Inbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders and find the required Order ID.-Select the Purchase Order ID and choose Post Goods Receipt.-Here you find that system is not displaying any line item against the purchase order to create inbound delivery.-Cause-If you Manually Finish the delivery of a purchase order, the stock for the products in the purchase order will not get updated in the system.The stock gets updated only if you receive the goods through inbound delivery.-Resolution-To receive the required quantity for all line items against purchase order, please follow below given steps :-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to Purchase Orders view.-Search the relevant purchase order, select it and choose the Edit button.-Navigate to View All ->under Items tab.-Select all line items one by one and choose option: Resume -> Delivery-Perform Send Update.-You will now be able to perform Post Goods Receipt against these line items and Inbound Delivery will be created.-Keywords-Unable to do inbound delivery, unable to do goods receipts,Delivery Completed status as Manually Finished

Title: Buyer Responsible Not Populating From Sales Order Automatically
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:  Its incomplete and  full solution is there in KBA  2338159 - How to Default Purchasing Unit and Buyer Responsible in Purchase Request or purchase order-You have created an Intercompany Sales Order and the Purchase Request/Purchase Order that was automatically created afterwards, does not have the Buyer Responsible field populated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to the Purchase Orders View.-Open the affected Document and see that the Buyer Responsible Field was not populated automatically.-Cause-This information is not coming from the Sales Order automatically because the activity Involved Parties for Purchase Requests and Orders is not in scope. In order for the Purchase Request to gather information such as Buyer Responsible and Purchasing Unit automatically from any source, you need to maintain this activity in scope.-Resolution-In order to maintain this in scope, you need to follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects and edit the Project Scope.-Go to the Questions tab.-Expand Purchasing > Purchase Request and Order Management > Purchase Requests.-You see the question as follows: 'Do you want to define defaulting of Purchasing Unit and Buyer Responsible for Purchase Request and Orders?'--Once this question is In Scope, the defaults start working as desired.-See Also-For further information, you can check the Help Document Defaulting of Purchasing Unit and Buyer Responsible for Purchase Requests and Orders. It explains in detail this functionality.-Keywords-buyer responsible, not automatically populated, sales order, purchase request, purchase order

Title: Withholding Tax Is Not Automatically Detected For Few Non-Localized Countries
Content: Symptom-You have created Custom withholding taxes via add-on for Non-Localized countries but system is not picking the Withholding tax automatically when supplier invoice is created for few non-localized countries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for relevant invoice.-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab.-Select Taxes tab.-Notice that the withholding tax field is empty.-Cause-The country code which is maintained in the Decision tree for that particular country is incorrect.-Due to this content mismatch, the system is not able to determine the withholding tax for that country even though it works for other countries.-Resolution-Please descope and activate the PDI solution again with correct content-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Custom Withholding tax

Title: Customer Demand cannot be Released Although Stock is Available
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release the Customer Demand ABC (ABC represents the Order ID), but you cannot release it although stock is available. The system displays the warning message: It is not possible to release the schedule line dated dd/mm/yyyy (dd/mm/yyyy represents a calendar date), for order item ID ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-Search for the Order ABC.-Select Go.-Select Release With Stock Check.-The warning message appears: It is not possible to release the schedule line dated dd/mm/yyyy, for order item ID ABC The stock is not available.-Cause-There is a stock of N quantities available but already there are other Orders that you have released to execution with more than N Quantities. Hence, we do not have stock for further release of items from Customer Demand. We can see available stock as N Quantities but this quantity is assigned to Orders already which are released and hence allocated, its just they are not yet delivered.-Resolution-To process Sales Order ABC, you will have to cancel the Allocation/Confirmation against other Sales Orders which are not so urgent by following the steps below.-Reject the Outbound Delivery Request.-And if you want, you can cancel these not so urgent Sales Orders by maintaining reason for rejection.-Keywords-It is not possible to release the schedule line dated, for order item ID the stock is not available, Customer Demand cannot be Released Although Stock is Available

Title: Error Message : "Net weight missing" in Intrastat Declaration
Content: Symptom-You have successfully created an Intrastat declaration via the Intrastat Declaration Run, however several items do not have any Net Weight data and when checking the Item you get the following error: Net weight missing.-As per Case Document 2245186 - Net Weight Appears as Zero in the Intrastat Declaration, you have previously maintained the Weight data in the Product Master Data, before creating the delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat Work Center.-Go to Intrastat Declarations view.-Show All Intrastat Declarations.-Find XYZ (XYZ represents the Intrastat Declaration ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Select an inconsistent line and click Check.-You get the error Net weight missing.-Cause-In the Intrastat Declaration, the system always displays the Net Weight in the UoM (Unit of Measure) Kg.-If there are UoM Characteristics maintained in the Product Master Data from UoM X (X represents a UoM different from Kg) to Kg, only for those items' Net Weights will be calculated. The system doesn't automatically calculate the conversion if these are not maintained in the Product Master Data - UoM Characteristics tab and referring to the UoM Kg.-Resolution-You need to maintain all the units used with a conversion to Kg in the Product Master Data before the deliveries are created.-See Also-2245186 - Net Weight Appears as Zero in the Intrastat Declaration-Keywords-Intrastat Declaration; Net Weight; Zero

Title: How to Resolve the Error Message Cannot Confirm Third Party PO ABC Item X as Source Document for this GSA
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Goods and Service Receipt for a Third-Party Purchase Order. In the New Goods and Service Receipt screen, no Items are displayed and the following Warning appears: Cannot confirm third party PO ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID of the relevant Purchase Order) item X as source document for this GSA.- Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Goods and Service Receipts work center.-2. Choose the Purchase Orders to Be Delivered / Show by Documents view.-3. Show Outstanding Purchase Orders.-4. Find Purchase Order ABC.-5. Click New Goods and Service Receipt.-In the New Goods and Service Receipt screen, no Items are displayed and the following Warning appears: Cannot confirm third party PO ABC item X as source document for this GSA.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour. Since the Third-Party Purchase Order is for a Material, no Goods and Service Receipt is required. In this case the system expects an Inbound Delivery.-Resolution-You need to create an Inbound Delivery for the Third-Party Purchase Order.-1. Go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center.-2. Select the Third-Party Purchase Orders view.-3. Search for the Purchase Order ABC and choose the button New Third-Party Delivery Notification.-4. In the New Third-Party Delivery Notification screen fill in the required fields.-5. Click Save and then Release.

Title: Unable to Post Supplier Invoice Cancellation Document due to exception:Cancel not possible; cancel related additional cost invoice first
Content: Symptom-Unable to Post Supplier Invoice Cancellation Document because of the exception-Exception:Cancel not possible; cancel related additional cost invoice first-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and credit memos view-Choose Show field as All document-Search and select the relevant document-Click edit-Navigate to exception tab-Where you will see the  above  exception-Cause-There is other invoice that is additional cost invoice done against this Supplier invoice which needs to be canceled before posting the cancellation invoice.-Resolution-Steps to view additional cost invoices created for a Supplier invoice-Go to General ledger work center-Go to closing cockpit view-Select the Source document view-Show All Source documents-In filter you may give the original invoice ID-Filter with Source document type as Supplier invoice-If you see too many documents then filter  it a bit further as mentioned below-In advanced filter you may give company ID, creation date same as creation date of original invoice etc-Additional cost invoices if exists for the supplier invoice will appear  along with other normal invoices if exists-Check each invoice to see if they are related to your invoice(your invoice and the additional cost debit item invoice should have reference to same Purchase order)-You can also check the invoices created with respect to the Purchase order/supplier invoice in the following path:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select advanced filter-Enter the reference type as order and enter reference id (i.e. purchase order id) or reference type as invoice and enter invoice id-Here you can see all the invoices and credit memos(original and cancellation) created for that Purchase Order or assigned to that invoice you are trying to cancel.-Please cancel all such additional cost Invoices which are still open-Also if original invoice is already paid then first you have to reverse the payment so that invoice is  in posted status. later you cancel  the invoice.-Note:-Unfortunately we cannot have the additional cost item invoice to be visible in the Document flow of the  respective Purchase order because this Invoice does not have an impact on the Purchase order details.-However we think that the addition cost Item which is actually related to Original invoice should be made visible in the Document flow of the Original invoice.-Which also is not there currently, hence, we request you to add the same to the ideas forum  at-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-so that  based on the votes it shall be developed in the future releases-Keywords-What are the additional cost item invoices ,Cancel not possible; cancel related additional cost invoice first,Unable to Post Supplier Invoice Cancellation Document

Title: Dump When Selecting a Shift Program in Resource
Content: Symptom-When you select the Shift Program ABC for the Resource XXX, the system crashes. (ABC represents the Shift Program ID; XXX represents the Resource ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Master Data work centre.-Select the Resources view.-Search for the Resource XXX.-Open the Resource XXX.-Select View All.-Choose the Operating Times tab.-Choose the Standard Operating Times sub-tab.-Select Shift Program under Operating Time Type.-Select the Value Selection for Shift Program.-Choose the Shift Program ABC.-Select Ok.-System crashes.-Cause-There is no value maintained for the Recurrence Pattern. The Recurrence Pattern is a mandatory field to Save the Shift Program, however you are able to Save it with no value on the field below Recurrence Pattern and this makes the data incomplete.-Resolution-Go to the Supply Chain Master Data work centre.-Select the Shift Programs view. -Search for the Shift Program ABC.-Open the Shift Program ABC.-Select View All.-Select the Recurrence sub-tab.-Maintain a value for any of those fields:-Every days(s) if you selected the Recurrence Pattern as Daily.-Recur Every Week(s) on if you selected the Recurrence Pattern as Weekly (on this option you need to check the week days too).-Monthly Recurrence if you selected the Recurrence Pattern as Monthly and all the required fields from this one.-Yearly Recurrence if you selected the Recurrence Pattern as Yearly and all the required fields from this one.

Title: Manual Entries Postings Are Allowed Though Period Is Blocked
Content: Symptom-The Manual entries postings are allowed as there is a message On DD.MM.YYYY postings are allowed for process group All and date DD.MM.YYYY  though 04 - Time or Service Confirmation for period/year PPP/YYYY (PPP is the period and YYYY is the year) is blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger workcenter-Navigate to the Companies view-Select Company ABC (ABC is the Company ID) and click on the set process controls tab-Under the General Tab, select 01-Manual entries-Click on the actions tab and simulate process control, there is a message On DD.MM.YYY postings are allowed for process group All and date DD.MM.YYYY  though 04 - Time or Service Confirmation for period/year PPP/YYYY is blocked.-Cause-You will notice that the set process controls for 0-All entries which is not blocked and so it will override the 1 - Manual entries set process controls. Hence the system will allow entries for the date DD.MM.YYYY which are blocked with 04 - Time or Service Confirmation for period/year PPP/YYYY .-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger workcenter-Navigate to the Companies view-SelectCompany ABC and click on the set process controls tab-Under the General Tab, select 0-All entries and change the Process control status to Blocked-Click on the Save button.-After this the users will not be able to simulate the 1 - Manual entries set process controls -Keywords-04 - Time or Service Confirmation, Process Control

Title: Outbound Delivery Invoice Request Is Inconsistent Due To Serial Number Issue
Content: Symptom-While checking the consistency for Outbound Delivery Invoice Request DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request), System triggers an error message.-'Serial number PQR does not exist. According to the serial number profile, an existing serial number is required. You can create a new registered product manually.'-(PQR represents the serial number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Requests View.-Find the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request DEF.-Select Check.-The following error message appears:-'Serial number PQR does not exist. According to the serial number profile, an existing serial number is required. You can create a new registered product manually.'-Cause-As the link between serial number PQR and the corresponding registered product is missing, this is causing the error and an inconsistency in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request DEF.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, kindly follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Third Party Logistics work center.-Go to the 3PL Outbound view and to the Outbound Deliveries subview.-Search for the relevant Outbound Delivery.-Select Edit.-Click the Actions button and select Undo Release.-Navigate to the Line Items tab and select the respective Line Item with the serial number PQR.-Select Serial Numbers sub-tab.-Remove the serial number PQR and then re-enter the same serial number. -Click the Save button.-Finally release the outbound delivery again.-The outbound delivery invoice request is consistent now.-Keywords-invoice request not consistent, invoice request error , Serial number does not exist. According to the serial number profile, an existing serial number is required. You can create a new registered product manually.

Title: Time Recordings are Going for Approval Even Tough No Approval Required Flag is set in the Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: Combined with Duplicate KBA:2537424 - Unexpected Approval Task for Time Recording on Project-Employee records  times on project task and releases them. You find that these times are always sent to the project manager for going for approval, even though the status of Time Recording in project is set as No Approval Required.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to check status of Time Recording in project.-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Select the Edit button.-Select the Project Plan tab.-Select the relavent Project Task.-Select the Basic Data sub tab.-Note that the status of Time Recording in project is set as No Approval Required.-Steps to check status of the Time Recording in the employee time sheet.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Select the relevant Employee.-Navigate to Employee Times.-You can see that, time entries are still waiting for Approval.-Cause-The services under work tab of the child project task are not marked as billable however in the header task under Accounting tab you have marked the Billable field. also since Project manager must be notified when such non billable time recordings are done thus it goes for approval-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-Keywords-No approval required, Non billable going for approval, time  recording going for approval

Title: Invoice request creation failed; open invoice request already exists.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2482459***-Scheduled project invoice request is not created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Every night a regular job runs automatically. The job automatically creates project invoice requests on the next day. When the invoice date is reached, an invoice run processes the invoices based on the invoice requests.-Resolution-To create another scheduled project invoice request first releases or cancel the open project invoice request then create new project invoice request.-If you wish to create the project invoice request for the past date or for the date which the job is failed we have an option you can create the forced invoice schedule.- Follow the below steps to create a forced schedule invoice request for the past date-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Choose Projects view.-Choose Project XYZ.-Choose icon next to the project and choose the Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request Not Created For a Sales Order

Title: Supplier Invoice not Created From the Collaboration Window
Content: Symptom-Scanned Invoice is not created when uploaded through Collaboration Window as system throws the error message:-Error message:System.Runtime.Remoting.ServerException-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to Collaboration window from your desktop icon.-Go to the Menu and choose Settings.-Then Select Invoice Scanning, select button Browse and choose the relevant folder from your system desktop (that has one or more pairs of text and PDF files with same name for each pair).-Click OK.-Go to View log and you can see the mentioned error highlighted in red.-Cause-When system does not find the Company name details (or found insufficient details) in the text file then system would search for company of the user who created the Scanned Invoice.-If system does not find the company of the user also then system throws this error.-Note: This could be one of the reasons for this error.-Resolution-Ensure either:-Company name is appearing correctly in the text file as maintained in ByDesign system-or-Company is assigned to User who is uploading the Scanned invoice.-Keywords-Scanned invoice error

Title: Tax Code is not Determined or Wrong Tax Code is Determined
Content: Symptom-Tax code is empty in the Purchase order/ supplier invoice which should have been determined automatically or it is determined wrongly.-Or you may receive error: Determination of tax code failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for relevant Purchase Order.-Navigate to Items Tab.-Further go to Sub-Tab Taxes.-Where you will see that Tax code is empty though Automatic Determination checkbox is checked.- or-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos views.-Select the respective Invoice.-Navigate to Items Tab.-Further go to Sub-Tab Taxes.-Where you will see that Tax code is empty though Automatic Determination checkbox is checked.-Cause-No Tax code exists for combination of Tax Event ABC and Tax Rate Type XYZ for Country Code YY hence the Tax Code is not determined.-Resolution-Follow the below steps that are necessary for Tax code determination:-A.Steps to see the Tax Rate type maintained for each product in respective item:-Go to Products Portfolio work center.-Go to Products view.-Search for the Product appearing in the item.-Navigate to Tax tab.-Where you can see that for Country code YY you have maintained the Tax Rate type XYZ.-B.Steps to see the Tax event determined:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase order and select Edit.-Navigate to Actions button and choose Activate Tax Trace then select Save button.-Go to Items tab.-Select Taxes Sub-Tab.-Select the link Display appearing against the Tax Trace Details.-Here you can see that the Result: ABC appearing at the end which is the Tax event (for example: Domestic Purchase).-Please check all the questions appearing above the Result in the decision tree, to understand why the respective tax event was determined based on the Purchase document details. Pay special attention to the delivery address, which should not be blank, and includes both the 'ship from' and 'ship to' details. Additionally, consider the Supplier master data and the Product master data in your review.-C.Steps to maintain the Tax Codes:-Go  to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select Activity list.-Navigate to Fine tune.-Show All Activities and search for Tax on Goods and Services.-Choose Define Tax codes.-You can see that no Tax Code exists for Tax Event ABC and Tax Rate Type  XYZ for Country Code YY, hence the Tax Code is not determined.-So we request you to create new Tax code for the above mentioned combination.-See Also-2891848 - Wrong tax country In Purchase order or supplier invoice-Keywords-Determination of tax code, tax code empty, tax code failed-wrong tax code

Title: Incorrect Source Logistics Area selection For Automated Replenishment Runs
Content: Symptom-System proposes incorrect source logistics area for an automated replenishment run under Internal Logistics-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to check for Automated Replenishment runs--Go To Internal Logistics Work Center-Go To Automated Actions View-Select Active Mass Replenishment Runs-Check for the Run ID X-To check for successful/unsuccessful job execution, Refer the latest Applciation Log ID-Steps to check for Replenishment Task --Go To Internal Logistics Work Center-Go To Task Control View-Show All Warehouse Tasks by Selection-Find Replenishment Task ID -> Confirm-Source Logistics Area ID Field is either Empty or Incorrect Logistics Area-Cause-In the Material Flow Rules, under the Source Determination Rules, multiple sequence IDs are maintained for the the same logistics area usage.-You may check the Source Determination Rules with the following steps --Go To Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center-Go To Locations View-Show Active Sites -> Find Site ABC -> Edit-Navigate to 'Material Flow'-Under Advanced Rules, Select Source Determination Rules-Here, user has maintained multiple sequence IDs with the same logistics area usage and without a stock seperator.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior. Material Flow Rules works only on one Sequence ID. In case multiple Sequence ID exist for the same logistics area usage, then Sequence Determination should be maintained. In the Sequence Determination, user should specify parameters like Logistics Unit, Product ID, Storage Group ID, Restricted Stock, Owner ID. Material Flow in this case will search for the Sequence Determination which matches the parameters. So the first Sequence which matches the parameter will be picked up. Hence the most specific sequence should be maintained at the top and most generic sequence at the bottom. If the sequence determination is not maintained, then the first sequence will be picked up by default.-Keywords-Incorrect Source Logistics Area selection For Automated Replenishment Runs,  automated replenishment run

Title: Price Variance Exception is Raised in the Supplier Invoice  When Approving or Posting
Content: Symptom-Price Variance Exception occurs when you try to approve/post the supplier invoice ABC (ABC refers to supplier invoice ID).-Exception message: The average net price xxx for 1 ea is greater than the price xxx of purchase order XYZ. Rounding differences are possible.﻿(XYZ refers to purchase order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for the invoice ABC. (ABC refers to supplier invoice ID)-Select View All.-Select Check button.-The price variance exception is raised in the Exceptions ﻿tab.-Cause-The Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ refers to purchase order ID) ﻿has more than one open supplier invoice (In Process/ In Approval). Consider the below mentioned scenario which triggers the exception message multiple times.-Suppose there is a Purchase Order created for P quantities and the price of each quantity is X.-The total net amount of the purchase order will be P*X = PX.--Imagine we create 3 invoices(A, B, C) for the above mentioned P quantity purchase order. (A, B and C refers to supplier invoice IDs)-Invoice A-> D quantities at X each -> D*X = DX-Invoice B-> E quantities at X each -> E*X = EX-Invoice C-> F quantities at R each -> F*R = FR-D + E + F = P quantities of the purchase order--Now the total net value of all the 3 supplier invoices (DX + EX + FR) together will be greater than PX as mentioned in the Purchase Order.--If we created the supplier invoices individually(eg. Invoice A) and then post with no other invoice (B and C) is open (In process/ in approval), the posting will be successful.-The posting of the invoices will be successful without any exception till the total net value of the supplier invoices ( DX + EX + FR)  does not exceed the total value in the purchase order (PX).--If we now create Invoice B and C parallely and then send it for approval, the invoice which is sent for approval first (say B) will not have exception before sending. The invoice which is sent for approval later (say C) will have a Price Variance Exception triggered. Now, when the first invoice (say B) which was sent for approval has completed the approval process will not be posted because there is another price variance exception raised. The price variance exception will keep arising until the total net value of the purchase order is equal to the total net value of the supplier invoice.--Price variance exception will be the average value calculated considering the total net value in the purchase order and the extra amount in the supplier invoices. As a result the price variance exception will be a low value.--When we create the invoices individually and post them, they will be posted successfully after accepting the exception once. The system will not trigger the exception in multiple documents at the same time since there is no open documents.-Resolution-This is the standard expected system behavior. You can either create the invoices individually and post them or ensure that the total net value in purchase order and supplier invoice are equal.-Note: This issue occurs only when there are multiple open supplier invoices for a single purchase order and the total net value of all supplier invoices are either greater or lesser than the net value of purchase order.-Keywords-Unable to accept the Price variance exception, price variance, supplier invoice exception, supplier invoice, supplier invoice error

Title: Error Appears While Posting Supplier Invoice With Reference to Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post supplier invoice with down payment request reference and system shows the below error message while posting.-Error - Item tax type differs from tax type of down payment request item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Select Edit and navigate to Exceptions tab.-Cause-The Tax country and Tax Code differs in Down Payment Request and Supplier Invoice document. Thus the tax elements differ & leads to the error message.-Resolution-You must ensure that the Tax country and Tax Code are same in Down Payment Request and Supplier Invoice. If differs, correct the tax country and tax code to fix the error message.-Keywords-Item tax type differs from tax type of down payment request item, supplier invoice tax, down payment request, tax type

Title: Bank Processing Date Is Updated with Plus One Day Automatically
Content: Symptom-You see that the system adds one business day automatically for the Bank Processing Date in the payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Select a payment with status In Transfer or Ready for Transfer.-You see that the Bank Processing Date is updated with plus one business day automatically from the payment creation date.-Cause-If Bank Processing Date is blank when the payment is created, system will calculate the date as plus one business day from the date of file creation and if the date is provided, then it will not re-calculate the bank processing date.-Also, the Bank Processing Date cannot be in the past and it should be greater than the current date, else system will re-calculate plus one business day.-Resolution-This is the desired system behavior.-Keywords-Bank Processing Date; creation date

Title: How to use Activate Tax Trace
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to use the Activate Tax Trace functionality in SAP Business ByDesign.-Or-You are looking at Tax Trace Details in the Purchase Order or supplier invoice or other documents, however system shows the error message upon selecting Display button.-Error - Application log information for this run is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The below steps apply to all sales documents, we are using a sales order as an example:-Go to the work center view Sales Orders.-Search for the relevant sales order.-Click Edit and View All.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Click Update Pricing and select Activate Tax Trace.-Click Save.-Now you have activated the tax trace for this sales order.-Navigate to the Items tab and select the Taxes subtab.-Click Display at Tax Trace Details.-The Application Log opens. -Navigate to the Results tab.-The below steps apply to all purchase documents (like supplier invoice), we are using a Purchase order as an example:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Navigate to Items tab and sub tab Taxes-Go to the Actions button and Select Activate Tax Trace-Select Save or Send Update-Navigate to Items tab and move to sub tab Taxes-Click Display link under Tax Trace Details-The log of tax trace will then be visible-If the Tax Trace Details-option does not appear after saving, close the document and open it again.-See Also-2597096 - You Cannot Activate The Tax Trace From a Customer Invoice-Keywords-Activate Tax, Tax Trace, Application log information for this run is not available, Tax Trace Details, Activate Tax Trace

Title: Difference Between Last Used And Last Put-Away Strategy
Content: Symptom-You want to know the difference between Last Used And Last Put-Away strategy to better design your logistics processes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The main difference between the two is that the Last Used strategy is not a stand alone strategy. It is a part of the Material Driven strategy. Last Put-Away is an independent strategy.-In Material Driven strategy, the system will first try to identify a logistics area by using the Fixed Bin strategy, if it does not find any logistics area via this strategy the system will then try the Last Used strategy if it is not able to identify any logistics area via this strategy then it will use the Empty Bin strategy to identify the logistics area.-Last Used Strategy searches the current stock in the inventory and finds out if there is any stock which has stock with the same stock separators (Identified Stock, Product Specification etc) in the inventory. There is no particular order in which the logistics areas which are used for the product is fetched.-The Last Put-Away strategy always identifies the latest logistics area in which the stock was placed by the system.-Last Put-Away reads the confirmation data of the last five putaway confirmations to find out the last/latest Logistics Area in which put way was done for the relevant product.-Keywords-last put-away, last used, strategy,

Title: System Triggers Error Message While you are Posting Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create Inbound Delivery from a Purchase Order, but when you click the button Post Goods Receipt you receive the following Error messages:-Determination of Destination Inventory failed for Product DEF (DEF represents the Product ID).-Inventory in Logistics Area not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Find and select the Purchase Order KLM (KLM represents the Purchase Order ID).-Select Post Goods Receipt.-Cause-Logistics Model associated with Standard Receiving at Site PQR (PQR represents the Site ID) has Inspection: Autonomic Inspection.-Logistics Use of many Logistics Areas is only Storage.-Resolution-You can either remove the Inspection from the Logistics Model or you can maintain Logistics Usage of the Logistics Areas to be also Inspection.-If you decide to proceed with the second option, please make sure that there is an Inspection Plan created either for the respective Product or Product Category.-See Also-2644970 - System Triggers Material Flow Warning Messages While Performing Post Goods Receipt-Keywords-Inventory in Logistics Area not available, Determination of Destination Inventory failed for Product ABC, Logistics Model, Logistics Use, Logistics Usage

Title: Cannot Create Notification; Items Have Different Ship-to Locations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an Inbound Delivery Notification against your Purchase Order, and want to change the Ship-to Location of the Delivery Notification.
