However, when you to change the Ship-To Location, the system is displaying the following error: Cannot create notification; items have different ship-to locations.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the purchase order against which you want to create the delivery notification document and select it.-Choose the button New Supplier Delivery Notification.-In the 'New Supplier Delivery Notification' screen, remove the existing value in the field 'Ship-to Location' to any other Ship-to Location to which you want to receive the products.-Choose the Save button.-You receive the above mentioned error message.-Cause-The Ship-to Location which was updated in the purchase order will be visible in the Inbound delivery notification as well. You cannot have a different ship-to location in the delivery notification document than what you have maintained in the purchase order.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior. The system is working as expected.-See Also-2652167 - Error: Ship To Location Is Not Within The Receiving Site-Keywords-Ship-To Location, Site, change, Post Goods Issue,

Title: Error "Source of Supply for Purchase Proposal XYZ not valid"
Content: Symptom-The automatic Release Purchase Proposal Run fails due to following error messages:-Source of supply not valid; purchase proposal XYZ not requested.-Requesting purchase proposal number XYZ not possible.-Source of supply for purchase proposal XYZnot valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Supply Control Work Center.-Go To  Automated Actions View, and select Release Purchase Proposal Runs.-Select the filter Active Purchase Proposal Runs and open the Application Log NNN (NNN represents the Application Log ID).-Go to the Results tab.-You can see the above error messages (you may need to expand the result to see the error messages).-Cause-Automated action to Release Purchase Proposals does not process the Purchase Proposals for cases where the Source of Supply is not valid. The automated action works for the proposals which can be processed further without manual intervention. If Source of Supply is not valid, the Background Job fails.-Resolution-However, user can release the Purchase Proposal manually. System will allow if Source of Supply is not valid or even if there is no Source of Supply selected for the Purchase Proposal.-Keywords-Purchase Proposal Runs, Purchase Proposal, release, Requested, Source, supply

Title: Supplier Invoice not Displayed in the Monitoring Invoices Report
Content: Symptom-Supplier invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to the supplier invoice ID) is not displayed in the monitoring invoices report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Reports View.-Search for Monitoring Invoices report.-Search for the Supplier Invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to the supplier invoice ID) under Invoice ID option in Edit Selection tab.-No records found.-Cause-Monitoring invoices report is meant to display the data at item level. However the supplier invoice XYZ (XYZ refers to the supplier invoice ID) does not have any line items & hence no data displayed in the report.-Resolution--If you want to view the report in Monitoring Invoices for Supplier Invoice with no items, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Data Sources View.-Search for data source - Supplier Invoice Header Data. (SRMIV_B01)-Select New & Joined Data Source.-Name the Joined Data Source.-Join Type is Inner Join.-Select Add Data Source and add Supplier Invoice Header Data (01) with Characteristic ﻿Supplier Invoice ID (INVOICE_ID).-Select Add Data Source and add Supplier Invoice Item Details with Characteristic ﻿Invoice ID.-Select ﻿Save and Close.-Keywords-Supplier invoice not displayed, monitoring invoices, supplier invoice report

Title: Modified Supplier Name is not reflected in Purchase Order Preview
Content: Symptom-Supplier name is changed in master data, But it is not reflecting in Purchase Order preview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select the Purchase Orders view-Choose the relevant Purchase Order and select Edit-Select Preview-The displayed output shows the old supplier name-Cause-Modifications in supplier master were done after Purchase Order creation date.-Resolution-Kindly create new Purchase order without copying old purchase order, then all modifications would reflect as expected.-Keywords-Old name of Supplier,Purchase Order preview shows faulty Suppier name,wrong Supplier Name,Modified supplier name, changed Supplier name

Title: Period Status in the Employee Time Sheet Appears as Not Calculated
Content: Symptom-While checking the time sheet of an employee, you see that Period Status appears as Not Calculated. Alternatively, you might be experiencing error message "Offsetting account PQR not valid on DD.MM.YYYY" (where PQR represents an actual Time Account and DD.MM.YYYY represents an actual date in day-month-year format).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Go to Time Recording subview.-Search for the relevant employee.-Click Open Time Sheet.-In the Time Entry tab, select the Calendar Week using the backward and forward button or select Go To in order to display time sheet for the selected period.-You will see that Period Status appears as Not Calculated.-You might also see error message "Offsetting account PQR not valid on DD.MM.YYYY" for this employee in the Administer Day Closure Runs application log or after taking any time-related action with the mentioned employee.-Cause-The valuation is failing for the employee in the mentioned date and that is due to non-assignment of the mentioned time account for this employee on the date specified.-Resolution-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Search for the relevant employee and click Edit.-Go to Time Profile tab.-Ensure mentioned date DD.MM.YYYY is covered in one of the time profiles by checking the start and end dates; if not, add a new time profile row.-Select the time profile row which covers the specified date.-Go to Time Account Rules tab.-Add time account PQR.-Keywords-Period Status, Period Status Not Calculated, Offsetting account not valid,

Title: Error: Exchange Rate X/Y on date  DD.MM.YYYY Missing for Currency Conversion.
Content: Symptom-While creating a Purchase Order, the subjected error is triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to New Purchase Order in common tasks.-Enter all necessary details (where supplier's currency is XXX and company's currency is YYY).-Click on Check button. Error is raised.-(XXX and YYY stands for the currency acronym)-Cause-No exchange rate was maintained between currencies XXX and YYY for Rate Type Z.-(Z stands for the Exchange Rate Type)-If Ship-to address is different from company's address, then Ship-to country's currency is considered as currency YYY, as tax calculation is based on the Delivery address which in turn decides tax country. Thus this error is raised by the Tax Calculation.-Resolution-To maintain the exchange rate between currencies XXX and YYY for Rate Type Z follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects.-Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine Tuning.-Search forActivity Tax on Goods and Services.-Then select Currency Conversion Type.-Here the country of company A whose currency is YYY, exchange rate type has been maintained as Z.-(A stands for the Company ID)-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Edit Exchange Rates in common tasks.-It is noted that in for Rate Type Z there is no entry against the currencies XXX and YYY maintained.-It is necessary to either maintain the desired exchange rate between currencies XXX and YYY for rate type Z or change this setting and make the rate type as default instead of Z.-Note: The Purchase orders created after maintaining the exchange rate only will consider the changed/newly created exchange rates automatically. However for the already created purchase orders apply a dummy change in the purchase order like mentioned below:-Remove the quantity on one line item and then click on check button.-Then re-enter the same quantity and then click on check button again (no error occurs).-Click on order button.-See Also-2349917 - Exchange Rate Type Determination for SRM or CRM Documents -1961446 - Error Message : Exchange rate Country/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion -2174711 - Error message - Error During Currency Conversion from into for Default Exchange Rate Type at DD.MM.YYYY -2101312 - Error occurred while trying to evaluate condition of a process step -Keywords-Exchange Rate, Missing for Currency Conversion, Purchase Order.

Title: Cannot post Supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoice is not automatically posted because of the exception: "Party of role responsible employee missing".-or-Supplier Invoice is created via WebService with a Technical User ID. However they aren't posted automatically, instead, they have status "Ready for Posting".-In the Payload response, you get the following message: Invoice forwarded to accountant (XYZ (ABC)) for posting. (XYZ is the User ID and ABC is the User's name).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Search for OPQ (OPQ is the Invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Click in View All button. -Navigate to Exceptions tab. -There is the error Message: "Party of role responsible employee missing".- or-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show: All Invoices and Credit Memos.-Search for OPQ. -The invoice's status is 'Ready for Posting', when it was expected 'Posted' instead.-Cause-There are two possible causes for this scenario.-Cause A: Business user is not maintained in the Employee Work Distribution. Hence the user cannot post the Invoices.-Cause B: The Entry method of the invoice is 'External application', 'External ERS invoice' or 'B2B message'. It means that the Invoice was created by a technical user (non-business user).-Resolution-Resolution for Cause A:-Add the user in the Employee Work Distribution by following the steps below:-How to maintain a default employee responsible in the Employee Work Distribution rules for Supplier Invoices:-Go to Application and user Management work center. -Go to Task Distribution view. -Go to Employee Work Distribution subview. -Select the Work Category 'Employee responsible for Supplier Invoices'. -Populate an employee in this rule based on invoicing unit (where Invoicing unit is the Bill-To maintained in the invoice).-Once done, the future invoices will go to this user and then they will have to post it manually.-Resolution for Cause B:-Execute the webservice with a Business User. Then the invoices will be posted automatically.-For already existing invoices, they have to be manually posted. Those changes only apply for future created invoices.-See Also- KBA: 2831586 - ERS Invoice Not Posted Due to Error Message: "Party of role responsible employee missing"-Keywords-External application, External ERS invoice, B2B message, technical user, Supplier Invoice, Ready For Posting

Title: Error Message "Communication Arrangement Has Not Been Configured; Contact Your Key User" While Creating or Editing a New Corporate Account
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create/edit a corporate account or contact, but the system throws the error message "Communication arrangement has not been configured; contact your key user."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center-Access the Accounts view.-Click New > Corporate Account or select an existing account and click Edit. -Add or change the relevant information.-Click Save.-Error occurs-Cause-The system is scoped for usage of ERP Integration Scenarios with IDOC, but the necessary communication arrangements are not maintained.-Resolution-If integration is needed and shall be activated, please follow the SAP Help Portal guide available in the See Also section.-If integration has been activated in scoping accidentally, please remove it from scoping.-In case, the issue persists report an case to SAP-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Integration Scenarios at SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Communication Arrangement, ERP Integration Scenarios with IDOC, create account, edit account, account management

Title: Exchange Rate Type Determination for SRM or CRM Documents
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Exchange Rate Type, Currency Conversion Profile for Create/Change/Delete Sales Order and made the assignment to the Set of Books.-Nevertheless, the system still considers the default exchange rate.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open any SRM or CRM document (CRM documents like Sales Order, Customer Invoice or SRM documents like Purchase order or Supplier invoice).-Add an item with price in foreign currency.-You see that upon converting the amount to company currency, the system has used the default exchange rate rather than the custom one.-Cause-Although the fine-tune activity Exchange Rate Types allows the creation of custom types, the logic behind depends on the business process/business object to support this feature.-Currently, it is the designed system behavior that only Default Exchange Rate Type is used and applied in all SRM and CRM documents.-Resolution-The system works as planned, hence the Default Exchange Rate Type is used.-The exchange rate can be seen and maintained as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, click Edit Exchange Rates.-See Also-2370139 - Error: Exchange Rate X/Y on date DD.MM.YYYY Missing for Currency Conversion.-Keywords-custom exchange rate type; default exchange rate type; currency conversion profiles

Title: What is Mass Data Maintenance  and how it works?
Content: Symptom-Mass Data Maintenance is a tool to modify some of the values of existing data (Master data and Transaction data), and is done via text/csv files.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Processes Involved:-(A) Export Data-(B) Change Data-(C) Import Data-(A) Export Data:-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-In the Export Data to Local File area, click the link to export desired Migration Object from the solution and select Go.-The system returns Migration File selected as table.-By default all the columns are included in the export.-If you want to skip certain columns, select Skip Export.-If you want to select only key and technical details select Skip All for Export.- After selection is completed select Export Data to CSV File.-Selected data is now downloaded to local machine.-(B) Change Data:-Make the changes required in the csv file downloaded in above step.-(C) Importing Data:-Click the link for the Migration Object you want to upload in the solution in Upload Data from Local File area.-Select the CSV file and upload.-During the upload your data is validated.-In case of following scenarios:-Incorrect formatting-Missing Data-Unexpected Content-The Validate Data screen opens where the error is highlighted.-Follow step-by-step process to correct the content and select OK to come back to Update screen.-Select Execute Data Import-You may immediately start a background job or schedule a program to run later.-You will receive a notification of the successful data update.-Addition Notes:-Once the errors are detected in the import file, this can be corrected and can be again uploaded in the system. It is not required to create a new Import File.-If you are unable to access Import Log Link in Mass Data Maintenance, it is probably because you have opened it in HTML5.-Open the Mass Data Maintenance Tool in Silverlight and then try to access Import Log, it will allow you to open and download the same.-Once the csv file is uploaded in the tool, it cannot be archived or deleted.-This process is not used to nullify a field but only change an existing data for a record, refer to the Knowledge Base Article: 1898866.-Difference between Mass Data Maintenance and Data Migration:-Data Migration: It is like an initial load, but is not completely automatic. It is performed using CSV files (not web services).-In this case you need to insert a "fake id" for each row you are going to import, just to identify each row and the relationship between them, but during the import, the system will simply ignore it, generating a new ID.-Mass Data Maintenance: The Mass Data Maintenance is completely different than the initial load and data migration (even though the UI interface is exactly the same of the data migration).-It is a way to modify a large amount of data, and is done via CSV files.-In this case you need to insert an ID for each row you are going to modify, and this ID must exist in the system.-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, CSV files, Transaction data, Import Data, Export Data

Title: Quality Documents in a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to add Quality Documents for a product in a purchase order.- or-You have added Quality Documents for a line item with required product in a purchase order but nothing happens. It shows No Records Found under attachmenst tab.- or-You got information message Quality documents attached; view documents in Attachments tab however you don not find any documents under  any attachments tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Select New Purchase Order sub view and enter required details.-Choose View All and enter line item using Add Row option.-Select relevant line item and choose Quality Documents via Attach option.- You found no documents under header attachments tab-Cause-This is a pre-determined SCM attachments. These are configured in the Quality Planning View under Inspection Plans Work Center with required Product and Supplier.-Only if you have any documents with Document Type :Technical Delivery Terms or Quality Assurance Agreement maintained in created Inspection Plan, only those can be automatically attached to purchase orders or purchase contracts using Attach option for a Line Item.-Resolution-Go to the Quality Planning work center.-Select the New Inspection Plan link under Common tasks.-A window opens. Fill inspection type as Receiving inspection - supplier delivery and inspection scope as required.-Enter relevant Product and Supplier details.-Choose the Next button in the guided activity.-You could see the Attachments tab.-Now choose Add File and select Document Type as Quality Assurance Agreement or Technical Delivery Terms.-Select Finish.-Now when you choose Quality Documents via Attach option in a purchase order.-System displays message : Item 1: Quality documents attached; view documents in Attachments tab.-You can see those Quality Attachments at Item Level Attachments tab in a purchase order.-See Also-Inspection Plan, Technical Delivery Terms or Quality Assurance Agreement , Quality documents, purchase order, header attachments

Title: Missing Product Specification ID Field in the Purchase Order Migration Template or Excel Upload
Content: Symptom-You can see a standard field called Product Specification ID & Product Specification Description in the purchase order view. However you cannot find this field in the migration template or Excel Upload for the purchase order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view and select Open Activity List-Navigate to Prepare tab and select All Activities-Select the activity Prepare for Data Migration and Open-Select the link Download Migration Templates-Under Transaction Data, you can find the Purchase Orders-Select Download and Save the file to desktop-In the migration template, you cannot see the above fields Product Specification ID & Product Specification Description-or-1.Go to Purchase requests and order work center-2.Go to Purchase orders view-3.Click on new and choose import from Microsoft excel-4.In the excel, you cannot see the  fields Product Specification ID & Product Specification Description-Cause-In the current release of ByDesign Product Specification Id details are not supported in the migration templates or Excel Upload.-Resolution-This is a new requirement and will be available in a future release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Unable to enter product specification

Title: Error Message :Material Not Available For Consumption In Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 3232950 ***- You are trying to consume a material in a Project Stock Order, but the system is showing the error message: "Material not available for consumption in project".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Navigate to Project Stock Orders view.-Find and select the relevant Project Stock Order ID.-Choose Edit button.-Select the relevant Line Item.-Click in Consume button.-Enter the relevant Details.-Click in OK.-The system returns the error message: Material not available for consumption in project.-Cause-The possible reasons that the system is triggering the error message are:-Reason 1: You cannot consume the material in case the Project Stock Order does not contain a Ship-From Location for the item type Pickup / Pre-Delivery.-Reason 2: The material is not available for consumption in the project as there is no Open Delivered Quantity to consume.-Reason 3: The issue is in the Logistics Area of the material. Please search in the Stock Overview for the Material that you are trying to consume and open its respective Logistics Area. You can see that the Inventory-Managed field is set as "No".-Reason 4: The identified stock ID is enabled for the material. However the current material in project stock is different from the one delivered to the project. The steps to check this are listed below:-Go to Project Management work center.-Open the relevant Project and navigate to Product tab and then Project Stock Order subtab.-Find the relevant Project Stock Order and check the Document Flow tab. You can find the Goods and Activity Confirmation for the delivery.-Open the Confirmation and note down the identified stock ID "XYZ" (XYZ represents the material identified stock ID delivered to the Project).-Go to Stock Overview and check the material in the relevant Project Stock Order.-Quantity and Logistic area are the same, but the identified stock ID is not XYZ.-Reason 5: The Ship To party in the Oubound Delivery is different from the Project Stock Order. Because of this mismatch, the custodian tagging in the Inventory is different from that expected, which is triggering the error message.-Resolution-The possible solutions, based on its reasons, are listed below:-Solution for reason 1: The user can manually complete the project stock order which does not have Ship-From Location. Then create a new Project Stock Order with a Ship-From Location.-Solution for reason 2: Once the stock is delivered, the user will be able to consume it.-Solution for reason 3: Please maintain the checkbox 'Inventory-Managed' for this material by following the steps below:-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Stock Overview common task.-Search for the Material you are trying to consume.-Click in its Logistics Area.-Click in Edit button.-Select the Logistics Area.-Mark the checkbox "Inventory-Managed".-Solution for reason 4: To known how the internal deliveries took place, please check the report "Confirmation Journal" via Internal Logistics work center. There you can find the relevant Transfer Confirmations. Please move the quantities with identified stock ID XYZ back to the project stock, then the consumption can be performed with no error.-Solution for reason 5: Until the Oubound Delivery is not released, the user can change the Ship-to Party (this is a flexibility provided by the system). Please undo release the Oubound Delivery, correct the ship to party and then release the Oubound Delivery again. This should resolve the issue at consumption as well.-See Also-KBA: 3363225 - Error Message: Consumption quantity must not be greater than available quantity-Keywords-Consume, Consumption, Project Stock Order, Ship-To, Ship-From, Location, Material, Outbound Delivery

Title: Location Type Indicator Not Valid
Content: Symptom-You are trying to block a Transport Lane in your system, but the system displays the following error message: Location type indicator not valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Transport Lanes view.-Select the relevant Transport Lane.-Click the Change Status button and select the option Block.-System displays the above error message.-Cause-The transport lane you are trying to block has both Ship-To Site and Ship-From Site assigned to it. However, the site which is assigned as Ship-To Site in the transport lane is not marked with the role Ship-To Location in its master data.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to assign the Ship-To Location role to your Site:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select the Locations view.-Search for the relevant site, select it and choose the Edit button.-Tick the Ship-To Location checkbox and choose the Save button.-You will be able to successfully block your Transport Lane without any error messages once you have performed the above steps.-Keywords-Transport Lane, Ship-To Location, Ship-From Location, Activate, Site

Title: The Button View Data XML is Grayed Out in the Output History of Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order where the output channel is XML and sent the purchase order to the supplier. However when you go to output history tab, the button View Data XML is grayed out and you can see the output data. (B2B Purchase Orders)- or- How to view the XML output in PDF form or preview format-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select View All and navigate to Output History tab-The View Data XML button is grayed out-Cause-When the output channel is XML, the data is sent via a B2B message and the form message type is not filled. Meaning the XML message used for printing/E-Mail are not identical. They are based on the same purchase order data but each output channel uses a different subset of this data. You cannot print the data send via the B2B XML. The view data xml option will be available for other output channels where the form message type is filled.--Note: Technically you could remove the watermark from the purchase order form template, but this would remove it for all scenarios not just the B2B case. Then the preview (and re-submit) would not display any watermark.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign. You can use the Preview option to generate the created PO form (Test Copy) before ordering the Purchase order.-Since Purchase order is already ordered thus when you click on preview it will shows what is possible now for this PO that is changed PO and cancelled PO, if you haven't made any changes  to the PO then you can use the preview.-also if the send by in out put history tab is email or printer then you can see output PDF, but in your case its XML thus you cannot see PDF,so-Work around is to copy this PO and then click on preview to see the created PO PDF.-Keywords-preview not visible, output pdf

Title: Error  - Posting of GSA Not Possible; Posting on DD/MM/YYYY Blocked in Financial Accounting
Content: Symptom-You cannot cancel the Goods and Services Receipt due to an error message:-Posting of GSA not possible; posting on DD/MM/YYYY blocked in financial accounting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Choose Receipts and Returns view.-Select the relevant Goods and services Receipt and select Cancel Document.-Cause-Accounting period relevant for date DD/MM/YYYY has Period Status as Blocked and hence you are getting this error message.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you can follow either of the following option.-Open relevant period in financial and post the cancellation Goods and Services Receipt document by following the below steps.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Companies sub-view under Master Data view.-Select the relevant company ID and choose Open and Close Period.-Search for the accounting period relevant for date DD/MM/YYYY. Here you can see that the Period Status of this period is Blocked.-Now select the period and choose Open Periods.-Choose Save button.-If you do not want to open the accounting period, then you can use Set Process Control and choose to post to accounting to some other open period by following the below steps.-First you need to Set Process Control. To do so, following the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select sub-view Master Data under Companies view. Select the relevant company.-Choose Set Process control.-Choose Add Row.-Select Process Control Status as Not Blocked, Business Process Group as Goods and Services Confirmation.-Entry Possible Until should be the date by which you want to do the reverse confirmation. Like if you are planning to do it today, then enter today's date.-From Posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ or the date before XX/YY/ZZZZ and To posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ  or any day after XX/YY/ZZZZ.-Finally choose Save and Close button.-Now you will be able to cancel the corresponding goods and service receipt which will create a cancellation Goods and Services Receipt which is in Status In Process.  Note that it will not post into accounting yet, but it will create a business task in General Ledger work center, where you need to select a new Posting Date for which accounting period is open.--To do  so, please follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Closing Cockpit--> Closing-Relevant Tasks.-Choose Advance button. In the Related Source Document, enter cancellation Goods and Service Receipt ID and for Related Source Document Type select Goods and Services Receipt.-Choose Go button. You will get the relevant business task.-Choose Edit button.-In this screen, you will see an entry for the source document i.e. Reverse Confirmation ID, which should be in error status.-Choose View Business Transaction button.-Now choose Post to Another Period button. In the field Alternate Posting Date, enter a suitable date for which accounting period is currently open.-Then choose OK button. It will take you back to the task screen. Choose Refresh button.-Now the document Processing Status will change from In Process to Finished.-    With this, cancellation Goods and Service Receipt will be posted into accounting with the posting date selected by you.-Keywords-set process control ByD, post without opening periods, ByD Posting Error, Confirmation not possible; posting on XX/YY/ZZZZ blocked by accounting

Title: Item of Item Group SERV - Service - Fixed Price Cannot be Added in a Service Order
Content: Symptom-You cannot add an item of item group SERV - Service - Fixed Price in a service order. The following error occurs:-Item XX: Products w/ item group Service - fixed price not supported for location of srv provision On-Site (XX represents the number of the line item).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Click on the New button and select the Service Order option.-Enter the respective account data.-Navigate to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-Enter a service of item group SERV - Service - Fixed Price.-The following error occurs: Item XX: Products w/ item group Service - fixed price not supported for location of srv provision On-Site-Cause-The following option is not active in your scoping:-Do you sell or provide services for a fixed price, but track the actual time and materials needed for reporting purposes?-Please Note: If you would also like to activate the item group SERV - Service - fixed price in a Service Quotes, Sales Quotes and Service Quotes share the same Business Object and therefore the scoping settings are also shared.-Resolution-The scoping option needs to be active for the item group SERV - Service - fixed price (Services Sold with Fixed Price, with Time and Cost Tracking) to be used in a Service Order.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your current project and press the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to the Questions step.-Select the element Offered Services in your scoping using the following path:-Service -> Product and Service Portfolio for Service and Repair -> Offered Services-The following question needs to be activated:-Do you sell or provide services for a fixed price, but track the actual time and materials needed for reporting purposes?-Please note that in order to use the item group SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals the following question needs to be activated:-Do you sell or provide services for a fixed price without tracking the actual time and materials needed?-The scoping option needs to be active for the item group SERV - Service - fixed price (Services Sold with Fixed Price, with Time and Cost Tracking) to be used in a Service Quotes.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your current project and press the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to the Questions step.-Select the element Offered Services in your scoping using the following path:-Sales -> Product and Service Portfolio for Sales -> Sell Services-The following question needs to be activated:-Do you sell or provide services for a fixed price, but track the actual time and materials needed for reporting purposes?-Keywords-Service - Fixed Price; Service Order; Service Quote;

Title: Scanner Strategy in Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This document elaborates SAP strategy which is in place to provide you with a more holistic usage and flexibility for Scanners/Rugged Devices.-In order to provide you with a more holistic usage and flexibility for scanners/rugged devices, a Partner based strategy is strictly recommended by SAP. There are various out-of-the-box web-services already provided which could be used by your implementation partners to provide mobile or scanner interfaces as per your business needs. These web-services can be accessed by following the below mentioned steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to Input and Output Management view and choose the Service Explorer sub-view.-Below are the names of a few webservices which could be used for your enhancements:-Query Site Logistics Tasks:  To support query on task types such as Inbound - Unload, Put-away, Outbound - Pick, Load & Internal - Replenishment, Removal.-Manage Site Logistics Tasks:  To support  Inbound - Unload, Put-away, Outbound - Pick, Load & Internal - Replenishment, Removal confirmations.-Query Production Lots: To support query on production lot based on following parameters: Production Lot ID, Production Request ID, Production Order ID, Output Product ID, Site ID, Lifecycle Status.-Manage Production Lots: To support confirmation of production tasks such as Make and Supply.-Create Goods and Activity Confirmations for Goods Movements: To support ad-hoc Goods Movement within a site.-Create Goods and Activity Confirmations: To provide the ability to scrap the inventory items from the specified logistics area within a site via a webservice.-Manage Logistics Layout Execution: To support creation of new Replenishment and Removal tasks.-Please note that the scanner functionality in Business ByDesign currently offers a limited enablement scope (for the existing customers only), mentioned as follows:-Support for a very limited set of scanner devices which are mentioned below:-Microsoft® Windows® Mobile 6.1-Intermec® CK3 and CN3.-Motorola® MC9090, MC55 and MC70 Enterprise Digital Assistant.-Microsoft® Windows® Mobile 6.5-Motorola®MC9190G.-The existing capabilities for warehouse and production confirmation activities are very basic in nature.-Advanced capabilities providing greater scanning flexibility such as support for Product Count, support for alternative Logistics Area scanning etc. are not available by default.  -Since webservice enablement is readily available, further enhancements of functional and performance topics can only be performed with the help of your partners. SAP will continue to maintain the current available scope and resolve any bugs that are detected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords-Barcode, Scanner, Label, Brand, Web Services-scanner devices

Title: Purchase Order Withdrawal From Approval is Disabled or Greyed out
Content: Symptom-There is no option to withdraw from approval for the Purchase Order which made some changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Navigate to Purchase Orders View.-Search for the relevant Purchase Order.-Choose Edit button.-Choose View All button, then you found the Actions button is disable and you couldn't withdraw the approval.-Cause-Withdrawal from approval typically results in a document returning to the In-Preparation status. However, in this case, withdrawal from approval is disabled because the purchase order has already been sent to the supplier. Since you have made changes, an approval was triggered. It is not possible to change the status of an ordered purchase document back to In-Preparation.-Resolution-This is how system designed, the approver who receives the approval task will only have two options: Approve or Send Back for Revision. Reject will not be available.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Withdraw From Approval, Cannot Withdraw, Cannot Reject

Title: Purchase Order Self Approval
Content: Symptom-You have scoped self approval for purchase order in scoping. Yet, buyer responsible or the creator of a purchase order did not receive the task.-It either remains unassigned in Business Task Management or approval is bypassed altogether.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Order work center.-Choose Purchase Order view.-Search and edit your purchase order.-Choose Approval view.-you will notice that no approver is determined here.-Cause-In general self approval business configuration question only covers the cases where the task is generated against the creator or buyer responsible of the purchase order via the work distribution :Direct Approvers, however if it is any other work distribution is used then the self approval business configuration question is not applicable.- Thus From 1505 version, we have provided a new option to address this issue and here the checkbox for buyer responsible or creator is provided.- Who should not receive the approval task for purchase order and purchase order items respectively should be checked.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to enable creator of purchase order to approve his own document irrespective of the condition. To do so,-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Choose Overview view.-Open the fine-tuning activity Purchase Order Approvals.-Choose Purchase Order Approval Filter.-Uncheck all the checkbox.-Save.-Keywords-Self approval purchase order,

Title: Error Message: “Location already exists; Activation failed” While Migrating Location and Logistics Areas
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool. Upon migrating, system throws the below error message:-Location XXXXX already exists-Activation failed-*XXXXX represents the Location ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Location and Logistics Area-Select Migrate location and logistics area using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-You receive the error-Cause-Migration is failing due to invalid Logistics Area IDs, Storage Control Profile ID, Product ID, etc.-Resolution-You must check the uniqueness of IDs (for Location and Logistics Areas) and Master Data (like Storage Control Profile, Product etc) before you start the migration.-The Logistics Area IDs should be unique. Maintain the correct data in the migration file and proceed with the migration activity.-Keywords-Migration of Location and Logistics Area, Logistics Area ID, Location and Logistics Areas, Location already exists, Activation failed

Title: Inventory Ageing Data Source Functionality
Content: Symptom-You are looking for a data source that shows data related to Inventory Aging and it seems that the available one, Inventory Aging (SCMINVAGV01) is showing incorrect data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This report is based on assumption that the materials which came in first are consumed first i.e. inventory net off will happen based on FIFO approach.-Currently, there is a “Confirmation Journal Report” already available which gives details of the incoming/outgoing dates for stock items. The inventory Aging Report is going to make use of this report to calculate the time elapsed in days since the time of incoming entry in the Confirmation Journal till the “TO DATE” of the report.-This report is based on the following assumptions and this report will be helpful for only if you use the FIFO Logic.-This report is based on assumption that the materials which came in first are consumed first, i.e. inventory net off will happen based on FIFO approach-This report will give inventory age at site level. It will not calculate age on logistics area level.-It calculates age of stock from the moment it comes in a site. It disregards inventory age in source site.-If you are not using FIFO logic then the age displayed will be wrong.-This report uses the following parameters. Please provide the following parameters to the report selection:-End Date: Date in past from which Inventory Age has to be calculated.-Start Date: Latest date on which Inventory Age is needed.-Site: Site on which inventory age is needed. This report runs on site level.-Also we have following limitations in this report:-Stock Transfer Scenario: When a stock transfer happens, an inbound confirmation will be created at receiving site. Since our report is based on confirmations, age of transferred stock in new site will be calculated, based on new confirmation. It does not take into consideration the age of inventory on the source site.-Physical Inventory Adjustment: In case of annual or periodic inventory count, if the inventory records don’t match with the actual count, an inventory adjustment is done. The question here is: What age will be assigned to the delta inventory? In case there is a higher actual inventory than in the records, increased inventory will be considered to belong to latest period i.e. it will be considered as part of latest confirmation. In case of lesser actual inventory than in records, missing inventory would be considered to belong to earliest period, i.e. it will be considered as part of earliest confirmation.-Scrap Scenario: Any stock scrap would result in reduction of inventory and this would have to be adjusted in the Inventory count.-Resolution-The behavior of how inventory aging data source works is explained above.-Further, the The old data source SCMINVAGV01 has been depreciated. Please use the latest data source SCMINVAGV04.-Keywords-inventory ageing, ageing report, ByD, Business ByDesign, Inventory ageing stock overview, stock overview does not match with inventory ageing-inventory ageing,ageing report,byd, business bydesign

Title: Error while Processing Warehouse Request; Action Not Executed
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Warehouse Request from an existing Delivery Proposal, and when you click on the button Create Warehouse Request, you receive the error message: 'Error Processing Warehouse Request; Action Not Executed'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Delivery Control: Delivery Proposals view.-Search and select the relevant delivery proposal and choose the button Create Warehouse Request.-You receive the above mentioned error message from the system.-Cause-You have maintained the value Autonomic Inspection for the field Inspection Process in the Logistics Model with type Standard Shipping for your relevant Site. If there does not exist an Inspection Plan in your system when Autonomic Inspection is configured in your Logistics Model, you will receive the above error message. This check was introduced in the system from the 1502 release of ByDesign.-Resolution-You can either create an Inspection Plan in your system or remove the Autonomic Inspection from your Logistics Model. Detailed steps on how to create an Inspection Plan is available in Business ByDesign help center document titled Create an Inspection Plan.-Please follow the below given steps to remove Autonomic Inspection from your logistics model.-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center. -Navigate to the Logistics Models view.-Select All Logistics Model by Selection in the field Show and choose the button GO.-Search and select the Logistics Model with type Standard Shipping for your relevant Site.-Choose the Edit button.-In the Edit screen remove the value Autonomic Inspection from the field Inspection Process and choose the Save button.-Choose the Check button, if the consistency status of the model is Consistent choose the Save and Release button.-Keywords-Logistics Model, Create Warehouse Request, Inspection Plan, Autonomic Inspection, Action, Not, Executed

Title: Error Message : 0 digit(s) permitted after the decimal point
Content: Symptom-You received the above error message after upload a Base Price List or List price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Pricing view.-Search fPrice List -Click in Edit button-You see this error message- or-Go to Product Portfolio WC-Go to List Prices View-Search for the respective List price-Click in Edit button-You see this error message-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign, inventory management allows and stores 3 decimals for for the unit of measure, however you cannot enter decimals for the Unit of measure EA. If you enter decimals for Unit of measure EA you will receive the mentioned error.-Resolution-So kindly remove the decimals under Price and Price unit .

Title: Go Shopping/Go Shopping (Advanced)/ Track my shopping carts link missing from Self Service Overview of Home Work Center
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find Shopping/Go Shopping (Advanced) link in Self Service Overview ﻿view of Home work Center.-or-A Service Agent cannot track shoppincarts via Track My Shopping Carts in the Home work centre.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Choose Self-Services Overview view.-You will notice Shopping/Go Shopping (Advanced)/Track my shopping link are missing.-Cause-As a service agent you cannot create shopping cart from your user ID .-Since Service Agents cannot create shopping carts for themselves and hence they cannot track shopping carts under Homework center.-Resolution-Service agent can create shopping cart on behalf of an active employee form Go Shopping view in Project Team or Project Management work center.-also Service agent can Track their Shopping carts by following below steps:-Go to Project team work center or Project management work center-Go to Common Task  -See Also-  1904593 - Creation of Shopping Cart by Service Agent-Keywords- Shopping cart-shopping/go shopping,track my shopping carts

Title: Products Are Not Being Selected For Inspection Automatically
Content: Symptom-The Inspection document is not automatically triggered after stocks are received through an Inbound Delivery even though relevant Inspection Plan is Active. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Control work center.-Go to Inspections sub view under Monitoring view.-Search with the Product ABC (ABC represents the Product ID)-There are no inspections related to the received products.-Cause-Inspections are not triggered automatically unless the Autonomic Inspection option is defined in the relevant Logistics Model.-Resolution-To enable Automatic Inspection in Logistic Model follow the below steps.-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to Logistics Model view.-Search for the Logistics Model DEF.-Choose Edit.-For the field Inspection Process, select the option Autonomic Inspection.-Choose Save and Release.-(DEF represents the Logistics Model ID for Standard Receiving)-Keywords-Autonomic Inspection; Products; Inspection; Inbound Delivery; Supplier Delivery; Receiving; Logistics Model; Product; SAP ByDesign

Title: Error:Postings Not Permitted; ABC is an Intercompany Settlement Project
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order via a purchase request created from an Intercompany Project with ID ABC.- or-You have created a purchase order and assigned the sales order that is  an intercompany sales order linked to a intercompany project- and you get the below mentioned error message when you perform a check on the purchase order created or  approve a purchase order.-"Postings not permitted; ABC is an intercompany settlement project"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant purchase order you have created from the intercompany project and choose Edit.-In the Purchase Order screen choose the Check button.-You receive the above mentioned error message.-Cause-Currently, we do not support creating purchase orders for an external supplier from an intercompany project or assigning a purchase order to an intercompany sales order that is linked to an intercompany project. This is a new requirement for us.-Resolution-Kindly check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum and if no such idea exist then please submit idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Intercompany Project; subcontracting; intercompany purchase orders;

Title: Error: The sum of the credit memo amounts is greater than the invoice amount because of a discount, surcharge, or reduction
Content: Symptom-System trigger Exception error message while posting Credit Memo against Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Credit Memo ID.-Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Exceptions tab.-It shows the Exception error: "The sum of the credit memo amounts is greater than the invoice amount because of a discount, surcharge, or reduction". -Cause-There is a discount, surcharge or reduction in the Supplier Invoice and that is missing in the Credit Memo.-Resolution-The Net Amount in the Credit Memo may be the same as in the Supplier Invoice in item level, however, the same does not apply for header level. This can be checked in the "Deduction and Surcharges" subtab. There it shows the price difference between the Invoice and the Credit Memo. -Therefore the Exception appears. -The user should enter the same discount, surcharge or reduction in the Credit Memo as in the Supplier Invoice. Only then the user will be able to post it. -Keywords-Credit memo, Supplier invoice, The sum of the credit memo amounts is greater than the invoice amount, discount, surcharge, reduction, exception

Title: Line Items per Purchase Order Limited to 30 During Excel Upload
Content: Symptom-The Excel upload functionality for Purchase Orders limits to the number of Line Items to 30 per Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Select the New button.-Select Import from Microsoft Excel® option from the drop down.-It can be seen that the line items are arranged in the horizontal manner with the maximum number of line items limited to 30 per Purchase Order.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-The Excel upload functionality allows only  30 line items per Purchase Order in the current version of Business ByDesign. For Purchase Orders more than 30 line items you may use the option of manual creation of line items through the frontend.

Title: Scheduling Of Recurring Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to change  the time at which a Recurring Supplier Invoice run is executed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Navigate to the Recurring Invoices view.-Select the relevant Recurring Invoice Template ID and choose the Edit button.-Navigate to the Define Recurring Invoice guided activity by selecting the Next button.-Under the header Recurrence Pattern you are not able to enter a time at which you want the invoice run to start.-You see that only date value can be changed and not the time.-Cause-The time schedule has to be same for all runs thus the job will run in that time.-Resolution-Steps to reschedule the Job run time:-Go to application user management-Go to  background jobs view-Select"Recurring invoicing for all buyers" click on Reschedule button-choose Recurrence-Enter date as next day and time as 00:30 in UTC ( convert time 00:30 in UTC to your time zone same as your personalize settings and enter the time).

Title: No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports
Content: Symptom-The Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report or Profit Overview by Key Figure report doesn't display any data although there are financial postings relevant for selection parameters.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Reports view, List subview.-Select the report Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme or Profit Overview by Key Figure.-Enter the selection parameters and click Go.-You get an information message that: No report data available to display; check selection for the report 'Profit detail by contribution margin scheme'.-Cause-The contribution margin scheme maintained in the Set of books specifies the structure of the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report. SAP delivers templates for contribution margin schemes (structure type Income Statement by Function of Expense) as financial reporting structures for every template chart of accounts. You can copy a template and adapt it to your needs or create a contribution margin scheme from scratch. In the customized reporting structure, you have not maintained all the Fixed Structure Items.-Resolution-Find the Reporting Structure setup as the Contribution margin scheme in the Set of Books.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the fine tuning activity Settings for Earned Profit Analysis.-Select the link Edit Financial Reporting Structure.-Select the appropriate reporting structure and click Edit.-You need to assign all the fixed structure items in the Income Statement by Function of Expense reporting structure:-Operating Profit— displayed as Income From Operations.-Gross Profit— displayed as Gross Profit on Sales.-Net Revenue—displayed as Net Sales Revenues.-Gross Revenue— displayed as Sales Revenues.-Cost of Sales— displayed as Cost of Goods Sold.-Additionally assign the following fixed structure items to nodes of the contribution margin scheme:-Income Statement — add to the root node of the contribution margin scheme.-Income Statement Result— add to the node displaying the net income or net loss of the income statement.-Returns— add to the node displaying the sales returns.-Make sure that data exists for the selection parameters in the report. In case you are still unable to see any data in the report, then Report an case to SAP.-Kindly refer to the attached screenshot and refer to the help document "Settings for Earned Profit Analysis – Configuration Guide".-Keywords-Contribution margin scheme; reporting structure; fixed structure item

Title: Input Products Missing in Production Order
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find the Input Products in a Production Task or in the Production Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view, and select By Order Header.-Find and edit the relevant Production Order.-Go to the Products tab, then to the Input Products subtab.-You can see that the Input Products are missing. -If you open the relevant Production Task and navigate to the relevant Input Products subtab, you can also see that the Input Products are missing there as well.-Cause-The Input Products are not appearing due to the settings on the related Bill of Materials. For Production Orders where the Released Execution Model Explosion Date is prior to the Valid From date of the Input Products in the Bill of Materials, the Input Products will not be considered.-Resolution-Check the validity date of the Input Products in the Bill of Materials, and ensure that they are valid at the Explosion Date of the Released Execution Model. This is necessary since the system does Backward Scheduling when calcluating the Production Start date.-Keywords-Valid From, Input Product, Production Task, Production Order, Backward Scheduling

Title: How to Create a Supplier Return Without a Reference
Content: Symptom-How to create a supplier return without a reference?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center-Go to the Common Tasks and select New Return to Supplier-You are not able to create a supplier return without reference as the system is asking for a Inbound Delivery ID-Cause-In order to create a Supplier return, you need to have a Inbound delivery ID or Goods and Service Receipts reference.-Practically speaking, return to supplier can be created only when you have goods on your company site. Without having a tangible product, it is not possible to sent back to supplier. Meaning, you must always have either Goods and Service Receipt document for Non-Stock scenario and Inbound Delivery document for To-Stock scenario. This is the current system behavior.-Resolution-You need to have an Inbound Delivery document or Goods and Service Receipts document reference in the system to create a return to supplier document.-Note: In case of migrated deliveries, there is no real delivery in the system. It’s just a reference on the purchase order due to this you cannot create a Return to Supplier for migrated deliveries.-Now in order to create Inbound delivery ID or Goods and Service Receipts, you must have the purchase order. Currently it is not possible to create return to supplier document with out purchase order or delivery reference. It can taken as a new requirement and you can post in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Return to supplier, RTS creation, return to supplier without purchase order, how to create supplier return without reference document

Title: How is supplier tax registration number determined in supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know how supplier tax registration number is determined in supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supplier Invoicing-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for respective Invoice and choose the button Edit.-Choose the button View all.-Go to General Tab.-Go to sub tab Taxes.-The Supplier's Tax Registration is not the one as expected.-  Cause-Based on the Ship From maintained in the Supplier invoice the Country to be chosen for determining the tax Registration details is determined.-So, for the system to pick the correct tax details you must maintain the tax details of the Ship From country in the supplier master data.-But If tax details are not maintained for the Ship From country in the supplier master data the below is applicable.-Then Supplier's Tax Registration details are taken from the supplier master data Financial tab sub tab Tax Data, if there are many maintained then system will pick the first one, if only one is maintained the system pick the same.-Resolution-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Select Suppliers View.-In the field Show choose show all suppliers option from drop down.-In the field Find enter desired Supplier-Choose the supplier and choose the button Edit.-Go to Financials Tab.-Go to Tax Data sub tab.-Under Tax Numbers field enter all mandatory details.-Save and close.-From now these tax details are filled automatically when ever you create an supplier invoice for this supplier.-Keywords-Supplier Tax Registration Number, Tax Number,Supplier Tax Number,

Title: Error Postings Not Permitted; Company Differs from Project Company When Assigning Project Task to Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You create an expense report for a project task connected to an inter-company project.-When assigning the respective project task an error message is triggered "Error Postings Not Permitted; Company ABC Differs from Project Company XYZ."-(ABC means Company ID; XYZ means Company ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Travel and Expenses work center select Common Task New Expense Report on Behalf.-Select an employee of company ABC.-Select an expense type, such as Business Trip or Out-of-Pocket Expense. -Enter a purpose. -Press Edit Cost Assignment.-In the new screen press Add Row, and select Account Assignment Type Project Task.-Select the task of the Project of Company XYZ, to which the employee of Company ABC is assigned to. -The error message appears "Error Postings Not Permitted; Company ABC Differs from Project Company XYZ."-Cause-For intercompany scenarios, a Purchase Order Item of type Limit associated with the project task the employee is assigned to, must exist. The Limit item must be connected to a service marked as Expense.-Resolution-Ensure that the Employee of Company ABC is assigned in the work tab of a task of a Project of Company XYZ.-Then either create a Purchase Request from the Products view in the Project:-From the Project Request, create a Purchase Order.-In the Purchase Order, add an item of type Limit. -Assign an Expense Service (the service must be flagged as Expense in the Service Master data) to the limit item. -Once the Purchase Order is posted a Sales Order of company ABC to Company XYZ as well as an Intercompany Project of company XYZ are generated. -It will then be possible to create an Expense Report for the employee of Company ABC.*-You can also directly create a Purchase Order from the Purchase Requests and Orders work center. It is sufficient to just create a Limit Item.  However, the limit item must be connected to an Expense service (the service must be flagged as Expense).-*Note: For inter-company scenarios the scoping element Expense Recording must be selected:-In the Business configuration work center access your solution profile through the Implemenation project. -Press Edit Project Scope. -Navigate to Step 3 - Scoping.-Find the Project Management scoping element. -Find the Expense Recording element and select it. -Move on the step 6 - Confirmation and press Finish.  -Log out of the system and back in again for the changes to take effect.-See Also-1961421 - Error Message: Postings Not Permitted; Company ABC Differs From Project Company XYZ.-Keywords-Intercompany Project; Posting Not Permitted; Expense Report

Title: Message "Nothing open for invoicing for purchase document" when Creating Credit Memos
Content: Symptom-You receive messages of type Nothing open for invoicing for purchase document and fields are not filled when trying to create new credit memos.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Entry view-Select the purchase order for which you want to to create the credit memo-Click on New Credit Memo-Cause-There is already an invoice in approval (or in status Ready for Posting) for the purchase order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. As long as a supplier invoice is posted for the purchase order document, the system will not propose any data for a credit memo with reference to the same purchase order. As soon as the document is posted, the data will then be proposed when creating the credit memo.-See Also-3061955 - Unable to invoice a Delivery or a Return or why are they appearing as open for invoicing-Keywords-return to supplier,nothing open for invoicing for purchase,credit memo,invoicing

Title: Error in Planning Run: Error Message:Production model for Product ID on Date for Quantity not Found
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled a Planning Run, but when the Run is executed the Material plannning did not happen due to the following:-'Creation of all receipts not possible.-Production Model for <Product ID / Planning Area> on DD.MM.YYYY for quantity X not found.-Creation of X proposals failed'.--The corresponding Released Production Model (RPM), Bill of Material (BoM), Bill of Operation (BoO) have correct Validity Dates. The requested Quantity X in the proposal is higher than the Maximum Lot Size in the Released Production Model, however you expect several receipts to be generated in order to cover the Demand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supply Planning.-Go to the view Automated Actions.-Go to the sub-view Planning Runs.-Mark the Run ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Running ID).-Open the Application Log ID with errors.-Go to the tab Results.-You can see the errors: Creation of all receipts not possible. Production Model for <Product ID / Panning Area> on DD.MM.YYYY for quantity X not found.-Cause-In the Product master data, you have the Planning Procedure defined as Demand-Driven Planning with Lot-Sizing Method defined as Lot-for-Lot. This means that the quantity is requested as-is in demand, but the production model supports Maximum Lot Size of 1ea (or inferior to the demand), hence you face this error. You need to change the Lot-Sizing Method to Fixed lot size with Fixed lot size quantity = 1ea (Or equals Maximum Lot Size) in order to generate receipts separately.-Resolution-Go to the Product Data Work Center.-Go to the View Materials, sub-view Materials.-Select the material, choose Edit and then View All.-Go to the tab Planning.-Change Lot-Sizing Method to Fixed lot size with quantity 1ea (Or = Maximum Lot Size).-See Also-You can also refer the knowledge base article 2202847 - Error Message:Production model for Product ID on Date for quantity not found-Keywords-Planning Run, Released Planning Model, Material, Lot-Sizing Method

Title: Data Source Taxes - Supplier Invoice Details Displays No Data
Content: Symptom-When previewing data source Taxes - Supplier Invoice Details no data is shown (empty report).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You go to the Business Analytics work center-You go to the Design Data Sources view-Find the data source Taxes - Supplier Invoice Details with the technical ID GLOTAXB11-Hit the preview button-You receive the message No report data available to display; check the selection-Cause-This data source is developed for Indian requirement. So there is a filter in the data source for country India.-Resolution-If there are no records for India in your system then it is correct that the data source does not display any data.- Try using other reports like  'All VAT / Sales Tax Items' report  that has  similar details.-Keywords-GLOTAXB11

Title: Error Message : Exchange rate Country/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion
Content: Symptom-While creating the Purchase Order in projects the system throws an error message as Exchange rate Country/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Choose the New Purchase Order view under Common Tasks.-The New Purchase Order floor plan opens.-Fill the required information like Supplier, Service product, Involved Parties.-The system displays an error: Exchange rate Country/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion-Cause-In the intercompany projects scenario the customer's (maintained as account in sales order) information sent by the Sales Order is carried over into the Purchase Order.-also this error is being raised by the Tax Calculation while doing the tax calculation based on the delivery address.-Resolution-Either maintain the Exchange Rate or send the correct customer details from the sales order.-Here delivery address is determined from the customer-If the account ID cannot be changed in the sales order, then the only option left is to change the customer details in the Purchase Order manually .

Title: Project Baseline is routed to wrong Manager for Approval.
Content: Symptom-Project Baseline is routed to wrong manager for approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Change Management View.-Choose Baselines sub view.-Find and choose the Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Choose View button.-Under Basic Data tab you can see the Approver for the Project Baseline.-To check whether the system has routed to right responsible unit manger.-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects View.-Choose Projects sub view.-Find and choose the Project XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Choose Edit and Project Plan button.-Navigate to Accounting tab.-Under Organizational Assignments you can see the Responsible Unit double click on the Responsible Unit ABC (ABC represents the cost center name).-Here you will be able to see the Manager Name for the respective Responsible Unit.-If the Responsible Unit manager is not maintained it will go next available Cost Center Manager.-Cause-1.There are default settings for project base line approvals which would work when no multi step approvals are maintained-2. You might have used wrong work distribution in multi step approvals.-Resolution-1.By default Project Baseline Approval shall go to Responsible (Cost Center) Manager which is assigned to the Project.-If Responsible Unit Manager is not maintained then it will go to next available cost center manager/line manager as appearing in organisation structure.-2.If multistep approvals is maintained it can be seen under application user management work center> approval process> baselines-so approver is triggered based on it .-Refer below help document that explains  how the  different work distributions used in multi step approvals work for project base lines approvals.-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2111/en-US/2db13578722d1014a2adad8ee1af3c59.html-Keywords-Baseline approval;Project approval;Project baseline approval

Title: System doesn't show the preferred supplier in purchase order
Content: Symptom-When assigning the source of supply for a Purchase Order the system doesn't show what the preferred supplier is.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Request view.-Show Open Tasks-Select task and click "Assign Source of Supply".-The new window "Assign Source of Supply" opens up.-There is a button called "Accept Preferred Supplier" but there's no field showing what the Preferred Supplier is.-Cause-The system passes the Preferred Supplier information from shopping cart to the Purchase Request but this field isn't displayed by default.-Resolution-Field 'Preferred Supplier' is not displayed by default, however it is available under the Personalization section and you can add it to the screen.-Once this is done, you can see the value of preferred supplier before accepting it.-Keywords-prefferd supplier,prefered Supplier,preferred Supplier

Title: The Registered Product do not Contain the Account Information
Content: Symptom-After creating and releasing an Outbound Delivery, the Registered Product record for the item delivered was created. However, the Registered product record did not contain the Account information and Ship-to address.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the Registered Products view.-Search and select the product ID ABC (ABC represents name of the product)-Choose Edit button.-Here for the product ABC, the account and Ship-to information is missing.-Cause-If you do not maintain the corresponding details from the outbound delivery then the Business Configuration scoping should be maintained correctly by selecting the question:Do you want the solution to  automatically record Registered product?.--Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the  Implementation Projects view.-Choose the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to the Review Questions->Service->Entitlement Management->Registered Products.-Scope the question:Do you want the solution to automatically record registered products sold during the outbound delivery,-Select the Next button and Finish the scoping.-Keywords

Title: Unable To Delete Logistics Task Folder
Content: Symptom-You are unable to delete a Logistics Task Folder as Delete option is Grayed out in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data Work center.-Go to the Logistics Task Folder view.-In the Show field, select All Folders By Selection from the drop-down.-Search for the relevant Logistics Task Folder ID using Find option.-Select the Task Folder ID with certain Task Type say Production Task.-Here you see that option Delete is not Enabled.-Cause-Since the Logistics Task Folder ID has assigned tasks you are unable to delete it.- In the normal business scenario, Logistics Task Folders are not created too often, and are not deleted once they are in use.-Only their assignment criteria is changed and person responsible gets changed with time.-Resolution-Only the task folders which have the Task Folder Type as Standard will have the Delete button enabled provided there are no tasks assignments in the folder.This is an Expected System Behavior.-Note:Please note the below points related to Logistics Task Folder :-1. Default Logistics Task Folders can never be deleted.-2. A Non-Default Logistics Task Folder can be deleted only if it does not have any assigned tasks.-Note : There should be no assigned tasks, not just open tasks-Keywords-You are unable to delete a Logistics Task Folder as Delete option is Grayed out in the system, Logistics Task Folder as Delete option is Grayed out in the system

Title: Error Message: Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA 2956896 - Project Invoice Request Not Created For a Sales Order With Project Milestone-When creating a Scheduled Invoice Request for a Milestone the following error message occurs: Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view and then the Projects sub view.-Show All Projects and click the Go button.-Select the Project ABC (ABC represents the project name).-Click the Project Identifier icon, which is displayed under the Project ID column.-Choose Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request.-While creating the Scheduled Invoice Request error message occurs: Scheduled invoice request not created; no relevant items found.-Cause-The error message occurs, because the Status of the Milestone to be invoiced is not set to Completed and  thus you cannot create an Scheduled Invoice Request-Resolution-To maintain the Status of the Milestone you can use the following steps:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view and then the Projects sub view.-Show All Projects and click the Go button.-Select the Project ABC.-Click the Edit button and choose Project Plan.-Select Milestone XYZ (XYZ represents the milestone name).-Set the Status to Completed.-Save changes.- Now you shall not see error message when creating  a  Scheduled Invoice Request.

Title: Creation of Shopping Cart by Service Agent
Content: Symptom-Both Employees as well as Service Agents can create Shopping Carts.-This KBA will highlight the points of Shopping Cart creation specific to Service Agents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon as a Service Agent.-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Common Tasks - Go Shopping.-Enter the name of an Employee.-The system raises the error Company Missing.-Resolution-Both Employees and Service Agents can create shopping carts from ByDesign.
