However the following points differ when a service agent is the creator of a Shopping Cart.-For Employees:-An employee can always procure for himself by creating a shopping cart from the Home work center.-Employees can also create shopping carts on behalf of other employees and service agents from all the three work centers: Home, Project Team and Project Management.-Note: You cannot create Shopping Carts for Service Agents using the Value Help.  however typing the Service Agent ID in the Employee field and click on enter button on your key board, system allows the Shopping Cart to be created.(There is on influence forum already so please vote for it to be developed soon https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/idea/269152)-For Service Agent:-A service agent assigned with Project Team or Project Management work center can only create shopping carts on behalf of an employee.-A service agent, if not hired as an employee can create shopping carts on behalf of an employee only using the functionality Go Shopping (Advanced) from Project Team or Project Management work center.-A service agent who is hired as an employee can create shopping cart for himself using the functionality Go Shopping in Home work center and also on behalf of other employee using option Go Shopping (Advanced) from all the three work centers: Home, Project Team and Project Management.--When an employee creates a shopping cart on behalf of another employee using Go Shopping (Advanced), the system picks the creator as the recipient so the address of the org unit assigned the the creator is picked.-In case the creator is a service agent, the system behavior is the same and the system will throw the error message Company Missing.-If you assign an Organizational Unit to the Service Agent, they can create shopping carts from the Home work center for themselves as well.-See Also- 2138393 - Go Shopping/Go Shopping (Advanced)/ Track my shopping carts link missing from Self Service Overview of Home Work Center-Keywords-shopping, cart, service, agent, company, missing,-shopping cart in home work center,charge to details missing; enter details,cost center missing,company missing,shopping cart,service agent,company missing

Title: New Individual Material Button Not Available in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-What access rights should a User be assigned with to be able to Create a New Individual Material?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Find XYZ (XYZ represents the Purchase Order ID).-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Go to Items tab.-Select Line Item ABC (ABC represents the Line Item ID).-Go to the Account Assignment subtab.-The New Individual Material button is greyed out.-You expect the New Individual Material button to be active.-Cause-Your user does not have the sufficient access rights for this function to be enabled.-Resolution-For a user to be able to create a New Individual Material, he/she should be assigned with access rights to several Views, the Invoice Entry and Invoices and Credit Memos views, of the Supplier Invoicing work center and the Fixet Assets view of the Fixed Assets work center.-This can be done as follows:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Under the User and Access Management view select the Business Users sub-view.-Select the concerned user and select the Edit button's Access Rights option.-Expand the SRM_SUPPLIERINVOICING work center and check the Assigned to User box for SRM_INVOICEENTRY and SRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS view.-Expand the FIN_FIXEDASSETS work center and check the Assigned to User box for FIN_FIXEDASSETSALL view.-Select the Save and Close button.-The steps to create a New Individual material would be:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Common task New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-In the Items section, select the Product Type 'Material'.-Follow-up with selecting the other parameters like Product ID, Tax Code, etc.-In the Account Assignment section, select Account Assignment Type as 'IMAT - Individual Material'.-In line with the Individual Material field, you will find a New button to create an Individual Matereial.-Keywords-new individual material,individual material

Title: Cost Distribution of Additional Cost Credit Memos
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Credit Memo with Item Type Additional Cost Credit Item and want to use the option Distribute among other invoices or credit memos. However, this option is not available in the Cost Distribution of the relevant item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all systems.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for Credit Memo ABC (ABC represents the relevant Credit Memo ID).-Click on Edit.-Click on View All.-Select the Items tab.-Select Cost Distribution subtab.-You can see that the option Distribute among other invoices or credit memos is not available.-Cause-Additional Cost Credit Items cannot be distributed directly to other invoices.-This applies to Supplier Invoices as well as Credit Memos.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour. When creating the Credit Memo, the Distribute among other invoices or credit memos button is available only for item type Additional Cost Debit Item.-Keywords-Distribute, Among, Other, Invoices, Or, Credit, Memos, Additional, Debit, Item, Missing, Not, Available, Cannot, Can't

Title: Cannot Import Purchasing Contracts. Error: Price Condition Missing
Content: Symptom-The user cannot import Purchasing Contracts due to the error: "Price Condition Missing".-Or, error: "Condition type missing" with warning: "Price Missing, Item Inactive for Sourcing".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant implementation project. -Choose Open Activity List.-Navigate to Integrate and Extend tab.-Find Migration of Purchasing Contracts and choose Open.-Choose "Migrate purchasing contracts" using the migration tool.-Select the Source File.-Choose Execute Migration.-One of the error message is triggered:-"Price Condition Missing";-"Condition type missing" (with warning: "Price Missing, Item Inactive for Sourcing").-Cause-For some items, the Contract Price is set to 0. This is not allowed.-The user can verify this in the Details section for the Source File, in the tab "Items - Prices", in column "Contract Price".-Resolution-Enter a value above 0 for all items' Contract prices.-Then the user can execute the migration once more.-Keywords-Migration of Purchasing Contract; Condition type missing; Price Condition Missing; Price Missing; Item Inactive for Sourcing; 采购合同迁移；缺少条件类型

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice: "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval"
Content: Symptom-System throws an error message "Item X: Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval" while creating a Supplier invoice with reference of Purchase Order (X represents line-item id of invoice, XYZ represent Purchase Order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Select Show: All Orders to Be Invoiced.-Search with XYZ (XYZ represent Purchase Order ID).-Choose New Invoice.-Error: Item X: Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval.-Cause-The Purchase Order XYZ is currently in the "In Approval" status. Therefore, it is not available for invoicing.-Resolution-Complete the Purchase Order approval process. Once the Purchase Order has been fully approved, try creating the invoice for the Purchase Order.-Keywords-Supplier invoice error; Supplier invoice exception; Referenced purchase order contains values that are in approval; Item X posting not possible

Title: Error Message: File cannot be uploaded, File size cannot exceed 20MB.
Content: Symptom-When trying to upload a MS-projects file to SAP ByD system, system throws an error message as File cannot be uploaded, File size cannot exceed 20MB.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Project Management work center.-Choose New project  view under Common task.-System will open New Project window.-Under Enter Initial Data tab, choose project type as Cost collecting project, Choose Source as Microsoft Project.-Navigate to next tab Copy Source.-Here choose the upload button and try to upload the Microsoft Project file which is more than 20MB, while uploading this file system throws an error message as File cannot be uploaded, File size cannot exceed 20MB.-Cause-This is a technical limitation from ByD in the current release thus you will not be able to upload a XML file more than 20MB-Resolution-So you have to upload the MS-projects XML file within the permissible range and you can create further tasks by going in the Project Management workcenter.

Title: Cannot Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of  KBA 2482459 - Scheduled Project Invoice Request is not Created automatically-Customer intents to create a new Scheduled Project Invoice Request and receives an alert: Action triggered; verify result in Work view in a few minutes but nothing happens after that.- or error Customer Invoicing not possible; posting to financial accounting is blocked on XX:XX:XXXX-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management workcenter and navigate to the Projects View and there choose the Projects subview.-Show All Projects and navigate to the respective project.-Click on the Project Identifier icon right beside the project ID and there choose Create Scheduled Project Invoice Request.-The alert appears: Action triggered; verify result in Work view in a few minutes-Nothing happens after that.-Cause-This command triggers an asynchronous backend report. After a few minutes you can verify its results in the Invoice Preparation - Work view of the Project Management workcenter.-There is an open task in work sub view of Invoice Preparation view under project management work center and you need to take actions on this task. If you open the task, you will come to know the error from the application log.-Task - Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request-Application Log-Here you can check if there were any issues raised during the scheduled invoice creation or you can review and release successfully created invoices.-For scheduled invoices the system creates invoices for the whole scheduled period. Therefore a possible cause why invoices were not created is that not all respective accounting periods are open for posting.-Resolution-To check if the accounting periods are open-Go to the General Ledger workcenter and here to the Common Tasks.-Choose Open and Close Periods-Select the accounting period in which you need release the invoice.-Check if the accounting period is open for operational postings (first allowed step: 010-Operational Postings; last allowed step: 010-Operational Postings or 020-Closing Entries).-In Details section ensure that the Process Control is configured correctly and that posting into the period is still/ already possible.-Steps to release the invoice.-In the Project Management workcenter go to the Invoice Preparation view and choose the Work subview.-Select Advanced (for advanced search option).-Search for the project ID reference and click Go.-Select the row and click Edit to open the corresponding task.-In the task choose Actions and select Retry to trigger the scheduled invoice request creation.-See Also-Case Document: 1773544 - Open Differences in SupplierInvoice and TradeReceivablesPayablesRegister, to be able to check details on the Set Process Control Steps.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request Not Created For a Sales Order

Title: What is the meaning of Approved status "Not Started" in Employee Times reports?
Content: Symptom-When running one of the Employee Times reports or any customized report based on data source HCMTLMU01.-It displays the characteristic Approved in the report.-However, when noticing a row with status Not Started for this field and would like to understand its meaning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The approval status Not Started is derived from the Employee Time Item and means that the approval was not started as the employee time was entered by the time administrator and therefore activated directly. Hence this status indicates that the employee time is active.--Also, customer created a time recording through the ESS timesheet and then activated it through the Time administration Workcenter. Hence, the backend will still show that the time recording was done through the ESS Timesheet.-Keywords-employee times report

Title: MRP Run Does Not Create Any Proposals for  Consumption Based Planning
Content: Symptom-For a product you have Demand in a planning area and so a Total Net Requirement above zero. However, when you execute Material Planning, the MRP run is not creating any Planning Proposals.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Products view.-Find and select the relevant Product.-Click the Open.-In the Product Planning Details screen, you can see that there is Demand.-Select 'Run Planning' and then either 'Single BoM Level' or 'Multi BoM Level'.-System does not show any error message but also does not create any proposal against the Demand.-Cause-In the product master data under Planning, you have maintained as 'Consumption Based Planning' with the 'Reorder Point Quantity' as XX (XX refers to Quantity). So MRP will create planning proposal only when stock reaches below the reorder point. Currently, stock is above the reorder point, that is why MRP is not generating any proposals. Please note that in Consumption Based Planning, demands like sales order, dependent demand, forecast demand etc. are not considered.-Resolution-System is not creating any purchase proposals as the On-hand stock or Available Stock is greater than the Reorder point quantity.-Note: System creates receipts if the On-hand stock plus the fixed receipts is below a threshold quantity (Reorder point quantity).-Keywords-Consumption Based Planning, Reorder Point Quantity, MRP RUN, Planning Procedure, Total Net Requirement-planning procedure,consumption based planning,reorder point quantity,mrp run

Title: Posting date 00.00.0000 must be after last retrmt date MM-DD-YYYY
Content: Symptom-You have created a fixed asset with a supplier invoice with posting date MM.DD.YYYY-You then transferred the individual material of this fixed asset with a posting date after the posting date of the supplier invoice date.-Now you want to cancel the supplier invoice but this posting does not go through to accounting as an error message appears: Posting date 00.00.0000 must be after last retrmt date MM-DD-YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Find the Error Message in the General Ledger workcenter-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Closing cockpit and there to the Source documents view. By default all unposted source documents are displayed here.-Find the supplier invoice that did not get posted.-In the bottom of the page you can see the error message: Posting date 00.00.0000 must be after last retrmt date MM-DD-YYYY (set of books ABC) (rtrmt stands for retirement).-Identify the Fixed Asset-To identify the fixed asset press on the ID of the cancelation invoice in the Source Documents view.-Press View all, navigate to the Items tab and there go to the Cost Distribution sub-tab.-Copy the ID of the Individual Material.-Now navigate to the Fixed Assets workcenter and here to the Fixed Assets view.-In the Show field, choose All Fixed Assets.-Open the Advanced search and maintain the individual material ID that you have just copied in the Individual Material ID field. Press Go.-Two Fixed Assets appear - One with status Capitalized and one with status Retired.-Identify the posting date of the original supplier invoice and the transfer posting-Open the retired Fixed asset by pressing Edit - Values and there navigate to the Journal subtab.-The first entry on the bottom is the posting of the original supplier invoice.-In the Posting date column, you can identify its posting date.-Further up you can see a Journal Entry Voucher with the transaction category Transfer-Sending (Transaction Category column).-In the Posting Date column you can see that the posting date of this transfer is after the posting date of the original supplier invoice (Once an individual material has been completely transferred to another fixed asset the status of the original fixed asset status changes to Retired).-Cause-As the transfer of the individual material was posted after the posting date of the original supplier invoice, which caused the retirement of the fixed asset, it is not possible to post its cancelation before this retirement date.-Resolution-You can either:-A) Post the cancelation invoice to a date after the retirement date or.-B) Cancel the transfer posting and then post the cancelation invoice. This is the most practical and clean option.-Option A)-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Closing cockpit and there to the source documents view.-Select the respective supplier invoice cancelation and choose Action- View Business Transaction.-Press Post to another period and maintain an Alternate Posting date on or after the posting date of the transfer posting.-Press OK and Post.-Option B)-In the Fixed Assets workcenter navigate to the Fixed Assets view and select the retired fixed asset.-Press Edit-Values and navigate to the Journal sub tab.-Click the Source Document ID of the transfer posting to open the journal entry voucher.-Press Edit and then press Reverse.-Now navigate back to the Source documents view of the General Ledger workcenter, select the supplier invoice cancelation and press Actions- Post Business Transaction.-The cancelation should now go through to accounting.-Keywords-fixes asset; source document; supplier invoice; goods and services receipt; cancelation; cancellation; reversal; retirement date

Title: Error "The item does not have a reference to a purchase order" When Creating Supplier Invoice Without Purchase Order Reference
Content: Symptom-You are creating new supplier invoice without reference to the purchase order and system shows this exception while posting.-Error: The item does not have a reference to a purchase order. Go to the exception and check whether the item should have a reference to one of the proposed documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Common Task and select New Supplier Invoice Without Purchase Order-Enter the mandatory information-Select Check button-Error appears-Cause-When you create a new supplier invoice without reference to the purchase order, the system will search un-invoiced purchase order with the combination of given supplier and product in supplier invoice. If it finds such purchase orders, system will throw an error in the invoice.-Resolution-System will provide the list of such purchase orders in the Exceptions tab in supplier invoice. If system identifies such open purchase orders, it is mandatory to assign the invoice to any of the proposed purchase orders and you can select confirm to make reference of them with the supplier invoice.-From standard system,this exception arises so that users may not forget to add proper reference to avoid any inconsistency in future.-If you do not want to add any purchase order reference, you can also make use of add-on to accept the exception automatically in this scenario.-If you want to change this behavior, you can post this in the influence forum as a new requirement for future implementation: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-This is our official channel to address all new requirements. If multiple customers vote for the same idea, our development team will check the feasibility of implementing this functionality in future .You can track and check the status of the idea in that forum.-Keywords-New Supplier Invoice Without Purchase Order, The item does not have a reference to a purchase order.

Title: Unable to edit approval process cause edit Button is Greyed out
Content: Symptom-You cannot change the Default approval process of a document because the Edit button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview view.-Select the Activities & find  for suppose Purchase Order Approvals.-Press View button.-Select the Default approval process for Purchase Order.-You can see here that it is not possible to select Edit because the button is grayed out.-Cause-Validity of Existing Default approval process for Purchase Order cannot be changed because it allows the key user to track past approval definitions.-Resolution-You can update the existing process by delimiting the validity with new process using Copy button.-1. Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-2. Go to the Overview View.-3. Find the Activity Purchase Order Approvals.-4. Press View button.-5. Once the screen opens press Copy button.-6. Enter the new Process Name, Define Conditions etc.. as per your choice & Save.-After this new Purchase Order Approval Process will be saved in Draft.--8. Repeat step 3 & 4 again.-9. Now again search the newly save process in All Processes query.-You will find the newly created process.-10. Now select the new process and press Edit Validity.-11. You will get the existing Active process and newly created process.-12. In the Old process remove the Unlimited Validity check box and update Validity To date.-13. In the new process Update the Valid From Date (similar to the Validity To date of old process) and select Unlimited Validity.--Now once the defined start date/time will come, new process will become enabled automatically.- Note:  This details are applicable for all documents  which has approval process enabled.-See Also-  3074744 - How to delete an approval process

Title: Purchase Order E-Mail Notifications are not Sent From Default Sender Address
Content: Symptom-You created a purchase order and sent to the supplier. When the supplier receives the purchase order E-Mail notification, it was sent from the E-Mail ID of the user who created the purchase order rather than expected sender address.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order and navigate to Output History tab-Select Resubmit button and enter your E-mail address in the To column-Select Resubmit-or-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order and make changes and Send update-You will receive an E-Mail notification from unexpected sender E-Mail address.-Cause-Sender email address is determined in one of the below methods which are mentioned priority wise:-1.Output channel selection-2.Buyer responsible email address-3.Default sender address-Note: Sender you see under Output history tab of PO or what you see after following below steps is the User (login user)who is actually submitting the Purchase order.- Go to Application user management work center- Go to Email and Fax queues  view or Print queues view - Select the respective entry and click edit- Go to Queued Documents tab- Where you can see the Sender- If you see this field empty then its Support user -Steps to see the Sender of the Output Email is:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order and navigate to You can also-Click on Edit output form of PO-Select Send by as Email-Scroll down-You will see that Sender E-Mail Address -If you see  this field empty then  that means system has considered the default Sender email address  appearing in BC activity E-mail and fax settings.-Resolution-1.If you have maintained Sender email address in Output channel selection then that is given highest priority by the system.so follow below steps to check it.-Go to Application user management user work center-Go to output channel selection view-Choose respective output form-Click on Go-You can choose value for below criteria's to determine  the respective Sender email address(along with other fields like output channel)  that are  set up.-Company-Supplier-Purchasing Unit-Employee Responsible-Which ever criteria system finds first it will pick the respective Sender email address-also ensure you give * when you don't want to define any of the above and don't give  EQ(*).-2.As a standard behavior system uses Buyer responsible email address as Sender email address-3.Default sender address will be used if there is no document-specific sender address. Means if the buyer responsible does not maintain E-Mail address, then system will send the purchase orders from the default sender E-Mail address.-Note 1:The Sender email ID will be determined using above methods while creating the Purchase order, i.e for first Output sent only and will not be used for resubmission or changes made.- Note 2: If you copy any Purchase order to create new purchase order then sender email address is also copied  as no redetermination happens( however developers have added this to their back log and shall fix it in one of the future releases)-See Also-Help Document: Create Output Channel Selection Rule for Purchase Order- 3311821 - Why Purchase order Emails are sent to supplier though DKIM not maintained for any domain.-Keywords-wrong sender email, purchase order sender E-Mail, sender Email, default sender email

Title: Even Though Demand is More Than Supply, MRP is not Creating any Planning Proposal
Content: Symptom-For a product and planning area combination, the current demand is more than the available supply, but MRP is not creating and planning proposal. Also it is not showing any error/warning message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products View.-Show All Products By Selection and find Product ID XYZ (XYZ means the Product ID).-Highlight the Product and choose Open button.-Sales Order are visible in the Supply and Demand List and Demand is greater than receipts.-Now to run MRP, choose Run Planning > Multi BoM Level.-System is not creating Planning Proposal.-Cause-In the master data for this product you have maintained Demand Management Procedure as ADRF-All demand reduce forecast. In this procedure, only forecast will be considered as demand. No other demand like dependent demand or actual demand like sales order will be considered. In the Product Planning Details screen, you can also see that such demand will not be reflected in the projected stock.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue please change the correct Demand Management Procedure, you can select between four options:-ADRF - All demand reduce forecast-ATOS_CPC - All demand consumes current forecasts-ATOS_MPC - All demand consumes preceding forecasts-ATOS_SPC - All demand consumes adjacent forecasts-To change the Demand Management Procedure:-Go to the Product Data work center.-Select the Materials view.-Search for the relevant product.-Select the searched product and choose Edit button.-In the material screen, choose View All button.-Go to Planning tab. Here, select the appropriate Demand Management Procedure from the dropdown.-See Also-Keywords-no supply created for demand, MRP error, MRP not creating proposal for sales order, MRP not creating production order for demand

Title: How to Preview the Documents for Canceled/Finished Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-For canceled/finished purchase order, when try to preview the document, the preview button is inactive. Also, the button 'You can Also' is inactive and it is impossible to select the required output channel to print this document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select Canceled/Finished Purchase Order document.-Select Edit.-Preview button and the link You Can Also is inactive.-Cause-Once Purchase orders is canceled or finished, it is impossible to make any further changes. Thus, preview of changed Purchase order or canceled purchase order is also not possible. In this case, it is only possible to view the already generated output PDF, which can be seen under output history tab.-Resolution-Use Output History tab to preview the form document for Canceled/Finished Purchase Order.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant Canceled/Finished Purchase Order and select Edit.-Go to the Output History tab and select the Canceled/Finished Purchase Order.-Save the PDF or take a print out for the Canceled/Finished Purchase Order.-The link 'You Can Also' will be active only when purchase order is in status of  In Preparation/Sent. This link will be inactive when the purchase order status reach Canceled/Finished.-Please note that this is not applicable if the output history is in XML format.  For orders sent by XML format, please kindly use the Print button instead.-Keywords-preview of purchase order, output history of purchase order.

Title: New delivery for purchase order completely delivered /cancelled or Delivery tolerance is exceeded
Content: Symptom-The user is facing one of the scenarios below:-[Scenario 1] The Purchase Order has a defined Over-Delivery Tolerance in it. However, system is still allowing to receive more than the Over-Delivery Tolerance.-or-[Scenario 2] There is no Over-Delivery Tolerance maintained in the Purchase Order. Also the Order status is Finished and its Delivery status is Completely Delivered. However the system still allows to create a new delivery.-or-[Scenario 3] The user is able to create a Delivery that exceeds the quantity specified in the Purchase Order.-or-[Scenario 4] Purchase order is canceled but system allows the creation of Inbound Deliveries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Delivery work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID).-Click in Post Goods Receipt button.-Enter the Actual Quantity (greater than the Over-Delivery Tolerance limit). -Click in Save and Close button.-System allows to post the Goods and Services Receipt. -Cause-There is no hard restriction with errors during the creation of an Inbound Delivery. This happens because if a delivery is received physically, you receive all the goods; then you accept or reject the delivery. If rejected, the goods are sent back to the Supplier.-In both cases, accepted or rejected, the Goods Receipt, Goods Issue and Invoices must be in the system to complete the supply value chain.-The system may trigger the warning messages:-Actual quantity is exceeding the tolerance range.-Actual quantity exceeds open purchase order quantity for delivery item. Be aware that over delivery may be within tolerance range.-Reference order item canceled.-So this a flexible feature. The user decides whether to create the Delivery or not.-Resolution-The user can decide whether to:-Return the delivery if the Order is cancelled or the quantity is greater than expected;-Cancel the inbound delivery if the Order was cancelled by mistake. Then new Order and new Delivery would be created to allow the correct invoicing.-All items are proposed. Item with open Purchase order quantity greater than zero do not exist.-Note: In Inbound Logistics work center, Purchase Orders view, if the drop-down is selected as 'Due and overdue purchase orders' or 'Open purchase orders', the cancelled Orders will not be shown. However if the drop-down is selected as 'Purchase orders by party' or 'All purchase orders by selection', the cancelled Orders will be shown.-See Also-KBA: 2586335 - Error : Item Quantity Greater Than Open X of Purchase Order-KBA: 2581940 - Released Quantity Exceeds Target Quantity in Purchasing Contract-KBA: 2732939 - Purchase Order Available For Delivery After Supplier Return-Keywords-Purchase Order; Over-Delivery; Item; Inbound Delivery; Goods and Services Receipt; Supplier Invoice; Over-Delivered; Quantity; Greater Quantity; Delivery

Title: Not More than 2 Decimals Are Allowed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: -Duplicate to 2250861 - Is it Possible to Change the Default Decimal Notation for Currencies? and 1669826 - Multiple Decimal Places Needed for Maintaining Product Pricing in Purchase Orders-for example:you would like to enter price lists in which the euro amounts are displayed with more than 2 decimals.-When number of decimals exceeds the limit, error message 'Enter a value that matches the unit EUR and has a maximum of decimal places 2.' is raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Price Lists view.-Open any price list and go to the Items tab.--When entering a price that exceeds two decimal places, the following error message appears at the bottom of the screen:-'Enter a value that matches the unit EUR and has a maximum of decimal places 2.'-Cause-This restriction of the decimal places comes from ISO 4217 which is standard for the rounding and available decimal for each currency.-https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217-Resolution-You can use the fine-tuning activity Currencies to view all currencies available in your system and the decimals which will be displayed for this currency.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects.-Select your implementation project and press the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tuning step and search for the Currencies activity.-You cannot change the number of decimals displayed in the Display Decimal column for the predefined currencies-See Also-1669826 - Multiple Decimal Places Needed for Maintaining Product Pricing in Purchase Orders-Keywords-currency, decimals, decimals permitted, rounding, calculator, only 2 decimals permitted, Price List, more decimals

Title: Purchase Order Item Approval is not Triggered
Content: Symptom-A Purchase Order has been created and ordered. Then changes regarding the net amount Or quantity Or price Or account assignment has been performed-After the changes, an Approval task is expected but none is generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view. -Search for the relevant Order ID. -Select it and click in Edit button. -Navigate to Items tab. -Perform any change in quantity, price or account assignment in a line item. -Save it. -No approval process is triggered. -Cause-The approval process is not triggered after changes performed in Item level because (1) the Purchase Order approval process is not scoped or (2) the rules for Purchase Order in item level are not scoped. -Resolution-The steps to scoped the needed approval process are listed below;. -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project. -Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Questions tab by clicking Next.-Expand Purchasing.-Select Purchase Orders.-Select the question "Do you want to use an approval process for purchase orders at item level?". -Click Next and Finish to save it. -Note: the activity 'Purchase Order Item Level Approvals' must be added to the project. This is not done automatically when scoping is changed. Under this activity the sub-activity 'Define parameters for purchase order item approval' must be also configured for Approval Specification. Here more specific conditions can be configured, such as the quantity/price/account assignment changes.-Keywords-Purchase order item, item level, approval process, approval not working, task not generated, approval not triggered, item changes

Title: Purchase Order: Gross Price is Displayed Instead of Net Price for Item Description
Content: Symptom-You create a new purchase order and enter a price on item level. The column description for price entry is Gross Price. You expect the column description to be Net Price.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-2. Go to the Purchase Orders view and open the relevant purchase order.-3. Select the View All button and navigate to the Items tab.-4. The price input field is named Gross Price. You expect it to be Net Price.-Cause-This is the intended system behavior.-Resolution-There are two ways to look at gross and net price from a business perspective.-On the purchasing side:-- The Gross Price is the price with which you start the pricing procedure in purchasing.-- The Net Price is the price used which includes all discounts and surcharges, and the VAT (Sales and Use Tax,..) if the tax is not fully deductable.-On the invoicing side:-- the Net Price is the price of the invoice without the tax.-- the Gross Price is the price of the invoice including the tax.

Title: Unable to Delete a Service Line Item in a Released Project
Content: Symptom-You as a Project Manager, want to delete a Service line item in a released Project but the Delete button is disabled or-You are unable to assign a service to the employee in project since the Service field is not enabled or-You are unable to delete an assigned Service from project ,because the Delete button is grayed out or-You want to change the Team Member assigned to a Service in the Work tab of a Project but the Team Member and Service field is grayed out and data cannot be changed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management workcenter.-Select Projects view.-Select the Project (Status: Released).-Select Edit button and choose Project Plan option.-Go to Work sub-tab.-Select a line item (Service line item).-Delete button is disabled.-Cause-Actual work is not zero or  purchase orders exists or purchase requests exists-Resolution-You have to cancel the actual time confirmations and purchase requests  and purchase orders if any and then the Delete button will be enabled .-Keywords- unable to delete work package, unable to delete service

Title: Watermark "Test Copy" on Purchase Order Preview and Other Documents
Content: Symptom-You are doing a preview of the output of a document (for example, a purchase order) and it has a "Test Copy" watermark in it. You would like this watermark to be removed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The below is an example, the same is true for other views in both Business ByDesign as well as Cloud for Customer.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant purchase order and press the Edit button.-Select the Preview button.-The watermark Test Copy comes up.-Cause-It is a legal requirement that our templates contain the watermark "Test Copy" when you preview them, so this behavior will not be changed.-This is the expected behavior of Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer. The watermark will not be present in the actual output.-Resolution-Navigate to the Output History and click the document name of the output. This file does not contain the watermark.-This workaround is applicable if the output history is not in XML format. This workaround is also applicable to other Business Documents of SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose the Invoice Document view.-Select the relevant invoice then choose Edit.-Go to View All and navigate to the Output History tab.-Double-click the PDF form; you will see the watermark is not visible.-Keywords-Test Copy, watermark, output, PDF,  PDF Document, Customer Invoice, Sales Order, Sales Quote, sales document

Title: Enhancements to Home Work Center in 2411 Release of SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The default view of the Home work center is enhanced to provide a new look and improved functionality. You can now see the following additional tiles under the Self Service section for easier access to key information:-Time Recording-Expense Reports-Create Expense Reports-Shopping Carts-Leave Request-Create Leave Requests-This KBA also provides additional information-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-My Launchpad-Self Service-Cause-In the screen, you can find the new tiles which is a shortcut / quick access. These tiles are actually links of certain Self Service options which lie deep within the employee self services overview, and require multiple clicks to just open.-Resolution-These new tiles are by default enabled for all the Business Users in My Launchpad. These Tiles are shortcuts however the actual links are also there in Self Services Overview.-If you have a requirement to remove these tiles then below are the options-Option 1 - How to remove the tile for an individual Business User-Go to Home work center-Go to My Launchpad-Go to Self Service section-Start Personalization Mode-Here you can remove the individual time or disable the entire self service section itself-Save the changes-Stop the personalization-Option 2:-If your requirement is to remove these tiles for multiple users then this action is possible only if the Users are assigned to Business Role where you need to use "UI Switches".-1. Go to Application and User Management work center-2. Go to Business Roles view-3. Search and Edit the Business Role-4. Go to UI Switches tab-5. Add respective UI switch-Following UI switches will control both self-service in desktop and mobile launchpad -SS_EDITTIMESHEET_DISABLE-Disable Edit Time Sheet-Removes the Edit Time Sheet link from Self-Services Overview-Time Recording-SS_GOSHOPPING_DISABLE-Disable Go Shopping-Removes the Go Shopping link from Self-Services Overview-Create Shopping Cart-SS_NEWEXPENSEREPORT_DISABLE-Disable New Expense Report-Removes the New Expense Report link from Self-Services Overview-Create Expense Report-SS_NEWLEAVEREQ_DISABLE-Disable New Leave Request-Removes the New Leave Request link from Self-Services Overview-Create Leave Request-SS_TRACKMYEXPENSEREPORTS_DISABLE-Disable Track My Expense Reports-Removes the Track My Expense Reports link from Self-Services Overview-Expense Reports-SS_TRACKMYLEAVEREQ_DISABLE-Disable Track My Leave Requests-Removes the Track My Leave Requests link from Self-Services Overview-Leave Requests-SS_TRACKMYSHOPPINGCART_DISABLE-Disable Track My Shopping Carts-Removes the Track My Shopping Carts link from Self-Services Overview-Shopping Carts-Note: It is not possible to remove the Tile for the Business Users who do not have Business Role assigned. Also, removing this way will remove the Tile in My Launchpad and also the links in Self Services.-Option 3:-In case, Option 2 is not ideal for you where you want the link in Self Service but only the tile should be disabled then,-Either you can choose Option 1 or You can change the design to New Home Design by using the toggle button on top of the screen because these new tiles are enabled only in old home design.-Keywords-home design, toggle, tiles, shortcuts, home, design, launchpad, self services

Title: Triple Records in Standard Data Source HCMTLMU01
Content: Symptom-Data source HCMTLMU01 shows triple records for an employee although there is only one time entry in the time sheet of the issued employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the time sheet of the employee.-Create one time entry with start and end time.-Go to Business Analytics - Design Data Sources.-Preview data source HCMTLMU01.-Filter the employee.-Set the view as Start Time, End Time, Date, Employee and Record Time.-Three entries display.-Cause-This is the default system behavior. In data source HCMTLMU01, there are two predetermined entries displayed without recording any time entry. One is a valuation result time which shows the total time of recording. The other is a default value and the date from and to will be hire date to Unlimited (termination date) of the time profile.-Resolution-If it is no need to use the default records, filter the start time and end time as Not equal to (!=)  00:00:00. Then, these two records will be filtered, and only recorded times with start and end time maintained will be available.-Keywords-Triple Records, Data Source, HCMTLMU01, Timesheet Entry

Title: Data Source and Position of Fields in Outbound Files of Non-localized Payment Medium Format
Content: Symptom-The data source for certain fields in the outbound payment file needs to be identified in the file output.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Outbound Files sub view within the File Management view.-Find the relevant file and select Download File action button.-The data source for specific fields in this payment format needs to be identified.-Cause-Payment file formats can be customized, such as for specific banks or countries where a localized version of the solution is unavailable. The exact data source for certain fields in the file format needs to be identified.-To determine this, the corresponding payment medium format for the relevant outgoing bank transfer document ID must be identified. These formats are configured through Business Configuration, where the payment file structure assigned to the payment medium format can be edited. The content of offset, and positioning of the data source can be defined in the "Define Fields" tab.-Resolution-To figure out corresponding payment medium format of Document ID,-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show the All Payments and find relevant Payment.-In the Payment data, Payment Medium Format displayed is XXX(XXX represents the payment format ID).-To define the field data source and related settings,-Go to Business Configuration work center and find the activity Ougoing Bank Transfer.-Select the Assignment of Payment File Structures to the Payment Medium Formats and open it.-Find the corresponding file structure ID of payment format IDXXX .-Close the view to go back.-Click the Edit payment file structures and open the another view.-Find the corresponding File Structure ID and choose Edit.-In the New Payment File Structure view, navigate to step no.3 step Define Fields.-Here, select Add Row to define data source of a field name at bank.-For example, field content definition for country code can be set to return the 5th and 6th character of the Swift code.-Keywords-Data Source, Outbound files, Download, Position of fields, Payment Medium Format, Non-Localized.

Title: Automatic On-Account Allocation for Non-Self-Initiated Payments in Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You process a bank statements either uploaded by bank statement file or web service.-You notice that certain transactions will generate automatic on-account payments against business partner without any apparent clearing logic. -For example Incoming Bank Transfers will automatically post and credited against customer account. -Your expectation is that such transactions shall remain open for Postprocessing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Liquidity Management work center go to Bank Statement view.-Select the relevant posted bank statement transaction.-In the column Postprocessing, follow the link Not Required.-This will open on-account clearing, Clearing Status: Completed.-View View All and Document Flow you can access associated Payment Allocation from bank statement.-Alternatively you can find affected Payment Allocations in the Payment Management work center under Payment Allocation view. -Cause-What we see here is the designed and intended system behaviour for automatic clearing of non-self-initiated payments.-As opposed to self-initiated payments (for example Outgoing Bank Transfers from Payment Run) - the default assumption is that no existing transactions are to be confirmed. Rather a clearing of open documents (for example Customer Invoices) shall be achieved.-Those candidate documents typically are identified via a matching of references in document and payment references contained in the bank statement item. The vehicle to achieve such a matching is the setup of suited Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines. -In the absence fitting references in invoicing document and bank statement or non-effective Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines at least an on-account payment shall be achieved where possible. This payment can be later cleared in AR Accounting for example in the customer account monitor. -This is the accepted and expected system behavior in bank statement processing, facilitating a sufficient degree of automation based on generally applied business scenarios.-In such a scenario this means that if the business partner can be identified unambiguously an automatic on-account payment and payment clearing will result.-The business partner typically can identified in the statement transaction by identifiers as name or IBAN, if present. -Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-In case you have a particular requirement that involves no automatic clearing of candidate documents by employing Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines and to also prevent automatic on-account payments, you could consider blanking the Payment Method associated with relevant External Transaction Code, for example XYZ.-Business Configuration work center. -Select Automatically Generated Bank Statements activity. -Select Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Choose applicable Import Format.-Here External Transaction Code XYZ is linked with Payment Method 'Payment Processing - Of Incoming Bank Transfer'.-Outlined clearing definition is based on the character of processed bank statement transaction as non-self-initiated payment, for example Incoming Bank Transfer.-By keeping the Payment Method blank - bank statement transaction showing External Transaction Code XYZ will be interpreted as Other Incoming Payments. -As a result described clearing logic will not apply and associated payment allocations will remain open for processing. -See Also-KB0919061 - Automatic On-Account Clearing of Outgoing Direct Debit in Bank Statement

Title: Error "Exchange Rate for and for Rate Type does not exist for " in Purchase Proposals INTERNAL
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- INTERNAL ONLY -System did not generate Request ID for Multiple Purchase Proposals.- When Checked in the backend we could see multiple error messages.-SenderParty:ExternalProcurementTriggerAndResponse-RecieverInterfaceName:PurchaseRequestProcessingPurchasingIn-ErrorMessage:Exchange Rate for KLM and DEF for Rate Type N does not exist for Time Stamp-(where KLM & DEF refers to Exchange Rate)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control Work Center-Navigate to  Monitor Purchase Requests View-Select All Purchase Requests by Selection-We could see Purchase Request ID missing for multiple proposals-Cause-In our example the currency of the Purchase Proposal is KLM-Therefore the system will check the exchange rate between DEF and KLM.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Select Edit Exchange Rates.-The Exchange Rates maintained are DEF to some other exchange rates-There is no exchange rate maintained between DEF and KLM. The system therefore reports the error.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you need to maintain the exchange rate between DEF and KLM.-Keywords-Error Message "Exchange Rate for  and for Rate Type  does not exist for " shows up for Multiple Purchase Proposals in back end, There is no exchange rate maintained between DEF and KLM. The system therefore reports the error, ErrorMessage:Exchange Rate for KLM and DEF for Rate Type N does not exist for Time Stamp

Title: System Displays Incorrect Decimal Notation
Content: Symptom-You have observed in the numerical values across multiple documents that the system is displaying an incorrect decimal notation (for example, 12.345,00 instead of 12,345.00 or vice versa).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The notation depends on the personalization settings of each user.-Resolution-Open the Personalize menu by clicking the user icon at the top-right corner of the screen.-Go to My Settings.-Navigate to the Regional Settings tab.-From the Decimal Notation dropdown field, select the desired decimal notation.-Click Save or Save and Close.-Log off and then log back into the system so that the changes are reflected.-Please note: These changes are user specific, meaning all users will have to change it in their respective personalization settings to be able to see the required decimal notation.-Keywords-Decimal Notation, Incorrect, My Settings

Title: Error: "Depreciation method not valid" Occurs During Fixed Asset Migration
Content: Symptom-An error occurs while trying to migrate fixed assets.-Upon simulating the import, the system displays the following error message: Depreciation method <description>not valid for valuation view <valuation view> set of books <set of books>.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and open the activity list.-In the Integrate and Extend phase, open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select (or create) the migration unit for fixed asset migration and choose Execute Migration.-Select the Fixed Assets migration object (upload the file if not done yet) and choose Process File.-After executing the Import Simulate, the following error is displayed in the logs: Depreciation method <description>not valid for valuation view <valuation view> set of books <set of books>-Cause-The depreciation method is not assigned to the accounting principle of the relevant set of books.-Resolution-You need to map the depreciation method to the accounting principles relevant for the company via below steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and open the activity list.-Open the Depreciation Methods fine-tune activity.-Choose Edit depreciation methods.-Select the concerned depreciation method and go to the Assignment to Accounting Principles tab.-Add the concerned accounting principles and save the changes.-After that, the import simulation should be executed again in the migration tool.-Keywords-Migrate, Fixed Asset, Depreciation Method, Not valid, Valuation view.

Title: Error "At least one earlier open schedule line for an item missing" During Post Goods Issue INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY -Error occurs during creation of Outbound Delivery from Outbound Delivery Request KLM (where KLM refers to Outbound Delivery Request ID)-At least one earlier open schedule line for an item missing-Failed to create outbound delivery-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Delivery Proposals View-Search for Delivery Request ID KLM-Choose Post Goods Issue and following error occurs-At least one earlier open schedule line for an item missing-Failed to create outbound delivery-Cause-There is still an open qty example-> 0.0000000365 from the previous schedule line. (It refers to 0.0000000365 -> open quantity in decimal)-From the UI is shows open qty Zero, delivered quantity with some number.-However, in the database, this open quantity is some number. This is due to quantity conversion in warehouse confirmation.-Resolution-Forward this to AP-ODP-ODR with analysis to Development team with Customer permission to correct the inconsistency from backend.-Keywords-At least one earlier open schedule line for an item missing,  Failed to create outbound delivery, Outbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery Request

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash in Home Currency Account
Content: Symptom-A Foreign Currency Remeasurement (FCR) Run for Cash was executed, and it was observed that a G/L Account linked to a non-foreign bank account was revalued using a certain amount in a foreign currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Open the concerned run.-Navigate to the Remeasured Balances tab.-It can be noticed that one G/L Account balance has been remeasured, nevertheless such account would refer to a home currency account.-Cause-In this case, a payment in foreign currency have been created, which is still in the status Ready for Transfer or In Transfer. Therefore, the transaction needs to be remeasured.-Resolution-The payment will continue to be processed by the FCR run as long as it remains unconfirmed in a bank statement.-To resolve this, the payment must either be confirmed or reversed if remeasurement is not required.-To review the foreign postings to the G/L Account, use the G/L Account - Line items report for the relevant G/L Account and accounting periods, up to and including the period selected in the FCR run.-Ensure to include the "Balance in Transaction Currency" key figure in the report to check the foreign-currency postings.-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run For Cash, G/L Account, Non-foreign bank account.

Title: Modify the Accrual Method for a Large Amount of Sales Document Items
Content: Symptom-For a large number of sales document items, an accrual method XYZ (for example, 102 - Recognize using cost-to-cost POC) is assigned.-After reconsideration, it has been determined that the current accrual method is unsuitable, and a change to accrual method ABC (e.g., 101 - Reverse deferrals and accruals) should be implemented.-Due to the amount of affected transactions, conducting a manual and single modification of the accrual method for each and every sales document item is not feasible.-Note: XYZ and ABC refers to two different accrual methods.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Sales Document Items view.-Search for a relevant sales order item.-In the Accounting Data tab, the assigned Accrual Method is shown.-Via Reassign / Accrual Method option, a change for this sales order item can be effected.-Resolution-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Sales Document Items view.-Choose the Advanced Filter option.-Query for Accrual Method XYZ (for example, 102 - Recognize using cost-to-cost POC).-Select a sufficiently large volume of items (Multi-select: Mark one item, scroll-down, Shift+Select). For performance reasons, a large - however reasonable amount should be selected.-Activate the button Reassign and choose Accrual Method.-For the respective Set of Books ID choose the alternative Accrual Method ABC (for example, 101 - Reverse deferrals and accruals) and press OK.  -Keywords-Accrual Method, Change, Modify, Larger Amount, Sales Document Items.

Title: Error "Release quantity cannot be more than the total confirmed quantity" During Release of Partial Quantity in Customer Demand
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-During Release of Partial quantity XX (where XX is the quantity) in Customer Demand DEF(where DEF is the Customer Demand ID) the following error is triggered-Release quantity cannot be more than the total confirmed quantity-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center-Go to Customer Demand View-Search for Customer Demand DEF -Select Line item and click Partial Release-New window pops up  "Input parameters for Partial Release"-Now enter Partial Quantity-Select OK-Error appears-Release quantity cannot be more than the total confirmed quantity-Cause-Partial quantity xx to be released is greater than Requested quantity of Customer Demand DEF.-Resolution-Enter Partial Quantity which is lesser than or equal to Requested quantity to avoid the error.-Keywords-Release quantity cannot be more than the total confirmed quantity, Partial quantity  is greater than Requested quantity

Title: Report Upload Error due to Key Figure Settings
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a report into a different tenant and receive error messages:-'Active exception for key figure already exists' -'Upload failed; raise an incident to restore the original objects'-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator Workcenter-Go to Transport Management in Target system-Select the same request ID which is created in the Source system in which Report is selected as Transfer content-Double click on ID to open-Actions>Activate-Activation fails-You will get the error messages:-- Active exception for key figure ABC already exists (ABC stands for the key figure for which the exception is active in the source tenant).-- Upload Failed; Raise an incident to restore the original objects.-.-Cause-You have more than one active exception or condition on a key figure maintained which is used in the report you are trying to upload.-Resolution-Please open your report in the source tenant and check your key figure settings in the report. Only one exception or condition per key figure can be active during transport. The other exceptions and conditions must be set to inactive. Once you deactivated them please save your key figure changes to the report view. Now you can continue with your download and upload your report in the target tenant again.-Please note that in C4C the fields are called as below:-Exceptions and Conditions-In ByD they are called as follows:-Conditional Formatting and Value Filters-See Also-2616624 - Error Message 'Report Component ABC does not exist' or 'Key figure ABC does not exist' appears during Report Upload-Keywords-upload error; exception, condition, key figure, target, source, report upload

Title: Error "Source in inventory not valid for material and area " in Webservice ManageProductionLotsBundleMaintainRequest-INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-During execution of webservice ManageProductionLotsBundleMaintainRequest following error is encountered-Source in inventory not valid for material KLM and area DEF-(where KLM refers to Material ID and DEF refers to Logistics Area ID)-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to Backend-Execute Tcode MDRS-Select Inbound Service Interface II_MANAGE_PROD_LOT_IN-Execute Webservice Request XML-Error appears-An exception occurred-PAF framework error: An exception with the type CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in-An exception with the type CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-Source type \CLASS=CM_AP_LEX_VALIDATION_MAT_LOA is not compatible, for the purposes of assignment, with target type \CLASS=CM_AP- when we bypass the above error  we see below error- Error appears "Source in inventory not valid for material KLM and area DEF"Source in inventory not valid for material KLM and area DEF appears when executing webservices  ManageProductionLotsBundleMaintainRequest.-Cause-As there is no sufficient stock available in Logistics Area DEF this error is triggered.-Resolution- Request customer to maintain sufficient stock and retry the same XML, it will work properly.-Keywords- An exception with the type CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in, An exception with the type CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause, Source type \CLASS=CM_AP_LEX_VALIDATION_MAT_LOA is not compatible, for the purposes of assignment, with target type \CLASS=CM_AP, Source in inventory not valid for material, when executing webservices  ManageProductionLotsBundleMaintainRequest.

Title: Scoping Question Cannot Be Changed
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update your project scope, by adding or removing a specific question from scope. However, you are unable to select or deselect one or more scoping questions, because the checkbox is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Proceed to the Questions step.-Find the relevant question.-The checkbox is disabled.-Cause-There are three main reasons why it is not possible to edit a specific scoping question:-The status of the project is not Started - some questions and fine-tuning activities are not editable when the status of the project is different from Started (Merged, Activated, etc.);-The question is marked as Protected under tab Dependency - The elements marked as Protected cannot be removed from scope after the system has gone live;-There is a dependency of other elements on tab Dependency - Some elements can cause automatic selection or de-selection of other elements.-Resolution-For each of the causes mentioned above, find the respective solution below:-Project's scope is only editable when the status is Started. If this is not the case, please create a change project;-Protected questions become unchangeable after the project's go-live. They are designed this way to avoid inconsistencies;-Some elements may automatically cause the selection or deselection of others. Please check the elements mentioned in the Dependency tab and check for the possibility of selecting or deselecting them.-See Also-1922087 - How to Create a Change Project and Its Lifecycle-2584005 - Frequently Asked Questions on Business Configuration - Change Projects-Keywords-Scoping question, Cannot edit, Protected, Change Project, Activity, Dependency: The element is selected and protected,

Title: Warning Message: No further invoice expected for item
Content: Symptom-You have Manually Finished the invoicing process of line items in a Purchase Order and when you try to create Supplier Invoice for the item, you get warning message:-No further invoice expected for item X of order ABC-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Show All Purchase Orders and find the required Order ABC (ABC refer to the purchase order ID).-Select and Edit it-Go to View All and navigate to Items tab-Select line item X (X refer to the item ID) and go to Basic Data tab and there under Settings section-You can see Invoice Completed status as Manually Finished-Now when you go to Supplier invoicing Work center-Go to Invoice entry view-Show All Orders to Be Invoiced and find the Order ABC-Select the Purchase Order ID and choose New Invoice-Here you find that system still propose all the not invoiced quantity for the purchase order item X, but there is a warning message:-No further invoice expected for item X of order ABC-Cause-If you manually finish the invoicing process of a purchase order item, system will display the warning message.-Resolution-If you need to invoice the purchase order item, please follow below given steps:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Navigate to Purchase Orders view-Search the relevant purchase order, select it and choose the Edit button-Navigate to View All under Items tab-Select all line items one by one and choose option Resume and then choose Invoice-Click on Send Update/ Save button-You will now be able to create invoice against these line items without the warning message.-Keywords-Invoice Completed status is Manually Finished,Unable to Create Supplier Invoice, No further invoice expected for item

Title: Incorrect Employee Assignment in Organizational Unit
Content: Symptom-Employee of the Organization unit ABC is incorrectly displayed with assignment unit XYZ in the Personnel Administration Employee view.-(Here ABC and XYZ refers to org units)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel administration work center-Search for the employee -The Reporting line unit under Organizational Assignment is displayed wrong Org unit-Cause-The Org unit ABC is not assigned as a Reporting Line Unit.---Resolution-The organizational unit must be a Reporting Line unit in order to be displayed correctly.--In order to make the changes follow the below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Org Structures view.-Locate the respective org unit and set proper Effective From date and select the Edit button.-In the below Definitions tab, make sure Reporting Line Unit is checked.-Select the Save button and Activate the change.-Keywords-Personnel Administration, Employee Assignment, Organizational Unit, Reporting Line Unit, Organizational Management
