Title: Process Communication Error "Working times for planning area calendar not found" in Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-During creation of Inbound Delivery Notification from a Purchase Order you notice that the Purchase Order is missing in the Inbound Logistics Purchase Orders view.-Also in the Document Flow of the Purchase Order there is a process communication error with the message:-Purchase Order DEF cannot create a Purchase Order Logistics Details (DEF refers to the Purchase Order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Find and select the Purchase Order DEF-Click Edit and then View All-Go to the Document Flow tab-You will notice  Process Communication Error in Purchase Order.-Click on the error icon you see the message: "Purchase Order DEF cannot create a Purchase Order Logistics Details"-When you go to the:-Application and User Management work center.-Process Communication errors view.-And select Open Errors with Incidents:-You can see the error as "Working times for planning area calendar not found"  for Sending Document "Purchase Order" and Receiving Document as "Purchase Order Logistics Details"-and also upon checking in SRT_MONI, you see the messages shown below:-Sender: PurchaseOrderProcessing.-Receiver: ExternalProcurementTriggerAndResponseOrderingNotificationIn.-Error Information: Error message must be a subclass of CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOTCM_EPPO to task.-Cause-The error occurs, because the Resource calendar was not properly maintained.-Resolution-Log in to Customer back-end system and execute the report  AP_FO_RES_CAPA_SCHE_CAL if it is a customer test system.-Execute T-code SE38.-Now select as Report name AP_FO_RES_CAPA_SCHE_CAL.-Execute the Report.-After executing the report, please try to restart the stuck message.-Message should go through.-Note: If Customer has reported the same issue from their production system, please try to restart the stuck messages. However, if the messages are still not processed successfully, kindly request customer's written permission and then proceed with the steps mentioned above once you have the permission.-Keywords-Working times for planning area calendar not found, Purchase Order cannot create a Purchase Order Logistics Details, CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOTCM_EPPO

Title: Extension Field Names are not Displayed Completely
Content: Symptom-You have created extension field in system and after adding that field to data source/report, you are not able to see the whole text. Field name length is getting truncated.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create extension field in system.-Add that field in any of the data source/report.-Now open that data source/report from Business Analytics work center.-Add that field in data source/report view and you will notice that whole text is not displayed. Text is getting truncated.-Cause-At report/data source level, we support up to 80 characters for characteristic names and 60 characters for key figure names.-This is applicable for extension fields as well.-Resolution-This is working as expected.-See Also-  2801953 - Business Object message is truncated to 255 characters-Keywords-Characteristic Name, Key Figure Name, Length, Report, Data Source, Truncate, Extension Field, Not Displayed Completely-report,extension field,data source,truncate,characteristic name,key figure name

Title: ESI - Operation "<operation name>{<namespace>}" not supported (interface: "<interface name>" errors in SRT_UTIL
Content: Symptom-In Web Service utilities error log (SRT_UTIL transaction) the following error is displayed for a Web Service Consumer:-Operation "<operation name>{<namespace>}" not supported (interface: "<interface name>".-Environment-ABAP Web Services-SAP NetWeaver-SAP NetWeaver Application Server for SAP S/4HANA-ABAP PLATFORM - Application Server ABAP-Reproducing the Issue-The error occurs during the standard use of applications which call a Web Service Consumer in the background. -Call the affected Consumer proxy with an invalid operation.-Cause-The Web Service Consumer design time object has been changed, and the current logical port configuration does not reflect these changes. As a result the application calls the consumer with an operation which does not conform to the configuration of the Web Service runtime.-To verify: observe the <operation name> in SRT_UTIL Error log.-Open transaction SOAMANAGER,-Select the Web Service Configuration menu point,-Search for the affected Consumer Proxy,-Display the Logical Port configuration of the proxy,-Navigate to the Operation Settings tab,-Check the listed operations of the logical port.-The listed operations in the logical port configuration and the mentioned <operation name> in the error log do not match.-Resolution-On-premise:-A new logical port needs to be configured in SOAMANAGER for the affected Web Service Consumer. To configure a new logical port, see the KBA 2033184 - ESI - How to create Logical Port manually for a Service Consumer in SOAMANAGER [Video],-As the last step, delete the previous, invalid logical port. Then set the newly created one as Default (if only one logical port is used in the scenario).-Business ByDesign:-Deactivate and reactivate the corresponding Communication Scenario.-See Also-SAP Help Portal - Communication Scenarios-SAP Help Portal - ABAP Connectivity - Web Services ABAP-SAP Help Portal - ABAP Web Services-SAP Help Portal - Set Up SOAP Web Services in SAP Business ByDesign-2818078 - ESI - Error: "Message "<&1>{&2}" not supported" in transaction SRT_UTIL or SRT_LOG-Keywords-Webservice, Web Service, Webservices, Web Services, ESI, ESI_GDPR, ESI_STD, Business ByDesign, ByDesign, Consumer proxy, Web Service consumer, consumer, logical port, configuration, SOAMANAGER, operation, settings, operation settings, Communication Scenario, proxy, operation not supported, namespace, interface,

Title: Cancellation Supplier Invoice Error Message: Posting date dd.mm.yyyy must be after last retrmt date dd.mm.yyyy of fixed asset "
Content: Symptom-A supplier invoice is posted to a fixed asset of type Asset Under Construction (AUC).-Later, to reduce the AUCs value, the supplier invoice is canceled.-The cancellation invoice appears as unposted source document with error message "Posting date dd.mm.yyyy must be after last retrmt date DD.MM.YYYY of fixed asset -XX-0" (XX-0 represents an AUC ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Select Source Documents subview.-Select the Supplier Invoice XYZ (XYZ stands for the cancellation invoice and has same posting date as the original invoice).-There is the error message:-'Posting date dd.mm.yyyy must be after last retrmt date dd.mm.yyyy of fixed asset -XX-0'.-Select Actions > Post Business Transaction.-Select Post to Another Period.-Enter in the Alternate Posting Date field, a date after dd.mm.yyyy.-Select OK.-Error message: 'Reversal not possible; posting date must be in fiscal year yyyy'.-Cause-The functionality compares the value date of the accounting document with the last retirement date of the fixed asset.-The value date is in this case the original supplier invoice's posting date; This value date cannot be changed. -Resolution-As the related fixed asset an Asset Under Construction, the reduction/cancellation posting can be done by directly reducing the acquisition cost of the asset using the Manual Postings functionality:-Access fixed asset XX, select Manual Posting > Acquisition.-Choose either the Current or Previous year where you want to reduce or cancel the value.-Select the Credit posting.-In the field Transaction Currency Amount, input the amount by which you want to reduce or cancel the fixed asset.-Under Offsetting Account Assignment, fill in the data as per your business requirement.-Select Simulate to confirm everything is correct and there is no error.-Post the transaction.-After successful posting of the transaction, the unposted Supplier Invoice can be marked as irrelevant by support.-Note: This also applies to an unposted Goods and Service Receipt.-See Also-3169646 - Cancellation Document With Error "Posting Date XX/XX/XXXX Must be After Last Retrmt Date YY/YY/YYYY of Fixed Asset ABC"-2016865 - 'Posting date 00.00.0000 must not be before last retrmt date 99.99.9999 of fixed asset ABC' Error in Partial Transfer of Individual Material-Keywords-Supplier invoice, GSR, cancellation, Asset Under Construction, Posting date must be after last retrmt date

Title: Error Message "Output request could not be executed; request is out of date"
Content: Symptom-While sending customer invoices, getting below error message:-Output request could not be executed; request is out of date-Choose Details, message shows: -Contact your key user to investigate this error. When the error has been solved your key user should inform you so that you can retry outputing the document.-/DOC/OM_ERR024-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Navigate to the Invoice Documents view.-Select any Invoice and Edit it.-Navigate to the Output History tab, Status as Error.-Click Error hyperlink, it says: "Output request could not be executed; request is out of date".-Cause-The error message '/DOC/OM_ERR024' seems bgRFC delay time is exceeded when processing the DOR Output.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior for the error message '/DOC/OM_ERR024'.-In this case, Output Request must not be executed. Use the retry option for the invoice document so that the Output Request will be re-triggered. If this is no other issue, the output status will change to successful.-Keywords-Output request could not be executed; request is out of date, /DOC/OM_ERR024, Contact your key user to investigate this error. When the error has been solved your key user should inform you so that you can retry outputing the document.

Title: Backend Dump Occurs During Any Action in the UI due to PDI Involvement.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-* ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** * -User will get a dump or a backend exception while they perform any action from the frontend UI, due to PDI involvement.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to frontend UI.-Navigate to the relevant work center views.-Perform the step.-Dump occurs.-Cause-To confirm the cause, follow the below steps:-Login to backend.-Open the ST22 transaction.-Navigate to the Application Information section.-You can see the Info message: Binding of UI data field (path) failed: ESR field= (Field name) (ESR namespace=(solution namespace)) unknown on proxy node=(node name) in proxy BO=(BO name.-If the above mentioned information is there in the dump details then the cause is that customer has deleted PDI extension field which is being still referenced with one of there UI component and the field details can be seen in above ESR field.-Resolution-The customer has to adjust the configurations and do the required changes in order to deleted field, so that it is not being referenced in any of the UI component.-See Also-2732671 - Backend Dump Occurs During Any Action in the UI due to PDI Involvement-Keywords-Dump in UI, Binding of UI data field, Application dump

Title: Time Cancellation Requires Approval from Manager
Content: Symptom-When working with time types that require approval, the cancellation of times that are already active require approval. However it is required that time cancellations do not require approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Currently, it is not possible to setup a time type that requires approval only for the creation of the time entries, but not for the cancellation.-Once a time is set to require approval, the approval is also required to cancel the time entry.-Keywords-TLM, time account, leave, self-service, time sheet

Title: Resource Calendar Report: Displaying Gross Capacity for All Employees
Content: Symptom-The "Resource Calendar" report only shows the gross capacity for employees with planned work in future periods, for example year 2025, whereas the expectation is for it to display the gross capacity for all employees, regardless of planned work.-Is it feasible to extend the Resource Calendar report to display gross capacity as seen in the "Forecasted Utilization – My Area" report without considering the planned work?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Resource Management workcenter-Proceed to the Resource Profile view-Search for an employee ID, for example, ABC (Here ABC refers to an employee ID)-Select Show Availability.-Observe that the gross capacity is displayed until 2025 for example for this employee and not beyond.-Cause-There is planned work beyond a year, as a project is assigned until say for example, December 30, 2025. This is why the gross capacity for this employee is extending beyond one year.-Resolution-The gross capacity shows one year from today, which is the standard behavior based on the current design of the ByDesign system. If period is selected longer than one year, a warning message appears stating, “Resource Availability is not computed beyond a year from today.”-It is not possible to extend the data source of the Resource Calendar report to display gross capacity as seen in the "Forecasted Utilization – My Area" report without considering the planned work.-As a recommendation, consider submitting this as an enhancement idea on the Influence platform. Access the Influence forum via the link: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 -Keywords-Resource Calendar, Gross Capacity, Planned Work, Future Period, Report, Employee, Management Decisions, Enhancement Idea, Influence Platform.

Title: Project Expenses Posting Against Project Task Instead of Cost Center
Content: Symptom-When posting expense entries to a project task, the system is posting to the project task instead of the cost center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for project ID: AAA (AAA represents the project ID).-Project type: grant funded.-Under Products - Purchase Orders path, can see purchase order BBB (BBB represents the purchase order ID) , and if go to document flow, can see supplier invoice Journal Entry: CCC (CCC represents the journal entry ID). -CCC is posted to project task instead of cost center.-Cause-Projects can collect costs and revenue as part of the business but posting to cost center or project task differs based on Business Process Variant of Project type (BPVT).-Customer has Externally Funded Project for reported project for public sector company.-Project is considered as cost object, hence it can post the journals against the project task instead of cost center except for overhead cost project (Cost Collecting Project). In overhead cost project all the cost are transferred from project task to cost center though settlement transaction as soon as transaction is created.-Resolution-Project costs are only accounted to a cost center when the cost center is the primary cost object (Overhead Cost).--If need to charge direct cost project expenses to cost centers, Overhead Distribution function for projects can be used.--Create a distribution rule for a project task and allocate all the accumulated costs to the cost center/s based on business needs.-Keywords-public sector, project task, project task, cost center

Title: Customer Invoice Splits Due to the Inconsistency on Buyer Tax Number
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*****INTERNAL USE ONLY******-When invoicing the outbound invoice request ABC, system splits the invoices into 2 documents, and you do not find any reason from Split Analysis function.-ABC represents the ID of the invoice request.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Requests work center view.-Search for outbound delivery invoice request ABC and press Invoice button.-The system has split into two invoices. -Select both new proposed invoices and click Split Analysis, no reason is provided.-Cause-The outbound delivery invoice request ABC contains lines from different sales orders, sales order line DDD -10 and sales order line EEE -10.-As per the master KBA 1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing, check the split criteria one by one and find the inconsistency on buyer tax number on reference sales order lines. -Open the sales order invoice request DDD.-In Items tab, select line 10, the Customer's Tax Registration is filled. -Open the sales order invoice request EEE.-In Items tab, the line 10 does not contain the Customer's Tax Registration information.-Due to the different values on reference sales order invoice request, the lines are split.-Further check the invoice request EEE, you find the Customer's Tax Registration is actually filled in the sales order EEE. The value was not copied properly when the sales order invoice request created.-Resolution-You can run the report: APCRM_TRIGGER_RECON_OB, to create new message from sales order to invoice request, to synchronize the value again. -Access to backend.-enter SE38 transaction.-in Program, enter the report ID "APCRM_TRIGGER_RECON_OB". -Click Execute button.-In the ID field, enter the sales order ID you want to do the reconcile. In this case, it is EEE.-in Base Business Transaction Document Type, select Sales Order.-In Service Interface Operation, select Request Invoicing.-Click Execute. -System creates a new XI message sent from SalesOrderProcessing to CustomerInvoiceProcessingRequestInvoicingIn, containing the up-to-date information. -The Customer's Tax Registration information is then filled in the sales order invoice request EEE.

Title: Error : "Pending System Requests for Projects Found." During the Merge of a Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-During the merging of a project, an error message is encountered: "Pending system requests for projects found."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview.-Select Open Activity List-Search for the project and open.-Select Start Merge.-Cause-The issue is caused by an internal inconsistency with the deleted Business Configuration Sets in the System.-Resolution-The following steps to clean up deleted files in XREP should be followed by the Business Configuration Development team.-Open table APXR_AHEADER and provide 2 filepaths in field "FilePath" and execute to display results.-Note that there will be 2 entries for each BC Set one with Deleted 'X' and another with Deleted ' '.-Go to edit mode of the table in debug mode and mark the entries having has_content 'X' as has_content ' ' & DELETED 'X'.-Now open another table 'OSLSXR_HEADER_S' and provide the both the filepaths in field 'FILEPATH'. Note that you will get 2 entries (1 for each BC Set). Both will have HAS_CONTENT 'X' and DELETED ' ' . Now mark those 2 entries as HAS_CONTENT ' ' and DELETED 'X' by going into edit in debug mode.-Keywords-Project merging, pending system requests, internal inconsistency, Pending System Requests for Projects Found.

Title: Employee Overview in Personnel Administration Shows Incorrect Manager
Content: Symptom-The system is displaying the incorrect Manager for an Employee in the Personnel Administration, Employee Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employee view.-Search for the employees XYZ.-Incorrect manager is displayed in the Employee overview.-Edit the employee, the correct manager is displayed.-Cause-The issue could be due to a collision in the validity dates of the manager for the Organization Unit.-For example:-The old manager is valid from 01.10.2023 to 10.01.2024, while the new manager is valid from 01.01.2024.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to resolve the issue:-Check the validity dates of the managers for the Organization Unit.-Correct the dates if needed, to avoid any collision.-Keywords-Personnel Administration, Employee Overview, Incorrect Manager, Validity Dates, Human Resource Organization Unit, Manager Collision.

Title: Production Lots - Line Items Report is not Displaying the Production Lot ID
Content: Symptom--Production lot ID is not displaying in the Production Lots - Line Items Report  and shows as #. System shows below error message while navigating from #.-Error Code: -No data read from the Master Data MDAV SCM_PROD_LOT for simple OB-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to the Reports > List View.-Select Production Lots - Line Items Report.-Enter the required details.-Click on Apply.-Go to Production Lot column -> Set Filter and Select #>Right click on #-> Click on Go to -> View Production Lot.-System shows error details:-Error Code: -No data read from the Master Data MDAV SCM_PROD_LOT for simple OB-Cause-The error is due to the Production Lot Status is "Started", so not in Finished stage. You can check the Production lot and there are some tasks are "In Process" status.-To Find the Production Lot in the report:-Open Production Lots - Line Items Report.-Enter the required details.-Click on Apply.-Go to Production Lot column -> Set Filter and Select #-Go to Journal Entry Column -> Click on Go to -> View Journal Entry -Select the G/L accounts in the Line items and Scroll down to view the Production Lot id.-Click on Production lot id to navigate to Production Lot Overview.-Go to the Confirmations tab.- Production Lot Status is in "Started" status and check the relevant task in the Production Confirmations as well.-Resolution-It is necessary to complete all in process tasks in Production Confirmations to view the Production lot details in the Production Lots - Line Items Report.- Keywords-Production Lots - Line Items Report, Production Lots id shows #, No data read from the Master Data MDAV SCM_PROD_LOT for simple OB

Title: Error - "No summary layout defined for tax return type WHT_PH" - for Philippines Localization, while doing Withholding Tax Return Run
Content: Symptom-  A custom solution was developed and mapped with the Tax Return Type Y00000000 - WHT_PH, intended for Philippine Tax localization.-An error occurs when attempting to perform the Withholding Tax Return Run.-Error message: No summary layout defined for tax return type WHT_PH.-Y00000000 refers to Custom Solution ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to Withholding Tax return runs sub view.-Search for the Run AAA.-Select the Application log BBB and go to Message Tab. -Error Message: No summary layout defined for tax return type WHT_PH -'AAA' refers to Withholding Tax return run.-'BBB' refers to Application log ID.-Cause-The above-mentioned error occurs due to two reasons. To check that, -In the Solution Explorer, right-click on your solution name Y00000000.-Select the Business Configuration node and select Business Configuration Set Y00000000_WTAXDECPROF.-Once the Business Configuration Set opens, this profile will take to the node ID: A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_GRPTYP field.-Case: 1-Ideally configuration of Tax Event node and the Summary Layout sub node is not required for withholding tax. In this case Node Group Criteria for Sub Totaling, the Summary Required is marked-Case: 2-In the node ID A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_GRPTYP field Regular tax items relevance Indicator should be mandatory selected in order to create the tax return.-Resolution-As this is related to Withholding Tax, try to follow the below mentioned steps.-Need to remove the field by unmarking the Summary Required in Node Group Criteria for Sub Totaling.-Ensure that Regular Tax Items Relevance Indicator is selected.-After doing the above-mentioned settings, try to do the Withholding Tax Return Run again and there won't be any errors.-Please note: As per the localization toolkit document, Summary tax declaration is not supported for Withholding Tax in PDI.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return Run, Node Group Criteria for Sub Totaling, Summary Required, Philippines Localization, PDI.

Title: Differences of Tax Amount occurred between Customer Invoice and Report - G/L Accounts Line items - South Korea
Content: Symptom-The Tax Amount that appears on the Customer Invoice ABC and the Report - G/L Accounts Line items are different.-While checking the Report: G/L Accounts Line items, the value difference is impacting both Debit Amount Company Currency and Balance Amount Company Currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Reports sub view.-Search for the Report - G/L Accounts Line items.-Give the inputs on mandatory Data Selection as; Company, set of books, Accounting Period/Year, Journal Entry, posting date, Display Currency - Conversion date-Run the report.-See the result in Debit Amount Company Currency, which is 100.199 KRW,-Check in the Customer invoice 'ABC', there the Tax amount is 100.200 KRW. ('ABC' refers to Customer Invoice ID)-The differences occur with 1 KRW.- Cause-Usually, these differences in amount occurs due to exchange rate.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice documents sub view.-Search for the Customer Invoice 'ABC'-Navigate to the Document Flow.-Find the respective Clearing ID with the Journal Entry.-Under relevant Journal Entry check the G/L accounts line items.-Note: The value provided below are just for the example calculations.-G/L account Line Item 1 - 50.045 KRW-G/L account Line Item 2 - 50.154 KRW-Summation of the values --> 50.045 + 50.154 = 100.199 KRW-Tax Exchange Rate: 1-Resolution-According to the summation of the values in the G/L accounts Line items 1 & 2, the system behaving as expected.-The Tax Exchange Rate is 1, and based on the calculation, the amount of 100.199 KRW is generated in the report G/L Accounts - Line items.-The Clearing with Tax Exchange Rate was updated after the Customer Invoice 'ABC' was posted. While trying to run report G/L Accounts - Line items, the Debit Amount Company Currency and Balance Amount Company Currency correctly reflect the applied Tax Exchange Rate value.-Keywords-Tax Exchange Rate, Report - G/L Accounts Line items, Debit Amount Company Currency, Balance Amount Company Currency, South Korea

Title: Error - "There are not enough rows in the Currency Code list table. Please add a line" occurred while creating the new Tax Entry from Microsoft Excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to create a new Tax Entry from Microsoft Excel system throws error message as mentioned below.-"An error occurred while exporting the file:-Error ID: AP_UI_OIN 043.-Error text: There are not enough rows in the Currency Code list table. Please add a line."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Go to VAT Entries View.-Click new Tax Entry from Microsoft excel, then you see below errors,-"An error occurred while exporting the file:-Error ID: AP_UI_OIN 043.-Error text: There are not enough rows in the Currency Code list table. Please add a line."-Cause-As a next process try to check whether the version of the template is old one or the latest by following the below steps.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view.-Search template name 'Manual Tax Entries Upload' in the table.-Find the template and click Versions.-Select the version with status Active and see that it is the latest version of the template.-It is a known issue. Application developers are requested to keep as many buffer rows as possible to accommodate code list enhancements from customers. And as a workaround customer have to save the Excel, which we gave them for future use in "Application and User Management work center -> Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view".-Resolution-Follow steps below to retrieve the template from backend for the Tax Entries.-In the backend go to transaction SE24.-In Object type insert: CL_OIN_OFFICE2007_UTIL-Select Display. -Do a double click in POPULATE_CODE_LIST_TABLES.-In Ln 175, set the External Breakpoint.-Go to the frontend and download the List Price from Excel (This will trigger debug screen in the backend).-Navigate to Standard tab.-In ln 175, double click in lt_code_desc.-In ln 176, double click on lv_row_index.-In ln 176, double click on lv_end_row_int.-If sum of LT_CODE_DESC and LV_ROW_INDEX is more than value of LV_END_ROW_INT, then we need to increase the value of LV_END_ROW_INT to a number that is greater than the summed value. [In this example, LT_CODE_DESC is 71 and LV_ROW_INDEX is 247. Its sum is 318, hence LV_END_ROW_INT needs to be greater than 318.]-Select the Edit button.-Change the value for a greater one. -Select Enter.-Give F8.-Give Save.-Keep pressing F8 until the debug screen is gone.-Excel will be downloaded.-Add the Excel in customer case’s Attachments.-Now customer can use the template.-See Also-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3236461"-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/1907729"-Keywords-File Export, Tax Entry, Microsoft Excel, Currency Code list table, Manual Tax Entries Upload, Versions.

Title: The Journal Report Displays All Journal Entries Based on a Calendar Year
Content: Symptom-Fiscal year is not equal to calendar year. The expectation is that the Journal report to display journal entries according to the fiscal year entered in the selection, but the postings displayed in the report are based on the calendar year.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics - Design Reports.-Sear and Open report: Journal.-Select 'Posting Date: Current Year to Date'.-See that all the postings in the current calendar year are displayed in the report.-Resolution-This is the current report design. If select 'Posting Date: Current Year to Date', the report will display all the postings in the current calendar year.-Keywords-Journal, Report, Fiscal Year Variant, Current Year to Date,

Title: Customer's Tax Registration Number Missing in Sales Order

Title: Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY not Getting Posted Due to the Process Communication Error: Please See Application Info Section in the Dump for More Details
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX with the following message error,-Cannot process Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX because Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY not yet posted in accounting. As Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX contains a reference to Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY but Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX. Check why Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY has not been posted.-XXX refers to Goods and Activity Confirmation ID.-YYY refers to Point-of-Sale Transaction ID.-(This KBA is applicable when POS is created from Webservice)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Source Documents sub view.-Filter it with Unposted Source Documents.-Search for the document Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX.-The document is unposted with the following error message,-Cannot process Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX because Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY not yet posted in accounting. As Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX contains a reference to Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY but Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Goods and Activity Confirmation XXX. Check why Point-of-Sale Transaction YYY has not been posted.-Cause-Firstly, check the reason, why Point-of-Sale-Transaction is not getting posted.-Login to the Backend.-Go to Transaction code: SE38-In Program field give: FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI-Press Execute.-In field Operational Document type, give 903 - Point-of-Sale Transaction-In field Operational Document ID, give Point-of-Sale Transaction document ID: 'YYY'-Keep the Display Options set on XI messages. (Note the XI Message ID)-Execute again-The error message will be displayed.-Error Details:-Sender: PointOfSaleTransactionProcessing-Receiver: AccountingFinancialsNotificationIn-Error: Please see Application Info section in the dump for more details.-Check this similar dump under the Transaction code: ST22-Dump Details:-Application Information-    1 Triggering application component: AP-ACC-AN-Active Calls/Events-   36 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003    6-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-   35 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001    2-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-   34 METHOD       CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CP    CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CM009   10-      CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX=>CHECK_TXJCD_COMPONENT-   33 METHOD       CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CP    CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CM008    6-      CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX=>CHECK_TAX_CALCULATION_RESULT-   32 METHOD       CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CP    CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CM004   11-      CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX=>CALC_TAX_ONE_FINNOTIF_TAX_ITEM-   31 METHOD       CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CP    CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CM00C    6-      CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX=>CALCUL_AND_AGGR_NON_SIMPL_TAX-   30 METHOD       CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CP    CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX==CM001   21-      CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX=>CREATE_ACCNOTIF_TAX_FINNOTIF-  Check the Tax details via below steps.- Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.- Go to the Sales Transactions sub view.- Search for the Document; 'YYY'.- Go to Tax Item tab.-There is Country/Region PQR will be visible. (Here PQR refers Country's name)-To check the relevant Payload,-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Web Service Message Monitoring sub view.-Give the Message ID (give the failed XI Message ID, which you have noted).-Payload details will be visible.-Press Ctrl+ F, give: TaxItem.(It will navigate to below mentioned details).-<RetailTransactionProductTaxItem>-        <ExternalID>1</ExternalID>-        <TaxCountryCode>VE</TaxCountryCode>-        <ProductTaxationCharacteristicsCode>310</ProductTaxationCharacteristicsCode>-        <TaxJurisdictionCode>0</TaxJurisdictionCode>-The Tax Jurisdiction Code should not have any value for country PQR. But above mentioned XI message payload (from POS to Accounting) is having Tax Jurisdiction Code value 0. Hence system is raising dump from accounting side.-Resolution-It is advised to leave the Tax Jurisdiction Code field blank when creating a Point-of-Sale transaction for country 'PQR'.-Once the value in the payload is corrected, the incident should be sent back to Support to restart the failed XI message for the Point-of-Sale transaction from the backend, ensuring it is posted successfully.-See Also-KBA - " 2377340 - How to Check for XI Messages in the Backend with SE38 and FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI "-Keywords-Goods and Activity Confirmation, Point-of-Sale Transaction, Payload, Dump, CL_FIA_FINNOTIF_ACCNOTIF_TAX=>CHECK_TXJCD_COMPONENT, TaxJurisdictionCode, PointOfSaleTransactionProcessing, AccountingFinancialsNotificationIn, Country Venezuela (VE).

Title: The Process Communication Error "Existing unit of measure and received unit of measure differ" is Displayed for a Sales Order Document.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The Process Communication Error "Existing unit of measure and received unit of measure differ" occurs for the Sales Order ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Order.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Process Communication Error is displayed for the Sales Order.-Cause-The Process Communication Error "Existing unit of measure and received unit of measure differ" was already corrected by the development team in the Release 2305, and should not occur for future Sales Order documents.-However for the Sales Orders created before May 2023, a manual backend correction will be required to be performed in order to properly deliver the Process Communication Error through a backend. -The Process Communication Error should have the similar details:-Sender: CustomerProjectInvoicePreparation-Receiver: SalesOrderProcessingRequestCustomerProjectInvoicingIn-Error Information: Existing unit of measure and received unit of measure differ-Resolution-In this case, it is required to forward the case to the development team with the analysis of the scenario and request the manual backend correction to be performed.-See Also-JIRA: BYDDEV-6908 -  Unit of measure mismatch for project based items-Keywords-existing unit of measure and received unit of measure differ, sales order, document flow, unit of measure

Title: Incorrect Field Mapping in Mass Data Processing
Content: Symptom-During mass data processing, an issue is being observed in the export of supplier data.-The certain field values are not being written into the correct field. Instead, these values are being written into a different field. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select the option to export supplier data.-Choose Go and export the CSV file.-Observe that few values are displayed in different column.-Cause-Special characters like comma, question mark, period etc. may have been used in the filed.-As the system identifies some of these characters as separators in a filed, this might cause the file to "break" into a wrong format, which leads to the mentioned technical exception.-Or, for example, quotes are maintained as text qualifier during upload and quotes are also used in the file data  (for example in description fields). But the text qualifier which is selected during the upload cannot be part of the data being imported.-Resolution-Review the file for values in incorrect formatting and correct the file.-Keywords-Mass Data Processing, Supplier Export, Incorrect Field Mapping, CSV Export

Title: The Process Communication Error "Item XX: Sum of dates' amounts exceeds the item's amount" is Displayed for a Contract
Content: Symptom-The Process Communication Error "Item XX: Sum of dates' amounts exceeds the item's amount" occurs for a Contract Document.-(Where XX represents the Line Item Number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Contracts View.-Filter for All Contracts.-Search for the Contract ABC (where ABC represents the Contract ID).-Open, Select View All.-Go the Document Flow tab.-The Process Communication Error "Item XX: Sum of dates' amounts exceeds the item's amount" is displayed for the Contract Document.-Cause-The Process Communication Error has been generated for the Contract ABC because the Total Percentage maintained for the Invoice Schedules Date of the Item XX exceeds 100%.-The Total Percentage of a Invoice Schedules Dates should not exceed 100%. In case Total Percentage exceeds 100% the system will detect that the Total Amount of the Invoice Schedules Dates for the Item differs from the Total Price Component Value of the Item.-This can be checked through the following steps:-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Contracts View.-Search for the Contract ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Go the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoice Schedule sub tab.-Select the Pricing sub tab.-The Total Amount of the Invoice Schedules Dates for the Item XX differs from the Total Price Component Value of the Item XX.-Resolution-In this case, it is required to change the percentage for a each Invoice Schedule Dates, so the the Total Percentage is either 100% or less.-The following steps can be performed for such actions in the system: -Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Contracts View.-Search for the Contract ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Go the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoice Schedule sub tab.-Change Percentage of the Invoice Schedule Dates.-The Total Percentage of the Invoice Schedule Dates should be displayed as either 100% or less.-After the changes for the Total Percentage of the Invoice Schedule Dates is performed, a case should be created with the SAP Support in order for the Process Communication to be retriggered through the backend.-See Also-KBA 3269389 - Error on the Sales Order: "Sum of Dates' Amounts Exceeds the Item's Amount"-Keywords-sum of dates' amounts exceeds the item's amount,  invoice schedule, dates, total percentage, process communication error, contract, pricing

Title: SEPA Payment to Business Partner Cannot Be Performed
Content: Symptom-SEPA payments to Business Partners cannot be performed due to the following error messages:-'Missing entry in mandatory field Country of cust./suppl. XXX for SEPA Credit Transfer'-'Technical error FOP_PAYMED_PREP 024'-'Payment details not determined'.-Note: 'XXX' represents the Payment ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments subview.-Show Payments 'In Preparation' and find the Payment ID XXX.-Open the Payment and choose Edit.-You receive the following error messages:-'Missing entry in mandatory field Country of cust./suppl. XXX for SEPA Credit Transfer'-'Technical error FOP_PAYMED_PREP 024'-'Payment details not determined'.-Cause-The Business Partner data contains no country details which is a mandatory requirement for SEPA Transfers in SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Navigate to the Business Partners subview.-Show all active Business Partners and find Business Partner XYZ. (XYZ represents the Business Partner ID)-Open business partner XYZ and choose View All.-In General tab you see that no country is maintained under Main Address for Business Partner XYZ.-A country must be maintained for the Business Partner to ensure successful processing of SEPA Payments.-Keywords-SEPA Credit Transfer, Missing Entry, Manadatory, Technical Error, FOP_PAYMED_PREP 024, Payment Method.

Title: Unable to create the Payment 'ABC' to Employee 'DEF' because the Account number and IBAN number data is empty in the Payment proposal list
Content: Symptom-The Payment 'ABC' to Employee 'DEF' cannot be created because the Bank account number and IBAN number are missing, preventing the generation of the outbound file.-'ABC' refers to Payment ID.-'DEF' refers to Employee ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Payment run sub view.-Search for the Run 'XYZ'-View Payment proposal list.-Filter it with Payments in preparation.-For the Payment 'ABC', there is no Account number and IBAN number.-Please note: If the header Account number and IBAN number is not visible then it might be hidden. Check this through 'Start personalization mode'.-'XYZ' refers to the Payment Run ID.-Cause-Note the details of Employee 'DEF' for whom the payment is being created.-Go to the Application and user management work center.-Go to the Business users sub view.-Search for the Employee 'DEF'.-Select that and below under the general data the company as 1000 have been maintained.-Now,-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Payment run sub view.-Search for the Run 'XYZ'-View Payment proposal list.-Filter it with Payments in preparation.-For the Payment 'ABC', you have given Employee 'DEF' as Payee.-And here the company maintained as 2000 which is incorrect.-The Account number and IBAN number is not visible in the Payment proposal list because of the mismatch in the companies maintained. Because of this system is not able to identify the details correctly for this Employee 'DEF'.-Resolution-  Correct company details must be maintained for Employee 'DEF' for Payment 'ABC' to ensure the account number and IBAN number are visible in the payment proposal list.-See Also-KBA - "https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2890528"-Keywords-IBAN number, Account Number, Payment Proposal List, Payment run, Company, Employee.

Title: Error Occurs When Approving / Releasing / Saving Time Entries: Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-When releasing, approving, or saving time entries or time entries associated with a project, the following error message is displayed:-'Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-There might be 3 different ways to reproduce the issue:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Time Recording view.-Select the sub view Time Sheet.-Select the relevant employee.-Select Open Time Sheet.-Go to the relevant calendar week or enter the time sheet for a specific period.-Select Save/ Realese.-or-Log in as employee.-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Service Overview work center.-Click Edit Time Sheet.-Go to the relevant calendar week and select Release.-or-Go to the Time Administration Work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Edit the relevant employee and go to Time Profile tab.-Select Time Account Rules tab.-Change the Deviating Accrual Rate field and save.-Cause-There might be different causes for the issue:-Cause 1: A possible cause is that the business feature for default premium pay is on, because the question below is scoped: Do you want to valuate internal time confirmations with actual employee compensation rates? (Edit Project Scope > Expand Financial and Management Accounting > Expand Management Accounting > Select Project Cost and Revenue Management).-For example, when you try to release a time recording for 01.01.2018, then time valuation starts running from a day before the actual date 01.01.2018. It detects and applies the default premium pay to the 31.12.2017. Due to this, system tries to cancel the already sent source document to financials and tries to send a new source document. But, while sending it finds that the process control for posting date 31.12.2017 is blocked.-Cause 2: A possible cause is that there was a change in the labour resource, org unit, or in the job ID.-- The employee was associated with a job valid from DD.MM.YYYY. He/she was assigned to this job on DD.MM.YYYY which was a backdated change effective from DD.MM.YYYY. During this assignment period, the employee recorded times for the labour resource. Labour resource XXX is for cost center YYY and job ZZZ (where XXX is the labour resource, YYY is the cost center, and ZZZ is the job).-- On the DD.MM.YYYY, the job assignment was changed to ZZZ effective from DD.MM.YYYY. Times recorded and released for DD.MM.YYYY now show different labour resource XXX which is for different cost centre YYY and different job ZZZ.-- However, when releasing time recordings, the system starts a full valuation from DD.MM.YYYY and detects a delta with the labour resource due to the backdated change from one job ZZZ to another job ZZZ. So, now the system is trying to cancel the existing times posted to projects and accounting with the old Labour resource and trying to re-post again with the new labour resource. Since the accounting periods are closed, you are getting the error message.-Cause 3: If the registred time entries are against a project:-The employee records the time sheet against the project and this project belongs to the company ABC. However for this company, there is no fiscal year maintained.-Resolution-Solution for cause 1: Please create a process control that allows time confirmation for the date before the date of time recording and try to release the time recording. When doing so, the system will send a new source document to financial side applying this new default premium pay.-Solution for cause 2:  This is the expected system behavior.-If you make changes to the Time Profile split, it will trigger a time valuation. This valuation will go back all the way to the start of the Time Profile. If any of the records have changes (for example, labour resources), the system throws the error as it is trying to change them, but it cannot be done due to the financial period being closed.-There are two options for resolution:-You can try to copy the existing time profile and save it in the Time Administration work center and then you can try to release the time.-You can also try to open the accounting periods.-Solution for cause 3:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Select the relevant Company.-Select Edit Fiscal Years button.-Maintain the Fiscal Year and select Save and Close.-Keywords-Financial period blocked, Releasing time, Approving time, Saving time, Change deviating accrual rate, Time Administration, Premium Pay, Process Control

Title: Completed Items Included on Data Extraction With Object Open Customer Contracts
Content: Symptom-Customer Contract items are being extracted using Data Extraction for the object CUSTOMER_CONTRACTS (Open Customer Contracts), even though they are Completed or Canceled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management Workcenter.-Enter the Data Extraction view.-Search for extraction ABC and select it (Where ABC represents the Data Extraction with Extraction Object Open Customer Contracts).-Select the Extraction.-On the Extraction Files tab, select the file and click on Download File.-Open the file on a spreadsheet.-There is no column indicating the status of each contract item. Completed and Canceled items are included on the Data Extraction, even though it is expected that only Open (In Process) items are displayed.-Cause-The Data Extraction for Extraction Object CUSTOMER_CONTRACTS (Open Customer Contracts) picks up all the Customer Contract Items from the system regardless of its status.-Hence, it will display Completed and Cancelled items as well.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-SAP ByDesign, Data Extraction, Open Contract Items, Migration, Completed Items, Canceled Items, Contract Data.

Title: How to Extract List Prices with Scales Prices
Content: Symptom-In Product Portfolio work center, List Prices view,  user maintained list prices with scales prices and need to extract them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There is a new report available to get the required data.-Follow below steps to upload the report to system.-Go to Business Analytics Workcenter-Go to Common Tasks -> Upload/Download-Go to Upload Tab-Click Upload Object and upload the attached xml file-Click Save-Report will be available in Design Reports view-The report has filters for Company, Supplier, Product, Validity Period and Status. -Keywords-LIST PRICE, PURCHASE PRICE, SCALE PRICE, DATA EXTRACT

Title: Error Message "Permanent establishment not determined" in Webservice SiteLogisticsTaskBundleMaintainRequest INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Following error is encountered when web service SiteLogisticsTaskBundleMaintainRequest is executed-Permanent establishment not determined -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Inbound request is of type "Spare Parts return Notification".-Spare Parts return Notification is typically created to record the return of unused spare parts that were delivered in advance as custodian stock for conducting services at customer site.-But for the product DEF(DEF refers to product id) as there is no stock present with the custodian/ PQR(PQR refers to Custodian id) hence causing the error.-Resolution-In order to resolve the error Custodian stock should be maintained.-Keywords-Permanent establishment not determined, Application exception occurred, CFM_MESSAGES004

Title: Error Message: No Report Data Available to Display; Check the Selection' while Executing Project Plan Values - Report
Content: Symptom-Project Plan Values - Report is not fetching the data and showing the below error message:-No report data available to display; check the selection-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for Report: Project Plan Values.-Enter the required Parameters.-Click on Apply.-Error Message displayed:-No report data available to display; check the selection-Cause-Project plan data is not visible in the report for the Project as the calculation of project cost estimate failed in financials.-Check the data in the below steps:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search for the required Project and check Error status field-The status of Project cost estimate shows is in error. Check Error status. The reason is end date of the project of the fiscal period is not defined in system in case if the fiscal year variant is not a pre-delivered by SAP. It is required to define the periods that are being used in start date and end date of the project. -Resolution-Maintain Fiscal year periods to retrigger the project cost estimate valuation by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and Open Activity List. -Search for Activity Other Fiscal Year.-Choose Open.-Select the Fiscal Year Variant.-Maintain the required periods and Save.-Keywords-Project Plan Values - Report, Other Fiscal Year, No report data available to display; check the selection

Title: Process Communication Error in Credit Memo: "Sum of Item Amounts Does Not Match Original Item Amount"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Process Communication Errors are encountered on Credit Memo Documents.-The error message "sum of item amounts does not match original item amount" is displayed in the Process Communication Errors view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for respective Invoice Document ID.-Select Edit > View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Observe the Process Communication Error message on the Credit Memo Document.-Restart the XI message in the backend via below steps :-SE38> FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI > Execute.-Operational Document Type 28 > Enter the Credit Memo ID as Operational Document ID.-Select XI message > Restart the XI message.-Restart Failed with the following Error message: 'sum of item amounts does not match original item amount'.-Cause-The issue is caused by a custom PDI that involves a Receivable Payable Item Split. This can sometimes lead to rounding issues, causing the system to generate an error when adding the items due to discrepancies in their sums.-Resolution-Customer has to check with the partner if there is any PDI that might be splitting the items at the Customer Invoice. If such a PDI exists, they should review and adjust the coding to resolve this issue.-Keywords-Credit Memo, Process Communication Error, sum of item amounts does not match original item amount.

Title: Delivery Status of Project Based Item in Sales Order is not Finished and the Sales Order is not Completed.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The Delivery/Fulfillment Status of a project based item in a Sales Order is not Finished even though the assigned Project Task is Completed or Closed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Orders work center.-Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select line Item XX (XX represents the Sales Order line item).-The Invoice Status is Finished but the Delivery Status is In Process. -Item Type is Service - fixed price (project) or Service - time and material (project). -The assigned Project Tasks is ABC-1 (ABC-1 represents the Project Task ID) and the Project Task is Completed or Closed.-Cause-The line item XX was not correctly passed in the payload of the last message from Project to Sales Order from CustomerProjectInvoicePreparation to SalesOrderProcessingRequestCustomerProjectInvoicingIn.-And when the message from ProjectProcessing to CustomerRelationshipAuxiliariesProcessingProjectAndCustomerTransactionDocumentAssignmentNotificationIn was sent with the FulfilmentProcessingStatusCode 3, the line item XX was not updated.-Resolution-Reconcile the last message from CustomerProjectInvoicePreparation to SalesOrderProcessingRequestCustomerProjectInvoicingIn and in the new message line item XX is passed with the correct fulfillment status <FulfilmentProcessingStatusCode>3</FulfilmentProcessingStatusCode>.-If the messages are not available anymore, ask the customer to perform a dummy change for the status of the Project Task. Once this is done the message will be available and it will be possible to reconcile it.-Keywords-Delivery Status, Project Based, Sales Order, In Process, Completed, Not Finished, Project, Closed, Fulfillment Status, Item, Status, Complete Sales Order, ByD

Title: The Function ReadOutputPDF Does Not Return the PDF as Output
Content: Symptom-User is using SOAP Webservice QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn but the function ReadOutputPDF does not return the PDF.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center -> Service Explorer view.-Search for the Service Name QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn.-Click Download WSDL.-Cause-This is system standard behaviour. In the XML code when it is marked as original, it will clear the output PDF data. This is the reason for not getting the output PDF data in response section.-Resolution-In case you want to change the system behavior, we kindly ask you to post your requirement in the Customer Influence Site:-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2018/08/31/web-service-calls-to-get-customer-invoice-pdf-from-bydesign/  - Web Service Calls to Get Customer Invoice PDF from ByDesign-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-ReadOutputPDF, QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn, output PDF data

Title: Schedule of Fixed Assets - Global Report Displays # in Cost Center (Fixed Asset), Cost Center, Profit Center, and Segment Fields
Content: Symptom-The Report Schedule of Fixed Assets - Global displays # in the fields Cost Center (Fixed Asset), Cost Center, Profit Center and Segment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search and open the report Schedule of Fixed Assets - Global.-In the view tab, add the fields Cost Center (Fixed Asset), Cost Center, Segment and Profit Center.-Choose Apply.-Notice # in these fields.-Cause-Only the field names can be added to the report; however, upon execution, they display #.-The logic to fetch the values for the characteristics like, Profit center, Cost center, Cost Center (Fixed Asset) and Segment are not available in the report Schedule of Fixed Assets - Global (Report ID GLOFXAU01_Q0007 and data source GLOFXAU01).-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-To view information of these fields, the report Schedule of Fixed Assets (FINFXAU01_Q0002) can be used.-Keywords-Report, Schedule of Fixed Assets - Global, Cost Center, Profit Center, Segment, missing values, GLOFXAU01_Q0007, GLOFXAU01, data source.

Title: UTC Time Stamp is Missing in the Invoice Documents
Content: Symptom-UTC Time Stamp is missing in the Invoice Documents.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Search for the relevant Invoice Document and Open.-Select output channel as DO NOT SEND.-Cause-When user selects output channel as Do Not Send or XML then UTC Time Stamp is missing in the Invoice Documents.-Resolution-When user selects output channel as Do Not Send or XML, system won't append the UTC time stamp in the document.-However, system will append UTC time stamp for the remaining output channels. This is an expected behaviour.-  Keywords-Data is missing in the invoice, UTC Time Stamp, Output Channel, Do Not Send

Title: Data not Displayed When Opening an Email Activity
Content: Symptom-When accessing the Email Activity ABC through the Account Management workcenter, no data is displayed (where ABC represents the Email Activity subject).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-  Navigate to the Account Management workcenter.-Go to the Activities view.-Filter for All Email Activities.-Search for ABC on the Search Bar.-Select the activity and click on Edit.-Nothing is displayed, as the user were creating a new Email Activity.-Now, go to the system's general Search field (on the top right corner of the screen).-Search for ABC.-On the All Categories tab, the Email Activity ABC is under Business Documents. Open it.-The data is displayed with no errors.-Cause-The relevant backend table is not filled in the moment that the Activity is opened.-Since the entry is not available, the data related to the email does not get displayed.-Resolution-In order to refresh the record and properly display data for the email activity, follow the below steps:-Open the Activity ABC through the system's general Search field.-Click on Change Status.-Change it to a different one.-Click on Save.-Change it back to the original Status.-Save it again.-Now, the data is refreshed and it is possible to access the Activity through the Account Management workcenter.-Keywords-activity, email, account management, not displayed, no content, no data, missing, byd.

Title: Error 500 During Initial Replication From Employee Central
Content: Symptom-The system shows '500 SAP Internal Server Error' error when trying to upload all users from Employee Central.-It might be possible to upload some employees one by one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center-Import Employees view-In the Employee List, click Actions, and choose Upload Data from Employee Central-In the Upload Data from Employee Central screen, click Upload Data-In the popup window, select Upload All Employees-System dumps with message: 'Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report and case.'-The dump details show '500 SAP Internal Server Error'.-Cause-Employee data received from SuccessFactors Employee Central contains invalid or unsupported data.-Invalid data may result from incorrect or inconsistent master data maintenance in SuccessFactors Employee Central.-Employment scenarios that are not supported by the SAP Business ByDesign–Employee Central integration, such as concurrent employment records, can also cause the issue.-Since the data originates from the source system, SAP Business ByDesign cannot process the affected employee records until the data is corrected in SuccessFactors Employee Central.-Resolution-Review the affected employee data in SuccessFactors Employee Central.-Identify and correct any invalid or unsupported employee records.-Ensure that the employee data complies with the SAP Business ByDesign Employee Central Integration Guide.-After correcting the source data, replicate only the affected employees instead of performing a full employee replication.-Once the source data has been corrected, the employee replication should complete successfully.-See Also-KBA 2763252 - Error When Trying to Replicate Employee Between SAP Business ByDesign and Success Factors-Keywords-success factors, successfactors, replicate, please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report and case, an input table in the PROVIDE command contains overlapping ranges.

Title: Sales Order ID Displayed as '#' in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure Report
Content: Symptom-When executing the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report, the Sales Order ID field is displayed as '#'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Reports view.-Search and open the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report.-Enter the mandatory selection parameters: Project, Accounting Period/Year, and Display Currency - Conversion Date, then execute the report.-Choose View -> Row Fields and add Sales Order, then select Apply.-Observe that the Sales Order is displayed as '#' for some entries.-Cause-The Sales Order column displays '#' because the incurred cost is assigned to a different Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-See Also-2727830 - Employee (Account Assignment) shown as # in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report-Keywords-Sales Order ID, Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure Report, #, Not Assigned.

Title: Bank Account Not Available for Selection when Editing Employee Personnel File
Content: Symptom-As a personnel administrator, the aim is to set bank account in employee's personnel file. It's noticed that there are no banks available for selection even though they have been maintained in the bank master data in the Cash and Liquidity Management work center.-This issue occurs only for US customers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center,-Select the Employees view.-Select the respective employee and choose the Edit button.-Select the Personal Data tab.-Navigate to the Payment Information tab.-From the Payment Method dropdown list, choose Bank Transfer or Check.-Select the Add Row button.-In the Bank field, open the selection dialog box.-Notice that some of the banks are missing in the list though it's confirmed that the bank master data has been maintained in the Cash and Liquidity Management work center.-Cause-For US banks, to have them shown in the Bank value help, it is now required that their National Bank Code should be maintained as ABA - US Federal Reserve Identification Code in the Bank Directory. The reason is that SAP Business ByDesign is integrated with US payroll service providers, which requires the ABA number rather than any other bank code type as part of an employee's payment information, in order to pay out salaries or wages via bank transfer.--So the value help will not display US banks which do not have a National Bank Code with ABA number entered.-Resolution-It's required to add a National Bank Code with type as ABA - US Federal Reserve Identification Code to the Bank Directory entry of a bank. Then this bank will be displayed in the bank value help.-Go to the Cash and Liquidity Management work center.-Select the Master Data view.-Select the Bank Directory view, and choose the bank in question.-Choose the Edit button.-Navigate to the General tab.-Under the National Bank Codes table, choose the Add Row.-Add another line item and set the National Bank Code Type to ABA - US Federal Reserve Identification Code.-Click Save and Close button.-Keywords-personnel file; bank directory; national bank code; nbc; ABA; US Federal Reserve Identification Code

Title: Handling Guide for PDI Cross Topic Incidents
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to learn how to efficiently handle a customer incident that relates to PDI customization.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-PSM Releases-The Public Solution Model (PSM) entries enable customer/partners to re-use existing standard functionality within their PDI Solution. This is a needs based policy which needs to be requested through incidents and reviewed by the application area that owns the functionality. It's important to identify these types of requests early and ensure that the customer/partner understands the process and provides the required information. See below blog and central KBA on the topic:-SAP Business ByDesign Public Solution Model (PSM) Policy-2370522 - Central Knowledge Base Article for PSM Requests -BADI Issues-In the Cloud Applications Studio, partners can create enhancement implementations based on SAP enhancement options (BADI).-Incidents related to Enhancement Implementations (BADIs) are routed to the corresponding application team, as they are the provider and are responsible for the BADI.-Kindly refer to the KBA for more details - 2658366 - Troubleshooting PDI Enhancement Implementation (BADI) Related Issues-Consulting Queries-As a team product support should be united in what falls under the support scope. You should encourage customers/partner to use other channels for these queries. Simple consulting may be handled within an incident however complex consulting should be redirected to the SAP Community. If handing over an incident to another support team, be mindful to communicate the correct expectation to the customer.-Identifying PDI Involvement-There are a couple of key techniques that can be used to identify PDI involvement in a customer issue but you need to apply the most appropriate given the environment. The SAAB back end transaction can be used to either trace or skip over execution of PDI scripting. Skipping execution of PDI should be used sparingly as it may affect the consistency of the customers productive data and invalidate the steps to reproduce. See KBAs on SAAB transaction:-3140335 - How to do PDI Trace in C4C and BYD without Using Cloud Applications Studio-2497419 - How to Switch off PDI in C4C or ByD for a Given User-Partner Analysis-A PDI Solution is the responsibility first and foremost of the team that developed it. This may be a customer developer, third-party partner developer or an SAP developer (IBSO). They are required to do the initial investigation. If the issue is found to be a technical issue (dumps, errors) within the Studio or unexpected/unusual system behaviour, the PDI support team can then get involved. To identify the developer responsible, refer to KBA 2533413 - How to Find the Creator of an Add-On in the Back End (PDI)-Since the issues are not limited to standard features, the PDI support team need extra information provided within the incident and adhere to a set of Priority Guidelines. More information on this below:-Pre-requisites for creating a PDI related incident at SAP Support-2883205 - Priority Definitions for Cloud Application Studio Incidents-Debugging ABAP-Debugging in the back end is a highly effective troubleshooting technique that can be utilized by all support engineers. It is generally recommended to put a breakpoint where the issue occurs and check the system variables. This task is done by the relevant application area and if satisfied that the problematic variable value is set earlier in the callstack (such as in PDI), this analysis can be passed to another team. See below detailed debugging steps for common scenarios to familiar yourself with the techniques:-2635374 - Basic: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger-2424439 - How to Troubleshoot and Debug the error: Changing data not possible; data is read-only-For more in-depth debugging tips, please reach out to senior support colleague and/or examine KBA 2638478 - Central Knowledge Base Article for Debugging ABAP code-Ownership-Sometimes incidents require analysis from a framework team. As these components do not have a responsible support team, you should retain ownership until closure or it is determined that the incident should move to another support team.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, PSM, Debugging, SAAB

Title: Time Sheet Update Blocked by Time Administrator
Content: Symptom-When attempting to record the time through self-service, the system throws the error "Updates to time sheets before YYYY-MM-DD blocked by time administrator".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home - Self-Services Overview.-Click Edit Time Sheet.-Add Time Entry.-Release.-Cause-This is the designed system behavior. The issue is caused by the setting "Block Updates to Time Entries" in Time Administration.-Resolution-The administrator can set the block period of time sheet update for employee as following:-Go to Time Administration - Regular Tasks.-Click Block Updates to Time Entries.-If the No Restrictions is checked, it means that the employee can update time sheet at any time.-If the Number of Months is configured, it means that the employee can update time sheet for the current month and the configured number of previous months.-See Also-Keywords-Time Sheet, Update Blocked, Time Administrator, Block Updates to Time Entries

Title: Discrepancy in Form Template Output due to Font Issue in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The expected form template output does not match the actual output, notice that there is a font display issue-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Purchase Requests and Orders workcenter.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search for PO ID: ABC (here ABC refers to PO ID)-Navigate to the output history tab.-Select the document link and observe that the preview differs from the actual output.-Cause-The discrepancy between the expected template and the output PDF is due to a font issue. The font that is being used is not installed on the ADS.-Resolution-Refer to the list of SAP-supported fonts at https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2c039373722d1014814a969cbd687414.html-Use the standard SAP font to resolve this issue.-If a custom font is required, provide the following details to install the font on ADS:-Font Type:-If it’s a free-style font, confirm that the font is free to use and send the font file in either .TTF or .OTF format.-If it’s a licensed font, provide proof of the license along with the font file in .TTF or .OTF format.-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Form Template, Output, Discrepancy, Font Issue, CIDFont+F*, ADS, Purchase Order, Form Template Group, S01, IDB600, Preview, Variant, Output Management.

Title: Incorrect Tax Country Determination for Suppliers from Canada
Content: Symptom-Incorrect Tax Country Determination for Suppliers from Canada-In the sales order, the line items are configured for external fulfillment set, and tax determination is handled automatically without any manual adjustments.-When the supplier is from Canada (CA), the system assigns CA as the tax country.-However, when the supplier is from other countries, such as the United States, United Kingdom, or China, the system correctly determines DE (Germany) as the tax country. The same behavior is expected for suppliers from Canada.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the respective Sales Order and select Edit.-Choose the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab and select the Taxes subtab.-When the supplier is from Canada, the system automatically determines the tax country as CA, while the expectation is for it to be derived as Germany (DE).-Cause-CA is being incorrectly determined due to external fulfillment scenario and the relevant configuration has to be maintained.-Resolution-To ensure the correct tax code and tax country are determined, create a configuration in external tax code determination with parameters as in the sales order.-If Germany (DE) should be determined as the tax country, a configuration must be set up for Germany with the appropriate parameters.-CA is being incorrectly determined due to the external fulfillment scenario, and this should be adjusted accordingly.-Keywords-Tax Country, Incorrect, Canada, CA, Germany, DE, Sales Order, Taxes.

Title: Tax Jurisdiction is not Determined Correctly on a Sales Document
Content: Symptom-When creating a Sales Document (Sales Quote or Sales Order) XYZ (where XYZ represents the Sales Order/Sales Quote ID), the system is determining a different Tax Jurisdiction than the one maintained in the Account FGH (where FGH represents the Account ID).-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Under common tasks, select New Sales Order.-Select View All.-In the General tab, enter the Account ID FGH.-Navigate to the Items tab.-In the Product ID field, enter the Product ID ABC (where ABC represents the Product ID).-Select Taxes sub tab.-The system determines the wrong Tax Jurisdiction.-Cause-The tax jurisdiction is determined based on the settings maintained in the Business Configuration activity Tax on goods and services under Tax jurisdiction determination rules depending on the Origination or destination based taxation.-Resolution-To change the behavior in order to fit in the desired business process, the follow steps can be performed:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search for Tax on Goods and Services - US activity.-Select the Define Tax Jurisdiction Determination Rules hyperlink.-For the specific state, Origination Taxation checkbox should be selected.-This configuration can be changed afterwards if required.-Keywords-Tax Jurisdiction, US, Sales Order, Tax on Goods and Services - US, Account, Origination

Title: Profit Overview by Key Figure Not Show Profit For Invoices
Content: Symptom-With the profit type set to 2- Invoice profit, the Profit by Key Figure report does not show any profit margin as no cost of sales are listed. -However, when changing the profit type to 3- Earned Profit, the report derives costs of sales and calculates a profit margin. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to List view.-Select report Profit Overview by Key Figure.-Run the report with the relevant selection for the company.-However, the report value is not as expected: With Profit Type 2 – Invoice Profit, cost of sales and profit margin are not be displayed. But when using Profit Type 3 – Earned Profit these values appear. -Cause-If Profit Type 3– Earned Profit is selected: With this setting, the report pulls data directly from actual accounting data based on the functional areas used, aligned with the Income Statement.-When setting the profit type to 2-Invoice profit, the data is derived from the CRM application, as maintained in the customer invoice pricing tab.
