The report can calculate the profit margin only if the respective price components are present in the customer invoice Pricing tab (List price, Cost, Discount, Surcharge etc.). -Resolution-Profit Type-The profit type determines the source of data used to calculate profit:-Order profit is based on the sales and service orders in CRM. This profit type is available at an early stage in the sales process and is therefore useful for forecasting and reports on incoming orders. However, there is no assurance that the order profit will be fully translated into actual profit later.-Invoice profit is calculated using the revenues from customer invoices in CRM. Since it is based on invoices, it is closer to the revenue data that will eventually be recorded in accounting.-Earned profit is based on the data in accounting and therefore corresponds to the amounts in the income statement. Since earned profit cannot be calculated until the data is recorded in accounting, it is not available as early as the other two profit types. ---See Also-Profit Analysis Based On Orders and Invoices-Profit Detail by Key Figure-Keywords-profit for invoices, Profit Overview by Key Figure report

Title: Warning Message Appears when you click on the link of Source of Supply in Planning screen INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-When you double click the link of source of supply of a Production Proposal DEF (DEF refers to Production proposal ID)warning message appears as below-No target UI registered for the execution-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Supply Planning Work Center-Navigate to Products View-Find the relevant Product  and Planning Area and select Open-In the opened Product Planning Details page you find the Production Proposal DEF (under Supply and Demand List section)-Click the Change Source of Supply button-A new popup box appears with the list of source of supply, click the link "Released Planning Model (RPM) KLM" (KLM refers to Production Model ID)-warning message occurs "No target UI registered for the execution"-Cause-This is a known issue which has to be fixed by Development team, there is a  technical complexity  involved and requires more effort to provide navigation to respective released model because of the various versions.-Resolution-We have to guide  customers to go to respective work center, i.e Planning and Production Master Data to see the released production model details.-Keywords-No target UI registered for the execution,Warning message appears when you click the link of source of supply in Planning screen, Production Proposal, Production Model , Change Source of Supply.

Title: The Services with type SEFL - "Service - Fixed Price without Actuals" Cannot be Selected in a Contract
Content: Symptom-A service item cannot be added into a contract. The service item is not visible in the selection help.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Click New to open the New Contract window.-Maintain the necessary in the General tab.-Go to the Items tab.-Click Add Row.-Open the Product ID value help.-Search for the Service ABC (where ABC represents the ID of service item).-No Service Item is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The item group of this service ABC is SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals.-The service type for sales without tracking actuals is not enabled in the system. Consequently, the service item with type fixed price without actuals is not supported in sales, including contract.-Resolution-The service type for sales without tracking actuals must be enabled in the system.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to step 4- Questions.-Expande Sales -> Product and Service Portfolio for Sales -> Sell Services, check the question: Do you sell or provide services for a fixed price, but do not track the actual time and materials needed?-Select Next button.-Select Finish button.-After this process the Service Item with item group as SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals will be displayed for the Contact documents.-Keywords-Contract, SEFL, Service, Service - fixed price without actuals.

Title: Lack of Serial Number Details in Confirmation Journal Report in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The Confirmation Journal report does not display details of serial numbers/registered products.-The issue arises when attempting to view the movements of a product's serial number in the Confirmation Journal report.-The Confirmation Journal data source does not reference the serial number field.-The issue persists even after joining two data sources: Confirmation Journal and Registered Product Movement History.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Analytics work center.-Proceed to the Design Reports view.-Search for the Confirmation Journal report.-Execute the report after entering the mandatory details.-You are not able to see any information related to serial numbers of the products. -Cause-The Confirmation Journal report is not designed to display Serial Numbers/Registered Products.-Resolution-Create a new report using the following data sources which contain serial numbers movement information:-Serial Inventory: SERIAL_INV-Registered Product Movement History: REG_PROD_MH-See Also-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Confirmation Journal, Registered Product Movement History, Serial Number, SERIAL_INV, REG_PROD_MH, report, data sources.

Title: Customer Invoice not included in TCS Tax Returns
Content: Symptom-A customer invoice posted with a TCS-relevant tax code is not included in the TCS Tax Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Access the TCS Tax Returns view.-Search for the respective Tax return ID.-Choose View.-Navigate to the Tax Return tab.-The relevant Customer Invoice is not picked up by the TCS Tax Return.-Cause-As TCS should be collected at the time of payment and the invoice is not yet paid, it is not included in the TCS Tax Return.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. The Customer Invoice must be paid to be considered in TCS Tax Return Runs.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, TCS Tax Return Run, Tax Code, Tax Return, Missing.

Title: How To Change the Status of an Individual Material in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-****DO NOT USE- TO BE CLARIFIED****--You want to change the status of the Individual Material ABC in the backend. (ABC represents the Individual Material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Choose Show: All Fixed Assets.-Choose Advanced on the top right.-Enter the Individual Material ID as in the Purchase Order or Supplier Invoice.-Choose Go.-Error Message: No Fixed Asset is returned.-There is no option to delete or block the Individual material id.-Resolution-NOTE: Please only change the status of an Individual Material once you have confirmation from Development Team that you should do so and you have explicit permission from the Customer.--Steps to change the status of the Individual Material ABC:-Log in the backend system with L6 authorization.-Use the backend transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO PDM_INDIVIDUAL_PRODUCT in the field called Load BO by Proxy Name.-Click Enter.-Click on Load by Query.-Select IDENTIFICATION-BY_ID.-Enter ABC in the field IndividualProductKey/ProductID/content.-Click on Continue.-Navigate to Parent.-Navigate to ASSET_SPEC.-Find the column called STATUS-LIFE_CYCLE_STATUS_CODE.-Click on Actions button.-Select REVOKE_OBSOLESCENSE.-(Note that the status changes to Code 3 - Blocked).-Click on Actions button.-Select UNBLOCK.-(Note that the status changes to Code 2 - Active).-Save.-The Codes for the different status of Individual Materials in the backend are:--Code 1 is In Preparation status.-Code 2 is Active status.-Code 3 is Blocked status.-Code 4 is Obsolete status.-See Also- 2642690 - Unable to Delete or Edit Individual Material-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Status, Individual Material, Change, Amend, Obsolete, Active, Blocked, In Preparation.

Title: The Profit Margin is not Displayed on the Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-The Profit Margin is not displayed on the sales quote.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Create a New Sales Quote from Common Tasks.-Select the View All button.-Add the account and other required details in the General tab.-Add the product in the Items tab.-The Profit Margin and Profit Margin Percentage are not shown at the item level of the sales quote.-Cause-The Profit Margin is not scoped in the system.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and choose Edit the Project Scope button.-Go to the Adjust Scoping step.-Expand General Business Data.-Expand Product and Service Pricing.-The Sales Price Specifications is not checked.-It is required to add it in the scoping and Finish the steps.-If the project is already closed then, a New Change Project needs to be created. Do the required scoping changes and merge the change project.-Keywords-profit margin, percentage, scoped, active, sales quote, quote, pricing, byd.

Title: Unexpected interest expenses in the Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow report
Content: Symptom-The interest expense value is visible in lease contract 'AA,' despite the interest rate for this contract being maintained at 0%.-'AA' refers to Lease contract ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to the Lease Contract sub view. -Search for the Contract 'AA'.-Select row and click on Report: Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow.-There, the Expense calculated as 66.300,10 CHF in the Interest Expense Company Currency row.-Please note: Amounts, dates and currency mentioned in this document is an example to explain the calculations.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. For the Lease contract 'AA' you have maintained Lease contract type as 'Retrospective non historic type transition contract'.-For this transition contract cashflows before 01.01.2024 (beginning of the year) are not relevant for postings.-Check the below calculations: (Example references)-Lease Liability value of the Lease valuation object item: 205463.92 CHF-Lease liability Opening balance: 271763.92 CHF-Repayment cost = Lease Liability value - Lease liability Opening balance-Repayment cost = 205463.92 – 271763.92 = - 66300.10 CHF-Ideally Clearing Cost of irrelevant cashflow intervals won't have clearing postings presence for those amounts (i.e., 0 CHF)-Interest Expense for the last cashflow item = Clearing cost – Repayment Cost = 0 – (-66300.10 CHF) = 66300.10 CHF-The above calculation and explanation are for retrospective transition contract approach and in the cumulative approach there will not be any similar kind of interest expenses accumulation in the end of the cash flow item. This is how you see the Interest expense in the 66.300,10 CHF Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow.-Resolution-The lease liability value which is calculated during not-relevant periods based on the Lease contract transition date was not covering under clearing postings and so those values are appearing in interest expense value of the last cashflow item. -As a workaround instead of Retrospective transition type, the cumulative transition approach will be helpful in order to remove the huge interest expense at end of the cashflow item.-See Also-KBA - "3503999 - How to calculate a RoU Asset Opening value/ Lease Contract Lease Liability Opening Balance"-KBA - "https://itsm.services.sap/kb_view.do?sysparm_article=KB0877632"-Keywords-Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow, Interest expenses, Lease Contract, Lease Liability value, Retrospective transition type.

Title: Error Occurs While Creating Incoming Tax Invoice for Ukraine
Content: Symptom-The following errors occur while creating a Tax Invoice for Ukraine.-"Posting of tax invoice failed"-"Amount - AAA in cover document UA01-423-2024 unequal to amount BBB in tax return"-"Tax Invoice amount for Ukraine Value Added Tax Domestic Purchase not correct".-Note: AAA refers to the amount in cover document, BBB refers to the amount in tax return and XXX refers to the Supplier Invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Go to the Incoming Tax Invoices view.-Search and select the respective Supplier Invoice ID.-Choose Create Tax Invoice and enter the relevant details.-Select Post and the errors occur.-Cause-The current behavior is designed on supplier invoices having single tax-relevant line items.-Resolution-For Ukraine tax related supplier invoices, ensure that no more than one line is present.-See Also-Keywords-Tax Invoice, Ukraine, Error, Posting Failed, Amount Unequal, Tax Return, Value Added Tax, Domestic Purchase.

Title: Error: "Language Code is not Valid" When try Releasing the Project Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**For Internal Usage Only**-Unable to release Project Invoice Request due to following error:-"Language Code is not Valid".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing workcenter-Go to Project Invoice Requests view-Select All Project Invoice Requests from the dropdown-Search for Project Invoice Request: ABC-Select Release-The below error message is displayed:-"Language Code is not Valid".-Cause-The issue arises because the user changed the language code, leading to an address inconsistency in the address snapshot within the ADSD_AS_COMM_PREFERENCE table.-Resolution-Create an incident to AP-RC-ADS development team to resolve the inconsistency.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request, Language Code is not Valid, Release, Customer Invoicing

Title: Unable to Undo Cancellation of Production Request in Production Control Work Center
Content: Symptom-A production request has been cancelled and there is a requirement to undo this cancellation.-No option is visible to perform the undo cancellation on the cancelled production request.-Environment-Production Control-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Proceed to the Production Request view.-Search and select the relevant production request with cancellation status as "Canceled".-You do not see an option to perform Undo Cancellation of this production request. -Cause-The system does not provide an option to perform Undo Cancellation action on a cancelled production request.-Resolution-Initiate the creation of a new production request which will generate production request with a different ID.-See Also-Keywords-Production Request, Cancellation, Undo Cancellation, Production Control Work Center, New Production Request.

Title: Error "Item type not permitted" Occurs When Creating Down Payment Request via Web Service
Content: Symptom-There is a Process Communication Error (PCE) displayed on the down payment request created via web service, the error is  "Item type not permitted".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You executed the web service request payload and tried to creat a down payment request in the ByDesign. In the response payload, you found the down payment request was created, and you notice that there was a note on Item, saying "Item type not permitted". The same error is also visible in the frontend.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Open the down payment request ABC, in is processed status. (ABC represents the ID of the down payment request)-Go to the Document Flow tab, you can see the Process Communication Error on the following invoice document.-Go to the the Application and User Management - Process Communication Errors view.-Show Open Errors with Cases query, you find the PCE for the invoice, the main error is  "Split item type must be 1 (invoice) or 2 (credit memo)."-Cause-In the request payload, you are using an incorrect value in <PricingProcedureCode>. The correct <PricingProcedureCode> for down payment request is  PPGDP1 (Gross Down Payment Procedure).-Resolution-You need to correct the request payload and execute the request again.-Keywords- <PricingProcedureCode>; PPGDP1; ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn; down payment request; web service; Item type not permitted; Split item type must be 1 (invoice) or 2 (credit memo).

Title: Cancellation Document With Error "Posting Date XX/XX/XXXX Must be After Last Retrmt Date YY/YY/YYYY of Fixed Asset ABC"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-When posting a cancellation document, you notice that it got stuck in the Unposted Source Documents with error: "Posting date XX/XX/XXXX must be after last retrmt date YY/YY/YYYY of fixed asset ABC".-Even when you change the posting date to a later date, the issue still arises.-XX/XX/XXXX refers to the Posting Date of the cancelation document.-YY/YY/YYYY refers to the Last Retirement Date of the Fixed Asset.-ABC refers to the Fixed Asset ID.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-In the unposted source documents, search for the relevant cancellation document (e.g. Goods and Services Receipt or Supplier Invoice). -See error message: "Posting date XX/XX/XXXX must be after last retrmt date YY/YY/YYYY of fixed asset ABC".-Cause-The functionality compares the value date of the accounting document with the last retirement date of the fixed asset in a background check. -The value date is in this case the original supplier invoice's posting date; This value date cannot be changed. -Resolution-Development support is able to remove the last retirement date of the fixed asset from the backend so that the cancellation invoice can be posted.-Ask the customer/business user backend modification permission and then forward the case to development.-Keywords-unposted source document, goods and services receipt, supplier invoice, cancellation, last retrmt date, fixed asset

Title: Error When Trying to Replicate Employee Between SAP Business ByDesign and Success Factors
Content: Symptom-An exception occurred when replicating Employees from Employee Central.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Import: Employees.-Select the row corresponding Remote Employee ID.-Click Actions.-Click Upload Data from Employee Central.-Click Upload data.-Fill the required date.-Click OK.-Cause-The issue is that for some of the Employees queried from Employee Central System, there exists a concurrent employment (Overlapping employment).-Resolution-Currently, SAP Business ByDesign does not support handling of concurrent employment. Please correct the data and retry uploading it.-Keywords-Concurrent employment, Upload Data, Employee Central, Master Data Replication, An input table in the PROVIDE command contains overlapping ranges.

Title: Recurring Journal Entry Voucher has the status as Finish Early
Content: Symptom-Recurring Journal Entry Voucher has its processing status as Finish early.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Recurring Journal entry voucher sub view.-Search for the relevant Recurring Journal entry voucher 'ABC'-The status is in Finish early.-Expectation is that the voucher should be In process or Finished instead it is in Finish early.-ABC - Refers to Recurring Journal entry voucher ID.-Cause-The Recurring Journal entry voucher 'ABC' may have been selected, and the option Actions >> Finish Early was chosen.-As a result, the voucher has a "Finish Early" status.-And this status cannot be changed from the backend.-Resolution-Finish Early:  Finish Early permanently excludes the Recurring journal entry voucher from the recurring journal entry voucher run.-Recurring journal entry vouchers that were finished early cannot be reactivated.-See Also-Recurring Journal Entry Vouchers Quick Guide | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Recurring Journal entry voucher, Processing status, Journal entry voucher, Finish Early, In process.

Title: Bank Name in the New Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-When creating a new bank statement, find that the 'Bank Name' is different from the bank name in the selection dropdown list or in the bank master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Click New->Bank Statement.-Enter the company ID.-Then open the dropdown list for field 'Bank Account ID'.-Select a bank account ID.-See that the 'Bank Name' file is automatically filled. However, the bank name is different from the one displayed in the previous dropdown list.-Cause-For the field 'Bank Name' in the bank statement view, it is derived from the Bank ID information in the bank master data. And the Bank ID information in the bank master data comes from the related Bank Directory Entry.-Steps to check the bank ID and bank name:-Open the bank master data.-Navigate to the General tab.-See that there is a field 'Bank ID'.-Double click on the 'Bank ID' and will open its related Bank Directory Entry view.-Here, see the field 'Bank Name'. The bank name in the bank statement is derived from this field.-Resolution-This is the current system design. The Bank name in the dropdown list comes from the 'My Bank Name' field in the bank master data as a reference information.-It's also possible to change the Bank Name displayed in the bank statement by modifying the value in its related Bank Directory Entry view.

Title: Error "Tax code not configured for country" When Updating a Sales Order with ManageSalesOrderIn
Content: Symptom-When updating the Tax Country for Item XX on a Sales Order ABC via web service (ManageSalesOrderIn). The response displays the error message "Tax code not configured for country DEF".-ABC represents the sales order ID-XX represents the line item ID-DEF represents the Tax Country-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the web service request.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Open the Sales Order view.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for Sales Order ABC.-Navigate to the Items tab, select Items XX.-Go to the Taxes subtab.-The error message "Item XX has Tax Country MNO but you expect Tax Country ABC" is displayed (MNO is the original Tax Country of the Sales Order).-Cause-Tag  <TaxationCharacteristicsCode listID="YY">Tax Code</TaxationCharacteristicsCode> is not placed within the right tag.-YY is the Tax Country Code, ex: GB for Great Britain.-Resolution-Make sure tag  <TaxationCharacteristicsCode listID="YY">Tax Code</TaxationCharacteristicsCode> is within  tag <PriceAndTaxCalculationItem>:- <Item>-    <ID>XX</ID>-       <PriceAndTaxCalculationItem itemProductTaxDetailsListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-        <TaxationCharacteristicsCode listID="YY">Tax Code</TaxationCharacteristicsCode>-            <ItemProductTaxDetails>-               <TransactionCurrencyProductTax>-                  <CountryCode>YY</CountryCode>-                  <EventTypeCode listID="YY">Tax Code</EventTypeCode>-                  <TypeCode listID="YY">1</TypeCode>-                  <RateTypeCode listID="YY1||2|1">1</RateTypeCode>-                  <CurrencyCode>CURRENCY</CurrencyCode>-                  <BaseAmount currencyCode="CURRENCY">11.22</BaseAmount>-                  <Percent> PERCENTAGE VALUE</Percent>-                  <BaseQuantity unitCode="EA">1.0</BaseQuantity>-                  <BaseQuantityTypeCode>EA</BaseQuantityTypeCode>-                  <Rate>-                     <DecimalValue>VALUE</DecimalValue>-                  </Rate>-                </TransactionCurrencyProductTax>-            </ItemProductTaxDetails>-        </PriceAndTaxCalculationItem>-</Item>-Keywords-web service, tag, tax code, tax country, tax region, sales order

Title: Recurring error of the background job: Position Must be/be Under a Reporting Line Unit From DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When executing the background job for the replication of Org Unit, the below error is displayed.-Error: Position Must be/be Under a Reporting Line Unit from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Background Jobs view-Select All Failed Jobs from the dropdown-View Application log-Navigate to Results-Notice the below error-Replication of organizational center from EC_INTEGRATION_HCM failed-Position must be/be under a reporting line unit from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY-Cause-There is an inconsistency in the backend that requires the execution of the report /MOM/BUILD_PRECALC.-  Resolution-Create an incident to SRD-MD-OM development team to execute the report.

Title: Error Message "Service call failed; report a case" While Migrating Bank Directories Using Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-Attempting to migrate Bank Directories using the migration system results in the following error message:-"Service Call Failed; Report a Case."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button for the selected project.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the activity Bank Directories.-Select Migrate bank directory using the migration tool link.-Select the migration file and select Execute Migration button and choose the required option.-In step 3(Simulate Import), system throws above error message.-Cause-There are many possibilities that may cause this issue. One possible cause is maintaining the National Bank Code for the Bank Directories without specifying the National Bank Code Type in the Migration Template, or maintaining the National Bank Code Type without specifying the National Bank Code.-Resolution-If the National Bank Code is used to identify the bank, the corresponding National Bank Code Type must also be specified.-Keywords-Bank directories, Migrate, Service call failed, report a case.

Title: Campaign Direct E-mail Does Not Send Attachment
Content: Symptom-When executing or sending Test E-mail on an existing Direct E-mail campaign, the files added to the attachments tab are not included on the E-mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Marketing work center.-Go to the Campaigns view.-Create a Campaign.-Add an attachment in the Attachments tab.-Click on Send Test E-mail or Execute button.-The attachment is not included.-Cause-Send Test E-mail functionality is just to check if the output is getting triggered in the system for the said domain. It does not support attachments.-The execution of Direct E-mail campaigns also does not include files from the attachments tab.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-If you need this functionality urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request.-If you are a partner: use "cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com" or the Partnerfinder-If you are a customer: contact your Account Executive-You can also raise an idea in our SAP Business ByDesign Influence Platform.-Keywords-Marketing, Campaign, Attachment, E-mail, Execution, Execute, Send Test Email.

Title: The Product Category cannot be linked to the Service Processor
Content: Symptom-The Product Category is not available to be linked to the Service Processor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Go to the Employee Work Distribution sub view.-Go to the section Business Area:Service and Support.-Select Processor for Service Request.-Click on the Edit button.-In the Edit Work Distribution Rules screen, click on the button Add Rule.-Maintain record for the Employee Responsible.-In the below section, it can be observed that there is no tab for Product Category, so that the Employee can be link to the Product Category.-Cause-There is no Fine-Tune activity maintained to link the Employee with the Product Category.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-In the Show field from drop-down, select All Current Projects.-Click on the Go button.-Select the current project and click on the button Open Activity List.-Go to the section Fine-Tune.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Activities.-In the Find field, search with Criteria to Determine Responsibilities for Service Requests.-Click on the Go button.-Open the activity.-In the Criteria to Determine Responsibilities for Service Requests screen, click on the link Select Criteria to Determine Processor - Service Request.-In the Criteria screen, select the criteria from drop-down as Processor by Country, Service and case Category, Product Category - SRQ and Save it.-Once done, Product Category tab will be available to link it with Employee Responsible under the Work Distribution Rule screen.-Keywords-product category, employee, employee work distribution, determine responsibilities for service requests

Title: Error "Outbound delivery with same external delivery ID already exists" During Undo Release of 3PL Outbound Delivery INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Error occurs during Undo release of 3PL Outbound Delivery DEF (DEF refers to Outbound Delivery id)-Save Failed.-Outbound delivery with same external delivery ID already exists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View-Search for DEF-Select Actions and Perform Undo release-Error appears as mentioned in the symptom section-Cause-This is Intercompany - 3PL - TPOP scenario.-In this case the process is as follows:-Sales Order(SO) -> Purchase Order(PO) -> SO -> 3PL Outbound Delivery -> TPOP IDN -> TPOP Inbound Delivery -> TPOP Outbound Delivery.-There are 2 outbound deliveries created: 3PL DEF  & TPOP NOP(NOP refers to TPOP Outbound Delivery id)-Resolution-You should cancel the Inbound delivery notification which would cancel the TPOP OD and then try to cancel the 3PL Outbound-delivery.-Go to Third Party Order Processing Work Center-Go to Third Party Delivery Notification View-Find KLM(KLM refers to Third Party Delivery Notification id)-Go to Actions->Undo release and cancel this Delivery Notification-As a result,Outbound Delivery NOP will also be canceled-Keywords-Outbound delivery with same external delivery ID already exists, Save Failed, Intercompany 3PL TPOP,when you are trying to Undo Release 3PL Outbound Delivery

Title: Sales Kits in the Web Service ManageSalesOrderIn
Content: Symptom-Adding Sales Kits in the creation/update of Sales Orders via Web Service ManageSalesOrderIn.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the Soap UI.-Execute the payload to create/update a Sales Order.-Logon to the Business ByDesign system.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-The Kit Header and Kit Sub Items are displayed in the newly created Sales Order document.-Cause-When using Sales Kits for the creation/update of a Sales Orders via Web Service, it is only required to specify the Kit Header ID as the Product ID in the payload. The expansion of the Kit Header into the Kit Sub Items is done automatically by the system.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior-Keywords-Kit Header, Kit sub Items, Web Service, ManageSalesOrderIn, Sales Kits

Title: Unposted Source Documents with Errors: "Determination of Profit Center from SalesUnit Failed" or "Cannot Find Business Residence for Sales Unit"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In the General Ledger - Closing Cockpit - Source Documents view, there are unposted source documents with the following errors:-Customer invoices display the error message: Determination of Profit Center from SalesUnit Failed, an associated BTM task also exists.-Supplier invoices or Goods and Services Receipts display the error message: Cannot Find Business Residence for Sales Unit, an associated BTM task also exists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view, Source Documents subview.-Identify the unposted source documents carrying the error messages Determination of Profit Center from SalesUnit Failed or Cannot Find Business Residence for Sales Unit.-Cause-The unposted source documents are linked to old sales orders for which the profit centre or the business residence cannot be derived from the sales unit specified.-1) The problem can occur for old Accounting Notifications (before SAP Business ByDesign FP 2.5) for sales order where the sales unit data has not be passed to accounting, therefore subsequent transactional documents where profit centre and business residence needs to be derived from the sales unit data to get them posted in accounting cannot be processed successfully.-2) The problem can occur if the sales unit specified on the sales order is not valid, time wise, for the posting date of the unposted source document.-Resolution-Sales order that is involved has to be identified.-In case of Customer invoice, it is straight forward to identify the related sales order.-In case of Supplier Invoice, the account assignment on the item level has to be checked on the preceding purchase order. The account assignment should refer to a sales order item.-In case Goods and Service Receipt, the associated supplier invoice has to be identified and then repeat the above.-1) In the backend it can be identified in the BO Testshell (transaction SESFTS) by selecting the BO FIA_ACC_NOTIF for the sales orders. Those with BTM tasks have Processing Status 2 (Pending) and the missing sales unit can be seen by navigating to ItemGroup->ItemGroupItem->ItemGroupItemSales.-The solution is to trigger a reconciliation for the concerned sales orders. The sales unit is retrieved and the profit centre or business residence can then be derived correctly.-In SE38, the report to use is APCRM_TRIGGER_RECON_OB. Select the sales order ID, mark ‘Sales Order’ and ‘Notify Accounting’.-2) The validity period of the sales unit needs to be extended in the Organizational Management work centre  to include the posting dates of the related unposted source documents.-Keywords-Determination of Profit Center, SalesUnit, Business Residence, Unposted Source Documents.

Title: A Date Range is Displayed for the Requested Date for a Service in a Sales Order in the Sales Order Confirmation
Content: Symptom-A date range is displayed for the Requested Date for a Service in a Sales Order in the Sales Order Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Line item XX which is of item type Service (XX represents the line item number).-The Requested Date is the 01.02.2020 (this represents the date maintained in the Requested Date)-Click on the Preview button.-In the Sales Order Confirmation for item XX, it can be observed that the Requested Date is displayed under the Item section in the PDF, with the range in our example being: Requested Date: 01 Feb 2020 - 02 Feb 2020.-Cause-For Service items there is a Requested Date and Requested End.-If the field Requested End is not visible, it can be made visible through the Personalization mode. In our example the Requested End is maintained as 02.02.2020-For service items, if the Requested Date and Requested End are not on the same day the Requested Date is displayed under the Item section in the PDF with the range in our example: Requested Date: 01 Feb 2020 - 02 Feb 2020-If the Requested Date and the Requested End Date are on the same day the Requested Date will not be displayed in the PDF-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-In this case, it is required to ensure that the Requested End date is correctly maintained.-Keywords-Requested Date; range; PDF; Sales Order Confirmation

Title: Withholding Tax Return Run Takes Several Hours to Complete Even Though it Finishes With Message "No tax item exists for period"
Content: Symptom-A Withholding Tax Return Run takes several hours to complete even though it finishes with successful message: "No tax item exists for period DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY".-"DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY" represents the concerned period for the Withholding Tax Return Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2411-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go the Withholding Tax Return Runs view.-Open the respective run and its Application Log.-Observe the timestamps on Started On and Changed On and notice that the run took several hours to get completed (for example, more than 3 hours).-Move to Results tab and notice the successful message: "No tax item exists for period DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY".-Cause-As per the existing logic if there are no open items for return selected period, the system is not considering this and tries to fetch all the business partners information available in the system. The system further tries to retrieve associated tax number details of these business partners which causes long loading time in spite of this return run not having any open items during the respective period.-Resolution-To resolve this issue a code correction is required, and will be addressed in a future SAP Business ByDesign Release.-See Also-Keywords-Withholding Tax Run, long loading time, technical error, report a case, Work package ID system error, no open items, fetch business partners information, tax number details, memory extension.

Title: Is it posiible to block Supplier Invoicing while the product is still in Inspection?
Content: Symptom-In the SAP Business ByDesign system, the finance department is able to Invoice the Purchase Orders for the products which are still under Inspection.-The requirement is to block the Invoicing of such Purchase Orders until the Inspection is completed and approved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Scenario: -Create a Purchase Order on a specific product.-Initiate Inspection on that product and inbound it to a specific logistic area.-While the product is still under Inspection, the finance department is able to Invoice the Purchase Order.-The requirement is for the Purchase Order to not be available in the to-be-invoiced list until the Inspection is executed with a decision.-The Purchase Order should only appear in the to-be-invoiced list when the Inspection decision is approved and the product is moved to a specific logistic area.-Cause-Resolution-The option of blocking invoicing when the product is still in inspection is not available, as per the current system design. -As a workaround, it is suggested to create an add-on in the system which will check the status of the inspection while creating the supplier invoice. The add-on should allow the posting of the Invoice only when the Inspection status is completed.-An extension field "Inspection status" can also be created in the Supplier Invoicing and made as a mandatory field. This field can be entered manually at the time of creation of the Invoice, ensuring that the Invoice will be posted only when this field is filled.-See Also-Keywords-Block Invoicing, product in inspection, Purchase Order should not be invoiced , invoicing the product in inspection

Title: Description Not Updating or Incorrect in Overview
Content: Symptom-Example:-A change in the Kit Description of a Kit Item was made.-The new description is not reflected in the Kit Item List OWL.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example-Navigate to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Open the Kit Item List view.-Search for the Kit ID.-Observe that the Kit Description field still shows the old, outdated Kit Description.-Select Edit to open the Kit Item.-Here the new, updated Kit Description is displayed correctly.-Cause-The issue is caused by a database inconsistency.-Resolution-Perform a dummy change in the Kit Description in the Kit Item List of the given example:-Navigate to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Open the Kit Item List view.-Search for the Kit ID.-Select Edit to open the Kit Item.-As dummy change, add e.g. a character to the Kit Description and save.-Remove the added character and save again.-Return to the Kit Item List view.-The Overview should now show the correct new, updated Kit Description.-See Also-Keywords-Kit Description, Kit Item List, SAP Business ByDesign 2411, database inconsistency, dummy change.

Title: Customer Invoice External Number Inconsistent with the one on the Sales Order.
Content: Symptom-Customer Invoice External Number inconsistent with the one on initial sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Document view.-Select the relevant document.-Select the Edit button then go to View All.-In the General tab the External Reference is XXX (XXX represent ID of the external reference).-You find this ID is inconsistent with the one on relevant sales order.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior,the External Reference ID of Sales Order appears as Purchase Order ID on Customer Invoice.-Resolution-You can view the External Reference ID maintained in the invoice request, which is extended from the Sales order, as the Purchase Order Id in the Items tab of the Customer Invoice document.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Document view.-Select relevant document and choose Edit button.-Go to View All then choose Items tab.-Under General tab you will find Purchase Order ID in Reference.-See Also-KBA 2619622 - External Reference missing from Invoice Request-Keywords-External Reference; Sales Order; Invoice Request; Customer Invoice; Invoice Document; Missing; Purchase Order

Title: Error In Customer Account Statement: 'Server Cannot Be Reached: HTTP 404 - Not Found'
Content: Symptom-Unable to generate output for Customer Account Statement due to the following error:-'Server Cannot Be Reached: HTTP 404 - Not Found'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work center-Navigate Periodic Tasks View-Go to Customer Account Statement-Choose Account Statement Run ID: XYZ-Click View Report Run Results-Navigate to Attachments-When viewing the attachment screen displays error "Service Cannot Be Reached"-And In Output History, click on the error hyperlink, the error displayed is as below-An output error occurred:-"Form template variant Customer Account Statement for language ABC and country/region DEF not found-View the details and follow the steps provided to solve the error"-Cause-The Customer Account Statement form template has been moved from group Balance Confirmation (Group Code: F05) to Customer Account Statement (Group Code: G15) group.-Resolution-Download the form template for Language ABC and Country/Region DEF from Balance Confirmation(F05) group and upload the same to Customer Account Statement(G15) group under 'Form Template Maintenance'.-Follow the below steps to resolve the issue:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Form Template Maintenance view-Open advanced filter, enter Template Group: Balance Confirmation and Country / Region DEF-Select Go-Highlight form template Customer Account Statement and download-Enter Template Group: Customer Account Statement now in the advanced filter-Select Go-Select Upload - As a new variant-Select the downloaded form template Customer Account Statement and Country DEF-Now rerun the Customer Account Statement run-Keywords-Customer Account Statement, Balance Confirmation, Service Cannot Be Reached, HTTP 404 - Not Found, Output Error, Form Template

Title: Some Fixed Assets Are Not Processed in Depreciation Run
Content: Symptom-Depreciation is executed for all fixed asset for period 001.YYYY. (YYYY represents the fiscal year) However, many fixed assets are not processed.-There are only depreciation amounts shown for period 012.YYYY in the depreciation overview of these fixed assets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Starting a new depreciation run for all fixed assets.-Go to Fixed Assets work center and Periodic Tasks view and then sub view Depreciation.-Select New Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Select Company and Set of Book.-Do not input any specific fixed assets.-Input Period/Year as 001/YYYY.-Start the run.-After completion - many fixed assets are not processed.-You open one of these fixed assets, and go to tab Values.-In sub tab Depreciation Overview, there shows a depreciation amount to be posted in period 012.YYYY - however, not for other periods in the fiscal year.-Tried the following step, but no effects.-Select Values--Recalculate Adjustment in tab Values.-Cause-At the beginning of each fiscal year a Recalculation-run should be automatically scheduled. However - due to framework changes this failed to happen in this particular instance.-Resolution-You need to start a recalculation depreciation.-Go to Fixed Assets work center and Periodic Tasks view and then sub view Depreciation.-Select New Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Remove the flag of Test Run.-Select Company and Set of Book.-Do not input any specific fixed assets.-Input Period/Year as 999/9999.-Start the run.-There are no posting of such execution, but just refresh data.-Now, perform normal fixed asset depreciation, and need to vefity the postings.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Depreciation run,

Title: Cost and Profit Margin in a Contract are not as Expected.
Content: Symptom-The costs or profit margin in the Pricing and Invoicing tab of a Contract are not as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.  -Select the Contracts view.-Click on the New button and select Contract.-Enter the respective data.-Go to the Items tab.-Add the respective product.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Go to the Pricing sub tab.-Click on the Expand All button.-Here it is possible to see that the price component Costs is not pulled for the contract item and hence the Profit Margin (%) is 100 even though the costs have been maintained for the item and are valid.-Cause-There is no automatic calculation of the planned costs in the contract item. A contract is a long term agreement and costs on a contract item serve no business meaning since for contracts the item prices are copied from the Price Agreements and not from Pricing and Invoicing.-Costs cannot be manually entered in a contract. However, the costs will get determined in the sales order when you create a Sales Order with reference to a contract.-There are two exceptions when the price component Costs will be displayed in a contract:-Costs will be displayed Pricing and Invoicing when a Sales Quote for Contract is created and then create the contract created as a Follow-Up document of the Sales Quote for Contract. In this case the costs are taken over in the new contract for this particular item. However any new created contract item will not display the costs.-If a contract is created as a copy of a contract which was created as a Follow-Up document, the costs are also taken over in the new contract for this particular item. However any new created contract item will not display the costs.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-cost, profit margin, wrong, not displayed, pricing, byd.

Title: Time zone Error during Release of Inbound Delivery.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--Error during Release of Inbound Delivery 999 (Where 999 is the Inbound Delivery ID). "The time zone is not valid. Enter a valid time zone."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center-Go to Inbound Deliveries view.-Find and select Inbound Delivery 999-Click on Release.-Above error occurs.-Cause-In the inbound delivery 999, the time zone ( Ex. UTC + 0 ) was blank for both the start date and end date hence the error.-Note:  Time zone is maintain in predecessor documents however for some reason the same is missing in Inbound Delivery.-Resolution-Backend correction is required to update the Time zone in Inbound Delivery.-Request permission from customer for backend correction and forward the incident to AP-SLP-LOT.-Keywords-Time zone, Inbound Delivery, Valid, Release, Start Date, End Date, Inbound Logistics

Title: Business Communication Error: Restarting Message Failed; System Error-INTERNAL
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL ONLY-Following Error message is encountered during Restart in Business Communication Monitoring-Restarting message failed; system error -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business Communication Monitoring View.-In Show select Message with Errors.-Select one message and Select on Restart.- Following error message is encountered- Restarting message failed; system error-Cause-Mentioned error occurs while trying to restart a message that's already been delivered.-This issue typically arises due to a mismatch between the Frontend and Backend view, as well as a status mismatch in the Business Communication Monitoring view and the SRTMONI.-To rectify this, you can run a Report on the system. This should help align the views and resolve the status mismatch, thereby resolving the error.-Resolution-Request permission from the customer to execute the report in the backend.-Once the permission is received forward the incident to AP-RC-DF-BMV component to correct the inconsistency.-Keywords-Restarting message failed; system error, Business Communication Error: Restarting Message Failed; System Error, SRTMONI-restarting message failed

Title: Current Earned CoGS Amount Differ In Each Set Of Books In The Revenue Recognition
Content: Symptom-After running the Revenue Recognition, it is observed that the Current Earned Cost of Goods Sold amount varies across the results in each set of books.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition sub-view.-Select the respective Revenue Recognition ID.-From the List of Logs, open the Set of Book PQR results.-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab.-Find the relevant Sales Order ID against which the Current Earned CoGS Amount is showing as, for instance, 45,000.00.-Again from the List of Logs, view the results for Set of Book XYZ.-Navigate to Processed Successfully tab and for the same Sales Order ID against which the Current Earned CoGS Amount is showing as, for instance, 48,000.00.--Note: 'PQR' and 'XYZ' refers to the respective Set of Book IDs.-Cause-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select the Material Unit Costs sub view under Master Data view.-Select All Unit Costs and search for the Material.-Highlight the Material ID with the respective Business Residence ID/Company.-Select View Cost History button.-Navigate to select the same Period/Year that matches your Revenue Recognition.-For Set of Book PQR the Resulting Inventory Cost is 45,000-For Set of Book XYZ, the Resulting Inventory Cost is 48,000, but the rate was updated to 45,000 only after the execution of the Revenue Recognition. Consequently, this updated rate is used and displayed as the Current Earned CoGS for this Set of Book.-Resolution-The material used in the sales order processing determines the Earned CoGS. The difference in value for each of Set of Book is due to the Material Unit Costs that is valid for each Set of Book at the time of running Revenue Recognition and its selection criteria.-Postings are inline with the above rates maintained. If the difference in values across the sets of books is unacceptable, the respective Revenue Recognition ID can be reversed by executing a new Revenue Recognition with the same selection criteria. After the reversal, verify the applicable rates, make corrections if necessary, and then rerun the Revenue Recognition process.-Keywords-Earned CoGS, Amount, Differ, Varies, Set of Books, Different, Revenue Recognition

Title: All Active Set of Books are in the Selection List when Entering the Valuation for a Labor Resource
Content: Symptom-When entering the valuation for a labor resource, find that it's possible to select all active set of books although only part of the set of books are relevant to the selected company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Resources view.-Search for resource ABC and edit(ABC represents the resource ID).-Under Valuation tab.-Maintain Cost Rate.-Find that for the 'Set of Books ID' field, all active sets of books are in the selection list.-Resolution-This is the current behavior. However, although all active set of books are in the list, it is not possible to select the one which is not relevant to the selected company. Error occurs and it's not possible to save the data. There are validity checks to prevent incorrect maintenance.-Keywords-Set of Books, Valuation, Labor Resource

Title: Issue with Uploading Data through Excel Add-in in ByD
Content: Symptom-Unable to upload template through Excel Add-in.-Error message displayed is:-"The following Error(s) occurred while saving data:-XmlDocument SendRequestToA2X(A2XRequest a2xRequest)reported error-Total Number of Records Saved : 0"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the respective excel file.-Logon to the system via Excel add-in.-Select the option Save Data To.-The following error message is displayed:-"The following Error(s) occurred while saving data:-XmlDocument SendRequestToA2X(A2XRequest a2xRequest)reported error-Total Number of Records Saved : 0"-Cause-The issue is not from the ByDesign system or the Excel Add-In, but instead the issue is from the Excel itself.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, follow these steps:-Open the respective excel file.-Navigate to the SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN add-in tab.-Select Logon.-Open the Proxy Settings option.-Remove the Proxy URL.-Select OK.-Now, login using the URL, Username and Password.-Select Save data to.-The record will be uploaded successfully-If the issue persists, please reach out to the IT team, as it appears to be related to Excel.-See Also-2586194 - Common Issues and Troubleshooting with SAP Excel Add-in for Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer-Keywords-Excel Add-in, ByDesign, Upload, Template, Error, XmlDocument, SendRequestToA2X, Save data to.

Title: How to Maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item, for Which Invoice Status is Manually Finished
Content: Symptom-How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in a Project Based Sales Order Item for which the Invoice Status is manually Finished.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Search and Edit the Sales Order ABC (where ABC is the sales order ID).-Click the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Select the line item YY which is of type Service - fixed price (project) (YY represents the line item ID).-The Invoice Status of line item YY is Finished, but there is no Invoice Document in the Document Flow of the sales order ABC.-Since Invoice Status is Finished, the Reason for Rejection is no longer editable.-Cause-The invoice status of Sales Order line item YY was manually finished through the Project Invoicing: Sales Orders view under the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Resolution-In order to make the Reason for Rejection field on the Sales Order line item editable, the Invoice Status must be turned back to Not Started.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view and Sales Order sub view.-Search with Sales Order ID ABC in the Find field and click on the Go button.-Select the Sales Order ABC and click button Change Status -> Revoke Finish Invoicing.-This will make the Invoice Status as Not Started for the Sales Order line item and the Reason for Rejection field should be enabled.-In case the invoice or invoice request has been cancelled:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view and Sales Order sub view.-Under Details in bottom half of screen, switch to Items tab, select item YY and choose "Revoke Finish Invoicing". -Keywords-Reason for rejection, project based, grayed out, not editable, read only, invoice status, revoke, sales order, byd.

Title: Wrong Currency in New Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-The currency in new Supplier Invoice is not the same as the one maintained in the reference Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Show: All Orders to be Invoiced-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID). -Click in New Invoice button.-In the New Invoice screen, the currency is different from the currency maintained in the Purchase Order. -Cause-Cause 1:-In case of Partial Invoicing scenario, the Supplier Invoice currency would be defaulted from the first Invoice created for the Order.-In case of Not Invoiced, the currency would be picked from Purchase Order or corresponding delivery documents like Goods and Service Receipts, Inbound Deliveries, Outbound Deliveries, etc…-Cause 2:-There are other Supplier Invoices, already posted or paid, that have the different currency. The system proposes the same currency as the last created supplier invoice. The idea behind this behavior is that the currency the supplier uses in his invoices may be different from the currency of the purchase order and the system assumes that a supplier always creates the supplier invoices with the same currency.-Resolution-The currency can be manually changed in the new Supplier Invoice.  If it is still in "In Process" status, please follow the steps below:-Open the new invoice.-Navigate to General tab.-Change the currency in the field 'Total Gross Amount'.-Save it. -Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Purchase Order; Currency

Title: Self Approval Of Sales Quotes Cannot Be Skipped
Content: Symptom-If a user EDF creates a Sales Quote XYZ and it also mainatained as the direct approver of Sales Quote, it is expected the approval process to be skipped.-However the system still requires the Sales Quote to be approved by the user EDF in the system.-(where XYZ represents the Sales Quote ID and EDF represents the User ID)-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Select Sales Quote XYZ.-Click the Edit button.-Click the View All button.-Go to the General tab.-The User EDF which created the Quote is also maintained as the employee responsible for the Sales Quote.-    7. Go to the Approval Process tab.-The User EDF which created the Sales Quote is also maintained as the direct approver of the Sales Quote. Therefore it is expected the Approval Process to be skipped as the User EDF which created the Quote is also the direct approver of the sales quote.-Cause-If the user EDF who is creating the quote is also the direct approver in the approval process and if this same user does not have a manager then this situation occurs.-If the approval process is scoped and the approval process is defined then there is no way to skip this process. The task will be triggered to the direct approver even though the user EDF is the employee responsible for the quote.-Resolution-The Sales Quote would have to be approved by the user EDF which created the document or, if a manager is available, the approval task would need to be reassigned to manager.-The system hereby is working as designed.-Keywords-Employee Responsibel; Approval Process; Sales Quote; Self Approval;

Title: Initiate Activity Button Is Grayed Out or Not Editable in Closing Cockpit
Content: Symptom-Initiate Activity button is grayed out or not editable for a period-end activity.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Closing Cockpit view and select Closing Cockpit sub-view.-Select the respective period end close in question.-Choose Edit.-Select the row corresponding to the relevant Activity Type to initiate the activity.-The Initiate activity button is grayed out.-Cause-Initiate Activity button will be active and editable only to the processor to whom this particular task is assigned.-Resolution-If the processor is no longer responsible for the task or is no longer with the company, the responsible employee can update the processor. This ensures the newly assigned processor can initiate the activity, enabling the button required to perform the manual task.-Keywords-Closing Cockpit, Period-end Close, Initiate Activity, Grayed out, Disabled, Processor, Responsible Employee

Title: Error "Conversion Result is Empty" When Uploading Bank Advice or Bank Statement Files.
Content: Symptom-An error message "Conversion Result is Empty" is displayed when attempting to upload bank advice or bank statement files-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Liquidity Management Work Center > Inbound files view.-Click on New > Inbound files.-Enter the required information.-Click on Add > File.-Select the file and click Add.-Click on Start File Upload.-The error "Conversion Result is Empty" is displayed.-Cause-The issue may be caused by a mismatch between the IBAN provided in the file and the Bank Account's IBAN stored in the system.-Resolution-Please verify that the IBAN provided in the file matches the one associated with the Bank Account in your system. -To check the IBAN maintained in the system, please follow these steps:-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > My Banks view-Search for the My Bank ID: XYZ and open it-Click View All-Go to Bank Accounts tab-Select the desired bank account ID-Take a note of the IBAN-See Also-Refer to the following Knowledge Base Articles for additional information:-KBA 3364738 - Error 'Conversion Result is empty' during new Inbound File-KBA 3294951 - 'Conversion Result is Empty' Error While Uploading Lockbox Inbound File-KBA 3450363 - Bank Statement Upload Error Conversion Result is Empty-KBA 1723697 - Error Message "Conversion Result is Empty"-Keywords-Conversion Result is Empty, Bank Advice, Bank Statement, File Upload, Inbound Files, Automatically Generated Bank Statements, Assign Import Formats, Bank Statements.

Title: Error: "New Tax Code Entry for Country IN Not Allowed" While Defining New Purchasing Tax Code for India
Content: Symptom-An error occurs when trying to define a new tax code for purchases with service tax in India: "New tax code entry for country IN is not allowed."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view and choose Open Activity List.-Open activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Choose Define Tax Codes.-Select Add Row and add a new tax code for country IN.-Choose Save.-Error: New tax code entry XX for country IN is not allowed is displayed.-Cause-In India, specifying the service tax code is not allowed.-Resolution-This is the standard system behaviour.-See Also-For more information, refer to the Help Center Documentation: Configuration: Tax Codes | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-New Tax Code, India, Not Allowed, Service Tax.

Title: Error: Please Activate And Check in the Object PQR.XYZ for a Solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You receive the error "Please Activate And Check in the Object PQR.XYZ" while Assembling or Checking the Solution, where PQR.XYZ is the file path.-Now 2 scenarios can happen:-1. The corresponding object is already active and checked in.-2. The corresponding Standard templates in case of a form isn't added to the solution and hence is showing an inactive.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the solution.-Click on Assemble and Download or right click on the Solution and select Check option.-System will pop up a message for saving the zip file, click on SAVE.-Error appears.-Cause-For Scenario 1: The issue is being caused as the corresponding object is inactive in the backend and as a result if you try to activate or check the solution it wont allow you but throw the error.-For Scenario 2: The issue caused because customer might have enhanced the standard form but later on they deleted from SDK itself for any other solution, but the standard form remains inactive and as a result if you try to activate or check the solution it wont allow you but throw the error.-Resolution-** You must first align with senior colleagues/PDI development before performing backend corrections **-Go to the transaction XREP.-Swith to the layer of the solution which have the error-Navigate to the standard templates path with the path you got from the error message.-Find the relevant application template node and expand.-Select the mentioned .xdp file, you can find that this file is inactive.-Edit and Activate.- Note: If you navigate to the version history tab of the template in the XREP transaction you can find out in which solution partner has made the changes which resulted in this issue and the details of the partner.-Keywords-inactive files-form templates inactive-Please activate and check in the object-.xdp

Title: How to Integrate Expense Data to Accounts Payables in Business ByDesign?
Content: Symptom-An alternative integration method is needed because Expense data integration from a third-party system to Accounts Payables encounters an issue as the web service "Manage Accounts Receivables Payables Ledger Accounts" is marked as deprecated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Business ByDesign do not have any web service to Integrate Expense Data with Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-A possible workaround would be to bring these Expense Reports as Supplier Invoice using the Supplier Invoice web service.-Keywords-Expense data, Accounts Payable, Integrate.

Title: System Dumps When Trying to Create 3PL Request for Delivery Request id INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-System crashes/dumps while trying to create 3PL Request from a Delivery Request DEF (DEF refers to the Delivery Request ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Delivery Proposals view.-Show All Proposals by Selection.-Find and select the Delivery Proposal DEF.-Click Create 3PL request.-System Dumps with the following details in the UI:-ClassName:sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName:post-500 SAP Internal Server Error-ERROR: The application running deliberately caused an abort with short dump. (termination: RABAX_STATE)-Cause-The Dump occurs because there is no valid Communication Arrangement maintained in the system.-In this case, the 3PL request is being sent from the Company KLM (KLM refers to the Company ID) to the Warehouse Provider PQR (PQR refers to the Warehouse Provider ID) without a  suitable Communication Arrangement.-Resolution-You must maintain a valid Communication Arrangement to process the Delivery Proposal. Please follow the below steps to realize this:-Navigate to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Communication Arrangements view.-Select the Third-Party Logistics Integration as Communication Scenario and click New.-Select Step 1: Select Scenario as Third-Party Logistics Integration.-Select Next to Step 2: Define Business Data, Maintain Business Partner ID, Identification Type, Company ID.-Select Next to Step 3: Define Technical Data, Maintain Application Protocol, Authentication Method and Host Name.-Select Next to Step 4: Review: To review the settings.-Select Finish to Step 5: Select Confirmation to confirm the settings.-Keywords-System dumps when trying to Create 3PL request, System Dumps When Trying to Create 3PL Request for Delivery Request id

Title: Inability to Release Inbound Delivery in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The Release button of the delivery document is not available.-Inbound deliveries cannot be processed further.-Environment-Inbound Delivery Processing in SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center in SAP Business ByDesign.-Proceed to the Inbound Delivery view.-Search for the delivery document and select it.-Observe that the Release button for the inbound delivery is not enabled.-Cause-The Put-away task created against the relevant Inbound document is still In Process.-The Inbound delivery will have the status updated as Released once the Task is Finished.-Resolution-Finish processing the put-away task.-The Inbound delivery will have the Release Status updated to Released.-See Also-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, SAP Business ByDesign, Release Button, Put-away Task, In Process Status, Release Status.

Title: You Receive the Error Message "Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company XYZ" in an Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-While processing your Sales Order, you receive the following error message: Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company XYZ in an Intercompany Scenario. This is relevant for A2A and B2B scenarios.-XYZ represents the seller company name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Edit Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the identification of the Sales Order).-The following message is triggered:-Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company XYZ.-Cause-The message Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company XYZ is raised as the sales unit is not within the seller company.-Resolution-In this case you have the following possibilities:--A) Change the determination, so that a sales unit is found, which fits to your selling company.-A rule should be maintained in the system as following:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Edit the relevant Sales Unit for Sales.-Add the Selling Company XYZ in the field Company.-Enter the responsible Sales Unit.-B) In case you need to fix the issue for only this sales order, you can change Sales Unit manually to a Sales Unit from the seller company.-See Also-KBA 1435095 - How to Determine Sales Unit in a Sales Order-For detailed information on the Party Role Determination you can find the following Blog: Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-Keywords-Intercompany; Seller; Party; Unit; Organization; Org Unit; Sales Unit; Sales Order; sales organization

Title: Error "Creation of resource load not possible" When Assigning an Additional Resource in Make Task
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error appears when trying to assign an additional resource DEF(where DEF refers to Resource ID) in Production Make Task KLM (where KLM refers to Production Task ID)-Creation of resource load not possible------> Access to read-only fields not allowed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center-Navigate to Task Control view-Search for Make Task KLM-Click Confirm-Enter quantity same as Ordered Quantity in Confirmed Quantity-Navigate to Subtab Activities and select sub tab Resources-Click Propose Resources-A new window opens "Selection of Resources" here select Resource DEF, click on >(include) and click ok-Error appears as stated above in Symptom section.-Cause-Error appears as the selected Activity has  confirm duration maintained is initial (00:00:00).-Resolution-If you maintain some value  which is not equal to 00:00:00 against Confirmed Duration, system will allow you to add the resource.-In order to resolve the issue, Follow below steps.-Go to Production Control Work Center-Navigate to Task Control-Search for Make Task KLM-Click on Confirm-Enter quantity same as Ordered Quantity in Confirmed Quantity-Navigate to Subtab Activities, Under activities select Activity and Maintain Confirmed Duration as 00:00:01-Keywords-Creation of resource load not possible, Access to read-only fields not allowed, Error appears when adding additional resource in make task, setup activity, Confirmed Duration , Make Task, Confirmed Quantity, Activity

Title: Approval Process does not work for Bank Payment Advice
Content: Symptom-The approval process for payments is configured in the system; however, it behaves inconsistently based on the type of transaction.-When a payment is processed using a payment method such as New Outgoing Bank Transfer, it correctly triggers the approval process.-However, when a payment is processed using New Bank Payment Advice, it bypasses the approval process and does not go for approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Select the Payment Monitor view.-Search and find the respective Bank Payment Advice.-The document is not sent for approval.-Cause-Currently, SAP Business ByDesign does not support an approval process for Bank Payment Advice. -Resolution-This functionality is not available and represents a potential new feature request.-This requirement can be shared through the SAP Influence Channel, where new feature ideas are collected and reviewed.-Feature request can be posted here: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-2063785 - How to Set Up Approval Process for Payments-3407183 - No Approval Process for Bank Payment Advice Created via Web Service-Keywords-Bank Payment Advice, Approval, Payment Monitor, Approve Payment Advice

Title: Wrong Resource Derived for Project Internal Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-Internal employees record time on project task AAA-A (AAA-A represents a project task ID).-For the internal service confirmation of employee XYZ the wrong resource is derived as cost object. However, for the actual posting value  the cost rate of the recorded service is used (XYZ reproduces the employee's ID).-You expect the resource and its cost rate connected to the employee's job to be derived for the time confirmation. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-Condition:-Employee XYZ is assigned to job ID ABC. -Their reporting line unit's cost center is XXX. -Open the relevant time recording: -Find the time recording's posting PPP, for example from the Source Documents view of the General Ledger. View the Business transaction and then open the journal entry (PPP represents the time recording's source document ID). -In the journal entry you notice resource DEF got derived.-Resource DEF is not associated with job ABC. -Resource DEF does not have an active cost rate assigned. -Instead, the service cost rate is used for the posting value. -Cause-By default, service costs are allocated automatically based on resource cost rates.-When an employee enters an activity confirmation, the system derives the resource from the employee’s cost center and job, and automatically defaults the resource in the confirmation. -In the case of time recording PPP, the system could not find a resource for the cost center XXX/job ABC combination. -The resource DEF associated with cost center XXX was found, not connected to any job and without any valid cost rate. -Therefore, the resource was still derived as cost object. -But for the actual posting the service cost rate is used. -Resolution-For time recordings always ensure that there is a resource available with the cost center/job combination of the respective employee/s.-Create or update a resource associated with cost center XXX and job ABC. -Ensure the cost rate and job assignment are valid on the posting date of time recording PPP.-You can the reverse time recording PPP and re-enter it again. This time the correct resource with the correct cost rate will be derived. -See Also-Service Cost Allocation to Projects-Keywords-time recording, wrong cost rate, wrong resource, project time recording,

Title: Unable to Remove Contacts in Service Control Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Unable to remove a contact from the Contact Details view inside the Service Control Center.-When an attempt is made to remove a contact, the system shows "removal requested" but then the contact reappears in the created ones.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center.-Proceed to the Contact Details view.-Select Active Contacts.-Choose the contact that needs to be removed.-Choose 'Remove assigned contact'.-Cause-Due to a synchronization problem between NZA and ICP.-Resolution-It is a sync issue between NZA And ICP. This has to be manually synced.-Create an Incident to SRD-CC-CI-CCS Development team to resolve the issue.-Keywords-Service Control Center, Remove contact, contact details, synchronization issue, remove assigned contact, removal requested

Title: Created By Column in Exchange Rate History Displays Technical User ID _XYZ
Content: Symptom-The Created By column in the Exchange Rate History displays the User ID as Technical User (_XYZ).-_XYZ refers the Technical User ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Edit Exchange Rates sub view in the Common Tasks view.-Choose View Exchange Rate History.-For some line items, the Created By column shows the User ID as 'Technical User (_XYZ)'.-Cause-A Communication Arrangement is being created for the Web Service ManageExchangeRateIn, and it is assigned to the Technical User ID _XYZ.-Resolution-The system creates a technical user whenever a communication arrangement is created. The users starting with underscore are for customer communication purposes (B2B / A2X / OData). This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-2757453 - Frequently Asked Question on Type of Users Available in the System-Keywords-Exchange Rate History, Created By, Technical User ID, Communication Arrangement, Web Service, ManageExchangeRateIn, A2X Web Services.
