Title: Read-Only Setting for Extension Fields via Adaptation Mode is Disabled
Content: Symptom-An SDK development, containing several extension fields on the project (master data) screen, has been deployed.-Some of these extension fields have been modified via adaptation mode to make them read-only.-The need is to revert these fields back to being editable, but the option is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Select any project.-Scroll down and select Basic Data sub-tab-Some fields are grayed out-In adaptation mode , select the Extension field-Right click on field and see read-only property is disabled-Cause-The issue is caused by many adjustments to PDI fields.-Resolution-As this is a custom solution, the issue should be addressed by the partner responsible for it. The partner needs to modify the content of the CT and update the property to "read-only" for the fields using the Extensibility Explorer.-See Also-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, PDI extension fields, read-only, adaptation mode, unlock fields, project management.

Title: Inconsistency in G/L Account Balance in Trial Balance and Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail Reports
Content: Symptom-The balance of G/L Account differs in Trial Balance and Accounts payable- Balance Audit Trial reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search and open the report Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail and enter the required data in the selection field.-Choose the option Apply.-The balance is XXX (XXX refers to the Balance Company Currency).-Now, open the report Trial Balance and enter the required details.-Choose Apply.-The balance is YYY (YYY refers to the Ending Balance Company Currency).-Cause-The difference between the report is due to postings executed without subledger involvement, such as manual journal entry voucher postings or balance carryforward postings. The Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail Report does not take these postings into account.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-1838469 - Accounts Receivable/Payable - Open Items Report Balance is Different to Financial Statement Report Balance-Keywords-G/L Account, Trial Balance, Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail, Balance difference, Ending Balance Company Currency.

Title: Issue with Employee Creation due to Error: Number Range Depleted
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-An error message "Number Range depleted" is encountered when trying to create an employee manually-The issue is related to the Internal employee Business Partner range, which is set from 9999900001 - 9999999999.-Despite having approximately 950 numbers left in the range, the system is unable to extend this range, leading to the error.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator workcenter-Navigate to Employees-select 'New'-Attempt to save or close the new employee entry-Notice the error: Number Range Depleted-Cause-The cause of the issue could be an inconsistency between the UI and backend, leading to the depletion of the number range for creating new employees.-Resolution-In order to update/extend the number range, create an incident to AP-RC-NR development team.-See Also-Refer to KBA 2774011 - Error While Creating Business Partner: "Number Range Depleted" -Keywords-SAP Cloud for Customer, Employee Creation, Number Range Depleted, Internal Employee Business Partner Range, Error, UI, Backend, Inconsistency.

Title: Cannot Send Payment Batches: No Communication Arrangement Found for Business Partner
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You cannot send payment batches nor request new bank statements from Treasury Intelligence Solutions (TIS) due to the error message:-'Save failed'-'No communication arrangement found for business partner ABC (Treasury Intelligence Solutions GmbH)'-(ABC is the business partner).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Batches view.-Search for Payment Batch DEF (DEF is the payment batch ID) and select it.-Click the settings icon and select Send Batch.-You get the following error messages:-'Save failed'-'No communication arrangement found for business partner ABC (Treasury Intelligence Solutions GmbH)'-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Communication Arrangements subview in the Input and Output view.-Search and select the “Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions”Communication Scenario.-Click open the same.-The service url is "https://api-mtls.eu.tispayments.com:443/apps/btm/ws/WebServiceApi/v1_3/soap1_1".-It can be noticed that the communication arrangement is not showing communication type or partner.-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Supplier view.-Search and select Supplier ABC.-The Supplier has been maintained with proper D.U.N.S number.-Cause-The Supplier Business Partner account was created after the activation of the TIS Communication Scenario.-Before activating and setting up the communication scenario, the supplier account should be active.-Resolution-The issue can be solved by following the steps below in the backend of the system:-It is recommended to perform such steps along with a FIN senior team member.-Login to the Backend.-Use transaction SE38.-Enter Program as /DOC/B2B_DEPLOY_AND_RUN .-Click Execute.-In the next screen, select Type Deploy Immediately.-Then Deploy.-Check Call AfterSave first.-Enter MCPGroup as FIN_PAY_BANK_TIS .-Check Save.-Check Check NW Configuration.-Click Execute.-The program is displayed.-A second entry in the Communication Arrangement for the communication scenario “Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions” is created.-The Communication Type is B2B and the Communication Partner is Treasury Intelligence Solutions GmbH.-You can check this in the frontend as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Communication Arrangements subview in the Input and Output view.-Search and select the “Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions”Communication Scenario.-There are two communication scenarios:-The communication scenario “Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions” with no communication type and no communication partner.-The second communication scenario “Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions” with the Communication Type is B2B and the Communication Partner is Treasury Intelligence Solutions GmbH.-Click open the second communication arrangement.-The Service URL has reset to "https://app1.tis.biz:8443/apps/btm/ws/WebServiceApi/v1_1/soap1_1"-You need to change this to "https://api-mtls.eu.tispayments.com:443/apps/btm/ws/WebServiceApi/v1_3/soap1_1"-  Change the URL in the backend as follows:-Request support user with access level name SAP_SUPPORT_L6.-Login to the backend.-Enter transaction SESFTS.-Load BO by Proxy Name: /DOC/MBCA.-Click Load by Query and select Root- QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter MessageCommunicationProfileGroupKey/ProxyName as FIN_PAY_BANK_TIS-Click ok.-You can see two lines.-Select the line with PartnerIdentitiferTypeCode/content as BUP001.-Click Navigate and select SERVICE_SPECIFICATION.-Select the node with Name as FIN_BS_TIS_OUT.-Click Form View Icon.-The expected WebURIDocumentPathName is apps/btm/ws/WebServiceApi/v1_3/soap1_1.-In this system it is shown as apps/btm/ws/WebServiceApi/v1_1/soap1_1.-Correction:-Click Edit Icon and select Edit.-Correct the WebURIDocumentPathName to apps/btm/ws/WebServiceApi/v1_3/soap1_1.-Now, you also need to adjust the HOST_NAME and TCP_PORT_ID to the new TIS domain, according to the tenant type (Production/Test) and region (TIS US/EU domains). You also need to redeploy the communication arrangement and adjust the proxy settings in the webservice configuration. For these changes, Refer to KBA 2689407 - Integrate SAP Business ByDesign With Treasury Intelligence Solutions (TIS) -Once you change the WebURIDocumentPathName, HOST_NAME,  TCP_PORT_ID, redeploy the communication arrangement and adjust the proxy settings in the web service configuration, the connection to TIS shall be working properly.-In Application and User Management, you find two communication scenarios:-The communication scenario “Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions” with no communication type and no communication partner.-The second communication scenario “Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions” with the Communication Type is B2B and the Communication Partner is Treasury Intelligence Solutions GmbH.-The service url is "https://api-mtls.eu.tispayments.com:443/apps/btm/ws/WebServiceApi/v1_3/soap1_1"-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Batches view.-Search for Payment Batch DEF and select it.-Click the settings icon and select Send Batch.-The Payment Batch has been sent and is now in status In Transfer.-Keywords-payment batch; TIS; Keine Kommunikationsvereinbarung für Geschäftspartner

Title: System Crash When Adding New Time Profile
Content: Symptom-The system crashes when trying to add a new time profile for an employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Mark the affected employee and click Edit button.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Add Row to create a new Time Profile.-Go to "Time Account Rules" on the sub menu of the time profile.-Change the any time account rule .-Select Save.-Cause-When a new row is added to the Time profile, and before saving it, attempt is being made to modify the Time account rule for the newly created profile. -Resolution-Follow below steps to resolve the issue:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the employee and click Edit button.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Add Row to create a new Time Profile.-Select Save.-Go to "Time Account Rules" on the sub menu of the time profile.-Change the any time account rule .-Select Save.-Keywords-System crash, Time profile, Time Account Rules,, Copy Time profile,

Title: Unposted Supplier Invoice due to error "Referenced item XX-1 of Contract XX not found"
Content: Symptom-A supplier invoice document is unposted due to the following error message:--"Referenced item XX-1 of Contract XX not found"-Note: XX-1 refers to the Contract line item and XX refers to the Contract ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Select the relevant Unposted Supplier Invoice Document ID.-The error message is 'Referenced item XX-1 of Contract XX not found'.-Cause-The contract item XX-1 included in the Supplier Invoice ABC is canceled. An invoice with the canceled contract cannot be posted.-Resolution-The supplier invoice ABC has to be canceled and both the original and the canceled invoice has to be marked as irrelevant.-To mark the documents as irrelevant, the cancellation invoice must be set as irrelevant first, which will automatically mark the original invoice as irrelevant. Upon opening the business transaction for accounting for the cancellation invoice, the button Mark as Irrelevant will be enabled.-(Here ABC refers to Supplier invoice)-See Also-1864680 - Cannot Set Supplier Invoice as Irrelevant in Closing Cockpit - Unposted Source Documents-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Unposted Source Document, Contract, Referenced item of contract.

Title: "ADS Render Failed No Variant found" Error in Document Preview
Content: Symptom-Even though corresponding forms are defined, the system issues the error message "ADS render failed" during the form output of a document. Also any attempt to preview fails with this error message.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example case:-Go to New Business work center-Go to Sales Quote view-Select a sales quote-Select Preview-Error: ADS Render Failed No Variant found. -Cause-The document (in the given example: a sales quote) refers to an account. For this account, there is a defined sender country & a defined language. But for the document template (in the given example: Quote) there is no variant with the same combination of country & language.-Resolution-To enable preview and output, maintain a document template variant with the same combination as in the account.-Keywords-Template; Rendering; Sales Quote; Service Quote; ADS; Preview; Output

Title: How to Find the Current Expense Report Approver Determination Setting?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to find the current expense report approver determination setting in the backend?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Login to the backend of the system.-Run T-code SE38.-Enter the report ERM_SET_APPROVAL_SWITCH and Execute.-In the first line you can see the entry Current ERM approval settings.-Keywords-Expense Report, Determination, Approver, SE38

Title: How to Update Existing Expense Report Approval Process
Content: Symptom-The approval process of the Expense Report is being attempted to be created, but the ability to create the change project is currently unavailable. The process of changing or updating the existing approval process is desired to be known.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The existing Expense Report Approval process can be updated by delimiting the validity with a new process using the Copy button.-Go to Application & User Management Work Center.-Then, go to the Task Distribution view and click on the Approval Processes link.-The Default approval process for Expense Report will be displayed.-Select the process and click on the Copy button.-Enter the new Process Name and define conditions according to your preference, then save the changes.-Once the new process is created and available in draft mode, the validity needs to be changed.-The new process should be selected and the "Edit Validity" button should be pressed.-The existing active process and the newly created process will be displayed.-In the old process, the "Unlimited Validity" check box should be removed and the "Validity To" date should be updated.-In the new process, the "Valid From" date should be updated (similar to the "Validity To" date of the old process) and the "Unlimited Validity" option should be selected.-Once the defined start date/time arrives, the new process will be automatically enabled.-Keywords- Expense Report, Approval Process, Update

Title: Custom Work Center/ Fields Developed in a Particular Solution are not Visible on UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports an incident saying they have deployed the PDI solution into their production system but the changes are not reflecting in the UI screen whereas in the test system the changes are visible.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Case 1:-The cause for the issue is the scoping is not done in the production system for the relevant change.-Note: Customer would say that they have not done any scoping for this change in their test system but still it is working there then why not in the production system.-The reason for this is default scoping elements are available in the test system and changes will take affect automatically even though the scoping changes are not made manually, but in production system this is not available and has to do it manually(Either in test system before deploying to production system or in production system directly).-Case 2:-The scoping is done correctly in the business configuration but still the changes are not reflecting.-Resolution-Case 1:-You could check whether the scoping is done for the solution or not by the following steps:--Step 1: Find the BAC element of the PDI solution that is required to be scoped in Business Configuration.-Login to the backend of the affected tenant.-Enter the transaction XREP.-Switch the layer to the development layer for the affected solution. Please see KBA for steps on how to do this: 2570850 - How to Use The Backend Transaction XREP -You will see 3 folders, expand the Development folder.-Look for the BC folder of this solution. (i.e. YXXXXXX_BC).-Expand the SRC folder.-Double-click on the file ending with .bac.-Open the XML tab.-Select the text in the tag <ElementID>BAC_NAME</ElementID>.-  Step 2: To check if the BAC element from the PDI solution is scoped or not.-Go to transaction BCE.-From the drop down choose BC Projects.-Enter * in the BC Projects field, select TRUE in Main and hit enter. This will open the Main Workspace.-Expand the BC Project to find Scope Selection.-Expand Scope Selection, and double click on Scoping.-Select the button: Scoping (With Question).-Select the find icon (it is an image of binoculars) enter the Element ID you found in XREP. (do not enter the <ElementID> only enter BAC_NAME)-The search will then highlight the element from the PDI solution.-Here you will see a column called Status.-If Status is not checked for the highlighted scoping question, it means the solution is not scoped.-  Step 3: Identify the scoping question which needs to be selected in the UI screen.-Logon to frontend UI.-Navigate to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the project and click on the button Edit Project Scope.-Check in the Scoping tab whether the relevant node is scoped or not, if not scope it.-Go to the Questions tab, find the relevant element, expand and find out the question which you find out in the step 1.-You can see that for this question the check box is not selected.-Inform the customer to select the check box for the question and complete the scoping.-Case 2:-If the scoping is done properly in the business configuration implementation project and still the changes in the solution are not reflecting in the UI, then check the following steps:-Repeat till the step 4 mentioned in the 1st step of case 1.-Expand the Development folder and look for the MAIN folder of the solution. In this example YXXXXXX_MAIN.-Once the solution is scoped (can verify again by the steps mentioned in the step 2 of case 1) then the MAIN folder should be available.-In case the MAIN folder is missing, please follow KBA: 3554270 - Missing MAIN solution after PDI deployment-In case the MAIN folder exists and still the changes in the solution are not seen, forward the case to the development component AP-RC-UIF-XTS. -See Also-2570850 - How to Use The Backend Transaction XREP-Keywords-Custom, Work Centre, Work Center, Not Visible, Cannot See, Missing, Scope, BCE, Element, BAC,

Title: Error message 'Error during update of the local file' when deleting Custom or Extension Screens in Cloud Studio.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The partner has deleted some custom/extension UIs in an MCS/CSS solution via Cloud studio solution explorer but the screens are not deleted and you see following error message: -'Error during update of the local file'-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer -SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio -Reproducing the Issue-1. Open solution in Cloud Studio. -2. Try to delete screens. -3. You see the following in the output window 'Error during update of the local file'.-Cause-There are references to the deleted files in the backend which have not deleted correctly. -Resolution-Check the following: -In Cloud application studio - Project explorer you can the see screens but when you try to open the screens in the UI designer and you see that nameOfFile.uicomponent does not exist. -Open the UI designer and go to configuration explorer window, you see that the folder Y123455_MAIN/SRC/abcdefg.Uicomponent is empty in the configuration explorer. -Check Xrep and you see that the files do not appear in either layer-Solution.  -Create a development incident with AP-RC-UIF as they need to remove these references so that the files no longer appear in the solution explorer.-Keywords-Error during update of the local file-Delete UI -Custom UI -Extension UI -UI screens -MCS-PDI

Title: Location Contains Logistics Area that Allows Negative Stock
Content: Symptom-You are trying to uncheck the the indicator Negative Stock Allowed for a specific Site or Location. However, an error 'Location ABC contains logistics area that allows negative stock' occurs which stops you to do that.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to the Locations View.-Search for the specific Site or Location and select it.-Choose Edit button.-Uncheck the indicator, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-There are logistics areas which marked as negative stock allowed below this specific Site/ Location, causing an expected error reporting.-Resolution-To resolve this error, you should first check the marking status of all sub-logistics areas under this Site/ Location by following the steps below.-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to the Locations View.-Search for the specific Site or Location and select it.-Choose Edit Layout button.-Check each line of the logistics areas which under the Site/ Location and make sure the indicator Negative Stock Allowed is unchecked.-Choose Save and Close.-After this, you would be able to uncheck the mentioned indicator at the Location/ Site Level.-See Also-2709628 - Error message appears when trying to uncheck the Flag in Negative Stock Allowed for Logistics Area-3074612 - Negative Stock Not Permitted For Logistics Area Under Storage Location ABC-Keywords-Location Contains Logistics Area that Allows Negative Stock, Negative Stock Allowed, Location, Site

Title: Journal Entry Voucher of Type Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable not Available for Clearing
Content: Symptom-You want to clear an open Customer Invoice XYZ over 1,000.00 EUR with an Accounts Receivable Credit recorded in a Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable ABC.-This entry, however, is not available for clearing in the Customer Account Monitor. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts object work list.-Select the desired account.-Click View button.-Click Trade Receivables tab.-Click Invoices / Payments tab.-Cause-Manual Journal Entry Voucher (MJEV) ABC has the following characteristics.-Journal Entry Type:  00085 - Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable-Business Transaction Type: 628 - Manual Write-Up/Write-Down Accounts Rec-Cr:  1,000.00 EUR-This entry does affect the Accounts Receivable Balance and will show in related AR Reports as 'Accounts Receivable - Line Items'.-This, however, does not present a reconcilable item. -The purpose of such a MJEV is the adjustment of AR/AP balances for a particular key date. -For AR/AP only actual documents can be cleared (invoices, credit memos, payments, other receivable/payables).-Resolution-In order to clear invoice XYZ over 1,000.00 EUR in the absence of suitable documents - you would have to create a document of type 'Other Payable' in the Customer Account Monitor.-Press New Charge/Credit.-In field Charge/Credit select '2 - Customer Credit'.-Select a Posting Date relating to an open period.-Under G/L Account select the G/L Account which will be debited.-After posting Other Payables DEF is created and shows as reconcilable document in the Customer Account Monitor.

Title: Service Confirmation Remains Not Started Though the Lines are Cancelled
Content: Symptom-You have cancelled the service confirmation but find the status of the confirmation remains Not Started.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Go to the Service Confirmations view.-Open the confirmation ABC, the status is Not Started. (ABC represents the ID of the service confirmation)-In the General tab, the Reason for Rejection is filled and in the Services and Spare Parts tab, the item Reason for Rejection is filled as well. The Cancellation Status is Cancelled.-You expects the status of the confirmation should be Finished.-Cause-The service confirmation is cancelled before released, so the document and item status remain Not Started, even though the document is cancelled.-Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior.-Keywords-service confirmation; status; not started; cancellation status; cancelled.

Title: Error while uploading Budget release: Budget category is greater than the planned amount
Content: Symptom-When trying to upload the Budget Release MS Excel file an error message appears: "Budget category XYZ is greater than the planned amount." (XYZ represents a budget category ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Budget Release view.-Press New - Budget Release from Microsoft Excel. -In the Excel file,  in the SAP Business ByDesign tab, log on to your system and then enter all the respective data.-To upload press Save data to. -The error message "Budget category XYZ is greater than the planned amount" appears. -Cause-The amounts entered in your budget release file for budget category/ cost center XYZ are different to the values entered for the same budget category/ cost center in your default budget plan: -To find your budget plan-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center. -Find the Planning view. -Now find your default budget plan (find the plan where Default appears with a green tick. Ideally, the plan version has the same ID as your release version) and open it. -Go to the Plan Data tab. -Check for budget category/ cost center XYZ. Compare all the values. You will find a value that appears lower than maintained in the budget release.-Example: -In your budget plan V1 (V1 stands for version 1) a value, say 100,00 LC, is maintained for each period of fiscal year YYYY (LC stands for local currency). Altogether,  a total result of 1200,00 LC is calculated in the Plan data report. -In your budget release file you entered the whole yearly budget, 1200,00 LC into period 1 of fiscal year YYYY. -The error message now appears as the plan value in period 1 of year YYYY is only 100,00 LC. -Resolution-In the budget release file maintain exactly the same values as maintained in the budget plan: -In the Planning view of the Cost and Revenue work center,  find your default budget plan and open it. -Go to the Plan Data tab. -Check for budget category/ cost center XYZ. Compare all the values with the budget release file. -All values entered in the budget release must be maintained exactly the same way as in the budget plan. -So, regarding the example, for period 1, 2, 3...12 enter 100,00 LC rather than the whole yearly budget in one period only. -See Also-Enter Budget Release Data-Keywords-Budget category is greater than the planned amount, budget release, budget plan, upload

Title: System Asks For Save Changes on Dialog Box After Clicking Close Button
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." --Dialog box appears asking to save changes when attempting to close an approval task, despite no changes being made.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the tenant.-Search for Work Center "Managing My Area".-Click on Approvals.-Select and edit a purchase order and click on "Edit" button.-Click on "Close" Button.-A dialog box appears asking if you want to save the changes in the system even though no changes were made.--Cause-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-Keywords-ByD, Save Dialog, Approval Task, Close Button

Title: Issue With Releasing Outbound Delivery in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-System dumps while releasing Outbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Outbound Deliveries view. -Find and select the relevant Outbound Delivery.-Click Release.-System dumps.-Refresh the screen and open the Outbound Delivery in Edit mode.-Click Check Consistency. -The system returns the following error message: Status of project task ABC (P not 'Started' or 'Released' (ABC represents the Project Task ID).-Cause-The issue is related to the Status of the Project and Project Task which is Completed.-Resolution-Revoke the Completion of the Project/Project Task.-Ensure the Status of the Project and Project Task is Released.-Now you will be able to Release the Outbound Delivery.-See Also-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Outbound Delivery, Release, System dumps, Project Task Status, Consistency Check, Error Message.

Title: Delay in Availability of Mass Data Run WCVIEW in Work Center Role Assignment
Content: Symptom-A Mass Data Run (MDR) view created for a specific project is not immediately available in the work centers to be assigned to a role.-This delay in availability may cause some concerns.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Mass Data Run (MDR) for a specific project.-Attempt to view and assign the MDR within the work centers to a role.-Resolution-To make the MDR WCView to appear on the Role Assignment faster, do the following:-Deploy the business configuration on SDK to make the MDR appear in the role assignment.-Monitor the role assignment to confirm the MDR's availability.-See Also-Keywords-Mass Data Run, MDR, delay, availability, work centers, role assignment, business configuration.

Title: How to Prevent Output While Creating Purchase Orders Using Web Service?
Content: Symptom-You would like to use the "Prevent Output" indicator while creating new purchase orders using web service. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the External system-Use Web service ManagePurchaseOrderIn -Create purchase orders from an external system-Use ManagePurchaseOrderIn service interface and Operation ManagePurchaseOrderInMaintainBundle -Cause-You can use the indicator <PreventDocumentOutputIndicator>true</PreventDocumentOutputIndicator> to prevent the output. -Resolution-You can go to the Purchase Order payload, use the indicator <PreventDocumentOutputIndicator>true</PreventDocumentOutputIndicator>. This will help you to prevent out and avoid sending the document to the supplier. -Note:-In addition to this, you can use the below indicators.-<OrderPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>true</OrderPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>-<CancelPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>true</CancelPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>-<FinishDeliveryPOActionIndicator>true</FinishDeliveryPOActionIndicator>-<FinishInvoicePOActionIndicator>true</FinishInvoicePOActionIndicator>-Keywords-Prevent Output in purchase order; <PreventDocumentOutputIndicator>true</PreventDocumentOutputIndicator>

Title: Error Message "Language code is not valid" in Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When releasing a project invoice request, system raises error message: Language code is not valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Project Invoice Requests view-Open project invoice request ABC (ABC refers to the project invoice request ID)-Press check, the error message comes-Cause-In project invoice request, there are multiple parities available:-project owner company (seller company)-customer (buyer company)-end customer (only available in intercompany/third party scenarios)-Check the company/account master data, you can find the language maintained for each of the companies.-If the language is not in business configuration scope, the error 'Language code is not valid' raises when releasing project invoice request.-Resolution-Enable the missing language in the system follow below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open fine-tuning activity: Additional Communication Languages.-Add the missing language.-Save the changes.-Once all the required languages enabled in the system, the project invoice request can be released without the error.-See Also-Keywords-Language Code, Not Valid, Project Invoice Request, Business Configuration, Additional Communication Languages, Language Change.

Title: Workflow Rule Creation for Project Stock Orders Not Available
Content: Symptom-The option for creating a Workflow Rule for Project Stock Orders is not available in the Application and User Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Workflow Rules view.-Click on New.-Open the dropdown for Business Object.-Notice that there is no option for Project Stock Order.-Cause-The current system does not support the creation of a Workflow Rule for Project Stock Orders or E-mail Notification since no related standard tasks/notifications are found in the Home - Inbox in Subscribe to Tasks.-Resolution-System behavior.-See Also-Keywords-Project Management, Workflow Rule, Project Stock Orders, Application and User Management

Title: Release Button Remains Enabled in Contract Despite All Items Being Released
Content: Symptom-Release option is still enabled when contract is with status In Process-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders - Contracts-Select the Contract ABC (ABC represents the sales order ID)-Click on Edit-Select Submit button-Release option is still enabled.-Cause-You have maintained Reason for Rejection for a line item which is with status In Preparation. -Resolution-You need to use Remove button to cancel/remove the line items which are with status In Preparation in contract instead of maintaining Reason for Rejection. -See Also-Keywords-ECC, EKPO-COMP, intra-company, sto, transport, ekpo, umson, automatically, free item, free, lumf, automatically, automatic, intracompany, inter, intercompany, ME21, Create Purchase Order Advanced, stock, condition, pricing, missing, tab, po, free item, umson, automatically, automatic, intracompany, inter, intercompany, OMS2, Purchase Order Advanced.

Title: The List View Disappears When Selecting Value Help in the 'Account' Field
Content: Symptom-When a value is entered in the 'Account' field and a value help is selected, the value help/list view disappears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Below is an example,-Go to Service Desk workcenter-Go to New Service Order view-Start typing in the 'Account' field and click the list view selection.-The list view only briefly pops up and then disappears-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-When a value is entered in the 'Account' field, the system automatically displays a default value along with a dropdown of suggested names. It expects the user to select from these available options, which is why the list view does not appear on the screen.-However, when you enter some text and place the cursor at the end before selecting the value help, the list view appears as expected.-Keywords-SAP Business, List View, Account and Contact, UI Element, Value Help, Dropdown, System Behavior.

Title: Error: Only 12 digits before the decimal point and 3 decimal places permitted.
Content: Symptom-When creating new planning proposal, error triggered: Only 12 digits before the decimal point and 3 decimal places permitted. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supply Planning-Access common task New Planning Proposal-Maintain all mandatory fields, maintain a quantity with over three decimals places.-Click Save, error triggered: Only 12 digits before the decimal point and 3 decimal places permitted. -Cause-Planning allows maximum of 3 decimals.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Planning, Decimal

Title: The Ship-to Party and Address are Different in the Master and follow-up Sales Orders in the 3PL Scenario Created via Webservice
Content: Symptom-In the 3PL scenario created through the webservice, the ship-to party and address are different in the Master and Follow-up sales orders-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-View: Sales Orders.-Search and edit ABC (ABC is the sales order id of master sales order).-Navigate to document flow and open the follow-up sales order DEF (DEF is the sales order id of follow-up sales order).-The ship-to party in sales order ABC is XX and YY in sales order DEF (XX and YY are ship-to party of sales orders).-The expectation is to have ship-to party in both the sales orders ABC and DEF.-Cause-The ship-to party, bill-to party, and address information were provided in the payload while creating the master sales order. The follow-up sales order retrieves the data from the account master data.-If the ship-to party in the sales order is different from the one maintained in the master data, the account name is used as the ship-to party and displayed in the follow-up sales order.--Note: Even if you enter the same ship-to party and address details that are maintained in the master data, it displays the account name as the ship-to party and the main address as the address because you are overwriting the master data information.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. Please do not pass the Ship-to party, bill to party, and address in the payload as it overwrites the information from the account master data.--The system will retrieve the information maintained in the master data and display the same ship-to party and address details in both sales orders, which are maintained in the account master data.-Keywords-Ship-to; Bill-to; Address; Account; 3PL; Intercompany; Webservice; SOAP; Incorrect; Sales Order

Title: Error: Posting date invalid due to closed accounting period; contact Accounting - Despite Period Being Open
Content: Symptom-You attempt to manually clear open Customer Invoice XYZ in the Account Monitor.-Immediately an error shows as 'Posting date invalid due to closed accounting period; contact Accounting (KBA: 1956938)'.-You enter a Posting Date referring to an open accounting period in all relevant Sets of Books; for example 31.12.2024.-This, however, does not eliminate the error. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts object work list.-Select the desired account.-Click View button.-Click Trade Receivables tab.-Click Invoices / Payments tab.-Select Invoice XYZ and click Clear Manually.-An error shows as 'Posting date invalid due to closed accounting period; contact Accounting (KBA: 1956938)'.-Cause-Customer Invoice XYZ has a Posting Date referring to a closed financial period; for example 31.10.2023.-Usually you would attempt to clear multiple items. The first selected item (here the only item invoice XYZ) - will default the Posting - and Clearing Date in the clearing object.-Since October 2023 is blocked this error is provoked.-Resolution-In order to clear Invoice XYZ, first select an AR item referring to an open period.-Such documents include invoices, credit memos, payments, other receivable/payables.-You will now be able to effect a clearing with a Posting Date/Clearing Date - earliest consistent with the Posting Date of selected AR item in an open period.

Title: How to Mark a Concur Cash Advance as Posting Failed/ Obsolete
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the Cash Advance view there are cash advances with status 6-In process or 3-Posting failed.-You are requested to mark these documents as obsolete from the backend. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center go to the Concur Cash Advance view. -Find cash advance XXX with status Posting failed (XXX represents the cash advance ID). -You are requested to mark the document as Obsolete. -Resolution-After receiving customer permission for the backend change, access STFK. -Use transaction SESFTS to access the test shell.-Load BO FIA_FAV_EXT_EXPENSE_REPORT.-Choose Load by Query and select CASH_ADVANCE_DATA - SELECT_ALL.-To display all the documents use the Table view. -In the the CahsAdvanceKey column find document XXX. -Press Navigate and choose TO_ROOT.-Press Edit. -In the LifeCycleStatusCode field change the value from 3-Posting failed to 5 - obsolete.-See Also- 2869408 - How to Mark Expense Reports from Concur as Posting Failed from Backend-Keywords-Concur cash advance, mark cash advance obsolete

Title: Data missing in offline mode
Content: Symptom-Custom EC data are not display in Offline Mode-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Visits work center view.-Open the visit with ID 1.-Navigate to the Custom EC tab, where you should be able to see the entries.-Click on the User icon.-Go to the Offline Model.-Open the visit with ID 1.-Notice that the records in the Custom EC tab are not visible.-Cause-The secondary relationship can be defined in the custom object using the annotation [OfflineSecondary] at the element declaration in the BO definition.--/YABCDEFGH_MAIN/SRC/CustomBO.bo-[OfflineEnabled]businessobject CustomBO {-        [OfflineSecondary(AP.PC.ActivityManagement.Global:Activity.UUID)][AlternativeKey][Label("Visit UUID")]    element VisitUUID                : UUID;-}-     There is an inconsistence with deployment of the secondary relationship mapped between the BO Activity and the CustomBO.-The reason is that multiple Custom BOs will deployed at the same time,  leading to conflicts.-         Resolution-Please reactivate the /YABCDEFGH_MAIN/SRC/CustomBO.bo If the issue persists, kindly open a case request backend active with the component AP-RC-BDS-OFL. -Recommendation: Adminstrator->Offline Settings->Related Data Download set the default setting to "Only first level" and not "All" for performance reasons. -The "All" setting typically does not serve a business need in all scenarios. You can maintain specific exceptions in the table below if necessary. -Keywords-offline,Custom BO,Custom EC,no data,OfflineSecondary

Title: Unable to Set Blocked Status for Planning Area in Material Master's Availability Confirmation Tab
Content: Symptom-The issue arises when attempting to update the status as Blocked for a Planning Area in the Availability Confirmation tab of Material Master.-The system does not allow the status to be set to Blocked once the Availability Confirmation is made Active for a Planning Area.-Environment-Available To Promise Check Run-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Product Data Work Center.-Proceed to the Materials View and choose the sub-view Materials.-Search and select the relevant material and choose the relevant option.-Choose the Availability Confirmation tab.-Attempt to change the Status against a planning area to Blocked.-Cause-Only values in the fields Availability Check Scope and other fields available in the screen can be changed.-Resolution-The system is designed such that once the Availability Confirmation is made Active for a Planning Area, the status cannot be set to Blocked.-See Also-Keywords-Material Master, Availability Confirmation, Blocked Status, Planning Area, Product Data Work Center, Materials View, Availability Check Scope.

Title: Incorrect Time Model Assignment in Employee Time Statement
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-An employee was assigned to a new time profile and therefore a new time model. However, the system only recognizes the old time model in the time statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter.-Select Employee View.-Search required employee.-Select employee and choose Time Statement option.-Notice that it shows only the old Time Model.-Cause-The problem occurs due to an inconsistency in the backend. Where there is an extra record with the Planning Category as 2 which is short-term planning.-Because of this extra record the time statement target hours are showing incorrect.-Resolution-We have to delete the Planning Category 2 (short-term planning) record from employee time via backend.-Go to the SESFTS transaction.-Maintain the following BO HCM_EMPLOYEE_SUPP_CO.-Then Load By Query > Root - Query_By_Elements.-Maintain the Employee ID.-Click Navigate to EmployeeTime.-Click Set Edit Mode.-Highlight the wrong Planning Category.-Click Delete button.-Note: In case you are not sure about how to perform the steps in the backend, please contact the ByD Technology PAL or the Development team.-See Also-2512272 - Frequently Asked Questions in Time Administration-Keywords-WRong, Time Model, Time Profile, Working Day, Run Day Closure, Time Statement, Employee, Issue.

Title: Only 10000 records are Displayed When Filtering for All Logs of a Invoice Run
Content: Symptom-When filtering for All Logs for a Invoice Run ID, the latest logs are not displayed. Only the first 10000 logs are displayed in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Go to the Invoice Runs View.-Select the Invoice Run ID ABC (where ABC represents the Invoice Run ID).-Select Execution Details.-Filter for All Logs.- The latest logs are not displayed. Only the first 10000 logs are displayed in the UI.-Cause-When filtering for All Logs of a specific the Invoice Run, the system always display the records from the First Logs created to the Latest Logs created.-Currently for any search performed in the system, there is a restriction in which only the first 10000 records are displayed. This occurs in order to preserve the system performance.-To overcome this behavior, it is always recommended to use the Advance Filter option in order personalize the search so the specific records required are displayed.-However, the Advance filter option is currently not available when filtering for all logs of a Invoice Run ID in the Execution Details tab, therefore it is currently not possible to filter for specific old logs after the 10000 log is register for a Invoice Run ID.-Resolution-This is current the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Invoice Run, Execution Details, 10000, All Logs

Title: Attachments not copied from Shopping cart to Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The Attachments tab in the Header of the Purchase Order does not contain the full list of attachments from Shopping Cart.-The attachments are only visible at Purchase order line item level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for the desired Purchase Order -Navigate to attachments tab, there are no attachments-Cause-Expected System behavior-Resolution-Purchase Order is created with reference to the Shopping cart which has individual attachments at its line item level, the same will be copied to the Purchase Order. Hence, there will be no attachment present at the Purchase Order header level in this scenario. -If any attachment is required at the header level of the Purchase Order, required attachment can be manually attached in the attachments tab of the Purchase Order at the time of creation itself. -Keywords-Purchase order attachment, attachment at purchase order header level, line item level attachments copied

Title: PCE : Solve Document Inconsistency in Project to Process Project Assignment Sent by Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--Process Communication Error in Project : Solve Document Inconsistency in Project to Process Project Assignment Sent by Sales Order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for the Project ID ABC (ABC represents Project ID).-Go to Sales tracking tab.-Select Document flow sub tab.-Process Communication Error in the Project ABC document.-Cause-The status of the Project will be Closed. So, when sales order is linked to this Project , PCE occurs-In Sales Order work center -> Sales Orders view -> search for the Sales Order ID-The Sales Order DEF (DEF represents Sales Order ID)  will not be present in the system, which implies that the sales order was deleted when it was in the status In preparation before/after the project was closed, which could be the reason for the process communication error in the project. -As the Sales order is deleted from the system and the project cannot find the sales order, a PCE is raised at Project.  --Steps to check the PCE in the back-end:-In the back-end, open transaction SRT_MONI.-Select Standard Selection Tab.-Sender Information:-Party: SalesOrderProcessing-Receiver Information: -Interface Name: ProjectProcessingCustomerTransactionDocumentAndProjectAssignmentIn-Select the relevant failed message from the results and verify that it corresponds to Sales Order DEF.-Resolution-Create an incident to Development team with the component SRD-PRO-PMN.-Get the customer’s approval to cancel the failed message. Development team will cancel the failed message and its sequence messages in the backend, resulting the task to Completed state.-Keywords-Process communication error in project; Sales order not available in the system; Solve Document Inconsistency in Project to Process Project Assignment Sent by Sales Order

Title: How to Activate Communication Arrangement With Partner Treasury Intelligence Solutions (TIS)
Content: Symptom-How to activate communication arrangement with partner Treasury Intelligence Solutions (TIS).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Prerequisites:-You have created a case already and the TIS add-on activation is done from SAP.-The Scoping question 'Direct Bank Communication - Do you want to select Treasury Intelligence Solutions to use payment batches?' in Business Configuration work center -> Implementation Projects view -> Edit Project Scope ->  4. Questions -> Scoping Element: Cash Flow Management -> Payment and Liquidity Management -> Communication for Payment and Liquidity is scoped.-Steps to activate Communication Arrangement:-Create supplier master data entry for TIS.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Integrate and Extend activity Service Provider – Treasury Intelligence Solutions (either from the Business Configuration Overview or from the Activity List of the Implementation Project). -Create the supplier master data entry for TIS and Ensure that the supplier ID, country, and the Dun & Bradstreet (D-U-N-S) number (to be found using the Additional Identifiers link) 341556023 are included and correct.-Note: You must create a supplier master data entry for TIS before you can activate the communication arrangement with TIS.-Activate the communication arrangement and communicate the system ID as well as the client certificate to TIS.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Fine-Tune activity Treasury Intelligence Solutions – Communication Arrangement.-Click Open -> Click Activate communication arrangement.-Activate communication with partner Treasury Intelligence Solutions by setting the corresponding indicator.-Press Save and Close.-Download the client certificate.-Navigate to the communication arrangement by clicking on the relevant communication scenario.-Make a note of the ID given for the My System field.-Save the certificate (file name extension ".CER") to your hard drive.-Select that file and either zip it or rename it to a .txt file.-Communicate client certificate and system ID to TIS (Certificate Exchange)-Contact TIS’s customer service OR Send an e-mail including the system ID and the client certificate to TIS’s customer service at:-info@tis.biz and send them the client certificate for identification purposes.-Into SAP Business ByDesign - Download the latest certificate available on the TIS server and add it to the certificate trust list in ByDesign system (refer to KBA 2938607 - How to Upload the Latest Certificate from Treasury Intelligence Solution to ByDesign System for more detailed steps).-See Also-Help document:-About the Payment Service Provider TIS (Treasury Intelligence Solutions)-Keywords-TIS, communication arrangement with partner Treasury Intelligence Solutions-tis,activate communication arrangement

Title: An Error Occurs When Trying to Create a Service Quote with the Reference to a Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a Service Quote with the Reference to an existing Sales Quote, the data is loaded into the new Service Quote.-Upon saving, an ID appears to be created, but the following error occurs and the Service Quote cannot be saved: -You are not authorized to change the data-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Service Quotes view.-Click on New and select Service Quote.-In the New Service Quote, click on the Create with Reference button.-In Reference Type, select Quote.-In Reference ID, select XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Quote).-Click on OK.-The following errors occur: -You are not authorized to change the data-Save failed.-Cause-The error occurs because creating a Service Quote with the Reference to a Sales Quote is currently not supported.-It is also not possible to create a Service Quote as a follow-up document of a Sales Quote via the Follow-Up button.-Resolution-This is the current system behvaviour.-  This is a new requirement. In order for you to directly get in contact with the decision makers in SAP Product Management, please submit your enhancement request via the following SAP Continuous Influence sites: SAP Business ByDesign-See Also-Keywords-Service Quote, Quote, Sales Quote, Create with Reference, Unauthorized, Follow-Up, Reference, Sales Quote, not authorized,

Title: Outbound Logistics Control - Release Option for Customer Demand Grayed Out
Content: Symptom-In the Outbound Logistics Control Work center, the release option for Customer Demand is grayed out. This issue is observed specifically for Sales Orders with the status "Not Released" and Delivery Type "Third-Party".-Environment- SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Control Work center-Select the Customer Demand view-Apply a filter for "Third-Party" in the Delivery type-Select an Order id and observe that the Release button is grayed out-Cause-The Sales Order is in a "Cancelled" status, which is preventing the release for delivery.-This can be verified following the below steps:-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Control Work center-Select the Customer Demand view-Apply a filter for "Third-Party" in the Delivery type-Select an Order id and scroll down to the General tab and observe that the Cancellation Status is Cancelled-Resolution-This is the expected standard system behavior. The system does not allow the release for delivery for Sales Orders that are in a "Cancelled" status.-See Also-Keywords-Outbound Logistics Control, Customer Demand, Release Option, Grayed Out, Sales Order, Cancelled Status, Delivery Type, Third-Party.

Title: ISAgent status is not correct in ISAdmin
Content: Symptom-The ISAgent was deployed manually and the corresponding Java stack was restarted but the status in ISAdmin is wrong, e.g. "Running but needs restart".-** Java parameters were applied correctly on Java of Monitored system and ISAgent is running without problems.-Environment-ISAgent 10.5.2, ISAgent 10.7.0-Reproducing the Issue-Deploy the ISAgent manually.-Cause-There are some problems for recognizing the status of the ISAgent when the manual deployment was done.-Resolution-Check the path "<drive>:\usr\sap\ccms\wily" (where the ISAgent was deployed) whether the below files exist:-ISAgentSetup.error_*-ISAgentSetup.properties_*-If files exists, move those to another folder so that those cannot be recognized.-Restart the corresponding monitored Java system.-Keywords-wrong status, manual setup, bytecodeagent, byte code agent

Title: Impossible to Perform Adjustment Confirmation For a Warehouse Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform Adjustment Confirmation against a Warehouse Order, but Enable Entry is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Monitoring view and select By Warehouse Order. -Find and select the relevant Warehouse Order ID.-Click Edit.-Click Adjustment Confirmation.-Select any of the Line Items.-"Enable Entry" is inactive although the Warehouse Order is Finished and the Outbound Delivery is Not Released.-Further, it can be seen that the Fulfilled Quantity for all Line Items is zero ea.-If you open the relevant Outbound Delivery and proceed to its Line Items, you can seen all Items have Delivery Quantity 0 ea and the Cancellation status: Canceled. The Outbound Delivery has been reversed and should have been cancelled.-You can also see that the relevant Warehouse Request is cancelled.-Cause-You have already adjusted the Fulfilled Quantity of the Warehouse Order / Outbound Delivery to zero and so Enable Entry is justifiably no longer active. You cannot reverse a reversal.-Resolution-We recommend you also cancel the Outbound Delivery. If it is necessary to deliver the Items to the customer, please create a new Delivery document.-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center and to the Delivery Proposals view.-Kindly create a new Warehouse Request (subsequently new Pick Task) or Post Goods Issue against the relevant Outbound Delivery Request.-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Enable Entry, Eintrag Aktivieren, Korrekturbuchung, Adjustment Confirmation, Warehouse Order, Lagerauftrag

Title: Pro-Forma Invoice Generation is Not Supported via Odata
Content: Symptom-It is necessary to generate Pro-Forma Invoice out of sales orders or outbound deliveries by using Odata interface. It was set up Odata service with object 'ProformaGeneration' and executed it, but error was faced and failed to generate the Pro-Forma invoice as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It is not supported to create a Pro Forma Invoice and save it via Odata.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior. It is feasible to do this via PDI development.-But how to do this would be a project specific consulting question. For further or future questions of this nature we suggest to contact the implementation partner.-Keywords-OData; GenerateProForma; ProFormaGeneration; Pro-Forma Invoice.

Title: Attachments In Invoice Documents not Carried Over to Follow Up Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a new follow-up Manual Invoice Request from an Invoice Document, the attachment is not passed to the new Invoice Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Document View.-Search for the document XYZ. (XYZ refers to the Invoice Document ID).-Create a Follow-up, New Manual Invoice Request. -The Attachment is not carried over to the Invoice Request.-Cause-Attachments will not reflect from the Invoice Document to the Manual Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Alternatively, a new Improvement Request can be submitted on SAP Customer Influence website.-See Also-2780151 - Sales Order Attachments are not visible in corresponding Project invoice Requests -2354355 - Attachments in Purchase Order to Supplier Invoice -Keywords-Attachments, Invoice Document, Follow Up, Invoice Request

Title: Broadcast Failing with "Asynchronous error (non-final) sending mail to" Error Message
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Broadcasts are failing with some unknown error messages.-No delivery to <e-mail address>, as recipient unknown-Asynchronous error (non-final) sending mail to <e-mail address>-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Broadcasts work center view.-Search for Affected Broadcast.-Click on "Start Immediately".-The following errors are displayed.-No delivery to <e-mail address>, as recipient unknown-Asynchronous error (non-final) sending mail to <e-mail address>-Cause-Recipient has either marked a previous e-mail from sender as spam or the e-mail address is identified as invalid. Then, this e-mail address has been added to suppression list and those e-mails are not delivered.-For confirming it, follow these steps:-Go to Backend. -Navigate to SCOT transaction.-Expand Outbound Send Request.-Confirm if e-mail has been triggered to the affected e-mail address. -If yes, expand Inbound Send Request.-An entry will be displayed having "Delivery Status Notification (Failure)" for the affected e-mail address.-Open it.-The error message "An error occurred while trying to deliver the mail to the following recipients:<e-mail address>" will be displayed.-Click on Delivery Status Notification.-The error message "Amazon SES did not send the message to this address because it is on the suppression list for your account." will be displayed.-Resolution-Open an incident with the operations team and request them to remove the Email ID's from the Suppression List. As soon as e-mail address gets removed from Suppression List, those e-mails will be delivered properly.-See Also-3309322 - Email Not Delivered to Recipient: No delivery to Email ID: XYZ, as recipient unknown-Keywords-Amazon SES did not send the message to this address because it is on the suppression list for your account, broadcast, no delivery to, as recipient unknown, Asynchronous error (non-final) sending mail to, report, dashboard, error

Title: How to Generate SAT Trace and Report of Optimizations for PDI solutions
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to take a SAT Trace in a customer's system because you discover high PDI time in a particular transaction.-A SAT Trace is used to: -Analyze the Customer's PDI code.-To provide recommendations to improve performance.-To make the custom code run more efficiently.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Reproducing the Issue-To take a SAT Trace:-1. Open the backend to the Customer's system.-2. Enter transaction SAT and execute.-3. Create a Variant XYZ (XYZ represents Variant name).-4. Now set the Aggregation to None.-5. Save this Variant using the Save icon and return to previous screen.-6. Click the button Schedule.-7. You need to determine the Application Server Name in which you are testing on to capture the correct data. -8. Refer back to your HTTP Watch Trace from the system. Chose the last POST request and then click the tab COOKIES.-9. The Format of the Server Name will be vaXXXXXX.-10. Enter this value as the Server Name.-11. Now set the Max no of Sched. Measurements to 4.-12. Set the Process Type to Any.-13. Move to the Customer's front end and prepare the issue reproduction steps so that when you click Schedule Measurement you will capture relevant data. (Example: Clicking Add Products in a Sales Order takes some time to complete).-14. Click Schedule Measurement in the backend and then reproduce the issue in the front end. (Example: Click Add Products in a Sales Order).-15. Go back to the Backend. You will be at the Overview of Scheduled Measurement screen.-You have now completed the SAT Trace.-Report to run for Optimizations for PDI Solutions in the customer system.-16. Open a new browser session and enter transaction SE38.-17. Run the report XPE_PDI_ANALYZE_PERFORMANCE -> Execute.-18. The Add on Performance Evaluation screen will appear. Enter your e-mail address and click Execute.-19. The details will be emailed to you. You can save these emails into a ZIP folder to be forwarded to either the PDI team for further analysis or the Customer.-20. You can then return to the Overview of Scheduled Measurements and delete the measurement.-Resolution-You have now completed your SAT Trace and Report for Optimizations for PDI Solutions.-See Also-2906819 - C4C Performance Issues Split-up among Other Topics-2181520 - How to Measure Network Bandwidth and Latency.-1431064 - How to take a HttpWatch trace in IE and Chrome-Keywords-SDK, PDI, XPE_PDI_ANALYZE_PERFORMANCE, XPE, Analyse, Performance, email, SE38

Title: Error "Document item AA not fulfilled; document is inconsistent" When Trying to Complete Execution for Item via Webservice
Content: Symptom-When creating a Sales Order via E-Shop, you want to Complete Execution for Item in one call, and the error is faced: Document item AA not fulfilled; document is inconsistent. (AA is the Line Item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You are passing the following tag via payload when creating the Sales Order:- <FinishFulfilmentProcessingOfAllItems>true</FinishFulfilmentProcessingOfAllItems>-As response, the system shows an error: Document item AA not fulfilled; document is inconsistent. The fulfillment does not get Completed as expected.-Cause-This error happens because the Confirm Execution was not done;-The Scoping Question: "Would you like your customers to confirm sales orders that originate from an E-Shop with information calculated in the SAP solution?" is active-The Scoping Question: "Would you like your employees to control the release of sales orders that originate from an E-Shop in order to initiate order processing?" is active.-Approval Process should not be scoped.-Resolution-Ensure that the Approval Process for Sales Orders is not in scope-Ensure that the following Scoping Questions are not active:-Would you like your customers to confirm sales orders that originate from an E-Shop with information calculated in the SAP solution?-Would you like your employees to control the release of sales orders that originate from an E-Shop in order to initiate order processing?-When creating the Sales Order via the E-Shop, and you want to Complete Execution, the following tags should be passed in a second call:-<ReleaseAllItemsToExecution>true</ReleaseAllItemsToExecution>-<FinishFulfilmentProcessingOfAllItems>true</FinishFulfilmentProcessingOfAllItems>-Keywords-Sales Order, Complete Execution, Confirm Execution, Webservice; execution; fulfillment; release; scoping; ManageSalesOrderIn; web service;

Title: Unassigned Approval Tasks for Expense Reports
Content: Symptom-In the Business Task Management view of the Application and User Management work center, unassigned approval tasks for expense reports are observed to appear for the key user.-This KBA aims to explain the reasons behind the occurrence of these unassigned tasks and provide guidance on how to handle and resolve them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Unassigned tasks for expense report approval are created due to two possible reasons: firstly, the task may not have the 'Approvals' work center assigned to the user responsible for it. Secondly, the task may not have a designated person responsible based on the approval process definition.-Cause 1: occurs when the approval process definition designates a user as an approver for expense reports but does not have the 'Approvals' work center assigned. The 'Approvals' work center is necessary for authorization to approve expense reports.-Cause 2: happens when the system is unable to determine the person responsible dynamically based on the approval process definition. For example, if the line manager of an employee needs to approve the report but no line manager is defined for that employee.-To determine the specific type of unassigned task, the option to "Re-determine assignment" can be chosen, and the application log that was created can be reviewed. If the unassigned task is caused by the employee not having the 'Approvals' work center view assigned, it is due to Cause 1. If the unassigned task is caused by no responsible approver being found for the document, it is due to Cause 2.-Resolution-Unassigned tasks can be resolved in one of two ways:-1. The assignment of the approval task can be re-determined. In the object work list of the unassigned tasks, the item can be selected and "Re-determine Assignment" can be chosen. The system will attempt to assign the task to the corresponding person responsible, based on the approval process definition. This method is generally effective for unassigned tasks caused by the approval work center not being assigned to the user, but only if the missing work center is assigned to the responsible user.-2. The task can be manually assigned. In the object work list of the unassigned tasks, the item can be selected and "Assign" can be chosen. In the subsequent dialog box, the approver to whom the task should be manually assigned can be selected. This method works for both causes 1 and 2.-Caution: The system verifies the instance authorization of the expense report and only displays possible recipients who match the instance authorization. For example, if an expense report needs to be approved by the line manager, cost center manager, and person X in sequential steps, but the cost center manager does not have the Approvals work center assigned (cause 1), only the line manager, cost center manager, and person X will be shown as possible recipients when attempting to manually assign the task. The assignment to the cost center manager will fail again if the work center is still missing, as this is checked during assignment. For unassigned tasks caused by cause 2, the system will display all users who have the Approvals work center assigned as possible recipients.-If neither solution 1 nor 2 provides a satisfactory resolution, the expense report can be recalled from the approval process. This will eliminate the unassigned approval tasks, and when the expense report is resubmitted for approval, any unassigned tasks should not occur for the second time, ensuring the desired approval is obtained.-Keywords-Expense Report, Approval, Task, No approver found, task is unassigned, unassigned approval tasks

Title: How to Update Value Date in the Payment Allocation from Backend?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 4 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-Payment file is updated with wrong date format and not able to post the Payment Allocation due to below error:-Error: 'Date YYYYDDMM not valid for' -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Select the Payment Allocation view.-Search and find Payment allocation ID XXX (XXX represents that ID of the payment allocation).-Select the hyperlink for Allocation ID XXX.-Confirm that items have been allocated as expected.-Press Post.-Error appears: 'Date YYYYDDMM not valid for' -Click on View All tab and you can see Value date format is wrong YYYYDDMM and it should be MMDDYYYY.-Cause-The cause is wrong date format is updated and this format cannot be updated form the UI. It requires to cancel the payment file and create a new payment file.-(Or) SAP Support can change the Value date format from the backend.-Resolution-To correct this issue, take the permission from the customer to update the correct date from backend.-Log into the backend of the system.-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Open the Payment Allocation BO - FOPXP_PAYAL.-Select Load BO Node Instances -> Load by Query -> FOPXP_PAYALHD - QUERY_BY_ID.-In the Search criteria enter the Payment Allocation ID to the ID/Content field.-Make sure that the amounts that you see in the UI are the same as what you see in the backend. Also make sure the dates are same.-Once you confirm this is the correct Payment Allocation you can NAVIGATE -> ALLOCATED_PAYMENT.-Click on Pencil Icon- Exclusive.-Change the Date format in Expected Bank Value Date field to MMDDYYYY.-Click on Save tab.-Now, Payment allocation can be posted without any error.-Keywords-Value date in payment allocation, Expected bank value date, wrong date format, Date not valid for'

Please kindly use the customer specific solution for such scenario.-Keywords-MCS; filter; Value; Missing; BCC; BC Set; BADI

Title: Error Message in Payment Allocation: Payment Amount Not Allocated Completely; Check The Open Amount
Content: Symptom-You notice a Payment Allocation in Preparation displaying the error message "Payment Amount not Allocated Completely, Check the Open Amount YYY" (where YYY represents the Open Amount).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocation View.-Show In Preparation Payment Allocations.-Find the respective Payment Allocation XXX (where XXX represents the Payment Allocation ID) and open it.-Select the Customer/Supplier.-Press Search Open Items.-You can see an Error Message: Payment Amount not Allocated Completely, Check the Open Amount YYY (where YYY represents the Open Amount).-Cause-There is still an Open Amount in the Payment Allocation. The Allocated Amount is less than the Transaction Amount. The Open Amount must be Zero.-Resolution-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Switch to the Payment Allocation View.-Show In Preparation Payment Allocations.-Find Payment Allocation XXX and open it.-Click tab Customer/Supplier.-Click tab Search Open Items.-Press Go.-Select the relevant Open Items (Tick the relevant checkboxes).-Press OK.-You can see now that the Allocated Amount is the same as the Transaction Amount. The Open Amount is Zero. The Post button is now enabled.-Press Post, then press Save and Close.-Keywords-payment allocation; payment amount; open amount

Title: Balance Confirmations Includes Cleared Invoices
Content: Symptom-After performing a Balance confirmation run, you notice that Balance Confirmation is including cleared invoices, and you expect that invoices should not be included in the Run as both invoices are cleared before the Run is executed. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Balance Confirmation view. -Select All Balance Confirmations. -Search for Balance Confirmation ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Balance Confirmation ID). -In Balance Confirmation: XYZ, go to Balances and Documents tab. -You will see that there are invoices that were already cleared before the run. -Cause-The system collects all the invoices which satisfy the below condition:-The Run will pick invoices for which Accounting Transaction Date is less than equal to the cut-off date and the due clearing date is greater than Cut-Off Date. To check the Cut-Off Date, please follow the steps below: -Go to Receivables work center. -Go to Balance Confirmation Runs subview. -Select the option "All Balance Confirmation Runs". -Search for Run ID: DEF (DEF represents the Run ID). -Click "Edit" button. -Here you will see the Cut-Off Date. -Resolution-Expected system behavior. -See Also-Quick Guide for Balance Confirmation Runs (Receivables)- -Open Items Receivables- -Balance Confirmation for Receivables-Keywords-Balance Confirmation; Run; Invoices; Clear; Cleared; Receivables; Include;

Title: Technical User Being Locked Automatically by the System
Content: Symptom-Technical User gets locked automatically by the system, even after unlocking the user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Support and Technical Users view.-Search for and select the particular user.-You can see that the box "Password Locked" is checked.-Cause-The Technical user is being locked because of too many failed authentication attempts with incorrect password. Could be because of the following reasons.-The old password was saved in the browser, hence even after the password changed the browser is still trying to login with the old saved credentials.-The Technical user are being used in some communication scenario. After changing the password, The client was continuously trying to login with the old password this results in the password  locked due to multiple incorrect logon attempts.-Resolution-First thing we would suggest is to check if that Technical user is used in any web services and to check if there could be places where some client is trying to log in with persisted (old) password.-If above does not solve the issue, we would suggest to change the User ID to something else so that the incorrect logon attempts do not affect this user ID-Keywords-Technical user, locked, user locked, password locked, automatically.-technical user locked,password locked,user locked
