Title: Frequently Asked Questions on ByD Security Topics
Content: Symptom-This KBA is to list the most frequently asked questions and answers on ByD Security Topics.-Scope of this KBA is restricted to:-SSO-Certificates-SSL-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1: When configuring SSO (using any IDP) to connect with SAP Business ByDesign, is it possible to display the below options after completing the SSO settings in IDP and SAP Business ByDesign?-・Login using SSO from the login screen.-・Normal login using SAP Business ByDesign login ID and password.-Answer:-It is not possible to have such screen in SAP Business ByDesign. For basic authentication (User name and Password), the URL is myXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com. In case of SSO enabled then the URL will have -SSO.-These two are different options for logging into the system and above option is not possible.-2: How to configure SSO in AZURE to connect with SAP Business ByDesign?-Refer to Microsoft tutorial - Microsoft Entra single sign-on (SSO) integration with SAP Business ByDesign-3: How to set up Single Sign-On in SAP Business ByDesign?-Follow the help document:-Configure Your Solution for Single Sign-On-4: Is User Certificate and Tenant Certificate same?-No, both the certificates are different.-5: How to Logon in SAP Business ByDesign by Using Client Certificate (X.509)?-Users can log on using client certificate to SAP Business ByDesign. Follow the below help document:-Logging on to the System-6: Can SAP provide the certificate for testing?-No. It is required to get the certificate from one of the trusted Certificate Authorities.-Find more details in the below website:-Logon Using Client Certificate (X.509) (Document is for SAP Cloud for Customer but still applicable for SAP Business ByDesign).-7: Where to get information about configuring SSO?-Refer to the blog - Single Sign-On (SSO) with SAP Business ByDesign.-8: Is it possible to change Predefined SOD Conflicts?-Yes, it is possible by enabling the view IAM_VIEW_CONFLICT. For more details refer to the ByD Security Guide.-9: Does it contain a path when downloading the tenant certificate?-When downloading the tenant certificate, it contains only the tenant certificate. The "Certification Path" of the Windows certificate viewer shows the issuer certificates if they are present in the system. If necessary, user can download the issuer certificate from SAP Trust Center Services by clicking the link "SAP Passport CA G2".-10. Is it possible in SAP Business ByDesign to have the tenant certificate with 4096 bits?-Tenant certificate with 4096 bits key size is not supported. SAP Business ByDesign supports only up to 2048 bits key size.-11. How to configure "Log out URL" and "Relay State" via SSO connect to ByDesign?-Single Logout URL can be found in the SP Metadata XML which is downloadable from: Application and User Management -> Common Tasks -> Configure Single Sign-On -> SP Metadata button.-Regarding RelayState parameter, check the below documentation:-What is RelayState in SAML and how to configure RelayState on AS ABAP-12. How to Import Key Pair File to a Third Party Tool?-For configuration refer to the documentation below:-Importing Key Pair File to a Third Party Tool-13. When using Federation Services with SSO, is it possible for SAP Business ByDesign to automatically pull the certificate when it is about to expire?-Currently, SAP Business ByDesign does not support automatically pulling of certificates from federation services for SSO setup.-14. Which encryption protocol for secure communication is supported in SAP Business ByDesign?-For SAP Business ByDesign, the system currently supports TLS 1.2 encryption protocol for secure communication. If you are already using HTTPS for communication, then you are already using TLS 1.2. You do not need to take any further action if your communication is already using TLS 1.2.-However, if your communication is using TLS 1.1, you should take action to update your system to support TLS 1.2 to ensure secure communication with the provider's service.-15. Why is the different behaviour of SoD Conflicts seen for the same Business Roles in two systems?-The SOD conflicts can be seen when assigning Application and User Management Workcenter.-The workcenter Application and User Management is for SAP Business ByDesign Systems and not for SAP Cloud for Customer Systems.-Assign Administrator workcenter which is for Cloud for Customer systems instead of Application and User management Workcenter.-If the Business Roles workcenter is required, then it will be available in General settings workcenter view which is in Administrator workcenter.-Select Administrator Workcenter --> General Settings view-16. The Certificate Prompt Popup is being displayed eventhough the login was already performed in the tenant.-User has to verify whether there is some refresh time at IDP side. The popup to select certificate might come when a new request for authentication is generated at IDP side.-17.How to Replace New Root Certificate in to the tenant?-Here we have taken example DigiCert Global Root G2 as New Root Certificate.-Go to DigiCert Trusted Root Authority Certificates website.-In the list of certificates, search for DigiCert Global Root G2 & download the PEM file.-Upload the PEM file into your trust store in SAP Business ByDesign.-     Steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to Common tasks Work Center View.-Select Edit Certificate Trust List.-Choose Upload.-Save changes.-Note : Your trust store must include the old root certificate as well as the new root certificate.-18. Is it possible to disable the option “upload certificate” in Configure OAuth 2.0 Identity Providers?-It is not possible to disable this option. In order to avoid any wrong certificate, assign the access to the link 'Configure OAuth 2.0 Identity Provider' in Administrator->Common tasks to only the key users so that no wrong certificate is uploaded in future.-19. User is unable to update expiring certificate with renewed certificate for Oauth due to '500 SAP Internal Server Error'.-When an IDP updates its signing/encryption certificate, they may reuse the same old key pair and update only the "valid from date", "valid to date" and "serial number". Therefore such new certificates cannot be put alongside the old certificates in the address book table as they violate the public key fingerprint (PKFINGERPRINT) unique index. In this case, create a case to SAP to correct the inconsistency.-SSO on ByD Mobile APP-1. ﻿Can SSO also be used for the ByD Mobile App?-Yes, it can. The SSO Url, configured for the system, has to be used in the mobile app.-2. What kind of security policy do I have to choose?-Security Policies can be selected as desired. No SSO-specific setup needed here.-Additional information:-For ByD Mobile specifically, no additional setup is needed. Identity Provider has to be configured by the User.-SSO configuration for the system has to be configured in the workcenter Application and User Management / Configure Single Sign-On.-Keywords-SSO, certificate, authentication, FAQ, TLS, mobile SSO

Title: Sales Order Invoice Request is Blocked
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that a Sales Order Invoice Request is showing as Blocked, despite having had an invoice being released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-The document status is Blocked.-Cause-Sales Order is blocked because under the Sales Order ABC, an Invoice Block was maintained.-The reason you were able to release the Invoice document, despite having an Invoice Block in the source Sales Order, is because the Invoice document was created before the block was maintained in the Sales Order.-Example:-Created Sales Order ABC.-Released the follow-up documents.-Set Invoice Block. -Go to the Invoice Request view.-Click Invoice button.-System does not generate Invoice Document.-Warning: Invoicing for item 10 type Outbound Delivery Invoice Request XYZ not possible; reference document blocked.-(XYZ represents the ID of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request).-Removed the Invoice block from the Sales Order.-Go back to the Invoice Request view.-Click Invoice button.-Click Save to save the document as an Invoice document  (Not Released).-Go to the Sales Order ABC.-Set the Invoice block again.-Opened the Invoice document and click release.-The system released the Invoice document.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Since the Sales Order is now Completed, you will need to cancel the Invoice document, remove the Invoice Block from the Sales Order and once this is performed, you may release the Invoice again and Sales Order Invoice Request will show as Processed.-See Also-2194102 - Customer Invoices Request is Blocked-2913446 - Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is in Status Blocked-1757278 - Customer Invoice Request For The Sales Order Is In Blocked Status-2638297 - Customer Contract Invoice Request Is Blocked, However Schedule Invoice Request Is To Be Invoiced-1932045 - The Customer Contract Invoice Request is Showing the Status as Blocked-Keywords-Sales Order, Invoice Request, Blocked, Invoice Block

Title: The Settlement Amount in an Expense Report is not the one Expected
Content: Symptom-You are creating an Expense Report for an Employee in the country A but the Settlement Amount is in the currency of the country B.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Open the New Expense Report on Behalf Common Task.-Complete the Expense Report.-In the step 2: Expenses. All the amounts are change in the column Settlement Amount with the country B currency.-Cause-The Settlement Amount is depending of the country in which the employee has been hired. You can find it with the following steps:-Go to the Personal Administration work center.-Click on the Employees view.-Click on Advanced-Select a country in Country-If you can not see the expected country in the list, it is mean the employee can not have been hire from this country.-Resolution-It is not possible to change the country. The only solution is to rehire the employee in the right country.-If the country is not in the list in Personal Administration work center, Regular Tasks view, you have to add the country.-If it is a Localized Country: （See KBA 3388229 to check the type of the related Country)-You have to Scope the Country and than to rehire the employee with the correct country.-If it is not a Localized Country:-You have to add the 'Non-Localized Employee' feature in scoping. (See KBA 2542790)-You have to add "Genetic Country Version" feature in Scoping.-In Scoping Question, you need to select the scoping question "Do you want to use the generic country version for Expense and Reimbursement Management?".-In Fine Tuning, you can create a new country version (for country A)  using the BC view link "Create New Country Version".-Now, you can search in BC view for "Generic Country Version".-Select the country you just created.-Now you can set up it as you have to (Per Diems, Mileage, etc).-Now you can rehire the employee with the button 'Non-Localized Country' and select the country A.-Keywords- Expense Report, Settlement Amount, Country, Employee

Title: Cannot Restrict Access Right for Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos at Org Unit Level
Content: Symptom-You cannot restrict access rights for supplier invoice and credit memos at org unit level.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application And User Management work center.-Open Business Users view and search for user ABC.-Click Edit: Access Rights.-Go to tab Access Restrictions find the Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Under Access Context, you can see it defaults on Company level, you are not able to restrict the access based on the org unit.-Cause-The access right for supplier invoices and credit memos can be restricted only at Company level not at the Org Unit level. This feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Access Right, Supplier Invoice, Org Unit

Title: Material Flow Rule FIFO Doesn't Work When Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-During post goods issue, system proposes identfied stock IDN_1, but you expect IDN_2 because you have set FIFO as picking strategy in material flow rule of ship-from site and IDN_2 has an earlier expiration date than IDN_1. (i.e. IDN_1 and IDN_2 refers to identfied stock IDs)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Go to view Delivery Proposals.-Search ABC (ABC represents delivery proposal ID), click Post Goods Issue.-In the screen "Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue", identified stock IDN_1 is proposed.-Choose value help of Identified Stock ID, you can see identified stock IDN_2 is also available, it has earlier expiration date than IDN_1.-Check the material flow rule of ship-from site, FIFO is selected as picking strategy.-Cause-In corresponding logistics model (Standard Shipping, Without Task), "Storage" is selected for Source Logistics Use; however, in the material flow rule of ship-from site, different logistics area use is selected for Source Determination Rules.-Resolution-Either change the Source Logistics Use in logistics model, or add a new sequence under Source Determination Rules in the material flow rule of ship-from site, so that there is a matching of logistics use between logistics model with material flow rule.-Keywords-FIFO, Post Goods Issue, Source Logistics Area, Material Flow Rule

Title: An Exception Exists in Supplier Invoice Created from Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-A Supplier Invoice is created from customer invoice. However, it cannot be posted due to an exception 'Account assignment data missing for item X; see Cost Distribution'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Navigate to the Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Open supplier invoice ABC. (ABC represents the affected supplier invoice ID)-Navigate to the Document Flow Tab, you notice that the supplier invoice is created based on a customer invoice.-Navigate  to the Exception Tab, the mentioned exception would be found.-  Cause-Currently for supplier invoice the base document is Purchase Order so account information flows from purchase order to Invoice. Since there is no Purchase order existing, the accounting information cannot be fetched.-Case 1:  Creating a standard Sales Order for a customer and no willing and needed to create a purchase order.-Case 2:  Processing the Internal intercompany business scenario.-Resolution-According to the master data you maintained, the seller and the account are partner company, the internal EDX as output channel in both account and supplier master for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo and Purchase Oder. The system will create the supplier invoice from customer invoice since supplier invoices only consider the output of customer invoice. This is expected behavior.-For case 1, you can void this supplier invoice manually if no intercompany scenario is involved. -For case 2, the intercompany supplier invoice is created with reference to a customer invoice and there is no reference to a purchase order. Hence it is necessary to manually select the Account Assignment Type as ACC - General Ledger Account only. After setting the G/L account, system sets the invoice status to Ready for Posting.-  Keywords-Account Assignment Data Missing, Cost Distribution, Intercompany, Supplier invoice, Customer Invoice, Credit memo.

Title: Wrong Country Displays for Customer/Supplier Country/Region Field in the Open VAT / Sales Tax Items - Report
Content: Symptom-Expense Report has been posted for an Employee and Employee belongs Country DEF.(Ex: Netherlands)-However, Open VAT / Sales Tax Items - Report shows Country as PQR(Ex: Germany) for the Employee in the Customer/Supplier Country/Region Field.-(Here, DEF and PQR refers to Country names)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Search for the report: Open VAT / Sales Tax Items - Report.-Enter the required details.-Click on Go.-Add Customer/Supplier Country/Region to the Rows.-Filter for the required Employee id and we can see Customer/Supplier Country/Region field shows Germany as country.-Cause-The cause is Address was changed for the Employee. -Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for the required Employees and Country is showing as Netherlands.-Go to the Changes tab.-Country/Region changed to from Netherlands to Germany.-Resolution-The field Customer/Supplier Country/Region field is showing Germany in the report: Open VAT / Sales Tax Items - Report as it is taking the information from the private contact data for the employee.-Add Tax Country/Region field to the rows for the report and it will show the country: Netherland.- Keywords-Customer/Supplier Country/Region field, Open VAT / Sales Tax Items - Report, Expense report

Title: SAP Business ByDesign - Companies Act, India, Rules 2014
Content: Symptom-A new amendment was released in August 2022 to store the details of the books of account. -Companies Act 2013, rule 29; Companies Act rule 3; electronic mode; back-up of the books of account and other books and papers.-Manner of books of account to be kept in electronic mode; Inspection and copies of records maintained in electronic form; Storage of documents in a server physically located in India;-The law has been enclosed as an attachment in this KBA, with the specific requirement clearly highlighted within the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Changes in the relevant provisions of the Companies Act published by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) in India.-Resolution-Legally, it is required that the documents / backup must be stored in a server located in India.-With regards to the server, SAP will not be able to assist, as we do not currently provide any physical servers for SAP Business ByDesign to our customers for data storage.-There are multiple approaches in SAP Business ByDesign to extract data.-Data Extraction-“Application and User Management -> Data Extraction” allows you to extract data in XML format and store it.-“General Ledger -> Periodic Tasks -> Extraction Run for Financial Data” allows you to extract financial and management accounting data and store it in AIS format that is required for auditing.-Business Analytical Reports-Our first recommendation is to use analytical reports such as G/L Accounts - Line Items, Journal, etc. Which contains all necessary data relevant to books of accounts.-These analytical reports can be accessed through the below views.-a. “Business Analytics -> Broadcasts”-Through this view, it will be possible for customers to get the data backup through emails which can be scheduled periodically, even at a daily basis.-b. “General Ledger -> Periodic Tasks -> Statutory Reports”-Through this view, it will be possible for customers to download the data backup on their local system once the statutory reports for given filter criteria are generated.-Keywords-India Data Center, Backup, Books of Account, Data, India, MCA, MCA Notification, Server, Storage, Broadcast, Business Analytics, BYD,

Title: System is Proposing The Wrong Identified Stock When Posting Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-The system is being set up to use the FIFO Picking Strategy in Outbound Process. Hence, the Material Flow Rule is being maintained at the Site and Logistics Area level. Further, the Logistics use maintained in Logistics Model tallies with the one maintained in the Material Flow Rules. However, when while performing "Post Goods Issue" the system is not picking the Identified Stock with Earliest Expiration Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Delivery Proposals view.-Find and select the relevant Delivery Request ID. -Choose Post Goods Issue.-The proposed identified stock is not the one with the earliest expiration date. -Cause-For FIFO, the combination of Identified Stock is checked against Allocation Type code as well. The system has picked the first Logistics Area with specific allocation type code that is found. The behaviour is therefore very correct. All Logistics Areas which are having Identified Stock with earlier Expiration Date than the proposed Identified Stock do not have any Allocation type code and are therefore not being proposed.-Resolution-Please maintain the Allocation Type code for all Logistics Areas. Please see below for details:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Locations view.-Find and select the relevant Site.-Edit Layout.-Locate all relevant Logistics Areas.-Go to the General tab.-Scroll down to the section 'Inventory-Managed Details'.-Maintain the Allocation Type and the Allocation Scope.-  See Also-3221942 - Material Flow Rule FIFO Doesn't Work When Post Goods Issue-3075450 - Wrong Identified Stock Proposed by The System When Posting Goods Issue-Keywords-Allocation Type, Allocation Scope, Identified Stock, FIFO

Title: GST Implementation in SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-This document describe the availability & implementation of GST (New Indian Taxation System - July 2017) in SAP Cloud for Customer.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-In SAP Cloud for Customer, there are two scenarios related to Pricing & Tax calculation (based on Business Configuration scoping):-Internal Pricing: Tax calculation is out of scope if customer scope Internal Pricing in SAP Cloud for Customer.-External Pricing: Taxes are pulled from ERP system integrated with SAP Cloud for Customer. This scenario is impacted by GST.- In External Pricing scenario tax numbers of SAP Cloud for Customer are exchanged with ERP and hence require changes post GST rollout in India.-Resolution-We have created new Tax Numbers (related to GST) for SAP Cloud for Customer systems which will be implemented in both 1705 & 1708 release.-The Software Correction is expected to be deployed in 1705 release of SAP Cloud for Customer on 18th June 2017.-The Software Correction will be available in 1708 release of SAP Cloud for Customer with standard upgrade.-Once the Software Correction is available in SAP Cloud for Customer, exchange of GST tax numbers will be possible with ERP.-Keywords-Internal Pricing, External Pricing, Indian Taxation System

Title: Extension Fields are Missing in Forms in the Target Tenant
Content: Symptom-Custom fields extended from SDK are not visible in the output forms when you try to preview it. The same functionality is working fine in the source tenant, but after moving the solution to target tenant the fields are missing.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Buisness ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to UI.-Navigate to the respective screen.-You can see the field and values are displaying properly in the UI.-Now you click on Preview/ Generate Summary to see the fields in the form.-The fields are missing in the form.-Cause-The issue is occuring because the extension field is a pre-fixed name in the Form template, if a new patch is created, the name in the Form template is changed.-So with the original solution V1, the same Form can be used with the extension fields in dev, test and production tenant. Once the patch is created a new namspace created but the field name in the target tenant will be still pointing to the orginal solution name.-You can verify this by opening the .XDP file in Adobe Live Cycle Designer, load the main schema. Navigate to the field via Data Connection, you still see the fields from the orginal solution.-Resolution-If a new patch, after activate in dev, test and production tenant(transfer from dev to test and production), you need to re-download the Form template, select new data connection(MainSchema.xsd), change the extension fields and upload again.-See Also-https://archive.sap.com/documents/docs/DOC-69441-Keywords-PDI extension fields missing in form template-SDK fields are not visible in form-Extension fields values are not appearing in test tenant

Title: Project Stock Order Cannot Create A Goods And Activity Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***--System shows process communication error in the Document Flow of Project Stock Order.-Error: Project Stock Order cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work center.-Choose Projects view.-Choose Projects sub view.-Find and Edit Project XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the project).-Navigate to Products tab and Project Stock Orders sub tab.-Choose the Project Stock Order under Document Flow and there will be a process communication error on project stock order.-Cause-When trying to consume the material after the creation of the project stock order the process communication error will be seen because the relevant Project or project task is Closed / Completed.-The XML message failing in the backend.-Message Details:-Sender party: ProjectProcessing-Receiver Interface Name: InventoryProcessingInventoryChangingIn--Error message /ISCB/CM_CB_CHECK must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task:-To find the Project Task for which the Project stock Order is assigned to scroll down the XMl message:-Resolution-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Find the relevant project.-Go to Project Plan tab then select the Revoke Closure in Project Status.-Save.-Once the project is in Released status, restart of failing messages will go through, then the system will create the Goods and Activity Confirmation automatically.-Please note that it should ideally ask the customer to release the project himself for a short period of time so that it can be restarted the error message.-Once the message has been restarted successfully, customer can be advised to close the project.-At the very least, ask the customer to provide a written authorization to Revoke Closure in Project Status and to close it back once the message has been successfully restarted.-Keywords-project stock order, cannot create goods activity confirmation, process communication error, project

Title: DATEV Export Results Shows Collective G/L Accounts Instead Of The Business Partner DATEV ID
Content: Symptom-In certain cases of postings, like down payments postings, the DATEV Export run shows the posting directly to the DATEV ID of the business partner involved and do not show the corresponding DATEV collective G/L accounts.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the DATEV Export subview.-Select the Run ID XXX (XXX stands for the DATEV Run ID).-In the section Execution Details set the Show filter with the value All Logs.-Select the Application Log ID: XYZ (XYZ stand for the Application Log ID).-Select Results tab.-From the DATEV Export Results, access the Data Prepared for Export tab - Journal Entries sub-tab and check the results of the DATEV export run for the concerned Journal Entry.-The columns Account and/or Offsetting Account shows only the DATEV ID of the business partner involved in the line items of the Journal entry and not the corresponding DATEV collective G/L accounts.-Cause-This is standard behaviour as the DATEV export run settings include the usage of the subledger accounts.-Resolution-If you want the DATEV Export run results to show the posting to the corresponding DATEV collective G/L accounts and not to the DATEV ID of the business partner involved and do not show the, the option Subledger Accounts Used needs to be unchecked in the DATEV Export run. Then, re-execute the run with the new settings maintained. -Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Run ID XXX (XXX stands for the DATEV Run ID). -Select Edit.-Uncheck the option Subledger Accounts Used.-Save the DATEV export run and re-execute it.-Keywords-DATEV Export Run, Subledger Accounts, G/L Accounts, Journal Entry.

Title: Freight Amount is Showing Zero Value in Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-Freight amount is showing Zero value while adding manually in sales document, i..e Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Open the Invoice Request XYZ. (XYZ represents the ID of invoice request)-Select the Invoice Request XYZand click on Invoice button.-Go to the Pricing Tab.-Item Pricing sub tab.-Click Add Row button.-Click on Dropdown and select Price Component: Freight.-Enter the some value under Amount section.-Here you can see that the Freight value is not reflecting under Price Component Value. It is showing Zero.-Cause-Scoping question Do you bill a fixed freight amount per order? is not scoped.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to resolve this issue:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-Select the active project and press the Edit Project Scope button-In the step 4 Questions navigate to General Business Data -> Product and Service Pricing -> Sales Price Specifications-In the section Freights, scoped the question: Do you bill a fixed freight amount per order?-Please note that the following question Do you calculate freight amount based on net weight? will then be automatically unscoped.-Keywords-Freight; Configure Price strategy freight; Freight Calculation

Title: Cancel Already Cleared Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You cancel a supplier invoice, instead of setting the original invoice as canceled, the system posts an Invoice Reversal document to the supplier account, and make it show up in the Open Items list.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-First of all, go to the Supplier Invoicing work center, and choose the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the supplier invoice in question, and choose Cancel Document.-The Invoice Cancellation document is posted, and the supplier invoice is canceled.-Then go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-In the Supplier Accounts view, open the details of the Supplier in question.-Show Open Items.-You can see the invoice cancellation document is shown in the list with the Document Type being Invoice Reversal.-Cause-The supplier invoice is already cleared by an outgoing payment, when you cancel the supplier invoice in the Supplier Invoicing work center, the original clearing still exists, and the system generates a new open item which is the reversal document.-Resolution-It is preferable that you do not cancel an invoice that has already been paid or cleared.-If, however, you need to cancel an invoice that has already been paid, first go to the Payables work center to reverse the clearing and then cancel the invoice in the Supplier Invoicing work center.-But in your case, the original invoice is cleared, and the payment has been confirmed in the bank statement. Instead of canceling the clearing, you first cancel the supplier invoice, so the original clearing still exists, an invoice reversal document is posted to the supplier account. You have two options to clear the Invoice Reversal document:-If the supplier returns the payment, you may manually clear the Invoice Reversal Document by an incoming payment:-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-In the Supplier Accounts view, open the details of the Supplier in question.-Show Open Items.-Select the Invoice Reversal document in question, and choose Pay Manually By.-Select for example, Incoming Check.-Enter the necessary information, and choose Post.-The Reversal document is cleared in this way.-You can also reverse the payment clearing of the original supplier invoice, and set the invoice back to Open, after that manually clear the original invoice and the reversal document:-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-In the Supplier Accounts view, open the details of the Supplier in question.-Show Cleared Items.-Select the original invoice in question, and open the clearing of this invoice.-Choose View All, and then Reset Clearing.-The original invoice and the outgoing payment are set back to Open on the Supplier Account. -You can then choose the original supplier invoice and the Invoice Reversal together, and choose Clear Manually.-For the outgoing payment, you may leave it on the supplier account for future clearing, or clear it with other supplier invoices.-See Also-Cancel Supplier Invoice, Cancel Cleared Supplier Invoice, Payables.

Title: Troubleshooting PDI SDK Translation Issues for Solutions Deployed and in Development
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- In this Knowledge Base Article, we will look at known issues regarding the Translation topic, and how we can troubleshoot Translation added via SDK.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio SDK-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the UI with the target language as the logon language.-Navigate to the respective screen wherever the customer has maintained translations.-You can see that the texts are displaying in the wrong language.-Cause-Please note that it is recommended to develop contents of your solution in English language and use XLIFF file to translate it to other target languages such as German, Spanish etc. At present SDK does not support translation of names of Work Centers and Views. This needs to be done via Language Adaptation Tool. -  There could be multiple reason as to why translation in the UI is not correct. Depending on solution status troubleshooting of translation issues differs. Below provided resolutions can be applied in the following scenarios: when solution is in development and when it is already deployed.-  Scenario 1: Solution in Development-Translation is probably not maintained in XLIFF file or XREP does not reflect maintained translation.-  Scenario 2: Solution is Deployed-Translation has been added to the BO in the later version, and the Bo has not been reactivated after this adjustment: added translation is not considered by the system as delta change. If you add translation to the BO, and simply activate the solution afterwards, this change only updates XREP entries, but it does not update MDRS. Only Activation of the BO can resolve those inconsistencies.-  (NOTE: When you create a solution in cloud application studio you can translate its content into another language. To do so you must export the translatable content to XLIFF file on your computer (XLIFF refers to XML Localisation Interchange File Format) Once the XLIFF file is translated you can import it onto the solution and check the status of all translations maintained). SAP does not provide any software to translate the file. Customers should use any open source editor to translate the content to target language, such as Virtaal.-Resolution-Depending on the solution status the following steps must be performed in order to investigate the issue further:-Scenario 1: Solution in Development-Step 1: Checks required from SDK-Logon to SDK.-Open the solution.-Right click on the solution, and select Translation -> Check Status.-Check translation screen will appear and check the entry for the target language.-You can see the number of translated texts.-  If you see that there are no texts translated here for the target language then that means customer has not uploaded the translations properly to this tenant. You can ask them to Import the translation again.-NOTE: If the issue is happening for a specific uicomponenent where the translations are maintained, you can directly right click on uicomponent and can check the status, instead of the entire solution.-  Step 2: Checks required from the Virtaal translation tool (or any other open source software application)-If the you can see that a specific number of texts are translated in the Check Status, then follow the below steps:-Right click on the solution and Select Translation -> Export Text.-Select the language and click on Export to XLIFF, this will save the translations in to XLIFF file.-Open the XLIFF file in the Virtaal translation tool, and search for the affected fields.-Check that the translations are maintained correctly in the target language.-If they are not maintained, the customer has to maintain the translations from their end and upload to the solution using Import Text, otherwise follow the step 3 below.-  Step 3: Checks required from backend.-Login to backend of the respective tenant.-Open the transaction XREP.-Navigate to the Main folder of the solution.-Find out the uicomponent or the file which is affected and open.-Navigate to the tab Texts.-You can see all the translation present in the tenant for the respective file under Short Texts section.-  Case 1: If the translations are missing or incorrect in XREP-During the upload of the translations, either some of the translations went missing or the translations present are incorrect. Please Forward the ticket to CSS Component AP-RC-BDS-TRANSL.-Case 2: If the translations are present in XREP but still it is missing in the frontend, we can run a report to re-activate the specific XREP file path.-ONLY TO BE DONE BY PDI DEVELOPMENT OR SENIOR PDI COLLEGUE! -Go to the transaction SE38.-Enter the program PDI_BC_LM_EXECUTE_OLD_SUPP and execute.-Copy the path from XREP mentioned in Step 3 and enter in the field value of XREP file path.-Enter the relevant file path and Execute.-Check in the frontend whether the translations are appearing now or not.-Case 3: After performing the case 2 still the issue is not resolved , then forward the ticket to CSS Component AP-RC-BDS-TRANSL for further analysis.-  Scenario 2: Solution is Deployed-If solution is already deployed it is not possible anymore to export XLIFF file and check translations in separate application such as Virtaal. Your analysis of the issue is based on whatever could be seen in the UI designer and the backend.-Step 1: Checks required from UI designer.-Open UI designer and navigate to affected UI component where translations cannot be seen.-Switch to Tab Controller and choose TextPool from available options on the toolbar.-Choose desired language, and check what description is maintained.-Step 2 Checks required from the Backend.-Results seen in UI designer must be compared with entries within the Texts tab of the affected UI component in XREP.-While still having affected UI component opened in XREP switch to tab XML.-Search for Tab <base:TextBlock language>. This tag contains all UI texts for which translation should be maintained.-Search for term "esrTextid" which shows UI Text and its respective description. Copy the full technical ID as shown in the below screenshot.-  Navigate to transaction MDRS and choose UI Text option from the dropdown.-Paste technical ID of UI text which you extracted from XML and hit enter.-Switch to tab Texts which holds language blocks available for this specific UI text.-There could be discrepancy between entries visible in XREP and MDRS. For example If specific BO in XREP has an entry for translated UI text, but the same is not reflected in MDRS for UI text this means that translation of the BO was added in later version of the Solution and BO activation was not performed.-This can be confirmed when looking at the affected UI component in XREP and comparing entries under Texts tab for current solution version, and previous solution versions (In folder ALL).-In this situation the BO on top of which translation was added needs to be reactivated.-ONLY TO BE DONE BY PDI DEVELOPMENT OR SENIOR PDI COLLEGUE!-Go to the transaction SE38.-Enter the program PDI_BC_LM_EXECUTE_OLD_SUPP.-Since solution is deployed change Mode Option from D to U.-Copy the BO path from XREP.-Enter the relevant file path and Execute.-  In case where BO needs to be reactivated, or discrepancies can be seen between UI designer, XREP and MDRS please consult such incidents with developers from component AP-RC-BDS-TRANSL.-Keywords-SDK Translation, XLIFF file, UI Text, Textpool, Incorrect Translation

Title: Broadcast Delivered at Wrong Time / Time Zone
Content: Symptom-The broadcast is delivered at a time different from when it was scheduled. The difference is more than the normal 1h delay, e.g. several hours or even on another day.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Broadcasts.-Click on New and set up the broadcast details.-Set up scheduling at a specific time and save this broadcast.-The recipients receive the broadcast at a different time, i.e. not the one you specified. There can be a difference of several hours, so that they even receive it on another day.-Cause-The broadcast was created by a user who has a different time zone than the recipient. The time zone considered by the broadcast is the one from the creator.-Resolution-This is the correct behaviour. The user setting up the broadcast can schedule it for a different time in his time zone, so that it is converted to the correct time for the recipients. You may also create several broadcasts for different groups of recipients (per time zone).-See Also-2584651 - Delay in Broadcast Execution-Keywords-broadcast, start time, wrong time, schedule, time zone, broadcast not received

Title: Warning in Report: QDEF Element Name of Key Figure is Longer Than 28 Characters
Content: Symptom-When running a report, you get the following warning message:-QDEF Element name ABC (ABC stands for a key figure ID) of key figure is longer than 28 characters.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Open your report and run it with the respective selection.-You get the above warning.-Cause-This is currently an issue in reporting.-Resolution-The message is planned to be corrected with a future release. Until then, you can ignore the warning since there are no actual inconsistencies.-Keywords-qdef element name, report, business analytics, report error, warning message, longer than 28 characters

Title: Payment Run Error: 'Work package ID <id> system error; report a case'
Content: Symptom-A payment run for Payables or for Receivables has been created. The run gets finished and payment proposals are created, however there's an error in the resulting execution: 'Work package ID <id> system error; report a case'.-Upon checking the payment proposal list, it can happen that some open items were not processed by run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Payment Runs view.-Create a new payment run with desired selection parameters.-Trigger its execution.-Once executed, open the corresponding application log.-The following error is displayed: 'Work package ID {XO{T3Rw7ksgf4rfQdNS6m system error; report a case' (The {XO{T3Rw7ksgf4rfQdNS6m is an example of how the work package ID looks like.)-It's also noticeable that, despite of the error, there are payment proposals created.-Cause-The payment run in SAP Business ByDesign has a parallel processing logic. This means that the run creates several parallel working streams to process the data, which are the work packages. Each work package process the data for a certain number of items.-In this case, one of the possible causes for the work package ID error could be a memory issue, which prevents that work package to complete its processing, due to the high amount of data being processed by the payment run. This can be a high number of open items or even a high number of suppliers in the selection parameters, meaning, if there are too many supplier/customer accounts and all them are selected in the payment run's parameters.-There isn't defined data limit based on which the payment run can end in a memory issue. The payment run could depend on the number of suppliers/customers and the open items for those suppliers/customers based on which the proposals can be created. Also it can depend of some configuration settings, such as if it's wanted to group several invoices and pay it together or to create one payment per invoice.-Resolution-Based on the above, if this is related to a memory issue, it is recommended to schedule the payment run execution to happen outside business hours (for example: after midnight), which can free up system resources.-If even by scheduling the run to be executed outside business hours the error still happens, separate payment runs can be created defining a supplier/customer range as parameter in the payment run.-Note that, if there are too many supplier/customer accounts, the value help in the payment run shows a limited number of accounts. To make sure that all accounts are displayed, they can be sorted via Payables -> Supplier Accounts view (or Receivables -> Customer Accounts view).-If event after applying the above recommendation the issue still happens, please open a case to SAP Support for further troubleshooting.-Keywords-Performance. Payment run. Supplier Account. Memory.

Title: Error: "Production fix not allowed as solution is not yet scoped"
Content: Symptom-You receive the below error message while opening a Solution in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-"Production fix not allowed as solution is not yet scoped"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the studio.-Open a Solution.-The error appears as a popup.-Cause-This error message can appear while evaluating the visibility of the Bug Fix button for Production and Pre-Production tenants. The error is raised when not all of the Business Options in a Solution are scoped in the current Implementation Project.-Resolution-Please scope the solution in the Implementation Project if you want to create a Correction Patch:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Open Implementation Project View.-Select the project and click Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the scoping questions as defined by you in the .bac file of the Solution.-Select the questions and finish the scoping.-See Also-SAP Cloud Applications Studio Documentation:-Bug Fix in Production and Pre-production Tenants-Keywords-SDK, PDI, bug fix, bug-fix, correction, preprod, patch, bac, scoping, business option, business topic

Title: Troubleshooting PDI Language Adaptation Tool Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The partner creates an incident, stating that the translations they have maintained via their PDI solution in the Language Adaptation Tool, are not reflecting in the UI.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-There could be multiple reasons for this issue, from support side you should check the below steps in the Resolution section.-Resolution-What do we need from the Customer/Partner?-What UI component the PDI element is on.-What are the names / types (fields, buttons, etc) of the PDI elements.-Identify what the fields are displaying as, and find out what the partner expects the fields to display as.-What is the name of the Language Adaptation and where have they have maintained the translations in the Language Adaptation.-Steps to be taken to view the Language Adaptation Tool translations:-Go to the Administrator Work Center.-Go to the Language Adaptations View.-Open the affected Language Adaptation, (the name of the Language Adaptation that the partner provided you with in step 4 of the pre-requisites).-Go to the UI Texts Facet.-Search for the affected field (please note, the * wildcard does not work here).-Check if all the Sources of this field has a Target (if the field has a column / label / tooltip / text etc.. then they all need to be maintained).-If they are not maintained, take a screenshot of your findings (where the Target is not maintained) and return the incident to the partner.-If they are maintained, but are still not displaying correctly in the UI, please check the SLG1 logs and send all of the information you found to the CSS component: AP-RC-TXA (please see steps below on how to check LAT issues in the backend transaction SLG1). -Quick Guide for checking LAT issues:-UI texts -> check in XREP to see if there is a textpool entry.-Code list texts -> check in MDRS.-Message texts -> check in MDRS.-Texts missing and customer blames us -> check in SLG1.-For all issues check SLG1 as these logs only exist for 30 days-  What can be checked in the backend for LAT:-SLG1:-You can use SLG1 to monitor the changes the partner has made.-Enter TEXT_MANAGEMENT_KUT into the Object filed, and enter the date the partner claims to have maintained the translations on.-Select the Execute icon.-You can see when the partner created the Language Adaptation.-Next to the date and time, you will see the KXXXXXX technical user name of who made these changes.-Here we can see that a Text Pool was created, it has an ID of SAPTEST, its source language is E (English) and it's target language is V (Swedish).-The X represents true, in the below screenshot it means the partner selected the checkboxes Get UI Text and Get Code Texts, but did not select Get Message Texts or Get Report Texts.-You will see the exact steps that the user took.-For example, in the below log, we can see the partner selected the Work Center (WoCs) partner.-They then selected the button Collect Texts (referred to as Action called).-A new timestamp for the XREP text was set, meaning the translations made it to the backend in XREP.-After the texts are collected, a translation is maintained. We can see only 1 translation was maintained as next to Number of UI texts modified is 1.-An invalidate load is performed only for the UI path that a translation was maintained for.-These logs will only last 30 days, so the LAT developers have requested that we always check the SLG1 logs, and maintain everything we find here in our analysis. For more information on the backend transaction SLG1, please see the KBA: 2581573 - How to Use The Backend Transaction SLG1-  MDRS:-Metadata Repository keeps translation values for each language code (a text load). Therefore, we can use the backend transaction MDRS to view the texts that are maintained. Please see Step 3 in the the KBA 2230974 - How to Handle Translation Issues Related to PDI Solutions in the SDK .-  Common issues:-1. The partner is trying to use the LAT to translate a PDI artifact, however they cannot see it in the available UI Texts.-Check the TextPool for the artifact they want to translate. If it is a mashup / pdi artefact / custom controller then we need to go back to the developer.-When they create a new CT, they need to create a new Text Pool, otherwise they cannot translate the new change.-If it is a PDI EC on an SAP floor, the LAT does not fetch a fallback value, because the language code is missing. You can only have one text value for something if there are no language codes (i.e. FR, DE etc..) <FallbackValue>  (fallback strategy) must be available.-  2. If we can see the message types in the custom BO in MDRS, but it cannot be found when trying to Collect Texts, then this is an issue. Please seen screenshots of what you have found, along with a full analysis to the backend transaction AP-RC-TXA.-  3. If you are experiencing time out issues in the Language Adaptation tool, there is a checkpoint report that we can run. Please see KBA: 2607698 - How to Handle Language Adaptation Tool Timeouts-See Also-2607437 - Troubleshooting PDI Translation Issues-2532338 - Language Adaptation is not working for PDI fields-2080512 - How to Find if a Field has been Translated by the Language Adaptation Tool-2576607 - Language Adaptation for Categories-2567509 - Text Fields Are Greyed Out In Language Adaptation-2501574 - How to maintain translation for Analytical Custom Objects in Language Adaptation tool-2604106 - Language Adaptation is not Working for a Key User Tool (KUT) Field-2544917 - Prerequisites to Enable Customer Language Adaptation-2560531 - On the Same Language Adaption, UI Texts IDs Differs From a Tenant to Another-  Keywords-LAT, Language Adaptation, PDI, Custom, Translation

Title: Purchase Order Delivery Date for Service Item Incorrect on Preview
Content: Symptom-You have added a service item in a purchase order. The delivery date on the preview is incorrect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the Option All Purchase Orders.-Query the record by the Purchase Order ID.-Select Edit and View All.-Choose Preview, you see that the delivery date shows as one day before than actual date.-Cause-Service To date has been maintained as Date followed by 00:00 hrs, system considers it as 1 day before. This is the reason it shows service date/period as one day less than actual date. This is standard system behavior.-Resolution-You need to enter either hrs or minutes in order to get the same date on output form.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the Option All Purchase Orders and find the relevant Purchase Order ID.-Select Edit and View All.-Navigate to the Items tab, under Basic Data sub-tab.-Enter a value as hours and minutes under Service To field next to Date.-Press Enter and then Preview. Save the Changes.-You will see that Delivery Date/ Service Period shows correct date.-NOTE: This behavior is valid for all the time zones.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Delivery Date, Service To, Preview, Incorrect, Wrong

Title: Process Communication Error on Project Stock Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-System shows Process Communication Error in the Document Flow of the Project Stock Order with the error being: "Project Stock Order cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management Work center.-Choose the Projects view, and then the Projects subview.-Find and Edit the relevant Project.-Navigate to Products tab, and then to the Project Stock Orders subtab.-Open the Project Stock Order in Edit mode, and navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Here the Process Communication Error for the Project Stock Order can be seen. -If clicking the red error icon, a new window opens, and the above mentioned error message appears.-Cause-The XML message is failing in the backend.-Message Details:-Sender party: ProjectProcessing-Receiver Party: InventoryProcessingInventoryChangingIn-Error Short Text: Error message CM_APLEX_CHECK_VALID_DATE_TIME must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task.-When trying to consume the Material after the creation of the Project Stock Order the Process Communication error will be displayed, because the Period is blocked for Accounting.-Resolution-First it is necessary to find the creation date or ACC_TRANS_DATE of the Project Stock Order. To find the creation date, scroll down the XML, and the ACC_TRANS_DATE YYYY.MM.DD can be seen. Once found the correct date, then perform the below steps to resolve the issue (we recommend to request the customer to carry out these steps. Otherwise it will be necessary a written permission from customer):-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Companies view.-Select the relevant company ID and choose Open and Close Period button.-Search for the accounting period relevant for date XX.YY.ZZZZ. Here it can be seen that the Period Status of this period is Blocked.-Now select the period and choose Open Periods button.-Finally choose Save button.-If it's not wanted to open the accounting period, then use "Set Process Control" and choose to post to accounting to some other open Period. To do so, please follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Companies view, and then the relevant Company.-Choose Set Process Control button.-Choose Add Row button.-Select Process Control Status as Not Blocked, Business Process Group as Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Entry Possible Until should be the date by which the Posting will take place. Like if the planning is to do it today, then enter today's date.-From Posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ or the date before XX/YY/ZZZZ and To posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ or any day after XX/YY/ZZZZ.-Finally choose Save and Close button.-Now it will be possible to post the Goods And Activity Confirmation.-Once the above steps are performed, the failed messages in the backend can be restarted.-Keywords-Project Stock Order, Messages, Project Management, General Ledger

Title: Error Message: Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY not valid; Earliest Possible Posting Date is DD/MM/YYYY
Content: Symptom-While clearing Invoice XYZ manually with Payment ID YYY on Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY (Ex:01.03.2017) and the error message is shown as Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY (Ex: 01.02.2017) not valid. The Earliest Possible Posting Date is DD.MM.YYYY (Ex:01.03.2017)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Find Supplier Account and then Choose Open.-Choose Invoice XYZ along with Payment ID YYY.-Choose Clear Manually with Posting Date as 01.03.2017.-Error message is shown.-Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY (Ex: 01.02.2017) not valid. The Earliest Possible Posting Date is DD.MM.YYYY (Ex:01.03.2017)-Cause-The error is due to Invoice is already considered in Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run.-Check on Item Details related to Invoice XYZ, the Posting Date is maintained as 01.02.2017 and the Invoice is considered in Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run on 28.02.2017 and would be reversed on 01.03.2017.-Once the invoice is evaluated in Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, it cannot be cleared at a later date.-Resolution-First, reverse the payables Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs and then manually clear the invoice with payment.-Keywords-Earliest possible posting date, clear manually

Title: How to take an ICM trace
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-This document shows How to take an ICM trace.-NOTE: this can take several minutes to set-up!-Things which you can check in the trace file:-1. Client certificates used-2. Certificate issues-3. All SSL errors and proxy configurations-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Step 1-- Request access to customer system for client "000"- Step 2-- Enter backend and open transaction SM51-- Double click on one of the application servers (it doesn't matter which one, because the following steps have to be repeated for all application servers)- Step 3-- Open a new session and enter transaction SMICM-  Step 4-- Click on "Go to" > "Trace File" > "Reset" to reset the ICM trace- Step 5-- Increase trace level to "3" by clicking on "Go to" > "Trace Level" > "Set"- Step 6-- Repeat Steps 3 to 5 for all application server shown in SM51- === Now Reproduce the issue from Front-end ===- Step 7-- Click on "Go to" > "Trace File" > "Display all"- Step 8-After you have performed your actions. You have to reset the trace level. Click "Goto" > "Trace Level" > "Default"- See Also-KBA 2351619 - How to take SMICM trace?-Keywords-ICM trace, client 000, SM51-icm trace,smicm,ssl errors

Title: Ship-To Address in Sales Volume Report Does Not Match With Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Ship-To address shows in the Sales Order Volume report is not same as the Ship-To address that is maintained the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Reports View.-Open the Sales Order Volume report.-In the selection choose the restriction for Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID for which you find the Ship-To address in the Sales Order does not match with the Ship-To address of the Sales Order Volume Report).-In the View section,  click Add Field option to add Ship-To Address in the View.-Run the report and you can see that the Ship-To address does not match with the Sales Order Ship to address.-Cause-It happens when you are not using the Standard Ship-to address of the ship-to account, or manually changed the address in the sales order.-This is system standard behavior. The Ship-To address, including the email and phone number, in the Sales Order Volume report is fetched from the Business Partner Master Data instead of the address maintained in the sales order.-Resolution-In order to display the Ship-To address which has been set for the Sales Order you have to use another Characteristic. Please proceed as follows:--In the Sales Order Volume report, click on the button Configure icon on the top right.-Expand the Dimension: Business Partner.-Find the characteristic  Address of Ship-To.-Check the box "Display in Report" and Click on Ok-The characteristic "Address of Ship-to" is now added into the Row Fields, you are able to see the Ship-to Address used in the sales order.-See Also-2657293 - Sales Order Volume Report Shows Incorrect Values For Project Sales Orders-Keywords-CRMSLOIB_Q0001, CRMSLOIB, Sales Order Volume Report Ship To wrong; Ship-To Sales Order Volume Report; Sales Order Volume; Report; Bill-to; City; City of Ship-to; Phone; E-Mail; #, Address, wrong, different

Title: G/L Account Migration Error: PAF Inbound Processing error
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate G/L Account Balances, however the import simulation phase end up with a PAF error.-Error meaagse: Error detected in source record with key value * | Goto Correction | PAF Inbound Processing: System Failure (* represents the specific value)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list of the relevant project.-Open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration unit that you are using to migrate the open items or create a new migration unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select the migration object for G/L Account balances and click Process File.-Cause-The PAF error within the migration tool usually occurs when there is an error with the data being migrated. One of the causes for this error to be raised is that the migration date set for the company (and hence used as posting date for the migration unit) dates outside the validity range of the company.-Resolution-For this case, there are two approaches that you can follow.-A) You can extend the validity of the Org. Unit via Organization Management  work center:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view-Find the related company in the structure.-Edit the Org. Unit and change the validity period in the Timelines tab.-After that, trigger the import simulation again in the Migration Tool.-B) Change the Migration Date.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Companies view.-Select the concerned company and click Actions -> Set Posting Date for Migration.-After the date has been changed, a new migration unit has to be created so that the posting date is derived accordingly.-Be aware that both approaches must be carried out with caution. Either the Organizational Management or migration date changes might highly impact in the system and must accord with your business processes.-Keywords-PAF Inbound Processing. Migration Error. Migration Tool. G/L Account Balances

Title: Best Practices for Modelling and Handling Data Sources and Reports - Performance
Content: Symptom-You are creating many data sources and reports and you would like to know what the best practices are to ensure the best performance. This is especially relevant if you handle a large data volume.-Please note: Generally, the performance of data sources and reports cannot be compared between 2 systems, even if the data source / report is the same. There are many factors that influence the performance. Below you will find some guidelines on the relevant data source / report settings.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Best Practices for Modeling Data Sources:-Fundamental understanding:-An inner join returns only those rows from the left table that have a matching row in the right table based on the join criteria.-A left outer join returns all rows from the left table even if no matching rows where found in the right table. Any values selected out of the right table will be null for those rows where no matching row is found in the right table.-For a detailed explanation of the join types, please see the help document called Data Sources.-A Cloud Data Source can be used in order to upload external data into your solution. Please note, the following restrictions for cloud data sources:-No access context is currently supported for cloud data sources, so the access context will always be Unrestricted. This means that whoever has access to reports based on this data source will see the complete data set.-If you use a cloud data source as part of a join and then create a report based on this join, the Add Fields button will not show the fields from the cloud data source.-Best Practices:-Combined data sources make sense where all involved data sources have many characteristics in common, but have different key figures. If there are only very few matches between the characteristics, a join might return better results. For example, you would like to see the combined revenue of a company, irrespective of whether it is coming from sales orders or service orders. So you can create a combined data source on sales orders and service orders to see the aggregated revenue of a company.-Combined data sources tend to be better in terms of performance. In a join, the data volume is multiplied MxN, depending on the join conditions. Hence it is also advisable to reduce the number of join conditions if possible.-When joining data sources, inner joins are the preferred approach.-You can join up to 5 data sources, but it is recommended to keep the number of joined data sources low.-If left outer joins are unavoidable, please note the following:-The data is fetched from the left to the right join members.-For this reason, to improve performance, the anchor of your data source should be the one containing least records.-If there are more than 2 join members, sort them by increasing data volume, i.e. the smallest data source should be the anchor, the next bigger one should be to the right of it, and the largest data source should be to the very right of the table.-For performance, it is preferable to have a master data data source as an anchor, instead of a transactional data source.-Avoid numerous "layers" of data sources, for example scenarios like the example below. These are complex joins and their calculation may take a very long time.-Join 1: several standard data sources are joined-Join 2: Join 1 and one or several standard data sources are joined-Join 3: Join 2 and more standard or customized data sources are joined-Such scenarios should be avoided.-For best performance, the join conditions should be set on ID fields. Please note, that ID fields may be stored in different formats (different lengths) in various data sources, and in those cases, the fields will not match and a join is not possible. Wherever the join on an ID field does not work, joining on UUID fields is advisable. -The join conditions should be set on compatible fields like having same data type and length. Don't ignore the compatibility warnings as this can cause errors in the future.-The join conditions should be on fields whose values are unique. For example, joining on the item ID (values like 10, 20, 30 etc.) is not recommended since there are many documents with such item values. The result of such a join is not consistent.-Best Practices for Modeling / Handling Reports:-Avoid the Show Master Data setting (step 4 in the report wizard) unless absolutely necessary. If this setting is required, it should be limited to 1 characteristic.-If possible, mandatory selection variables should be set up in the steps 4 and 5 in the report wizard.-When setting variables in the report, this should be done via the report wizard, not via the Add Fields button in the report. End users can use the Add Fields button if they need to add one or two variables, whereas if you designing a report as a key user please set the variables in step 4 of the report wizard. Otherwise, the system first fetches the data for all characteristics and key figures that are part of the report, and then another call is made to get the data for the fields added via Add Fields. This will impact the report performance negatively.-When choosing fields for variables, try to use those fields that come from the anchor data source. Setting filters on fields from the anchor data source is always preferable.-Exclude selections take up more system resources than Include. Try to avoid the Exclude operator if possible, however if they are necessary, set them on fields of type ID, rather than UUID. So for example, if you need a negative selection (IS NOT) on the Employee field, make use of the field Employee Responsible ID, rather than Employee Responsible.-When running the report, make sure to apply proper filters in the report Selection - especially for reports / data sources with large data amount (e.g. more than 250k records).-Large selection ranges, as well as any select-all based approach should be avoided, since the same may lead into performance issues / timeout. Since the data volume constantly grows in the databases with time, every report should be handled with proper selection parameters.- Other Factors-There are other factors that influence the performance of Analytical objects in systems, such as overall data volume in the system, system usage, background jobs and their frequency.-For this reason, a comparison of the performance of data sources and reports between different systems is not feasible, even if the above settings are the exact same.-Keywords-report cannot be opened, time out, report loading time, dump, performance, best practice, modelling

Title: How to Check if a Sales Order or a Purchase Order was Created as a Copy
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You want to check if a sales order was created as a copy of an existing sales order. The same applies for purchase orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Logon to the backend.-Go to the Test Shell transaction sesfts-Enter BO Sales_Order for Sales Order or BO /SRMAP/LPURX_PO for Purchase Order -Select Load by Query -> ROOT – QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-In the ID/content field enter the sales order id-Execute-Navigate to ITEM-Copy the NODE_ID of the items-Go to transaction SE11-Enter the Database Table TTED_DO_ITEM-Click on Display-Click on the Contents symbol-In the ITEM_GUID field enter the NODE_ID of the items you copied-Click on Execute-If the Man_Seller_TAXID flag is set this means that the document was created as a copy from an existing Order and this Item was taken over from the previous Order.-Keywords-Sales Order; Purchase Order; Copy; Backend; SE11; Wrong account in sales order;

Title: Impossible to Mark Extension Field as Mandatory in UI of Expense Report Item
Content: Symptom-An extension field is added in the details of the expense item, however, there is no provision to designate it as mandatory.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter Adaptation Mode.-Go to Travel and Expense work center and Expense Reports view.-Select an expense report and select Edit.-Go to Expenses tab and select one expense item.-Select the extension field and then right click the cursor, but no option to mark it as mandatory in field attributes list.-Cause-Setting a field within the expense list to be mandatory is not supported in our technology layer in ByD HTML5. This limitation is documented as item 7 in KBA 2372377.-Since expense item is a list, only lead selected item will be visible. So, mandatory check is done only on selected expense item and it will ignore other items. Due to this behavior we are not offering mandatory setting via adaptation mode if the field is a list bound.-Resolution-The only possibility to perform a check against a field that has been set within a list to mandatory in adaptation mode is to provide the check in a customer specific coding in a customer enhancement via ByD PDI technology-See Also- KBA: 2372377 - Limitations of HTML5 UI in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Expense Report, Extension Field, 费用报销单，扩展字段

Title: Balance Confirmation Run for Cleared Items
Content: Symptom-The Balance Confirmation Run is executed and shows only open items in the form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Balance Confirmation view.-Select the respective Run ID and click Edit.-Go to Balances and Documents tab.-Only open items are displayed.-Cause-Balance Confirmation Run is only for open items, the functionally of run is not meant for cleared items.-Resolution-Balance Confirmation Run is meant for open items only. However, if the cut-off date is changed in the run the items that were open as of that date will be collected.-To check cleared items, the Aging List for Receivables report (Report ID FINDUEU04_Q0008) can be used.-Keywords-balance confirmation; balance confirmation run; cleared items; cut-off date; open items

Title: How to Define Specific Payment Terms For Customer Invoices For Fixed Date Calculation
Content: Symptom-You want to define a specific Payment Term for a Customer Invoice. The Invoice Date is the dd-mm-yyyy (Invoice Date) and the Customer Invoice Due Date is the dd-mm-yyyy (Due Date).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Open the Activity List.-Show Activities in Project and find <Payment Terms>. Use an asterisk to extend the search.-Click on Accounts.-Press on Maintain Payment Terms.-Click Add Row.-Mark the checkbox Use Fixed Date Calculation.-Under Net Price Due enter Fixed Day of Month (3) as XX (where XX represents the days when the Customer Invoice is due).-In the field Additional Month (3) enter YY (where YY is the month when the Invoice is due).-Press Save and Close.-Now the Customer Invoice from the dd-mm-yyyy (Invoice Date) will be due on the dd-mm-yyyy (Due Date).-Keywords-Specific Payment Term; Customer Invoice Payment Term; Net Price Due; Payment Term; Fixed Day of Month; Zahlungsbedingung; fälliger Nettopreis; Kundenrechnung Zahlungsbedingung; correct due date

Title: Dump CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL: Local Shortcut Call Failed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--You are trying to save or to release any instance (for example, Service Order, Sales Order, Invoice, Account, Individual Customer) but a dump is raised with the following error message:--"CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL:"Local Shortcut Call Failed (Y12345678_Y12345678_/Y12345678_YS12345678__03/Y12345678_CO_S0CE52EEE22E0B095)"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-Case 1:-This dump happens because changes were done to BOs involved in an Internal Communication Scenario within SAP Cloud Applications Studio. These BOs were then activated but the file responsible for the communication scenario (.pid) was not updated/activated afterwards.-You can find the .pid file name by searching for the outbound service interface from the error (Y12345678_CO_S0CE52EEE22E0B095) in transaction MDRS.-Case 2:-If the Solution is in a "Deployed" status in a Test Tenant, this dump can also happen if the Solution is not scoped. You can check the Scoping Status of the Process Component in MDRS:-Go to back end Transaction MDRS.-Select Process Component.-Search for Y12345678_YS12345678__03.-Check Scoping under Overview tab.-This should be set to "Productive" if the Solution is fully scoped. You can further check the Scoping Status of the Solution in the UI or back end (BCE).-Resolution-Case 1:-This issue gets resolved by activating the .pid file responsible for the Internal Communication Scenario affected. In case the custom solution is In Development status, please ask the partner to activate it from SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-In case the solution is deployed, you have to activate the .pid in SE38 > PDI_BC_LM_EXECUTE_OLD_SUPP with below parameters:--xREP file path: /Y12345678_MAIN/SRC/InternalCommunicationFilePath.pid-Content type: PROCESS_INTEGRATION-Scope (Item,Solution): I-Mode (Dev,Install): D (execute either with D or U until issue gets solved)--Case 2:-Customer must ensure that the Solution is scoped via the Business Configuration.-Keywords-dump, pid, SDK, PDI, Process Component, scoping, status, scoped, Solution, Internal Communication Scenario, activate, in Development, Deployed

Title: Tax Code Description in Italys Input VAT EC Register Form
Content: Symptom-On the output form of the VAT Return of type: Input VAT EC Register, one invoice with two or multiple items of different Tax Code ABC and DEF, appears with only one Tax Code in the form with a summed up of the Tax Amount of all the items.-ABC and DEC stand for the Tax Code ID.-The same scenario applies to the VAT Return type: Output VAT Extra EC Register.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Select the VAT Returns subview.-Show All Tax Returns.-Search for the Tax Return ID: XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the VAT Return).-Select the button Preview.-In the output form, the Invoice ID: XYZ (XYZ stands for the ID of the invoice) shows with only one tax code ABC with the sum up of the tax amount of the items with the Tax Code ABC and DEF.-This also results in the amount of the Summary per Tax Code been wrong (not the expected one).-Cause-Only one Tax Code: ABC shows in the output form with the summed up of the tax amount because, for the invoice XYZ, the Tax Code ABC and DEC are used.
