Both Tax Codes are mapped to the same Tax Event using the same Tax Type and Rate Type.-In SAP Business ByDesign, for the output form of the Input VAT EC Register (Italy), the grouping is based on Tax Event, Rate Type and Due Category.-Resolution-This is the normal system behavior.-If two or multiple Tax Code (with different description) which are mapped to the same Tax Event are used in the same invoice, only one tax code shows in the form with a summed up of the tax amount.-To fulfill the legal requirement for Italy Input VAT EC Register form to show every Tax Code Description used in an Invoice, you must not include two different Tax Code which are mapped to the same Tax Event in the same invoice. You must include the materials of the same Tax Code in one invoice.-In your case here, the materials with the tax code ABC must be in one invoice and the materials with the tax code DEF in another invoice.-  Keywords-Input VAT EC Register Form, VAT Return Italy, Tax Code Description, Summary Per Tax Code Amount, Output VAT Extra EC Register.

Title: How to Test a Custom or Standard Web Service from Backend and SOAP UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** --How to test a web service during troubleshooting a web service related issue by simulating it from the backend or SoapUI.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Simulation from Backend-Go to MDRS transaction code.-In the first drop down, select Inbound Service Interface.-In the second drop down, enter the ES Name of the Web Service, which can include an wildcard like * (ES Name is the common name known by the customer, which is visible on the UI, like on Web Service Message Monitoring (WSMM) view).-Get the Web Service name from the customer themselves or from the Service Explorer view or WSMM view.--   Double-click the web service name on the left side and then press the icon  /  or hit F8 to Test the web service:--    Choose the Method(Operation) to simulate the web service call and click on Execute (F8) to view the complete XML body:--        In this step, there is an alternative way to test, which is to choose 'Generate Initial Req. Template', this could avoid the xml formatting issue if any.-    Choose the XML editor button:--    Remove the existing XML data and input the sample XML data given from the customer or taken from WSSM view, for example:--    Click on the third button from left to right or F9 to check if the XML is well formed.-If well-formed, click on Execute (F8) button to execute the web service.-Get the response for this in another tab called Response and there you can see if the call was successful or is there any errors.--Simulation from SOAP UI-Open the SoapUI tool.-Go to the tab File -> select New SOAP Project.-Give a Project name and browse the WSDL file that got from the customer.--    Select the relevant action(Create, Read e.t.c) and expand it.--     Double-click the request and copy paste the request (XML, payload) that you got from the customer on the request window.-Enter the Authentication details: user name and password (which can be support credentials from CAM tool).-Click on the green button on the corner of the request window as highlighted in the screenshot:--    Get the response of the action in the response window.-  Resolution-Please refer to the above section on how to test a web service call from the backend or from SoapUI.-Keywords-WS, web service, MDRS, test, inbound, outbound, execute, call, trigger, error, backend, Debug

Title: Error 'Party with role Sales Unit missing; maintain in Involved Parties tab' in a Service Order or Service Quote
Content: Symptom-When creating a new service order or service quote you receive the error message 'Party with role Sales Unit missing; maintain in Involved Parties tab', but you expect it to be automatically determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of a Service Order:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-In the Common Tasks, choose New Service Order.-Add the Account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-You receive the error message 'Party with role Sales Unit missing; maintain in Involved Parties tab'.-Cause-Your master data needs to be maintained correctly for the automatic determination of the sales unit.-Resolution-You have two options for removing the error message from the Service Order or the Service Quote:-Manually add the Sales Unit in the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoicing sub tab of the Service Order/Service Quote.-Manually add the Service Execution Team in the General tab of the Service Order/Service Quote (if the determination is set up to be based on the Sales Unit of Service Execution Team in the fine tuning activity  Involved Parties for Service Orders/Involved Parties for Service Quotes).-Create a work distribution rule for the automatic determination of the Service Execution Team (if the determination is set up to be based on the Sales Unit of Service Execution Team in the fine tuning activity  Involved Parties for Service Orders/Involved Parties for Service Quotes).-You can create a work distribution rule for determination of the Service Execution Team following these steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Organization Work Distribution view.-Select Service Execution Team for Service Orders under Business Area: Service and Support.-Edit the Service Execution Team for Service Orders.-Maintain a rule, it will ensure the automatic determination of Service Execution Team and Service Organization in the Service Orders.-Save your changes.-Note: The above rule is relevant only if there is a sales unit above the service execution unit or if this service execution unit is also set as a sales unit.-If this is not the case, you need to maintain a rule for the Sales Unit for Sales and deactivate the Step 1 - Sales Unit of Service Execution Team, in the fine tuning activity Involved Parties for Service Orders:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click on Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine Tune tab.-Open the activity Involved Parties for Service Orders or Involved Parties for Service Quotes-Select Sales Unit and click on Maintain Determinations button.-Deactivate Step 1 - Sales Unit of Service Execution Team.-Then the Sales Unit can be directly determined via Step 2 - Responsibility "Sales Unit for Sales".-See Also-Community Blog: Party Role Determination in a Service Document-Keywords-automatic determination ; service execution ; work distribution rule ; Involved Parties for Service Orders ; Sales Unit for Sales; Service Quote; Sales Unit

Title: Error "SP CL_PDI_RI_XREP_SP_ABAP1 failed process file /YPQR_//XYZ.absli in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT " Occurs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY** -You are receiving the below error messages when you upload a PDI solution to a tenant:-Wrong developer key or content was modified. Report an incident.-SP CL_PDI_RI_XREP_SP_ABAP1 failed to process file /ABCDEF123_/……/XYZ.absli in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT  (ABCDEF123_ represents the custom solution ID and XYZ represents the ABSL file name).-Failed to import branch of solution into XRepository-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio.-Go to Implementation Manager.-Click Upload.-Upload the zip file of the solution YPQR_-Error message appears (ABC represents user ID. YPQR represents custom BO name. XYZ represents absl file name. M represents tenant ID.)-Wrong developer key or content was modified. Report an incident.-SP CL_PDI_RI_XREP_SP_ABAP1 failed to process file /YPQR_/……/XYZ.absli in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT-Unable to save the content for file /YPQR_/……/XYZ.absli in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT-Error processing file  /YPQR_/……/XYZ.absli-Failed to import branch of solution into XRepository-Repository API call cl_sdi_xrep_access=>import_files returned an error. See preceding message.-An exception occurred-Unable to import files for solutionYPQR_. See preceding message.-Class CL_PDI_1O_ONEOFF_PROJECT_TYPE invocation for phase IMP has failed-Error executing Phase IMP of Project YPQR_ Type ONE_OFF.-Cause-In the source system, the logon language of the PDI development user ABC has Non-English language. Then, the patch solution was activated and then assembled. Due to this, ABSLI corresponding to an ABSL script was incorrectly generated in the backend with an additional attribute:'SIGNATURE' in Non-English language. Non-English logon language made the ABSLI inconsistent.-Resolution-The partner has to maintain his development user language as English in all their tenants. In the source system where the solution was assembled, they need to create a new patch to clean up and activate the affected ABSL files.-This is also documented in the Released to Customer KBA 2917997 in the "See Also" section.-In case the new deployment fails, you can:-Use backend T-Code XREP to check if the /YPQR_/……/XYZ.absl in staging or not-If it is in staging, please contact a senior PDI support colleague or contact the development team to fix it.-See Also-Please refer to 2917997- Issue when Uploading a Custom Solution into a Tenant.-Keywords-SP CL_PDI_RI_XREP_SP_ABAP1, failed, process, file, absli, PDI

Title: No Records Displaying for Mass Data Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- The below steps are only to be done by senior members of the PDI Support team. Be mindful of your actions.-The Partner has created a Mass Data Run (MDR) in the SDK, and have generated screens for this MDR. However, no records are displaying in the OWL for this MDR.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Mass Data Run work center view.-You will notice that it either has no or less records than expected or the error comes up when creating a new record: Instance With Same Key (X) Already Exists.-Cause-All the instances of a Business Object (in this case the Mass Data Run Object) are stored in a secondary persistency (also refered to as FSI) in the database of the system.-This issue occurs when this secondary persistency (FSI) is not updated, and therefore the records will be missing/not visible in the UI.-Resolution-If the issue happens on a test/dev tenant, please send the below KBA to the customer:-2589514 - No Records Displaying for Mass Data Run-If the above solution does not work, a member of the PDI Support team can do the following:-Reproduce the issue in the frontend.-If there are no records in the OWL for this Mass Data Run, check to see if there are any records for this Mass Data Run in SESFTS.-Follow the steps in this Knowledge Base Article to reload the FSI view, and to activate the FSI view in the transaction VIEWBUILDER: 2187722 - Instance With Same Key (X) Already Exists.-Common ground rules for FSI-related issues:-Be mindful and use common sense regarding the amount of data contained for each node. If it has a huge amount of records (e.g. >300 thousand), it is advisable to reload outside business hours of the customer or in the tenant CMP (contractual maintenance period) which happens on weekends. -While reloading a BO node from an FSI view, you migh face errors on the related work center view/screen which makes use of the FSI view.-In general, a MDRO would not hold many records (tipically less than 100) so you can always perform the reload for the custom Mass Data Run BO.-See Also-2589117 - Troubleshooting PDI Mass Data Run Issues-2571142 - How to Search for a Business Object in the Backend Transaction SESFTS-2013763 - PRC_SALES_PRICE_LIST cannot be FSI loaded/reloaded-2031064 - How to Calculate Approximate Time a BO will Take to Complete the Reload-Keywords-FSI, GFSSTM, VIEWBUILDER, MASS DATA RUN, FSI, DATA MISSING, NO RECORDS, MDR, INSTANCES NOT APPEARING

Title: Error Message: "Production Model for Product ID on Date for Quantity not Found"
Content: Symptom-When trying to run MRP or manually create a New Planning proposal for a product and planning area combination, receive the error message:-Production model for Product ID XYZ on Date DD.MM.YYYY for Quantity X not found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-On products, filter for product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-Choose Open.-On the Product Planning Details screen you use Run Planning Button, Single or Multi-Level BoM, or choose on New Planning Proposal button.-Receive Error Message: Production Model for Product ID on Date for Quantity not found*-*When using new planning proposal button, the error will appear after you enter Quantity and Date.-Cause-You are trying to create the production proposal for the current date. System will do backward scheduling and calculate the start date. You need to make sure that this start date falls before the validity date of Release Planning Model (RPM). Let's say that, in the Release Planning Model, the production duration for each item is set to 1 min.-If you create proposal for say 1000 Items, the system will try to set the start date depending on the time it takes to create all the items : 1000 mins which corresponds to about 2 days based on site calendar. Therefore the start date will be the 2 days before the current date.-Since RPM validity starts from current date, you are getting the error message.-Resolution-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Select the Production Model view.-Search for the relevant production model.-Select the searched model and choose Edit button.-In the production model screen, go to the General tab.-Here change the Valid From date for a day in the past which complies with the quantity time of production.-Choose Release Production Model drop down and then select For Planning and Execution.-Keywords-BOM, Bill of Materials, Production Model, Production Proposal, MRP.

Title: Error When Trying to Migrate SEPA Mandates for Customers
Content: Symptom-An error occurs when attempting to migrate SEPA mandates for customers using the migration tool in Business ByDesign.-The error message displayed is "Service call failed; report an incident".-The issue arises when trying to update data about the method of payment and mandate for several hundred customers who already have bank data in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Configuration work center.-Then go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity "Migration of Customers" and open it.-Click "Migrate customers using the migration tool".-Select the affected template.-Click "Execute Migration Step by Step".-The error message will appear at the "Simulate Import" step.-Cause-There are two possible causes for this error in the Migration of Customer:-SEPA Creditor ID is missing at company level.-Missing account determination group for customer and company.-Resolution-For the first cause, please maintain the SEPA Creditor ID at company in the org level.-You can maintain this data in the Organitional Management work center.-Select Company.-Click Edit.-Go to the General tab.-Hyperlink External Identifier.-Enter account determination group for customer and company.-As per the logic system is throwing message when 'Cash on Demand' is not scoped in the Business Configuration.-See Also-2420304 - Unable To Modify Contact Information Using Migration Tool-3254075 - Error "Service Call failed; Report an Incident" When Trying to Migrate Contacts-Keywords-Migration of Customers, SEPA mandates, Customers, Accounts, Company, Error, Service call failed, Migration tool, Method of payment, Mandate, Simulate Import.

Title: Negative Stock Values in Material Inventory Balance Summary Report Due to Backdated Consumption Entries
Content: Symptom-The Material Inventory Balance Summary Report reflects negative stock values for a specific period despite negative stock being disallowed. This occurs when backdated consumption entries are recorded with dates preceding the corresponding stock receipt.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Open the Reports view and select the Material Inventories - Balance Summary report.-Filter for the product category and fiscal year.-Observe negative stock values in one month and positive values in the next, even though negative stock is not allowed for the location.-Cause-The issue occurs because consumption entries are recorded with a backdated posting date, preceding the receipt of stock. This results in negative stock values being reflected in the Material Inventory Balance Summary Report for the earlier period.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Backdated transactions adjust current stock levels while posting valuation differences on the specified date. Therefore, restrict backdated postings to authorized personnel to minimize errors. This would maintain accurate reporting and alignment between stock adjustments and their financial impact.-Keywords-Negative Stock, Material Inventory Balance Summary Report, Backdated Consumption Entries, Stock Receipt Dates, Process Controls

Title: Customer Account statement form requires Invoice date/Document date - South Africa
Content: Symptom-This KBA is applicable only for South Africa Localization.-While trying to send the Customer Account Statement output form to the customer, only posting date for the customer invoice is visible and not the Invoice date/Document date in the customer account statement form .-The requirement here is that the Invoice date/ Document date should be visible in the customer Account Statement form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Account Statement sub view.-Check the Customer Account Statement Run ABC. (Here ABC refers Statement Run ID)-Open the Customer Account Statement of customer DEF. (Here DEF refers Customer account ID)-Highlight the relevant application log, and select 'view Report run results'.-Navigate to the attachments and check the document in PDF.-Only posting Date visible and not the invoice date/document date.--Cause-The initial requirement document for Customer Account Statement - South Africa clearly says that they need "Column 1: Dates of Movements " which means the date on which movement has happened basically the date on which the posting has happened hence it shows the Posting date in the pdf.-All the calculation is performed on basis of Posting dates because that's the date when the actual amount moved from into a G/L account, hence taking this dates into consideration for calculating due amount in the given period makes sense functionally.-Hence the requirement of the Invoice date/ Document date in the Customer Account Statement form cannot be taken.-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected. And this new request to change the behavior of fields part of PDF file for Customer Account Statement - South Africa cannot be applied.-See Also-Documentation link: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2e30d84496214461ad763692c3a0b4a5/fd243f5ef7194aa7a4814238050b43a2.html -KB0681974  -  South Africa: Customer Account Statement Form Template Is Wrong-Keywords-Customer Account Statement form, Customer Invoice, Receivables, Posting Date, Invoice Date.

Title: Inbound Delivery Notification Inconsistency Post 2411 Upgrade
Content: Symptom-The Inbound Delivery Notification document becomes inconsistent when the iStock is updated.-An error message is displayed stating "The product specifications for the item ID and the PO must match."-The updated iStock is not mapped to the product specification (PRS) which was requested in the relevant Purchase Order.-Environment-Inbound Delivery-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search and select the relevant delivery notification.-Choose the Action.-Navigate to the Line Item and change the iStock. Ensure this iStock is mapped to a PRS id which is not the PRS requested via the relevant PO.-Save the document.-Cause-In the 2411 upgrade, the system behavior was enhanced to ensure that the product specification received in the warehouse is the same as the product specification requested in the purchase order.-This enhancement was implemented to ensure that warehouse confirmations are posted without issues in accounting.-The Inbound Delivery Notification document will be inconsistent to ensure that the product specification requested in the purchase order is received in the warehouse.-Resolution-Make the Inbound Delivery Notification consistent by updating the product specification which was requested in the purchase order.-The document can be processed once the notification is consistent.-See Also-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, iStock, product specification, PO, 2411 upgrade, inconsistency, warehouse confirmation, accounting.

Title: Unable to Find New Created Labour Resource Cost Rate which Created by Calling Webservice ManageLRCRIn
Content: Symptom-You create labor resource cost rates using the standard inbound service ManageLRCRIn. Subsequently, you know from the response payload that the call was successful, but the created data could not be found in the system.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Cause-The service used here is not for creating Labor Cost Rate, but for creating Labor Cost Rates runs.-Go to the Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Navigate to the Labor Cost Rates View.-Select the Operation All Runs, you will notice the new created record is in there.-Resolution-System is working fine as the service II_MANAGE_LRCR_IN (Maintain labour resource cost rates) does create the Labour Resource.-We recommend you to use either the migration service to create new Labour Resource or to do same from the UI.-To migrate Labor Resources using the migration service:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Labor Resources.-Select Migrate labor resources using the migration tool.-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen and the Download Migration Template.-Fill the required and the mandatory fields in the migration file.-Upload the Migration File.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records.-Migration is successful- Keywords-Labour Resource Cost Rates, Webservice, ManageLRCRIn, II_MANAGE_LRCR_IN

Title: Employee Replication Request Error where ST22 refers to METHOD CL_FOP_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT_A
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Employee Replication Request from EC for employee causes the replication process to crash.-The same issue occurs when attempting to fetch data from EC again for this employee.-The error message "Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report a case."  is displayed.-ST22 error relates to METHOD CL_FOP_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT_A-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select Master Data Replication.-Choose Employee.-Select the failed request for the affected employee.-Select Edit.-Choose Replicate.-Error messages "An error occurred." "Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report a case." -The backed ST22 error shows:-Category               ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors         MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT-ABAP Program           CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP-Application Component  BC-ESI-ESF-ABA-Date and Time          DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS-Active Calls/Events-No.   Ty.          Program                             Include                             Line-      Name-   55 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003    66-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-   54 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001    24-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-   53 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CM00O   125-      /BOPF/CL_FRW=>SET_APPLICATION_ERROR-   52 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CM00D  1101-      /BOPF/CL_FRW=>DO_MODIFY-   51 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW_INT_ACCESS=======CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW_INT_ACCESS=======CM00K    59-      /BOPF/CL_FRW_INT_ACCESS=>END_MODIFY-   50 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW_INT_ACCESS=======CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW_INT_ACCESS=======CM00C    22-      /BOPF/CL_FRW_INT_ACCESS=>/BOPF/IF_FRW_MODIFY~END_MODIFY-   49 METHOD       CL_FOP_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT_A====CP    CL_FOP_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT_A====CM006    19-      CL_FOP_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT_A=>RESET_CONTEXT-   48 METHOD       CL_FOP_DET_PAYFRM_DEL=========CP    CL_FOP_DET_PAYFRM_DEL=========CM001   537-Cause-The issue is probably caused by changed payment information.-Compare the failed replication request with the last successful one and identify the change(s).-Example: The Payment Form is maintained as Cash in the failed request, and as Bank Transfer in the last successful request.-The issue might additionally also be associated with an Inactive status of the employee in the ByDesign system.-Resolution-You may suggest updating the replication request to match the values of the successful replication request.-Then try replication again.-See Also-Keywords-Employee Replication, EC, Replication Process, Crash, Error, Master Data Replication, Failed Request.

Title: Error on purchase order "Business residence not found; check ship-to or service location"
Content: Symptom-User face the error "Business residence not found; check ship-to or service location" when creating a new purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Open the affected purchase order and navigate to the affected item.-Change item type from service to material.-Click on check, receive the error "Business residence not found; check ship-to or service location".-Cause-The account assignment of this item is project task. However the responsible unit of this project is not marked as cost center.-Resolution-Please mark the responsible unit of the assigned project as cost center.-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Enter Edit mode and Locate the affected org unit.-Navigate to Definitions tab, under Managerial Definitions, mark the Cost Center definition for the org unit.-Activate and save.-Then go back to check, the error will be gone on the purchase order.-Keywords-Business residence not found; check ship-to or service location, Purchase order, Project task, Business residence, Delivery, ship-to location

Title: How to manually restart and debug process communication messages
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When a process communication error (PCE) message is erroneous due to PDI, it is up to the partner responsible to fix their custom solution, otherwise, the problem will persist.-This KBA will describe how to find and restart an internal message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-The cause for a failed communication message may be because of a custom solution on the customer's side.-Resolution-We need the ID of the document (sales order, customer invoice, etc.) that the client wants us to restart. Then, follow the below steps to restart the internal message:-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Select the affected BO.-Go to ROOT - QUERY BY ELEMENTS (directory icon).-Query in the ID of the document.-Once the document is fetched by query, right-click on the instance (left side).-Select Message Monitoring > second option (Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow).-Once in the Message Monitor screen (SRT_MONI), select the errored view(s).-Click Action > Restart. -The status should be on Delivered if everything is corrected.-If the error persists, you can debug the message restart:-In SRT_MONI, click on Technical View button.-Then click on the column value of Queue Name.-Here, right click on the failing queue sequence object on the right side -> Unit analysis -> Debug with current user.-A breakpoint you have set in SE24 should trigger. (e.g. a breakpoint set in CM_ESI_T100 => CONSTRUCTOR)-See Also-Keywords-Process Communication, Sales Orders, Manual Restart, Backend, Error, Transaction SESFTS, Message Monitoring, Restart, Delivered.

Title: The Error "E-mail address is invalid" is Displayed When Creating a Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When creating a Project Invoice Request from a Sales Order document, the error "E-mail address is invalid" is displayed in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Project Invoicing View.-Select the Sales Order sub view.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Mark the Sales Order ABC.-Select New button.-Select Automatic Manual Invoice Request.-Select Check button.-The error "E-mail address is invalid" is displayed for the new Project Invoice Request.-Cause-The e-mail address of the account party role in the Sales Order ABC was maintained with extra spaces when the document was released.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Open, select View All.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab-Mark the Account Party Role-Scroll down to the Communication tab-The e-mail address of the account party role is displayed with extra spaces.-Note: This scenario can also occur for other Party Roles in the Sales Orders.-Resolution-In this case, a backend correction must to be performed by the development team in order to remove the extra spaces of the account e-mail address in the Sales Order document.-Therefore once the scenario described is identified for any Project Invoice Request, it is required to open a case with SAP support team requesting the changes to be performed for the account e-mail address at the Sales Order document along with approval for the corrections to be applied in the document.-Keywords-e-mail, email, sales order, project invoice request, e-mail address is invalid, extra spaces

Title: Mismatch in Tagged Inventory Status of Registered Product
Content: Symptom-Registered product status is set to Obsolete.-Tagged Inventory Status of the registered product is displayed as "In Stock".-Environment-Goods and Activity Confirmation-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Service Entitlements work center.-Proceed to the Registered Product view.-Search for the relevant registered product with the status Obsolete.-Choose the Edit button.-Observe that the Tagged Inventory Status is displayed as "In Stock".-Cause-The status of a registered product, which is currently in stock, is changed to Obsolete, causing the stock to become restricted.-This change in status does not affect the Tagged Inventory Status of the registered product.-Resolution-The reported behaviour is not a bug in the system.-See Also-Keywords-Registered product, Obsolete, In Stock, Tagged Inventory Status, Service Entitlements, inventory, stock.

Title: Error When Transferring Employee to an Organizational Unit
Content: Symptom-An error occurs when attempting to transfer an employee to the organizational unit. The error message displayed is:-Update to organizational structure currently not possible; Period not valid; parent node only valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Regular Tasks.-Select the required Country and click on Transfer Employee.-Input the mandatory fields.-Save the changes.-The error message is displayed.-Cause-The Valid To date of the Org Unit is maintained as 31.12.2999, due to the end date of the Org Unit the transfer is not possible.-Resolution-In order to fix this error, please change the Valid To of the Org Unit from 31.12.2999 to 31.12.9999(Unlimited) and then try transferring the employee.-See Also-Keywords-Employee transfer, Organizational Unit, Error, Update to organizational structure currently not possible, Period not valid, Parent node, Validity dates, Position record split, Org Unit, Transfer, Employee, Regular Task.

Title: User wants this field Process Type in the Purchase Order web service query to create the PO
Content: Symptom-You want to create a purchase order using the standard web service query ManagePurchaseOrderIn and you want to add the field "Process Type" in the file but you are unable to find this field in the query.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and user management work center-Select view service explorer-Select Maintain purchase orders-> ManagePurchaseOrderIn-Open the documentation link-The web service (ManagePurchaseOrderInMaintainBundle )sample does not contain process type field -Cause-The standard Business By Design web service query does not have specifically "process type" field in the purchase order request XML file.-But there is a Direct Material Indicator.-This indicator indicates if the item is a stock or consumable item. If the flag is set, then it is a stock item.-Resolution-If you want to specify the process type , you can set the indicator as True or false :- <DirectMaterialIndicator>false</DirectMaterialIndicator>- <ThirdPartyDealIndicator>false</ThirdPartyDealIndicator>-Keywords-process type missing in PO web service,  ManagePurchaseOrderIn

Title: Unexpected E-mail Address in BTP Role Assignment Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer is working on assigning BTP roles for business users in SAP Business ByDesign. It is reported that when checking the report which shows the users provisioned with certain BTP roles, there are e-mails which should not be appearing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Business Users view.-Select any user from the list.-Click on the Assign BTP Roles button.-Click on the View Role button.-Select one of the BTP roles from the dropdown list, so the user list is displayed.-Here there are e-mail addresses whose respective business users are not provisioned with BTP roles.-Cause-The role assignment report should be pulled at runtime using a BTP API request, so the report should be always up-to-date. The e-mails listed are the ones currently provisioned in BTP using the e-mail address maintained in the employee workplace data in SAP Business ByDesign.-In some cases, inconsistent entries may remain in the report even after unassigning the BTP roles from a user.-Resolution-Please create an incident for development component AP-LM-PRV-BLR-DEV with the list of e-mails that should be removed.-Keywords-BPA, iRPA, IRPA_Admin, IRPA_User

Title: Placeholder Images in Application and User Management Work Center
Content: Symptom-In the "Application and User Management" work center, within the "Substitutions" view, for employees who have a maintained image in their personnel file, these images are displayed. -In the "Application and User Management" work center, within the "Substitutions" view, for employees who do not have a maintained image in their personnel file, placeholders are displayed. -This issue is observed in the Release 2411, whereas in the previous Release 2408, no image was displayed for such employees, which might be the expected behaviour.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the "Application and User Management" work center.-Open the "Substitutions" view.is -Find image placeholders for all employees for whom no image exists in Personnel Administration. -Resolution-As part of accessibility enhancement the non textual elements like images and icons are updated with alternative text in 2411 release. -This alternative text will be visible in case element cannot be loaded / does not exist while user open the application.-Keywords-Application and User Management, Substitutions view, placeholder images, employee images, Release 2411, Release 2408, regression issue.

However total gross amount is not getting rounded off.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for relevant purchase order-Select Edit and you can see the Total Gross Amount -The decimals are not rounded to the next number-Resolution-This is currently a technical limitation. If you would like to enhance the functionality, you can post the idea in influence forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 -Keywords-Purchase order gross amount; Rounding off Amount; Decimal rounding off;

Title: Error on Product Category Hierarchy Migration: "Root product category cannot be edited/deleted later; check before saving"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Migration of Product Category Hierarchy gives error at Simulation:-"Root product category cannot be edited/deleted later; check before saving"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Business Configuration work center.-Overview view.-Search activity "Product Category Hierarchy".-Migrate using Migration Tool.-Process the relevant file.-In Simulation step see error: "Root product category cannot be edited/deleted later; check before saving".-Cause-A Warning is being displayed as an Error in the Migration Tool UI, and an Error not being displayed.-There will be no ST22 log but a SLG1 record will display "Root product category cannot be edited/deleted later; check before saving" as a warning. However the SLG1 record will also display a separate Error which is not visible in the Migration Tool UI.-Resolution-Resolve the backend Error and "Root product category cannot be edited/deleted later; check before saving" will no longer display in the Simulation Step.

Title: The Delivery Status of an Item is Displayed as "In Progress" Even Though the Overall Status of the Sales Order is "Completed"
Content: Symptom-The Delivery status of an item is being displayed as "In Progress" even though the overall status of the Sales Order is "Completed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Sales Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ID XYZ. (where XYZ represents the Sales Order ID)-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Mark the Line Item XX. (where XX represents the Line Item number)-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Delivery status of the item is displayed as "In progress" and the Invoice status is displayed as "Not Started".-In addition, the Delivery process is occurring through a 3PL document.-Cause-In this case, the 3PL request is rejected which cause the status of the document to change to "Finished". Therefore, the Delivery status of the Item will be kept as "In Progress" in order to indicate that the Delivery of the item has started at some point for the Sales Process of the document.-Even after maintaining a Reason for Rejection for the Line Item, the Delivery status will continue to be displayed as "In Progress". This occurs because once the Reason for Rejection is set for the item, the system will identify that this action has completely stopped the Delivery process for the Item and will keep the status as "In Progress" for reference.-In addition, the warning message "Item XX: Cancelled item may already be in process; stop delivery/execution" will be displayed after setting the reason for rejection for the Item.-Additionally, to verify the item cancellation status, you can check in Sales Order Volume report, show the Cancellation Status (Item) field in the view.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-3pl, sales order, delivery status, in progress, item, finished, rejected, canceled.

Title: A Dump Error is Displayed When Creating a Custom Surcharge or Price List in the system
Content: Symptom-When creating a Custom Surcharge in the Surcharges View, a dump error is displayed in the UI.-Note: The same dump error can also occurs when creating Price List via the Price List View. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to the Surcharges View.-Filter for the Custom Surcharge List ABC (where ABC represents the Custom Surcharge List).-Click on New button.-In the dropdown, select the Custom Surcharge List ABC.-The dump error is displayed in the UI.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to the Price Lists View.-Filter for the Custom Price Lists EDF (where EDF represents the Custom Surcharge List).-Click on New button.-In the dropdown, select the Custom Price Lists EDF.-The dump error is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The set up of the Custom Surcharge or Price List in the Configure Price Strategy activity was performed using a PDI field in which the content of the field comes from a Custom Business Configuration activity.-Currently, the Price Engine does not support extension fields for which the content comes from a Custom Business Configuration Object. Therefore, in case the content for the Extension fields is being determined through a Custom Business Configuration activity, it will not be possible to maintain these fields for the Pricing Tables and further configurations in the Pricing with Extension fields scenario.-Resolution-It is not be possible to use Extension fields in which the content is determined via a Custom Business Configuration Object (BCO) for the Pricing with Extension fields scenario. This occurs because the content of the PDI field comes from a Custom Business Configuration activity which in this case is consider as dynamic content being possible for any user to alter at any point in time. -The Price engine was design to support only Extension fields of code types where the content is static, for example KUT or .codelist data types. In this case, we recommend to always use KUT or .codelist datatypes for the set up of the Pricing with Extension fields scenarios in the system.-This is currently limitation in the Pricing scenario.-See Also-KBA 2353501 - How to Create Surcharge Based on Extension Field-KBA 3099502 - How To Create a Custom Price List With Extension Fields -Keywords-Surcharge, Surcharge List, Price List, Custom, PDI, field, SDK, Business, Configuration, Object, CL_PRC_ESF_CND_PV_IL, Could not create data object; type  does not exist

Title: Error: "426 Upgrade Required" in SAP Business ByDesign Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-When testing the connection of a Web Service Communication Arrangement in tenant, the following error occurs:-Checking connection failed-Ping failed (KBA: 2926863)-Upgrade Required-When debugging the response of the call on SDK, the following error code appears:-Error code: 426-On Header Parameters, you will find on some the following value:-Value: "HTTP/1.x 426 Upgrade Required"-Where x equals anything other than 0.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application & User Management.-Select Communication Arrangements.-Choose the concerned Communication Arrangement.-Click Edit -> Technical Data -> Edit Advanced Settings;-Click on the concerned URL.-Click Check Connection.-Cause-The error is caused by the use of an unsupported HTTP version.-SAP Business ByDesign (Byd) and SAP Cloud for Customer(C4C) only supports HTTP version 1.0.-Resolution-Confirm that the HTTP version being used is 1.0.-If a different version is being used, contact the service provider to adjust the HTTP version to 1.0.-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Error 426, Upgrade Required, HTTPs version, SDK, Communication Arrangement, Check Connection, REST, Web Service.

Title: How to Change the Sales Organization or Distribution Channel in a Service Order or Service Quote
Content: Symptom-You want to change the Sales Organization or Distribution Channel in a Service Order or Service Quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Resolution-For Service Orders:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Open Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Service Order ID).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoicing sub tab.-In the section Organizational Assignment for Sales you can change the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel as per your requirement.-For Service Quotes:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Quotes view.-Open Service Quote ABC (ABC represents the Service Order ID).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoicing sub tab.-In the section Organizational Assignment for Sales you can change the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel as per your requirement.-See Also-Keywords-Service Orders, Distribution Channel, Sales Organization, Service Order Processing, Change Sales Organization, Change Distribution Channel, Distribution Chain, Sales Org, Service Quote,

Title: How To Create Split Open Items In Receivable/Payables Using API
Content: Symptom-Need 'Split Open Item' on SAP Clud Application Studio for developing a custom solution, ,however the action cannot be found via Studio. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Find Account ID XXX (XXX represents the customer account ID).-Click View.-Select the target open item.-Can see Actions - Split Open Items.-Cause-Currently we haven't provided the PSM release for the button Split Open Items. -That's the reason this cannot be achieved to code an add-on solution.  -There is also no existing node for the action Split in the corresponding WSDL. So using API is not an option.-Resolution-The current BADI_FOP_TRP_ITEM_SPLIT doesn't work for the specific case due to missing ability to add the Customer Account.-And this would need to be logged as a new feature request. Suggest any change at Customer Influence web site.-Keywords-Split Open Items, API

Title: G/L Account Mapping Is Not Working to Post Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-While trying to post a supplier invoice, system throws error:-"Account determination missing for account determination group ABC. Choose the account determination for Costs. To define the account for chart of accounts DEF go to tab 'General Expenses'. Enter a general ledger account for 'ABC'.-ABC means the Account Determination Group for General Expenses.-DEF means the Chart of Accounts.-Since G/L Account Mapping has been done from Chart of Accounts GHI to DEF and for G/L Account ABC to XYZ, the expectation is that the system managed to post the invoice without the need of defining a G/L Account for ABC in DEF.-GHI means the Chart of Accounts.-XYZ means the Mapped G/L Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The G/L Account Mapping enables manual postings in all sets of books for a company in cases where the sets of books do not all use the same chart of accounts. This functionality is supported for:-Manual journal entry vouchers-Recurring journal entry vouchers-Acquisition and revaluation postings for fixed assets-Supplier invoice postings is not supported in G/L Account Mapping.-Resolution-The error message is valid here and the required entry must be done in Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity --> Chart of Accounts DEF --> Costs subledger --> General Expenses tab.-See Also-Help document: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination – Configuration Guide --> Define G/L Account Mapping-Keywords-g/l account mapping; supplier invoice; CoA; Chart of accounts; Costs; general expenses.

Title: Process Communication Error: "Business Partner Internal ID missing"
Content: Symptom-Business Partner Internal ID missing error occurs in Process Communication Error view for the below documents:-Sending Document: Supplier -Receiving Document: BO_CA_BusinessPartner-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Process Communication Error-Error: Business Partner Internal ID missing-Cause-The webservice is missing the Internal Business Partner ID.-It could be due to a custom solution. The actions the partner is performing with the web service are missing a business partner ID.-Resolution-The partner is responsible for investigating and resolving any issues related to their solution, as they are the only ones who can analyze its underlying logic. Please contact the partner responsible for the solution to address and resolve the issue.-Keywords-Custom Solution, Business Partner Internal ID missing, Process Communication Error, Partner Solution

Title: Error message "Work description is mandatory for project task" "Time period or duration mandatory in combination with project data on"
Content: Symptom-The system throws an error message while trying to record the time "Work description is mandatory for project task" "Time period or duration mandatory in combination with project data on"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Access the Self-Services view.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet under Time.-Navigate to the required week.-Enter the time recording as required.-Select the Save button or move to different tab .-System throws the below error message.-Error message "Work description is mandatory for project task" "Time period or duration mandatory in combination with project data on"-Cause-The issue is occurring when any cell containing data is clear and set it to zero while in the worklist view.-Resolution-It it recommended to use the day view to clear the contents of any day. To remove time entries in the day view, please use the "Delete" action or the delete symbol. This way, you can avoid encountering the mandatory error for the work description.-Keywords-Edit Time Sheet, Work description, Day View, Worklist view, Project

Title: Output Email Sent to Unexpected Email Address for Third Party Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are using the third party process in order to sell products to your customer and have them delivered directly from your supplier. However, unexpectedly, you find your customer also receives the output email of the third party purchase order, which allow your customer see your supplier and your costs. And you haven't manually added any email address in the order output setting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to New Sales Order (Advanced) view.-Add Customer and External Reference in the order.-Navigate to Items tab to change Fulfillment Type to External and add Supplier .-View You can Also > Edit Output settings, here you can see the emails that the sales order will be sent to.-Submit and release.-Then find the created purchase request and click Create Purchase order.-For the new purchase order, click You can Also > Edit Output settings for Created PO > You can see that email address of customer is listed in the send to address of the purchase order.-Cause-You have ticked 'Send cc' box for the Recipient in Business Configuration activity 'Purchase Order Output Control Settings'.-Resolution-Please untick the box via the following path:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Filter 'Activities' list.-Search for 'Purchase Order Output Control Settings'-Open 'Purchase Order Send Email Control Settings'.-Untick the 'Send cc' box for Recipient.-Or-You can manually remove the recipient email address when creating new purchase order via You can also - Edit Output Settings for Create PO. Please remember to do this for every newly created purchase order, since this action only works for the currect purchase order you create.-See Also-KBA: 2571549 - Purchase Order Output Email is Not Sent to Supplier-Keywords-Purchase Order, Output Channel, Email Address, Supplier, Output History, 采购订单, 输出渠道, Purchase Order Output Control Settings, 第三方

Title: Amber Alert Displayed for Availability Check (ATP) Despite Sufficient Stock
Content: Symptom-The Availability Check (ATP) displays an amber (yellow) signal even though there is enough on-hand quantity to fulfill the demand.-The expectation is for the ATP to display a green signal indicating that the order can be confirmed sufficiently.-Environment-Customer Requirement-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to the Customer demand view.-Search and select the relevant order.-Choose the respective line item and chose the Actions button.-Select the option Check Availability.-The availability check signal is Amber even though there is enough stock available to fulfill the demand.-Cause-The availability check displays a green signal indicating the orders are confirmed sufficiently if all the requested quantities can be delivered on the requested date time.-The requested date for the line item in your demand is in the past.-Since the requested date is in the past, the item(s) cannot be delivered on the requested date.-Resolution-The system will always display an amber alert when and if the requested date is in the past, as the orders cannot be delivered on time.-See Also-3466533 - ATP is Yellow Though No Stock is Available -2957703 - ATP Shows Insufficient Quantity For a Product Which is Available on Stock -Availability Checks Help Document - ByDesign-Keywords-Amber Alert, Availability Check, ATP, Sufficient Stock, Past Requested Date, Order Confirmation, Outbound Logistics Control, Customer Demand.

Title: Data type of data source field is not available / Involved MDAV Mapping - Element does not exist in involved MDAV
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -You are getting error message below when editing data source:-Data type of data source field XYZ is not available-Involved MDAV Mapping - Element does not exist in involved MDAV-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. You are editing a data source.-2. You get error:-Data type of data source field XYZ is not available-Involved MDAV Mapping - Element does not exist in involved MDAV-Cause-You have deleted an extension field from the underlying Data source, or if join or combined the data source member, and the Data Source is now throwing an error.-The error message even identifies which field is erroneous.-Resolution-You can see the field both from the backend & the UI showing how such issues can be identified easily.-Explain to customer which field he should remove.-The customer should just remove the erroneous field from the affected Data Source.-Keywords-MDAV; Data source; element; not available;

Title: User is unable to select multiple line items in a Shopping Cart to create a single delivery document for all items
Content: Symptom-You have created a shopping cart with multiple line items and want to create a single delivery document for all items.-But you observed that you cannot select multiple line items in the shopping cart OWL screen, however you can do so from inside the cart under Items tab. -Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select view Self Services Overview-Select Confirm Deliveries-Click on the respective shopping cart with multiple items-Now you are unable to select all items at one go and confirm delivery-Cause-This is the standard SAP by design behavior where OWL (preview screen) has restriction to select only single line for any action.-It is a technical limitation for OWL screen.-If you are navigating or opening the shopping cart line item in view all mode, then you can select multiple line items for any action.-Resolution-You cannot select multiple line items if you open the cart and select the items.-Keywords-unable to confirm delivery for multiple items in shopping cart, shopping cart delivery

Title: Middle name field is missing for employees in China
Content: Symptom-The Middle Name field is not visible for  China employees in Biographical Data. However, for employees of nationalities other than Chinese, the Middle Name field is visible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the employee - ABC-Edit the Employee data-Go to Biographical Data under Personal Data -Middle name field is missing-Cause-Although you have hired this employee through one of the options in the non-localized dropdown, the country you selected is actually a localized country in SAP Business ByDesign.-This dropdown is the same one used in every country/region selection in the system, so all countries are displayed - not only the non-localized ones.-Below is the list of localized countries in SAP Business ByDesign.-Australia-Austria-Belgium-Canada-China-Denmark-France-Germany-India-Israel-Italy-Japan-Mexico-Netherlands-New Zealand-South Africa-South Korea-Spain-Switzerland-United Kingdom-United States-Resolution-The employee is being hired using an option from the dropdown menu that is not localized. However, the country selected is a localized country within SAP Business ByDesign.-In the system, each country has its own set of rules. In China, the middle name is not required and this is the standard behavior. -When hiring an employee through the Localized China tab, the middle name field is not visible. This is because it follows the specific rules and requirements for employees in China.-Keywords-Middle name, China, Localized, Non - Localized, Biographical Data,Personal Data
