Title: In Invoice Scanning tool, the Value in Index 16 Cannot be Reviewed
Content: Symptom-Invoice Scanning is not working as expected when reviewing the values from scanned pdf. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Scanning view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Invoice's ID). -Click in Review button. -Select the value from index 16.-In Field insert the item column to change the value.  -In Row Index insert '16'. -Click in Apply. -The pop-up doesn't close, and the reviewed value is not updated. -P.S.: this happens for index equal to or greater than 16.-Cause-When training the Invoice Scanning tool by reviewing the values, only index from 1 to 15 can be picked. -Resolution-System is working as designed. -See Also-KBA: 2957942 - Accuracy of Intelligent Invoice Scanning-Keywords-Invoice Scanning, Index 16, Reviewed Values, Intelligent Invoice Scanning, PDF Scanning Invoice, PDF Invoice Scanning, PDF Supplier Invoice, Scanned Invoice

Title: Invoice Split Occurs Due to the External Reference on Project Invoice Request Failed to Pass to the New Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You select multiple invoice requests and try to invoice them into one invoice. But system split happens. From Split Analysis option, you find the External Reference is the reason for the split, the invoice generated from the project invoice request has no External Reference value however it is filled in the invoice request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select multiple invoice requests including one Customer Project Invoice Request ABC. They all have the same external reference value 123.-Click Invoice, in the new invoice screen, system proposes 2 new invoices. -Select both proposed invoices, and click Split Analysis button, you can see the split reason is on External Reference field. One new invoice has no value on External Reference. You notice this new invoice is from the project invoice request.-Go back to the Invoice Requests view, the External Reference is actually filled in the project invoice request.-ABC represents the ID of the project invoice request.-123 represents the External Reference filled in the selected invoice requests.-Cause-The country specific determination code fetch is failed because of the Proposed CI Proposing Type is blank in the document in backend, and hence it's fetching BC Configuration determination code for the same and which is 1 (Copied from Own ID). So, the external reference 123 in the project invoice request is not filled in the new invoice, this causes the invoice split.-To check the value in backend.-Access to backend.-Enter  transaction code /NSESFTS-Enter BO APCI_CUST_INV_REQUEST, and load the project invoice request ABC.-In Overview node, PROPOSED_CI_PROCESSING_TYPE is not filled. -Resolution-Manual correction in backend is needed to fill the PROPOSED_CI_PROCESSING_TYPE value for the project invoice request. Please forward the case to development team.-Keywords-invoice split; project invoice request; external reference; blank.

Title: Inability to View TextCollection in XML of Delivery Note
Content: Symptom-The TextCollection section is not visible in the XML of the delivery note.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Proceed to the Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for Outbound Delivery ID XXX and access the Notes section. (XXX means Outbound Delivery ID)-Notice there is an Internal note.-Proceed to Output history, select the latest Output Delivery Print, and click on View Original XML.-The TextCollection is not seen.-Cause-The issue arises when the Note Type chosen is 'Internal Comment'. In this case, the TextCollection section is not visible in the XML file.-Resolution-It is necessary to choose Note Type Additional External Comment and the field will be visible in the XML file.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, XML, TextCollection, Internal Comment, Additional External Comment, Notes section, Delivery Note.

Title: Error While Posting Supplier invoice "Avalara Error"
Content: Symptom-Avalara error is being triggered in Supplier Invoice or Purchase Order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Click in Check button. -The error is triggered:-Avalara Error-Cause-There are some steps to check:-(1) check if the Address information is fully maintained in the Supplier Master Data. In General tab, it has to be maintained the Postal Code, the Region or the Jurisdiction Codes. -(2) check if the information is correct in the Supplier Master Data (specially the Postal Code). -Correct the information and then save it. -Resolution-Maintain the details in Supplier Master Data and the issue will not occur for new invoices.-For existing affected documents, follow the steps below:-Open Supplier Invoice ABC.-Remove the Supplier.-Click in Check button.-Add the Supplier in the blank space. -Click in Check button.-The error is no longer being triggered. -Keywords-Avalara Error, Supplier invoice, Purchase Order, Supplier master data

Title: Duplicate Form Templates Appear in Edit Output Settings While Creating a Manual Invoice
Content: Symptom-When creating a manual invoice and selecting the "Template Name" from the drop-down, some templates appear to be duplicated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing workcenter-Go to New Manual Invoice view-Enter the Account ID-Select 'You Can Also'-Select Edit output settings-Select Customer Template dropdown-Notice the form templates are duplicated-Cause-In Form template Maintenance, there are two duplicate templates available for English language, one template is without country name and another is with country name. This is causing duplicate entries for those templates to be displayed.-Resolution-Check the Form template Maintenance-Identify the duplicate templates for English language-If only one template is desired, either delete one template from Form Template Maintenance or maintain country code where it is not maintained.-Keywords-Duplicate Templates, Output Settings, English Language, Form template Maintenance, Invoice, Drop-down Menu, SAP, Business ByDesign.

Title: How To Cancel Sales Order With a Service Line Item
Content: Symptom-You have a Sales Order with a Item Type Service- Fixed Price or Fixed Price without actuals or Time and material. You would like to know how to cancel it.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work-center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for DEF. (DEF represents the Sales Order ID)-DEF has a Item Type Service and the delivery status is finished.-Try to cancel the Sales Order and it will not be possible.-Cause-The Reason for Rejection field on the sales order line depends on the Delivery Status. See below table.-Once the Reason for Rejection is maintained, the remaining quantity will be cancelled, you are not able to create new service confirmation or invoice.-Sales Order Item Delivery Status Cancellation-Service Line  Not Started The Reason for Rejection is editable and cancellation can be done on the Sales Order screen.-Service Line  In Process The Reason for Rejection is editable and cancellation can be done on the Sales Order screen.-Service Line  Completed Depending on the Service Item Type, the Invoice, Service Confirmation or both will have to be cancelled firstly. -Resolution-In order to cancel the Sales Order line, please follow the below:-Item Type - Service: Time & Material and Service: Fixed Price-When the Status is In Process or Not Started, the Reason for Rejection will be enabled. Hence, the Sales Order line can be cancelled.-When the status is Completed, first the Invoice has to be cancelled. Then, the Service Confirmation will have to be cancelled by maintaining a Reason for Rejection. This will set back the delivery status on the sales order line back to In Process.-The Sales Order line can now be cancelled, by maintaining a Reason for Rejection.-Item Type - Service: Fixed Price without Actuals-When the Status is In Process or Not Started, the Reason for Rejection will be enabled. Hence, the Sales Order can be cancelled.-When the status is Completed, the Invoice has be cancelled firstly.-The Sales Order can now be cancelled, by maintaining a Reason for Rejection.-Note:For cancelling a Sales Order with a Material Line Item, Kindly check the KBA 1755905.-See Also-1755905 - You are not able to Cancel a Sales Order-2644606 - How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item -2632981 - How to Cancel an A2A Service Order in ByDeisgn System-1913197 - How To Cancel Sales Order Created Via Intercompany Process-2580915 - Error When Cancelling Sales Order Item - The action CANCEL is Not Possible -Keywords-"Cancel", "Service", "Sales Order", "Service Confirmation", "Time & Material", "Fixed Price", "Fixed Price without Actuals"

Title: Creation of Custom Unit of Measure in ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A custom unit of measure needs to be created in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center.-Select By Materials View.-Search for Material ABC (ABC refers to Material ID).-Choose the Edit button.-Select the Base UoM dropdown.-Expected Unit of Measure is missing.-Resolution-Follow below given steps to add custom unit of measure to ByDesign system. -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the Active Project.-Choose Open activity list button.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search for the activity "Quantities and Units of Measure" using the filter "All Activities".-Choose Open button.-Select Create and Maintain Trading Units hyperlink.-Click on Add Row.-Enter the following details:-Unit: Unit must begin with 'Z' followed by 2 characters.-UoM symbol: (E.g. H87).-Description: (E.g. Piece).-Activation status: Released.-Define Display Decimals if needed.-Select Save and close.-Keywords-Product Data Work Center; Materials View; custom unit of measure; Business Configuration work center; Implementation Projects view; Quantities and Units of Measure; Trading and Physical Units; H87;

Title: Access has been denied
Content:
Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*Internal Use Only*-User unable to login to tenant even if User is not locked and network trace throws error "Your login has been denied due to attempted access from a country or region in which SAP does not provide products and service".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Application and User Management WorkCenter-Navigate to Business User View-Select Edit-Go to Attributes-Verify if User is locked or password is locked.-You can see user is not locked and password is also not locked but still user is unable to login to tenant .-Cause-Cause is not known.-Network Trace:-Access has been denied

Your login has been denied due to attempted access from a country or region in which SAP does not provide products and services. Any attempt to circumvent this restriction may result in your account being permanently disabled. Per SAP policy and applicable law, using or accessing SAP products and services in or from these countries is strictly prohibited. For more information on SAP end use restrictions, please visit:

-Resolution-Create Case to Operations team to reset and resend initial credentials to IT contact and Initial User can reset password for User who is not able to login to tenant.-Keywords-user not able to login

Title: Inconsistency in Product Planning Details INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Finished Production Orders are still appearing in the Product Planning Details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Products view.-Select the Advanced Search.-Enter the relevant Product ID XXX. (XXX means Product ID)-Enter the relevant Supply Planning Area ID YYY. (YYY means Supply Planning Area ID)-Click Go.-Notice there are Production Orders still visible even though these orders are finished.-Cause-The issue is caused by an inconsistency in the backend that needs to be checked by the development team.-Resolution-It needs a backend correction through Laid back mode. Forward to Development team AP-SDM-MSD to perform correction and the available quantity will be updated.-Keywords-Stock Overview, Product Planning, Inconsistency, Material Code, Supply Planning, Backend Correction, Dependent Demands, Finished Production Orders.

Title: Unable to Delete Quality Standard Value in Suppliers Fine Tuning Activity
Content: Symptom-Unable to delete the Quality Standard value in the Suppliers Fine Tuning Activity because the delete button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-Select Open Activity List button-Proceed to the Fine Tune phase-Search for the Suppliers Activity-Select the Set Up Quality Standards link-Observe that the delete option for the field displayed is greyed out-Cause-The Implementation Project Status is Live, and the corresponding activity is a protected activity, which results in the Delete button being greyed out.-Resolution-Since the activity is protected, it cannot be deleted from the UI.-To resolve this, create a case with SAP Technical Support to perform the necessary backend correction to remove the value.-See Also-Keywords-Quality Standard, Delete, Greyed Out, Inactive, Fine Tuning, SAP Business ByDesign, Implementation Project, Live Status, Protected Activity, Backend Removal.

Title: Inventory Ageing Report Displays Quantity but No Value
Content: Symptom-The Inventory Ageing report is only displaying the quantity of the stock, but no value is shown.-The expectation is that the Inventory Ageing report should display both the quantity and the value of the stock.-Environment-Inventory-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Physical Inventory Work Center.-Proceed to the Reports view and select the option List.-Search for and select the Inventory Ageing report.-Input the relevant values in the available fields and execute the report.-The report displays the age of materials and the quantity in relation to the period available, but no value of the quantity is displayed.-Cause-The Inventory Ageing report shows the age of warehouse and external warehouse stock based on a First In First Out (FIFO) basis.-This report does not include the valuation of the displayed stock.-Resolution-Refer to the "Material Inventories - Balance Summary" report to view the valuation and quantity of stock.-The list of reports based on Inventory Valuation is available in the help document available via the link here.-Refer to the section against Inventory Valuation in the document.-See Also-Keywords-Inventory Aging, Report, Quantity, No Value, Material Inventories - Balance Summary, Inventory Valuation, FIFO, Warehouse Stock.

Title: On Copying Customer Contract, Aprpoval Note is Copied as Well
Content: Symptom-On copying an existing customer contract, you find the Approval Note is copied into the new contract as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center.-Go to the contracts view.-Open an contract, the approval note is filled.-Click copy button, the approval note is copied into the new contract. -Cause-When using copy function, system tries to copy as much as the data from source contract into the new contract, including approval note. -Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-Keywords-customer contract; copy; approval note; copied.

Title: Error: Instance with the same key already exists While Creating Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Communication Arrangement, the system displays the following error:-"Instance with the same key (ABC) already exists."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In Sap Business Bydesign:-Go to Application and user management work center-Navigate to Communication arrangement view-Select New-Select Communication Scenario.-In the System Instance ID field, enter ABC (ABC refers to instance ID)-Select Next-Observe the error "Instance with the same key (ABC) already exists "--In Sap Cloud for Customer:-Go to Administrator work center-Go to General Settings view-Select Communication Arrangements-Select New-Select Communication Scenario as OData Services for Business Objects-In the System Instance ID field, enter ABC (ABC refers to instance ID)-Select Next-Observe the error "Instance with the same key (ABC) already exists "-Cause-The issue is caused by a data inconsistency in the system.-Resolution-To resolve the issue:-Go to the Communication Systems view.-Select the affected Communication System.-From the Actions button, select Set to Obsolete.-Recreate a new Communication System with the required details.-Once the new Communication System has been created successfully, proceed to create the Communication Arrangement again.-Keywords-Communication Arrangement, Same Key Already Exists, Communication System, Communication Scenario

Title: Incorrect (Doubled) Planned Hours in the Resource Calendar
Content: Symptom-Resource Calendar line shows double the total of the contributing lines.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Resource Management work center.-Resource Search view.-Show Availability.-Navigate to the relevant lines. --You will see the Planned Hours are twice what is expected ie 4hrs instead of 2hrs (more obvious if changed to the 12 Weeks view as a small difference of 1 or 2 hours may be within rounding parameters).-Cause-Database Inconsistency. -Resolution-A Backend Correction is needed to correct this. Please log a case with Technical Support for this.-Please be aware that in this specific case where the entries are doubled there will generally not be any knock-on effects, and the only effect is to show double numbers in the Resource Calendar. There are though other cases where the issue appears similar but can have an affect on the Employee's Time & Labour Management. It is therefore recommended to bring this to our attention immediately on discovery.

Title: Unable to Cancel The Customer Contract
Content: Symptom-When trying to cancel the customer contract, the Cancellation relevant fields are greyed out both on header and item level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales order work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search and edit contract ABC (ABC represents contract ID).-Navigate to General tab and Renewal and cancellation sub-tab.-Under Cancellation section, all relevant fields such as Cancellation Received On, Cancellation Requested For, Cancellation Reason and Cancellation Effective On are greyed out.-Cause-The reason why cancellation relevant fields are greyed out and it is impossible to cancel contract ABC is because the fulfillment status is finished for line item.-Resolution-The fulfillment must be revoked for line item and then it will be possible to cancel the contract ABC on item level and also on header level.-Please follow the below steps to revoke the fulfillment status:-Go to Contract ABC (ABC represents contract ID).-Navigate to Items tab and choose particular line item.-Click on Revoke button and choose Fulfillment.-Now, the relevant Cancellation fields should be editable.-Keywords-Contract; Cancellation; Greyed Out; Fulfillment; Revoke; Line Item

Title: Error 500: SAP Internal Server Error When Accessing Communication Usage Monitor View
Content: Symptom-The error "500 SAP Internal Server Error" occurs when accessing the Communication Usage Monitor view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Communication Usage Monitor view-Observe the error 'Internal 500 Server Error'-Cause-The Communication Usage Monitor collects data from the Communication Arrangement, and according to the standard system design, if the data exceeds 1,000 entries, it results in a dump.-Resolution-Identify the unwanted communication arrangement.-Delete the identified unwanted communication arrangement from Application and User Management -> Communication Arrangements View.-Ensure that the total count of communication arrangements is reduced to less than 1000.-See Also-Keywords-Server Error, Communication Usage Monitor, Application and User Management, SAP Internal Server Error, Communication arrangement, 500 Server Error, NODE_ID key, Duplicate key, Data Collection, Dump.

Title: Error while deleting WSID file in Cloud Application Studio
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -The following error occurs while attempting to delete a .wsid file on Cloud Applications Studio:-Package '$YABCDEFGH_01ABCDEFGHIJKL23' cannot be deleted, it is not empty (see longtext).-Error deleting MDRS entities for /YABCDEFGH_MAIN/SRC/Path/To/file.wsid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Access the SDK.-Open the concerned solution.-Attempt to delete the .wsid file.-Error message appears.-Cause-The issue is caused by some leftover artifacts that are still present, preventing the complete deletion of the file.-Resolution-The development team needs to delete the leftover artifacts.-Once the artifacts are deleted, the file can be deleted from Cloud Applications Studio.--Please create an incident to AP-RC-BDS-WS.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, Cloud Applications Studio, file deletion, error, MDRS entities, leftover artifacts, package not empty, SDK.

Title: A Dump Occurs When Trying to Use the Query Open Errors with Tasks in the Process Communication Errors
Content: Symptom-A Dump occurs when trying to load "Open Errors with Tasks" under the Process Communication Errors view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Access the view of Process Communication Errors.-Attempt to load "Open Errors with Tasks".-Dump occurs.-Cause-The dump occurs due to the high volume of data that is present in the system.-Resolution-In order to query Open Errors with Tasks, please set the filter and then try to execute the query to limit the number of entries.-See Also-Keywords-Error, dump, query, Open Errors with Tasks, Application and User Management, Process Communication Errors, Cannot, Query, Unable.

Title: Product Category disappears on the Shopping Cart screen
Content: Symptom-You have created a shopping cart with free text items and released it . Later you can see the product category field is showing blank.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select report: Shopping Cart Tracking-Open the respective Shopping Cart-Select view all-Navigate to Items tab-At the right end , there is a product category field->It shows empty .-If you click on each line item, it will show the product category name.-Again if you close and open the document, the field will show empty.-Cause-1. The Design and fact sheet technical mapping for the overview screen is built in a way to display all the line item's product category in one Go.-2. Whereas in the View All screen, upon the default line-item selection, the very first line of product category is displayed. Subsequently upon all other item line selections, rest of the row entries are visible. -The system is picking the first selected line-item as default for Product category fetching and mapping to UI data model. -Subsequently the next line selection will trigger the backend for next selected line-item's product category fetch. -Resolution-This is expected system behavior for the View all screen.-Note:-For improving query performance, the view all screen mapping is different.-Keywords-product category missing in shopping cart

Title: How to remove Task : Assign Supplier to Purchase Request from user's Task List?
Content: Symptom-Email for Task: "Assign Supplier to Purchase Request" is going to some users.-Customer wants to remove these users from the task list.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase requests-> open tasks-You can see the task-You are also receiving emails for the same in your outlook-Cause-This Task – "Assign Supplier to Purchase Request" is generally raised by the system when it cannot automatically determine a supplier for a purchase request item.-The task is relevant to all employees to whom the Purchase Requests view is assigned.-The user receives this task in the Purchase Requests view of the Purchase Requests and Orders work center. To respond to this task, open the task and choose action: Enter a supplier.-Once done, the system completes the task and removes it from the worklist.-The attributes of this task type are fully predefined and cannot be configured.-Resolution-You can complete the task or you can remove purchase requests view from the user's profile, then the task will not go to the concerned person.-Note: You also have a task subscription option in the Home work center -> Inbox. You can check which tasks the user has subscribed to and remove the subscription if not required.-See Also-Refer help document:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2dcb73b1722d1014ad85e8f49474642b.html?version=2405-Keywords-Assign Supplier to Purchase Request, how to remove user from task list, task subscription

Title: Shipment Dates Falling on Incorrect Days in Schedule Lines
Content: Symptom-The system is not proposing expected day as a shipment day for any order and ignores it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics control work center-Go to Customer Demand view-Find required Sales Order ID-Under Schedule lines, observe that the delivery date is  and the shipment date is incorrect.-Cause-Since question "Do you want to receive availability confirmations for products at the start of the 24 hour cycle?" is scoped. The issue arises due to the configuration to receive availability confirmations for products at the start of the 24-hour cycle. The ATP check works based on this cycle. If the product is available at any time within this cycle, the ATP check returns the Confirmation Date Time, which is the Date Time of either the start of the cycle or the end of the cycle, based on the scoping. This is causing the system to propose a delivery date one day before the Released Receipt's Delivery Date and calculating dates accordingly.-Resolution-Navigate to Business Configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view-Select the First Implementation or relevant Implementation Project-Choose Edit Project Scope-Navigate to Step 4 Questions-Expand "Supply Chain Planning and Control"-Expand "Demand Management and Order Confirmation"-Select "Product Availability Check"-On the right plane under Questions for Product Availability Check, under Group: Availability Check Scope for Standard Products and Spare Parts, de-scope the question "Do you want to receive availability confirmations for products at the start of the 24 hour cycle?"-Once this is done, check the schedule lines again.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2768328-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/1950241-Keywords-SAP Business ByDeisgn, Supply Chain Management, Shipment Dates, Monday, ATP Check, 24-hour Cycle, Availability Confirmations, Schedule Lines, Delivery Date

Title: Dump error occurs when trying to hire employee.
Content: Symptom-Dump occurs, when the user tries to open Hire employee view-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center-Select Regular task view-Choose UK-Choose Hire employee-Dump Occurs : Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-Cause-User does not  have the write access for Regular tasks .- Resolution-To overcome the issue, provide write access to the user.--Steps to do the changes:-Go to Application and user management work center-Select Business user and search for the user-Choose Edit button and select Access Rights.-Go to Access Restrictions tab-Now filter Work Center View Name with Regular tasks.-Now do the change to write access from no access to unrestricted-Keywords-Hire employee, Access, Regular task

Title: Unified Reporting Israel - Incorrect files which doesn't have any data for B100 records and VAT Registration number in the summary form
Content: Symptom-While trying to create the Unified Reporting for the fiscal year YYYY, files were created without any errors.-Upon uploading the files to the Tax Authorities simulator, no B100 Records (BOOKKEEPING TRANSACTIONS) and the VAT Registration number were generated.-('YYYY' refers to the year)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Unified Reporting - Israel.-Search for the Run 'YY' ('YY' refers to Unified Reporting Run ID).-Highlight it and view Report Run results.-Select attachments and download the Unified Reporting Summary form.-There won't be any data in the VAT Registration Number and for B100 records (BOOKKEEPING TRANSACTIONS).-Cause-While creating a run to extract the unified report of the company 'ABC' for a particular accounting period 'YYYY', that company should not have its status as 'Blocked' in Business Partner Data. Because of this, B100 records and VAT Registration numbers are missing in the file.-'ABC' refers to the Company ID.-Resolution-  The Company 'ABC' under the relevant Business Partner status needs to be changed from 'Blocked' to 'Active.'-After making the necessary changes, a new run must be created.-In the Unified Reporting Summary form, the VAT Registration Number and B100 Records (Bookkeeping Transactions) will be visible.-See Also-Unified Reporting - Israel-KBA - " 2884775 - Unified Report Run - Israel: Enter a valid File Save Path; Hover over the field to see more info "-Keywords-Unified Reporting, Israel, Business Partner Data, Summary form, Bookkeeping Transactions, VAT Registration number.

Title: Outbound File Error: 'File Format XYZ is not consistent'
Content: Symptom-Payment outbound file created based on custom Payment File Structure XYZ has status Error in File Creation. While checking the application log, error is displayed:-'File format XYZ is not consistent'-  XYZ means the Payment File Structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management view.-Go to the Outbound Files subview.-Show All Files and find the respective Outgoing File.-Choose the File and Go to Attachment.-Choose Display Log.-Error is displayed:-'File format XYZ is not consistent'-Cause-The sum of the length of all fields in a custom payment file structure must not exceed 1500 characters.-In this case, the sum is exceeding this limit, hence the system is not able to create a payment file.-This can be checked as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Go to either Outgoing Wire Transfers (Real Time Bank Transfers) or Outgoing Bank Transfers activity.-Click Edit payment file structures.-Select File Structure ID XYZ and click Edit.-Click Next button twice until step 3 Define Fields is reached.-Under Fields, check for each field what is the Field Length defined under Field Content Definition tab -> Data Positioning section-The sum of all field length must not exceed 1500 characters. -  Resolution-Restrict the total field length to a maximum of 1500 characters. After that, the payment file based on custom format XYZ should be successfully created.-Keywords-Payment Structure, Payment File, Outbound File, Outgoing Bank Transfer, File Format is Not Consistent, field length, 1500

Title: Multiple user sessions are generated when viewing attachments.
Content: Symptom-When accessing a  PDF attachment from a business document, it will open in a new browser tab and start a new session. This session will not end even if the tab is closed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Below is one of the example:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center -Select Invoices and Credit Memos view -Search for supplier invoice 1234-Open supplier invoice and navigate to Attachments tab-As key user, check number of sessions-Select the pdf attachment, it opens in a separate browser tab-As key user, check number of sessions. The count has increased by 1 since step 6.-Close the browser tab that is displaying the pdf attachment.-As key user, check number of sessions. The count has not decreased, it is the same as step 7.-NOTE: there is no way to close that tab except to use the browser's tab close feature.-Resolution-The Purchase order, Sales order, Customer Invoicing and it all behaves same as supplier invoice.  This is a Known issue and will be checked in one of the future releases.-Keywords-User Session, Attachments, Pdf

Title: Unable to access the activity "Chart of Account, Financial Reporting Structure and Account Determination", due to the project is in draft state
Content: Symptom-Unable to access activity "Chart of Account, Financial Reporting Structure and Account Determination".-Because the relevant Activity list gives the below mentioned warning message.-Warning: Project in the draft state.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Project view-Select Open Activity List button for any project-Unable to access the activity "Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination".-The relevant project having this activity list is in draft state.-Cause-  Editing the project scope must be in completed status to update the activity list. After this only any activities under the list will be accessible without any warning messages.-Ideally the active project remains in a draft state, because any user has been worked in that relevant project and didn't complete or closed that project leaving it in draft state. -Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select Edit Scope button.-The message "Finish editing the project scope; activity list is not up to date" will appear on this screen. -Now move to the step 5 which is Review.-Select Finish.-Now try to refresh icon in the top right corner of Implementation Projects and there won't be any warning messages.-After this, the activity "Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination" to make changes.-Keywords-Chart of Account, Financial Reporting Structure and Account Determination, Draft state, Project Scope, Business configuration.

Title: Dashboard does not appear for users
Content: Symptom-You want to show the standard dashboard, e.g. "Service Overview" via the work center Analysis to a specific user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Analytics work center.-2. Search for Service overview.-3. You cannot see it.-Cause-This is expected behavior.-A user will be able to see a dashboard in Analytics -> Dashboards if they have authorizations for at least one of the reports in that dashboard. Example: User XYZ has access to only 3 reports, none of which are in any of the dashboards, hence he cannot see the dashboard.-Ideally, a user should have access to all the reports of a dashboard to be able to use the dashboard properly. - Resolution-To correct this, the system admin has to assign all the related dashboard reports to at least one of the Work Center Views of this user.-Steps:-Go to Business analytics work center.-Go to Design report.-Search for the report name or id.-Select the row containing the report name.-Click in Assign button.-Set at least one assignment equals to user's assignment.-Keywords-Dashboard; not visible; visible; report; user;

Title: Missing Account Notes in report
Content: Symptom-You notice Account Notes only shows the last Account Note even when there are more than one note. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data source view.-Search for "Opportunity Notes"(C4C) or " All Activities with Predecessor Opportunities"(ByD).-Add notes to view.-You will view only the last account note.-Cause-This is the expected behavior of the system.-Resolution-As per the current design of the data source , we only see one latest note displayed. -Currently we do not have any other data source that shows all the notes in the account.-It would be a new requirement. You can raise a request in the customer influence site:-SAP Customer Influence-< https://influence.sap.com/ >- Keywords-Account Notes; Account note;

Title: Organizational Unit Not Displayed in Employee Times Report
Content: Symptom-Employees are organized into teams according to the organizational structure and assigning them to organizational units works as intended. However, the 'Employee Times' report does not reflect the 'Organizational Unit.' Although the data source includes both the cost center and reporting line unit, these may not correspond to the organizational unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics workcenter-Go to Data Sources view-Search for Employee Times -Select Add Row Field and notice that the 'Organizational Unit' field is not available for selection.-Cause-As per the technical limitation, it is not possible to add the "Organizational Unit" field in the standard "Employee Times" Data Source. -Resolution-The Standard Data Sources offers some standard fields to be used for reporting. Such fields (characteristics and key figures) are extended and visible in the Data Sources embedded in the system. However, not all fields available in the UI are published to Data Sources due to technical designing.-Our recommendation is post this as an enhancement idea over our Influence platform.-You can access the Influence forum in the link below: Influence Portal-Keywords-Standard Data Sources, Employee Times, Organizational Unit, Business Analytics, Reports,

Title: Document Preview Shows a Different Form Template Than the Document Output History
Content: Symptom-The template displayed in the document's output history does not match the template despite a rule being configured in Form Template Selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-For example, below is an example of Customer Invoicing Document:-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Invoicing Document view-Select Document ID-Select View All-Navigate to the Output History tab-Select the Document Name -Notice that the template is not as expected.-Cause-The form template is manually changed in the Edit Output Settings of a document.-There are two ways of maintaining form template rules: -a) Form Template Selection-b) Account Level-The form template selection rules can be overridden by manually changing the form template in the document's Edit Output Settings.-The template configured at the Account Level will take precedence over the form template selection rules.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Wrong Template, Form Templates, Form Template Rules, Template Selection, Edit Output Settings

Title: No Customer Invoice Request Created After Outbound Delivery Released for Service Order
Content: Symptom-You find that Customer Invoice Request is not created after Outbound Delivery released for the service order.-Environment-SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Requests view.-Open Advance search and search Service Order ABC (where ABC stands for the service order ID)-There is no outbound delivery invoice request.-Open the Service Order ABC in Document Flow tab, the Outbound Delivery EFG (where EFG stands for Outbound Delivery ID) is released. Status: In Process; Service Status: Released; Delivery Status: In Process; Invoice Status: Not Relevant-Cause-In the Service Order ABC, the Item Type is Spare part - advanced ship or sales (SHIP).-If you check Service Confirmation XYZ (where XYZ stands for service confirmation), it is marked as non billable. No invoice is created if the Non- Billable checkbox is not active in the Service Order but the Non- Billable checkbox is active in the Service Confirmation.-This scenario is possible for product type SHIP, DIGI and SECO. However, for Service – fixed price items this is not allowed.-Resolution-The Service Order item will be completed if the Service Confirmation is released with order completion.-Invoice and Delivery status in the service order will be Finished.-See Also-Help Document: Services-Keywords-Service Order, Service Confirmation, Outbound Delivery, Invoice Request, Non-Billable, SHIP,DIGI, SECO

Title: FAQs Related to Code Correction Feature That is Lost After Merging the Change Project
Content: Symptom-This knowledge base article lists the frequently asked questions related to Code Correction feature that is lost after merging the change project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Resolution-1. What is Code Correction Feature and What are the pre-requisites?-This feature is created by SAP to facilitate any urgent changes which must be implemented during an upgrade window: that is when test and production tenants are on different release.-Code Correction Feature is only allowed on either Productive or Pre-Productive tenants where corrections are critical for business continuity.-For Production Bug Fix to be enabled Tenant Role Code must be Pre-Production.-System purpose defines, how you want to use the tenant as, Standalone test tenant (Pre-Production) or Remote test tenant (Remote change projects). For eg: If the change project is a remote change project, then the system purpose will be test (not pre-production). Hence, Code Correction Feature will be available only in Pre-Production tenants.-For more information you can refer to the below blogs:-https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-blogs-by-sap/working-with-partner-solutions-during-upgrade/ba-p/13290605-https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-blogs-by-sap/production-bug-feature-for-deployed-solutions-in-production-tenant-and-the/ba-p/13306021-2. What caused the Code Correction Feature to be lost?  -When the First Implementation is in Started Status (which means in Pre-Production state (3/20), the feature is enabled for Code Fix. When the First Implementation Project is closed, the purpose of the system changes which causes the Code Correction feature to be lost. -Note: 3 refers to the System Purpose i.e. Pre-Production and 20 refers to the Project Status i.e. Started. -3. How to get the Code Correction Feature back?  -In order to have the Code Correction Feature, the respective tenant should be in First Implementation project with Started status. -Note: It is always advisable to have the code correction feature in Development environment rather than Test, then deploy it to the upper tenants.-4. Can the Test tenant be used as both Remote Change Project and for Code Correction?   -Test tenant cannot be used for both Remote Change Projects and Code Correction Feature as the system purposes are different.  -Please note, when the purpose of the system is not followed as per the SAP process, then it will lead to data inconsistencies in the system. -5. What are the pre-requisites of copying a change project which has custom Solution (PDI Solution)?  -Whenever you are doing a Solution Profile Copy, then the SDK solution and version should be the same. -Active project in the target tenant should be closed i.e., there should be no open projects in order to accept the Solution Profile Copy from the source tenant. -6. What is a Standalone System and how to enable Scoping and Fine-Tuning activities?  -Standalone tenant has the same functionality as of Production tenant, but it cannot go Live. Eg: Perform scoping/fine tuning activities, test the same and if it meets the business requirement, then make the same changes to production manually.  -7. What happens after the change project copied from Production to Test system is merged? -When the change project is Merged and Activated in the target tenant, the connection between the source and the target tenant is disconnected. The final step is to close the project in each tenant manually. -8. What is Partial Assembly/Partial Deployment?  -Partial assembly is introduced with release 1908, which would allow a user to assemble only changed/added files in a one-off patch solution. This will ensure that the time taken for the solution Lifecycle management processes such as Assembly, Deployment, etc. is reduced since the content files assembled and deployed would be reduced. Such a feature would be highly beneficial if some minor changes are done in the corresponding patch version since that would result in a smaller number of files to be assembled. -For References: -Patches | SAP Help Portal -Assemble and Download – New and Changed Items -9. What is Local and Remote Change Project and some of the frequently asked questions related to Change Projects?  -Refer to the KBA: 2584005-10. What would be the impact if the Change Project that has been merged is not closed?  -There would be no impact since the connection between the source and target system would be disconnected. In order to synchronize the status, it is recommended to close the change project after it has been merged. -11. Can the system be changed to pre-production status to get the code correction feature back, while there is an active change project? What are the consequences of doing so?-No, the tenant cannot be changed to pre-production if a remote change project, which has been moved to another test tenant, is still in "Started" status. Attempting to change the system to pre-production under these conditions would cause the remote change project connection to break, leading to configuration issues and improper functioning of BC configuration.-To set the tenant to pre-production, the remote connection reference must first be removed. After doing so, the tenant can be updated to pre-production. However, note that once the connection is removed, each tenant will function as a standalone pre-production system, which is not a recommended solution.-Keywords-Change Project, Remote Change Project, Local Change Project, Standalone Tenant, Code Correction Feature, Pre-Production, First Implementation Project, Business Configuration

Title: Error: Change or Delete Duplicate Rows With Key 'ABC' in 'Employee Time Recording Profile'
Content: Symptom-Unable to create a Time Recording Profile under Time Types in Business Configuration due to the below error:-Change or Delete Duplicate Rows With Key 'ABC' in 'Employee Time Recording Profile'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Overview view-Search for Time Types - Country-Go to Maintain Time Recording Profile-Enter 'ABC' as the Profile Code-Select Save-Notice the error: Change or delete duplicate rows with key 'ABC' in 'Employee Time Recording'-Cause-The Profile Code 'ABC' is already in use by the different Time Type-Country.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. Our recommendation is to use the different Profile Code.-Keywords-Time Recording Profile, Time Type, Profile Code, Delete Duplicate Rows

Title: Journal Entry Voucher's Item's Custom-Specific Text Field visibility issue
Content: Symptom-In the Journal Entry Voucher screen, under the "Item Details - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher" section, the "Custom-Specific Text" field is available for the line item.-When selecting a Cost Center/Profit Center value for the line item, the system hides the "Custom-Specific Text" field.-While trying to make the "Custom-Specific Text" field always visible using Extensibility Explorer in SAP Cloud Application Studio's UI Designer were unsuccessful, as the visibility option is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center-Go to the Journal Entry Vouchers sub view.-Give New Journal Entry Voucher.-Try to give all the mandatory fields and under "Item Details - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher" section of line item "Custom-Specific Text" field is available.-When selecting Cost Center/Profit Center value for the line item, the system makes "Custom-Specific Text" field hidden. -It is required to make the Custom-Specific Text field always visible.-Cause-For the respective Account Assignment type, the CC-Cost center and PRFT- Profit Center, also the account assignment CUSTOM_TEXT1 - Customer-specific Text is not maintained as mandatory.-Need to maintain the account assignment CUSTOM_TEXT1 - Customer-specific Text as 1-mandatory.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Account Assignment Types fine-tune activity. -Search for Maintain Account Assignment Types and click that.-For Account Assignment Type: CC -Cost Center, the Available Account Assignments: CUSTOM_TEXT1 - Customer-specific Text should be maintained as 1 - Mandatory in the Data Input Control field.-Give save and close.-For Account Assignment Type: PRFT -Profit Center, the Available Account Assignments: CUSTOM_TEXT1 - Customer-specific Text should be maintained as 1 - Mandatory in the Data Input Control field.-Again, give save and close.-Now the field will be available in the screen for Cost Center, Profit Center Account Assignment Types. -Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, Custom-Specific Text field, Profit Center, Cost Center, Business configuration.

Title: Button "Reverse Confirmation" is Grey in Display/Reverse Good and Activity Confirmations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse the Goods and Activity confirmation (GAC) having some Stock which has been allocated to a Project. However, in the Internal Logistics work center => Common Tasks => Display/Reverse Goods and Activity Confirmations screen, the Reverse Confirmation button is inactive, hence Confirmation cannot be reversed/cancelled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Internal Logistics work center. -Go to the Common Tasks and select Display/Reverse Goods and Activity Confirmations. -Find and select the relevant Confirmation ID.-You can see the "Reverse Confirmation" button is grey.-Go to the document Flow tab.-Here the Goods and Activity Confirmation has been created against a Project Stock Order.-The Status of the Project Stock Order is completed, however no consumption has been made.-Cause-The Allocation and Consumption GACs cannot be reversed/cancelled.  Stock must be returned from the Project back to the normal Stock.-    Resolution-Since it is not allowed to cancel the Goods and Activity Confirmation, return the allocated Stock either through Goods Movement or Consumption for Project. - To return via Goods Movement:-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks and select Goods Movement.-Enter all the required details and complete the guided activity.-Once the Goods Movement is completed, the Allocated Stock is removed from the Project and the Stock is available for other process.-   To return via Consumption for Project:-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks and select Consumption for Project.-In the open guided activity, select the Posting Type: Goods Return.-Enter all the required details and complete the guided activity.-Once the Goods Movement is complete, the Allocated Stock is removed from the Project and the Stock can be used for other process.-For further reference, we recommend the Blogpost: Product returns from projects to inventory.- See Also-For more project return use cases, refer Blog: Product returns from projects to inventory | SAP Blogs-  Keywords-Consumption, cancel consumption, project stock order, stock stuck

Title: How to Consume C4C / ByD Data Sources in SAC Using OData
Content: Symptom-When setting up a new connection in SAC to import the data sources from C4C system and you are seeing the error message below.-"Unable to Connect to data source. Check the connection details and user credentials, and then try again".-Environment-SAP Analytics Cloud-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Enable the OData API for Data Sources.-Create a communication arrangement and generate the technical user.-Expose your data sources.-Generate OData URL.-Detailed steps are explained in the SAP Help Center document below.-Extract Data from Data Sources Using OData | SAP Help Portal-For more information on how to create a communication arrangement check the below help document.-Create a Communication Arrangement | SAP Help Portal-At SAC side:-Create a New Connection.-Enter the Data Service URL and the technical User Credentials.-Cause-The Data Service URL is entered in the wrong format when the new connection is created in SAC.-Resolution-To create a connection successfully between C4C and SAC to consume a data source using OData follow the steps given below.-Login to the C4C system.-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Data Sources.-Search for the data source -> Build OData Queries.-Generate the Meta data Query. It will look like this <system URL>/sap/c4c/odata/analytics/ds/<madav_ID>.svc/$metadata.-The above query will run in the browser with technical user ID and credentials.-Now remove the "$metadata" in the end. The URL will look like this <system URL>/sap/c4c/odata/analytics/ds/<madav_ID>.svc.-In SAC, in the New Connection Dialog Box enter the Data Service URL in the above format.-Enter the Technical User ID and Credentials.-You can use either "ODATA services" or "Cloud for Customer Analytics" as connection type in SAC.-Once the connection is successfully created you can create a model out of it and build your query using the fields in selection and filters.-Note : You need to have a dedicated connection in SAC for every data source in C4C.-For Example if you want to consume X number of data sources, you will have new connections created at SAC side using X unique Data Service URLs for the respective Data sources from C4C.--See Also-For the integration with ByDesign, you can also check the following URL:-Integrating with SAP Business ByDesign--For Usage of OData and how query can be created, please refer to below blog:-OData for SAP Business ByDesign Analytics-Keywords-SAC, SAP Analytics Cloud, Data Sources, OData, Unable to connect, new connection, import data sources, URL, connection type, Error Message

Title: Offset G/L Account Is Incorrectly Displayed In G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-A particular G/L Account XXX (XXX is the G/L Account ID) shows a journal entry transaction. When viewing this transaction, and selecting the line in which this G/L account is debited or credited, it's observed that the G/L Account(Origin) is also XXX.-When executing the G/L Accounts - Line items report for XXX, it's observed that for the same journal entry the Offset G/L Account is not XXX but YYY instead (YYY is the Offset G/L Account displayed in the report).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Select the report G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Enter the required fields and the G/L Account XXX.-Offset G/L Account displayed is YYY but if the respective journal entry is opened, system shows XXX.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Journal Entries view.-Find the concerned Journal Entry.-Observe by selecting the G/L Account XXX in this journal entry that the G/L Account(Origin) maintained is XXX, so not the same as in report (YYY).-Cause-The Offset G/L Account is always calculated for the entire document and sub-transactions in document. If there are journal entry items with highest Debit/Credit amounts, then that will be determined as the offsetting account. This occurs mostly in more complex postings (for example, GR/IR, Revenue Recognition, journal entries resulting from automated runs, Manual Journal Entry Vouchers, etc.) with multiple line items in debit/credit in the journal entry.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Offset account, Incorrect G/L account, Offset G/L Account

Title: Error Message: 'Error for Account 123 in Chart of Accounts XYZ and acct det. profile PQR' while Changing the G/L Account Type
Content: Symptom-Unable to change the G/L Account Type due to below error message.-Error for Account 123 in Chart of Accounts XYZ and acct det. profile PQR:-Account type DEF of acct 123 does not match usage in account determination.-Save failed-(Here 123 refers G/L account)-(XYZ refers Charts Accounts id)-(DEF refers to G/L Account Type)-(PQR refers Account Determination Profile)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview.-Search for the Fine tune activity - Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on Change Immediately. -Go to the Edit Chart of Accounts view. -Select the Chart of Accounts view and try to change the G/L Account Type DEF. -Click Save. -Error Message shown:-Error for Account 123 in Chart of Accounts XYZ and acct det. profile PQR:-Account type DEF of acct 123 does not match usage in account determination.-Save failed-Cause-The error is due to G/L account is assigned under the Account determination. You cannot change the G/L account Type if the G/L account is still assigned under Chart of Accounts > Account determination.-First, check in which account determination the G/L account is being used.-Steps to follow:-Go to General Ledger work center-Go to General Ledger Accounts view.-Find the respective G/L Account and click Edit > Chart of Accounts-Select the respective G/L Account and click Where-Used List button-Expand Account Determination and take note of the path.-Resolution--Remove the account from the account determination by following below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration.-Click on Overview.-Search for the Fine tune activity - Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on Change Immediately tab.-Open the respective subledger under Account Determination section (e.g. Fixed Assets).-Navigate to the respective tab (e.g. Historical Cost) and delete the assignment of the G/L Account with the Account Determination Group.-  Once you save the changes you should be able to change the G/L account type.-See Also-Help Center Document General Ledger Accounts Quick Guide ->Display and Edit Chart of Accounts->Account Type.- 2433095 - Acct XYZ in CoA ABC Cannot be Deleted/Changed; Transaction Data Exists-Keywords-G/L account type,  error for Account  in Chart of Accounts, account determination, Change of G/L account type

Title: Deactivation of Approval Process For Expense Report Does Not Work If the Standard Approval Process is Changed.
Content: Symptom-Expense report goes to approval after deselected the Check box for Audit and Approval in Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management Activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the relevant Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune Activities.-Show All Activities and Find Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management Activity.-Choose Open.-Go to Edit Audit and Approval Scenarios.-Deselect the check boxes Audit Required and Approval Required for each Country Version for which you don’t want that Expense Reports will be Audited or Approved.-Submit the Expense report and you see it went to Approval.-Cause-First, check the Approval Process under Application and User Management Work center.It should be standard Approval Process.-If the Standard Approval Process is modified,then the deactivation of Approval Process does not work for Expense Reports.-Resolution-The Standard Approval Process must be as follows:-Work Distribution: Approver of Highest Cost-Conditions:-Group 1: Expense Report Approval Configuration should be equal to Yes.-Once the Standard Approval Process is maintained and the Configuration related to Deactivating the Approval Process for an Expense Report is set,then the Expense Report skips the Audit and Approval Process.-See Also- 2354912 - How to Deactivate Approval Process for an Expense Report-Keywords-Deactivation of Approval Process, Standard Approval Process, Edi Audit and Approval

Title: Error Element ABC in namespace 'http://123abc-one-off.sap.com/12345678_' is not unique in WSDL document.' When trying to deploy a solution into a production Environment
Content: Symptom-When you activate your solution after deployment to your production environment you get the following error message.  -Failed to activate items of type B2BWebServiceIntegration-Recheck WSDL and upload it again.-Message 'Element ABC' in namespace 'http://123abc-one-off.sap.com/12345678_' is not unique in WSDL document.' -Error Creating MDRS entities for/Y123456_MAIN/SRC/BO_ABCD/NameOFWebService/abcdedf-Recheck WSDL and upload it again.---Environment-Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud For Customer -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Deploy your Add on to your Production Tenant in Cloud Studio -Activate solution. -Activation fails due to errors as detailed above. -Cause-Non unique elements in the WSDL file. -The reason this issue happens in the production tenant is because the WSDL from the source tenant contains elements for both the original and patch namespaces, where as the production tenant will only contain the original namespace. -    Resolution-Our suggestion is to always download the WSDL from the production tenant and use it in the source tenant and upload to WSID (Web Service Definition)-Then, assemble and download the solution in source and import deploy to the production environment. -Keywords- Activation, Failed, Items of type B2BWebServiceIntegration- Recheck WSDL- not unique in WSDL document.-Web Service definition -WSID

Title: Documentation on Mapping Between Spain Tax Events / Tax Codes and different Spain Tax Declaration Returns
Content: Symptom-For Spain, the mapping between the tax codes / tax events and SII codes, and the mapping of the tax codes / tax events for the various Spain tax returns, is unclear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Please find attached a comprehensive spreadsheet listing the mapping between the various tax codes / tax events to the different tax returns for Spain, including the SII tax returns. The document also provides details on the important configurations and navigation paths for the Business Configuration fine-tuning activities concerning tax events, tax codes, assignment of tax events to the tax returns, tax deductibility, and tax exemption reason.-Keywords-Tax code, tax event, tax rate, deductibility, mapping, Spain SII tax return, Spain Modelo 303 tax return, Spain Modelo 340 tax return, Spain Modelo 349 tax return

Title: Customer Return Remains In Process
Content: Symptom-You have fully invoiced a Customer Return document, and you notice that the document remains In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Return).-Click Edit.-Status: In Process.-Cause-The issue happened because the warehouse tasks were finished after the Credit Memo was sent to the customer.-When the warehouse tasks are completed, the Inbound Delivery is updated, which also updates the fulfilled quantity on the Customer Return.-As a result, the invoice status is changed back to In Process, allowing for additional invoicing if needed.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-To complete the Customer Return, please release the Return with Credit Memo, the Invoice Request for the Return will change its status for "To Be Invoiced" and you can manually change the amount being invoiced, such as 0 dollars.-Once the Credit Memo is released, the Customer Return will be Completed.-In case you have approval scenario, please approve the Customer Return once the document is released.-Keywords-Customer Return, In Process, Warehouse, Tasks, Invoice, Not Started, Approval

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** --Text Items not included in preview of Production Order: -Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to production control work center.-Go to Production orders view.-Search Production Order ID.-Edit and choose preview.-Here in form -> text items and description is missing.-Cause-The mentioned production order has REM 10010370-33 Version 3, which does not include any Text Items in the BOM. Title: How to complete approval tasks for Purchase Order and Supplier Invoice from Backend?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Approval tasks still open in Application and User management, while the Supplier Invoice / Purchase Order is completely approved -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-To check the status of Purchase Order:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for the Purchase Order ID ABC -Status is no In Approval-To check the status of Supplier Invoice:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for the Supplier Invoice ID XYZ-Status is not In Approval -To see the open approval task:-Go to Application and User Management work center -Go to Business Task Management view-Search for Purchase Order ID / Supplier Invoice ID -Open approval task in status In Approval is present -Cause-Database inconsistency -Resolution-Tasks needs to be completed in backend, follow below steps:-Open backend.-Open Transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL.-Enter the BO Name - : ( For Purchase Order - /SRMAP/LPURX_PO ) , (For Supplier Invoice - /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV ). -Enter the BO Node ID (In SESFTS -> enter the respective BO Name ( /SRMAP/LPURX_PO or /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV ) and click on enter -> Load by query -> ROOT-QUERY_BY_ELEMETS -> Enter the Purchase Order ID ABC / Supplier Invoice ID XYZ next to the field ID/content and enter -> BO Node ID is fetched).-Click on Execute (or F8).-Search for the task to be completed and select the line.-Click on the Flag button.-Complete the task.-The same procedure can also be used to complete the open task for Goods and Service Receipts document from backend , which is already Completed/ Cancelled but still having an open task. -BO Name for GSR which can be used in backend is : -/SRMAP/LPURX_GSA-See Also-1994439 - While Approving Purchase Order You Receive An Error Message Action Not Enabled-3333529 - Approver unable to approve or reject due to Error:' Action not enabled' -Keywords-Complete the approval task from backend, purchase order task, supplier invoice task, approval task, complete the GSR task, goods and service receipt task, open task

Title: Cancel Purchase Order button is disabled on Purchase Order Screen
Content: Symptom-You have cancelled the follow-up  documents but still you are unable to cancel the order.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders wc-Select view Purchase Orders-Select the respective order-Cancel Purchase Order is not enabled-Cause-The purchase order has follow up documents created which were cancelled but the cancellation documents are not yet posted to General Ledger i.e. journal entry (JE) is not created yet. Hence the cancellation posting is not complete and system is not able to understand that the follow up documents are cancelled.-Hence the purchase order status is still not in sent status and shows "follow up document created" status where you cannot cancel the order.-Resolution-Kindly check if there are any inconsistencies in the cancellation documents, and if so, please correct the errors and post the cancellation documents in General Ledger so that journal entry (JE) gets created.-Then the purchase order will be back to sent status and will be open for cancellation.-Keywords-purchase order cancellation, follow up documents not cancelled, cancel purchase order is disabled

Title: Duplicate entries in Remeasured Balances.
Content: Symptom-A Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run 'ABC' was executed.-While reviewing the Postings and Results, duplicate entries of the G/L account were noticed under Remeasured Balances, with the same Entry/Balance appearing twice. This causing the Remeasurement Posting to be made twice as well.-'ABC' refers to Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Foreign currency Remeasurement run sub view.-Search for the Rub 'ABC'.-Navigate to the Remeasured balances tab.-In the Remeasured Balances tab, the G/L account shows duplicate entries, with the same Entry/Balance appearing twice. -Cause-The company 'DEF' has 2 sets of books, 'PQR' and 'TUV', where both assigned to the same Chart of Accounts 'XYZ'.-When both sets of books are selected in the Data Selection of the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, two entries are generated for each G/L account because both sets of books use the same Chart of Accounts.-DEF refers to Company ID.-PQR refers to Set of Books 1-TUV refers to Set of Books 2-XYZ refers to Chart of Accounts.-Resolution-To avoid these Duplicate entries in the Remeasured Balances, try to select only one Set of Books under the Data Selection of Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run.-After this selection complete the run and check under Remeasured balances tab, there won't be any Duplicate entries of the G/L Accounts.-Keywords-Duplicate Entries, Remeasured Balances, Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, G/L Accounts, Chart of Accounts.

Title: Error - 'Account determination is missing for item type Cost of Sales' occurs while posting Goods and Activity Confirmation
Content: Symptom-The Goods and Activity Confirmation 'ABC' is not getting posted due to an error message "Account determination missing for item type cost of sales."-'ABC' refers to Goods and Activity Confirmation ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Source documents sub view.-Filter it with Unposted Source documents.-Search for the documents Goods and activity confirmation 'ABC'.-Highlight it and the error message is visible.-Error: Account determination is missing for item type Cost of Sales. Specify account determination in chart of accounts 'DEF' and account determination profile. Column Path Sales->Cost of Sales->Cost of Sales, Item Type Cost of Sales. -'DEF' refers to Chart of Accounts ID.-Cause-Cost of Sales account assignment is required for the Goods and Activity Confirmation. -It is not maintained so that Account determination missing error occurs. Also, under the Cost of Sales tab, for Finished goods the cost of sales should be maintained as COGS Material Consumed, and the same will be taken into the Goods and Activity Transaction for the postings.-Resolution-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Go to the Overview sub view.-Select and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination, select the Subledger Sales.-Highlight the Chart of accounts 'DEF' and go to the tab Cost of sales.-Try to maintain the required account determination based on the Goods and activity confirmation either it is Materials or services.-For Finished goods, if the Cost of Sales has been maintained as COGS Material Consumed, then try to maintain the account determination for Materials.-Now, go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Source documents sub view.-Filter it with Unposted Source documents.-Search for the documents Goods and activity confirmation 'ABC'.-Select Actions-->Post Business Transaction.-It will get posted without any error message.-See Also-KBA - "2664718 - Cost of Sales Tab is Missing in Account Determination"-Keywords-Goods and Activity Confirmation, Account Determination, Cost of Sales, Business Configuration, Unposted Source documents.

Title: How to restrict users from Accessing Supplier Invoices that belong to a Different Company?
Content: Symptom-You have set restricted access in Edit-> Access Rights view for a certain user but the user is still able to access supplier invoice which belongs to a different company.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User management work center-Select Business Users view-Edit Access Rights for user A (A refers to a user)-Navigate to Access Restrictions view and restrict only to the specific company Q to which the user A belongs to.-Now login as the user A-Select Supplier Invoicing work center->Invoices and Credit memos view-User A is still able to access invoices belonging to different company say R-Cause-Restriction rules are not created in this system.-Resolution-To restrict users from creating supplier invoices which do not belong to their company, you have to create Restriction rules.-Steps:-Go to application and user management work center-Select view Business role-Edit/create a business role.-Assign Invoices and Credit Memos view in work center and view assignments tab.-Click on access restrictions tab and select view Invoices and Credit Memos and assign restricted read and No access to write.-Scroll down and select rule "Restrict to Employee's Company".-Assign business role to required users and confirm.-Now the users who are assigned to this business role can only access the invoices belonging to their company.-If the above does not work as expected kindly perform the below actions as well:-Afterwards Perform Update Access Rights of the business user ID and then verify that the SRM_INVOICESCANNING restriction settings of role and user match.-In case the issue remains, perform Actions > Check Access Rights Consistency for the user for any related inconsistencies. The effective access rights consist of the sum of the different access restrictions. If permission is granted in any view of an activity group, it will overrule restrictions of other views in the same activity group.-Keywords-access restrictions, supplier invoice access based on company, business role, Restrict to Employee's Company

Title: Change the Getting Started tile Image in Home Launchpad
