Title: Error - 'Service call failed; report an incident' occurs while migrating the material Valuation data
Content: Symptom-While trying to migrate the materials, however in the simulate step system gives the below mentioned error message.-Errors detected during data import-Data Import (1 Errors Found, 0 Warnings Found)-Error detected in source record with key value 'ABC' ('ABC' refers to the Material ID)-Go to Correction-Edit Source Record-Service call failed; report an incident-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the overview-Search for activity: Migration of Material Valuation Data.-Select Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant Migration Unit.-Give Execute Migration - Execute Migration Step by Step and in the simulation the log shows the error message as mentioned below,-Errors detected during data import-Data Import (1 Errors Found, 0 Warnings Found)-Error detected in source record with key value 'ABC'-Go to Correction-Edit Source Record-Service call failed; report an incident-Cause-If the material 'ABC' cost in the Inventory valuation view is maintained with long value such as in trillions, it will give the error mentioning that particular material 'ABC'.-Basically, there is a limitation for the length of the cost and the data type must be a packed decimal number, it only accepts 22 digits including the decimal indicator and +/- sign. If it exceeds more than 22 digits, that is the reason for this error message while migrating the materials,-Resolution-If this error message occurs, a case must be created to SAP Technical Support with an updated authorization to proceed with the correction. It requires the engagement of Development Support to make the required backend correction.-There won't be any workaround possible in UI system to change the values of the materials, -The error related to the digits limitation in the backend will be reviewed, and the exception raised in debug mode, which has the context menu "Compose Paragraph," will be skipped.-Once the correction is completed, the materials data can be migrated.-Keywords-Migration of Material, Valuation, migration, Error detected in source record with key value, Service call failed

Title: When Confirm Post Goods Issue, On-hand Stock is sufficient for an Identified Stock but Available Stock is Zero.
Content: Symptom-When confirm post goods issue against a delivery proposal, for a specific identified stock, on-hand stock is sufficient but available stock is zero, hence you cannot select it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to worker center Outbound Logistics.-2. Access view Delivery Proposals.-3. Select a delivery proposal, click Post Goods Issue.-4. In the screen "Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue", under tab Line Items, for product A, click the value help button on field "Identified Stock ID".-5. In the pop-up window, select "All Results" in filter "Result Type", click Go.-6. In the result, identified stock XXX has positive on-hand stock, but available stock is zero.-7. Check in common task Stock Overview, for product A with identified stock XXX in corresponding site, there is positive on-hand stock.-Cause-Identified Stock XXX is either blocked or expired. You can check its master data by directly clicking it.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-See Also-1492809 - Not Enough Quantity is Available in the Logistic Area Error Message Appears while confirming the Pick Tasks-Keywords-Available Stock, On-hand Stock, Identified Stock, Stock Overview, Post Goods Issue

Title: Stock Transfer Proposal are Created Without Document ID
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -In Product Planning screen you will notice that stock transfer proposals are created without document ID. Moreover you are unable to delete these proposals.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products view.-Find Product ID ABC(where ABC is the product ID) and Planning Area ID 123(where 123 is the Supply Planning Area ID)-Choose Open.-Then you will notice Stock Transfer Proposals in Requested status without any document ID.-Cause-Stock Transfer Proposals without Document ID are created due to inconsistency.-Resolution-Request permission from customer for backend correction and forward the incident to AP-SDM-MSD for correction.-Steps:-Put break point in FM: /LCAP/ORDER_GET_DATA)-Go to ByD UI,Supply Planning - Products (Exeption View) -> Enter product and press enter - Debugger will hit-Check the GUID in internal table it_order-SESFTS: STOCK_TRANSFER_PROPOSAL -> Load by Node Id (Root) -Enter the node id received from step 3-Make sure to check the status of STO. (Should be 2 - exception requested), check the Product, check all the exception.-Delete STO Proposal-Keywords-Stock Transfer Proposal, Document ID , Product Planning, Supply Planning, Requested.

Title: Troubleshooting Dump "numeric overflow: the precision of the decimal value is larger than the target precision"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-The following Dump occurs when releasing or saving a document such as a Sales Order:-Error Analysis:-Database returned SQL code 314; error text is: numeric overflow: the precision of the decimal value is larger than the target precision: X: type_code=5, index=11"  (X stands for the length in our example it is 4)-Active Call/Events-    5 FUNCTION     SAPLSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATE         LSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATEU02           439-      SFSG_AFTERSAVE_HDB_TRNS_CFIUT-    4 FORM         SAPLSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATE         LSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATEU02             1-      SFSG_AFTERSAVE_HDB_TRNS_CFIUT-    3 FORM         SAPMSSY4                            SAPMSSY4                              121-      UPDATES_NO_UTASK-    2 FORM         SAPMSSY4                            SAPMSSY4                               38-      LOCAL_UPDATE_TASK-    1 EVENT        SAPMSSY4                            SAPMSSY4                               17-      START-OF-SELECTION-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This issue can also occur for other Documents. We are using Sales Orders as an example.-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Click on the Submit button and select the Release option. -Dump occurs-Cause-This error occurs because an extension field with type Decimal in the system exceeds the length for which it is set up.-Resolution-ST22-The following dump details can be found:-  Error Analysis:-Short text of the error message:- "Database returned SQL code 314; error text is: numeric overflow: the-  precision of the decimal value is larger than the target precision: 4:-  type_code=5, index=11"-  Active Call/Events-    5 FUNCTION     SAPLSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATE         LSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATEU02           439-      SFSG_AFTERSAVE_HDB_TRNS_CFIUT-    4 FORM         SAPLSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATE         LSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATEU02             1-      SFSG_AFTERSAVE_HDB_TRNS_CFIUT-    3 FORM         SAPMSSY4                            SAPMSSY4                              121-      UPDATES_NO_UTASK-    2 FORM         SAPMSSY4                            SAPMSSY4                               38-      LOCAL_UPDATE_TASK-    1 EVENT        SAPMSSY4                            SAPMSSY4                               17-      START-OF-SELECTION-  Go to Transaction SE37-Function Module: SFSG_AFTERSAVE_HDB_TRNS_CFIUT (as per function module under active call/events in the dump)-Click on Display.-Add an External Breakpoint at line 439 (If this is the line mentioned under active call/events in the dump)-Execute the action in the UI. In our example this would mean Release the Sales Order.-  Debugger will open.-  In the Modify in line 428 (or the line of the Modify above the breatkpoint you set) double click on the <FS_MODIFY_OFFSET>-CUSTOMER_TABLE_NAME and on the <FT_EXT_CONTAINER> (Please note, in some cases it shows-<FS_INSTER_OFFSET>instead of <FS_MODIFY_OFFSET>. You can process the same steps with this also).-Copy the table name from <FS_MODIFY_OFFSET>-CUSTOMER_TABLE_NAME which is in our example /1FS/SALES_OR_N6619890_078-In the variables double click on <FT_EXT_CONTAINER>-You can double click on the Row that will format the table in a more structural view so you can see the data better-  Here you can check the values for the extension fields.-You need to check the values for the extension fields that have decimals.-Transaction SE11-Database Table enter the table you copied from variable <FS_MODIFY_OFFSET>-CUSTOMER_TABLE_NAME which is in our example /1FS/SALES_OR_N6619890_078-Click on Display-Here you can see  the extension fields and the definition such as data type, length and decimals places.-In our example in the Error analysis section the following error is displayed:-"Database returned SQL code 314; error text is: numeric overflow: the precision of the decimal value is larger than the target precision: 4: type_code=5, index=11"-This means that the extension field that is causing the issue was defined with a length of 4 (which includes the decimals) but exceeds the length of 4.-In our example there are 2 extension fields that are defined with the length of 4 and the decimal places of 2-    We can now compare the values in the debugger of these extension fields.-  You can see that the fist extension field has the value 125.60. This means that the length of the field would need to be at least 5 (3 before the decimal and 2 after the decimal).-But since it was only defined with a length of 4 the decimal value 125.60 is larger than the defined length of 4 and hence the dump occurs.-  Click on F8 in the debugger to completed the process.-Delete the External Breakpoint-  Transaction /N/EXT/FIELD-In the Field ID -> right mouse click -> select Find-In the Find field enter the Extension Field you copied in our example /BYD/A3MFUP000B1EF60F324BD-Change the P to an F-e,g, from /BYD/A3MFUP000B1EF60F324BD to /BYD/A3MFUF000B1EF60F324BD-Click on the green check-  Copy the ESR Name and the Label name of the field and provide this to the customer informing the customer that the dump points to the error “numeric overflow: the precision of the decimal value is larger than the target precision: 4”.-This error occurs because extension field (enter the ESR Name and Label name) with type Decimal in your system that is set up for a totally length of 4 (this includes the number of decimals) but the value in this field is determined as 125.60 which has a length of 5 and therefore exceeds the length 4.-Since the length of an extension field cannot be changed the solution is:-- either ensure that no value that has a greater length of 4 is passed-- or the customer needs to remove the extension field and create a new extension field with a greater length as per the customers requirement.-Keywords-Sales Order, Save, Release, Dump, Numeric Overflow, Decimal, Exceeds, Larger, Precision, Extension Field, KUT, PDI, Calculated field, SAPLSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATE, SFSG_AFTERSAVE_HDB_TRNS_CFIUT

Title: How to find an ABAP Class for Platinum Engineering Reuse Functions
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 5 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You received a customer case where a Platinum Engineering reuse function is used but there is no documentation for this as these are SAP Internal functions.-Platinum Engineering namespace: http://sap.com/xi/AP/PlatinumEngineering -In this KBA you will see how to find the source code for these functions in the Backend.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-In MDRS transaction you will be able to find the source code of these reuse functions created by Platinum Engineering team (AP-XPE).-The steps to do so are the following:-1. Log in the backend with a SAP_SUPP user and open MDRS.-2. Select "Transformation Definition" in the dropdown and type "XPE*" in the search field. Then, click on the value help button next to the search field(it looks like an arrow pointing down).-3. It will open a Modal Dialog screen where you need to type "XPE*" in the Transformation Def. field and then click on button "Start Search".-4. This will retrieve a list with all the Platinum Engineering Functions available. Let's say that in this example you want to know more about the function BOAction.CheckLock, so you find it in the list and double click on it.-5. This will lead you to have all the details about Transformation Definition "XPE_CHECK_LOCKING" available in MDRS. Now to find the ABAP Code, Double click on the Object Name "XPE_CHECK_LOCKING", then go to tab Implementation and double click on the value present in column "by ABAP Class".-6. It will open a list of methods for this Implementation Class. By double clicking on EXECUTE you will be in the ABAP Code for that function. From here you can directly set an external breakpoint to troubleshoot the scenario the customer reported.-Keywords-library, reuse library, code, abap, platinumEngineering

Title: Registered Product Owner and Custodian Information Missing in Consignment Scenario
Content: Symptom-In consignment scenario, the owner and custodian information is missing in registered product master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements work center-Go to Registered Products view-Find product ABC (ABC refers to the product ID)-Open it and view all-Go to Involved Parties tab -You see there is no data here. However if you check in Serial Inventory Overview, you see the product has Owner and Custodian information maintained.-Cause-Customer Consignment is a new feature released with Business ByDesign 2105 to support the scenario “Use Different Consignee and Customer with Serial Number for Consignment Fill-up”. The  mentioned issue in the article have been resolved with version 2411.-Resolution-For the affected registered product, you can check the owner and custodian of a registered product (consignment) in common task Consignment Serial Stock Overview. Alternatively, you can add owner and custodian manually under tab Involved Parties in the master data of registered product.-Keywords-Registered Product, Consignment, Fill up, Custodian, Owner

Title: Embeded report without collapsed view in Sales Order Overview
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When the collapsed view of embedded report is deactivated via adaptation mode, the information in the report vanishes.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to any work center with Embedded report.-Start adaption mode.-Deactivate the collapsed view.-It seems to be working fine.-End adaption mode.-Go back to the embedded report.-The report doesn’t show anything, the information in the report vanished.- Cause-An embedded report in a C4C UI is designed to be a "child" object of the UI itself. When the UI loads, it calls all it's children like embedded reports, extension fields, mashups and so on to load after it has finished loading its own components.-This is the basic design of every UI in C4C.-A child object like embedded report does NOT get called until the loading of the parent UI finishes completely. If there's any error in loading of the parent UI, a report embedded inside will not load.-As example, Sales Quote and some other UIs have been designed to perform some internal(technical) write operations when they load. Specifically, for Sales Quote, the write operation visualizes some dynamic data to the user opening the UI. This works fine for users which have both read & write authorizations for these UIs.-However, in this case, when the user does NOT have the write authorization to the Sales Quote instance which they're trying to open, this technical operation is failing. As a result, the embedded report is never called to load initially. During subsequent clicks by the user, like changing a tab, the write operation is not triggered & hence the embedded report loads.-Resolution-Unfortunately, the application team responsible for Sales Quote says that this technical operation to visualizes some dynamic data to the user is a basic loading operation and cannot be changed.-Hence, the customer should look at the following workarounds:-a) If the number of users having read-only authorizations & opening Sales Quote & other UIs which have this issue are more than the users which have both read & write authorizations, the embedded report should be maintained as collapsed. The subsequent click by such users to expand the Embedded Report panel would trigger the call to execute the report so that data can be shown.-b) If the previous condition is not true & the users having read-only authorizations & opening Sales Quote UI is less, the users can just click on another tab in the UI & then come back to this tab to see data in the report.-This is a limitation.-Keywords-Sales order; sales quotes; collapse; embedded report; report; collapsed;

Title: Error when Migrating Bank Account Balances
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you migrate Bank Account Balances you get the error: Migration terminated, Contact Your Service Adviser.-In the Backend you do not find any such Migration Object "Bank Account Balances".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center - Overview view.-Search for the Activity "Migration of Accounting Transaction Data". -Press Change Immediately.-Click on Migrate Accounting Transaction Data using the Migration Tool.-Highlight the Migration Unit Bank Account Balances.-Choose Execute Migration.-Select File Line and click on Process File.-You can see the Error during Validation Process: Migration terminated, Contact Your Service Adviser-Cause-In the Backend there are two Migration Objects: GL Account Balances and Bank Statements. These two Migration Objects form the Bank Account Balances Object in the Frontend. If in the Backend either one of those Objects is inconsistent then the Error is appearing in the Frontend. You need to make both Migration Objects consistent in the Backend.-Resolution-In the Backend open the Transaction DMC_INC_CORR.- Click the value help in the field to select the Migration Object GL Account Balances.-Press Check Object Consistency.-Select this Option and execute it (by pressing F8 or clicking the "Execute" icon at the top of the screen) to run a check for the object's consistency. If this step fails stating that the Runtime Object is invalid, move to the next step.-This option will attempt to generate a new, valid runtime object for the selected migration. In case this step completes successfully, it will probably correct the issue; check back in the frontend to see if the migration issue persists. Should this fail, it will raise an error message like: -"Error while generating runtime objects for XXXXXX.-Syntax error in function module XXXX.-Error message: The field "XXXXXX" is unknown, but there is a field with the similar name "XXXXXX"".-  Select "Zero reference error" and press F8 or click the "Execute" button at the top. Wait until process complete, once done move to the next step.-Select "Execute Cleanup report" press F8 or click the "Execute" button at the top. Wait until process complete, once done move to the next step.-Execute "Check Object Inconsistency" to check if the Migration Object is consistent now.-Press Generate Runtime Object.-Repeat the steps 2-9 with the Migration Object Bank Statements.-Once the two Objects are consistent in the Backend then repeat your Migration in the Frontend.-Keywords-Migration Object, Migration Bank Account Balances, Migration GL Account Balances, Migration Bank Statements, Migration Inconsistency, make Migration Object consistent in the Backend, Migration of Accounting Transaction Data

Title: Error - 'Profit center XYZ determined for Expense Report ABC is not valid on DD.MM.YYYY' occurred while trying to post the Expense Report
Content: Symptom-While trying to post the Expense Report 'ABC' facing below mentioned error message.-Error Message: Profit center XYZ determined for Expense Report ABC is not valid on DD.MM.YYYY. Check the validity of profit center XYZ in Organizational Management and your default profit centers in configuration.-(ABC refers to Expense Report ID).-(XYZ refers to Profit Center ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Expense Report sub view.-Search for the Expense Report ABC (In Process status)-Try to post it.-The error appears as " Profit center XYZ determined for Expense Report ABC is not valid on DD.MM.YYYY. Check the validity of profit center XYZ in Organizational Management and your default profit centers in configuration".-Cause-This error appears because the validity date of the Profit center determined for Expense Report got expired and not valid on that particular date mentioned in the error message. -Resolution-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Edit Org Structures sub view.-Search for the relevant Company of the Profit center under Org unit name.-Select that Org Unit, under timeline there is a Profit center 'Valid from' and 'Valid to' Date -Try to extend the 'Valid to' to the relevant date. (as mentioned in error message)-Once this validity is extended, expense report 'ABC' can be saved without any error message.-Keywords-Organizational Management, Validity Date, Profit Center, Org Structures, Expense Report.

Title: Prevent Output field is not editable for Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-User is unable to mark (or unmark) the Prevent Output field in the Purchase Order because the checkbox is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to General tab.-See that the checkbox for Prevent Output is grayed out (not editable).-Cause-The field Prevent Output is only editable when the document has "In Preparation" status.-Resolution-The user can cancel the Purchase Order and create a new one. In the new one,  the user will be able to edit the checkbox for the Prevent Output field.-Keywords-Prevent Output; Purchase Order; In Preparation

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on ByD Resource Management (RPM)
Content: Symptom-This KBA is to list some of the frequently asked questions on ByD Resource Management (RPM)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-1. My Availability workcenter view not available in Project Team work center for employees to edit their availability.-You have two solutions for Resource Calendar in the system:-The older solution is Resource availability based on Commitment quantity where you get the possibility of editing the Resource Calendar as an employee. The help document refers to the older resource calendar.-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cb4cbc7722d10149d2799a35f072d7d.html?locale=en-US-The newer solution is resource availability based on planned work where the employee would not be able to edit the Resource Calendar. The help document link for the same is https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/120ab365437e471c87bcb4c98701d7c1.html .-If you have scoped in new solution for Resource Calendar then editing of Resource Calendar by employee is not supported.-2. Resource Calendar Report doesn't show all relevant data as expected.-The report HCMRPMU05_Q0001 relies on data existing in the Resource Calendar.  This is created at the time of the Resource Planning Management solution being scoped on the system and the changes to projects planning, absences, planned times etc are kept up to date on the resource calendar for the specific employees.-For example: If you scope Resource Planning Management on a particular day then the data will be calculated and the Resource calendar is updated from that date onwards  This is the reason for the date only being available from the scoping date and not from the duration of the time file and the planned times from the time file.-Also check 3211036-3. Is it possible to show the resource availability of an employee on an hourly basis in Resource Calendar?-The system determines the number of hours that a resource has available on a certain day and this is shown in the availability calendar. If you are a project manager or a resource manager it is good to know the individual capacity of your team members, but it would be very useful to see the capacity (in hours) of your whole team or your selection of resources. This could be done by adding all the individual capacity numbers in an extra row below the resource availability calendar.-This feature is currently not supported in Resource Planning. You can upvote this idea in SAP Influence Forum below:-Improvement Request Details - Customer Influence (sap.com)-4. What is the purpose of Background Job Run: Resource Calendar Availability Calculation?-In the view background jobs there is a run called Resource Calendar Availability Calculation:-Select Application and User Management workcenter-Select Background Jobs view-Search: Resource Calendar Availability Calculation-Run ID: AVAIL_CALC-Run Type: Time And Labour Schedule Run-This Run Id is created by: Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM)-AVAIL_CALC is a background job triggered by TIMX_SCHEDULE_RUN MDRO when the new Resource Calendar is Scoped in.-This job is helpful to execute the Update_calendar Action in Timx_resource_calendar which will performs the calculations based on the CNRs created.-CNRs are triggered whenever there is any employee resource calendar relevant changes made in the system.-5. It takes a long time to show the availability of employee in Resource Management.-This is the expected behavior since the function has been performed for all the employees in the system. It has to fetch the availability data for all the employees for a period of three months in the past and 1 year in the future.-Many factors and conditions are involved in fetching the data from BYD. It depends on the number of projects, project tasks that employee has been assigned to, work schedule, color codes based on the holidays and working days.-6. Resource Calendar Report not displaying all tasks for an employee in a project.-The Resource Calendar stores data for the past 90 days and the upcoming 1 year, focusing on tasks with significant planned work hours distributed across specific days.-For tasks with limited planned hours, the planning may have either:-Been completed more than 90 days ago, leading to the data no longer being available in the calendar.-Not been distributed evenly throughout the year, as the Resource Calendar considers only those days where the task exceeds a threshold of 15 minutes of planned work.-In contrast, tasks with more extensive planning are distributed across multiple days, meeting the criteria for inclusion in the calendar.-This explains why certain tasks may not have corresponding day node data and are therefore not displayed in the report.-Keywords-Availability, Resource Planning Management, HCMRPMU05_Q0001

Title: Unable To Download Templates in the Microsoft Office Template Maintenance View
Content: Symptom-The template cannot be downloaded from the Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view, as the Download option is grayed out for templates, for example, List of Project Activities.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter-Go to Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view-Search for Templates, For example: List of Projects Activities-Select the Template and now you can observe the "Download" option is disabled-Cause-The template selected in Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance is a virtual template.-  Resolution-The virtual export templates cannot be downloaded, only write-back and specific export templates can be downloaded from Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance. As these are virtual, they are not stored in physical form as per the standard system design.-To verify if the template is virtual, follow the steps below:-Go to the browser and login to the ByD system-Open the Developer Tool-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter-Go to Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view-Search for Templates, For example: List of Projects Activities-In the developer tool, navigate to the Network tab-Select Json and navigate to the Preview tab-Expand the Response section-Expand the Controller -> Code List section-Expand the 0 section-Observe the below code indicating that the template is Virtual-_d: "Virtual"-_n: "1"-Keywords-Template, Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance, Virtual Template, Form Template, Download

Title: Error - 'Enter a value with no more than 2 characters' while trying to create a new Customer groups activity
Content: Symptom-While creating a new Customer Group via Business Configuration, it is specified to use one of the prefixes V, W, X, Y, or Z.-All alphabetic prefixes and numerics from 1-9 have already been used.-The system does not allow the use of two-digit numbers or alphanumeric combinations.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview sub view.-Search for the Customer Groups activity.-Select 'Maintain Customer groups'.-Try to give add row and enter Z10 (Alphanumeric), the error appears.-"Enter a value with no more than 2 characters".-Cause-While attempting to use three digits, such as Z10, results in the error message: "Enter a value with no more than 2 characters." The system does not accept customer group activities with three-digit alphanumeric values.-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected, based on a pre-defined custom configuration that restricts the Customer Group ID to a maximum of two characters.-Additional Customer Groups with new custom IDs can be created using a pair of letters, such as:-XA, XB, XC up to XX-YA, YB, YC up to YY-ZA, ZB, ZC up to ZZ-Special characters like !, ?, #, etc., can also be used to create unique IDs, such as:-V1, V?, V#-This approach allows for the creation and saving of a larger number of Customer Groups with new custom IDs without encountering errors.-Keywords-Customer Groups, Alphanumeric, Characters, Prefixes, Special Characters, Business Configuration.

Title: Issue on clearing a Credit Memo automatically in the Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-The system clears Customer Invoice automatically in the Bank Statement, but the Credit Memo is not cleared. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario: 1 -1) Create a Credit Memo.-2) Go to Liquidity Management work center.-3) Select New Bank Statement.-4) Enter the data in 1st tab. -5) Go to 3rd tab  and click on *Add Row*. -6) Select Payment Method - Outgoing Bank Transfer for Credit Memo. -7) Enter Credit Memo ID in the Invoice ID field and enter amount. -8) Post the Bank Statement. ----> Here the Post Processing status is Required. Why? Ideally it should be cleared. -Scenario: 2 -1) Create a Customer Invoice.-2) Go to Liquidity Management work center.-3) Select New Bank Statement.-4) Enter the data in 1st tab. -5) Go to 3rd tab and click on *Add Row*. -7) Select Payment Method - Incoming Bank Transfer for Customer Invoice. -8) Enter Customer Invoice ID and amount. -9) Post the Bank Statement. ----> Here the Post Processing status is Not Required. This is correct system behavior and it is expected for Credit memo documents also.  -Cause-As per the system design, the Invoice ID field accepts only Invoices, however not the Credit Memo. Usually when Credit Memo ID given in the Invoice ID field, the Bank Statement post processing status is in 'Required' status and not cleared.-Note:-For Customer Invoice, when selecting payment Method as Other Incoming Payments or Incoming Bank Transfer, then the system clears automatically. -For Credit Memo, when selecting payment method as Other Outgoing Payments or Outgoing Bank Transfer, then the system not getting clear automatically. -Resolution-While creating the Bank Statement, Credit Memo ID is given in the Invoice ID field. Invoice ID field is expected to be filled with only Invoice ID not with Credit Memo ID.-Hence system doesn't go for Automatic Payment Allocation and the post processing status is in “Required” in case of Credit Memo. This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-KBA - "2465360 - Automatic Clearing of Invoice and Credit Memo in the Account Monitor "-Keywords-Credit Memo, Customer Invoice, Bank Statement, Post Processing, Liquidity Management, Clearing.

Title: Exceptions/Conditional Formatting Settings in Report are not Taken Over in Excel
Content: Symptom-In report ABC, on key figure DEF, you have set up an exception/conditional formatting. For example, this key figure shows a different background colour when a certain value is reached.Now you either download and open report in excel or directly open the report via excel add-in, you notice that the exception (i.e. the background colour in this example) is missing and the key figure does not show the defined background colour.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report ABC from the work center Business Analytics.-Click on the key figure in the rows or columns and choose New Exception/Conditional Formatting.-Choose the key figure DEF and set up the exception/conditional formatting as required, for example by defining a background colour for specific values.-Click OK. You will see the background colour in the report. Save this view.-Now download this report in any desired format and open it via excel or log in excel add-in and open the saved report view, the exception/conditional formatting is not maintained and the background colour is not taken over.-Cause-Exceptions Settings/ Conditional Formatting are not supported yet in excel.-Resolution-As the Exception/Conditional Formatting settings are not supported via excel,hence it not considered in the report format.--Should you need this new functionality you can create a request via the Influence page-Cloud for Customer: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/903-Business ByDesign: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-2085844 - Exception Settings Not Taken Over in Broadcasted Reports-Keywords-Exception, Report, Color, Excel, Indicator, Conditional Formatting-excel,report,exception,indicator

Title: Payment Advice not clearing automatically via Web Service in reference to the Invoice
Content: Symptom-A Payment Advice 'ABC' was created via web service in reference to the Invoice, but the system is not automatically clearing the items.-The following criteria were verified:-The XML structure is correct.-The compensation strategy configuration is accurate.-The Invoice is correctly referenced in the Bank Advice.-Only the Invoice is used as the reference.-'ABC' refers to Payment Advice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Customer Accounts sub view.-Select the Account ID DEF (DEF means the Account ID) and give view.-Under Trade Receivables tab, select the Invoices / Payments subtab and navigate to Open Items list.-Automatic Clearing is not created.-Cause-When an invoice and payment advice are created on the same day, the clearing runs automatically.-If a payment advice is generated the following day, the clearing does not occur automatically.-Resolution-Is there any way that automatic clearing happens on any date?-For fully cleared advice and invoice the system will clear automatically.-For partially cleared advice may be 1st clearing will go automatically and subsequent clearings will be done manually.-Is it cleared automatically for the Partial payment of Invoice?-When a partial payment of an invoice is made on the same date, the Net Due Date remains aligned with the invoice's original Net Due Date. As a result, the system clears all invoices automatically.-When partial payments of an invoice are made on different dates (e.g., one day apart), the Net Due Date changes. This creates a conflict, causing the system to post the payment advice but leave it uncleared in the Customer Account Monitor.-Is it possible to modify the invoice due date so that it is automatically cleared on any date?-No, it is not possible to modify the invoice due date because the date is automatically derived from the posting date and Payment terms condition.-This is a standard system behavior. Basically, there is a checkpoint of Net Due Date calculation at the time of clearing, as the clearing strategy will apply based on the fine tune settings. - See Also-KBA  - "2589692 - Automatic Clearing Between Bank Advice Created via Web Service and Invoice is Not Working "-Keywords-Payment Advice, Web-Service, XML, Customer Account, Receivables, Invoice, Business Partner, Automatic Clearing

Title: Delivery Status Of Service Order Is Not The Expected One.
Content: Symptom- The Delivery Status of an Item in a Service Order is still Finished even though the Service Confirmation was cancelled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Search for the Service Order ABC (ABC is service order ID).-Navigate to Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select the Line Item XX for Service ABC (where ABC is product ID of type Service - time and material and XX is the line item number). -The Delivery Status is Finished. -Go to the Document Flow tab and open the Service Confirmation that was created for Service ABC.  -Navigate to Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select the line Item in which you confirmed the Service ABC. -You can see that the item was cancelled via a Reason for Rejection.-You expect that since the Service Confirmation was cancelled that the Delivery Status of the item should have been revoked to In Process, but it is still showing as Finished. -Cause-The Service Confirmation was already Invoiced.-When you entered the Reason for Rejection in the Service Confirmation, there is was a warning message displayed: Fulfillment of item XX in order ABC was not revoked, item already invoiced.-Resolution- You need to cancel the Invoice to revoke the status in the Service Order.-Keywords- Service Order, Service Confirmation, Revoke, Reopen, reason for rejection-service order,service confirmation,revoke,reopen,reason for rejection

Title: System Dump while Finishing Production Task
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-A System dump occurs when changing the status of a Production Task to Finished.-The following error appears in T-code ST22: -" Index Information-    1 Termination: Exception 'CM_APPE_PAO_PLOT_TO_ACC' caught by class 'CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER' [SAPM-    2 Triggering application component: AP-PE-    3 Exception chain (click button "Unformatted Display" for all details):-    4  1. Info: Permanent establishment ID not found for production lot XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX-    5     CM_APPE_PAO_PLOT_TO_ACC, Program:SAPMHTTP, Include:, Position:0"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Choose Task Control view.-Search the Production Task ABC (ABC Represents Production Task ID).-Choose Change Status.-Choose Finish.-The system dump occurs.-Cause-The Logistics Area ID is missing for the main product in the Output Products tab of the relevant Production Lot.-The missing Logistics Area causes a data inconsistency in both the UI and backend, triggering a dump when the Production Task status is changed to Finished.-Steps to check in UI:-Go to Production Control work center.-Choose Production Orders view.-Search the relevant Production Order id.-Under general tab choose production lot id.-Choose Products tab.-Choose Output Products sub-tab.-The Logistics Area ID is missing for the Output product.-Steps to check in backend:-Enter T-code SESFTS in the backend.-Enter PRODUCTION_LOT BO in the BO ID field.-Choose Load by Query and select Root - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-Enter the Production lot XYZ in the search field and execute the search (XYZ represents Production lot ID).-Choose Navigate select MAIN_PRODUCT_OUTPUT.-CONFIRM_LOGISTICS_AREA_UUID-CONTENT shows initial value  00000000000000000000000000000000.-Resolution-Create an incident to the component AP-PE-TSK.-For the Development Team reference, the correct UUID can be fetched from production order.-Open T-code SESFTS.-Query the relevant production order ID in PRODUCTION_ORDER BO.-Choose Navigate - MAIN_PRODUCT_OUTPUT.-The correct UUID displayed in LOGISTICS_AREA_UUID-CONTENT.-Keywords-System Dump; Production Task; Finish; Logistics Area; Output Products; Production Lot; SESFTS; PRODUCTION_LOT; PRODUCTION_ORDER; CONFIRM_LOGISTICS_AREA_UUID; Permanent Establishment ID; Task Control; Production Control; ByDesign

Title: PAYMENT REPORTING business role is assigned to Invalid Work Center view
Content: Symptom-The system detects inconsistencies in work center assignments for a business user.-The Business Role 'XYZ' under the header work center which is FIN_PAYABLESAP that have one of the view id PAYMENT REPORTING.-This view id PAYMENT REPORTING got assigned to INVALID WORK CENTER view which is not correct.-('XYZ' refers to Business Role ID)--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Role sub view.-Search for the Business Role 'XYZ'. ('XYZ' refers to Business Role ID)-Select edit and navigate to the 'Work center and view Assignment' tab.-Under the work center FIN_PAYABLESAP, the view id PAYMENT REPORTING is assigned to INVALID WORK CENTER name.- Cause-This expectation is that the Business role 'XYZ' with the view id PAYMENT REPORTING should not be assigned to the INVALID WORK CENTER View. -One of the reasons might be that this view is assigned from FDE_ADMIN Business role. This role has Work Center FIN_PAYABLESAP. And all the users who are assigned with this role FDE_ADMIN will have the view PAYMENT REPORTING.-Please Note: This Invalid assignment won't cause any issues.-The PAYMENT REPORTING view becomes active when the "Payment Times Reporting" business option group is scoped.-Currently, this business option group is not scoped in the customer/partner tenant.-It is likely that the business option was scoped in the past, and the customer/partner assigned the view to business users through the Business Role.-Later, the business option was descoped, rendering the view inactive.-The assignment to the Business Role or Business Users is not automatically removed upon descoping.-Manual removal of the assignment is required.-Resolution-It can be unassigned by following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users sub view.-Select that respective Business user.-Go to the Business Roles view-Now select all Business Role form drop down,-Search for the FDE_ADMIN.-Give Edit and go to Work center and view assignment tab.-Uncheck PAYMENT REPORTING work center view.-Once the changes done, save it.-Select confirm in the pop up to update for all the users to whom the role is assigned.-Now the view PAYMENT REPORTING will be unassigned -See Also-KBA -"2609157 - Health Check: Assignment of Work Center Views Requires Adjustment ".-Keywords-Invalid Work Center view,  PAYMENT REPORTING,  FIN_PAYABLESAP, Application and User Management, Scoping.

Title: Zero Value posted in the Journal Entry of Production Confirmation 'ABC'.
Content: Symptom-Zero Value posted on the Journal Entry of Production Confirmation 'ABC'.-In the relevant Journal Entry of the source document Production Confirmation, try to check the debit/ credit value in company currency, it will be zero.-'ABC' refers to Production Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents sub view.-Search for Production Confirmation 'ABC'.-Select Actions--> Business Transaction.-Give View all.-Go to Journal Entries Tab, try to see that debit/ credit value in company currency which will be zero.-Cause-Initially no values posted in the goods receipt and because of this due Valuation at product level is zero due to this Journal entry posed with zero value transaction for the Production Confirmation 'ABC'-  The Product cost must be checked under Product Master Data.-For the Finished Product, no Valuation Cost is available.-The Costing Method is set to Moving Average and also the cost history consistently shows a value as zero.-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected.-The Input Material (raw material) has a Valuation Cost assigned, and its Journal Entries include the cost.-This cost is not transferred to the Finished Product because no BOM (Bill of Material) is present.-Due to the absence of the BOM, the cost is never updated for the Finished Product.-This results with the Zero value journal entry postings for the Production Confirmation 'ABC'.-Keywords-Product Cost, Production Confirmation, Goods and Service Receipt, Bill of Material, Production Task, General Ledger.

Title: Process Communication Error - "Document date DD-MM-YYY is not within the validity period of tax reporting unit AA" occurs in the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Process Communication error occurs in the Supplier Invoice XYZ. ('XYZ' refers to Supplier Invoice ID)-Error: "Document date DD-MM-YYY is not within the validity period of tax reporting unit AA". ('AA' refers to Tax reporting unit ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice and Credit memos sub view.-Search for the Supplier Invoice XYZ. ('XYZ' refers to Supplier Invoice ID)-Go to the document flow there will be the red marked icon which is the Process Communication error.-To check the error message, follow the below mentioned steps.-Go to the Application and user management work center.-Go to the Process communication error sub view.-Filter it with Open error with cases.-In the Sending document header, give 'Supplier Invoice' and enter-The process communication error will be visible with the Supplier Invoice document ID.-Error message: "Document date DD-MM-YYY is not within the validity period of Tax reporting unit AA". ('AA' refers to Tax reporting unit ID)- Cause-Try to check the Tax reporting unit 'AA' under the Organizational Structure, the validity period is 01.02.9999/Unlimited, and in the respective Supplier Invoice 'XYZ' the document date is 01.01.9999. Hence, it's a mismatch.-Because the validity period starting from is later than the maintained Document date.-Please note: The dates mentioned above is for the examples reference.-Resolution-Try to correct the Document date of the Supplier Invoice XYZ by following the below mentioned steps.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice and Credit memos sub view.-Search for the Supplier Invoice 'XYZ'.-Select Edit.-Try to change the document date which should come within the timeline of the validity period maintained in the Tax reporting unit 'AA'.-Give Save.-Once the changes done, create a case to SAP Technical Support, so that the failed XI message from the backend will be reprocessed to clear the Process Communication error exist in the Supplier Invoice 'XYZ'.-See Also-KBA - "3319544 - Tax Reporting Unit is not Determined while trying to post the Supplier Invoice "-Keywords-Process Communication Error, SupplierInvoiceProcessing,  AccountingInvoiceAccountingIn, Document date,  Tax reporting unit.

Title: Error Message "Labor Resource Assignment Mandatory for Project Time Confirmation on DD.MM.YYYY."
Content: Symptom-While trying to record time against a project or approve timesheet of an employee, system throws error message "Labor resource assignment mandatory for project time confirmation on DD.MM.YYYY".-This KBA also works for recording time using service confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Access the Self-Services view.-Choose the Self-Services Overview.-Click the Edit Time Sheet link.-Enter the time recording as required.-Click the Save button.-Click the Release button. -System throws the mentioned error message.-Alternatively:-Go to the Project Team work center.-Access the Edit Time Sheet view under the Common Tasks section.-Click the Save button.-Click the Release button. -System throws the mentioned error message.-Cause-It is not possible to post employee times when there is no Resource maintained. Labor resource assignment is required for Project Time Recording to calculate the project's internal costs based on labor resource cost rates.-To confirm there is no resource maintained:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees view.-Locate and select the relevant employee.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Employment tab. -In the Organizational Assignment sub-tab, take the Reporting Line Unit name, the employee's Job and validity.-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Master Data view.-Access the Resources subview.-Search for the employee's Cost Center (Reporting Line Unit) from step 6.-Select and click Edit-Check whether the employee's Job (from step 6) is maintained or not under Valuation tab, and ensure that it is valid.-Resolution-If no resource is maintained for the relevant job and cost center combination, create it as follows:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Master Data view.-Access the Resources subview.-Search for the relevant job.-Select and click the Edit button.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Under Cost Center Assignment, click Add Row.-Enter the relevant cost center.-Set the validity so that it encompasses the period in which the time recordings will be entered (i.e. Valid From date set before the time recording dates).-Click the Save button.-It might be the case that there's already a resource maintained for the job and cost center combination, but the issue is simply in the validity period. In this case, edit the resource and correct the Valid From or Valid To dates accordingly.-In case you do not want to use the resource cost rate, you can create labor resources without a cost rate which would assure that the service cost rate will be determined.-Note:-1.If there is a Labor Resource with Cost Center but no Job assigned, then the Cost Center (Reporting Line Unit) of the employee is used to select this Labor Resource.-2.If a Labor Resource exists with Cost Center and Job, then the Cost Center (Reporting Line Unit) and Job of the employee is used to select this Labor Resource.--See Also-This error message can also occur when a project manager tries to approve times.-Keywords-Labor resource assignment mandatory, Project time confirmation, No labor resource, Time recording, Project management, Time approval

Title: Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing in the Closing Cockpit not Finished
Content: Symptom-The Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing needs to be closed in the Closing Cockpit. All the relevant activities are finished but the Status of the Closing is still in status: In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Centre.-Go to the Closing Cockpit sub-view in Closing Cockpit view.-Select the company ABC (ABC is the ID of the company)-YYYY/0PP (YYYY stand for the year and 0PP stands for the period).-Click on the Open Period - End Close  arrow icon in the bottom right-hand corner.-In Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing for YYYY, 0PP, ABC,  all relevant activities are completed.-All activities have the status "Finished" and the sign-off status as "Accepted," but the Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing status remains "In Process."-Cause-The Status of Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing should be changed to Finished whenever you mark the last activity of the closing as Finished. Unfortunately in this case, the status of Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing was not updated.-Resolution-As a workaround, the issue can be solved by selecting an activity and changing the status to In Process and thereafter change it back to Finished.-However, this can only be done by the responsible User. For other users, all the options are greyed out.-You need to ask the responsible User to perform the steps below to mark the Period-End closing as Finished:-Open the Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing: YYYY, 0PP, ABC.-Select any one of the Activities and click on the Set Status to In Process.-Save the Changes.-Select the same activity again and reset the status to Finished.-Save the changes again.-Now the Period/Quarter/Year-End Closing: YYYY, 0PP, ABC has the status Finished.-Keywords-Period-End Closing, Quarter-End Closing, Year-End Closing, Closing Cockpit, Status, In Process, Finished.

Title: Unable to view the data for Report - Schedule of Fixed Assets - Italy.
Content: Symptom-  The Report: Schedule of Fixed Assets - IT (Italy) does not display any data despite providing all mandatory inputs in the data selection.-Instead of retrieving data, the following error appears.-Error message: Failed to open report - "Internal Server Error" - Open an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Asset work center.-Go to the List sub view under the Reports.-Search for the Report Category - Schedule of Fixed Assets - IT-Try to give the inputs for the fields such as Access Context, Company, Set of Books, Valuation view, Accounting Period/Year-While running the report no data getting generated, instead there is an error.-Error message: Failed to open report - "Internal Server Error" - Open an incident.-Cause-As per the Report Category: Schedule of Fixed Assets - IT - Shows the schedule of fixed assets for each asset class, specified according to Italian legal requirements.-The Report data is actually meant for country Italy.-For example: Executing this report for Company 'ABC', which belongs to countries such as Greece, China, India and so on, does not display data. Instead, the error message mentioned above appears.  ('ABC' refers to Company ID).-Resolution-The Report Schedule of Fixed Assets - IT is relevant only for the region Italy and in addition to Fixed Asset accounting data, the following information must also be reported according to Italian legal requirements.-Check the help center documentation: Schedule of Fixed Assets — Italy | SAP Help Portal -Keywords-Fixed Assets, Report, Schedule of Fixed Assets, Italy, Partner Company, Internal Server Error.

Title: Closing Relevant Task - Reposted or split item 'ABC' is cleared (Clearing 'DEF') while trying to reverse the Clearing
Content: Symptom-In the "Closing-Relevant Tasks" view, the document cannot be posted and gives the task message "Reposted or split item 'ABC' is cleared (Clearing 'DEF')."-The system detects an issue that prevents automatic processing in the accounting process component.-In this example, expense report 'GHI' is a source document which is in In-process status and while trying to cancel this expense report, system is giving this clearing relevant task.-'ABC' refers to the Original Clearing.-'DEF' refers to Split Clearing.-'GHI' refers to Expense report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing relevant tasks sub view.-The task "Reposted or split item 'ABC' is cleared (Clearing 'DEF')" will be visible. -Select that and under Business Transaction, there will be this Expense Report 'GHI' with In-Process status.-Cause-This task occurs because by referencing the expense report 'GHI', the split clearing item got created where it got divided into original clearing 'ABC' and split clearing 'DEF'. In each case, the system informs that the additional Clearing ID that exists for a split item must be reset. So reset is required for the split clearings and then reverse the original clearings.- Resolution-Try to find the Clearing 'DEF' on the same customer account monitor and reset it.-After resetting Clearing 'DEF,' return to Clearing 'ABC' to reverse it without further issues.-Once the changes are completed, reprocess the cancellation of the Expense Report.-The cancellation will now post to accounting, generating a Journal Entry.-Keywords-Clearing, Closing Relevant Task, Split Clearing, Expense Report, Reset Clearing.

Title: Project Assignment Rules for Sales Order Items with Time and Expense Type - Service
Content: Symptom-User check the Assignment Rules for Sales Order Items for a project, and notice that some rules define a service ID and other rules only define a generic entry with an asterix (*).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Search for the affected project.-Choose Edit Time and Expenses.-In the new screen press Edit All Rules and choose View All Rules button.-Some rules define a service ID and others only show a generic value in the service field [asterisk(*)].-Resolution-In general, the system creates the assignment rules as generic as possible and as specific as needed. However;-If all the sales order items are assigned to different project task then the sales order item can be uniquely identified through the project task. It is not needed to specify the service explicitly in the assignment rules. Therefore, an asterisk (*) is maintained in the Service field.-If all the sales order items are assigned to the same project task, such as just the project header, an additional criterion is needed to identify to correct sales order item. In this case the service ID is derived from the sales order item to appear in the Service field.-If multiple sales orders exist for the same project, further specifications might be necessary to identify the correct sales order item for an expense. Also here, the Service field will be filled with an actual value. -Keywords-Project Assignment Rules, Service, Not Invoiced Time and Expenses, Asterisk (*)

Title: Output History Tab is Missing for Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-It was expected to be able to access the Output History tab in the Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID).-Click in Edit button.-The user is unable to navigate to Output History tab, because there is no Output History tab.-Cause-There are some possible causes on why the Purchase Order doesn't have an Output History tab.-Cause 1: Purchase Order ABC is currently in 'In Approval' status or in "In Preparation" status. If you navigate to Changes tab, you can see that the document didn't go through Sent status yet.-Cause 2: For migrated purchase orders, the actual output would have already happened before the migration stage itself. Hence the Output does not get generated upon migration into ByDesign system.-Cause 3: The Prevent Output indicator is checked in General tab. If you checked this indicator, the purchase order will not be outputted and the supplier will not be notified automatically when the purchase order is ordered, changed, or cancelled.-Resolution-For each case:-Resolution for Cause 1: -If the Purchase Order is in "In Preparation" status: once the Purchase order is ordered, the Output History tab will be showing for this document.-If the Purchase Order is in "In Approval" status: once the Purchase order is approved, the Output History tab will be showing for this document.-Resolution for Cause 2: Since supplier already received order outside of ByDesign, so no need of sending it again via Bydesign. Every thing else you can continue as usual.-Resolution for Cause 3: The Prevent Output indicator is available at each purchase order document level, and it's unchecked by default. When you create a new purchase order, you can manually check it. If you want to stop using this indicator to avoid user mistake, you can hide this field via key user adaptation mode to make the field not published to end users.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Approval; Output History; In Preparation; Migration; Migrated

Title: When Previewing Material Supply and Demand Data Sources, System Dumps
Content: Symptom-You are trying to preview a data source like Material Supply and Demand List. The system takes lot of time to open this data sources in preview mode and later it may dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work center-Go to Design Data Sources view-Select the Data Source that you want to preview.-In this case, Select Material Supply and Demand Keyfigure data source and click on Preview button.-System takes long time in opening the data source and after some time fails.-Same scenario happens when Material Supply and Demand List data source is also attempted to open with Preview button.-Cause-The cause is the huge number of records in this data source. To retrieve information regarding these records, the system is taking more time than the set time limit. Due to this a time out event is triggered and the system crashes.-Resolution-Please follow the below mentioned steps to avoid such crash while trying to preview the data source:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Source view and select the Material Supply and Demand List data source that you wish to preview. -Click on the New button and select option Report from drop down. -A Guided Activity screen opens up. In this screen, please provide a Report name and proceed with default selections.-In step 4:Characteristic Properties, select Planning Area ID, Specification ID and Material ID as Using Variable under Value Selection column.-In step 7: Confirmation step, select the option Create View for this Report in a Web Browser.-Now in the new screen, you will have the Planning Area ID, Specification ID and Material ID as selection parameters for the report.-Generating the report using value by providing any of the selection parameter doesn't result in a dump as the result set contains filtered data as per the selection parameter. Similar steps can be followed to preview Material Supply and Demand Keyfigure data source.-Keywords-data source, time out, material supply and demand, crash, dump, SCMMSDVV02, SCMMSDVV01, memory, internal server error-scmpdv01,scmmsdvv02,scmmsdvv01

Title: Error - 'Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID-CONTENT is filled' occurs when trying to create a New Charge/Credit for Payables
Content: Symptom-  An error occurs when attempting to create a New Charge/Credit for Payables.-Error Message: Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_NAME-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_UUID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_NAME-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_UUID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_TASK_KEY-TASK_ID-CONTENT is filled-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Audit work center.-Go to Payables sub view.-Give New Charge/credit,-Now try to give the G/L account and Project task.-Then enter.-The error message will display as follows,-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_NAME-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_UUID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_NAME-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_UUID-CONTENT is filled-Type is ACC but component PROJECT_TASK_KEY-TASK_ID-CONTENT is filled-Cause-The warning message raised due to no data provided in the mandatory fields because of that number of warning message have been raised.-Here system expects that required data needs to be filled for the given project task.- Resolution-  When creating a New Charge/Credit for Payables, all mandatory fields, such as Net
