Component COST_CENTER_ID is Filled  ."-Keywords-New Charge/credit, Payables, Type is ACC but component PROJECT_REFERENCE-PROJECT_ELEMENT_ID-CONTENT is filled.

Title: Tax Abroad Configuration for Output Tax
Content: Symptom-Unposted Source Documents with a message stating that the documents cannot be posted since there are missing configuration for Output Tax, even though the configuration is correctly maintained in the Business Configuration Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Select the Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-See a few Invoices with the following error message:-Account determination is missing for item type Output Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC and account determination profile <DEF>. Column Path Tax->Output Tax->Output Tax, Item Type Output Tax.-Cause-Open one of the invoices and check the company of the same. Now, check which country is configured for that Company and Charts of Accounts. After that, go to the Tax Lines of the Invoice. See that this Invoice has taxes to be posted in a country different than the country of the Invoice company.-This is the reason why the error message is being displayed. For such cases like Tax Abroad postings, Account determination code 9050 is considered for posting lines in accounting document. Since 9050 configuration is missing in configuration, this is pending in the Unposted Source Documents with error stating configuration is missing.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview view.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select the option Tax under Account Determination.-Select the Account Determination Profile DEF.-Under the tab Output Tax you need to add the Taxable Event 9050.-After maintaining the mentioned configuration, post the unposted source document.-See Also-2370769 - Error: Account Determination is Missing for Item Type Output Tax-2699898 - Error while posting Unposted Documents (India Relavent)-2292440 - Error 'Account determination is missing for item type Input Tax. Specify account determination in Chart of Accounts XYZ and Account Determination Profile PQR Column Path Tax->Input Tax->Input Tax,Item Type Input Tax.' Occurs When Posting Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Output Tax, Tax Abroad, Configuration, Missing Configuration, Charts of Accounts, Business Transactions, Invoice, Unposted Source Documents, Account Determination Profile.

Title: Service Quote Number Not Found In The Service Order XML
Content: Symptom-When you create a Service Order as a follow up document, to a Service Quote, the Quote Number/ID cannot be found in the XML of Service Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Order work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Search for the required Service Order and click on View All.-Navigate to the Output history and click on View Data XML.-When you search the XML, the Service Quote Number/ID reference cannot be found.-Cause-This the current system behavior.-Resolution--As per the current release of the Business ByDesign, the standard service order XML file has no information of the service quote number/ID.-Keywords-"Service Quote", "XML", "Service Order"

Title: Changing Currency in Released Service Order
Content: Symptom-You want to change the currency for a released Service Order, but the field is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Service Order Worcenter.-Select the Service Order Processing View.-Open Service Order ABC (ABC represents the Service Order ID).-Select the Pricing and Invoicing Tab.-Select the Invoicing Subtab.-The dropbox for the Currency is grayed out.-Cause-Once a Service Order is fully released, the currency cannot be changed anymore, irrespective of the invoicing status.-This is the expected system behaviour.-You can change the currency for all line items with the Invoice Status Not Started by adding another line item.-Resolution-Open Service Order ABC.-Navigate to the Services and Spare Parts Tab.-Click on Add Row.-Select any Service.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing Tab.-Select the Invoicing Subtab.-Change the currency for the Service Order.-Navigate back to the Services and Spare Parts Tab.-Remove the line item that you have previously added.-Keywords-Service Order, Currency, Change, Release, greyed out, Serviceauftrag, Währung, Wechsel, ausgegraut.

Title: Application Log Instance Show In Process Even Though There is No Background Job Running
Content: Symptom-Status of an Application Log instance show “In Process” even though there is no background job running and customer wants to delete it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign; Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator WC-Check the Mass Data Run view-Check the RUN ID-Check the application log still shows “In Process”-Cause-In the case of custom Pdi business object, when a job execution fails with a dump or a timeout , the MDRO framework does not get the control back from the application process, . Because of this, the MDRO framework does not update the status of the Application log and it is remains as “In Process”.-Resolution-You can find the correct status of the log, select the required MDRO instance.-Click on “View Jobs”-Select “Run Jobs” from the “Schedule Jobs” drop down. -The status of the job tells you the correct status. Its finished or failed.-To avoid situations like these, it is recommended to utilise MDRO’s action logic to avoid dumps. This can also be achieved by handling the “Avoid Dumps” suggestions from the “Performance Tips” on the action absl logic and try to get avoid this in process job log status.-See Also-You can refer to the SAP Cloud Application Studio help documentation MDRO section for more details.-Keywords-MDRO;JOB;INPROCESS;FAILED JOB

Title: Unable to Hide My Settings using Adaptation
Content: Symptom-Unable to hide the option "My Settings" using Adaptation mode-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Adaptation mode.-Hover on "My Settings".-No Option to hide the button.-Cause-My Settings is a standard option available for the end users to maintain few settings which cannot be hidden by a Key User.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior-Keywords-My Settings, Personalize, Adaptation

Title: Access Context of Report Not Working
Content: Symptom-An business user opens a report for which there is an access context (for example, 1015 Employee, Territory, Account, Sales Data). Instead of seeing his own (and his employee's) data only, one of the 2 scenarios happens:-The user sees all data.-The user sees no data at all.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report from the assigned work center.-Check the Access Context - it will be restricted.-Click on Go.-Either you will see all the report data, or the report returns no results at all. For this user however, it is expected to show some specific (restricted) results.-Cause-See below for possible reasons:-A) There are no access restrictions maintained for the work center view(s) that this report is assigned to. The access context of the report can only work if there are also access restrictions on the respective work center views. If there are no restrictions, this will create a conflict.-B) The report is assigned to a work center for which there is a conflict in access contexts. Whenever such an assignment is done, the access restriction cannot be applied.-C) The access restrictions were maintained, but you maintained different restrictions for different work center views. For example, the report and the user are assigned to 2 work center views. On the user level, you have maintained different restrictions for these work center view, one is restricted on user's data and the other is restricted to the user's team. The report will use the wider restriction, i.e. it will show the data of the user's team.-D) Other where access context shows as Unrestricted.-Resolution-Scenario A)-Go to the work center Application and User Management, view Business Users.-Search for the respective user and click on Edit > Access Rights-Go to the tab Access Restrictions-Search for every work center view that the report is assigned to -Under Read Access, maintain an access restriction.-This has to be done for all work center views that this report and this user are assigned to. If you are using business roles (C4C only), please maintain a restriction on the business role level.-Scenario B)-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Search for the report and click on Assign.-From the Show dropdown, select Assigned (this will show all work centers that the report is assigned to).-Check if there is a conflict with the access context of this work center view. If there is, the access restriction cannot work. You can unassign the report from this work center to avoid this.-Scenario C)-It is correct that if different restrictions are set, the wider restriction will apply to the report. Please make sure that the same restriction is set for each work center view that the report is assigned to. It is help to assign the report to as few work center views as possible. This way, you have less work center views where you need to align restrictions.-Scenario D)-Please unassign all Work Center Views and Business Roles (if any) of the report and reassign the same back again. This should regenerate the access context successfully.-See Also-2575041 - Conflict of Access Context During Report Assignment-2592130 - How to Set the Access Context of the Report-2742771 - Access Context in Joined Data Sources-Keywords-Access Context, context, report, restricted, not working, Business User-access context,report data,access restrictions

Title: Error Message "Service call failed, report an incident" When Migrating Services
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When migrating Services through Migration activity, system throws the error message "Service call failed, report an incident".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Access the activity through Overview view or through the projects in Implementation projects view-Search for the activity "Migration of Services"-Enter the sub-activity "Migrate Services Using the Migration Tool"-Select a template to be migrated and click on "Execute Migration"-Click on the option "Step-by-Step"-Proceed with the migration steps until step 3-After the simulation is processed, the error is raised- Backend Analysis:-This issue results in a dump using steps provided in the KBA 1877585 - How to Debug "Service Call Failed" Error Message in the Backend-MDRS:-An exception occurred-An exception with the type CX_AI_APPLICATION_FAULT occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-ST22 - Application Error-Error in runtime cardinality for BO PDM_SERVICE_PRODUCT, Node VALUATION_QUANTITY_UNIT -Service call failed; report an incident-Cause-Cause for the issue is due to duplicate valuation quantity unit in the service which is visible only in the backend.-Resolution-Data has to be corrected by running the Report: PDM_CORR_INCONSISTANT_VAL_QTY  -Note that only one valuation UOM is allowed for any service product. Somehow more than one duplicate valuation quantity units are getting created. Due to this, while enhancing the service product, error message "service called failed" is getting raised.-Then run the above report to identify the list of Services which have the inconsistent valuation quantity unit data and delete those units.-Execution:-1. Execute the report PDM_CORR_INCONSISTANT_VAL_QTY  in SE38-2. Use button "Display Inconsistent Records" to display the services with duplicates. -3. Use button "delete Inconsistent Records" does the delete.-For these entries, verify the ‘VALUATION_QUANTITY_UNIT’ node data in the backend table "PDM_SRV_D_VQU".-If all services have duplicate entries, then simply use the above report to delete the duplicate valuation quantity unit data.-If any service has more than one valuation quantity unit data with different UOMs then we must check with customer to know the valid "valuation quantity unit" and clear the inconsistent entry.-Note: If you are not aware or not clear about the executing the report, contact ByD Technology PAL or send it to AP-PRD-MAT development.-See Also-1877585 - How to Debug "Service Call Failed" Error Message in the Backend-Keywords-cardinality, service, migration, enhance, create, byd, service call error

Title: Sales Order Line Item Service- Time and Material is Still in Process.
Content: Symptom-Your Sales Order was fully delivered and invoiced. However, the status of the Sales Order is still in process because the line item with item type Service- Time and Material is still in process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Show All Orders and enter XXX in the Find Field. (XXX represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Navigate to the Items Tab.-Select line item YYY (YYY represents the ID of the line item).-You can see that the delivery status of the line item is still in process.-Cause-Check the related Service Confirmation of the line item.-In the Service Confirmation, click the Release button and you can see that the service confirmation was Released Without Order Completion. The option Release With order Completion is still enabled.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Show All Orders and enter XXX in the Find Field.-Navigate to the Items Tab.-Select line item YYY.-Click Conmplete Execution.-This operation completes the line item.-Keywords-sales order, status in process, service, time and material, delivery status, service confimation, order completion-sales order,order completion,service time and material,service completion,in process

Title: Warning Message Determination of Tax Code Failed
Content: Symptom-Warning message "Item XX: Determination of tax code failed. (XX represents item number)" occurs on a Sales Order or Customer Invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view. -Edit the sales order PQR. (PQR represents the Sales Order ID)-(or)-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Search for the Customer Invoice DEF. (DEF represents the Customer Invoice ID)-Click on Edit tab.-System shows warning message "Item XX: Determination of tax code failed".-Cause-Some possible causes for this issue are:-The Tax Rate Type is not maintained on the product master data of the item entered in the document.-A custom Tax Code was maintained on the activity Tax on Goods and Services without a Tax Rate Type:-Hence, there are 2 Tax Codes for the same Tax Event: the SAP standard Tax Code and also the custom added Tax Code. As the Tax Rate Type was not maintained on the custom code, the system cannot determine which one to pick.-Resolution-For cause 1:-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to Products View.-Select and edit the Product XYZ. (XYZ represents the Product ID, which was entered on the item XX).-Navigate to Taxes tab.-Under Product Tax Classification there are the Tax Type and Tax Rate Type with respect to the Country.-Maintain the Tax Type and Tax Rate Type correctly and click on Save.-For cause 2: -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and select Open Activity List.-Open the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Click on Define Tax Codes.-Select the respective tax code for the relevant Tax Event and Country.-Under Details select Add Row.-Maintain the Tax Type and Tax Rate Type.-Click on Save.  -The Tax Code should be determined now with no further issues.   -Keywords-tax code is not automatically determined; Automatic determination failed;

Title: Release Button Greyed Out for Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-Unable to release outbound delivery due to grey out button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for relevant Outbound Delivery ID, here the document is Not Released and the release button is greyed out.-Cause-Open the document flow of outbound delivery, the corresponding warehouse order and warehouse task are not with status Finished.-Resolution-After finishing the corresponding warehouse order and all warehouse tasks, the button is enabled.-See Also-2691994 - Error: "The action RELEASE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident."-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Release, button.

Title: Not Able to Create a New Material Using Copy Functionality With In Preparation Status
Content: Symptom-The requirement is to create a new Material based on the existing one. When using the Copy functionality in the "In Preparation" status, no data is copied into any fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio workcenter-Go to Products view-Go to By Materials subview-Select the Product-Select Copy-> With In Preparation Status-New Material screen opens, but there is no data copied in it in any of the tabs-Cause-This behavior is related to the "Distribution Channel." When copying the Material from the Product Data Work center, ensure the Distribution Channel is maintained in the Business Configuration.-For example, copying a Material ID XXX in the system does not fetch the data because multiple "Distribution Channels" are maintained in the Material, which are not configured.-You may check the Distribution Channels associated with the Product as below:-Go to Product Portfolio workcenter-Go to Products view-Go to By Materials subview-Search for the Product-Select Edit (View All) the Material-Go to Sales tab and observe the Distribution Channel-Resolution-Since certain Products utilize the Distribution Channel, it is necessary to add these Distribution Channels to the system by following the steps outlined below:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Distribution Channel-Select Add Row and maintain the required Distribution Channels with their Descriptions-Now, Copy->With In Preparation Status should work as expected.-Keywords-With In Preparation Status, Distribution Channel, Product Portfolio

Title: Service Performer or Service Execution Team is not Defaulted in a Service Order or Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When you create a sales order with a service item, or a service order.-The parties for service execution (service performer and service execution team) are not defaulted, but you would like to have an automatic proposal.-Or the system proposes a default party, but you expect another one.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order.-Enter the account ABC (ABC represents the identification number of the account).-Enter all relevant data.-Add service XYZ (XYZ represents the identification number of the service).-No service performer or service execution team is found automatically, or the system proposes a service performer or service execution team which is not expected.-Cause-For each party role in each business document there are some steps to determine a party as proposal.-These steps are executed one after the other, until there is at least one party found.-These steps use master data maintained in this system, either responsibility rules or the organizational setup.-If none of the steps find a suitable org center, nothing is defaulted for this party role.-Service Order-Service Performer-Evaluate account responsibilities (set in the Account Management work center ) with the party role 'Service Performer - Service'-Evaluate responsibility 'Resp. to Determine Service Performer - Service Order'-Service Execution Team-Evaluate responsibility 'Resp. to Determine Service Execution Team - Service Order'-Take service org center of service performer-Take single service org center in the system-Sales Order-Service Performer-Evaluate account responsibilities (set in the Account Management work center) with party role 'Service Performer - Sales Orders'-Evaluate responsibility 'Resp. to Determine Service Performer - Sales Order'-Service Execution Team-Evaluate responsibility 'Resp. to Determine Srvc. Execution Team - Sales Order'-Take service org center of service performer-Take single service org center in the system-Resolution-If there is only one org center handling service execution, it is sufficient to assign the organizational function 'Customer Service' there.-To distinguish several service teams and service performers, for example by address data or product categories, you can maintain responsibility rules. Org centers require the organizational function 'Customer Service' to become responsible for services.-Where to maintain this master data-The assignment of the organizational functions of org centers is done in the Organizational Management work center, via the 'Edit Org Structures' link.-Responsibilities for org centers are maintained in the Organizational Management work center, Work Distribution view and the Organizational Work Distribution sub view. The responsibilities for service execution are available in 'Service and Support' Business Area.-The account dependent employee responsibilities are maintained directly in the account master data in the Account Management work center, in the Contacts tab, Relationships and Responsibilities sub tab under the Responsibilities section.-Relevant party roles are 'Service Performer - Sales Orders' and 'Service Performer - Service'.-The other responsibilities for employees are maintained in the Organizational Management work center, Work Distribution view and the Employee Work Distribution sub view. The responsibilities for service execution are available in 'Service and Support' Business Area.

Title: Service Order Cannot be Completed as Invoice Status is Not Started.
Content: Symptom-You complete a Service Process via Service Order and create a Service Confirmation as well as an Invoice, but the Service Order does not complete, because one of the Line Item has the Invoice Status Not Started.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create Service Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Order).-Follow Up on the Service Order with a Service Confirmation.-Change in the Follow Up Service Confirmation the Product ID for one Line Item.-Submit the Service Confirmation with Order Completion.-Invoice the generated Service Confirmation Invoice Request.-Navigate back to Service Order ABC.-Select Tab Spare Parts and Services.-You can see that Line Item 10 is still in Status In Process with Invoice Status Not Started.-When you create a new Service Confirmation, you cannot reference Line Item 10 from Service Order ABC.-Cause-By changing the Product ID in the Service Confirmation, but keeping the Service Order Reference, the Line item is blocked in Service Order ABC.-However when you create the Invoice from the Service Confirmation, the Invoice cannot update the Service Order ABC, because the entered Product ID is not available in the Service Order.-Thus the Invoicing Status remains Not Started.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue and complete the Service Order, you will need to change or cancel the Follow Up Service Confirmation.-To cancel or change the service confirmation follow KBA 2585089.-When creating a new Service Confirmation, you need to use the same Product ID in the Service Confirmation as in the Service Order.-See Also-KBA 2585089 - How To Correct a Service Confirmation When The Status is Not Relevant, click here.-Keywords-Service Order, Service Confirmation, Invoice Status, Complete, Serviceauftrag, Servicerückmeldung, Rechnungsstatus, Abschließen

Title: No Data Migration template or an Excel Add-in for Product Models.
Content: Symptom-Unable to find Product Models Data Migration template or Product Models Excel add-in.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Navigate to Overview View.-In Show select Activities.-In Find search for Migration of Product Models-Not able to find Product Models or data migration.-Go to Product Development Work Center.-Go to Product Models View.-Not able to find Product Models for Excel add-in.-Cause-Currently the system does not support migration template or excel add-in for the Product Models.-Resolution-This is the standard system designed behaviour.-Keywords-Product Models, Data Migration, template, Product Models Excel add-in,Excel add-in.

Title: Unable to Upload Demand Plan Key Figure through Excel Upload for more than 1200 records.
Content: Symptom-When you upload data through excel for a Demand Plan, it is not possible to upload more than 1200 line items in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Demand Planning Work Center.-Select Demand Plans Subview.-Show All Demand Plans By Selection and select Go.-Select a Demand Plan.-Select Upload.-Excel sheet will open. Fill in the mandatory fields.-Perform Save To.-Cause-Only 1200 records can be uploaded per time as there is a Microsoft limitation set on the number of records that can be updated based on the number of columns in each row.-Resolution-Remove the records if it is more than 1200, limit to 1200 records for Excel upload as a best practice and for a better system performance.-This is the expected system designed behavior.-Keywords-Demand Plan,Key Figure,Excel Upload,1200,Microsoft, limit

Title: Unable to Scope Approval For Manual Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-You are trying to enable the approval for customer invoices in your implementation project, but you are unable to finish the project due to following error message:-"Currently unable to finalize these scope changes/ some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data.".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Edit the scope of your project.-Go to step Questions.-Expand Sales ->Customer Invoicing -> Miscellaneous Invoicing.-Check the question: Do you want to set up approval process for manual customer invoices and credit memos?-Advance until next step.-You receive the error:-"Currently unable to finalize these scope changes/ some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data."-Cause-There are documents pending to be invoiced in your system. Hence, the approval process cannot be enabled until you invoice them.-You can check the documents to be invoiced following the next steps:-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Requests.-Select to show: To be invoiced invoice requests.-Resolution-You must invoice all documents before enabling this question.-See Also-KBA 3407086 - Approval Process Cannot be Scoped or Descoped for Manual Customer Invoices and Credit Memos-Keywords-Approval Process; Scope; Manual Customer Invoice

Title: Service Order cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer is facing a process communication error in the Service Order document flow, "Service Order cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Open service order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Click on Edit and go the document flow.-Process Communication Error: Service Order cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)-When you check the XI Message in SRT_Moni in the backend you will find an XI Message which could not be processed with the following details:-Sender Party: ServiceOrderProcessing-Receiver Interface: AccountingSalesAndPurchasingAccountingIn-Error Information: SalesAndPurchasingAccountingNotification XYZ SalesItem YY: Pricing information missing-Please Note: YY represents the line item ID-Cause-When the affected service order was created, only certain line items had price components maintained. Due to this, messages are stuck at the backend, as there is no pricing information maintained for the remaining line items.-Resolution-Ask the customer to make the below dummy changes and revert back to SAP for further re-start of the error messages.-Go to the Service Orders work-center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Search for the affected Service Order.-Click on Edit and go to Pricing and Invoicing tab, choose the pricing sub-tab.-Change the pricing date manually.-Click on Update Pricing.-Now, revert back to the original pricing date and click on update pricing.-Once this is done, please restart the messages in the backend, so that it will have the correct price components.-See Also-1981866 - No Pricing Information in a Sales Document-Keywords-Service Order, Business Transaction, Accounting, Price Components, SalesAndPurchasingAccountingNotification, Pricing information missing, ServiceOrderProcessing

Title: Changes to Requested On Date in a Service Order or Sales Order do not Save.
Content: Symptom-When changing the Requested On date in a Service Order or a Sales Order, the system does not save the changes but reverts back to the original date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use a service order as an example. -Go to the Service Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Service Order Processing View.-Show All Orders and enter XXX in the Find Field. (XXX represents the ID of the Service Order).-Navigate to the General Tab.-Change the Requested On date to another date in the future.-Click Save. -The system automatically reverts back to the original date.-Cause-When creating a new Service Order, you can change the Requested Date and it automatically changes the Requested End Date.-If the Requested End Date was changed manually, the automatic determination stops working.-If the Service Order was created via a Web Service (A2X), the automatic determination of the Requested End Date is not working.-Once the Requested End Date determination is disabled, the Requested Date cannot be set to a later date than the Requested End Date.-In this case the Save fails and the Requested Date is set to the original value.-Resolution-Go to the Service Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Service Order Processing View.-Show All Orders and enter XXX in the Find Field. (XXX represents the ID of the Service Order).-Click on View All.-Navigate to the General Tab. And navigate to Main information Tab.-When changing the Requested On date to a date in the future, also manually adjust the Requested End date to a date after the Requested On date. The changes can then be saved.-Keywords-Service Order, Requested Date, Requested End Date, Wunschtermin, Gefordertes Enddatum, Serviceauftrag-change,service order,requested on date

Title: How to Deactivate Approval Process for an Expense Report
Content: Symptom-How to deactivate the approval process for an Expense Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Under Task Distribution - choose the Approval Processes view.-In the field Show, select All Approval Processes active and scheduled.-Select the approval process for Expense Report.-Click on Edit Validity tab.-Enter the Valid To Date and uncheck the box for Unlimited Validity.-System does not allow and shows an error message: One Process must have an unlimited Valid To date-Cause-This is system behavior that it is not possible to deactivate the approval process for Expense Report once it is set.-Resolution-It is not possible to deactivate the approval process completely for an Expense report, but you can use the below workaround to stop review and approval process for an Expense Report.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the relevant Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune activities.-Show All Activities and Find Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management Activity.-Choose Open.-Go to Edit Audit and Approval Scenarios.-Deselect the check boxes Audit Required and Approval Required for each Country Version for which you don’t want that Expense Reports will be Audited or Approved.-  See Also- 3253428 - Deactivation of Approval Process For Expense Report Does Not Work If the Standard Approval Process is Changed. -Keywords-Expense report, Approval Process, Deactive approval process

Title: Dump Occurs when Copying a Sales Order Created from a Webservice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-When you try to create a Sales Order as a copy of another sales order a dump immediately happens after you click on the Copy button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order workcenter.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Select Sales Order YYY (YYY stands for the impacted Sales Order ID).-Click on the Copy button.-The following dump is triggered immediately:-Error ID: SAPSQL_ILLEGAL_FOR_ALL_ENTRIES-Method: /PAPR/IF_PARTY_CONFIG~GET_COPY_R-Class: /PAPR/CL_PARTY_CONFIG-Cause-There are too many error messages associated to this Sales order about various pieces of Master Data missing such as:-'Currency missing'-'Address inconsistent for location'-'Item : Organizational data missing'-'Party with role Sales Unit missing'-'Address inconsistent for party Ship-To ABC' (ABC regfers to the Ship-to party ID)-'Country in address of Ship-To party missing'-'Address inconsistency: Country code is mandatory'-'Postal code, street, and P.O. box in address of Account and Bill-To party missing'-'City in address of Account and Bill-To party missing'-'Item : Product ID  does not exist'-Resolution-Even if the user ascertains that these errors are not what are preventing the copy from being done, please ensure that most, if not all, of these errors are addressed before trying to copy the Sales Order again to see if the dump still occurs.-Once Master Data has been correctly maintained by the user and you still reproduce the dump, please foward to AP-SLO-SO for further analysis if no further cause can be determined.-Keywords-Dump, system crash, Sales Order, webservice, Master Data, errors, error messages, inconsistent

Title: Collecting logs for SAP Cloud for Customer Outlook Add-in or SAP Business ByDesign Outlook Add-in
Content: Symptom-The logs for SAP Business ByDesign Outlook Add-in or SAP Cloud for Customer Outlook Add-in are required to be collected.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Microsoft Outlook Add-in for SAP Business ByDesign-Microsoft Outlook Add-in for SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-To collect the logs from the Outlook Add-In, follow the steps below:-In the Microsoft Outlook client, navigate to the add-in.-Click the Help button and then Increase Log Level. The Increase Log Level functionality will enable the recording of logs by the add-in while the activity is perform.--For SAP Business ByDesign---For SAP Cloud for Customer---Perform the required activities to reproduce the issue.-Click the Help button and then Show Log File Directory. This will redirect to the folder path where the log files are stored.----The .log file can be found inside the folder path of the below image.---Repeat step 2 now to disable the Increase Log Level. It is important to disable the Increase Log Level function after the above steps to avoid impacts to the performance.-See Also-3452934 - How to Take HTTP logs in Outlook-Keywords-Microsoft Outlook, Outlook add-in, logs, log, addin, Outlook addin, retrieve, integration, client-side

Title: List of Actions Which Cannot be Performed by Users Assigned to PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT
Content: Symptom-List of Actions which cannot be performed in the UI by the User Assigned to PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT work center.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-PDI development user has limited access in relation to UI modifications.-Resolution-Below are the list of actions which cannot be done  by the user who is assigned to PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT work center;-Any of the Key User adaptations (Master Layout and Page Layouts).-Export and import of Layouts.-Creation and edit of Mashups.-Editing and uploading of Form Templates.-Assigning Reports to Work Center.-Access the Project Scope or Activity List of the Implementation Project or a Change Project.-Keywords-PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT; PDI user; Adaptation; Development user;

Title: Short Dump When Downloading Exported Files from Change Collector
Content: Symptom-When attempting to download the file of the Changes in a Change Collector Run, a short dump or maintenance window is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select Change Collector view-Select the Run ABC (Where ABC refers to the Run ID)-Scrolldown and select the Execution sub-tab.-Click on the Execution XYZ (Where XYZ refers to the Execution ID)-Select the Changes tab.-Click on the Export button.-Click on To Microsoft Excel button.-The short dump or maintenance window page is displayed.-Cause-Cause for the issue is that the data volume limits crossed, due to which export functionality is not working. The reason for this is that excel allows a maximum size of 2 GB data. When this size is exceeded the dump occurs. This is an issue with excel which limits the file size to 2 GB.-Resolution-To avoid exceeding the 2 GB size limit, it is necessary to split the condition into smaller groups and then export them.-See Also-2142911 - Cannot Export Large Volume of Data to Excel-Keywords-Dump error, Export to, Change Collector, Excel

Title: Extension Field Where in Which the Content Comes From BC is Not Support in Pricing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-You have an extension field with code list type via PDI and enabled to Pricing, so that the field could be added into the custom price list. The extension field is also enabled in your Business Configuration so that the end user can maintain code list values in the activity when needed. The extension field data type is structure.-It is possible to create custom price lists by using this extension field in item level, but when adding an item into the price list, the system dumps.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service portfolio work center.-Go to the Price lists view.-Choose price list ABC (ABC represents the name of the custom price list).-Create a new price list and go to the Items tab.-Click Add Row.-The system dumps.-Cause-Currently, the system does not support extension fields for which the content comes from the Business Configration. We support extension fields of code types where the content is static.-Resolution-This is a limitation in Pricing.-See details in the attachment.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-[Enter your Keywords here...]

Title: Change Project Merged Failed due to Conflict in Fine-Tuning Settings
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the user to Merge a Change Project, Merge is failed and the Merge Report shows below error messages;-Error Details:-Fine Tuning-Check for fine-tuning conflicts-Technical error occured. Please create an case.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-To find the cause for the issue and what is the fine tuning conflicts between Change project and productive workspace, follow the below steps:-Log in to Backend system.-Execute T-code SLG1.-Here, you can find the below Foreign Key errors;-Foreign key error in node A1S_CRM_PARTY___/PAPR/C_SCHEME; field ID_IN_SCHEME; Application component: AP-RC-GEN-PAP-Value XYZ in setting A1S_CRM_PARTY___/PAPR/C_SCHEME must also be entered in setting A1S_FND_PARTYROLAPC_C_PARTY_RO-Foreign key error in node A1S_CRM_PARTY___/PAPR/C_SCHEME; field ROLE; Application component: AP-RC-GEN-PAP-Value XYZ in setting A1S_CRM_PARTY___/PAPR/C_SCHEME must also be entered in setting A1S_FND_PARTYROLAPC_C_PARTY_RO-In transaction BCE, you can find the description of the BC schema which is in the above error message.-BC Schema: A1S_CRM_PARTY___/PAPR/C_SCHEME --> party Determination Role--BC Schema: A1S_FND_PARTYROLAPC_C_PARTY_RO --> party Role-Note: This case can be forwarded to the component AP-SVO because the Foreign Key error are belongs to Application Development.-Resolution-So, The reason for the Merge failed is that the customer have added Party Role XYZ into the Fine Tuning activity Involved Parties for Sales Quotes but as per system designed, it is required that the user need to define the role code in the fine tuning activity Party Role Definition.--User can add the value it as per the below steps:--Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view.-Highlight the Change Project "Phase 3 implementation" and select "Open Activity List" button.-Go to Fine-Tune phase.-Select "All Activities" in Show field.-Search for the activity "Party Role Definition".-Select "Add to project" button after highlighting the activity "Party Role Definition".-Now, add the code XYZ and save the activity.-Now, you can able to merge the change project.-Keywords-Change Project, Fine-Tuning, Merge, Merge changes, create an case

Title: Report Header Embedded Into Broadcast Reports
Content: Symptom-You would like to know if there is a way to suppress the Header Information sent along with the broadcast report in its content. This info is always included regardless the output format set (csv, xml or html).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Business Analytics.-Go to Broadcast Sub View.-Run manually any of the existent Broadcasts in order to trigger the email delivering.-In the email, the report attached is displayed as XML (visible in the MS Excel) and the Report Header is always displayed at the top.-Cause-There is no way to suppress this header information. From technical point of view, it is coming from the Analytics Runtime as a default for any report.-Additionally, this is a common request for the most customers where need such header information for reference purposes.-Resolution-You can register this as an enhancement request for a future release on the Influence Forum.-Keywords-report name, broadcast, header, remove, exclude, analytics

Title: Technical error AP_INVENTORY 054
Content: Symptom-User is trying to reverse a Warehouse Confirmation but then receives technical error "Technical error AP_INVENTORY 054"-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign All versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center-Go to Monitoring: By Warehouse Order view-Edit the desired warehouse order-Go to Confirmations tab-Select the desired warehouse confirmation-Click on Reverse Confirmation-You receive the error: Technical error AP_INVENTORY 054-Cause-This error is triggered in case the Logistics Areas used on the warehouse confirmations that are already obsolete.-Resolution-No inventory transaction is allowed in obsolete logistics areas. The same for reversal of inventory transactions. The system behaves as expected.-Keywords-Logistics Area, Reverse, Warehouse Confirmation, Technical error AP_INVENTORY 054

Title: Broadcast E-mails are Not Received by the Recipients
Content: Symptom-All Broadcasts in the system show as successful but are not received by the recipients mentioned in the Broadcast.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Broadcasts.-Open the logs for Broadcasts.-The logs for Broadcasts that shows that it is successfully sent to recipients. But e-mails are not received by the recipients mentioned in the Broadcast.-Cause-This is a test system and the E-mail and Fax Settings in the Business Configuration are set to send emails only to one e-mail address. Hence all the e-mails will be sent to the e-mail address mentioned in the Email and Fax Settings.-Resolution-Select Send all e-mails to business partners in E-mail and Fax Settings.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the view Implementation Projects.-Select your new change project and click on Open Activity List.-In the Fine-Tuning phase, search for the activity E-mail and Fax Settings.-Select Send all e-mails to business partners- If broadcasts are still not received in end user mail box, then please help us with a case with all details shared into it.-Keywords-broadcast, reporting, analytics, wrong recipient, test system, wrong e-mail, email-once recipient,one recipient,one email

Title: Error message: File is inactive in solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Title: Error in Put Away Task "Quantity update not possible; reverse in-transit quantities and save"

Title: Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier
Content: Symptom-Many business tasks are being created with the subject: "Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier" (ABC is the Customer Invoice Cancellation's ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-There is one or more open tasks with the subject "Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier"-Open the task and see its description:-- An error occurred:-- Canceling invoice XYZ not possible; invoice not determined (XYZ is the Customer Invoice's ID)-- Execute the task and follow the solution proposal to solve the error. -Cause-The original Customer Invoice XYZ has the Output Channel as E-Mail and Printer. The Cancellation Invoice ABC has the Output Channel as XML and Printer. If a Cancellation Invoice has the Output Channel XML, this means that it is an intercompany invoice (or a third-party invoice) and a Process Message is created which automatically cancels the Intercompany Supplier Invoice.-Since the original Customer Invoice XYZ has the Output Channel as E-Mail and Printer, no Supplier Invoice was created. Hence when the system tries to cancel the Supplier Invoice via the process message of the Cancellation Invoice ABC, the Process Communication Error “Canceling invoice XYZ not possible; invoice not determined” occurs.-Because of that a failed message was triggered in the backend and also the open tasks in the front-end. -Resolution-Please create a case with your permission to cancel the failed message in the backend. -Once the failed message is corrected, the task can be completed, and the tasks will no longer appear in the 'Open Errors with Tasks in the Process Communication Error' view anymore.-For future - this can be avoided by checking the Output Settings before the Cancellation Invoice is released and ensure that the Output Channels are the same as in the Original Invoice.-Keywords-Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice; Customer Invoice; Invoice Cancellation; Supplier Invoice; Output Channel

Title: Change License Type in User Subscription View from Classic License Model to Simple License Model
Content: Symptom-User Requesting to change license model from Old license module to new License module-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Workcenter-Go to User Subscription view-Notice the License Model-Cause-After 2102 release, the License Model has been changed by SAP.-Resolution-If Purchased License Materials by User are in Old License model which is Classic License Model and if user is expecting to change License view to Simple License Model that is New license model.-This cannot be changed directly from SAP Support, since it is not the original source.-The respective CEE or AE should reach out to the Cloud Fulfillment Team via an IT Direct Ticket and request that they change the Entitlement Materials to New License Model (SIMPLE) on the CRM side as needed.-See Also-Refer KBA :3317209 - User Subscription Shows no Subscription | SAP Knowledge Base Articl-Keywords-Change License Model

Title: How to Determine Tax Date
Content: Symptom-You are trying to find a configuration which can perform the determination of tax date in sales documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Tax Date*-No records found-Cause-The system does not have any configuration aimed for the determination of the Tax Date in documents.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-You can consult the following KBA on how to proceed: 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-See Also-KBA: 2902263 - How System Defines the Tax Date on Sales Order-KBA: 2870164 - How is Tax Calculation Date Derived in Customer Invoice-Keywords-Tax Date, Determination, Configuration

Title: Error Occurs While Trying to Create New Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-Error appears while trying to create new purchase request with requestor ABC. -Error - Item 1: Requester ABC not found-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Common Tasks view and select New Purchase Request (Manual)-Enter company and select Add Row-Try to add the Requestor ABC-System shows an error message-Cause-The Employee ID ABC has been created with a space in the beginning. So if we search the employee with *ABC in Personnel Administration work center, then we can see the employee. Also, when we checked the number range for employees in Business Configuration and it seems that the number range is maintained as manual due to which user can create the id with any free text. Due to the reason, system shows the error message "Requester ABC not found"  in the Purchase Order.- Resolution-In order to fix the error , you have to pass the employee id as *ABC and check if the system is accepting the same. Else as employee id is primary key field and cannot be changed, you need to terminate the employee and rehire to mitigate the issue.-Keywords-Error - Item 1: Requester ABC not found

Title: Incorrect Employee Status in OData Response
Content: Symptom-In the process of reading out employment relationships via OData, inconsistencies regarding the status are observed.-The employment relationship of a specific employee was terminated on a certain date, however, the employee still appears as Active during the OData Response.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Choose a specific employee.-Check the Termination Date.-Edit Employment.-Verify that all data indicates termination as of the specified date.-Run the provided OData call.-Find at least one position with an End Date later than the given Termination Date.-Cause-The issue is caused by an inconsistency in the backend position record for the employee.-Resolution-Open a SAP support case and describe the issue.-Specify related steps to reproduce and the OData request payload.-Include permission to reproduce the issue.-Include permission to modify the data and to perform a backend correction (if needed).-See Also-Refer to Knowledge Article KB0644070 for further information on Personnel Administration.-Keywords-OData, employment relationship, backend data correction, employee status, personnel administration, termination date, inconsistency.

Title: Migrated Registered Products are Displayed Incorrectly in the Registered Products View
Content: Symptom-After migrating Registered Products via the Migration tool, the Product ID associated with the Registered Product is displayed incorrectly in the Registered Products view. Is it possible to perform a mass update of Registered Products using the Migration tool?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements workcenter-Go to Registered Products view-Search for Registered Product ID:ABC-Notice the associated Reference ID is incorrect.-Cause-The target conversion value is selected incorrectly during the migration process.-       Resolution-It is not possible to perform a mass update of Registered Products using the Migration tool. The recommended approach is to mark the existing records as obsolete and then migrate the Registered Products with the correct conversion values.-Keywords-Migration, Registered Product, Product ID, Value Conversion, Mass Update

Title: Revenue Recognition Error: Deep merging is not supported
Content: Symptom-The revenue recognition run finishes with the error message "Doc. item XYZ/XX: Deep merging is not supported." m(XYZ/XX refers to a sales order item ID XYZ-XX)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition run.-Execute a revenue recognition run for sales order XYZ (XYZ refers a sales order ID). -It finishes with the error "Doc. item XYZ/XX: Deep merging is not supported."-Cause-Sales order item XYZ-XX uses accrual method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC. -When using accrual method 108, all fix-price sales order items are bundled into one, the leading, sales order item, here XYZ-XX. -To bundle and merge all project values, an internal, only project-based item is generated as well. -So, for each project and all the connected fix-price sales order items there is always only one leading sales order item and only one internal item. -Sometimes, usually because of accrual method changes and when sales order items are created at different times, not one internal item but two internal items are generated, connected to different sales order items, causing the Deep-Merging-not-supported-error. -The internal item can be found in the backend.-But you can also find it in the Manual Revenue Recognition data of any of the fix-price sales order items connected to the associated customer project: -In the Sales Document Items view find, for example, item XYZ-XX.-Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and choose Percentage of Completion.-In the new screen you should see only one line per set of books, for which accrual method 108 is used, showing now sales order item assignment. SO if there are two set of books assigned to your company, there should be only two empty sales order item lines. -If there are more than one empty line per set of books, the data is inconsistent. -Resolution-Send a case to Technical Support with the permission to correct the inconsistency from the backend: -To correct the inconsistency we-1. change the accrual method of all fix price items in the user interface (UI), connected to the affected project. -2. In the backend we then remove all internal items. -3. After,  we reassign accrual method 108 back to all fix-price items. -4. Finally, we verify, in the UI as well as from the backend that only one internal item is generated for the project. -Once corrected, the deep merging error will no longer appear. -See Also-2860171 - Revenue Recognition Run Errors for fix-price Sales Order Items: Use one merge item with code 'replace basic data' only--2845657 - Revenue Recognition Run Error for Fix-Price Sales Order Items Without Accrual Method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC--2479036 - Revenue Recognition Run Error - Doc. item: Only Doc. Items of the Same Profit Center can be Merged-Keywords-Deep Merging, 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC, revenue recognition error

Title: Account Hierarchy Node ID Length Error: "ID XXX not Within a Permitted Number Range; Permitted Ranges are 1-999999 and A-ZZZZZZZZZZ"
Content: Symptom-In the Account Hierarchies view, an error occurs when attempting to input a node ID exceeding 10 digits. The error message displayed is: "ID xxxxxxxxxxx not Within a Permitted Number Range; Permitted Ranges are 1-999999999 and A-ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management workcenter-Go to Account Hierarchies view-Select New-Choose Hierarchy-Enter the Node ID upto 11/12 digits-Select Save-Observe the error: -ID xxxxxxxxxxx not within a permitted number range; permitted ranges are 1-999999999 and A-ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ-Save failed-Cause-Extending the number of digits entered in the Node ID is not feasible, as per the system constraints.-Resolution-According to our standard system design, the number range for the Account hierarchy allows for up to 10 digits when the Node ID is manually entered. However, when the node ID is entered in alphanumeric format, it can accommodate up to 20 characters.-Keywords-Account Hierarchies, Node ID, Number Ranges, Digits, Alphanumeric

Title: Is it Possible to edit the values in PO acknowledgement when the preceding documents are completed?
Content: Symptom-The question here is to understand the feasibility of making changes or updating the price or any other values in the PO acknowledgement from backend, where the preceding documents like Outbound delivery is released ; Supplier Invoice is paid ; Clearing document is completed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Purchase Order is created and ordered with relevant details. -From this Purchase order, a PO acknowledgement is created which is not matching the details in the Purchase Order. Supplier Invoices are created and paid with wrong values. -Is it now possible to change the data in PO acknowledgement which will reflect in preceding documents? -Resolution-Corresponding documents like Supplier Invoice and Clearing are paid and completed. At this point, we will not be able to make any changes in the PO acknowledgement document. -The only way ahead is to cancel / revoke all the preceding documents and then create a new PO acknowledgement for the Purchase Order with the correct values and proceed further. -Keywords-Modify PO acknowledgement from backend, incorrect values in PO acknowledgement

Title: 'Individual material AAA is only assigned to retired fixed assets' Error When Trying to Void Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Unable to void supplier invoice due to error: 'Individual material AAA is only assigned to retired fixed assets'-AAA means the individual material ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for supplier invoice ID ABC (ABC means the supplier invoice ID).-Click the Void button.-The error message 'Individual material AAA is only assigned to retired fixed assets' is displayed.-Cause-The issue arises because the individual material contained in the invoice is tied to a Retired fixed asset.-Resolution-The fixed asset needs to be capitalized before performing the voidance of supplier invoice ABC. This can be done by removing the Deactivation Date of the fixed asset.-To identify the fixed asset via the individual material and change status from Retired to Capitalized, below steps can be followed:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Asset view.-Filter for fixed asset with Individual Material ID AAA and click Go. -Fixed Asset ID DEF, which statu Retired, is found (DEF means the fixed asset ID).-Open the asset and click View All.-Under Master Data tab -> Life Cycle subtab, the Deactivation Date is displayed.-Remove the Deactivation Date for all the relevant Set of Books and save the changes: this changes asset's status from Retired to Capitalized.-Now the supplier invoice can be voided.-After the voidance, the Deactivation Date can be entered again in the asset, which will change its Status back to Retired.-See Also-KBA 3299828 - Error 'Individual material XYZ is only assigned to retired fixed assets' During Goods and Services Receipt Posting -Keywords-Supplier invoice cancellation, void, error, Individual material, retired fixed assets, D25E13412024, IMAT ID 100000367, Fixed asset ID 27, Retired, Capitalized, Voided, test tenant, Production tenant.

Title: Exchange Rate Error Appears in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Error occurs while trying to order purchase order. -Error - Exchange rate Zloty/Euro on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and click on Check button-Error appears-Cause-User has selected a wrong currency instead of actual currency for the company. Hence the error occurs. -Resolution-Since the user has accidentally selected the wrong currency, system is looking for a currency conversion. To fix the error, you need to select the correct company currency manually in the purchase order and order to the supplier. -Keywords-Exchange rate Zloty/Euro on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion

Title: Issue with Confirmation Update Run Unconfirming Previously Confirmed Goods
Content: Symptom-System removes confirmations on existing customer demands. -This behavior is observed after the Confirmation Update Run is executed-Environment-Customer Requirement-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center-Navigate to the Customer Demand view-Search and Select the relevant customer demand document-Observe that the item which was confirmed sufficiently is not confirmed any more after the confirmation update run was executed-Cause-Confirmation Update Runs deletes the existing confirmations on all the items in the orders which are selected, for availability check by the run-The Availability check is executed on all the selected order items in the sequence maintained as per Sorting Parameters in the confirmation update run-Resolution-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center-Navigate to the Automated Actions view and choose the option Confirmation Update Runs-Select the relevant run and choose the Edit button-Select the tab Net Change Run and select the field Product with Availability-Relevant Changes Only-Save and Close the run-Set the status of the run to Active-Once the mentioned field is marked and run Active, the orders for which the products have any changes in their stock situation only will be picked up for availability check.-See Also-Keywords-Confirmation Update Run, Outbound Logistics Control, Customer Demand, Availability Check, Net Change Run, Product with Availability-Relevant Changes Only

Title: No Cost Center Assignment for G/L Account (COSEXP) in Goods and Service Receipts
Content: Symptom-You notice that for G/L Accounts of type Costs or expenses (COSEXP) some journal entries show a profit center but no cost center.-You are using a Reporting Principle involving mandatory Profit Center assignments (e.g. Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg or Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg, clearing).-This is particularly observed for Goods and Service Receipts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Service Receipts work center. -Open the Receipts and Returns view and filter for All Documents.-Search for Goods and Service Receipt XYZ.-Via View All enter the Document Flow.-Open the corresponding journal entry by clicking the journal entry item.-For debited COSEXP g/l account (for example: Expenses for Finished Goods) a Profit Center ID is assigned, however, the field Cost Center ID shows blank.-Cause-Whether a Cost Center is assigned for g/l accounts (Type: COSEXP) will depend on the Account Assignment for the Purchase Order Item.-An Account Assignment referring to a Sales Document (Customer Contract, Sales Order, Service Order) - will not result in a direct Cost Center assignment for the Goods and Service Receipt, while a Profit Center is derived.-Resolution-This is the expected and accepted system behaviour.

Title: Product Quantities are Different Between Report Inventory Balance and Report Physical Inventory Count
Content: Symptom-Product quantities are not matching between Report Inventory Balance and Report Physical Inventory Count for the same Site.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to Design Reports View.-Search for Physical Inventory Count.-Pass Selection parameters such as desired product ID and Site ID.-Can see Product Actual quantity.-Then,-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to Design Reports View.-Search for Inventory Balance Report.-Pass Selection parameters such as desired product ID and Site ID.-Can see Ending quantity which is not equal to the Actual quantity in Report Physical Inventory Count.-Cause-There is a difference of quantities between the two reports due to backdated posting of warehouse confirmations.-Resolution-Inventory Balance report works on the actual execution date and not the creation date, hence there might be quantities difference in both reports. This is a standard system behavior. -Keywords-Inventory Balance report, difference quantities, Physical Inventory Count, Ending quantity, Actual quantity

Title: Error Message: 'Bank Account Number Must Not Have Less Than 12 Characters' in the Supplier Master Data
Content: Symptom-When adding Bank Account Number under Financial Data tab in Supplier master data, system gives the error message: -Error Message: Bank Account number must not have less than 12 characters-Country: Belgium-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier work center.-Search for the required Supplier ID:-Go to the Financials Tab -> Bank Data tab.-Select Add Row and add Bank Account Number and Other required fields.-Error Message shown: "Bank Account number must not have less than 12 characters” -Cause-The Payee Bank Account Number is not valid on the Bank Account Number. -According to the Belgium IBAN format, the Bank Account Number derived from the IBAN is the 12 Digit Account number:-The Bank Account has format as BB-RRRR-AAAAAAA-SSS-B - Bank-R-Branch-A-Account-S-Suffix-Only the Account and Suffix should be entered in the Bank Account Number field. The Bank and Branch are derived by the system from the National Bank Code.-Resolution-Maintain the correct Bank Account Number in the below steps:-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers sub view.-Search and select the required Supplier.-Go to the Financials Tab -> Bank Data tab.-Enter the correct 12 Digit Bank Account number.-See Also-Please refer to the below link, to check what is the IBAN Standard for Belgium-https://www.xe.com/ibancalculator/sample/?ibancountry=belgium-Transfer Wise provides a portal, when you can verify your bank account number.IBAN Number: Find, check or calculate your IBAN -https://wise.com/in/iban/-Keywords-Bank Account number Financial data, Supplier master data

Title: System Crashes Upon Posting Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-System crashes upon attempting to post payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Payment Management work center.-Open the Payment Allocation view.-Find and open Payment Allocation XXX (XXX means the Payment Allocation ID).-Notice that Open Amount is zero.-Click the Post button.-The system crashes.-Cause-One possible cause for the issue is the existence of duplicate exchange rate data sets having the same external key (Unit Currency, Quoted Currency, Quotation Date/Time). This should not occur and leads to inconsistencies in the system.-To confirm the cause, proceed as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Common Tasks view -> Edit Exchange Rates.-Click View Exchange Rate History button.-Click 'Click here to execute the query'-System will return at least one error as the one below:-"Data inconsistent - create case - internal key ABC"-ABC means the internal key.-Resolution-Open a case to SAP Support giving your permission to delete all exchange rates duplicate entries from backend system.-Once the entries are deleted, both issues will be resolved, meaning the errors in the Exchange Rate History view and the system crash upon posting payment allocation XXX.-See Also-Internal KBA 2251087 - Error: Data inconsistent - create case - internal key XYZ.-Keywords-posting, bank statement, error, duplicate, exchange rate, data inconsistent, internal key, backend correction, Payment Allocation.

Title: Task: Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Many business tasks are being created with the subject: "Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier" (ABC is the Customer Invoice Cancellation's ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Show: All Items. -There are numerous tasks with subject "Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier". -Open the task and see the description:-- An error occurred:-- Canceling invoice XYZ not possible; invoice not determined (XYZ is the Customer Invoice's ID)-- Execute the task and follow the solution proposal to solve the error.-Cause-The original Customer Invoice XYZ has the Output Channel as E-Mail and Printer. The Cancellation Invoice ABC has the Output Channel as XML and Printer. If a Cancellation Invoice has the Output Channel XML, this means that it is an intercompany invoice (or a third-party invoice) and a Process Message is created which automatically cancels the Intercompany Supplier Invoice.-Since the original Customer Invoice XYZ has the Output Channel as E-Mail and Printer, no Supplier Invoice was created. Hence when the system tries to cancel the Supplier Invoice via the process message of the Cancellation Invoice ABC, the Process Communication Error “Canceling invoice XYZ not possible; invoice not determined” occurs.-The failed message triggered in the backend should have the information below: -Sender: CustomerInvoiceProcessing    -Receiver: SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoicingIn    -Description: Cancellation of invoice XYZ not possible; invoice not determined-When trying to restart it, the message is not delivered. -The system keeps creating the tasks because of this failed message. The customer's user is trying to cancel the Customer Invoice; however, the system couldn't find the related Supplier Invoice document. That's why the error is being triggered in the backend and in the tasks. -Resolution-Please send this to development team's analysis. They should be able to cancel the failed message with customer's permission. Then the tasks will not be created anymore.-After that the message below can be sent to the customer: -"Since there is no Supplier Invoice to be cancelled via the process message, we cancelled the process message now. Then the Task “Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier” can be completed now and should not appear under the 'Open Errors with Tasks in the Process Communication Error' view anymore."-See Also-KBA: 3543888 - Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice ABC Sent by Supplier-Keywords-Solve Document Inconsistency in Invoice Request message referring to unknown Invoice; Customer Invoice; Invoice Cancellation; Supplier Invoice; Output Channel; CustomerInvoiceProcessing; SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoicingIn

Title: Unable to Delete Registered Products in Status In Preparation
Content: Symptom-Registered Products in status 'In Preparation' cannot be deleted.-No 'Delete' button is visible for Registered Products in status 'In Preparation'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Service Entitlements work center.-Select the Registered Products view.-Select the Registered Product.-Observe that there is no 'Delete' button, even if the Registered Product is in status 'In Preparation'.-Cause-The system does not currently support the deletion of Registered Products, even if they are in status 'In Preparation'.-Resolution-If you don't intend to use the Registered Products anymore, you can mark them as Obsolete or Blocked.-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Select the Registered Products view.-Select the Registered Product.-Click on the 'Change Status' button and select the option 'Obsolete' or 'Blocked' as per the requirement.-Note: If the Registered Product is in status 'In Preparation', it needs to be first set to 'Active' and then to 'Obsolete' or 'Blocked'.-See Also-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Registered Products, Delete, In Preparation, Change Status, Obsolete, Blocked.

Title: Goods Return Is Created By User That Doesn't Have Access Rights To Goods And Services Receipts Work Center
Content: Symptom-The user with no access to Goods and Services Receipts' work center is able to create or cancel Goods and Services Receipts. They can also create Goods Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the system with user XYZ (XYZ is the user that does not have access to Goods and Services Receipts' work center).-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view.-Click in the link: Track my Shopping Carts.-Filter by 'Shopping Carts - Completed'.-Open shopping cart ABC (ABC is the Shopping Cart's ID).-Click in View All button.-Click in Receipts and Returns button. -Click in "New Goods Return" button or "Cancel Document" button. -Click in Post button.-The user was able to create and post the Goods Return OR the user was able to cancel the Goods and Services receipt.-It was not expected that XYZ's user would be able to do those actions.-How to check the user's Access and Restrictions:-Go to Application user management work center.-Go to Business users view. -Search for user XYZ.-Click in Edit button and select Access Rights.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment tab. -The work center SRM_GOODSSERVICERECEIPTS is not assigned to XYZ's user.-Cause-Even though the scoping question "Do you want to allow your employees to confirm the receipt of goods or the completion of services?" is not scoped, the user is indeed able to create and post a Return and able to cancel the Goods document. This scoping question affects only the use of 'Confirm Delivery' button, that is in the Shopping Cart screen. If this scoping question is scoped, any user with access to a Shopping Cart is able to create a Goods and Services receipt.-However, if this question is not scoped, the user is still able to click in the 'Receipts and Returns' button. So the user with access to Shopping Carts is able to create Returns and cancel Goods documents.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.-In case the scoping questions has to be unscoped, the steps below can be followed:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Click in Edit Project Scope button.-Click in Next button until reach step 4 'Questions'.-Expand Purchasing.-Expand Self-Service Procurement.-Select Shopping Carts.-Uncheck the flag for the question "Do you want to allow your employees to confirm the receipt of goods or the completion of services?".-Save it. -See Also-Help Portal: Create a Goods Return for a Shopping Cart-Help Portal: Cancel a Goods and Services Receipt for a Shopping Cart-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipt, Shopping Cart, Scoping Question, Access, Restrictions, SRM_GOODSSERVICERECEIPTS, Goods Return, Authorization

Title: Tax Code is Not Updated After Changing the Tax Country in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-In the sales order document, the default tax country determined in the item line is for example CA and tax code is 501. You manually change the tax country to US, and find the tax code remains 501 while you expect the tax should be 515 for export.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center view.-Open the sales order ABC.-Go to Items tab, select line 10. Notice that the ship from is in country US and ship to is in country CA. It is an export transaction.-Go to the Taxes tab, the tax country is CA and tax code is 501 for GST tax. You manually change the tax country to US and expect the tax code 515 for export could be re-determined. But system remains the tax code as 501.-Cause-This is because you have maintained an External Tax Determination rule XYZ which matches the order ABC. So the tax code 501 is determined from the rule. (XYZ represents the ID of the rule)-When creating the sales order, the taxation is done based on complete document and the tax code was enforced to 501 as per the External Tax Determination rule, that is reason after changing the tax country from CA to US tax code is not getting updated. -You can check the External Tax Determination rules by the steps below.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity "External Tax Determination for Goods and Services". -There is a rule XYZ, the order ABC matches the rule. and the enforced tax code is 501. -The condition maintained as following, (as an example)-In Location Details:-Ship-From: single country US.-Ship-To: Single country CA, state AB.-Tax Code Details:-Use Dedicated Tax Code: ticked.-Tax Code: 501.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. -You can manually change the tax code in the sales order.-Keywords-tax code; tax country; external tax determination.
