The template becomes visible only when France is selected using the Advanced Filter.-Note: This issue may also occur with other form templates for different combinations of country and language variants.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business Bydesign:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Access the Form Template Maintenance view-Select "Click here to execute the query" to load all the templates-Locate the form template group: ABC-Here no template is available for Country France and Language French-Select Advanced Filter and in the template group, select form template: ABC and Language: France-The form template for French/France appears-In SAP Cloud for Customer:--Go to Administrator work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view-Select "Click here to execute the query" to load all the templates-Locate the form template group: ABC-Here no template is available for Country France and Language French-Select Advanced Filter and in the template group, select form template: ABC and Language: France-The form template for French/France appears-Cause-There is a backend inconsistency.-Resolution-Create an incident to AP-RC-OUT development team in order to resolve the inconsistency from the backend.-Keywords-Form Template, Country Specific, Language Variant, Country Variant, Template Group, Advanced Filter, UI

Title: Employee Time from XX.XX.XXXX to YY.YY.YYYY Overlaps with Another Record
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to change the work schedule of an employee, error message "Employee time from XX.XX.XXXX  to YY.YY.YYYY overlaps with another record" is raised (where XX.XX.XXXX and YY.YY.YYYY represent different dates)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Access the Employees work center view-Locate the relavant employee-Select it and click Edit-Navigate to the Time Profile tab, then to the Work Schedule sub-tab-Assign a work schedule to the employee-Click Save-Cause-The issues may be caused by backend inconsistencies and might need a backend correction.-To confirm this:-Access backend transaction SESFTS-In the Load BO by Proxy Name field, enter TIMX_AGREEMENT-Click the arrow next to the folder icon, then select Load by Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-Enter the ID of the affected employee in the Employee_IdentificationEmployeeID/content field, then click the Continue (green check mark) button to execute the query.-Using the Navigate button, go to the ITEM node-Select the row for the time profile whose dates match the affected one in the UI-Navigate to ITEM_PERIOD_PROVISIONS, then to ITEM_PERIOD_PLAN_WORKTIM-Here the EMPLOYEE_TIME_UUID-CONTENT is empty, showing only zeroes.-Resolution-Forward to the SRD-HR-TLM development for the necessary backend correction.-(If the correction fails during valuation, there may be an insufficient balance in an account, e.g. a zero balance in vacation quota, which prevents the posting of a time recording. Development should be able to identify the relevant account, so that on customer side, sufficient quota can be added to the relevant account, or the time recording can be deleted.)-Keywords-Employee Time,  Overlaps with Another Record, Time Profile, Work Schedule

Title: Stock Transfer Order: No Journal Entry Created for Warehouse Confirmation
Content: Symptom-A stock transfer order is created in the system to transfer goods from Business Residence A to Business Residence B of the company. However, in the process of the stock transfer order, no journal entry is created for the outbound warehouse confirmation or the related goods and activity confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics Control - Customer Demand view.-Search for the specific stock transfer order.-Select the order, edit and view all.-Navigate to the document flow tab.-Extend all.-Locate to the outbound warehouse confirmation and observe that there is no journal entry associated with it.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-The journal entry is only generated for the inbound warehouse confirmation. In the journal entry of the inbound warehouse confirmation, the inventory amount is credited to the original business residence and debited to the new business residence.-See Also-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, Journal Entry, Warehouse Confirmation, Outbound Journal, In-Transit Stock, Inbound Warehouse Confirmation, Outbound Warehouse Confirmation, Business Residence.

Title: Requested Date in Intercompany Sales Order is Equal to the Delivery Date in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In intercompany scenario, when the Delivery Data is changed in the Purchase Order, the Requested Date of the Sales Order is changed too. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to change the Delivery Date in the Purchase Order:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the intercompany Purchase Order's ID). -Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the item. -Navigate to Basic Data subtab. -Change the Delivery Date to "01.01.2099". -Steps to check the change in the Sales Order:-Navigate to Document Flow. -Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ is the intercompany Sales Order's ID). -Navigate to Items tab. -Select the item.-Navigate to Details subtab. -The Requested Date is the same as the Delivery Date maintained in the Purchase Order. -Cause-In intercompany scenario, the Delivery Date of the Purchase Order is carried to the Sales Order by default. The Requested Date in both general and item level will have the same value as in the Delivery Date of the Purchase Order. -However, if the Delivery Date is changed in the Purchase Order (after the creation of the Sales Order), the Sales Order is changed in item level only. -Resolution-System is working as expected. -The Requested Date in the Sales Order, in Header level, can still be manually changed. -See Also-KBA: 2690132 - The sales Order Requested Date is not reflected in Third-party Purchase Order if the Delivery date is Manually Changed in Purchase Order-Keywords-Delivery Date, Requested Date, Intercompany, Sales Order, Purchase Order

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-A KUT field is created and visible in the personnel file of employees.-But for some employees it is not visible and cannot be added.-This issue relates to employees of some countries only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select an employee.-Select Edit to open the personnel file.-Navigate to Employment > Work Agreement.-The KUT field is not visible.-Open Key user Adaption-In Details section, + extension field is not available for adaption-Cause-The field needs to be published country-specific.-Resolution-Add the field to at least one employee of every localized country.-In case non-localized countries are in use, it should be sufficient to add the field to only one employee of any of the non-localized countries. An according HF is planned to be implemented with release version 2502.-For reference, see also KBA 0002905703 - How to Work with Extension Scenarios.-Keywords-KUT field, Business Users, Work Agreement, Employee, Visibility, Country-specific, Key-user, Adaption, Extension Fields, SAP BYD, Personnel Administration, custom field

Title: Deviation function is no longer accepting automatically
Content: Symptom-Automatic Set up for Accepting Deviations is not working.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to the Task Control View.-Show All Tasks and select a relevant Put Away Task.-Click Confirm.-Navigate to the Line Items tab, and go to the section: Quantities.-Enter an Actual Quantity less than the Planned Quantity.-Maintain the Deviation Reason: Missing part.-Click Save.-Go to the Monitoring view.-System has generated a new task with deviation which it needs to be manually accept. It is expected the system to automatically accept the Deviation as it has previously been configured to handle it this way.-Cause-When checking Business Configuration, it is possible to see that for the Inbound process the "Deviation approval by user" is maintained for the Deviation code "Missing part".-Resolution-To enable the automatic Acceptance of Deviation for these Codes, make the necessary adjustment in Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview.-Find the activity "Deviation Code for Warehousing" and Open it.-Now, select "Assign Deviation Codes for Warehousing".-It is possible to see all the Assigned Deviation Codes.-For automatically accepting the deviation code once the task gets confirmed, select System Deviation Approval using the drop down for the relevant Code and process.-Click Save.-See Also-KBA: 2452146 - How to Maintain Deviation Code for Warehousing and Automatic Set up for Accepting Deviations For All Tasks-Keywords-Deviation, accept, automatic, automatically, Pick, Put Away, Logistics, Tasks, Monitoring

Title: Error message "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Error message "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XYZ in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval" when trying to create a Supplier Invoice from a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoice Entry.-Choose Show: All Orders to Be Invoiced.-Select the relevand Purchase Order.-Click on New Invoice.-See the error message "Item XYZ: Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XXX in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval." appears. (where XYZ means the Item ID and XXX means the Purchase Order ID).-or-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for the Invoice ABC -In exceptions tab , error is "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order XXX in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval"-But, the purchase order XXX is not in approval-Cause-This error may occur due to lock issue.-Resolution-Issue can be corrected in the backend with the following steps:-Go to transaction SE38.-In Program enter the report: /SRMAP/PI_RECONCILIATION.-Execute the Report  (F8).-Select Reconciliation for specified Business Object Instance.-In Business Object Type Code enter 001.-In Business Object ID enter the Purchase Order ID.-In Remote Process Component Namespace enter http://sap.com/xi/AP/SupplierInvoicing/Global.-In Remote Process Component Name enter SupplierInvoiceProcessing.-Aspect can be left blank.-Click on Execute (F8).-See the message Reconciliation processing executed successfully.-See Also- 3050587 - You are Getting Error on Supplier Invoice: "Posting not possible; referenced purchase order in supplier invoice contains values that are in approval"-Keywords-Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice, Referenced purchase order in approval, supplier invoice exception

Title: Web Service Does Not Return Any Value
Content: Symptom-When using web service ManagePurchaseOrderMaintainBundle, it returns zero values in the log even though there are expected results. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The first step is to download the WSDL file: -Go to Application and User Management work center. -Go to Service Explorer view.-Select 'Read purchase order'.-Click in 'Download WSDL' button.-WSDL was downloaded. -Second step in the tool SOAP UI: -Open SOAP UI.-In File, select 'New SOAP Project'. -In Initial WSDL, impost WSDL downloaded before. -Expand 'binding'. -Expand ManagePurchaseOrderMaintainBundle. -Double click in Request1. -Insert the payload. -Add the user in 'Auth section'. -Click in the green icon (Submit request). -The response is: -<soap-env:Envelope xmlns:soap-env="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">-   <soap-env:Header/>-   <soap-env:Body>-      <n0:PurchaseOrderByIDResponse_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global" xmlns:prx="urn:sap.com:proxy:ABC">-         <Log/>-      </n0:PurchaseOrderByIDResponse_sync>-   </soap-env:Body>-</soap-env:Envelope>-(ABC is the value given by SOAP UI and is specific for each run.)-It was expected that the Response would a payload with all the details of the Purchase Order. -Cause-The tag below is being used in the payload:-<wsse:Security soap:mustUnderstand="1" xmlns:wsse="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd"/> -This tag is related to WS-Security, which is a standard for securing SOAP messages. The <wsse:Security> tag is used to include security information, such as authentication (username and password), tokens, or digital signatures, in the SOAP message. The attribute soap:mustUnderstand="1" means that the SOAP processor receiving this message must understand and process the security defined in this tag. If the processor does not understand it, it must return an error.-The possible reasons that the query didn't return any results are:-Cause 1: Authentication or permission issues:-When the <wsse:Security> tag is added, it may be providing credentials (such as security tokens or passwords). If the authentication is invalid or the server cannot process the credentials correctly, the request might fail, resulting in an empty response or an error.-Make sure it is being maintained the correct credentials in the security header (such as <wsse:UsernameToken> or other authentication elements).-Cause 2: The server is not configured to understand the security:-The soap:mustUnderstand="1" attribute means that the server receiving the request must be able to understand the security header. If the server is not properly configured to handle these headers, or if it cannot process the security, it may ignore the request or return an error.-This could cause the response to be empty or an error, depending on the server's implementation.-Cause 3: Interference with the request:-Using the security tag may interfere with how the request is handled by the server. If the security is incorrectly configured or if the payload is improperly formatted, the server might discard the request or return an unexpected response, such as an empty result set.-In some cases, the server may return zero results as a way of "not processing" the request when it detects something wrong with the security.-Resolution-Please check if one of the resolutions below is applicable to the scenario: -Resolution 1: Check the server logs-If possible, check the logs of the server receiving the request. There may be error or warning messages indicating that the security header was not processed correctly.-Resolution 2: Test without the security tag-Try removing the <wsse:Security> tag and see if the query returns results. This will help confirm if the issue is related to security or something else in the request.-Resolution 3: Verify security parameters-If the security header includes information such as an authentication token or username and password, ensure that these details are correct and match what the server expects.-Resolution 4: Validate the security configuration-If the user has access to the service's documentation or configuration, check if the WS-Security header is being implemented correctly and if the server is prepared to handle the credentials being provided.-Keywords-ManagePurchaseOrderMaintainBundle, WSDL, SOAP, Payload, WS-Security

Title: Not Able to Approve the Price List Due to the Approval Task is Cancelled
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The price list ABC is with In Approval status, it is awaiting for the reaction from the approver. The approver checked the approval task of this price list, but found the approval task is cancelled. Therefore it is not possible to approve the price list and release it.-* ABC represents the ID of the price list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio - Price Lists (Gross) view.-Show Distribution Chain Price List (Gross) as example.-Select price list ABC. This price list is with approval status as In Approval.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Task Management.-Show all the tasks and search the price list ABC, there are some approval tasks shown, but the last approval task for the price list is cancelled status and there is no any other Open or In Process approval task for the user to process the price list.-Cause-So far, it is unknow that why the approval task was cancelled. But due to the approval task status, it is not able to approve the price list and release the price list in frontend.-Resolution-The case need to be forwarded to development team in component AP-PMD-SPL for the backend correction after getting permission from customer.-Development colleague will manually change the approval status to Approved. The release button will be then enabled and the user could further release the price list in frontend.-Keywords-price list; cannot be approved; In Approval; BTM task cancelled.

Title: Steps to Attach the Proforma Invoice to the Sales Order Document
Content: Symptom-This KBA article explains how to attach a proforma invoice to the Sales Order output document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work center-Go to Sales Order view-Select the Sales Order XXXX-Navigate to the Attachments tab-Notice, the Pro Forma invoice is not attached in the Attachment tab and is neither attached to the Invoice Document released.-Cause-The Pro Forma Invoice was not saved. -In addition, the Include in Output option was not selected. As a result, the Pro Forma Invoice was neither attached to the Sales Order nor included in the Sales Order output document.-Resolution-To attach the pro forma invoice to the Sales Order document, follow the below steps:-Go to Sales Order Workcenter-Go to Sales Order view-Select the Sales Order XXXX and choose Pro Forma Invoice-A preview will get generated and now Select "Close"-The details of Pro Forma invoice will be displayed-Select “Save and Close” or “Save”-Go to to View All-Under Attachments tab you can see the Pro Forma Invoice attached-Go to Edit Output Settings, navigate to the Attachment tab-Check in "Include in Output" checkbox and submit the document.-The Pro Forma Invoice will be sent to the recipient along with the Sales Order document.-See Also-SAP Help Document: Create a Pro Forma Invoice | SAP Help Portal -Keywords-Pro Forma Invoice, Sales Order, Include In Output, Attachment

Title: Process Communication Error "Technical error APLC_LER 030" Between Outbound Delivery Request and Logistics Execution Request
Content: Symptom-In terms of Project Stock Order Scenario for Project XXX,  find a process communication error exists between Outbound Delivery Request and Logistics Execution Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to Process Communication Errors View.-Select Open Errors with Incidents.-You observe a process communication error as below.-Sending Document:Outbound Delivery Request-Receiving Document: Logistics Execution Request-Main Error: Technical error APLC_LER 030-Cause-The business user ignores the project or its project task is closed and continues to cancel the line items of the project stock order. The message gets blocked from updating the business document.-Our development team will add logic to prevent users from doing so in a future release.-Resolution-Before the logic is promoted, please ask the business user to check the project task status of the project stock order before doing the cancel action.-To fix the affected document, you need to change the project status by following steps:-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Navigate to Projects View.-Select Project XXX and edit it.-Go to Product- Project stock order subtab.-Find the Project Stock Order, you will understand the corresponding Project Task YYY.-Go to Project Plan- Gantt Chart subtab.-Select Project XXX, make sure that the status is not completed or closed.-Find the Project Task YYY in Search Text filed, make sure that the status is not completed or closed.-Save.-Once the project and its task get restarted, please submit a case so that SAP support can restart the stuck message in the backend.-Keywords-CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT, Technical error APLC_LER 030, Project Stock Order,  Project Task, Status.

Title: Error" Please try resuming your work .If you still face issue. Report an Incident " While Editing Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-User facing dump while editing Supplier invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing WorkCenter-Navigate to Invoice and Credit memo View-Choose Invoice ID-Select View All-Select the Items tab-Dump: Please try resuming your work .If you still face issue. Report an Incident -Cause-User made some changes once invoices got posted.-Resolution-Once the B2B invoices are created, do not make any changes to it after it got posted. -NOTE:-If the invoices are already posted , From SAP end we will not be able to figure out the root cause.-If the issue is still occurring, please help to recreate the scenario with the new invoices in your test system and forward case to SAP for further Investigation.-Keywords-posted invoice, supplier invoice dump

Title: Austria SEPA Payment Files
Content: Symptom-According to the What's New in SAP Business ByDesign, there is a change in the SEPA payment files for Austria as of the release 2411, however, the payment file remains the same of the previous versions.--KBA is valid only for Austria-Whats New in SAP Business ByDesign-Category: Legal and Compliance-Business Area: Financial Management-Functional Localization: Austria-Title: Austria SEPA Payment Files Updated to Exclusively Use the Structured Address Data-Description: As per the legal changes from the European Payments Council, with rulebook 2023 effective from Oct, 2025, all the payment service users need to provide structured address data in their payment files. To reflect this change in SAP Business ByDesign,the following Austria Templates relevant to SEPA payment files are updated.--SEPA Credit Transfer-SEPA Direct Debit-ISO 20022 Bank Transfer-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Payment Monitor view-Search for the desired payment and click the Outbound file ID hyperlink-Click View All-Go to Attachment tab and Download the payment file-Open the document-The address details are not structured-Cause-The Payment Medium Format Code assigned for the bank is still using the "old" version.-E.g.: "74 - SEPA Credit Transfer"-Resolution-Assign the new Payment Medium Format Code for your Austrian Bank.-Payment Medium Format Code: "100 - XSLT Bank Transfer" for AUSTRIA ISO20022 Bank Transfer - Transformation Name: PAYFOCTATSTMPLV02 for Austria ISO20022 Bank Transfer-Payment Medium Format Code: "102 - XSLT SEPA Bank Transfer" for AUSTRIA SEPA Credit Transfer - Transformation Name: PAYFOCTATSTMPLV01 for Austria SEPA Credit Transfer-Payment Medium Format Code: "103 - XSLT SEPA Direct Debit" for AUSTRIA SEPA Direct Debit - Transformation Name: PAYFODTATSTMPLV01 for Austria SEPA Direct Debit-Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Overview view-Search for the activity "Common Master Data Configuration" and open it-Select the Configuration Type Code "5 - Transformation Repository" and click Edit-Filter by the Country/Region "AT - Austria"-There are 3 Transformations for Austria-Transformation Name: PAYFOCTATSTMPLV01 for Austria SEPA Credit Transfer-Transformation Name: PAYFOCTATSTMPLV02 for Austria ISO20022 Bank Transfer-Transformation Name: PAYFODTATSTMPLV01 for Austria SEPA Direct Debit-Take a note of the transformation name according to your needs-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Master Data > My Banks view-Search for the Bank ID "ABC"-Click Edit > General-Go to Payment Formats tab-Click on your User Icon at the top right corner of the screen and click "Start Personalization Mode"-Click OK on the "You are now entering Personalization Mode" pop-up-Select Unnamed Table and click ">" button-Mark the Checkboxes for Transformation Name and Transformation ID-Click Save and OK-Click on your User Icon at the top right corner of the screen and click "Stop Personalization Mode"-Go to Payment Formats tab-Enter the "new" Payment Medium Format Code according to your needs-Under Transformation ID, click the Help value and select the required Transformation name-Click Save-(ABC means the My Bank ID)-See Also-Help Documentation: XSL Transformation-Keywords-Austria, SEPA, bydesign, payment, address, xsl transformation

Title: Handling Font Issues in SAP Business Bydesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document is to provide the steps involved in adding Fonts in the ByD System, responsible teams and known issues / constrains-***This document is strictly Internal***-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-User reports a case,-Requesting to add a font in the tenant which can be used for Forms / Outputs.-Preview shows different fonts.-Some issues with fonts.-Let's understand the processes:-Below are the steps followed by Operations team to add a font into a tenant-Support receive an case with the request to add fonts-Support to verify:-Whether it is free style font or licensed font:-If free style, provide the confirmation that the font is free style (ex: URL of the font) and the font in either .TTF or .OTF format.-If it is Licensed fonts:-User to provide Proof of license and font either .TTF or .OTF format in the case.-With the information, report an incident to Operations.-OPS team checks whether the Font is already there in the Server:-If Yes, then the font is already there in the tenant. If it is still not working then forward to AP-RC-OUT Product Support.-If No, then a Change Request is created for approval.-Add the font in Data Center and then restart of the Data center.-Add the font in the master clone and then into all clones (around 80 clones).-***For Support***-Above process takes 5 to 10 days and hence, set the expecation to customer about the timelines.-Case with this request shouldn't be a P1 (Very High). In case of P1, try to reduce the priority then move it to OPS.-After clones are updated and restarted, if the fonts are not reflecting in the system, then forward the incident to AP-RC-OUT development.-How to handle Service requests of Customer fonts for ByD and C4C?-In case, customer wants to add a font which is not part of the supported fonts in Help center, then follow the below steps:-Ask the customer to provide the custom fonts as either ttf or otf format (zipped).-A legal prove of purchase ie. Invoice etc (Unless they open-source fonts).-Ask the customer to check and if it is still not working ask for a document ID and let me know.-If the custom fonts are not shown, Ask the customer to provide at least 2 fields where they use the custom font. This makes debugging much easier rather then searching in a custom form for a field.-As Operations to make the fonts available on all ADS and after that’s done to provide the full font list as attached text file.-When do we involve BC-SRV-FP and what do the colleagues need and do not need?-Forward an incident to BC-SRV-FP in case Operations or Output Management development is recommending to do so. Please be aware, the development team BC-SRV-FP is not specific to ByD/C4C and hence they don’t logon to ByD or C4C so reproducible steps are irrelevant.-The colleagues don’t need:-Steps to reproduce-The customer form or anything which requires to logon. That not what the colleagues need.-What is needed?-Take ADS Trace according to KBA '3243655 - You want to take an ADS Trace', take a screenshot which points out on the problem and - most important - name the file which includes all needed files and a short summary of the problem itself.-Please also make the customer aware that fonts are Service Requests and follow different SLA’s as a technical issue.-FAQ:-<In process>-Keywords-Font, process, install, forms, ttf, otf, font license

Title: System Throws Errors while Creating New Custodian Goods Return Notification
Content: Symptom-You receive below errors while creating New Custodian Goods Return Notification:-Error: The address data is missing.-Party X does not exist or is not valid for this role ( i.e. here X refers to a Party ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Under the Common Tasks view, select New Custodian Goods Return Notification.-Enter relevant data, Ship-to Party ID and Ship-to Location ID, Sender ID, and required Product ID.-Now Check Consistency.-The system throws the above error messages.-Cause-Since there are no roles assigned to the business partner. When a user creates New Parts Return Notification the desired business partner doesn't show up because the system interprets it as a contact name.-Resolution-The user must assign business roles to the desired business partner and maintain correct master data.-Keywords- Business Partner, Inbound Logistics, New Custodian Goods Return Notification, Ship-to Location, The address data is missing

Title: System Allows User to Create A Customer Return Notification for A Sold Product with Obsolete Identified Stock
Content: Symptom-The system encounters below errors when creating a Customer Return Notification (CRN) for a sold product with obsolete identified stock. However, it still creates an Inbound Delivery Notification and a Customer Return document.-"Error during warehouse request release-Associated identified stock A is obsolete. Mark Stock as Restricted.-Deletion of request ID is not permitted-Zero Quantity for request ID, item ID B is not permitted. Add a quantity greater than zero or reject the requested item"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Choose New Customer Return Notification in Common Task.-Search for the Sales Order ID.-Select the record and choose Next.-Fulfill the Delivery Notification ID and the return reason.-Choose Next.-Choose Finish and Create Warehouse Request, then the document would be created even if the mentioned error occurs.-Cause-After analyzing the issue, we have identified that there is currently no system check in place to determine if the identified stock is obsolete or not when creating a CRN.-Resolution-This issue has been permanently resolved since 2411 release.-If there is any inconsistent CRN created before that, please report a case to us and we will help delete the CRN from backend.-See Also-3543975 - Error "Insufficient Stock for the Product" Triggered When Creating New Over-the-Counter Sale https://me.sap.com/notes/3543975-Keywords-Error during warehouse request release, Associated, Identified Stock, Obsolete, Customer Return Notification.

Title: Error "You are not authorized to access the data" while accessing the Employee Time profile from the Time Administration work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**Internal Only**-When trying to access the Employee Time file, error message "You are not authorized to access the data" and no details are displayed.-When opening an Employee Time related report, one or more employees's ID are shown as "#" and their names are shown as "No Text for UUID {...}". -RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn READ' on instance 'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' of 'BONodeProxy PERS_FILE_OIF_BE_ECO ROOT' in context 'UIApplication /SAP_BYDGLO_APPLICATION_UI/hcm/BE/PA/persfileoifbe.OIF.uicomponent Operation Start' ".-When trying to access the Employee Time file, error messages: RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn READ' on Instance '...' of 'BoNodeProxy TIME_AGR_FACTSHEET_ECO ROOT' in context'...' /  RBAM: Skip Operation 'BuiltIn READ'  on 'BoNodeProxy TIME_AGR_FACTSHEET_ECO ROOT'- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the affected BYD system-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Select the affected user-Click on Edit-User gets the error "You are not authorized to access the data" as displayed-Or-Login to the affected BYD system-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Report View-Open an Employee Time related report-There will be some error entries with ID "#" and name "No Text for UUID {...}"-Cause-Due to missing Access Control List(ACL) entries in the backend due to sync issue.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to verify the ACL entries for the affected Employee.-Login to the backend-Enter the T Code SESFTS-Enter the BO "HCM_EMPLOYEE_SUPP_CO"-Click Load By Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS and enter the Employee ID under Employee ID/Content-Click on Right button-On Left pane drop down the Employee & double click on Employee-Select the line & Click on Navigate -> Access Control List-Click again on Navigate -> Entry-If there is no entries found this is because of the missing ACL-NOTE: Do not execute the below program instead send the incident to SRD-HR-TLM development. This is to identify the root cause of the issue-Further you can verify ACL entries for the affected user can be found in the report, by following below steps:-Go to Backend-Enter T Code SE38-Enter the program "AP_PAD_ADJUST_ACL_ENTRIES"-Click on Execute-For check the list of users affected select the Check box "Execute in Test Mode(without Save)" -Select All Employees under Action to be executed for & Select the check box of Create for All Erroneous Employees under All Employees-Find the Employee ID in the list -Once you varify the above, where you see affected Employees ACL is missing, please follow the above steps again without selecting the check box "Execute in Test Mode" i.e. step 5.-Keywords-You are not authorized to access the data, ACL Missing, Time File, Cannot Access TimeSheet, No Text for UUID, Employee Time report,PERS_FILE_OIF_BE_ECO ROOT, RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn READ' on instance-time file,timesheet,srd-hr-tlm,acl,rbam,no authorization

Title: Journal Entry Voucher Excel Upload Error: 'The Value '' of the Field 'Credit Amount *' is Invalid.' or 'The Value '' of the Field 'Debit Amount *' is Invalid.'
Content: Symptom-While uploading a Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel the following error messages occur:-'The value '' of the field 'Credit Amount *' is invalid.'-'The value '' of the field 'Debit Amount *' is invalid.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries - Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Press the New button and select the Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel option.-Download the file and enter the relevant data in the Excel file.-Press Save Data to, to proceed with the upload of the Journal Entry Voucher file to the Business ByDesign system.-Error occurs:-'The value '' of the field 'Credit Amount *' is invalid.'-'The value '' of the field 'Debit Amount *' is invalid.'-Cause-The issue is with the credit/debit amount format in the excel template. When enter the credit/debit amount in the file, the format is incorrect so the data cannot be recognized by the system.-Resolution-Use the 'Text to Columns' button under the Data tab in the Excel file for Debit Amount and Credit Amount.-See Also-KBA 1736565 - Error Message "The Value " " of the Field 'Cost Object Type' is Invalid"-KBA 1760524 - Cannot Upload Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel, Upload Journal Entry Voucher, Credit Amount, Debit Amount, The value '' of the field 'Credit Amount *' is invalid, The value '' of the field 'Debit Amount *' is invalid

Title: No Plan Data Displayed in the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual Report
Content: Symptom-A financial Plan Version from Microsoft Excel has been successfully uploaded. Afterwards when checking the plan data by executing the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual report, notice that no Plan data is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Reports > List view.-Search and open the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual report.-Enter data in mandatory fields Company, Set of Books, Accounting Period/Year and Display Currency - Conversion Date.-Hit Go.-Notice that the report returns no data for the Plan column.-Cause-The uploaded financial plan version is not defined as the Default one. The Cost Centers - Plan/Actual report only displays Plan data for the default plan version, thus no Plan data is displayed.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to define the uploaded financial plan version as the Default one in order to obtain Plan data from the report.-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Planning view.-Select the Plan Version which is uploaded from Microsoft Excel.-Click Set as Default.-After this setup, run the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual report again and the Plan data will be displayed here as expected.-See Also-2042849 - No Plan Data Displayed in the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast Report-Keywords-Budget, Planning, Plan Data, Default Version

Title: Error 'Individual material XYZ is only assigned to retired fixed assets' During Goods and Services Receipt Posting
Content: Symptom-Error message is displayed while trying to post a Goods and Services Receipt:-'Individual material XYZ is only assigned to retired fixed assets' (XYZ refers to individual material)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents list, search for the relevant Goods and Services Receipt and error is seen.-Cause-The Fixed asset related to Individual material is retired and system blocks any further Goods and Services Receipt postings.-Resolution-The fixed asset needs to be capitalized before performing any further Goods and Services Receipt postings. This can be done by removing deactivation date of asset.-To identify the fixed asset via the individual material and change status from Retired to Capitalized, below steps can be followed:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Asset view.-Filter for fixed asset with Individual Material ID XYZ and click Go. Here we see asset is Retired.-Open the asset and click View All.-Under Master Data tab -> Life Cycle subtab, the Deactivation Date is displayed.-Remove the Deactivation Date and save the changes, this changes asset's status from Retired to Capitalized.-Now the Goods and Services Receipt can be posted from the Unposted Source Documents List.-See Also-2170879 - Error Message: Individual Material is Only Assigned to Retired Fixed Assets-Keywords-Fixed asset, Goods and Service Receipt, Unposted source document

Title: Warning Message When Bank Statement Upload Leads to Gap in Continuous Numbering.
Content: Symptom-A MT940 format bank statement has been uploaded with an opening balance of XXXX, which does not match the closing balance YYYY of the previous MT940 bank statement. It is expected that the system will perform a veto check, preventing the upload and posting of a bank statement where the opening balance does not equal the closing balance of the previously uploaded statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, and select the Bank Statements view.-Select the Newly created bank statement.-View Opening Balance.-Select the Preceding bank statement ID.-View Closing Balance.-Previously uploaded MT940 bank statement closing balance is not matching with the opening balance of the newly uploaded bank statement.-When uploading the next statement you receive a warning:-'Previous bank statement XYZ does not exist or not posted yet.'-Cause-This behavior is correct in the event that a bank statement is uploaded with a number that does not follow the ID of the last posted bank statement. In this case, the system displays a warning message. Additionally, another bank statement may be entered with an opening balance that deviates from the closing balance of the previous bank statement.-For example:-Previous bank statement number is 1. The subsequent bank statement ID as derived from the statement header is 3 for the same Bank Account ID.-Resolution-In order to guarantee a continuity of bank statement numbering and coherence of opening - and closing balances please make sure to add the missing statement or get in touch with your house-bank for clarification.-Keywords-Bank Statement, Upload, sequence number, posting, Balance.

Title: The recipient does not receive the Broadcast Email
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-+++INTERNAL USE ONLY+++-For some reason, you do not receive the Report attached in the e-mail sent out by broadcast scheduled jobs.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Broadcasts View.-You have created a broadcast job and scheduled it to send out a report to one or more e-mail addresses.-The broadcast runs successfully, however the receipts either don't get the e-mail or get the e-mail without the report enclosed.-Cause-For some reason, the system is preventing to get the attached file.-Resolution-At SAP side, you can crosscheck in the backend if the broadcast has sent out the message successfully to an external Domain Name.-Open a STFK connection-Open the t-code: SOST-Seek by the message related.-You filter by the time stamp, broadcast name, recipient address and so on.-Open the message and check if the attachment file is there (XML Report).-Check also if there is a green light for this particular message, meaning that is was transmitted with success.-If the aforementioned points are ok, the Broadcast job indeed sent out the Z report.-At customer side, the customer needs to approach his system administrator in order to verify the security settings of his Anti-Spam & Firewall at workstation and server level as well as Outlook security settings (Trust Center). It might prevent the customer either to receive the email from the Service Provider (SAP) or block the attachment.-If you want to validate the sender, you can change the Recipient email address to another email (with a different Domain Name) and run the Broadcast manually, so that you can validate the receipt of the broadcast message.-Keywords-broadcast, sost, scot, not sent, domain name

Title: Warning Message: 'Execution Status Of Item On Print Queue  New' Occurs During Outbound Delivery Creation
Content: Symptom-When the Outbound Delivery interface is printed at the time of delivery creation, the following warning message appears:-'Execution status of print queue item - New'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter-Go to Outbound deliveries View-Search for Outbound Delivery ID: ABC-Select Edit-Notice the warning message "Execution status of item on print queue – New"-   Cause-When the shipment status changes, the warning message will be displayed at the time of Print Queue:-Creation.-Update.-Deletion.-Resolution-This warning message can be ignored as it will not impact any process.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Execution status of item on print queue – New,  Print Queue, Warning Message, Shipping Status

Title: Cannot See Button 'Edit Payables Line Item' in the Supplier Invoice ABC
Content: Symptom-Cannot see button 'Edit Payables Line Item' in the supplier invoice ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search the posted Supplier Invoice ABC, open it and click View All.-Under General tab, Payment Information sub-tab, Payment Details, cannot see button'Edit Payables Line Item'.-Cause-The status of the supplier invoice ABC is 'Paid'.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Edit Payables Line Item, Supplier Invoice

Title: Address Information is Missing in Payment File ISO20022 Payment Format in XML File
Content: Symptom-Creat an outbound file for payments to an employee ABC and the file format is ISO20022 Payment Format. Then find that the employee address information is not available in the XML file.-<PstlAdr>-….-<AdrLine> </AdrLine>-</PstlAdr>-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Outbound Files.-Select the affcted Outbound file.-Edit the file.-Click on View All.-From the Attachments tab, download the XML file and observe that the employee address information is not available.-Cause-There are two possible reasons:-The address information for this employee in his personal profile has not been maintained.-If the above address information has been maintained but still cannot see it in the XML file, it may due to the Business Partner also has an employee role. The Business Partner address is maintained as the "Main" Address. Therefore all the changes on employee level will be ignored. The system is always selecting the Main address which is maintained on Business Partner level.-Resolution-Check the employee address in its Personnel Profile. Maintain the relevant address information under Personal Data tab, Private Contact Data sub-tab.-In the second scenario, if the Business Partner also has an employee role, change the address on the Business Partner level as well to match the Employee and recreate the payment file.-Keywords-Employee, Address Information, ISO20022, Outbound File

Title: Not Possible to Release Customer Invoice due to Error: "Invoice request XYZ item XX not possible; reference document inconsistent"
Content: Symptom-When trying to release or save a newly created customer invoice the following error message occurs:-"Invoice request XYZ item XX not possible; reference document inconsistent" (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice request and XX the line item number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for invoice request XYZ.-Select invoice request XYZ line and click the Invoice button.-The following error message occurs:-"Invoice request XYZ item XX not possible; reference document inconsistent".-Cause-The error “Invoice request XYZ item ABC not possible; reference document inconsistent” can be triggered for different reasons-Please have a look at this KBA for specific issues: 2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-In this example the issue is caused due to the following:-When invoicing an outbound delivery invoice request, system matches the data from the sales order invoice request with the data of the outbound delivery invoice request to create the invoice (same applies to customer contract invoice request). In this case, there might be inconsistencies with the currency used.-Resolution-Ensure that the currencies ﻿maintained in the sales order invoice request and the outbound delivery invoice request have a conversion maintained.-To do so, follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Click Edit Exchange Rates.-Maintain the conversion rates as needed.-The document should be consistent now.-See Also-KBA: 2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-Keywords-invoice request, item not possible, reference document, inconsistent, warning, error message, outbound delivery invoice request, byd.

Title: Cannot edit a purchasing document. Error: "Object locked by ; Please try again later"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- *** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-User cannot edit a purchasing document because of error: "Object locked by <XYZ>; Please try again later". (XYZ is the user's ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view -Search for the Purchase Order ID and click on view all-System throws the error while performing any actions on this PO -        Error "Object locked by user; Please try again later"-Cause-There are lock entries in the backend that need to be deleted.-Resolution-Log in to the backend.-Execute transaction SM12.-Enter Table Name = '/SRMAP*' or Enter technical user name of the user ID (XYZ) which is displayed in the UI error. -Click on List.-Delete the relevant lock entries. -Keywords-Object locked; User; SM12; Backend; user lock; lock error on purchase order

Title: Unable to Invoice Even After Removing the Inconsistencies in the Invoice Request Document
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to invoice even after removing the inconsistencies in the invoice request document.-The following error message still appears: -"Invoice Request XYZ Item XX not possible; reference document inconsistent." (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice request and XX the line item number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select the invoice request XYZ and click the Invoice button.-A new screen appears with all fields grayed out and the following warning message is displayed: -"Invoice Request XYZ Item XX not possible; reference document inconsistent."-Cause-The redetermination of the invoice request was not successful.-Resolution-To resolve this issue please follow the below steps:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Edit the invoice request XYZ.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Open the sales order ABC and select View All (ABC represents the sales order ID).-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Select either Sales Unit or Invoicing Unit.-Click the Remove button.-Click the Add button and select the Sales Unit or Invoicing Unit and enter the same value maintained before.-Click Save.-It is now possible to invoice the document.-See Also-KBA: 2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-Keywords-customer, invoicing, unable, invoice, inconsistencies, removing, request

Title: Unable to Change the Product Category Assigned to a Material
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to change the Product Category assigned to a Material since the field is read-only.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center or any work center where you can access Materials view.-Select Material view.-Search and Edit a Material.-  Cause-The Product Category is not changeable if the Material was set as a Material Template. This is expected system behavior.-Material Template view of Product Data work center. If you can find the Material in this view, then the Material is a Material Template. Therefore the Product Category field is not enabled.-Resolution-You can set any other Material with the same category as Template. Then you can able to change the category of former Material, but for the other material the category can not be changed-Keywords-Product Category, greyed out, change, material ID, business ByDesign

Title: Retrieving data using ODATA
Content: Symptom-Due to technical limitation, only up to 50 key figures and characteristics can be selected while retrieving data from ODATA-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Run the specified query which have relevant report name and selections used in the report.-You will be able to see only only first 50 key figures and characteristics visible in the data extracted-Cause-Due to technical limitation, only up to 50 key figures and characteristics can be selected.-Report execution through OData requests always gets executed only for initial selection, that is, the parameters which are maintained in the report metadata-Resolution-We recommend that you should explicitly select data for the needed fields. Also if you want to override the initial selection in the parameter values, then use $filter=PAR_SEL_DPY_MAINPROSPCT_ID eq '1001140'. Here 1001140 is an example value.-See Also-Help Center document, with the keyword as "Retrieving Analytics Data Using OData"-Keywords-ODATA, 50, key figures, characteristics, limit, amount-odata, data extraction

Title: Multiple Inbound Delivery for Purchase Order in ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-More than one Inbound delivery created for a single purchase order.-Items have already been received in one delivery.-Unexpected creation of another delivery document by the system.-Environment-Confirmed Inbound Delivery.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Inbound Deliveries view.-Search for the Inbound delivery against the relevant purchase order.-You can see more than one Inbound delivery created against the purchase order-Cause-The ByDesign system allows the creation of Inbound delivery notifications against a purchase order for which a delivery notification is already created. However, when the second delivery notification is created, the system displays an Information message at the time of creation and a warning message when the consistency of the document is checked.-Information Message: All items are proposed. Item with Open Purchase Order Quantity greater than zero do not exist.-Warning Message: Notification quantity exceeds open quantity plus over-delivery tolerance-Resolution-The reported behavior is not a bug in the system. This is a flexibility provided in the system to account for dynamic changes at the time of delivery in your warehouse.-See Also-Keywords-ByDesign, Purchase Order, Inbound Delivery, Duplicate, Warehouse, Delivery Document.

Title: Automatic On-Account Clearing of Outgoing Direct Debit in Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-After uploading and posting an electronic bank statement you observe that for outgoing direct debit payments automatic on-account payments are posted.-This result is not according to expectation as you would like to allocate and clear such transactions differently.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Search for the bank statement and transaction. -Follow the link Postprocessing 'Required'.-Instead of an open Payment Allocation you enter a Clearing Overview (Clearing Status: Paid on Account).-Cause-An outgoing direct debit payment represents a non-self-initiated payment. Hence not the confirmation of an existing payment is assumed but a clearing, presumably against open payables or on-account. -In case no open payables are identified or a rule of type Account Assignment is active for respective Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines - the systems falls back on the assumption that a clearing shall happen against account (here supplier).-An unambiguous business partner identification usually would happen by IBAN match in the supplier master data and payment explanation in respective bank statement item. -For example, Bank Statement Format: MT940 DE -For Supplier XYZ an IBAN is maintained in the master data under - -Financial Data / Bank Data:-IBAN:     DE893704004405320XXXXX-In the payment explanation block of relevant bank statement item :86:, following tag ?31 the IBAN of the payee is maintained as: -?31DE893704004405320XXXXX-(Similar content is provided in xml bank statements as ISO20022.)-If such conditions are met an automatic on-account clearing will happen for Supplier XYZ.-This an accepted and expected system definition in the scope of automatic bank statement processing.-Resolution-The following alternatives can be evaluated if you do not desire automatic on-account clearings against supplier.-In case an Allocation to G/L Account is intended we recommend to set up a Rule for Analyzing Memo Lines of type:  7 - Account Assignment.-If a unique identifier can be provided in payment explanation blog :86: an automatic g/l account allocation can be achieved.-In case an open allocation without any automatic allocation is preferred for a particular business partner it could be considered to remove the IBAN in supplier master data under Bank Data.-A business partner identification by IBAN match then will not happen.-Keywords-Paid on Account, Payment Allocation, Clearing, Direct Debit

Title: No Automatic Clearing in Bank Statement Despite Working Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines due to Percentage Clearing Difference Threshold.
Content: Symptom-You have defined working Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines identifying payment relevant payables or receivables (for example, Rule Type: 2 - Open Receivable Document ID).-Based on provided memo line content open candidate documents are identified unambiguously.-Additionally Clearing Strategies have been defined accommodating an automatic clearing for thresholds defined for overpayment or underpayment. -After uploading and posting affected bank statement transactions candidate items are identified, however appear as not cleared (Postprocessing: Required). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Affected Payment Allocations can be accessed via:-In the Liquidity Management work center go to Bank Statement view.-Select the relevant posted bank statement transaction.-In the column Postprocessing, follow the link Required.-Alternatively you can find affected Payment Allocations in the Payment Management work center under Payment Allocation view.-Select the relevant open payment allocation of type Bank Statement.-Cause-When a payment difference crosses a percentage threshold of 5% in either direction (overpayment as well as underpayment) a manual clearing is required.-This definition has been introduced as last safeguard for high-volume automatic clearings for payment-relevant documents (for example: customer invoices) when Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines are applied in bank statement processing. -This definition applies irrespective of and overrules made definitions for Clearing Strategies.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Edit Clearing Strategies activity and Maintain clearing strategies.-Settings defined for: Payment Tolerance Types, Tolerance for Over Payment, Manual Clearing Tasks.-The 5% threshold can be easily crossed with involved clearing amounts < 1.00 MU (Monetary Unit) where for currency-specific decimal settings applicable amount modifications are limited.-The following table illustrates the application of the 5% Clearing threshold for overpayments as well as underpayments.-Here it is assumed that Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines as well as Clearing Strategies are set up accurately and effectively.-    % Payment Difference Result -            Overpayment:   -        Invoice: €0.10    -Payment in Bank Statement: €0.11 10% No automatic Clearing.-        Invoice: €1.00    -Payment in Bank Statement: €1.06 6% No automatic Clearing.-        Invoice: €1.00    -Payment in Bank Statement: €1.05 5% Automatic Clearing.-        Invoice: €1.00    -Payment in Bank Statement: €1.04 4% Automatic Clearing-            Underpayment:  -        Invoice: €1.00    -Payment in Bank Statement: €0.96 -4% Automatic Clearing-                Invoice: €1.00    -Payment in Bank Statement: €0.95 -5% No automatic Clearing.-Resolution-The system works as designed. -In case you are seeking a change in functionality or adoption of a new feature we ask to submit your idea in our Influence Platform.-Here requests for enhancements are introduced and evaluated by other customers and our product team.-Keywords-automatic clearing, bank statement, payment difference, payment allocation, clearing strategies

Title: Service Order is in Status In Process even though the Items were Delivered and Invoiced
Content: Symptom-The Service Order is in Status In Process even though the Items were Delivered and Invoiced.-The Delivery Status and the Invoice Status of the Items are in status In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Open Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Service Order).-The Status is In Process.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select Line Item XX (XX represents the line item number).-In the Details section under the General tab you can see that the Delivery Status is In Process and Invoice Status is In Process.-You expect the Status to be Completed since the items were fully delivered via the Service Confirmation and the Service Confirmation was fully invoiced and the Invoice is in Status Released.-Cause-The Service Order is not completed because the Service Confirmation was released with the option Without Order Completion. This means that the execution has to be manually completed in the Service Order.-Resolution-Navigate to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Open Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Service Order).-You can either Complete the execution by either clicking on the Submit button and the Complete Service Execution option.-Or you navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select Line Item XX (XX represents the line item number).-Click on the Complete Execution button.-If the Complete Execution button is not active you need to check if an Execution Block is maintained in the General tab and the Main Information sub tab of the Service Order. -In this case you need to remove the Execution Block to complete the execution. -You can follow the steps in KBA 3490832 - Execution Block in Service Order is Not Editable-See Also-KBA 3490832 - Execution Block in Service Order is Not Editable-Keywords-Service Orders, Execution Block, Credit Limit, Complete Execution, Service Order Processing, Service Confirmation, Invoice, Check Credit Limit, Complete Service Execution, read only, not editable, Delivery Block, Status; Completed, In Process, wrong status,

Title: Unable to Close Service Confirmation Due to Exceeded Inventory Quantity at Logistical Area
Content: Symptom-The following warning arises when attempting to close a service confirmation; "Release not possible; quantity exceeds inventory quantity at area ABC".-Where ABC is the logistics area from which the spare parts/services were sourced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center: Field Service and Repair.-Select view: Service Confirmations.-Search All Confirmations for the desired service confirmation.-Select the confirmation then Edit.-Release (With/Without Service Completion).-The following warning is prompted, preventing the service confirmations' completion: "Release not possible; quantity exceeds inventory quantity at area ABC".-Cause-The issue arises because all the line items in this service confirmation have already been confirmed via a duplicate service confirmation with all the same items and has the status 'Finished'.-Resolution-Navigate to work center: Field Service.-Select view: Service Confirmations.-Search All Confirmations for the relevant confirmation which remains 'In Process'.-Edit, View All.-Go to the Spare Parts and Services tab.-For all the line items contained in the 'Finished' duplicate service confirmation, maintain a Reason for Rejection for each one.-Following this the service confirmation should be successfully completed, then subsequently its associated service order.-Keywords-Service Order, Service Confirmation, Inventory Quantity, Error Message, Line Items, Reason for Rejection, Complete Execution

Title: Error Message: 'Low Value Asset Max/Min Amounts Missing for crcy AB and actg ppl. 1234' during Fixed Asset Migration
Content: Symptom-Error message while migrating the Fixed assets using the Migration Tool.-Low value asset max/min amounts missing for crcy ABC and actg ppl. 1234-(Here, ABC refers to Currency and 1234 refers to Accounting Principle)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and select Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend.-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity and click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration unit and select Execute Migration.-Simulate the migration, then you get the error message:-Low value asset max/min amounts missing for crcy ABC and actg ppl. 1234-   Cause-A minimum and maximum amount for the currency ABC has not been maintained in the error and accounting principle 1234 within the Business Configuration Activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-Resolution-  Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets Activity.-Click "Change Immediately".-Select accounting principle 1234.-Maintain the min and max amount for the currency. --Once the amount for the respective accounting principle is maintained, migration will be executed without any errors.-See Also- 2800082 - Error message: Changing Valid to not possible during Fixed Asset Migration  -Keywords-Low value asset max/min amounts missing, Fixed asset migration,

Title: Error When Uploading Bank Statement File in CSV Format.
Content: Symptom-An error occurs when attempting to upload a Bank Statement file in CSV format.-The error message displayed is: "No bank account active on YYMMDD for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found".-The issue persists despite the bank details appearing to be correct.-(XYZ represents the Bank Account ID)-(ABC represents the National Bank Code)-(DEF represents the currency)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Attempt to upload a Bank Statement file in CSV format either via Bank Statements view or File Management - Inbound Files view.-Maintain the mandatory data as to File Type, Company, Bank ID, Import Format.-Under Attachments press Add- File.-Find the file that you want to upload and press Add.-Start File Upload.-Error message appears:-No bank account active on YYMMDD for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found.-Bank account missing or cannot be determined-Bank statement ID $1 for bank account ID rejected-Cause-The 'My Bank Account ID' field in the CSV file has been filled with "XYZ", which is not a valid in SAP Business ByDesign. This leads to the system's inability to identify a bank account.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, the "Bank Account Number" must be used in "My Bank Account ID" field in CSV file.-Open the CSV file and locate the 'My Bank Account ID' field.-Replace the incorrect "XYZ" value with the correct Bank Account Number "AAA" (AAA represents the Bank Account Number).-Save the changes to the CSV file.-Attempt to upload the corrected CSV file again.-See Also-KBA: 3167595 - Error: No bank account active on YYMMDD for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found-Keywords-Bank Statement, CSV file, Upload error, Bank Account ID, Incorrect value, Bank Account Number, Bank account missing or cannot be determined.

Title: Error During Custom Developments Via SDK Since There Is No Active Implementation Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Having below error messages when doing custom developments via SDK since there is no active implementation project existing in system.-Error during deployment of implementation project. Report an incident.-Status of Workspace does not allow change. Check the status of your implementation project in the Business Configuration Workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open the implementation project errors.-Or-Go to SDK-> Open the solution.-Activate-> Right click and deploy.-Error appears.-Cause-SDK development is possible only in the Standalone Pre-Production Tenant.-However, in this tenant there is a Remote Change project from other tenant with status Cancelled.-Resolution-Report an incident to business configuration development team to update the remote change project accordingly to change the teanant to Standalone Pre-Production Tenant. -Then there will be an active project as First Implementation in the Implementation Projects view, and now you can perform SDK changes.

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Does Not Consider Documents with Future Posting Dates
Content: Symptom-The Revenue Recognition Run was executed for example on 28.10.2024 for the current accounting period, in this example, period 010/2024. However, documents with posting dates after the execution of the Revenue Recognition run (e.g.: 29.10.2024, 30.10.2024, 31.10.2024) are not included in the run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center > Revenue Recognition view.-Perform the Revenue Recognition run.-Cause-The system uses the current date as the posting date when running the revenue recognition for the current accounting period. Consequently, documents with posting dates later than the current date are not considered in the run.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-See Also-KBA 1954056 - Derivation of the Revenue Recognition Run Posting Date-KBA 2117833 - Costs of Sales Not Realized According to Expense Posting Date  -Keywords-Revenue Recognition, Future Documents, Posting Date, Accounting Period

Title: Submit Button is Disabled in Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-The Submit button is disabled in some sales orders and the reason is unknown.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the order ABC. The Submit button on the top is disabled. (ABC represents the ID of sales order)-Cause-The sales order is In Preparation status, and no List Price component is added to the sales order items, hence submit is disabled.-Resolution-In order to enable the Submit button, manually add the List Price in the order by performing the steps:-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab - Pricing sub tab of the sales order.-Select one item line (example: Line Item 10) and click Add Row button.-From Price Component drop down list, select List Price.-Once the List Price is added, the Submit button is then enabled.-Keywords-Sales Order; Submit; disabled; grayed out; List Price

Title: Unable to release the Customer Invoice due to the error messages "Due date must not be before invoice date" and "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The Customer Invoice with the Tax Country Japan has been saved and cannot be released due to the error "Due date must not be before invoice date" and "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents.-Search and edit the Invoice XYZ (XYZ is the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click on Release button.-The following error message appears:-Due date must not be before invoice date-Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date-Cause-The scenario has occurred due to the incorrect determination of the closing date, as a Customer account was used instead of the payer accounts (Invoice summary relevant) in the invoices. Therefore, even if the Due date of the invoice is changed, the scenario remains uncorrected.-Resolution-The Customer Account should not be used in place of payer accounts. Backend correction will have to be performed to correct the closing date by AP-CI-CI-GLO team.-Keywords-due date must not be before, invoice date, invoice, account, due date must not be before invoice date, Japan, Invoice Summary

Title: Execution Block in Service Order is Not Editable
Content: Symptom-In the Service Order ABC, you want to remove the Execution Block set in the order and continue the service execution process, but you find the Execution Block field is now read-only. You are not able to remove the Execution Block and hence not able to process it further.-ABC represents the ID of the service order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders - Service Order Processing  view.-Open the service order ABC.-The Execution Block is filled with a value. It is not editable.-Cause-The Execution Block was filled before Customer Invoice XYZ released for a Service Order line item. Once the Invoice is created and released, the invoice status of the line changes to In Process or Finished (depending on the Delivery Status), and in this case the Execution Block field becomes read-only.-This is the current system design.-XYZ represents the ID of the Customer Invoice.-Resolution-In order to edit the Execution Block, the user has to cancel the customer invoice XYZ. Once it is done, the item invoice status will be changed back to Not Started and the Execution Block field will be editable.-Alternatively, if the Execution Block was set via the Credit Limit Check, you can change the Credit Limit in the Account Master Data respectively to ensure the Credit Limit is not exceeded in the Service Order, and perform the Credit Limit Check again in the Service Order. -Keywords-service order; execution block; delivery block; read only; not editable, greyed out.

Title: Error: 'No bank account active on YYMMDD for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found'.
Content: Symptom- Upon Bank Statement file upload an error appears as: "No bank account active on YYMMDD for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found."-(XYZ represents the Bank Account ID)-(ABC represents the National Bank Code)-(DEF represents the currency)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-File upload either either via Bank Statements view or File Management - Inbound Files view.-Maintain the mandatory data as to Company, House Bank, Import Format.-Under Attachments press Add- File.-Find the file that you want to upload and press Add.-Start File Upload.-Error Messages appears: "No bank account active on YYMMDD for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found."-Cause-This error points at an inconsistency in determining a valid bank account based on file format, content and maintained bank master data.-Hence multiple causes can result in this error.-Resolution-The following list details pertinent KBAs addressing this error based on the underlying root cause.-2399474 - Error Message When Uploading Bank Statement "No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XXX, national bank code YYY, and currency ZZZ found"-2780248 - Error Message No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number 1000, national bank code XYZ, and currency XXX found -2654852 - Spain - CSB 43 file format Error Message No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number ABC, national bank code XYZ, and currency WWW found-2590226 - Bank Account Upload Error Received as Letters in Bank Account Number Not Allowed -2558477 - Bank Statement Upload: Bank Account Missing or Cannot be Determined -2089501 - MT940 UK Bank Statement Upload Date Not Valid-2669287 - How to Solve Bank Statement File Upload Failed Errors -1940792 - Error Message: No Bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number, national bank code, and currency XYZ-3541049 - Error When Uploading Bank Statement File in CSV Format.-Keywords-Bank Account, Active, Account Number, National Bank Code, Currency, Bank Statement file upload.

Title: Sales Order Item Cancellation Not Reflecting in Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-The Sales Order line item is cancelled; however, the cancellation status is not updated to Customer Demand. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ID ABC (where ABC represents Sales Order ID).-Choose Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Select the line-item YYY and maintain Reason for Rejection. (where YYY represents Line-Item ID)-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to Customer Demand view.-Search for Customer Demand ID ABC. (where ABC represents Sales Order ID)-Choose Edit.-Go to items tab.-The line-item YYY is not cancelled, the delivery block status is equal to Blocked.-Cause-When a change is made to sales order by maintaining Reason of Rejection an approval request is triggered. The changes made to the Sales Order will only be reflected to customer demand after the required approval is completed. s-Resolution-Approve the changes made in the Sales Order by following the below steps.-Go to Sales order work center.-Go Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ID ABC. (where ABC represents Sales Order ID)-Choose edit.-Go to items tab.-Select the relevant line item, Maintain the reason for rejection.-Choose Save.-Choose Submit, select Submit for approval.-Approve the Sales Order if an approval is required according to the criteria defined in the approval process.-Once the Approval Process status in the Sales Order has changed to Approved or Approval Not Necessary, the Cancellation status will be updated to the Customer Demand -Keywords-Sales Order Item; Cancelled; Reason For Rejection; Approval; Customer Demand; Line; SAP Business ByDesign

Title: How to Change Language of a Technical Integration User
Content: Symptom-This KBA explains how to change the language of a Technical User.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to Application and User Management Work center.-Click on Communication Arrangements view.-Choose and click in one communication arrangement which is used by technical user.-Click in View all button.-Click on technical data tab and click to edit the credentials button.-In the drop down will be an option to select the language of the technical user.-Click on save button.-In SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to Administrator Work center.-Go to General Settings.-Click on Communication Arrangements.-Choose and click in one communication arrangement which is used by technical user.-Click in View all button.-Click on technical data tab and click to edit the credentials button.-In the drop down will be an option to select the language of the technical user.-Click on save button.-Note: This solution is not valid for standard Technical Users that are delivered by SAP.-The language of e.g. the Technical User SAP_SYSTEM cannot be changed. As this user is involved in various internal operations, a change could lead to inconsistencies.-Keywords-Technical User, Language, Technical User Data, BYD, C4C, SAP_SYSTEM

Title: Posting of Invoice not Possible Due to Error in Financial Accounting ; Low Value Asset max/min Amounts Missing for crcy and actg ppl.
