Content: Symptom-You cannot post a Supplier Invoice due to the exception/ error message " Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Low value asset max/min amounts missing for crcy ABC and actg ppl. DDDD"-(ABC is the currency and DDDD is the accounting principle ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Select Invoice EFG (EFG is the Supplier Invoice ID).-Click open the same and then View All.-Navigate to the Exceptions tab.-the error is "Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Low value asset max/min amounts missing for crcy ABC and actg ppl. DDDD".-Cause-You want to create a Low Value Asset from the Supplier Invoice.-You have not maintained a minimum and maximum amount for the currency ABC and accounting principle DDDD in the Business Configuration Activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets Activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Select accounting principle DDDD.-Maintain the min and max amount for the currency ABC.-Now, you are able to post the supplier invoice without any error.-Keywords-Low value asset max/min amounts missing, Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting, Fixed asset

Title: How to Extract SAP Business ByDesign Tenant Data Before the Contract Ends?
Content: Symptom-User wants to know how to extract tenant data before the end of SAP Business ByDesign Contract?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Cause-Data extraction needs to be done before end of contract.-Resolution-Strongly Recommend:--When opening a case for data extraction, it is highly recommended to do so through SAP for Me. This ensures accessibility, as data extraction may take time to complete, and if the SAP contract terminates in the meantime, the tenant will become inaccessible, preventing updates from being visible in cases linked to the tenant. --1. When the contract is about to end with the SAP Business ByDesign what happens to data which is present:-Answer : User has to extract the data from your end before contract ends. -refer the Below KBA 2473303 - How to Enable and Use the Data Extraction Tool in SAP Business ByDesign--2. Which format data will be present.-Answer : Data will be available in XML format after data extraction is completed.-3.  How Extract Attachments of Business Objects-Answer: User need create a case to SAP and explain their requirement and business scenarios. -See Also-2667932 - Frequently Asked Questions on Data Extraction in SAP Business ByDesign System-2473303 - How to Enable and Use the Data Extraction Tool in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Archive, moved, ByD, format, data, SAP contract end, extract, SAP business Bydesign, tenant data

Title: System Crash When Clearing/Paying a Down Payment Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal use only***-You are clearing or paying a down payment request via e.g. Bank Credit Advice or via a Manual Clearing. When posting the transaction the system crashes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Under Common Tasks, click New Bank Payment Advice.-Give all the required parameters.-Match an open Down Payment Request to be paid.-Click Release.-The system crash. This can also happen when manually clearing the down payment request.-Cause-In ST22 transaction, you see that the system crash is raised from CL_FIA_FVPUR_RELATED_SERV=>GET_CB_DATA_FROM_PO_MIRROR.-In this case, one of the possible causes for the issue is that the Down Payment Request has a Purchase Order as cost assignment. This Purchase Order, however, remains as an unposted source document under General Ledger.-Therefore, when trying to clear the down payment requests, the system is not able to make the related cost assignment associations, since the cost object (purchase order) is not posted yet.-You can check the cost assignment as follows:-Open the down payment request in view all.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Cost Assignment tab.-To check the purchase order as unposted source document as related errors, follow below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-In the unposted source documents, search by the purchase order ID that is the cost assignment of the down payment request.-Resolution-You need to refer to the errors due to which the purchase order remains unposted and address them accordingly so that the purchase order can be posted. Once done, you should be able to post the bank payment advice and/or clearing.-p.s. The same error occurs during approval of payment (e.g Outgoing Bank Transfer).-Keywords-Bank Payment Advice. Down Payment Request. CL_FIA_FVPUR_RELATED_SERV. GET_CB_DATA_FROM_PO_MIRROR. favpur. Dump, AP-ACC-PUR, Approval, Manual Payment

Title: How to Enable and Use the Data Extraction Tool in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You want to perform Data Extraction in your SAP Business ByDesign system, but the work center view is not available for you.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-The view Data Extraction is not available.-Cause-The Data Extraction view has not been assigned to your business user or role.-Resolution-Strongly Recommend:--When opening a case for data extraction, it is highly recommended to do so through SAP for Me. This ensures accessibility, as data extraction may take time to complete, and if the SAP contract terminates in the meantime, the tenant will become inaccessible, preventing updates from being visible in cases linked to the tenant.--With release 1802 an explicit scoping of the view Data Extraction is not necessary anymore.-To assign the Data Extraction view to your Business User. The below steps are applicable only if you are not using Business Roles:-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Users view-Search for your Business User-Select Edit -> Access Rights-Go to the tab Work Center and View Assignment-Expand the work center Application and User Management-Tick the checkbox for the Data Extraction view-Select Save and Close-If you are using Business Roles, follow the steps below:-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Roles view-Select the Business Role which you want to assign the Data Extraction work center and click Edit-Go to the tab Work Center and View Assignment-Expand the work center Application and User Management-Tick the checkbox for the Data Extraction view-Select Save-Select Assigned Users -> Update Users-Note:-After the above settings, the user should logout of the system, and logon again so that the changes take place.-3.  To extract Master Data:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Data Extraction view-Select New-Enter a Run ID-Select the Extraction Object which you want to extract-Select the Package Active checkbox and define Package Size to automatically perform the extraction in packages with each package containing the number instances selected-Select Export Code Description to show texts/descriptions for the codes-Choose to Save or Activate and Run-To view the results, search for runs with status Finished-Select the run to see a list of files that are extracted-You can choose to Download the extracted files or Remove them-  Note:-1.  If you require Data Extraction of attachments, report an case to SAP to provide you this information.-Note: Such process might take a few weeks as this process is performed manually by the operations team and, it will depend on the amount of attachments available in the system.-2.  Extraction Files are generated only in .XML format-3.  If the downloaded files appear corrupt or you are unable to view the contents of the extracted file, change the file name of the downloaded file so that it ends on .zip and then open the file.-For example, if the extracted file is filename.xml you may change the file extension to filename.zip and view the extracted data.-Keywords-Data Extraction, Scoping Data Extraction, Data Extraction Tool, Attachment, Output Files.

Title: Error While Migrating the Open Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate Sales Orders using the migration tool. During the simulation you receive the below error:-Action Release not possible; action is disabled-Save not possible; document is inconsistent-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Open Sales Orders-Choose Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with migration mode Add new records-In the Simulation step, you receive the mentioned error-Cause-Products used in the migration file does not have a Net Value maintained, the Net Value is 0 and the Product is not maintained in a Price List that is valid for the Sales Order. Therefore, the price calculation fails, the document becomes inconsistent and cannot be released.-Please note:-When the value "0.00" is maintained in the Net Value field in Excel Migration Template for Open Sales Orders,  the system ignores the value as 0/No Value due to a technical limitationa.-If you want the Product to have a List Price of 0,00 you will need to maintain the Product in a Price List with 0,00.-Resolution-Either maintain List Price in the Price List or maintain a Net Value in migration template and proceed with migration.-Keywords-Net Value, Sales Order, Open Sales Order, List Price, Pricing, Action Release not possible

Title: Error: 'Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code' (Spain)
Content: Symptom-While migrating Employee Data - Spain into the system, error message is displayed: 'Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Employee Data - Spain activity and select it.-Click open the same or click Change Immediately.-Click on Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool.-Select the File with Migration Status In Process.-Click Execute Migration and select Execute Migration Step by Step.-During Simulation Import, error message is displayed: 'Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code'.-Cause-The issue is because of incorrect Bank Account Number maintained in the migration template. For country Spain, the IBAN format - ESAA-BBBB-CCCC-DD-XXXXXXXXXX-ES = Spain-AA = Check Digits-BBBB = Bank Code-CCCC = Branch Code-DD = National Check Digit-XXXXXXXXXX = 10 digits Bank Account Number-If the Bank Account Number is entered as "XXXXXXXXXX", then the error message is displayed. The Bank Account Number field in the migration template should have 20 digits number and this number is called as BBAN - Basic Bank Account Number. This number can be generated from IBAN. For example, if the IBAN = ESAA-BBBB-CCCC-DD-XXXXXXXXXX, then the BBAN (Basic Bank Account Number) is BBBB-CCCC-DD-XXXXXXXXXX.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-See Also-KBA 2917594 - Migration: Bank Account Number Not Valid According to Check Digit Calculation Code-Keywords-Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code, Employee migration error, Check Digit Not Valid

Title: Determination of Delivery Address in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-This material explains how the Delivery Address is copied to the Shopping Cart when using the option "Shopping Cart (Advanced)".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view and Self-Services Overview sub-view. -Select Go Shopping (Advanced) option.-Fill the fields "Recipient" and "Ship-to/Service Location".-OR-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks view and Go Shopping sub-view. -Fill the fields "Recipient" and "Ship-to/Service Location".-OR-Go to Project Team work center.-Go to Common Tasks view and Go Shopping sub-view. -Fill the fields "Recipient" and "Ship-to/Service Location".-The Delivery Address is determined automatically. -Cause-When the user provides a value against Recipient, the Delivery Address is copied onto the Shopping Cart from the Workplace Contact Data of the employee Master Data.-When the user provides a value against Ship-to/Service Location, the Delivery Address is copied onto the Shopping Cart from the Site Address of the supply chain design location Master Data.-Note 1: when both the fields are fulfilled, then the Delivery Address is selected from Ship-to/Service Location. -Note 2: when the user creates the Shopping Cart via option "Go Shopping", by default the creator (user) will be the Recipient.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. -See Also-KBA: 2038134 - Changed Address Data for Employees are Not Taken Over in New Shopping Cart-Keywords-Determination, Delivery Address, Shopping Cart, Recipient, Ship-to, Service Location

Title: Error Message: Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code
Content: Symptom-Error message is thrown when trying to add a New Bank Account:-'Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the My Banks view.-Select the bank entity and click Edit Bank Accounts.-Create a new bank account record.-Error message is displayed: 'Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code'.-Cause-Ideally system cannot mis-interpret the bank account number by itself.-The bank account number is checked against the Check digit calculation code provided in the Bank Directory of the My Bank.-The Check digit calculation code and the bank account number are to be provided by the bank.-Resolution-The check digit calculation code must be validated in the Bank Directory for My Banks and the bank account number with the respective bank.-Keywords-new bank account; Bankkonto erstellen

Title: Error message: Changing Valid to not possible during Fixed Asset Migration
Content: Symptom-Error messages: "Changing Valid to not possible; Field is read only and No individual material assigned while migrating the Fixed assets using the Migration Tool".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and select Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend.-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity and click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration unit and select Execute Migration.-Simulate the migration, then you get the Error messages: Changing Valid to not possible; Field is read only and No individual material assigned-Cause-You have not maintained the valuation view for the fixed asset classes and need to be maintained to execute the migration of fixed asset successfully.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and perform the action Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine tune.-Select the activity Fixed Asset Classes.-On the new screen click on Edit Fixed Assets Classes.-Select the fixed asset class which you are using and check the bottom section Default Valuation Settings.-Add a row for the valuation view YYY(YYY means valuation view)--Once you maintain the valuation view for all the classes the migration will be executed without any errors.-See Also- 3541654 - Error Message: 'Low Value Asset Max/Min Amounts Missing for crcy AB and actg ppl. 1234' during Fixed Asset Migration-Keywords- Changing Valid to not possible, No individual material assigned, Fixed assets migration error

Title: Purchase Order Approval Task Is Unassigned
Content: Symptom-You define the Approval Process with Work Distribution Rule as Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager and Order a new Purchase Order. System fails to find the Approver for the approval task of the Purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to the Approval Processes View.-Select the active Purchase Order Approval Process.-Check the Work Distribution: Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager maintained for the purchase order approval process.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Select New Purchase Order.-Fill in all the mandatory details.-Select Order button.-Cause-System fails to find an approver to a Purchase order due to any of the Below mentioned cases:-Case 1: Employee is not assigned to a Reporting Line Unit: The creator of the purchase order is not assigned to any org unit.-Case 2: Reporting Line Unit to which the employee is assigned does not have a manager.-Case 3: The Manage My Area Work center is not assigned to Reporting Line Unit Manager or does not have the proper authorization to approve the PO.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to get the approval task assigned with an approver:-Case 1: The purchase order is created by a service agent who is not assigned to any org unit. Follow the below steps to hire a service agent:-Go to the Personnel Administration Work Center.-Select the Regular Tasks View.-Under the Hiring section, select the Hire Service Agent as Employee link.-Select the value help of the Service Agent field, where the service agent is missing.-Case 2: Assign manager to the Reporting Line Unit to which the employee is assigned.-Case 3: Assign the Manage My Area Work center to Reporting Line Unit Manager.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Approval Process, Task, Approver, Reporting Line Unit Manager

Title: Error "Different ship-from locations assigned to items in delivery group" Occurs When Creating a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When creating a sales order with two items having different Ship-From values, the following error occurs:-"Different ship-from locations assigned to items in delivery group A" ("A" represents the name of the group).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select the Sales Order view.-Find Sales Order ABC (ABC represents ID of the sales order).-Select View All button and add two line items in Items tab.-Select two different Ship-From value for two items.-Select the Delivery Rule as: Single Delivery - full quantity.-An error occurs stating Different ship-from locations assigned to items in delivery group A ("A" represents name of the group)-Cause-If the Delivery Rule is chosen as Single Delivery - full quantity, the Ship-From address should be consistent or same for all the items.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Find out Sales Order ABC (ABC represents ID of the sales order)-Select View All button and add two line items in Items tab.-Enter two different Ship-From value for the two items.-Select the Delivery Rule as Multiple Deliveries.-Keywords-Ship-From, Delivery Group, Delivery Rule, Sales Order-cm_cda_dcitm:manual_shipfrom_differ

Title: Sales Or Service Order Is Still In Process Instead Of Completed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You find the service or sales order is still in status In Process instead of Completed. In the item details, you see the invoice status is not finished, however, all the items were invoiced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open certain sales order, you can see the general status is In Process.-Go to the Items tab, the Delivery Status is Finished and the Invoice Status is In Process or Not Started, however all the items are actually invoiced. You can find the invoices in the Invoice Documents work center view.-The sales order status is incorrect.-Cause-One of the most probable cause of the issue is failing XI message from Customer invoicing to Sales Order or Service Order.-In case if the document is older there is no way to find such messages.-How to check if the invoice has updated order:-Open the respective order in BO test shell (sesfts).-From root navigate to BTD_REFERENCE node.-Look for BTD_REF-TYPE_CODE = 28 (if there are many instances with this value, a better way is to sort the list on this column).-If there is no value for BTD_REF-TYPE_CODE = 28 -> no message from invoice has been successfully delivered to Order.-If there are values:Take a note of values in column BTD_REF-ID-Content for all the instances having BTD_REF-TYPE_CODE= 28. These are the invoice ID's which have already been communicated via messages.-Now open the order in UI. Go to View All. Go to Document flow tab.-Now check if there is any released customer invoice shown in the Document Flow which is not in the noted customer invoice from step 4.-Resolution-Go to transaction SE38-Run program APCI_TST_TRIGGER_RECON_OPA-Give the customer invoice ID and check the relevant option below (Confirm Sales order/Confirm Service order/Confirm Service confirmation).-Keywords-undelivered message, in process, unfinished, invoiced, status, not completed, invoice

Title: Approval Note is Not Available in Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-You have sent back an approval task of customer invoice for revision with a note. You expect this approval note is available in the customer invoice. But it is not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Select the Approval task of customer invoice ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice)-Select Edit and add notes in the right bottom-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Find and open the customer invoice ABC.-Navigate to Approval Note section in General tab.- The expected approval note is not available in the customer invoice.-Cause-Currently approval note is not copied down to the customer invoice documents.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Invoice; Approval Note; Approvals; Revision

Title: Error Message E-mail Address is Invalid: Not listed in Allowed Email Domain
Content: Symptom-When trying to send a sales quote via E-Mail getting error message: E-mail Address is Invalid: Not Listed in Allowed Email Domain.-This error may also appears when sending other business document like purchase orders.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Sales work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Open Sales quote ABC (ABC represents sales quote ID).-Click on the Actions button.-Click on Submit button.-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Choose Sales quote ABC (ABC represents sales quote ID) and click edit.-Click You Can Also and choose Edit Outputting Settings.-Change the Send By field to E-Mail.-The error message "E-mail address is invalid: Not listed in allowed email domain." ﻿occurs.-Cause-The DKIM key is not request for the sender e-mail domain.-The domain is not listed as allowed e-mail domain.-Resolution-In SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Sales work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Open Sales Quote ABC (ABC represents sales quote id).-Go to Involved Parties tab.-Here Party role Sales Unit has e-mail address example@example.com (example@example.com represents e-mail address).-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Choose Sales quote ABC (ABC represents sales quote id) and click edit.-Click You Can Also and choose Edit Outputting Settings.-Change the Send By field to E-Mail.-Go to the end of the pop-up page.-Here Sender E-mail Address has e-mail address example@example.com (example@example.com represents e-mail address).-Now follow the below steps:-Check whether DKIM key is activated for the domain of the e-mail address. If not, go to Step 2. If the DKIM key is already activated, go to Step 3.-Create a Case with the component SRD-CC-CI-CCS (for SAP Business ByDesign) or LOD-CRM-ADM (for SAP Cloud for Customer) or change the sender whose domain is DKIM activated. -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the configuration element E-Mail and Fax Settings and open it.-Click on the hyperlink E-Mail and Fax Settings.-Click the Add button in Allowed Sender E-Mail Domains.-Enter the example.com (example.com represents the domain)-Click the Save and Close button.-The sales quote can now be sent via e-mail to any e-mail address with this domain.-See Also-2233947 - Error Message When Trying to Send a Sales Quote Via E-Mail: E-mail Address is Invalid: Not Listed in Allowed Email Domain.--2937666 - DKIM Key Activation for sending the Business Emails in SAP Business ByDesign (ByD)-Keywords-Sales Quote, Purchase Order, Output Setting, DKIM key, E-mail domain, byd, c4c

Title: Unable to Download Add-In From Download Center in Business ByDesign - Workaround
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to download additional software in the Download Center due to the following error message:-"Could not get access to download area on SAP Service Marketplace."-This KBA provides an alternative method to download the Add-In from SAP FOR ME.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP For Me-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Choose Download Center.-Try to download the add-in-The mentioned error message should appear.-    Resolution-As a workaround, you can follow the below steps to download the add-in from SAP For Me.-Go to Link: https://me.sap.com/home-Go to Systems and Provisioning view-Under Optimize Your System, select Software Download Center-In the Search field enter the Add-In name (For e.g. Excel)-Now Select BYD_EXCEL_ADDIN (Maintain Software Component)-Under Downloads, select the Folder BYD_EXCEL_ADDIN 1305 -Now, Select BYD SYSTEM to see the available versions-Now click on the latest link to download the Add-In-NOTE:-Ensure to verify the Patch Level and the Release Date as highlighted below.-The Content information can be viewed under the Related Info column-Keywords-Download Error, Excel Add-In, Adobe LiveCycle Designer, Cloud Print Manager, Outlook Add-In, Add-In, Download Center, Could not get access to download area on SAP Service Marketplace

Title: System Proposing Incorrect Logistics Area During Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-The system proposes an incorrect logistics area during the Post Goods Receipt (PGR) against Purchase Order (PO).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Find relevant PO ID and select post goods receipt.-Now system proposes incorrect logistics area against the Location maintained in respective purchase order.-Cause-The system operates at the site level according to the hierarchy and strategy selection as per material flow rules however there are no specific settings to configure the logistics area based only on location alone.-Resolution-Kindly update requirement on Customer Influence forum:https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-2608268 - System is Proposing Wrong Logistics Area While Doing Post Goods Receipt-Keywords-PGR, Post Goods Receipt, Logistics Area, Incorrect, Purchase Order, PO, Material Flow Rules, Site Level, Hierarchy, Strategy Selection.

Title: Extended Processing Time for Issuing Goods in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Outbound delivery processing in SAP Business ByDesign is taking longer than usual, exceeding 2 minutes for deliveries with 3-4 line items.-This issue is impacting operational efficiency and user productivity, causing delays in fulfilling customer orders.-Environment-Outbound Delivery Request-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Proceed to the Delivery Proposal view.-Search the relevant  delivery proposal with id-Select it and choose the Post Goods Issue button.-The system takes more than one minute to display the screen.-Cause-The absence of material flow rules in the location.-In the absence of material flow rules, the system uses the default picking strategy which is Minimum Movements.-The strategy considers all bins that contain the requested material, and scans the entire inventory to proposes a source randomly.-if the stock overview has too many line items of a product(s) system will have to scan all the line items to identify a source. -Resolution-Maintaining the material flow rules will help eliminate this issue.-See Also-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Outbound Delivery, Processing Time, Post Goods Issue, PGI, Material Flow Rules, Operational Efficiency, User Productivity, Customer Orders.

Title: Migration Status Shows In Process After Completion of Migration.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Migration status shows In Process even after migration files are imported successfully and replicated in the system -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Example: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Navigate to Overview View.-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data-Chooses Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool-  Files are imported successfully and replicated in the system, still system shows migration is "In Process" State instead of Finished.-Cause-Inconsistency in Backend.-Resolution-Development team has to manually updated the Data from Backend.-Report an Incident to SRD-CC-MIG-DMC Development Team.-See Also-https://itsm.services.sap/now/cwf/agent/record/incident/a94829d73bc5de1013592e50c5e45a4c-Keywords-Migration Successful , Migration In process

Title: Changes in Output Settings are not Registered on the Change log for Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-Changes made in the Output Settings of a Manual Invoice Request or Invoice Document are not registered on the Changes tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For Manual Invoice Requests:-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Click on the Common Task New Manual Invoice.-Click on Save. The Manual Invoice now have an ID, and its changes should be registered on the Changes tab from now onwards.-Click on You Can Also -> Edit Output Settings.-Make any change on the Output Settings of a Business Document.-Click on Save.-Go to the Changes tab.-For Invoice Documents:-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Filter for All Invoice Documents.-Search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of an Invoice Document which is Not Released yet).-Click on Edit.-Click on View All.-Click on You Can Also -> Edit Output Settings.-Make any change on the Output Settings of a Business Document.-Click on Save.-Go to the Changes tab.-As a result for both documents, it is possible to see that the changes on the Output settings were not registered on the change log.-Cause-Changes on the Output Settings are not registered on the change log for any document.-If the Output Settings are changed, the final setting can be seen on the Output History of the Invoice Document after it is Released.- Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-changes, output settings, manual invoice request, customer invoice document, change log, tab, not registered, not displayed, not showing, byd.

Title: Unposted Source Document: Account determination missing for account determination group Other Income - Third parties error
Content: Symptom-Unposted source document (e.g.: Customer Invoice) with error:-Account determination missing for account determination group Other Income - Third parties. Choose the account determination for Sales. To define the account for chart of accounts 'ABC' go to tab 'Other Income'. Enter a general ledger account for 'Other Income - Third parties'.-(ABC represents the Account Determination Group)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents sub-view.-And search for your Source Document ID, in this case the Source Document is a Customer Invoice.-Select the ID and under the Details session you can see this error:-'Account determination missing for account determination group Other Income - Third parties. Choose the account determination for Sales. To define the account for chart of accounts 'ABC' go to tab 'Other Income'. Enter a general ledger account for 'Other Income - Third parties''-Cause-A company can only use an account determination profile if that profile has been assigned to the country for that company. -Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center > Overview -Search for the activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination'-Click on View button.-Under Account Determination section select Sales.-Select the Account Determination Profile.-Click Assign Countries/Region to Profile button-Click Add Row-Add the company country-Click OK-Click Save and close-Try to pose the unposted source document again-See Also-KBA 2284030 - Unposted Source Document Error: 'Account Determination Missing for Account Determination Group-Help Documentation - Define Account Determination for Each Subledger-Keywords-Account Determination, Customer Invoice, unposted, Financial Accounting, Error, Missing Account Determination,

Title: Confirmation Update Runs Failure Due to Temporary Lock Errors
Content: Symptom-System throws the error: "Technical error APACR_APPL_LOG 190; report an incident during confirmation update runs."-The error occurs during the execution of the Confirmation Update Runs in the Supply Planning work center.-The error is accompanied by locking errors.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center.-Select Confirmation Update Runs under Automated Actions.-Select the relevant Run ID and show All Logs.-Open the corresponding Application Log ID-Navigate to the Results tab and expand all sections.-here all errors are displayed.-Cause-The errors are identified as temporary lock errors. These occur when users edit sales orders during the start and end of the run, preventing the run from locking these orders. -Resolution-Adjust the frequency of the run from every 15 minutes to every 1 or 2 or more hours.-Ensure that users refrain from editing sales orders while the run is being executed.-Proceed with executing the run and check the results.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3312678-Keywords-Confirmation Update Runs, Supply Planning, Temporary Lock Errors, APACR_APPL_LOG 190, Run ID 20241104, Application Log ID 5198665, Sales Orders, Frequency Adjustment.

Title: Error: Conversion rate for ABC and DEF missing on DD.MM.YYYY when creating a manual payment
Content: Symptom-An error message "Conversion rate for ABC and DEF missing on DD.MM.YYYY" is encountered when creating a manual payment.-(ABC and DEF stands for the currency acronym)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work Center > Supplier Accounts view-Search for the desired Supplier Account and open it-Click on "Pay manually by" and select the Outgoing payment method-Click View All-Enter the required information-Under Bank Account ID, select the desired bank account-Inform the Payment Method-Click on "Post".-The error message "Conversion rate for ABC and DEF missing on DD.MM.YYYY" is displayed.-Cause-When trying to post the payment, the system performs some validations and one validation is if there is any configuration maintained in the Business Configuration Work Center > Global Settings for Payment activity > Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Method based on Amount. In this case, the system checks for all currencies which are maintained and subsequently validates whether the exchange rate has been maintained or not between these currencies.-If there is no exchange rate maintained between these currencies, the system throws this error.-Resolution-Review the settings of the "Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods based on Amount" under the Business Configuration Work Center > Overview > Global Settings for Payment activity.-Maintain an exchange rate between the affected currencies.-See Also-Keywords-Exchange rate, manual payment, outgoing, inconsistent exchange rate, prioritization, bank accounts, payment methods, Global Settings for Payment

Title: Missing 'Edit Time Sheet' Option in Project Team Work Center Common Tasks
Content: Symptom-The 'Edit Time Sheet' option is not available in the Project Team work center under Common Tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Project Team work center-Access Common Tasks-Observe that the 'Edit Time Sheet' option is not available.-Cause-The issue arises due to the absence of scoping for time recording in project management.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the open project and choose 'Edit Project Scope'.-Proceed to step 3, 'Scoping'.-Expand 'Project Management >> Project Planning and Execution'.-Scope the 'Time Recording' option.-Press 'Next' until the last step and press 'Finish' to complete the change.-Log out of the system and log in again for the changes to take effect.-The 'Edit Time Sheet' option should now be available in the Project Team work center under Common Tasks.-See Also-Keywords-Project Team, Common Tasks, Edit Time Sheet, Missing Option, Time Recording, Project Management

Title: Inbound Delivery Creation with Zero Quantity Without Reporting Deviation
Content: Symptom-The system allows the creation of an Inbound Delivery with a zero quantity without the need to report a deviation.-This behavior is observed when attempting to post goods receipt without a task.-Environment-Inbound Delivery Request-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Access the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search and select the relevant delivery notification document.-Click on the Post Goods Receipt button.-Enter zero in the Actual Quantity field.-Click on the Save and Close button.-Cause-This is a business flexibility provided to document business cases where no quantity has been received from the supplier shipment.-While using logistics tasks, additional options of documenting and recording deviations are available.-The Post Goods Issue screen is a dynamic screen for which multiple logistics documents like warehouse request, warehouse order, and warehouse confirmations are created in one step.-To keep the system performance optimal, functionalities like recording deviations are not available in the Post Goods Issue screen.-Note : The system displays a warning message "Zero quantity is entered for the Fulfillment item XX" (XX represents line item ID) when zero quantity is entered for awareness of the user. -Resolution-If a system behavior enhancement is believed to be necessary, post the request in the Customer Influence Forum.-See Also-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, Zero Quantity, No Deviation Report, Post Goods Receipt, Inbound Logistics, Actual Quantity, Business Flexibility, Logistics Tasks, System Performance, Customer Influence Forum.

Title: Incorrect Invoicing Unit Name Displayed in the Advance Search for the Invoicing Unit
Content: Symptom-When entering the Org Unit ID in the Advance Search in the Invoicing Unit field, the Invoicing Unit Name is not displayed as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoice Documents View.-Click on the Advanced Filter.-Click on the value help button of the field Invoicing Unit.-In the search field, insert ABC (ABC represents the Org Unit ID).-In the results the the Invoicing Unit Name for Invoicing Unit ABC is displayed as XXX (XXX represents the Invoicing Unit Name).-Also when manually entering ABC in the Invoicing Unit field, the result is displayed and ABC - XXX. -You expect the Invoicing Unit Name to be displayed as YYY since this is the Org Unit Name maintained in your Org Structure for the Org Unit. -Cause-The Invoicing Unit Name is mapped to the Business Partner Name of the Associated Business Partner of the Org Unit.-The Associated Business Partner ABC has the Business Partner Name XXX, hence the Invoicing Unit Name is displayed as XXX.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Select the Org Structures View.-Set the effective date as "today".-Click on the Find button.-In the search field, insert ABC.-Click on the Locate button.-Navigate to the Definitions tab.-Under the Legal Definitions section, open the Business Partner by clicking on the hyperlink.-Change the Business Partner Name from XXX to YYY.-Save the changes.-Enter the Invoicing Unit ABC in the Advance Search in the Customer Invoicing work center. The Invoicing Unit Name will now be displayed as YYY.-See Also-InfoDoc 828585 / 2021 / BYD2111 Wrong company name / SAP Delivered Support [Link](https://support.wdf.sap.corp/sap/support/message/002075129500008285852021)-Keywords-Invoicing Unit Name, Org ID, Org Unit Name, Invoice Documents, Invoice Requests, Incorrect Name, Business Partner Name, Description, Organizational Management, Org Structures, Definitions tab, Legal Definitions, Business Partner, Advance Search, Customer Invoicing.

Title: Error when adding planning mark and reporting point in Operation of Bill Of Operations
Content: Symptom-When editing the Production Bill Of Operation, 500 error occurs while adding a planning mark and reporting point under required operation.-The system displays the error message: "500 SAP Internal Server Error".-This issue prevents it from editing Bill of operation and impacts the normal production progress.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production master data work center.-Go to the Bill of Operations view and find required BOO ID.-Select relevant operation and choose Insert.-Mark the checkboxes for Planning mark and Reporting point.-The system throws an error.-Cause-There is a synchronization issue between the planning view of the Bill of Operations and the Bill of Operations hierarchy.-Resolution-Go to the Planning and Production master data work center.-Find the required Bill of Operations and edit it.-Go to the Planning View Tab.-Choose "Update planning view button" for synchronization.-Save and Close, then reopen the Bill of Operation.-Go to the Structure and select relevant operation-Choose insert and mark the checkboxes for Planning mark and Reporting point.-System updates the changes.-Save and close the BOO.-See Also-Keywords-Bill of Operations, Planning mark, Reporting point, Error, SAP Internal Server Error, Synchronization, Production Model,

Title: Error in Lead Creation Through Business Card Scanning in SAP Application in Mobile
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Users experience an error message when attempting to create a lead through the Follow-Up button after scanning a business card and completing information extraction.-Lead creation does not proceed as expected, impacting workflow continuity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to Mobile URL by using the respected customer Tenant URL-Open the app and navigate to My Customer Interactions-Tap the "+" button to initiate business card scanning-Add a description and tap Scan to include the business card image-Tap Extract to capture information from the card-Once extraction completes, attempt to create a lead via the Follow-Up button Error occurs as below.-Your entries have been saved.-You are not able to open this link due to a missing work center view assignment.-Cause-The error occurs due to a missing Work Center (WoC) assignment for the user in the SAP system. This assignment is required for the lead creation function to operate correctly.-Resolution-These are resolution steps need to follow to solve the issue-Assign the Missing Work Center: The customer should assign the specific work center required for lead creation. This can be done by following the steps in SAP Note 2749403 , which provides detailed instructions on assigning a work center to a user.-Collaborate with the IAM Team: If there are uncertainties about the exact work center to be assigned, consult the IAM team for verification.-If configuration-related questions persist, or if functional guidance is needed, connect with the CRM PS team for further assistance.-Keywords-Your entries have been saved, lead creation, Error, follow up

Title: Address of employee in Personnel Administration is deleted while creating address for Business Partner with webservice ManageBusinessPartnerIn
Content: Symptom-When creating a new address for business partner by webservice ManageBusinessPartnerIn with payload like following, the private address of employee in Personnel Administration is deleted.-                <AddressInformation actionCode="01" addressUsageListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">-                    <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>AddressInformation</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-                    <AddressUsage actionCode="04">-                        <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>006</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-                        <AddressUsageCode>XXDEFAULT</AddressUsageCode>-                    </AddressUsage>-                    <Address actionCode="01" telephoneListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-                        <EmailURI>test@example.com</EmailURI>-                        <PostalAddress>-                            <CountryCode>DE</CountryCode>-                        </PostalAddress>-                    </Address>-                </AddressInformation>-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is a designed system behavior. As for data structure, employee address is coming under Business Partner. Address usage XXDEFAULT can only exist once across all address information records. Therefore, before calling the webservice, the existing address with address usage XXDEFAULT is deleted.-Resolution-Remove XXDEFAULT in the payload. Once XXDEFAULT is removed, it will not influence the address in Personnel Administration.-Keywords-Address, Deleted, ManageBusinessPartnerIn, XXDEFAULT, Business Partner, Employee

Title: Error in Return Processing Due to Failed Tax Calculation
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs when opening Return XYZ (XYZ represents the Return ID):-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again. -When clicking on the Update Pricing button and selecting Completely in the Pricing tab the following errors are displayed in case Vertex is in scope: -No result returned by external provider-Vertex Error: An unit based tax rule cannot be applied to a line item with a quantitiy of zero. Please ensure that the quantity is not zero and retry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Open Return XYZ.-The error "Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again" occurs.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Click on the Update Pricing button and select Completely.-The errors "No result returned by external provider" and "Vertex Error: An unit based tax rule cannot be applied to a line item with a quantity of zero. Please ensure that the quantity is not zero and retry" occur.-Cause-The error "Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again" occurs because the Credited Quantity is 0 ea. Since the item has a 0 quantity no price can be determined and therefore also no tax can be calculated.-The Planned quantity is the quantity that is planned to be returned as per the Customer Return Delivery Notification.-The credited quantity is the quantity that actually was returned as per Customer Return Delivery (Inbound Delivery).--As per the standard process, you should not create an Inbound Delivery until the product and the actual quantity is returned.--If you have an Inbound Delivery Request that in the end turns out that no product is actually returned, you need to cancel the Inbound Delivery Request instead of creating an Inbound Delivery with 0 fulfilled quantity.-If you check for example Return XYZ.-In the Document Flow you can see that the Return was created from Customer Return Delivery Notification ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Return Delivery Notification).-The Item has the Delivery Notification Quantity 1 ea (hence, this is the planned quantity in the Return).-The fulfilled quantity in Inbound Delivery EFG is 0 ea (hence, this is the credited quantity in the Return) (EFG represents the ID fo the Inbound Delivery).-That would mean that the products were not returned.-If no product was returned, you should have cancelled the Customer Return Delivery Notification ABC.-If a product was returned but by mistake you created the inbound Delivery EFG with a 0 ea quantity you need to cancel the Return and Inbound Delivery.  -Resolution-Cancel the Return and the Inbound Delivery.-Create a new Inbound Delivery with the Fulfilled Quantity as 1 ea and then release.-Process the newly created return.-Before cancelling the Return, enter the Credited Quantity 1 ea in the Items tab so that the Return will be consistent and can be cancelled without any issues.-See Also-Refer to KBA 2936830 - How to Cancel a Customer Return-Keywords-Return, Tax calculation failed, KBA: 2744399, Error, No result returned by external provider, Vertex Error, Unit based tax rule, Quantity of zero, Inbound Delivery, Credited Quantity, Sales Orders, Returns, Pricing, Update Pricing, Cancel, Fulfilled Quantity.

Title: How to deactivate an extension scenario in Purchase Order?
Content: Symptom-How to deactivate the existing extension scenario in a Purchase Order -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Resolution-The extension scenario can be deactivated / removed using the following steps :-Go to the Purchase Requests & Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Edit the Purchase Order ID, in the opened window, select Adapt -> Enter Adaptation mode ->then Edit screen.-Select the section General Information -> Extension fields tab, select the extension field which you have created and select the Further Usage link.-In the opened window, go to the Extension Scenarios tab, in the second table, choose the extension scenario and select the Deactivate button.-Save & publish the extension field changes.-Keywords-Purchase order extension field, deactivate extension field

Title: The Error "Approved On date missing for cancellation invoice" is displayed when saving a Cancelation Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When saving a Cancelation Invoice in the system, the error message "Approved On date missing for cancellation invoice" is displayed in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Filter for All Invoice Documents.-Search for the Cancelation Invoice ABC. (where ABC represent the Invoice ID)-Open, Select View All.-Select Save button.-The error message "Approved On date missing for cancellation invoice" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The Date for the "Approved On" field was not populated in the table APCI_D_CI_ROOT for field INV_LEG_AUTH_DATE_TIME. Causing the error "Approved On date missing for cancellation invoice" when saving the Invoice.-Resolution-The "Approved On" field is a backend field which is not available to be changed in the UI.-In this case, it is required to request customer's approval to perform the backend correction confirming the exact date to populate the "Approved On" field, and afterwards kindly forward the case to the development team (Component: AP-CI-CI) in order for the date to be maintained for the "Approved On" backend field of the Cancelation Invoice.-Once a date is maintained for the "Approved On" field of the Cancelation Invoice in the backend, it will be possible to save/release the Cancelation Invoice successfully.-Keywords-cancelation invoice, approved on, field, backend, value, date, error, date missing for cancellation invoice

Title: Confirmed quantity is greater than Planned quantity of the production task.
Content: Symptom-The system allows the Confirmed Quantity of the Production Task to exceed the Planned Quantity without displaying a warning message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search the Task ID ABC (ABC represents Task ID).-Choose Confirm.-Enter the Confirmed Quantity greater than the Planned Quantity.-Choose Save.--The system accepts it without displaying any warning message.-Cause-This process is supported by SAP Business ByDesign and is designed to provide the flexibility to enter the Confirmed Quantity greater than the Planned Quantity.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Production Order; Task Control; Confirmed quantity; Planned quantity; SAP Business ByDesign; No Warning; Production Control; Exceeds; Flexibility

Title: Creating a Report for Material IDs and HSN Codes
Content: Symptom-A report containing Material ID and HSN code of a product is required.-No standard report with this information is identifiable.-Environment-Inventory-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Analytics work center.-Proceed to the Design Reports view.-Attempt to identify a report which provides both Material ID and HSN codes for the products.-Cause-Not all reports are available as standard reports.-A new report with the relevant Data source needs to be created.-The data source with id: MATERIAL, which contains the fields Material ID and HSN code, should be used.-Resolution-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Navigate to the Data Sources view.-Search and select the Data Source with id "MATERIAL".-Choose the button New and select the option Report.-Follow the steps in the report creation wizard to create the report.-See Also-Keywords-Material ID, HSN code, Business Analytics work center, report creation, Data Source, MATERIAL.

Title: "554 4.4.7 Message expired: unable to deliver in 840 minutes" Error in Document Output
Content: Symptom-You are sending a document output via e-mail, however the status of the output history entry shows an error.-Upon clicking on the error to see the details, you can see the following log:-"554 4.4.7 Message expired: unable to deliver in 840 minutes.<451 4.2.0 Internal queueing error>"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For this KBA, we will take as an example a Purchase Order:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Enter the Purchase Orders view.-Open the respective purchase order.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Click on the Error link to open the details of the output error.-Here you can see the error message.-Cause-The error code "554 4.4. 7" indicates a delivery error. This is generally caused when the target e-mail server is offline or unreachable. This may also indicate that the recipient e-mail server is blocking/bouncing back the e-mails sent from Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Please check directly with the recipient for blocks or offline e-mail servers in order to ensure that the e-mails coming from the Business ByDesign server are not being rejected.-Keywords-DKIM, timeout, expired, PO, sender, recipient

Title: Unable to Scope the Question for Inventory Postings beyond 6 months
Content: Symptom-The document has a date that is more than 6 months in the past.-In Business ByDesign, there is a restriction in place that prevents inventory postings beyond six months in the past.-The system throws an error while confirming the document : Actual Delivery Date must be between and today.-An option is available to enable postings beyond six months in the past. This can be set up in the Business Configuration of your Implementation Projects however the checkbox is greyed out-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center. -Search for the relevant implementation project and choose the Edit Project Scope button. -Navigate to the Scoping section and make sure that the option Inventory Posting is selected from the sub-element Inventory Management under the scoping element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics.-Move to the Questions section and expand the scoping element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics.-Under Inventory Management select Inventory Postings. -Select the question: Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months?.-Here Checkbox is greyed out for the question.-Cause-To enable scoping question for posting beyond 6 months, it is necessary to mark the scoping element "Quality Assurance" as a prerequisite.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center. -Search for the relevant implementation project and choose the Edit Project Scope button. -Navigate to the Adjust Scoping section and make sure that the option Quality Assurance is selected from the sub-element under the scoping element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics.-Once it is done, in next guided activity :Review questions -> checkbox gets enabled for question: Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months?.-Review the question and complete the guided activity.-See Also-2831591 - Actual Delivery Date Must Be Between DD.MM.YYYY And Today-1938088 - Changes in the Business Configuration Are Not Reflecting in the System-Keywords-Inbound Warehouse Tasks, Inventory Posting Restriction, Business Configuration, Implementation Projects, New Change Project, Quality Assurance, scoping, business configuration, inventory, Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months?.

Title: Tasks Displayed in Incorrect Language When Logged in with a Different Language (e.g. Finnish)
Content: Symptom-When logging in with Finnish as the selected language, tasks are displayed in a different language, such as Chinese, rather than Finnish.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the system in Finnish language-Navigate to the Home workcenter-Go to Inbox view-Select Subscribe to Tasks-Observe that task subjects are displayed in Chinese or, in some cases, another incorrect language instead of Finnish.-Cause-SAP does not maintain English as the default fallback language for the tasks.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Chinese, Language, Business Task, BTM, Subscribe to Tasks, Finnish

Title: Error When Creating Subsequent Credit for Invoice
Content: Symptom-System shows "Invoice document ABC not found or not valid" at the bottom of the screen when attempting to create a new subsequent credit. (ABC represents the selected invoice/credit memo document to create subsequent credit on)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Supplier Invoice and Credit Memo View.-Enter Invoice ID ABC, and highlight the invoice.-Select New - Subsequent Credit button.-You receive the message "Invoice document ABC not found or not valid".-Cause-Invoice ABC only contains one additional cost debit item. -Resolution-The creation of a subsequent credit is only supported when it refers to posted invoice items or credit memo items and increases the credit on the invoice or reduces the debt on the credit memo. It is not supported for additional cost debit items. For more information, please check Help Portal: Create a Subsequent Credit or Debit -See Also-Help Portal: Create a Subsequent Credit or Debit -Keywords-Subsequent Credit, Additional Cost Debit Item, Supplier Invoice, Invoice document not found or not valid

Title: Error Message "Bank transfer payment method requires a main bank account" When Changing Employee Payment Information
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**WAITING FOR VALIDATION, if proven, change status to Released to Customer and remove this statement*** -An error message "Bank transfer payment method requires a main bank account" is displayed when attempting to change the main bank account for an employee in the Personnel Administration.-The issue occurs when selecting a bank account with payment method Bank Transfer as the Main Bank Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Personnel Administration work center.-Navigate to Employees view-Search for the affected employee-Edit the employee-Open tab Personal Data.-Open subtab Payment Information.-Remove the Main Bank Account flag of the current main bank account and flag another bank account as Main Bank Account. -Save.-All flags are removed.-Again, flag another bank account as Main Bank Account. -Save.-Error:  "Bank transfer payment method requires a main bank account".-Resolution-There are two options to mark the bank account as Main Bank Account:-One option is a checkbox in the row of the line item.-Another option is a checkbox in the Bank Details section.-Both options needs to be marked.-Keywords-Error Message, Bank Transfer, main bank Account, Change Employee Payment Information, Personnel Administration, Bank 3473, IBAN IT17A0301503200000005868464, Main Bank Account, Checkbox.

Title: Rejected Items Still Showing in Pick Task in Task Control
Content: Symptom-Items that have been rejected are still appearing as open in the pick task.-The issue occurs even after reversing the confirmation and cancelling all the way back to the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Outbound Logistics work center.-Access Task Control view.-Search for Task ID XYZ. (XYZ means Task ID)-Observe that two line items with open quantity are still showing in the confirm pick task.-Cause-The deviation reason was not maintained when confirming the pick task.-Resolution-It is necessary maintain a deviation reason to the open quantity rejected to confirm the pick task.-Navigate to Outbound Logistics work center.-Access Task Control view.-Search for Task ID XYZ.-Navigate to the line items with open quantity in the pick task.-Set a deviation reason for the open quantity rejected.-Confirm the pick task.-See Also-Refer to KBA 2174763 - Pick Task is Still in Process Even After Delivering the Complete Requested Quantity.-Keywords-Outbound Logistics, Pick Task, Rejected Items, Open Quantity, Deviation Reason, Confirmation.

Title: Employee Details are Displayed Blank in Time Administration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Users are unable to see particular employee details in Time Administration the screen appears to be blank/details of the employee is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time administration work center-Select Employees-Search for the effected Employee-Select and Edit Time File-Empty screen - No data is visible-  Note: This is not reproduced by support user-Cause-The root cause is not yet found but there is an issue on the HCM side with the ACL (access control list) of the Employee BO.-Resolution-Steps to confirm if there is an inconsistency:-Go to the Transaction SESFTS.-Load Employee BO.-Load by Query-> Identification Query by Employee Attributes and Fill the Employee ID /Content field and search.-Navigate to root.-Navigate from Root -> ACCESS_CONTROL_LIST node.-Navigate to ENTRY there will be no record here.-Steps to resolve:-To correct this issue, go to Transaction SE38 and load the program 'AP_PAD_ADJUST_ACL_ENTRIES'.-IMPORTANT NOTE:-Discuss with ByD Technology PAL if there is any need to execute this report.-Later, Execute for one employee in Test Mode to verify whether the result is correct.-DO NOT attempt to execute the report for All Employees.-Finally, -Execute the report and check the Steps 1 to 6 again - there should be records now.-Keywords-Blank Screen, employee ID, employee name, time administration

Title: 500 Internal Error happened while activating an organization unit.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When attempting to activate an organization unit, a pop-up message which requests to raise an incident appears. Expand the detail information, 500 Internal Error appears and checking in backend T-code ST22, the application information is following.-Application Information-Index Information-    1 Triggering application component: AP-RC-ADS-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management -> Org Structures.-Click Edit.-Select the issued Org.-Click Activate -> Activate Selected and Dependent Org Units.-Cause-The error is from address snapshot. Title: Error: 'Origin invoice reference not completely specified for document ID ABC.' in Supplier Invoice.
Content: Symptom-Encountered an error while trying to post blocked Supplier Invoice in the General Ledger related to the closing of the period.-Error message: 'Fiscal year XYZ closed for set of books DEF and company 123'-When attempting to post in an open period, a different error message appears: 'Origin invoice reference not completely specified for document ID ABC. Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions'-(XYZ represents the Fiscal Year)-(DEF represents the set of books)-(123 represents the company ID)-(ABC represents the Template ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents subview.-Search for related Unposted source document ID.-Attempt to post the business transaction to another period.-The following error message appears:-'Origin invoice reference not completely specified for document ID ABC.'-'Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions'-Cause-The issue arises due to the deletion of the reference Invoice Template ABC, which was used for creating a supplier invoice. The business transaction cannot be posted for this supplier invoice to accounting in an open period due to the absence of the reference template. Follow the steps below to check the same:-Open the unposted Supplier Invoice. -Click "View All". -In "Reference Document" section > References > Invoice Template ABC. -Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select "Templates" option in the dropdown menu.-Search for Template ID: ABC.-Here there is no template with ID: ABC. -Resolution-Since the reference template of Supplier invoice does not exist, the business transaction cannot be posted in the accounting. If there is an updated cancelation invoice, the recommended way is to mark the business transaction as irrelevant:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents subview. -Search for related unposted cancellation supplier invoice. -Click "Actions" button > View Business Transaction. -Click "Mark as Irrelevant" button. -Always check the version number of an unposted Supplier Invoice:-•        If it is version 1 and an unposted reversal/ cancellation exists, the Supplier Invoice can be marked as irrelevant in the UI (by marking the reversal/ cancellation as irrelevant, which then also marks the original).-•        If the version is 1 and the document is a reversal/ cancellation check if the original SIV, version 1 is also unposted, then marking as irrelevant will work again in the UI.-  See Also-Keywords-Unposted, Business Transaction, Error, General Ledger, Blocked Documents, Invoice Template, Supplier Invoice, Origin invoice reference not completely specified for document ID ABC.

Title: Unable to Use Migration Template to Create Supplier with Multiple Collaboration Email Addresses
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When updating Collaboration tab of Accounts using Migration tool, it throws an error message-Cannot create duplicate entries in Collaboration view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration -Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Customer.-Choose link to Migrate Customers using the Migration Tool.-Upload the file and use "Enhance Existing Record" Mode.-Select Execute Migration, then Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error message appears "Cannot create duplicate entries in Collaboration view".-Cause-The customer collaboration data doesn't support in migration tool, neither via Mass Data Maintenance.-Resolution-Raise an incident for the Dev team SRD-CC-MIG-DMC to generate a payload based on the specified requirements.-See Also-SAP Note KBA 3300454 - Error Message: "Cannot Create Duplicate Entries in Collaboration View" while Updating Collaboration Tab of Accounts - SAP for Me-Keywords-Customer Collaboration, CommunicationArrangement, ManageCustomerIn, Migration of Customer, Mass Data Maintenance, Customers.

Title: Error: '500 SAP Internal Server Error' When Executing the Start Time Valuation Run for an Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**Internal Use Only**-System dumps with the below error, when executing the Start Time Valuation Run for an employee.-"500 SAP Internal Server Error"- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter-Go to Employee workcenter view-Search for an Employee: ABC-Select a row and choose Action-Start Day-End Closing for this employee-Activate the checkbox to the left of "Start Time Valuation" and choose the start button to the right of it.-Enter date MM/DD/YYYY and choose "OK"-Notice, Internal Server 500 error.-Cause-A duplication dump occurs when 0021 (Transfer to project confirmation) entries are missing the calendar period item in the backend.-Dump Details:-Runtime Errors ASSERTION_FAILED-ABAP Program CL_DUPLICATE_PITEM============CP-Resolution-As a pre-requisite, the Employee should have the time recorded against the project. If yes, then follow the below path to verify if 0021(Transfer to project confirmation) entries are missing in the calendar period item:-Go to SESFTS transaction-Enter BO HCM_EMPLOYEE_SUPP_CO-Go to Load By BO Instance-Choose Load_By_Query-Select Query_By_Elements-Enter Employee-id in field EmployeeID/content-Double click on Time_Agreement-Navigate to Item-Navigate to Employee_time_Item-Navigate o Calendar_Period_Item-Select all records and navigate to Root-Notice in the field: Time_Valuation_Step_Code-Content, the entries 0021 is missing-Create an incident to SRD-HR-TLM development team to add an entry in the debug mode.-Keywords-CL_DUPLICATE_PITEM, Start Time Valuation, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, Employee

Title: How to notify the Manager when a user opens a Purchase Request?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to activate a notification when a user opens a Purchase Request?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Resolution-It is not possible to notify a user when the Purchase Request is opened. But on Create / every save, an email notification can be triggered. Kindly refer to the below SAP Documentation:-Workflow Rules Quick Guide | SAP Help Portal-  Alternatively, you can also set up the Task Subscription according to the requirement , by following the below steps, which will trigger the email notification. -Go to Home work center -> Inbox view -> Expand the Purchase Request task, and set up the task subscription as per the requirement. -Keywords-Notification subscription , email notification on purchase request, notification of opening a purchase request

Title: UI Dump When Manager Accesses Employee's Resource Availability Calendar Overview from Home Screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When accessing an employee directly from the Home screen and scrolling to view the resource availability, the system encounters a UI dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to managing My Area view-Directly choose employee-Scrolling to view the resource availability, the system encounters a UI dump-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report a case.-Details-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Cause-The issue is caused by an excessive number of project assignments for certain employees. When the system tries to fetch and organize all project tasks, services, and plans to display daily availability, the high volume of data leads to extended processing time, resulting in a UI timeout.-Resolution-Unassign any unnecessary projects or project tasks for the affected employees.-This will restore functionality to the resource availability view and improve performance when editing timesheets.-Note:-Dev need to provide us the below details:-1.    What’s the ideal or maximum number of projects one employee should have to keep everything running smoothly?-2.    Is there a suggested limit on how many worklist items an employee should have to avoid slowdowns?-Keywords-resource availability, UI Dump
