Title: Delete Button of BC set greyed out in Cloud Application studio.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-* ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** *  -Delete button greyed out for field values in Cloud Application studio for BC set.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Application Studio.-Open PDI solution.-Open BC set - XYZ_SET.bcc.-Under field values select any row and try to delete nothing happens.-Cause-If a customer-specific solution is in maintenance mode, it is not allowed to do changes to certain content types. These change and delete restrictions ensure that you do not make changes to a solution that could lead to loss of data or create inconsistencies or errors on a customer's production tenant. -Resolution-Delete the whole BC set and create new BC set.-See Also-Maintenance of Business Configuration Content.-Keywords-Business configuration content, field values, bcc, set, SDK, PDI.

Title: Error: 'Products with item group External Service  Time and Material not supported' Occurs When Entering a Service into a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs when entering a Service into a Sales Order:-Item XX: Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click on New and select Sales Order.-Enter the respective account.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add Service XYZ (XYZ represents the Service ID).-The following error message occurs:-Item XX: Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported-Cause-The item group RSTM - External Service – Time and Material is used as a place holder in Service Orders for Services that are requested but yet to be defined. The requested Service Item is replaced by concrete Services and Materials by the Service provider through planning, processing, reporting back, and invoicing the requested service.-This item group is only supported in the Service scenario (Service Orders) and not in the Sales scenario (Sales Order).-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-See Also-Further information on item types can be found in the Help Center Document Services-KBA 3216002 - Error: Item XX: Products with item group XYZ not supported-KBA 3509521- Error: 'Products with item group External Service – Time and Material not supported' Occurs When Entering a Service into a Service Order-Keywords-RSTM; Service; item type; item group; time and material; external service; not supported; sales order; quote;

Title: Issue with Automatic Release of Production Order Release Run
Content: Symptom-The Order Release Run under Production Control work center does not release the production order which is with In Preparation status as expected.-Environment-Production Planning Order-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Navigate to the Automated Actions view and choose the option Order Release Run.-Select the release run with id and execute the run.-When you check the application log, you can see that an order you expected to be picked up is Not Released picked up by the run to be released. -Cause-The Production Order Release Due Date was not in the Run Horizon nor in the past and hence not picked up by the run.-Run Horizon is a value maintained in the Production Order Release Run which determines which orders needs to be picked up for release, based on their "Production Order Release Due Date"-Resolution-Once the release due date is in the past or in the run horizon the order will be picked up.-See Also-Keywords-Order release run, Production order, Automated Actions, Production Control work center, Horizon, Release Due Date.

Title: MDR Instances can't be deleted
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to delete Run IDs (jobs) of a custom mass data run since the delete button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer -SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Custom Mass Data Run work center view.-Select an existing Run ID.-Note that the Delete button is greyed out or disabled. -Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-The delete button of an MDR instance is enabled when the selected MDR is Obsolete (or In Preparation) and it was never executed.-Resolution-If the Obsolete (or In preparation) Mass Data Runs in question have already been executed, it's correct for the button to be disabled.-Keywords-Delete Mass Data Run, Mass Data Run, MDR, Custom MDR, Delete, Disabled, Grayed Out, Mass Data Run OWL, Mass Data Run Screen, Mass Data run View.

Title: How to Resolve Closing Relevant Tasks from the Backend.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-There are some open Closing Relevant Task, but the actions tab is greyed out.-These are the tasks that should have been completed automatically once the Check Deposit is Confirmed. However, the task still has the status as In Process although no action is required for such tasks. There is no option to complete these tasks from the UI.-Task: Process Check Deposit with Overdue Transfer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center General Ledger.-Go to View Closing Cockpit.-Go to Closing Relevant Tasks sub view.-You will find the Incomplete tasks for Check Deposit. (Along with this you will also find the tasks like Payment Advice, Incoming Check)- Cause-Whenever the check deposit is released and set to In Transfer, System creates task to notify the users that it should be included in the Bank Statement to complete the process. These tasks should be finished automatically once the check deposit is confirmed in the Bank Statement.-Due to an underlying issue, these tasks could not be completed automatically. This issue has now been resolved. For existing documents, however, we need to execute a backend report to finish all such tasks.-Resolution-Login to the Backend.-Go to Transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL.-Provide the front-end tasks namely Very High, High, Medium and Low priority details (like Due date, Time and Priority etc from the Tasks) and give execute.-You will now find the relevant tasks which is stuck as Incomplete Task in the UI, select it and give Complete.-Now the mentioned task has been cleared in Closing Relevant Task sub view.-See Also-KBA 2094467 - How to Resolve Incomplete Tasks of Payment Advice, Incoming Check and Check Deposit. -Keywords-Payment Advice, Incoming Check, Check Deposit, Transfer, Bank Confirmation, Closing Cockpit, Closing Relevant Tasks, Incomplete Task, open task

Title: EUDP Backend Access Restriction De-activation Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In case of critical case which requires backend access from outside the EU for any reason, you can raise the “EUDP Access Restriction De-activation Request”.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Before you trigger the request please make sure that you are familiar with the WIPS document EU Access Process, as well as the prerequisites are fulfilled:-All other possible avenues have been exhausted – including, but not limited to, utilizing colleagues physically on EU soil; using an internal test system; utilizing a “Person-in-the-middle” etc.-You need access to the backend of the customer’s system.-The customer has provided a waiver.-The Case priority is either Very High or High.-There is a documented urgency to have this resolved outside the possibility getting EU based colleagues to take over OR there is a knowledge gap that warrants this.-If the prerequisites above are fulfilled, please use the following template to request the EUDP Backend Access Restriction De-activation Request:-Download the template from the Attachments Section named as "EUDP Access Restriction Deactivation Request for BYD customer Customer Name.oft".-Note: The deactivation cannot be longer than 4 hours for security reasons. Please request it only at the time the Developer/Support Engineer starts working on the issue. If you need to extend it, please use the original request e-mail to do so.-See Also-KB0639122 - How to Temporarily Allow Global Remote Access by Deactivating the EU Access on SAP Cloud for Customer Systems-2630819 - How to temporarily allow global remote access by deactivating the EU Access setting using the Emergency Function (Cloud)-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, ByD, EUDP, EUDP Backend Access Restriction De-activation Request.

Title: PDI Data Source is Missing Data
Content: Symptom-You have created a data source via the Cloud Application Studio, however when you preview it in the system or when you create a report on it, you notice that some records from the system are not shown in the data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, select view Design Data Sources.-Search for your PDI data source and click on Preview.-Add the fields / variables as required.-Not all expected records are shown.-Cause-The content of a PDI data source is determined - among other settings - by the anchor node. One possible cause is that you have not set the anchor node to the ROOT node, but to a lower level node instead. Hence the data source will only show those records that have entries in that subordinate node.-Resolution-Please contact the creator of your PDI solution and request them to check the data source settings, and its anchor node in particular.-Keywords-PDI,Data Sources,Missing Data,Business Analytics

Title: Error: "GENERAL_ERROR Error during proxy processing (PART UNKNOWN (NULL))"
Content: Symptom-You receive error:"GENERAL_ERROR Error during proxy processing (PART UNKNOWN (NULL))", in external web service response even though they receive successful message in web service message monitoring payload response.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to frontend system.-Go to the Communication Arrangements subview.-Open the relevant communication arrangement -Note that the payload is triggered from the external system like CPI or ERP, however the SAP C4C or SAP ByDesign only receives response message and can be viewed here as Error:  "GENERAL_ERROR Error during proxy processing (PART UNKNOWN (NULL))"-OR-Open SOAP UI.-Load the WSDL for the respective service to a new project.-Select the operation and generate the request.-Enter the request XML.-Maintain the Authentication details.-Execute and you get the error in the Results window with Error: "GENERAL_ERROR Error during proxy processing (PART UNKNOWN (NULL))"-OR Same WDSL is working in another environment, for example, a Test Tenant.-Cause-The WSDL needs to have end point for the C4C in the response message payload  OR-The client receives HTTP 202 status code which indicates asynchronous behavior OR-The targetNamespace in the WSDL is incorrect for the endpoint -Resolution-The error could be resolved after adding the mandatory namespace to the response message. In the example sample below, the namespace used is "C4cCustomer"--    <soap:Body>-    <urn:CustomersReplicateResponse xmlns:urn="urn:C4cCustomer">-    <Message>-    <CdcResponse>-     ...-    <c4cRequestID>...</c4cRequestID>-    </Message>-    </urn:CustomersReplicateResponse>-    </soap:Body>-The called server should reply with http code 200 (OK). In case you are using CPI, please fix this in your custom iflow.-We do not support a unique targetNamespace per environment, please adapt the configuration accordingly. -Keywords-proxy processing (PART UNKNOWN (NULL), C4cCustomer, wsdl, response

Title: Payment Method is Not Displaying When Creating New Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Manual Invoice and the system is not displaying any Payment Method.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select New.-Select Manual Invoice.-Select Payment Method.-The system does not display any value.-Cause-In order for a Payment Method to be displayed for the Sales Orders or Manual Invoice Requests in the system, it is required to scope a Payment Methods question which is found under the Business Configuration.-You have not scoped either of the following scoping questions: -Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?-Do you want to use direct debit to receive payments from your customers? -Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Show All Current Projects and click Go.-Select the Implementation project.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Go to section 4-Questions by clicking on the Next button.-Select and expand the Cash Flow Management.-Select Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select Payment Methods.-Go to Group: Incoming Payments.-Depending on your requirements you can:-For Credit Cards select the question: "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?"-Once this is selected, the system will display the Credit Card option.-Please Note: To enable the Credit Cards, you will need to contact SAP support by creating a new case. Please see the help center document: Customer Payments by Credit Card-For Direct Debit select the question: "Do you want to use direct debit to receive payments from your customers?"-Once the scoping question was activated you can open the relevant account master data.-Go to the Financial Data tab, add the Direct Debit in payment method and maintain the Bank Account or maintain the SEPA Mandate details.-Once you follow these steps, you should be able to see Direct Debit in the drop-down list when creating new sales orders or new manual invoice requests.-See Also-2494505 - Payment Method not Displaying in the Sales Orders and Manual Invoice Requests-3105245 - Cannot Edit Payment Method for Customer Invoice-Keywords-Credit Cards, Customer Payment, Configuration Guide, Invoice, New, Manual

Title: Error Message "Scoping of SAP intelligent RPA Not permitted, eligible license missing" When Scoping iRPA
Content: Symptom-When you scope the iRPA scoping question (Do you want to enable integration with SAP Intelligent Robotic Process Automation?) system throws below error-Scoping of SAP intelligent RPA Not permitted, eligible license missing-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementations Projects view.-Select the First Implementation/Change project and select Edit Project Scope button-Go to Questions section-Expand: Communication and Information Exchange -> Integration with External Applications and Solutions-Select Integration Scenarios for Cloud Solutions from SAP-Check the question "Do you want to enable integration with SAP Intelligent Robotic Process Automation?"-Error Occurs when performing Finish-Cause-Scoping of iRPA is only allowed for Production Tenant and Test Tenant. if you are attempting to perform the scoping in any other tenant then this issue occurs (eg: Sales Demo tenant)-Resolution-You can scope IRPA in test and production systems.-Below is also an option to consider:-You can take advantage of the Intelligent RPA trial we offer to achieve the same functionality. Instructions on getting started with a trial version of SAP Intelligent RPA can be found here - Getting Started with the Free Plan for SAP Intelligent RPA.-Furthermore, you can use the trial version to gain access to the Desktop Agent component from the SAP Download Center by following the instructions listed here - On-premise Components Setup.-Once you complete the setup steps explained in Getting Started with a Trial Account in the Cloud Foundry Environment, you will be able to start testing and demoing Intelligent RPA bots for SAP Business ByDesign as described in How to Configure and Orchestrate your IRPA Cloud Factory-Keywords-IRPA, license, intelligent RPA, Intelligent Robotioc Prociessing Automation, License, lisense

Title: The Fiscal Year as Suffix is not showing as expected in Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing
Content: Symptom-The Fiscal Year as Suffix is not displayed as expected in the Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for: Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing-Click on Define document numbering formats for India-For Company XXX, Fiscal Year as Suffix is maintained. (XXX represents the company ID)-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Set of Books and Assigned Companies view.-For Company XXX, Set of Books ABCD. (ABCD represents the Set of Books ID)-Edit Fiscal Years-For example: Fiscal Year 2023 - is with First Day Of Fiscal Year: 04/01/2023 and Last Day Of Fiscal Year: 03/31/2024-Cause-For Country India the Fiscal Year as Suffix is from 1st April of a year to 31st March of the next year and not on the settings maintained in the Set of Books.-Therefore, if the indicator Fiscal Year as Suffix is active for the Document Numbering rule, the Fiscal Year is used as Suffix.-Example:-In the document numbering formats for India you activated the Fiscal Year as Suffix indicator for your rule.-You created an Invoice on the 01.05.2024 with the Tax Country India.-The Invoice created will have the ID XX-XX-2023 since it falls into the Fiscal Year 2023 (1st April of 2023 to 31st March 2024) for India.-For all other countries the Calendar Year is used as Suffix and the Indicator is also named in the Document Numbering Format Rules as Calendar Year as Suffix for all other countries.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Fiscal Year as Suffix; Edit Fiscal Years; Suffix; India; Year; Fiscal; Invoice; Document Numbering; Invoice Number; Invoicing; ID;

Title: Process Communication Error in Point of Sales Transaction
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-The following process communication error occurs for a Point of Sales Transaction: Only one coding block item permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Backend Transaction SRT_MONI.-You see an Erroneous XI Message.-Sender Party: PointOfSaleTransactionProcessing.-Receiver Party: InventoryProcessingInventoryChangingIn.-Error Information: Only one coding block item permitted.-Cause-The Point of Sales Document is created with a material and the payload includes the AccountingCodingBlockAssignment.-When a material is used, the account assignment is determined according to product and when this tag is passed then an additional accounting coding block instance exists and this leads to an error.-  Resolution-The customer has to cancel all respective documents and create a new Point of Sales Transaction.-However, the customer needs to ensure that for material the following tag needs to be removed from the payload.-                  <AccountingCodingBlockAssignment>-                     <AccountingCodingBlock>-                        <GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode>A-1500</GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode>-                     </AccountingCodingBlock>-                  </AccountingCodingBlockAssignment>-Once the transactions are canceled you can cancel the original XI message and the cancellation message in SRT_MONI-Keywords-POS; Point-Of-Sales; Process Communication Error; Only one coding block item permitted

Title: Erro while changeing the number range: Update for from number APCRMl_SALESQUOTE_IN failed; interval is already in use.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY***-While changing the number, there is an errror "Update for from number APCRMl_SALESQUOTE_IN failed; interval is already in use" or similar error triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The following reporduceing step is an example. This error will happen for all the Number Range activities.-Go to Business Configuration -> Overview.-Search for Number Ranges for New Business.-Upon changing the Number Range, error is displayed as "Update for from number APCRM1_SALESQUOTE_IN failed; Interval is already in use".-Cause-This error indicates that the value changed is already within the current number range setup.-Resolution-Verify the Number Range in the affected system in the UI by following the below steps:-Login to the affected system-Go to Business Configuration work center-Search for the activity Number Range for the issued object and it is possible to see the number ranger as from AAAAAAAA to BBBBBBBB, where AAAAAAAA represents the start number and BBBBBBBB represents the end number.-If try to modify the start number bigger than AAAAAAAA or the end number less than BBBBBBBB, the error will happen. If want to change this number range, it is possible to change it by clicking on Change Current Number and input the New Current Number Range as per requirement. The number range will kept but the next document ID will start after the new setting Current Number.-Note: Make sure whatever the Number Range is using is not already consumed in the system.-Also, if there is no Change Current Number button in frontend, it is also possible to change it from backend. It is possible to verify the number range from the backend by following below steps:-Login to the affected backend system.-Exeute the TCode SNRO.-Enter the BO as SALESQUOTE (BO name will shown in as the middle parts of the error.) and hit enter.-Click on Intervals.-In the new tab, click on Intervals with glasses icon again, the Start, End and Current Counter is here.-If the current number needs to be changed, follow below steps:-Login to the affected backend system.-Exeute the TCode SNRO.-Enter the BO as SALESQUOTE (BO name will shown in as the middle parts of the error.) and hit enter.-Click on Intervals.-In the new tab, click on NR Status.-Modify the NR Status.-Save.-If the change of number range from backend is necessary, get the confirmation and get it checked by the Dev team to do the changes accordingly.-Note: Make sure that the customer requirement is understood and the customer is sure about what they are requesting. Record all these in the incident.-See Also-2871171 - Error Message Update from Number APCRM1_SERVREQ_IN Interval is Already in Use-2279451 - Not Possible to Alter the Default Number Ranges for Customer Contract and Contract Template-2701433 - You are Unable to change the Number Range for Purchase Orders-Keywords-Number Range, APCRM1_SALESQUOTE_IN, New Business

Title: In Customer Return Assign Reference at Item Level Does Not Work As Expected
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign Sales Order as reference at item level of Customer Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the return).-Go to the Items tab and select the Assign Reference button.-You assign reference Sales Order ABC(ABC is id of the sales order).-You get an error message: Sales Order reference with ABC-XX not valid(ABC is the id of the sales order and XX is the line number of the product which you have as assigned reference).-Cause-The delivery status of line item XX in Sales Order ABC is not Finished and is still In Process. Hence the reference is not valid as the item is not yet completely delivered.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-If the delivery status of line item in sales order is still In Process then the reference line item of sales order needs to be delivered and status to be set as Finished. Once it is achieved, try and Assign Reference at Item level in Customer Return XYZ.-See Also-KBA 1913167 - The Function Assign Reference for Returns on Item Level Does not Work as Expected-KBA 2894762 - Customer Return is Inconsistent - Sales Order Reference Not Valid-Keywords-Customer Return; Assign Reference; Sales Order; Item; Error Message; Sales Order Reference with ID not valid; Inconsistent.

Title: Why System Is Not Fetching Source of Supply In The Purchase Request?
Content: Symptom-User is creating a purchase request and wants system to automatically determine the Source of Supply in the request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Common Taks-Select New Purchase Request (Manual)-Enter All details-Navigate to Item Tab and Enter Item-Navigate to Source of Supply Tab-You see the "Supplier" field is empty-Cause-The system does not automatically populate the source of supply when there is no active contract or list price available.-   Resolution-When there is active contract or list price available for the product and buying company, system proposes a source of supply according to sourcing rank.-When there is no active contract or list price available for the product and buying company, system searches for existing purchase orders and shows them in the "Assign source of supply" link under the "Source of Supply" sub-tab of the purchase document (Purchase order, Purchase request). The source of supply can be assigned by selecting one from the displayed purchase orders.-See Also-Regarding sourcing rank, refer to help document: Sourcing Rank in Assign Source of Supply-Keywords-Source of Supply; Purchase request; Assign Source of Supply; Supplier in purchase request

Title: Limitations in Using Print Queue APIs in PDI Solutions
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to build custom scenario to send documents to standard print queue using PDI solution.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP BusinessByDesign-Resolution-SAP provided 2 transformation definitions for this purpose:-Transformation definitions:-/DOC/OM_CREATE_PRINTQUEUE_ITEM - OutputManagementUtilities_CreatePrintQueueItem : Send the document binary content directly to the mentioned print queue-/DOC/OM_CREATE_PRTQ_ITEM_WT_FT - OutputManagementUtilities_CreatePrintQueueItemWithFormTemplate : Send the form data XML and template code for PDF generation using ADS call and then, send the PDF to the mentioned print queue.-Important Note:-Since these documents are not created through normal business flow, there will not be any traces of these documents in output management BOs. Therefore, document retrieval is not possible.-The ‘Document Name’ in the respective print queues (to which these documents are sent using the API) will be blank. This is because of the previous point i.e No traces in Output management BO.-Keywords-Print queue in PDI solution, Print queue API, Custom print, Print custom BO, Limitations in Printing, Limitations in print queue

Title: The Schedule Invoice Request is With Status as To be Invoiced for the Canceled Contract-Item
Content: Symptom-A Schedule Invoice Request is with Status To be Invoiced for Canceled Contract-Items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-Show All Invoice Requests and search for Contract ABC (ABC represents the Contract ID).-Schedule Invoice Request PQR (PQR represents the scheduled invoice request ID) is in the status To be Invoiced for the Contract ABC-Item YY (YY represents the line item ID).-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contract view and search with Contract ID ABC.-Edit the Contract ABC, click View All.-Go to the Items tab, select the line item YY.-Under Details, in the Cancellation section, Item YY is canceled with Invoice Cancellation as set on 'Keep Invoice Requests'.-Cause-If the Contract-Item is canceled with the Invoice Cancellation reason as Keep Invoice Requests, it does not cancel the Open Invoice Request.-Resolution-Before release 1905, the only workaround is to Invoice that Contract-Item with amount = 0.00.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-Show All Invoice Requests and search for Contract ABC.-select the Schedule Invoice Request PQR.-Invoice the Schedule Invoice Request.-In the New Invoice screen, click View All.-Go to the Items tab.-For Item YY, maintain the Price List as zero amount and Release the Invoice document.-Should you not be able to change the Price List to zero you need to create an Invoice and then a Credit Memo.-From release 1905 onwards. We introduced a feature to cancel open invoice schedules if the item is already canceled:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contract view and search with Contract ID ABC.-Edit the Contract ABC, click View All.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoice Schedule sub tab.-Select line item YY.-Click on the Action button and select the Cancel open dates option.-All open dates for this item is then canceled.-Keywords-Rechnungsterminplan, Scheduled Invoice Request, Abzurechnen, To Be Invoiced, Keep Invoice Requests, Rechnungsanforderungen beibehalten

Title: How to Cancel the Schedule Invoice Request for the Contract, When Contract Item's Fulfillment Status is Finished and Invoice Status is Not Started
Content: Symptom-How to cancel the Schedule Invoice Request for the Contract, when Contract Item's Fulfillment Status is Finished and the Invoice Status is Not Started.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Contracts and in the Find field enter PQR(where PQR is the contract id).-Edit the Contract PQR and go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and sub tab Invoice Schedule.-Here the Contract->item is schedule for the date XX. YY. ZZZZ with the status as Open.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view .-In the Show field from drop-down select All Invoice Request and in the Find field enter the Contract id PQR.-You will see the Schedule Invoice Request LMN(where LMN is schedule invoice request id) for the date XX. YY. ZZZZ reference to the Contract PQR is with status as To Be Invoice, which you want to cancel.-Cause-Since the scheduled Contract->Item in the Pricing and Invoicing tab and sub tab Invoice Schedule is with status as Open, the related Schedule Invoice Request LMN can be canceled.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Show filed from drop-down select All Contract and in Find field enter PQR.-Edit the Contract PQR and go to the Items tab.-Select the Contract Item and click on the button Finish->Invoicing and Save the Contract.-This will change the status in the Contract->Item under the Invoice Schedule subtab from Open to Canceled and cancels the Schedule Invoice Request LMN.-Keywords-scheduled inovice request; cancel; fulfillment is finished.

Title: Invoice Request Status is In Conflict
Content: Symptom-The status of the Invoice Request is shown as In Conflict.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-In the Show field from drop-down select In Conflict Invoice Request items and click on the Go button.-It displays the In Conflict record XXX (where XXX represent the document ID) and XYZ (where XYZ represent the Document Type).-Cause-The Customer Invoice Request is In Conflict because changes had been made in the preceding documents.-For instance, an item of the Service Order/Sales Order has been canceled after the corresponding Customer Invoice Request has been invoiced. This implies the invoice contains an item which should have been canceled, but it was not. As a result, incorrect invoice will be received.-In order to resolve this conflict, it is needed to cancel the invoice and create a new invoice out of the Customer Invoice Request.-In case the Invoice Request was created via the web service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn please see KBA 3582936 - External Customer Invoice Request in Status With Conflict-Resolution-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Invoice Documents and click on the Go button.-Click on the Advanced search link.-Under section Preceding Document, enter value for Preceding Document ID as XXX and Preceding Document Type as XYZ.-When clicking on the Go button, the affected invoice will be displayed.-Click on the Cancel button.-Now under Invoice Requests view, it won't reflect as In Conflict anymore.-See Also- KBA 3582936 - External Customer Invoice Request in Status With Conflict-KBA 3074534 - Invoice Requests in Status With Conflict - Invoice schedule item XX: quantity value has changed-KBA 2776630 - Customer Invoice Cannot be Released due to a Conflict detected in the Scheduled Invoice Request-KBA 3696422 - Scheduled Invoice Request is in status With Conflict with the Warning “Conflict in item XX; invoice schedule item XX: date has changed” -KBA 2921124 - Scheduled Invoice Requests in Status With Conflict-Keywords-In conflict, customer invoice request, preceding document, cancel invoice document, status.

Title: "New Sales Quote for Contract" is Missing in New Business Work Center
Content: Symptom-You want to create a New Sales Quote for Contract but it is missing in the Common Tasks in New Business work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Here you are not able to select the New Sales Quotes for Contract.-Cause-In Business Configuration, Selling Products and Services the Materials in Customer Contracts element is not scoped.-Please Note that users with the Access Rights to the view Clearing Runs (FIN_CLEARINGRUNSAR ) in Receivables will have the New Sales Quotes for Contract option available also if Materials in Customer Contracts is not in scope.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-In step 3 Scoping expand Sales -> Customer Product and Service Portfolio for Sales.-Here you have to mark the Sell Standard Products.-In step 4 Questions expand Sales -> Selling Products and Services -> Customer Contracts.-Here you have to mark the question "Do you want to work with materials in contracts?".-And Save it.- Now you are able to select the New Sales Quote for Contract in New Business work center.-Keywords-Quote for Contract; Access rights; restriction; missing; User; FIN_CLEARINGRUNSAR; Clearing Runs

Title: No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports for Profit Types Order Profit and Invoice Profit
Content: Symptom-The Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report or Profit Overview by Key Figure report doesn't display any data although there are financial postings relevant for selection parameters.-Executing the profitability report returns the message 'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Reports - List view.-Select the report Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme or Profit Overview by Key Figure.-Enter the selection parameters, and select Profit Type as: 1 (Order Profit) or 2 (Invoice Profit).-Press Go.-The information message 'No report data available to display; check selection' appears. -Cause-The reporting structure used for the contribution margin scheme has no price components assigned to its structure nodes.-Resolution-To see the appropriate data for profit types Order Profit or Invoice Profit, the price component need to be assigned, by following below steps:-In the Business Configuration work center, access the Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis fine-tune activity, either from the Implementation Project's activity list or from the Overview. -Select Edit Financial Reporting Structures.-Select the reporting structure Key ABC (ABC represents the reporting structure ID entered as Contribution Margin Scheme in the profitability report, which is also assigned to the company's set of books). -Press Edit.-In the structure press Expand All.-Select the relevant structure node.-Choose Actions and select Assign Price Components.-Press ok.-In the next screen press Save or Save and Close. -Note: -The business user should decide under which structure node which the price component is to appear.-The logical node for the Cost price component would be the one marked as Cost of Sales structure item.-See Also-2052832 - No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports-Help Center document: Edit Financial Reporting Structures-Help Center document: Settings for Earned Profit Analysis – Configuration Guide help doc-Keywords-Profit, Contribution Margin Scheme, Report, Profit Overview by Key Figure.

Title: SAP Readiness Check 2.0 "Add-On Compatibility" and "Active Business Functions" tiles are empty
Content: Symptom-In SAP Readiness Check 2.0 the sections Add-On Compatability and Active Business Functions are empty-Message "System does not exist in maintenance planner. To add the system to the maintenance planner, check SAP Note 2408911" is shown.-Message "No data" is shown. -Message "The data can't be received. Please contact SAP." is shown.-Message "Technical Error Occurred" is shown.-         Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Readiness Check 2.0 for SAP S/4HANA supports the following source releases:-SAP ERP 6.0 (Enhancement Package 0 to 8)-SAP S/4HANA Finance 1503 and 1605 (which are technically based on SAP ERP 6.0 Enhancement Package 7 and 8 respectively)-Reproducing the Issue-Open SAP Readiness Check and check the Analysis for your System to check Add-On Compatibility and Active Business Functions tiles.-Cause-System is missing in Maintenance Planner.-SID in Maintenance Planner differs from the SAP Readiness Check (SID have to be equal, no long SIDs).-Verification is showing Errors in Maintenance Planner.-There are no information to report in the readiness check report. -Resolution-For symptoms #1 & #2 & #4-Ensure that the system is with same SID in the Maintenance Planner and that the System Verification show no errors. If the verify status is red, refer to SAP KBA 2448962 - "Verification Status" shows "ERROR" in Maintenance Planner system list.-Click on the system SID then navigate to "Additional Software Details" to check the Active Business Functions maintained. If there are no items maintained here, the readiness check report will show "No data".-Navigate to "Software" to check the Add-On maintained. Only SAP standard Add-On will be reported in the readiness check report, and no third party addons will be reported. Similar to Active Business Functions if there are no information maintained here the readiness check report will show "No data".-If there were changes made, refresh the tiles then the RC report to update the changed information. Create a new analysis if the tiles remain the same.-For symptom #3 & #4-1. Open the system from Maintenance Planner. Make sure the system in verified in a recent date. If you access your system face an error similar to :-Unable to fetch system data for selected system-<SID>[ABAP] Reason: System data is not completely -transferred from SAP Solution Manager-2. Follow the resolution steps of SAP KBA 2323131 - Error in Maintenance Planner:  System data not completely transferred from SAP Solution Manager.-3. After the changes are made, refresh the tiles then the RC report to update the changed information. Create a new analysis if the tiles remain the same.-4. Please also ensure that you choose the correct customer number when uploading the analysis result. Otherwise, it's not able to find the system components info in the Maintenance Planner.-See Also-2408911 - Uploading of System Information into Maintenance Planner-Keywords-Add-On Compatibility, Active Business Functions, S4R, ABF, addons, addon, AOC, addon compatibility, "The data can't be received. Please contact SAP.", The add-on check could not be executed due to a technical error. Please create a support incident under component SV-SCS-S4R, "Add-On Compatibility" and "Active Business Functions" are blank-The maintenance planner reports that no add-on software is implemented in the system.-The maintenance planner reports that no active business function is implemented in the system.

Title: Changes in the Business Configuration Are Not Reflecting in the System
Content: Symptom-Changes made in the scoping or fine-tuning activities of the Business Configuration work center, however those changes are not reflecting in your system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that changed project is not merged.-Resolution-If the changes are being done through a change project, then it is always mandatory to merge the change project in order to reflect the changes into the system.-Final status of the change project should be Merged (or Activated, in cases where the Activate Solution Capabilities activity is available, as it must be completed after the merge). Repetition Required activities should also be re-configured after merge.-See Also-1922087 - How to Create a Change Project and Its Lifecycle-Keywords-Changes, Not Reflecting, System, Business Configuration, Fine-Tuning, Activities, Change Project

Title: Cannot Invoice Outbound Delivery Invoice Request - Warning: 'Invoicing For Item XX Type Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC Not Possible; Reference Document Blocked.'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to invoice an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request the following error message is received:-'Invoicing For Item XX Type Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC Not Possible; Reference Document Blocked. (XX represents the line item number and ABC represents the outbound Delivery invoice request ID)'.-There is no Invoice Block when checking the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select All Invoice Requests in the Show field.-Click on the Advanced button for the advance search.-Here enter the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ refers to the sales order ID).-Select the Document Type as Sales Order and click on the Go button.-There are two Invoice Request Types: Outbound Delivery Invoice Request and Sales Order Invoice Request.-The Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is with status 'To be Invoiced' and the Sales Order Invoice Request is with status 'Blocked'.-If the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC is invoiced, the following warning message is displayed: -'Invoicing for item XX type Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC not possible; reference document blocked' and you will not be able to perform the actions Save as Invoice or Release).-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Select the Block Orders in the field Show.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ.-Open the sales order and navigate to the General tab.-In the section Invoicing, no Invoice Block has been set.-Navigate to the Changes tab-In the Attribute field, select the Approval Status and press Go.-There is an entry where the Approval Status was changed from Not Started to Approval not Necessary.-Logon to the Backend-Go to transaction /nsesfts.-In the Load BP by Proxy Name field enter Sales_Order.-Load by Query - Root Query by Elements.-In the ID/content field, enter the number of the sales order.-Right Click the number of the Sales Order and select Message Monitoring - Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow.-Select the last XI message sent from Sender Party SalesOrderProcessing to Receiver Interface Party CustomerInvoiceProcessingRequestInvoicingIn.-The message has been delivered and is in status Green.-Open the XI message by clicking on the message ID.-Check if the SettlementBlockedIndicator is set to true.-  Cause-This is the expected system behavior and the reason for this can be due to one of the following two options:-If a sales order is changed, meaning an item is added, the pricing is affected, such as total price and net value. Therefore the approval process is triggered again.-The approval process was changed.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and choose Submit for Approval.-The approval if applicable will be sent to the Reporting Line Manager.-Request the reporting line manager to log in to the Business ByDesign system and approve the sales order.-Once the approval process is executed successfully the Sales Order Invoice Request will not be in status Blocked anymore. The Outbound Delivery Invoice Request can be invoiced.-See Also-See the KBA 1893489 - Unexpected Approval Status of the Sales Order.-2194102 - Customer Invoices Request is Blocked-Keywords-Invoicing for item type Outbound Delivery Invoice Request not possible; reference document blocked; Approval Process; Sales Order; Blocked

Title: Incurred Costs on Customer Sales Project Realized on the Wrong Project Task
Content: Symptom-An employee has recorded time on project task XYZ-XX of customer sales project XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID; XYZ-XX represents the project task on which the time was initially recorded).-The expense got realized on the expense account defined for Internal Service Confirmations.-However, the expense is no longer associated with project task XYZ-XX but now realized on project task XYZ-YY (XYZ-YY represents a different task of project XYZ).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In general, two business transactions are generated for expenses of customer projects with sales integration: 1. the expense posting and 2. the expense assignment to sales order (creation of the customer project expense list (CPEL)).-The original expense posting, for example, an internal service confirmation: -Example:-An employee records time on project task XYZ-XX incurring a cost of 100,00 LC*.-Expense posting (expense gets associated with the project task:-G/L Account Internal Services:  Credit: 100,00 LC  -Deferred CoGs/ G/L Account (Origin): Internal Services:  Debit: 100,00 LC Project Task XYZ-XX-The expense assignment to sales document Item is generated [the Customer Project Expense List (CPEL)]:-With this posting the expense gets assigned to the respective project-based sales order item; In the ideal scenario this posting happens automatically at the time of the expense posting. -Or, the CPEL is posted once the expense got manually assigned to the sales order item in Project Management. -If no Accrual Method is assigned to the Sales Order item, -All incurred project costs get assigned to a sales order item on the deferred Cogs account and then realized on the respective P&L account at the same time: On the expense account the project task assignment switches from XYZ-XX to XYZ-YY: -Deferred CoGs/ G/L Account (Origin): Internal Services: Credit :100,00 LC* Project Task XYZ-XX  -Deferred CoGs/ G/L Account (Origin): Internal Services: Debit  :100,00 LC Project Task XYZ-XX Sales Order Item ABC-AA**-Deferred CoGs/ G/L Account (Origin): Internal Services: Credit : 100,00 LC Project Task XYZ-XX Sales Order Item ABC-AA-G/L Account Internal Services  Debit: 100,00 LC  Sales Order Item ABC-AA Project Task XYZ-YY (assigned to Sales Order Item ABC-AA)-If an Accrual Method is assigned to the Sales Order item,-the incurred project costs get assigned to a sales order item on the Deferred Cogs account with the expense account defined as G/L account (Origin) during the Expense Assignment posting:-Deferred CoGs/ G/L Account (Origin): Internal Services: Credit :100,00 LC* Project Task XYZ-XX  -Deferred CoGs/ G/L Account (Origin): Internal Services: Debit  :100,00 LC Project Task XYZ-XX Sales Order Item ABC-AA-The expense gets realized only with the revenue recognition run. revenue recognition run credits the project task associated with the sales order item, here XYZ-YY*** -Deferred CoGs/ G/L Account (Origin): Internal Services: Credit :100,00 LC* Project Task XYZ-YY Sales Order Item ABC-AA-G/L Account Internal Services  Debit  :100,00 LC Sales Order Item ABC-AA* Project Task XYZ-YY (assigned to Sales Order Item ABC-AA)-* (LC represents Local Currency)-** (ABC-AA represents the Sales Order item ID)-*** NOTE:With an accrual method assigned, the expense cleared on sales document item and project level, but not necessarily on project task level [(see columns in bold) If the expense assignment occurs separately (i.e., not directly with the expense posting as it happens usually for internal service confirmations), then the expense is not cleared on project task level on the Deferred CoGs account]-To find both Business Transactions,-navigate to the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue work center. -Open the advanced search. -In the Project ID field enter XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID) and press Go. -Now all sales order items connected to the project appear. -Select one of the sales order items and press Reports and choose Sales Document - Line Items for Project. -In the report add Associated Source Document ID to the rows and filter for Employee Time Calendar XXX (XXX represents the ID of the Internal Service Confirmation).-Press Go.-Now add further characteristics to the Rows and sort all characteristics as follows (All other characteristics can be removed from the current report selection):-G/L Account-G/L Account (Origin)-Associated Source Document ID-Business Transaction-Journal Entry ID-Project Task-Associated Sales Order and Item-You notice two business transactions for the expense: The Expense Assignment to Sales Document (the CPEL posting) and the Internal Service Confirmation.-If no Accrual Method is assigned to the Sales Order Item:-The expense, for example, Employee Time Calendar XXX is associated with Project task XYZ-XX.-But the Expense Assignment is associated with project task XYZ-YY, realized on the Expense Account for Internal Service Confirmations.-If an Accrual Method is assigned to the Sales Order Item:-The expense, for example, Employee Time Calendar XXX is associated with Project task XYZ-XX.-The Expense Assignment is associated with project task XYZ-XX and Sales Order Item ABC-AA.-The Revenue Recognition run realizes the expense on Sales Order Item ABC-AA but Project Task XYZ-YY.-Cause-Costs and revenues recorded for customer sales projects are always realized on the project task associated with the sales order item to which the expenses got assigned to.-During the expense assignment the specifications of the sales order items, such as the associated project task, product or the profit center take priority over the assignment settings of the original, incurred expense.-In the given example, the expense of time recording XXX gets associated with project task XYZ-YY because the sales order item ABC-AA is assigned to project task XYZ-YY. Therefore, the project task from the time recording switches from task XYZ-XX over to XYZ-YY when the expense gets realized.-To verify the sales order assignment-Go to the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue workcenter. -Find sales order item ABC-AA. -Go to the Associated Objects tab. -You now see that the item is associated with project task XYZ-YY. -You can further verify this with the Sales Documents - Line Items report (Report ID FINPRFU24_Q0001) as above: Add the Associated Sales Order and Item to the rows..-You can see that Sales Order item ABC-AA is assigned to the expense [Another way to check the assignment, would be to directly look at the Journal Entry of the Expense Assignment (CPEL) posting].-Resolution-If project costs from time recordings (or any other expenses, such as expense reports, goods receipts, supplier invoice items) are to be realized on the project tasks for which the expense was incurred, or on any specific project task of your choice, you need to ensure that the expense gets assigned to the Sales Order item which is associated with this exact project task.-If you, for instance, create a new project task, XYZ-XX, in project XYZ and expenses are to be realized on this project task, then you need to create a new sales order item which you then assign to this new project task XYZ-XX.-All existing expenses on project task XYZ-XX  that are not yet invoiced can get reassigned to the new sales order item so that they get realized on the project task.-For all expenses that got invoiced already you can create a manual journal entry voucher for sales documents to move the amounts from project task XYZ-YY to XYZ-XX.-Keywords-Wrong project task assigned to Project Expense, Expense Assignment, Sales Order Item Assignment Rules, Customer Sales Projects Incurred Expenses, Project Task Association

Title: Cannot select the correct UoM when create a new material
Content: Symptom-There are two UoMs in the tenant. One is EA (the custom UoM) and the other is ea (the SAP standard UoM). When create a new material, try to select ea but the tenant automatically picks EA.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio -> Products.-Click New -> Product.-Click View All.-In filed Base UoM, select ea.-The system will pick UoM EA.-Cause-For a UoM, UoM Unit and UoM Symbol will be considered as the same. If the symbol of a custom UoM is the same as the Unit of a standard one, the system cannot distinguish these two UoMs. This is how system designed. -Resolution-When create an new custom UoM, the symbol of the new UoM should be different from any existed UoM's Unit or Symbol. In the mentioned case of this document, EA can be changed to EA1 or EAZ to avoid the issue.-Keywords-Custom UoM, Symbol, Unit, Wrongly Pick

Title: Execute Payment Function Greyed Out in Automatic Payments View
Content: Symptom-The Execute Payment function is greyed out in the Automatic Payments view within the Payables work center.-The issue prevents the execution of payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Select the relevant Payment ID.-Observe that the Execute Payment button is greyed out.-Cause-The Payment is inconsistent and therefore not ready for execution.-Resolution-Navigate to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Select the relevant Payment ID and click on Edit.-Click on the Check tab.-The error messages displayed will explain why the payment cannot be executed. Correct the errors, and if the payment is consistent, the Execute Payment option will be enabled.-See Also-2152347 - Execute Payment Tab Is Disabled / Grayed Out-Keywords-Execute Payment, greyed out, Automatic Payments, Payables work center, Payment ID.

Title: Timeout Error Encountered When Confirming Pick Task Via Web Service "ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn"
Content: Symptom-A timeout error occurs when trying to confirm a pick task via the web service "ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Site Logistics Task-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the web service "ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn" with the payload.-A timeout error is encountered in the tool used to execute the web service.-Cause-The number of line items in the task is more than the recommended number for a delivery document.-The recommended number of line items for outbound/inbound document is 50.-The task contains more than the recommended number of  line items.-Resolution-Reduce the number of line items in the task.-See Also-Keywords-Timeout Error, Confirm Pick Task, Web Service, ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn, Line Items, Delivery Document, Outbound, Inbound, Late Delivery Split.

Title: Error "Distribution chain not valid: enter distribution channel" When Importing a File in The Mass Data Maintenance Tool
Content: Symptom-When attempting to add Sales Data for an account using the Mass Data Maintenance tool in the system the below error message is displayed:-"No Customer Imported. XYZ Customer Failed." (where XYZ refers to the number of customers)-In the Import Log, the error message "Distribution chain not valid: enter distribution channel" appears for all records in the file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance Work Center.-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance View.-Under File Overview sub-tab, in the dropdown select "File for Processing" option.-Click on the file ABC (where ABC refers to the file name) under File Overview sub-tab.-Click on Execute Data Import.-Click on Immediately.--The error  "No Customer Imported. XYZ Customer Failed." is displayed in the top of the screen.--Click on the "Failed" option under the Status Column.-Click on Display Help.-The error message "Distribution chain not valid: enter distribution channel" is displayed.-Cause-One or more Sales Organization in the import file records do not have a rule maintained in the Relevant Distribution Channels option in the Work Distribution View. This rule is required to define a Sales Data (Sales Organization and Distribution Channel) for an account. If this rule is not maintained for the Sales Organization, the error message will appear when trying to define this Sales Organization in the account, as no Distribution channel was defined to be selected.-Resolution-In this scenario, it is required to first check which Sales Organization maintained in the Mass Data Maintenance import file records do not have a rule in the Relevant Distribution Channels option in the Work Distribution View.-To check follow the below steps:-Go to Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to Work Distribution View.-Select the option Relevant Distribution Channels, under Business Area: Sales and Marketing.-Click on Edit.-Click on the header of the column Org Unit Responsible.-In the Filter field, insert one of the Org Units ID which was trying to be imported in the file.-Check if any rule is displayed for the Org Unit searched.-Repeat the steps 1-7 for all the Org Units maintained in the Mass Data Maintenance File.-After verifying the Org Units that do not have a rule maintained, it is required to add a Rule for these Org Units by following the below steps.-Go to Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to Work Distribution View.-Select the option Relevant Distribution Channels, under Business Area: Sales and Marketing.-Click on Edit.-Click on Add Rule, under Work Distribution Rules.-Under the Column Org Unit Responsible, insert DEF (where DEF refers to the Org Unit ID).-Scroll down, in the sub-tab Distribution Channel, define the Distribution Channel for the Sales Organization.--NOTE: The option "All" will define all Distribution Channels for the Sales Organization, however it is possible to define only the specific Distribution Channel that is maintained in the file to be imported in the tool.--Under the Columns "Validity from" and "Validity to", define the start date of the rule and end date of the rule.-Click on Save.-After adding the rules for all the Sales Organizations required, the import process in the Mass Data Maintenance tool will be validated and the Sales Data records will be imported with no errors. -See Also-2219704 - Not able to Select a Distribution Channel in a Sales Document and the Sales Data in the Account-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, No Customer Imported, Customer Failed, Distribution chain not valid, enter distribution channel, Relevant Distribution Channels, Organizational Management, Work Distribution, Sales Data, Sales Organization

Title: Fail to Restart Finished Production Task Due to Error
Content: Symptom-Restart a finished production task, an error triggered: Restart not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Access view Task Control.-Select a finished task ABC, click Change Status - Restart, error triggered:-Action failed------> Restart failed for task ABC-----------> Restart not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked-Save failed-Cause-The period of year YYYY month MM is blocked, and there is no corresponding process control.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Production Task, Restart, Blocked
