Title: Logistics Area Not Valid Error During Goods Movement
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When executing a goods movement to Logistics Area LOA1(where LOA1 is the Logistics Area ID) an error Logistics Area Not Valid is encountered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Internal Logistics workcenter and Goods Movement view.-2. Key in Site ID and Product ID-3. Attempt to move quantity from LOA2(where LOA2 is the Logistics Area2) to LOA1-You will encounter an error message "Logistics Area Not Valid"-Cause-Error is encountered due to the presence of two Logistics areas named LOA1 under the same site. This duplication seems to be causing the issue.-Resolution-Issue can be resolved by renaming one of the Logistics Area.-Request permission from customer to rename the Logistics Area which is obsolete to some different name and create incident to Development Team AP-LAS-LOA.-  Keywords-Logistics Area, not valid, duplicate, site, obsolete

Title: Clearing items missing in VAT reports
Content: Symptom-When running VAT reports, VAT claimed from early settlement discount in the receivables allocation module is not appearing tax reporting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns view.-Search for VAT Return ID: AAA (AAA represents the VAT Return ID).-Can see Customer Discounts for Early Payment Clearing items missing in VAT reports.-Cause-Fine Tuning Activity: "Tax Adjustments for Payment Differences" is not specified for the particular country.-Resolution-Follow below steps to Assign the Deduction Category:-Go to Work Center Business Configuration.-Choose Overview.-Open the Activity Tax Adjustments for Payment Differences.-Please kindly set up for the particular country, and there would be a tax correction entry (e.g. Customer Discounts for Early Payment), which would be considered in the VAT Return. -Keywords-VAT, early settlement discount, clearing, Tax Adjustments for Payment Differences

Title: Create Remittance Advice Button Not Available for Outgoing Direct Debits
Content: Symptom-The "Create Remittance Advice" button is greyed-out for Outgoing Direct Debits.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Payment Management Work Center > Payment Monitor view.-Select "All Payments".-Search for the desired Document-Highlight the Document-The "Create Remittance Advice" button is not grey out.-Cause-The "Create Remittance Advice" button is only enabled for "In Transfer" and "Ready For Transfer" payments. It is also only available for self-initiated payments. Outgoing Direct Debit payments are not self-initiated, hence the button is not enabled.-Resolution-Expected system behavior-See Also-KBA 3486962 - Create Remittance Advice option has been greyed out for the Payment 'ABC' -Keywords-Create Remittance Advice, button not available, Outgoing Direct Debits, Payment Management, grey out

Title: Custom Unit of Measure is not Available in Supplier Invoice Excel Template
Content: Symptom-When accessing the Supplier Invoice Excel template, the custom Unit of Measure (UoM) is not available in the drop-down in column 'Unit'. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view. -Click in New button and select Import from Microsoft Excel. -Open the downloaded Excel template. -The custom UoM ABC is not available (ABC is the custom UoM). -Cause-The custom unit of measure doesn't appear in the standard Supplier Invoice Excel template by default. So, it has to be manually added. -Resolution-Steps to add the unit of measure in the Supplier Invoice Excel template:-Open the Excel Template. -Navigate to Home. -In Cells section, click in Format. -In Visibility, go to 'Hide & Unhide' and select 'Unhide Sheet'.-Select Validation.-Click in OK.-Here maintains the ABC unit of measure following the same rule of the other already maintained units. -Save it.-The UoM should be available in the 'Data' sheet.-For better understanding of the Excel, please check Microsoft material "Hide or Unhide worksheets". -See Also-Microsoft Support: Hide or Unhide worksheets-KBA: 1675834 - How to Add a New Unit of Measure for Quantities

Title: Process Communication Error in the Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order and sent to supplier. However system creates a process communication error. -- Purchase Order cannot create a Supplier Invoice Request -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view -Select the relevant Purchase Order and select Edit button -Go to Document Flow tab-You can see the Process Communication error-Or-You can go to Application and User Management work center -Go to Process Communication Errors view -Select Open errors with Cases-Cause-Purchase order item is assigned to account assignment type ABC. However in business configuration work center under account assignment types activity, Supplier Invoice Request is not maintained. Hence the process communication error created. -Resolution-You can follow the below steps to fix the error. -Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects and select Open Activity List -Navigate to Fine Tune Activity and search for activity Account Assignment Types -Click on Maintain Account Assignment Types -Select Account Assignment Type ABC-Select the tab, Assignment to Business Transactions -Select Add Row and enter 128 - Supplier Invoice Request -Select Save and Close-Once the account assignment type is maintained, you can report a case to SAP and request to restart the process communication errors.

Title: Cancel Request Button is Greyed Out in Production Request
Content: Symptom-Production Request cannot be canceled since Cancel Request Button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Production Requests view.-Find Production Request XYZ (XYZ means Production Request ID)-Notice the Cancel Request Button is greyed out.-Cause-Cannot cancel Production Request since the Production Order is finished and all subsequent documents are in finished status.-Resolution-Since the Production Order is finished and the following tasks are finished too, it cannot reverse Production Order and cannot Cancel Production Request. To create a new Production Order with reference to the same Production Request then first finish the task without reporting the quantity.-Then follow the below mentioned steps:-Go the Production Requests view.-Search for the relevant Production Request. Here you can see that the Create Order button is disabled.-Choose Undo Set Complete. After this, the Create Order button will be enabled.-Choose Create Order, and then Partial Quantity.-Enter the Number of Production Orders you want to create.-Then enter Ordered Quantity Per Order. Also if you do not want to create further Production Orders for this Production Request, then select Production Order Creation Completed.-Finally choose OK button.-System will create a new Production Order with reference to this Production Request.-Keywords-Production Request, Production Order, Cancel Request, Greyed Out.

Title: Extension filed not visible in ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Customer cannot see an extension field in a report, while the mentioned field is present on the related data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open the affected report -Try to add extension field, but it is not visible.-The mentioned field is present on related data source.-Cause-You have created an Extension field.-You have created these an Extension fields in "Supplier Account" Monitor work center throughout the steps:-Go to: Supplier Account.-Go to adaptation mode.-Click on Add.-Extension Fields (All extension fields are visible).-Click on extension field name,-Show further Usage.-Data sources and Reports.-The Extension field further Usage where you can see that this field is only extended to a third data source and reports based on this data source--Resolution-You could not find the mentioned related data source here to extend these fields that is the reason these fields are not visible in data source and report.-You can only extend the Extension fields created in work center to the available data sources only. You may check a third data source and reports based on this third data source the Extension fields are present.-Please check the below link for the detailed information on how to add Extension fields to data source/report:-< https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2be1c953722d1014a1f8dce8e33caa94.html?state=DRAFT >-Keywords-Extension field; missing; not appear;

Title: Error: 'Rule 02 - Restrict to Managed Sales Units for XYZ Work Center View in Business Role Determined no Restrictions' Appears When the Business Role is Assigned to the User
Content: Symptom-A Business Role has been configured with access to sales quotes; however, users assigned to this role do not see the requested work center view. Instead, an error message is displayed upon business role assignment, stating: "Rule 02 - Restrict to Managed Sales Units for XYZ Work Center View in Business Role Determined no Restrictions."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Business User view-Search for Business User: ABC-Select Edit-Choose Access Rights-Under Business Role Assignment, select relevant Business Role-Notice the below error:-Rule 02 - Restrict to Managed Sales Units for XYZ Work Center View in Business Role Determined no Restrictions-View XYZ can't be assigned since no restriction could be determined.-Cause-The restriction rule will be dependent on an org unit assignment such as a sales organization, for example — in this case, if the org unit to which the user is assigned is NOT a sales organization or does not have a sales organization in its immediate hierarchy, the system will not assign the work center (or work center view).-Restriction Rule 02 - Restrict to Managed Sales Units limits access to sales units managed by specific employees, and the Business User is not a manager in the system. Consequently, when the system tries to assign authorization for the work center view to the user, it cannot find any managed units by this user.-Resolution-Business Role with Restriction Rule will assign the view only if the restrictions can be determined for the specific view and rule. Hence, ensure that the Business User is a manager or remove the Restriction.-See Also-2749403 - Work Center Or Work Center View Missing for A Business User-https://me.sap.com/notes/2749403-Keywords-Business Role, Business User, Restriction Rule, Rule 02 - Restrict to Managed Sales Units, Work center View Not Assigned

Title: Error Message: Operation Not Possible; Confirmed Inbound Delivery Must Be Released - While Adjusting In-Transit Stock to Zero
Content: Symptom-An error message is encountered while trying to adjust In-Transit Stock to Zero: "Operation Not Possible; confirmed inbound delivery must be released".-The issue arises when attempting to remove in-transit stock from the SAP system after cancelling the inbound delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Physical Inventory Work Center.-Proceed to the Common Tasks view and select the option Adjust In-Transit Stock.-Choose the relevant line item entry and click on the button "Adjust In-Transit Stock to Zero".-Cause-The Inbound delivery against which the In-transit stock was created has been cancelled.-The removal of In-Transit stock requires the cancellation of the outbound delivery created from the sending site.-It is essential that the stock transfer Inbound delivery notifications have the status as Advised and not Received before cancelling the outbound delivery.-Resolution-To cancel the outbound delivery please follow the steps maintained in the KBA : 1381358 - Cancel Outbound Delivery-See Also-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, Adjust In-Transit Stock to Zero, Error Message, Operation Not Possible, Confirmed Inbound Delivery Must Be Released, Cancel Outbound Delivery.

Title: Error "Item XX: Change of product not permitted; contract ABC exists for item XX" While Releasing the Service Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to Release the Service confirmation due to error "Item XX: Change of product not permitted; contract ABC exists for item XX".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Field Service and Repair - Service Confirmations.-Edit Service Confirmation: DEF. (DEF represents the service confirmation ID)-System shows the error message "Item XX: Change of product not permitted; contract ABC exists for item XX". (ABC represents the Contract ID and XX represents the line item ID)-Cause-The release button for Service Confirmation DEF is disabled due to an inconsistency error that occurred during the creation of the Service Confirmation.-Resolution-Navigate to Field Service and Repair - Service Confirmations.-Edit Service Confirmation: DEF.-Select line item XX and click on the Remove button.-Click on the Add button and use value help for product ID.-Select same Product from the list and maintain the required details.-Release the service confirmation.-See Also-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Release, Error, SAP Business ByDesign, Inconsistency, Product Change, Contract, Resolution.

Title: Error When Uploading a Customer Invoice Requests via the File Input
Content: Symptom-The following errors occur when uploading a Customer Invoice Requests via the File Input:-"Error in business configuration for processing type code; report incident" and "Error in business configuration for property movement direction code".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center. -Select the File input view.-Change the drop down to Unprocessed files.-Click Add.-Select the service interface as Customer Invoice Uploader Input, then upload the respective file.-Click OK.-Change the drop down back to Active runs.-Highlight the Run and click Schedule.-Close-Once the run was executed, the latest scheduled Run appears in the Execution details.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Open External Customer Invoice Request that was created via the Run.-The following errors are displayed:-Item 10: Error in business configuration for processing type code; report incident-Item 10: Error in business configuration for property movement direction code-Cause-The error "Error in business configuration for processing type code; report incident" occurs because the Product Type Code was not passed in the payload.-You also need to pass the Product type code:-1 Material-2 Service-3 Individual Product-For a Material for example you need to pass it as follows :-<TypeCode>1</TypeCode>-    The error "Error in business configuration for property movement direction code" occurs because the tag ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode, is used to determine the type of item it should be, invoice or credit memo:-1 - Credit Memo-2- Invoice-If you want to create a Credit Memo Item you need to pass the following tag for the Item:-<ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode>1</ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode>-  Please note that you should also not pass negative signs in the values. Since the ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode is passed as 1 the system will determine it as a Credit Memo Item and automatically use a negative sign.-Resolution-You need to adapt the payload of your file accordingly and then upload it again to update the External Customer Invoice Request that was created.-See Also-KBA 2637318 - Create Invoice Request with Invoice Items and Credit Memo Items via Web Service When the Relevant Scoping Question Is Not Checked.-Keywords-Error, Business Configuration, Processing Type Code, Property Movement Direction Code, Customer Invoice Requests, ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode, Credit Memo, Negative Signs, Invoice, Service, Material, Individual Product.

Title: Automatic Deletion of Failed Background Jobs in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-When checking the failed Background Jobs of the system, it is observed that the failed Background Jobs are no longer visible after a certain period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Background Jobs View.-Select "All Failed Jobs" from the dropdown menu.-Observe that not all failed Background Jobs are listed.-Cause-Background Job logs which are older than 14 days are archived from the system and are no longer displayed. Therefore, "All Failed Jobs" lists only the jobs which are not older than 14 days.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior. --Failed Background Job logs older than 14 days are archived automatically from the system. They will not be displayed in the "All Failed Jobs" list anymore. -Keywords-Failed Background Jobs, Job Logs, Automatic Deletion.

Title: Completion Overdue Alert Remains in the Inbox Even the Order is Completed Status
Content: Symptom-In your inbox, you find there are some alert tasks are still open for you, the tasks are about "Complete Overdue: Check Service Order". However the referenced service orders are already completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Inbox view.-In the Open Items query, you can see alert "Completion Overdue: Check Service Order ABC...".-Open the service order ABC, the order is actually completed status. -In the document flow, we can see confirmation is released.-You want to know why system still shows the alert task for completed service order.-ABC represents the ID of the service order.-Cause-You have activated the service levels in the system, so system monitor the deadlines as per the service level parameters. The system automatically assigns the task to the processor of the service order with information on when the service order must be completed.-This task is created if one of the following situations applies:-The service performer has not executed the order yet-The service performer has executed the order, but has not yet created a service confirmation to report the work done-The service performer has created a service confirmation, but has forgotten to enter the Fixed On date and time.-In the case here, the service confirmation has no Fixed On date maintained, so the completion is not reached and the overdue alert was created.-Resolution-The user has to cancel the service confirmation and create a new one with Fixed On date maintained. Afterwards, the alert task will be udpated to completed status.-Keywords-completion overdue; check service order; alert; BTM task.

Title: How to close a Data Flow Verification Result manually?
Content: Symptom-The error in the Data Flow Verification Result (DFV) has already been resolved, while this DFV status is still open. This KBA provides the steps to change the Data Flow Verification Result to closed manually.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Data Flow Verification Results view.-Search for desired DFV under All Results.-The Data Flow Verification process is completed, while the result status is still open.  -Resolution-Click on Start Repeat Check button in DFV, the generated application log is without errors. Hence, there is no difference observed in the documents now. The DFV result can be closed. In this case, the Data Flow Verification Result can be closed manually by following the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the view Data Flow Verification Results.-Search for the relevant result.-Click on Change Status to Closed.-See Also-KBA 3413666 - Dataflow Verification Results with Differences-Keywords-How to close the DFV manually, DFV, Data Flow Verification Result, closed manually, Closed.

Title: The tenant is kept after change to another license vendor
Content: Symptom-What will happen on the current tenant if change to another license vendor?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If change to another license vendor, the tenant currently using will be kept but it is necessary to sign a new contract. If any help is needed in the process, contact Renewal Executive, Customer Success Partner or Account Owner for help.-Keywords-License, Change vendor, Current Tenant.

Title: Approver is showing Incorrectly or Missing in Monitoring Invoices report
Content: Symptom-User is facing 2 issues:-For few supplier invoices, approver is showing as "# not assigned" in report although they are in approval and approver is determined correctly.-For few supplier invoices, approver is showing incorrect name in the "Monitoring Invoices" report.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select view Design reports-Open Report: Monitoring Invoices-Add Approver field-You can see few invoices show approver field as #Unassigned and few invoices show wrong approver name.-Cause-The approver showing in the report is not coming from the approval field but it is from approver party.-Approver party gets assigned in 2 ways for supplier invoice:-1). When you create any new Invoice without copying the invoice, a fresh invoice is created, then no approver party will be assigned and in the report, the approver party will show as not assigned (# Unassigned).-The approver party in these cases get assigned only when the invoice is approved/Posted. Once we post the invoice, you can see the approver party is assigned and it will show the approver name in the report as well. -2). Now when we try to create a new invoice by copying from the old invoice which is either in-Approval(this is also been copied from the posted document itself) or Posted after In-approval, it will copy the approver party also.-For few invoices, they have been copied from the posted invoice whose Approver party was X (X refers to approver). So now, if you copy this invoice and put the copied invoice in approval it will show approver as X in Report till it is In-Approval state.-Once you will approve the invoice, the approver party will get updated in backend with whatever approval rule is assigned.-So, if you create any invoice copying old invoices, the approver in report will show the approver of the invoice from which it was copied, only till it is in approval status. It will eventually update once the invoice is approved/posted.-Hence the approver name is correctly reflected in report only once they are posted.-Resolution-The expected behavior is that the invoice will show no approver in the report until it gets approved and to avoid wrong approver name on report for invoices in approval, please create new invoice without copying previous invoice, if any invoice is copied, the approver party will get copied from the old invoice and remain there until it is approved.-See Also-3310618 - Purchase Order Approver Details not Shown in the Custom Report-Keywords-approver name missing in report, wrong approver in report, monitoring invoices

Title: Invoice Monitoring Report Shows Incorrect Total Amount in Company Currency
Content: Symptom-System shows incorrect total amount in company currency in the Invoice Monitoring report. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Select Monitoring Invoices Report-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-In the Display Currency - Conversion Date enter specific date-System shows the incorrect value for Total amount in company currency-Cause-The conversion rate in the "Invoice Monitoring" report refers to Invoice Date and hence system considers Invoice Date as a base for currency conversion. -Resolution-As per the Invoice Date in the supplier invoice system is picking the currency conversion rate and hence you see a different value for Total amount in company currency. -Keywords-Total amount in company currency; Invoice Monitoring report

Title: Multiple Line Invoices Cannot be Fully Displayed in 'Encumbrance - Line Items' Report
Content: Symptom-In the report Encumbrance - Line Items, currently, if the supplier invoice is created with multiple line items against single purchase order line Item, the report can only recognize the first line item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go toDesign Reports view.-Search for Report Encumbrance - Line Items.-Observe that if there are multiple line items in the report, only one line item of the supplier invoice is picked in the report.-Cause-This is a known limitation for this report.-This scenario is not fully considered when designing this report. As a result, at present there is a small gap in the reporting of cumulating the multiple invoice line item for a single PO item. Only the first line item will be picked in the report.-Resolution-SAP development team is working on this issue and an internal task has been created for this. This report functionality will be improved in the future release.-See Also-Keywords-Encumbrance Report, Multiple Line Invoices, Invoice Amount, Encumbrance - Line Items Custom, Encumbrance - Line Items.

Title: BYD2408 Invoice error
Content: Symptom-Error in New Supplier Invoice:-"Item: The calculated amount 123 differs from amount 454. The system calculates the amount by multiplying quantity by price divided by price unit. Ensure that the quantity, price, and price unit are correct." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the work center Supplier Invoicing-Select The view Invoice Entry-Search and select the PO ABC and click New Invoice-Click View and select the Items Tab.-From here you can see the Items come as a Kit, in which only the first line Item can has the Quantity change.-Change the quantity and click Check.-The mentioned error message appears.-Cause-This is currently a restriction known by our Development Team; this is a very rare scenario with Kit items where the price allocated to the child items (based on kit distribution %) shows a difference from the actual gross price. This issue does not occur with all kits but only with certain ones. -Resolution-As a workaround, please create the Supplier Invoice without altering the quantity & create a separate Purchase Order or delivery for remaining quantity.-Our Development Team is also currently working on a potential future solution.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Kit Items; Error

Title: Customer Invoice Request not generated for Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Customer Invoice Request not generated for Sales Order with line item type Service - fixed price.-Environment-Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing - Invoice Requests -Search for invoice requests from Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID) -System shows No Records Found-Cause-The sales order ABC is having line item with item type Service - fixed price, but the corresponding Service Confirmation DEF is released without order completion. (DEF represents the Service Confirmation ID)-Resolution-Kindly perform Service Confirmation release with order completion or Complete Execution in sales order. -You can follow the below steps. -Go to Field Service and Repair - Service Confirmations -Select and Edit Service Confirmation DEF-Click on Release -> With Order Completion-Or you can follow the below steps-Go to Sales Orders -> Sales Orders View -Select the Sales Order ABC -Edit and Click on View All -Navigate to Items tab-Select the line item and click on Complete Execution button -This will trigger the Invoice Request.

Title: Deviating Bank Information tab is Missing in the Supplier Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice however Deviating Bank Information tab is missing under the General tab. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center -Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice -Select Edit and navigate to General tab-Go to Payment Information sub tab-Deviating Bank Information sub tab is missing-Cause-This is an expected behavior. -Resolution-From 2408 version onwards, the invoice document need to have the Payment Method as Bank Transfer in the Supplier Invoice to activate the Deviating Bank Information. You can refer to the below case document below.-3508753 - Missing Deviating Bank Information on Supplier Invoice-https://me.sap.com/notes/3508753 -See Also-3508753 - Missing Deviating Bank Information on Supplier Invoice-https://me.sap.com/notes/3508753 -Keywords-Missing Deviating Bank Information on Supplier Invoice

Title: Lease Valuation Cash Flow Report - How to calculate a RoU Asset Opening value/ Lease Contract Lease Liability Opening Balance
Content: Symptom-The Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow report calculates an unexpected ROU opening balance/Lease Opening Balance for a lease contract. -To calculate the lease contract's present value (PV) you applied the discounted cash flow formula. The resulting lease liability amount/ ROU opening balance is different to the mentioned amounts displayed in the cash flow report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Lease Contract ABC-Start Date:  01.01.YYYY-End  Date: 31.12.YYYY-Lease Term in Month: 12-Interest: 5%-Lease Installments: 1000,00 LC (Local Currency)-Recurrence: Once, every month-Payment Form:  In Arrears-Apply the discounted cash flow formula: Payment / (1 + Interest Rate): -For each period you calculate a lease liability of 952,38 LC: 1000,00 LC / (1+0.05), resulting in a total lease liability/ ROU opening balance of 11.428,56 LC (952,38 LC x 12). -However, the lease contract cash flow report calculates a different ROU opening balance: 11.685,32 LC. You wonder about the formula behind this value. -Cause-1. Act/360: -In SAP Business ByDesign the net present value, interest and depreciation are calculated daily based on the actual/360 day count convention, using the actual number of days in a month and 360 days in a year to calculate interest payments. -Example: -Period 1: 01.01.YYYY to 31.01.YYYY:-Number of days 30.-Act/360: 0,083333 (30/360).-2. Compound Interest Calculation - Discount Factor Calculation: -The formula for discounting and interest calculation uses compound interest (exponential interest calculation): PV= Payment x Discount Factor (DF).-The easiest way to calculate the discount factor is by applying the following formula in MS Excel: -DF= 1/POWER((1+interest rate),number of days/360).-Example: -Interest rate: 5%, i.e. 0,05-Month: from 01.01.2024 to 31.01.2024: 30 days-DF= 1/POWER((1+0.05),30/360)= 0.995942407-3. Present Value - Lease Liability - ROU Opening Balance Calculation (at its simplest form, not regarding additional service charges, initial cost etc.) : -To calculate the present value/the lease liability opening balance on which the ROU opening balance is based on use the following formula in MS Excel: -PV=ROUND(Payment amount*DF),number of digits)*-*Use the ROUND formula according to the decimal places of the used currency (for example, enter 0 for JPY, which uses no decimal places; enter 2 for EUR which uses 2 decimal places). -Resolution-To calculate the ROU opening balance, the generic formula is '(Contract Value + Additional cost) - Total Interest Expense'.-For a comprehensive picture you can use the MS Excel and apply the formulas as above/below: -Days: =days(due date,01/01/YYYY)-act/360: days/360-Discount Factor: 1/POWER((1+interest rate),number of days/360)-PV/ROU opening balance: ROUND((Payment amount*DF),number of digits)-Due Date Number of Days act/360 Interest rate Discount factor Payment Amount PV-01/01/YYYY 0 0 0.00 0 0 0-31/01/YYYY 30 0.083333333 0.05 0.995942407 1000 995.94-29/02/YYYY 59 0.163888889 0.05 0.992035718 1000 992.04-31/03/YYYY 90 0.25 0.05 0.987876547 1000 987.88-30/04/YYYY 120 0.333333333 0.05 0.983868147 1000 983.87-31/05/YYYY 151 0.419444444 0.05 0.979743219 1000 979.74-30/06/YYYY 181 0.502777778 0.05 0.97576782 1000 975.77-31/07/YYYY 212 0.588888889 0.05 0.971676853 1000 971.68-31/08/YYYY 243 0.675 0.05 0.967603038 1000 967.6-30/09/YYYY 273 0.758333333 0.05 0.963676899 1000 963.68-31/10/YYYY 304 0.844444444 0.05 0.959636624 1000 959.64-30/11/YYYY 334 0.927777778 0.05 0.955742809 1000 955.74-31/12/YYYY 365 1.013888889 0.05 0.951735798 1000 951.74-        SUM/MROU/Lease Liabilty -Opening Balance-11685.32-See Also-3401049-Applied Interest Days for Net Present Value Calculation-Lease Valuation Cash Flow Report - How to calculate a Lease Contract's Interest Expenses, Repayment and Lease Expense Amounts?-Keywords-ROU opening balance unclear, Lease Opening Balance, Lease Contract Cash Flow

Title: Undo Release Of Invoiced Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-The system allows the execution of Undo Release action on an outbound delivery which has already been invoiced.-You expect this action be disallowed by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Access the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search and select the relevant Outbound delivery which is released and Invoiced.-Choose the Undo Release button. -The system executes this action successfully. -Cause-The ability to perform Undo Release on an invoiced outbound delivery is a feature of the system, designed for flexibility.-This feature allows the warehouse to respond to any changes in the quantity of the delivery without having to wait for changes to be made in the Invoice.-If any changes are made to an Outbound delivery once it's Invoiced, the relevant Invoice Request will have its status changed to In Conflict.-This update in Invoice Request will alert the invoicing team to make the relevant changes to the Invoice document as per agreement with the business.-If you need the system to stop Undo Release of the Outbound Delivery after it is invoice you need to scope the question "Do you want to stop undo release of outbound delivery if its already invoiced ?"-Resolution-You can follow below steps to scope the question to stop Undo Release of outbound delivery after its invoiced. -Go to the Business Configuration work center. -Navigate to the Implementation Projects view. -Select the relevant implementation project and choose the button Edit Project Scope. -Navigate to the fourth chevron named Questions. -Under Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics element expand the Outbound Logistics element. -Select the outbound delivery sub-element. -Under questions for Outbound Delivery mark the question "Do you want to stop undo release of outbound delivery if its already invoiced ? "-Once the review and confirmation of this above change is done you will not be able to perform Undo Release of outbound delivery if its already invoiced. -See Also-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Post Goods Issue, Invoiced, System Behavior, Flexibility, Invoice Request, In Conflict, Undo Release, Undo Release Error, Undo Release Issue

Title: You are Not Able to Delete an Org Unit Due to the Error "Org unit is used in Customer Return"
Content: Symptom-You are going to delete an org unit, but system shows error 'Org unit XYZ is used in Customer Return ID ABC'.  But in the return, the org unit XYZ is not used as sales unit or seller party.-ABC represents the ID of the customer return.-XYZ represents the ID of the org unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures work center view.-Click Edit.-Select the org unit XYZ.-Click "Check selected and dependent org units". system shows the error.-Cause-In the return ABC, the account/payer/bill-to party is with the ID = XYZ. -Org unit XYZ is organization CATEGORY_CODE not person and it used in transactional documents as different role code categories (Payer, Bill to Party, account, Service recipient). Hence, the org validation check identifies the usage of documents and raising the message.-Resolution-Currently, this is the designed system behavior and it is working properly as per the logic.-Keywords-org unit validation check; cannot delete org unit; technical error; Org unit is used in Customer Return ID.

Title: Unable to Select Expired Identified Stock in Production Task
Content: Symptom-The system does not allow the selection of identified stock for a production task if the stock's expiration date has passed.-Despite the expiration, the expectation is for the system to display a warning message but still allow the selection of the expired identified stock for the production task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Inventory-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center.-Proceed to the Task Control view.-Search for the relevant make task, select it and choose the Confirm button.-In the Confirmation screen, the system does not display the identified stock which is intended to be assigned to the product due to the stock's expiration date having passed.-Cause-The system does not have a setting that allows the assignment of expired identified stocks to products during the confirmation of the production task.-Resolution-Consult with your partner to develop a custom solution.-Post your feature request to the Customer Influence Forum.-See Also-Keywords-Production Control, Task Control, Identified Stock, Expiration Date, Confirmation, Custom Solution, Feature Request, Customer Influence Forum.

Title: Process Communication Error 'Sales Kit Item Base Quantity/ Unit Code is missing" on Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-There is a Process Communication Error on the sales order document flow.-In the backend, you find the error is "Sales Kit Item Base Quantity/ Unit Code is missing".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center view.-Open the order.-In Document Flow tab, you find the PCE error. click it, system shows the information: - Sales Order * cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting).-In the Application and User Management - Process Communication Errors view.-Find this sales order, the main error is not displayed. -You have to check the error in backend.-Access to backend and enter /NSESFTS.-Search BO:SALES_ORDER-Click Load by Query and then select Query by Elements.-In the ID/content field, enter the sales order ID.-You will see the sales order in the BO Instance Structure, right click the sales order ID and click Message Monitoring - Launch XI for BO. -You find the failed message.-sender: SalesOrderProcessing-Receiver Interface: AccountingSalesAndPurchasingAccountingIn-error: SalesAndPurchasingAccountingNotification * SalesItem *: Sales Kit Item Base Quantity / Unit Code is missing.-Cause-This happens in a Sales Kit scenario in the sales order, when the Sales Kit presented has no Kit item list or no Unit of Measure (UoM) maintained in the Kit Item List. Because the kit item list is not presented or has no UoM, the system is raising errors related to quantity conversions, and might also shows errors related. The system is trying to do the conversion between two Units of Measure, but this cannot happen.-Resolution-For the existing sales order, it is necessary to remove the incorrect Sales Kit from the Sales Order. -You need to maintain the proper sales kit item list for the sales kit items and ensure the UoM is presented in the sales kit correctly.-Afterwards, you can add the sales kit again in the sales order.-Keywords-Sales Kit Item Base Quantity / Unit Code is missing; PCE; process communication error; sales kit.

Title: No Change Log About Planned Quantity in Production Order
Content: Symptom-After planned quantity changed in a released production order, in corresponding change log there is no information about planned quantity change.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control, access view Production Orders.-Select a released production order, click Edit,-Select tab General, change value in Planned Quantity.-Click Save.-Select tab Miscellaneous, select sub tab Changes.-Select the latest change log, there is no information about planned quantity.-Cause-When a production order is in preparation, if planned quantity is changed, there will be information about "Planned Quantity" in corresponding change log.-However, once a production order is released,  if planned quantity is changed, there will be no information about "Planned Quantity" in corresponding change log. The change will be reflected by change of date and duration in the log.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Production Order, Planned Quantity, Change Log

Title: Cannot Find Ordered Purchase Order in Work Center View Inbound Logistics - Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-Purchase order ABC (ABC represents purchase order ID) is ordered but it cannot be found in work center view Inbound Logistics - Purchase Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Access view Purchase Orders.-Search ABC, find purchase order ABC, its status is Sent.-Go to work center Inbound Logistics.-Access view Purchase Orders.-Search ABC, there is no result.-Cause-Item in purchase order ABC has item type Expense. Since purchase order item with item type Expense is not involved in any logistics process, it won't appear in work center view Inbound Logistics - Purchase Orders.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Inbound Logistics, Item Type, Expense

Title: Error "Could not get Access to Download Area on SAP Service Marketplace"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error "Could not get access to download area on SAP Service Marketplace." when attempting to download the add-in from the self-service overview section-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center-Proceed to the Business Flexibility view-Choose on Download Center-Attempt to download the add-in-The system throws below error  "Could not get access to download area on SAP Service Marketplace."-Cause-The error is caused by a replication issue. A GTS block is applied in the CRM customer. After removing the block, the license is replicated successfully.-Resolution-The issue is being resolved by the IT team who had to replicate the license information(IT Ticket Category -IMAS_CB )-If the issue reoccurs, an IT ticket needs to be opened-For operations related questions, contact ExportControlOperations@sap.com-For legal questions, contact ExportControlLegal@sap.com-See Also-Knowledge Base Article KB0469569 - Processing Download Issues in ByDesign Tenant-Keywords-SAP Excel add-in, download issue, self-service overview section, access issue, SAP Service Marketplace, replication issue, GTS block, license information, IT ticket, operations related questions, legal questions.

Title: "Assign to All Purchase Requests" functionality does not update all the Purchase Requests in Assign Source of Supply
Content: Symptom-You are trying to maintain a Supplier for multiple Purchase Requests using the "Assign Source of Supply" functionality, but only one Purchase Request get updated with this Supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the work center Purchase Requests and Orders-Select the view Purchase Requests-Select multiple Purchase Requests and click "Assign Source of Supply"-From the new window select multiple Purchase Requests again and click "Assign to All Purchase Requests".-You can see not all the lines will have this Supplier maintained as you were expected.-Cause-If the Source of Supply is Contract, only the Purchase Requests which have a Product ID linked with the mentioned Contract will be updated with the picked Supplier.-If the Source of Supply is List Price, all the Purchase Requests will be updated with the picked Supplier.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Source of Supply, Purchase Requests, Assign to All Purchase Requests

Title: Monitoring Invoices Report Shows Incorrect Document Type
Content: Symptom-In the monitoring invoices report, system shows the document type as Invoice for the invoice cancellation document. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center -Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view -Select the relevant Invoice Cancellation document-You can see that document type is Invoice Cancellation in the Invoice-Now go to Business Analytics work center and Design Reports view-Select Monitoring Invoices report and search for relevant Invoice ID-Execute the report-You can see the Document type appears as Invoice-Cause-In the current release, system shows only two filters for Document Type i.e. Invoice and Credit Memo in the monitoring invoices report. -Resolution-The Monitoring Invoices report is based on Supplier Invoice Item Details data source. This data source shows all invoices per supplier, product, or account assignment. The accountant can check the invoice value, the price, the quantity, and the status of the invoice (for example, if it was posted or in approval or in error correction) for the specified time period.-The document type Invoice Cancellation is stored in the header section of the invoice. However the monitoring invoices report is based on Supplier Invoice Item Details data source. we see that characteristic could be improved here to indicate the right document type for cancellation invoices. Hence the idea of characteristic enhancement can be take as an new improvement. You can post the idea in influence forum -https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -Keywords-Monitoring Invoices Report Shows Incorrect Document Type; Incorrect Document Type in Monitoring Invoices Report

Title: Unable to Modify Validity Dates for Certain Tax Codes.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When attempting to change the validity to date from unlimited to dd.mm.yyyy for the Tax code XYZ (XYZ represents the Tax Code), an error message is displayed.-The error message states 'Change of field not permitted'.-This issue prevents the modification of the validity dates, tax event, and "Is Obsolete" for certain tax codes.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Configuration work center.-Proceed to the Overview view.-Search for the activity: Tax on Goods and Services.-Open the option "Define Tax Codes".-Search for the Tax Code "XYZ" for Country/Region "DEF" (DEF represents the Country/Region).-Attempt to change the Valid to Date from "Unlimited" to "dd.mm.yyyy".-The error message 'Change of field not permitted' is displayed.-Cause-The error occurs because the system has not granted authorization to modify the TAXEVENT, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, IS_OBSOLETE, and CONSTANT_NAME for specific tax codes.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. To check which tax code is editable, please check the steps below: -Open an STFK session for the customer system.-Open SE24 transaction.--In the Object Type enter CL_BCT_BOPF2WORKSPACE.-Click "Display".----In the Class Interface, go to "Methods" tab and double click in the Method: IF_BCT_BOPF2WORKSPACE~MODIFY.-- Set an External BreakPoint in the line 8 and 69.-----Go back to UI and proceed with the desired change (validity dates, tax event, and "Is Obsolete") in the Tax Code, and click "Save". -The Debugger will open.-Click "Continue" button or F8. ----Double click on the  ASSIGN <s_bo_node_content>-rts_chngbl_before->* TO <ts_chngbl>.-Now Double click on the Variable <S_BO_NODE_CONTENT>-RTS_CHNGBL_BEFORE->*.-----The Values shown in the table are all the tax codes for each country.-To search for specific Country/Region or tax code click on "Table Display in ALV" button. ----Now select the desired column and then "Filter" button. ----After filter for the specific column, there are tax codes without "X" in the fields, this means those fields are not editable.----The customer/ partner should be informed that this is the reason for the error message, because the change in the desired field is not editable in the UI or backend. -See Also-Keywords-Tax Management, Tax Codes, Change of field not permitted, TAXEVENT, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, IS_OBSOLETE, CONSTANT_NAME, authorization.

Title: Contact Name is not Fully Displayed for the Ship-To Address on the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When adding a contact to the Ship-To name field on a Sales Order, the Title, First and Last names of the contact are copied to the Additional Name fields with some characters missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click on Edit.-Click on View All.-On the Ship-To section, click on Address Details.-The Additional Name fields do not show the complete name of the contact maintained for the Ship-To party. A part of it is truncated and therefore not displayed.-Cause-There is a character limit for the Additional Name fields on the Business ByDesign's system, which is:-Title (regardless its amount of characters) + 59 characters. -This limitation works for all Additional Name fields together (Additional Name 1, 2, 3...). The sum of its characters must be within the limitation above.-Example:-The contact has the following attributes: -Title: Mr.-First Name: 1234567890123456789012345678901234567890-Last Name: 1234567890123456789012345678901234567890-The Additional Name fields will show the following:-Additional Name 1: Mr.-Additional Name 2: 1234567890123456789012345678901234567890-Additional Name 3: 1234567890123456789-Which is the title and 59 more characters.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-address, address details, ship-to party, contact, additional name, sales order, truncated, title, not displayed, byd.

Title: Error Message "SQL error during data preparation: invalid datatype: LOB type in distinct select clause: line 1 col 5067 (at pos 5066)"
Content: Symptom-The data model fails when Loading Data in Machine Learning Cockpit with below error-SQL error during data preparation: invalid datatype: LOB type in distinct select clause: line 1 col 5067 (at pos 5066)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Machine Learning Cockpit work center-My Models view-Create a New model-Click Data Load button-Cause-The data load step is failing because there are some fields that were included in training that are of datatype string and text which are not supported by the framework as they have unlimited length.-Resolution- Framework can only support fields with a max length of 60.-Keywords-data load, data model, mlc, model, training

Title: Invoice ID Missing In The Electronic Payment XML File For Mexico
Content: Symptom-You create the Electronic Payment XML file for Mexico and notice that a cleared invoice is missing in the file. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Electronic Payment Documents view.-Search for the payment document ID XYZ (XYZ stands for the ID of the payment document).-Select Edit.-Select the Attachments tab.-Open the XML document.-Document ID: XXX (XXX stands for the invoice ID) is not in the XML file.-Cause-Invoice XXX is cleared with Credit Memo YYY (YYY stands for the credit memo ID).-Select The Document List tab.-Select Document ID XXX.-Under Clearing Details subtab, select the Clearing ID.-Here, you see the Document Type that clear the invoice and it is a Credit Memo. -Resolution-The XML file only shows the invoices that have been cleared with Document Type: Payment. -When the invoice is cleared with a credit memo, the invoice does not show in the XML file. This is the designed system behaviour. -Keywords-Electronic Payment Documents, XML File, Mexico Electronic Payment File.

Title: The Greater Than relative selection from a report provides wrong values
Content: Symptom-Within a report, you are filtering a field by Greater than 15, and the result wrongly shows 3.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open any report.-Filter a field which is "Text" type by Greater than 15, and the result shows 3.-Cause-This field is supposed to show days, but it has been created as a text field. Since it is a text and not a number, any sorting or comparison will happen according to how numbers are treated when they're stored as texts. For texts, '3' will be greater '15' since ASCII value of 3 is greater than 1.-Resolution-For the comparison/filtering to work, you must store these texts as 03 instead of 3. A much better approach would be to create this extension field as a number, add it to the report as a key figure and then use the conditions feature to restrict the values.

Title: Unable to Delete a Service Line Item in Project
Content: Symptom-Delete button is greyed out despite project purchase request is cancelled for Project and service. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view and select the relevant Project -Go to the Products tab and create a new Purchase request for i.e. Service -Submit the request and go to Purchase requests view -Filter on the Purchase requests created based on Project-Cancel the Open Quantity-Go back to the Project and Project task -Go to the Work tab-You can see that the delete button is still grayed out-Cause-Once you create the project purchase request from products tab, it will be in draft status. So the Delete button will be enabled only when project purchase request is in In Preparation status. Once it is released to purchasing activities, the document will be converted from project purchase request to purchase request. Despite you cancel the purchase request, the Delete button will not be enabled as it is already Released. -Resolution-The Delete button will be enabled only when project purchase request is in In Preparation status. This is an expected behavior. -Keywords-Delete button is greyed out despite project purchase request is cancelled for Project and service.

Title: Concur Integration Settings Showing new Service Provider CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT
Content: Symptom-When changing the registration of services or users for the SAP Business ByDesign to SAP Concur Integration a new service provider CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT is offered for configuration in addition or instead of the expected service providers CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH and CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have set up the integration to SAP Concur before release 22.02 and did all the necessary settings for CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH and CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2. With the upgrade to release 22.05 the integration scenario to Concur was adopted to JWT web token based authentication and replaced the deprecated v1 Financial Service API calls by the new v4 version. This was announced in the What's New document of this release: click here-Service Registration:-In the Business Configuration work center, Implementation Projects view, search for the recurring activity Integration with Concur Solutions.-Click Open-In the list of service providers you now find the entry CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT with a new Client ID-User Registration:-Go to the Application and User Management work center, User Registration for OAUTH2 Web Services view.-On the Overview screen, CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT is shown in the list-Cause-With release 22.05 the integration settings have been migrated fully automatically to the new gateway without user interaction. Based on the settings for the two services CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH and CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2 a new service CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT has been set up with this migration. The necessary parameters like client ID and client secret were provided by the Concur API called to switch to the new authentication process. For more information please refer to the Concur Developer documentation-The deprecated service provider instances CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH and CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2 remain in your SAP Business ByDesign tenant as a fallback in case of severe problems when integrating via the new gateway. However, as soon as your system is migrated successfully you can ignore these settings, they are not considered any longer by the system. With release 22.11 the obsolete services are deleted from the system.-Further changes in your settings after 22.05:-• The predefined communication arrangements Concur Integration and Concur Integration OAUTH2 were replaced by Concur Integration JWT and were therefore set to isolated. They are deleted with 22.11.-• The logon credentials in the communication arrangement Concur Integration User Credentials have to be changed from user/password to CompanyID/requestToken in case a new access token cannot be requested via the user’s refresh token because it is outdated. For more information please refer to the SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide-Remark: When you started implementing the integration to SAP Concur with release 22.02 or later you directly started the setup with the new gateway, the service provider CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT and the new communication arrangements.-Resolution-In case you want to register additional users for the provider service CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT you are requested to enter the client secret. Since there is a new client ID assigned to this service also the client secret has changed. If you do not have access to the new client secret via your SAP Concur consultant please report an incident-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration, ByD User Registration for OAUTH2 Web Services, CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT, Concur Client Secret

Title: Sales Order Invoice Request is Created with Processed Status
Content: Symptom-You have released a sales order as well as the outbound delivery of the order, but you find the sales order invoice request is created with Processed status. You are not able to further invoice the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search the sales order ABC, you find the sales order invoice request ABC is with status Processed. You are not able to further invoice it.-ABC represents the ID of the sales order.-Cause-Once the outbound delivery is released, system will create outbound delivery invoice request as the base of the invoice.-The sales order invoice requests is not the base of invoice. Once a sales order is released, system automatically creates the sales order invoice request with processed status, it stores the pricing information of the sales order and will be used when creating customer invoice. System determines the pricing details from sales order invoice request and determine the delivery quantity information from outbound delivery invoice request. (Same concept works in other CRM documents, i.e. service order, contracts etc...)-Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-For Product Delivery-based item, please invoice the outbound delivery invoice request to create customer invoice.-Keywords-sales order invoice request; outbound delivery invoice request; product delivery-based; invoice request; processed.

Title: Microsoft Office 2024 to Disable ActiveX Controls by Default
Content: Symptom-Microsoft Office 2024 to disable ActiveX controls by default-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The Blog from MS: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/microsoft-office-2024-to-disable-activex-controls-by-default/-Microsoft has made the decision to disable legacy software in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio client apps starting with the October release of Microsoft Office 2024. This action is being taken due to a recent cyber security issue where some clients' data was breached. For more details, please refer to the following link-https://cisoseries.com/cybersecurity-news-avis-rentals-breach-microsoft-disables-activex-wisconsin-medicare-breach/#:~:text=The%20company%20will%20start%20turning,static%20images%20in%20Office%20documents.  -The October release of Microsoft Office 2024 will disable the legacy software in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio client apps. Microsoft will begin turning off ActiveX controls in documents opened in Win32 Office desktop apps in October 2024, and will extend this to Microsoft 365 apps in April 2025. After this, existing ActiveX objects will be displayed as static images in Office documents. Microsoft has chosen to disable all legacy software in Windows apps and transfer it to 365 apps.-Keywords-Microsoft Office 2024, ActiveX, Microsoft 365 apps

Title: Production Lot Closure Run: Why Are Some Lots Not Closed?
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled the Production Lot Closure Run, but some Lots are not being closed even though the the Planned Latest End Date and the Effective End of Production fall within the Horizon you have maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Production Control work center. -Go to the Automated Actions view and select Lot Closure Run. -Find and select the relevant Run ID.-Show All Logs.-Find and open the relevant Application Log ID.-You can see under the General Tab under Summary that 0 of 0 lots were closed.-Click Edit.-You can see user have maintained Run Horizon: XX Hour(s) (XX represents a number of hours) and the Planning Areas Equal To: ABC (ABC represents the Planning Area ID).-Go to the Monitoring view.-Find the relevant Production Lot ID.-Click Edit.-Go to the General tab. -You can see the Production End is within the above Horizon of XX hours, but the Lot was not closed when the Run was executed.-Cause-The duration defined in the mass production lot closure run affects the horizon defined in the Business Configuration for the production lot closure strategy and vice versa.-We can observe that in Business configuration settings for production lot closure strategy, you have maintained horizon in days as 5 days.-Due to the Business Configuration settings, the production lot closure will be Production end + Horizon days.-In the system lot schedule run, we can see you have only maintained the Run Horizon as XX hours.-The lot closure run will consider the production lot closure date before the production schedule date + Run Horizon.-Due to the duration in Business Configuration settings, the affected production lots did not close.- Resolution-The system is working as expected.-Keywords-Lot Closure Run, Business Configuration

Title: Contract Templates are not Displayed When Creating a Contract From Template
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a new contract from template, a contract template is not displayed on the selection, even though it is active.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to the Contract Templates view.-There are active templates on the system.-Go to the Contracts view.-Click on New -> Contract.-Enter an Account.-Enter a Sales Unit.-Click on Create From Template button.-Click on the value box.-One or more templates are not displayed on the options, even though it is active on the system according to the Contract Templates view.- Cause-In the drop-down list on the Contract Template ID field, the system proposes only templates that:-1. Are released-The system does not include templates that are not active.-2. Match the sales organization and distribution channel of the account entered in the Contract-The system also includes templates that do not have a sales organization and distribution channel specified.-3. Contain products that would not cause an error if added to the new contract-The system draws up a product list based on products at item and entitled product levels, and checks these products against the sales organization and distribution channel of the account. If a product does not match, and would therefore produce an error if added to the contract, the system filters out the related template.-4. Contain at least one item-The system filters out templates that do not have any items.-NOTE: In case a template is not proposed on the selection and the reason is unknown, it is possible to manually enter the template ID on the Contract Template ID field and check the error messages. The inconsistencies will be displayed by the system.-Resolution-Check and assure that the relevant contract template match all the criteria above. -See Also-Help Portal - Create a Contract from a Contract Template.-Keywords-contract template, customer contract, active, template selection, not displayed, not showing, not possible, sales order, byd.

Title: Lease Valuation Cash Flow Report - How to calculate a Lease Contract's Interest Expenses, Repayment and Lease Expense Amounts?
Content: Symptom-You are running the Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow report for a lease contract and want to clarify how the Interest Expenses, Repayments and Lease Expense amounts are calculated in the months of the lease contract's life time. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Lease Contract Management work center go to the Lease Contracts view.-Find lease contract XYZ (XYZ represents a lease contract ID).-Press Reports and choose Cash Flows. -In the report you wonder how the Interest Expense, Repayment and Lease Expense values are calculated for the different due dates. -Resolution-Two main principles apply when calculating all the values (ROU opening balance, interest expense, repayment amount, lease expense), displayed in the Lease Contract Valuation Cash flow report: -1. Act/360: -In SAP Business ByDesign the net present value, interest and depreciation are calculated daily based on the actual/360 day count convention, using the actual number of days in a month and 360 days in a year to calculate interest payments. -Example: -Period 1: 01.01.YYYY to 31.01.YYYY:-Number of days 30.-Act/360: 0,083333 (30/360).-2. Interest Expense  Calculation: -In SAP Business ByDesign the interest expense calculation is based on the compound interest principle. -Formulas: -To calculate the Interest Expense, Repayment, Lease Expense per period, use MS Excel and apply the following formulas: -Contract Value (Clearing Amount*Lease Term)+any additional costs (Service Charges, initial cost, exercise price etc.)-Act/360 see KBA 3503999-ROU Depreciation ROUND((ROU opening balance of first due date/365)*number of period days,number of currency digits)-ROU opening balance/-Lease Liability Opening Balance-                         In general, (Contract Value + Additional cost) - Total Interest Expense, see KBA 3503999-ROU Ending Balance  ROUND(Opening Balance - ROU Depreciation),number if currency digits)-Interest Expense ROUND(Opening Balance*(POWER(1+_interest_rate,(Period Days/360))-1),2)-Repayment Payment Amount (Clearing Amount)- Interest Expense-Lease Liability Ending Balance Opening Balance - Payment Amount + Interest Expense-Lease Expense Depreciation +Interest Expense-Example: -Lease Contract XYZ-Start Date: 01.01.YYYY-End Date: 31.12.YYYY-Currency: USD (2 currency digits)-Interest Rate: 5%-Lease Term in month: 12-Lease installment: 1000,00 USD -Recurrence: Once a month-Payment Form: In Arrears. -Create a table in MS Excel with the following collumns: -Date Days-(Number of days in period) Contract Value RoU Asset   Lease Liability Lease Expense-Opening Balance Depreciation Ending Balance Interest Rate Opening Balance Clearing/Payment Amount Interest Expense Repayment Ending balance-In the table-enter the Due Dates of the periods into the dates collumn,-enter the clearing/payment amounts into the Clearing/Payment amount fields for each month,-enter the interest rate into the Interest Rate field for each due date. -for the first due date, 31/01/YYYY, calculate the ROU opening balance and Lease Liability opening balance, using KBA 3503999, linked below:-  A B C D E F G H I J K L M-1 Date Days-(Number of days in period) Contract Value RoU Asset   Lease Liability Lease Expense-Opening Balance Depreciation Ending Balance Interest Rate Opening Balance Clearing/Payment Amount Interest Expense Repayment-Ending balance-                         2  31/01/YYYY 30   11685.32     5.00% 11685.32 1000        -3 29/02/YYYY 29         5.00%   1000        -4 31/03/YYYY 31         5.00%   1000 31         5.00%   1000        -10 30/09/YYYY 30         5.00%   1000        -11 31/10/YYYY 31         5.00%   1000        -12 30/11/YYYY 30         5.00%   1000        -13 31/12/YYYY 31         5.00%   1000        -Now use the above formulas to fill in all the blank fields. -For the first due date, 31/01/YYYY, row 3, the formulas look as follows in MS Excel: -Contract Value =SUM(I3:I14)-ROU Depreciation =ROUND((D2/365)*B2,2)-ROU opening balance/-Lease Liability Opening Balance-                         see KBA 3503999-ROU Ending Balance  =D2-E2-Interest Expense =ROUND(D2*(POWER(1+G2,(B2/360))-1),2)-Repayment =I2-J2-Lease Liability Ending Balance =H2-I2+J2-Lease Expense =E2+J2-...resulting in the following values: -Date Days-(Number of days in period)
