Opening Balance-3401049-Applied Interest Days for Net Present Value Calculation-Keywords-lease contract, interest expense, repayment, lease expense calculation, cash flow

Title: Output E-mail is not Replicated to Sender's E-mail Client
Content: Symptom-You have sent a document output (for example, a purchase order) through e-mail with a specific sender address, however when the user accesses the sender's e-mail outbox, the output e-mail does not appear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Since the output e-mails are sent from the Business ByDesign servers, rather than the e-mail account server (for example, Gmail or Outlook), the e-mails are not replicated to the sender's outbox in their e-mail client.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-OM, SMTP, recipient, domain

Title: Error - Value XYZ in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Not possible to assign a payment file structure to a payment medium format in Outgoing Bank Transfers fine tuning activity due to error while saving:-'Value XYZ in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree.' (XYZ represents the payment file structure ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project and click Open Activity List.-Open fine tuning activity Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Click Edit assignment of payment file structures to the payment medium formats.-Click Add Row.-Enter the concerned Payment Medium Format, Character Set and File Structure ID.-Click Save.-Error message is thrown:-'Value XYZ in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree'-Cause-In the backend, the Mapping Type - DMEE is not maintained for the Payment Medium Format.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to assign the Payment File Structures with the Payment Medium Format:-Open the backend.-Enter T-code BCE.-Select Configuration Workspaces.-Enter * in the Configuration Workspace field.-Double-click the Initial Implementation.-Click on Fine Tuning. Select Global Fine Tuning on BC Node button and Enter Node ID - A1S_FIN_FIO_PAYMGLO_C_FIO_PAYM. Click on Execute.--You can find the the current content of the node.-In the above screenshot, click on Display <-> Change and Insert Row. Here, you have to maintain the FORMAT_CODE(Payment Medium Format), MAPPING_TYPE = DMEE and CHARSET_CODE. Click on Save.-Note: You can identify the custom File structure ID, which is created using SAP Cloud Application Studio. The error message looks like "Value Y*****_ in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree".-In this case, you can maintain the assignment in the front end with a User ID that has access to the Business Configuration work center, while having with the same User ID the solution Y*****_ open in the SAP Cloud APplication Studio. Basically, it is not a backend mapping, but it is a SAP Cloud Application Studio adjustment.-See Also-KBA 2474689 - Error Message When Assigning Payment File Structure to Payment Medium Format: Value in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree-Keywords-Value XYZ in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree,  setting DMEE Configuration, Payment file structure

Title: Is Microsoft Purview's Self-Hosted Integration Runtime Supported in SAP Business ByDesign?
Content: Symptom-Microsoft Purview offers the option to use a "self-hosted integration runtime". Is this feature supported for SAP Business ByDesign?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There is no information from SAP about the support of Microsoft Purview for SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-We recommend reaching out to the Microsoft team for further clarification.-See Also-Connect to and manage an SAP S/4HANA source | Microsoft Learn-Keywords-Microsoft Purview, Business ByDesign, Self-Hosted Integration Runtime

Title: Document Remains "Pending" Status In Output History Tab When Sending Purchase Orders To External System Via Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-Document remains "Pending" status in Output History tab when sending Purchase Orders to external system via Communication Arrangement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Order view.-Filter All Purchase Orders. -Select particular Company & Supplier ID.-Select & View Purchase Order.-Navigate to Output History.-Document status will be "Pending".-Cause-Communication System ID and Business Instance-System Instance ID are different.-Resolution-User has to maintain Communication System ID and Business Instance-System Instance ID as the same.-After modifying both IDs, Purchase order will be delivered to the end-point and "pending" status will be changed to "successful".-See Also- 3008211 - Error While Checking Connection in the Custom Web Service Communication Arrangement-Keywords-Pending, Output history, status, Purchase Order, Communication Arrangement

Title: Message 'No object found for selection' for a Landed Cost Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You create a new Landed Cost Clearing Run and see no purchasing document is picked and message shows 'No object found for selection'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Landed Cost Clearing view and open the respective Landed Cost Clearing Run.-Under Messages, run shows 'No object found for selection'.-Cause-Even though the purchasing document is created with invoicing and the goods receipt is done, Landed Cost Clearing Status is still Open and the run considers the purchasing document when it is Cleared.-Resolution-You can check the status and mark the status as Cleared by following below path:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Open report Landed Cost – Monitor and Set Clearing Status for Goods Receipts (Report ID FININVU24_Q0001).-Execute the report with details as per Landed Cost Clearing Run to see details.-Here you see the Landed Cost Clearing Set Status still shows 'Open'.-Left click 'Landed Cost Clearing And Component' --> Execute Actions -> 'Change Status to be Cleared'. Perform same thing for other component as well if available.-Now create a new Landed Cost Clearing Run.-Remark: In case the Report is executed through Business Analytics work center, a message: "Executing actions in key user mode is not possible" may be raised. To avoid such occurrence, it is recommended to execute the Report through Inventory Valuation work center.-See Also- SAP Community Blog Post: Landed Costs in SAP Business ByDesign – Analytical Enhancements-Help Portal: Landed Costs Clearing Runs-Keywords-Landed cost, No object found for selection, purchasing document, purchase order

Title: Price Component is Displayed in Different Language in Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components Report which is not Expected
Content: Symptom-You run the Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components report the Price Component is displayed in different language which was not expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Reports view.-Search for report: Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components. -Open the Report.-In the Selection, enter ABC for the characteristic Invoice (ABC represents the ID of your customer invoice).-Run the Report. -Cause-The field 'Price Component' on the Report is mapped to the 'Description' in the Pricing and Invoicing tab and is saved based on the logon language used while creating and releasing the Invoice Request. This field is used to display the Price List from which the Price Component was automatically determined based on logon language.-The same applies to the Report Sales Order Volume with Price Components-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Report, Price Component, language; Sales Order Volume with Price Components; Sales Order; Language; List Price;

Title: The Dump Error "Please try Resuming Your Work. If You Still Face Issues, Report an Incident." is Displayed When Activating the Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When attempting to check or activate an organizational structure, the system displays the following error message after a few minutes:-"Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management Work Center.-Under Common tasks, click on Edit Org Structures.-Enter an Effective Date and click on Ok.-Select the org unit to be activated.-Click on the Check button (alternatively, click on the Activate button).-From the drop down list, select Check Selected Structure (alternatively, click on Activate Selected Structure).-After a few minutes, the below dump error message appears:-"Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident."-Cause-This is a common timeout dump caused by the amount of data being processed.-Resolution-In order to properly perform the required operation (activation or check), the process can be executed in the background of the system. -To perform the check or activation action in the background, follow the below steps:-Go to Organizational Management Work Center.-Under Common tasks, click on Edit Org Structures.-Enter an Effective Date and click on Ok.-Select the org unit to be activated.-Click on the Check button (alternatively, click on the Activate button).-From the drop down list, select Check Selected and Dependent Org Units in Background  (alternatively, click on Activate Selected and Dependent Org Units in Background).-This will perform the required actions in a background job which is not subject to UI timeouts.-Keywords-Organizational unit, Activate, Organizational management, selected, dependent

Title: Tax G/L Accounts are not Showing in Journal Entry for Stock Transfer Order
Content: Symptom-You are not able to see the Tax G/L account postings in the Journal entry for IGST related Stock Transfer Order (Outbound delivery).- Country:India-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-In the Show field, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection option from the drop down.-Search for the relevant Delivery ID.-Select the Delivery ID and click on Edit.-Go to Document flow and there is no Journal entry for Warehouse confirmation.-Cause-IGST will be calculated for Stock Transfer between two different GST registered Tax Reporting Units of the company.-During release of outbound delivery GST invoice will be generated and Warehouse request will consider Inventory cost maintained in the material.-You need to maintain the Inventory cost for the material before creating the Stock Transfer Order. You need to maintain the cost for SHIP FROM and SHIP TO locations.-You can check the SHIP FROM and SHIP TO locations in the Stock Transfer Delivery Overview.-Resolution-You need to follow below steps to maintain Inventory Cost for the respective material:-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products -> By Materials view.-In the Show field, select All Materials by Selection option from the drop down.-Search for the relevant material ID.-Click on Edit and select View All tab.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Select the respective Company and Business Residence.-Click on Edit Cost and maintain the cost and save it.-Now you need to create new Stock Transfer Order to show the GST details in the delivery note.-See Also- 3268059 - Tax Details are Showing Blank in the Delivery Note for Stock Transfer Invoice in Interstate Stock Transfer Scenario-Keywords-GST Stock transfer order, IGST tax G/L's are missing, Warehouse confirmation, Tax accounts are missing for STO

Title: Processing Download Issues in ByDesign Tenant
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to download additional software in the Download Center, the following error message appears:-No Access to SAP Service Marketplace.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The customer might report this issue from Home > Self-Services Overview > Install Additional Software, but this view is not available with a Support User.-Instead, the issue can be reproduced as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Click on Download Center.-Try to download the same add-in as the customer, however it is advised to test as many as possible.-The mentioned error message should appear.-Cause-A) If the issue is technical, usually only 1 or 2 add-in is affected. This then most likely affects all systems, not just the customers i.e. the add-in is not available in our DEMO systems either.-B) Incorrect data in CRM systems. The license material codes assigned to the customers contract are either invalid or incorrectly maintained.-C) Expired contract/order or Contract block due to payment issues.-Resolution-The incidents related to ByDesign Systems will now be processed by ByD Technology Team.- Prerequisites, used transactions and tools:-Product and Production Management System (PPMS)-Cloud Reporting Tool.-If the issue is technical, where all the Addins are affected, then the incident first has to be forwarded to SRD-CC-SWD. Required analysis from Support are as follows:-PPMS check to determine if the issue is technical or license related:-open I7P in SAP Logon-open the Service PPMS > Product and Production Management System > SWDC Control Center > Download Objects.-In the Download Object Test enter the Technical Key of the tested add-in and the M-User number of the customers system in the User field and click on Execute.-NOTE 1: The M-User number of system is a representation of the Tenant ID. Example: if the Tenant ID is 740112478, the M-User id is M0740112478 (add M in front of the last 10 digits of the Tenant ID). In a BCP incident this number is located under Parameters > SAPSYSNO.-NOTE 2: The Technical key which is the Object ID can be taken from the Network Trace. Example: In the Chrome Browser, open the Developer Tools. Now download the Addin. A json entry will be available in the Network Trace.-Click on the json and in the Headers, under the Request Payload, you can see the Object ID.-If all the PPMS checks are passed, create an incident and forward to operation team.-2) If only a specific Addin is affected for the customer and our Demo systems, then reach out to the respective Development team who has developed the Addin.-Example : SRD-CC-OIN-GW for Outlook and SRD-CC-OIN-XL for Excel Addin.-3) If a specific Addin is affected the customer system where they are not able to download.-a) Then the first steps is to check the Cloud Reporting Tool, for that Customer:-Launch the Cloud Reporting Tool: https://reporting.ondemand.com/sap/crp/cdo-Input the Customer Name and click on Orders.-Check if there is any valid ERP Order ID which has a "Valid To" date indicating a Future date. (Indicated in a Green Entry).-b) Then, you may have to raise a IT Ticket to check this issue. Choose the Component : IMAS_CB .-Provide the details in the following Template :-Customer Name :-Tenant URL :-Customer ID-ERP Order ID along with "Valid From" and "Valid To" dates.-Attach the screenshot of the I7P check along with the M User ID and Object ID.-The IT Team will provide the next steps on how to proceed further.-Keywords-No Access, SAP Service Marketplace, Addin, Download Center

Title: Profit Center and Segment not Derived in The Trial Balance Report
Content: Symptom-The profit center and segment are shown as "#" when executing the Trial Balance report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger workcenter.-Go to the List subview.-In the Trial Balance report, maintain the required parameters (Company details, Set of Books, Accounting Period/Year and G/L Account).-Under the G/L Account Reporting Structure: Move the elements Segment, Profit Center, and Business Transaction Type to Rows.-Click Go to execute the report.-Notice that the Segment field is shown as "#".-Cause-One of the reasons for this behavior is that the default profit center is not maintained for the company in the respective Business Configuration activity.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Select Fine Tune Activity Profit Center Derivation.-Click Edit Default Profit Center.-Maintain the Profit Center and Save.-Once the Trial Balance report is executed again, the Profit Center and Segment will be displayed.-See Also-SAP Help Center Document Derivation of Profit Center and Segments-Keywords-trial balance; profit center; segment; default profit center

Title: Dump Occurs When Enabling Custom Fields Using Adaptation Mode
Content: Symptom-System dump while enabling some custom fields which are hidden using adaption mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center, Invoice Request view.-Select To Be Invoiced Requests from the dropdown list.-Choose any Invoice Request.-Go for Adaptation Mode.-Dump occurs.-Cause-Publish activity is not performed for the screen.-Resolution-Please go through below steps:-Perform the Publish action without any change.-At affected screen, go to User menu. -Select Key User Settings. -Start Adaptation Mode.-Select Ok for the warning message.-Click Publish.-Keywords-Dump, Adaptation mode, custom fields, Invoice request dump

Title: Scope Item is not Copied from Request for Change Template
Content: Symptom-Request for Change templates are used with a scope item defined in the scope assignment block of the template. When creating a request for change from the template the scope item is not copied to the request for change.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Request for Change template in the CRM UI-Define a scope item in the scope assignment block-Release the template-Create a Request for Change document from the template-See that there is no scope item in the assignment block of the resulting request for change-Cause-The copy control rules are incorrect-The wrong transaction type was selected in the scope assignment block in the template-Resolution-Check the copy control rules-Execute transaction code SM34-Maintain cluster AIC_SETTINGS2-Find the template transaction type (SMCT, ZMCT, etc.)-Select "Copy Control Rules"-Find the line that defines the rules for the target transaction type (SMCT -> SMCR, ZMCT -> ZMCR, etc.)-Check that the column "Scope" is ticked-Check that the correct transaction type has been selected in the scope assignment block for the template-On the CRM UI navigate to your template-Scroll down to the scope assignment block-Click the dropdown and check the options available-If needed enable keys in the dropdown options (Click "Personalize" in the header -> Personalize settings > Tick "Show keys in dropdown lists")-  Check that the correct transaction type has been chosen-For example if copy control rules do not allow SMMJ to be created from ZMCR then SMMJ should not be selected in the template. Instead if ZMCR -> ZMMJ is permitted ZMMJ should be used.-  See Also-2636654 - How to configure Copy Control for follow-up transactions - SAP Solution Manager-Keywords-copy control rules, request for change, template, RFC, RFC template, charm, scope, assignment block, scope item, SMCT, ZMCT, SMCR, ZMCR, copy, solution manager, solman

Title: Unexpected sequence of change documents when using CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT
Content: Symptom-You are using CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT to handle your status changes.-These status changes could imply the triggering of an import action.-Therefore, import order could be relevant.-You introduce the documents on desired sequence expecting status changes are handled in that order.-The sequence is not respected.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Access CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT screen.-Introduce several documents on a specific sequence.-You execute the report.-Documents are handled in a non-expected order.-Cause- The report CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT is not designed to handle import order of changes. This is documented in online help.-If you want to set multiple change documents to the next status (for example, from Authorized for Production to Imported into Production), execute the batch job CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT. To set all change documents assigned to a change cycle to the next status, specify the change cycle ID. You can also specify other selection criteria. For example, you can select the urgent changes as the transaction type and specify a change cycle ID to set all urgent changes of the change cycle to the next status. You can also use this report to import all changes at a scheduled time, into the follow-on systems.-Caution: Using this report for a batch import of multiple documents may lead to issues:-The dependencies of different change documents are not foreseeable. As a result, the system cannot process the import order automatically.-If multiple imports are triggered simultaneously, the program might be impacted due to interferences.-Resolution-This is standard and expected behavior.-You can either develop your own report here, or you have to run CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT for multiple times in sequential - each time you need to give the change ID you want to import so that the order is handled by your execution.-See Also-2285580 - CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT does not change status [VIDEO]-Keywords-CRM_SOCM_SERVICE_REPORT, wrong, import, order, sequence, dependency, Change Request Management, SolMan

Title: Bank Statement Postprocessing Status Remains "In Process"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-When you post the bank statement the Post processing status does not change to Not Required. Instead it stays in status In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Select All Bank Statements.-Search for the bank statement.-Here you will notice that bank statement Postprocessing status is still In Process.-Cause-This case is applied only when the bank statement is uploaded and there are no items in it. The status remains in "In Process".-You can open the Bank Statement > Go to the Transactions tab > You could see there are no items listed in the bank statement.-Resolution-Note the following before updating the status of Bank Statement-Make sure that there are no items in the Bank Statement or all items should be in not required status. -We need approval from the customer to update the status from backend.-1. Login into backend-2. Go to SESFTS-3. Enter the BO: FOPXP_BANKSTAT-  4. Navigate to Load by Query-> ROOT – QU_BY_ELEMENTS-  5. Enter the Document ID: XYZ (You can view the Document ID in the Bank Statements UI)-6. Click Navigate-> ITEM. The screen will not show the details if there are no items in the bank statement.-  7. Click Navigate Back button-8. Click Pencil Icon – Exclusive-  9. Select OverrallPostprocessingCode as 1(Not required)- 10. Save the Data-See Also-KBA 3102952 - Bank Statement Postprocessing Remains In Process-KBA 2140745 - Bank Statement Appears with Postprocessing Required at Statement Level While Postprocessing is Not Required at Item level-KBA:2050083 - Bank Statement Postprocessing Status Remains In Process-Keywords-bank statement; postprocessing; in process; required; not required

Title: The Error "Items of delivery group have different requested delivery dates" is Displayed For a Sales Order Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -The Sales Order document is showing a Process Communication Error in the Document Flow tab and when verifying in the Application and User Management Work Center the error "Items of delivery group X have different requested delivery dates" is displayed (X represents the Delivery Group of the items).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.- Go to the Sales Orders View.- In the search field, search for Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID and MNO the Customer Demand ID).- Select View All button.- Navigate to the Document Flow tab. -The Sales Order and the Customer Demand documents displays an error icon, if both error icons are selected the following messages are displayed in the UI.-Customer Demand: - Customer Demand MNO cannot process an update sent by a Sales Order-Sales Order: - Sales Order ABC cannot update Customer Demand MNO-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Process Communication Errors View.-Filter for the Open Errors with Incidents.-In the Sending Document ID column, filter for the Sales Order ID ABC. -Scroll down in the Error Details tab.-The Main Error is displayed as: Items of delivery group X have different requested delivery dates.-Or a process communication error occurs for the Message:-Sender Party: SalesOrderProcessing-Receiver Interface Name: CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn-Error: Items of delivery group X have different requested delivery dates-Cause-This error occurs because in the Sales Order document one or more Line Items have a requested date maintained with a different date or time zone from the other Line Items and the items have the Delivery Rule Single delivery - full quantity and are therefore in the same Delivery Group.-This mismatch between the date or time zones of the Line Items requested dates cause the Process Communication Error to be displayed in the Document Flow of the Sales Order.-Resolution-In order to make the document consistent it will be required that the date and time zones maintained for the requested date of all Line Items in the same Delivery Group are the same in the Sales Order document.-In case the overall status of the Sales Order document is  "Completed" or  "In process", than kindly forward the case to the development team for a backend correction as the Requested Date field will be grayed out. -In case of a failed XI message, once the date/time zone has been corrected in the Sales Order, the process message can be reconciled. -Keywords-items of delivery group have different requested delivery dates, delivery dates, dates, requested date, field, sales order, time zone, different requested delivery dates, items of delivery group

Title: SAP 500 error while changing the Material flow rule.
Content: Symptom-While changing the material flow rule from advanced to basic rule you are facing a dump and SAP 500 error occurs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data and navigate to Locations.-Select and edit the desired location.-Go to Material Flow-Select Basic Rule.-Cause-While changing the advanced rule to basic rule the system is checking for Logistics Area which is not entered, as advanced rule only takes in Location.-Due to this as the logistics area is not found, the system is timing out while performing the search.-Resolution-Maintain the Logistics area and the destination and then change the rule.-Follow the below steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data and navigate to Locations.-Select and edit the desired location.-Go to Material Flow-Select Basic Rule.-Maintain values for field Source & Destination Logistics area and then proceed to save the selection.-Keywords-material flow, advanced rule, basic rule, location

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Jobs Failing/Cancelled - The Internal Session Was Terminated With a Runtime Error (See ST22)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have executed a GR/IR Clearing Run that is presenting status In Process and processing status Information.-Upon checking the Run Jobs you see that a job failed with an error description: 'Cancelled manually or by the system'.-Checking the Job Log you see the messages: 'The internal session was terminated with a runtime error and: 'The Job is cancelled'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Inventory Valuation workcenter.-2. Go to the Periodic Tasks and GR/IR Clearing view.-3. Select the row for the respective Run ID and press View Jobs button.-4. Show Run Jobs: You can see a Failed job with the error description 'Cancelled manually or by the system'.-5. Click View Job Log button.-The steps look like below:-Job started-Step 001 started (program SAP_MDRI_REPORT, variant , user ID XYZ, where XYZ means the User ID executing the run.)-MDRO: FIA_GRIR_CLEARING_RUN (57, ABC where ABC stands for the GR/IR Clearing Run ID)-The internal session was terminated with a runtime error (see ST22): Job cancelled-Cause-The message 'The internal session was terminated with a runtime error (see ST22)' appearing in the Job Log indicates that a backend error occurred upon the execution of the respective job.-Such backend errors are usually caused by a memory issue which, in turn, was caused by a too large dataset selected for the run. In the run's parameters, you need to check if you have left blank Purchasing Document from/to ID and flagged the Recalculate All Items checkbox.-If both conditions are met, all the POs are being reprocessed and the dataset can become excessively large.-Resolution-When creating the GR/IR Clearing Run, in the Data Selection section, you should select only the Purchase Order or range of Purchase Orders that are intended to be processed. This will create a smaller dataset and this memory issue should not occur. The selection could be restricted to one Set of Books at a time. This would restrict data amount and data complexity as well.-Another solution would be to schedule the GR/IR Clearing Run to be executed out of the business hours.-See Also-3037997 - How to Finish a GR/IR Clearing Run from the backend-Keywords-GR, IR, run, status, stuck, in process, didn't finish

Title: How to Extract Report of All User Activities From Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA would help you to Extract Report of all user activities from backend.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Open system backend.-Transaction code - SE16 - Database Table.-Provide the table name "BYD_CLIENT_INTERACTS_ROOT".-Provide the time frame mentioned by the user by entering the date to the INTERACTION_DATE field.-Choose Execute.-Collect the details to notepad or excel via export option.-Keywords-User Activity, Report monitoring, Extract Report, Report of all user activities

Title: Minimum Order Quantity not applied in Over-The-Counter Sale
Content: Symptom-When setting a Minimum Quantity in Master Data of a Product and afterwards adding this Product in a Over-the-Counter Sale document, the Minimum Quantity set in Master Data of the Product will not be applied.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales Work Center.-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales View.-Select New button.-In the dropdown, select Over-the-Counter Sale.-In the new document, enter the mandatory information (Account, Sales Unit, Employee Responsible, etc).-Navigate to the Items tab.-In the Product ID field, enter the Product ABC. (where ABC represents the Product ID)-Change the quantity to a value less than the minimum quantity maintained in the Master Data of the Product.-The system will allow the save for the Over-the-Counter Sale with the less quantity then minimum quantity in the Master Data of the Product.-Cause-The minimum quantity applies in the documents like Opportunity, Sales Quote, Sales Order etc, but it's not applied in invoice document.-Over-the-Counter Sale is currently consider a Invoice Request document in the system, so the default quantity is still 1 ea. Therefore according to the current system behavior, it will be possible to save the Over-the-Counter Sale with less quantity than minimum quantity maintained product master data.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-minimum quantity; OTC; Over-The-Counter Sales

Title: Warning Message "Document 123 of type XXX is still open in a previous period" in VAT Return Run
Content: Symptom-Following a VAT Return Run, the application log shows a warning message: Document 123 of type XXX is still open in a previous period.-Note:-123 refers to the Document Type ID-XXX refers to the Document Type-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Workcenter.-Select VAT Return Runs view.-Search for the relevant ID.-Open the corresponding Application log.-Navigate to the Result Tab.-Result: A warning message appears: There is 1 open item between YYY and ZZZ (YYY and ZZZ represents the dates).-Document 123 of type XXX is still open in a previous period.-Cause-As indicated in the warning message, the mentioned document has not been reported and is still open in a previous period. This can be verified by using the report Open VAT / Sales Tax Items.-Resolution-When there are documents open in a previous period, then the option is that you can create a new VAT Correction Return to ensure that all the VAT relevant documents are reported.-The other option would be cancelling the return corresponding to that period and then running the VAT Return Run once again so that a new return is created.-Keywords-Warning message, VAT Return Run, Document type, open, previous period.

Title: Project Time Recording Sent to Wrong Approver
Content: Symptom-Project time recording is sent to the wrong approver (apart from a project manager).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Recording view. -Go to Time Sheet sub view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the employee's ID).-Click in Open Time Sheet button. -Here you can see the Approver name for whom the time recordings are sent for approval.-Cause-There is a substitute assigned to project manager. In this case, all the time recording will be sent to project manager substitute for approval.-Steps to check the project manager substitute:-Go to Project Management work center. -Go to Projects view. -Search for XYZ (XYZ is the Project's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Team and Staffing tab.-Here you can see the approver is marked as the Substitute.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-See Also-KBA: 2936484 - Supplier Invoice Linked to Project Task Displays an Additional Approver-Keywords-Project time recording approver; Project manager; Substitute; Project; Approval process; Time recording

Title: Cannot Change Revenue Assignment in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-The invoice has been sent for revision and it is expected that the Revenue Assignment of the document will be able to be changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, Customer Invoice ABC will be used (ABC representing the ID of the document).-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Click New Manual Invoice.-Enter the required information.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Revenue Assignment subtab.-Enter the required information.-Click Release. -The document is sent for approval.-Approver sends the document back for revision.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Revenue Assignment subtab.-G/L Account and Account Assignment Type are grayed out.-Cause-Once the Invoice Request becomes an Invoice document, whether by clicking Release or by clicking Save as Invoice, the Revenue Assignment information becomes grayed out.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, G/L, Account, Revenue Assignment, Change

Title: Error: Logistics execution requisition confirmation item does not exist
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-** SAP Internal Use Only**-Data Flow Verification Results shows differences between LER and IDR with belowing errors:-Logistics execution requisition confirmation item does not exist-Inbound Delivery Request Base Business Transaction Document ID:XXX (i.e.Here XXX is referring to Inbound Delivery Request ID)-Irrelevant state occurred-Logistics Execution Requisition-Irrelevant state occurred-Inbound Delivery Request Base Business Transaction Document ID:XXX-Inbound Delivery Request Item with reference to -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Choose Data Flow Verifications Results view.-Search relevant ID.-Here you can see above error message for Logistics Execution Request ID. -Cause-Duplicate Purchase Orders Entries exists.-Or-All the preceding documents Sales Order, Purchase Order, Outbound Delivery, etc. all are in cancelled status, so that there is no further run results.-Resolution-Pre-Checks:-    Check at the backend if LER: XXX exists against PO ID.-    When you try open respective PO, there are two orders exists with same ID out which Item 2 is already Canceled in a one PO.-    Additionally, when you navigate to the document flow, system crashes.-    Go to Inbound Logistics Workcenter-> go to Purchase Orders view-> find relevant PO ID-> you find duplicate entries exists.-Note: If you encounter such case, kindly forward it to the development component: AP-LEC-LER.-Dump details:-Application Information-Index Information-1 CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PROVIDER_CO====CP, Include:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PROVIDER_-2 Info: An exception with the type CX_BSA_RUNTIME_DYNAMIC occurred, but was neither handled lo-3 CX_BSA_RUNTIME_DYNAMIC, Program:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PROVIDER_CO====CP, Include:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PRO-4 Info: An exception occurred-5 CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PROVIDER_CO====CP, Include:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PROVIDER_-6 Info: An exception with the type CX_BSA_RUNTIME_DYNAMIC occurred, but was neither handled lo-7 CX_BSA_RUNTIME_DYNAMIC, Program:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PROVIDER_CO====CP, Include:CL_BSA_SERVICE_PRO-8 Info: An exception occurred-9 CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL, Program:CL_PO_DELIVERY_PROG_QAF_ECO===CP, Include:CL_PO_DELIVERY_PROG_-10 Title: Unposted Source Document Error: 'Account Determination Missing for Account Determination Group'
Content: Symptom-There is an unposted source document (e.g. customer invoice) and an error message has been noticed, which is preventing the document from being posted. Error message:-'Account determination missing for Account Determination Group XYZ. Choose the account determination for Sales. To define the account for chart of accounts '' go to tab 'Other Income'. Enter a general ledger account for 'XYZ'.'-(XYZ represents the Account Determination Group)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents sub-view.-And search for your Source Document ID, in this case the Source Document is a Customer Invoice.-Select the ID and under the Details session you can see this error:-'Account determination missing for Account Determination Group XYZ. Choose the account determination for Sales. To define the account for chart of accounts '' go to tab 'Other Income'. Enter a general ledger account for 'XYZ'.'-Cause-The account determination group maintained under Income Group that is maintained for the planned revenue in the project task is not assigned to any G/L Account in Fine Tuning.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on View button.-Under Account Determination section select Sales.-Select your Account Determination Profile.-Go to Other Income tab and assign a G/L account respectively.-Click on Save and Close.-Keywords-Account Determination, Missing, Account Determination Group,

Title: "Document Cannot Be Generated" Error When Generating Document Output or Preview
Content: Symptom-While trying to generate the output of a document (or its preview), system raises one of the below mentioned error messages:-Document cannot be generated; ADS rendering of SAP template failed-Document cannot be generated; ADS server returned an SOAP error-Document cannot be generated; form master template error-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-I. Document cannot be generated; ADS rendering of SAP template failed-For this error message, the most common causes of the issue are:-The template contains an extension field which is defined with the data type that only supports text, however a binary object (for example, an image) was pasted in the field, causing the rendering error.-The document contains an invalid character in one of the text fields.-The form template is using a component of type "checkbox" to display a field of type "indicator". When the XML with the document data is passed to the form, the values are sent as "TRUE" or "FALSE". These values cannot be interpreted by the checkbox component, as it expects an integer value.-The error might be caused due to customizations of the form which make it invalid.-II. Document cannot be generated; ADS server returned an SOAP error-This error message means that the document XML which the application generates for the output is too large and the ADS server is unable to process it. This can happen, for example, with sales orders with too many items (products) assigned or e-mail activities with too many attachments.-III. Document cannot be generated; form master template error-This issue happens when changes to the form master template are made by a user with PDI Developer role, for example, any user which has one or more views from the PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT - Partner Development work center assigned to their access rights. This causes the change to be saved against a PDI layer in the backend, which in turn causes the form master template to become inconsistent.-Resolution-I. Document cannot be generated; ADS rendering of SAP template failed-Check the document (and if possible, the XML file generated by the document) for any binary objects being passed to the form template, and ensure that it is not bound to a field of type "text."-For these sorts of errors, system also raises an error message along the lines of "InvalidDataException: Xml parsing error: not well-formed (invalid token) (error code XX), line XX, column XX of file"; by opening the document's XML in an XML editor, the line and column numbers can be used in the error message to find the invalid character. The invalid characters will usually occur in free text fields such as Notes, Internal Notes and Internal Comments.--NOTE: To locate the special character in the XML, open the document's .XML file in the Notepad++ tool, for example. This tool will format the XML file, allowing to easily identify the specific column and line of the special character.--Check the form template for components which are being bound to a field of type "indicator" and ensure that a correct component in the form is being used to properly handle the boolean values sent through the XML.-Check for customizations made in the form template which could be causing the error. There is also an option to revert to a previous consistent version of the template to more easily identify the issues. A common customization which causes ADS rendering issues is the use of rich text tags or other such scripts.-If none of the proposed solutions have solved the issue, please report a case to SAP for further analysis.-II. Document cannot be generated; ADS server returned an SOAP error-The solution is to reduce the size of the generated XML by reducing the data of the document. This will depend on the document: if it is a sales order with too many items, consider dividing it into multiple sales orders with fewer items; if it is an e-mail with multiple attachments, consider deleting unnecessary attachments or (if all attachments are necessary), downloading them, deleting them from the system and re-uploading them with type Internal.-III. Document cannot be generated; form master template error-To avoid this error, please ensure that users with PDI Development role DO NOT edit and save changes to forms, specially the form master template.-Once the issue is already happening, however, it can only be corrected by a manual correction from SAP in the tenant's backend. Hence, please report a case to SAP providing the authorization for support to take necessary action.-Keywords-Output, Preview, Document cannot be generated, ADS, ADS rendering of SAP template failed, ADS server returned an SOAP error, form template, form master template error, InvalidDataException, Xml parsing error, not well-formed, invalid token

Title: User Lock Error Message
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that even when two users edit the same view, no error message is raised indicating a lock entry.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to ABC work center (ABC is the name of the work center)-Go to XYZ view (XYZ is the name of the view)-Edit-Follow steps 1 to 3 with a different user.-You notice that although both users are editing the same view, both are still in edit mode and are allowed to initiate a change. No error message is raised so far.-Cause-In SAP ByDesing/ SAP Cloud for Customer there are two different concepts for locking an object. These different lock types may be explained as follows:-The exclusive lock is always maintained on the first modification and reverted to the optimistic lock once the instance is saved. If more than one user is accessing the same instance of the fixed assets, then all have the optimistic lock. Once any user make any changes on the instance then for the other users there is no event raised. Hence, the other user still have the optimistic lock whereas the person who is performing the modification will have exclusive lock on the instance.-The system should not allow two or more users to have exclusive lock at the same time if the event is triggered. If both the users are editing and user who first starts modifying the instance didn't save the instance then the other user wouldn't be able to perform modification because the first user already has the instance with exclusive lock and will be able to perform modification once the instance is saved by the other user.-The same behavior is seen in most of the screens and where a document can be edited or the edit screen is there for the instance, like period control and process control.-Example:-User A open the fixed asset in edit mode and user B open the same asset also in edit mode: Both the users have the optimistic lock and are able to initiate a change-User B triggers a change, e.g. update the useful life, without saving. User B now has the exclusive lock of the instance and only this user is able to perform changes.-User A tries to trigger an change, however at this time user A will get the error message, since user B has the exclusive lock.-User B save his change. The exclusive lock is removed and both users will have the optimistic lock, allowing each one of them to initiate a new change event.-User A refresh the screen in order to clear the lock error. The changed data is already updated in the asset, e.g. the updated useful life.-The changes can be tracked via change log.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-lock, exclusive lock, optimistic lock, modification

Title: Cannot Select Required Countries in List of Countries Relevant for Generating Direct Cash Flow Statement with Cash Flow Keys Activity
Content: Symptom-The Direct Cash Flow Statement Based on Cash Flow Keys has been enabled for other countries/regions besides China depending on scoping after the release of ByD 2208 (August, 2022). However, you cannot select the required country/region ABC in the List of country/regions relevant for generating Direct Cash Flow Statement with Cash Flow Keys activity (ABC represents required country/region).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the 'List of countries relevant for generating Direct Cash Flow Statement with Cash Flow Keys' activity and select it.-Press Add to select the required country/region ABC from the list of country/regions. You expect that the cash flow statement can be created for this country/region.-However, country/region ABC is not available. -Note: If 'List of countries relevant for generating Direct Cash Flow Statement with Cash Flow Keys' activity is not available, it first needs to be scoped under path in Business Configuration: Financial and Management Accounting - General Ledger - Communication for General Ledger.-Cause-There are two possible reasons:-Country/region ABC has not been added to your solution profile. The Drop down country/region list will only contain countries/regions that are in scope.-Country/region ABC is scoped but is not a standard or pre-localized country/region.-Resolution-If country/region ABC is a standard or pre-localized it can be added to the solution profile as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Press Edit Project Scope button.-In the scoping step country/region and Type of Business, press Edit Countries/Regions.-Add the required country/region ABC into the scope.-The country/region should now be available in the fine-tune activity. -See Also-Direct Cash Flow Statement | SAP Help Portal-What's New in Financial Management | SAP Help Portal-SAP_ByDesign_Localization_List.xlsx (workzone.one.int.sap)-Keywords-Cash Flow Key

Title: Approval Process for Price list and Discount List.
Content: Symptom-You have created and released a sales price list or discount list but the system didn't trigger any approval task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Choose the Price Lists view.-Show Base list and choose Go.-Create a new Base Price List.-Provide all mandatory information and release the price list.-You expect that system will trigger the approval process and the approval task will go to the line manager. But this price list released automatically.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Choose the Discount Lists view.-Show Overall Customer Discount and choose Go.-Create a new Overall Customer Discount.-Provide all mandatory information and release the discount list.-You expect that system will trigger the approval process and the approval task will go to the line manager. But this discount list released automatically.-Cause-Since you have not activated the price or discount list approval process during scoping in business configuration, hence the approval is not triggered.-Resolution-Firstly you need to activate  the sales price lists or discount lists approval process in scoping of business configuration by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and choose Edit Project Scoping.-Navigate to Questions.-Find and expand the Business Area General Business Data.-Select the business sub-topic Sales Price and Discount Lists under business topic Product and Service Pricing.-Select/Check the question - Do you want to set up an approval process for price and discount lists?-Finish Scoping.-When a user releases or cancels the release of a price list or discount list, the system automatically sends an approval task to the responsible line manager of the user requesting the release or cancelation. If this user is not assigned a manager, the BTM task for approval will be sent to all users in the system with necessary access rights mainly (MMA_SALESPRICEMAINTENANCE and Price List/Discount List View)-Note : The approval process for sales price list or discount list will not be available under Approval Processes view of Application and User Management work center.-Additionally if you want to set-up additional approver for sales price list then you can set up the same in Alternative Approver for Sales Price Lists by following the below steps.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Choose sub-view Employee Work Distribution under Task Distribution view.-Navigate to Business Area : Sales and Marketing.-Select Alternative Approver for Sales Price Lists.-Choose Edit option.-Choose Add Row provide all mandatory information.-Select Save and Close.-Note : The alternate approver for discount list is not available in system and hence cannot be set-up.-Keywords-Price List; Approval Process; Approval; Discount List; Approver; user;

Title: Dump When Editing an Instance of a Custom BO
Content: Symptom-After adding an Access Control Context to a Custom BO you receive a dump while editing an instance which was created before the Access Control Context was present.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Custom BO instance.-Create a solution patch where you add an Access Control Context to this Custom BO. Example Add an association to the business object that is used for access control and mark the association with the annotation [RelevantForAccessControl].-Try to edit the Custom BO instance created on 1.-Dump will be raised.-Cause-You are trying to edit an instance of a BO for which access control context has been defined.-The Instance which you are trying to edit was created in a version of the custom solution prior to the addition of access control context.-After this instance was created a subsequent version of the custom solution was deployed to the tenant, in this subsequent version the access control context annotation was added to this BO.-Thus the expectation is that the Access Control relevant nodes are present for each Business Object instance, and as this expectation is not met the dump is raised.-Resolution-In order to resolve the error, the instances created before the deployment of the solution version which has added the ACL should be deleted and re-created.-See Also-Help Documentation -Keywords- PDI, SDK, "The ACL Root Was Not Found"

Title: Over-the-Counter Sale is Not a Search Criteria in Invoice Requests View
Content: Symptom-When trying to use the Advance Search of the Invoice Requests View, the Over-the-Counter Sale option is not displayed for the field Invoice Request Type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Filter for All Invoice Requests.-Select the Advanced Filter.-In the Invoice Request Type field, select the drop-down list.- No Over-the-Counter Sale option is displayed, however in the Results table, it is possible to see that there are Invoice Requests with Type Over-the-Counter Sale.-Cause-Currently, the option Over-the-Counter Sales is not available in the Advanced Filter for the Invoice Request Type field.-Resolution-In this case, it is recommended to search the Over-the-Counter Sale Invoice Requests by setting filter on Invoice Request Type column.-For this process the following steps can be performed:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Filter for All Invoice Requests.-Select the Invoice Request Type column.-In the Filter field, enter Over-the-Counter Sale.-The Over-the-Counter Sale Invoice Requests will be displayed in the UI.-Keywords-Invoice Request Type; Over-the-Counter Sales; Advanced Filter

Title: Private Contact Data cannot be updated using ManageEmployeein webservice.
Content: Symptom-Private Contact Data is not updated using ManageEmployeeIn web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The Payload you ran updates the Address information in Business Partner but not the Private contact data of the Employee.-Cause-You haven't maintained the Identification node in the Payload.-Resolution-Please pass the identification node as shown below-<Identification actionCode="06">-<ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>Identity</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-<PartyIdentifierTypeCode>HCM001</PartyIdentifierTypeCode>-<BusinessPartnerID>EmployeeID<BusinessPartnerID/>-<IdentifierIssuingAgencyName/>-<EmployeeID>XXXX</EmployeeID>-</Identification>-Note: Only for *<BusinessPartnerID>EmployeeID<BusinessPartnerID/>*-In SAP System PartyIdentifierTypeCode HCM001 is mapped with EmployeeID, hence you need to use the same Employee ID here in please of Business Partner ID, else there will be MDCI Identity error:-Error Message: An MDCI implementation (from business object IDENTITY) has rejected the save-Note:-If Employee ID in your UI is Alpha-Numeric, then use this Employee ID "XXXX" as it is.-If Employee ID in your UI is only Numeric, then you need to feed 60digits in this value including your ID.-Example: Employee ID 1-You will pass this value in EmployeeID 000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001-Keywords-  ManageEmployeeIn, Private Contact Data, web service, api, A2X, payload.

Title: Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Internal Server Error (500) While Performing Check Connection to Success Factors
Content: Symptom-When Check the connection for "Organisational Centre Replication Outbound with EC Service" is performed, the system throws below errors:-Checking connection failed-Ping failed-Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Internal Server Error (500)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Communication Arrangement view.-Search and Edit EC Integration.-Check the connection for "Organisational Centre Replication Outbound with EC Service".-Cause-There are multiple causes which may result in above issue, below are known cases.-Resolution-Case 1: Ping may fail but replication works fine-The SAP Web Service Framework offers a SOAP Ping to test a SOAP connection between service consumer and service provider. This SOAP ping is exposed in the soamanager UI and via API. The SOAP ping may fail, even when the SOAP communication works fine and web service requests are executed successfully.-Refer to the SAP Notes 1903596 - SOAP Ping fails with 3rd party service provider for more details-Case 2: Incorrect login credential of successfactor system is maintained in Business ByDesign system.-Steps to update communication arrangement credential:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center - Input and Output Management -  Communication Arrangement.-Select communication scenario 'EC Integration'.-Click Edit button.-Go to 'Technical Data' Tab.-Click 'Edit Advanced Setting' Button.-Select one outbound communication scenario and click 'Edit Credential' button.-Input username and password.-Click ok button.-Click Save and Reactivate button.-Repeat the same steps from 6 to 9 for the second communication scenario as well.-After above steps retest the employee replication scenario.-Case 3: The Communication Arrangement setup for 'EC Integration' relates to a wrong system. This might happen when there are several successfactor systems. The failed logon error message is occurring as the logon credentials for integration on BYD are not matching the SF logon credentials, meaning they are maintained for company ID 'abc' instead of 'xyz' (where 'abc and 'xyz' represent company IDs). Please maintain the communication arrangement to correct the Company for both services. This is maintained via the following path (see also above steps for case 2):-Go to Application and User Management Work Center - Input and Output Management -  Communication Arrangement.-Select communication scenario 'EC Integration'.-Click on 'Edit API keys'.-Select both services and maintain the correct company ID for integration.-After performing above steps, retest the employee replication scenario.-See Also-List of SAP SuccessFactors API Servers-Keywords-Ping failed, Check connection, EC Integration. employee replication, service error, EC communication arrangement

Title: Check service error after Tenant Copy: A technical error occurred (Message communication profile has no RBAM role): /DOC/MBCA 046
Content: Symptom-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“--When an order is created via webservice you receive an error --“Authorization role missing for service "ServiceInterface http://sap.com/xi/A1S/Global ServiceInterfaceName <default> <default>", operation "Operation http://sap.com/xi/A1S/Global MaintainBundle" (UTC timestamp 20240301090619; Transaction ID 390B35FD2BD61EDEB5F55EEC72799B1F)”--Check the service from the communication arrangement, you will receive the following error:-"A techincal error occurred (Message communication profile has no RBAM role): /DOC/MBCA 046. Report an incident."-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre requisites:-A tenant copy has been completed.-You have a communication arrangement based on a custom web service created via the Cloud Applications Studio.-Steps to reproduce:-Administration and User Management.-Communication Arrangements.-Open the Communication Arrangement.-Technical data > Edit advanced settings > check service.-Error: A technical error occurred (Message communication profile has no RBAM role): /DOC/MBCA 046-Cause-1.The effected service interface in the .csd file has a different process component from the one present in the .csd file. This error occurs after the Tenant Copy and is an expected system limitation.-2.PC Interactions present in the MCPs are not actually created(not present) in the system which is causing the RBAM issue-Resolution-1.Activate the .csd file on the souce tenant, deploy the solution to the target tenant and create a new communication arrangement on the target tenant.-2.Recreate the communication scenario and the arrangement-Delete the communication arrangement -Delete the communication scenario -Recreate the communication scenario -Recreate the communication arrangement for this communication scenario -Keywords-profile, PDI, SDK, scenario, technical

Title: The Contract Item Has Status In Process, Though Fulfilment and Invoicing is Finished
Content: Symptom-The contract item status is In Process, though Fulfillment Status and Invoice Status are Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Find field search with ID ABC (where ABC is the Contract ID) and click on the Edit button.-Go to the Items tab and select Line Item XYZ (where XYZ is service base line-item) for which Fulfillment Status is Finished and Invoice Status is Finished.-The Status of Line Item XYZ is still showing as In Process.-Cause-Item PQR will have the status Completed once all the 3 conditions are satisfied as below:-The Fulfillment Status as Finished-The Invoice Status as Finished-The Contract Item End Date of Line Item XYZ in Contract ABC is reached, meaning the validity of Item XYZ is expired.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-contract item, status, in process, fulfillment, invoice, finish, finished, end date.

Title: Compounded Characteristics in joined Data Sources
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You received a customer incident with an inconsistent data source and/or report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Select the joined data source XYZ (XYZ stands for the joined data source name or ID)-When you select the data source you will get three error messages:-DataSource XYZ contains inconsistencies.-Compounding of Characteristic ABC (ABC stands for the characteristic) out of sync with joined MDAV.-Please contact your Administrator DataSource XYZ contains inconsistencies.-Cause-Characteristic ABC in the joined data source is compounded on another characteristic, which is currently not present in the data source.-Resolution-Please add the missing characteristic to the joined data source and the issue will be resolved.-See Also-How to check which characteristic should be added to the data source.-Login to the backend.-Open transaction MDRS.-Search for the basic data source where the compounded characteristic is coming from.-Go to the characteristics and open the dropdown menu.-Go to the characteristic ABC and select it.-In the tab characteristic check the box for characteristics is compounded.-If it is ticked, go to the tab compounding and you will see the missing characteristic.-Tell the customer to add this characteristic to the joined data source.-Keywords-Compounded Characteristics; joined Data sources; MDRS; inconsistencies-datasource contains inconsistencies,compounding of characteristic,out of sync with joined mdav

Title: Assignment of Profit Center to Postings in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This KBA explains if it is possible to assign profit center to postings where profit center is not derived.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Show All Reports and find report Trial Balance.-Enter the Selection Criteria and execute the report.-Notice that against some of the G/L Accounts, the Profit Center is unassigned.-The goal is to assign Profit Center to these transactions.-Cause-By drilling down to the journal entries which contribute to the Ending Balance it can be seen that the Profit Center is not assigned even to the Journal Entry Items.-Resolution-Profit Center cannot be assigned to postings in SAP Business ByDesign by a method. However, a Default Profit Center can be maintained against various Subledgers and if the Profit Center is not derived, the Default Profit Center will be considered during postings.-See Also-Help Center Document:-Derivation of Profit Centers and Segments | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Profit Center Derivation, Default Profit Center, Journal Entry, Unassigned

Title: CRM Scenario: Service - Fixed Price in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Service - Fixed Price item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Case 1: With Time Recording-Enable the scope in Business Configuration: Edit Project Scope>Questions>Sales>Selling Products and Services>Sales Orders-1. Release the sales order, the status changes to Open.-2. Release to Service Execution.-The status of the sales order changes from Open to In Process. Service status of order line changes to Released.-3. Confirm Service Execution.-Copying referenced sales order item ID 3696-10 for service confirmation is not possible as it is enabled for time recording.-Since Time Recording for Sales Order has been activated, the assigned Service Performer need to accomplish time recording in his/her time for respective Sales Order.-4. Log in as delicate service performer via Home Work Center>Self-Services Overview>Edit Time Sheet>Add Time Entry-Actions> Release-Back to respective Sales Order> Document Flow>A service confirmation has been automatically generated with status Finished.-The Delivery Status of the sales order item changed from Not Started to In Process.-5. Complete Service Execution-Delivery Status changed from In Process to Finished.-6. Invoice the Sales Order invoice request.-Since the item type is Service - fixed price, it’s necessary for delicate service performer to record time for business usage while the fixed price will be copied from Sales Order directly to Customer Invoice regardless the actual time costing.-Back to respective Sales Order, it is now Completed.-Case 2: Without Time Recording Enabled.-1. Release Sales Order.-2. Release to Service Execution.-The status of the sales order changed from Open to In process, and item line service status changed to Released.-3. Confirm Service Execution.-In the New Service Execution, you can input the actual duration spent in Service Delivery.-You will get a warning message says “Item 10: Fulfilled quantity is greater than ordered quantity” if the value you’ve input is greater than the original value in Sales Order.-But this won’t block you from completing the service process.-4. Release Service Confirmation with Order Completion.--Please Note: If you release the Service Confirmation without Order Completion you will have to Complete the Execution manually in the Sales Order via the Complete Execution button to be able to invoice the Sales Order Invoice Request.-Back to the respective Sales Order and check Document Flow.-Service Confirmation has the status Finished but no Service Confirmation Invoice Request has been created. This is because that the item type is Service - fixed price, the invoice request will be based on Sales Order but not Service Confirmation.-5. Invoice the Sales Order Invoice Request.-The status of the sales order changed to Completed, same as on the item level.-Keywords-SERV; service- fixed price; sales order

Title: Overall Discount is Not Supported in Over-The-Counter Sale Web Service
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a Overall Discount for an Over-The-Counter Sale (OTC) via web service interface, it is not replicated for the document in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Overall discount is not supported for OTC via web service. Header level condition Overall discounts are not accepted in the request.-Resolution- This is the correct system design.-See Also-For Sales Order documents, the overall discount is supported to be added via web service interface, please kindly refer to the blog below for further details:-Discounts in Sales Orders and Contracts (SAP Business ByDesign)-Keywords-web service, otc, overall discount, over-the-counter sale

Title: Error when performing Adjustment Confirmation of a Serial Number
Content: Symptom-System is Showing the Error "Missing quantity" on doing Adjustment Confirmation of a Serial Number.--Environment--SAP Business By Design --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to By Warehouse Order View.-Search for Warehouse Order XYZ.-Choose Edit button.-Select the line.-Choose Enable Entry button.-Go to Serial Numbers sub-tab.-Select Serial Number ABC.-Choose Remove button, then the error occurs-(Here XYZ refers to Warehouse order and ABC refers to Serial number)-Cause-For Registered Product with serial number ABC, under detailed inventory tracking tab, the  Inbound delivery is created or Outbound delivery or Both is created with it's reference, therefore the stock type is goods issue which can be seen in stock overview. ---Resolution-To perform adjustment confirmation:--1)Cancel the Document with serial number ABC which is the last active document -                    OR-2) Release the document as per business requirement.--Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Warehouse Confirmation, Missing quantity, Serial Number, Inbound delivery

Title: How System Defines the Tax Date in a Sales Order or Contract
Content: Symptom-You want to know how system defines the Tax Date in a Sales Order or Contract.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We are using a Sales Order as an example:-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center, Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order ABC (where ABC stands for the sSales Order)-Click View All button-Navigate to General tab-You will find the Posting Date is EFG (where EFG stands for the Posting Date).-Navigate to Items tab, Taxes sub-tab-You will find the Tax Date is XYZ (where XYZ stands for the Tax Date).-Cause-The Tax Date is defaulted according to the Pricing Date. The Pricing Date is defaulted from the Posting Date. If the Pricing Date is not changed manually, it will automaticall changed when the Posting Date is changed. The Posting Date and therefore also the Pricing Date is by default the current date.-The Tax Date can also be changed from the Taxes sub-tab under Items tab to some date other than the Pricing Date and that won't affect the Posting or Pricing Date. But if you change the Posting Date, and the Pricing Date was not manually changed, this will change the Pricing Date and this will impact the Tax Date.-Tax Date is the date according to which the tax calculation will happen and can be same or different from Posting Date or the Pricing Date.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.-Keywords-Tax Date, Sales Order, Posting Date

Title: Extension Field Missing for an Employee in Personnel File
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field for Employees, however you notice that despite having published the adaptation with the extension field added to the Employee screen, the field does not appear for other employees.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search and select the employee.-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the user avatar icon at the top right of the screen.-Click on Key User Settings.-Click on Start Adaptation Mode.-Navigate to either the Employment or Personal Data tab.-Right click on a screen section, then click on "+Extension Field".-Create an extension field or add an existing one to the screen.-On the adaptation panel on the right, click on Publish.-After the steps, the extension field is expected to be available for all employees. However you notice that for certain employees, the field is still not added to the screen by default.-Cause-The employee personal file screen in SAP Business ByDesign is country-specific. If an extension field is added to the screen of a Germany employee, for example, it will not be automatically added to US employees.-Resolution-The extension field must be added to the employee personal file screen for each country where it is needed.-Keywords-Personnel, Administration, Country, Extension Field, Employee

Title: Inbound Warehouse Task Created Without Reference ID
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to create a Warehouse Request for a Delivery Note, following error message occurs:--Creation of the Warehouse Request Failed,  but still the Warehouse Order and Warehouse Task is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Execution Workcenter.-Navigate to Inbound Warehouse Tasks view.-Select the relevant Task ID, notice that task is created without Request ID, Reference ID & Reference Type.-Cause-Error might be due to temporary inconsistency.-Subsequently when trying to Create Warehouse Request again there will be no error and this time Warehouse Order and the corresponding Warehouse Task  is created successfully with Request ID, Reference ID & Reference Type.-Resolution-Since the Warehouse Task is without any Reference ID, the task is unable to be neither Confirmed or Reversed.-Send the incident to CSS Component: AP-SLP-TSK so that the task can be cancelled from backend.-Keywords-Request ID, Reference ID, Reference Type, Warehouse Request, Delivery Note, Warehouse Task, Warehouse Order.
