Title: Why are there multiple Status fields in search of SM_CRM? - Solution Manager
Content: Symptom-Why are there multiple Status fields in search-Trying to search documents in CRM_UI and there are duplicate Status fields-How to remove duplicated Status field from Search Criteria-Duplicate Status when searching Request for Change (RfC)-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Open SM_CRM and click Change Request Management > Search > <document type> (e.g. Request for Change)-Click a Search Criteria drop down box and notice there are multiple entries for Status:-Resolution-The fields are not duplicates, rather, they represent different fields of information.-To understand the true meaning of the field, the Technical Information can be displayed to help see the difference.  To display this:-Click Show Configurable Area and click the area of Search Criteria: (If you do not see the configuration button follow KBA 2741600)-Click Show Technical Details-The full technical field name and description will be displayed to show there is a difference in the various fields:-Note: The Label can be changed to differentiate the values, if desired.-See Also-2741600 - "Enable configuration mode" in personalize settings is not displayed-Keywords-ITSM, Change Control Management, Charm, ZMIN, SMIN, Change doc, Incident, SMCR, ZMCR, SMMJ, ZMMJ, SMHF, ZMHF, Urgent Change, Normal Change

Title: How to work with ChaRM Standard Changes documents
Content: Symptom-Tips and tricks for using Standard Changes documents in Change Request Management-Allowlist* objects defined in cm_adm_cockpit but not working and have Upon-Saving Checks set to On (Legacy CSOL)-How to use separate scheduled import job for Standard Changes? -Error: Saving is not possible due to the errors listed below.-The listed objects are not approved for standard changes. Change Administrators can add them to the allowlist in the Administration Cockpit. Alternatively, select a transport request of a normal or urgent change.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2 SP05 and later-Resolution-For information on using Standard Changes documents, see SAP Community wiki page How to work with ChaRM Standard Changes documents. -Please note:  Upon-Saving Checks must be using On setting vs. On (Legacy CSOL) to work.-*This word has been redacted and replaced with an inclusive term, please note that this may appear differently in your product, system code or table.-See Also-SAP Application Help Processing Standard Changes (for latest SP).-Note: You can use the drop-down menu in the application help portal to select your specific SP level. -Wiki: How to work with Change Request Management Cross System Object Lock CSOL-2970883 - Using the Global Switch with Allowlist* in Charm-Keywords-standard change, allowlist*, whitelist, white list, black list, blacklist, not allowed list

Title: The Customer Contract Invoice Request is Showing the Status as Blocked
Content: Symptom-The Customer Contract Invoice Request is in Blocked status and you would like to understand why the Invoice Request is Blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-Filter for All Invoice Requests.-Search for the Customer Contract Invoice Request ABC (where ABC represents the Customer Contract Invoice Request ID).-The Customer Contract Invoice Request ABC is displayed with status as Blocked.-Cause-The Customer Contract Invoice Request is showing the status as blocked, because in the Contract document a Invoice Block was set.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Contracts.-Search for the Contract ABC (where ABC represents the Contract ID).-Open, Select View All.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoicing sub tab.-Under the section Invoicing for the field Invoice Block, remove the blocking reason-Select Save button.-Once done, the Customer Contract Invoice Request will not be in status as blocked anymore.-Keywords-contract, customer contract invoice request, blocked, invoice block

Title: Error Message: "Cannot change cost center XYZ (ABC); it is assigned to fixed asset"
Content: Symptom-When trying to activate an Organizational Structure, the system displays the following error message for some of the Cost Centers:-"Cannot change cost center XYZ (ABC); it is assigned to fixed asset' (XYZ stands for the Cost Center ID and ABC for the Cost Center name).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Click the Organizational Structure View.-Expand the tree until Cost Center XYZ is visible.-Select Cost Center XYZ.-Click Edit.-The error message is raised: "Cannot change cost center XYZ (ABC); it is assigned to fixed asset".-Cause-An attempt is made to delete/delimit a Cost Center (Validity) that contains one or more Fixed Assets that have Assignment Intervals which the time frame collides. This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-To activate the Organizational Structure:--For each affected Fixed Asset, follow the steps below:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Select the Fixed Assets view.-Search and Edit the Fixed Asset.-Go to Master Data tab and Basic Data sub-tab.-Under All Assignment Intervals selection, create a new assignment interval with a dummy cost center or any other cost center assignment.-Then Save the Asset.-It needs to be ensured that the timeline of the Organizational Structure where the change is planned is not covered by the validity of the original Cost Center XYZ.-Now, the Cost Center can be changed according to the settings and this Organizational Structure can be activated.-Go to the respective Fixed Asset Master Data and change the new Assignment Interval line created before from the dummy Cost Center to the old Cost Center.-Keywords-cost center; fixed asset; org. structure

Title: Error: Mapping for Data Type APC_S_REGION_CODE, Code ABC, and Local Context XYZ does not exist'
Content: Symptom-Facing issue when replicating employees from SuccessFactors to SAP Business ByDesign due to error:-'Mapping for Data Type APC_S_REGION_CODE, Code ABC, and Local Context XYZ does not exist' (where ABC represents a region code and XYZ a Local Context code).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication Work Center.-In Import, click Employees view.-Search for any employee.-Choose Actions > Upload Data from Employee Central.-Note: There will a failed entry with selection date DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM.-Cause-There are missing code list mappings for RegionCode.-Resolution-You need to maintain these mappings in the Business Configuration work center:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose Overview view.-Select Activities.-Search for Code List Mapping for Integration with External Applications and Solutions and open it.-Choose Maintain Code List Mapping.-In section Code List mapping Definition, filter for RegionCode as Local Data Type Name.-Select Employee Central Integration.-In section Code List mapping Rule, click Add Row.-In section Code List Mapping Rule, maintain the Mapping Rule and the Local Context.-In section Code List Mapping, maintain Local Code, External Code, Description, etc.-Choose Save.-In case the Local code/ External Code is not maintained in Code List Mapping, follow the below steps as it needs to be maintained in the Regions fine-tuning activity as well.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Activities.-Search for Regions.-Choose it.-Choose Add Row.-In selection, maintain the Country/Region, Code and Region Description and save the changes.-Once the changes are made maintain the same in Code List Mapping.-Note:-In the second step related to Local code/ External Code not maintained, it is not mandatory to maintain the exact same description as what is received from Employee Central. It is possible to maintain any description (within 20 characters limit) which will help to identify this region code with this description within SAP Business ByDesign. This is not going to impact integration in any way.- The exact code from Employee Central needs to be maintained for successful processing.-This is the mapping which is required during employee query and replication from Employee Central. Also, it can have length up to 40 character which is sufficient for most use cases.-Keywords-Employee Central, daily run, Success Factors, ByD, employee replication, Region Description, Code List Mapping

Title: System Crashes When Sending a Payment Batch to TIS
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a payment batch, however it crashes upon sending.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center. -Go to Payment Batches view.-Find a Ready for Transfer batch and click Actions -> Send Batch.-System crashes.-Cause-One of the possible reason for the crash to happen is a recent change in the tenant certificate, which is used for authentication when communicating with TIS. Since the certificate is not replicated on TIS side, the authentications fails.-Resolution-You can check if the tenant certificate as follows:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Communication Arrangement view.-Find and open communication arrangement 'Direct Bank Communication with Treasury Intelligence Solutions'.-Click Download Certificate.-You can refer to current validity range and reach out to TIS to make sure the correct certificate is replicated on their side as well.-For details on how to reach our to TIS, please refer to help document About the Payment Service Provider Treasury Intelligence Solutions-Keywords-Payment Management. Payment Batch. TIS.-http code 401 unauthorized

Title: You are Unable to Upload the Customer Invoice Request File
Content: Symptom-While trying to upload document the Service Interface field is not showing ﻿any values in the drop down.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Input and Output Management view.-Select the File Input sub view.-Show Unprocessed Files and select Add button.-In the new pop-up window the drop down for Service Interface﻿ shows no values.-Cause-In the Business Configuration the Upload of Invoice Requests﻿ is not selected under Scoping.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to view Implementation Projects.-Select relevant project and click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to step 3 Scoping by selecting Next Button.-Select Sales-> Customer Invoicing -> Upload of Invoice Requests.-Make sure the Upload of Invoice Requests is selected.-Navigate to step 4 Questions.-Select Sales-> Customer Invoicing -> Upload of Invoice Requests.-Select the box for the question You can use file input to upload external documents for invoicing.-Select Next Button﻿ and then select ﻿Finish ﻿button.-You should now be able to upload the Customer Invoice Request File.-See Also-KBA 2930377 - How to Upload Customer Invoice Files per File Input Scenario-Keywords-Invoice Request; File Input; Upload;

Title: Is it Possible To Change the Employee ID?
Content: Symptom-You have the requirement to change Employee ID.-For example, you have the Employee ID ABC and the requirement is to change the Employee ID ABC to new Employee ID XYZ but you cannot find a way to do this in the UI.-ABC and XYZ would be the possible Employee IDs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-Currently, it is not possible to change the Employee / Personnel ID in the frontend UI.-Resolution-The only option available is to create a new Employee and Terminate the old Employee.-In the Front end there is a choice to enter the desired new Employee ID if the ID has not already been used.-Keywords-backend, delete Employee ID, Personnel ID, Change, Edit.

Title: System Displays an Error While Changing Serial Number Profile
Content: Symptom-When trying to change the serial number profile from Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Process to any other value for a material, system displays the below error message even though all Inbound, Outbound tasks are Finished and Production Lots are closed.-"Open task found for material; serial profile cannot be changed"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Navigate to the Materials view.-Search for the relevant material, select it and choose the Edit button.-Choose View All and under the General tab, it can be seen that the value in the field Serial Number Profile is Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Process. Here, when trying to change the serial number profile to any other profile the above mentioned error is faced.-Cause-PI Count Document created is still "In Process" for the relevant material. It is necessary to complete the Count Tasks as well as PI Count Document ID at the header level. In case, PI document has multiple line items and it was completed count tasks only for the relevant material then also system will not allow changing the profile as PI count document is still In Process. It must be Approved, and status should be Finished at header level.-Resolution-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Go to the Monitoring view and choose By PI Count Document sub view.-Open the advanced Filter and enter required Product ID under section: Count Item Data.-Choose Go.-Here it can be seen a PI Count Document ID generated for the relevant product with status "In Process".-Edit it and navigate to Count Tasks tab and check if it is with status Finished. If not, then first complete the Count Task.-Once it is done, go back and select PI Count Document ID.-Select it and choose Approve Count.-Here the system changes the status of the PI Document to Finished.-Now go to relevant material master data and it can be changed the serial number profile to any required value.-See Also-2678793 - Open Task Found for Material XYZ; Serial Profile Cannot be Changed-2784113 - Error is Thrown When Changing the Serial Number Profile-Keywords-Serial Number Profile, Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Process, No serial number profile, System Throws Error While Changing Serial Number Profile, Error while changing serial number profile, Physical Inventory, Count Task, PI Count Document

Title: Error Message : Employee XYZ has inactive assignments in Organizational Management, first activate OM assignments
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign a certain employee to an organizational chart there is an error message displayed : Employee XYZ has inactive assignments in Organizational Management, first activate OM assignments.-Note: This case document is applicable in case the issue is with Service Agent-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partners work center.-Go to  Employees view.-Select employee XYZ and click on Edit.-In the Organizational Unit field select the Org Unit.-In the Job ID field select job position.-Click on Save.-The error message: Employee XYZ has inactive assignments in Organizational Management, first activate OM assignments will be displayed.-Cause-The Selected Org unit has inactive changes that needs to be activated , that is the reason to prevent you to assign the same to the employee.-Resolution-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Search by the Org Structures and edit it.-Click on the activate button.-Select the Activate Selected Structure option .-After the org unit is activated you should be able to assign it to the employee.-Note (In case of Service Agent): Delimit or remove the Service Agent assignment from Org Unit (planning area) and then try the Org Assignment.

Title: Old Company Name is showing instead of New Company Name in Incidents screen
Content: Symptom-You have changed the name of a Org Unit (It is defined as Company), but the old name is still showing in the cases ﻿screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User management work center.-Select cases view.-Search and highlight or open the case-Cause-The Company name in the case is being picked from the Business Partner of the Company but not from the Org Unit.-The reason for this behavior is that the Changes in the Organizational Management is Time Dependent whereas in the other work centers and screen, it is not time dependent and it depends on the respective screen which is displaying name.-Resolution-If you change the Business Partner name with the new Company name, then cases that are getting created after this change will reflect the new name.-Keywords-Old Company Name, New Company Name, Incidents, screen, Application and User Management.

Title: Error Message Cannot change Cost Center XYZ (Cost Center name); it is assigned to fixed asset
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When the user tries to activate the Organizational Structure, the system throws the below error message:-'Cannot change Cost Center XYZ (XYZ represents Cost Center name); it is assigned to fixed asset'-'Cannot change Profit Center DEF (represents Profit Center name); it is assigned to fixed asset'-'Cannot change Segment 123 (represents Segment name); it is assigned to fixed asset'-Note: This is a most frequent issue and mostly occurs with different causes based on customer. This document is Released Internally because the solution (as documented below) should be given based on the type/complexity of the issue reported by the user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Structure work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All.-Cause-When a Cost Center is assigned to a Fixed Asset, system automatically derives the Profit Center and Segment from the Hierarchy above the Cost Center. If there is any changes that alters this combination with result in the above issue. They are,-Changing the Cost Center validity or deleting the Cost Center.-Changing the Profit Center validity or deleting the Profit Center.-Changing the Segment validity or deleting the Segment.-Creating a new Profit Center between the Cost Center and Profit Center which has a Fixed Asset.-Creating a new Segment between the Cost Center and Profit Center which has a Fixed Asset.-Making the Cost Center (for which a Fixed Asset was created) itself as a Profit Center.-Changing the Profit Center of the Cost Center (meaning, Moving the cost Center to another part of the org structure). -Resolution-Once a Fixed Asset is created with a Cost Center which automatically derives the Profit Center and Segment then it is not possible to alter this combination in Org Structure until the Fixed Asset gets retired or scraped.-There are different possible ways to overcome the issue,-The simple way is to avoid altering (delimiting or deleting) the combination of Cost Center, Profit Center, and Segment for which a Fixed Asset exists.-1657418 - Error Message: Cannot change cost center XYZ (Cost Center Name); it is assigned to fixed asset -If the Fixed Asset has a posting in it then repost it to another Cost Center. All assets in company with that as a Cost center have to be reposted to another cost center. In general all active assets which belong to the cost center which is to be changed need to be adjusted. This might be a lot of work depended on the number of assets. Unfortunately ByD does not offer a mass change here but you can simply change the org. data in the assets and re-posting is triggered automatically. Then all G/L balances with the segment must be zero at the change date.  -1734874 - Error Message: Cannot change cost center XYZ (); it is assigned to fixed asset-If the Fixed Asset is Zero, the scrap it by using below steps:Initially, when the customer activated the Org Structure there was no errors but this time they get many error messages as above for all the Cost Centers and Profit Centers. This is because profit center and Segment accounting is activated in the scoping. The earlier activation would have gone though because this option would not have been activated in BC. Please check with the customer on when the BC scoping was done for Profit and Segment accounting. If this scoping is done, a profit center should be found a above or at the same level of business residence and cost center. Also it shall be possible to derive a segment for all profit centers. Once the user de-scope the "profit center and segment reporting" in the scoping, then you can able to activate the Org Structure. -1584085 – How to delete or scrap the fixed asset for which no acquisition cost has been assigned.-1694998 – How to delete Fixed Assets-When to consider that the reported problem is consulting issue?-If user would like to do many changes in the Cost Center and Profit Center, and if modification results in same error message for each Cost Center.-When user activated the Reporting Principle as Income statements by function of costs, then Profit Center is not mandatory for creating a Fixed Asset. Assume that user created Fixed Asset without Profit Center. If, they try to create a Profit Center in the hierarchy above the Cost Center, this will result in above error message. Note: It is not always the case that the customer has activated only the Reporting Principle as income statements by function of costs. If they activate the reporting Principle for Income statements by function of profit center and segment reporting, then the Profit Center is mandatory for creating a Fixed Asset.-User may have many Fixed Assets for a Particular Combination of Cost Center and Profit Center. Now, if the requirement is to delimit/delete the Cost Center or Profit Center, while doing if it ends up in the above error message.-In these cases as a Support Consultant, you can close the case with the cause for the issue along with the template for consulting cases.-Keywords-Fixed Asset; Cost Center; Profit Center; Change; Delete; Validity; Assigned;

Title: Reports on HTML5 and RUI homepage is displayed as a wrong chart type.
Content: Symptom-The report on HTML5 and RUI homepage is displayed as "Bar" chart type. However, you have set the default chart type as "Bubble" in Business Analysis work center.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite :-You have set the default chart type of this report as "Bubble" in Business Analysis work center.-Then assign the report (report view) to your homepage-You will see the report is displayed as "Bar" chart type, not "Bubble" on your HTML5 homepage and RUI homepage.-Cause-This is a standard system behavior.-The system does not support “bubble” on both HTML5 homepage and RUI homepage for current version.-However, we are planning to support additional chart types on RUI homepage, including Bubble chart in future release.

Title: How to check the current version of ISAgent (Byte Code Adapter) - SAP Solution Manager 7.2
Content: Symptom-How to check out the current ISAgent version.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-CA Wily Introscope Enterprise Manager 10.7-CA Wily Introscope Enterprise Manager 10.8-Resolution-Check out current installed ISAgent version using System Information-Start SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java of SAP Solution Manager--http://<SolutionManagerJavaHost>:<port>/startPage--Go to System Information then access the Components Info tab-In the "Name" column, filter by 'ISAGENT*'-Select the affected component and check the column 'Version':--Check out current installed ISAgent version using ISAdmin user interface-Access the ISAdmin Administration URL below:--http://<SolutionManagerJavaHost>:<port>/smd/ISAdmin--Select the affected System, then check the column 'IS Agent Version':--  See Also-KBA 2068401 - How to update the ISAgent (Byte Code Adapter) - SAP Solution Manager 7.1 / 7.2-KBA 3394385 - How to check version and patch level of Introscope Enterprise Manager-Keywords-Enterprise Manager Version , Introscope version, WILY INTROSCOPE AGENT, ISAgent BCA Byte Code Adapter, update the ISAgent

Title: Error: "Check With ID XYZ Already Exists For Bank Account PQRS; Save Failed; Refresh List to Perform Further Actions" When Approving Task
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs while trying to approve a task in Managing My Area work center:-"Check with ID XYZ already exists for Bank account PQRS"-"Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions"-(XYZ represents the Check ID, PQRS represents the Bank Account ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Select the Approval Task and perform the action Approve.-You get the error message Check with ID XYZ already exists for Bank account PQRS; Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions.-Cause-The reason for this problem is that the next check ID in the check lot (which determines which number the next check will have) didn't get the correct check number.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Master Data view.-Go to the My Banks subview.-Select the My Bank PQR.-Perform the action Edit Bank Accounts.-On the new window select the Bank account XYZ.-Navigate to the tab Check Lot.-Perform the action Void Unused Check and enter the check number XYZ a date and void reason and press ok.-This will not create a new outgoing check but just delete the number from the check lot so that the system does not try to use the number for the next check.-Keywords-Check with ID already exists, Bank Account, Managing My Area, Approvals, Refresh list.

Title: Credit Limit Check in Sales Order is Incorrect
Content: Symptom-When you execute the Credit Limit Check in a sales order the information message displays a different amount than expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from the Common Tasks.-Enter Account ABC (ABC represents the account ID).-Click the Check Credit Limit button.-The following information message appears: Credit Limit Not Exceeded; XXX is left (Here XXX is Available Credit Limit Amount for the Account ABC).-Let's take an example as XXX is 3000 VND, we can also check the Credit limit amount left as follows:-Go To Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Find the Account ABC.-Select the Account ABC and you can find the Customer Balances in General Tab is 8,000 VND.-The Credit Limit in Financial Data of Account ABC in Account Master Data is 10,000 VND.-The Available Credit Limit is calculated as Credit Limit-Customer Balance. The Available Credit Limit displayed in the Sales Order is not the expected amount. The expected amount is 2,000 VND in the example Sales Order but the system shows it as 3,000 VND.-Cause-Since the Account ABCis both Customer Account and Supplier Account, when calculating the Available Credit Limit the system considers both Customer Balances and Supplier Balances. Let's consider Credit Limit Amount assigned to Account ABC is 10,000 VND, the Customer Balances is 8000 VND and the Supplier Balances is 1,000 VND. The Available Credit Limit will be 10,000 VND - 8,000 VND + 1,000 VND = 3,000 VND which is the actual Available Credit Limit.-Please note that the Invoiced Open Amount is determined from the receivables of the account and only the Posted Items are taken into consideration. The Statistical Items are not taken into consideration for the Invoiced Open Amount.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Netting, Mixed Account, Credit limit, Receivables

Title: Custom Key Figures not Available for Data Source Creation
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a custom data source using a data source that contains certain customized key figures, however, the customized key figures are not showing up for selection in the data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analyticswork center and access the view Design Data Sources.-Click on New and choose one of the two options: Combined Data Source or Joined Data Source.-On the Create Data Source screen, click on Add Data Source and select one of the data sources you want to use.-When you check the Key Figures for the selected data source, you will see that all customized key figures are not available.-Cause-As the key figures are created based on a specific data source, custom key figures are only available for the data source which they were created upon.-Resolution-If you wish to have your customized key figures in a new custom data source, you will have to create the key figures in the new data source.-See Also-2346561 - Cannot Find Key Figures While Creating a Join Data Source-2130915 - Newly Created Key Figure Does Not Appear in the Data Source Preview-Keywords-custom data source, key figure missing, cannot be added, no results, joined data source, combined data source, calculated key figure, restricted key figure, analytics, report-key figure,joined data source,new data source,combined data source,customized key figures,add key figure

Title: The External Document ID in Recurring Invoice is proposed in the Bank Payment Order but not the Payment Reason
Content: Symptom-The External Document ID in Recurring Invoice is proposed in Bank Payment Order but not the Payment Reason.-The Payment Reason which is maintained in the Recurring Invoice should be proposed in the Bank Payment Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents.-Open the Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice).-Go to the General tab.-Here you are also able to see the Payment Reason 123 (123 represents the ID of the Payment Reason).-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the Bank Payment Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Bank Payment).-Here the Payment Reason will not be displayed. Only the Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice).-Cause-In the Business Configuration you have to maintain the Outgoing Bank Transfer and has to edit the Payment Correspondence Profiles.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find the Activity "Outgoing Bank Transfer".-Click the Change Immediately button.-Click the link: Edit payment correspondence profiles.-Select the Payment Correspondence Profile: "06 - SEPA Credit Transfer and Direct Debit".-Here you have to change the Source of Variable Data: "07 - Free Text from Invoice" OR check the checkbox under column "Use Text from Invoice / Document".-Once done the Payment Reason will be displayed in the Bank Payment Order.-Keywords-Bank Payment Order; External Document ID; Supplier Invoice; Payment Reason-recurring invoice,bank payment order,payment reason

Title: Not Possible to Cancel a Customer Contract
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to cancel a customer contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for the contract ABC (ABC represents the ID of the contract).-Edit the contract ABC and select the View All button.-Go to the General tab and select the Renewal and Cancelation subtab.-Cancelation Reason field is grayed out, hence it is not possible to cancel the contract.-Cause-Since the Fulfillment Status of the Item is Finished for the reported contract, the cancelation is not possible anymore.-Follow the steps below to check the Fulfillment Status:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for the contract ABC.-Edit the contract ABC and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select the line Item.-Check for the Fulfillment Status field.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-customer contract, sales order, fulfillment, status, cancelation not possible, cancelation reason, grayed out.

Title: Where to Find the Adaptation Changes Done in Adaptation Mode?
Content: Symptom-You have made changes in a UI screen through Adaptation Mode, and have a requirement to see what changes were made.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-UI Adaptation changes can be verified in the Flexibility Changelog. To access it, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Select Flexibility Change Log view.-In the Flexibility Change Log view, all adaptation changes and their status will be recorded. When the Flexibility Change Log view is visible, it indicates that the user is authorized for making adaptation changes.-The user who is having access to the Business Flexibility view is authorized to make changes with Business Flexibility that can be published to all users.-Keywords-UI, Extension Field, Personalization

Title: Error Message: Fixed Asset Cannot be Scrapped
Content: Symptom-You want to scrap the fixed asset ABC (ABC is the fixed asset ID) using manual posting option Complete Scrapping.-You get the error message: "Fixed asset ABC cannot be scrapped."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search and select fixed asset ABC.-Click Edit General.-Click Manual Postings and select the Complete Scrapping option.-Click Simulate (Post).  -An error message displays: "Fixed asset ABC cannot be scrapped."-Alternatively use the option Individual Material Scrapping as Manual Posting.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search and select fixed asset ABC.-Click Edit General.-Click Manual Postings button and select the Individual Material Scrapping option.-Input the Individual Material ID if not automatically populated.  -Click Simulate (Post).-The Error Message Retirement not possible, individual material /asset not capitalized is shown-Cause-The fixed asset supposed to be scrapped does not have any Acquisition and production Costs (APC) related posting.-This might be due to the cancellation of the Initial Goods and Services Receipt or this fixed asset is a migrated one.-As a result even though the status of the fixed asset ABC is Capitalized, the status of the only Individual Material composing the fixed asset or the Individual Material you want to scrap (if the fixed asset ABC is composed of several Individual Materials) is Assigned instead of Acquired.-Resolution-Retire the fixed asset ABC by manually setting the deactivation day for all set of books.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the fixed asset ABC.-Click Edit Master Data.-Navigate to the Life cycle Data subtab.-For all Set of Books, set the Deactivation Date to the date which want to retire the fixed asset.  -Keywords-fixed asset; scrapping; verschrottung; Anlage; Anlage kann nicht verschrottet werden

Title: Credit Limit Check is not Available in Manual Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a Manual Invoice and want to check the Credit Limit Check.-You only see the button Check and not the button Credit Limit Check.-You have followed the Configuration Settings of the Help Document: Credit Limit Check.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the New Manual Invoice from Common Tasks.-You can find the button 'Check' but not the button 'Check Credit Limit'.-Cause-The option Credit Limit Check is available only for documents such as  sales orders, service orders, sales quotes, or customer contracts. The system is designed as such that the documents that are not applicable for Credit Limit Check do not have the button available.-The feature is currently not available in Manual Invoices. It is assumed that the check has already been done in Sales Order or other preceding documents.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.-Keywords-Check Credit Limit, Invoice, Check-invoice,check credit limit,check credit limit button

Title: How to Cancel Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You have received a Down Payment Request from one of your customers, everything is completed and finished on the whole process:-Your sales order is completed-Your logistics processes are completed-Your customer invoice is cleared from the trade receivables and linked to an incoming check-Your payment is already posted on a bank statement-However, you need to cancel this Down Payment Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The underneath documents are part of the Down Payment Request process:-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts subview.-Open the Account ID which you need cancel the Down Payment Request.-Click on View.-Go to Trade Receivables tab.-Click on Advanced made a search with the Clearing ID.-You must have these Document Type with status Cleared:-a) Down Payment Request / Clearing ID A-b) Payment / Clearing ID A-c) Invoice / Clearing ID B-d) Down Payment / Clearing ID B-You must have a request payment document + the payment (financial document).-Once you clear the above documents, system creates the down payment + invoice document you must create due to the tax proposes and formalize the process.-Cause-All postings were successfully created, now you must reverse some documents.-Resolution-A) Take a note from the underneath documents ID’s in order to execute the Reverse action.-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Open the Bank Statement that you have processed in the Down Payment Request.-Click View All.-Go to Transactions tab.-Go to Document Flow subtab.-Note the ID’s for the below documents:-• Bank Statement (Document ID )-• Payment Allocation (Bank statement reference)-• Check Deposit-• Incoming Check-• Payment Allocation-• Payment-• Clearing  (Down Payment)-• Customer Invoice (Down Payment Invoice)-B) Reverse the Bank Statement Payment Allocation:-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Search for the Bank Statement Allocation ID you noted above.-The status is Posted, select this row and click on button Reverse.-System always requires a Posting Date for the reverse action; we suggest reverse on the original date.-Status of the Bank Statement allocation changes from Posted to Canceled.-The status of the incoming check is again In Transfer.-After this reverse process, system creates a new Payment Allocation of the cancelation and the status will be In Process, take a note of this Allocation ID.-C) Reverse the Check Deposit:-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Deposits view.-Go to Check Deposits subview.-Search for the  Check Deposit ID you noted above.-The current status is Released.-Click on button Actions Reverse.-System always requires a Posting Date for the reverse action; we suggest reverse on the original date.-Status change from Released to Canceled.-Your incoming check returns the status as Ready For Deposit.--D) Reverse the Clearing ID in Receivables of this combination: (invoice + down payment).-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts subview.-Open the Account ID which you need cancel the Down Payment Request.-Click on View.-Go to tab Trade Receivables.-Search for the Clearing ID combination = invoice + down payment.-Click on this Clearing ID.-Click on View All button.-Click on Reset Clearing.-Click Save and Close.-Now both (invoice + down payment) are open again.-E) Reverse the Incoming Check.-Go to Payment Management Work Center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Select your Incoming Check which needs to be canceled.-The status now is Ready For Deposit.-Click on Reverse button.-System always requires a Posting Date for the reverse action; we suggest reverse on the original date.-Status is now Canceled.-At this moment you have these documents with Open status:-Down Payment Request + Payment-On this moment you have these documents with Canceled status-Down Payment + Invoice-F) In this scenario your down payment request was wrongly requested to your customer, but the Sales Order is correct, so you need to cancel the Down Payment Request.-Steps to cancel:-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts subview.-Open the Account ID which you need cancel the Down Payment Request.-Click on View.-Go to tab Trade Receivables.-Open the Down Payment Request.-Click on View All.-Click on Cancel.-Close-Refresh the account.-Status change to Canceled.-In this moment the only open document is the invoice.-G) Now you must include this open invoice on the Bank Statement which has the status Postprocessing - Required. Once you include this invoice on the Bank Statement the Payment Allocation (the one from step C) will be posted.-Steps:-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Search for the Bank Statement ID, with status Posted but the Postprocessing is Required.-Click on Required.-There is an error Payment amount not allocated completely; check the open amount (the amount appears).-Go to Customer/Supplier subtab.-Click on Search Open Items.-Find the open invoice, press Go.-Select the number.-Press Ok.-Choose Post.-Select Close.-Refresh the Bank Statements.-The Postprocessing changes from Required to Not Required.-Back to Trade Receivables and refresh screen.-Invoice is Cleared with new Clearing ID.

Title: Error Message "Please enter only valid Katakana characters" When Saving Bank Directory for Japanese Bank
Content: Symptom-This KBA is especially for the Japanese customers.-The following error message pops up when saving a bank directory for Japanese bank:-"Save failed"-"Please enter only valid Katakana characters"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The issue can be reproduced with following steps:-Go to Liquidity Management work center, Master Data view and Bank Directory sub view.-Select New, then Bank Directory Entry.-Input Bank Name and Bank Name (Katakana).-Select Country as Japan.-Select Save, then an error message prompts, even though katakana has been filled in field Bank Name (Katakana).-Cause-Only half-width katakana characters are allowed for entering the bank name.-Resolution-Enter half-width katakana in Bank Name (Katakana).-Typically, half-width katakana appears smaller than full-width katakana.-See Also-SAP Format for Bank Directory Upload — Japan-Keywords-Bank Directory, Japan Bank, Katakana Characters

Title: Invoice Request With Status To Be Invoiced After Invoice Document Cancelation
Content: Symptom-When an Invoice Document is canceled, the preceding Invoice Request turns back to status "To Be Invoiced" on the Invoice Requests View.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the Invoice Document ABC (where ABC represents the invoice document name), whose status is Released.-Select the Invoice Document ABC and click the Cancel button.-A new Cancelation Invoice Document is created.-Click Save.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-You can see that there is an invoice request with status as To be Invoiced with reference to the Invoice Document ABC.-Cause-Once an Invoice Document is canceled, the corresponding Invoice Request will change the status from Processed to To be Invoiced back again. A new invoice can be created from this invoice request.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-invoice document, preceding document, invoice request, to be invoiced, processed, status, byd.

Title: Open Task Found for Material XYZ; Serial Profile Cannot be Changed
Content: Symptom-When trying to change the Serial Number Profile value for a material from Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Process to any other value, system shows the below error message.-"Open Task Found for Material XYZ; Serial Profile Cannot be Changed" (XYZ means Material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Navigate to the Materials view.-Search for the relevant material, select it and choose the Edit button.-Select the View All button, the value in the field Serial Number Profile is Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Process.-When trying to change the profile to any other value the above mentioned error is faced.-Cause-As the error message suggests there is an open task for the material. This task could be a Production Task, Put-Away Task, Pick Task, Replenishment or Removal Task.-Resolution-It is necessary to make sure that all the tasks in which the material is used are processed completely. It can be search for the tasks in the relevant work centers. Once all the tasks are processed it will be able to change the serial number profile. Please ensure that the Production Lots in which the product is used are with status "Closed", as any other status will trigger the error message.-See Also-2784113 - Error is Thrown When Changing the Serial Number Profile-2833568 - System Displays an Error While Changing Serial Number Profile-Keywords-serial number profile error, error while changing serial number profile, not able to change serial number profile, issue with serial number profile

Title: Concur Expense Report- Payables Open Amount is Different From Total Expenses Amount
Content: Symptom-When checking a Concur expense report in the Employee account monitor you notice the payment amount is differnt to the total expense amount as entered in the JSON file (tag:totalApprovedAmount).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Concur go to the Expense Reports view.-Show All Expense Reports.-Select the relevant Report Key. You notice the total expense amount in the Total Expenses collumn, for example 100,00 LC (LC= Local Currency). -Press View and choose Journal Entry.-You notice the accounts payable amount to be much less, for example 25,00 LC. -Cause-The Concur expense report contains not only expense report of payment type Cash, PAYER=COMP/PAYEE= EMPL but also CBCP (company billed/company paid) payments, meaning, credit card payments directly to the credit card vendor, PAYER:COMP/ PAYEE CBCP.-As the expense report contains different payment types, more than one business transaction has been created for the system report key ID>-In the General Ledger Expense report you can only view one of the generated journal entries.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-In the Source Documents view of the General Ledger you will find two business transactions for the same report key ID, one for the employee expense report and one expense report for the credit card vendor.-See Also-3523337 - Error Message -PEV with expense document reference of type Expense Report already exists - When Trying to Post Concur Expense Report-Keywords-Concur, Expense Report, Journal Entry, Total Expenses

Title: How to Resolve the Error 'VAT Registration Number Missing for Account ABC' in a Sales Order or an Invoice.
Content: Symptom-When opening the Sales Order or the Invoice XXX (XXX represents the ID of the Sales Order or the Invoice), the document shows the error 'VAT Registration Number missing for Account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Account).-However, in the items tab, in the Taxes sub tab, you can see that a VAT number is entered for the items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of a Sales Order:-Go to the Sales Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Show All Orders and enter XXX in the Find Field (XXX represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Navigate to the Items Tab.-Select a line item and navigate to the Taxes sub tab. -You can see that a VAT number is maintained for the Customer’s Tax registration information.-Cause-The error occurs because the VAT number maintained in the Sales Order is an old VAT number which is no longer maintained in the account master data. The VAT number was since changed in the account master data.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Show All Orders and enter XXX in the Find Field (XXX represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click on View All.-Perform a dummy change with any of the data of the Sales Order.-Click Save.-The Save will re-trigger the tax determination and the error will be resolved.-Keywords-Sales Order, VAT number missing, account master data, Fehler in der Prozesskommunikation, 'Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer fehlt für Kunde', Kundenstammdaten; Customer Invoice; Invoice;

Title: Product Category Not Released For Accounting; Select Another Category
Content: Symptom-Error message Item XXX: Product category XYZ not Released for Accounting; Select another Category while creating shopping cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Navigate to the Self-Services Overview sub view.-Select Go Shopping (Advanced) link under the Shopping section.-In Step 3 Edit Shopping Cart, enter the Product Category, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-Account Determination Group for Product Category XYZ is not maintained in the fine tuning activity Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories.-Resolution-You can maintain an account determination group for product category XYZ in the fine tuning activity.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and select Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune Tab.-Select All Activities from the drop down list and search for activity Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories.-Open the activity and select Add Row button.-Maintain the Product Category ID and Default Account Determination Group and select Save button.  -Keywords-Product, Category, Not Released, Accounting, Shopping Cart, Account Determination Group.

Title: How to Enable the Read Access Logging Feature?
Content: Symptom-You want to enable the option Read Access Logging under the work center Data Protection and Privacy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-[Enter your Reproducing the Issue here...]-Cause-[Enter your Cause here...]-Resolution-This option needs to be scoped under the Business Configuration work center. To do so, please follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the view Implementation Projects-Select your implementation project and click on Edit Project Scope-Click on Next until you reach the step Questions-Expand the option Built-in Services and Support -> System Management -> Security-Add the question "Do you want to switch on the Read Access Logging for personal sensitive data?" to the scope of the system-Save your changes to the scoping-See Also-Data Protection and Privacy in SAP Business ByDesign-Data Protection and Privacy in SAP Cloud for Customer-Keywords-Read Access Logging, Data Privacy, Data Protection

Title: Right of Use Asset - Depreciation Overview- No records found
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-DO NOT USE send case to development for recalculation-A depreciation run, executed for a Right Of Use Asset (RoU Asset) finished with info message: 'For the selected fixed assets, posting not required in set of books ABC' (ABC represents the Set of Books ID).-When checking the ROU asset's depreciation overview there are no depreciation values displayed. The 'No records found message' is displayed instead. -However, the Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow report correctly calculates depreciation values for each period of the lease contract's life time. -You cannot trigger a recalculation adjustment for the ROU asset as the option is greyed out. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Depreciation view.-Find and open the respective run ID. executed for ROU asset XYZ (XYZ represents the ROU asset's ID). -Go to the Messages tab. -Notice the information message 'For the selected fixed assets, posting not required in set of books ABC'-You check the associated lease contract's cash flow to verify the depreciation calculation: -In the Lease Contract Management work center go to the Lease Contract view. -Find lease contract DEF (DEF represents the lease contract ID) and select it.-Press Reports and choose Cash Flows. -In the report check the Depreciation Company Currency column. -Here, the expected depreciation values appear for each period of the lease contract's/ ROU asset's life time. -However, in the ROU asset master data, the depreciation values are not displayed: -In the Fixed Assets work center go to the Fixed Assets view. -Find ROU XYZ (or access the ROU from the lease contract's lease Objects tab)-Press Edit and choose Values. -In the Depreciation Overview tab there are no depreciation values displayed. The 'No records found message' appears. -You try to trigger a recalculation for the ROU asset:-In the Fixed Assets work center go to the Fixed Assets view. -Find ROU XYZ (or access the ROU from the lease contract's lease Objects tab)-Press Edit and choose Values. -Under Valuation Values per Set of Books press Values: Here. the Recalculate Adjustment option is greyed out. -Cause-An inconsistency exists for the ROU asset that prevented the lease management accounting application to store the depreciation values into the ROU asset. -For ROU assets the Recalculate Adjustment option is not available in the user interface. -Resolution-Once you have customer approval, we can trigger the recalculation adjustment from the backend: -Request an L6 user with write access. -In STFK go to the testshell, transaction SESFTS. -enter BO Proxy name FIA_FIXED_ASSET.-Press Load by Query and choose ROOT- BY_MASTER_DATA.-In the Key/MasterFixedAssetID/content field enter the ROU assets ID DEF.-In the Company ID field enter the ROU asset's company ID and press OK (green tick). -Press Navigate and choose SET_OF_BOOKS.-In the pop-up screen press OK (green tick). -Select the relevant set of books or select all entries and press Navigate and choose SOB_VALUATION_VIEW.-Select the respective valuation view.-Press Actions and choose RECALCULATE_VALUE_ADJUST.-Press Save. -The depreciation values should now appear for the ROU asset and the depreciation run should perform postings. -Should there still be no values maintained, send an incident to development at AP-ACC-LM.-See Also-3505563 - Right of Use Asset Depreciation Run Message: For the selected fixed assets, posting not required in set of books-Keywords-ROU asset, no depreciation, depreciation no records found, Lease contract's ROU asset, depreciation missing

Title: Supplier Invoice Was Posted With a Goods and Services Receipt That Was Returned
Content: Symptom-The user was able to post a Supplier Invoice with reference to a Goods and Services Receipt that was no longer delivered. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Search for: ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice's ID). -Navigate to Items tab. -Navigate to Document Flow subtab. -Open Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) XYZ (XYZ is the Goods and Services Receipt's ID). -The GSR has 'Goods Returned' status. -It was not expected that the system would allow the posting of an invoice with a delivery document that was returned. -Cause-When the GSR was created and linked to the Supplier Invoice, the system automatically changed the Invoice's status from 'Exception' to 'Ready for Posting'. Because the delivery document is linked to the Invoice, the system turns the exception "Missing Receipt or Return Document: The receipt document is missing or invalid" to Obsolete. -Once the exception has status Obsolete, its status won't change back. -Even if the GSR is later returned and invoice is still not Posted, the system doesn't update the Invoice. Also, when clicking in Check button, the system triggers a warning message (example):  "Item N: The invoiced quantity 1 ea is greater than the delivered quantity 0 ea of purchase order OPQ. Possible reasons are a goods return, a goods and services receipt cancellation, or an accepted missing receipt/return document." (N is the number of the item in the Invoice; OPQ is the Purchase Order's ID).  -The same happens for Invoices that are already paid or posted, and its delivery document was later returned. The user has to decide if they take an action such as cancelling the Supplier Invoice or creating a Credit Memo. -Resolution-System is working as designed.-See Also-KBA: 1584460 - Exception in Supplier Invoice: The receipt document is missing or invalid.-Keywords-Missing Receipt or Return Document; Exception; Supplier Invoice; Goods and Services Receipt; Return to Supplier; Goods Return; Return Document; Missing Receipt

Title: Zero Quantity Items Are Shown When Creating New Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When the user creates Supplier Invoice for a Purchase Order, the New Invoice screen shows items that have zero quantity and zero amount. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID). -Click in New Invoice button. -In the Items section, there is a line item with zero quantity and zero net amount.-Because the item is Finished, it was expected that this item wouldn't be there. -Cause-When the item has Finished invoicing status, the system doesn't assign this item for a new supplier invoice. However, there are exceptions, which will be listed below. -Type 1: When the item type is quantity-related, such as material, service or expense: -Cause 1 (Zero Quantity and an Open Amount): The item was invoiced with its full quantity, however, with a reduced net amount. For example, there is an item in the Purchase Order that has total net amount as 9,99 EUR and quantity as 1 ea. It was created an invoice for this item with net amount as 9,98 EUR and quantity as 1 ea. The item status is 'Finished' even though there is an open amount of 0,01 EUR. However, the system cannot propose an amount when the total quantity was already fully invoiced (open quantity = zero). Hence the item goes to the invoice but with zero quantity and zero net amount.-Cause 2 (Zero Quantity and Zero Amount): The item was invoiced with its full quantity and full net amount. However, the supplier invoice is not posted. Hence the item will still be assigned to the new invoice. -Resuming, the item is not assigned to the supplier invoice when it was invoiced with same or greater amount. -Type 2: When the item type is not quantity-related, such as limit: -Cause 3 (Quantity is not relevant): When invoicing the item for the first time, the quantity and amount are both zero. It is expected that the user manually inserts the amount here. In this scenario the invoiced quantity is not relevant. The invoicing status of the item only is 'Finished' when the order amount is fully invoiced. -Resolution-System is working as expected. -See Also-KBA: 1938149 - In Supplier Invoice, 'Invoice Price per Price Unit' (Net Price) does not Match 'Purchasing Price' in Purchase Order-KBA: 3141218 - Value Of The Invoice Is 0,00 (Zero) After Performing The Lease Contract Run-Keywords-Zero Quantity; Zero Amount; Finished status; Supplier Invoice
