Title: Error 'Negative stock not permitted in logistics area, material' occurs when performing Post Goods Issue
Content: Symptom-While trying to Post Goods Issue against Stock transfer Order with specific material, below error message occurs even though this material has enough stock in system: "Negative stock not permitted in logistics area, material."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Under Delivery Control view, navigate to Delivery Proposals subview.-Search for the relevant Delivery Request ID.-Select Go.-Select Post Goods Issue.-Select Propose Quantities.-Click Release.-Here system throws an error message as above although enough stock is available for the required product.-Cause-The available On-Hand stock for this material in the desired logistics area has been allocated and assigned to another Warehouse Order which is still in process, hence, there is not enough stock available.-Resolution-It is necessary to maintain the stock for this material under the desired logistics area.-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, Stock Overview, Negative stock, Post Goods Issue, Material

Title: How to scope Goods and Services Receipt Expected in Contracts ?
Content: Symptom-Goods and Services Receipt Expected checkbox is not selected automatically while creating a new Contract-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to Contracts view-Select New -> Contracts -Enter all the necessary details-Enter the item details -Go to General data sub tab-Goods and Services Receipt Expected checkbox is not automatically selected -Cause-As per the current system design, scoping of Goods and Services Receipt Expected while creating a new Contract is not available. -Resolution-Currently there is no scoping questing available to automate the Goods and Services Receipt Expected checkbox during the creation of the Contracts. You have to do it manually as per the current system design. Goods and Services Receipt Expected scoping question can be scoped at PO level but not at the Contracts creation. -If you feel that this is an important feature to be added to the By Design system, you can put it up as a new requirement in the influence forum. -Influence forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipt Expected in contract, scoping question for Goods and Services Receipt Expected , goods and service receipt from contracts

Title: How to find a Table Name for a Business Object
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA will describe how to find the Table Names of a specific BO.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-This info can be used to find the number of extension fields created for a certain BO-node and what is the aggregate length.-Resolution-To get the BO table names, follow the below steps:-Go to transaction MDRS.-In the first drop-down, ensure it is Business Object.-Click on the second arrow.-A new window will pup-up, in the ES Name, put the Business Object name with wildcards, example:-For Customer Invoice, you can search it like: *Cust*Inv*.-For Supplier Invoice, you can search it like: *Sup*Inv*.-Click Search.-It will usually be the one where it is only the full name.-Double-click it.-Copy the Bus. Object name.-Go to transaction GFSSTM.-On Business Object, paste the copied text.-Click Start Monitor (F8).-Go to the tab Load Status.-Expand the row that's the same name of the copied text on the Diamond Blue part.-The table names will be on the Ext Table column.-The names of the tables are the same for all customers, and the last 3 numbers is the Tenant ID of the customer.-See Also-Knowing the table name of the BO, the below KBA can be followed to know the number of created Extension Fields and their aggregate length.-3515541 - How to know the number of created Extension Fields and their aggregate length on the Business Object in BusinessByDesign-Here is a list of all known Table Names:-3525484 - List of all known table names of Business Objects-Keywords-PDI, SDK, extension, field, table name

Title: Project Task Expense Entries Posting Against Profit Center Instead Of Cost Center
Content: Symptom-When posting expense entries to a project task, the system is posting it to the profit center instead of the cost center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Reports view.-Search for report: G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-Maintain all company and set of books relevant data.-Filter for journal entry ID: XXX (XXX represents the project task expense posting).-It has profit center assigned not cost center.-Cause-The system always check the source document to derive the cost center in the journal entry. Click on the source document of journal entry to check whether there is a cost center maintained.-If there is no cost center ID column, add the Cost Center ID field via Personalization menu to see whether the field is maintained.-If a cost center is maintained and the G/L Account hit in the journal entry allows postings with cost center, then the cost center is derived.-Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-project expense, cost center, profit center

Title: Why List Price is Used in Intercompany Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-When system triggers purchase request by purchase request planning run in an intercompany scenario, the price is from list price and cannot be edited.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a sales order for intercompany sales and purchasing scenario.-Select "External" as fulfillment and select a supplier for the line item in sales order.-When purchase request is triggered, see that price in the purchase request is the list price maintained for the supplier and product.-Cause-If a list price is maintain for a product and a supplier, it will be picked up by system when triggering purchase request in an intercompany scenario.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-List Price; Purchase Request; Intercompany; Sales Order

Title: Product Specification: Property is Obsolete
Content: Symptom-Error in product specification -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Planning and Production Master data work center. -Go to the Product Specifications view. -Find and select the relevant Product Specification.-Click Edit.-You can see there are multiple Properties assigned to this Product Specification and some of them are showing the error: Property is obsolete.--Cause-Navigate to the Product Development work center. -Go to the Product Models view. -Search with the relevant Product ID to find the respective Product Model.-Click Edit to open the Product Model.-Scroll to the section : Properties and Default Values.-You can see the that Properties listed as obsolete in the Product Specification are indeed missing.-System behaviour is therefore consistent.-Product Properties already removed in the Product Model and so system is correctly reporting that the Properties are obsolete.-Resolution-Please ensure to maintain your Master Data (Product Model) properly.-You have the option to "Remove Obsolete Properties" in the Production Specification.-System working as designed.-

Title: Error "Account determination group not found for PSE /" in Revenue Recognition Run for Contract
Content: Symptom-Error "Account determination group not found for PSE  /" occurs in the Revenue Recognition Run executed for the Sales Document Type Contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go the the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Select All Revenue Recognition Runs from the dropdown menu and select the Run ID.-In the Details section, click on the Log Results.-Navigate to the Messages tab to see the error message "Account determination group not found for PSE /".-Cause-The error occurs due to the inconsistent contract.-Resolution-This requires a backend correction. Forward the case to the SAP Support with the permission to perform the necessary corrections from the backend.-Keywords-Account determination group not found for PSE, Revenue Recognition Run, Error, Contract

Title: Amount Text On Output Check Form
Content: Symptom-You translate the system into Arabic language and design the output form for outgoing checks. On the form, you notice that the amount in text form is not correct. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.- Open the Outgoing Check ID: XXX (XXX stands for the outgoing check ID).-Select View All.-Select Preview > Check.-The amount is for example 41,435.000 and shows in text form as Four-One-Four-Three-Five.-In the XML form this shows in the tag as: <AmountText languageCode="EN">Four-One-Four-Three-Five</AmountText>.-Cause-The amount in the Arabic system took by default English as language code because Business ByDesign system is not configured in Arabic language for output check form. -For English as default language code, the system read the amount by one digit number "41,435.000"- Four-One-Four-Three-Five. Hence, the mount in text form is not correct.-Resolution-The output form for outgoing checks supports language such as English, Spanish, German, French etc. For not supported language, the system uses English as default language code and reads the amount by digit to form the amount text. This is the designed system behaviour.-Keywords-Output Check Form, Amount Text, Language Code, Arabic Language, <AmountText languageCode="EN"></AmountText>.

Title: Delete Button is Disabled for Business Role
Content: Symptom-You are trying to delete a business role after setting it as obsolete, however the delete button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Open the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Business Roles view.-Search and select the desired business role.-You can see that the Delete button is disabled, even though the role is marked as obsolete.-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Open the Administrator work center.-Enter the General Settings view.-Click on Business Roles.-Search and select the desired business role.-You can see that the Delete button is disabled, even though the role is marked as obsolete.-Cause-Even though the business role is marked as obsolete, there are still business users assigned to the business role.-This prevents the deletion of the business role.-Resolution-In order to enable the Delete button, please unassign the business role from all users who are currently assigned to it.-In order to check the users currently assigned to the business role, you can follow the below steps:-Open the Administrator work center.-Enter the General Settings view.-Click on Business Roles.-Search and select the desired business role.-Click on the business role ID to open it.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Assigned Business Users tab.-Here you can see the list of users who are currently assigned to the role.-Keywords-business user, work center, undo obsolete

Title: Unable to Confirm Production Check Task
Content: Symptom-When trying to confirm the production check task, after clicking Finish Results Recording button, system does not update the Check task status to "Finished" and the task is still "In Process" status.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search for the relevant Check Task ID.-Select it and choose Confirm button.-Choose Finish results recording button, then system updates planned and confirmed quantity correctly.-Choose Finish Task button, new Pop window opens.-Input Parament for Finish Task.-Click on OK.-Find task status not change to "Finished",  it remains "In Process".-Cause-The root cause of this issue is that the serial number is confirmed before performing finish results recording actions.-If the serial number is entered in the Confirmation tab without clicking Finish Result Recording button, relevant production confirmation will be created for the entered quantity, but the inspection will still in un-finished status.-Check Task cannot be finished without completing the inspection. When clicking Finish Result Recording button, the system expects a serial number to be entered for the inspected quantity, which leads to inconsistency.-Resolution-This issue can be avoided by entering the serial number in Check Task after clicking Finish Result Recording button.-If the issue already occurs, report a case to component AP-PE-TSK with backend corrections permitted, so that SAP can resolve this inconsistency in the backend.-Keywords-Production Task, Check Task, Finish results recording, Finish Task, Status, Finished, In Process

Title: Extension Field for Project Purchase Request Cannot be Updated on Item Level via PDI Solution
Content: Symptom-An Extension field on item level in Project Purchase Request cannot be updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Your PDI solution is trying to update an Extension field in ProjectPurchaseRequest BO - Item node, but this is not possible due to either process communication error:-Purchase Order ABC cannot update Project Purchase Request (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID)-Changing data not possible; data is read-only -Cause-The Add-On is trying to modify an Extension Field while it is set as "read-only" by the application. This happens in the item level when system tries to update the Project Purchase Request. The system checks, on item level, and its result depends on the status of the Purchase Order. The status of the Purchase Order can be checked by following the steps below:-Open Purchase Order ABC.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-Make note of the Purchase Request ID, which is OPQ.-Also make note of the Project ID, which is XYZ. -Open Project XYZ.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Products tab.-Navigate to Project Purchase Requests subtab.-Search for Purchase Request OPQ.-Check the Purchasing Status of the Purchase Request Item. -If the Purchasing Status is "Ordered", the item node is set as read-only.-If the Purchasing Status is "Requested", the item note is writable (not set as read-only).-Resolution-In your BeforeSave script file, you can be checking what is the value of PurchaseOrder.Item.Status.OrderingStatusCode field from the related Purchase Request and Purchase Order documents. If it is Requested, you will be able to update the required extension fields.-Keywords-Read, Only, Process, Communication, Error, Project, Purchase, Request, OrderingStatusCode, Technical error, AP_ESI_COMMON, 107, PRO_PROJECT_PURCHASE_REQ

Title: Incorrect Dunning Template Being Selected for the Dunning Letters
Content: Symptom-When performing a Dunning Run, the Dunning Template is being incorrect chosen for the Dunning Letters generated, even with the rules for the Dunning Letters in the Form Template Selection View being correctly maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Dunning Runs View.-Select the Run ABC (where ABC refers to the Run ID).-Click on Schedule.-Select Start Immediately, under Schedule section.-Click on Save and Close.-The Dunnings Letters will be created.-Go to Dunning View.-In the Dropdown, select All Dunnings Proposals.-Click on Advanced Filter.-In the Run ID field, insert ABC.-Click on Go.-Select the Dunning XYZ (where XYZ refers to the Dunning ID).-Click on Edit.-Click on Preview.-Click Send Options.-The template for the Dunning Letter selected is different from the one maintained in the Form Template Selection View for Dunning Letters.-Cause-The system is selecting the dunning template due to the rule maintained in the output of the account for the "Dunning Outbound".-This is the expected system behavior. The account output rules are validated and selected before the rules maintained in the Form Template Selection View.-Resolution-To apply the rules maintained in the Form Template Selection View for the Dunning Letters, it is required to remove the Dunning Outbound output rule from the account.-To remove the rule of the account, perform the below steps:-Go to Dunning View.-In the Dropdown select All Dunnings Proposals.-Click on Advance Filter.-In the Run ID field, insert ABC.-Select the Dunning XYZ.-Click on Account Name "YYY", under "Customer Name" (where YYY refers to the Account Name).-Click on View All.-Click on Communication tab.-Click on Collaboration sub-tab.-Under Business Document Settings, select Dunning Outbound.-Scroll down to the Output Channel Settings section.-An output channel is selected, and a template defined for the Dunning Letters in the account.-Remove the template maintained in the output channels.-The rules maintained in the Form Template Selection View for the Dunning Letters will be applied correctly.-Keywords-Dunning, Template, Incorrect Template, Selection, Dunning Run, Output Management, Output Rules, Dunning Outbound.

Title: Replenishment For Production is Not Reflected in Production Order
Content: Symptom-After replenishment for production completed, there is nothing changed in corresponding production order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Access Production Orders view.-Select a production order which is not finished, click Edit.-Click button You Can Also, select New Replenishment with Reference.-Select a product, click Replenish.-Open the newly-created warehouse request, proceed until replenish task is finished with quantity confirmed.-Check in this production order, nothing changed.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior. Replenishment with production order as reference will not impact production order or its production task. Its only result is "Goods Movement" - some inventory is moved from one logistics area to another logistics area. The inventory is not allocated to this production order, it can be used for any purpose.-Keywords-Replenishment, Replenish, Production Order

Title: Error "Organizational unit must be or must be assigned to a reporting line unit" While Assigning Org Units To Employees
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign org unit to employee when creating new employee in system, but facing error "Organizational unit must be or must be assigned to a reporting line unit".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner work center.-Create new employee via clicking the New button.-Enter the First Name and Last Name.-Enter the org unit ID.-When saving, the error is shown: "Organizational unit must be or must be assigned to a reporting line unit".-Cause-The Self-Service Procurement check under the Purchase Order is scoped in Business Configuration. As the reporting line unit is mandatory for self-service procurement, hence for every employee reporting line unit is mandatory in order to procure the self-service requirement. -Resolution-You can remove the scoping of Self-Service Procurement check under the Purchase Order or assign reporting line unit to the required org units.-Keywords-Org Unit, Employee, Reporting line unit, Self-Service Procurement

Title: Internal Error Number [625] During Inventory Processing
Content: Symptom-System is returning the above error while you are trying to execute Stock Overview query with the But exclude parameter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center. -Go to the Common Tasks view. -Select Stock Overview.-Enter the relevant Storage Location ID.-Click on More Filters beside the Logistics Area ID field and activate the checkbox "But exclude".-Maintain the Logistics Area you want to Exclude and click Ok.-Click Go.-System returns the error: Internal error number [625] during inventory processing.-Cause-In troubleshooting we found that there is a technical limitation on the usage of Exclude option in select option.-As the empty value is given in Logistics area with Excluding a particular Logistics Area, system is building ranges table in backend due to the EXCLUDE operator. Ranges table has limitations in Select statement due to which mentioned error is getting returned.-In simple terms there is limitation in usage of EXCLUDE and it works only for very small data sets.- Resolution-Due to the huge number of Logistics Areas in your, we recommend to use the search without the Exclude option and you can then sort the result set. -You can also narrow down your search by using more parameters since the Exclude option only works on very small data set.-See Also-The Explanation can be found even in the blog post:-SAP Message /LIME/CORE625 - Length exceeded (&1) in selection with value range table (stechno.net)-Keywords-Stock Overview, Exclude, Query

Title: Not Able to Open Pro Forma Invoices on Sales and Service Quotes
Content: Symptom-When clicking on the Pro Forma Invoice button on a Sales or Service Quote, the following warning message appears:-"You are not able to open this link due to a missing work center view assignment".-It is not possible to access the Pro forma Invoice option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the New Business workcenter.-Go to the Sales Quotes view or Service Quotes view.-Select the quote XYZ (XYZ represents the Quote ID).-Click on the Pro Forma Invoice button.-The warning message "You are not able to open this link due to a missing work center view assignment" is displayed and you cannot open it.-Cause-The current business user does not have the access rights for any of the workcenters responsible for the Pro Forma Invoice on quotes.-Some of the workcenters that provide access to the Pro Forma Invoice are: Over-The-Counter Sales, Sales Order, Outbound Logistics and Third-Party Logistics.-Resolution-Navigate to the Application and User Management.-Go to the Business Users view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the User ID).-Click on Edit -> Access Rights.-Go to the Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Click on Find.-Search for any of the workcenters responsible for the Pro Forma Invoice (for example, Sales Orders).-Select the Work Center ID CRM_WOC_SALESORDERS and click Locate.-On the Available Work Centers and Views section, select the Work Center / View ID "CRM_WOC_SALESORDERS".-Mark the checkbox to Assign it to the user.-Click on Save.-Now the workcenter is assigned and the current business user is able to access Pro Forma Invoices on Sales and Service Quotes.-Keywords-pro forma invoice, sales quote, service quote, preview, business user, access right, work center, view, assignment.

Title: The Error "Financial posting on requested date DD.MM.YYYY blocked" is Displayed When Maintaining a Reason for Rejection for the Service Items in a Sales Order or Service Order
Content: Symptom-When rejecting a service item with item type Service - fixed price without actuals via reason for rejection in a Sales Order, the error message "Financial posting on requested date DD.MM.YYYY blocked" is displayed in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-       Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Maintain a Reason for Rejection for the Line Item XX (where XX represents the Line Item number).-The error message "Financial posting on requested date DD.MM.YYYY blocked" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The error message "Financial posting on requested date DD.MM.YYYY blocked" is displayed in the UI when rejecting a service item with item type Service - fixed price without actuals because the posting period of the Sales Order is blocked for financial accounting. -In a Sales Order document, the Requested Date field in the General tab is used as the posting date for financial accounting. If the Requested Date field is not filled in the Sales Order document, then the date in the Posting Date field is used. -This error message can occur in the following scenarios:-The delivery status for the service items with item type Service - fixed price without actuals is displayed as "Finished".-The delivery status for the service items with item type Service - fixed price without actuals is displayed as "Not Started".-Resolution-The following steps can be performed for each scenario:-1. The delivery status for the service items with item type Service - fixed price without actuals is displayed as "Finished".-As the Delivery Status of the service items is "Finished", it should be possible to maintain a reason for rejection for the items. However it will not possible to change the Requested Date in the Sales Order/Service Order as the field will be grayed out.-In this case, it is required to open the posting period for date maintained in Requested Date field in the Sales Order/Service Order and then set a reason for rejection for the Items.-Following are the steps for this process (using a Sales Order example):-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate the General tab.-Locate date in the Requested Date field.-Close the Sales Order ABC-Open the posting period for the date maintained in Requested Date field.-Open the Sales Order ABC again.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Maintain a Reason for Rejection for the Service Items.-Select Save-The status of the Sales Order should change to "Completed".-2. The delivery status for the service items with item type Service - fixed price without actuals is displayed as "Not Started".-As the Delivery Status of the service items is "Not Started", it should be possible to maintain a reason for rejection for the service items and also it should be possible to change the Requested Date in the General tab of the Sales Order/Service Order.-Following are the steps for this process (using a Sales Order example):-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate the General tab.-Locate date in the Requested Date field.-Change the date Requested Date field to a date in a open posting period.-Select Save.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Maintain a Reason for Rejection for the Service Items.-Select Save.-The status of the Sales Order should change to "Completed".-Keywords-financial posting on requested date, blocked, sales order, reason for rejection, service items, requested date, item type, service - fixed price without actuals

Title: Error: DFV Error Manual Payment: Transaction Amounts Differ
Content: Symptom-You have the following errors in the Data Flow Verification (DFV) Error for a Manual Payment:-"Transaction amounts differ-Accounting Notification ABC (ABC represents the Payment ID), Operational Document Type Manual Payment, Company.-Accounting Notification Item ABC-N (N represents the item ID of the payment).-Financial Audit Trail Documentation 0 for Payment Order ABC of Company.-Payment Allocation Item N."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Data Consistency view.-Go to the Data Flow Verification Results subview.-Select DFV Result DEF (DEF is the DFV Result ID).-For manual payment ABC, the following errors are displayed:-"Transaction amounts differ-Accounting Notification ABC, Operational Document Type Manual Payment, Company.-Accounting Notification Item ABC-N.-Financial Audit Trail Documentation 0 for Payment Order ABC of Company.-Payment Allocation Item N."-Cause-The line Item N is split into two lines in the Business Transaction for Accounting of the Journal entry.-The split of one item creates two lines in business transaction. During data flow verification process it tries to compare the actual amount with business transaction amount. But, due to split of the items the system raises the error "Transaction amounts differ". In real time scenario there is no error.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Search for ABC.-Select the related Journal Entry XYZ (XYZ is the journal entry ID) and open the same.-The Manual Payment is ABC.-Open the same and then View All. --> it is an outgoing bank transfer for the amount AAAA.AA Currency.-Go back to the Journal Entry XYZ.-Click You Can Also and select View Business Transaction for Accounting.-Click View All.-For the Item ABC-2, the lines are split into two. The sum of the amounts in the two split items is same as the amount in the item 1.-As the line in the business transaction got split in to two lines, the system could not recognize the actual amount of Payment Allocation.-Resolution-You can ignore the DFV (Data Flow Verification) Result and close the same.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Data Flow Verificaton Results.-Search and find the related Data Verification.-Select the button "Change Status to Closed".-Keywords-DFV; data flow verification; Business Document Differences; manual payment; accounting notification

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY***-A request has been made for the extraction of the Business Configuration Data for all BCO's (including Custom) from a tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Please create in incident with the AP-RC-BCT Development team who will extract the BC Nodes and provide them in a .zip file.- See Also-Note: -This request does not include the extraction of Master and Transactional Data, for which there is a separate process outlined in the KBA 1801951 - Case Processing - Data Extraction or Data Return and Attachment Extraction.-This refers to the extraction of BC Nodes Only.-Keywords-Business Configuration Data, BCOs, BCO,  Data Extraction, BC Nodes, Export, Business Configuration

Title: The sequency of extension fields in mass data maintenance UI is different from the exported CSV file
Content: Symptom-After modify the sequency of extension fields in mass data maintenance UI, the sequency of extension fields in exported CSV file is not the same as that in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Go to Mass Data Maintenance view.-Click Export Customers/Materials/Suppliers.-Input the Selection and click go.-Modify the sequency of extension fields.-Click Export Data to CSV File.-Open the exported CSV file.-The sequency of extension fields is not expected.-Cause-This is the system designed behavior. The modification of sequency in UI will not influence the sequency in exported CSV file. The sequency in CSV file is determined by the sequency in which the extension fields are added.-Resolution-To modify the sequency of extension fields in exported CSV file, delete the added extension fields and add them again in the expected sequency.-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, Extension Fields, Sequency, CSV File, UI, Export

Title: Sales Order Item Data Source and Report shows wrong product category
Content: Symptom-Sales Order Item Data Source and Report shows incorrect product category for old sales orders. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center-Select Design Data Sources view-Select the Sales Order Item data source-On the selection tab select the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the old sales order ID)-On the view tab choose the Sales Order, product, and product category on the report-The product category shows incorrect data when compared to the product category maintained in the product master data.-Cause-The product category was changed in the product master data after the creation of sales order and therefore report/data source showing the old product category for the corresponding sales order.  -Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.

Title: Error "Numbering formats must be maintained for warehouse provider" Occurs When Saving Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-When enter External Delivery Item ID in a Third-Party Inbound Delivery Notifications and check consistency of it, following error occurs:--Numbering formats must be maintained for warehouse provider.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to “Third-Party Logistics” work center.-Click on “Inbound Delivery Notifications” view.-Set the query on “All Delivery Notification by Selection”.-Search the relevant delivery notification ID.-Click on “New Inbound Delivery” button.-First go to “Line Items” tab and click on “Propose Quantities” button.-Input desired delivery ID on the “External Delivery ID” field .-Click on Check inconsistency button, above error occurs.-Cause-The desired Inbound Delivery type is custodian goods return delivery. While check the  “Document Numbering Formats for Inbound Delivery”  activity, there is no line item with document type as Custodian Goods Return. -There are two business configuration settings related to custodian goods return (from ‘scoping’ section of business configuration) which should be enabled/selected:-Sell Consignment Products-Spare Parts Handling-Resolution-First, the two business configuration settings related to custodian goods return should be selected in Business Configuration.-Go to Business Configuration work center and view Implementation Projects.-Select the project and select Edit Project Scope.-Select Next till steps 3, Scoping.-Expand Scoping Element Sales->Product and Service Portfolio for Sales.-Select Sell Consignment Products.-Expand Scoping Element Service->Service and Repair.-Select Spare Parts Handling.-Then, follow the instructions in the below help document to configure the document numbering formats for custodian goods return delivery.-Help document: Configuration: Document Numbering Formats for Inbound Delivery-Keywords-Numbering formats must be maintained for warehouse provider, Number range, custodian goods return, Inbound Delivery Notifications, New Inbound Delivery, External Delivery ID

Title: Incorrect Time Entries in Employee Time Report
Content: Symptom-In the standard report HCMTLMU01_Q0002, the recorded time for an employee is showing as X hours instead of the expected Y hours.-  X hours represents : Target Hour-Y hours represents :  Booked Hour by Employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to business analytics work center-Go to Design reports.-Search for the report  HCMTLMU01_Q0002 and open it.-Enter employee Id ABC-Run the report and navigate to the right.-Observe the recorded time for this date shows X hours instead of the expected Y hours.-Eg: You have recorded 5 hours but the report is showing 8 hours which is matching the Target hours.-Cause-The employee is using exception-based time recording. The system records the remaining time not booked by the employee automatically which is matching the Target hours.-Resolution-The employee is using exception-based time recording.-On the particular date, the Work Schedule shows that the employee has booked only Y hours. The system will automatically record the remaining X hours which matches the Target hours. This is the  standard functionality of exception-based time recording.-Exception based Time recording : Exception-based time recording is used if employees only have to record exceptions to their planned working time as defined in their work schedules, for example, when they need to record overtime or sick leave. The requirement for recording hours worked against a project should not be considered when determining the time recording method. -Positive Time recording: The positive time recording method requires employees to record all times worked, all absences and leaves. This method would be selected for an employee who is paid for hours worked. -Keywords-Time recording, exception-based, discrepancy, HCMTLMU01_Q0002, standard report, recorded time, time entries, employee report.

Title: List Price Value Not Fetched in the Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-When creating a shopping cart for a product, system does not fetch the pricing values for it although a list price has been maintained in the system. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Service Overview view.-Select Go Shopping hyperlink.-In the opened window fill in the required fields and select Next button.-Select Add Row button and enter the product ID which has a list price and quantity details.-See that the system does not fetch the pricing details and the price is shown as ZERO in the table.-Cause-This is the standard behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system. System will not fetch the pricing values in the shopping cart during creation. -Resolution-When finishing the shopping cart, the system will check in the master data for the pricing values (in this case the list price). And the price details will be displayed in the purchase request which is created from the shopping cart.-Keywords-Shopping Cart; List Price; Product

Title: Exception "An error occurred. Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case." While Hiring an Employee in Personnel Administration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Hire an employee in Personnel Administration. Upon trying to Hire the employee, system throws an exception:-An error occurred. Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Select tab Country XYZ (where XYZ is the Country name)-Under Hiring section, select Hire Employee-An error Occurs : An error occurred. Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case.-Cause-The user does not have write access for regular tasks .- Resolution-Steps to provide Write access to regular task.-Go to Application and user management work center-Go to Business user and search for the User.-Select Edit button and select Access Rights.-Go to Access Restrictions tab-Filter Work Center View Name with Regular tasks.-For the write access change the restriction from no access to unrestricted.-Keywords-Hire Employee, An error occurred, Write Access

Title: Error "Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks" During Migration of Suppliers
Content: Symptom-While migrating Suppliers using Migration of Suppliers activity, you receive below error in the Value Conversion Step:-"Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks"-        Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview.-Search and open the migration activity Migration of Suppliers.-Click Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool.-Start execution for the migration file.-Execute Migration Step by Step.-In second step, confirm the value.-In simulation, error "Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks " is displayed.---Cause-This issue is caused due to duplicate entries in mapping table of the Business Partner, value mapping task was failing.-The framework expects the Business Partners to be created via Migration tool, if that is not the case there could be chances of duplicate. -Resolution-Send to SAP Support team to remove the duplicate entries of Business Partner from the backend.-Keywords-ADG Migration, Migration of Suppliers, Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks

Title: How To Upload The Excel Upload Template With Extension Fields For Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-A Excel Upload Template for Sales Order has been modified to add extension fields. This new Excel Template for Sales Order is required to be published for all the users to create Sales Orders in the system.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The Excel Upload Template for Sales Orders has been modified with Extension Fields.-The Excel Upload Template requires to be published for all the users to create Sales Documents. -Resolution-In order to publish the modified Excel Upload Template, it is required to follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance View.-Go to Advanced Filter.-Select the Template Group as Sales Order Upload.-Select the Template Type as Microsoft Excel® (Write-back).-Upload the adapted template by clicking Upload.-The following options are available:-Overwrite an existing template by choosing Replace Existing Language Variant-   Create a new template by choosing New Template or New Language Variant, if you want to create a new template in a new language-     In order to make the template available for all users, the publish option must be selected by clicking Publish.-Keywords-Excel Upload, Extension field, Excel Template

Title: Detailed Item Line Information in Outbound Delivery is Not Taken into Outbound Delivery Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-In the outbound process, the sales order line was split into several lines due to the different batch ID assigned. But in the outbound delivery invoice request, these detailed item lines are not taken, there is only one item line to be invoiced. -You expect the invoice item splits into detailed item lines according to the outbound delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics - Outbound Deliveries view.-Open the outbound delivery ABC.-In the Items tab, the Line Items tab, there is one item line with delivery quantity as 3 ea. -In the Detailed Line Items tab, there are for example 2 lines for this product, with different Identified Stock ID assigned.-You expect that in the outbound delivery invoice request, the lines are split into 2 lines according to the Detailed Line Items information. But in the outbound delivery invoice request ABC, only one item line for the product with quantity 3 ea.-  Cause-The delivery details are not taken into the outbound delivery invoice request as well as the follow-up invoice request. The invoice request line quantity is taken from the line quantity in Line Items tab instead of Detailed Line Items tab.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-See Also-3328758 - The Currency and Payment Terms are not Fetched in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request from Sales Order-Keywords-outbound delivery detailed line items; not taken into invoice request; customer invoice.

Title: Error: 'Expense Report Not Possible; Posting on Posting Date In Company Blocked'.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Expense Report appearing with a Process Communication Error:-'Expense Report Not possible; posting on dd.mm.yyyy blocked in company 123 (123 represents the Company ID)'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Applications and user management work center.-Select the view Process Communication error.-Select the drop-down view Open Errors with case.-Search for Expense Report ID ABC, you can see the following error (ABC represents the Expense Report ID).-"Expense Reporting not possible; posting on dd.mm.yyyy blocked in company 123"-Cause-You can ask customer to open the Process Control for Expense Reporting and then you can restart the message.-Resolution-Restart the XI message from the backend of the customer system:-Go to STFK.-Select the transaction SE38.-Select the report: FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI.-Select Execute.-Enter the selection option.-Operational Document Type 47- Expense Report.-Enter the Expense Report ID as Operational Document ID.-Select the option Restart.-Once the XI message is successful delivered, the Expense Report will be shown an Unposted Source document in Source Documents View.- If the Restart does not deliver successfully, click on the option Reconcile.-Then the XI message will be delivered successfully.-Keywords-Expense Report, Posting, Blocked, Process Control, Process Communication Error-expense report,posting blocked,process control settings

Title: Change Collector by User Not Displaying Changes
Content: Symptom-The Change Collector by User feature is not displaying any changes, regardless of the user input.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management Work Center.-Access the Change Collector Work Center View.-Select the line Change Collector ID.-Scroll down and click on Execution.-Click on Execution ID .-Navigate to the Changes tab.-Observe that no records are found.-Cause-There could be multiple causes for the issue.-The issue arises when no changes have been made by the specified user within the given time frame. This is why no changes are appearing in the Changes TAB.-The Document type should be used based on the requirement.-Resolution-Verify the user for which the details are being fetched for the Changes Report.-Ensure the correct Document type is being used. Anything related to Business user use - User document type, any changes in supplier tab choose Supplier document type-Check if any changes have been made by the specified user within the given time frame use BT in Interval Definition.-See Also-Change Collector and its Process-Keywords-Change Collector, User Management, No Changes, Document Type, User, Change Report, Auditor, Execution ID, Changes TAB.

Title: GR/IR Clearing Issues for Purchase Orders Involving Fixed Assets in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The GR/IR (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) process for a purchase order (PO) that was completed in a previous period encounters error after the goods receipt is canceled. The errors can include incorrect asset depreciation calculations, discrepancies in GR/IR balances, and issues clearing goods receipts and invoices related to fixed assets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Purchase Orders and Requests work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view and search for the relevant PO.-In the Document Flow tab, observe the goods receipt and invoice receipt entries for the PO.-Attempt to cancel a goods receipt (GR) after the PO has been received and invoiced.-Run the GR/IR Clearing process:-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Execute the GR/IR run in test mode and notice the errors.-Attempt to clear remaining balances in the GR/IR inventories balance summary.-Notice errors related to asset depreciation or discrepancies in GR/IR balances.-Cause-This issue typically arises when the goods receipt for a PO involving a fixed asset has already been processed and depreciation calculations have begun. Canceling the goods receipt disrupts the accounting records and asset valuation, leading to errors in GR/IR clearing. This can include issues such as:-Depreciation Reversals: Reversing depreciation for assets when the goods receipt is canceled.-Mismatch in GR/IR Balances: Discrepancies between goods received and invoiced quantities/amounts due to incorrect cancellation.-Resolution-To avoid these errors, please update the settings the following in all valuation views:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for fixed asset ID XXX.-Click Edit and navigate to the Master Data.-Go to the Asset Valuation tab.-For Valuation View and the respective Set of Books ID, under Additional Parameters section change the Valuation Check Settings to 3 - No checks.-Then perform the GR/IR Run in Test Mode first. Once you have confirmed the results are as expected, proceed to execute it in Update Mode. -See Also-Navigate to the Fixed Assets work center.-Search for the relevant fixed asset and go to its Asset Valuation tab.-Under the Additional Parameters section, change the Valuation Check Settings to "3 - No checks" for the relevant valuation view and set of books.-Recalculate depreciation for the affected fixed assets after updating the valuation check settings.-Ensure that any previous incorrect depreciation calculations are corrected before continuing with the GR/IR process.-Perform the GR/IR run in Test Mode first to verify that the errors have been resolved.-Once the test run is successful, proceed to execute the GR/IR clearing in Update Mode.-By following these steps, you can resolve the GR/IR issues for purchase orders involving fixed assets-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing, Goods Receipt, Invoice Receipt, Fixed Assets, SAP Business ByDesign, Depreciation Calculation, Asset Valuation, Purchase Order, Accounting Errors, Valuation Check Settings.

Title: Multiple GR/IR Postings for a Single Purchase Order in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Multiple GR/IR (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) postings appear for a single purchase order (PO), leading to discrepancies or additional journal entries in the purchasing account. This issue is often due to partial deliveries or multiple invoices against the same PO.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Purchase Order and Requests work center.-Go to the Purchase Order view.-Search for the relevant purchase order.-Under the Item section, view the Document Flow.-To review GR/IR clearing details:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select GR/IR Clearing, then search for and select the relevant document.-Cause-The occurrence of multiple GR/IR postings is typically due to the following reasons:-Partial Deliveries: The supplier delivers goods in multiple shipments, leading to multiple goods receipts (GR) for the same PO.-Multiple Invoices: The supplier sends multiple invoices (IR) for these partial deliveries.-Reconciliation Process: The system automatically posts GR/IR entries to reconcile each goods receipt and invoice receipt, ensuring that quantities and values match the PO.-When multiple GRs and IRs are linked to the same PO, the system generates multiple journal entries in the purchasing account.-Resolution-In SAP Business ByDesign, the GR/IR (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) process ensures that the quantities and values of goods received (GR) match the invoices received (IR) from suppliers. When there are multiple GR/IR postings for the same inbound delivery, it typically indicates that multiple receipts or invoices were processed against the same purchase order (PO).-The GR/IR process will reconcile these goods receipts and invoice receipts to ensure that the quantities and values match the PO and actual deliveries.-Each inbound delivery and supplier invoice is linked to the PO item, allowing detailed tracking and reconciliation.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing, Goods Receipt, Invoice Receipt, Purchase Order, Partial Deliveries, Multiple Invoices, SAP Business ByDesign, Reconciliation, Purchasing Account, Journal Entries.

Title: Down Payment Request is not Automatically Included in the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-The user expected that a Down Payment Request would be automatically linked to Supplier Invoice. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Down Payment Request's ID). -Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-Invoice DEF cannot be seen (DEF is the Supplier Invoice's ID). -The Supplier Invoice is not automatically linked to the Down Payment Request. -Cause-There are specific conditions that must be met for the Down Payment Request (DPR) to be automatically linked to the Supplier Invoice (SIV). The scenarios are explained below:-The SIV has reference to a Purchase Order and the item type is 'Invoice Item' -> DPR is automatically linked. -The SIV has no reference to a Purchase Order and the item type is 'Invoice Item' -> DPR is automatically linked if its maintained data and total gross amount are the same as the Supplier Invoice. -The SIV has no reference to a Purchase Order and the item type is not 'Invoice Item' -> DPR is not automatically linked. -Please note that the balance amount is taken into consideration. For example, there is a DPR that has Paid status and an amount of 10 USD. This DPR's amount is picked by a SIV with the same amount. Now the DPR amount is zero, hence, it cannot be linked to another SIV. -Resolution-In case it is not automatically assigned, the user can still manually link the documents by following the steps below:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for DEF (the Supplier Invoice ID). -Click in Edit button.-Navigate to General tab. -Navigate to Payment Information subtab. -Navigate to Down Payments sub subtab.-Click in Add Row button. -Insert ABC (the DPR's ID). -Save it.-See Also-KBA: 1763835 - How to Remove Down Payment Request from Supplier Invoice-KBA: 3507876 - Supplier Down Payment Requests are Automatically Assigned to the Supplier Invoice Document-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Down Payment Request; Purchase Order Reference

Title: Error at Posting of Customer Invoice - Posting not possible; fixed asset 123-FA-0/set of books ABC not capitalized
Content: Symptom-An error occurs while posting a customer invoice in the source documents work center view.-The error message states: "Posting not possible; fixed asset 123-FA-0/set of books ABC not capitalized".-Note: -123 refers to the Company ID-FA-0 refers to the Fixed Asset ID-ABC refer the Set of Book ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find the customer invoice ID XYZ (XYZ refers to the Customer Invoice ID) and observe the error: "Posting not possible; fixed asset 123-FA-0/set of books ABC not capitalized".-Cause-The customer invoice XYZ includes the material YYY (YYY refers to the Individual Material ID) in the line items. The Fixed Asset FA-0 related to Individual Material YYY is retired.-Resolution-The asset needs to be capitalized to resolve this issue. Please follow the steps below to capitalize the retired fixed asset:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Filter for fixed asset with Individual Material ID YYY in the advanced filter and click Go. Here we see asset FA-0 is retired.-Click Edit > Master Data.-Navigate to the Life Cycle Data sub-tab, observe the deactivation date.-Remove the deactivation date and click Save. Close the asset.-Go to the Source Documents work center view and post the customer invoice XYZ.-Keywords-Unposted Source Document, Error, Customer Invoice, Fixed Asset, Retired, Material, Line Item, Capitalized, Posting not possible; fixed asset /set of books not capitalized.

Title: Report Material Supply and Demand List Aggregated View Not Displaying Data
Content: Symptom-The report "Material Supply and Demand List Aggregated View" not displaying demand for the future.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Find Report :SCMMSDVV01 and open it.-Set View to Detailed By Month-Filter Selections by required Supply Planning Area ID-Filter Selections by Material ID and choose Apply-Scroll out to required year in future and see the forecast stops example in next year February.-Now navigate to Supply Planning work center-Go to Maintain Demand Forecast view.-Filter again by required product ID and planning Area-Filter by Start Date from Jan 2025-See that there is a active forecast in March of 2025-However in report :SCMMSDVV01 -> forecast stops one month before i.e. February only.-Cause-Since in the material master data , the demand management procedure is maintained as consumes current forecast for all the products hence when it is being checked the quantities has been consumed already (Supply Planning -> Maintain Demand Forecast) hence the value is missing. -Resolution-This is expected system behavior-See Also-Maintain Demand Forecast , demand management procedure, consumes current forecast, SCMMSDVV01

Title: Error while uploading report
Content: Symptom-When uploading a report to target tenant an error occurs.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Download the report from Source Tenant.-Try to upload the report in Target Tenant.-You would see below errors:-         View XYZ is invalid-         Variables XYZ are invalid-         Upload failed; Raise an incident to restore the original objects-Cause-There is a bookmark present in the report in the Source Tenant.-This needs to be removed.-Resolution-Go to Source Tenant, and remove/delete this XYZ bookmark from the report.-Download the report again and upload in the Target Tenant.-Keywords-bookmark, upload, transport management, View XYZ is invalid, Variables XYZ are invalid, Upload failed; Raise an incident to restore the original objects--report upload,bookmark in report

Title: Error When Assigning an Ad-Hoc Time Account - No Account Rule Exists
Content: Symptom-You want to set up an Ad Hoc Time Account with a defined entitlement of leave per calendar year. You therefore create an Ad Hoc Time Account and a corresponding Time Type in the Business Configuration Work Center. Following the instructions of the SAP help documentation Create a New Ad Hoc Time Account you do not maintain any Time Account Rule. You then try to add the Time Account to the Time File of an employee in the Time Administration work center at the Time Profile tab. But the Account is not available for selection there, and when adding it in the Time Account Balances tab, the system throws an error message, stating that no Time Account Rule is maintained for this Time Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the respective Employee ID and choose Edit.-Select the Time Account Balances tab.-Select New to add a new Time Account.-Select the previously created Time Account Type.-Select posting type: Entitlement.-Enter the first date of the year for Validity From and Bookable From.-Enter the last date of the year for Validity To and Bookable To.-Select OK.- You receive the following error: Acct ABC with bookable period dd-mm-yyyy - dd-mm-yyyy not created; no account rule exists (ABC represents the of ID of the Time Account Type)-Cause-It is not correct to assign the Ad Hoc Time Account in the Time Account Balances Tab of the employees Time File. The Start Date of Time Account and Time Type does not match.-Resolution-Assign the Ad Hoc Time Account in the Time Profile tab, Time Account Rules subtab of the employees Time File. In addition, ensure that the Time Account has the same Valid From date as the corresponding Time Type.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview.-Find the Time Types - <country> activity and open it.-Select the Maintain Employee Time Types link.-Mark the row of the relevant Time Type.-Note down the Valid From date.-Choose Close.-Find the Time Accounts <country> activity and open it.-Select the Maintain Time Account Types link.-Mark the row of the relevant Time Account Type.- Change the Valid From date to the noted Valid From date.-Choose Save and Close.-Assigning an Ad Hoc Time Account:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the respective Employee ID and choose Edit.-Select the Time Profile tab.-Select the Time Account Rules subtab.-Select New to add a new Time Account.-Select the previously created Time Account Type.-Select posting type: Entitlement.-Enter the first date of the year for Validity From and Bookable From.-Enter the last date of the year for Validity To and Bookable To.-Select OK.-Keywords-Ad Hoc Time Account, Employee Time File, Ad-Hoc, Rules

Title: Web Service QueryAccountOpenAmountsIn is not retrieving the correct results.
Content: Symptom-Account Open Amounts web service (QueryAccountOpenAmountsIn)  is not retrieving the correct results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center > Service Explorer view-Search for QueryAccountOpenAmountsIn-Click Download WSDL-Configure the SoapUI to use the web service QueryAccountOpenAmountsIn-Enter the payload-As response, the system is not retrieving the correct information-Example of response:--<env:Envelope xmlns:env="http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope">-   <env:Header/>-   <env:Body>-      <n0:AccountOpenAmountsQueryResponse_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global" xmlns:prx="urn:sap.com:proxy:LWK:/1SAI/TAS63BA8AD59E7F8E4948CA:804">-         <ProcessingConditions>-            <ReturnedQueryHitsNumberValue>0</ReturnedQueryHitsNumberValue>-            <MoreHitsAvailableIndicator>false</MoreHitsAvailableIndicator>-         </ProcessingConditions>-      </n0:AccountOpenAmountsQueryResponse_sync>-   </env:Body>-</env:Envelope>-Cause-During web service execution, system retrieves payment agreement data from FSI view 'A1FOP_PAY_AGREE_CRED_LIM'.-This FSI view checks the default currency is maintained for the company in the org structures.--If the default currency is not maintained in the org structures for the company, then, the web service will not fetch the expected results.-   Resolution-Maintain the default currency for the affected company in the Organizational Management Work Center > Org Structures view-Keywords-web service, webservice, QueryAccountOpenAmountsIn, Query Account Open Amounts, Find accounts open amounts

Title: Dump While Posting Manual Tax Entry
Content: Symptom-Dump is thrown while trying to post a Manual VAT Entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Entries view.-Find and open the respective Manual Tax Entry.-Click Post.-Dump is thrown.-Cause-The tax code used has been created via customization (PDI). The Due Category has been defined as 2 - Receivable, but the Direction Indicator has been set as 1 - Outgoing.-Hence, while clicking Post, system triggers a backend dump with error 'Receivables Payables Entry AAA: Transaction amount does not balance to zero'. (AAA means the Manual Tax Entry ID).-Remark: the error message is only available in system backend, hence only available for SAP Support to check.-Resolution-Fix the configuration for the respective tax code in the PDI solution.-Keywords-tax code; manual tax entry; direction indicator; CM_FIA_ACC_PAYACC_IB_AGENT; Transaction amount does not balance to zero

Title: Error Message While Trying to Change the Type Category From a Time Type
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-* ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** *-Customer is receiving the Error Message below while trying to change the Type Category from a Time Type.-Category change not possible; employee time still uses time type: XYZ*-*XYZ represents the Time Type ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work Center Business Configuration and select the tab Overview.-Search for *Time Type*.-Select Configuration Element "Time Types".-Click Change immediately.-Click "Maintain Employee Time Types".-Select the Time Type XYZ and try to change the field type category.-Error message appears after try to saving the change.-Cause-Customer already created Time Recordings for the Time Type XYZ, due to that the change is not possible.-Resolution-It is the expected system behavior. If there are already existings Time Recording for the specific Time Type, the change is not possible.-Steps to check if there are Time Recording for the affected Time Type:-Access the backend.-Go to the T Code SESFTS.-TIMX_EMPLOYEE_TIME.-Query by Elements.-In Item Type content, enter the Time Type ID.-Click Ok.-You will see that there are several Time Recodings for this specific Time Type.-Keywords-Cannot, Change, Time Type, Error Message, Category change not possible, employee time still uses time type.

Title: Forecast Document Items Report Shows Message: No report data available to display; check the selection
Content: Symptom-The execution of report Forecast Document Items (Report ID FINFCDU02_Q0001) returns info message: 'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find and open report Forecast Document Items (Report ID FINFCDU02_Q0001).-Enter Company ID and Set of Books as selection data.-Click Apply to execute the report.-Notice that the report returns no results, but an info message at the page bottom:-'No report data available to display; check the selection'-Cause-The report is being executed for a set of books which is not the default set of books of the respective company. -Purchase order data would be at company code level and default set of books only, and would not flow to different set of books.-Resolution-Execute the report for the default set of books of the respective company ID.-Keywords-Forecast Document Items, FINFCDU02_Q0001, default set of books

Title: Wrong Tax Country in Sales Order With Ship-From United Kingdom
Content: Symptom-A sales order was created where the items are being shipped from United Kingdom, however, the system is determining the Seller country as the Tax Country, in this case Estonia.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the document).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select item 10.-Navigate to the Taxes tab.-The Tax Country shows EE - Estonia instead of GB - United Kingdom as it is expected.-Cause-For GB - United Kingdom, it will only be considered as a taxable country if the item net amount is less than or equal to 135 GBP (Great British Pound). -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-3047994 - BREXIT Tax Code and Tax Country Determination Northern Ireland-Keywords-Sales Order, Tax Country, Wrong, VAT, GB - United Kingdom, 135, GBP

Title: Field: Reversal of Supplier Invoice is not coming in the Standard Form Template but visible in the XML File
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-While previewing Standard Form Template of the Journal Entry Voucher the field Reversal of Supplier Invoice is missing.-In the XML file, Journal entry type: Reversal of Supplier Invoice is visible and the name is specified, but the same value have not been binded to the Standard Form Template. -You want to know how to bind this field in the Standard Form Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Statutory reports sub view.-Select the Report: Journal entry voucher.-And highlight the Run PQR, give edit. (PQR refers to Run name)-In the second step, give view results.-You will have a option Preview, select that.-Here the query is, in the UI you can see the Journal entry type as 90023 - Reversal of Supplier Invoice, but in the form template the Journal entry type is not specified.-Cause-To check this field in the XML file, please follow the below mentioned steps.-Login to the Backend.-Go to the Transaction code: SE37-Give the Function module name as FPRT_CREATE_DOCUMENT -Select Display.-Put session breakpoint at Line 34 [PERFORM render_document USING    iv_xml_data iv_form_data is_control is_options].-Now preview the form in UI.-Once another session opened in the Backend, download the XML file extension.-In the XML file, you can see the field Reversal of Supplier Invoice as given below but it was not visible in the template while previewing it in the UI.-XML File details:-</OriginalEntryDocumentReference>-<PartnerOriginalEntryDocumentID>001-000-9999</PartnerOriginalEntryDocumentID>-<BusinessTransactionDocumentNumberValue>1</BusinessTransactionDocumentNumberValue>-<AccountingDocumentPostingDate>YYYY-MM-DD</AccountingDocumentPostingDate>-<AccountingBusinessTransactionTypeCode>201</AccountingBusinessTransactionTypeCode>-<AccountingDocumentTypeCode>90023</AccountingDocumentTypeCode>-<AccountingDocumentTypeName>Reversal of Supplier Invoice</AccountingDocumentTypeName>-You couldn't able to see this field: Reversal of Supplier Invoice because in the standard form template there is not configuration/setup for this field.-Resolution-Here the data tag Reversal of Supplier Invoice is coming in XML file which is from Application side.-So in order to incorporate this field AccountingDocumentTypeName : Reversal of Supplier Invoice in the Standard Form Template, it need to enhance the form template as per requirement only by the Partner developer on customer's side.-They can do it though Adobe Lifecycle Designer. For more details please check this community link: Data Binding Basics in Print Forms-See Also-You can also refer below links:-Data Binding Basics in Print Forms-Data Binding with Repeating Items and Simple Tables in Print Forms-Data Binding with Repeating Items and Complex Tables in Print Forms-Building Tables with Scripts-https://learning.sap.com/live-sessions/print-form-adaptation-with-adobe-livecycle-designer-for-sap-sales-and-service-cloud-Keywords-Reversal of Supplier Invoice,  AccountingDocumentTypeName, Journal Entry Voucher, XML File, Standard Form Template, Statutory reports, configuration

Title: Business Task: Solve Document Inconsistency in Sales Order to Process Purchase Order Processing sent by Purchase Order.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Business task: Solve Document Inconsistency in Sales Order to Process Purchase Order Processing sent by Purchase Order XXX (XXX represents the ID of the purchase order) is in progress.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Search for Purchase Order ID XXX, there are business tasks with subject: Solve Document Inconsistency in Sales Order to Process Purchase Order Processing sent by Purchase Order XXX.-Cause-One possible reason is that system has created an intercompany sales order automatically, but it cannot find another new purchase order as reference.-Resolution-1. Check in backend with T-code: SRT_MONI. There will be XI message(s) from PurchaseOrderProcessing to SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn.-2. Check with customer if the document flow is all working well and no new sales order is expected to be created.-3. If no new sales order is expected, check with development team if the XI message(s) shall be cancelled so that system won't continue triggering the business tasks.-See Also-2925259 - Process Communication Error in Inter-company Sales Order-Keywords-Business Task; Sales Order; Purchase Order

Title: Error Message: Posting not Possible; Acq. Cost of Indiv.Mat. Less Than Trasf. Amnt
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error while posting Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material for fixed asset XYZ.-Posting not possible; acq. cost of indiv.mat. less than trasf. amnt-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Select the Fixed Asset XYZ.-You can either Edit the asset and then apply manual postings or directly access this feature by choosing Manual Posting.-Choose Partial Transfer of Individual Material.-Fill in all required parameters for amount, accounting period, and target fixed asset.-Either Post or Simulate the resulting journal entry and you get an error message.- Posting not possible; acq. cost of indiv.mat. less than trasf. amnt-Cause-The reason is due to the balance of the individual material is less than the amount being transferred, hence the partial transfer of amount for Current Year cannot be executed.-Resolution-You can check for balance for the Fixed Asset XYZ in the Fixed Assets - Line Items report and this report includes all postings for an Individual Material with posting date. Enter the correct amount for partial transfer of Individual Material.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Posting not possible; acq. cost of indiv.mat. less than trasf. amnt
