Title: Complete Execution Button Reversal
Content: Symptom-A user accidently clicked on the Complete Execution button in an item of a Sales / Service Order and you would like to reverse.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use a Service Order.-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select a line item.-Click Complete Execution.-Cause-Once the user clicks on the Complete Execution button under the Items tab, there a two possible outcomes: -Click Close button.-A Confirmation Dialog will open.-Select No.-This will close the document without saving the change performed.--Or-Save the document and the line item is completed. -Once the button is clicked and saved, no reversal can be performed as this is a confirmation that the Delivery was finished.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Service Order, Sales Order, Complete Execution, Reversal, Accident

Title: Warning Message Appears While Checking Kit Item List Consistency
Content: Symptom-You have created a Kit Item List for a Parent Kit ID -KK (KK refers to Kit ID), however when you check the consistency of the kit system throws below warning message:-Sales organisation details for item does not match with kit -KK--Or you added a new Product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID) and the following error occurs when you click on Check Consistency:-Product ID XYZ does not have active sales org matching the kit header-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to the Kit Item List view.-Choose All Kits and find the required Kit ID. (KK refers to Kit ID)-Select and Edit it.-Choose Check Consistency.-System throws above warning message.-Cause-In a Parent Kit, more than one sales organizations are maintained with distribution channel under Sales tab. However the same Sales Organizations are not updated for all Items maintained in a Kit Item List. To avoid an inconsistency the same should also be maintained in Child Kit Item List.-Resolution-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to Products View.-Choose All Products and find Parent Kit ID.-Select and Edit it.-Choose View All and navigate to Sales tab.-Here you can see many Sales Organizations for Parent Kit however same are not maintained for Kit Items in a Kit Item List.-Now go to Kit Item List view and find the required Kit ID: KK (KK refers to Kit ID).-Edit it and View All.-Here under section: Items, all kit items are available.-Open each Product ID via hyperlink.-Navigate to Sales tab and set up the Sales Organizations with Distribution Channel details same as Parent Kit ID:KK (KK refers to Kit ID).-Perform Save.-Once it is done for all Items in a sales kit, perform Check Consistency.-Keywords-Sales organisation details for item does not match with kit, Parent Kit Item, Sales Kit Item List, Sales Organizations and Product and Service Portfolio; Kit header; Kit Item; sub item; Item List; Sales Kit

Title: Project Expenses Assigned to Sales Order Item not Realized
Content: Symptom-You verify that all expenses of customer project XYZ are assigned to a sales order item (XYZ stands for the project ID).-But you still notice that one/some of these expenses appears unassigned on the Deferred Cost of Good sold account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Project Management work center go to the Invoice Preparation - Not Invoiced times and expenses view.-Find project XYZ.-Press Edit Time and Expenses.-Verify that all expenses are assigned to a sales order item. -Now check the Deferred CoGs account:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Open the Advanced search. -In the project ID field, enter XYZ and press Go.-The sales order items associated with the project XYZ appear.-Select one and press Reports and choose Sales Accruals for Project.-In the report you notice a deferred CoGs amount.-Add the Associated Sales Order and item attribute. You notice that the amount is not assigned, appearing as #.-Use further attributes and filters, such as G/L account (origin), Project task, Accounting Period/Year, Associated Source Document Type to identify where the amount originates from.-Eventually add Associated Source Document ID and filter for the document/s for which an unassigned amount appears.-Add Journal Entry type. -You notice that there is an expense assignment business transaction but also the expense assignment reversal reported even though the expense is assigned to a sales order item in Project Management.   -  Cause-The expense document has been marked as Quantity/ Expense to Be Deferred*:-Go to the Edit Time and Expenses Screen.-Select the respective expense document in the Time and Expense Items table. -Underneath, in the Details section go to the Quantity and Expense Details tab. -Here you see that the total quantity of this item appears as Quantity/ Expense to be deferred, not as Quantity to be invoiced or written off. -When an assigned expense document is marked as to be Deferred its expense assignment is reversed, so it appears as unassigned, deferred amount on the Deferred CoGs account.-Resolution-If the expense is to be realised on the expense account as well as the revenue account, enter the quantity/amount  as Quantity/Expense to Be Invoiced. -If the expense is to be only realised on the expense account, but not invoiced to the customer, enter the quantity/amount as Quantity/Expense to Be Written Off. -In both cases another expense assignment version is generated to assign the document in accounting. -The expense is realised immediately on the expense account, if no accrual method is assigned to the sales order item. Or, if an accrual method is used, the next revenue recognition run will realise the expense.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition, Sales Accruals Report, assigned expense deferred

Title: Error When Migrating Fixed Assets in the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data Tool
Content: Symptom-When trying to Migrate Fixed Assets in the system, the below error message is displayed:-'Data import of your accounting transaction data is incomplete. You can start the import once again to import the missing data'.-However, no errors are displayed in the Import Log.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the First Implementation Project.-Click on Open Activity List.-In the search field, insert Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the Unit ABC in the migration (where ABC refers to the migration unit title).-Click execute migration button.-When finishing the migration import, the import log is informing no data with the below error message:-'Data import of your accounting transaction data is incomplete. You can start the import once again to import the missing data'.-Cause-The inventory IDs maintained in the template are already being used.-Resolution-The Inventory IDs should be modified in the template, as those IDs are already maintained in the system.-To verify which Inventory IDs are required to be modified in the template, perform the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the First Implementation Project.-Click on Open Activity List.-In the search field, insert Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the Unit ABC in the migration (where ABC refers to the migration unit title).-Under details table in the Link to Import Log column, click on View Import Log for the Fixed Assets Line.-The Inventory IDs that should be modified in the template will be displayed.-Keywords-migration, inventory ID, fixed assets, byd, import log, no data

Title: Error Displayed When Trying to Replicate Employee: Time Profile Start Date Cannot Be Changed Due to Existing Employee Time Before DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-When trying to replicate an employee, the system displays the following error message:-"Time Profile start date cannot be changed, employee time exists before DD.MM.YYYY"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This issue might be occurring because the calendar currently assigned to the employee in SAP Business ByDesign is "X". However, the holiday calendar specified in the replication request from SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central is "Y".-Resolution-As per the documentation and the new holiday calendar support from SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central to SAP Business ByDesign, please refer to the following SAP Help document:-What's New in Human Resources-The provided link will help understand why the replication request currently has the holiday calendar "Y" instead of "X" for the employee.-Code mapping needs to be performed in SAP SuccessFactors to ensure that SAP Business ByDesign interprets the correct holiday calendars received from SuccessFactors Employee Central.-It is kindly suggested to map the correct external code in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central for the holiday calendar and then query this employee to ensure that the correct holiday calendars are received in the replication request.-Keywords-Replication, Employee, Start Date, Time Profile

Title: System Crashes While Posting Supplier Invoice for Custom Withholding Tax Code - India
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have created a withholding tax code for India for example Z04 and when you try to use it in supplier invoice and simulate journal entry, system dumps.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier invoice.-Select custom Withholding Tax code (For example Z02, Z04 etc).-Select Simulate Journal Entry from Actions button.-System dumps.-Cause-The dump is triggering from the application component: AP-DUE and the raising class is - CM_FIA_ACC_INVACC_IB_AGENT. In the application info, you can see the error as  - Supplier Invoice: Required entry field Withholding Tax Item Withholding Tax Rate Type Code is not filled-Tax code Z04 mapped to 606 - Withholding Tax Foreign Supplier-Tax Type - 19 - Withholding Income Tax-Tax Rate Type - 12 - PAN not quoted-Income Type - 195 - Other Sums-The tax Code Z04 is mapped to tax event 606. This tax event is mapped to tax types 19, 21 and 22. The tax code Z04 is mapped only to tax type 19. Please inform the end user that the mapping of tax types to tax code and corresponding tax event should be in sync. Also, the tax event 606 is a taxable tax event which means a rate type is necessary for all three tax types mapped to it, but the user has maintained it only for tax type 19 which is currently mapped to tax code Z04 as well as tax event 606.-19 - Withholding Income Tax-21 - EC on Income Tax-22 - SHEC on Income tax-Resolution-Map the tax types 21 and 22 to withholding tax code Z04 with proper tax rate types, the way it is configured for tax type 19. Later you will be able to post the supplier invoice without any issues.-Keywords-Required entry field Withholding Tax Item Withholding Tax Rate Type Code is not filled; Withholding Tax code; CM_FIA_ACC_INVACC_IB_AGENT; Withholding Tax code Z04, Z02

Title: Report Assignments Missing - How to Reassign Reports
Content: Symptom-Reports are missing in the Analysis work center. When you check in the Business Analytics work center, the reports have the status Unassigned.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Check the Assignment Status column.-All reports are shown as Unassigned.-Cause-The Unassign All job was triggered. This feature is available in the Design Reports work center view > Assignment Overview.-Resolution-This feature unassigns all reports from all work center views and business roles. You can use the Reassign All button to revert this, however please note the following points:-You can only reassign standard reports. Custom and mobile reports have to be assigned manually.-You can only reassign reports to work center views. Assignments to business roles will have to be done manually.-For this reason, if you have dashboards and KPIs which are based on report assignments to business roles, these will need to be redone manually.-Please also note that the Unassign All feature cannot be used selectively. Hence unassigning reports is only possible for each report separately or for all reports in one go.-PLEASE NOTE --> SAP Product Support cannot restore the original assignments to custom reports and they must be done manually.-Keywords-Unassign all, reassign all, report assignments, business roles, work center views, assign reports

Title: Municipality Code in Brazil
Content: Symptom-The maintained municipality code does not appear in the drop-down list while defining the ISS rate for the service code. (Brazil)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration - Overview view.-Search for activity Tax on Goods and Services - Brazil.-Open 'Define Tax Municipalities'.-Add a Municipality Code 1111111(1111111 represents the municipality code)-However, when open 'Define ISS Rates for Service Codes'.-Add row.-No items in the dropdown list.-Cause-The relevant data in settings 'Define Service Codes - Incoming/Outgoing' is not maintained.-Resolution-Maintain the relevant data in settings 'Define Service Codes - Incoming/Outgoing'. Then the code can be selected in the 'Define ISS Rates for Service Codes' view.-Go to Business Configuration - Overview view.-Search for activity Tax on Goods and Services - Brazil.-Open 'Define Service Codes - Incoming/Outgoing'.-Add relevant information for the Municipality code 1111111.-Keywords-Municipality Code, ISS Rate for the Service Code

Title: Payment Run ID with wrong Payee Bank Information
Content: Symptom-Using the work center Payables you created a Payment Run which generated Payment Proposals. Once opening these payment proposals on the Automatic Payments view you noticed the Payee Bank Information is not the one you are expecting to see. The system is ignoring the main bank concept.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In order to see the Payment Run ID you can use the underneath steps:-Go to Payables work center-Select the Periodic Tasks view-And click on Payment Runs-Search your ID reference and Go-Under the Execution Details information-Show the All Logs option-Click on the application log number-And select the Results tab-Find for your supplier name and for the payment proposal ID-Steps to see the Payee Bank Information of the payment proposal created through the Payment Run:-Go to Payables work center-Select Automatic Payments view-Show All Payment Proposals option-Search for the Payment Proposal ID and open it-On the Payee Bank Information is possible see the Bank Account Number ABC. -You are not expecting to see the Bank Account Number ABC on this payment proposal, but the Bank Account Number 123 as it is the main account for this supplier.-Here the steps to see the supplier master data bank account details:-Go to Supplier Base work center-Select Suppliers view-Search for the supplier name or ID and Go-Select the supplier and click on Edit Financial Data-Select the Bank Data tab-TheBank Account Number ABC is maintained on the Supplier Master Data in the first line.-The Bank Account Number 123 is maintained on the Supplier Master Data in the second line.-Cause-System is picking for the Payee Bank Information the account which is maintained in the first line. If the main bank account is maintained in the second line system will choose the bank maintained in the first line ignoring the Main bank concept.-Resolution-Development team confirmed it is not always the case that the first bank account is picked in the proposal and currently there is no logic on the code perspective to pick it in a certain manner for customers. This issue is already known to development.-The only workaround available is to have only one account for the Supplier.-  See Also-Incident 3100816826 is the same scenario for Employee Payment Run.-Keywords-Payee, Bank, Payment Run ID,

Title: The Withholding Tax Net Base Amount Differs In Supplier Invoice And Outgoing Payment
Content: Symptom-For supplier invoice view and outgoing payment view, the withholding tax net base amount is not the same, and has a small difference of decimal places.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First check the supplier invoice view:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for invoice: AAA (AAA represents the invoice ID).-Go to General tab - Taxes tab - Withholding Tax Details.-The tax net base amount is 123(123 represents the tax net base amount).-Then check the outgoing payment view:-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to Payment Monitor view, search for payment: CCC (CCC represents the outgoing payment ID).-Go to Open Item tab, can see tax net base amount is 456(456 represents the tax net base amount).-The tax net base amount is different, and only has a small difference of decimal places.-Cause-The payment and supplier invoice documents are applied to different tax amount calculation logic. The supplier invoices in Business ByDesign contain aggregated tax amounts at the document level. The payment in Business ByDesign contain aggregated tax amounts at the item level. This may result in rounding differences between the tax amount calculated at the document level and item level total tax amount. The reason behind this difference is that unlike the document level, item level tax amounts are calculated as per each line item and rounded off to relevant decimal places. This method has been chosen because it is used by accounting. -Ideally, in an accounting software, each line item is posted to general ledger separately and hence, tax amounts need to be rounded off at line item level. On the other hand, since tax authorities accept both methods of calculating tax amounts, suppliers choose to calculate and pay tax applicable to the total net price i.e. the document level tax amount. This might result in some difference between the document and the item level tax amounts. The system ensures that the total tax paid on an invoice at the end should be same as the tax amount of the actual invoice prepared by the supplier. If this difference is not distributed at the item level, it can cause discrepancies between the taxes that are being paid to the relevant tax authorities and the taxes that were declared and therefore, a supplier might end up paying less or more taxes to the tax authorities.--In order to maintain this sanity with respect to accounting, the system is designed using a certain set of rules that try to equalize the document and the item level taxes. These rules are called the rules of tax difference distribution.-Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-supplier invoice, outgoing payment, withholding tax, net base amount

Title: How to Prevent System from Automatically Printing Delivery Note after Releasing the Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-After releasing an outbound delivery, a delivery note is printed automatically. Open the outbound delivery and go to Output History tab, there is a delivery note which is created by the system. You want to know how to prevent system from automatically printing the delivery note.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the relevant Outbound Delivery ID.-Click Edit button.-Go to Output History tab and then see the delivery note.-Cause-For Delivery Note, the output channel rule has been configurated as "Printer" only. At the same time, the question "Do you want to send the process-integrated output documents via multiple output channels?" is unchecked in system Business Configuration.-A delivery note will generate when releasing an Outbound Delivery.-As a results, the system will output the delivery note via printer automatically after releasing the Outbound Delivery.-Resolution-Firstly, scope multi-channel for output generation.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view-Select the project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Open the Elements under the Path: Communication and Information Exchange -> Business Process Management -> Process-Integrated Input and Output Management.-In the group Enabling Multichannel for Document Output, activate the following question: Do you want to send the process-integrated output documents via multiple output channels?-Secondly, define "Do not send" Output Channels for Delivery Note.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Output Channel Selection view.-Show results for Delivery Note.-Click Go.-Click New.-Click Add Row.-Select Do not send in Output Channel.-Click Save and close.-After done above steps, the printing delivery note action will not be automatically performed by the system.-See Also-2911155 - How to Define Multiple Output Channels-Keywords-Output Channels, Delivery Note, Print, Outbound Delivery, Printer, Outbound Logistics, Output History

Title: Authorization of the Business User is Deleted by Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM) automatically
Content: Symptom- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--You found the Access Right changes for the Business User and the changes automatically done by Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Woc-Select Business User View-search for the business user and select Edit Access Rights-Navigate to Changes Tab--Now, you can find access rights is deleted by Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM) in the change log.-Cause-In business configurations, the functionality requiring the removal of all access rights for any user which has run out of validity is marked. When the user became invalid, a background job removed all the access rights of the user.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-You can verify the issue from:-Go to Business Configuration Woc-Select Implementation Projects  View-Highlight the project and select Edit Project Scope-Navigate to Questions Built-in Services and Support > System Management > User and Access Management > Group: Remove authorization for invalid users: Do u want to remove substitutions and authorizations for users whose validity date is in the past.-Keywords-Access Rights, SAP_SYSTEM, Technical User(SAP_SYSTEM), Changes, User Chnages, User Access Rights, Business User

Title: Error When Trying to Edit the Project Scope in the Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit the Project or Open the Activity List, however the following error appears:-Value XYZ in setting A1S_FIN_MOVTYDETIAC_GLMOVTTDMA must also be entered in setting A1S_FIN_MOVTYDETFIAC_GLMOVTTDM-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Then go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the required Project.-Click Edit Project Scope or Open Activity List.-Error occurs.-Cause-Such issue might occurs after deploying a PDI and the scoping option related to Consolidation Preparation was not scoped.-Resolution-You need to first first scope Consolidation Preparation and then deploy the add-on.-Keywords-Value, in setting A1S_FIN_MOVTYDETIAC_GLMOVTTDMA, must also be entered in setting A1S_FIN_MOVTYDETFIAC_GLMOVTTDM, Business Configuration, Implementation Projects, Edit Project Scope, Open Activity List, PDI.

Title: Payment Currency in the Expense Report is not as Expected
Content: Symptom-Create an expense report for employees hired in a Hong Kong company with an expense amount in currency HKD. Upon saving, the currency of the reimbursement amount changes to a different currency, such as USD.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the Expense Reports view.-Select and edit the respective expense report.-See the payment currency is USD.-Cause-In the example of Hong Kong, which is a non-localized country/region, the assigned default currency is maintained as USD: -To verify:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Create New Country/Region Version activity. -For country/region Hong Kong, the default currency is USD.-Resolution-If there are expense reports exist in the system for this company, it is not possible to change the currency in the UI. If changes required, create a case to Support Team for backend adjustments.-See Also-KBA 2690313 - Display Currency in the report is not as Expected-KBA 1625369 - How System Determines Default Currency in Expense Report-KBA 2741128 - Currency Derivation for Expense Report Payments -Keywords-Expense Report, Currency

Title: YXXXXXXX default Business Option not visible in Production system
Content: Symptom-After deploying the solution to the production system,the YXXXXXXX default Business Optionis not visible.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to "Business Configuration" work center and click "Implementation Projects" and select "First Implementation".-Click "Open Activity list".-Select "All activies" in the drop down.-Search for "YXXXXXXX: default Business Option.-No records found.-Cause-When you create a solution some default with YXXXXXXX options also get created in the backend. These default options are only meant for testing activities when a BAC file is not yet created in solution in SDK.-The whole purpose of these default options is to allow user for testing the functionally of their solution in the test tenant without having/scoping a BAC file.  This is the expected behavior the default option. YXXXXXXX: default Business Option are not able to see in the production system and is never created in production system. This is only created in test system until BAC does not exist.-Resolution-Before deploying the solution to Production tenant it is mandatory for the user to create BAC file in the test system and then scope this custom option in the UI to use the functionality.-Logon to frontend UI.-Navigate to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the project and click on the button Edit Project Scope.-Check in the Scoping tab whether the relevant node is scoped or not, if not scope it.-Go to the Questions tab, find the relevant element, expand and find out the question which you find out in the step 1.-You can see that for this question the check box is not selected.-Inform the key user to select the check box for the question and complete the scoping.-See Also-Also refer KBA -  2294617 - How to Change the Fine Tuning Activity Name From Solution: Default Business Option-Keywords-default option,Not Visible, Cannot See, Missing, Scope

Title: Time Profile of an Employee Cannot be Changed After Extention of Employee Contract
Content: Symptom-Time Profile of an employee cannot be changed after the extension of an employee contract.-Business Requirement: In the Personnel File of an employee the Termination Date has been changed to a later date. Now you want to create a new Time Profile with an End Date matching the newly created Termination Date. But the original End Date of the existing Time Profile cannot be overwritten.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Time Administration work center.-2. Select the Employees view.-3. Mark the affected employee and choose the Edit button.-4. Go to the Time Profile tab.-5. Add Row to create a new Time Profile.-6. The existing End Date cannot be overwritten and no Time Profile with new End Date can be created.-Cause-There is a pending task for the employee in the system which should be completed to reflect the changes in Time Profile End Date for this employee.-Resolution-1. Go to Time Administration and select Work view.-2. Search the Employee ID.-3. Open Task: Review Time Data (Correction of Hire Date) for the employee.-4. Complete the task.-Keywords-Employee Contract, Extension, Termination Date, Overwrite

Title: PCE Error On Customer Invoice: Net Amount Is Not Equal To The Total Amount Determined
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -A Process Communication Error on customer invoice displays as: Net amount is not equal to the total amount determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Process Communication Errors view.-Select "Open Error with Incidents".-Search for the affected customer invoice ID and click on go.-An error displays as: Net amount is not equal to the total amount determined.-Cause-The PCE is reasonable.-When looking into the change log, the totals are being changed as well as taxes.-On checking the change history, the net amount has been changed by business user.-Since the net amount cannot be edited from UI, this caused the PCE on Invoice.-Resolution-First cancel the XI message from backend. After that, there will be no process communication error for the invoice.-Then ask customer to recreate the customer invoice without changing the amounts.-Keywords-net amount, total amount determined, PCE error, customer invoice

Title: Error Occurs in the File Input Run for the Customer Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-Error occurs in the File Input Runs for the customer invoice requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to File Input view.-Select the Execution Details tab.-At Show field, select the option Last 100 Logs.-Open the application log XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the application log).-Select the Results tab.-Error appears:  Length of unit exceeds maximum length "3", specified with maxLength while converting XML to data type for document.-Follow the steps below to check if the invoice requests are created for the File Input Runs:-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show Inconsistent Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the external invoice request).-You can find the invoice requests created for the file input run are in erroneous status.-Following error messages appear:-Mandatory List Price missing.-Error during product specific quantity conversion.-Combination of product and quantity unit does not exist.-Cause-In the Invoice Requests all errors are from Quantity Type Code and the List Price because:-You have not maintained the List Price of the products in the excel template which is mandatory.-Though you have entered a valid Quantity Type Code but the UoM you have entered is not correct (UoM represents Unit of Measure).-Resolution-When you create the excel and convert it into XML, please make sure that you enter the List Price for each item and correct UoM of the product in the excel.-Also, if you want to enter other UoM for the Product you should maintain the Quantity conversion in the product itself.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio workcenter.-Go to the Products view.-Edit the Product.-Add the Quantity Conversion.-Save the changes.-Keywords-file input run, customer invoice request, invoice request, length of unit exceeds maximum length, specified with maxLength while converting xml to data type for document, inconsistent, quantity conversion, list price, quantity

Title: Mass Removal of Purchase Request Line Items not Possible
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase request for wrong products. You want to know, is it possible to delete or remove several purchase request line items in one go?--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Requests view-Select the relevant Purchase Request-Select Edit & navigate to Items tab-You do not have option for mass removal of items or delete action for the multiple line items at a time-Cause-In the current release, it is not possible to remove the line items with multiple selections. Hence mass removal or deletion of line items is not possible. -Resolution-The behavior requires a major changes in the software coding and can be taken as a new requirement. Hence I kindly request you to post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -Keywords-Mass removal of purchase request items; Mass deletion of purchase request items

Title: Overlapping Number Ranges at Check Lot ID GHI
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a new Check Lot to Bank ABC, errors are raised when saving. (ABC stands for the Bank ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Open My Banks view.-Open Bank ABC.-Go to Bank Accounts tab.-On Bank Account Number DEF, click on Check Lot tab. (DEF stands for the Bank Account Number)-Click on Add Row and fill all the relevant data.-When saving, errors are raised:-"Save Failed"-"Overlapping number ranges at check lot ID GHI" (GHI stands for the Check Lot ID)--Cause-The issue happens because in the desired number range for the created Check Lot ID GHI, there are one or more check numbers that occurs to be part of another Check Lot ID number range that already have a posted check.-Example scenario for check lots (Check numbers here are just an example for illustrating):-Check Lot JKL:-   First Check: 100-   Last Check: 200-Check Lot GHI:-   First Check: 1-   Last Check: 500-(GHI and JKL stands for the check lot IDs)-Here, there is an overlapping of the Check Lots. Checks from number 100 to 200 are within the number range of GHI - 1 to 500. Even if the previous Check Lot is Blocked, system will not allow to use checks that are within that range.-Resolution-The existing Check Lot can be splitted into a new one, through the following path:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Open My Banks view.-Open Bank ABC.-Go to Bank Accounts tab.-On Bank Account Number DEF, click on Check Lot tab. (DEF stands for the Bank Account Number)-Select Check Lot ID GHI and click on Split Check Lot.-On the screen that pops up, on Check Lot: Insert the new Check Lot ID. On the Check Number: Insert the number of the first check that needs to be assigned (In this case, 100) and click on OK.-See Also-Check Lots and Check Numbers for Outgoing Checks-Keywords-Overlapping number ranges at check lot, check lot

Title: Statistical Time Account is Missing in the Employee Time Statement
Content: Symptom-The Employee Time Statement doesn't include a Statistical Time Account. Therefore, it's required to add it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Timesheet view-Search Employee ID.-Select Time Statement button.-The Statistical Time Account data is missing from Time Statement for the employee.-Cause-The Employee Time Statement displays only Quota and Working Time Account details. Statistical Account information cannot be found in this report.-Resolution-Documentation for the Time Account addition process is not available. This process is populated by default according to standard settings.-Keywords-Statistical Time Account, Employee Time Statement, Missing

Title: How to create a Supplier as Natural Person.
Content: Symptom-In the Business Partners view of Information Lifecycle Management work center, when filtering the data for suppliers, only natural person supplier will be listed. This KBA explains how to create a Supplier as natural person.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Business Partner work center.-Go to Supplier view.-Click New -> Supplier.-Click View All.-Fill in the mandatory information.-Check the checkbox Non-Company.-Click Save.-Or it is also possible to change an existed Supplier to natural person as following:-Go to Business Partner work center.-Go to Supplier view.-Select the existed Supplier.-Click Edit -> General.-Click View All.-Check the checkbox Non-Company.-Click Save.-Keywords-Supplier, Natural Person

Title: The report Recorded in Employee Times is showing 2 entries for an Employee XYZ
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-* ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** *-You can observe that in Time Administration report for "Recorded Employee Times" is showing 2 entries for an Employee XYZ for vaccation on DD/MM/YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center -Select Reports view  -Select Recorded Employee Times Report view -Search for the Employee XYZ -We can see there are two entries (duplicate entry) for the vaccation on DD/MM/YYYY -Cause-Due to inconsistencies on replication of data from backend to "Recorded Employee Times" report.-Resolution-Due to the two entries in the FSI persistency. A FSI reload is required-Follow the below steps for a reloading FSI :-1. Logon to Backend-2. Use the transaction GFSSTM-2. Fill the details :-    Fast Search View : /APC/FSP_TIMITEM-    Business Object : TIMX_EMPLOYEE_TIME ITEM-    Node : ITEM-3. Click on Execute-4. Select the field TIMX_EMPLOYEE_TIME ITEM >> ITEM and reload the Persistance value-This should resolve the unexpected values in the system.-Keywords-FSI Reload, Recorded Employee Times Report, TIMX_EMPLOYEE_TIME ITEM, GFSSTM, /APC/FSP_TIMITEM

Title: Extension FIeld Added Via Easy Form Editor Does Not Show Data
Content: Symptom-You have added an extension field to a form template table using the built-in Easy Form Editor. However despite being correctly included, the field displays no data in the final document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Form Template Maintenance view.-Search and select the desired template where the field must be added.-Click on the Open button.-Click on Easy Form Editor.-In the Sections Panel, expand a table section of the form (tables are named with a "tbl" prefix).-Click on the Columns section.-A new panel will open below with the section details. Click on the Add button.-Click on Field.-A popup will appear showing the fields available. Use the arrow buttons to add the necessary field.-Click on Ok in the popup.-Click on Save in the Easy Form Editor.-Click on Publish.-After generating a preview of a document using the edited form, the field does not display data.-Cause-The field has an incorrect binding created by Easy Form Editor. This can be seen when opening the template in Adobe LiveCycle Designer.-The Easy Form Editor is meant to be used to perform small changes in the form templates, such as titles, labels, which columns will be displayed in a table, etc. The Easy Form Editor may not be reliable to add extension fields to a table section.-Resolution-You can use the Adobe LiveCycle Designer in order to add the extension fields to the form template, and properly control the binding of the data.-Keywords-ALD, Easy Form Edior, Form Template, Output

Title: Creation of Extension Field in New Project Stock Order under Projects
Content: Symptom-Unable to add the extension field to the Project Stock Order pop-up window.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for Project ID ABC (ABC represents Project ID).-Choose Edit.-Go to Products tab.-Go to Product Overview sub-tab.-Select Product.-Choose Create Project Stock Order button.-Pop up window opens of new project stock order-Creation of an extension field is not supported in the pop-up window.-Cause- This is the current system behaviour.-Resolution-This can be considered as a new requirement.-An enhancement request can be submitted through the SAP Influence Portal - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -This is the official channel for proposing and tracking new feature requirements.-Keywords-Extension Field; Project stock order

Title: Error 'Communication Party does not exist' is Thrown When Migrating Suppliers / Customers
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate suppliers / Customers using migration mode 'Enhance Already Existing Records', but you get an error at Simulation step stating: 'Communication party does not exist'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Suppliers / Customers-Click on it and open the migration tool.-Change the migration mode to 'Enhance Already Existing Records' and add your template.-Execute migration.-The error is thrown at the Simulation step.-Cause-You are trying to modify already existing records, in this case Collaboration data, but you are using migration mode: 'Enhance Already Existing Records'. There is Collaboration data for the supplier / Customer that you are trying to modify.-Note: Enhancement mode at migration is for existing suppliers with initial data only.-Resolution-Migration mode 'Enhance Already Existing Records' should only be used for existing suppliers where you are trying to add new transactional data (such as Collaboration data).-If you are trying to modify already existing Collaboration data, please use Mass Data Maintenance following the steps below,-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select link for Export Suppliers.-Add the required materials and select Ok.-Go to Collaboration tab.-Select <Export> for the columns which needs change.-Select Export Data to CSV File button.-In the excel file, change/add the values for those fields and save the changes, and close the file.-Close the Export of Suppliers screen.-Select link for Import Suppliers in Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Upload the file and execute the data import.-The described work around will only work if the you are using the single channel settings for the collaboration data. When using Multi-Channel settings, neither the migration with mode “Enhance Already Existing Records” nor the mass data maintenance allows updating these settings.-Collaboration Data and Migration/Mass Data Maintenance-Customer (Single Channel)-1-Migration-Add New Record-ok-  2-Migration-Enhance Existing Record-ok-If the collaboration record to be added does not yet exist-3-Mass Data Maintenance-  ok-For existing entries, it is not possible to add “new” entries, use (2) for this- Customer (Multi-Channel)-1-Migration-Add New Record-ok-  2-Migration-Enhance Existing Record-ok-If the collaboration record to be added does not yet exist, not possible to add further channels to existing collaboration.-3-Mass Data Maintenance-  Not ok-Mass data maintenance does not support multi-channel; for this you need to use the web service- For (3): remove the sheets from “mass data maintenance” for multi-channel-Supplier (Single)-1-Migration-Add New Record-ok-  2-Migration-Enhance Existing Record-no-Currently Not supported-(as LCTI needs to be true, i.e. delete existing data;  would need to send all data.- Gives an error when trying to add channels to existing documents and when adding new document)-3-Mass Data Maintenance-  Ok-Existing entries can be changed (channel, email, fax number..)- Supplier (Multi-Channel)-1-Migration-Add New Record-ok-  2-Migration-Enhance Existing Record-no-Currently Not supported-(as LCTI needs to be true, i.e. delete existing data;  would need to send all data.- Gives an error when trying to add channels to existing documents and when adding new document)-3-Mass Data Maintenance-  Not ok-Mass data maintenance does not support multi-channel; for this you need to use the web service- Keywords-Suppliers, Migration, Mass Data Maintenance-mass data maintenance,collaboration data,communication party does not exist

Title: How To Move Unconsumed Material Of Project Stock to Warehouse?
Content: Symptom-How to move unconsumed material of project stock to warehouse?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Go to Project Stock order view-Search for the relevant Project Stock order-Choose edit -Can see the Project Stock order is status "In Process"-Order X quantity of material-Consumed only Y quantity of material-Expect(X-Y=Z), unconsumed Z quantity of material to move to warehouse (i.e. Here X,Y,Z are quantity of materials)-Cause-Since the satuts of the project stock order is "In Process", so the unconsumed quantities of the material remain in project.-Resolution-Once the Project Stock order is completed the remaining unconsumed quantities is being updated to the warehouse.-Keywords-Project stock order; Unconsumed material; Project-project stock order,unconsumed material,project

Title: Product List is not available while adding Products in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add products in your Sales Order using Product List but the expected Product List is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Click New Sales Order and fulfill the necessary data in General tab.-Navigate to Products tab.-Click on the Chevron and Select Add from List-Expected Product List  is not Displayed even if it is active and available in the Product Lists View.-Cause-If the Product List maintained is not valid to the account you are using in the Sales Order ,then the Product List will not be available.-Resolution-Go to Products Work Center-Go to Product Lists View-Find for the Product List and Open it-Navigate to Accounts Tab-Add the Expected Account for which you want the Product List to be valid-If you want the Product List to be available for all the Accounts , you have to mark the Valid for All Accounts in the Header of the Product List.-Keywords-Products, Sales Order, Byd

Title: Error : Authorization role missing for service : ServiceInterface
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-While Consuming Custom Webservice via SOAP UI, the following error is being raised:-Authorization role missing for service: ServiceInterface XYZ, where XYZ is the service interface name.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open SOAP UI.-Load the WSDL for the respective service to a new project.-Select the operation and generate the request.-Enter the request XML.-Maintain the Authentication details.-Execute and you get the error in the Results window.-Cause-There could be multiple reasons for this error:-Case 1: If the authentication method is via work center view and the required work center views are not assigned to the user.-Case 2: If the authentication method is via communication arrangement and the customer is not using the technical user maintained in communication arrangement to consume the service in web service.-Case 3: If the RBAM policies are not generated correctly for the user in backend.-Resolution-The resolution for the above mentioned 3 cases are:-Case 1: Check and suggest the customer to assign the required work center views to the users.-Case 2: Check and suggest the customer to use the correct user ID and password of the technical user maintained in the communication arrangement of the web service.-Case 3: You can perform following steps:-Login to the backend tenant.-Go to SRBAM transaction code.-Check that the policies are generated correctly under RBAM Explain.-If not, click on the RBAM policy generation link.-Execute and generate the policies.-Keywords-error, consuming, inbound, cannot, execute, SOAP, PDI, SDK, WS-pdi

Title: Error In Availability Check Of Customer Demand Released With Stock Check
Content: Symptom-You released a customer demand with stock check. However, when you try to perform Post Goods Issue or confirm the pick task, the system displays no stock available error message. -Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Delivery Proposals view. -Select the relevant delivery proposal and choose the Post Goods Issue button. -While trying to save the Goods Issue, the system displays information that there is no Stock for the relevant product. -You are not sure why this happened as you had released the customer demand with stock check and the system released it without errors. -Cause-When the customer demand is released the system does not perform a hard block on the stock that was confirmed for the customer demand.-If there is an execution document like a make task, requires the stock of the product the system will allocate the stock from inventory to that execution document. -There will be a hard block on the stock allocated to a customer demand only when a warehouse request is created against the demand.-It could so happen that an execution document was allocated the stock was planned for the customer demand. -Resolution-If there is no warehouse request created against the customer demand the system will allocate the free stock to another execution document which requires the stock. -Keywords-Availability check error, Issues in availability check, ATP issues,

Title: You Noticed the Search Is Not Working Properly When Using the Search to Find Documents in Hebrew
Content: Symptom-You are using the system in Hebrew and noticed that when using the Searching or Filter function in the system, the result is not the same one as in English.-For example, you are searching for  Tasks in the system and you noticed that a few Tasks are not appearing when searching in Hebrew.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Access the system in Hebrew.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Task Management view.-Show All Tasks.-Search for the ID XYZ.-The document with ID XYZ does not appear.-Cause-Currently, this is the expected system behavior as the document was not created or maintained in the language Hebrew. As the document is only stored in English, the search does not find the ID in Hebrew.-Resolution-You would need to maintain the description in the required language code to get these results in Hebrew or any other language.-Keywords-Search, Filter, Not Working, Hebrew, English, Missing, Not Showing, Language, English.

Title: Release sap_byd 1234 of solution is not compatible with system.
Content: Symptom-Release SAP_BYD 1234 of solution is not compatible with system.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK of the target tenant-Upload the solution-Deployment failes with the mentioned error-Cause-You have attempted to deploy solution which has been assembled in previous release. Tenant on to which you wish to deploy the solution is however on higher release.-Deployment landscape, as per SAP system architecture operates in the following way: Deployment of solution works only if solution is being deployed on a system which is n+2 releases from the one on which .zip file has been created (meaning solution has been assembled)-This means that for example, a PDI solution got downloaded from a tenant with release 2102. This solution can be uploaded to a tenant with release 2102, 2105 and 2108. The upload will fail on a system with release 2011 (lower release) and 2111 (3 releases ahead).-Resolution-Login to the SDK with TEST tenant URL -Go to implementation manager tab-Go to Current Version Tab-Click Assemble & Download button-Re-upload the new download button-See Also-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_CLOUD_APPLICATIONS_STUDIO/cbcebe3cfb1647a8b0322c18dbb0b481/73ae01a173e210148794d5a02b1f9317.html?q=Solution%20version%20upload-Keywords-Release SAP_BYD of solution is not compatible with system, solution deployment failed, previous release, higher release

Title: The Lookup Button in the Microsoft Excel Template 'Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel®'
Content: Symptom-When clicking the Lookup button in the Microsoft Excel Template 'Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel®', the Journal Entry Type '00088' is not the list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Click New->Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel® and you will download the template.-Open the excel template.-In the template, click the cell below Journal Entry Type field.-Go to SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN Excel tab.-Under Workbook section, click Lookup button.-Click Search button.-Journal Entry Type 00088 is not in the list.-Cause-Since 'Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel®' is a specific template for Journal Entry Document type 00088, the lookup button is not applicable here. -Resolution-For template 'Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel®', the lookup button will get disabled in the future.-See Also-Upload a Journal Entry Voucher | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel®, Journal Entry Type '00088', Manual Journal Voucher

Title: Dump While Selecting the Expense Type in the Expense Report
Content: Symptom-System crashes when selecting the Expense Type in an Expense Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view.-Create New Expense Report.-When select "Expense Type: XYZ", system crashes.-(XYZ represents the expense type ID.)-Error message：-"Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-Details-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Response-500 SAP Internal Server Error-500 SAP Internal Server Error"-Cause-The dump is there because of assertion condition violation.-Delimited tax group 05 [Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope)] used while creating the custom expense types.-Resolution-It is recommended to use tax group 02 [Domestic acquisition (exempt)] instead, while creating the custom expense types, since the prior one(tax group 05 [Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope)] has been delimited.-Follow the below steps to change the tax code group from 05 to 02:-Go to Business Configuration work center - Overview.-Search for Activity: Expense Reporting - ABC (ABC represents the country name.).-Go to Edit expense types.-Select Expense Type: XYZ.-Under tab Definition, and see: Tax Code Group: Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope).-Use tax code 02 -Domestic acquisition (exempt), instead of tax code 05 -Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope).-Keywords-Internal Server error, Expense Report, Dump

Title: User Cannot See Employee Time Records From Service Agents
Content: Symptom-The user is trying to view employee time records from service agents, but the system is only displaying time records from regular employees.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Employee Time Records View.-In the Employee Name, put filter for the required Service Agent.-No results.-Cause-The Employee Time records View does not show service agent time recordings for a Key user.  It only shows for internal users. It shows for the support user as the support user does not require an authorization context, so this user has the ability to show all employees.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The development team will evaluate this scenario further and the system behavior might be changed in future releases.-Keywords-Employee Time Records, Cannot, Unable, Find, Service Agents, Key User.-The user is attempting to view employee time records from service agents, but the system is only displaying time records from regular employees.

Title: Time Out Error While Performing Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-When trying to performing Post Goods Receipt system throws time out error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Find the relevant Purchase Order ID.-Choose Post Goods Receipt-System throws time out error.-Cause-Due to the large number of line items in the purchase order, the processing time is prolonged and may result in a timeout error.-This issue is caused by a limitation in the Inbound delivery system, which only allows a maximum of 50 line items.-Resolution-It is recommended to create multiple inbound deliveries. This will help in dividing the line items and carrying out post goods receipts more efficiently.-Keywords-time out, post goods receipt, inbound delivery, purchase order

Title: No Option To Define Right To Left In Broadcast Reports
Content: Symptom-When you create a new broadcast, there is no option to define that the report will display right alignment for the column text. This functionality is known as RTL (Right to Left).-You might need to use this text alignment for the language Hebrew, for instance.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Go to the Broadcast view.-Create a new broadcast for the required report.-There is no way to set RLT within the broadcast options.- Cause-Currently, we do not support RTL in broadcasting.-Resolution-An alternate solution would be to open the system link provided in the broadcast or only send the link, as RTL is supported when the report opens in Excel or in the browser.-Keywords-RTL;broadcast; right alignment, report, business analytics,

Title: How to Resolve Incomplete Tasks of Payment Advice, Incoming Check and Check Deposit.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-There are some Incomplete BTM Tasks that should have been completed automatically once the Payment Advice or Check Deposit is Confirmed. However, the task still has the status as In Process although no action is required for such tasks. There is no option to complete these tasks from the UI. The following list of tasks are affected due to this issue.-Process Check Deposit with Overdue Bank Confirmation.-Process Check Deposit with Overdue Transfer.-Process Overdue Incoming Checks.-Process Overdue Advice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center General Ledger.-Go to View Closing Cockpit.-Go to Subview Closing Relevant Tasks.-You will find the Incomplete tasks for Payment Advice, Incoming Check and Check Deposit.-Cause-Whenever the check deposit is released and set to In Transfer, System creates task to notify the users that it should be included in the Bank Statement to complete the process. These tasks should be finished automatically once the check deposit is confirmed in the Bank Statement.-Due to an underlying issue, these tasks could not be completed automatically. This issue has now been resolved. For existing documents, however, we need to execute a backend report to finish all such tasks.-Resolution-You have to take permission from the customer to perform the backend correction to complete these tasks. We need to execute the backend report FOP_REPAIR_UNCOMPLETED_TASKS which completes incomplete tasks for 3 objects: Payment Advice, Incoming Check and Check Deposit.-Note: This report completes incomplete tasks for all 3 objects: Payment Advice, Incoming Check and Check Deposit. If the customer has reported an issue just for one object, then you can inform the customer that the report will clear all the inconsistent tasks related to all the 3 objects.-Backend Report Details.-While you execute the Backend Report : FOP_REPAIR_UNCOMPLETED_TASKS, you will get the following options to execute the report.-SHOWINC - This option will show you the list of incomplete tasks. It will only show the UUIDs for all the tasks. You can execute the report with the option to find out the list of incomplete tasks first. After executing the report in the correction mode, you can again execute the report to verify that all the tasks have been completed.-CORRINC- This report will complete all the tasks for 3 objects as described above.-SELINC -This report is used to select the task based on UUIDs. You don’t have to use this option for this issue.-Backend Report Execution Steps-Login into Backend.-Go to Transaction se38.-Enter the report FOP_REPAIR_UNCOMPLETED_TASKS and click on Execute.-4.Select the SHOWINC and click on Execute.-  5. It will show the list of Task and then click on Back.-6. Now Select the CORRINC and click on Execute.-7. Again select the SHOWINC and click on Execute.-8. You should not get any Inconsistent Task.-All the Inconsistent Tasks have been resolved now, you can close the case.-Keywords-Payment Advice; Incoming Check; Check Deposit; Transfer; Bank Confirmation; Closing Cockpit; Closing Relevant Tasks; Incomplete;

Title: No Purchase Proposal is Generated By Automated Run
Content: Symptom-The system is currently not generating a purchase proposal ID, which is causing an issue in generating purchase requests through the automated purchase proposal run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control workcenter-Go to Automated Actions view and select Release Purchase Proposal Runs sub view.-Edit the required Run ID.-Under Selection Criteria, open the  required Application log.-Under general tab, there shows "Number of selected purchase proposals is 0 ".-Then go to Supply Control work center and select Monitor Purchase Requests view.-Search for relevant purchase request ID.-Here no corresponding purchase request generated against the required product.-Cause-The reason for this issue is that the product's master data shows that the procurement type is Internal Procurement instead of External Procurement for the planning area in question.-Additionally, the planning procedure is set to manual planning. This means that purchase proposals for this product need to be created manually. To release the manually created purchase proposal, it can be done through a release run, which will then release it to a purchase request.-Resolution-We would suggest that you review and update your planning procedure according to your specific business needs. This can be done by running the Material Requirements Planning (MRP) process or maintaining a job to run MRP in the system.-Once the MRP process is completed, purchase proposals will be generated by the system and can be released via run accordingly.-We recommend reviewing and updating planning procedure to align with your business needs. It can be done by running the Material Requirements Planning (MRP) process or setting up a job to run MRP in the system. After the MRP process finishes, the system generates purchase proposals, which can be released as needed.-Keywords-Purchase proposal, MRP run, automated actions, release run, release purchase proposal run, procurement type, internal procurement , external procurement, manual planning, planning procedure

Title: Negative Stock Not Permitted in Custodian A Material B
Content: Symptom-In terms of Serial Number Product, error "Negative stock not permitted in custodian A, material B" occurs when performing undo release for an outbound delivery for spare parts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for the outbound delivery for spare parts.-Choose Actions- Undo Release, then the error would occur.-Cause-In shipping business, system would create a reversal Goods and Activity Confirmation(GAC) for standard GAC while performing undo release for outbound delivery.-However, the standard GAC for outbound delivery is not last document in Spare Parts of Service Order Scenario, but standard GAC for service confirmation is.-Therefore, in terms of serial number product, the mentioned error occurs as expected since the serial number is consumed in standard GAC for service confirmation.-Resolution-You need to reverse the service confirmation by following steps before performing undo release for the outbound delivery.-Go to Service Orders Work Center.-Navigate to Service Order Processing View.-Search for the Service Order.-Edit it and go to Document Flow Tab.-Open the Service Confirmation.-Go to Services and Spare Parts Tab.-Select the line of product, select a value for Reason for rejection.-Save.-Then the service confirmation for the product would be reversed. After this, you can perform the undo release for the outbound delivery.-Keywords-Negative Stock, Custodian, Serial Number, Undo release, Spare Parts, Service Order.

Title: Error "Total duration of All Recorded Times Exceeds 24 hrs on DD.MM.YYYY" While Trying to Activate a Time Entry
Content: Symptom-You are trying to activate a Time Entry for an Employee, however, system shows the error message:-"Total duration of All Recorded Times Exceeds 24 hrs on DD.MM.YYYY"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Time Administration.-Go to the view Employees.-Search for the affected employee.-Enter the Employee Times tab.-Select the affected date.-Click the entry with status Pending Cancellation.-Click Actions and then Activate.-Cause-As the system works with Terminal Integration, the employee has a Clock Out for the Time Event without having a Clock In.-Resolution-In order to correct this scenario, you need to maintain a Clock In for the Employee. Also, you might need to perform a Day Closure Run for the Employee by following the steps below:-Go to the work center Time Administration.-Select Regular Tasks.-Click Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Specify the employee for whom you want to run day closure.-Select Start Time Valuation if you want to recalculate a valuation run for all time data of the employee from a specific date on.-Click Run to specify the valuation start date.-See Also-Integration of Time Recording Terminals-Administer Day Closure Runs-Keywords-Error Message, Total duration of All Recorded Times Exceeds 24hrs, Cannot, Unable, Activate, Time Entry.
