Title: Sales Order Warning Message: "Company XYZ not registered in country ABC, define Taxnumber as Type 2"
Content: Symptom-Warning message in sales order: 'Company XYZ not registered in country ABC, define Taxnumber as Type 2'.-XYZ stands for Company ID (Name).-ABC stands for Country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view. -Select sales order DEF (DEF indicates the ID of the sales order). -Select the Edit button.  -Warning message is displayed: 'Company XYZ not registered in country ABC, define Taxnumber as Type 2'.-Cause-The Seller Party (company XYZ), is not registered in the country of the Ship-To/Payer Party.-Resolution-Register the seller party in the country of the ship-to/payer party.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities - Tax Authorities view.-Select tax authority GHI (GHI indicates the ID of the tax authority).-Choose Edit - Company Tax Arrangements button.-Select the Add Row button.-Add company XYZ.-Go to the Tax Numbers sub tab.-Add tax number type 2-Tax Number.-Add the relevant Tax Number.-Select the Save button.-The warning message will not appear anymore in newly created sales orders for combination of seller party (company XYZ) and country ABC.-Keywords-taxnumber; seller; company; tax authority; tax number

Title: Trial Balance Report Balance is Different Than Material Inventories - Balance History Report
Content: Symptom-The balance of G/L Account ABC shows different amounts when comparing Reports Trial Balance and Material Inventories - Balance History. (ABC stands for the G/L Account ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the Trial Balance Report:-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Open Design Reports View.-Search and open Report Trial Balance.-Maintain the mandatory variable fields as well as the G/L account that you want to check.-Click Apply.-At the very bottom of the table a total result is displayed in the Ending Balance Company Currency column.-Leave the report open.--To check the Material Inventories - Balance History Report:-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Open Design Reports View.-Search and open Report Material Inventories - Balance History.-Maintain the mandatory variable fields as well as the G/L account that needs to be checked.-Click Apply.-The total result displayed in the Ending Balance Company Currency column is different to the Ending amount in the Material Inventories - Balance History Report.-Cause-Reports such as Material Inventories - Balance History does not take postings into account that have been executed without subledger involvement, such as Manual Journal Entry Voucher postings or Balance Carryforward postings.-Resolution-To check if the reason for the difference between the Trial Balance and the Material Inventories - Balance History Report is a posting without subledger involvement:-Navigate to the Business Analytics work center and there to the Design Reports view.-Select the G/L Accounts – Line Items report.-Maintain the same variables as per the Trial Balance Report.-Hit Apply.-Add the key figure Balance Company Currency by pressing the cross sign "+" on the Column Fields in the report View.-Now add the characteristic Subledger Account Type to the rows and move this characteristic to the first place of all row characteristics.-In the Edit Filter tab, filter for the respective G/L account.-Hit Apply.-Check the amount displayed in the Balance Company Currency column for the subledger account type Without Subledger. It will display the difference between Trial Balance and the Material Inventories - Balance History Report.-Therefore the reason for the difference between the report is that there have been postings executed without subledger involvement, such as manual journal entry voucher postings or balance carryforward postings. These are not considered in the Material Inventories - Balance History Report.-See Also-1838469 - Accounts Receivable/Payable - Open Items Report Balance is Different to Financial Statement Report Balance-Keywords-Material Inventories, Trial Balance, difference

Title: Revenue Recognition Run - Application Runtime Exception
Content: Symptom-Revenue recognition run finishes with errors.-In the Messages tab of the run, the following message is displayed: 'During run the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to Periodic Tasks - Revenue Recognition.-Press New - Revenue Recognition Run.-Enter all obligatory data (Company, Period/Year) and then press Start Now to immediately execute the run.-After several minutes a message appears stating the run time error: 'During run the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred'.-Cause-This error occurs due to a lack of memory when the run has to process a very high volume of data.-Resolution-This issue has been taken into consideration for performance improvement in future SAP Business ByDesign releases.-At the moment this error can be prevented if the revenue recognition run is executed for each set of books separately:-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter, navigate to Periodic Tasks - Revenue Recognition.-Press New - Revenue Recognition Run.-Enter all obligatory data (Company, Period/Year).-In the Set of Books field select one set of books.-Press Start Now to immediately execute the run.-The run will finish without errors.-Repeat steps 1 to 6 for each set of books.-The Revenue Recognition run can also be scheduled to be performed after the business hours.-Keywords-application runtime exception, During run the error 'Laufzeitfehler in der Anwendung; melden Sie einen Vorfall' occurred, During run the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred, RR

Title: Error 'General ledger account alias AAAAA does not exist' Occurs When Calling Web Service ManageJournalEntryIn
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You get the error message "General ledger account alias AAA does not exist" when you create Journal Entries using web service "ManageJournalEntryIn".-AAA means the G/L Account alias.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the backend.-Use transaction MDRS.-Select Inbound Service Interface.-Enter the wen service - II_MANAGE_JOURNAL_ENTRY_IN.-Double-click Object Name - II_MANAGE_JOURNAL_ENTRY_IN.-Click Test (Press F8).-Click Execute.-Click XML Editor.-Enter the Payload.-Click Check Well-formedness.-Click Execute.-You get the error: "General ledger account alias AAA does not exist".-Cause-There are two possible reasons:-You have entered the G/L Account instead of Account Determination Group. Basically, you have to enter the G/L Account Alias, not the G/L Account. -You have to choose the Account Determination Group,  but the Account Determination Group ID does not fall under below Subledgers:-General Ledger-Groups for Other Income-Groups for Other Current Assets-Groups for Other Liabilities-Costs-Groups for General Expenses-Resolution-You want to identify the list of GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode from backend then follow the below steps:-Open the backend.-Use transaction SE16.-Enter the Table Name - APC_GLACCTALI.-Press Enter.-Click Execute OR Press F8.-You get the list of GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode, which are eligible to use in the web service payload.  -See Also-KBA 3109471 - Error 'General ledger account alias AAAAA does not exist' Occurs When Calling Web Service ManageJournalEntryIn-Keywords-Find GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode from backend, General ledger account alias AAAAA does not exist-find generalledgeraccountaliascode from,general ledger account alias aaaaa does,ii_manage_journal_entry_in,managejournalentryin

Title: No Time Account Appears to the Employee When Trying to Assign a Time Account Rules
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign the Time Account XYZ in the Time Account Rules for an Employee, however it does appear under the Time Account field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration > Employees view.-Search for the affected Employee and Edit it.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Go to the Time Account Rules subtab.-Click Add Row for the Assign Time Accounts section.-Time Account XYZ is not available. -Cause-This scenario is occurring due to the Validity of the Time Account and the Start Date of the Employee's Time Profile. The date between Time Account and Start Data must overlaps.-Resolution-In order to correct this scenario, you can either change the Start Date of the Time Profile, or adjust the Validity of the Time Account.-Keywords-Time Account Rule, Time Account, Not available, Missing, Not Appearing, Not visible, Time Administration.

Title: Payment File Creation Based on A Custom Payment File Structure Is Stuck in Status In File Creation
Content: Symptom-Payment outbound file stuck in status 'In File Creation'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management - Outbound Files work center view.-Find file ID AAA (AAA is the File ID) with status 'In File Creation'.-The file has been created since several hours, but its status does not change from 'In File Creation'. This file is stuck.-Cause-The issue with the payment file occurs due to a Constant that has been maintained for the respective Payment File Structure.-This Constant has a length of hundreds of characters, which makes the total number of characters in the file larger than what is allowed, causing the issue.-Resolution-Substantially reduce the number of characters for the Constant field (for example, to 10 characters) in the respective Payment File Structure, save the changes and proceed with payment file creation again.-Keywords-payment file structure; constant; payment file creation; CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS; PaymentProcessing; PaymentProcessingFileCreationForPaymentOrderingIn

Title: Error Message 'Sufficient Quota Required for Posting on DD.MM.YYYY to Account ABC' When Trying to Add a Time Account Rule
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a Time Account Rule for an Employee, however the system shows the error below:-Sufficient Quota Required for Posting on DD.MM.YYYY to Account ABC-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center and Employees view.-Search for the affected Employee ID.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Go to the Time Accounts Rules.-Click Add Row.-Add the required Time Account.-Click Save.-Cause-The error appears due to changes done in the custom holiday calendar assigned to the employee, after the applied leaves were deducted in the year of the error message from affected time account.-As you are trying to add a new time account effective from a older year, the system recalculates all the time account balances considering time model, holiday calendar and other time accounts related configurations.-Resolution-If your intention is to add the time account ABC for the employee effective since the start of time profile, then please be aware, it is going to recalculate all the assigned time account balances back from that date to the present day and there is possibility the balances could change if any configuration changes were done without correction run.-In this case, you need to fix the previous year’s custom holiday calendar/correction run, as some holidays in year YYYY that were not deducted from the affected account, are no more been taken as holiday and are now getting deducted and hence, changing the balance for previous leaves.-If that is not the intention, then you would consider adding another time profile in order to avoid the recalculation for the past years’ time account balances.-See Also-2465924 - Cannot Modify Time Accounts for Employees-1654985 - Error Message 'Sufficient Quota Required for Posting on DD.MM.YYYY to Account ABC' when Releasing Time Entries-2338743 - Error Message 'Sufficient Quota Required for Posting on DD.MM.YYYY to Account ABC' in Day Closure Run-Keywords-Error Message, Sufficient Quota Required for Posting on, to Account, Adding, Inserting, Creating, Time Account Rule.

Title: Topic Responsibility for Output Management Related Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This document provides an explanation of the teams that are responsible for addressing issues related to forms.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Form template Selection is wrong in C4C:-Rules are working hierarchically so if a rule hits that form is picked.-C4C is using their own Nested UI for form template selection => That needs to be checked by application not OM Framework.-Issue Reported Support Team Development Team-Data is missing or Content in document preview incorrect-Respective application to validate their data passed in the document XML as outlined in 2193339.-Scenario 1- Data not passed in XML or Data incorrect in form preview.-Action Needed- Respective application to validate the requirement and involve application development based on customer's use case for missing data. And for incorrect data in form XML, forward to respective application development. This is applicable for standard and customer form.-Scenario 2 - Data is passed in XML and Data passed in XML is correct.-Action Needed- Check if the form template which is used to preview is standard SAP Delivered / custom. If so, forward to Output management support (AP-RC-OUT) team.-  If the Output of any document is in XML (External System)-Forward the incident to respective application support team.-  Binding / scripting issues or form alignment issues in custom form template-For example: Decimal output is incorrect, font not correct, Table data extending to another page, page alignment issues etc.-Action Needed- Forward incident to output management support.-If you are unable to identify scripting or form alignment issues, forward it to ADS team providing all artifacts which is XML, XDP, PDF from backend.-BC-SRV-FP-ADS rendering error on preview-ByD: Forward incident to output management support team. OM support to follow document- 2655972 and involve ADS team if needed.-C4C: LOD-CRM-ADM (support processing org).-BC-SRV-FP-XML parsing error on preview-Such issues occur when XML has a special character and form template is not compatible to handle this character.-Action Needed- Extract form XML referring to 2193339 while previewing affected document. Send the incident to respective application support.-  Document cannot be generated; ADS server returned an SOAP error or browser crash/ dump on document preview-Such issues occur if XML data size is big and there is time out generated at ADS.-Action Needed- Extract form XML referring to 2193339 while previewing affected document. If XML size is big, send the incident to respective application support to validate this use case.-Only for ADS issues:-C4C: LOD-CRM-ADM-Document cannot be generated; form master template error-Scenario 1: Master template is in PDI layer.-Action Needed: Refer to the KBA 2641742 and trigger action accordingly.-Scenario 2: Master template is not in PDI layer.-Forward incident to output management support team.-AP-RC-OUT-Formatted Text issues on preview - Text Editor content, Rich text related issues-Refer to steps outlined in KBA  2876971.-Note- Limitations with respect to formatted text  2308038.-Respective Application team-E-mail Issues-Scenario 1: Latency in receiving emails.-Scenario 2: Bounce back errors such as 5.4.7 - Delivery Expired or timed out.-Scenario 3: Document not received by recipient.-Note: In most cases, OM development cannot identify root cause for such issues. Mostly this will be infrastructure related. Send it to hosting instead of AP-RC-OUT-Hosting team-Handling custom font requests-If there is any request to add custom form from customer, refer to KBA  2781536 for steps. If the fonts are still not visible then forward to Output Management support team.-Note: For requests in C4C tenants, you need create report which can be found in Attachments section.-  No PDF Output Generated-Respective Application Team.-  Adaptation of Local Form Template / Local Form Template Maintenance-C4C: Respective C4C Application or C4C Platform.-AP-RC-MOB-CF-MSC-Issue with web services OutboundDeliveryExecutionOut and InboundDeliveryReplicationOut -The output is not transmitted via XML. The Sender Interface is InputAndOutputManagement which belongs to /DOC/CO_OM_XML_REPLIC_OUT and  is therefore handled by AP-RC-OUT-AP-RC-OUT-Keywords-responsibility, XML, Output Management, OM Framework, byd, c4c-ads rendering,form template issue,e-mail issue,e-mail latency,handling of custom font,xml parsing error on preview,form binding,form template maintance,ads server returned an soap error or bro,document cannot be generated; form maste,master template,output management issues,fomatted text,rich text editor

Title: Error appears while trying to Migrate Project: End constraint not permitted for summary task
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate project using migration tool however system throws the following error:-"End constraint not permitted for summary task".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Overview-Select Migration of Projects activity.-Select Migrate projects using the migration tool-Select the file-Execute step by step-Error appears. -Cause-The duration is not maintained in the task level under the Duration column of the migration template.-Additionally, ensure that when the project is created, the given dates in the expenses, revenues and tasks must be in the range of the project start date and end date.-Resolution-For the Project task details, duration days need to be maintained for the summary tasks based on the Project Start date and End date.-Keywords-Project migration error; End constraint not permitted for summary task; Project migration template; Migration template;

Title: Unable to add Assignment to Business Transactions for Account Assignment Types
Content: Symptom-When attempting to add a row to Assignment to Business Transactions, the Add Row button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview.-Search for and open the Business Configuration activity Account Assignment Types.-Click Maintain Account Assignment Types.-Select the the line PRFT.-Click Assignment to Business Transactions.-Result: You cannot add row.-Cause-Standard Account Assignment Types cannot be changed.-This means you cannot change which Business Transactions it is used for. The Business Transaction Assignment can only be changed for Custom Account Assignment types. This is the correct system behavior.-Resolution-Profit centre will be derived from Cost Centre, which is already assigned to Supplier Invoice and Purchase Order. The Account Assignments can also be changed to make the Profit centre mandatory for the other Account Assignment Types that are already available for Supplier Invoice and Purchase Order.-See Also-Configuration: Account Assignment Types-Keywords-add row, grey out, grayed, gray

Title: VAT Return for GB - United Kingdom: the Pay button is greyed out
Content: Symptom-The Pay button is greyed out for a VAT Return for GB - United Kingdom.-Remark: UK Making Tax Digital (MTD) for VAT is scoped. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Find Tax Return ID XXX (XXX is the Tax Return ID), with Tax Return Status Reported, and notice that Pay button is greyed out (even though the Tax Return is relevant for payment).-Cause-Until 2018, tax return for GB - United Kingdom was electronically submission configured. As of April, 2019, the UK Making Tax Digital (MTD) became mandatory for businesses with turnover above the VAT threshold (£85,000).-The Electronic Submission indicator was used to activate the file generation functionality that existed before HMRC introduced MTD (Making Tax Digital). Post MTD introduction, the same should not be used. Activating the same while having MTD configured in the system confuses the system on the submission choice that has been made and Pay button remains disabled as the system is unable to understand whether the return has been successfully submitted or not. -For the Reporting Company of Tax Return ID XXX, both Electronic Submission and MTD are active, hence the Pay button is greyed out.-Resolution-The general guidance is to use only one of the submission mode, and since file medium is no longer supported, only MTD should be scoped in the system and Electronic Submission indicator should always be off.-The Electronic Submission indicator should be removed from the respective Tax Authority -> Company Tax Arrangement -> Tax Return Arrangement.-After removing the indicator, the Pay button becomes available again.-Keywords-UK MTD; tax return; vat return; pay button

Title: Bank Account Upload Error Received as Letters in Bank Account Number Not Allowed
Content: Symptom-You get 'No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XYZ, national bank code XX, and currency AAA found' error when uploading an Incoming Bank Statement file.-(XYZ stands for the account number); (XX stands for the national bank code number); (AA stands for the currency).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Select the relevant Bank Account.-Click on the New button and select Bank Statement Upload.-Upload the Incoming Bank Statement file.--Error 'No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XYZ, national bank code XX, and currency AAA found' is displayed.-Cause-The Incoming Bank Statement file contains a mix of numbers and letters for the Bank Account ID information in tag 25.-SAP Business ByDesign system supports a Bank Account ID containing only numbers, therefore, when the Incoming Bank Statement file is uploaded, as Bank Account ID information in the file differs from the one maintained in the system, the system cannot find the correct Bank Account. --Resolution-You can maintain an Alternative Account Number that matches the one in the Incoming Bank Statement file.--Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the Master Data view. Select the My Banks subview.-Select the relevant Bank.-Click the Edit button and select Bank Accounts option.-Select the relevant Bank Account ID.-Under Account tab go to the Alternative Account Number box, enter the Bank Account ID as shown in the Incoming Bank Statement file. Note: Remove leading zeroes and spaces between characters both on the file and on the Alternative Account Number field.-Save the changes.-Upload the Bank Statement again.-See Also-KBA 2399474 - Error Message When Uploading Bank Statement "No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number X, national bank code Y, and currency ZZZ found"-Keywords-Incoming Bank Statement File-Alternative-Account Number-Bank Account-National Bank Code-Currency-Liquidity

Title: Error: General Ledger Account Alias A-1500 Does not Exist
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post an Expense Report fetched from Concur and it fails with error, "General ledger account alias A-1500 does not exist".-Payment Type = CBCP(Personal).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur View.-Go to the Expense Reports sub-view and search for expense report XX[represents Expense Report Id].-Press Post.-Error: "General Ledger Account Alias A-1500 Does not Exist".-Cause-A-1500 is a default GL Alias delivered by SAP . The error message is thrown when A-1500 account determination configuration in fine tuning is missing.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine tune activity. -Press Edit Account Determination Groups.-Under General Ledger select Groups for Other Income.-Maintain A-1500 Group ID and assign a G/L account.*-*This GL-Alias A-1500 can be configured with the G/L Account according to your business.-See Also-2901216 - How to Restore Default Account Determination Group-3091179 - Concur Expense Report Error: General ledger account alias does not exist-3109471 - Error 'General ledger account alias AAAAA does not exist' Occurs When Calling Web Service ManageJournalEntryIn-Keywords-Concur, General Ledger Account Alias, A-1500

Title: Product Specification Error While Creating Supplier Return
Content: Symptom-- Error message "Product Specification Is Mandatory for ABC" appears while creating a Supplier Return.--Environment-- Source: SAP Business ByDesign (byd)-- System Type: Productive System-- System ID/Name: CLOUD / URL-- Product Version: SAP Business ByDesign 2402-- System Managed By: SAP Cloud Tenant-- Install Base Item: URL-- Sold Product: BYD INSTALLATION-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-2. Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option "New Return to Supplier".-3. Enter all the relevant details for the screens displayed and navigate to the Review screen by selecting "Next".-4. In the Review screen, choose the "Finish" button.-Cause-The error occurs because the item was received with an Identified Stock (iStock) to which a product specification was mapped. The expiry date of the iStock, which you are trying to return, is in the past.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, change the expiry date of the iStock to a future date and perform the steps to create a supplier return.-See Also-N/A-Keywords

Title: The Time Profile End Date Does Not Match Employee Termination Date
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-* ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** *-The termination date in an employee's personnel file has been changed to a later date. A new Time Profile needs to be created with an end date that matches the updated termination date. However, the original end date of the existing Time Profile cannot be overwritten.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Mark the affected employee and click Edit button.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Add Row to create a new Time Profile.-The existing End Date cannot be overwritten and no Time Profile with new End Date can be created.-Cause-There is an inconsistency between the Work Agreement and the Time Agreement. When the termination date is altered, the Time Agreement should be updated accordingly. Due to this inconsistency, both agreements become unsynchronized.-Resolution-To ensure accurate synchronization between the backend and the Work Agreement End Date, it is necessary to make a correction. Therefore, kindly request the user's permission to proceed with the backend correction.-See Also-2475827 - Time Profile of an Employee Cannot be Changed After Extention of Employee Contract-Keywords-Time Administration, Time Profile, Work Agreement, Time Agreement-time administration,time profile,work agreement,time agreement

Title: Custom Holiday Appears in the Wrong day of the Week
Content: Symptom-Holiday is appearing wrongly in the Time Sheet of Employees from a specific Country. You have maintained a Holiday as guaranteed and Previous for Friday, and such Holiday occurs on a Friday. However, you noticed that the system is assigning the Holiday on a Thursday.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Then go to the Employees view.-Search and open the affected Employee.-Click Edit.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Click Show Holiday Calendar.-Notice that the Holiday is maintained for a incorrect date.-Cause-At the holiday definition for the  affected holiday, you have selected a guaranteed holiday on Friday, which should be moved to the previous day (when it falls on a Friday). This setting is intended to be used for countries where the weekend occurs on a Friday.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. The Holiday details must be changed in the Working Day Calendar activity.-Keywords-Holiday, Guaranteed, Wrong Date, Wrong Day, Not showing in the right date, Working Day Calendar, Holiday Calendar, Employee, Time Sheet.

Title: Tax Determination in the Credit Memo for Return is not the Expected One
Content: Symptom-Tax date in the customer return credit memo is not the expected one, the tax date is considering the outbound delivery shipment date instead of the actual inbound delivery date.-For example, the inbound delivery notification was received on 21.06.2024. The reference outbound delivery is with shipment date as 18.06.2024.-In the customer return credit memo, the tax date is 18.06.2024 (from outbound delivery) instead of 21.06.2024 (from inbound delivery notification).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Open Customer Return Delivery Notification XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Inbound Delivery Notification).-The Actual Delivery Date is XX.YY.ZZ (XX.YY.ZZ is the date of return). You expect this to be the Tax Date of the Credit Memo ABC (ABC represents the ID of the credit memo).-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoicing Documents view.-Choose Show All Invoicing Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the credit memo).-Edit the credit memo ABC and go to the Items tab.-Select the line item and select the Taxes subtab.-The tax date is showing Outbound Delivery Shipment Date instead of Actual Delivery Date of the return.--Cause-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign as per legal requirements for return tax calculation.-Resolution-If your return scenario deviates from the standard returns you can consult the steps in the following KBA:-2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-customer return; tax date; unexpected; shipment date; outbound delivery.

Title: How to Enable Custom Business Objects and Extension Fields in OData and Data Workbench
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find a custom business object (BO) created from PDI on Data Workbench or an extension field created on a standard business object is missing in the Data Workbench template.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Data Workbench work center.-Click on Import view.-Select Custom BO.-The custom BO is not available.-Now select Standard BO.-Select the related entity and download the excel workbook.-You notice the extension field is missing in the template.-Resolution-To add PDI extension fields created from SAP Cloud Applications Studio (PDI) to standard OData services, which will then be reflected to Data Workbench (if availabe), please follow the below link:-https://community.sap.com/t5/application-development-blog-posts/new-feature-odata-service-extension-with-extension-fields-in-sdk/ba-p/13348038 --To add a custom BO and its respective fields to Data Workbench, you can create a custom OData service following the steps below:-Go to the Administrator work center.-Select the OData Service Explorer view.-Change the Show filter to Custom Odata Services.-Click on New, to create a new custom OData service. -Check the option: Data Workbench enabled (if you want to use this service with Data Workbench).-Edit the Custom OData service.-Select the required Custom BO under the "Select Business Object" button.-Expand and select the required Entities (fields).-Now all the fields related to the selected entities will be available in the right hand side window of the OData Service.-Save your custom OData service.-Click on Activate.-Now the selected custom BO along with its fields will be available in the Data Workbench work center, under the Custom Object option.-Keywords-custom, odata, service, custom, business, object, data, workbench, extension, field, PDI, SDK, template, excel, migration

Title: IRPA Bot "Automated Purchase Order Upload" is not Creating Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-You are using IRPA bot "Automated Purchase Order Upload" to create Purchase Order in the ByD tenant but no Purchase Orders are created-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Cause-One of the cause for the issue that Evaluated Receipt Settlements is not scoped.-In order to use this Bot, Evaluated Receipt Settlements must be scoped-Resolution-Follow below steps to scope Evaluated Receipt Settlements-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view-Edit Implementation Projects-Go to Questions-Expand 'Purchasing', Expand 'Supplier Invoicing'-Select Automatic Settlements-Scope all the Scoping Questions-Complete the Scoping-In case the issue persists, It is also recommended to Re-Create Communication Arrangement as described in the KBA - https://me.sap.com/notes/3473316-Keywords-IRPA, Automated Purchase Order Upload, unable, create, purchase order

Title: How to Terminate Restore Point?
Content: Symptom-***Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.***-You want to Terminate restore point from the customer system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Resolution-You can request a termination of a restore point by following the below steps.-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Click on the Systems view.-Select System and click on Terminate Restore Point.-Below screenshot will explain you the above steps.-  Note: -1. Once the restore point is terminated, it is not possible to request rollback/reset for that restore point.-2. Once the restore point is terminated it cannot be re-activated.-3. Once you request termination of restore point, ideally restore point will be deleted within 1 Business Day.-See Also-2315326 - How to Request a Restore Point-2560598 - How to Request Restore/Rollback to Restore Point?-Keywords-Terminate Restore Point, Delete Restore Point

Title: New Tax Rate Type For Localized And Non-Localized Country
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer wants a new Tax Rate Type as per the legal requirements of any country. For example: Special Reduced - 2.-This Tax Rate is missing and you cannot add it in the relevant activity of the Business Configuration work center: Tax on Goods and Services as the Add Row button is grayed out for this specific country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation and click Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune phase.-Search for activity Tax on Goods and Services and open it.-Open Tax Rate Schedule.-Here, you can see the different Tax Rate Types for the respective country. For example: Reduced, Special Reduced.- There is no option to add another Tax Rate Type as the Add Row button is grayed out.-Cause-This is a country specific legal requirement. SAP development team will create a hotfix and deliver the new Tax Rate Type and Tax Rate. Later on the customer can change the Tax Rate as per their requirement.-Resolution-Verify that the country/region for which this change is to be made is localized, pre-localized or a tax basic country/region for which additional localized product tax content can be made available via the Localization toolkit (Topics - Tax - choose Tax Basic Countries/Regions) or check the list of localization tax basic countries/regions in the See Also section.*-With the following details, you can forward such incidents to AP-TTE-GLO component:-Name of Tax Rate Type (it should not be duplicate).-Tax Rate.-Valid From Date.-NOTE: As this is new development request priority Very High is not justified. Development team will create Hotfix for this requirement. Additionally, EP will not be created for this requirement.-*If the country/region appears under Basic Product Tax Content Available, advise the customer to contact their implementation partner to make the required change.-See Also-3388229 - Localization - Countries/Regions Where SAP Delivers Tax Content for SAP Business ByDesign-Localization Tax Basic Countries/Regions-Keywords-Tax Rate, Type, Localized, Non-Localized, Reduced

Title: Dump Executing GR/IR-Run Due to Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While executing a GR/IR run, a dump occurs. The dump in ST22 shows it came from CL_FAI2D_ACDOC_DATA->MODIFY_ITEM, line 188 and the slatype is 01 (Fixed Assets)-Reproducing the Issue-The issue can be reproduced by follwing these steps:-Under Business Configuration, go to activity "Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets" and make sure that, for the accounting principle and currency you're going to use you have no Minimum or Maximum amount or the "Valid from" date is before the dates you are going to post.-Create a Purchase order with account assignment as IMAT and create a new IMAT. Provide a product category correctly configured for fixed assets.-Create a goods receipt with a posting date in the previous period. This will create and capitalize a fixed asset.-Create a supplier invoice with posting date in the previous period. Change the value of the goods, so when we execute the GRIR run it posts to fixed assets.-Create a new fixed asset.-With the IMAT created in step 1, retreive the fixed asset created in step 2. Go to "Manual Posting" and select "Complete transfer of Individual Material".-Post the complete transfer to the current period.-Go to the business configuration activity of step 1, add values and put a date after the posting date of the complete transfer.-Execute a GRIR run for the previous period (period that the goods receipt and supplier invoice posted).-If all went well, the run should end up in a dump with no further description.-Cause-The change of the Capitalization Threshold values after a complete transfer of fixed assets are causing the dump, which actually originates at CL_FIA_LEADOBJ_AP->INITIALIZE. You can put a breakpoint in the constructor method of CM_FIA_FIXED_ASSET_CFG and check the stack.-Resolution-To solve the issue, the following steps need to be performed:-Go to Capitalization Threshold of Fixed assets activity on Business configuration, choose your accounting principle and currency and either change the validity for a date before the complete transfer of fixed assets or remove the Minimum and Maximum amount.-Reverse the Complete transfer of fixed assets. This is a journal entry voucher that you can find by opening the valuation tab of the original fixed asset and going to the tab Journal Entry.-Run the GR/IR run again, which should go through correctly.-Keywords

Title: Scoping Activity is Read Only for a Merged Change Project
Content: Symptom-You cannot edit the scope of a change project once it is in the status Merged.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-In field Show, choose option All Projects.-Select a project with status Merged.-You can see a View Project Scope  instead of Edit Project Scope which leads to a read only view of project scope.-Cause-The changes in the scoping carried out through the change project have already been merged with the production system. So, it is not possible to change the scope of a Merged change project.-Resolution-You can include the changes in any existing change project or create a new change project to include the desired scoping changes.

Title: IDP Is Not Automatically Selected During SSO Logon
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--You have configured Single Sign-On and when logging in via SSO, you are asked to select an Identity Provider from the dropdown menu, even though only one Identity Provider is maintained.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Launch the SSO url and you will be presented with SAP NetWeaver page to select the IDP-Cause-If Manual Identity Provider Selection is checked in the ﻿Configure Single Sign-On ﻿screen, this behaviour occurs.-Resolution-C4C supports multiple IDP's, so based on your requirement, you can check/uncheck the option "Manual Identity Provider Selection"  by following the below mentioned steps:-Navigate to Administration work center-Navigate to Common Tasks > Configure Single Sign-On-Under My System,  find Manual Identity Provider Selection option-Keywords-SSO, Netweaver, login issue, Manual Identity Provider Selection

Title: How to Debug the Error "Enter the currency for the specified Amount" in Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You got error "Enter the currency for the specified Amount" when performing some action on the system.- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In this case the error occurs when adding surcharge in a sales order. But in reality, this is just an example since this error can happen in any context.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the order in question, Go to the Pricing tab.-Add surcharge on one line, i.e. 10,00 USD. -Click Save button. Systems shows error:Enter the currency for the specified Amount.-Cause-This issue is more common when the user creates an extension field for Amount. This field requires a supporting field called Currency. It is technically mandatory that user needs to enter Currency when an Amount is entered.-Resolution-To find out which field causes this error, you will need to debug in backend.-Reproduce the issue in the UI.-Leave the final step until you have set the debugging scenario in the backend.-Open the backend and navigate to SE24 (Class Builder).-Enter the class CM_ESI_T100 (message class) and click Display.-Click Set External Breakpoint. Ensure your cursor is at the top of the method.-Execute the final step in the UI to trigger the debugger.-Once the debugger is launched, open Standard tab to reveal the Call Stack.-Double click on the method below the Constructor method(s). In this case, the error is from method /EXT/IF_CUS_RUNTIME_BUFFER-Go to Objects tab, and then Indiv.Display sub tab.-Manually enter Reference: LO_ATTRIBUTE.-You can see the extension field in MV_ITERNAL_NAME variable. The field can be PDI or KUT.-  The PDI or KUT field here will have a P in them, e.g.:-YABCDEFGY_P000638A58102F3 -/BYD/A049NP00065DF9BAB4CF1-You need to replace this P for an F and then search for this extension field details in /n/ext/field transaction.-Once you find the affected field, please share this field to the customer and inform them to ensure that the currency is also passed with the amount during runtime.--Note:-The field may be updated from a PDI .absl script. To confirm if this is the case, check KBA: 2851290 - How To Check if a Field is Used in a PDI-You can find the relevant .absl script which updates the field in the given context and share it to the customer.-See Also-2458842 - Error Message "Enter the currency for the specified Amount" During Migration-Keywords-LO_ATTRIBUTE; SE24; Enter, the, currency, for, the, specified, Amount

Title: FAQ's related to Facebook Integration With C4C
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FAQ's related to Facebook Integration With C4C-Resolution-1. You are not able to create the Facebook Social Channel.-- Steps to reproduce::  Administration work center -> Service & Social view -> Social Media Channels -> Create a new channel for Facebook (Add ID, Secrete, Date, Log Level, Direct Message) ->-Connect with Channel -> Login to the Facebook page -> Select Get Account Details -> No account get picked.-Cause: You are logged into the different Facebook account.-Solution: Open Both C4C & Facebook in different tab of the same browser -> Logout from the existing Facebook account/page -> Re-login to the respective/correct Facebook account ->-Try the step Connect with Channel from C4C.-2.Error Social media provider ID is required occurs when you are trying to set-up the Facebook channel.-- Make Sure that your Client ID & Secrete are correct.-3. How to enable Direct Messaging in Facebook.-- Go to the Business Configuration Scoping -> Questions -> Service Request Management -> Scope the question Do you want to Support Direct messages for Facebook.-- Once above scopng is completed, do the required changes in the Facebook Channel:-Configure how Facebook Direct Messages are handled:-• Add to completed ticket – including specifying a time range within which the completed message should have been closed-• Add to an Open ticket-• Or do not process-4. Missing Facebook posts and Comments from Facebook.-- The missing posts and comments may be due to the privacy settings of the customer on Facebook.-Facebook allows every user to define the security (visibility) of posts and comments that are published on Facebook.- -If end users decide to enable "extreme privacy settings", i. e. turn off the platform and therefore block access to all 3rd party apps and integration,-their comments and posts cannot be imported into Cloud for Customer. A customer may report this as an issue with the product, since these comments and-posts are visible on the Facebook wall but not in the Queue or agent workspace.-5. There are no messages being imported. But your Facebook page has many comments and posts.-- You have not scoped the Direct Messaging feature in BC scoping, however enabled it for processing channel set-up.-Solution: Administrator -> Service and Social -> Social Media Channels -> Choose the Channel ID -> For the Direct Messages link, choose the option Do Not Process from the drop-down -> Save.-6. When replying a ticket, the system shows the following error message:-The following HTTP error occurred in the social media adapter: :message#(#100) Error finding the requested story#type#"OAuthException","code"100.--> You are trying to reply a message in the Facebook, however the message was already deleted from Facebook side, hence the message: Error finding the requested story.-Since the message was already deleted from Facebook, the ticket can be Set as Irrelevant.-7. When posting a message as a reply to a Facebook ticket an error occurs: Application limit reached.--> The limit is reached because the same app is being used by many channels at the same time and Facebook puts a throttle on the usage.-Create a new app and use that to connect some of the channels, thereby distributing the load on the app.-8. You created a ticket from Facebook Direct Message, but the attachments are not reflected.--> This feature is not supported yet. This is the standard system behavior.-9. When an already existing Individual Customer changes his name on Facebook and opens another ticket afterwards, the account name of the individual customer is not updated.--> This is the expected system behaviour.-The system recognises the facebook profile and keeps the original account name but updates the information in the Social Information section of the individual customer account, instead of creating a new individual customer.-10. Import Run created for the social media channel Facebook stays in In Process status and does not get finished.-Errors in log:-A runtime error occurs for channel, raise an incident.-Errors in log:-Number of new social media activities created for channel ABC: 0.-Number of new user profiles created for channel ABC: 0.-Number of new service requests created for channel ABC: 0-Failed to lock social media provider root node ID YYY (YYY represents the root node ID).-> The problem is related to the amount of data that the Import Run is trying to extract, which is in turn connected to the start date set in the Import Run.-- Cloud for Customer (C4C) is designed to support engagement, and is therefore optimized to extract a limited number of messages per import run.-We recommend you set the start date of the import run to max 2-3 days in the past-11. An individual customer has been created twice in the system, with two different ID’s and the same Facebook account.--> This issue typically happens when two Facebook applications are used to connect to Cloud for Customer.  In this the case Facebook masks users across applications. This is a Facebook privacy feature.-Recommendation is to use only one Facebook application to connect to Cloud for Customer. For the duplicate customers, you have to mark one as obsolete.-12. How does Cloud for Customer ensure all Social Media messages are extracted from e.g.: Facebook?-e.g. Facebook posts/messgaes created when C4C system is down.--> Cloud for Customer is for technical reasons not able to extract social media messages at the pre-configured extraction times.-As soon as the system is able to extract messages again all messages not yet extracted are extracted. Cloud for Customer uses a time marker for each social media message to ensure all messages are replicated to the system.-13. Unable to configure custom social media message import run on Cloud for Social Engagement.--> This is expected system behavior.-Cloud for Social Engagement supports batch extraction only for channels supported by the solution Facebook, Twitter and Social Media Analytics.-For custom channels, Cloud for Social Engagement cannot extract messages. You will have to write your own extractor to search, find and send messages from the external source,-and post them into Cloud for Social Engagement using the webservice APIs. This is explained in the document Developing a custom channel in the online help center.-Please notice that, starting on October 2024 this process will not be valid anymore due to Twitter/X new guidelines.-More details here can be seen at SAP Help Portal, under the topic "X (Formerly Twitter) Integration Discontinued"-14. Deletion of Social Media Messages coming from custom Social Media Channel.--> Deletion of Social Media Messages coming from a custom Social Media Channel is not supported.-15. All photographs and comments of album posted on Facebook page are not replicated to Cloud for Customer.--> This is the expected behavior of Cloud for Customer. Currently we do not handle the posts from the album in C4C.-16. FB Import runs - FB API limitation:-In one run, we cannot imoprt more than 25,000 comments or replies.  -This limittaion is imposed by FB. https://developers.facebook.com/bugs/1772936312959430/.-However, if there are any new posts that generate large number of comments, and if import job runs intermittently then we should be able to pull those.- Eg: A new post generated 10,000 comments in first 10 min, then import runs fetches those comments. Same post in next 10 min generate another 20,000,-then next import run can import those and similarly many more.  However, at one point, import runs cannot fetch more than 25,000 posts.That is a FB API limitation.-17. Generic Steps of Facebook Integration:-https://blogs.sap.com/2016/07/20/sap-hybris-cloud-for-customer-integration-with-facebook/-18. How to Create a Marketing Lead in SAP Cloud for Customer from a Facebook promotion-https://blogs.sap.com/2015/05/20/creating-a-marketing-lead-in-sap-cloud-for-customer-from-a-facebook-promotion/-19. How to Create a Custom Channel:-1.Go to Start of the navigation path Business Configuration Next navigation step Implementation Projects End of the navigation path.-2.Select the project for which you want to create the channel type.-3.Select Open Activity List.-4.Select Fine-Tune and then All Activities in Show.-5.Select Create or Delete Custom Channel Type, then select Add to Project.-6.Click Create or Delete Custom Channel Type to open the channel.-7.Click Add.-Enter the channel type code and the name of the channel.-8.Save your selections.- -20 How to Add the Custom Channel to the C4C-1.Navigate to Start of the navigation path Administrator Next navigation step Service and Social Settings Next navigation step Social Media Channels  End of the navigation path.-2.Click New.-3.For Channel Type, select the channel name that you previously created.-4.Enter the mashup Web service ID that you have created for the response.-5.Enter your Channel ID, Channel Name, and Language. You can choose to set the channel to Listen Only mode while you are setting up the system.

Title: Error Message "Invalid UID number" While Updating UID For Switzerland Country/Region for an Account
Content: Symptom-When trying to save an Account with new UID number for Switzerland (Swiss) Country/Region, system throws error message below:-"Invalid UID number"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select the account ABC (where ABC refers to the Account ID).-Edit Account.-Maintain UID number and save the changes.-Error: Invalid UID number-Cause-SAP Supports UID maintenance for Switzerland Account only in Specified format.-Resolution-Follow below Steps to Maintain the UID in General Tab View:-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select the account ABC.-Edit Account.-Navigate to the General Tab.-Maintain UID without punctuation marks (Example: CHE123456789).-Follow below Steps to Maintain the UID in Financial Data Tab View:-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select the account ABC.-Edit an Account.-Navigate to Financial Data Tab. -Go to Tax Data Tab.-Navigate to Tax Numbers Section.-Select Add row.-Choose Country/Region Switzerland.-Go to Tax Number Type.-Choose UID Number from drop down.-Maintain UID with Punctuation marks (Example: CHE-123.456.789).-If the UID is desired to be maintained in a format other than the mentioned above, the tax number validation check can be disabled in the Business Configuration, and any value can be maintained by the system.-Steps to disable tax number validation check.-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Navigate to Implementation Projects view.-Choose First Implementation Project which is in Started Status.-Select Open Activity List.-Choose All Activities from dropdown.-Search Countries/Regions.-Select Open.-Edit Countries/Regions.-Select Countries/Regions as Switzerland.-Navigate to Tax Attributes Tab.-Uncheck Tax Fields Check Enabled.-Select Save and Close.  -NOTE: SAP will NOT be responsible for any number getting maintained in the system once Tax Fields Check Enabled is unchecked.-This modification can be performed in the system according to the business needs.-Keywords-Invalid UID , Swiss UID , Switzerland UID, UID format, Tax Numbers, byd

Title: Quantity Field Data not Available for Read in SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You are unable to Read the data: Quantity field in backend SDK solution, so that this data can be used to pay the employees based on How Many Hours worked.-This field shows 0.0 hours.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Frontend:-1. Go to Time Administration.-2. Select Employees.-3. Filter with required Employee ID.-4. Select Edit, Employee Times then select Calendar.-5. Select a Date Quantity data.--Backend:-1. Login to SAP Cloud Application Studio.-2. Select View and then Repository Explorer.-3. Query with EmployeeTime.-4. Add parameters --          EmployeeID/content-          ItemDate as above-          Select OK-5. Select Navigate by Association -> Select Currentitem -> Select Single Record view.-6. Single Record View open up where Quantity/content shows as 0.0 hours.-Cause-Quantity field for the Employee Time is not stored on the Employee Time BO.  As the results are generally valuated after input, the quantity field on the Employee Time BO is not filled.  The Duration field is filled only when a value is entered in the Duration field via UI.- The Valuated Quantity field is held on the Employee Time Calendar BO Period Item node, which is visible in the SDK.-Resolution-Try the period Item node is for Time_item_Category_code 12 for Step Code 0014 on the root node.-Or Create a Custom Report using data source HCMTLMB07 where a Key Figure exists called Valuated Quantity which will also provide the valuated figures for employees.-This can then be downloaded.-See Also-Refer Attachment-Keywords-Quantity, Employee Time BO, HCMTLMB07, Time_item_Category

Title: Not Possible to Repost or Split Migrated Payables and Receivables Items
Content: Symptom-You want to apply the Repost Open Items functionality for open payables. When attempting to repost you receive the error: Invoice XYZ is migrated; repost or split not possible. (XYZ stands for the Invoice ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Choose the Suppliers view, select the relevant supplier account ABC and press View.-In the Supplier Account Monitor, highlight the open invoice XYZ and choose Actions / Repost Open Items.-The following error messages appear:-"Repost not possible. Not all selected items can get reposted."-"Invoice XYZ is migrated; repost or split not possible."-Cause-As a system definition it is not possible to repost migrated payables. The rational is that when migrating Open Items Payables via migration tool the transaction's essential parameters as document date, creditor etc. should be sufficiently specific and clear in order to ensure a consistent migration also with respect to tax implications. The same applies for migrated Open Items Receivables and the function Split Open Item.-Resolution-For all Open Items Payables and it is recommended to double-check before the migration process how these transactions are ultimately to be distributed among supplier and customer accounts.-In case you do not want to repeat the migration process in particular cases you can consider and check the following workaround.-Navigate to the Supplier Account Monitor for for supplier ABC. (ABC stands for the Supplier ID)-Apply a New Charge/Credit, type Supplier Charge to clear invoice XYZ.-State a viable and clear Document Description and make sure to select dates identical to migrated invoice XYZ.-Clear both documents against each other.-Re-create a conventional invoice copying the data of original invoice XYZ.-Keywords-Split invoice, migrated, payables, receivables

Title: Unable to Find Payment Data Records in the Supplier Base Work Center post Migration of Suppliers
Content: Symptom-Post Migration of Suppliers, the Payment Data is not visible in the Supplier base and Business Partner Data work centers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base/ Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Find a migrated supplier.-Select the Edit button and select Financial Data from the drop-down.-Navigate to the Payment Data tab.-Cause-The help center document titled Configuration: Migration of Suppliers, suggests that the Migration of account determination groups payables using the migration tool is a mandatory follow on activity to assign Financial Data to suppliers, after the Migration of Suppliers. Hence, the cause for this behavior is that the Migration of Account Determination has not been performed as a follow up.-Resolution-Post the Migration of Suppliers, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Show Activities and Find activity: Migration of Suppliers.-Hyperlink: Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool.-Upload the populated template.-Select Execute Migration and complete subsequent actions as presented by the system.-See Also-Configuration: Migration of Suppliers-Keywords-financial data, missing, payment data, supplier, migration-migration of suppliers,payment data,migrate account determination groups pay,payment data is not visible

Title: Currency Conversion Failed Due to Missing Exchange Rates
Content: Symptom-Error occurs when trying to clear a clearing document 123(123 here represents Clearing ID) 'Currency conversion failed due to missing Exchange rates. Maintain the Exchange rates for conversion from (for Eg: Singapore Dollar to Pound Sterling )for Mid Rate'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Go to the Supplier Accounts Sub view.-Show All Suppliers and Find Supplier ID.-Select the Supplier ID and choose view.-Go to Open items and choose Clearing Id.-Click on Clear.-Cause-Exchange rates are not maintained between the two currencies in Set of Books.-Resolution-Maintain the Exchange rates by following steps:-Go to the General Ledger Work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the Edit Exchange Rates Subview.-Go to Edit Exchange History.-Enter the Exchange rate between the two currencies and Valid From Date for the required Exchange Rate Type.-Keywords-Currency conversion,Manual clearing,Exchange Rates

Title: Error message in report assignment: Work Center View ABC cannot be used for report assignment
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign a report to a PDI created work center view, however you receive the following error message:-Work Center View ABC cannot be used for report assignment. Please deselect. (where ABC stands for the custom work center view)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Search for your report.-Click Assign.-Select your custom work center and work center view and tick the Assign option.-Save.-You receive the message above.-Cause-There is no stable anchor assigned to this work center view.-Resolution-Please set a stable anchor for this work center view. For more details on this you can check the help center, in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio Guide, articles "Create a Report", "Add a Report List to a Work Center", "Anchors" and "Define an Anchor for a Floorplan".-Keywords-Work Center View cannot be used for report assignment, pdi, sdk, report, assign, cannot assign report, assignment, reporting, error message, custom data source

Title: No Pricing Information in a Sales Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You notice that there is no pricing information in a sales document such as a service order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use service orders as an example:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Open service order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-In the Item Pricing section click on the Expand All button.-No pricing components exist for any of the line items.- Logon to the Backend:-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Load the Business Object SERVICE_ORDER.-Load the query ROOT-QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter XYZ in the ID/content field and execute the query.-Right click on XYZ and select Message Monitoring ->  Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow-You will find an XI message in status Red:-Sender Party: ServiceOrderProcessing-Receiver Interface Name: AccountingSalesAndPurchasingAccountingIn-Error: SalesAndPurchasingAccountingNotification XYZ SalesItem XX: Pricing information missing (XX represents the line item number).-  Cause-Item price components are missing in follow up documents. The root cause has been fixed with HF 55756 which has been deployed for 1308 with SPS 15. However this hotfix will only ensure that the issue will not occur again. For existing sales document a manual fix is required.-Resolution-For Direct Support:-Inform the customer that the document needs to be corrected via a Backend correction and get the approval from the customer for this correction. Once you got the approval please send the Incident to Expert Support CRM.-For Expert Support CRM & Managed Services:-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Load the Business Object SERVICE_ORDER.-Load the query ROOT-QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter XYZ in the ID/content field and execute the query.-Copy the Root NODE_ID of the affected service order XYZ. -Logon to the Backend transaction SE38. -Enter FIX_MISSING_PRICE_COMPOENENTS in the Program field and click Execute (F8).-Enter the NODE_ID you copied previously.-If the affected document is a service order select the radio button S_SERV.-If the affected document is a sales order select the radio button S_SALES.--Execute the report (F8).-If the document has been corrected you will get the following information message: Successfully fixed.--Should you not get this information message but for example an error message please note the error message and forward the Incident to development again with the respective error details and a screenshot if possible.-Check in the Frontend if in the pricing components now exist for any of the line items in the Pricing and Invoicing tab of the affected service order.-You have to run report APCRM_TRIGGER_RECON_OB to trigger A2A messages with changes for the Service/Sales Order and the related Service Confirmation(s).-Logon to the Backend transaction SE38.-Enter  APCRM_TRIGGER_RECON_OB in the Program field and click Execute (F8).-Enter the Document ID of the affected Service Order or Sales Order.-In the Base Business Transaction Document Type section select the respective document (Service Order or Sales Order).-In the Service Interface Operation section select the Notify Accounting option.-Execute the report (F8).-You have to repeat steps 2 to 6 the execution for every Service Interface Operation.-You then have to repeat steps 3 to 7 for all corresponding Service Confirmations.-  Now you have to check if the failed XI message has been reconciled. If not you have to manually reconcile the message.-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Load the Business Object SERVICE_ORDER.-Load the query ROOT-QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter XYZ in the ID/content field and execute the query.-Right click on XYZ and select Message Monitoring ->  Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow-Select the failed XI message.-Select the Actions -> Reconcile button.-All messages should be delivered now.-Keywords-Pricing Information; Sales Document; Service Order; Error; Process Communication; Missing Price Calculation Information; SalesAndPurchasingAccountingNotification; Business Transaction; Sales Order cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting).

Title: How To Check if a Field is Used in a PDI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- You can check whether or not a specific field is being mentioned on any PDI script on the system.- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-To check this, you need to have the field ESR Name. If you don't know how to get it, pelase check KBA 2851332 - How To Find a Field's ESR Name.-Resolution-Log in the system backend.-Enter transaction SE38.-Run Report RP_PDI_SEARCH_ALL (F8).-Provide the below inputs:-SOL = ALL.-SEARCH = The fields ESR Name.-ENABLE = TRUE.-Press F8 to run.-You will see a screen with all the PDI scripts that show the field. You can double click them to open the code on the XREP.

Title: Overtime Does Not Display in Overtime Report
Content: Symptom-In the Employee Times Overtime Overview report the Overtime does not reflect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter.-Choose the Reports overview.-Select the Employee Times: Yearly Report view.-In the Employee field, select Employee ID XXX (where XXX represents Employee ID).-Move Time Type from Not Currently Shown to Rows.-Scroll all the end to the right, see that X hours of Overtime are recorded under current year.-Go back to Time Administration workcenter and  Reports view.-Select the Employee Times: Overtime Overview report.-Select the employee XXX.-Additionally, set the Date From / To field to Current Year to Date.-No overtimes are shown on records, end even the Overtime Time Type is not appearing on the rows.-Cause-Overtime associated with an overtime pay type will be visible in the "Employee Times: Overtime Overview" report. However, overtime entries without an associated Premium Pay type will be listed under the Actual Hours column in the report.-Resolution-To ensure that overtime is correctly displayed in the report, it is necessary to add an Overtime Pay type to any overtime recordings in the system. This ensures that overtime hours are categorized properly and appear under the designated section of the report. If no Overtime Pay type is added, the system will default to showing the hours under the Actual Hours column in the report.-Keywords-Overtime, Employee Times, Report, Premium Pay

Title: Time Account Rule not Replicated Into Employee's Time Account Balance
Content: Symptom-The Time Account Rule maintained in the Activity of Time Accounts is not being replicated into the Employee's Time Account Balances tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Then go to the Employees view.-Search for the required Employee.-Check the Time Account Vacation, it's empty.-Cause-The age of the Employee is outside the year's range maintained in the Time Account Types, under activity Time Accounts - Country.-Resolution-Check and maintain the activity of Time Accounts according to the age of the Employees.-Go to the Business Configuration and then Overview view.-Search for Time Accounts - Country.-Click View.-Click Maintain Time Account Rules link.-Check the affected Time Account Type.-Note:The year's range works according to the Employee's Date of Birth.-Keywords-Time Account, Rule, Leave, Vacation, Not Replicated, Zero, Time Account Balance, Employee.

Title: LegallyRequiredPhrase in Form Template XML is not Showing in the Communication Language Maintained in the Account Master Data
Content: Symptom-Form template showing LegallyRequiredPhrase in English, but you expect a different language PQR. (PQR represents the Communication Language Maintained in the Account Master Data)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Edit Invoice XYZ and click on View All. (XYZ represents the Invoice ID)-Select the Output Document and Click on View Data XML. -The Legally Required Text ABC showig in the tag <LegallyRequiredPhrase> is in English. (ABC represents the Legally Required Text maintained for the Tax Exemption Reason)-Cause-The Target Language is missing in Standard Phrases for Legal Text Information.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and click on Open Activity List.-Search for Tax on Goods and Services Activity.-Click on Define standard phrases for legal text information.-Select the country mainatained as Tax Country in the Invoice.-Select the tab which is having the Legally Required Text ABC and Click on Translate Button.-Select the Source Language as English and Target Language as the Communication Language Maintained in the Account.-Select the Tax Country Code and click on Expand Subtree.-Select the relevant Tax Exemption Reason Documentation.-Maintian the Target Language  and click on OK.-Click on Save.  -Keywords-<LegallyRequiredPhrase>, languageCode, Form Template

Title: You Want to Revoke the "Completed" Status of the Sales Order in a Project-Based Sales Scenario
Content: Symptom-You want to revoke the Completed status of the sales order in a Project-Based Sales scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Select the sales order, you find the sales order is already Completed and there is no way to do changes in it.-Now go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view.-Go to the Sales Orders subview.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-The status of the sales order is Finished.-Cause-You have Finished the sales order in the Project Invoicing view of the Customer Invoicing work center.-Resolution-To revoke the Completed status of the sales order you need to change the status of the sales order in the Project Invoicing view of the Customer Invoicing work center:-Now go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing view.-Go to the Sales Orders subview.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Select the sales order XYZ.-Select the Change Status button and choose Revoke Finish Invoicing.-With the above steps the status of the sales order is changed, now you can do the required changes in the sales order.-  Keywords-Sales Order; Project based; Invoice Status; Finished; Not Started; revoke

Title: Metadata Does not Contain Identity Provider
Content: Symptom-The error message 'Metadata does not contain Identity Provider' occurs when you try to upload the Metadata for the new Identity Provider(IdP).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-For SAP Business ByDesign-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the Configure Single Sign-On sub-view.-Go to the Identity Provider tab.-Click on New Identity Provider.-Select the Metadata you wish to upload.-Error occurs: 'Metadata does not contain Identity Provider'.- SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Go to the Administration work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the Configure Single Sign-On sub-view.-Go to the Identity Provider tab.-Click on New Identity Provider.-Select the Metadata you wish to upload.-Error occurs: 'Metadata does not contain Identity Provider'.-Cause-This issue affects systems which use the Single Sign-On method for login to the system.-Case 1: The Metadata does not contain the tag IDPSSODescriptor(your IdP). Without the tag the metadata will not be accepted.-Case 2: An already existing IdP is in the backend with the same key.-Resolution-Case 1: Check with your Identity Provider if you have received the complete and correct metadata. Make sure the tag IDPSSODescriptor is in the new Metadata.-Case 2: Open an case and provide us the Metadata attached to the case with your permission so development can remove the existing IdP and can upload the Metadata in case the customer still cannot upload it in their system after the IdP is deleted.-Keywords-Upload Metadata, New Identity Provider-new identity provider,upload metadata

Title: The Request of IT Contact Assignment is Rejected
Content: Symptom-You are going to create a new IT contact assignment, but every time, the request is rejected by system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Control Center.-Go to the Contact Details view.-Click Create Contact Assignment button to open the creation window.-Select Contact Type as IT Contact, select one user in the Assign to Contact field. The user name copied into the following contact details. In this case, the user name is in Chinese.-Click Send Chagnes and Close.-Aftter a while, you will see the request gets rejected. You are not able to create new IT contact.-Cause-The reason why the creation failed is that in the two fields First Name - international and Last Name - international only Latin characters are allowed.-Therefore a check in our SAP CRM system failed, but is unfortunately not forwarded to the UI.-Resolution-You have to maintain the First Name - international and Last Name - international in Latin characters.-Keywords-IT Contact, Rejected, BYD, C4C
