Title: How to Hire a Service Agent as an Employee?
Content: Symptom-How to Hire a Service Agent as an Employee?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In order to hire a Service Agent as an Employee, follow the below steps:-Go to Personal Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Click Hire Service Agent as Employee.-Choose the Service Agent ID.-Input all the following mandatory fields at least.-Administrative Category-Work Agreement-Agreed Working Hours-Hire Date-Organizational Unit (If the Organizational Unit is already maintained in the Service Agent's General Infotmation, the data will be automatically filled)-Job (If the Job is already maintained in the Service Agent's General Infotmation, the data will be automatically filled)-Click Save.-This task will hire an Service Agent as an Employee.--Note: After performing this action, the Service Agent ID should be replaced with the new Employee ID.-Keywords-Hire, Service Agent, Employee

Title: Warning: "BoM Item Groups: value YES in column Multiple Selections Allowed will be truncated; edit source value" while migrating Bill of Materials
Content: Symptom-You are not able to upload Bill of Materials in migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configurations workcenter.-Select Overview.-Search Migration of Bill of Materials.-Execute the file step-by-step.-Error Message: Duplicate source record detected in the tab BoM Item Groups.-Removed duplicate records from the file.-The import throws warning message: BoM Item Groups: value YES in column Multiple Selections Allowed will be truncated; edit source value.-No records imported after executing the file.-Cause-The warning - "BoM Item Groups: value YES in column Multiple Selections Allowed will be truncated; edit source value" occurs because the value that is allowed for "Multiple Selections allowed" field is either flagged 'X' or blank.-Resolution-If the multiple selection has to be enabled, the field must be flagged 'X'. The duplicate records needs to be removed from the Item group descriptions tab the same way it has been removed in the BOM Item Groups tab.-Keywords-Bill of Materials, BoM Item Groups, "BoM Item Groups: value YES in column Multiple Selections Allowed will be truncated; edit source value", BYD

Title: Dump When Opening a Time Profile
Content: Symptom-An exception occurs when you open the Time Profile of an Employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Mark the relevant employee.-Choose Edit.-Select the Time Profile tab.-Mark the row of the relevant Time Profile.-An exception occurs.-Cause-For this Time Profile, a Schedule Model is maintained as Predefined Work Schedule. This Schedule Model is associated with a Period Model. In this case, the Period Model must include all seven weekdays. But at least one weekday is not maintained. Therefore the Schedule Model becomes inconsistent.-Resolution-First maintain the missing workday(s) for the relevant Period Model:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Time Models view.-Click on the relevant Period Model.-Add a row for every missing workday and maintain properties.-Choose Save.-Now run a Day Closure Run for all affected employees:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Click on Run Day Closure for one Employee.-Select the affected Employee.-Flag the action Set Period Closure Date and maintain current date.-Select Save.-Now flag the action Start Time Valuation and choose Run.-As Valuation Start Date, maintain the start date of the Time Profile.-Choose OK and Save.-Keywords-Absturz, Crash, Systemabsturz, Zeitprofil, Zeitdatei, Bckendfehler

Title: How to Create New Form Template
Content: Symptom-When you try to preview Purchasing Contract, error occurs:  Form template Purchasing Contract variant for language English and country XXX cannot be found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work Center-Go to Contacts view.-Open a contact and Select Preview button.-Cause-The form template for specific language and specific country is not created.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Flexibility view-Go to Form Template Maintenance sub view.-Select any existing form template Purchasing Contract-Select Copy and choose As New Variant -Select country and language-Select Ok-Select Publish-PS. This method can also be used to create other kind of form template for any language and any country which is supported by ByDesign system.-Keywords-New, Form Template, Application and User Management, Form Template Maintenance.

Title: Account Assignment Details not Appearing in Supplier Invoice( Goods receipt doesn't exist)
Content: Symptom-Exception in the supplier invoice "account assignment data missing" for items. where supplier invoice is created  from customer invoice and no Purchase order exist.- or-Error appears when you try to post the supplier invoice from SAP-ERP into SAP Business ByDesign system via IDOC integration, while accompanying purchase order does not exist in the SAP Business ByDesign system.- or-Exception in the supplier invoice "account assignment data missing" for items.where supplier invoice is created  from customer invoice and  Purchase order exist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Filter for All Documents.-Search for ABC and open it (ABC represents the Invoice ID).-Navigate to the Exceptions tab.-Check the messages for all items:-Account assignment data missing for item X.Y; see Cost Distribution ; Account assignment data missing for item X.Y; see Cost Distribution-Cause-Currently for supplier invoice the base document is Purchase Order so account information flows from purchase order to Invoice.-Since there is no Purchase order existing, the accounting information cannot be fetched.- or- If you enable delayed verification mode then due to current limitation the account information does not flow from purchase order to Invoice when no goods receipt exist.-Resolution-1.As per current system behaviour only when Purchase order exists the account assignment details can be fetched on to supplier invoice.-In this case, the intercompany supplier invoice was created with reference to a customer invoice and there is no reference to a purchase order. Hence it is necessary to manually select the Account Assignment Type as ACC - General Ledger Account only.-After setting the G/L account, system sets the invoice status to Ready for Posting.-2. The Account Assignment Type cannot be configured for a specific Product ID, so you can post this idea in our Influence Page - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-3. Also post/search this in SCM forum so that  you may get any solutions if any other customers are following.-For consulting questions use SAP community  Network (SCN) at https://www.sap.com/community/tag.html?id=01200615320800000691-4. If you want account details to be populated under cost distribution during invoice creation, then uncheck the Delayed Verification checkbox in the scoping. Steps to be followed to uncheck this functionality is mentioned below;-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Questions and select the scoping element Purchasing.-Select Supplier Invoicing and Supplier invoice and credit memos.-Select the question; Do you want to use delayed verification as supplier invoice entry capability? Set as No-Finish the scoping.-5.Also, if you still think that based on Purchase orders appearing in reference item column (when you use the delayed verification under Cost-distribution sub tab in Invoice) the Account assignment details has to appear, Kindly put this in ideas forum mentioning the business use case so that based on the votes received our developers can consider for developing it in future releases.-Submit an idea via the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum:-https://ideas.sap.com/SAPByDesign-See Also-3071353 - G/L account missing in the account assignment tab of Supplier invoice or Goods and service receipt-2536409 - Account Assignment Details not Appearing in Supplier Invoice -Keywords-Account; Supplier Invoice; Exception; Data Missing;GL account; Account assignment missing;cost distribution details missing;

Title: Unable to See the E-Mail Address In Business User Overview and Business Partner Data Overview for a Service
Content: Symptom-You are unable to see the e-mail address in the business user overview for a service agent (assigned with a business user) and the edit e-mail-option is grayed out in the Home work center.-You are unable to see the e-mail address in the business partner data overview for a service agent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Case 1: Email address missing in Business User Overview for a service agent.-Go to the Application and User Management work center -Go to the User and Access Management - Business Users view.-Search for user ABC (ABC represents the Service Agents ID).-In the Overview screen of user ABC, the e-mail address is missing.-Case 2: E-Mail address missing in Busines Partner Data Overview for a service agent.-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partner view.-Search for Business Partner ABC.-In the Overview screen of Business Partner ABC, the e-mail address is missing.-Cause-Case 1: The e-mail address of the Service Agent is not maintained in the field In-House Address of the Service Agent.-Case 2: The e-mail address of the Business Partner is not maintained in the field personal address of the Service Agent.-Resolution-Case 1:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center. -Go to the Service Agents view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the Service Agents ID)-Click on Edit - General.-Under field the In-House Address click on the Copy Address hyperlink.-Select the Business Residence for the service agent from the list.-Click ok.-Now the E-Mail field is enabled: Maintain the service agent's e-mail address here. This e-mail address would be reflected in the Business User Overview.-Case 2: -Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Service Agents view.-Search for ABC.-Click on Edit -> Address.-Click on Add Row.-Add Main Personal Address.-Click ok.-Now the E-Mail field is enabled, maintain the service agents e-mail address here and this email address would be reflected in the Business Partner Overview.-Keywords-cannot see, not available, email, Business User Overview, Business Partner Data

Title: Blank Row in Template of Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-The first row of the template in Migration Tool seems to be blank and if you try to execute the migration, you get errors in the Validation step saying "'General': Mandatory value missing in column 'ABC' ".-Obs: In this first row, there should be at least one column filled. It could be one of the last columns, so you can't see it in the Migration Tool unless you scroll to the side.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The XML file has one or more columns filled that are not related to the template and are probably a few rows after the template ends. The system is adding this row as a record, and since all other columns are empty, it is throwing the error of mandatory fields.-Resolution-You need to clear this cell in the XML file and upload it again.-Keywords- empty row, Blank row, template, Migration, ByD-blank row,migration template

Title: Project and Project Task are Shown as Not assigned in the Cost Centers - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-In the Report Cost Centers - Line Items, Project and Project Task are shown as #, which means Not Assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Cost and Revenue.-Go to the view Reports.-Select the report Cost Centers - Line Items.-Specify the Cost Center and other necessary data.-Click the button OK to display the report.- You can see for each line item, the Project, and Project Task are shown as Not Assigned.-Cause-When you check the Cost Center - Line Items report for the desired selection criteria, in the result list, you can, for example, see a list of transaction types being Internal Service Confirmation. A time confirmation credits cost center of the employee and debits the project task. Your G/L Account labor overhead reflects the credit postings for the employee costs. The project task information and the related project details are only visible via the offset characteristics.-Resolution-To see the project task information for each relevant item, follow the steps below:-Go to the work center Cost and Revenue.-Go to the view Reports.-Select the report Cost Centers - Line Items.-Specify the Cost Center and other necessary data.-Click the button OK to display the report.-Go to the Not Currently Shown, and find Offset Project Task, and move it to row.-After that, you should be able to see the related project task information.-Keywords-Project, Project Task, Cost Centers-Line Items, Not Assigned.

Title: Business Task Created for Invoice and its Cancellation
Content: Symptom-A wrong invoice was created and later canceled it. But the original invoice and the cancellation invoice are still in status 'In Process' and a business task that can't be solved appears in the work views of the General Ledger work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center General Ledger. -Go to view Closing Cockpit-Go to sub-view Closing-Relevant Tasks-Search for the source document type (Supplier Invoice, Customer Invoice, etc..) and select the appropriate task.-Click the title and this will open a new screen, where the invoices are displayed with status In Process.-Cause-As the original invoice was created incorrectly and therefore is to be canceled, both the invoice and its cancellation can be set to irrelevant.-Resolution-Go to Work Center General Ledger.-Go to view Closing Cockpit.-Go to subview Source Documents.-Select the unposted source documents and search for the cancellation invoice.-Select the cancellation invoice and click View Business Transaction.-In the new window, click Mark as Irrelevant.-This will set both the original and the cancellation invoice to irrelevant.-The corresponding task will disappear within 30 minutes.-Keywords-mark as irrelevant; business transaction for accounting; invoice; source document

Title: SSO Error Occurs When Trying to Download a Report Template
Content: Symptom-Error occurs 'No endpoint with binding is defined for profile SSO' when trying to download a report template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Business Analytics work center.-2. Go to the Design Data Source view.-3. Select a data source or customize data source(if available).   -4. Click Download Template button.-5. An error appears: 'No endpoint with binding is defined for profile SSO'.-Cause-The active Identity Provider (IdP) is not valid.-Resolution-To resolve the error the current active IdP has to be deactivated:-In  SAP Business ByDesign as well as SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense-1. Go to the Administrator workcenter.-2. Go to the Common Tasks view.-3. Select Configure Single Sign-On.-4. Go to the Identity Provider tab.-5. Click on Deactivate Single Sign-On.-6. Click Save.-7. Try downloading the template again.-For SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center. -2. Go to the Common Tasks view.-3. Select Configure Single Sign-On.-4. Go to Identity Provider tab. -5. Click on Deactivate Single Sign-On.-6. Click Save.-7. Download the template again.-Keywords-Download Template, SSO error, Report Template-download template,sso error,sso

Title: Unposted Purchase Order Error: Currency Conversion Failed due to Missing Exchange Rates. Maintain the Exchange Rates for Conversion from ABC to XYZ for Mid Rate
Content: Symptom-You have noticed an unposted source document and an error message which prevents the document from being posted. The error message is:-Currency conversion failed due to missing exchange rates. Maintain the exchange rates for conversion from ABC to XYZ for Mid Rate-ABC means the Source Currency.-XYZ means the Target Currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center. -Go to the Closing Cockpit view. -Go to the Source Documents subview. -Search for your Source Document ID, in this case the Source Document is a Purchase Order.-Select the ID and under the Details section you can see this error:-Currency conversion failed due to missing exchange rates. Maintain the exchange rates for conversion from ABC to XYZ for Mid Rate-Cause-You are using Currency Conversion Profile DEF and which uses Posting date as conversion date. This Purchase Order has items with a delivery date of MM-DD-YYYY and for those items, the exchange rate cannot be derived.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the View Implementation Projects.-Choose option Open Activity List.-Show All.-Find Currency Conversion Profiles activity.-Open the Activity.-In new screen, find Currency Conversion Profiles and click to open.-Here you are able to check that Business Transaction Type Purchase Order for the profile DEF uses the Conversion date 2 - Posting Date.-DEF means the Currency Conversion Profile.-Resolution-You need to maintain exchange rate from ABC to XYZ as of delivery date of MM-DD-YYYY.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Open the Edit Exchange Rates view in the Common Tasks section.-Maintain the relevant exchange rate between Source Currency: ABC to Target Currency: XYZ.-Confirm the entries by clicking Save and Close.-Now you will be able to post the Unposted Source Document.-Keywords-currency conversion; mid rate; purchase order; delivery date; posting date; source currency; target currency; business transaction; unposted

Title: No User Subscriptions Available in the User Subscriptions View
Content: Symptom-When trying to fetch active Business Users in the User Subscriptions view in Service Control Center work center, the system returns null values.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Select User Subscriptions view.-Show Current Month.-The system reports No Records Found.-Cause-The system behaviour is caused by an upgrade of a central SAP maintenance system. This update takes place regularly every three months. To minimize any negative impact to our customers, it is usually scheduled on a Sunday.-Resolution-Check again after about 3 hours and the information should be available again.-In the event that the problem persists for a longer period of time, create a SAP Case. -Keywords-No records Found, Licensed, Assigned, Over Usage

Title: Validation Implementation for Italy in Customer Invoicing and Supplier Invoicing
Content: Symptom-Since Release 1702 a new validation implemenation for Italy has been introduced.-This feature will allow the user to adjust the posting date of invoice documents in a sequential order. Hence, the documents posted or released will be in a sequential order per the posting date.-Supplier Invoice:-You can only use a posting date that is between the posting date in the previous invoice and today’s date. You cannot use a future date as your posting date.-You can only post an invoice if all the previous invoices with lesser posting dates are posted.-You can only edit a posting date of a document that has not been posted.-Customer Invoice:-You can only use a posting date that is between the posting date in the previous invoice and today’s date. You cannot use a future date as your posting date.-You can only post an invoice if all the previous invoices with lesser posting dates are posted.-You can only edit a posting date of a document that has not been posted.-During manual posting, if the posting date has been left blank, the system will use the system date as the posting date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-[Enter your Cause here...]-Resolution-This is the expected System behaviour.-See Also-1857437 - The Customer Invoicing Numbering Rule for Italy Has Only the Possibility to Have the Same Rule for All Invoice Types-Keywords-Italy; Invoice; Posting Date; Invoicing; Release not possible; release documents in sequence starting with;

Title: Unable to Access SAP Business ByDesign With SSO Using Safari on MacOS
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--When you try to access the SAP Business ByDesign system through SSO login using Safari browser you receive an error message:-Safari Can't Open the Page https://myXXXXXX-sso.sapbydesign.com because Safari can't establish a secure connection to the server myXXXXXX-sso.sapbydesign.com.-        Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Safari browser-Type the URL from your system with SSO enabled: https://myXXXXXX-sso.sapbydesign.com-You will see the error message-Cause-The issue is due to trust between Safari, Business ByDesign (BYD) system and the Identity Provider (IDP) server. BYD system is using DigiCert Baltimore CA and IDP server is using Entrust (or another one) as CA.-Resolution-You need to add the certificates from BYD system and IDP server to the Keychain to allow the access with Safari.-Keywords-Safari, SSO, MacOS

Title: Error When Trying to Download the WSDL File From Inbound Webservice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to download a WSDL file from an inbound service, you receive an error message: 'WSDL not available for service XX (XX is the technical name of the service)'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business ByDesign-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Go to the Communication Arrangements view.-3. Select the communication arrangements you need to download the WSDL file from and click Edit.-4. Go to the Technical Data tab.-5. Click on the Edit Advanced Settings button.-6. Select the Inbound tab.-7. Select the Service you need to download the WSDL file from. -8. Click on the Download WSDL button and select where you want to save the file. -9. An Error occurs: 'WSDL not available for service XX'.-In SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer:-1. Go to the Administrator work center.-2. Go to the Communication Arrangements section.-3. Select the communication arrangements you need to download the WSDL file from and click Edit.-4. Go to the Technical Data tab.-5. Click on Edit Advanced Settings button.-6. Select Inbound tab.-7. Select the Service you need to download the WSDL file from.-8. Click on Download WSDL button and select where you want to save the file. -9. Error occurs: 'WSDL not available for service XX'.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign , to identify if the service is scoped:-1. Go to the Application and User Management workcenter.-2. Go to the Service Explorer view.-3. Search and select the inbound service you desire to download the WSDL file from.-4. Go to the Process Component section.-5. The checkbox In Scope will be inactive.-In SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer, to identify if the service is scoped:-1. Go to the Administrator work center.-2. Go to the Input and Output Management view.-3. Select Service Explorer subview.-4. Search and select the inbound service you need to download the WSDL file from.-5. Go to Process Component section.-6. The checkbox In Scope will be inactive.-Resolution-In the Service Explorer, when you select the service that is marked as not In Scope, click on the Hyperlink found under the Service section. This will open a new window.-In the overview section you will see the Endpoint Activation element that describes By Scoping of Component. This means, by scoping the corresponding component described under the element Process Component Name, will enabe the service.-1. Go to the Business Configuration center.-2. Go to the Implementation Project view.-3. Search and select the current active Project.-4. Click on Edit Project Scope button.-5. Navigate to the Scoping tab.-6. In the scoping search for the corresponding Process Component and scope it. For example, the inbound service ManageCustomerIn points to the Process Component Name BusinessPartnerDataManagement in the documentation which needs to be scoped.-7. Navigate to the Confirmation tab to enable and save the option.-8. The In Scope checkbox should now be selected so you can download the WSDL file from the webservice.-  Keywords-download WSDL, WSDL file, inbound web service

Title: How to Add a New Field to Existing Office Templates in SAP ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 7 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-A new field needs to be added to a Microsoft Office Template Maintenance-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The solution is possible in the work center Application and User Management under the view Master template > Microsoft Office Template Maintenance.-This solution is explained with the following use case/example: To add the field Time Type to the template Employee Activity List - Quick Activity (Billable Projects).-A. Prerequisite-To customize an existing template you would need the following two tools.-A Zip tool (i.e WinRar, WinZip,7-Zip, etc)-A tool to Modify XML Files-1. Download the existing template to our local desktop from the Application and User Management Work Center >  Microsoft Office Template Maintenance >- Employee Activity List - Quick Activity (Billable Projects). In the example a template for English language is downloaded-2. Open the file in excel and switch to the "Developer" tab and click on "Source".-3. If you don’t have the developer tab in your Excel, please go to “File” -> “Options” -> “Customize Ribbon” and enable the check box for "Developer":-4. Once you click on the source button, you should see the underlying data structure associated with it. To determine which cell is mapped to which attribute, select the cell and you can see the mapping on your right-hand side. This also works vice-versa. To map a cell to an attribute simply right-click on the XML field and click "map element". To remove the mapping click "remove element". The bold attributes are mapped to cells in the sheet.-B. Add new fields to the template-To add a new field the data structure needs to be enhanced first. To do so perform the following steps.-1. Locate the "Excel" file stored on your local desktop.-2. Right click and change the extension to .zip.-3. Open it with your preferred Zip-Tool and navigate to the folder "XL".-4. Copy the file xmlMaps.xml and paste it in a new location on your local desktop.-5. Open the “xmlMaps.xml” file that is there on your local desktop with your preferred XML-editor (e.g. Notepad++) --6. Bound the new field "Time Type" to the field of the ECO.-7. Under the complex type add the new field "Time Type".-8. Save the XML file.--9. Now copy the XML file which was saved in step h and replace the xmlMaps.xml file in step d with this new file.--10 Change the extension of the file from ".Zip" to ".XLSX".-C. Modification of the excel template--Proceed with the below steps to modify the excel template.--1. Add the new field "Time Type" in the excel file.--2. Open the developer tab and click on Source.--3 Locate the "Time Type" in the XML source.-4. Bind the newly added field in step a to the "Time Type" in XML. Right-click and click map element in the XML.-5. Now  the new field is added to the excel. At run time the value is passed on to the UI designer field, which in turn gets filled up with the value coming from the ECO/BO. This ultimately gets filled in the excel since it is bound to the field in the UI designer.-D. Upload the new template--Once the changes are ready in the excel file, you need to perform the following steps to ensure that the downloaded content has the new field Time Type added:--1. Under Application and User Management  > Microsoft Office Template Maintenance> of SAP Business ByDesign.--2. Open Employee Activity List - Quick Activity (Billable Projects) Language English and upload and publish the excel file.--3. Once this is done, the download of the excel file will have the newly added field "Time Type" in it.-Keywords-Office Forms, Master template Office, Excel.

Title: Process communication error : Intercompany posting not allowed;Cost Center belongs to different company
Content: Symptom-Process communication error in Supplier quote, as a result awarded quote has not generated any Purchase Order -Environment-Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to Requests for Quotations view -Search for the Request for Quotation ID -Click on View all and go to document flow-Supplier Quote document is having a Process Communication error and Purchase Order is not created out of this Request for Quotation document -Cause-Cost Center and Companies are different in the documents.-The flow of the documents created are as below in this scenario:-Shopping Cart -> Purchase Request -> Sourcing Request -> Request for Quotation -> Supplier Quote -Shopping Cart , Purchase Request and Sourcing Request are all created for Company A -While the Company B is manually entered while creating Request for Quotation document. Hence the Supplier Quote has also taken Company B. As there is a difference in the Company used in the documents, system is throwing the the process communication error : Intercompany posting not allowed;Cost Center belongs to different company. -Resolution-As Request for Quotation document is already published and respective Supplier Quote is created, the company values cannot be modified. Hence, this is the system behavior.-As a workaround, Process communication error on Supplier Quote can be cancelled upon the customer permission. Later the Supplier Quote and Request for Quotation can be cancelled (which are having wrong company). These documents can be created again with reference to the Purchase Request which was already created in the flow before. -Keywords-Company changed, Request for quotation, supplier quote error

Title: Rounding Difference for a Sales Document From Mexico
Content: Symptom-A sales document was created and you would expect that the rounding would be executed to the Total Item Net Value and Total Tax Amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use a Customer Invoice.-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Search for the Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Open the document and select View All button.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Total Item Net Value: 3,612.10-Tax Rate: 16%-Total Item Net Value*Tax Rate = 3,612.10*16% = 577.936-The Total Tax Amount or Value Added Tax shows 577.93 whereas you expected to see a rounding number to 577.94.-Cause-For the country of Mexico there is a country specific configuration which makes the tax calculation irrelevant, hence rounding on header/total tax amount is does not happen. - Resolution-This is currently standard system behavior.-See Also-2919136 - Rounding Difference not shown in sales documents-Rules of Tax Difference Distribution in SAP Business ByDesign -Keywords-Rounding, Sales Document, Not Happening, Wrong, Tax Amount, Pricing, Net Value, Incorrect

Title: Journal Entry for Expense Report from SAP Concur Does Not Have a Line Item for VAT Posting
Content: Symptom-An expense report from SAP Concur has been posted to SAP Business ByDesign via a journal entry. In this journal entry it was expected a line item with VAT/Tax posting, however, there's no such line item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Open the respective journal entry.-Under Line Items section, notice that there's no line item containing VAT/Tax posting.-Cause-The respective expense report has been posted with Payment Type = Company Paid (in the respective JSON file this is indicated as "journalPayee": "COPD"), so there is no VAT-Input Tax G/L Account.-Resolution-The system behaves as expected.-The journal entry posting for an expense report from Concur with Payment Type = Company Paid will usually consists of two line items:-Debit Record to the 'Costs or expenses' G/L Account.-Credit Posting to the 'Other liabilities' G/L Account.-See Also-KBA 2893675 - Error: General Ledger Account Alias XYZ Does not Exist -Keywords-je; concur; vat; payment type; company paid; journalPayee; COPD

Title: Process Communication error - "Account <010101> in chart of accounts ABC: Chart of Accounts missing" occurred in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are facing Process Communication Error for the Supplier Invoice 'DEF'.-It mentions that Business Transaction not yet posted for Accounting.-DEF refers to Supplier Invoice.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice and Credit memos sub view.-Filter it with the Supplier Invoice 'DEF'.-Go to the Document flow.-You will see the Process Communication error icon in red mark.-It mentions that Business Transaction not yet posted for Accounting.-To check the error please follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Process Communication Errors sub view.-Filter it with Open errors with incidents.-In search field, give Supplier Invoice 'DEF'-You will see Sending document: supplier invoice and Receiving document: Accounting-Select that line and you will see the main error as below mentioned-Account <010101> in chart of accounts ABC: Chart of Accounts missing.-Action POST not possible; action is disabled-Cause-Journal entry is not created for the Supplier Invoice 'DEF' due to the above mentioned Process Communication Error.-Account determination is missing for the Chart of Account, You see the G/L account 010101 is not mapping for this ABC: Chinese Chart of Account and the same G/L account 010101 is mapping for other EFG: IFRS Chart of Accounts and due to this the Supplier Invoice is not generating Journal Entry.---Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview sub view.-Search for the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Now go to the Edit Chart of Accounts.-Select the Chart of Account 'ABC'.-Here you will see the G/L account <010101> is not mapped to this particular Chart of Account.-In order to resolve this you have to map the G/L account properly to the relevant Chart of Account.-Save it.-Once this is done from your end, you have to revert this incident to Support so that they can restart the failed XI message from the backend for the Supplier Invoice 'DEF' to generate Journal entry.-See Also-2962580 - Account Determination is Missing for Item Type Deferred Output Tax in the Chart of Accounts Used for Thailand-Keywords-G/L account, Account Determination, Chart of Accounts, Business Configuration, Supplier Invoice, Journal Entry, Process Communication error.

Title: Outbound Delivery Request Quantity Changed Automatically
Content: Symptom-- The planned quantity in outbound delivery request is altered without any user intervention.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-2. Proceed to the Delivery Control view and select the Delivery Requests sub-view.-3. Choose the relevant delivery request and click on the Edit button.-4. In the Total Requested Quantity field, observe that the quantity has deviated from the original customer demand.-Cause-- The discrepancy in the planned quantity is due to the business delivering a quantity greater than the requested quantity.-- When over-delivery occurs, execution documents such as outbound delivery request, 3PL request, warehouse request, etc., have their planned quantity adjusted to match the delivered quantity.-- The actual requested quantity can be viewed in sales order and customer demand.-Resolution-- The change in planned quantity is a result of over-delivery of quantities.-- This is a standard system behavior and does not require any changes.-See Also-- N/A-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, 3PL Request, Planned Quantity, Over-delivery, Business ByDesign, Delivery Request, Total Requested Quantity, Customer Demand.

Title: No Approval Process for Bank Payment Advice Created via Web Service
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Create a bank payment advice with a cash discount in the system (UI), the document is sending to approval. However, if a payment advice is created with a cash discount via web service, it's not sending to approval instead the payment gets cleared.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Service Explorer view.-Search for Web Service Name: ManageBankAdviceIn.-Download the WSDL file and enter the required information in the file.-Login to SOAP UI.-Execute ManageBankAdviceIn web service to create payment advice, e.g. payment advice 123.(123 represents the payment advice ID)-See that payment advice 123 is not sending to approval instead the payment gets cleared.-Resolution-As per the current system design, approval process is not designed for create bank payment advice through web service.-Keywords-Payment Advice, Web Service, ManageBankAdviceIn, Approval, Approve Payment Advice, Bank Advice

Title: Released Execution Model Contains Work Instruction Which Has Been Removed in Production Model.
Content: Symptom-Initially there is a work instruction with content for an activity in BoO. When Edit a production model which using this BoO, you click button Remove to remove this work instruction, and then release the model to planning and execution. However, check the newly created execution model, you can still find that work instruction with content.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon system in English version.-Go to work center Planning and Production Master Data.-Access view Production Models.-Select production model PM_1, click Edit.-Select tab Bill of Operations, select sub tab BoO Structure.-Select activity ACT_1, in the below select tab Activity Descriptions, there is a work instruction for language English, it has content.-Click tab Remove, click Save, click Release Production Model - For Planning and Execution.-Click Open Released Execution Model - Current Released Version.-Select the activity ACT_1, in the below the work instruction for language English still displays content.-Cause-If you logon system in English version, the English version work instruction is the default work instruction for BoO and production model and will be brought to execution model even when you click Remove to remove it.-This rule applies to other language version, for example, Chinese version work instruction is the default work instruction if we logon system in Chinese version.-Resolution-Please clear the content of the work instruction (after that, you can decide whether to click button Remove or not) to ensure no content of the work instruction will be displayed in released execution model.-Keywords-Work Instruction, Production Model, BoO, Execution Model

Title: instantiation lock on Pdi solution - approval process failing to activate: APP1_NTF_APPR_ACTRULE
Content: Symptom-Instantiation Lock on Pdi solution when activating approval process following solution clean-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Perform a clean of a PDi solution -Attempt to activate an approval process in your solution example: /Y1234567Y_MAIN/SRC/CustomObject/Object-Root-ApprovalStatus.approvalprocess-Errors are raised similar to below: -Errors in the create action condition of action rule 'APP1_NTF_APPR_ACTRULE'-Instantiation lock flag is set for task type used in action rule 'APP1_NTF_APPR_ACTRULE'-Cause-This is a known issue following a solution clean-Resolution-SDK activation required of the BO that the approval process is based on - this should resolve the issue. If it does not please raise a case providing all details and permission to activate all affected BOs and approval processes on SAP side. -Keywords-Instantiation lock, Pdi, Failed activation, approval process error

Title: Sales Organization and Distribution Channel in the Document do not Match
Content: Symptom-Customer Returns is showing an error stating that there is a mismatch between the Sales Unit and Sales Organization within the product data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represent the ID of the Return).-Click Edit.-Error: Item 10: The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data. Check your entries in the document or the product master.-Cause-During the document creation phase, some change was performed in the product data, which was not automatically fetched to the sales document.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represent the ID of the Return).-Click Edit.-On the General tab, under the Organizational Assignment section.-Remove the Sales Unit and the Distribution Channel.-Hit Enter.-The system will automatically populate the Sales Unit.-Add the Distribution Channel again.-The error will be removed and you can now proceed.-See Also-2443945 - In a Return the Error Occurs: Currency not maintained in Account-Keywords-Customer Return, Error, Account, Product, Sales Unit, Distribution Channel, The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data. Check your entries in the document or the product master.

Title: Error - "Cost center validity is missing on DD.MM.YYYY" due to this Purchase order is not getting posted
Content: Symptom-You see an unposted source document of type Purchase Order, with the error message which prevents the document from being posted.-Errors:-Cost Center 'ABC' not valid on 01.01.1999. (ABC refers to Cost Center ID)-No profit center could be derived for forecast document item.-No segment could be derived for forecast document item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit sub view.-Go the to Source Documents sub-view.-Filter it with Unposted Source documents.-Search for the Purchase order 'DEF'.-Select the ID and under the Details section you can see below errors.-Cost Center 'ABC' not valid on 01.01.1999. -No profit center could be derived for forecast document item.-No segment could be derived for forecast document item.-Cause-You have maintained the required data and specified the Profit Center for each Subledger is set, but the Purchase order can't be posted. -This is because the Cost center 'ABC' associated with the Purchase order 'DEF' line item is not valid for that date 01.01.1999 mentioned in the error message.-If you check in the system for the Purchase order 'DEF' line item 'GH' the service period is from 01.01.1998  to 01.04.1999.-If you check the respective Cost center 'ABC' for this Purchase order Valid From/To:01.01.1999/Unlimited, which is not matching.- Resolution-To resolve this you have to correct validity of the Cost center 'ABC' assigned to other Purchase order 'DEF' line item 'GH'.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Go to Timelines tab and scroll down to Managerial section.-Revert the Valid From date according to the Purchase order line item's service period.-Check the consistency of the Org Structure-Now, you can save the Org Structure with changes-Once the changes done, please follow the below steps to post the Purchase Order.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source documents sub view.-Filter it with Unposted source documents.-Search for the Purchase order 'DEF'.-Select that and go to Actions.-Give Post Business transactions,-Then you can post follow up documents like the Goods Receipt document or Supplier Invoice document.-See Also-2621591 - Unposted Purchase Order Error: No Segment/No Profit Center Could be Derived for Forecast Document Item.-Keywords-Purchase order, Cost Center Validity, Forecast document, Purchase order line item, Service period.

Title: Handling Cloud Print Manager (SAP Business ByDesign) Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This document helps to provide the details and instruction required to handle issues related Cloud Print Manager from SAP Business ByDesign customers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Important Documentation-Below resources are released for customer and can be shared whenever is required.-Troubleshooting Guide-Cloud Print Manager Solution Guide - Guided Answer-Infrastructure Setup-SAP Cloud Print Manager Quick Guide - SAP Help Portal-Cloud Print Manager for Pull Integration – Installation and Configuration - SAP Community Blog----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------For analyzing a CPM issue, it is required certain details from customer and below is the Template for Printing issues (real output only).- Questions which need to be ask:-a) Which Version of the CPM do you use? (can be found in the CPM Help->About)-b) On Which Operation system is the CPM installed? Windows 8,10, Microsoft server 2016, etc.-c) Screenshot of the logon tab in the Windows services (open the windows services->navigate to the SAP cloud print service, here go to the logon tab)-d) Does the user who started the service is a full windows administrator?-e) Goto (in CPM) settings and do the “cleanup directories” and check whether the issue is reproducible.-If the issue is reproducible, provide us the logs in the following this path.-C:\Users\Windows Admin which has started the service\AppData\Roaming\SAP\Cloud Print Manager for ByDesign-Here get all info’s from all folders as zip file.- Important:-If the status in the output history (and CPM or even if output is email) is successful, what does it mean?-Successful for email means we have successfully sent the mail out.-Successful for printing means we have successfully sent the print task to the printer spooler.-Before asking for a call with customer, keep in mind that this requires access to the CPM and ideally a windows Administrator in the call.-Keywords-CPM, cleanup directories, windows service, byd

Title: Mobile Emulator Link does not work on a Mobile Device
Content: Symptom-While using the Mobile Emulator Link https://myXXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/public/ap/ui/repository/SAP_UI/HTMLOBERON5/mobileClient.html# in a browser on a mobile device, problems occur.-(XXXXX represents the individual system info)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open a browser on your mobile device and maintain the emulator link https://myXXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/public/ap/ui/repository/SAP_UI/HTMLOBERON5/mobileClient.html#-Cause-The emulator is not supported and should not be used other than by SAP Support for testing.-Resolution-To open the System on a mobile device like IPhone, IPad, Android etc. in a browser, use the standard URL only: https://myXXXXX.sapbydesign.com.-Otherwise it is recommended to use the Mobile App.-Keywords-Mobile, IPhone, Emulator, Android

Title: Split Item Is Being Marked as Restricted Even when It is Set As 'false' in Request Payload
Content: Symptom-When confirming an inbound task using the standard API service ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn, the Restricted Indicator remains marked for the new split line item, even if it's set as false in the request payload.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-<soap:Envelope-    xmlns:soap="http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope"-    xmlns:glob="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-    <soap:Header/>-    <soap:Body>-        <glob:SiteLogisticsTaskBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-            <BasicMessageHeader/>-            <SiteLogisticsTask>-                <SiteLogisticTaskID>?</SiteLogisticTaskID>-                <SiteLogisticTaskUUID>?</SiteLogisticTaskUUID>-                <ReferenceObject>-                    <ReferenceObjectUUID>?</ReferenceObjectUUID>-                    <OperationActivity>-                        <OperationActivityUUID>?</OperationActivityUUID>-                        <MaterialOutput>-                            <MaterialOutputUUID>?</MaterialOutputUUID>-                            <ProductID>?</ProductID>-                            <TargetLogisticsAreaID>?</TargetLogisticsAreaID>-                            <ActualQuantity unitCode="?">?</ActualQuantity>-                            <IdentifiedStockID>?</IdentifiedStockID>-                            <InventoryRestrictedIndicator>true</InventoryRestrictedIndicator>-                            <SplitIndicator>true</SplitIndicator>-                        </MaterialOutput>-                        <MaterialOutput>-                            <ProductID>?</ProductID>-                            <TargetLogisticsAreaID>?</TargetLogisticsAreaID>-                            <ActualQuantity unitCode="?">?</ActualQuantity>-                            <IdentifiedStockID>?</IdentifiedStockID>-                           <InventoryRestrictedIndicator>false</InventoryRestrictedIndicator>-                        </MaterialOutput>-                    </OperationActivity>-                </ReferenceObject>-            </SiteLogisticsTask>-        </glob:SiteLogisticsTaskBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-    </soap:Body>-</soap:Envelope>-Cause-In the user interface (UI), when a task is split and the "Restricted" checkbox is checked, all split line items will also have the "Restricted" checkbox checked. The user can choose to keep or uncheck the box and proceed with confirming the task.-When the task is split using the provided API, it currently works the same way as the UI. The split task inherits the same attribute as the parent task. So, if the parent item is restricted, the split lines will also be restricted. However, the items are fulfilled directly and the user will not have the opportunity to change the attribute later.-Resolution-Our development team is aware of the missing functionality and has included it in the upcoming work schedule. It will be fixed in a future release. This improvement will enable users to choose which split lines should not be restricted. As a result, the "Restricted" checkbox will be unchecked for those particular lines. This enhancement will offer users greater flexibility and control when splitting tasks using the API.-Keywords-ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn, InventoryRestrictedIndicator, Restricted, Task, Split.

Title: BYD2405 Show Data Limitation error when sending data to other system
Content: Symptom-Failed to read the request form. Form key length limit 2048 exceeded-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-While using CPQ as middleware , executing a web service in absl results in the following error: -Failed to read the request form. Form key length limit 2048 exceeded-Cause-system limitation as per documentation: -https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_CPQ/f21989f09f494ce1a537942ae2523dc6/e6c842b6d8294bed986c454074deae5d.html-The maximum query string length for GET endpoints is 2048 characters. When this limit is exceeded, an error message (Error occurred!) is displayed.-Resolution-Partner to modify the code so that it sends multiple smaller requests

Title: Goods and service receipts (GSR) created by API has duplicate line items
Content: Symptom-A Goods and Service Receipts is created for partial delivery by API. -Check frontend for the created GSR, there are duplicate line items, and the purchase order item becomes completely delivered.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a non-stock purchase order XXX with only one item (ordered quantity is 10 ea).-Create GSR for it by API. The delivery is partial, for example, delivered quantity is 6 ea.-Execute the payload. -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center and find purchase order XXX, its delivery status becomes Completely Delivered.-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center and find the created GSR. It contains two items like the below image.-Cause-This is because the request payload contains unnecessary paragraph on header level which causes extra delivery.-Resolution-Remove payload that shows PO reference on header level, only keep PO reference on item level (remove below payload):-<POReferenceID ActionCode="01" >-<BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-<ID>XXX</ID>-<TypeCode>001</TypeCode>-</BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-</POReferenceID>-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipts; GSR; Web Service; Delivery; Purchase Order

Title: Dump During Release of Customer Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-** INTERNAL USE ONLY **--A dump happens when releasing a Customer Invoice, preventing the document from being released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find Customer Invoice ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Highlight the document and click the Release button.-A system dump will happen after a few seconds.-Checking the dump logs in ST22, the following dump pattern is found: -Error: MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT-Terminated Program: CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP-Application Info:-CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:CL_APCI_CUST_INV_PROFIT_AEO_TCCP, Include:CL_APCI_CUST_INV_PROFIT_-Info: An exception with the type CM_AEO_TRANS_EXCEPTION occurred, but was neither handled lo-CM_AEO_TRANS_EXCEPTION, Program:CL_AEO_RUNTIME_UTILITY========CP, Include:CL_AEO_RUNTIME_UTI-Info: AEO transformation failed in class  method SET_ROOT_ATTR.-CM_FIA_DATE_TO_PERIOD_CONVERT, Program:SAPMHTTP, Include:, Position:0-Info: Fiscal Year Variant DEF not valid for Posting Date GHI (Where DEF represents the Fiscal Year ID and GHI represents the posting date).-Cause-As the dump info indicates, this dump happens because the Posting Date used in the Customer Invoice is not valid for the relevant Fiscal Year Variant.-Resolution-The Posting Date of the Customer Invoice needs to be corrected in order to be valid in relation to the Fiscal Year Variant. After this, the Customer Invoice can be Released.-Keywords-Dump, Customer Invoice, Fiscal Year Variant, Posting Date, 500 Error, Impossible, Unable, Release.

Title: Unable to Fetch Supplier Contact Using QueryContactIn Service
Content: Symptom-Unable to fetch contact data that assigned to supplier using QueryContactIn service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Request:-<ContactSelectionByElements>-<SelectionByInternalID>-<InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>-<IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>-<LowerBoundaryIdentifier>XXX</LowerBoundaryIdentifier>-</SelectionByInternalID>-</ContactSelectionByElements>-<ProcessingConditions>-<QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>true</QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>-</ProcessingConditions>-<RequestedElements contactTransmissionRequestCode="1">-</RequestedElements>-"XXX" indicates supplier contact ID.-Response:-<ProcessingConditions>-<ReturnedQueryHitsNumberValue>0 </ReturnedQueryHitsNumberValue>-<MoreHitsAvailableIndicator>false </MoreHitsAvailableIndicator>-</ProcessingConditions>-Cause-II_QUERY_CONTACT_IN is defined to use query BUSINESS_PARTNER - ROOT -QU_BY_RL_CP_OR_CP_CUST (Query By Role Contact Person Or Relationship Is Contact Person For Customer), which has customer and not supplier context.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-QueryContactIn;Supplier

Title: Non-Monetary Assets and Liabilities are not Evaluated in Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Korea Country
Content: Symptom-According to KR accounting standards, non-monetary assets and liabilities are to be evaluated in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, however its not available at the moment in ByDesign Product--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Payables/Receivables work center-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run-Cause-Non-monetary assets and liabilities, such as advance payments or prepayments, are not evaluated in foreign currency.-For example, if you pay 100 USD to purchase a tangible asset called A, it is correct to consider that you are holding tangible asset A at the end of the period, not 100 USD cash.-Resolution-Current system behavior-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement, Non-Monetary

Title: SAP Security, Backup and Disaster Recovery Policy in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This document provides information about the SAP Security, Backup, and Disaster Recovery Policy in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-BACKUP SERVICES-The backup services for SAP Business ByDesign provide regular data and archive log backups. The backups are stored in offsite disk and commercially reasonable efforts to restore productive tenants from backups as soon as practicable in case of a disaster resulting in loss of the production data center. The backup services are included in the subscription and provide the following:-Backup service Nonproductive systems Productive system-Service Description Standard Support – restore from disk Standard Support – restore from disk-Replication to remote datacenter Yes Yes-Data Backup Cycle 14 days 14 days-Recovery option Point in time Point in time-Cost Included in the subscription Included in the subscription-Operational Characteristics-Restoration is not a service available on request for customers. It is only available in an emergency situation to mitigate risks from logical errors such as data corruption and other irreparable situations. We recommend that customers request for tenant restore points before important events like data migration, change projects etc., so that a reset to a last good state can be made available quickly.-Backup is performed with the following frequency:-Every day database backup (Monday-Sunday); twice per week with interval of 3 days we take full backup, on other days of the week, we take a differential backup.-Backup will be retained for 2 weeks in the primary datacenter and for another 2 weeks in the remote datacenter.-Log file backup every 30 minutes-SAP performs daily backup replication to a remote datacenter within the same region.-These data backups can be restored in the primary datacenter.-Appropriate processes and automated tools are in place to validate backup integrity, and backup logs are reviewed daily to detect and correct backup failures.-Backup cycles of the productive and non-productive systems are stored for 28 and 14 days respectively.-We are able to restore data to any point in time within the backup cycle.-FAQ-1. What is the backup scheduled for SAP Business ByDesign?-Answer:  Every day database backup (Monday-Sunday); twice per week with interval of 3 days we take full backup, on other days of the week, We take a differential backup. Also on customer request we create restore point and can be rolled back to the restore point when required. The rollback option is only for 14 days from the day of restore point creation. After 14 days the restore point will be automatically deleted.-2. What are other ways can customer request for the Backup of their individual systems?-Answer: Customer can use the Service operations request which is available for the customer called, Restore Point. For more information, refer to the following Knowledge Base Articles:-KBA 2315326 - How to Request a Restore Point -KBA 2653007 - How to Terminate Restore Point? -KBA 2560598 - How to Request Restore/Rollback to Restore Point? --3. The 'Point in time,' is it limited to retrieving data alone from the previous daily backup, or does it offer the capability to recover to a more recent point in time, considering that logs are backed up every 30 minutes?-Answer: To recover data from a specific time or from where it was last saved, we need the latest complete data backup and backups of the logs. If there's a disaster, we'll restore the system using the newest complete data backup along with the log backups up to the point of the disaster.--4. When a backup is performed are there anything excluded from recovery or is all data restored, including the temporary logs?--Answer: All data is recovered up to the point in time when the recovery is performed, including temporary logs. --5. Is recovery possible for data from as recently as 24 hours ago? What is the minimum timeframe for which data recovery is possible?--Answer: Backups are retained for up to 14 days in a geographically separated backup data center, and recovery can be performed within this retention period based on the available backups. --6. Explain the mechanism for recovery to a state as far back as possible using differential backups and log backups performed between full backups.--Answer: Recovery is possible by restoring the latest completed full backup, followed by applying the corresponding differential backups and log backups in sequence to reach the desired point in time. --7. Specify the granularity of restoration from backups. Is it possible to restore only a specific piece of data to past state, or does it require restoring the whole system to a past point in time?--Answer: Restoration is possible only by restoring the entire system to a past point in time; restoring individual pieces of data is not supported. --8. Does SAP Business ByDesign have ransomware countermeasures in place? Is Immutable Protection (which prevents deletion or modification of written backups for a set period) functioning?--Answer: SAP Business ByDesign have retention lock immutability enabled for backups. --9. If data is lost or corrupted due to an incident occurring on a customer's User PC (such as data encryption by ransomware or unauthorized access), it would also be restored from backup?--Answer: In the event of data loss or corruption in SAP Business ByDesign, data restoration from backup is possible.-Recovery can be performed up to the latest possible point in time (including log file replay) within the database recovery process, based on the customer’s requested recovery timeframe. Please note that the exact recovery outcome depends on the nature and scope of the incident.--    See Also-Blog: SAP Business ByDesign Backup-Help Portal Document: Security Guide for SAP Business ByDesign-Further for the SOC1 Reports and Log files, refer the Knowledge Base Article: KBA 2681625 - How to Get SOC1, SOC2 or ISO 27001 Reports for Audits-SAP Trust Center Links related to Security, Data Protection & Data Centers:-My Trust Center-Security-Data Protection and Privacy-Data Centers-Keywords-Backup, Data Center, Data Protection, My Trust Center, Cloud Operations, Disaster Recovery Management, byd-backup, data center,disaster recovery management,restore point

Title: Attachment Icon in Shopping Cart Approval Task is Not Displayed
Content: Symptom-A shopping cart has an attachment and requires approval.-But when the approver is trying approving it, there is no attachment icon in the approval task.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a shopping cart with an attachment and send it for approval.-The approver goes to Home, Inbox to check the approval task.-Select the shopping cart approval task.-In the column of attachments, there is no icon showing that there is an attachment.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior.-The attachments column is for the approval task itself. If the approver add an attachment to the approval task, then there will be an icon displayed in that column. By clicking Actions->Add Attachments, an attachment can be added to the task.-Resolution-Attachment in a shopping cart will not be displayed in the approval task.-See Also-KBA 3415707 - Shopping Cart Approver is Unable to View Attachments in the Approval Task Details -Keywords-Shopping Cart; Attachment; Approval

Title: Status of the package is invalid MDR
Content: Symptom-Error raised in failed Mass Data run - Status of the package is invalid - example: Package 6: Status of the package is invalid"-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Error is raised in a failed mass data run-Cause-1. What does this error message mean? Is there any reason for this to happen?-The error "Package 6: Status of the package is invalid" comes up when the work package sub process didn't come back to the main process with the result within 10 hours. After that the main process writes the above error into application log and will go on to trigger the next package execution.-Solution: Optimize the number of instances processed within a package so that it gets finished within 10 hours. This will improve the performance of MDRO overall.- 2. Is there any impact in the backend?-There could be two reasons why the work package sub process didn't come back to the main process within 10 hrs.-The work package dumped in the backend. In this case, the processing of the instances part of this package would have failed.-The work package running for more than 10 hrs. In this case, the customer would notice that the business document would still be locked by the MDRO but the main process would show the package is invalid.- Solution: optimize the number of instances processed within a package so that it gets finished within 10 hours. This will improve the performance of MDRO overall.- 3. Customer schedule 30 jobs in parallel - is there any restriction for the max amount of parallel processing?-There is no restriction as such. But this is very error prone and the chances of work package failing with lock error (based on the use case) are very high. Also to trigger work package we use RFC calls. If you consider a minimum of 6 work packages per job. Then it will be almost 180 RFC calls happening in the system parallelly which could result in failures based on the system performance and load. So it's not recommended to schedule these many MDRO jobs parallelly.-Resolution-optimize the number of instances processed within a package so that it gets finished within 10 hours. This will improve the performance of MDRO overall.-Keywords-Parallel processing, MDR, MDRO, Locking, locks

Title: Unable to Add Company-Specific Content in Parallel to the SAP-delivered Learning Modules
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to add Company-Specific Content to the Learning Center but you are unable to find the added content in Learning Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Home work center.-2. Select Learning Center view.-3. Select Help Link on the right and click Add Company-Specific Help.-4. Select New > Link and select Save.-After that, you are unable to locate the added Company-Specific Help in learning center.-Cause-It is only possible to add links/files below SAP-delivered modules.-Resolution-Please add Company-Specific Help links/files in the SAP-delivered modules.-1. Go to Home work center.-2. Select Learning Center view.-3. Select the respective Learning Modules and click Edit Company Specific Content button besides the modules name.-4. Select Add and Save the entries.-Then the content will show under the respective Learning Modules.-See Also-Help Document <Company-Specific Learning and Help Content Quick Guide>-Keywords-Learning Center, Company-Specific Help-company-specific content,learning center

Title: Expense Report Posted Twice in the System
Content: Symptom-You have an ICS (ICS stands for Integration with Concur Solutions) integration between SAP Concur and SAP ByDesign solutions, and you notice that an Expense Report, for example, the one with Report Key 123 (123 represents the Expense Report ID), is received twice in the ByDesign system. You want to identify the root cause of this issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Expense Reports sub view under the Concur view.-Search for the Expense Report 123.-You will see that the Report Key 123 is posted twice with the same Posting Date:-One with the status 'Posting Acknowledgement Sent'-The other with the status 'Acknowledgement Sent'-You want to know why it was posted twice.-Cause-Two different Get Concur Document Runs were created by two different users at the same time and on the same date, resulting in duplicate entries being posted.-Resolution-To verify the two different runs triggered at the same time, follow these steps:-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-In the Concur view, go to the Get Concur Documents Runs subview.-Select All Get Concur Documents Runs from the dropdown and look for the Active Run IDs.-You will find two runs created by different users, User 1 and User 2, at the same time and on the same date.-Check the Application Log of these two runs created by Users 1 and 2. Navigate to the Results tab. You will observe that the Expense Report 123 is included in both of these runs.-Keywords-Concur ByDesign, Expense Report, Report Key, Get Concur Documents Run, Duplicate

Title: Not Able to Release a Customer Invoice Due to Error: "Rebate Agreement determination failed"
Content: Symptom-You are not able to release a customer invoice, system raises error: "Rebate Agreement determination failed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Documents view.-Open the invoice ABC.-Click release button, get error: Rebate Agreement determination failed. -ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice.-Cause-You have enabled the Rebates function in the Business Configuration. But there is no Rebate agreement maintained in the system.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Implementation Projects view.-2x click on First Implementation.-Select Edit Project Scope, then navigate to Step 4 - Questions-Expand Product and Service Pricing, then Select Sales Price Specifications. You will see the Group: Rebates (1) > the question "Do you wish to maintain Rebates?" is ticked.-The error occurred because Rebate price component (accrual rate) was selected in error when creating the invoice.-Resolution-You may try to update the pricing in the invoice.-1.Open customer Invoicing WC  -2.Open Invoicing documents and open the invoice KRP-111462-2024 .  -3.Open pricing tab. -4. Click on update pricing button-5. Select completely. Note, it will redetermine the price from price master data, manually added price component will be deleted as well. Please add them again afterwards.-7. Save and release invoice.-   If you are not using rebate agreements, it is better to uncheck the scope for the Rebate Agreement.-Keywords-customer invoice; cannot release; Rebate Agreement determination failed.

Title: Withholding Tax Items Report Shows 0,00 Tax Amount And Tax Base Amount For Supplier Invoice And Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You have posted Supplier Invoice or Down Payment Request in the system.-Now, the Withholding Tax Items report (Report ID FINTAXU08_Q0001) shows Tax Amount and Tax Base Amount as zero (0,00).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to List view.-Open the report Withholding Tax Items (Report ID FINTAXU08_Q0001).-Execute the report.-Here, you see the Supplier Invoice and Down Payment Request shows the Tax Amount = 0,00 and Tax Base Amount = 0,00.-But when you open the Supplier Invoice (SIV) or Down Payment Request (DPR), then you see the Withholding Tax amount is calculated.-Cause-The report - Withholding tax Items is built in such a way that, it shows amount when the SIV and DPR is in Paid status.-If it is in Posted status then system will display the Supplier Invoice and Down Payment Request in the report, but the amount will remain zero (0,00).-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior for standard report Withholding Tax Items (Report ID FINTAXU08_Q0001).-Keywords-Withholding Tax Items Report, supplier invoice in Withholding Tax Items report, Zero Tax amount in Withholding Tax Items report

Title: Extension Field value Disappears when you edit the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The user has created a purchase order and added extension field value, and then ordered the purchase order.-Later the user tries to edit the ordered purchase order and the extension field value which he/she had manually entered, disappears.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Create a new purchase order and enter the value in extension field-Select "Order" on the purchase order-Now try to edit the sent purchase order-The extension field value disappears.-Cause-Under Adaptation mode-> further usage-> extension scenario, you have set such a scenario that system expects the extension field data to be coming from another document like master data.-e.g. "Service - General Information to Purchase Order - Item" -But  if there is no such extension field in the master data, then no value will be populated in the extension field in order.-Each time you edit the order, system refreshes the data and the value disappears.-Resolution-Either the value should be entered in the extension field created in master data so that it comes to the purchase order screen or this extension scenario should be disabled in the order.-See Also-1939964 - Extension Field Value Disappears While Adding A Line Item in the Purchase Order-Keywords-extension field data missing, extension field is not working, wrong extension scenario

Title: Cannot Add an Element to the Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are unable to add business object elements for the service operations already defined in the Web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cloud Application Studio-Open Y Namespace  PDI Solution -Open the Business Object .bo file and check the elements are added node and .bo is activated-Now open the Web service file where, you need to add the newly elements for the Service Operations which are already defined in the Web service.-You will not be able to add the field in Web service under Business Object View tab.-Cause-If you have included a dependent object in your business object definition, you can only select the dependent object node and not the elements.-Resolution-This is expected behaviour of the system, in the patch solution you trying to modify the elements of the service defination web service for an Business Object were dependent objects are defined.- See Also-Modify the webservice-Keywords-Webservice;DependentObjects;elements;datatype fields;

Title: Negative Value is showing in Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are creating a project invoice request but expenses are showing in negative value in the request.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center-Select view Project Invoice Requests-Open the respective request-Navigate to Items tab-Under Times and Expenses sub-view->Expenses available to be invoiced for user shows negative value.-Cause-The same quantity is already invoiced. You can see the details in this path:-Project Invoice Request->Items->Time and Expense Items-> enter the relevant provision date and click on Item details or add the source column and you can see the quantity and invoice reference.-This is the reason why the invoice item is showing negative in the new project invoice request.-Resolution-Kindly remove the invoice item which is in negative and then continue processing.-Keywords-project invoice request, expense item has negative value in project invoice request, negative item in project invoice request
