Title: How to Delete Shopping Cart which is already Requested?
Content: Symptom-You want to delete a requested shopping cart but the system do not show any option to do so.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home  work center-Select the view Self -Services-Select "Track My Shopping Carts"-Open the respective shopping cart which is in status "Requested".-There is no option to delete.-Cause-Shopping cart can be deleted only if it is in "in preparation" status. Once it is requested, follow up purchase request will be created from the cart and so system will not allow you to delete the cart anymore.-Resolution-Once the document is released, the system does not allow to delete it but you can cancel the shopping cart by cancelling the remaining open quantity of the purchase request created as a follow-on document of the shopping cart.-If there are follow up delivery documents and purchase orders, please cancel them in reverse order, i.e. cancel the delivery document first, then cancel the purchase order and then cancel the open quantity in purchase request at item level using Actions-> Cancel Open Quantity.-This will cancel the shopping cart.-If the purchase order is in preparation status, you can delete it and then cancel open quantity of purchase request.-Keywords-shopping cart deletion, partially delivered shopping cart, how to delete shopping cart, how to cancel quantity in purchase request, delete shopping cart in "requested " status

Title: How to Remove the Document / User Lock in Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-There is a communication error in the document flow in a sales order, when checking it in backend, you find the failed XI message with error message:-Operation not possible; business document locked.-Or the error message: User is locked. Please notify the person responsible-It does not help if you restart the message.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Check in frontend:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open one sales order and go to the Document Flow tab-You could see the communication error on the sales order:Sales Order cannot process an update sent by a Customer Demand.-Check in backend in SESFTS, you find the failed XI message on this order with either of these errors:-Operation not possible; business document locked.-Or-User is locked. Please notify the person responsible-You tried to restart the failed XI message, but the error is not removed after you restarted it.-You also tried SM12, no block recording relevant.-Cause-If the user stated in the XI message is a business user the lock can occur due to the fact that the user has a lock or that the user is not valid anymore.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business User view.-Search for the technical user stated in the XI message.-In the details section you can see if the user is still valid and in the OWL you can see if the user is locked.-In this case, please contact the customer and ask the customer to unlock the user.-Once this is done restart the XI message.-If the customer does not want to unlock the user or the user is a technical user you can remove the lock by debugging the Unit Analysis.-Resolution-1. Find out the failed XI message on this sales order. In this case, 00163E0841121EE49AF512970D195092.-2. Go to transaction SRT_MONI, select Technical View and put the message into the Message ID field.-3. Find the failed XI. Click the hyperlink in Queue Name column.-4. On the right-hand side of the screen you will see a red icon indicating failure.-5. Right click this icon in Status column.-6. Go to option Unit Analysis -> Debug Unit with Current User.-7. Press F8 to execute the debugging.-After executed, the status goes to green, and the failed XI message delivered.-Keywords-document locked; lock; User is locked, process communication error, operation not possible, business document locked, backend

Title: Production Model and Bills of Material Input Products do not Match
Content: Symptom-You updated the input materials in a Bill of Materials, but in the corresponding Production Model changes are not reflected.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Product Master Data work center.-Go to the Production Bill of Materials view.-Search the relevant BoM.-Search for input product XYZ. You can see that the material is not included in the BoM variant. -Now go to the Production Models view.-Search for the production model for the relevant production model.-Then choose Open Released Planning Model button.-Select the latest RPM version.-Go to the Products view and then select Input Products view. Here you can see that it is still showing product ID XYZ.-Cause-After you make changes in the BoM, you then need to release the production model for planning and execution. Then only updates will be reflected in the released production model.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-In case, there are hundreds or more of production models to update or if you need to change a range of input products, it is not feasible for you to do this one by one. Then you can use the Automated Actions Production Bill Of Material Mass Maintenance in order to maintain the input products in BoM. You can also Check and release Production Models to release the changes.-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to the Automated Action View-Select the Production Bill Of Material Mass Maintenance Run.-Choose the New button.-Enter a Run ID, Description and an ECO ID.-Select Delete Input Product check box. You can select other option as well.-Enter Input Product XYZ.-Select Check Production Model and Release Production Model.-Choose Next-Choose Select All button to select all the BoMs which have input products XYZ..-Schedule the job as per the business requirement.-Please note that using this Automated Action, you are Deleting the Input Products, not just un-assigning it from the BoM variants.-Keywords-Input materials, Bill of Materials, Production Model, BoM

Title: E-mail Option For Delivery Note Is Not Available In Output Channel Selection
Content: Symptom-The Email option is unavailable for Delivery Notes in the Output Channel Selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Output Channel Selection-Under Show for Rules, select Delivery Note-Select New Rules-Notice under Output Channel, Notice E-mail option is not available for selection.-Cause-The Email functionality is not available for Delivery Notes under Output Channel Selection, which is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-Setting E-Mail as the default option in the Output Channel Selection Rule for Delivery Notes is being planned for a future release.-Keywords-Output Channel Selection, Delivery Note, Output Channel Setting, Email, Parameter

Title: Logon Error Message
Content: Symptom-When you execute a payload from third party tools such SOAP UI or POSTMAN, the tool throws the below error messages.-HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized-content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8-sap-system: XYZ-www-authenticate: Bask realm=“SAP NetWeaver Application Server (XYZ/ABC](alias)*-strict-transport-security: max-age=31536000; indudeSubDomains-set-cookie: sap-usercontext=sapdient=ABC; path=/;HttpOnly;Secure-<html> <head><title>Logon Error Message</title><META http-equiv=“Content-Type* content=*text/html;charset=UTF-8" >< style type=“text/css*>body-Where XYZ is the System ID and ABC is Tenant ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-A Communication Arrangement Setup is in place for receiving Inbound messages from a Third party application or Tool.-When a payload is executed from an application or tool using Basic Authentication with the credentials of a Communication User (a user maintained in the Communication Arrangement), the error message mentioned above is displayed.-Cause-The Communication user is either User Locked or Password Locked.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Support and Technical Users view.-Search the Communication User and highlight.-Select Unlock button.-Execute the payload again with the correct password.-Keywords-Logon Error Message, 401, unauthorized, communication, soap, postman, user, byd

Title: E-Mail Activate Subscriptions For Business Task Management Is Grayed Out
Content: Symptom-You want to enable business users to be notified by e-mail about new business task management items but E-mail channel option is grayed out.-You may receive the following error message: Maintain a valid e-mail address in the employee master data.-You may attempt to tick the checkbox next to business partner data. But checkbox is inactivated.-You hover over E-Mail. You will see the following system message: You can select E-Mail if the notification channel has been selected.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home Work Center-Select Inbox view under Work section-Click on Subscribe to Tasks-The Task Subscriptions screen will be opened-The checkboxes under E-mail column are grayed out-Cause-This can be caused by two reasons:-The task notification using E-mail channel option is not enabled in the project scope.-The in-house communication E-mail has not been added to the business user (employee or service agent).-The e-mail added to employee is not synced to the business user.-Resolution-Case 1:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Click on Implementation Projects View-Click on New to create a new change project. To edit the scope of a project created previously, select the project and click on Edit Project Scope. The new change project or edit change project guided activity is displayed.-Go to Questions step-Select All Elements-Expand Communication and Information Exchange and then Business Process Management options-Select Business Task Management option-Check Yes for the following question: Do you want to use e-mail to notify business users about Business Task Management items?-Go to Review step and then click Finish.-Case 2 (Service Agent):-Go to Business Partner Data Work Center-Select Service Agents View-Select the desired service agent-Select General under Edit button-Click on link Copy Address under In-House Address-Allocate the desired address to the service agent once you allocate the In-House Address the field E-mail will be enabled under In-House Communication.-Enter the in-house communication details, such as E-mail etc.-Click on Save -In case this does not solve the issue, open an SAP case to refresh the assignment in the backend-Case 3 (Employee):-Go to the Personnel Administration Work Center-Go to the Regular Tasks View-Under Personal Changes, select Change Workplace Contact Data-Enter your employee id in the field Employee-You can maintain your email address here-This will reflect under Home work center, Edit my contact data ﻿subview-Case 4:-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center-Search for the issued business user-In the General Tab of the Detail, the e-mail is blank-Go to the Personnel Profile of the related employee-If the e-mail of employee is maintained, raise a case to SAP to do the backend correction-Keywords-Subscribe to tasks, task subscription screen, Abonnements von Aufgaben, Funktion Aufgabenabonnement, Aufgabenbenachrichtigung via E-Mail Option, Benachrichtigung über verschiedene Aufgaben per E-Mail, Fehlermeldung: "Geben Sie eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse in den Mitarbeiterstammdaten ein", in Mitarbeiterstammdaten gültige E-Mail Addresse hinterlegt greyed-maintain a valid e-mail address in emplo,subscribe,unsubscribe,subscribe to tasks

Title: Internal Server Error when Releasing Leasing Contract
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You try to release a Lease Contract. But an 500 Internal Server error/exception error appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Click on Lease Contracts view.-Search for the Lease Contract and click on Edit.-Click on Actions and select Release.-You see the dump/exception error/500 internal server error. -Cause-Currently, when certain master data is missing, such a dump error message appears when releasing a Lease Contract. We are working on improving the Lease Contract functionality to display clear error messages rather than an Internal Server error.-One reason could be that you have not maintained a 'Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets'  for Accounting principle 'XXXX' and currency 'ZZZ' (XXXX is the Accounting principle assigned to the used set of books; ZZZ is the Currency code of the Company's default currency).-Resolution-Follow the below steps to maintain the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview.-Search for the activity - Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-Select the Accounting Principle XXXX.-Press Add Row.-Enter the Currency, Valid From/To Dates, Minimum/Maximum Amount as per your business requirement.-Press Save.-Now, you can Release the Lease Contract.-See Also-2946469 - Internal Server Error when Releasing Leasing Contract Assigned to Free Cost Object-Keywords-CL_FIA_LEASE_CNTRT_CRT_FXA_ACT, dump when releasing Lease Contract, Contract Release dump,

Title: Invoice Split of Credit Memo and Invoice Items
Content: Symptom-You have scoped Invoice and Credit Memo Items in Customer Invoice Request in the Business Configuration Setup, but newly created invoices still split Credit Memo Items and Invoice Items.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the view Invoice request.-Select an invoice request with Credit Memo Items and Invoice Items.-Click Invoice.-You can see that the system creates two invoices, splitting Credit Memo Items and Invoice Items.-Cause-You have maintained different rules for the External Reference Number Determination for Credit Memos and Invoices.-The External Reference Number Determination is a standard Split Criteria.-Resolution-Open the Business Configuration work center.-Find and open the activity External Reference Number Determination for Customer Invoice.-Maintain the same rules for Credit Memos and Customer Invoices.-See Also-KBA 2181036 - When Invoicing External Customer Invoice Request a Customer Invoice is Created Even Though the Total Value is Negative-KBA 1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing-KBA 1720356 - How To Determine The External Reference In A Customer Invoice-Keywords-Invoice Spit; Credit memo; Invoice; External Reference; Invoice; credit memo item; invoice item; +; -

Title: Fixed Asset Migration: The Accumulated Depreciation Differs in Multiple Set of Books
Content: Symptom-While migrating fixed assets using the default Excel, in the posting preview, depreciation values are different for the different set of books, although the same Depreciation Method for both set of books is being used.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Select the Integrate and Extend chevron.-Search and open the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Open the 'Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool' link and create a new unit.-Select the new unit and click Execute Migration.-Click Upload File to upload the Fixed Assets data.-Click Process File and observe that the depreciation values differ in multiple set of books.-Cause-If multiple set of books are being used in one company, only Copy as 'Auto Complete Method' should be used.-Resolution-To resolve the issue with the differences in the depreciation calculation, the Auto Complete Method should be set to 4 instead of 3 for multiple set of books:-After clicking Process File, choose Review Settings for Auto Complete Method in the Convert Values step.-Change the Field Value from 3 to 4.-Choose Confirm Field Value.-  Keywords-Anlagen, Migration, Rechnungslegungswerke, Anlagenmigration

Title: Dump While Selecting the Expense Type in the Expense Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-System crashes when selecting an Expense Type in the expense report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view.-Create New Expense Report.-When select "Expense Type: XYZ", system crashes.-(XYZ represents the expense type ID.)-Error message：-"Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-Details-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Response-500 SAP Internal Server Error-500 SAP Internal Server Error"-Cause-The dump is there because of assertion condition violation.-Delimited tax group 05 [Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope)] used while creating the custom expense types.-  Check from the backend.-Transaction code: ST22-Information on where terminated.-Termination occurred in the ABAP program "CL_ERM_DET_EXP_REP_REC========CP" -in "SET_TAX_FIELDS".-The main program was "SAPMHTTP".-In the source code you have the termination point in line 110 of the (Include) program-"CL_ERM_DET_EXP_REP_REC========CM00M".-TIPs:-This tax group 05 is delimited, since there was a duplicate entry of tax group : Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope), while adding the expense type in the expense report. The same prod tax characteristic code was bounded to two tax groups : 02 and 05. Hence, 05 tax group entry was delimited.-Resolution-It is recommended to use tax group 02 [Domestic acquisition (exempt)] instead, while creating the custom expense types, since the prior one(tax group 05 [Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope)] has been delimited.-Follow the steps below to change the tax code group from 05 to 02:-Go to Business Configuration work center - Overview.-Search for Activity: Expense Reporting - ABC (ABC represents the country name.).-Go to Edit expense types.-Select Expense Type: XYZ.-Under tab Definition, you can see: Tax Code Group: Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope).-Use tax code 02 -Domestic acquisition (exempt), instead of tax code 05 -Non-taxable acquisition (out of scope).-See Also-3221284 - Dump While Selecting the Expense Type in the Expense Report-(Released to Customer)-Keywords-Internal Server error, Expense Report, Dump, SET_TAX_FIELDS, Crash

Title: Customer Project Expense List documents posted to a wrong period
Content: Symptom-Customer Project Expense List documents are posted to a wrong period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-In the dropdown, select "all Invoices", and search for Invoice ABC (ABC means the Invoice ID).-Select the Invoice ABC.-Go to View All.-Go to Items tab.-Open Cost Distribution tab.-The Invoice has Account Assignment to project task: XYZ (XYZ means project task ID) (same for both Invoices). -However, when checking project task XYZ, on work Sub-tab, there is no Service Assigned to this.-On project: For project DEF (DEF means project ID), by choosing Project Task XYZ, clicking on Display History on Work Sub-tab, Time Confirmation X (X means time confirmation ID) is assigned to this project task XYZ.-Hence the difference of expense assignment is posted to a different date, because Time Confirmation X was assigned to XYZ.-Cause-For Project Task XYZ, checking on Work sub-tab, there's no Service Assigned.-On Project: For project ABC, it's possible to see when choosing Project Task XYZ, clicking on Display History on Work sub-tab, that Time Confirmation X is assigned to this task.-Resolution-The difference of expense assignment is posted to a different date, because Time Confirmation X was assigned to Project Task XYZ.-Keywords-project, Customer Project Expense List, period, Time Confirmation, Supplier Invoices, Project Task

Title: Cannot Reverse a Posted Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You reverse a posted bank statement and you receive a successful information message that states that all dependant payment allocations were cancelled or deleted and your entries have been saved. But, the bank statement is not reversed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Select the Bank Statement ID: XXX (XXX stands for the bank statement ID).-Select Actions > Reverse.-You receive the information message: -All dependant payment allocations were cancelled or deleted.-Your entries have been saved.-But the bank statement is still posted.-Cause-The bank statement has a payment allocation that is posted. This payment allocation needs to be reversed first.-Resolution-Reverse the posted payment allocation of the bank statement first, then reverse the bank statement.-Keywords-Reverse Bank Statement, Payment Allocation.

Title: Purchase Order Item is not visible in the respective Project
Content: Symptom-You have created a project and purchase order related to the project has been created with multiple line items, but you are unable to see the purchase order items in the respective project.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to project management work center-Select view Projects-Open the respective project-Select view all-Navigate to Products tab-You are unable to find the respective purchase order item in this project-Cause-The Purchase Order item is assigned to a different project task which can be seen in the account assignment field of the purchase order. Hence, the item is not showing in the correct project .-Resolution-If the purchase order item is not yet finished, you can manually change the account assignment to the correct project task in the order and select "send update" so that it will reflect in the correct project .-Keywords-unable to find purchase order in project, po item missing in project, purchase order missing in project

Title: Error when using the web service ManagePaymentOrderin
Content: Symptom-You are using the web service Manage Cash Payments "ManagePaymentOrderin" and the response is showing the error:-<Note>Changing TAX_CALC_BASE_AMT_GRS_AMT_IND not possible; field is read-only</Note>-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the web service Manage Cash Payments - ManagePaymentOrderin-The response shows the error:-<Note>Changing TAX_CALC_BASE_AMT_GRS_AMT_IND not possible; field is read-only</Note>-Cause-A possible cause of the issue is a missing information in the payload-Resolution-Add the element <TaxCountryCode>XX</TaxCountryCode> in your payload-XX means the ISO Tax Country Code.-See Also-Inbound Service Manage Cash Payments-Keywords-webservice, Manage Cash Payments, ManagePaymentOrderin, Changing TAX_CALC_BASE_AMT_GRS_AMT_IND not possible; field is read-only

Title: Unable to Perform Goods Movement Due to Error
Content: Symptom-You try to perform goods movement but there is an error:-You cannot carry out goods movements involving this logistics area. To be included in goods movements processes the logistics area or one of its parents in the location layout must be inventory-managed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Access common task Goods Movement.-In step 1, maintain all mandatory fields, click Next.-In step 2, maintain Product Moved Quantity and Target Logistics Area ID, click Next, error triggered:-You cannot carry out goods movements involving this logistics area. To be included in goods movements processes the logistics area or one of its parents in the location layout must be inventory-managed.-Cause-The target logistics area is not inventory-managed and none of its parents in the location layout is inventory-managed.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Please ensure the target logistics area is inventory managed or one of its parents in the location layout is inventory-managed.-This rule also applies to Change of Stock when logistics area is changed for stock.-See Also-KBA: 3471982 - Inventory Disappear After Goods Movement-Keywords-Goods Movement, Change of Stock, Inventory-Managed

Title: Error When Migrating Sales Kits in the Migration of Materials Tool
Content: Symptom-An error is being displayed when attempting to migrate sales kits in the migration of materials tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the First Implementation Project.-Click on Open Activities button.-In the Search field, insert Migration of Materials.-Click on Migration of Materials.-Click on Migrate materials using the migration tool.-Select the migration file ABC (where ABC refers to the migration file name).-Click on Execute Migration.-Click on Execute Migration Step-by-Step.-In the simulation step, the system displays the following error:-'Data entered is not valid for Sales Kit XYZ (where XYZ refers to the material ID)'.-Cause-The Identified Stock Type is wrongly maintained for the Material being migrated as a Kit Item.-Resolution-Either maintain a valid entry in the migration template or remove the Identified Stock Type value from the migration template.-Keywords-migration, sales kit, identified stock type, material, byd

Title: The Total Value on Cancelled OTC document is Not Zero
Content: Symptom-You have cancelled some OTC sales documents, and found total value on most of the sales OTC documents are changed to zero as expected, but there is one still showing the total value. This impacts the reporting data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales view.-Search the sales document ABC, you can see its Cancelled Status is Cancelled, but Total Value is not zero.-Cause-The amount values will not be changed to zero after cancellation if the document is inconsistent.-Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-To valid this situation, you will have to remove the inconsistency on the document before cancellation.-Keywords-OTC; Over-the-Counter; Sales Document; Cancelled; Total Amount; Net Value; Tax Amount; not Zero; not cleared.

Title: Unable to Post Supplier Invoice due to Dump or 500 Internal Server Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Unable to post supplier invoice due to 500 internal server error.-or-Unable to load query to pull list of invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Select Edit and select Post.-Error appears.- or-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Go to advanced filter.-Choose some filter values like status and choose Exception.-Click in Go.-You will get Dump.-Cause-When we check the error logs in the backend using ST22, there were some duplicate references created which is stopping the users from posting of Supplier Invoice.-Dump details:-Program error - ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY  -Terminated Error - /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDHAD-Active calls and events:-39 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR====CP    /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR====CM006-   /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR=>/SRMAP/IF_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR~RETR_RNID_GET_GUIDS_TO_NODE_I-38 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_CMN=====CP    /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_CMN=====CM002-   /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_CMN=>/SRMAP/IF_FND_SP_MTHP_CMN~CHECK_EXISTENCE-37 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR====CP    /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR====CM00A-   /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR=>/SRMAP/IF_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR~RETR_PROCESS_LOCKING-36 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_ABS_PD=======CP    /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_ABS_PD=======CM002-   /SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_ABS_PD=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACCESS~RETRIEVE-35 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_LSIVX_SIV_SP========CP    /SRMAP/CL_LSIVX_SIV_SP========CM007-   /SRMAP/CL_LSIVX_SIV_SP=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACCESS~RETRIEVE-Error analysis:-You tried to insert an entry into table-"\PROGRAM=/SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDHAD\DATA=GX_HDRADM". However, updating-the unique table key "SK_OBJECT_ID" resulted in a duplicate entry. The key-concerned may be either the primary key or a secondary key.-The key components of the duplicate entry have the values-"{000000000000000000000000000000ABC;127}" (ABC represents the document ID in the UI).-Resolution-Please refer to the below screen shots:-Check the dump and see which document is affected using ST22.-Then go to SE16 - Enter /SRMAP/D_HAD-Provide the document ID with leading zeros in OBECT_ID attribute and Execute (F8).-You will see two entries that means two invoices with same ID, choose one of the entry that have process type INV and click on Display (F7).-Enter/h and hit enter button on your keyboard twice.-You will see below screen,  you may see that 'using C code' shall appear in any of the tabs like desktop1 or standard etc, but automatically you will see that tab showing  'using C code'.-Double click on 'using C code'.-Under Variables, click on edit button and remove SHOW and add EDIT then hit enter button your keyboard.-Later click on execute (F8).- Go back to the previous screen and remove couple of zeros in the below screen (only remove 1 or 2 zeros), then click on Save.-See the message Database record successfully created/changed.-Close the debugger and click on back to exit the editing.-After removing the duplicate reference entry from the backend the error should be solved, to confirm this search in the UI with the initial ID without the zeros.-Keywords-/SRMAP/CL_FND_SP_MTHP_RETR====CP, ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY, /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDHAD, The key components of the duplicate entry have the values

Title: How to Prepone or Postpone your System Upgrades in SAP Business ByDesign (ByD) and SAP Cloud for Customer (C4C)?
Content: Symptom-You want to prepone or postpone a system upgrade to the next dates or releases.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-For Private systems:-If your organization uses private tenants, you will be having option to prepone/postpone the upgrades. As you will having dedicated system, under that system only your tenants will be hosted. If you want to prepone/postpone that can be discussed via Incidents.-For Public/Multi-Customer (shared) systems:-If your tenants are hosted in the Public systems, where along with your tenants other customer tenants will also be hosted, so prepone/postpone will impact other customer tenants as well, so requests to postpone or prepone an upgrade are supported with strict limitations and are evaluated based on the business use case. All such requests are subject to SAP evaluation and approval. If approved, the upgrade schedule can be adjusted only within a limited window, and changes to a different day or release cycle are not supported. SAP reserves the right to reject any request if the business justification does not meet the required criteria.-Please Note:-The maximum allowed adjustment is up to 4 hours only.-Approval is not guaranteed and depends on SAP evaluation.-Note:-Please verify whether the system is Public/Private Edition, if you are not sure, create incident to SAP for the same.-If you are in private edition, we would be requiring the Future date in the format DD/MM/YYYY and Time zone only in UTC along with that, please specify the tenant URL for which upgrade timeline to be changed.-If you want to change the upgrade timeline, incident to be created at least week before (not in same week/ a day/2 day before), so that we can align with our internal teams and accommodate the changes accordingly.-If you are in public edition, upgrade schedule changes are limited and subject to SAP. The maximum possible adjustment is up to 4 hours, and approval is not guaranteed.-Keywords-Postpone a Release upgrade, Delay an upgrade, Upgrade.

Title: Ship-To Location not Filled in the B2B Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have released the customer invoice and system creates B2B supplier invoice automatically however Ship-To location appears blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Company A and Company B are connected via Webservices-Company A sends a Purchase Order to Company B with a Ship to Location of a 3rd Party Warehouse provider. Externally managed location is maintained in the Logistic layout-A Sales Order is created automatically in Company B. (Ship to Location is clearly seen in the Sales Order and also the Delivery)-Outbound Delivery is performed and a Customer invoice is Posted in the Company B-In the Company A, delivery document is created in the Third party Logistics Work Center -External Reference ID is added with the prefix and is saved  -Inbound delivery is created and is released in Company A-When a Customer invoice is posted Company B,system creates Supplier invoice in Company A -However Ship to is missing in the supplier invoice-Cause-For B2B messages, the Ship-To location information is not sent and therefore cannot be defaulted. Additionally, there is a new requirement to read this information from the Purchase Order item instead of the product recipient party, as the latter does not provide the necessary information.-Resolution-Our development team is aware of this and has already added it to the work schedule. The problem will be resolved in a future release. In the meantime, customers can manually enter the Ship-To location and post the invoice as a workaround.-Keywords-Ship-To location not filled in B2B supplier invoice; Ship-To location is blank.

Title: E-Mail Address Not Displaying in Business User Details
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In the Application and User Management Work Center, the E-Mail field in the Details section of a business user is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Access the Business Users Work Center View.-Search for business user XYZ (where XYZ stands for the ID of an actual business user demonstrating this behavior).-Select the user.-Below the OWL (object work list), you can find the business user's Details; in the General Data, you can see that the E-Mail field is empty.-Cause-The e-mail of a business user will be pulled from the Communication Data section of the Personnel Administration record for the employee associated with the mentioned business user. First, ensure that an e-mail address was actually maintained in the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees view.-Search and select the employee associated with business user XYZ.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Employment tab.-Navigate to the Workplace Contact Data sub-tab.-Check the E-Mail field under the Communication Data section.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, the e-mail should be maintained in the field mentioned above.-If the e-mail is correctly maintained in the employee's Personnel Administration record, then it is possible that the IDENTITY business object has inconsistent/null references in the address attributes, which is why the e-mail address is not being determined in the business user's details. To confirm this:-Log on to the system's backend.-Open transaction SESFTS (BO Test Shell).-Input IDENTITY in the Load BO by Proxy Name field, then press Enter.-Click Load By Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ID.-Provide the User ID of the user  — in this example, XYZ — in the field ID/content field (It is also possible to provide the Identity UUID in the field "GUID of the Identity" which it is obtained in the Identity BO in test shell (SESFTS)). -Click the Continue button (or press Enter).-The user's ADDRESS_HOST_TYPE_CODE and ADDRESS_UUID-CONTENT attributes will be blank.-To resolve this, follow the instructions below:-Open transaction SE38.-Input report name RAPID_USER_ADDRESS_CHECK and click Execute (or press F8).-In the User field, provide the Technical ID of the required user.-To run the corrective report for all users in the system, leave the User field empty.-Uncheck the Test mode box.-Click Execute (or press F8).-The run will correct the issue and display a list of users corrected once done. If the report is run with the Test mode box checked, it will show a list of the users impacted as well, but won't execute any corrections.-If the report doesn't fix the user(s), send the incident to the SRD-CC-IAM development component.-Keywords-Business User, No E-Mail, Details, byd

Title: How to create the perfect case for Solution Manager Diagnostics component and subcomponents
Content: Symptom-You want to create a support case for SAP Solution manager Diagnostics (SV-SMG-DIA*) component  and you want to know which information and details you need to provide in the case.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager-SAP enhancement package for SAP Solution Manager-Resolution-1. Before Creating the case-Go to the SAP Solution Manager SCN channel. There you will find links to the SCN forum, SAP Help documentation, hot notes, KBAs and much more. Perform this task first since a large number of issues can be solved by existing documentation, specially if it is a consulting or a common issue.-SCN SAP Solution Manager Overview-SCN SAP Solution Manager Community Forum-Diagnostics Wiki Homepage-If you can't find solution during search, check the following KBAs:-2172375 - How we search [Video] -2081285 - How to get best results from an SAP search?-When creating the case, you will be given the option to search for notes about your issue. Again, always perform this task since a large number of issues can be solved by already existing notes or knowledgebase articles (KBA). For some hints on efficient note search, review KBA 2388433 - Information about using Expert Search for SAP Notes & KBAs - SAP for Me-Always take your time to read and answer the Component Specific Questions section during case creation, which will provide you with additional valuable information. SAP KBA/Note 2082327 assists on finding the right component area.-2082327 - How to speed up case processing SD-Respect case's priorities, as described in the below note. Make sure your issue fulfills the requirements for the selected priority, especially in case of Very High priority.-67739 - Priority of problem cases-Make sure to select the correct component for your case. Creating the case in the wrong component can lead to increased processing times.-VAR Customers: For VAR customers, check the following points:-a. Make sure you are the VAR for your customer. Check with your SAP contract department if you are not sure.--b. Make sure you have maintained the AISUSER table as per the following Wiki:-   http://wiki.sdn.sap.com/wiki/x/cweUDw--c. For VAR Go-Live:-   1285423 - Go-live with Solution Manager for VAR--ISV Customers: Make sure that you are using the standard webservice ICT_SERVICE_DESK_API. Also, check the following Wiki and make sure you have activated the interface correctly:-http://scn.sap.com/community/it-management/alm/solution-manager/blog/2013/03/09/activating-ictservicedeskapi-in-71-2. System Connections-In order for us to analyze the issue, in most cases it will be necessary to logon to your system. Whenever possible try to reproduce your issue in a test or development environment and provide us with access to this system instead of your production system. The following connection types are commonly used for analyzing an ERP SD case.-R/3 service connection (also called as SAPGUI connection): refer to the following note, on how to open this kind of connection:-812732 - R/3 support service connection-HTTP connection: for vast majority of SD cases HTTP connection is not necessary. Nevertheless you can efer to the following note on how to configure this connection type. Maintain the correct URL for your portal:-592085 - Set up the HTTP Connect service-WTS connection: as an alternative to the HTTP connection, we can also use a WTS connection to logon to your system. This type of connection if necessary you find information in the following note:-605795 - Windows Terminal Server connection in remote support-Citrix GoToAssist: this is a replacement to NetViewer tool where a customer can securely share their screen. Refer to the below on how to install and configure Citrix GoToAssist from the SAP Service Market Place.-2026090 - How to install and configure Citrix GoToAssist from the SAP Service Marketplace [video]-LOP: Line Opener Program (LOP). For more information about this, refer to the following KBA:-1757997 - Line Opener Program for SAP SRM-SSO: For the R/3 service connection and the HTTP connection you can configure Single Sign On. This allows end-to-end encryption and avoids the necessity of providing logon credentials to SAP Further details can be found in SAP Note 2562127 and 2562154.-3. Connection Errors-Often, delays in processing customer cases are caused by connection errors. Therefore, always make sure that the opened system connections are working properly before creating or sending the case to SAP. The most common connection errors and their solution are detailed below:-Error: SNC processing failed - resolved by the following note:-1178684 - No service connection: "SNC processing failed"-Error: internal error - resolved by the following note:-1178628 - No service connection: internal error.-Error: partner not reached, Error: connection to partner broken, Time out errors - resolved by the following notes:-1178624 - No service connection: "Partner not reached" (sapserv#)-1178631 - No service connection: connection to partner broken-Error: route permission denied - resolved by the following note:-1178546 - No service connection: route permission denied (...)-4. User Data / Logon Credentials-For security reasons, DO NOT put the passwords directly into the case, instead always use the Secure Area as described in the following note:-508140 - Customer case - Customer logon data--The user must be of DIALOG user type. Also, make sure that the SU01 user is in the validity date with valid password and that it is not locked.-5. The Perfect case-System landscape: describe your system landscape, by mentioning system ID’s and client numbers of your system wherever applicable.-Software component versions: provide your software component versions with SP (Support Package) levels. If you are not sure which components are relevant please use SAP Note 1076573 and refer to type 1 and 2 information.-Steps to reproduce: create a step by step description document which uses screenshots to illustrate the steps leading to the issue.-Be sure to mention all relevant information, such as Transaction codes used, User data, and example data which can be used for reproducing the issue.-Do not attach individual screenshots one by one to the case. Instead use Microsoft Word or Excel as the main document and put the screenshots into a single file with instructions.-Compressing the description document into an archive file is not necessary. Single files of up to 4 MB can be attached to cases.-Specific Sample Documents: Provide the case number that is currently experiencing, or has previously experienced the described Issue.- DUMP: if you are experiencing a DUMP, export it into the .html or .txt format and attach it to the case.-Performance issues: First of all check the following KBA for performance issues with CRM WEB UI:-1676755 - Performance optimization in Solution Manager IT Service Management-If you are expieriencing performance issues, try to reproduce the issue and trace it with transaction ST12, and attach the trace files into the case. If ST12 transaction is not available, trace the performance problem with transactions SE30 and ST05 parallel. You can refer to the following notes for more information:-ST12 Trace: it integrates the ABAP (SE30) and the Performance (ST05) Trace into one transaction. The ST12 transaction for customer systems is delivered using the ST-A/PI add-on (standard add-on for service preparation). SAP Note 69455 provides further information on this subject. The transaction is not translated. It is available in English only and has no official documentation. However, SAP Note 755977 includes a brief instruction.-755977 - ST12 "ABAP Trace for SAP EarlyWatch/GoingLive"-69455 - Servicetools for Applications ST-A/PI (ST14, RTCCTOOL, ST12)-ST05 (SQL trace): you can also refer to the following below SAP Notes, on how to analyze database performance.-805934 - FAQ: Database time-31511 - Program runs very long: Performance analysis-Permissions for SAP Processors: To speed up processing of the case, ensure that any permissions which the SAP Processor might need during the investigation of the issue are granted, and explicitly stated in the text of the case.-As per SAP policies, an SAP Processor cannot perform either a logon action, or take screenshots of a Customer system (for illustrating solutions to that Customer) without explicit permissions from the Customer.-An SAP Processor also needs explicit permissions before test data or documents can be created on the effected Customer system.-The below template text can be Customised and inserted into the text of an case so that any of the above mentioned permissions are granted:-"For the purpose of analysing and testing the described issue, I authorise logon to our system (specify the system) by the employees of SAP Support that are dealing with this case. I also authorize the taking of screenshots by the employee for the sole purpose of illustrating possible solutions to me for this issue. Finally, I authorise the creation of test data and/or documents (specify the test data/documents that the processor is permitted to create) during the course of the employee's investigations".--User Authorizations for analysis: If you grant permission to a SAP Support Engineer to logon and perform analysis of the effected system, ensure that the User provided in the Secure area has all of the Authorizations, Profiles, and Roles necessary to reproduce the issue.--User related issues: If the issue is relating to system Users, specify if only a single User encounters the issue, or if a group / all Users are encountering the issue.-Specify Users that experience the issue, so they can be used for the purpose of analysis.-If specific single Users are encountering the issue, create a copy of one of those Users on the system for testing and investigation purposes. Ensure to place the details of the newly created copy User in the Secure area, and inform the SAP processor that you have done this.--Web UI issues: If the issue involves elements of the Web UI, try to reproduce the issue while temporarily enabling the SU01 User parameter 'WCF_IGNORE_ENHANCEMT' with the value 'A'. -Check the following note which provides further information on the use of this parameter:-1311966 - Switching off customer enhancements for symptom analysis-Provide the results of this test in the case text. (I.E. was the issue still reproducible, or does the issue no longer occur when the parameter is enabled?) --VAR Customers: For VAR customers, check the folloiwng points:-a. Incase of issue with sending case to SAP, then provide me SMBI trace as per the following note:-    1394862 - Trace of communication between SAP Solution Manager and SAP--b. If you still have the issue then answer the following questions:-Is the issue with only one user or with all other users as well?-Is issue with only with one particular Installation number or with all?-Is the issue with only one customer or with all customers?--ISV Customers: Provide the following information:-a. A clear description of the scenario, such as where the case was created and how it was updated.-b. A trace file for the scenario which has the issue. Upload the XML trace in the case. Also, check the following note:-    1163386 - Web service interface tracing for the Service Desk-  6. Also Important-Mention any modifications, BADIs or custom code that could influence the behavior.-If you are reopening an case previously closed in all cases, mention the case number of the closed case for reference. Do not insert the complete text content of the closed case into the new one, rather include a summary and only reattach any files or documents to the new case that were present in the old one.-If you have tried to find a solution for the problem prior to send the case to SAP, list the steps you have made and the notes you have implemented.-See Also-SAP Note 1339209 - Title: Quote for Contract is in Pending Progress Although the Follow-Up Contract is Created
Content: Symptom-The Quote of Contract ABC is completed status with progress status as Pending, although the follow-up contract is created. -You expect the progress status should be Won, in green.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business - Sales Quotes view.-Search the quote ABC.-You can see the status is Completed, and progress shows in Yellow which is Pending status.-Open the quote for contract ABC and go to the Document Flow tab, contract was created. -You expect the progress should be shown Won status in green.-ABC represents the ID of the quote for contract.-Cause-In the Changes tab, you can find the change history of the quote for contract. There is a change created after the quote changed to completed status, where you can see a new quote created out of the quote for contract ABC, and then the progress status changed from Won to Pending.-Since follow-up quote is created, the status in the original quote shows in Pending progress.-Resolution-This is the current designed system behavior.-Keywords-quote for contract; progress; Pending;

Title: Remove Activities (Services) From Edit Time Sheet View
Content: Symptom-The goal is to remove Activities from Edit Time Sheet view. Use-case: for example, simplifying the list of Activities available to employees.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home workcenter.-Got to Self-Services Overview view.-Go to Edit Time Sheet view.-Click Add Row in Time Entry Section.-Open the Activity Value Help.- All Activities and created activated Services are displayed.-Cause-Activated Services (Activities) created in Product Data workcenter could not deleted or restricted in the Activity Value Help in User Interface. It is not possible to delete via backend transaction either because it is not possible to block or set obsolete Services. Further information for Masterdata can be found in KBA 2185206 - Unable to Delete Master Data or Transactional Data.-Resolution-It is the current system behaviour to show all Activities (also called as Services) from the Activity value help in Time Sheet Screen.-Keywords-service, remove service, time sheet

Title: Project Invoice Request gets created Automatically again and again for a closed Project
Content: Symptom-You have a project which is already closed and you have also manually created invoice as well for full quantity, but still project invoice request is getting created automatically every time even when you delete the invoice request in preparation status.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select Project invoice requests view-Select the request which is in status "in preparation"-Select delete-Again next day , another project invoice request gets created-Cause-The project invoice request is created by: Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM), which means it is created by a job run that has been scheduled by the user , hence this schedule is running and creating invoice request automatically every time user deletes the new request. -Project status will not affect when invoice schedule is set in sales order.-Resolution-User should first remove the schedule , then delete the project invoice request, so that no more project invoice requests are created automatically from that sales order item. If the sales order item is completely invoiced, then the status of the sales order will also become completed once the schedule is removed.-Keywords-project invoice request getting created repeatedly, invoice schedule, project status closed

Title: Customer Invoice ID is not Fetching in Manual Sales Journal Entry Voucher Screen
Content: Symptom-You have create a manual journal entry voucher, Journal Entry Type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents, screen variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.; In the Item Details, you enter Sales Doc. Type as 28 - Customer Invoice but the Customer Invoice is not showing in the value help for Sales Doc. ID field.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General  Ledger work center.-Select the New Journal Entry Voucher common tasks.-Select the Journal Entry type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-Screen Variant: 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.-Enter G/L Account: Cost of Goods Sold, Debit Transaction:1.500,000 and Sales Doc. Type: Customer Invoice-Customer Invoice is not showing in the value help for Sales Doc. ID field.- Cause-You can only post to a Customer Invoice in Journal Entry Voucher if there is no reference to any of the below sales document types.-Sales Order-Customer Return-Service Order-Service Confirmation-Point-of-Sale Transaction-Customer Contract-Resolution-You can only select the Manual invoices for Sales Doc. ID field.-This is the system design. And this is long-standing logic and it would be a new requirement to change same.-See Also-Help center: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cc26fd7722d1014805fb12e7529365e.html

Title: Unable to delete Activity Category, Delete button is grayed out
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-You are not able to delete Activity Category, Delete button is grayed out in Assignment of Categories.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Select Open Activity List.-Select All.-Select All Activities.-Search and Open activity Activity Categories.-Select Assign Categories.-Select activity type XYZ. (XYZ represents the name of the activity type)-Select category ABC. (ABC represents the name of the category)-Here you will find that Delete button is grayed out. Unable to delete the Activity Category.-Cause-For each Activity Type we have one default Category which cannot be deleted.-Following categories cannot be deleted:-- 0005-Preparation category for Activity Type 542-Activity Task;-- 0022-Business fax category for Activity Type 50-Fax;-- 0003-Business letter category for Activity Type 65-Letter;-- 0001-Customer visit category for Activity Type 12-Appointmentl;-- 0004-Business e-mail category for Activity Type 39-E-mail;-- 0002-Telephone call category for Activity Type 86 - Phone Call.-This is system expected system behaviour.-Resolution-If you do not want your users to be able to select some of those categories, you can use Code List Restriction to hide it either from all users, or for certain Business Roles.-In this example we will hide the Category Customer Visit for all users.-Go to the Administrator work centre.-Click the Code List Restriction link.-Select the Business Object: Activity.-Select Code to Restrict: Category.-Note: If you use no control field, this will mean that the category will always be hidden, without condition. If you add a control field, the category will be hidden if it matches your entries.-Note: You can select a business role if you want the restriction to only be the case for one particular role. However, if you do that, it will still be available for other business roles.-Save and open.-Click Edit.-Now select the values you want to allow or restrict. For our example: Appointment > Customer Visit > uncheck.-Save.-When creating a new Appointment, the option to select the Category Customer Visit will no longer be available.-You can reverse this restriction by deleting the Code List Restriction and from then onwards, the option will be back.-Please note: the category will still be in your business configuarion. You cannot delete it here.-Keywords-- 0005-Preparation category for Activity Type 542-Activity Task;-- 0022-Business fax category for Activity Type 50-Fax;-- 0003-Business letter category for Activity Type 65-Letter;-- 0001-Customer visit category for Activity Type 12-Appointmentl;-- 0004-Business e-mail category for Activity Type 39-E-mail;-- 0002 - Telephone call category for Activity Type 86 - Phone Call.-Activity Category, Delete button is grayed out in Assignment of Categories.

Title: Report Aging List for Receivables show Employee ID as Unassigned(#) for Customer Account
Content: Symptom-You are executing Aging List for Receivables Report for Customer Account and you see that the EmployeeID is shown as # or Unassigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Show All Reports and Find Report Aging List for Receivables.-Mention the Company ID, Customer Account and Choose Apply-Go to View and choose EmployeeID from Row Fields.-Employee ID shows unassigned against the Customer Account.-Cause-Employee ID is only an Additional Filter in case Business Partner is an Employee.The field is not filled if the Business Partner is a Customer Account.-Resolution-You can try using the Report Account Responsibility Data if you are looking for the Employee ID responsible for the Customer Account.-Keywords-Aging List for Receivables,Customer Account, EmployeeID

Title: Time Zone In User Interface vs Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-The Time-Zone settings for your business user are not reflected in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio, UI Designer or system backend.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-You can regulate the UI time-zone via business user settings, or 'My Settings'. You have to log off and back on to the system for changes you make to be reflected.-The Cloud Applications Studio, however, pulls the time-zone from the backend which is maintained in UTC (+0). The time-zone for the backend and therefore the studio cannot be changed and are not reflected from business user settings.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour. The backend needs to have a unified time-zone to keep the system stable.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]

Title: Inventory Disappear After Goods Movement
Content: Symptom-You have performed goods movement but cannot find corresponding inventory in target logistics area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Access common task Goods Movement.-Move some quantity of product PRO from source logistics area LOA_1 to another logistics area LOA_2. -Access common task Stock Overview, search product PRO in LOA_2, there is no on-hand stock.-Cause-Logistics area LOA_2 is not inventory-managed, while its parent logistics area LOA_3 is inventory managed. If you explore on-hand stock of product PRO in Stock Overview, you will notice the moved inventory is now stored at LOA_3.-This is because, when you perform goods movement and move goods to a logistics area which is not inventory-managed but one of its parents in the location layout is inventory-managed, system will allow this but the stock will be stored at the parent logistics area.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-This rule also applies to Change of Stock when logistics area is changed for stock.-See Also-KBA: 3472040 - Unable to Perform Goods Movement Due to Error-Keywords-Goods Movement, Logistics Area, Disappear, Inventory-Managed, Stock Overview, Change of Stock

Title: Cloud Applications Studio File is Locked by a Support User in a Custom Solution
Content: Symptom-You are trying to activate a file in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK), however activation is failing, and an error is appearing:-'Failed to lock / unlock file /123456_MAIN/SRC/XXXX.xbo for user K123456 in client X'.-'File  /Y123456_MAIN/SRC/XXXX.xbo on solution Y123456_MAIN branch X is locked by SAP_SUPP001 already'.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open Solution: XYZ (XYZ represents your custom solution ID).-Right click the affected file.-Select: Active or Check.-The errors will appear.-You will not be able to Activate or Check in the affected file.-Cause-This issue can occur if SAP Support were working on an case that affected this file.-When you check in a file in the Cloud Applications Studio, a Session ID is created for that lock. This Session ID is what you can see in the Session Administration tool in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-If the SAP Support Engineer was testing this file in the back-end, then the lock would not have an Cloud Applications Studio Session ID. This is why you cannot see the lock in the Cloud Applications Studio Session Administration.-Resolution-Open the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Select: View.-Open the Session Administration.-If you do not see any locks, select the Refresh icon.-If you still do not see any locks, but these errors appear you will need to open an case to SAP Support.-Please let SAP Support know that you have attempted to Refresh the Session Administration and still could not see the locks, so SAP can check in the backend.-Keywords-SDK, User Lock, Cloud Application Studio, Support User Lock, Session Administration

Title: Error List Shows Old Error Logs in Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-Errors are shown in the error list while opening any .xbo or any .absl script for a deployed solution.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open respective solution YABC12345 (YABC12345 refers custom Add-on name).-Solution is in Deployed status.-Open any absl file for example or any other object.-Check the error list its pointing to some errors.-Cause-Old errors are releflecting in error List View, as there is no refresh happened on the error list view.-Resolution-Please ensure  to delete your laptop cache files and then reopen the error list from View menu tool bar.-Example - C:\Users\XXXX \Documents\CopernicusIsolatedShell\Projects ->>> delete the instances from this folder.-These are the temporary cache files which gets generated on every login.-See Also-Please refer to the SAP Cloud Applications Studio Help Documentation for more details.-Keywords-Errors list view; Deployed Solution showing errors; After upgrade extension fields errors.

Title: Unable to Change Project Scope to Track Vacation and Paid Sick Leave in Separate Time Accounts
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to track Quota Accounts for Paid Time Off and Sick Time separately, and a single Quota Account cannot be used to track both. But you found the below Time Account Scoping Question is greyed out.-"Do you track vacation and paid sick leave in separate time accounts?"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Select Implementation Projects view.-3. Select New.-4. Navigate to step 3 Review Questions.-5. Select Human Resources > Time Accounts.-Unable to check question: 'Do you track vacation and paid sick leave in separate time accounts?'-Cause-The scoping question is marked as Protected, which means it cannot to be updated after the system has gone live.-Resolution-You can manually maintain Business Configuration settings to track Quota Accounts for Paid Time Off and Sick Time separately as following (Please note the screenshots originate from an internal system that might vary from your country's business configuration.):-1. Create the relevant Time Types and Time Accounts and link them together.-  2. Add the Time Accounts to Employees Time Profile.--3. Record some entries and check Time Account Balances.-  Keywords-Time Administration; Separate Time Accounts

Title: Sales Documents Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (Item Type) Report Shows Double Allocation Amount for Material/ Sales Document Item
Content: Symptom-In the Sales Documents Actual costing cost breakdown (Item Type) the Allocated Amount appears doubled for output material XYZ (XYZ represents the material ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Inventory Valuation work center go to the Reports view and find the Sales Documents Actual costing  cost breakdown (Item Type).  -In the report enter all mandatory data.  -In the Product field enter material XYZ and press Apply.-You can now see all costing results for sales document items connected with the product.  -Add the Allocation Amount key figure to the report.-You notice the Allocation Amount, derived from the Actual Cost Allocation run. It appears doubled.-Navigate from the allocation amount to the Sales Documents - Line Items report. Here, the actual cost allocation amount appears correctly.-Cause-For produced materiasl the data of the product/sales document item is derived from the Production Lot Actual Costing view.-The Sales Documents Actual costing cost breakdown (Item Type) displays multiplied values of the Allocation Amount when production models involve multiple item types, such as materials as well as services. -Resolution-In the report add the Item Type-Break Down attribute. The allocation amount appears for all involved item type.-Keywords-sales documents actual costing -cost breakdown (item type) report, allocation amount

Title: How to Delete Partially Delivered Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You want to delete a partially delivered shopping cart but the system do not display any option to do so.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Home.-Select the view Self -Services.-Select Track My Shopping Carts.-Open the respective shopping cart-There is no option to delete it.-Cause-Shopping cart can be deleted only if it is in preparation status.-Resolution-Once the document is released, the system does not allow to delete it but you can cancel the shopping cart by cancelling the remaining open quantity of the purchase request created as a follow-on document of the shopping cart.-If there are follow up delivery documents and purchase orders, please cancel them in reverse order, i.e. cancel the delivery document first, then cancel the purchase order and then cancel the open quantity in purchase request at item level using Actions-> Cancel Open Quantity.-This will cancel the shopping cart.-Keywords-shopping cart deletion, partially delivered shopping cart, how to delete shopping cart, how to cancel quantity in purchase request

Title: Created By Field In Attachments For Customer Invoice Is Not The Expected One.
Content: Symptom-The Created by field under the Attachments tab in the Customer Invoice is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice request view.-Select any Invoice request Outbound delivery Invoice request XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Invoice request).-Click on Invoice button.-In the General tab, under Attachments sub tab, you can see that the created By field is displayed as the user who is creating the customer invoice, instead of user who attached the document in the corresponding sales order, since the attachment is flowing from Sales Order to Customer Invoice.-Cause-The Created By field in Attachments tab in the General tab of the Customer Invoice always displays the User who is creating the Customer invoice and not the user who added the attachment in corresponding sales order.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Attachments, Customer invoice, created by;

Title: Cloud Applications Studio: Manage Versions Shows Incorrect Time
Content: Symptom-You open Manage Version for a custom script file and the displayed time is not in 24h format or is missing the "PM" suffix in the 12h-format.-Environment- SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Set your computer to 24h time format.-Log in to your custom solution in your SAP development/test tenant.-Create a script file between 13 and 23 o'clock OR choose a file that have modified between 13 and 23 o'clock.-Open "Manage Versions" for this script file.-You seethat the displayed time is not in 24h format or is missing the "PM" suffix in the 12h-format.-Cause-You have set your computers region to German (Germany).
