Title: How to Troubleshoot and Debug Failed XI Messages With the Error: Changing Data Not Possible; Data Is Read-Only
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You noticed a failed XI message in SRT_MONI with the error: Changing data not possible; data is read only-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business  ByDesign-Cause-The issue occurs if a PDI solution is trying to change a field in a document which is read only at that point in time.-Resolution-We will use the example of a failed message from CustomerRequirementProcessing to SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn-Logon to the backend transaction STR_MONI-Load the respective XI message--Click on the Technical View button-Copy the user that created the XI message--Open a New Session in the backend-Go to transaction SE24 (Class Builder)-In the field Object Type enter the Class CM_ESI_T100--Click on the Display button-2x Click on CONSTRUCTOR--In the Menu bar Select Utilities -> Settings-In the tab Debugging enter the user you copied from the XI message---Click on the green check button-In the Constructor right click on the left side beside the line numbers and select Set External Breakpoint--Go back to the Message Monitor session-Select the Process Communication Error message-Click on the Actions button and select Restart-Click on Yes in the Restart window-The Debugger will open-Double click on the method EXF_EXECUTE from class CL_PDI_SFW_AS_ACCESS of stack No. 32.-To find out the BO and BO Node, the Add-On and the Method on what is modified 2x click on-mv_proxy_bo_name-mv_proxy_node_name-iv_method_name-iv_partner_esr_ns-You will see the respective value for the variables in the Variables 1 side window---In our example this would be:-The modification is happening on BO SalesOrder on the Item node-The Method in which the modification happens is DETERMINE_AFTER_MODIFY-The Add-On which is trying to modify the Sales Order Item is Y********_-Now double click in the MODIFY_FROM_BUFFER method of CL_PDI_SFW_AS_ACCESS class and double click on "lt_lcp_modif" from line 159.-Double click in the variable "mv_proxy_bo_name" from line 155 as well and will be able to check the modifications done in the affected Business Object, in this case SALES_ORDER--In the Variables 1 tab, double click on variable "LT_LCP_MODIF" to check the table content.-Now double click on the Standard Table from "CHANGED_ATTRIBUTES".-The values shown here are the extension fields being changed by the PDI script file. Take note of these values.--Back in the debugger, change to the Standard tab and hit F8 so the debugger continues to run and finish the process.-Remove the External Breakpoint. -You can search for these extension fields by either checking the BO structure on ﻿MDRS or in the Extensibility: Field Viewer transaction /n/ext/field, so you can obtain the extension field UI Text or Label-Right mouse click and select Find. -In the Find field, add the Extension field without the Prefix EXT- , without the Suffix -CONTENT and change the P to an F. -Click the green check mark.-The you will see the Extension field in question. --You can find out the Field Label and ESR Name for the field.-In our example:-ESR Name           stuckxi-Label (E)              Stuck XI Message Number-Open a new session in the backend-Go to Transaction XREP-Expand the folder Development-Look for the respective Add-On and open the MAIN folder-Open the Folder SRC-We know that the Method was DETERMINE_AFTER_MODIFY on the Sales Order Item-2x click on the SalesOrder_EXT-Item-Event-AfterModify.absl-You can see the code logic of the add-on in the absl script-You can now inform the customer/partner that this is the reason for the process communication error, provide them all details and inform them that the creator of the Add-On  needs to check and correct the Add-On logic.-See Also-2610403 - Extension Field For Sales or Service Order Cannot Be Updated on Item Level via your PDI solution-2838653 - Extension Field For Project Invoice Request Cannot Be Updated on Item Level via your PDI Solution-2424439 - How to Troubleshoot and Debug the Technical Error AP_ESI_COMMON 107-2533413 - How to Find the Creator of an Add-On in the Back End (PDI)-Keywords-Read Only; Read-Only; PDI; SDK; XI Message; failed; stuck; debug, add on, changing data, se24, not possible, extension field

Title: Revenue Recognition run Realises Revenue on Wrong G/L Account for Customer Sales Project
Content: Symptom-Customer sales project ABC is closed. All associated sales order items have been completed for invoicing. -In Financials a final delivery or invoice date is set (Cost and Revenue > Sales Document Items > Dates tab. -The revenue recognition run realises revenue on account XYZ (XYZ represents a G/L account ID) for project ABC (ABC represent the project ID). -But you expect the revenue to be posted to account DEF instead (DEF represents a G/L account ID) according to the account determination group assigned to the customer of the associated sales order and customer sales project. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Open the Advanced search.-In the Project ID field enter project ID ABC. -All sales order items associated with the project appear.-Press Reports and choose Sales Document - Line Items for Project. -You notice that during the final clearing, after the project is closed and associated sales order items are completed, the revenue recognition run realises revenue on account XYZ. -Cause-There are customer invoices created with a different revenue assignment.-In the project invoice request, under Step 5 – Refine Invoice Items, an account determination group linked to G/L account XYZ is maintained. This manual setting overrides the account determination derived from the customer assigned to the related sales order.-To verify this: -Open the Sales Document - Line Items report and identify the customer invoices created for the project.-You will notice G/L account (origin) XYZ.-Open one of the invoices, for example via the Journal Entry ID.-In the Items tab, open the Revenue Assignment sub-tab.-Here, you can see account determination group X-XXXX assigned.-To verify the corresponding G/L account assignment:-Go to Fine Tuning → Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select Account Determination and choose Sales.-Open the Other Income tab.-Since the revenue account was manually specified in the invoice request, the revenue is treated as Other Income.-Locate account determination group X-XXXX in the Account Determination Group: Other Income column.-In the corresponding Other Income column, you will find G/L account XYZ assigned.-As long as the customer project remains open and the related sales order items are not completed for invoicing, the revenue recognition run continues to recognize revenue using the standard G/L account (DEF) derived from the account determination group maintained for the customer.-During final clearing, however, once the project is closed and all related sales order items are completed for invoicing,  the revenue recognition run always aligns revenue with the actual customer invoices. Therefore, if a different G/L account was specified in the invoice, the revenue is transferred from the standard G/L account (DEF) to the G/L account maintained in the invoice (XYZ). -Resolution-The system works as designed: Upon final clearing, the revenue recognition run aligns the revenue postings with the actual customer invoices and transfers the revenue to G/L account XYZ, as maintained in the invoice/s. -See Also-  3017640 - Revenue Recognition Run Realizes Revenue of Contract Item on the Wrong G/L Account -Keywords-revenue, wrong G/L account, revenue recognition run

Title: Cash Position by Transaction Source Report Shows the Transaction Amount in USD Currency Which is not Expected
Content: Symptom-You are running the Cash Position by Transaction Source report (Report ID FINPAYU03_Q0002) and noticed that the Opening/Closing Cash Balance transaction amount is showing in USD currency for Bank Account ZZZ although its bank statement posted in currency EUR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Reports List view and find the report Cash Position by Transaction Source.-Fill the Company ABC, Display Currency Default Company Currency and Go.-You notice that for Bank Account ZZZ the transaction Amount of Opening/Closing Cash Balance is showing in USD currency.-ZZZ Refers to Bank Account.-Cause-You have filled in the data selection, Display Currency as Default Company Currency and the current behavior is that by default it picks the currency as USD only when the Logon User A chooses Company ABC in the data selection, and this user is assigned under Company DEF.-Resolution-This is solely dependent on the logon user who is trying to view this report by choosing Display Currency as Default Company Currency, if the Logon user company and the company in the data selection is not same then system defaults it to USD currency and try to convert the values to USD only and show under Transaction Amount.-Note:-In case a currency conversion between EUR to USD is not maintained then system cannot convert to Default Display Currency which is USD and resulting which Transaction Amount continue to show in EUR only despite the Logon user belong to different company and this use case may still continue to show the same transaction currency EUR amount in this report taken from the bank statement and the currency EUR in which it is posted.-In case a currency conversion between EUR to USD is maintained then the system converts it to Default Display Currency which is USD and resulting which Transaction Amount will show the amount in USD only because the Logon User does not belong to the same company for which the data selection belongs to.-See Also-KBA 1950627 - Report Default Currency different from the Company Currency-Keywords-Transactional Value, default company currency, report, USD currency, unexpected, wrong, incorrect

Title: Unexpected General Ledger Accounts in the Financial Statement Report
Content: Symptom-You have filled the selection of the Financial Statement report but the results shows few G/L accounts which are not expected in this report.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Design Reports > Financial Statement, click on it.-Fill the details and the Financial Reporting Structure PQR (PQR represents financial reporting structure) and Apply.-system loads the data and but some of the G/L and their amounts are not expected in this report.-Cause-Financial Reporting Structure is wrongly mapped with the G/L's that you are not expecting in the Financial Statement report.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Implementations Projects > Open Activity List.-Fine-Tune > Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Edit financial reporting structures > Key PQR (PQR represents financial reporting structure > Edit.-Select the G/L's and delete which are not required as part of this PQR.-This way, going forward the report doesn't consider these G/L's.-The structure forms the basis for creating different financial statements.-Keywords-financial reporting structure with unexpected g/l accounts

Title: Issue With Validity Date in Production BOMs
Content: Symptom-In the Bill of Materials, you have deleted "Duplicates" on a certain date and since then, when you change the "Filter Options" to "By Reference Date & in the Future", the system does not show any Input Material any more for the date you made the change or later.-Environment-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Planning and Production Master Data work center. -Go to the Production Bills of Materials view. -Find and select the relevant Production Bill of Materials.-Click Edit.-You can see the Reference Date is showing today's date and no Input Materials are displayed.-Change the Filter Option to By Reference Date & in the Future.-You can see no Input Materials are also displayed.-Change the Reference Date to a date before the change was made.-You can see  the Input Materials are displayed.-Go to the Engineering Change Orders tab.-Select the row with the relevant ECO ID with which the Change was made.-You can see Deletion Action was done. You can see the Product ID and Product Description are empty. -Cause-On the said date, all the Line items were deleted using the ECO XXX (XXX represents the ECO ID). Hence, none of the valid input products are available to show.- Resolution-System working as designed.-Keywords-Input Product, Production BOM, Reference Date, Reference Date & in the Future, Deletion, Delete

Title: Incorrect Company Name In XML Outbound File
Content: Symptom-The file generated by the system is not correct and it was refused by the bank. The issue is in the Company's name, when the system uses a code instead of the Company's name. -This behavior can be found in the XML file via tag: <Nm><Nm>. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Outbound Files subview. -Select "All Outbound Files". -Search for File ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the file ID) and open it. -Go to Attachment tab and download the file. -Open the file and go to the bottom of the file there is the following tag: <Nm>DEF</Nm> (DEF represents the Customer ID at Bank). As per bank requirements, this is wrong and should be the company name. -Cause-The file is getting the Creditor Name filled with the Customer ID at Bank Code instead of the company name because the Customer ID at the Bank represents the Account Holder Name at the bank.-The Account Holder name has priority over the company name for payments, and this is why it is being passed on in the file. -Resolution-To avoid this issue, we can enhance the company details in the Customer or Supplier master data of the Business Partner, and add the company bank data in the company's financial data (the company can also be a maintained with the role of supplier). To add the company bank data, please follow the steps below:-Go to Business Partner work center-Go to Accounts. -Search for Account ID: ABC (ABC represents the Account ID). -Click "Edit" button > Financial Data > Go to Bank Data subtab. --When Maintaining the Customer or Supplier bank details, we should remember to keep the "Account Holder" field empty, unless the account holder varies from the company name.-This way, the payments can be made without any issues.-Keywords-Company name incorrect, Tag, <Nm>, XML file, Outbound File, Customer ID at Bank.

Title: System Dumps While Trying to use the Find Option in the Org Structures View
Content: Symptom-System dumps when the Find button is actioned in the Org Structures view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management workcenter-Go to Org Structures view-Select the date: DD/MM/YYYY-Select Find-Notice the system loads for a while and then dumps:-An error occurred-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-Cause-The issue is caused due to huge org structures resulting in performance issue.-Resolution-Please follow the below alternative steps to find the Org Structures:-Go to Organizational Management workcenter-Go to Org Structures view-Select date-Select Go to Org Structures Button-Select Advanced hyperlink-Provide the Org Unit ID-Select Find-Choose OK-Now select Edit-Enter the Date: DD/MM/YYYY-Select Find, you will now be able to locate the Org Units.-Keywords-Org Unit, Dump, Find Button, Advanced hyperlink, Organization Management, Org Structures

Title: Unable to remove value in Gross Weight in product master data
Content: Symptom-It is impossible to remove value in Gross Weight in product master data. When trying to delete/remove the value, the following error occurs.-Error: 'Gross weight UoM factor for UoM pieces must be greater than zero'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data -> Materials.-Select any material and click Edit.-Under General tab, remove the value from field Gross Weight.-Error occurs.-Cause-It is the designed system behavior that if an unit is maintained, the value must be greater than zero.-Resolution-It is possible to remove the unit first and then remove the value by following steps.-Click View All.-Go to General -> UoM Characteristics.-Remove the unit.-Remove the value.-Click Save.-Keywords-Unable to delete Gross Weight, UoM Characteristics, UoM factor must be greater than zero

Title: Wrong Credit Limit Value Appears While Currency Conversing.
Content: Symptom-The Credit Limit is not reflecting the expected value for the account when changing currencies in a sales document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will use KRW (Korean Won) and USD (United States Dollar)-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Select New Sales Quote.-Enter the Account and Sales Data.-Under the Item section, click Add Row-Add an item.-Click View All.-Click the Check Credit Limit button.-Info message: Credit limit not exceeded; 944,857,235 KRW is left.-Change the Currency from KRW to USD.-Info message: Credit limit 705,132.60 USD exceeded by 12,884,525.29 USD.-- Cause-The reason this happens is because there is a higher exchange value between the used currencies within the scenario.-Below are the details from my previous memo: -When creating a new sales quote with currency set as KRW, the following logic with be performed to display the message for whether the credit limit is within or exceeded.-Calculation logic:-Credit Open Amount = Credit Open Amount - (minus) Gross Amount Others.--Example:-= 958,439,143.00 - 13,581,907.00 -= 944,857,236.00 -Here the Credit Open Amount is positive, hence it is within the limit and the amount of field (Gross Amount Others) is stored in buffer.-Now, if we change the currency of the document from KRW to USD, we will see the same calculation (logic as presented above), but with different values:-Example:-= 697,381.71 -13,581,907.00-= -12,884,525.29 -While changing the currency from KRW to USD, the system fetches Gross Amount Field (Gross Amount Others) from buffer as mentioned above and the deducts from converted Credit Open Amount.-For this reason the value becomes negative and thus the message informs that the value is exceeding credit limit.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-In order to solve this, there are two alternatives:-Change the currency configuration of the Credit Limit Check from option 2 to option 1.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Credit Limit Check.-Select the line of the Activity and click Open-Check Current Document (1)-Check Current Document and Other Open Orders (2)-Check Current Document and Other Open Orders Including Documents "In Preparation" (3)-Change from: Check Current Document and Other Open Orders (2)-Change to: Check Current Document (1)-Or-In case you would like to maintained the second option for your Credit Limit Check, please ensure that follow-up Sales Orders are completed.-Once one of the above solutions is taken, no error will show. -Keywords-Sales Quote, Sales Order, Currency, Wrong, Conversation, Credit Limit

Title: ATP is Yellow Though No Stock is Available
Content: Symptom-The ATP check is yellow in a Sales order, even though when there is no stock in the Ship from location.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center view.-Open the Desired sales order.-In Items tab, select a line item and choose check availability,-The ATP is yellow(which means late delivery is possible)-Then check the Stock overview and the product is not available in the mentioned location.-Cause-You have not entered any value in the availability check scope under the Availability Confirmation tab of the product master data,-By doing this you specify that you are only interested in scheduled dates and do not want to match supply and demand.-Please check the ATP check documentation in the Help centre https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cb49146722d10148170bd98ad8e0def.html?version=2402-Resolution-Maintain the relevant setting in the Product master data.-Go to product portfolio workcentre and select By materials view-Select the relevant product ID and view all.-Navigate to the availability confirmation tab and maintain the details for availability check scope field.-Keywords-ATP, Availability confirmation, Yellow

Title: Purchase Request ID and Purchase Order ID is Not Generated Once Service Order is Created And Released
Content: Symptom-User created Service order and set to release but purchase request ID and purchase order ID generation is pending.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Service Order WorkCenter -2. Navigate to New Service Order View-3. Fill Details and Save-4. Select Service Order ID-5. Choose Edit-6. Select Submit and Choose Release to Service Execution from drop down.-Once service order is released Purchase Request ID and Purchase Order ID will be automatically created which is not happening here.-Cause-Organizational unit to which Employee belong to is excluded for the operational purchasing in organizational work distribution.-Resolution- -Steps to check excluded org units,-Go to Organizational management workcenter-Go to Organizational Work Distribution View-Navigate to Work category "Business Area: Purchasing"-Select Operational Purchasing-Choose Show Excluded Org Units-User can find the List of Excluded Org Units.-Follow below steps to include the Org Units mentioned in "Excluded Org Units" list ,-Go to Organizational management workcenter-Go to Organizational Work Distribution View-Navigate to Work category "Business Area: Purchasing"-Select Operational Purchasing-Choose Edit-Select Add Rule-Enter Org Unit ID shown in "Excluded Org Units"-Select Save and Close-Once all the org Units shown in Excluded list are included in Work category "Business Area :Purchasing" , User can Run a new Test so that Purchase Order ID and Purchase Request ID will be automatically generated after Service Order is created and released.-Keywords-Excluded Org Units , Include org units, pending purchase order ID ,pending Purchase Request ID, service order released

Title: Not Able to Finalize Scoping Changes due to Error "Solution Profile Check Ended With Content Error; Save Failed "
Content: Symptom-User want to finalize scoping changes but unable to complete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center-Navigate to Implementation Projects view-Select the Project .-Select Edit Project Scope.-Select Edit Countries/Regions.-Choose Country-Choose Ok-Select Next until final step-Select accept pre-selected answers if no scoping changes required.-Select Finish.-System throws Error "Solution Profile Check Ended With Content Error; Save Failed " -Cause-Business Configuration is inconsistent since required scoping questions is not selected.-Resolution-As per the Business configuration and data in the system, Business Configuration is expecting to select below two scoping questions,-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center-Navigate to Implementation Projects view-Select the Project .-Select Edit Project Scope.-Select Edit Countries/Regions.-Choose Country-Choose Ok-Select Next until Scoping questions-Navigate Manufacturing-Choose Warehousing and Logistics-Select Quality Assurance-Choose Sample Management-Select Next for Questions and enable below 2 questions-Questions:-1. Do you want to vary the inspection scope randomly and/or according to the history of inspection results?-2.Do you want to create sample records with unique identifiers and use these to record inspection data?

Title: PCE error"Form template variant"Changed or cancelled purchase order "for language XX and country/region YY not found" or "Cannot confirm output; another item with status "To Be Output" exists"
Content: Symptom-Process communication error in the purchase order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase requests and orders work center-Go to the Purchase orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order -Select Edit and navigate to the document flow tab-Here you see that there is a process communication error.-To see all PCE errors and its error details follow below steps:-Go to the Application and User Managment work center-Go to  Proces communication Error view-Choose 'Open errors with incidents'-Search and select the error related to respective purchase order-The main error is "Cannot confirm output; another item with status "To Be Output" exists" and in the error details you will see "Form template variant"Template type "for language XX  and country/region YY not found"-Cause-You don't have a form template for cancelled or/and changed purchase order for country YY and language XX.-Resolution-Similar to the 'created Purchase order' template which has fall back template with language English and no country, you have to create same for cancel purchase order and also for changed purchase order as well in Application user and Management work center under Form template maintenance view.- or-You have to set up a template for exact combination of country and langauge as shown in error.-Or-In the form template selection view, you might have not maintained any thing for changed purchase order. Once the template is maintained, SAP can clear the error message from the backend.-Keywords- Cannot confirm output; another item with status "To Be Output" exists; Form template variant"Template type "for language XX  and country/region YY not found"

Title: Cloud Applications Studio (Pilot) Freezes While Debugging and Restart Every Time
Content: Symptom-Cloud Applications Studio freezes while Debugging.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications -SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to reproduce from the frontend-Navigate to Woc  XYZ-Open any ticket-Make a demo change on the field for the debug to trigger.-Steps to reproduce from the SDK (Cloud Application studio)-Login to the SDK with the technical user ID.-Open the absl which needs to be debugged.-Add the break point on the absl file.-Activate the debug.-Perform the frontend steps to trigger the breakpoint.-Once the debug triggers the SDK freezes or crashes.-  Cause-The issue occurs because there is restriction in the SAP backend for PDI technical user.-If the PDI technical user password length is more then 40 characters and if same user is performing an debug on Cloud Application Studio then the Studio will crash.-Resolution-If you are using any PDI technical user to debug the script then the maximum length of the password of that user is supposed to be within 40 characters.-Keywords-Cloud Applications freezing, debugging crash, SAP backend restriction, PDI technical user issue, password length limit, SDK crash, SAP Cloud for Customer, ByDesign Solution Explorer, debug breakpoint issue, frontend debug trigger, absl file debug, technical user password issue, SAP backend limitation, SDK freezing issue, debugging resolution

Title: How Products are Sorted in a List Based on the Workcenter
Content: Symptom-Do products get sorted differently depending on the workcenter they're in, even when using the same Ascending sorting setting?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Order Workcenter-Filter by All Orders-Search Service Order-Sort Services and Spare Parts by 'Product ID' in Ascending Order-Now,-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications Workcenter-Filter by All Delivery Notifications by Selection-Search Delivery Notification ID-Sort Delivery Notification items by 'Product ID' in Ascending Order--Although the list of product ID values is the same and the Inbound Delivery Notifications are related to the Service Order, the order of the items is not identical when sorted in ascending order by the Product ID.-Cause-The sorting will vary due to the use of different BOs(Business objects) and data types for the fields. Moreover, in the service order, the product is combined with the description.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-sorting logic , product ID , ascending order , sorting, list , workcenter

Title: Legal Approval Greyed Out For Stock Transfer Delivery
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Stock Transfer Orders (STOs) - India: You are currently facing an issue with the "Legal Approval button" being greyed out in your automatic e-invoicing implementation. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Outbound Deliveries view. -Find and select the relevant Stock Transfer Delivery.-You can see that the Legal Approval Status is: "Approval not Necessary".-Click Edit.-You can see the document is Not Released and the Legal Approver button is greyed out.-If you check the Ship-To and Ship-From Locations, they appear to be in the same State.-If you check the Business Configuration, you can see the customer have scoped the questions:-Do you want to enable the legal approval process for customer invoices using the invoice Reference Number?-Do you want to create follow-up legal documents against Outbound Delivery.-Cause-If you open the relevant Tax Authority, you can see that both the sender and receiver are assigned as 'Assigned Tax Reporting Units'.-Navigate to the Tax Management work center. -Go to the Company Tax Arrangements view. -Open the relevant Tax Authority.-You can see under 'Assigned Tax Reporting Units' that both Sender/Seller and Receiver/Buyer are listed.-This configuration of 'Assigned Tax Reporting Units' is not right. Since both the tax reporting units are assigned to same tax authority the issue happens. -Resolution-Please maintain the correct configuration in the company tax arrangement.-See Also-Stock Transfer Order E-Invoicing - India-Posting of Stock Transfer Order – India-Keywords-Stock Transfer Delivery, Legal Approval, Greyed Out, Outbound Delivery, India, GST, Tax Authority, E-Invoicing, Stock Transfer Order.

Title: How to Set Supply to Production When Using SOAP Request Manageprodmodelin?
Content: Symptom-You are creating Production Model via the Web Service 'ManageProdModelIn'. However, when you try to set the SupplyToProductionRelevanceIndicator in the Webservice, you are not able to do so. Hence, you are not able to create Production Model with Supply Operation/Activity using the Web Service and are seeking advise how to go about resolving this issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Planning and Production Master Data work centre.-Go to Production Models view.-Open a relevant instance of Production Model.-Click <Edit>.-Go to the <Bill of Operation> tab and then to the <BoO Details> sub-tab (if not already there).-You see that you can set Supply to Production directly from the User Interface.-Go to <Product Assignment>.-You can assign Product to the Supply Operation/Activity.-In the Webservice, you cannot find this possibility.-Cause-Webservice 'ManageProductionModelIn' does not have the tag 'SupplyToProduction' relevant indicator to update.- Resolution-You have to set this indicator using the Bill of Operations inbound interface 'ManageProductionBillofOperationsIn' before running 'ManageProductionModelIn'.-Keywords-Web Service, Supply To Production, II_MANAGE_PROD_BOO_IN, ManageProductionBillofOperationsIn, ManageProductionModelIn, II_MANAGE_PROD_MODEL_IN, Production Model

Title: Error: "Reason code invalid" While Updating 3PL Inventory Adjustment
Content: Symptom-An Inventory Notification is created in the system however the document becomes inconsistent throwing an error "Reason code invalid" while trying to update the absolute stock in 3PL inventory adjustment using the reason code 1 - Initial migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics Work center.-Select 3PL Inventory Management sub view.-There you can see the Internal Notification ID.-Select any one Internal Notification ID.-Choose edit.-Go to Item tab, under the Reason field select the drop down you find see only 6 reason code.-Now here user is entering reason code: "1-Initial Migration" manually however system throws above error.-Now, -Go to Third-Party Logistics Workcenter.-Select 3PL Inventory Management sub view.-Go to Advanced filter.-Under the Item Data in the field Reason.-Select the drop down, here number of reason codes are around 34 in total.-Cause-Inventory Notification Advanced Filter have more reason codes compared to Inventory Notification Reason codes at the time of creation of a document.-They have different logic and different BO's mapping for Reason code Value help in the backend.-Inventory Notification Advanced Filter Reason code does not have any filters in logic whereas Reason code while creation of Inventory Notification has value help filter logic in the backend.-Resolution-As per standard SAP, it allows the visibility of only 6 values available in dropdown while creating Inventory Notification with type Inventory change in Externally-Managed location. -Keywords-3PL inventory adjustment, Reason code, Reason code invalid, Internal notification ID, inventory notification ID, external managed

Title: Unable to Update Identified Stock for Output Product in Production Order Through Web Service ManageProductionOrderIn
Content: Symptom-When update identified stock of output product in production order through standard web service ManageProductionOrderIn, there is error in response such as Identified stock 123 not valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In the payload, you maintain identified stock like <IdentifiedStockID>123</IdentifiedStockID>, however, when identified stock contains only number, system can only recognize it in format with 20 digits.-Resolution-Please maintain identified stock in payload like <IdentifiedStockID>00000000000000000123</IdentifiedStockID>. The key here is the identified stock should have 20 digits.-Keywords-ManageProductionOrderIn, Web Service, Identified Stock

Title: Payment Method "External Payment" not visible in the UI
Content: Symptom-Payment Method "External Method" not visible when creating sales order via the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select Sales Orders view.-Click in New, Sales Order and View All.-Under the General tab, go to Payment section.-For Payment Method, select the drop-down list.-You will noticed that External Payment option is not visible in the drop-down list.-Cause-The Payment method "External payment" is not visible when creating Sales Order in the UI. The "External payment" option is only visible when creating the document via the webservice call.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. -See Also-Help Center Documentation: Customer Payments by External Payments-KBA: 3096429 - External Payment is Not Copied to New Sales Order -Keywords-Missing, not available, webservice, SOAP, payment.

Title: VAT Form Template for Switzerland is Not Compliant With Tax Law
Content: Symptom-The VAT Form Template for Switzerland named 'Vat tax certificate Switzerland' is outdated and hence not compliant with tax law.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance view.-Select Form Template Group: Tax Return.-Search for Form Template 'Vat tax certificate Switzerland' for Country/Region Switzerland.-Notice that the template is available in four languages: English, French, German and Italian. For all languages it has been last edited in 2018.-Cause-According to Value Added Tax Online obligation - FTA, VAT registration and reporting will generally be carried out electronically from January 1st, 2024. -Due to this online obligation and since the Swiss eCH standard eCH-0217 (XML upload VAT) was already made available in SAP Business ByDesign as of February 2020, the new VAT declaration form is out of scope in SAP Business ByDesign for the time being.-Resolution-The form template 'Vat tax certificate Switzerland' can be adjusted by using the Adobe® LiveCycle® Designer for SAP Business ByDesign in accordance with the new VAT rates effective from January 1st, 2024 (see ESTV Musterformulare Erhöhung MWST-Steuersätze ab 2024), analogous the SAP Help Portal 'Updating the Tax Return Form Template – Italy’, accessible here Tax Return Form Template - Italy.-If you need access to the XML generated upon the preview action for form template 'Vat tax certificate Switzerland', please open a Case with SAP Support mentioning this KBA 2193339.-See Also-SAP Help Document: Updating the Tax Return Form Template-Keywords-Switzerland; vat; tax certificate; form template; Umsatzsteuerzertifikat für Schweiz

Title: Messages Status in Business Communication Monitoring Mismatch with SRT_MONI Backend Transaction
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Messages Status in Business Communication Monitoring mismatch with the status in SRT_MONI Backend Transaction.-Either the Message ID for which status mismatch exists is provided in the incident, else, there would be a few of messages whose status need to be updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Communication Monitoring view.-In the dropdown, select Business Messages with Errors.-In case if Message ID is provided in the incident, look for that message on the Business Communication Monitoring View in the UI.-Go to backend transaction SRT_MONI.-Filter the messages using the same Message ID.-The same message in SRT_MONI is in Delivered state, but on Business Communication Monitoring View in the UI it shows as either Long Running/Content Error/Technical Error.-Cause-The issue of the status mismatch could be because of some temporary inconsistencies during the background job runs related to the Business Communication Monitoring.-Resolution-Go to SE38 transaction.-Execute the report APBMV_STATUS_MISMATCH_FIX.-From the value help, select the current status of the message which is to be updated. (For example: if the message is showing as Long Running on the Business Communication Monitoring View in the UI and is in Delivered state in SRT_MONI, select Long Running from the value help).-Execute the Report.-Verify if the Long Running/Technical Error/Content Error messages are cleared from the Business Communication Monitoring View in the UI, if their status is actually delivered in SRT_MONI.-Keywords-BCM, message status, srt_moni

Title: Error 'Change not possible; object does not exist' Occurs During Invoice Summary Run
Content: Symptom-An error occurs when performing Invoice Summary Runs with migration transaction data of open items receivables 'Change not possible; object does not exist'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Invoice Summary Runs view.-Search for invoice summary run ID: AAA (AAA represents the invoice summary run ID), and check application log: BBB (BBB represents the application log ID).-Can see error in results tab: Change not possible; object does not exist.-Cause-The migrated invoice has already been captured in the 'Invoice Summary Initialization Run' as per the process, but it is in cancelled status now.-Hence it is not required again to reprocess the migrated invoices using 'Invoices Summary Runs' once it is done via 'Invoice Initialization Summary Run'.-Resolution-It is not recommended to cancel the summary documents created from the invoice summary initialization run.-After the initialization summary run is completed and the migrated invoices are included in the summary document, it is possible to proceed with the further business process (Creation of new customer invoices and the payments).-Also once the migrated invoice is paid, the payments with details will be captured in the subsequent summary documents.-Keywords-Invoice Summary Runs, Migration Transaction data, Change not possible; object does not exist.

Title: Error: "Total duration of all recorded times exceeds 24 hrs" when Approving or Releasing Times
Content: Symptom-When approving Times you receive the error "Total duration of all recorded times exceeds 24 hrs" despite there being less than 24 hrs recorded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Time Administration-Employees-Search for the affected Employee-Approve or Release hours -System gives Error: Total duration of all recorded times exceeds 24 hrs-Cause-This can be caused by the interaction between Duration Based Time Recording (maintaining the number of hours, as opposed to a Start and End Time) and Core Hours Time. -Duration based Time Entries will never be considered to overlap with any Core Hours maintained in the Time Model.-E.g.:  If Core Hours are maintained between 10:00-14:00, only 20 hours will be available to book with Duration Based Time Recordings. -Resolution-Recommendation from Support is to avoid Core Hours/Flex Time when using Duration based Time Recording.-See Also-See KBA 2926654 - Some of Time Recordings are Incomplete Instead of Complete Status - Part 2 for more details.-Keywords-recording, recordings, approval, approve,

Title: Business Message with the Status as Long Running
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--A business message is being displayed with the status as Long Running in the Business Communication Monitoring view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Communication Monitoring view.-In the dropdown, select Business Messages with Errors.-The business message with the status as Long Running is displayed.-Cause-Synchronization issue in the Business Message Monitoring view.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Communication Monitoring view.-In the dropdown, select Business Messages with Errors.-Select the business message with the status as Long Running.-Collect the Message ID of the business message.-Login in the backend.-Go to the transaction SRT_MONI.-In the field Message ID, insert the Message ID of the business message.-Click on Execute.-Collect the Processing Status, Receiver Interface Name and Sender Party information.--An incident should be opened with the development team providing the collected information in order to perform a backend synchronization for the business message with the "Long Running" status.-Keywords-Business Communication Monitoring, byd, Long Running, Delayed, Verzögert

Title: Old Business Tasks Appear in the Unassigned Task
Content: Symptom-Some old business tasks which are already assigned to a certain business user suddenly appear as unassigned task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management -> Business Task Management.-Some old business tasks opened long time ago appear as unassigned task recently.-Cause-The access right of previous responsible business user is changed. As a result, the previous responsible business user does not have enough access right. The system gets the already assigned task back and try to reassign.-Resolution-It is possible to reassign the old tasks to anyone who has enough access right. If the old tasks are no longer needed, open an incident to SAP and provide the permission. SAP can either cancel or complete the tasks from backend.-Keywords-Old Task, Unassigned Task, Cancel or Complete the Task

Title: Renaming the Term Incident(s) to Case(s) in SAP Business Bydesign Tenants
Content: Symptom-With 2405, the term Incident(s) are replaced with case(s). You will find the term case in most of the screens/UI within ByD Tenant.-However there are few screens/scenario, the term is yet to be renamed. This KBA is to make you aware about those screens-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-ByD Built-in Support & Documentation etc.-ByD functionality / Work Center Application and User Management – Incident View (& documentation)-Error Messages in the ByD system from “… report an Incident” into “…report a Case”.-Some of messages level where success, warning or erroneous conditions are listed-CCC and CHD scenarios where again similar changes would be needed-Keywords-incident, case, rename
