Title: The Supplier Delivery Notification Displays Wrong Quantity Received
Content: Symptom-User checks supplier delivery notification quantity after confirming the inbound tasks and finds that notification quantity is not same. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Find required IDN ID and edit it.-Navigate to Line items tab-Here user finds that relevant IDN does not have same quantity as per inbound tasks confirmation. -Cause-When an Inbound Delivery Notification (IDN) gets created against any reference PO, system fetches actual quantity as per ordered in PO and IDN is generated as per ordered quantity.-Therefore, while creating a Supplier Delivery Notification itself, the user must enter the quantity manually if has to be modified as per business need instead of relying on the system to propose quantities which is based on the PO's ordered quantity. -Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system.-Keywords-incorrect quantity, IDN, supplier delivery notification, purchase order, received, inbound logistics

Title: Net Value in Company Currency for CPEL of Concur Expense Report Items not Clear
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Expense report XYZ, generated through Concur, is created in foreign currency FC for project ABC (XYZ represents the expense report ID, ABC represents the project ID). -The expense report contains numerous items. For each item a Customer Project Expense List (CPEL) is created.-The CPELs list the expense item amount in foreign currency FC and a net value in  company currency CC.-According to the FC-CC exchange rate valid on the expense report posting date you calculate a different net value in company currency. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center and here to the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.  -Search for project ABC and press Edit Time and Expenses.  -Find an item of expense report XYZ, for example item XYZ-X (XYZ-X represents an expense report item ID). -Under the table check the Invoicing Details and access the CPEL AAA via the Project Expense List Item ID field (AAA represents the CPEL ID).  -In the CPEL you notice an amount in foreign currency FC.-And you notice the net value in company currency CC. -The net value in company currency does not correspond with the FC-CC exchange rate valid on the posting date of expense report XYZ.-Cause-The CPEL net value in company currency is derived from the FC-CC exchange rate valid on the provision date of the expense item.-Resolution-To verify the net value -go back to the Edit Time and Expenses screen find expense item XYX-X.-Check the Provision date.-Now go to the Edit Exchange Rates common task in the General Ledger.-Open the Exchange rate history.-Check the FC-CC* exchange rate, valid on the expense item's provision date.-*If no FC-CC exchange rate exists on the provision date, check the inverse exchange rate CC-FC on the provision date. -Keywords- CPEL, net value CPEL, expense report item, Concur expense report, foreign currency, project management

Title: When Changing Identified Stock Type for Material, Error Triggered: Change of batch indicator not possible; inventory exists.
Content: Symptom-When changing Identified Stock Type from "03 - Optional Specified Stock" to "04 - Mandatory Specified Stock" for a material, error triggered:-Change of batch indicator not possible; inventory exists-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Product Portfolio.-Access view Products - By Materials.-Search product ABC (ABC represents product ID), click Edit, View All.-Under tab General, for Identified Stock Type, change it from "03 - Optional Specified Stock" to "04 - Mandatory Specified Stock", error triggered: Change of batch indicator not possible; inventory exists-Cause-When both below conditions are meet, it is impossible to change Identified Stock Type from 03 to 04:-1) There is quantity conversion maintained in the material master data.-2) Warehouse stock is available for the material with identified stock type "Optional Specified Stock" in Stock Overview.-Resolution-Once the warehouse stock with identified stock type "Optional Specified Stock" is removed, you can try to change the Identified Stock Type of the material again.-Keywords-Identified Stock, Optional Specified Stock, Mandatory Specified Stock,

Title: Contract is Not Visible to the Users in the Contracts View.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The contract ABC is not visible (displayed) in the contacts view, however it is accessible in other views, for example the Invoice Requests view. And the issue happens only to this specific contract.-ABC represents the ID of the contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Show all the contracts and you can find many contracts.-Search the contract ABC, there is no record found.-Then go to the Customer Invoicing work center and Invoice Requests view.-Search the contract ABC, you can see the contract invoice request ABC.-Click the ABC hyperlink, you are able to open the contract ABC and edit it.-The user has enough access rights on the contract ABC, but this contract is not found in the contracts view.-Cause-In the backend, go to BO TEST SHELL (T-code: SESFTS), and open the contract ABC.-In the node AccessControlList - Entry, you can find the access control of the contract. Select the Access Context for 4 - sales. The dates are 00.00.0000. -However, if you select another visible contract and check the AccessControlList - Entry - Access Context - Date fields, the values are 01.01.0001  and 31.12.9999.-Resolution-The Access Context Date values are incorrect and need to be corrected by development.-Keywords-contract not visible; access control list; not displayed; contract.

Title: CVE-2021-44228 - Diagnostics Agent impact for Log4j vulnerability
Content: Symptom-Vulnerability CVE-2021-44228 for log4j-How does this impact the Diagnostics Agent for Solution Manager-log4j is an apache library used commonly in java applications.  This particular issue was identified in log4j2 and fixed in log4j2.15.0.-Environment-Diagnostics Agent-All operating systems-Resolution-The diagnostics agent is not affected by this vulnerability.-Refer to SAP's official statement at https://support.sap.com/content/dam/support/en_us/library/ssp/my-support/trust-center/sap-tc-01-5025.pdf-See Also-https://logging.apache.org/log4j/2.x/security.html-https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-44228-Keywords-CVE-2021-44228, log4j, Diagnostics Agent, vulnerability, apache

Title: G/L Account Balances Migration Error: Account AAA In Chart Of Accounts BBB Is Not Based On Open Item Management
Content: Symptom-During the G/L Account Balances migration, the following error message occurs:-Account AAA In Chart Of Accounts BBB Is Not Based On Open Item Management (AAA represents the G/L Account ID, BBB represents the Chart of Accounts ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Press Open.-Press Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the respective Migration Unit.-Process the file 'G/L Account Balances'.-In the simulation step, an error occurs: Account AAA In Chart Of Accounts BBB Is Not Based On Open Item Management.-Cause-G/L Account: AAA in Chart Of Accounts BBB does not belong to the following account types: Other Assets/ Other Liabilities / Equity.-And for G/L Account: AAA, the migration file contains information in the clearing description column which is incorrect. -This column is only relevant if the G/L Account is open-item-managed.-Resolution-For general payables and receivables, open item management is performed in the Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable subledgers. Therefore it is only possible to apply open item management to the following account types:-Other Assets-Other Liabilities-Equity-More information can be found in help document:<Open Item Management and G/L Accounts>.-See Also-1786985 - Transactions Not Listed in Open Item Management for G/L Accounts-Keywords-G/L Account Balances migration, Open Item Management

Title: The field "Product Category" in Shopping Cart cannot be set as Mandatory from Adaptation Mode or Personalization Mode.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set the field "Product Category" in Shopping Cart as Mandatory but you cannot find any option from the ser interface.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue->>Work Center Home->>Self-Services Overview ->>Select Go Shopping Advanced->>In Step 3 (Edit Shopping Cart), the field "Product Category" cannot be set as Mandatory, either through Adaptation Mode or Personalization Mode.-Cause-The "Product Category" field cannot be made mandatory via Adaptation Mode or Personalization Mode as it is bound to above table (KBA 2372377 > point 7).-2372377 - Limitations of HTML5 UI in SAP Business ByDesign-https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2372377-Resolution-Please contact you add on partner in order to set the field "Product Category" mandatory through PDI solution.-Keywords-"Shopping Cart"; "Product category"; "Mandatory"; "Adaptation/Personalization Mode"

Title: Confirmation Not Possible; Posting on DD.MM.YY Blocked by Accounting
Content: Symptom-Error "Confirmation not possible; posting on DD.MM.YY blocked by accounting " occurs when doing business which would create a Good and Activity Confirmation(GAC), like releasing an outbound delivery, creating inventory adjustment, etc.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Business Process Group 06 - Goods and Service confirmation is blocked for the mentioned period DD.MM.YY.-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Choose Open and Close Periods in Common Task.-Select the line of the period which matches the company and the set of book for your business.-In details, you would find that 06 - Goods and Service confirmation is blocked.-Since this Business process group covers the business of GACs, it's system expected that the error occurs while doing any business that generates a GAC.-Resolution-To resolve this, you can unblock or remove this block as per below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select sub-view Master Data under Companies view.-Select the relevant company.-Choose Set Process control button.-Select the line for Business Process Group: Goods and Services Confirmation.-Change Process Control Status to Not Blocked/ Choose Remove button.-Choose Save and Close button.-After this, the error wouldn't occur while doing business.-Keywords-Confirmation Not Possible, Posting, Blocked, Accounting, Business Process Group, Goods and Services Confirmation.

Title: Facing Error "Switching off Supplier Approval not possible: open requests exist" When Removing the Supplier Approval From the Scope
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When Descoping the Supplier Approval Facing Error "Switching off Supplier Approval not possible: open requests exist"-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Business Configuration -> Implementation Projects-Select the project and click on Edit Project Scope-Navigate to the Questions step-Find the supplier approval question "Do you want to set up the approval process for supplier"-When trying to Descoping question-SLG1  Logs :-Switching off Supplier Approval not possible: open requests exist-Switching off Supplier Approval not possible: open requests exist-BC Engine service 'CHECK_ALL' called in system JVB (033), user-Switching off Supplier Approval not possible: open requests exist-Solution profile check ended with content error-Runtime check ended with content error-Execution of veto check failed-Cause-suppliers with Approval status "1" i.e. Not Started.-Resolution-Step 1: Request Customer to perform the activity in UI i.e change status of all suppliers with Approval Status as '1' to Approved as '4' and check ,if they are able to merge the change project.-If it is not possible -Step 2:-Open the backend and follow the below steps to clear all pending Supplier Approval requests.-Path to navigate: In SESFTS, open BO Name:BUPA_APPROVAL_REQUEST->Query by elements-enter Approval Status Code value as '1' and change the status as suggested above.-Keywords-Switching off Supplier Approval not possible, Descoping Supplier Approval

Title: Error Costs not Determined: There is no Inventory Cost for Material in Sales Order Item Cancellation
Content: Symptom-Receiving an error message when trying to cancel a line item in a Sales Order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Item 10.-Add a reason for rejection.-Error shows: Item 10: Costs not determined: There is no inventory cost for material HIJ in company XYZ (HIJ represents the ID of the of the Material and XYZ represents the ID of the Company)--Cause-The reason the system is returning the error is because the cost maintained under the product Valuation tab is not valid for the Sales Order, as the Valuation valid from date begins after the Pricing Date of the order.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Please perform the following: -Go to the Sales Orders work center-Select the Sales Orders view-Search for ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab of the Sales Order.-Pricing Date: 23.04.2024.-Navigate to the Items tab Double click on the product.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-Company XYZ is maintain but Valia From date of the Business Residence is after Pricing Date.-Change the valid from date of the Business Residence to match the Pricing Date or prior.-Click Save.-Open the Sales Order again.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the line item and maintain a Reason for Rejection.-Now you will be able to cancel the line item as expected.-   See Also-2879580 - You get Error While Creating a New Sales Order: "Costs not determined"-Keywords-Costs not determined, Sales Order, Inventory Valuation, Inventory Cost, No inventory Cost for Material, Product, Pricing Date

Title: Process Communication Error on Sales Orders Due to Error: Unit of measure deviates between quantity attributes.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The sales order is released but no customer demand created. In the Process Communication Errors view, you find the error from the order saying "Unit of measure deviates between quantity attributes".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management - Process Communication Errors view.-Show Open Errors with Incidents query, you find the process communication error on the sales order ABC.-In Main Error part, you can see the error is "Unit of measure deviates between quantity attributes ".-ABC represents the ID of the sales order.-Cause-In the sales order ABC, it contains a sales kit item XYZ, the UoM of the sales kit header item is DEF instead of ea (Each). -Open the Sales Kit Item List for Kid XYZ, the Quantity/UoM is 1 ea-Each.-Open the Kit master data: XYZ, The Base UoM is DEF. -When creating a sales kit in UI, the Base UoM is always defaulted to ea-Each, it cannot be modified. But in this case, the Base UoM is rather than ea-Each. Duo to the difference on UoM in Sales Kit master data and Sales Kit Item List, the error raised.-XYZ represents the ID of the sales kit item.-DEF represents the code of the UoM.-Resolution-You need to recreate the sales kit manually with the header UoM as ea-Each.-For the affected sales orders, you may cancel them entirely. And create it again manually with correct sales kit items.-Or add the new correct sales kit into these sales orders then cancel the incorrect lines.-Keywords-sales kit; Base UoM; "Unit of measure deviates between quantity attributes"; DFV; No customer requirement matches sales order.

Title: Application Log IDs from Mass Data Runs are Out of Sequence
Content: Symptom-You can see that Mass Data Run Views show Application Log IDs out of order (e.g. the Application Log ID 283 was processed before Application Log ID 250). -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Custom Work Center View created for Mass Data Run.-Select a Run ID.-You can see its Application Log IDs out of sequence. -Cause-This is a system standard behavior. To improve the performance of the system, most application number ranges are buffered on the application servers. Otherwise, every number would have to be fetched from the database server by the application server in sequence, via the network, which can be very detrimental to performance. That's reason why you can see application logs out of sequence in Mass Data Run work center views.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior for keeping system stability and performance. -Keywords-Application Log IDs, Out of Sequence, sequence, logical sequence, mass data run

Title: Error: Fiscal year & and period & not open for company & and set of books &
Content: Symptom-Unposted source documents with the following error:--Fiscal year YYYY and period XXX not open for company ABCD (Company Name) and set of books XYZ-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center > Source Documents view-Select Unposted Source Documents-Search for the affected unposted document-Document is unposted with the following error:-Fiscal year & and period & not open for company & and set of books --Cause-Fiscal year YYYY and period XXX not open for company ABCD (Company Name) and set of books XYZ. The system is attempting to make an inventory posting to a previous period. This posting will result in a revaluation in the following period (XXX/YYYY).-Go to General Ledger Work Center > Source Documents view-Search for the affected unposted document-Click Actions > View Business Transaction-You can see the error: Fiscal year YYYY and period XXX not open for company ABCD (Company name) and set of books XYZ-Click on the hyperlink to open the details-The following description is shown:-Fiscal year YYYY and period XXX not open for company ABCD (Company Name) and set of books XYZ. The system is attempting to make an inventory posting to a previous period. This posting will result in a revaluation in the following period (XXX/YYYY).-However, period (XXX/YYYY) is not open. You therefore need to open period (XXX/YYYY) for closing step "Operational postings" in company ABCD (Company Name) and for set of books XYZ.-This closing step is assigned to the business transaction type Determine Material Costs Automatically.-Reason of the revaluation:----------------------------When an inventory posting is processed for a previous period, the system takes into account the following variables:-* Inventory quantity-* Inventory value-* Perpetual cost method-* Inventory cost-The system uses these variables to check whether revaluations are necessary for the periods following the posting period.-Example 1:-For a material with the Standard perpetual cost method, a revaluation can be necessary when the inventory cost in a following period differs from that of the posting period.-Example 2:-For a material with the Moving Average perpetual cost method, a revaluation can be necessary when the inventory quantity is zero or negative for the following period. If the inventory quantity is negative, the Moving Average cost method behaves like the Standard cost method and the inventory cost of this period does not change. In both cases the system posts to the inventory account in the following period.-Note that these examples do not cover all possible cases.-   Resolution-In order to post the source document, it is necessary to open period (XXX/YYYY) for closing step "Operational postings" in company ABCD (Company Name) and for set of books XYZ.-Go to General Ledger Work Center > Set of Books and Assigned Companies view-Go to Advanced Search-Search for the Company ID "ABCD" and Set of Book "XYZ"-Click Go-Click Open and Close Periods-Find the affected period (XXX/YYYY) and open it for Operational postings-Save your changes-Try to post the document again-Keywords-unposted source document, Fiscal year & and period & not open for company & and set of books &

Title: Cost Estimate of real cycle not supported for Prod Lot After Adjustment Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Actual Cost Roll up Run reports the error "Cost Estimate of real cycle not supported for Prod Lot XYZ. KBA - 2890289" (XYZ represents the affected production lot ID).-You check the production lot's production confirmations and notice an adjustment confirmation for which the outputput product is maintained as input product. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Inventory Valuation work center go to the Allocation Rollup view. -Find the respective run and in the Details section underneath select the Execution Details tab. -Select the execution log and press View. -In the Messages tab you find the error message  "Cost Estimate of real cycle not supported for Prod Lot XYZ. KBA - 2890289" for material ABC (ABC is the output material ID of production lot XYZ). -Now access the production lot XYZ from the Production Lots view in the Inventory Valuation work center). -In the Confirmations tab you notice an adjustment confirmation.-You notice, the production lot's output product ABC appears in the Input Products tab and not in the Output Products tab. -Cause-The error message refers to KBA  2890289 - Error 'Valuation with cost estimate of production lot ABC failed' Occurs in Actual Cost Rollup Run which explains that a situation where a production lots output product is used as input product is not supported.-Resolution-When creating adjustment confirmations the business user is free to choose the output and input product to allow any adjustment scenario. At this stage it is not checked weather the maintained input product is actually the underlying production lot's output product. Therefore, no warning or error message will appear. -To prevent failing actual cost rollups you must ensure that the adjustment confirmation's input product is not the production lot's output product. -Keywords-cost estimate of real cycle not supported, actual cost rollup, production lot

Title: Margin Contribution Scheme is Not Assigned in Data Source FINPRFU20 Profitability : Earned Profit Preview
Content: Symptom-The Preview of Data Source FINPRFU20 shows the value # in the Margin Contribution Scheme column.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Data Sources view.-Go to the Design Data Sources subview.-Find the Data Source FINPRFU20.-Click the Preview button.-Click View.-In the Row Fields area click the + sign.-Select the following Characteristics:-Contribution Margin Scheme-Company-Set of Books-Click Ok.-You notice that the Contribution Margin Scheme column is showing the value # for Company ABC and Set of Books XX. (ABC represents the Company ID)(XX represents the Set of Books ID)-Cause-Margin Contribution Scheme value is not maintained for Company ABC and Set of Books XX.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation projects view.-Open the Activity List.-Find the Set of Books activity.-Open the activity.-Select the Set of Books XX.-Select the Company ABC.-Click the Edit button.-Open the Company Settings tab.-Show the drop down menu for Margin Contribution Scheme.-Select the Margin Contribution Scheme value.-Select Save.-If you can not select Margin Contribution Scheme value due to 'No items found', please refer to KBA 2380850 - No Records Found to Assign Contribution Margin Scheme in the Set of Books-See Also-Please also see the KBA 2177622 - No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports for Order / Invoice Profit-Keywords-Margin; Contribution; Scheme; Assignment; Cost; Profit; Set of Books; Company; FINPRFU20; Data Source; Profitability; Earned

Title: Project Time Recordings are Not Completely Displayed in the Customer Invoice Output
Content: Symptom-You have created an custom customer invoice template and included the project time recording part. When previewing the invoice, you find the preview output only displays part of the employee's time records, not all.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the customer invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select the relevant invoice, click Preview, you are able to check the time recordings of each employee included in the project. You find some of the time records are not shown in the output for the employee. -Go to the Output History tab, select the output PDF and click view XML, you however could see all the time records of the employee  are available in the XML (under <CustomerProjectInvoiceProductViewSubSubtotal> section). -Cause-The table 'rowAssignedProjects' is binding with '$.CustomerProjectInvoiceProductViewSubSubtotal[0].CustomerProjectInvoiceProductViewSubSubtotalItem[*]' in adobe live cycle designer for form template of customer invoice. Due to this display only first record of project team member items.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to maintain the binding for 'rowAssignedProjects' table.-1)Please download the customer invoice form template from 'Application and User Management - Form Template Maintenance' work center view.-2)Open Adobe Livecycle Designer, select XDP file which is downloaded from the form template.-3)Bind the table 'rowAssignedProjects'  as attached screenshot name 'Project Details Binding' then save. The code would be like below after binding.-$.CustomerProjectInvoiceProductViewSubSubtotal[*].CustomerProjectInvoiceProductViewSubSubtotalItem[*]-4)Upload the saved XDP file into customer invoice form template in 'Application and User Management - Form Template Maintenance' work center view.-  After followed the above steps then execute the invoice to get all the record items for the project team member.-Keywords-project invoicing; project invoice request; time recordings not displayed; customer invoice template; <CustomerProjectInvoiceProductViewSubSubtotal>.

Title: Error Service organization ABC does not belong to seller company
Content: Symptom-Error "Service organization ABC does not belong to seller company" when adding a line item in the Service Order.-ABC represents the ID of the Organization Unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Orders Processing view.-Search for ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Service Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Click Add Row.-Enter Service ID 123 (123 represents the ID of the Service).-Error: Service organization ABC does not belong to seller company-Cause-The issue is occurring because of the inconsistency caused by the Service Execution Team which was added previously.-   Resolution-Please perform the following steps to correct the error: -Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Orders Processing view.-Search for ID XYZ.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Select the Service Execution Team. -Remove the value from the field. -Hit Enter.-Add the Party ID again.-Hit Enter.-Enter Service ID 123-Error: Service organization ABC does not belong to seller company-See Also-3215962 - The Following Error Occurs in a Sales Document: Party with role XYZ does not belong to seller company ABC-Keywords-Service Order, Service organization, does not belong to seller company, Error

Title: Unhandled Exception while debugging in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-While debugging in the studio, you see either of the below errors:-"Debugging of the backend process cannot be continued."-"Exception during data read occurred."-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have created a Custom Solution.-You have an .absl script on a .bo or .xbo file.-You are navigating to an association during the execution of the .absl script.-Reproducing the Issue:-In the SAP Cloud Applications Studio, click "Start Debugging".-Execute .absl script.-In the Output window, you the error is shown after the association is called and the studio dumps.-Cause-The association is not debuggable in the current release.-Resolution-As the script execution is fine, we recommend using a Trace to check the variables at runtime. This process is similar to classic debugging except that you are only able to see the values once the Trace has been stopped.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, scripting, dump, 500, association, output, solution, debug, de-bug, script, window, dumping

Title: Error Message in Project Migration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate a Project via Migration Tool, however you face the error messages "Changes made affect the scheduling of the project" and "Data inconsistent for confirmation".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration - Overview view.-Filter and open activity: Migration of Projects.-Click on Migrate projects using the migration tool.-Select the relevant file.-Execute the migration.-See the error messages.-Cause-There is a wrong information added in the template.-Resolution-Under Action Column, click on Edit Source Record.-Select the correct file.-Go to Project Plan tab.-Change the value of  Time Recording Approver Type field from 1 to 2.-Click save and close.-The "Time Recording Approver Type" field determines who will approve the time confirmations. -- If TimeConfirmationApproverTypeCode = 1, the Project Lead has to approve the time confirmations. -- If TimeConfirmationApproverTypeCode = 2, the Task Owner has to approve the time confirmations. -If you maintain TimeConfirmationApproverTypeCode = 1 in the excel sheet, the project lead will have to approve the time confirmations, and you should not get any errors.-By following these steps, the migration process should proceed without errors.-Keywords-Projects, Migration Tool, Migrate projects using the migration tool, TimeConfirmationApproverTypeCode

Title: Asset under Construction Settlement Run Is Not Settling the Complete Net Book Value of the AuC
Content: Symptom-The execution of an Asset under Construction Settlement Run did not transfer the complete AuC (AuC means Asset under Construction) Net Book Value to the fixed asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks -> Settlement view.-Open the respective Run ID with Settlement Type Asset Under Construction to Fixed Asset(s).-Move to Processed Project Tasks tab.-Notice that system has posted an Amount to the fixed asset which is only part of the AuC's Net Book Value.-Cause-The Asset under Construction Settlement Run will transfer the Acquisition postings from the AuC to the fixed asset which are assigned to the respective project task only.-For example: a Goods and Services Receipt that has Account Assignment Type as PRO - Project Task and is assigned to the respective project task defined in the run.-Other postings to the AuC which are not assigned to the project task will not be transferred by the run.-Resolution-System behaves as designed.-Keywords-AuC; Asset under Construction; Settlement Run; project task

Title: Incorrect Subtyp in JSON for E-invoice for Country India
Content: Symptom-E-invoice JSON has incorrect subtyp as B2B and you expect it to be EXPWP as have selected the export Tax Code.-   Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Documents View-Search for XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Customer Invoice)-Click on Download e invoice-Result: Subtyp shows as B2B-Expectation is that it should be EXPWP-Cause-The only tax codes relevant for E-Invoicing in export scenarios:-562 - Export Sale (IGST) Export with payment tax-576 - Export Sale (IGST) LUT/Bond Export without payment of tax-In Customer Invoice XYZ, you are using a different tax code as 577 which is not relevant for Export.(XYZ is the ID of the Customer Invoice)-Resolution-This is the current system behavior. Kindly create a customer invoice with correct tax code.-See Also-E-invoice; JSON; Subtyp; B2B, EXPWP; GST;

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate Not Valid
Content: Symptom-You are not able to release a Customer Invoice due the error: Tax Exemption Certificate Not Valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit-Two errors are displayed: -Error during calculation of price and tax-Tax exemption certificate not valid-Cause-The reason why system is running into errors is due to the following:-The tax date found in the invoice is an earlier or future date as the start date of the tax exemption certificate e.g. The tax date found in the invoice is the 24th, whereas, the start date of the tax exemption certificate maintained under the account is for the 25th.-The tax date was set for this date, as this information was taken from the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-The invoice date from the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is considered as pricing and tax date for the header and items of the invoice document.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Options to correct the scenario:-Go to the account master data and change the validity of the Tax Exemption Certificate.-Once you have performed this, do the following:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Navigate to Pricing.-Click Update Pricing.-Select the option Completely.-Click Save.-If this does not work then please cancel the Outbound Delivery and create a new one for the source sales order, which will then pass the correct tax date.-See Also-KBA 3462116 - Sales Order Invoice Request is Inconsistent as Tax Exemption Certificate is Not Valid-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Tax Date, Outbound Delivery, Tax Exemption Certificate, Not Valid, Invoice Request

Title: The e-mail sent to the tenant is rejected by the tenant
Content: Symptom-When trying to send an e-mail to the ByD tenant, the e-mail is rejected by the tenant and there is a feedback mail from the e-mail service provider which includes the following error code:-'SMTP error, RCPT TO: Host XXX RCPT TO said 550 5.7.1 TLS 1.2+ required by recipient' (XXX represents the tenant which the e-mail is sent to).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This issue occurs due to the sender domain doesn't send emails via TLS 1.2 or above.-Resolution-Check whether sender domain infra supports TLS 1.2/1.3. If not, upgrade e-mail infra to TLS 1.2/1.3 or change a domain which supports TLS 1.2/1.3.-See Also-Amazon SES and security protocols-https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/security-protocols.html#security-ses-to-receiver-Keywords-TLS 1.2./1.3, SMTP error, 550 5.7.1, E-mail Rejected

Title: How to make changes if any wrong mapping in Supplier ID during Migration Process.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User executed Migration (Example :migration of materials), where migration is successful but migrated data shows wrong Supplier ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter-2. Navigate to overview view-3. Search Migration Activity (Example: Migration of Materials)-4. Select Source file-5. Execute Migration-Migration is successfully executed but after Migration Supplier ID is not shown as expected.-Cause-The value conversion for the migration tool uses the initial ID mapping for the respective business objects, and is shared across all migrations that use the same property.-In our example for Supplier ID, this means that if the ID was mapped to a different value during the migration of Suppliers, the same target value will be suggested for Supplier IDs in the migration of materials ,account determination groups etc.-Resolution-Following the example of Supplier ID migration, you can check the value mapping for an object by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for activity Migration of Suppliers and open it.-Choose Migrate Suppliers Using the Migration Tool.-In the Show dropdown list, select Completed Files.-Select You Can Also.-Choose Export Value Conversion to File.-This will download a text file where you can see the value mapping that was used during the initial migration. This value mapping will be used in any other migration that has a value conversion task for Supplier ID-To make the corrections follow below Steps,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for activity Migration of Suppliers and open it.-Choose Migrate Suppliers Using the Migration Tool.-In the Show dropdown list, select Completed Files.-Choose You Can Also.-Choose Export Value Conversion to File.-Edit the Target Supplier ID for the one changes is required-Save the Exported Value Conversion File where changes are made in your Local folde.-Go back to Step 6 and Choose You can Also-Select Import Value Conversion to File.-Choose the saved file from your Local folder-Select Import-NOTE: Do not make any changes in Exported File other that the Supplier ID where wrong mapping has taken place.-Keywords-Supplier ID, Wrong mapping

Title: System Dumps While Accessing the Purchase Order Screen
Content: Symptom-When you are navigating to Inbound Logistics-Purchase Order, User getting dump error whenever they are trying to change the filter option.-Example: If User is trying to change field selection from All purchase order by Selection to "Due and Overdue purchase order". User is getting below error: Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound logistics Work Centre-Choose Purchase Order.-Change field selection from All purchase order by Selection to Due and Overdue purchase order or vice versa.-Cause-The system is fetching all the schedule lines for all Purchase orders present in the system, this means the search is going above for example 121000 records depending upon the orders and the system is timing out with the dump.-Resolution-As the data is more, we recommend using filter via advance filter or if the purchase order is known please provide the purchase order id in the search.-Keywords-System Dump, Purchase order, schedule line, Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.

Title: Spain SII Tax Return Rejected With Error '1105 - Valor del campo NumSerieFacturaEmisor incorrecto'
Content: Symptom-Spain SII Tax Return of tax return type SII - Incoming Invoices is Rejected by tax authority due to Error Code 1105 - Error Description 'Valor del campo NumSerieFacturaEmisor incorrecto'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Open the respective VAT Return with Tax Return Type SII - Incoming Invoices and Approval Status Rejected.-Click View All.-Go to Tax Return tab.-Notice the existence of one or more Document IDs with Error Code 1105 and Error Description 'Valor del campo NumSerieFacturaEmisor incorrecto'.-Cause-In this scenario, the incoming invoices being fetched by the tax return are expense report journal entries created in SAP Concur, which is identifiable in the Tax Return Details by Source Document Type 'External Source Document'.-Since the journal entries are directly created via SAP Concur without source document reference (in SAP Business ByDesign system), system is not able to fetch multiple fields. As the reference document is not found in system, the XML doesn't have NUM_SERIE_FACTURA_EMISOR field, and hence tax authority send 'Rejected' approval status.-Resolution-Since the journal entries are created with tax event '1-Non-Taxable Purchase' they are picked up in the return 'SII - Incoming Invoices'. The suggestion is to create these expense reports via SAP Concur with tax event '3-Non-Taxable Purchase (Without Reporting)', which is a non taxable and non reporting event. In this way, these journal entries will not be picked up in the return and hence issue will not occur. -Keywords-spain SII; incoming invoices; 1105; Valor del campo NumSerieFacturaEmisor incorrecto; concur; External Source Document; Non-Taxable Purchase; Non-Taxable Purchase (Without Reporting)

Title: Not Possible to Activate Custom Data Source in Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- You receive the following error message while trying to activate custom created data source.- Environment-SAP Bysiness ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio- Reproducing the Issue-Log into the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the solution ABC (ABC refers to the namespace of the solution).-Navigate to the custom data source DEF (DEF refers to the affected data source).-Right click on the .ds file and choose Activate.-Cause-This issue occurs, if you have used Numeric data type in the BO (Business Object) on top of which the custom data source is created. Numeric data type, coming from the BASIS global namespace (as specified on the screenshot below), are considered as a String data type in the runtime framework (Application/MDRS), hence activation fails.-  SAP recommends to use IntegerValue as seen on the below screenshot. This data type, which is coming from the namespace Common is widely accepted by the application components.-  You are not able to activate such data sources as long as they consist of elements of data type Numeric.-As of now Cloud Applications Studio does not send any notifications that Numeric data type cannot be used for custom created data source.-Resolution-If the solution is in status "In Development" and in Version 1 you can still change the data type used on elements in the BO. Otherwise you cannot make such change.-Keywords-data type of fields not valid for key figures, cannot activate custom data source, custom data source, Numeric data type, IntegerValue,

Title: Error "Identified Stock not valid" While Performing Check Consistency
Content: Symptom-When performing consistency check of the Outbound Delivery system throws below error:---      Identified Stock ABC not valid.--     (Here, ABC represents Identified stock ID)-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for Outbound Delivery -Choose Edit.-Perform Check Consistency.-Cause-Changes in the identified stock after the creation of Outbound delivery leads to such errors as the identified stock is not refreshed in the line item.- Resolution-Go to Third Party Logistics Work Center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for Outbound Delivery -Go to line item tab, select line item.-Expand it and select sub line item row with identified stock id ABC.-Select the value selection in the right corner.-Select any other stock id other than ABC-This refreshes the line item.-Now again, choose the value selection and choose correct identified stock ABC.-Choose check consistency.--            (Here, ABC represents Identified stock ID)---Keywords-Outbound delivery inconsistency, Identified stock, Identified stock not valid , check consistency

Title: How to Remove an Incorrect Account Determination Group and Company Assignment in the Employee Account Monitor
Content: Symptom-You have migrated account determination groups for employees with a wrong assignment of company, account determination group and employee reference. You wish to remove this assignment, but it's not possible directly via user interface.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Show All Employees.-Search for the respective employee. -The system returns the employee account monitor, however the company assignment to the combination of employee and account determination group has been wrongly migrated.-Cause-It's current system design that you cannot enter or remove an account determination group/company assignment for employees via user interface.-Resolution-If you wish to change the account determination group that is assigned to an employee and company, you can refer to KBA 2571960 - Unable to Change Account Determination Group For An Existing Employee-Nonetheless, if you have migrated an incorrect company assignment and you wish to remove it, please raise a case for support to further evaluate the scenario. Be aware that, before finalizing the import via migration tool, there are a series of checks, which asks the user to verify the data and confirm its correctness before final import, since there are cases where this cannot be undone.-To send the incident to support:-Specify the combination of employee ID, account determination group and company that you wish to remove.-Make sure that there are no postings at all for this combination.-Grant SAP the approval for backend correction.-Reference this KBA in the incident you send to support.-Keywords-Account determination group. Employee. Migration Tool. Company.

Content: Symptom-When trying to release the time sheet in the self-services overview view, dump occurs- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview view.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Update the times and select the Release button and choose Release All.-System throw the exception.-An error occurred:-Try to continue with your work. Title: Error Message “Undefined Date Format”, While Migrating Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-When trying to upload migration file for Fixed Assets, the system throws below error message:-'Undefined Date Format-Some date entries are in error; enter dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before initiating the migration'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view and select Open Activity list button.-Open Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Click Execute migration.-Click Upload File of Migration object "Fixed Assets".--At this point, system will throw the info/warning message:-'Undefined Date Format-Some date entries are in error; enter dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before initiating the migration'.-If you ignore it, by clicking OK, and proceed to Process File, the file validation will fail with error message:-'File validation failed. Create an incident.'-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the date used in some of the fields (for example Initial Acquisition Date, Capitalization Date, etc.) is invalid.-Resolution-The date entered in any data cell of migration file should be valid.-Day = 00, Month = 00 or Year = 0000 is not valid.-Change the date and try migration again.-Keywords-Undefined Date Format, fixed assets, migration, date

Title: Error: Activity on DD.MM.YYYY Invalid / Activity not valid on DD.MM.YYYY When Recording Time in ESS
Content: Symptom-You have setup positive time recording with terminal integration. You observed that the system doesn't fetch the correct time type DE0001 automatically when creating new times entries for (project) time recordings, even though the time type is active in ESS. After selecting it manually and clicking on Ok and then clicking on Save or Release, an error occurred. Error:-Activity on DD.MM.YYYY invalid.-or-Invalid / Activity not valid on DD.MM.YYYY -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Click on Self-Service overview-Click on Edit Time Sheet-Click on Add Time Entry-Enter Work Package task-Note: Time entry is blank or incorrectly preselected-Enter time type manually if possible-Click on Ok-Click on Save or Release-Resolution-As per current system behavior Time recording method - Positive with Terminal Integration is designed to be used in scenarios where external terminals are used for recording clock-in and clock-out time which can be used for checking the total time spent by a employee against planned time.-Change this time type to e.g. Positive and this might be sufficient to avoid the error.-The following info might be helpful as well:-If total time spent is less than planned time or if there is any discrepancy in clock-in and clock-out data of an employee, then it is shown in Time Administration work center > Messages view.-If employees wish to record any time recording against a project that is just considered time allocation to a project, this time will not be counted while calculating the time calculated against the planned time.-Positive time recording with terminal integration is using e.g. DE1100. This time type is defaulted for project time recording in a case which has a time type category of time allocation. System will always try to use DE1100. Currently this defaulting cannot be changed via any configuration. The system is not defaulting to another time type as it is not enabled for the Time sheet.-Keywords-Time recording, time type, doesn't fetch correct time type, positive time recording with terminal integration, project time recordings, time type active for ESS, service confirmation

Title: How to Update New Dunning Procedure Code Field Via Webservice
Content: Symptom-User wants to update New dunning Procedure code field via webservice after creation of Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management WorkCenter View.-Navigate to Accounts view.-Select Account ID.-Select Edit.-Navigate to Financial Data Tab.-Choose Payment Data.-Navigate to "Dunning" field.-User wants to update New dunning field via webservice.-Cause-Field can be updated by using webservice "Manage Trade Receivables Payables Accounts".-Resolution-User can use webservice "Manage Trade Receivables Payables Accounts" , pass company and business partner ID to update new dunning field.-Below is a simple example of an update message-NOTE: In below payload XXXXXX refers to company ID and YYYYYY refers to Business Partner ID.-<n0:TradeReceivablesPayablesAccountBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">- <TradeReceivablesPayablesAccount actionCode="02">-  <CompanyID>XXXXXX</CompanyID> -  <BusinessPartnerInternalID>YYYYYY</BusinessPartnerInternalID>-  <NettingBlockedIndicator>true</NettingBlockedIndicator>-  <DebtorDoubtfulIndicator>true</DebtorDoubtfulIndicator>-  <DunningBlockedIndicator>true</DunningBlockedIndicator>-  <DunningBlockingExpirationDate>yyyy-mm-dd</DunningBlockingExpirationDate>-  <DunningBlockingReasonCode>02</DunningBlockingReasonCode>-  <NewDunningProcedureCode>03</NewDunningProcedureCode>- </TradeReceivablesPayablesAccount>-</n0:TradeReceivablesPayablesAccountBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-See Also-https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2111/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_TRP_ACCOUNT_IN.html-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/34de7a7c1a7e43178141074817068fb1/37faab74f63049d7816184add8077065.html-Keywords-New dunning field, account management, dunning strategy, ManageTradeReceivablesPayablesAccountIn

Title: Incoterms And Incoterms Location Are Missing While Creating New Sales Order
Content: Symptom-While creating a sales order the Incoterms and Incoterms Location fields are empty and not filled automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Sales Orders view.-Click New button and select Sales Order.-Fill the details including account ABC (ABC represents the account ID).-System determines the Ship-To and Bill-To automatically.-Click View All button and navigate to General tab.-Here you find that Incoterms and Incoterms Location are missing.-Cause-The Incoterms are determined from the Ship-To Party.-If no Relationship Type Has Ship-To Party is maintained in the Account Master Data, the Account is also determined automatically as Ship-To Party by the System.-If a Relationship Type Has Ship-To Party is in the Account Master Data, the Business Partner that has the Main indicator active is determined if the Business Partner status is Active.-The fields Incoterms and Incoterms Location are only automatically determined if the information is maintained in the master data of the Ship-To Party if the Business Partners of the Ship-to Party has the Business Partner Role Account.-Please Note: If the Ship-To Party on header level is the same as on Item Level, the changes on the header will cascade to the Item. If the Ship-To on Item level is not the same as the Ship-To on header level, the changes on header level in the General tab will not be cascaded to this item since it is being shipped to a different Ship-To party. The incoterms on Item level are then brought over to the customer demand, as this is where we are selling to.-Resolution-You have to maintain the Incoterms information in the Ship-To account if you want it to be determined automatically when creating a new sales order.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open the account master data of the Ship-To Party.-Click View All button.-Navigate to the Sales Data tab.-Maintain default Incoterms and Incoterms Location for required Sales Organization.-See Also-KBA 2197792 - Incoterms and Incoterms Location are not Taken from Account When Creating New Sales Order-Keywords-default, Incoterms fehlen, Incoterms, not populated, nicht gezogen

Title: Stock Transfer Order Exists as an Exception Even After Acknowledged
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-You find Stock Transfer Order as an exception even after it is being acknowledged as an exception.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning workcenter.-Go to the Products view.-Search for the required Product ID.-Select and under Details section.-Go to Exceptions tab, here you find Acknowledge button is grayed out.-Cause-Synchronization issue-Resolution-Pre-checks:-It is a STO scenario-The exception is still present in Supply Planning-> Exceptions: Products view after Acknowledged.-The acknowledge button is grayed out. If we open the product planning details, the same exception is under Exceptions tab.-Note: If you get this issue, send it to development component: AP-SDM-Backend Correction steps:-Open STO in Outbound Logistics Control - Customer Demand-Open planning view of product in both side (Ship to and Ship From site: check general tab of STO), and check if any document present with same STO.-If yes, send incident to SPR component to check further-If not, follow the below step to remove the exception.-Put break point in FM: /LCAP/ORDER_GET_DATA)-Go to ByD UI, Supply Planning - Products (Exception View) -> Enter product and press enter - Debugger will hit-Check the GUID in internal table it_order-SESFTS: STOCK_TRANSFER_PROPOSAL -> Load by Node Id (Root) -Enter the Guid received from step 3-Make sure to check the status of STO (should be 2 - exception requested), check the Product, check all the exception.-Delete STO Proposal-Post-Checks:-Exception should be removed from product planning.-Keywords-Customer Demand, Stock Transfer Order, Products, Acknowledge, Supply Planning, Exceptions, STO

Title: Error When Cancelling Sales Order Item - The action CANCEL is Not Possible
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-An error occurs when you are cancel an item in a sales order via the reason for rejection: 'Item XX: The action CANCEL is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders workcenter.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select line item XX (XX represents the line item number).-Enter a Reason for Rejection.-The following error occurs: 'Item XX: The action CANCEL is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.'-Cause-The sales order item is project based and the Fulfillment status is set to Finished since the project is in status closed or completed. It is not allowed to cancel a project based item if the delivery status is finished.-In general this scenario is not allowed in the system. It can, however happen if the invoicing status for the delivery based item is set at the same time as the cancellation, e.g. due to a time delay in the processing of the XI message.-Resolution-Go to the Project Management work center. -Go to the Projects view. -Find the relevant project used for Line Item XX of Sales Order XYZ. -Go to Project Plan tab then select the Revoke Closure/revoke completion in Project Status. -Ensure that the status of project task is released.-Click on the Save button. -After the changes, the delivery status for the sales order item is set to 'Not started' status and you can enter the Reason for Rejection on item level of the sales order and finish the Customer Invoice to complete the sales order.-Once this is completed, you can complete/close the project using same steps by selecting complete/close in Project status.-See Also-KBA: 2644606 - How to maintain the Reason for Rejection in Project Based Sales Order Item-Keywords-Cancel Sales Order Item Action cancel not possible

Title: Error Message "New case for conflict resolution." When You Add New Change Project
Content: Symptom-When you add a new change project, system throws below error:---->New case for conflict resolution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on the button NEW-Navigate to step 2-Adjust Scoping-Expand the scoping elements: Project Management> Project Planning and Execution and tick Time recording and Expense recording-Click on Next-An error occurs: New case for conflict resolution.-Cause-Due to a sequencing issue related to scoping questions, scoping engine is unable to resolve it automatically.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose NEW.-In a guided activity, go to step 3(Questions) without selecting any option in Step 2.-In Step 3, select All Elements from the drop-down list.-Expand Project Management-> Project Planning and Execution-> Project Resource Management.-In the list of questions, under group Resource Management, select the question "Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on Commitment Quantity of the employee from Projects Team and Staffing Tab?"-Now navigate back to step 2.-Here select the business topics-> Time Recording and Expense Recording.-Now choose Next to move to step 3 again.-Review questions in option Group: Resource Management again and decide which of the two questions should finally be selected.-Note that either one of the two questions must be selected.-At last, choose Next and Finish to complete the creation of the change project.-Keywords-Project Management, Project Planning, Time Recording, Expense Recording,change project,New case for conflict resolution

Title: Error in OData Query Execution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You notice an below error while executing OData Query :-"Program error in class CL_RSBOLAP_QV_AXIS method : INVALID_CHARACTERISTIC_NAME"-Environment-Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select Design Report-Create Query based via "OData Query Builder"-Execute the same query in browser and the error is noticed as :--"Program error in class CL_RSBOLAP_QV_AXIS method : INVALID_CHARACTERISTIC_NAME"-Cause-The root cause here is generally due to a bug in the system-The regeneration of a partner MDAV in a scalable partner solution does not regenerated the runtime cache objects for an MDAV, thus new field, deleted fields changed field attributes are not visible in the report.-Resolution-This requires backend correction in the related data source of the report-Before proceeding to it, first check how is the data source behaving in UI-Ideally the error should be noticed in that as well.-Now login to backend and perform the below steps :--Access the system backend.-From Tx MDRS select the desired MDAV.-From the menu choose Utilities then Invalidate Runtime Object.-After the compiling is completed the issue should be solved.-Same solution is applicable to any of the report from Business By Design systems as well

Title: Error "It is not Possible to Finalize Your Scope Changes; Some of Your Decisions Would Cause Inconsistencies in Your Fine-Tuning Settings" While Scoping New Country
Content: Symptom-While Scoping New Country in a Change project, getting the error:-“It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings”-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select on Implementation Project overview.-Choose New and choose on Select Scenario.-Here Add country and choose the arrow.-Press OK and choose Next until step 4.-Review Status: You have not reviewed all of the decision-relevant questions for your solution scope. For the questions not reviewed, would you like to accept the answers preselected by SAP based on best practices for your country and type of business?.-Choose Accept preselected Answers and Enter Title.-Choose Finish.-Finish Project: It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. Before continuing with your project, you must either reverse the decisions causing inconsistencies and then click Finish again or click Cancel to cancel your changes entirely.-Cause-The delivered Cost Center Types 10 to 50 are part of every country-specific Accounting Content provided by SAP. Removing them or just part of them will cause foreign key issues whenever new accounting content gets provided or activated for the system, e.g. when scoping a new country.-Resolution-Do not remove these delivered Cost Center Types 10 to 50. In case you do not want them to be used, rename them with e.g. "DO NOT USE" or similar so that colleagues know that they shall not be used within your company, and then add your own Cost Center Types and adapt Accounting Content, etc according to your wishes. ( i.e. Here 10 -50 refers to Cost Center IDs)-A. In case of these Cost Center Types are already deleted and you can still access the Business Configuration: Open the BC activity Cost Center Types and there use the button Restore Default. You can select explicitly which configuration entries you want to have restored.-NOTE: Make sure the activity "Cost Center Types" is added to the change project-To avoid any inconsistencies during the change project merge you should also restore the cost centers directly in the active main workspace. This can be done via-     Workcenter Business Configuration-     Workcenter View "Overview"-     Search for "Cost Center Types"-     Mark the line and press "Change Immediately".-B. In case of these Cost Center Types are already deleted and you cannot access the Business Configuration anymore yourself:-Please contact Cloud Support via incident and provide us also the approval to restore the missing default values. The development support team will then restore them, and once the inconsistencies are solved you can again access the Business Configuration and name these values according to your wishes.-NOTE: There will be no issue restoring the cost centre types if any is (mistakenly) deleted or description is changed. Any cost centres will still be linked with the cost centre type ID itself (10, 20, 30) so all that will change with restoring the defaults is that the description will change as well as the deleted types being added again.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2472143-Keywords-Scoping New Country , Cost Center Types , Inconsistency error in fine tune settings

Title: Delayed Messages in Business Communication
Content: Symptom-Few Hanging Messages to and from SAP are seen in Business Communication Monitoring.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Open the Business Communication Monitoring view. -In the dropdown, select Messages Exchanges with SAP.-The messages if any will be displayed.-Cause-This situation usually occurs due to temporary downtime of the SAP system.-Resolution-Please execute re-start button for the hanging messages.-Do those messages appear regularly?--The messages will be in "long running" status because there was temporary downtime of the SAP system. This could happen if the similar situation happens in future.--Does manual re-start works?--Though the status shows "long running", the messages were actually delivered on the last status change on date shown in the UI. You can try Re-start.--Any recommended way how to handle these Messages?--Sometimes there could be inconsistencies between the status shown in the UI and the actual status in the backend. If the re-start from the UI doesn't work, open a case with SAP with the component AP-RC-CEC-B2B.-Keywords-Messages, Business Communication, Monitoring, byd
