Title: Behaviour of Key Figure Actual YTD
Content: Symptom-Run a Report and add Key Figure Actual YTD but the result is not as expected.-Environment- Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Select Design Reports.-For example, Search and open FINGLAU04_Q0004 Financial Statements - Plan/Actual.-Regarding Selection Criteria , Put Company XXX(XXX Represents the ID of the Company).-For Financial Reporting Structure, Put  YYY(YYY Represents the ID of the Reporting Structure).-In the View tab, Remove Key Figures "Plan" "Variance" and "Variance %".-Then Add Key Figure "Actual YTD".-In column add field "Accounting Period/Year".-Result and Expectation:-The expectation is that the results should be accumulated for example in the month February (February should be Actual YTD January+Actual YTD February). However, the system is not accumulating the amounts from the previous period.-Cause-Key figure 'Actual(…)':-Calculation = opening balance + debit - credit .-Actual is the balance of an item for that period range. The opening balance is already as the ending balance of the previous period and hence the data coming is already cumulative. Actual gives balances for the selected period in the fiscal year.-Key figure 'Actual YTD(…)':-Actual YTD gives the balances from the first period to the current date in that fiscal year.-Resolution-This is a standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Actual YTD in Reporting, Report, Financial Statements - Plan/Actual

Title: "Invalid Token Detected" Error When Performing a Filter in Odata Query
Content: Symptom-When performing an Odata query with a filter defined for a text field, the following error message is returned:-Invalid Token Detected at Position X (where X represents the position of a character from the query)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Perform a query using an Odata URL, and defining a filter for a text field. For example:-https://myXYZ.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/v1/c4codataapi/ContactCollection?$filter=Email eq "abc'def@mydomain.com"-Cause-You are using a special character such as single or double quote (' or ") in the field value. As the Odata API uses these characters to limit the begin and the end of the values to be filtered, they are not properly handled by the system, causing the error.-Resolution-Perform the query suppressing the special character. In the example above mentioned in the Reproducing the Issue section, the e-mail of the filter should be inserted as "abcdef@mydomain.com".-The Odata API is capable of identifying the value even without the special characters.-Keywords- OData, Invalid Token Detected, Custom OData, Error, characters.

Title: Error While Executing MDR : RFC Exception SYSTEM_FAILURE Raised No Roll Storage Space of Length Available for OCCURS Area
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Partner reports an incident about the below errors when a custom MDR is executed:-Error during MDR Run-MDR failed-Work package 1: Finished; RFC exception SYSTEM_FAILURE raised-RFC exception SYSTEM_FAILURE raised; No roll storage space of length XYZ available for OCCURS area-RFC exception SYSTEM_FAILURE raised; Unable to fulfill the request for XYZ bytes of memory space-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to UI.-Create a new run for the Custom MDR.-Schedule the MDR.-You can see the above mentioned errors in the Results tab.-Cause-Each transaction requires some main memory space to process application data. If the operating system cannot provide any more space, the transaction is terminated.-This error may arise from following scenarios. You have to analyze the dump in the ST22 transaction and proceed accordingly(2150508 - How To Analyze Partner Dump Issues).-Application log access - The dump is thrown from the framework class.-Query Retrieval of instances - The MDR fails with this error whenever there is a huge amount of data to be processed which cannot be fit into the backend memory allocated/ if a workprocess exceeds the maximum memory that is allowed.-Standard Applications - The dump is thrown from the standard applications due to internal table storage issues.-In parallel jobs - There could be several other jobs scheduled on same time, which would be consuming some heavy load on the server.-Resolution-Case 1: You should forward the incident to MDR framework development team.-Case 2: Suggest customer to build smaller packages of data that is requested, e.g. limit this to 1000 records (or lower if complex data set), and make sure between packages memory is reduced again.-Also you can suggest partners to check and fine tune the PDI coding to fetch lesser amount of data according to your requirement, so that the MDR will not fail.-Case 3: Respective application development team should check.-Case 4: Suggest customer to re-schedule run at different times to reduce the concurrent load on server.-Keywords-RFC, Exception, Failure, MDRO, MDR, PDI, SDK, failed, with, Errors, mass, data, run

Title: Error "Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist" When Trying to Replicate Between SAP Business ByDesign and Success Factors
Content: Symptom- Employee replication runs in to error "Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center-Go to the Employee List view-Search for Failed/Not Started replications-Find the failed attempt with the error message: "Time agreement item deletion not possible; employee times exist"-Cause-The Employee central of Success Factors is sending only one employment instance and Time profile information from the Success factors.-Go to Employee Data Work Center-Go to Employee view-Select All Employees-Search for the Employee -User can see that there are multiple entries records for the employee with different hire dates.-Check the replication file in Master Data replication work center there is only one employment maintained.-Go to Master Data Replication work center-Go to Employees view-Select Failed/Not Started-Select the employee-Select Edit-Go to the Tab Employment-Observe, that only one employment record.-Resolution-The issue has to be checked with the Success factors team why only one employment record is being sent from the Success Factors to ByD.-See Also-SAP Note KBA  2888553- Error Message: "Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist" While Creating new Time Profile -Keywords-Master Data Replication, Employee Replication, Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible, Employee Times Exist, Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist, Employee Data.

Title: Manual Clearing Cannot be Done Due to Error Message: Due date must be the same as or after baseline date
Content: Symptom-In the supplier Trade Payables accounts there's one invoice reversal document. While trying to manually clear this item with other invoices, the system gives error message: 'Due date must be the same as or after baseline date'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-In the Supplier Accounts view, open the details of the Supplier in question.-Show Open Items.-Select the Invoice Reversal document in question, and other invoices to be cleared.-Choose Clear Manually.-In the New Manual Clearing page, error is displayed:-'Due date must be the same as or after baseline date'.-Cause-The original supplier invoice was already cleared by an outgoing payment, and the payment has been confirmed in the bank statement. Later on, instead of canceling the clearing firstly, the supplier invoice was directly canceled, so the original clearing still exists, an invoice reversal document was posted to the supplier account. This cancellation happened a long time ago when an error existed in the inbound agent which changed the payment Baseline Date, so the Baseline Date in the reversal document was not right. Now this issue has been addressed to let the system check this date when creating the reversal document.-Resolution-To fix the issue, the Base Line Date must be checked in the reversal document, and compared with the Due Date. If it's after the Due Date, it has to be adjusted, following the steps below:-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-In the Supplier Accounts view, open the details of the Supplier in question.-Show Open Items.-Open the Invoice Reversal document in question.-Navigate to the General tab, and then change the Base Line Date under Payment Terms section to make it the same or before the Due Date.-After that, it should be possible to successfully clear the documents.-Keywords-due date; base line date; baseline

Title: The Sales Order or Sales Quotes Uploaded via Excel Failed with Errors
Content: Symptom-The Sales Order or Sales Quote uploaded via excel failed with below errors.-'Create not possible; source object inconsistent'-'Party with role Sales Unit missing'-'The currency was not found for account XYZ, sales organization  and distribution channel (XYZ represents the Account ID)'-'Distribution channel or sales organization missing'-'Item XX: Products with item group not supported' (XX represents the Line Item Number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Sales Orders-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales orders view.-Select the New button and choose Sales Order from Microsoft Excel®.-Add mandatory details in the excel.-Upload the excel in Business ByDesign system.-You receive the pop up mentioning Record(s) failed to save due to the errors.-'Create not possible; source object inconsistent'-'Party with role Sales Unit missing'-'The currency was not found for account XYZ, sales organization  and distribution channel (XYZ represents the Account ID)'-'Distribution channel or sales organization missing'-'Item XX: Products with item group not supported'-Sales Quotes:-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Click on the New button, select Sales Quote from Microsoft Excel®.-Fill the template with the relevant information using the Lookup function.-Click on Save data to.-The upload fails with the following error messages:-'Error while copying price components and tax details'-'Party with role Sales Unit missing'-'The currency was not found for account XYZ, sales organization  and distribution channel.'-'Distribution channel or sales organization missing'-'Item XX: Products with item group not supported'-Cause-You have not set the master data correctly and the system is not able to recognize the Sales Unit and Distribution Channel. Or add the Sales Unit and Distribution Channel to the excel template.-Resolution-You can set up the automatic determination of Sales Unit and Distribution Channel in the sales order by following below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view -> Organizational Work Distribution subview.-Select Sales Unit for Sales under Business Area: Sales and Marketing.-Edit the Sales Unit for Sales option.-Select the Add Rule option.-You can add the rule depending upon your business requirement. This rule ensures automatic determination of sales unit in sales documents.-Alternatively you can add the respective field in the excel template as per KBA 1972763 - How to Add the Sales Unit Field in the Excel Upload Template-See Also-Refer to Knowledge Base Article 1972763-Please also kindly check the Community Blog Party Role Determination in a Sales Document for further insights regarding the scenario.-Keywords-sales quote, sales order, upload, error message, template, excel, sales data, item group, product, sales unit

Title: Project Based Intercompany Sales Order is not Released Automatically
Content: Symptom-You have created an Intercompany Purchase Order and upon releaseding/sending the document, you expect that the Sales Order should be released automatically, but the Sales document remains In Preparation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Select New Purchase Order from the Common Tasks.-Enter the needed data.-Click Order.-Open the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order created).-Navigate to the Document Flow tab. -Sales Order XYZ is created, but remain In Preparation. (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Cause-The Project Based Sales Order is not released automatically, since the system is not able to create a Project to the scenario.-This happens because the Organization Unit being used in the scenario is not marked a viable/valid Cost Center.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior for Project based items (Entitlement and Service Project).-Go to Organizational Management - Org Structures-Select the Org Unit ID ABC (ABC represents the Org Unit used in the sales order)-Click on Edit and navigate to Definitions subtab.  -Please mark the Organization Unit as a Cost Center-See Also-KBA: 1828436 - Intercompany Project Scenario: The Automatically Created Sales Order is not Released Automatically by the System.-KBA: 2487134 - The Intercompany Project is not Created Automatically From Sales Order-Keywords-Sales Order, Purchase Order, Intercompany, Responsible Unit, Project

Title: 'Undefined Date Format' Info Message While Uploading Fixed Assets Migration File
Content: Symptom-When trying to upload a file for Migration Object Fixed Assets (extended) in the Migration Tool, right after the upload the system is throwing info message:-'Undefined Date Format-Some date entries are in error; enter dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before initiating the migration'.-Since it is only an info message you click OK and proceed to Process File, however the file validation fails with the error message:-'File validation failed. Create an incident.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select the row of Migration Unit for Company ABC (where ABC means the Company for which you are trying to migrate fixed assets).-Click Execute Migration button.-Select the row of Migration Object Fixed Assets (extended) and click Upload File.-Select the XML file and upload it.-At this point, system will throw the info/warning message:-'Undefined Date Format-Some date entries are in error; enter dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before initiating the migration'.-Then click OK, and proceed to Process File, the file validation will fail with error message:-'File validation failed. Create an incident.'-Cause-The XML file contains a Date format which is not compliant with the Date format that system is expecting.-For example:-In the XML file you have Date format as DD.MM.YYYY (for example 31.01.2017), but the system is expecting Date format YYYY-MM-DD (for example 2017-01-31).-Resolution-The Date format should be changed in the XML migration file to the format that system is expecting (in the example analyzed YYYY-MM-DD).-For example in Microsoft Excel this change can be done to a whole column at once by selecting the respective column and changing the cell type by following the below steps.-Open the Microsoft Excel.-Go to the Home tab.-Click the arrow icon in the Number section.-Select Date category.-Select YYYY-MM-DD type.-This action should be performed for every single Date cell in the XML file.-Once the changes are finished, upload the file again and proceed to Process File. If no other issues exist the file validation will finish successfully this time.-See Also-The instructions contained in this KBA are compatible with Microsoft® Excel® for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2308 Build 16.0.16731.20542) 64-bit.-Keywords-Undefined Date Format; YYYY-MM-DD; File validation failed. Create incident

Title: How to find a Sales Order in ByD Created from a Webshop with ReleaseCustomerRequest set to False
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to find a Sales Order Created from a Webshop with ReleaseCustomerRequest set to False.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Your Sales Order was created by a webshop successfully, however you cannot find the sales order neither in the UI or in the backend.-Cause-As the ReleaseCustomerRequest is set to false this is the normal system behaviour that the order is not shown in the UI. In the test shell you would need to remove the default flag to show orders with ReleaseCustomerRequest set to False.-Resolution-As you can see in the screenshot attached, in order to find the sales order with ReleaseCustomerRequest set to False it is necessary to remove the pre-filled filter that exclude all sales order with a ReleaseCustomerRequest = 1 (Not Released)-    For your reference, This action call is not related to the Release action on the Sales Order UI.-  See Also-1757249 - Sales Volume Report Show Incorrect Data-2000395 - Release a Sales Order Automatically via the Web Service-1840866 - You Are Not Able to Find your Sales Order created from your E-Shop in the ByD system-2626296 - Sales Order Created via Web Service Not Automatically Released-Keywords-ReleaseCustomerRequest; missing Sales Order; E-Commerce; E-Selling; Web Service

Title: Relative Selections do not work with Custom Financial Reports
Content: Symptom-You have created a customized financial report based on a SAP Standard Financial data source and created a relative selection for characteristic Accounting Period/Year for example but the selection does not work.-For this example, we are using the data source ﻿G/L Account Period Totals / Balances (FINGLAU01).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and access the view Design Reports.-Click New Report.-Define a name for your newly created financial report and select the data source G/L Account Period Totals / Balances (FINGLAU01), then, click Next.-In the next steps, select all relevant Key Figures and Characteristics for the report, then click Finish.-Open your newly created report and click the value help for Accounting Period/Year for example.-Select any relative selection from the list and click Go.-See that the selection is not applied to the report.-Cause-Because of the Fiscal Year Variant, relative selections do not work with custom financial reports.-Resolution-This is a known limitation in the system. You can, however, create a custom relative selection for a custom date.-Please note: the relative selection will work with custom financial report when opened from Business Analytics Work center. Therefore, the limitation does not apply to Business Analytics work center.-See Also-Help Documentation: Relative Selections Quick Guide-Keywords-financial report; custom report; relative selection; selection; fiscal year; business analytics; selection does not work

Title: Expense Report error: "This expense report is currently being edited by ABC"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You try to open Expense Report XYZ but receive either of the following messages:-"This expense report is currently being edited by ABC". However user ABC is not editing the expense claim.-"You have locked this object in another window for editing .Do you want to unlock it".-(XYZ represents the Expense Report ID, ABC represents the user name that is editing the expsen claim)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel Admin work center-Go to the Expense Reports view-Find Expense Report ID XYZ-Open the Expese Report-You receive the following error message:-Error: "This expense report is currently being edited by ABC"-Cause-When user ABC closed the expense report the lock was not relased from the Back end.-Resolution-You need to remove the object locks from the customers back end.-Log into the backend.-Go to the transaction SM12.-Identify locks for user ABC.-Delete the locks for user ABC.-Once you have removed the object locks the expense report should now be available to edit.-Keywords-Expense Report, locked, currently edited by, locked this object

Title: How to solve issues of Inconsistent report assignment after upgrade
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-This document is meant ONLY for the Analytics/FSI/TREX Expert Support Team since the wrong usage of these reports could cause system instability.-After the system upgrade (in this case 4.0) some inconsistencies are encountered with custom reports. Below are the possible scenarios the user may encounter:-Report missing from application work centers.-Unassigned reports after upgrade.-Unable to open the report due to an authorization error (in case of ICP).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Business Analytics work center then choose Design Reports view.-Search for the desired custom report. In this case XYZ.-You can see that the report XYZ is assigned to work center XX correctly.-If you go to work center XX the report is not shown.-In addition, if you open a work center where the report is displayed as Information Consume Pattern (ICP) an error message is shown: You are not authorized to execute report XYZ.-Cause-The handling of the so-called invalidation folders in the Multiplexer has a loophole.-Resolution-TX: SE38 - P_XREP_CORE_GENERATE_LOAD – Use parameters as described below (will take 5-10 minutes).-Select Layer Strategy then Only for Files with CT and enter LAYER_CUST into the Layer Strategy field.-Result:-Successful to generate LOAD for file: /SAP_BYDGLO_APPLICATION_UI/fin/tx/TaxManagement_ServiceTaxReturns_WCView.WCVIEW.uiwocview in layer strategy LAYER_CUST.-Successful to generate LOAD for file: /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/BCTools/WorkCentre/BCOverviewOWL.OWL.uicomponent in layer strategy LAYER_CUST.---------------LOAD Generation/Invalidation finished.-TX: SE38 – Program: AP_UI_XTS_REGEN_SCOPING_INDEX (will take 2-5 minutes).-TX: SE38 – Program: AP_RBAM_POLICY_GENERATION (use default parameters – will take about 10 minutes). NOTE: The reports SHOULD NOT be run if the Receiver Queue Status is set to ‘Active/Yellow’ -  Initial Load Active-Select Execute (F8).-Result:-Regenerate the Scoping Index Table.-Generation is running in manual mode.-Generation user: SAP_SUPP001.-Layer Strategy of user: LAYER_CUST.-Scoping Generator Version: 0400080001.-77 workcenters determined for scope check.------------------- NOTE: You can then advise the customer run the Report Assignment Details report in order to check the assignment compliance with the work centers.-Keywords-report assignment, FSI, unassign all, reassign all

Title: Display Currency Does Not Work in Report
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom key figure which uses 'Currency Conversion' but when using it in the report, you cannot see all lines being converted as expected. It does not work for all currencies in the report.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports work center view.-Search for the report.-Open it.-Select 'Display Currency' as 'USD'.-Run it.-You can see results for custom key figure having different currencies (e.g. BRL, EUR).-Cause-There is no currency conversion maintained for the currency selected under 'Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies' configuration of 'Default Exchange Rate Type' type. Therefore, the report cannot convert the currency since it has no reference. The analytical framework just recognizes those currencies which are maintained under 'Default Exchange Rate Type' (i.e. 001 - Default Exchange Rate Type) for the report conversion. Those currencies which were imported from different systems and are available under 'All Exchange Rate Type' selection are not considered for the custom key figure currency conversion. You can check if the required conversion is maintained in the system following these steps:-Go to Administration work center.-Go to Common Tasks work center view.-Click on 'Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies'. -Select 'Default Exchange Rate Type'.-You can see those currencies which the 'Display Currency' option uses.-Resolution-You can maintain a currency conversion of 'Default Exchange Rate Type' to be considered by the 'Display Currency' following these steps:-Go to Administration work center.-Go to Common Tasks work center view.-Click on 'Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies'. -Select 'Default Exchange Rate Type'.-Click on 'Download Excel XML Template'.-Edit it and maintain those values as required.-Click on 'Import'.-Select the Excel XML file downloaded.-You'll have a reference for the 'Display Currency' conversion. -See Also-1963229 - Currency not converting when using a custom key figure in the report-Keywords-custom key figure, currency conversion report, display currency report, display currency, report conversion custom, key figure properties, currency properties, asterix

Title: Supplier or Customer Account Monitor throws Error Message 'Error in Heuristic Retrieve_Root_Node_ID for Node:Item_Details'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have created a new Supplier Invoice or Customer Invoice for a recently maintained Supplier or Customer.-You view the Open Items of e.g. the Supplier Invoice in the Supplier Account Monitor.-You then get this Error Message: 'Error in heuristic RETRIEVE_ROOT_NODE_ID for Node:ITEM_DETAILS'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Select the Supplier Accounts View.-Choose the Supplier ABC (ABC represents the Supplier ID).-Press View.-Open the Trade Payables tab.-Highlight the Open Item with External Reference DEF (DEF represents the Supplier Invoice).-You can see the Error Message 'Error in heuristic RETRIEVE_ROOT_NODE_ID for Node:ITEM_DETAILS'.-Cause-This issue needs an FSI reload, then the Error Message will disappear.-Resolution-Request a support user with L6 access level (SAP_SUPPORT_L6).-Open the Backend.-Enter transaction 'gfsstm' and press Enter.-Under Business Object maintain 'FOPXD_TRPACCT' and press Execute.-Scroll down on the left under 'Fast Search Views' until you can see the node 'FSP_FIN_TRPACCT'.-Expand this node by clicking on the arrow on the left.-Select all the sub-nodes. -At the top of the screen Load, check the Number on the right side. If You find it in high range then perform the FSI view reload out of business hours. -Click on Persistence and Press Yes.-Press Refresh until you see the changes are applied.-Go to the UI.-When you open now the Trade Payables tab in the Supplier Account Monitor you can see no Error Message anymore.-See Also- 2734130 - Error "Instance With the Same Key Already Exists'' When Adding Financial Data on an Account -Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Open Items Payable; heuristic Retrieve_ROOT_NODE_ID; New Customer or Supplier; Supplier Account Monitor; Customer Account Monitor; Customer Invoice; Lieferantenrechnung; Kundenrechnung; heuristisch

Title: Last and First Name of an Employee is Not Displayed in the Order you Expect
Content: Symptom-Last and fist name of an employee is not displayed in the order you expect.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In our example we will use an employee which is located in Japan.-Go to the People work center.-Select the Employees view.-Open employee ABC EFG(ABC represents the first name and EFG represents the last name of the employee)-On the left pane header the name of the employee is displayed ABC EFG (First Name Last Name).-However in Japan the order should be EFG ABC (Last Name First Name).-Cause-Every business partner person has a value for the attribute Country for Name Format. If for the corresponding country value name formatting rules are maintained in your Business Configuration the system will use the formatting accordingly. If no rule for this specific country has been maintained a fall back is used to format the name.-In our example, for employee ABC EFG the value for the attribute Country for Name Format is JP - Japan. However no name formatting rule for the country Japan has been maintained in the system.-Resolution-You can check the Country for Name Format for the employee as follows:-Go to the Business Partner work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the employee ABC EFG.-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the Additional Name Fields hyperlink.-In the field Country for Name Format the respective value for this attribute is in your case JP – Japan.-To maintain a rule for the respective country (Japan in our example) you can use the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the First Implementation view.-Select you implementation project.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Select All Activities in the Show field.-Select the General Business Partners and click on the Add to Project button.-Open the activity and click on the Maintain Name Formats hyperlink.-Click on the Add Row button in the Name Formats section.-Add the country JP – Japan.-In the Details of Name Format section you can add the respective fields and their position as per requirement for the country you just added.-Click on the Save and Close button.-The formatting for the employee ABC EFG is now done according to the rule you have just created.-See Also-2734352 - Some Employee's Names are Displayed as 'Name Surname' and Others as 'Surname Name'-2696095 - The Name Format of An Employee is Not Consistent in All Views-2810661 - Employee Name Displayed as Last Name First Name, Even Though you Have Maintained Another Name Format in Business Configuration-Keywords-Employee, Employee Name, Order, First Name, Last Name

Title: Assigned Reports Missing in Work Centers
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-The customer has created custom reports and assigned them to work centers. However, these reports are not available in the reports list even though they are not hidden.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Search for a custom report and click Assign.-See that it is assigned to a work center, for example, Managing My Area. It is not hidden.-Go to the work center Managing My Area, view Reports.-The report is not listed here.-Cause-There an inconsistency in the backend, which is normally corrected automatically by the system. In this case, the automatic backend report failed.-Resolution-It may already help if the customer takes one report, unassigns it, saves, and then assigns the report again. Otherwise, you can perform the following steps (see screenshot below):-Log on to the backend.-Open the transaction se38.-Enter the report AEL_LARU_REPL.-Execute (F8).-Message "LARU repl succ" is seen when successful else "LARU repl failed" is displayed.-This report does not cause any changes in the customer system, so no specific authorizations are required from the customer.-Keywords-report missing, report not visible, not shown, custom report, report assignment, business analytics, reports list, report list, AEL_LARU_REPL, backend report

Title: Revenue Recognition run Considers Current Exchange Rate for Previously Posted Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-Due to floating exchange rates the revenue recognition run posts an accrual or a deferral revenue amount for an invoiced sales order item maintained in foreign currency.-For the sales order item accrual method  1-Recognize at point of invoice is assigned-As the sales order item is fully invoiced you do not expect the revenue recognition to consider any exchange rate differences for customer invoices posted in previous periods.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center. -Go to Revenue Recognition view.  -Find and open Revenue Recognition Run ABC (ABC represents the ID of the run).-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab and select Advanced Information. Then choose the Event Based sub-tab. -You notice an accrued revenue (if the current total earned revenue value is higher than in previous periods) or a deferred revenue (of the current total earned revenue value is higher than realized before). -Cause-The sales order item is not completed for revenue recognition: -Go to the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenues work center.  -Find the sales order item in  question.-Go to the Accounting Data tab.  -You notice the Revenue fully recognized indicator is not set. -As long as this indicator is not set,  any exchange rate fluctuations will update the realised revenue of the sales order item. -There can be different reasons, why the Revenue fully recognized indicator not set:-The sales order item is not yet completed: The Final Delivery or Invoice Date not set:  In  the Sales Document Items view check the Final Delivery and Invoice Date. -The Final Delivery or Invoice date is after the posting date of the revenue recognition run. In that case any exchange rate fluctuations are considered until the final  delivery and invoice date is on  or before the revenue recognition run's posting date.  -Resolution-If only the invoiced value on the posting date of the customer invoice is to be considered,  assign accrual method (5- Recog at point of invoice (invoiced rev)). This accrual method only considers the exact revenue at point of invoice and does not consider any exchange rate differences, even if the sales order item not yet completed.-If you are dealing with Fixed Price items, the option above is not available, and the solution is to manually complete the Sales Order Item in the Customer Invoicing work center. Then, once completed, all accruals will be cleared with the next run.-Keywords-revenue recognition run; deferred revenue; accrued revenue, exchange rate differences, recognize at point of invoice, fixed price, project based

Title: Warning / Information Message While Accessing Exchange Rate Screen
Content: Symptom-When a user navigates to the Edit Exchange Rate view a warning / information message shows:-Different user and system time zone. Check that the date/time conversion from user to system time zone does not lead to a date change. SAP recommends to use a user having system time zone. User time zone (UTC+00:00) Greenwich Mean Time with daylight saving time (UK), system time zone (UTC+00:00) Burkina Faso, Bouvet Islands, Cote d'Ivoire, West Sahara, Ghana, Greenland, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Heard/McDon.Isl, Brit.Ind.Oc.Ter, Iceland.-Or-Different user and tenant time zone. User time zone (UTC+00:00) Burkina Faso, Bouvet Islands, Cote d'Ivoire, West Sahara, Ghana, Greenland, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Heard/McDon.Isl, Brit.Ind.Oc.Ter, Iceland, tenant time zone (UTC+00:00) Greenwich Mean Time with daylight saving time (UK).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger work center.-Select Common Tasks -> Edit Exchange Rates view.-Here the system raises the information message:-Different user and system time zone. Check that the date/time conversion from user to system time zone does not lead to a date change. SAP recommends to use a user having system time zone. User time zone (UTC+00:00) Greenwich Mean Time with daylight saving time (UK), system time zone (UTC+00:00) Burkina Faso, Bouvet Islands, Cote d'Ivoire, West Sahara, Ghana, Greenland, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Heard/McDon.Isl, Brit.Ind.Oc.Ter, Iceland.-Or-Different user and tenant time zone. Check that the date/time conversion from user to tenant time zone does not lead to a date change. SAP recommends to use a user having system time zone. User time zone (UTC+00:00) Burkina Faso, Bouvet Islands, Cote d'Ivoire, West Sahara, Ghana, Greenland, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Heard/McDon.Isl, Brit.Ind.Oc.Ter, Iceland, tenant time zone (UTC+00:00) Greenwich Mean Time with daylight saving time (UK).-Cause-The information message displayed on the exchange rate screen is to inform the user that ByDesign is considering the (UTC+00:00) time zone to have an international standard.-This will be raised for systems having a system time zone set up deviating from (UTC+00:00) Burkina Faso, Bouvet Islands, Cote d'Ivoire, West Sahara, Ghana, Greenland, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Heard/McDon.Isl, Brit.Ind.Oc.Ter, Iceland.-Besides this, every tenant may have a time zone different from system time zone. time zone is different from system time zone or tenant time zone - the system raises the information message.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects Title: Error Message: 'Posting date must be after or the same as dd.mm.yyyy' in a Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-Upon posting a payment allocation including the allocation type Payment Assignment you retrieve the error message:-Posting date must be after or the same as dd.mm.yyyy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In case you are processing a bank statement and want to assign payments in the resulting payment allocation-you can either access the relevant payment allocation via:-Work Center: Payment Management.-Navigate to the View: Payment Allocations.-Select and Edit the relevant payment allocation.-- or via the posted bank statement.-Work Center: Liquidity Management.-View: Bank Statements.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and Edit.-Follow the link Postprocessing required to access the relevant payment allocation.-  In the Payment Allocation choose View All.-Under tab Payment Assignment you choose the relevant payment(s) represented in the bank statement and drag them into the allocation grid.-Immediately the error message shows and the field Posting Date is highlighted.-Cause-At least one of the involved transactions has a posting date later than the default payment allocation date dd.mm.yyyy, which reflects the bank statement date.-It is a definition that the posting date of the payment allocation cannot be earlier than the date of any of the involved transactions.-Resolution-Check the effective posting date of the involved assigned payment(s) and adjust the posting date of the payment allocation to a date which at its earliest reflects the posting date of the latest assigned payment. For that, you will have first to reverse the Payment Allocation to edit the Posting Date for the transaction.-To reverse Payment Allocation:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Open the posted payment allocation you want to reverse.-Click Reverse.-After reversing it, you will be able to adjust the posting date.-See Also-1854613 - Manual Payment Clearing - Posting Date Not Permitted - Posting Date Can't be Edited-Keywords-payment allocation; posting date

Title: How to Delete Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article describes different scenarios regarding deleting or retiring fixed assets that can no longer be used.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If you manually create a fixed asset, and the fixed asset is still In Process, then you can select this fixed asset, and choose Delete, the fixed asset can be directly deleted in this way, but this fixed asset number can no longer to reused. In fact, you don't necessarily need to delete this fixed asset, instead, you can change the Fixed Asset Description, Fixed Asset Class as well as Individual Material Description etc.-If the fixed asset is Capitalized, and an individual material is shown as Acquired in the Master Data of the fixed asset, it can no longer be deleted. In order to remove it from your asset portfolio, you can follow the steps below:-Select this fixed asset, choose Manual Posting and then Complete Scrapping.-Check the proposed Document Date and Posting Date. You can change the proposed Closing Step.-Enter a Description when necessary.-Choose Add Row to specify an additional fixed asset number or subasset number to be scrapped completely. Click Delete to remove a fixed asset ID or subasset ID from the list.-Click Simulate to display the document in the general ledger and preview it before the Posting is made.-Post it, the asset is retired from the company at the current net book value excluding revenue.-  If the fixed asset is Capitalized, but the initial acquisition cost is set as zero, in order to retire it, Complete Scrapping is not possible, you may follow the steps below: if the migrated fixed asset is Capitalized but the initial acquisition cost is set to zero the Deactivation Date is only available once Migration process control is in place with a restricted Entry possible Until date.-Edit this fixed asset, and navigate to the Master Data tab.-Select Life Cycle Data.-Set the Deactivation Data for all the set of books.-Save, and the fixed asset will be set to Retired.-  If the fixed asset is Capitalized, you don't want to set this fixed asset to retired but to scrap the related individual material, please follow the steps below:-Select this fixed asset, choose Manual Posting and then Individual Material Scrapping.-Check the proposed Document Date and Posting Date. You can enter a Description. You can change the proposed Closing Step.-Check the specified Individual Material ID or select an individual material.-Click Simulate to display the document in the general ledger and preview it before the Posting is made.-Post it, the scrapped individual material is set as Retired. Note that if you scrap the last individual material assigned to a fixed asset, the system sets the status of the fixed asset to Retired. The asset is then no longer managed on the balance sheet.-  Meanwhile, you can also use Complete Transfer of Individual Material to completely transfer an individual material from one fixed asset to another, the original fixed asset will be set as Retired if there is only one individual material assigned.-Select the fixed asset or subasset and choose Manual Posting and then Complete Transfer of Individual Material.-Check the proposed Document Date and Posting Date. You can enter a Description. You can change the proposed Closing Step.-Check the specified source individual material number or select a source individual material.-Specify the fixed asset number and subasset number of the target fixed asset. If the target fixed asset has a subasset number, the system adds this information automatically. For multiple subassets, you need to select the corresponding subasset number.-Alternatively, you can click New to create a new fixed asset.-Click Simulate to display the document in the general ledger and preview it before the Posting is made.-You can refer to the above mentioned scenarios to delete or retire fixed assets.-See Also-1984584 - How to Set the Deactivation Date for Migrated Fixed Assets-2746985 - Cannot Set Deactivation Date For Migrated Fixed Asset-Keywords-delete fixed assets, retire fixed assets, how to

Title: Error Message "Changing The Conversion Not Possible" While Editing Quantity Conversion of Material or Service
Content: Symptom-When trying to change or delete a quantity conversion maintained in a material or service's master data, when system raises an error message such as the ones below or something similar:-Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open procurement price lists, source documents for supplier invoices-Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open customer quotes, procurement price lists, purchase orders, sales orders, source documents for supplier invoices-Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open stock items-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Access the Materials or the Services view.-Locate and select the relevant material/service.-Choose the Edit button.-Choose the View All button.-In the General tab, scroll down to Quantity Conversion section.-Try to delete or change a quantity conversion.-Error message is raised.-Cause-The relevant material or service is already used in one or more documents of the type(s) mentioned in the error message, so it is:-Not possible to modify the existing quantity conversion.-Not possible to remove the existing quantity conversion.-Not possible to have another row with a different value for the same UoM (unit of measure) combination.-The reason for this is that the business documents which are using this material or service would end up in inconsistency if the change was allowed.-The veto check executed is not at quantity conversion level, but rather at material/service level: if that material/service is being used in a document, even if the quantity conversion used is one other than the one you intend to delete or change, the system will still block the action.-Resolution-Closing or canceling documents that reference the relevant material or service may permit changes to the quantity conversion. However, this functionality is highly application-specific and may not be effective for all document types. As such, this approach cannot be guaranteed to resolve the issue.-Therefore, the recommended solution is to create a new material with the required quantity conversions correctly maintained and block the existing material.-Keywords-Quantity, Conversion, Product, Material, Service, Changing The Conversion Not Possible, quantity conversion.

Title: Incoterms and Incoterms Location are not Taken from Account When Creating New Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You defined the Incoterms and Incoterms Location in the account master data for a certain sales chain combination. But when creating a sales order for this account, after setting the sales unit and distribution channel, the corresponding Incoterms and Incoterms Location are not taken from the account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create new sales order and put account, sales unit, distribution channel and other required data.-Click View All, you find the Incoterms and Incoterms Location are missing in General tab.-Cause-The Incoterms are determined from the Ship-To Party.-Incoterms and Incoterm Location will get identified on the basis of Ship-To only when correct sales org and distribution channel are determined automatically. In this case, the sales unit determination is not set, so system failed to determine the sales unit and thus failed to identfied the Incoterms and Incoterms Location.-Please Note: If the Ship-To Party on header level is the same as on Item Level, the changes on the header will cascade to the Item. If the Ship-To on Item level is not the same as the Ship-To on header level, the changes on header level in the General tab will not be cascaded to this item since it is being shipped to a different Ship-To party. The incoterms on Item level are then brought over to the customer demand, as this is where we are selling to.-Resolution-You have to maintain a rule for sales unit so that when creating the sales order the sales unit can be automatically determined.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-In the Find fields, search Involved Parties for Sales Orders.-Open it and select Sales Unit row.-Click buttom Maintain Determinations and maintain a rule as per your business requirement.-Afterwards, when creating new sales order, the sales unit can be determined automatically and the Incoterms and Incoterms Location can be picked from account master data.-See Also-KBA 2144304 - Incoterms And Incoterms Location Are Missing While Creating New Sales Order-Keywords-Incoterms, Account, Sales Order

Title: Tax Payment Error: 'Define a default profit center for company XYZ and subledger Tax'
Content: Symptom-While posting or approving a Tax Payment the system shows an error message: 'Define a default profit center for company XYZ and subledger Tax'.-XYZ means the Company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax management work center.-Click the Tax Payments view.-Open the Tax payment.-Click Post.-OR-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Click the Approvals view.-Select the task - Approve Tax Payment ABC. (ABC represents the Tax Payment ID)-Click Approve.-You see the error message: 'Define a default profit center for company XYZ and subledger Tax'.-Cause-If the Reporting Principle is Profit Center Accounting and Segment Reporting for the set of Books, then it is required that we derive profit center for all postings done on P&L accounts.-Resolution-You have to maintain Default Profit Center using below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click the Overview.-Search for the fine tune activity - Profit Center Derivation.-Click Edit Default Profit Center.-Maintain line 1 with Subledger value as 'Tax' and a profit center.-Maintain line 2 with Subledger value blank/empty and a profit center.-Click Save.-After maintaining the default profit center, system allows you to post or approve the Tax Payment.-See Also-Help Document Reporting Principles.-Keywords-Error while approving payment, Profit center error in tax payment

Title: Different Discount List Selections Fetching the Same Discount Lists
Content: Symptom-Two or more Discount List selections created with different Item Pricing Tables show the same Discount Lists when used.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Open the Discount Lists view.-Use Selection ABC (Where ABC Represents one of the Selections created).-A list of Discount Lists is displayed.-Now, change the Selection to DEF (Where DEF Represents a different Selection).-The same list of Discount Lists is displayed.-Cause-This happens when two or more Pricing Group Assignments use the same Header Pricing Table but different Item Pricing Tables. This can be checked as follows: -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select the Implementation project and click on Open Activity.-In the Fine Tune tab select the activity Configure Price Strategy and click on Open.-Select the Pricing Group Assignments hyperlink.-One or more Discount Lists will have the same Header Pricing Tables (But different Item Pricing Tables).-Using the same Header Pricing Table in this way is not supported and will lead to duplication issues. -Resolution-Please ensure that Header Pricing Tables are not used between two or more Discount Lists.-See Also-2798721 - Custom Discount List or Price List Does Not Appear in the Discount List OWL-Keywords-Discount List, Duplication, Duplicated, List, Selection, Change, Header, Pricing, Item, Price Strategy, Pricing Group Assignments

Title: Revenue of Sales Order not Realised by Revenue Recognition Run but in the Customer Invoice Directly
Content: Symptom-Sales order item XYX-XX with item type SEFL - Service- fixed price without actuals is fully delivered and invoiced (XYZ-XX represents a sales order item ID). -An event-based accrual method is assigned to the item (either Recognize at point of delivery or Recognize at point of invoice). -However, the revenue recognition run does not process the sales order item. Instead, the revenue is directly realised through the invoice of the service confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Sales Orders work center go to the Sales Orders view and find sales order XYZ. -Open the sales order and check the document flow.-You can see the service order. Access the service order to verify it confirms the full quantity. -When using accrual method Recognize at point of delivery: -    4. You execute the revenue recognition run. The run does not realise any revenue for the confirmed quantity. -When using accrual method Recognize at point of invoice: -In the sales order's document flow you can also see the customer invoice. -Check the journal entry of the customer invoice: Its revenue has been credited to a Revenue account already. -You expected the customer invoice to be posted to Deferred Revenue first. The revenue recognition run then is to clear the deferred revenue and to realise the revenue on the revenue account. -Cause-Sales Order item XYZ-XX is of item type Service - fixed price without actuals. When working with this item type an actual service confirmation is not necessary. The created service confirmation is not referenced to the sales order item. The revenue is realised through the service confirmation and not through the sales order item. -You'll notice the sales order item's Delivery and Invoice status has not started. -In the Sales Document Items view, Accounting Data tab you notice no Incurred Costs or Invoiced Revenue is recorded. -Resolution-When working with item type SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals the service must be confirmed through the sales order item via the Complete Service Execution option (either on item or header level).-This will trigger the service confirmation directly for the sales order item, deriving the service costs from the item's maintained labour resource and duration.-The sales order item's delivery status has changed to Finished. -With the completion of the execution a sales order item invoice request is triggered. The resulting invoice will be posted to Deferred Revenue. -The invoice status of the sales order item is Finished.-The revenue recognition run will process the sales order item to clear the deferred revenue and realise the invoiced value on the revenue account.-In the Sales Document Items view, Accounting Data tab you can see values appearing in the Incurred Costs and Invoiced Revenue field. -See Also-Services-Keywords-sales order not processed by revenue recognition run, invoice revenue not deferred but directly realized

Title: Withholding Amount is Recalculated when Creating Payments for a Migrated Supplier Invoice in Mexico
Content: Symptom-When creating payments for a migrated supplier invoice in Mexico, the default withholding amount differs from the figure maintained in the migration file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Search for supplier account ID ABC.-View all items.-Select Document ID DEF.-Open the related clearing document XYZ.-The default withholding amount is for example, 1000 USD.-However, when checking the migration file, the total withholding tax amount is, for example 800 USD, which differs from the calculated amount 1000 USD.-(ABC represents the supplier account ID. DEF represents the migrated supplier invoice ID. XYZ represents the clearing document ID.)-Cause-The VAT tax rate in the migration file is different from the one maintained in the BYD system. The system will NOT check the VAT tax amount when uploading the template.-However, when creating payments for supplier invoices, the system will recheck the tax rate and recalculate the VAT tax amount. And the subsequent calculations for withholding tax amounts will also be based on the recalculated VAT tax amount.-Resolution-This is the current system design to avoid inconsistencies when creating payment. Change the tax rate in the system and make it the same as the one used in the migration file can help resolve the issue.-Steps to check and change VAT tax code in the system:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Open Define Tax Rate Schedules.-The respective Tax rate can be changed in this view.-Keywords-withholding tax, outgoing payment amount, clearing document, VAT tax amount, tax code, supplier invoice

Title: Address Not Determined Correctly In Follow-Up Manual Invoice Request or Manual Credit Memo Request.
Content: Symptom-Address details for parties such as Sales Unit and Invoicing Unit is not derived correctly even though it is maintained in master data for the Manual Invoice Request or Manual Credit Memo created as a follow up of the existing Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center-Go to Invoice Documents View-Search for Invoice XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Invoice)-Select the Invoice and click on Follow Up -Select Manual Invoice or Manual Credit Memo-In the new Invoice screen, click on View all and navigate to Involved parties-Select Sales Unit, you can see the address displayed is not the expected one.-You expect the system to pick the latest address maintained in the master data. When you create a new Manual Invoice Request or Credit Memo Invoice Request which is not a follow up of any Invoice, you can see the address is derived correctly-Cause-Manual Credit Memo Request or Manual Invoice Request is created as a follow up of the Customer Invoice XYZ, hence the address maintained in the Invoice will be copied to Manual Credit Memo Request or Manual Invoice Request. This is ensure the consistency of parties and address in both documents.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Address, Manual invoice request, manual credit memo, address missing;

Title: Unable to Change Invoice Approval Process - draft
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-When attempting to remove a process step from the Supplier Invoice Approval Process, the system returns a "SAP 500 Internal Server Error".-Backend analysis (ST22) shows an ABAP dump with the following details:-Category: ABAP Programming Error-Runtime Error: ASSERTION_FAILED-ABAP Program: CL_WKF_BRF_DEPLOY=============CP-Application Component: SRD-CC-BTM-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select Approval Processes view-Choose the relevant approval process -Click on copy-Select and remove a process step-Click Save-"SAP 500 Internal Server Error" Dump Occurs--Cause-Calculated attributes may cause this kind of issue. After their removal, the approval process can be copied without any issues.-Resolution-The issue requires verification by the Development team (SRD-CC-BTM) to identify the attribute(s) causing this behavior.-Once the relevant attribute(s) have been identified by Development team, perform the following steps:-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Choose the Approval Processes view.-Select the relevant approval process.-Choose Copy.-Select the relevant process step.-In the Conditions section below the selected process step, remove the attribute(s) identified by the Development team.-Save the changes.-Note: The above customer-side steps should be performed only after the Development team (SRD-CC-BTM) has verified and identified the affected attribute(s).-Keywords-system dumps, error, fails, not possible, SAP 500 Internal Server Error, Supplier Invoice Approval Process, Copy, Remove Process Step, ASSERTION_FAILED, Approval Process

Title: How to Reject Contract Cancellation Request
Content: Symptom-The cancellation information was set at the item level of a Customer Contract, a task was created and you would like to know how to cancel/remove the task. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Task Management work center.-Search using the Contract ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Contract).-Subject: Automatic Cancellation of Contract Item ABC - 10.-Resolution-In case the Cancellation Effective On Date has not reached, please perform the following: -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select item 10.-Scroll down and remove the Cancellation Reason.-This is will remove the cancellation information of the item and cancel the task. -Keywords-Cancellation Reason, Contract, Customer Contract, Reject, Task, Business Task Management, Cancellation Request

Title: How to Query a Price List by ID or UUID via the Web Service QuerySalesPriceListIn
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to query a Price List by Price List ID or UUID via the Web Service QuerySalesPriceListIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Since this service is based on the TypeCode, PropertyID and PropertyValue, you must pass either of the parameters to fetch the query along with PriceListID or UUID.-Type Code 7PL0 is used for Base Price List, Distribution Chain Price List, Customer Specific Price List, Base Price List by Product Category, Distribution Chain Price List by Product Category, Customer Group Specific Price List-Type Code 7PL1 is used for Overall Customer Discount-Type Code 7PL2 is used for Customer Specific Discount Products-Type Code 7PL3 is used for Overall Customer Group Discount-Type Code 7PL4 is used for Customer Specific Discount Product Category-Resolution-Here a sample Payload where the Type Code is 7PL0 since it is a Base Price List and the Price List ID is Base Price List Company X:-<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap=http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope xmlns:glob=http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global>-   <soap:Header/>-   <soap:Body>-      <glob:SalesPriceListFindByTypeCodeAndPropertyIDAndPropertyValueQuery_sync>-         <SalesPriceList>-            <TypeCode>7PL0</TypeCode>-            <ID>Base Price List Company X</ID>-         </SalesPriceList>-      </glob:SalesPriceListFindByTypeCodeAndPropertyIDAndPropertyValueQuery_sync>-   </soap:Body>-</soap:Envelope>-  Here a sample Payload where the Type Code is 7PL0 since it is a Base Price List and the  UUID of the Price List is 7fb92382-9129-1ede-b8d5-5db4f0bdc4c9:-<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap=http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope xmlns:glob=http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global>-   <soap:Header/>-   <soap:Body>-      <glob:SalesPriceListFindByTypeCodeAndPropertyIDAndPropertyValueQuery_sync>-         <SalesPriceList>-            <TypeCode>7PL0</TypeCode>-            <UUID>7fb92382-9129-1ede-b8d5-5db4f0bdc4c9</UUID>-         </SalesPriceList>-      </glob:SalesPriceListFindByTypeCodeAndPropertyIDAndPropertyValueQuery_sync>-   </soap:Body>-</soap:Envelope>-See Also-KBA 3195901 - How to Query Campaign Specific Price List via the Web Service QuerySalesPriceListIn-Keywords-QuerySalesPriceListIn; Web Service; Webservice; Query: Price List;

Title: System is Not Proposing The Source Logistics Area in The Outbound Pick Task
Content: Symptom-The system is not selecting Source Logistics Area automatically within the Site A. If you click Source Logistics Area in the relevant Task, you can see there are two logistics areas available with sufficient quantities. -The function is working for all the Logistics Areas from the Sites B and C are populated automatically to respective pick task (you can refer pick task 102872).-(A, B and C represent the Site ID).-Environment-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Task Control view. -Find and select the relevant Task ID.-Click Confirm.-You can see the Source Logistics Area field is empty for all Line Items.-If you click on the Source Logistics Area ID value selector for Line Item 1 for example, you can see there are multiple logistics areas available with sufficient quantities, but the system has not proposed any of them automatically. -Cause-The referred Storage Location is included in the Sequence ID of the Material Flow of Site: B. Also, the Line Number are sequential and do not have same priority. In Site: A, the relevant the Locations are missing. Also, the Line Number assigned to all included Location is: 1. This means all have same priority.-Resolution-I recommend you to maintain the Material Flow same as for the Site where the Source Logistics Areas are being proposed. --

Title: Information Maintained for Extension Field at Material Level is Not Being Carried to the Product in a New Sales Order Document
Content: Symptom-After creating and filling the information for a Extension Field ZZZ in the Product Master Data, the same information is not being carried to the Extension Field ZZZ of the Product in a Sales Order document, even though the Extension Field ZZZ is displayed in the document.-(where ZZZ represents the Extension Field name)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to the Products View.-Search for the Product ABC. (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Open, Select View All.-Locate the Extension Field ZZZ.-Information has been maintained for Extension Field ZZZ in the Master Data.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-In the Common task column, select New Sales Order.-Open, Select View All button.-Fill the mandatory information in the General tab.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Add Row button.-In the Product ID field, enter the Product ID ABC.-The Extension Field ZZZ is displayed in blank.-Cause-The Extension Field ZZZ is displayed in blank for the Product in a new Sales Order document, because the Extension Scenario "Material - General Information to Sales - Item" is currently not added for the Extension Field ZZZ.-Resolution-Kindly add the Extension Scenario "Material - General Information to Sales - Item" for the Extension Field ZZZ through the adaptation mode.-For this process we kindly ask you to perform the below steps:-Note: The Extension Field ZZZ must be enabled to be displayed in the Sales Orders documents.-Go the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-Open any recent created Sales Order with status "Open". -Select View All.-Select the User Icon.-Select Key user settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Navigate to the Item tab.-Select the "+ " Icon.-Select the Extension Fields option.-Mark the Extension Field ZZZ-Select Show Further Usage-In the new window, select the Extension Scenarios tab.-Mark the Extension Scenario 'Material - General Information to Sales - Item'.-Select Add Field.-In the Adaptation collunm, Select Publish button.-Exit the Adaptation Mode.-Now when adding the Product ABC in the Sales Orders, the information maintained in the Extension Field ZZZ will be carried out to the same Extension Field ZZZ in the Sales Order document.-Keywords-product, extension field, not displayed, information, blank, sales order

Title: Error "Go Live Not Possible. Workspace is Not of Type Pre-Production"
Content: Symptom-When trying to go live with system, you receive the following error: 'Go Live not possible. Workspace is not of type Pre-Production'-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign  -Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the affected change project.-Open Activity List.-Select the Go Live tab.-Select Confirm Go Live.-Select Next.-Select Finish.-Error Occurs.-Cause-The system is a DEMO system, and go-live activities cannot be performed in it.-Resolution- These activities can only be performed for pre-production systems, that is, test systems created with the purpose of becoming a production system, or production systems directly.-Keywords-business configuration, change project, go live, demo

Title: GST Details Such As IRN Number, State Code, State Name etc Are Missing In Customer Invoice For Country India
Content: Symptom-GST details such as Seller Party GSTIN, Bill To and Ship To GSTIN , IRN Number, IndiaStateCode, IndiaStateName, HSN Code at the item level etc are not available in the output xml of Customer Invoice XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center-Go to Invoice Documents view-Search for Invoice XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Invoice)-Edit the Invoice and click on View-Navigate to Output History Tab-Click on View Original XML-In the XML document you see the fields such as Such As IRN Number, IndiaStateCode, IndiaStateName etc. are missing.-Cause-Seller Party GSTIN, Bill To and Ship To GSTIN , State Code ,IRN Number and HSN Code in item level are not available in the output xml of Customer Invoice XYZ because of inconsistency in the legal approval process . These fields are available in "SignedQRCode_1.text" attachment .This file contains Digitally signed information and this file is used for mapping the above missed field information. If this document is missing in the Customer Invoice, then the fields will not be available in the XML.-Resolution-Kindly attach the "SignedQRCode_1.text" document while uploading the Legal Approval Information from IRP in the Customer Invoice to get the correct data in the XML.-Keywords-Seller Party GSTIN, Bill To and Ship To GSTIN , IRN Number, IndiaStateCode, IndiaStateName, HSN Code at the item level , missing, XML, Customer Invoice;

Title: Supplier Return Posts to Difference Account Instead of the Inventory Account for Material with Moving Average Perpetual Cost Method
Content: Symptom-In the journal entry of a return to supplier you notice an unexpected posting line to a difference account. -You see the expected posting line to the purchasing clearing account (Unbilled Payables) with the initial inventory amount. -You also see the expected posting line to the Inventory account, however, with a different value. -The difference is offset to a difference account defined for losses from purchase price differences.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To access the posting choose, for example, the following path: -Go to the Source Documents view of the General Ledger.-Find the supplier return's goods and activity confirmation XYZ (XYZ represents the goods and activity confirmation ID). -Press Actions and choose View Business Transaction.-Press View All and go to the Journal Entries tab. Then access the journal entry. -You can see three posting lines for material ABC (ABC represents the material ID), for example: -Inventory Account: Credit: 180,00 CC (CC represents company currency). -Unbilled Payables:    Debit: 150,00 CC-Difference account:  Debit:   30,00 CC-Cause-Between the initial inbound delivery and the supplier return the inventory cost of material ABC has changed. The supplier return updates the resulting quantity to zero. Therefore, the resulting inventory value changes to zero which causes any differences to the initial delivery to be posted as purchase price difference: -Example: Material ABC: -Sequence of business transaction events: -Initial inbound delivery DEF at a purchase value of 15,00 LC/1 ea (DEF represents the goods receipt ID): -2. Inventory value and cost updated, for example through GR/IR clearing  3. Return to supplier XYZ: return of delivery DEF, ie. 10 ea: -capitalized quantity: 10 ea-capitalised amount: 150,00 LC (15/1 ea)-capitalized quantity: 0 ea-capitalised amount: 30,00 LC-capitalised quantity: -10 ea-capitalised amount: -180,00 LC-Resulting Inventory impact: -resulting inventory quantity: 10 ea-resulting inventory value: 150,00 LC-resulting inventory cost: 15,00 :C /1 ea-Resulting Inventory impact:-resulting inventory quantity: 10 ea-resulting inventory value: 180,00 LC-resulting inventory cost: 18,00 LC/1 ea-Resulting Inventory impact: -resulting inventory quantity: 0 ea*-resulting inventory value: 0,00 LC**-resulting inventory cost: 18,00 LC/1 ea-Posting: -Inventory account:  Debit: 150,00 LC-Unbilled Payables:  Credit: 150,00 LC-  Posting: (for example, in case of GR/IR clearing)-Unbilled Payable: Debit:  150,00 LC-Inventory account: Debit: 30,00 LC-(Purchases in Transit: Credit: 180,00 LC)-  Posting: -Inventory account:                   Credit: 180,00 LC-Unbilled Payables:                     Debit:  150,00 LC-Purchase price diff. account:       Debit:   30,00 LC-*/**: As the resulting inventory quantity updates to zero the resulting inventory value must be zero as there is no quantity left. Therefore, the return considers the full inventory value, here 180,00 LC for the return posting. -Resolution-This is the designed system behaviour: -The difference between the initial posting of goods receipt DEF and return GHI, here 30,00 LC,  is set off to the purchase price difference account. -As the supplier return updates the resulting inventory quantity to zero, the full inventory value is considered. The difference amount between initial delivery and the return is offset to a difference account for purchase price differences. -Keywords-return to supplier,  supplier return, wrong account, difference account

Title: GLOTAXTIB02 Data Source With No Information in a New Created Report.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new report based on data source "All Incoming/Outgoing VAT Invoices with Original Order Items", with ID: GLOTAXTIB02. But, when you will open this new created custom Report XYZ (XYZ represents the new customer report) started with the letter "Z", you are getting the following message: 'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view. -Search for the new created custom Report: XYZ. -Open it. -You will see the message: -'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Cause-Currently, the data source being used for this report is GLOTAXTIB02 is a dedicated data source for reporting on VAT Invoices in Ukraine which will only contain data if this functionality is used in Ukraine, and will not contain anything for any other country. This data source is employed for specific tax reporting in Ukraine, not related to standard tax reporting.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-GLOTAXTIB02, Data Source, VAT Invoices, Incoming/Outgoing, New Report.

Title: Production Confirmation Does Not Consider Production Order Quantity
Content: Symptom-Production/ execution model XYZ is based on a quantity of 1 ea (XYZ represents the production/execution model ID).-Based on this production model you create a production order ABC for a quantity of more than 1, for example 3 ea (ABC represents the production order ID).-In the Make Operation you define main resource DEF with a cost rate of, for example, 50,00 LC per 1 hour.  And you specify a fixed duration of, for example, 30 minutes (DEF represents the resource ID, LC stands for local currency). -When checking the production confirmation's journal entry for a confirmed quantity of 3 ea , you notice only the duration for the production of 1 ea is considered, 25,00 LC for 30 minutes -You expect for the production confirmation to consider the ordered quantity of 3 ea and post a cost amount of 75,00 LC (for 3 x 0,5 hours = 25,00 LC x 3). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the posting: For example:  -In the Inventory Valuation work center go to the Reports view and find the Production Lots - Line items report.-In the report enter Production Lot ID ABC (the same ID as the production order ID) and press Apply. -Add the Business Transaction type to the report. -You verify that the valuation quantity of the goods receipt from production is correct, here 3 ea.  -You notice an Internal service confirmation journal entry with the amount (25,00 LC) corresponding to the production duration (0,5 hours) of the quantity of 1 ea. However, you expected an amount of 75,00 LC as the production order quantity is 3 ea (3 x 25,00 LC = 75,00 LC). -Cause-In the Production Model XYZ and underlying Bill of Operation the Make Operation is maintained with a Fixed Duration. When confirming the production for a make operation with fixed duration this fixed duration is derived as confirmed duration automatically. Here it is assumed that the production of 1 quantity takes as long as the production of a quantity higher than 1.-Resolution-If you must work with a fixed duration but for some reason the duration of the production of the ordered quantity differs from the planned duration of the production/execution model, then you can manually change the confirmed duration before finishing the production task:-In the Execution work center go to the Production tasks view and find the respective production task of production order ABC.-In the Production task navigate to the Activities tab.-Enter the Confirmed quantity.-By Default the fixed duration appears as confirmed duration. However, the Confirmed Duration field is editable, so that you can modify the duration if needed. -It is also possible to change the duration type of the make operation to Variable Duration. In this case, the duration of the underlying execution model is multiplied by the ordered quantity. It can  also be adjusted before finishing the production task:-In the Planning and Production Master Data work center go to the Production Bill of Operation view. -Find the Bill of Operation (BOO)used in production model XYZ. -In the BOO press View All and go to the Structure tab. -Find the respective Make Operation.-Select the connected activity. -Remove the value in the Fixed Duration field. -Enter the duration in the Variable Duration field. -Check the consistency of the BOO and save your changes.-Any new production order's internal service confirmation of the respective make operation should now be based on the variable duration and therefore derive the production cost from the ordered quantity and the defined, variable duration. -Keywords-production confirmation, duration, production order quantity, production planned quantity, production confirmed quantity

Title: How to Export Logistics Area Data
Content: Symptom-You want to understand that if there is a way to export data of logistics areas.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Two options with detailed steps for you:-Create data extraction run based on object LOCATION_LOA.-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to Data Extraction View.-Choose New button.-Fulfill Run ID.-Select LOCATION_LOA as Extraction Object.-Choose Add Row in Selection Criteria Session.-Select LOCATION_ID-CONTENT as Parameter Name.-Select the location ID as per your business.-Choose Activate and Run button. System will export all the logistics areas' information under the Location you selected.-Create a custom report based on Data Source SCMLOARESTB01.-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to Data Sources View.-Search for Logistics Area General Information or SCMLOARESTB01.-Choose New - Report button.-Fill all the required details and Save.-Navigate to Design Reports View.-Search for the report which you just created.-Open the report and you can download the data in XML, CSV formats.-Keywords-Export, logistics Area, Data Extraction, LOCATION_LOA, SCMLOARESTB01.

Title: Expense Report not creating a Journal Entry - U.S
