Content: Symptom-You have encountered an issue where Expense Report 'XXX' has not generated a Journal Entry. -XXX refers to the Expense Report ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Travel and Expense work center.-2) Go to the Expense Reports sub view.-3) Search for the Expense Report 'XXX'.-4) It didn't generate Journal Entry or placed under Unposted Source Documents.-Cause-Root cause for the missing Journal Entry is that for related Expense Type OTHP Account Determination group for paid expenses (credit in Journal Entry) is identical to Account Determination group for expense account (debit in Journal Entry), this applies not only to Expense Type OTHP but also for Expense Type TRNP. This means debit is equal to credit, consequently no accounting notification will be sent, and no Journal Entry will be created.-Resolution-If you want to have a Journal Entry for Expenses of type OTHP (and perhaps also TRNP), then you must change account determination group for paid expenses to a different one as for Expense Accounts.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview sub view.-Search for Activity Expense Reporting US.-Then give Edit Expense Types.-Select Expense Type OTHP (and perhaps also TRNP) under tab Account Determination.-Click Save.-Once the changes done, you must cancel existing Expense Report 'XXX' and create a new one for the Journal Entry to be created.- Keywords-Expense Reporting US, Expense Type, Journal Entry, Business Configuration, Account Determination.

Title: Tax (GSTIN) Number Field Editable in Supplier Invoice Document (India GST)
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post supplier invoice and you can change the tax number or GSTIN number in the Invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Click in View All button.-Navigate to General tab.-Navigate to Taxes subtab.-Go to Supplier's Tax Registration field.-You can modify the Tax Number.-Cause-The Tax Number field under Supplier Tax Registration is an editable field for all tax types and for all the countries.-Resolution-You can disable the Tax Number field using adaptation mode and users will not be able to change the Tax Number, Tax Number Type etc. Please follow the below steps to disable the field;-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for invoice ABC. -Select Adapt and Enter Adaptation Mode.-Select Yes and Ok.-Click in Edit button.-Click in View All button.-Select Adapt and Edit Screen.-Go to Supplier's Tax Registration field and select Tax Number field.-Go to Field Properties below and select Read Only check box.-Select Save and Publish.-Select Adapt and Leave Adaptation Mode.-Now you can see that, Tax Number field is grayed out and disabled for modification.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Tax; GSTIN; Tax Registration; Field; Adaptation Mode

Title: 'No report data available to display; check the selection' Message While Running the Financial Plan and Release Version History Report
Content: Symptom-The report Financial Plan and Release Version History shows the information message 'No report data available to display; check the selection' even when executed with all the required parameters filled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the Financial Plan and Release Version History report (Report ID FINCACU20_Q0001).-Enter necessary parameters such as Company and Set of Books.-Execute the report.-Notice the information message displayed: -'No report data available to display; check the selection'-Cause-Active budget check is not scoped in the system.-Resolution-Active budget check is a pre-requisite and once it's scoped, relevant data is displayed for the Financial Plan and Release Version History report.-See Also-Help Document: Financial Plan and Release Version History-Keywords-Design reports, Active budget control, Configuration, Scoping, active budget check

Title: Missing Set of Books Description In Another Language Rather Than English
Content: Symptom-Missing Set of Books Description when accessing the system with another language rather than English (for example French, German, Italian). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in with a language other than English. -Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Sets of Books and Assigned Companies subview.-Unable to see the Set of Books Description.  -Cause-When we check the master data of the Set of Books activity in the backend, we can see that the Master Language for this activity is set as "EN" (English), this is ByDesign standard. So, if the user has the description in English logon, this means that when the mentioned Set of Book Description was created, it was done with English as the logon language.-If we check the Set of Books activity in another language, we can see that the Set of Books Description was not maintained. The system can't translate automatically the description.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Maintain the Set of Books Description manually for another language. Please follow the steps below for the same: -Log in with a language other than English.-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Overview view. -Search for activity: "Set of Books" and open it. -We can see that "Set of Books Description" is missing. -Select the desired Set of Book ID and click "Edit" button. -Now, maintain the "Set of Books Description" with the desired translation or description. -Keywords-Set of Books Description, translation, English, other language.

Title: Unable to Release Price Lists Consistently When the Number of Items over 10000
Content: Symptom-Unable to release price lists consistently with number of line items exceeds 10000.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio - Price Lists -Select and Edit the Price List ABC (ABC represents the Price List ID)-Click on Release button.-Cause-For optimum performance, the number of line items on the Price List are best limited to around 10000 or less.-Resolution-Reduce the number of line items in the Price List and limit it to a number less than 10000. Once this is done, the price list can be Released successfully.-Keywords-huge number; cannot release price list.

Title: Customer Project Invoice Request Is Inconsistent With Error: Status of project task XYZ not 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed'
Content: Symptom-The Customer Project Invoice Request is in Status Inconsistent or Partially Inconsistent due to the Error:-Status of project task XYZ not 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed' (XYZ stands for the Project tasks)---Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select the Customer Project Invoice Request YYY(YYY is the ID of the Invoice Request).-The status is Inconsistent or Partially Inconsistent.-Click on the Check button.-The following error is displayed for all or some items:-Status of project task XYZ not 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed' (XYZ stands for the Project tasks).-Cause-A Project Task is assigned to the respective Items. When checking the respective Project Tasks you can see that these tasks have the status "Closed", which makes the Customer project Invoice Request inconsistent.-Resolution-To solve the issue you need to ensure that all respective Project Tasks have the 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed'. Once you have changed this you can do the following:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select the Customer Project Invoice Request ABC.-Click on the Check button.-In the new window click on the Redetermine All button.-Save you changes.-Keywords-Status of project task XYZ not 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed' ;Customer Project Invoice request; Inconsistent

Title: Serial Number Exists in Logistics Area; Cannot Be Issued
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -In Third Party Order Processing (TPOP) scenario, below error occurs while performing adjustment confirmation for inbound warehouse order involving two receiving steps as per KBA 2714888.  -“Serial number AAA exists in logistics area BBB; cannot be issued.”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Inbound Deliveries View.-Search for the inbound delivery.-Choose Undo Release button.-Navigate to Monitoring- By Warehouse Order View.-Search for the warehouse order.-Choose Edit button.-Choose View All button.-Choose Adjustment Confirmation button.-Select the line of Unload Operation.-Choose Enable Entry button.-Go to Serial Numbers Subtab.-Remove the Serial Number you wanted, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-Improper serial number tracking on an intercompany TPOP scenario with a 2-step logistics model on the receiving company side during adjustment confirmation with the serialized product. Currently in the particular case For TPOP when its reversal of an unload task (adjustment confirmation), the serial number tracking is not maintained. The tracking is working fine for standard inbound scenario. -Corresponding JIRA：[BYDDEV-11316] Unable to perform the reversal for an unload task for in TPOP - SAPJIRA (tools.sap)-Resolution-Our development team is planning to add serial number tracking to this TPOP scenario to ensure consistency across the product. This will be released in future.-Until the problem gets permanently fixed, our development team can provide backend correction for the affected serial number.-For the backend correction, create an internal incident to component AP-IP once get customer's authorization.-See Also-2714888 - How to Perform Adjustment Confirmation for a Warehouse Order Involving  Two Step Receiving Process (Unload and putaway operation)-Keywords-Adjustment Confirmation, Third Party Order Processing, Serial Number, Two Steps, Serial number exists in logistics area, Cannot be Issued.

Title: Exchange Rate Loss not Realized for Bank G/L Account in Foreign Currency Remeasurement For Cash
Content: Symptom-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Method 'A002 - Lowest value' and Foreign Currency Remeasurement Principle '002 - Lower Value' are applied for a Company and related Set of Books (SoB).-For a particular bank g/l account XYZ the valuation at key-date would imply an Exchange Rate (EXR) Loss. -You notice, however, that Key Date Valuation Amount equals Historic Valuation Amount.-Therefore no Loss will show for bank g/l account XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Open the respective run.-Go to Remeasured Balances.-For G/L Account XYZ no Loss is shown and posted.-Cause-The FCR-Cash groups and aggregates g/l account balances according to House Banks.-Calculated balances in Company Currency according to Key Date Exchange Rate then will be compared to Historic Valuation Amounts.-Whether Gains and Losses will be shown will depend on applied FCR-methods and principles and whether an aggregated Gain or Loss is computed per House Bank. -Depending on account balances and EXR-movements this can lead to a situation that the valuation of a single bank g/l account and bank account can differ from the grouped results for a particular House Bank. -Business Configuration Settings: -Activity: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash-Assign remeasurement method to accounting principle:-For applicable Accounting Principle Foreign Currency Remeasurement Method 'A002 - Lowest value' is assigned under tab 'Use for Cash'.--Edit foreign currency remeasurement methods:-Method:                                                              A002 - Lowest value-General Settings:-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Principle:           002 - Lower Value-Example: -Company Currency is EUR. -Bank G/L Account 121003 - Bank 3 is linked to a bank account in USD with a balance of 0.00 USD.-There are other Bank G/L Accounts linked to bank accounts for the same house bank Bank 1.-The Historic Valuation Amount in EUR is 14,556.04 EUR. The periodic EXR Gain/Loss hence would calculate as:-Key Date Valuation Amount  (0.00 EUR) ./. Historic Valuation Amount = -14,556.04 EUR-The Key Date Valuation Amount, however, shows as 14,556.04 EUR. Hence no Loss is realized for Bank G/L Account  121003 - Bank 3.-The calculation logic is illustrated in below table:-G/L Account Bank Name Balance Amount USD Key Date EXR Calc EUR Historic Valuation Amount EUR Calc Gain/Loss-120000 - Bank 1 Bank 1 2,500.00 1.2 3,000.00 2,336.45 663.55-120001 - Bank 2 Bank 1 6,500.00 1.2 7,800.00 5,486.65 2,313.35-121003 - Bank 3 Bank 1 0 1.2 0.00 14,556.04 -14,556.04-136000 - Cash in Transit Bank 1 -7,025.36 1.2 -8,430.43 -20,294.27 11,863.84-                          284.70-At a Key Date Exchange Rate of 1.2 EUR/USD house-bank Bank 1 has a calculatory EXR Gain of 284.70 EUR on aggregate.-According to Foreign Currency Remeasurement Method 'Lowest Value' there is no Gain posted for this bank and affected period.-No Gains or Losses will result from this FCR-Remeasurement Run for each bank g/l account including  121003 - Bank 3.-This scenario changes when applied Key Date Exchange Rate is sufficiently low so that an EXR Loss on aggregate per house-bank would show. We then would expect Losses as well as Gains for affected house-bank accounts to be shown and posted.-G/L Account Bank Name Balance Amount USD Key Date EXR Calc EUR Historic Valuation Amount EUR Calc Gain/Loss-120000 - Bank 1 Bank 1 2,500.00 0.9 2,250.00 2,336.45 -86.45-120001 - Bank 2 Bank 1 6,500.00 0.9 5,850.00 5,486.65 363.35-121003 - Bank 3 Bank 1 0 0.9 0.00 14,556.04 -14,556.04-136000 - Cash in Transit Bank 1 -7,025.36 0.9 -6,322.82 -20,294.27 13,971.45-                          -307.69-Resolution-This is the intended system behaviour. -The rationale of this definition is that, in this example - although an EXR Loss of -14,556.04 EUR for  121003 - Bank 3 is not posted - the even bigger EXR Gain of  14,840.74 EUR for the other bank g/l accounts belonging to Bank 1 is not acknowledged.-This conforms with Foreign Currency Method: A002 - Lowest value and Foreign Currency Remeasurement Principle: 002 - Lower Value.-We would expect deviating results  per bank g/l account only in rarer scenarios, since for bank accounts in foreign currency, movements usually would go in a similar direction. Especially when we have bank accounts with a FC-Balance of 0.00 - this effect may occur when values are aggregated for an entire bank. -If a Loss per bank g/l account will be shown then depends on the Balance Amounts, Historic Valuation Amounts and applied Key Date Exchange Rate. If the Key Date Exchange Rate is sufficiently low so that an EXR Loss on aggregate and per house-bank would show - we would see Losses as well as Gains for affected house-bank accounts.

Title: Dump When Opening a TI Screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer can see a dump when opening a TI screen. By checking on ST22, you can see following information:-The execution of determination "YABCDEFGH_DET_AFTER_LOADING" (impl. class "CL_PDI_ESF2_DETERMINATION") of node "ROOT" in BO "UTILITY_PREMISE" has thrown an exception; application component "LOD-CRM-IND-UTL""-Dereferencing on null condition-The application component may vary according to the affected business object.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Utilities > Premise work center view.-Open Any.-You can see a dump-Cause-By checking on Backend > ST22, you can see following dump:-It happens when there is an inconsistency on AfterLoading event created on SAP Cloud Applications Studio for mentioned Business Object and Node (e.g. ROOT node of UTILITY_PREMISE business object).-Resolution-You need to activate AfterLoading event on backend by following these steps: -Go to "1O" Transaction in Backend. -Click on "'Assign Developer to Default Partner".-Navigate to "SE38" Transaction.-Insert "PDI_BC_LM_EXECUTE_OLD_SUPP".-Click on Execute.-Insert AfterLoading path in "xrep File path" field.-Select "ABSL" for "Content Type".-Select "I" for Scope.-For "Mode", select "U" if it is a Deployed solution or select "D" if it is a "In Development" solution.-Click on Execute.-The activation of AfterLoading event should ideally resolve these dumps experienced. -See Also-2980177 - SE38 - Activating Pdi solution files in the backend-Keywords-Dereferencing on null condition, the execution of determination, DET_AFTER_LOADING, CL_PDI_ESF2_DETERMINATION, has thrown an exception; application component

Title: Delivery Block maintained in Account Master Data is not present in a Sales Order created as follow-up to a Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-You created Sales Quote XYZ for Account ABC. After the Sales Quote's creation, you maintained both an Invoice Block and a Delivery Block in ABC's Master Data. Following these changes to ABC's Master Data you created Sales Order DEF. The Invoice Block is present in the follow-up Sales Order DEF, the Delivery Block is not.-XYZ represents Sales Quote ID-ABC represents Account ID-DEF represents Sales Order ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center: New Business-Open view: Sales Quotes-Select New -> Sales Quote-Create a quote for Account ABC, then Save-Sales Quote XYZ created-  Before creating a follow-up sales order maintain blocks as follows: -Go to work center: Account Management-Open view: Accounts-Search All Accounts: ABC-Edit -> Sales Data-Maintain reasons for both Invoice Block and Delivery Block-  Then create a follow-up sales order to Sales Quote XYZ which was generated prior to the Invoice and Delivery Block master data alteration: -Go to work center: New Business-Open view: Sales Quotes-Search All Quotes: XYZ-Select Follow-Up -> Sales Order-  In the New Sales Order window under the General tab you can see that the Invoice Block is automatically present in the follow-up Sales Order, however the Delivery Block is not.-Cause-The Invoice Block is not stored in the business object for Quotes. Hence when you create a Sales Quote the system does not check for an Invoice Block in the Master Data as it is not stored in the Quote (the field does not exist in the backend for Quotes). The Invoice Block in the Account Master Data is therefore not even checked when the Sales Quote is created and it therefore does not matter if it was maintained or not. Once you create the Sales Order the system checks if there is an Invoice Block maintained in the Account Master Data at that point in time and if there is one maintained the system will take over the value in the Sales Order.-The Delivery Block however, is stored already in the business object for Quotes and therefore when creating the Sales Quote the system will determine the value that is maintained in the Account Master Data for the Delivery Block. If you then create a follow up Sales Order, the data is copied over from the Sales Quote to the Sales Order and not newly determined from the Account Master Data.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Account, Invoice Block, Delivery Block, Master Data, follow-up

Title: Execution status of the Actual Cost Release Run remains 'In Process'
Content: Symptom-The Execution status of the Actual Cost Release Run remains 'In Process'.-You encounter an error message "Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident" in the Actual Cost Release Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to Actual Cost Release view.-Select All Actual Cost Release Runs from the dropdown and search for the run ID xxx (xxx is the Actual Cost Release Run ID).-Click on the Execution ID with the Execution Status 'In Process' and navigate to the Messages tab. -An error message "Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident" is displayed.-Checking the Run Jobs for error details:-Click on View jobs and select the Run Jobs from the dropdown. In the Error Description "Cancelled manually or by the system" error is displayed. Now click on View Job Log and you will see the details below:-Job started-Step 001 started (program SAP_MDRI_REPORT, variant , user ID aaa, where aaa is the User ID)-MDRO: FIA_MAT_COST_EST_RELEASE_RUN (420, abc where abc is the Run ID)-Error: Error when closing PPF: Critical (system) failure during error remote call----    Cause-The error "Error when closing PPF: Critical (system) failure during error remote call" is because of the huge amount of data that is being processed.-Resolution-One possibility to discard this error is executing the run outside the business hours. -The other solution is that, while selecting the parameters in the 'Selection Criteria' of the Run, you have to select only a specific range of Materials along with the Product Category that you expect to be processed by the run.-Keywords-Actual Cost Release Run, execution status, in process

Title: Unable to Create Project with Unit of Measurement Meters, Meter Squared or Meter Cubed
Content: Symptom-You are part of construction industry and hence you would like to execute the create and process the project with Unit of measurement in Meters, Meter squared or meter cubed not in hours. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Go to Create a New Project-In Project Plan - Gantt Chart, select project header-Go to subtab Project Settings, General - Unit of Work-Try to enter the unit of measurement as Meters etc.-It is not possible to enter other unit of measurements other than Hours/Working Days-Cause-The Unit of Work option is designed to measure project members' work/service maintained under Work subtab. System only supports hours and Working Days as a unit of measurement. -For the goods maintained under Materials subtab, users can use UpM as Meters etc according to the material's master data setting.-Resolution-The new set of unit of measurements like Meters, Meter squared or meter cubed is a new requirement. Hence we kindly request you to post the idea in influence forum - -https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -Keywords-Create Project with Unit of Measurement Meters, Meter Squared or Meter Cubed; Unit of measurement of projects in Meters

Title: Error: "The remote Server Returned an error: (500) internal Server Error" During Upload of Price List using Excel
Content: Symptom-You are not able to upload a price list using excel due to the error: "The remote Server Returned an error: (500) internal Server Error".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open your Excel Template with the saved data of the price list.-Log on to the system using the respective credentials.-Click on the Save Data To button.-The following error occurs: The remote Server Returned an error: (500) internal Server Error.-Cause-This error can occur due to the use of the "Accounting Format" using "$" as an Accounting Number Format in one or more cells of the Excel template. Since the "$" symbol is not allowed in the Template, the error happens during the upload.-Resolution-You need to ensure that no cells in the Excel Template have been formatted in the Accounting Format using "$" as an Accounting Number Format.-See Also-2423217 - Unable to Upload a Price List using Excel due to the Error: "The remote Server Returned an error: (500) internal Server Error".-Keywords-Price List, 500, Error, Upload, Excel, Dump, Server Error, $, Amount

Title: Journal Entry Voucher For Fixed Assets Does Not Generate Journal Entries
Content: Symptom-When Journal Entry Voucher ABC of type Manual Posting for Fixed Assets is created for Fixed Asset DEF, it is noted that no G/L Accounts appear on the Items section and also no Journal Entry was generated for it. (ABC and DEF stands for the Journal Entry Voucher and Fixed Asset ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Open Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Search and open Journal Entry Voucher ABC.-It will be noticed that there is no Journal Entries related, and in Items section the amounts are allocated to no G/L Account. -Cause-Journal Entry Voucher ABC is a Manual Posting for Fixed Assets posted to a Valuation View which is a statistical view that do not generate postings on G/L Accounts.-If a Set of Books has multiple Valuation Views, only one Valuation View is relevant for postings from the Fixed Assets subledger to the general ledger. All other Valuation Views are statistical views that provide all the information in the Fixed Assets subledger but do not generate any postings. The statistical views can be evaluated with reports.-All valuation views are independent of each other, even if multiple valuation views are assigned to one set of books. A change of valuation parameters (such as useful life, depreciation method, depreciation start date, etc.) in one valuation view does not affect the same valuation parameters in other valuation views.-Checking on Fixed Asset DEF master data:-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Open Fixed Assets view.-Find and open Fixed Asset DEF.-Go to Values tab.-Here, it is noted that for Set of Books GHI, there are more than one Valuation View.-Checking on Journal subtab, it is noted that only for one Valuation View there are Journal Entries generated. A Valuation View which is different from the one that Journal Entry Voucher.-(GHI stands for the Set of Books ID)-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-See Also-Manual Postings in Fixed Assets-Configuration: Fixed Assets Valuation Views-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, Fixed Assets, no journal entry

Title: The Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" is displayed for a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Process Communication Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" is displayed in the Document Flow tab of a Sales Order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Process Communication Error is displayed for the Sales Order XYZ.-Cause-The Process Communication Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" occurs because the items in the Sales Order document were rejected with a Reason for Rejection Code that is no longer valid in the system.-In order to check the Reason for Rejection Codes that are currently valid in the system, the following steps can be performed:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-In the search field, search for Reasons for Rejection.-Open the Reasons for Rejection activity.-The valid Reason for Rejection Codes are displayed in the UI.-Resolution-In order to remove the Process Communication Error from the Sales Order document, the following solutions can be applied:-Option 1 -  Change the Reason for Rejection for the Line Items to a valid option.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Mark the Line Items YY (YY represents Line Item Number).-Change the Reason for Rejection to a valid value.-Select Save button.-Perform the same for other line items which have the same invalid Reason for Rejection Code in the Sales Order XYZ.-Option 2 - Restore the Reason for Rejection Code in the 'Reasons for Rejection' activity-Note: This option can only be applied if a Default Reason for Rejection Code was deleted in the system. If a custom Reason for Rejection Code was deleted in the system, then we kindly recommend to apply the "Option 1" as the custom Reason for Rejection Code can no longer be restored. -Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search for Reasons for Rejection.-Open.-Select Restore Defaults button.-Mark the Key for the Default Reason for Rejection Code.-Select Restore button.-Select Save and Close.-After one of the above processes is performed in the system, we kindly ask you to open a case in order for SAP support to perform a backend correction to remove the Process Communication Error from the Sales Order document.-See Also-KBA 3452802 - The Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" is Displayed for a Sales Order (Internal)-Keywords-cancellation reason, is not valid, valid, items, reason for rejection, sales order, process communication error

Title: Custom Quality Decision Codes are not available in Inspections.
Content: Symptom-You have created Custom Quality Decision code Z_A1(where Z_A1 is a custom decision code) however in the Inspection documents this decision code is not visible in the drop down.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Quality Control workcenter and Inspections view.-2. Filter by Open Inspections.-3. Select and Edit any inspection of type: Receiving inspection - supplier delivery  Ex: 1234(where 1234 is the inspection document)-4. Go to Decision tab -5. Select the drop down for Quality Decision-You will not see custom decision code Z_A1-Cause-In Business Configuration,  Maintain Settings for Inspection types is not maintained for Custom Decision codes hence the same is not displayed in Quality Decision list.-Resolution-After you create new Decision codes in Maintained Decision code, it is required to also Maintain Settings for Inspection types for these custom decision codes.-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter and Overview  view.-2. Select the Configuration Element: Inspection types -3. Click on Maintain Settings for Inspection Types-4. Here select the Inspection type here it is Receiving inspection - supplier delivery.-5. Under Decision Codes Add Row and select the custom Decision Code Z_A1 and Save-After this you will be able to see the newly created custom decision code in the Quality Decision dropdown list of the Inspections.-Keywords-Inspection, Quality Control, Decision Code, Inspection type, Maintain Settings for Inspection Types, Quality Decision

Title: Project Costs appear Incorrect in the Project Overview
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When checking the Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue report for a customer sales project you notice the cost appear too high. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Project Overview tab of customer project XYZ *(XYZ represents the customer project ID), for example from the Project Management  work center: -In the Project Management work center go to the Projects view.-Find and open project XYZ.-In the project navigate to the Project Overview tab. -Here, the Reports sub-tab you check the Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue report.-You notice the Total Incurred Cost amount is much too high (You might expect an amount of 1000,00 LC but the report displays a Total Incurred Cost amount of 2000,00 LC (LC=Local Currency). -You verify that the actual cost amount of the project is only 1000,00 LC so the value in the Project overview seems distorted.-Cause-An accrued cost amount exists for the project's sales order item.-As the Planned/Incurred Cost and Revenue report of the Project Overview is based on the  financial report FINCACU04_Q0004  - Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure any financial postings are taken into account to display the Total Incurred Cost amount.  -The following example scenario can cause this situation: -Project XYZ is associated with sales order item ABC-AA (ABC-AA represents a sales order item ID). -Sales order item ABC-AA is assigned to an accrual method, such as Recognize at point of Invoice or Recognize based on manual amounts. -Based on the accrual method the revenue recognition run calculated a due cost amount: -A quantity, equivalent to 1000,00 LC, was invoiced in or before the run's chosen accounting period, but the expense document/s is/are assigned to sales order item ABC-AA in a later accounting period (Recognize at point of invoice)-Or- A manual cost amount of 1000,00 LC is maintained for the sales order item and are valid in the chosen accounting period of the revenue recognition run. However, these cost are only created/assigned to sales order item ABC-AA in a later period. -In both cases, the revenue recognition run recognizes the 1000,00 LC cost amount to be realised on the expense account in the chosen accounting period. As they do not yet exist/are not assigned in the chosen period, the costs are offset as Unbilled Payable value/accrual. -Meanwhile, in a later period,  the costs are assigned to the sales order item. These expense assignments now debit the Deferred Cost of goods sold account, which will also be displayed in the Project Overview report. -It now seems as if a value of 2000,00 LC has been incurred, ones through the revenue recognition accrual in the earlier period, ones through the expense assignment posting in a later period. -Resolution-As the graph in the Project Overview report is based on actual financial postings any business transaction is considered. -To clear the previous accrual, execute the revenue recognition run in or after the accounting period when the costs have been assigned to sales order item ABC-AA. -The transaction will clear the accrual (debit 1000,00 LC)  and the deferral (credit 1000,00 LC) , so that the project's graph now correctly displays the total incurred cost, here 1000,00 LC.

Title: Errors - "Work package ID 'XXX' system error; report an incident: Data of Payment Processing is missing" occurred in Liquidity Forecast Run.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to do Liquidity Forecast Run, it gives the error message: Result of the work packages: Work package ID 'XXX' system error; report an incident: Data of Payment Processing is missing".-'XXX' refers to Work Package ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-2) Go to Liquidity Forecast Run sub view.-3) Search for the Run 'YY'. ('YY' refers to  Liquidity Forecast Run ID)-4) Select that and under Messages tab you will see the below mentioned error message,-Work package ID XXX system error; report an incident-Data of Payment Processing is missing.- Cause-The liquidity forecast run was getting failed & dump was occurring in backend due to performance issue. For every liquidity forecast run the data is fetched from three Data sources (i.e. tax & trade receivables payables register, payment processing, due item processing) and in customer system the processing is happening for every Company ID. Since the processing takes places for every Company ID , Performance/Memory issue occurs which in turn results in dump.-Usually in the system, you should have 3 Data Sources whereas in the customer system only 2 Data Sources are being present. Here Payment Processing one is missing. for this reason it gives the below mentioned dump.-Dump Details:-ABAP Program           CL_FOP_PAYMENT_LIQFC_SERVICE==CP-Application Component  AP-PAY-PR-Active Calls/Events:-18 METHOD       CL_FOP_PAYMENT_LIQFC_SERVICE==CP    CL_FOP_PAYMENT_LIQFC_SERVICE==CM003    36-   CL_FOP_PAYMENT_LIQFC_SERVICE=>_GET_COMPANY_SEL_CONDITION-17 METHOD       CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCP    CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCM007    38-   CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COL=>GET_PAYMENTS_FOR_LIQUIDITY_FC-16 METHOD       CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCP    CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCM005    46-   CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COL=>CREATE_PAYMENT_REGISTER_ITEMS-15 METHOD       CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCP    CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCM002    67-   CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COL=>COLLECT_DATA_FROM_SOURCES-14 METHOD       CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCP    CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COLCM001   195-   CL_FOP_ACT_LIQFC_R_ST_DATA_COL=>/BOPF/IF_FRW_ACTION~EXECUTE-13 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CM00Z   596-   /BOPF/CL_FRW=>DO_ACTION-12 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CP    /BOPF/CL_FRW==================CM00W    59-   /BOPF/CL_FRW=>/BOPF/IF_FRW_SERVICE_LAYER~DO_ACTION-11 METHOD       /BOPF/CL_SP_SERVICE_PROVIDER==CP    /BOPF/CL_SP_SERVICE_PROVIDER==CM00I   183-   /BOPF/CL_SP_SERVICE_PROVIDER=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACTION~EXECUTE_ACTION-10 METHOD       CL_FOP_PROVIDER_LIQFC=========CP    CL_FOP_PROVIDER_LIQFC=========CM00A     7-   CL_FOP_PROVIDER_LIQFC=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACTION~EXECUTE_ACTION- 9 METHOD       CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CP    CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CM018    24-   CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICE_PROVIDER~EXECUTE_ACTION- 8 METHOD       CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CP    CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CM04F   230-   CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICES_ACCESSOR~WRITE_GENERIC- 7 METHOD       CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CP    CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CM005    24-CL_ESF_LCP_BASE=>IF_ESF_LCP~EXECUTE_ACTION-Resolution-Under the Liquidity Forecast Run 'YY' the forecast profile should have selected as "<Z1> - Z1" instead of "1 - No restriction." -Here you have to change the forecast profile to "Z1" and in the Liquidity Forecast Run 'YY', the source data (Liquidity data source)- Payment Processing is not present.-While creating this Z1 forecast profile under Business Configuration, it should have prompted one warning, No of days should not be more than 180 days but you can see in configuration it is for 365 days which is beyond 180 days. You have to correct this in the system by following below mentioned steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview sub view.-Search for the Activity: Liquidity Forecast.-Select "Review and Adapt Liquidity Forecast Profiles"-In the Liquidity Forecast Profile ID, for Profile: Z1 you have to maintain the No of days above 180 days.-Click Save and Close.-Also you have to maintain forecast profile only for one Company ID by following the below mentioned steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview sub view.-Search for the Activity: Liquidity Forecast.-Select "Define the companies that the forecast will capture the data of"-For Liquidity Forecast Profile Code, select the Company ID which you want to do the Run for.-Click Save and Close.-After this setting, you have to do the Liquidity Forecast Run again. It will be completed successfully without any error messages.-Keywords-Liquidity Forecast Run, Data Sources, CL_FOP_PAYMENT_LIQFC_SERVICE=>_GET_COMPANY_SEL_CONDITION, Dump, Forecast Profile, Company Code.

Title: Error: Only sales order items allowed in combination with customer project when trying to post a JEV
Content: Symptom-Error when trying to post a Journal Entry voucher-Only sales order items allowed in combination with customer project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center > Journal Entry Voucher view-Click New > Journal Entry Voucher-Enter the required information-Company: XX-Set of books: YYYY-Journal Entry type: 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents-Screen variant: 633 - Man. Adjusting Entry for Sales Documents-Transaction Currency: Enter the Currency-Closing step: Select the closing step-Posting date: DD.MM.YYYY-Document date: DD.MM.YYYY--Add Row-G/L Account: Inform the G/L Account-Debit in Transaction Currency: Inform the amount-Sales Doc. Type: 115 - Service Confirmation-Sales Doc. ID: Select/inform the document ID-Sales Doc. Item ID: Select/inform the Item ID-Project Task: Select/inform the Project ID--Add Row-G/L Account: Inform the G/L Account-Credit in Transaction Currency: Inform the amount-Sales Doc. Type: 115 - Service Confirmation-Sales Doc. ID: Select/inform the document ID-Sales Doc. Item ID: Select/inform the Item ID-Project Task: Select/inform the Project ID--Click Post-Error: Only sales order items allowed in combination with customer project-Cause-According to the message error "Only sales order items allowed in combination with customer project", the system only allows the doc type "Sales Order" in combination with projects- Resolution-Expected System behavior-See Also-Help Portal - Manual Entries for Sales Documents-Keywords-JEV, not posted, error, Only sales order items allowed in combination with customer project

Title: Cannot open List Prices from Microsoft Excel due error: "Not enough rows in table for XYZ code list. Add more rows."
Content: Symptom-You are unable to download Excel template to upload List Prices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to List Prices view.-Click in New button and select List Prices from Microsoft Excel.-It opens a new tab in the browser and it shows message:-Error ID: AP_UI_OIN 043-Error text: Not enough rows in table for XYZ code list. Add more rows.-Please report an incident if the error persists.-XYZ can be MeasureUnitCode or GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode.-For example:-Error text: Not enough rows in table for MeasureUnitCode code list. Add more rows.-Error text: Not enough rows in table for GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode code list. Add more rows.-Cause-This scenario is a known issue. Application developers are requested to keep as many buffer rows as possible to accommodate code list enhancements from customers.-Resolution-Firstly please try to follow the steps below:-Steps to download and correct the template:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view.-Open the Advanced Filter.-Filter:-Template Group: List Price – Worklist-Template Type: Microsoft Excel® (Write-back)-Click in Go.-Download the required template language variant.-Open the xlsx file that was downloaded.-Extend the data area at the end, in order to create buffer lines (Please check the screenshot below).-Save it.-Now the steps to replace with the new template:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view.-Click in Upload button and select Replace Existing Language Variant.-Browse the file that you saved earlier.-Click in OK.-Click in Publish.-Click in Yes.-Now you should be able to follow the steps to select 'List Prices from Microsoft Excel' and face no errors.-In case you are still facing errors, please report an incident to SAP Support so the template related to List Prices can be retrieved from backend system. Then you can save the given Excel template we gave you for future use in Application and User Management work center - Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view.-Please note that if you still face issues even after using the new given Excel template, the cause may be due to template versions. Please verify if the other templates are relevant for you process by following the steps below:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance view. -Search for List Prices. -Check if there are templates that were manually created by business users. -If they are not relevant, you may delete them.-Try to launch the new Excel for List Price. -Keywords-Excel; Template; List Price; Row; Code List; MeasureUnitCode

Title: Tax Return SII: The Total Amount Of Multiples Down Payments Are Not Reflecting Individually in The Tax Authority.
Content: Symptom-When entering multiples Down Payments and offsetting them against a payment, the tax returns generated by the system only display the total amount in one Down Payment instead of reflecting the individual Down Payments in the tax authority.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns. -Select All Tax Returns. -Search for Tax Return ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Tax Return ID). -Click "View" button > Click "View All".-Go to Tax Return tab. -Here we can see the Document ID: DEF (DEF represents the Document Ref ID of the tax return). -The tax returns generated by the system only display the total amount in one Down Payment instead of reflecting the individual Down Payments in the tax authority. - Cause-As part of SAP Business ByDesign, for down payments, we only support the process where customer first creates a down payment Request, then pays it and then clearing gets generated (1:1). The other process is not being supported.---Resolution-Expected system behavior. -If you want to continue with the process as mentioned, you have to take care of the document submission manually as it is not supported in SAP Business ByDesign. Also, you can implement logic in the Partner Badi ModifyXMLData provided to manipulate the data to be sent to Tax authority. Please refer the blog "How to populate field values in SII XML using ModifyXMLData BAdI in SAP Business ByDesign" in See Also section. -See Also-How to populate field values in SII XML using ModifyXMLData BAdI in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Tax Return, SII, Multiples, Down Payments, Not Reflecting, total amount, Individually, Tax Authority.

Title: A valid organizational unit can not be selected when migrating Open Items Payable
Content: Symptom-You are facing an issue while migrating Open Items Payable using Accounting Transaction Data migration tool since you are unable to select and find Profit Center IDs using the Input Help.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search for the Activity 'Migration of Accounting Transaction Data' and click on it.-Click on 'Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool'.-Search for the respective Migration Units for Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Execute Migration.-In the Migration Scope section, select the Migration Object 'Open Items Payable' and click on Process File.-Navigate to the step 'Convert Value' and you can see a task 'Edit Value Conversion for Profit Center ID' and click on 'Process Task'-The Profit Center ID 'X' number is with the status 'Conversion Required'.-Try to find the Profit Center ID using Input Help. The Profit Center ID 'X' is not found.-Cause-The Profit Center ID 'X' cannot be selected during the migration process because its validity period has ended in the previous year.-Resolution-The system only displays Profit Centers that are currently valid.-See Also-Migration, Open Items Payable, Input Help, Profit Center, Validity

Title: Plan Cost Incorrect in Revenue Recognition Run For Sales Order Item with Manual Estimated Cost Amount
Content: Symptom-You create Sales Order item ABC-AA and assign a POC relevant accrual method, for example 102-Recognize Using Cost-to-Cost POC (ABC-AA represents the Sales Order item ID).-The net value of the Sales Order item is maintained in a foreign currency FC and not in Company Currency CC.-You maintain a manual value in Company Currency in the Estimated Costs field o of the Edit Percentage of Completion Screen. -You expect this manual value to appear as Planned Cost value in the Revenue Recognition run application log. However, the amount is different in the run. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Find sales order item ABC-AA maintained in Forein Currency FC.  -Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and choose Percentage of Completion. -Under Calculation Basis for calculated POC enter a Company Currency value in  the Estimated Costs field, for example 500,00 CC (Company Currency).-Go back to the Sales Document Items view and navigate to the Acounting Data sub-tab under Details. From here access the last revenue recognition run that processed the item. -In the run go to the Processed Successfully tab, choose the Advanced Information and then POC-Based. -Find item ABC-AA. -You notice the Plan Cost column displays a different amount (for example: not 500,00 CC but 475 CC). -Cause-For the two currencies FC and CC an exchange rate and the inverted exchange rate exist. However, on the posting date of the revenue recognition run the rates are not in  sync.-If the CC-FC and the FC-CC exchange rates are not in sync on the posting date of the run,  the Plan Cost value, used by the run to calculate the current POC, is different to the estimated costs maintained for the item:-Example: -You execute the revenue recognition run for accounting period 010.YYYY (October YYYY) (YYYY represents a calendar year). -On 31.10.YYYY the CC-FC exchange rate is 0,5 and the FC-CC exchange rate is 1,9.-The run calculates the manual estimated cost amount into transaction currency, i.e. 500,00 CC x 0,5  250,00 FC and back into company currency: 250,00 FC x 1,9= 475 CC. -For the run to consider a Plan cost amount of 500,00 CC, the FC-CC exchange rate should be 2.-Resolution-The system works as designed:-When a sales order item is not maintained in company currency:-To derive the Plan Cost value for the calculation of the sales order item's current POC, the estimated, manual costs, maintained in company currency CC, are recalculated into transaction currency FC and then back into company currency CC.-If you work with inverted exchange rates, ensure that both exchange rate directions, here FC-CC and CC-FC are in sync.  -The issue only occurs when a manual Estimated Cost amount is used for a sales order item.  If you maintain planned cost directly in the project (work, material, expenses tab) in company currency, these values will not be converted into transaction currency and back. -If you only work with one exchange rate direction then this recalculation (From CC to FC and back to CC) does not occur.-See Also-3027668 - Calculated POC Does Not Consider Exchange Rate For Sales Order Item in Foreign Currency-Keywords-Plan Cost wrong, revenue recognition, POC

Title: Attachment tab not visible in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-Attachment tab not visible in Shopping Cart created using the Go Shopping function.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select Self-Services Overview view.-Click on Go Shopping link.-Create a Shopping Cart.-See that there is no Attachments tab.-Cause-If the Shopping Cart is created via the function Go Shopping the attachment tab is not available, since this function creates a simple document. On the other hand the Go Shopping Advanced creates a more complete document were is possible to add more information, such as attachments. -The Go Shopping function and Go Shopping (Advanced) have some differences, such as:-User Context:-- The Go Shopping function is mainly for individuals purchasing items for themselves or for their own projects. The user is placing an order for their own needs.-- The Go Shopping (Advanced) function is used when one wants to purchase items on behalf of someone else or a different project. This is typically used by personal assistants or others who need to order items for their colleagues or for other projects.-Set Defaults Step:-- The Go Shopping (Advanced) function has an initial step called "Set Defaults" where you enter the details of the employee for whom you are shopping. This step is not present in the standard Go Shopping function.-Cost Assignment:-- In the Go Shopping process, the cost is usually assigned to the cost center to which the user belongs or the project chosen by the user.-- In the Go Shopping (Advanced) process, the cost can be assigned to different areas such as the cost center of the recipient, a customer contract, a project task, a sales order, or a service order. It also allows for the cost assignment to be split among different areas.-Preferred Supplier and Contract:-- The Go Shopping (Advanced) function allows you to specify a preferred supplier for an item and select a contract for the item from a list of contracts assigned to that catalog item.-Overall, the Go Shopping (Advanced) function provides more flexibility and options for complex shopping scenarios, such as ordering on behalf of someone else, splitting cost assignments, add attachments, and selecting preferred suppliers or contracts.-Resolution-So to use this tab, please creates a Shopping Cart from Go Shopping Advanced.-See Also-Please check more information on the documentation:-Create a Shopping Cart-Create a Shopping Cart on Behalf-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Attachment

Title: Error "Fuel Tax not Scoped in System; Maintenance of Fuel Tax not possible." When Editing Fuel Tax Classification
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -You get the error below once you open the configuration activity of Fuel Tax Classification.-"Fuel Tax not Scoped in System; Maintenance of Fuel Tax not possible."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Tax on Goods and Services activity.-Select Edit Fuel Tax Classification, then you get the error: "Fuel Tax not Scoped in System; Maintenance of Fuel Tax not possible."-Cause-The business option BO_A1S_FND_FUELTAX is currently not switched on in backend. As the option is hidden, it cannot be switched on from the frontend.-Resolution-Currently, it can only be switched on by SAP in the backend.-Before applying any changes in the backend, ask for authorization to customer.-To do this, you can follow the steps below:-Open an STFK session for the customer system.-Open BCE transaction.-Select the "Adaptation Workspaces".-In the Adaptation Workspace field, fill with an asterisk "*" and then press enter.-Double-click the first (and only) workspace UUID.-Go into edit mode and press "Scoping (With Questions)".-Expand BA_A1S_FND_CTAITS, then BP_A1S_FND_GLOTOP, then BT_A1S_FND_TAXCAL, and OG_A1S_FNG_TAXCALCOUNTRIES.-Check the flag of BO_A1S_FND_FUELTAX.-Click Save. -Once you have selected it and saved, the BC content associated with it will be deployed (in case of switching on) or un-deployed (in case of switching off). This might take some seconds/minutes to finish completely since something is done in background.-See Also-How to Scope a Hidden Business Option in the Backend-Keywords-Fuel Tax; BCE; Fuel Tax not Scoped in System; Maintenance of Fuel Tax not possible.

Title: Last Change Date in Business Role does not Match the Date in Business Role Overview
Content: Symptom-After updating a business role with an UI switch related change, e.g. by removing an UI switch, the change log is not reflected in the business role overview.-While the changes tab of the role shows the latest change date AA:BB:CCCC, in the business role overview an earlier change time DD:EE:FFFF is shown (where  AA:BB:CCCC and DD:EE:FFFF represent clock times).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Roles view-Mark the relevant role-Find Last Change Date DD:EE:FFFF-Edit the role and select View All-Go to Changes tab-Find last Change on 22.01.2024 AA:BB:CCCC-Note: The data may equalise over time-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour as a change wouldn't be possible without affected other objects in an unpredictable way.-UI switches are created by customers. The Framework is designed in a way that the UI switches Data will be stored into the Buffer data.-Any change here affects the whole framework and coding. It may lead to improper behaviour and critical issues in other business objects.-Keywords-Not Reflected, align, difference, different,

Title: When Search in Report Inventory Ageing, No Data Available to Display.
Content: Symptom-In standard report "Inventory Ageing" (SCMINVAGV04_Q0001), search a specific storage location, no data display.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Access view Design Reports.-Select a storage location for filter Site, maintain other filters.-Click Apply, nothing display in the result, and there is a warning "No report data available to display; check the selection".-Cause-The filter Site only works for site/location but doesn't work for storage location under site.-Resolution-Please select a site/location which is also a storage location for filter Site.-Keywords-Inventory Ageing, No Report Data, Site, Check the Selection

Title: Retirement Posting of Low Value Fixed Asset for Valuation View DE001 is not posted
Content: Symptom-You're trying to make a complete scrapping of a Low Value Asset AB, but this is not successful.  (AB represents Fixed Asset ID).-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work center Fixed Assets.-Go to the View Fixed Assets.-Search for Fixed Asset AB.-Select Manual Postings.-Select Complete scrapping.-You notice that the Fixed Asset AB is still in status "Capitalized", but you expect it is in status "Retired".-Cause-Fixed Asset AB is flagged as Low Value Asset for the German Tax Set of Books.-If any of the following conditions (mentioned below) are met, then the retirement transaction is NOT posted for valuation view DE001. (DE001 represents the valuation view for the German Tax Set of Books).-The valuation view's code (in set of books configuration) is equal to DE0010.-The low value asset flag is set to true (under Master Data -> Life Cycle Data).-Depreciation method for the valuation view configured on the fixed asset is NOT equal to "0100".-The net book value as on the posting date of the retirement (including the to-be-posted depreciation values till that date) is NOT zero (if the other valuation views have the same master data settings and same postings, you can see this easily in the retirement transaction: if the retirement transaction's journal entry contains a "Loss from scrapping" line then the net book value is not zero as on the retirement transaction date).  -Only if one of the above conditions are not true, then the retirement transaction is posted for the valuation view.-Resolution-In most of the cases it is the net book value that is not zero at the time of scrapping, then the retirement transaction is not posted for for this valuation view.-To post the retirement transaction for the valuation view for the German Tax Set of Books, change the depreciation method to 0100. Then you can scrap the Low Value Fixed Asset also for Valuation View DE0010 and Set of Books German Tax.-Keywords-valuation view DE001, scrapping Fixed Asset, Low Value Fixed Asset

Title: Error "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item" Raised when a Follow-Up Sevice Order is Created from a Contract using a Registered Product
Content: Symptom-When creating a follow-up Service Order from a Contract and inputting a Registered Product, the error "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item" is raised and the Service Order becomes Inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Open the Contracts view.-Find Contract ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Contract you wish to create a follow-up Service Order from).-Highlight the Contract and click the 'Follow-Up" button, then click the "Service Order" option.-In the New Service Order screen, click on View All.-Navigate to the Account and Affected Product tab .-Input Registered Product DEF (Where DEF Represents the ID of the Registered Product).-The error "Change of party not permitted; contract exists on item" is raised.-Cause-A possible cause for this error to be raised in this scenario is due to an inconsistency during the determination of Involved Parties in the document.-Resolution-In order to correct the error, a dummy change needs to be performed in the Sales Unit of the document:-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Open the Contracts view.-Find Contract ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Contract you wish to create a follow-up Service Order from).-Highlight the Contract and click the 'Follow-Up" button, then click the "Service Order" option.-In the New Service Order screen, click on View All.-Navigate to the Account and Affected Product tab .-Input Registered Product DEF (Where DEF Represents the ID of the Registered Product).-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Remove Sales Unit GHI from the Involved Parties (Where GHI Represents the ID of the Sales Unit of the Service Order).-Press ENTER.-Input the Sales Unit GHI back in the Involved Parties.-This allows the system to successfully redetermine the Involved Parties in the document and for the document to be saved.-Keywords-Service Order, Contract, Follow Up, Error, Inconsistent, Inconsistency, Unable, Registered Product, masterdata, party, parties, not possible, not permitted.

Title: Material Not Permitted with Product Category Constraint
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an replenishment rule for a specific logistics area under Site A. However, you are getting an error "Material B not permitted with product category constrain" while adding replenishment rule for product B.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Locations View.-Select Site A.-Choose Edit Layout button.-Select the line of the specific Logistics Area.-Go to Replenishment and Removal Rules - Replenishment Subtab.-Fulfill a product based rule for product B.-Choose Save button, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-You have set the storage groups in Restrictions Subtab of this specific Logistics Area. Then System would only allow user to add the product information which matches one of these maintained storge groups.-Resolution-The system works as expected, you can check the setting by below steps:-Open the master data of Product B.-Go to Logistics Tab.-Select the line for Site A, then you will understand that the Storage Group is X.-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Locations View.-Select Site A.-Choose Edit Layout button.-Select the line of the specific Logistics Area.-Go to Restrictions - Allowed Logistics Units and Storage Groups Subtab, you will understand that the storage group X is not one of the maintained allowed Storage Groups.-Keywords-Replenishment Rule, Product Category Constraint, Allowed, Storage Groups, Master Data, Logistics Area.

Title: How to Maintain Sales Activities by Using API ManageOpportunityIn
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to maintain the sales activities for an opportunity by using web service API.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have prepared the request XML as following and executed it, but system returned error "Processing of data for node BTD_REFERENCE of BO OPPORTUNITY not possible". So you are not able to create sales activities. -body message:-            <Opportunity actionCode="02" activitySuccssrBusTransacDocRefListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">-                <ID>ABC</ID>-                <ActivitySuccessorBusinessTransactionDocumentReference actionCode="01">-                    <BusinessTransactionDocumentReferenceActualValues actionCode="01">-                    <SalesCyclePhaseCode>Z01</SalesCyclePhaseCode>-                    <SalesCyclePhaseStepCode>Z02</SalesCyclePhaseStepCode>-                    </BusinessTransactionDocumentReferenceActualValues>-                </ActivitySuccessorBusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-            </Opportunity>-ABC represents the ID of the opportunity.-Z01 represents the sales cycle phase code.-Z02 represents the sales phase step code.-Cause-As per the API help document: Inbound Service ManageOpportunityIn -> section: Business Transaction Document References-With the Business Transaction Document Reference, the opportunity can be linked to other business documents like an activitiy or a campaign. To create or update a business transaction document reference, the ID (or UUID), TypeCode of the related business document as well as the RoleCode of the business document within the relationship shall be provided.-In the sample request XML above, the activity ID, type code are missing.-Additionally, for BTD reference modification via web service, it is always expected that the complete list transmission indicator should be passed as true.-Resolution-Please adapt the request XML according to the help document. -Sample XML as reference.-  <Opportunity actionCode="02" activitySuccssrBusTransacDocRefListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-                <ID>ABC</ID>-                <ActivitySuccessorBusinessTransactionDocumentReference actionCode="01">-                      <BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-                         <ID>572</ID>-                         <TypeCode>542</TypeCode>-                     </BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-                    <BusinessTransactionDocumentReferenceActualValues actionCode="01">-                         <SalesCycleCode>001</SalesCycleCode>                    -                         <SalesCyclePhaseCode>Z01</SalesCyclePhaseCode>-                        <SalesCyclePhaseStepCode>Z02</SalesCyclePhaseStepCode>-                    </BusinessTransactionDocumentReferenceActualValues>-                </ActivitySuccessorBusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-            </Opportunity>-See Also-help center document: Inbound Service ManageOpportunityIn-https://help.sap.com/doc/8a98c5f7d5be4b40b3dd97bbdaf28cc4/CLOUD/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_APCRM_MANAGE_OPPORTUNITY_IN.html-Keywords-"Processing of data for node BTD_REFERENCE of BO OPPORTUNITY not possible"; ManageOpportunityIn; sales activities; opportunity API; web service.

Title: Deletion of Payment Block Fields Using webservice ManageSupplierIn
Content: Symptom-Execution of standard web service: ManageSupplierIn to delete the payment block reason code and payment block expiry date is not working hence throwing an error  <MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>3</MaximumLogItemSeverityCode> -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Reproducing the Issue-Open Soap UI-Create new SOAP project.-Select WSDL file XYZ(where XYZ is the Request payload)-Create your XML payload which has the action to delete the payment block reason code and payment block expiry date -Choose Submit.-system throws an error-<MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>3</MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>-Cause-The webservice ManageSupplierIn only supports creation and change of payment block details-Resolution-The deletion of payment block reason code and payment block expiry date via webservice ManageSupplierIn is not possible. The only option available is to manually update in UI.-Keywords-Payment Block Reason Code, Payment Data, Supplier BO, Supplier Base, Supplier Master Data, webservice ManageSupplierIn,

Title: Note Field in Report: Aging List for Receivables Shows a '#' (Not assigned) Value.
Content: Symptom-When you open the Aging List for Receivables Report, and filter for a specific customer, you see a "#" in the filter "Note".  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Receivables work center. -2. Go to List subview. -3. Open the report "Aging List for Receivables" -4. In "View" section add the fields "Note" for Customer Account and "Reference Invoice" and "Invoice Date" for Customer Invoice ID. -5. Filter for customer: XYZ (XYZ represents the Customer).-6. Click "Apply". -7. Here we will see a "#" in filter "Note". -Cause-The "Note" column shows note data maintained at the customer invoice level. The "Note" text can be maintained at the below path:-Receivables work center -> Customer Account subview -> Search for customer account -> Open customer account monitor -> Select customer invoice -> Click on 'Item Details' button -> Maintain text in 'Note' field and save.-If the user has maintained note text at the Customer account Master data level, the Aging List report didn't show data in the "Note" column associated with a Customer account.-The Aging List for Receivables report doesn't support this functionality. -Resolution-Expected system behavior. -Keywords-Note, Report, Aging List for Receivables, #, Not assigned, Value.

Title: Dump while trying to pay migrated invoice - Israel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-You are trying to pay a migrated invoice and system throws dump (Runtime error).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Payables Work Center.-Select Supplier Accounts.-Search with AAA(AAA refers to supplier account).-View and search for open item Migrated Invoice BBB(BBB refers to migrated supplier invoice).-Select row and click on Pay by Outgoing transfer.-System dumps.-Cause-In the migrated file we can see that the product tax is empty (Tax data Sheet), but Withholding taxes is there. However, In migration file, field product tax are defined for India, and for Israel its not relevant.-The issue would only occur when the withholding taxes are migrated with the planned indicator, and there are no product taxes, as this information is needed when the withholding taxes are recalculated at the point of payment. This recalculation requires the product tax information to get the base amount. If planned indicator is not set in migration file, the system is not taking into account the withholding tax in supplier master data.-The result is that the supplier invoice calculated without withholding tax deduction and the payment is not shown at the statutory report. The business impact is that the company cannot issue payments to suppliers.-Resolution-For Israel, dump cannot be avoided. During the migration documents it is necessary to have product taxes as the base amount for Withholding taxes is based on the product Tax amounts. this cannot be done.-The only option to migrate the withholding component as well without product taxes for Israel is to post the withholding taxes only ( without product taxes ) via Withholding Base amount entries.-See Also- 3000403 - 500 SAP Internal Server Error Appears When You Pay Migrated Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Withholding tax, dump, Outgoing bank transfer

Title: Error "System versions do not match" When Copy Solution Profile From Production to Test
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When requesting for a solution profile copy from a source system to a target system, the below errors can be faced:-Check System Versions -System versions do not match.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to Systems view.-Select the line of source system and choose copy solution profile button.-Choose Source system ID, source solution profile ID as well as the target system where the solution profile will be moved.-Choose OK and the request starts.-When requesting for a solution profile copy from a source system to a target system-Cause-This is due to mismatch of PDI solutions/versions between systems and/or workspaces.-Recommendation is to check and compare the content of the tables APXR_LAYER for LAYER_CUST and Version 0000 for the two systems involved and the content of table BCTD_WSSOLUTION for the main workspace in the production system and the change project in the test system.-The content has to match between all these four cases. A manual upgrade of these two workspaces could also be helpful to reveal any inconsistencies. -We need to check the four scenarios whether it is matching or not.-1. The content of the tables APXR_LAYER for LAYER_CUST for the two systems involved -2. The content of the tables APXR_LAYER for Version 0000 for the two systems involved -3. The content of table BCTD_WSSOLUTION for the main workspace in the production system -4. The content of table BCTD_WSSOLUTION for the main workspace change project in the test system-The content has to match between all these four cases. -Resolution-Below is the possible way to correct this inconsistency in the backend.-This can be done by the following,-A manual upgrade of these two workspaces.-To know the steps to upgrade the workspace, refer to below the-3443395 - How to Upgrade a Workspace in Backend? -See Also-KB0665514 : How to Copy Solution Profile in SAP Business ByDesign -2906047 - Copy Solution Profile or Change Project error related to Add-On-Keywords-SDK, PDI, BYD, Copy Solution Profile, Service Control Center, solution profile, copy, source productive tenant, target test tenant, source development tenant, copy of solution profile, not allowed

Title: 'View Printed Results' Is Greyed Out for Statutory Report Journal Entry Voucher - China
Content: Symptom-The 'View Printed Results' button in Journal Entry Voucher - China view is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Statutory Reports view.-Search and open Journal Entry Voucher - China.-Select the Report Run and you can see 'View Printed Results' is greyed out.-Cause-The run is scheduled but not printed in the system.-Resolution-There are two options for printing the results of a report run:-Using Print Results.-This option enables to first view and check the report run results before printing the PDF. Once the run is scheduled and finished, it is possible to click on 'Print Results' to generate the printed results.-Using Schedule and Print.-The 'Schedule and Print' button enables to schedule the report run and create a printed copy of the report directly, that is, without checking the report run results. The printout is stored as a PDF attachment of the report run and available in the overview of created runs. -More information can be found in Help Document: <Print a Statutory Report>-Keywords-printed results greyed out, Journal Entry Voucher - China

Title: Whether Down Payments can be Excluded from the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run
Content: Symptom-Whether down payments can be excluded from the Foreign Currency Remeasurement run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Execute a Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for supplier ABC (ABC represents the supplier account ID).-Check the log result.-Under Processed Successfully tab, see that the down payment 123 is also included in the run (123 represents the down payment ID).-Cause-Currently it is the system design to include down payments in a Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run. There is no option to only exclude down payments from the run.-Resolution-Although down payments are considered in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, there is a settings to decide whether the postings need to be reversed in the subsequent period.-The settings that define whether or not the Foreign Currency Remeasurement run postings are reversed in the subsequent period are maintained in business configuration, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash.-Click Assign remeasurement method to accounting principle.-Select the respective accounting principle.-Go to tab Use for Cash-Refer to column No Subsequent Reversal Posting.-If this checkbox is flagged for the respective accounting period, the foreign currency remeasurement run postings are not reversed in the subsequent period and differences are not carried over through time.-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, Down Payment, Exclude,

Title: Tax Country/Region of a Item Type Service Time and Material is displayed incorrectly in the Invoice document
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Tax Country/Region displayed for a Item Service Time and Material in a Invoice Document is not the same as the one maintained in the Sales Order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Filter for All Invoice Documents.-Search for the Customer Invoice ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Taxes sub tab.-The Tax Country/Region is displayed as XX (XX represents the Country Code), which is not the same as the one maintained in the Sales Order.-Cause-The Tax Country for a Item Type Service Time and Material is defined in a Invoice based on the Tax Country/Region maintained for the item in the Service Confirmation document.-For the Item type Service Time and Material, the Service Confirmation works as document which validates the information maintained in the Sales Order, however this information can be changed during the creation of the Service Confirmation (for example: Quantity, List Price, Tax Country/Region). This changes will be carried out to the Invoice Document as the Item type Service Time and Material is invoiced through the Service Confirmation Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-tax country/region, wrong, sales order, invoice, incorrect

Title: Scoping Question "Do You Directly Post Journal Entry Vouchers To Partner Companies?" Is Missing.
Content: Symptom-When defining the scope of an implementation project, you notice that the scoping question "Do you directly post journal entry vouchers to partner companies?" is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - 1808 and above.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects view.-Click on the implementation project, and click on Edit Project Scope.-Proceed to the step 4 - Questions.-Expand the nodes Financial and Management Accounting -> General Ledger -> General Ledger.-The scoping question is not appearing for review.-Cause-This behavior is caused due to the fact that direct journal posting for partner companies is available only on certain countries.-The countries for which this option is available are the following:-Austria-Australia-Brazil-Canada-China-Germany-Denmark-Spain-France-United Kingdom-India-Italy-Mexico-Netherlands-United states-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-journal vouchers, intercompanies

Title: The Net Value and Net Price Fields are Grayed Out for the Items in a Sales Order Document
Content: Symptom-The Net Value and Net Price fields are grayed out for the Items in a Sales Order document and also the Price List field is not displayed for the items in the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Under Common tasks, select New Sales Order.-Click on View all button.-Fill the mandatory information in the General tab.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click on Add Row button.-Under Product ID column, insert Product ID ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-The Net Value and Net Price fields are displayed grayed out and also the List Price field is not displayed for the items in the document.-Cause-As per standard system behavior the Net Value and Net Price field cannot be manually changed in a Sales Order document, however these fields are have their values based on the List Price field.
