The value maintained in the List Price field will determine the Price and related price information for the item.-Therefore, in order to change the amounts of Net Value and Net Price fields in the Sales Order, it is required to manually change the amount in the List Price field of the item.-In addtion, the List Price field is always enabled for Items in Sales Order as this is a mandatory information to be carried out to other Sales documents (with the exception being for Kit sub Items). If the List Price is not being displayed for a specific Sales document, then the field is not yet enabled in the Personalization Mode.-Resolution-In this case, we kindly ask you to enable the List Price field to be displayed for the Sales Order document in order to change the Price values for the Items.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-Open any Sales Order.-Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click on the User Icon.-Select Start Personalization Mode.-Select the Arrow in the Unnamed Table option.-Mark the checkbox in the List Price option.-Select Save in the Personalization column.-Click on the User Icon.-Select Stop Personalization Mode.-The List Price field should be displayed for all Sales Order documents. Also when changing the value of this field the Net Value and Net Price should be redetermined accordingly.-Keywords-Net Price, Net Value, Sales Order, List Price, not displayed, grayed out

Title: Error 'Posting Failed' during New Charge/Credit for a Customer Account
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are getting error 'Posting Failed' while trying to clear customer line item via 'New charge/Credit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center ‘Receivables’.-Select Relevant Customer and open it.-Click on View -> Select item and select ‘New Charge/Credit and enter required field values like GL account, amount, Tax code and State and hit Post to see error described.-Cause-Missing postal code-Resolution-When state field is filled, postal code field becomes mandatory and issue gets resolved once its maintained and New charge/credit is posted-Keywords-New Charge/Credit, Customer account, Posting failed, Postal code, State

Title: "Inspected By" Column is Missing in the Exported Excel File.
Content: Symptom-When exporting the inspections from the Quality Control Work Center to Microsoft Excel, the "Inspected By" column is not available in the exported Excel file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Control Work center.-Go to Inspections Sub-view under Monitoring view.-Select All Inspections in the drop down.  -Choose Export and Select "To Microsoft Excel".-Cause-The "Inspected By" column is not available in the exported Excel file as the standard Excel export template is designed without including this column by default. -Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Inspected By; Quality Control; Monitoring; Inspections; Export; All Inspection; SAP Business ByDesign; Excel

Title: Currency Conversion Date Derivation in Balance Carryforward Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-This KBA explains how the system determines the Currency Conversion Date for a journal entry resulting from Balance Carryforward when the respective Currency Conversion Profile is configured for Conversion Date as '1 - Document Date' for Balance Carryforward business transaction type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If the Journal Entry's Source Document Date (which in case of balance carryforward is the Creation Date of the run) is after the posting date of the document (in this case the journal entry's Posting Date) then even if in the respective Currency Conversion Profile -> Business Transaction Type 'Balance Carryforward' -> the Conversion Date '1 - Document Date' is selected, the Currency Conversion Date will be equal to the Posting Date. -However, if the Source Document Date is before the Journal Entry's Posting Date, then the system takes the Source Document Date as preferred date for Currency Conversion Date while posting the journal entry. -For example:-1st scenario: Balance Carryforward step 1 created on 24.10.2023, meaning journal entry's Source Document Date is 24.10.2023.-Journal entry posted on 31.12.2021. -Since 24.10.2023 is after 31.12.2021, the Currency Conversion Date will be equal to posting date (31.12.2021).-2nd scenario: Balance Carryforward step 1 created on 14.12.2021, meaning journal entry's Source Document Date is 14.12.2021.-Journal entry posted on 31.12.2021. -Since 14.12.2021 is before 31.12.2021, the Currency Conversion Date will be derived from journal entry's Source Document Date (14.12.2021).-Keywords-bcf; balance carryforward; currency conversion date; currency conversion profile; source document date; posting date

Title: Error "Logon Data is not Correct; log on Again" While Trying to Login C4C
Content: Symptom-Few users are facing error  "Logon data is not correct; log on again" while trying to login C4C-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to tenant-Error  "Logon data is not correct; log on again" is displayed.-Cause-There is space before user ID. -Resolution-You need to remove space before user ID of the employees via data workbench file using employee object.-Go to Data Workbench work center.-Select Export View.-Select employee object.-Select Next.-Select Export Data.-Add the values which needs to be modified/updated in the template and then follow the below steps-Go to Data Workbench work center.-Select Import.-Select Individual Object.-Select Update.-Search the object.-Select Next.-Upload the template.-See Also-2568268 - Frequently Asked Questions on Data Workbench Work Center  -Keywords-Data Workbench; Logon data is not correct; log on again; login issue

Title: Unable to Remove Not Invoiced Time and Expenses Records for Migrated Projects
Content: Symptom-A Project with actual work hours is migrated via Data Migration Tool. As the consequence, Customer Project Expense List(CPEL) gets created and the corresponding record exists under Not Invoiced Time and Expenses View. Since the time sheet of the project employee is not migrated during the migration, the actual work hours and the CPEL record has no sense, but there is no option to remove the CPEL record.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Navigate to Projects View.-Search for the migrated project XXX and choose Edit button.-Navigate to Project Plan - Gantt Chart - Work Subtab.-Choose Delete button for all the records of each project task.-Choose Save button and Close button.-Navigate to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses View.-Search for the migrated project XXX, the records can still be found.-Cause-For Non-Migrated Projects, once employee books time against a specific project task and activity (service) then the work records will not be able to delete in the projects. The Delete button will be disabled since the records should be updated by the employee in Home - Self-Services View.-For Migrated projects, as create Project out of migration tool along with actual work hours, CPEL gets created and the Delete button is also enabled in state. Since there is no linkage created at backend between Project task and CPEL, by clicking on the Delete button can only delete the work records which are having Zero actual work quantity.-Resolution-This has been known by our development team and will be enhanced in a future release. Until the permanent solution is not introduce, if you want to remove these no sense records, please create a case and authorize SAP can remove them from backend. -Keywords-Not Invoiced Time and Expenses, Project, Migrated, Data Migration, Actual Work

Title: How to Maintain the Bank Processing Date for Tax Payments
Content: Symptom-You create a Tax Payment from the Tax Management work center. This tax payment must be executed on a future date. -But, for Tax Payments it is not possible to maintain a Bank Processing Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Tax Management work center create a new Tax Payment, either in the Tax Payments view or via the Common Tasks section.-The payment must be executed on a future date. Therefore, you adjust the Payment and Posting date of the payment. -When checking the corresponding Outgoing Payment in the Payment Monitor, or when creating a payment file for this payment, you notice that the payment execution date is the Document Date plus 1 day. -Cause-Currently, it is not possible to maintain a Bank Processing Date in internally created Tax Payments. With the Bank Processing Date not specified, it is derived from the Document's Creation date plus 1 day.-Resolution-If a Tax Payment must be executed on a specific date, create the payment externally, from either the Payment or Liquidity Management work center:-In the Payment or Liquidity Management work center create a New Outgoing Bank Transfer, either from the Payment Monitor or from the Common Tasks section. -Press View all to open all tabs. -In the General tab, in the General Data section maintain Company and Bank Account. -In the Payee Data section, in the Payee field enter the Financial Authority's details. -The Financial Authority maintained as payee will trigger the field Account Type in the Payment Application Method section.-In the Account Type field, select Tax Authority (Once posted, this payment will generate a Tax Payment in the Tax Management work center with status In Preparation). -Maintain the Payment Amount and Currency.-In the Processing Data section, you can also maintain the Bank Processing date to define when the payment is to be executed. -Keywords-bank processing date, tax payment

Title: 'Create Remittance Advice' Is Greyed Out for Confirmed Outgoing Payments
Content: Symptom-The 'Create Remittance Advice' button is greyed out for confirmed outgoing payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-See the 'Create Remittance Advice' button is greyed out for confirmed outgoing payments.-Cause-For confirmed outgoing payments, the system does not allow to create any remittance advice. -Resolution-System is designed based on standard business practice and business process. -Keywords-create remittance advice, confirmed outgoing payments

Title: Unable to Check Supplier Invoice Because Of Dump
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -System crash when the user clicks in Check button on Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button.-Click in View All button.-Click in Check button.-In the backend, transaction ST22, you can see the dump information:-"-Application info-Triggering application component: AP-SIP-/SRMAP/CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION, Program:/SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDH, Include:/SRMAP/LFND_PDHU34, Position:348-Info: Fatal Runtime Exception occurred-/SRMAP/CX_LSIV_CURCONV_ERR, Program:/SRMAP/CL_LSIV_MGR_TOOLKIT====CP, Include:/SRMAP/CL_LSIV_MGR_TOOLKIT====CM00L, Position:75-"-Cause-Different currency is used in one of the Purchase Orders or the Inbound Deliveries related to this Supplier Invoice. So please follow the instructions below:-Check the currency maintained in all Purchase Orders linked to the invoice. In case they are all the same, please check step 2.-Open all Inbound Deliveries of all the Purchase Orders checked in (1). Check all the currencies maintained in those Inbound Deliveries. -Resolution-Ensure that the documents related to the Invoice have the same currency as it is maintained in the Invoice.-In case any of the documents have a different currency, the user can (1) cancel it and then create it again with the correct currency or (2) maintain different delivery documents for each currency.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Currency; Dump; Error 500; Backend; ST22; Purchase Order; Inbound Delivery

Title: Goods and Activity confirmations View is not Fetching Correct Data with the Filter Based on a Specific Date
Content: Symptom-Even though there are confirmations on specific date the filter in Goods and Activity confirmations View doesn't work and hence there are no confirmations displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to work center Internal Logistics workcenter and Goods and Activity Confirmation view and Advance Search-2. Key in Created On date Ex: 22.02.2024 and click on Go or Click to Execute the query.-You will not see any data.-Cause-Goods and Activity Confirmation view is not fully functional as it was designed based on customer request for specific functionality.-But all the fields are not fully functional here.-Resolution-As per the standard guidelines it is required to access the information related to Goods and Activity Confirmation from Common Tasks view  of Internal Logistics workcenter i.e. Display/Reverse Goods and Activity Confirmation.-See Also- Goods and Activity Confirmation, Display, Reverse, Internal Logistics, Filter, Created On

Title: Purchase Order Workflow Rule is not sending Notification to Creator, Requestor and Recipient of shopping cart
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order workflow rule and in Recipient field, you selected "Notification to Creator, Requestor and Recipient of shopping cart" , but notification is not sent as per this rule.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select Workflow Rules-Select Business Object: Purchase Order-create a notification rule -Enter all details and in the last step, set the Recipient: Notification to Creator, Requestor and Recipient of shopping cart-Cause-As per the rule, notification will go to Creator, Requestor and Recipient of "shopping cart", but this is a standalone purchase order or the preceding document is not a shopping cart that means it is not created from a shopping cart, hence the rule is not working.-Resolution-Please set the recipient determination as "Notification to Employee Responsible", so that Buyer Responsible of the purchase order will get it.-Keywords-purchase order notification, workflow rule, Recipient: Notification to Creator, Requestor and Recipient of shopping cart, buyer responsible

Title: How to Check Tax Prepayment Supported Countries from Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are receiving an error message while processing Tax Prepayment for Country XYZ (XYZ represents Country Name).-Error: Tax prepayments not permitted for tax return type Tax Return in XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments view.-Click on New -> Tax Payments view.-Enter the Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Select Tax Payment Type as Tax Prepayment.-Press Enter and you can see the Error message: Tax prepayments not permitted for tax return type Tax Return in XYZ (XYZ represents Country Name).-Cause-SAP ByDesign system does not support Tax Prepayment functionality for all the countries. Currently ByDesign supports four country codes: IN, DE, US and GB. (countries may be added in the future depends legal complaince)-Resolution-You can check Tax prepayment supported Countries in backend.-Go to Transaction code: SE16-Enter Table Name: FOP_C_TAXDECL_PAYM-            3.  Press Enter.-        -    4.  Click on Execute (F8).-        You can see the entries marked true(X) for Prepayment revelant column. i.e, only those countries are supported for Tax prepayment.-Keywords-Tax prepayment, Tax prepayment supported countries, tax return type

Title: Cannot View the Sender and Receiver information after Creating Distribution Rules
Content: Symptom-Create a new distribution rule AAA and add the Sender' and 'Receiver' information in the system(AAA represents the distribution rule ID). However, after saving the rule, there is no record under 'Sender' and 'Receiver' tabs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Distribution Rules view.-Search for rule ID AAA.-Click on Edit.-Under 'Senders' and 'Receivers' tab.-No records found.-Cause-By default, the 'Assignment Valid On' date is set to today under 'Senders' or 'Receivers' tabs. However, the validity period of the rule has been set to the future.-Resolution-Change the 'Assignment Valid On' to a date that is equal to or later than the effective date.-Keywords-Distribution Rule, Sender, Receiver, Miss, Disappear, No record

Title: How to Avoid Output Generation in Purchase Order?
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order but do not want to generate output history.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders-Create a new Purchase Order-Enter all details and order-The purchase order goes to Sent status-In output history tab, you can see purchase order output has been generated successfully-However, you do not want to generate output in purchase order-Cause-If you have already set "output channel selection" settings, system will generate output using any of the output channel like email, fax or printer.-Resolution-You have a check box "Prevent Output" in the Purchase Order General tab. If you uncheck that box, then the output will not be generated in purchase order and supplier will not be notified automatically if the purchase order is ordered, changed or canceled.-Currently there is no option to set "Prevent Output" for multiple Purchase Orders in batch, user has to set it one by one.-Keywords-purchase order output, output history, prevent output

Title: Unable to Add Custom Field for Some Countries
Content: Symptom-User is unable to add custom fields for some countries via SDK-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-User is trying to add custom field to below screen-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employee view-Edit any Employee-Go to Employment tab-Go to Clauses sub tab-Go to Details-Cause-Extension fields are not enabled by default for every country. - Resolution-If you are unable to add an extension field to certain screens, you need to submit a request on the Customer Influence Portal- Keywords-Custom extension fields, SDK , unable to add extension fields , Countries ,BE ,CH ,NO,DK ,CN ,HK.

Title: External Invoice Requests created via ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn cannot be linked to Sales Order/Item under Revenue Assignment on Item Level
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to pass Sales Order/Item under Revenue Assignment on Item Level when creating External Invoice Requests via webservice ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When creating an Invoice Request via the web service an External Customer Invoice Request is created.-The External Customer Invoice Request behaves like a Manual Invoice Request and cannot be linked to a preceding document such as a Sales Order, Service Order, Service Confirmation etc.-In the system, these documents are invoiced via the standard internal ByDesign processes e.g. via an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request, Sales Order Invoice Request, Service Order Invoice Request, Service Confirmation Invoice Request etc; and in this scenario the respective AccountingCodingBlockAssignment is linked automatically.-However when assigning the item to a Project Task it is needed to pass the AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode as PRO.-For example:-<AccountingCodingBlockAssignment>-<AccountingCodingBlock>-<AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode>PRO</AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode>-<ProjectReference>-<ProjectElementID>XYZ-123-4</ProjectElementID>-</ProjectReference>-</AccountingCodingBlock>-</AccountingCodingBlockAssignment>-  Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-You can find more information about the web service as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Service Explorer view.-Select the Service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn with the Operation Maintain customer invoice requests-In the Details section, click on the Link for Documentation.-See Also-2066581 - In the New Manual Invoice Request, the Account Assignment Type as SLS -Sales Order is Missing-2977977 - How to set Reconciliation Account with Web Service 'ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn'-Keywords-Webservice, not possible, missing, Sales Order, Revenue.

Title: Petty Cash Description Is Missing in Value Help of Petty Cash in Outgoing or Incoming Payment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-** INTERNAL USE ONLY **-Description of Petty Cash is missing in value help window when you create new Petty Cash Payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management - Petty Cash.-Select petty cash XZY and select New Outgoing Cash Transfer.-User value help of Petty Cash ID of the target party, no description of them. However, there is description maintained for each petty cash account already.-Cause-The behaviour is that the description is created for whatever language you login with and there is no option to create the Description node again in a different language.-The Cash Storage Edit QAF is built to handle only one description.-For example, if you create the petty cash account with decription maintained in English environment. Later on, you login Chinese environment, and add Chinese description of the same petty cash account. It is not working. When you create new petty cash payment in Chinese environment, the description is still missing per the reproduction steps above.-Resolution-Please forward incident to development team of component SRD-FIN-MOP to correct the description in the targeting language environment.-Please also remind customer always create petty cash account with description in the working language environment for most of their business users of ByDesign.-Keywords-Petty Cash, 小额现金，零用金，描述

Title: Net Sales Field is Blank in the Report Profit Overview by Key Figure
Content: Symptom-In the report Profit Overview by Key Figure you notice that the Net Sales field is blank for few Sales Document IDs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Select List subview.-Run the report Profit Overview by Key Figure with the required selection.-You notice that for some sales document ids the Net Sales field is updated with some value and for some other sales documents the Net Sales field is blank.-Cause-If the customer invoices that belong to the sales documents are not posted, then the Net Sales field will not be updated.-Resolution-If you need to see the correct profitability view of the sales documents, then as a prerequisite post the relevant Customer Invoices and Goods and Activity Confirmations related to the sales documents for which you need to know the profitability. Once the follow up documents of the sales documents are posted then you will be able to view the Net Sales and Total Cost of Goods Sold resulting which the system shows the Gross Profit / Operating Income of this report.-Report Sales Document - Line Items, will help to Cross check if the Customer Invoices and Goods and Activity Confirmation documents are posted. If the Customer Invoices and Goods and Activity Confirmations are posted and is not reflecting in the Profit Overview by Key Figure report, then report a case to SAP to investigate the root cause.-Keywords-Net Sales, Profit Overview by Key Figure, Cost of Goods Sold.-net sales not updated,net sales blank in profitability report,net sales field blank in profit overview,profit overview by key figure

Title: Error in program /SDF/CL_S4RC20_FACTORY========CP while running SAP Readiness Check 2.0 or SAP Signavio Process Insights, Discovery Edition
Content: Symptom-While running the SAP Readiness Check 2.0 or SAP Signavio Process Insights, Discovery Edition the corresponding job got aborted along with below dump-Category ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors OBJECTS_OBJREF_NOT_ASSIGNED-Except. CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL-ABAP Program /SDF/CL_S4RC20_FACTORY========CP--Short Text-Access using a 'ZERO' object reference is not possible.-Environment-SAP Readiness Check 2.0-SAP Signavio Process Insights, Discovery Edition-Reproducing the Issue-Executing RC_COLLECT_ANALYSIS_DATA or RC_VALUE_DISCOVERY_COLL_DATA-Cause-Error during implementation of SAP Note 2745851-Resolution-Reset 2745851 and implement it once again. Always make sure to use the latest version of the SAP Note.-See Also-2758146 - SAP Readiness Check for SAP S/4HANA & Process Discovery (evolution of SAP Business Scenario Recommendations) or SAP Innovation and Optimization Pathfinder

Title: Cannot process Goods and Activity Confirmation ABC because Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF not yet posted in accounting
Content: Symptom-Goods and Activity Confirmation ID ABC shows as an Unposted Source Document with error message:-"Cannot process Goods and Activity Confirmation ABC because Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF not yet posted in accounting. As Goods and Activity Confirmation ABC contains a reference to Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF but Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Goods and Activity Confirmation ABC. Check why Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF has not been posted." (ABC and DEF stands for the IDs of the referred documents).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-In Unposted Source Documents, you will notice Goods and Activity Confirmation ID ABC with the error message above.-Cause-As the error message states, Goods and Activity Confirmation ABC contains a reference to Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF, but Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF has not been posted in accounting.-One of the reasons why the Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF is not posted in accounting is because the transaction contains a Non-Taxable tax code and also contains a tax amount.-The tax code and tax amount information was sent to the ByDesign system via payload.-To check this follow this path:-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Open Point-of-Sale Transactions View.-Search and open Point-of-Sale Transaction DEF.-Click on View All and go to Tax Items tab.-Here you notice that the Tax Code is "1 - Non-Taxable Purchase Out of Scope of Law" or another similar Non-Taxable Tax code.-Also, in the Tax Amount field, there is an amount different than zero maintained.-Due to the mismatch, an error occurs and the Point-of-Sale transaction is not sent to accounting.-You can check the tax rates in the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview sub view.-Search for the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Select Define Tax Codes.-Search for the relevant Tax code and check for the Tax rate type.-Click the Define Tax Rate Schedules link.-You can chek the Rate in % for the Tax rate type is blank or 0.-Resolution-To prevent this error, please ensure that you only maintain a tax amount for taxable items.-For the documents that are currently in error. These documents will have to be canceled and created with correct tax amount for taxable items.-Keywords-Point-of-Sale, Payload, Non-taxable, Goods and Activity Confirmation

Title: Error: Down Payments Cannot be Cleared Together with Items of Other Types
Content: Symptom-You are trying to clear the Payment, Down Payment & Invoice, and receive the error message: Down payments cannot be cleared together with items of other types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose the Supplier in question, and then select View.-In the Trade Payables tab, show Open Items.-You can see the Payment, Down Payment & Invoice.-Select these three items, and choose Clear Manually.-On the New Manual Clearing screen you see the error message - Down payments cannot be cleared together with items of other types.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-The standard process is to first clear the Down Payment with the Invoice and then clear the remaining amount with the Invoice.--OR--While creating the Invoice, add the open Down Payment to the Invoice itself and later clear the remaining balance of the Invoice with the Payment.-Keywords-Down payment, Clear, Other type,

Title: Changing UoM Quantity Conversion For Product Not possible Error "Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open project baselines, projects"
Content: Symptom-Customer needs to update the UoM quantity conversion for material and while saving the changes the error "changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open project baselines, projects" is raised.---Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Access the Materials view.-Locate and select the relevant material.-Click the Edit button.-Click the View All button.-In the General tab, scroll down to Quantity Conversion section.-Try to delete or change a quantity conversion.-Error message is raised.-Cause-The relevant material or service is already used in one or more documents of the type(s) mentioned in the error message, so it is:-Not possible to modify the existing quantity conversion.-Not possible to remove the existing quantity conversion.-Not possible to have another row with a different value for the same UoM (unit of measure) combination.-The reason for this is that the business documents which are using this material or service would end up in inconsistency if the change was allowed.-The veto check executed is not at quantity conversion level, but rather at material/service level: if that material/service is being used in a document, even if the quantity conversion used is one other than the one you intend to delete or change, the system will still block the action.-Resolution-You can use the standard report available in the system to check if product is linked in more than one project.-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Click on Design Reports.-In the search field insert "Project Product Data" and click on the link of the report name.-In the filter "Product" insert the product ID and click on "Apply" button.-You will get the result about which projects the product is linked.-See Also-1720124 - Error Message "Changing The Conversion Not Possible" While Editing Quantity Conversion of Material or Service

Title: Error: "Conflicts Exist; Use Show Filter to Display Conflicts You Need to Resolve"
Content: Symptom-When you select Sales element Sell Standard Products in Scoping, you get a Conflict error:-Error: "Conflicts exist; use show filter to display conflicts you need to resolve"-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Go to Scoping tab.-Expand Product and Service Portfolio for Sales under Sales element.-Select Sell Standard Products option.-You will see the conflict error.-Cause-The issue is raised because there is a dependency over the scoping element Sell Standard Products.--Resolution-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Go to Scoping tab.-Expand Product and Service Portfolio for Sales under Sales element.-Select the element Sell Standard Products and open the Dependency tab.-Selection of Shipping along with Sell Standard Products allows the scoping changes and removes the conflict error.-Check the dependency and then proceed further with the correct corresponding selection as below screenshot.-Keywords-Sell Standard Products, Sales, conflict error

Title: Report or Data source shows message Currency Code / Unit Code does not exist
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer faces error below (or similar) and needs help identifying the problematic instances:-"Currency Code XYZ does not exist (table /ISCER/C_CER)"-"Unit Code XYZ does not exist (table /ISQC/C_UT)"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Go to MDRS-Search and load basic MDAV-Expand Using Query Definition-Double-click FSI view, for example, FSP_COD_OPPI-Select tab QDEF Elements-Identify "Result Element" for rows with "Data Type Element" CURRENCY_CODE / UNIT_CODE-Under Overview again, double-click FSI view, for example, FSP_COD_OPPI-Click Test / Execute (F8)-Click LOAD-Under Selection click "New FIELD" icon-Paste the "Result Element" in FIELD-Select EQ in OPERATOR-Paste VALUE, for example, CFA-For multiple "Result Elements" with "Data Type Element" CURRENCY_CODE / UNIT_CODE add the OR COMPOSITION-Select Number Requested as some large value-EXECUTE-Export as spreadsheet-Keywords-FSI, Currency, MDAV, QDEF Elements, Data Source

Title: Supplier Invoice cannot be Posted due to Exception: Balance is not equal zero
Content: Symptom-Supplier invoice cannot be posted due to exception: "The balance is not equal zero: XXX EUR. The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts".-If click on Calculate Total Amount, the exception would be obsolete but the subtotal would be incorrect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find the issued supplier invoice and open it.-Navigate to Exceptions tab. There is an open exception about the balance difference.-Click on Actions -> Calculate Total Amount on header level.-The exception goes obsolete. But new subtotal proposed by system is not expected. -Cause-There are cost distributions that are assigned 0% for each line item.-Resolution-Open the issued supplier invoice.-Navigate to Items tab. Select each line item and navigate to Cost Distributions subtab.-Remove the records that are assigned 0%.-Save the change and click on Actions->Calculate Total Amount.-The subtotal would be corrected and the invoice can be posted.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Subtotal; Balance; Cost Distribution

Title: Web Service: Not Able to Create Purchase Request that Contains Two Line Items via SOAP UI
Content: Symptom-When creating a purchase request that contains two line items via SOAP UI, an error "RABAX occurred on server side" occurs and no purchase request is created.-But if the payload contains only one line item, or two line items that are exactly the same, purchase requests can be created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Service Explorer view, download WSDL for ManagePurchaseRequestIn.-Open it in SOAP UI to create a new project.-Input the payload to create a purchase request with 2 line items.-Execute the payload, an error occurs: "RABAX occurred on server side".-Cause-Supplier is not maintained in the payload for both line items.-Resolution-It is mandatory to maintain supplier(s) for both line items in the request payload.-Keywords-Purchase Request; Line Item; SOAP UI; Web Service; RABAX occurred on server side

Title: Product Not Delivered to Project Stock Order Due to Process Communication Error in Delivery Goods and Activity Confirmation.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Project Stock Order cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work center.-Select Project Stock Orders View-Enter project stock order ID.-Select and choose edit-Go to document flow tab.-Here process communication error exists.-Cause-Since the relevant Serial number status is Blocked, process communication error exists.-Resolution-Go to Service Entitlement Work center.-Select Registered Products view.-Dropdown and select all registered product.-Enter the Serial number in search filed.-Here the status of Registered Product ID is Blocked.-Select the relevant Registered Product ID-Edit it and update status to Active via Change status option.-Keywords-Serial number, Project Stock Order, Goods and Activity Confirmation, Stock overview of material missing, registered Product id,

Title: Error When Trying to Scope BPA or iRPA
Content: Symptom-You are trying to scope iRPA or BPA in the tenant, however at the Review step of the scoping process, the following popup error appears:-"Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data.-If error messages are displayed. resolve them before you proceed."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 3 - Scoping.-Expand Communication and Information Exchange, then Integration with External Applications and Solutions.-Check the checkbox for Integration Scenarios for Cloud Solutions from SAP.-Now navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Expand the same path from step 6.-Click on the Integration Scenarios for Cloud Solutions from SAP row.-Here either select question "Do you want to enable integration with SAP Intelligent Robotic Process Automation?" or "Do you want to enable integration with SAP Build Process Automation (BPA)?" and try to finish the scope.-Cause-When BPA or iRPA are provisioned, a service request is created to verify the need to provision the other system instances required for the setup (for example, and IAS tenant).-As this service request is not completed instantaneously, further changes in BPA/iRPA scoping are blocked until all open service requests are completed.-Resolution-You can check the status of the service requests by following the below steps:-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Enter the Service Requests view.-Here you can search for the most recent service request with ID BYD_ML_SPA and check the status.-Once the status is completed, you should be able to proceed with scoping changes for iRPA/BPA.-Keywords-Robotic Process Automation, Build Process Automation, Machine Learning

Title: Warning in supplier invoice : Only non-EU tax codes are allowed for non-EU suppliers
Content: Symptom-When creating a supplier invoice (supplier is a EU member), there will always be a warning message: Only non-EU tax codes are allowed for non-EU suppliers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Create a new supplier invoice and make the seller a member of the EU.-Click on Check, there will be warning message: Only non-EU tax codes are allowed for non-EU suppliers.-Resolution-This is to be fixed in future releases.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Supplier; EU; Non-EU

Title: Sales Order ID displayed as # in the Data Source CRMSLOIB
Content: Symptom-When filtering for a Sales Order in the Data Source CRMSLOIB, the Sales Order ID is displayed as #. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Data Sources View.-Search for the Data Source CRMSLOIB.-Mark the Data Source CRMSLOIB.-Select Preview button.-Select the View Icon.-In the Row fields section, select the '+' Icon.-In the Row selection, search for Sales Order.-Mark the Sales Order option.-Select Ok button.-Select the Selection Icon.-In the Sales Order field, enter the Sales Order ID ABC. (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID)  -Select Apply button.-The Sales Order ID is displayed as #. -Cause-The List Price was not maintained for the Items in the Sales Orders ABC, therefore the Sales Order ID is displayed as #  in the Data Source CRMSLOIB as the system is able to identify that Items were maintained for the document, however they are inconsistent due to mandatory price information missing.-Resolution-This is currently a standard system behavior -In this case, we kindly recommend to always maintain a valid List Price information during the creation of the Sales Order document.-Keywords-Data Source CRMSLOIB, CRMSLOIB, Sales Order, ID, #, Sales Order Item

Title: How to Query Campaign Specific Price List via the Web Service QuerySalesPriceListIn
Content: Symptom- You would like to know how to query a Campaign Specific Price List via the Web Service QuerySalesPriceListIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Type Code for the Company Specific Price List is 7PL0.-You need to ensure that you include the following Header Key Names in your payload for the element:-CND_SALES_ORG_ID for the value of the Sales Organization.-DISTR_CHANNEL for the value of the Distribution Channel.-CND_CAMPAIGN_ID for the value of the Campaign ID. -Resolution-Here a sample Payload where the Sales Organization is P1110, the Distribution Channel is 01 and the Campaign ID is 214:-- - - - - 3- 7PL0- - true- - CND_SALES_ORG_ID- - - P1110- - - - true- - DISTR_CHANNEL- - - 01- - - - true- - CND_CAMPAIGN_ID- - - 214- - - - - --See Also-More details can be found in the help documentation:-Go to the Application and User Management work center. -Select the Service Explorer view. -Select the Service QuerySalesPriceListIn. -In the Details section, click on the Link for Documentation. -KBA 3464656 - How to Query a Price List by ID or UUID via the Web Service QuerySalesPriceListIn-Keywords-Query; Campaign, Price Specification; CND_SALES_ORG_ID; Web Service; Price List; QuerySalesPriceListIn

Title: The Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" is Displayed for a Sales Order (Internal)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports that a Process Communication Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" is being displayed in the Document Flow tab of the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Process Communication Error is displayed for the Sales Order XYZ.-Go to Transaction SEFTS.-Search for the BO name -> SALES_ORDER.-Select the arrow in the folder Icon.-Select the option Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the "ID/content" field, insert the Sales Order ID XYZ.- Select Confirm.-In the BO Instance Structure Column, Right click the Sales Order ID XYZ.-Select Message Monitoring -> Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow.-Select Action button.-Select Restart option. -Restarting the failed XI message is not effective.-Cause-The Process Communication Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" occurs because the item in the Sales Order XYZ was rejected with a Reason for Rejection Code that is no longer valid in the system.-In order to check the Reason for Rejection Codes that are currently valid in the system, the following steps can be performed:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-In the search field, search for Reasons for Rejection.-Open the Reasons for Rejection activity.-The valid Reason for Rejection Codes are displayed in the UI.-Resolution-Customer has two available options that can be applied for this scenario:-Option 1 - Change the Reason for Rejection for the Line Items to a valid option.-Option 2 - Restore the Reason for Rejection Code in the 'Reasons for Rejection' activity.-The steps for each option is described in details in the KBA 3448847 - The Error "Cancellation reason XX is not valid" is displayed for a Sales Order.-If the customer choose to perform the Option 1, then a reconcile action can be performed for the failed XI message after the Reason for Rejection is changed to a valid value in the document. (The message will be recreated with the correct value)-If the customer choose to perform the Option 2, then a restart action can be performed for the failed XI message after the Rejection Code is restored in the 'Reasons for Rejection' activity. (The Reason for Rejection Code will be valid again in the system)-Note: The option 2 can only be a applied if a Default Reason for Rejection Code was deleted in the system. If a custom Reason for Rejection Code was deleted in the system, then only the Option 1 would be applicable as a custom Reason for Rejection Code can no longer be restored.-Keywords-cancellation reason, is not valid, valid, items, reason for rejection, sales order, process communication error, backend

Title: Error when deleting Patch Solution from SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You are trying to delete a Patch Solution from SAP Cloud Applications Studio and it is failing with the following error message:-Phase Transition from IMP_TMPL to DISCARD not allowed in Project Type ONE_OFF.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer -SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Reproducing the Issue-1. Log on SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-2. Right click on the solution's name.-3. Click on Delete.-4. You get the error message: Phase Transition from IMP_TMPL to DISCARD not allowed in Project Type ONE_OFF.-Cause-The movement from Import to Discard phase of any solution is not allowed. You should not try to delete solutions you just uploaded, it won't work.-Resolution-If somehow you imported a solution you did not want to and now you need to delete it, first activate this solution, then you will be able to delete it without issues.-Keywords-PDI; Delete; Deletion; SDK;

Title: Supplier Field is Empty in Sales Order Volume Report
Content: Symptom-You would like to view the Ship-From maintained in the Sales Order within the Sales Order Volume report, however, the Supplier field which is expected to show this value is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Lists sub-view.-Select and open the Sales Order Volume report.-Add the Sales Orders ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Enter Row field Supplier.-Despite having a Ship-From maintained at the item level, the data is not reflecting within the report under the Supplier field. --Cause-Both scenarios below are applicable to the item having an Internal or External fulfillment. -If the Sales Order line item is cancelled and the delivery status as Not Started, no value will be displayed in the Supplier field of the report.-In case the line item Delivery Status is In Process and the item is cancelled, then the Supplier field will be maintained.-Should the Delivery Status be In Process and the item not cancelled, the Supplier field will be maintained.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-2968849 - Ship-From Field is Not Available in Sales Order Volume Report-2464702 - Ship-From Field not Showing Value for Sales Order -Keywords-Ship-From, Report, Field, Not Available, Sales Order Volume Report, Fulfillment, Cancelled, Missing, Value

Title: System Continuously Marks the E-Mail Invalid Checkbox in the Account Master Data
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a marketing campaign and notices that the system is raising error message "E-mail address invalid" for one of the accounts involved. This is because, in the account's master data, the checkbox E-Mail Invalid is marked in the Communication tab.-However, even after you unmark this box and save, this is getting marked again by an SAP technical user and you would like to understand why.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Access the Accounts work center view. -Locate the relevant account in the object worklist and select it.-Click the Edit button, then select Addresses-In the new screen, right below the E-Mail field, the E-Mail Invalid box is marked.-Unmark this box and click Save (or Save and Close).-After some time, you notice that the box is marked again.-Checking in the Changes tab, you can see that change was done by technical user SAP_SMTP_IN.-Cause-This is the expected behavior.-If the e-mail address in the account master data was already used in a direct e-mail campaign, but the e-mail server returned a delivery status notification (DSN) that the e-mail could not be delivered, the system will automatically check the E-Mail Invalid box in the master data.-Resolution-Kindly double-check if the e-mail address is correct or use a different e-mail address to which campaign e-mails can be successfully delivered.-See Also-Create and Execute a Direct E-Mail Campaign, in SAP Help Portal.-Keywords-E-Mail Invalid, Checkbox, System, SAP_SMTP_IN, Account, Master Data

Title: No Contact Person Information Can be Found
Content: Symptom-You found that there is no contact information of ship to address in printed delivery note for third party scenario or Third Party inter company scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for the outbound delivery XXX.-Choose Preview - Preview button, then you found there is no contact information of ship to address in the delivery note.-Cause-For third party scenario or Third Party inter company scenario, node <ContactPerson> doesn't exist under Node <BuyerParty> or <ProductRecipientParty> in view data xml of standard outbound delivery, even if the main contact had been maintained in the master data.-Resolution-It's a known missing functionality. Our development team would fix the issue in future release.-See Also-Contact, Ship to, Delivery Note, ContactPerson

Title: No report data available to display; check the selection
Content: Symptom-You have personalized Gross profit and Net profit Tiles in Launchpad and the report displaying an error message No report data available to display; check the selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Start Personalization Mode.-Click Add Tile -> KPI.-Select Gross Profit and Net Revenue.-Click Apply.-5.Click Save.-Stop personalization mode.-Click in the gross profit and click analyze data you will see the message saying:No report data available to display; check the selection.-Cause-The Contribution margin scheme is not maintained for the set of books ABC(where ABC represents the Company ID).-Resolution-To add the Contribution Margin Scheme to the Set of Books:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find the Set of Books activity.-Under the activity, select the Set of Books XYZ (where XYZ represents the Set of Books ID).-Select the Company ABC (where ABC represents the Company ID).-Click the Edit button.-Open the Company Settings tab.-Show the drop down menu for Margin Contribution Scheme.-Select the Margin Contribution Scheme value.-Select Save.-Run the report again.-Keywords- No report data available to display; check the selection

Title: Supplier Invoices are Pending in "Posted Documents with Missing Delivery" List
Content: Symptom-Supplier invoices have recipient reference (inbound delivery/GSR), but they are pending in Supplier Invoicing work center->Documents to Be Processed->Posted Documents with Missing Delivery. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Documents to Be Processed view.-Select "Posted Documents with Missing Delivery" from the dropdown list.-Open a supplier invoice among the list. It has been referred to an inbound delivery/goods and services receipt.-Cause-Stuck tasks that can be solved in frontend.-Resolution-Open the issued supplier invoice. -Navigate to Exceptions Tab.-Click on "Remove posted document from missing delivery" button.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Missing Delivery; Documents to Be Processed

Title: How to generate purchase order outputs via backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Purchase order output is not generated even if the order is in sent status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Open the affected purchase order and navigate to Output History tab.-Although the order is in sent status, there is no Created PO/Changed PO output records can be found there.-Resolution-Method to trigger purchase order outputs in backend:-T-code: SE38-Open report: ZME1_PO_CREATE_DOR_OUTPUT (Z-report attached)-PO_UUID: Here enter the Node ID of affected purchase order-S_PO_FTG: Here enter S01 for Created PO template and S02 for Changed PO template-Keywords-Created PO template, Changed PO template, purchase order output, output history, output not generated, output not created

Title: Peppol Integration Scenario Generates Inconsistencies
Content: Symptom-The number of decimals displayed for Tax Amount within the outgoing message from the Peppol shows 6 decimal places instead of 2.-Thus you would like to know if there is any feature that allows you to change the number of decimals used in invoices in SAP Business ByDesign and be able to update the schematron validation of the outgoing invoices to Peppol.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Cause-There is no provision or feature which allows the change/update of the number of decimal places for outgoing Peppol xml payload in SAP Business ByDesign.-Also, updating the XML while using Peppol service is not possible.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Number of decimal places for percentage (Peppol BIS Billing) is as per standard Peppol document and there is no restriction on number of decimals for percentages.-Keywords-Peppol, Decimals, Tax, Amount, Schematron, Invoice, XML, Payload

Title: Unable to Approve Outgoing Payments Due to Number of Items
Content: Symptom-System times out upon approving a payment task.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Highlight the task Approve Supplier Payment <payment ID> - <company ID/Name> - <Supplier> - <amount and currency>.-Click Approve.-After some time, you receive a system crash.-Cause-The payment you are trying to approve has too many invoices, hence the system times out upon approval. As a symptom of such issues, the system would usually hang for some time before raising the Unexpected error during backend processing dialog.-Resolution-In such scenario, you usually can execute a payment with 500 - 600 invoices. This number fluctuates depending upon the available resources and on what other system activities are performed at this time, which background jobs are running, your local internet connection, etc. For this reason, the data set size may vary.-You can split and perform this specific payment manually. Another option is to switch off the approval process and create the payment run for this supplier with the option Execute payment automatically. In this way the payments are created in the background and, after the run, the payment appear on the Payment Monitor in the status Ready For Transfer.-See Also-2063785 - How to Set Up Approval Process for Payments

Title: Error "Currently Unable to Finalize These Scope Changes; Some of Your Decisions Would Cause Inconsistencies in Your Fine-Tuning Settings or The Productive Data." During Finish Project
Content: Symptom-The Integration with SuccessFactors has been scoped in Business Configuration and now you want to descope the setting "Integration of Employee Data From External Application to Cloud Solution". However, an error message is displayed when trying to confirm the changes:-Error During Finish Project-Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data.-If error messages are displayed, resolve then before you proceed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select a change project and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to step 3. Scoping.-Expand Human Resources > Personnel Administration.-Uncheck the scoping element Integration of Employee Data from External Application to Cloud Solution.-Go to step 4. Questions.-Expand Communication and Information Exchange > Integration with External Applications and Solutions > Integration Scenarios for Cloud Solutions from SAP.-Under Group: Integration with SuccessFactors Employee Central, you will see that the scoping question "You can integrate your solution with SuccessFactors Employee Central" is unchecked.-Expand Integration of Master Data.-Under Group: Group: Employee Data, you will see that the scoping question "Do you want to replicate employee data from an external application to your cloud solution?" is unchecked.-Try to confirm the changes and you will see the error message.-Cause-The reason why you are seeing this error is because there is a check implemented to maintain consistency between SuccessFactors and Business ByDesign. Descoping will not be allowed if you have successful replication requests between these two systems.-Resolution-The best way to restore the system to the pre-integration state is to create a service request from the Service Control Center Work Center to restore the system to its previous restoration point, when the integration was not scoped.-You can check if there is an active restoration point created in the Service Control Center Work Center, because it is only possible to rollback the tenant to a restore point if it is created accordingly.-Also, it is possible to terminate the tenant and request a new tenant from Service Control Center Work Center, if it is a test tenant.-See Also-2560598 - How to Request Restore/Rollback to Restore Point?-2798983 - How to check if the restore point exists for a tenant-1941544 - How to Delete or Terminate a Test System?-2136036 - How to request a New Tenant for SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer from Service Control Center-Keywords-integration with successfactors, descope, integration of employee data from external application to cloud solution, employee central

Title: Automatic Allocation of Incoming Payment Advices in Bank Statements (MT940 UK)
Content: Symptom-Payment Advices are generated in SAP ByDesign. These are to be automatically confirmed via processing of an automatic bank statement, e.g. format MT940 UK.-Although the Advice ID is reflected in the memo-text of a bank statement transaction, an automatic allocation does not happen.  Affected allocations have to be manually processed and candidate remittance advices have to be allocated manually in tab Payment Confirmations/Returns.-The expectation is that the external Advice ID shown in bank statement transaction memo (tag :86:) should facilitate an automated allocation without post-processing via setting up suitable Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can access relevant payment allocation(s) either in:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant Payment Allocation in status In Preparation.-or via the posted bank statement:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Open the Bank Statements view.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and Edit.-Follow the Postprocessing: Required link to access the relevant payment allocation.-Cause-The Document ID referenced in the bank statement transaction header (tag :61:) determines if and how an incoming payment advice/remmittance advice can be allocated - and the Payment Allocation posted automatically.-The prerequisites to enable an automatic allocation when posting an automatic bank statement are as follows:-Payment Advice ID = External Reference in Payment Allocation.-Payment Advice ID is identical to Payment Reference in Remittance Advice.-Advice ID has to be perpetuated 1:1 in transaction header :61: after the External Transaction Code (e.g. 'FFPC' for MT940 UK).-Depending on specifications of your house-bank the digits for the document identifier in transaction header (tag :61:) might be restricted and consequently the Advice ID will be truncated in the bank statement.-Example:-Advice ID and the Payment reference show as: A88888888-88888888-In the statement-line (:61:) the document-reference is truncated and shows as  88888888-8888888- An automatic allocation according to described prerequisites is not possible and then has to be effected manually.-Using Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines identifying payment advices as depicted in transaction memo (tag :86:) - is not an option to identify payment advices (externally generated payments).-This is a system-definition.-Resolution-Numbering convention for payment advices should be made consistent with specifications for bank-statements issued by the house-bank.-A possible workaround would be the modification of the content of the Payment Advice field Payment Reference - which is also used to identify a candidate transactions.-The purpose of the Payment Reference is to enter a value known to the house-bank - and later used by the bank to confirm the payment.-Since the Document ID in the Statement-Line (:61:) is truncated (e.g.: 88888888-8888888) - this string would have to be filled as Payment Reference during the advice creation upfront.-

Title: Central Knowledge Base Article for PSM Requests
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This is the Central Knowledge Base Article for a PSM Request (Public Solution Model). PSM Requests are handled by the concerned Application Area.-The Public Solution Model (PSM) is the released business content of the SAP Cloud Solution. You can access and use it in the SAP Cloud Application Studio (SDK).-The different published content types are Business Objects, Business Configuration Objects, Data Types, Form Message Types, Object Value Selectors, Embedded Components, UI Inports, UI Outports, Business Configuration Entities, Web Services etc.-In some cases the object may say released, but the box for Write Access is not checked. This means the customer can use this object, but as read-only. (i.e. they cannot add their own values to it.-Information the Partner must provide for PSM requests: 2455548 - Information Required for PSM Release Requests-PSM In MDRS (to check in the Repository Explorer): 2581671 - How to check Extensibility and Public Solution Model details about BO, Node and Element-PSM Release of a BO / Node: 1757585 - How to Handle Public Solution Model (PSM) Issues.-PSM Release of a UI Anchor: 2373508 - PSM Request for a UI anchor-PSM Release of a Business Option Anchor: 2359584 - Anchor Not visible While Creating BAC Element in SDK-How to Search for a Business Object in MDRS: 2373877 - How to Search for a Business Object in MDRS -How to troubleshoot technical AP_ESI_COMMON 107 error - 2424439 - How to Troubleshoot The Error: Technical Error AP_ESI_COMMON 107  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Based on one of the above scenario, action can be taken by Support Engineer:-1. Closing the incident if the PSM released indicator is not set or;-2. Sending to the respective application team based on the Business Object Package details.-Keywords-PSM, Request, Release, MDRS, Repository Explorer, Cloud Application Studio, SDK

Title: The Sales Quote is Not Getting Completed Automatically
Content: Symptom-You have created a follow-up sales order from the sales quote ABC, but the quote is not changed to Completed status automatically.-(ABC represents the ID of the sales quote)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center New Business.-Go to the view Sales Quotes.-Edit the sales quote ABC, in the Document Flow tab, you can see there is a sales order created out of the quote.-But the status of this sales quote is still In Process instead of Completed.-Cause-The quote is partially referenced to a sales order not fully. Hence it is still In Process.-There are 2 lines in the quote while only one line is referenced in the follow-up sales order. You might deleted this line from the order and hence, the quote is partially referenced.-To explain this in an Example:-You created Sales Quote ABC with Line Item XX and a Quantity of 10 ea (XX represents the Line Item number). -You create a follow-up Sales Order with Line Item XX. -In the Sales Order the Quantity of 10 ea from the Sales Quote is suggested for Line Item XX.-You change the Quantity to 3 ea and save the Sales Order. -Open the Sales Quote ABC and navigate to the Items tab.-Select Line Item XX. -In the Quantity field you can see that the value is 10 ea. -In the Ordered Quantity field you can see that the value is 3 ea (if you do not see this field you can add it via Personalization or Adaptation).-This field is update from the Quantity maintained in the follow-up Sales Order. -The Sale Quote Item is completed if the Ordered Quantity has the same or a greater value than the Quantity. -Resolution-The quote is completed if it is fully rejected, or fully referenced to sales orders. The quantity offered is equal or less than the ordered quantity.-You are create a new sales order and reference to the remaining quote line(s) or manually change the status to Completed status.-See Also-Online help document:Sales Quotes Quick Guide-Keywords-Sales Quote; Completed; Life Cycle status

Title: Unable to Order Purchase Order Because Of Dump
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -User is unable to order the purchase order due to dump. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search XYZ (XYZ refers to Purchase Order ID).-Click in Edit button.-Click in Order button.-It is triggered a dump (error 500).-When checking in the backend, transaction ST22, you see the information below: -{-Active Calls-26 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003 6-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-25 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001 2-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-24 FUNCTION /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDH /SRMAP/LFND_PDHU34 42-/SRMAP/FND_PD_ABORT-23 METHOD /SRMAP/CL_FND_LOG=============CP /SRMAP/CL_FND_LOG=============CM001 6-/SRMAP/CL_FND_LOG=>ADD_MSG-22 METHOD /SRMAP/CM_FND_MESSAGES========CP /SRMAP/CM_FND_MESSAGES========CM005-/SRMAP/CM_FND_MESSAGES=>ADD_TO_LOG-21 METHOD /SRMAP/CM_FND_MESSAGES========CP /SRMAP/CM_FND_MESSAGES========CM006 27-/SRMAP/CM_FND_MESSAGES=>CREATE_MESSAGE_GEN-20 METHOD /SRMAP/CM_LPUR_PO_SP==========CP /SRMAP/CM_LPUR_PO_SP==========CM003 2-/SRMAP/CM_LPUR_PO_SP=>CREATE_MESSAGE-19 METHOD /SRMAP/CL_FND_PAF_OPA=========CP /SRMAP/CL_FND_PAF_OPA=========CM00T 14-/SRMAP/CL_FND_PAF_OPA=>GET_REMOTE_PC-18 METHOD /SRMAP/CL_FND_PAF_OPA=========CP /SRMAP/CL_FND_PAF_OPA=========CM003 44-/SRMAP/CL_FND_PAF_OPA=>IF_SPAF_OUTB_PROCESS_AGENT~DETERMINE_RESPONSIBILITY-17 METHOD CL_SPAF_OUTB_PA_CONTROLLER====CP CL_SPAF_OUTB_PA_CONTROLLER====CM00H 17-CL_SPAF_OUTB_PA_CONTROLLER=>IF_SPAF_OUTB_ASYNC_CONTROLLER~RUN_AGENT-16 METHOD CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CP CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CM00D 7-Dump will occur in the class /SRMAP/CL_FND_PAF_OPA. Method is : GET_REMOTE_PC-Click on it and you will see that "no valid communication arrangement found".-}-Cause-The dump can occur because there is no valid communication arrangement maintained for the Supplier and Company combination. Due to this, there will be unprocessed messages at the backend between Supplier Invoicing and Purchase Order Business Objects.-Note: The above cause not applicable if the Company and Supplier are sister companies as they don't need special arrangement (they already exist in same entity and are two companies in ByDesign).-Resolution-After checking if the Supplier and Company are sisters or not, please send one of the resolutions below, according to customer's needs:-A) In case the Supplier and Buying Company are not sisters-Kindly inform the customer to maintain the valid Communication Arrangement for the Supplier and the Company. The steps to maintain communication arrangement in the system are showed below:-Go to Appplication and User Management work center.-Go to Communication Arrangement view.-Click in New button.-Maintain the Communication Arrangement.-B) In case the Supplier and Buying Company are sisters: -Please ask them to follow below blog and ensure that all pre-requisites are met.-Blog: SAP Business ByDesign Intercompany Process Automation-See Also-Blog: SAP Business ByDesign Intercompany Process Automation-Keywords-Dump; Error 500; Purchase Order; Communication Arrangement; Supplier; Company; ST22; Backend

Title: Error "The UOM Already Exists, Enter a New Code Value"
Content: Symptom-You are setting Units of Measure in the System, the error appears.-The UOM already exists, enter a new code Value.-  Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Implementation Projects.-Open Activity list.-Go to Fine Tune Tab.-Open Activity Quantities and Units of Measure.-Enter Unit of Measure-Cause-The message will appears if you are creating more than one at a time or creating the Unit with the same code.-Resolution-To avoid this error message, please Add a row with the code that starts with Z, not copying from the above one. After completing the Unit, press save and then go to the second line.-The idea is always to add a row and then press enter after complete the same, so the system will trigger if the code is already existing or not, after that you can proceed to the next one.-Keywords-Business Configuration, UOM, Physical Measure Units

Title: Unable to Assign Certain Roles To a Business Partner
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a business partner with a certain role, the option required is unavailable for selection.-Or-It is not possible to assign an Employee as a Supplier from the Business Partner Data work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partner Data work center;-Access the Business Partners view;-Select an existing business partner;-Click the Create As button;-Some options are unavailable.-Cause-The system has two main Business Partner types: organizations (which represent companies) and persons (which represent individuals). Certain roles are exclusive to business partner organizations and others, exclusive to business partner persons, for example, an Employee cannot have the Supplier role assigned to it, because the Employee is a business partner person and the Supplier role is for business partner organizations.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-Help Portal Document: Business Partners-Keywords-Business Partner; Roles; Create As; Business Partner Data; Employee, Supplier

Title: Filter on Custom Data Source using Month element returns Error or Incorrect Results
Content: Symptom-You have a Custom Data Source with a an element of data type Month. When trying to filter by this element on the Data Source you get incorrect results or see the below errors:-"Value ABC not valid for variable XYZ"-"Check your variable selections"-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have a Custom or Extension Business Object.-You have created a Custom element of data type Month.-You have created a Custom or Extension Data Source for the Business Object.-Steps to reproduce:-Open View Design Data Sources under Business Analytics Work Center.-Search fro your Custom Data Source.-Click Preview.-Enter a value (for example, 6, 06, 0006) for the Month element.-Cause-The data type Month has a maximum character limit of four characters. When searching in the Data Source, the system expects a basic number (1 through 12). The Data Source then converts the value to four characters by appending "--0" or "--" in the case of 10, 11, 12.-Also an issue with another data type YearMonth - it will raise a similar error when querying through data source.-The data type YearMonth has a maximum character limit of 7 with format YYYY-MM. Any other format will prevent effective querying by this element.-Resolution-You need to store the variable as the converted value (for example, --06) in the back end and use the basic number (for example, 6) in the Data Source filter. This is how the Month data type works in conjunction with Data Sources.-The other option would be to use another data type.-See Also-See SAP Knowledge Based Articles:-2535152 - Inconsistencies in Report Selections / Filters in Custom Reports-2679456 - Report Filters Not Working: Value Not Valid For Variable-2534002 - Filtering a Report Throws Error Message 'Value not Valid for Variable'-2541093 - Error in embedded report: Value not Valid for Variable-Keywords-PDI, SDK, datasource, datatype, design, report, analytics, APC_V_MONTH

Title: Error Message: For Withholding Tax Returns - File 26Q the Permanent Account Number is Expected
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error message while adding New Tax Authority.-For Withholding Tax Returns - File 26Q the Permanent Account Number is expected-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the the Tax Authorities view.-Select New -> Tax Authority and maintain all necessary information.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Select the Add Row button and maintain Company, Valid From/To.-Go to Tax Return Arrangements and select the Add Row button-Enter Tax Return Arrangement ID:TDS_RETURN, Tax Return Type:4 - Withholding Tax Returns - File 26Q-You can see the error message: For Withholding Tax Returns - File 26Q the Permanent Account Number is expected-Cause-The cause of the issue is that you have not maintained the valid Permanant Acocunt Number and not assigned to the respective Tax Reporting Unit.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the the Tax Authorities view.-Select New -> Tax Authority and maintain all necessary information.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Select the Add Row button and maintain Company, Valid From/To.-Go to Tax Return Arrangements and select the Add Row button-Enter Tax Return Arrangement ID:TDS_RETURN, Tax Return Type:4 - Withholding Tax Returns - File 26Q-Go to Tax Numbers Tab and select the Add Row button.-Enter Tax Number Type: 7 - Permanent Account Number and enter a valid PAN number.-Go to Assigned Tax reporting Units tab and Assign the respective unit.-Click on Save tab.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Returns - File 26Q, Permanent Account Number is Expected,Withholding Tax Returns

Title: Ship-From Field not Showing Value for Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Ship-From field in the line item is blank for some sales orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID).-Edit the sales order and navigate to the Items tab.-In line items the field Ship-From is not showing any value. -Cause-Fulfilment for this sales order is External and therefore the value is available in the Supplier field rather than in the Ship-From field. -Resolution-This is a standard system behavior. -See Also-3461366 - Supplier Field is Empty in Sales Order Volume Report-2968849 - Ship-From Field is Not Available in Sales Order Volume Report-Keywords-Sales Order, Supplier, Ship-From, Missing

Title: Download of Crystal Reports
Content: Symptom-You are not able to open e.g. the report FINGLAU04_Q0002_CR-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics-2. Go to Design Reports-3. Open formatted report e.g. FINGLAU04_Q0002_CR-4. You are not able to open the report.-Cause-Formatted reports are based on Crystal reports.-If you want to edit a formatted report, there is a SAP Add-In for Crystal Reports which requires the license of Crystal Reports and if you just want to view the formatted report the license free Crystal Reports Viewer-Resolution-1. SAP Add-In for Crystal Reports-The prerequisite for the installation to work is that Crystal Report 2016 is installed. Checks are carried out to verify this.-The missing files can be found under-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/softwarecenter/object/0030000001382112018-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/softwarecenter/search/BIPSDKRT42O06-and-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/softwarecenter/object/0030000001371092018-Please note that these must be downloaded with the S-User, unzipped and run in administrator mode.-It must be the 32Bit version if shown in the popup and please ensure that the firewall and virusscanner is deactivated.-2. Crystal Reports Viewer-The viewer can be found at-https://www.sap.com/products/crystal-reports-viewer.html--Note : CR is no more supported by ByD System-Keywords-crystal reports, download, viewer, SAP Add-In for Crystal Reports,

Title: How is the GL Account Derived When the Business Residence is Sales Unit?
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order, a follow up Goods and Activity Confirmation(GAC) and the G/L Accounts of Journal Entry related to GAC is picked up as per Account Determination Group(ADG) under Inventories.-You have later changed the ADG on the Material and have created a Sales order, a GAC but the G/L Accounts that are considered does not change.-You want to know the logic on how the G/L Accounts are dervied in the Journal Entry created for GAC created as a follow up of Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find the Sales Order ID.-Select the Sales OrderID and Choose Edit.-Choose View All.-Go to the Document Flow.-You can see the Goods and Activity Confirmation and the Journal Entry Created.-Resolution-The Account Determination Group that is fetched for the G/L Accounts considered in Journal Entry for Goods and Activity Confirmation is as follows:--Journal Entry Item 1:-This is an Inventory item and is posted to G/L Account configured under Account Determination Group which is maintained in Material Master Data under the Valuation tab for the Combination of Company and Business Residence.--Journal Entry Item 2:-The system takes into consideration of this Business Residence via the following Logic:-The Business Residence for this Journal Entry Item is derived from the Business Residence of the Sales Unit.-You can check the Involved Parties tab in Sales order-You will get to know the Sales unit.
