When you check this Sales Unit, you will get to know the Business Residence that is associated with the Sales unit- -So, When you check this Combination of Company and Business Residence in Material Master Data then the ADG is determined and the GL Account maintained under Material Consumption against this ADG will be derived.-Keywords-G/L Account Derivation, Sales Unit, Business Residence

Title: Ship-From Field is Not Available in Sales Order Volume Report
Content: Symptom-You are running the Sales Order Volume Report, and you want to add the field Ship-From, however, this field is not available to be added.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for: Sales Order Volume Report.-Run the Report.-Select the View option-Click on plus signal (+) in Row Fields to search for the fields to be added.-Search for Ship-From.-Nothing appears. -Cause-This is the expected behavior.-Ship-From in the Sales Order Volume Report can be made visible by adding the Supplier party.-Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for: Sales Order Volume Report.-Run the Report.-Select the View option-Click on plus signal (+) in Row Fields to search for the fields to add.-Search for Supplier.-You will be able to add this as a party.-See Also-2464702 - Ship-From Field not Showing Value for Sales Order-3461366 - Supplier Field is Empty in Sales Order Volume Report-Keywords-Sales Order Volume, Ship-From, Supplier

Title: The System throws an exception or does not reflects latest changes when editing a Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-While editing a communication arrangement which has been created for a communication scenario (.csd) within an add-on from the Cloud Applications Studio, you notice that the latest changes done to the .csd are not reflected into the user interface or a dump / unhandled exception happens.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-In Cloud for Customer:-Go to Administration work center.-Open General Settings view.-Click on Communication Arrangements.-Edit the affected artifact.-In Business ByDesign:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Click on Communication Arrangements.-Edit the affected artifact.-Cause-This problem happens if a service is removed or added from a communication scenario definition (.csd) and the same is not updated in the communication arrangement.-Resolution-Whenever a service is added or removed from the .csd file after the communication arrangement is created, the communication arrangement must be deleted and re-created to get the latest changes.-Keywords-error, PDI, .CSD, SDK

Title: Material Cost Does Not Change after Migration
Content: Symptom-You input cost as zero in migration of material valuation data. However, material cost does not change to zero after migration execution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Maintain the cost as zero for material XYZ (XYZ means the Material ID) in the migration template of material valuation data.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List.-Go to Integrate & Extend.-Select Migration of Material Valuation Data.-Select Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool.-Execute the migration.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center, view Master Data and sub view Material Unit Cost.-Search for material XYZ, you can see the cost is not zero.-Cause-In the cost history of material XYZ, you can see that there was manual change of cost done. With it, migration of material valuation data will not change the cost.-System works as designed.-To view material cost history, please follow steps here.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center, view Master Data and sub view Material Unit Cost.-Search for material XYZ, and select View Cost History.-Resolution-If you want to change the material cost to zero, change it manually again.-Keywords-Material Cost Migration

Title: How to Handle Public Solution Model (PSM) Issues. INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-Customer requests for read/write access for a particular BO.-The customer needs to check below mentioned information with the partner and then send the incident to the relevant application component.-In case partner need to access SAP Business ByDesign business content which is not yet released for consumption via the Public Solution Model (PSM), he can request this business content to be released.-Please check the below prerequisite that support should adhere:- Check the use case of customer solution, and what he is trying to achieve (what is the purpose of your development/solution)- Check the required business content / entities to be released in PSM, and why they are needed.- In case he requires business content like fields of a business object from a UI screen, request him to provide a screenshot of that UI screen and mark which UI elements shall be enabled for read-access and write access.- Please gather contact information like e-mail address and telephone number so that SAP can easily get back to you in case of questions.- As this is new development request priority very high is not justified.-Once we receive this information we need to check application component for the particular BO.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to backend of any LEAP or SME system.-Go to transaction MDRS.-Search for the BO - requested for write or read enablement.-Select the Metadata Repository tool.-Select object type Business Object in the first input field.-Enter the Business Object technical name in the second input field or press the down arrow to get a search mask.  For example, search with ES Name - Material.-Double-click the business object in the left pane.-The business object details are displayed on the right pane.-Select Overview.-Go to Public Solution Model. Check the release status.- 11. Double-click the package name in the General Data section.-12. The application component is displayed on the package's Properties.-Resolution-PSM requests must be handled by the application component responsible for the affected BO.-Please note: In case, EP is requested for a Test partner development system, cross check with the customer if they need this correction to be deployed to their other systems, meaning Test or Production systems.-Keywords-How to Handle Public Solution Model (PSM) Issues, PSM requests must be handled by the application component

Title: Account determination missing for item type Historical Costs: Current Year
Content: Symptom-Customer reports following error while running the Lease Posting Run ID XYZ (XYZ represents Lease Posting Run ID)-Error: Account determination missing for item type Historical Costs: Current Year.-Error: Other valuation items related to lease contract AA cannot be processed (AA represents contract ID).-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Select the view Lease Contract Posting Run.-Select the Run ID XYZ.-Select the Processing Status "Error" under the Execution Details section.-Click View.-Go to the tab Messages.-Error: Account determination missing for item type Historical Costs: Current Year.-Error: Other valuation items related to lease contract ZZ cannot be processed.-Cause-G/L account is missing in Historical Cost of the Account Determination Group of corresponding ROU Class ZZZ (ZZZ represents Right-of-Use Asset Class)-Resolution-You need to identify the Account Determination Group from the related Right Of Use Asset.-Open the contract AA.-Go to the Leased Objects tab and identify the Right of Use Asset ID.-Open the Right of Use Asset.-Identify the Account Determination associated.-Maintain the Historical Cost of the Account Determination Group:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Search and find the activity: Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select Fixed Assets under Account Determination.-Select the correct Account Determination Profile.-Go to the Historical Cost tab.-Select Add Row button and Maintain a Historical Cost account for your Account Determination Group.-Keywords-IFRS16, Lease Posting Run, Historical Costs, Lease Type, Account Determination

Title: Error "Value in Setting Region Must Also be Entered in Setting Region."
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to delete some of the system delivered Regions in Business Configuration. But you receive the error:-Error: Value XX in setting Region must also be entered in setting Region (where XX represents the Region)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Regions-Select the required Region XX (where XX represents the Region)-Choose Remove button-System throws error-Cause-It is not possible to delete the system delivered Regions from Business Configuration.-Resolution-This is the system behaviour.-Keywords-Delete Regions, Value in setting Region must also be entered in setting Region

Title: Dump when assigning a value to an extension field of type DecimalValue
Content: Symptom-You observe a dump with either the below error:-Overflow in the operation-Overflow converting from X-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Attempt to save a value to a field of type Decimal value that exceeds their length.-Cause-Fields of Type 'Decimal Value' by default are restricted to 7 digits with a limit of 2 decimal places within that.-Resolution-An annotation will need to placed on the creation of the PDI extension field of type DecimalValue to allow a value greater than the default decimal value restriction.-This annotation cannot be added to the field once it has been deployed - not even through a patch. A new field will need to be created with the annotation.-In the below example, it can be see that the element num_flag is restricted to 7 digits with 2 decimal places by default where CalAmount has annotation added that allows 16 digits with 6 of those as decimal place digits.-Keywords-Overflow in the operation, Extension Field, dump, SDK, PDI

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement For Cash Balance Amount
Content: Symptom-You have executed the Foreign Currency Remeasurement For Cash and the balance amount is showing as XXX (XXX implies amount) which is not as expected and not matching with Cash - Trial Balance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Click Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash view.-Select the Run and click view.-Navigate to the tab Remeasured Balances.-Balance Amount is showing as XXX.-Cause-Filter the Cash - Trial Balance with exact selection criteria of Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash in order to compare and check the balances.-Resolution-To Crosscheck the balances, proceed as follows:-From the Cash - Trial Balance, bring in the Key figures Ending Balance Line Item Currency and Ending Balance Company Currency as the Foreign Currency Remeasurement (FCR) works on the line item currency.-Then match the following:-Balance Amount (FCR) -> Ending Balance Line Item Currency (Trial Balance).-Historic Valuation Amount (FCR) -> Ending Balance Company Currency (Trial Balance).-Keywords-foreign currency remeasurement for cash; fcr; remeasured balances

Title: Error: Phase Transition from POS to DISCARD not allowed in Project Type ONE_OFF While Deleting the Solution
Content: Symptom-You get below error while deleting the solution .-Phase Transition from POS to DISCARD not allowed in Project Type ONE_OFF-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Select a Solution.-Right click on the solution and select Delete Solution option.-You can see an error:-Cause-This is the design of the system. A patch solution cannot be deleted directly from the status POS (Post Processing Phase).-Resolution-To resolve this, you will need to create a new patch version and then delete the actual patch solution. With a new patch version, this will be having status "In Development" and then you can delete the patch solution properly. Please follow these steps:-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open Solution.-Click on Implementation Manager.-Click on Create Patch.-After new Patch Solution Version creation, right click on Solution.-Click on Delete.-The solution will be deleted successfully. This is the design of the system that a patch solution cannot be deleted directly from the status POS (Post Processing Phase).

Title: Information Required for PSM Release Requests for SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-If you need to access business content in SAP Business ByDesign that has not been released for consumption through the Public Solution Model (PSM), you can request SAP to release this business content.-Depending on your use case, different parts of the PSM are relevant, for example:-• ByD Add-ons using SAP Cloud Applications Studio (relevant for Partners) require, for example, public read or write access to business object components, business configuration entities, UI (User Interface) components (to enhance standard screens), and web services/interfaces (for custom communication arrangements or to add extension fields to web services or interfaces). For some requirements use case specific Exits might be required as well.--• Custom OData services (relevant for Key Users and Partners) require for example public read or write access to business object components, such as business object nodes, elements, associations, actions, action parameter, queries and query selection parameter. Additionally, business object elements need to be prepared for OData consumption.--• Custom Communication Scenarios (relevant for Key Users) require releasing the web service APIs (interface operations) that shall be included in the communication scenario.--• Key User Extensibility of Web Service APIs (relevant for Key Users) require releasing the corresponding web service API (interface operations) and to externally expose the web service extension point.--• Deep linking/External Object-based Navigation and Mashups (relevant for Key Users and Partners) require UI stable anchors including imports/outports and UI port bindings.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-When you plan a ByD Add-on or integration project using OData APIs, it is essential to understand and review the released ByD content and to identify gaps early in your project. If needed, you can ask SAP to enhance the ByD Public Solution Model by creating a ByD case with following information:-Create a case in the SAP cloud solution and use the prefix PSM. (For information on how to create a case, see here). Title with prefix “[PSM Request]” and the business object or UI screen name, for example “[PSM Request] Business Object Customer” or “[PSM Request] for Customer Accounts”-Describe the use case of your solution and what you are trying to achieve (that is, what is the purpose of your development/solution?). This information gives SAP the possibility to evaluate which PSM enhancement in detail is required.-Describe the required business content/entities to be released in PSM, and why you need them. Be as precise as you can.-If you require, for example, write access to a business content such as the fields of a business object element from a UI, provide a screenshot of that UI and highlight the elements that need to be enabled for read-access or for write-access.-Add your contact information - that is, e-mail address and telephone number - so that SAP can easily get back to you in case of questions.-Based on your information, SAP evaluates if your PSM request is feasible and which entities must be included in the PSM in detail to serve your use case. One key question is always if SAP can ensure compatibility for the requested enhancement. In some cases, refactoring might be required upfront to be able to ensure compatibility.-After we receive your PSM release request, it will take some time to evaluate your request from our side. In general, we will allow read access to PSM business objects requested as soon as relevant information is submitted via incident as described.-If the requested business content could be released, it usually will be released in the future Hotfix/Upgrade according to the development and testing time.--In the case of future release planning, SAP will ask you to submit your PSM request as an Improvement Request (IR) in the ByD Customer Influence Session. Please create the IR with the same information as provided in the ByD incident and refer to the evaluation result provided by SAP in the ByD incident response.-Also, your request might get rejected because the change/access from PDI (Partner Development Infrastructure) to requested business content is not allowed.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: About Public Solution Model-SAP Blog: SAP ByDesign Public Solution Model-Keywords-PSM, release, request, write, read, access, PDI, SDK, public, solution, model, ByD, odata, extensibility

Title: Value Missing in Replenished Quantity Field While Previewing Supply To Production Form
Content: Symptom-While previewing Supply to Production form, user observes that value for replenished quantity field is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Find required supply task ID and choose preview.-Now in form, replenished quantity field value is missing though planned quantity is filled.-Cause-In the production supply task, you can print tasks that are in the 'Not Started' status. This helps production users know what needs to be done before starting production tasks. However, the user needs to manually fill in the replenishment quantity in the print note.-Resolution-It is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Supply task, form, Production task, supply to production, preview, replenished quantity missing, value missing, production control, actual quantity, planned quantity

Title: Default Value With More Than 80 Characters is Truncated
Content: Symptom-You have created an Extension Field in a particular screen and maintained more then 80 characters in the Default Value. You noticed that a new document is created, the Default Value of this Extension Field is truncated, it shows only until 80 characters.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-Current meta model for Business Objects currently has a restriction of 80 characters for node element default values. So at this point, all values longer than that will be truncated.-Resolution-Currently, this is the expected system behavior. The SAP Business ByDesign does not support more than 80 characters as Default Value.-Keywords-Extension Field, KUT Field, Default Value, Truncated, Limitation, Limit to 80, 80, characters.

Title: The Business Partner Name Format's-Maintained Sequence is Displaying Inaccurately in The Business Partner Interface
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the Business Partner Name Format in the below sequence-2-First Name, 3-Last Name-But system still display the Business Partner (EX: Private Account) as Last Name+ First name in Accounts view.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project and select Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune chevron.-Search and open General Business Data activity.-Select Name Formats link.-Maintain Name Formats sequence as stated above.-Check in Business Partner or Account Management work center:-Go to Account Management or Business Partner Data work center.-Select Accounts view.-Maintain First Name and Last Name for an Account.-Again go to Accounts view and search for the Account.-Resolution-The Account Name in the Account view, always displays the Name in the format (Last Name + First Name). If you have changed the default format to (First Name + Last Name), then follow the below steps to display the formatted account name in the Accounts view.--1. Go to Account Management or Business Partner Data work center.-2. Select Accounts view.-3. Select a particular Account or All Accounts.-4. Select Personalize option (Top right corner of the screen) and choose This Screen.-5. Under section Sections, select Accounts and scroll down to find the field Formatted Account name under Fields section.-6. Check the Visible check box for Formatted Account name. Note: You can move the field using up/down arrow.-7. Save the changes.--Now you can able to find the Formatted Account Name in the format (First Name + Last Name),

Title: Custom Tax Code Does Not Calculate the Tax Base Amount
Content: Symptom-You are creating Tax content for a non-localized country using Localization Toolkit. You have created tax type, Tax event and Tax Codes. Now, when you see in the sales order/customer invoice for XXX tax (XXX represents the custom tax code created from Localization Toolkit), the system shows tax base amount as 0 (zero) and the system is not able to calculate tax amount. However, VAT is calculated correctly and also shows tax base amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Open the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID).-Go to the Items tab and then the Taxes tab.-Add the tax code as XXX(XXX represents the custom tax code created from Localization Toolkit) and notice that there is no Tax base amount calculated.-Cause-Currently, multiple tax type calculation is supported only for localized countries. For non-localized countries, if you are using standard tax calculation procedure, only one tax type calculation is supported and that is why in this case only for tax type VAT you could see base amount and tax amounts being calculated.-Resolution-You can look to create custom tax calculation procedure and implement the PDI badi for calculation procedure to support multiple tax type calculation.-See Also-Work Zone page: Localization Toolkit-Keywords-Custom Tax code, VAT, Sales order, Customer Invoice

Title: Total Gross Amount and Total Tax Amount Are Not Automatically Calculated in Intercompany Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-Total Gross Amount and Total Tax Amount fields in the intercompany invoices are not automatically calculated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button. -You can see that "Total Gross Amount" and "Total Tax Amount" are blank.-Cause-In intercompany scenarios, the tax are calculated based in preceding documents (such as Customer Invoices). The tax amounts are not automatically calculated for intercompany scenario because system wants to prevent any inconsistency in subsequent documents specially on Financial side.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Click in Actions button and select Calculate Total Amounts.-Now the Supplier Invoice has the fields calculated.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Intercompany; Calculate Total Amounts; Total Gross Amount; Total Tax Amount-intercompany invoices,supplier invoice,total tax amount

Title: How to activate budget check for Shopping Cart Request?
Content: Symptom-How to activate budget check for Shopping Cart Request?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self services view. -Under Shopping option, choose Go shopping to create a shopping cart request with all the relevant details.-Cause-Budget check is available only for Purchase Order creation or manual Supplier Invoice creation without reference. -Resolution-Availability of budget is checked at Purchase Order creation or manual Supplier Invoice creation without reference. System checks the available budget at the time of Purchase Order release, approval, or change after release. Similar checks are in place for the Supplier Invoice without a reference to a Purchase Order. It checks the anticipated to be spent amount on the Purchase Order against the respective available budgets. If the amount in the purchase order (item) exceeds the available budget, the purchase order can't be released.-  While, Budget check cannot be performed while creating a Shopping Cart request. -Activating the scoping question, "Active Budget Control" function will not help to do the budget check for shopping cart, as this functionality is not available. -See Also-Active Budget Control | SAP Help Portal-Active Budget Control in Supplier Relationship Management | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Budget check for Shopping cart, activate budget check , shopping cart

Title: Error in Goods Receipt: Recipient not found or Requester not found
Content: Symptom-You have submitted a project related time entry which has in turn created a Goods and Services Receipt but you are unable to post the goods receipt document.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center-Select view Receipts and Returns view-Select Show by Documents-Search for the respective Goods Receipt document-It is in status "In Preparation"-Select Check-Error: Recipient not found/ Requester not found-Cause-The (requester/recipient)employee ID was changed from A(old employee id) to B(new employee id) before the goods receipt document was posted. Hence it has created an inconsistency in backend and system is throwing the error.-Resolution-Please ensure to post all the relevant documents before making any master data changes.-For current document in error where no further actions can be taken from front end, you can raise an incident to SAP for backend correction.-Keywords-Recipient not found, Requester not found, goods receipt cannot be posted, goods receipt cancellation document cannot be posted or deleted, GSR cannot be posted, GSR in preparation

Title: Analyze issues on component SRD-CC-WEK

Title: Approver name is different in Approval tab compared to the actual Person Responsible for the Shopping cart Approval task
Content: Symptom-You have set up an approval process for shopping cart or purchase order or supplier invoice. System has correctly determined the approvers based on the approval process , however, after approval, you can see a different user in the Approval tab of the respective document.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select Self Services Overview-Open the respective shopping cart-In Approvals tab, approver is a different person-Cause-The system has determined the approvers correctly , but approval was manually completed by another user who has the necessary rights to take action on that approval task. Hence, under Approvals tab, the system is showing the name of the person who has completed the task.-Resolution-If the person responsible for the task takes action on the approval task, then the system will show that person's name in the Approvals tab.-That means, whoever takes action on the task, his/her name will appear in the Approvals tab after the task is completed.-Keywords-approvals, approver name different in approvals tab, approval task, person responsible is different in shopping cart, purchase order approval, supplier invoice approval, shopping cart approval

Title: Error"Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL ONLY-When the user attempts to terminate the employee 'ABC' with a termination date of DD.MM.YYYY, an error occurs stating "Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Regular Tasks view and select India -Click Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Select employee ABC.-Enter date as DD.MM.YYYY-Save (or Save and Close) button.-The error message will be displayed- Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times-Cause-User would have created a manual entries for time accounts(Vacation, Sick leave and Casual Leave). So after creating they deleted the same entries again. These manual adjustments will get stored in Time Account Maintenance Request BO. These time accounts will have a carry forward in the end of a year. These records get deleted in Time account maintenance request but not in the child node where the these carry forwards records will get stored.-Resolution-There are records in the child node: period end processing request, So because of these records it is not allowing to terminate the employee.-Get Customer permission and send the Incident to Development team SRD-HR-PAD to do backend correction.-Keywords-Cannot Delimit Time File Validity, Terminate Relationship, Cancel times, Employee Times Exist

Title: User is Still Able to View Documents Assigned to Other Organizations
Content: Symptom-The access restriction was performed for some users, which would allow them to view only documents from a set of organization units, however, when the user logs into the system, they are able to view documents created for organization units which are restricted. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Business User).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Work Center and View Assignments tab.-Expand CRM_WOC_SALESORDERS.-Select CRM_RETURNS.-Make as Restricted for Read and Write.--Under the Detailed Restriction subtab.-Mark the following Access Group IDs as Read and Write Access.-HIJ and MNO (HIJ and MNO represent the IDs of the Organization Unit).--Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Return).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Sales Unit assigned: HIJ (unit not assigned to the user).-Cause-The reason the user is still able to view documents that belongs to the organization units which have been restricted during the assignment is because the organization unit was not assigned to a manager. -When an organizational unit is not assigned to a manager, for the access control list, the unit does not have an owner, causing it to remain with a shared ownership and allowing any user to have access to it or to documents created from such units.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -In order to solve this, please assign a responsible for each organization unit being used in the sales process.-Once this is fulfilled, the users with a set of restrictions will only be able to view documents which fall within the managers ownership.-See Also-2770652 - Access Restriction for Business User is not Working as Expected-Keywords-Return, Access, Restriction, User, Business User, Work Center, View, Work Center and View Assignments, Business Users, CRM_WOC_SALESORDERS, CRM_RETURNS_SERVICE

Title: Delivery Schedule Updated in the Purchase Order is Not Carried into the Intercompany Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a third party + intercompany process. The document flow is like:-Sales Order AAA -> Purchase Order XYZ -> Sales Order BBB.-Afterwards, you updated the delivery schedule in the purchase order XYZ and expect this update is taken into the sales order BBB. But system only updated the delivery schedule in sales order AAA, not in sales order BBB.-AAA, BBB represent the sales order ID.-XYZ represents the purchase order ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders - Purchase Orders view.-Open the Purchase Order XYZ. -In Items - Delivery Schedules tab, there are 2 schedules available.-Go to the document flow, you can see the third party sales order AAA and intercompany sales order BBB.-Open the order AAA, in Items - Confirmation Schedules tab, the updated 2 schedules are shown.-Open the order BBB, in Items - Confirmation Schedules tab, the update is not there.-Cause-In the intercompany sales order, the fulfillment is Internal. For internal fulfillment orders, the confirmation is scheduled based on ATP. so the update in the PO is not carried into the sales order BBB.-While, the sales order AAA is External fulfillment, when the delivery schedule was updated in PO, an XI message was sent from PO to ExternalProcurement to update the schedule.-Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-Keywords-confirmation schedule; intercompany sales order; external fulfillment; purchase order; delivery schedule.

Title: Workflow Rule Defined for the Delivery Block Triggers Incorrect Notification
Content: Symptom-The user has set up two workflows to send notifications when a Delivery Block is set or removed.-For instance: The user has configured the following workflows:-Delivery Block Deactivated-Delivery Block Activated-The goal is to trigger notifications when the Delivery Block field is set or removed. However, there is an issue where if the Delivery Block field is set along with any other field on the General tab of the Account, the deactivation notification is triggered instead, regardless of the presence of a value in the Delivery Block field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management workcenter-Go to Accounts view-Select Account: ABC-Select Edit-Navigate to Sales Data tab-Enter the Delivery Block field value, for eg: Credit Limit-Select Save-Now, go to General Tab-Enter data on to any field, for eg: Additional Name: ABC-Save-Observe, the Activation and Deactivation of Delivery Block notification both are triggered which is incorrect.-Cause-The user has selected the Value Before Object Change in the workflow defined.-Resolution-The workflow rule, which is defined based on the Business Object Account, is expected to activate notifications solely when a "Delivery Block" field is changed. However, due to the Value Before Object Change, the predefined conditions are met, resulting in triggering of the notification. Also please note the workflow rule is not limited to a specific field, as per the standard system behavior.-Below are the steps to remove the Value Before Object Change:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Workflow Rules-Select the Workflow created on Business Object Account-Select Edit-Navigate to the Conditions tab-Edit the Rule-Notice the Value Before Object Change field is checked-Now, uncheck the Value Before Object Change checkbox-Save-    Keywords-Delivery Block, Workflow Rules, Notification, Account, Value Before Object Change, Conditions, Sales Data

Title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) on the Tenant Request Scenarios in SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-This document covers some basic and frequently asked questions regarding Tenant Request Scenarios.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-1 - How to perform a new tenant request?-The tenant request option is available in the Service Control Center work center. -The steps can be performed by following:-    1. Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-    2. Go to Systems View.-    3. Click on the Request System Button.-    4. Fill the options with the required information.-The system will display a message with the downtime selected and the service request ID.-Also, refer to the KBA below which describes the types of different requests available in the system.-2136036 - How to Request a New Tenant for SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer-2 - How to Request a Partner/Reference/Demo Tenant?-The 'request system' button in the Systems view of the Service Control Center work center cannot be used by partners to request new partner/reference/demo tenant. -Instead, partners should contact the SAP TDD (SAP Test Demo Development Licenses for SAP Partner) team by following the KBA 1848459 and request a new tenant. The request will be validated by the team based on the contract and requirements.-Also, refer to the KBA below for further information:-2295749 - How to Request a Partner/Reference/Demo Tenant-3 - How to Request Tenant Refresh in SAP Business ByDesign?-To perform a system refresh, follow the below steps:-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to Systems View.-Select the Refresh System Button.-Fill the details for the refresh scenario required.-Click on Ok.-The refresh request is created.-Refer to the KBA below for guidance on filling the options and selecting the appropriate scenario.-2340655 - How to Request Tenant Refresh in SAP Business ByDesign-4 - How to terminate a productive tenant?-Due to security reasons, it is not possible to request to terminate a productive tenant in the system UI.-To request the termination of a productive tenant, open a case with SAP with the component SRD-CC-CI-CCS informing the productive tenant URL, tenant ID and the reason for the termination.-Further information can be referred in the below KBA.-2741988 - How to Terminate a Productive Tenant-5 - How to terminate a test tenant?-The termination of a test tenant can be performed by following the below steps:-    1. Go to the Service Control Center Work Center.-    2. Enter the Systems view.-    3. From the tenant list, select the test tenant required.-    4. Click on the Terminate System button.-    5. Click to confirm the Termination.-The termination request should be displayed in the service requests view of the Service Control Center work center.-Furthermore, it is currently possible in the system to defer the termination of a test tenant by up to three weeks, during which it can be temporarily used both test tenants in parallel.-To define the termination date, a pop-up window will appear when selecting the termination button, requesting the termination date.-Points to Note:-    • The scheduling process is only available for test tenants.-    • The termination can only be defined within 3 weeks from the current date of the request.-    • Test tenant, which is scheduled for termination, will be terminated on the given date. -In addition, refer to the KBAs below which mention the scenarios:-1941544 - How to Delete or Terminate a Test System-2727628 - Test Tenant Request with Time Overlap in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)-6 - When should the downtime for a tenant request be defined to avoid conflicts with the CMP?-For service requests, such as refresh and new tenant creation, copy or termination requests, the schedule of the downtime must be outside the CMP. This means either 4 hours before the test tenant CMP starts or 4 hours after the production tenant CMP ends. Avoid scheduling the downtime during the systems CMPs and in between the systems CMPs.-7 - What is and how to check the CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) of the tenant?-CMP is the contractual maintenance period performed every weekend for the SAP Business ByDesign tenants.-To check the tenant CMP, perform the following steps:-    1. Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-    2. Under Maintenance Schedule View click on List.-    3. On the left top corner in the dropdown list, it can be chosen a non-productive systems or productive systems.-    4. The status of the "type of activity" will be as "Maintenance" and it is displayed as planned or not, as well the relevant start time and duration in UTC time zone.-Further information can be referred in the KBA below.--3310728 - How to check your CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) in SAP Business ByDesign--8 - How to Cancel or Change a Tenant Request triggered from Service Control Center Work Center?-In this scenario, open a case with high priority to the component SRD-CC-CI-CCS. As currently in our system there is no functionality available to cancel or change the request already triggered.-Also, check the KBA below for further reference:-2886861 - How to Abort or Change a Tenant Request triggered from Service Control Center Work Center-9 - How to Purchase Additional Systems?-In SAP Business ByDesign system a purchase of an additional system can be performed by following the below steps:-    1. Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-    2. Go to Systems View -    3. Go to Service Requests sub-view.-    4. Click on Purchase additional systems button.-Once the request is raised for purchasing an additional system, this request will go to the license team. It will be reviewed the request and proceed accordingly to assign the new tenant.-Once the confirmation of the license team is provided about the newly purchased tenant, perform the steps provided in the question #1 to request the new tenant.-The scenario is mentioned in the KBA below.-2830233 - How to Purchase Additional Systems?-10 - How to change the tenant requester details?-The tenant requester name and ID cannot be changed. -This information is provided to inform who have requested the tenant and can be checked by following the below steps:-    1. Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-    2. Go to Systems view.-    3. Select the required system.-The tenant requestor details are displayed under Tenant Requestor section.-Further information can be referred in the KBA below.-2949329 - Change Tenant Requester Details from the System.-See Also-KBA 2136036 - How to Request a New Tenant for SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer-KBA 3310728 - How to check your CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) in SAP Business ByDesign-KBA 2949329 - Change Tenant Requester Details from the System-KBA 2886861 - How to Abort or Change a Tenant Request triggered from Service Control Center Work Center-KBA 2830233 - How to Purchase Additional Systems?-KBA 2741988 - How to Terminate a Productive Tenant-KBA 1941544 - How to Delete or Terminate a Test System-KBA 2727628 - Test Tenant Request with Time Overlap in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)-KBA 2295749 - How to Request a Partner/Reference/Demo Tenant-KBA 2340655 - How to Request Tenant Refresh in SAP Business ByDesign-FAQ: Cloud test, demo, and development for SAP S/4HANA Cloud – one-system landscape (8012331)-Partner Portal: SAP Partner Portal | welcome -Keywords-tenant request, refresh, new tenant, cmp, byd.

Title: Error in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK) After Idle Time
Content: Symptom-You can see following errors after an idle time of SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-xRepository Error-ProtocolException (SERVER): JSON communication failure. Severe server side error. Exporting parameter is null.-ProtocolException (SERVER): JSON communication failure. There was an error deserializing the object of type. -ProtocolException (CLIENT): Details: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.-As a result, you can only close SAP Cloud Applications Studio via the Task Manager.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open a Solution.-Open a Script.-Start Debugger.-Leave it opened for some hours without using it. -Cause-These errors are raised because of idle session timeout. -Resolution-When SAP Cloud Applications Studio is left idle for a long time (>10 mins), the best would be to logoff and login again before doing any other action on the SAP Cloud Applications Studio. Else, you will need to close it via the Task Manager. -Keywords-sdk, idle time, idle, session time out, session time, xRepository Error, ProtocolException (SERVER), JSON communication failure, Severe server side error, Exporting parameter is null.

Title: Overallocation of Incoming Direct Debits Based on Memo Line Rule
Content: Symptom-You have executed a number of Incoming Direct Debits against customers, for example by running a Receivables - Payment Run. Subsequently a payment file has been created (for example: SEPA Direct Debit).-A bank statement in format MT940 confirming these Incoming Direct Debits is processed thereafter.-You have set up a Rule for Analyzing Memo Lines, Type: 9 - DME Reference, in order to effect an automatic confirmation of relevant Direct Debit payments.-Related Payment Allocations remain in status 'Postprocessing Required'.-When accessing concerned Payment Allocations you notice an over-allocation for each related bank statement transaction.-This will turn the Open Amount in each allocation negative.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can access the relevant payment allocations either in:-Payment Management work center.-Navigate to Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant payment allocation.-- or via the posted bank statement.-Liquidity Management work center.-Bank Statements view.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and edit.-Follow the link Postprocessing required to access the relevant payment allocation.--Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines can be defined either via:-Business Configuration work center.-Global Settings for Payment.-Create and edit rules for analyzing memo lines.-or - by editing any open Bank Statement Payment Allocation.-Cause-The bank statement records confirmed Direct Debits in single transactions instead of 1 batch transaction.-The result of a rule of type DME Reference (Data medium exchange) usually refers to the Payment Message ID which is assigned when creating a payment file.-In case an unambiguous and relevant result is obtained this will facilitate a 1:N automatic allocation and confirmation of payments represented in a bank statement transaction.-The application of such a rule hence assumes that all payments contained in the payment file are contained in 1 bank statement transaction (batch transaction).-This means that the full amount of all candidate Direct Debits sharing the same DME Reference (Payment Message ID) will be allocated in each Payment Allocation. -Example: -3 Incoming Direct Debits are created for 3 customers.-  Amount  External Reference-Incoming Direct Debit: A 1,000.00 EUR AAA-Incoming Direct Debit: B 2,000.00 EUR BBB-Incoming Direct Debit: C 3,000.00 EUR CCC-Payment File 500 is created with assigned Payment Message ID 513 and sent to your house bank. -Subsequently an MT940 bank statement XYZ is processed containing these payments.-Item ID Payment Method  Credit Amount Postprocessing -1 Incoming Direct Debit 1,000.00 EUR Required-2 Incoming Direct Debit 2,000.00 EUR Required-3 Incoming Direct Debit 3,000.00 EUR Required-For all 3 items 513 is obtained as result in a Rule for Analyzing Memo Lines (Type: 9 - DME Reference).-Payment File 500 (Payment Message ID: 513) contains 3 Direct Debits over an amount of 6,000.00 EUR.-Following the logic that for a single line-item all related payments associated with Payment Message ID 513 shall be confirmed - resulting Payment Allocations will propose all Direct Debits for confirmation for each line-item. -For Example: -Item ID 1, Payment Allocation External Reference XYZ/1:-Transaction Amount: 1,000.00 EUR-Allocated Amount: 6,000.00 EUR-Open Amount:  -5,000.00 EUR-Resolution-Application of Rule Type '9 - DME Reference' assumes the allocation of all related payments associated with a Payment Message ID for a bank statement transaction (1:N). In other words, all associated open payments are contained in one batch-transaction.-In case there is more than 1 payment and confirmed payments are recorded in several line-items Rule Type '9 - DME Reference' should not be applied.-In such a scenario the unique External Payment Reference would be expected for each line-item. -The External Payment Reference in MT940 would be contained in transaction-block :61:.-For Example: -:61:2404090409CR1000,00NTRFAAA-Would automatically confirm Direct Debit AAA over 1,000.00 EUR.-As this is a intrinsic clearing-functionality, no memo-line rules are taking effect.-Alternatively the house-bank would have to be advised to bundle all payments into one batch-transaction as outlined above.-The same logic applies for Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Keywords-Bank Statement -Payment Allocation -DME Reference

Title: System generating Production Proposals during a Planned Downtime
Content: Symptom-It was entered a planned Downtime, however system is generating Production Proposals in this time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Resource Operating Profiles view.-Find Operation Profile ID XYZ (XYZ means Operation Profile ID).-Open and check under tab Downtime and Addition Times.-Downtime was set as Maintenance for the chosen date.-Notice that in Process Production Proposal under Supply Control work center there are proposals in the chosen date.-Cause-After declaring downtime for the Resource Profile for the Resources, can be seen in the Resource Load work center for each Resource that for those date ranges the capacity for the Resource is zero.-Those Production Proposals are believed to be created before the declaration of Downtime for this Resource Profile, because of that those Resources got assigned on those dates as well which is understandable.-Resolution-It needs to go into each Resource under that Resource Profile (Resource Load) and needs to do Load Levelling for those date ranges, so that the operations assigned to those Resources on those dates will get preponed or postponed based on what you select in the Load Levelling and it will be distributed accordingly.-Keywords-Resource, Downtime, Load Levelling, Production Proposal.

Title: Extension Fields do not Appear in Dunning Output
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer has created extension fields through Key User Adaptation for Dunning Letter, however the fields are not available in the PDF or the form template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Enter the Dunning view.-Change the query to All Proposals-Open a dunning object.-Click on the user avatar icon on the top-right of the screen.-Go to Key User Settings.-Click on Start Adaptation.-Navigate to the Dunning items tab.-Right click on the table header.-Click on the "+extension fields" button.-In the popup, select the extension field created.-Click on Show Further Usage.-In the Form Templates tab, you can see the field extended for all versions of country and language. However this field does not appear in the final PDF form.-Cause-This is a current limitation when adding KUT extension fields to the Dunning Letter form template.-Resolution-As a workaround, customers should create the required extension fields through Cloud Application Studio and extend them to the form template.-Keywords-KUT, PDI, SDK, XDP, XML, XSD

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2402 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2402 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 20th of April 2024. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Centre.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2402 HC 03-Resolution-Cross-Area Topic-Mobile Framework  -The SAP Business ByDesign Android mobile application was experiencing issues with opening PDF files. This issue is now fixed.  (Hotfix ID: 1000028812) -Customer Relationship Management-Sales Price List-The ManageSalesPriceList service is now working as expected. (Hotfix ID: 1000026489)-Sales Order -In the CUSTOMER_RETURN business object, under the Customer Return node, the AddServiceTransactionDocumentReferenceForRepair action is now read-released in the Public Solution Model. (Hotfix ID:  1000029700)- Customer Invoice -When an invoice document is canceled, the displayed pop-up did not contain the Invoice Date and Posting Date making it difficult to decide. This issue is now fixed, and the pop-up displays the dates. (Hotfix ID:  1000026296)-UI Plug-Ins -Earlier, the CRMCUCOISCU data source displayed truncated Contract UUID values in the Contract Item ID field. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000025199)-Cross Country Extensions -The fix ensures that the QR code information is correctly displayed on the customer invoice form for Switzerland while doing the multiple release of a invoices. (Hotfix ID:  1000029004) -You can now send documents via PEPPOL even if the numbering rule is not maintained or a global invoice number is picked. (Hotfix ID: 1000027913)-Financial Management-Business Partner Template-In the Customer business object, under the Common node, the Script Code field has been read-released in the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 1000026812)-Tax Declaration -For Israel, vendor payments (clearing of credit memo using incoming bank transfer payment method) will not be reported in all the withholding tax returns. (Hotfix ID:  1000028054)-Travel and Expense Management -For Denmark, the per diem rates for meal, mileage, and lodging are updated as per the regulations from January 2024. (Hotfix ID: 1000025025)- Statutory Reporting -The Mexico Electronic Accounting system now allows users to access the correct general ledger accounts list based on the selected set of books. Additionally, the Israel - 6111 Report has been corrected to distribute the difference between the parent 6111 node's balance and the sum of all child 6111 nodes only when necessary, resolving the redistributed balance issue. (Hotfix ID: 4500023687) -  Supply Chain Management-Delivery Processing-In the APDL_INBOUND_DELIVERY Business Object, under the ITEM node, the Action-CANCEL has been read-released in the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 1000026945) -Production Segment-In the PRODUCTION_SEGMENT Business Object, under the PROD_BOM_ITEM_ACT_ASSIGN Node, the SUPPLY_RELEVANCE_INDICATOR is now read-released under the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 1000028441)-Production Bill of Material-In the BOM_PRODUCTION Business Object, under the COMPONENT Node, the FIRST_ASSIGNMENT_INDICATOR is now read-released under the Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 1000028172)-Payment Processes -Earlier, object creation without manual adjustment used to run into issues because of unsuccessful bank statement uploads. The uploads for bank statements (CAMT053 V8 generic) or Payment. (Hotfix ID: 1000029260)-*Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g., operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed)-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2402; HFC03; Hotfix; SPS03; Hotfix Collection; 2402;

Title: Logistics Area Description Missing in a Custom Report Based on The Standard Data source: Logistics Area General Information
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer have created a report on the basis of the Standard Data source: Logistics Area General Information.-However, the report is not returning the correct value in the Description of a particular Logistic Area.-Customer is asks SAP to check the reason the system is returning the value "#" instead of the expected value. In the Data source itself, the correct value is being returned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Analytics work center. -Go to the Design Reports view. -Find and select the relevant Custom Report.-You can see it is based on the Virtual Data Source: Logistics Area General Information (SCMLOARESTB01).-Open the Report and you can see a number of Logistics Areas returned. And from all the returned Logistics Areas, you can see for a particular Logistics Area, the system is returning the value # for the Logistics Area Description.-If you go to the relevant Location Layout, you can see there is a Description maintained for the affected Logistics Area.-If you check the Data source, you can see the Description is actually returned.-Cause-Issue identified and Code fix created.-Resolution-Code correction was needed to resolve the issue. Code fix is now complete and is part of a Hotfix. The hotfix was deployed to customer's system with the 2402 version 03. -Keywords-Custom, Report, Data, source, Logistics Area General Information

Title: Fixed Asset reversal error: Reversal not possible because fixed asset XX-Y is retired
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse a migrated fixed asset, however, the below error occurs:-Reversal not possible because fixed asset XX-Y is retired-Journal entry voucher cannot be posted-Journal entry voucher ABCD cannot be reversed-Save failed-  XX-Y = Fixed Asset ID-ABCD = Journal Entry Voucher ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center > Fixed assets view-Search for the Fixed Asset ID XX-Y-Click Edit > Migration-Click Reversal Migration-Do you really want to reverse migration postings? Master data changes are also saved.-Click Yes-Error-Reversal not possible because fixed asset XX-Y is retired-Journal entry voucher cannot be posted-Journal entry voucher ABCD cannot be reversed-Save failed-Cause-The Fixed Asset ID is retired and the Deactivation Date and Last Retirement Date fields are active.-Resolution-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center > Fixed assets view-Search for the Fixed Asset ID XX-Y-Click Edit > Master Data -Go to Life Cycle Data tab-Select the set of book and remove the Last Retirement date and Deactivation date-Save-The fixed asset should return to Capitalized status-Try to reverse the fixed asset again-See Also-KBA 2674773 - When Reversing Journal Entry Voucher, error message: Reversal not possible; unreversed postings to ind. material AAA asset BBB -KBA 2672859 - Invoice Cancellation, Error Message: Reversal not possible because fixed asset XYZ is retired -KBA 2217593 - How to Reverse the Scrapping of a Retired Fixed Asset--Keywords-fixed asset, migrate, migration, reverse,

Title: Error: Payer/payee missing when trying to create a Bank Payment Advice via web service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Bank Payment Advice via web service "managebankadvicein", however, you are receiving the following error:-Payer/payee missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Try to create a Bank Payment Advice via web service "managebankadvicein"-In the Response, the following error is shown:- <Note>Payer/payee missing</Note>-Cause-Currently, the Payer/Payee ID is a mandatory field to be sent in the payload to create a Bank Payment Advice via web service "managebankadvicein"-Resolution-Expected System Behavior.-The BusinessPartnerInternalID (Payer/Payee ID) is a mandatory field when creating a Bank Advice via web service---If you would like to influence the system behavior, consider to use our Influence Channel to post a new Feature Request. Link: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 requests need 20 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis twice a year, with the results being communicated in the corresponding review blog post. The ideas can be voted by other customers and partners and the most voted ones might be collected to the product backlog for future versions.-See Also-Help Documentation: Inbound Service Manage Bank Advices Documentation-Keywords-web service, webservice, managebankadvicein, bank advice, payer, payee, missing

Title: System is not Allowing Decimal Values in New Planning Proposal.
Content: Symptom-When creating a New Planning Proposal you notice the system rounds up decimal quantities to the next whole number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks.-Select New Planning Proposal View.-Click Add Row.-Maintain the Product ID.-Maintain the Quantity as a figure with a decimal value. e.g 1.25, 1,5.-Maintain the Planning Area ID.-You will notice that the system rounds the quantity up to the next whole number in the Planning Quantity Column.-Cause-You have not maintained decimals settings in their Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to Business and Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the Relevant Implementation Project.-Click Open Activity List.-Filter by All Activities.-Search for the activity 'Quantities and Units of Measure'.-Click Open.-Click 'Create and Maintain Trading Units'.-Find the relevant UoM  (Unit of Measure) that you are using.-Enter the amount of decimals you would like to show in the 'Display Decimals' column.-You can now create a New Planning Proposal, the system should now show the Decimal Values.-Keywords-Rounding, Decimal, Planning Proposal

Title: Logistics Area With Insufficient Stock Is Proposed as Source Logistics Area in Pick Task
Content: Symptom-System proposes logistics area ABC (ABC represents logistics area ID) as source logistics area for a pick task. However, check in Stock Overview, there is no sufficient on-hand stock for the product in logistics area ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Access view Task Control.-Select a pick task, click Confirm.-Under tab Line Items, for product DEF (DEF represents product ID), logistics area ABC is proposed as source logistics area.-Check in Stock Overview, there is no sufficient on-hand stock for product DEF in logistics area ABC.-Cause-This pick task is located in site XYZ (XYZ represents site ID). All/many logistics areas (including ABC) under site XYZ have not maintained allocation type and allocation scope, these logistics areas are considered with infinite inventory, hence they will be considered when system is looking for source logistics area, no matter there is sufficient stock or not.-Resolution-Please maintain allocation type and allocation scope for all logistics areas under site XYZ.-Keywords-Pick Task, Source Logistics Area, Propose, Insufficient, Stock, Allocation Scope, Allocation Type

Title: Customer Invoice Dumps due to Fiscal Year
Content: Symptom-The system is generating an exception every time you try to release an invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select any Not Released document.-Click Release.-System creates an exception.-Cause-The reason the system is returning the exception is because the fiscal year variant XYZ not valid for Posting Date maintained in the invoice. (XYZ represents the name of the fiscal year). -You can check the settings of the Fiscal Year in your Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Select the Fine-Tune phase-Open the activity Other Fiscal Year from the activity list.-Select the Fiscal Year Variant XYZ.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -Please maintained a valid fiscal year and posting date to match the information maintained within the invoice document. -Keywords-fiscal year, error, exception, dump, invoice, not valid, variant, CM_AEO_TRANS_EXCEPTION

Title: System Crashes While Releasing An Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-When user tries to release an stock transfer outbound delivery/ outbound delivery system crashes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Search the relevant ID.-Select and choose Release.-System crashes.-Cause-In material master data of the required materials, Cost Rate which is maintained is valid from MMDDYYYY, however the Delivery Date on the Outbound Delivery is set earlier than "valid from" for which no cost has been maintained in the material valuation of required materials with business residence. ( i.e. MMDDYYYY refers to Valid From date)                                                                                                OR-Additionally, the Delivery Date on the Outbound Delivery is set later than "valid to" date for which no cost has been maintained in the material valuation of required materials with business residence. and hence the cost is not valid.    OR-Also, the item's ship-to party ( Business Residence) in respective material's master data->their Business Residence at Valuation level, the status is with "In Preparation" instead of Active in stock transfer scenario.-Resolution-Go to the Product Portfolio workcenter.-Go to the Products view.-Search for the relevant Product ID.-Select and edit the product ID.-Choose View All.-Navigate to Valuation tab.-Select required Business Residence.-Maintain Cost Rate with Valid From/ Valid To as per Outbound Delivery Date.-Keywords-Outbound delivery, stock transfer order, system crash, dump, valuation, business residence, validity, cost rate,

Title: Tax Codes Missing for Down Payment Invoice Requests
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-All the tax codes defined in the Business Configuration Fine tune activity - Tax on goods and services not appearing while creating Down payment Invoice Requests. -Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Requests View.-Search for Down payment invoice request XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Down Payment Invoice Request).-Select the Invoice request and click on Edit.-Under Tax details, for Tax Code you can see only Tax codes are available. However, you expect to see all tax codes available in Business Configuration.-Cause-For the Down payment invoice requests for the country China, only the exemption related tax codes are required to be shown/selected as per the legal requirement. Hence the system will display only the following tax codes:-507 - Domestic sale of exempted goods-511 - Exempted domestic sale of products, down payment-513 - Export sale of goods-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-New tax codes not appearing in Downpayments, Downpayment requests tax codes, Down payment, tax code missing

Title: Error When Trying to Approve a Manager Approval via ByD Mobile
Content: Symptom-You are trying to approva a Manager Approval via ByD Mobile, however the Mobile shows the following error message:-Approving Error An error occurred. Please try again.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Access the ByD Mobile.-Go to the Manager Approvals tile.-Then Expenses section.-Select the affected Manager Approval.-Click Approve.-Error occurs.-Cause-This error occurs because multi-step approval (MSA) of expense reports is not supported for SAP Business ByDesign Mobile.-Resolution-For this error, please change the approval process for expense reports to One-Step.-See Also-2543238 - Approval Process for Expense Reports and How To Change it-Keywords-Manager Approval, Approving Error,  An error occurred, Please try again, ByD Mobile, Manager Approval, Expenses.

Title: Termination Date Modification of Business User
Content: Symptom-The termination date for Business User ABC  was set to DD.MM.YYYY by user XYZ. This action is visible in the change log of user ABC. However, we find that XYZ does not possess writing access rights on Application and User Management.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-User XYZ has write access to Employee Work center to change employee data.-Resolution-The Business users cannot be directly created. Instead, they are generated when an employee is created.-User XYZ has access to the employees Work Center (WOC) to create an employee, there by triggering the creation of a business user simultaneously. Consequently, the changes reflected in the change log are attributed to Business User ABC. -Keywords-Termination date, Business user, Employee woc, Change Log.

Title: Sales order Total Value is Displayed Wrongly for Currency INR (Indian Rupee)
Content: Symptom-Total value of the sale order is not equal to the Sum of Total Item Net Value and Tax. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders -> Sales Orders-Select Sales order ABC (ABC represents the sales order ID)-The Total value of the sale order is not equal to the Sum of Total Item Net Value and Tax-Cause-For INR (Indian Rupee), the predefined rounding value is 0.5. This means that rounding is done to multiples of 0.5 INR as per common business practice. -Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementations Projects view.-Select the First Implementation and select Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine Tune tab.-Search and open the Activity Currencies.-Search for Currency code INR -You can see the Rounding Value is maintained to 0.5 INR. -Keywords-Incorrect total value;

Title: Error message "Change of employee time not possible; backup or cancelled item"
Content: Symptom-When user attempts to release the hours, an error occurs initially, but upon the subsequent attempt, the hours are successfully released when user clicks again.-Error: Change of employee time not possible; backup or cancelled item-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select Projects-Search for the project ABC(ABC represents the project name)-Select View All-Navigate to Work tab -Select Add Row and record time for any day and Release-The below Error pops up-Error : Change of employee time not possible; backup or cancelled item-   Cause-The custom PDI class is causing the issue and triggering error message. -Resolution-Check with your Implementation partner to check the custom solution and correct the issue. -See Also-Employee Time, Project management, Projects ,Backup, cancelled item

Title: Cannot Create Supplier Invoice for Released Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create a Supplier Invoice for an Inbound Delivery that already has Released status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Show: All deliveries to be invoiced.-Search for the inbound delivery's ID.-The result is: 'No records found'.-Cause-Firstly you should check if the Purchase Order's item is expecting an invoice, by following the steps of the below KBA:-KBA: 2930926 - Unable to create invoice based on Purchase order or delivery-If you confirmed that indeed the item is expecting an invoice, then you should check the item's Invoice Completed status by following the steps below:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for the Purchase Order's ID.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the item.-You can see that: 'Invoice Completed: Manually Finished'.-If for this item the Invoicing status was manually finished, you cannot invoice the Inbound Delivery.-Or-If the Invoice Status of the Inbound Delivery is marked as Not Relevant , the Inbound delivery ID will not be visible for Invoicing when searched.-In such cases, a backend correction is required to change the status. Post which the document will be available for invoicing.-Resolution-You can manually revoke the invoicing status for this item in the Purchase Order.-Follow the steps you made to check the Item's Invoicing status.-Click on Resume button.-Select Invoice.-Then the 'Invoice Completed' status will be revoked. Now you should be able to invoice this item.-See Also-KBA: 2930926 - Unable to create invoice based on Purchase order or delivery-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Inbound Delivery; Revoke; Manually Finished; Invoicing; Purchase Order

Title: Sales Order Filter returns Wrong Results
Content: Symptom-Same number of Sales Order is displayed for Different queries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Accounts Management Work Center.-Go to Accounts view.-Select any Account.-Click on the link to open the Overview.-Navigate to Sales tab.-Click on Advance filter in Sales Order section.-Click on Organize Queries.-Select All Orders with Ship-To Party Role as default and ensure the Execute on Selection is selected.-Click on Apply.-You can see XYZ Sales Order displayed.-In the Sales Order dropdown section.-Click on All Sales Orders.-You can see same XYZ Sales Order is displayed.-Same results are returned even though different queries are applied.-Cause-"All Sales Orders" query will show all the Orders where the Account ID is same as Ship To in Sales Order.-"All Orders with Ship-To Party Role" query will show all the Orders where Account is also maintained as Ship To Party Role.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Ship-To Party Role, Sales Order, Queries, Incorrect.

Title: Error Message: 'Conflicts Exist; Use Show Filter to Display Conflicts You Need to Resolve' while Scoping Digital Payments Add-on
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -You are not able to scope the Digital Payments Add-on due to below error message:-Conflicts exist; use show filter to display conflicts you need to resolve-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project line.-Choose Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the 4th option (Questions tab).-Expand Communication and Information Exchange.-Expand  Integration with External Applications and Solutions.-Select Integration Scenarios for Cloud Solutions from SAP option.-Navigate to the scoping question Do you want to enable integration with SAP Digital Payments Add-on? under Group: Integration with SAP Digital Payments (1).-Select as reviewed and error shows.-Error message: Conflicts exist; use show filter to display conflicts you need to resolve-Cause-There is missing scoping dependency for digital payments and needs to be activated from backend, involving the scoping of a hidden question which should enable the activation of the Digital Payments Integration.-Resolution-Run transaction code BCTADM and note down the workspace ID.-Run transaction code BCE. -Select the Parameter as Adaptation Workspace from the dropdown.-In the Adaptation Workspace field enter the value * and press enter-In the Adaptation Workspaces list, search for the Workspace ID from the step 1 and double click on the workspace under the object name column.-Click Scoping (with Question) tab-Click Search button and search for "BO_A1S_FIN_CRCMA"-Go to the scoping question for Credit Cards - Customer Payments and select [change] button and select the checkbox after [Credit Card – Customer Payment]-You notice the system automatically activate the BO's BO_A1S_FIN_CH and BO_A1S_FIN_BTMCC-Click Save-Click Activate button.-Now run transaction SE38 and execute report RP_BCT_WS_UPGRADE-Enter the Workspace Id and check box Complete Deployment, Bypass Change Pointers, Remove Dangling PDI Pointers. -Click Execute (F8)-The output report is generated. -Note: -If you face any error in report output, please contact to development team.-Login to frontend and you will be able to set the scoping question as reviewed.-Keywords- SAP Digital Payments Add-on, Scoping error,  Conflicts exist; use show filter to display conflicts you need to resolve

Title: Missing IBAN in outbound payment file
Content: Symptom-Missing IBAN in the outbound payment file-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management Work center > Outbound files view-Search and find Payment -Open it and Select View All-Go to Attachment tab-Download and open the document-The IBAN is missing-Cause-One possible reason for this issue is that the IBAN has been maintained in the Supplier Master data after the creation of the payment file-Resolution-Check the IBAN in the Supplier Master Data-Go to Supplier Base Work Center > Suppliers view-Search for the Supplier and open it-Click on View All-Go to Financial Data tab > Bank Data subtab-Then, check if the IBAN is maintained-If the IBAN is maintained correctly, then check when it was entered in the Supplier Master Data-Click on Changes tab-Click on Go-In the Change logs, verify the Date/Time when the IBAN was entered in the master data-Take a note of the Date/Time-Now, check the creation date of the outbound payment file-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Outbound Files view-Search for the Payment file and check the creation date of it-If the creation date of the Payment file is before than the date of when the IBAN was entered in the Supplier Master Data (step #10), then, the IBAN will not be included in the payment file-To have the IBAN included in the Payment file, create a new Outbound payment file-Keywords-IBAN, missing, out

Title: Not Able to Terminate The Existing Tenant From Partner Tenant
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error "Terminating customer systems is not supported in partner systems"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Partner tenant.-Go to Service Control Center Work center.-Go to Systems View.-Select the tenant that needs to be terminated.-Select Request termination.-Error appears.-Cause-The test tenant cannot be terminated by login into Partner tenant.-Resolution-Login to any other live Test/Production tenant.-Go to Service Control Center Work center.-Go to Systems View.-Select the tenant that needs to be terminated.-Select Request termination.-Note: If you have only one test tenant and no production tenant then the termination has to done by login into test tenant and scheduling the termination. Though we can view all the tenants under Service Control Center, it's two independent contract and cannot be mixed. You cannot login into the Partner tenant and terminate the test tenant.-See Also-2727628 - Test Tenant Request with Time Overlap-Keywords-Test tenant termination, terminate tenant, Partner tenant, Terminating customer systems is not supported in partner systems

Title: Unable to Add an Extension Field From an Expense Report Into the Expense Report App
Content: Symptom-An extension field from an expense report shall be added to the expense report app.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The extension fields, which are defined for the desktop expense report application, can be brought into the mobile app by opening the key user view of the app in the browser using the following URL:--XXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/public/ap/ui/repository/SAP_UI/HTMLOBERON5/client.html?sapbyd-agent=MBLHTML-(XXX has to be replaced by your system URL, e.g. my123456)--There it is possible to add or change fields in a similar manner as for the desktop application. If a field has already been added to the desktop application, it should be offered here for adding it to the mobile screen as well. Please note that not all the screens in mobile app allow the user to add extension field like Manager Approval.
