It is the system designed behalf that in some screens, the extension field button is missing or the control pannel of extension field is blank.-Keywords-Expense Report App, Expense Report, Extension Field, kundenspezifisches Feld.

Title: Material Description In Traditional Chinese Cannot Be Uploaded To The Expected Language While Using Excel Add-In Tool
Content: Symptom-When creating Material with a Material Description in Traditional Chinese using the Excel Add-In tool, the Material Description is getting created in Simplified Chinese. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center -> Materials view.-Click New -> Material from Microsoft Excel and download the template.-Open the template and input the material to create with a Material Description which language code is ZF(Traditional Chinese).-Login system and save the data to system.-Login into system in language ZF(Traditional Chinese).-Go to Product Data work center -> Materials view.-Search for the material just created and open it.-Material Description is not uploaded.-Open Language dropdown list, choose Simplified Chinese (ZH), Material Description is created in Simplified Chinese (ZH).-Cause-The excel template for material downloaded from system does not contain a language property.-Resolution-The language property is missing for the excel template, the same can be added with below steps:-Rename the writeback template file from filename.xlsx to filename.zip.-Now unzip the newly created file.-Go to docProps->custom.xml.-Open custom.xml in any editor and add the below mentioned property [Note: fmtid should be same as others, pid should be in order with others (if the last pid in file is 13 than new one should be 14 or the next number).]-Compress and zip all the files again after saving edited file.-Rename again from filename.zip to filename.xlsx.-Open the newly generated excel file -> go to File -> Info -> click on Properties -> Advance Properties.-Scroll down to the property name "_SAP_T_LANGU" and change value from EN to desired language code - ZH,ZF, etc. in upper case.-Click OK.-Close and reopen the file.-Property to add: <property fmtid="{D5CDD505-2E9C-101B-9397-08002B2CF9AE}" pid="14" name="_SAP_T_LANGU"><vt:lpwstr>ZF</vt:lpwstr></property>-Note: -The steps 1 to 6 would have to be followed one time per file to set the default language, and steps 7 to 9 will have to be repeated if need to change the default language to some other language, otherwise all the steps will be onetime activity for one file.-If download a new template every time, then all the steps would have to be followed.-Keywords-Material Description, Material, Excel Add-In, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese

Title: Error: Budget category not allowed; active budget control not scoped
Content: Symptom-Error when trying to post a Journal Entry Voucher.-Message error: Budget category not allowed; active budget control not scoped-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center > Journal Entry Vouchers view-Search for the Journal Entry Voucher ID: XYZ-Click Actions > Post-The error occurs-Budget category not allowed; active budget control not scoped-Cause-The scoping question "Do you want to perform budget checks during the integrated procurement or manual invoicing process?" is not active-Resolution-Scope the question "Do you want to perform budget checks during the integrated procurement or manual invoicing process?" -Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Implementation Projects view-Select the Implementation Project and click Edit Project Scope-Go to Step #4 - Questions-Navigate under Financial and Management Accounting > Management Accounting > Financial Planning-Scope the question "Do you want to perform budget checks during the integrated procurement or manual invoicing process?"-Save your changes-Try to post the Journal Entry voucher again-Keywords-budget, control, Budget category not allowed; active budget control not scoped

Title: How System Saves Exchange Rate per User Time Zone
Content: Symptom-You do not use UTC as your time zone, and you want to know the impact for exchange rate valid from time when you maintain it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You do not use time zone as UTC. For example, you use UTC+8 as your time zone. You create exchange rate valid from mm/dd/yyyy 10:00:00. You want to know how system saves the validity of the newly created exchange rate.-(mm/dd/yyyy represents the month date and year maintained for the exchange rate)-Cause-System will save it valid from mm/dd/yyyy 10:00:00 UTC+8, which is mm/dd/yyyy 02:00:00 UTC. Because the system time zone is UTC, and validity is converted to UTC when being saved.-Resolution-Please always take your personal time zone into consideration when you use exchange rate validity.-See Also-2609018 - How Exchange Rate is Derived for Different User's Time Zone-2735045 - How Journal Entry Voucher Selects Valid Exchange Rate-Keywords-exchange rate, time zone, 汇率，用户时区，时区

Title: How to Delete A2A or B2B Orders From SAP Business ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-How to delete the A2A or B2B Orders from SAP Business ByDesign system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and select Go button.-When trying to delete a A2A or B2B order the system throws an error message: "B2B order cannot be deleted".-Cause-You cannot delete the A2A or B2B orders directly in the Business ByDesign system.-Only deletion of intercompany sales order documents without items or deletion of sales order documents created from external system is permitted.-Resolution-In case the document was created from an external document:- The A2A or B2B Sales Order can be deleted only through a Purchase Order cancellation request message. This is a standard process. You need to send the cancellation from the Sender system to cancel those orders. This can be done for B2B orders when they need to be deleted. This does not cancel the sales order but deletes it. This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Note: Attaching the sample XML of a deletion request from Purchase Order to Sales Order (B2B Scenario).-  In case the Puchase Order was created in the same SAP Business ByDesign System you can cancel the Sales Order by cancelling the Purchase Order-See KBA 1913197 - How To Cancel Sales Order Created Via Intercompany Process-Keywords-sales order, delete, B2B; A2A

Title: Error: Currency ABC does not match currency of bank account XXX when creating a Forecast planning
Content: Symptom-Error when creating a new Forecast Planning Item.--Currency ABC does not match currency of bank account XXX-ABC = Currency-XXX = Bank Account ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Forecast Planning Items view-Click New > Forecast Planning Items-Enter the required information-Error-Currency ABC does not match currency of bank account XXX-Cause-The bank account ABC has currency restrictions-Resolution-In order to verify if the Bank Account ABC has any currency restrictions proceed as follow:-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Master Data > My Banks view-Search for your My Bank ID and open it-Click View All-Go to Bank Accounts tab-Search for the Bank Account ID XXX-Click Currency Restriction sub-tab-To restrict transactions to specific currencies, specify those currencies on the Currency Restriction tab. Simply choose Add Row and select the appropriate currencies. The bank account currency is always allowed and does not need to be added, unless you want it to be the only currency allowed– in this case you must enter it here. -If only the bank account currency is allowed for transactions, then, only the bank account currency must be maintained here.-See Also-Banks and Bank Accounts documentation-Keywords-currency, forest planning, bank, account

Title: 'All proposals postponed; total payment proposed exceeds account balance' Warning in Payment Run
Content: Symptom-When you open the Application Log of the Payment Run ID XXX, you can see the following error message:-'All proposals postponed; total payment proposed exceeds account balance' (XXX represents the Payment Run ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the Payment Runs view.-Search for Run ID XXX.-Under Execution Details open the Application Log ID YYY. (YYY represents the Application Log ID).-Select the Results tab.-Under the Description view, you notice a row displaying the Message: 'Payer ABC: payment strategy 01; 0 grace days' (ABC represents the Account ID).-Expand the Message and you notice warning message: 'All proposals postponed; total payment proposed exceeds account balance'.-Cause-This warning is a result of the overall account balance check (both payables and receivables). It indicates that the overall proposed payment amount is not required. This check considers all created payment proposals regardless of currency and payment details. The most common reasons for this warning message are:-On account payments are not considered by the payment run (unless you specify that they should be when you create the run).These items are, however, still open and therefore visible in the balance.-Items that are locked by a clearing process, such as when a clearing is still in approval, are not selected by the payment run. These items are, however, still open and therefore visible in the balance.-The payment run does not perform payables and receivables netting, but the balance check considers both. Therefore, if the business partner is both, customer as well as supplier, payment proposals may be postponed due to open items of the other account type.-Note that down payments are not considered by the balance check.-Resolution-What you can do:-Ignore the balance check warning and execute the Payment anyway by choosing Reset Postpone:-Go to Receivables/Payables Work Center.-Open the Payment Run view.-Select the row with the Run ID XXX.-Under Execution Details show All Logs.-Select the respective Execution ID.-Click View Payment Proposals button.-Select the row containing the relevant Payment in status Postponed.-Click Actions button.-Choose the option Reset Postpone.-Trigger the Payment by pressing Execute Proposal.-Void the Individual Payment Proposal:-Go to Receivables/Payments Work Center.-Open the Payment Run view.-Select the row with the Run ID XXX.-Under Execution Details show All Logs.-Select the respective Execution ID.-Click View Payment Proposals button.-Select the row containing the relevant Payment in status Postponed.-Click Void Proposal button.-Edit the proposal to Add or Remove items:-Go to Receivables/Payments Work Center.-Open the Payment Run view.-Select the row with the Run ID XXX.-Under Execution Details show All Logs.-Select the respective Execution ID.-Click View Payment Proposals button.-Select the row with the relevant payment is status In Preparation.-Click Edit Proposal.-Now, you can add or remove the items.-Ideally, however, you should maintain accounts on a regular basis to keep the number of balance check warnings to a minimum.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Messages in the Payment Run Application Log.-Keywords-Receivables, Payables, Payment Run, Payment Proposal, Warning Message, Error, Postponed, Proposal Postponed, Account Payments, Payment Strategy, Clearing Process, Open Items.

Title: Sales Order Volume Report Does Not Show The Created On Time of the Sales Orders.
Content: Symptom-The Sales Order Volume Report only shows the created on Date, however you expect to see the created on time of the Sales Order -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Reports view.-Select the List subview.-Choose Sales Order Volume report.-Select the preferred parameter then choose Go.-Go to View tab and add the Created On field under Rows Fields-You will see only date, however you also expect the created time to be displayed.- Cause-The Created On field in the Sales Order Volume report is of type DATE and it only shows the Date and does not include the created time. Currently the created time of is not available in the Sales Order Volume report.-Resolution-This is the Current system design.-If you have a business requirement which needs to change this system behavior we recommended you to provide this feedback at SAP Business ByDesign Ideas forums, available at:https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. This forum is monitored directly by our Product Management and they will be able to assess your requirement for feasibility to be added in the future release.-We are continuously extending our products with new functions and appreciate your feedback.-Keywords-Sales Order volume Report, Created On Time, Sales Order

Title: How to Find Deleted CT's - Change Transactions
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to find Change Transactions which were deleted by a Key User.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to system backend from relevant system.-Go to SE37 transaction.-Insert function module AP_UI_FLEX_GET_CTS_FOR_ID.-Click on Execute (Fn+F8).-Set  IV_DELETED_CTS to X.-For IV_CT_TYPE, enter CT type which you want to search- Eg: AddExtensionField, AddPostCondition etc.-Click on Execute and Save.-Under Export Parameters- In ET_CT_INFO, click on table.-You will see the list of CT's of AddExtension Field.-Scroll right to see status of deletion and you can further get CT name, user who deleted, time stamp etc.-Keywords-Deleted,CT, Key User, change transaction, delete, CT, Removed

Title: Production Order Not Visible in Production Processing Times Report
Content: Symptom-- Production Order with the status "In Preparation" is not visible in the Production Processing Times report.-- Despite the presence of such orders in the Production Order view, they are not displayed in the report.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Production Control work center.-2. Go to the Reports view and select the List option.-3. Search and select the Production Processing Times Report.-4. In the Selection section, select the value help for the field Production Order Status.-5. Choose the value "In Preparation" from the list of available values.-6. Select the Apply option.-7. Observe that the report does not display any information, despite the presence of orders with the "In Preparation" status in the Production Order view.-Cause-The Production Processing Times report does not display Production Orders with the "In Preparation" status.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system. The Production Processing Times report is designed not to display Production Orders with the "In Preparation" status. -As a work around the user can use  below data sources to get information of data sources with In Preparation status.-Data source ID: SCMPOHDROPU01-Data source name: Production Order By Header Output Products-Data source ID: SCMPOHDROPU02-Data source name: Production Orders/Lot: Dates and Quantities-See Also-- [Link to relevant SAP Business ByDesign documentation or related KBAs]-Keywords

Title: S/MIME CERTIFICATE with Email: Email is Going to Expire Notification Message
Content: Symptom-You receive an e-mail notification with the message "S/MIME CERTIFICATE with e-mail: E-mail ABC is going to expire" and would like to understand what actions to take when facing this scenario.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Cause-This e-mail notification is sent when the S/MIME certificate of the inbound e-mail address is about to expire in the SAP Cloud for Customer system.-Resolution-You can renew the S/MIME certificate following the steps below:*-For SAP Cloud for Customer:-Navigate to Administrator work center.-Navigate to Common Tasks work center view.-Navigate to Configure S/MIME tab.-Navigate to Incoming E-mail tab.-Select the line item containing the e-mail from the table.-Click Renew S/MIME Certificate.-After following the above steps, the certificate is renewed and you should not experience the notification e-mail again.-For SAP Business by Design:-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Follow the steps 2-6 which are mentioned for SAP Cloud for Customer.-Once the certificate is renewed, it will have a validity period of 1 year from the day the renewal was done, so it should be annually reviewed.-* This might be required for non standard items without automatic renewal-Keywords-C4C; Cloud for Customer; Service; E-Mail; S/MIME Certificate; S/MIME CERTIFICATE with email: e-mail is going to expire; Notification; Common Tasks; Incoming E-Mail; S/MIME; SAP Business by Design, ByD

Title: In the Project on Adding New Team Member the Billable Option gets Check Bydefault
Content: Symptom-In the Project on adding New Team Member the Billable option gets check bydefault.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view .-In the Show field select All Projects and in the Find field enter PQR(where PQR is the project id) and click on the Go button.-Select the project PQR and click on Edit->Project Plan and goto subtab Work Breakdown Structure.-In the below section further navigate to the Work tab and click on the Add Row button.-Here, you can see for column name Billable the check-box gets selected bydefault.-Cause-Defaulting of the Billable option depends on the Project Type.-For example:If the project is of type Customer Project , Direct Cost Project etc which are billable then on adding the rows under the Work tab, bydefault it gets as billable.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: How to check the Statutory Mileage Rates and Advisory Fuel Rates (Mileage Rates - UK)
Content: Symptom-You want to know the updated Statutory Mileage Rates and Advisory Fuel Rates in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For Statutory Mileage Rates:-Go to the Business Configuration work center. -Go to the Overview view. -Search for the Fine Tune Activity: Statutory Mileage Rates.-Select Mileages Rates - UK.-Select Open.-Select Edit mileage reimbursement rates. -Go to the Statutory Rates tab. -Here, you can find the statutory mileage rates as specified by the authority based on the vehicle class.. -For Advisory Fuel Rates: These rates are maintained in the backend.-Resolution-For Statutory Mileage Rates: The rates are picked up from UK Government Portal - https://www.gov.uk/expenses-and-benefits-business-travel-mileage/rules-for-tax.-For Advisory Fuel Rates: The rates are picked up from the UK Government Portal - https://www.gov.uk/guidance/advisory-fuel-rates.-If there is any change on the portal, SAP updates the rates accordingly in the backend and publishes these rates via SAP for Me - https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/legalchangenotification. You must have to login with S-User ID and filter for Country/Region - United Kingdom(GB), Product - SAP Business ByDesign. You can find the details:-Note - The Advisory Fuel Rates are not visible over the UI. KBA - 2957730 - UK: How To Check the Advisory Fuel Rates Used in Expense Reports-See Also-Configuration Guide for Mileage Rates - UK-Keywords-Statutory Mileage Rates, Advisory Fuel Rates, Mileage Rates - UK

Title: Unable to Create Project Type XYZ.
Content: Symptom-When creating a New Project the Project Type XYZ  (XYZ represents the project type for ex : Customer project with sales integration) is not available under Project Type drop down menu.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Project Management work center.-Choose New Project under Common Tasks.-New Project floor plan opens.-While entering Initial Data under Project Type dope down menu you can see the Project Type XYZ is not available.-Cause-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the project and the Open Activity List button.-Choose the Fine-Tune arrow.-Find and choose the Project Types activity-Choose Open button.-Here you could see the in the column Obsolete if the check box is checked for the Project Type XYZ, the Project Type XYZ will be Obsoleted it means no more you can use this project type while creating the New project. -Resolution-If you want to use the Project Type XYZ while creating the New Project kindly uncheck the check box and save it will enable the project type XYZ in your system.

Title: "Authorization Code Not Available" Error in User Registration for OAUTH2 Web Services
Content: Symptom-You are trying to setup a Concur integration with SAP Business ByDesign, however upon trying to register a user for OAuth to perform the integration tasks, the Access Permission Status column shows a red icon, and when hovering the icon the following message appears:-"Authorization Code Not Available".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services work center view.-Select the CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT service provider entry.-In the table that appears below, you can see the users with the mentioned Access Permission Status icon.-Even if the correct access key is set for the user according to the integration guide, there is no change in the user status.- Cause-The issue is caused due to an incorrect API server link configured in the Business Configuration activity Integration with Concur Solutions.-As an example, if your Concur server URL is "https://eu2.concursolutions.com", it should be maintained in the business configuration as "https://eu2.api.concursolutions.com".-Furthermore, please ensure that the Concur Integration communication "Concur Integration (JWT)" is not isolated.-Resolution-To check and adjust the configuration, please follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select your current implementation project and click on Open Activity List.-Search for the activity Integration with Concur Solutions and open it.-In the Service Provider table, select the entry CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT.-Click on the button Register Client.-In the API Server URL and Authentication Server URL fields, maintain the Concur URL as described in the example above (inserting ".api." after the server identifier of the URL).-Click on the button Save and Close.-To check the communication arrangement, please follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Communication Arrangements view.-Search and select communication arrangement Concur Integration (JWT).-Click on the De-isolate button.-After checking the steps above, you can try to re-register the user (by removing it, and then re-entering the user again).-See Also-Replicating Data After SAP Business ByDesign Client Copy-Keywords-ECC, Concur, Client, Replication, Token

Title: How to Descope Active Budget Control
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to descope the Budget control.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-No steps to reproduce.-Cause-There are budgets available and thus you cannot descope the Budget Control.-Resolution-Firstly the user has to remove this Budgets from the system before revoming Budget Control from scoping:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Budget Release view. -Delete them. -Secondly, the user has to uncheck the Budget Check for Purchase Orders.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view. -Select activity Budget Control.-Open it.-If the Budget Check is marked for Purchase Orders, unmark it. -Save it. -Thirdly the user has to unmark the Budget Relevant checkbox in the activity Budget Queries:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for the activity Budget Queries. -Open it. -Select Edit G/L account groups for reporting.-Select the relevant G/L Account Group.-Select the Budget relevant check box-Fourthly, ensure that the user removes the Budget Category in the respective Product's master data:-Open the Product's master data.-Click in View All button. -Navigate to Valuation tab.-Maintain the Budget Category as per your business requirement. -Fifthly, ensure to remove the Budget Category in respective Product Category from Product Category work center.-Sixthly, please also disable a Cost Center for Budget Check from "Organizational Management work center" and "Org Structures view" by unmarking the Budget Check Enabled flag.-Seventeenthly, if necessary consider to descope the scoping question below:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project entry titled "First Implementation".-Click in Edit Project Scope button. -Click in Next button until reach to "4. Questions" section. -Expand "Financial and Management Accounting".-Expand "Management Accounting".-Expand "Financial Planning".-In the group "Budget Control", unscope the question "Do you want to perform budget checks during the integrated procurement or manual invoicing process?"-Save it. -See Also-KBA: 3223379 - Error Message: Field Budget category not supplied/missing for budget check-Keywords-Budget; Check; Release; Active; Control; Cost Center

Title: Error "Supplementary sickness pay rule code not valid" during employee replication
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- Error message "Supplementary sickness pay rule code not valid" is thrown while trying to replicate an employee to SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Go to Employees view.-Filter the list by "Failed/Not Started" status.-Search for the relevant ID.-Open Application Log.-Cause-Once enabling Employee Replication, the Personnel Administration work center is deactivated. But before enabling Employee Replication, this employee already had the Supplementary Sickness Pay Rule Code maintained.-Resolution-Development team has developed a program (ZPA_MODIFY_SICK_PAY_DATA) to remove all existing Sick Pay Supplement for employees.-Make sure to request customer's authorization to remove it from backend.-Development will follow the below steps to execute the report:-Access the backend program using T-Code SE38.-Enter the program name ZPA_MODIFY_SICK_PAY_DATA.-Click on the 'execute' button.-Upon reaching the selection screen, please take note of the following instructions:-Choose the appropriate radio button(s) (One, Multiple, or All Employees).-Select the corresponding checkboxes as required (One, Multiple, or All Employees).-For Single or Multiple Employee selection, input the relevant employee numbers. Should you opt for the update for all employees: Select the 'All Employees' radio button. No employee numbers are necessary for this selection.-Finally, execute the report program either in Test Mode (Simulation) or without Test Mode. Upon completion, the sick pay supplement code will be removed, and the results will be displayed accordingly.-See Also-Jira https://jira.tools.sap/browse/BYDDEV-11278 created to have this report in the backend.-Keywords-supplementary pay, sick pay supplement, sick pay, supplement

Title: MCS Logon Mode Popup Appears Upon Logging into Tenant in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK)
Content: Symptom-You are trying to log in to the tenant in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK) and a pop up screen appears for Multi-Customer Solution Logon Mode. This mode has 2 options such as:-Load MCS Solution > Installation Key-Deploy MCS Solution.-Without selecting any of these options you will not be able to login to the tenant.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Launch Cloud Applications Studio in your system.-Provide the tenant details and credentials for Logon.-Pop up appears.-Cause-This can happen due to below 2 reasons:-If you have assigned the MCS work center assignment under Partner development Work Center in the User and Access Management work center view.-If you have created a MCS solution in this tenant.-Resolution-Please find the resolution for both the above mentioned use cases:---Case 1: You will have to unassign the MCS view from the user assignement in Application and User Management work center view in the UI.--Case 2: You will have to provide the MCS key to login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK). The MCS key would have generated during the first deployment of the MCS solution to this tenant.-Keywords-MCS key pop up-unable to login to SDK due to MCS key-Multi customer solution key required-Installation key required-mcs key pop up,not possible to access sdk,cannot login to sdk due to mcs key

Title: System Dumps While Creating New Return to Supplier Document From Outbound Logistics Work Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY**-You receive dump when creating new return to supplier document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Return to Supplier.-Enter the corresponding inbound delivery ID.-Select the item line and click on Next button.-On the new page (step 2), system dump (500 internal error).-Go to backend, T-code ST22, you find the application information of this dump:-Triggering application component: AP-SRM-FND-/SRMAP/CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION, Program:/SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDH, Include:/SRMAP/LFND_PDHU34, Position:348-Info: Fatal Runtime Exception occured-/APORS/CX_PARAMETER_ERROR, Program:/SRMAP/CL_FND_REFERENCES======CP, Include:/SRMAP/CL_FND_REFERENCES======CM00U, Position:139-Info: Creation of link failed-Cause-There are temporary persistence locks in backend need to be deleted.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to delete the inconsistent database entries:-Go to T-code: SE11-Database Table: /SRMAP/D_44LINK-Click on Display button.-Click on Contents button on the new page.-Locate field: BO_1_NODE_KEY, and enter value: ##*, and Execute.-You will be able to see all the lock entries.-Select All, and click on Display.-Enter: /h in code bar, then you will see message on the bottom of the screen: Debugging switched on. Click Enter button.-In ABAP Debugger, double click on 'c_code'.-Change the value 'SHOW' to 'DELE'. Presee Enter button on your keyboard.-Click on Continue  (F8), and back to the entry, you will see the Delete Entry button enabled now.-Click on Delete Entry button and Next Entry button, until all the entries are deleted.-Once all the entries are deleted, please also check there is no entry under BO_2_NODE_KEY (by entering ##* to see if any entries there).-Keywords-Creation of link failed, Return to supplier, Dump, Triggering application component: AP-SRM-FND-/SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDH-/SRMAP/CL_FND_PDAO_FACADE=====CP-/SRMAP/FND_PDOBJREL_GET_STABS

Title: User Password Has Been Locked Due to Many Incorrect Login Attempts
Content: Symptom-The password has been forgotten and has been locked due to multiple incorrect login attempts.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the tenant URL.-In the User ID field, insert your User ID.-In the Password field, insert your password.-Click on Log On button (in SAP Business ByDesign) or Sign in button (in SAP Cloud for Customer).-Message appears: Password has been locked due to many incorrect login attempts-Cause-The password has been locked due to many incorrect login attempts.-Resolution-When a password is locked due to multiple incorrect login attempts, users have the option to change their password through a simple process. The password recovery can be performed by clicking on the "Forgot Password?" (SAP Cloud for Customer) or "Forgot your password?" (SAP Business ByDesign) link in the login screen. This functionality provides a convenient solution for users who may have forgotten their password or are unable to access their account due to the lockout.-Upon clicking the link, users should be redirected to a password recovery page. This page often requires them to verify their identity to ensure the security of their account. The authentication method consists in receiving a verification code via e-mail, therefore the user needs to have the unique e-mail maintained in the Business User.-NOTE: If same e-mail ID is maintained for multiple users then forgot password functionality doesn't work.-It's worth noting that for security reasons, SAP does not unlock or reset user passwords, unless under exceptional circumstances. Our approach prioritizes the protection of user accounts and ensures that password management remains in the hands of the users themselves.-See Also-3011997 - Unable to Generate New Password From the Forgot Password Link-Keywords-Password, Locked, ByD, C4C, Many Attempts

Title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) on License Management in SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-This document covers some basic and frequently asked questions regarding License options in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-1 - Where to find the Licenses Usage of the System? -Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to User Subscriptions View.-All the different licenses usage in the system are displayed. -NOTE: The license usage is only applied for production tenants. -2 - How License Types Are Categorized/Mapped to Core, Advanced and Self-Service Users? -The license model is divided into three categories: core users, advanced users, and self-service users under user subscription after the 2102 release. -Initially, the license type was differentiated as follows, which is the mapping between core users, advanced users, and self-service users (latest):-Standard Self-Service User-Standard Enterprise User-SCM Enterprise User-CRM Sales Team User-SCM Self-Service User-SCM Team User-Project Manager Self-Service User-Project Management Team User- The license types are now mapped as follows: -Old License Type-New License Type-Standard Enterprise User-SCM Enterprise User-Advanced User-CRM Sales Team User-Project Management Team User-SCM Team User-Core User-Project Manager Self-Service User-Standard Self-Service User-SCM Self-Service User-Self-Service User--In addition, refer to the KBA below for further reference on the matter: -3434377 - How License Types Are Categorized/Mapped to Core, Advanced and Self-Service Users? -3 - What to do if the users are locked, however they are still consuming a license in the system? -In this case, it is recommended the below steps to synchronize the employee data:-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to User Subscriptions View.-Click Synchronize Employee Data button.-Also, refer to the KBA below for further information: -2742875 - Business User ID and Contact Details are not in Sync under User Subscription in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)-4 - What to do if the license type in the system is being updated, however they are not correct? -In case there are incorrect license assigned after synchronizing, open a case with the component SRD-CC-CI-CCS, as this might be a synchronization issue in the backend. -5 - How can be determine the percentage of utilization of the licenses assigned to users? -There is no concept of utilization percentage of the user licenses, even if a user does not actively use the system at all, it still consumes a license. -Furthermore, the license purchase can be of type self-service, core and advanced user license, as mentioned in the question #2. -Each license includes specific work center views. The License type for the different work centers and work center views can be checked in the access rights configuration of the system.-Also, refer to the KBA to check which license is defined for which work center view:-2821292 - How to Assign/Change User License Type for a Business User in SAP Business ByDesign -Therefore, the license type a user consumes is determined by the work centers view assigned to the user. The system calculates this based on the assigned work centers.-The defined purchased numbers of licenses and assigned numbers of users to a specific license can be seen in the Service Control Center work center.-Related Documents:--3169605 - License Type Changes after the Activation of Access Restrictions--User Subscriptions Quick Guide-6 - How to restrict business users to consume license in SAP Business ByDesign? -If a business user is consuming a license, however it should not be consuming this license, the user can be locked to remove the license consumption by following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center (in SAP Business ByDesign) or Administrator Work Center (in SAP Cloud for Customer).-Go to Business User View.-Search the respective user.-Click on Edit Attribute.-In the new window, check the User Locked check box.-Click on Save and Close.-Only active business users from the production system will consume a license type in SAP Business ByDesign and will be considered for the billing cycle. -Counted user check box in the Service Control Center work center is a reference to know the overview of license type assignments and the active users in the production system. -When you add a user subscription, you will be able to see the details in the user subscription view of the Service Control Center work center. This view will display the license types, how they are being used, and which users are assigned to each license type.-Related documents:-All About Contact Details & User Subscription - ByD--2659697 - How to Restrict Business Users to Consume License in ByD/C4C System -7 - How to find the license related reports in SAP Business ByDesign? -To check the license type defined for a business role in a report, follow the below steps:-Login to the Production tenant.-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Designed Reports View.-In the search field, insert CCABUSINESS_ROLE.-Click on All Business Roles to open the report.-Click on the button "Click here to start the report".-Go to View.-Add Row Field named "Simplified License Code".-Also, refer to the KBA below for further information: -3065414 - How to find the License Related Reports in SAP Business ByDesign?-8 - What to do if the User subscription view is not displaying any user subscribed?-Consult with the respective CSP (Customer Success Partner), AE (Account Executive), or sales team to ensure the entitlements are assigned correctly and that the license contract and renewals are up to date.-If the entitlements are assigned correctly and the license contract are up to date, however no user has license subscription listed in the system, open a case with the component SRD-CC-CI-CCS.-See Also-3434377 - How License Types Are Categorized/Mapped to Core, Advanced and Self-Service Users?-3169605 - License Type Changes after the Activation of Access Restrictions-3065414 - How to find the License Related Reports in SAP Business ByDesign?--2742875 - Business User ID and Contact Details are not in Sync under User Subscription in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)-2821292 - How to Assign/Change User License Type for a Business User in SAP Business ByDesign --User Subscriptions Quick Guide-All About Contact Details & User Subscription - ByD -Keywords-license, FAQ, User Subscription, byd

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on ByD Output Management
Content: Symptom-This KBA is the consolidation of some of the frequently occurring issues and Queries related to ByD Output Management-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-Documentation-Output Management - Configuration-1. SAP Cloud Print Manager Stopped Working-Refer to the KBA 3241218 - The Printings From SAP Cloud Print Manager Stopped Working Without Reason-5. Customer is trying to send mail, but it is neither landing inbox or spam-Check the DKIM Setting-Refer the below Blogs:-https://blogs.sap.com/2022/06/14/next-generation-cloud-delivery-transition-new-business-bydesign-e-mail-infrastructure/-https://blogs.sap.com/2021/01/15/dkim-key-activation-for-business-emails-in-cloud-for-customerc4c-business-bydesignbyd/-Check in the below tool, status should show Green-https://dkimcore.org/tools/keycheck.html-3. Within the Output tab, the Email-text looks fine.When the mail goes out, EMail text has wrong format (For example, Overlapping/fonts)-Instead of copy paste the template code into the system, manually type it all over again and only keep the placeholders.-5. As per the system design, the email subject line is limited to 50 characters.-Output Management - A2X-For the queries or setup related questions about Web Services / XML based output, refer to below blogs-How to get SAP Business ByDesign events in a loosely coupled solution-SAP Business ByDesign Output Management – part 1-SAP Business By Design Output Management – part 2-Output Management - Forms-Refer KBA 3292558 - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) On Forms Flexibility-Output Management - Others-Is ByD supports C-XML Scenarios?-Yes, for more details refer to SAP community blog - Is SAP ByD supporting CXMAL scenarios-Keywords-OM FAQ, Output management, forms, Print, email, a2x, fonts-om faq, output management, forms, print,

Title: Project is not Available for Selection Under Availability Calendar of an Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Employee: ABC is being committed to the project: DEF, however, the project is not showing in the Availability Calendar.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management workcenter-Go to Project view-Search for Project: DEF-Go to Team and staffing-Navigate to Team subtab-Search and Select Employee: ABC-Navigate to Show Availability-Choose Expand-Notice Project: DEF does not show up in the Availability Calendar of an Employee: ABC-Or-Go to Resource Management workcenter-Go to Resource Profiles view-Search for Employee: ABC-Under Resource Availability set the timeframe (For eg. 01.01.2024-30.06.2024), notice Project: DEF is missing.-Cause-This issue occurs whenever we don't save the project commitments after removing the record and make the new changes.-Resolution-Check for the erroneous messages from SRT_MONI with 'sender party' 'ProjectProcessing' and receiver party  'EmployeeStaffing*', by following the below steps:-Login to the Backend System-Go to SRT_MONI transaction-Scroll Down to the Sender Information and enter 'ProjectProcessing' -In Receiver Information enter 'EmployeeStaffing*'-Select Execute-In this scenario you will receive two XI messages one is for Delete and the other is for Change-Cancel these erroneous messages-Keywords-SRT_MONI,  Sender Information, ProjectProcessing, EmployeeStaffing, Project, Availability Calendar, Resource Availability

Title: No Approver Is Determined For Project Purchase Request.
Content: Symptom-When the Project Manager himself creates the Project Purchase Request, system is unable to determine the approver. The system will trigger an unassigned task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Checking the Purchase Request:-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the project.-Go to Products tab and choose the Purchase Request Approval sub view.-Choose the Project Purchase Request XYZ.-Choose the Approval tab, you can see the No Approver found; task is unassigned message.- Checking the Approval Tasks List:-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Approvals view.-Choose the Expenses and Purchases sub view.-Here you will not be able to see the approval Task for the Purchase Request XYZ﻿.-Cause-The issue occurs because the Automatic Approval checkbox is not activated on the approval process.-If the project manager's substitute creates the project purchase request, it is expected that automatic approval option is selected in the approval process maintained in the Business Configuration. If the automatic approval is not selected then the system will not determine the approver and it will trigger the unassigned task.-Steps to Configure the automatic approval process:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Choose the Task Distribution view.-Choose the Approval Processes sub view.-Choose the active approval process for Project Purchase Request.-Copy the approval process and create a new Project Purchase Request and enable the Automatic Approval check box.-Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: How to Anlayze Holiday Calendar Issue when the Holiday List for Employee's are Empty
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 2 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-User have setup a holiday calendar for Qatar within the Business Configuration Work Center, under the UAE List of holiday calendars. Subsequently, user has performed day closure for employees under the Qatar entity (QA123). However, the holidays for Qatar are not visible for employees.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work center-Select  on Employee view-Search for the employee ABC  and edit-Go to Time Profile tab-Select Show Holiday Calendar -The Holiday list is empty-Cause-Due to inconsistency in the calendar backend tables, subsequent processes are not functioning properly.-Resolution-We always require a pairing of a holiday calendar, which is linked to a working day calendar. This connection is assigned through a factory calendar, with only the holiday calendar and the working day calendar being visible to the customer.-Holiday calendars define holidays, while working day calendars specify weekends. The combination of a working day calendar with an associated holiday calendar determines whether a particular day is classified as a working day.-Holiday Calendar Validity: -So starting with a holiday calendar ID this ID has to be found in the table /ISDT/C_CS_PHC (column HOLIDAY_CAL_ID).-In table TFACD the holiday calendar ID is found in column HOCID and the corresponding factory calendar ID in column IDENT.-This factory calendar ID is also found in table /ISDT/C_CS_WDC (column FACTORY_CAL_ID) together with the assigned working day calendar in column WRK_DAY_CAL_CODE.-In table THOCI you find the validity of a holiday calendar: start year in column VJAHR and end year in column BJAHR.-In table TFACD you find the validity of a factory/holiday calendar together with the definition of working days (1) and non-working days (0). The columns are Monday=MOTAG, Tuesday=DITAG, Wednesday=MIWCH, Thursday=DOTAG, Friday=FRTAG, Saturday=SATAG, Sunday=SOTAG.-Additionally, some custom-defined holiday calendars are no longer valid. The end year of validity can be verified in tables THOCI (column BJAHR) and TFACD (column BJAHR). If an extension of this validity period is required, the relevant incident should be raised to component AP-RC-DT, as the extension can only be performed via transaction BCE within the current workspace.-Assigned Holiday Calendar:-The holidays, which are assigned to a holiday calendar, are found at table THOC: Column IDENT contains the holiday calendar ID and column FTGID contains the assigned holidays.-The definition of these holidays is found at table THOL with the holiday ID at column FTGID.-The holiday type is visible in column REGEL.-The irregular holidays with type U in column REGEL of table THOL are defined in table THOLU.-Holidays of type V have a specific distance to Easter, as defined in column ABSTD of table THOL.-  Code list of possible definitions for guaranteed public holidays in column GARANT of table THOL:-E - Thursday moved to next day-D - Thursday moved to previous day-G - Friday moved to next day-F - Friday moved to previous day-Y - Sunday moved to next day-S - Sunday moved to previous day-M - Saturday/Sunday moved to next/previous day-X - Saturday/Sunday moved to next day-V - Saturday/Sunday moved to previous day-Z – Friday/Saturday moved to next day-A – Thursday/Friday moved to next day-  In table THOCS you find for every factory calendar (column IDENT) if each day of the year is a working day (1) or a holiday (0) according to the definitions in the above mentioned tables.-In table TFACS you find for every holiday calendar (column IDENT) if each day of the year is a working day (1) or a weekend or holiday (0) according to the definitions in the above mentioned tables. Compared to table THOCS, table TFACS contains the weekends as non-working-days in addition.-If the tables in a customer system do not fit into this picture, then something is wrong. Forward the Inc to Devlopment AP-RC-DT-Keywords-Holiday Calendar, Employee, List, Empty

Title: System Crashes While Releasing Outbound Delivery
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**Internal Use Only**-When you try to release Outbound Delivery, system crashes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Search required ID.-Select and choose Release.-System crashes.-You find below dump details in ST22:-Application Information-Index Information-    1 "/DOC/OM_DOCUMENT_OUT_REQ" an exception has occured. The method "EXECUTE" of class-    2 "/DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR" contains errors, which are described in the exception chain-    3 below. Please open a ticket to the responsible component "AP-RC-OUT"!-    4 Triggering application component: AP-ACC-    5-    6 Exception chain (click button "Unformatted Display" for all details):-    7  1. Info: Inv. cost of material XXXX bus. resid. XX set of b-    8  2. Info: An exception with the type CM_FIA_MATLA occurred, but was neither handled locally,-    9  3. Info: Application error: Exception while calling method EXECUTE of action REFRESH_DEF_OR-   10  4. Info: Internal application error of business object /DOC/OM_DOCUMENT_OUT_REQ, /BOPF/CX_F-Cause-In material master data of the required materials, Cost Rate which is maintained is valid from MMDDYYYY, however the Delivery Date on the Outbound Delivery is set earlier than "valid from" for which no cost has been maintained in the material valuation of required materials with business residence. ( i.e. MMDDYYYY refers to Valid From date)-Additionally, the Delivery Date on the Outbound Delivery is set later than "valid to" date for which no cost has been maintained in the material valuation of required materials with business residence. and hence the cost is not valid.-Resolution-Go to the Product Portfolio workcenter.-Go to the Products view.-Search for the relevant Product ID.-Select and edit the product ID.-Choose View All.-Navigate to Valuation tab.-Select required Business Residence.-Maintain Cost Rate with Valid From as per Outbound Delivery Date.-Note: Check above dump details and update the customer accordingly.-Keywords-Dump, Outbound Delivery, Business residence, Cost Rate, Valuation, /DOC/OM_DOCUMENT_OUT_REQ, Inv. cost of material bus. resid. set of b,

Title: Error Message: Company tax arrangement for federal tax authority is missing or incomplete. For reporting purposes, the employer must have a valid company tax arrangement.
Content: Symptom-When you try to complete the payroll date, System throws below error message-Company tax arrangement for federal tax authority is missing or incomplete. For reporting purposes, the employer must have valid company tax arrangement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center-Choose the Work view.-Choose the open task.-Under open task choose the Complete Payroll Data - US (Hire) for XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of an employee)..-Choose the Edit .-Complete Payroll Data screen will appear select the USHR - US bi-weekly under payroll Group-Choose the Next.,-System Displays an error message Company tax arrangement for federal tax authority is missing or incomplete. For reporting purposes,the employer must have a valid company tax arrangement.-Cause-The error message referring to Company tax arrangement for federal tax authority is missing or incomplete. For reporting purposes, the employer must have a valid company tax arrangement is appearing because the company into which the employee is hired doesn't have a tax arrangement with the Federal Tax Authority. During payroll hire this is checked.-Resolution-Go to Personnel Administration work center.  -Choose the Tax Authorities subview under the view Authorities.-In the Find field, search for federal.-Choose the USA Federal Tax authority record that comes up.-Choose Tax Authority under Edit button.-The Tax Authority screen appear, go to tab Company Tax Arrangements.-Here an entry for the required company has to be maintained.

Title: Postings not Permitted For Project Task XYZ
Content: Symptom-While posting the Receipt Cancellation system displays an error message Postings not Permitted For Project Task XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Choose Receipts and Returns view.-Choose the Receipt Cancelation ABC.-Choose Edit button.-Now choose Post button, the system will display the above error message.-Cause-Whenever Service Agent cancels the Time Confirmation or Expense Report the system will post the Goods and Service Cancelation automatically to cancel the Goods and Service Receipt. But sometimes the Receipt Cancelation will not be posted automatically if the relevant Project Task with ID XYZ is Closed.-Resolution-You need to revoke completion of the Project Task XYZ status back to Released then post the Receipt Cancelation.-Follow steps mentioned below to revoke completion of the Project task XYZ status back to Released. This action needs to be performed by Project Manager.-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects View.-Choose Projects sub view.-Choose Project XYZ.-Choose Edit --> Project Plan Button.-Choose the Project Task XYZ.-Go to Basic Data tab.-Go to Project Task Status value help choose the Revoke Closure and Revoke Completion and Save.

Title: Incorrect Description In Access Restrictions For a Site Or Location
Content: Symptom-You are seeing an in-correct description of your Site while maintaining Access Restriction for a Business User.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Find the user and click on button Edit Access Rights.-Now go to the Access restriction tab.-Select the relevant work center view (as an example SCM_DELIVERYPROPOSALS view)-Scroll down to view the restricted sites , here if you see the description of site is in-correct.-Cause-The root cause of this issue is that for location or site no description has been maintained. Due to this a wrong text is displayed in case no description can be found for the location.-Resolution- Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data.-Select the Locations view.-Select the Location and click on button Edit.-Select the field Site Description and maintain the description as required.-Click on button Save.-Changes done above will reflect in the access rights screen, the next time you access the screen.-Keywords

Title: New Tax Codes Not Appearing For Downpayment Requests
Content: Symptom-New Tax Codes defined in the Business Configuration Fine tune activity - Tax on goods and services not appearing while creating Down payment Requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Down payment Request.-Click on the required Supplier.-Click on View All.-Navigate to Items tab and in the tax code field, in the drop down, you do not find the Tax codes defined in the Business Configuration Fine tune activity - Tax on goods and services-Resolution-For the Down payment requests for the country China, only the exemption related tax codes are required to be shown/selected. Hence the system will display only the following tax codes:--Purchase:-9 - Domestic purchase of exempted goods-12 - Exempted domestic purchase of products, down payment-13 - Imported goods (supplier invoice)--Keywords-New tax codes not appearing in Downpayments, Downpayment requests tax codes,

Title: Error Message 'Exchange rate for Euro and US Dollar for rate type ABC does not exist for DD.MM.YYYY' when Saving Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You create an expense report and save it. System may throw the below error messages:-Exchange rate for Euro and US Dollar for rate type ABC does not exist for DD.MM.YYYY-No calculation of settlement results due to inconsistent entries-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Servicess Overview view.-Select the New Expense Report link under Expenses.-After completing the Expense Report, select the Save or Submit button.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the exchange rate in specific period for the currency Euro and USD is not maintained.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to maintain the exchange rate:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Edit Exchange Rates under Common Tasks.-Select Default Exchange Rate Type in the Show field.-Select the Add Row button to maintain the exchange rate.

Title: Product is Created With Product Category ID Blank
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -The Product Category ID becomes blank during product creation and it's not possible to update it afterwards.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Access the Materials work center view.-Click New > Material.-Add all mandatory information, including Product Category ID.-Click Save.-The Product Category ID field will become empty and the message "Product Category ID missing" is raised. Attempts to edit the product and add this information will also be blocked by the same error message.-Cause-An inconsistency during the product's creation might have created an empty Product Category Assignment instance. To check this, follow the below instructions:-Access the SESFTS transaction.-In the Load BO by Proxy Name field, input PDM_MATERIAL and press the Enter key.-Next, click the arrow next to Load BO Node Instances button (folder icon) and select Load by Query > IDENTIFICATION...BY_ID.-In the popup, insert the product ID in the ProductID/content field and press the Enter key.-Once the record loads, click Navigate > TO_ROOT.-Next, click Navigate > PRODUCT_CATEGORY_ASSIGN.-There should be an instance for this node, with the main fields (PRODUCT_CATEGORY_ID_KEY) empty, similarly to the below screenshot.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, please obtain customer's authorization to do the following:-Navigate to the PRODUCT_CATEGORY_ASSIGN node of the relevant product in SESFTS as described in the previous step.-Click the Set Edit Mode button (pencil icon).-Click the Delete BO Node Instance button (trash can icon).-Save the changes.-Once this is done, the customer should be able to successfully add the Product Category ID from the frontend.-Keywords-Product Category ID, Missing, Blank, Cannot Update

Title: How to Influence the Creation of a Scheduled Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how you can influence the creation of a Scheduled Invoice Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Every night, a regular job automatically runs and checks the invoice dates. Per default the horizon taken into consideration is three days before the invoice date. This job creates scheduled invoice requests for the scheduled invoice dates.-Resolution-If you would like to change the default value in the horizon or you want to create a Scheduled Invoice Request immediately and would not like to wait for the regular job during the night you have the following option:-Change the horizon:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select your respective implementation project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tune step-Open the fine tuning activity Time Horizon for Scheduled Invoice Requests Run.-You can maintain the time horizon(in number of days) for the consideration of scheduled invoice requests run. The run only picks those scheduled invoice requests which fall within this time horizon from the date of run.-Save the fine tuning activity.-Trigger the scheduled invoice requests immediately:-Please follow KBA 2707172 - How to Manually Trigger a Scheduled Invoice Request for a Sales Order-See Also-Help Center Document: Invoice Schedule-Keywords-Invoice Schedule; Scheduled Invoice Request; not created; missing; Horizon;

Title: PDI Dump - CODE_GET_DESCRIPTION
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Dump raised relating to PDI script.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-  Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-This dump could be raised from simply opening a standard or custom work center or saving an instance on a given work centre.-Cause-The proxy datatype to which the ABAP generated code points, is a restore point tenant that is deleted.-Example-System ABC, with one live tenant 001.-PDI solution has been deployed successfully to this tenant, and the proxy datatype to which the ABAP generated code points to is from 001.-A restore point is requested, and a local tenant copy 002 is created (PDI solution will not be activated in this target tenant).-Without activation the ABAP generated code in 002 still points to the proxy datatype in 001.-002 is made a live tenant, and 001 is made as the restore-point tenant - status quo remains and this dump will not occur.-A third tenant, 003 is made as the live tenant, while 001 & 002 are now restore point tenants.-Again, in all three tenants, the ABAP generated code points to the datatype in 001.-The issue now arises when tenant 001 is deleted. At this point, the proxy datatype in tenant 001 is also deleted, due to which, the ABAP generated code points to a datatype that no longer exists in the system.-When this happens, the dumps start occurring on the UI.-Dumps appear as below:-Resolution-Perform a backend activation of the absl script detailed in the dump call stack.-Use the following KBA for steps on how to perform this backend activation - 2980177 - SE38 - Activating Pdi solution files in the backend-Keywords-Restore Point Deletion; CODE_GET_DESCRIPTION; CL_PDI_SFW_AS_METHOD_UTIL;

Title: Project Expense and Revenue Planning using Microsoft Excel® - Known Issues
Content: Symptom-1. In the excel, there can be only 8 project task hierarchy levels. All the tasks in hierarchy after the 8th level will be displayed at the 8th level itself.-2. Filtering and sorting in the excel does not ensure data consistency. User is advised not to use those functionalities.-3. Selecting multiple rows, and using the copy/cut and paste function is not advised as it will result in data inconsistency.-4. Translation of the excel worksheet name will always be in English and it should not be changed.-5. Row grouping is not ensured if Microsoft Excel® provided insert is used.-6. Title: Concur Tax Calculation Failed Error Message
Content: Symptom-You post an Expense Report in Concur and receive the error message:-Tax code only for CONCUR - Domestic Acquisition (Exempt) not valid for country Germany on tax date dd.mm.yyyy-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In Business Configuration work centre, for the Tax Code XXX with Description "only for CONCUR - Domestic Acquisition (Exempt)" you use in the Expense Report the "Valid From Date" and/or "Valid To Date" is not maintained.-XXX stands for the Tax Code.-Resolution-You need to maintain both Valid From Date and Valid To Date of the Tax Code you use in the Expense Report.-Keywords-Concur, Expense Report, Tax Code, Tax Description, Tax Calculation, Tax Code Only For Concur.

Title: Unable to see time information for projects in approval
Content: Symptom-You are unable to see time information entered by employees against projects that must be approved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Approvals > Time Recordings view-No actionable time information is displayed.-Cause-The time recording approvals can only be seen in the respective project manager's approval list.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.

Title: The keyfigures are displays as 0.00 value in the Customer Project Overview Report.
Content: Symptom-When you Run the Customer Project Overview Report for some customer projects the keyfigures like Quantity-Ordered, Net Value- Ordered, Net Value - Invoiced is displays as 0.00 value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Choose the Reports view and click on List sub view.-Choose all reports in Show field and filter with Customer Project Overview Report in the Find field.-Open the Customer Project Overview Report in web browser.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the keyfigures like Quantity-Ordered, Net Value- Ordered, Net Value - Invoiced is displays as 0.00 value in the Customer Project Overview Report.-Or-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Reports view and click on List sub view.-Choose all reports in Show field and filter with Customer Project Overview Report in the Find field.-Open the Customer Project Overview Report in a web browser.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the keyfigures like Quantity-Ordered, Net Value- Ordered, Net Value - Invoiced is displays as 0.00 value in the Customer Project Overview Report.-Cause-This Customer Project Overview Report displays all customer project with sales integration and without sales integration. If the project type is Customer Project without Sales Integration so this type of project  do not have a Sales Order linkage, hence you donot see any values for key figures like Quantity-Ordered, Net Value- Ordered Net Value - Invoiced.-Resolution-System is working fine as this is designed behavior.-Keywords-Customer Project Overview Report-Quantity-Ordered-Net Value- Ordered-Net Value - Invoiced

Title: Change source of supply is grayed out in Stock Transfer Proposal for a Business User
Content: Symptom-When trying to access option Change Source of Supply for a Stock Transfer Proposal ID KLM (KLM means Stock Transfer Proposal ID), the option Change Source of Supply is disabled from Business User ID DEF (DEF means user ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Control Work Center.-Navigate to Process Stock Transfer Proposals View.-Select drop down All proposals by selection.-Select any STO proposal and select actions --> Change Source of Supply.-The Change Source of Supply is grayed out.-Cause-As the Business User DEF is not assigned to either of work center views: SCM_PROCESSPRODNPRPSLS (Process Production Proposals) and SCM_PROCESSPURCHASEPRPSLS (Process Purchase Proposals), hence Change of Source of Supply button is disabled for this user.-Resolution-To enable button Change Source of Supply it is necessary to assign either of work center views: SCM_PROCESSPRODNPRPSLS (Process Production Proposals) and SCM_PROCESSPURCHASEPRPSLS (Process Purchase Proposals), as follows:-Navigate to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business Users View.-Select User DEF.-Select Edit --> Access Rights.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Assign to User work center views SCM_PROCESSPRODNPRPSLS (Process Production Proposals) and SCM_PROCESSPURCHASEPRPSLS.-Select Save.-Keywords-Change Source of Supply is grayed out in Stock Transfer Proposal for a Business User, SCM_PROCESSPRODNPRPSLS (Process Production Proposals) and SCM_PROCESSPURCHASEPRPSLS, Change Source of supply is disabled,  "Change source of supply" is disabled from your Business User

Title: PDI had thrown an Exception : Solution YABC is not valid.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the customer / partner is trying to do some adaptation changes via adaptation mode in the SAP Business ByDesign system, the system throws an error message as, PDI had thrown an Exception :  Solution YABC is not valid (YABC represents the solution name).--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to any XYZ workcenter-Select any XYZ view.-Select Adapt button and select the Enter Adaptation Mode .-Once again select Adapt button and select Edit This Screen.-The screen will go to adapt mode here try to do some changes system throws an error message as, PDI had thrown an Exception : Solution YABC is not valid.--Cause-When the SDK user tries to do the regular adaptation, the system throws an error message  PDI had thrown an Exception :  Solution YABC is not valid because the solution is deleted.-Resolution-If you want to do a regular adaptation (without recording it in an add-on solution), then you have to use a user which is not enabled for the SDK (which does not have the work center Partner development assigned but the Application and User Management should be assigned). Unassign the Partner development work center.

Title: Process Integration Application Error: The project task XXX for sales order YYY was not posted
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-PI (Process Integration) message ends with the following error:-The project task  XXX for sales order YYY was not posted (here XXX is the name of the project task and YYY is the sales order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to back end.-Enter the transaction SRT_MONI.-Enter the message ID.-Select Execute.-Select the message and then select Error Log.-You can see the following error under short text: The project task  XXX for sales order YYY was not posted-Cause-The sales order XXX is posting on the project YYY that is closed or completed, which is not allowed.-The project should be in released status so that the postings can go through.-Resolution-Following checks have to be done to be sure that the issue is as described:-Check 1: The error message should be The project task  XXX for sales order YYY was not posted.-Check 2: When the sales order YYY is opened the error message: Postings not permitted for Project Task XXX should be visible occurs.-Check 3: The project of the task XXX should be in either closed or in completed status.-    To resolve the issue the customer has to change the status of the project to released:- Go to Project Management work center.- Select Projects view.- Select All Projects and find the project of the task XXX and select Go.- Select the Project ID to open the project and then select View All button.- Change the status of the project to Closed by selecting the option Revoke Closure in the basic data sub-tab, this changes the status to Completed.- Select Revoke Completion to change the status to released and select Save.- Also check if the period where the posting is happening is Open.- Restart the stuck PI message.-  Created by BYDMS-KB-PI-Keywords-process integration,project task for sales order not posted

Title: Error Message "Product Category ID Missing" While Saving a Material
