Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you save a Material (creation/modification), system throws below error message:-Save Failed-Product Category ID missing-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-After adding / updating the details, select Save.-Cause-Potential cause for the issue is that there is erroneous entry in the Site Product Category Assignment in addition to the correct entry with site UUID as 000000000.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, the erroneous entry should be removed and the steps are as followed:-Login into backend.-Go to SESFTS.-BO "PDM_MATERIAL".-Navigate through Root -> INVENTORY_PROCESS_INFO -> SITE_PROD_CATEG_ASSIGN -> SITE_UUID.-Highlight the Site UUID with 000000000.-Remove and save the changes.-  See Also-2843079 - Product is Created With Product Category ID Blank-Keywords-product category id missing, material, save

Title: Unable to Generate New Password From the Forgot Password Link - Internal Checks
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When using the password reset self-service, the system sends a token to the user's e-mail address, to set up a new password. However, the user does not receive the token in the e-mail address provided.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the system's log-on screen.-Click the link Forgot your Password? (SAP Business ByDesign) or Forgot password? (SAP Cloud for Customer).-A popup screen will come up, requesting to enter the user's e-mail address.-Automatically a new popup will request the user to enter the token that was sent to the e-mail address. -Cause-There might be several causes related to this issue. Some of them are listed below, with their resolution.-Resolution-I - The e-mail address of the user is not maintained in the system-For SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Regular Tasks views.-Select option Change Workplace Contact Data.-Search for the Employee to be edited.-Maintain e-mail address under Communication Data. -For SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Administrator work center-Access the Employee view.-Search and select the employee to be edited.-Click Edit.-The employee's TI will open in Edit mode, where you can change the e-mail address.-II - The same e-mail address is used by several Users-Go to backend transaction SESFTS.-Input BUSINESS_PARTNER in the Load BO by Proxy Name field, then press Enter.-Click Load By Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_COMMU_DATA.-Enter the e-mail address in field EMailURI/content. -Click the Continue button (or press Enter). -Note:-If there are multiple entries for category 1 indicate that the same e-mail ID is used multiple times.-If there are multiple entries by category 2, one person is responsible for more accounts.-To check which business users have the duplicate e-mail after performing the steps above:-Expand the new entry generated under BO Instance Structure.-Expand the option AssignedIdentity.-The business user ID will be displayed.-  III - Check the E-Mail and Fax Settings fine-tuning activity-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Search and open activity E-Mail and Fax Settings.-In the next screen, click the E-Mail and Fax Settings link.-Under the section E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System, check if option "Send all e-mails to this address" is selected.-When this configuration is maintained, all outbound e-mails from the system will be sent to the e-mail address determined in the field underneath it, so that the customers can check how the e-mails are displayed before using them in productive circumstances. Since all outbound e-mails are routed to the e-mail address maintained in this fine-tuning activity, this includes password reset tokens.-Please advise the customer to set this option to "Send all e-mails to business partners" so that the users receive their password reset tokens as expected.-Note: this functionality is only available in test systems.-IV - The e-mail address is maintained under Personnel Administration, but does not show in Details of Business User-It is possible that the IDENTITY business object has inconsistent/null references in the address attributes. This inconsistency causes e-mails to not be sent to the users affected.-Please check KBA 2124865 - E-Mail Address Not Displaying in Business User Details.-V - Check the outbound send requests-Go to backend transaction SOST. -Set the Send Date and Time to a timeframe which includes the time of the password rest attempt.-Check if the Request has been sent (Status: Transmitted) to the user address (Recipient). -If settings show that mail was delivered successfully from our side and the customer still does not receive e-mails, send incident to development component BC-SRV-COM -VI - Ask customer to check their SMTP for spam blockers-Go to backend transaction SCOT > Outbound Messages to check SMTP Nodes and Settings (Sender Domain, Mail Host, Etc... ). -Contact customer and ask him to review their SMTP server and check if they are blocked. -VII - Check or configure S/MIME certificate-The following should be checked by the customer:-Go to the Common Tasks work center view. -In SAP Business ByDesign, under the Application and User Management work center.-In SAP Cloud for Customer, under the Administrator work center.-Access the option Configure S/MIME.-Navigate to the Outgoing E-Mail tab. -Check if the certificate has expired in the system.-Click Renew S/MIME Certificate. -Save the changes and test the scenario again. -VIII - Check encryption for outgoing e-mails-Go to Configure S/MIME (see above) and navigate to tab Activate S/MIME. -Check if customer has selected Encrypt Outgoing E-Mails. -If yes, the system is expecting user's S/MIME certificate to send an encrypted e-mail while trying to reset password. Therefore, ask the customer to uncheck/unselect this option and then test the Forgot Password feature again. -IX - Check the logs for Attempts of Usage of the Password Reset Self-Service feature-See KBA 2135939 - Accessing the Logs for the Attempts of Usage of the Password Reset Self-Service Feature.-X - If Forgot Password screen doesn't launch and asks for user ID/password-See KBA 1866086 - Password Reset Link Requests Logon Credentials.-XI - Check the S/MIME Encryption for Password Reset E-Mails option.-The below changes need to be checked and requested.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the First Implementation Project.-Click on Open Activity List button.-Go to the Fine-tuning tab.-In the search field, insert E-Mail Encryption and Signature Check.-Under Outgoing E-Mail section, check the E-mail scenario "S/MIME Encryption for Password Reset E-Mails".-In the E-mail scenario for Password Reset E-Mails, it is recommended to change the encryption option from Encrypt to Encrypt if possible.-Keywords-Forgot Password, New Password, Token Not Received, e-mail, SRD-CC-IAM, byd, c4c

Title: Tax code is Incorrectly Determined in Supplier Invoice created from Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Incorrect Tax code is picked up in new invoice created from preceding purchase order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go to Invoice entry view. -Show: "All Orders to be Invoiced".-Search for the Purchase Order ID.-Click in New Invoice button. -Navigate to Items tab and Taxes subtab. -The tax code which is determined automatically does not match with the Purchase Order's Tax Code. -However when creating a new supplier invoice or a new purchase order with the same data, without copying and the tax code, the Tax Code is correctly determined.-Cause-The user has initially maintained the VAT Registration Number and created documents like purchase order using it. At that point of time, since the VAT number was maintained in the Supplier master data, the system assumed that the Supplier is VAT registered.-But later on, the user has changed the tax numbers in the Supplier master data. The user replaced the VAT Number with another tax number. The user has basically changed its type to something else.-Now, when the user copies this old Purchase Order or create a Supplier Invoice for it, the system uses the tax number determined on the Purchase Order and that tax number is no more a VAT Number. While parsing the decision tree to get the tax event, the system checks whether the Supplier is VAT Registered, it checks the type code of the tax number on the context documents i.e. the Purchase Order and detects that it's not VAT and then the decision triggers a fresh determination all together.-Resolution-The user can manually change the Tax Code in the Supplier Invoice or create a new document without copying from old ones.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Tax Code, VAT, Tax Event, Purchase Order

Title: Error : Additional Staffing Not Allowed On Intercompany Project
Content: Symptom-While adding employee to intercompany project you will receive above error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Search for the Intercompany Project IC XYZ.-Choose Edit and Team and Staffing button.-Under Team Member choose Add Row.-Then search and select for the employee you will receive the above error message.-Cause-Intercompany project used only for reference purpose at the partner company hence additional staffing is not allowed.-Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: Rejected hours cannot be deleted.
Content: Symptom-The Employee or Service agent recorded hours against project. The hours are rejected by the approver project manager, when the employee or service agent tries to delete rejected hours from the Time Sheet the hours cannot be deleted since the Delete button is grayed out in the Time Sheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Case 1.-Go to the Home work center.-Choose Self-Services Overview view.-Choose the link Edit Time Sheet.-The time sheet floor plan opens and here when the employee or service agent tries to delete rejected hours (marked in red color) from the Time Sheet the hours cannot be deleted since the Delete button is grayed out in the Time Sheet.-Case 2.-Go to the Project Team work center.-Chose Edit Time Sheet under Common Tasks.-The time sheet floor plan opens and here when the employee or service agent tries to delete rejected hours (marked in red color) from the Time Sheet the hours cannot be deleted since the Delete button is grayed out in the Time Sheet.-Cause-The reason here is Project is closed, completed or stopped and time recordings done against the project are locked because the Project is closed, completed or stopped, when the employee or service agent tries to delete rejected hours from the Time Sheet the hours cannot be deleted since the Delete button is grayed out in the Time Sheet.-Resolution-Please revoke the project status back to release so that the system enables the delete button in the Time Sheet and the  employee or service agent can go ahead and delete the rejected hours from the time sheet.-Please follow the steps to revoke the project status back to release this can only be done by Project Manager.-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects View.-Choose Projects sub view.-Choose Project XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID against which the employee or service agent had done the time recoding which was rejected by the Approver Project Manager).-Choose Edit --> Project Plan Button.-Go to Basic Data tab.-Go to Project Status value help choose the Revoke Closure and Revoke Completion and Save.-If you don’t want to revoke the Project status back to release then the Administrator can delete the Rejected hours from the Employee or Service Agent Time Sheet via Time Administration work center.

Title: Error Message: Individual Material is Only Assigned to Retired Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-You execute a GR/IR-Clearing run YYYY-PP-XXXXXXXX (YYYY-PP-XXXXXXXX is the GR/IR-Clearing run ID).-For Purchase Order Item ABC-NN (ABC-NN is the Purchase Order Item ID) you get the error message "Individual material is only assigned to retired fixed assets".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the GR/IR-Clearing subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Search for GR/IR-Clearing YYYY-PP-XXXXXXXX and select it.-The Clearing run ended in Error.-Click View and then View to open the GR/IR-Clearing YYYY-PP-XXXXXXXX.-There is one error message under the General tab.-Navigate to the Data Selection tab.-The Run Parameters are maintained.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-The error message is "Individual material  is only assigned to retired fixed assets".-Navigate to the Processed with Errors tab.-The Purchasing Document ABC-NN ended with error: "Individual material is only assigned to retired fixed assets".-The GR/IR-Clearing Set ID is PQR-LN (PQR-LN is the GR/IR-Clearing Set ID).-Click on the ID to open it-At Line Item LN (LN is the line item in the GR/IR-Clearing Set ID PQR-LN). This Item is in status Canceled and related to Purchase Order Item ABC-NN.-Cause-You procure an asset via purchase order process.-You manually scrapped the fixed asset acquired via goods receipt before executing the GR/IR clearing run.-Hence the GR/IR run is not able to post price differences to the fixed asset.-You can find the Individual Material and the related Fixed Asset as follows:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Click on the Purchase Order ID ABC-NN to open it and then View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Line Item NN (NN is the Purchase Order Line Item of ABC-NN).-Navigate to the Account Assignment subtab.-The Account Assignment Type is IMAT - Individual Material.-The IMAT - Individual Material ID is IMAN (IMAN is the Individual material ID).-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Asset view.-Filter for fixed asset with Individual Material ID IMAN and click Go.-The related Fixed Asset is FAA (FAA is the fixed asset ID). The status of the fixed asset is Retired.-Resolution-For solving this error, reverse the scrapping of the fixed asset and then execute the GR/IR clearing.-GR/IR-Clearing run have to be executed before performing transfer/retirement transactions on any fixed asset for assets acquired via goods receipt or invoice.-In such cases the offsetting account belongs to the Fixed Asset ledger.-The more frequently you execute GR/IR clearing runs, the more accurate the calculations involving the moving average cost or fixed assets.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing; WE/RE-Verrechnung; Anlage; Fixed asset; Individual Material is Only Assigned to Retired Fixed Assets; 单一物料，报废的固定资产

Title: Costing Not Possible; Labor Resource For Team Member XYZ Not Found
Content: Symptom-While adding team members to project planning screen the system displays below warning message.-Costing Not Possible; Labor Resource For Team Member XXXX Not Found-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center.-Select Projects view.-Select Projects subview.-Show all and find Project ABC.-Select Edit - Project Plan button.-Select project task ABC-1.-Select the Work tab-Select Add Row button-Choose Team Member XXXX and service then you will receive the above warning message.-Cause-Based on the valuation strategy the system checks for Labor Resource for the assigned team member, if the system is unable to find the relevant Labor Resource Cost Rate for that team member then system throws the above warning message.-If you want the work to be valuated on service Cost Rate, you can ignore the warning message then system checks for the Service Cost Rate.-Resolution-Steps to find the employee Job role and Cost Center.-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Choose the Employees view.-Search th the employee XYZ(Represnts the employee Id or the manger Id).-Choose Edit button.-The Personnel File employee XYZ will open.-Go to Employement tab -> Organizational Assignment sub tab note down the assigned Job, Cost Center and Validity.-Please follow the steps below to create resource with a combination of assigned Job role and employee assigned Cost Center.-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose Master Data view.-Choose Resources subview.-Search and select the resource ABC (Ex: HRS1134 - Consultant).-Choose Edit button.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Under all Cost Center Assignment, choose on Add Row.-Enter the current cost center assigned to the employee or Manager XYZ.-Enter a valid from date that starts before the period that Employee or Manger XYZ is entering times.-Choose Save button.

Title: Create Project Button Is Disabled
Content: Symptom-The Create Project button is disabled in the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Under Common Tasks, select New Sales Order.-Enter the required information.-The Create Project button will be disabled.-Cause-In a sales order, the Create Project button is enabled only when the sales order items have an item type that is relevant to the following project-based services:-Services – Fixed Price (Project)-Services – Time and Material (Project)-Expense – Fixed Price (Project)-Expense – Time and Material (Project)-Resolution-When creating a sales order, the Create Project button is enabled only for project-based items.-If the sales order includes non–project-based item types, the Create Project button will be disabled. This is standard system behavior.-See Also-Keywords-Create Project Button, Button Disabled, Project-Based, Items, Sales Order

Title: Purchasing UoM from Product Master Not Copied to Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Purchasing Uom in product master as XXX however your purchase request is created with Uom YYY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Order work center.-Choose Purchase Request view.-Choose All Purchase Requests.-Search for your purchase request and you will notice it is created with Uom YYY.-Cause-Uom XXX maintained in product master is applicable only to supplier facing document like purchase order, shopping cart, RFQ, Contract and also in agreed list price with supplier.-NOTE  : Purchase request by default will contain the Planning Uom if it created with source Planning Proposal and Purchasing Uom if is created with source Shopping Cart.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior and system behaves as designed.

Title: You are Unable to Maintain a Numbering Range for the Project ID
Content: Symptom-Unable to maintain number ranges for Project IDs in the Business Configuration.-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Select Activities from drop-down.-Search Project Types.-Select Open Button.-Only a letter prefix can be maintained at the beginning of the Project ID (for example, CPSO, DCP, MCP), while maintaining a number range is not possible.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior. -Resolution-The Project Numbering for each Project type starts always with the Number 1 and keep incrementing the number.-Keywords-Number range; Project; Business Configuration; Project Types

Title: Time Recoding Flag Is Not Available In The Purchase Order For Project Procurement.
Content: Symptom-While creating purchase order for service you could see the Time Recording flag is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose the Purchase Orders view.-Find and choose the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the PO).-Choose Edit button.-Go to Items tab.-Choose the service assigned to the service agent.-Here you can see the Time Recording flag is not available, if the field is not enabled for time recording the service agent/external employee will not be able to record the time against the project.-Cause-The time recording integration with projects procurement is not enabled, hence the time recording flag is not available in the purchase order.-Resolution-Steps to enable Project Procurement.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose the project and choose the Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Questions tab.-Choose the Scoping Element Human Resources -> Time and Labor Management -> Time Recording-Here enable the below 2 questions.-You have chosen to record employee times in order to integrate them with Projects.-You have chosen to record employee times in order to integrate them with Procurement.

Title: How to Suppress Creation of Business Tasks for Missing Project Time and Expenses
Content: Symptom-How to suppress creation of business tasks for missing project time and expenses while creating project invoice request for invoice schedule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose Work view.-Here you can see the system is creating the business tasks for missing time and expense and requesting the user to manually decide how to proceed.-Cause-If you do not want the system to create business task in case of missing time and expenses you can now suppress creation of business tasks while creating project invoice request for invoice schedule-Resolution-Follow the below steps to configure the system accordingly.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab-Search for .Project Types.-Choose project type Customer project with sales integration and enable the question Finish invoice schedule automatically, if no time and expenses can be assigned to project invoice request created via invoice schedule.-Choose Save button.

Title: Business User Can See a Different Form Than a PDI User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer complains that a Form change is not being reflected to Business Users. However, when checking it using a PDI User, those changes are visible. -Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The steps to reproduce may vary according to each business requirement. An example would be generating Form itself or following these steps:-Login Using a PDI User.-Go to Administrator > Form Template Maintenance.-Select Form.-You can see an specific "Changed On" date. -Login Using a Business User. -Go to Administrator > Form Template Maintenance.-Select Form.-You can see a different "Changed On" date. -Cause-The issue happens when a PDI User has changed an Standard Form or a Business User has changed a PDI Form. -If a Standard Form:-Go to Backend.-Go to XREP. -Go to LAYER_CUST.-Open Affected Standard Form.-Go to Version History tab.-You'll see a PDI Entry. -If a PDI Form:-Go to Backend.-Go to XREP. -Go to LAYER_CUST.-Open Affected PDI Form.-Go to Version History tab.-You will see a $CUST entry.-These changes are not supported since PDI Forms are intended to be done exclusively by PDI Users and Standard Form are intended to be changed by Business Users only. These changes are maintained in different layers. -Resolution-You'll need to corrected affected Form in Backend. Please first inform customer that those last changes done by either PDI User or Business User will be lost as soon as we correct these forms from backend. -If a Standard Form:-Go to Backend.-Go to XREP. -Go to LAYER_CUST.-Open Affected Form.-Go to Version History tab.-You'll see a PDI Entry. -Now switch to the Layer of the respective solution.-Open Affected Form.-Go to Version History tab.-Select PDI Entry and click on "Clean Up".-If a PDI Form:-Go to Backend.-Go to XREP. -Go to LAYER_CUST.-Open Affected PDI Form.-Go to Version History tab.-You will see a $CUST entry.-Select $CUST entry.-Select $CUST Entry and click on "Clean Up".-These steps should ideally resolve those errors and both users would ideally be able to see same Form results and format. -See Also- 2784805 - Please activate and check in the object SAP_BYD/Foundation/MasterTemplates/000.TPFM-Why you should avoid editing custom forms from UI-Keywords-form, pdi user, business user, changes, reflected, pdi form, standard form,

Title: Error When Changing Run ID of Mass Data Run to Obsolete
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer can see following error when setting a Run ID of a Mass Data Run to Obsolete. -Cannot change status; run XYZ is scheduled-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Mass Data Run Work Center View-2. Select Run ID (e.g. XYZ). -3. Click on Actions > Set to Obsolete.-4. You can see an error: -Cannot change status; run XYZ is scheduled-Cause-There are two possible reasons why those errors are being displayed:-There are Scheduled Jobs for Mass Data Run and you can check it by following these steps:-Go to Mass Data run Work Center View. -Select Run ID (e.g. XYZ). -Click on View Jobs.-You can see Schedule Jobs.-There are no Scheduled Jobs on frontend and hence there are inconsistencies on Business Object which stores Scheduled Jobs information on backend. -Resolution-There are two possible resolutions according to each cause.-If there is any Scheduled Job for Mass Data Run, please ask customer to follow these steps:-Go to Mass Data run Work Center View. -Select Run ID (e.g. XYZ). -Click on View Jobs.-Select Schedule Jobs.-Click on Cancel Job button. -If there is NO Schedule Job for for Mass Data Run, please follow these steps:-Go to Backend. -Go to GFSSTM transaction.-Insert "BACKGROUND_JOB_SCHEDULE" Business Object.-Execute. -Expand <SMDRI_SCH_ROOT_QUERY_ELE>.-Select ROOT node of BACKGROUND_JOB_SCHEDULE.-Click on Persistency. -Click on Refresh.-Then, either you or customer should be able to set Run ID of Mass Data Run to Obsolete. -Keywords-Cannot change status, run, is scheduled, mass data run, run id, status, obsolete, mass data run obsolete

Title: Intercompany Purchase Order Sent by E-Mail Instead of Internal EDX as Output Channel
Content: Symptom-You have created an intercompany purchase order and ordered however the order was sent through E-Mail instead of Internal EDX. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase order and select Edit button-Navigate to Output History tab-You can see that purchase order was sent via E-Mail-Cause-If you check the supplier master data, user has changed the output channel under Collaboration tab from IDX-Internal EDX to INT-E-Mail. Hence purchase order was sent via E-Mail instead of Internal EDX. -Note - Another possibility would be that, user has changed the output channel to E-Mail from You can also button runtime. -Resolution-Supplier master data should not be changed frequently from E-Mail to Internal EDX and vice versa. If purchase order is inconsistent, please cancel it and recreate a new purchase order with internal EDX as an output channel. -Keywords-Internal EDX; Intercompany purchase order;

Title: Report Schedule of Fixed Asset shows a different Netbook Value
Content: Symptom-You opened report: Schedule of Fixed Assets (FINFXAU01_Q0002). The Net Book Value for Fixed Asset Class DE (DE represents the Fixed Asset Class) at end of the year is different to the Net Book Value at start of the following year for the same Fixed Asset Class. -You expect the values to be the same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Fixed Assets-Select the View : Lists-Search for Report Schedule of Fixed Assets (FINFXAU01_Q0002)-Enter the selection criteria:-Company: ABC (ABC represents the company ID)-Set of Books: 1-Valuation View: 1-(In this example we are using the years 2022 & 2023)-In the report you enter Accounting period selection: from 001.2022 till 012.2022-The Net Book Value for Fixed Asset Class DE at the end of 2022 is 10000 EUR. -Now change the timeframe or open a second report with a timeframe selection: from 001.2023 till 012.2023-Here you can see the Net Book Value at start of 2023 = 12500 EUR.-There is a difference. You expect the ending value at 2022 to be the same as opening value 2023-Cause-There is missing Fixed Assets in the report results for 2023.-If you add the Fixed Asset ID as key figure to the row fields of the reports and compare both reports you notice that in the report for the year 2023  Fixed Asset ID XYZ (XYZ stand for Fixed Asset ID) is missing.-Fixed Asset XYZ has a Net Book Value at end 2022 of 2500. Eur. This is the value that is missing and the difference you can see in both reports.-Go to the Work Center Fixed Asset.-Select the View Fixed Assets.-Open Fixed Asset XYZ.-View All.-Go to Master Data.-Go to Subtab Basic Data.-Here you can see that the Fixed Asset XYZ has only a valid assignment to an cost object till a date in year 2022.-Resolution-As the Fixed Asset XYZ is not assigned to any cost object in 2023 this Fixed Asset is missing in the report Schedule of Fixed Asset in 2023. -To have the correct values in the report for 2023 you must validate the Organisational Assignment of the Fixed Asset XYZ.-Keywords-Schedule of Fixed Assets; FINFXAU01_Q0002; Net Book Value

Title: Error "Kit Product is not allowed" Appears While Creating Contact for kit Items
Content: Symptom-Error appears while trying to create contract using kit items -Error "Kit Product XXX is not allowed." (XXX is a product ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to Common Tasks-Select "New Contract"-Enter All details in General Tab-Enter item in Items tab-You get an error-Cause-In the current release, we do not support kits in Strategic sourcing (contracts, quotes, shopping cart) scenario. This has been documented in the help center document - Kits Process Flow.-Resolution-This can be taken as a new requirement and please post this request in influence site. Influence Opportunity Homepage - Customer Influence (sap.com) -Keywords-Kit Product is not allowed; Kit item in contract; Error in contract;

Title: Approval condition "No price" is not working in Shopping cart
Content: Symptom-You have set an approval rule with condition "No price Not equal to Yes" or "No price equal to Yes" for shopping cart approval but it is not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management - Approval Processes-Select Approval Process : Shopping Cart-Set up an approval rule and add condition "No Price"(Not equal to Yes or equal to Yes)-The approval is not triggered as expected-Cause-If you have set a condition "No price Not equal to Yes" , this means there must be a price specified in the shopping cart item and if it is "No price equal to Yes", then it means that the condition is satisfied when no price is set in the cart item.-Resolution-Kindly update the price accordingly in the shopping cart to meet this "No price" condition, only then approval will be triggered correctly.-Keywords-no price condition in shopping cart approval, "No price Not equal to Yes", "No price equal to Yes"

Title: Baseline Date for Payment Cannot be Saved in the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Baseline Date for Payment gets changed while creating new scanned invoice ER-6995. You have created a new supplier invoice and trying to update the Baseline Date for Payment however it keeps getting changed after you save. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center -Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice -Go to General tab and navigate to Payment information - Payment details sub tab-Change the Baseline Date for Payment and select Save-System changes the date back to previous date-Cause-The Baseline Date for Payment is a date from which the terms of payment apply. When you define the payment terms, due date will be based on either Invoice date or Receipt date and the Baseline Date for Payment will be calculated accordingly. -Note - In the Business Configuration work center - Overview - Activity Suppliers - Define Payment Terms for Procurement - For the defined payment term - The due date will be calculated based on either Receipt date or invoice date. You have defined Invoice date.  -Resolution-Since the Baseline Date for Payment is calculated based on invoice date, it will revert back to invoice date. If you change the invoice date, the baseline date will also gets changed. -This is an expected behavior.-Keywords-Baseline Date for Payment not saved; Baseline Date for Payment keeps changing; Baseline Date for Payment

Title: Main Bank Account Indicator is Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-You are trying to mark a Bank Account as the Main Bank Account, however the Indicator is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Then go to the Employees.-Search for the Employee ID.-Click Edit.-Go to the tab Personal Data.-Payment Information subtab.-Notice that Main Bank Account is greyed out.-Cause-The reason on why the Main Bank Account is not available is due to the Payment Method that is selected.-The Main Bank Account will be available only for Bank Transfer option.-For Check and Cash options, the Main Bank Account will not be available.-Resolution-Currently, this is the expected system behavior. In order to use the option of Main Bank Account, please change the Payment Method to Bank Transfer.-Keywords-Unable, Cannot, Mark, Greyed Out, Main Bank Account, Indicator, Checkbox, Employee, Payment Information, Personal Data.

Title: Uncleared Amount on Account 'Goods Received not Invoiced' due to Exchange Rate and Cost Differences
Content: Symptom-A GR/IR Clearing Set for Purchase Order Item DEF-1 consisting only of Goods Receipt ABC and related Goods Receipt (Confirmation Type: Adjustment) XYZ shows an uncleared amount on GR/IR-Clearing Account 'Goods Received Not Invoiced' (or Amount/Quantity Awaiting Invoice).-The Purchase Order by now is cancelled and the Valuation Quantity for this Clearing Set is 0.00 ea.-Company Currency and Transaction Currency differ. -For Example: -Company Currency:         EUR -Transaction Currency:     GBP -The outstanding amount on 'Goods Received Not Invoiced' for this PO-Item is not considered in GR/IR Clearing Runs. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Reports/List view.-Click Report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary.-Fill in required selection parameters for Company, Set of Books and Purchase Order Item DEF-1. -Key Date equals Today.-Here you find an uncleared amount for Clearing Set Type 'Delivery' for Purchase Order Item DEF-1 -Cause-The Net Value of PO-Item DEF-1 is 600 GBP/ea. -Goods Receipt ABC for 1 ea is posted on 01.01.2023.-The Exchange Rate (EXR) maintained for that day is 0.8 EUR/GBP.-Account 'Goods Received Not Invoiced' hence will be credited with 480 EUR.-On 31.12.2023 an Adjustment Confirmation (-1 ea) is posted in Goods Receipt XYZ, booking out the received 1 ea. -Now the applied EXR is (realistically) 1.2 EUR/GBP.-At that time the Inventory Qty is 1 ea at 700.00 EUR.-As a result 700.00 EUR Credit Inventory. -As outlined the Net Value is 600.00 GBP/ea for  PO-Item DEF-1.-For 1 ea and applied EXR 1.2 EUR/GBP this now translates to 720.00 EUR that now Debit 'Goods Received Not Invoiced'.-The difference of 20.00 EUR represents an EXR-Gain and Credit the account for 'Inventories: Differences -> Gain from Exchange Rate Differences'.-For PO-Item DEF-1 and GR/IR-Clearing Set 'Inbound Delivery' this results in a remaining Debit balance of 240.00 EUR.-Resolution-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Select Purchasing Document Items view.-Select 'All Purchase Order Items' and search for PO-Item DEF-1.-Press button Final Clearing and select Mark. -Choose an opportune date, for example 31.12.2023.--This implies that any open balances on GR/IR-Accounts will be cleared for associated Clearing Sets.-A GR/IR Clearing Run for Purchasing Document DEF would now Credit 240.00 EUR from 'Goods Received Not Invoiced' and Debit the G/L Account for Inventories: Differences -> Loss from Purchase Price Differences.-See Also-GR/IR Clearing -Goods Received not Invoiced -Amount Awaiting Invoice-Clearing Set

Title: Quantity Variance Error in Supplier Invoice even after flagging "Unlimited Over-Delivery" checkbox in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You get error in supplier invoice: "Item quantity greater than open 0 quantity of purchase order" even though you have already flagged this "Unlimited Over-Delivery" checkbox in Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Create new Purchase Order-Navigate to Items tab-Under Basic Data, you can see "Unlimited Over-Delivery" checkbox is flagged under Settings-Now go to Supplier Invoicing-Select Invoice entry-Create invoice for that purchase order-Exception occurs: "Item quantity greater than open 0 quantity of purchase order"-Cause-Unlimited Over-Delivery check box will allow delivery for more than the ordered quantity , but this will not impact the standard message in supplier invoice when invoice is created for more quantity than ordered.- You can accept the error and continue.-Once unlimited delivery is no longer needed, unchecking this box will not allow delivery above ordered quantity. Moreover in orders where the delivered quantity is already above the ordered quantity, no more deliveries will be allowed.-Resolution-You can configure exception tolerance level in this fine tuning activity in Business Configuration work center: "Supplier Invoice Exceptions"-> Quantity Variance exception.-That way, the error message will show as warning and will not stop from posting invoices.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cbd93dd722d1014a783c4d93d7d7407.html?version=2311-Keywords-Item quantity greater than open 0 quantity of purchase order, quantity variance, Unlimited Over-Delivery, supplier invoice, purchase order

Title: Account determination missing for for Receivables while creating Bank Payment Advice.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create the New Bank Payment Advice, while trying to clear the open items you are facing the below mentioned error message.-Error message: Account determination is missing for customer. Define the accounts for chart of accounts XXX tab Receivables 'field' Received Down Payments. Enter a General Ledger account for the account determination group for customers Foreign, affiliated and reconciliation account type Down payment Reimbursement.-'XXX' refers to Chart of Accounts ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity management work center.-Go to the New Bank Payment Advice sub view.-Give all the required inputs. -Select the accounts in the open items and try to clear, you will face the below provided error message.-Error: Account determination is missing for customer. Define the accounts for chart of accounts XXX tab Receivables 'field' Received Down Payments. Enter a General Ledger account for the account determination group for customers Foreign, affiliated and reconciliation account type Down payment Reimbursement.-Cause-Error message is raised due to missing:-Account determination for the customers Foreign, affiliated and reconciliation account type Down payment Reimbursement.-Resolution-1) Go to the Business Configuration work center.-2) Go to the Overview sub view.-3) Search for the activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination'.-4) Under Account Determination, go to Account Receivables tab.-5) Now highlight the Chart of accounts 'XXX', under Receivables tab for account type Foreign, affiliated - Received Down payment account is not maintained.-Here you have to to maintain the required account. Once done then you can clear Bank payment advice with any error.-Keywords-Account determination, Bank Payment Advice, Account Receivables, Down Payment, Business Configuration.

Title: Unified report Israel credit and debit in the BKMVDATA file
Content: Symptom-Unexpected results with Unified report Israel BKMVDATA file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-  Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Select Unified Reporting - Israel.-Search for the relevant Run ID.-Click on View Report Run Results.-Download and open the BKMVDATA file.-  Result: You noticed there is a sign in the BKMVDATA for Credit - 2 and Debit - 1.--In some lines in the file the sign is Credit (1) but the sign of the movement is (+) and sometimes it is Credit and the sign is (-).-  You are wondering the reason for this behavior.-Cause-The result (Transaction amount, Transaction code(1= debit, 2 = credit) ) of B100 records for G/L Accounts in BKMVDATA.txt file in the specific lines are based on the data source/report "G/L Accounts Line Item(General Ledger -> List -> Reports).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior and not an inconsistency.-Keywords-Credit Debit, Unified Report Israel

Title: Tax Authority duplicate check button is greyed out.
Content: Symptom-The duplicate check button is greyed out within the tax authority.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select Tax Authorities.-Search for ID XXX and open it(XXX represents the ID of the tax authority).-Result: The duplicate check button is greyed out.-Cause-The duplicate check action is enabled while creating a new tax authority. It helps to check any existing tax authority via the information available in the system.-The action is disabled post creation of the tax authority.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior, the feature is only available when creating the new tax authority.-Keywords-Duplicate check

Title: Cases Are Missing After Tenant Is Refreshed
Content: Symptom-You have opened Case from your Tenant but after performing System Refresh, the cases are missing in the Tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Mangement Work Center-Choose the Cases View-Search for Relevant Case ID-No records found-Cause-This is System Standard Behaviour.-Resolution-After Performing system refresh, all the cases will be deleted automatically in the tenant.-Once cases are deleted, we won't be able to retrieve the case and the ID as well.-Keywords-Cases, Missing, Cases View, Tenant Refresh, retrieve Cases

Title: List Price of a Product in an New Manual Invoice Changes when Adding Another Product
Content: Symptom-The List Price of a Product in an New Manual Invoice is not as expected and/or changes when adding Another Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Invoice in the Common Tasks.-Enter the respective Account, Sales Unit etc. -Navigate to the Items tab. -Add Product XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Product).-You can see that a List Price is determined e.g. as 5.00. -Add another Product. -The List Price of the previously added Product changes to 0.00. -Cause-The product XYZ is maintained in 2 price lists that could apply for the created Invoice.-For example, in Customer Group Specific Price List ABC and in Base Price List EFG  (ABC and EFG represent the Name of the Price Lists).-In the Base Price List EFG the Amount is maintained as 5.00 in our example.-The Customer Group Specific Price List ABC should be first determined as per access sequence, before the Base Price List EFG is determined. However, since the scale of the price for the product in Customer Group Specific Price List ABC does not start with 0 or 1 but the quantity maintained is 1 the system cannot properly determine the price and adds both price lists in the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Pricing sub tab which makes the document inconsistent.-  Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Invoice in the Common Tasks.-The respective data in the General tab.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add Product XYZ.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Pricing sub tab.-Expand line item 10.-You can see that the Price Components List Price is there twice.-The first one with the Amount 5.00 which is determined from the Base Price List EFG-And the second one with the Amount 0.00 which is determined from the Customer Group Specific Price List ABC and this line is red since there is no Price maintained in the scales for 1 pcs.-  This means that there was an issue with the determination of the List Price as there can only be one Price Component of type List Price for an item.-  Check the first Price List:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Price Lists view.-Show Base Price List-Open Base Price List EFC- You can see that the Product XYZ is maintained with 5.00 for 1 unit.-  Check the second Price List:-Show: Customer Group Specific Price List.-Open the Price List ABC.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Search for Product XYZ.-You can see that there is a scale maintained and the scale does not start with 0 of 1 as unit but starts e.g. with 500 units.-The quantity in your Invoice for the Item is 1 unit hence no price can be determined, and the List Price is 0.00.-  You need to ensure that you scale always starts with 0.-  The reason why the system changes the List Price to 0.00 when adding a new product occurs because when you add the new product the system will remove the duplicated entry of the base price list and since there is no scale maintained for 1 unit the system determines the list price 0.00.-Resolution-To solve the issue, please change the scales in the Customer Group Specific Price List ABC for Product XYZ accordingly and add a scale with a 0 unit and the respective Amount. Then release the Price List.  -Once this is done, the price maintained in the Customer Group Specific Price List ABC for the product will be determined accordingly.-Keywords-Scale; Scales; Price List; duplicated; twice; changes; List Price; 0.00; zero price;

Title: Change Transaction (CT) Log Related issues and solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This KBA is strictly Internal-Change Transaction: Any change done as key user/ end user in UI Frontend (using Personalization mode or Adaptation mode) or in UI designer or in Partner Solution are saved as CT log and can be seen in backend program (SE38) “AP_UI_XTS_CT_OVERVIEW” as key user, end user and partner solution change.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Symptoms:-Whenever the entire page of any application/work center is crashed leaving blank screen or dump, it could be because of inconsistencies of recent CT’s. (Ref INC5579870, INC5629379, INC5080056, INC7533595)-When there is a greater number of CT logs created for an application (Ref INC5768855) or a greater number of personalization is created by an end user to a particular work center or application.-A dump occurs immediately when accessing a screen, and the ST22 dump shows the message: Info: Binding of UI data field /ABC/XYZ/123 failed.-ByD Mobile App screen is stuck or blank-Resolution-Diagnosis:-Refer to KBA 3316236 - How to find the CT that causes the dump "Info: Binding of UI data field" from front end -How to check CT in the backend system-  1. Input T-code se38, then Program AP_UI_XTS_CT_OVERVIEW, then click Execute button-2. Input the UI Component(you can get the UI component by navigating to work-center or application in UI frontend,  press and hold ALT+CTRL+SHIFT+D together, Dialog box of Debug Console will open, under Controllers/Data you can get the UI components copy the component from /SAP……. When there are multiple UI component try selecting the UI component where the change could be) Selection and User name, then click Execution button.-2.1  If you do not know the user's technical id, please follow stepInput T-code /osu01, then user's Alias-3. Change Transaction Analyser, you can search any CT-4. You can view the Change by double clicking the CT.-5. You can select and delete the CT here also.-Solution:-CT issues are generally due to inconsistencies of them, and the idea is it to rectify the CTs by following ways:-Proceed with a Generate Load (refer the KBA 3041337 in See Also section) or via Tcode XREP.-This can be performed by AP-RC-UIF-RT-B PS / DS teams-If the changes are made under personalization or Adaptation mode, ask the customer to discard, or publish the changes.-This should be performed by customer-If the above actions does not solve the issue, the deletion of the CT will be necessary( Get permission from customer to delete the recent CT log)-a) For KUT fields the delete can be done by back-end (refer to resolution from KBA 2956807 in See Also section). Forward such cases to BC-DWB-REP-EXT support team-b) For PDI fields, the deletion should be done by SDK. Forward such cases to PDI support team-Keywords-CT, UI, ByD, CT log, change transaction, mobile stuck

Title: Cannot Add Header Discount Pricing Component to Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Header Discount pricing component has been activated within the Pricing Procedures, however, the same is not showing within the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click New.-Select Sales Order.-Enter the needed master data.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Under Total Pricing, click the Add Row button.-The pricing component is not showing as expected.-Cause-The Price Component Header Discounts in step 111 of your Pricing Procedure is not a Price Component for which you can add a manual value in the Total Pricing section of your Sales Document.-Therefore, it is also not visible in the drop down list when you click on Add Row in the Total Pricing Section.-The Price Component Header Discounts in step 111 of the Pricing Procedure is a calculated value which is calculated on the total sum from Step 051 to Step 054.-This means that if you add one or multiple Overall Discount (%) (step 052) in the Total Pricing section of the sales document, the Price Component value of these are summed up and is displayed in the Header Discounts.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -See Also-If you would like to use additional discounts with a Fixed value or a Percentage based value, you can avail of the feature Absolute and Percentage based Additional Overall Discounts.-Please see the following Blog for further details:-Maintain Absolute and Percentage based Overall Discounts in CRM documents-2891573 - Activation of Additional Overall Discount -Keywords-Pricing Procedure, Pricing Component, Over Discount, Discount, Header Discount, Configure Price Strategy

Title: Planned Shipment Date Is Incorrect In 3PL Request
Content: Symptom-After creating an outbound delivery against a 3PL request, user finds that Planned Shipment Date is incorrect in the relevant 3PL request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third Party Logistics work center.-Go to 3PL requests view and find relevant ID.-Edit it and go to the General tab.-Here you can find that Planned Shipment date as X and Planned Delivery Date :Y instead of A and B.-( Here A, B, C and D refers to planned shipment date and planned delivery date)-Cause--In the 3PL request, the planned shipment date is obtained from the reference of sales order (SO).-According to the sales order reference, at the time of release, the planned shipment date is X and the planned delivery date is Y. As per the initial sales order because no outbound delivery was created.--Now, if a user creates an OD later against a 3PL request, the system does not update the dates in the 3PL request again. To check the dates, you can go to the deliveries tab in the 3PL request.-Resolution-Go to the Third Party Logistics work center.-Go to 3PL requests view and find relevant ID.-Edit it and go to the Deliveries tab.-Here you can find the Planned Shipment date: A and Planned Delivery Date: B which is expected as per outbound delivery created against relevant 3PL request ID.-Keywords-outbound delivery, planned shipment date, planned delivery date, 3pl request, incorrect date,

Title: 500 Internal Error (Dump) When Trying to Approve Sales Order Containing Sales Kit Items
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to approve a Sales Order which contains one or more Sales Kit line items, however, when clicking the Approve button, the system displays a '500 Internal Error'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Manage My Area work center.-Open the Approvals view.-Search for Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the affected Sales Order).-Click the Approve button -The system will dump after a few seconds.-Checking the scenario in the backend transaction ST22, you can find the following dump pattern: -Error: MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT    -Terminated Program: CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP-Active Calls/Events: -25 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003 66-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-24 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001 24-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-23 METHOD CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_CONTEXT==CP CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_CONTEXT==CM00K 259-CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_CONTEXT=>ASSEMBLE_MESSAGE_A2A-22 METHOD CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_CONTEXT==CP CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_CONTEXT==CM006 5-CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_CONTEXT=>IF_APCRM_OUTB_PROCESS_CONTEXT~ASSEMBLE_MESSAGE-21 METHOD CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_OB_AGENT=CP CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_OB_AGENT=CM006 5-CL_APCRM_FULFILLMENT_OB_AGENT=>IF_APCRM_OUTB_PROCESS_CONTEXT~ASSEMBLE_MESSAGE-20 METHOD CL_APCRM_GEN_PROCESS_AGENT====CP CL_APCRM_GEN_PROCESS_AGENT====CM007 611-CL_APCRM_GEN_PROCESS_AGENT=>ASSEMBLE_MESSAGE-Application Info: -Triggering application component: AP-XCR-Cause-This error can happen when the value of the Ship-From is not present in the Sub Items of a Sales Kit. You can check this as follows: -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC.-Edit the document and click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Highlight the line item containing the Sales Kit Header Item.-You will see that the Ship-From information is present.-Now, highlight any line item containing the Sales Kit Sub Items.-You will see that the Ship-From information is empty.-Resolution-In order to correct this scenario, you need to withdraw the Sales Order from approval and then perform a dummy change on the Sales Kit Header Item. The steps are as follows: -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC.-Edit the document and click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Highlight the line item containing the Sales Kit Header Item.-Change/Remove the Ship-From (Or the Fulfillment).-Press ENTER.-Revert the value of the Ship From or Fulfillment back to what it was before the change on step #7.-Press ENTER.-The system will then update the Ship-From on all the Sales Kit Sub Items and allow the document to be approved.-Keywords-Approval, Sales Order, 500, Error, Dump, Crash, Message, Internal, Sales Kit, Header, Item, Sub, Ship-From, Fulfillment, MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT, ST22, CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION, AP-XCR

Title: How Inventory Valuation Works For a Sales Kit.
Content: Symptom-You would like to know why the system is not altering the valuation of the Sales Kits even with the following scoping question “Do you want to valuate sales kit based on kit component costs?” scoped. -In the inventory history, you can see that the valuation price for the single components of the kit has changed, but you can't find any changes in the valuation price of the kit itself.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Materials subview. -Search for Material ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the sales kit ID). -Click in View Cost History. -Here we can in all previous periods that you don't have any history for this material (Sales Kit).-Or-Go to the Service and Product Portfolio Work Center.-Go to the Products View.-Filter for All Products.-In the search field, search for the Sales Kit XYZ.-Mark the Sales Kit XYZ.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-Here you will see the Inventory Cost: 0,00 and Perpetual Cost Method: Moving Average.-Cause-The scoping Question "Do you want to valuate sales kit based on kit component costs?", is only related to the cost price components of the sales order items. In terms of Inventory valuation, only the cost of the kit's products are considered. Therefore, when you purchase a sales kit you actually purchase the separate the products of the kit rather than the kit itself. So, the inventory cost of these separate products is updated after the goods receipts, but not the inventory cost of the sales kit. -You can also check in the Purchasing Documents - Line Items report where only the components of the kits appear.-Resolution-Expected system behavior. -See Also-1911776 - Using the moving average cost for material valuation-3426587 - How to Locate the Inventory Costs for Sales Kit in the System-Keywords-Do you want to valuate sales kit based on kit component costs?, Scoping Question, Sales Kit, Moving Average, Inventory Valuation.

Title: Bank Statement posted even if the payment allocation was in error
Content: Symptom-When creating a Bank Statement, even though you are using a G/L account that has mandatory Cost Center for G/L account assignment in the payment allocation, the system allows to post the Bank Statement.-The Payment Allocation is then in status Required when the Bank Statement is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Select Bank Statements.-Search for Bank statement ID XXX(XXX represents the ID of the Bank Statement).-Click on Required next to the relevant line item.-Navigate to the Allocation to G/L account tab.-Result: You notice that the G/L account used is one where the Cost Center is mandatory.-There is therefore the error Cost Center is missing.-Your expectation is that the system should have prevented the Bank Statement to be posted.-Cause-Bank statement creation and allocation of Bank Statement line item are two different processes. Whenever the system is trying to do automatic allocation of any line item and finds some error, it then put the "Post Processing" status as "Required" and move on for the next line item processing. This is a standard system behavior.-Resolution-As exposed in the Cause section, items of a Bank Statement even if erroneous would not prevent the posting of the Bank Statement. If there are any error, the corresponding Payment Allocation would appear with status Required in the posted Bank Statement so that you can correct them.-Keywords-Required; Bank Statement; mandatory; Cost Center

Title: Scanned Supplier Invoice Document is created without PDF attachment
Content: Symptom-When you open a scanned supplier invoice document , you can see PDF attachment is missing.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for the respective scanned invoice document-Select View All-Navigate to Attachments tab or original document tab -No PDF document found  or Error: failed to load PDF document-Cause-This scanned invoice was not created from invoice scanning view using standard PDF file ,it is a manually created scanned invoice which can be done by scanning Text document as well.-Manual scanned invoice can be created using "New Scanned Invoice" option under Common Tasks view in Supplier Invoicing work center.-Resolution-Please use Invoice Scanning view to upload scanned invoice and make use of intelligent PDF scanning process.-You can also scan and upload supplier invoice PDF documents in bulk using collaboration tool.-Keywords-scanned invoice , PDF missing in scanned invoice, intelligent PDF scanning, manual scanning, invoice scanning, collaboration tool

Title: Approver of supplier invoice cannot receive approval notification email
Content: Symptom-Approver of supplier invoice cannot receive approval notification email although user has subscribed to the supplier invoice approval task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-User has only checked box  'Approve <BO Sub Type> <Supplier Invoice ID> - <Supplier Name> - <Total Gross Value of the Supplier Invoice>' under Managing my area - Supplier invoicing from Home - Inbox - Subscribe to Task.-User must also check the box 'Approve <Cancellation Indicator text> <BO Sub Type> <Supplier Invoice ID> - <Supplier Name> - <Total Gross Value of the Supplier Invoice>', then the approval notification will be sent to the user email address.-Resolution-This is expected system design.-Keywords-Approval email, Notification, Supplier invoice, No email sent, Approver, Approval task

Title: Customer Invoice Associated with Incorrect Profit Center
Content: Symptom-You have posted a customer invoice and in the journal entry for one of the line items the profit center derived is not as per your expectation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign---Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to View Invoice Documents.-Search and find customer invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the customer invoice ID).-Open the Customer Invoice and select view all.-Go to tab Document Flow.-Click on the Journal Entry icon.-You notice in the journal entry for one of the line items the profit center derived is not as per your expectation.---Cause-If you selected profit center accounting and segment reporting for a set of books, the profit center and segment are automatically entered in the line items of journal entries created from source documents.-In this case, manual changes were completed that overrode the Profit Center assignment of the Sales Order Item.-Resolution-To check what changes were completed:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Sales Document Items view.-Find the related sales order.-Highlight the related Sales Order Item.-Click the Administrative Data Tab.-View Changes.-Here you will notice all changes that have been completed and a record will show the update of the Profit Center.-Keywords-Default, Profit Center, Sales Order, Customer Invoice

Title: System Does not Notify the Requester of Shopping Cart When a New Product is Added or Removed From the Purchase Order Created Based on Cart
Content: Symptom-You as an employee creates a shopping cart and submit for purchase request. Once purchase request is created, purchasing department adds new line item and send purchase order to the supplier. However employee cannot see modifications in shopping cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self services and select Shopping-Create a New Shopping Cart and Submit-Purchase request is created-Purchasing department add new items in Purchase Request and Creates Purchase order -Cause-When the shopping cart is submitted, system creates a purchase request automatically. Now when you convert request to purchase order by adding new lines, the changes will not be reflected back to shopping cart. In the shopping cart document, there is no Changes tab to see change history. Shopping cart is an internal and employee specific document. But purchase order is a legal document which is sent to the supplier. -Resolution-It is a flexibility allowed to the business users to add additional items in the purchase order apart from shopping cart items. This is an expected behavior. If you expect a change in the functionality, please add your idea in to ideas forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -Note - However users can track the shopping cart and check the document flow to see the purchase order details. Or They can use any reports to track or compare the details. -Keywords-Shopping cart change history; Shopping cart modification in purchase request

Title: Working days are visible as day off in the calendar
Content: Symptom-A work schedule with time & daily model has been maintained for an employee. But the calendar in the home work center shows working days as day off.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Open Self-Services Overview-Select Edit Time Sheet-Working days are marked as Day Off- Cause-The time type used in the daily model of the employee might not be valid or not marked as relevant for work schedule in the business configuration.- Resolution-Go to Business Configuration-Go to Overview-Search for the relevant time type-Select the relevant time type-Click on Maintain Employee Time Types-For the time type, maintain column Relevance for Work Schedule as Productive and ensure that the time type is valid-Save-Afterwards, ensure that a correction day closure run is executed. -See Also-incorrect; not available; status; absent

Title: Error Message: 'HCFR_WASC_CODE-CONTENT is not enabled' in SOAP Payload Response
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to hire or adapt an employee through the SOAP API. But the payload response includes an error message: -<Note>HCFR_WASC_CODE-CONTENT is not enabled</Note>- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The payload includes an entry for <WorkAgreementStatutoryCategoryCode>-This means that you are trying to maintain a statutory category for the employee. However, this code is not enabled for the country of the employee. This can be validated as follows:-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Open the relevant employee (or, if not yet exists, check another employee associated to the same country.)-Select Employment tab, Work Agreement subtab-Check of statutory category/code is not available -Resolution-Remove this data in the payload and run the import again- Keywords-failed; fails; API; Request; Import;

Title: Error Message - Cannot convert between UoM ABC and EFG; they are the same or of same type
Content: Symptom-Error Message -  Cannot convert between UoM ABC and EFG (for example: Gram and Kilogram); they are the same or of same type while trying to maintain the Quantity Conversions for the Material-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Products Portfolio work center-Go to Products view-Select Material PQR(PQR refers to the material ID)-View all-In the General tab, under the Quantity Conversions-You maintain the quantity as grams and in the corresponding quantity, you maintain - Kilograms-The system displays an error message - -Cannot convert between UoM Gram and Kilogram; they are the same or of same type-Cause-Expected behavior.-The Quantity Conversions is when you can specify the equivalent measurement of one unit to another unit, for example, one pallet contains 15 boxes.-In this case, a gram is a measure of weight or mass equivalent to 1 1000 th of a kilogram. Hence there is no need to specify it under quantity conversions. Same for Meter and Kilometer, Liter and Milliliter, etc.-Resolution-We suggest to maintain a different Unit of measure in the corresponding quantity and the error will not appear.-Keywords-Cannot Convert Between UOM, Unit Of Measure, Product Master Data, Quality Conversion

Title: Wrong Discount When Using Gross Quality Loss Fee
Content: Symptom-The system is changing the gross amount of invoices created from Schedule Invoice Request from a positive value to a negative value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Create a Customer Contract in the System.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Click New.-Enter the needed data.-Select Gross Pricing within the General tab.--Navigate to the Items tab.-Add an item with item type Service - fixed price without actuals.-Select the Price per Period indicator.-Maintain the List Price 160,30.-Quantity: 1 Month.--Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Click the Add Row for the Item Pricing.-Select Gross Quality Loss Fee and enter the amount -91,60.-The Price Component Value is -91,60 since it is for 1 month.--Navigate to the Invoice Schedule subtab.-Click Add Row.-Select the item.-Enter 4 periods, each with 3 months (each period for a month within the year).-Save and Release.--Navigate to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search using the ID of the Contract.-Click Edit.-Select You Can Also.-Choose Create Schedule Invoice Requests.-Click Save.-Select the newly created Schedule Invoice Request,-Click Invoice.-The Gross Quality Loss Fee Amount is -274,80 (3 times the amount -91,60) and the Price Component value is -824,40 (-274,80 x 3 month).-Cause-The reason this is happening is because within the Gross Pricing Procedure, the Calculation Rule for Gross Quality Loss Fee is maintained as Fixed Amount and it needs to be changed to Quantity.- Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please change the calculation rule from Fixed Amount to Quantity for the Gross Quality Loss Fee.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Configure Price Strategy.-Click Open.-Select the Pricing Procedure hyperlink.-Select the Standard Gross Procedure.-Navigate to the Gross Quality Loss Fee (Step 050).-Change the Calculation Rule to Quantity.-Click Save and Close.-Now you can proceed with the creation of Gross like contracts and with the Gross Quality Loss Fee.-Keywords-Gross Quality Loss Fee, Discount, Wrong, Configure Price Strategy, Fixed Amount, Quantity

Title: How to delete Right of Use Assets with status "In Process" for a Cancelled Lease Contract
Content: Symptom-You want to delete a Right of Use Asset (RoU) for a cancelled Lease Contract.-After the Release of a Lease Contract a Right of Use Asset was created. You made a mistake in the Lease Contract, so you cancel the contract. You expect that the related Right of Use Asset updates to status "Retired", however it remains in status "In Process".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work center Fixed Asset.-Go to View Fixed Asset.-Search for Right of Use Asset ABC. (ABC represents the RoU Asset ID)-You can see the Status of the RoU Asset is "In Process".-Therefore you expect the Delete Button to be available, because no postings have been completed for the RoU Asset, however the Delete Button is greyed out.-Resolution-If you cancel the Lease contract and there are no postings completed on the RoU Asset then it is possible to delete the Lease Contract.-Once the Lease Contract is deleted, automatically the "In Process" Rou Asset ABC gets deleted also.-Keywords-Right of Use Asset; cancellation Lease Contract, Fixed Asset,

Title: The Error "Object currently locked by XXX; try again later" is Displayed for Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-You notice that a Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is currently locked for invoicing after a Invoice Run is performed in the system. When opening the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request the error "Object currently locked by XXX; try again later" is displayed in the UI.-(where XXX represents the user ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Request View.-Filter All Invoice Requests.-In the search field, search for the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC (where ABC represents the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ID).-Mark the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ABC.-Select Edit button.-The error "Object currently locked by XXX; try again later'" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-Two or more Invoice Runs have been scheduled to be executed by the user XXX. This invoice runs are sometimes overlapping which is causing both background jobs to try to access a document at the same time causing a lock error for the document.-This can be check by following the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Select the Background Jobs View.-Select the Advance Filter.-In the Responsible User field, enter the User ID XXX.-The Invoice Run/Background jobs scheduled for the user XXX will be displayed.-You can see by the recurrence period that at some moment of the day the Invoice Runs are occuring parallel execution which is causing the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request to be locked by the user XXX.-Resolution-We kindly recommend to rearrange the recurrence schedule of the Invoice Runs for the user XXX in order to avoid their parallel execution and therefore avoid the lock error for the invoice requests.-In addtion, if Invoice Requests documents are already with the error "Object currently locked by XXX,  try again later" then we ask you to open a case with approval to remove the locks of the invoice requests documents through the backend.-See Also-Please also kindly check the following documentation regarding lock errors for Sales documents in the system:-KBA 2733352 - You Receive Error Message "Operation not possible; document locked by ZZZ"-KBA 3319137 - Sales Order is Frequently Locked and Updated-Keywords-outbound delivery invoice request, invoice request, background jobs, object currently locked by, try again later

Title: Overhead Distribution run error - Sender XXX / ZZZ / WWW in rule YYY will be credited > 100%
Content: Symptom-The Overhead distribution run finishes with error:-Sender XXX / ZZZ / WWW in rule YYY will be credited > 100%-XXX - Sender-ZZZ - G/L Account-YYY - Distribution rule ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center > Overhead distribution view-Select All Distribution Runs-Search for the Run ID with error-Click Log Result link-Go to Messages tab-Error: -Sender XXX / ZZZ / WWW in rule YYY will be credited > 100%-Cause-One possible cause of the issue might be the G/L Account ZZZ is maintained more than once in the Financial Reporting Structure-Resolution-1) Identify the Distribution Rule used in the Overhead distribution run-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center > Overhead distribution view-Select All Distribution Runs-Search for the Run ID with error-Click Log Result link-Go to Data selection tab-Take a note of the Company ID,  Set of book and Distribution Rule-2) Identify the Financial Reporting Structure used in the Distribution Rule-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center > Distribution Rules view-Go to Advanced Search-Search for the Distribution Rule ID, Company ID and Set of book-Take a note of the Financial Reporting Structure-3) Review the Financial Reporting structure-Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Overview view-Search for the "Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination" activity-Under Financial Reporting structure, click Edit financial reporting structures-Search for the Financial Reporting Structure that was noted from the step #4 - Identify the Financial Reporting Structure used in the Distribution Rule-Select the Financial Reporting structure and click Edit-Click Search and search for the G/L Account ZZZ that is shown in the message error-You notice the G/L Account is used more than once-Review your Financial Reporting structure and delete the duplicate entries. The G/L Account should be maintained in only one expense-Keywords-overhead distribution, error, rule

Title: Blocked Material can be used in New Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have changed the status of a Material to "Blocked" but you can still use it in a new Purchase Order -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You are changing the status of a Material ABC as per below:-Work Center Product Portfolio -By Materials view-Search, Open and View All the material ID ABC (ABC being an example).-Go to Purchasing.-Change the status from Active to Blocked & Saved-Now you are creating a new Purchase Order:-Work Center Purchase Requests and Orders -Click New Purchase Order and View All-Under Items tab, ad the Product ID ABC in the Product ID field-This message appears: "No Search results"-Click "Enter", the Material Data will be maintained automatically on line Item level (Product Description, Product Category...).-You did not expect this behavior with a Blocked Material.-Cause-This is the current expected system behavior.-Resolution-Upon ordering the New Purchase Order, this error message will pop up:-"Item 1: Product blocked "-The system will always stop the creation of a new Purchase Order which contains a Blocked Material (or Service).-Also, it is never advised to force the entry of data in any field by clicking Enter.-Keywords-"Blocked Material", "New Purchase Order"

Title: Request to Enable Attachment After Outbound Delivery Has Been Released
Content: Symptom-Feature Request to be able to add attachment to Outbound Delivery in Released Status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Outbound Deliveries view. -Find and select a released Outbound Delivery.-Click Edit.-Go to the Line Items tab.-Go to the Attachments sub-tab.-You can see the Add button is greyed out and you cannot add a file or a link.-You would like to be able to add attachment to a Released Outbound Delivery.-Cause-Currently this function is not possible.-Resolution-Your request is beyond technical support as the feature/functionality you request is currently not part of the SAP product you have subscribed to, as outlined in our Product Documentation.-You have the following options:-You like your company or an SAP Partner to implement the feature/functionality into your environment, e.g. by using the SAP Cloud Application Studio for custom coding-You like to wait for SAP to potentially add this feature / functionality into the Standard Product, e.g. into SAP Business ByDesign-This program is related to Products and Solutions. Ideas are reviewed by SAP Product Management. Votes help to prioritize ideas along with other important selection criteria such as:-DESIRABILITY: How many customers voted for this? How many customers will benefit from it?-VIABILITY: Is this Improvement Request globally relevant? Is this in alignment with SAP’s strategy for the product?-FEASIBILITY: Is the development effort realistic?  Is this request achievable within the product’s architecture?--All ideas are welcome and valuable. However please note that the volume of ideas will usually be much higher than the scope of what we can accomplish on our product development roadmap. -In case you choose option 1:-Reach out to the responsible decision maker within your company.-Your company may reach out to an SAP partner of your choice.
