You may like to consult the Partnerfinder.-In case you choose option 2:-In order for you to directly get in contact with the decision makers in SAP Product Management, please submit your enhancement request via the following SAP Continuous Influence sites:-SAP Business ByDesign- To be able to add an attachment to an Outbound Delivery that is already released, you must Undo the Release of the Delivery and add your attachments.-Keywords-Outbound, Delivery, Released, Add, Attachment, Attachments,

Title: Customer Project Invoicing Task not Assigned to Responsible
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have noticed that the Review and Release Project Invoice Request tasks are being assigned to the global queue instead of assigning to the responsible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Task Management view-Select All items-Search for task XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the documents)--System returns the task assigned to the work center instead of the responsible.-Resolution-This standard system behavior.-Currently we do not have any activity that allows the control on user assignment for Review and Release.-Since there is no fine-tuning activity where we can decide the Responsible users, the task notification goes to the persons who has the Customer Invoicing work center access.-See Also-Business Task Management-Task - Review and Release Project Invoice Request-Keywords-Project Task, Assignment, BTM, Invoice Request

Title: No Outbound Delivery Item Matches Inbound Delivery Item Message In DFV Result
Content: Symptom-- Users encounter a message stating "No outbound delivery item matches inbound delivery item" when executing the Data Flow Verification (DFV) run.-- This issue is observed when the "Start Document Synchronization" button is clicked in the DFV results.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to "Application and User Management".-2. Go to "Data Flow Verification Results".-3. Search for the relevant result ID.-4. Click on the "Start Document Synchronization" button. The error message is displayed.-5. Click on the result to view the error message: "No outbound delivery item matches inbound delivery item".-Cause-The error occurs because in the delivery notification, the items are displayed as more than one line items as the material in the relevant line item is sent via multiple identified stocks from the outbound delivery line item.-So when executing the DFV run, the Outbound Delivery (OD) has one line item and the Inbound Delivery Receipt (IDR) has three line items, causing the error message.-Resolution-The issue can be resolved by creating an Inbound Delivery Document from the mentioned Inbound Delivery Notification (IDN).-The DFV result can be set as Closed after creating the Inbound Delivery. -Keywords

Title: Preview Functionality of Customer Account Statement
Content: Symptom-You want to know if Customer Account Statement can be previewed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Customer Account Statement sub view.-Show Active Runs and Search for the Run ID.-Select the Run ID and Choose View Report Run Results.-You do not find preview of Customer Account Statement.-Cause-You can only view Attachments generated out of Customer Account Statement Run and there is no preview available on Customer Account Statement.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to view attachments:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Account Statement sub view.-Show Active Runs and Search for the Run ID.-Select the Run ID and Choose View Report Run Results.-Go to Attachments sub view.-You can see the Attachment generated out of Customer Account Statement Run.-Keywords-Preview, Customer Account Statement, Attachment

Title: How to Sync External ID Which Is Not being Generated For Customer case in BYD and C4C
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Customer creates an case from their tenant, however once case is sent to SAP side, no external reference ID is generated. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-BYD:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to case view.-Filter for all incidents and search for incident subject or internal ID.-You will see that case is in status "in process - provider action" but no reference ID is generated/created.-C4C:-Go to Administrator work center.-Go to case view.-Filter for all cases and search for case subject or internal ID.-You will see that case is in status "in process - provider action" but no reference ID is generated/created.-Cause-When job is working successful, ByD source cases replicates from the tenant to the SAP for Me portal and ServiceNow in ~15 minutes. After this time, if no external ID has been generated/created, it is possible a replication issue.--There are multiple reasons for this issue occurring, hence case needs to be checked by development team component AP-SSR.-As workaround, you can proceed as steps provided in resolution tab to sync external reference ID manually while development check the issue.-Resolution-First check the source type of the incident : SAP for Me, chat, SaE or ByD.-SAP for Me, chat and SaE incident were not created from a tenant and are only accessible and visible in SAP for me portal.-This resolution applies only to cases which were created directly from a BYD or C4C tenant, hence the source of case will be always as "ByD".-  Logon to Customer Tenant Backend.-Go to T-code SE38.-In "Program" field paste the following report "APCRM_SSR_LP_INCIDENTS_SYNC".-Click to Execute button.-Refresh the case view in the tenant to check if external ID is generated/created.-Keywords-External ID, Reference ID, Sync Incident, Created, Generated, Incident, case to SAP

Title: Migration of a down payment showing with negative value
Content: Symptom-You are migrating a down payment with a positive value, however in the validation phase it appears with a negative sign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Overview.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the concerned migration unit and open the migration source file for Open Items Receivable.--Result: You see that you are migrating a positive amount for a down payment.--Go back to the migration unit and click on Execute Migration.-Select the source file line for Open Items Receivable.-Click on Process File.-Then click on Cross-Check Balances Preview.--Result: The amount for the down payment appears with a negative sign.-  Cause-The system uses the document type to determine the sign.-You are migrating a down payment, therefore it is with a negative value in the validation phase.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior. Even though you insert a positive value, as you are migrating a document type as down payment, the value will turn negative in the validation phase.

Title: How to identify which font types are used in PDF files
Content: Symptom-If the display of text in e.g. a Preview of a document differs from the display in Adobe Lifecycle Designer, the related PDF may contain not supported font types.  A simple option to find out which fonts are used in a PDF is described below:- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Prerequisite: You are using Acrobat Reader.-Open the PDF document in the Acrobat Reader, not in the browser version-Click somewhere in the document and select Ctrl + D-Select the Fonts tab-Check the font types that appear in the lists *-Note: Helvetica and MyriadPro are the fonts that are used to display text that was created with non supported fonts. In case you find not supported font types below Helvetica and MyriadPro, this means that the document includes these font types, but they cannot be displayed and Helvetica respectively MyriadPro are used to replace them. -See Also-3023486 - Supported Fonts Types in Form Templates-2946723 - Font is Different In Output Preview Than When Editing Form Template with Adobe LifeCycle Designer-Keywords-fonts; check; find out;

Title: Error "Switching off Supplier Approval not possible: open requests exist" while trying to merge Change Project
Content: Symptom-You are trying to merge a Change Project and get below error in your Merge Report:-"Issue found during the technical merge-Switching off Supplier Approval not possible: open requests exist"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select relevant Change Project.-Open Activity List.-Open activity Merge.-Start merge.-It will finish in error and you will see complete error details under "Merge Report".-Cause-You are trying to de-scope the Question "Do you want to set up the approval process for suppliers?", but this is not possible to be done while there are suppliers under In Approval status in the system.-Resolution-You need to clear the suppliers in status Potential Suppliers.-This can be checked in below path:-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Filter by Potential Suppliers.-After there are no more Potential Suppliers it should be possible to de-scope the Question.-Keywords-merge error, merging error, suppliers, Switching off Supplier Approval not possible, not able to merge, project, supplier approval, approval process

Title: Condition 'Item Without Purchase Order' is not working in supplier invoice approval process
Content: Symptom-You have maintained condition 'Item Without Purchase Order' in supplier invoice approval process, however it is not working for document type down payment request as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Process view.-Open the approval process for supplier invoice and you have maintained condition 'Item Without Purchase Order' equal to Yes, then the invoice goes into the approval.-However when creating new down payment request with purchase order reference on the item level, it still goes into approval.-Cause-The condition 'Item Without Purchase Order' for supplier invoice approval process is not effective for down payment request as per current logic. -Resolution-There is an alternative workaround available using another condition "Reference to Purchase Order" for down payment instead of "Item Without Purchase Order". This condition also checks for purchase order reference at item level in the backend.-Keywords-Down payment request, supplier invoice, Approval, Item Without Purchase Order, Reference to Purchase Order

Title: Unable to Renew Certificate as the Button is Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-You are trying to renew a Certificate in the system, however the button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator work center.-Then go the Communication Certificates view.-Try to click Renew Tenant Certificate, however it's greyed out.-Cause-The button is greyed out for inbound certificates as this should be renewed from the sender's side. The sender has the keypair for the inbound certificates, hence it cannot be renewed from SAP side.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The button will be active only for Outbound Certificates as SAP is the sender is such cases. This can be checked if we change the category from Inbound to Outbound in the drop down.-Keywords-Unable, Renew, Certificate, Button, Greyed Out, Inbound, Outbound, Renew Tenant Certificate.

Title: Standard Export to Excel Function Export Duplicate Value
Content: Symptom-When calling the standard export function to export the custom BO to Excel, there are duplicate values shown in the exported file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer BO screen.-Click on export -> to MS Excel.-Open the downloaded file.-The values in field A and filed B are duplicated, while in the frontend, the data is shown correctly.-Cause-This is the designed system behavior due to the field name of field A and B are part of each other so that the system cannot mapping the data correctly.-Resolution-For compound fields A and B, if the UI Names both contains the same value, the system will fail to mapping the value. For example, if the UI Name of field A is Price/content and the UI Name of field B is PriceUnit/content, the same value will be exported to excel since both names contains the value Price.-In this case, change the name of any of these fields so that they are not part of each other. Then the issue will be resolved. For example, Price can be changed to Price1 and then PriceUnit/content will not contain Price1 and the correct mapping will be done.-See Also-Custom BO, Export to Excel, UI Name, Duplicated Value

Title: Error: "Item XX: Project ABC is a customer project" when linking a Contract Item to a Project Task
Content: Symptom-Error: "Item XX: Project ABC is a customer project" (Where XX stands for the line item and ABC the Project ID), when searching for a Project Task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center-Select Contracts view-Show: All Contracts-Search for Contract ID 123 (Where 123 refers to the Contract ID)-Click in Edit and Go to Items tab-Click in Add Row and add a Product ID which is type project based-Under Cost and Revenue Assignment, click in the value help and search for Project Task ABC-The following error message appears:-Error: Item XX: Project ABC is a customer project-Cause-Right next to Project Task there is a (?) sign, if you hover over the mouse, the following message appears:-"You can assign the item to a project task in a multi-customer project or a direct cost project to enable costs and revenues for services and expenses to be posted to the project. A multi-customer project is recommended. You cannot assign the item to a customer project or overhead cost project."-Hence, since Project ID ABC is a customer project the system throws the error message as the project must be a multi-customer project.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-Keywords-Cost and Revenue Assignment, Value Help.

Title: Not Delivered Product in Purchase Order Doesn't Show in the Corresponding Product Planning Screen
Content: Symptom-A product in purchase order is not delivered. However, it doesn't show in the corresponding product planning screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Access view Purchase Orders -Find purchase order ABC, click Edit.-Select tab Items, for product DEF, Ship-To Location is XYZ, Delivery Completed shows Not Delivered.-Go to work center Supply Planning.-Access view Products.-Search product DEF in planning area XYZ, click Open. In the screen "Product Planning Details: DEF/XYZ", there is no purchase order ABC.-Cause-Though purchase order ABC shows not delivered, actually all quantity has been received and then returned to supplier, there is no open quantity remains for receipt from perspective of product planning. Therefore, the purchase order will not display in the product planning screen as supply.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Not Delivered, Supply Planning, Product Planning

Title: The Invoicing Unit in Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is Different From What was Maintained in The Sales Order.
Content: Symptom-While checking the Invoicing Unit in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request it differs from the Invoicing Unit which was maintained in the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice requests view.-Select All Invoice Requests.-Search for Outbound Delivery Invoice Request XXX (XXX represents invoice ID).-Click on Invoice button.-Navigate to Involved parties.-The Invoicing unit is different from what was maintained in the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents sales order ID).-Cause-While checking the changes performed in the Sales Order, the Invoicing Unit was changed after the Customer Demand was created.-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select All Orders.-Search for the sales order ABC.-Click on Edit and click on View All.-Navigate to the Changes tab.-The Invoicing Unit was changed from ZZZ to YYY. (ZZZ and YYY represents the initial and changed invoicing unit respectively).-Resolution-To resolve the issue and correct the discrepancy, either cancel the released Outbound Delivery and also the respective line item at Sales Order item level by setting reason for rejection. Then add new line item with correct Invoicing Unit before creating Customer Demand.-Or cancel to complete Sales Order by setting Reason For Rejection at the header level of the Sales Order and then create a new Sales Order.-It is not possible to update the current Outbound Delivery Invoice Request as the changes were made in Sales Order after delivery process was already started.-See Also-KBA 2047019 - How to Delete or Cancel an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request-Keywords-Invoicing Unit; Outbound Delivery Invoice Request; Sales Order; not expected invoicing unit

Title: "Service call failed, report an case" while Migrating any Business Object
Content: Symptom-While trying to migrate a file (e.g. Suppliers) using migration tool in Business Configuration, the following error is shown at simulation step:-"Service call failed, report an case"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-For example-Go to Business Configuration work center-Enter the Overview view-Search for 'Migration of Suppliers'-Select 'Migrate suppliers using the migration tool'-Select the relevant file to be migrated -Execute Migration Step by Step -After simulation, error message appears-Cause-This error may indicate incorrect content in the migration file, like fields that are missing or incorrectly filled (for example, Output Channel is not maintained in Collaboration Multichannel for Supplier Migration).-Resolution-In order to solve the issue, please check the file to see if there is any field/content missing or incorrect (for example, maintain Output Channel in Collaboration Multichannel for Supplier Migration).-Keywords-Material, Suppliers, customer, migration error, migration of,

Title: SSO not available for SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You want to use SSO to login into SAP Cloud Applications Studio, but it is not available.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Try to login using SSO.-Notice that SSO is not available as a login choice.-Cause-SSO is not currently a feature available for SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Resolution-It is currently this is not supported in SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-You can register this requirement on the ideas forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#. On this forum, other customers can vote for your requirement which will give us a better understanding on the priority of this functionality. Our product management delivers the features requested here according to priority and technical feasibility and effort.-Keywords-SSO, Cloud Application Studio, SDK, Login, PDI.

Title: Barcode Scanning Functionality in ByDesign
Content: Symptom-It is required to confirm whether the SAP barcode scanning functionality is functional and can be integrated with the following scanner type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Support for Scanner Devices-Effective May 2016 release, support for rugged devices is deprecated. This means that SAP will not offer further enhancements for this functionality.-SAP will continue to provide minimal support for existing customers. No support will be available for new customers.-For new customers, it is recommended to contact the implementation partner . For more information, refer to Scanner Strategy in SAP Business ByDesign-Effective November 2016 release, Windows Mobile: Mob Warehouse software installation package available in the download center in service marketplace will be withdrawn.-Resolution-In order to provide  with a more holistic usage and flexibility for scanners/rugged devices, a Partner based strategy is strictly recommended by SAP. There are various out-of-the-box web-services already provided which could be used by implementation partners to provide mobile or scanner interfaces as per business needs. These web-services can be accessed by following the below mentioned steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Input and Output Management view and choose the Service Explorer sub-view.-Below are the names of a few webservices which could be used for enhancements:-Query Site Logistics Tasks:  To support query on task types such as Inbound - Unload, Put-away, Outbound - Pick, Load & Internal - Replenishment, Removal.-Manage Site Logistics Tasks:  To support  Inbound - Unload, Put-away, Outbound - Pick, Load & Internal - Replenishment, Removal confirmations.-Query Production Lots: To support query on production lot based on following parameters: Production Lot ID, Production Request ID, Production Order ID, Output Product ID, Site ID, Lifecycle Status.-Manage Production Lots: To support confirmation of production tasks such as Make and Supply.-Create Goods and Activity Confirmations for Goods Movements: To support ad-hoc Goods Movement within a site.-Create Goods and Activity Confirmations: To provide the ability to scrap the inventory items from the specified logistics area within a site via a webservice.-Manage Logistics Layout Execution: To support creation of new Replenishment and Removal tasks.-Please note that the scanner functionality in Business ByDesign currently offers a limited enablement scope (for the existing customers only), mentioned as follows:-Support for a very limited set of scanner devices which are mentioned below:-Microsoft® Windows® Mobile 6.1-Intermec® CK3 and CN3.-Motorola® MC9090, MC55 and MC70 Enterprise Digital Assistant.-Microsoft® Windows® Mobile 6.5-Motorola®MC9190G.-The existing capabilities for warehouse and production confirmation activities are very basic in nature.-Advanced capabilities providing greater scanning flexibility such as support for Product Count, support for alternative Logistics Area scanning etc. are not available by default.  -Since webservice enablement is readily available, further enhancements of functional and performance topics can only be performed with the help of partners. SAP will continue to maintain the current available scope and resolve any bugs that are detected.-See Also-Configuration: Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128-SAP Business ByDesign Mobile Execution (for Rugged Devices)-Keywords-Barcode, Scanner, Rugged, Devices, ByDesign

Title: Extension Field Created in Product Master not Available in the New Return to Supplier Screen
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field in the product master data and extended to purchase order, inbound delivery and other document types. However in the new return to supplier screen, the created extension field is not available. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Common Tasks and select New Return to supplier-Select the Query Supplier Delivery Items by Selection -Select the relevant Inbound Delivery and click on Next button -In the Edit Return to Supplier phase, go to Adaptation mode-You are unable to find the extension field-Cause-There is no extension scenario available from product to return to supplier document in the further usage section. Hence the extension field will not appear in the new return to supplier screen. The return to supplier screen is currently not supported with extension scenarios. -Resolution-Creating extension fields in the Return to Supplier document is not supported. You can post the idea in influence forum and share the feedback - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. -Keywords-Return to Supplier extension field; extend field to Return to Supplier screen; Extension scenario in Return to Supplier

Title: Error "Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted failed; retry or report an case. " While Confirming Milestone: Design Accepted
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm the milestone: Design Accepted, but system reports error:" Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted failed; retry or report an case. "-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center, Implementation Project view.-Select the First Implementation project.-Open Activity List.-Go to Prepare tab.-Open the activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted. -Confirm.-System reports error "Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted failed; retry or report an case. ".-Cause-You have scoped question "Do you want to enable data extraction from attachments for automatic expense creation?", but extract expense data from attachment not supported for China datacenter.-Resolution-Please descope the question "Do you want to enable data extraction from attachments for automatic expense creation?" as below:-Go to Business Configuration work center, Implementation Project view.-Select the First Implementation project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to step 4, Questions.-Expand Travel and Expenses, then expand Expense and Reimbursement Management.-Select the Expense Reporting.-On the right side of the screen, navigate to Extract expense data from attachment.-Uncheck question "Do you want to enable data extraction from attachments for automatic expense creation?". -See Also-2959689 - Error Message "Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted Failed; Retry or Report an case"-Keywords-Confirm Milestone; Design Accespted Failed; Retry or Report an case; Business Configuration; First Implementation

Title: Error Occurred While Requesting Approval for Customer Invoice for E-Invoicing.
Content: Symptom-You are experiencing an error while requesting approval for the Customer Invoice in e-invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-View: Invoice Documents.-Search for Invoice ID ABC and edit it (ABC represents customer invoice ID).-Click on Legal approval button and Request Approval.-Error occurs: "Account role is not maintained for Business Partner XYZ" (XYZ represents Business Partner id).-Cause-You have defined the communication arrangement with the business partner and enabled legal approval for invoices in India. However, the current communication arrangement is outdated and no longer supported.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, please follow the steps below to remove the scope of the above question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and choose Edit Project Scope.-In the Questions section, navigate to Compliance and expand it.-Then expand Invoice Processing and choose Invoice Reference Number - India-Scope the following business options:-To scope the communication arrangement for business partner, select the checkbox In Scope against the question: Do you want to have a communication arrangement with business partner for electronic invoices ?-Uncheck this question and finish your scoping.-Keywords-Customer Invoice; E-invoicing; Account; Business Partner; Legal Approval; Communication Arrangement

Title: The Tax Code Determined for a Service Product is not as Expected if the Ship-to Party is the Contact of Account
Content: Symptom- The Tax Code determined in a Sales Document e.g. a Sales Order for a Service Product is not as expected if the Ship-to Party is the Contact of Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from Common Task.-Add the account ABC in the sales order (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Add ship-to party XYZ (XYZ is the contact maintained under account ABC).-Go to the Items tab of the sales order and add a service DEF (DEF represents the ID of the service).-Select the Taxes subtab.-The Tax Code is Domestic Sale, Standard Rate.-You expected Non-EU Export of Services, Reverse Charge (in an Non EU scenario) or EU Sale of Services, Reverse Charge (in an EU scenario).-Cause-The tax determination logic in the system differs if a ship-to party is not a company:-If you select contact XYZ as ship-to, then the condition Is Service Recipient is company? becomes False --> hence the Tax Code is determined as Domestic Sale.-If you select account ABC as ship-to, then the condition Is Service Recipient is company? becomes True --> hence the Tax Code is determined as Non-EU Export of Services, Reverse Charge (in an Non EU scenario) or EU Sale of Services, Reverse Charge (in an EU scenario).-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Service; Tax Code; Service Recipient; Ship-To; Person; Company; Employee; 501; 530; ; 310; 550; EU Sale of Services; Reverse Charge; Domestic Sale of Services; Non-EU Export of Services,

Title: 500 Internal Error When Trying to Approve Sales Order Containing Sales Kit Items.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to approve a Sales Order which contains one or more Sales Kit line items, however, when clicking the Approve button, the system displays a '500 Internal Error'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Manage My Area work center.-Open the Approvals view.-Search for Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the affected Sales Order).-Click the Approve button -The system will display a '500 Internal Error' after a few seconds.-Cause-This error can happen when the value of the Ship-From is not present in the Sub Items of a Sales Kit. You can check this as follows: -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC.-Edit the document and click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Highlight the line item containing the Sales Kit Header Item.-You will see that the Ship-From information is present.-Now, highlight any line item containing the Sales Kit Sub Items.-You will see that the Ship-From information is empty.-Resolution-In order to correct this scenario, you need to withdraw the Sales Order from approval and then perform a dummy change on the Sales Kit Header Item. The steps are as follows: -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC.-Edit the document and click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Highlight the line item containing the Sales Kit Header Item.-Change/Remove the Ship-From (Or the Fulfillment).-Press ENTER.-Revert the value of the Ship From or Fulfillment back to what it was before the change on step #7.-Press ENTER.-The system will then update the Ship-From on all the Sales Kit Sub Items and allow the document to be approved.-Keywords-Approval, Sales Order, 500, Error, Dump, Crash, Message, Internal, Sales Kit, Header, Item, Sub, Ship-From, Fulfillment

Title: Error: Change to profit center assignment not possible; Used in fixed assets
Content: Symptom-You try to add another Profit Center assignment to a Fixed Cost Object that already holds a Profit Center and you receive the error:-Change to profit Center assignment not possible; Used in fixed assets-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Select the view Free Cost Objects.-Search and find XYZ (XYZ represents the Cost Object ID).-Select Edit.-Go to the Assignments Tab.-Under Organizational Assignment select Add Row.-Enter a line for the second Profit Center.-Select save.-Error Appears: -Change to profit center assignment not possible; Used in fixed assets -Cause-System functionality does not allow the assignment of a free cost object with multiple profit centres assigned.-Resolution-Create a new Free Cost Object for the Profit Center with the validity required.-Keywords-Free Cost Object, Profit center, Change to profit center assignment not possible

Title: User License Type Mismatch under User Subscription in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--This KBA will give you details, where you find the license differences between the Application User and Management & Service Control Center work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User and Management work center-Go to Business User-Search for the User ex "XYZ"-You see User is consuming the Core User license-  When you try to find this user in User Subscription view from Service Control Center work center, you find the same user under different License Type-Navigate to Service Control Center work center-Go to User Subscription view-Open the Advanced User you see User "XYZ" is listed under this-  Cause-Possibly there could 2 reasons:-User Subscription data is not synced-Affected user might have Substitution who is consuming different license type.-Resolution-If there is any mismatch of the User License Type, please check the following:-Scenario 1. Please check is affected User "XYZ" have any active Substitution.-Example:-At the time when the substitution was created, the substitute consumed an advanced user license, but later it was changed to a core user license.-Note that subsequent license relevant changes made by the substitute do not influence the license consumption of the substitute.-In this What customers can do here? You need to check whether this substitution is still active and necessary. If not, you can just end it so that users again consume just a core user license. If the substitution is still necessary, we would recommend to end the current substitution and creating a new one with the same users. This way, the current license type of substitute would be used.-Scenario 2. No active Substitution exist for affected XYZ user- If there is no substitution for the affected user, please follow the below steps to update the User data:-Login to Production tenant.-Go to Service Control Center work center-Open User Subscription view-Select the affected License/User Type-Click on Synchronize Employee Data, this will synchronize "Updates all names, email address, User ID's and employee IDs on the User Type Overview screen"-If this doesn't update the right license types, please create incident for the same.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign User Subscription Quick Guide-SAP Cloud for Customer User Subscription Quick Guide-Keywords-User Subscription, License Consumption, Substitution.

Title: CurrencyConversion.SpellAmount is not supported in Arabic language
Content: Symptom-You are using CurrencyConversion.SpellAmount to convert number to words using Arabic language in your ABAP Code.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Open SDK(Cloud Application Studio).-Use SpellAmount for Arabic Language in the code.-No Conversion is happening.-Cause-Arabic is not currently supported please see the below code for your reference.-While the below code is correct but the SpellAmount will not convert to Arabic Language.-var spell;-this.Amount1.content = 10.14;-this.Amount1.currencyCode = "EUR";-this.Language = "AR";-spell = this.Amount1.SpellAmount (this.Language);-this.Integer = spell.IntegerValue;-this.Decimals = spell.DecimalPart;-Resolution-SpellAmount does not support Arabic as of now.-See Also-Please see this link explaining CurrencyConvesrion Reuse Library.-Keywords-Currency, Conversion, SpellAmount, Arabic, Language, Reuse, Library

Title: Issue with Retain Manager Checkbox in Personnel Administration Work Center
Content: Symptom-If You Transfer an Employee by Enabling the Checkbox Retain Manager to Different Org Unit the Employee is not Visible in the Active area of the Org Unit-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Work Center.-Go to Regular Tasks View.-In Employment Changes section, select Transfer an Employee.-Fill the following fields: Employee, Transfer Date, Organizational Unit, Job.-You notice that a checkbox appears Retain Manager Assignment.-Mark the checkbox Retail manager-And transfer an Employee to different org unit.-Cause-When users make changes to an organizational unit in edit mode, it will be immediately visible in the planning area. However, it may take up to a day for these changes in Personnel Administration to be reflected in the active area of the org unit.-Resolution-This delay is caused by a background job that runs daily. This means that it will take a day for the changes to be reflected in Active area-See Also-   3295270 - How Checkbox Retain Manager Assignment Works?-Keywords-Retain Manager , Org unit, Personnel Administration, Business partner data

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***WAITING FOR VALIDATION, if proven, change status to Published and remove this statement*** -You have executed the G/L Accounts - Line Items report and the Creditor Business Partner column shows the value "#", however you expect to see the Partner ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center > Design reports view-Search and open Report: G/L Accounts - Line Items-Enter the required selection-Under View, add the row "Creditor Business Partner"-Click Apply-The report shows the value "#" in the Creditor Business Partner column-Cause-A possible cause of this issue is a missing configuration in the Business Partner master data-Resolution-Go to Business Partner Data Work Center > Business Partners view-Search for the Business Partner ID XXX-Under Business Partner Roles section, click Account-Go to Finance Tab, click 'Add Row'-Enter the required information-Save-Keywords-partner ID, business partner ID, report missing

Title: Description in Fine Tuning Activity Reverting to a Different Value When Saving
Content: Symptom-When creating an entry for a fine tuning activity, the description is not saved as entered and reverts to the original as maintained in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open Business Configuration WoC.-Search for specific activity.-Open the hyperlink of the corresponding Business Configuration Object.-Click in 'Add Row'.-Enter a value for key and description. -Save it.-You will see that the inserted data changes/revert automatically to a specific value.-Cause-Description for BCSet cannot be changed in UI when you are trying to change description for an already existing Key maintained in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK).-Resolution-If you want to change the description of the BCSet entry created in the cloud studio, it should be done in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK).-Please refer to 'SAP Cloud Applications Studio Business Configuration: FAQs' blog post-Keywords-Business Configuration; Fine Tuning; Business Configuration Set

Title: Tracking ID Missing in The "Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue" Screen
Content: Symptom-You are performing Goods Issue and when you click "Post Goods Issue", you expect to be able to enter the Tracking ID in the "Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Delivery Proposals view. -Find and select the relevant Delivery Proposal.-Click Post Goods Issue.-In the "Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue" screen, the Tracking ID field is missing. -Cause-The feature/functionality you request is currently not support.-Resolution-You can only maintain "Tracking ID" in Not Released Outbound Deliveries.-We recommend the following help documents for further references:-Shipping Service Integration – Configuration Guide - https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/0635ec3491974ad988be05d6b1dcf734/2d118ff5722d1014b582a7ec17b46705.html?locale=en-US-Outbound Deliveries Quick Guide - https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2dde0356722d10148760c133049b0dfd.html?locale=en-US-See Also-2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-Tracking, ID, Post, goods, Issue, Outbound, Logistics, delivery

Title: Unexpected Plus or Minus Signs in Credit Memo XML
Content: Symptom-When the Output XML of a Credit Memo is checked, it is noticed that the values of the <CalculatedAmount> tag have inverted positive and negative signs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find and Open Credit Memo ABC (Where ABC Represents the Credit Memo ID).-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Output History tab .-Highlight one of the outputs and click the View Original XML button.-It will be observed that within the <CalculatedAmount> tag, the negative/positive signs for the values are inverted from what is seen in the Items themselves (The value intended to be positive is now displayed as negative, and the value intended to be negative is now displayed as positive).-Cause-Due to the nature of the Credit Memo functionality being different than a regular Customer Invoice, the values of the <CalculatedAmount> tag have inverted positive and negative signs.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Plus, Minus, Negative, Positive, Sign, Simbol, +, -, XML, Output, Code, Template, Credit Memo.

Title: Product Description is Empty in Intercompany Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You have created an intercompany sales order from purchase order, and found the product description is missing in the order line. However, the product description for language ZH is maintained in product master data (login language is also ZH).-The issue is not occurred when you manually create a new sales order for the same product.-Environment-SAP Business Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center view.-Open the sales order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the intercompany sales order).-Go to the Items tab, you find the product description is not displayed.-Double click the product ID hyperlink to open the product master data, the product description for the login language is actually maintained.-Cause-The sales order ABC is an intercompany sales order, created from purchase order.-In intercompany scenario, the order is created by A2B messages not manually by the login user. So the language is not taken from the login user. The language is EN by default. -Since there is no product description maintained in EN language, the product description in the order line is not displayed.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-intercompany sales order; product description missing; empty; blank.

Title: Migration of Services Shows no Error Details
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Services using the migration tool. During the simulation step, the tool shows that all service records contain errors, however no error message is shown in the error log.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Services.-Click on Migrate Services Using the Migration Tool.-Select the migration file.-Click on Execute Migration.-Click on Step-by-Step.-Proceed to step 3 - Simulation.-After the processing is completed, you can see the records with error.-Cause-This issue happens due to the Language field from the General tab of the migration template.-Due to a datatype constraint, the tool does not support values such as "EN", "ES", etc.-Instead, the template should contain either the full name of the language (for example, "English", "Spanish", etc.) or a single character ("E" for English, "S" for Spanish, etc.).-Resolution-Please adjust the Language field of the migration template General tab.-Keywords-Migration, Import, Execute Immediately, BC

Title: Error "Product ABC not valid; it is blocked" When Adding a New Product into a Sales Order or Service Order
Content: Symptom-When you add a new Product into a Sales Order or Service Order, you see error "Product ABC not valid; it is blocked" (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Product) and the document becomes inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Using a Service Order as an example:-Go to the Service Order Processing work center.-Open the Service Orders view.-Find and open Service Order DEF (Where DEF Represents the Service Order ID).-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab -Add Item ABC by inputting it's ID in a new Line Item.-The system will display error "Product ABC not valid; it is blocked"-Cause-This error is raised when the Product is Blocked for the particular Sales Organization and Distribution Channel used in the Sales Order or Service Order.-Resolution-You can correct the Blocked status by following these steps:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Open the Products view.-Find and Edit Product ABC.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Under Distribution Chains, find the pair of Sales Organization and Distribution Channel used in Sales/Service Order DEF.-Change the status of the Distribution Chain from 'Blocked' to 'Active'.-Save the Product.-Keywords-Blocked, Blocking, Block, Product, Material, Masterdata, Master data, Sales Order, Service Order, Error, Issue, Impossible, Unable, Error, Inconsistent, Red, Not Valid, Invalid.

Title: Error while trying to run reports from Excel using the SAP Add-In
Content: Symptom-Error while trying to run reports from Excel using the SAP Add-In:-Unexpected error in server communication; session needs to be closed-Message was: The remote server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error.-(Exception System.Net.WebException)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Try to run reports from Excel using the SAP Add-In.-SAP is failing to complete the download and giving me the following error message:-SAP Business ByDesign - Connect --- "Unexpected error in server communication : session needs to be closed. Message was: The remove server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error. (Exception System.Net.WebException)"-Cause-SAP C4C has an add-in for Excel; which provides a chance to create/update business objects depending on needs. After installation if there is something corrupted in your template or on template's structure, eventually you will get the Error: (500) Internal Server Error as output.-Resolution-Please, follow the steps outlined in the post below:-SAP C4C Excel Add-In: (500) Internal Server Error Solution <https://community.sap.com/t5/crm-and-cx-blogs-by-members/sap-c4c-excel-add-in-500-internal-server-error-solution/ba-p/13352030>-Keywords-SAP Add-In; Excel; Unexpected error in server communication; 500 Internal Server Error; Reports

Title: How to set 'Process Type' in purchase order webservice interface
Content: Symptom-User would like to know how to set 'Process Type' in purchase order webservice interface for some custom development purpose.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Process Type field is a derived field, based on certain conditions: like direct material indicator, third party indicator.-We don't provide PSM release for this particular field.-Resolution-'Process Type' field is a derived field, based on certain conditions like: 'DirectMaterialIndicator' and 'ThirdPartyDealIndicator'-For example, if you would like to set the purchase order as non-stock type, please set both 'Direct Material Indicator' and 'ThirdPartyDealIndicator' as false.-Note: For 'Item Type' field, we have item type code to support:-<BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>18</BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>-TypeCode          Description-18                      Material-19                      Service-20                      Limit-84                      Expense-Please go to Documentation link of ManagePurchaseOrderIn for detailed information.-Keywords-Process type, ManagePurchaseOrderIn, Item type, Purchase order, Non-stock, To-stock

Title: Error message when reporting an case to provider in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--You are unable to to send a case to SAP due to the error: "Cannot send to provider: please update your e-mail address and/or telephone number. For help, see the quick guide in the Help Center. To report the case internally, deselect the Forward to service proider checkbox".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the tenant.-In the right top corner, click on question mark button and select help center.-Scroll down to support tab and click on Solve an Issue or Report an Incident link.-Fulfill the pre-requisites to submit an incident, you will see the error message "Cannot send to provider: please update your e-mail address and/or telephone number. For help, see the quick guide in the Help Center. To report the case internally, deselect the Forward to service proider checkbox".-Cause-It is required to have an e-mail address and telephone number associated to your account.-Resolution-The workplace e-mail address can only be maintained by administrator not by employee/service agent himself/ herself.-To maintain the email address for:-(A) For Internal employees:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Regular Tasks view.-Select Change Workplace Contact Data task.-Search the Employee and enter Email under Communication Data.--(B) For Service Agent:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Service Agents view.-Select Service Agent and edit Email.-See Also-Cloud for Customer KBA 3164313 - You are getting an error while you want to send an case to SAP  Business ByDesign-Keywords-BYD, C4C,Report a case, Send case to provider, SAP, Provider, Business ByDesign, Cannot send incident to the provider.

Title: How to update the duration of the Project Phase when the duration of the respective Project Task is modified?
Content: Symptom-Duration of the Phase in a Project cannot be edited when the duration of the Task is modified-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Resolution-Once you change the duration of the Project task, kindly follow the below steps to update the duration of the subsequent Project Phase.-Go to Project Management work center -Go to Projects view and search for respective Project ID ABC-Select the Project Plan tab-Go to Gantt chart sub tab and click on More(>>) and then Options-Select the Schedule tab. This will automatically schedule the Phase duration based on the Task duration. -   See Also-Kindly refer to the below blog on Project scheduling and its aspects for further information. -Project Scheduling | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Project Phase duration update, Schedule the phase duration, phase duration

Title: How License Types Are Categorized/Mapped to Core, Advanced and Self-Service Users?
Content: Symptom-The License Model is divided into three categories: Core Users, Advanced Users, and Self-Service Users under User Subscription after the 2102 release.-Initially, the license type was differentiated as follows, this article helps to clarify, what is the mapping between Core Users, Advanced Users, and Self-Service Users (latest) to below types?-Standard Self-Service User-Standard Enterprise User-SCM Enterprise User-CRM Sales Team User-SCM Self-Service User-SCM Team User-Project Manager Self-Service User-Project Management Team User-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Workcenter-Go to User Subscription view-Notice the License Model has been categorized as below:-Advanced User-Core User-Self-Service User-Cause-After 2102 release, the License Model has been changed by SAP.-Resolution-The License Types are now mapped as follows:-Old License Type New License Type-Standard Enterprise User Advanced User-SCM Enterprise User-CRM Sales Team User  Core User-Project Management Team User -SCM Team User -Project Manager Self-Service User Self-Service User-Standard Self-Service User-SCM Self-Service User-Additional Questions:-1. Is there a feasibility to revert to the old License Type Model?-No, it is not possible to revert to the old License Type Model. Only those licenses which are bought shall be displayed.-2. “Change License Model” option is available in demo system, where the user can switch the view of License Types but are not available in Production/Test tenant. Could this be enabled in customer system?-When new license types were introduced, it was necessary to determine which new license types the customer needed to purchase in order to be compliant. This option is only enabled on demo systems.-3. Is there any priority relationship for old License Type Model?-Yes, there is a priority for different old License Type. If the user is assigned with two access rights and these two access rights need different License Type, the higher License Type will be consumed by this user. The priority of License Type is following: -SCM Enterprise User-Standard Enterprise User-SCM Team User-Project Management Team User-CRM Sales Team User-SCM Self-Service User-Project Manager Self-Service User-Standard Self-Service User-See Also-Release 2102 - https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2de1fdbd722d1014a64cdc160ca81c86.html?version=2102#display-your-user-subscriptions-by-type-Release 2311 - https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2de1fdbd722d1014a64cdc160ca81c86.html?version=2311#display-your-user-subscriptions-by-type-Keywords-User Subscription, License Type, License Model, Advanced User, Core User, Self-Service User

Title: Service Order Status with Item Type Service- Time and Material Is Still In Process.
Content: Symptom-Service Order with Item Type Service- Time and Material status is still In process and you expect it to be completed-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders work center-Go to Service Order Processing View-Search for Service Order XXX ( (XXX represents the ID of the Service Order). -Select the Service Order and click on Edit button-Navigate to the Items Tab.-Select line item YY(YY represents the ID of the line item).-You can see that the delivery status of the line item is still in process.-You expect the service order to be completed, however the service order is in status In Process.-Cause-You have released the Service Confirmation was Released Without Order Completion. The option Release With order Completion is still enabled. -Resolution-This is the Current system behavior. If you release the Service Confirmation without Order Completion, you have to Perform the action 'Complete Execution' in Service Order to change the status of Service Order from In Process to Completed. Please follow the below steps:-Go to Service Orders work center-Go to Service Order Processing View-Search for Service Order XXX-Select the Service Order and click on Edit button-Navigate to the Items Tab.-Select line item YY.-Click Complete Execution.-Service Order will now be completed-Keywords-Service Order, Time and Material, In process, release with order completion;

Title: In the JSON file, customer invoice ID appears as NIL instead of the number ID.
Content: Symptom- Customer invoice number missing in the JSON file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select Invoice Documents view-Search for invoice ID ABC (Where ABC stands for the Invoice ID)-Edit / View All-Under the General tab, go to Attachments section-Open the JSON file-  You will notice that the invoice ID is missing in the JSON file and instead the value appears as NIL.-  Please refer to the following part in the JSON file:-{"Typ": "INV", "No": "NIL",-Cause-"NIL" value for document number in JSON file comes when "request legal approval" button is directly clicked without first saving the document.-Resolution-For the legal approval of next document please follow below mentioned steps:-  1. When creating a new customer invoice, please first click on "Save" button, this will generate the customer invoice ID.-2. Once document id is generated and visible on the screen, please Click on "Legal Approval" -> "Request Approval" button.-Keywords-Invoice, incorrect number, incorrect ID, NIL, JSON, India.

Title: 'Different chart of accounts; provide a set of books or maintain mapping' Error In New Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-Error message 'Different chart of accounts; provide a set of books or maintain mapping' is displayed while clicking Simulate of clicking Post in a New Journal Entry Voucher.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Journal Entry Voucher option.-Enter respective Company, leave Set of Books field empty, enter Journal Entry Type 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher and Screen Variant 601 - Journal Entry Voucher and other required fields.-Enter the line items: one line for G/L Account ABC and a second line for G/L Account DEF (ABC and DEF mean G/L Accounts).-Click Simulate or Post.-Error is displayed: 'Different chart of accounts; provide a set of books or maintain mapping'.-Cause-The G/L Account Mapping has been done in the following sequence:-Chart of Accounts: Chart of Accounts assigned to an alternative set of books.-Mapped Chart of Accounts: Chart of Accounts assigned to default set of books (company's leading set of books).-This order is incorrect. The mapping should be done in the opposite way.-Resolution-Maintain G/L Account Mapping from Chart of Accounts assigned to the default set of books (company's leading set of books) to Chart of Accounts assigned to an alternative set of books.-See Also-Help Document Define G/L Account Mapping-Keywords-chart of accounts; CoA; mapping; set of books; SoB

Title: Query Not Saving in Advanced Filter for Down Payment Requests
Content: Symptom-Query is not being saved in Advanced filter for Down Payment Requests for both Supplier Invoices and Customer Invoices. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Select an invoice that has In Process status.-Click in Edit button. -Navigate to General tab. -Navigate to Payment Information subtab.-Navigate to Down Payment sub subtab. -Click in Add Row button. -In Dow Payment ID column, click in the double box to open the window regarding this field. -Open the Advanced Filter. -For Clearing Status field click in the "filter+" icon. -Make sure that the options maintained are "Equal to = Open" and "Equal to = Partially Cleared". -Click in Save Query button. -Maintain Query Name as "ABC" (ABC is the name of your query).-Maintain the "Execute Query on Selection: Yes".-Maintain the "Use as Default Query: No". -Click in OK. -Please repeat step 11. -In the drop down in the header select query "ABC". -Open the advanced filter. -For Clearing Status field click in the "filter+" icon. -The options maintain in steps 14-15-16 are not here. -The options maintained for query ABC were not saved. -The same happens for Down Payments from CRM side (Customer Invoicing). -Cause-This behavior is a technical limitation in the system. -Resolution-The Development Team is working to resolve it in the future releases.-Keywords-Down Payment Request; Down Payment; Query; Advanced Filter; Supplier Invoice; Customer Invoice

Title: Revenue Recognition Run doesn't display run descriptions while logged-in in different logon language
Content: Symptom-In the Revenue Recognition view, runs do not show Run Descriptions created in a language different from the user's logon language. The customer uses both Finnish and English logon languages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue Work center.-Under Periodic Tasks view, go to Revenue Recognition sub-view.-Here, the run descriptions are only visible in the language the run was originally created in making it harder for the users using different languages in the system to recognize their runs and tasks generated without description in their chosen logon language.-Cause-If the run descriptions were made in English, then when we log in to a system with Finnish logon logon language or vice versa, the Run Descriptions are not visible because there is no translation maintained for static texts. The Description will come only if it is maintained in that logon language.  -Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-However, you can also observe that when you copy a revenue recognition run from another one with blank description, the newly copied one has description. So, this can help the user recognize their runs.-See Also-3245156 - "There Is Description of Revenue Recognition Copied from Another Revenue Recognition without Blank Description"-Keywords-Revenue Recognition, Run Description, Logon Language, Finnish

Title: Unable to fetch the paid amount in Contract using KUT extension field
Content: Symptom-KUT extension field with Calculation Rule Payment Amount (PaymentAmount – PaymentControl) not fetching the paid amount from Relevant Invoices. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders -> Contracts view-Select the contract XXX (XXX represents the contract ID)-Edit and click on View All-Under General tab the  KUT extension field is not showing any value even though the invoice is Released -Cause-This  Calculation Rule Payment Amount (PaymentAmount – PaymentControl) is designed to fetch the external payment amount. It will only display a value if the Payment Method is set as External Payment. Therefore, it is not possible to retrieve the paid amount from the Payment Allocation for the respective invoices. -Resolution-To obtain the paid amount, you will need to refer to financial reports. Unfortunately, it is not feasible to directly fetch the value in the contract.-Keywords-Zahlungsbetrag; payment allocation;
