Title: The Bank Accounts Field is Displayed in Blank During the Creation of a Manual Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You notice that while creating a new Manual Invoice Request and filling the mandatory information for the document, no options are displayed for the field Bank Accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Requests View.-Select New button.-In the dropdown, select Manual Invoice Request.-In Account field, enter Account ABC (ABC represents the Account ID).-In the Sales Unit field, enter the Sales Unit EDF (EDF represents the Sales Unit ID).-Select the value box of the Back Account field.-No Bank Accounts option are displayed.-Cause-The Bank Account options will be available in the Manual Invoice Request according to the Payment Reference selected for the document. Currently the following Payment Reference are available in the system:-Country/Region Independent-Inpayment Form 71 – Denmark-Inpayment Form 75 – Denmark-Obsolete:  ISR – Switzerland-Obsolete: Acceptgiro – Netherlands-The Bank Accounts are displayed according to the country selected in the Payment Reference option. Therefore the country of the Bank Accounts maintained in the master data of the Account ABC requires to be one of the following:-Netherlands-Switzerland-Denmark-Also your company requires to uses Acceptgiro, ISR, or OCR - Denmark payment processes. -In addition, the scoping question 'Payment Reference Processing for Receivables' also must be "In Scope" in order to use the functionality for the Bank Account field in the system. -Therefore as an example, if the Payment Reference "Inpayment Form 71 – Denmark" is selected when creating a Manual Invoice Request for the Account ABC, a Bank Account with Country/Region maintained as Denmark must be included in the Financial tab of the Account ABC in order for the option to be displayed in the field Bank Accounts.-Resolution-This is currently a standard system behavior.-In addtion, further information regarding the Payment Methods can be found by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-In the search field, search for the Payment Reference Processing for Receivables.-Select the Payment Reference Processing for Receivables hyperlink.-A detailed description will be displayed regarding the usage of the Payment Reference functionality.-Keywords-payment reference, bank accounts, field, manual invoice request, invoice request, blank, not appearing, value box

Title: Error Message : 'Form template code mandatory' Occurs When You Create Pro Forma Invoice for Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Error message "Form template code mandatory" when you try to create a pro forma invoice for the sales order, even though you have maintained the template in the system.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Search for Sales Order XYZ. (XYZ is the ID of the Sales Order.)-Select the Sales order and click on proforma invoice.-The proforma invoice is not generated.-You get the error message: "Form template code mandatory".-Cause-The error message 'Form template code mandatory' occurs because there are no line items in the Sales Order XYZ and the form template for the Pro forma invoice is determined based on the Tax Country determined for the Item. You cannot create a Pro forma invoice for Sales Order without Line Items.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior. You will be able to create the Pro forma invoice after you add the line items.-See Also-2982572 - Error: 'Form template is mandatory' or 'There's no Template Code in the Predefined Output Determination Rule'-3009144 - Form Template Code Mandatory Proforma Invoice-2974095 - Error message: 'Form template code mandatory' occurs when you try to create a Pro forma invoice.-3157009 - Form Template Code Mandatory Proforma Invoice in Outbound Delivery-Keywords-Form Template Selection, Form template code mandatory, Error, Preview, Allocate. Customer Invoice, Invoice Document, Form, Sales Order

Title: Error "500 SAP Internal Server Error" while selecting changes tab.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Changes made under Account ID is not reflected when checking changes tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management.-Locate and open the relevant Account ID.-Click on Edit.-Select General and click tab changes.-Click on execute the query.-"500 SAP Internal Server Error" occurs.-Cause-This error is due to BO node AttachmentFolder.FILE_CONTENT deleted from BO CUSTOMER.-The dump is happening due to unavailability of node in BO.-Resolution-Forward to SRD-CRM-ACC development team to make required below changes.-The removed nodes is part of the BC set node for the change document node exclusion (/ISPCD/C_M_NODE). Change Document Service searches the exclusion table for entry whenever it is unable to locate metadata information for the node. If the item is found, it means the node has been removed from the BO model. The change document would then restore all of the node's entries to the application without undergoing any modifications (obtaining UI text and ESR names).-Make the required formatting changes in change document items inside their BADI implementation ECO_TRANSFORMATION.-See Also-Handling of Change Documents for deprecated or deleted BO Model - ByD Cloud Technology Layer - ByD India Responsibility - Wiki@SAP (int.sap)-Keywords-BO Nodes, Account Management, Attachment disappeared

Title: Error Message: “Settings Cannot be Changed”, While Trying to Edit or Add an Activity to a Merged Change Project
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to Edit/Add an activity in a Merged Change Project, but system throws the message:-'Settings cannot be changed'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Highlight your Merged Change Project, and select Open Activity List button.-Select the activity.-OR-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Highlight your Merged Change Project, and select Open Activity List button.-Select the activity.-Select Add to Project button.-Cause-Once the Change Project has been Merged no change can be done on this project. Only Confirm Go-live and Close Project activities are Open.-Resolution-If Change Immediately button is available for the activity, you may change the activity using the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for the activity.-Select Change Immediately button and make the desired changes.-If the Change Immediately button is not available for the activity, a new Change Project will be required or in case you already have a Change Project with status Started, you can Add this activity to the Change Project and make the desired changes.-Keywords-Merge, Started, changes, projects, activity, immediately, byd, c4c

Title: Additional Compare Operator is Required for Extension Field in Customer Invoice Approval Process
Content: Symptom-When you add an Extension Field as Condition in Approval Process for Quote or Sales Order, the Compare Operator is not as expected. In the drop down list of the Compare Operator field, you cannot find "Contains" and "Does not contain".---Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center- Approval Processes View-Select Approval Process: Customer Invoice-Click Copy-Click Add Group in Conditions session-Select the Extension Field ABC (where ABC stands for the Extension Field you have created) -In the drop down list of the Compare Operator field, you cannot  find "Contains" and "Does not contain"-You expect to see Compare Operator "Contains" and "Does not contain".-Cause-When you add an Extension Field as Condition in Approval Process for Customer Invoice , you cannot find the Compare Operator as "Contains" or "Does not contain" for extension field type List or Amount, Decimal Number or Quantity. The Compare Operator  "Contains" or "Does not contain" is available only if the Extension Field Has Calculation check box is checked.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior-Keywords-Extension Field, Approval Process for Quote, Compare Operator; Amount; Decimal Number; Quantity; Greater Than; Equal to; Less than; Condition; Parameter

Title: GSTIN Number is Missing for the Ship-To Party Role in the .JSON File
Content: Symptom-In the JSON file generated from a Invoice document, the GSTIN number is missing for the Ship-To party role.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Select the Invoice Documents View.-Search for the Invoice ABC (where ABC represents the Invoice ID).-Mark the Invoice ABC.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the General tab.-Locate the Attachments sub tab.-Download the .JSON file generated for the Invoice. -Open the File in your computer.-The GSTIN number is not displayed in the "ShipDtls" section.-Cause-As per the latest GSTN notification dated 29 July 2026, the mandatory Ship-To GSTIN requirement for e-Way Bill generation has been kept on hold until further notice.-Accordingly, SAP Business ByDesign will revert the following solution changes introduced based on the GSTN notification earlier via an Emergency Patch planned to be deployed on the weekend of the 31st of August:-The GSTIN Number for the Ship-To Party Role has been added to the JSON file with Release 2605 Hotfix Collection 3 which was deployed on the weekend of the 18th of July. (Hotfix number 1000040608)- Resolution-The system will continue to function as it did prior to the implementation of the Ship-To GSTIN enhancement.-Any GSTIN maintained in Customer Master Address Line 5 will remain unchanged but will not be used for Ship-To GSTIN determination in e-Invoice JSON or output forms.-If Address Line 5 contains any value other than a valid GSTIN, the maintained value will continue to be printed as part of the address section in the JSON and print forms.-SAP will continue to monitor GSTN updates and communicate any future changes once a revised implementation timeline is announced. -Keywords-gstin, not displayed, missing, json, invoice, ship to, e-invoice, india, URP, Approval, GST, e-Way Bill

Title: Payments not picked up in the Quarterly Tax Return Run.
Content: Symptom-You have initiated Tax Return Run XXX for Quarterly period. While checking data, it is reflecting only one month of data.-('XXX' refers to Tax Return Run id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Tax Management work center.-2) Go to Withholding Tax Returns sub view.-3) Search for Tax Return XXX.-4) Here you have verified the time period which is From: 01.01.9999 TO: 31.03.9999 (Quarterly period of time - Example : January, February and March ).-5) Then check the Report: Withholding Tax Items -6) Input parameters like Company, Supplier, Income type, etc..,-7) Here you will see that it has transactions in February and March, but not included in the Tax Return run.-By copying the same Withholding Tax Return Run, you have tried to run the correction run, but you are facing the below mentioned error message.-Error: No reported tax return to be corrected was found.-Cause-The reason is that, you could see there are multiple acknowledge numbers present for January, February and March months (i.e.., Quarterly period of time).- Resolution-It is expected that the payment should contain the challan number and payment reference number as mandatory without that 26Q return won't get created.-But for the February and March months challan return Run you haven't maintained. This might be one of the reasons.-Challan Identification Number & Payment Reference Number which is not maintained for both the payments is the reason when you create the quarterly return, February and March months documents are not getting picked. Instead only January month got picked up.-So you have to maintain the challan number for the payment documents so that those documents will get picked in the 26Q return.-For alternate solution you can create a separate returns for February and March months.-  Please follow the below provided steps to maintain the required fields:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select the Tax Payments view.-Find out your Tax Payment ID.-Select your desired Tax Payment ID and click on the View button.-Give Challan number in the Challan Identification Number field as well as in the Payment Reference Number field.-Once you have maintained this, now try to do the Quarterly Tax Return Run. Now all the 3 months of payment will be picked up without any issue.- See Also-1963579 - Error Message : "Challan Identification Number Format Is Incorrect" when Filling Challan Identification Number For Withholding Tax Payment.-Keywords-Tax Return Run, Quarterly Tax Return Run, Challan Identification Number, Payment Reference Number, Withholding Tax.

Title: In Edit Timesheet Columns Not Getting Re-Ordered
Content: Symptom-When user rearranges the columns in the Edit Time Sheet via Personalization mode by dragging and dropping for each view, however after save the order of columns are not updated for either of the views day/week -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time, select Edit Time Sheet-In the Time Entries section, select the View Day from the drop-down menu-Select Start Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-You are now entering the Personalization Mode-Select OK-Change the order of the columns Start Time, End Time, Hours-Select Save in the Personalization panel-Select Stop Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-Choose Save and Close-Now perform the steps:-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time, select Edit Time Sheet-In the Time Entries section, select the View Week from the drop-down menu-Select Start Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-You are now entering the Personalization Mode-Select OK-Change the order of the columns Start Time, End Time, Hours-Select Save in the Personalization panel-Select Stop Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-Choose Save and Close-The positions of the columns are not as the same for the previously saved view-Cause-The positions of the columns are not maintain in the order of personalization.-Resolution-Rearrange the columns and save the personalization for both the view Day and Week at the same time -  Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time, select Edit Time Sheet-In the Time Entries section, select the View Day from the drop-down menu-Select Start Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-You are now entering the Personalization Mode-Select OK-Change the order of the columns Start Time, End Time, Hours-In the Time Entries section, select the View Week from the drop-down menu-Change the order of the columns Start Time, End Time, Hours-Select Save in the Personalization panel-Select Stop Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-Choose Save and Close-Keywords-Reorder, Personalization mode, Edit Time Sheet, Self-Services

Title: Message Monitoring option not displayed for documents in the SESFTS transaction
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You would like to check the sequence XI messages created for a specific document in the transaction SESFTS, however the Message Monitoring option is not being displayed. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For the following example, we will use the Sales Order BO: -Logon to the backend.-Go to Transaction SEFTS.-Search for the BO name -> SALES_ORDER.-Select the arrow in the folder Icon.-Select the option Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the "ID/content" field, insert the Sales Order ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Select Confirm.-In the BO Instance Structure Column, Right click the Sales Order ID XYZ.-The Message Monitoring option is not displayed.-Cause-In this case, the Message Monitoring option is currently not enable in the transaction SESFTS for the Support User used to access the backend.-Resolution-The following steps can be performed in order to enable the Message Monitoring option in the SESFTS:-Logon to the backend.-Go to Transaction SEFTS.-Click in the Changes Setting Icon (little User Icon).-Select Perspectives.-In the dropdown, select the Change Perspective Settings.-Select the Function Overview tab.-Scroll to the bottom, Select the 'x' Icon for the Message Monitoring option (the Icon will change to a pencil).-Go back to the Initial screen for the Transaction SEFTS.-Now the Message Monitoring option will displayed in the backend when right clicking the specific document ID.-Keywords-backend, message monitoring, SESFTS, not displayed, not available, sales order, sales quote, return

Title: The field "Product Category" in Shopping Cart cannot be set as Mandatory from Adaptation Mode or Personalization Mode.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set the field "Product Category" in Shopping Cart as Mandatory but you cannot find any option from the ser interface.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue->>Work Center Home->>Self-Services Overview ->>Select Go Shopping Advanced->>In Step 3 (Edit Shopping Cart), the field "Product Category" cannot be set as Mandatory, either through Adaptation Mode or Personalization Mode.-Cause-The "Product Category" field cannot be made mandatory via Adaptation Mode or Personalization Mode as it is bound to above table (KBA 2372377 > point 7).-2372377 - Limitations of HTML5 UI in SAP Business ByDesign-https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2372377-Resolution-Please contact you add on partner in order to set the field "Product Category" mandatory through PDI solution.-Keywords-"Shopping Cart"; "Product category"; "Mandatory"; "Adaptation/Personalization Mode"

Title: Receipt Types Are Missing While Creating Expense Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-End User may raise an case stating that the system does not show any receipt type while creating an expense report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the New Expense Report On Behalf.-Fill in all the mandatory fields in step 1 General Information.-In step 2 Receipts, select the Add Row button.-Where the value help of Receipt Types is empty.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to check whether the receipt types are available in the backend table:-Login to the backend of the system.-Execute transaction BC80-Enter the table name as ERMC_SERV_PROV.-Select the respective BC set based on country, for example, if the country is US then the BC set is BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_US_RT.-Check the BC node, A1S_FIN_RECPTYPEERMC_ADG_ASS_2 and A1S_FIN_RECPTYPEERMC_EXPTYPE_A.-If the receipt types are not visible, then the issue is caused by that the BC set for that country is not deployed. In this case a redeployment of the BC node BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_US_RT by hosting colleagues will resolve the issue.

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When trying to enter in the Activity List of a Change Project/First Implementation, system shows the error below:-Some technical issues and inconsistencies have been found in your solution profile. Please find additional information below. You can close this screen and come back later, restart the upgrade or create an case.-Conversion of fine tuning set failed for node XYZ-An exception was raised-Field ABC in node XYZ has been deleted-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project entry.-Click Edit Project Scope.-During the Upgrade process system shows the error.-Cause-A field was deleted in a BC node even though Finetuning for this field existed.-In SLG1 you can find errors:-*Conversion of fine tuning set failed for node XXX-*Exception occurred when applying node changes:-*An exception was raised-*Field XXX in node XXX has been deleted-Resolution-Important: The steps below must be executed by a colleague from ByD Technology.-Using the transaction SE38, you can run the report RP_BCT_WS_UPGRADE.-On the selection screen select the affected workspace and select "Forced Mode". Title: Amount on Journal Entry Different From Amount in Sales Register-India Report
Content: Symptom-You run the report Sales Register-India and notice that the field 'Product Tax Base Amount' shows an amount different from the amount on the Journal Entry of the customer invoice. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for Invoice ID XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the invoice).-Net Value is 200, 36 EUR.-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Select Items tab.-Select Tax subtab.-Tax Base Amount is 200,36 EUR.-Select Document Flow tab.-Open the corresponding Journal Entry of the invoice.-The amount in the JE posting shows as 18.000,34 INR.-The posting date is 08.01.2024-The Exchange Rate is 89,84-To run the Sales Register-India report.-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view. -Open the report Sales Register-India.-Run the report with the necessary selection.-For invoice XXX , the report shows the Product Tax Base Amount as 18.244,78 INR.-18.244,78 INR in the report is different from amount 18.000,34 INR in the JE posting.-Note: The amounts and date used in this document are example.-Cause-The amount in the report is obtained from the exchange rate available in the system at the creation time of the invoice.-Before the posting of the Journal Entry, another exchange rate is maintained and is used for the journal entry posting. -This is why the amount on the journal entry posting is different from the amount in the report. -Resolution-This is the expected and designed system behavior.-To have the same amount in the report and on the journal entry, cancel invoice XXX and recreate it so the exchange rate used by the system for the invoice and the report is the same.-In the future, make sure at the creation time of the invoice, the appropriate exchange rate is maintained and available in the system.-Keywords-Product Tax Base Amount, Sales Register-India, Journal Entry, Customer Invoice, Exchange Rate.

Title: System Dump when you are Trying to Release Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-While trying to release Outbound Delivery the system throws a dump.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Outbound Deliveries view-Search for Outbound Delivery ABC (ABC represents Outbound Delivery ID)-Choose Release button-The system dumps.-Cause-Cost of the material is missing in the valuation tab of material master data.-Resolution-Maintain the cost of material & business residence data in the valuation tab of material master data.-Steps:-Go to Product Data Work Center-Go to Materials view-Search for Material XYZ. (XYZ represents Material ID)-Choose Edit.-Under Valuation tab, maintain the Cost & Business Residence data.-Choose Save.-After performing these steps Release Outbound Delivery.-Keywords-Dump; Outbound delivery; Release; Cost of material; Business Residence

Title: Error "Product Category ID Missing" While Saving a Material
Content: Symptom-When you save a Material (creation/modification), system throws below error message,-"Product Category ID missing"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center-Select Materials view-Update details-Select Save-Error : Product Category ID Missing-Cause-Mandatory fields has to be updated.-Resolution-Error occured as the Product was created without the Mandatory field.-All the mandatory fields should be filled before saving Material creation/update-Keywords-product category id missing, material, save

Title: Company details not displayed correctly in Supplier Master Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 5 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -In a Supplier Master Data, Financial Data tab, Payment Data you notice a list of companies are recorded. However an inconsistency in the view prevents the data from being displayed correctly.-You may see the company code but not the Company name. You are also not able to add any payment information against the company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the view Suppliers.-Search and find XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier ID).-Select View All.-Select the tab Financial Data.-Select the tab Payment Data.-Under Company you see:-Company: ABC (only displaying the code) (ABC represents the Company ID).--However against another Supplier you can see this same company being displayed as expected.-Cause-There is a database inconsistency in the display. You can only see the Company ID on the view.-The instance in the BO was not created correctly at the time when the company was added to the Supplier.-Resolution-To correct the inconsistency you can follow the below steps:-Log into the STFK.-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Go to the BO FOPXF_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT-Enter BusinessPartnerInternalID: ABC (ABC represents the Supplier ID).-The next screen will display a record for each company that is listed against the supplier. In my example there should be 2 records (A record for Company ID 1 and Company ID2). But because of the inconsistency we will only see 1 record.--In the above image - you can only see a record for Company 2.-To insert the missing information missing for Company 1 select the "Create BO Node Instance" at the top of the screen-Enter:-BUSINESS_PARTNER_INTERNAL_ID: ABC (Supplier ID).-COMPANY_ID: 1 (The Company Code for the company with inconsistent data).-Select Save at the top of the screen.-Go back to the Business ByDesign Supplier Master Data screen and refresh,-All Companies should now display name and code correctly. And all Payment information fields are available to maintain.-On occasion when you Create BO Node Instance you may get an error at the bottom of the screen that displays "Instance already exists". If this is displayed you need to create an incident and check with development team. Explain to the team you have followed the above KBA and the error that is displayed.-Keywords-Supplier Master Data, Company, Financial Data, Payment Data, Company Name, Company Code, Display

Title: Invoice Schedule is Not created in Intercompany Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the "Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders" in Business Configuration. But the invoice schedule is still not created for the intercompany sales orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center view Sales Orders.-Search for the relevant intercompany sales order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the intercompany sales order)-Click edit and view all.-Go to the tab Pricing and Invoicing.-Go to the Subtab Invoice Schedule.-No invoice schedule has been created.-Cause-Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders only supports project based time and material items.-In this case, the item is product - delivery based, it is not supported to create invoice schedule in the follow up intercompan sales orders.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-Invoice Schedule for Intercompany Sales Orders; invoice schedule not created; intercompany sales order.

Title: Changes in Fields Names are Not Carried Out to Sales Order Reports
Content: Symptom-You notice that after renaming the fields in the Sales Order documents through the Personalization Mode, the changes are not being carried out to the Sales Order Volume report. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the example below we will demonstrate the scenario changing the Requested Date field to XYZ through the Personalization mode.-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Filter for All Orders.-Open any Sales Order document.-Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the User Icon.-In the dropdown, select Start Personalization mode.-In the Personalization column, select the arrow in the Products section.-Right Click on the Requested Date.-In the text box, enter XYZ.-In the Personalization column, select Save button.-The field 'Request Date' will be renamed to XYZ in all Sales Order documents.-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Search for the Report CRMSLOIB_Q0001 (Sales Order Volume).-Open.-Add the field Requested Date to the report.-The field name is displayed as "Requested Date" instead XYZ.-Cause-When field names are changed at document level or OWL level through the Personalization mode, this changes will not be carried out to any Sales Order report.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-sales order, personalization mode, sales order volume report

Title: Shopping Cart Skipping Approval
Content: Symptom-When creating a Shopping Cart the same is skipping approval even though the Approval Process activated and consistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view.-Click Go Shopping (Advanced).-In Recipient under Ship-To enter the user responsible for approval.-Click Next until step 3.-Enter the product information (make sure that the information added is relevant for approval).-Click Show Approval Details-See that the person responsible is the same as the recipient.-Click Check button.-Click Finish if no errors were displayed.-See the message "Shopping cart created and requested".-Cause-It is no longer possible for a user to approve their own carts.-So please check which is the user that is the Approver of the Shopping Cart. In case the Approver is the same user as in the 'Recipient', the 'Requester' or the 'Creator' of the Shopping Cart, the system will skip the approval process and create automatically the Purchase Request.-Resolution-This is a system behavior.-In case you want to change this, please follow one of the solutions below:-Make sure that the approver is not the Requestor, Recipient or the Creator of the shopping cart;-Maintain other approvers determined so the task can still be processed by them (via the configuration of multiple responsible or substitution rule setup);-Remove the 'Automatic Approval' flag. It will ensure that at least approval is not skipped but that at least an unassigned task is created in the case where no additional approver can be found.-See Also-Help Portal: Approval Rules for Purchasing-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Approval Process; Skip; Recipient

Title: Error "ID 1 / Item XYZ not valid; amount has invalid number of decimals" when Uploading Bank Statement File
Content: Symptom-You are uploading a bank statement file, for example in format SWIFT MT940. -An error shows as "ID 1 / Item XYZ not valid; amount has invalid number of decimals".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Click New > Bank Statement Upload.-Enter required data for Company, Bank ID and Import Format.-Click Add > File and select the respective file.-The error shows as:-"ID 1 / Item XYZ not valid; amount has invalid number of decimals"-(XYZ representing an affected bank statement transaction)-Cause-This error most likely will occur in bank statement files based on a pertinent MT940 format, for example MT940 UK. -The number of amount decimals in MT940 is usually is defined as 2 following SWIFT format specifications.-In case the characters following the amount are numeric, these are parsed and interpreted as additional digits, provoking the error. -For example: -In MT940 UK The amount follows the date and C/D sign. The amount has 2 decimals and is followed by a 3 digits (letters) representing the External Transaction Code. This is followed by transaction references.-:61:240404C1,25STONONREF - -In case numeric content following the amount (2 decimals) is passed this will be interpreted as additional decimals contravening applicable specifications for MT940.-For example:-A transaction line showing as: -:61:240404C1,251234 -- will be met with an error: "ID 1 / Item XYZ not valid; amount has invalid number of decimals" -Resolution-Only upload files adhering to pertinent SWIFT specifications for bank statements. -For example:-https://www.sepaforcorporates.com/swift-for-corporates/account-statement-mt940-file-format-overview/

Title: Amounts in the Sales Order Credits doesn't match with the amount in Web service XML file.
Content: Symptom-You want to use this Webservice queryaccountopenamountsin to check Credit Limit from Webservice.--You are testing with the account XXXX with credit limit 5.000 EUR. If you check credit limit for one of the Sales Order, it results with the information message: "Credit limit not exceeded; 3233.40 EUR is left" ('XXXX' refers to account ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to sales order Work center.-Select a Sales Order YYYY for the account XXXX.-Click on Actions – Simulate Check Credit Limit.-It gives the information message as: Credit limit not exceeded; 3233.40 EUR is left.-Here no warnings/error messages occurred.-Based on the amount mentioned in the information message (i.e.,3233.40 EUR), when you compared it with the process of web service in the XML response the result is different as mentioned below.-<CreditLimitAmount currencyCode="EUR">5000.0</CreditLimitAmount>-<CurrentSpendingLimitAmount currencyCode="EUR">4261.9</CurrentSpendingLimitAmount>-<ReceivablesBalanceAmount currencyCode="EUR">738.1</ReceivablesBalanceAmount>-Cause-Information message in BYD during credit limit check: Credit limit not exceeded; 3233.40 EUR is left.-On comparison with Web service XML response as below-<CreditLimitAmount currencyCode="EUR">5000.0</CreditLimitAmount>-<CurrentSpendingLimitAmount currencyCode="EUR">4261.9</CurrentSpendingLimitAmount>-<ReceivablesBalanceAmount currencyCode="EUR">738.1</ReceivablesBalanceAmount>-In the webservice response, if you check the calculation it behaves as expected--> 5000-738.10 = 4261.9 EUR.-Here you are using the file which fetches only the Open Items, so the amount in information message and Webservice XML response mismatched.-Resolution-You have to use the below tag lines to get the Open items and In preparation items in the Web service.-- <AccountOpenAmountsSelection>-            <!--Zero or more repetitions:-->-            <SelectionByAccountID>-               <!--Optional:-->-               <InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>-               <IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>-               <!--Optional:-->-               <LowerBoundaryIdentifier>XXXX</LowerBoundaryIdentifier>-               <!--Optional:-->-            </SelectionByAccountID>-         </AccountOpenAmountsSelection>-         <ProcessingConditions>-            <QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>1</QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>-            <QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>false</QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>-         </ProcessingConditions>-    <IncludeOpenOrders>true</IncludeOpenOrders>    <IncludeOpenAndInPreparationOrders>true</IncludeOpenAndInPreparationOrders>-Once you added this in the file, then you can see that the amount matches in both ByD and Web service.-Keywords-Sales Order, Credit Limit, Web Service, XL, Open Items, Invoiced Items, queryaccountopenamountsin.

Title: Error Message: Expected Value Date DD.MM.YYYY Must not be Before Document Date DD.MM.YYYY+1"
Content: Symptom-You are receiving below error message while posting the POS(Point-of-Sale) transaction.-Expected value date DD.MM.YYYY must not be before document date DD.MM.YYYY+1-(or)-You are trying to post the Unposted source document POS(Point-of-Sale) transaction in the current period and received error message:-Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Source Documents View.-Filter for All Source Documents.-In the search field, search for the ID.-You can see the error "Expected value date DD.MM.YYYY  must not be before document date DD.MM.YYYY+1".-(or)-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Source Documents View.-Filter for All Source Documents (ex: POS(Point-of-Sale) transaction.)-In the search field, search for the ID.-Click on Actions ->Post business transaction to another period.-Enter the Alternate Posting date and click ok.-You can see the error "Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting"-Cause-The document date is being compared against Credit Card Payment Value Date which should not be before the document date. When the document is stuck in unposted source document, we do not allow to post it to an alternate date before the current proposed posting date.-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Source Documents View.-Filter for All Source Documents.-In the search field, search for the ID.-Click on Sales Transaction and Go to Payment item tab > Credit Card Payment Value Date is DD.MM.YYYY+1.-Resolution-You need to cancel this POS transaction and mark as irrelevant both the business transactions for original POS and cancellation POS transactions.-In the General Ledger work center go to the Closing Cockpit- Source Documents sub-view.-In the Unposted Source Documents, find and select the Reversal document: XYZ. (XYZ represents the ID of the Reversal/cancellation document).-Press Actions -  View Business Transaction.-In the new screen choose Mark as Irrelevant.-This will mark the Reversal as well as the Original Source Document as Irrelevant for Accounting.-Now you can create a new document with the corrected set of dates.-   Keywords-Point-of-sale transaction, Expected value date must not be before document date, unposted source document error, Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting

Title: Fields Not Sorted Using $OrderBy in OData Reports
Content: Symptom-You have built an OData query to retrieve report data, and you have used the operand OrderBy to sort the fields, however in the report results you can see that the data is not sorted.-For example: You are calling the report Invoice Volume via the following URL:-https://myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RPCRMCIVIB_Q0001QueryResults?$select=CIPR_PROD_UUID,CIACBA_PRJ_UUID&$orderby=CDOC_UUID desc-And you would expect that the results are sorted by Invoice ID, in a descending order, however this is not the case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Cause-For the OrderBy option to work, you have to add the field on which you are sorting to the view (via $select) and it has to be the first field in the list.-Resolution-In this example, you would need to change the URL to:-https://myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RPCRMCIVIB_Q0001QueryResults?$select=CDOC_UUID,CIPR_PROD_UUID,CIACBA_PRJ_UUID&$orderby=CDOC_UUID desc-See Also-1628310 - Sorting of Characteristics and Key Figures in Reports-Keywords-Odata, report, orderby, sorting, characteristic, ascending, descending, System query options '$orderby' are not allowed in the requested URI

Title: Error Message When Company And Customer Have Same Peppol Identifier In SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom- You need to test the integration between SAP BYD and PEPPOL Exchange service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Click on the New button and select Corporate Account.-Enter an Account name and address.-Click on Additional Identifiers (right under Additional Name).-Enter a value ID in reference to Peppol Participant Identifier.-You will see the error message "Number xxxx:xxxxxxxxx is already assigned to partner x for ID type xxxxxx"-('X' Represents the Peppol Participant Identifier ID and customer account ID).-Cause-The peppol identifier has to be different for every business partner to test PEPPOL service application.- Resolution-Two business partners cannot have the same PEPPOL identifier number, hence why the system does not allow saving of same number on two different accounts.-The blog below will help you in understanding how SAP Business Bydesign integrates with the Peppol network.--Integrating SAP Business ByDesign to Peppol Network-Keywords-How to test, Peppol, Account ID, Peppol ID, Business ByDesign, BYD

Title: Unable to Active Business Object
Content: Symptom-Activation of custom Object Fails with errors Character is not Expected-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open Solution YABCXXXXX_ -Open the respective Business Object.-Activate errors appears  bo Character '' is not expected-Cause-The error pops up because there seems to be an additional invalid character at the beginning of the BODL. -Resolution-User can copy the entire BODL from the SAP Cloud Applications Studio to an external editor (like Notepad++ or VS Code) and then check if an unrecognized character is present at the beginning of the BODL.-If this is present, please request to remove this character, paste the BODL back to the SAP Cloud Applications Studio and then re-activate the BO. The BO activation should then go fine.-Keywords-Activation error; bo Character '' is not expected;

Title: Dump Appears While Approving or Releasing Customer Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to release an invoice or you had processed the customer invoice and sent for an approval and when approver tries to approve it, the system dumps.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The error can occur when releasing the invoice or when approving the approval task since the approval also triggers the release. We will use the Approval as an example:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Documents view-Select the relevant Customer Invoice-Submit for approval-Go to the Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant approval task-Select Approve and dump occurs-Dump Details:-   24 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003    66-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-   23 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001    24-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-   22 METHOD       CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA======CP    CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA======CM00J    26-      CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA=>MAP_IAN_DUE_ITEM-   21 METHOD       CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA======CP    CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA======CM00L   132-      CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA=>MAP_IAN_ROOT-   20 METHOD       CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA======CP    CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA======CM004    19-      CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA=>ASSEMBLE_MESSAGE_INVOICE-  Application Information: Triggering application component: AP-CI-Cause-The Due Date is missing in the customer invoice and hence dump occurs during the release of the invoice or at the time of approval process.-Message Class:CL_APCI_CI_NOTIF_ACC_OPA======CP-Method: MAP_IAN_DUE_ITEM-Resolution-In case of an approval scenario you need to send the Customer Invoice back for revision. Title: Tax Code: Domestic Purchase - Assets, Standard Rate 20% (France) Is Not Available
Content: Symptom-When claiming an expense for the purchase of IT equipment via ERM Reporting, Tax Code: Domestic Purchase - Assets, Standard Rate 20% is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select New > Expense Report on Behalf.-Select Employee: XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the employee).-Fill in the required fields.-Select Next and Add Row.-Select any Expense Type.-In the dropdown of the field Tax Code, the Tax Code: Domestic Purchase - Assets, Standard Rate 20% is not available.-Cause-The Tax Code: Domestic Purchase - Assets, Standard Rate 20% is not delivered for ERM Reporting as it is for Assets which are Fixed.-Resolution-To fulfill this claim requirement, you need to use the standard Purchase Order functionality.-Note: The Tax Code: Domestic Purchase - Asset, High Reduced Rate 10% available in the dropdown is for Goods and Services for DOM regions.-Keywords-Tax Code, Domestic Purchase - Assets, Standard Rate 20%, Note de Frais, Code de TVA Achat National - Actifs, Taux Standard 20%, Expense Report.

Title: Wrong Net Price is Showing in Migrated Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-In migrated sales orders, the net price is showing the wrong value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Sales Orders -> Sales Orders view-Select the sales order ABC (ABC represents the sales order ID)-Edit and click on View All-Navigate to Items tab, the net price is showsing the same value as net value. -You expect the net price should be divided by the quantity, for example quantity is 10 ea, net value is 800 USD, the expected net price is 800 / 10 = 80 USD. But system shows net price is 800 USD.-Cause-Price list is not maintained for this product and therefore the system copys the net value to net price.-Resolution-You need to maintain the price list for the products before migration. Thus, when creating migrated sales orders, system determines the available list price from the a price list. Then the net price will be calculated by the net value and quantity. Otherwise, system will copy the net value amount to the net price.-Keywords-migrated sales order; net value; net price; wrong net price; unexpected net price.

Title: Missing Hour(s) in Time Statement
Content: Symptom-When opening the Time Statement of an Employee in the Time Administration work center, no values are available in the Hours column, although times are recorded, as visible in the Start and End time columns.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view and mark the line of an Employee.-Choose the View Time Statement button.-Select the concerned period.-Choose the Preview button.-Although values for Working Time exist in the Start and End columns, the values for Hours columns are missing.-Cause-The visibility of the Hours in the Time Statement depends on several settings. The issue may be caused by the fact that only the Start and End time columns are filled in the Time Sheet. The Hours column is not intended to calculate a duration based on Start and End Time.-Resolution-To maintain Hours, perform the following steps:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Sheet view.-Find and mark the line of an Employee.-Choose Open Time Sheet.-Go to the Time Entry tab.-Mark the row of a Time Entry.-Maintain hours in the Duration field.-Save and Release respectively Approve.-The maintained Hours overwrite the Quantity which is calculated based on Start and End Time. To avoid inconsistencies, the total Hours should be a value not higher than the originally calculated Quantity.-Keywords-Zeitnachweis; Stunden, Time Sheet, Time Entry

Title: Dump Occurs When You Try to Release the Customer Contract
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to release or approve the customer contract, the system results in 500 internal error/Dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work center.-Go to Contracts View.-Search for Contract XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Contract).-Edit the Contract.-Click on Submit-> Release button.-The Dump occurs with below details in ST22:-The following checkpoint group was used:  "No checkpoint group specified" - If in the ASSERT statement the addition FIELDS was used, you can find - the content  of the first 8 specified fields in the following overview: - " ME->MV_PA_BO_NAME = `CUSTOMER_CONTRACT` " -Cause-You are not able to release the Contract because the item start date is earlier than the header start date for one of the Line item.-   Resolution-The error is caused because the Contract Item Start and End date is not within the Contract Header Start and End Date range and therefore the Contract cannot be released. Kindly suggest the Customer to maintain valid dates.- Keywords-Contract; release; Dump; " ME->MV_PA_BO_NAME = `CUSTOMER_CONTRACT` " ; "No checkpoint group specified" .

Title: Unable to Record Times or Perform Manager Approvals via Mobile View Configuration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-The configuration of a mobile view is not successful. When selecting the Time Recording or Manager Approvals link, the following error occurs:-An error occurred-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access a link similar to the following one: https://myxxxxxx.businessbydesign.cloud.sap/sap/public/ap/ui/repository/SAP_UI/HTMLOBERON5/client.html?sapbyd-agent=MBLHTML&app.component=/SAP_UI_CT/Main/root.uiccwoc&rootWindow=X&redirectUrl=/sap/public/byd/runtime#-Select Time Recording or Manager Approvals link-An error occurred. Content: Symptom-You would like to set up the Access Restrictions for a User to see only the Sales Orders where he is employee responsible in the respective Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Cause-In the Access Restriction, the access Context for Sales Orders is 4-Sales, you will be able to set access restriction only based on sales organizations. Your request to set access restriction on employee/user level is not feasible currently.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Access Restriction; sales Order, employee responsible;

Title: You get an Error Message in the Sales Order: "Party with role Sales Employee missing"
Content: Symptom-You get an error message in the sales order: Party with role Sales Employee missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and search for the Sales Order ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Click the Edit button of the selected Sales Order.-Error appears: Party with role Sales Employee missing.-Cause-In the Business Configuration activity Involved Parties for Sales, you have marked Sales Employee as mandatory. The determination is maintained as Logged in user, that means sales employee will get determined automatically same as logged in user. But in this case the determination step is not active.-If the step is not active, user has to manually enter the party in the sales order.--Steps to check the Business Configuration activity:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Go to the Fine Tune step.-Search for the activity Involved Parties for Sales Orders.-Open the activity.-Select Sales Employee -> Select Maintain Determination button.-The party role Sales Employee determination is based on Logged on User, but this is not active (active column is not ticked).-Resolution-You have to create a Change Project and activate the rule for Sales Employee determination is based on Logged on User in the Involved Parties for Sales Orders activity.-You can check below Help Documents for assistance in creating a change project:-Prepare a Change Project.-Implementing a Project — Change Projects.-Keywords-Sales Order, Error, Party with Role Sales Employee Missing

Title: Error: "Delivery ID: cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP INTERNAL USE ONLY**-In a 3rd Party inter-company scenario, you have cancelled the inbound documents and are looking to cancel the corresponding OD, however getting below error :-Delivery ID XXX: cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed  (Here XXX is an Outbound Delivery ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view and find required OD.-Edit and navigate to document flow.-Extended view -> open relevant warehouse order -> edit and choose Adjustment confirmation.-Choose Enable Entry -> remove serial number one by one.-System throws error message for SRs as below :-Serial number cannot be deleted; this is not the last active document.-Further if you try to cancel outbound delivery, system throws error:-Delivery ID: cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed.-Cause-This is a TPOP inter-company scenario.-Since OD has a non-adjustable indicator marked true, as this OD is the last active document, this indicator should be false.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-It should be an Intercompany scenario with 3PL Outbound Delivery Document.-Tagged Inventory Status of Serial Number XXX is ‘In Stock’.-In the BO APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY -> ITEM -> ITEM_PRODUCT -> ITEM_PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER, NON_ADJUSTABLE is set.-Note: If you receive such case, send this incident to development component: AP-ODP.-Backend Correction steps:-In the backend, go to TCode SESFTS => BO APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY -> ITEM -> ITEM_PRODUCT -> ITEM_PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER, remove the NON_ADJUSTABLE flag.-Ask the Customer to Cancel the Outbound Delivery.-Post-Checks:-The Outbound Delivery should be cancelled.-Keywords-APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY, Serial number cannot be deleted; this is not the last active document,  cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed, serial numbers, cancel, outbound delivery, 3PL

Title: Purchase Order Acknowledgment Status is not Updated by Purchase Order Interactive Form Reply from Supplier
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Purchase Order Interactive form reply from supplier is not updating Purchase Order Acknowledgment status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the ABC (Purchase Order's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-There is a Process Communication Error: Purchase Order ABC cannot process an update sent by an external consumer-Cause-The Global Location Number maintained for the Company has more than 13 characters.-Please follow the steps below:-Open Purchase Order ABC. -Navigate to General tab.-Double-click in the Company's ID.-You can check that customer has maintained Global Location Number XYZ.-Then you can see the failed message in the backend:-Open the backend. -Use the transaction SRT_MONI.-Search for the failed message.-The information is shown as below:-Sender Party: (blank)-Receiver interface name: PurchaseOrderProcessingOrderingIn-Error information: Unknown Party XYZ-You cannot restart this failed message manually.-Resolution-Ask the customer to maintain a Global Location Number which has 13 characters or less.-You can send them our material below:-KBA: 3256002 - Purchase Order Acknowledgment Status is not Updated by Purchase Order Interactive Form-After the customer following the steps and then returning the incident, you can restart the failed message in the backend.-See Also-KBA: 3256002 - Purchase Order Acknowledgment Status is not Updated by Purchase Order Interactive Form-Keywords-Purchase Order; Global Location Number; Acknowledgment; Backend

However, you have observed that the tooltip icon is not visible, and the associated tooltip information is not being displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Product Data Work Center.-Go to the Services View.-Select any service and click "Edit."-Click the "View All" button.-Click the avatar icon located at the top right of the system and then select "Key User Settings" and select "Start Adaptation Mode."-Right-click on the respective extension field and select "+ Extension Fields."-Although the tooltip field is filled, it is not appearing in the user interface.- Cause-Expected system behavior.-Resolution-Hover over the dropdown icon in the respective extension field to view the tooltip text.-Keywords-Tooltip, Missing, Extension Field, Icon

Title: Table Calculation Is Not Appearing in Purchase Order After Clicking in View All Button
Content: ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 2 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-The view of the Table Calculation is different before and after "View All button". The Table Calculation is not available when checking the Purchase order details. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Order's view). -Click in the link in the Purchase Order ID column "ABC" (Don't click in in Edit button). -In the "Purchase Order Items" section, we can see that the first line is showing the sum of the total items for the columns "Quantity", "Net Price", "Price Unit" and "Net Value/Limit" (Screenshot below only shows the Quantity column). -Click in "View All" button.-Navigate to Items tab.-The line of the sum of all items is no longer there.-Also when opening the Personalization Mode, the Table Calculation is not available (Screenshot below).-Cause-The Table Calculation is not supported in the Purchase Order in "View All" screen. That's why the Table Calculation is not available when checking it in the Adaptation Mode. -Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. -See Also-KBA:  3370285 - How to Add Sum row in the Supplier Invoicing work center in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)-Keywords-Purchase Order; Table Calculation; Adaptation Mode; Sum

Title: Error 'Check Deposit Canceled; Release of Allocation not Possible' during release of Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-Unable to post a payment allocation due to the error: Check deposit canceled; release of allocation not possible in payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Payment Allocations view.-Select the Payment Allocation and click on it.-Transaction Amount and Allocated Amount is equal and you click on post.-Error: Check deposit canceled; release of allocation not possible in payment allocation.-Cause-Initially when you allocated a check deposit in this payment allocation, this allocation is not immediately posted but have been saved. Later, when you decided to post this allocation by this time the assigned check deposit is canceled. In this case, we need to remove this check deposit from the payment allocation and choose other items to allocate to the payment allocation else system will not allow this payment allocation to be posted.-Resolution-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Payment Allocations and select the payment allocation in question.-Navigate to Payment Confirmations/Returns tab.-Select the Canceled check deposit line which is already assigned, click on upward arrow and save. This will unassign the check deposit.-Select a new check deposit and click on downward arror button to assign in this payment alloation or allocation to G/L accounts tab or customer/supplier and assign on account, and match the transaction & allocated amount and make sure the open amount is zero then you will be able to post the payment allocation.-Keywords-Check Deposit Canceled; Release of Allocation not Possible in Payment Allocation-canceled check deposit in payment alloca

Title: Error Message 'Service call failed, report an case' While Migrating Services
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate or enhance Services using the migration tool, and in the simulation step the error message is displayed:-"Service call failed, report an case".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-In the search box, search for the activity "Migration of Services" and enter it.-Enter the sub-activity "Migrate Services Using the Migration Tool".-Select a template to be migrated and click "Execute Migration".-Click the option "Step-by-Step".-Proceed with the migration steps until step 3.-After the simulation is processed, the error is raised.-Cause-This error message indicates inconsistencies in the migration template.-Possible inconsistencies:-You are trying to upload Service IDs which are already created with the same Sales Org. assignment.-You are trying to upload Service IDs which are already created for the respective company.-The UoM (Unit of Measure) maintained for a few records is incorrect (for example: you have maintained 'DAY').-There are duplicate entries for a service in the Valuation sheet.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. --In order to solve the issue, check the template for duplicate entries and remove the same.-Keywords-BC, Material, Valuation, migration of services, enhancement, enhancing, service ids, enhancing services

Title: Error: Action START_PUBLISHING not possible; action is disabled
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error occurs when trying to publish Catalog. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Catalogs view.-Show: All Catalogs.-Select catalog ID ABC (ABC is the Catalog's ID). -Click in View Publication Log button. -Navigate to Results tab. -You can see the following errors:-Publication of catalog model started-Action START_PUBLISHING not possible; action is disabled -Action FINISH_PUBLISHING not possible; action is disabled-Cause-Catalog is stuck in process. You can perform some steps in the backend to correct the Catalog's status as Failed in the front end.-Resolution-The steps to correct the Catalog's status in the backend are:-Open the backend. -Go to transaction SESFTS. -In 'Load BO by Proxy Name' insert BO: APCCMX_BO_PCG-In 'Load BO Node Instances', load by query in 'ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS'.-In ID/content, insert the Contract's ID 'ABC'. -Click in Navigate and select VERSION. -If there is more than one item line, select the latest version.-We can see that:-a. TRANSMISSION_ID = Empty.-b. DELETED_INDICATOR = False.-c. STATUS-PUBLISHING_UPDATE_STATUS_CODE = 2 (In Process).-Click in Actions and select 'FINISH_PUBLISHING'. -Save it. -Now in the front end the 'Current Publication Status' of this catalog changed to 'Failed'. -Keywords-Catalog; Publish; START_PUBLISHING; FINISH_PUBLISHING; Product Portfolio

Title: Error in Report: Message E R7 245 Cannot Be Processed In Plug-in Mode HTTPS
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-[INTERNAL USE ONLY]-The customer has opened an incident informing us that some reports are showing this error "Technical Error Occurred, Message E R7 245  Cannot Be Processed  In Plug-in Mode HTTPS". Hence, the reports cannot be opened.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Open the report informed by the customer which is showing the error message.-The error message appears in the report right after clicking Go (Check attachment).-Cause-There is a technical inconsistency in the data source.-Resolution-To solve this behavior you have to clear the data source and report cache by following the steps below:-Find the report and its ID, e.g SRMIV_B03_Q0020.-Open the backend system and then use the MDRS transaction.-Select the option MDAV Key Figure Composite, add the report ID and press Enter.-Double-click on the data source that is used in this report. On the menu (top of the screen), click Utilities and Invalidate Run Time Object.-Now double-click on report and again, click Utilities > Invalidate Run Time Object.-In rare cases, it may happen that a high number of data sources will be affected. In this case, we have the option to invalidate the cache for all data sources and reports in one go. Before doing so, please inform the customer that due to deleted cache, the reports and data sources will run more slowly right after the correction. However, after being run once or twice they will go back to normal. After confirming that the customer is happy to proceed this way, perform the following steps:-In the backend of the system, go to the transaction SE38.-Enter the program MDRS_ANA_INVALIDATE_LOAD.-Click Execute (F8).-Check all boxes.-Click Execute (F8) again.-Keywords-Error R7 245; R7 245  Cannot Be Processed  In Plug-in Mode HTTPS, Technical Error Occurred, delete data source cache, invalidate cache, report inconsistent

Title: Case Status is Incorrect Under Track My Cases View
Content: Symptom-Status of Caset under track my Cases in help center and in application and user management workcenter is not in sync.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and user management WorkCenter-Navigate to Cases View and search for Case-It is in status closed-Now, login with particular business user and go to Help Center-Open Track my Cases-Search for Case-It is in process status-Cause-This is due to inconsistency in sync between status in help center and application and user management work center.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to close the Cases from UI .-Open Track my cases-Open the case that needs to be closed.-Click on "Cancel case" button. It will change the status to completed there.-If that does not work,it needs to be closed from backend for this you need to provide your approval-See Also-2684828 - How To Return An Case To Provider Which Has The Status In Process - Requester Action-Keywords-Help Center, Track my cases, In Process, Closed, case

Title: Case Updates From SAP not Visible to the Customer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer has an open case with SAP and receives a notification of an update, but when they enter the case through Application and User Management work center, it is not possible to see the update from SAP.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to case view.-Search for the case through its ID or Subject (casetitle).-Click on the incident to see the notes.-You can see that recent updates from SAP are not visible.-Cause- There is a replication issue in the backend.-Resolution-Enter customer's system through the backend.-Go to transaction SE38.-Run (F8) the report APCRM_SSR_LP_INCIDENTS_SYNC to trigger a sync in the backend regarding replication notes.-NOTE: If running the reports doesn't fix the issue, please forward the case to AP-SSR development team.-Keywords-replication, updates, incidents, replication issue, not visible, not appearing, byd

Title: How to Determine Sales Unit in a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The sales unit determined in the sales order or sales quote is not the one expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of a Sales Order:-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Click Sales Orders view.-Edit Sales Order DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Sales Order).-The sales unit is not the one you expected.-Cause-The Sales Unit is determined according the following rules in your system:-Responsibility to determine Sales Unit - Sales:-The system uses parameter values to classify business documents, determine responsibility, and distribute accordingly. The parameters used in the 'Responsibility to Determine Sales Unit - Sales' work category are as follows:-Country-Region-City-ZIP Code-It is also possible to activate additionally the usage of ABC Classification and Account ID via fine tuning.-Prerequisites: The sales units must be defined and activated in the Organizational Management.-Functional Unit of Employee Responsible:-If the first rule is not set-up the system tries to derive the sales unit from the employee responsible - sales.-If the Organizational model contains only one sales unit, then this one is taken.-Resolution-How to maintain Responsibility to Determine Sales Unit - Sales:-Go to Organizational Management work center;-Click Work Distribution view;-Select Work Category > Sales and Marketing;-Select 'Responsibility to Determine Sales Unit - Sales' and Edit.-You can define work distribution rules by selecting the priority (from 1 to n), the ID of Org Unit Responsible and the 'Valid from' and 'Valid to' dates. -Then you can select the rule details: Company, Country, Region, City, ZIP Code, ABC Classification and Account.-Use Case:-Sales unit XYZ must be determined in sales order when using the account ABC: (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Unit and ABC represents the ID of the Account)-Maintain a new rule in Work Category Responsibility to Determine Sales Unit - Sales for the org unit XYZ.-Add the Account ABC to the rule detail.-Sales unit XYZ must be determined in sales order when using an account with a determined country (e.g. US) and city (e.g. Chicago):-Maintain a new rule in Work Category Responsibility to Determine Sales Unit - Sales for the org unit XYZ.-Add the country (e.g. US) and add the city (e.g. Chicago) to the rule details.-How to define responsibility criteria for the selected responsibility category:-Go to Business Configuration work center;-Select Implementation Projects view;-Go 'Open Activity List' button;-Select fine tuning activity 'Criteria to Determine Responsibilities for Sales';-Select criteria to determine Sales Unit - Sales.-How to change the determination logic:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Click 'Open Activity List' button.-For Sales Orders select fine tuning activity 'Involved Parties for Sales Orders' or in case of Sales Quotes select the  fine tuning activity 'Involved Parties for Sales Quotes and Quotes for Contract'.-Select the Party Role.-Click on the Maintain Determinations button.-You can activate or deactivate determination steps for your party role.-See Also-For detailed information on the Party Role Determination you can find the following Blog: Party Role Determination in a Sales Document -Keywords-party role definition, sales orders, sales unit determination, work distribution, sales quote, quote for contract, sales unit-销售

Title: How to Check Cost Center Assignment in Source Document Related to Inventory Difference Confirmation?
Content: Symptom-You are trying to check if a Cost center is being assigned to a Source Document.-In the Journal Entry, you see that the Source Document Type is 'Goods and Activity Confirmation' but when you navigate to Source Document ID, it opens up an Inventory Difference Confirmation.-This KBA helps you to check the Source Document from Supply Chain Management Side in detail as the Inventory Difference Confirmation does not show whether there was a Cost Center Assignment during Source Document creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view and then to Journal Entries Subview.-Show All Postings and Search for Journal Entry ID 123(123 represents Journal Entry ID).-Select the Journal EntryID and choose view.-Choose the Source Document ID.-This opens up Inventory Difference Confirmation and you will not be able to see the Cost Center Assignment.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to check Inventory Difference Confirmation-Go to the Physical Inventory Work center.-Go to the Monitoring view and then to By PI Count Document.-Show All PI Count documents and Go to Advanced Search.-Select the Product ID and Creation Date.-You can see the respective Physical Inventory Count Document and under General tab you can see the Cost Center that is assigned.-Keywords-Inventory Difference Confrimation, PI Count Document, Physical Inventory

Title: Unable To Define An Org Unit As A Reporting Line Unit
Content: Symptom-Unable to define an org unit as a reporting line unit. Reporting Line Unit checkbox is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Organizational Structure view.-3. Select the respective org unit.-4. Navigate to Definitions tab.-Then you can find Reporting Line Unit checkbox is greyed out.-Cause-The system of record for reporting line structures is Employee Central. When the replication scenario is scoped it is no longer possible to edit reporting line unit properties in the organizational management work center. It is also not possible to define an existing organizational center of different type to also be a reporting line unit. Reporting line units are only created automatically during replication based on the manager assignment of the replicated employees.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior. Please maintain the reporting line structures in Employee Central.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Organizational Management, Reporting Line Unit,  Employee Central, org unit, assign, edit, manager

Title: Enable DKIM and DMARC for your e-mail sending domains
Content: Symptom-Google announced to change their policies. What effects will this have on sending out emails?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It will effect sender domain and also receiver domain.-Gmail and Yahoo is rolling out new stringent e-mail sender guidelines that enforces stricter e-mail authentication checks. These updates have the potential to affect the delivery and handling of business / bulk e-mails that you send to recipients.-To ensure that your e-mails are delivered to Gmail and Yahoo email accounts without any disruptions, it requires all senders to have SPF, DKIM and DMARC authentication enabled.-  We have already completed the required actions to activate SPF checks for all outbound e-mails.-This will effect also the receiver email.-Resolution-SAP is recommending to configure DMARC as other companies will follow.-Action Required:-Enabling DKIM for your sender domain is already a mandatory step - Please refer to following blog on how to enable DKIM for your sender domain(s) if not already done - DKIM Enablement for Sender Domains - ByD.-Set up DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance) for email authentication.-Please align with your network and security experts to create TXT records in your DNS Servers for DMARC enablement.-We highly recommend to enable DKIM and DMARC for the domains that are configured in ByD to send emails (even though you don’t use Gmail or Yahoo as recipients / sender domains, there may be more and more e-mail service providers who would apply this guidelines later so we would request to enable DMARC for the domains).-If you good to go with DMARC you can check here: -https://mxtoolbox.com/SuperTool.aspx-  Helpful links:-Gmail Announcement: https://blog.google/products/gmail/gmail-security-authentication-spam-protection/-Yahoo Announcement: https://blog.postmaster.yahooinc.com/post/730172167494483968/more-secure-less-spam-DMARC Policy Blog: Amazon SES: Email Authentication and Getting Value out of Your DMARC Policy-Keywords-DMARC, Yahoo, Gmail, email outbound,
