Title: Direct Responsibility Tab Shows No Data in Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports that when trying to export customers using Mass Data Maintenance, the Direct Responsibility tab shows no data in the export preview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the link to Export Customer.-Optional: use the available filters to select specific accounts.-Click the Go button.-Navigate to the Direct Responsibility tab.-You see that no data is fetched.-Cause-The issue is caused by an inconsistency in BO persistence.-Resolution-In order to fix this issue, please follow the below steps:-Log into the system's backend.-Search for backend transaction GFSSTM.-Find the Business Object "FND_PARTY_ROLE".-Click the Execute button (or press F8).-Now navigate to Extras > Replication > Reload BO.-Enter the BO name FND_PARTY_ROLE.-Click the Execute button (or press F8).-Once above steps performed, wait for few seconds and then try to reproduce the issue in the front end.-Keywords-Direct Responsibility, MDM, Mass Data Maintenance, FND_PARTY_ROLE, GFSSTM, Export Customers, byd

Title: Action to be taken when customer doesn't see Send to Provider option in the Action field while sending case to SAP or Forward to Provider check box is missing for Key User in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD) or SAP Cloud for Customer(C4C)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**Internal Only**-This KBA helps you with the scenario on what actions to be taken and which team to be consulted in the below situation:-Customer is trying to create case directly to SAP Support by checking the check box of Forward to Provider, however check box is missing for the Key Users.-After new case is created by Key user/Business User, if Key user want to interact with the SAP Support to get help on the case they have to send case to SAP Support by selecting the Action filed as Send to Provider and add a note to provider, however Send to Provider field is missing from the action field-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User Management work center(BYD) or Administrator(C4C)-Go to case view-Edit any In process case -Drop down the Action field-Here the option Send to Provider is missing-OR-Go to Help Center-Click on Solve an Issue or Report an case(BYD) or Report case(C4C)-Go to page which is used to enter incident information-For key user forward to provider check box(BYD) is missing or Direct forward(C4C) is missing-Resolution-In this situation try to reproduce the issue in the affected customer system. If the issue reproduceable, you can take the below actions:-Send the incident to dev component: AP-LM-AM-INC to verify why these options missing-Also create incident to Operations team to check is the tenant is enabled with GBB Managed. Further you can share these incidents. INC6923003 (Correlation ID/SPC Ticket ID: 1142192697)-See Also-Example customer case: CS20230006592140-Keywords-Send to Provider, Forward to Provider, Key User, case, Action feild, cannot send case to SAP, Send case to SAP, AP-LM-AM-INC, AP-SSR, AP-LM-SPC-BLD, GBB

Title: When Trying to Change Quantity Conversion, the Error Message "Changing The Conversion Not Possible" is Raised
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Unable to modify the Item Quantity Conversion in the Production tenant results in an error message stating "Changing The Conversion Not Possible". The error message may differ depending on the affected Business Object, such as Internal Request (Shopping Cart) or Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Product Portfolio work center.-Access List Prices view.-Select the desired product.-Click the Edit button.-Then, click the View All button.-Under the General tab, scroll down to the Quantity Conversion section.-When trying to delete or modify a quantity conversion, an error message appears: "Changing The Conversion Not Possible."-Cause-The existing quantity conversion cannot be modified or removed due to the usage of the relevant material or service in one or more documents of the specified type(s). Allowing such changes would result in inconsistencies within the associated business documents.-It's important to note that the system's veto check is conducted at the material or service level rather than the quantity conversion level. Even if the intended modification or deletion affects a different quantity conversion, if the material or service is being used in a document, the action will still be blocked.-Resolution-Go to Backend using transaction code SE24.-Provide Class name as CM_ROOT.-Double-click Constructor and put a Breakpoint.-Now go to UI.-Click Delete in UI on the Quantity Conversion.-The Debugger will open. Through the call stack, the following can be seen:--A. Validation is done in the method IF_PRD_UOM_CONV_CHANGE_VETO~MASS_MODIFICATION_CHECK (class /SRMAP/CL_REQ_PROD_UOM_VETO) this is a SRM class. Here, they are looping over the changed materials and querying the Business Object /SRMAP/LREQX_IR (this BO might be different) to see if this material is used in any internal requests (Shopping Cart).--B. At line 112, we can see the node IDs of the relevant internal requests or the affected Business Object.--After confirming the affected Business Object, go to the SESFTS transaction and use the BO /SRMAP/LREQX_IR (Shopping Cart) with the ID found in the steps above.-For Internal Request, use the report /SRMAP/BBP_PD, which you can run through transaction code SE38, with the above mentioned node ID for internal request. This will allow us to search if this material is being used in the Internal request (Shopping Cart).-Finally, the error is raised in method /BOPF/IF_FRW_VALIDATION~EXECUTE (CL_PDM_V_QCONV_VETO_CHECKS) line 448, as the material is used in the Internal Request (Shopping Cart).-See Also-1720124 - Error Message "Changing The Conversion Not Possible" While Editing Quantity Conversion of Material or Service-2638478 - Central Knowledge Base Article for Debugging ABAP code-Keywords-Quantity, Conversion, Product, Changing The Conversion Not Possible.

Title: Missing data when importing data from SAP Business ByDesign Analytics in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
Content: Symptom-Missing data when importing data from SAP Business ByDesign Analytics in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)-Environment-SAP Analytics Cloud, Enterprise Edition-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAC tenant.-Create a new Import Data Connection to SAP Business ByDesign Analytics.-Please ensure that that the Data Service URL uses the right format in SAP Analytics Business ByDesign (Example:  <system URL>/sap/byd/odata/<madav_ID>.svc )-Note that every data source in ByD will have one dedicated URL so you need to have a dedicated connection in SAC for each of them.-If you don't know the Data Service URL, please refer to SAP KBA 2913312 or submit one case to component AP-RC-ANA.-Create a new model based on the connection created above.-Select one entity and then build one query by moving data elements into the Selected Data and Filters areas.-Select OK to run the query.-In the data appearing in the Data Integration view, verify that some data is missing.-IF running the OData request (Example:  <system URL>/sap/byd/odata/<madav_ID>.svc/<Entity Name>) from browser directly,  the data you expected cannot be also found, which means that the OData Service exposed from ByD doesn't return such data.-=> Note: you may need to run <system URL>/sap/byd/odata/<madav_ID>.svc/$metadata from browser in advance to get the Name of such entity based on the label shown in step 4.--Cause-As per SAP Blog, Using OData APIs for SAP Business ByDesign Analytics you can query and extract SAP Business ByDesign reports and data sources for analytical use cases:-OData for Reports can be used to query and retrieve characteristics and key figures exposed in ByD analytical reports.  -OData for Data Sources is designed to extract analytical raw data in flat tables.-In the scenario above, the query created in SAC is built on OData for Reports to extract formatted analytical data pre-processed by ByD.-In this case, OData will always take the Default Value selected for Variables defined in the ByD report.-So the records of other members excluded from such report variable/filter are not returned from the OData for Reports API.-Note, when running the same report in ByD, you will still have choice to change values for the variables to show more data. -Resolution-Check with your ByD expert to see if it is possible to change/remove the Default Value selected for Variables defined in the ByD report.-Please always ensure that you could see the data you expected when running the OData request (Example:  <system URL>/sap/byd/odata/<madav_ID>.svc/<Entity Name>) from browser directly.-See Also-2569847 - Where can you find SAC user assistance (help) to use, configure, and operate it more effectively?-Have a question? Ask it here and let our amazing SAP community help! Or reply and share your knowledge!-2487011 - What information do I need to provide when opening a case for SAP Analytics Cloud?-2511489 - Troubleshooting performance issues in SAP Analytics Cloud-Search for SAP Analytics Cloud content using SAP for Me, Google or Bing:-https://me.sap.com/servicessupport/search#?q=SAP%20Analytics%20Cloud%20OR%20SAC&tab=All-https://www.google.com/search?q=site%3Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fuserapps.support.sap.com+SAP+Analytics+Cloud-https://www.bing.com/search?q=site%3Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fuserapps.support.sap.com+SAP+Analytics+Cloud-Note: Add relevant text or warning/error messages to the text search field to filter results.-SAP Analytics Cloud Connection Guide-Getting Started with SAP Analytics Cloud Expert Community page-SAP Analytics Cloud Get More Help and SAP Support-Need More Help? Contact Support or visit the solution finder today!-Your feedback is important to help us improve our knowledge base.-Keywords-EPM, SAP Cloud for Planning, sc4p, c4p, cforp, cloudforplanning, Cloud for Planning, Cloud for Analytics, C4P, Cloud4Analytics, CloudforAnalytics, Cloud 4 Planning, HCP, C4A, BOC, SAPBusinessObjectsCloud, BusinessObjectsCloud, BOBJ, BOBJcloud, BOCloud., BICloud, BO Cloud, SAC, Import, Acquire, Load, ByD, C4C, report, Odata, missing, miss, data, row, record, filter, variable, initial, selection, default, value, member

Title: The Price Component Value for the List Price of a Product in a Sales Document is not as expected
Content: Symptom-The calculation of the Price Component Value for the List Price of a Product in a Sales Document is not as expected.-This is valid for any Sales Document such as Sales Order, Service Order, Contract, Invoice etc..-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In our example we are using a Contract, the Unit of Measure EA and Box and we are using the currency EUR. -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Open Contract XYZ (XYZ represent the ID of the Contract).-Select line item 10 with Product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Product).-The Quantity is maintained e.g. as 180 box.-The List price is maintained as e.g. 3600.00 EUR-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Pricing sub tab.-You can see that the Price Component Value of the List Price is 648000000.00 EUR.-You expect that the Price Component Value of the List Price is 3600.00 EUR * 180 box = 648000.00 EUR-Cause-The Price Component Value of the List Price for line item 10 in Contract XYZ is calculated as 648000000.00 EUR because the Unit of Measure for the Price Component List Price is maintained as EA and you have a quantity conversion maintained in the Product Master Data. -In our example the Unit of Measure for the Price Component List Price is maintained as EA and the Quantity Conversion in the Product Master Data of Product ABC is maintained as 1 Box = 1000 EA.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Open Contract XYZ.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Pricing sub tab.-Expand Line item 10.-Select the Price Component List Price.-You can see that the Amount is 3600.00 EUR and the Unit of Measure in the field For is maintained as 1 EA.-The Ordered Quantity is 180 Box.-  To check the quantity conversion maintained for the Product:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Open Product ABC.  -Navigate to the General tab.-The Quantity Conversion is 1 Box = 1000 EA-The reason why the Unit of Measure in the For field is determined as EA is because the Sales Unit of Measure in the Product Mater Data under the Sales tab for the Distribution Chain that is also maintained in the Contract is maintained as EA and when the Product was added in the Contract it was manually changed to Box.-  If the Amount is 3600.00 EUR for 1 EA the calculation is as follows:-3600.00 EUR * 1000 =  3600000.00 EUR (Amount for 1 box)-3600000.00 EUR  * 180 =  648000000.00 EUR (Amount for 180 box)-Hence the Price Component Value of the List Price is 648000000.00 EUR.-Please Note: -If you maintain the List Price before you change the Quantity Unit of Measure in our example from EA to Box, the List Price you enter is for 1 EA.-If you maintain the List Price after you change the Quantity Unit of Measure in our example from EA to Box, the List Price you enter is for 1 Box.-You can see this then in the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Pricing sub tab in the For field for the respective item and the Price Component List Price.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you would like to have the Price Component value of the List Price determined as e.g. in our example 648000.00 EUR for 180 Box then you need to maintain the Unit of Measure 1 Box in the For field in the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Pricing sub tab of the Contract.- Keywords-List Price; Price List; Unit of Measure; UoM; Sales Order; Contract; Pricing; Tax Amount; Tax Base Amount; incorrect; wrong; calculation ;

Title: Not Possible to set Additional Identifiers as Mandatory on Suppliers
Content: Symptom-You are trying to setup fields in the Additional Identifiers section of a supplier as mandatory, however there is no option to do so.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Enter the Suppliers view.-Click on the avatar icon at the top-right of the screen.-Click on Key User Settings.-Click on Start Adaptation Mode.-Click on the New button.-Click on the "Additional Identifiers" link.-Right click on the field that needs to be set as mandatory.-Here you can see that there is no option to set the field as mandatory.-Cause-Currently it is not possible to set additional identifiers as mandatory for Suppliers.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-Global Location Number, D-U-N-S, Standard Carrier Alpha-Code, German Customs Number, Legal Entity Identifier, KUT

Title: DVM workcenter - Error "ADBC connection not maintained for CRA analysis for system <SID>"
Content: Symptom-In the "Reorganization and Compression (Incl. HANA Sizing)" tile of the DVM workcenter, the CRA Analysis fails for a system with error "ADBC connection not maintained for CRA analysis for system <SID>".-It is not possible to select metrics in the "Reorganization and Compression (Incl. HANA Sizing)" tile. -Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2 SP3-6-Reproducing the Issue-Run transaction SM_WORKCENTER-Select "Data Volume Management"-Select "Reorganization and Compression (Incl. HANA Sizing)"-Click "Analysis list" and select "CRA analysis"-Click "New Analysis"-Cause-The CRA error is usually caused by the DBConnection not being mapped to the correct managed system. Therefore, in CRA, the program is not able to find the DBConnection for the particular SID.-Resolution-The DBConnection needs to be re-created or setup by the Solution Manager administrator, to ensure the correct SID is chosen.-Keywords-DVM, Workcenter, Reorganization and compression, reorg, DBConnection, CRA, analysis, ADBC connection, connection not maintained, select metrics

Title: Lease Posting Run Error: Number Range Interval Overflow For Document Type Lease Clearing
Content: Symptom-You run a Lease Posting run and it ends in error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Lease Posting Run subview.-Select the Run ID: XXX (XXX stands for the Lease Posting Run ID).-Select the Log Details tab.-Select the line of the erroneous run.-Select View.-Select Messages tab.-There are the error messages: -Number range interval overflow for document type Lease Clearing.-Other cashflow items related to lease contract AA cannot be processed (AA stands for the ID of the lease contract).-Period ABC in fiscal year YYYY closed for closing step Operational postings.-Cause-A Posting Date is not maintained for the lease posting run.-Resolution-On the Data Selection tab of the Lease Posting Run, maintain a Posting Date. If this field is not visible, add it from Personalization Mode.-When the lease posting run is performed, the system considers the Due Date of the contract as Posting Date. If the period of the due date is closed and you want to post on this date, you need to open the period.-If you don't want to open the period and prefer to post the run on another specific date which is opened, on the lease posting run, select the key Date Type as '3-Select a date'. Select a 'Key Date' and Posting Date. This posting date is considered by the system and all cash flow lines will be posted with same posting date.-Keywords-Lease Posting Run, Lease Contract, Cash Flow Posting, Document Type Lease Clearing, other Cashflow Items.

Title: Internal 500 Server Error Occurs While Saving New Supplier Invoice Approval Process
Content: Symptom-System dumps while updating the Default Approval Process for Supplier Invoice when the new condition 'Random Exception Check Percentage' is added.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Approval processes view-Select the approval step Default Approval Process for Supplier Invoice-Select Copy-Select Add Row under Conditions, you can see add the option Random Exception Check Percentage and compare operator as equal to and with a value as 100-Save and Close-Notice the system dumps with an error: 500 SAP Internal Server Error-Cause-Inconsistent behaviour caused due to adding multiple conditions.-Resolution-Below is a workaround that the user can follow to save the Approval Process for Supplier Invoice:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Approval Process view-Choose Approval Process for Supplier Invoice-Select Copy-Remove all the step and Save-Now Select the copied Approval Process-Select Edit-Add step and Group, add condition 'Random Exception Check Percentage'-Save-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Approval Process,  Random Exception Check Percentage, Internal 500 Server Error

Title: Dump When Opening Customer Accounts View or Supplier Accounts View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You get a dump when opening Customer Accounts view and / or Supplier Accounts view. --Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Show customers with account movement, search for XXX (where XXX is the Customer Account ID).-Press view.-You can see a dump. This happens for many Customer Accounts however you do not know for how many.-and / or-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Show Suppliers with Account Movement, search for YYY (where YYY is the Supplier Account ID).-Press view.-You can see a dump. This happens for many Supplier Accounts however customer does not know for how many.-Cause-After a TBT rebuild / FSI reload the system is showing a wrong status for TBT report run which is throwing dump.-Resolution-Prerequisites: You have checked the TBT report / FSI reload status and it should be green (no errors).-Steps to check the TBT report / FSI reload status:-Login to backend.-Enter "gfsstm" and press the green checkmark.-Under Business Object enter "FOPXD_TRPACCT".-Press the "Execute" Button (F8).-Expand node "A1FOP_TRPACCT".-In case under column "Loaded" everything is green here please proceed with the next steps:-Beside the green checkmark on top left enter "/nse16".-In table name enter "FXPRSC_TBTO_S".-Hit the green checkmark.-Under OBJ_NAME enter "FOP_TRPREG_TRPAB".-Press "Execute" (F8).-Find the last entry marked as X.-If status is 1 it is fine. If status is 2 you need to change it to 1.-To change the status to 1 click on second button in the menu bar (Change).-Change STATUS from 2 to 1 and press save.-Go back and leave backend.-Now check in the UI if you can access the relevant customer account XXX and supplier account YYY. -Keywords-customer account, supplier account, TBT, dump opening customer account, dump opening supplier account, dump, error customer account, error supplier account,  /BOPF/CL_FRW=>SET_APPLICATION_ERROR, CL_FOP_QRY_TRPREG_BA, FOP_TRPREG_TRPAB

Title: Error when uploading List Prices through Excel: "Error Agent requires transaction to complete successfully although transaction save failed - Error Sender business partner not active"
Content: Symptom-When uploading or updating a List Price through Microsoft File, the mentioned error message pops up.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-WoC Product Portfolio-List Prices View-Click "New" > "List Prices from Microsoft Excel"-Maintain the data in the file and click Save Data-The error message shows up.-Cause-One or multiple Suppliers maintained in the Excel File are under status "Blocked".-Resolution-Change the status of the blocked Supplier(s) to Active and Save.-After doing so, the upload will be successful.-Keywords-"List Price"; "Microsoft Excel"; "Error Agent requires transaction to complete successfully although transaction save failed - Error Sender business partner not active"; "Supplier status"; "Blocked"

Title: Uploading Serial Numbers for Goods Movement Leading to System Dump
Content: Symptom-System dumping when you try to upload an Excel file with the serial numbers for Goods Movement confirmation. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Internal Logistics work center. -Go to the Common Tasks and select Goods movement.-Enter the relevant Site ID. -Click Add Row.-Enter the relevant Product ID and the Source Logistics Area ID.-Select Next.-Enter the Target Logistics Area ID.-Go to the Serial numbers sub-tab.-Upload the Excel file with the Serial numbers.-The system dumps.-Cause-The file is corrupt-Resolution-Ensure you uploading a non corrupt file.-You can copy the values to a Text Editor (Notepad) and Save. You can thereafter try to upload the Serials using the Text file. Or you can copy the values from the Text Editor back to a new Excel Spreadsheet.-The system should upload the values without an issue this time.-Keywords-Dump, Serial, Number, Crash, Goods Movement, Excel, error, 500

Title: Error When Changing Run ID of Mass Data Run to Obsolete
Content: Symptom-You can see following error when setting a Run ID of a Mass Data Run to Obsolete. -Cannot change status; run XYZ is scheduled-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Run Work Center View.-Select Run ID (e.g. XYZ). -Click on Actions > Set to Obsolete.-You can see an error: -Cannot change status; run XYZ is scheduled-Cause-There are two possible reasons why those errors are being displayed:-Indeed there are Scheduled Jobs for Mass Data Run and it can checked by following these steps:-Go to Mass Data run Work Center View. -Select Run ID (e.g. XYZ). -Click on View Jobs.-You can see Schedule Jobs.-There are no Scheduled Jobs on frontend and hence there are inconsistencies on Business Object which stores Scheduled Jobs information on backend. -Resolution-There are two possible resolutions according to each cause:-If there is a Scheduled Job for Mass Data Run, please Cancel Job following these steps:-Go to Mass Data run Work Center View. -Select Run ID (e.g. XYZ). -Click on View Jobs.-Select Schedule Jobs.-Click on Cancel Job button. -If there is NO Schedule Job for for the particular Mass Data Run, please raise a Case to SAP and we will check consistency of Business Object which stores these Background Jobs execution.-Keywords-Cannot change status, run, is scheduled, mass data run, obsolete, run id, error

Title: Custom Web Service is not Showing During Creation of Communication Scenario in SAP Business By Design
Content: Symptom-You have created a Custom Web service from SAP Cloud Application studio and during creation of a Communication Scenario in SAP Business By Design,the Web service is unavailable.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management View and the Communication Scenario Subview.-Choose New.-Give the Communication Scenario Name.-Go to Assigned Operations and Choose Add Operations.-You will not be able to find the Custom Webservice here.-Cause-The Communication Scenario using Custom Webservice has to be created from SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Resolution-It is a system expected behavior. Custom Webservice are not visible during creation of a Communication Scenario and such creation needs to be done via SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Keywords-Custom Webservice,Communication Scenario

Title: Error 'No Valuation Method Available for Company and Set of books' during Foreign Currency Remeasurement of Payables Run
Content: Symptom-Foreign Currency Remeasurement of Payables failing due to the error message: 'No valuation method available for company and set of books'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Under Periodic Tasks, select Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs.-Select the Executed Run and click on View.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-Notice the error message: 'No valuation method available for company and set of books'.-Cause-For the accounting principle and the assigned Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods the 'Valid From' date maintained is not applicable to the selected period in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement run.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view -> Open Activity List -> Fine-Tune > Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Payables and Receivables.-Select -> Assign remeasurement method to accounting principle.-For the Accounting Principle which is linked to your company, select the Use of Accounts payable and maintain the correct valid from for the assigned Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods.-or Execute the Foreign Currency Remeasurement of Payables for a period or later periods which is after the valid from date maintained in this settings.-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement of Payables, no valuation methods available, no valuation methods, foreign currency remeasurement payables

Title: Dump "CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL:"Local Shortcut Call Failed (ABCProcessing/YPQR_YPQR__NUMBER/EFG)." Occurs while Saving Instance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Dump "CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL:"Local Shortcut Call Failed (ABCProcessing/YPQR_YPQR__NUMBER/EFG)." occurs while saving instance in the fronted UI.
