Title: Request Reports on Unusual Activity by the User - IP Address, Change Logs and Usage Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User suspects there has been an anonymous changes on certain Business Objects and requests below information to SAP.-o IP address of the user-o Change Logs-o Usage Reporting-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Below is an example,-Go to Supplier Base Workcenter-Go to Suppliers view-Search for ID: ABC-Select Edit and View All-Navigate to the Changes tab-Notice there are some changes made by the user on the Bank Details.-Resolution-Queries:-1. Is it possible to provide an overview about all data that was changed by the user in the defined period?- The changes can be seen in the changes tab of the Master Data. To extract the over all report of the changes made on different BO's then create an incident to SRD-MD-BP development team.-2. Is it possible to identify the IP address of the user to verify the system access?-There is no option/flexibility to get the IP address of the user and from where the information was accessed due to technical limitations.-3. Is it possible to list the password changes of the user and if the password changes were done by the user or an administrator?-Customer can make use of the below reports from Business Analytics work center -> Design Reports: -User Logon Details-User Activation and Deactivation Log-All Current Users-Audit Logs can be requested to the Operation team by providing the defined timeframe of the issue occurred.-Keywords-IP address, Change Logs, Usage Reports, Supplier Data, Changes, Audit Logs

Title: "Financials assignment for Material XYZ/business residence ABC(ABC Description) not specified"
Content: Symptom-Unposted source document for Supplier Invoice or Customer Invoice shows the following error:-"Financials assignment for Material XYZ/business residence ABC(ABC Description) not specified". (XYZ represents the Material ID, ABC represents the Business Residence ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Choose the Source Document View.-Show Unposted Source Documents and search for DEF (DEF represents your Supplier Invoice or Customer Invoice ID).-You see a task with the below error message: -"Financials assignment for Material XYZ/business residence ABC(ABC Description) not specified".-Cause-Financials assignment for Material XYZ/Business Residence ABC is not maintained on the posting date DD-MM-YYYY.-So the document was not posted successfully and created a task in the General ledger.-If you check the material master data, you will see the same error against the Material. Check the changes tab, you will notice that the Business Residence ABC was added recently. Therefore you need to add the financial assignment for this Business Residence.-Resolution-To maintain the financials Assignment for Material XYZ for Business Residence ABC, follow the below steps:-In the Product Data work center, choose the Materials view.-Search for material XYZ and click Edit.-In the Valuation tab, add one row for Business Residence ABC.-Enter the Account Determination Group.-Enter all mandatory data.-Click Save.-To successfully finish the task, follow the instructions below:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents sub view.-Select the query Unposted Source Documents in Show field.-Select the relevant task created for DEF.-Choose Post Business Transaction from drop-down of Actions option.-See Also-Please refer to KBA: 2660379 - Message 'Financials Assignment for Material ABC/Business Residence XYZ not specified' is Still Displayed After Valuation Maintenance-Keywords-financial assignment, material, business residence, not specified, error

Title: Sales Quotes Not Showing in The Relevant Muti Customer Project
Content: Symptom-User released a sales quote and linked it to a muti customer project.-However, in the muti customer project, sales quote assignment tab, user cannot see it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new sales quote-In Items tab, maintain a product, ensure the item type is not project based-You get the Cost and Revenue Assignment option, maintain a muti customer project task -Release the sales quote-Go to the respective project, Sales Tracking tab, Sales Quote Assignment subtab-User expects to see the sales quote here, but nothing is showing.-Cause-This is the current system behavior. In sales quote,-if user wants to link it to project type "customer project with or without sales integration ", please use item type "service time and material(project)"or "service fixed price(project)", then user gets option to assign a project task under Project field. Through this way, the sales quote can be reflected on the project, Sales Tracking tab - Sales Quote Assignment subtab.-if user wants to link it to project type "multi customer project" or "direct cost project", please use item type "service time and material" or "service fixed price" , then user gets option to assign a project task under Cost and Revenue Assignment field. Through this way, the sales quote cannot be reflected on the  project, Sales Tracking tab - Sales Quote Assignment subtab.-Resolution-Although the sales quotes cannot be shown in muti customer project side, once user creates follow up sales orders for the sales quotes, the sales order can be correctly shown in the project, Sales Tracking tab - Sales Order Assignment subtab for user's reference.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Muti Customer Project, Sales Tracking, Project, Assignment

Title: How to Enable Feed for a Custom BO Created via SDK?
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to enable the feed in a Custom BO which is available in a standard BO, created via SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Feeds in Custom BO's created via SAP Cloud Applications Studio are not supported.-Resolution-Feeds are only available for the standard BO's. This is a known scenario and has been added to the backlog. The functionality will be made available in one of the future releases.-Keywords-Feed in custom BO-Enable Feed

Title: Error - The Supplied GUID Does Not Correspond to a Software Problem Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When you go to the Process Communication Errors view you see the following error:-"The supplied GUID (XYZ) does not correspond to a Software Problem Report" (where XYZ stands for an UUID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Click Process Communication Errors view.-Filter - Open Errors with cases.-We can see these details in other screen as well by following below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Click Business Communication Monitoring view.-Filter - Messages exchanged with SAP/Business Messages with Error.-Results:-Sending Document ID - No Data Available-Receiving Document ID - No Data Available-Error - The supplied GUID (XYZ) does not correspond to a Software Problem Report.-Sender Information: Business Partner SAP_ServiceProviderCockpit-Cause-The issue is due to a Software Problem Report (SPR) missing. Since there is no way to recover the missing SPR, and it cannot be re-created, you have to cancel the respective XI messages.-(This stuck message might be for a test case, which was created from /ITSAM/PI_CONNECTION_TEST report. This report is used for test connections to validate whether the incident management connections are working fine. The Scenario (User incident to Provider) from which this message is triggered is marked as Obsolete.)-Resolution-To find the message ID:-Login to the backend.-Go to BO Test shell (SESFTS).-Enter the BO name SPAF_TECHNICAL_ERROR_BO.-Load By query -> ROOT - Query_by_elements.-In the popup Set query Options, chose required Resolution Strategy Code, e.g. ErrorResolutionStrategyCode = 6 ( case Creation ), and execute the query (a hint to the relevant Resolution Strategy Code is given by the content of the Sending Document column of the error message in the Process Communication Error view).-For all the root instances, navigate to subnode MESSAGE_ATTRIBUTES.-Click on Table View icon and find the field MESSAGE_UUID-CONTENT, which gives you the message IDs.-Copy the content-To delete the message:-Go to SRT_MONI or n/SRT_MONI, (In SRT_MONI use the same message IDs to filter the messages along with selecting Processing Status Group as Erroneous to look for only erroneous message).-Select Multiple Selection in the Message ID Field and paste the copied message IDs.-Click on Execute Button.-Compare with the errors in the UI, select the row and click on Action button, select Cancel the message ID.-Once the message ID is canceled then the error message will disappear from the Process Communication Errors & Business Communication Monitoring view in the UI.-You can check the detailed actions for these kind of issues in this link. PCE Video-See Also-3212184 - How to deal with some Common Process Communication Errors-Keywords-GUID, Process Communication Error, PCE, SPR-

Title: "Value "Name" for variable "E2E Metric Type Variable" is invalid" and "No Applicable Data Found" in Workload Analysis
Content: Symptom-The following text might occur in Workload Analysis-1. Value "{name}" for variable "E2E Metric Type Variable(multiple values)" is invalid-or-2. "No Applicable Data Found"---Disclaimer: "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.1-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Cause-For symptom 1, it is in very rarely cases caused by BW query issue, and in general it indicates that data of this metric type has never successfully collected and further loaded into Solution Manager BI client.-For symptom 2, it mostly indicates that no data of that metric type for this managed system can be found in the certain period in Workload Analysis, however there must be at least one managed system has ever this kind of data collected and loaded into Solution Manager system BI client.-Resolution-For both cases, please always download and apply the latest version of config xml file for your Solution Manager SP level from SAP Note 1259109 to avoid errors due to the old config xml.-For symptom 1, perform the steps below to trouble shoot if this is a normal behavior.--a. Goto listcube and enter the infocube  0SMD_MPEH-b. Press F4 to the field "Metric Type" and search for the metric type in the error of workload analysis to verify if it really doesn't exist in the list.----c. For further testing, select one metric from the list and execute it as below, in general there should be historical data for at least one system in the result.----d. Open the config xml file that you use in your system in text editor and search for the Metric Type----e. Go to Wily workstation and enter the Expression of metric to verify whether data of this metric for that host or system can be seen in Wily. If not, that means either data collection has issue or the functions in the managed system are not used at all. For the first case, please see step f and g. As for the second case, this is normal behavior that no data in Wily can be seen since no relevant activities have ever occur in managed system.----f. In case the metric in Wily should locate under "SAP Host Agent" node since AgentType is Host as defined in the screenshot, the log files of Diagnosics Agent should be checked. Or you can create a new case in SV-SMG-DIA and attach the Support Logs as mentioned in SAP Note 1076573.--g. In case the metric in Wily should locate under node that is covered by Introscope Bytecode Agent e.g. under the node "SAP Netweaver", the log files of Bytecode Agent should be checked as mentioned in SAP Note 1306843.--h. If metric exists in Wily and data can be seen there, that means data collection up to Wily is OK, there must be something wrong with Solution Manager system so that data cannot be loaded from Wily into BI client. Please check extractors in extractor framework, steps in managed system configuration and extractor framework batch job "EFWK RESOURCE MANAGER" and "E2E BI HOUSEKEEPING".--For symptom 2, the investigation direction is to verify why this kind of data for this managed system in that time frame cannot be found in workload analysis. The start point is always to verify data availability in Wily and perform step f, g and h above. Also, SAP Note 1435043 might be helpful to resolve the issue.-See Also-1827116 - Rating not determined (Grey) at SAP EarlyWatch Alert-2041550 - Error "Value "SERVLETS" for variable "E2E Metric Type Variable(multiple values)" is invalid" occurs in the Workload Analysis-Keywords-E2E Metric Type Variable; No Applicable Data Found; Workload Analysis;

Title: Missing data and other replication issues for employees with nationality or location: Mexico
Content: Symptom-Example:-Within an integration scenario including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP Business ByDesign, employees with nationality/location: Mexico are replicated. But in the replication there is no way to receive the RFC, CURP AND SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER fields, which are captured in SuccessFactors.-Result: These security IDs are not replicated to the  SAP Business ByDesign system.-Environment-SAP SuccessFactors-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To reproduce the given example:-Go to the Master Data Replication work center-Open Employees view-Search for the Remote Employee ID-Click Edit-Go to the Personal Data > Biographical Data-Fields  RFC, CURP or SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER are not available-Resolution-SAP does not offer standard localization for Mexico in HCM. We currently only have localization in Financial Management, Customer Relationship Management, and Supplier Relationship Management modules.-Since we do not have Localization for HCM module for Mexico, it is not possible to incorporate fields such as RFC, CURP, and SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER for MDR from our side-You may explore the feasibility of potential custom (PDI) solutions with your partner -In light of this issue, we recommend submitting this as an enhancement idea on our Influence portal. This will enable our Product Management team to review and consider this as a future roadmap plan in future releases of the product.-See Also-For your reference, please find the relevant details in the following help document: Mexico -Please find information about enhancement requests in the following KBA: 2531650 - New Customer Request for Additional Feature or Function in SAP standard software -Keywords- data

Title: How to Remove Unassigned Notification Related to Vacation Cancellation?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal Use Only***-You received an case from the customer for the below issue:-There are Unassigned BTM Notification for employees which were terminated in the past - Supported task type: HCM_TIM_TIM_NTF_CANC_APPROVED [Task Type ID is made read-only].-These notifications were sent to the employees after manager approval but no action happened/they were not read by the employee.-It is not possible to determine assignment for these notifications because the employee was already terminated.-System may automatically generate Health Check cases for these unassigned notifications.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Task Management view-Select Unassigned Tasks-With the Advanced Search, select the required task-Go to Application log-Click on the Recent Application log-In General Tab, under Summarizing Messages, you will see the Employee Name with ID-You can see tasks related to vacation cancellation and you can see that there is no option to delete. Also determination of assignment is not working-Cause-This situation occurs when an Employee didn't attempt to check these notifications before his/her termination.-Resolution-It is not possible to remove the notification by customer/support from the UI. Instead, the removal should be performed from the backend.-Find attached to this KBA the document which has the step by step process to be followed in the backend, to remove theseunassigned notifications.-Note: At present, this report doesn't support mass remove instead this needs to performed for each employee.-In case of any questions, please contact ByD HCM Product Area Lead.-In case the removal via report does not work (e.g. there is no notification for the given creation time in the backend), development may need to remove the notifications manually.-Keywords-Notification, task, vacation cancellation, remove task, review time data, Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization

Title: Description Field in Manual Invoice Request is Not Available in the Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the value in Description field in the manual invoice request. After releasing this invoice request, you find the field Description is not available in the following customer invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Customer Invoicing work center - click New manual invoice.-Input all required fields, and maintain value in the Description field under General tab.-Release the invoice request and open the customer invoice just created. -You find the Description field is not availabe in the invoice.-Cause-It is the current system design that the Description of the invoice request is not carried into the following customer invoice.-Resolution-You may utilize other fields in the invoice request to transfer the value from invoice request to customer invoice. For example, External Reference field or create extension field (and enable the necessary extension scenario).-Keywords-Manual Invoice Request, Description, Missing, Header Text, Invoice Document

Title: How To Work With Down Payments in Sales
Content: Symptom-Down Payments are Invoices generated for Sales Processes, before the actual Invoicing Process for respective Sales activity is started.-This Knowledge Base Article will explain the functionality of Down Payment Requests in SAP Business ByDesign.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There are two options to create Down Payment Requests in Business ByDesign:-Down Payments can be created for specific sales documents, including Sales Orders, Service Orders and Contracts. In our example, we will use Sales Orders.--You can navigate to the Sales Orders OWL (Object Work List), select the respective Sales Order and click on the Create Down Payment button.---You can enter an external Reference Number, the amount of the Down Payment and the relevant tax details. Note that some countries restrict the taxation selection.--Once you click on OK, a Down Payment Invoice Request will be created and can be opened in the Invoice Request view in the Customer Invoicing workcenter.--Note that Down Payment Invoice Request data is determined based on the logged in User.--The Down Payment will be fully assigned to the Sales Document, from which it was created:---You can adjust Pricing Details, Organizational Assignment, Taxation Details and External References and then Release the Down Payment Invoice Request.--You create a Down Payment Request, which you can find in the Invoice Document view.--The created Down Payment Request will be fully assigned to the sales document, from which it was created.--While the Down Payment is created, you cannot yet assign it to Invoices from related sales document. You need to first clear the payment for the Down Payment Request.--Clear the Down Payment Request.--Process the sales document, until you can invoice it.--When you invoice the sales document, the Down Payment will be assigned automatically:--If you want to prevent the assignment, you can deactivate the Assignment for the Down Payment Request before creating the Invoice.--Navigate to the Invoice Document View and find your Down Payment Request and click the button No Invoice Assignment.-Please note: When you un assign a down payment request, system displays the message 'Invoice clearing switched; check status in accounts receivable'.-This is an information message, since the down payment invoice need to be cleared before usage, and since you now removed the assignment, system alerts you to check the receivable of the account.-There is no impact to the invoice clearing process.-If you want to assign it to the next invoice, you can activate the assignment by opening the Down Payment Request and clicking on Allow Invoice Assignment.--Once you release the Invoice with Down Payment Request assigned, the paid value will be noted and only the residual value will be considered for payment.---You can also create a Down Payment Request without reference to any sales document.--Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter and select the New Down Payment Invoice Request view.--Enter the required organizational and pricing related data and release the Down Payment Invoice Request.--This creates a Down Payment Request without any assignment to sales documents.--You need to clear the payment before being able to assign it manually.--Once the payment is cleared, you can now select this Down Payment in open Invoice Requests:--Open any open Invoice Request for particular customer and on General Tab you will find the Assigned Down Payments Header.--You can assign only part of the Down Payment Request to the sales document invoice request.--If you now save the sales document invoice request, the reference is set and can be checked in the Down Payment Invoice Request:---Once you create the Invoices from the sales documents, they will appear in the Actual Payments tab.---You can use the Web Service Manage Down Payment Invoice Request to create Down Payments with and without Assignment to sales documents.-Further documentation on the web service can be accessed via the Service Explorer view in the Application and User Management Workcenter.--Down Payment Invoice Requests are considered manual invoice requests and will trigger the Approval Process for Customer Invoices.--Invoice Runs can be set up to consider Down Payments during automatic creation of Customer Invoices.--See Also-KBA 2849101 - Cleared Down Payment Showing Under Open Down Payment Requests-KBA 2785060 - Invoice is not created by the Invoice Run for an Invoice Request with a Down Payment assigned-KBA 2776354 - Down Payment Requests Are Created With Error Message 'Sales data or pricing terms not found for account'-KBA 2493672 - Down Payments Are Not Creating Journal Entries-KBA 2377308 - No values in Drop Down List for Payment Terms in Invoice Request or a Down Payment Invoice Request-KBA 2377224 - How is the Tax Country Determined in a Down Payment Request which was Created via a Sales Order-KBA 2228707 - Down Payment Status in the Open Down Payment Requests-KBA 2077847 - Tax Code in the Create Down Payment Window is Not the Same as in the Sales Order-KBA 2013735 - Not Possible to Not Assign a Down Payment Request in an Invoice Request-KBA 2013708 - Cannot Create Invoice When Deactivate the Down Payments Transfer Indicator-KBA 1964635 - Down Payment Request can be Assigned to Invoice Request Even Though it was Already Assigned to an Invoice-KBA 1934847 - Cannot Add Cleared Down Payment Request to an Invoice Request-KBA 1713865 - Your Payment Term for Cash Discount is Not Displayed in your Down Payment Request-KBA 2886206 - Error in Customer Invoice: Invoice date before date XX.XX.XXXX of the referenced invoice not allowed-KBA 2914214 - A Down Payment Is Not Assigned to a Customer Invoice as Expected-KBA 1979774 - Create Down Payment Disabled for Indian Seller-Keywords-Down Payment Request, Anzahlung, How To, Guide,

Title: Product Description Translation in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You open a Sales Order document, navigate to the Items tab and expected to see the description of the products with the logon language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, let's consider Spanish and Chinese as the language maintained under the Other Languages tab, at the Product master data.-You have logged in the system in Spanish.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click the Edit button.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-You see the description of the items in Chinese.-Cause-When a Sales Order is created with a line item, product and product description and once saved, the description will not be translated in every logon. The product description will show in the language in which it was saved.-In this example, the creation of the Sales Orders was done with a user logged in Chinese and after saved, the system stored the description in Chinese.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you believe that this can be improved, we would like to invite you to create a thread under the SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence.-See Also-KBA 3354528 - Language of Product Description in the Output Document of the Sales Document is Not the Expected One-Keywords-Sales Order; Item; Description; Translation

Title: Unable to Migrate Open Sales Orders With Service Fulfillment Via Project
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate a sales order with product of type Service fixed price without actuals. However, in the Migration Template, under item tab, "service fulfillment via Project" is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find and Select activity the Migration of Open Sales Orders Activity.-Select Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool via the hyperlink.-You can also > Download Migration template.-In the Migration Template, item tab, "service fulfillment via Project" is not available. -Cause-In UI screen, if you enter a Product ID of a service item of type Service fixed price without actuals, and assign the sales order to a multi customer project, you will see a Service Fulfillment via Project check box under Cost and Revenue Assignment. The indicator is unchecked by default. If you select the check box, the system will do the following steps:-Plan the costs from the project and not the sales order-Make mandatory fields Labour Resource and Duration in the sales order item level non-mandatory-Currently, the migration of items with service fulfillment via Project is not supported.-Resolution-We do not currently have the possibility of migrating items with service fulfillment via Project. The idea of migration generally is that it is all the tasks have already been performed in the legacy system and that there is no pending task on them.-Please note that "Service Fulfillment via Project" is not available via standard webservice either.-You can create a request for a new requirement in the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Site - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-This forum is monitored directly by our Product Management and they will be able to assess your requirement for feasibility to be added in the future release.-See Also-KBA  3108741 - Cannot Migrate Open Sales Order with Service Fixed Price Without Actuals and External Fulfillment-Keywords-Migrate Open Sales Orders, Service Fulfillment Via Project, Service fixed price without actuals

Title: Mini Scenario SRM: Strategic Sourcing - Sourcing Request from Purchase Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-1) Select a purchase request to renegotiate and generate a new Sourcing Request:-- Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-- Go to the Purchase Requests view.-- In "Show: Open Tasks", open a task with Task Status "New" and Task Title "Create Purchase Order".-- Choose “Assign Source of Supply”-- In the “Purchase Request” screen, choose “Quick Sourcing Request”-- You get a message "Sourcing request created”.-- Choose Close.-  2) Send RFQs to Bidders out of the new Sourcing Request:-- Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-- Go to the Sourcing Requests view.-- Choose "Show: Sourcing Requests from Purchase Requests"-- Mark the relevant Sourcing Request ID with Reference ID = Purchase Request ID from Step 1.-- Choose New RFQ -> For Selected Items.-- In the "New Request for Quotation" screen, in the tab General, enter the Submission Deadline.-  - In the tab Bidders, add 2 bidders (= suppliers).-- Change the email address for the 2 bidders to your email address:- -> double click on the buyer ID- -> Choose View All.- -> Go to the tab Communications- -> Go to the sub tab Collaboration- -> Change the file E-mail- -> Choose Save.-- Choose You Can Also -> Edit Output Settings in order to check that the settings are correct.-- Choose Send to Bidders.-- You get a message "RFQ with ID X saved"-  3) Check the new RFQ-- Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-- Go to the Requests for Quotation view.-- Select the query "Show: Published RFQs".-- Mark the new RFQ and verify that no quotes is received for the RFQ-   4) In Outlook, for the bidders, you received an email "Request to Submit Quote for RFQ X":-- Open the interactive pdf form.-- Fill in all relevant details.-- Choose Submit-- Choose Desktop Email Application in the pop-up Select Email Client.-- In Outlook, for the message, choose Send.-  5) Compare the Quotes and award one of them:-- Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-- Go to the Requests for Quotation view.-- Select the query "Show: Published RFQs".-- Mark the new RFQ and choose Show Quotes.-- Mark both quotes and choose Compare Quotes.-- For one of the quotes, choose Decline and for the other one, choose Award.-- In the tab Document Flow, you can visualize the new Purchase Order with status In Preparation.-- In Outlook, you have received relevant emails for the Result Notification of the Quotes.-  6) Complete the new Purchase Order:-- Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-- Go to the Purchase Orders view.-- In "Show: Open Tasks", open a task with subject "Complete Purchase Order".-- Amend the data if required and press the Check button.-- If no error, you can choose Order.-   7) If required, the Purchase Order has to be approved.-- Log in as approver.-- Go to the work center Managing My Area.-- Go to the view Approvals.-- Select "Show: Open Tasks".-- Mark the task with subject: "Approve Purchase Order X"-- Choose Approve.-   8) Send the purchase order to the supplier:-- Open the purchase order.-- Choose Order.-- Verify that the status is Sent.-- In Outlook, check the purchase order.-  9) Change back the Communication Email address from your email address to supplier01@bydmail.com for both bidders.

Title: Error: "Not enough rows in table for GenderCode code list. Add more rows"
Content: Symptom-In Account Management work center it is not possible to create Contacts using Microsoft Excel. The following error messages occur:-An error occurred during file export:-Error ID: AP_UI_OIN 043-Error text: Not enough rows in table for GenderCode code list. Add more rows.-Please report an case if the error persists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center-Go to Contacts view-Select the button New -> Contacts from Microsoft Excel-System loads for a while and throws the error messages -Cause-This system behavior is based on a recent adaptation of the extended code list in the system.-Resolution-A new version of the file containing 5 Gender Codes has been released and is planned to be added to the system in a future release.-For the time being, you may use the  English version or the German version attached to this KBA. Please use these templates to upload Contacts using Microsoft Excel.-See Also-KBA 1907729-Keywords-Kontakte von Excel, Template, Kunden Management

Title: Cost Estimate Price Component Missing in Sale Order
Content: Symptom-You are unable to enter the Estimated Cost on the Sales Order as the Price Component Cost Estimate is not available in the Sales Order. This estimated cost is used to determine the POC for Revenue Recognition for the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Under this check the Item Pricing and Total Pricing Details.-The Price Component Cost Estimate is missing here.-Cause-You haven't done the scoping settings required to use Cost Estimate Price component in the Sales Order.-Please Note:-The Price Component Cost Estimate in step 082 of your Pricing Procedure is only relevant for project based sales order items.-In sales orders the Cost Estimate price component is available for items of type:-Service - time and material (Project),-Service - fixed price (project),-Product - project-based,-Expense - time and material (project),-Expense - fixed price (project).-The Price Component Cost in step 081 of your Pricing Procedure is relevant for the other service items types and materials.-Resolution-In order to see the Estimate Cost in the pricing tab, You have to scope the option Price Specification in the scoping.-Steps to enable the Price Specification:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Edit Scope.-Go to 3rd step (Scoping).-Select General Business Data > Product and Service Pricing.-Tick the box for Sales Price Specifications.-Go to Questions.-Select General Business Data > Product and Service Pricing > Sales Price Specifications.-Make sure that Yes is selected for the question: Do you calculate profit margins for service or sales orders and make them visible to your sales employees?-Save and Finish the Scoping.-This change will only take effect in new sales order. In order to enter the Cost Estimate in the Existing Sales Order, you need to update the pricing in the Sales Order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Under Total Pricing section -> Select Update Pricing - Completely (If you have not added any price component manually).-If you have added any manual price component then select Update Pricing - Keep Manual Changes.-Save the order.-Cost Estimate should now be displayed in the pricing tab.-See Also-1856482 - Cost Estimate Price Component questions-2414369 - Cost Estimate Price Component Not Available For Material In Sales Order-Keywords-Cost; Cost Estimate; Sales Order; Pricing; Strategy

Title: Error: Duplicate Email/Fax/External System Channels are not Allowed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-On creating or save of some business document, you notice error Duplicate Email/Fax/External System Channels are not allowed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center as an example.-Click on Payment Monitor view.-Find the document ABC (ABC represents the payment document ID).-Select and click Create Remittance Advice.-Then the error occurs: Duplicate Email/Fax/External System Channels are not allowed.-Cause-There is duplicate communication arrangement in the system business partner. The duplicate entry might have been created through migration.-Find the business partner for the affected document.-Click on View All.-Navigate to Collaboration tab and then to Collaboration.-Under Business Document Settings, you will see duplicate entries for Business Document Name.-Resolution-You need to delete the duplicate entry for the business partner ID TEST(e.g) from backend after getting approval from customer as explained below.-Go to system backend and enter SESFTS.-Enter BUSINESS_PARTNER BO.-Click on Load by alternate key-> Overview-Internal ID.-Enter Business Partner Internal ID- TEST and enter.-Select Navigate -> TO PARENT.-Select Navigate -> COMMNUNICATION_ARRANEGMENT.-Select Navigate-> CHILD_COMMNUNICATION_ARRANEGMENT-Cross check duplicate entry code under Compound Service Interface.-Select entries which are duplicate.-Select the entries-> Navigate -> COMMINICATION_DATA.-Select the entries -> Navigate -> Default Email.-Based on entry, copy node ID which you want to delete.-Then Navigate -> Parent.-Goto Edit -> Select entry to be deleted based on Node ID.-Click on Delete.-Keywords-Duplicate Email/Fax/External System Channels are not allowed, Communication arrangement error, collaboration tab, Business Partner, Communication arrangement by migration

Title: How to Create a Development User to Work in SDK
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to create a user to work in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK) for PDI development activity.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Prerequisites ->-You should have an initial business user. The initial user is provided to you during the tenant provisioning process.-Create Service Agent ->-Go to Business Partner Data for SAP Business ByDesign.-Go to Business Partner for SAP Cloud for Customer.-Click on 'New Service Agent'.-Fill all the mandatory details.-Click on SAVE.-Click on 'Request User' for a business user to be created.-Go to Application and User Management WOC.-Go to Business User View.-Find your user (search with the name given for service agent).-Click on Edit > User Attributes.-Change User ID and Password.-Assign Access Rights ->-Go to Application and User Management WOC.-Go to Business User View.-Find your user with the user ID.-Click on Edit > Access Rights-Assign below Work Centers for PDI Developer User --PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOMPENT/ Partner Development-ANA_BUSINESSANALYTICS /Business Analytics-Application and User Management-  6. Click on SAVE.-  7. Login once to frontend to change the password.- Now you can use this user for logging to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-See Also-You can also refer SDK Help Guide Section 'User Setup Quick Guide' for more details:-User Setup Quick Guide- Keywords-PDI, User Setup, SDK, Development User, Service Agent, cloud studio,-c4c,new developer user,new setup for sdk,custom development,first time login in sdk,initial pdi setup

Title: Error "Organizational Unit Locked by XYZ" During Hiring Process
Content: Symptom-You are executing the process to hire an employee on your Business ByDesign solution when you encounter the mentioned error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Regular Tasks view.-Click the link to Hire an Employee.-If there are multiple countries scoped in your solution, you will have to select the relevant country tab before this.-Fill the mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk) for the first step and click Next.-Fill the mandatory fields for the second step and click Next.-The error message "Organizational unit locked by XYZ" (where XYZ stands for a business user ID) occurs.-Cause-The most likely reason for this is the user mentioned in the error message is working on the second step of the hiring process and has selected the same org unit for the employee's assignment. In the backend, the business object will lock while this first hiring process writes information to it, in order to avoid inconsistencies, and this lock causes the error observed.-Resolution-Please try to avoid executing this process concurrently with another process already in progress.-If you have ensured there are no other users executing employee hiring at the same time as you are, kindly report an case to SAP Product Support for further analysis.-Keywords-Organizational Unit Locked, Personnel Administration, Hire An Employee, Org Assignment

Title: How to Check and Repair Inconsistent Extension Fields From Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**** INTERNAL USE ONLY ****-This document describes how to check which extension fields in a particular system are inconsistent, and how to repair them.-A potential scenario is: The customer has performed a layout import including many extension fields. Now when they go into Edit mode of some of the extension fields, they see the following error:-'Fields needs repair; press Repair to resolve'-The customer raises an incident because too many extension fields are involved to check and repair each of them manually.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To reproduce from the frontend, this is a possible scenario (in C4C):-Go to the screen where the extension field is maintained.-Enter the Adaptation mode.-Edit Master Layout-Hover over the field and click on Edit -> Field Definition.-Here, in the header of the extension field, you see the above error message with an exclamation mark. This can potentially happen for several fields.-Cause-The cause for this inconsistency is not known as of now. It seems to occur in a few cases only. i.e. sporadically and temporarily.-Resolution-The below steps are valid for both ByD and C4C.-To check which fields are inconsistent:-Logon to the backend.-Go to the transaction ANAST.-Scroll down to the table Extensibility, and click on MDRS_ANA_EXT_SUPPORT_TOOL.-Check the option Appearances Overview Customer, then click on Execute.-This will give you a list of all KUT extension fields in this system. Scroll through it and see if there are fields marked in red. Whichever fields are highlighted are inconsistent and need repair.-To repair them:-From this view, copy the extension field ID of every affected field. The relevant ID is the second column.-Go back one step in the transaction.-Check the option Repair one Customer Field.-Now the line Custom Field is enabled. Enter the extension field ID here.-Click on Execute.-This will have to be repeated for all affected extension fields.-If you notice that the fields are in bulk which need repairing then please select and execute the option “Repair Customer Enh (no del)” from MDRS_ANA_EXT_SUPPORT_TOOL.--NOTE: There should be no connection interruption in between, but if you face an interruption follow the below steps:-Then check how many fields still need repairing, if it is still in bulk (30, 40+) then again follow the same steps.-If there are only few (5, 10), then repair them manually as per above steps.-Try these steps when customer is not using the tenant as per their confirmation in their timezone.-Keywords-repair, inconsistent, extension field, backend, ANAST, Fields, needs, repair; press, Repair, to, resolve, Field, needs, repair; press Repair to resolve, field, definition, adaptation-report cannot be saved,report can not be saved,characteristic is missing in mdav,error during upload

Title: How to Check Sender E-mail address for a Business Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -For a document, wrong sender email address is passed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales work center (as an example).-Click on Sales Quotes view.-Open any Sales Quote.-Click on Actions -> Submit.-Sales quote is released but not from desired sender e-mail address.-Resolution-The sender e-mail address is filled by application in their call back method and this can be verfied with below steps.-Goto system backend.-Enter SE24 t-code and put class name as /DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR.-Double click on method REFRESH_FOR_BACKEND.-Search for the line – ‘lr_callback->initialize’ and Put a break-point at the following lines as highlighted.-Now, open Sales Quote and click on Actions and then Preview. The control reaches the method.-Once the control reaches the respective code, press F6. Then, double click on ‘lt_init_params_brf’ or, ‘lt_init_params’ to check the Sender email address that was passed.-Double click on the respective structure. In this case, the value is available in the structure – ‘lt_init_params_brf’.-As highlighted in above screenshot, the sender email address is already filled by application in their callback class.-You could see sender e-mail address filled by application.-Note: Incase of any further queries on sender e-mail address, respective application team should answer.-Keywords-sender e-mail address, wrong e-mail, sender e-mail, E-mail address incorrect

Title: XML Syntax is Getting Changed With ExecuteRESTService
Content: Symptom-The ExecuteRESTService as part of WebServiceUtilities is causing the '<' in the resulting XML file to be changed to '&lt'. It also changes different characters.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Calling a REST service third party webservice using WebServiceUtilities.ExecuteRESTService in ABSL scripting.-Cause-This method allows encoding which can change characters in the XML file. An example would be having "&" converted to "&amp".-Resolution-Using "ExecuteRESTServiceWithoutEncoding" should resolve this issue. Please implement "ExecuteRESTServiceWithoutEncoding" in your ABSL script.-Keywords-XML, ExecuteRESTService, '&lt'

Title: A Dump is Occurring When Clicking on 'Click here to execute the query' in the Time Sheet View
Content: Symptom-When trying to access the Time Sheet view and clicking on 'Click here to execute the query' to check the employee times, the system throws an exception:-An error occurred-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Recording view.-Go to Time Sheet sub-view.-When selecting an option from the dropdown menu ('Active Employees' or 'All Employees'), a link will appear in the middle of the screen.-Click on the link that says "Click here to execute the query".-System throws the error.-Cause-In the Business Configuration workcenter's project scope, currently only a PDI (Partner Development Infrastructure) created country/region is scoped and in order for the Time Sheet view to work correctly, at least one standard country/region must be scoped.-Resolution-Follow the steps below in order to scope a standard country:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-In the scoping step 'Country/region and Type of Business', click Edit Countries/Regions.-Add a standard country/region and click OK.-Click the Next button until you reach the Review step (step 5).-Click the Finish button.-Keywords-Time Administration, Time Sheet, Timesheet, Employees, Dump

Title: PDI Field Cannot be Added to A Standard Screen
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom field in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK). You have opened the UI Designer, and have navigated to a standard screen. You can see there is a UI Anchor, therefore you should be able to add the field to this screen, however you cannot.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the UI Designer.-Navigate to the desired standard screen.-Open the Extensibility Explorer.-Select the Add Extension Field to Section Group button.-You will not see the field you created, therefore cannot add it to this screen even though there is a UI Anchor and required operation for this screen.-Cause-This issue can occur when you have added your field to the wrong Business Object or wrong Node in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Resolution-Check the XML of the UI Screen in the UI Designer.-Check what Namespace, Business Object and Node this screen is based on.-When you are extending an SAP Namespace in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio, you can select a Namespace and then a Business Object in the creation wizard.-Add the field to the correct Namespace, Business Object and Node, and then return to the UI Designer to add the field to this section.-Please note, if there are no UI Anchors or operations (e.g. "Add Extension Field to Section Group") for the section you are trying to add the field to, then you will need to open an case to SAP Cloud Product Support.-This case will be a PSM (Public Solution Model) request. Please add 'PSM' to the case title, and you can add screenshots of the exact issue you are facing.-For more information, please see section 5.6 in the Cloud Application Studio Help Documentation.-See Also-2573967 - Field Creation Failed when Creating Extension Fields-2490905 - Save Query Button is not Visible in the UI of a Custom Screen-2570897 - Error Message When Deleting Custom UI Component-Keywords-PDI, Custom Field, UI Designer, Add Extension Field to Section Group, UI Anchor, Cannot Add Field

Title: Wrong Default Country/Region in Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You create an expense report, either for yourself or on behalf, for employee XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of an employee).-After filling the Type of Expense Report field you notice country/region ABC appears in the Country/Region field (ABC represents a country/region ID).-However, you/ the employee is assigned to a cost center associated with country DEF (DEF represents the expected country/region ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new expense report, either through Home- Selfservices, or on behalf, in the Travel and Expenses work center under Common Tasks - New Expense Report on Behalf.  -Choose an expense report type. -Under Dates and Locations you notice country/region ABC in the Country/Region field. -Change the country/region in the field to DEF. -Press Add More Destinations.-You notice, country/region DEF appears as first destination in step 002, rather than in step 001- Start of the Trip. -Also, country ABC appears in the last step- End of trip. -Cause-Country ABC is suggested, because you/ the employee was hired for country ABC.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Add the Country/Region field to the Employees table via the Personalize function. -Find yourself/ employee XYZ.- In the Country/Region collumn you notice country ABC.-Resolution-To solve this issue, the current employment for country ABC must be terminated in the Personnel Administration work center under Regular Tasks.-Afterwards, perform a Rehire for the correct Country DEF.-See Also-Quick Guide for Regular Tasks (in Personnel Administration)-KBA 1625369 - Reimbursable Expense Amount Calculated in Wrong Currency in Expense Report-Keywords-Expense Report, default country, home country, start trip, end trip

Title: List Price Maintained in the Contract is not Fetching into the Follow-up Service Order
Content: Symptom-The list price not auto populating to service order created as a follow-up from contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Contracts view.-Select the Contract XYZ. (XYZ represents the Contract ID)-Click on Follow-Up button and select Service Order from the list.-The List Price is not fetching the values from contract.-Cause-Service order is just a planning document for a contract in this scenario and no price gets determined for such items. In the service order you needs to plan the fulfillment and working condition of the service/spare part. such items are invoiced on contract only.-In service confirmations created from service order items, price will be picked up from contract, if price agreements in contract is maintained.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Service Order, Follow-up, Contract, List Price, Missing, Pricing, Automatically

Title: Error: Move Project Solution Profile to Production Tenant During Merge of a Change Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the Business Configuration Workcenter, While performing the merge activity , the following error is displayed .--Error Message: Move project solution profile to production tenant in the merge report of a change project.-Error Details-Merge Back-Move project solution profile to production tenant-Details :-Technical error occurred. Please create an case.-SLG1 Logs will be as follows:-An exception was raised-Source sys rep is different from target sys. Source: Target: XYZ.-Source sys rep is different from target sys. Source: Target: ABC.-Skip check with SPA/GPA Param BCT_IMPORT_NO_CHECK in the target tenant-An exception was raised-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the concerned project.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Go-Live tab.-Select and Confirm the Merge Changes to Production System activity.-The error occurs .-The issue is also faced while simulating the merge of the project.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the add-on composition of the test and production system is not the same. The test and production tenants have different add-on compositions , one or more add-ons (for example, XYZ or ABC) are present in one tenant but missing in the other.-Resolution-This issue can be overcome by aligning the add-on composition so both tenants contain the same add-ons required for the change project.-Keywords-ByD, tenant alignment, add-on mismatch, extension compatibility, component version mismatch, system landscape consistency, promotion to productive system, package dependency issue, tenant synchronization failure, setup parity, application log analysis, parameter check bypass, release management

Title: Error in UI related to "Importing Parameter"
Content: Symptom-You are executing some steps on the UI (Edit, Save, Create, Delete or Custom Action) and you receive the error message:-"Importing parameter PARAM is initial"  or "Invalid importing parameter PARAM"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have created a Solution in the Cloud Applications Studio.-You have created a Custom Business Object or Extension Business Object.-You have created a Script File for your Business Object.-Cause-You are using SAP Built-In Functions in your custom script where one or more of the importing parameters have not been given a value. For example, for cdate = this.ADate.Delta(this.BDate, true), the Error Message "Importing parameter DATE2 is initial" tells us that this.BDate is initial.-Resolution-Perform a trace in the Cloud Applications Studio to see what custom scripts are being called.-Debug the scripts and check for Built-In Functions used in the code.-If you have corrected all importing parameters for the Built-In Functions and the error is still raised, please open an case with SAP Product Support.-See Also-Check section SAP Built-In Functions Reference in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio Documentation. There you can see all supported Built-In Functions and the required parameters.-Keywords-Importing, Parameter, is initial, Built-In, Functions, for Strings, Date, Datatype, Data, Type, absl, After, Modify, AfterModify, BeforeSave, Before, Save, AfterLoading, Loading, ValidationOnSave, Validation, OnSave, Script, BO, XBO, Function, Method, blank, empty, Delta, PDI, SDK, Solution, Scripting, Custom, Code, Logic, PDI_ABSL_RSC

Title: Solution Version Mismatch on SAP Cloud Applications Studio. Solution XYZ not up-to-date. Update to version 123.
Content: Symptom-The following error message may interrupt either solution deployment, or it may be displayed while logging into SDK:-"Solution XYZ not up-to-date. Update to Version 123" (Where XYZ refers to Y-namespace of the solution and 123 refers to the patch version)-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have attempted to deploy solution on specific tenant, however the action was interrupted by the following warning message:-This message may also appear when you are logging into SDK on a specific tenant.-Cause-The warning message is displayed due to cross client dependency and system architecture. When you log into the studio on specific tenant, system "checks" if the same solutions which are deployed on this tenant, are also deployed on other tenants. It also checks in which version they are. If any of them are deployed in higher version it displays previously mentioned warning. The purpose of this warning pop up is to help partners proactively avoid solution mismatch across tenants.-This is also explained in the below blog, which provides detailed information about SAP system architecture and the deployment landscape.-https://blogs.sap.com/2015/08/27/sap-cloud-applications-studio-deployment-landscape-basics/-In this case if you have attempted to deploy lower version of solution, where this solution has been deployed in higher version on some other tenant already, deployment will not be allowed.-Resolution-You need to deploy the higher version of the solution on tenant, where you face this error message. This way this add-on will be now distributed across tenants in same versions.-See Also-SAP tenant landscape-Keywords-failed, PDI, SDK, fail

Title: Error Message "Error during download of file; report an case" While Trying to Download the Migrated XML file
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User had migrated the records using Migration Template and records are successfully migrated. Now, when the user try to download that file, system throws below error message:-Error during download of file; report an case-Resolution-The file meta data from the backend table is missing. So, we can not download or recover this information.-To verify whether the file is in the backend,-Check using the report ADMCONT_DOWNL_EXCEL_FILE in SE38. If the file is listed, you can just select the file to download it.-You can also check in DMC_PERSISTENCE table whether the file is in the backend or not.

Title: Error: 'Combination of Bank and Account Number With Different Company Exists'
Content: Symptom-When you try to add a Bank Account to multiple companies, system throws below error message:-'Combination of bank, account number XYZ with different company exists'-(XYZ represents the account number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to My Bankssubview.-Select your Bank and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Select sub tab Bank Accounts.-Click Add Row button.-Fill in all the details and click Save.-The system gives an error: 'Combination of bank, account number XYZ with different company exists.'-Cause-You are getting the error message as the Bank Account should be unique and you are entering same Bank Account ID in the new Bank Account.-The Bank Account ID is a key and should be unique. The Bank Account ID is used as a short cut in payment transactions to identify the Bank Account.-Resolution-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to My Bankssubview.-Select your Bank and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Select sub tab Bank Accounts.-Click Add Row button.-Enter a different Bank Account ID under Accounts tab.-Now you should be able to create new Bank Account by maintaining the unique Bank Account ID.-  Keywords-Account Number, Bank statement, Bank Account, Company, Combination.

Title: RBAM Error Messages On a Custom Work Center View Created By PDI
Content: Symptom-You can see RBAM error messages after adding the Embedded Component (EC) to a Custom WCview.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer -SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAB Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Frontend system.-Open Custom Workcenter.-Open Custom Workcenter View.-You can see following error:-RBAM: No authorization for '    ' <default> on BO/Instance '    '<default>  'YXYZOOOO_ZSOOOOOO'<default> in context ''-RBAM: Skip operation ' Action/Interface <default> '    ' on 'BONodeProxy <default>  'YXYZOOOO_ZSOOOOOO'<default>  ROOT4F9B.....'-Cause-This error occurs when the embedded component is directly added to WCview and there is no dependeny between WCview and embedded component.-Resolution-You need to set the parent dependency to 'No' for custom embedded component to resolve this error messages.-Below are the steps --Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open PDI Solution (e.g. YXYZOOOO).-Open Affected Custom Embedded Component in UI Designer.-Click on Edit Mode.-Change the 'Parent Dependency' property to 'No' Under Configuration.-Click on Save and Activate.- Keywords-RBAM, PDI Solution, Custom Error Messages, <default>, No authorization, RBAM: Skip operation, EC, Embedded Component, C4C, BYD, SDK, UI Designer-rbam error,custom view

Title: Error Message "Service Call Failed; Report an case" While Migrating Bill of Operations
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Bill of Operations, system throws below error message:-"Service Call Failed; Report an case"-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and search for activity Migration of Bills of Operations.-Open with migration tool and Execute the file step by step. You receive the above error at Simulation step-Cause-The cause for could be that the migration template has been filled wrongly.-You might have entered Start and End (which are technically Markers) as Operations under the Operations Details sheet in the Operation ID Column.--The system considers that as Operation ID and proceeds further but it gets no further corresponding Activity ID under the sheet Activity Details for Start and End. Hence the system throws the error.-Resolution-The system will generate the Start and End Mark by default, so you should leave these fields empty.-Keywords-migration, bill of operations, service call failed, error

Title: Error Message: 'Payment Direction Differs From Balance Of Open Items; Amount Set To Zero'
Content: Symptom-Error Message: 'Payment direction differs from balance of open items; amount set to zero' while trying to clear down payment with a payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts sub view.-Select All Suppliers.-Choose Supplier Account Monitor: XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier account) and click View.-Now select Trade Payables tab and Invoices/Payments sub-tab.-Select the row of a Down Payment which has no Clearing ID assigned.-Click Pay Manually By -> Outgoing Check.-Click Post button and the error message is displayed: 'Payment direction differs from balance of open items; amount set to zero'.-Cause-You cannot clear a down payment with a payment under the open items.-Resolution-Once you create a down payment request, then you can clear this request with payment.-It will create a new down payment in status open which should further be cleared with an invoice.-Keywords-Payment direction differs from balance of open items, amount set to zero while trying to clear down payment with a payment, down payment

Title: Extension Field not Saving
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Extension field value is getting vanished on save.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer work center (as example).-Click on Accounts view.-Open any accounts.-Enter any value in extension field XYZ.-Click on Save, data is vanished in field XYZ.-Cause-This could be happening because the field value is being overwritten with some PDI logic from ABSL scripts.-Resolution-You can verify this with below steps:-Goto system backend and enter transaction SE38.-Enter report RP_PDI_SEARCH_ALL.-Execute or F8.-In search, enter the ESR name which can be found in /n/ext/field transaction for respective extension field as below.-Check Search in Enabled PDI option.-Execute.-If the field is used by any PDI, you will see this highlighted in green color.-NOTE: This report will highlight the usage of any field in PDI, so this means that you need to check the file type before taking further assumptions. If the field is being manipulated by any PDI ABSL script, you need to look for a file path whose extension is .absl-Keywords-Extension, field, PDI logic, Extension field dissapeared, value not saved, Extension scenario not working, data not saved

Title: How to Withdraw Purchase Order from Approval from Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You see a purchase order is in status In Approval while there is currently no approval task available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search purchase order ABC (ABC refers to purchase order ID)-You see it is in status In Approval-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Tasks Management view-Search All Items with purchase order ID: ABC-You see there is no open approval tasks for the purchase order -Cause-There is inconsistency.-Resolution-When customer cannot withdraw the purchase order from approval in frontend and asks SAP perform from backend, you can perform below steps.-Access Backend T-code SESFTS-Load Purchase Order BO:-For Purchase Order HEADER approval, use BO: /SRMAP/LPURX_PO -For Purchase Order ITEM approval, use BO:/SRMAP/LPURX_TPO -Select the arrow to the right of the folder icon-Select ‘Load by Query'-Select ‘Root – QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS’-Enter PO ID in the ‘ID/content’ row and select Continue-Check that the Po status is set to 2 (2 = In Approval) -Select the ‘Actions’ button-Select WITHDRAW_FROM_APPROVAL and save (ctrl+s)-After withdrawing from approval, go to frontend and refresh the purchase order. The PO status will be changed to state before approval.-Now customers can perform follow-up actions from frontend accordingly. -Keywords-Purchase Order Approval, Withdraw From Approval, No Approval Task, Cannot Approve

Title: Supplier Access Restrictions by Company is Not Working
Content: Symptom-You configured access restrictions for the Supplier Base work center for a specific company; however, the user can still view all suppliers or when creating a new supplier invoice, the user can view all suppliers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Restricting access:-Navigate to the "Application and User Management" work center.-Open the "Business Users" view.-Select the desired user and click "Edit" -> "Access Rights."-Proceed to the "Access Restrictions" tab.-Choose the Work Center View ID 'BPM_SUPPLIERS.'-Set the Read/Write Access to "Restricted" and select the appropriate Access Group ID under Detailed Restrictions.-Save your changes.-User accessing Suppliers:-Navigate to the "Supplier Base" work center.-Open the "Suppliers" view.-Currently, users can view all suppliers without any restrictions.-Open any supplier profile.-Proceed to the "Financials" tab.-Notice that Payment Data is displayed only for the company for which access was granted.-If the user has write access and selects "View All," they can only add payment data for the company they have write access to.-Cause-There is currently no direct link between the supplier and the company. The company information in the supplier master data is exclusively accessible under the financial data tab. Consequently, restrictions are limited to payment data only.-To observe this, navigate to the Payables work center and access the Supplier Accounts view. Similarly, due to this setup, it's not feasible to restrict suppliers in supplier invoices or purchase orders-Resolution-As this feature is currently unavailable in the system, we encourage you to post your request on the Customer Influence Forum or we suggest reaching out to your partners for assistance in its development.-See Also-2913832 - Supplier Invoice Access Restriction by Company is Not Working-Keywords-Supplier, Access Restriction, Company, Payment Data

Title: In the New Manual Invoice Request, the Account Assignment Type as SLS -Sales Order is Missing
Content: Symptom-In the New Manual Invoice Request, the Account Assignment Type as is SLS -Sales Order is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the current project and click on the button Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune section and search with the activity name Account Assignment Types.-Open Account Assignment Types and in the Account Assignment Types screen click on Maintain Account Assignment Types.-Select the record for Account Assignment Type as SLS - Sales Order and under Details section below go to the subtab Assignment to Business Transaction.-Here you can see the Business Transaction as 29 - Invoice Request is maintain.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-From the Common Task select the New Manual Invoice.-In the New Manual Invoice screen maintain all mandatory details and click on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and add product.-Go to Details section of the product below and the subtab Revenue Assignment.-In the field Account Assignment Type select the drop-down option.-You will see the Account Assignment Type as SLS - Sales Order is not listed here, although you maintain it in Fine-Tune activity.- Cause-In case of the Manual Invoice Request , the following Account Assignment Types are not allowed even if maintain in the Business Configuration ->Fine-Tune activity. They are :--CC - Cost Center.-CUST - Customer Contract.-IMAT - Individual Material.-SLS -Sales Order.-SRV - Service Order.-ICC - Intercompany.-This also applies to an External Customer Invoice Request created via the web service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.- Keywords-AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode; Revenue Assignment; Account Assignment Types; Invoice Request;  AccountingCodingBlock;

Title: Remove Bank Account Assigned To a Company
Content: Symptom-You want to remove a bank account which was wrongly assigned to a company in the system-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Workcenter.-Select My Banks under Master Data.-Select the bank account XYZ (XYZ represents the bank account) which was wrong assigned.-Here we do not find an option to remove it.-Cause-We cannot remove a "Bank Account" as the "bank account ID" which is saved cannot be changed as it has a unique key-Resolution-Go to Liquidity Management Workcenter.-Select My Banks under Master Data.-Select the bank account XYZ.-Select Actions Tab.-Click Close.-If the incorrect bank account could be closed; then system will be allowed to create a New Bank account with the same Bank Account Id.-After this, you can create a new record for the company and system will allow you to save it.-Keywords-Remove, Bank Account, Assigned To, Company, Wrong.

Title: Guidelines for Cloud Applications Studio Expert Chat
Content: Symptom-How to use Expert Chat for Cloud Applications Studio.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-When to use Expert Chat for Cloud Applications Studio:-You need a quick clarification on a specific Cloud Applications Studio error.-You have searched for KBAs on a technical/functional Cloud Applications Studio error and could not find a resolution. If the issue requires back end access, the expert will convert the chat to an incident.-When to use other Support Channels for Cloud Applications Studio:-If you want a detailed explanation about specific Cloud Applications Studio behavior, please use the Schedule an Expert channel.-If you have a consulting query, please use the SAP Community Questions & Answers. Title: Exception "An error occurred. Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case." While Terminating an Employee in Personnel Administration
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to terminate an employee in Personnel Administration. Upon trying to terminate the employee, system throws an exception:-An error occurred. Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case.-500 SAP Internal Server Error-Error: The application running deliberately caused an abort with short dump. (termination: RABAX_STATE)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Select Country XYZ (where XYZ represents the Country)-Select the link Terminate Relationship with Employee-In the Employee field, select Value Help and find Employee ID-Select the Last Working Day DD.MM.YYYY-Choose the Termination Category-Choose the Termination Reason-Select Save-System throws an exception-Cause-There is inconsistent data for Time Agreement.-Resolution-To solve the inconsistencies in Time Agreement, run the day closure for the employee.-Go to Time administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-In Time Valuations section, select the link Run Day Closure for One Employee-Select the Employee from the value help-Select the checkbox for Start Time Valuation-Select Run-In the Valuation Start Date field, provide the Time Profile Start Date of the Employee-After executing above task, you will be able to terminate the employee.-Keywords-Correction Run, Valuation Run, Terminate Employee, Personnel Administration, An error occurred, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, Exception, Run Day Closure

Title: PDF's stuck under status "In Process" or "Error" in Invoice Scanning".
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded some PDF's in the Invoice Scanning View, however the upload failed and the status will either be "In Process" or "Error Occurred while Processing the PDF", even after a lengthy amount of time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Work Center Supplier Invoicing -Invoice Scanning View-Click Upload and add the PDF's files-Start the Process-or-You are using an external application to upload multiple PDF at once.-Cause-One of the common cause of this issue is the volume of PDF you have uploaded at once.-Resolution-Please reduce the volume of PDF's you normally upload at once until the mentioned issue does not occur anymore.-Keywords-"PDF"; "Invoice Scanning"; "Error Occurred while Processing the PDF"; "Supplier Invoices"; "Upload"

Title: Valuation Parameters For Fixed Asset Missing in General tab
Content: Symptom-You notice that there are no Valuation Parameters, such as  Capitalization Date, Useful Life etc., maintained in the General tab of Fixed Asset XYZ (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select Fixed Asset XYZ.-Press Edit - General.-On the General Tab there is no information displayed in Valuation Parameters section.-Cause-The Fixed Asset's validation start date is in the future. Therefore the information is not displayed. This is expected system behavior.-Resolution-You can only view data in the Valuation Parameters section if it is valid on Today's date.-To check the validation date, meaning the start date of the Fixed Asset's Cost center assignment please follow the below steps:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select Fixed Asset XYZ.-Press Edit.-Go to the Master Data tab.-Under All Assignments Intervals the start date of the cost center assignment is maintained.-If the assignment start date is in the future the data will not be displayed until that date.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Valuation Parameters, empty, Data missing

Title: Error Revenue Recognition Run - Revenue Accounting Contract Missing - Item Category Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-In the Revenue Recognition run application log you notice the error message 'Revenue Accounting Contract Missing' appearing for some Customer Contract items.-You might notice other errors, such as "Cannot determine G/L account; item category missing"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Select the Revenue recognition view. -Search for the relevant run and open the application log. -Navigate to the Messages tab or the Processed with Errors tab. -Cause-The revenue accounting contract(RAC) or a specific POB of the RAC did not get mapped to the respectice sales document item in Accounting:-Navigate to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Select the Sales Document Items view and select either Sales Order Items or Customer Contract Items. depending on which item is affected. -Search for the relevant item. You notice the Revenue Accounting Contract (RAC) column is empty even though the RAC functionality is active.-Resolution-Due to a technical issue, the RAC column is not mapped from the sales document item to accounting.
