The respective XI messages fail:-Open STFK and go to the SRT_Moni transaction.-Select 'Business Object Selection' and enter-BO Proxy Name: REVENUE_ASPECT_OF_SSD-BO Query: ROOT - Query_BY_ELEMENTS-BO Element: ID-CONTENT-BO Identifier: Enter the RAC ID  associated with the customer contract (In the customer contract's General tab check the ID under Revenue Accounting Contract)-You can see numerous failed XI messages (Sender Party: CustomerRelationshipAuxiliariesProcessing; Receiver Interface Name: RevenueAspectOfSalesAndServiceDocumentAccountingIn)-Please forward this incident over to the CRM Application team to establish the connection of the customer contract and the RAC (Component: AP-SLO-SO for sales order items, AP-CCP-CC for customer contract items)-Once the CRM team corrected the connection-check if the RAC ID now appears in the Revenue Accounting Contract column of the Sales Document Items view. -You can now reconcile the RAC's XI messages, either through the above path. -Or you can use the APCRM_TRIGGER_RECON_OB report: -Go to transaction /nSE38.-In the Program field enter APCRM_TRIGGER_RECON_OB and press Execute.-In the ID field enter the RAC ID. -Under Base Business Transaction Document Type select Revenue Accounting Contract. -Under Service Interface Operation select Notify Accounting.-Press Execute. -Once all messages are reconciled open the RAC in the UI and check if all POBs of the RAC are connected to a sales document item:-From the Sales Document Items view enter the RAC. -Expand all POBs and verify that they are all connected to a sales document item. -Keywords-Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting Contract missing, POB Sales Document connection missing, Item Category missing

Title: SAP for Me Data Volume Management shows no data for Memory Disk usage, Memory Usage, SAP HANA Analysis
Content: Symptom- Case 1: HANA Memory Usage, HANA disk Usage & the tile Technical SAP HANA Analysis are showing "0" as a result as per screenshots below:-            Case 2: Accessing the DVM data searching by the relevent system ID in the SAP for Me, the following error occcurs :-   --      Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP for Me - Data Volume Management-Reproducing the Issue- Goto https://me.sap.com/dataoverview, no data is shown as "0" in HANA Memory Usage, HANA disk Usage & the tile Technical SAP HANA Analysis - Goto https://me.sap.com/dataoverview, search by the system ID & the following error information is displayed:-Error : Direct access failed-The combination of system, client, and date cannot be found-Redirecting to last used (or default) set-Cause-Case 1: The cause of the issue in the managed system, tcode DBACOCKPIT, the configured database user does not the sufficent privilage in the database-Case 2: The related DVM notes are not implemented completely-Resolution-Case 1: The database user needs to have the role SAP_INTERNAL_HANA_SUPPORT granted, in order to call different HANA monitoring & system views. Please refer Predefined Database (Catalog) Roles-Grant role as per this statement : GRANT SAP_INTERNAL_HANA_SUPPORT TO <USER_NAME>;-Please refer to the following GRANT Statement (Access Control)-Case 2 : In the Managed System run the report RTCCTOOL in SE38 with selection for DVM notes. Implement any related DVM notes-See Also-1969700 - SQL Statement Collection for SAP HANA -> Problem 258: insufficient privilege: Not authorized-Predefined Database (Catalog) Roles-GRANT Statement (Access Control)-2698930 - No Data is visible when using the DVM Cloud application - Authorisations-Keywords-DVM cloud, access, sapnet, rtcctool, client date, SAP_INTERNAL_HANA_SUPPORT, refresh, dvm, notes

Title: Cash Discount Box in Invoice Request Not Ticked Automatically
Content: Symptom-You create a Sales Order with Payment Terms containing a cash discount. In the follow up Invoice Request the checkbox for Cash Discount is not ticked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new Sales Order AAA (AAA represents the Sales Order ID).-Select Payment Terms with Cash Discount.-Navigate to the Items Tab.-Add Product ABC (ABC represents the Product ID).-Release the Sales Order.-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing Workcenter, Invoice Requests View.-Open Invoice Request AAA.-Navigate to the Items Tab.-The checkbox Cash Discount for Product ABC is not ticked.-Cause-In the product master data there is a checkbox Cash Discount Allowed, which determines if the checkbox is automatically ticked in Invoice Requests.-Once this box is ticked for respective Sales Organisation, the created Invoice Request is automatically ticked checkboxes Cash Discount.-Resolution-Open the product master data for Product ABC.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Select the respective Sales Organisation used.-In the General Subtab, there is a checkbox Cash Discount Allowed.-Check this Box.-Now this product always creates a ticked checkbox in Invoice Requests. You need to activate the checkbox for each Sales Organisation used.-Keywords-Skonto zulässig, Zahlungsbedingungen, Rechnungsanforderung, Ankreuzfeld, Cash Discount Allowed, Payment Terms, Invoice Request, checkbox

Title: System Dumps When You Try to Upload a Bank Payment Advice.
Content: Symptom-You try to upload a bank payment advice. However, when you click the button "Start file Upload" the system gets a dump error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management workcenter.-File Management view.-Inbound file subview.-Click the New button and select Inbound File from drop-down selection.-Under the Attachments section select the bank payment advice file and click the "Start File Upload" button.-The system produces a dump error.-Cause-The bank advice payment file date format is maintained as YY.MM.DD. The pertinent system specification for the bank advice payment file date format however is YYYY.MM.DD.-Resolution-To overcome this situation, you must maintain the bank advice payment file date format as YYYY.MM.DD and upload the file.-Keywords-Dump, Upload, Bank Payment Advice, File.

Title: Update of Opportunity Status is not Possible
Content: Symptom-You are using the web service ManageOpportunityIn to update the status of an Opportunity, however the LifeCycleStatusCode is not getting updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Service Explorer view.-Search for the ManageOpportunityIn.-Download the WSLD (Web Services Description Language).-Populate the structure with the expected information.-Execute the payload service.-Error: RBAM: No authorization for 'Operation http://sap.com/xi/A1S/Global MaintainBundle' on 'ServiceInterface http://sap.com/xi/A1S/Gl-Cause-You are not able to update the status of an Opportunity via web service as the LifeCycleStatusCode tag is not supported for the service ManageOpportunityIn.-The status of an Opportunity can only be updated manually in the UI (User Interface) by using the Change Status button.-  Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-An alternative option would be by creating ODATA service for Opportunity and using the action OpportunityProcess which uses the BO Query Process to change the status from Open to In Process. A sample ODATA url to change the status is: https://{{TenantHostname}}/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/khopportunity/Process?ObjectID='{{OpportunityObjectID}}'-Keywords-ManageOpportunityIn, Web Service, LifeCycleStatusCode, A2X, Update, Opportunity, RBAM

Title: Exception (Dump) When Sending Order Confirmation to Account
Content: Symptom-You receive a system exception (dump) when performing the action of sending the Sales Order confirmation to account.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Choose Edit.-Choose Submit.-Select Send Order Confirmation to Account.-System is showing dump. - Also, checking the scope, you can see that the required question 'Do you want to receive sales orders electronically from your customers using Electronic Data Exchange?' is scoped.-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Open the Implementation Projects view.-Highlight the relevant Implementation Project.-Choose Edit Project Scope button. -Navigate to Step 4 (Questions).-Expand "Sales" and then "Selling Products and Services".-Select Option "Communication for Selling Products and Services".-Question 'Do you want to receive sales orders electronically from your customers using Electronic Data Exchange?' is already checked/scoped.-Cause-Under the Communication Arrangement, user have changed the Application Protocol of the communication scenario linked to the business partner used in the Sales Order from XI to HTTPS.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Please change the application protocol to XI.-In this example, we will use business partner XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the business partner used in the Sales Order).-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Communication Arrangements view.-Search for the scenario linked to the business partner XYZ.-Choose Edit.-Navigate to the Technical Data tab.-Change the Application Protocol to XI.-Choose Save and Reactivate.-Now the inconsistency will no longer occur.-Keywords-Application Protocol, Communication Arrangement, Sales Order, Submit, Send Order Confirmation to Account, Dump, Exception

Title: Error: Upload Failed in SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a solution in your Development system(Source tenant) and you are trying to deploy the same solution in the Test or Production system(Target tenant). At this point you are facing an error: Upload Failed in SAP Cloud Application Studio.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Log on to SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Created a solution in Source tenant with Version 1505-Deploy the same Solution in Target tenant with Version 1502-Here you can see the error message: Upload Failed-Cause-The error occurs because the Source tenant is with version X and you are trying to deploy the solution in Target tenant with version X-1. Please note that the Version of both - Source tenant and Target tenant should be same then only system will allow you to deploy the solution.-Resolution-Please check the date when the Target tenant will be upgraded to 1505 and according to the date ask customer to deploy the solution.-See Also-For further information you can refer:-2096859 - Import of Solutions in New Release

Title: Not able to send Case to Provider (Action Field missing)
Content: Symptom-Not able to send case to Provider.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to system-Go to Application User And Management Work Center-Go to Case View-Select the Case and click on Edit-In action field, 'Send to Provider' is missing (Action field have only 'Complete' option)-Cause-Requester himself is also a key user.-The Case raised by key user has been picked up by another key user.-Resolution-Please understand that in the Application and User Management, Case view is meant for key users to pickup and process cases.-When case is put back to requester action , the reply has to be send from the following below steps :-Go to Help center-Click on Track my cases-Select the case and click on case ID-Add a note and click on Submit-Once the above actions are completed, Status will change to 'In Process' for key user and 'Send to Provider' option will be available.-Please perform the following actions to send the case to Service Provider:-Go to Application And User Management Work Center-Go to Case View-Select the Case and click on Edit-In action field, select 'Send to Provider'-Click on Add and select Note for Provider below-Click on Save-Keywords-Send case to SAP, Action Field is missing, can not send case to SAP

Title: Error : Service call failed; report an case, during migration of Time and Labour Management
Content: Symptom-During Migration of Time and Labour Management, you got the error "Service call failed; report an case"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration -> Overview-Open the Activity Migration of Employee Data - Non Localized Countries/Regions  -Inside the activity, Open the link Migrate time and labor management data using the migration tool-In the next screen, Upload the file and then execute the Migration Step by Step-You will get an errror in the Simulation Import step-Cause-One issue might be that you have added a minimum balance limit to a statistical account. Statistical accounts are only for statistical purposes and therefore should not have a minimum balance limit.-Resolution-Remove the Minimum balance Limit or Change the Accout Category in the Time Accounts Activity.-Steps :-Go to Business configuration and then Overview-In the Acitivity Lists, Open Time Accounts - International -> Time Account Types-In the next screen, Choose the relevant time type and then do the changes accordingly.-Keywords-Time and Labour, Migration, Employee Data, Time Account

Title: Production Bug Fix Feature is not Available in Test Tenant
Content: Symptom-You observe that Production Bug Fix feature(PBF) is not available in your one test tenant, wherein this is available in another test tenant.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-Requisites:--The work center view Production Fix Authorization is already assigned to studio developer.-Ensure the solution is under the Deployed status.-The solution is scoped in Business Configuration.-Steps to Reproduce:--Login to SDK.-Open the deployed solution.-You will see that the option for Open Correction is missing in the solution explorer.-Cause-Production Bug Fix feature will be available only in Pre-Production and Production tenants. Even though it will show as test tenant in SDK, the tenant type should be of Pre-Production for this to be available.-The system logic will always check the role of the tenant before deciding what features to enable and will not enable the PBF functionality in any tenant other than a productive or Preproductive tenant. So this depends on the below 2 factors for a test tenant:--Tenant Type: Test (Role Code: 7)-System Purpose : Pre-Production(System Purpose : 03)-System Purpose will be defined based on the change project in your system. For example, If the change project is a remote, then the system purpose will be test(not pre-production) and the PBF functionality will not be enabled.-Resolution-Your tenant cannot be used for both remote change projects (test tenants) and production bug fixes (productive/Preproductive tenants). Hence you can either change the system purpose to pre-production based on your requirements or not to use the PBF functionality in this particular tenant.-See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2019/11/14/working-with-partner-solutions-during-upgrade-and-associated-errors/-Keywords-Production Bug feature not available-Bug Fix feature is not visible-Open Correction button is not visible-Close correction is not visible-PBF functionality missing-PBF functionality is not working as expected-Tenant role affecting PBF functionality, System purpose impacting PBF availability-PBF functionality, bug fix is not available in test tenant, Open correction button is not visible, fix correction not working

Title: "Communication Error; Create an Case on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS Component" When Accessing Service Control Center
Content: Symptom-You notice that no details are shown when accessing any of the views in the Service Control Center work center. Error message "Communication Error; create an case on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS component" is also raised.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to your tenant.-Click the Service Control Center work center.-Navigate to any of the work center views under the Service Control Center work center. -Error message "Communication Error; create an case on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS component" is raised and no details are loaded.-Cause-This error is raised whenever the Service Control Center work center is accessed while an SAP internal system upgrade is in progress.-Resolution-As soon as the SAP internal system upgrade is completed, access to the Service Control Center work center views will be normalized-Keywords-Communication Error, create an case on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS component, upgrade, maintenance, not able to see active systems, not able to see contact details-not able to see active systems,not able to see contact details,communication error,contact srd-cc-ci-ccs,create an incident on the srd-cc-ci-ccs

Title: Unable To Add Note While Creating Case
Content: Symptom-Unable to add note in the case.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer and SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application User And Management Work Center-2. Click on cases Sub View-3. Select the case and Click on Edit-4. Add a note in the case-5. Save Button is greyed out.-Cause-User is assigned to Application and User Management work center and cases View, however write access for the cases is either Restricted or No Access.-Save button in the case Edit oval is greyed out.-Resolution-In order to change the write access rights for the cases follow the below step-1. Go to Application User And Management Work Center-2. Go to Business Roles sub view under User and Access Management view-3. Select the Role which is assigned to you and click on Edit-4. Go to Access Restrictions tab-5. Filter the work center view name as case-6. Change the Write Access to Unrestricted-7. Click on Save-Keywords-Note in case, Write note in case, Send case to SAP with Note.

Title: How are Postings Related to Production Confirmations Done When Services are Involved
Content: Symptom-You are comparing Production Confirmations ABC and XYZ and you observe that the G/L Accounts taken into consideration for posting are different.-You want to understand why there was a difference in G/L Accounts taken into consideration during posting of Production Confirmations.-ABC means Production Confirmation ID.-XYZ means Production Confirmation ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Go to Journal Entries sub view.-Show All Postings and Find Documents XYZ and ABC.-When you check the Journal Entries related to Production Confirmations ABC and XYZ, the differences in G/L Accounts could be seen.-Cause-Differences in G/L Accounts are because of missing Service in one of the Journal Entries related to Production Confirmation.-Resolution-Journal Entry related to Production Confirmation ABC contains Service and in case of Production Confirmation XYZ there is no Service.-Since there is no Service taken into consideration in Production Confirmation XYZ  the Account Determination for Account Determination Group for Services which is blank will be taken into consideration.-In case of Production Confirmation ABC, the Account Determination will happen according to the Account Determination Group maintained in the Valuation view of Service/Material Master Data. Hence, the G/L Account differs.-You can check the G/L Account Determination by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and click Open Activity List.-Go to Fine Tune Activity and Show All Activities.-Find Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Go to Account Determination and then go to Costs.-Go to Service tab.-You can check the G/L Accounts assigned for Credit and Debit for Internal Services according to Account Determination Group for Services.-Keywords- production confirmation; service; journal entry

Title: How to find Case in Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-How to find case in Business ByDesign system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To find case which are created in system can be found by following below steps :-1. Login to Business ByDesign-2. Go to Application User and Management work center-3. Select cases view-4. Select case ID OR In Show Select All cases-Second way to Track your case is found by following below steps :-1. Login to Business ByDesign-2. Go to Help Center-3. Click on Track My cases-4. It will diplay open cases OR you can find case by inserting case ID in Find and Click on Go-Note : This will only show the user cases who logged in to the system-Third way to Track your case is found by following below steps :-1. Login to Business ByDesign-2. Go to Home Work Center-3. Under Self Services View click on My Requests-4. It will Show All open cases which is created by you(Logged in User)-Note : This will only show the user cases who logged in to the system-Keywords-Cases in ByDesign, Find cases in ByDesign, Track my cases, My Requests.

Title: How to Check Retention Period of Form Templates
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This document shows how to check retention period of SAP delivered form templates.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The retention period is assigned to each Form Template Group.-Over the retention period, it is not possible to view output history of the documents, which uses the template for output.-Resolution-First, you need to get the template group information of the form template.-Go to Application and User Management work center and Form Template Maintenance view.-Click on Advance filter, find the Template Group of the required form template with the help of Template Group.-After filtering it, it will display the Group Code templates.-Let's take the exmpale of Remittance Advice. (All screenshots below are taken from our Internal Replication and Analysis tenants.)-Now, you can get the retention period of the form group in backend.-Use transaction code SE16 to check table - /DOC/I_OM_HIS.-Input the form template group ID, you can get the retention period.-Keywords-Form Template, Retention Period

Title: The Diagnostics Agent does not stay assigned in the Managed System Configuration
Content: Symptom-During the Managed System Configuration, in the step 'Assign Diagnostics Agent', the Agent is correctly assigned. However, if you go back to the Assign Agent step, the Agent appears unassigned.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Start the Managed System Configuration for a system-Go to step ‘Assign Diagnostic Agent’-Assign the Agent to the server-Left the ‘Assign Diagnostic Agent’ screen-Go back to the ‘Assign Diagnostic Agent’ step. The Agent will appear unassigned-Cause-Old entries in the Agent Administration page are causing this erroneous behavior.-Resolution-To fix the issue, follow the steps described in the topic "Automatically Remove the Zombie Entries" from the Wiki below:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SUPPORT_CONTENT/techops/3821554842.html?q=Automatically%20Remove%20the%20Zombie%20Entries-See Also-2385361 - How to connect Diagnostics Agent to Solution Manager 7.2 system-Keywords-connected, assigned, unassigned, disconnected, servername, missing, SMDAgent, solman_setup

Title: Restrict Tenant Access by IP address in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You are trying to restrict the tenant access by IP address in a multi-customer system, therefore limiting the access to your SAP Business ByDesign system to only a few users. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-Tenant Access restriction by IP address is IP Specific and not User Specific.-Resolution-In SAP Business ByDesign it is possible to restrict tenant access by IP address for Single Customer System (Private Cloud) but it is not feasible to implement the IP address restriction if the tenant is currently located in a multi-customer system(Public cloud)-Keywords-IP address, restriction, access, byd

Title: Value of Time Recording Cannot Be Updated after Project Type Changed
Content: Symptom-You had created a specific project type XXX in business configuration, and its indicator Mandatory Approval of Time Recording is marked. Then you changed the project type from others to A for an existing project, you found that the value of Time Recording could not be updated automatically as per the setting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Navigate to Overview View.-Search for Project Types.-Choose Open button, then you would find that the indicator Mandatory Approval of Time Recording is marked for project type XXX.-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Navigate to Project View.-Select the project YYY you wish.-Choose Edit button.-Go to Project Plan> Gantt Chart> Basic Data Subtab.-Change Project Type to XXX, then you found that the value of Time Recording could not be updated automatically.-Cause-The change/update of "Project Type" will not update or change of or fill Confirmation Approval Indicator and Time Confirmation Profile Code. This filling Confirmation Approval Indicator and Time Confirmation Profile Code and fill Default work unit from Business Configuration. Execute this, only if project type was set for the first time.-This is a standard behavior of the system; it is designed in that way.-Resolution-You have to take manual action here to change the field value.-Keywords-Project Type, Mandatory,  Approval, Time Recording, Indicator.

Title: Renewal of SAP Passport CA certificate - SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-User wants to renew the SAP Passport CA Certificate or User received an email from SAP to renew the SAP Passport CA Certificate.-This KBA is to give additional insights about this renewal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Help Center Documentation-Each SAP Business ByDesign tenant is provisioned with a tenant certificate issued by the SAP Passport CA. The validity period of the tenant certificate is 1 year. For the functioning of the communications relying on the tenant certificate, it's mandatory to upload the valid certificate after renewal every year to the relevant target systems.-You can view the tenant certificate from Application and User Management -> Common Tasks -> Edit Certificate Trust List -> View Tenant Certificate.-You can download the tenant certificate from Application and User Management -> Communication Certificates -> Download Tenant Certificate.-For more details, refer to the documentation Renewal of Tenant Certificate-Blog-To know the changes & impacts, actions and details in terms of Integration, refer to the blog Renewal of Tenant Certificate-This blog also has a FAQ which clarifies questions around this topic.-Overview-What is Single Sign-On with SAP Passports?-Refer to the detailed documentation -KBA-KBA 3336913 - Tenant Certificate Details in SAP Business ByDesign-KBA 3366283 - System throws Error Message 'Certificate already exists'-Email Communication-If you receive an Email from SAP to renew the SAP CA Certificate, then follow the below instructions:-Immediate action Required:-In case you have configured direct trust to the current SAP Passport CA G2, the new SAP Passport CA G2 certificate with the extended validity date must be added in to your trust list to avoid any disruptions in the integrations.-Download Section-Download the New SAP Passport CA Certificate here-Download the SAP Cloud Root CA certificate here--Please download the following ROOT and Intermediate certificates and import in the relevant trust lists-SAP Passport CA G2-SAP Cloud Root CA-In case you have configured certificate mapping to the exact Tenant/M-user certificate of ByD (certificate pinning) you need to map to the renewed Tenant/M-user certificate of ByD tenant after it is available.-Notes:-A) In case you have configured trust to the SAP Cloud Root CA no action is needed.-B) In case you have configured certificate mapping based on Subject and Issuer string no action is needed.-These changes relate to all BYD customers.-If you did not use this certificate anywhere in your communication arrangements for outbound communication, then no action required.-Additional Q&A-1. Do we also need to update the communication arrangements with the external systems?-You need to adjust your communication arrangements with the external systems after you receiving communication from SAP that switch is done on your instance since the old certificate will be invalid after the renewal. Actions mentioned in the blog need to be taken every time of your certification renewal.-2. Do ByD Evaluate a user/CA is set to a specific Outbound/Inbound process?-Currently the ByD does not have this functionality to evaluate if an user/CA is set to a specific Outbound/Inbound process, this is not available in the UI. Post your requirement in the SAP Customer Influence Site: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-3. What to do if we used any 3rd party integration with SAP Passport CA G2?-Go ahead and download the latest passport CA G2 from given link in communication and replace from your end.-4. The validity of the Passport CA G2 trust certificate for both Test and Production environments was initially communicated as extended until 30 Dec 2026. Later, additional updates suggested that this validity could be extended to 30 Dec 2027.-Why are there two different expiry dates (30‑Dec‑2026 vs. 30‑Dec‑2027)?-This difference is expected and normal.-30‑Dec‑2027 → SAP Passport CA G2 intermediate (issuing) certificate -30‑Dec‑2026 → tenant-Level (end-entity) -These belong to different layers of the chain:-Root CA → SAP Passport CA G2 (Intermediate CA) → Tenant Certificate-Intermediate CA certificates always outlive the tenant certificates they issue.-So the difference in expiry dates is fully expected and not a system issue.-5. Will both Tenant certificate and SAP Passport CA G2 intermediate certificate renew automatically?-Tenant certificate:-Yes. It renews automatically via SAP's background job process before expiry and No customer action is needed.-SAP Passport CA G2 intermediate certificate:-Managed centrally by SAP and No tenant-level renewal is required. -6. Does the expiry variance require any action?-No, this variance is normal system behavior.-No tenant‑level and application‑level issues. No immediate renewal required.-The tenant certificate will auto‑renew before its expiration date.-7. Is any action required from Users?-Action is required only if your integrations directly trust (pin) the SAP Passport CA G2 certificate.-If you use certificate pinning:-Add the new SAP Passport CA G2 certificate (valid until 30‑Dec‑2027) into your trust store.-Do NOT remove the currently used certificate.-This ensures seamless validation during the transition.-Keywords-Renewal of SAP Passport CA certificate, chain, different expiry dates, trust, SAP Passport CA G2, tenant certificate, expired certificate

Title: Form Template selected for Down Payment Requests Is Not The Expected One.
Content: Symptom-The Form Template picked for Down Payment Invoices is not the expected one. You have assigned the form template in Collaboration tab of Account master data and the same template is used for down payment invoices also.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Down payment Request).-Click Edit.-Click Preview.-The form template selected is not the expected one-Cause-If you have maintained the form template in Collaboration tab for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo under the Account level, the system will consider the same form template for Down Payment Requests also. There is no possibility to maintain a separate form template for Down Payment requests in the system. -Resolution-This is the expect system behavior.-Keywords-Down payment request, form template, invoice, account, collaboration;

Title: Catalogue Upload Error: Language code English not supported; use ISO 639-1 codes only
Content: Symptom-User face error when uploading catalogues into system: Language code English not supported; use ISO 639-1 codes only-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Catalogs view.-Click Import button and upload the file.-System in processing the import and shows the result after some time.-The status changed from in process to failed.-View Import Log, you see the Application Log with result:  Language code EN not supported; use ISO 639-1 codes only.-Cause-As per 639 -1 code standard, the English code should be 'en' . However the code used in the file is 'EN', hence system block the uploading.-Resolution-Please change the code in the file from 'EN' to 'en', and the error shall be gone.-Keywords-Language code English not supported, Use ISO 639-1 codes only, Catalogs, Catalogue, Upload, Failed

Title: Error while searching a Supplier Invoice based on General Ledger "Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 10 characters, for example, 12345678900.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to search some Supplier Invoices (SIV) or Credit Memos (CM) based on a specific General Ledger (GL).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Work Center Supplier Invoicing -Invoices and Credit Memos view-Open the extended filter and search the General Ledger (in field G/L Account) 12345678900 (this number is an example).-Click Go: the mentioned error message shows up.-Cause-Under this view, the system will not be able to search any SIV or CM based on a GL account which contains more than 10 characters.-Also, when searching using the G/L Account field, the system will propose only the Account Determination Group for General Expenses (the GL Alias), and not the General Expense itself.-Resolution-Upon the creation of the Account Determination Group for General Expenses, no more than 10 characters should be used to avoid this issue.-You can alternatively use a report to search for SIV's or CM's based on a specific GL.-Keywords-"Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 10 characters, for example.."; "Supplier Invoicing  Invoices and Credit Memos " "General Ledger Account"; "Error"

Title: RBAM_ERROR when using custom Odata Service
Content: Symptom-When using custom Odata Service, after inputting all the necessary information and payload, the following error message happened if clicking post in postman. -{-"error": {-"code": "RBAM_ERROR",-"message": {-"lang": "en",-"value": "Not Authorized: Check Authorization Restriction for the User"-}-}-}-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Postman and give the Odata URL-Fill the authorization as well as the x-csrf-token-Fill the payload in the Body-Click Post-Cause-The work center view under Properties Tab is not maintained.-Resolution-Login the corresponding tenant-Go to Application and User Management -> Odata Service-Switch to Custom Odata Service-Select the issued Odata Service and click Edit-Choose the relate Node in the right table-Under Properties Tab, maintain field Work Center View-Keywords-RBAM_ERROR, POSTMAN, Custom Odata Service

Title: Liquidity Forecast run error - Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident
Content: Symptom-Liquidity Forecast run finished with the following error:-Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident--XYZ means the work package ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Liquidity Forecast runs-Search for affected run-Click on the Application Log ID link-Go to General tab-Under Summarizing messages click Expand All-The error is shown-Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident--Cause-The issue is occurring due to large amount of data being processed and lack of memory. Since Liquidity Forecast involves data being fetched from multiple sources or due payment management, tax management and etc., a large amount of data is processed.-One possible cause of the issue is a missing configuration in the Liquidity Forecast activity.-Resolution-Review and Configure the Liquidity Forecast activity. -Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Overview view-Search for the "Liquidity Forecast" activity and open it-Under "Review and Adapt Liquidity Profiles", here, you can define multiple profiles-Under "Define the companies that the forecast will capture the data of", here, you can define the companies that the forecast will capture data from -Save your changes-When performing a new Liquidity Forecast run, you can specify the Forecast profile, then, the run will consider only the companies that are assigned for the profile-If you have created multiple profiles, you need to run the Liquidity Forecast for each profile separately.-See Also-Help Documentation: Liquidity Forecast-Keywords-liquidity forecast, error, Work package ID system error report an incident

Title: Quantity conversion failed for material
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Following error occurs when you confirming production make task.-"Quantity conversion failed for material XXX----Quantity GRM is not defined----Conversion factor for quantity MASS not defined in Product definition-Save failed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for the task you wish.-Edit it.-Click on "Confirm".-Go to Input Products Subtab.-Fulfill the quantity as YY g for input product XXX.-Click on "Save", then the error would occur.-Cause-The issue is with the wrong type code maintained in the Production_lot Material Input Quantity.-It should be MASS but it is maintained at GRM.-Please refer to steps in internal memo for query the type code.-[Note: The steps in the internal memo are suitable for checking the error reporting of the same problem, even if the units in the error reporting are not the same.]-Resolution-Until knowing how to reproduce the issue, we need to handover the incident to the development team for correction.-See Also- 2694726 - Error: Conversion factor for quantity MASS not defined in Product definition; Action Failed.-Keywords-Quantity conversion failed for material, not defined, Conversion factor.

Title: Unable to filter a Production Model using an extension field.
Content: Symptom-Unable to filter a Production Model using an extension field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Production Order By Order Header view.-Select All Production Orders.-Go to column Production Model and filter by ABC (ABC means Production Model ID).-System doesn't find it and the following warning message is displayed: "The data cannot be displayed completely. Sorting and Filtering are not reliable since the number of hits is too large. Reduce the number of search hits by restricting the search criteria."-Cause-"The data cannot be displayed completely. Sorting and Filtering are not reliable since the number of hits is too large. Reduce the number of search hits by restricting the search criteria."-As the warning message says, the filtering might not work due to the amount of records that displays in this particular view.-To maintain system performance, list will show 10,000 records by default if a search parameter is not entered in the Search field.-Resolution-Filtering for this particular field is not working due to the amount of data is available for this screen.-However, if the steps below are followed, filtering will work properly:-Go to the Production Control work center and then Production Orders.-Show All Production Orders.-Open Advanced Search, icon nearby the Search field.-Maintain the Product ID as DEF (DEF means Product ID).-Click Go.-System will return records.-Perform the filter for the Production Model as ABC, for example.-System will return records with this Production Model.-Keywords-Production Model, Production Order, Extension Fields, Product

Title: Error "RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn READ' on instance" While Editing Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User is getting below error while editing employee -Error "RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn READ' on instance  'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' of 'BONodeProxy PERS_FILE_OIF_BE_ECO ROOT' in context 'UIApplication /SAP_BYDGLO_APPLICATION_UI/hcm/BE/PA/persfileoifbe.OIF.uicomponent Operation Start' "- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to employees view-Search for the affected employee-Open employee in edit mode-Error is thrown "RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn READ' on instance  'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' of 'BONodeProxy PERS_FILE_OIF_BE_ECO ROOT' in context 'UIApplication /SAP_BYDGLO_APPLICATION_UI/hcm/BE/PA/persfileoifbe.OIF.uicomponent Operation Start' "-Cause-Due to a sync issue, there are missing Access Control List (ACL) entries in the backend.-Resolution-Go to Backend-Enter T Code SE38-Enter the program "AP_PAD_ADJUST_ACL_ENTRIES"-Click on Execute-For check the list of users affected select the Check box "Execute in Test Mode(without Save)" -Select All Employees under Action to be executed for & Select the check box of Create for All Erroneous Employees under All Employees-7.Find the Employee ID in the list -Once you verify the above, where you see affected Employees ACL is missing, please follow the above steps again without selecting the check box "Execute in Test Mode" i.e. step 5.-See Also- 3345359 - Error "You are not authorized to access the data" while accessing the Employee Time profile from the Time Administration work center -Keywords-RBAM , ACL, Employee file, PERS_FILE_OIF_BE_ECO ROOT, Personnel administration , time administration, AP_PAD_ADJUST_ACL_ENTRIES, /SAP_BYDGLO_APPLICATION_UI/hcm/BE/PA/persfileoifbe.OIF.uicomponent

Title: Unable to Close Open Tasks Assigned to the Users Left the Organization
Content: Symptom-The notification task is being created for an user that is no longer in the company, however even though they forward this task and completed with another user, the task remains open in the Open Task on Purchase Orders view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Purchase Orders view-Filter for Open Tasks-See several task with the subject: Notification: Delivered Quantity Adjusted for Purchase Order ABC with Return to Supplier-Cause-Typically, this type of task is automatically assigned to the individual responsible for the Purchase Order.-Resolution-When the individual is no longer employed with the company, manual allocation of the task is necessary. It is the standard system behaviour and it is designed to function in this manner for such situations. -Keywords-Open Tasks, Purchase Order, Manual Task Allocation, User Notification

Title: While Performing Adjustment Confirmation, Serial Number tab Missing
Content: Symptom-Unable to see Serial number field while creating Adjustment Confirmation against the Production Order even though Serial Number Profile field is maintained as mandatory in Material Master data.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign---Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work center.-Select Production Orders view.-Under General tab choose Production Lot ID.-Select on view all.-Choose on Adjustment confirmation.-Choose the input product tab.-Notice Serial number field is not populated in adjustment confirmation.-Cause-Confirmation Method is maintained as 'Backflush' under input Products in respective Production Order.-Resolution-Ensure to maintain the Confirmation Method as 'Explicit' while creating the Production Order in order to see the Serial Number tab.-Go to Production Control Work center.-Select Production Orders view.-Select the Production order and choose edit.-Select products tab and choose input products tab.-Here you see the confirmation method field change it to 'Explicit' and save and close.-See Also-3237604 - Quantity Consumption Of Input product At Check Task In Production Order-Keywords-Adjustment confirmation, Production Lot, Production order, Input product, Serial number.

Title: Preview of the purchase order is truncated and the blank pages are displayed when there is long 'Remark for Suppliers' on item level
Content: Symptom-Preview of the purchase order is truncated and the blank pages are displayed when there is long 'Remark for Suppliers' on item level, and you are using standard purchase order form template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Order and Requests work center.-Go to Purchase Order view.-Search for affected purchase order and click on Preview.-Observe the form displayed has the text truncated and has blank pages.-Cause-‘Remark for Supplier’ section on item level, being a table and distinct from the header, is not intended for lengthy instructions. Additionally, page breaks is not allowed within this content for item level as per current template design. So it will only show the content which can fit into page, rest all will be truncated. -There is as such no limitation on number of line or characters. However, we recommend keeping it within 25-30 lines, but it'll again depend on the available space on the page considering other content shown.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-If there is a need to maintain extensive content for items, please create a document and attach it in the attachment tab available for each item separately.-See Also-3039735 - Blank Page is Randomly Added to an Output or Preview of a Document-Keywords-Preview, Purchase order, Truncated, Blank pages, Remark for suppliers, Form template

Title: Intercompany sales order and project are not created automatically although the purchase order is sent by XML
Content: Symptom-The Intercompany Sales Order and Intercompany Project has not created automatically from Purchase Order. However, you can see the intercompany relevant Purchase Order is Sent to Supplier, and you have maintained output channel as Electronic Data Exchange (EDX) in either supplier or account respective master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Show All Purchase Orders and find relevant Order ID.-Select and Edit the Purchase Order.-Choose View All and navigate to the Document Flow tab, here you can see the intercompany sales order is not created via B2B communication.-However you can see the purchase order is sent to supplier and sent by XML.-Cause-The purchase order is migrated into the system.-For migrated purchase orders, the actual output would have already happened before the migration stage itself and hence does not get generated upon migration into ByDesign system.-Hence, it will always be created in Sent status in the system and cannot be created first in open/in preparation status, then order it to trigger the intercompany sales order/project creation.-Resolution-Intercompany sales order/project cannot be created automatically from migrated purchase order.-This could be taken up as a new requirement and hence we suggest you to post on Customer Influence Site [New Idea Place] -https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886--This is our official channel to address all new requirements.-Keywords-Intercompany sales order, Intercompany project, Automatically created, Purchase order, Migrated

Title: Forgot Password Functionality Requests Logon Credentials
Content: Symptom-When attempting to use the self-service "Forgot your Password?" (ByD) or "Forgot Password" (C4C) feature, you are not directed to enter any e-mail address to receive a verification token.-Instead a "Sign In" window appears asking you to enter a username and password.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the tenant URL.-In the logon screen, click the Forgot Password? (C4C) or Forgot your password? (ByD) link.-A popup screen will come up, requesting user ID and password to proceed.-Cause-The forgot password functionality has been disabled and requires a backend correction by support. This may be due to long periods of inactivity in the tenant.-Resolution-Please create an incident with support to reactivate the feature.-Keywords-Password, Self-Service, Verification Token, Verification, E-mail, Forgot Password, Forgot Your Password, Credentials, Login, Logon

Title: Not possible to cancel purchase order item due to error: Cancellation not allowed. Check open delivery documents.
Content: Symptom-Although you have already canceled the inbound delivery item, it is still not possible for you to cancel purchase order item due to error: Cancellation not allowed. Check open delivery documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Filter the list 'All Documents'-Search and open the affected purchase order.-Navigate to affected item and click on 'Cancel item' button.-The error occurs.- Cause-We cannot cancel a separate line item in a released inbound delivery notification. Inbound delivery notification status will go to released once there is a warehouse request created. The only way for user to cancel the purchase order line item here is by reversing all the quantities delivered and cancelling the inbound delivery notification and then cancelling the purchase order line item. Once this is done you will have to create a new delivery notification and complete the process. From delivery end this is the behavior; no line item cancellation is possible, only whole document cancellation can be done.-Resolution-You can either cancel the whole inbound delivery notification and then cancelling the purchase order line item, or manually finish the delivery and invoice for the affected line item so that system will no longer require additional deliveries or invoices for the item.-See Also-1347361 - Reversal of Inbound Delivery-3253872 - Error:"The action CANCEL is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident" While Cancelling Inbound Delivery Notification-Keywords-Cancellation not allowed. Check open delivery documents, Purchase order item, 取消采购订单

Title: System Crashes When Releasing Purchase Proposal
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-System crashes when releasing a purchase proposal. Then you check the dump details via T-code ST22 and following message can be found.-"INSERT on DB table EPTR_D_PREQ_ITEM failed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Product View.-Open Product XXX.-Select the Purchase Proposal YYY.-Choose Release button, then system would dump.-Cause-Such issue comes due to some locking of proposal documents between different users and a Purchase Request gets created without updating the proposal status. Hence even after Purchase Request is created, proposal is visible in UI.-Resolution-Please ask customer to delete this proposal and create a new proposal.-Keywords-Dump; Release; Purchase Proposal; EPTR_D_PREQ_ITEM.

Title: Value Code # is Updated While Selecting The Filter Condition For Business Partner Data Report
Content: Symptom-When user tries to extract the Business partner data by adding the filter condition for "Script" field.-And when Latin Language is selected they observe the value displayed on the script field is #.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Navigate to Design Data Sources view-Open the Business Partner Master Data - script dependent (Data Source ID : BPARTNER_SCRIPT )-Select script field and choose value help.-In the selection Tab, choose the Script value as Latin-Script value is displayed as #-Cause-Due to standard internal coding in the content value of the Default language Latin is stored as SPACE. -Hence the system identifies space as the value code for Latin.-Resolution-LATIN is default script and as per design default script has <SPACE> as code in backend. Hence data source will have empty value which will be converted as # in analytics.-In order to get correct results user has to create the report first and then he can use that report.-Note: User has to create report on top of data source to get the correct results.-Follow below steps to create report:-Go to Business Analytics work center-Navigate to Design Reports view-Select "New" button.-Choose Report-Update the details and save-Keywords-Latin, script, Data source, Reports, View, Value code, space

Title: Stock Set as ‘Inspection’ is considered when Checking Availability In Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-You check the Availability of a Product in the Customer demand, and it shows as available. However, when you try to perform the Warehouse Task, you can't see any available stock. When you check your Stock Overview, you can see that the only stock displayed is set for 'Inspection'.-Now you expect that stock in 'Inspection' not to be considered in the Customer Demand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to Common Task view and choose the option New Sales Order (Advanced).-Enter the mandatory fields in the General tab of the New Sales Order screen and navigate to the Items tab.-Enter the relevant product whose stock is available only in the logistics area marked for inspection.-The system sets the availability confirmation flag as Green.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign, ATP does not consider attribute like logistics usage in the logistics area level. Hence stock in a logistics area with usage Inspection, is considered in ATP.-Resolution-When posting goods issue or confirming the task, the system should not find any available stock, this is the system behavior.-Keywords-Inspection, Sales Order, Stock Overview, Warehouse Task, ATP, Customer Demand.

Title: Reverse Confirmation Button is Disabled
Content: Symptom-The Reverse Confirmation button is disabled when attempting to reverse a Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Open Display / Reverse Goods and Activity Confirmations under Common Task.-Search for the Confirmation ID XYZ.-The Reverse Confirmation button is grayed out.-(XYZ represents Goods and Activity Confirmation ID)-Cause-The Goods and Activity Confirmation was created as a result of an Inventory Adjustment.-For a Physical Inventory Count with the Reason Code: Inventory Difference, the system does not allow reversal of the corresponding Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Therefore, the Reverse Confirmation button is disabled.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Reverse Confirmation; Goods and Activity Confirmation; Grayed out; Inventory difference; Reason code; Disabled; Internal Logistics; Confirmation ID; Inventory Adjustment; System behavior

Title: How to Add Extension Field in Form Templates
Content: Symptom-This document describes the steps that should be followed to enable an Extension Field in a Form Template which was created in a particular screen (business document).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the respective Work Center.-In the screen where you have created an extension field, choose the Adapt button on the right corner of the screen and select the option Enter Adaptation Mode.-It opens a confirmation screen, select the YES option.-Again choose the Adapt button on the right corner of the screen and select the option Edit Screen.-Select the heading Extension Fields you can see the extension field has been marked for display.-Highlight the field and select the Further Usage link, it opens a page.-In the Form Templates tab, highlight the Form Template.-Select Add Field and Edit button, choose either Easy Form Editor or Adobe LiveCycle Designer.-Note: Easy Form Editor, will extend the field to Easy Form Editor and you can set the conditions (Show always, show if exists and do not show). Adobe LiveCycle Designer will generate the binding path and you need to create a field using Adobe LiveCycle Designer and assign the binding path.-The Field Available option will be checked for the respective template.-Note: If you wants to extend the field to another screen then go to the Extension Scenarios tab and user Add Field to extend to selected screen-See Also-2580034 - How to Enable XML Schema in Adobe LiveCycle Designer-2545812 - Unable to bind a field using Adobe LiveCycle Designer (ALD), even when the data is available in xml.-Keywords-Extension Field, Form, Template, Easy Form, Adobe LiveCycle Designer,

Title: Error Message: Consumption quantity must not be greater than available quantity
Content: Symptom-Not possible to consume project stock order, due to error:  Consumption quantity must not be greater than available quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Navigate to Project Stock Orders view.-Find and select the relevant Project Stock Order ID.-Choose Edit button.-Select the relevant Line Item and click Consume.-Enter the relevant Details and click OK.-The system returns the error message: Consumption quantity must not be greater than available quantity of ABC (ABC represents for the material ID that you want to consume on the project).-However you have already done the delivery on project for material ABC.-Cause-The project stock order consumption is not possible because the quantity was moved away.-After the material be delivered to the project, you have done goods movement for it and the remaining quantity is less than the quantity showing in the project screen.-Resolution-In ad-hoc confirmation the project stock is not reduced and you can do this from Internal Logistics work center -> Consumption for Project. The quantity is consumed directly from the source LoA and the project task information is captured in account assignment and available in accounting.-The ad-hoc confirmation can be executed in Physical Inventory work center -> Change of Pre-Delivered Stock view. However you can perform the goods movement from Internal Logistics work center -> Consumption for Project is for ad-hoc consumption. Change of pre-delivered stock is used to remove the project tagging in case of Pre-Delivery scenario (where you have a custodian of the stock)-So the ad-hoc confirmation doesn’t deal with stock tagged to the project at all. For the pickup (scenario with movable LoA) and consumption at site (scenario with project LoA), the project tagging can be removed by posting goods movement via Internal Logistics work center -> Goods Movement view.-Note:-1. If project stock order raises an error during consumption, you can check the stock in Stock Overview. If there are not enough stock with project tagging, you can check Confirmation Journal from Internal logistics work center -> Reports list and check Confirmation Journal report by retrieve the Goods and Activity Confirmation ID (GAC ID), by querying for product And with stock type as “Custodian Party”, confirmation type as ‘Standard’ and Inventory change reason as “Transfer”, and find out the GAC ID (conf ID), which has effective quantity as 0 nos. This is same for pickup and consumption at site as well.-2. You can revert the ad-hoc confirmation via Reverse Confirmation in Goods and Activity Confirmation screen.-Both the ad-hoc consumption as well as the goods movement GACs can be reversed from the same screen. However, the end user also needs to understand that the reversal of the confirmation happens at the header level. So if more than one items were included in the document, especially in goods movement, then all the items would be reversed and more importantly, the stock for the product should exist in the LoAs before the reversal is triggered – if there isn’t sufficient stock, inventory will raise an error to that effect.-3. All the confirmations that are inventory relevant can be found in confirmation journal. The inventory change reason would be different for different scenarios. For goods movement GACs, the inventory change reason code would be ‘Transfer’, where the issue line would have project tagging, while receipt line wouldn’t. For consumption GAC (triggered from PSO as well as ad-hoc consumption) the change reason code would be ‘Consumption’ – it’s just that the ad-hoc consumption GAC will not have any BTD reference information.-Keywords-Cannot consume Project Stock Order; Consume Project Stock Order; ad-hoc confirmation; Consumption for Project

Title: Updating Sales Order Via Web Service Removes the Ship-From Information on Item Level
Content: Symptom- After updating a Sales Order via the web service, the fulfilment and ship-from fields are empty for the item, even though the payload still contains this information.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Sales Order via the web service. Sales Order ABC is created.-Update the Sales Order ABC to the same payload, and change the value of one of the fields, e.g. <BuyerID>.-Execute the web service.-The fulfilment data and ship-from have been deleted on item level.-Cause-During Sales Order creation, the system expects all of the required data to be provided.-However, during an update of an existing Sales Order, the system expects only the identifying information and new data to be provided.-Resolution-In the update payload, include only the required information, such as Sales Order ID and field to be updated. If you want to update item information, include the item ID, and the field to be updated on item level. This means that the ship-from data will not be removed.-Keywords- ManageSalesOrderIn; update sales order; ship from.

Title: How to Work with Extension Scenarios
Content: Symptom-In Business ByDesign, Administrators are able to create Extension Fields, either at Header or Item level. They can then add these fields to screens or templates in order to adapt the system to their needs.- Another facet of these fields is that via Extension Scenarios, you are able to create an extension field in one business context and then add that extension field to multiple other business contexts. The data stored in the extension field is then passed from one business context to the next as part of a business process.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-There is no previous configuration or scoping needed in order to work with Extension Scenarios, all you need to do is follow these steps:-Creating the Extension Field (Not necessary if this has already been done):-Navigate to a screen where you want to add the new field.-From the Adapt menu, select Enter Adaptation Mode.-In adaptation mode, select Edit Screen from the Adapt menu.-Click on the Extension Fields pane of the adaptation panel.-Select a section from the list, or alternatively, click directly on a section that has been enabled for extension fields on the screen.-Click Add.-Select a field type.-Enter a field label.-Save your changes.-Select the Visible checkbox next to the extension field to make it visible on the current screen.-Click Save.-Adding an Extension Scenario to this field, in order to extend it to another scenario:-Navigate to a screen where you have added the field.-From the Adapt menu, select Enter Adaptation Mode.-In adaptation mode, select Edit Screen from the Adapt menu.-Go into Adaptation Mode.-In the side bar, scroll down until you see a plus ('+') sign.-Click on it and select Extension Fields.-Highlight the extension field that you wish to extend.-Click on Further Usage.-Go to the tab Extension Scenario.-Highlight the Extension Scenario you want to add this field to.-Click 'Add'.-Repeat steps 10-11 until all Extension Scenarios necessary are covered.--You can find a list of all available Extension Scenarios in the Help Center Document Extension Scenarios-See Also-KBA 2727775 - Value Of Field Added Via Extension Scenario Not Available.-KBA 2636184 - How To Integrate KUT Extension Fields Into Web Services.-KBA 2353750 - Error When Activating Process Extension Scenario: Process Extension Scenario already shipped. No changes allowed.-KBA 2834449 - Extension Field Information is not Passed from Sales Order to Down Payment Invoice Request via Extension Scenario.-KBA 2711089 - How to Extend a KUT field in BYD HTML.-KBA 2241752 - The Extension Field Created in Sales order is not Updating the Values in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-KBA 2246008 - Extension Scenario Material to Contract Item is not Available.-KBA 2730064 - Not Able to Pass Extension Field from Sales Order Header to Purchase Request in a Third Party Scenario.-KBA 3066009 - Value of an Extension Field is Not Passed to the Credit Memo-Keywords-Extension Fields, Extension Scenario, Extensibility

Title: Cannot Release Outgoing Check Due to Error Message: Insufficient Money on Bank Account XYZ
Content: Symptom-You try to manually pay a supplier by check. When you choose Release, the system gives an error message: Insufficient money on bank account XYZ. But you are sure that there is enough balance on the checking account XYZ. (Here XYZ refers bank account id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier ABC, and then choose View.-Choose the Open Item DEF, and then choose Outgoing Check and Pay Manually By.-After completing all the necessary data, choose Release.-     You can see the error message: Insufficient money on bank account XYZ.-Cause-When you choose the Release button of an outgoing check, the system also takes those open payment proposals into account in order to check against the balance in the bank account XYZ, if you look at the Automatic Payments in the Payables work center, you can see there are a lot of open payment proposals which are charged to bank account XYZ, so this leads to the fact that the balance in the bank account XYZ is not enough to pay the open item DEF of your supplier ABC.-Resolution-In order to get rid of the error message and successfully release the outgoing check, you can either void some of those open payment proposals or make the system stop doing the liquidity check.-To void the open payment proposal, follow the steps below:-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Automatic Payments view.-Select the open payment proposal charged to bank account XYZ.-Choose Actions, and then choose Void.-Repeat the same procedure for all those payment proposals that you want to void.-To stop the system from doing the liquidity check of bank account XYZ, follow the steps below:-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier ABC, and then choose View. (Here ABC refers Supplier ID)-Choose the Open Item DEF, and then choose Outgoing Check and Pay Manually By. (Here DEF refers Supplier Invoice ID)-Tick Liquidity Allocation Not Required.-You should be able to release the outgoing check in both ways.-See Also- 1761426 - Message 'Insufficient money on bank account XYZ' When Posting Outgoing Bank Transfer -Keywords-Insufficent money, Outgoing payment, Liquidity check

Title: Why Does Fixed Asset Depreciation Run Generate Several Journal Entries Instead of One Single Journal Entry
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-After executing a fixed asset depreciation run, you check the log of the run and find out that there are a couples of journal entries generated, while you only expect one single journal entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Depreciation sub-view.-Select the Finished depreciation run just executed, and choose the View button.-Navigate to the Postings tab, and you can see that more than one journal entry is created.-Cause-When processing the fixed assets, the system groups the fixed assets in different packages, one package produces one journal entry document. The number of packages produced depends on the number of the fixed asset, and the number of Set of Books. From a business point of view, it has no influence if one or a couple of documents are produced by the depreciation run. The system is designed in this way for the sake of performance.-In your case, because the number of the Processed Fixed Assets is over 10,  also there are more set of books for your company, so the system produces more than just one journal entry.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Packaging, Depreciation Run, Journal Entry, Fixed Asset

Title: Down Payment Request is not Shown in Accounts Payable - Open Items Report
Content: Symptom-You have created a down payment request for a given supplier account. You see that the down payment request is being shown as Open Item in the supplier account monitor, however this down payment request is not shown when running the Accounts Payable - Open Items report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the related supplier account monitor. You'll see the Down Payment Request is Open status.-Go to Lists view of the Payables work center.-Open the report Accounts Payables - Open Items.-Give the relevant company, supplier ID and dates. -Run the report.-You notice that the Down payment Request is not returned in the reports list.-The same behavior can be noticed in the Accounts Payables - Line Items.-Cause-The Down Payment Request is still not posted (no Journal Entry assigned) and hence is only considered as a statistical item. In the Supplier Account Monitor, note that there is a checkbox flagged as Include Statistical Items, reason being that the down payment request is shown in the supplier account monitor.-Resolution-In order to make the Down Payment Request visible in the Accounts Payables - Open Items Report or Accounts Payables - Line Items Report please follow the below steps.-Open Accounts Payables - Open Items Report or Accounts Payables - Line Items Report.-Enter your selection criteria.-Under Standard Selection option select the field "Statistic Relevance".-Here you have to select "X" form the options.- Now you notice Down Payments details appear on the report.-Please be aware to see the Down Payment Request Value you must add the column Debit Amount Line Item Currency.-Keywords-statistic items, Accounts Payables, Statistical Items, down payment request. Open Items, Line Item. Down Payment Request.

Title: Depreciation Calculation For The Fixed Asset Is Zero For The Useful Life Periods
Content: Symptom-You want to run the depreciation for a fixed asset but realize that no depreciation calculation is done by the system for the period in question.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center, and choose the Fixed Assets view-Select the Fixed Assets subview.-Choose the fixed asset in question,and then click Edit.-Navigate to the Values tab, and then choose Depreciation Overview.-No depreciation is calculated for the useful life periods and shows the depreciation amount as 0,00.-Cause-The Initial Acquisition Date is set as for example as 01.08.2014 and the Capitalization Date is showing as 15.07.2012. The Capitalization Date should be equal or after the acquisition date. If this is not met the system will fail to calculate the depreciation.-Resolution-In order to rectify the situation and to calculate the depreciation, correct your Capitalization Date in the Fixed Assets - Master Data tab under Life Cycle Data.-Under the Values tab select Values and click  Recalculate Adjustment.-Keywords-Fixed asset, Depreciation calculation

Title: How to Unlock or Change the Password for Technical Print User
Content: Symptom-You need to unlock the printing technical user, or need to change its password.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cloud Print Manager-Resolution-To unlock the technical user, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Click on the Support and Technical Users view.-Locate the required user (generally users will have prefix "PRT_") and select it.-Click on the Unlock User button.-To change the password for a print user, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Print Queues sub view.-Search and select a print queue to which the required user is assigned.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Details tab.-Click on the Edit button to the right of the Assigned User field.-Here you will be able to change the user password, and it will be saved after clicking on the Ok button and saving the queue.-Note: When setting or changing the password for a print user, you need to follow this policy for Print User:-Password must be more than 8 characters.-The password must contain at least 2 letters (alphabets).-The password must contain at least 1 uppercase characters (A-Z)-The password must contain at least 1 digits (0-9).-Keywords-Printer User, PRT_001, Cloud Print Manager, authorization, authorisation, unable, cannot, can't, not working, access, does not work,

Title: 'Insufficient funds in petty cash DEF' Error While Performing Incoming Cash Transfer
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an Incoming Cash Transfer from Bank Account ABC to Petty Cash DEF, or an Incoming Cash Payment - Direct Posting to G/L account. When you try to post the document, the error message is shown as:-'Insufficient funds in petty cash DEF'.-ABC means Bank Account ID.-DEF means Petty Cash ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work center.-Go to the Petty Cash view.-Show All Petty Cash and Find Petty Cash ID DEF.-Select the Petty Cash ID and Go to New and then to Incoming Cash Transfer or Incoming Cash Payment - Direct Posting to G/L account.-Select the Bank Account ID/Payer ID and the Transaction Amount.-Choose Post.-Error message is shown:-'Insufficient funds in petty cash DEF'.-Cause-The liquidity of Petty Cash ID is negative even on transferring Transaction Amount GGG (GGG here represents Transaction Amount) from Bank Account ID/Payer ID to Petty Cash ID. The liquidity position of Petty Cash ID can be checked by following steps:-Go to the Payment Management Work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments and Go to Advanced Filter.-Enter the Petty Cash ID, Value Date and Status. Input the Value Data as Less than or Equal To the Receipt Date you input in the Incoming Payment.-Choose Export To Microsoft Excel.-Value Date is the Posting Date of Incoming Cash Transfer. Ensure that the Status of the Payments is Confirmed.-Once you add the values in Excel, the liquidity of Petty Cash ID is shown. The liquidity position would ideally be less than zero and in negative even on adding the Transaction Amount of Incoming Cash Transfer. Hence, the error message is shown.-Resolution-You can enter the Transaction Amount in Incoming Cash Transfer which would bring the liquidity position of Petty Cash ID to positive.-Keywords-Petty Cash, sufficient Funds, Incoming Cash Transfer, Incoming Cash Payment - Direct Posting to G/L account

Title: Sales Order Volume Report Shows Incorrect Values For Project Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-When checking the Sales Order Volume report, you find that Project Sales Orders do not have values maintained for Invoice Amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order workcenter.-Select the Reports View.-Open the Sales Order Volume report.-In the selection choose the restriction for Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Project Sales Order ID).-Choose the key figure Invoiced Amount in view.-Run the report and you can see that there are no values for Sales Order ABC.-Cause-The Sales Order Volume Report does not display information on Sales Orders Items, which have Project Tasks assigned.-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-You can use the Customer Project Overview report to display the Invoiced amount for the relevant projects.-Navigate to the Project Management workcenter.-Select the Reports view.-Open the Customer Project Overview report.-Sort by selection for relevant projects.-Add Invoiced Amount in the view.-Keywords-Sales Order Volume, report, customer project overview, Invoiced Amount, Kundenauftragsvolumen, Bericht, Kundenprojekt Übersicht, Rechnungsbeträge
