Title: Forgot Password Functionality Requests Logon Credentials (Backend Correction)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports that the password reset self-service is requesting logon credentials to proceed.-In case the customer is using sso, the following error might appear: "No RelayState mapping found for RelayState value" (see internal memo)-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the tenant URL.-In the logon screen, click the Forgot Password? (SAP Cloud for Customer) or Forgot your password? (SAP Business ByDesign) link.-A popup screen will come up, requesting user ID and password to proceed.-Cause-An issue occurred on the system, deconfiguring the System User used for the Self-Service feature.-Resolution-To confirm the cause, please follow the steps below:-Access the system's backend.-Open transaction SICF-Press F8 or click Execute.-On the left side, below "Virtuelle Hosts / Services", expand the hierarchy and further expand sap > ap > ui.-Under "ui", select the "selfservice" row and click Goto > External Aliases in the menu at the top of the transaction.-     Now, in the new screen, double-click the entry /sap/ap/ui/selfservice.-Navigate to the Logon Data tab.-If the cause is as described in this KBA, the User field will be blank and the Password Status will be Initial. In case the situation is not as described, please disregard the rest of this KBA, as the issue most likely has a different cause and resolution.-     To reconfigure the System User and re-enable the Self-Service functionality to the customer, follow the below steps:-Access the system's backend.-Open transaction SE38.-Input the report A1S_IAM_SETUP_USERS.-Press F8 or click Execute.-Select the checkbox Activate Password Self Service.-Press F8 or click Execute.-If there is no exception after the execution of the report, the issue should be solved. (There might be info messages nevertheless) -If there is any exception found after the execution of the report, ask customer to try forgot password functionality again to check if the issue is resolved. -9.Click Exit to complete the change-You can check back at transaction SICF to confirm the correction. User should now be SAP_IAMLGN and Password Status should be Set.-See Also- 2616642 - Unable to Generate new Password From Forgot Your Password Link-Keywords-Forgot Password, Logon Credentials, Not Working, "No RelayState mapping found for RelayState value"

Title: First Implementation Project In Production System has Status Tested, but System Is Still In Pre-Production
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports that they cannot close the first implementation project: even though the Confirm Go-Live and Close Project fine-tuning activities are grayed out and closed, the project's status remains as Tested.-Additionally, they might report seeing warning message "Implementation project not yet live" or error message "Action CLOSE not possible; action is disabled" when trying to execute the Close Project fine-tuning activity again.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects work center view; see that the First Implementation project status is Tested.-Select the First Implementation project and click the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Go Live tab; see that the Confirm Go-Live and Close Project activities are already in status Closed.-Click the name of activity Close Project to open it.-The Close Project checkbox will already be checked; click the Confirm button.-Error message "Action CLOSE not possible; action is disabled" is raised.-Cause-This issue is caused by the Confirm Go-Live and Close Project activities being incorrectly closed ahead of time, either by an inconsistency or manually by the customer.-Resolution-Important: The following steps should only be performed by the AP-RC-BCT support team and only if the prerequisites mentioned are all fulfilled (step 4, 8 and 12 are as described below):-Log into the tenant's backend.-Access transaction code BCTADM.-Under the Workspace Operation, select Workspace Overview.-Ensure that the workspace flagged as Main appears with System Purpose as 3 - Pre-Production and Project Status as 50 - Tested; keep note of the Workspace ID for later use.-Now, access transaction code SE16-Search for the table TENANT-Use the TENANT_URL to filter for the relevant tenant and click the Execute button (or press F8)-Ensure that the ROLE_CODE is 04 - Production. -Back in transaction code SE16, search for the table BCTD_WSACTIVITY-Filtering using the y entering the UUID of main workspace in the WS_ID field and the following values in the ELEMENT_ID field:-WS_ID: enter the Workspace ID of the main workspace found in BCTADM;-ELEMENT_ID: 'BO_A1S_CRT_GOLIVE_CHECK_SWITCH' and 'BO_A1S_FND_CMCPIM' (click the Multiple Selection button to enter more than one value at once);-IS_WORKITEM: X-Ensure that there is one record for each of the two activities and the FT_STATUS is currently on value 3 - Closed (which is incorrect and causes the customer’s issue).-Select one of the element IDs, then click the Edit (pencil icon) button.-Change the FT_STATUS from 3 - Closed to 1 - Open.-Click the Save (floppy disk icon) button.-Go back and repeat steps 12 to 14 for the other element ID.-Now, ask customer to close activities "close project" and "confirm go live" again in UI. --It should resolve the issue.-See Also-1705462 - Status and Life Cycle of Implementation/Change Projects at Different Stages-2819814 - First Implementation Project In Production System has Status Tested, but System Is Still In Pre-Production-2194540 - Unable to Close a First Implementation Project in Test System-Keywords-First Implementation, Productive, Tested, Action CLOSE not possible, byd, c4c

Title: Journal Entry not Created for the Posted Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have created supplier invoice and posted it. However, there is no Journal Entry created for the Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Enter all the mandatory details and Post it.-Navigate to Document Flow tab and Journal Entry has not been created.-Cause-System failed to post the supplier invoice due to document lock. For example, when two invoices are posted at a time with reference to the same purchase order, system creates a lock. While processing one invoice, it is trying to get the references from the purchase order and at the same time, second invoice is trying to get the same purchase order reference. Hence system creates a document lock.-Resolution-You can go to SRT_MONI transaction from backend and restart the XI message.-Ask customer to approve one invoice at a time which has a reference to the same purchase order.-Workaround: As soon as the document is locked, system creates a business task for the employee responsible person.-Inform Employee Responsible to cross check the task from: Application and User Management work center -> Task Distribution -> Business Task Management -> User can find a task for the relevant invoice.-Task – Description appears as below.-Solve Document Inconsistency in Business Transaction ABC to Process Invoice Notification Sent by Supplier Invoice XYZ Application and User Management-As soon as the user complete the task, system will release the locks and creates Journal Entry for supplier invoice.-Keywords-Journal Entry, Supplier Invoice

Title: How to Reverse an Incoming Check Returned By the Bank
Content: Symptom-You have processed an incoming check from your customer, however you get a bank notification that returns the check due to insufficient funds.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Select a group of incoming checks and assign them to a Check Deposit in order to deposit them to your bank.-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Check Deposits subview.-Select the relevant check deposit and release it. The incoming checks should now be In Transfer.-You are now awaiting the bank notification to process your bank statement.-Cause-The Bank entity processed your checks, however one of them was returned due to insufficient funds. Reason being that the writer has insufficient funds to afford the check, hence it gets bounced.-Resolution-Technically in the system, it is not possible to unassign or change assignment of a particular check once the deposit is released. The only way to achieve this is either wait for the Bank Statement Notification or a Bank Statement to confirm the check bounce, or if you cannot wait, then the deposit has to be reversed and all other checks need to be reassigned back. However, doing this may lead to audit problems as you will lose account of the bounced check and the corresponding document entry.-In order to process the bounced check, you should deal with it as an outgoing return in the bank statement through the following steps.-Wait for the bank notification that would contain the details of both the confirmed and the bounced check.-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Create a new Bank Statement for the relevant company and bank account.-Calculate the Closing Balance only for the confirmed check amount.-Go to step 2-Select Items and select the released deposit.-Go to step 3-Create and Edit Items. You will see a row for the selected check deposit. Note that this regards a credit amount.-Add a new row for the bounced check by selecting the Payment Method as Outgoing Return of an Incoming Payment. Specify the check amount as a debit amount.-Once the bank statement is consistent, post it.-Go to back to the Bank Statement view.-Select the row related to the recently posted bank statement.-Click the Required hyperlink in the Postprocessing column, in order to open the payment allocation. -On the Payment Confirmation/Returns tab, select the bounced check and click the downward arrow to allocate the amount. Note the Payment Returned box flagged.-Post the payment allocation.-The payment allocation gets posted and the bounced check linked to it becomes Returned.-Keywords-Incoming Check, Check Deposit, Bounced Check, Returned Check, Bank, canceled

Title: Direct Debit or SEPA Mandate Error: Instance with the same key already exists
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-KBA NOT TO BE USED FOR THE TIME BEING-Mandate ID XYZ is assigned to a customer account's SEPA Mandate. Due to expired validities or changes in bank account data SEPA Mandates might have been set to Status: Obsolete.-When attempting to save a new SEPA Mandate having the identical ID XYZ an error shows as: Instance with the same key already exists. Saving is therefore not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Receivables work canter, go to Customers view and select Customer Accounts-Access the account master data by clicking on Customer Name-Edit / Financial Data-The SEPA Mandates are maintained under Payment Data-Press New and save a new SEPA Mandate showing the ID XYZ-An error shows as: Instance with the same key already exists-Cause-This is intended system behaviour since every SEPA Mandate carries a unique Mandate ID which serves as primary key, regardless of the Status. The preferred option would be to assign a new Mandate ID or using the previous ID and a suitable suffix.-It can however be a strong requirement for customers to maintain Mandate IDs matching the respective Account ID.-This document describes the steps to delete the obsolete Mandate ID from the database in order to facilitate the entry of a new SEPA Mandate having the previous Mandate ID XYZ.-Resolution-Enter the Test-Shell with SESFTS-Choose transaction SESFTS-Enter BO Proxy Name: FOPXF_PAYMENT_AGREEMENT and use the query to load the Payment Agreement instance (here SEPA Mandate)-Load by Query: Root - QUERY_BY_COMPANY_PARTNER-Specify Customer Account ID XYZ in the Query Options for field BusinessPartnerInternalID-Via Navigate go to the attribute DIRECT_DEBIT_MANDATE-Copy the attribute value from UUID-CONTENT-Open DB table FOP_D_DDMANDATE and fill the UUID as DB_KEY-Delete the unique entry representing SEPA Mandate ID XYX in debug mode (For steps how to delete a DB record consult for example: KBA 2639870 - How to Delete a Row From a Cloud Data Source from Backend)-Perform an FSI Reload BO: FOPXF_DIRECT_DEBIT_MANDATE -> Root Node: FOPXF_DIRECT_DEBIT_MANDATE-Maintaining of a new SEPA Mandate showing Mandate ID XYZ should now be possible.-Note that these changes require explicit customer approval and are to be performed by - or under the assistance of an Expert Support colleague.-  Keywords-SEPA Mandate, direct debit

Title: Slow Performance While Executing the Activities Query
Content: Symptom-Slow performance while executing the query in OWL screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For example we are selecting Activities view.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Activities view.-Show All Activities and choose Go button.-The display of list takes more time than your expectation.-You also get a warning message: The data cannot be displayed completely. Sorting and Filtering are not reliable since the number of hits is too large. Reduce the number of search hits by restricting the search criteria.-Cause-On a particular query screen (e.g. Activities, Sales Orders, Service Orders), if the data is huge and you try to query with All parameter then performance will be relatively slow and the system will throw below warning message:-The data cannot be displayed completely. Sorting and Filtering are not reliable since the number of hits is too large. Reduce the number of search hits by restricting the search criteria.-Resolution-In case of such warning message & slow execution, it is always advisable to use the Advanced query, optimize your search criteria then try to view the data. In Advanced query you have many parameters to optimize the query e. g. Date, Activity Type, Employee Responsible, Status, Account Name, Account ID etc.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Activities view.-Show All Activities and choose the Advanced option.-Select the required parameters and choose the Go button.-The duration for the display of list will be optimized as per your expectation.-Please be noted that this solution is also working for Supplier Invoices, Purchase Orders, etc.-Keywords-Slow performance, Data cannot be displayed completely, Sorting and Filtering are not reliable since the number of hits is too large, Reduce the number of search hits by restricting the search criteria

Title: How To Identify Dump Issue When There Is No ST22 Logs In The Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This KBA article addresses how to analyze the dump issue from the UI perspective when there are no ST22 Logs available in the backend.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The following is an example; the problem could arise in any of the screens.-Go to Customer Invoicing workcenter-Go to Invoice Documents view-Search for Invoice ID: ABC-Select Follow-Up button-Choose Manual Credit Memo-Now the system loads for a very long time and dumps.-Resolution-Take the Network Trace by following the steps below in order to identify the error:-Login to the system in browser (preferably in Edge/Chrome)-Enter F12, the developer tool will be displayed-Now, execute the steps in the UI-For example, Go to Customer Invoicing workcenter-Go to Invoice Documents view-Search for Invoice ID: ABC-Select Follow-Up button-Choose Manual Credit Memo-Wait until the system dumps with an error.-Now in the DevTools, navigate to the Network tab-In Console, you can see an error: ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR as below.-If the error message is ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR it does not indicate a UI issue. Title: Balance Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created the balance confirmation run and Credit memo and its cancellation is not picked in the Run.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Receivables work center.-Open Relevant Balance Confirmation you see Credit memo and cancellation not included in the run.-Cause-System design-Resolution-Balance confirmation run picks only items which are currently open in account monitor and having accounting transaction date less than equal to passed 'Cut-off Date' value.-Cancellation invoice is not getting stored in backend register, so it will not be considered for run.-In current scenario, credit memo invoice is already cancelled and balance confirmation run was created after the cancellation date with cut off date before both Run and Cancellation dates.-Also 'Return Date' is the date by which company is expecting confirmation from customer/supplier for balance confirmation letter which they sent.-Keywords-Balance confirmation, Credit memo, Cancellation

Title: How to change the Relevance Status of a source document from Irrelevant to Relevant?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-The customer has changed the Relevance status of a source document as Irrelevant. Now, they want to change it back to Relevant. You cannot find the option over UI nor in the backend (SESFTS - BO Test shell).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Click on Source Documents view.-Search for the Document and check the Relevance Status.-You can find the Relevance Status as Irrelevant. -Now, you want to make it as Relevant. -However, the option of marking this Source Document as Relevant is not available.-Resolution-Basically, there are two parts:-Part A) - Change the Relevance Status to Relevant at DB(database) level for a particular source document.-Part B) - FSI view Reload to trigger the changes in OWL. -NOTE:-1) The Relevance Status change is at DB(database) level. Hence, it must be done with proper care. In case, you are new to the topic, then you can involve senior colleagues.-2) When you try to reload FSI view, then check the Number (in Part B), because this is not a standard procedure and highly dependent on the number of documents.-It is always recommanded to Reload the FSI view out of business hours, if the Number is in higher range. -3) This KBA is valid for Original as well as cancelled Source Document.  -Let's begin with Part A) - Change the Relevance Status to Relevant at DB(database) level for a particular source document.-Go to SE38.-Enter Program - FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI.-Click on Execute.-Enter the Operation Document Type and Operation Document ID.-Select button - Accounting Notification.-Click on Execute.-Here, you can find the Node ID.--Copy the Node ID and paste it in notepad.-Go to transaction code SE16.-Enter the table - FIAD_BAN_HD and Hit Enter key.--Enter the DB_KEY (Copied Node ID from BO Test Shell) and Execute.--Select the line and click on Display. --In the displayed view, the fields are not Editable. --Enter /h and Hit Enter key two times. You will be navigated to ABAP Debugger. --In the ABAP Debugger, select line - 5(left side - using c_code).--In the above screenshot, click on Pencil icon(Right side - Under Variables 1 tab).-Replace SHOW to EDIT and hit Enter key. Press F8.-You see the fields in the Step - 13 are Editable. Scroll down to the bottom of the screen and you can find the field - ACNTFRELSTATUS.-Change the Relevance Status(ACNTFRELSTATUS) to 1 - Relevant and press Save. This has finished Part A. You can verify the Relevance Status in SESFTS. --Part B) - FSI view Reload to trigger the changes in OWL. -Go to T-code - GFSSTM.-Enter BO - FIA_ACC_NOTIF and Execute.-Expand FIASV_ACCNOTIF_ROOT  ---> Select ROOT with BO - FIA_ACC_NOTIF-Check the Number on the right side. In the above case it is 39,318. If You find it in high range then perform the FSI view reload out of business hours. -Click on Persistence and then Yes.-Monitor the 'Loaded' status, until it turns green. Also, you can verify the Start Date and Start Time. It must be current CET time.-Result - The Source Document now appears with Relevance Status Relevant.-Keywords-Relevance Status, Change the Source Document to Relevant, Source Documents, Mark as Releavnt, Relevant

Title: Supplier Part Number Missing on Label Created With Reference to Warehouse Task
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Label against a Warehouse Task, but the field Supplier Part Number is missing in the Label.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Task Control.-Find the relevant Task ID.-Go to the Execution Details sub-tab, you can see the Supplier Part Number is displayed.-Select the New Labels option and a new window opens.-Go to the Inbound Information sub-tab.-You can see under the Logistics Details section the Supplier Part Number field is empty.-Go to the Common Task and select "Labels".-Show "All Label by Selection" and enter the relevant Label ID.-Click View.-In the Label Overview, you can see that the Supplier Part Number is also empty. -Cause-Supplier part number is stored in Inbound Delivery Notification when we create Labels with reference to the Inbound Delivery Notification and we can fetch the supplier part number and store it in the label created.-Since this information is not stored in the Warehouse Task, we do not fill the Supplier Part Number when we create Label with reference to Warehouse Tasks.-Resolution-Hence, we would like to suggest to you the following steps to create Label with reference to Inbound Delivery Notification so that you are able to see Supplier Part Number:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center and Labels view.-Click on New Labels and Add Row with Reference to Inbound Delivery Notification.-Enter the relevant Inbound Delivery Notification ID and choose OK.-Go to Inbound Information subtab tab and check Supplier Part Number is fetched for the line item.-Keywords-Warehouse Task, Label, Supplier Part Number

Title: URL Mashup Not Available For Selection In Adaptation Mode
Content: Symptom-User has created a URL mashup in Mashup Authoring, but is not available for selection in the Adaptation Mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management-Go to Mashup Authoring view-Notice the URL Mashup: ABC is Active-Now go to any screen to add the mashup (For example: Product and Service Portfolio)-Go to Key User Settings-Select Adaptation Mode-Select '+' icon and select Mashup-Now filter the Mashup Type: URL Mashup-Notice, the Mashup: ABC is not available for selection.-Cause-In Mashup Authoring,  the URL Mashup has the Mandatory field checked under Request Parameter.-Resolution-Users should uncheck the Mandatory field under Request Parameter in Mashup Authoring by following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Mashup Authoring view-Select the URL Mashup: ABC-Select Edit-Scroll down to Request Parameter and uncheck the Mandatory field-Keywords-URL Mashup, Adaptation Mode, Request Parameter, Mandatory Field, Mashup Type

Title: OutputManagementUtilities.GetPDF() Brings No Results When Debugging It
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer complains that the OutputManagementUtilities.GetPDF() function brings no results when debugging it via SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-There might be multiple ways to reproduce it, depending on each customer's implementation. An example would be:-Go to Sales Order > Sales Order work center view.-Select Sales Order XYZ.-Select an Item and click the button "Edit".-Click the button "New Down Payment".-Click on "Post".-By debugging YABCDEFG_CL_D22A89D9E9E593D0E=>ACTIONCUSTOMFORM12345677, you can't see values for OutputManagementUtilities.GetPDF() function. -Cause-The issue might be caused because a Business User has changed PDI Custom Form. For confirming it, you may follow these steps:-By debugging PDI Classes in SE24 (e.g.  YABCDEFG_CL_D22A89D9E9E593D0E=>ACTIONCUSTOMFORM12345677), you will see similar ABAP Coding:-##ABSL_SRCPOS[X][Y]          call_reuse_service(-                                 EXPORTING-                                   iv_function_name = '/DOC/OM_GET_PDF'-                                   it_parameter     = lt_param_bind-                                 IMPORTING-                                   et_messages      = lt_lib_message-                                 CHANGING-                                   cg_data          = _ret_43 ).-                               ADD_MESSAGES_TO_MSG_HANDLER( it_messages = lt_lib_message ).-                               CLEAR ls_param_bind.-                               CLEAR lt_param_bind.-                               CLEAR lt_lib_message.-                                Then, you can check values of "lt_param_bind" variable and then double click in FORM_TP_CODE. This will lead you to PDI Custom Form ID affected (e.g. YABCDEFG_PJJBM).-Then, follow these steps:-Login to Backend.-Navigate to XREP. -You can navigate to similar path of: /YABDEFG_MAIN/GEN/Forms/YABCDEFG_P0C.FLDR/6460A9FD1D74AF5F.TMPL/YABCDEFG_PJJBM__DE -Double Click -Navigate to Version History tab.-You can see a $CUST entry.-This means PDI Custom Form has been edited by a Business User. However, PDI Custom Form are intended to be edited by PDI Developer Users only. -Resolution-First, inform customer reason why they're not receiving a response from OutputManagementUtilities.GetPDF() function and ask for permission to correct it. Then, you need to remove $CUST entry on PDI Custom Form for resolving it:-Login to Backend.-Enter the transaction code XREP.-Ensure that your user is on LAYER_CUST.-Navigate to the path that partner received the error i.e. ABC.-Select the tab Version history of the .XDP file.-You will be able to find an entry as $CUST with the Content ID in the error message i.e. PQR.-Select the $CUST entry and click on the button Clean Up.-You might debug those scripts again and you'll be able to see results for OutputManagementUtilities.GetPDF().-Keywords-OutputManagementUtilities.GetPDF(), form, script, absl, /DOC/OM_GET_PDF'

Title: The Material Maintained In The Project Is Not Visible In The Customer Demand.
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order for a product maintained in your project. You expect to see the order item information in customer demand. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-Search for the sales order you created against your project. -You do not see any information of the sales order in the customer demand view. -Cause-You have not created a Project Stock Order against the Project. -Only materials created with Project Stock Orders will be displayed in the Customer Demand. -Resolution-Create a Project Stock Order against the Project and this order will be displayed in the customer demand view. -Below help documents will help you with details of how to create Project Stock Orders. -Sourcing Materials From Projects. -Maintaining Projects - Products. -See Also-Sourcing Materials From Projects. -Maintaining Projects - Products. -Keywords-Project Stock Order Not Visible, Items in Sales Order for Project not visible, Item in Project not visible in customer demand, Material in Project not visible in customer demand.

Title: '500 Internal Server Error' When Trying to Upload a Price List via Excel
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a Price List via Excel add-in, however, when you try to perform the upload, the system displays the message: -"The remote Server Returned an error: (500) internal Server Error."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open your Excel Template with the data of the price list.-Log on to the system using the respective credentials.-Click on the Save Data To button.-Error "The remote Server Returned an error: (500) internal Server Error." is raised and the upload does not go through.-Cause-One of the reasons for this error to happen would be when the Currency code used is of the incorrect length. -The system expects the Currency code to be 3-characters long, for example: "USD" would be correct, while "US" or "Dollar" would be incorrect.-Resolution-You need to ensure the use of a 3-character long Currency code in the excel upload template for Price Lists.-See Also-2423217 - Unable to Upload a Price List using Excel due to the Error: "The remote Server Returned an error: (500) internal Server Error".-2614379 - Error Faced During Price List Upload-2938699 - Unable to Upload Price List Via Excel-Keywords-Excel, Upload, Add-in, Data, Dump, Error, 500, Unable, Impossible, Not Saved, Currency Code, ISO.

Title: Export of Materials via Mass Data Maintenance is Incomplete
Content: Symptom-When exporting materials via Mass Data Maintenance, the amount of materials in the CSV files is incorrect. Some materials might be missing in the export files. This happens with or even without using the filter mechanism during export. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Gp to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Select Export Materials-Select e.g. 100000 Materials-Export Data to CSV file-According to selection one or more files with a total of 100000 data records will be created-Confirm to continue-Check the export files-The total amount of all records in the export file(s) does not match 100000. It is e.g. 100010 -Resolution-When exporting data via Mass Data Maintenance, ensure the following:-1. Search based on a combination of material and language in which the data is maintained specifically. -2. When searching without a language filter, you can export data, but you might need to adapt the file, i.e. by removing duplicate entries.-3. As an alternative solution, make use of Data Extraction, to also get a proper result.

Title: Error "Party Seller with ID ABC not contractually capable" in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When trying to post a new Purchase Order (123) for a specific Supplier (ABC), the mentioned error message shows up.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Work Center Purchase requests and Orders-Purchase Order View-You have created the Purchase Order 123 with the Supplier ABC-Upon clicking "Check", this error message pops up:-"Party Seller with ID ABC not contractually capable"-Cause-You are using the field "Legal Competence" in the Supplier ABC Master Data but the field is not ticked.-Resolution-WoC Supplier Base-Suppliers View-Search, Open and View All the Supplier ABC-Under General Tab > Details Sub-Tab, tick the field "Legal Competence" & Save-After doing so, the mentioned error message in Purchase Order 123 should not occur anymore.-Keywords-Party Seller with ID not contractually capable, Legal Competence, Purchase Order, Supplier

Title: E-Mail Output Error 554 5.0.0 Transaction failed: Illegal filename
Content: Symptom-In the status of an email outbound, you see an error 554 5.0.0 Transaction failed: Illegal filename.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The email error  indicates the following-Diagnostic-Code: smtp; 554 5.0.0 Transaction failed: Illegal filename-'Module1.vb'. in aws-https://community.sap.com/t5/enterprise-resource-planning-blogs-by-sap/next-generation-cloud-delivery-transition-new-business-bydesign-e-mail/ba-p/13523279#comment-631565-Please check above link:-What are the attachment types that are “NOT Allowed” at our e-mail server?-E-mails containing one of the following file types currently fall into the category “dangerous attachment”:-ade, adp, app, asp, bas, bat, bhx, cab, ceo, chm, cmd, com, cpl, crt, csr, der, exe, fxp, hlp, hta, inf, ins, isp, its, js, jse, lnk, mad, maf, mag, mam, mar, mas, mat, mde, mim, msc, msi, msp, mst, ole, pcd, pif, reg, scr, sct, shb, shs, vb, vbe, vbmacros, vbs, vsw, wmd, wmz, ws, wsc, wsf, wsh, xxe, docm, xlsm.--This also applies if attachments with these extensions are found in the following (password-protected) archives:-arj, cab, jar, lha, rar, tar, zip, gz-Resolution-Please follow the guideline for allowed attachment.-Keywords-email error, attachments, email status error,554 5.0.0 Transaction failed: Illegal filename

Title: Error - Item : Product, product category or tax code of item missing on Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Error when adding a Row in items for the creation of a new Purchase Order - -"Item 1: Product, product category or tax code of item missing"-Environment-Source: byd-Type: Productive System-System ID/Name: CLOUD / my434992.businessbydesign.cloud.sap-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign 2402-System managed by: SAP Cloud Tenant-Install base item: my434992.businessbydesign.cloud.sap-Sold product: BYD INSTALLATION-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Order work center -Go to New Purchase Order view -Select the required Supplier -Go to items tab and click on Add Row -Error "Item : Product, product category or tax code of item missing" pops -Cause-One line item was added without an item. Hence, the system is not able to determine the tax code.--A line item was added manually as a free text item (description). For such cases, the tax code needs to be added manually.-Resolution-This is the default expected system behavior. As the system is conveying the user that Product, Product Category or Tax code of the items are not entered at the initial stage itself. -A Purchase Order cannot be created without a product , hence the system gives an initial error .-  Enter a Product ID,  this will automatically determine the Product category and enable tax determination along with fetching all the details related to this Product automatically. - Keywords-Add row in Purchase order, Product, product category or tax code of item missing, Purchase order tax code, Product ID

Title: How to set up .7z ZIP file format ?
Content: Symptom-How to set up .7z ZIP file format , in order to attach the .7z ZIP file format in the attachment tab of documents-(This applies to all other documents like Sales Order, Supplier Invoice, Purchase request, etc )-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue- Resolution-Follow the below steps to add .7z format under ZIP files format,-Go to Business Configuration work center -Go to Implementation Projects and select the Project-Choose on Open Activity List-Search for MIME type and open-Search for MIME type code 10051 which is for zip file -Under File Extension tab, add row and add File extension code Z01 for 7z format -Check mark the Default box and save-Keywords-7z ZIP file format, 7z format attachment

Title: How to Set restricted Stock as Unrestricted?
Content: Symptom-You want to set certain quantity of a product in your warehouse as Unrestricted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option Stock Overview.-Enter the relevant Product information and choose the Go button.-You see that the flag Restricted is set for the product selected.-Resolution-Go to the Internal Logistics work center.-Select the Change of Stock option from the Common Tasks view.-Enter the Site and the planning area related information in the mandatory fields.-Choose the Add Row button and enter the Product and related information like identified stock quantity Unit of Measure etc, whose stock you need to mark as Unrestricted.-Choose the Next button.-Enter the quantity you need to mark as unrestricted in the field Changed Product Quantity and mark the flow Changed Restricted Status.-Choose the Next button and review the entries made.-Choose the Finish button.-You can see in stock overview that the value entered in the field Changed Product Quantity has been marked as Unrestricted.-Keywords-unrestricted, Change of Stock, Product

Title: Cannot Assign Down Payments to the External Customer Invoice Request created via webservice
Content: Symptom-When the user creates the External Customer Invoice request via webservice Managecustomerinvoicerequestin, it is not possible to assign the down payments because Assign Down payments button is missing. -Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work center-Go to Invoice Requests View-Select Show All Invoice Requests from Drop down-Search for External Customer Invoice Request XYZ which is in status To be Invoiced.(XYZ is the ID of the External Customer Invoice Request)-Click on Edit button and then in the Invoice request Screen Click on View All Button-Assigned Down payments section is not visible under the General tab.-Cause-Whenever you create a invoice request via webservice which has both Invoice item and Credit Memo item, it is not possible to assign the Down Payment Requests. Assign Down Payments is available only when you create the External Customer Invoice Request with Invoice Items only. It is not available when you create the External Customer Invoice Request with only Credit Memo items or Both Invoice and Credit Memo Item.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-External Customer Invoice Request; Assign Down Payments; Credit memo item;

Title: Asynchronous error (non-final) in broadcast
Content: Symptom-You have created a broadcast but when it is executed it fails with the following error:-Asynchronous error (non-final) sending mail to XYZ@mail.com (where XYZ@mail.com refers to the email address of a broadcast recipient)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Click on Broadcasts view.-Search for your broadcast.-Check the Last Run column - it shows a red dot. Hover the mouse over it and you will see the error.-Cause-The broadcast could not be executed due to too much data.-There is a background job every hour which picks up all broadcasts for that period and runs them. So each broadcast run as a maximum of 1 hour to be executed. Sometimes broadcasts cannot be executed during this hour if:-The underlying report contains a very large amount of data and loading this report does not finish.-The broadcast is user specific and you have a large amount of recipients.-Resolution-Please review the modelling of the broadcasted report and the underlying data source. For best practices on modelling custom data sources and reports, please see the KBA 2366796 - Best Practices for Modeling and Handling Data Sources and Reports - Performance. Also please review which selection and view you are using in the report / broadcast.-If your broadcast is sent to a large number of users (80 users for example), please review if the "user specific" setting is required. This setting usually only makes sense when relative selections like "my user name", etc are used, since this would of course have different results for each user. If you need the user specific setting and the number of recipients cannot be reduced, please divide your broadcast up into several smaller ones, i.e. with a smaller list of recipients. Please stagger the start times of those smaller broadcasts to different hours of the day.-Keywords-Asynchronous error (non-final), report, broadcast, data volume, too much data, cannot send, error message,

Title: Error Message State, City, Street, or Postal Code Missing For Business Partner
Content: Symptom-Error while trying to perform legal approval in customer invoice -State, City, Street, or Postal Code missing for business partner-State or City missing for Invoicing Unit -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing - Invoice Documents -Select the Invoice: ABC (ABC represents the Invoice ID)-Click on Legal Approval -> Request Approval-Error: State, City, Street, or Postal Code missing for business partner-State or City missing for Invoicing Unit -Go to Business Partner Data - Business Partners -Search for corresponding Invoicing unit DEF. (DEF is the invoicing unit for the Invoice ABC)-Click on Edit -> Addresses- State, City, Street, or Postal Code are maintained. -Cause-The field State, City, Street, or Postal Code is not maintained under Org Structures -Resolution-Go to Organizational Management - Org Structures -Select the Org Unit ID DEF -Click on Edit-Under Addresses sub tab -Maintain field State, City, Street, or Postal Code-Click on Save and Close. -Once this is maintained, all the new documents will fetch the value and the error wont appear. -Keywords-Error message on release customer invoice; Mexican; Mexico;

Title: Open Item Transaction not reflecting in Bank statement
Content: Symptom-You find new incoming transactions are not displaying in the New bank statement, whereas outgoing transactions are being shown.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Liquidity Management-Under Bank Statements - Click on "New," then select "New Bank Statement."-Fill in all the required fields and click "Next" to proceed to "Select Items."-In the "Select Items" section, only outgoing transactions are visible; incoming transactions are missing.-You have verified required payments are marked as "in-transfer." Despite this, they're not appearing in the bank statement.-Cause-There is a Payment Reference filled on the advice (related to the Incoming bank transfer) and any advice that has a Payment Reference does not show up in the second step of Bank Statement creation.-The issue happens when the transaction's bank account ID does not match with that of the bank statement.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-See Also-KBA 2524918 - Incoming Bank Transfer Not Appearing in Step 2 During Bank Statement Creation-Keywords-Bank statement, Payment Transaction

Title: Posted Supplier Invoice not Available in the Supplier Accounts for Payments
Content: Symptom-You have posted the supplier invoice with reference to purchase order however invoice is not showing in supplier accounts to create the payments. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit button and navigate to Document Flow tab-You do not see the invoice which is posted and available for payment processing-Cause-You have manually finished the invoicing status and no invoice is created or posted. Since the invoicing status is manually finished, the purchase order status is set to Finished. -Resolution-When you search the invoice with reference to Order, there are no invoices. This confirms that, user has not created or posted any invoices but rather manually finished the invoicing status. You can resume the manual invoicing and post the new invoice, so that it will be available in supplier accounts. -Keywords-Posted Supplier Invoice not Available in the Supplier Accounts for Payments; Invoice manually finished

Title: Sales Order Item with Invoice Schedule Items Data Source Shows Wrong Item Status
Content: Symptom-You are using the data source Sales Order Item with Invoice Schedule Items and noticed that the report shows an Invoiced scheduled item with the Open status .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Data Sources view.-Search for Sales Order Item with Invoice Schedule Items.-Click Preview.-Enter Sales Order ABC (ABC represent the ID of the Sales Order).-Navigate to the View tab.-Enter the following fields under Row:-Sales Order Item-Invoice Schedule Item ID-Invoice Schedule To Be Scheduled Item Life Cycle Status-Line item  shows as Open--Resolution-In order to have the expected value, please add the field/column "Invoice Schedule Item Life Cycle Status" which will provide the correct/expected Invoice Schedule Status for the line item. -Keywords-Invoice Schedule, Item, Life Cycle, Status, To Be Scheduled, Data Source, Sales Order Item with Invoice Schedule Items, Report

Title: How to Send PDF Document Using Campaigns in Marketing
Content: Symptom-You want to send PDF documents via campaigns instead of HTML-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Marketing work center.-View: Campaign Management.-Sub-view: Campaigns.-Cause-It is not possible to send PDF documents instead of HTML via mass email campaigns in SAP Business Bydesign.-Resolution-This is expected system standard behavior.-Keywords-Campaign; Marketing; HTML; PDF

Title: Line Item Currency Not Assigned in Trial Balance Report
Content: Symptom-In the Trial Balance Report for some G/L Accounts, the Line Item Currency is displayed as 'Not assigned'. Some G/L accounts have multi currency transactions. You wonder how to check the total amount for each currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Lists subview in the Reports view.-Search for the report Trial Balance and select it.-Run the report for Company ABC (ABC stands for the company ID) and Set of Books XYZ (XYZ stands for the Set of Books).-To the row fields add the field Line Item Currency. -For certain G/L Accounts, the Line Item Currency is Not Assigned.-Cause-Trial Balance is a standard report and it is built on a standard data source which is of type Combined. -This is the expected behaviour for Combined data sources and all reports based on them. -When the fields in the report view come from different basic data source, this will result in 2 lines, where one shows the data available in the first data source, and the other line shows the data from the second data source.-Resolution-In order to check the sum data of line currency, you can click 'Show Result Row' in the report column to add the summary figure.-In this way, you are able to see the sum of amount for each currency under each G/L Account.-See Also-2488796 - Multiple Lines in Combined Data Sources-Keywords-Trial Balance report, not assigned, line item currency, G/L-Account

Title: Warning Message is Triggered for Supplier Invoice When Clicking in Check Button
Content: Symptom-Warning message "Item ABC: The delivery note XYZ is not found. The delivery note does not exist or is inactive, or the supplier, buying company, product, product category, or product type in the delivery note differs from that in the supplier invoice." is triggered when clicking in Check button for Supplier Invoice. -ABC is the item's number. -XYZ is the inbound delivery's ID. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for PQR (PQR is the supplier invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button.-Click in Check button.-You get the warning message:-Item ABC: The delivery note XYZ is not found. The delivery note does not exist or is inactive, or the supplier, buying company, product, product category, or product type in the delivery note differs from that in the supplier invoice.-Cause-This warning message is triggered because of the Cost Distribution maintained for the item. If it is maintained more than one line in Cost Distribution, the system triggers the warning message. -If only one line is maintained in the Cost Distribution, the warning message is not triggered. -Resolution-Please note that since it is a warning message, you can ignore it. Only error messages will stop the user from processing the document. So you can just ignore it. The system is working as designed. -Keywords-Supplier invoice; Warning message; Delivery note; Cost distribution

Title: Error: "During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error ' application runtime exception, report an incident' occurred " in Actual Cost Rollup Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***RELEASED INTERNALLY***-Error: "During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error ' application runtime exception, report an incident' occurred " in Actual Cost Rollup Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to Actual Cost Rollup View.-Find run XXXX-XX-XXXXXXX.-View the log of it.-Go to tab Messages.-You will see Error: During run for company ABC, set of books DEF, the error 'application runtime exception, report an incident' occurred.-To check the dump information from backend:-Log on to Backend via STFK.-Run Transaction ST22.-Find the dump.-In the detailed information, you will see:-What happened?-    Error in the ABAP application program.-    The current ABAP program "CL_FIA_MCE_ACT_QS_CONTROLLER==CP" had to be interrupted because it contains a statement that cannot be executed.-Error analysis-    A line was to be inserted or modified at position 1 of the sorted internal table (type SORTED_TABLE) "\CLASS=CL_FIA_MCE_ACT_QS_CONTROLLER\METHOD=DET_TRANS_STRUC_PL\DATA=LTS_MSG".-    The sort sequence of the table determined by its key was disrupted as a result.-Cause-In the actual cost rollup run, it is calculating production lot 123. And in the production lot 123, resource 456 is used and its cost unit is Second/Minute/Hour, but resource 456 does not have valuation (meaning in the cost rate, there is only currency but no amount), so the system will look to the service 789 maintained for the resource. The Cost Unit of the service 789 is cubic meters(or others) other than Second/Minute/Hour. As there is no conversion set for Cubic meter -> Time(Second/Minute/Hour), the system raises the Error.-Resolution-You need to maintain the Quantity Conversions for the service under tab General in the master data so that the system can calculate the actual cost rollup for the Production Lot.-Keywords-actual cost rollup; dump; CL_FIA_MCE_ACT_QS_CONTROLLER==CP; \CLASS=CL_FIA_MCE_ACT_QS_CONTROLLER\METHOD=DET_TRANS_STRUC_PL\DATA=LTS_MSG.

Title: Error When Trying to Execute an Employee Replication Between SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Success Factors
Content: Symptom-The following error message occurs when trying to perform an Employee Replication.-Time Profile start date can't be changed with multiple profile splits. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center and Employees view.-Query by Failed/Not Started.-Check the affected Remote Employee ID.-It will have mentioned error.-Cause-The error occurs due to a gap between Work Agreements of the failed and latest successful replication requests which is the cause for the Time file error.-Resolution-In order to fix this error, you must update the replication request without gaps in the work agreement. This can be checked in the Employee Replication screen, Employment tab.-Keywords-Error, Time Profile start date can't be changed with multiple profile splits, Cannot, Unable, Employee Replication, Master Data Replication, Work agreement.

Title: Unable to open Business Transaction for Paid Concur Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You want to view the Business transaction of a Concur Expense Report that is in status Paid. But the Business Transaction does not open.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Expenses.-Search and find Report Key: XYZ (XYZ represents the Expense Report Key ID).-Select View -> Business transaction.-You expect the Business Transaction details to open, but no document details open.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-You can only view the Business Transaction for Expense Reports in Status Posted.-However if you would like to view this information you can follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Source Documents.-Select the dropdown view "All Source Documents".-Search and find XYZ.-Select Actions.-Select View Business Transaction.-Keywords-Concur, Source Document, Expense, Business Transaction, Paid, Posted

Title: How to Identify if There is a PDI Solution Involved in the Integration Between Business Bydesign and Success Factors
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This KBA show how to check if there is a PDI involved in the integration between Business ByDesign and Success Factors.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center and then Employees view.-Show All and search for the affected Employee ID.-Click Actions > Upload Data from Employee Central.-Then click Upload Data.-Maintain Remote Employee ID.-Click Ok.-A dump occurs.-Resolution-These steps must be performed by the colleagues from ByD Technology team.-Access the backend.-Go to the Transaction SE20.-Enter ‘ES_EC_INTEGRATION_QUERY’ in Enhancement spot and click on Display Icon.-Expand the Items.-Now check that there are two BADI Implementation. One is for Query Request and the other is for Query Response.-When you double click the implementation, it will show if any solution (enhancement/BADI implementation) was implemented. It starts with Y*.-Now if you check the dump in the ST22, you can check the ABAP Program that has the error. e.g CL_ECINT_ADQRY_ACT_EXECUTE_CEQ’, in the section of "Information on where terminated".-This is calling the BADI implementation for Query request, this can been seen in the line that has "CALL BADI mo_bady_query_request -> configure_query".-Keywords-Business ByDesign, Success Factors, Integration, Master Data Replication, Employees, Upload Data from Employee Central, Dump, Error.

Title: Kit Integrity Violated for Item; Quantity Inconsistent
Content: Symptom-For Kit item product with Serial Number in Third Party Inter Company Business Scenario, you split it into two items with different Identified Stocks and Serial Numbers while processing standard Outbound Delivery Process. -Then below error occurs while releasing Third-party Delivery Notification. -Item ID B is not valid kit item for parent line item A-Kit integrity violated for item B; quantity inconsistent-Kit integrity violated for item C; quantity inconsistent-Quantity inconsistent for kit product XXX, parent line item A-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Order Fulfillment Work Center.-Navigate to Third-Party Delivery Notifications View.-Search for the notification and select it.-Choose Release button, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-Our development team had found the root cause of this issue and corrected the code line.-The corresponding hotfix is scheduled to deployed on the weekend of 02-02-2024. It means that the issue would no long occur in future release after 05-02-2024.-Resolution-For affected documents, there is no option to fix them even with L7 correction authorization. After the deployment of the hotfix, user can cancel the affected documents and create new ones to continue the business.-See Also-2852086 - Third Party Inter Company Scenario-Keywords-Kit Integrity Violated for Item, Quantity Inconsistent, Kit Product, PCE.

Title: How to Upgrade a Workspace in Backend?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A workspace has to be upgrade from the backend. How to do this?-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-Note: Once an upgrade is started, the progess and results can be fetched from transaction SLG1 (object BCT).-With BCTADM-You can use transaction BCTADM. ATTENTION: This transaction has a lot of options that can harm the system. If your are not 100% sure, what you are doing, Discuss with ByD Technology PAL / BC Development-Advantage of this procedure: easy to trigger and remember, disadvantage: upgrade runs in Dialog Mode (might run into Time Outs for longer upgrades)-Start transaction BCTADM-Select Update Workspace in section Workspace Oprerations-Select the correct Workspace ID (press Enter to verify description)-Execute (F8)-With Report RP_BCT_WS_UPGRADE-Triggers the same upgrade as BCTADM but from a ABAP Report. This has the advantage of being able to be triggered as background job (avoids Time Outs).-Start transaction SE38-Enter Report RP_BCT_WS_UPGRADE and execute (F8)-Select the Workspace ID from the value help-To execute in Dialog Mode: Press F8-Note: DO NOT USE "Forced Mode" - This is specific to development-To execute in Background Mode: Press F9 and set the execution to Immediate in the popup and Save.-When WS upgrade is necessary? (below are some of the scenarios)-System shows "Check for Upgrade..." while trying to open activity list for First Implementation Project or a Change Project-If the changes from customer (scoping/fine tuning) or SAP changes (backend) are not reflecting in the tenant-Workspace / project is inconsistent in the frontend-Keywords-BC, workspace, upgrade, backend

Title: Error: 'Operation Not Possible; Business Document Locked' Occurred In Process Communication
Content: Symptom-Goods and Services Receipt Failed With Process Communication Error: 'Operation not possible; business document locked'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Process Communication Errors view-Display Show: Open Errors which require no action -Their information is listed below: -Sending document: Goods and Services Receipt ABC-Receiving document: Business Transaction (For Accounting) [ID unavailable] -Main error: Operation not possible; business document locked-Related error: Purchasing document item could not be locked-Sending document: Goods and Services Receipt DEF-Receiving document: Business Transaction (For Accounting) [ID unavailable] -Main error: Operation not possible; business document locked-Related error: Forecast document is locked-Cause-The Goods and Service Receipts in the process communication errors are posted and the Journal Entries are also created.-Resolution-The system does not allow to reverse the transaction with different posting date. In order to resolve the errors, cancel the GSRs ABC and DEF.-Note: "Open error which requires no action" messages are already processed messages, hence they cannot be cancelled.-Keywords-Process Communication Error, Goods and Service Receipts, Open error which requires no action,

Title: Dump"500 SAP Internal Server Error" while replicating Reporting Line Units
Content: Symptom-User want to replicate reporting line unit but system is throwing dump once replication is triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Master Data Replication Workcenter view-2. Navigate to Reporting Line Units view-3. Choose Option failed/not started from drop down.-4. Select Remote Reporting Line Unit ID--5. Select Replicate-System loads for a while and triggers dump "500 SAP Internal Server Error"-Cause-Replication run might be already triggered by user and it is running at background hence lock is creating inconsistency .-Resolution-There would be background job running on org center replication .-To check running replication request follow below steps,-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter view-Navigate to Background Jobs-Choose " All Running Jobs" from drop down.-Keywords-RLU replication error, Object currently locked by User, replication run, background job

Title: Data Source Yield & Scrap Displays ‘Not assigned’ in Row Field ‘Scrap Reason’
Content: Symptom-You have confirmed scrap quantity with deviation reason for repointing point in a production task. However, check corresponding production lot in standard data source Yield & Scrap (SCMYASU01), row field ‘Scrap Reason’ displays ‘Not assigned’.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In work center Supply Planning, open common task New Planning Proposal, create a new production proposal manually, release it to production request.-Create a new production order on basis of this production request.-Release this production order.-Open a make task of this production order. Click Confirm.-Maintain some quantity for Confirmed Scrap. Select Tool broken for Deviation Reason. Click Save.-Click Change Status - Finish.-Click OK in pop-up window.-Go to work center Business Analytics, access view Design Data Source. Find data source  "Yield & Scrap" (SCMYASU01), click Preview.-Enter the production lot ID you just worked on in filter Production Lot ID. Click Apply.-Select View, click button + on Row Fields, search Scrap Reason and add it.-In the result, Scrap Reason is Not assigned.-Cause-Data source Yield & Scrap (SCMYASU01) is providing the quantities of yield and scrap recorded for a production order. That means total confirmed and scrap quantities of each reporting point of production lot/order. However, Deviation reason(scrap reason) is a field at production confirmation level rather than production lot - reporting point level. For example: production lot - reporting point - RP01 has three production confirmations, CONF1,CONF2,CONF3.-CONF1 has 0 scrap quantity.-CONF2 has 1 scrap quantity with tool broken as scrap reason.-CONF3 has 2 scrap quantity with material damage as scrap reason.- -Hence, Yield & Scrap (SCMYASU01) will not display anything in the scrap reason since there are multiples reasons from multiple confirmations, and it is not reasonable to display any one of them.-Here this data source only gives the reporting point level data with scrap and confirmed quantities but not confirmations level data.-Resolution-This is standard behavior of data source Yield & Scrap. Please use standard report Confirmation Journal (SCMCFJU01_Q0001) to check deviation reason of production confirmation.-Keywords-Production Lot, Production Order, Yield & Scrap, Deviation Reason, Scrap Reason, Not assigned

Title: Create Inventory Adjustment
Content: Symptom-- Need to perform an inventory adjustment for a specific product.-- The goal is to adjust the available stock to zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Supply Planning work center.-2. Navigate to the Products view.-3. Search for the relevant Product Planning Area combination and select the Open button.-4. The available stock is displayed.-5. The aim is to perform an adjustment confirmation and reduce this stock to zero.-Cause-The need to adjust the inventory could arise when there is a discrepancy between the planned inventory and the system's record of the stock.-Resolution-1. Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-2. Navigate to the Common Tasks view and select the option New Inventory Adjustment.-3. In the New Inventory Adjustment Screen, enter the relevant details of the site and the product, then select the Next button.-4. In the Edit Inventory chevron, enter the Logistics Area and Product ID and select the flag Zero Quantity.-5. Select the Next button to move to the Review chevron.-6. Review the information and select the Finish button.-7. The stock for the product in the relevant logistics area will be updated to zero.-See Also-Inventory Adjustment Help Document-Keywords

Title: Invalid Access Group For a Work Center View ID in a Business Role
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Access Group ID for a Business Role under Access Restrictions tab and some of the options are listed as Invalid Access Group.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center (SAP Business ByDesign) or Administrator Work Center (SAP Cloud for Customer).-Go to Business Roles View.-Select the Business Role affected.-Click on Edit button.-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Select the Work Center View ID affected.-Under Details Restrictions some of the Access Group ID are listed as Invalid Access Group.-Cause-The Org Unit referenced by the Access Group ID was deleted or is no longer valid in the system. Therefore, to ensure the system consistency it displays the Invalid Access Group as reference for those Org Units, hence this is the expected system behavior.  -Resolution-For this case, we recommend to remove the Invalid Access Group options by unchecking the Invalid Access Group and saving the changes in the business role, as it is only being displayed as a reference to the Org Unit that is not available in the system anymore.-To remove the Invalid Access Group options follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center (SAP Business ByDesign) or Administrator Work Center (SAP Cloud for Customer).-Go to Business Roles View.-Select the Business Role affected.-Click on Edit button.-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Select the Work Center View ID affected.-Uncheck the Invalid Access Group option.-Click on Save.-The Invalid Access Group will not be displayed in the UI for the Work Center View ID of the business role.-Keywords-byd, c4c, Invalid Access Group, Business Role, Work Center ID

Title: The Posting Date and Request Date is Inconsistency in Mobile APP and UI
Content: Symptom-The posting date and request date is inconsistency in Mobile APP and UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login ByD mobile APP.-Go to Manage Approval.-Go to Sales Order.-Open Sales Order ABC.-Note down the posting data and requested data.-Login ByD UI.-Go to Sales Order work center -> Sales Order View.-Search for the Sales Order ABC.-The posting/requested date is different with those noted down in Step 5.-Cause-The logged user is in a different time zone with the recorded date.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. The dates shown on the sales order might appear to be different than that stored in the BO because of the difference in the time zones and due to the internal time zone conversion, this difference in the dates is observed.-The data on the manager approval screen in mobile APP is fetched and displayed as it presents on the sales order BO. But in the normal UI, if the time zone of the logged user is different than the time zone of the posting/requested date stored in the backend, then due to internal time zone conversion, the different date is shown on the UI.-In some cases where the time zone for the logged user is same as that of the data in the backend then there is no time conversion and same date is shown on the UI.-Keywords-Posting Date, Request Date, Inconsistency, Mobile APP, Sales Order

Title: How to check User Change logs, Login IP address, Export, Activity Details
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA will help you to get the details on when requirement comes from the customer regarding the security breach related concerns and asks for the logs for the User login, User Change logs, User login IP details, User Exports/Imports and etc.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Example customer is looking for the below logs from SAP:-Logs of IP Adresses that logged into the users in the system-As per the SAP standard parameters maintained in SAP server we do not have the information at the user level hence details about IP Address of user who logged into Tenant is not available to provide.-Logs of failed authentifications for the users-For these details you can ask operations to give the details.-Was the log in done via SSO or via UserID+Password-This can be prediected by the change logs in the Changes tab when you edit the Access Rights for a user-Logs on all the password changes that were issued for the users-When was the last password change for this user? Which user triggered this password change?-These details can also be checked by you in the front end as well as in backend under SU01 t code.-3212403 - How to Check When and Why a User gets Locked or Unlocked-If you create incident to Operations, even operations can provide these details.-Logs of activities of the users in the system. What kind of data were accessed by the intruders?-These details can be provided by the SAP Operations team, you can create incident to operations with the details of the user and system they will help you to provide the details in shared link, which you can share it to customer.-Logs of exports - Did the intruders export any reports or data from the system?-Possible ways to export the data from the system is below:-Mass Data Maintenance, check these logs and apply filter by the Requested/Created User-Data Extraction, check by the Data Extraction Run created by-Other possible way is to export data in excel format from the specific work center-Exporting the Output history-Reports from Business ANalytics work center-Which customer can anyways check from their end.-SAP doesn't have any possibilities to check what kind of data has been exported and how it has been exported.-Some of above requirements will be available in the Report under Business Analytics work center -> Design Reports -> Report Name "User Logon Details", "User Activation and Deactivation Log"  & "All Current Users"  request you to explore this.-Keywords-User Change log, User Login Details, User Activity, User Logon Details, User Activation and Deactivation Log, All Current Users

Title: Character in Codice Fiscale Number does not match the last name
Content: Symptom-When modifying the Codice Fiscale Number of an employee, the system throw an error "Character ABC in Codice Fiscale Number does not match the last name XYZ"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration -> Employee-Search for Employee XYZ and open the personnel file-Click Edit-In the field Codice Fiscale Number, input the code like ABC123456789-Click Save-Cause-The system cannot detect the special characters in the employee's last name.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior. For Codice Fiscale Number, the first three letters will be the first three consonant letters of the employee's last name. However, the system cannot detect special characters. If an employee's last name include special character in the the first three consonant letters, the system will regard the special character as a consonant letter.-For example, if the last name is X'YZ, for the system, the first three consonant letters will be X'Y while it should be XYZ. In this case, remove the special character will resolve this issue.-Keywords-Character does not match, last name, special character, Codice Fiscale Number

Title: Unable to Add Extension Field to Data Source Company Master Data ( /MOM/COMPANY)
Content: Symptom-User has created extension fields in the org unit categorization screen, but they are unable to add these extension fields to the Data Source Company Master Data (/MOM/COMPANY)-(Here /MOM/COMPANY is a Data Source ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Go to Common Tasks -Navigate to Org unit categorization task-Go to user login icon-Select key user settings -Start adaptation mode-Go to created extension field-Show further usage-Go to Data sources and reports tab-Not able to add Company master data source(/MOM/COMPANY)-Cause-The org unit extension field is intended only for financial reports (like profit center master data-/MOM/PROFITCTR and cost center master data-/MOM/COSTCTR ) . -(Here /MOM/PROFITCTR and /MOM/COSTCTR are Data Source ID)-Resolution-This is a current system design.-See Also-Overview of Data Sources in General Business Data-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2ca981c6722d1014b6f9d5b54eb77472.html-Keywords-/MOM/COMPANY;  /MOM/PROFITCTR; /MOM/COSTCTR; Extension Field; Company Master Data; org unit categorization; common task;

Title: Where does the Replacement Delivery Date come from in a Return to Supplier?
Content: Symptom-When creating a New Return to supplier, after inputting Follow-up Decision as Replacement or Partial Credit Memo & Replacement, system auto generates a Replacement Delivery Date. Where the Replacement Delivery Date comes from?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to New Return to Supplier view.-Select the relevant Inbound Delivery Items.-Click Next button.-Enter the returned Quantity and Reason.-Click Next button.-Click Finish button and system will guide you to provide a Follow-up Decision in Return to Supplier XXX (XXX respective the ID of Return to Supplier).-Now open the Return to Supplier XXX.-Select the follow-up decision as Replacement or Partial Credit Memo & Replacement in down list.-System will auto generate a default time in Replacement Delivery Date filed.-Cause-In the return to supplier process, after selecting the Follow-up Decision as Partial Credit Memo & Replacement or Replacement, the replacement date will be calculated 7 days from the current shipment date. -Resolution-This is standard functionality, programmatically system-generating.-Keywords-Return to Supplier, Replacement Delivery Date, Shipment Date.

Title: Sales Order Invoice Request is Inconsistent as Tax Exemption Certificate is Not Valid
Content: Symptom-Sales Order Invoice Request is inconsistent and cannot be processed. When the Check button is selected, the following error message is displayed:-Tax Exemption Certificate Not Valid-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Navigate to Invoice Requests view.-Search for invoice requests related to sales order ABC (ABC represents the sales order ID).-Select the inconsistent Sales Order Invoice Request.-Click Check.-The error "Tax Exemption Certificate Not Valid" is displayed.-Cause-The tax exemption certificate is blocked in account XYZ, which is the account used in the sales order (XYZ represents the Account ID).-Resolution-1. Unblock the Tax Exemption Certificate-Go to Account Management work center.-Navigate to Accounts view.-Search for and edit account XYZ.-Navigate to the Financial Data tab.-Open the Tax Exemption Certificate sub-tab.-Select the relevant certificate ID.-Change the certificate status to Unblock.-2. Update Pricing in the Sales Order-After the tax exemption certificate is unblocked in the account master data:-Go to Sales Order work center.-Navigate to Sales Orders view.-Search for and edit sales order ABC.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Select Update Pricing.-Select Completely.-Save the sales order.-Once the above steps are completed, the Sales Order Invoice Request becomes consistent and can be processed further.-See Also-KBA 3003112 - Tax Exemption Certificate Not Valid-Keywords-Sales Order; Sales Order Invoice Request; Invoice Request; Inconsistent Invoice Request; Tax Exemption Certificate; Tax Exemption Certificate Not Valid; Tax Certificate; Blocked Certificate; Unblock Tax Exemption Certificate; Account Master Data; Financial Data; Pricing; Update Pricing; Sales Order Pricing

Title: Currency unit ABC not allowed; missing exchange rate into XYZ
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer has reported a Sales Order with a process communication error which is being caused due to the following error: -Currency unit ABC not allowed; missing exchange rate into XYZ-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Backend/STFK.-Enter transaction SRT_MONI.-Filter for the following services:-Sender Party: CustomerRequirementProcessing    -Receiver Service Interface: SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn    --System returns the following error: Currency unit ABC not allowed; missing exchange rate into XYZ-Cause-The reason this is happening is because the Exchange Rate is valid from 30.05.2023 23:00, which is outside the selection criteria, since for the system to select the proper exchange rate for an item it checks for creation date-time.-For the system to determine the exchange rate both document creation date and exchange rate should be less than or equal to the creation date of the document.-In this example, the date for exchange rate is set for the 30.05.2023 23:00 and creation date of Sales Order is 12.05.2023.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-Please inform the customer to change the exchange rate date. -Keywords-Currency unit, not allowed, missing exchange rate into, Exchange Rate, Sales Order, Process Communication Error, Error
