Title: Journal Entry Voucher For a Multi-Customer Project - Customer and Multi-Customer Projects not Allowed for G/L postings
Content: Symptom-You create a Journal Entry Voucher of type 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher or Recurring Journal Entry Voucher and assign a Multi-Customer Project task to a line item when an error message appears:-'Customer and multi-customer projects not allowed for G/L postings'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General  Ledger work center.-Select the New Journal Entry Voucher common tasks.-Select the Journal Entry type 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher.-Add the Row for the debit and the credit with the Project Task.-The error message 'Customer and multi-customer projects not allowed for G/L postings' appears.-Note - The error message appears at the time of creation of Recurring Journal Entry Voucher as well.-Cause-For Sales Projects, either Customer project with sales integration or Multi-Customer Project you can only use the JEV type 00088 – Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-The JEV type 00047 only posts in the General ledger without any subledger involvement.-Resolution-If you just need to reassign costs or revenues to a Multi-Customer project use Journal Entry Voucher type 00088 – Manual Entry for Sales Documents and screen variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the New Journal Entry Voucher common tasks.-In the new screen, select Journal Entry type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-Select the Screen Variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.-Maintain the line items as needed, crediting or debiting the Multi-Customer Project in one line item and the respective cost object (for example a Profit Center) in the other line item. -Press Simulate.-This time the simulation of journal entry posting is possible.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign help document Manual Entries for Sales Documents-Keywords-Customer and multi-customer projects not allowed for G/L postings; Multi-Customer Project, Manual Journal Entry Voucher for Sales Documents; Kundenprojekte/Projekte für mehrere Kunden für Sachkontenbuch. unzulässig

Title: Error Message "Lowercase or special characters not permitted in field ID of node ROOT"
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Location and Logistic Area using migration, system throws below error message:-Lowercase or special characters not permitted in field ID of node ROOT-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Location and Logistics Area-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the you have used special characters (Ex: &) in the Logistics Area ID-Resolution-Businss ByDesign restricts the usage of special characters (Example: &) for Location and Logistics area IDs-Keywords-"Lowercase or special characters not permitted in field ID of node ROOT", Migration, Logistics, ByD

Title: HSN Code Not Piccked by JSON File
Content: Symptom-You have created an Invoice document with Free text item and after the document was approved, you noticed that the HSN Code is missing from the JSON File.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Document created).-Under the General tab, navigate to the Attachments subtab.-Open the JSON File.-You see the following is empty: "HsnCd": "",-Cause-For the Free text item, the HSN code is not printed on the Form and is not available in JSON file.-In customer invoicing, the HSN code is derived from product master data.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-As a workaround, kindly add the HSN code manually to JSON file and upload the data to IRP portal.-Another alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-See Also-KBA 3435446 - Unable to Create E-Invoice Due to Free Text Item used in Customer Invoice.-Keywords-HSN Code, Code, HSN, JSON, File, Free Text, Free, Text, Invoice

Title: Error during ATP Check on provider side; report an incident.
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to perform ATP check in a sales order for line items, system throws an error:--Error during ATP Check on provider side; report an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales order work center.-Go to Sales Orders View.-Show: All orders via drop down.-Search required sales order ID and edit it.-Here warning message occurs as below :-  Error during ATP Check on provider side; report an incident.-Cause-Since for "To-Stock" items, quantity is not updated therefore while checking ATP system throws an error.-   Resolution-Once user updates the quantity against each line item, ATP gets triggered and as per the stock availability in the system error disappears.-Maintain the quantity against the line items in a sales order then system checks the ATP for required quantity as per ship from determination.-Keywords-Error during ATP Check on provider side; report an incident, ATP, check availability, sales order

Title: Supplier Invoice Error "Posting failed; Document numbering rule for self-invoice is not defined"
Content: Symptom-System throws below error for supplier invoice hence unable to post the manual ERS (Self Invoice) though Document Numbering Rule is maintained correctly.-Posting failed; Document numbering rule for self-invoice is not defined-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center -Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select Manual ERS Credit Memo-Fill mandatory details & select Post -Above error appears- Cause-In the Business Configuration work center, for Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing,-User has defined two rules for the Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing.-For the first rule, Self-Invoice/ERS is not marked and for the second rule Self-Invoice/ERS is marked as "Yes".-Resolution-The Second rule defined for the  Self-Invoice/ERS has to be moved to the top so that system considers it while creating the self-invoices(evaluated receipt settlement).-Note: The sequence of rules in the list is important as the determination of document numbering formats works from top to bottom.-Keywords-Error in Supplier Invoice; Error "Posting failed; Document numbering rule for self-invoice is not defined"; Manual ERS Error; Unable to Post Supplier Invoice;

Title: Error Message "Partial Day Absences Not Allowed as No Planned Working Time" When Trying to Release or Approve Time
Content: Symptom-You are trying to take action regarding time recordings, either in the Project Management work center or the Time Administration work center, when the system throws the below error message:-On MM/DD/YYYY partial day absences not allowed as no planned working time (where MM/DD/YYYY stands for a date in month-day-year format).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Partial absences are not allowed if recorded on a public holiday (no planned working time). Partial day absences are identified on the maintained duration of the time recordig in the employee's time sheet.-This message might be raised even if the action (approval/release of time) being taken is not executed in the same date to which the error message refers — this is because these actions will trigger a valuation that covers all time behind the date in which the action is being taken, so it will catch any such occurrence that exists in the past.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-There are several possibilities on how to handle this behavior:-1. Remove the duration of the vacation/leave entered on MM/DD/YYYY. The time will then be treated as a full-day absence on a public holiday and will not result in the error message, as full day absences will be paired with planned working time for that day and if there is no working time, the valuation will not take advantage of that vacation/leave.-2. Define a working time model for MM/DD/YYYY to get planned working time. The vacation will then be valuated/leave and the time account for holiday time will be updated.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Time Model View.-Click New.-Create a new Period model ABC and the valid From/To date should involve MM/DD/YYYY.-Define MM/DD/YYYY as a work day. For example, if MM/DD/YYYY is Saturday, assign a Daily Model to Day 6.-Save and Finish the Period model ABC.-Select the Employees view.-Select the employee and open his/her time file. -Go to Time Profile.-Add a new row under Time Profile and assign Period model ABC under the Work Schedule. Note the start date and the end date when modify the Time Profile to avoid inconsistency or overlap. -3. Remove the recorded absence time as MM/DD/YYYY is a public holiday defined in holiday calendar. To see employee's recorded time:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the employee and open his/her time file. -Select the Employee Times tab and select the category Vacation or Leave and the corresponding date (MM/DD/YYYY) in the table view. -The time should appear there. Now the time administrator can delete the time entry.-See Also-3044983 -  Error Message "Partial Day Absences Not Allowed as No Planned Working Time" When Trying to Book Leave-Keywords-Partial absence not allowed, cannot release time, public holiday

Title: The withholding tax is not shown in the journal entry of the payment - nonlocalized Countries/Regions
Content: Symptom-Your supplier invoice has more than one withholding tax included on it, however, when you check the Journal entry of the payment, you notice the taxes are not included.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center > Invoices and Credit Memos-Search for your Supplier Invoice and open it-Go to the Document Flow tab-Open the Journal entry of the Payment Order-You notice that the withholding taxes are not included in the Journal Entry-Cause-During the configuration of the Withholding tax, the system offers two possibilities:  "WHT due at invoice and not relevant for down payment" or "WHT due at payment and relevant for down payment", depending on the country specific requirements. See page 16 of the documentation.-If you are using the option "WHT due at payment and relevant for down payment", there is a system limitation that does not support multiple Taxes.-Due to this limitation, the system does not show the values of the Withholding taxes in the Journal Entry of the payment document.-Resolution-It is a known limitation in the SAP Business ByDesign system and there is already an Improvement Request in the Influence Channel for this topic. See below, please:-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/idea/300806-Requests need 20 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis twice a year, with the results being communicated in the corresponding review blog post. The ideas can be voted by other customers and partners and the most voted ones might be collected to the product backlog for future versions.-See Also-Enable Withholding Tax for NonLocalized Countries/Regions in SAP-Keywords-withholding tax, WHT

Title: Removal of Third-Party Cookies in Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge Browser
Content: Symptom-Starting in Q1/24, end users may face issues with their web applications when running in Chrome due to Chrome's third-party cookie deprecation.-End users could experience broken authentication flows or content sections not loading or behaving correctly. -Affected are all applications utilizing third-party cookies, especially those that embed content from other domains with iFrames and rely on:-a) Cookie-based authentication / Single-Sign-On. Authentication via, for example, Identity Provider or Java session tokens could break randomly, content sections may not load or authentication flows could get interrupted.-b) Application-specific mechanisms that require cookies. Previous end user customization or application configuration might be ignored. -c) A combination of both.-Starting January 4th, 2024, this will initially affect 1% of end users when using an unmanaged Chrome browser. More users will be affected over time. After Q2/24, without mitigation, affected products will break for all end users when using Chrome.-Microsoft Edge is built on Chromium. As far as we know, Microsoft will follow the Chrome approach shortly after.-Reason and Prerequisites-This note is primarily addressing Google Chrome's third-party cookie deprecation and its implications.-Third-party cookies are used for tracking, advertising, session management, SSO, personalization. At SAP, we use them for session management and Single Sign-On (SSO).-Browser vendors are in the process of deprecating or limiting the use of third-party cookies to prevent user tracking for data privacy reasons:-- Firefox and Safari have already changed their default behavior by blocking third-party cookies while allowing end users to manually opt-in again.-- Google Chrome begins its deprecation plans on January 4th, 2024. Microsoft Edge is built on Chromium. As far as we know, they will follow the Chrome approach shortly after.-Google Chrome takes a different path by permanently blocking third-party cookies after 2024. End users will only be able to manually opt-in again throughout 2024. Afterwards, Google will fully block third-party cookies, leading to a breaking change in affected applications.-Google rolls out the change in a phased approach, starting for 1% of end users on January 4th, ramping up to 100% of end users by the end of 2024, subject to approval by the CMA (see Section F). During the phase-out, only unmanaged Chrome instances will be affected.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario/Symptom examples :-HTML Mashup – Wherever external domains are integrated may impact in loading. For Example: Google Maps loading issue or Login page -SSO – Single Sign On -Resolution-Client-side solutions (end users / IT departments):-Note: The options listed are considered temporary. We do not yet know how long any of these will remain in Chrome.-End users can use Chrome's opt-in feature to allow all third-party cookies within a given website. This blog post, "The next step toward phasing out third-party cookies in Chrome", explains how the "opt-out” for users will work. -A list of top-level domains can be added to a local allow list in the Chrome browser config either via policies or manual configuration.-Open chrome://settings/cookies or navigate to Chrome > "Settings" > "Privacy and Security" > "Third-party Cookies". -IT departments should consider actively managing Chrome browsers since managed browsers are initially excluded from the phased roll-out.

Title: Error Unit of Measure and Currency Missing
Content: Symptom-You are facing a process communication error between a Customer Return and a Customer Invoice with the error: Unit of Measure and Currency Missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Return).-Click the Edit button.-Click View All button.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Error is between the Customer Return to the Customer Invoice document.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Process Communication Errors view.-Select line with: -Sending Document: Customer Invoice-Sending Document ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Customer Invoice)-Receiving Document: Customer Return-Receiving Document ID: ABC-Main Error: Unit of measure and currency missing.-Resolution-This is a known inconsistency which requires a manual correction by SAP.-Please create a case with the following and send it to SAP:-Add the Document IDs which are in error.-Provide permission for a manual correction to be performed.-Keywords-Unit, Measure, Currency Missing, Return, Error, Process Communication Error, Customer Invoice, Issue

Title: You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does Not Match Your User Settings
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--When you try to access the Edit Project Scope or Open Activity list from the Implementation Projects View, you receive an error message You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings.-Further, if you check the status of LAYER_CUST in the transaction APXREP_BROWSER, it will be inactive.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View-Select First Implementation project and select Edit Project Scope or Open Activity List-The system displays the error message You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings.-Cause-The deployment of one-off solution ended with errors which caused layer LAYER_CUST to become inactive. Hence there is a mismatch in the solution profile of the user and the main workspace.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you need to activate the layer strategy - LAYER_CUST in order to access the activity list of the project.-To activate the LAYER_CUST , follow the below mentioned steps.-Log in to the backend using the support user.-Enter t-code APXREP_BROWSER.-Go to menu path Environment -> Layer St. Maint.-Enter LAYER_CUST for the input field Layer Strategy Name.-Select Display. You will find that the layer strategy is Inactive.-Select Activate.-Once the activation is complete, you can access the activity list of the project.-See Also-2002244 - Error: You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does not Match Your User Settings.-1826066 - Error Message "You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does Not Match Your User Settings", While Accessing Scoping or Fine Tuning-Keywords-You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile, Error, Edit Project Scope, Open Activity

Title: Extra Line Feed Inserted in Statutory Report Journal - France (FEC) File
Content: Symptom-You run the Statutory Report: Journal - France and notice that on the resulting .txt file there is a break in the line after the G/L Account's name and this prevents the files from being read by the French Tax Administration:-Example:-00058|Report de solde|20000000023|20140101|280500|Amt Logiciel-|||2014-02-00000003|20140217|Exécution du report de solde|55 849,69|C|||20140217|55 849,69|EUR-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open General Ledger work centre.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Select Statutory Reports.-Choose Journal - France.-Click New.-Run the report.-Check the .txt file, you can see a break on some lines.-Cause-These breaks are displayed because there is an extra character (line feed) after the G/L Account's name in Business Configuration which is propagated to the report.-This character probably comes from copying and pasting the G/L Accounts' names into SAP Business ByDesign during configuration.-Resolution-Open Business Configuration work centre.-Go to Implementation Projects view and choose the relevant project.-Open the Activity List.-Navigate to Fine-tuning.-Search for the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Choose Edit chart of accounts.-Select the relevant Chart of Accounts.-Check the G/L Accounts impacted in Journal - France .txt file where you can see an extra line displayed.-Navigate to the second (empty) line, press Delete (leftward arrow key).-Repeat for all the impacted G/L Accounts.-Save.-The extra-line should now be gone and data in Journal-France .txt file should be displayed correctly once you run the report again.-Note:-If you check the Journal Entries associated to the G/L Accounts in the impacted lines, you will notice that the extra line is displayed there as well before correction.-Keywords-Journal - France; statutory; LF; line feed

Title: Confirmed Quantities Display Three Decimal Places in Custom Unit of Measure
Content: Symptom-During check Available-To-Promise (ATP), you find the confirmed quantity still shows 3 decimals for custom Unit of Measure(UoM), even if it is configured as zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-Navigate to Customer Demand View.-Select the Customer Demand XXX.-Navigate to Schedule Lines Sub-tab, you will note that the confirmed quantity shows 3 decimals with the custom UoM you created.-Cause-Open the master data of the confirmed product, you would find following information.-A Quantity Conversion between a standard UoM and the custom UoM.-Base/ Inventory Valuation UoM is the standard UoM.-Sales UoM is the custom one.-The confirmed quantity in some cases to have more than 3 decimal places, the issue is caused by a rounding to 3 decimal places during ATP checking.-As the consequence, the system creates a warehouse task with an additional line item for this product and the open quantity is the excess quantity caused by the rounding.-This is a known limitation in the live cache (planning and ATP).-Resolution-Please reject the redundancy decimals during confirming task as a workaround.-See Also-2828720 - Planning Does not Allow More Than Three Decimal Places-Keywords-UoM; Three Decimals; Customer Demand; ATP.

Title: Unable to Assign a Purchase Order Template as Output Template at Supplier Level
Content: Symptom-"No items found" when assigning a Purchase Order template to the supplier as an output template on the Collaboration window of the supplier record.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Select Supplier view.-Select any supplier and click Edit > Addresses.-Navigate to Collaboration tab.-Select Purchase Order under Business Document Settings and select template dropdown list under Output Channel Settings.-Then "No items found" shows.-Cause-For purchase order, there are different form group codes maintained for each of the operations like - Created PO, Changed PO and Cancelled PO. Therefore, the dropdown list shows empty, as the determination cannot be picked from only one group code since each group code represents a different operation in PO. This will lead to wrong output during different operations (Creation/Change/Cancel), if the template group is maintained at supplier level.-The feature to add PO template at supplier level will be fixed in future release.-Resolution-The same can be done in 'Form Template Selection' available under 'Application and User Management' work center. Please maintain these form template rules for PO using 'Form Template Selection', rather than at supplier level.-See Also-Help document <Form Template Selection Quick Guide>-Keywords-Supplier; Output Channel Settings; Purchase Order Template

Title: Unable to Find Attachment While Approving Goods and Service Receipts
Content: Symptom-An error message stating "You are not authorized to access the data" appears when the approver navigates to the document details of the goods and services receipts in order to view the attachments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Search for relevant GSR ID.-Edit it.-Choose required document ID link.-Choose View all.-System throws an error "You are not authorized to access the data" .-Navigate to attachments tab.-There are no attachments available.- Cause-You have read and write access to the work center “SRM_GODSSERVERICERECEIPS” as “restricted” so you can’t access the data.-Resolution-Check the documents in the attachments tab after changing the work center "SRM_GOODSSERVICERECEIPTS" access rights to "unrestricted."-Keywords-Attachments are not visible for approver; Goods and service receipt; Approver; You are not authorized to access the data;

Title: An Error Occurred During the Credit Memo Posting.
Content: Symptom-Error while posting the credit memo "Item Y: Account assignment data missing for item Y.Y; see Cost Distribution" (Y represents line item number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for relevant credit memo-Edit-Choose Check-System throws an error "Item Y: Account assignment data missing for item Y.Y; see Cost Distribution"-Cause-The purchase order and supplier invoice for the product have the process type "To-Stock," however the credit memo that was generated from the scanning view now has the process type "Non-Stock.". The error is raised because the process type "To Stock" does not have an account assignment. -Resolution-As the credit memo was generated using a scanned invoice, make any necessary corrections to the memo before generating the credit memo.-Or else create the new credit memo manually.-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to Invoice entry view-Search by the delivery ID-Click on New credit memo.  -Keywords-Account assignment data missing for item; see Cost Distribution; Unable to post credit memo; Process type in credit memo;

Title: Error: "Action not enabled" while Approving Manual Payment Task
Content: Symptom-You cannot approve Manual Payment Task due to an error message: 'Action not enabled'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Choose the Approvals view.-Search for the Task - Approve Manual Payment XXX (XXX means the Payment ID, for example, and Outgoing Bank Transfer).-Choose 'Approve' or 'Send Back for Revision'.-Error is displayed: 'Action not enabled'.-Cause-The relevant Accounting period for the payment is Blocked for posting and hence you are getting this error message.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you have to Open the relevant period and post the payment following the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Companies sub-view under the Master Data view.-Select the relevant company ID and choose Open and Close Period.-Search for the accounting period relevant for date DD/MM/YYYY. Here you can see that the Period Status is Blocked.-Now select the period and choose Open Periods.-Enter the First/Last Allowed Step to 010 - Operational Postings.-Click the Save button.-Now, you will be able to approve the corresponding Payment Task.-Keywords-Payment Approval Error, Action not enabled, Payment Task Error, Approve, Send Back for Revision

Title: Error Message: DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY; Cost Center A must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit
Content: Symptom-When you try to Activate an Org Structure, system throws below error message:-DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY; Cost center A must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Organizational management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures  link under Common Tasks.-3. Highlight the Org Structure.-4. Select Activate button and choose Activate All option.-Cause-There are different causes that lead to this error message:-1)-If you try to maintain a deviating Business Residence for an org unit which is Company A and the Business Residence B that you are trying to assign is Company B. Then as per generic rule there will never be a Business Residence found.-The fact that a deviation is maintained is meaningless. In fact, the chosen organization modeling violates the best practices given in the documentation because Company and Business Residence are on the same node.-The generic rule is that a Business Residences are always below a Company and belong to exactly one Company.-2)-In principle, A cost center must have a business Residence either on that Cost Center or above it.-If you have a Cost Center attribute assigned to an Org Unit then it is mandatory to have a Business Residence either in that Org Unit or any of its Superordinate Org Units.-3)-Seldom there is no problem about Cost Center itself and there is also a valid Business Residence assigned to it, but the error still happens.-The reason may be that one or some of the Superordinate Org Units of this Cost Center is not valid during the period DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY. For example, the Superordinate Profit Center is not valid during the period while the Cost Center has the definition as Profit Center itself, the system will pass the Profit Center check and propose a Business Residences error.-Resolution-1)-You have to either flag Company A also as a Business Residence (even if it has the same address, it has to have its own Business residence because a Business residence is always part of a Company and cannot be reused between companies) Or, Introduce a level below Company A which is the Business Residence (so separate the Company from the rest) this would fulfill the best practices.-2)-The system works as designed.-To resolve the issue, follow the below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Set the Effective From date as DD/MM/YYYY (Note: this date should be equal to the Valid From date of the Cost Center).-Search and highlight the Org Unit XYZ or its higher level org unit.-Go to Definitions tab.-Check the Business Residence option.-3)-Please make sure that all the Superordinate Org Units are valid from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY. If there is any Superordinate Org Unit unvalid, please first activate that Superordinate Org Unit and then activate the issued Cost Center.-See Also-You can also refer the Knowledge Base document:-1538493 - Error "DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY; Cost center XYZ must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org Unit. “ while Checking an Org Structure-Keywords-Activate, Org Unit, Org Structure, Cost center, must be below a Business Residence, It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit.

Title: Error Message: Cannot change timeline of cost center XYZ; cost center is used by financial accounting
Content: Symptom-You are trying to check or activate an organization unit or organization structure, however the system raises the following error:-"Cannot change timeline of cost center XYZ; cost center is used by financial accounting" (where XYZ represents the org unit ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Insert an effective date and click on OK.-Select an Org unit.-Navigate to the Timelines tab of the org unit.-Modify the end validity date of the org unit.-Click on the Check button.-Click on Selected and Dependent Org Structures.-Note: Alternatively, the same error happens when using the Activate button.-Cause-This error happens when the org unit being delimited is a cost center. There are different causes that may lead to this issue:-Cause 1:-There are postings which still exist for the cost center for a date after the end of the new validity. The system has prevented the shortening of the timeline to prevent the cost center from being inactive by the date of the postings.-This can be verified as follows:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Enter the Reports view.-Open the report "Cost Centers - Line Items".-Enter the relevant cost center.-Click on the Go button.-In the results you will find postings for the date after the one being set as the end of the validity.-Cause 2:-The validity of the cost center is being split into more than one time period interval. This causes the error message since there is an open/active Financial Accounting for this cost center, since it is not possible to split the validity of the Cost Center even if the validity dates do not have any gaps.-Cause 3:-If the cost center validity of the org unit is already split in more than one time period interval and these timelines are merged into one, the error message happens for a similar reason as of cause #2.-Resolution-Solution for Cause 1:-It is possible to end the timeline before a fiscal period with postings. In this case, the balance in the affected timeframe must be zero. In order to reach a balance of zero, try to reverse the journal entries that generated the postings. Where this is not possible, you can transfer the values so that the final balance would be zero. You can do this in the General Ledger work center under New Journal Entry Voucher.-After this adjust, you can change the validity of the org unit.-You may also choose to end the timeline of the cost center at the end of the latest fiscal period in which the cost center has postings. In this case, if you set the Valid To date of Org Units as the end date of the latest fiscal period, there should not be errors related to the financial accounting.-Solution for Causes 2 and 3:-To rectify the issue with splitting/merging time periods of the cost center, you can check the currently active version of the org Unit in the Active Area of the org structure and restore the same in the Planning Area.-For Example: if you merged the two time periods into one, then you can follow the below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Insert an effective date and click on OK.-Select an Org unit.-Navigate to the Definitions tab.-Uncheck the Cost center attribute.-Again mark the Cost center attribute.-Navigate to the Timelines tab.-Here you can see the changes will be rolled back as they were in the old time period.-Set the effective from date as today's date.-Click on the Check button.-Click on Selected and Dependent Org Structures.-Keywords-Posting, Timelines, Validity

Title: PSM - Release Request for Hiring, Rehiring or Transfer processes
Content: Symptom-To achieve the same kind of data entry that the standard tasks for hiring and rehiring allow via the SAP Standard UIs, you require public write access to one or some of the following Business Objects and its respective nodes and fields:-For hiring this is achieved using following SAP Standard view: Personnel Administration - Regular Tasks - Hire Employee.-For rehiring this is achieved via: Personnel Administration - Regular Tasks - Rehire Employee.-For transfer this is achieved using following SAP Standard view: Personnel Administration - Regular Tasks - Transfer Employee. -With enabled PSM, the BOs are displayed with 'Public Write Access: No' in the repository explorer, and the actual BO Model does not display any of the nodes and fields contained by the object:-Namespace: AP.PersonnelAdministration.Global, Business Object: PersonnelHiring-Namespace: AP.PersonnelAdministration.Global, Business Object: PersonnelTransfer-Viewing the same business object with disabled PSM reveals that there are indeed a number of nodes and fields for data entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-                                                                                                                                                                                                Resolution-The processes of hiring, termination, rehiring, and transfers within SAP are structured in a way that restricts alterations to the data once instances have been created. Due to these inherent limitations, it is not possible to provide PSM write access to modify or edit the instance of the records created during Hiring, Rehiring and Transfer processes. -This relates to:-Hiring and Rehiring-Business Object: PersonnelHiring-Technical Name: PAD_PERSONNEL_HIRING-Transfer-Business Object: PersonnelTransfer-Technical Name: PAD_PERSONNEL_TRANSFER-You may consider to utilize the following Inbound Service Interfaces:-II_MANAGE_PERS_HIRING_IN - Hiring-II_MANAGE_PERS_LEAVE_IN - Termination-II_MANAGE_PERS_REHIRE_IN - Rehiring-II_MANAGE_PERS_TRANSF_IN - Transfer-See Also-KBA: 2531650 - New Customer Request for Additional Feature or Function in SAP standard software  -Keywords-public solution model, development, access, missing, not available

Title: Application Error Message "HTTP Code: 503 ( Service Unavailable )" in Web Service Message Monitoring - Interface: _-ITSAM_-SM_SEARCH
Content: Symptom-You see web service messages with the error the message  "HTTP Code: 503 ( Service Unavailable )" . (Possibly several a day) -  Full Error message: -  Status: Application Error  -Message ID: ABC (Where "ABC" represents Message ID)-Error Text: HTTP Code: 503 ( Service Unavailable )  -Service Interface:   _-ITSAM_-SM_SEARCH -Service Interface Namespace      -urn:sap-com:document:sap:rfc:function -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Application & User Management-Web Service Message Monitoring-Result: You see web service messages with the error described above.-Cause-The application interface mentioned (ITSAM_-SM_SEARCH) is used for the Solution Search functionality.-The errors that are shown are still related to an old configuration which results in these kind of entries in Message Monitoring. -Resolution-These error messages can be ignored as they do not cause any impact in the customers' system. Also, the Solution Search functionality still should return results as expected.-Keywords-HTTP Code: 503 ( Service Unavailable ) , _-ITSAM_-SM_SEARCH, Web Service Error, Application Error, Outbound Message Failing, Outgoing

Title: PSM Request for Node PROD_INPUT_ITEM_SCRP_FACTOR of Business Object PRODUCTION_SEGMENT
Content: Symptom-Open any production model in the system and go to Bill of Operations Tab - Product Assignment Subtab, you will find field <Input Scrap> in the line of element Input Material.-You need to set the field during the migration of the production models. Since this field is not available in the migration file, you want to achieve that with the ABSL script.-However, you find that the PSM of Node PROD_INPUT_ITEM_SCRP_FACTOR is Not Released, while checking the association Business Object PRODUCTION_SEGMENT as per following path. -Path: BO PRODUCTION_MODEL -> Root PRODUCTION_SEGMENT > Associations BO PRODUCTION_SEGMENT ->Root ->PROD_INPUT_ITEM_SCRP_FACTOR- IPSCRAP-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Basically, production model is the hierarchical view of Bill of Operation + Bill of Material + additional info on production model. The Input scrap field is built on hierarchical node in ippe framework, so PSM write access will not work on the hierarchical node.-Resolution-We cannot provide PSM release to the Input scrap field due to logical constraints.-Keywords-Production Model, Input Scrap, PSM release, PROD_INPUT_ITEM_SCRP_FACTOR, PRODUCTION_SEGMENT.
