Title: ID of Documents are Created Out of Order or there are Gaps in Document IDs
Content: Symptom-Some documents (for example Sales Orders or Contracts or Purchase Order) have document IDs that do not reflect the chronological order of creation.-You may also see gaps in document numbering, even if you have not deleted any document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This behavior can be reproduced by normally creating documents (for example Contracts or Sales Orders or Purchase Order) in sequence.-You may notice that sometimes the system will use a new document ID that is not sequential. Example:-Contracts Creation:-Sept-13 Contract 81 was created by the system.-Sept-14 Contract 76 was created by the system.-Cause-For performance reasons the system uses a pre-selected pool of ID numbers. technically this means that a memory buffer will reserve a certain number of ID's.-The number range object used for the documents (Contract or Sales Order) in the system uses the memory buffer. When the system buffers a number range object, it does not update numbers individually in the database but reserves a present group of numbers (depending on the number range object) in the database the first time a number is requested.-The system makes these numbers available to the application server in question. The following numbers can then be taken directly from the application server buffer. New numbers are not used in the database until the application server buffer has been used up. As there are more than one application servers available, the numerical sequence will not reflect the (chronological) insert sequence because the numbers are buffered separately on the individual hosts.-This kind of definition could lead to the following symptoms:-- Gaps (jumps) occur when allocating internal numbers-- The number assignment does not reflect the insert sequence.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system.-See Also-Keywords-Sequence; Sales Order ID; Gap in Purchase Order; Good and Service Receipt

Title: Exception/Dump on Party Determination in a Sales Document (Class CL_CDA_ORGPT_PROC)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Exception/Dump on party determination in a sales document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Order work center.-Create a New Service Order.-An exception/dump is triggered.-A dump in class CL_CDA_ORGPT_PROC is triggered.-Cause-In the fine tuning, party determination is not set up correctly.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune.-Select the activity Involved Parties for Service Order.-Check if the determination of parties such as Seller and Service Execution Team have rules set up to active.-In case the system cannot find any active rule for those parties an exception/dump will be triggered.-See Also-Screenshot of Business Configuration for Party Determination Scoping is attached for reference.-Keywords-CL_CDA_ORGPT_PROC=>GET_CONTACT_HANDLE_MEM, CL_CDA_ORGPT_PROC=>MULTI_PUT

Title: FTE Values Are Different Between Work Agreement and Organizational Assignment in Employee Personnel File
Content: Symptom-You observe that the FTE values of a particular employee are different in the Work Agreement and Organizational Assignment sub-tabs in the employee personnel file.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view. -Search for the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button. -Enter the Employment tab.-Here if you check the Work Agreement and Organizational Assignment sub-tabs, you can see that the FTE values are different.-Cause-There may be 2 main reasons for this issue:-The FTE calculation may be outdated after a change is done in the Working Time business configuration activity.-There is an incorrect setting in the Working Time fine-tuning activity.-For a particular combination of Work Agreement and Administrative Category, if you adjust the validity date of the working hours to a certain date, any employee with this Work Agreement and Administrative Category that have a hire date outside of the configured validity will not have any Standard Working Hours.--For example, consider an entry in the Working Time activity with Standard Working Hours valid from 01.01.2011 to Unlimited. Then consider that this entry was modified as valid from 01.01.2011 to 01.10.2011. In this scenario, all the employees that fit this working time entry and have their hire date between 01.01.2011 to 30.09.2011 will not have any Standard Working Hours.-Resolution-If there was a change in the working time that was not reflected on the employees, you can perform a dummy change in order to refresh the FTE calculation. To do this, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search and select the employee.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Employment tab.-Enter the Work Agreement sub-tab.-Select the entry with the incorrect FTE value.-Click on the Remove button.-Click on Save and Close.-Click again on the Edit button to edit the same employee.-Navigate to the Employment tab.-Navigate to the Work Agreement sub-tab.-Create a new entry with the correct working time.-Click on Save.--If there is a change in standard Working Time validity for this group, a new record must be created with the new Standard Working Time instead of adjusting the existing record.--For example, if you set the working time configuration as the following:-DD1.MM1.YYYY1 – DD2.MM2.YYYY2 = 38.5h/Week-DD3.MM3.YYYY3 - Unlimited = 37h/week--Real Time Example:-01.01.2011 - 30.09.2011 38,5h / Week-01.10.2011 - Unlimited 37h / Week--To Correct the Working Time, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the active implementation project.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tune tab.-Open the fine tuning activity Working Time.-Select the respective combination (Work Agreement and Administrative Category) and change the Valid From field to the respective date as documented above and add a new row for the current assignment.-Click on the Save and Close button.-After making the above correction, it is required to run a report in the background to correct the wrong FTE values calculated earlier. This report should be executed by SAP. Hence raise a case to run the report to correct the wrong FTE value.-Keywords-FTE, Working, Permanent, Hourly

Title: Condition Maintenance Group SRM_PPS is Missing; A Technical Error (Mandatory Initialization Missing) Occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 502
Content: Symptom-Following error occurs while you are creating a new production order,-"Condition maintenance group SRM_PPS is missing-A technical error (Mandatory initialization missing) occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 502. Report an incident".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to New Production Order.-Enter details like Product ID, Site ID, Quantity. Then system prompts the error message.-Cause-This is a known issue and will be fixed in future release.-Resolution-Despite the error being shown in the screen, if clicking Save button, a production order would be created. Therefore, there is no holdup in creating Production Orders. You can follow this till the issue gets resolved.-Keywords-New Production Order, Technical Error, PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 502.

Title: Error "Follow-up document not permitted for a voided document" While Creating Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-You get an error when you try to create credit memo for a supplier invoice -Error "Follow-up document not permitted for a voided document"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-2. Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-3. Search for the relevant invoice-4. Choose "New"-5. Choose "credit memo"-6. System throws an error-"Follow-up document not permitted for a voided document"-Cause-It is allowed to create an credit memo for the supplier invoice which has status "Voided".-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Credit Memo; Voided Supplier Invoice; Error for Credit Memo;

Title: Migration of older/existing POs and contracts to adopt to the new Japan legal change
Content: Symptom-Due to the new legal change introduced in Japan, existing/older POs, contracts and ERS invoices must be migrated with new tax rate and tax type as per the new tax code set up mentioned in the Product documentation.-Resolution-Applicable Solutions-This document helps buyers to handle existing/older POs, contracts and ERS invoices to follow the Japan Tax Consumption legal change.-The tables below describe a sample tax type and tax rates before and after the legal change.-[Before legal change]-Tax Type Tax Rate Tax Code-SalesTax 10% SX-SalesTax 8% V1-   [After Legal change]  -Tax Type-Tax Rate Tax Code  -SalesTax 10% SX Old-SalesTax  -8%-V1 Old-SalesTax_10 10% V6 New-SalesTax_8  -8%-V2 New-Note - Keep the older tax types and tax codes and then create the new tax types and new tax codes. Then setup the tax code lookup as mentioned in the Product documentation.-Migration approaches for older/existing documents (PO, Contracts, etc):-Option 1 - Cancel existing PO/Contract and re-issue with the new tax types and new tax codes. Then setup the tax code lookup as mentioned in the Product documentation.-Option 2 - Modify the existing PO/Contract and re-issue with the new tax types and new tax codes. Then setup the tax code lookup as mentioned in the Product documentation.-Option 3 - If above options are not suitable, then follow the steps below if any issue persists for the respective flows.-Flow Buyer Pre-requisite Invoice Creation Reconciliation-PO Flip-(PO Based Invoice created in SAP Business Network)--(or)--Contract-(Contract Based Invoice created in SAP Business Network)-1.Keep the older tax types and tax codes, and then create the new tax types and new tax codes. Then setup the new tax code lookup as mentioned in the Product documentation.--2.Add an approval flow on the Invoice Reconciliation (IR) document. Invoice will be created on Business Network site by Supplier, either with old tax type or new tax type.--Note - Need to educate Suppliers to create an invoice with older/newer tax type. The invoice should contain only one tax rate, either 10% or 8% (one tax rate per invoice) per invoice.--Note - When supplier create invoice against contract, supplier must add Tax in Header level. Supplier will punch-in to Buying application so that steps will be different from PO flip invoice creation. 1.Invoice received on SAP Buying and Invoicing may get various exceptions in the IR document .--2.1.Edit the IR document under Line View > View Tax Details > Select the old tax code and view the prorated header tax information.--2.2.Edit the IR document under Exceptions > Select the new tax code.--3. Verify if the proration is happening correctly or not in the Line View. If the information is correct, then submit the IR document.-Paper invoices-(Created in SAP Buying & Invoicing) Buyers need to create an invoice with either old/new tax type. The invoice should contain only one tax rate, either 10% or 8% (one tax rate per invoice) per invoice.--Note – Do not create invoice with multiple tax rate on the same invoice.-ERS invoice-(Created in SAP Buying and Invoicing)-Here, the invoices are created automatically based on tax code mentioned in the PO 1.Invoice will be created automatically when Buyer receives items.--2.Buyer need to receive items that belong to the same tax rate per receipt. (Buyer can either receive items with 8% or 10% at a time)--Note – Do not receive items that belongs to different tax rates in the same receipt.-Link to Product documentation: - https://help.sap.com/docs/ariba/978b7e36451a4c2c85321a3ef6f3a7e5/9464ed59bece470f8c2c016ceab29dfb.html?parentHref=%2Fwhats-new%2F6a6876bb02204429bfc72cf8b861a866%3FArea%3DSAP%2520Ariba%2520Buying%2520and%2520Invoicing%26locale%3Den-US%26Version%3DSAP%2520Ariba%25202308%26q%3Dng-6139&parentName=What%27s%20New%20in%20SAP%20Procurement%20and%20SAP%20Business%20Network-Additional Information-How to recover if multiple tax rate invoice is issued with same tax type?-Reject the IR and re-create the invoice with single tax rate (or)-Reject the IR and perform “Negative receipt” setting minus value in goods receipt, and then create new receipt with single tax rate for ERS. (Negative IR need to be rejected as well). -Note: Old tax type/tax code and new tax type/tax code need to be differentiated.-If tax codes are diverted to new tax type, exception cannot be cleared even if ERS invoice has single tax rate only.-Keywords-[Change Request ID: NG-6139]

Title: Error - Cancel not possible; Payment file already generated; Reverse that first
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to Reverse the Rejected payment and you see the error - Cancel not possible; Payment file already generated; Reverse that first.-Or-The payment status on the Payment Monitor screen is Rejected. However, when you open the payment, then the status is In Transfer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management workcenter.-Click on Payment Monitor view. -Select the Outgoing Bank-to-Bank transfer with status Rejected. -Click on Reverse. -You see the error message - Cancel not possible; Payment file already generated; Reverse that first.-OR-Go to Payment Management workcenter.-Click on Payment Monitor view. -Select the Outgoing Bank-to-Bank transfer with status Rejected. -Click on Document ID.-In the Payment overview screen, you can find the status is In Transfer. -Cause-Basically, the Rejected Payment cannot be Reversed. This is a standard system behaviour.-Resolution-To Reverse the Payment, follow the below steps:-Go to Payment Management wc.-Click on Payment Monitor view. -Select the Outgoing Bank-to-Bank transfer with status Rejected. -Click on Actions --> Set to Not Transferred. This will change the status of the Payment to Ready For Transfer.-Click on Reverse. -Keywords-Cancel not possible; Payment file already generated; Reverse that first, Reversal not possible for Rejected Payment, Rejected Payment.-cancel not possible,payment file already generated;,reverse that first,reversal not possible for rejected payme,rejected payment

Title: Some of the Materials are not Displaying in the Value Help While creating a new Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-When you create a Purchase Order, some of the Materials are not visible in the value help of the line item, although the material is available in Product Data work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Order and requests work center.-Select New Purchase Order.-Select Item Type as material.-Select value help of Product ID.-Some of the materials are missing.-Cause-The issue is that there is a mismatch in the number of entries in FSI persistency and the BO persistency of PRODUCT_TEMPLATE - PROCUREMENT_PU. All the value helps and OWLs work on FSI persistency.-The value of the Purchased indicator is derived from the status of Procurement_pu. In case of the missing product/material, instances of procurement_pu are missing in FSI persistency. FSI Reload will solve the issue for the customer.-Resolution-Please forward the incident to Hosting for FSI reload for the BO - Node PRODUCT_TEMPLATE - PROCUREMENT_PU.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Materials, Value Help, FSI, PRODUCT_TEMPLATE, PROCUREMENT_PU

Title: Error occurs in a Sales Document: Financial Data for Seller XXX Missing in Master Data of Account XXXX
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Sales Order or a Sales Quote for Account XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Account) which has a default Sales Unit and Sales Organization from Company ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Company), however, the user changes the Sales Unit for one of Company GHI (GHI represents the ID of another Company) and is still able to release the Sales Order or Sales Quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of a Sales Order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the New Sales Order option from the Common Tasks.-Enter Account XYZ.-Sales Unit and Sales Organization are automatically chosen from the Employee Responsible for Company ABC.-Now change the Sales Unit for one from Company GHI.-You get the following warning message under the Sales Order: Financial data for seller XXX missing in master data of account XXXX.-The Submit button is still gray out.-Add product MNO (MNO represents the ID of the Product) and the Submit button is enable.-Cause-The Company GHI does not belong to the Financial Data under the Account XYZ to which you want to sell, however, considering that the Sales Unit for Company GHI is maintained under the product MNO added to the Sales Order or Sales Quote, the system will not block the sale.-Resolution-This the expected system behavior.-See Also-KBA 1822783 - Inconsistent Invoice Request is Created With Error Message: "Financial data for seller missing in master data of account"-Keywords-Sales Order; Release; Different Company; Inconsistent; Sales Quote; Account; Financial data

Title: Error Message "User is locking time data of employee" When Releasing Time Recording
Content: Symptom-You may get the below error message while releasing the time recordings in time sheet:-"User is locking time data of employee"-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select Self-Service Overview view.-Select Edit Time Sheet link under the Time section.-Record the times.-Click Release button and choose the Selected Week or All option.-System throws the above error message.-Cause-The issue is due to the fact that another employee (key user or time administrator) is editing your time file or time profile at the same time.-Resolution-You can check with your colleagues to see if they are editing your time file or time profile. If yes, ask them to exit the editing then you can continue your time recording.-Keywords-Locking, Time Data, Time Sheet

Title: Error: "Delivery ID :cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to cancel outbound delivery however system throws an error:--Delivery ID: cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Deliveries work center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Search required Delivery ID.-Select and choose Edit.-Choose Actions -> Cancel.-Now error triggered as -Delivery ID: cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed - Cause-Since Outbound Delivery is with status Released while cancelling hence serial numbers inventory status is Issued to Customer hence system throws error.-Resolution-Correct way of cancelling an OD-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Find relevant Outbound Delivery ID and first perform Undo-release for OD-Perform save.-Once it is done, perform adjustment confirmation against warehouse order-Then cancel the required Outbound Delivery ID.-Note : If its an old document, keep relevant accounting period open to process the document.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/1850511-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3066550-Keywords-Adjustment confirmation, Delivery ID :cancellation failed; some serial numbers cannot be removed, undo-release, cancel outbound delivery, serial number.

Title: System Dumps during Split in Production Task XYZ.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In Supply Task, when selecting an input product without a Target Resource and performing a split, the system results in a dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search for the Production Task XYZ (XYZ represents Production Supply Task ID) -Choose Confirm.-In Line Items tab, select line item without a Target Resource and Choose Split.-System throws Dump.-Cause-The Target Resource is not populated in the Supply Task for the corresponding line item because multiple activities are maintained within a single operation in the Bill of Operation.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work center.-Go to Production Bills Of Operation view.-Search and open the Bills of Operation DEF (DEF represents Bills of Operation ID).-Go to Structure Tab, multiple activities are maintained within the same operation.-Select Insert and Choose Insert Operation.-Create a new operation for each activity.-Keywords-Production; Split; Target Resource; Input Products; Operation; Bill of Operation; Activity; Supply Task; BOO; Planning and Production Master Data; Dump; Production Control;

Title: Unable to Approve Supplier Payment Task (Specific to Country Japan)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to apporve task - Approve Supplier Payment XXX and get the error - Amounts inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login with Business User who is facing the issue. -Go to Managing My Area work center.-Click on Approvals view.-You can find the task - Approve Supplier Payment XXX.-You have to open the task and press Approve.-you see the error message - Amounts inconsistent. -Cause-There is limitation in the current JAPAN bank charge functionality. In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign system, the payment can be posted along with applied bank charge when supplier invoice and bank charge belong to same Supplier Account.-The system does not support payment with bank charge, if there is Payee Relationship maintained in the supplier account master data. You can follow the below steps to check the Payee Relationship :-Go to Payables work center. -Go to Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier. -Click on Edit --> Contacts.-Go to Relationships tab.-You can find Relationship Type - "Is The Payee Of" with other Supplier Account.-Resolution-You have to cancel the Supplier Invoice and remove the Relationship Type in the Supplier Account Master data. Later, you can create a new Supplier Invoice. -Note - The solution is same for both Automatic Payment and Manual Payment. -See Also-https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2744399

Title: Discount Percentage Details not Appearing in the Output XML of Purchase Order Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have ordered the purchase order along with the discount percentage details. However when you look at the output xml system does not show the percentage details. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view -Go to the relevant Purchase Order and select Edit-Navigate to Prices tab and enter Overall Discount (Percent)-Now go to the Items tab and Prices sub tab-Enter the Manual Discount (Percent) -Click on Order and check the output XML in the Output History tab-Cause-In the pricing component, discount percentage field is not visible as the functionality is not supported as of now. -Resolution-This is a new functionality request. This will be validated and reviewed by the product management team. As a work around, you can create an extension field at item level and extend it to forms to see the discount percentage. -Keywords-Discount percentage details not appearing in output XML; Discount percentage details not appearing in forms; Discount percentage details not appearing; <TypeCode listID="1">01DP</TypeCode>

Title: BYD2305 Maintaining Identified Stock Mandatory For Product Specification
Content: Symptom-You want to use Product specification without Batch Management (Identified Stock ID).-Environment-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign 2305-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Material.-Select the Identified Stock Type for this Material as: "03 - Optional Specified Stock".-Create a Product Specification and assign to the Material.-Create a Purchase Order and try to perform Goods Receipt against.-Now you try to confirm the Goods Receipt without maintaining the Identified Stock ID like to enter the Product specification without .-Cause-The identified stock is optional only if there is no Product Specification. In this case, a product specification is used, hence the identified stock becomes mandatory.-Resolution-You have to maintain the Batch Number. It  is MANDATORY to maintain the Identified Stock ID when you are using Product Specification. -System is working as designed.-Since this is the current behaviour of the system, we would also recommend you to approach the Product Management Team with your feature request by lodging an Enhancement Request via the Influence Portal (SAP Business ByDesign - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886).-See Also-Identified Stock Quick Guide-1691081 - System triggers error message "Value for identified stock missing" while confirming a make task

Title: Extension Field Cannot be Added as OVS
Content: Symptom-Customer tried to configure in the UI Designer an extension fields of type "LANGUAGEINDEPENDENT_EXTENDED_Text" as OVS and  getS the error message 'No editable Identifier available in the selected area'.-Environment-SAP  Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open the affceted screen (.uicomponent) using the UI Designer-Add the extension field to the view-Navigate to "Extensibility Explorer"-Click on button "Change ID-Field Configuration"-New pop up will appear with the following error message: 'No editable Identifier available in the selected area'-Cause-This happens because the extension field was configured as type " LANGUAGEINDEPENDENT_EXTENDED_Text", but  this type of extension field cannot be configured as OVS.-Resolution-1. Remove this field from the frontend first.-2. Change the field type from LANGUAGEINDEPENDENT_EXTENDED_Text to type ID.-3. Then re-add this field to the UI designer via clicking 'Add Extension Field to Section Group'-4. Then configure this field as OVS via clicking 'Change ID-field Configuration' in the Extensibility Explorer-Keywords

Title: Fewer Employees Are Visible in Time Administration Work Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-If the user reports an incident with below issues:-Error Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY while recording times in Time Sheet.-Some employee ID is missing in the Time Administration work center.-Work Agreement does not exist for employee ID in the Personnel Administration work center.-Then you can follow the below resolution to resolve the issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When Time and Labour Management is added to the business scope after the system is going live, Time Agreements for all existing employees should be generated by the system automatically. This may not happen in the system if a corresponding job had not been scheduled.-Resolution-Log in to the backend.-Run transaction SE38.-Run the report AP_TIM_MIGRATE_FOR_UPGRADE.-This will resolve the issue. Now the user should be able to view all the employees in the Time Administration work center and employees can record time without problem.-See Also-Refer to case document: 3032180 - Error 'Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY' During Time Recording for Employee-Keywords-Employees, Time Administration, Missing, Time Agreement, Personnel Administration, Work Agreement

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Error : 'Account Determination Group XXX; G/L Account Missing for Services' due to Exchange Rate Differences
Content: Symptom-When you perform Goods Receipt and Invoice Receipt Clearing Run, system shows the error message 'Account determination group XXX: G/L account missing for services'.-(XXX represents the Account Determination Group).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks View.-Select the GR/IR clearing Sub View.-Select New and choose GR/IR Clearing Run.-Enter the required data to the respective fields.-Select button Start Now and execute GR/IR Clearing Run.-Once you execute GR/IR clearing, log results get generated. -You see that log which was generated is displaying Processing Status: Error.-Select the error Log and open it using View button.-Navigate to the Messages tab, here you can see error message: 'Account determination group XXX: G/L account missing for services'.-Cause-There is a currency difference between Supplier Invoice and Goods and Services Receipt.-Therefore the Exchange Rate Difference accounts should be specified under activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination - Account Determination in Business Configuration Work Center to collect the gains or loss resulting from these two kinds of differences for Services.-Resolution-In order to maintain Account Determination Group for Services with required G/L accounts within the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination. Please follow the below detailed steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center and choose Overview View. -In the field Show, select  All Activities using drop down and select fine tune activity Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination. -Select Change Immediately.-Select Account Determination and then select the hyperlink Costs.-Select Account Determination Profile as ABC and select the Sub Ledger Costs (ABC represents the Account Determination Profile Code).-Under section Costs, navigate to the tab Exchange Rate Differences and maintain the Account Determination Group for Services as DEF (DEF represents the Account Determination Group code), then enter relevant Accounts for Gain/Loss from Exchange Rate Differences.-Select Save.-Keywords-Account Determination, GL Account missing, G/L Account Missing for Services, GR/IR, Goods Receipt and Invoice Receipt Clearing

Title: Error: Customer and multi-customer projects not allowed for G/L postings
Content: Symptom-You are trying to proceed with the Migration of the G/L Account Balances and you have come across the error - Customer and multi-customer projects not allowed for G/L postings.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Open button.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool option.-Select desired Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration button.-Select G/L Account Balances line.-Click Process File button.-During the simulation you observe the error 'Customer and multi-customer projects not allowed for G/L postings'.-Cause-The reason this error appears is due to the Project Task ID in the migration template. You can check the source record value for Project Task ID.-Currently, the system only allows project task of type customer/multi-customer with a manual posting of Journal Entry Voucher. It is not possible through data migration.-Resolution-You have to remove Project Task ID from the migration template and proceed for migration.-If you still need to upload Project Task ID of type customer/multi-customer with a manual sales variant then you have to use manual journal entry vouchers. You may consider use Excel Upload from Journal Entry Vouchers view of General Ledger work center.-See Also-KBA 2546626-Keywords-Customer and multi-customer projects not allowed for G/L postings, G/L Account Balances migration error.

Title: Error - Account determination group AAA: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Gains and Losses ->Material Consumption
Content: Symptom-You have noticed an unposted source document type - Goods and Services Receipt with error message: Account determination group AAA: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Gains and Losses ->Material Consumption.-AAA means the Account Determination Group for Materials ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents list.-Select the row of the respective Goods and Services Receipt.-Notice the error message: Account determination group AAA: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Gains and Losses ->Material Consumption.-Cause-The Account Determination Group for Goods and Services Receipt is determined based on the Product Category ID maintained in the Goods and Services Receipt.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to know the Account Determination Group for corresponding Product Category ID:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview and search for the Fine Tune activity - Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories.-Filter with the Product Category ID.-Check the Default Account Determination Group for Material or Service.-Follow the below steps to maintain the Account Determination Group and G/L Account:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview and search for the Fine Tune activity - Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click the Inventories Subledger.-Select the Gains and Losses tab.-Maintain the Account Determination Group and G/L Account under Material Consumption tab. -Now, you can post the Unposted Source Document:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Search for your Source Document ID, the Goods and Services Receipt.-Select the ID and press Actions and select Post Business Transaction.-Keywords-G/L acct missing for Inventories, unposted GSR, Goods and Services Receipt.

Title: Data Extraction - Open Items Receivable / Payables
Content: Symptom-Key notes for Data Extraction for OPEN_ITMS_RECEIVABLE - Open Items Receivable & OPEN_ITMS_PAYABLE - Open Items Payable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Click on Data Extraction view.-Click New.-Select Extraction Object - OPEN_ITMS_RECEIVABLE - Open Items Receivable or OPEN_ITMS_PAYABLE - Open Items Payable. -Resolution-Below are the key notes to consider after performing Data Extraction for Open Items Receivable & Open Items Payable:-1) Fields with Zero Amount: For any non-mandatory field If any field is having zero value, then the system is keeping as blank. For example - Cash Discount Relevant field. If there is 0,00 amount in Cash Discount then the field is blank.-This applies to all sheets - Open Items, Tax Data and Withholding Tax Data.-For any mandatory field, If any field is having zero value, then the system is fetching same as zero and not making it blank. Since ByD migration tool expects some value in a mandatory field. For example, in the data extraction excel you can find the Tax Amount as ‘0’, Tax Rate as ‘0’.-2) Cash Discount Gross Amount and Cash Discount Net Amount: If an open item is cash discount relevant, then the system fetches both Cash Discount Gross Amount and Cash Discount Net Amount. This applies to Open Items sheet.-Note - ByD migration tool don’t expect both Cash Discount Gross Amount and Cash Discount Net Amount to be passed. During migration of extracted file to ByD system one of the values should be removed manually. Also, ByD migration tool will give error, if Transaction Amount is less than Cash Discount Gross Amount.-3) Negative values: During data extraction the system is fetching all Amount as positive Amount. If any Amount is -ve then the system is converting to +ve Amount during extraction.This applies to all sheets - Open Items, Tax Data and Withholding Tax Data.-4) Tax Jurisdiction Code for Tax Country US: At the time of data extraction, the tax data sheet is aggregated based on lowest level tax jurisdiction code level.This applies to Tax Data sheet. For example:-If we have two records with Tax Jurisdiction Code as OH and OH XX then both these records will be aggregated on lowest level tax jurisdiction code i.e OH XX will appear in the Tax Jurisdiction Code.-If we have three records with Tax Jurisdiction Code as OH, OH XX and OH XX YY, then all three records will be aggregated on lowest level tax jurisdiction code i.e OH XX YY will appear in the Tax Jurisdiction Code.-Note - The Tax Amount will be aggregated for all the Due Categories.  For example, in the below screenshot, there are two line items in the Due Category. After performing Data Extraction, you can find the aggregated Tax Amount = 6.25 USD.-In the extracted excel the same appears as below:-5) Tax data handling for India and Mexico: -If product split line items have record with different Tax Net Base Amount scenario for example, Tax on Tax scenario for India as shown below, then no aggregation is applied on such product items. Instead, all tax split line items will be fetched as it is in data extraction excel.-The same data appears in the excel as below:--In case any performance issue occurs due to the different Tax Net Base Amount, then switch mechanism can be enabled from backend. In this case, all tax register split line items entries for country India and Mexico will be fetched as it is without any aggregation logic irrespective of any scenario.To Enable switch you have to Report an incident and mention this KBA.--6) Tax data handling for reverse charge case: No aggregation logic will be applied for reverse charge case for any applicable country. If any reverse charge case has multiple tax split line items, then only record with Due category ‘Payables’ will be considered for extraction. Record with Due category ‘Receivables’ will be ignored.-The same data appears in the Tax data sheet as below post extraction:-This is specific to Tax Data sheet.-Below are the key notes specifc to Data Extraction for Open Items Payable only:-1) Line-item id fix in withholding tax: Every Withholding Tax entry will be mapped to its corresponding tax register entry. This mapping can be found with line items id values.-2) Withholding tax data: The system is fetching Withholding Tax data as it is without any aggregation or any calculation logic.-Keywords-Data Extraction - Open Items Receivable, Data Extraction - Open Items Payables

Title: Object Locked by User when Printing Label after Accessing Edit Output Settings in Labels
Content: Symptom-Error message "Object currently locked by user ID; try again later" occurs while printing label.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Labels Common Task.-Select a label.-Click Preview- Edit Output Settings.-Click Apply.-Click Print Labels, then the error would occur.-Cause-This is technical limitation because of the way the UI is configured.-Resolution-For this particular UI, the only way to avoid this lock issue is to close the UI after the edit output settings are applied before printing the labels.-Keywords-Object locked, Print Label, Output Setting.

Title: Process Communication Error in Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-You have created a Credit Memo as a Follow-Up document of Customer Invoice and observed that the Credit Memo is not posting in accounting. Basically, there is no Journal Entry created.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing workcenter. -Click on New Manual Invoice. -Fill the relevant data and Release the invoice - AAA. -Go to Invoice Documents view in the same workcenter.-Select the Released invoice - AAA and click on Follow-Up - Manual Credit Memo.-Fill the relevant data and Release Credit Memo - BBB. -Now, go to General Ledger work center.-Click on Journal Entries view and Search for Credit Memo - BBB.-You cannot find the Journal Entry for Credit Memo. -Cause-There is a difference in amount between Credit Memo and Customer Invoice. For Example:-Customer Invoice - AAA Total Amount - 168,01-Credit Memo - BBB Total Amount - 168-When, you create a Follow-Up document then the system calculates Tax Amount and Tax Base Amount. In this case, the Tax Amount is zero, but there is a small difference on Tax Base Amount. This leads to error in the backend and system do not create Journal Entry.-Resolution-Part A) Follow the below steps to clear the Customer Invocie and Credit Memo:-Go to Customer Invoicing work center. -Click on New Credit Memo.[Not as a Follow-Up document using Customer Invoice-AAA. ]-Fill the relevant data and Release the Credit Memo - CCC. -Go to Receivables workcenter. -Click on Customer Accounts view. -Select Customer Account and click View. -Select Customer Invoice - AAA and Credit Memo - CCC. -Click Clear Manually. -You have to Apply Discount and Select the Payment Difference Reason which is Not Tax Relevant[For example - 97 - Currency exchange differences].-Click on Clear. -Part B) You have to Cancel the Follow-Up Credit Memo.-Go to Customer Invoicing Work center. -Go to Invoice Documents view. -Search for the Credit Memo - BBB.-Click on Cancel and Release the Cancellation Credit Memo DDD. -Go to the Document Flow of Cancellation Credit Memo DDD. -Here, you can find the Process Communication Error icon on Orignal Credit Memo - BBB. -You have to Report an Incident to clear the Process Communication Error with reference to the KBA.  -The Original Credit Memo BBB is stuck in the backend, so the system will not allow to post it's Cancellation. -SAP will Restart the XI Message for Original Credit Memo - BBB. This action will create Journal Entries for both Original and Cancelled Credit Memo. -Note: Customer Must have to Report an Incident,-Keywords-Credit Memo not posted in accounting, Journal Entry not created for Credit Memo, No JE for Credit Memo.

Title: Business Object - PaymentRegister (FOPXP_PAYREG) - Write Accsess / PSM
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to use the standard Business Object - PaymentRegister(FOPXP_PAYREG) in the custom solution, using SAP Cloud Application Studio. To use this Business Object, you need Write Access and Public Solution Enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The Business Object - PaymentRegister(FOPXP_PAYREG) contains payment relevant information, which is used by other Business Objects / work center views. Also, the business object contains sensitive information about Payment Amount, Bank Account details. Therefore, it is not possible to Enable the business object for PSM (Public Solution Model) along with the Write Access.-Keywords-PaymentRegister BO, FOPXP_PAYREG, PSM

Title: Crystal Add in Error in Crystal Report
Content: Symptom-You have installed Crystal Reports and you want to use the Crystal Reports Add-In to edit the formatted reports of Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When you log in to Crystal Reports, you receive an error. For example:-A serious error has occurred. Report an case.-ERROR: Proxy is active, specify its Settings.-Cause-As a part of our commitment to meet the highest security and technology standards we have decided to disable the TLSv1.0 protocol. Unfortunately, the add-in versions for Crystal we are currently supporting are not enabled for TLS versions 1.1 and higher.-Resolution-We have to deprecate and remove the related add-ins for Crystal 2008 and 2011 from our Download Area in SAP Business ByDesign. This Add-In cannot currently be supported.-Nevertheless, we are currently upgrading our add-in to Crystal 2016, which is also enabled for newer TLS versions. This is planned to be delivered with a future release.-In the meantime, we recommend considering Excel to fulfill formatting reporting requirements.-See Also-This information was also sent out to the IT Contact maintained in your system.-Keywords-crystal reports, addin, add in, not supported, deprecated, proxy is active, error message, business analytics-proxy is active,crystal reports 2011,error: proxy is active, specify its sett,crystal reports

Title: User Name Field For Broadcast Recipient Empty
Content: Symptom-You might find that the User Name field remains empty in a Broadcast even though you entered an e-mail address that is associated with a valid business user.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Broadcast-Create a new or edit an existing broadcast-In the Recipients area you select add row and open the value help in the To (E-Mail Address) field-Select a user from the value help-You find the User Name field in the broadcast remains empty.-Cause-This is a technical issue and a correction has already been delivered.-However, some users (in particular users that exist since a long time in the system) may still be affected.-Resolution-SAP Cloud Support can correct the affected users with a specific backend script. Please open an case with medium or low priority and refer to this case document.-Keywords-user name; broadcast; not displayed; empty

Title: Wrong Goods and Services Receipt's reference in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You expected that a different Goods and Service Receipt ID would be showing in Supplier Invoice's item reference.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select item ID m (m is the number of the item).-Navigate to Basic Data subtab.-You can see that the field has value:-Services Receipt ID/Item: PQR-n (PQR is a Goods and Service Confirmation and n is the item number in the document).-You expected that it would show reference 'XYZ-n' instead of 'PQR-n' (XYZ is another Goods and Service Confirmation).-Also:-Follow all steps until 8. -Navigate to Cost Distribution subtab. -In Cost Distribution section, for line m.1, Reference item: XYZ-n Goods and Service Confirmation. -The references are different in each tab.-Cause-This scenario is a known issue. Based on priority, the development team will implement a fix in a future release.-Resolution-Our development team is unable to correct the displayed data in the UI, but correct information is maintained in the backend. So this issue does not impact on business process.-Keywords-Supplier invoice; Goods and service receipt; Goods and service confirmation; Cost distribution; Basic Data

Title: The Query My Production Tasks Finished Today in Work Center Execution Under The View Production Tasks is Not Working
Content: Symptom-You have Finished a Production Task assigned to your name with today's date. Now, when you proceed to the work center view 'Execution - Production Tasks' and select the query screen 'My Production Tasks Finished Today', the system does not return a result.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Execution work center.-Go to the Production Tasks view.-Find and select a Task in your name as the Responsible with either the Status Not started or In Process.-Click Confirm and Finish the Task.-Change the screen to 'My Production Tasks Finished Today'.-You can see when you execute the query the system returns No records found even though you have just finished a Task with today's date.-Cause-This is a known limitation.-Resolution-We recommend that you use other query or create a custom query.-Keywords-Execution, My Production Tasks Finished Today

Title: Error Message: 'Import simulation failed. Create an incident' while performing Data Migration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-When trying to perform Data Migration of any data, upon execution of Migration system throws below error message:-Import simulation failed. Create an incident-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Select a Migration activity.-Execute the Migration of the Uploaded XML file.-Cause-Check in SLG1 log, for the error that is causing the issue. If there is no error message, then check in ST22. If the Error ID is: DBSQL_DUPLICATE_KEY_ERROR,  then the issue is due to some duplicate entries in the excel which were already existing in the system.-Resolution-Any duplicate entries in the file must be removed. Afterwards, try to migrate the data again.-A way to find out duplicate records in an excel file, is the following (as proposed by Microsoft):-Select the cells you want to check for duplicates. -Click Home > Conditional Formatting > Highlight Cells Rules > Duplicate Values.-In the box next to values with, pick the formatting you want to apply to the duplicate values, and then click OK.-Keywords-Migration of Accounting Transaction Data,  DBSQL_DUPLICATE_KEY_ERROR, Import simulation failed;create an incident

Title: Purchase Request Is Not Validating Contract Item
Content: Symptom-You expected that an error message would be triggered when entering wrong contract's item ID in Purchase Request, however, it doesn't happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to New Purchase Request Common Task view.-Click in View All button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Enter in item product ABC (ABC is the product's ID).-Go to Source of Supply subtab.-Enter contract DEF (DEF is the contract's ID) or the system will enter a contract ID automatically.-In contract item field, enter GHI (GHI is a random number).-System accepts item ID GHI. System should not have accepted ID GHI.-Cause-This scenario is a known issue. Based on priority, the development team will implement a fix in a future release.-Resolution-You are still able to change the Contract Item ID in the follow-up Purchase Order, but still, no error message is triggered during the process. However, once the Purchase Order is finished, the information cannot be corrected anymore.-If you face this issue and cannot change the ID from your side, please open an incident so SAP development team can perform the correction.-Keywords-Contract; Purchase Order; Purchase Request; Product

Title: Error Message Material Stock qty. ref. quantity is too big When Posting Manual Journal Entry Voucher for Materials
Content: Symptom-While posting Manual Entry for Materials, You get the following error message:-Material XYZ stock qty. XX ea - ref. quantity YY ea is too big (set of books ABC).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries View.-Go to Journal Entry Voucher sub-view.-Create a New Journal Entry Voucher with type 087 — Manual Entry for Materials.-Select the screen variant as 630 – Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Materials.-Enter the relevant details and Post the Journal Entry Voucher.-You then get the error message: Material XYZ stock qty. XX ea - ref. quantity YY ea is too big (set of books ABC).-Cause-While posting the Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Materials ,you need to specify the Reference Quantity to which the Charge/Credit refers. The Reference Quantity must be less than the material inventory quantity. This ensures that you do not charge for or credit any materials that are no longer available in the system.-You are trying to post the manual entry with the Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY and correctly entered the Reference Quantity which was available as of the Key Date  DD.MM.YYYY. However system checks for the quantity in the period end rather than on a particular key date. Hence system throws the error message that Reference Quantity cannot be greater than actual Inventory Quantity.-Resolution-System works as expected and check the Inventory Quantity on period end. Follow the below steps to check the actual Inventory Quantity:-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Click on Materials view.-Search for the Material ID.-Here, you can find the Inventory Quantity.-The quantity entered in the Journal Entry Voucher should be less than the Inventory Quantity.-Keywords-Material stock qty. ref. quantity is too big (Set of Books ABC), stock qty. ref. quantity, Error in Manual Entry for Materials.

Title: No Task Displayed in Tasks View of Different Work Centers
Content: Symptom-You, as a personnel administrator, would like to perform some tasks in the Regular Tasks view of any work centre such as Personnel Administration but the screen is empty.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center (or any).-Select the Regular Tasks view.-The view may be empty and there is no task link or data displayed.-Cause-The issue might be caused by an outdated Silverlight Client Cache or Internet Explorer Cache on your machine.-Resolution-To clean up the Silverlight client cache:-Right-click into empty an space of the Regular Tasks view.-Select Silverlight and go to the Application Storage tab.-Select the Delete All button.-To clean up the Internet Explorer Cache:-Select Tools - Internet Options.-Choose Button Delete and keep Passwords and Preserve Favorites Web Site Data unchecked.-Press Delete.-Select Apply.-Choose Ok.-If the issue still persists, report an case to SAP support with the screenshot of the below screen:-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Check my computer settings option under the Common Tasks.-Take a snapshot of the settings screen.

Title: Time Account Balance of an Employee Shows Incorrect Value
Content: Symptom-When checking the Time account balance of an employee, the system shows balance as Zero although there is leave existing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Adminstration work center.-Select view Employees.-Select and edit the respective employee.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Where the Balance is showing as Zero.-Cause-Reason for showing the Balance as Zero is due to the Posting Type Set to Zero which was done initially by the employee or time administrator.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to verify/calculate an employee's time account balance,-Go to Time Administration workcenter.-Select Employees view.-Search and edit the respective employee.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Go to Postings sub tab.-Where you can verify the Posting type and Quantities of hours deducted. If the Posting type is set as Set to Zero for an accural then automattically the remaining balance will be turned to Zero.-In case if still there is a deviation in the time account balance, you can report an case to support.

Title: DO NOT SEND option for purchasing contracts does not work
Content: Symptom-You are using the DO NOT SEND option for purchasing contracts, but the documents are sent to the default printer queue.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center: Application and User Management-Choose the view: Output Channel Selection and search for purchasing contracts-Here choose DO NOT SEND as output channel-Now initiate an output and you will see that the documents is sent to the default printer queue-Cause-DO NOT SEND is not supported in COR architecture and the purchasing contract is on COR architecture.-Resolution-There are no plans to change this behavior, the system works as designed.-Keywords-Do Not Send, Purchasing contracts.

Title: Time and Expense Items in the Sales Order are not Reflecting in Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When you create a Project Invoice Request from a Sales Order and when you do Propose Invoice Structure in Step 3, the Time and Expense items are not reflecting in the Invoice Request.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Invoicing view using Customer Invoicing work center.-Highlight the Sales Order and select New button and choose Invoice Request option.-Go to Step 3 (Define Invoice Items) and select Propose Invoice Structure button.-Select Next button, the Time and Expense items are missing.-Cause-The Time Sheet or Expense Report is still being edited and hence in Edit mode (e.g. some users are still updating the documents).-Or the Time Sheet or the Expense Report is locked.-Resolution-Option 1:-Check with the users to Save and Close the Time Sheet and Expense Report related to this Invoice/Sales Order. Then you can see the Time and Expenses.-Option 2:-Even if there are no open sessions but the Times and Expenses are still missing, then it could be because of a backend lock. This must be removed by SAP. For that, please report an case.

Title: How to Change the Approver of a Released Time Recording
Content: Symptom-You want to know if it is possible to change the approver of a time recording which was already sent for approval.-Resolution-As a Time Administrator:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Search and highlight the employee.-Select the Edit button.-Go to the Employee Times tab.-Go to Specific date and select the Time Type.-Change the Approver name in the Approver field.-However if the time administrator changes the time recording directly, its status becomes Active which means the approval is not needed.-As an Employee:-An employee can cancel the time recording and create it again, which will be assigned to a correct approver if the former was assigned to wrong approver.-Other Option:-If you are not able to change the approver by using the above options, you can create an case and send to SAP.-Keywords
