Title: Data Discrepancy in Trial Balance and G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-When comparing Trial Balance report with G/L Accounts - Line Items report, all the accounting periods are not shown in the line items report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To open Trial Balance report:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Reports view and click the List.-Open the report Trial Balance.-Enter appropriate filter data selecting the Accounting Period/Year for one Fiscal Year.-Select a G/L Account (if required).-Click Accounting Period/Year and click Move to Rows.-To open G/L Accounts - Line Items report:-Go to the General Ledger work Center.-Go to the Reports view and click the List.-Open the report G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Enter the same filter data.-Click Accounting Period/Year and click Move to Rows.-Cause-When the Trial Balance report is executed for all accounting periods within a fiscal year, it displays the trial balance for G/L accounts for one year.-Meanwhile, the G/L Accounts - Line Items report only displays data for accounting periods in which postings exist, which can result in differences between the opening and closing balances shown in the reports.-Another possible reason is that the Trial Balance report consider only postings with specific Closing Steps, whereas the G/L Accounts - Line Items report includes postings from all Closing Steps. Adding the Closing Step characteristic to both reports can help to identify this.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-periods without postings, nonposting periods excluded, zero-activity periods, opening balance mismatch, closing balance mismatch, report variance, reconciliation issue, detail versus summary, fiscal period coverage, posting existence filter, zero-balance periods, line item visibility, balance rollforward, period aggregation behavior, empty periods hidden

Title: Error - Derivation for accounting principle DEF, chart of accounts ABC, G/L account ZZZ
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post the New Outgoing Bank Transfer or approving task - Approve Manual Payment <XXX> and getting below errors:-'Derivation for accounting principle DEF, chart of accounts ABC, G/L account ZZZ'-'No functional area could be assigned'-'Previous action failed; inconsistent data cannot be saved'-'Approval failed'-'Problems with allocation of payment XXX'-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click on New Outgoing Bank Transfer. -Enter the relevant data in Company, Payee, Posting Date, Bank Account ID. -Select Outgoing Payment With - Direct Posting to G/L Account. -You see error messages:-Derivation for accounting principle XXX, chart of accounts ABC, G/L account ZZZ.-No functional area could be assigned.- Or-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Click on Approvals view.-Search for the Task - Approve Manual Payment XXX.-Click Approve.-You see error messages:-Derivation for accounting principle XXX, chart of accounts ABC, G/L account ZZZ.-No functional area could be assigned.-Previous action failed; inconsistent data cannot be saved.-Problems with allocation of payment 1.-Approval failed.-Cause-The Reporting Principle for Set of Books is Function of expense and it requires Cost center at the time of posting.-Resolution-When you post the New Outgoing Bank Transfer, then you must have to select the Cost Center.  --If you get the error at the time of Approving Manual Payment task, then the approver has to Reject the task. The status of the Outgoing Bank Transfer becomes Approval Rejected. Later, you can create a New payment with Cost Center.-Keywords-Derivation for accounting principle, No functional area could be assigned, Previous action failed, Approval failed, Approvel Manual Payment task.

Title: Error during key figure creation: Instance with the same key already exists
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new key figure but on saving you face the following error:-Save failed-Instance with the same key already exists-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Key Figures.-Click New.-In step 1, enter a key figure name and select the required data source.-Choose the type "restricted key figure".-Go to step 2 and enter your formula here.-Click Save.-You get the above errors.-Cause-There is an issue in the parameter-handling, when a date-parameter is used multiple times.-For example, you may have used "Today" several times in your formula. This can happen with any date parameter.-Resolution-We are currently checking if / how this can be improved in future releases, however there is a workaround:-Create your key figure with a formula where the date parameter is used only once. Save this key figure.-When you edit it again, you can change the formula as required, i.e. the date can be used as many times as needed.-Keywords-key figure, business analytics, can't save, instance with same key already exists, reporting, save failed

Title: Tax Number Type for Country Kosovo
Content: Symptom-You want to add Tax Number Type in the Supplier/Customer master data for Country - Kosovo. But, you cannot find the Standard Tax Number Type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center. -Click on Suppliers View. -Select the Supplier and Edit - Financial Data.-Go to Tax Data tab. -Click Add Row under Tax Numbers.-Enter Country - XK - Kosovo.-In the Tax Number Type field, you cannot find any record. -Note - Above steps apply to Customer master data also.-Cause-Unfortunately, the standard Tax Number Type is not provided for the Country - XK – Kosovo, due to:-It is not a recognized by ISO 3166. Basically, it is a region of the country Serbia.-Technically, it is not possible because there is a dependence on the pre-requisite scoping question 'Do you want to add countries/regions with preliminary ISO codes?'. Follow the below steps to find this question:-Business Configuration work center.-Click on Implementation Projects view.-Filter with All Current Projects.-Select First Implementation (that should be in Started status).-Click on Edit Project Scope and then Next repeatedly until we come to step 4 Questions.-Scoping Element Built-in Services and Support Business Environment.-Drill down to Units, Rates and Cross-Application Data.-Click on Business Option Countries/Regions with preliminary ISO codes (1)-Question 'Do you want to add countries/regions with preliminary ISO codes?'.-Select the checkbox under column 'In Scope' (this is a pre-requisite for the tax number functionality to be delivered, which may not be the case with all customers)-If this question is NOT checked, then the country code for Kosovo won't be available in the system and as a result, the Tax Number Type functionality will result in foreign key errors that would arise due to the missing Kosovo country code.-Resolution-This is a current system behaviour.-Keywords-Tax Number Type, XK - Kosovo

Title: Extension Field Unavailable in Production Order
Content: Symptom-You create an extension field EXT1(where EXT1 is the extension field) in Product Portfolio to extend to several view and forms.-However you find that the extension scenario Production Request - Output Item Information to Production Order - Output Item Information is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Product Protfolio workcenter and  Materials view.-2. Open any material and click on View All-3. Enter Adaptation mode-4. Right Click on a field from the General Tab, then click on "+Extension Field"-5. Create a new field, or select an existing one, then click on "Further Usage"-6. Navigate to the Extension Scenarios tab-Here you can see the following scenario related to production:-- Material - General Information to Production Proposal - Output Item-- Production Proposal - Output Item Information to Production Request - Output Item Information-- Production Proposal - Production Proposal Output to Production Request Planning Details - Requested Material Output-- Production Request Planning Details - Requested Material Output to Production Requests - Material Output-  However, there is no extension scenario for the Production Order object-Cause-There is Extension scenario from Material to Production Proposal-Output Items but there is none which goes forward to Production Request/Production Order.-  Resolution-Currently the scenario to Production Request/Production Order is not available in the system.-This would need to be registered as a new requirement in our Influence Portal ( https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886 ),-so other users can upvote it and it may be considered for future system releases based on demand and technical feasibility.-  Keywords-Extension field, Production Request, Production Order, Production Proposal,Output Item, Planning.

Title: Performance of report Customer Demand Details
Content: Symptom-The report "Customer Demand Details" is low to load, for example when opening the value help for "Sourced from".-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Open Customer Demand Details.-In the selection, open the value help for "Sourced From".-It loads for several minutes before anything is shown.-Cause-We have implemented some code changes to improve the performance of the report. However, the performance in the Value help cannot be changed completely due to the following reasons:-The root cause is due to the high number of data in the system. During the call of the value help, the system traverses through all of these records and stores them temporarily. Since the records are high, it takes times for this activity.-However note that after selecting the value help, the report execution is faster, since the system does not need to derive the orders again (unless the selections are changed).-So you could for example run the report first with the default selections and then select the Values from the Value help. This will make the value help much faster.-Resolution-Unfortunately, due to the distinct design of the underlying data source SCMCDU01, this behavior in the value help cannot be addressed with a short term change.-You can register this on the Influence Portal to be taken up in a future release.-Keywords-Customer demand details, report, performance, too slow, reporting, SCMCDU01_Q0001

Title: KBA Attached in Partner Incident Interface is not Displayed in Customer Tenant
Content: Symptom-As a partner, you use the partner incident interface from the communication scenario "Integration of the support request: partner to customer".-While using the function of submitting references, e.g. KBA in the solution collection, the KBA appears in partner system, however it is not displayed in customer tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This functionality is not yet implemented in Partner communication scenario/solution search from Partner to Customer, hence it's not working.--Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-As a workaround, KBA ID can be added as a normal note and sent to Customer which can then be opened and checked by Customer.-Keywords-Partner Communication Scenario, KBA, Solution Search

Title: Error "Mandatory Input Missing In Row 1/Column 'Master Template'(FPFC_CONTEXT_ID)" When Trying To Add Row Under Form Master Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When adding a new row for a template under Master Template Maintenance you receive the below error message-Error Message 1 - Only single comparisons allowed for test parameter Element 'Company'-Error Message 2 - Mandatory input missing in row 5/column 'Master Template'(FPFC_CONTEXT_ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the system with support user-Go to Application and User Management-Navigate to Master Template Maintenance-Form Master Templates dropdown-Click on New / Select existing Form Master Template and click on Copy existing --> This works fine-Select the "newly created" template-Click on Assign button-Add a row with company/Org Unit ID-Select Output Channel ex 'Email'-Save and close.-Below Error messages are displayed-Error Message 1 - Only single comparisons allowed for test parameter Element 'Company'-Error Message 2 - Mandatory input missing in row 5/column 'Master Template'(FPFC_CONTEXT_ID)-Cause-The FDT rule table was probably corrupted due to some invalid operation.-Resolution-Route the incident to AP-RC-OUT Support team so they can validate if the table is ok or fix it in case there is some inconsistency.-See Also-@AP-RC-OUT Support team, please check the details given in the wiki link: Form master template and perform the correction accordingly.-Keywords-FPFC_CONTEXT_ID, Master Template, Master Template Maintenance, Add, Row, Error, Master, Template, Mandatory,

Title: Error "Base UoM for kit must be EA - Each" Occurs During Migration of Materials
Content: Symptom-Error "Base UoM for kit must be EA - Each" occurs during Migration of Materials.-Environment-All versions after SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN 2202-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Migration of Materials activity and Open.-Click in Migrate Materials using the Migration Tool.-Choose the xml file you want to migrate.-Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error occurs.-Cause-This is upgraded as part of 2202 release.-Resolution-You have to change the UoM as EA for kit.-Keywords-Base UoM, Migration, Materials

Title: 'Leave Available (as of today)' Field in Leave Request Shows Incorrect Balance or No Balance is shown
Content: Symptom-Field Leave Available (as of today) in employee's Leave Request is incorrect, which is reflecting total account balance available for the entire year or doesnt not show any Balance.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Home.-Select view Self Services and select radio button Self services Overview. -Select the link New Leave Request under section Time. -Check the balance of Leave Available (as of today).-Note that this field may show the total entitled leave balance whole year rather than accrued leave balance until today, Or it may not show any balance.-Cause-The reason for displaying the entitled balance whole year in the field is the posting type configured for the time account rule in Business Configuration.-Resolution-In order to show leave balance accrued until today rather than the end of year, you need to change the time account rule in Business Configuration:-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Select Overview view.-Select Show All Activities.-Search for the Activity Time Account.-Click Time Account used for employee's paid time-off.-In popup window, click link Maintain Time Account Rules. There you can choose the time account rule used by the time account and click the button Maintain Account Rule in the detail section.-A new window will open up, where you can change Posting Type on tab Accrual Rule from Entitlement to Accrual. Then click Save and Close.-After this change has been saved it might be necessary to remove the time account from the employee's time file and add it again. Then the changed time account rule will take effect. Note that the changed balance may not be shown immediately in the time account postings, but after the next day closure run which is scheduled to be run during the night.--See Also-   2977796 - Leave Available (as of today) is Blank When Creating a Leave Request, 1307446 - Leave Available (as of today) does not show any data-Keywords-Leave Available (as of Today), Time Account, Maintain Time Account Rules, Entitlement, Accrual

Title: Unable to Disable Account Determination Group For General Expenses
Content: Symptom-Unable to disable Account Determination Group for General Expenses as there is an Error Message Value XXX in setting Account Determination Group for Reimbursement Rate must also be entered in setting G/L Accnt Det.Group for Expense Report is displayed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to Implementation Projects view.-3. Select the project and perform the action Open Activity List.-4. Navigate to Fine tune and select the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-5. Select the activity Costs under Account Determination.-6. Delete the entries for Account determination groups for expenses under the tab General Expenses.-7. The system displays an error message Value XXX in setting Account Determination Group for Reimbursement Rate must also be entered in setting G/L Accnt Det.Group for Expense Report-Resolution-The system does not allow deleting the Account Determination groups and should not be deleted.-They are used in the template for generic country versions and therefore should remain in the system else otherwise no new country versions could be created in the system-Keywords-Value XXX in setting Account Determination Group for Reimbursement Rate must also be entered in setting G/L Accnt Det.Group for Expense Report,  G/L Accnt Det.Group for Expense Report, Delete Account Determination Group, Delete ADG

Title: Lease Posting Run - Application runtime exception; report an incident
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***WAITING FOR VALIDATION, if proven, change status to Published and remove this statement***-You have executed a Lease Posting run. The run finishes with error - During run for company ABC, set of books XYZ, the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Click on Lease Posting Run.-Enter all obligatory data (Company, Key Date Type, Key Date) and then press Start Now to immediately execute the run.-After several minutes a message appears stating the run time error: During run for company ABC, set of books XYZ, the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred-Cause-One of the reason could be the Minimum and Maximum amount for Low value asset is not maintained in the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets fine tune activity.-Or-The Starting Date of latest version Lease Contract must be after the Valid from date of low-value assets for each accounting principle, which is maintained in the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets fine tune activity.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click Overview.-Search for fine tune activity - Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-Open the activity and maintain the Currency, Valid from, Valid to, Minimum Amount & maximum Amount.-Or-If the Valid from date is maintained, then compare this date with the Starting Date of latest version Lease Contract. -Maintain the Minimum and Maximum amount-For Example:-1) Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets-Valid from date - 01.06.2021--2) Starting Date of latest version Lease Contract-Start Date - 22.06.2021--You will not get any error message.-See Also-Keywords-Low value asset max/min amounts missing for crcy and actg ppl.,  Application runtime exception; report an incident, Lease Posting Run, During run for company, set of books

Title: Column Filters Do Not Work in any Views of the Mass Change of Materials and Services
Content: Symptom-You are e.g. in the 'Planning' or 'Valuation' view of the Mass Change screen, where filters are not working for any column (Material Description, Product Category ID, Identified Stock Type, Net Weight, Gross Weight, Net Volume, Gross Volume, Length, Width, Height, Purchasing Status, Logistics Status).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data or Product Portfolio work center.-Select Materials or Services view.-Select several products and select Mass Change button.-Change to any available option (Planning, valuation, ...) in Show field.-Select the filter icon, try using filter for any column but nothing works.-Cause-The reasons why it is not possible to provide this feature are:-The filtering option is disabled in order to avoid overlapping and enabling the Default row in the Mass Change screen.-Immediate solution is not possible since the changes are complex in nature.-Resolution-In the Mass Change (like e.g. Planning, Valuation) screen, you cannot exclude a specific row from filtering. Since the purpose is to keep the mass change at the top to be shown always, filtering for a value may get this removed from the filtered view. So filtering is disabled in the Mass Change screen.-Workaround:-Search for the particular parameter in the Material or Service view screen using Advanced Search and then apply mass change for the instances (filter the data before applying mass change). If you need further filtering/selection in the Mass Change screen, you can select further, using the CTRL key in the keyboard.-See Also-1719641 - Inconsistent Filtering for Planning Area in Mass Change of Materials-1823348 - Inconsistent Filtering for Company/Business Residence in Mass Change of Services-Keywords-mass change, filter, material, service, Column, Field

Title: Dashboard Title Displayed Incorrectly
Content: Symptom-You are viewing a dashboard in the Insights work center. However after opening it, the name of the dashboard is shown incorrectly on top of the page. It seems to show a technical ID instead of the text.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Insights work center.-Open your dashboard.-The title line does not show the dashboard name but a technical ID.-Cause-The title of your dashboard includes the special character / which is not supported in this context.-Resolution-Please remove this character from the dashboard name.-See Also-To request changes of the standard behavior, please use the Influence portal available here.-Keywords-dashboard, insights, analytics, analysis, wrong name, title, description, technical ID

Title: Migration of Open Items Payable Error - Migration of Withholding tax items not possible; Product tax item missing
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Open items payables and receive the below error message:-Migration of Withholding tax items not possible; Product tax item missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend tab.-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity and click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration unit and select Execute Migration.-Simulate the migration, then you get the error message: --Migration of Withholding tax items not possible; Product tax item missing-Cause-There is no Tax Date maintained in the Migration template. Basically, the system needs Tax Data in order to determine Withholding Tax for the open items.-Resolution-You must have to maintain the Tax Data in the migration template and reupload in the Migration Tool.-Keywords-Migration of Withholding tax items not possible; Product tax item missing, Product tax item missing

Title: Error - No acct det. config. in table FIAC_ADGEN_EXDIF for profile <ABC> and sla line item type Remeasured Exchange Rate Differences: G/L Account
Content: Symptom-When you execute the Foreign Currency Remeasurement for G/L Accounts, you receive the error message "No acct det. config. in table FIAC_ADGEN_EXDIF for profile <ABC> and sla line item type Remeasured Exchange Rate Differences: G/L Account".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks > Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Select the executed run and open the respective Log Result.-Move to the Messages tab.-Here, you can find the error - No acct det. config. in table FIAC_ADGEN_EXDIF for profile <ABC> and sla line item type Remeasured Exchange Rate Differences: G/L Account. (ABC = Account Determination Profile)-Cause-The G/L Account relevant for gain or loss due to exchange rate difference, is not maintained in the General Ledger subledger.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to maintain the G/L Account for Gain/Loss from Foreign Currency Remeasurement:-Go to Business Configuration work center and choose Overview.-Search for the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on Change immediately.-Under Account Determination, click on General Ledger.-Select the Account Determination Profile (Mentioned in the error message)-Select tab Exchange Rate Differences and click on Add row.-Here, you have to maintain the G/L Account for Gain from Foreign Currency Remeasurement and Loss from Foreign Currency Remeasurement. -Save your changes.-You have to execute the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for G/L Accounts again.-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for G/L Accounts, No acct det. config. in table FIAC_ADGEN_EXDIF for profile, Remeasured Exchange Rate Differences: G/L Account

Title: UK MTD Error - Client Registration missing; contact administrator
Content: Symptom-You are configuring the UK MTD for VAT Return submission in the Test system and you see the error message - Client Registration missing; contact administrator.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Test system Only. -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview.-Search and open the UK Making Tax Digital activity.-Enter the VAT Registration Number.-Click on Allow Access. -You get the error message - Client registration missing; contact administrator.-Cause-The HMRC does not provide any sandbox/test system. Hence we suggest you not to configure UK MTD in the Test System as any successful submission carried out in the Test System will result in a live Tax Submission to HMRC.-Resolution-You can configure the UK Making Tax Digital (MTD) for VAT, directly in the Production system.-Keywords-Client registration missing; contact administrator, UK MTD

Title: 'Tax registration number not valid' Error for General Tax Number for Austria
Content: Symptom-When maintaining a General Tax Number for the Country Austria you get the error message 'Tax registration number not valid'. This is only valid for the Country AT - Austria.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Switch to the Company Tax Arrangements View.-Highlight the Company ID XXX (where XXX represents the Company ID in question) for the country of the Tax Authority Austria.-Press Edit.-Switch to the tab Company Tax Arrangements.-Change to the tab Tax Numbers.-Press Add Row.-Select 2 - General Tax Number.-Enter Data in any format, for example: tax authority Innsbruck (81) and tax number (242/6575), so for example: 812426575 or AT812426575.-You get an error message: 'Tax registration number not valid'.-Cause-You need to maintain only the seven digits of the Tax Number, not the 2 digits of the Tax Authority. The Tax Authority will then be derived automatically.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Switch to the Company Tax Arrangements View.-Highlight Company ID XXX country of the Tax Authority Austria.-Press Edit.-Switch to the tab Company Tax Arrangements.-Choose the tab Tax Numbers.-Press Add Row.-Select 2 - General Tax Number.-Enter a seven digit Tax Number, for example 2426575 (see example above).-You can see that in Header Finanzamt Innsbruck is displayed automatically.-See Also-KBA 2407500 - 'Tax registration number not valid' Error Message While Entering Company Tax Arrangement Tax Number-Keywords-Tax registration number not valid; general tax number Austria; company tax arrangements

Title: Sorting in report does not work
Content: Symptom-You are sorting on a characteristic in your report. You notice that it does not work correctly, for example all values are sorted alphabetically, but a few values are in the wrong order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-You have enabled the extended text feature in this report. Unfortunately the sorting cannot work on descriptions when this feature is switched on.-Resolution-Please switch off the extended text feature:-Open your report.-Click Configure > Hide Extended Text-Reopen your report.-To request a change in behavior, you can make use of the Influence Portal.-Keywords-report, sorting, ascending, descending, wrong order, not working, business analytics, show extended text, 60 characters, 1024 characters, ID, description

Title: Org Unit Manager of an Particular Org Unit is Disappeared Automatically
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a particular employee as a manager for an Org Unit but suddenly the assignment removed automatically or the validity is ended on a particular date.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Org Structures view.-Highlight the Org Unit.-Go to General tab.-Where the Org Unit Manager is missing. when you check in the Timelines tab, the Valid To date for the Organizational Unit Manager is ended on a Particular date (past date).-Cause-The cause for the issue could be,-1. A User might have unassigned the Org Unit Manager from the Org Unit on that particular date. This can be verified in the Changes log of that particular Org Unit.-or-2. There might be a change in Position of the Employee. Position means any transfer performed for this employee with respective to Job or Reporting Line Unit or Org Unit. When any event which leads to change in position happens,the position gets delimited and a new position is created. So in this case the position of the manager was delimited hence the transfer of position happened which made the manager to disappear.-As a Transfer changes details of the work agreement there are two possibilities for employees:-a) Leave him/her as Manager-b) Remove him/her as Manager-To be on the safe side, it was decided to let the manager assignment follow the working agreement (case b). When a transfer or termination of a manager is done, a warning informing about the potential manager issue (he/she should continue to be manager).-Resolution-To verify,-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Search and highlight the Org Unit.-Go to Timelines tab.-Where you can find the Valid To date of the Manager assignment in that Org Unit. So you can find the org Unit Manager only if the Effective From date is lesser than the Valid To date.-To verify whether there is a transfer,-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select employees view.-Edit the Employee.-Go to Employment tab and Organizational Assignment sub tab.-Here, you can transfer details of that employee.-The system works as designed.-To resolve the issue, You can re-assign that employee again as a Manager for that Org Unit and activate the changes to that particular Org Unit.-See Also-KBA 3219162 - All Manager Assignments of an Employee are Delimited after his/her own Transfer-Keywords-position change,org unit manager,manager,manager missing,manager validity

Title: Product Catalog Zipfile does not show files in File Explorer
Content: Symptom- Product Catalog Zip file does not show files in File Explorer-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Product Catalogs view.-Open a catalog-Navigate to the Product Search tab.-Add a zip file as attachment-Then download it using "download all" button-Open that zip file in file explorer.-You will not see any files-Cause-This behaviour is a current limitation due to the file names in the Zip folder.-Resolution-The reason why the zip file is not working is because the files inside have a name like: /BOAttachments/xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/XXXXXX_F5.jpg.-The leading "/" is the issue, the name should instead be BOAttachments/xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/XXXXXXXXF5.jpg.-You can remove the  leading "/" from the file name and upload it.-We have taken this limitation into our backlogs and it might be considered in one of the future releases.-Keywords-Product Catalog, Zip files, File Explorer, attachments.

Title: Error "Project Task is only supported in Business Bydesign Public Sector Edition" Occurs While Uploading Plan Data for Expenses and Income Statement
Content: Symptom-You upload the Plan Data for Expenses and Income Statement, and in the template, you enter the project task ID; but error "Project Task is only supported in Business Bydesign Public Sector Edition" occurs while saving data to the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Go to Planning View.-Click New->Plan Version from Microsoft Excel.-Select New Expense And Income Statement Plan and click Download.-Open the Excel and enter all necessary data including Project ID, then logon to SAP Business ByDesign in the Excel.-Click Save data to ..., error "Project Task is only supported in Business Bydesign Public Sector Edition" occurs.-Cause-It's a valid error - project tasks are not supported in the private edition for budget planning, only in the public sector edition.-The basis of active budget control for projects differs:-Public Sector -> Financial planning is required / the project task cost estimate does NOT serve as basis for active budget control.-Non-Public Sector -> Project task cost estimate.-To check the edition of the system, you can:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select currently project and click Edit Project Scope.-In the first step, you see the Type of Business is not Public Edition.-Resolution-Current system design.-Keywords-Project Task is only supported in Business Bydesign Public Sector Edition, Plan Data for Expenses and Income Statement, Project task, Public edition, non-public edition.

Title: 500 Internal Error While Saving New Budget
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***RELEASED INTERNALLY*** -You save a new budget, but the system dumps with 500 Internal Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the system with customer's account:-Go to Home Work Center.-Go to Self Service View.-Click Track My Budget Queries.-Click New->Budget Query.-Select Travel(or other categories) in Budget Category.-Enter all other values.-Click Save and Close. Then system dumps.-Cause-Duplicate budget query IDs for two sequential fiscal years which leads to the dump.-In the system, when a new Budget Query being created for current year (i.e. 2022), it assigns ID - '1' to new budget query but getting errored out on save as there is already an existing budget query in the backend with ID - '1' which was created last year (i.e. 2021). The system will not allow you to save duplicate budget query ID.(here, the fiscal years are just examples.)-To check the duplicate budget query IDs, you can:-Logon to the backend.-Enter transaction code SNRO and click Enter.-Enter ‘FINBUDREQU’ in the Object and click on the Intervals.-On the next page, click on the NR Status button, here you can see the NR status for fiscal years 2021 and 2022 are 1(see below highlighted fields).-Resolution-As a workaround, we can change the NR Status for fiscal year 2022 from the backend via below path:-Logon to the backend.-Enter transaction code SNRO and click Enter.-Enter ‘FINBUDREQU’ in the Object and click on the Intervals.-On the next page, click on the NR Status button.-Change the NR Status of fiscal year to a number which is greater than 1, here in the example, we enter 4 and click save.-Now, you can save the new budget query in the front end.-See Also-3193743-Keywords-budget query, save, dump, 500 internal error.

Title: Error "XXXXXX is balance sheet acct and cannot be planned as income and expense acct" Occurs When Uploading New Expense And Income Statement Plan
Content: Symptom-You upload the New Expense and Income Statement Plan, error "XXXXXX is balance sheet acct and cannot be planned as income and expense acct" occurs. And you are sure the G/L Account XXXXXX is a revenue account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Go to Planning View.-Click New->Plan Version from Microsoft Excel.-Select New Expense And Income Statement Plan and click Download.-Open the Excel and enter all necessary data, then logon to SAP Business ByDesign in the Excel.-Click Save data to ..., error "XXXXXX is balance sheet acct and cannot be planned as income and expense acct" occurs(XXXXXX is the G/L Account).-To verify the G/L account type of XXXXXX, you can:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open Activity Editing Chart of Accounts.-In the G/L Account table, filter G/L Account XXXXXX, the G/L Account type is REVGAN - Revenues or gains.-Cause-In this case, there are typos in the Company ID or Set of Book ID.-Resolution-Make sure the Company ID and Set of Book ID are correct and the same as what in the system.-Keywords-is balance sheet acct and cannot be planned as income and expense acct, upload, New Expense and Income Statement Plan.

Title: Cannot Update Tax Country When Your Create External Customer Invoice Request Via File Input
