Title: Error - Account AAAAAA in chart of accounts ABCD has no mapping to chart of accounts PQRS
Content: Symptom-You are trying Post "Manual Posting - Acquisition" and you get the error -  Account AAAAAA in chart of accounts ABCD has no mapping to chart of accounts PQRS.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to Fixed Assets View.-Click on Fixed Assets Sub-View.-Select the Fixed Asset.-Click on Manual Posting and then on Acquisition.-Fill the relevant data and keep the Set of Books field blank.-Click on Simulate.-You'll receive error message "Account AAAAAA in chart of accounts ABCD has no mapping to chart of accounts PQRS".-Cause-The selected G/L Account - AAAAAA is maintained under Edit Charts of Accounts - ABCD & PQRS. But there is no mapping between G/L Account AAAAAA and both the Charts of Accounts ABCD & PQRS together.-Resolution-You can view the mapping between G/L Account AAAAAA with two Charts of Accounts by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Click on Overview.-Search for the activity - Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on Edit G/L account mapping.-Here, you can find the combination of Charts of Accounts - ABCD & PQRS.-Under Details section click on Add Row-Maintain the G/L Account - AAAAAA.-Note:-1) You have to ensure to map only accounts that can be used in manual journal entry vouchers. Mapping to reconciliation accounts is not appropriate.-2) This KBA is valid for Manual Posting - Revaluation.-Keywords-Account in chart of accounts has no mapping to chart of accounts, Error in Manual Posting - Revaluation, Error in Manual Posting - Acquisition

Title: Download of Hierarchy in Excel via Broadcast not shown
Content: Symptom-The report hierarchy is not shown when a report is sent as an Excel file via broadcast.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to Broadcasts.-Enter the selection and view of the report with a hierarchy.-Send the Broadcast as any Excel file: .csv, .xml or .xslx.-When you open the e-mail attachment you will not see the hierarchy.-Cause-.csv and .xslx are not supported for hierarchies. .xml is supported but only as a snapshot.-Resolution-To see the hierarchy in a broadcasted file, please use .xml as it works more like snapshot of the report view. The hierarchy must be fully expanded in the view of the report otherwise it will only show the levels expanded.-Keywords-.xml, .csv, .xslx, broadcast, excel, C4C, ByD, hierarchy, hierachy,

Title: Cannot Add Extension Field to QueryServiceConfirmationIn
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add an Extension Field to the web service QueryServiceConfirmationIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Service Confirmations view.-Open any Service Confirmation.-Click on the user's icon (top right of the window).-Select Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Click View All and go to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select Extension Fields.-Select the Extension Field ABC (ABC represent the ID of the extension field).-Click on Show Further usage.-Select the Services tab.-You can see that the service QueryServiceConfirmationIn is not available for Service Description Manage Service Confirmation - Item.-Cause-This functionality is currently not supported.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Extension Field, QueryServiceConfirmationIn, Not, Available, Add, Field, Web Service, webservice

Title: Assign Account to Rule for Analyzing Memo Lines: Fund ID and Function ID Fields Are Not Available
Content: Symptom-The Fund ID and Function ID fields are not available for usage in the Assign Account to Rule for Analyzing Memo Lines screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find and open activity Global Settings for Payment.-Click Create and edit rules for analyzing memo lines.-Click Assign Account to Rule button.-Notice that fields Fund ID and Function ID are not available for usage.-You notice that these fields are also not available for selection in Personalization and Adaptation modes.-Resolution-This scenario is currently not supported as part of the Public Sector implementation and is a limitation.-Keywords-fund ID; function ID; Assign Account to Rule; rules for analyzing memo lines

Title: System is Showing the Warning 'Quantity entered exceeds delivered quantity for item XX in sales order XYZ' When Creating Customer Return Notification
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create New Customer Return Notification based on a Sales Order with a Kit or an Outbound Delivery. When you select both the Kit Header and the Kit Items and proceed to the next screen, you see that the Kit Items of the Sales Kit are duplicated. Also, the system displays for the duplicate Kit Item the following warning messages:-Quantity entered exceeds delivered quantity for item XX in sales order XYZ (XX represents the Item ID and XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item AA in outbound delivery ABC  (AA represents the Item ID and ABC represents the Outbound Delivery ID).-Quantity entered exceeds delivered quantity for item YY in sales order XYZ (YY represents the Item ID and XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item BB in outbound delivery ABC (BB represents the Item ID and ABC represents the Outbound Delivery ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to Common Tasks and select New Customer Return Notification.-Enter the Sales Order ID or the Outbound Delivery ID.-Click Go.-You can see all Line Items are listed including Kit Header and the Kit Items.-Select all rows and click Next.-You can see the System has copied the Kit Header and the Kit Items. You also notice the Kit Items are listed double whereby the system has highlighted the duplicate Kit Items and displays the warning message mentioned above under symptom.-You further notice that you cannot edit the Quantity of the Kit Items listed under the Kit Header whereas this is possible for the duplicate Kit Items.-Cause-This is not a bug, but an enhancement that was introduced as part of 2005 release. You can now select the sales kit header to Return the whole Kit or just the individual Sales Kit Item.-When you select both the Kit header and the Kit Items, you indicate you are returning the whole kit (including all Kit Items) and the individual Kit Items you selected. Since the Quantity is now more than the Quantity in the Outbound delivery / Sales Order, the system is correctly warning you that the Quantity you have entered is more than the Quantity you have delivered.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-In this case when you select both the kit header and the listed kit items, you are actually returning the kit as a whole (which means it should contain both the sale kit header and the sales kit items) and also the individual sales kit items.-If you would like to return the Sales Kit, please just select the Kit Header alone and the Kit Items will be added automatically in the next screen. And if you only intend to return individual Kit Item, please select these as desired and go to the next screen.-Note 1: If you select the Kit Header and also the Kit Items and you proceed to the next screen where you get the warning messages, you can just remove the duplicate Kit Items.-Note 2: When you select the Sales kit header for return, you are not allowed to change the quantity of the sales kit Item. As changing the Kit Item quantity may result in a Sales Kit integrity issue, the Kit item Quantity is in this scenario not editable.-Keywords-Quantity entered exceeds delivered quantity for item * in sales order *-Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item * in outbound delivery *

Title: Error 'Key AAAA, XXX...XXXXXXX, BB' Occurs When Migrating Open Item for Payable.
Content: Symptom-You migrate open item for payable, you get errors:-Tax Data: missing key relationship for the following values:-Key AAAA, XXX...XXXXXXX, BB(AAAA stands for the Company ID, XXX...XXXXXXX stands for the Document ID, BB is the Line Item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open Activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Find the migration unit CC and click Execute Migration(CC is the ID of the migration unit).-On the newly open page, select open item payable with source file DDD.xml(DDD is the ID of the uploaded file).-Click Process File.-After the system process the file, you get below errors: Tax Data: missing key relationship for the following values:Key AAAA, XXX...XXXXXXX, BB. -Here, the ID XXX...XXXXXXX is more than 35 characters.-Cause-There's a discrepancy between the source structure document ID field length in the migration object OPEN_ITMS_PAYABLE Open Items tab versus the Tax Data and Withholding Tax data tabs in the migration template, and the former Open Items tab is the correct length (35) as per the length defined in the target structure. The result of this is that when you have a field length longer than 35 maintained, the field is truncated on the open items tab and then there's no matching key on the untruncated tax tabs, so there's a validation error at this point.-Resolution-The issue can be resolved by maintaining document ID of 35 characters or less in all tabs, as this is the correct field length.-At the moment there's an internal discrepancy between field length allowed in this field on the Open Items tab versus the two tax tabs (which allow 80 characters). It will be enhanced in the future release.-Note: OPEN_ITMS_RECEIVABLE migration object is fine without such issue.-Keywords-Open Item for Payable. Migration. Tax Data: missing key relationship for the following values. Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.

Title: Error - Owner party ID not Valid; It is Not Active
Content: Symptom-When creating a new fixed asset an error message appears: "Owner party ID XXX not valid; it is not active".-OR-You receive an error "Owner party ID XXX not valid; it is not active" while performing Migration of Fixed Assets (where XXX represents Owner party ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Fixed Assets Workcenter navigate to the Fixed Assets view-Choose New - Fixed Asset.-Enter all the required details.-After pressing Save the error message appears: Owner party id XYZ not valid; it is not active.--OR-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter. -Select the Overview view.-Search and open the Activity : Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select the Fixed Assets activity.-Upload the file and execute Import.-You get the error - Owner party id XYZ not valid; it is not active-Cause-The owners ID refers to the business partner organization number. The status of the business partner is locked.-Resolution-Go to the Business Partner Data workcenter-In the Business Partner view.-Select Business Partner ABC and the status is Blocked.-Click on the Change status button and choose Active.-After this it will be possible to create a the New fixed for the business partner/ company.-Keywords-Owner party id XYZ not valid; it is not active, Fixed asset Error, Fixed asset creation error.

Title: Wrong time format in Reports
Content: Symptom-Time Format is not displayed in Reports as per the regional settings when in 12-Hour Time-Environment-Cloud For Customer-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to to the work center Business Analytics.-Click on the view Design Reports.-Open any report, for example Activity Analysis.-Execute the report.-Add any Date Time field to the rows (for example Appointment(Created On Date/Time)-It shows in the 24-Hour time format though in Regional Settings, the time format is set to 12-Hour.-Cause-The Date and Time format are displayed as stored in the backend and regional settings are not applied here. In the backend, time is displayed in a 24-Hour format.-Resolution-If you are looking for any changes in the product design, you can submit this as an enhancement request in our Influence page.-See Also-Please refer to the below KBA to know how to raise new requirement request.-2571552 - New Requirements in Reporting / Analytics-Keywords-Date and Time; Time Format, report, business analytics, 12 hours, 24 hours

Title: Characteristic Involved Data Source Not Available in Copied Reports
Content: Symptom-You would like to copy one of the audit reports (Balance Audit Trail, Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail, Accounts Receivable - Balance Audit Trail, Cash - Balance Audit Trail or Tax - Balance Audit Trail, Expense and Reimbursement Details). You notice however that the characteristic Involved Data Source is not available in the report copy. Without this field, the report does not show meaningful data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and select the view Design Reports.-Search for an audit report, for example Balance Audit Trail and click on New > Report As Copy.-Here, in the first step, you will see the warning message Characteristic 0MDAV cannot be used. It is removed from the report.-If you move on to step 3, you see that the field Involved Data Source is not available in the list.-Cause-The field Involved Data Source is unfortunately not available for customization.-NOTE: The field Involved Data source will not appear in custom joins either.-Resolution-All audit reports are highly complex; for example they require a specific layout (ones that includes the Involved Data Source) to display the data properly. We would recommend not to customize them, but to use other financial reports / data sources instead.-See Also-Knowledge Base Article 2091664 - Report Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail Shows Wrong Value in Balance Company Currency .-Keywords-0MDAV, Involved Data Source, custom data source, custom report, custom key figure.-missing

Title: Change Appointment Time Frame Under Activities: Calendar View
Content: Symptom-You are navigating through the Activities: Calendar View, noticed that every slot is for a 30 minute time frame and you would like to change this to 15 minutes (quarter hour).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Activities view.-Click Show Calendar.-Slots are currently set for 30 minutes.-Cause-The functionality to adjust activity time frame is not part of the system and as of now, the system only provides half hour time slots.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Account Management, Activities, Show Calendar, Time, Appointment, half hour, quarter hour, 30 minutes, 15 minutes, Setting

Title: Error Message "Mandatory value missing or invalid; check Time Recording Profile field on General Information sheet"
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate the Time and Labor Management data of the employee, system throws below error message:-Mandatory value missing or invalid; check Time Recording Profile field on General Information sheet-or-Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks-Environment-SAP Busines ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation Project view-Select Open Activity list button-Search for activity Migration of Employee Data and open the activity-Select sub activity Migrate time and labor management data using the migration tool-Cause-The cause for the error message is that there is no values entered for Time Recording Profile.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, Enter 0 for the field Time Recording Profile in the General Information sheet and try to migrate the data again into the system.-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Select Implementation Projects view.-3. Select Open Activity List button for First Implementation.-4. Go to Fine- Tune chevron.-5. Search and Open Time Types - US activity.-6. Select Maintain Time Recording Profile link.-7. Add the Time profiles here.-8. Save the changes.-Now, try to migrate the data again into the system.

Title: Limitations of HTML5 UI in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This knowledge base article lists currently known limitations in SAP Business ByDesign's HTML5 user interface.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-HTML UI permanent limitations-1. Technology limitations-1.1. In Internet Explorer 11, we do not support embedded display of PDF content. This issue is due to an Internet Explorer 11 limitation—the PDF content gets displayed on top of the pop-over content, making the pop-over non-interactable.-1.2. In the Form Template Maintenance user interface, editing the template (under the "Open" button dropdown) with Adobe LiveCycle Designer is not available in HTML5 UI.-1.3. Data Migration screens such as the Migration Tool are browser dependent. They are supported in Internet Explorer 11 and Google Chrome only.-1.4. Display status of currently installed software is not possible in HTML5 UI. In Silverlight UI, Install Additional Software screen showed the status of the installed software on end user’s local system via a green square symbol (latest version is installed), a yellow triangle (a newer version is available to install) or a white circle (software is not installed).-1.5. While printing in Silverlight UI, there was an option to print page header and page footer. This feature is not supported in HTML5 UI.-1.6. Attachment of files with size greater than 100 MB.-1.7. Microsoft Edge version 41.16299 shows stranding scroll bars after expanding scroll container.-2. Defunct features-2.1. "Icon view" for attachments. In Silverlight UI, attachments feature provided option to switch between "icon view" and "tabular view." The HTML5 UI does not support "icon view" for attachments. Attachments will be displayed in tabular view.-2.2. Printed content of Gantt chart, work breakdown structure, network diagram and hierarchical graph are different in Silverlight and HTML5 UI. Currently, it is not planned to implement Silverlight's way of printing in HTML5 UI for these controls.-2.3. Quick filter in analytics report screen is not supported.-2.4. The Report Gallery is not supported in the HTML5 UI.-2.5. Merging of table cells based on merge rules on certain table displays is not yet implemented.-HTML UI limitations planned to implement in future releases-Limitation in Reporting / Analytics-3. The bottom progress indicator of reports while loading is not yet available in the HTML5 UI.-Core UI Control limitations-4. Highlighting the input field on clicking the validation error message. In Silverlight UI, upon clicking the error message, the associated field was highlighted and the focus was set on the erroneous field. This feature is not yet supported in HTML5 UI.-5. The Learning Center video playback is not yet supported in HTML5 UI.-6. Using up arrow key to select last item in a dropdown list will not work in HTML5 UI.-7. The capability to make an input field mandatory is not supported in cases where the field is used inside a table or if the field's data is bound to a row of a table (This statement may not be applicable for all documents, e.g. purchase order). However, if the option to make a field mandatory is not available, then it means that in HTMlL it is not allowed even if it was allowed in Silverlight.-Keywords-Limitations, HTML5 UI, SAP Business ByDesign, Silverlight

Title: Error Message: Timeline of org unit XYZ () should be changed in future only, When Activating the Org Unit XYZ.
Content: Symptom-When you try to Check or Activate an Organizational Structure, system throws below error message:-Timeline of Org Unit XYZ should be changed in future only-Activation failed; resolve all errors-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit button or Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org Unit or Org Structure.-Select Check All or Activate All option.-Cause-The cause for the issue is might be because, that you are try to extend the Valid From date of the Org Unit XYZ to a past date. For Example: If the Valid From date of the Org Unit XYZ is 01.01.2013 and if you to change the date to 31.12.2012 or any earlier dates, then the system ends up with above issue.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, change the Valid From date of Org Unit XYZ to the initial date which was used during last activation . This can be performed in the Planning Area and in the Timelines tab of the Org Unit XYZ.-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Select the Org unit and Go to Tab Timelines.-Change the Valid From date to the initial date which was used during last activation and press Enter key in the keyboard.-See Also-You can also refer below documents:-1740758 - Error Message "Timeline of Org Unit XYZ Should be Changed in Future only" While Activating the Org Structure

Title: Dunning Letter Considers Wrong Output Channel
Content: Symptom-After changing the sending options for a Dunning Proposal in the OWL (Overview) you noticed that the changed Output Channel is not taken into consideration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Open the Dunning View and search for a dunning proposal in status In Preparation.-Click Preview.-Select Send Options, change the Output Channel and click Apply.-Click the Actions button and click Execute Dunning.-Your output channel changes are not considered.-Cause-Since you cannot save the Output Channel in the Overview (OWL) the previous Output Channel will always be considered.-Resolution-If you need to change the Output Channel before executing the Dunning Output please do the following:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to view Dunning and search for a Dunning Proposal in Status In Preparation.-Click the Dunning ID.-Click Preview.-Select Send Options and change the Output Channel.-Click Apply and then the Save button to keep this change.-  After executing the Dunning the new Output Channel is considered correctly.-Keywords-Dunning proposal; dunning ID; output channel

Title: Error When Trying to Replicate Employee Between Success Factors and Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You are trying to replicate employee between SF and ByD, however, the error below is appearing:-Error occured during time agreement data update-Save failed-Start Date can't be changed,because of Manual Adjustments on Time Account-Time Profile start date can't be changed with multiple profile splits.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2205 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Then go to the Employees view.-Find the affected Remote Employee ID and select it.-Click Edit.-Click Replicate-Error appears.-Cause-One of the cause might be that you are trying to delimit the time agreement, but it's unable to do so because the replication request is trying to change the start date of the time profile. Currently, this change is not allowed because manual adjustments exists for the time profile. Also in case there are splits present in the time profile, the change of start date of the time profile start date wont be allowed.-Resolution-To solve this scenario you need to follow one of the options below:-Delete the manual adjustments and execute the replication request.-Change the time profile start date of the replication request same as that of the time profile in Byd System.-Keywords-Master Data Replication, Employees, Error, Replicate, Start Date can't be changed, because of Manual Adjustments on Time Account, Time Profile start date can't be changed with multiple profile splits.

Title: IRPA Feature Limitations
Content: Symptom-SAP Business ByDesign provides customers with automatically provisioned Intelligent Robotic Automation, managed by SAP in a specially prepared sub-account of the SAP Business Technology Platform. As a result, IRPA features that require the customer to access the underlying BTP account are not currently available to SAP Business ByDesign customers-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Resolution-Business Technology Platform Destinations-At present, the Destination (link to the new help) feature is not supported. The Configuration page for destinations remains empty and SAP Business ByDesign customers cannot add destinations themselves. API notifiers can be used only without destinations.-SAP Cloud ALM Integration-SAP Cloud ALM Integration which allows SAP Cloud Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) platform to monitoring environment backlog and status of automation processes is not supported for the ByDesign implementation of Intelligent RPA as it needs access to BTP Cockpit for setup.-Keywords-IRPA; Limitations; ALM; Destination

Title: Down Payment Tax Code for Belgium
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Down Payment document where the Tax Country is Belgium and the system determines Tax Code 300 - Non-taxable sale in Belgium.-You expect that a different Tax Code is determined by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order document).-Click Create Down Payment button.-Enter Tax Country Belgium.-The Tax Code 300 - Non-taxable sale in Belgium is determined-Cause-Based on previous requirements, no VAT (Value-Added Tax) was required to be calculated when a Down Payment would be created for an advanced payment. With Release 2108 we enabled all Tax Codes for Down Payments.-However, the Tax Code 300 will be automatically determined by the system.  --Resolution-You can manually select the respective Tax code from the drop down list.-This is the current system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-See Also-2284849 -Tax Code Determination Error for Down Payment Requests-Keywords-Belgium, Down Payment, Tax Code, 300; 310

Title: Data in the Column Supplier Tax ID in the Report 'Withholding Tax Items' is Not Shown as Your Expectation
Content: Symptom-You are checking the data of Supplier tax ID in the report 'Withholding Tax Items'. However, the data is not shown as your expectation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Go to Reports View.-Find and open report: Withholding Tax Items.-Enter below values: Company ABC, Tax Country/Region XX, Supplier HIJ.(ABC stands for the Company ID, XX stands for Country/Region, HIJ stands for the Supplier ID)-Click Apply-Add field Supplier Tax ID to the report.-You can see, for supplier HIJ, the Supplier Tax ID is YYYYYYYYYY.-To check the tax number you maintained for the suppliers:-Go to Payables Workcenter.-Go to Suppliers View.-Find and open Supplier HIJ-Go to Tab Financial data, sub tab Tax Data.-You can see for Country/Region XX, there are two lines:-Country/ Region XX, Tax Type DD, Tax Number YYYYYYYYYY.-Country/ Region XX, Tax Type EE, Tax Number XXXXXXXXXX.-You expect the system to pick XXXXXXXXXX in the report 'Withholding Tax Items'.-Cause-This report only picks first tax number if multiple are maintained in the supplier's master data.-Resolution-The workaround is:-Remove the undesired tax number in the supplier financial data.-Run the report and download the needful reports.-Maintain the tax number again. -Keywords-Withholding Tax Items. Supplier Tax ID. Incorrect. Unexpected.

Title: Error - External Reference <XYZ>: Error in tax recalculation due to <ABC> <DEF> discount. Use a Payment Difference Reason that is not relevant for tax adjustment. (KBA: 3109103)
Content: Symptom-You get the error message "External Reference <XYZ>: Error in tax recalculation due to <ABC> <DEF> discount. Use a Payment Difference Reason that is not relevant for tax adjustment. (KBA: 3109103)" when trying to clear the Invoice and Payment manually.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work centre.-Click on Customer Accounts view.-Search for the Account and Click View. -Click on Clearing ID. -In the next screen You find the error message - "External Reference <XYZ>: Error in tax recalculation due to <ABC> <DEF> discount. Use a Payment Difference Reason that is not relevant for tax adjustment. (KBA: 3109103)", once you click on Clear. -Cause-This occurs when the Transaction currency and the Tax Reporting Currency of the document are different. During clearing/payment, a negligible discount is applied, and the adjustment is relevant for tax recalculation.-Example:-Customer Invoice created with Transaction Currency in EUR and Tax Reporting Currency in DKK .-Exchange Rate Applied = 7.44-  Base Amount Tax(%) Tax Amount Gross Amount-Transaction Currency (EUR) 213 25 53.25 266.25-Reporting Currency (DKK) 1584.72 25 396.18 1980.9-During clearing/payment, when a negligible discount is applied, for example 0.01 EUR, the Tax Lines in Transaction Currency are adjusted as follows:-Transaction Currency (EUR)-Base Amount Tax(%) Tax Amount-Gross Amount-213 25 53.25 266.25-212.992 25 53.248 266.24-    0.002  -The Tax Amount is then rounded off to two digits = 0.002 rounded to 0.00. Hence in the Transaction Currency, the Tax Amount = 0.00-Further, in the Reporting Currency the discount applied would be 0.01 * 7.44 = 0.0744-The Tax Lines adjusted in Reporting Currency would be:-Reporting Currency (DKK)-Base Amount Tax(%) Tax Amount Gross Amount-1584.72 25 396.18 1980.9-1584.66048 25 396.16512 1980.8256-    0.01488  -The Tax Amount is then rounded off to two digits = 0.01488 rounded to 0.01. Hence in the Reporting Currency the Tax Amount = 0.01-Resolution-You have to post the discount against a Payment Difference Reason that is not tax adjustment relevant.-Keywords-Clearing, Cash Discount, Tax Deduction Correction, Tax Amount, Transaction Currency, Zero, 0

Title: Long Loading in Sales Quotes or Sales Orders After Changing "Group By" Filter
Content: Symptom-End User tries to change filters in the Sales Quotes/Sales Order view and gets a long loading time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Service Work Center.-Select Sales Quotes under New Business sub-menu.-Change the "Group By" filter.-Cause-Scrolling the OWL will load a small number of records for viewing and continue to load these small batches as the user goes further. However, triggering the "Group by" option will add an additional layer onto this process, effectively now pulling back all the records to group them in the necessary order for the selection.-Whenever this issue takes place, it is most likely that the system has a great amount of quotes in the system.-Resolution-In order to optimize the performance, advanced filter is recommended to search for quotes of interest. Otherwise it will take longer to load the quotes.-Keywords

Title: Error Message: Expense Data for period from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY already exit, While Creating a new Expense Report
Content: Symptom-When you create a new Expense Report with Expense Report Type as Business Trip, system throws below error message:-Expense Data for period from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY already exist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and expenses work center.-Select Expense Reports view. -Select New Expense report and select Expense Report Type as Business Trip.-Fill in all the mandatory details.-Select Next button, System throws above error message.-Cause-User already has an expense report with Business Trip as Expense Report type with this time frame.-Resolution-It is not possible to create multiple Expense Reports for the same time period if you choose Business trip as Report Type.-Keywords-expense report, timeframe, period

Title: The Currency Unit of the Assessable Value for the Materials are Not Editable
Content: Symptom-Maintain the financial data of materials and find that the currency unit of the Assessable Value for the materials is not editable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to Materials View.-Find and open Material ABC(ABC is the ID of the material).-Go to Valuation tab.-See for Company DD and Business Residence EE(DD is the ID of the Company, EE is the ID of the Business Residence), the Inventory Cost is FF LC / 1 EA, for example (FF represents the amount, LC represents the currency other than INR).-The currency of Assessable Value is INR. And the currency for the Assessable Value cannot be changed to LC, as it's not editable.-Cause-Since the Assessable value is a field used only for India Stock transfer, the currency for the same is always in INR.-Resolution-In case there is an ask for maintaining the same in a different currency, place a request in customer Influence portal. SAP responsible team would take up the same based on the response on customer influence request.-Keywords-currency unit. assessable value. not editable. INR. Indian Rupee.

Title: Error 'ACTION ADD_CHILD not possible; object does not exist' Occurs When Editing Financial Reporting Structure
Content: Symptom-You get the error message 'ACTION ADD_CHILD not possible; object does not exist' when you try to Add Item in the Financial Reporting Structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work centre.-Go to Overview view.-Search for the Activity - Chart of Accounts: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination and open it.-Click on Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the Structure and Click on Edit. -Click on Expand All in the new screen. -Select the Structure Item and click on Add Item. -You see the error -  ACTION ADD_CHILD not possible; object does not exist.-Cause-You are not allowed to add a child node to a node to which a G/L account is assigned. This is only possible if you want to add the line under a Header node.-Resolution-This is a standard system behaviour.-Keywords-ACTION ADD_CHILD not possible; object does not exist, Error in Edit Financial Reporting Structure.

Title: The Characters in the Template of Bank Directory Can Not be Recognized in the System
Content: Symptom-You upload the bank directory via the template provided by SAP, but after the file uploaded successfully, you check the bank directory in the system, the bank name and street are showing ?????? or incorrect characters.-This problem occurs when your upload file contains non-English characters. For example, the bank name and street are all in Simplified Chinese.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to Bank Directory View.-Click New Bank Directory upload.-In Step1, select format SAP template and add file ABC.csv(ABC is the ID of the csv file).-Click next to last step and the file uploaded successfully.-Go to Bank Directory View.-Search Bank ID XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the bank you just uploaded).-You can see the bank directory is created, but the bank name is ?????? and the street is also ??????(or incorrect characters).-Cause-The SAP Template format for bank directory only supports windows-1251 encoding.  This is used for English and Cyrillic character sets and not Chinese character sets.-Resolution-You can upload them to the system, then correct the incorrect characters manually;-Or-You can manually create Bank Directories.-See Also-SAP Format for Bank Directory Upload-Keywords-bank directory. upload. character. incorrect. Simplified Chinese. Traditional Chinese. 银行目录. 上传. 乱码. 中文. 简体. 繁体.

Title: Missing Leads Vew in SAP Business ByDesign Mobile Application
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use the Leads view in SAP Business ByDesign mobile application, how you do not find it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently it is only supported to use the Leads functionality in the mobile device if the With Handover scenario has been scoped.-The functionality has been added to our product backlog to be implemented in a future release--Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Leads, New Business, Marketing, With Handover, Without Handover, Mobile, Application

Title: Count or Inlinecount Shows Wrong Result in OData Query
Content: Symptom-You are using OData to retrieve data source or report data. You are also using $count or $inlinecount, however you notice that a wrong value is returned (for example smaller or larger than the actual result of your query).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-Some data sources have a specific technical scope, which does not support the count or inline count. The affected data sources are (technical IDs):-byDesign:-BPCSCARB-BPCSCONTB-BPCSCONTB_2-BPCSDB-BPCSFINB-BPCSRSPB-BPSPPB-BPSP_PRD_CAT_LIFE-BUPASUPPLIERCOLLB01-CCABUSINESS_ROLE-FNDCLMB-FND_SUP_ADDRESS-FND_SUP_FINDATA-HCMTLMB13-SCMITEMCHST-SCMLOARESTB03-SCMLOARESTB04-SCMLOARESTB05-SCMLOCLYTB01-SCMPRFB01-SRMIR_B02-SRMPCO_B02-SRMPO_B12-SRMPRC_B01-SRMPR_B03-SRM_PPS_SCALES_MDAV-Cloud for Customer:-ANA_TEST_DTJ_B01-BPCSCARB-BPCSCONTB-BPCSDB-BPCSRSPB-BP_EMPLOYEE_DETAILS-CCABUSINESS_ROLE-CODBPCSCONTB-CODUSMB-CODUTLPREMISE-COD_IND_BANKING_B07-COD_IND_BANKING_B08-COD_IND_BANKING_B09-COD_IND_RET_CUS_CHK_B01-COD_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_B01-COMPETITOR_PRODUCT_B-CRMCASEREPB-CRMCHECKLISTHB-CRMEMPSKILL_B-CRMIBASEHB-CRMIBASEIPOINTHB-CRMIBASESKILLHB-CRMIPOINTHB-CRMIPOINTSKILLHB-CRMMEASUREMENTPOINTDOCHB-CRMOPPHHB-CRMQPPRTB01-CRM_SKILLH_B-FINCACB12-FINCACB13-FINCACB16-FNDCLMB-HCMTLMB05-PDM_MAT-PROCPIB03-PROCPIB06-PROCPIB07-PROCPIB09-PROCPIB11-UTILITIES_CA_ANAL_VIEW-Resolution-In these data sources, count and inlinecount do not provide reliable results and should not be used.-To request changes or enhancements, please use the Influence Portal.-Keywords-odata, count, wrong, inlinecount, report, data source, inline count

Title: Error - Significant leading zeroes are not allowed in FinancialPlanData/ID
Content: Symptom-You upload a new Plan Version using MS Excel and receive error message - Significant leading zeroes are not allowed in FinancialPlanData/ID, when you click 'Save data to'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Click on Planning view.-Click on New and select Plan Version from Microsoft Excel.-Select New Expense And Income Statement Plan.-Click on Download. -Fill the data in the excel.-Go to SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN tab.-Click on Save data to.-Error - Significant leading zeroes are not allowed in FinancialPlanData/ID.-Cause-The excel file has Plan Version starting with "0", which is causing the error.-Resolution-You have to remove the leading zeros from the Excel and click on Save data to.-Keywords-Significant leading zeroes are not allowed in FinancialPlanData/ID, Upload Financial Plan error, Planning version error

Title: Error Message: Activity Not Valid - When Releasing Recorded Times
Content: Symptom-You are not able to save and release times even though Projects are released and Project Tasks are assigned to a Sales Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Navigate to Self Services view.-Click on Edit Time Sheet.-Release the relevant tasks.-You get an error message: Activity not valid-Cause-In work center Business Configuration the Actual hours worked have to be activated and the Default values for time recording have to be maintained properly.-  Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center. -Press Overview.-Use an asterisk to search for all entries with Time Types <*Time Types*>.-Click on Time Types - Germany (or respective country).-Select Maintain Employee Time Types.-Under Actual Hours worked, Service Activation the checkbox Time Sheet has to be checked.-Click Save and Close or Close if checkbox is already selected.-Press Activate for Time Recording Services.-Choose Time Sheet.-DE0001 - Actual Hours Worked must be shown in Activated Time Types.-Go back to work center Business Configuration.-Press Overview-Use an asterisk to find entries with <*Time Recording*>-Click on Default Values for Time Recording - Germany-Default Value for Time Recording using Service Product must be Actual hours worked.-Keywords-Time Type, Activity not valid,Timesheet

Title: Error Message "Company of Employment and Organizational Unit Do Not Match"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to transfer an employee from org structure ABC to org structure XYZ (where ABC and XYZ stand for org structure IDs)n order to retain the same Employee ID, but system throws error message: "Company of employment and organizational unit do not match".-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center. -Select Employees view. -Access the relevant employee's personnel file (select an employee currently assigned to org structure: ABC)-Click the Actions button and choose Transfer Employee. -Fill in the Job/Organizational Unit (from intended organizational structure: XYZ) and other mandatory details.-Cause-The employee is already assigned to an org unit in the org structure ABC, so it is not possible to transfer them to an org unit in a different org structure XYZ.-This functionality is not supported by application as this leads to creation of a new employment, work agreement for the employee.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-You may consider using the workaround of terminating the employee from current org structure ABC and rehiring them in the new org structure. In this way, they can retain the same Employee ID.-In case, the Employee is hired wrongly and there is no reference documents created, then the below option is feasible:-I) Change the Hire Date of Employee:-Go to Personnel Administration.-Select Employees view.-Search and edit the employee.-Go to the Employment tab.-Select Change Hire Date and change the date to one day prior to actual hire date.-Change Service Start Date to match new hire date.-Save the changes.-The change will be saved successfully if there are no reference records.--II) Now terminate this employee with termination date same as new hire date.--III) Rehire the employee under the new company with hire date one day after the termination date used in the previous step.-Note: if the employee has two work agreements, then it is not possible to have a hire date in the first work agreement.-Keywords-Company, Employment, Organizational Unit, Organisational Unit, Do Not Match

Title: Unable to Work With File Input When The User is Using SSO Authentication
Content: Symptom-The User is using SSO authentication to access the system, however, when trying to use the File Input View, system requests the user's credentials.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2111 and higher.-Cause-Currently this is the expected system behavior. SSO is not supported with the File Input function.-Resolution-Access the system without the SSO configuration and it will work properly.-See Also-Customer Influence Site-Keywords-SSO, File Input, Not Supported, Credentials.

Title: Unable to Update Price List via Migration Tool or Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When trying to update Price List via Migration Tool or Mass Data Maintenance the system shows the following error message:-Duplicate source records detected for the following values-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2111 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Price Lists and open it.-Click Migrate price lists using the migration tool.-In the Migration tool, select the affected template.-Click Execute Migration > Step by step.-In the Validate File step the system will show the error.-Cause-Only extension fields of type code value can be downloaded and used to upload data. The customer can see this when trying to download the data for the pricelist 'Custom price based on code value'. For pricelist of all other types, the customers needs to either use the A2X service or OData to upload data. The customer can use migration for a few cases. However, when there is the combination of product + extension field, such scenario will not be possible.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Customer can use A2X service or OData to upload data.-See Also-3093704 - Unable to Migrate Custom Price List due to Error: Duplicate source records detected for the following values-Keywords-Migration of Price Lists, Mass Data Maintenance, Error, Duplicate source records detected for the following values, Cannot, Update, Existing, Records.

Title: Error in a Report Execution created on the top of a Cloud Data Source
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to run a report face created on the top of a Cloud Data Source or a Joined Data Source which makes use of a Cloud Data Source, the system returns an unexpected Abap error message.-The error message can varies itself, depending on how the data source involved which contains the Cloud Data Source (MDAV type 8) was designed or even the debugging technique used to get the error code in the backend. In general, you might come across with:-column store error: fail to create scenario:  [34011] Inconsistent calculation model;CalculationNode (.c0xx:1an:table_xxxx):ColumnTable HANADB:TABLE NAME not found (cannot get catalog object)-2991 - table config for index HANADB:.c0xx:1an:cs_xxxx is not valid-Reproducing the Issue-In order to figure out if the root cause of the issue faced by you is related to the same one referred in this case document, you will need to check what is the Data Base followed by a debugging technique.-To check what is Data Base type:-Log on the BackEnd of the system involved-As soon as you get access to the backend, click on System menu-In the System Status screen, check what is maintained for Database System-In case it's MaxDB you cannot consider this case document, since it's applicable for Hana DB system only-In case it's HDB (Hana DB), you might continue with upcoming steps-   2.  The debugging technique involves the TREX Aggregation from the Cube and it helps to pinpoint the backend error retrieved, you can debug it as follows:-Open TX CODE: se24-Open Class: CL_MDRS_MDAV_RT_DATA_CS-Open Method: READ_INTERNAL-Go to Line 124:   CALL FUNCTION 'TREX_EXT_AGGREGATE'  and place a break-point.-Execute your Data Source (MDAV) or your Report (MKFC)  and wait for the Debugger screen.-Once in the debugger screen, Press F6 to execute the CALL FUNCTION.-Check LV_ERROR_CODE and LV_ERROR_TEXT variables in order to see the ERROR ID and the ERROR message.-The both variable will return the message code error: 2991 - table config for index HANADB:.cxxx:1an:cs_xxxx is not valid-To check how the Storage Type is maintained for the DB Table of Cloud MDAV-Open TX CODE: MDRS-For the first drop down list select: Analytics > MDAV (Multidimensional Analytical View)-For the second field, type the Data Source ID of the Cloud Data Source-Press Enter and then Double click on the MDAV name -In the Overview tab, navigate to the bottom page till you find the field DB Table-Double click over the Table Name and the action will open the Table Structure-Click on Technical Settings or Press CTRL + SHIFT + F9-Check what is set for the Storage Type:-  In case the Storage Type is set to ROW STORE instead of COLUMM STORE, then the issue will happen.-Cause-The HANA Data Base does not allow Storage Table in Row type.-Unfortunately you can't decide or define the table type during the creation of the Cloud MDAV as it gets created automatically from the UI when you mentioned the fields and saves the MDAV. Hence, if you have created the Cloud Data Source in a Cloud system which is MaxDB, the tables will be created automatically as Row Store whereas if you have create the Cloud Data Source in a system with HANA DB, the tables will be created automatically as Column Store.-Resolution-Once you have identified the table with Row Store for one or more Data Source, you will need to request to the MS Database Incident Management colleagues, which belong to the Hosting Team, to convert the Storage Type of the particular Table Name from Row to Column.-Please, forward this request to SPC Queue: MS - Customer Support Requests and ask them to assign the SPC Incident to MS Database Incident Management, once we there is no direct routing from BCP to DB Incident Management queue.-As additional information for Hosting Team, you can advise the database administrator to make use of the following SQL statement in order to perform the Storage Type conversion: ALTER TABLE table_name [ALTER TYPE] COLUMN-After the change request has been accomplished by Hosting, you can repeat the Step 3 again in order to crosscheck the effect for the Storage Type.-See Also-You can even get the information about all HANA Tables currently defined as ROW store in the HANA Schema with a data base connection through of HANA Studio.-In this case, you should then perform the following:-Get an Application Layer User Access-Open the BCP incident-Click on More > Request User-Click on Change button-Select Database layer access-Fill out the SID and check the mandatory boxes-Take note of the User and Password-Open a connection with HANA DB Server-Open the STFK Connection-For Connections select: SAP HANA Database-For Server select: vadbhsn-Click on Request Opening button-Click on Log on-In the Proxy Configuration popup click on Execute-In the SAP GUI Security messages, just press Allow-Double Click on the Path shown in the OSS Service connection pop up screen-Copy and paste the User&Pass obtained in the Step 1 -Once the  SAP Hana Studio program get started, click on Workbench button-Execute the Query in the SQL in the HANA Administration Console view-In the right side, you will see the SID of the system, double click on that-Right click over the SID and select SQL Console-In the SQL white board, type the following SQL statement:  select * from tables where table_type = 'ROW' and schema_name = 'HANADB'-To execute the Query-A new Result tab will come up, jump to it-Check the TABLE_TYPE in order identify the existent tables defined as Row Type.-You can also run another exclusive query for your desired table by typing another SQL statement: select * from tables where table_name= 'TABLE NAME'-As pre-requisite you need to have Java 1.6 64bits and SAP HANA Client Studio. You can get both application in the following URL:-Java: http://www.java.com/-SAP Hana Studio: https://hanadeveditionsapicl.hana.ondemand.com/hanadevedition/- Keywords

Title: Error 'General ledger account alias AAAAA does not exist' Occurs When Calling Web Service ManageJournalEntryIn
Content: Symptom-You get the error message "General ledger account alias AAAAA does not exist" when you create Journal Entries using web service "ManageJournalEntryIn".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management--Service Explorer.-Find the webservice "ManageJournalEntryIn" and then download WSDL.-Save the WSDL in your local drive.-Load the wsdl in SOAP UI.-Input your code of uploading journal entry.-Input the user name and login password.-Run the request, then you get the error - General ledger account alias AAAAA does not exist.-Cause-There are two possible reasons:-You have entered the G/L Account instead of Account Determination Group. Basically, you have to enter the G/L Account Alias, not the G/L Account. -You have to choose the Account Determination Group,  but the Account Determination Group ID does not fall under below Subledgers:-General Ledger-Groups for Other Income-Groups for Other Current Assets-Groups for Other Liabilities-Costs-Groups for General Expenses-Resolution-Follow the below steps, to identify the GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode(Account Determination Group ID) under correct Subledger:-Go to Business Configuration work centre.-Click on Overview.-Search for the Fine Tune activity - Chart of Accounts: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Click on Edit Account Determination Group.-Select the GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode(Group ID) which fall under below Subledgers and execute the payload in SOAP UI:-General Ledger-Groups for Other Income-Groups for Other Current Assets-Groups for Other Liabilities-Costs-Groups for General Expenses-Keywords-General ledger account alias does not exist, Error in ManageJournalEntryIn web service, ManageJournalEntryIn webservice

Title: Error Message: Category change not possible; employee time still uses time type: XYZ, when Trying to Change Pre-delivered Time Types
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, may have a requirement to change the pre-delivered employee time type's category from Leave to Illness, such as changing the category of time type Maternity leave or Parental leave from Illness to Absent. System will throw the below error message when you try to save the change:-Category change not possible; employee time still uses time type: XYZ-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Activity List view.-Select the Fine Tuning arrow.-Select the activity Time Types.-Select Maintain Employee Time Types link.-Change the Time Type Category of Employee Time Type (Parental leave or Maternity leave) from Illness to Absent.-System throws above error message.-Cause-System is working as designed. It is not possible to change the pre-deliverd time type's category of employee time types when there is already an existing time recording for the Time Type in the past.-This is the expected system behavior.-It's only possible to perform this change when you never had a time recording to the time type.-Resolution-It is not possible to change the pre-delivered time type category Illness to Absent in the current release. This may be changed in the future release. In the mean time, below workaround can be used to temporarily overcome the issue.-Step 1: Create a new Time Type in Fine-Tuning-Go to fine-tuning activity Time Types.-Select the link Maintain Employee Time Types.-There you can copy the existing time types Maternity protection and Parental time.-You have to enter codes for the new time types (e.g. ZDE002 and ZDE003) and change their Time Type Category to Leave.-Select Save and Close button.-Step 2: Create a new Collision Rule in Fine-Tuning-Select the link Maintain Collision Rules. A screen with all time types and their assigned collision rules is displayed.-Your new time types can be found at the end. They will have collision rule Planned absence assigned as the original time types.-Select the button Maintain Collision Rules and the list of available collision rules will be displayed.-Add a new collision rule and enter a code (e.g. ZDE1) and a name.-Click the button Save and Close and open again the list of available collision rules. The save is necessary to provide the new collision rule in the value help.-Now you can mark your new collision rule and add details.-It is recommend to add the same details as configured for collision rule Planned Absence except the first entry. There you have to replace the Weaker Collision Rule Planned Absence with your new collision rule and change Send Message to Warning. After adding the details, click the button Save and Close. On the screen with all time types and their assigned collision rules go to the end and change the assigned collision rule for your new time types from Planned Absence to your new collision rule.-Step 3: Change the existing time recordings in the system-The time administrator or the employees have to change the existing time recordings with the original time types for Maternity protection and Parental time by replacing the original time types with the new time types.-Step4 : Deactivate the original Time Types in Fine-Tuning-Go to fine-tuning activity Time Types.-Select the link Activate for Time Recording Services.-There are four tabs with time types. There you can move the original time types for Maternity Protection and Parental time to the right (Deactivated Time Type) on every tab.-In case you did not change the time type’s names while copying, you may find double entries for the mentioned time types. In this case the new time types are displayed at the end of the list.-Keywords-impossiblke, can't cannot

Title: Unable to Download and Upload Excel Type of Reports from Transport Management

Title: Forms Master Template Hebrew Footer
Content: Symptom-You created a Master template footer, language Hebrew, and it is not showing the correct footer formatting in the Master template preview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the-Work Center Application and User Management.-View Master template maintenance and edit the Master template.-Above the footer chose Hebrew as language.-Maintain Hebrew text into the footer.-Preview the document on the right side now and you see the footer is not shown correctly.-Cause-All Forms which are used for the Master template preview are left to right languages while Hebrew is from right to left.-This would affect all right to left languages due to the fact that all Example forms for the preview are left to write "countries".-Resolution-We took this into our backlogs and will fix this with one of the upcoming releases.-Keywords-Hebrew, Master template, Footer.

Title: Performance Issue When Assigning Target Group to a Contact
Content: Symptom-The system dumps when you assign a target group to a contact.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select any contact.-Click View All .-Select Marketing Data.-Assign Target Group.-Fill out the group and account and click OK.-The system hangs.-Cause-There are too many records being fetched on the object list. This is because the target group you wish to assign has more than 20000 members. Whenever the size of the target group exceeds 20K members the system will time out.-Resolution-As a workaround please create target groups with up to 15000 members or split existing target groups into smaller ones.-We recommend creating 2 or more new target groups and filtering out the contacts that are already involved with the target group you wish to use to add them to the new groups.-When creating new target groups you can use already existing ones and filter out members you wish to remove.--You are able to select and remove Target Group Members by holding down shift and selecting up to 1000 lines. After selecting them click Remove > Selected.-You can filter the Target group Members maybe by alphabetical order, this way you can create a group starting from A-K and a Target Group for L-Z.-Go to the Marketing work center.-Select Target Groups.-Click New and Target Group.-Change the drop-down menu to Target Groups.-Add the existing target group ID you wish to split up.-Click Go.-Highlight the target group under 'Target groups Found'.-Click Add and Selected.-Selected Target Group Members is filled out.-Filter the Target group Members as desired, e.g. by alphabetical order, this way you can create a group starting from A-K and a Target Group for L-Z.-The performance issue with large target groups of more than 20K members is already added to our development backlog to be addressed in a future release.-Keywords-target group, hangs, freeze, members, contact, html5, performance, time out, unresponsive-time out,dump,add members,contact,target group,assign,members

Title: Unit Conversion in Key Figure Results in ERR
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom key figure and set up a unit conversion, however when you display the key figure in the report, it shows ERR.-Consider the following scenarios as an example:-A) You have made sure that in the product master data, there is a conversion from specific units of measure to each (e.g. Bag to Each etc). However when you open the report with your key figure, the conversion is not working and the unit of measure shows ERR.-B) You have maintained a Service with Base UoM wday - PD (Working Day). You have maintained a Quantity Conversion for this Service in order to convert one working day into hours (e.g. 1 wday = 8 hours). Your intention is to create a key figure that displays the values in hours instead of working days. In order to achieve this you need to create a new key figure based on a standard key figure (which shows working days) and select Conversion Type Unit Conversion and Target Unit Hour(s) in step 3 of the key figure wizard.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Key Figures.-Click on New.-In step 1, enter the name, the data source and the key figure type and click on Next.-In step 2, enter your formula or restriction and click on Next.-In step 3, select Unit Conversion in the conversion type. Select a target unit such as Each or Working Day.-Click on Finish.-Go to the work center view Design Reports and open a report which is based on the data source you have chosen in the key figure.-Click on Add Fields > tab Key Figures and add your key figure.-Arrange the report view as required, including your key figure.-You will see that there is no conversion to Each, but instead you see the value with the unit ERR.-Cause-In key figure unit conversions, only the following conversions are possible:-Product/material independent conversions, for example meter into kilometer, gram into kilos, etc. Conversions maintained on Product level are not considered in Reporting for example, each to package etc.-Conversions between different trading units (e.g. working day) to different physical units (e.g. hour) are not supported.-Resolution-Please use the Influence Forum if you would like to register this as a new feature request.-Keywords-key figure, unit conversion, unit of measure, ERR in reporting, currency, working day-trading units,error,key figure error,key figure values,key figure displays error,key figure shows error,err

Title: Invoice Block Does Not Prevent Customer Invoice Creation in Over-the-Counter Sale
Content: Symptom-When a Delivery Block or Invoice Block is set on the Account, it does not block the Customer Invoice creation of an Over-the-Counter Sale.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and open account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Click on the View All button and navigate to the Sales Data tab.-In the Document Blocks section, select a Delivery Block or Invoice Block from the dropdown list.-Click on Save.-Now create a new Over-the-Counter Sales for this account:-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Select New Over-the-Counter Sale from the Common Tasks section.-Click on View All.-In the Name field for the account enter ABC.-Fill all mandatory fields and click on Invoice button.-The system creates and saves the Customer invoice.-The Over-the-Counter Sales document was expected to be blocked, as a Delivery Block or Invoice Block was maintained in the account.-Cause-Over-the-Counter Sales function is different than the standard Sales Order process.-As explained in the help document “Quick Guide for Over-the-Counter Sales”, in an Over-the-Counter Sale the customer personally purchases goods directly in a shop and/or at the counter, and there are three possible payment scenarios. But none of them is considering a Delivery Block or Invoice Block because it is not relevant with this function as having a block would mean that the sale is denied.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Kindly consult the following KBA on how to proceed: 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available -See Also-Help document: Quick Guide for Over-the-Counter Sales | SAP Help Portal-SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/3766-Keywords-Over-the-Counter Sales; Invoice Block; Delivery Block; Customer Invoice; Account.

Title: Service Performer not Found in Sales Order's XML
Content: Symptom-You have opened/downloaded the XML structure from the Sales Order and noticed that the Service Performer is not present.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Click View Data XML button.-Download the XML.-Search for the user ID XYZ and nothing returns (XYZ represents the ID of the Service Performer).-Cause-The Service Performer is not supported for the Sales Order's XML structure.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-You can consult the following KBA on how to proceed: 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available -Keywords-Service Performer, Sales Order, XML,  Output History, View Data XML

Title: Error in OData Query for Standard Report: Property C0CHAR_STRUCTURE
Content: Symptom-A standard report does not show data through OData query instead shows the below message:-"Property C0CHAR_STRUCTURE (Entity Type ABC): mandatory filter is missing" (where ABC standard for the technical ID of the report.)-"Char Structure (C0CHAR_STRUCTURE) needs to be either filtered or requested"-However, when you execute the web browser report you can see the data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Create the Odata URL according to prerequisites for any standard report which is assigned to any work center.-Example: For standard report "Employee Times: Monthly(HCMTLMU01_Q0002)"-https://myxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/HCM_TIMEADMINISTRATION_analytics.svc/RPHCMTLMU01_Q0002QueryResults-It shows the above message in the response: "Property C0CHAR_STRUCTURE (Entity Type RPHCMTLMU01_Q0002): mandatory filter is missing".-Cause-Certain reports have a technical structure that cannot be queried through OData.-Resolution-You can execute such reports only through the web browser.-You can also try to create a copy of standard report (or create a new report) with no key figure selected from key figure group. With these custom reports, you should be able to get data via OData.-See Also-KBA 2336518 - Report Does Not Open in ODATA-Keywords-Property C0CHAR_STRUCTURE, employee times, odata, report, mandatory filter is missing, key figure group-property c0char_structure,mandatory filter is missing

Title: Error - Tax Item of Doc. ABC of Type Receivables Payables Entry, Event Domestic Purchase Of Services and Rate Special 1 not assigned to box [China]
Content: Symptom-You execute a VAT return run for China. It fails with the error message 'Tax item of Doc. ABC of Type Receivables Payables Entry, Event Domestic Purchase Of Services and Rate Special 1 not assigned to box'.-ABC means the Other Charge/Credit ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work centre.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Select Run ID AAA (AAA means the VAT Return Run ID).-Open the respective application log.-See the error message in Results tab:Tax item of Doc. ABC of Type Receivables Payables Entry, Event Domestic Purchase Of Services and Rate Special 1 not assigned to box.-Cause-Even though no Tax Code was derived for "Other Charge/Credit", the system was able to derive the Tax Event Domestic Purchase Of Services and Tax rate Special 1 from the fine tune activity - Tax Returns for Goods and Services - China. However, for this tax event no Tax Rate Type - 16 - Special 1 is maintained in the Fine Tune activity.-Resolution-You have to maintain the Tax Rate Type - "16 - Special 1" for Tax Event - Domestic Purchase Of Services:-Go to Business Configuration work centre.-Click on Overview.-Search for the Activity - Tax Returns for Goods and Services - China.-Click on Check and adapt the Tax Returns for Goods and Services.-Here, you have to select the VAT Return Type.-Go to Tax Event Tab.-Search for the Tax Event - Domestic Purchase Of Services.-In the Summary Layout click on Add Row.-you have to maintain the Tax Rate Type = 16 - Special 1.-See Also-2960233-2562619-Keywords-Error in VAT Return Run China, Tax Item of Doc. ABC of Type, Tax Item of Doc. ABC of Type Receivables Payables Entry

Title: Custom Fonts are not shown in the Preview - Browser Limitation
Content: Symptom-You want to use customer specific fonts in a form template but the fonts are not shown in the preview.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work center Customer Invoice, for example.-View Invoice documents and search for any invoice and hit the preview button.-Here you cannot see your custom fonts.-Cause-The preview  function is not using the embedded fonts. If you save the preview and you open the PDF with an Acrobat reader you will see the Fonts are part of the PDF. Also, printing via the Acrobat Reader and the Cloud Print Manager will consider your Fonts. This is a browser limitation and not related to all fonts depending on the browser you are using.-Resolution-If you print those documents, they will use the fonts as expected. Save to file would have the fonts in the PDF too. In case the output channel is e-mail, it might be an issue if the setup (Microsoft) will not automatically open the attachment in the Acrobat Reader and instead using a browser.-The recommendation here is to change the Microsoft Logic so that PDFs are always opened with the Acrobat Reader. For assistance to do so please contact your Local IT or IR representative.-Keywords- Custom Fonts, Preview Fonts, Fonts.

It might be fixed in one of the future releases.-Keywords-Remove email, Remove, RFQ, e-mail

Title: Output Error Message "G Suite SMTP Relay Service Doesn't Match Domain" When Sending Document by E-mail
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Purchase Order (PO - as example) and sending the document to the e-mail "example@ext.com" you receive the following error message:--"***-*.*.* Invalid credentials for relay [**.***.***.**]. The IP address you've ***-*.*.* registered in your G Suite SMTP Relay service doesn't match domain of ***-*.*.* the account this email is being sent from. If you are trying to relay ***-*.*.* mail from a domain that isn't registered under your G Suite account ***-*.*.* or has empty envelope-from, you must configure your mail server ***-*.*.* either to use SMTP AUTH to identify the sending domain or to present ***-*.*.* one of your domain names in the HELO or EHLO command. For more ***-*.*.* information, please visit *** *.*.* https://support.google.com/a/answer/6140680#invalidcred g8sm173680wrh.35 - gsmtp"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new PO.-Sent the document to "example@ext.com" e-mail.-Error message appears.-Cause-The IP address you registered in the G Suite SMTP relay service setting doesn’t match domain of the account this e-mail is being sent from. If you are trying to relay mail from a domain that isn’t registered in your Google Apps account, you must configure your mail server either to use SMTP AUTH to identify the sending domain or to present one of your domain names in the HELO or EHLO command. See SMTP Relay service setting for more information.-Resolution-This is not an issue with SAP system, this needs to be sorted out with Google support (Gmail server configuration).-Keywords-Google, Output, G Suite, SMTP, Relay, Domain

Title: Blank Page is Randomly Added to an Output or Preview of a Document
Content: Symptom-You are previewing or printing a document and you see a blank page added.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Customer invoice (for example).-Select the view Invoice documents.-Search and find Document XYZ (XYZ represents the Invoice ID) and either preview or release it for output ie. printing.-You will see a blank page in your custom template.-Cause-The custom form which is used is not well formed.-Resolution-Within Adobe LiveCycle Designer ensure you enabled "Allow Page Breaks within content" in the table. This might be located in a subview but will depend on the template you are using.-The screenshot below is just an example.-We recommend to contact your Implementation Partner to assist you.-Keywords-Empty pages, Blank Pages, template,

Title: Character 'ONLY' Wrongly Shown in the Column Total When Previewing the Results of Journal Entry Voucher - China
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you are previewing the results of Journal Entry Voucher - China, character 'ONLY' is wrongly shown in the column Total for some amounts. 'ONLY' here means '整' in Chinese.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Statutory Reports.-Click Journal Entry Voucher - China.-Select the run ABC.-Click Edit.-Go to step two.-Click Preview, you will see the below examples shown in the column Total:-1.Total: ONE HUNDRED ZERO ONLY. (The amount is 100.00CNY, correct.)-2.Total: ONE HUNDRED FIFTY ONLY. (The amount is 100.50CNY, incorrect.)-3.Total: ONE HUNDRED ONE ONLY. (The amount is 100.01CNY, incorrect.)-Cause-According to Chinese Accounting Principle, if there is amount after the decimal, there can't be the character 'ONLY'(整) in the column Total.-Resolution-If the case is urgent, you can forward the incident to SRD-FIN-GLO-REP for backend correction.-The changes to other customer systems will be shipped via 2105 release.-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher - China; Total; ONLY; 日记账凭证中国; 整.

Title: System Generates BTM Task 'Review Time Data (Transfer)' after Transferring an Employee
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, may receive BTM task Review Time Data(Transfer) after an employee is transferred to another org unit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center after transferring an employee.-Select the Work view.-Where you may find the open task Review Time Data (Transfer).-Cause-The purpose of this BTM task is to make the time administrator (who may be a different person than the personnel administrator) aware that a transfer has happened and the employee's time file may have to be checked whether the current work schedule, time account rules, etc. are still valid after the transfer.-Resolution-BTM Task: Review Time Data (Transfer)-If the check of the employee's time file is not necessary, or when it has been done and (possibly) the time file has been updated, the time administrator can set the BTM task to the status 'Completed'.-You can follow the below steps to set the BTM task status:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Work view.-Select the task and the Actions button.-Select the Completed option from the drop down list.-BTM Task: Overdue Review Time Data (Transfer)-If the above steps were not done and there is a Due Date associated with BTM task Review Time Data (Transfer), then you will receive a second BTM task as an overdue notification. This task is sent to the Home work center, the Work, Inbox view. You can easily identify such overdue tasks by the red exclamation mark (!) in the first column of the list. This due date is defined in the Business Configuration work center.-Follow the above described steps to set the BTM task status to Completed and if you want to avoid notification tasks for overdue BTM tasks Review Time Data (Transfer) (or other BTM task types as well), you can switch them off using the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the project and the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune arrow.-Select the Business Task Management for Hire, Employment Changes and Termination activity. A new window opens.-Select the task Review Time Data (Transfer) in the left side of the window.-In the right side of the window, select either None or Change Priority to switch off the overdue notifications.-See Also-This KBA is relevant for other HCM related tasks such as Payroll, Compensation and so on-Keywords-Task, hire, rehire, payroll, time data, trnasfer

Title: wrong status of incident in customer system and on our side - incident is stuck
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Wrong status of incident in customer system and on our side - incident is stuck.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Incident shows two not matching status on customer side and on our side-e.g.-Customer side: In Process – Provider Action-Our side (BCP):  Solution Provided-Both sides will not act as they believe the incident is on the other side-Cause-Most likely there was a mismatch in Messaging and status. e.g. you sent a reply and did not set the incident to Customer Action or Solution Proposal. Its an synch issue The messages might be puzzled - meaning out of chronicle order. Therefore please repeat the last message.-2.  To speed up the synch after adding a note you can do the following in the backend:-     Transaction: se38-     Program : APCRM_SSR_LP_INCIDENTS_SYNC-     Run(F8)-Keywords-incident stuck, wrong status, provider action, BCP, CSS NG, CSS-Status / Priority:-Solution Provided
