Title: Error while Releasing Check Deposit
Content: Symptom-You have assigned checks to the Check Deposit and you try to release the Check Deposit, at that time you see the error - Deposit ID ABC : Posting date DD.MM.YYYY not permitted. The Item to be cleared already has Postings assigned to it with Posting Date dd.mm.yyyy and Document(Clearing) id DEF. Enter a Posting Date equal to or after dd.mm.yyyy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work centre.-Click on Check Deposit view.-Select the Check Deposit - ABC. -Click on Action and then Release and Set to In Transfer OR Release and Print Deposit Slip.-You can see error-Cause-Initially, the Checks were assigned to the Check Deposit - DEF Which has posting date dd.mm.yyyy. Later, the Check Deposit - DEF Reversed with Posting date in future. Now, you are assigning the Checks to the New Check Deposit - ABC.-The error occurs because checks assign to the Check Deposit ID - ABC has a posting date which is before the posting date of the Reversed Check Deposit - DEF. For example:-Check Deposit - DEF-Posting date - 05.11.2020-JE created with Posting date - 05.11.2020.-Reverse the Check Deposit - DEF-Posting Date - 03.12.2020(In future – dd.mm.yyyy)-Reversed JE created with Posting date - 03.12.2020.-Now, you are assigning the same checks to the New Check Deposit – ABC.-Check Deposit – ABC-Posting Date – 17.11.2020(DD.MM.YYYY)-Click on Release ---->Release and Set to In Transfer OR Release and Print Deposit Slip.-Here, you see the error message because the Reversed JE was posted on 03.12.2020. Hence, you have to change the posting date of Check Deposit to 03.12.2020 or after.-Resolution-This is a standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Check Deposit Error, Posting date not permitted, Enter a posting date equal to or after, Incoming Check error.

Title: Error: Payment methods of check lot XXXXXX support different output channels
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add Check Lot in the My Bank with multiple Check Lot Payment Method - 1) Check File & 2) Check printing, but system throws-error - Payment methods of check lot XXXXXX(XXXXXX refers to Check Lot ID) support different output channels.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management Workcentre.-Click on the My Banks view.-Search for the My Bank ID.-Click on Edit.-Go to the Bank Accounts tab.-Select the Bank Account number.-Go to the Check Lot tab.-Click on Add Row.-Enter the Check Lot ID - XXXXXX(XXXXXX refers to Check Lot ID), First Check and Last Check.-In the Allowed Check Lot Payment Method add, 1) Check File & 2) Check printing.-System throws error - Payment methods of check lot XXXXXX  (XXXXXX refers to Check Lot ID) support different output channels.-Cause-Ideally, the Check Lot can be used for either Check File or Check Printing as a Payment Method. Two Allowed Payment methods - 1) Check File & 2) Check Printing are essentially generating an output.-Resolution-Only one Allowed Check Lot Payment Method should be maintained in the system - either Check File OR Check Printing.-This is a standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Payment methods of check lot XXXXXX support different output channels, Allowed Check Lot Payment Method, Check File Check Printing.

Title: Broadcasted Report File is Missing Entries
Content: Symptom-You have created a broadcast which is sending a report as xlsx, xml or csv. When you open the broadcasted file in Excel, you notice that in some cells, the data entry is missing.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the file that you received via e-mail.-Filter for some specific entries.-You notice that some cells are empty.-If you open the report on the UI and do the same filtering there, the cell has data.-Cause-Broadcasted reports currently do not support repeated text. So for example, if you have the account ABC (ABC stands for the account number) and several sales orders for this account, on the report UI, you will see the account listed once and the sales orders listed next to it:-Account Sales Order-ABC 123-  456-If you filter for the sales order 456 in the report UI, the system will recognize that now there is only 1 line with the account information, and it will show the account.-The Excel file however is static, once the entry is missing there, it will not show again. So if you filter for the sales order 456, the Account field remains empty.-Resolution-You can enable the Display Repeated Text setting and the account ABC will be shown for each of the sales order entries. Once you open this file from the broadcast, there will be data in every cell.-To enable this setting:-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Open the report you are broadcasting.-Run it with the view and selection from the broadcast.-In C4C: Click the Show Table Settings icon.-In BYD: Go to the View section and click the Chart/Table Settings icon.-Set the Display Repeated Text option to Yes/ On.-Save this view.-Go to the work center view Broadcasts.-Edit the broadcast that you are sending.-Select the new report view you have just created.-Save the broadcast.-Keywords-broadcast, missing data, repeated text, xlsx, xlx, report, business analytics, email, csv, Excel

Title: Process Communication Error: 'Number range interval overflow for document type Reversal of Clearing'
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Cancellation Customer Invoice and you notice that there is a Process Communication Error preventing the cancellation invoice from being posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the view Process Communication Errors.-Open the view - Open Errors with Incidents.-Search and Find Sending Document ID: ABC (ABC represents the Invoice document ID)  -Here we can see the Main Error: Number range interval overflow for document type Reversal of Clearing-Cause-Number Range for Journal Entry Type "Reversal of Clearing" is not maintained in Business Configuration.-> The reason why its "Reversal of Clearing" and not just a "Customer invoice reversal" is because a clearing has happened against the original Invoice and if you're reversing ths document you need to reverse the clearing lines as well.-Resolution-You need to maintain a number range in Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges activity in Business Configuration.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Activity: Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges-Select the option: Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges-Select Number Range Profile DEF (DEF represents the Number Range Profile that is relevant)-(The relevant Profile is selected because this is the number range profile that is selected against the set of books - to confirm this you can follow KBA: 2565042 - Error Message Against Unposted Source Documents Number range interval overflow)-Under Details we can see that nothing has been maintained for Journal Entry Type: 90027 - Reversal of Clearing-Add Row, select 90027 - Reversal of Clearing from the Journal Entry Type and then select a Number Range.-See Also-2565042-Keywords-Number Range interval, Reversal of Clearing, Number Ranges

Title: You Get Warning Message: "The action is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again" When Releasing a Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You get warning message when releasing a down payment invoice request.-Warning message: The action is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Click New Down Payment Request from Common Tasks view.-Maintain the required information and click Release button.-System shows the following message:-- The action is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-- Down Payment Request ABC saved successfully. (ABC represents the ID of the down payment request)-- Document has been submitted for approval to your manager.-Cause-The warning message is triggered when approval for Manual Invoice Request is scoped.-The action Released is not possible because the approval process is not finished when click Release button directly on the Down Payment Request.-Resolution-It is te designed system behavior.-Keywords-Down Payment Request; The action is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. ; Warning

Title: Technical error while submitting UK VAT Return (please reset the access grant for account)
Content: Symptom-You try to submit your UK VAT return to the HMRC.-The Submission gets returned with the error "Technical Response: : error : invalid_grant,error_description : replace_access_token HTTP code: 400|Refresh access failed, please reset the access grant for account".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Tax Management work center go to the VAT Returns view. -Find and select VAT return XXX, in Status Reported (The VAT return has been released and returned and is ready to be submitted to the HMRC) (XXX represents the VAT return ID). -Press View to open the return. -In the new screen press Submit. -The Submission is not successful: In the Submission Information section the following information appears: -Submission Status: Returned-Approval Status: Rejected-Error Description: |Technical Response: : error : invalid_grant,error_description : replace_access_token HTTP code: 400|Refresh access failed, please reset the access grant for account.-Cause-If there are any account changes like Add/Remove of the Authorized Account performed by user, then the grant access gets expired automatically from the external website. In this case, user has to generate the new code from the external site.-Resolution-To generate the new Code to grant the access follow the below steps:-Login to the system with an authorized Business User. -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Fine Tune activity UK Making Tax Digital.-Here, the user can see Authorized Account.-Press Allow Access. -You will be re-directed to the external website to grant the new code. -Once the new code is generated from the external website you can submit the VAT Return. -Keywords-please reset the access grant for account, UK MTD Error, UK Making Tax Digital, Refresh access failed

Title: Multilevel Approval For Payments
Content: Symptom-You have created a payment using Outgoing Check or Outgoing Bank Transfer and you are expecting to approve the payment by two approvers/persons.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Click New Outgoing Check or New Outgoing Bank Transfer link from the Common Tasks pane.-Select appropriate data and click the Release button.-The Payment is with In Approval status.-Here, you expect the approval goes to two person.-Cause-In SAP ByDesign the single level approval process is supported. This is a system definition.-Resolution-The functionality of multilevel approval for Outgoing Check and Outgoing Bank Transfer is not supported in the system.-This is the current standard system behavior.-See Also-2063785 - How to Set Up Approval Process for Payments-Keywords-multilevel; multi-level; multistep; multi-step; approval

Title: Error: It is not allowed to change value from XXX to YYY
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit the fine tune activity - Account Determination Group for Tax Event and see the following error - It is not allowed to change value from XXX to YYY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work centre.-Click on overview.-Search and open activity Account Determination for Tax Events.-Filter the fields - Country/Region and Tax Event.-Change the account determination group from XXX to YYY.-Click Save.-Error: It is not allowed to change value from XXX to YYY.-Note: The Account Determination Group XXX and YYY are created in SAP Cloud Application Studio. -Cause-The content is provided via SAP Cloud Application Studio and it is not possible to change it via UI as the custom BC sets fields get marked "read only in next layer". Also, it is not possible to change the BC sets from backend.-Resolution-In such cases the BC sets changes are possible only via the SAP Cloud Application Studio. You have to reach out the person who has delivered the PDI solution.-Keywords-It is not allowed to change value from to, Account Determination for Tax Events.

Title: Wrong Format in Excel Report Field After XLSX Download
Content: Symptom-You have downloaded a report to Excel (xlsx) however the fields come in a wrong format. They are text fields in Excel, even though in the report, it is for example a Calendar Month.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Select the Design Reports view.-Run your report.-Download it as a xlsx file.-Mark a field and see that it has a General or Text formatting.-Cause-The field has a type for which no formatting can be downloaded.-Resolution-Since 1911, the formatting will be kept correctly for certain field types: Date, Amount and Quantity fields.-Please note about date fields that only pure dates will retain their formatting. Fields like Calendar Month, Calendar Week etc are not formatted in a xlsx download.-See Also-If you download a report in the XML format date fields will show the format as General. This is the expected system behaviour at the moment. If you want to change this behaviour this would be a new requirement. Please post this request on our SAP Cloud for Customer Continuous Influence forum or SAP Business by Design Continuous Influence forum.-Further details are also available in the Knowledge Base Article 2584678 - Excel Sum Function Does Not Work on Reports Downloaded in xlsx Format.-Keywords-excel, report, analytics, download, xlsx, format, formatting, text, custom, 1911

Title: Table column Width Adjustment is not Saved
Content: Symptom-You want to adjust the column width of a particular characteristic but when you save the view personalization, the changes are not maintained.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Analysis work center.-Go to the Reports sub-view.-Open a report -e.g. the Opportunity Analysis report.-Make sure your desired field is visible in the Rows.-e.g. Sales Unit-In the report table, adjust the Sales Unit column width as you wish.-Click on More Action and save the view in order to save the new layout.-When you open the report again, the column width changed are back to the original width.-Cause-Table column adjustment is not supported if the field is a hierarchical field.-Table column adjustment is not supported if the table has a hierarchy in the table settings.-Table column adjustment is not supported when characteristics are added in the columns.-Resolution-Table column adjustment is not supported if the field is a hierarchical field:-Go to Analysis view-Go to Reports sub-view-Open a report-e.g. Opportunity Analysis report-Make sure your field desired is visible in the Rows-e.g. Sales Unit-Click on Organize Data; which is right after the Filters icon-In the right pane that shows up, click over the Actions icon (...) and then Settings-In the Characteristic window that pops up, check if the Display Hierarchy is disabled for this particular field (it should not be set to: Description, ID and Description or Description and ID).- Table column adjustment is not supported when characteristics are added in the columns:-Go to Analysis view-Go to Reports sub-view-Open a report-e.g. Opportunity Analysis report-Make sure your field desired is visible in the Rows Fields and not in the Column Fields area.-See Also-Column width adjustment is supported only when the header has only one row.-Please also see the help documentation: The Business Analytics Guide, chapter 'Functions in the Content Area' and the additional KBA 2690961 - Table Column Width Adjustment is not Saved in a Report .-Keywords-Column, width, column width, rows, adjust, change, table column

Title: Error Message : Accounting period closed; contact accounting department
Content: Symptom-When the service agent is trying to release the time sheet against an intercompany project the system throws an error message as Accounting Period Closed; Contact Accounting Department.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Choose the Self-Services view.-Choose the Self-Services Overview.-Choose Edit Time Sheet link.-Here try to record the time against the project.-Choose Save button.-Choose Release --> All button now system throws an error message as Accounting Period Closed; Contact Accounting Department.-OR-Go to Project Team work center.-Choose the Edit Time Sheet view under Common tasks.-Here try to record the time against the project.-Choose Save button.-Choose Release --> All button now system throws an error message as Accounting Period Closed; Contact Accounting Department.-Cause-The Entry Possible Until validity is expired for the company the service agent belong to, hence the system will not allow to do any posting in accounting for that period, it throws an error message as Accounting Period Closed; Contact Accounting Department. please contact your Admin to do required changes.-Resolution-Go to General Ledger Work center.-Go to View 'Company'.-Select the company, set of book combination and perform the action 'Set Process Control'.-On the new window Add a new record for the particular period and enter a new Entry Possible Unit date which is a valid date when you want to allow the service agent to do time recording against project.-Once the new record is created, ask the service agent to do time recording against project for that period.->>Please note, it is important to have a GSA (Goods and Service Confirmation) entry maintained in Set Process Control along with Time or Service Confirmation, to allow these postings to be successfully released for Service Agents.-Keywords-Accounting period closed on contact accounting department, Service Agent, Time Sheet, Project

Title: Cost Center is not visible for a Leave Recording in the Recorded Employee Times report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Recorded Employee Times report (Report ID: HCMTLMB07_Q0001) for a leave recording instance (Period: Date From/To) for one or more employees does not show a cost center.-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Reports view-Find the report Recorded Employee Times-Open the report-Select the link to start the report-In the Selection tab, provide the Employee ID and Key Date and apply-Observe that Cost Center is not showing up for a particular leave recording instance of this employee-Cause-Most likely, there’s a split in the org center assignment for the cost center.-Date Range 1: From/To-Date Range 2: From/To-Due to this split, there are two records for the same cost center in the FSI View.-Hence the leave recording start and end dates (From /To) are falling in two different splits of cost center.-Resolution-With this kind of data setup, an issue with the date handling (Temporal Join) in the underlying MDAV has been noticed.-Changing the MDAV design would mean severe impact on the performance of the report, hence currently it is not possible to address this design change, also the issue is not reproducible in internal systems.-Development has kept a note of this issue and added it to the product improvement backlog. They will explore the technical feasibility for the same in future releases.-As a workaround it is suggested to use a report based on the data source Employee Times (HCMTLMU01). Customer can be informed about the same.-This report should show the correct cost center assignments for all leave recordings.-Keywords-Recorded Employee Times, Employee, Time recordings, Time Administration, Cost Center, HCMTLMB07_Q0001 , HCMTLMU01, Leave Record. Leave Records, Not available, shown,

Title: Not Possible to Export all Configurational Changes in one File or Different Formats

Title: No Employee Is Shown in Team Calendar in Managing My Area
Content: Symptom-You cannot see any employee or the absences of the employees in Managing My Area, although you have full access to the Managing My Area work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Select the My Department view and choose My Team; the list is empty.-Select Launch Team Calendar under Common Tasks; there is no employee shown here either.--Cause-The My Team view in Managing My Area is specific to managers, so that they can see the list of employees assigned to their own org units or cost centers.-If you are not assigned to any org unit as a manager, you cannot see any employees in the My Team view or Team Calendar.-Resolution-Check in the Organizational Management work center whether you have been assigned to an org unit as the manager and also confirm that the org unit has at least one employee assigned.-Keywords-No Employees, Team Calendar, Managing My Area

Title: Error Message: Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters
Content: Symptom-When you try to maintain  Org Unit Name with more than 40 characters, system throws error message: Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational management work center.-Select Org Structures view.-Click Edit-Select Chevron General -Maintain the Org Unit Name.-Select Save.-System display above error message.-Resolution-Currently it is not possible to have Org Units Names with more than 40 characters.-We suggest you to make a meaningful abbreviation or consider to use a more generic Org Units Name, with less than 40 characters.-Workaround:-Org Unit Name mentioned in the General tab, is an internal org unit name. Hence, here there shouldn't be a problem to use abbreviations.-For external communication, in the Addresses tab, there are 2 fields "Company Name" and "Department Name" and both have a limit of 40 characters.-And during consumption, these 2 fields are concatenated, which gives an 80 character field.-Note: The character length mentioned in the migration template is incorrect, and will require correction from our side. The limit should be 40 characters only.

Title: Fingerprint or Face Scanning Not Available on SAP Manager Approval app for iOS
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The fingerprint and face scanning features are not available on SAP Manager Approval for iOS.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-While the Android version of the standalone SAP Manager Approvals app supports biometric login, the iOS version does not and there are currently no plans to invest here.-Resolution-Since the ByD2005 release, the manager approvals functionality is also available within the central SAP Business ByDesign Mobile app (you can refer to the blog https://blogs.sap.com/2020/04/30/mobile-manager-approval-and-user-management-for-sap-business-bydesign-cloud-erp/ as well as ByD2005 What's New) and this app supports biometric login for both the Android and the iOS version.

Title: How to avoid Time Out dumps when posting a Supplier Invoice?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to post a Supplier invoice containing several hundred items. When you select Post, the system processes the request for several minutes before sending back a back-end error. The invoice cannot be posted because of this issue.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents.-Find XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice ID).-Select Edit.-Select Post.-The system processes the document for several minutes, then sends back a back-end error.-In the backend transaction ST22, you can see the last class called was :-/SRMAP/CL_LSIV_SP_APPL_SIR====CP    /SRMAP/CL_LSIV_SP_APPL_SIR====CM01H     -/SRMAP/CL_LSIV_SP_APPL_SIR=>PREP_PACK_FOR_REF_ROLECODE_CHG.-Cause-The large number of items in the invoice causes a Time Out dump which prevents the system from processing the entire document. This is normal system behaviour to avoid performance issues.-Resolution-To allow the system to process large invoices, you can switch to Service Adaptation Definition Language (SADL) object worklist (OWL) where you will be able to post the Invoices in the background.-In order for the OWL to be SADL-enabled, you must scope it in the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and select Edit Project Scope.-Select Next until you reach the Questions screen.-Find and expand Built in Services and Support -> System Management -> User Interface List mode.-Find and scope the question "Do you want to use the new enhanced and faster object work list based on Service Adaptation Definition Language (SADL)?" by ticking the box.-Click Next.-Click Finish.-Once this is scoped, you can go back to Invoices and Credit Memos view, select the Invoice ID and click Actions - Quick Post.-For customers who joined the system after 1302, the scoping question is activated by default, hence they already have the 'Quick Post' option available.-Keywords

Title: Analytical Objects from Disabled PDI Solution Shown in UI
Content: Symptom-You have created some analytical objects (e.g. report or data source) via the Studio, however afterwards, you have disabled the solution. However when you log on to the system as key user, you still see the objects from the disabled solution listed in the report or data source list.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer- Reproducing the Issue-Deploy a solution to your system that contains some reports or data sources.-Create a patch for this solution. The object will now be available twice.-Disable the original solution.-Log on to the system with a key user. You will see the report twice - once from the original solution, and once from the patch.-Cause-When a user logs on to the system as a PDI user, they will not see any objects that are from a disabled solution. However when you log on as a key user, the objects from the disabled solution are currently still shown.-This will only affect the test or development system, since in productive system you will always scope one solution (no patches are deployed in production).-Resolution-We are working on adjusting this behaviour, however due to its complexity it will require extensive testing and cannot be done as a short-term solution. We have taken this up in our product planning and will deliver an adjustment with a future release.-Keywords

Title: Unable to Perform Scoping of Time Accounts due to Inconsistencies
Content: Symptom-After time accounts were added to the project scope, the system doesn’t allow to finish the change project and throws the below error message:-It is not possible to finalize these scope changes at this time; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. The desired scope change is possible in a change project after go-live-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Cause-The issue is due to the fact that fine-tuning activities related to time types in the optional activity Time Types - <Country> were  performed. A set of SAP pre-delivered entries were deleted and customer specific ones in the customer name range (starting with 'Z') were created.-Due to the addition of time accounts into the scope of the implementation project, new content from SAP will be deployed that is related to time types as well. This, however, will lead to inconsistencies, when those time types were deleted in fine-tuning.-Resolution-To solve this conflict, you should reload the SAP pre-delivered time types and perform the scope change afterwards. This can be achieved as stated below:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view-Select Open Activity List button-Select Fine-Tune chevron-Select the activity Time Types - <Country>-Open the activity on the fact sheet and use the button Restore Defaults (where available) to reload the SAP pre-delivered entries-Note: This will keep the customer-specific entries without any changes.-Now you are able to complete the change project without any issues.-Keywords-not able, fine-tune

Title: Error - Business System not existing
Content: Symptom-You want to create journal entries using webservice ManageJournalEntryIn and you are getting error message-- Business System XYZ not existing (XYZ represents the System Instance ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Step A)-Prerequisite: You have downloaded and installed the free SOAP UI tool.-Step B)-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Service Explorer View.-Show All Synchronous Inbound Operations, find 'ManageJournalEntryIn' and press Go.-Highlight 'ManageJournalEntryIn' and press Download WSDL.-Save the WSDL file.-Step C)-Open the SOAP UI Tool.-Press File - New SOAP Project.-Enter a Project name ABC (where ABC is the SOAP Project name).-Load the WSDL you downloaded in step B4.-Hit the green Play Button.-You can see an error message in the right window of the SOAP UI: Business System XYZ not existing.-Cause-The error message appears because of incorrect element --"OriginalEntryDocumentReferenceBusinessSystemID". This element has to be filled with the value of System Instance ID.-Resolution-To identify the correct System Instance ID, follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center and here to the Communication Systems view.-Search for the correct Communication System and press Edit.-Go to the System instances tab.-Here, you can find the System instance ID.-Keywords-Error in ManageJournalEntryIn, Business System not existing.

In the meantime, you can still use this data source for creating new custom reports.-See Also-This data source can also not be used for data source extension for the moment.-Keywords-data source, missing, not listed, not shown, business analytics, sales order item, CRMSLOIB01, standard data source

Title: App Password not available in Manager Approval App for IOS
Content: Symptom-The option to set the App Password is not available in the Manager Approval App for IOS-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Manager Approval App.-Enter the Byd URL in the settings.-Enter the user credentials and click Log On.-The Pop up appears to Set the App Password in the Android device, not in IOS.-Cause-The IOS Manager Approval App still uses the old native container due to technical reasons which does not have such options like Android which uses the new container-Resolution-This is an expected behavior-Keywords-app password, manager approval app, IOS App

Title: Migration: Bank Account Number Not Valid According to Check Digit Calculation Code
Content: Symptom-While migrating customers in to the system, you get the following error messages:-" Error detected in source record.-Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Customers activity and select it.-Click open the same or click Change Immediately.-Click Migrate customers using the migration tool.-Select the File with Migration Status In Process.-Click Execute Migration and select Execute Migration Step by Step.-You get the following error messages:-" Error detected in source record.-Bank account number not valid according to check digit calculation code."-Cause-There is an issue with determination of the correct bank when both the national bank code and the BIC/SWIFT is given.-If there are multiple national bank codes for a specific BIC/SWIFT code, the determination of the national bank code is wrong.-Therefore the check against the check number fails.-Resolution-As a work around, leave the field SWIFT/BIC empty in the migration file and then execute the migration.-Keywords-migration of customer; error detected in source code; bank account number not valid; Kontonummer ungültig; Migration von Kunden

Title: Business Partners of Terminated Employees are Still Active in Business Partner Data Work Center
Content: Symptom-You as an HR Administrator, observed that after terminated an employee from Personnel Administration work center, his/her Business Partner remains in Active status. You would like to know, whether this causes any problem in your business processes?-Note: Similar behaviour is observed for Employees under Administrator work center in Cloud for Customer.-Cause-It is the design of internal Employees that they have no status handling as other Business Partner Projections (as Customer, Supplier, etc.). If the internal Employee is Active or not is realized via the validity period of the work agreement. So the mentioned Employees (both are the same employee; at least the name is the same??) are already terminated and therefore can not be used or will be displayed in the most F4-helps.--The required functionality (set internal Employee to a status other than 'Active') is not supported in the standard Business ByDesign solution.-Resolution-The System works as designed.--Even though you have terminated the employee in Personnel Administration work center, the respective Business Partner remains Active because as per definition, a business partner can be used for other roles like Account, suppliers, etc. Blocking a Business Partner while terminating an employee will result in inconsistency, if the Business partner is used in any other Business transaction document (Ex: sales order, purchase order).-Although the Employee is terminated we allow not a status other than active for internal Employees. The reason for this design is consumer of internal Employees (Rehire Employee, Employee OWL, Change workplace address, Change Private Address, etc. ) counting on this system behavior. Hence, it is not possible to block/Obsolete a Business Partner which is a Internal Employee (Active or Terminated).-The terminated employees might have been responsible for some opportunities while they were still active. Therefore to be able to se arch for such opportunities, the value help still shows also the terminated employees.--In cases, if the Business partner has only Service Agent role, you can block the status manually in the Business partner Data work center by using Change Status. So if an Service Agent has been in any point of time an internal Employee, the status cannot be changed.--Note: Same logic is applicable for the Cloud For Customer as well.-Keywords-Business Partner status , Unable to update Business Partner, Business Partner Employee

Title: Backend Error When Creating a Quote With Reference to a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are copying a sales quote and create with reference to a sales order with an invoice schedule.-The system shows a backend error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the New Business workcenter.-Select the Sales Quote view.-Select any quote and copy.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Remove all line items.-Click Create with Reference.-Enter a sales order ID with an invoice schedule.-The system dumps.-Cause-This is a technical limitation, that occurs when a quote is copied and a create with reference is executed to a sales order with invoice schedule.-Resolution-In this scenario you can either use a Create with reference or a copy on a sales quote.-So either create a new sales quote and create with reference to the sales order.-Or copy a sales quote, but do not use Create with reference.-This behavior will be adjusted in a future release.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Sales Order, Create with Reference, Invoice Schedule, Angebot, Auftrag, Rechnungsterminplan, Anlegen mit Bezug

Title: Deployment Error: XBO scripting identifiers not recognised during activation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer has triggered activation of New and Changed Items in their source tenant. They then assemble this solution and transport to their target tenant.-During upload they receive multiple errors relating to scripting (AP-RC-BDS-SCR). The errors state that certain identifiers are not recognised.-Example: Customer has added new messages to an XBO extension. The new message identifiers are not recognised when uploading to the new tenant.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To reproduce this error:-Open the backend of impacted target tenant.-Go to function module (SE37) PDI_1O_ACTIVATE.-Enter the solution name, phase (RAD), and sync left empty (false).-Hit execute.-Go to SDIM.-Open the failing version.-Check the logs.-You will see the mentioned errors in the logs.-Alternatively, you can just view the logs of the failed activation done by the customer!-Note: You can also view the logs in SLG1.-Cause-This is a known issue if the solution does not have Custom Business Object (CBO) in it, then if customer activates solution choosing "New and Changed item" option then "fq" file for XBO is not updated correctly which leads to activation error when solution is deployed.-Resolution-To over come this issue until customer adds CBO in solution : -They will have to activate solution by choosing "all items" and then assemble, download the solution and deploy it. - To overcome current issue : -Customer will have to create a new patch in source system, after patch creation rightclick on solution level and choose activate all items, once activation is done-Then they can proceed with solution assembly, download and deploy it in target tenant. -Until they add a single CBO they will have to follow the same process before deployment or assembly . Right click on solution- > Activate All Items, assemble and download then deploy.-Keywords-XBO, Extension BO, Business Object, AP-RC-BDS, SCR, Scripting, Identifier

Title: External Transactions Checkbox in Payment Monitor View Is Not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-The tri-state checkbox External Transactions is not working as expected in Payment Monitor work center view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2002-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Select show-list Payments In Transfer.-Click Open Advanced Filter icon.-Notice that the External Transactions checkbox is fully marked/painted.-Click Go button.-Notice that the number of payments is, for example, 500.-Untick the External Transactions, by clicking one time over it.-Click Go.-Notice number of payments is still 500.-Tick the External Transactions, by clicking one time over it.-Notice that the number of payments is different now, for example, 1000.-Now, fully mark/paint the External Transactions checkbox, by clicking one time over it.-Click Go.-Notice that the number of payments is again different. Now it is the sum of non-external transactions with external transactions: 500 + 1000 = 1500. Now the number is correct.-Cause-The tri-state checkbox is supposed to work as follows:-Fully marked: both external transaction payments and non-external transaction payments are considered.-Ticked: Only external transaction payments are considered.-Empty: Only non-external transaction payments are considered.-During the initial screen load, when the checkbox is fully marked/painted, the system is not able to properly sum external transactions and non-external transactions, and that's why it displays a wrong number of payments.-Resolution-This is currently a product limitation.-As a workaround, the checkbox should be clicked three times and then the Go button clicked. In this way a proper page load takes place.-First time: changes from fully marked/painted to empty-Second time: changes from empty to ticked-Third time: changes from ticked to fully marked/painted again-Keywords-external transactions; payment monitor; checkbox; limitation

Title: Incorrect Amount in Follow-Up Invoice/Credit Memo/Correction Invoice
Content: Symptom-Creating a Follow up Invoice from an existing invoice from a scheduled invoice request and the suggested values for pricing are incorrect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a contract with one line item of type "Service - Fixed Price without actuals".-Tick the Price Per Period indicator.-Create an invoice schedule with multiple dates.-Invoice the scheduled invoice request from the contract.-Create a follow up invoice/credit memo or correction invoice for the original invoice.-In some cases the pricing is taken over incorrectly.-Cause-When the price per period indicator is ticked, each line in the invoice schedule is broken down to quantity percentage.-We store the percentages in rounded values, if necessary.-The original invoice is calculated with the original values.-Follow up invoices are generated with the rounded values.-Example:-Line item 10 is entered with price 320 EUR.-One date for line items 10 is entered with 1EUR.-The system calculated the quantity for that invoice request -> 1/320 = 0.003125.-The information is rounded to 0.003.-The original invoice is generated with the correct values.-Follow up invoices calculate with the rounded values -> 0.003 * 320 = 0.96 EUR.-Resolution-This is currently a limitation in the system and will be changed in a future release.-To avoid this behavior, make sure to adjust the suggested quantity values in follow up documents.-Cancellation invoices are not affected. You can cancel the original invoice and re-invoice it.-Keywords-Invoice, Calculation, Follow-Up, Credit Memo, Correction, Quantity, Pricing, Rechnung, Berechnung, Folge, Gutschrift, Korrekturrechnung, Menge, Preisfindung

Title: Canada: Incorrect Region is Displayed in a Manual Tax Entry Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-An incorrect Region (state) is displayed in the journal entry created for a manual tax entry in Canada.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Manual Tax Entries > VAT Entries view.-Open Manual Tax Entry AAA (AAA means the Manual Tax Entry ID).-Click View All.-Under Account Assignment section, notice that State displayed is ABC (ABC means the State name).-Open the Journal Entry from the Manual Tax Entry.-Select the line item with a credit posting to the Taxes G/L Account.-Notice that Region displayed is not ABC, but DEF (DEF means the Region name).-Cause-The manual tax entry AAA was created with State DEF, as a mistake. Later, the State was changed to ABC (correct one) and the manual tax entry released. Under these circumstances, the system is not able to update the Region (state) in the Journal Entry and it stays as DEF.-Resolution-This is currently a system limitation.-As a workaround, when a manual tax entry has been posted with such error, it can be reversed and a new entry can be created with correct State.-See Also-A similar limitation is observed in the Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher scenario for Canada.-Please check KBA 2886707 - Canada: Incorrect Region is Displayed in Journal Entries Resulting From Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher-Keywords-manual tax entry; vat entry; state; region; canada; CA

Title: Price List is Partially Released Even Though the Status is Released on Header Level
Content: Symptom-When updating or creating Price Lists either via Microsoft Excel import or from the front end, on item level some of the products' status is Released but some are still in the status of 'Partially Released' or 'Not Released'.-While on the header level, the Release Status is Released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This occasionally happens under certain conditions.-Update or create Price List via Microsoft Excel import.-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to Price Lists tab.-In the dropdown list, choose the type of Price List you want to see.-Click Download button and download the template of Price List.-Fulfill the required fields and update the price as per work needs.-Save Data to Business ByDesign.-Logon to the system and find the Price List you just updated.-The Release Status on header level is Released but if go down to item level, some of the products' status is still under 'Not Released' or 'Released Partially'.- Update or create Price List via front end.-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to Price Lists tab.-Choose the respective Price List you want to update.-At Items sub tab, mass change the products' list and save.-The Release Status on header level is Released but if go down to item level, some of the products' status is 'Not Released' or 'Released Partially'. -Cause-Due to the internal technical buffer handling issue, it might happen that some products in the price list are Not Released or Partially Released even though the price list header is Released.-Resolution-This is a known issue and you can avoid such issue by following either workaround described as below:-After adding new product into the price list, do not save the price list. Directly trigger release of price list without Save. (Via Release action in UI, release will save the price list internally and then trigger release action)-After adding product price in price list, Save the price list, Close the price list edit UI, reopen and trigger price list release action in UI.-For the affected Price List, you need to perform a dummy change for one of the products in the items-(for example, by changing the amount, pressing the enter key on your keyboard and then changing the price back to the original price.)-The header status will then change and it is again possible to release the price list.-  Keywords-Price List; Release; disabled; Not Released

Title: Lock Error While Editing Times
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-When a business user, time administrator or key user performs a time recording or time related action (like adding a new line to the time profile of an employee), the system dumps respectively throws one or more of the following error messages:-An exception with the type /HOE/CM_LOCK occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-An exception of the type '/HOE/CM_LOCK' occurred that was not caught anywhere along the call hierarchy. It was neither handled locally nor declared with a RAISING clause-Operation not possible; Employee Time locked by user XYZ (where XYZ represents the business user) -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The dump might be caused by a parallel exclusive lock on recorded times for this employee.--The parallel lock might have happened on a date in the past, and for any reason the lock was not resolved after the employee closed the transaction.-Resolution-Go to Administration and User Management work center-Go to Business Users view-Find the Technical ID for the employee-Open the SM12 transaction in the backend-Maintain the Technical ID in the User Name field-Click on List-Check the locks-Ensure that the user is currently not logged in/that no current transactions are involved-Mark the lines listed-Delete them using Shift+F2 or the bin symbol at the top of the screen-Keywords-blocked, Operation nicht möglich, Zeitbestätigungsarbeitsvorrat ist durch Benutzer, gesperrt,-

Title: UoM Is Not Changable In Other Parts Of The Material Even After Changing The Base UoM
Content: Symptom-You have created a Material with a Base UoM and it is applied to all parts of the Material. When you change the Base UoM in General tab, the UoM is not changing in Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation, and Valuation tabs since the field is read-only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Search for material XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the material).-Select material XYZ and click Edit.-Change the Base UoM to a New Value.-Save the changes.-The Changes are not reflecting in the other sections of the material.-Cause-Once a Base UoM is activated for Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation, and Valuation then it is not possible to change it.-Resolution-There are two possible workarounds to overcome the issue:-You can maintain the quantity conversion in the Material for the old UoM to the new UoM.-1. Go to Product Data work center.-2. Select Materials view.-3. Edit and go to General tab of material XYZ.-4. Maintain the quantity conversion between the old Base UoM and the new Base UoM.-You can create a New Material with same type but with required Base UoM.

Title: Renaming Broadcast Attachments
Content: Symptom-When you send out broadcasts in the format xml, xlsx or csv (or any of them zipped), the recipients receive a file with a cryptic name, such as CODOPPU_Q0001.xml. You would like to change the file name into another label.-Alternatively, if the attachment is opened in Excel (xml or xlsx file), you would like to change the sheet name.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Broadcasts.-Click on New.-Enter the details as required. Select one of the following formats: xml, xlsx or csv.-Tick the box ZIP if required.-Save and Close.-Back in the broadcast list, mark your broadcast and click on Start Now.-Once the broadcast is received, you notice that the attachments has a name such as CODOPPU_Q0001.xml which is not meaningful.-Cause-The attachment of a broadcast is named by the technical ID of the report that is sent. The sheet name of xml or xlsx files is determined by the time stamp when the broadcast is sent.-Resolution-Currently there is no option to rename the attachment of a broadcast or the Excel sheet. Please register this on the SAP Influence page:-ByDesign: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Cloud for Customer: https://influence.sap.com/SAPCloudforCustomer-Keywords-zip, xml, xlsx, csv, technical ID, excel, worksheet, sheet, change label, lable

Title: While Exporting Organization Structure in Excel, Business Residence is Missing
Content: Symptom-You have exported the Organizational Structure in Microsoft Excel, but the Business Residence is missing in the excel file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Structure work center.-Select Org Structures view.-Switch to Table view.-Select Export button and choose Microsoft Excel.-Cause-The reason why the Business Residence field is not exported is that it is a Calculated field which has an icon and a text. The value for the icon is determined via a calculated rule.-Resolution-You can export the Org Structure by using the second field Business Residence as stated below:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Personalize and choose This Screen option.-3. Under Screen layout, select Untitled Table.-4. Under Fields section, scroll down till the end and you can find another Business Residence field. Check the Visible check box.-5. Save the changes.--Now, when you export the Organizational Structure, you can find the Business Residence.--Keywords-Organisationsstruktur, Organisationsmanagement, Betriebsstätte

Title: Error Message: "Sales Organization XYZ Used in Sales Documents; Delete not Possible, Operation not Possible; Sales Org. Referenced by Material ABC"
Content: Symptom-You try to Check or Activate an Organizational Structure in Organizational Management work center. But this is not possible since the system throws below error message:-"Sales Organization XYZ used in sales documents; delete not possible, Operation not possible; sales org. referenced by material ABC". (XYZ represents the Sales Organization; ABC represents the Material)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the respective Org Structure.-Select Check All or Activate All.-The above mentioned error message appears.-Cause-The respective Org Unit might be marked as a Sales Organization and have Sales Functions with some validity. Anyone of the below change will cause the issue:-If you have completely removed the Sales Functions from the Org Unit.-Delimiting the Sales Functions in the Org Unit to a past or future date.-Deleting the Org Unit in the Planning Area.-Resolution-Once a Sales Organization is used in a Material, Service or any other Business Transaction Document, then it is not possible to delete the Sales Organization Function or delimit the validity of it to the past date, or to delete the Org Unit.-A possible solution to overcome the issue is to delimit the Org Unit or the Sales property of the Org Unit to a future date.-You can also refer to the knowledge base article 1681186 - Error Message: Operation not Possible; Sales Org. Referenced by Service Product XYZ-If the solution of blocking the Sales Organization in the Material doesn’t solve the issue, then you can re-assign the Sales Organization Function in the respective Org Unit.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Unable Deletion

Title: Approve Button is Not Shown in Approvals Work Center View for Manual Customer Invoice Task
Content: Symptom-You are the responsible person to process an approval task for manual customer invoices. In your Approvals work list, you are not able to find the Approve or Send Back for Revision button. You have to open the approval task to see the buttons.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Manage My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-You can see a list of approval tasks assigned to you.-Select a task for Approval Manual Customer Invoice, you are not able to find Approve or Send Back for Revision button. While select another approval task for i.e. Sales Quote, the Approve and Send Back for Revision are shown.-Select the task for Approval Manual Customer Inovice again, click Edit and open the approval task details. You are now see the Approve and Send Back for Revision button.-  Cause-This is currently the system design.-Resolution-You need to open the approval task and then perform Approve or Send Back for Revision Action.-Keywords-Approval for Manual Customer Invoice; Approve Button; Send Back for Revision button; missing in OWL.

Title: Leave Available (as of today) does not show any data
Content: Symptom-When the Employee is creating a New Leave Request through Self-Services Overview, the field Leave Available (as of today) is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home workcenter-Go to Self-Services Overview-In the section Time, select the link New Leave Request-In the Create step, choose the Type of Leave -In the Additional Information section, the field Leave Available (as of today) is blank-Cause-The Time Type is mapped to Time Account which is a Statistical Time Account.-Resolution-Statistical Time Accounts are used mainly for statistical purposes for example: counter, overtime. The main purpose of this Time Account is to document how may days or hours are recorded which can be used for reporting purposes.- -For managing balances, Quota Time Account type should be used where, based on accrual and deduction, the remaining balances are calculated.- -To check the Time Account Categories which you added in Business Configuration, you may follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center -Select Implementation Projects view or Overview -Search and Open the activity for Time Accounts - <Country> -Select Maintain Time Account Types-Choose the respective Time Account to view the Time Account Category-See Also-You may refer the Help Center document Time Accounts which describes usage of Time Account Category Type in detail.-Keywords-Urlaubsantrag; Vacation; Holiday; Abwesenheit; Abwesenheitsantrag

Title: Business Object Identity is Not PSM Released
Content: Symptom-You want to have write access to the Business Object (BO) Identity, but this BO is not PSM released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Cause-The Identity business object cannot be released for PSM write processes due to the nature of the BO (it is an infrastructure BO, which is not in the application layer control, but in the underlying NetWeaver platform control) and its underlying infrastructural dependencies.-Resolution-In case you have specific needs, raise this as a requirement, based on which the Identity and Access Management team can explore alternative possible solutions to enable them and plan the required development in future releases.-New requirements are submitted in the links below:-https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-https://influence.sap.com/SAPCloudforCustomer-See Also-2593068 - Business Role Through Identity BO is not PSM Released-Keywords

Title: Supplier Name Field in Travel and Expense Forms only Available for Spanish Employees
Content: Symptom-When you create a new expense report with a Spanish employee in the general data, you will see that for the Expense Type "Dues & Subscriptions" in step 2 "Expenses, there is the field "Supplier Name" available. In this field the supplier name for Spanish employees can be maintained. However, when you follow the same steps with a non-Spanish employee, the field will not be shown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Travel and Expenses and choose the coomon task New Expense Report on Behalf.-In the General Data of step 1 (General Information) you use a Spanish employee and provide the necessary information.-Move on to step 2 (Expenses) and add a row in the expenses list.-As an Expense Type, choose Dues & Subscriptions.-In the tab Expense data, you will see the field Supplier Name.-  6.  The same field will not be available for non-Spanish employees.-Cause-The field Supplier Name is hard-coded in the application for Spanish employees. This means there is no possibility for the Cloud Support to change this in the standard functionality, as it would create indifferences with other functions of ByDesign. Therefore, in the standard functionality it is only possible to maintain this field information for Spanish employees.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour for the standard functionality of Business ByDesign. You can request a PDI solution from our Service Center. Our colleagues in the custom development will then check the feasibility for the implementation of the field for non-Spanish employees.-You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-a) If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-b) If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-Keywords-Business ByDesign, Travel and Expenses, Supplier Name field-byd,travel and expenses,supplier name,spanish employees

Title: Error Message "Enter planning group" When Removing a Planning Group ID From a Material
Content: Symptom-When you create a Material, it is possible to save it without Planning Group ID (active Planning Area without Planning Group ID assigned). However it is not possible to remove Planning Group ID, once it has been assigned and saved once on the Material Master.-When you try to remove the Planning Group ID and save, system throws below error message:-Enter planning group-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select the Material.-Select Edit button.-Go to Planning tab.-Add a Planning Area (do not enter the Planning Group ID) and required details in other tabs.-Save the Material. Save is successful.-Now, go to the Planning tab again.-Add a Planning Group ID for a Planning Area.-Save the Material.-Remove the Planning Group ID and upon attempting to save the Material, system throws above error message.-Cause-Let start from Demand Planning work center, a Demand Plan can be created to work on multiple Products. To make user's job easy, you club together 10 Products in a group (Planning Group) and then assign this Group to a Demand Plan. What Demand Plan does is to copy all these 10 Products and then forgets the Group. Now, if you remove the Planning Group ID in the Material, there is no way for Demand Plan to know that it has to remove this Product from further processing.--Therefore this check happens when the Planning Group is maintained once.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-This is a new requirement and will be considered in one of future release of Business ByDesign but we cannot say anything about which release this feature will come.

Title: Error Message: Site assigned to permanent establishment 9999 (Business Residence name) from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY is not active; While Activating an Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate an Org Structure, system throws below error message:-Site assigned to permanent establishment 9999 (Business Residence name) from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY is not active-Activation Failed; resolve all errors-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Select Activate and choose Selected Structure.-Cause-There could be 2 possibilities for the issue, they are:-The Site assigned to the org unit 9999 is not active, which means the status of the site is Blocked for the particular period.-You might have converted the org unit 9999 to another org structure. So the org unit 9999 still shows the previous site assignment.-Resolution-Resolution 1: (To activate the Site, follow the below steps)-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the Org Unit and go to Definitions tab.-Select Details link besides Business Residence.-Select Associated Site link.-A new screen opens, Select Edit button.-Select Change button and choose Activate.-Resolution 2:-A site belongs to exactly one business residence. A business residence belongs to exactly one site.-You cannot move a business residence as it is by definition the geographical representation of a place where the company is doing business. The geographical representation is the Site. A location can also not be transferred from one business residence to another.-This means once the business residence is activated and created, the assignment cannot change. And you cannot create a new site as of a specific date. And it seems you are actually trying to move the business residence and that is not possible by definition. This cannot be achieved.-In this case you can delimit the business residence flag in org unit 9999 and create a new business residence which will create a new site with the name of Business residence. Then, you can able to activate the Org structure, which will create a new site.

Title: Cannot Select Account Hierarchy in Custom Price Tables For Price Lists
Content: Symptom-You are creating a custom price list and want to select Account Hierarchy as a selection criterion, but it is not available in the Price Table of Pricing Strategy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You are creating selection criteria for your custom Price Lists:-Navigate to the Business Configuration workcenter.-In the Overview find the Pricing Strategy activity and open it.-Open the Pricing Tables.-Add a row and look for Account hierarchy (CND_BY_HIER_GUID).-The value is not available in the Selection options, on Header, and on Item Level.-Cause-You cannot select account hierarchy for custom Pricing Tables, and thus cannot create custom Price Lists with Account Hierarchy.-This is a technical limitation in the current SAP ByDesign system.-Resolution-Use other selection criteria than Account Hierarchies for your business use case when creating custom Price Lists.-You can also enter a new feature request on our Customer Influence Site for your specific use case here.-See Also-Customer Influence Site, click here.-Keywords-Preislisten, Kundenhierarchie, Preisstragetie, Preistabelle, Pricing Strategy, Price List, Pricing Table, CND_BY_HIER_GUID

Title: Unexpected Query Result in Value Help Search of Account in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When using value help search in Sales Order,you try to do the query with condition as exclude with a wild card selection, while system doesn't throw the correct result back and exclusion of wild card selection doesn't work.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center-Under Common Tasks, click New Sales Order-Click value help on the Name field and Open Advanced Filter-In Account ID field, click More Filters on the right hand side-Fulfill the query as: Value equals to *L* but exclude *_*-Account ID which includes '_' still being listed on the result list-   Cause-There is a restriction for current system design.Exclusion of "wildcard" selection in Sales Order value help serach is currently not supported.-Exclude with a wild card (*)  doesn't get transformed to fetch data.-Resolution-This is system's current behavior.-As workarond, you can do a specific filter on Account ID value instead of a generic filter including wild card and Not Contains Pattern.-Keywords-Value Help search, query, Wild Card

Title: Incorrect Tax Rate is Applied for Special Economic Zones
Content: Symptom-You notice that on your Sales Orders the expected Tax Rate for Special Economic Zones (SEZ) is not applied.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Search for Sales Order YYY and select it (YYY stands for the Sales Order ID).-Click on Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Item tab and then the Taxes subtab.-You can see that the Automatic Tax Determination feature is activated but that the applied Tax Code is not the one you expect.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour as Automatic Tax Determination is not available for Special Economic Zones.-Resolution-As a workaround, it is necessary to manually maintain the expected Tax Code on your Sales Order:-Go to the Sales Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Search for Sales Order YYY and select it.-Click on Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Item tab and then the Taxes subtab.-In the Tax Code drop down menu, select the relevant Tax Code for your transaction and save.-Keywords-Special Economic Zones, SEZ, EOU, Exported oriented units, tax rate, wrong, Sales Orders, Customer Invoices, automatic tax determination, taxes, determination automatique des taxes, code de taxe

Title: Error: Item BTD Reference Missing for Line Item in Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In a Inbound Delivery Notification 1234567890(1234567890 represents the Inbound Delivery Notification) when you perform Check Consistency or Save you will receive the below error message--Item BTD reference missing for line item 9999(9999 represents the Line Item)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter and Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-2. Show All Delivery Notifications and Find 1234567890.-3. Select the IDN and perform Check Consistency.-You will receive the above error.-Cause-Line item 9999  for Product Productxyz is associated with Purchase Order 1111(1111 represents Purchase Order).-In the Purchase Order 1111, the line item has Process Type: Non-Stock, Item Type: Material and is already processed in the system.-Since the non-stock product reference is sent as a line item the system is giving the above error message.-  Resolution-Transfer the incident to CSS Component: AP-IDP to make the Inbound Delivery Notification document Consistent by removing the line item 9999 which is making the document Inconsistent.-Keywords-BTD Reference, Non Stock, Item Type, Process Type

Title: Error While Activating Communication Scenario In Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You get an error while activating communication scenario definition file (.csd) in your PDI Solution.-Name XYZ(XYZ represents a element) already exists in namespace.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to your tenant via Cloud Applications Studio-Open Solution - YYYYYYY_(YYYYYYY_() represents solution name).-Right click the .csd file-Select Activate- Cause-This happens when the communication scenario has the same name as external webservice (.wsid) in your solution and you have selected an inbound webservice in communication scenario. Due to these reasons, duplicate entries will be created in backend-Resolution-To resolve this you can follow either of the following steps-If you do not require the inbound service in your communicaiton scenario,  select only the outbound service in the communication scenario.-If you require the inbound service , then change the name of the communication scenario. Title: Error Message 'Custom code missing' on Sales Orders or Custom code Not Derived to Sales Order UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You have enabled Custom Codes in Business Configuration Activity Account Assignment Types.-When you open your Sales Order an error message is triggered immediately and its release is not possible:-'Custom code A missing' (A represents the ID of the Custom Code).-Or, no error message is raised but the Custom Code is not displayed on the Sales Order UI.-Environment-SAP ByDesign, All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sale Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order XXX (where XXX stands for the Sales orders ID).-Click on Edit and then View All.-The error message 'Custom Code A missing' is immediately raised and it is not possible to release the Sales Order.-The Custom Code cannot be found even if no error mesage is raised.-Cause-This message is raised because Custom Codes have been enabled on Sales Orders in Business Configuration but are not being derived to the Sales Order interface. This is a current system limitation which is going to be addressed in a future release.-Please note that if the Custom Code is set to Optional, the error message is not raised. The Custom Code is still not derived-Resolution-There are possibilities to address this by developing a Partner Add-on with the following association:  ITEM->ITEM_ACC_CO_BL_DISTRIB which is a released and Write-enabled Business Object.-In the meantime, in order to be able to release your Sales Orders, you have to disable Custom Codes in Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune tab, search for and open activity Account Assignment Types.-Open Maintain Account Assignment Types.-Select the relevant Account Assignment Type, for instance, Project Task.-In Details, in the Account Assignments tab, select Custom Code A.-You can see that its Data Input Control is set to 1- Mandatory. In order to go ahead with Sales order releases, you must change this setting to 2 - Optional or remove it altogether.-If a Partner Add-on is later developed, then Data Input Control can be set to 1- mandatory-See Also-You can also request this new feature and influence its development by submitting a New feature request on our Customer Influence forums: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Cost and Revenue Assignment, Project Task Assignment, PDI, Partner Add-on, facturation impossible, customer invoicing not possible, tâche de projet, commande client, Solution Partenaire
