Content: Symptom-You are creating a standard Embeded Component for reports in the custom screen and adding tags for tablets since it is a required screen for RUI.-When you are trying to add ANA_ICP.EC it is showing the following error “Activation Failed for because of backend consistency check violation. Referenced file /SAP_BYD_TF/AnalyticsPattern/ANA_ICP.EC.uicomponent must be tagged for device Tablet”-Disclaimer: "Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental".-Reproducing the Issue-In SDK Studio-Login in your tenant.-Go to My Solutions in your SDK page.-Select the respective solution in the folder.-Go to your _OWL.uicomponent.-Cause-This error occurs because the usage of standard embedded component ANA_ICP.EC for RUI is not currently supported.-Resolution-Unfortunately, this functionality is not supported, so it is not possible to enable this personalization for RUI.-Keywords

Title: Cannot Calculate or Report Withholding Tax for Japan
Content: Symptom-You cannot calculate or report Withholding Tax for Japan in this release.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Click New Supplier Invoice under Common Tasks.-Click View All> Items> Withholding Tax tab.-The system does not give you options to enter withholding tax codes for Japan.-Cause-In the current release, the system does not support withholding tax calculation or reporting for Japan.-Resolution-For Tax Calculation:-In the Supplier Invoicing work center, select the invoice which requires WHT deduction and post the invoice for the entire amount.-Calculate the withholding tax amount outside the system manually.-In the Payables work center, open the Supplier Account view and select the supplier account that you require.-Click View to open the Supplier Account Monitor screen. Select the open item and choose New Charge/Credit to open the New Charge/Credit screen.-In the Charge/Credit screen, select Supplier Charge in the Charge/Credit field.-Under the header, Line Items, add WHT – Creating liability in the General Ledger Account column. In the Amount field, enter the withholding tax amount that was computed outside the system.-Go to the Payment Management work center and select New Outgoing Check.-Select the tax authority and select Direct Posting to G/L Account under the header Payment Application Method.-Select the G/L account and enter the amount.-Click Release to make the tax payment.-Transfer the under/overpayment amount to the balance sheet account created for recording tax payable to the Government- Keywords-Japan, Withholding Tax-withholding tax,japan

Title: Payroll and Compensation not Available in Project Scope
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to scope Payroll and Compensation for Non-Localized Countries in SAP Business ByDesign. When checked in the Project Scope, the Scoping Elements for Payroll and Compensation are not available in Human Resources.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select Edit Project Scope button-Go to the Scoping step-Expand Human Resources-Scoping Element for Payroll and for Compensation are not available-Cause-Currently SAP Business ByDesign does not support Payroll and Compensation for Non-Localized Countries.-It only provides Hire to Rehire functionality and Time Administration for Non-Localized Countries.-Resolution-This is the system behaviour.-See Also-Further information could be found in CD 1991483-Keywords-Payroll, Compensation, Pre-localized, Pre localized, Non-localized, Non localized

Title: District Tax for Illinois is not derived from Vertex to SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You use Vertex in order to calculate taxes for business transactions in the United- States.  On your transactions with the State of Illinois, you notice that the Disctrict Tax, while being calculated in Vertex, is not derived to SAP Business ByDesign.-The overall tax amount to be applied is therefore not correct.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Centre.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Search for Sales Order XYZ and select it (XYZ stands for the Sales Order ID).-Click on Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Items tab and then the Taxes subtab.-Check each of the Items.-You notice that for each item only the State Tax is applied but not the District Tax, even though Vertex calculates it properly.-This issue has been reported for the State of Illinois only.-Cause-Development has confirmed that this is a known issue as configuration for Illinois needs to be worked on further.-It's been added to the Development backlog but, no time frame has been given for its completion.-Resolution-No workaround has been provided so far.-Keywords-Vertex, add-on, addon, Sales and Use tax, District tax rate, Tax entries, sales orders, invoices, customer invoices, Illinois, State of Illinois, Tax calculations, Taxes, Sales Tax Rate, Consumer Use Tax Rate

Title: Determination of Profit Center from Sales Unit failed - Unexpected Error During Backend Processing
Content: Symptom-An unexpected error during backend processing error message appears when you try to post a Business Transaction for a Supplier/Customer Invoice from the General Ledger.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit View.-Go to the Closing-Relevant Tasks sub-view.-Search for Task Determination of the profit center from the Sales Unit ABC and open it.-When clicking on Post, system shows an unexpected error during back end processing.-Cause-The invoice related to Sales Unit ABC has a Posting Date preceding the validy start date of the Sales Unit; Therefore the Profit Center could not be derived.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue go to the Organizational Management Work Center and adapt the timeline of the sales function of the Org Unit ABC accordingly.-Keywords-Determination of profit center from SalesUnit ABC on DD.MM.YYYY failed, unposted source document, profit center, Kundenauftrag, sales order, ungebuchte Ursprungsbelege, buchen

Title: Review Account Balances Not Display the Balance of Statistical Time Account
Content: Symptom-User as a time administrator, want to review the balances of time accounts. But user find that the time account types of Statistical Account category are not showing in Time Account Types in Regular Tasks of Review Time Account Balances.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select the Review Account Balances in Time Account Processing.-Select the drop down box for the Time Account Type field, where the time account types with Statistical Account category are not available.-Cause-Statistical accounts do not have a quota which changes when posting happens, e.g. when leave is taken. The purpose of the Review Account Balances screen is to check the balance and to maintain deviating rules.-Resolution-When user click on Maintain Deviating Rules, user can determine what happens for the remaining balance at period end, such as the leaves are carried forward into the next year etc. But this is only needed when the standard rule does not fit. For statistical accounts, such carrying forward/paying out mechanism at period end do not exist. Hence, the  statistical accounts are not shown on this screen.-Keywords-Review Account Balance, Statistical Time Account Balance, Statistical Time Account

Title: Balance Days of a Time Account Is Not Set to Zero even though a Fine Tuning Rule Is Set
Content: Symptom-User as a time administrator, find that the Balance Days of Time Account Quota in employee's time file still shows remaining days instead of zero although you have set a rule in Fine-tune activity to change the remaining balance to zero at the end of the fiscal year (e.g. Anually, April 1).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the employee and choose the Edit button.-Go to the Time Accounts Balances tab.-In the Time Accounts section, you can see the Balance as X days.--Cause-This is because that no time valuation correction run has been triggered yet.--If an employee's time administration data are changed, all results are automatically updated. However, if fine tuning settings are changed, which potentially concern many employees, no automatic update of employee data takes place. Future results are updated in the next day closure run, but past data need to be corrected by a time valuation correction run manually.-Resolution-Correction run for an employees:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select the Run Day Closure for One Employee link under Time Valuations.-Select the employee and you choose the required action based on your business requirement.-Correction run for many or all employees:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select the Administrator Day Closure Runs link under Time Valuations.-Select New button and choose the Day Closure Run option.-Enter an ID (for your reference), Description and Correction Start Date.-Choose Save and Close button.-Note that you can set the Selection Criteria to select the employees this action needs to perform on based on your business needs.-Keywords-Balance Days , Balance Days Set to Zero, Time Account Balance days

Title: Error Message "DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Employee(s) on Org Unit XYZ (Org Unit Name) must be Below a Cost Center. It is also Possible to Flag the Org Unit to Which the Employee is Assigned as a Cost Center."
Content: Symptom-You have made some adjustment in the Org structure and when you try to Check or Activate the Org structure, system throws below error message:-DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to DD2.MM2.YYYY2; Employee(s) on Org Unit XYZ (Org Unit Name) must be below a Cost Center. It is also possible to flag the Org Unit to which the Employee is Assigned as a Cost Center-or-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Org Unit XYZ (Org unit name) must be below a cost center. The org unit itself can also be flagged as a cost center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Select the Org unit XYZ.-Select Check or Activate button.-System throws above error message.-Cause-There are multiple causes which may lead to this error message. Few of them are as follows,-Cause 1:-The org unit XYZ have employee assignment from DD1.MM1.YYYY1 but you have made the cost center assignment from DD2.MM2.YYYY2.-So the ground rule is that if there is any employee assignment for an org unit then the org unit must be a costcenter. But in this case it should be, from DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to DD2.MM2.YYYY2 this org unit XYZ was not set as Cost center.--Cause 2:-You have maintained functions for the Org unit XYZ.--Checkboxes on the Functions tab are only allowed units marked as Cost center and Business Residence.-Resolution-Resolution 1:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit org structures.-Set Effective from date as DD1.MM1.YYYY1.-Highlight the org unit XYZ and go to Timelines tab.-Change the Vaild From date to DD1.MM1.YYYY1 (which is same as the Valid from date of the employee assignment) for value Cost center.-Check the consistency and then you can able to activate the Org structure.-Resolution 2:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structure option under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org unit XYZ.-Go to Functions tab.-Uncheck the selected functions.-Check and activate the Org Structure

Title: Expense Report Is Sent to Other Approver Than Employee's Cost Center Manager
Content: Symptom-You created an expense report and by default this report should be sent to your cost center manager for approval. But you find that system assigns the expense report to another cost center manager.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Service Overview.-Select the New Expense Report link.-Here you can see that the approver is different from your cost center manager.-Cause-The default cost assignment of an employee for an expense report is stored in the Expense Arrangement of an employee and it is usually kept in sync with any organizational unit changes of the employee, e.g. if an employee is transferred from org unit ABC to DEF, the cost assignment in the Expense Arrangement is delimited and a new entry is created with cost center DEF as default cost assignment. However under certain circumstances this synchronization does not take place, e.g. if an expense clerk has manually modified the default cost assignment in the expense arrangement of an employee.-So the issue might occur because someone manually changed the default cost assignment of the employee.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, the default cost assignment needs to be restored.-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the Expense Arrangement view.-Search and highlight the employee.-Select the Edit button.-In the Cost Assignment section, Select the Add Row button.-Input the Cost Center of employee's belonging cost center and the Percentage.-Select the Save and Close button. -Keywords-Assignement, Expense Report, Cost Center, Cost Assignement

Title: Error Message When Validating and Uploading E-Bilanz File in Excel: File incomplete. Use an Official Excel Template
Content: Symptom-You get an error message when validating an Electronic Financial Reporting XBRL - File in Excel: 'File incomplete. Use an official excel template. XBRL means eXtensible Business Reporting Language and is similar to XML forma't.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have already made the Electronic Report Run and the XBRL File in XML format has been created.-Open Microsoft Excel and select SAP ERP Client for E-Bilanz.-Import the XBRL File by clicking on Import XBRL-Datei. (This means Import XBRL File in English, this tool is available in German only - therefore the description is in German).-Now press Validierung (English: Validation).-An error message is raised: File incomplete. Use an official Microsoft Excel template.-Cause-This can have multiple reasons. See below:-Some installation requirements have not been fulfilled. A Microsoft Visual C++ Language Pack is missing - the most recent one is Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for VS2013 x86.-This must be a 32-bit Microsoft Excel runtime version, 64 bit version is not working.-Some DLL Files from SAP ERP Client for E-Bilanz (ERIC_DLL folder) are not stored correctly in the Microsoft Excel Installation Folder. You can find the ERIC_DLL folder in C:\ProgramFiles(x86)\SAP\SAP ERP Client for E-Bilanz\ERIC_DLL. Since the folder is hidden make sure to display hidden files in the options of the Windows Explorer.-An old version of Microsoft Excel is installed - it should be Microsoft Excel 2016.-There are not enough Authorization Rights for your computer.-Resolution-Verify if the version of the SAP ERP Client for E-Bilanz (Eric Client) is the newest (currently 1.0.3.36) by clicking the i-Button in SAP ERP Client for E-Bilanz.-We recommend to install the newest version of Microsoft Excel 2016.-You need to use the 32-bit version.-Install Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for VS2013 x86.-Install Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0.-Make sure Microsoft Office is closed during Installation.-Copy ERIC_DLL files from SAP ERP Client for E-Bilanz into Microsoft Excel Installation Folder.-Make sure your computer has enough Authorization Rights (Administration Rights recommended).-  Keywords-E-Bilanz, File Incomplete

Title: Different Tax Code in Customer Contract and Follow-Up Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You create a follow-up service confirmation from a contract and the entered tax details for the items are different in customer contract and service confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Service based Contract ABC (ABC represents the contract ID).-Navigate to the Items tab and select the Taxes Subtab of the Line Item DEF (DEF represents the Line Item ID).-Change the Tax Code manually.-Click on Release and Confirm Execution.-In the opening Window enter the Information for Line Item DEF and reference it to the contract ABC.-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Services and Spare Parts tab, Taxes Subtab.-You can see that the entered Tax Code is not the manually adjusted Tax code from the contract.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-As contracts are intended as long running documents, the taxation details for each execution can vary.-In a service confirmation the tax determination is retriggered during creation.-Thus manually adjusted tax details are not passed from contract to service confirmation.-Resolution-You can manually adjust the Tax Details in the Service Confirmation:-Open the Contract ABC.-Click on Release and Confirm Execution.-In the opening Window enter the Information for Line Item DEF and reference it to the contract ABC.-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Services and Spare Parts tab, Taxes Subtab.-Change the determined Tax Code manually.-Keywords-Vertrag, Steuercode, Tax Code, Customer Contract, Servicerückmeldung, Service Confirmation, Follow-Up, Folgedokument.

Title: Search with Extension Field does not Work
Content: Symptom-Extension fields added to the Advanced search do not fetch any records.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center with the extension field and open the OWL (Object Work List).-In the OWL screen, click on the Advanced filter option.-Enter Search data within the extension field.-Click on Go.-           No records will be found.-Cause-This normally happens when there is a mismatch in the Extension field's Business context and the Business Object where the field is assigned.-Example 1: In the Product OWL: While creating/adding an extension field, 2 contexts are found.-Material - Sales Information-Material – General Information-  Example 2: In the Account OWL: While creating/adding an extension field, 2 contexts are found.-Account - General Information-Primary Contact Extensibility-Resolution-Hide the added field via Key User Tool.-Add a new Extension field using the correct Business context.-Example: If the field is used within the Account view, then the field with the context Account-General Information should be added. If the field has to be used within the Contacts view then the Primary Contact Extensibility should be used. Sample screen as below:-

Title: Profile Picture in HTML5 in ByD Cannot be Changed
Content: Symptom-You would like to change the profile picture (employee image) displayed in the upper right corner of the screen on the HTML5 client. After doing the necessary steps to upload a profile picture it is still not changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign HTML5 client-Reproducing the Issue-Select the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services view.-Click Edit my contact data.-Go to Change Photo.-Upload an image and click Finish.-Cause-The feature was introduced with 1708 but due to performance issues this was switched off again.-Resolution-Currently the feature has been disabled until the performance issues can be resolved. The feature will be enabled in an upcoming release.-Keywords-profile, image, picture, photo, HTML5, ByD, Mitarbeiterfoto, Employee Image-html5,byd,image,photo,picture,mitarbeiterfoto,profile,employee image

Title: Unable to Create Product Category with Leading Zeros in ID
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to manually create or migrate Product Category with a leading zero in the ID (e.g. 01 or 02).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1802 and higher.-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer 1802 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product workcenter.-Select Product Administration tab.-Select the New button.-Enter the required details and the ID with leading zero (e.g. 02), then save.-Observation-The Product ID is created without the leading null.-Cause-The Category ID does not support leading zeros, if the ID is purely numeric. Therefore, Category IDs 01 or 02 and 1 or 2 are considered to be the same.-Resolution-In case a letter or other character is introduced in the ID, the zeros won't be truncated.--The same behavior applies to other IDs such as Material and Service Product, for example.-Keywords-Leading Zero; product category ID, material ID, External document ID, number range

Title: Backend Error when Deleting an Activity from Opportunities View
Content: Symptom-You are trying to delete an Activity from the Opportunities Workcenter and the System shows a Backend Error Message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the New Business Workcenter.-Open the Opportunity View.-Open the Opportunity ZZZ (ZZZ represents the Opportunity ID).-Click on Delete Activity.-The system shows a Backend Error Message.-Cause-You are using custom Sales Cycles and/or Sales Phases.-You can maintain custom Sales Cycles and Sales Phases in the Sales Cycles and Phases Acitivity from the Business Configuration Workcenter.-If you maintain Sales Cycles and Phases with less or more than 3 characters, this behaviour can occur for some users.-Resolution-In order to avoid this issue, maintain Sales Cycles and Phases with excatly three characters in length. To do so follow these steps:-Open the Business Configuration Workcenter.-Find Sales Cycles and Phases Activity.-Maintain Sales Cycles/Phases.-Create custom Sales Cycles/Phases with exactly 3 characters in length.-To deal with already created opportunities and activities that cause a dump from the opportunity workcenter, you can delete them from Account Management Workcenter:-Open the Account Management Workcenter.-Navigate to the Activities View.-Find Activity ZZZ.-Click on Delete.-This will allow you to delete Activities with Sales Cycles/Phases using more/less than 3 characters.-Keywords-Sales Cycles, Sales Phases, Dump, Backend Error, Opportunity, Delete, Löschen, Verkaufszyklen, Verkaufsphasen, Fehler

Title: Employee Missing in the Value Help for Org Unit Manager
Content: Symptom-You have hired an Employee in the system. When you try to assign this employee as an Org Unit Manager for a particular Org Unit, the employee is missing in the value help for Org Unit Manager.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight an Org Unit.-Go to general tab.-Select the value help for Org Unit Manager.-Where the newly hired employee is missing.-Cause-If the Employee's hire date is DD.MM.YYYY, then this employee is active in the system only on/after DD.MM.YYYY. If you want to assign this employee as a Org Unit manager then, you should set the Effective From as on/after DD.MM.YYYY.-In case of lean HCM system, hire date is equal to creation date of the Employee-Resolution-So, set the Effective From date as DD.MM.YYYY and then you can able to find the employee in the value help.

Title: You are not able to Block Planning Area in Logistics, Planning and Availability Confirmation for a Material
Content: Symptom-You have activated a Planning Area for Logistics, Planning and Availability Confirmation in a Material but you couldn't able deactivate or remove the Planning Area which is status Active.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Product Data work center.-Select the Materials view.-Highlight the Material XYZ (XYZ represents the Material ID) and select the Edit button.-Go to the Logistics or Planning or Availability Confirmation tab.-Select the respective Planning Area. Where the respective Planning Area is in Active status, you can see that the Remove button is greyed out, and it is not possible to change the status to blocked.-Cause-Once a product is activated for a planning area/site in Planning, Logistics and Availability Confirmation, it is not possible to remove it or make it inactive. If the status is still In Preparation then you can delete the planning area from the product data.-The reason for this behavior is, if the Material is used for Logistics, Planning and Availability Confirmation, blocking the status will end up in inconsistencies in the Business Transaction Documents in which the Material is used. So, in general it is not allowed to block the status of Material for Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed-Keywords-Block, Deactivate, Planning Area,  Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation

Title: Discrepancy Between Report and Application Data Regarding Time Values - ByD
Content: Symptom-Your setting in the Business Configuration Activity Time Zone Maintenance is different from the default UTC. In this case that we will use as an example the customer time zone was set to CET which corresponds to UTC +1.-You run a standard report, for example Customer Contract Volume (technical ID CRMCCOIB_Q0001), and move the characteristics Calendar Day into the report. You may notice that the calendar day in the report is different to the one shown in the object (contract in this case).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You enter a new customer contract XYZ (where XYZ represents the customer contract ID) in the Sales Orders work center, Contracts view.-You change the date /time in the Contract Item Date fields to 17.09.2017 00:00 CET.-You go to the view Sales Orders work center, Reports view.-Find the standard report Customer Contract Volume and open it.-Move characteristic Calendar Day into the report.-Find the contract XYZ.-The report will display field Calendar Day as 16.09.2017.-Cause-In the backend we always store the date / timezone content in the UTC format.-The reports picks up data from the backend, so the report data would always be in the UTC format. Hence, 17.09.2017 00:00 CET is stored as 16.09.2017 23:00 in the backend and therefore the report displays this date.-It is not possible to change this behavior in reports as of now.-Resolution-A possible workaround could be to update the field Contract Item Date to 17.09.2017 01:00 CET. Then the report should display the Calendar Day as 17.09.2017.-Keywords-wrong date, time zone, reporting-date format,utc format date in report,time zone,date,report

Title: Error Message: "The material ID is not valid. You cannot use special characters or spaces between characters when creating the ID" While Using Special Character in Defining New Material ID
Content: Symptom-When you create a new Material with the Material ID which contains a special character (example: *, &, }, {, >, <), system throws the below error message:-The material ID is not valid. You cannot use special characters or spaces between characters when creating the ID-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data workcenter-Select Materials view-Select New Material link under Common Tasks-Enter the Material ID YYYYY* where YYYYY* stands for the Material ID-Fill the mandatory fields-Select Save-System throws the mentioned error-Cause-The system is designed in way to allow you to use only alphanumeric characters and few special characters.-Resolution-You may use only alphanumeric characters and few special characters mentioned below:-ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_:/-.\-You may check the activity Number Ranges for Materials in Business Configuration to understand how your system is designed to accept the characters.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-For the relevant project select Open Activity List button-In the tab Fine-Tune, open the activity Number Ranges for Materials-You will be able to see the Number Ranges maintained for the Materials -Keywords-Number Ranges for Materials, Special Characters, Alphanumeric Characters, Material ID, Product ID

Title: Table Calculation Row Always Displayed on Top in HTML5
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY.-Result row of Table Calculations in HTML5 is displayed on top although Display Result Rows at Top of Table isn't checked.-Environment-ByD HTML5-Reproducing the Issue-Log into HTML5 UI.-Go to New Business work center.-Open Opportunities view.-Open any opportunity.-Select View All.-Enter Adaptation Mode.-Select Items tab.-Right click on Items table and select Table Calculation.-Select for which value you want the sum to be displayed.-Click Apply and save changes.-Exit Adaptation Mode.-Cause-The issue is occuring because the change has been done by a Key User through Adaptation Mode. Due to a bug the result row is always displayed on top regardless of chosen option.-Resolution-As a workaround the end user can configure the Table Calculation through Personalization mode.-See Also-The issue will be fixed in the upcoming release:-1805 (master) with https://git.wdf.sap.corp/3084369-1802 (HFC02) with https://git.wdf.sap.corp/3084379-Keywords-result row; calulation table; items; tables calculation; tables calculations; Display Result Rows at Top of Table;-result row,calulation table,tables calculation,tables calculations,display result rows at top of table,sum on top

Title: Feed for Custom Business Object is Displaying All Feed Updates
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom Business Object, and have enabled Feed for this object. However when you go to the Feed Facet you can see all object updates, not updates that are specific to this one Business Object instance.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud For Travel And Expense.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the affected work centre.-Go to the affected view.-Open instance ID XYZ (XYZ represents an instance in the affected OWL).-Open the Feed Facet.-You will see all object updates in the Feed, not the updates specific to this one Business Objects instance.-Cause-This is standard system behaviour. It is not possible to view object level Feed, for custom Business Objects.-Resolution-This can be added as a New Requirement to the Influence Forum:-https://influence.sap.com-Keywords-Feed, Custom Object, Partner, Standard Facet, Cloud Application Studio, SDK

Title: ISR Tool
Content: Symptom-You are in  Switzerland and need to print the ISR payment slips via tray control.-Environment-Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You downloaded the tool via the Download Center and want to set the ISR tool up.-Cause-The ISR tool will be set to obsolete soon.-Resolution-We have introduced with 1608 the new CPM (Cloud Print Manager). The ISR functionality is already fully integrated into the CPM.
