Title: Export and Import of Layouts not available
Content: Symptom-Unable to find the option to export and import the layouts.-Cause-Export and import of layouts is currently not available.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-Keywords-Export layouts,Import layouts

Title: Error While Migrating Material Using Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You are attempting  to migrate the Material using Migration Tool, In Step 2 of migration, error occurs for Edit Value Conversion for Material Type Code for India.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Integrate and Extend chevron.-Search and open Migration of Materials activity.-Select Migrate Materials Using the Migration Tool link.-In step 2 (Convert Values), Error for the task Edit Value Conversion for Material Type for India.-Select Edit Value Conversion for Material Type for India link.-A new screen opens where the status is red and Material Type Code for India field is empty.-And the Description showing is No additional information available.-Cause-Material Type Code For India is a globalization field applicable only for India. If the system is scoped other than India, then this should not be Active.-Resolution-To resolve issue, download the file again and remove the active status for the field Tax Account Code for India in the excel. After this, you can able to complete the Migration Materials without any issues.--Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Integrate and Extend chevron.-Search and open Migration of Materials activity.-Select Migrate Materials Using the Migration Tool' link.-Select the XML file and select Actions button and choose Download.-In the excel, go to the sheet General.-Remove the status Active from the field Tax Account Code for India.-Save the Excel.-Now you can able to migrate the material.-  Keywords-migration tool, material type code for india, migration of materials,

Title: Sticky Notes Changes
Content: Symptom-You want to track the changes done to a specific public or private Sticky Note.-Resolution-The system does not store logs for Sticky Notes changes in the backend. Currently there is no way of tracking these changes.-Keywords-logs, sticky notes

Title: Error Message: "Cannot change relationship between cost center () and its company; cost center has postings in accounting that have not been reversed"
Content: Symptom-When you try to change the attribute of Org Unit XYZ from Cost Center only to Cost Center and Profit Center.  While checking the changes done, system throws below error message:-Cannot change relationship between cost center () and its company; cost center has postings in accounting that have not been reversed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the org unit XYZ.-Go to Definitions tab.-Select the check box Profit Center.-Select Check button and choose Check - Selected Structure option.-Cause-There are different possibilites which leads the above error message. The below might be a cause for this issue:-If the Org unit XYZ is moved from one company to another company. i.e., If you have maintained XYZ to a Company (Currecntly Belongs to) and later you have changed to another company on DD.MM.YYYY and now you wanted to make the Org unit as Profit center. This implies a change of Company for the Cost Center which is not allowed as soon as postings exist.--Resolution-Follow below steps to resolve the issue,-Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-Select Edit Org structures.-Enter DD.MM.YYYY in effective from field.-Choose org unit XYZ.-Go to the definitions tab, position the cursor into the Currently belongs to field and clear the field. Verify that afterwards, the original business residence will shows up.-Alternatively, it might be possible to move the cost center to the other company once all non-zero balances for all GL accounts are reposted to another cost center so that all balances of XYZ are zero.-However, this path should be avoided, instead a new cost center can be created in the another company.

Title: Delimited Org Units (Company) are Still Visible in Active Area even after Activation
Content: Symptom-User have delimited the Org Units XYZ (Company) on DD.MM.YYYY and activated the changes done. But the Org unit XYZ is still visible in Active area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Active Area:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Org Structures view.-Select Effective from Date as DD.MM.YYYY.-Select Go button.-The delimited Org unit XYZ is still visible.-Planning Area:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Select Effective from Date as DD.MM.YYYY.-Select Go button.-The delimited Org unit XYZ is still not visible.-Cause-Users are trying to activate the org structure after delimiting the XYZ (i.e. user have set the date to DD.MM.YYYY, delimits the org units and then directly clicks on Activate button).-Now the system will state that activation was successful, however it will only attempt to activate the visible structures on the screen. Since XYZ no longer valid on DD.MM.YYYY, it wouldn't be part of the-selection and hence not be activated.-Resolution-Follow below steps to resolve the issue,-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Org Structures view.-Select the org unit XYZ.-Choose Edit button.-Set the effective from date to a date before DD.MM.YYYY and make sure that the org unit XYZ is visible.-Select Activate all or activate selected structure option (after highlighting the org unit XYZ).-Now the Org unit XYZ will not be visible in the Active area.-Keywords-Active area, Planning area, Effective date, Delimited Org Units, not Visible

Title: Relative Selects for characteristics in reporting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Not Yet Completed***-You want to check how the relative select options available for characteristics fields in reports.-Resolution-Relative selects are also called as Transformation definition or exit members in backend. They are usually of type 3(Characteristics Selection Derivation) in backend.-They are accessible from backend via MDRS >Transformation Definition.-The relative selection based on the data type of the first field element. If that corresponding data type is used as a characteristic in any of the standard data source and parameters are passed on top of those characteristics relative selects will be made available in the value help of that field.-If the same field has relative select in one report and other does not have the it, we need to check the data type of those characteristic in both the data sources. (Eg: Date field) -The option type of relative select are similar to selection type of parameters in the report. If they don't match the relative select will not be shown.-Parameter Type Relative Select Type-Any All Types Supported-Single  Single-Interval Single, Interval-Multiple Single, Multiple

Title: Error Message 'No quota available' while Creating New Leave Request
Content: Symptom-You may get the below error message when creating a new leave request by self services:-Error Message: No quota available-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Home-Select the view Self-Services-Select the link New Leave Request under the section Time-Follow the guided procedure to request a leave-Select the button Save, the error no quota available occurs-Cause-If you are requesting a new leave for the first time and if you receive 'no quota available' error, it could be the case that the configuration of the time profile of the employee is not completed.-In particular the error may be caused by missing Time Account Accrual Rule which results in no initial entitlement and no balance for the time account.  Therefore you are not able to request any leave, as no deduction is possible for the time account.-Resolution-In order to solve the issue it is necessary to assign a Time Account Accrual Rule to the employee:-Go to the work center Time Administration-Select the view Employees-Select the relevant employee in the list and select the button Edit-Select the tab Time Profile-Select the below sub-tab Time Accounts rule-Assign the preferred Time Account Rule to the time account-Select the button Save

Title: Status of Expense Report Changes From In Approval to In Audit When Editing
Content: Symptom-You created an expense report and sent it for approval. When you edit the expense report, you note that the status of the expense report changes from In Approval to In Audit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center-Select the Expense Reports view-Select the respective report with the In Approval status and choose the Edit button-In the popup window, the status changes to In Audit-And the approver still has the approval task in his/her Inbox-Cause-The scenario works as follows:--Condition: Status of an expense report is In Approval and the approver has the approval task for this expense report in the Managing My Area work center.--1. If the user edits an expense report which is in status In Approval, then the internal status changes to In Audit.-      > This status change will not be effective until the expense report is saved.-      > If the user closes the expense report without saving, the status of the expense report does not change and remains In Approval.--2. If the user changes the expense report and saves it.-     > The status changes to In Audit.-     > The approval task which is in the approver's inbox will vanish.--3. Once the auditor reviews the expense report and accepts it.-     > The status changes to In Approval.-     > New approval task will be sent to the approver.-Note that the above scenario stays the same when editing an expense report with status Released.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior.

Title: Dump When Downloading File From Data Extraction
Content: Symptom-When you try to download a file you have created for Data Extraction, the system dumps and the file isn't downloaded or is empty.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center and select the Data Extraction view-Select the extraction object you have created-Select the file under Extraction Files-Click on Download Files-After you save, the system dumps-Cause-One of the possible causes is that there are too many records to extract in only one file, causing it to be too large.-Resolution-You can try to extract the data using the packaging approach, by following the below steps:-In the Data Extraction view, click on New-Fill the General Data accordingly-Check the Package Active checkbox under Control Parameters-The system will suggest the ideal size in Package Size-Save it and activate it-Now the system will extract the data and divide it into smaller packages.

Title: Error Message: DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1; org unit XYZ has one or more functions assigned. Because of this, the org unit must be below a cost center. Flag this org unit or any org unit above it in the structure as a cost center.
Content: Symptom-When you try to Check or Activate an Org Structure, system throws below error message:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1; org unit XYZ has one or more functions assigned. Because of this, the org unit must be below a cost center. Flag this org unit or any org unit above it in the structure as a cost center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Check or Activate the Org Structure.-Cause-In an Org Structure, if you assign any org unit to at least one function then it is mandatory to have either that org unit or its higher level as a Cost Center. if it is not maintained, then the above error message is raised.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, follow the below steps:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures.-3. Set the Effective from date as DD.MM.YYYY (this date should be equal to the Valid From date of the Function) and select Go button.-4. Highlight the Org unit XYZ and go to Definitions tab.-5. Check the Cost Center check box.-6. Now, set the Effective From date as today's date.-7. Select Check All button.-Now, you are able to activate the Org Structure without any issues.

Title: Service Agent Cannot Create Leave Requests in Self Services
Content: Symptom-The link 'New Leave Request' does not exist in the view 'Self-Services' so that the service agent cannot create a leave request by employee self-service.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center 'Home'.-Select the view 'Self Services' and the option 'Self Services Overview'.-The link 'New Leave Request' does not exist.-Cause-The reason that the user does not have the option of creating leave request is because he/she is a service agent (external employee).-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-If a user is external employee (service agent), it is not possible for him/her to create leave request by self service.-See Also-If the user is internal employee but still he/she is not able to view the link 'New Leave Request' in Self Services, you can refer to the case document 1234548 - The Link 'New Leave Request' Not Available in the Employee Self-Services for resolution.

Title: Warning Message "Country specified in address of org unit is not supported by SAP Business ByDesign. Localization is not available for this country."
Content: Symptom-When you try to Check or Activate an Org Structure, system throws below warning message:-Country specified in address of org unit is not supported by SAP Business ByDesign. Localization is not available for this country.-Cause-The cause for this issue is that the country used in address is not support by SAP Business By Design.-Resolution-Countries which are support by SAP Business By Design:--Americas: Canada, Mexico (Focus on Professional Services), and USA--EMEA: Austria, Germany, France, Switzerland, UK, Denmark, Italy, the Netherlands and Spain--APJ: India, China, Australia and New Zealand--Recommendation: You can ignore this warning message and activate the Org structure but it may cause further issues in FIN or CRM transactional documents. Hence Please consult with your SAP Project team to overcome this issue.-Note: Supported Languages: German, English, French, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Dutch (UI only).

Title: Error Message "Timeline Entered is Invalid, enter a timeline between DD.MM.YYYY and DD.MM.YYYY" While Trying to Change the Start Date of an Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When user changing the Effective date of an entire Org Structure to earlier date, system throws below error message:-Timeline Entered is Invalid, enter a timeline between DD.MM.YYYY and DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Go to Timelines tab, preferably on the topmost Org Chart node in the tree.-Set the Valid From date to earlier date as per your requirement.-Where the dates of all the parameters are changing except for Org unit manager and the employees assigned to that.-When trying to change the Valid from date of Org unit manager and the employees, System throws above error message.-Cause-The effective date of an Org structure/Org unit can be changed only after the activation of the Org structure. Because in the Planning area, it is not possible to change the valid from date of an Org unit manager and the employees assigned to the org unit.-Resolution-Follow the below steps in order to change the valid from date of an entire Org structure: --1. Go to Organizational Management work center. -2. Select Edit Org Structures view.-3. Go to Timelines tab, preferably on the topmost Org Chart node in the tree. -4. Set the Valid From date on the Timelines tab (where the org unit ID is in the value column) to the new desired date (DD.MM.YYYY). Please note: You could able to see that once user change the start date of an org unit then the other dates will also change except the timelines of Org Unit Manager and the employees assigned to it. -i.e,. The Org unit date will be DD.MM.YYYY (new date) and for Org unit manager and the employees assigned to the org unit will remain in the date DD.MM.YYYY1 (Old Date). -5. Go through the tree from top to bottom and perform step 4 for each of the nodes. -6. Save and Activate the entire structure. -7. Now, Again go to the Planning Area of the Org structure. Enter DD.MM.YYYY1 (Old Date) in Effective from field and select Go button. -8. Go to the Timelines tab, of the topmost Org Chart node in the tree. -9. Change the Valid from field of the Org unit Manager and the employees assigned to DD.MM.YYYY (new date). -10. Save the changes and Activate the Org structure. --Now user could see the entire Org Structure's Valid from Date to DD.MM.YYYY (new date) which is the date as per user requirement.--Keywords-error message, timeline invalid, start date change, org structure, effective date, organizational management, org unit manager, employees assigned, planning stage, valid from date, activation, org chart, timelines tab, save changes, system error, invalid timeline

Title: Able to Create Supplier Even After Restricting Write Access to a Particular User
Content: Symptom-You as a Key User, restricted the Write Access for a particular user for creating Supplier from Business Partner Data work center. But still that user is able to create Supplier from Supplier Base and Payables work center.-Reproducing the Issue-In Application User and Management, for work centers BPM_SUPPLIERS, BPM_SUPPLIERSCENTRAL and BPM_SUPPLIERSFIN, No access is given for Write access.-Cause-In principle, a New Supplier can be created in four different work centers:--- Work center view Supplier in Work center Business Partner Data-- Work center view Supplier in Work center Supplier Base-- Work center view Supplier in Work center Payables-- Work center view Business Partner in Work center Business Partner Data (for create as scenario)--If an user has all these views (what will not happen very often) and you want to restrict the user not being able to create suppliers, you have to restrict all the four work center views . If you forget to restrict one of them you will see this by the way as well in the "business user authorizations conflict UI".-Resolution-The system work as designed.

Title: Error Message: Sales properties of () should be changed in future only.When the sales properties are changed in the past, reporting related to Sales may become inconsistent
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate a Organizational Structure, system throws below error message-Sales properties of () should be changed in future only. When the sales properties are changed in the past, reporting related to Sales may become inconsistent-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org Structure.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All.-Cause-The cause for the error message is might be because below reasons,-You  try to delimit the sales Properties of any Sales Organization, Sales Unit, Marketing, Customer Invoicing or Service Organization to a Past date.-You  try to delimit the sales Properties of any Sales Organization, Sales Unit, Marketing, Customer Invoicing or Service Organization to a Present date itself.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Sales Properties of any Org Unit should be delimited only on a future date but not on past date/present date. The system doesn't allow because, that will end up in inconsistent Sales Document.-So, you can delimit the Sales Property of an Org Unit to a future date.-Using Effective From Date:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective Date as on or after two days from current date (Ex: if the todays date is 13/7/2012, then the effective from date should be on or after 15/7/2012)-Highlight the Org Unit XYZ.-Go to Functions tab and uncheck the Sales Properties (Sales Organization or Sale Unit).-Now, the Org Unit's Sales Properties will end by Next day's date (Ex: 14/7/2012), which is a future date.-Now, you can able to activate the Org Unit.-Using Timelines Tab:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org Unit XYZ.-Go to Timelines tab.-Change the Valid To date of the Sales Properties to a future date (Ex: if the todays date is 13/7/2012, then the Valid To date should be on or after 14/7/2012)-Select Enter key in the keyboard.-Now, you can able to activate the Org Unit.

Title: Finish fulfillment of multiple contracts
Content: Symptom-You want to finish the fulfillment of multiple Contracts, but to complete it, you need to finish the Contract's fulfillment manually. You want a way to finish this fulfillment with a Mass Action(automated). -Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Service Entitlement-2. Select the Contract-3. Search for Contracts-4. You will see that there are a lot of contracts in process-Cause-This is expected behavior, Unfortunately currently we do not have a possibility to finish fulfillment of multiple contracts in mass from the UI.-Apart from this the finish fulfillment can only be done individually per contract.-Resolution-One option would be to get this done via a PDI add-in as the corresponding action in the backend is released for PSM.-Apart from this the finish fulfillment can only be done individually per contract.

Title: Changing Account Details In a Customer Contract
Content: Symptom-A Customer Contract is created for a specific Account, and later the Account information is changed in the same existing contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Select the Contracts view.-Select a contract and click Edit.-Under the General tab, observe that an Account is maintained with a specific address.-Change the account address after the contract has been created.-Go to the Account Management Work Center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open the account maintained in the contract.-Navigate to the Communication tab and open the Addresses sub-tab.-Click Add Row, maintain the new account address, and select the Main checkbox.-Save the changes.-Reopen the existing contract.-The updated account address is not reflected in the existing contract.-Cause-Once the contract is saved, any changes made to the master data will not be updated in the existing contract.-Resolution-There is no functionality to update an open/existing contract with changes made to the master data.-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Contract; Account Information; Existing Contract; Account Master Data; Account Address; Contract Update; Customer Account; Contract; Address Change

Title: Can we limit Journal Entry details access by removing the report navigation?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to know if it is possible to change or remove the navigation from the Cost Center - Line Items - My Area report, to Journal Entries, in order to restrict the access to managers confidential information as budgets/cost center statements.-Alternatively is it possible to delete the journals that have multiple cost center posting so that we can re-process as individual cost center journals?-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Cost Center - Line Items - My Area report with a specific User XYZ.-Variable Selection:-Company: Default-Set of Books: X-G/L Account (Origin): Y-Add the Journal Entries characteristic to the rows.-From the report the User XYZ sees all the Journal Entries for the Cost Center is restricted to.-If you navigate to a specific Journal Entry which has multiple cost center posting you will see that from the Journal Entry Line Items you can access posting related to different Cost center or G/L accounts on top of the one you are allowed to see.-In this case,  it looks like the User XYZ is able to navigate to a Journal Entry although the Journal Entry work center view is not assigned and consequently is able to see Journal Entries details related to other Cost Centers without restrictions.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed.-Resolution-The current system behavior will be analyzed to see if improvements are needed.-In the meantime an alternative approach would be to copy the Cost Center - Line Items My Area report from the Business Analytics work center and remove the Journal Entry characteristic in the copied report. This would ensure that-navigation to a JE cannot happen.--Once the new report is created, you can un-assign the old report from the desired work center and assign the new report to that work center.-Note: The Journal Entries which have been posted in the system cannot be modified or canceled in any way either from the frontend or from the backend due to Audit issues.--What can be done is to reverse the desired Journal Entry Voucher as this will reverse the postings by creating new cancelation Journal Entries although both the original as well as the canceled Journal Entries will still be visible in the report.

Title: ByD HTML5 Keyboard Shortcuts not Working
Content: Symptom-Keyboard shortcuts used in Silverlight do not work in HTML5.-Reproducing the Issue-e.g. Adding new rows in Sales Orders:-Log into HTML5 system.-Go to Sales Order and create New Sales Order.-Try adding a row with CTRL+Insert.- Cause-The shortcuts available in Silverlight are bound to Silverlight itself and cannot be used in HTML5.-Resolution-It is planned to implement HTML5 shortcuts in the future but it is not determined when.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/doc/saphelp_byd1708_en/2017.08/en-US/KTP/Software-Components/01200615320100003379/SAP_BBD/GS_GC/SAP_BBD_Getting_Started.html

Title: Rearranging Fields and Columns in Adaptation Mode in HTML5
Content: Symptom-When trying to change the sequence of columns or fields in any view, you notice that it does not work in Adaptation Mode.-Reproducing the Issue-This can be reproduced in any view, but for an example we use New Stock Order.-Open Outbound Logistics Control.-Go to Common Tasks, New Stock Transfer Order.-Click on your profile image.-Select Key user settings, Start Adaptation Mode.-Try to rearrange the sequence of fields and columns.-Click on Save and Publish.-You notice that the order reverts back to the original.-Cause-These changes are considered End User Changes, therefore they can only be adjusted in Personalisation Mode and not in Adaptation Mode.-Resolution-Instead of opening the screen in Adaptation Mode, go to Start Personalisation Mode. Once you are done with your changes, click on Save. The changes will be taken over but only for your user. This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Renaming of Certain Characteristics not Possible in Custom Reports
Content: Symptom-You want to know why you were not able to rename some of the characteristics in the report that you have created.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for any custom report.-Click on the Go button.-Find that the fields you want to rename are present in the format ABC(DEF) under Add Fields option.-Now edit the report using the Edit with Report Wizard option.-Navigate to Step 3: Select Characteristics in Report Wizard.-Search for the field: ABC by using the Show Filter Row option.-Find that the fields are not present.-Cause-This is designed system behavior. Renaming of characteristics (using Report Wizard) is possible only for the characteristic fields that come directly from the Data Source on which the Report is built on.-Lets say the custom report is built on the data source - XYZ (XYZ represents that name of the data source) and XYZ also has a standard data source - DEF as one of its constituent data sources. If the field which you want to rename comes from the data source DEF (DEF represents the name of a data source) and not from XYZ then it will be denoted as ABC(DEF) in the report where DEF refers to the standard data source DEF. And because these fields come from a different (standard Data Source) data source, these fields cannot be edited or shown while editing the report in the Report Wizard.-Resolution--Always check if the characteristic you want to rename comes directly from the data source on which the report is built on, if not then combine or join the data source with the one that has the required fields.

Title: Dump /Exception while Releasing Times Recorded in Edit Time Sheet
Content: Symptom-When you release the times recorded in Edit Time Sheet, system may throw the exception/dump.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview view.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Update the times and select the Release button and choose Release All.-System may throw the exception.-Cause-The exception is caused by inconsistent setup of the time account type XYZ in Business Configuration which is used by time recordings.-In the Business Configuration work center, if the time account type is configured as Recurring, but the Bookable To date is set to Unlimited, this configuration is suspicious and most likely not intended, because for a recurring yearly time account the new account instance is created each year so Unlimited in Bookable To does not make sense.-The reasonable configuration would be to set up the account type either as Permanent in the Creation field, or to choose the value in the Bookable To field to something like End of time account.-After changing account configuration in Business Configuration, it is normally required to trigger a time valuation correction run, as this cannot be done by the system automatically for all affected employees.-Resolution-You should double check the setting of Business Configuration for time account type XYZ, in particular the recurrence setting and the rule in the Bookable To field.-If you correct something in the Business Configuration, a correction run has to be performed for each affected employee, i.e. each employee who uses this time type for time recording. A correction run can be triggered as below:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select Run Day Closure for One employee and for mass process select Administer Day Closure Runs.-The correction run's start date should be the end date of the earliest account instance which is affected by the Business Configuration change, or earlier.-In a future release, system will throw some error messages rather than the exception for this case.

Title: Custom Title for Contact is not Synchronized with the Outlook Add-in
Content: Symptom-When synchronizing a contact with a custom academic title or title other than the six standard titles from MS Outlook it will not appear in the system or in Outlook. -Reproducing the Issue-Scenario 1-Open Outlook.-Navigate to Contacts.-Open existing contact or create a new contact.-In the contact detail view, click on Full Name button.-In the Title field, open the drop down menu and you will see six standard title.-You can remove the title with Backspace and replace it with any title like, Ph.D. or Dr. Prof. for example.-Synchronize this existing or newly created contact with the Outlook Add-in to your system.-Result: Under the contact, the title or academic title you have maintain in Outlook before is not appearing-Scenario 2-Open you system and navigate to your Contacts.-Edit any contact you wish.-In the Title, or Academic Title field you can select the standard or your customize title you have maintained in the Business Configuation work center.-Save the change and synchronize the contact to MS Outlook via the Add-in.-Navigate to contacts in Outlook.-Open the contact and you will not see the customized title or academic title.- Cause-The six standard titles or academic titles in Outlook are hard-coded by Microsoft . It is therefore currently not possible to enable customized titles to be synchronized to either your system or Outlook.-Resolution-You have to manually amend the contact with the customize academic titles or title in Outlook or in the system, after the synchronisation.-Please note: In order to choose a custom title in the contact, in your system, you have to first maintain this title or academic title in the Business Configuration work center:-Go to  Business Configuration work center.-Search for the term academic.-Open the result General Business Partners.-Navigate to either Maintain Academic Titles or Maintain Titles and open one option.-Here you can maintain your desired titles which will appear in the drop down menu in the title field or academic title field, for you contacts.

Title: No Warning or Notification, While Transferring an Org Unit Manager to Another Org Unit
Content: Symptom-After transferring an employee (also the Org unit manager) from one org unit to another org unit, the manager position is lost and also approvals were not be sent over to her/him anymore.-System didn’t notify, that he/she is an manager and no warning message stating that the approval processes will also not work accordingly.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-In the future release, A notification or a warning message will be shown while moving an org unit.-For time being you can follow the below workaround:-Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Select Org Unit which the transferred employee belongs to.-Remove the employee as the Org Unit Manager in the below tab General. Remember to assign any other employee in the org unit as manager if needed.-Save and activate the change.-After org structure change, you should be able to transfer the employee successfully.

Title: When Delimiting an Org Unit from a Hierarchy that Org Unit is Detached from the Org Strcuture
Content: Symptom-When you try to delimit an Org Unit, that Org Unit is detached from the hierarchy and showing as a separate Org Unit.-Further, while Checking the Consistency or while Activating the Org Unit, system may throw below error messages:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Profit Center XYZ () must be below a Segment. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit.-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Cost Center XYZ () must be below a Company. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Cost Center XYZ () must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit-Cause-There are different actions which may lead to the above issue, they are-Case 1:-If you try to delimit the Org Unit XYZ with Valid To date as DD.MM.YYYY, then the system by default takes the same Valid To date for the attribute Parent Organizational Units. If you manually change the Valid To date of attribute Parent Organizational Units to a date lesser that the actual date. Then the Org Unit XYZ will removed from the parent Org unit and will be shown separately.-Case 2:-If you change the Valid To date of the attribute Parent Organizational Units to a past date (with reference to the Org Unit valid To date), Then the Org Unit XYZ will removed from the parent Org unit and will be shown separately.-Case 3:-The org unit XYZ is marked as Profit Center from DD.MM.YYYY which is not allowed because there is an Org unit below this which is a Segment.-Resolution-The basic principle is that the Valid To date of the attribute Parent Organizational Units must be equal to the Valid To date of the Org Unit.-Hence, you need to maintain the Valid To date of the attribute Parent Organizational Units as same as the Org Unit.-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective From date as required.-Highlight the Org Unit XYZ and go to Timelines tab.-Scroll down to the last for the attribute Parent Organizational Units and change the Valid To date as same as Org Unit date.-In principle, a Profit center should be always below the Segment. You can either mark the Org Unit XYZ as Segment from DD.MM.YYYY or uncheck the Profit Center attribute of Org Unit XYZ from DD.MM.YYYY.

Title: Error Message When Trying to Post or Simulate Manual Posting - Complete Transfer of Individual Material
Content: Symptom-During a Manual Posting - Complete Transfer of Individual Material for Fixed Asset XYZ (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID) an error message is thrown:-'Posting Date must be before dd.mm.yyyy'. (dd.mm.yyyy represents the posting date).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Asset sub view.-Search for Fixed Asset XYZ.-Click the Manual Posting button and select Complete Transfer of Individual Material.-Maintain a Posting Date, Document Date and Fixed Asset Target ABC (ABC represents the Fixed Asset Target ID).-Click Post or Simulate.- Error message is thrown: 'Posting Date must be before dd.mm.yyyy'.-Cause-Fixed Asset ABC has an organizational change posting with posting date on dd.mm.yyyy.-Due to this posting, other new postings with posting date earlier than that are not permitted.-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets sub view.-Search for Fixed Asset Target ABC.-Click Edit and View all.-Navigate to Values tab.-Navigate to Journal subtab.-You find Journal Entry with Transaction Category 'Transfer Due to Organizational Changes'.-Resolution-The Complete Transfer Posting of Individual Material must have a posting date after dd.mm.yyy.-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-manual posting; complete transfer; individual material; IMAT; Transfer Due to Organizational Changes; Transaction Category; post; simulate

Title: Yield and Scrap Report Issue
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Internal Use Only-Yield and Scrap report (Standard) does not shows Production Order with status 'Started' or 'In Preparation'-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics Work Centre-2. Go to Design Report and search for "Yield and Scrap Report"-3. Run the report, you can see only those Product Orders which are either Closed or Finished -Cause-This is default behavior of the report which is being designed in the system.-It is intended to show only those orders which are Closed or Finished.-Resolution-There are 2 alternate solution here-1. Advise customer to create a custom report based on "Yield and Scarp" data source. To view the data for production order in started status, customer need to create a new keyfigure by the below steps :---- Navigate to select key figures->click create->give some name and select restricted option below->Select one key figure--- click next->select a characteristic as "Production Lot Status", restricted type as "variable"--- Click on Set default value selection -> To set the value for this Production Lot Status, then click finish--- Come back to report and navigate to "Select Key Figures", in the drop down select " all"--- Customer will have to then find the newly created key figure and finish editing the report.--- Preview the report this default key figure will be visible for further use.-2. Customer can also use Data Source "Production Orders By Header General Details" to view all the Production Order in which are in "Closed","Finished", "Started" or "In Preparation" status.-There is no standard report based on it. Hence customer needs to create a custom report based on same data source.

Title: Report "Sales Order Volume" the selection for the characteristic "Product Category" is not working
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-THIS DOCUMENT IS RESERVED FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY--In the report Sales Order Volume the selection for the characteristic Product Category is not working. For example, the Product Category as ABC is used in Sales Order. Later the Product Category is changed to XYZ in the master data of that product.-However, it would not anymore be possible to select this category ABC in the selection area. Rather XYZ would appear.- Reproducing the Issue-Open the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Reports List view.-Open the report Sales Order Volume and in the selection area add the product and product category.-The Product Category previously was ABC in Sales Order for Product A. Later the Product Category is changed to XYZ in the master data of that product A.-Now click on the value help for product category ABC. It would not be listed.-Entering it manually does not work either.-Cause--In Sales Order-Item-ItemProduct-Product Category is persisted in the database. (eg. ABC).-Later, if the product category is changed in master data (eg. XYZ), then in the Sales Order would still have ABC in backend. And the OVS for the Product Category in report, comes from the dimension Product, which is generic and retrieves data from Product Master data, not from Sales Order transactional data. ie. XYZ. Hence, in report XYZ would appear.-Reason of the limitation: Due to Performance, Sales Order-Item-ItemProduct-ProductCategory data is not retrieved.-Resolution-You can follow the following work around :-Open Sales Order-View All-Item tab.-Go to Adaptation mode-Go to Extension Field - Create (name it like 'Sales Order Product Category')-Choose Text field-Tick the checkbox Calculation-Select Product Category Internal ID from dropdown-Go to Further usage link-Add the new field to datasource - Sales Order Item-Edit and Add the field in report - Sales Order Volume (Web and Mobile, or Web only)-Add the field in the report using 'Add fields' from Dimension - 'Extensibility'-Save. Publish if required.-Unfortunately, for the already created Sales Order, this workaround would not be applicable.

Title: Wrong Allocation for Tax Payment Created Through Bank Advice
Content: Symptom-You notice that Payment allocation XXX generated from bank payment advice ID YY for Tax Authority AA shows incorrect Payment Allocated To status.-Despite choosing Tax Authority the payment is being allocated to 2 - Trade payables instead of 8 - Tax payables or receivables.-You open Payment Allocation XXX and click on view all, the following error message occurs:-Financial data of business partner AA (Tax Authority) not found-Payment allocation XXX remains in status In Preparation due to this error.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select subview Bank Payment Advices.-Click on New button on the top right corner of your screen and select Bank Payment Advice.-Fill out the necessary fields.-Choose Tax authority as Payer/Payee (Tax authority which is not set up as a supplier).-Mark the Posting Advice check box.-Choose Bank transfer for payment method.-Choose Bank account ID.-Click on release.-Click on View All button on the same bank credit advice after release.-Go to Document Flow tab.-Open the associated Payment Allocation.-Click on View All button.-Result: Following error message appears:-Financial data of business partner AA (Tax Authority) not found-And under chevron Customer/Supplier, in the Payment Allocated to section, the wrong allocation is assigned:-2 - Trade payables-The correct allocation should be:-8 - Tax payables or receivables- Cause-This issue is known and occurred with 1705 update.-The system does not recognize Tax Payments created through Bank Advices as Tax Payments and therefore allocates them wrong as 2 - Trade payables instead of 8 - Tax payables and receivables.-Resolution-This is a known issue and correction will be released with 1711 update.-The current workaround is to manually change the Payment Allocation to section.-In the effected Payment allocation do the following:-Open effected Payment allocation XXX generated due to creation of a Bank Advice.-Click on View All Button.-In Chevron Customer/Supplier, under Payment Allocated to section select 8 - Tax payables and receivables.-Match Allocation amount with Open Amount.-Click on Post button.-

Title: Interface error; WS-Runtime; AP-AM; Agent has selected more than one error message as fatal
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-There would be affected XI message in message monitor (srt_moni).-Error Information : Agent has selected more than one error message as fatal.-Other details of the incident: Program: CL_SPAF_INB_PROXY_ADAPTER=====CP Name of Method or Function Module: CL_SPAF_INB_PROXY_ADAPTER=====CM004 Package: AP_FO_ACTIVITY_PRX ; Interface error; WS-Runtime; AP-AM;-To cross verify:-Open the xml of the failed XI message.-Check the attribute 'ATTRIBUTES' - 'item' value-Make sure, the attribute 'ATTRIBUTES' - 'item' value is 'NAME-CONTENT'- Reproducing the Issue-This issue is reproducible.-Introduce a foirbidden character e.g. 'tab' in the Subject field of an email/appointment/task/calendar activity, then try synchronizing the same from Outlook to ByDesign system.-This error in message monitor would appear with a corresponding failed XI message.-Cause-Cause:-In the Subject field of the email/appointment/task/calendar activity, there is/are forbidden character(s) (Like 'tab'), which is/are not allowed by the system. This is an expected behavior.-And this system restricts the forbidden characters to be synchronized to the SAP system due to security.-Resolution-Please provide the details of the affected email/calendar/appointment/task activity to the customer or end user:-example:-Contact Person:  abcd@example.de-Subject or Name-Content: ExampleSubject -Creation Date: 2014-07-17T08:48:21Z-Solution: Please request the customer to edit and remove the forbidden characters (Like 'tab') from the email/calendar/appointment/task's subject.-Then try the synchronization. Now, the synchronization of the message would be successful.-As of now, the already failed XI messages would not get processed, because of the invalid character in the subject. Hence, need to be canceled.

Title: Reports Sent As E-Mail Attachment do not Open Directly From E-Mail
Content: Symptom-You want to know why the report sent As E-Mail Attachment cannot be opened directly from the Email.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open any report XXX (XXX represents the name of the report) which you want to send As E-Mail Attachment.-Click on GO.-Now click on Send and select the As E-Mail Attachment option.-User receives the report as an attachment to his/her E-mail but is unable to open it. The user has to save it to his/her desktop to be able to open it.--Cause-When sending the report As E-Mail Attachment, the system will use the report name as the file attachment name. There is a limitation in the file name at Microsoft side - 218 characters, so if the report name is too long, the report cannot be opened from the Email directly but has to be saved locally first.-Resolution-Use WinRAR/Winzip as the default application for .zip files to access the reports from the attachment.

Title: Unable to add KPI Evaluations or Create KPIs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL ONLY-Scenario 1: When you try to add or create a new Key Performance Indicator, you will get a blank screen and no KPIs is shown.-Scenario 2: You try to create KPIs but all buttons are greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario 1:-Go to the Work Center Corporate Performance-Go to view Key Performance Indicators-Click on Action > Open Evaluation Catalog > New > Evaluation-Scenario 2:-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design KPIs.-All buttons are greyed out.-Cause-Inconsistency in the KPIs Business Object.-Resolution-A) To check if the issue exists:-Open a backend connection-Open the BO test shell:  SESFTS-Type the BO name RCKFM_KPI-Run the query Select All or Query by Elements-If it shows null results : there is an inconsistency issue at backend.-B) To fix the issue:-Open a backend connection-Run the t-code SE37 in order to Execute the function module-Type the FM  RCKFM_REPLICATE_LA_KPIS-For IV_UNCONDITIONALLY_EXEC_IND you type  'X’- The KPI catalog should appeared afterwards to Key User.- You can redo the steps A, and at this time the BO query will show 24 entries.-See Also-1488916 - The Key Performance Indicator (KPI) monitor is not showing some defined KPIs-1645276 - Troubleshooting Tips for Issues Related to Key Performance

Title: The Added Favourite Work Center is Missing after Re-login in ByD HTML5 Client
Content: Symptom-Customer tried to add quick access of Work Center as favourite to My Launchpad via HTML5 version but favorites is disappeared after re-login the tenant.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Login HTML5 client.-2. Add One of the Work Center to My Launchpad page. (via the star sign next to the navigation list)-3. Logoff the system and Re-login-4. Newly added favorite disappeared.-Cause-In the HTML5 client, the shortcuts are added as a title to the launchpad in the Html5 client, then those shortcuts are not accessible anymore once the Launchpad is not selected or a different tab is open. This was different behavior form the Silverlight client, because in the silverlight client the shortcuts were part of the UI shell and therefore always accessible.-Resolution-In 1711 Html5 client, we will not add the shortcuts anymore to the Launchpad but to a dedicated point in the shell (again, as in Silverlight) and in addition we will transfer the already configured shortcuts from the Silverlight client to these new point in the shell as well (which is currently not considered in the Html5 client).-Adding shortcut-like tiles to the Launchpad will be possible as well, but only explicitly via personalization of the Launchpad itself.

Title: Launchpad Tiles do not Refresh Automatically
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-The data in the Launchpad tiles does not refresh automatically after you edit and save changes through a tile. -Reproducing the Issue-Log into system and open the Launchpad.-Click on any of the available tiles.-Edit any task, item, alert and change its state.-Close the window after saving.-Cause-Both Silverlight and HTML5 do not support the required function to automatically refresh the tile state.-Resolution-This is a known issue and has been added to the development backlog. No timeline is available yet.-As a workaround you can navigate to any other work center and then back to the Launchpad or refresh the page with F5.-

Title: Business ByDesign - Belgium Localization features.
Content: Symptom-The Belgium Localization provided as part of Business ByDesign has the below missing functions with respect to legal and tax reporting. Currently ByDesign does not support these reports and functions. As these are not critical for Go Live and are regulatory reporting or auditing requirements for year end the same would be provided as part of ByDesign in the up coming releases.--  XML-format for BELCOTAX-reporting of fiches 281.50.-- Inclusion of Unpaid invoice items in the BELCOTAX Returns for WHT (Currently relevant invoices which are paid are included)-- CODA Bank Statement format-

Title: Error Message "DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Segment XXX (Org Unit Name) must not be Below Segment YYY (Org Unit Name)" While Activating Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate an Org Structure, system throws below error message:-DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to DD2.MM2.YYYY2; Segment XXX (Org Unit Name) must not be Below Segment YYY (Org Unit Name)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Select Check button and choose Check All .-System throws above error message.--Cause-There are 2 possibilities which will cause this issue.-Cause 1: If you have maintained XXX and YYY both as segments during DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to DD2.MM2.YYYY2.-or-Cause 2: If you have maintained YYY as Profit centers above the Segment XXX.----Resolution-Solution 1:--It is allowed to have only one segment in a particular Org Structure for a particular Time period. So it is not possible to have 2 segments in one Org Structure.--If you want to uncheck any one org unit as a segment, then follows the below steps:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures.-3. Input effective date and select Go button.-4. Highlight the org unit and go to Definitions tab.-5. Uncheck Segment.--Solution 2:--A segment should always be above the profit centers or you can flag a segment as profit center and the segment definition should be set at company or business residence level.--Because segment collects the balances of all lower-level profit centers and offers additional financial reports to those provided at profit center level.

Title: The Opportunity Pipeline report does not show the Product ID
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-The content of Product characteristic is not shown in the Opportunities report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Analysis work center and then Reports view.-Open the Opportunity Pipeline Report report.-Move the Product characteristic from Not Currently Shown to the rows.-Not Assigned symbol is shown in the Product column for all or few opportunities.-Use the navigation target to open one of these opportunities that does not show Product value:- You will see that it can have one or more products maintained in the Product tab;- The same can be also valid for other Opportunities.-Cause-The product are not shown on the report because in Opportunity an existing product is not associated. Instead a product description is maintained with its associated product category. If opportunities are created with only user entered product descriptions (no product ID associated), then such products do not appear in the reporting. Only the product category will appear in reporting.-Resolution-This is as per system´s design.-See Also-Additional technical information:-If you check the secondary persistency for the BO OPPORTUNITY, the Product ID will also shows empty in the results as well as if we run the Query by Node ITEM_PRODUCT in the BO Test Shell t-code. The same is also noticed through of LISTMDAV from MDRS transaction, where the Product ID characteristic shows null values.

Title: Unable to Approve the Time Entries of an Employee due to System Exception
Content: Symptom-You, as a manager, try to approve the Time Recording of an employee but the system throws an exception.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Select Confirm Time Recording under Common Tasks.-Select Time Recording Approval task and select Approve button.-Cause-The cause for the dump is probably that the Time Account which is used for the Time Recording is a Recurring account and the Bookable To date is a high date (31.12.9999).-Resolution-If you want to use the Bookable To date as 31.12.9999, then you can use Permanent Account instead of Recurring Account. If you want to use Recurring Account, then you can use a Bookable To date which is reasonable.-To overcome the Exception temporarily, you can perform the Correction Run for the affected employee as stated below:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Enter the employee affected and select Start Time Valuation.-Select Run button.-On the popup screen, enter the Valuation Start date and select OK button. Note: The valuation start date should be set as far in the past as the earliest vacation record has been recorded.

Title: Start Day for Weekly Recording Time is not Reflecting Correctly
Content: Symptom-You have set a custom Start Day for Weekly Recording and this is not reflecting correctly in the Employee Time Sheet.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the view Overview-Search for the Activity "Default Values for Time Recording - <COUNTRY>" and open it-Set the field "Start Day" to a different day, then click on Save-Go to the Time Administration work center and access the view Time Sheet, under Time Recording-Select any employee under the country for which you've changed the Start Day and click on Open Time Sheet-On the first week that the Time Sheet is opened, the week is correctly set as per the defined Start Day-Click on the button to go to the Next or Previous Week-The period "From/To" will be reset to the standard Start Day.-Cause-This is a known issue by our development team.-Resolution-A correction is planned to be made available in a higher release.

Title: Missing Report View in Broadcasting
Content: Symptom-You want to know why the report View you created in the report is not available for selection while broadcasting the report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Broadcasts-Enter the Name, select Object Type,in this case it is a Report.-Choose the report from the value help under Object Name.-Fill in the details for Channel, Subject, Message.-Under the Recipients section, click on Add button and enter the To (E-Mail Address).-Under Format and Content section fill in the Format.-Click on the dropdown for View.-Cause-The reason why the View you had created in the report is not available for selection in broadcasting is because the View was not created from Business Analytics work center.-The View would have been created from any of the work centers to which the report was assigned to.-Resolution-Open the same report from Business Analytics work center and recreate the same View and Save it.-Now while broadcasting the report, the View will be available for selection.

Title: You See a XML Page When Log On Via SSO in Excel Add-in
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to log in SAP Excel Add-in you are presented with a XML page with SSO Navigation Container window.-Cause-The SSO configuration has not been done or completed in the system and hence when trying to logon with the SSO the Navigation Container will redirect to the logon page of the system (which is the XML content that you see).-Resolution-Please perform the configuration of the SSO environment in the system first.-Check Help Center documents:-Single Sign On

Title: Error Message: Load Workspace Scoping Model Failed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-User is trying to edit a Project scope and receives the fallowing Error Message: Load Workspace Scoping Model Failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects and select the project.-Open the Edit Scope.-The Error Message:Action Not Possible;Object Does Not Exist will be displayed on the bottom of the screen.-Cause-Configuration is layered by the solutions they belong to. Solutions are covered by layer strategies, the default being “LAYER_CUST” which includes all solutions installed in a tenant. In productive systems (production, partner dev, change test etc.) the workspaces have all installed solutions applied (which matches the layer strategy LAYER_CUST).-While business users have the default layer strategy LAYER_CUST, users may have been assigned a different layer strategy. For example, partner development users have a layer strategy only including the one-off solutions those users are developing.-When accessing a workspace (e.g. by Edit Scoping or Open Activity List) the system compares the user’s layer strategy with the solutions applied to the workspace and prevents modifications to avoid data inconsistencies during workspace upgrade. If that check fails, this currently results in the misleading error message “Load Workspace Scoping Model Failed”.-Resolution--Please verify with the customer if the user  in question is a development user.-If it is a development user , please recommend the customer to use a regular Business user.-In case the customer doesn’t know the type of user , you can check whether the customer user has layer strategy on APXR_SETTINGS table by using the case document :  1804115 - How To Check If The User Has The layer Strategy-If the user appears on the table, please recommend the customer to use a regular Business. Otherwise please forward it to BC expert to further analyze it.-

Title: Error Message: Cannot set Timeline of the Org Unit XYZ, Employee assigned from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate or end the Validity of the Organizational Unit XYZ, system throws below error message:-Cannot set Timeline of the Org Unit, Employee assigned from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY-Or-Timeline for org unit XYZ not allowed; employees assigned from DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to DD2.MM2.YYYY2 -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks-Select Org Unit XYZ-Select Edit Org Unit button and choose End Validity option-Cause-The cause for this error message is that, some Employee is assigned to the Org Unit XYZ with active Validity. To verify, follow the below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks-Select Org Unit XYZ-Go to Timelines tab-Here, you can find the Employee assignment for this Org Unit.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-It is not possible to delimit the Org unit XYZ, since it has Employee reference to it.-If you want to delimit the Org unit XYZ, then the Employee should be transferred to another Org unit in Personnel Administration work center using Transfer Employee in Regular tasks view.

Title: When Uploading or Downloading a Price/Discount List, the Items with Scales are Not Processed
Content: Symptom-When uploading or downloading a price/discount list, items with scales are not processed.-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite : The Price List XYZ has 3 items as follow :-Product ABC with no scale price maintained.-Product DEF with a scale price maintained.-Product EFG with no scale price maintained.-I. You would like to download the prices list XYZ to an excel file-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio-Go to the Pricing view-Select Prices List XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the price list)-Select Download-You can see that in the excel, only the products with no scale prices were downloaded : Product ABC and Product EFG.-II. You would like to upload new values for Product ABC, DEF and EFG to your master data in your ByDesign system-From Excel File user can Save Data back into your ByDesign system-Once you have upload the new values to your system, you realize that the scale for product DEF has been removed.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior in the current release.-Resolution-When uploading or downloading a Price/Discount List, items with scales are currently not supported.

Title: Excel Add-in Proxy Credentials Not Stored
Content: Symptom-When logging to Excel Add-In, the proxy settings for user name and password are not stored.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to Excel Add-In-On Add-In tab click on Logon-Click on Proxy Settings button-Fill the User Name and Password fields-Click OK-Close the Excel-When you open the Add-In again, the information is not stored-Cause-As these data are stored in machine's registry, this would cause security issues.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-You need to enter the credentials every time you logon to Excel Add-In

Title: Custom Crystal Report Cannot be Opened in ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom formatted report (this can simply be a copy of a standard report) containing formulas in Crystal Reports. In Crystal Reports you can open the report without issues. When you try to open the report in your ByDesign system you get an error message.-Reproducing the Issue-In the respective Work Center go to Reports > List-Open the respective report (for example Financial Statements - Two Years - Print Layout)-Edit your selection if applicable-Click OK-You receive an error message that starts with: JRC returned an error: […]-Cause-Many financial reports contain formulas, so when a copy of these reports is created the JRC (Java Rendering Configuration) is unable to map these formula fields in the copied report and hence it fails. The report might work in Crystal Report Designer, but will not work from the ByDesign Interface as the JRC links the ByDesign formatted report to the Crystal Report.-Resolution-You will have to create a new report similar to the one you want to copy and add the formulas manually in your custom report.

Title: Number of Organizational Units is Lesser Than What was Created in the Organizational Management
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User had created a Organizational Structure and activated it. But when checking other business process documents like Sales Order, purchase Order and so on, some of the Org Units are missing.-Cause-There 2 possible causes for this issue,-User might have not activated all the Org Units.-There might be inconsistency in the FSI data for BO /MOM/ORG_CENTRE.-Resolution-Compare the Org Structure in the Active Area and Planning Area to find out the inactive Org units and advice the customer to activated the Org Units.-If all the Org units are activated but still some units are missing, then reloading the FSI data for BO /MOM/ORG_CENTRE will resolve the issue. Forward the incident to Expert Support FSI for reloading.

Title: The Organizational Unit are Shown in the Accounts Workcenter
Content: Symptom-When creating levels in the Org structure, the twin accounts are automatically created. That is, Account is created in the Customers view and further, Business Partner is created in the Business Partners workcenter. Hence it cannot be set to Obsolete in the Business Partner workcenter. Even if changed to Obsolete, the Business Partner status remains Active.-Reproducing the Issue-1.  Go to the Business Partners work center.-2.  Go to the Business Partners View.-3.  Show Active Business Partners.-4.  Find the Business Partner ID: XYZ.-5.  On the OWL, select Change Status -> Obsolete.-     Your entries have been saved.-6.  Check the status of the Business Partner: XYZ and status is still Active.-Cause-The Twin Business Partner cannot be set to Obsolete.-Resolution-It is an expected system behaviour.-The Org unit in this case is a Company and is valid. As long as the Company stays valid in the system, the related Business Partner cannot be removed as you can execute certain business scenarios that requires the related Business Partner.

Title: Expense Amount Not as Expected
Content: Symptom-You create an Expense Report for a Business Trip with a duration longer than 24 hours.-Nevertheless the system calculates the Expense Amount only for one day.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports sub view.-Show All Expense Reports and find Expense Report XYZ. (XYZ represents the Expense Report ID)-Open Expense Report and navigate to the Dates and Locations on the General tab.-You see that the Trip starts on day X and ends on the following day Y. (X and Y represent the dates)-Navigate to Per Diems selection on the General tab.-You can see that only the Meals tick box is selected.-Navigate to the Review tab.-Under the Reimbursements and Expense Summary the Meal Per Diems amount is not what you expected.-  Cause-Since the Lodging selection box in the Per Diems area under the General tab is not marked the system cannot derive that the employee stayed overnight and hence summarizes the two days as only one-day business trip.-This applies to all overnight trips for which no hotel receipt is maintained.-Resolution-Navigate to the Expenses tab.-Add a new row with Expense Type Hotel.-Maintain 0,00 as the Expense Amount.-Click save.-Once you have maintained a hotel receipt the system can derive that the trip was overnight and deducts the correct Meals Per Diems amount.

Title: Error 'Failed to Get the Partner Top Folder Due to Wrong Lifecycle Setting' in Mashup Creation
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Mashup and when you Save the newly created Mashup you have the error: 'Failed to Get the Partner Top Folder Due to Wrong Lifecycle Setting'.-Cause-You have either Partners Workcenter or PDI Development Workcenter (and views) assigned to your user access rights.-Resolution-Please remove the Partner Workcenter and PDI Development Workcenter and views from your user:-Go to Administration Workcenter-Open Business Users View-Select user ABC(ABC refers to the user ID with the issue)-Click in Edit-Select Access Rights-Go to Work Center and View Assignment-Check Partners workcenter (CODPARTNERWC) and PDI Developmet (PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT)-Uncheck all related access rights from those views/workcenter-Click Save

Title: Company Settings are not Saved
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are not able to make any changes to the Company Settings.-Example: you navigate to Company Settings, open the General tab and try to disable User Personalization Features.-When removing the check mark and saving, the change is reverted so it's not possible to enable Personalization.-Reproducing the Issue-You navigate to Company Settings and do changes, but they are reverted automatically.-Go to Adapt.-Click on Company Settings.-Make any changes and click Save.-Cause-The DB table has become inconsistent.-Resolution-You need to make changes in the customer's backend system.-Go to Transaction SE16 and enter the table APUI_KEY_VAL-Please follow the steps in the below JAM page:-https://jam4.sapjam.com/profile/283186/documents/UM6LBcjUFEoYz2J8BrX0ZB/versions/13659662/slide_viewer

Title: Error Message: Availability Confirmation - XYZ - Replenishment lead time must be greater than avail.check horizon
Content: Symptom-When you try to Mass Change Availability Check Horizon for list of Materials, system throws below error message:-Availability Confirmation - XYZ - Replenishment lead time must be greater than avail.check horizon-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select the required materials. -Select mass Change button.-Select Availability Confirmation in the Show field. Enter the Availability Check Horizon in the empty cell below the header column Availability Check Horizon and select Enter key in the keyboard.-Select Apply Mass Change button and choose All Items.-Cause-The Replenishment Lead Time must be greater than Availability Check Horizon.-The benefit of entering a replenishment lead time is that you obtain a confirmation date that does not move, as opposed to the confirmation date of the check horizon. The reason for this is that the system determines the end of the replenishment lead time by adding the replenishment lead time from the product master to the current date, taking into account the working day calendar of the ship-from location. When the product availability is checked again for the same order a few days later, the system uses the order entry date as the current date and not the “real” current date. In this way, the end of the replenishment lead time stays the same and your confirmation date remains stable.-By defining an availability check horizon, you specify the number of days (today plus a certain number of days) within which the system checks the demand against the supply, taking the working day calendar of the ship-from location into account.-By defining a replenishment lead time, you specify the maximum length of time required for the in-house production or external procurement of a product.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Tax Advisor Function Austria/Switzerland Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY - You are not able to select Tax Advisor for Austrian or Swiss companies under company tax arrangements.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to WoC Tax Management.-Subview Tax Authorities --> Company Tax arrangements.-Select and Edit any company based in Austria or Switzerland.-Go to sub tab Tax Return Arrangements.--Result: There is no option for Tax Advisor selection.-Now go back to Subview Tax Authorities --> Company Tax arrangements.-Select and Edit any company based in Germany.-Go to sub tab Tax Return Arrangements.--Result: The option for Tax Advisor selection is available.-For Austrian/Swiss companies, will all have same results. Germany has the option.-Cause-When the U30 periodic VAT return in Austria is submitted via xml to the tax authority's portal by the tax advisor and not by the customer him/herself, the current VAT return xml does not work.-The tax advisor has his own FON (FinanzOnline Login https://finanzonline.bmf.gv.at/) tax portal account and over this account the upload of the customers' VAT returns are done.-Due to data-privacy and -protection point of view it is seen as critical if the tax advisor would upload the xml with the customer's FON portal account, hence for the case the tax advisor is uploading the VAT return xml some information is missing (the VAT number of the tax advisor and the customer information field) in the file.-For the localization of Germany it is possible to configure a certain tax advisor and also a separate VAT number for the electronic upload, but for Austria/Switzerland not.- Resolution-This functionality should have been implemented into ByD in 2009, however was never implemented and therefore is seen as a legal gap.-This is currently treated as a new requirement and will be developed in one of the future releases!- See Also-https://sapjira.wdf.sap.corp/browse/GSCBDACH-411

Title: Error Message "BO or BO node mismatch" while Exporting Material into Microsoft Excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to export Materials into Microsoft Excel, system throws below error message:-Error ID: AP_UI_OIN 074-Error text: BO or BO node mismatch-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product data work center.-Go to Material view.-In the Show option, select All Materials.-Select the button Export and choose To Microsoft Excel.-Choose language and Select Download.-Cause-The cause for the issue might be because of inconsistency in the configuration schema of the customer specific template.-The UI list on which excel export is configured will have a BO and BO node associated with it. In excel export there will be a comparison of this BO and BO node with the BO name and node name in the configuration schema of the excel template.--In this case, there was a mismatch in the BO name which was causing the problem.-Resolution-The inconsistency needs to be removed in the backend. Forward this incident to SRD-CC-OIN-XL.-

Title: Some of the Sales Units are Missing in Work Distribution Rules Sales units for Sales
Content: Symptom-Work Distribution Rule Sales Unit for Sales doesn’t show all the Sales Units, when you try to assign a rule for that sales unit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Work Distribution and choose Organizational Work Distribution.-Edit the Work Distribution rule sales Unit for sales.-Select Add Row button and select the value help for Organizational Unit.-Where the required Sales units are missing in the value help pop up.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-When maintaining work distribution category Sales Unit for Sales, it is only possible to select a sales unit if it is below a sales organization.--You have to do one of the following:-Make the sales unit as a sales organization-Make a superordinate org unit a sales organization-Move the sales unit below a sales organization in the org structure.

Title: Is it Possible Change the Root Product Category to Lower level?
Content: Symptom-You have created a Product Category Hierarchy and would like to know whether it is possible to change the root Product Category to lower level.-Resolution-It is not possible change the position of the ROOT product category. This is because if you change the root, it may result in an inconsistent hierarchy.

Title: Materials Disappears while changing to Planning view in Mass Change
Content: Symptom-After selecting some materials for Mass Change, when you navigate to Planning view, Only few materials are available or all the materials are disappeared.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select some materials.-Select Mass Change button.-A new screen opens, Select Planning option in Show field.-Only few materials are available out of the selection or all the material are disappeared.-Cause-If the material is in the status Initial for Planning, then the material will not appear in the Planning view of the Mass Change.-Resolution-In Planning view, you can only find materials with Planning status Active and In Preparation. If the Planning status is Initial or Not Started, then the materials will not be displayed.-If a particular material have 2 Planning Area IDs and both are in Active or In Preparation status, then both the planning area ID will be displayed in the planning view.-So, if the material is not active for Planning then the material will not be displayed in the Planning view of the Mass Change.

Content: Symptom-In Edit Time sheet, Advanced Search is not working in the Select Activity popup window, whereas Basic Search is working properly.-     Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Services view and the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link under Time section.-Select the value help icon of Activity field.-Select the Advanced link, enter keyword in the Activity Description field. System returns No Records found whereas for the same keyword Basic search returns the correct result.-Resolution-This is expected behavior.
