Title: Warning Message: “Retrieving reports and Data Sources is failed. User XYZ not authorized to extend analytical reports”
Content: Symptom-When you try to assign an Extension Field to a particular report, system throws below warning message:-Retrieving reports and Data Sources is failed. User XYZ not authorized to extend analytical reports-Reproducing the Issue-This issue will occur in the Adaptation mode of any work center, view or any screen. For this document, let assume the issue occurs while adding an extension field to a report associated with Accounts.-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select All Accounts in Show field and select Go button.-Select Adapt and choose Edit Screen option.-Select Extension Fields pane in the side bar.-At the bottom of the Field Properties, select Further Usage link.-A window opens up with the above warning message.-Cause-User has no authorization for Business Analytics work center.-Resolution-To add an extension field to a report user requires authorizations provided by the Business Analytics work center. -Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select User and Access Management view.-Select Business Users sub view.-Highlight the user, Select Edit button and choose Access rights option.-Go to Work Center and Work Center Assignment tab.-Highlight Business Analytics work center and select Assigned to User check box.-Select Save and Close button and accept the warning.-Log off and login again, so the changes will reflect for the user.

Title: Error message "Posting date DD.MM.YYYY not valid. The earliest possible posting date is DD.MM.YYYY" when trying to clear a document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You try to clear a document but, when trying to do so, you are faced with an error message about the posting date: "Posting date DD.MM.YYYY not valid. The earliest possible posting date is DD.MM.YYYY"-Reproducing the Issue-This issue can be seen either on a Process Communication Error in Work Centre Application and User Management as in BCP incident 3500321623 or when trying to clear a Payables or Receivables Invoicing Document as in BCP 3100998737.-First scenario:-Open the Customer Invoicing Work Centre-Open the  Invoice Document View, show all-Search and select Document ABC, click on Edit-Navigate to the Document Flow-A Process Communication Error is displayed on document ABC: Customer Invoice ABC cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)-  Open the Application and User Management Work Centre-Open the Business Data Consistency View and subview Process Communication Errors-Open Errors with Incidents-The following message is displayed: Posting date DD.MM.YYYY not valid. The earliest possible posting date is DD.MM.YYYY-Second scenario:-Open the Payables Work Centre-Open the Work View, show all-Search and select the task related to clearing document DEF-Open the task Review and complete clearing DEF for supplier MNO - 0.00 XYZ (where XYZ is the transaction currency), the Manual Clearing DEF windows opens-Click on the Clear button-The following message is displayed: Posting date DD.MM.YYYY not valid. The earliest possible posting date is DD.MM.YYYY- In both cases, if you try to manually change the posting date, the error message remains.-Cause-According to development, this is a known issue that happens while trying to manually clear invoices if the system does not consider the posting date displayed on the UI and determines another one. If there exists any invoice having that different posting date on the tax register, the error message is raised.-In normal scenarios, the posting date of the invoice should not persist in the tax split lines of the tax register and be considered while clearing the items.-Resolution-This issue requires manual backend corrections from development and the incident needs to be sent to component AP-DUE-TRX after having required approval for backend corrections from the customer.-You can also further check the following transaction to confirm that this is the issue at hand:-Business Object impacted is FOPXD_TAXRPREG as can be seen in transaction SESFTS:-1. Go to Test shell, sesfts.-2. BO : FOPXD_TAXRPREG-3. Load by query=>query_by_comp_basebtdref-4. Give Business transaction document Id (invoice) impacted-5. Navigate to TAXRPPSP-The difference in Tax dates should be visible from there-See Also-Two scenarios have been described in this case document, however, variations can be seen in the following BCP incidents:-- 3500229788, 3100911493 & 3100869735: Issue appears in the Receivables Work Centre , View Customer Account - Trade/Receivables, when trying to clear an Invoice-- 3500228715: Issue appears in the Payables Work Centre , View Supplier Account - Trade/Receivables, when trying to clear an Invoice

Title: Corrupt Migration File
Content: Symptom-This Issue is Very Specific to the French User due to French Standard Translation, during Migration Activities.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects-3. Search for Migration of XYZ-4. Migrate XYZ using the Migration Tools-5. Select You Can Also, Adapt Migration Object-6. Download Migration Template-7. Save The Template and Open Template-Cause-The Header Name of Each Sheet (as listed in the last template sheet) are Being Used to Make up the Sheet Labels that you Have in the Template File When Opening it in Excel. Now These Sheet Labels can Only Have 31 Characters.-If the Sheet Header is Longer Than 31 Characters, Then it is Simply cut Automatically at the 31st Character When the Template is Being Generated.-As Long as the Abbreviated Label Names (First 31 Characters) are Still UNIQUE , This Will Work.- Resolution-Customer Will  Have to Manually Create a File With Modified Labels. As for the Upload not the Actual Label Name is Relevant, but the Technical Sheet Name Which you find in the Hidden Line 4 or 5 Sometimes.

Title: Error Message "Sales Data: Instance with the same key already exists"
Content: Symptom-When you try to Account Mass Change for Sales Data of selected Accounts, system throws below error message:-Sales Data: Instance with the same key already exists-Note: You are assigning Sales Organization/Distribution Channel to the Accounts using Mass Change. This can be performed by using Remove from Worklist in Step 1.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Mass Change Account Data under Common Tasks.-In the find text box enter '*' to display all Accounts.-Select Add to Worklist button and choose All Accounts and select Next button.-In Step 2 (Change Accounts), select Show and choose Sales Data from Dropdown.-Enter values for  Sales Organization and Distribution Channel in the Mass Change row.-Select Apply Mass Change button and choose All Accounts.-Select Finish button.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that there are some Accounts which already have a Sales Organization/Distribution Channel assigned to it.- Resolution-Please performone of the following workarounds as per the requirement:-1. As a workaround, you can do Mass Change only for the Accounts, for which Sales Organization/Distribution Channel is not assigned.-2. Follow the steps below to Mass Change all accounts:-    a) Go to Mass Data Maintenance workcenter.-    b) Export all data for the relevant accounts from the system.-    c) Make the required changes in the CSV file.-    d) Upload the CSV file again.

Title: Standard Rate for Withholding Tax is Zero for France
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Pay button is disabled on the withholding tax return.-You also notice that the standard rate is zero and cannot be changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Tax Returns view.-Go to Withholding Tax Returns sub view.-Show Reported Tax Returns.-You notice that the Pay button is disabled for Tax Return ID XYZ.-Cause-For country France, Withholding Tax Rate depends on supplier and not on income type as for most of the countries.-Hence, the Withholding Tax Return is simply a reporting tool, and nothing is calculated.-A DAS2 file is generated, and you can submit it to the required tax authorities.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior for Withholding Tax Return for country France. -Keywords-tax return, withholding tax return, France, Withholding Tax Rate, DAS2 file

Title: Monthly Report Run for RG1 Excise Report does not return accurate results.
Content: Symptom-When you run the monthly report for RG1 Excise Report of India, the opening balance does not return accurate results.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Click List under Report.-Open RG1: Excise Register - India.-In the new screen that appears, under Selection, select date range from begining to end of a month.-After you run the report, immediately or scheduled, the opening balance provided in the result is not accurate: The system runs the report for the whole period the item is in the system instead of the month. Hence, the result is displayed for the whole period the item is in the system and not for the month user has selected.-Cause-This is current SAP ByDesign system behaviour: The report displays data for the whole period the item is in the system instead of the specified time the report is run for.-Resolution-Go to Tax Management work center.-Click List under Report.-Open RG1: Excise Register - India.-In the new screen that appears, under Selection, select date range for the entire period the product has been involved.-After you run the report, immediately or scheduled, the opening balance provided in the result is now accurate.

Title: Dashboards visible in Silverlight differs of the Dashboards visible in HTML5
Content: Symptom-You might come to realize two situations in regards to the visualization of Dashboards in Silverlight in comparison with HTML5 mode:-The most of Dashboards available for assignment in Silverlight are not visible in HTML5 mode. -The standard sub views: Executive, Manager, Representative are only available in Silverlight mode and its content is null.-Reproducing the Issue-For the Issue 1-You have assigned different Dashboard Views in the Analysis Work Center for a particular user, however in HTML5, some of these views are not seen.-In the Dashboard for HTML5 platform, you can only visualize 4 sub views: Pipeline Sourcing, Pipeline, Sales Performance and Win/Loss but you can not see for example: Forecast, Forecast Variance and Sales overview as in Silverlight mode.-For the Issue 2- The standard sub views: Executive, Manager, Representative are only available in Silverlight mode and its content is null,-Log on Silverlight mode-Go to Analysis Work Center-Go to the sub views mentioned-There is no data as well as the same sub views are visible only in Silverlight mode.-Resolution-For the Issue 1-The Sub Views listed for assignment in COD_ANALYSIS, do not has connection with the Dashboards available in HTML5 and does not matter what View Box you check there for assignment. it will only make effect for the Silverlight View mode.-For the Issue 2-It's is system behavior. The Sub Views are used for special purpose, and they have been deprecated for the later releases. Therefore, you should not use them anymore.

Title: HTML5: Dashboard Does Not Show Columns With 0 Value
Content: Symptom-You have created a report that uses the setting Show Master Data for the field ABC. This means that even if there are no key figure values for some entries of the field ABC, all the entries will still be shown. You then set this report to be displayed as chart, and create a dashboard on it.-You notice that in the HTML5 dashboard, the report chart does not show the master data for the field ABC, but instead only those entries are shown for which there are key figure values.-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to HMTL5 and go to the work center Analysis, view Dashboards.-Select the dashboard DEF (it contains the report chart with the master data setting).-The chart only shows a few entries, not all of them as you would expcet due to the Show Master Data setting. -Cause-There is a limitation in the HMTL5 UI, with regards to dashboards and the report setting Show Master Data. If characteristics are added to the columns (rather than rows), master data attributes are not displayed in dashboards.-Resolution-If you really need the Show Master Data setting in your dashboard, there are several workarounds for this behaviour:-The same setup works fine as a table. You can change your report display to the table view.-Move all characteristics to the rows, and only keep the key figures in the columns. Please note that if you have several characteristics in the rows, the one showing the master data should be shown last (i.e. at the bottom of the characteristic list or to the very right in the table).-You can also display this dashboard in RUI, since the limitation is specific to HTML5.

Title: Checks that can be done when Analytics objects are missing after system copy/move/upgrade
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For some reason, such as tenant copy/move or system upgrade, you have noticed that some Analytics objects (report views, reports, data sources or key figures) are missing in the target system. Which means, the standard objects were in the source system but they are not present in the target system.-Cause-Different causes can exist behind the customize Analytics objects missing, the most common is due to one of the aforementioned actions done in the system.-Resolution-Firstly: Check from UI perspective if the report objects are there:-Check if the report name or ID can be found in the Business Analytics > Report View-Check if the data source name or ID can be found in the Business Analytics > Design Data Sources-Check if the key figure can be found in the Business ANalytics > Key Figures-Secondly: Check from backend perspective if we have the entrie of this object in the Analytics tables-Check if the DB Table still exist;-Check if Metadata is listed in the MDRS tcode-Check if MDAV's entry exist in the abap table: MDRS_X_MV_ROOT-Check if MKFC's entry exist in the abap table: MDRS_X_AP_MKFC-Check if MKDS (report views)  entry exist in the abap table: MDRS_X_MKDS_ROOT-For extension fields, check if the object exists in the abap table: MDRS_X_AEXT_ROOT-For Cloud Data Source, check the storage tables: MDRS_X_MMDD_ROOT and MDRS_X_MMDD_VELS-Please forward the incident to ANA ES queue in case you have not found references in order to investigate it even further.

Title: Bill of Exchange or Purchase Account Tabs Missing from Account Determination Profile
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that for some Account Determination Profiles information is missing such as the Bill of Exchange or Purchase Account tabs for Subledgers Cash and Inventory, respectively.-Reproducing the Issue- 1. Go to  Business Configuration  Work Centre- 2. Open the relevant  Implementation project - 3. Open the activity list and select the Fine-tune tab- 4. Search for and open the activity  Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination- 5. Navigate to  Account Determination, select the Cash subledger - 6. Select the relevant Account Determination Profile-You can see that the Bill of Exchange tab is missing.- 1. Change the subledger to Inventory- 2. Select the relevant Account Determination Profiles again-The Purchase Account tab is missing as well.-Note: The Settlements tab can also be missing from the Cost subledger  as well as the Deferred Output or Input Tax columns from Output Tax and Input Tax from the Tax subledger.-Repeat the same steps with the Costs and Tax subledger if the Settlements tab and Deferred Tax columns are missing-Cause-This is the expected behaviour if the relevant country hasn't been assigned to the impacted Account Determintation Profile(s)-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Workcenter.-Implementation Project-Click on the Open Activity List button, navigate to the Fine-Tune activities tab.-Search for and open the activity Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting structures, Account determination-Under Account Determination, open the Cash subledger.-Select the impacted Account Determination Profile-Click on the Assign Countries to Profile button-In the opened prompt, cick on Add Row and add the desired Country-Save the changes.-Go back to the Cash subledger and check that the Bill of Exchange tab for the respective Account determination Profile is displayed- Assigning the country to the profile should solve all the issues relative to tabs or column missing in one step.

Title: Unexpected Tax Rate in Customer Invoice on Services delivered outside the EU
Content: Symptom-A sales order contains the material and the delivery service sold by a company in France (European Union) to a private customer (natural person) in the US.-The material is exonerated from VAT. However, the standard 20% VAT is applied to a service.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work center.-Go to Common Task - New Invoice Request view.-In Items tab, enter two items as follows :-Item XX - Material - Tax Code : 523 - Export - Goods to non EU and non DOM.-Item YY - Service - Tax Code : 510 - Domestic Sale - Service, Standard Rate. (XX and YY represent the line item numbers.)-You can see that material item is subject to 0% VAT and service item is subject to 20% VAT.-You expect the VAT for the service to be the same as for the material : 0%.-Cause-This is linked to EU Tax regulations, specifically Directive 2008/8/EC.-From the Help Center Document: "Master Data for Tax Determination" :-Certain services are always taxed at the head office of the company that provides the services, even if these services are provided for an account located outside the borders where the head office is located. In the master data records of such services, ensure that nothing has been entered in the Tax Exemption Reason field on the Taxes tab, and that the Taxable at Destination indicator has not been set.-According to the Directive and its implementation under the Annual Tax Act 2009 from January 1, 2010 onwards, this is the basic rule for services that are provided for a private end consumer located outside the borders where the head office is located.-Resolution-This is normal system behaviour related to EU legislation.-VAT applies when the service is shipped to a natural person - private account. However it does not apply when the service is shipped to a corporate account.-

Title: No Filter Available for Parameter States in Organizational Work Distribution Rules
Content: Symptom-In Organizational work distribution rules, you are not able to search the States or Pincode selection using the first letter and also there is no filter option available in the UI to search from the long list.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-Select Work Distribution view and select Organizational Work Distribution.-Select Sales Unit for Sales and select Edit button.-Select the Rule name row.-Go to States or Pincode tab below the section Rule Details.-There is no filter to search from the long list.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution- Search of States based on first letter and filter option are known, this feature will be considered for one of the higher release of Business ByDesign.

Title: Data Changes in Supplier Are Not Being Logged
Content: Symptom-You noticed that some specific changes you do in Suppliers are not registered on Changes tab-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center-Select Suppliers view-Edit any Supplier-Do some modification in supplier data (e.g: Add new company in Financial Data->Payment Data)-Save the changes-The changes were not registered in Changes tab-Cause-There is a technical reason behind this. -For the records on change histories, not all business partner data (or supplier data) are recorded for change due to performance and data payload reasons.-The mentioned communication data for business document setting is not part f the data which are recorded for change history.-Resolution-The behavior of data recording in Changes tab is not the same for all set of supplier data. For this reason, some kind of data will be recorded in change tab but some will not.-For example,  Bank Detail belongs to a node of Supplier and in this case it will be recorded.-Payment data is a separate component which is only bound to supplier via association for which the creation operation is not set for change document, so it will not be recorded in Changes tab.

Title: Cannot Request Logon Certificate in Internet Explorer
Content: Symptom-Requesting a logon certificate in Internet Explorer 11 with Windows 8.1 and above is not possible.-Reproducing the Issue-Open a ByDesign or Cloud for Customer system.-Go to Personalize.-My Settings and open Manage Certificates.-Click on Request Logon Certificate.-Enter your credentials and click Request Certificate.-After this nothing happens and no browser logon certificate is created.-Cause-Since the upgrade to Windows 8.1 the increased security settings of Microsoft prevent the certificate to be generated. As this is a Internet Explorer specific limitation, the developers already informed Microsoft about this, but as of now there is no permanent solution for this issue.-Resolution-As a workaround the logon certificate can be requested in Mozilla Firefox and imported to Internet Explorer.-After requesting a certificate go to the Firefox Options.-Click on Advanced and Certificates.-Open the Your Certificates tab and backup / save the certificate locally.-Once you are done with this, go to the Internet Explorer options, Contents, Certificates and Import the previously saved certificate under Personal.

Title: Sales Order approvals are not part of the Manager Approvals App
Content: Symptom-You are not able approve Sales Orders on the Manager Approvals App but are able to view and approve this within your SAP Business ByDesign System.-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to the Manager Approvals App.-Select Approvals.-Sales Order which has to be approved cannot be found in the Manager Approvals App.- Cause-As of now Sales Order approvals are not part of the Manager Approvals App.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.-As a workaround, approve Sales Orders from your SAP Business ByDesign system in the Managing My Area work center.

Title: Key Figures displayed with decimal places on the Home Page
Content: Symptom-The value of the key figure is shown along with decimal points when added as tile to home page but the key figure is set to display in the report without decimal places in the key figure settings.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Home Page-2. Navigate to key figure added to the Home Page-3. It shows the values including Decimal places-If you check the corresponding report:-i. Go to Business Analytics Work Center-ii. Open this report-iii. Navigate to key figure Settings> Specific tab-It will be set to 0 (no decimal places)-Cause-This is standard behavior on Home page.-Resolution-The key figure being shown with decimal places on the Home Page though you have selected not to display the decimal points for the key figure in key figure settings in the report, as it is designed behavior to show the exact value including decimal points.

Title: No calender in the value help for the field Changed On in the standard report Supplier Details
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The selection made for the field Changed on from the Value Help is not applying on the report result when trying to filter for the standard report Supplier Details.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analysis Work Center-2. Go to Design Reports View-3. Open the report Supplier Details-4. Title: New Supplier Part number not Populating.
Content: Symptom-New supplier part number which is maintained in the product master data is not populating in the Purchase Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to Purchase Orders view.-Show all Purchase Orders & select the relevant Purchase order.-Navigate to Items Tab & Choose Basic Data sub-tab.-Supplier Part Number maintained in the master data is not reflected.-Cause-The Supplier Part Number which is visible in the purchase order is fetched from the contract against the relevant supplier. The part number which is maintained in product master data will not be displayed in the purchase order.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Therefore we need to create a new contract for a new supplier part number to be fetched in the purchase request/purchase order.-

Title: Error Message "File could not be Parsed Successfully" While Importing .txt File in Languages Other Than English Using Mass Data Maintenance Work Center
Content: Symptom-When you are importing .txt file in Mass Data Maintenance Work Center in Language other than English system throws below error message(s).-"File could not be Parsed Successfully"- Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Mass Data Maintenance Work Center-2. Select Export Materials Link-3. Select Export to CSV File-4. Update the Material ID as 奥林巴斯ECHO用HOO for Language Chinese-5. Import the CSV file-Cause-The cause for the error here is that the .txt file which is getting uploaded is not encoded in proper format while saving it in the system to support other lanuages other than English- Resolution-While uploading the file with .txt format, make sure that Encoding of the file of type UTF-8 ﻿whle saving the file. If you upload the .txt file with the encoding type UTF-8 then characters in other languages will not be replaced with zunk characters.

Title: Application Error During Migration of Customer Contracts
Content: Symptom-During the migration of customer contracts you receive the message Application Error in Simulation Step-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration and select Implementation Projects view-Open the activity list of your project-Search for activity Migration of Customer Contracts-Open with migration tool-Execute the migration step by step-You receive the message Application Error-Cause-The error might be happening because you entered an invalid material in template or invalid sales unit.-Resolution-Enter a valid Product and Sales Unit in your template. This means, a Product and Sales Unit which exist in your system.

Title: Not Able to Choose Terminated Company in Organizational Management in Reports
Content: Symptom-You try to choose a company in various reports, e.g. in report G/L Accounts Line Items - however, this particular company does not come up in the value help.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center -Choose the Reports - List view-Use an asterisk <*> and search for g/l accounts-Click on report G/L Accounts Line Items-Under company, you cannot select company ABC-You can leave the other values as default-Cause-The Valid To date in work center Organizational Management is in the past. You have to change the Valid To date in work center Organizational Management to a date in the future. Reports show only the companies which are valid at the moment.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center-Select the Org Structures view-Find the respective company and press Locate-Press Edit-Click Timelines-You see a value for Organizational Unit which is valid to dd-mm-yyyy. This should be changed e.g. to Unlimited-Choose Save-This should bring up the respective company as selection in the value help Company of the report e.g. G/L Accounts Line Items.-

Title: Implementation of FRS 102 - UK
Content: Symptom-According to legal requirements, the FRS 102 financial reporting standard applicable in the UK and Republic of Ireland came into effect on January 1, 2015. Therefore, FRS 102 is effective for accounting periods commencing on or after January 1, 2015. With FRS 102, the titles of the required financial statements are specified, however, other titles can still be used and companies can retain existing terminology, for example, to keep the title “Balance Sheet” instead of changing it to "Statement of Financial Position".-For FRS 102, the following applies in your SAP Business ByDesign solution:-The balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement provide the basis for preparing the financial statements, in accordance with FRS 102. Existing templates have not been updated.-There are no specific reports provided for the Statement of Comprehensive Income and Statement of Income and Retained Earnings due to the nature of the underlying transactions. This information can instead be prepared from data already provided by your solution. - Resolution-In the SAP Business ByDesign solution, you can use data provided in the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement to prepare the required financial statements in accordance with FRS 102.-You can also prepare the Statement of Comprehensive Income and Statement of Income and Retained Earnings using relevant data already provided by your Business ByDesign solution. -Note:-The Statement of Comprehensive Income is a combination of the profit and loss account and the Statement of Total Recognized Gains and Losses.-The Statement of Income and Retained Earnings combines data from the Income Statement, Statement of Comprehensive Income, and the Statement of Changes in Equity into one statement. However, this is only possible if the only equity changes in the given year are for profit and loss, payment of dividends, correction of material errors for prior periods, and the effects of changes in accounting policy.

Title: Invoice Request Missing in Data Source Sales Ledger Line Items
Content: Symptom-You are creating a report or data source based on the data source Sales Ledger Line Items. You would like to see the Associated Invoice Request and the Associated Invoice Request Item but you notice that the invoice request is always shown as unassigned (#).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Data Sources.-Search for the data source Sales Ledger Line Items.-Click on Preview.-Add the fields related to the invoice request, for example Associated Invoice Request ID-You will see that is shows unassigned (#).- Cause-Due to technical reasons, the data source Sales Ledger Line Items cannot show the invoice request information.-Resolution-If you need to see details about the invoice request, please use another data source, for example Profitability : Invoice Profit or Profitability Management.

Title: Excel Add-In in Microsoft Office Starter Versions
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The SAP Excel Add-In can not be used in Microsoft Office Starter editions-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite: The "Starter" version of Microsoft Excel 2007 or Microsoft Excel 2010 is preinstalled on the computer. The version of Microsoft Excel can be determined by following the instructions provided by Microsoft under https://support.office.com/en-us/article/What-version-of-Office-am-I-using-932788b8-a3ce-44bf-bb09-e334518b8b19?ui=en-US&rs=en-US&ad=US-Navigate to the "Additional Software" window via Work Center Home, View Self-Services Overview, Link Install Additional Software-Download the SAP Add-In for Microsoft Excel by clicking on the Download-Link below the description-Open the downloaded file and follow the installation wizard steps-When you launch Excel after the Add-In installation, the SAP-Business ByDesign Ribbon is not shown-Cause-Microsoft Office starter versions are feature-reduced versions of the Microsoft Office 2007 and 2010 applications including Excel, designed to introduce users to the Microsoft Office suite. As the aim of the starter versions is mainly to convince users to buy a full version, they are lacking several features, including the support for Add-Ins. All limitations are listed on https://support.office.com/en-us/article/Excel-features-that-are-not-fully-supported-in-Excel-Starter-0982b3f1-7bca-49a7-a04b-3c09d05941d4?CorrelationId=d5fead87-db47-452d-acf2-5bef7d969a4b&ui=en-US&rs=en-US&ad=US.-Hence, it is not possible to use the SAP Add-In for Excel with Microsoft Excel Starter.-Resolution-As this is a limitation of Microsoft Excel, we cannot provide a resolution. The only way to make Add-ins work is to license a fully featured version of Microsoft Excel.

Title: Past Org Structure Not Reflected in Report
Content: Symptom-You are viewing a report which shows the hierarchy of profit centers. -You see transactions assigned to profit center ABC (ABC stands for the name of the profit center) even though you expect them to be assigned to profit center DEF.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report from the assigned Work Center e.g. report Cost Centers - Line Items from Work Center Cost and Revenue-Set up hierarchy for profit centers by clicking Add Fields and selecting Display as Hierarchy for Profit Center (Dimension: Journal Entry > Journal Entry Item)-You see key figure values assigned to profit center ABC even though you expect them to be assigned to DEF-Cause-The key figure values you are checking were posted against the organizational unit GHI.-At the time of the transaction the organizational unit GHI was subordinate to DEF, today however it is subordinate to ABC. -If you run the report today it will reflect the Oranizational Structure that is valid today.-Resolution-Currently our reports always show data reflecting the organizational structure as valid today. -It is unfortunately not possible to pull a report that reflects historic organizational structures.

Title: Open Items Receivable/Payable Cannot be Migrated on the Opposite Credit/Debit Side.
Content: Symptom-You are performing the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data and notice that payments that are migrated as part of Open Items Receivable/Payable are always migrated as positive amounts on the respective credit/debit side, regardless if it was maintained as a positive or negative value in the migration template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the Fine Tuning Activity "Migration of Accounting Transaction Data" either via Overview or an open Project that contains the activity.-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Mark the Migration Unit in question and click Execute Migration-Select Migration Object "Open Items Receivable" and attach the the file containing an item with Document Type "Payment" and a negative value.-Proceed through all further migration steps as instructed on-screen to complete the process.-After finishing the migration, you see that the manually entered "-" sign has been ignored and the migrated item has a positive value when viewed in the Customer Account Monitor.-Cause-The system uses the Document Type rather than the leading sign to determine the credit/debit side of the item. As a result, the migration of a negative payment on Accounts Receivable (such as a return payment) is not possible.-Resolution-We recommend either settling the item in the legacy system before migration or recreating the item afterwards via these steps:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Open the Customer Accounts view, locate the Account in question and click View.-Click on New Charge/Credit and configure the payment as desired.

Title: Missing G/L Accounts In G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You cannot see all the G/L Account in Search option of G/L Account Characteristic in  G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center  -Go to Reports - List View-Search for the G/L Accounts - Line Items Report-Click on Search option for characteristic G/L Account.-Here, you can not see the list of G/L Accounts-Cause-Due to some technical issues, the FSI view for G/L Account is not updated. Hence, you don't see the data as expected.-Resolution-Kindly send the incident to ES - Tech queue to perform the reload of FSI View : FSP_FIN_GLACCOUNT.

Title: Work Center not Visible after Activation and Scoping of the Partner Developed Solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You as developer have deployed activated the PDI Solution into a system.-However when you look for the work center in order to assign it to your user in editing of access rights view, the work center does not appear in the list for selection.- Cause-As developer your user is assigned to PDI_DEVELOPMENT and therefore configured as a developer user.-This kind of users have restrictions when it comes to the frontend usage of the system.-Resolution-It is highly advised by SAP that PDI developers always use one user to develop and a separate business user for testing.-This will not only prevent this issue but others you might stumble upon during your testing.-

Title: Personalized View Is Ignored In Excel Workbook
Content: Symptom-You may experience that a personalized view in an MS Excel workbook is ignored and instead the default view of the report is considered. In such a situation even though the name of the personalized view is displayed actually the default view of the report is shown.-Cause-This is due to a current limitation. Nevertheless please note that this situation only arises if there are mandatory parameters needed and if these are kept blank.-For example: A report view which is not the default view requires a mandatory parameter on variable Project (Note: Such parameters are shown with an asterisk / *). If you create a workbook based on such view and do not enter any value for Project before saving the workbook the next time you open and refresh it there will be data shown from the default view of the report.-Resolution-You can bypass this limitation by giving valid parameter value to all mandatory variables.-If this for some reason is not feasible users should be made aware that they have to reselect the same view (click on the view name from the dropdown list of the report views) to see the data for the personalized view.

Title: ERROR:Reference Object Node Sender Technica lID missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A2X web service requests have a node called ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID which can be used to correlate response where cardinality of request nodes. Its useful for external clients to match the request nodes with response nodes.-When sending a SOAP request to a Inbound Web Service of the system, the customer receives a response with errors.-Customer reports issue that the ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID is not returned for all error messages.-Example: -<Item>-<TypeID>044(/FOP_PAYADV/)</TypeID>-<CategoryCode>INC.BOI</CategoryCode>-<SeverityCode>1</SeverityCode>-<ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>3</ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-<Note>Payment allocation failed</Note>-</Item>-  <Item>-<TypeID>116(/FOP_PAYAL/)</TypeID>-<CategoryCode>INC.BOI</CategoryCode>-<SeverityCode>2</SeverityCode>-<Note>Payment amount not allocated completely; check the open amount (78.39 AUD)</Note>-</Item>-Cause-This is a system limitation.- Resolution-This will happen for any A2X which has error messages sent by different Business Objects. The messages from the second object won't return a ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID node.

Title: No Corrective Tax Posting when Clearing Bad Debt Invoice due to Insolvency
Content: Symptom-A customer of your Canada-based company is unable to settle an invoice due to insolvency and you need to reflect this in SAP Business ByDesign.-To achieve this, you follow the directions provided in SAP Help Portal article Reserves for Bad Debt, subsection Writing Off a Receivable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You proceed to manually clear the customer invoice as follows:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Open the relevant customer account.-Select the document to be written off and click Clear Manually.-In the New Manual Clearing screen, use S01 - Insolvency as Payment Difference Reason and post the clearing.-Although the help article mentions that "The VAT amount is corrected on the basis of your country settings", you can't see any corrective tax postings in the resulting Journal Entry or a subsequent VAT Return Run.-Cause-This functionality has not been implemented in all country versions of SAP Business ByDesign.-Among others, Canada is currently not supported.-Resolution-For countries where this functionality is not yet supported, any tax corrections for insolvency-based write-offs would need to be performed manually according to the country-specific regulations.-We recommend using a New Journal Entry Voucher to do so.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Reserves for Bad Debt-Keywords-bad debt; insolvency; VAT; corrective tax posting; writing off

Title: No Labor Resource Found for Project Confirmation When Internal Employee Releases Time Entry On Project Task
Content: Symptom-When you, as an internal employee, release time entry on project task, you may encounter the error No labor resource found for project confirmation.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview view.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Record time on a project task.-Select the Release|Selected Period button then the error message No labor resource found for project confirmation may appear.-Cause-When you record time on a project task, the system needs to determine the cost rate which is defined in Labor Resource Rate in order to post the expense to the project. If the system cannot find the employee's corresponding cost rate based on his/her Cost Center and Job ID, error message No labor resource found for project confirmation is thrown.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to create employee's labor resource rate:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Select the Master and Data view and Resource sub view.-Select the New button and Labor Resource. -Make sure to open the value help and search for Cost Center ID to which employee belongs and the same for the Job ID to which the employee's belongs to.-Fill in other fields and select the Save and Close.-The newly created labor resource should appear in the list. Select it and choose the Edit button.-In the Valuation tab, you can adjust the settings such as Cost Center Assignments, Cost Rates and Job Assignment as needed.-Please make sure the labor resource's Valid From in Valuation should not earlier than employee's Time Agreement's Valid From:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the employee and choose the Edit button.-Select the Time Profile tab. The current Time Agreement's Start Date must be earlier than or equal to the labor resource's. If it is not the case, you need to adjust Start Date in employee's Time Profile and/or labor resource's Valuation accordingly.-After valid labor resource rate is defined, when employee records time on a project task, the corresponding cost rate will be retrieved based on his/her cost center and job ID. The costs (cost rate times recorded time) will be posted to the project then.

Title: Error In GR/IR Run : Fiscal year YYYY And Period MMM+1 Not Open For Company ABC And Set Of Books XYZ
Content: Symptom-When you execute the GR/IR run for Period MMM / Year YYYY, you get the error for the Later period(s).-Error : Fiscal year YYYY and period MMM+1 not open for company ABC and set of books XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center-Select GR/IR Clearing Run view-Search for the Run ID-Click on View-Go to Data Selection Tab-Here note the Period/year for which GR/IR run was executed. For example Period 007/2014.-Go to Messages Tab-Here you will see the error message : "Fiscal year YYYY and period MMM+1 not open for company ABC and set of books XYZ." This error message will be displayed for later period (For example : period 009/2014)-There are no subsequent document(s) posted in the later period (i.e after period 007/2014 till current period) for the documents processed in the GR/IR clearing run.-Cause-In the Processed with errors tab of the GR/IR run, you can find the purchase order for which error is raised. Material used in the purchase order is using the cost method as Moving Average. There are postings in the later periods for this material and there are revaluation to be posted due to GR/IR clearing run. System tries to adjust the values of all later periods. If system does not recalculates the price for the later periods, and only calculates for the period for which run is executed, price of material in later period will be inconsistent. -In order to calculate and post the revaluation, periods should be open However the these period(s) are closed for the operational posting and hence GR/IR Clearing run throws the error.-Resolution-You can use the report : Material inventories - line item to see all the posting for the Material.-In order to execute the GR/IR clearing run, You need to open all the future periods where there are postings.-Step A : Opening the period-Navigate to General Ledger work center-Choose Set of books and assigned companies sub view-Select the company and click on open and close period-Select the respective period-Open the period for operational postings-Also check the process control maintained for the period and if required create a process control entry by following below steps.-Step B : Adjusting the process control if required-Navigate to General Ledger work center-Choose Companies sub view-Choose the Company ID with Set of Books ID-Click on Set Process Control button-Click on Add row-Enter the values as below-Process Control Status : 1 - Not Blocked-Business Process Group : 01 - All-From Posting Date : DD.MM.YYYY (for example : 01.09.2014)-To Posting Date : DD.MM.YYYY (for example : 30.09.2014)-Entry Possible Until : DD.MM+1.YYYY (For example : 15.10.2014)-The period of the From Posting Date / To Posting Date always refers to the posting date in the source document. Posting date the document should be in between From posting date and to posting date.-Entry Possible Until : The date in this field refers to the entry date in the source document. You can allow, for example, that a source document can still be entered for a period after the accounting period has been closed as long as the document has a posting date within the accounting period.-After Opening the period and maintaining the Process control Settings, execute the GR/IR run again.-See Also-Help Center Document:-Process Control for Operational Postings-Open and Close Accounting Periods-

Title: Cannot Close Activity "Confirm Milestone: Solution Accepted" in Test System
Content: Symptom-You cannot close the activity Confirm Milestone: Solution Accepted in the test system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Project view-Select the project and open activity list-Open the activity Confirm Milestone: Solution Accepted-The tick box for closing activity is grayed out-Cause-In a test system, certain activities including "Confirm Milestone: Solution Accepted" are disabled, because you cannot go live with a test system. You have to maintain these configurations in productive system and go live in that system.-Resolution-Perform this activity in the productive system

Title: Unit of Measure Not Translated in Excel Reports
Content: Symptom-You open a report in Excel using a logon language other than English. Here you notice that the units of measure are displayed in English, although your logon and Excel language are set up differently.-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to the system in your preferred language (other than English)-Go to the work center and view that your report is assigned to-Open your report in Microsoft Excel-You notice that although the report is shown in your logon language, the units of measure are shown in English, for example HUR for hours, EA for each, etc. You expect the units of measure to be shown in your logon language instead.-Cause-This is a limitation of this functionality.-Resolution-When opening the report in Excel, only the English descriptions of the unit of measure can be shown. The reason for this is partly because it is needed for further calculations, pivot tables etc. Additionally, only the ISO standard units with 3 digits can be shown, so a description longer than 3 digits would not fit. If you would like to see the unit of measure in another language, you have 2 options:-You can view the report in the browser instead of Excel. In browser-based reports, the unit of measure is displayed according to the logon language.-Otherwise, please open the report in the browser first. Then click on Download and Report in Microsoft Excel in XML Format.

Title: Dashboard Report does not Respond
Content: Symptom-The system response is affected whenever you select a custom Dashboards report where the Pie Chart is defined as the Chart type.-Reproducing the Issue-Open system on HTML 5.-Go to Analysis Work Center-Go to Dashboards Sub View-Select the dashboard from the drop-down menu-The system becomes unusable and the symptom may vary.-E. g. If you try switch the tab, from Dashboard to Report and then Report to Dashboard the screen gets blank as well as the overall response looks affected.-Cause-The reason is because you have set the report view as Pie Chart with more than one dimension and more than one key figure. It doesn't qualify for pie chart type and the HTLM 5 cannot render the graph in a proper way. The report view Opportunity Pipeline Detail Report (Campaign Dashboard) is configured two times in this dashboard with different variants and dimensions (campaign and source and two key figures). The pie chart originally only works properly with One dimension set for characteristic and key figure.-Resolution-You have the option to, either change the Chart type of the desired report view or adjust the dimension to be compatible with Pie Chart.

Title: Background job failed due to FSI, system roll issue or any other system specific dumps
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Background job gets failed due to system inconsistencies-Reproducing the Issue-Execute transaction SM37 (job log).-Type in one of the given parameters: Canceled Job Name (Job UUID) or User Name-Adapt the date of occurrence to the given one.-Select the canceled job and select the Job log.-Now you can see the error information and the time of occurrence in detail.-Also you can find the related dump in the job log or you can also look for the related dumps in ST22.-Cause-The jobs failed because of system inconsistencies around the execution time. In such incidents ,usually the background jobs get failed due to memory related dumps i. e. System_No_Roll etc,FSI / TREX related dumps etc.-Resolution-It seems the dump is related to system inconsistency during the time this was run, these are sporadic in nature and there is no impact on business because of these dumps (since the subsequent executions do a kind of self-heal).-If the job is periodic then kindly reschedule the job and check the run or wait for next run,and if the job is non periodic or event triggered and failed due to the mentioned issue then-Check 1 -> Check if the dump is amongst a series of other dumps (FSI, System Roll Issue or any other system specific dumps) around the same time when this dump occurred. If, so ignore this dump.-Check 2 -> If Check 1 shows that there are no surrounding dumps, then check if the job has failed continuously for at least 5-6 times in a 2 week period (or if the dump is old, then check for the recent weeks jobs). If this is the case, then forward the dump to AP-RC-RAA  queue for analysis - with a comment saying that these checks were done.-See Also-Related message numbers are:-3500182717, 3500186100, 3500185187, 3500185175, 3500185322-For Ex : Background job 00163E07FF441EE4878025C35456AEEC failed-The internal session was terminated with a runtime error (see ST22)

Title: Is it Possible to Add Sales Documents or Purchasing Documents as an Attachment in an Account?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to add Sales Documents (Sales Order or Service Orders) and Purchasing Documents (Contracts or Purchase Orders) as an attachment in any Account. So, you would like to know whether this is possible in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Account Management work center.-2. Select Accounts view.-3. Edit an Account and go to Attachments tab.-4. Select Add button and choose File.-5. In the dropdown box for Document Type, you can only find Business Card, Business Partner Image and Standard Attachment.-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-You may consider using the following workaround:-If an Account is used in any other business transaction documents (ex: Sales Order, Sales Quotes, Contracts, etc,.) then you can note down the document IDs in any word documents like Notepad or MS Word. Later you can attach it to the particular Account as a Standard Attachment.-Note: It is possible to have only the pre-delivered Document Types.

Title: Error Message: Only one default address permitted for org. centre XYZ () from DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1
Content: Symptom-When you try to check or activate an Org Unit or Org Structure, system throws below error message:-Only one default address permitted for org. centre XYZ () from DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight Org Unit XYZ.-Select Check or Activate.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that for the Org Unit XYZ, Main Address is maintained more than once for a same period of Time, which is incorrect.-Resolution-Case 1:-If you have maintained Time Period for Main Address of an Org unit as below:-Main Address - 01.10.2012 to Unlimited--Main Address - 01.11.2012 to Unlimited.--So for the time period 01.11.2012 to Unlimited, the same address is maintained more than once. This is not allowed which is expected system behavior.-To resolve the issue, follow the below steps:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures.-3. Highlight Org Unit XYZ.-4. Go to Timelines tab.-5. Scroll down to Addresses Attribute.-6. Change the Valid To date of the first row of Main Address to a date which doesn't overlap with the next row's Valid From date. This will ensure the continuity of the address.-7. Check and Activate your Org Structure.-For Example:-Main Address - 01.10.2012 to 31.10.2012--Main Address - 01.11.2012 to Unlimited.-Case 2:-If you have maintained Time Period for Main Address of an Org unit as below:-Main Address - 01.11.2012 to Unlimited--Main Address - 01.11.2012 to Unlimited.--So for the time period 01.11.2012 to Unlimited, the same address is maintained more than once. This is not allowed which is expected system behavior.-To resolve the issue, follow the below steps:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures. Note: The effective from date should be Valid From date of the both address which should be same.-3. Highlight Org Unit XYZ.-4. Go to Address tab and remove the country which you do not want and press ENTER key-5. Scroll down to Addresses Attribute.-6. Navigate to Timelines Tab, you should see only One Main Address which is the desired address with Valid From: 01.11.2013-7. Set Valid From as desired then Check and Activate your Org Structure.

Title: How to Find Employee's Cost Center Manager Who Is Different From Reporting Line Unit Manager
Content: Symptom-You, as a personnel administrator, find that the Manager field in employee's personnel file actually shows the Reporting Line Unit manager of the employee, who may be different from his/her Cost Center manager.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Highlight an employee, select the Edit to open the Personnel File of the employee.-Where the Manager displayed in the General tab is the reporting line unit manager, not the cost center manager.-Cause-The org unit defined in the Organizational Management work center may have several Definitions. Some org units can be reporting line unit, but not cost center, or vice versa.-Resolution-The system shows employee's reporting line unit manager in the personnel file of the employee, not cost center manager. Follow the below steps to find employee's cost center manager:-Go to the Resource Management work center.-Select the Resource Search view.-Enter employee ID in the Find and select the Go to get the employee.-Select the View button.-In the popup, you can see Cost Center under Organizational Data.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Org Structures view.-Select the Find button to locate the cost center.-Select the below General tab, the Org Unit Manager is the manager of the cost center.

Title: Use of the "Total Net Value Change percentage’ condition in PO reapproval.
Content: Symptom-A new condition ‘Total Net Value Change percentage’  for approval in purchase order is provided to control the re-approval based on Net value change.-If this condition is used to control the approval then it should not be used as the only condition in a group. It should always be used in combination with some other condition like "Total Net Value" in the group.-If the condition ‘Total Net Value Change percentage’ is used as the only condition in a group then there will be a discrepancy in the results in case of purchase orders which are being sent to the supplier for the first time.-   Reproducing the Issue-Edit the approval process for Purchase orders :-Open Application and User Management work center-Under task Distribution header, Open Approval Process view.-Copy existing approval process for Purchase Orders.-Select the condition: "Total Net Value Change Percentage" and select the chosen operator and percentage values.-You also need to add and define another condition in the same condition group, for example : "Total Net Value" for the system to correctly apply the condition.

Title: User with Read and Write Restriction to View all Accounts Would be Able to Select and View in Activity or Opportunity. However, write restriction works.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Limitation - User with read restriction to view all accounts, would be able to select and view in Activity or Opportunity.-However, it would not impact the authorization while document creation, since system would not allow to save with a restricted Account. Since, the write restriction works as expected.- Reproducing the Issue-e.g. Employee MC2471 is read and write restricted on Account MC9785, but not on Account MC6049.-Hence, while creating a New Activity or New Opportunity, employee MC2471, should ideally be able to select the Account MC6049 in the Account Value Help.-But as of now employee MC2471 can select both Account MC9785 and Account MC6049 from the Value Help.-However, system would not allow employee MC2471 while, she select Account MC9785 from the Value Help. Since, Account MC9785 is restricted.-Cause-Business Partner need to enhance query with access restriction parameters. Which would be applied in the Account Value Help. This do not exist yet.-Resolution-Business Partner and Account Management would work towards the read restriction enablement.

Title: Cannot Issue Intrastat Declaration File for Country Italy
Content: Symptom-You cannot generate the intrastat declaration file for Country of Declaration = Italy. The button Issue Declaration File is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Intrastat.-Go to the view Intrastat Declarations.-Select a released intrastat declaration with Country of Declaration = Italy.-The button Issue Declaration File is missing.-Cause-In Intrastat solution for Italy, the system does not support yet the automatic generation of declaration files.-Resolution-You need to use the Excel Export functionality and declare the goods in the appropriate format manually:-Open the declaration file.-Go to the tab Items.-Choose Export -> To Microsoft Excel.

Title: MDAV based on BO MAT_SUPPLY_DEMAND_VIEW
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-MDAV which are based on BO MAT_SUPPLY_DEMAND_VIEW faces performance issues if the number of records being fetched are more than 25000.-Reproducing the Issue-If customer has maintained more than 20000 products relevant for planning area and tries to fetch all of them using MDAV based on BO MAT_SUPPLY_DEMAND_VIEW then system takes couple of minutes.-Cause-The cause of the performance issue is that the BO MAT_SUPPLY_DEMAND_VIEW is based on Livecache. And when we try to retrieve more than 20000 records from livecache it takes lot of time.-Resolution-Please try to restrict your query in such a manner so that the records fetched are not more than 25000.-Another thing which customer can see whether he really requires so many products with planning relevant.

Title: Handling Inbound Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document guides you to analyze the Inbound Error: BO reference missing or not valid that occurs after performing the health check incident from Process Integration (PI) 17.-The PI message for the Service Interface SAPSupportRequestProcessingSoftwareProblemReportingIn fails with the above mentioned error.-The transaction SRT_MONI (till FP2.5: SXMB_MONI) displays the following information-Web Service Utilities: Message Properties Screen-Note: You can display the screen by double-click on the failing PI message.-    Cause-The issue is caused by the fact that during a tenant copy, all SAP_SUPPORT_REQUESTS (SSR)  been deleted. However, SPR_SOFTWARE_PROBLEM_REP (SPRs) has not been deleted. When an old SPR, which does not belong to the new tenant is canceled or completed,  a message is sent to the corresponding SSR, which has been deleted during tenant copy. This leads to the inbound error on SSR. If the specified issue is confirmed, the failing PI message can be deleted or terminated. To verify this, perform the following steps to verify the issue: -Check if the SPR ID exists in this tenant.-Check if the SSR ID exists in this tenant. -Check the message header in the failing PI message. -Check the current tenant ID and its Build History in Service Provider Cockpit (SPC).-From XML, the following information can be determined:-SPR ID-For inbound errors on service interface SAPSupportRequestProcessingSoftwareProblemReportingIn, SPR ID is displayed in tag <ID> in <ServiceRequest> field of the XML.-Check if the SPR ID exists in the current tenant, where the issue occurred through the transaction SSPR_ADM. You can also view the TimeStamp.-SSR ID-For inbound errors on service interface SAPSupportRequestProcessingSoftwareProblemReportingIn, SSR ID is displayed in the tag <SellerID> in <ServiceRequest> field of the XML.-Check if the SSR ID exists in the current tenant, where the issue occurred through the transaction SESFTS and the Business Object (BO) SAP_SUPPORT_REQUEST.-Note: Use ROOT ,select QueryByElements and then select ID = SSR ID-       3.  If the SSR ID does not exist in the current tenant, the message Query returned 0 Records is displayed.- Note: If the SSR ID exists, the information in the document is not the appropriate workaround. You must forward the issue to the Development Support team.-Message Header-When an A2A message is sent locally within a ByD tenant, SenderBusinessSystemID and RecipientBusinessSystemID is set to _LOCAL_SYSTEM_ALIAS_SAP_INTERNAL_CONSTANT_VALUE_. -The SPR ID-SchemeID differs from the SSR/SellerID-SchemeID. This indicates that the Central Help Desk (CHD)scenario is active and that this A2A message will be sent from one ByD tenant to another tenant. The SenderBusinessSystemID and RecipientBusinessSystemID will not be filled with _LOCAL_SYSTEM_ALIAS_SAP_INTERNAL_CONSTANT_VALUE_.-Current Tenant ID and its Build History in SPC -Determine the current tenant ID through the transaction SE16 and database Table TENANT for your tenant/client/mandt: This is stored in field VIRTSYSNUMBER.-Check the Build History in the tenant fact sheet of the corresponding SPC.-Thus, the SPR was created before current tenant was built. SPR still exists in current tenant but SSR not. SPR sends A2A message locally, but tenant ID of SSR (SellerID-schemeID) is not identical to current tenant ID.-As the SPR was not deleted during tenant copy, the failing PI message can be canceled or terminated.- Resolution-Cancel or termination of failing PI message -1. If the PI message cannot be canceled, as the option Cancel is deactivated, select Technical View.- 2. Navigate to the sequence monitor using the Sequence ID.-3. Select Hard Sequence Termination.- 4. Select Yes in the following screen to confirm the hard termination of the sequence. -5. Refresh SRT_MONI / SXMB_MONI. The message Canceled is displayed in the Processing Status field.-General Handling of Health Check Incidents -As the health check PI 17 incident is listing one issue for one service interface and one type of problem, you must resolve all failing PI message for the mentioned service interface in the related tenant.-This can be done using the transaction SRT_MONI and the following settings:-Timestamp from                       01.01.2000 / 00:00:00-Timestamp to                          31.12.9999 / 23:59:59-Processing Status Group             Erroneous-Interface Name                        SAPSupportRequestProcessingSoftwareProblemReportingIn- Created by BYDMS-KB-XI

Title: Error Message: User is Registered as Partner Developer.No Authorization for Migration
Content: Symptom-When trying to access any migration activities, system throws the error message User is registered as Partner Developer. No Authorization for Migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Go to Integrate and Extend tab.-Select any migration activities and open the migration tool.-Observe error message 'User is Registered as Partner Developer. No Authorization for Migration.'-Cause-The cause for the issue is the tenant is setup with the Partner Development Role.-Resolution-1. Migration activities are not permitted in tenants set up with the Partner Development role.-2. Deploy solution to a test tenant and perform migration-related activities there. -Keywords-Permission denied, Insufficient privileges, Access rights, Security role restriction, role-based access control, RBAC, development tenant limitation, data migration blocked, migration access denied, bydesign permission issue, partner developer restriction, cannot open migration tool, security settings for migration, move solution to test system

Title: Copy not allowed; source and target system have different add on versions
Content: Symptom-When you try to Copy a solution profile from a tenant to another you get the follwoing error message:-Copy not allowed; source and target system have different add on versions-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go Service Control Center work center;-2. Go to Systems view;-3. Select source instance;-4. Click on Copy Solution Profile button;-5. Source system is selected;-6. Choose your respective solution profile;-7. Select respective tenant as Target System;-8. Click Ok;--Cause-In these systems there is one or more solutions implemented.-Resolution-In order to be able to copy solution profiles source and target systems have to have same solutions implmemented with the same version.-Therefore you have to contact the person who created the solution in order to deploy same in both systems.

Title: Cannot Delete Org Unit because There Is Employee Work Agreement Reference
Content: Symptom-You want to delete an org unit and have removed all employees from the org unit. But you get the error message when try to delete the org unit:-Deletion of org unit ABC not allowed; employees assigned from D1.M1.Y1 to D2.M2.Y2-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Find and locate the desired org unit. -Select Edit Org Unit button and choose Delete.- The above error message may appear.-Cause-You cannot remove an org unit as long as there exists some reference to a terminated employee. One employee was hired on D1.M1.Y1. His reporting line unit is the being deleted org unit and his work agreement was terminated on D2.M2.Y2.-Resolution-The solution is to remove this reference first by doing a transfer on the employee's hire date and then delete the org unit:-Go to the work center Personnel Administration.-Select the view Regular Tasks.-Select the link Transfer Employee.-Select the respective employee, enter Transfer Date to his hire date and Org. Unit to any org unit you want to keep.-After the employee is transferred to another org unit and the reference to the being deleted org unit is removed, it will be possible to delete that org unit.

Title: Although the Status of the Business Partner is Blocked or Obsolete, It is still Available for Selection
Content: Symptom-When you try to assign a Business Partner to an Account or a Contact, you have observed that the Value Help of Business Partner field lists all the Business Partner, even if the status is Blocked or Obsolete.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Contacts view.-Edit any Contact.-Select the value help for Business Partner.- Cause-The system is designed in a way that usage of Business Partner will not consider the status. Because It might be that you want to complete the data of a blocked/obsolete account before you unblock/active that again.-Here is the evaluation of status of Business Partner:-In Preparation: It is not possible to use the Business Partner in any other business transaction documents.-Active: All business documents are allowed to create references with this status value. This status value is a prerequisite for the consistency of the reference.-Blocked: Business documents are only allowed to create new references with this status when they can save inconsistent data.-In contrast, if the Business documents which already have a reference to a meanwhile blocked Business Partner can finish their process / do not need to change their behavior.-Obsolete: It is not allowed to create references to Business Partner with this status because the intention of this status value is that the Business partner gets archived.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-The status of the Business Partner will be displayed in the value help pop-up after personalizing the screen as described below,-Select the value help for Account or Business Partner or Contacts.-Select Personalize icon.-Tick the check box for Status.-Select Save button.-Now, you can able to find the Status of the Business Partner in the value help pop-up, based on that you can select the Business Partner/Account.

Title: User is Able to Edit a Material Eventhough There is no Write Access
Content: Symptom-For a particular user, you have provide no Write access to Edit a Material in Product Data work center. But still the user able to Edit, Change and Save the Material.-Reproducing the Issue-Step 1: Blocking the Write access for a particular user in Application and User Management work center.-Step 2: If the user try to change a Material in Product Data work center, system still allows to change and save.-Cause-Even though, you block Write access for Material in Product Data work center. If the user is having Write Access to Material in any other work center, then the user can still be able to Edit the Material in Product Data work center.-Resolution-If you want to restrict a user for changing the Material, then it is mandatory to restrict his/her Write Access to all Material views in different work centers.-For example, you can access the Materials through any of the below work centers. So, if you want to restrict an employee for changing the material, then you should give No Write Access to all the Material views that was assigned to him/her.-View: By Materials - work center: Product Portfolio-View: By Materials - work center: Product and Service Portfolio-View: Materials - work center: Product Data-View: Materials - work center: Inventory Valuation-View: Materials - work center: Audit-View: Products - work center: Supply Planning-View: Materials - work center: Product Development-Special Case:-After restricting write access to all the above workcenter/views, if the user is still able to edit a Material, then the cause could be that user has also work center views PDI_ADMINISTRATION and PDI_DEVELOPMENT in work center PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT assigned.-This implicitly grants unrestricted Read and Write Access, because this is necessary for development users in PDI. According to the documentation of the ByD Studio, those Work center views shall not be assigned to regular business users because of this fact.--Please remove the assignment of those work center views, if the restrictions on other views shall be enforced.

Title: Unable to Create Service Agents in Prepare Phase Activity
Content: Symptom-You have received the new Business ByDesign system with Initial User but you are not able to create a New Service Agent from Business Configuration work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Prepare Phase.-Select Define Key Users of the Project activity.-Select Create Service Agent button.-System throws below error message Target UI cannot be determined in current scope-Resolution-In order to create a New Service Agent, you need to close the activity Confirm Milestone:Design accepted in the Implementation Project. This will assign the work center Business Partner Data to SAP_INITUSER and will allow SAP_INITUSER to create service agents.--This process will take some minutes to enable the authorization to SAP_INITUSER to create the service agents.--Refer also to the documentation Complete the Activity List : First Implementation in the SAP Business ByDesign Library. An except: Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted.--You cannot move on to the next phases of the Activity List until you have confirmed this milestone.-Note: Once the Service Agent is creation is complete, the Initial User will be locked automatically by the system and cannot be used anymore

Title: Business Configuration Is Not Editable 96 Hours Before Productive Upgrade
Content: Symptom-When you try to edit activity in Business Configuration work center, the system throws the error: Changes to Fine-Tuning not possible due to release upgrade.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune.-Open an activity-Click Edit-The system throws the mentioned error-Cause-This is a correct system behavior as the system is undergoing a productive upgrade.-Resolution-Below are restrictions 96 hours before productive upgrade-BC work center is in read only access-No changes in scoping possible-No changes in fine tuning possible-No configuration of new printers-No account determination modification-No field modifications-No productive data transfer (migration) during productive upgrade weekend

Title: Unable to Maintain Introduction Texts in Swiss Dunning Letters using Easy Form Editor
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Dunning letters for Switzerland have been delivered since FP4.0 and contain invoice details grouped according to specific criteria such as currency, customer number, and subscriber number. The information is split into separate dunning letters within a single PDF file.-Dunning letters are generated using the Dunning Letter form template where the information is grouped in sections, such as info blocks or text blocks, and can be edited using Easy Form Editor. Each dunning level of the dunning letter is composed of a different introduction text and title.-For Swiss dunning letters, it is not possible to edit the text blocks to make changes to the introduction texts of the generated dunning-letter forms using Easy Form Editor.-Cause-Due to technical limitations in the Easy Form Editor tool, it is not possible to dynamically show all text blocks and it is therefore not possible to edit the texts within the text blocks.-Resolution-To edit the text blocks of dunning letters for Switzerland, you must instead use the Adobe® LiveCycle® Designer.-To do so, you must first have installed the Adobe LiveCycle Designer and the Add-In for Adobe LiveCycle Designer front-end components on your computer. You can then edit the texts as required.-Note:-In the Adobe LiveCycle Designer, text blocks for different dunning levels are accessible under the Hierarchy tab. As the texts of different text blocks overlap on top of each other in the editor, you should edit each text block one at a time, and make the others temporarily inactive or invisible by setting the appropriate value in the Presence field of the Adobe LiveCycle Designer editor.-For information about using Adobe LiveCycle Designer, see the Adobe product documentation.

Title: Error Message "Cannot delete cost center XYZ; it is assigned to a resource"
