Content: Symptom-When you try to check or activate an Org Structure after deleting or delimiting a Cost Center, system throws below error message:-Cannot delete cost center XYZ; it is assigned to a resource-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Check or Activate the Org Structure.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Cost Center that you are try to delete/delimit is still being used in any Resources (Ex: Labor Resource, Equipment Resource, Vehicle Resource or Resource Group) in the system.-To verify, follow the below steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data or Cost and Revenue work center.-Select Resources view.-Select All Resources in Show field.-Select Advanced and input Cost Center XYZ in Cost Center ID field.-You can find the list of resources in the search result.- Resolution-To resolve the issue, follow the best suitable option which suits your business.-Option 1: Delete the Resource-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data or Cost and Revenue work center.-Select Resources view.-Select All Resources in Show field.-Select Advanced and input Cost Center XYZ in Cost Center ID field.-Highlight the Resource and select Delete button-Option 2: Block the status of the Resource-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data or Cost and Revenue work center.-Select Resources view.-Select All Resources in Show field.-Select Advanced and input Cost Center XYZ in Cost Center ID field.-Highlight the Resource and select Change Status button and choose Block option.-After performing any one of the above option, you can try to check or activate the Org Structure again.-Option 3:-Reassign the Cost Center attribute to the respective Org Unit. -

Title: No Records Found While Opening Test System Available link of a Change project
Content: Symptom-When you select Test System Available link of a Change Project, system didn't display any details.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Project view.-Select Test System Available link for the Change Project.-Cause-There are couple of reasons that might caused this issue, they are-1. The change test systems were not requested/created out of the Change Projects in Business Configuration work center, as there are no records on the system request in the system. If the test systems are setup outside from the regular Business Configuration process, e.g. via mail to SCC, we cannot display the full data as we have no records on the system request.-2. The change test systems were decommissioned out of the Change Projects in Business Configuration work center, as there are no records on the system request in the system. If the test systems are decommissioned outside from the regular Business Configuration process, e.g. via mail to SCC, we cannot display any data as we have no records on the system decommissioning.-3. The Test System details for change projects will be available in the link only when the Project is in the Merged or later stages, since the Project is migrated to the Test tenant till then and it is present only as a reference in the Production Tenant.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Is It Possible to Have an Overview of Absentees List for Specific Time Period
Content: Symptom- You, as a line manager or time administrator, would like to know whether it is possible to see a list of absentees of your team members or all employees during specific time period.-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current release and will be implemented as a new requirement in a future release of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Limitations in the Electronic Invoice for Mexico
Content: Symptom-Electronic Invoice for Mexico has been delivered with the following limitations:-Receipt of partial payment and delivery note are not supported.-Only schema version 3.0 is supported.-The Addenda xml tag is not supported.-The following xml tags valid for all industries are not supported:-Impuestos Locales -Donativos Donatarias-    5.   The following industry-specific xml tags are not supported:-For the retail industry: Sector de ventas al detalle ("Detallista")-For service providers authorized by the Mexican tax authorities to approve and sign electronic invoices (PAC): Proveedor de Servicios Autorizado:-For oil companies and petrol stations: Estado de cuenta de combustibles de monederos electrónicos como Factura Electrónica-For companies that receive donations: Donativos “Donatarias”-For money exchange companies  Compra venta de “Divisas”-For banks or any companies issuing Digital Bank Statement:  Estados de Cuenta Bancario "ECB" -    6. Pedimento is not supported.-Pedimento is a document that companies receive from customs when acquiring goods abroad. The document number, its creation date and authority identification should be given in the invoices in case imported goods are sold in Mexico.-Reproducing the Issue-Not applicable; The functionality was not developed in the current releases.-Cause-This functionality is not supported in the current release.-Resolution-Not applicable

Title: Error message "Migration of payment with cash discount is not possible"
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the error message Migration of payment with cash discount is not possible while trying to migrate Open Items Receivables.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Click on button Open Activity List.-Search for activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data and open with migration tool.-Execute migration for migration object Open Items Receivable.-On simulation step you receive the error message mentioned.-Cause-In your migration template, you have filled the field Full Payment Due Days for the lines where document type is Payment. As per design, for document type Payment this field is used for cash discount purposes that is why this error is coming up.-Resolution-You must leave blank the field Full Payment Due Days for the lines where document type is Payment, and repeat simulation.

Title: Availability Calendar is not populated
Content: Symptom-An employee is entering working hours correctly; however, the Availability Calendar for the employee is not populated in the Resource Management Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Resource Management Work Center-Click on Resource Search-Search for employee XYZ and click Show Availability-The Availability Calendar is not populated and the following message is displayed:-“Working days not determined; check work schedule for XYZ”-Cause-The Availability Calendar is not populated because the Work Schedule for the employee is not maintained.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, maintain the Work Schedule for the affected employee:-Go to Time Administration Work Center-Select Employees view-Search for the employee (XYZ)-Click Edit-Navigate to the Time Profile tab-Select the Work Schedule sub-tab-Assign a valid Work Schedule-Click Save-Keywords-Availability Calendar, availability not populated, employee availability missing, resource management availability empty, show availability not working, working days not determined, work schedule not maintained, work schedule missing, time profile work schedule, employee calendar not visible, resource search availability issue, SAP ByDesign availability issue

Title: Error Message: DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; business residence XYZ () must be below a company, While Activating the Org Structure
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Org Structure with Org Unit ABC as Company which is a top level Org Unit and Org Unit XYZ is child of ABC, where XYZ is Business Residence. Highlight the Org Unit XYZ, select Activate button, choose Selected and Dependent Org Units.-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; business residence XYZ () must be below a company. Although it is also possible to flag both properties on the same org unit, it is not recommended to do so. The business residence should be flagged on an org unit below the company.-Cause-Org Unit XYZ is inactive and flagged as Business Residence and it is below ABC which is inactive Company. You can not only activate the sub unit because there is no active Company above it. You need to include the Company in the check.-Resolution-Hence, you need check or activate from the top level Org Unit. I.e,. highlight Org Unit ABC and then, check or activate the Org Structure.-This is general system behavior.--When you are creating an Org Structure for the first time in the system, you can check the consistency/activation from the Company level only but not from Business Residence level.--If you want to check the consistency of the Org Structure, you can highlight the Org Unit (top level) and use any options under Check button.--Note: You are allowed to activate the individual low level org units once you activate the Org Structure for the first time.

Title: Unable to Search and Find Business Partners with Both Account and Supplier Role
Content: Symptom-When you try to search for a Business Partner which has roles Supplier and Account, system returns only Business Partners which has Accounts role.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Business Partner view.-Select Advanced Search link.-Select Supplier and Account in the Business Role.-Select Go button.-Resolution-This is currently not possible because the contrition not equal to Supplier is true for the other role. Hence, it is not possible to search the Business Partners with role Account and Supplier.--To make an OR for different query parameter values of the same parameter options is the default behavior and can not be changed.

Title: How to View Partial and Half-day Leave in Team Calender
Content: Symptom-The document describes the steps to view partial and half-day leave in Team Calender.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area Work Center.-Select Overview View.-Click Launch Team Calendar under Common Tasks.-Where a horizontal line appears for half-day leave.-Cause-There is only a horizontal line with background color.-Resolution-Follow the steps to get the details of the partial and half-day leave:-Open the Team Calendar. -Click on the box contains the Horizontal line.-A table opens up below showing the partial and half day leave details.

Title: How to View All Project Expenses(Time Recordings) on the Project Including Comments
Content: Symptom-You, as a project manager, want to view all time recordings on the project by project team members. Is it possible to run a report to display all the time recordings with recording's notes?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view and select the ﻿Time and Expenses sub-view.-Select All Items in the Show field.- Resolution-The only way to view the comments added during time confirmations is through the Activity Report of an employee. But currently there is no central UI to open the activity reports of all the employees for any administrative purpose.-Some of the alternatives are as follows:-1. The activity report is only available on the ESS Time Sheet of an employee. There the link to Open activity report is available in the toolbar.--2. To open the activity report for another employee you have to be either the line manager (for internal employees) or the project manager (for service agents).--a. As a Line Manager you can go to Managing My Area work center where you can find the common task Call Employee Services on Behalf. There you are able to open the Time Sheet for the employees reporting to you.--b. As a Project Manager you can go to Project Management work center, Resources view, Service Agents sub-view. There you are able to search for any service agent and open his/her ESS Time Sheet.---See Also-You can also refer to the below Knowledge Base documents for further clarifications:-1512025 - Is It Possible to Print or View the Activity Record of Other Employee?-1520194 - Project Manager Can Only See Project Expenses in Last 90 Days

Title: Incorrect Industry is Displaying in Some of the Accounts
Content: Symptom-In some Accounts, the Industry is showing technical name instead of actual name.-Reproducing the Issue-Go Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select and Edit an Account.-Go to General tab.-Here the Industry is showing technical name.- Cause-The cause for the issue is that the industry sector XYZ which was assigned to those Accounts were deleted from the Fine tuning activity General Business Data.--Therefore for the accounts which still have this industry sector value (XYZ) no proper text could be shown anymore.--Resolution-If you really don't need industry sector XYZ anymore, please change the corresponding accounts accordingly (maintain a different industry) or you can also restore XYZ again via the Business Configuration finet uning activity General Business Data.

Title: After Scoping Expense Report, Upon Finising the Scoping, System Shows Inconsistencies Warning related Scoping
Content: Symptom-You have scoped Expense Report into your main scoping and at the time of finishing it, system pop-up with below warning message:-It is not possible to finalize the scope at this time. Some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your settings. The desired scope change would cause configuration settings to be deleted which you have already used in Fine-Tuning. Before continuing with the current project,you must either reverse the decision causing inconsistencies or delete the associated Fine Tuning settings and then make your changes to the Project Scope.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you have deleted any of the account determination group which are pre-delivered by SAP.-Resolution-Hence, to resolve the issue, restore the deleted Account Determination Groups using below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity List of respective Project.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select Edit Account Determination Groups link.-Select Restore Defaults button.-Select Save and Close button.

Title: Filtering is not Working in Account Data Mass Change
Content: Symptom-When you try to filter the data using the filter row in the Step 2 of Mass Change Account Data, filtering is not working.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management or Business Partner Data work center.-Select Mass Change Account Data under Common Tasks.-Add the required Account in the Work list.-Provide a keyword in the filter row and result data are not properly displayed.-Cause-In Step 2 of Mass Change Account Data, you cannot filter. the row where the data was entered is the Mass Change row.--The use case to select in Step 1 is Accounts, and perform a mass change for a filtered list in Step 2 is currently not supported in the Mass Change.-Resolution-you may consider using the following workaround:--In the Step 2, you can enter the Value that needs to be changed and select the respective row using CTRL key and select Apply Mass Change button and choose Selected Items.

Title: Context in the Error Message Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters, is minimal
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you enter Material Description with more than 40 characters, The system throws below error message:-Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters, for example, <valid material description>-But in the higher releases, the example text is truncated and the system throw below message:-Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select a material and select Edit button.-Enter Material Description with more tan 40 characters.-Cause-The reason for this change was an agreed with higher releases after incorporating feedback from several customers. Most customers were confused by the replication of the wrong text. Therefore in an attempt to harmonize and improve message throughout the system this chance was introduced.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Regions for South Africa is Missing in "Edit Value Conversion for Region" While Migrating Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Org Structure using Migration Tool, all the regions for South Africa is missing in Edit Value Conversion for Region in the Step Convert Values.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Activity List of respective Implementation Project or Change Project.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and open Perform Organizational Structure Setup activity.-Select Import org structure using the migration tool link.-Select Execute Migration and follow the process.-Cause-In the migration template, for South Africa, Country field is filled as SA. But during value conversion, SA is mapped to Saudi Arabia. This can be verified in Step Convert Values, Value Conversion for Country.-Resolution-To resolve the issue correct the mapping in Value Conversion for Country. After changing the mapping, region codes for South Africa will be displayed in Edit Value Conversion for Region.

Title: Error Message "Material XYZ not assigned for Company AAA and Business Residence BBB"
Content: Symptom-When migrating material valuation data, the error occurs like Material XYZ not assigned for Company AAA and Business Residence BBB or Valuation Data Missing for Material XYZ Business Residence BBB-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the project and click Open Activity List-Open activity Migration of Material Valuation Data-Click the link of Migrate materials using the migration tool-Select file and click Execute migration->Execute migration step by step-Error occurs: Material XYZ not assigned for Company AAA and Business Residence BBB or Valuation Data Missing for Material XYZ Business Residence BBB.-Cause-Materials have to be assigned for company and business residence before migrating the valuation data.-Resolution-To upload information of company and business residence, use the tab Financial Organization in the migration object Materials. Populate only this tab and upload the file using the migration mode Enhance already existing records. (Find this setting when you mark your template in the file list and navigate to Properties -> Advanced -> Migration Mode.)-See Also-KBA 3567945- Missing Product Specification When Maintaining Product Specification Valuation -Keywords-Valuation data, data migration, business residence, company, edit cost.

Title: "Actual Work" Varies for a Project Team Member in Different tabs of a Project
Content: Symptom-You as a Project Manager observed that the Time Recorded by a project team member differs in Work tab and Team and Staffing tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects view.-Highlight the Project and select Edit button and choose Team and Staffing option.-Here for the employee, the Time recorded by him/her is showing correctly.-Go to Project Plan tab and Gantt Chart sub tab.-Highlight the Project Task and go to Work tab.-Here for the same employee, the time recorded is 0 hours, which is different from the above value.-Cause-The employee recorded Time for correct Service for the respective Project Task but inside the Project, the wrong service is assigned to that employee. This can be verified as follows:-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects view.-Highlight the Project and select Edit button and choose Team and Staffing option.-Select Staff by Structure sub tab.-Go to the respective Project Task and expand the tree.-Here, you can observe that the Employee have wrong service assigned and also you can find that the actual time recorded by that employee is shown as Not Named (N.N.).-Resolution-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects view.-Highlight the Project and select Edit button and choose Team and Staffing option.-Select Staff by Structure sub tab.-Go to the respective Project Task and expand the tree.-Highlight Employee and change the Service to a the actual service.-Now, you can check in the Work tab where the Time will show the correct assignment.

Title: Error Message: Financial Data - Details; Missing Key Relationship, while Migrating Service Valuation Data
Content: Symptom-When you migrate the Service Valuation data using Migration, system throws below error message during validation.-Financial Data - Details; Missing Key Relationship for the following values:-Key XYZ, ABC-Where, XYZ is Service ID and ABC is Company ID-Cause-The cause for the issue is Company ID maintained in Financial Data - General tab and Financial Data - Details tab is not the same.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, maintain same Company ID in both the tabs and repeat migration.

Title: Why Contacts Picks Business Address Instead of Personal Address, while Assigning a Contact to an Account?
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Business Address and Personal Address for a Contact. When, you assign that Contact to an Account, system picks the Business Address instead of Personal Address.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Highlight an Account.-Select Edit button and choose Contacts option.-Under Relationships and Responsibilities, select Add Row button.-Choose Relationship Type as Has Ship-To Party and select a Business Partner.-You can see here that the system pulled the Business Address instead the Main Personal Address-Note: It is not possible to change this address.-Cause-For business partner address determination of contacts, the address determined will always be workplace address and if not found then employee workplace.-Personal address will not be available for user selection.-The Personal address is not available for selection because, showing the personal address is violation. And also, personal address is not display in Business Partner Data, Accounts and so on.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: HC_BYD40: Differences in 127 and XXX
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- DFV errors as below :-Differences in 127 and AccountingNotification-Differences in 127 and TradeReceivablesPayablesRegister (SupplierInvoice)-Differences in 127 and TaxReceivablesPayablesRegister (SupplierInvoice)-Error key: No XXX item matches supplier invoice-Reproducing the Issue-Option 1 from front end:-Log in into front end.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Open Business Document Differences view.-Select query All differences  and select Go.-Look for DFV errors as mentioned above.-Select the DFVs and note down the SIV ID in the DFV.-In case the DFVs point to the same SIV ID, single BCP needs to be reported and other two need to be completed as duplicates.-Option 2 from SAP insight:-Open SAP Insight from the incident.-Select SPC Incident from same Tenant under Query Related Incidents.-Check the screenshot attached.-It shows all the reported incidents for Differences in 127 and XXX in continuous order (here ex: 1000194318, 1000194320 and 1000194321).-Take the three DFV result IDs from insight and log in into front end. Follow step 1 to 7 (in the case doc).-Verify whether all the SIV IDs are the same. If yes close any two incidents by updating this case document details.-Send one incident to development (make sure all the three DFV Result ID’s are updated in the incident).-Cause-On posting of Supplier Invoice an XI message is triggered which updates 3 Business Objects namely AccountingNotification, TradeReceivablesPayablesRegister and TaxReceivablesPayablesRegister.-Currently you get three DFVs like below for one failed XI message from SIV to accounting for the same tenant and system resulting in three different BCP.-Resolution-Create a single BCP for DFV Differences in 127 and AccountingNotification and complete other 2 as duplicates.

Title: Is it Possible to Sort the Attachments of any Business Partner Using Created On Date?
Content: Symptom-In any Business Partner, you are allowed to sort the Description of the attachment but the sorting is not working for Created On date.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Business Partners view.-Edit any Business Partner.-Go to Attachments tab.-Resolution-This feature is not supported by Business Bydesign due to technical restrictions its not possible to provide any sort function here.

Title: Changes Activated in the Planning Area is not Reflecting in the Active Area
Content: Symptom-You have activated some of the changes in the Org Structure and when you refresh the Active Area, the changes are not reflecting.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Planning Area, activate the changes performed in the Org Structure.-Go to Active Area, select refresh icon.-Changes are not reflecting in the Active Area.-Cause-The issue is caused by the fact the user used the refresh button on the Active Area screen which has a limitation.-Resolution-The workaround is to leave the work center page and re-enter it, which will lead to correct reloading of data.-This limitation will be fixed in one of the higher releases of Business ByDesign.

Title: Error Message: Project task XYZ does not exist, While Migrating Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Sales Orders using Data Migration, system throws below error message for some of the Sales Orders:-Sales Order ABC: Project task XYZ does not exist.-Cause-There are different causes that results in above issue:-If the Project Task ID provided in the Migration Template is wrong/misspelled.-If the Project Task ID provided in the Migration Template doesn't exist in the system.-If the Project Task ID provided in the Migration Template is not in the status Released.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, follow the below instructions on case basis:-Case 1: Check in Project Management work center for the exact name/id of the Project Task and migrate the Sales Orders again.-Case 2: Update the Migration template with the exact name of the Project Task and migrate the Sales Orders again.-Case 3: You are allowed to enter the Project Task in Sales Order only if the Project is Released. Change the status of the Project to Released and migrate the Sales Orders again.

Title: Error Message: Country Code is Mandatory, While Creating a New Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When you create a New Project Invoice Request, system throws below error message at last step: -Invoice request not created-Country code is mandatory-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Project Invoicing view and select Project view.-Highlight the Project.-Select New button and choose New manual project invoice request.- system throws above error message.-Cause-The issue is due to a little discrepancy in the process of handling Employee Workplace Address Information:-Apparently, the workplace address of employee XYZ (Internal business partner ID is ABC, who is responsible for the Project) was created at a time when the corresponding organization had no postal address information-The generated Address Snapshot for this Employee Workplace Address is now missing the postal address information, which is complained in the follow-up process when using such an Address Snapshot.-Resolution-To clean up this situation, you have the to change or re-assign the Address Data to a company, which has maintained postal address information.-As an Employee:-Go to Home work center.-Select Self-Services Overview view.-Select Edit My Contact Data link. Where you can change/re-assign the address.-or-As a HR administrator:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select link Change Workplace Contact Data, then input the affected employee.-Here you can re-assign the employee Workplace address.

Title: Error Message "The currency was not found for account XYZ, sales organization ABC and distribution channel Direct sales"
Content: Symptom-When you try to save an Account, system throws below error message:-The currency was not found for account XYZ, sales organization ABC and distribution channel Direct sales-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select New Private or New Corporate Account.-Save the Account.-Cause-The cause for the error message  is that there is no Currency maintained for the combination "Account XYZ, Sales Organization ABC and Distribution Channel Direct Sales".-Resolution-To resolve the error message, follow the below steps:-1. Go to Account Management work center.-2. Select Accounts view.-3. Search and Edit the Account XYZ.-4. Go to Sales tab.-5. Under Sales Data, you can maintain the Currency for above combination.

Title: Error Message "Select Journal Entry Type 00088 for (multi-) Customer projects for Sales" While Migrating the GL Account Balance
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate the GL Account Balance, migration throws below error message for Projects which are of type Customer Projects.-Select Journal Entry Type 00088 for (multi-) Customer projects for Sales-Cause-The General Ledger entry contains multi-customer projects and is not supported in the GL account migration.-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.--You can only migrate direct projects, if you want to migrate the above scenario you have to do it manually in respective General ledger.

Title: Is it Possible to Upload a Same Materials Using Different Language Excel Templates?
Content: Symptom-Your company uses two languages and when you try to upload the material template it creates the material only in one language (the language which the template was downloaded), after that you can use those material only in that language. So you would like to know, How to maintain Material in two languages.-When you try to do the same, Excel throws below error message:-Material ABC is already exist-Resolution-When you upload materials into your system using a particular Template (Language 1) then it is possible to update those materials only using that Template (Language 1). If you try to update those materials using some other language templates, system will not allow you to update. This is actual system behavior.--Once, you upload a material into system those material will be available in the system inspite of logon language.-Option 1:-But for any material, Material Description and Detailed Description depends on Logon Language. So, if you uploaded material into the system (Language 2) then you can maintain the Description in Language 1 as follows:--1. Login into the system in Language 2.-2. Go to Product Data work center.-3. Search and Edit the Material.-4. Select View All button.-5. Go to Other Languages tab under General tab.--Where you can select the language as Language 1 and update the material description. So when you login into the system with Language 1 you can find the material description in Language 1.-Option 2:-You can directly use the activity Migration of Material to migrate the materials in two different languages. But you can differentiate it by maintaining different language for Material Description and Detailed Description.-You can use the Migration of Material activity in the Integrate and Extend phase of Implementation Projects to upload material with different language for Material description and Detailed Description.--1. Download the Migration template for Materials.-2. In General sheet, you can maintain the details of the Material. Under section Description you can maintain description in one Language.-3. Go to Other Languages sheet, Here you can maintain the Description in another Language for the same material.-4. For Detailed Description of material, go to Detailed descriptions sheet. For a particular material, if you have detailed description in two different language. Then, in the first row enter the Material ID, Language1 and Detailed Description. In the second row, enter the same Material ID, language 2 and Detailed Description.

Title: Scoping Question for External Supplier Invoice Integration Add-On is Missing in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to upload Supplier Invoice using Microsoft Excel but the Scoping Question for Activating this option is missing in Business Configuration.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-Go to Questions section.-Expand Purchasing, expand Supplier Invoice and select Invoices and Credit Memos.-Here there is no Question for uploading the Supplier Invoice from excel to Business ByDesign system.-Cause-The reason that the question for activating supplier invoice upload by Microsoft excel is missing because the Add-on External Supplier Invoice Integration was not yet purchased by you.-Resolution-To purchase the Add-on External Supplier Invoice Integration,  follow the below steps:--1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Select Implementation projects view.-3. Select Edit project Scope for First Implementation.-4. Go to section 3 Scoping.-5. Expand Purchasing, Expand Supplier Invoicing and select Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos.-6. Under the section Details: Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos, go to SAP Store tab.-7. Here, you can find the Add-On External Supplier Invoice Integration.-8. Select the link External Supplier Invoice Integration, which will directly take you to the SAP Store for Purchasing the add-on.--Once you purchase, the question will be enabled in the system, so you activate supplier invoice upload by Microsoft excel.

Title: Is it Possible to Update or Add Purchasing Units in Materials Using Mass Change?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to add or change Purchasing Units of Materials but you couldn't the field in Material Mass Change.-Resolution-It is not possible to add or change the Purchasing Units of Materials using Mass Change. This feature was provided as a feedback to solution management as a future requirement.-In the meantime, you may consider using the following workaround:--1. Change the Purchasing Unit manually for each Material.--2. If you have Uploaded the Material using New Material Using Microsoft Excel, then you can update the Purchasing Unit of those material using New Material Using Microsoft Excel.

Title: Unable to Confirm Milestone: Go-Live Readiness Accepted, Since the Check Box is Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-When you try to confirm the activity Go-Live Readiness Accepted, the check box is geryed out.-Cause-you cannot confirm the milestone, if you have requested a new production/test system.-Resolution-You have to confirm the Milestone: Go-Live Readiness Accepted in the new system which you have requested.

Title: Backend Exception While Creating New Manual Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the user tries to create a New Manual Invoice, system throws exception.-Dump Info:-1 CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:/ISQC/CL_WC_UNIT==============CP, Include:/ISQC/CL_WC_UNIT==============CM00I, Position:1-2 Info: An exception with the type /ISQC/CX_QCAT_NOT_DEF occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-3 /ISQC/CX_QCAT_NOT_DEF, Program:/ISQC/CL_WC_UNIT==============CP, Include:/ISQC/CL_WC_UNIT==============CM00A, Position:9-4 Info: Quantity category is not defined.-Exception /ISQC/CX_QCAT_NOT_DEF is thrown in method GET_QCAT_DIMENSION of class /ISQC/CL_WC_UNIT-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Invoice under Common Tasks.-Cause-The cause for the issue that one of the Physical Unit or Trading Unit which was created by customer don't have the Reference UoM. Follow below steps to verify it customer system:-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. select the Implementation Project.-3. Select button Open Activity List-4. Go to Tab Fine tune-5. Search and open Activity Quantities and Units of Measure-6. Select the link Create and Maintain Physical Units or Create and Maintain Trading Units.- Resolution-If you find that there is a Unit(s) which don't have a Reference UoM, please ask the customer to Maintain the Reference UoM and save the changes.-In case, if the customer reopens the incident stating that they are receiving error message Reference UOM cant be change as UOM XYZ is already released upon saving then follow the below instruction:-Check with the customer whether they want us to maintain the Reference UoM for the affected unit? If yes, get the exact Reference UOM they want us to maintain. -If No, check whether they want us to delete the affected Unit completely from the system.-For both the options, we need a explicit approval from customer.-Upon confirming the above option, forward the incident to ES Applications – BC/Forms/FND/MIG, further the incident will be forwarded to the CSS component AP-RC-QC.-See Also-BCPs: 3500092040 and 3100497515

Title: Process Integration Application Error : Message is a reconciliation but the reconciliation counter received is the same as the counter from persistence
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-PI (Process Integration) message ends with below error:-English: Message is a reconciliation but the reconciliation counter received is the same as the counter from persistence-German:Die Nachricht ist eine Reconciliation, der enthaltene Reconciliation Zähler ist jedoch gleich dem Zähler aus der Persistenz-  Reproducing the Issue-Log in to back end.-Enter the transaction SRT_MONI.-Enter the message ID.-Select Execute.-Select the message and select Error Log.-You can see the below error under short text:-Message is a reconciliation but the reconciliation counter received is the same as the counter from persistence.-Cause-As soon as a document is created, instead of a normal XI message a reconciliation is triggered.-Resolution-To resolve the issue you need to reconcile the message.-Before reconciling perform the following checks:-1. The  sender interface is: SalesOrderProcessingCustomerTransactionDocumentAndProjectAssignmentOut and the receiver interface is ProjectProcessingCustomerTransactionDocumentAndProjectAssignmentIn.-2. If the stuck message is actually a reconciliation message which can be identified by the user (it would be support user) then instead of reconciling the message you should cancel the message.-After the above mentioned checks you can reconcile the message using the following steps:-Log in to back end.-Enter the transaction SRT_MONI.-Enter the message ID.-Select Actions.-Select Reconcile. -Cancel the original message having error.-  Created by BYDMS-KB-PI

Title: Error Message "Cannot Delete Profit Center XYZ, Postings exist in Financial Accounting"
Content: Symptom-You have created Organizational Structure with many Profit Centers, Now, you have a requirement to extend the validity of a Profit Center to Past Date (Changing Valid From date of the Profit Center to a Past date) but when Activating system throws below error message,-Cannot Delete Profit Center XYZ, Postings exist in Financial Accounting-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the Org Unit.-Go to Timelines tab.-Extend the Valid To date of the Profit Center attribute to a Past Date.-Check or Activate the Org Structure-Cause-You are not able extend the validity of the Profit Center to a Past date because, there might be some posting exist in the system with the Profit center.-Resolution-It is not possible to extend the validity of a Profit Center to a past date in a same Time Interval row. So, the Validity of the Profit center should be splitted.-Follow the below steps,-1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures.-3. Highlight the Org Unit.-4. Go to Timelines tab.-5. Set the Valid From date of the Profit Center attribute to DD.MM.YYYY (This is a date which is in past), Now change the Valid To date as DD.MM.YYYY and select Enter key in the keyboard.-6. Set the Effective From date as DD1.MM1.YYYY1 (This is the actual Valid From date of the Profit center).-7. Highlight the Org Unit.-8. Go to Definitions tab.-9. Mark the Profit Center check box.-10. Check the Org Structure for consistency.

Title: Error message: "Entry in field Tax Number 1 is longer than 07 characters" while Assigning Tax Number for Switzerland
Content: Symptom-When you try to assign a Tax Number for Switzerland as per the below steps, system throws below error message:-Entry in field Tax Number 1 is longer than 07 characters-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select All Accounts in Show field.-Select an Account.-Select Edit button and choose Financial data.-Go to Tax data tab.-Select Country as CH - Switzerland and enter the Tax Number.-Select Save button.-Cause-You are trying to maintain a UID in a tax number field which is causing the issue.-Resolution-Steps to maintain UID in the Account:--1. Go to Account management work center-2. Search and open the account.-3. In General tab, If there is no UID Number field visible under the Account area, Select on the link Additional Identifiers.-4. Enter any UID Number (12 digit number) and select OK.-5. Now the UID Number and UID Appendix fields will be visible under Accounts area. Appropriate value can be filled for UID Appendix field (just below UID Number) as well.--Additional Info: Please refer to the section Enterprise Identification Number — Switzerland in the Help Center documentation What's New: Business Partner for further details.

Title: Account Determination Group is not Copied to Mass Change Screen of Materials
Content: Symptom-When you create more than one Material using Material Template, the Account Determination Group which is maintained in the Material Template is not carried/copied to the Mass Change screen.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Material Templates view.-Highlight the template and select Create from Template button.-Enter the Number of Materials.-In the Mass Change screen, go to Valuation.-Here the Account Determination Group is missing.-Resolution-This is a known issue and it is only a Display issue and it has been fixed with the Next release of Business ByDesign.-But this will not affect the Existing and new Account Determination Group. So, you can assign a new Account Determination Group.

Title: Blank Page While Opening a Form Template using Easy Form Editor
Content: Symptom-When you open a Form template using Easy Form Editor, the left side of the screen is blank due to which you are not able add any fields in the Form Template. But you are able to view the Form Preview (Sample Data).-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application and user Management work center.-2. Select Form Template Maintenance view.-3. Open a Form Template with Easy Form Editor.-4. Where we can see the sample data preview but the right side of the screen is blank, hence you are not able to edit the form.-Cause-The reason for this behavior is, if the form template has been modified by the Adobe Lifecycle Designer then it cannot be modified by Easy Form Editor any longer.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.

Title: Error Message "3 is not a fixed value of field Activation Status" While creating New Trading Unit
Content: Symptom-When you create a New Trading Unit of Measurement and upon saving it, system throws below error message:-3 is not a fixed value of field Activation Status-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Fine-Tune chevron.-Open the Quantities and Units of Measure activity.-Select Create and Maintain Trading Units link.-Add a new entry with unit, UoM Symbol, Description, Activation Status 2 - Released and Display Decimals 0.-Save your changes and the above error message will appear.-Cause-The Activation should be set from status In Preparation to Released. It is not possible to save the Units directly with Released status.-Resolution-When you enter a new Unit, it should be set to status 2- Released from the status 1-Inpreparation. Hence follow the below steps,-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to Implementation Projects view.-3. Click Open Activity List button.-4. Go to phase Fine- Tuning.-5. Open the activity Quantities and Units of Measure.-6. Select the link Create and Maintain Trading Units.-7. Select Add Row and add a new entry with Unit , UoM Symbol, Description, Activation Status 2 – Released and Display Decimals 0.-8. Change the status Activation Status to 1 - In Preparation and select Enter key in the keyboard.-9. Now, change the status to 2- Released and select Enter key in the keyboard.-10. Select Save button.

Title: No Employees are Displayed for a Manager in Managing My Area
Content: Symptom-You as a Manager (Internal Employee or Service Agent), couldn't find any of your reporting employees in Managing My Area work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to My Team view.-Go to My Department sub view.-Cause-If your assignment as Manager is ended for that Org Unit, then the employees will not be displayed under your team.-This can be verified in Organizational Management work center by providing the exact Effective From date.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Old Company Name is showing instead of New Company Name in Output Channel Selection
Content: Symptom-You have changed the name of a Org Unit (It is defined as Company), but the old name is still showing in the Rules of Output Channel Selection.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application and User management work center.-2. Select Output Channel Selection view.-3. Select Show Rules For from the value help (for example: Customer Invoice)-4. Select Go button.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the new changes are reflecting in the Rules of Output Channel Selection.-Resolution-To resolve the issue is,-Go to Application and User management work center.-Select Output Channel Selection view.-Select Show Rules For from the value help (for example: Customer Invoice)-Select Go button.-Locate the Org Unit (For Example: Seller/Invoicing Unit).-Select Edit button.-Re-assign the Org Unit. This will pick the current name of the org Unit.

Title: Webpage Link which is Added to a Form is not Working
Content: Symptom-You have added a Webpage link in a Form but it is not working when using it with Business ByDesign to display any documents (Ex: Sales Quote, Purchase Order, etc,.) . Whereas you are able to select and open the link when using the Form with Adobe LifeCycle Designer.-Resolution-A navigation from a PDF to some website, be it via a button or a link, requires client-side scripting. But this is only available if a form is rendered as interactive form. But if a form was designed as print form by SAP the form template maintenance does not offer any option for users to upload there own template as interactive form, therefore it is not rendered as interactive form.--This is a new requirement that would need to be implemented in a future release.

Title: Material Template is Saving as a Material Instead of Template
Content: Symptom-When you create a Material Template, it is saving as a New Material instead of Material template.  And then when you edit the material and while using Set as Template button, it is not setting the material as a template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Material Templates view.-Select New button.-Fill the required fields and Save the changes.-Resolution-Creation of Material Template:--When you create a New Material Template in Material Template view, this will also create a New material and the new Material can be used in other business transaction as like other materials.--Set as template:--When you set any Material as Set as template, this will create a New material Template in Material Template view.

Title: Same Customer Part Number is Automatically Picked for all Sales Organization in a Material
Content: Symptom-When you add a New Sales Organization (Distribution Chain) in a Material, the system by default picks the Customer Part Number of the already existing number in the Sales Organization.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Materials view.-Edit the Material.-Go to Sales tab,-Under distribution chains, Select a Sales Organization and go to Customer part number sub tab.-Where you can find the customer part number is maintained.-Now add a New Sales Organization and directly go to Customer part Number sub tab.-Here you can find the customer part number automatically filled based on the above distribution chain.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-It is not an issue, this is the general behavior of the Business ByDesign system towards the customer part number.-Customer part number will only differ for different products. It will not differ for the same product based on the sales organizations.-That is the reason why the same customer part number is copied for all the sales organizations.-But you can maintain different customer part number for different customers in a same product.

Title: Error Message "X is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value." When Adding State Name
Content: Symptom-When you update State Name for an Organizational Structure, system throws below error message:-X is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight an Org Unit.-Go to Address tab.-Update/Add the Address along with State Name.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you might have selected Enter key just by entering the character X instead of full state code.-Resolution-So, in order to choose the value from the error screen. Select the value from the drop down or type the correct state name and press Enter key in the keyboard. This will refresh the screen and will accept the new value.

Title: Wektra System Connection
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Checking and repairing the connection to the Central Wektra/KTP.-Cause-CTCs are used to correctly configure KTP/WEKTRA connectivity between ByD ABAP tenants and central KTP/WEKTRA server farm.-If the CTC has a wrong configuration data, no Ad-Hoc CTC exists to correct the wrong configuration.-Warning - Do not try to run the configuration CTC a second time for correction.-Resolution-Perform the following to identify the problem, which is related to the Central KTP connection issue.-1. Go to transaction se37 and execute the health check function module WKT_HEALTHCHECK_REP. If ev_code is not equal 0, perform the manual steps to correct KTP/WEKTRA connections.-Manual steps to correct KTP/WEKTRA connections-A proxy reconfiguration is required if return parameter ev_code not equal 0. Depending on the landscape (DEV, VLAB, PROD) the following reports need to be executed to correct the connectivity settings for KTP/WEKTRA.-Use transaction sa38 and execute the following.-WKT_LOGICAL_WS_DEST_CREATE_VLA for Verification Lab-WKT_LOGICAL_WS_DEST_CREATE for Development-WKT_LOGICAL_WS_DEST_CREATE_HOS for Production-The required password for the report can be found in GMP Passvault. Generally, the password should be master password for the corresponding landscape.-Verify Connectivity-1. Go to transaction se37 and execute the health check function module WKT_HEALTHCHECK_REP. The health check should work now and the configuration should be correct. If ev_code is not equal 0, change the proxy settings.  -Change proxy settings-Start the sicf transaction.-1. Select SERVICE for Hierarchy Type and execute.-2. Go to Client Menu -> Proxy Settings (Ctrl F2).-If the message No Proxy for the Following Addresses is displayed, -*.sap.corp;*.sap-ag.de; for internal systems (DEV + VLAB) and byd.sap.corp (for PROD) should be listed and added if not available.-Verify Server Certificate-1. Go to transaction se37 and execute the health check function module WKT_HEALTHCHECK_REP. The health check should work now. If ev_code is not equal 0, check if the load balancer in the server certificate is valid.-Broken Links-Some legacy Wektra redirect links inside the documents or flash may be broken. This is because of the missing alias to virtual host mapping on old tenants. Try the manual steps explained above to correct the KTP Wektra issue.-All WEKTRA/KTP connection settings are client specific. You can verify WEKTRA/KTP connectivity for a whole system by checking the Wily Dashboard of the corresponding landscape.-You can find a WEKTRA metric for each tenant indicating a red or green light in the tenant view.-Created by BYDMS-KB-IM -

Title: Error Message: Cannot change timeline of business residence XYZ (), inventory exists in site XYZ.
Content: Symptom-When you check or activate an Organizational Unit, system throws below error message:-Cannot change timeline of business residence XYZ (), inventory exists in site XYZ-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common tasks.-Highlight the Org unit.-Select Check button and choose Selected Structure.-System throws above error message.-Cause-The cause for the issue that there may be Stocks assigned to this site XYZ. To verify, follow the below steps:--1. Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-2. Select Stock Overview under Common Tasks.-3. Select All Stocks By Selection.-4. Select Advanced Search.-5. Select Site ID as XYZ.--You can find the list of Stocks.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, it is required to move the stocks to another Site.-Please refer to help documents Stock transfer or Intra company Stock Transfer to find the steps to perform.

Title: Error Message: "Creating Employee not possible; number range interval APHCF1_AP_HCF_EMPLOYEE_EXT_01 missing"
Content: Symptom-When you try to create a Service Agent, system throws below error message:-Creating Employee not possible; number range interval APHCF1_AP_HCF_EMPLOYEE_EXT_01 missing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Prepare Phase.-Select Define Key Users of the Project activity.-Select Create Service Agent button.-Cause-The cause for the error message is that there is no number range set in the system for Service Agents.--The deployment might have is not yet done in the system and therefore also no number ranges are available. Which means the scoping activity has not been completed. This has to be done before, so it is possible to define the key user (as here the number ranges are needed). An explicit confirmation is requested by opening of the activity and confirming this milestone.--Hint: The standard number range for service agent IDs is 0 - 6999999. If you have different requirements for service agent IDs, go to the optional Number Ranges for Employees and Service Agents activity in the Fine-Tune phase and make adjustments accordingly.--Then you can able to create a Service Agent without any issues.--Resolution-The system works as designed.-See Also-You can also refer to the document 1781056 - Unable to Create Service Agents in Prepare Phase Activity

Title: Unit of Measure is not Changing for all Parts of a Material
Content: Symptom-You have created a Material with a Base UoM and later decided to change it to another value. When you change the Base UoM in General tab of a Material, the Unit of Measure is not changeable in Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation, and Valuation.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Search and Edit the Material.-Change the Base UoM in the General tab.-But the UoM is changed in Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation, and Valuation.-Cause-1. Once you activate the Base UoM for Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation, and Valuation, then it is not possible to change the value.--2. Even if you maintain Quantity Conversion, that will not work for Planning activity of the Material. Since it is a master data and might have used in Bill Of Material.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-The possible workaround is to create a New material with same type and deactivate the previous material.

Title: How to resolve XML error CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_DATE_TIME on SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- XML-Conversion error: AP-SLO: SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn--Resolving failing XI message for the error : CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_DATE_TIME: XSLT exception at offset-Receiver Interface name: SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn-  Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-The root issue is that the xml message contains incorrect formatted-StartDateTime/EndDateTime for the DeliveryPeriod in the ScheduleLine element:-Check the corresponding tags in the erroneous XML message:-For example:-<ScheduleLine>-<ID>1</ID>-<DeliveryPeriod>-<StartDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">2012-07-24T08:00:00Z<(>-<<)>/StartDateTime>-<EndDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">2012-07-29</EndDateTime>-</DeliveryPeriod>-<Quantity unitCode="EA">96</Quantity>-</ScheduleLine>-The delivery period timestamp(i. e. 2012-07-29) maintained as a part of the item schedule line tag  is not of the right pattern.-It should be of pattern:-yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss(.s+)?Z-Resolution-Please ask the sender to resend the XML it in the correct format:-yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss(.s+)?Z-This means the date 2012-07-29 has to be followed by data in the format-hh:mm:ss(.s+)?Z .-Example:-<ScheduleLine>-<ID>1</ID>-<DeliveryPeriod>-<StartDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">2012-07-24T08:00:00Z<(>-<<)>/StartDateTime>-<EndDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">2012-07-29T08:00:00Z<(>-<<)>/EndDateTime>-</DeliveryPeriod>-<Quantity unitCode="EA">96</Quantity>-</ScheduleLine>-The erroneous messages have to be cancelled.

Title: Newly Created Party Role Is Not Visible in the Value Help when Trying to Assign the Newly Created Role to the List of Involved Party
Content: Symptom-Newly created (party) role are not visible in the value help when trying to assign the newly created role to the list of involved party.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity button and select Fine-Tune.-Select activity Opportunities. A window opens.-Select the link Maintain Involved Parties under Involved Parties.-Select the button Define New Party Role. Add new party role in the new window and select Ok button.-Select Add Row and click the drop down arrow respective to the column Party role.-Where the newly added party role is not visible/available.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-You need to save the newly created party role before using/selecting it. Follow below step to make the newly party role available in the drop down list.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity button and select Fine-Tune.-Select activity Opportunities. A window opens.-Select the link Maintain Involved Parties under Involved Parties.-Select the button Define New Party Role. Add new party role in the new window and select Ok button.-Select Save button.-Select Add Row and click the drop down arrow respective to the column Party role.-Now you can able to find the newly added party role(s) in the drop down list.

Title: Unable to Assign a Service Agent as a Supplier
Content: Symptom-You are not allowed to assign a Supplier role to a Service Agent, since the option is disabled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Business Partner view.-Highlight a Business Partner which has the role Service Agent.-Select Create As button and the Supplier option is disabled.-Resolution-In principle, there are two types of business partners. They are Business partner organizations (Your business partner is a company) and Business partner persons (Your business partner is an individual).-In this case, Business Partner is a Service Agent who represents an individual and for whom you are trying to create a Supplier role which is a Business partner organizations.-This is not possible as per above definition. Hence, the system works as designed.-Note: Supplier role can be assigned only to Business Partner Organizations.

Title: Error Message: Cannot change profit center XYZ; it is assigned to fixed asset
Content: Symptom-When you try to check or activate an Org Unit, system throws below error message:-Cannot change profit center XYZ; it is assigned to fixed asset-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the Org Unit.-Check or Activate it.-Cause-The cause for the error message is that the Profit Center attribute assigned to the Org unit XYZ is split into 2 time periods (DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and DD2.MM2.YYYY2 to DD3.MM3.YYYY3). For Example (01.05.2012 to 31.05.2012 and 01.06.2012 to Unlimited) This can be verified in the Timelines tab of the Org Unit XYZ.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, follow the below steps:-1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures and set the effective from date as appropriate-3. Search and highlight the Org unit XYZ.-4. Go to Timelines tab.-5. For profit center, replace the Valid To as DD3.MM3.YYYY3 from DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and select Enter key in the keyboard.-6. Now, go to Definitions tab.-7. Uncheck the Profit Center.-8. Select Check button and choose Check Selected and Dependent Org Units.

Title: Unable to Delete Distribution Chains from Material/Service Since Remove Button is Disabled
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to remove some of the Distribution Chains from a Material or Service, but the Remove button is disabled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Service or Material view.-Edit a Service or Material.-Go to Sales tab.-Cause-In Sales tab of a Service/Material, Once you activate a Distribution Chain then it is not possible to remove the entry from the Service/Material. Service and Material are Master Datas, so it is not allowed to remove because it may result in inconsistency in the document which ever is using this Service/Material.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-So, you are only allowed to Block the Distribution Chain from the Service or Material which intern will not allow any business transaction document to use this Distribution Chain of this particular Service or Material.--The Remove is enabled only for the Distribution Chains which are in the status Initial and In Preparation.

Title: Error Message: Cannot change cost center XYZ (); it is assigned to Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate an Organizational Structure, system throws below error message for some Cost Center-Cannot change cost center XYZ (); it is assigned to Fixed Asset-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-User created new Profit Centers in the Org Structure.-Highlight the Org Structure.-Select Activate All button.-Note: In the system many Fixed Assets were migrated with only Cost Center but without Profit Center.-Cause-The reason for having Fixed Assets which were created/migrated only with Cost Center and without Profit Center is,-Fixed assets have already been created in the system for the cost center. So it is not possible to change it. Further you have not activated profit center reporting.--Please refer to our help center for document Reporting Principle. The reporting principle used in your set of books is Function of costs format.--If you have selected profit center accounting and segment reporting for a set of books, the system automatically enters the profit center and segment in the line items of journal entries created from source documents. Please refer to our help center for document Derivation of Profit Centers and Segments. It explains the prerequisites need to be fulfilled for the derivation of profit centers and segments:-Resolution-To resolve the issue create a new Organizational Assignment Interval in the affected fixed assets. The start date of the interval should be after the last posting date on the cost Center and a date before the Profit Center assignment changes in Organizational Management was done.--This will resolve all issues. Use this method as standard for all future changes.

Title: Unable to do Mass Change for User Specific Extension Fields in Product Data Work Center
Content: Symptom-You have some extension fields created for the Materials. When you try to do Mass Change, the header cell of those extension fields are read only.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select the Material, that needs to Mass Changed.-In the new screen, the header cell for the extension field is read only.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-It is not possible to Mass Change the values in user specific extension fields.

Title: Unable to Check Depreciation Method to Exact Date for Depreciation Method XYZ
Content: Symptom-When you try to check/choose Depreciation Method to Exact Date for the Depreciation Method XYZ, the check box is grey out/read only.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open activity list button.-Select Fine-Tune chevron.-Select Depreciation Methods activity.-Select XYZ.-Under Calculation Parameters, the checkbox Depreciation Method to Exact Date cannot be checked.-Cause-The options Depreciation Only If No Special Depreciation and Depreciation Method to Exact Date are disabled, as per below conditions:-Depreciation Only If No Special Depreciation-1. Suspends depreciation in the case of special depreciation.-2. Set this checkbox if the system should not calculate depreciation when special depreciation is posted.-Depreciation Method to Exact Date-1. You can define that the system calculates depreciation for exact days. The period control rules of the depreciation method then no longer apply over the entire life of the fixed assets concerned.-2. Select this indicator if required.-Note: You cannot switch this setting on or off for a fixed asset if the asset has been posted to, even if you change the depreciation method.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-You can also refer help center documentation Configuration: Depreciation Methods for further details.

Title: Error Message: Only one default for usage BILL_TO permitted for org. centre XYZ () from DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1
Content: Symptom-When you try to check or activate the Org Unit XYZ, system throws below error message-Only one default for usage BILL_TO permitted for org. centre XYZ (Org Unit name) from DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1-Only one default address permitted for org. centre XYZ (Org Unit name) from DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the Org Unit XYZ.-Select Check or Activate.-Cause-The cause for the error message is, Bill-To Address and Main Address have two addresses maintained from DD.MM.YYYY to Unlimited. i.e., for a particular period of time 2 addresses were maintained, which actually results in overlapping.-This can be verified in Timelines tab of XYZ in Planning Area.-Resolution-To resolve the issue,--1. Go to Organizational management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-3. Highlight the Org Unit XYZ-4. Go to Timelines tab.-5. Change the Valid To date a for both Bill- To and main address to a date which doesn't overlap.-6. Check the consistency of the Org Unit.

Title: Is it Possible to Import the List of Industries in General Business Partners Activity
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have a requirement to add hundreds of Industries into the system through General Business partner Activity but there is no way to import. You can find the complete list of SAP delivered Industries in Translate option and would like to whether to have User defined Industries also like that way?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Fine Tune chevron.-Search and Open General Business Partner fine tuning activity.-Select Maintain Industries link.- Resolution-The system works as designed.-It is not possible to import the industries and only option is add manually one by one.-It is not possible to have user defined industries as like the sap pre-delivered industries in Translate section of General Business Partner fine tuning activity.-What is the usage of translate option in Maintain Industries?-SAP Business ByDesign (ByD) has explanations in multiple languages when pre-defined by SAP. But for customer defined industry, the customer needs to maintain the explanation in more than one language if you need them.-For example, a user logs in with the German language and creates an industry named Z1 and marks explanation in German, the user can find German explanation, but no other languages will be translated automatically.

Title: Error Message 'Enter a service agent ID between XXX and YYYY' when Hiring an Employee
Content: Symptom-When hiring an employee, you may get the below error message:-Enter a service agent ID between XXXX and YYYY-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Personnel Administration.-Select the view Regular Tasks.-Under the Hiring section select the link Hire Employee.-Fill in the mandatory details in step one (Enter Personal Data), which are marked by an asterisk.-Select the button Next.-System may throw the above error message.-Cause-There may be two causes for this issue:-The Employee ID you entered is not in range of the values set in Fine Tuning activity Number Ranges for Employees and Service agents. -The Employee IDs are used up.-Resolution-The employee ID which you are using to create an employee is not in range of the values you configured in the Fine Tuning activity Number Ranges for Employees and Service Agents.-You can check the number ranges configured in the Fine Tuning activity:-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Select the view Activity List.-Select the arrow Fine-Tune.-Search for the Fine Tuning activity Number Ranges for Employees and Service Agents and select the link Number Ranges for Employees and Service Agents. A new window will open.-In the new window, select the Number range for employees row from available number ranges.-Solution 1:-If ID of the employee entered is not within the configured number range, you have to enter the employee ID within the range as per the fine tuning configuration (can be verified as above).-Solution 2:-If configured IDs are used up, follow the below steps to change the number range then enter a new ID:-Select Number range for employees row from available Number Ranges.-Select on the value of End Number and increase the range of number of employees.-Select the button Save and Close.-You should get a confirmation message: Your settings are saved and deployed successfully.-Select the button OK.-Now, the number range has sufficient free numbers to be used for newly hired employees.

Title: Error Message: Cannot delete cost center (); used by an overhead rule in accounting
Content: Symptom-When you try to delete an Org Unit and activate the changes, system throws below error message:-Cannot delete cost center (); used by an overhead rule in accounting-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Cost Center that you are try to delete is used for creating a Overhead Rate and Overhead Rate is still active in the system.-Resolution-If you want to delete the Cost Center, then the Overhead Rate should be deleted from the system. The steps are as follows,-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Select Edit Overhead Rate under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Overhead Rate ID.-Select Delete button-Select Save and Close button.-Now, you can able to delete the Org Unit which is marked as Cost Center.-Note:-If you have a Cost Center which is not required anymore, then there are two ways to make it unavailable from the Organizational Structure.--1. Delimit the Org Unit on today or a future date (Recommended).-2. Delete the Org Unit from the Org Structure.-The main difference between delimit and delete is, deleting an Org Unit will complete erase the Org unit from the system but delimiting will keep the Org unit in the system but in inactive status from the date you delimited it.

Title: Expense Report Shows Cost Center Manager as Approver Instead of Real Approver
Content: Symptom-You can see that the expense reports shows approver as cost center manager instead of who actually approved it.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the Expense Reports view.-Select All Expense Reports in Show field.-Where you can see the approver name in Approver column.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-Within the expense report, the approver is determined according to the assigned cost center or the assigned project task. The determined responsible approver's name is always shown in the Expense Report OWL, whereas the real approver can only changes the status but will not be shown in the Expense Report OWL.--You can see the actual approver from the Change History tab of the expense report, whose status is set to Released.-For Example:-If a cost center manager creates an expense report, this report will be sent to himself/herself for approval because he/she is the responsible approver for all the expense reports charged to the cost center. So even he/she forwards the expense report to his/her higher Org Unit Manager who performs the approval task, this only changes the status of expense report, but not the approver name. From the Change History tab of the expense report, you can see that Org Unit Manager has set the status to Released.

Title: How System Calculates Balance of Accural Time Account
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, run the Time Accounts report to show the balance of time accounts. You may think the balance of some employees' accural time accounts incorrect.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Reports view.-Select Time Accounts report.-Filter with the respective employee or the time account.-Where you think the data (hours) displaying for balance of accural account is incorrect.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-If there is an accural assigned to a time account which is associated with an employee, then the accural (in hours) will be added to the employee's time account at the specific time monthly.-Example:-If Taken is X hours and the Accural is Y hours, then the balance will be calculated as Balance = Y - X.-How to verify the accural and deductions of an employee?-1. Go to Personal Administartion work center.-2. Select Employees view.-3. Select employee and select Edit button.-4. Go to tab Time Account Balances, Select Quota Account XYZ with respect to the month.-5. Under the Postings tab, you can see the Deductions and the accural.

Title: Save Failed While Trying to Rehire an Employee
Content: Symptom-You, as a HR administrator try to rehire an employee but system may throws the below error message when saving:-Rehire Activity Failed.-Strat date date must not be later than end date.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select the employee.-Select the Actions button and choose Rehire Employee.-Fill in the mandatory details and select Save button.-System throws the above error message.-Cause-The cause of this error is because the Payroll Group assigned to the employee is still active which was used for his/her first-time hire.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, the condition needs to be checked.-The payroll group assignment used for the employee during the first time hire should be after the first hire date and should end before the second hire date.-Example:-If the first hire and termination date of an employee is 1/1/2001 and 1/10/2005, the second hire date is 12/10/2010, then the payroll group assignment used for the employee in first hire should start after on 2/1/2001 and end on or before 11/10/2010.-If you correct this data, the rehire scenario should work fine.

Title: When Editing Time Entry, Newly Changed Names of the Project Task is not Reflecting in the Value Help
Content: Symptom-When the user created the project <xyz> and the project tasks were named as <xxx1> and <xxx2> . Now the tasks names were changed to <yyy1> and <yyy2> but this changes is not reflected in the value help when doing time sheet entry.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Edit time sheet link under Common Tasks.-Select Value help on the task.-The shown project tasks in the value help doesnt show the correct description in the time sheet itself. Where as, in the worklist the correct description is shown.-Cause-A single change of the task name/description is not reflected in the worklist due to missing functionality.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-In current release, it is not possible that A single change of the task name/description is not reflected in the worklist.-But below steps can be followed to overcome this issue,-If changing the task name together with the task's planned period or responsible, the worklist should reflect those changes. Afterwards the planned period or the responsible can be reset to the previous content.

Title: Unable to Find Newly Created Org Units When Trying to Transfer an Employee
Content: Symptom-You create a new Org Unit in Organizational Management work center and want to transfer some employees to this newly created Org Unit. When you try to transfer an employee, you cannot find the Org Unit which is created just now.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Transfer Employee link.-Fill in Transfer Date.-Select the value help of Org Unit under New Organizational Assignment.-Where you cannot find the newly created Org Unit.-Assumption:-The Transfer date entered in the screen is later than the current system date.-The Effective from date of the newly created Org Unit is same as the Transfer Date.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-The value help of org unit in Employee Transfer screen by default is showing all valid org units as of the current system date.
