Since the Effective from date of the newly created org unit is same as the Transfer Date and later than current date, system is not listing this org unit which is invalid on the current date.-Workaround:-Select the Value help for the org unit in the Transfer Employee screen and select the link Advanced Search.-Enter the Valid On date (which should be equal or greater than the effective date of newly created org units).-Enter the ID of the OrgUnit in the Find field or through the field Org Unit ID.-Select Go button.-Now the org unit should appear in the list and can be selected.-However, it should show all org units which are valid as of the transfer date, similar to the behavior of the value helps in the Hire and Rehire screens, which will be available in the future release.

Title: Warning Message 'No bank details maintained for the partner' When Select Bank Transfer as Payment Method
Content: Symptom-When you select Bank Transfer as a payment method for an employee, you may receive the below warning message:-No bank details maintained for the partner.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Personnel Administration.-Select view Employees.-Select an employee.-Select Edit button.-Go to tab Personal Data and select sub-tab Payment Information.-Select Payment Method as Bank Transfer.-System may throw the above warning message.-Cause-Since bank details are not configured for an employee so you are getting this warning message.-Resolution-Go to work center Home.-Select view Self-services.-Select Edit Payment Information link under Compensation.-Here an employee can select payment method and configure the bank account details.-You can receive your regular payments by check or directly transferred into your bank account. Any changes made to your bank account details are automatically reflected in the system.

Title: Country Field Becomes Mandatory When Mail Address Is Entered during Hiring an Employee
Content: Symptom-While you hire an employee, initially the field Country is not indicated as mandatory field (without asterisk). After you fill up some fields (such as Mail Address), the field Country becomes mandatory (with asterisk shown).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Personnel Administration.-Select view Regular Tasks.-Select the link Hire Employee under section Hiring. A new window opens.-By Default Country field appears as optional.-Select any country under Country field. Now Country field becomes mandatory.-Cause-System is working as designed.-Country is not a mandatory field here. The Country field is a part of the employee's Mail Address, which a user does not have to enter in Hire Employee. Therefore the Country field is initially not mandatory (without an asterisk).--However, when you decide to enter the employee's Mail Address, it requires Country as prerequisite to enable the rest of the address fields. In this case, the Country field becomes mandatory and, thus, is getting marked with an asterisk.

Title: No Logistics Areas are Available for Selection After Assigning XYZ as Site While Creating a Labor Resource
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of creating a new Labor Resource and have observed that after assigning the XYZ as Site there is no Logistics Area available in the value Help.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue or Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Resources view.-Select New button and choose Labor Resource.-In General tab, assign Site XYZ.-Select the value help for Logistics Area.-Cause-The cause for this is that there is no logistics area created for the Site XYZ.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, it is required to create new logistics area for the Site XYZ. This can be done as follows,-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Locations view.-Highlight the Site XYZ and select Edit button.-Check Logistics Relevance check box. Please note, once it is checked then it cannot be reverted.-Save the changes.-Select Edit Layout button.-Here you can create Logistics area. Then it can be used in the Labor Resource for the Site XYZ.

Title: Error "No vaild target account found for source account" when Delimiting Time Profile in Employee's Time File
Content: Symptom-When you add one new time profile to delimit the existing time profile in employee's time file, system may throw the below error message:-Saving failed-No vaild target account found for source account XYZ (DD.MM.YYYY - DD.MM.YYYY) in <(DD.MM.YYYY)1>-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Adninistration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select the required employee and select Edit button.-Go to Time Profile tab.-Select the Add Row button.-Input the date in the Start date and Unlimited in the End date in the newly added row.-Select Save button.-System may throw the above error message.-Cause-The cause of the error message is that the current time profile has time account XYZ assigned. The assigned time account XYZ has a period end rule of posting type Carry Forward. Therefore the newly created time profile should have the same time account type XYZ assigned, that the balance of XYZ can be forwarded to the new time profile.--Resolution-It is recommended to copy the existing time profile instead of creating a new one to delimit the time profile. The advantage is that the copied time profile has the same time accounts and the work schedule as the old one. Then the work schedule can be reassigned for the employee:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Employees view and select the respective employee .-Select Time Profile tab, where you can select Copy button by selecting the last time profile (i.e. first row of the time profile).-After performing above task, the work schedule can be assigned to this time time in the Work schedule sub-tab.

Title: Golden Tax Number Not Available in Balance Confirmation Print Form and Financial Reports
Content: Symptom-Golden tax number as received from Golden tax system in China is now available in multiple financials screens and print forms. However, it is not shown in Balance confirmation form and the financial reports yet.-Reproducing the Issue-1. In the Customer Invoicing work center, check for invoices that you need to send to the Golden Tax System. Mark the identified invoices as Golden Tax relevant and prepare a text file for import into Golden Tax software installed on the local PC. At this time, the system blocks the customer invoice release to accounting.-2. Download the 'outbound' file from the system to the local PC.-3. Log into the Golden Tax System on your PC and import this file. Downloaded invoices are visible in the Golden Tax System. You can print or cancel invoices and generate reports.-4. All the printed invoices receive a unique number from the Golden Tax System, which is referred to as the Golden Tax number. Select the Export option in the Golden Tax System to create an inbound file and upload the file to the system, using the attachment service.-5. The system updates the Golden Tax relevant customer invoice with the Golden Tax number and the invoice data is transferred to financials.-You can see the Golden Tax Number in all the FIN screens except the Balance Confirmation Print Form and Financial Reports-Cause-In the current release, the system does not support this issue.-Resolution-Currently there are no resolution or workaround for this limitation.

Title: Is it Possible to Extend Service Agent ID Field to a Report or Another Screen?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to extend the fields like Service Agent ID, First name and Last name to another screen or report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select New Service Agent from Common Tasks.-Select Adapt and choose Adaptation Mode.-Again select Adapt and choose Edit Screen option.-Select Extension Field in the Side Bar.-There is no option for extending Service Agent ID field.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-It is not possible to extend a system defined field to another screen or report. You can only extend an Extension Field created for a screen to another screen.-If you want to have a Service Agent ID field in a screen, then you can create the extension field in that screen.

Title: Error Message "Sales organization for sales unit XYZ missing in master data"
Content: Symptom-When you assign a Sales Unit XYZ to any Sales documents like Sales Order, Service Order, Leads or Opportunities, system throws below error message:-Sales organization for sales unit XYZ missing in master data-Cause-There is no Sales Organization exist for Sales Unit XYZ.-Because, when you assign a Sales Unit to a sales documents, system should find a Sales Organization. Which means, there should be a Sales Organization for the Org Unit XYZ in the same hierarchy above it or the Org unit XYZ itself can be a Sales Organization.-Resolution-To overcome the issue, you can either make the Org Unit XYZ as a Sales Organization or any Org Unit which is above the hierarchy.

Title: System Dumps, While Saving a New Material
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the User try to save a New Material, system throws Exception.-Dump Details:-METHOD save_step_number_ranges.-Application Info:-Index Information-1 CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:CL_PRD_PRODUCT_ID=============CP, Include:CL_PRD_PRODUCT_ID=============CM009, Position:1-2 Info: An exception with the type CX_RCNR_FOREIGN_LOCK occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-3 CX_RCNR_FOREIGN_LOCK, Program:CL_RCNR_UTILITY===============CP, Include:CL_RCNR_UTILITY===============CM005, Position:122-4 Info: Record is locked by another application-- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select New Material under Common Tasks.-Enter the mandatory details.-Select Save button.-Cause-The main cause for the issue might be because of below reasons,--At the time of creating a New Material, if the browser closed abruptly or if the session expires (Time Out). Then a temporary lock will be created in generating the material ID.-Resolution-This is a temporary issue and user can able to create new material.

Title: Substitute of a Manager Cannot Able to Find the Employees Belongs to that Manager
Content: Symptom-A Manager assigned a Employee/Manager as a substitute but in Call Employee Services on behalf feature, employee those who belongs to Manager is not visible to the substitute.-Reproducing the Issue-Assigning a Employee or another Manager as a substitute for a Manager.-Login with the credentials of the Employee who was assigned as a substitute.-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Select Call Employee Services on Behalf under Common Tasks.-No employee are listed.-Cause-At present, a substitute can able to find the Tasks of the Manager and can do required actions on that but the employees belongs to that Manager will not be visible to the substitute-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current release of Business ByDesign and this feature is already added a requirement for one of the future releases.

Title: System Dumps While Adding a New Rule in Work Distribution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the End-user try to add a new rule in any of the Work Distribution rule, system throws exception with below details,-Error ID: TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED-Abap Runtime Error Details: TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED-Source Code Extract: Main Program SAPMHTTP, Program CL_ESF_LCP_BUFFER=============CP, Include CL_ESF_LCP_BUFFER=============CM002, Event GET_REF_TO_LOCAL_COPY, Line 23-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Organizational Work Distribution view.-Select Group by as Business Area.-Highlight Sales Unit for Sale and select Edit button.-Go to Account tab (bottom of the screen).-Select Add Item button and Chose any account from the value help.-Select Ok button and select Save button.-Dump occurs (loads until 80 percent/ dump appears after that).-Cause-The root cause is a known limitation of the RSP component. Generally we cannot scope with the amount of work distribution data the customer have in the system. That is there are many work distribution rules exist in the system, hence it is not possible to add more row for that Work Distribution rule.-Resolution-So this issue can be resolved by deleting the outdated rules regarding work distribution category Sales unit for sales. As a consequence of this action the customer won't be able to see work distribution settings as they were in the past and Present settings will not be touched.-This action requires the end user approval.

Title: Loss of Manually Selected Activities
Content: Symptom-You find a lot of manually selected activities disappear from activity list.-Reproducing the Issue-1 Go to WoC: Business Configuration-2 Go to View: Implementation Projects-3 Select the project-4 Click Open Activity List-5 Go to Fine Tunning-6 You find some activities disappear and some activities change status.-Cause-The issue will happen if the following steps are performed:-You have already added activities in the activity list.-You open the scoping and click Save Draft.-You close the scoping without finish.-You open the scoping again and click Finish.-Step 3 will lead to the loss or status change of manually selected activities. It should be avoided in operation.-Resolution-Re-add the activities to activity list.

Title: Product ID is Same for all the Products Which Were Exported to Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You have exported the Products into the Microsoft Excel but the all the Products have same ID.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select the list of Materials.-Select Export button and choose To Microsoft Excel.-Cause-The issue is not with the SAP delivered template. The issue is due to the user modified template. The issue has occurred because the formula (for the Product ID column) is wrong-Resolution-Replace the modified/customized excel with SAP delivered template. -Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Flexibility view.-Select Office Template Maintenance sub view.-Highlight the Row List of materials with Template Group as Materials - Work list, <language>  and Template Type Microsoft Excel (Export).-Select Upload button and choose Replace Existing Language Variant.-Select Browse button and select the excel attached.- Select Ok button.-Now you can able to export the Materials without any issues.

Title: What Is the Difference between Terminate Relationship With an Employee and Terminate Relationship with Employees in Payroll
Content: Symptom-Users want to know if an employee can be terminated anywhere other than the Personnel Administration work center.-There is confusion between the tasks Terminate Relationship With an Employee and Terminate Relationship with Employees in Payroll.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The termination process starts in the Personnel Administration work center and task Terminate Relationship with Employee. There is no other place to terminate the relationship with employee in the system. Users, as a personnel administrator, should be aware that some follow-up activities must be done for a terminated employee.-For the necessary follow-up activities in Time Administration and Compensation, business tasks to review the employee's time data and compensation data upon termination are generated and displayed in the Work views of the respective work center. These business tasks must be processed and completed as well.-Finally, as a follow-up activity to stop Payroll Processing for the employee, the Inactive option in Payroll checkbox has to be selected in the employee's personnel file. This may have to be done only some time later, in case payments to the employee have to be processed through Payroll after his/her termination date. This is described in more details in help document Terminating Relationship with Employee in Payroll. -Keywords-Offboarding, Separation, End of employment, Exit process, Post-termination steps, Final payment, Last working day, Deactivation, Pay run stop, Wage stoppage, Remuneration stop, Benefits end, Offboarding workflow, HR offboarding, Final settlement

Title: Specific Employee is Missing in Managing My Area of his/her Manager
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For a Manager, a particular employee is missing in Call Employee Service on Behalf option in Managing My Area work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Select Call Employee Services on Behalf under common tasks.-Here the particular employee is missing in the list.-Cause-The ACL-entries (Access Control List) of that employee is incorrect which is caused by the inconsistency during transferring of that employee.-Resolution-The ACL entries need to be refreshed in the backend to resolve the issue.-How to check the ACL of an employee?-Login to the backend system-Call transaction SESFTS-Enter Employee and press Return key in the keyborad.-Search for employee via query Identification->QUERY_BY_EMPLOYEE_ATTRIB e.g. enter EmployeeID in field ‘EmployeeID/content’-Navigate from Identification Node to Root Node-Navigate from Root to Access_Control_List-Navigate from Access_Control_List.Root to Access_Control_List.Entry-Here you should find at least 3 entries for an internal employee if HCM is active:-1007 that contains the Company uuid of the employee-1003 that contains the Reporting Line Unit uuid of the employee-1000 that contains the Employee uuid of the employee-Sometimes the entry 1003 (and 1007) is missing. In this case the employee is not visible in Managing My Area.-You can refresh the entries if you navigate back to the root node-Change to Edit Mode-Execute Action Adjust_Responsible_Agent-Navigate to Access_Control_List.Entry again and check the entries.-If the entry 1003 exists you can save your changes if the customer agrees(approval from customer required). Then the employee should be visible in MMA.-

Title: Error Message Cannot delete supply chain property on org unit XYZ; used in logistics
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate an Org Unit XYZ, system throws below error message:-Cannot delete supply chain property on org unit XYZ; used in logistics-Operation not possible; perm. estblmt. referenced by material ABC-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures in Common Tasks.-Activate the Org Unit XYZ or activate the Org Structure.-Cause-You attempted to delete an org unit with the function Warehousing assigned to it or you attempted to delete the Warehousing function from an org unit.-However, the inbound logistics unit is referenced from an inbound delivery. For this reason, the system has prevented the deletion.-And the respective Business Residence/Planning Area is assigned to a Material which is active.-So, once an org unit assigned as a site and planning area, it is not possible to delete the org unit.-Resolution-In principle, it is not possible to delete an org unit which carries certain properties that are referenced from Supply chain Management processes or other master data (Material referencing the Site/SPA, Warehousing Function).-To overcome the issue, follow the below steps:-Step 1: Block the site XYZ:-1. Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-2. Select Locations view.-3. Highlight the site XYZ and select edit button.-4. Select Change Status button and choose Block.-5. Select Save and Close button.-Note: Once the site is blocked, the respective Planning area assigned to the material will also get blocked.-Step 2: Revert the deleted org unit XYZ.-1. Go to Organizational management work center.-2. Select Edit button.-3. Select Roll Back button to revert to the last valid active version of the org structure.-Note: Please be advised that this also removes all other changes done to any organizational unit since the last activation as indicated by the confirmation pop-up.-Step 3: Delimit the Org unit XYZ.-After Roll Back, you could able to find the org unit XYZ in the Planning Area. Now, delimit the org unit on a future date.-1. Set the Effective From date on a Future date.-2. Highlight the org unit XYZ.-3. Select Edit Org Unit button and choose End Validity. So Org unit XYZ no longer displayed. The end date has been set to a date before the current effective-from date.-Note: If the effective from date is 11/02/2012, then the validity of the org unit end by 10/02/2012.

Title: Expense Report Status Instantly Changed to Approved instead of In Audit or In Approval
Content: Symptom-When you create and save an Expense Report, the status of the report changes immediately to Approved instead of going through the normal flow of In Audit and In Approval.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the New Expense Report under Common Tasks.-After completing the Expense Report, the status changes to Approved.-Cause-In Business Configuration, if you maintain a Minimum Amount and if you create an Expense Report with an amount less than the Minimum Amount, the audit and/or approval is not required and the report gets approved automatically. This can be verified as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune chevron.-Open the Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management activity.--Resolution-If you create an Expense Report with amount XY which is less than the Minimum Amount maintained in the above fine tuning activity then the Expense Report is not sent for audit and/or approval.-The system works as designed.

Title: System Dumps when Removing a Time Entry in Employee's Time Sheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the customer tries to remove a particular time entry in employee's time sheet, system may throw exception.-Reproducing the Issue-1.       Go to the Time Administration work center.-2.       Select the Employees view. -3.       Select the respective employee and select the Edit button.-4.       Select the Employee Times tab.-5.       Highlight a time entry and select the Remove button, or change the Valid To date.-6.       Select the Save button. -System may throw an exception.-Cause-The cause is that the customer might have migrated the time entry through data migration with Valid To as Unlimited (31.12.9999). Actually it is not possible to record times like this, hence currently there is no way to delete them in the frontend.-Resolution-Get the approval from customer for deleting these entries at backend and forward the incident to CSS component SRD-HR-TLM.

Title: SAP Operating System Collector Not Running
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The SAP Operating System Collector (SAPOSCOL) is not running.- The SAPOSCOL collects information about the operating system, without this it is not possible to monitor Operating System.-Cause-SAPOSCOL in a SAP system.-SAPOSCOL is running on any instance of the SAP system. It measures for example the following things:-CPU Usage-Disk Performance-Swapping-Memory Usage-LAN Statistics-File System status-Paging-Top CPU Consumers-Hardware Information-All of this measured data can be viewed in transaction ST06. It is collected mostly for 24 hours. So, you are able to investigate the current situation and the history. That explains the special advantage to many simple OS tools, that just let you know the snapshot, but mostly not the last hours.- Resolution-Log in to back end of the particular system.-Call transaction ST06 and refresh with the time stamp.-If recent data is not available, restart SAPHOSTAGENT.-Log in to OS Llvel with <sid>adm.-Cd /usr/sap/hostctrl/exe/saposcol -restart-./saposcol start to directly--s  - status of OSCOL.--d  -  dialog mode.                                --k  -  kill running collector.                     --r  -  kill running collector and print results.   --l  -  launch/start the collector.                       --f  -  launch the collector in any case.         --s  -  show collector status.                      --i  -  set new collecting interval.               --v  -  show collector version.                     --u  -  time until collector becomes idle.      --e  -  interval when collector is idle.           --c  -  clean shared memory.                      --p  -  put shared memory to file.                  --g  -  get shared memory from file.          --t  -  set debug trace level.                     --n  -  set normal trace level.                      --o  -  print all data.                             --m  -  print all snapshot data.                    --x  -  test background process running and answers.-saposcol  -d to debugger mode is done when the system is in shutdown state, you have to clear the live cache memory which is available in col.put directory.-Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: Process Communication Error:Changes not Permitted; task XYZ1 is blocked, closed, or stopped
Content: Symptom-You as Administrator, observed the below process Communication Error for one of the Project in the system:-Title: Solve Business Document Inconsistency in Project XYZ to process Employee Time Confirmation-Message: Changes not Permitted; task XYZ1 is blocked, closed, or stopped-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Overview view.-Select Open Errors with tasks under Process Communication Errors.-Select the respective task and select Open Task Detail button.-Cause-When an employee records times on a project, some messages are sent to Project Management and Accounting. A user cannot record times on a project if it is 'closed', 'stopped' or 'on hold'. Additionally the user receives a warning if the times recorded would lead to messages sent to Accounting for closed accounting periods.-If employee times are changed (at a later stage), messages are recalculated and it is checked if there have been changes relevant to Project Management or Accounting. In that case new messages are sent and the earlier ones are cancelled. If the assignment of an employee to a cost center or job has changed, then the determination of the Labour Resource of the employee may change. This can also happen in case the definition of the Labour Resource has changed, leading to a different Labour Resource being determined for an employee. Please note that this is only relevant if the Labour Resource determination changes, but not in such cases as cost rate changes.-If a change in Labour Resource determination is starting with some date in the past, more precisely for a period where times have already been recorded and messages sent to Accounting, then these times may have been posted to a wrong Labour Resource (and possibly wrong Cost Center). For this reason a recalculation of earlier sent messages may lead to resending message with different Labour Resource.-Resolution-To solve the error, proceed as follows:-Open the Project XYZ in Project Management work center.-Select View All button and navigate to the project task.-Change the task as follows: If the status of the project task is Stopped or Closed, revoke the stopping or closure. Or if the On Hold checkbox is selected for the project task , uncheck the checkbox.-Note: The status of a project and its tasks, including the option to put a project or task on hold, is automatically inherited to all subordinate tasks below it. If the entire project or a superordinate task is stopped or closed, you must first revoke this status; this status is then automatically revoked for all subordinate tasks. If the entire project or the superordinate task is on hold, you must first uncheck this checkbox; the On Hold checkbox of all subordinate tasks is then also removed automatically.-Save the changes.-The system sets the status of the project task to Released and On Hold is no longer selected.-Restart the process by selecting the Restart Process in the Process Communication Error screen.-Result: The system updates the project task accordingly.-Note: Check if it should be permitted to add further postings to the project task .-If further postings are to be permitted, no further actions are required.-If no further posting are permitted, close / stop / block the project task again.

Title: Production Bill of Material/Variant Update Not Supported
Content: Symptom-Production Bill of Material (PBoM)/Variant update is not supported in current release.-When a new version of a Product Design is released, the current lean handover to the PBoM can neither create a new Variant for an existing PBoM, nor update an existing Variant. System will always create an individual NEW Variant of a NEW PBoM for each handover.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Development work center.-Select the Product Designs view.-Show All Product Design Versions.-Select the respective Product Design with status Released and select the Edit button.-Select the Convert to Production BoM button.-In the pop-up window, enter a new value in the BoM ID field to create a new Production Bill Of Material.-Select the Ok button.-Select the Where Used tab.-You can see the new BoM that was created in the Production BoM table with BoM Variant as 1.-Cause-System does not support creation of a new BoM Variant for an existing BoM ID nor update of existing BoM Variant.-Resolution-This feature will be supported in a future release.

Title: Automated Tasks in Error Detected
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Automated tasks are used for asynchronous update processing. If these tasks have the Error status, the business data does not reflect the latest changes. The system expects this data to be up to date. -Reproducing the Issue-1. Log in to the back end of the system with SP_ADMIN_L6 - Full System Access by requesting user from Service Provider Cockpit.-2. Go to transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL.-SBTM_TASK_SEL : Task Instance monitor gives task type, description, priority.-3. Enter the TASK TYPE ID mentioned in the Error Information Section of the incident.-Enter STATUS = E (means error).-Press Execute F8.--Cause-If the BTM tasks have the error status, the business data does not reflect the latest changes.-The system expects this data to be up to date.-This results in a health check.-Resolution-For each task displayed:-1. Select the task by selecting the Task Instance ID.-2. Select the Restart button in the Details tab.--3. After all the tasks are restarted, select the refresh button.-4. If the restart is not working, send the incident to the corresponding development component. The component for which the incident is to be forwarded can found in the error description of the incident.-Created by BYDMS-KB-IM

Title: Price component 0TTE (Tax) appears when assigning price components
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When assigning price components for profitability structures (income statement by function of expense) you see a price component 0TTE (Tax...). This price component is not relevant for profitability and should not appear in the list.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Call up the activity list in 'Fine Tuning' from the 'Business Configuration' work center-2. Select the activity Settings for 'Earned Profit Analysis or Settings for Invoice and Order Profit Analysis'.-3. Choose Edit 'Financial Reporting Structures':-a) Select a structure of the type 'Income Statement by Function of Expense' and choose 'Edit Structure':-b) You are now in the 'Financial reporting structure'. To add a 'Price component' to an item of the structure, select a line of the 'Structure', choose 'Assign', and select 'Price Components' in the dropdown list.-c) On the left side of the below screen you may select the price component you want to assign. On the right side, you may select the item to which you want to assign the component.Then click Add.-In this case we can see the price component 0TTE (Tax) appears on the list. This is due to an incorrect system behaviour. -Standard Recommendation-The following list shows the available price components and the financial structure items to which they can be assigned. These assignments are only a recommendation.-Price Component-Description Financial Structure Item-7PR1 List Price Gross Revenues-7PR6 Product Discount Sales Discounts-7PR7 Service Type Gross Revenue-7PR8 Freight Gross Revenue-7PR9 Warranty Gross Revenue-7PRC Goodwill Gross Revenue-7PRA Quality Lost Deduct Sales Discounts-7PRB Restocking Fee Gross Revenue-7PRE Migration Price Gross Revenue-0007 Overall Discount (%) Sales Discounts-0008 Costs Cost of Goods Sold-DIFF Rounding Differences Gross Revenue-Cause-The filter of the price types is not set up correctly. You can find the logic for the price types that are extracted in /APC/CL_BI_SLO_PRICING->retreive_item, line 214.                -The logic of determining the category code from the condition class (PRCC_COND_CT-KOAID) and the condition sign (PRCC_COND_CT-KNEGA) is as follows:                                                      -KOAID = 'A' and KNEGA = 'X' => category code = 2 (discount) -KOAID = 'A' and KNEGA = 'A' => category code = 3 (surcharge) -KOAID = 'B'                        => category code = 1 (price)-KOAID = 'D'                        => category code = 4 (tax)-Resolution-If price component 0TTE (Tax) appears, this is a bug.-In fact, tax components are not reported under profitability and should not be assigned.-The incident can be forwarded to SRD-FIN-ANA

Title: Profit reports show wrong or no market segment attributes after maintaining the market segment attributes for cost centers and customers
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Even after you maintained the market segment attributes for cost centers and customers the profit reports still shows the wrong market segment attributes or none at all.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Select any of the profitability reports. For example, the 'Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme' report-2. You will see that the report shows wrong or no 'Market Segment' attributes.-3. When you check the 'Market Segment' attributes for cost centers and customers you can see that are correctly defined.-You may check the 'Market Segment' attributes as follow:-Organizational management workcenter-Edit the Organizational Structure-Select the definition tab-Select a segment, for example 'Cost Center' then details-Cause-The replication of these attributes is done once every 24 hours. This means that the results will not show up immediately in the corresponding reports.-Resolution-You may change the market segment or any other reported attribute, if you want to force a change, as follow:-1. Go to 'Organizational management' workcenter-2. Select the 'Organizational structure' in edit mode-3. Select the Definition tab-4. Select a segment, for example 'Cost Center', then details and edit the data-5. Save and wait for 24 hours to ensure that the master data has been replicated to the Business Intelligence (BI).-Once the data has been replicated all transactions on cost centers or projects, including transactions that existed before replication to the BI, will show the new market segment attributes. All new transactions with reference to a customer from the date of replication forward will be enriched with the customer group.-Transactions that existed before you maintained the market segment attributes will continue to show the original customer attributes.

Title: Cost Center and Business Residence Property Settings for Financial Veto Check Implementation
Content: Symptom-You have an inactive organizational structure in which you have defined the top organizational unit as a company. This organizational unit is not defined as a cost center or a business residence as their child organizational units contain such definitions. You have also selected a financial related business function for this organizational unit. When you check the organizational structure you may receive error messages such as-01.01.2010 to 31.12.9999; org unit A000 (XXX inc.) must be below a cost center. The org unit itself can also be flagged as a cost center-01.01.2010 to 31.12.9999; org unit A000 (XXX inc.) must be below a business residence. The org unit itself can also be flagged as a business residence-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Org Structures view and select the Edit Org Structures tab in the Common Tasks.-In the new window select the relevant organizational structure and the top organizational unit.-Select the option (option under the down arrow mark) Check Selected and Dependent Org Units which will cause the error messages to be displayed.- Cause-According to the veto check implementations in financials two things are required if an organizational unit is a functional unit-A cost center should be derivable from a functional unit and-A business residence should be derivable from a functional unit.-Since you have selected a function, the organizational unit has become a functional unit and hence for satisfying the financial veto checks a cost center and a business residence is required.-Resolution-In the Functions tab for Finance and Administration functions uncheck any function. Then there will be no inconsistency.-In case you want that particular organizational unit to have business functions then the business residence should also be assigned.

Title: The Project Task with Zero Cost Assignment is also displaying in the Report Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure
Content: Symptom-The Report, Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure shows the project taks even if it has Zero cost assignment.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to workcenter Project Management.-Select view Reports.-Select the report Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure.-Select the project XYZ in the variable screen.-Where the project tasks with Zero Cost Assignment is displaying.-Cause-The system behaviour is as expected.-Resolution-The Project task might had the posting earlier and later then it was reversed.--So business wise you should be able to identify both the transactions, specially in case it had been posted in sepatrate peroiods.--To avoid seeing ZERO use "ZERO suppression" properties in the report properties. Detailed steps as follows:-Open the Project Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure.-Select Table Properties (Screw icon at the top right corner of the report screen).-Go to Data Provider tab.-Choose Active: Remove Row When All Values = 0 option for the field Apply Suppression to Rows under the section Zero Suppression.

Title: Unable to a Particular Service agent under Resources view
Content: Symptom-particular Service agent is missing in the Resources view, When a Project Manager tries search for that Service Agent-Reproducing the Issue-Go to workcenter Project Managament.-Select view Resources.-Select All Service Agents in the field Show. -Now search for the service agent.-Search results in No Record found.-Cause-The Cause for the issue is the service agent had been linked to the wrong supplier account.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, reassign the service agent to right Supplier Account.

Title: Project Tasks are appearing twice in the Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure Report
Content: Symptom-In the Report Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure, Some of the project tasks are appearing twice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to workcenter Project Management.-Select view Reports.-Select the report Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure.-Select the project XYZ in the variable screen.-Where the project tasks are appearing twice.--Cause-The system is working as designed.-Resolution-The report Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure displays tasks of a project in an hierarchical structure, which has to consider the different roles of node tasks (i.e. those with child tasks).-The one line of a node task has the aggregation results of the child tasks, the other line has the data directly assigned to the task itself.--However, that FIN report displays only tasks with costs. So not every node task appears twice, because not every node task has costs assigned.

Title: Excel upload functionality for New Contacts is not available in Business partner Data work center.
Content: Symptom-You would like to upload the new contacts using Excel upload functionality but the feature is not available in Business partner data work center. But you could able to find this functionality in Account management work center. The Byd help document also suggests, it is possible to upload new contacts using excel in Business partner Data work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Business partner Data:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Contacts view.-Select New button, where there is no option Contacts from Microsoft excel.-Account management:-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Contacts view.-Select New button, where you could able to find the option Contacts from Microsoft excel.-Resolution-The excel upload functionality only exists in the Contacts view in the Account Management workcenter, as this functionality is very important for CRM contacts we only offered the functionality here, but not for the generic contacts view in the Business Partner Data workcenter.-We will adapt the documentation in next release to make clear that this functionality is only available for CRM contacts.

Title: 'Decided On' Time Stamp Is Displayed as 00.00.0000 00:00 in Change History of an Inspection
Content: Symptom-When checking the Change History of an Inspection, you may find that the time stamp for the Decided On is displayed as 00.00.0000 00:00.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Quality Control work center.-Select the Monitoring view.-Select the Inspection and search for the respective inspection.-Select the Edit button.-Go to the Miscellaneous tab and select the Changes sub tab.-Select the Go button.-Select a row and in the Details section, you find that the Decided On time stamp is 00.00.0000 00:00.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-The time stamp for Decided On is shown as 00.00.0000. 00:00 because it shows the initial time when the decision was made and until now no decision has been made for the inspection.-Similarly when the decision is revoked in the inspection, the time stamp of Decided On is reverted back and is shown as 00.00.0000. 00:00 again.

Title: Approval Task for Expense Report Sent to Cost Center Manager instead of Project Manager
Content: Symptom-You create an expense report and assign the cost to a project task in it. But the approver for the expense report is assigned to your cost center manager instead of the project manager.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the Expense Reports view.-Search and open the expense report XYZ.-In the Overview tab, the approver is maintained as your cost center manager instead of the project manager even the cost assignment of the receipt line is to the project task.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-If the amount entered in the receipt line is zero or if no amount is entered, then the approver will be the cost center manager no matter whether the cost assignment is to the project task or not.

Title: Error Message: “No average values for working time maintained in time profile” when Create Snapshot for a Payroll Run
Content: Symptom-When creating snapshot for a payroll run, you may find the error message in Payroll Process Data for an employee:-Error Location: Time Administration-Error Description: No average values for working time maintained in time profile-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payroll Processing work center.-Select the Payroll Run view.-Select the Payroll Group.-Select the View Payroll Process Data link under Further Links.-Go to the Employee Data tab.-Select the employee XYZ, the above error message is shown.-Cause-The cause of the issue is that the start date of the employee’s time profile is later than payroll run period.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, follow the below steps:-1)  In the Time File of the employee change the Start Date of time profile.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Search and Edit the employee XYZ.-Go to the Time Profile tab, where the Start Date should be earlier or equal to the payroll run date.-2)  Update the snapshot.-Go to the Payroll Processing work center.-Select the Payroll Run view.-Highligh the Payroll Group.-Select the Update Snapshot button.

Title: Error Message: Lower Case or Special Characters not Permitted in field ProductCatagoryInternalID of Node XYZ
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload a new material using Excel Add-in, system throws below error messages:-Error 1: Lower case or special characters not permitted in field ProductCategoryInternalID of node XYZ.-Error 2: An error occurred during save process-Reproducing the Issue-Open MS-Excel file (for New material) which is downloaded from Material view of Product Data work center.-In the excel, Go to SAP tab.-Select Logon.-Enter the user credentials and select ok.-After enter the details of the materials, select Save Data to button.-Excel throws above error messages-Cause-The cause for the issue is due to the fact that Planning Group Description is entered in the field Planning Group ID.-The Planning Group ID shoud be Upper Case and should be same as in the ByD System-Resolution-You can enter the correct Planning Group ID and Save the data, which will save sucessfully.

Title: Content in the Locked Business Partner is Showing in the Contact
Content: Symptom-If you have a contact which is assigned to two Business partner, one is locked and other is active. In contact the field Department from business Card is empty but this data is maintained in the active Business partner.-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to check in Contact-Go to Business Partner Data workcenter.-Select Contacts view.-Search for the contact and select Edit button.-In General tab, under section Business Address, the field Department From Business Card is empty.-Where you could find some of the datas has been taken from the locked business partner.-Steps to check in active Business partner-Go to Business Partner Data workcenter.-Select Business partner view.-Search for the Business partner and select Edit button.-Go to contacts tab.-Where the data is maintained in the field Department From Business Card.-Cause-The functionality is working as designed.-The system is taking both the Business Partner IDs as seperate Business Partners.So if in one BP account, if the department details are not maintained then it will not be shown in contacts.This is inline with the concept that a person can be a contact person for multiple accounts (This is a scenario in SME)--Resolution-You can perform some changes in the contact maintenance for a correct view. Steps are as follows,-Go to Business Partner Data workcenter.-Select Contacts view.-Search for the contact and select Edit button.-Select View All button.-In General tab, under section Business partner, If the locked BP ID is maintained then you cchange it to the active BP ID.-Go to Relationships tab and you can remove the relationship with the locked account.

Title: Product Category ID is Pre-Filled While Creating a New Material
Content: Symptom-While creating a New material, You could find that the Product Category ID is getting pre-filled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data workcenter.-Select New Material link.-In the new screen, Product Category ID is pre-filled in the Product Category field.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-Pre-filling of the product category is not an issue but a requirement from the Solution Management.-The scenario where this would be useful is that when a user is creating multiple materials which belong to the same category, in that case defaulting the product category of the material which was previously saved is useful. The user in, that case does not have to select the same product category from the value help. This behavior is user specific such that the defaulting of product category would happen for the user with which you have logged in. So the next time New Material screen launched, the product category would be defaulted from the previously saved Material for the same user.-

Title: How to Block a product Category Without Affecting the Receipts Where it is in Use?
Content: Symptom-You have a product categories that youdon't want to use anymore. At the same time, you dont want to delete these product categories as they appear in some receipts and you should be able to reproduce the former account allocation.--How to avoid that the employees don't use these product categories anymore but that they still stay active for receipts where they are used?-Cause-The system works as designed.-In current release, we do not offer a possibility to phase our product categories. Once a product category is on use it will remain usable. You can not delete a product category once it has been used.--Resolution-Product category once in use can`t be set to unusable or deletable.-This functionality is considered in the next higher release of the product.

Title: Error "DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY; Cost center XYZ must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit." while Checking an Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When you try to check the Org Structure created by you, system throws below error messages;-DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY; Cost center XYZ must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit.-DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY; Org Unit XYZ must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-Select Org Structures view.-Select and Edit the respective Org Structure.-Select Check button and choose Check All option.-System throws above error message.-Cause-The reason for the error is due the fact, that the Org structure has a valid from date (Timelines) for its Business Reseidence which is later than its Org unit's business residence valid from date.-Resolution-The error message will be resolved, If you maintain the correct date for the Org Structure. Steps are as follows:-Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-Select Org Structures view.-Select and Edit the respective Org Structure.-Go to Timelines tab.-Change the Vaild from date of the Org unit's Business Residence.-Select Check button and choose Check All option.-Select Save button.-Select Activate and choose Activate All option.

Title: Error Message "Target value Cannot be Empty" While Doing Migration of Material
Content: Symptom-While doing migration of material using the Data Migration tool, you could find that the field Target Value Description is uneditable and the system gives the below error message:-Target value Cannot be Empty-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business configuration workcenter.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open activity List button.-Go to the Integrate and extend chevron.-Search for the activity Migration of Materials and select the link. A new window opens up.-Select the Migrate materials using the migration tool link.-Select a file which you need to upload and select the Execute Migration button.-Select the Next button and select the option Edit value Conversion for Availability Check Scope.-The field Target value Description is uneditable. When you select Save button, system throws the metioned error message.--Cause-The cause for the issue is that the functionality to Hide and Unhide fields is activated for the user.-Resolution-Go to the Business configuration workcenter.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open activity List button and select the Integrate and extend chervon.-Open the activity Migration of Materials. A new window opens up.-Select the Migrate materials using the migration tool link.-Select a file which you need to upload and Select Execute Migration button.-Select Next button and select the option Edit value Conversion for Availability Check Scope.-Follow the below mentioned steps after reaching the window Edit value Conversion for Availability Check Scope:--1. Place the cursor in any field on the table and right click. -2. Choose the User settings and then select Invisible Elements.-3. Title: Supplier Invoice Journal Entry Simulation: No Postings for Retainage Account
Content: Symptom-During journal entry simulation for supplier invoice ABC, which contains retainage payment type, no postings are done in the retainage account (Reconciliation Account) for the retainage percentage.-ABC means the supplier invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open Invoice ABC (invoice containing Retainage payment type, for example, 5%).-Click Actions > Simulate Journal Entry.-Notice that no postings are done to the retainage account (Reconciliation Account) to represent the 5% retainage.-Cause-During journal entry simulation, a second journal entry containing the retainage posting (to the Retainage Reconciliation Account) is not created.-This second journal entry (journal entry type 00092 - Repost/Split of Open Items) is only created when the invoice is posted.-In this way, when the invoice is posted, two journal entries are created:-Journal Entry of type 00023 - Supplier Invoice-Journal Entry of type 00092 - Repost/Split of Open Items (containing the retainage postings)-Resolution-The system behaves as expected in this case.-Keywords-retainage; installment; supplier invoice; payment type; journal entry; journal entry simulation; reconciliation account

Title: Warning Message 'Revaluation is Already Done. Action Post_Adjustment Not Permitted' Displayed in Actual Cost Allocation Run
Content: Symptom-You perform an Actual Cost Allocation Run and find the warning message in the application log 'Revaluation is already done. Action Post_Adjustment not permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work centre.-Go to the Actual Cost Allocation sub view.-Show All Runs and find the Run ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Run ID).-Select the Run XYZ and navigate to the Log Result.-Open the Log and navigate to the Messages tab.-Message 'Revaluation is already done. Nothing is to be posted for the Cost Object.-Go to the Inventory Valuation work centre.-Go to the Material Actual Costing sub view.-Search for the materials listed in Not Processed tab.-For each material you see that the Allocation Amount is zero.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. Title: Access Restriction Not Working For Enterprise Search
Content: Symptom-A Business User has been restricted to access certain objects, for example for Accounts.  However, the Business User can access restricted Accounts via the Enterprise Search. The restrictions are working fine on work center view level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Configure the scenario-Login to System in Silverlight Version.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business User view.-Select Business User ABC that you wish to restrict.-Press edit and select Access Rights.-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Search and select from the work center View ID: BPM_ACCOUNTS.-Change the Read Access and/or Write Access to Restricted.-Below, in the Detailed Restriction section you have to specify the Access Group and select the respective Read Access and/or Write Access you wish to grant access. -Save the change.- Test the scenario:-Ask the affected Business User to login to the system.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Account view.-Search for an account which the Business User should have no access. -The Business user will not see the restricted account in the Overview Worklist(OWL).-Click on the Enterprise Search and search for the same restricted account again. -The restricted account will be shown as a result -Business user is now able to click on the link to open the account to which he should has no access.-- Cause-The Enterprise Search Enterprise Core Objects(ECO), "CUSTOMER_ES_ECO" is part of several work center views available to the user. Most of them are granted to the user in unrestricted read/write mode.-The Enterprise Search Object is not maintained with the Association to Access Code List(ACL), which is required to find the user's necessary restrictions.-If the restrictions derive from all views granted to an user are maintained at same level, this means there is no need to evaluate the ACL and it is always considered as unrestricted access to the ECO.-Resolution-In the current system version and until further notice it is not possible to restrict access via Enterprise search for accounts.  It is planned to extend the Restrict Access functionality also for the Enterprise search in future releases.-Keywords-access restriction, enterprise search -access restriction,enterprise search

Title: ARCHIVED: Error "Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY" during Time Recording
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Consolidated in KBA 3032180 ***-You may receive the below error message, while recording time in the Time Sheet for any activity:-Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY-And also, you may not be able to find your employee ID in the Time Administration work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services and choose the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Go to the respective week, input the time for a day.-Select the Save button.-System throws the above error message.-Cause-When Time and Labour Management is added to the business scope, Time Agreements for all existing employees should be generated by the system automatically. This may not happen in the system if a corresponding job had not been scheduled.-Because of this, the following issues can occur in the system:-Error Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY while recording times in Time Sheet.-Your employee ID is missing in the Time Administration work center.-Work Agreement does not exist for your employee ID in the Personnel Administration work center.-Resolution-Therefore, the corresponding job needs to be triggerred manually to create the Work Agreements, which should be done by SAP.-Please raise an case to SAP to trigger the backend job manually.-After the job is run, you should find the Time Agreements for all employees available in the system. Additionally, the manually triggered job also creates tasks of Complete Time Data (Hire) which appear under the Work view of the Time Administration work center. Using these tasks, the time data of the employees can be completed.--Keywords-3032180

Title: Error Message: XYZ () not permitted; ID already in use, While Activating an Org Unit
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**TO BE ARCHIVED**-Reason: Consolidated in KBA 2461723-When you try to activate an Org Unit/Org Structure, system throws below error message:-XYZ (Org Unit Name) not permitted; ID already in use-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Select the Org Unit XYZ.-Select Activate button.-Cause-There are different reasons that might have caused this issue,-You have already activated an Org unit with an ID and try to activate another Org Unit with same ID.-There was already an Org Unit XYZ which was activated and later it was deleted. This can be verified in the Changes tab of the Org Unit XYZ in Active Area. In the Planning area, the org unit XYZ was deleted and a new org unit XYZ was created again. i.e, before activating the deletion, you are creating a new Org Unit with the same ID and try to activate the changes.-Resolution-For Cause 1, refer to the Knowledge Base document 1654071 - Error Message: ID XYZ not permitted; ID already in Use-If the issue is because of cause 2,-It is always recommended to activate the Org Structure after deleting the Org Unit and then create a new org unit with the same ID. Hence, use Roll Back option to roll back all the changes done in the Planning area.-Note that roll back will delete all the changes done in the planning area and revert to last active version.-Go to Planning Area of the Organizational Structure.-Select Roll Back button.-Then you can delete the Org unit XYZ and activate this deletion.- After which, you can create a new org unit with the same ID.

Title: Nederlands Chain Liability
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Chain Liability is a legal requirement for Netherlands. This is particularly needed if we have a company which has sub contracting as part of their business. The company in this case has to ensure (on behalf of the sub contractor) the income tax and social insurance amount from the services obtained through the sub contract is paid to the authorities either directly or through a specific account maintained by the sub contractor for the payments. We support the entire end to end functionality from Supplier Invoicing in ByDesign Release 1505 onwards. What is not available is the following --- Direct payment to tax authorities.-- Entering Chain Liability data in Purchase Order.-- Support of chain liability in ERS invoices created automatically from Purchase orders.-- Reporting for Chain Liability.

Title: In ERP- ByDesign Integration Time Delay Issue, While IDN Creation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer is using ERP-ByDesign integration. Customer reports that it takes 5-15 mins to create Inbound Delivery Notification (IDN) in ByDesign.-The scenario is as followed:-Orders are received in the R/3 system as there is no site logistics processing configured in their ByDesign system. The document is then sent from R/3 to ByDesign, where an IDN is created. However, the time between receipt of the IDoc in ByD and the creation of IDN is sometimes up to 15 minutes. The "normal" waiting time is about 5 minutes, but sometimes it takes more time.- Cause-The Agent  IIW_APDL_ID_DESADV_IDOC_IN used to parse this IDOC into XML, and this parsing may take time sometimes. This might happen due to network problems also.-Resolution-This is a known issue in the current release of Business ByDesign. As of now it is not possible to change the system behavior and reduce the time delay.

Title: Limitations in Calculation for Meal Per Diem Deductions for Austria
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This limitation is applicable for the meal per diem deduction functionality for Austria. Meal Per Diem Deductions for mixed trip is not supported completely. For these trips, the system calculates only the deductions for foreign segments. In case of multiple foreign segments on the same day, the system does not consider the time that you spend in multiple foreign segments. The domestic segment deduction for mixed trips is also not accurate.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-2. Select the Expense Reports work center view.-3. Create a new expense report of type Business Trip for an Austrian employee.-4. In the expense report, under Dates And Locations, click on the link Add More Destinations to add some foreign segments.-5. Under Per Diems, select the Meals checkbox and click on the link Deduct Free Meals to select the complimentary meals.-6. Save the expense report.-7. Select Preview > Reimbursement Details,  to preview the expense report.-In the Reimbursement Details pdf, under the Meals Per Diem section, the deductions for the domestic segment of the trip is not correct.-The system also does not consider the foreign segments deduction rate for multiple segments. It  adds up the per diems for foreign segments and applies the deduction percentage on this sum.-Cause-In the current release, the system does not support the time based deduction calculation for multiple foreign segments.

Title: ARCHIVED: Error Message: Cannot change timeline of cost center XYZ (); cost center is used by financial accounting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**Archive reason: Solution consolidated in KBA 1775202**-When you try to activate an Org Unit, system throws below error message:-Cannot change timeline of cost center XYZ (); cost center is used by financial accounting-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight an Org unit.-Try to Check or Activate it.-Cause-The reason that you are not allowed to end the validity of Org Unit XYZ is, you attempted to shorten the timeline of a cost center (the org unit itself or the Cost Center definition on an org unit). However, postings exist for the cost center in the timeframe that is delimited. The system has prevented the shortening of the timeline.-This can be verified as follows,--1. Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-2. Select Reports view.-3. Open the report "Cost Centers - Line Items"-4. Enter cost center and relevant and Go-5. You will find postings for the respective Posting date.-This is the reason that you are not able to delimit the Org Unit.-Resolution-To resolve the issue,-Case 1:-You may choose to end the timeline of the cost center (Org Unit) at the end of the latest fiscal period in which the cost center has postings. In this case, if you set the Valid To date of Org Units as DD/MM/YYYY (which is the end of the latest fiscal period) then you can able to delimit the Org Units without any issues.-Case 2:-It is also possible to end the timeline before a fiscal period with postings. In this case, the balance in the affected timeframe must be zero. In order to reach a balance of zero, try to reverse the journal entries that generated the postings. Where this is not possible, you can transfer the values so that the final balance would be zero. You can do this in the General Ledger work center under New Journal Entry Voucher.-Then you can change the timeline on the Timelines tab of the Org Structures view in the Organizational Management work center.

As a result the system regards that the upper layer unit is inactive. Therefore, when you change the timeline of the lower layer and activate it, you get the error which means there is no active upper layer unit.Activate the upper layer and every thing is OK.-See Also-You can also refer to below documents, if the above solution doesn't resolve your issue:-1538493 - Error "DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY; Cost center XYZ must be below a Business Residence. Title: ARCHIVED:Project Manager is not Receiving Project Time Confirmations Approvals for the Times Recorded by a Project Team Member.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Combined with  KBA: 2600134 - Project Time Recording Posted Without Approval-You as a Project Team Member (internal employee) recorded time against a particular task and released as well, but the manager couldn’t receive the approval tasks for those Time Recordings.-Cause-There are different causes which resulted in this issue, they are-For the Project task, if you have not set the flag for Mandatory Time Approval then the Project Manager will not receive any approval task — instead, all the times will be approved automatically.-If a Time Administrator records Project Confirmation instead of the Project Team member in Time Administration work center, then no approval task will be sent to Manager — instead, all the times will approved automatically.-  Resolution-If you have not set the flag Mandatory Time Approval, then you can set now and re-release the Project Time Confirmations. Now, the approval task will go to the Project Manager for approval.-See Also-Note: project time recordings from external employees (service agents) always require approval regardless of the setting.

Title: Unable to Change or Delete a Quantity Conversion in Material Master
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a new Unit of Measure in fine tuning (Quantities and Units of Measure activity) which you want to use in the Material master data. To use the newly created Unit of Measure you have maintained the Quantity Conversion for a Material. Now you try to either remove the entries or change the Quantities. But it is not possible because an error message is thrown which says that there are open business documents in the system. This is not possible as you have created, maintained and saved the Quantity Conversion only few minutes ago and you are sure that they are not used in any business document so far.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center-Select view Materials-Select a Material and select Edit button-Select View All button-Go to tab General-Section Quantity Conversions-Here you try to change the Quantity Conversion or remove the rows but an error message is thrown which may be similar to the following error message.-Changing of the conversion is not possible; Used by one or more open purchase orders, source documents (general ledger), source documents of supplier invoice.-Conversion between Sales UoM XXXX and Planning UoM YYYY can't be batch specific.-Cause-Though the system may allow you to add new Quantity Conversions, a system check (Veto Check) has been implemented in such a way that if any Material where the new Quantity Conversion is maintained is used in any open business document (e.g Purchase Order) which is in open status or/and created before maintaining the Quantity Conversion the system will not allow you to change or delete the Quantity Conversions. The Veto Check does not check which Quantity Conversion is being used in the open business documents. It just checks if the respective Material is used in any open business document.-Resolution-You need to close any open business document before you try to change or delete the Quantity Conversion.-In principle, there are two main check happens when you try to delete a Quantity Conversion maintained in a Material.--1. Whether the Material is used in any other Business Document?---> It is not possible to remove the Quantity Conversion--2. Whether the target UoM (Quantity Conversion) is the actual UoM for other active processes of that Material. For Example: Quantity Conversion is 1 EA = 10 M; where M is Purchasing UoM.---> It is not possible to remove the Quantity Conversion.-  Here are some of scenarios which you can make a note: (For Example, we took Purchasing process of the Material for comparison)--1. Not possible to remove Quantity Conversion - if the Material is used in any other Business document--2. Not possible to remove Quantity Conversion - if the Base UoM and Purchasing (Status: Active) UoM are different where the Quantity Conversion is maintained between Base UoM and Purchasing UoM--3. Not possible to remove Quantity Conversion - if the Base UoM and Purchasing (Status: Blocked) UoM are different where the Quantity Conversion is maintained between Base UoM and Purchasing UoM--4. Possible to remove Quantity Conversion - if the Material is not used in any other Business document or any process is not activated--5. Possible to remove Quantity Conversion , if Base UoM and Purchasing (Status: Active/Blocked) UoM are same

Title: You wish to enable Delta Activation of Analytical Content during deployment of your solution (DADA feature) however you are unable to do so.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have requested DADA feature (DADA refers to Delta Activation During Assembly or Delta Activation of Analytical Content) to be enabled for your solution. However the feature does not seem to be applied for your solution as activation log does not displays it.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Before noticing any issues with requested feature you have performed all necessary steps/prerequisites to make sure this feature has been enabled for your solution. This includes the following:-You have enabled this feature on your end by configuring scoping question in Business Configuration Work Center. This can be done in the following way:-Navigate to Business Configuration Work Center-Choose Implementation Projects-Select your project-Choose Edit Project Scope option and navigate to Questions-Go to Build-in Services Support-Navigate to System Management and Choose Analytics-Select the following question "Do you want to enable delta content for analytical objects developed in the SAP Cloud Application Studio?"- After perfoming any Life Cycle Management Activity on your solution, you do not see the following log in Implementation Manager within Cloud Application Studio:-Cause-DADA feature is only supported for solutions where all analytical content have been created in English language. This means that such solution elements like Reports or Data Sources have been created while appropriate user have been logged in to Cloud Application in English Language.-NOTE: DADA feature has been introduced in 1902 release, and as of now (March 2019) can only be enabled via configuring appropriate question in Business Configuration Work Center. It has been created to enhance the deployment process: when enabled only newly created analytical content or changed analytical content is to be considered during Life Cycle Management Activity of the solution. This considerably reduces time of solution deployment/ activation etc. since so far, as per system architecture, analytical content gets activated at the end, and in its full scope.-DADA functionality is also described in Blog listed in See Also section of this Knowledge Based Article.-Resolution-Before requesting this feature please make sure that all analytical content of your solution have been created in language "EN". Other languages are not supported at the moment.-See Also-SAP Delta Activation of Analytical Content/ Delta Activation During Deployment-Keywords-DADA, silent feature, Delta Activation of Analytical Content

Title: ARCHIVED:Portal Runtime Error
ARCHIVED:The Project downloaded from Project Plan opens up in XML format
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:  There is no such download button itself now in project-The project downloaded from 'Project Plan' is saved as XML file.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center ‘Project Management’.-Select view ‘Projects’.-Select a project <xyz>.-Select the button ‘Edit’ and choose the option ‘Project Plan’.-In Edit Project window, select button ‘Download’.-A popup window opens and asks you to save the file (default file extension ‘.xml’).-Open the downloaded file which displays as XML.-Cause-This is default behaviour of the system to download Project as XML file. You can open the file in Microsoft Project 2007 or 2010 with project details otherwise the downloaded file is shown as plain XML text in browser, text editor or Office Word.-Resolution-The project downloaded from 'Project Plan' is in XML format.-You should open the downloaded xml file in Microsoft Project, which shows the project details in graphical user interface and allows you to copy the project structure, relationships, durations, time constraints, and planned work quickly and easily.-Note: The appearance of your projects may vary between Microsoft Project and Business ByDesign in terms of the project structure and the scheduled dates because different scheduling logic and calendars are used.-See Also-Refer the Help document 'Integration with Microsoft Project' in the ByD system for the detailed behaviour of this functionality.

Title: Product Category Value Help in Report Does Not Have Any Values
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Reason for archiving: This field can now be used in the selection ****-You are using the report Profit Overview By Key Figure and you have enabled the hierarchical display for the field Product Category. However when you add the product category to the selection and open the value help, no product category can be selected.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report Profit Overview By Key Figure-Click on Add Fields and search for the Product Category (dimension Product)-Drill down into Product Category-Product Category ID, check all 3 checkboxes. This will add the field to the selection area and enable the hierarchy. Click OK.-In the selection area, you will now see the variable Product Category ID (Product Category)-Click on the value help.-There are no values here.-Cause-Currently the value help for hierarchy fields is not supported in this report. We are checking if this can be enabled in a future release.-Resolution-Please use the selection field Product Category (rather than Product Category ID) for variables. It does not have a hierarchy and can be used to select values.
