Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have a requirement to scope Compensation functionality but not Payroll functionality, but Compensation is available only when Payroll is selected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Highlight First Implementation and select Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to "Scoping" and expand "Human Resources".-Compensation is available only when Payroll is selected.-Cause-At the moment Compensation and Payroll functionality is bundled together.-Resolution-You can make Payroll Processing Work Center invisible to your user, but the usage of Compensation is creating reminders for maintenance of Payroll data as well.-Keywords-scope Compensation; Payroll Processing; business configuration; edit project scope; implementation projects

Title: Data Source Cannot be Added to a New Joined Data Source
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Reason for archiving: outdated, an duplicate (and updated ) KBA is 2727789 ***-You want to create a join model between two or more data sources, however the data source desired is not available for selection by clicking on Add Data Source button.-Example of use case: You want to create a joined data source between HCMRPMU01 and HCMEMPB, HCMRPMU01 is available but HCMEMPB cannot be found and simply it is not available to create a Joined Data Source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, Silverlight UI-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the View Design Data Sources.-Click New > Joined Data Source.-Click on Add Data Source.-Search by HCMEMPB, for instance.-The data source HCMEMPB cannot be found.-Cause-The reason why the Employee Master Data (ID: HCMEMPB) as well as other data sources are not available to create a Joined Data Source is due to a technical designing. There are some data sources which use Temporal Joins to map a period of time (time-dependent characteristic) and hence, it is technically impossible to create a join condition.-Joined Data Sources on top of temporal joins were never supported.-Resolution-You can make use of combined conditions to meet his request or as an alternative option, approach our Cloud Service Center Department in order to raise a new requirement and develop a customized solution for you.-The data sources IDs with a temporal join are:-CRMCCOHHB-CRMSLOIHB-CRMSORHHB-CRMSRQHHB-HCMEMPB-HCMPAB01-HCMPAB02-HCMPAB03-HCMPAB04-HCMPAU01-HCMRPMU03-HCMTLMB01-HCMTLMB02-HCMTLMB03-HCMTLMB04-HCMTLMB05-HCMTLMB06-HCMTLMB07-HCMTLMU01-HCMTLMU02-HCMUSPAB01-See Also-Temporal Join means that the result of the Data Source is dependent on the execution time point which is passed from the query.-You can also request a customized feature from the Cloud Service Center; please contact them as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page-See also: 2727789 - Data Source Cannot be Used as Join Member-Keywords-data source missing, joined data source, HCM data source, Datasource can not be used as Join Member, cannot be used

Title: Filter Option for Columns not Available in HTML5
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Left click on a column header does not give the option to filter values.-Environment-ByD HTML5 layout-Reproducing the Issue-Log into ByD using the HTML5 layout.-Go to a view containing values in a column e.g. Supplier Invoicing and then Invoices and Credit Memo.-Left click on Document ID.-Cause-Object Work List - Enhanced Mode has been delivered and enabled with the 1711 release. In order to achieve feature parity between the HTML5 and Silverlight client Filter Bar was implemented. As this feature is not compatible with the classic column filter the latter has been disabled. See also video attached demonstrating the behaviour in 1708 and 1711 release.-Resolution-You can scope Object Work List - Classic Mode to go back to the old view. Note that it will disable all the additional functionalities listed in Object Work List - Enhanced Mode.-See Also-Keywords-Filter Column Object Work List Enhanced Mode Classic Mode HTML5

Title: Tags Cannot be Removed in HTML5
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the HTML5 client Tags longer than 30 characters cannot be removed in the Internet Explorer, as the delete Button is out of the View and no scrollbar is shown.-Environment-Business By Design HTML5-Internet Explorer-Reproducing the Issue-The issue is reproducable with all Tag Views.-As an example Sales Order:-Open the Sales work center.-Open up any Sales Order.-Click on the Tags Icon.-Enter a Tag longer than 30 characters.-Click again on the Tags icon.-Notice that the Delete Button / Scrollbar isn't shown.-Cause-This is a known issue in ByD1711. It will be fixed in a future release.-Resolution-As a workaround you can use:-Silverlight in Internet Explorer.-The sidebar (questionmark on the top right) to delete the Tags.-Google Chrome with HTML5 layout.-Keywords-HTML5, Tags, Scrollbar, Delete

Title: ARCHIVED:Unable to Show Project Based Items in Sales Order Invoicing Overview in Field Invoice Request and Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:  Pure Duplicate of KBA: 2157977 - Unable to Show Project Based Items in Sales Order Invoicing Overview in Field Invoice Request and Invoice -You have created a project based invoice or invoice request in the system. Now you search for the items in the sales order invoicing overview and notice that the system does not display any results for the invoice request and invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work centre.-Select the Sales Order Invoicing Overview view.-In the drop-down menu select Sales Orders without invoice Schedule.-The search returns no results in invoice request and invoice.-Cause-The fields Invoice and Invoice Request will not be available for project based items as the invoicing in such cases is not done on the sales order site. Therefore from a sales order side you won’t receive information about the invoice. This is also the reason why you are not able to add the column Project Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.

Title: Error Message: Address Incomplete; Enter Address, While Activating an Organizational Structure
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***ARCHIEVED*** Not Applicable anymore** There is no Tax Jurisdiction Code in address*****-When you try to check or activate an Organizational Structure, system throws below error messages:-Tax jurisdiction code XYZ not valid-Address incomplete; enter address-Cause-The cause for the issue is that, you have maintained the Tax Jurisdiction Code for the Org Unit but other details like Country, Postal code and so on are not filled.-And, it is not possible to update the address or remove the Tax Jurisdiction Code.-The reason that you are not able to update is that the Org Unit was a Company earlier and then removed.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to resolve the issue:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective date which should be equal to the Valid From date of the Address attribute.-Highlight the Org Unit.-Select the tab Definitions.-Set the flag Company and confirm the popup (If any).-Select the tab Addresses.-Remove the Tax Jurisdiction Code XYZ of the Bill-To-Address.-Select the tab Definitions.-Remove the flag Company.-Check and Activate the Organizational Structure.

Title: Dump Occurs on Sorting Column for Custom Tabs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-In the standard Business Object on the Custom Tab ,  you've added the extension field with custom Object Value Selector on the Quick Create screen (custom quick create).-When you click on the column for custom tab and choose sort option (Descending or Ascending) the error message will appear.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to reproduce :-1 Open the SAP Cloud Application Studio and navigate to affected BO.-2 Go to the corresponding tab-3 Click Add-4 Open OVS in the selected field-5 Click on the column and set descending/ascending option.-6 Below error message will appear.-Backend details:-CX_OBERON_COMMAND_EXCEPTION, Program:CX_OBERON_COMMAND_EXCEPTION===CP, Include:CX_OBERON_COM-Info: An exception was raised-CX_BSA_SADL_QUERY_RUNTIME, Program:CL_BSA_SADL_QUERY_ENGINE======CP, Include:CL_BSA_SADL_QUE-Info: Issue occurred during query execution in TREX (264 ): LOB type "BSAF5" in view = "HANA-Cause-TEXT field is associated with the ES Namespace.- This has CCTS type name.- This is present in an OVS. Ideally sorting should not be allowed. This has been restricted for these kind of fields by controls team since as it is HANA limitation.-Resolution-Sorting on TEXT/Unlimited length fields are not supported. This is due to underlying DB limitation.-Keywords-An exception was raised, textfield, unlimitedfield, sorting, pdi, c4c, sapbyd

Title: For Approved Leave Requests There Is No Posting to the Time Account
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You, as a time administrator, may observe for some employees no postings are recorded on their Time Accounts even after the approvals of their leave requests.-Reproducing the Issue-The employee has requested for X days of vacations and it is approved by the manager.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Highlight the employee and select the Edit button.-Go to the Employee Times tab.-Highlight the vacation period and go to the Account Posting tab. No Postings is displayed.-Go to the Time Account Balances tab, for the Time Account ABC, the Balance and Taken remain unchanged.-Cause-There are different causes that may lead to this issue:-Cause 1:-In the Business Configuration work center, if the Time Type for vacation is not configured to post on the Time Account ABC.-Cause 2:-If a wrong (set up is incorrect) Daily Model is assigned to the Time Model in the employee's time file.-Resolution-Solution 1:-If the time type requires posting to the Time Account ABC, the time account must be added to the time type:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune chevron.-Open the Time Types - <Country> activity.-Select the Maintain Employee Time Types link.-In the Employee Time Types section select the respective time type.-In the Details area, you need to add the Time Account ABC.-Solution 2:-Complete the settings of daily model, in order to correct the Time Model assigned to the employee.-Having made the changes in Business Configuration work center and/or in the Time Model view in the Time Administration work center, the system will use the new setting for new time entries. In order to correct postings of approved leave requests in the past, you need to perform day closure run:--Option 1:-Perform a time valuation run for a single employee:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select the Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Enter the employee affected and select the Start Time Valuation.-Select the Run button.-On the popup screen, enter the Valuation Start date and select the Ok button. Note the valuation start date should be set as far in the past as the earliest vacation has been recorded.-Option 2:-Perform a time valuation run for multiple employees via a background job:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select the Administer Day Closure Run.-Select the New button and choose the Day Closure Run.-Enter an ID and a description for the Run.-Check the Correction Indicator flag.-Enter a Correction Start Date (this date has the same meaning as the valuation start date mentioned in Option 1).-In Selection Criteria enter the employees affected.-Select the Save button.-Select the Set to Active.-Select the Schedule button.-Enter the Scheduling Option (e.g. Start Immediately).-Select the Save and Close button.-On the screen Administer Day Closure Runs, you can select the View Jobs to check the status of the job.

Title: Is it Possible to Rename Root Product Category Hierarchy?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a New Product Category Hierarchy but you are not able to rename the root level since the field is read-only.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Product Categories view.-Select the root Product Category.-Select Maintain Product Categories button.-Select the Top (root) Product Category.-Cause-Once you create and save the root level (Product Category), it is not possible to rename it. The reason for not allowing to rename the root level is that it will end up in inconsistency.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-It is not not possible to rename the root Product Category but you are allowed to change only the Description.

Title: Limitations After Migration of Case Document Search to KBA Based Search
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-As part of 1711 we have done the migration from Case document search to KBA based search.-In the UI, customer’s see this as “troubleshooting” documents in the solution search result / Help Center search. More details about the topic can be found in wiki: https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1889093788-Resolution-As part of this activity there a couple new limitations introduced,  which needs to be communicated to customers as part of 1711 release notes.-Troubleshooting documents are migrated to new repository. Only the Troubleshooting documents that are still relevant will be migrated. In case if , if one of the non-migrated  Troubleshooting document was added to the Solution collection as part of the Incidents in the past, it will not be accessible any longer.-The Solution Search Advanced find form will only have the “Max Hits” fields, all other fields are removed since they are not supported by the new repository-The Search for Troubleshooting happens independent of the logon language, across all language versions of the troubleshooting documents, but the results will be returned in the logon language if a match exists in the logon language. If the document doesn’t exist in logon language version as a fallback English version of the document (if exists) would be returned.

Title: Notes are not Sorted in Chronological Order in Opportunities or Leads
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-ARCHIVED AFTER HOTFIX DEPLOYMENT - ISSUE IS  FIXED-INTERNAL USE ONLY-After opening an Opportunity or Lead in Edit mode, you notice that Notes are not displayed in the order you expect i.e. latest on top and oldest at the bottom.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, HTML5-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work centre.-Go to the  Opportunities view.-Show All Opportunities, search for Opportunity AAA (AAA stands for the Opportunity ID).-Click on Edit and stay on the General tab.-Scroll down to the bottom of the page.-The Notes do not follow a chronological order as you expect: some from September are at the very top while some from later months are at the bottom.-You notice that the notes created after the upgrade to 1711 while not at the top are still in chronological order with the others.-The same behavior can be seen for notes left on Leads-Cause-This is currently a known issue. A fix was implemented with the release of 1711 and Hotfix 74636 so that latest notes, if not at the top are at least in order. The old notes, however, have not been fixed retroactively.-Resolution-As a work-around, you can suggest that user consult the notes in the Overview where they are sorted in chronological order:-Go to the New Business work centre.-Go to the  Opportunities view.-Show All Opportunities, search for Opportunity AAA.-From the Worklist, click on the ID.-Scroll down to find the notes at the bottom of the page.-They are all displayed in the expected chronological order.-Keywords-Edit mode, sorted out, wrong order, sorting, not working, Leads, Opportunities, Opportunity, New Business

Title: Error Message: Cannot Delete Profit Center XYZ, Postings exist in accounting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to Check or Activate an Organizational Structure, system throws below error message:-Cannot Delete Profit Center XYZ, Postings exist in accounting-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures.-3. Highlight the Org Structure.-4. Select Check All or Activate All.-Cause-The cause for the error message is that validity of the Profit Center attribute of the Org Unit XYZ is delimited to a past date, which is not allowed because there are many FIN related documents are using this Profit Center.- Resolution-To resolve the issue, you can extend the validity of the Profit Center to future dates and most appropriate date could be the Period End date.

Title: Error Messsage "DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Org Unit XYZ (Org unit name) must be below a cost center. The org unit itself can also be flagged as a cost center.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have a created a Org structure with Top level org unit XYZ as Company and segment. But while checking the consistency, system throws below error message:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; Org Unit XYZ (Org unit name) must be below a cost center. The org unit itself can also be flagged as a cost center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structure option under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org unit XYZ.-Select Check and choose Selected Structure and Dependent Org units.-System throws above error message.-Cause-The reason for the check failing is the fact that you have maintained functions for the Org unit XYZ.--Checkboxes on the Functions tab are only allowed for nodes that are below a unit marked as Cost center and one that is Business Residence.--Resolution-To resolve the error message, Remove all the flags on the functions tab for org unit XYZ.--Steps are as follows,-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structure option under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org unit XYZ.-Go to Functions tab.-Uncheck the selected functions.-Select Save button.

Title: ARCHIVED: Project Task is not Displayed in the Value Help While Doing Time Recording for an Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You as a Time Administrator, when entering time on behalf of an employee, you are not able to find the Project Task in the task value help.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Time Recording view.-Select Time Sheet sub view.-Search and highlight the employee.-Select Open Time Sheet button.-Under Time Entry tab.-Go to respective Calendar week.-Select the value help for the Task field in the Time Sheet section.-No project task is displayed.-Note: The employee belongs to the org unit XYZ and this Org unit is assigned to the Project whose project task is not displayed.-Cause-The employee is not assigned to any project task directly. The value help (drop down) does only provide those tasks in which the employee is directly assigned in the selected date period.-Resolution-This is the same behavior as in the Employee Time Sheet.-Note: In the Time Sheet of an employee, you can enter any valid task manually.

Title: Excel Uploaded Times are Sent to Approval Even it is not Configured as Such
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For a Particular Project, you have not set Mandatory Time Approval Required but when you upload Times for this Project using Excel, the Times are set to In Approval status.-Cause-The excel upload of Time follows the same approval process as like the Time Recording in Time Sheet. In fact, if an employee is recording times on a project he/she is staffed (either directly or indirectly) and the project is configured in a way that approval is not mandatory than those times are automatically approved. On the other hand if an employee is recording times on a project he/she is not staffed (neither directly nor indirectly) and the project requires no approval than the time is sent for approval. The times recorded by a service agent are always sent for approval.--But there is one exception. If the Approver is recording the times which will be sent for approval then they are automatically approved by the system. This is not the case for the time in the attached excel, even the Approver is uploading the Times using excel, then the status will be set to In Approval.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-The Project Manager should approve the times manually in Project Management work center, Approvals view.

Title: Legal Change Effective April 1 2015 - Prompt Payment Discount VAT Regulation - Great Britain
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-From April 1 2015, a legal change to the VAT legislation on Prompt Payment Discount (PPD) in Great Britain comes into effect. -In summary, these changes are:-Suppliers must account for VAT on the amount they actually receive as payment-Customers must recover the amount of VAT that they actually pay to the supplier-To support this, HMRC provides two options:-Suppliers may issue a credit note with details of the reduction under consideration-Alternatively, if they do not wish to issue a credit note, the invoicing document must contain additional information that includes the following:-The terms of the PPD-A statement that the customer can only recover as input tax the VAT paid to the supplier. For this, SAP delivers content; however, customers or partners using Business ByDesign must do additional fine-tuning in their system. This fine-tuning enables them to post invoice gross amounts and the system can then make the necessary adjustments for discounts and VAT at the time of payment. -Reproducing the Issue-When you want to simultaneously pay PPD-relevant invoicing documents created both before and after April 1 2015, the Business ByDesign system does not support the correct calculation of cash discounts for both timeframes at the same time.-Note that this issue only occurs during payment of these invoicing documents and all the documents are still created correctly in the system (using the old rule when the posting date is before April 1 2015 and the new rule when the posting date is after April 1 2015).-Cause-There are two technical limitations in the Business ByDesign system:-Limitation 1: The Tax Adjustments for Payment Differences fine-tuning activity is not time dependent. When you make settings in this fine-tuning activity, the system executes the payment of PPD-relevant invoicing documents, such as invoices and credit memos, based on these settings. As a result, this will then not be correct for the payment of any PPD-relevant invoicing documents created and posted before April 1 2015 (when the old rule for PPD still applies). This is relevant for the payment of both customer and supplier invoicing documents.-Limitation 2: Additionally, after you make these settings in fine-tuning, the withholding tax base amount in PPD-relevant supplier invoices will not be correct at payment time.- Resolution-Limitation 1:-After April 1 2015, we recommend that you pay all open PPD-relevant customer and supplier invoicing documents which are in your system after making the below setting (for example, invoices that have payment terms included, for example “14 days 2%, 30 days due net”)-In the Tax Adjustments for Payment Differences fine-tuning activity,make the following setting:-Under Tax Country, enter GB - United Kingdom-Under Grouping for Payment Differences, enter 4-Cash Discount-Under Tax Type, enter 1-VAT-Note:-This fine-tuning setting only affects the payment of customer and supplier invoicing documents and does not affect the creation of the documents themselves. Therefore, regardless of this setting, any customer or supplier invoicing document you create, both before and after April 1 2015, is created correctly by the system, using the old rule when posting date is before April 1 2015 and the new rule when posting date is after April 1 2015. Customers can switch the fine-tuning setting on and off as often as they require, but only for payments.-In summary:-All PPD-relevant invoicing documents posted before April 1 2015 should be paid without making this setting in fine-tuning-All PPD-relevant invoicing documents posted after April 1 2015 should be paid after making this setting in fine-tuning -Limitation 2:-There is no workaround available; SAP implementation is needed. Sometime after April 1 2015 (when it is expected that all invoices created before April 1 2015 are closed), SAP will deliver both the content described in the fine-tuning activity and also the code to adjust the withholding tax base amount during the payment of PPD-relevant supplier invoices.-Note:-These limitations no longer apply from SAP Business ByDesign 1508 onwards.-

Title: Unable to Post Payment Allocation Due to Error Message: The action ALLOCATE is not possible.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While executing payment allocation activities, payment allocation XXX cannot be posted due to error The action ALLOCATE is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Payment Management-Go to View Payment Allocation-Select  the payment allocation XXX-You will see the mentioned error message preventing you from posting-Cause-There is a temporary payment allocation created while you were navigating between the different steps in Bank Statement. If you create the Bank Statement, then these Payment Allocations are created with the proper preceding document reference and else these temporary payment allocation should be deleted. Some payment allocations are persist in the system and you will see the payment allocations with the preceding document IDs as TMP-* in your system.-To check the Temporary Payment Allocation in your system:-Go to Payment Management work center-Go to Payment Allocation view-Show All Payment Allocations-Search for the Preceding Document ID as TMP-*- Resolution-Proceed according to CD 2086528 - How to Delete the Payment Allocation with Preceding Document ID as TMP-*

Title: UK: No check / check letter template available (also: no generic template available)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When a payment is made to a supplier by using the payment method Outgoing check, to send the payment through a physical check the same has to be printed out. For UK since there is no generic version of a check template or a check letter template available that can be used as a default , printing of check in the specific templates required for these countries is not possible.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Work Center 'Cash & Liquidity Management'-2. Go to the view 'Payment Monitor'-3. Select New Payment by outgoing check.-4. Enter all the details like the paying company, the payee, total amount etc.-5. Select the invoice that needs to be   paid.-6. Select Complete Bank data and then Release.-7. Now you can preview a check using the Preview option.-The check layout previewed in case when the paying company is in UK is not as per standard layout required for UK.- Cause-A Check template for UK is not provided which can be used for printing of checks for UK.-Resolution-For UK you need to use the standard template or by manual intervention for writing the check.

Title: User Unable to Customize The Field "OutlineNumber" From the Excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User is unable to find the Field name present the "Project excel" for the PDI customization-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Search for the relevant project-Choose Edit-Choose "Download"-Import the downloaded XML into the excel-Search for the "OutlineNumber" column-User wants this field for the PDI customization -Cause-This field is present in the BO "PRO_PROJECT_OIF_ECO". As this is a eco level BO.-The read and write access to any field exist only at the BO level not at eco level. Therefore, the field " outline number" is not available for the read and write access in the SDK.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior. Guide the customer to Influence forum-Keywords-customization of field; project template; PDI; OutlineNumber; excel

Title: User Able to Change Data In Supplier Master Data Even With No Write Access to Work Center View ID BPM_SUPPLIERSFIN
Content: Symptom-User ID ABC was able to change and save data in Supplier Master Data for Supplier ID DEF (for example, Payment Terms in Purchasing tab) even with Write Access defined as No Access to Work Center View ID BPM_SUPPLIERSFIN.-ABC stands for the User ID.-DEF stands for the Supplier ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-A) Making a change and saving in supplier master data:-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Find Supplier ID DEF and click Edit -> Purchasing.-Make a change to the Payment Terms.-Click Save.-System saved the change successfully (no error message raised).-B) Checking access rights for User:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management -> Business Users view.-Find User ID ABC.-Click Edit -> Access Rights.-Open Access Restrictions tab.-Find Work Center View ID BPM_SUPPLIERSFIN.-Notice that Write Access is defined as No Access, so your expectation is that system wouldn't have allowed a change in Payment Terms for Supplier DEF, but raised an error message instead.-Cause-The write access to the Supplier Master Data is determined not only by Work Center View ID BPM_SUPPLIERSFIN, but for the following additional Work Center View IDs (considering they are all Assigned to User in tab Work Center and View Assignment):-BPM_SUPPLIERS-BPM_SUPPLIERSCENTRAL-FIN_SUPPLIERACCOUNTS-Resolution-Only by defining Write Access as No Access for the four Work Center View IDs below the system will deny the edition/saving of changes in supplier master data, by throwing the errors:-"You are not authorized to change the data"-"Save could not be executed"-BPM_SUPPLIERSFIN-BPM_SUPPLIERS-BPM_SUPPLIERSCENTRAL-FIN_SUPPLIERACCOUNTS-Keywords-BPM_SUPPLIERSFIN; BPM_SUPPLIERS; BPM_SUPPLIERSCENTRAL; FIN_SUPPLIERACCOUNTS; IAM; write access; no access; supplier master data

Title: How to Check Which Customer Invoices Were Created Via Invoice Runs
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled an invoices run in the system and want to know, which customer invoices were created via the invoice run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Runs view.-Select the Invoice Run ABC. (ABC represents the invoice run ID)-From Execution Details, search and open one application log, you can see the information that "Number of customer invoices created: 2". You want to know which 2 invoices were created exactly from this invoice run execution.-Cause-n/a-Resolution-You can find the generated customer invoices via the following steps:-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Runs view.-Select the Invoice Run ABC. (ABC represents the invoice run ID)-From Execution Details, select the execution you want to check.-Click 'Show Documents' button, system opens a new screen and you can see the customer invoice IDs created from the execution.-See Also-2862379 - How To Work With Invoice Runs-Keywords-invoice run; customer invoice; execution result; show documents; application log.

Title: Price Unit of Contract Items not Shown in Data Source
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When user checks data source: Purchasing Contract Item Details (SRMCT_B02), user can see per unit price. But there is no column showing price unit. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center, Contracts view.-Create a new contract XYZ (XYZ stands for document ID).-In contract XYZ, under Items tab, add product ABC, maintain the unit and price as 5,000.00 EUR/10 ea.-Go to Business Analysis work center, Design Data sources view.-Preview data source "Purchasing Contract Item Details (SRMCT_B02)".-Click "View" button and add row field "Product".-There is a column named "Per Unit Price", showing 5,000.00 EUR at row of product ABC.-But there is no row field named Price Unit that can be added.-Cause-This is a limitation of the current system functionality.-Resolution-User can add and maintain extension field in contracts to show per unit price/price unit, and add the extension field to the data source "Purchasing Contract Item Details (SRMCT_B02)".-Keywords-Contract; Data Source; Price Unit; Extension Field

Title: Non-deductible tax is being considered as Deductible tax
Content: Symptom-Tax Code ABC (ABC means Tax Code ID) for Supplier Invoice is wrongly being considered in VAT Return DEF (DEF means VAT Return ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-In the dropdown, select all Documents.-Search for Supplier Invoice ID XYZ (XYZ means Supplier Invoice ID).-Open Supplier Invoice ID XYZ -> Go to Items Tab -> Taxes Sub-tab, you'll see Tax Code ABC is assigned to this Supplier Invoice (Domestic Purchase of Goods and Services, Standard Rate, Non-Deductible).-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Go to Tax Return View -> VAT Return sub-view.-In the dropdown, select all Tax Returns -> Search for VAT Return DEF and open it.-Select View All -> Go to Tax Return Tab -> Tax Box Description.-Select Tax Box Description "Input Tax" and click on Details, you'll see that Supplier Invoice ID XYZ is showing in VAT Return, even it's non-deductible.-Cause-Typically, system will show all non-deductible transactions as well in VAT Return, but it doesn't come under Tax Liability since Tax Code is non-deductible once the deductible amount will be 0 (zero) for any currency transaction.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Deductible, Supplier Invoice, Tax Code, VAT Return

Title: Carry Forward Function Not Working Properly
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the Carry Forward from a Time Account did not work properly, where the data was not updated from the last year to the current one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration Work Center.-Then go to the Employees.-Search for the Employee ID and click Edit.-Go to the Time Account Balances tab.-Check the Time Account..-The balance value is not correct.-Cause-The Time Valuation from the Time Account is not accurate according to the Employee details.-Resolution-You need to perform a Time Valuation run for the affected Employee in order to have the carry forward updated.-Please follow the steps:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Then go to the Regular Tasks.-Click Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Maintain the Employee ID.-Select Start Time Valuation checkbox and click Run.-Maintain the last day from the last year (e.g 31.12.2023).-Click Ok.-After that, the Carry Forward will be performed by the system.-See Also-Time Valuation: Correction Run-Keywords-Carry Forward, Time Account, not carried, not working, not updated, Time Administration, Employee.

Title: Error: Status of project task XYZ not 'Started' or 'Released'
Content: Symptom-In the error message in the title, "XYZ" is the project task ID.-The user may see this error in any document that is related to projects. For example, it can be a Process Communication Error in the document's Document Flow tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Process Communication Errors view.-In the drop-down, select 'Open errors with incidents'. -Here you can see the error: Status of project task XYZ not 'Started' or 'Released'-Cause-The project task mentioned in the error message has a status that is not Started or Released.-Resolution-Change the status of the task and then create case to restart the message in the back end-The task's status needs to be changed to 'Started' or 'Released'. After changing the task's status, please create an incident. Only then our Support team can restart the failed message (process communication error).-Keywords-Process communication error, project task, project, status, restart, backend

Title: Error Message When Trying to Terminate the Relationship With an Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USER ONLY***-Customer is reporting that the following error occurs when they try to Terminate the Relationship with an Employee.-Cannot delimit time file validity; employee times exist; cancel times-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Regular Tasks view.-Click Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Select employee XYZ (where XYZ represents an actual employee ID).-Input mandatory information for the Last Working Day and Termination Category fields.-Click the Save (or Save and Close) button.-The error message will be displayed.-Cause-There are entries in the backend with the Life Cycle Status Code as 2 (Active) and these active time recordings are not allowing the termination of the Employee.-Steps to check it in the backend:-1- Go to SESFTS -> TIMX_AGREEMENT-2- Load by Node Id-> Root -> Enter Node Id - Put the Employee UUID (you can check it from the Employee BO)-3- Navigate to Item - (don't give any date/execute directly)-4- From Item, navigate to -> EMPLOYEE_TIME_ITEM -> Enter Date from 01.01.2023 to 31.12.9999 (As you want to terminated employee from 31.12.2022)-The Date From can change according to the last working day.-Resolution-When there are time entries in the backend, then the Development Team needs to evaluate the deletion of such Time Entries.-See Also-1934540 - Error Message "Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times" While Terminating an Employee-3210677 - Unable to Terminate an Employee-Keywords-Cannot delimit time file validity, employee times exist; cancel times, terminate, employee, cannot, unable, not being able to, error.

Title: Dunning Proposal E-mail Configuration Settings
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that some Dunning proposals are sending from the default system address and you didn't find any configuration to set the default e-mail or you don't know how the e-mail is selected for the dunning process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center. -Go to Dunning view. -Select All Dunning Proposals.-Search for Dunning ID: AAA (AAA represents the dunning ID). -You will see that dunning is sending from the default system address. -Cause-The system picks up the e-mail from Org Structure view under the Address Tab of the Organizational Management Work Center.-If there is no e-mail address maintained for company ABC (ABC represents the company) of the dunning, the system will use the Default System Sender Address.-To check what is the Default Sender Address, please follow the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for E-mail and Fax Settings activity.-Open the activity.-Select the E-mail and Fax Settings option.-Here you can see the Default Sender Address.-Resolution-If you want to send from a different default sender, please maintain the e-mail that you want in the address information of the Organizational Management work center > Org Structures view. Please check the steps below:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view. -Select the  org unit ID ABC that represents the company of the dunning.-Details: ABC > Addresses tab. -You will see that there is no e-mail address maintained.-Click Edit button. -Go to addresses tab again and maintain the desired e-mail address. -Activate the selected structure. -Now the new default e-mail will be used in the dunning as Sender E-Mail Address. You can check the same by following the steps below:-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Dunning view.-Select All Dunning Proposals.-Search for Dunning ID: XYZ.-Click Edit button. -Click Preview button > Send Options. -In the very bottom of the pop-up, you will find the Sender E-Mail Address. -Keywords-Sender E-Mail Address; Dunning; Dunning Proposals, Default System Address

Title: Process Communication Error Between Customer Invoice and Accounting: 'Net Amount Is Not Equal to the Total Amount Determined'.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Process Communication Error between Customer Invoice and Accounting: 'Net Amount Is Not Equal to the Total Amount Determined'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find the desired Invoice ID.-Go to Document Flow-Process Communication Errors are Shown on Customer Invoice.-Restart the XI message in the backend via below steps :-SE38> FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI > Execute.-Operational Document Type 28 > Enter the Customer Invoice ID as Operational Document ID.-Select XI message > Restart the XI message.-Restart Failed with the following Error message: 'Net Amount Is Not Equal to the Total Amount Determined'.-Cause-The reason why the Process Communication Errors are shown is because the Customer has changed the Total Amount as well as the Tax Amount.-This can be validated using the Change log available on the Customer Invoice.-Resolution-The Customer Invoice needs to be cancelled and then the customer has to create new Invoices without changing the Amounts.-Once the Customer Invoices are canceled, we need to cancel the XI message in the backend.-Keywords-Net Amount Is Not Equal to the Total Amount Determined, Customer Invoice, Process Communication Errors.

Title: Error during Merging Changing Project From Test System to Production System
Content: Symptom-Error Message: "Check system versions. System versions do not match" in the Merge Log during Change Project Merge.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Perform the following steps in the test system:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and select the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Go Live tab.-Select and Complete the Merge Changes with Production System activity.-Cause-The error is caused because a partner developed add-on solution is present on the test system and not added on to the production system.-Resolution-Please advice the partner to either have the add-on installed on the production system or removed from the test system.-Keywords-Merge, Change Project, Merging Changes, BYD, C4C

Title: Incorrect amount for the Tax Box Code 399T in the VAT Return
Content: Symptom-System is not calculating correctly the Tax Box Code 399T in the VAT Return for Switzerland. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center > VAT Returns view.-Search for the affected VAT Return and open it.-Click View All.-Go to Tax Return tab.-The amount of the Tax box code 399T is incorrect.-Cause-Tax Box 399T is calculated from fields 302T and 382T (302T + 382T = 399T). But as part of recent changes, the value for Tax Box 399T will no longer be calculated automatically based on value of 302T and 382T.-Resolution-You have to maintain the configuration in Summary layout for 399T box in respective tax events and tax rates, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center > Implementation Projects view.-Select your Implementation Project and click Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-tune tab.-Search for the 'Tax Returns for Goods and Services - Switzerland & Liechtenstein' activity and open it.-Click Product Tax Return Switzerland.-Go to Tax Event tab.-Now, it is necessary to maintain the configuration in Summary layout for 399T box in respective tax events and tax rates.-See Also-KBA 3423091 - SAP Business ByDesign 2311 Hotfix Collection 3 Information-Keywords-tax box code 399T, VAT return, incorrect, wrong, amount, value

Title: Employee Time Model Replication is not Occurring/up to date, for all the Employees
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You find that for some employees, the Time Model was set correctly by the Replication request. However, there is an issue where the Employee Replication from SuccessFactors is not updating their Time Profile Work Schedule to match the one replicated from SuccessFactors.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Set the Time Model correctly through the Replication request.-Manually update the Time Model information in the Employee Master Data.-You try to revert the Time Model ID by either processing a copy of the Replication request or generating a new Replication request from EC.-Cause-The Time Model information did not update due to the processing check, which compares the data for each Logical Part of the Replication request with the latest successfully processed request. As no changes were detected, the update did not take place.-Resolution-The Replication process is designed to be used independently and should not be combined with manual changes.-Keywords-SF, Replication, Time

Title: How to Upload Customer Invoice Files per File Input Scenario
Content: Symptom-You don't know how to upload customer invoice files per file input scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Prerequisite: Upload of Invoice Requests needs to be in scope-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your Implementation Project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Expand the path: Sales -> Customer Invoicing -> Upload of Invoice Requests-Activate the following question: You can use file input to upload external documents for invoicing.-You can upload customer invoice files per file input scenario as follows:-Download Customer Invoice File Creation Template from attachment section of this KBA..-Prepare file and save file on your machine. -Upload the file to the WebDav folder.-Go to Application and User Management work center > File Input view to define file input run.-Save and schedule the job.-Find the uploaded invoice requests in the Customer Invoicing work center.-Note:-Please ensure that the document IDs are used only for one upload and that the header Information needs to be written once.-You need to enable the file input run in your solution configuration as described in the SAP Document File Input Scenarios below.
