Title: Error "Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks" During Migration of Customers
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate customer, system throws below error message:-Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the 'Overview' view.-Search for and open the migration activity 'Migration of Customers.'-Execute the migration for the respective migration file."-Cause-The issue is caused by maintaining the Employee UUID as the Employee ID in the sheet 'Direct Responsibilities' instead of using the UUID (which is a 16+ character code).-Resolution-Employee UUID is mandatory if the Employee ID is not maintained. Please ensure that either the Employee ID or the Employee UUID is maintained, but not both. Since the Employee ID has already been maintained, please avoid adding the Employee UUID.-Keywords-Value Conversion, Customer With Errors, Tasks

Title: Unable to fulfill JEV Upload due to Memory Space
Content: Symptom-You are uploading a journal entry voucher with a high number of line item and notice an error in the AccountingEntryRplicationIn interface.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Web Service Message Monitoring view.-You see the failed message for AccountingEntryRplicationIn with error: 'Unable to fulfil request for <number> bytes of memory space'-Cause-This is a memory exception due to massive number of items in the template.-Resolution-You need to reduce the data set so that the upload can happen. Around 10000 lines can be passed through the AccountingEntryRplicationIn web service before the memory exception is raised.-Whether or not the upload runs through can also depend on what other system activities are performed at this time, which background jobs are running, your local internet connection etc. For this reason, the data set limit size may vary.-See Also-KBA 1924880 - Error When Uploading Journal Entry Voucher-Keywords-Time out. System no roll. Performance. JEV. General Ledger. Journal Entry Voucher. Excel.

Title: How to find the correct latest patch of LM-Service for the relevant SP level of Solution Manager system
Content: Symptom-How to find the correct latest patch of LM-Service for the relevant SP level of Solution Manager system.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Resolution-Go to the webpage http://support.sap.com/swdc.-Access Software Downloads in SAP for Me-Select the Support Packages & Patches fields-By Alphabetical Index (A-Z) -> Choose S-SAP SOLUTION MANAGER-SAP SOLUTION MANAGER 7.2-SOLUTION MANAGER JAVA STACK-SOLMANDIAG 720-Find the file with the name format LMSERVICE(XX)P_(Y)-80000341.SCA. Here XX stands for SP level of Solution Manager, Y stands for patch number.-For example, LMSERVICE07P_5-80000341.SCA means the patch 5 of LM-Service for Solution Manager 7.2 SP07 and it can only be implemented in Solution Manager 7.2 SP07 system.-IMPORTANT: Starting with SAP Solution Manager 7.2 SP15, LM-SERVICE 7.20 (SOLMANDIAG) will persist in SP14 and only increment the patch number together with ST 720 (SAP Solution Manager ABAP component):-SAP Solution Manger SP 14 = ST 720 SP14 + LM-SERVICE 7.20 SP14 P00 or higher-SAP Solution Manger SP 15 = ST 720 SP15 + LM-SERVICE 7.20 SP14 P03 or higher-SAP Solution Manger SP 16 = ST 720 SP16 + LM-SERVICE 7.20 SP14 P06 or higher-SAP Solution Manger SP 17 = ST 720 SP17 + LM-SERVICE 7.20 SP14 P11 or higher-SAP Solution Manger SP 18 = ST 720 SP18 + LM-SERVICE 7.20 SP14 P15 or higher-There will be a minimum patch number per SAP Solution Manager SP and it will be checked in SAP Solution Manager Configuration > Infrastructure Preparation > 2.2 Enable Connectivity > Check Java Software Prerequisites.-See Also-KBA 2475657 - How to check the LM-SERVICE Software component version applied on your system-SAP Note 2686969 - Upgrading the LM-SERVICE Patch Level-KBA 2771041 - SAP Solution Manager 7.2: Support Package stack levels-Keywords-solmandiag 720, LM-Service patch, LMSERVICE,

Title: Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel Upload Errors
Content: Symptom-You try to upload journal entry voucher for sales from Microsoft Excel. But when you click Save Data to in the Excel template either a (500) Internal Server Error or more specific messages appear, such as:-Warning: Sales Document or Customer Project or Cost Object missing; Action POST not possible; Action deactivated.-Warning: Cost revenue type missing; Action Post not possible; action is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter go to the Journal Entries - Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Press New ->Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel.-In the SAP Business ByDesign tab press Logon to log in.-Maintain the data for all mandatory fields (*).-Enter other necessary data, such as Sales Document IDs, item IDs, project tasks.-Press Save data to-Possible Error Messages:-(500) Internal Server Error-Warning: Sales Document or Customer Project or Cost Object missing; Action POST not possible; Action deactivated.-Warning: Cost or Revenue type missing; Action POST not possible; Action is deactivated.-Cause- (500) Internal Server Error:-- The sales document type is not maintained for all items-- Mandatory fields are maintained with empty values.-Warning: Sales Document or Customer Project or Cost Object missing; Action POST not possible; Action deactivated.-- The sales document id and sales document item ID is not maintained for all items.-Warning: Cost or Revenue type missing; Action POST not possible; Action is deactivated.-You try to transfer amounts for a sales document from a G/L account of type REVGAN- Revenue or Gains or COSEXP- Cost or Expense  to an account of type OLIAB-Other Liabilities for which the G/L account (origin) needs to be entered.-Resolution-In order to successfully upload the journal entry voucher into the system, you need to:-Enter the sales document type for all items;-Leave no mandatory field with empty values;-Enter the sales document ID and sales document item ID for all items;-Enter a G/L account (Origin) of the original sales revenue account for postings to G/L accounts of type OLIAB- Other Liabilities*;-*If you post to Deferred Cost or Deferred Revenue accounts then maintain the actual expense or revenue accounts in the G/L account (Origin) field. If directly post to expense or revenue accounts the G/L Account (Origin) will be derived automatically.-This way the upload will work.-Keywords-00088; 633;634; sales doc. type, sales doc. ID, sales doc. Item ID, sales document, customer project, cost object missing, journal entry voucher for Ssales from Microsoft Excel,

Title: Wrong Cost Rate Used for a Resource/Service During Planned Cost Calculation of a Project
Content: Symptom-Planned Cost for a project is not as expected.-Newly updated service/resource-cost-rates are not being taken into consideration for the calculation of the Planned Cost. Still the calculation is performed based on the old service/resource-cost-rate.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue workcenter and choose the Projects view.-Show all projects, and find the project in question.-Choose View Plan Values.-Use Filter option to find your Project Task ID.-Select subtab Services and for the Service/Resource in question, the rate picked under Cost Rate field is not as per your expectation for the calculation of the Planned Cost.-Cause-Background on Cost Rate Determination for Service Confirmations on Projects:-Cost Rate Determination:-For internal employees, their work is valued using the following valuation strategy hierarchy:-Labor resource cost rate-Service cost rate-If you want the work to be valued with the service cost rate, simply make sure that no cost rate is defined for the labor resource.-For external employees and employees of other companies within the same corporate group and temporary employees, the work is valued using the following valuation strategy hierarchy:-Price from fixed source of supply-Price from contract-Price from price list-Service cost rate-It possible, that after you made the necessary amendments, either in the labour resource or in the Service Valuation master data you did not retrigger the Valuation of the Planned Project costs.-Resolution-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Projects view.-Show all projects, and find the project in question.-Choose View Plan Values.-Use Filter option to find your Project Task ID.-Click on Valuate All button from the top of the screen. Now the system will revaluate and takes the latest values of the Cost Rates for the calculation of the Planned Cost.-See Also-Project Cost and Revenue Planning-Keywords-resource cost rate, project planning

Title: 97 - Currency exchange differences Posted to Original Expense Account
Content: Symptom-You have created an expense report or a supplier invoice accounted to a specific G/L account. -You create a separate payment with a value below the original expense report/invoice value for the employee/supplier.-In the following clearing you define the difference between invoice and payment as a discount of type 97-Currency exchange differences.-You expect that the currency exchange difference is posted to a separate exchange rate difference account which you have maintained in fine tuning.-Instead, the discount is posted to the original expense account that you have maintained for accounts payable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine tune activity under Account Determination - Accounts Payable, in the Exchange Rate Differences tab you have maintained G/L accounts for exchange rate differences.-0 - Pre-condition: You have created a/n expense report/ supplier invoice for a/n employee/supplier and a payment with a value, lower than the original expense amount separately.-in the Payables workcenter navigate to the Supplier Accounts view.-In the Show field, select All Employees or All Suppliers.-Select the respective employee/supplier and press View.-In the Trade Payables tab, select the expense report and the payment and choose Clear manually.-For the invoice, maintain a discount of type 97 - Currency exchange differences.-Post the clearing.-In the journal entry of the clearing you notice that the currency difference discount has been posted to the original G/L account which corresponds to the account determination group that you have maintained for payables.-But you expect that the currency exchange difference is posted to one of the G/L accounts that you have maintained for exchange rate differences in the Exchange Rate Differences tab.-Cause-The posting logic for the maintained discount is controlled by the settings maintained in the fine tune activity Posting Control Profiles for Procurement Processes.-The standard posting control profile suggests to post any kind of cash discounts to the original expense account.-The payment difference reason 97-Currency exchange rate difference is still considered as cash discount:-Go to the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles fine tune activity.-First choose the Generally Accepted Accounting Principle link to find out which posting control profile is used by the respective accounting principle.-Take note of the posting control profile description and close the screen.-Now choose the Posting Control Profiles for Procurement Processes link.-Find the posting control profile which you noted down and check the Procure for Consumption tab.-Here, under 1-Cash Discount, 2-Over-/Under payment, 3-Differences from Deviating Payment you can see that the Post to Original Expense Account indicator is selected. -This is the reason why the cash discount from the currency exchange rate got posted to the original expense account.-However, it is possible to use a customized posting control profile,  in which you can deselect the original expense account posting logic for certain payment and price differences:-Resolution-Create a new posting control profile for procurement processes and assign it to the respective accounting principles:-In the Business Configuration workcenter access the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles fine tune activity.-Choose the Posting Control Profiles for Procurement Processes link. -To create a new posting control profile copy the General Posting Profile: Choose Copy, change the Posting profile ID and the profile description.-In the sub-tabs underneath you can maintain the payment difference posting settings for three procurement options: Procure for Consumption, Procure to Stock, Procure to Fixed Assets.-If you do not wish payment or price differences generating a discount to be posted to the original expense account, go to the Procure for Consumption tab, select 3 - Differences from Deviating Payment Currency and deselect the Post to Original Expense Account column indicator. -Press Save and Close.-Now choose the Generally Accepted Accounting Principle link.-In the new window you can assign the new Posting Control Profile to the respective accounting principle/s.-Press Save and Close.-If you now maintain a payment difference of type 97 - Currency exchange differences in a clearing the payment difference will be posted to the exchange rate difference account maintained in the Exchange Rate Differences tab for Accounts Payable.-See Also-1816316 - Supplier Cash Discount Posted to Original Expense Account-Keywords-Currency Exchange, Difference, Expense Account, 97 - Currency exchange differences, Payment Difference, Other Discounts/Credits

Title: Error: Upload of MIME Type XYZ/ABC not Permitted
Content: Symptom-You are trying to synchronize an e-mail with an attachment that contains an image file, or you have received a health check with the following error:-E-mail synchronization: "Upload of MIME type application/jpeg not permitted".-Health Check: "The document you want to upload has the MIME type ABC. Documents with this MIME type are not allowed to be uploaded" (where ABC represents the MIME type).-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Cause 1: In case the error occurs during the e-mail synchronization process;-The system does not currently support emails with the specified MIME Type. In order for the system to receive such emails, you need to allow this specific MIME Type in the Business Configuration work center.-Cause 2: If you have received a Health Check;-The message is failing because MIME type ABC is not included in the list of allowed MIME types. To resolve this issue, please add ABC to the allowed MIME types in the Business Configuration. Once this change is made, the message can be restarted.-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1:-You may add the MIME Type using the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open the activity Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload.-Select Add Row.-Make Z entry for MIME Type (for example: application/jpeg) and select Allowed checkbox.-Select Save.-Once it is allowed, the system will accept E-mails that have MIME Type.-Resolution for cause 2:-Check the Allowed checkbox for the MIME type and save the changes.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open the activity Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload-Filter your result based on MIME Type - ABC and select the Allowed indicator.-Save your changes.-NOTE:-Ensure to allow all required mime types as per your ZIP format.-Examples: application/7z, application/x-gzip, application/x-Zip-compressed , application/zip etc.-Once you enable the MIME type, the affected message can be restarted.-See Also-2774580 - Error "Upload of MIME type application/octet-stream not permitted" when uploading Emails with attachments -Keywords-PI Message Monitoring, SAPSupportRequestProcessingSoftwareProblemReportin, MIME Type, Not Allowed, Synchronization

Title: Source Solution Profile ID shows No Records Found
Content: Symptom-You requirement is to create a new system. Upon selecting Source Solution Profile ID, you see the message No Records Found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center Work Center-Go to Systems View-Select the Request Creation button-Enter the System Type-Enter the Data Source as Copy of Source System (Copy solution profile) -Enter Data Source System ID, Solution Profile Source System ID-In the new pop up window for entering the details ,even after you enter the Data Source System ID, the field Source Solution Profile ID shows No Records Found-Cause-There are No open Change Projects for the entered Data Source System ID and Solution Profile Source System ID.-The source tenant have only remote change project, example scenario: User copied the Change Project from Production to test and you are requesting a test from this test system through the change project copied from Production tenant.-Resolution-Data Source Option : Copy of Source System (Copy solution profile) should be selected only if you want to have a standalone test system with merge back capabilities to production system or the regular remote test system for remote change projects. For this you need to have an open Change Project (Status of the Change Project should be Started, but not Merged or Closed).-If you do not intend to have a Merge back System then Data Source Option : Copy of Source System can be Selected , this does not require any Solution Profile.-If there is a local change project in source tenant then only the solution profile id will be visible-See Also-1922087 - How to Create a Change Project and its Lifecycle-1810663 - Cannot Create a Change Project Out of The Change Test System-Keywords-Solution Profile, Copy Solution Profile, Change project, No records found, byd, c4c

Title: How to Add a New Reason For Payment Differences
Content: Symptom-A new Reason for Payment Differences can be added during manual clearing of an open item in the Customer or Supplier Account Monitor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables or Payables work centre.-Go to the Customer Accounts or Supplier Accounts sub view.-Select an Open Item and click Clear Manually.-A new screen opens and gives you the option to select a Payment Difference Reason from a drop-down list.-The required Reason for Payment Differences is not in the drop-down list.-Cause-Add the new Reason for Payment Differences in the Business Configuration activity Reasons for Payment Differences.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Overview sub view.-Show All Configuration Elements and search for the activity: Reasons for Payment Differences.-Open activity and select Country and Grouping for Payment Differences.-Click Add Row and assign a new Payment Difference Reason.-See Also-Payment Difference Reason Statistics | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Zahlungsdifferenz, Grund für Zahlungsdifferenz, clearing, payment clearing, cannot find, can't find, Reasons for Payment Differences for Non-Localized Countries/Regions

Title: Tenant Certificate Details in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This KBA will help you to know your tenant certificate details in SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Each SAP Business ByDesign tenant is provisioned with a tenant certificate issued by the SAP Passport CA. The validity period of the tenant certificate is 1 year.-You can follow the below steps to check the Tenant Certificate details in your SAP Business ByDesign tenant.-Go to Application User and Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks.-Click on Edit Certificate Trust List.-Click on View Tenant Certificate.-In the new tab you will be able to see details like Issued By, Validity & etc.-Tenant certificate will be automatically updated by SAP every year.-No e-mails sent to customers or partners.-See Also-Renewal of Tenant Certificate-Keywords-Tenant Certificate, SAP Business ByDesign, SRD-CC-SEC,

Title: Error: Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for CUSTOMER-DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY - DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY_CTI
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add Direct Responsibilities for your existing accounts using Mass Data Maintenance, but the process fails with the following error:-Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for CUSTOMER-DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY - DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY_CTI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the Import Customers link.-Click Upload Data from Text File.-Select the file you wish to upload from your computer.-Select Import Data to Tab: Direct Responsibility.-Click Upload.-Click Finish Upload.-Click Execute Data Import - Immediately.-The above error message occurs.-Cause-The system works as designed - you cannot add direct responsibilities to accounts via Mass Data Maintenance, but only modify the existing ones. The system works as designed.-Resolution-You should use the migration process instead.-Keywords-mass data maintenance, customer, account, direct responsibilities, migration, byd

Title: List Prices Present Not Manually Created
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A number of list prices with a status "in preparation" being created in the system however user didn't individually create them.-The number of affected items can be quite large.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Product Portfolio workcenter-Open View : List Prices-Show : List Prices in Preparation-A large number of items are listed-Cause-User actually created the list prices unknowingly. On creating a new list price based on a product category the system pulls all the products for this category and lists them all.-If user simply Choose "Finish" in the Guided Activity at this point the system creates all these list prices in the system with the status 'In Preparation'.-This is the normal system behaviour.-Depending on the amount of products in the system, this can lead to a very large number of such items that might not be required and will then need to be manually deleted.-Resolution-When creating a new list price based on a product category and supplier, once you reach the second step in the Guided Activity (Enter price) and all the products are listed, you must:-Select the products you want to create a list price for by updating the price information. This will automatically tick the Release button for the selected product-Remove from the list the products you do not want to create a list price for using the Remove button.-Choose Finish. This will create and release only the list prices that are present and selected.-Note that if at this point you untick the release button and click Finish, the corresponding list price will be created with the status "In preparation".-Keywords-List prices; List prices created Automatically; In preparation List prices;

Title: Backend Dump Occurs During Any Action in the UI due to PDI Involvement
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Customer will get a dump or a backend exception while they perform any action from the UI.-Could not create object; class does not exist.-Object instance creation of action rejection implementation class.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the system.-Navigate to the relevant work center view.-Perform the required actions.-Dump occurs.-Cause-To confirm the cause, follow the below steps:-Login to the backend.-Open the ST22 transaction.-Locate the dump.-Navigate to the Application Information section.-You can find either message:-Could not create object; class YABC_CL_ACTION_VALIDATION does not exist, where YABC is the solution name.-Object instance creation of action rejection implementation class "YABCDEFGY_CL_ACTION_VALIDATION" of action "YABCDEFGY_ABCD12345667890ABC" on node "ROOT" in BO "BO_NAME" failed.-Resolution-You would need to inform the customer/partner to activate all ActionValidation scripts created on the BO/Node from the add-on mentioned on the error message, as well as the .xbo file to which the script is created.-You can also locate the script on XREP and provide the file path to the customer/partner.-In case the PDI solution is not seen on XREP while in LAYER_CUST, most likely the PDI is partially deleted, meaning that it was attempted to be deleted by the customer, but this failed.--To confirm that the PDI is partially deleted, follow below steps:-Go to SDIM transaction-Expand One-Off folder-Expand the affected PDI folder-Double click in 100 folder-If the status is UNDEPLOYED, then the PDI is partially deleted and partner can fully delete it from SDK, following the KBA:  2175583 - How to Delete a Solution from the Cloud Applications Studio-See Also-KBAs:- 2570850 - How to Use The Backend Transaction XREP - 2175583 - How to Delete a Solution from the Cloud Applications Studio--Keywords-Could, not, create, object, Dump, UI, CL_ACTION, Action, Class, Validation, PDI, SDK

Title: Cannot Upload Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel Because of Error Message: Incorrect binding for element `Note`
Content: Symptom-You try to upload journal entry voucher from Microsoft Excel, when you click Save Data to in the excel template, the system gives error messages:-Incorrect binding for element `Note`.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view-Go to Journal Entry Vouchers subview.-Create new voucher from excel as New ->Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel.-Select the Save data button in the Excel add-in.-You get the error message mentioned above.-Cause-The issue is with the header text in the excel template, it's too long. This text must not be longer than 35 characters. The same restriction is also valid for the note of the items.-Resolution-You should change the header text, and make it less than 35 characters, after that, you should to able to successfully upload the document to the system.-Keywords-Excel, Journal Entry Voucher, Incorrect biding for element, Upload.

Title: Solution Provided by Hotfix Deployment
Content: Symptom-Dear Customer,-To solve the reported issue, we created a software correction and implemented the correction into your system.-We would like to ask you to test your application to verify it is working as expected.-Best Regards,-SAP Product Support-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer

Title: Canceled Purchase Order Line Item Still Showing Awaiting Invoice/Receipts Under GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary
Content: Symptom-You post invoices and receipts for a purchase order.-You later cancel some line items of the Purchase Order.-On running the GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary report, those canceled line items are still showing under amount awaiting invoice/receipt even after the GR/IR Clearing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center: Inventory Valuation.-Under Reports / List choose the report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary.-Select the relevant parameters for your report creation including purchasing document XYZ (XYZ means the Purchasing Document Item).-Items which are canceled are showing as amount awaiting invoice / amount awaiting receipts.-Cause-Since the purchase order status still showing as partially delivered / invoiced and mark for final clearing was also not set for the canceled items, system is still assuming that goods/invoices are expected, so the same is being shown in the report.-Resolution-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Select Purchasing Document Items view.-Select Purchasing Document Item XYZ.-Select the canceled Purchasing Document Item line and Click Final Clearing -> Mark.-Enter the Marked Final Clearing Date DD.MM.YYYY.-Since the previous GR/IR Clearing Run did not mark these canceled line items because it has not done any clearing for them, so you can manually mark these items and run the GR/IR Clearing Run. Upon completing the run, the entry in the report should be cleared.-Keywords- GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary, Purchase Order, Mark for Final Clearing.

Title: Schedule a New Recalculation Run for Depreciation, for the Company and the Set of Books
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new depreciation run for Company ABC (ABC stands for the company ID) and set of books NNN (NNN stands for the set of books ID) for the period PPP/YYYY (PPP/YYYY stands for the period/year).-You get the warning message " For correct results, before running this depreciation, schedule a new recalculation run for depreciation, for the company ABC and the set of books NNN as there has been no successful processing of recalculation run after the opening of the fiscal year YYYY."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Depreciation view.-Press New and choose Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Enter a run description. -Enter the company ID. -Select the respective closing step. -Enter the Period PPP/YYYY.-A warning message appears: "For correct results, before running this depreciation, schedule a new recalculation run for depreciation, for the company ABC and the set of books NNN as there has been no successful processing of recalculation run after the opening of the fiscal year YYYY."-Cause-Every time a new fiscal year is created, the depreciation values accumulated for all the fixed assets have to be recalculated, so the new period-wise values are persisted for the newly created fiscal year.-Therefore, a recalculating depreciation run (notice the period 999/9999)  is automatically scheduled.-For some reason, this recalculation run was not triggered or finished with errors.-Resolution-You can solve this issue by performing a new recalculation run as follows:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Depreciation view.-Click the New button and then Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Enter Run Description.-Uncheck the Test run box.-Enter Company as ABC.-Select the Closing step as 020 - Closing entries.-Enter the Period 999/9999.-After the run is finished, check the status of the run.-If there are errors, resolve them and execute the Recalculation Run once again.-Should you not be able to resolve the errors, send an incident to Product Support.-Keywords-fixed assets; Anlage; depreciation; Abschreibung; Abschreibungslauf, Neuberechnung

Title: Error Message: 'Reversal not possible; posting date must be in fiscal year'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have canceled a goods receipt or a supplier invoice that is related to fixed asset procurement, however the document remains unposted with an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view. -Find the unposted source document.-Error: 'Reversal not possible; posting date must be in fiscal year <fiscal year of original procurement posting>'-Click Actions -> Post Business Transaction to Another Period.-Choose a date in the previous fiscal year as the error message suggests.-Error: 'Business transaction for accounting for <document type and ID>, <version number> with alternate posting date not processed. Alternate posting date must be after proposed posting date.'-Cause-Since this is related to fixed asset acquisition, the reversal/cancelation document shall be posted within the same fiscal year as the original source document.-Resolution-There are two approaches that can address this scenario:-Option A (Supplier Invoice / Customer Invoice):-In case of a supplier invoice, you create a credit memo that offset/adjust the postings with the desired posting date or adjust the values via manual journal entry voucher. Once the credit memo is posted, the invoice cancellation can be marked as irrelevant from backend by support. However, this may lead to inconsistencies, in GR/IR Clearing Run, Data Flow Verifications and possibly in reconciliation reports.-by marking the cancelation invoice as irrelevant, no reversal posting/no journal entry is gonna happen in accounting.-The original invoice will remain as is, in status canceled in application side, with no cancelation posting in accounting.-The fixed asset and individual material would not be returned to Capitalized/Acquired status.-In the customer/supplier account monitor, the original invoice would still show as open (if not yet paid). But you could clear it against the credit memo.-Data flow verification results could possible raised errors for these transactions. Because it shows cancelled in application side but there is no cancellation posting in accounting.-Option B (Goods Receipt and/or Supplier Invoice):-In this approach, development can evaluate the possibility to change the cancellation posting date from backend to the previous year. To do so, an incident is required where you provide support team with:-the desired cancellation posting date in the fiscal year of the original procurement document.-confirmation that the fiscal year and period of the desired is open for postings.-approval for backend correction.-Note that with this approach the fiscal year has to be reopened and valuation runs like foreign currency remeasurement must be reversed. Since postings will occur to the fiscal year, the numbers will likely change and closing procedures shall be done again.-In both options, it is recommended to first re-create the scenario/error in a test environment so that you may analyze the data and decide whether you want to proceed with the same in production.-By granting approval for backend correction in these circumstances, you acknowledge that inconsistencies may occur and that SAP will not be liable in case any inconsistencies occur due to these postings in the future.-The above mentioned options are workarounds for this case. The permanent fix is being analyzed via internal incident https://support.wdf.sap.corp/sap/support/message/1980028205 and JIRA [BYDDEV-103] Issue of cancellation documents; Synchronous check to accounting missing - SAPJIRA (tools.sap)-See Also-  1670755 - Cancelation of a Goods and Services Receipt refering to a Fixed Asset Cannot be Posted

Title: Postal Address or Physical address of Data Center
Content: Symptom-The postal address of the data center which contains the data of the tenant is unknown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Cause-This information is internal, to maximize data security, and for the protection of your data.-Resolution-We are unable to provide the physical address/Postal address of any of our data centers.-Keywords-Data Center, Postal Address, Physical Address, Geolocation, Data Security

Title: File Validation Failed in Migration of Customer Contracts
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--Customer reports error message "File validation failed. Create an incident" when importing customer contracts in the migration tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Locate and open fine-tuning activity Migration of Customer Contracts.-Click the link "Migrate customer contracts using the migration tool."-In the next screen, select the relevant migration file.-Click Execute Migration, then select Execute Migration Step by Step.-On step 1, Validate File, error occurs.-Cause-First, ensure that the issue is not caused by an invalid runtime object (check See Also section for more information), then check if there is a technical exception in backend transaction ST22 with the following header:--Category               ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors         UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION-Except.                /ISDT/CX_INVALID_DATETIME-ABAP Program           /1CADMC/SAPLDMC0800000000003-If that is the case, the issue is happening because  the fields Contract Start Date and Contract End Date fields in the migration template are not filled, or include incorrect data.-Example: Below values are entered:-Contract Start Date: 01.01.2024  00:00:00-Contract End Date: 31.12.2024  23:59:00-Correct would be:-Contract Start Date: 01.01.2024-Contract End Date: 31.12.2024-Resolution-Please advise the customer to provide correct values for fields Contract Start Date and Contract End Date in the General tab of the Migration of Customer Contracts template.-See Also-3198065 - Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create Incident" in Any Migration Service-Keywords-Migration of Customer Contracts, Migrate, File Validation Failed, UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION, /ISDT/CX_INVALID_DATETIME,-METHOD       CL_DMC_RT_RBAM_CALLBACK=======CP    CL_DMC_RT_RBAM_CALLBACK=======CM002     7  CL_DMC_RT_RBAM_CALLBACK=>IF_XTS_RBAM_CONTEXT_CALLBACK~CALL_AS_UI_APPLICATION

Title: 'ABC is not a contact for DEF' Error in New Manual Clearing
Content: Symptom-Error message upon trying to post a New Manual Clearing:-'ABC is not a contact for DEF' -Remark: the same error message also occurs in Collection Case GHI screen.-ABC represents a Contact ID (Name).-DEF represents the Customer Account ID (Name).-GHI represents a Collection Case ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivales work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Find respective Account ID and click View-Select respective Payment open item and Invoice, which is Collection Case GHI.-Click Clear Manually.-Enter respective Posting Date and Document Date.-Click Clear.-Error is thrown:-'ABC is not a contact for DEF' -Remark: the same error is thrown while opening Collection Case GHI from Receivables work center -> Collection Cases view.-Cause-In Collection Case GHI, the Customer Contact ABC is maintained.-However, ABC is not maintained as a Contact in Customer Account DEF.-Resolution-The Customer Contact assigned to the Collection Case GHI must be also maintained in Corporate Account master data as a Contact (Contacts tab -> Contacts sub tab).-Keywords-collection case; contacts; activity; customer contacts; new manual clearing

Title: Time recording with no Approval Required still being sent for approval
Content: Symptom-You create a Time Recording and is being sent for approval despite the Project configuration saying that for Time Recording No Approval is Required.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview view.-Click on Edit Time Sheet under Time.-Click on Add Row.-Enter the Project Task.-Enter the Activity.-Select the Time Type.-Click on Actions-Select Release.-See that the Status is In Approval.-Cause-In the header task the configuration No Approval Required there is some configuration on the Project Settings that made this Approval necessary.-The approval is required if:-this is made for a Non-Listed Service, meaning the services listed on the Products tab.-this is made for a Non–Team Member, meaning a person that is not part of the Project team listed on Team and Staffing tab.-this is made Outside of Planned Period, meaning the planned period of the relevant work package. In case no period is planned for this work package, the planned period of the project task is considered instead.-this Exceeds Planned Work, meaning this time will exceed the Planned Work established on Team and Staffing tab.-Resolution-On the Basic Data for the header task you can define if a time recordings will be generally allowed, allowed with approval, or not allowed at all.--And in the Project Settings (this tab is only visible on the header task) you will be able to specified which configuration will be used by the system to create this approvals.-All other tasks for the Project will only have one Time Recording dropdown, but will follow the rules created on the Project Settings.-If you don't want to create an approval for this, you need to select No Approval Required for all the fields under Time Recording on Project Settings.-Keywords-Project Time Recording, Project Time, Time Recording, Project, Time Recording Approval, Approval Required

Title: Double Calculation In Subsequent Work-in-Progress Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You are facing an incomplete calculation of the production lot in the WIP clearing run, you notice that the production lot was calculated twice, despite the production order being finished, leading to double calculation in subsequent WIP clearing run. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to WIP Clearing subview. -Here we can see two run IDs: XYZ (XYZ represents the first run) and DEF (DEF represents the second run). -Production lot is calculated twice - for example, first in WIP from 010.2023 and secondly in WIP 011.2023.-The production order was finished in 010.2023 - but there is just half of the posting done In 011.2023, it is again and completely calculated.-Cause-One possible reason for this behavior is because of the end date of the Production lot. Please check the example below:-Production End shows as 11.12.2023 08:36.-Execution Monitor:-Restart:                                                 11.12.2023 08:36-Finish:                                                   11.12.2023 08:36-  I.e. previously cleared balances in 010.2023 will be reversed for 011.2023. The WIP Clearing would again clear the balances when run for 012.2023.-  Similar logic as for GR/IR – if documents are canceled but have been cleared before. The Clearing will be reversed in the period when they happen to be open again. -  To check the end date of the Production lot, please check the steps below: -  Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Production Lots subview. -Select "All Production Lots" option. -Search for the desired production lot.-Click "View" button > View All. -Go to Execution Monitor, and here we can see all the details. We can also check in "General" tab. -Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-WIP Clearing, Work-in-Progress Clearing Run, Twice, Double Calculation, Subsequent, Production lot.

Title: Extension Field in Purchase Order not Shown in Response via API: QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn
Content: Symptom-There are extension fields on item level in a purchase order, but when querying the purchase order by API: QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn, the content in extension fields are not returned in the response.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Create a new purchase order XYZ (XYZ stands for the document ID).-Fill in extension fields on item level.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Service Explorer view and download WSDL for API: QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn.-Create a new project in SOAP UI for the WSDL.-Input required information in the payload to find XYZ. -In the response result, there is no structure of "<n1:TechnicalName(field name) xmlns:n1="namespace of the extension field”>Value of extension field</n1:TechnicalName>".-Cause-This is an expected performance.-QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn cannot return extension field values on item level, but will return ones on header level.-Resolution-To get extension field values on item level, user need to call ManagePurchaseOrderIn.-See Also-KBA 2636184 - How To Integrate KUT Extension Fields Into Web Services-Keywords-Extension field; Web Service; QueryPurchaseOrderIn; SOAP UI

Title: Report Customer Invoice Volume With Price Components Does Not Display The Expected Information For Field Net Value (Transactional Currency)
Content: Symptom-When you select the field 'Net value (Transactional Currency)' on the Report Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components the value displayed is not the same amount you see on the Customer Invoice Document.-Environment-SAP Business By Design -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID HJK.-Click on Open and then the View All button.-Navigate to the Pricing tab-Net value is 5.148,00 EUR-Total amount is 5.301,70 EUR-To see the report information follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Design Reports view.-Search for the reports CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 and CRMCIVIPATCB_Q0001.-Open, view all.-On each report navigate to the View tab.-If you add the Column Field 'Net Value (Transactional Currency)' the information is not the same for both reports.-In the Report CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 the net value (transactional currency) field is showing the value 5.301,70 EUR.-In the Report CRMCIVIPATCB_Q0001 the net value (transactional currency) field is showing the value 0,00 EUR.-Cause-In the report 'Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components' (Report ID CRMCIVIPATCB_Q0001) the Key Figures Net Value (Transactional Currency) and Total (Transactional Currency) cannot be correctly displayed on Invoice level since for these price components the aggregation does not work as expected.-The system will not accumulate all line items but will just take the first value of the line items.-In the Customer Invoice HJK, the first line item in the report is line item 20. Since line item 20 in HJK is a Sales Kit - Sub Item and does not have a price, the value is displayed as 0,00.-You can also see this by adding the Customer Invoice Item in the Rows of the report and expand the Invoice in the results.-Resolution-This is a system expected behavior.-Keywords-Report, CRMCIVIB_MQ0001, CRMCIVIPATCB_Q0001, Currency, Transactional, Price Components, Volume

Title: You are Unable to Assign a Work Center to Business User Who is the first Business User
Content: Symptom-You are unable to assign a work center to the Business User who is the first Business User created in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search and Select the Business User XYZ (XYZ represents the Business User ID).-Open in Edit mode through Access Restrictions view.-You can observe that you are unable to assign a work center to the user.-Cause-The User XYZ is not assigned any work center, as it's the first business user.-Resolution-The initial user should assign the work center to the first Business User created.-See Also-1658013 - User Cannot Create New Business Users Or Service Agents Using Initial User-Business Roles Quick Guide | SAP Help Portal-Keywords- Business User, Access Restrictions, Initial User-business user,access restrictions,initial user

Title: How To Configurate An E-Mail Template in a Workflow Rule of Type Notification
Content: Symptom-A workflow rule of type Notification is configured with a custom email template; however, the notification email is sent using the default template, and no option is available to change the template.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. Workflow rules of type Notification always use the standard email template, which cannot currently be modified or replaced with a custom template.-Resolution-As a workaround, create a new workflow rule of type E-Mail and select the required email template by following the steps below:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Workflow Rules View.-Click on New.-Complete Steps 1 and 2 to define the rule. -Then go to Step 3 - Define Actions, in the workflow rule creation.-In the Rule Type field, select E-Mail.-In the Template File field, click on Browse button.-You can select the specific HTML file template for the workflow rule mentioned.-The e-mail will be sent with the template selected.-Keywords-Workaround, Email Rule, Custom HTML, Template Limitation, Default Email Format, Email Template Assignment, Notification Uses Default, Email Alert, Workflow Configuration, Rule Action, Customization Limitation, Email Notification Behavior

Title: Incorrect Total Cost in Project
Content: Symptom-In Project Plan, you maintained some work (service) and material item. However, you see no value or unexpected value showing in the Total Cost field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Project view-Open a Project -Go to Project Plan, Work subtab-You see for Service item ABC (ABC stands for the service ID), the total cost is missing or wrong-Or-Go to Project Plan, Materials subtab-You see for Material item DEF(DEF stands for the service ID), the total cost is missing or wrong-Cause-The Total Cost in project screen is displaying the total planned cost of the item. It is calculated based on the Planned Quantity (X) and the Cost Rate (Y) in the same screen.-Total Cost = X*Y-If the cost rate is not found, even there is planned quantity, the Total Cost is showing as blank.-If the planned quantity is 0, even there is cost rate and actual quantity, the Total Cost is showing as 0.-Resolution-Please ensure the planned quantity and cost rate is correct maintained for the service/material item.-Keywords-Project, Total Cost, Cost Rate

Title: How to Handle Administrator User Locking Situations
Content: Symptom-You locked an administrator business user and need to request SAP for that user to be unlocked and/or for the password to be reset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-SAP has a very strict data protection and security policy to protect Customer data and System access. Please ensure that there is an Administrator or key user available at all times with access to the Business Users view to unlock users and set temporary passwords. SAP suggests to avoid having only a single administrator user to prevent such situations.-There might be a scenario where all users get locked by accident. In such a case, you can provide SAP support with that admin/key user's user ID and request for SAP to unlock and also reset that user's password.-Important Info: SAP will only send the password to the e-mail maintained for this particular user. SAP will never share a business user's password on the phone (unless the identity of the caller being the same as the business user owner is confirmed and clear). SAP will never send a temporary password to an e-mail address that is not already maintained in connection to that same user in the system.-In case the above scenario is not correctly configured, your SAP CSP (Customer Success Partner) or SAP Representative needs to be contacted to confirm the user identity in the company, so SAP support can process the request in an exceptional basis.-These strict rules are in the interest of data protection and Application-User Security.-See Also-3295340 - User Password has been Locked due to Many Incorrect Login Attempts-Keywords-Admin, Security, Data Protection, Business User, Key user, byd, c4c

Title: Field Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected Automatically Checked on Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You create a Purchase Order and the field Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected is being automatically checked even though you have configured the Supplier Master Data to Not Expect the Acknowledgment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select New Purchase Order.-Enter the Supplier.-Navigate to Items tab.-Click on Add Row.-See that the Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected is checked.-Cause-You have configured the Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Setting to expect a manual change on the Acknowledgment.-Resolution-If you want to follow the Supplier Master Data configuration and not manually change the Acknowledgment setting please follow the below steps to change the configuration:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Setting.-Open the activity.-De-select the checkbox for Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected.-Click on Save and Close.-This should apply the expected behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order Acknowledgment Expected, Acknowledgment, Purchase Order Acknowledgment, Purchase Order Item Follow Up, Follow-up Documents

Title: Unposted Production Confirmation Due to Missing Cost Rate Error: Cost Rate for Resource Missing
Content: Symptom-You have a created a production confirmation, which ended up as an unposted source document due to missing resource's cost rate. However, you have previously successfully posted other production confirmations with this same resource.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents view.-Highlight the unposted production confirmation.-The following error is shown: 'Cost rate for resource <resource ID and name> and set of books <ID> valid on <Date> is missing'-You wonder why the error is raised, since there are previous posted production confirmations with this same resource, which did not end up in error.-The previous postings can be found via Production Lots - Line Items or G/L Accounts - Line Items report with the Resource as a selection parameter.-Cause-If you check the master data of the resource mentioned in the error message, the Cost Rate and Cost Unit are empty, having only the unit of measure (e.g. EUR / Hour(s)) present. Therefore, the system is not able to derive the cost rate to make the valuation based on the resource. Reason being the error is raised.-Previous production confirmation postings could have happened with this resource, even with Cost Rate in blank. The error would not be raised in such cases because the related production confirmation uses a service from this labor resource. Since the service related to this resource is used, the valuation happens based on the service cost rates (that are maintained) and not based on the resource rate.-Therefore, if the resource confirms it's work in the production confirmation without providing any service, the valuation happens based on the resource's cost rate, which is currently blank.-If the resource provides a service in the production confirmation, the valuation is based on the service's cost rate. Therefore, the resource's cost rate could be blank and the error would not be raised. Also, in this case, when the service is being used, you have to delimit the cost rate in the resource.-To check if the service from the resource us used, open the production confirmation and check the Services section.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. If there is a resource in the production confirmation without reference to its service, the valuation happens with the resource's cost rate. Hence, you need to maintain the cost rate and cost unit in the valuation tab of the related resource.-See Also-KBA 2093887  Cost Rate For Resource XXX and Set of Books ABC Valid On DD.MM.YYYY is Missing-KBA 2191749  Error Message: Cost rate for resource XXX and set of books ABC valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing-Keywords-Production Confirmation. Production Lot. WIP. Labor Resource. Valuation

Title: Common Issues in Migration and Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This Knowledge Base Article lists the most common issues with the migration tool (and Mass Data Maintenance), as well as how to solve them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution- Initially, always ensure that:-Customer is using the latest migration template downloaded from the migration tool.-The values entered in the migration template have no formatting, comments, etc.-No alteration was made to the migration template's header.-File size of the migration template is within the limit of 100 MB.-# Issue summary Cause Solution-1 Application-related error messages in any of the migration's step Application-related error messages in the migration process have the same cause as respective messages in the UI Respective application team must advise on how to solve the messages-2 Error message "File validation failed" in any migration-a. Data in incorrect format or missing mandatory data.-b. Backend inconsistency of the migration object.-c. Duplicate entries in CSV template-a. The migration's error log advises what data is incorrect or missing.-b. Check KBA #3198065 on how to correct.-c. Check ST22 for ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY dump and verify duplicates using Excel / CSV editor-3 500 SAP Internal Server Error when accessing the migration tool or downloading a migration template Issue is caused by an inconsistency of the migration object in the backend. Check logs in SLG1 and/or ST22, then apply the relevant correction in transaction DMC_INC_CORR (see KBA #3202122 for more details).-4 Error message "Service call failed" in Simulate Import step Issue was caused by an error for which no error message is written (application error for which message was not created or dump) 1. Check in backend transaction SLG1 if available log provides more details (in case of application error).-2. If no further details are available in SLG1, debug further following KBA #1877585-5 Migration processing is stuck at a certain percentage a. When stuck at 1%, this is usually a failure to release the migration job in the backend.-b. When stuck at 25%, it is often because some data reference in the migration template caused an endless recursion (loop) a. Please check the relevant migration job in SM37 as per KBA #2651420; if all is correct in SM37, this might be an issue with a PDI script (see KBA #2475888).-b. Advise customer to identify and correct the recursive data reference (see KBAs #2024054 and #1886526 for example).-6 Frequent user locking errors in Migration of Material/Service Valuation The issue can be caused by the huge amount of data being migrated. Suggest best practices for performance improvement as outlined in KBA #3076767-7 “Data import aborted” during Mass Data Maintenance Often, this error generic message indicates inconsistencies in the migration object are impacting the Mass Data Maintenance job. Check logs in SLG1 and/or ST22, then apply the relevant correction in transaction DMC_INC_CORR (see KBA #3202122 for more details).-8 Blank screen when validating data in Mass Data Maintenance This issue can also indicate issues with the migration object in the backend. Same as above.-9 Microsoft Silverlight screen is raised when trying to access Mass Data Maintenance User does not have all necessary access rights to open Mass Data Maintenance Since Mass Data Maintenance runs on the same framework as the migration tool, access to the work center view is also necessary to access it (see KBA #3021382).-10 No data in the Direct Responsibility tab when exporting customers through Mass Data Maintenance Behavior happens because of issues of data persistency in internal tables.-A business object reload needs to be executed (see KBA #3170551 for further details).-NOTE: this should be done by the BC-SRV-FSI support team.-Keywords-Migration, Mass Data Maintenance, DMC_INC_CORR, File validation failed, Data import aborted, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, byd

Title: How to check your CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You need to check your tenants CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) before triggering a tenant request to avoid it is scheduled in between source and target systems contractual maintenance period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Under Maintenance Schedule view click on List.-On the left top corner you will see a drop down list, then you can choose your non-productive systems or productive systems to check.-The status of the "type of activity" will be as "Maintenance" and you can see if it is planned or not, as well the relevant start time and duration in UTC time zone.-See Also-2136036 - How to Request a New Tenant for SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer-2340655 - How to Request Tenant Refresh in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period), Tenant Request, Tenant Refresh, Maintenance Schedule, byd

Title: Initial User Cannot Create New Users Even With Confirmed Milestone: Design Accepted
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer is using the initial user and trying to create new users or service agents, but cannot see the Application and User Management Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The initial user is unable to see the Application and User Management Work Center.-Cause-Usually the cause is the one seen in KBA 1658013, but because of a backend issue, sometimes the initial user's rights are misconfigured.-Resolution-To reassign access to the Application and User Management Work Center to the user, we must refresh their access rights. For that, follow the steps below:-Enter the customer system through the backend.-Go to transaction SE37.-In the field "Function Module" insert "BCT_ASSGN_WOC_INIT_USR".-Click on execute (F8).-Mark the checkbox "Uppercase/Lowercase".-Click on execute (F8).-Now the customer should be able to access Application and User Management Work Center.--See Also-1658013 - User Cannot Create New Business Users Or Service Agents Using Initial User-Keywords-Create users. create service agents. Application and User Management. Access.  BCT_ASSGN_WOC_INIT_USR.

Title: Actual Cost Rollup Failed With Error Messages: 'Cost center has no cost' - 'Valuation with cost estimate Failed'
Content: Symptom-You have executed the Actual Cost Rollup and receive some error messages, such as-'Cost center AAA (Manufacturing) has no cost.' (AAA represents the Cost Center ID).-'Valuation with cost estimate of resource XYZ failed' (XYZ represents the Resource ID).-'Valuation with cost estimate of production lot ZZZ failed' (ZZZ represents the Production Lot ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view -> Actual Cost Rollup.-Find and select XXX (XXX represents the Actual Cost Rollup run ID).-Go to the Execution Details view.-Find Execution ID YYY.-Go to the Messages view.-You will find the error messages below:-'Cost center AAA (Manufacturing) has no cost.'-'Valuation with cost estimate of resource XYZ failed.'-'Cost center AAA (Manufacturing) has no cost.'-'Valuation with cost estimate of production lot ZZZ failed.'-Cause-For the system to recognize the Costs, they need to be successfully posted.-However, in this case, there is no charge posted to the Cost G/L account of the service, which is related to the resource XYZ in related production lot ZZZ.-To verify this, you can first check the Cost G/L account of the service.-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Resources.-Open resource XYZ and go to Services tab.-Open Service DEF (DEF is the service ID - Name) and go to Valuation, here you get the Account Determination Group.-Go to Business Configuration work center and Overview view.-Search for Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination and open Costs subledger configuration.-Go to Service, you can get the G/L account of Credit and Debit for Internal Services.-Now you can check the posted charge to the G/L account in the following report:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Reports view -> List and show all Reports.-Select the Cost Centers - Line Items report.-Search using the requested information as company, Set of Books, Accounting Period, Cost Center AAA and G/L account you get.-The report does not display any data in the Charge key figure for this G/L account. Or, the Charge value is negative.-In this case, there are no costs to be considered for the Cost Center to which the resource belongs to. The run cannot finish successfully.-Resolution-The Cost Center can receive postings through a Journal Entry Voucher. For example, you can create a Journal Entry Voucher for the company (something like salary posting) with a debit to the Cost Center and an offset line which will have the credit.-An example of such post would be:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view -> Journal Entry Vouchers.-Click New -> Journal Entry Voucher. At least two rows need to be maintained. Example as follows:-Line A: Production G/L Account ABC: Debit - in combination with Production Cost Center AAA.-Line B: G/L Account DEF: Credit - in combination with  and optional Cost Center BBB.-Observation: The Debit Line should be against the Cost Center for which the charge needs to be posted and the Credit Line should have either a different Account Assignment Type or should belong to a different Cost Center. The Debit Line G/L Account should be of Expense Type.-Note: when you create the manual journal entry voucher to post the expense, the G/L Account ABC must be an account with G/L account type Costs/Expenses, otherwise, you might get error: Account assignment to cost center AAA only allowed for account type Costs/Expenses. G/L Account ABC cannot be used. So you can change the G/L Account type of ABC to Costs/Expenses if it is not.-After you have successfully posted the cost to the relevant Cost Center, create a new Rollup run and you see the error will not occur.-Keywords-Cost center, Valuation cost. No cost.

Title: Report data is displayed in a different language than the one you expected
Content: Symptom-You run a report and the output file (e.g: PDF file) that is generated is in English language, however you expect the data is displayed/printed in a different language.-E.g.: The content of the report is displayed in English but, you expect the content to be displayed in, Spanish language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The report was originally executed and the output file was created when the user was logged in the system using English Language.-Resolution-If you create a run for the Report while logged in the system using English language, all the data generated by this report will be in English and it will be persisted in the same language in the system. So, whenever this report is opened it's data (text, PDF) will always be in English.--If you create a new run for the Report while logged in the system using a different language (e.g.: Spanish), all the data generated by this report will be in Spanish and it will be persisted in the same language in the system. So, whenever this report is opened it's data (text, PDF) will always be in Spanish.--If during the execution of the report, you use the "Schedule" or "Schedule and Print" option, the system will use the language set for the user, in this case, you need to check the language that is set under the user attributes.--Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view.-Go to the Business Users subview.-Find the relevant Business User ID.-Click on the Edit button.-Select the Attributes option.-Under Language box display the drop-down menu.-Select the desired language.-Click on the Save button.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-report, translation, language, header, translate, PDF

Title: File Validation Issues in Any Migration Service
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer is working with one of the multiple migration services in the system and receives an error message such as "File validation failed. Create incident" or "Migration terminated; contact your service adviser" in the first step of the migration process.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This can happen in any migration service in the system. For this example, we will be using the Customers migration service.-Access the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects work center view.-Alternatively, go to the Overview work center view and skip to step 4.-Select the available implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Use the search bar to locate the Migration of Customers fine-tuning activity.-Open the activity.-Click the link "Migrate customers using the migration tool."-In the migration tool's screen, select the migration file indicated by the customer in the Source Files table.-Click the Execute Migration button, then select Execute Migration Step by Step-The error message is raised already in step 1, "Validate File."-Cause-Often, this is caused by inconsistencies with the migration object in the backend.-To determine if this is the case, you can go to backend transaction DMC_INC_CORR, use the value help of the Migration Object field to select the object (following our example, we are using CUSTOMERS_A2X001) and execute the Check Object Consistency routine (select it and press F8 or click the "Execute" button at the top).-If the check fails with the below error message, it indicates that there is an inconsistency with the migration object (if the check completes successfully, check SLG1 transaction for additional error logs, as issue might be related to application content).-Resolution-The first step after confirming the runtime object is invalid is to attempt regenerating the runtime object by running the Generate Run Time Object routine. In case this completes successfully, it might have been enough to address the issue—please verify in the frontend if the issue is no longer occurring and inform the customer.-In case this fails, there are a few errors common errors that might occur which can also be solved by other routines in the DMC_INC_CORR transaction. Please check the See Also section for more details.-See Also-3202122 - How to Use The Backend Transaction DMC_INC_CORR-Keywords-Migration, File Validation Failed, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, DMC_INC_CORR, Migration terminated, Contact your service adviser

Title: Time Account Postings Shown as Bookable From and Bookable To in the Future Year
Content: Symptom-You have recorded time under a specific Time Type for the current year. However, in the Account Postings section under Employee Times, it shows 'Bookable From' and 'Bookable To' dates in the future year.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the Employee and click on Edit.-Navigate to Employee Times.-Select the required entry.-Under Details: Account Postings show Bookable From and Bookable To in the future year.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Posting Type is not defined for the Time Accounts in the fine tuning activity for Time Types.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for Time Types - X and open it (Where X represents the country).-Open Maintain Employee Time Types.-Select the relevant Time Type.-Go to Time Account Posting tab.-Choose the Posting Type as either Accrual or Deduction. Apply the same configuration for those Time Accounts where the time is posting in the future year.-Following this setup, execute the Administrative Day Closure run for all employees.-Time will be posted to respective Time Accounts based on Bookable From and To.-See Also-Administer Day Closure Runs -Run Day Closure for One Employee-Keywords-Account postings, Time Types, Posting type, Bookable From, Bookable To, Future year

Title: Migrating Employee Time File Error: "Target Value Cannot Be Empty"
Content: Symptom-After creating the time model in the Time Administration work center under the Time Models view, you encounter an issue during the employee time file migration. Specifically, you are unable to select a value from the value help for the working time model in the "Edit Value Conversion for Working Time Model" step due to the absence of available data.-Furthermore, you may notice that the status of the working time model is marked as red, with the error message "Target value cannot be empty."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview view.-Search for Migration of Employee Data -<Country> and open it.-Click on Migrate time and labour management using the migration tool.-Select the relevant file.-Click on Execute Migration > Execute Migration step by step.-Click on Edit Value Conversion for Working Time Model.-Cause-A potential cause is the absence of schedule models in the Time Model view. The input help displays only those time models that are designated as schedule models in the time model view.-Resolution-For data migration, only models of the type "schedule model" are supported. To ensure their availability, you must have selected them in the project scope under Questions in the Human Resources area. Additionally, it is necessary to configure the schedule models in the Time Administration work center before migrating time and labor management data.-Keywords-Time model, Employee time file, Migration of Employee Data, Edit value conversion for working time model, Migrate time and labour management using the migration tool,

Title: Unexpected grouping of the payment proposals
Content: Symptom-The Payment run generates several payment proposals for the customer, however, for the same Payment ID, there are documents with different net due dates.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center > Payment Runs view-Search for the desired Run ID-Under Execution Details, select All logs-Click View Payment Proposals-You notice that for some Payment IDs, there are documents with different net due dates- Cause-The grouping in the Payment Run happens based on Currency, Business Partner UUID, Company UUID and Net Due Date.-If the combination does not match, the system will create more than one payment proposal for the customer.-Credit memos with different due dates are grouped with the Payment Proposal group with higher value.-Based on the Business Partner and Due Date multiple groups are created and the Credit memo gets added to the groups which has the higher value.-Resolution-Expected System behavior---Keywords-Payment runs, group, grouping, proposal, proposals
