Once that is done, check back with the customer to confirm the issue has been resolved.-See Also-1658013 - User Cannot Create New Business Users Or Service Agents Using Initial User-Keywords-Initial User, Work Center, Missing, Create, Service Agent, Administrator, Application and User Management, BCT_ASSGN_WOC_INIT_USR, byd, c4c

Title: No Tax Return Type Available For Selection in Tax Return Arrangements of Tax Authority.
Content: Symptom-You have created a tax authority for country XYZ. You  have entered all the country specific information in the master data. When maintaining the tax return arrangements it is not possible to select the tax return types of country XYZ. In the Tax return Type column the selection value help displays "No items found".-(XYZ represents the Country)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Tax Management workcenter navigate to the Tax Authorities view.-Select the tax authority of country XYZ and press Edit - Company Tax Arrangements.-In this tab ensure that in the top table the relevant company and validity is entered.-In the Tax Return Arrangements subtab press Add Row.-In the first column enter the desired tax return arrangement ID.-In the Tax Return Type column there is no tax return type available. Instead, "No items found" is displayed.-Cause-If there is a localized version of the SAP Business ByDesign solution available for country XYZ its country specific tax return types are available, provided country XYZ has been added to your solution.-If there is no localized version of the SAP Business ByDesign solution available for country XYZ its country specific tax return types are not available.-Resolution-If there is a localized version for country XYZ available you need to add it to your solution profile:-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Press Edit Project Scope.-In Step 1 - Country and Type of Business you can see all the countries currently selected in your solution. You notice that country XYZ does not appear here.-Click on the Edit Countries link.-Select country XYZ in the Available Countries table and move it over to the Selected Countries table.-Press Next until Step 5- Review and then press Finish to confirm. Automatically all basic financial settings will be saved for country X.-Therefore, the tax return types of country XYZ will now be available as well.-If there is no localized version for country XYZ available you need to send an case to Support and request to make the country specific tax return types available in the Company Tax Arrangements of the country XYZ's tax authority.-Note:-For countries that are either not supported by the system or are not included in the scope of your business solution, the system selects all open tax items of the country of the tax authority during the tax return runs for generic tax returns. Tax return types for generic tax returns are only provided for certain countries. For more information please view the SAP Business ByDesign online help document Generic Tax Return As Tax Return Type. Should the country of your choice not be listed in this document, you can contact SAP through a case for delivery of the generic tax return for this country. Please also see the pdf document About_Using_the_Generic_Tax_Return.pdf in the attachment section of this case document.-  Keywords-Tax Return, No items found, Tax Return Arrangements, Tax Authority.

Title: How to Use The Backend Transaction DMC_INC_CORR
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This Knowledge Base Article intends to explain the functionalities in the DMC_INC_CORR backend transaction, as well as when and how to use them.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The Migration Object field is the one used to specify which object will be used to execute the available jobs. Click the value help in the field to select the relevant migration object with which you are working (the migration objects here are referred by their technical names—to check how the technical names map with the frontend names, please check the table in the attachments of this KBA).-In regards with jobs for correction of issue, these are divided into two categories:-Initial Steps for Migration Object-Types of Inconsistency Issues-NOTE: if you are unsure on how to execute any of the below steps, do not do it! Please ask the help of a senior ByD Technology colleague or forward the incident to the SRD-CC-MIG-DMC support queue.-I. Initial Steps for Migration Object-These initial steps are basic tests and corrections to attempt in order to observe the actual status of the migration object.-Check Object Consistency-Select this option and execute it (by pressing F8 or clicking the "Execute" icon at the top of the screen) to run a check for the object's consistency. If this step fails stating that the runtime object is invalid, move to the next step.-Generate Run Time Object-This option will attempt to generate a new, valid runtime object for the selected migration. In case this step completes successfully, it will probably correct the issue; check back in the frontend to see if the migration issue persists. Should this fail, it will raise an error message that can clue you into what inconsistency is actually affecting the migration, allowing you to apply the relevant solution.- -II. Types of Inconsistency Issues-After the initial steps have been completed and you have a clearer idea on the actual issue, you can proceed with one of the following corrective jobs:-Zero Reference Error--This corrective job should be executed if the runtime generation fails with an OBJECTS_OBJREF_NOT_ASSIGNED_NO technical exception (short text: "Access using a 'ZERO' object reference is not possible"). In the frontend, this issue might manifest as a 500 SAP Internal Server Error when trying to access the migration tool or when downloading a new migration template.-Issues with Extension Fields--This corrective job should be executed for any issues with extension fields, such as:-Migration completes successfully, but data from the extension field is not updated in the system-The extension fields' headers in the migration template are blank-In case the label is still missing after this report then the user might have not added the label in respective language-Extension field is missing in the Migration template / Mass Data Maintenance-In case of PDI issues, if this report does not solve then the issue might be with the PDI.-Message "Syntax error in function module" is raised when attempting runtime generation. -FORM 'ASSIGN' already exists--This corrective job needs to be executed if the attempt to generate a new runtime object fails with error message "A FORM already exists with the name 'ASSIGN'." This will open a migration tool window in the browser and ask to confirm and although it will seem that nothing happens, the job will actually have been executed.-Execute Cleanup Report--The cleanup report can be used to address issues such as extension fields with empty headers in the migration template or scenarios where, after migration or update through Mass Data Maintenance, data entered in the template for an extension field is not reflected in the frontend. It can also be used when the runtime generation fails with error message "Semantic descriptor does not exist."-Delete Runtime Objects--This is rarely used, as this action is already included as part of the cleanup report and there are other reports that already address issues that used to be solved this way (such as the "A FORM already exists with the name 'ASSIGN'" error message). Like the "FORM 'ASSIGN' already exists" job, it will open a migration tool window in the browser and seemingly do nothing, but it will still be executed.-If you've already attempted the corrective jobs above and the issue persisted or if the error message raised is not covered by any of the available options, please document everything that was attempted and forward the incident to the SRD-CC-MIG-DMC development queue.-Keywords-Migration, File validation failed, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, FORM 'ASSIGN' already exists, Semantic descriptor, cleanup report, Syntax error in function module, DMC_INC_CORR

Title: Error: Invoice Belongs to Different Clearing Transaction Item Rejected
Content: Symptom-You check the Account balance of a Supplier Accounts in the Payables workcenter Supplier Accounts view. The Account Balance of Supplier XYZ is 0,00 LC (XYZ represents the supplier ID, LC stands for Local Currency).-However, when entering the Supplier Account monitor and checking theTrade Payables- Invoices/Payments tab you notice two items which can be cleared against each other and balance to zero.-One of the open item is in status Partially Cleared and the other item is in status Open. Once selecting the Clear Manually option you receive the error message: 'Invoice DEF belongs to different clearing transaction; item rejected' (DEF represents the Invoice ID).-Another error: Payment 123 belongs to different clearing transaction; item rejected (123 represent the Payment ID)-Note:This is applicable in case of Customer Accounts as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables/Receivable work center.-Select the Supplier Accounts/Customer Accounts view.-Search for the supplier/Customer ID which has an open amounts to be cleared.-You can confirm the Account Balance is zero.-Press View and navigate to the Trade Payables -  Invoices / Payments sub-tab to display the Open Items.-Two open items exist with the amount balance zero:-a) ABC: -0,01 LC / Partially Cleared (ABC represents the ID of one open item).-b) DEF  0,01 LC / Open (DEF represents the ID of the other open item).-You notice a Clearing ID for both documents:-a) ABC: Multiple IDs (Multiple IDs  represents the ID of the clearing).-b) DEF: GHI (GHI represents the ID of the clearing).-Now you select both items and press Clear Manually.-An error message appears: 'Invoice DEF belongs to different clearing transaction; item rejected'.-Payment 123 belongs to different clearing transaction; item rejected-Cause-The item DEF with Open status has already a Clearing ID. The status should be Cleared.-Nevertheless, this item could not be cleared automatically for some reason so that the invoice still appears open.-Reasons why documents cannot be cleared automatically:-Missing payment reference-Payment difference-Payment made before invoice is received-Resolution-Void the clearing ID of item DEF and clear both items again manually:-In the Supplier Accounts view of the Payables work center open the account of the relevant supplier.-Navigate to the Trade Payables - Invoices/Payments sub-tab.-Select the item DEF and click Clearing ID reference XYZ.-Press the View All button.-Now choose the Void Clearing button.-Close the screen and return to the Supplier Account Monitor.-Select both items and press Clear Manually again.-(or)-In the Customer Accounts view of the Receivables work center open the account of the relevant Customer.-Navigate to the Trade Receivable - Invoices/Payments sub-tab.-Select the item DEF and click Clearing ID reference XYZ.-Press the View All button.-Now choose the Reset Clearing button.-In case of multiple Clearing IDs repeat steps 3 to 5 for all clearing IDs.-Now close the screen and return to the Customer Account Monitor.-Select both items and press Clear Manually again.-Keywords-Clear Manually not possible, Invoice belongs to different clearing transaction; item rejected, cannot clear Invoice Manually; Balance of 0.01 LC; clearing not possible

Title: Quantity Value Gets Rounded When Doing Cost Estimation For A Material
Content: Symptom-While performing the Material Cost Estimate Run, the valuation quantity for the input materials gets rounded to the nearest whole number value; though in the Production Bills of Material you have maintained the values for the input material in decimals.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Material Cost Estimate view.-In the Show field, select All Cost Estimates from dropdown and search for the respective Material ID for which you want to see the cost estimation.-Select the Edit button, in the opened window go to the Input Materials tab under Details section.-You can see that valuation quantity for the input Material ID has been rounded to the nearest whole number.-Cause-In the Material Cost Estimates Fine Tuning activity, as you have selected the checkbox for the cost type Estimated Cost, system was rounding the values to nearest whole number while performing material cost estimate run.-Note: In general, whenever you do the Material Cost Estimate for any material in the system it takes the quantity value which has been defined for the Input Materials in the Production Bills of Material.-The effect of quantity rounding in material cost estimates is that units which do not normally have decimal places (such as Each) are rounded up based on the rounding behavior of production orders.-Resolution-You can avoid the quantity rounding using the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the overview view.-Search for activity: "Material Cost Estimate" and open it.-Select the option "Rounding in Material Cost Estimates" and open it.-Select the "Estimated Cost" cost type and uncheck the checkbox for "Quantity Rounding" and click "Save" button.-See Also-Material Cost Estimates – Configuration Guide-Keywords-material cost estimate, rounding, up, round

Title: Unable to Find Supplier Name Field in Data Source Supplier Details
Content: Symptom-The text for "Supplier" in data source "Supplier Details" is derived from Supplier Formatted Name, which contains a concatenation of name and additional name. You have a requirement to have the field that only shows the supplier name but unable to find field "Supplier Name" in the data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Data Sources view.-Search for Data Source Supplier Details (ID: BPSPPB).-Select Documentation button.-Unable to find Supplier Name Characteristic.-Resolution-To get the name only, you could add the field by pressing ADAPT.-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Data Sources view.-Search for Data Source Supplier Details (ID: BPSPPB).-Select Adapt button.-Select Field "Name" (ES Name: Organisation/Name/FirstLineName) and select Add.-See Also- SAP Help Portal Adapt a Data Source (for HTML5)-Keywords-Supplier Details; BPSPPB; Supplier; Name; Data Source

Title: Unable to Remove a Value or Nullify a Data of Accounts Using Mass Change Account Data
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to uncheck a particular parameter for some Accounts or remove a value and reset it to empty using Mass Change Account Data, but the system is not allowing you to perform this particular action.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-In the Common Tasks section, select the Mass Change Account Data-Select list of Accounts and select Add to Worklist button.-Cause-Removing values (like unchecking flags and clearing text entries) is not supported in the mass change of Accounts and will remain a limitation due to technical constraints.--Problem is that the mass change row comes with empty content and by that recognizes a flag being set from false to true as a change - keeping a flag false or setting it from false to true and again to false is not recognized.-Resolution-Hence, this functionality is not available in current release and will be considered for one of the future release but cannot promise availability at a certain due date--In the meantime, the only workaround is to deselect the values in the checkboxes or remove the value line by line in the mass change screen.-Note:-Nullifying a value is not possible even through Migration (Enhance Existing Records) and Mass Data maintenance.-Keywords-nullify, mass change, account, worklist, byd

Title: Unable to Add Work Package in Project Management Time Sheet
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a Work Package in the Project Management Time Sheet, the button Add Work Package is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management Work Center.-Click Edit Time Sheet view.-Click Button Manage My Worklist.-The button Add Work Package is grayed out.-Cause-This scenario is occurring because the Employee is a Service Agent. Service Agents are external employees and therefore not able to add work packages themselves.-Resolution- Currently this is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Add Work Package, grayed out, Project Management, Time Sheet.

Title: G/L Account Description Is Not Displayed Correctly In The Financial Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When executing the Financial reports (For example: G/L Accounts - Line Items, Trial Balance, Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast), G/L Account description is not displayed or is incorrectly displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports view.-Search for the respective report and open it.-Enter the required data.-Click Go to execute the report.-You will notice that the G/L Account descriptions are not displayed or are displayed incorrectly.-Cause-Due to some technical issues, the FSI view for G/L Account is not updated. Hence you don't see the data as expected.-Resolution-First of all, make sure that data exists in the system for the selected Parameters. Then you can verify the G/L Account Description in the below steps:-G/L Account description is maintained in the Business Configuration activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination -> Edit chart of accounts.-G/L Account description is available in the General Ledger work center -> General Ledger Accounts view.-If description is correctly displayed in the above screens, resolution requires the FSI reload.-Open the Transaction GFSSTM-Enter FSI View: FSP_FIN_GLACCOUNT-You can send the Case to ES Technology & Architecture queue for FSI reload with the above information.-Keywords-g/l account description; FSI reload; FSP_FIN_GLACCOUNT

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run Does Not Use the Right Key Date Exchange Rate
Content: Symptom-The key date exchange rate from a foreign currency XYZ to your local currency ABC decided in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Receivables is not the latest exchange rate shown in the Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies table.-(XYZ represents the foreign currency)-(ABC represents the local currency)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the 'Receivables' work center, choose the 'Periodic Tasks' view.-Select the 'Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs' subview.-Click on 'New' and choose Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run from the list.-Enter the 'Company ID' and 'Period/Year'.-Click on 'Start Immediately'.-Choose 'Display Log'.-In the 'List of Logs' screen, click on 'View'.-Go to the 'Processed Successfully' tab.-Choose one line item with the transaction currency being XYZ.-Document the exchange rate shown in the 'Key Date Exchange Rate' column.-Then go to the 'General Ledger' work center.-Under 'Common Tasks', click the 'Edit Exchange Rates' link.-In the 'Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies' table, you can see the exchange rate from XYZ to ABC is different from that in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run.-Cause-During the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, the system determines the key date on the basis of the selection parameters 'Period' and 'Fiscal Year'. The last day of the period or fiscal year is the key date. In the system, there is one exchange rate from currency XYZ to ABC which is valid from the last day of the month, when the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run is executed prior to the last day of the month, this exchange rate has not become valid, thus is not shown as the latest exchange rate in the Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies table.-Resolution-The remeasurement can be repeated as often as required until the receivable has been cleared or written off. If you execute the 'Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run' on the last day of the month, you can see the key date exchange rate from XYZ to ABC in the run is the same with that in the 'Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies' table.-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, Key Date, Exchange Rate.

Title: Cannot Upload Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You try to upload journal entry voucher from Microsoft Excel, when you click Save Data to in the excel template, the system gives error messages:-'For gen. ledger purposes, at least one debit and credit line required;'-'Line items do not balance; correct the difference amount;'-'Action Post not possible; action is disabled.'-But you are sure the line items are balanced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Go to Journal Entry Vouchers subview.-Create new voucher from excel as New -> Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel.-Select the Save data button in the Excel add-in.-You get the error messages mentioned above.-Cause-The issue is with the format in the excel template, when you enter the line items, you do not follow the right way, so the data format cannot be recognized by the system.-Resolution-In order to successfully upload the journal entry voucher into the system, follow the steps below:-After you download the excel template, open it up, and you can see that, by default, there are two line items.-There is an arrow at the end of the last column, and that arrow needs to be pulled down to add more line item with the same format.-In this way, you should be able to add line items properly to the excel.-Keywords- jev; excel; journal entry voucher

Title: Error While Migrating Projects With Status Completed
Content: Symptom-You find below options in the text help for the Migration of Projects template in the Project Status field description:-Project Status*--An identifier that defines the stage a project has reached. Enter one of the following numbers to define the status: -'1' (for planned) '2' (for started) '3' (for released) '6' (for completed)--However, you receive below error when you use status code value as 4.-"Error detected in source record with key value 'PRXXX' Goto Correction;-Action FINISH not possible; action is disabled"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center-Select Overview view-Search Migration of Projects activity-Select Migrate Projects using Migration Tool-Execute Migration step by step-Cause-It is only possible to Migrate Projects which are not yet finished. It means Projects which are in status 1, 2 or 3 can be migrated using the Migration of Projects Activity.-Resolution-Currently in help text for the Project Status field shows more values than we really support in the migration template. This is a mismatch to the values we really use in projects from User Interface:- In Planning- Started- Release- Stopped- Closed- Completed-Use the options 1(Planned), 2(Started), 3(Released) in the Migration Template and re-execute. We shall rectify the help text in the template in one of the future releases.-See Also-KBA 3416500 -       Error: "Start date must not overlap with another planned period" during Project Migration-Keywords-Projects; Migration-migration of projects

Title: Some of Time Account Types do Not Appear in Review Account Balances
Content: Symptom-Some of Time Account Types are missing in the regular task Review Account Balances in the work center Time Administration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Time Administration.-Select the view Regular Tasks.-Select the link Review Account Balances under the section Time Account Processing.-Click on the dropdown list for the field Time Account Type.-Note that not all time account types defined in the system may be available for selection.-Cause-The regular task Review Time Accounts is meant to show the summary of the period end processing. Therefore, only those time accounts with a Period End Rule configured should appear.-Resolution-If you want a time account to appear in the mentioned dropdown list, it is necessary to configure a Period End Rule.-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Go to the view Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune.-Search for the activity Time Accounts.-Select the link Maintain Time Account Rules.-Select the button Maintain Account Rule under the section Details.-Select the tab Period End Rules.-Here you can maintain Period End Rules of the time account.-Keywords-Missing, Time Account, Balance,

Title: Data Source Customer Invoice Item with Tax Details Shows No Data
Content: Symptom-You notice that the data source Customer Invoice Item with Tax Details shows no data although there are customer invoices in your system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the view Design Data Sources in the work center Business Analytics.-Search for the data source Customer Invoice Item with Tax Details and click on Preview.-The preview shows no data.-Alternatively, you can open your customized report on this data source from the assigned work center. The report does not give any results either.-Cause-1.The data source Customer Invoice Item with Tax Details shows only those invoices that were created for Mexican accounts. Customer invoices for other accounts will not be considered.-2.For Not Released Invoice Documents that were created for Mexican accounts, if these invoice documents are NOT in legal approval status, they do not match with restriction rules in the data sources GLOCIU01, GLOCIB01 and hence cannot be viewed. You can make "Legal Approval Status" field visible via Personalization Mode.-Data Source Name: Customer Invoice Item with Tax Details-Data Source IDs: GLOCIU01, GLOCIB01-Description: Contains all customer invoice items which are not released and in approval status. It provides you with information on the products, quantities, gross amounts, net amounts, tax amounts.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Invoice Item, Tax Details, Data Source, Tax Details shows no Data, GLOCIU01, GLOCIB01

Title: Default Value Missing Extension Field After Load
Content: Symptom-In a table or screen you have an Extension Field with a default value. When you add a row or use the quick create screen, the default value is filled as expected.-When adding a value in another field, the table or screen will load and the default value for the preview field will disappear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the screen with the table.-Click to Add Row.-Fill a different field and hit enter to load the value.-Exemple:-For Supplier General > Supplier Invoice General is maintained for the field ABC.-The field "A" is added in target Supplier Invoice -> General.-In Source Supplier General, the field is no added (the same behavior if the field is added but has no value assigned).-Every time time information like Supplier info, Material Items, etc. are changed, the Extension Scenario is trigged and tries to copy the value of the field ABC from source.-Cause-There is an Extension Scenario for the field with the default value and in there is no value in this Extension Scenario.-Resolution-Remove the Extension Scenario if not used or keep the value in the source.

Title: You are unable to change the Guaranteed Holiday into Non-Guaranteed Holiday in your Holiday Calendar
Content: Symptom-You have changed a Guaranteed Holiday to a Non-Guaranteed Holiday through the Business Configuration Activity "Maintain Holiday Calendar." However, the system is not saving the modifications.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Configuration Work center.-Enter the Overview View.-In the Activity list, search for 'Working Day Calendar' and open it.-Click on the 'Maintain an existing holiday calendar' link.-Select your Holiday Calendar and go to the 'Select Holidays' section.-Choose the Guaranteed Holiday that needs modification and click on Edit.-Change the Holiday status from Guaranteed to Non-Guaranteed and carefully review and confirm the changes.-Return to the 'Maintain an existing holiday calendar' link and verify if the adjustments are reflected.-Note that despite making the change, the Holiday status remains as Guaranteed.-Cause-You cannot convert a Guaranteed Holiday to a Non-Guaranteed Holiday directly. If the holiday has already been applied in Employee Times, you have to delimit the holiday for the previous year and then create a new holiday with the desired status for the current year.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration Work center.-Enter the Overview View.-In the Activity list, search for 'Working Day Calendar' and open it.-Click on the 'Maintain an existing holiday calendar' link.-Select your Holiday Calendar and go to the 'Select Holidays' section.-In the list of Selected Holidays, you will find the option to edit the Valid From Year and Valid To Year columns.-If you want to modify a holiday, starting from, for example, 2020, adjust the Validity of the existing holiday by changing the Valid To Year column to 2019.-Then, create a new Non-Guaranteed Holiday with the same name and set the Valid From Year to 2020.-By following this process, the holiday will be Non-Guaranteed from the year 2020 forward. Ensure a correction run is performed if the calendar changes are not immediately reflected. You can confirm the results by reviewing the work schedules in the Employee's Time files.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Holiday Calendar, Employee Time, Working Day Calendar

Title: Error Message 'Times with Time Types <XYZ> and <ABC> collide for period <dd.mm.yyyy> to <dd.mm.yyyy>' When Saving Employee Time
Content: Symptom-When trying to add two time recordings with different time types on the same day or during the same period in the employee's time file, the system generates the following error message:-Times with Time Types <XYZ> and <ABC> collide for period <dd.mm.yyyy> to <dd.mm.yyyy>.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Time Administration work center.-Access the Employees view.-Choose the relevant employee and click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Employee Time tab.-Try to record two different Time Types for the same timeframe, such as illness and vacation for the same day.-Click the Save button to confirm the entries.-Error message 'Times with Time Types <XYZ> and <ABC> collide for period <dd.mm.yyyy> to <dd.mm.yyyy>' appears.-Cause-Generally, the system does not allow you to save time recordings with different time types for the same time period; for example, recording illness and vacation for the same day. However, the company policy might consider the possibility of illness during a vacation period.-The collision rule for time types is introduced in the work center 'Business Configuration' to permit or disallow this kind of system behavior.-Resolution-In order to configure the behavior of the system with regard to the collision of 'Time Types' in the 'Time Sheet', follow the below steps:-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Activity List view.-Click on the arrow Fine-Tune.-Search for the activity Time Types and open it.-Open the link 'Maintain Collision Rules'.-Click the button Maintain Collision Rules.-Here, you can maintain/configure the collision rule.-Click the Save and Close button to save your changes.-Keywords-Collision, Rules, Time Type

Title: How to Change the Closing Cockpit Display From a List View to a Clustered View
Content: Symptom-The system displays a classic list view of the closing cockpit display view and you expect the clustered view for all the required closing activities for a specific period/quarter.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Workcenter.-Navigate to Closing Cockpit View and Closing Cockpit subview.-Here the view has the classic display view with all of them in list view.-You expect the Display to be changed to a clustered view for all the required closing activities for a specific period/quarter.-Cause-The Scoping Question Do you want to use the new enhanced and faster object work list based on Service Adaptation Definition Language (SADL)? is to be scoped and after this the expected Clustered View of the Closing Cockpit will be displayed.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center and open active scope-Navigate to the Questions Section and then Built in Services and Support, then System Management-Click the User Interface List Mode.-Check the Question Do you want to use the new enhanced and faster object work list based on Service Adaptation Definition Language (SADL)?-After this question is scoped, the system displays the Clustered View of the Closing Cockpit.-Keywords-Business Configuration, List Mode

Title: Error Message: Value 92 in setting Deferred Tax Configuration must also be entered in setting Industry Sector
Content: Symptom-When trying to delete the Industry type 92 (Public Administration) in the Maintain Industries activity in Business Configuration work center, system throws below error message:-"Value 92 in setting Deferred Tax Configuration must also be entered in setting Industry Sector".-"Save Failed"-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Fine-Tune chevron.-Open General Business Partners activity.-Select Edit financial reporting structures link.-Select Maintain Industries link.-Select Industry 92 (Public administration) and select Delete button.-Click Save button.-Cause-Industry type 92 (Public Administration) is delivered with all ByD Systems and it is mainly used for the system scoped for country Italy. It is not possible to delete this Industry type, even if this type is not used for Business Partners and your system is not scoped for Italy.-Other countries might use this Industry type or reference to it. A deletion could cause Business Configuration inconsistencies.-Resolution-The system works as designed. You may rename it with "do not use" or similar.-Keywords-Branche, löschen,

Title: "Send to Provider" can not be selected by the Key User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--Key user can not select "Send to provider" in an incident.-Customer cannot reopen the incident, since send to provider action is missing.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Only the key user is capable of sending incidents to SAP Support. A key user has the Work Center Application and User Management assigned as well as the view Incidents.-Go to Application and User Management Work center-Go to Incidents View.-Open an incident in Edit Mode.-Click the Action – dropdown.-The Send to Provider option is missing.-  Cause-"Managed by GBB" flag for the tenant is not set in the Business Landscape Directory (BLD).-You are able to identify the flag in the SPC system fact sheet.-Resolution-Send the incident to Operations team and request to them apply the same fix they have done via this incident INC6687148.-You can find the link to the incident in the reference tab.-Keywords-k-user, key user, send to provider, incident

Title: Reimbursable Expense Amount Calculated in Wrong Currency in Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You create an expense report with a receipt amount in currency ABC. After saving or when navigating to step 4-Review, you notice the currency of the Reimbursable Expenses changes to currency DEF (ABC and DEF represent two different currencies of two different countries, ABC and DEF).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the Expense Reports view.-Select and edit the respective expense report.-In the Expenses view, all expenses are maintained in currency ABC.-Press Save or navigate to step 4-Review. -You notice, the Reimbursable Expenses amount appears in currency DEF.-Cause-The employee, for which the expense report is created, was hired for country/ region ABC with default currency ABC. Therefore, the reimbursable expense amount automatically changes to the currency of the employee's default country/region's currency. The country/origin of the assigned cost center does not determine the default currency.-To check the employee's country/region:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center and navigate to the Employees view. -Via the Personalize function add the Country/Region column to the Employees table. -Find the respective employee. -You notice the Country/Region is DEF. -Resolution-If the employee is to be reimbursed in the currency DEF,  then the employment must be terminated in country/region ABC and a re-hire needs to be performed for country/region DEF.  -See Also-KBA 2690313 - Display Currency in the report is not as Expected-KBA 2741128 - Currency Derivation for Expense Report Payments-KBA 3407173 - Payment Currency in the Expense Report is not as Expected-KBA 2644245 - Wrong Default Country/Region in Expense Report-Keywords-expense report, wrong currency, employee

Title: How to Analyze Backend Dumps
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--This document provides details to look for in SAP Incight and system backend when we encounter backend exception.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Check in SAP incight for relevant dump details.-Reproduce the dump in system and check if dump details in incight and in transaction ST22 match.-Then in incight, check in Dump Analysis for below details.-Responsible component.-Error Txt.-With this information, you need to check from where exception is triggered.-In ABAP Runtime Errors section, check for Application Info.-Scenario 1:-If the information is generic as; Info: An exception was raised.-Navigate to ABAP Call stack and check for the class at which exception is triggered.-If the call stack indicates dump in Oberon as shown below, forward incident to Client-UI Rendering queue.-Scenario 2:-In Application Info, if the information is referring to issue in Binding of UI as:-Example 1: Info: Binding of UI data field /Root/DataList/empname failed: ESR field=empname/content (ESR namespace=) unknown on proxy node=ROOTXYZ in proxy BO= Y5xxxxxx…..-Example 2: Info: Binding of UI data field /Root/00163E07096C1ED4BDA7F0B15E8CFBBCB failed: ESR field=CountryVNI_07J98VHU2NCO6ITLCIOGZDK3I (ESR namespace=http://xxxxxx-one-off.sap.com/Yxxxxxx_) unknown on proxy node=ROOT in proxy BO= XXXXXX.-Navigate to ABAP Call stack and check for the class at which exception is triggered.-Only, if the call stack indicates dump in Oberon, forward incident to Client-UI Rendering queue.-If the call stack is different referring to either PDI or any application, forward to respective queue.-Scenario 3:-Some times in Responsible Component incight says AP-RC-UIF-RT and Active calls may refer to Oberon.-But check ABAP Runtime Error, check for relevant class / information.-If the class refers to either PDI / one-of or any application, forward to respective queue.-Example: 1-       Example: 2-Keywords-ST22, backend, Dump, How to check Dump

Title: Error Message: Bal. Carryforward not Executed for Company ABC, Set of Books XYZ, and Year
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error message as below when you execute balance carryfoward.-Bal. carryforward not executed for company ABC, set of books XYZ, and year.-(Here ABC refers to Company id and XYZ refers to Set of books id)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks View and Balance Carry Forward Sub-view.-Click on new Carry Forward.-Enter Company: ABC; Year To Be Carried Forward:YYYY and Balance Carryforward Step: 2 - Calculate and carry forward profit/loss.-Click on Start Now.-An error message is displayed: Bal. carryforward not executed for company ABC, set of books XYZ, and year.-Cause-The error is because you have not executed the Balance Carryforward Step 1 in Update Mode for the set of books XYZ. You need to execute Step 1: Carry the G/L account balances forward in update mode and then execute step 2 to view the results.-Balance Carry Forward consists of two steps:--1. Step 1: Carry Forward G/L Account Balances-2. Step 2: Calculate and Carry Forward Profit/Loss-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks View and Balance Carry Forward Sub-view.-Click on new Carry Forward.-Enter Company: ABC;Year To Be Carried Forward:YYYY and Balance Carryforward Step: 1 - Carry forward G/L account balances.-Click on Start Now.-Once you execute balance carryforward for Step 1: Carry Forward G/L Account Balance, then you will be able execute for Step: 2 - Calculate and carry forward profit/loss without this error message.-Keywords-Balance carryforward, Bal. Carryforward not Executed for Company

Title: WIP Clearing Generates Journal Entry to G/L Account Price Difference from Production Instead of Inventory
Content: Symptom-After you run WIP clearing, you notice that there is journal entry posted to G/L account of price difference from production instead of G/L account of inventory.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-After WIP clearing, you open the log and go to tab Processed Successfully and select the production lot, you found there is posting to G/L account of price difference from production instead of G/L account of inventory.-Cause-System works as designed.--WIP clearing does not lead to a revaluation of stock if no stock is available anymore for the material at the point of time of WIP clearing. The total produced quantity is issued to a sales order before execution of WIP clearing. Hence the delta on the WIP account is posted to price differences instead of posting it to inventory account.-Resolution-To adjust the postings, you need to follow the steps below:-Restart any production task for the production lot in work center Production Control.-Execute WIP clearing for production lot, so system reverses the existing WIP clearing (technically it is neither a reversal nor cancelation of the postings, but the postings will be done with the status reversed; i.e the positive amount in original WIP clearing will be posted as negative amount in this new WIP clearing).-Cancel the goods issue to sales order.-Finish the restarted production task again. Please note that the finish date must fall into the same period of WIP clearing.-Execute WIP clearing again for production lot. This WIP clearing will post to inventory account.-Post goods issue to sales order.-Keywords-WIP clearing run, Production lot, Production price variance

Title: Error Message "Enter the currency for the specified Amount" During Migration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--When you try to migrate data (any Migration Object) through Migration, system throws below error message:-Enter the currency for the specified Amount-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration.-Search for Migration of ABC (ABC replaces the activity name).-Open and click Migrate XYZ (XYZ replaces the migration object name) using the migration tool.-Click Execute Migration, then Execute Migration Step by Step.-Process to Step 3 Simulate Import.-Cause-1. This issue is more common when the user creates an extension field for Amount. This field requires a supporting field called Currency. It is technically mandatory that user needs to enter Currency when an Amount is entered.-2. The issue may also be due to the extension field Currency code did not created properly in the template so that the system cannot recognize the field.-Resolution-1. Ensure that you fill both Amount and Currency to resolve the issue.-How to identify the supporting field?---Here, Amount is Main field and Currency is supporting field.-If the issue persists even after maintaining the Currency then the issue should be fixed with clean up report.-Technical Analysis:-If the user fills the Currency and the issue still exists then download the payload from MWB_SRVC_CENTER for respective MO and check whether there is attribute for the main field. if not then clean up report will fix the issue.--If there is attribute for the main field and the Currency is filled, go to the migration tool page. Then click the "You can also" button on the right top and choose "Adapt Migrate Object" to manually update the migration template.--Note: Request the premission from the customer before doing "Adapt Migrate Object" or ask the customer to do it by himself. The process may need one hour or more to be completed.-See Also-How to use MWB_SRVC_CENTER can be referred to 1877585 - How to Debug "Service Call Failed" Error Message in the Backend-Keywords-Migration, Currency, "Enter the currency for the specified Amount", BYD

Title: Is it Possible to use a Webservice Using a Browser
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to consume a webservice for WSDL QueryContactIn using a browser instead of using it in the SOAP UI.-Business Requirement: To find the URL so that you can use it in the bowser itself , like consuming REST API.-Resolution-Webservice QueryContactIn is a SOAP webservice as it contains a Response, meaning it is a synchronous webservice. Synchronous webservices contain a Response message type. All query webservices are synchronous webservices.--The Response generated by the SOAP web service cannot be handled by the browser and hence it is not possible to use it in a browser environment.--You can use SAP delivered asynchronous webservices as these are REST full and do not contain a Response message type. As they do not contain a response the browser does not need to handle any response and so they can be used in a browser environment.-Keywords-Webservice, QueryContactIn

Title: Error: "No report data available to display; check the selection "
Content: Symptom-You receive an error when trying to check Reports such as Employee Times: Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly and Yearly.-Error: No report data available to display; check the selection.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Time Administration workcenter.-2. Go to Reports view.-3. Select Employee Times: Weekly.-4. Select Not Currently Shown.-5. Change Employee to Columns.-6. Change Time Type to Rows.-Cause-The reports are not returning data since there’s no relevant employee time recordings present in the system.-Resolution-Maintain suitable Employee Data in the system and then execute these Reports.-Keywords-Report, Data, Missing

Title: While Assigning a Work Schedule to an Employee, System Throws an Exception
Content: Symptom-You as a Time Administrator, while assigning a work schedule to an employee, system throws an exception.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select an employee and select Edit button.-Go to Time profile tab.-Select Work Schedule sub tab.-Select a Work Schedule.-System throws Exception.-Cause-The problem is caused by the fact that the period model used in the time profile does not have a correct sequence of days for a week.-When using a period time model, it must contain a sequential series of days. There cannot be a gap between two days in the model (For example: 1, 3, 4, 5)-Resolution-You can check the period model by following the steps below:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter Time Model View.-Select the Period Model to be assigned to the employee.-Click Edit.-Here you can see that the Day column is not in sequence.-It is suggested to set up a week containing 7 days similar to the example below:-Day 1 - Daily Model = XYZ-Day 2 - Daily Model = XYZ-Day 3 - Daily Model = XYZ-Day 4 - Daily Model = XYZ-Day 5 - Daily Model = XYZ-Day 6 - Daily Model = no model>-Day 7 - Daily Model = no model>-Where XYZ represents the daily Time Model.-Keywords-Time model, Time Profile, Dump, Work Schedule

Title: Acquisition Costs Posted After Deactivation Date in the Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-A Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material is posted for the complete amount of Fixed Asset XYZ using the option Relating To = 2 - Previous Years for Set of Books ABC. (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID, ABC represents the Set of Books ID)-Despite the presence of the deactivation date, acquisition postings with a posting date on or after the deactivation date are still accepted by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center and Fixed Assets view.-Filter for All Fixed Assets, find XYZ and select it.-Press Edit, then select Master Data from the dropdown.-Navigate to the Life Cycle Data sub-tab.-Note that Deactivation Date is already set as DD-MM-YYYY for Set of Books ABC.-Navigate to Values tab and select Set of Book ABC line under Valuation Values per Set of Books.-Navigate to Journal sub-tab.-At least one acquisition was posted to the Fixed Asset on or after the deactivation date.-Cause-The complete transfer was performed using Partial Transfer of Fixed Asset for the full amount with Relating To = 2 - Previous Years for Set of Books ABC.-As a result, the posting was created only for Set of Books ABC. Consequently, the Deactivation Date and Last Retirement Date were set only for Set of Books ABC and not for the other set of books.--As the Individual Material itself did not obtain the status Retired, subsequent acquisitions and other follow-up postings continued to be accepted for the fixed asset.-Resolution-When using Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material then it is expected that the amount is not for the complete book value.-When using Manual Posting - Complete Transfer of Individual Material then it is expected that the amount is for complete book value.-When the first option is selected with complete amount, it has to be done for both set of books. If the posting is created for only one set of books, the Individual Material does not obtain the status Retired, resulting in subsequent acquisition postings being allowed for the Fixed Asset.-When the second option is selected, all relevant sets of books are considered by the system by default. As a result, the status of the Individual Material is updated to Retired, after which no further acquisition postings are allowed for the Fixed Asset.-Keywords-Fixed asset, Retired, Transfer Postings, Partial transfer, Manual posting, Acquisition, Deactivation date, Individual material, Retired

Title: Data Source 'GLOTAXTIB02' With no Information.
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report, and the primary data source being used for this report is GLOTAXTIB02. When you open this new custom report you get the following message: 'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view. -Search for the create custom report. -Open it. -You will see the message: -'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Cause-Currently, the primary data source being used for this report is GLOTAXTIB02.-This is a dedicated data source for reporting on VAT Invoices in Ukraine which will only contain data if this functionality is used in Ukraine, and will not contain anything for any other country. This data source is employed for specific tax reporting in Ukraine, not related to standard tax reporting.-Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-GLOTAXTIB02, Data Source, Report, Custom.

Title: VAT Return Rejected - SII - Spain - Error Code 1117
Content: Symptom-In Spain SII - Outgoing Invoices tax return, the Customer Invoice ABC was rejected due to Error-Error Code: 1117 -Error en el bloque de la Contraparte. El NIF no esta identificado. NIF:12345. NOMBRE_RAZON: XYZ-ABC means the Customer Invoice ID-12345 means the NIF Number-XYZ means the Customer name-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center > VAT Returns view-Find and Open the respective VAT Return-Click View All-Go to Tax Return tab-The document ID: ABC is rejected with the following error: -Error Code: 1117 -Error en el bloque de la Contraparte. El NIF no esta identificado. NIF:12345. Title: G/L Account is not Available in Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You are trying to select a specific G/L Account in the approval process but it is not available in the drop-down. -This KBA applies for approval process regarding Supplier Invoices. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view.-Select approval process ABC (ABC is the approval process's name).-Click in Copy button.-Select step JKL (JKL is the step number). -In Conditions section, click in Add Group button.-For "Field" select: "G/L Account[]".-For "Compare Operator" select "Contains".-For "With" select "Value".-For the last field, open the drop down.-The option "PQR" is not available (PQL is the ID of the G/L Account that you are trying to insert in the condition). -Cause-The G/L Account PQR is not available in Cost Sub Ledger.--Resolution-The steps to enable the Account Determination Group for G/L Account PQR will be shared in the steps below: -Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Overview view.-Search for activity "Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination". -Open it. -In section Account Determination, open the link for "Costs".-Navigate to General Expenses tab. -Click in Add Row button. -Maintain here the data for "Account Determination Group for General Expenses" and "General Expenses" columns. -Click in Save and Close button. -See Also-KBA: 2421061 - Error: XXX is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value-Keywords-Approval process, G/L Account, GL Account, Condition, Supplier Invoice

Title: The Item Description of a Schedule Invoice Requests is not the Same as the one Maintained in the Contract
Content: Symptom-After changing the Item Description in a Contact document, you notice that the changes performed in the Item description were not carried out to the Schedule Invoice Requests.-For example, the Item Description in the Contract document was updated from "XXX" to "ZZZ", however in the Schedule Invoice Requests the Item Description is displayed as "XXX".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-Select the Advanced Search Icon.-In the Document ID field, Enter the ID ABC (ABC represents the Contract ID).-In the Document Type, select Contract.-Mark the Customer Invoice Requests and Schedule Invoice Requests.  -The Description maintained in the Customer Invoice Requests and Schedule Invoice Requests are different from the ones maintained in the Contract Document.-Cause-The description of the Items in the Schedule Invoice Request are based on the Item Description of the Customer Contract Invoice Request.-As the changes performed in the Contract document were not carried out to the Customer Contract Invoice Request, the Schedule Invoice Request were generated with the previous Item Description. -Resolution-In this case a dummy change in the Contract ABC will be required in order to update the Item Description of the Customer Contract Invoice Request and Schedule Invoice Requests.-For this process, it will be required to perform the following steps:-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Contracts View.-Filter for All Contracts.-In the search field, search for the Contract ID ABC.-Open and select View All.-Navigate to General tab.-Perform a change in the Internal Note.-Select Save button.-Remove the change performed in the Internal Note.-Select Save button.-After this changes are performed, the Item Description displayed in the Customer Contract Invoice Request ABC should be updated with current one maintained in the Contract document.-Therefore the Item Description in the Schedule Invoice Requests with status as "To be invoiced" should be updated as well. -Note: If the Schedule Invoice Requests are with status as "Processed" the Item Description will not be updated. The update in the Item Description will only be applied for Schedule Invoice Request with status as 'To be Invoiced".-Keywords-item description, description, contract, schedule invoice request, invoice request, change, update

Title: How to connect Extension Fields from Shopping Cart header to Purchase Order header
Content: Symptom-You have created an Extension Field in the Shopping Cart General Information section and want to extend this field to Purchase Order header.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open a Shopping Cart.-Create an Extension Field in Shopping Cart General Information.-Click on Show Further Usage button.-Navigate to Extension Scenarios tab.-See that no extension scenarios were found.-Resolution-This is how the system is designed, it is not possible to extend an Extension Field from Shopping Cart Header to another document.-As a workaround you can use the Shopping Cart item level Extension Field, this can be extended to Purchase Request item and then to Purchase Order item.-Please follow the below steps to extend:-On the screen on which you created the extension field, enter adaptation mode by selecting Enter Adaptation Mode form the Adapt menu.-Select Edit Screen from the Adapt menu.-The adaptation panel opens on the right side of the screen.-Under Extension Fields, select the extension field you created previously and scroll down until you can see the extension field details.-Click the Further Usage link.-On the Extension Scenarios tab of the Further Usage screen, you can see a list of all extension scenarios to which you can add this extension field.-Click on the arrow icon next to the extension scenario name to view a list of data flows. Each data flow consists of a source and target business context. This reflects the direction in which data is passed from one business context to the next. An extension scenario can contain one or more data flows.-Select the extension scenarios that you want to extend and click Add Field.-The extension field is made available in all business contexts involved in the selected extension scenarios. This means that you can now add the extension field to all screens, form templates, data sources and reports that are based on these business contexts.-To make the extension field visible on the screens that are part of each extension scenario, you must navigate to the screen, and select Enter Adaptation Mode from the Adapt menu.-Select Edit Screen from the Adapt menu.-Under Extension Fields, select the screen section on which you want the extension field to be visible and then select the Visible checkbox beside the extension field name.-Save and publish your changes.-You will need to do this steps in the Shopping Cart, then you will need to repeat the steps in the Purchase Requests and then repeat from 7 to 9 in Purchase Orders screen.-See Also-Add an Extension Field to an Extension Scenario -Extension Scenarios-Keywords-Extension Field, Shopping Cart, Purchase Request, Purchase Orders, Extension Scenario

Title: How to Extract Documents in PDF Format in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The option to archive and extract PDF documents, such as Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, and Supplier Invoices, is not available in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The document archiving feature is currently not supported in SAP Business ByDesign systems, as the PDF documents are generated in runtime in the system. Therefore, the documents cannot be extracted in PDF format.-Resolution-As a workaround, download the PDF document manually from the system and upload it as an attachment to the relevant document.--Once the PDF document has been uploaded as an attachment, an attachment extraction request can be submitted to extract the PDF document from the system.-See Also-KBA 2473303- How to Enable and Use the Data Extraction Tool in SAP Business ByDesign -Keywords-Archieve, Extract, PDF, Documents, Manual, Document, Attachment, Extraction, Submit, Not Supported , System

Title: While Enabling "Credit Card Payment" Scoping Question Missing In The Project Scope.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer needs to enable "Credit Card Payment" in the business configuration scope however they realize that the scoping question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" is missing in the Project Scope.-This KBA explains how to activate the scoping question via backend.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project line.-Choose Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the 4th option (Questions tab).-Expand Cash Flow Management.-Expand Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select the Payment Methods option.-Navigate to the last question under the Incoming Payments, scoping question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" is missing.-Cause-As of the SAP Business ByDesign release 2302 the scoping question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" has been removed from the system-Resolution-Run transaction code BCTADM and note down the workspace ID.-Run transaction code BCE. -Select the Parameter as Adaptation Workspace from the dropdown.-In the Adaptation Workspace field enter the value * and press enter -In the Adaptation Workspaces list, search for the Workspace ID from the step 1 and double click on the workspace under the object name column.-Click Scoping (with Question) tab-Click Search button and search for "BO_A1S_FIN_CRCMA"-Go to the scoping question for Credit Cards - Customer Payments and select [change] button and select the checkbox after [Credit Card – Customer Payment]-You notice the system automatically activate the BO's BO_A1S_FIN_CH and BO_A1S_FIN_BTMCC-Click Save-Click Activate button.-Now run transaction SE38 and execute report RP_BCT_WS_UPGRADE-Enter the Workspace Id and check box Complete Deployment, Bypass Change Pointers, Remove Dangling PDI Pointers. -Click Execute (F8)-The output report is generated. -Note: -If you face any error in report output, please contact to development team.-Login to frontend with new CAM password and work centers related to Clearing house account should be visible.-See Also-Customer Payments by Credit Card-3330989 - Scoping Question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" is Missing in the Project Scope--3391322 - Integration issue between the SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Customer Checkout - Credit Card Payments-Keywords-Credit Card Payment, Do you accept customer payment using credit cards, Cash Flow Management, Payment and Liquidity Management.

Title: Return to Supplier does not Generate Output
Content: Symptom-When you create a Return to Supplier you can see that no Output Document is created, so this is not sent to your supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Returns to Suppliers view.-Click on New Return to Supplier.-Select Inbound Delivery Items.-Click on Next.-Enter the Reason and the Follow-up Decision.-Enter the Quantity for Replacement or Credit Memo.-Click on Next.-Click on Finish.-See that no Output was created.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Since this is an internal document, only the follow-up document (Credit Memo or Outbound Delivery) will generate the output. -If the follow-up decision in the Return to Supplier is a Credit Memo you will find the document in Supplier Invoicing - Invoice Entry filtering for All Returns to be Invoiced, then you can search for the document ID and create a Credit Memo, this document will generate an Output that will be sent to Supplier.-However, if you decide for the Replacement this document will be sent to Outbound Logistics - Delivery Proposals, here you can filter for Return to Supplier Proposals and search for the document ID and create the Outbound Delivery, this will also create an Output that will be sent to Supplier.-Once the follow-up process is finished (the follow-up decision is made and the delivery processing is finished), the status of the return to supplier is set to Finished.-Keywords-Returns to Supplier, Return to Supplier, Output, Credit Memo, Outbound Delivery

Title: Dataflow Verification Results with Differences
Content: Symptom-Upon reviewing the Data Flow Verification Results, you can see an open discrepancy was found between the Purchase Order and its Logistics Details. The error messages indicated a mismatch in the PVPO item BTD (Business Transaction Document) references for the Purchase Order, with subsequent details pointing to a Purchase Order Item BTD Reference issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the view Data Flow Verification Results.-Open the Advanced Filter.-Filter for:-Status - Open.-Business Document One - Purchase Order.-Business Document Two - Purchase Order Logistics Details.-See that a result is open with a difference.-Click to open this.-The error message displayed is "No PVPO item BTD ref matches purchase order item BTD ref Purchase Order".-Click on the arrow to see the next error message.-The error is "Purchase Order Item BTD Reference of Type Purchase Order".-Cause-The item of the Purchase Order is a Third-Party and the planning is not relevant for items with process type Third-Party.-Resolution-In this case you can close the Data Flow Verification Result manually doing the following steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the view Data Flow Verification Results.-Search for the relevant result.-Click on Change Status to Closed.-Keywords-Data Flow Verification Results, Purchase Order, Purchase Order Logistics Details, No PVPO item BTD ref matches purchase order item BTD ref Purchase Order, Purchase Order Item BTD Reference of Type Purchase Order

Title: Pay Manually By Button Is Disabled For Supplier Invoice ABC
Content: Symptom-When you navigate through Supplier Account DEF, Pay Manually By button is disabled for Supplier Invoice ABC. (ABC and DEF stands for Supplier Invoice and Supplier Account IDs)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work Center.-Open Supplier Accounts view.-Search for Supplier Account DEF and open it.-Go to Trade Payables tab, Invoices / Payments subtab.-Select Invoice ABC.-You notice that button Pay Manually By is greyed out.-Cause-The button is greyed out because Invoice ABC already have a Payment created. You can check this through the following steps:-In the Supplier Account DEF, Invoices / Payments subtab, select the line for Invoice ABC.-In Clearing ID column, click on Clearing GHI. (GHI stands for the Clearing ID).-Click on View All.-Go to Document Flow.-You will notice that there is already a Payment created.-The system does not allow two Payments to exist for the same Item.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Pay Manually By, Supplier Account, Greyed

Title: How to Check Which User is Able to Perform Password Reset
Content: Symptom-A password reset is required; however, it is not known which users in the system have the authorization to perform password reset activities.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-To identify the business users in the system who have the required authorization to reset passwords for other users.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business User View.-Select the Advanced Filter.-In the field, Work Center View ID insert IAM_BUSINESSUSERS.-Select Go.-All the users displayed have the permission to reset the password of others business users in the system.-Keywords-user password, administrator, password reset.

Title: 'Items with the same original document must be cleared separately. Two or more items in clearing resulting from transfer posting or splitting belong to the same source document. Remove these items.'
Content: Symptom-Error message is thrown while creating a New Manual Clearing for a Supplier Account:-'Items with the same original document must be cleared separately. Two or more items in clearing resulting from transfer posting or splitting belong to the same source document. Remove these items.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Find respective Account ID and click view.-Select together one Invoice and two Payments: for the Payments, make sure they have the same External Reference ID and Document ID.-Click New Manual Clearing.-Error is thrown:-'Items with the same original document must be cleared separately. Two or more items in clearing resulting from transfer posting or splitting belong to the same source document. Remove these items.'-Cause-The error message raised by the system when you clear split open items is a current system behavior. This occurs due to a technical limitation in the tax register that uses the due clearing ID as reference.-Therefore, the items originate from the same document (splitting) have to be cleared separately.-Resolution-Clear the items that originate from the same document (same External Reference ID and same Document ID) separately.-Keywords-new manual clearing; transfer posting; split

Title: Service Request Documents are Not Created From Email via Outlook Addin
Content: Symptom-You want to create Service Request documents using the e-mail service.request@my<number>.mail.sapbydesign.com, however, no Service Request is being created in the system. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use Microsoft Outlook.-Open Microsoft Outlook.-Click New Email.-Enter service.request@myABC.mail.sapbydesign.com (myABC represents the tenant number).-Click Send.-Log into the system.-Navigate to the Service Desk work center.-Select Service Request.-You see that no Service Request was created from the e-mail sent. -Cause-The reason the system is not receiving the e-mails being sent is because you are sending e-mails to service.request@myABC.mail.sapbydesign.com, whereas the target tenant URL contains .cloud.--Example:-service.request@myABC.mail.businessbydesign.cloud.sap-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please make sure that sent to e-mail is the accordance to the target tenant URL. -See Also-2025807 - E-mail Text in Edit Output Settings for Service Request is Read Only-2880782 - Duplicate Service Requests Created via Outlook Addin-2036320 - E-Mail, Phone and Fax of the Processor in the Output Document of a Service Request is Not the Expected One-3345865 - How to Create Service Request via Microsoft Outlook -Configuration: Creating Service Requests From Incoming E-Mails-Create Service Requests from E-Mails-Keywords-Service Request, E-mail, .cloud, Not, Created, Microsoft Outlook

Title: Cannot Post Cancellation Purchase Order in General Ledger, Query Unposted Source Documents. Error: "G/L Account information missing"
Content: Symptom-You cannot process business transactions for a canceled purchase order in Closing Cockpit. You get the error: G/L Account information missing.-Additionally the following error message appears for the subsequent versions of the purchase order in Accounting: Processing Purchase Order XYZ, version X impossible due to errors in version Y. First resolve the tasks of the business transaction for accounting for Purchase Order XYZ, version Y, then post the business transactions for accounting again.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center General Ledger.-Go to the view Closing Cockpit.-Go to the sub-view Source Documents.-Choose Show: Unposted Source Documents.-Mark the relevant Purchase Order.-Choose Actions and then Post Business Transaction.-You get the error: G/L Account information missing.-Cause-You have changed the account assignment for the purchase order just before cancelling it. The new account assignment is not consistent however no Accounting Checks are performed anymore for cancelled items.-To verify this:-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to the view Purchase Orders.-Find the relevant purchase order and choose Edit.-Go to the tab Items and sub-tab Account Assignment.-Check the Cost Objects.-Go to the tab Changes.-Click Go.-You can verify that the account assignment was changed for the item at the same time it was canceled.-Resolution-For immediate resolution, provide us with the desired account assignment information and log a ticket to support. Give us approval to mark the transactions as Irrelevant in the backend using this account assignment information. We are working on a permanent solution in the meantime.-Keywords

Title: How to Change Ship-from Location for Each Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The supplier has multiple addresses that can be used as ship-from location. You want to select different ship-from address per purchase order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Supplier Base work center, Suppliers view.-Find and open the target supplier. Click on View All.-Navigate to Communication tab and Addresses subtab.-Click on Add Row to create a new address for this supplier.-At Ship-From column, the default value is No. Select Yes (Standard) from the dropdown list. Then the other address will become No, select Yes for it.-Save the changes and close the screen.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center, New Purchase Order common task.-Fill in the mandatory fields.-Navigate to Delivery subtab on item level. At Ship-From Locations in Involved Parties field, use value help to select target ship-from location.-Note: there are multiple addresses maintained as Ship-From in supplier master data. Only one address is "Yes (Standard)" at Ship-From column. This means that this address will be the default ship-from location when creating a new purchase order.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Address; Ship-From Location; Supplier; Supplier Master Data

Title: Payment Run Error "Work package ID system error; report an incident"
Content: Symptom-A Payment Run has been created and the error Work package ID system error; report an incident  appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payable work center.-Select the view Payment Runs. -Select the payment run for account 123 (123 represents the account ID).-Search and find Run ID: ABC (ABC represents the Payment Run ID).-Select the application log DEF (DEF represents the Application Log ID).-Open the application Log and under the General Tab you see:-Error appears: Work package ID system error; report an incident -Cause-This error is occurring because the logic checks that the total amounts of the items to be considered by the run all have the same direction (+ or -).-The account 123 is a mixed account (both customer and supplier). And the netting option is scoped in Business Configuration.-So the relevant receivable items are being picked up and totally (giving a + total) but also there are items from the payables (supplier) side being factored in. These amount to a gross total. -Because both positive and negative amounts are identified, the issue arises.-Resolution-Payables and receivables should be cleared separately.-It is recommended to select Netting Block option when creating the Payment Run.-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the view Payment Run.-Create a new Payment run.-Enter the required data.-Select the tick box for Netting Block.- See Also-https://me.sap.com/notes/0003374080-Keywords-Netting block, Payment Run, Work package ID, system error, system error; report a case, Work package ID {, Payable, dump, CL_FOP_GROUPING_SERVICE, CL_FOP_GROUPING_SERVICE

Title: Material XYZ Has Different Inventory Quantities in Different Reports
Content: Symptom-You observe the Inventory Quantity of a material XYZ (XYZ refers to material ID) is different in SCM and Financial Reports.-SCM Report: Inventory Report (Report ID: SCMINVV02_Q0001)..-FIN Reports: Material Inventories - Balance Summary (Report ID: FININVU14_Q0001).-                      Material Inventories - Balance History (Report ID: FININVlJ14_Q0002).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Work center Business Analytics and view Design Reports.-Search Inventory Report (Report ID: SCMINVV02_Q0001), open it, enter XYZ in filter Material, click Apply, in the result the On-Hand Stock is PQR (PQR Refers to Quantity 1).-In report Material Inventories - Balance Summary (Report ID: FININVU14_Q0001), enter XYZ in filter Material, click Apply, in the result Inventory Quantity is ABC (ABC Refers to Quantity 2).-In report Material Inventories - Balance History (Report ID: FININVU14_Q0002), enter XYZ in filter Material, click Apply, in the result Ending Quantity is ABC again.-Cause-SCMINVV02_Q0001 derives quantity from on-hand stock which is PQR.-FININVU14_Q0001 and FININVU14_Q0002 - Both financial reports works on dates, meaning that Key Date and Accounting Period/Year are considering, and hence based on the selected dates, data will be shown appropriately. To understand further, for both the reports add 'Accounting Period/Year' as a Row Field and you can see the period wise quantity movements.-Resolution-Correct system behaviour.-Keywords-Material Valuation, Quantity

Title: Modified Supplier Name is not reflected in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-When you are modifying Supplier name in master data, it is not reflecting in Shopping Cart-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self Service view and open the Self-Services Overview subview. -Open the Link Go Shopping (Advanced).-We see that the old address is displayed and not the modified address in the Shopping Cart.-Cause-Changes in master data will not be reflected in Shopping Cart if the modifications are done after the creation of the Shopping Cart.-If the Shopping Cart is copied from a Shopping Cart which has old address, then the system will not fetch the modified address.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-When you copy a shopping Cart, all the data in that Shopping Cart will be copied. Hence, the modifications done to the address will not be fetched.-Keywords-Shopping cart; Address displayed is incorrect; Supplier name in shopping cart
