Title: Updated Supplier Name Is Not Showing In Transaction Documents.
Content: Symptom-In the Supplier Masterdata, the Supplier name is changed however in the newly created purchasing documents the new name of Supplier is not updated still shows the old name of Supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In case copying of existing documents (like Shopping Carts/Purchase Orders/Supplier Invoices) which had a wrong(previous) name of Supplier. When a re-usable master data(Supplier Name)a is changed, on a copy of existing documents (like Shopping Carts/Purchase Orders/Supplier Invoices) which have used this master data(SupplierName), the newly copied documents will carry over the details from the original documents. Hence, after the master data change, it is recommended to not copy, but to manually enter the master data while creating new documents.

Title: Working Day is Shown as Day-off in Employee Time Sheet
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, open an employee's time sheet in Time Administration. You note one of his/her working day is marked as day-off in Time Sheet.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Time Recording view and Time Sheet subview.-Select the respective employee and select the Open Time Sheet button.-Select the Show Work Schedule button.-Where a working day is shown as day-off.-Cause-The employee has applied for a leave on that particular day and it is approved by the manager. In this case, system will display the day as day-off.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Keywords-Wrong, Work Schedule, Day off

Title: Approval Process Does not Retrigger When the Item List Price is Updated.
Content: Symptom-You set an Approval Process to the Sales document but when the price of an Item is updated the Approval process does not trigger for a second time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Sales quotes view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the Id of the sales Quote document).-Open and click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-The Item List Price is 1.000,00 (This can be any price, 1.000,00 is just an example).-Change the price to a value lower than 1.000,00.-Approval is not triggered.-    8.Change the price to a value higher than 1.000,00.-Approval is triggered.-Cause-The system only retriggers the Approval again if one of the below conditions are met:-1. New net value without freight is greater than the old net value without freight-2. New profit margin is less than the old profit margin-3. New total discount is greater than the old total discount-In our example, the net value is lower than the already approved net value, the system will not retrigger the Approval Process.-Resolution-This is the system behavior.-However, a new condition can be created for when a value is edited to be lower than the already approved one.-In case the price is updated to a higher value than the approved and the Approval is not triggered, please check the Process by following the steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Approval Processes view.-Click on view for Approval Process for Quote.-Conditions.-Work Distribution.-Skip Reapproval is checked for all approval steps.-In this case to have the Approval retriggered the Skip Reapproval  option must be unchecked.-See Also- KBA 1892959 - Already Approved Sales Quotes do not Trigger the Approval Process Again if There is any Change in the Validity Dates-Keywords-Approval, triggering, trigger, value, price, list price, update.

Title: Not possible to Change the Added Notes to Time Recordings
Content: Symptom-You are not able to change the notes/comments added to time recordings subsequently.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-It is not possible to change a note added to a time recording after saving. However, you can create a new internal comment for the same time recording as the most recent one. Only this one is used in the follow-up processes.-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self Services Overview view.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link under the Time section.-Select the already recorded time.-Select the Edit Details button.-Select the respective date and enter some internal comments.-Select the Release button and choose All or Selected period.-Select the Save and Close button. --Keywords-Comments, Note, Update, Change,

Title: How to add a Shortend Fiscal Year Variant to a Set of Books.
Content: Symptom-How to add a Shortend Fiscal Year Variant to a Set of Books.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to Implementation projects view.-Select the Project and click on Open Activity List-Select the fine tuning activity Other Fiscal Year.-Create a New Fiscal Year Variant.-On the new screen, enter the data <XYZ>, Description, Number for Accounting Periods = <012> and mark the option Year-specific fiscal year variant.-After doing this you will get the new variant in the previous screen.-Navigate to the Deviant Fiscal Year and enter the information Fiscal year = 20XX & Number of Accounting Periods = 0XY(the requires shortend periods).-Navigate to the Period Details-Perform the action Generate Accounting Periods for Specific Fiscal Year and enter 20XX-This will generate the periods and now you have to adjust the start date and end date accordingly.-Once you change the dates of all the 0XY periods, press enter.-Perform the action Generate Accounting Periods for Specific Fiscal Year and enter 20XX +1.-This will automatically populate the rest of the periods which you require and that will be of subsequent 12 periods.-Save the New fiscal Year variant.-Go to Integrate and Extend in Business Configuration workcenter.-Select the activity Set of Books.-Create a New Set of books and here you have to maintain 'XYZ' as the Fiscal Year Varaint.-See Also-Changing Fiscal Year Variants/ Shortened (Extended) Fiscal Year | SAP Blogs

Title: Error Message: 'Invalid Combination of Account and Item Type' while Posting Cancellation Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post Cancellation Invoice XYZ and the error message is shown as: Invalid combination of Account and Item type Other Assets.-(Here XYZ is Invoice id)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Show All Unposted Source documents and find document XYZ.-Error message is shown.-Cause-The Original Supplier Invoice is posted with a line item which is of Account Type Other Assets. Before Cancellation Invoice is posted, you have changed the Account Type from Other Assets to a different Account Type for E.g. Accounts Payable.-During posting of Cancellation Invoice dump occurs as the Original invoice is posted to an Account Type Other Assets which does not exist anymore.-Resolution-You should change the Account Type of the account which is considered in the Original invoice to Other Assets and you can post the Supplier Invoice.-Keywords-reverse. Account Type. General Ledger Account.

Title: Upon SSO login user is prompted to NetWeaver screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA helps to investigate the issue, where customer complaints that upon launching the SSO URL, user is prompted to SAP NetWeaver Screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Launch the URL-Enter the credentials-You see below screen:-Cause-One of the reason could be, user who is trying to login with the SSO tenant URL might be using the same Email ID for multiple Business Users.-Resolution-Check the SSO setup in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-If customer says issue is with only 1 reason, try to get the User ID & Email ID associated with the User.-Check does the same Email ID is updated for multiple users, if yes ask customer to change/remove the Email ID and ask them to use one Email ID for only one User.-Further you can schedule a call with customer and take the SAML Trace as explained in the KBA: 3356099 - How to Take SAML Traces for SAP Business ByDesign(BYD) & SAP Cloud for Customer(C4C) Systems .-Check the logs, if same Email ID is used by multiple users, for sure it will be display as:  -SAML20 SP (client 328): Email xyz@abc.com is used by multiple users: &2 User1 User2 User3-Attached sample Trace.-Keywords-SAML Trace, SSO Not Working, BYD, SRD-CC-SEC, Web Dynpro, NetWeaver

Title: Unable to see Additional Sections Inside Account Sales Data
Content: Symptom-When entering an account, you are not able to see the following sections in the Sales tab:-Sales Quotes, Sales Orders, Contracts, Target Groups, Campaigns, Activities.-The user has access to all of these objects in the system, however is not able to see this data inside the account screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Account Management work center.-Open the Accounts view.-Select an account and open it.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Here, the mentioned sections are not visible.-Cause-This issue is caused by a missing access right that need to be assigned to the user, in order to access the data from the respective account screen.-Resolution-In order to solve the issue, assign the Business Partner Factsheet views to the user.-This can be done following the below steps:-Go to Application and user management work center.-Enter the Business Users view (or Business Roles, if you use them to control access restrictions for the users).-Search for the user and click on Edit -> Access Rights.-Navigate to the Work Center and View Assignment.-Search for the work center Business Partner FactSheet Access Control.-Assign the respective views to the user.-Keywords-Sales Data, Customer

Title: UK MTD - Multiple active accounts exists - Identify Configured Accounts From the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer tries to submit their UK VAT return to the HMRC.-The Submission gets returned with the Error "|Multiple active accounts exists for VRN GBXXX.|Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located in: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA." (GBXXX represents the UK Company's VAT registration number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Tax Management work center, go to the VAT Returns view. -Find and select VAT Return XXX, in Status Reported (XXX means the VAT Return ID. The VAT return has been Released and Returned and is ready to be submitted to the HMRC).-Press View to open the return. -In the new screen press Submit. -The Submission is not successful: In the Submission Information section the following information appears: -Submission Status: Returned-Approval Status: Rejected-Error Description: |Multiple active accounts exists for VRN GBXXX.|Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located in: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA.-Cause-The number of Authorized accounts accessible from SAP OnDemand for the UK MTD Integration Service to submit data to the HMRC is restricted to one account only. If more than one account is maintained the error above is raised.-The Authorized Accounts are maintained in the Fine Tune task UK Making Tax Digital, for the UK MTD Integration service under Authorized Accounts. *-*Note: This activity is user specific. A business user can only see their own authorized accounts here. Authorized accounts maintained from other users are not visible.-Resolution-It is possible to identify all configured account from the Backend:-Request a Support ﻿User with authorization for backend access.-Open STFK.-Go to the Testshell, transaction SESFTS.-In the Load BO by Proxy Name field enter OAUTH_WEB_RES_ACCESS. -Press Load and select Load by Query and then ROOT - SELECT_ALL.-In the new screen just press OK (green tick on the bottom). -Select the Node displaying GLO_UK_MTD_MPCG in the ID column. -Press Navigate and select ACCOUNT.-Here only one entry should appear for the same Service Provider Account name, here GBXXX (according to the Company's VAT registration number).-If more than one entry appear, identify the business users that created the entries:-Select one of the Instances and press Navigate and select LAST_CHANGE_IDENTITY.-In the ID-CONTENT as well as FORMATED_NAME columns you find the business user credentials.  -Inform the customer about the different accounts created by different business users. Advise them to have all accounts removed which are not to be used for the digital VAT return submission. -To remove Authorized Accounts:-Log into the UI with a business user whose account is not to be used for the submission. -Access the Fine Tune activity UK Making Tax Digital. -Under Authorized Accounts press Remove. -Then press Save and Close. -Once all accounts, unnecessarily created, have been removed, the VAT return can be re-submitted.-Keywords-Multiple active accounts exists; Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located in: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA; UK MTD; UK VAT Return submit

Title: Costing Quantity Unit Deviates from Inventory Valuation UoM of Product ABC
Content: Symptom-An Actual Cost Rollup Run has been executed and in the Processed with Errors tab there's an error message:-"Costing quantity unit deviates from inventory valuation UoM of Product ABC" (ABC represents the product ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Management work center.-Under Periodic Tasks select Actual Cost Rollup.-Select the Run ID YYY (YYY represents the actual cost rollup run ID) and click on the resulted Execution ID ZZZ (ZZZ represents the execution ID).-Navigate to Processed with Errors tab.-For the Cost Object Type Material Inventory notice the error message:-"Costing Quantity Unit Deviates from Inventory Valuation UoM of Product ABC".-Cause-If the material price/cost validity is not maintained in accordance with the selection provided in the Actual Cost Rollup Run, then Actual costing will not happen for the product ABC.-Resolution-Example:-When performing the Actual Cost Rollup Run: YYY for period 04-2016 to 06-2016 then the material which qualifies for the rollup cost should have its costs rate maintained at the latest by 04-2016 onwards or prior period in its product master setup valuation tab.-But if the costs for the product ABC are only valid from period 06-2016 which means that during the periods 04 and 05 there is no valid cost existing in the system then the actual costing will not happen, because to have the rollup cost applied the material should have its cost valid for the entire period selection that is mentioned in the Actual Cost Rollup Run.-Solution:-Either the selection period in the above run should be adjusted to be in sync with the cost rate validity for the materials-Or make sure the material has valid cost set up in the system for the period for which above rollup run is being executed.-Keywords-Actual Cost Rollup Run; inventory valuation UoM; costing quantity unit

Title: Error - Combination of inventory account AAA and material BCD not valid. Materials valuated at standard cost cannot be written up or down. Select a price difference account for such materials instead.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post the Manual Journal Entry Voucher for Material and you are getting an error - Combination of inventory account AAA and material BCD not valid. Materials valuated at standard cost cannot be written up or down. Select a price difference account for such materials instead.-AAA means the G/L Account.-BCD means the Material ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Click New Journal Entry Voucher.-Select the Journal Entry type 00087 - Manual Entry for Materials.-Select the Screen Variant 630 - Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Materials.-Enter the data and click Simulate.-You can see an error - Combination of inventory account AAA and material BCD not valid. Materials valuated at standard cost cannot be written up or down. Select a price difference account for such materials instead.-Cause-The material you have chosen has a Perpetual Cost Method as 'Standard'. The inventory cost cannot be changed by adjusting through Manual Journal Entry Voucher. This is a standard system behavior.-Resolution-You must select the material which has Perpetual Cost Method as 'Moving average'. The moving average cost is adjusted automatically based on the charge or credit.-Keywords-Materials valuated at standard cost cannot be written up or down, Error in Material JEV, Combination of inventory account and material not valid.

Title: Tasks Submitted during a Substitution Period Not Handed Over Automatically to the Owner after Substitution Period Ends
Content: Symptom-Tasks which are assigned during the substitution period are not automatically handed over to the owner even after the end of the substitution period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For a given period, configure a substitution: Manager A should substitute Manager B for the given period. During the period of the substitution, one of the employee reporting to Manager B enters a Leave Request. The corresponding approval task correctly reaches the inbox of Manager A.-Manager A opens the task but he does not complete the task which therefore remains in status "In progress".-The substitution period ends and the above mentioned approval task remains in the inbox of Manager A and it is not transferred back to Manager B for completion. -Cause-This is the system expected behavior.-Resolution-When switching off the substitution, all the tasks which are still in status "New" are immediately transferred back to the person being substituted, while those tasks, which were taken in progress by the substitute stay with the substitute for completion.-In case the substitute would like to hand over all the "In Process" tasks to the person being substituted, he/she has to forward the tasks manually.-Keywords-Substitution, Task, Period, In progress

Title: Journal Postings Missing for Goods and Activity Confirmation
Content: Symptom-The Journal postings are missing for some of the Goods and Activity Confirmations.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Internal Logistics workcenter.-Select the Display/Reverse Goods And Activity Confirmations view.-Choose the Goods and Activity Confirmation AAA (AAA refers to the Goods and Activity Confirmation document).-Navigate to the Document Flow and notice that the journal entry icon is missing and there are no journal entries.-Cause-The Reason Code for the Goods and Activity Confirmation is Transfer.-Resolution-There won't be journal entry postings for the Goods and Activity Confirmation with Reason Code Transfer.-Keywords-GAC; goods and activity confirmation; reason code; transfer; je; journal entry

Title: Form 1099-MISC Copy B: RECIPIENT’S identification number Field is Blank
Content: Symptom-You've created a Withholding Tax Return Run with Tax Return Type 3 - Miscellaneous Income (1099 Misc) - FormB. The run generates a Withholding Tax Return, which contains the 1099-MISC FormB (form "Copy B") separately for each supplier. When you preview the document you notice that the RECIPIENT’S identification number field is blank for one or more suppliers. It's not printed out on the form. As a consequence the form is not valid and you cannot print it out.-This Case Document is relevant for Country Version US - United States only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center-Go to Tax Returns > Withholding Tax Returns view-Select the newly created Tax Return ID, with Tax Return Status In Preparation, and click Preview button-The 1099-MISC FormB opens in a new browser window and you notice that the RECIPIENT'S identification number field is blank for one or more suppliers.-Cause-The reason for such system behavior is that you did not maintain a Tax Number Type that is valid for the 1099-MISC FormB in the master data of the supplier. There are only two Tax Number Types valid for this form: Employer Identification Number (EIN) and Social Security Number (SSN). If you did not maintain a Tax Number Type at all, or maintained a different one (e. g. State Sales and Use Tax Registration Number) the data won't be printed out in the RECIPIENT’S identification number field.-Resolution-You should maintain a Tax Number Type like Employer Identification Number or Social Security Number in the master data of your suppliers, as follows:-Go to Business Partner Data work center-Go to Suppliers view-Find the supplier and click Edit > Financial Data-Move to Tax Data tab-Under Tax Numbers section, enter Country US - United States and the respective Tax Number Type and Tax Number-Click Save-As a result the Tax Number you just updated is reflected in the RECIPIENT’S identification number field of the 1099-MISC FormB form. The reflection is instantaneous, meaning you just need to close the form browser window and open it again (click Preview) to see the Tax Number.-  Keywords-1099-MISC, Withholding Tax, Tax Return, Form.

Title: Actual Utilization Report Showing Incorrect Hours
Content: Symptom-You have created a new customized report upon the data source Actual Utilization, now this report is displaying some hours with time type 8 that are not maintained in the Time Administration view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and access the view Design Reports;-Show All and search for the report you have created;-Run the report and check that there are some hours under the time type 8;-If you check on the Time Administration work center, there is no time booked for this time type.-Cause-The system determines the total time recorded using Time Valuation and stores it under the Time Type 8.-Since these times are based on valuation, they are listed under the Time Type Category 12 - Valuation Result.-Resolution-The underlying data source is designed in a way that it would return all the times recorded by the employees along with valuated time entries.-As such filter based on different time type categories/selections which is not done on the data source level and is done only at the report level.--This can be compared in other SAP delivered reports based on Employee Times data source such as “Employee Times: Yearly”, “Employee Times: Monthly”, etc., you can see that the filtration is done at the report level not on the data source level.--Hence if you create a report using the data sources you need to explicitly pass the filters at the report level to see only the data recorded by the employees.-Keywords-Resource, Custom, Calendar, Wrong

Title: Collection Case Has Zero Value Open Amount
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You notice that Collection Cases with 0 (zero) value open amount are still appearing with status In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Select the Collection Cases View.-Search for ID XXX (XXX represents the ID of the collection case).-Result: They appear with status In Process even though the open amount equal 0,00 YYY (YYY represents the currency).-Cause-There is an issue with our system regarding Collection Cases. There is a fix planned. Until then, follow the Resolution section to fix the problem.-Resolution-Open transaction se38 in the backend.-enter “Z_R_COL_CASE_CORR_NON_CLRD" and click create.-Enter any title.-Click Save.-On the next step, click local object.-Paste the attached file in to the text fields, activate and execute (F8).-If while creating the report, the system advises that it already exists, press display, activate and execute.-The report goes through all instances of collection cases that have a status that is incorrect according to the Customer Account Register.  This means that all cleared items in the account monitor should update to completed any collection cases that are still in progress.-Keywords-Collection Case; incorrect status; 0 amount

Title: Work centers cannot be assigned to a Business user
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign Access rights to a business user using 'Copy from user' but work centers are not assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users view.-Find the specific user.-Click Edit and select Access Rights.-Click the Actions button.-Select Copy from user.-Select a user and Click Ok.-Message 'User MV_IDENTITY_ID is invalid (validity period), authorizations not updated' is shown and no work center is assigned.-Cause-The user whom you selected using copy user has business roles assigned. Business role can be assigned only to valid users in the system. The validity of the business user is expired or starts from a future date. Such users with validity period cannot be assigned with business role and the same will not work for invalid users. You can also see the Business Roles under the Business Role tab grayed out for such users.-Resolution-The Access rights can be assigned for such users by direct assignment of work centers, as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users view.-Find the specific user.-Click Edit and select Access Rights.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment.-Select the desired work centers.-Keywords-Business role, Access rights, Copy from user, byd

Title: Goods and Service Receipt is Not Posted Due to Missing Segment and Proft Center
Content: Symptom-You have noticed an unposted source document and an error message which prevents the document from being posted. The error message is:-Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY-Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents sub-view.-And search for your Source Document ID, in this case the source document is a Goods and Service Receipt.-Select the ID and under the Details session you can see this error:-Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY-Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY-Cause-The error occurs since there is no Cost Center maintained for account assignment in the Goods and Service Receipt. If no Cost Center is maintained the system is not be able to derive both profit center and segment to ensure such a valid organizational assignment for automatically created assets.-Resolution-You may maintain the default profit center in the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the project, and select Open Activity List.-Go to tab Fine-Tuning Activities.-Select Fine Tuning activity Profit Center Derivation.-Select Edit Default Profit Center.-Click Add Row.-Enter required data and specify Profit Center for each Subledger.-Choose Save.-Now you are able to post the document.

Title: Subseq. Acquisition Not Permitted In Calc.Proc
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Low-Value Asset (LVA) using procurement process already. Now you want to post additional acquisition costs for the LVA, by posting a new goods and service receipt for the same individual material.-GSR is showing as unposted due to error message Subseq. Acquisition Not Permitted In Calc.Proc -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Select the not posted goods and services receipt document in question.-Choose View Business Transaction, you can see the same error message: Subseq. Acquisition Not Permitted In Calc.Proc- Cause-The inital acquisition post has been created in a previous fiscal year than the new acqusition posting. By default Low-Value Assets are created with the depreciation method L200 - Str.-line 20% LowValueAsset.  Therefore low value assets are being fully depreciated in the fiscal year of their acquisition. Subsequent acquisitions can only be made within this fiscal year.- Resolution-The ideal way would be to cancel the goods receipt and to not go ahead with the posting:-Cancel the goods receipt.-The cancellation document will also appear as unposted source document in the Source Documents view of the General Ledger workcenter.-Highlight the cancellation and press Actions - View business transaction.-In the next screen press Mark as Irrelevant.-This will mark the goods receipt cancellation as well as its original as irrelevant for accounting-If you need to go ahead with the posting you could change the depreciation method of the fixed asset temporarily, to, for example L010 - Str.-line from acq.value to 0. But this is not recommended.-Keywords

Title: Gross Price is Not Supported in Migration
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate open sales orders via Migration Tool. When executing the migration process, system reports error message: Price component type for migration price is invalid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-This applies to the Migration of Open Sales Orders and the Migration of Service Orders. We will use the Migration of Open Sales Orders as an example:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects and open the project.-Go to Integrate and Extend tab and select activity:Migration of Open Sales Orders.-Click Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool to open the migration tool.-Select the migration file that you want to migrate into system.-Click Execute Migration Step by Step.-Go to Step3:Simulate Import, system shows the error: Price component type for migration price is invalid.-You are able to create new sales order by the data in migration template successfully manually, but system does not allow to create it via migration tool.-Cause-This is because you are trying to use Gross price in the Sales Orders or the Service Orders. The distribution channel maintianed in the migrateion file is Direct Sales which is set as defaul channel for Gross price. -However, Gross price is not supported in migration for Open Sales Orders and Service Orders.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation project and open the project.-Go to Fine-Tune tab and select activity:Configure Price Strategy.-Click Default Gross Pricing, you can see that Gross price is set as default pricing for Direct Sales channel.-Resolution-Remove the default Gross pricing rule for the distribution channel, and then execute the migration.-The Migration of Open Sales Orders and the Migration of Service Orders with Gross Prices would be a new requirement.-In order for you to directly get in contact with the decision makers in SAP Product Management, please submit your enhancement request via the following SAP Continuous Influence sites: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Gross Price; Sales Order; Service Order; Migration; Price component type for migration price is invalid; Gross

Title: Time Model in Value Selection not Displayed or Error Message 'Time model not Permitted for Current Country'
Content: Symptom-You want to assign a certain time model and you do not get these time model displayed in the value selection box to select. You maintain the time model manually and you get error message:  Time model not permitted for current country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You go to Time Administration Workcenter-You go to the Employees View-You find your concerned employee and click Edit-You navigate to the tab Time Profile and sub tab Work Schedule-You want to maintain under predefined work schedule the appropriate time model-You open the value selection box and do not find the appropriate time model-(You maintain manually the value of your appropriate time model and get the error message)-Or-You fulfill the task Complete Time Data (Hire)-In step 2 Define Work Schedule you want to maintain the appropriate time model-You do not find the time model in the value selection box and if you manually maintain the time model you get the error message-Cause-There are two countries related to an employee: employment country and country of his/her assigned org unit-Only time models could be assigned to employees,  in which the employees are originally hired. Every time model must be assigned to a country when created.-Therefore it is not possible to hire e. g. a Germany employee and to assign the employee to another country time model even the organization unit is assigned or belonged to another country and the employee should be employed according to time model.-Resolution-If appropriate you might have to terminate and rehire the employee from the required Country to get the appropriate time model for employee assigned.-Go to the Personnel Administration - Regular Tasks view.-Select the required Country tab.-Click Rehire Employee.-In Personal Administration WOC in the Employees View you could filter in employment for country (Advanced Filter Option). In Personal Administration WOC in Regular Tasks View you could hire employees for different countries, (if scoped).-See Also-Only time models could be assigned to employees, in which the employees are originally hired. Every time model must be assigned to a country when created.-Therefore it is not possible to hire e.g. a Germany employee and to assign the employee to another country time model even the org-unit is assigned or belong to another country and the employee should be working according to the time model.-In Personal Administration Workcenter in the Employees view you could filter in Employment for Country (Advanced Filter Option). In Personal Administration Workcenter in Regular Tasks view you hire employees for different countries, (if scoped).-Keywords-Time Model, not available, not appearing, Wrong Time Model, Personnel Administration, Time Administration, Employee, Country, Hire, Hiring, missing

Title: System is not Working as Expected When Applying for Partial Day
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to request leave for a specific duration (for example: 2 hours). While you are able to send the leave request, the calculation in the Vacation Account is not as expected.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When the leave request is applied from Self-Services Overview, we have the option for only Full Day and Half Day. There is no partial day.-Resolution-This is the system behavior and New Leave Request only supports half day and full day leave and not partial day.-Refer below for more insight on the system behavior:-1. If the Time is recorded in the Employee Time Recording (Time Administration work center) then any hours recorded over the Actual Hours will be recorded under Over time.--2. If you apply Vacation through New Leave Request option in the Self service then later if you record some time for the same day then the additional time will not go for Over time.--This is expected system behavior.--If you use the SAP pre-delivered vacation time type then system might have thrown a collision error when you record time as described above. But the Time type which you are using is customized and there is no collision rule maintained.--Recording time of Types - Paid Time off and Actual Hours Worked, throws collision errors and hence the system does not allow recording times of these two types together.--These are maintained in the Business Configuration work center, open the Time Types – <Country> fine-tuning activity and click Maintain Collision Rules. You have maintained the collisions rules, but the 'Send Message' is not maintained and hence the recording is allowed.--Maintain the Send Message for the collisions rules.-See Also-For further information about Collision Rules, refer to Help Document:-Configuration: Maintain Collision Rules-Keywords-Partial Day, Leave Request, Vacation, Calculation, Self-Service, Over Time, Collision Rules.

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice Due to Error Message: Profit Center Missing; Profit Center Accounting Active From DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice due to the following error messages:-'Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY.'-'Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents subview in the Closing Cockpit view.-Search for Source Document ABC (ABC represents the Supplier invoice ID) and select it.-The error messages are:-'Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY.'-'Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY.'-Click the Invoice ID ABC to open the same.-The Buying Company is XYZ (XYZ represents the Company ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-For line item ABC-DE (ABC-DE represents the line item ID of supplier invoice ABC), navigate to the Cost Distribution subtab.-Under Account Assignment, the G/L-Account and Cost center is missing.-Cause-These error messages will show up in the supplier invoice if no Cost Center is maintained for Account Assignment within the invoice.-If no Cost Center is maintained, the system is not able to derive both profit center and segment to ensure valid organizational assignment for created assets.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Activity Profit Center Derivation.-Click Change Immediately button.-Click the link Edit Default Profit Center.-No Profit Center has been maintained for Subledger for Company XYZ.-Resolution-You can maintain the Profit Center as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Activity Profit Center Derivation.-Click Change Immediately button.-Click the link Edit Default Profit Center.-Click Add Row.-Enter required data and specify Profit Center for each Subledger.-Click Save. -See Also-Help Center Document Derivation of Profit Center and Segments-Keywords-Lieferantenrechnung; Profit center; Cost center; supplier invoice; Segment missing; segment reporting active; Profit center missing

Title: Depreciation Value is Incorrect in Legacy System After Migration of Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-After the migration of fixed assets, it was discovered that the depreciation value of one of the fixed assets in the legacy system was incorrect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Asset work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the Fixed Asset XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Fixed Asset).-Press Edit, and then select Values from the dropdown list.-It can be observed that for Set of Books ABC (ABC represents the Set of Books ID) the value is XXX (XXX represents the value of the given Set of Books).-Cause-As the values were incorrect in the legacy system, the same incorrect values were entered in the migration file and subsequently migrated to SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-To correct the values of Fixed Asset XYZ in SAP Business ByDesign, the write-up method can be used.-Below are the steps for write-up method:-Go to the Fixed Asset work center.-Select the Fixed Asset XYZ.-Press Edit, and then select Values from the dropdown list.-Select the Set of Books ABC.-Press Manual Posting, and then select Write-Up from the dropdown list.-Select the Depreciation type.-Select the Valuation view.-Specify the concerned amount.-A write-up acts as a reverse depreciation. The resulting amount is visible in the Journal tab of the Values view. Subsequently, the correct depreciation amount can be posted.-If the migration has been closed, the migration can be reopened and reversed from the Migration tab. Subsequently, a new legacy fixed asset can be created either via the migration template or from the Fixed Assets work center. When creating the asset, the correct values can be maintained in the Migration tab, resulting in the correct depreciation being posted for the respective fixed asset.-Keywords-depreciation adjustment, accumulated depreciation correction, reverse posting, opening balance fix, data migration error, legacy data remediation, balance sheet impact, restatement, historical data correction, manual journal entry, financial statement correction, amortization correction, book value adjustment, true-up entry

Title: How to Request Restore/Rollback to Restore Point?
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--Your tenant has a restore point, and you want your tenant to be as it was when that restore point was created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-You want to reset your system to the date of restore point(Active Restore Point).-In order to request Reset to Restore Point request you to follow the below steps:-Go to Service Control Center work center.-Go to Systems view.-Select the System which has the Active Restore Point.-Click on Reset to Restore Point button. -Fill the required details & click on Ok.-  Process Details:-After a rollback, all the incidents in the tenant that is restored, will be automatically closed.-Restore points can be used to remove changes made during data migration.-Restore points cannot be used to remove changes made to partner developed solutions.-When a rollback is complete, SAP will send e-mail notification to the requestor, informing them that the rollback is complete.- Restrictions:-Customer can request for "Reset to Restore Point" only if they have an active Restore Point.-During the reset process, the tenant being restored is not accessible. -A Restore Point can be reset only once. Please note that once you make a request to reset your system to the available restore point and this request is fulfilled, the restore point is consumed and cannot be reused for another reset request.-PDI-Solution related limitations:-When source tenant has no PDI solution deployed at the time of Restore Point creation, rollback is possible.-When source tenant has PDI solution(s) deployed after the time of Restore Point creation, rollback is not possible.-Once a Restore Point is taken, please avoid deploying new PDI patches on the source tenant. In such cases, versions of PDI solutions will mismatch at Restore Point and tenant levels.Hence, a rollback to the Restore Point cannot be processed as the Restore Point will have an updated PDI version. -See Also-2315326 - How to Request a Restore Point -2653007 - How to Terminate Restore Point?-Keywords-Roll Back, Restore Point, Data Migration, Business Configuration, Implementation Project, Backup, Back-Up, Revert, Restoration

Title: How to check Password Reset Attempts via Self-Service in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have received an incident where the users report that they are not receiving the e-mail with the new password generated by the Forgot Password feature.-The users insert their e-mail address on the field, but do not receive the e-mail in their inbox. You want to see the system logs for the usage of this functionality to identify possible causes.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the logon screen.-Click the link Forgot your Password? (SAP Business ByDesign) or Forgot password? (SAP Cloud for Customer).-A new page will open.-Insert the user e-mail address.-Click the Submit button.-A new popup will appear requesting the user to enter the token that was sent to the e-mail address.-However, no e-mail is received.-Cause-There may be multiple causes, as described in the Knowledge Base Article 2616642 - Unable to Generate New Password From the Forgot Password Link.-Resolution-After reproducing the issue (or after the customer reproduced the issue), follow the below steps:-Log in the backend of the system.-Open the transaction SLG1.-Insert the parameters as follows:-Object: AP_IAM-Subobject: SELFSERVICE-In Time Restriction, select a timeframe that includes the time in which the password reset attempt was made.-Click the Execute button or press F8.-The system will display a list with the successful and failed attempts. To see the Message Text and have more information on what error the system raised, double-click the relevant row. The message raised by the Identity and Access Management system will display the cause of the failed attempt to send the token e-mail.-Keywords-Password, IAM, Security Policy, Recovery, ESS

Title: Missing Time Account Types in Report Time Accounts: Monthly
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find any other time accounts related data in report Time Accounts: Monthly. You want to view all the time account types in this report.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Report view.-Select Report "Time Accounts: Monthly".-Filter employee you would like to display in this report.-Then you can find only Annual Leave Account displayed.-Cause-Only time account type Annual Leave Account is assigned to the employees in the system.-Resolution-Please assign other Time Accounts which you would like to view in the report.-See Also- Help document <Quick Guide for Employees (in Time Administration)>-Keywords-Time Accounts;  Report

Title: Upload Service Confirmations From Microsoft Excel is Grayed out
Content: Symptom-The 'Upload Service Confirmations from Microsoft Excel' option appears grayed out in the Time Administration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Navigate to Time Recording view.-Select the Action button.-The option 'Upload Service Confirmations from Microsoft Excel' is grayed out.-Cause-Time recording integration for sales orders has not been scoped.-Resolution-Time recording integration for sales orders needs to be scoped in the system before the action Upload Service Confirmations from Microsoft Excel is enabled.-Service confirmations are linked to Sales Orders.-You can scope the Time recording integration for sales orders as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select you respective implementation project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions tab.-Expand the Scoping Elements with the following path:-Sales>Selling Products and Services>Sales Orders-The Question following Question needs to be in scope: Do you want to record time for sales orders?- Please note that this means that you cannot create manual Service Confirmations for your Sales Orders anymore but the Service Confirmations will be created via the Time Recording.- See also the following KBA’s for the process with both scenarios in the example of a Service with item type Service - Time and Material:-2875032 - CRM Scenario: Service - Time and Material in Sales Order-Further examples are also liked in the KBA 2875052 - CRM Scenario: Services and Expenses in Sales Order (Summary Table)-See Also-KBA 2875032 - CRM Scenario: Service - Time and Material in Sales Order-KBA 2875052 - CRM Scenario: Services and Expenses in Sales Order (Summary Table)-Keywords-Time, Upload, Service, Excel

Title: Error "Time Recording Profile ZXX not valid" Occurrs When Completing the Time Data for an Employee or New Hire
Content: Symptom-When completing the time data for an employee or newly hired employee, you receive the error:-"Time Recording Profile ZXX not valid" (where ZXX represents the time recording profile ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When hiring a new employee:-Create an employee via Personnel Administration regular task.-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search and open the newly created employee.-At the top of the screen, click the message to complete the time data of the employee.-On the first step, select a Time Recording Profile.-Here the error appears.-For an employee who has already been hired:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select work view.-Select task Complete Time Data (Hire) for X (where X represents the employee ID).-In the new screen: select ZXX from Time Recording Profile dropdown list.-Click Next.-Here the error appears.-Cause-Cause 1: If the error occurs when hiring a new employee:-The Time Recording Profile selected is an international profile, which is not applicable for any of the below countries/regions:-AT-AU-BE-CA-CH-CN-DE-DK-ES-FR-GB-IN-IT-JP-MX-NL-NZ-US-ZA-The international Time Recording Profiles can be checked by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for activity Time Types - International.-Enter the sub-acvitity Maintain Time Recording Profiles.-Cause 2: If the error occurs for an employee who has already been hired:-The issue is due to the mismatch of Time Recording Profile and the employee's country.-Resolution-Solution for cause 1: The system works as expected.-Solution for cause 2: Please use a time recording profile that is defined under the employee's country.-It is worth noting that the country considered for the time recording profile validation is the one selected at the time of the employee hiring.-For example, if you hire the employee through the regular task for country Germany, only Germany time recording profiles can be selected. This applies even if you select the nationality and the address of the employee as a different country.-Keywords-Time Types, Exception, Positive, Time Model, Time File

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Processed With Errors: "Asset XYZ Val.View 1: Acquisition Cost Negative"
Content: Symptom-After executing the GR/IR Clearing Run, the following errors can be found under the Processed with Errors tab:-An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ.-Asset XYZ Val. View 1: Acquisition Cost Negative.-(XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to GR/IR Clearing sub-view.-Select Run ID AAA. (AAA represents the GR/IR Clearing Run ID)-Select Processed with Errors tab.-Select the Purchasing Document Item row.-Notice the error messages:-'An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ'-'Asset XYZ val.view 1: Acquisition cost negative.'-Cause-Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt clearing runs compare the amounts from receipts of goods or services with the associated amounts on the invoices. The run first determines the quantity that matches both a goods or services receipt and an invoice, and clears the Purchases in Transit and Unbilled Payables accounts based on this quantity.-When the newly created asset is a result from a complete transfer of an old asset, the Individual Material (IMAT) for it would be same and the GR/IR clearing run tries to find the Goods and Service Receipt in the fixed asset from which the newly created fixed asset was created and fails since it is already transferred.  Hence the acquisition costs are turning negative, and this causes the error message.-Example:-The acquisition cost was transferred from Asset XYZ to Asset ABC (ABC represents the receiving fixed asset) via complete transfer. Now when the GR/IR Clearing Run is executed for purchase order from which the Asset XYZ was determined and GR/IR clearing searches for the offsetting accounts to clear but the cost is negative in the asset as the Goods and Services Receipt used is no more in the asset due to its transfer and basically the acquisition cost turned zero/negative.-Resolution-To resolve the GR/IR Clearing Run errors the following sequence has to be followed:-Reverse the Fixed Asset Transfer as this will automatically correct the posting.-Perform GR/IR Clearing Run, which will then update the acquisition cost.-If the transfer of the fixed asset is still needed, it can be performed now and the behavior would be correct.-Keywords-GR/IR; clearing run; acquisition cost negative; fixed asset; imat; individual material-gr/ir,acquisition cost negative

Title: How to Mass Change Employee Responsible in Opportunities
Content: Symptom-From 1902 release, you are able to mass change the employee responsible in the created opportunities.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-n/a-Cause-From 1902 release, the system supports mass change party roles in opportunities, including employee responsible.-Resolution-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunties view.-Select one or more opportunities, click button Action - Assign Party.-In the Select Party screen, you can choose the party role you want to change and the new vlaue of the role. For example, choose Employee Responsible role, and choose employee XYZ as the new value. Click OK button, the change is executed. (XYZ represents the new employee name)-Open the opportunity you used, in Involvied Parties - Sales Team tab, you can see the employee responsible right now is XYZ.-Please note that the change will only be executed if the Forbid Manual Changes indicator for the respective Party Role is not active in the Business Configuration.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Business Configruation work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tune step-Open the fine tuning activity Opportunities-Click on the Maintain Involved Parties hyperlink-Select the respective Party Role e.g. Employee Responsible-The Forbid Manual Changes indicator should not be active.-See Also-2776636 - Employee Responsible Removed After Mass Re-Assignment of Employee Responsible in Opportunities-Keywords-Opportunties; Mass Change; Party Role; Re-Assignment; Mass Re-Assignment; Opportunity

Title: You Are Unable to Access The Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to access the Mass Data Maintenance work center, however the system is requesting you to Install the Microsoft Silverlight.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click Mass Data Maintenance view-System requests you to Install the Silverlight. -Cause-The issue here is not actually with availability of Silverlight, as Mass Data Maintenance has moved on to no longer require Microsoft Silverlight since this plug-in was deprecated back in 2019. The cause of it is actually related to a lack of access rights to the work center BC_DATAMIGRATION.-Resolution-In order to solve it, you need to assign the access right BC_DATAMIGRATION to the affected users.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users view.-Search for the affected User ID.-Click Edit and then Access Rights.-Go to the Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Click Find and search for BC_DATAMIGRATION.-Locate and Assign it to the User.-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, Get Silverlight, Install Silverlight.

Title: Displayed Account Name is Different From the Value Maintained in Account Name field
Content: Symptom-You have maintained "Account Name" field with value "ABC", but you found the Account Name is displayed as "ABC DEF" in the Account OWL.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select Account ABC DEF (Where ABC DEF stands for Account Name).-In the Account Editor screen, you can find "Account Name" field is only maintained with value "ABC" and you are unable to find any field that maintained with value "DEF".-Cause-"Additional Name" field of the account is maintained with value "DEF" and the Displayed Account Name shows "Account Name" + "Additional Name". "Additional Name" field may be hidden via Adapataion mode.-You can also check "Additional Name" field in Business Partner view.-Resolution-You can remove the value in Additional Name field to make the displayed account name the same that in Account Name field.-Keywords-Account; Account Name; Additional Name

Title: Edit Cost Tab is Greyed Out in the Valuation Tab of Material Master Data
Content: Symptom-You are not able to edit cost in the valuation tab of material PQR as the Edit Cost tab is greyed out.-(Here PQR represents the Material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Search and Edit the Material PQR.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Select the respective Company and Business Residence.-(or)-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Search and Edit the Material PQR.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Select the respective Company and Business Residence.-Notice that Edit Cost tab is greyed out.-Cause-The issue is due to fiscal year is not maintained for the respective company. Hence, you are not able to maintain the cost for the respective set of books.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Master data view.-Go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies sub-view.-Select respective Company and click on Edit Fiscal Years tab.-You have not maintained the Fiscal year details.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Master data view.-Go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies sub-view.-Select respective Company and click on Edit Fiscal Years tab.-Click on New Fiscal Year tab and maintain the Fiscal Year for the respective year.-Keywords-Edit cost tab, Material master data, Valuation, greyed out, grayed out

Title: Error Message in Supplier Invoice With Credit Memo Item and Invoice Item: Only Positive Total Tax Amount Permitted
Content: Symptom-When a Supplier Invoice is created with a Credit Memo Item and an Invoice Item, the following error message will appear: Only positive total tax amount permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select New Invoice without Purchase Order.-Complete the relevant data.-In the Items Tab, add 2 lines, one for Credit Memo and 1 line for Invoice Item-Select Check-See the error message: Only positive total tax amount permitted.-Cause-The system does not support negative tax amount. Invoice(s) with both Credit Memo line(s) and Invoice line(s) causes inconsistencies.-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-As a workaround, create two separate documents: one for Invoice Items and the other one for Credit Memo Items.-Keywords-Only Positive Total Tax Amount Permitted, Credit Memo, Supplier Invoice.-only positive total tax amount permitted,supplier invoice,invoice item,credit memo item

Title: Error 'No Functional Area Could be Assigned' Occurs During Posting
Content: Symptom-You have an unposted source document with the error "No functional area could be assigned".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Source Documents.-Search and find Document ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Source Document ID).-Here you see the error: No functional area could be assigned.-Cause-Not all the GL accounts for all the Chart of Accounts that are used for this company and its Set of Books have a functional area assigned.-Because of this, the system is looking for a default functional area, however in your settings none of the functional areas have been marked as default.-Resolution-To resolve the issue you have two options:-A. Maintain a Default functional area-Go to the business Configuration work center.-Select the view Overview.-Search and find the activity: Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Select the option Edit Functional areas.-Choose one of the Functional Areas and select the Default flag.-B. Maintain a Functional area for all individual GL accounts for every Chart of Accounts via Edit functional area determination, in this same fine-tune activity.-See Also-2696325 -  Error Message: No Functional Area could Be Assigned During Unposted Warehouse Confirmation-Keywords-Functional areas, default

Title: Revenue Recognition Error: 'Document item XYZ/XX: Derivation of planned costs not possible'.
Content: Symptom-You execute the revenue recognition run for sales order item XYZ-XX which uses accrual method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC.-The run finishes with the error "Document item XYZ/XX: Derivation of planned costs not possible".-(XYZ/XX represents the sales order ID/sales order Item ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Revenue Recognition subview.-Click the Revenue Recognition ID you need.-Go to the Messages tab.-You can see the error Document item XYZ/XX: Derivation of planned costs not possible.-Go to the Processed with Errors tab, search and open sales order item XYZ/XX.-Click View All.-Go to the Items tab.-The item is linked to a Project.-Cause-When using the accrual method "108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC" the estimated costs are either derived directly from the project (work, materials, expenses tab) or from a manual Estimated Cost value.-The error is reported when no such planned costs exist and when no manual POC is maintained either. -Resolution-To resolve this issue, you have three options: -1. Maintain the cost directly in the Project:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center. -Go to Sales Document Items view.-Search for the related Sales Document Item.-Go to  the Associated Objects tab.-Open the Project related to the Sales Document item. -In the project Go to the Project Plan tab select a project task.-Go to the "Work", "Materials" or "Expenses" sub tabs, where you can maintain planned values according to your business needs. -2. Maintain a manual Estimated Cost value:-Again in the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and revenue work center find the related sales order item. -Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and choose Percentage of Completion.-Here, under Calculation Basis for calculated POC, you can enter the Estimated Costs manually. -  3. Enter a manual Percentage of Completion: -Again in the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue work center find the related sales order item. -Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and choose Percentage of Completion.-Here, under Details for Project, you can enter a new row with the required Percentage. -Keywords-revenue recognition, planned costs, pricing and invoicing, POC, percentage of completion, 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC

Title: Follow-up Document related Fields Not Working As Expected in Purchase Order Items
Content: Symptom-When creating Purchase Order, after adding an item manually, the follow up document settings "GSR expected" and "Invoice expected" indicators are not set as expected. You expect the value here (flagged or unflagged) should follow the settings in configuration activity "Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Purchase Request's ID). -Select ABC-1. -Click in New Purchase Order button.-Click in View All button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Click in Add Row button (to add a new item).-Add the needed information such as Product ID, Quantity, Process type and Ship-To. -Click in Check button.-In Basic Data subtab you can see that:-Goods and Services Receipt Expected: yes/marked-Invoice Expected: yes/marked -For both fields (or only one) it was not expected that it would be marked because the Configuration is maintained differently. -Steps to check the Configuration maintained:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view. -Select activity "Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings". -Click in View button.-Here you can see that it is maintained:-Item type: DEF (DEF is the item type maintained for the added item).-Process type: GHI (GHI is the process type maintained for the added item).-GSR expected manual change not allowed: not marked (no). -Invoice expected manual change not allowed: not marked (no). -Hence the user is not expecting that in the Purchase Order those fields are marked. -Cause-When creating a Purchase Order with a reference to a Purchase Request, the system accurately identifies follow-up flags for both stock and non-stock items based on Configuration. However if the user manually adds an extra item, then by default row will be created for item type with follow-up flag set correctly as per configuration. Redetermination doesn't happen when process type is changed manually in item. -For Purchase Requests with stock items, the Purchase Order is generated with stock item types and follow-up flags aligned with the Business Configuration. However, manually changing the process type to "stock" sets both GR and IR flags, persisting even when reverting to non-stock. The same thing happens for non-stock items in Purchase Requests, where the process type change to "stock" results in both GR and IR flags being set, and these settings persist upon reverting to non-stock.-Resolution-If the redetermination is still required in the Purchase Order in this specific scenario, the user can follow an workaround:-Add all the additional items.-Go to General tab. -Remove the Supplier.-Press Enter.-Add the Supplier again.-Press enter. -Or the user can create a Purchase Order without reference to a Purchase Request for additional items (depending on business scenario) where redetermination happens even if items are added and changed manually.-See Also-KBA: 3124895 - Follow-up Document related Fields are missing in Purchase Order Items-KBA: 2415028 - The Invoice Expected field is Automatically Flagged/Unflagged in Purchase Order-KBA: 2580173 - Incorrect Follow-up Document Settings in Purchase Order-Keywords-Purchase Order; Purchase Request; Item; Invoice Expected; GSR; Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings; Goods and Services Receipt Expected
