Title: Error Message When Allocating Payment Advice in Payment Allocation: 'It is only possible to confirm an advice collection completely'
Content: Symptom-An error message is raised when trying to allocate bank advice in payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Open the related payment allocation-Click Post. -Error: 'It is only possible to confirm an advice collection completely'-Cause-You have created more than one bank payment advice with the same Payment Reference ID. However, not all of these advices are allocated together in the payment allocation.-When multiple bank payment advices are created with the same Payment Reference ID, all these advices must be allocated together in the Payment Confirmations/Returns tab of the payment allocation.-Resolution-You need to allocate all the payment advices with the same Payment Referece ID in the same payment allocation. To check what payment advices share the same Payment Reference ID, proceed as follows:-Open the payment allocation.-Click on tab Payment Confirmations/Returns.-Open the advanced fileter.-Search by the related Payment Reference ID.-The system returns the advices that shares the same payment reference ID.-Obs: In case you have created separate payment allocation for the individual advices, you would need to allocate the differences accordingly or cancel the bank statment / bank statement item to create a payment allocation that corresponds to the amounts of these items together (that shares the same payment reference ID).-For more details on how to reverse a specific payment allocation, please refer to help document Quick Guide for Payment Allocation.-See Also-KBA 2340259 - Error Message: It Is Only Possible to Confirm an Advice Collection Completely while Posting a Payment Allocation-Keywords-Payment Allocation. Bank Statement. Bank Payment Advice. Bank Debit Advice. Bank Credit Advice. Payment Reference.

Title: Unexpected External Reference ID of a point of sales transaction is shown during the creation of the payment allocation
Content: Symptom-Unexpected External Reference is shown for the Point of sales transaction during the creation of the payment allocation-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center > Bank Statements view-Select the Bank Statement and open it.-In the third screen "Create and Edit Items", select "Required" in the further Processing Column.-Go to the Payment Allocation > Payment Confirmations/Returns Tab.-Here, you notice a list of sales transactions with unexpected External Reference.-Cause-The system fetches the External Reference from the field "External Payment Reference" of the Sales Transaction > Payment Items tab -Resolution-System behavior-Keywords-point of sales transaction, external reference, incorrect, wrong, external payment

Title: Change log for Security Policy in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to check if, when and how a security policy was changed in a certain period of time?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign does not offer the option of displaying a change log for the security policy. It is therefore not possible to determine whether changes have been made to a security policy.-Keywords-possibility, audit, made changes, during, calendar year, time frame, specific, -

Title: How to Define Sales Planning
Content: Symptom-Sales planning offers a solution that enables you to define and monitor sales targets. It promotes seamless monitoring of sales targets, forecasts, and revenues and also makes it easy to create new plans.-Planning for your business involves three different elements: strategic planning, financial planning, and operational planning. While strategic planning is a high-level management task and therefore takes place outside of the system, financial and operational plannings are supported by tools and applications that have been designed to guide and support you in mastering your company’s planning and budgeting tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDeisgn-Resolution-There's no previous configuration on Scoping Questions or Activities.-How to Define a Sales Planning:-Go to the Managing My Area Work Center.-Select the Sales Planning view.-Enter the data, such as Sales Unit, Horizon From/To, Plan Name, and Currency in the Set General Properties screen.-Click on the Next button.-Specify the granularity of your plan in the Select Planning Dimensions screen.-Enter a description for the active version or you can create a new version in the Manage Plan Versions screen.-Click on the Next button.-Select the data on which your planning is to be based and where it should be copied to in the Copy Actual Data screen.-Review your entries in the Review screen.-Click on the Finish button.-Go back to the Sales Planning view.-Select the Plan ID ABC (ABC means yours Sales Planning created).-Click on the Change Status and select Active to release the selected sales plan.-You can select the accounts, employees, product categories, products, and sales units that you want in the plan.-You can open the plan data in Microsoft Excel in the Confirmation screen or close the guided activity.-Please Note: There is no specific limit on the versions that can created, however only one version can be active for each sales plan.-See Also-Help Document: Sales Planning Quick Guide-KBA: 2893853 - Missing Sales Orders From Sales Target Plan--KBA: 2892135 - Wrong Format in Excel Template for Sales Planning--KBA: 2620411 - Few Fields are Grayed Out in the Downloaded Excel Plan Data--KBA: 2079482 - Processing Workflow for Sales Planning Issues--KBA: 1970508 - Error Message "You are not authorized to execute report Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee)" while accessing Overview view of Sales Order work centre.-KBA: 1751238 - You are not able to Select the Required Sales Unit When Creating a Sales Plan-Keywords-Sales Planning; Planning; Sales Target

Title: Error: 'Object currently locked by SAP_SYSTEM (SAP_SYSTEM)'.
Content: Symptom-You are facing the following issue with a lot of unposted source documents: 'Locking object not possible; object locked by SAP_SYSTEM (SAP_SYSTEM)'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents subview. -Select "Unposted Source Documents". -Here you will find a lot of documents with the following error message: -'Locking object not possible; object locked by SAP_SYSTEM (SAP_SYSTEM)'-Cause-One possible reason for this type of issue is that many operations are being performed closely together, and the system does not have enough time to release the locks on the documents (which are in place to prevent conflicting changes being saved in the same document or document flow.)-The Business ByDesign system usually manages to recover from these errors and ensure that all data sent is eventually created and consistent, however, there is a very high number of instances where this error happens. With such a high number of errors, it's impossible for the system to consistently recover from them all, and eventually, you will see cases like this where the document fails to be created.-Resolution-To prevent this issue, it's advisable to increase the time between system calls, in order to give time for all necessary locks to be released and avoid this issue. -Usually, a background job runs every day and should clear the error messages. However, if the issue still persists, please open a new incident to SAP Support, requesting to unlock these messages from the backend or for further investigation. -Keywords-General Ledger, Unposted, source documents, Object, locked, SAP_SYSTEM.

Title: Error In Concur Expense Report: 'Business Transaction Expense Report XYZ : Tax Code not filled in tax item'.
Content: Symptom-While trying to post a Concur expense report but facing the following error messages: -'Business Transaction Expense Report XYZ : Tax Code not filled in tax item'-'Business Transaction Expense Report XYZ: Simplified Tax without tax group'-(XYZ represents the Report Key ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Concur view > Expense Reports subview. -Select "All Expense Reports".-Search for Report Key ID: XYZ. -Here it will shows below error messages: -'Business Transaction Expense Report XYZ : Tax Code not filled in tax item'-'Business Transaction Expense Report XYZ : Simplified Tax without tax group'-Cause-One possible reason is because the tax code is not filled. Check the same by following the below steps: -Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Concur view > Expense Reports subview. -Select "All Expense Reports".-Search for Report Key ID: XYZ. -Click in the "Download the Original JSON" button.-Open the downloaded HTML file, and you could see that the tax code is filled as below.-"taxCode":null,-Resolution-Mark the Expense Report as "Failed" and then post again with the correct tax code filled. -Keywords-tax code, Expense Report, Concur, tax item, not filled, Business Transaction.

Title: Description Field in Project Invoice Request Doesn't Match Content Maintained in Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You input description in expense report per expense item, but you find it shows unexpected content in project invoice request's description field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to New Expense Report on Behalf view to create expense report XXX.-The first thing to do is maintaining details at step 1: General Information.-Enter a purpose for the expense report at Purpose field.-Click Edit Cost Assignment->Add Row, select Project Task from the dropdown list for Account Assignment Type field.-Enter the project task YYY to which you want to link the expense report. Click OK.-Click on Next, navigate to step 2: Expenses.-Click on Add Row to add an expense item. Choose Country/Region (mandatory), Expense Date, Expense Type, etc. if necessary. Note: once you select an expense type, you will be asked to maintain expense amount and tax code. -Enter memo for the item at Description->Additional Remarks field.-Click on Next, navigate to step 3: Attachments.-Add attachments if necessary.-Click on Next, navigate to step 4: Review.-Confirm the information of this expense report and click Finish.-Go to Project Management work center -> Invoice Preparation view -> Not Invoiced Time and Expenses subview.-Search for the project YYY and click Edit Time and Expense.-Find the item created from expense report YYY.-In Description column, the content is not what you maintained in expense report YYY.-Cause-Description in Not Invoiced Time and Expenses is related to expense type chosen in expense report.-Content maintained in expense report's Description->Additional Remarks field will be shown in Note field in Not Invoiced Time and Expenses.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Project Invoice Request; Expense Report; Description; Note; Expense Type

Title: Adding Distribution List as an IT Contact
Content: Symptom-You want to add the Distribution list as an IT contact.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-IT contact can be created for one specific user e-mail ID either by Assigning User to new contact or Assign to existing contact (existing Business User) in the system as well as you can assign new contact where you can mention the distribution list e-mail ID.-Keywords-Distribution list as an IT contact, e-mail ID, byd, c4c

Title: Down Payment Request Not Appears in Purchase Order Document Flow
Content: Symptom-You create a Down Payment Request based on a Purchase Order. -However, in purchase order's document flow, you cannot see the down payment request neither under standard view nor extended view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Create a new purchase order YYY and order it.-Open Supplier Invoicing work center.-Create a new down payment request MMM and link it to purchase order YYY by maintaining "Order ID" field at Item tab.-Post down payment request MMM.-Check purchase order's document flow on header level.-There is no down payment request MMM neither under standard view nor extended view.-Cause-This is a normal system behavior. -Down payment request is directly linked to supplier invoice, and supplier invoice is linked to purchase order. This means down payment request should be attached to purchase order via supplier invoice. -If there is no supplier invoice linked to both down payment request and purchase order, down payment request will not show up in purchase order's document request.-Resolution-In order to see down payment request in purchase order's document flow, you need to create and post supplier invoice for the purchase order.-Note: down payment request should be paid first otherwise supplier invoice cannot be posted.-Keywords-Down Payment Request; Purchase Order; Supplier Invoice; Document Flow; Down Payment

Title: Change Immediately Option is not available for Project Activities
Content: Symptom-Change Immediately option is not available for Activities in your Project under Overview view in Business Configuration workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to Overview view.-Select Open Activity List.-Select any activity e.g. Quantities and Units of Measure.-Cause-In the given scenario the reported tenant is a Test System and it is connected to Productive System and there is already a change project copied from Productive system and this change project is the main workspace.-Resolution-If you want to perform any changes to a fine tuning activity, then activity should be added to the change project and then you can perform the changes.-Note: Saved changes will be visible only in the Test system until you trigger merge. After merge, changes will reflect in production system.-See Also-Keywords- Change Immediately, Business Configuration, Activity, C4C, BYD

Title: Business Role Report Shows Incorrect Access Restriction for User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--When executing a report that uses the data source "All Business Roles", the access restriction for a work center is not displayed correctly.-For example, a business role that has unlimited read and write access may be showing as only unlimited read.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics WoC.-Navigate to the Design Reports view.-Search for the report with data source "All Business Roles" and open it.-Filter for a specific business role identifier.-Click on Apply.-In the report view, check for the work center mentioned by the customer.-It is possible to see that the report is not showing the same access rights of the business role that is being used in the system.-Note: In Business ByDesign, you can check the business role configuration going to the Application and User Management work center, Business Roles view.-In Cloud for Customer, you can go to the Administrator work center, General Settings view and click on Business Roles.-Cause-This issue is caused by changes that were made in the business role that were not synchronized in the user policies. Generally these changes are made via background run, but no update run is performed to synchronize the user policies to the new business role policies.-Resolution-Kindly inform the customer to create a user update run for the business role in question with the UI action:-Go to Application and User Management.-Go to General Settings.-Click on Business Roles -> XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Business Role).-Click in View All.-Click in Assigned Users and click to Update Users.-Keywords-Incorrect Access Restriction, Business Role, C4C, BYD, data source

Title: Warehouse Confirmation Journal Entry Posted With 0,00 Debit Side Only
Content: Symptom-You have posted warehouse confirmation and in the journal entry, you only see debit posting with 0,00 and no credit posting and not even with 0,00.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Select the source document and view the journal entry.-Sample:-Inventory - Finished Goods A/c Debit 0,00-Gain/Loss -Inventory A/c Debit 0,00.-Cause-Purchase order priced zero and the net value of the PO is zero.-Material used in the purchase order has its inventory cost rate maintained as zero.-Perpetual cost is  maintained as standard cost.-Resolution-When the Purchase Order has zero value and material cost is also zero then the postings are expected to be like this.-Generally if material cost is different from purchase order cost then the difference account is hit. But here both the Purchase Order cost and material cost is zero.-This is in case of standard cost though. If it is moving average then inventory gets revaluated. But here the cost rate maintained for the material and PO price is zero.-If this is the case then the posted are as expected above.-Keywords-warehouse confirmation posted with zero balance, no credit posting-no credit posting for warehouse confirma,warehouse confirmation zero posting

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run is Not Showing any Postings for Purchasing Document
Content: Symptom-Not able to view the postings for GR/IR Clearing Run for a specified Clearing Set.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to GR/IR Clearing subview.-Search for GR/IR Clearing Run ABC (ABC means the GR/IR Clearing Run ID).-Click Log Result.-Go to the Postings tab.-Here you can see that there are no postings for this run.-Cause-The root cause for this issue is that when performing the GR/IR Clearing Run for previous fiscal year and the documents clearing dates are outside the scope for the clearing.-This could be due to the Non-Calendar Fiscal Year issue, and check the configuration  following the below steps:-Navigate to General Ledger work center-Choose Set of books and assigned companies sub view-Select the company and click on open and close period-Example:-When following the Non-Calendar Fiscal Year, which is from April to March, and 2015 is the current fiscal year. Now when executing a GR/IR Clearing Run for the period 012.2014 assuming that this covers March 2015.-The relevant supplier invoice and goods and service receipt are posted in March 2015. This however, in line with the fiscal year definition, corresponds to period 012/2015 instead of 012/2014.-Fiscal Year: 2014-001/2014 = April 2013-012/2014 = March 2014-The purchase order posting is done later to this and this GR/IR Clearing Run will not clear this purchase order because you are trying to perform GR/IR Clearing for the period 012.2014.-As per the rule to perform the GR/IR Clearing: if the clearing period is not the same as the current fiscal period then the system will then get the last posting day for the clearing period for 2014 fiscal year, meaning 31-03-2014.-Resolution-Need to create a GR/IR Clearing Run for the current fiscal period (012.2015). Postings then will be generated accordingly.-See Also-Help Documents:-GR/IR Clearing Quick Guide.-Marked Final Clearing Date for Purchasing Document Items.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing Run; no postings-gr/ir clearing run,no postings

Title: Bank Account ID Cannot Be Changed
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change or edit the Bank Account ID which is already assigned in the bank master data.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to My Banks View.-Select the My Bank ID XYZ (XYZ represents the My Bank ID).-Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Here you see Bank Account id is grayed out. You are not seeing any option to edit.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign system, bank account is considered master data, so once it's created, it cannot be deleted or either changed.-The bank account ID is unique key that cannot be changed once it's saved, either from frontend or backend.-Resolution-System behavior is as designed.-In case you want to have a different Bank Account ID for this bank account, you can edit the bank account, and in the Bank Accounts tab of the bank master data, select the bank account item and choose Actions-> Close this Bank Account, and create a new bank account with the correct bank account ID.-Keywords-Bank Account, ID, Change.

Title: Recorded Time Not Shown In Report
Content: Symptom-You are using a report based on data source Employee Recorded Times (technical ID: HCMTLMB07).-You may notice that for some employees, the key figure Employee Recorded Time shows incomplete or missing values.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Run a report based on data source Employee Recorded Times (for example, Recorded Employee Times)-Display the characteristics Employee and the key figure Employee Recorded Time.-Recorded times ares not visible in the data source and the report, respectively-Cause-This key figure only shows duration-based time recordings.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Time Recording or Time Sheet view.-Find an employee for whom the recorded time is missing.-Click the Open Time Sheet button.-Go to the Review and Correct tab.-Select a date row with a time recording that is missing in the report.-Check if the field Hours is populated.-If the hours column is not filled, then the key figure Employee Recorded Time does not show any values in the report.-Resolution-Currently the report Recorded Employee Times based on the data source HCMTLMB07 shows only duration-based time recordings and doesn’t show time recordings based on Start and End time.-Make sure to maintain values in the Hours field (duration) when completing your time recording. Note that the Quantity field is filled automatically, if you enter a start and end time, but for duration-based time recording you need to maintain a duration.-Alternatively, you can retrieve time recordings without the hours in your report by displaying the characteristics Start Time and End Time in the report.-Or you can create a new report based on data source: HCMTLMU01 (Employee Times).-Note: We have explored the technical feasibility for this requirement, but changing the design would mean severe impact on the performance of the reports, hence we cannot address this requirement currently. We will explore the possibilities of this requirement in future releases.-Additional Characteristics of this report:-For Vacation time type also, the key figure Employee Recorded Time does not show any values. This means even if you fill the Duration field for the vacation (time types such as Absent, Leave, etc.), the key figure Employee Recorded Time will not show any value. This report is not designed to show the recorded hours for Vacation time type.-The report shows duration-based times even if they are canceled. To distinguish between active and canceled time recordings, you may add the Status field to the report.-If you have a requirement to compare the status of the time recording between the report and the time File of the employee, then compare the Status field in this report to the Approval Status field in the Time File. Status field is actually a consolidated status derived from Life Cycle Status and Approval Status.-Keywords-recorded employee times, HCMTLMB07, HCMTLMB07_Q0001, duration, working hours, erfasste mitarbeiterzeiten, missing times, reporting

Title: Purchase Order With Free-Text Item of Type Expense is Un-Posted Due to Error Message: Cannot Find Account Determination Group For Product Category XYZ
Content: Symptom-You noticed that a Purchase Order with a free-text item of type Expense is showing up under Unposted Source Documents list with the error message Cannot find account determination group for product category XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the product category).-However, when you go to the fine tuning activity Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories aiming to maintain an account determination group for the respective product category you realize that is only possible to maintain it for Materials and Services. There's no option to maintain an account determination group for expenses.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents list.-Select the row of the respective purchase order.-Notice the error message: Cannot find account determination group for product category XYZ.-Cause-When you create a service in Business ByDesign you have the option to flag it as an Expense, so it is treated as an expense for financial purposes.-When you create a purchase order with a free-text item (no Product ID given) and Item Type Expense, the system understands it as a service flagged as expense.-For this reason the system requires you to maintain a Default Account Determination Group for Services for the concerned Product Category.-Resolution-You should maintain a Default Account Determination Group for Services for the respective Product Category in fine tuning activity Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories, option Edit Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories.-To maintain Account Determination Group for Product Categories, Please follow below steps.-Go to the Business configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open activity list.-Go to Fine tune tab.-Show All Activities.-Search for Default Account Determination Group for Product Categories.-Click Open.-Maintain a Default Account Determination Group for Services for the respective Product Category.-After saving your changes you should be able to post the Purchase Order.-Keywords-purchase, order, expense, type, not posted, un-posted, error, cannot, find, account, determination, group, product, category, default

Title: System Trigger Incorrect Approver When you set the Condition Total Net Value Change Percentage
Content: Symptom-You have created an approval process for purchase order with condition Total Net Value Change Percentage. However when you create a purchase order, system triggers incorrect approver. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant purchase order.-Select Edit and navigate to Approval tab.-System triggered an approval process with incorrect approver.-Cause-The condition Total Net Value Change Percentage will be used in the Purchase Order Header Re-approval scenario only and you can set a condition for re-approval. You can specify a percentage and if the net value of purchase order changes and the change meets the percentage criteria then the re-approval is triggered.-Resolution-To make use of the condition Total Net Value Change Percentage, the purchase order must be sent to supplier at the first place. Later, if you do any changes to the ordered purchase order document, system will trigger an approval process. In such cases or scenario, you can use the condition Total Net Value change percentage. -Note: -You can refer to the help document - Purchase Order Approvals and make use the below Conditions. -The following conditions can be used for approvals-For Purchase orders-- Supplier Classification-- Supplier Hierarchy Node-- Entry Method-- Process Type-- Account Assignment Changed-Purchase Order Item-- Supplier-- Company-- Product Category-- Net Value Change-- Percentage Change in Net Value-You can set a condition while selecting the approval rules to determine if a change in the purchase order items value by a certain percentage, should trigger an approval or not.-- Percentage Change in Quantity-- Account Assignment Changed-Purchase Order Header Re-approval-Total Net Value change percentage-You can set a condition for re-approval. You can specify a percentage and if the net value of purchase order changes and the change meets the percentage criteria then the re-approval is triggered. -Keywords-Condition Total Net Value Change Percentage; Purchase Order Header Re-approval; Total Net Value Change Percentage

Title: Cannot Migrate Price List When the Price List is Too Huge
Content: Symptom-You are going to migrate price list by using the migration tool, but system gives an application error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for activity Migration of Price Lists.-Open it and open the migration tool.-Select the migration file and click Execute Migration Step by Step.-In the Simulation step, you get error: Application Error or Service Call Failed error.-You are not able to migrate the price list into system.-Cause-Issue is caused by memory error in backend when uploading huge price list via the migration workbench.-Resolution-Workaround is to use the Excel Add-in to upload the price lists.-Solution:  3 Step Process-Download and install of ByD excel Add-in and install-Download  price list template and fill the data and upload Template-Upload Data via excel.-Detailed Steps:-Download and install of ByD excel Add-in-Go to Application and User Management work center-> Download Center -> SAP Add-in for Microsoft Excel-Steps to download price list upload Template-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center -> Pricing view -> Select Price List in pricelist dropdown -> click Download button to get the price list template.-Steps to Upload Data via excel.-Click on login option and enter the following details in the popup.-Change URL details: https://  Customer system URL -> Enter Login with user credentials -> Enter Data and click on  Save Data to  option.--Note: For optimum perfomance, the number of line items on the price list are best limited to around 10000 or less.-This applies to the Excel Upload, the Data Migration and also the releasing or cancelling of price and discount lists.-See Also-Related case documents:-2121972  - Dump While Filtering  the Number of Items in the Price List-2614379 - Error Faced During Price List Upload-3079750 - Error When Downloading, Extracting or Querying Price List or Discount List-2919441 - You are Not Able to Cancel the Release of a Price List or Discount List-Keywords-Price List,  Migration, Line Items, 10000, 10.000, performance, 500, Excel

Title: No Certificate for e-mail address XYZ found OR No Email received after Clicking Forgot Password link
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer clicks on “Forgot Password link” but does not receive the e-mail.-Error Message "No Certificate for e-mail address XYZ found"-Environment-SAP Coud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click Forgot Password link in Log on Screen.-System will prompt you to provide security code which will sent to registered e-mail ID-E-mail is not received-Cause-One possible cause is a BC configuration in settings. If encryption is maintained then the corresponding user must have the required certificate associated with him. If not, then he will not receive the e-mail.-Resolution-Take a trace in SLG1 T-code to check if e-mail was sent to specified e-mail address.Below are detailed steps to take trace.-Log on into the backend of the system through STFK-Open the transaction SLG1-Select the parameters as follows: Object: AP_IAM      Subobject: SELFSERVICE-Select a timeframe that includes the time the attempt was made on Time Restriction-Click on the Execute button or press F8-If you find that the e-mail is not sent with error "No certificate for e-mail address XXXXXX"-  Ask customer to Change "S/MIME Encryption for Password Reset E-Mails" in BC fine tune settings for "'E-Mail Encryption & Signature Check" to "Encrypt if possible or do not encrypt", to do this, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Overview-Search for the activity "E-Mail Encryption and Signature Check"-In the new screen change the Encryption type to Encrypt if possible for the Outbound Email for Email Scenario "S/MIME Encryption for Password Reset E-Mails"-      See Also-3325841 - Error No Certificate for e-mail address XYZ found while resetting the Password for a User-2135939 - Accessing the Logs for the Attempts of Usage of the Password Reset Self-Service Feature-See also: SAP Cloud for Customer Security Guide-Keywords-E-Mail Encryption and Signature Check, No Certificate, No Certificate for e-mail address XYZ found

Title: GSTR-2: Taxable Custom Duty Invoice is not Picked for the VAT as Expected
Content: Symptom-You create a GST Return-2 XXX for India and a taxable Custom Duty Invoice is not picked for the VAT as expected.-(Here XXX means the GST Return ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns -> VAT Returns view.-Open Tax Return ID XXX and click View All.-Go to the Tax Return tab.-Click Details button.-The Custom Duty Invoice you expected to be picked for this Tax Return is not showing in the list.-Cause-The Tax Return ID XXX has Tax Return Type set as 16 - GSTR-2 / GST ANX-2.-You can see the Tax Return Type being used on the GST Tax Return following these steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the GST Returns view-Select Tax Return ID XXX.-Click Run ID YYY (YYY is the Tax Return Run ID).-Under area Tax Return Details you can see Tax Return Type: 16 - GSTR-2 / GST ANX-2.-According to the SAP Business ByDesign 2005 Release (May, 2020), Custom Duty Invoice will be picked for GSTR -1.-Simplified GST Return Changes:-In addition to the existing GSTR1 and GSTR2 tax returns, you can now generate the GST ANX-1 and GST ANX-2 reports on the basis of the documents associated to inward and outward supplies. The GST ANX-1 and GST ANX-2 reports are part of an upcoming legal change. The import relevant tax events are now mapped to the GST ANX-1 return, hence, while submitting the GSTR1, you’ll have to manually remove the import relevant tax events from the excel generated.-Resolution-You need to execute GSTR-1 to include the Custom Duty Invoice as the import relevant tax events are now mapped to the GST ANX-1 return.-Keywords-GSTR2, GSTR1, Invoice is missing GST return, GST Return India, Custom Duty Invoice is missing in VAT, Tax Return, Invoice included in GST

Title: Reconciliation Report Shows Error: Accounting and logistic inventories differ: Material ABC Business residence DEF (GHI)
Content: Symptom-When executing the reconciliation report, error message 'Accounting and logistic inventories differ: Material ABC Business residence DEF (GHI)' is displayed.-ABC means the Material ID.-DEF means the Business Residence ID.-GHI means the Business Residence description.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Reconciliation view.-Select the Reconciliation Report which shows error and click Log Result.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-Error message: Accounting and logistics inventories differ: material ABC busines resid DEF (GHI)-Cause-There are some documents of type 55 - Goods and activity confirmation and 94 - Production Confirmation not posted in accounting.-To check this, follow the below mentioned steps:-Navigate to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Click Advance and select Related Source Document Type as 55 - Goods and Activity Confirmation and 94 - Production Confirmation not posted in accounting.-Click Go and select the appropriate row.-In the messages area of the screen, the error message is displayed: "Account determination is missing for position type Physical Inventory / Inventory Differences. Specify account determination in chart of accounts LMN and account determination profile OPQ Column Path Inventories->Physical Inventory->Loss from Inventory Diff..., Position Type Physical Inventory / Inventory Differences."-LMN means the Chart of Accounts.-OPQ means the Account Determination Profile.-Due to this Unposted Source Document, the Inventory Difference in accounting and logistic inventories occurred.-Resolution-To resolve this error, the maintained Account Determination Group for each material appearing in the error message must be identified:-Step 1.-Navigate to the Product Portfolio work center.-Select Products -> By Materials view.-Show All materials and search for the material ABC.-Click material ID to open and view.-Click View all and Navigate to Valuation.-Here, the Account Determination Group maintained for material ABC can be found.-Step 2:-Go to the Business configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List and navigate to Fine Tune.-Search for activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Inventories under the Account Determination section of screen.-Select Account determination profile OPQ.-Go to Physical Inventory sub tab.-Maintain the appropriate data for the Account determination Groups found in the Step 1.-Follow Step 1 and Step 2 for all materials appear in the Reconciliation report error message:  Accounting and logistics inventories differ: material ABC busines resid DEF.-After maintaining the data please follow the below steps to post the unposted source documents:-Navigate to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Click Advance and Select Related Source Document Type as 55 - Goods and Activity Confirmation and 94 - Production Confirmation not posted in accounting.-Click Go and select the appropriate row.-Click Action and select Post Business Transaction.-Once Source document is posted successfully, execute the Reconciliation again.-Keywords-reconciliation run; materials; inventory; accounting; logistics; gac; goods and activity confirmation

Title: How to check Customer's System CMP Downtime.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-"Image/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) is the 4 hours of reserved downtime during which SAP deploys Hotfixes, Emergency Patches and other Maintenance Activities every week.-NOTE: Maintenance Window of 4 hours is taken for both Test and Production Tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-The downtime of any system can be found by following the below steps:-Go to Service Provider Cockpit (SPC).-Go to Cloud Landscape.-Go to System View.-Enter the System Name and click Go.-Select the System and click Downtime.-The Downtime of the System can be seen on the right-hand side of the screenshot.-Keywords-CMP, Contractual Maintenance Period, Customer System-cmp,cmp (contractual maintenance period)

Title: Sales Quote is not appearing in Project Document Flow
Content: Symptom-Sales Quote is not appearing in Project Document Flow however it is available in the Sales quote assignment section.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Find XYZ (XYZ represents the project ID)-Click Edit - Project Plan.-Go to the Sales Tracking tab.-Go to Document Flow  subtab.-Cause-Technically there is no any reference between the Project and Sales Qoute, Project documents flow is the mirror object of Sales Order document flow.-After releasing a Sales Order the Sales Quote will be show in the Project document flow as well as in the Sales Order document flow.-Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: Unable To Find Organizational Data Update After Rehiring An Employee
Content: Symptom-You want to rehire an employee to update his/her organizational assignment, but unable to find the organizational data update after rehiring.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.-2. Go to Regular Task view.-3. Select Rehire Employee.-4. From the value help select the terminated employee.-5. Fill required fields and set the Hire Date the day after the last termination date.-6. Select Save button.-Save the data without error, but you are unable to find the updated data under the employee personnel file.-Cause-Another new entry with the same employee ID will be created after rehiring. The reason for the issue might be that only active employees are shown by default and you are checking the previous record.-Resolution-1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.-2. Select Employees view.-3. Select All Employees from the dropdown list.-4. Search for the employee.-Multiple entries (two entries if you rehire the employee in the first time) for the same employee can be found.-Keywords-Rehire employee, Organizational Data

Title: Temporarily Making The Tenant Unavailable For Use
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer wants to make their Live tenant unaccessible for few days.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If you receive any case with a request to make the system unavailable, then kindly open an incident with the operations team with the below details:-For this request 2-3 days prior information is needed so that provisioning team can take necessary approvals.-Time frame from which the tenant needs to be unavailable.-End date to revert the changes.-Note:-The status of the tenant after it's unavailable for use will be "Live" only.-Upon trying to access, a maintenance window will appear which shows that the tenant is currently not available to use.-See Also- 3396460 - How to Forward a Customer Case to Operations/ Hosting/ Provisioning team-Keywords-tenant unavailable, tenant unaccessible, maintenance window.-tenant unavailable,temporarily tenant unavailable

Title: Expense Report's Approver is not Determined When Costs are Assigned to Free Cost Objects
Content: Symptom-You assign an expense report's costs to a free cost object, however no approver is determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Find the concerned expense report and open it.-You notice that no approver is determined.-Cause-In your expense report's approval process, you have defined work distribution as e.g. Approver of Highest Cost. The approval determination for free cost objects is not possible because there is no manager assignment to this kind of cost object.-Resolution-To determine an approver in such cases, you may either use standard cost centers, instead of free cost objects, or use approval determination based on the reporting line unit of the traveler. For that, please follow below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Approval Process subview.-Use the Line Manager of Employee as the Work Distribution ﻿on the approval process rule for expense reports. Note that you have to create a new rule in order to set up data.-Having the expense report approval rule set based on the reporting line unit of the traveler, means that the approval task is triggered to claimer's line manager no matter how the costs are allocated.-Keywords-Expense Report Approval, Business Task Management, Expense Report

Title: GSTIN of Supplier and GSTIN of Receiver Fields are Blank in GSTR Return Form
Content: Symptom-You are not able to view data for GSTIN of Supplier and GSTIN of Receiver fields in GSTR return form excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Go to the VAT Returns subview.  -Show All Tax Returns.-Open the Tax Return ID XX and click on View All.-Go to Tax Return tab.-Click on Export -> To Microsoft Excel.-Here, you can see that the data for GSTIN of Supplier and GSTIN of Receiver fields are blank.-Cause-The reason is that you have assigned Tax Reporting Unit to multiple Tax Authorities. One tax authority is GST registered i.e, GSTIN is maintained and in the other tax authority, GSTIN is not maintained.-During the GST return creation, system checks for the Tax Reporting Unit and finds the one where GSTIN is not maintained.  Hence, GSTIN is showing blank in the excel.-Resolution-You need to assign one Tax Reporting Unit (TRU) to only one tax authority.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangement sub view.-Select Tax Authority XYZ and select Edit-> Company Tax Arrangements.-Select respective Company and click on Assigned Tax Reporting Units.-Maintain different Tax Reporting Unit as per your requirement.-You need to run the report again to view the GSTIN details in the excel.-Keywords-GSTIN of Supplier, GSTIN of Receiver, Tax Reporting Unit

Title: Unexpected Approval Task for Time Recording on Project
Content: Symptom-The employee XYZ (where XYZ represents the Employee ID) has recorded times against the project DEF (where DEF represents the Project ID).-In the project, for the project task on which the times have been recorded, the time recording rule is set to No Approval Required.-After being released, the status of these time recordings changed to In Approval, but you expected them to be in status Active.- or-Service agent records some times on project task and releases them. You find that these times are always sent to the project manager for approval even Mandatory Time Approval is not selected for the project in Project Management.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-A.Steps to check status of Time Recording in project.-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Select the Edit button.-Select the Project Plan tab.-Select the relevant Project Task.-Select the Basic Data sub tab.-Note that the status of Time Recording in project is set as No Approval Required.-2.Steps to check status of the Time Recording in the employee time sheet.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Select the relevant Employee.-Navigate to Employee Times.-You can see that, time entries are still waiting for Approval.-Cause-Cause 1:If an employee records times on a project on which the employee is not staffed(Non team member) (neither directly nor indirectly), then the time is sent for approval.-An employee is staffed on a project if their name or org unit is maintained under Team and Staffing in the project. This org unit needs to be a functional unit, meaning it needs to have at least 1 function assigned to it.-Cause 2:The services under work tab of the child project task are not marked as billable however in the header task under Accounting tab you have marked the Billable field.-Cause 3:The Mandatory Time Approval setting is relevant for time recordings of internal employees only.-Casue 4:For the Project task, you have set the flag for Mandatory Time Approval .-Resolution-Since Project manager must be notified for various below reasons in general thus system is developed to send for approval.-Solution 1: To avoid employees from recording times against projects to which they are not assigned .  However you can go to Project header task-> project settinsg tab and choose  No aproval required against option 'NonTeam members'.-Solution 2: Non billable time recordings are done.-Solution 3: Service agents does the time recording thus it goes for approval.-Solution 4: Steps to unmark Approval required  for Time Recording in project task:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Select the Edit button.-Select the Project Plan tab.-Select the relevant Project Task.-Select the Basic Data sub tab.-Choose No Approval Required.-See Also-2600134 - Project Time Recording Posted Without Approval-Keywords-wrong; incorrect; approver;No approval required;Non billable going for approval; time  recording going for approval;Time confirmation ;times Service agent

Title: New Tax Rate Schedules for Switzerland
Content: Symptom-As per the legal change for Switzerland effective from January 1 2024, three new tax rate types (‘Special Standard’, ‘Special Reduced’ and ‘Special Special’) have been introduced.-The new tax boxes that are introduced for tax reporting of documents created with the new tax rates are 303B, 303T, 313B, 313T, 343B, 343T, 383B and 383T.-You want to use these tax rate types before 01.01.2024. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Note: SAP will provide the new tax rates directly in SAP Business ByDesign as of 01.01.2024.-However, it is possible to use the new tax rate types before 01.01.2024:-Additionally,-you need to create custom tax codes to assign the new tax rate types and-you need to assign the new tax rate types to the corresponding tax events and form boxes.-Step 1: Find the three new tax rate types in Fine Tuning: -In the Business Configuration workcenter access the Tax on Goods and Services fine-tune activity (either from the activity list of your implementation project or from the Overview screen). -Choose Define Tax Rate Schedules. -Since system version 2311, you find the three tax rate types 7 - Special Standard (8,1%), 8 - Special Reduced (2,6%) , 9 - Special Special (3,8%), all valid from 01.01.2018. (The earlier validity since 2018 is used to make the tax rates types available before 01.01.2024). -The tax rate percentages can be adjusted in the future if need be. -Step 2: Create Custom Tax Codes and assign the new tax rate types: -Stay in the Tax on Goods and Services fine-tune activity.-Under Tax Codes choose Define Tax Codes.-Press Add row.-Now set up a new tax code, starting with a letter for CH-Switzerland and the tax event of your choice.-In the Details table underneath you can assign the tax type, one of the new tax rate types and maintain the tax deductibility. -Proceed like this for all new tax codes. -Step 3: Set up the Summary Layout - Assign the tax rate types to the tax events and form boxes: -Access the Tax Returns for Goods and Services - Switzerland &Liechtenstein fine-tune activity (either via the activity list from your Implementation project or from the Business Configuration Overview). -Choose Product Tax Rerturn Switzerland. -Choose the Tax Event tab.-Select the used tax event.  -Under Summary Layout set up the respective tax rate type, percentage, validity and assign one of the new form boxes (303B, 303T, 313B, 313T, 343B, 343T, 383B and 383T).  -Add further tax rate types if suitable. -Proceed accordingly for all the tax events used for the newly created tax codes. -Keywords-Tax Rates; Steuersatztabellen, Switzerland, Tax Rate Schedules

Title: Error: Amount XYZ too high; only ABC open for cash location DEF
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Journal Entry Voucher for Cash and when clicking on Save, system shows the following error:-Amount XYZ too high; only ABC open for cash location DEF.-(Here XYZ  and ABC refers to amount, DEF refers Bank Account)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center-Go to Journal Entries View.-Go to Journal Entry Vouchers Sub-View.-Click on New -> Journal Entry Voucher.-Select the Journal Entry Type as 00083 - Manual Entry for Cash.-Select the Screen Variant as 636 - Manual Write-Up/Write Down for Cash.-Add a Debit amount for the respective G/L Account and link it to the Bank Account.-Complete the necessary details.-Click on Post button.-System displays the error Amount XYZ too high; only ABC open for cash location DEF.-Cause-The amount being posted as Debit for the respective G/L Account would make the G/L Account Balance positive.-System doesn't allow the G/L Account Balance going from negative to positive in a single transaction.-You can check the G/L Account Balance in the following report:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Reports View.-Search and open the report Cash - Trial Balance.-Complete the parameters as per respective Company, Set of Books, Accounting Period, G/L Account, Bank and Bank Account.-Report shows the Total Balance of respective G/L Account for that Bank Account.-The Journal Entry Voucher you are trying to create would make the balance positive and that is why the error is triggered.-Resolution-To post the full amount, it's necessary to perform 2 steps:-Create a Journal Entry Voucher with the amount you have open for respective G/L Account for the Bank Account in the opposite sign. This procedure will make the total balance as zero.-Create a new Journal Entry Voucher with the remaining amount.-Keywords-Cash Location,  Journal Entry Voucher, G/L Account Balance, Amount

Title: How Checkbox Retain Manager Assignment Works?
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how checkbox Retain Manager Assignment works when transferring an employee who is a manager of an Org Unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Work Center.-Go to Regular Tasks View.-In Employment Changes section, select Transfer an Employee.-Fill the following fields: Employee, Transfer Date, Organizational Unit, Job.-You notice that a checkbox appears Retain Manager Assignment.-Resolution-When "A" (A means the Employee) is transferred to "X" (X means the Org Unit) with Retain Manager Assignments, it will still keep "A" as the manager of its previous org unit, and it will not automatically make "A" the manager of "X". To make "A" the manager of "X", it needs to be explicitly assigned as the manger from the Edit Org Structures UI.-The Retain Manager Assignment checkbox is only applicable to Managers, where previously this Action to Maintain the Manager of an Org unit after Transfer, would have been completed manually in the Organizational Management Work Center.-During the Transfer, when a Managing Employee is selected, then and only then will the "Is Manager For" section become Visible. This will also depend on when the Transfer occurs.-For example, if a Manager has a Validity of 01.12.2022, but you want to Transfer them from a date previous to this, then this functionality won't be available, as you wouldn't be transferring a Manager, who wasn't a Manager prior to that date.-For scenarios where the "Retain Manager Assignment" is switched on (Checkbox ticked), then when the Transfer is complete, they would also be the Manager of the New Org Unit and remain as Org Unit Manager for the previous one. So if for example, the Managing Employee has an Org Manager Validity period from 01.12.2022 - Unlimited in ORG X, and they are Transferred on 15.12.2022 to ORG Y, with this Checkbox Ticked, then they will be maintained as Manager for both.-As part of our standard process, the details will be displayed based on the Transfer date (I.e 15.12.2022 - Unlimited ORG X, 15.12.2022 - Unlimited ORG Y). But if 01.12.2022 is entered as the Transfer date (without saving, just to illustrate the point), then the previous Managerial Org Assignments would be displayed, which will tie in with what is visible in the Org Structure.-If this checkbox is left empty, then this would indicate that their intention for the person being Transferred, is for them not to be a Manager and therefore, these previous entries would be Delimited as of the Transfer date minus one day. For this, then there won't be any Retain Manager Assignment or Is Manager For section available, as they are no longer a Manager as of the Transfer date.-The information still remains the same as previous example. For example: the details are still available for periods where they were a Manager, for example, in the Transfer section, if you enter a Date that is on of between any validity period for when they were / are a Manager, then these sections for Retaining the Assignments etc, will become visible once again.-Note:-When you enable retain manager, In the Planning Area of Org unit it will be available but it will one day to reflect in the Active Area because the background job runs daily to sync the changes which is causing the delay.-See Also- Transfer an Employee-Keywords-Retain Manager Assignment, Transfer an Employee, Org Unit, Manager

Title: Business Configuration Set for Expense Type and Account Determination Group
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***RELEASED INTERNALLY*** -You are trying to do custom development in the Travel and Expense Report. For that, you need the Business Configuration Set for Expense Type and Account Determination Group.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-1.For usual expense types there is a BC set per country version.-The name / description of the BC Set is always-BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_nn_RT  RECEIPT TYPES NN where NN is the two letter country code.-For instance:-You have scoped following country versions: CA, CN, GB, MX, US, ZUAE.-So the following BC sets are relevant:-BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_CA_RT  RECEIPT TYPES CA-BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_CN_RT  RECEIPT TYPES CN-BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_GB_RT  RECEIPT TYPES GB-BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_MX_RT  RECEIPT TYPES MX-BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_US_RT  RECEIPT TYPES US-BC_A1S_FIN_RECPTYPE_XX_RT  RECEIPT TYPES XX-The last one with country code XX applies to Generic Country/Region Version ZUAE (AE United Arab Emirates).-2.The name of the BC node for mapping of Expense Types to Account Determination Groups is always-A1S_FIN_RECPTYPEERMC_ADG_ASS_2 Account Determination Group for Receipt Type-Runtime table is ERMC_ADG_ASSIGMT.-3.In addition there is a following BC sets:-For ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MILEAGE:-BC_A1S_FIN_FRADASSM_ADGMIL_CA ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MILEAGE CA-BC_A1S_FIN_FRADASSM_ADGMIL_CN ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MILEAGE CN-BC_A1S_FIN_FRADASSM_ADGMIL_GB ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MILEAGE GB-BC_A1S_FIN_FRADASSM_ADGMIL_MX ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MILEAGE MX-BC_A1S_FIN_FRADASSM_ADGMIL_US ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MILEAGE US-BC_A1S_FIN_FRADASSM_ADGMIL_XX ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MILEAGE XX-For ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MEALS: -BC_A1S_FIN_FRADASSM_ADGMEAL_XX  ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR MEALS XX-For ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR LODGING XX: -BC_ODT_FRADASSM_ADGLOD_XX  ACCOUNT DETERMINATION GROUPS FOR LODGING XX:-Node is always: A1S_FIN_FRADASSMERMC_FR_ADG_AS Account Determination Group for Reimbursement Rate Type-Runtime table is: ERMC_FR_ADG_ASSM.-You can copy the above data and inform customer the same according to their needs.-Keywords-custom expense reports. business configuration set. expense type. account determination group.

Title: How To Cancel a Supplier Invoice Cancellation
Content: Symptom-You are unable to cancel a posted Supplier Invoice Cancellation because the Cancel Document button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the Invoice Cancellation ID.-Click in Edit button.-You can see that the Cancel Document button is grayed out.-Cause-The system works as designed. A cancellation of a cancellation document is not possible.-Resolution-You can create a new Supplier Invoice from scratch by copying the original Supplier Invoice. Similar Logic applies for Customer invoices as well.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Cancel an Invoicing Document-SAP Help Portal: Canceling a Supplier Invoice-1467296 - Cancellation of a Cancellation Invoice-1888021 - Cancel Already Cleared Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Cancellation; Cancel

Title: 'Adding item not possible; accounts are already assigned' Error While Adding an Item to a Financial Reporting Structure
Content: Symptom-Error is raised while trying to add a new item to a Financial Reporting Structure:-'Adding item not possible; accounts are already assigned'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the respective Key ID reference and click Edit.-Under Financial Reporting Structure, expand the lines each one at a time until you reaches the first line which contains accounts assigned to it (Structure Elements: Accounts).-Select this line and click Add Item.-Error message is thrown:-'Adding item not possible; accounts are already assigned'-Cause-The error is displayed because the Add Item button was clicked.-Resolution-The correct way to include the new accounts created is via Actions -> Assign Account, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the respective Key ID reference and click Edit.-Under Financial Reporting Structure, expand the lines each one at a time until you reaches the first line which contains accounts assigned to it (Structure Elements: Accounts).-Select this line and click Actions -> Assign Account.-In the Assign Account popup window, select the desired account by marking the checkbox.-Click OK.-Save your changes.-Keywords-financial reporting structure; assign account; add item

Title: GSTR Tax Return Types
Content: Symptom-You have Tax Return Types 15 - GSTR-1, 16 - GSTR-2 and 17 - GSTR-3 and you want to know what data each report fetches when you use its Tax Return Arrangement ID and perform a VAT Return Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Open New, Tax Return Run.-Fill the required data like Tax Return Arrangement ID and From and To validity.-Click Set to Active and Schedule the run.-In the Tax Return that gets generated, you want to know based on what logic system is picking the data and what data you can expect.-Resolution-GSTR-2 - Supplier Invoices (Purchasing scenarios).-GSTR-1 - Customer Invoices (Sales scenarios).-System calculates the data from GSTR-1 and GSTR-2 and the reconciliation happen after that total pay/receivable gets calculated at GSTN level.-After that you need to run GSTR-3 to close particular tax lines in ByD system.-Currently, in the VAT Return Runs, you need to select the Tax Return Arrangement ID that you mapped for your GSTR-1, GSTR-2, GSTR-3 accordingly based on which run you want to execute.-See Also- 2943283 - GSTR-2: Taxable Custom Duty Invoice is not Picked for the VAT as Expected -According to the SAP Business ByDesign 2005 Release (May, 2020), Custom Duty Invoice will be picked for GSTR -1.-Simplified GST Return Changes:-In addition to the existing GSTR1 and GSTR2 tax returns, you can now generate the GST ANX-1 and GST ANX-2 reports on the basis of the documents associated to inward and outward supplies. The GST ANX-1 and GST ANX-2 reports are part of an upcoming legal change. The import relevant tax events are now mapped to the GST ANX-1 return, hence, while submitting the GSTR1, you’ll have to manually remove the import relevant tax events from the excel generated.-Keywords-GSTR, GSTR-1, GSTR-2, GSTR-3, Tax return types, VAT, India

Title: User is Not in The Access Group
Content: Symptom-User PQR  belongs to cost center ABC which is assigned to organization unit 456, but this user are not in the access group id 456.-(PQR represents the User ID, ABC represents the Cost Center ID and 456 represents the Organization Unit ID)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users View.-Search for the user PQR.-Click on the Edit  button and then the Access Right button.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-Select the CRM_OPPORTUNITYTABLEVIEW.-Go to the Detailed Restriction sub tab.-We can see that there are users, however it is missing the users PQR-Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Select the Org Structures View.-Search for org unit 456.-Navigate to Employees.-We can see the user PQR is assigned to this organization.-Cause-For the user, CRM_OPPORTUNITYTABLEVIEW view is not assigned in work center and view assignment, so that the user is not able to see the CRM_OPPORTUNITYTABLEVIEW in access restriction.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users View.-Search for the user PQR.-Click on the Edit  button and then the Access Right button.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Select the CRM_OPPORTUNITYTABLEVIEW.-Assign it to the user.-Save.-This will let the user be seeing in the Access Group.-Keywords- CRM_OPPORTUNITYTABLEVIEW; Access Right; Access Group

Title: Opening Balance of New Bank Statement Shows as Zero
Content: Symptom-You create a new bank statement in year YYYY.-The default opening balance shows in the new bank statement is zero.-However, this is not the first bank statement in system. The latest bank statement was created in year YYYY-2 which closing balance is not zero.-But the opening balance in new bank statement is not as the same as the closing balance of the latest one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center and select common task New Bank Statement.-The opening balance in new bank statement is not as the same as the closing balance of the latest one.-Cause-When a new bank statement is created, the system checks for the closing balance of the latest one created in the current year and shows the opening balance as the same as the closing balance of the latest one.-If system does not find any bank statement in the current year, it then looks for the latest one created in last year. If that fails, system will show the opening balance of new bank statement as zero.-Since in this case, the latest bank statement was created in the year before last year, so it shows the opening balance of new bank statement as zero in this case.-Resolution-You can manually change the opening balance to the same as the closing balance of the latest bank statement created in the year before last year in the new one.-Keywords-bank statement, opening, closing, balance

Title: Event AfterModify under AddressInformation Node is not getting triggered in SDK
Content: Symptom-You have tried modifying few fields in the AddressInformation tab but the AfterModify event is not getting triggered even though the fields are in the same BO node.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the solution and navigate to the relevant path.-Put a breakpoint in the AfterModify event of AddressInformationnode from Customer BO.-Login to UI.-Navigate to Customer work center.-Open any account and switch to Addresses tab.-Try to modify some standard address-related fields like Postal Code, Street, House Number, etc.-You can see that the debugger is not hit in the event AfteModify. -Also, the script is not triggered when updating the field on the account Quick Create (QC) screen.-Cause-A script on a node will only be called if fields of that node are changed or the association from that node is changed.--The data that you see on an account comes from a combination of different Business Objects (BO) + Dependent Objects (DO) in the backend. Address information itself is a regular node on the Business Partner BO. It doesn't hold any real Address information but holds just a pointer and data values to the actual DO (address snapshot) where the real address is stored.-When you do an update, changes are done to the snapshot but no changes are done to AddressInformation node as nothing relevant to this has changed i.e. it still points to the same snapshot instance. Hence, updating address will not call the AfterModify of AddressInformation node.-Resolution-You can create a BeforeSave event on AddressInformation node, which will then get triggered on save of the account, if address-related fields are changed.-Alternatively, if you want to have some logic which checks whether AddressInformation is filled, you may create an AfterModiffy script on Common node and once fields under this node (for example standard field Name or an KUT/PDI extension field) is updated, it will be executed.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, script, modifying, phone, number, does, not, trigger, event, after, modify, e-mail, e-mail, address, information

Title: Error Message Proposal discarded; Incoming Payment Data Missing for XYZ
Content: Symptom-You get the error message "Proposal discarded; Incoming payment data missing for XYZ" while performing a payment run (XYZ represents the Business Partner ID). -This scenario is valid for both Receivables and Payables.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Payment Runs sub view.-Perform the action New Payment Run.-Fill in the details and perform the action Schedule.-Perform Schedule Immediately.-The run is created with error message "Proposal discarded; Incoming payment data missing for XYZ".-The same applies if you run a New Payment Run from Payables Work Center.-Cause-The payment method, for internally initiated incoming payments maintained for Business Partner XYZ, is not supported in Payment Runs.-Resolution-The payment run supports the following standard payment methods for internally initiated incoming payments:-- Direct debit-- Credit card-Payment run will try to create payments for customer which is internally initiated incoming payments. The Payment Methods maintained in the Master data of the Business Partner XYZ does not contain any of the above methods. System behavior is correct. You need to maintain the correct payment method for the Customer or Supplier Account considered by the run and the memos will be processed accordingly.-In case, Direct debit is unavailable, please follow below steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project line.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the 4th option (Questions tab).-Expand Cash Flow Management.-Expand Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select the Payment Methods option.-Mark the checkbox on "Do you want to use direct debit to receive payments from your customers?"-Confirm the changes.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Messages in the Payment Run Application Log-Keywords-proposal discarded, incoming payment data missing, error, payment run, payables and receivables, Eingangszahlungsdaten fehlen für, Forderungen, Verbindlichkeiten, Zahlungslauf

After 5 attempts the user will be locked.-Resolution-Go to Application and user management.-Take any inbound communication arrangement for the respective system.-Go to view all.-Go to technical data.-Go to Edit Credentials.-You will be navigated to below screen shot, uncheck Password Locked and save changes.-    Keywords-Technical User, user locked, web service, communication arrangement

Title: How to Update Contact Details in the Service Control Center Work Center
Content: Symptom-When user try to change the contact details of person ABC (ABC represents the name of a user) , the contact details are not updated in the Contact Details view of the Service Control Center work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite: User have changed the contact details of the user ABC who is an active contact listed in the Contact Details view in the Service Control Center work center.-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Go to the Contact Details view.-Click the Filter icon.-Enter ABC to locate the user.-The contact details of user ABC are not updated automatically.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Go to the Contact Details view.-In the Filter icon , Enter user ABC in the Name column.-Select the Enter key.-a. To update the contact details when the user ABC has the status of the Administrator column set to "No".-Select Edit.-Update the desired field values.-Select Send Changes and Close.-b. To update the contact details when the user ABC has the status of the Administrator column set to "Yes".-Select Remove Contact Assignment.-Select Confirm in the Pop-Up window.-Select Create Contact Assignment.-Enter the desired details of the user ABC.-Select Send Changes and Close.-It may take up to 24 hours for contact details creations or changes to take effect.-Keywords-synchronization delay, update latency, change not reflected, update not visible, delayed update, reassign contact, recreate contact assignment, administrator contact update, manual update required, wait time 24 hours, SCC contacts update, contact record not syncing, name filter search, expected behavior update

Title: PriceSpecificationElementPropertyValue Property Not Available For OData Service Creation
Content: Symptom- "PriceSpecificationElementPropertyValue" property not available for OData service creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Application and User Management Work Center.-Select the OData Services View.-Change the dropdown to Customer OData Services and click on New.-Give the service a name and click on Save and Open.-Click on Select Business Object and select object SalesPriceList.-Expand Root -> PropertyValuation -> PriceSpecificationElementPropertyValuation -> PriceSpecificationElementPropertyValue.-Here you can see the mentioned fields, which cannot be included in the OData service.-Cause-The fields are not editable in the OData services even though they are publicly read released, is because the fields are not added to the Price Lists FSI view. The reason is that during the upgrade, select all query has to run to reload all the data from primary to secondary persistency and this results in an issue for tenants that have high volume price lists in their system, thereby impacting the upgrade.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-You can use the API web service instead.-Keywords-Odata;  Price Specification;

Title: Supplier Invoice Cancellation Cannot be Posted Due to Error Message: Asset XYZ val. view XXX: Acquisition cost negative
Content: Symptom-You try to cancel a supplier invoice ABC, but the supplier invoice cancellation document DEF is not successfully posted, and the system gives an error message:-An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ.-Asset XYZ val. view XXX: Acquisition cost negative;-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center > Source Documents view-Select Unposted Source Documents-You can find there is a source document DEF with the Source Document Type being 127 - Supplier Invoice.-Choose View Business Transaction. -You can see the Reversal Document field is set as Yes, and the error message is : Asset XYZ val. view XXX: Acquisition cost negative; An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ.-Cause-When the supplier invoice ABC is posted, a fixed asset XYZ is created. Before you cancel the supplier invoice ABC, a manual posting of acquisition cost of fixed asset XYZ is posted, which sets the acquisition cost of fixed asset XYZ to zero. So when you try to cancel the supplier invoice ABC, the system gives you an error message. It's thus not possible to cancel the original supplier invoice.-Resolution-In order to cancel the supplier invoice ABC, any manual postings to the related fixed asset XYZ after the initial acquisition should be reversed first:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center, and choose the Fixed Assets view.-Select the fixed asset XYZ and then Edit it.-Go to the Values tab, and then select the Journal tab.-Open the journal entry voucher of the manual posting of acquisition cost, and then Edit it.-Reverse it.-Go to General Ledger work center > Source Documents view-Select Unposted Source Documents.-Select the source document DEF, and choose View Business Transaction.-Choose Post, if the posting period is still open. But you may also choose Post to Another Period if account period is already closed.-The supplier invoice cancellation document DEF should be successfully posted.-Keywords-fixed asset, unposted document, supplier invoice, cancel, can't post

Title: Unable to create a to-stock purchase from a shopping cart
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to create a to-stock purchase from a Shopping Cart. The system does allow and however, in the subsequent Purchase Requests and Orders, it changes back to to Non-Stock type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view.-Go to Self-Services Overview subview.-Select the Go Shopping or Go Shopping (Advanced) link under the Shopping section.-In Step 3 Select Products with to-stock purchase.-The system does allow and however in the subsequent Purchase Request and Orders, it changes back to to Non-Stock type.-Cause-Shopping Cart for To-Stock material is not possible in the system, since this is use as employee level, for individual and immediate use, and in the Purchase Order the process type is to-stock as it allows buying items to use in production or for sale.-To buy a to-stock product, it is recommended to do it from the Purchase Request or directly from the Purchase Order.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Non-Stock, To-Stock, Purchase Order

Title: Error While Trying to Migrate Personnel Administration Data
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Personnel Administration Data via Migration Tool, however, you are facing the following Error Message:-COMPANY_UUID-CONTENT is missing-Company XYZ of position must be company of employment-XYZ means the Org Unit ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration WoC and then Overview View.-Search for the activity Migration of Employee Data.-Click Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool.-Select the file.-Click Execute Migration > Step by Step.-At the simulation step the error appears.-Cause-The Org Unit maintained to the Employee is not maintained properly in the Organization Management. Where the Org Unit XYZ is not a Business Residence, Cost center and Reporting Line Unit.-Resolution-An Org Unit must have these attributes to hire an Employee.-Keywords-Cannot, Unable, Not being able, Migrate, Migration, Migration of Employee Data, Employee Data, Org Unit, Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool, Execute Migration, COMPANY_UUID-CONTENT is missing, Company, of position must be company of employment.

Title: Error in VAT Return Run: Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident
