Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a VAT Return Run and in the final of the process you are getting the following error message 'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.-XYZ represents the code of the package ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Return Runs subview. -Search for the Run ID DEF (DEF represents the run ID).-Click in the Application log ID ABC (ABC represents the application log ID).-You will see the error message:-'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.-Cause-Dump is happening due to large amount of selected data being retrieved from the Tax Register Item node.-The VAT had an error due to lack of memory.-Resolution-There are some ways in which the issue can be handled:-Reduce the data selection of the VAT Return run. You can inform a smaller period in the From/To dates;-Or,-Use Aggregation Run-You can use the aggregation run functionality that creates multiple returns for the same run, one after the other to avoid huge data in a single return. For more information refer to the Blog Aggregation Tax Returns in SAP Business ByDesign -Keywords-VAT Return run, package, report an incident, dump

Title: "Negative Quantity not possible" Error in Recurring Invoice Template due to Negative Amount (Credit Memo) Items
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Recurring Invoice Template, you try to input a negative amount for an item in order to represent a Credit Memo item. However, error "Negative Quantity not possible" is raised and the Recurring Invoice Template becomes inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Under Common tasks, select New Recurring Invoice Template.-Enter the Account and relevant organizational information.-Enter a line item with a negative value in the amount.-The system will display error "Negative Quantity not possible".-Cause-The Recurring Invoice Template does not support Credit Memo (negative amount) items. Only Invoice items with positive amounts can be used.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Recurring Invoice Template, Recuring, Reocurring, Customer Invoice, Negative, Minus, Credit Memo, Line Item.

Title: Purchase Order's Item Status is not Returned in WebService
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-The user is using the webservice QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn because they want to check the Purchase Order's item status. However this information is not available in the webservice response. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Service Explorer view.-Select 'Query Purchase Orders'.-Click in 'Download WSDL' button. -Open SOAP UI.-Open the project and search for the Purchase Order query (QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn). -Fulfill the XML payload with the request needed.-Enter the user credentials.-Execute the request.-The user gets the response of the Webservice. The response does not mention the item's status for any of the items. Hence the user does not know if the item is cancelled or not. -Cause-The item's status is not shown in the webservice QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn. This information is not available. -Resolution-This is a limitation for the webservice QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn, but there is a workaround. -In service ManagePurchaseOrderIn, Read purchase orders, the user can only get the item status by searching PO ID/UUID.-In the response, the user can find very detailed item status, as showed below (e.g.):-<ItemStatus>-<PurchaseOrderItemLifeCycleStatusCode>10</PurchaseOrderItemLifeCycleStatusCode>-<PurchaseOrderItemApprovalStatusCode>1</PurchaseOrderItemApprovalStatusCode>-<CancellationStatusCode>1</CancellationStatusCode>-<DeliveryProcessingStatusCode>3</DeliveryProcessingStatusCode>-<InvoiceProcessingStatusCode>3</InvoiceProcessingStatusCode>-<InvoicingStatusCode>3</InvoicingStatusCode>-<OrderingStatusCode>3</OrderingStatusCode>-<PurchaseOrderConfirmationStatusCode>9</PurchaseOrderConfirmationStatusCode>-<PurchaseOrderDeliveryStatusCode>3</PurchaseOrderDeliveryStatusCode>-</ItemStatus>-Refraining that for ManagePurchaseOrderIn this can only be executed with PO ID/UUID, so the information returned is only for this specific ID (the user can’t query by time/product like in service QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn). -Keywords-Purchase Order; Query; WebService; Web Service; Item; Status; QueryPurchaseOrderQueryIn; ManagePurchaseOrderIn

Title: How to restart with our support user stuck messages 'Not first in queue or User account not in validity date or Business user locked
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You may come across some stuck messages in the backend where the sequence messages were already processed.-However the dependent messages were still showing in Not first in queue and Restart does not work.- or-You want to restart the messages where business user cannot be  unlocked or cannot extend the validity due to user no more with the organization-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to restart the messages only after getting permission from customer.-(Also take help of  Senior colleagues while  following this steps to avoid any misusage)-Select the message in Transaction: SRT _MONI in back end L6 authorization.-Click on 'Queue monitor 'button(symbol: truck)-Select and right click on the message having red traffic light-Select Unit Analysis -> Debug unit with current user. -You may see  debug screen opened, just close it.-You may see error or exceptions, just close it( if you see these, then  message will not be processed successfully may be they are stuck with different error)-You will see that message is vanished  if restart  helped to process the message.-Keywords-business user locked, user account not in validity date, not first in queue, locked, user, validity date, not first, queue

Title: Frequently Asked Questions - SAP Support Expert Chat - SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-SAP Support Expert Chat has been launched for SAP Business ByDesign and detailed steps explaining how to use this service is explained in the blog here.-What are the best practices and frequently asked questions while using Expert Chat with SAP Support for SAP Business ByDesign products?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. What is Expert Chat?-Expert Chat is a real-time support channel with live and direct access to an SAP Support Expert, creating a faster and more direct route to issue resolution.-More information can be found in the blog here. -2. When can expert chat be used?-For issues with medium or high priority.-To ask basic how-to questions.-To report a new product issue.-To request an update on an existing incident.-3. When should expert chat not be used?-For critical issues with very high priority.-To ask complex consulting questions.-To request a new feature.-4. Who can start Expert Chat?-Prerequisite: S-User registration is required to access chat. (This only needs to be done once and you can find more information in KBA 1271482.)-The key user of SAP Business ByDesign (one who has the view “Incidents” from the Workcenter Application and User Management /Administrator assigned) can start Expert Chat.-5. How and where to access Expert Chat?-Click the question mark in the upper right corner to open the Help Center.-Click the hyperlink "SAP Support Expert Chat".-6. Who will I be chatting with?-When you open a new chat session, you will be connected with the same support team as in the incident channel. There are no robots or automated responders.-7. What are the mandatory fields in the chat form to initiate an Expert chat?-Description – Enter the query / subject for which you want to initiate the chat.-Application Area -  Enter the concerned business area.-First & Last Name - Enter your First and Last Name.-E-mail Address - Valid business e-mail address which is maintained with the key user in the application.-Captcha. – Unique alphanumeric numbers. (To make sure you are not a robot.)-8. If the SAP Product Support Expert is not able to answer my question during the chat session, will I need to start the incident submission process again?-Anytime a chat is opened we will create a follow up incident for you that can be accessed through the SAP for ME. The incident includes the whole chat conversation and we will handle the incident like a normal incident if the issue was not solved in the chat.-9. Why do I receive an error message “We are sorry, there is currently no expert available to live chat with you in the area you have selected?”-Currently there may be no support expert available for the chat service in the application area you have selected. You may try later or send an incident instead.-10. Can I escalate or receive updates for existing incidents via Expert chat?-Yes, you can choose to contact our Customer Interaction Center (CIC) while opening a chat to discuss issues regarding already existing cases. To contact CIC navigate to the Services & Support tab and click Chat on the Contact the Customer Interaction Center (CIC) card.-11. Can I refer to the Expert Chat session information at a later time?-Yes, after every chat we will create a follow up incident in the SAP for ME for you where you can access the transcript of the chat.-12. Are there any technical restrictions to use Expert Chat (supported browser, security settings, etc.)? Which browsers are supported?-Yes, before starting Expert Chat, you need to make sure that several sites are allowed by company web access policy from any supported browser.-SAP Knowledge Base Article 2392095 describes all the requirements for a successful Expert Chat session including recommended firewall configurations and list of supported browsers.-13. Can I start multiple chat sessions on the same topic?-We do not limit the number of chat sessions. However, we recommend that you start only one chat session per problem or question. -14. Can I attach a document?-Yes. Expert Chat supports file attachment-15. Do I have an option to screen share with support in Expert Chat?-Yes, screen-sharing capability is available to improve support experience with this real-time support channel.-16. Do I need to provide my consent to the SAP Product Support Expert before screen sharing?-Yes, this is mandatory. The SAP product support team will always send a request for screen sharing and only post receiving the approval screen sharing will be initiated.-17. Do I need to install any software for screen sharing?-No. When you have agreed with the SAP Support Expert to start a screen sharing during the Expert Chat session, then you will be prompted to approve this request and will receive the "GenesysDX.exe" standalone application which carries out the screen sharing. The application "GenesysDX.exe" contains a security token for a single session.-18. During the screen sharing will the SAP Support Expert have access into documents, files and applications on my PC?-No. During the screen sharing session, the Support Expert will only be able to see your screen and has no access to your computer and system. You can pause or stop the screen sharing any time.-As a best practice close all the applications and documents are not related to your technical question (e-mail software, document, etc).-19. Do I have an opportunity to provide feedback/rate a session?-Yes, there is a customer satisfaction survey after the Expert Chat interaction. Please make sure that the popup windows are enabled in your browser.-See Also-Blog: Chat and SaE in built in support-Blog: How to use Expert Chat for your technical issues? Try this live support channel and solve your incident or technical problem nearly 2x faster!-Blog: Expert Chat – Now available for SAP Business ByDesign & SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-KBA: 1271482 - How does an administrator create or delete S-User IDs - SAP for Me-KBA: 2392095 - Requirements for a successful Expert Chat Session with SAP Product Support-Keywords-What is Expert Chat, When can expert chat be used, When should expert chat not be used, Who can start Expert Chat, access Expert Chat, Who will I be chatting with, mandatory fields, no answer in chat, "We are sorry, there is currently no expert available to live chat with you in the area you have selected", escalate incident, incident update, save chat session, technical restrictions Expert Chat (browser, security settings), multiple chat sessions, attach document, screen share,

Title: Groupware Logon Business Configuration Scoping Messages
Content: Symptom-You're trying to log in the Microsoft Outlook Add-In, but is getting one of the below messages:-SAP Business ByDesign - BC Scoping Error: Groupware is not scoped in for synchronization, the synchronization is not possible. Please change the scoping for synchronization to work.-SAP Cloud For Customer - The SAP Cloud For Customer Add-In for Microsoft Outlook has not been set up yet. Please ask your administrator to check the business configuration settings for the integration of local e-mail applications.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-The scoping questions for Groupware integration in Business Configuration were not completed successfully.-Resolution-Note: The screenshots are taken from SAP Cloud For Customer, but the options are the same in SAP Business ByDesign.-Please check if your scoping is correctly done according to the below requirements:-1. Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-2. Go to Implementation Projects.-3. Select your current project.-4. Click on Edit Project Scope button.-5. Navigate to Scoping phase by clicking Next.-6. Expand Communication and Information Exchange.-7. Expand Office and Desktop Integration.-8. Make sure the Microsoft Office Integration element is checked.-9. Advance to Questions phase.-10. Expand General Business Data.-11. Expand Business Partners.-12. Select Handling of Business Partners.-13. On the Questions for Handling of Business Partners pane expand Account Maintenance.-14. Make sure the following questions are checked:-a) Do you want to sync accounts and contacts in your solution with Microsoft Outlook?-b) Do you want to sync accounts and contacts in Microsoft Outlook with your solution?-15. Continue and complete the project edition process.-16. You should be able to log in the Add-In now.-See Also-Keywords-Groupware; Add-in; Add-on; Scoping; Scope; Connect; Login; Outlook; Logon; The underlying connection was closed; establish trust relationship

Title: Assignment Rules for Sales Order Items in Not Invoiced Time and Expenses
Content: Symptom-When you create an expense for your project you can see that the assignment rule is not automatically assigning this expense to the Sales Order item.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management.-Not Invoiced Time and Expenses.-Filter for All Active Customer Projects.-Search for the relevant project.-See that are some times and expenses not assigned to a sales order.-Click on Edit Times and Expenses.-Click on Edit Assignment Rules.-Select View All Rules.-See that a rule already exists.-Cause-The rule created has the Time and Expense Parameters as Service.-Resolution-In order to do the assignment for expenses please create a rule where the Time and Expenses Parameters is Material, then click on Apply Assigned Rules.-See the below screenshot:-See Also-Keywords-Project, Time and Expenses, Not Invoiced Time and Expenses, Sales Order, Time and Expense Type, Time and Expense Parameters

Title: Error in File Input Run For Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Unable to upload xml of supplier invoice because of error "[...] not processed; Issuer ID not found in the system". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to File Input view.-Show: Active Runs-Select run ID ABC (ABC is the run's ID). -Navigate to Execution Details subtab.-Open application log ID XYZ (XYZ is the latest log ID).-Navigate to Results tab. -You can see the description:-ABC.xml not processed; Issuer ID not found in the system (ABC is the name of the XML file). -Cause-There is mismatch between the data maintained in the XML and data maintained in the system. For example:-In the file -> Supplier's name: BUSINESS NAME CO-In the system -> Supplier's name: Business Name Co.-Resolution-Please maintain the data in the XML the same as the ones maintained in the system. Only then re-run the file input run.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Run; Mismatch; File Input

Title: Outbound Payment File is Not Consistent
Content: Symptom-You have observed that the Outbound File created is empty.-Logs shows that File Format e.g. APAY Z_HSBC is not consistent.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to File Management view.-Go to Outbound Files subview.-Show All Files and Find Outgoing File ID XYZ (XYZ represents the outgoing file ID).-Choose the File and Go to Attachment.-Choose Display Log.-Error message shows as File is not consistent.-Cause-One possible cause for this issue is that you have given Field Length for the field ADVICE-TEXT as 2 and ideally it should be 999.-It is also recommended that you maintain:-Field Length for Field Intermediary Bank Name should be 35.-Character Set Assignment as UTF-8.-Resolution-Field Length for field ADVICE-TEXT can be changed by following steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Go to Implementation Projects.-Select the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Show All Activities and Find Activity Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Choose view.-Go to Edit Payment File Structures.-Go to File Structure ID Z_HSBC and Choose Edit.-Go to Define Fields.-Select the Field ADVICE-TEXT.-Go to Tab Field Content Definition and go to Data Positioning and change the Field Length to 999.-You can also check the Character Set Assignment by following steps:- Follow Steps 1 to 5.-Go to Edit Assignment of Payment File structures to the Payment Medium Formats.-You can check the Character Set assigned to File Structure ID and it should be UTF-8 for File Format APAY Z_HSBC.-See Also-Keywords- Outbound, Payment File, Not Consistent.

Title: How to Assign/Change User License Type for a Business User in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--This document will guide you on how to assign/change the User License Type for a business user in SAP Business ByDesign-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In SAP Business ByDesign, License Type or User License Type will be assigned based on the work center views assigned to a business user. Please note that license consumption will only be considered for the active business users in the productive tenant.-To assign License Type/User License Type to a business user based on the work center view, you can do as follows:-Log into the SAP Business ByDesign productive tenant.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Access the Business Users work center view.-Select the relevant user and click the Edit button, then select Access Rights.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment tab-You can see under the User Type column which type of license is associated to each work center view; select the checkbox for the work center views you want to assign to the user based on the license type.-                                                                                                          OR-You can also assign License Type/User License Type to a business user based on a business role:-Log into the SAP Business ByDesign productive tenant.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Access the Business Users work center view.-Select the relevant user and click the Edit button, then select Access Rights.-Go to Business Role Assignment tab.-Select the checkbox to assign one or more business role based on the information in the License Type column.-See Also-User Subscriptions Quick Guide at SAP Help Portal-Keywords-User Type, License Type, License, User Subscription, SAP Business ByDesign, Assignment, Work Center, Business Role

Title: Customer Invoice not Posting to Sales Discount
Content: Symptom-You have created a customer invoice with discount, however the system did not post to Sales Discount G/L Account.-Sales Discount in this example refers to the P/L account that collects all sales discounts given to customers, set up under the Sales subledger -> Sales Discounts. Differentiation by means of account determination groups within Sales Discount accounts may happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Open the concerned invoice.-You'll see discounts applied in the line items.-Go to Document Flow tab.-Click to open the Journal Entry of this customer invoice.-You notice that the system did not post to Sales Discount account.-Cause-The account determination to Sales Discount, from customer invoicing, would be done to customer invoices without revenue deferral using the Net Price method.--Invoices that relate to sales orders with an accrual method are always posted by the system with revenue deferral. Invoices without reference to a preceding document are always posted by the system without revenue deferral. It may also happen that invoices are created with reference to a sales order, which does not have an accrual method assigned. In this case, revenues are not deferred.--In this case, the invoice either have revenue deferrals and/or the price method used in the sales document is the Gross Price, hence the postings are not broken down to discounts as the Net Price.-To check if a sales order has accrual method assigned, follow below steps:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Sales Document Items view.-Find the related sales order.-Click the Accounting Data tab.-The accrual method can be changed/removed via Reassign and/or Unassign buttons.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-If you wish the system to do the account determination to Sales Discount, the above described conditions of revenue deferral and pricing method shall be met.-Keywords-Sales Revenue. Revenue Recognition. Account Determination. Accrual Method. Discount. Gross Price. Net Price.

Title: How to Forward a Customer Case to Operations/ Hosting/ Provisioning team
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You received a Customer Case and you would like to know how to forward the issue to Operations/ Hosting/ Provisioning team-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Resolution-You cannot forward the case directly to hosting team since they are currently not in ServiceNOW. -You need to create an internal Incident from the case and forward the incident to concern hosting team. -Open the case in ServiceNOW-Navigate to Incidents tab-Click the New button-Go to the Initial Description section and add Subject: #Customer Incident (before the original description of the case)-Add a Description-If required, add the Business Impact  -Click Save-In the New Incident click "Assign to Me" button-Under Details section Enter Service Offering as "SPC Operation"-Now enter the Handover Service-For Incident management “SAAS_BYD_C4C_Cloud_Operations”-For Provisioning “SAAS_BYD_C4C_PROVISIONING_L2”-Under Compose section, add Provider Info-Click Save.

Title: How to Change the Unit of Measure in a Project
Content: Symptom-Unit of Measure to be changed from Hours to Days in Project ABC -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Search for Project ABC and open -Navigate to Work sub tab, we see that Unit of Work is showing as h (hours).-Cause-There is no cause for this, as this is a consulting query.-Resolution-We can change the Unit of Measure (Work) by following the below steps:-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view and search for Project ABC-Under Project Plan tab, Project Settings subtab, change the Unit of Work from Hours to Working Day(s) and save-Keywords-How to Change the Unit of Measure in a Project , Unit of Work in Project

Title: You receive error: 'Maintenance of user XYZ locked by SAP_SYSTEM' When Trying to Edit a Business User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to edit a Business User but you get the error message: 'Maintenance of user XYZ locked by SAP_SYSTEM'.-XYZ represents the User ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business ByDesign, go to Application and User Management work center.-In SAP Cloud for Customer, go to Administrator work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for the relevant Business User ID.-Edit the user.-You will see the error.-Cause-There is an automated Background job that runs every hour. The job name is: AP_IAM_IDENTITY_UPDATE and its purpose is to update Business Users' authorizations every time an Administrator makes changes to the employee's master data, such as their Org Unit Assignment or territory. Should this be done for the specific user, the associated business user will be locked and not editable. This will only stay locked for a few minutes (unless there is a huge amount of users being updated) and it will appear as locked by SAP_SYSTEM in the UI, as well as backend transaction SM12. You should be able to find the locked user's ID in SM12 as a lock argument.-Resolution-Please inform customer of this functionality and ask them to ensure that the associated employee's master data has not been changed before they tried to edit the Business User (You should also be able to check this yourself in the Employee's changes).-See Also-Development Wiki page (Here you can find further details on this job as well as some very useful backend steps to debug the issue).-External KBA which can be sent to customer: 3395516 - You receive the error "Maintenance of user XYZ locked by SAP_SYSTEM" when trying to edit a Business User-Keywords-Business User, IAM, Locked by SAP_SYSTEM, Administrator, Business User Attributes, Business User Access Rights-locked by sap_system,business user access rights

Title: MT940 UK Bank Statement Upload Date Not Valid
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a new bank Statement by uploading an MT940 UK file error messages appear: 'Date YYYMMDD not valid for. No bank account active on [...] for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found'.-(XYZ represents the account number).-(ABC represents the bank code).-(DEF represents the currency).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Liquidity Management workcenter navigate to the File Management - Inbound Files view.-Press New - Inbound File.-Maintain the mandatory data and the Import Format MT940 UK.-Under Attachments press Add- File.-Find the file that you want to upload and press Add.-Now press Start File Upload.-Error Messages appear: 'Date YYYMMDD not valid for. No bank account active on [...] for account number XYZ, national bank code ABC, and currency DEF found'.-Cause-The bank Statement date maintained in tag :20: of the MT940 UK file is not maintained in the correct format YYYYMMDD.-Resolution-You need to correct the date maintained in the tag :20: in format YYYYMMDD.-The easiest way to do this is by converting the 940 file to a text file, by changing the ending of the file to .txt.-Open the file and correct the date in tag :20: by applying the correct format YYYYMMDD.-You can either keep the txt format of the corrected file or convert it back to 940 file format, just by changing the ending of the file back to .940.-Then add and upload the file again:-In the Liquidity Management workcenter navigate to the File Management - Inbound Files view.-Press New - Inbound File.-Maintain the mandatory data and the Import Format MT940 UK.-Under Attachments press Add- File.-Find the corrected file that you want to upload and press Add.-Now press Start File Upload.-This time the bank statement will be uploaded.-See Also-Keywords- MT940 UK, Bank Statement, Upload, Date, Not Valid.

Title: How to Change Payment Terms and Due Date of Receivables Open Items
Content: Symptom-You want to change the Payment Terms of a Receivable Open Item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts object work list.-Select the desired account.-Click View button.-Click Trade Receivables tab.-Click Invoices / Payments tab.-Select the item to be changed.-Under Payment Terms / Due Dates you want to change the Payment Terms.-Cause-Resolution-The Due Date of an Open item can be changed in the Item Details in the Customer Account monitor.-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Go to Customer Accounts object work list.-Select the desired account.-Click View button.-Click Trade Receivables tab.-Click Invoices / Payments tab.-Select the item to be changed.-Click Item details button.-Now in the section Payment Terms you can either:-Select other Payment Terms. On <Enter> the system will recalculate the due date from the base line date and the new payment terms.-Or-Remove the payment terms. On <Enter> the field Due Date will become editable.-Save the changed item.-See Also-Keywords- Payment Terms, Due Date, Receivables, Open Items, Change.

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Run Error - No Functional Area Could be Assigned
Content: Symptom-You have executed a depreciation run but the run finishes with errors:-"Derivation for acc.principle ABC*, chart of accts XYZ**, G/L account DDD***, Nonsales ObjectNo Functional area could be assigned"-*ABC represents the Accounting Principle ID.-**XYZ represents the Chart of Accounts.-***DDD represents means the G/L Account ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Navigate to the Periodic Tasks - Depreciation view.-Click New - Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Enter a run description, maintain the company and the respective period and year.-Click Start Now to immediately execute the run.-After a few moments a message appears stating Run ID EEE finished with errors (EEE means the Depreciation Run ID).-On the top of the screen click Display Log.-In the Log navigate to the Erroneous Fixed Assets tab and you can see the below error message:-"Derivation for acc.principle ABC, chart of accts XYZ, G/L account DDD, Nonsales Object"-"No Functional are could be assigned"-Cause-Since you have scoped to report Income Statement by Function of Expense and maintained the reporting principle as Funct of exp, the system tries and assign a functional area when it is hitting the G/L Account DDD which is another operational expenses. However, the system failed to assign since it could not find a default functional area for nonsales object or a functional area assigned to this G/L Account in particular in the activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Resolution-You should maintain a functional area for the accounting principle ABC and G/L Account DDD, as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project, and select Open Activity List.-Go to tab Fine-Tuning Activities.-Open activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Click Edit functional area determination.-Select the row for Accounting Principle ABC.-Choose tab Determination Using G/L Accounts.-Click Add Row.-Input the G/L account DDD, and select Functional Area.-Click Save.-After that, execute the Depreciation Run again and the error message should not appear again.-Keywords-derivation; nonsales object; functional area; function of expense; depreciation;

Title: Customer ID/Supplier ID is Not shown in Balance Confirmation Run.
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find the Customer ID XYZ in the List of All Customers during the Balance Confirmation Run.-(XYZ represents the Customer ID).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Go to Balance Confirmation Runs subview.-Choose New and then Go to Balance Confirmation Run.-Choose Restriction Type as Manual Collection of Customer/Supplier.-Choose Company ID.-In the List of All Customers, you are trying to Search for the Customer ID XYZ and it is not shown.-Cause-The number of Customers displayed in Manual Collection of Customers is limited to 10000 Entries. The Customer ID XYZ is not included in the list of first 10000 Entries and it is not available for selection.-Resolution-System behaves as designed and this is a limitation.-See Also-Keywords-Customer ID, Supplier ID, Receivables, Balance Confirmation Run, List.

Title: You receive the error "Maintenance of user XYZ locked by SAP_SYSTEM" when trying to edit a Business User
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit a Business User but you get the error message 'Maintenance of user XYZ locked by SAP_SYSTEM'.-XYZ represents the Business User ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business ByDesign, go to Application and User Management work center.-In SAP Cloud for Customer, go to Administrator work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for the relevant Business User ID.-Edit the user.-You will see the error.-Cause-There could be two causes for this message:-Scenario 1: There is a standard automated background job that runs every hour. This job's purpose is to update Business Users' authorizations every time an Administrator makes changes to the employee's master data, such as their Org Unit Assignment or territory. Should this be done for the specific user, the associated Business User will be locked and not editable. This will only stay locked for a few minutes (unless there is a huge amount of users being updated) and it will appear as locked by SAP_SYSTEM in the UI.-Scenario 2: You are making frequent changes to the same Business User (for example: changing the Valid To date).-Resolution-For scenario 1: The user should be automatically unlocked after some time, when the background job is finished.-For scenario 2: we do not recommend that you make changes to a Business User so frequently (for example, on a daily basis). In case you are editing the Business User's Valid To Date and you need this in order to control the user's access to the system, you should consider using the "User Locked" checkbox instead. This prevents the user from logging into the system while it is checked and will not cause inconsistencies due to a huge amount of daily changes in the user.-Keywords-user frequently locked, business user access rights, business user attributes, locked by SAP_SYSTEM, SAP_SYSTEM

Title: Can't Reverse a VAT Return - UK
Content: Symptom- Can't reverse the VAT Return for United Kingdom companies. The reverse button is greyed out.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center > VAT Return view-Search for the desired VAT Return ID-It is not possible to reverse the VAT Return. The Reverse button is greyed out-Cause-The issue usually occurs when both the old UK VAT return xml file and UK MTD are active at the same time in the system.-Refer to this documentation to check if the Making Tax Digital - UK is active in your system.-Resolution-To deactivate the old UK VAT return xml file, refer to the below steps:-Go to Tax Management Work Center > Company Tax Arrangements view-Search for your Company ID and Tax Authority ID-Click on Tax Authority link-Click View All-Go to Company Tax Arrangements tab-Select the desired Company-Go to Tax Return Arrangements sub-tab-Select the desired Tax Return Arrangement ID-Deactivate the parameter "Electronic Submission"-It should enable the Reverse button in the VAT Return-See Also-Making Tax Digital - UK-Keywords-VAT return, reverse, UK, United Kingdom

Title: Post Withholding Tax For Country Spain In the Invoice
Content: Symptom-Is it possible for the system to post withholding tax for Spain at the invoice entry level?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the New Invoice Without Purchase Orders link in Common Tasks or go to the Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Invoice.-Enter all the mandatory details for the country version Spain.-Select the Post button.-In the journal entry postings, it's not possible to find the entries for withholding tax for Spain posted.-Cause-The withholding tax developed in Business ByDesign for the country/region Spain is due at payment only. This setting is not configurable and cannot be changed.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-In case of seeking a change in functionality or adoption of a new feature kindly submit an idea in our Influence Platform.-Here requests for enhancements are introduced and evaluated by other customers and our product team. -Keywords-Withholding Tax, Spain, Invoice entry, Supplier Invoice.

Title: Dump is triggered when trying to finish Purchase Order (In backend: "TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED")
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -The user is unable to finish either the delivery or the invoice of purchase order because of error 500 (dump). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to follow in the UI (front end): -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the purchase order's ID). Also please make sure that the document is selected. -Click in Finish button and select "Delivery" or "Invoice". -You get a dump (error 500) after some minutes. -Steps to follow in the backend:-Go to transaction ST22. -Search for the dump according to the time frame you reproduced it. -Navigate to Active Calls / Events.-The information displayed is:-58 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_FND_REFERENCES======CP    /SRMAP/CL_FND_REFERENCES======CM00R    58-   /SRMAP/CL_FND_REFERENCES=>RETRIEVE-57 FORM         /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDOBJREL             /SRMAP/LFND_PDOBJRELF63                44-   READ_MULTI_APORS_LINKS-56 FORM         /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDOBJREL             /SRMAP/LFND_PDOBJRELF56                45-   PDOBJREL_READ_MULTI_APORS-55 FORM         /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDOBJREL             /SRMAP/LFND_PDOBJRELF19                49-   PDOBJREL_READ_MULTI_DATA-54 FORM         /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDOBJREL             /SRMAP/LFND_PDOBJRELF25                51-   PDOBJREL_READ_MLTI_DATA_SWITCH-53 FUNCTION     /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDOBJREL             /SRMAP/LFND_PDOBJRELU02                73-   /SRMAP/FND_PDOBJREL_GETDETAIL-52 FORM         /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PD                   /SRMAP/LFND_PDF0R                     385-   PROCDOC_GETDETAIL-51 FUNCTION     /SRMAP/SAPLFND_PD                   /SRMAP/LFND_PDU07                     186-   /SRMAP/FND_PROCDOC_GETDETAIL-50 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_FND_PDAO_PD=========CP    /SRMAP/CL_FND_PDAO_PD=========CM008     3-   /SRMAP/CL_FND_PDAO_PD=>/SRMAP/IF_FND_PDAO_PD~PROCDOC_GETDETAIL-49 METHOD       /SRMAP/CL_FND_PD_BO===========CP    /SRMAP/CL_FND_PD_BO===========CM00M    34-   /SRMAP/CL_FND_PD_BO=>PD_GETDETAIL_MULTI-Also in the "Header" of the dump information is displayed:-Category:               ABAP server resource shortage-Runtime Errors:         TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED-If you navigate to Error Analysis, you can see:-    The internal table-     "\PROGRAM=/SRMAP/SAPLFND_PDOBJREL\FORM=PDOBJREL_READ_MULTI_DATA\DATA=LT_APORS_-    LINK_DATA" could not be enlarged further. In order to-    make error handling possible this table had to be deleted. This means-    that the table will either be displayed further down or, if you go from-    here to the ABAP Debugger, with 0 rows.-Cause-The Purchase Order has far too many Goods and services receipts, or Supplier invoices, linked to it. Because of the many references, the system triggers an error. -You can check this by following the steps below:-Open purchase order ABC. -Navigate to Items tab (check how many items this document has). -Select the first item. -Navigate to Document Flow subtab.-Make note of how many documents are linked to this item (Goods and services receipt and invoices). -Do the same for the other items. -Resolution-Inform the customer to not create Purchase orders with far too many items or far too many documents related to each item. -Also please share the KBA regarding the limitation of items:-KBA: 2956449 - Limitation on Number of Items in ByDesign Documents-See Also-KBA: 2956449 - Limitation on Number of Items in ByDesign Documents-Keywords-Purchase order, goods and services receipt, backend, ST22, dump, items, limitation, supplier invoice

Title: Error Message: 'Absolute Value Of Assigned Amount Too High'
Content: Symptom-You are creating a New Incoming Check and you are getting the following error message: 'Absolute value of assigned amount too high'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center-Select New Incoming Check under Common Tasks-Enter the Applied net Amount more than Open Amount -Here, you can see the error message: Absolute Value Of Assigned Amount Too High-Cause-While creating a New Incoming Check, there is no provision to adjust the Remaining Balance if the Applied Net Amount exceeds the Open Amount.-Resolution-Make sure that the Applied Amount for a receivable document does not exceed its open amount.-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Absolute Value, Assigned Amount, High, Payment Management, Incoming Check.

Title: Error Message While Entering Corporate Identity Number for an Indian Customer Account: 'Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 20 characters'
Content: Symptom-While entering a Tax Number Type Corporate Identity Number (CIN) for an Indian Customer Account you receive the error message: Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 20 characters.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers > Customers view.-Select the Indian Customer Account for which you want to maintain the Tax Number Type.-Click Edit > Financial Data.-Move to Tax Data tab.-Under Tax Numbers section click Add Row.-Select Country: IN - India.-Select Tax Number Type: Corporate Identity Number.-Enter the respective Tax Number.-The alphanumeric code you just entered has 21 digits, but as the system allows only 20 digits an error message is thrown: Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 20 characters.-Note: This scenario also applies to Suppliers in the Payables work center.-Cause-The Corporate Identity Number code or Company CIN No. / code is a 21 digits alphanumeric code / number issued to every company incorporated in India.-Nevertheless the Tax Number Type field was implemented with a max length of 20 digits and cannot be extended due to technical issues. Extending the data type for this field will have a huge regression impact.-Resolution-The Tax Number Type field won't be extended to permit the 21 digits of the Corporate Identity Number.-As the Corporate Identity Number should be printed in output forms (e. g. invoices) you can use preprinted forms as a workaround. In this way the CIN can already be printed on those forms and all other data will come from Business ByDesign as usual.-See Also-Keywords-CIN, number, supplier master data, India, 20 characters, entry, too long.

Title: Not Able to Add Internal Attachement to Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-When trying to add attachments to a new purchase request, the document type is only Standard Attachment. There is no "Internal Attachment" option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Click New Purchase Request (Manual) common task.-Fill in required fields.-Navigate to Attachments tab, click Add->File.-Upload the attachment file, open the dropdown list of Document Type column.-There is only one option, which is Standard Attachment.-Cause-This is because purchase request belongs to internal documents, it will not be sent to supplier. Therefore, there is no need to upload internal attachment. However, for purchase orders that will be sent to suppliers, you can upload internal attachments if you don't want the attachments to be visible to suppliers.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior. -Keywords-Purchase Request, Attachment, Internal Attachment, Document Type

Title: Issue in Excel Template When Exporting the VAT Return
Content: Symptom-You are trying to export the VAT return in Excel, at the UI level, the screen has the Business Partner ID, Business Partner Name, and VAT registration ID. But in the Excel template, those fields are not available.-Now, you would like to know how to bring those fields into an Excel template. - Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center. -Go to VAT Returns subview. -Search for Tax Return ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Tax Return ID).-Click "View". -Go to Tax Return tab. -Click "Export" button > To Microsoft Excel. -Open the excel file downloaded. -Here we can see that is missing the Business Partner ID, Business Partner Name and VAT registration ID.-Cause-The fields in the Excel are configured in Group ID - XLS_FIN_TAX_AT_VAT_RETURN which does not contain Business Partner-related fields.-Adding Business Partner details in the Tax Return Excel download is not a legal requirement and hence we will not add those fields in the configuration.-Resolution-Expected system behavior. -Keywords- VAT return, Excel Template, Business Partner ID, Business Partner Name, and VAT registration ID.

Title: How to scope for adding sub domain field to activate mass email functionality in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--To activate the mass email functionality sub-domain needs to be added for which scoping has to be done under First Implementation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Go to Overview Sub view.-Search for Email and Fax Settings.-Click on Email and Fax Settings.-        The option to add sub domain is missing.-Cause-As the scoping is not done only two options are available.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Project Sub view.-Click on First Implementation.-Click on Edit Project Scope.-Click next until you reach Questions.-         6. Click on next and finish.-     After scoping is done the options for adding the sub domain and documentation will be available.-  Keywords-Scoping, Mass Email Functionality, Sending emails, Campaign.

Title: While Selecting a G/L Account for a Supplier Invoice System Does not Show Accounts Based on Company the User Is Assigned
Content: Symptom-While creating a Supplier Invoice and selecting the G/L Account under Items Tab > Cost Distribution Sub-tab, you see that system is showing all G/L Accounts even though user who is creating the Invoice is not assigned to all Companies.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks > New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Click on "View All" button.-Go to Items Tab.-Go to Cost Distribution Sub-tab.-Under Account Assignment, go to G/L Account.-You are able to see accounts that belong to other companies than the one you are assigned.-Cause-The Account Determination Group shown in the Supplier Invoice is based on the settings defined in the Business Configuration and not based on Companies.-Resolution-System behavior is correct.-You can see the G/L Accounts marked to be visible in the Supplier Invoice by accessing following path:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select your Implementation Project and click on Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune Tab.-Search and open the activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on the link Edit Account Determination Groups.-Here you can see each Account Determination Group and check which one is marked as Available in Supplier Invoice, these will be visible in Supplier Invoice irrespective of Company selection.-Keywords-G/L Account, Supplier Invoice, Company,

Title: Dunning Letters without Relevant Information
Content: Symptom-Dunning letters are not showing some relevant information, such as invoice numbers, dates, due dates, dunning levels and summary.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Receivables Work Center.-2. Go to Dunning View.-3. Select Dunning ID.-4. Click on Preview button.-5. Click on Dunning Letter button.-5. You will see that the preview is being displayed without invoice no's, dates, due dates, dunning levels and summary which is the main part of the Dunning Letter.-Cause-Reminder Letter is set as the Default Rule for Dunning Strategies which has Max Dunning Level as blank and Dunning Notice Legally Effective as blank.-Resolution-1. Go to Application and User Management work center.-2. Go to Input and Output Management View.-3. Go to Form Template Selection Sub-View.-4. Select Show Rules For Dunning Letter.-5. Click on Change Sequence button.-6. Move the Reminder Letter as the last rule for each Dunning Strategy.-See Also-Keywords- Dunning Letters, Receivables, relevant information, nvoice numbers, dates, due dates, dunning levels, summary.

Title: System Throws Error Messages Related to Business Residence and Cost Center When Assigning a Function to an Org Unit
Content: Symptom-When you assign one or more functions to a particular org unit, while checking or activating, system throws one or more of the below error messages:-DD.MM.YYYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1; org unit XYZ has one or more functions assigned. Because of this, the org unit must be below a cost center. Flag this org unit or any org unit above it in the structure as a cost center.-DD.MM.YYYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1; function(s) assigned to org unit XYZ (Org Unit Name). Org units with functions assigned must be a cost center or be below one. Check that a cost center exists in the structure above and that there are no segments between this org unit and the cost center.-DD.MM.YYYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1; org unit XYZ has one or more functions assigned. Because of this, the org unit must be below a business residence. Flag this org unit or any org unit above it in the structure as a business residence.-DD.MM.YYYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1; org unit XYZ has one or more functions assigned. Because of this, the org unit must be below a Profit Center. Flag this org unit or any org unit above it in the structure as a Profit Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Organizational Management work center.-Go to Edit Org Structures.-Select org unit XYZ (where XYZ stands for the relevant org unit's ID).-Check or activate the org structure.-Cause-You have assigned one or more functions to org unit XYZ, but for this assignment, either org unit XYZ or its parent org unit should be a cost center, profit center or business residence.-Resolution-To resolve the issue,-You can remove the function(s) assigned to the Org unit and assigned them to any other org unit which meets the above-mentioned conditions.-If the function is a must for org unit XYZ, then you have to define either this org unit or its parent org unit with Cost Center, Business Residence and/or Profit Center definition(s).-See Also-Guide: Setting Up Your Org Structure, at SAP Help Portal.-Keywords-Org Unit, One or More Functions Assigned, Cost Center, Profit Center, Business Residence

Title: Unposted Source Document Error: 'Fixed Asset Name Missing, Enter Fixed Asset Name'
Content: Symptom-You have noticed an unposted source document and an error message which prevents the document from being posted. The error message is: 'Fixed Asset Name Missing, Enter Fixed Asset Name'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents subview.-And search for your Source Document ID XYZ (XYZ representes the Source Document ID), in this case the Source Document is a Goods and Service Receipt.-Select the ID and under the Details session you can see the following error message:-'Fixed Asset Name Missing, Enter Fixed Asset Name'.-Cause-If the prefix of your saved individual material has empty spaces then you will get this type of error message. You might have copied with empty space before the name of the material. Due to this, the Fixed Asset is not getting saved with that name.-Resolution-You need to edit the Goods and Service Receipt and manually retype the Individual Material Descriptions and then save it. Now you will be able to post the document.-Keywords-Unposted, Source Document, Error, Fixed Asset, Name Missing, General Ledger.

Title: Difference Between Functions Set Process Control and Open and Close Periods
Content: Symptom-It is not always necessary to adjust the settings of the function Set Process Control to execute a posting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Companies view.-Select a Company ID and click Set Process Control.-Here you can check if the Process Control is active for a respective posting period.-The Entry Possible Until date must not be earlier than the actual current date.-Open the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Navigate to Open and Close Periods.-Here you can check if the respective posting period is open.-You can also check if the First Allowed Step and the Last Allowed Step are in accordance with your current requirements.-Cause-The settings of the Set Process Control functions are only checked by the system when postings are generated from work centers which are not part of the financial accounting, for example: supplier invoices, goods and service receipts, customer invoices.-Resolution-For postings which are generated from financial accounting work centers, for example: journal entry vouchers, manual postings on fixed assets etc., the function Set Process Control is not relevant.-The same applies for adjustments through financial accounting, such as depreciation runs, GR/IR Clearing Runs, Balance Carry Forward runs etc.-Please be aware that the accounting periods in the Open and Close Periods function have to be open for all postings regardless from which work center they are generated.-Keywords-Set Process Control, Open and Close Periods, Journal Entry Voucher, Manual Posting, 期间控制，流程控制，

Title: Change the Posting Date of An Already Confirmed Outgoing Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-You create an outgoing bank transfer XYZ to clear the outstanding invoice items for one of your suppliers. But you find out that not only the open related items on the supplier account are not cleared automatically, but also the outgoing bank transfer is not posted to the right period. You think you can cancel the outgoing bank transfer XYZ and redo the payment, but the system does not allow you to cancel the outgoing bank transfer. Now you don't know how to fix the issue.-XYZ means the outgoing bank transfer ID.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center and choose the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments.-Select the Outgoing Bank Transfer XYZ.-Open up the document.-Under the General tab, you can see the posting date in the Accounting Data section.-The date is not the same posting date in the original supplier invoice as you expect.-Also go to the Payables work center and choose the Suppliers view.-Check the respective supplier account, and you can see that the related supplier invoices are still open.-Cause-As the payment amount in the outgoing bank transfer XYZ is different from the amount in the related supplier invoices, so it's not possible for the system to automatically clear the items. Also because this outgoing bank transfer XYZ has been confirmed in a bank statement via the payment allocation ABC, so the system does not allow you to directly cancel the bank transfer and redo the payment.-ABC means the payment allocation ID.-Resolution-To fix the issue, follow the steps below:-Go to the Payment Management work center and choose the Payment Allocation view.-Select the payment allocation ABC and reverse it. A new payment allocation DEF (DEF is the payment allocation ID) should be created.-Now the Reverse button of the outgoing bank transfer XYZ should be available.-Choose to reverse the payment order XYZ.-Now go to the Payables work center, view the account of the supplier in question.-Click Pay Manually By and then choose Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Set the target posting date and release it.-Then go to Payment Management work center, and choose the Payment Monitor view.-Select the newly created bank transfer and choose Set to In Transfer under Actions for Bank Transactions.-Then the bank transfer is changed to In Transfer.-Go back to the Payment Allocation view, and choose the newly created payment allocation DEF.-Choose Edit and then View All. -In the Payment Assignment tab,-Assign the newly created Payment Order.-Choose Release.-The open items are paid with the new outgoing bank transfer; also the outgoing bank transfer is posted at the desired posting date.-See Also-Keywords-outgoing bank transfer; confirmed; payment allocation; bank statement; reverse

Title: How To Read the Amounts in Recurring Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You have observed that the Amount shown in Header of a Recurring Journal Entry Voucher is different from the Amount shown in Credit for Recurring Journal Entry Voucher Items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Go to Recurring Journal Entry Vouchers subview.-Show All Recurring Journal Entries and Find Recurring Journal Entry Voucher XYZ (XYZ represents the Recurring Journal Entry Voucher ID).-Choose Edit.-Go to Recurring Journal Entry Voucher.-Go to Template for Recurring Journal Entry Voucher Items.-Amount shown in Credit in Transaction Currency is different to the Total Amount shown on header.-Cause-Recurring Journal Entry Voucher tab shows amount of single Journal Entry Voucher which is the Debit Amount In Transaction Currency * Number of lines = Credit In Transaction Currency.-This is one of the Journal Entry Voucher in Recurring Journal Entry Voucher. Header Amount = Single Journal Entry Voucher * List of Journal Entry Vouchers.-Hence the Header Amount is different from Amount shown on Recurring Journal Entry Voucher tab.-Resolution-You can check the List of Journal Entry Vouchers covered under Recurring Journal Entry Voucher by the-following steps:-Follow Steps 1 to 5.-Go to List of Journal Entry Vouchers.-You could see the Start Date and End Date of Recurring Journal Entry Voucher and-Recurring Amount*List of Journal Entry Vouchers = Header Amount.-See Also-Keywords- Recurring Journal Entry Voucher, How To, Read, amount, Debit Amount, Credit in Transaction Currency, Total Amount.

Title: How to Delete or Scrap Fixed Assets for Which No Acquisition Cost Has Been Assigned
Content: Symptom-You create a fixed asset manually. You have not acquired the fixed asset. You have not assigned any acquisition cost to the fixed assets. When you want to delete the fixed asset, the button Delete is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select a fixed asset.-See that the button 'Delete' is grayed out.-Cause-Once you set the field Capitalization Date to some value, then the status of your asset changes from In Process to Capitalized.-It is not possible to delete Capitalized assets.-Resolution-You have 2 options:-Clear out the Capitalization Date manually and reuse the asset for the purchase process.-Set the Deactivation Date manually.-Steps to do:-Select your asset.-Go to the Master Data tab.-Go to the Life Cycle Data tab.-Here either change the field Capitalization Date or Deactivation Date.-Keywords-Delete Fixed Asset, Scrap Fixed Asset, Acquisition Cost, Capitalized Fixed Asset.

Title: Error Message "Insertion of data failed; data with key XYZ already exists for node ROOT" While Migrating Suppliers
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to update/enhance the few parameters/attibutes in your Supplier Master Data. When you try to perform this activity through Migration, system throws below error message:-Insertion of data failed; data with key XYZ already exists for node ROOT-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity for Suppliers.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Note: Migration Mode for the respective file is Enhance already existing records-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you are trying to modify the already existing data of the Supplier XYZ.--The general functionality of the migration mode Enhance already existing records is to enhance the Supplier. In this case, the enhance mode will work only if there is no Data maintained for the Suppliers in the particular tab (EX: Purchasing). Which means, you have not maintained any information related to Purchasing in the Supplier and you can use this mode to add those information. But, if you have already maintained a purchasing information and trying to modify that, then it is not possible through this mode or through migration.-  Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-You can use this mode to enhance the Purchasing Data of Suppliers only if there is no Purchasing information maintained in the system.-See Also-KBA: 2511426 - Error Message: “Insertion of data failed; data with key XXXXX already exists for node ROOT” While Migrating Suppliers-Blog: Mass Changes of ByD Data using Excel and ByD Web Services

Title: Reverse a Payment Allocation With Status in Preparation
Content: Symptom-You notice a Payment Allocation in Status in Preparation with a corresponding Payment Advice. You expect this Payment Allocation to be cancelled / reversed already.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Select the Payment Allocation View.-Show all Payment Allocations, find XXX (XXX stands for the Payment Allocation).-Click on Payment Allocation XXX with Payment Advice YYY. (YYY represents the Payment Advice ID).-Press View All.--You can see that Payment Allocation XXX is still in status in Preparation. You expect that this Payment Allocation is already posted or reversed.--Under Details of Payment Advice, click on Payment Advice YYY.-Press View All.-You can see that Payment Advice YYY is in status Released.-Cause-Payment Allocations in status in Preparation cannot be canncelled as such. You have to cancel the corresponding Payment Advice which is the preceding document to the Payment Allocation. Once you have cancelled the Payment Advice the corresponding Payment Allocation is cancelled automatically.-Resolution-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Switch to the Payment Allocation View.-Search for Payment Allocation XXX and open it.-Click on Payment Advice YYY.-Press View All.-Click Reverse.-Now the corresponding Payment Allocation XXX is cancelled / reversed as well. If this is not the case wait a few minutes, empty Silverlight and Internet Explorer Cache, log out of the system and log in again.-See Also-Keywords-Payment Allocation Status in Preparation; automatic reverse cancellation Payment Allocation; customer invoice paid payment cleared payment allocation still in preparation

Title: Planned Depreciation Only Considered Yearly - No Depreciation Posting In Accounting Period for Statistical Fixed Asset Valuation View
Content: Symptom-You notice that for a statistical Valuation view of a Fixed Asset, the planned Depreciation is displayed only on a yearly level, not per Accounting Period.-You also notice that the Depreciation run did not consider this Valuation view in a period other than the last period of the Fiscal Year.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Search and open Fixed Asset XYZ(XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID).-Go to the Values tab.-Navigate to the Depreciation Overview sub-tab.-Select Valuation view ABC (ABC represents the statistical/ internal Valuation view). -You notice that the planned depreciation amounts is calculated yearly, due in the last period of each fiscal year of the Fixed Asset's useful life. The Depreciation is not planned per period as displayed for Book Valuation Views.-Also, after the Depreciation run for a period other than the last period of a Fiscal Year, you notice that the planned Depreciation was not updated for the Valuation view ABC. -Cause-The book valuation views are the only valuation views relevant for the General ledger. Therefore, the automatically calculated and planned annual depreciation is distributed to the respective accounting periods. For each period the depreciation run automatically posts the proportional depreciation amounts to the G/L accounts defined in account determination. At the same time, the posted value is updated in asset accounting.-For all other valuation views, such as the statistical/internal Valuation view ABC, the system considers depreciation on a yearly basis in the last period of the Fiscal Year. However, this depreciation is not posted to G/L accounts but only updated in fixed asset accounting.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-You need to make sure that this issue only occurs for the Statistical(Internal) Valuation view and not for the Book(Non-Statistical) view. Follow the below mentioned steps to check the type of valuation view:-In the Business Configuration work center navigate to the Implementation projects view and open the Activity List.-Open the Integrate and Extend phase and open the Set of Books activity.-Select the Set of books that is assigned to the company and press Edit.-In the Fixed Asset Settings tab you can find the assigned valuation views.-If the Internal check box is not selected, it means that it is a Book(Non-Statistical) Valuation view.-If it is selected, then it is a Statistical/ Internal Valuation view.-Note: If the issue occurs for the Book(Non-Statistical) view, refer the KBA noted in the See Also section.-See Also-2085507: Planned Depreciation Is Not Being Calculated Per Period for all Fiscal Years-Keywords-Statistical Valuation View; no depreciation posting during fiscal year; depreciation per year,

Title: Error Message In Payment Allocation: Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting
Content: Symptom-When opening a payment allocation from a bank statement item you get the error message: Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Open the allocation with status In Preparation that is linked to the respective bank statement item (Preceding Document Type Bank Statement).-Notice the error message: Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting.-Cause-The reason for the error message is that the respective accounting period, which the payment allocation posting date lies on, is closed for closing step 010 - Operational postings.-Resolution-You have to open the accounting period for closing step 010 - Operational postings by following the steps below:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Click Open and Close Periods under Common Tasks view.-For the combination of Company ID and Set Of Books, select the respective Accounting Period ID.-In the First Allowed Step column select the option 010 - Operational postings from the dropdown menu.-Click Save and Close button.-As a result you should be able to post the respective payment allocation.-See Also-Keywords-010; 020; operational postings; closing entries, Payment Allocation,

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Error - Doc. item: Only Doc. Items of the Same Profit Center can be Merged
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The Revenue Recognition run finishes with the error message Doc. item ABC/XX: Only doc. items of the same profit center can be merged.-This error message hints towards a project based fixed price sales order item, ABC-XX, with the accrual method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC.With this Accrual Method all fixed-price sales order items connected to the same project are bundled into a single item, the Leading Sales Document Item,  for the purposes of revenue recognition.-In order to bundle all fix-price Costs and Revenues into a single item, the sales order items must point to the same company, segment, profit center, and customer.-You have verified that all project based fixed price sales order items of the project are assigned to the same profit center. However, the error is still reported in the revenue recognition run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To identify the error:-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks - Revenue Recognition view.-Find the run with processing status Error and open the Log via the Log Result link.-In the Messages tab the error message Doc. item ABC-XX: Only doc. items of the same profit center can be merged is displayed.-To verify that all sales order items of the project are assigned to the same segment/profit center:-Navigate to the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue workcenter.-Find sales order item ABC-XX.-Go to the Associated Objects tab and copy the Project ID DEF.-Now open the Advanced Search.-Enter the project ID DEF into the Project ID field.-In the Revenue type field select 3 - Project Sales (Fixed Price).-In the Accrual Method field select 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC.-You will now see all fixed price sales order items associated with project DEF.-In the Profit Center column verify that all items are assigned to the same profit center.-*It can also happen that the accrual method of all fix-price items was changed from 108 to a different accrual method. But the error still appears in the revenue recognition run.-Cause-Background: -To bundle all fixed price sales order items with accrual method, 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC the system automatically creates an internal ONLY-projectbased item. -This internal ONLY-project based item is associated with the same company, segment and profit center of the Leading Sales Document Item.-If the profit center of the Leading Sales Document Item gets changed then this new assignment might not get updated for the internal project-based item. -OR-If you changed the accrual method of the project's fix-price sales order items from 108 to a different accrual method, it can happen that the internal item does not get automatically removed so that the error message still appears. -Resolution-Our development team are working on improving the profit center assignment logic for the internal project items. The functionality shall be enhanced in a future SAP ByDesign release.-For now, we can manually change the profit center of the internal project-based item from the backend.-Before this backend correction you need to-Ask for Customer permission for backend correction and to execute the Revenue Recognition run in test mode.-Verify that ALL fixed-price sales order items with accrual method 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC associated with the project are assigned to the SAME profit center in the UI as described above.-Locate the Leading Sales Document Item:-In the Sales Document Items view open the Advanced Search.-Under Related Documents, in the Project ID field enter the Project ID, here DEF. -Under Accounting Data, in the Revenue Type field select 3- Project Sales (Fix Price).-Press Go to display all Sales Order items connected to the project. -Select the first Item and go to the Accounting Data sub-tab.-Find the Leading Sales Doc. Item column and take note of its Sales Order ID. If this column is not displayed then you are looking at the Leading Sales Document Item, ABC-XX (ABC-XX represents the Leading Sales Document Item ID). Or there is only one Sales Order connected to the project. In this case just take note of the Sales Order ID, here ABC. -After these steps-Identify the internal. project based item: -access STFK with a L6-support user authorization.-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC.-Select Load By Query and select ITEM-QUERY_BY_PROJECT_REF. -In the ProjectReference/ProjectID/content field, enter the Project ID and press OK (green tick in the bottom right).-Ensure that you are viewing all items in Table view. You can see all items of the sales order in a table list. If you can only see information on one specific Item click the Table View button in the top left corner.-Under More Functions mouse-over Switch Attribute Names and select Display Proxy Names. -Identify the Internal Item: Find the OPERATIONAL_DOCUMENT_ITEM_REF-UUID-CONTENT column. For one item only 000000000000000000... appears**. This is the internal project-based sales order item.-If the fix-price items no longer use accrual method 108, delete the internal item: -Select the internal item. -Press Edit (Pencil icon).-Press Delete (Bin icon). -Press Save. -If the fix-price items still use accrual method 108. change the profit center assignment of the internal item: -Select the Internal Item and ensure that this item is connected to the Leading Item's Sales Order: -Press Navigate and choose TO_PARENT.-In the Parent Node find the OPERATIONAL_DOCUMENT_REFERENCE-FORMATTED_ID column and ensure that the ID displayed here is the ID of the Leading Sales Doc. Item, here ABC. -Go back to the Items table (button left beside Navigate). -To be 100% sure, check the BO Node again. It MUST display: FinanciaAccountingViewofSalesAndServiceDocument - Item. -Once you verified that you are in the Items table, keep the Internal Item selected and scroll further to the right to find the CURRENT_PROFIT_CENTER_UUID-CONTENT column. -You notice that the ID displayed here is different to the ID displayed for the other Items. -To change it  -Press Edit.-Copy the profit center ID of item ABC-XX. -Paste it into the profit center field of the internal item.-Press Save.-After this change, execute a revenue recognition run in test mode. The error message should not appear anymore.-(**Sometimes the Internal Item does not appear in this table on Project Level. In this case you need to find it on Sales Order level:-For the BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC press Load Query and select ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the OperationalDocumentReference/FormattedID field enter the ID of the Leading Item's Sales Order**, here ABC and press OK.-Press Navigate and select ITEM.-In the Items table, identify the Internal item (as above) and scroll to the right to find the CURRENT_PROFIT_CENTER_UUID-CONTENT column. If the ID displayed here is different to the other IDs, change it applying the above steps.-***In exceptional cases it can happen that the Internal Item is not connected to the Sales Order of the Leading Sales Document Item. In this case check all other Sales Orders connected to the Project:-For the BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC press Load Query and select ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the OperationalDocumentReference/FormattedID field enter the ID of another Sales Order (containing project-based fix-price service items), for example XYZ connected to Project DEF (XYZ represents another Sales Order connected to Project DEF).-Press Navigate and select ITEM.-In the Items table, identify the Internal item (as above) and scroll to the right to find the CURRENT_PROFIT_CENTER_UUID-CONTENT column. If the ID displayed here is different to the other IDs, change it applying the above steps.)-See Also-2948703 - Revenue Recogntion Run error: Only doc. items with the same buyer party can be merged-2860171 - Revenue Recognition Run Errors for fix-price Sales Order Items: Use one merge item with code 'replace basic data' only-Keywords-Only Doc. Items of the Same Profit Center can be merged; Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC;

Title: Registered Product Warranty is not updated in the Service Order
Content: Symptom-Warranty of the registered product is not determined in the service order even it is maintained in the master data.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Order Work center-Go to Service Order Processing View-Select Show All and find for the relevant Service Order XXX. (XXX represents the service order number)-Select View All-Under the General tab, navigate to the sub tab Account and Affected Product.-In the Warranty Section you can see that the fields under it are grayed out.-Cause-If the warranty of the registered Product is expired, prior to the creation of the Service Order, it would be irrelevant to show the expired warranty of the registered product in the service order even though it is maintained in the master data.-Hence the system does not determine the warranty details and shows the fields grayed out.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-See Also

Title: Error: "Enter a value with no more than 40 characters" While Maintaining the Description in Material
Content: Symptom-While maintaining the Material Description, it is restricted to 40 characters and you see the below error message. Is it possible to increase the length of the Material Description above 40 characters?-Enter a value with no more than 40 characters-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data or Product Portfolio work center-Select Materials view-Search and highlight the Material-Select Edit button-Maintain the Material Description-Select Save-System throws the mentioned error-Cause-It is not possible to have more than 40 characters in the Material Description field.-Resolution-You can maintain additional information about the Material in the field Details.-Go to Product Data or Product Portfolio work center-Select Materials view-Search and highlight the Material-Select Edit button-Here, in the field Details, you can maintain additional information or Description about the Material.-Keywords-Material, Product Portfolio, Product Data, Material Description, 40 characters
