Any depreciation or transfer postings must be manually adjusted or reversed.-If it is not possible to change the organizational assignment of the fixed asset it can be considered to mark the cancellation supplier invoice as irrelevant from the backend via Support.-However, marking the reversal document as irrelevant will cause a technical inconsistency as the original invoice will still appear as canceled in Supplier Invoicing whereas it appears as posted in Accounting.-This inconsistency must be balanced by-creating a supplier credit memo to clear the original invoice amount,-adjusting the expense generated from the depreciation calculation, for example through a Special Depreciation posting,-retiring the fixed asset via a manual complete scrapping posting.-If you are aware of this technical inconsistency and take over full responsibility to balance this inconsistency on your side, please send an incident to the SAP Cloud Product Support requesting and permitting to mark the cancellation invoice as irrelevant from the backend.-Note: As usual, if the issue can be reproduced in your test environment, we comment to apply the correction first in the test tenant to then proceed with the same in production.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Organizational Unit, Reversal of posting not possible as fixed asset, assigned to a different organizational unit, retry after changing the organizational assignment in fixed asset-fixed asset,organizational unit,reversal of posting not possible as fixe,assigned to a different organizational u,retry after changing the organizational

Title: How to Filter Purchase Requests Having Life Cycle Status: In Preparation?
Content: Symptom-User wants to filter the purchase request which are having status "In preparation" while creating the purchase order in the "Open purchase request view"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Purchase request and order work center-2. Go to Purchase request view-3. Choose "open purchase request" from drop down-4. User notices many purchase requests with Life Cycle Status: "In preparation"-Resolution-In the "Open purchase request" view.-There is a column named "Follow-on process" in adaptation mode, here this column has two values one is "Blocked" and another is "Not Blocked"-For the purchase request which are available to create the Purchase order and "Life cycle status" is "released" they have the value as "Not Blocked".-However for the  purchase request which are not available to create the Purchase order and "Life cycle status" is "In preparation" they have the value as "Blocked".-User can use this column as a filter to differentiate while the user is creating the purchase order.-Keywords-Purchase request; Purchase order creation from purchase request; Life cycle status of purchase request; Open purchase request; adaptation mode; filter

Title: Agent Admin UI Language determination
Content: Symptom-You are working with SAP Solution Manager Agent Adminitration, which is a JAVA stack application, and want to change the Language.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Resolution-Language is determined by user configuration in ABAP stack - SU01 or JAVA Stack - User Management.-As Agent Administration is part of SAP Solution Manager JAVA stack, you can review SAP Note 1129932 - Issues with mapping of locales between UME and AS Java  and 947081 - Locales, languages, date and time formats in Web Dynpro

Title: Export to Excel Fails With 500 SAP Internal Server Error
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use the Export to Microsoft Excel functionality, but your attempt is triggering the following exception:-500 SAP Internal Server Error-Error: Access using a 'ZERO' object reference is not possible. (termination: RABAX_STATE).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-This can occur for any of the documents which support exporting to Excel. For example:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Org Structures work center view.-Click Export > To Microsoft Excel.-The technical exception will be raised.-Cause-When the user performs the export to Excel, the styles for the content are actually retrieved from the Master Template.-The above exception is thrown when the particular style in the Master Template is missing.-Resolution-Go to the Master Template Maintenance work center view.-In Cloud for Customer, under the Administrator work center.-In Business ByDesign, under the Application and User Management work center.-Select the row with the master template for Microsoft Excel.-Click the Versions button.-Select the previous SAP provided version and click Revert.-Now the export to Excel should work as expected.-Keywords-Export, Excel, Internal Server Error, 'ZERO' object reference

Title: 'Error in line 8: 12 Element; maximum line length of 8 exceeded' Error On New Bank Directory File Upload
Content: Symptom-Error message upon uploading New Bank Directory:-'Error in line 8: 12 Element; maximum line length of 8 exceeded'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center-Go to the Master Data -> Bank Directory view.-Click New -> Bank Directory File Upload.-Select the format as SAP Template and upload the file in ".csv" format.-Click Next.-Click Finish.-Error is displayed:-'Error in line 8: 12 Element; maximum line length of 8 exceeded'-Cause-In Excel Bank Directory file in .csv format, in line 8, element 12, which corresponds to field name "Valid To" the maximum line length of 8 was exceeded, since you have entered a value for the Valid To date with more than 8 characters, for example: "99991231,".-Resolution-Change value to have 8 characters, for example, "99991231" and upload the Bank Directory File again.-See Also-Help Document: SAP Format for Bank Directory Upload-Keywords-bank directory file upload; csv; valid to

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error
Content:
Symptom-When you click on the Release button inside the Customer Invoice or on the Invoice Documents view a dump error is happening.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Invoice Documents view.-Search for the Invoice ID EFG (EFG represents the Invoice ID you are trying to release).-Select and Click on the release button.-A dump error occurs:-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Response--500 SAP Internal Server Error--

500 SAP Internal Server Error

-
500 SAP Internal Server Error

500 SAP Internal Server Error


- Open the document and click on View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow.-There is a Process communication error in the Sales Order:- - Sales Order xxxx cannot process an update sent by an external consumer.-Cause-Cash Discount Terms (CDT) is maintained in the invoice which means Full Payment End Date becomes mandatory, since the Full Payment End Date is not maintained the system is throwing a Dump.-If there is no Cash Discount Terms assigned, the System will automatically capture the Baseline date as the Full Payment End Date (Due Date).-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -In case you have Cash Discount Terms (CDT) maintained, Full Payment End Date must be maintained too.-See Also-2597986 - Dump Occurs While Releasing a Customer Invoice-Keywords-release, released, Internal Server Error, customer invoice, dump, Cash Discount Terms (CDT).

Title: Error Message: Bank Account ABC does not Support Payment Method Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-When you make an outgoing payment, the system gives the following error message: Bank account ABC does not support payment method Bank Transfer.-(Here ABC refers to Bank Account ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-View the related Supplier account.-Choose an open item.-Click Pay Manually By->Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Select the Payee Data and Bank Transfer Data as per your requirement.-Choose Complete Bank Data.-The following error is raised by the system:-Bank account ABC does not support payment method Bank Transfer- (Or)-Go to the Payment Management work center, and choose New Outgoing Check under Common Tasks.-Specify the Company ID, Payee, Payment amount and currency, as well as Bank Account ID.-Set the payment Reference to Items.-In the Open Items table, select the target open item, and then choose Complete Bank Data.-The system gives error message: Bank account ABC does not support payment method Bank Transfer.-Cause-The error is caused by insufficient definitions for a Payment Method and for a particular Bank Account (e.g. International Bank Transfer).-In addition - corresponding payment formats, if applicable, have to be properly set-up in order to facilitate a bank transfer by a house-bank.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Select My Bank view.-Select the Bank XYZ.-Edit Bank Accounts.-Select Payment Method tab.-Click on Add Row tab and maintain the Payment Method (Ex:International bank transfer).-Choose Save.-Also, you need to maintain the correct Payment Format which supports by your Bank.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-My Banks view.-Select the Bank XYZ and go to Payment Formats tab.-Click on Add Row tab and maintain the correct Payment Format.-Choose Save.-You should be able to successfully make the outgoing bank payment from this bank account.-Keywords-Bank account doesnot support payment method, Payment method bank transfer, Bank account

Title: Issue in Calculation of Revenue Recognition for Contracts For a Straight Line Accrual Method.
Content: Symptom-User observes that the system is calculating the Revenue Recognition Run for 13 months instead of 12 months for a Straight Line Accrual Method.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Revenue Recognition Runs view. -Search for the required Run ID for the Contract ABC.-Check the Contract Start Date and End Date.-User observes that the run is calculating for 13 months instead of 12 months.-Cause-The accrual method is '303 - Straight-line – even periods' assigned for the Contract item ABC and the Contract start date is DD-MM-YYYY  and the Contract end date is DD1-MM-YYYY and these dates fall in 13th period as well and the revenue recognition is calculating for the 13 periods. -(Here ABC refers to a contract item)-Resolution-It is the standard behavior of SAP ByDesign for this accrual method.

Title: Error: 'Revoking Fiscal Year XYZ Forbidden: Allow Opening Closestep in Next Year
Content: Symptom-When you try to reopen a fiscal year and edit it, the system gives an error: 'Revoking fiscal year XYZ forbidden: Allow opening closestep in next year'.-(XYZ represents the fiscal year)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Master Data view and there open the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies subview.-Find and mark the respective set of books and select Edit Fiscal Years.-Mark the respective fiscal year XYZ and press Reopen Fiscal Year.-You get an error message: 'Revoking fiscal year XYZ forbidden: Allow opening closestep in next year'.-Cause-In the Open and Close periods tab, for the following fiscal year DEF, the first allowed step for period 001 is not set to 001- Opening Balance.-(DEF represents the next fiscal year in regards to fiscal year XYZ)-Resolution-In the General Ledger workcenter go to the Master Data view and there to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies subview.-Select the respective set of books/ company combination and click on Open and Close periods.-Navigate to period 001 of fiscal year DEF.-In order to reopen the previous fiscal year XYZ go to the period 001 of the following year DEF.-In the First Allowed Step column select: 001- Opening Balance from the drop-down menu.-Repeat this step for all set of books assigned to the company (- on the top of the table you can change the set of books in the Set of Books ID field)-Keywords-Revoking, Fiscal year, Allow opening closestep in next year, Open and Close periods,

Title: The Change Immediately Button Is Greyed Out For Some Activities
Content: Symptom-You want to change a Fine Tune Acitivity immediately, but the Change Immediately button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Open Overview view.-3. Find and mark the relevant activity (e.g. Number Ranges for Materials).--You expect that you can change the activity immediately, but the Change Immediately button is greyed out.-Cause-Each application checks the risk factor of an activity in order to activate the function Change Immediately for it.--If a Change Immediately of the data in the productive tenant is too risky, the function Change Immediately will be disabled (greyed out).-  Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.--We recommend to create a new Change Project for the respective activity in order to perform the planned changes-in a test system and to check the consistency of the changes there. --See Also-Keywords-Change Immediate, Change immediate disable for activity, Change Immediate greyed out , Unable to edit activities using Change Immediate

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice Source Document in Closing Cockpit After Maintaining Cost Distribution Correctly
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice in the Closing Cockpit after maintaining the cost distribution for the invoice items. You have maintained the correct Goods and Services Receipts (GSRs) references while setting some referenced GSRs to 0% as the Remove button is not enabled. However you get such errors:-'Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order DEF item DEF-X in accounting.'-'Processing supplier invoice GHI, version X impossible due to errors in version 1. First resolve the tasks of the business transaction for accounting for supplier invoice GHI, version 1, then post the business transactions for accounting again.'-ABC means the goods and service receipt ID.-DEF means the purchase order ID.-GHI means the supplier invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Select the query Show: Unposted Source Documents.-Find the supplier invoice.-Choose Actions and then Post Business Transactions.-You get the errors:-'Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order DEF item DEF-X in accounting.'-'Processing supplier invoice GHI, version X impossible due to errors in version 1. First resolve the tasks of the business transaction for accounting for supplier invoice GHI, version 1, then post the business transactions for accounting again.'-Cause-The invoice still references the old GSRs even though the percentage allocated = 0%.-Resolution-You need to cancel the supplier invoice, then mark the new cancellation invoice as Irrelevant in Accounting. This will mark the original invoice as irrelevant too. Afterward, create a new invoice and check the cost distribution for the items. The GSR references should be correct and in case they are not correct, you can delete an old GSR reference manually as the button Remove will be enabled.-Keywords-GSR, cancellation, mark as irrelevant

Title: The Button 'Immediately Change' Is Disabled
Content: Symptom-You want to make an immediately change for some business. But when you go the Business Configuration Work Center, you find that the button Immediately Change is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center. -Go to the View Overview.-You will see the  button Immediately Change is disabled-Cause-You need to specify which activity you are going to edit first.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center -Go to View Overview-Show All in Business Configuration Search-In the search bar, search the activity you are going to edit-In the search result find the activity-Now, you will find the button Immediately Change is enabled.-See Also-Keywords- Immediately Change, Business Configuration, Activity, BYD, C4C

Title: '1166 - Valor del campo TipoImpositivo no esta incluido en la lista de valores permitidos' Error in Spain SII VAT Return
Content: Symptom-In Spain SII - Incoming Invoices tax return, the Supplier Invoice ABC was Rejected due to Error 1166 - Valor del campo TipoImpositivo no esta incluido en la lista de valores permitidos.-ABC means the Supplier Invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view -> VAT Returns subview.-Find and open the respective Tax Return, with Tax Return Type SII - Incoming Invoices.-Click View All and move to Tax Return tab.-Find Document ID ABC with Acceptance Status Rejected, Error Code 1166 and Error Description 'Valor del campo TipoImpositivo no esta incluido en la lista de valores permitidos'.-Cause-Invoice ABC contains a tax code tied to a tax event assigned to an obsolete tax rate type/tax rate.-For example, invoice ABC contains tax code 14 - Travel Agency Services (tied to tax event 14 - Travel Agency Services), which is assigned to tax rate type 5 - Special Travel Agencies, with tax rate 6% (this can be checked in fine tuning activity Tax on Goods and Services).-The Special Travel Agencies tax rate type for Travel Agency Services doesn't exist anymore.-Resolution- If you need to enter a supplier invoice under a Travel Agency regime you should use either tax code 36 - Exempt Acquisition Travel Regime 05 (with Tax Rate Type Zero) or 37 - Domestic Acquisition, Standard Rate, Non-Deductible, Travel Regime 05 (with Tax Rate Type Standard), depending on your needs.-Keywords-Spain SII; Incoming Invoices; approval status; Partially Approved; 1166; rejected

Title: Error Message: Company ABC Set of Books: No Fiscal Year is maintained
Content: Symptom-You want to update or enter the inventory cost for a material.-In the Valuation master data tab you verify that the company - business residence combination is active.-However, the Edit Cost function is grayed out (if you try to enter the data manually for the first time) or an error message appears when trying to update the previously migrated value: "Company ABC Set of Books XYZ : No Fiscal Year YYYY is maintained' (ABC represents the company ID, XYZ represent the set of books ID, YYYY represents the missing fiscal year). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Product Data work center go to the Materials view. -Find material FGH (FGH represents the material ID). -Press Edit and then View All. -Go to the Valuation tab.-Select a company- business residence combination.-The error message "Company ABC Set of Books XYZ : No Fiscal Year YYYY is maintained" appears.-Cause-For the company ABC - set of books XYZ combination no fiscal year is maintained.-Resolution-Maintain a fiscal year for company ABC and set of books XYZ:-In the General Ledger go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view. -Find set of books XYZ in combination with company ABC.-Press Edit Fiscal Years. -You notice that no fiscal year exists.-Press New Fiscal Year. -Press Save and close. -You should now be able to enter the inventory cost for the material.-See Also-2137781 - Error Message : Company ABC: Already Assigned To A Different Set Of Books

Title: Cash Discount Applied Even After the Due Date Applicable for the Discount
Content: Symptom-You have created the payment for the customer and you observe that Cash Discount was applied although payment is posted after the period for discount calculation has expired.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customers Accounts view.-Click Account ID.-Select Show Cleared Items.-Select Payment ID XYZ (XYZ means the Payment ID), and choose Edit.-Under the General tab, you can see the Cash Discount has been applied.-The Maximum Cash Discount Due Date is before the posting date.-Cause-This issue is caused by the configuration of Payment Strategies in your system. You can find the Payment Strategies settings by following below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the Payment Strategies activity.-Click Edit payment strategies.-Here you can see the checkbox of Always Take Maximum Cash Discount checked. It means the system should always take the maximum possible discount, even though the discount period might have already elapsed, the discount is taken regardless of the payment date.-Resolution-You can un-check the Always Take Maximum Cash Discount for the relevant Payment Strategies to make sure that Cash Discount is only until the valid Due Date for the discount.-Keywords-skonto nach frist, discount after payment term, due date,

Title: Almost all Numbers in Number Range for XYZ are Reserved
Content: Symptom-You receive an incident stating Almost all numbers in number range for XYZ reserved, (XYZ represents the Number Range Object Long Text and Interval Number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Incidents view.-You noticed that the system created an incident with below description (Example):-Health Check Component: Cross-Application Services-Health Check Name: Number Range Depletion-Description: The system is running out of unique numbers for a particular number range. When this occurs, the system does not allow you to create a new business document or master data, depending on which number range is affected. You must extend your existing number range.-Number Range Profile Name: FIAADO-Number Range Type Name: FIAADO_0002-Number Range Object Name: FIA_ACCDOC-Number Range Object Long Text: FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT-Number Range Subobject Name: 000001-Year: 2021-Interval Number: 60-Remaining Percent Level: 3 %-Warn when less than % remain: 6 %-Cause-This is an automatic system alert, which aims to inform that for a specific document, its number range has almost no available numbers/IDs left, hence the related business transaction would not be created.-Resolution-Within the error description in the incident, there are two important fields: Number Range Object Long Text and Interval Number-The number range object in the above example is FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT, which stands for the business object of journal entries. The message also mentions the interval numbers 60 for year 2021.-Therefore, it is known that for fiscal year 2021 the system is running out of numbers for journal entries with interval number 60.-To check and adjust the number ranges, please follow below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open the activity Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges.-Click Edit number range profiles for journal entries.-In this screen you'll be able to edit the number ranges.-However if all the number ranges have been assigned to a Key you will not be able to edit the First Number and Last Number without coming up against error messages.-In this example we have a warning against Key 60.-Under Number Ranges you can see that for Key 60: First Number: 600000000001 and Last Number: 609999999999-You can also see that Key 61 shows: First Number: 610000000001 and Last Number: 619999999999-Select Edit Journal Entry Type Assignments.-Search for Number Range 61 - 610000000001 - 619999999999.-This brings up no results.-This means that Key 61 has not been assigned to any Journal Entry Type.-As you are not able to edit the Number Range. We need to edit the Journal Entry Number Range Assignment.-Search for Number Range 60 - 600000000001 - 609999999999.-This shows us a list of Journal Entry Types that are associated to the Number Range 60 - 600000000001 - 609999999999.-Edit the Number Range for all the Journal Entry types shown to now become 61 - 610000000001 - 619999999999.-See Also-2774212 - Almost all Numbers in Number Range are Reserved-Business Configuration Documents: Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges-Keywords-Number Range, Journal Entry, Accounting Document, Journal Entry Type Assignments, Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges, FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT

Title: Graphic view in report cannot be displayed
Content: Symptom-The report can show data in the table view. However, you would like your report to be shown in a graphic view, and it cannot be displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Reports view.-Click on Report: XX.-You can see the information is showing correctly.-But when you select graphic view such as 'Bar', no information is displayed.-Cause-When the node levels are high, or the data volume is high or both.-The categorization of the data by the reporting structure is causing the issue in generating the graph.-Resolution-It is the standard expected behavior. One suggestion (if possible) could be try and create reporting structures where less data is selected this will improve the report performance and possibly resolve graphical issues as well. -Keywords-Graphic view, no information, report, bar

Title: Reverse Tax Payment for a Replaced Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse a tax payment, however the system informs that its cancellation failed.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments view.-Find the related tax payment and click Reverse.-The following errors are raised:-Cancellation of tax payment XYZ failed. (XYZ represents the Tax Payment ID).-Cancellation of document <ID> failed-Action Reopen not possible; action is disabled-Cause-The tax payment that you are trying to reverse is paying a tax return with status Replaced, which means that after the tax return was paid, and hence completed, a correction run was executed for the same and created a new tax return.-Resolution-Since the tax payment reversal is being made with reference to the amended tax return, the return that amends this Tax Return has to be reversed first.-You can easily track these documents via bellows steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments view.-Edit your tax payment.-In the Tax Return Details, open the associated tax return. You see that this return is Replaced.-Click the tax return ID on the field Corrected By: The correction return is opened.-After reversing the correction return, you are able to reverse the tax payment.-Keywords-Tax payment, Reverse Tax Payment

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Run with Description as Recalculation after Configuration Change Company XYZ
Content: Symptom-There is a depreciation run with description as 'Recalculation after configuration change company XYZ' generated by system automatically, but you noticed that no postings were done via this depreciation run.-XYZ means the Company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center-Go to the Periodic Tasks view and click Depreciation subview.-Open depreciation named 'Recalculation after configuration change company XYZ' (you can see it is generated by Technical User (SAP_LMADM)).-Cause-This is an expected system behavior. The system behaves in this manner whenever any changes occur in either Business Configuration or Org Structure which can directly or indirectly affect the fixed asset or depreciation of the fixed asset. The system runs this depreciation run for the open periods in order to bring the planned depreciation value in line with the current changes that are made in the system. This run, that is conducted by the system, will not generate any postings. Moreover, as you can see from the run description, the changes are done in the Org Structure or Business Configuration.--The depreciation run is triggered with Period/Year 999/9999, the planned depreciation is recalculated for all open periods. This is the same as you use the function Recalculate Adjustment on the Values tab in fixed asset master data. This recalculation is to ensure all the fixed assets' depreciation values are correct at any time.-Resolution-No action is necessary from your side.-Keywords-recalculation; fxa; recalculate adjustment; depreciation; fixed asset

Title: 'Value exceeds maximum length 25' Error Message in Supplier Bank Account Prioritization
Content: Symptom-Error while adding entry in Supplier Bank Account Prioritization view:-'Value exceeds maximum length 25'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2308--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find and open Global Settings for Payment activity.-Click Prioritize Supplier Bank Accounts for Automatic Payments.-Click Add Row.-Enter data in all fields, including field IBAN/Account Number.-Click Save and Activate.-Error is thrown:-'Value exceeds maximum length 25'.-Cause-Even though there are country specific logic implemented in the system for IBAN number verification, when it comes to Prioritize Supplier Bank Accounts for Automatic Payments, under Global Settings for Payment activity, some business rules are configured in the system. Under such rules, IBAN number field is restricted to 25 characters. This is how system is designed so far.-Resolution-You have to accommodate the IBAN within such limitation.-SAP Product Management Team is discussing regarding addressing such limitation in a future SAP Business ByDesign Release.-Keywords-supplier bank account; IBAN; maximum length

Title: Non-Localized Country: Withholding Tax Return Run Not Displayed Even Though It Was Created Successfully
Content: Symptom-You've successfully created a Withholding Tax Return Run for a non-localized country/region in the system, however while checking the Withholding Tax Return Runs list, the Run ID you've just created is not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks > Withholding Tax Return Runs view.-Select Show All Tax Return Runs.-Notice that the Withholding Tax Return Run that you've just created is not displayed.-Cause-While creating the Tax Declaration Profile for the concerned non-localized country/region in SAP Cloud Applications Studio, in the Tax Return Types node you did not maintain the appropriate Object Type Code for withholding taxes. The Object Type Code specifies whether withholding taxes or product taxes shall be reported. For withholding taxes, enter ‘134’.-Resolution-You should maintain Object Type Code as '134' for withholding taxes.-See Also-For further information please refer to the Localization Toolkit, Category Tax > Subtopic Withholding Tax > Documentation How To enable Withholding Tax content for non-localized countries/regions in the SAP Cloud Applications studio-Remark: The work zone SAP Business ByDesign - Localization in which the Localization Toolkit document is stored is a closed group. Please Report an incident to SAP requesting access to this group in case you are not able to access the above link. In the incident, you should provide your name, e-mail address and explicitly request access to work zone SAP Business ByDesign - Localization.-Blog: Enable Withholding Tax for Non-Localized Countries/Regions in SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return Run; BC Set; Tax Declaration Profile; A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT; Tax Return Types; Object Type Code; 134

Title: Depreciation Overview Does Not Show Any Values For Some Periods
Content: Symptom-You navigate the Depreciation Overview tab of the Fixed Asset ABC and you don't see any Planned depreciation values for some periods. You expect to see the Planned depreciation in the depreciation starting from the period the asset was capitalized. (ABC represents the Fixed Asset ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Find and select the fixed asset ABC.-Click on Edit button and choose Values.-Select the Depreciation Overview subtab.-You will see that planned depreciation is not shown for some periods.-Cause-This is a migrated Fixed Asset and it was migrated with the posting date of XX.YY.ZZZZ. So the historical depreciation until the date XX.YY.ZZZZ was migrated and hence it will not show up in the Depreciation Overview. (XX.YY.ZZZZ represents the date on which the Fixed Asset was migrated)-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. System will not show any Planned Depreciation values until the migration posting date. It will show the Planned Depreciation from period after the migration posting date. System will adjust the depreciation amount in the next period which means any differences between the calculated depreciation until the migration date and migrated depreciation will be posted on the period after the migration posting date.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Depreciation

Title: Frequently Asked Questions Regarding Employee Self-Services and Manager Self-Services
Content: Symptom-Below are some frequently asked questions regarding Employee Self-Services and Manager Self-Services.-*X and Y represents the days-*PQR and XYZ represents the Employees-*XXXXX represents the Organizational Unit-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1.   User is not able to see the Time related options in Self-Services Overview in Home Workcenter-The relevant scoping questions are not scoped in Business Configuration workcenter.-2.   User is not able to see the link New Leave Request in Self-Services Overview in Home Workcenter-User is a Service Agent (external Employee) or the system has not been scoped to include the possibility of Employees to create leave request in the Employee Self-Services.-Or-Scoping Question missing in Implementation Project.-Follow below steps to scope relevant question:-Business Configuration-Current Implementation Project-Edit Project-Navigate to Questions-Select element Human Resource - Time and Labor Management - Time Recording-Select Question : Do you want your employees to submit leave requests using employee self-service?-3.   You are not able to maintain the Employee contact data in Self-Services.-If you have not scoped the Personal Administration as a scoping element, you will not be able to use the Employee Self-Services.-4.   When you request leave for 'Y' days through Employee Self-Services, only 'X' days are shown as deducted. The number of days deducted seems less than the    applied leaves.-There might be some days which are Public Holidays during leave period as per the Holiday Calendar. Hence the system will not consider the holidays and count only working days.-5. You, as a line manager, find that some Time Recording approval Tasks do not appear in the Approvals view of the Managing My Area work center.-For Time Types of category Vacation, Leave, Illness and Special Attendance, the approval options are maintained as follows:-a. Go to the Business Configuration work center-b. Select the Implementation Projects view-c. Go to the Fine-tune tab-d. Search and Open the fine-tune activity Time Types – <Country name>-e. Select Maintain Approval Options link-The approval Tasks for the Vacation, Leave, Illness and Special Attendance Time Types can be found in Manager's Approvals view in Managing My Area workcenter.-The approval Task for time recordings on Project Task cannot be seen in Managing My Area workcenter. The Project Manager must go to Project Management work center, Approvals view and Time Recordings sub-view to approve them.-For Time Types of category Productive Times and others, the approval option is configured centrally by a scoping question:-a. Go to the Business Configuration work center-b. Select the Implementation Projects view-c. Select the Edit Project Scope button of the respective Project-d. Go to Questions step-e. Expand Human Resources-f. Time and Labor Management-g. Select Approvals and scope the question Would you like your managers to be able to approve or reject their employees' time sheets for the <Country> in the system?-The approval Tasks for Time Recordings on Time Types of Time Type Category Productive Time, but not on Project Task can be seen by the Confirm Time Recordings link under Common Tasks in Managing My Area-6.   Why can't the substitutes of Managers see all data in My Team and Team Calendar within Work Center Managing My Area?-An Administrator can enter a substitution for an Employee, so that the substitute can access the same data as the Manager (see work center Application and User Management ->  work center view Substitutions).-If the substituted Employee is a Manager with access to the work center Managing My Area and work center view My Team, the Substitute will not be able to access the following data:-The view My Team does not show the employees of the substituted Manager-The Common Task Team Calendar does not show the Employees of the substituted Manager-7.   Why can't the user see any Employee or the absence of the Employees in Managing My Area, although the user has full access to the Managing My Area workcenter-The My Team view in Managing My Area is specific to the Manager. So the Manager can see the list of Employees assigned to his/her own Org Unit or Cost Center.-If you are not assigned to any Org Unit as a Manager, you cannot see any Employees in the My Team view or Team Calender.-Check in the Organizational Management work center, whether you have been assigned to an Org Unit as the Manager and also confirm that the Org Unit has at least one Employee assigned.-8.   You, as a line Manager, observe that the Employee information in the Managing My Area displays only partial information which seems to be minimal.-The system works as designed. If you access an Employee through the Managing My Area work center, whatever information displayed is relevant to the essential information required by a Manager, because only Managers have access to the Managing My Area work center.-If you want more Personnel information about the Employee, you can open Employee's Personnel file in the Personnel Administration workcenter.-9.   You as a Manager (Internal Employee or Service Agent), cannot find any of your reporting Employees in Managing My Area work center.-The system works as designed. If your assignment as Manager is ended for that Org Unit, then the Employees will not be displayed under your team.-This can be verified in Organizational Management work center by providing the exact Effective From date.-10. The Organizational Unit Manager is not able to view all the Employees of Org Unit in the Team Calendar in Managing My Area workcenter.-The system works as designed. The Organizational Unit Manager will be Service Agent (external Employee). Hence he/she is not able to view the Employees of Org Unit in the Team Calendar.-11. A Manager assigned a Employee/Manager as a Substitute but in Call Employee Services on behalf feature, Employee those who belongs to Manager is not visible to the Substitute.-At present, a Substitute can find the Tasks of the Manager and can do required actions on that but the Employees belongs to that Manager will not be visible to the Substitute-12. Employee Who is a Substitute is not able to see the Details of the substituted Employee in Team Calendar-Example: In the workcenter Application and User Management, view Substitutions, Employee PQR has Substituted Employee XYZ. But when Employee PQR launches the Team Calendar via workcenter Managing My Area, he/she can find Employee XYZ's mentees under the Organizational Unit XXXXX, but cannot see Employee XYZ itself.-Substitution of Employee does not give authorization to the Substitute to see the details of the Employee, whom he had Substituted.-The system works as designed. Here Employee PQR has Substituted Employee XYZ, which means Employee PQR can Work On Behalf Of Employee XYZ only for those Employees who report to Employee XYZ. But Employee PQR does not have authorization to see the details of Employee XYZ.-13. You as a Manager, are not able to view the Employee XYZ in your Team Calendar-The relevant Time Model has not been assigned to the Employee XYZ. The Time Administrator needs to assign the Time Model to the Employee XYZ.-14. You are not able to maintain a substitution for an employee as the employee is not visible for selection in the search help.-      While creating substitutions, only employees who have at least one business role assigned, will be listed.-15. A Time Type of Vacation is approved automatically by the system, even though when an Approval is required.-The vacation was approved because a manager was not assigned at the time of the requested vacation. Transfers of employees in personnel file led to the fact that their assignments as manager were removed, and the actual changes was not visible in detail in org. management.-16. Is it possible for Service Agents to access the Holiday Calendar ?-No, because Service Agent is an External Employee-17. Some old Employee Times appeard back in Manager's Approval List in the list of times To Be Approved. How to hide them?-       In case you want to remove unwanted old Approvals from your list of tasks, please use Advanced Filter Option to add Date and save the query  from current year.-Select Manage My Area woorkcenter-Select Approvals view-Under Open Tasks-Use Advanced Filter-Select Date : Filter - Greater than Current Year-Press Go-Save Query-Keywords-Time Model, Team Calendar, Manager Self-Services, Employee Self-Services, Frequently Askes Question, Time Management, Employee, Manager, Self-Services.

Title: Error Message: Payment Correspondence Profile Missing for Payment Medium Format XYZ and Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-Error message upon posting a bank transfer: 'Payment Correspondence Profile Missing For Payment Medium Format XYZ and Bank Transfer'.-XYZ represents the Payment Medium Format.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center.-Click New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Fill the required data and click Post.-System shows the error message below:-'Payment Correspondence Profile Missing For Payment Medium Format XYZ and Bank Transfer'.-Cause-In the Business Configuration activity Outgoing Bank Transfer, Payment Medium Format is either not assigned to the Payment Method and Payment Correspondence Profile, or it has been assigned to Payment Method with specific Origin of Paid Item.-Origin of Paid Item: when maintaining the specific value for this field, system allows creation of payment from related work centers only.-For example: If Payment Medium Format XYZ is assigned to Bank Transfer and Payment Correspondence Profile with Origin of Paid Item as Trade payables, system allows the creation of the bank transfer from Payables work center but not from Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation Project and click Open activity list.-Navigate to the Fine tune tab.-Search and Open Activity: Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Click Edit assignment of payment correspondence profiles to payment medium formats.-Select Row with the desired payment medium format.-Under the details section of the screen, click Add Row.-Maintain Payment Method and respective Payment Correspondence profile, keeping field Origin of Paid Items blank.-Click Save.-Now when creating a new Payment system will not raise the error message.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Outgoing Bank Transfers - Configuration Guide-Keywords-Bank Transfer, Payment Format, Payment Correspondence Profile

Title: No Open Items are Listed to be Matched when Creating a new Incoming Check
Content: Symptom-When you create a new incoming check, after the company and the payer is entered, no payer relevant open items are listed as possible match.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-From the Common Tasks pane, click on the New Incoming check link.-On the screen New Incoming check, enter the mandatory data for the company and the payer.-Let the Payment Application method set  to Reference to Items as default.-No open items are retrieved to be matched for payment in the Open Items list.---Cause-When a payment, regardless the payment type and payment form, is initiated for the first time, the currency to be used in the payment is not defaulted. Therefore it is not possible to list the payer relevant open items to be matched.-The matched item list shows open items relevant for the payer (invoices and payments), on the payment there is a check implemented which required the currency therefore if no currency is specified no open items can be shown (including open invoices).-Resolution-The first time a payment is initiated, the payment currency has to be entered manually in the New Incoming Check screen in the Currency area of the Payment Amount field. The Open Items list will then show the payer relevant open items.-Keywords-Incoming Check, Default, Open Items, Currency

Title: KUT Fields from Employee Time Sheet do not Appear for Service Agents
Content: Symptom-After adding extension fields to the employee time sheet (in Time Administration - Time Sheet), the same fields are not available in the adaptation mode of the service agents time sheet (in Service Agents - Edit Time Sheet).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-You have created some extension fields through adaption mode on "Time Administration - Time Sheet" for employee time entries. You want the same set of extension fields on "Project Management - Service Agents" for service agents.-Cause-The fields added to the employee time sheet are only available for internal employees. The view in Service agents work center currently does not allow the addition of extension fields. The same constraint applies to the Employee self-service (ESS) Time sheet.-Service Agent shares the Employee Business Object Instance, that will have an indicator as External.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-Timesheet, KUT, Service Agent, Time Sheet, Employee, Time Administration.

Title: Incorrect Maximum Cash Discount Shown in Customer Accounts When Clearing an Open Invoice
Content: Symptom-You want to manually clear an open Customer Invoice in the Customer Accounts view. It seems the maximum cash discount is calculated incorrectly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we show the behaviour of a Customer Invoice to the amount of EUR 1626,00 with payment terms 8 days 2% discount.-Navigate to the Receivables work center.-Go into Customer Accounts view.-Navigate to the tab Trade Receivables -> Invoices / Payments.-Find the Customer Account you are referring to and click View.-Select the External Reference ID and click Clear manually.-The invoice shows the total value of EUR 1626,00 so you expect the maximum cash amount of 2 % to be EUR 32,52 (1626*0,02 = 32,52).-The maximum cash discount displayed is 15,72 EUR.-Cause-Not all items of the invoice are marked as relevant for cash discount. This can be checked by following the steps below:-In the New Manual Clearing view click the link of the Document ID to directly navigate to the document.-Below Items click the Product ID to view the product.-Click View all and navigate to the tab Sales.-Below Details you can see the checkbox Cash Discount Allowed is not ticked.-Resolution-This is the designed system behaviour. As one of the items is not allowed to have a cash discount applied, the maximum cash discount will only be calculated for the remaining items.-Keywords- maximum cash discount; cash discount allowed

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation to be Calculated Before Migration Date
Content: Symptom-You want to calculate depreciation for the fixed assets before migration date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Asset work center.-Go to Depreciation view.-Click New -> Depreciation.-Run Depreciation before migration date.-The system is not allowing to depreciate the asset before migration date.-Cause-Depreciation is always calculated from migration date, it is not advisable to calculate depreciation of assets before migration date.-Resolution-Regarding depreciation of a migrated asset with a date before the migration date, even if the depreciation start year is before the migration year, the depreciation starts only from migration start year.--You are supposed to migrate all the depreciations from the legacy systems, as we cannot create postings for any date before the migration start date.--If you calculate depreciations for the year before migration, then this we would have to add that depreciation values also to the year of migration that would be incorrect accounting as each year balance should go to that respective year only.-Keywords-Fixed assets, depreciation

Title: Outbound File Created in Format .TXT Instead of .XML
Content: Symptom-The format of the payment file created for an Outbound File is .TXT.-You expect the format to be .XML.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Outbound Files subview in the File Management view.-Search for Outbound File ABC (ABC is the Outbound file ID) and select it.-The status is confirmed.-Click the ID to open it.-Navigate to the Attachment tab.-The payment file is of type .TXT-Click the Display Log button.-The Application Log ID is DEF (DEF is the application log ID).-The Results originate from Payment File Register.-Navigate to the File Content tab.-The Status is Green.-The description is " Document ID GHI , payment of NN,NN EUR  to NAME , Ihre Spesenabrechnung JKL  Ihre Spesenabrechnung ".-(GHI is the document ID ; NN,NN is the amount in currency Euro; NAME is the name of the person/ supplier/ customer; JKL is the expense report ID; MNO is another expense report ID)-Cause-There are two reasons:-You have activated Domestic payment/ transfer and have not maintained all the required bank data which is necessary for SEPA.-The Payment File format is not one of the following:-SEPA_CT, SEPA_Direct_Debit_File, Swiss_ISO_20022_Payment_Format, ISO_20022_Payment_Format, Check_File JP_XML_DOMESTIC_PAYMENT_FORMAT.-For all other file formats like DE DTAUS0 Domestic Payment the file created would be .TXT format.-Resolution-You need to maintain the required bank data necessary for SEPA.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Search and select Payment proposal GHI created for Payee NAME.-The Status is Completed.-Click the ID to open the same.-Click View All.-There is a warning message: "IBAN required for country DE to support SEPA payments."-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Bank Payment Order is GHI.-Click the same to open it.-The Payment Medium Format Code is DE DTAUS0 Domestic Payment.-The Payment Method is Domestic bank transfer.-Under Payee Data: Payee is NAME.-IBAN is missing.-Complete the required details in the Payee's bank data to solve the issue.-  You have maintained the correct bank details, but the file created is still in .TXT format.-In this case, there are different or many Payment Medium Format Codes maintained under your Bank's Payment Method.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the My Banks subview in the Master Data view.-Search and select Bank MNO (MNO is the Bank ID).-Click Edit General.-Navigate to the Payment Formats tab.-Apart from SEPA, there are other Payment Medium Format Codes like DE DTAUS0 Domestic Payment maintained.-According to KBA 1882049, it is recommended to maintain only one of the major payment formats for each bank account (SEPA only instead of DTAUS and SEPA).-See Also-1882049 Modification of Payment Method and File Format for a Bank Account-Keywords-Ausgehende überweisung; Outbound file; Zahlung; Spesenabrechnung; Expense report; Payment, Bank payment order; SEPA; DTAUS; .xml; .txt; payment file

Title: How to Determine Service and Support Team in Service Request Documents
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to configure Service and Support team in Service Request documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Desk work center.-View: Common tasks.-Create New Service request.-Click on value help in Service and Support team option.-No Service and Support Team is determined.-The Criteria to Determine Service and Support Team - Service Request needs to be configured in Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to Business configuration work center.-View: Overview.-Search and open activity Criteria to Determine Responsibilities for Service Requests.-Select Criteria to Determine Service and Support Team - Service Request.-Choose the appropriate Criteria.-See Also-Service and Support Team for Service Requests | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Service Request, Service and Support, Service Desk

Title: How to Default Company and Currency for New Manual Payments
Content: Symptom-You wish to know how the system determines default Company and Currency when creating a new manual payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click New Incoming Check under Common Tasks.-For illustrating purposes, Incoming Check has been selected as payment method, however this remains true for outgoing checks and bank transfers.-Cause-The system automatically determines the Company and Currency details based on the last check created by the user.--In case you have never created a new check, the company and currency are not automatically populated, hence the fields remains in blank.-Resolution-Once a first check is created, Company and Currency are populated according to the data used in the last check created by the user.-For example, if you create a check in USD, the next check that you create will have USD as default currency. If you change to EUR, the subsequent check will have EUR defaulted for your user.-Keywords-Incoming Check, Default Company, Payment, Currency

Title: Dump Occurs When Cancelling a Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -You are unable to cancel Purchase Order because a dump is being triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID.-Click in Edit button.-Click in Cancel Purchase Order button. -The dump is triggered.-In the backend:-Go to transaction ST22. -Search for the dump according to the time frame you reproduced it. -Navigate to Active Calls / Events.-The information displayed is:-17 METHOD CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CP CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CM01A 96-CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER=>TRIGGER_SHORT_DUMP-16 METHOD CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CP CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CM00L 52-CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER=>FINALIZE_ESI_SAVE-15 METHOD CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CP CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CM005 165-CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER=>IF_ESF_SRVMGR_BEFORE_SAVE~ON_BEFORE_SAVE-14 METHOD CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CP CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CM03V 91-CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER=>IF_ESF_SM_TRANSACTION_CALLBACK~ON_BEFORE_SAVE_EVENT-13 METHOD CL_ESI_TRANSACTION_HANDLER====CP CL_ESI_TRANSACTION_HANDLER====CM001 152-CL_ESI_TRANSACTION_HANDLER=>IF_ESI_TRANSACTION_SAVE~SAVE-12 METHOD CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CP CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CM04H 119-CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICES_TRANSACT~SAVE_TRANSACTION-11 METHOD CL_ESF_LCP_FACADE=============CP CL_ESF_LCP_FACADE=============CCIMP 114-LCL_LCP_TRANSACTION=>IF_ESF_LCP_TRANSACTION~SAVE_TRANSACTION-10 METHOD CL_ESF_ACP====================CP CL_ESF_ACP====================CM009 54-CL_ESF_ACP=>IF_ESF_ACP~SAVE_TRANSACTION-Following the steps below you can check if the communication arrangement is being maintained correctly:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to General tab. -Double-click in the Supplier ID. -Click in View All button. -Navigate to Communication tab. -Navigate to Collaboration subtab.-Select 'Purchase Order' in Business Document Name. -Click in Maintain XML Settings button.-Navigate to Technical Data tab.-Click in Edit Advanced Settings button. -Navigate to Outbound subtab.-Click in Check Connection button.-You get the error messages:-Checking connection failed-Ping failed-Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: Processing error in Internet Communication Framework: ("ICF Error when receiving the response: ICM_HTTP_TIMEOUT") ()-Cause-The customer needs to ensure that the communication arrangement with the Supplier is successful. Otherwise the system prevents the cancellation being output by triggering the dump.-Resolution-First option: the customer can change the Output Channel for the canceled Purchase Order.-Open the Purchase Order.-Click in You Can Also button.-Maintain another Output Channel. -Second option: if the customer insists in using the communication arrangement with the Supplier as XML, they'd need to maintain it accordingly.-For that, please check below KBAs for help:-2604833 - ICM_HTTP_CONNECTION_BROKEN Error When Checking Connection in Communication Arrangement.-2926863 - Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Internal Server Error (500) While Performing Check Connection to Success Factors.-After that they will be able to cancel the Purchase Order.-See Also-KBA: 2604833 - ICM_HTTP_CONNECTION_BROKEN Error When Checking Connection in Communication Arrangement-KBA：2926863 - Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Internal Server Error (500) While Performing Check Connection to Success Factors-Keywords-Purchase Order; Cancel; Dump; Communication Arrangement; Supplier

Title: Invoice Split in Central Bank Reporting
Content: Symptom-The invoice amount is split in two lines in Central Bank Reporting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Go to Central Bank Reporting subview.-Select the Country and search for the supplier invoice in question.-You notice that for the single invoice, two lines with the amount split are displayed.-Cause-Cost Distribution is applied in the invoice, resulting in split of the invoice value in the central bank reporting.-This condition can be checked by following below steps:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit memos view.-Select the Invoice ABC (ABC indicates supplier invoice ID).-Click Edit and Navigate to Items tab.-Open Cost Distribution subtab.-Here you will observe that Distribution Additional Costs Proportionally is ticked and the invoice cost is distributed. As a result, in the Central Bank Reporting view for the same invoice you will find two lines with the amounts split as per the cost distribution applied in the invoice.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-cbr; central bank reporting; invoice split; SIV; cost distribution-central bank reporting,invoice split

Title: 'Material ABC, business residence DEF; financials assignment not active' Error Message in GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-GR/IR Clearing Run finished with error in Messages tab:-'Material ABC, business residence DEF; financials assignment not active' -ABC means the Material ID.-DEF means the Business Residence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the GR/IR Clearing view.-Find and open respective Run ID, with Processing Status Error.-Move to Messages tab.-Notice the error:-'Material ABC, business residence DEF; financials assignment not active' -Cause-For material ABC, Business Residence DEF and Company GHI (GHI is the Company ID for which you have executed the GR/IR Clearing Run), an Account Determination Group is missing in material master data.-Resolution-Maintain Account Determination Group in master data of material ABC, as follows:-Go to the Product Data work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Find material ABC and click Edit.-Click View All.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Under Companies/Business Residence section, click Add Row.-Enter Company GHI and Business Residence DEF.-Enter an Account Determination Group.-Click Save.-Change the Status from In Preparation to Active.-Click Save again.-After performing the above steps you should execute the GR/IR Clearing Run again and the Purchasing Document Item containing material ABC should be processed successfully.-Keywords-GR/IR; valuation; financials assignment; account determination group

Title: How to Mass Add New Material Description in Other Languages
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to enhance material description in other languages.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select the respective material and click Edit.-Select View All and Navigate to Other Languages sub tab under General tab.-You request to know how to add new Material Description in other Languages for multiple materials.-Resolution-You can mass add material description in other languages using Mass Data Maintenance and Material Migration Tool with Migration Mode Enhance already existing records.-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select Mass Data Maintenance view.-Click Export Materials link.-Navigate to Other Languages tab and select Export Data to CSV File.-Update the Other Language Description in the CSV File.-Select Import Materials link in Mass Data Maintenance.-Choose file and select Import Data to tab Other Languages.-Click Upload.-Or-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Migration of Materials activity.-Select Migration materials using the migration tool.-Upload the migration file with new language descirptions.-Select Properties and select Enhance already existing records in Migration Mode.-Select Execute Migration Step by Step.-Keywords- Material Description; Other Languages; Mass Data Maintenance; Material Migration; Enhance already existing records

Title: GR/IR clearing does not create any posting
Content: Symptom-You have ran the GR/IR clearing for an specific Purchase Order, however it has not shown any value in the Postings tab-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center > GR/IR Clearing View-Search for the Run ID: XXX and open it-Go to Postings tab-You notice there is no information available-Cause-The Purchase order is not fully delivered-Resolution-Make sure that the PO is fully delivered, or, if the item is marked for final clearing.-Marked items are cleared by the next GR/IR clearing run that is executed on or after the Marked Final Clearing Date.  --Help Documentation: Marked Final Clearing Date for Purchasing Document Items-See Also-KBA 2734512 Purchase Order Items Not Cleared by GR/IR Clearing Run -KBA 3106294 - Unmarked for Final Clearing Purchasing Document is Still Processed by the GR/IR Clearing Run-Keywords-PO, GR, IR, clearing, posting, value, Purchasing Documents, Line Items

Title: Vacation Time Account Balance Not Updated Despite Approval of Absence Request
Content: Symptom-Vacation time account balance for a particular employee is not updated in the employee details, even after the absence request has been approved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select the employee who has requested vacation leave, and the request has been approved by the manager.-Click Edit button.-Navigate to General tab, where remaining vacation days are not deducted under Time Accounts.-Cause-To deduct from the vacation account balance, it's essential to assign a work schedule to the employee because the balance is calculated based on the work schedule.-Resolution-Assign a work schedule to an employee by the following steps:-Go to Time Administration Work Center.-Select Employees View.-Search for the employee and select them.-Click Edit button.-Go to Time Profile tab.-Select the Work Schedule sub tab.-At this point, the user can choose to assign either a predefined work schedule or create an individual/customized one.-For individual one,  select 'Handle Holidays as' Average Values from the dropdown menu. After that, click the 'Add Row' button in the Individual Work Schedule section to assign the work schedule.-For predefined one, select a Time Model. If there is no predefined time model available follow the below steps:-Go to Time Models view.-Create at least one periodical model that can be used.-Click Save button. This action will save the work schedule in the employee's time file, and subsequently, the vacation account balance can be updated through the posting process.-Keywords-Vacation Time balance, Approval of Absence Request,  Time Balance-deducted

Title: VAT Return Correction Run error message "No reported tax return to be corrected was found".
Content: Symptom-You create and execute a VAT Return Run in order to correct an existing VAT Return, but the Application Log of the run reports the error message "No reported tax return to be corrected was found".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Open New, Tax Return Run.-Enter the relevant variables, including the option Correction Run and a validity period that does not exactly correspond with the period covered by the VAT Return to be corrected.-Save, activate and execute the run.-You get an error in the Application Log of the run that reads: No reported tax return to be corrected was found.-Cause-If the dates covered by the correction VAT Return Run deviate from those of the VAT Return to be corrected, the system will report that it is unable to find a corresponding VAT Return.-Resolution-In order for the system to correct a particular VAT Return, the correction VAT Return Run needs to cover the exact same dates as the original VAT Return. In order to avoid possible mistakes in the data entry while creating correction VAT Return Runs, it is recommended to proceed as follows:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Select the VAT Return to be corrected.-Go to Actions and then Schedule Correction Run.-This ensures that the data copied directly from the original VAT Return and the correction VAT Return Run can be executed without further issues.-Keywords-VAT Return, correction

Title: Error: Failure of the changes has time recording DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-When changing the status of a time recording for an employee from 'Pending' to 'Approved' for a specific period, you encounter the following error:--Error: Failure of the changes has time recording DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Recording view and select Time Sheet sub-view.-Search for the required Employee and select it.-Click Open Time Sheet button.-Click Go To button and select the required date DD/MM/YY.-You can see Status of the time recording is shown as Pending.-Click Release button and choose Selected Week option.-Error Message is displayed: Failure of the changes has time recording DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-There could be multiple reasons for this issue and one of possible cause is that the Approver is the same as the employee, when it should be the person who is responsible for the project.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-To resolve this, update the Approver, and the Approval Task will then be sent to the appropriate manager. Once approved, the Status will automatically change accordingly.-Keywords-Time Recording, Pending, Approved, Failure

Title: Unable to View Time Sheet Approvals
Content: Symptom-User is not able to view the Timesheet Approvals in Managing My Area however you are unable to view and approve the Timesheet through SAP ByD Mobile APP-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area Work Center-Select Approvals View.-Here you do not find Timesheet Approvals.- --Cause- Under Managing My Area Work Centre, Approvals View is used for approving the leaves only, not for Timesheet Approvals.-Resolution-Below are the options to find Timesheet Approvals.-OPTION 1:-Go to Managing My Area Work Center-Go to Common Tasks View-Select on Confirm Time recording view-OPTION 2:-Go to Project Management Work Center-Go to Approvals View-Select the Time Recordings-Keywords- Approvals , Timesheet Approvals, pending approvals

Title: Frequently Occurring issues with interface between SRM and CRM
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -If a case is received, your first step is to identify as quickly as possible if the root cause area lies in SRM or CRM side.-Following are some of the key points which suggest that the case could be related to SRM or CRM.-Work Center      Problem Type Expert Support Queue to be forwarded to-Service Entitlements-UI related issues i.e. Invoice schedule for Customer contracts in Contracts view-ES Applications - CRM-Customer Invoicing Any Issue related to Customer Invoice-ES Applications - CRM-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Key Terms to Identify the Business Area:-                                 Supplier Relationship Management                                     Customer Relationship Management-Supplier Invoice: A document that states the recipients (usually the buyer’s) obligation to pay the suppliers for materials received or services rendered. An invoice is normally created after the goods receipt or service receipt has been confirmed.-Customer Invoice: A document that states the invoiced customer’s obligations to the supplier of products. An invoice is normally created after the goods receipt or service performance has been confirmed.-List Prices: A work center view that allows a company to define pricing information for a material or a service as provided by a supplier. A list prices is used when there is no contract or catalog available for the supplier.-Price Lists: A work center view that allows you to define separate prices lists such as base price, customer discount, customer group discount, product discount, and product group discount-Purchasing Contract: A legally binding agreement between a buyer and a supplier that covers the supply of materials and services at specified conditions.-Customer Contract Management: A scenario that enables you to create and manage contracts related to services in the framework of your support entitlements or manage, it provides functions to handle services requests and service confirmations related to customer contracts. Additionally you can maintain price agreements and invoice schedules for contract items.-Keywords-SRM, CRM, Topic Responsibilities, List Prices, Price List, Supplier Invoice, Customer Invoice, Purchasing Contract, Customer Contract Management, Service Entitlements

Title: Dunning Interest Calculation Logic
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how is the logic behind the Dunning Interest calculation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center. -Go to Dunning view. -Select the option "All Dunning Proposals" in the dropdown. -Select the desired Dunning ID and open it. -In the General tab, you will see an unexpected value in Default Interest. -Cause-The system calculates interest rate and rounds the amount generated by the below formula:-(Dunning amount * Dunning_relevant_step-Default interest rate / 100 * Overdue days / 365)-Also, you can check the configuration following the steps below: -Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Overview view. -Search for the Activity: Dunning Strategies and open it. -Dunning Strategies-Edit dunning strategies-Resolution-Expected system Behavior.-Keywords-Dunning, Interest Calculation, Logic, value, Dunning strategies

Title: Warning Message "Documents with sale type XYZ for customers w/o VAT ID not considered" Is Shown on EC Sales List ABC
Content: Symptom-When running a EC Sales List Run, the follow-up EC Sales List ID ABC shows a warning message: "Documents with sale type XYZ for customers w/o VAT ID not considered" and you would like to check the documents that were not considered for EC Sales List ABC. (ABC stands for EC Sales List ID and XYZ stands for the document Sale Type).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Open EC Sales Lists view.-You will notice Tax Return ID ABC with status In Preparation. Open it and click on View All.-On General tab, in Run Information section, click on Application Log ID DEF. (DEF stands for the Application Log ID)-On Results tab, message appears:-"Documents with sale type XYZ for customers w/o VAT ID not considered"-Resolution-You can check the documents not considered for the EC Sales List ID ABC on the Report: Open VAT / Sales Tax Items.-First, follow these steps:-1. Go to EC Sales List ID ABC.-2. On Tax Return tab, select a row with a Document of Sale Type XYZ and click on Details.-3. On the next screen you can see Documents with Tax Event GHI that weren't picked by the EC Sales List Run. (GHI stands for the Tax Event code).-4. Take note of the Tax Event code.-Then, go into the Report, as follows:-5. Go to Tax Management work center.-6. Open Reports view.-7. Open Report: Open VAT / Sales Tax Items with the parameters matching Company and Period from EC Sales List ABC.-8. On Tax Event column, filter for Tax Event GHI.-It will show all Source Documents for this period with Tax Event GHI. You can cross check it with the documents on EC Sales List ABC and distinguish the ones that were not considered.-See Also-EC Sales Lists Quick Guide-EC Sales List Runs Quick Guide-Keywords-EC Sales List, VAT

Title: How to Request a Partner/Reference/Demo Tenant
Content: Symptom-Partner wants to have a new Partner/Reference/Demo tenant either to use it for demo to the client or to test the ruggedness of the product.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Partners cannot request new Partner/Reference/Demo tenant by clicking on 'Request Creation' button from Systems view in Service Control Center work center.-Resolution-Partners need to contact SAP TDD team (SAP Test Demo Development Licenses for SAP Partner) via Partnership Support in SAP for Me to request a new Partner/Reference/Demo tenant-Click on 'Get Support'.-Select 'Test, Demo, and Development'.-Select the appropriate subcategory.-Then the concerned team will validate the request based on the contract and the requirement and will further proceed by delivering the Tenant to the Partner.-For a complete list of applications available in Partner Support, refer to KBA 1848459 - How do SAP Partners get help with all partner topics and applications (including Partner Dashboards in SAP for Me).-See Also-Partner Portal: SAP Partner Portal | welcome -KBA 3597596 - How to contact TDD Partner Support for BTP Partner Accounts-KBA 3428090 - Get assistance for SAP TDD subscription or usage related topics - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition-Keywords-Partner, Tenant Creation, Reference Tenant, Demo Creation, demo tenant, patner tenant, new demo tenant.

Title: No Entries for Your Company in the Central Bank Reporting List
Content: Symptom-There are no entries for your company in the Central Bank Reporting (CBR) list, and you are sure that your company is not deactivated in the Central Bank Reporting – Exclusion activity in business configuration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables or Receivables work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Central Bank Reporting subview.-Under Show, specify the country to report, for example, Germany.-Nothing shows up.-Cause-The Central Bank Reporting entries are created, however due to the system settings, they are created in status Not Relevant, and are thus not shown in the list.-Resolution-In order to get your entries show up in the list, follow the steps below:-In the Payables or Receivables work center, open Periodic Tasks.-Select the Central Bank Reporting subview.-Under Show, specify the country to report as Germany.-Click Advanced, and filter all the Not Relevant document items, and click Go.-Mark all the results, and set the status to Relevant via the Change Status button.-Then you can see all the CBR entries created from your invoices, verify the correct central bank code proposals for product, product category or account group by choosing Determine Central Bank Code under Actions.-After that, use Propose Central Bank Code button or edit the CBR code for each record manually.-Keywords-central bank reporting; cbr; not relevant

Title: Changes of Functional Area Not Reflected in Financial Report
Content: Symptom-You assign G/L Account XXX to Functional Area XYZ. (XXX represents the G/L Account ID, XYZ represents one Functional Area).-After the change you check a financial report, for example the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report.-You expect that all transactions on account XXX now appear as assigned to Functional Area XYZ. However, in the report transactions to this account appear in association with a previously assigned functional area. Or the account Functional Area ABC but also the previous Functional Area XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration work center access the Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis fine-tune task, either from the Overview (if your system is already live) or from an Implementation project. -Press Edit functional are determination.-Find Account XXX and verify that the Functional Area XYZ is now assigned to the account.-Open a financial statements report, such as the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme (Earned Profit) report and choose suitable entries for the variable screen.-Add the Functional Area and G/L Account characteristics to the rows.-Filter for G/L Account XXX.-You notice transactions on this account associated with a different functional area. -Or, G/L account XXX cannot be found in the report as the previously used functional area is not used in the chosen Contribution Margin Scheme. -Cause-Changes of Functional Area assignments are only reflected for transactions created after the Functional Area assignment change. All transactions posted before the new assignment are still displayed with the previous functional area assignment.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-functional area change G/L Accounts, financial report functional area reassignment

Title: VAT code ABC entries are missing in VAT Return ID DEF of type Input VAT Domestic
Content: Symptom-You notice that there are no entries of Tax Code ABC in VAT Return ID DEF of type: Input VAT Domestic for the period GHI for country IT - Italy, although there are Invoices with Tax Event 40 posted in the same period.
