(ABC stands for the Tax Code number, DEF for Tax Return ID and GHI for the accounting period).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Open VAT Returns view.-Search and open VAT Return DEF.-Click on Preview.-In Tax Code field, no entries of Tax Code ABC appears, although you are aware there are documents posted with this Tax Code for the correspondent period.-Cause-Tax Code ABC is mapped to Tax Event: 40 - Domestic Purchase Art. 17, Comma 6 DPR 633/72 Reverse Charge.-Entries with Tax event 40 are no longer valid for Tax Returns from type: VAT domestic Register.-As of SAP Business ByDesign 2311 Release, Tax event 40 will be mapped only to Summary Register VAT return.-You can check this on the following path:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation and click on Open Activity List.-Go to Fine Tune phase.-Search and open Activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Click on Define Tax Codes.-Find Tax Code ABC for Country IT - Italy.-You will notice it is associated with Tax Event: 40 - Domestic Purchase Art. 17, Comma 6 DPR 633/72 Reverse Charge -Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. As of SAP Business ByDesign 2311 Release, Tax Event: 40 now is mapped only to Summary Register VAT return.-Keywords-VAT return, Italy, Tax Event 40, Input VAT Domestic

Title: "Posting Type Carry Forward not Permitted" Error When Assigning Time Account to an Employee Time Profile
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign a time account to an employee time profile, however the following error message is raised upon selecting the time account rule:-"Posting Type Carry Forward not Permitted for Account rule XYZ of Permanent Acct. ABC" (where XYZ represents the code of the account rule, and ABC represents the name of the account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for an employee and select it.-click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently valid time profile.-In the panel below, enter the Time Account Rules sub-tab.-Click on the Add button.-Select a time account to be assigned.-On the Time Account Rule field, select one of the rules created for this account.-Upon selecting the time account rule, the error message appears.-Cause-This error is raised because the time account is configured as a permanent time account. This way, there is not an end of period for the account and hence no period end rule can be applied.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-In order to check and correct the setup of the time account, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the activity "Time Accounts - DEF" (where DEF represents the country of the time account).-Click on the link to enter the activity.-Enter the sub-activity Time Account Types.-Select the account to be used in the employee profile.-In the Creation column, you can see the value set as Permanent.-In order to work with period end rules, you need to select the recurrence of the time account as Recurring. After this, you need to define the recurrence of the account in the Recurrence column of the same screen.-Keywords-time type, set to zero, carry on, carry over

Title: How to check Downtime Availability Report in SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--To check the planned and unplanned downtime in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the below steps in order to see the planned and unplanned downtime in the system:-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to System Availability View.-In the above screenshot you can check the planned and unplanned downtime for your system. SLA relevant will be set as No if its a planned downtime else it will be set as Yes.-Keywords-Downtime Availability Report, System Availability, Business ByDesign, BYD, Cloud for Customer, C4C

Title: PCE error: Profit center ABC not found on MM.DD.YYYY
Content: Symptom-You are receiving a Process Communication error:-Profit center ABC not found on MM.DD.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Go to Process Communication Errors view-Select "Open Error with Incidents"-Search for the affected Sending document ID and click on Go-Main error:-Profit center ABC not found on MM.DD.YYYY--Cause-The validity of the profit center is not viable as of today and ended before the posting date of document.-Resolution-In order to adjust the validity of the Profit Center, please follow below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Organizational Structures view.-Click Find, search for Profit Center XYZ and click Locate.-Click Edit.-Go to Timelines tab.-Here adjust the valid to date accordingly. It is necessary that profit center is valid on the day to post document-Keywords-profit center, pce, cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)

Title: Zero Hours Displayed for Recorded Time in Employee Times Reports
Content: Symptom-When running Employee Times Reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly) the Recorded Time displays as 0.00 h value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work Center.-Go to Reports View and select List subview.-Select the Employee Times report: Weekly report (You can run any report which is created based on data source HCMTLMU01).-In View section and click + to add fields to Row.-Select Employee, Reporting Line Unit characteristic in rows.-Click Go.-Here you can see the Recorded Time displays as 0.00h in the Reports.-Cause-If the employee's Time Recording Method is set up as Positive Time Recording, the system compares planned hours against actual recorded hours to identify instances where an employee has worked too few or too many hours in a day. This information is reflected in the 'Recorded Time' field within the Employee Times report, and you may encounter this issue in such cases.-The Employee Times Reports only display Active and Approved hours. If the recorded hours are in an inactive or pending change status, they will not be shown in the Employee Times Reports.-When the employee's Time Recording Method is set to Exception-Based Time Recording, this Case Document is not applicable. In this method, on days when nothing is explicitly recorded in the timesheet, Scheduled hours are used to calculate and post actual hours worked.-Note: The recorded hours could be in an inactive status due to a number of reasons:-The employee timesheet has not been released.-The employee made some changes and saved them, but they haven't released the timesheet-For the two reasons mentioned above, please release the timesheet.-     3. An error message, 'Error Message: Labor resource assignment mandatory for project time confirmation on MM/DD/YYYY,' may occur when employees record time via a different Add-On screen, and approval is required. This error can affect the employee timesheet, causing the recorded hours to be in an inactive status under the Time Administration work center.-To resolve this issue, please refer to the KBA: 1961483 - Error Message "Labor Resource Assignment Mandatory for Project Time Confirmation on DD.MM.YYYY."-Resolution-The Employee Times reports only display hours that are in an active and approved status. If the recorded hours are in an inactive status, they will not be included in the report.-Keywords-Employee Times, Report, Recorded Times, Zero, Hours, Missing

Title: How to Create Service Request via Microsoft Outlook
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Service Request via e-mail but no document is created upon sending the e-mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Cause-In order to perform the creation of Service Requests via e-mail, you need to have maintained the following:-Have performed the needed configuration in the system to allow the exchange of information between SAP Business ByDesign and Microsoft Outlook.-Downloaded the SAP Business ByDesign Add-In for Microsoft Outlook Integration.-Resolution-This is the system behavior.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the Scoping tab.-Expand Communication and Information Exchange.-Select Office and Desktop Integration business option.-Select the Microsoft Outlook® Integration check box. --Go to Service.-Expand Customer Care.-Select Service Request Management.-Scoped the following questions:-Do you want to create service requests automatically from incoming e-mails? -You can create service requests from incoming e-mails. --Now you have to download the SAP Business ByDesign Add-In for Microsoft Outlook Integration.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select Download Center view.-Search and download the SAP Add-In for Microsoft Outlook Integration.-Once you have completed the download, closed and opened Microsoft Outlook, to create the Service Request perform the following:-In Outlook, log in the system.-Once you have logged, select the e-mail you want to send for the system.-Right click on top of the e-mail.-Go to Service Desk work center.-Select the Service Requests view.-Here you can see that the Service Request was created from the e-mail.-See Also-2025807 - E-mail Text in Edit Output Settings for Service Request is Read Only-Quick Guide for Microsoft Outlook® Integration-Create Service Requests from E-Mails-Keywords-Service Request, E-mail, Outlook, Integration, Add-In, Unable, Sending, To Send,

Title: Error - Customer invoice not possible; individual material ABC is obsolete
Content: Symptom-You have noticed the Customer invoice as unposted source document and an error message which prevents the document from being posted. The error message is: Customer invoice not possible; individual material ABC is obsolete. (ABC stands for the Individual Material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents sub-view.-Search for your Source Document ID - DEF (DEF stands for Customer Invoice ID).-Select the ID and under the Details session you can see below error: Customer invoice not possible; individual material ABC is obsolete.-Cause-The status of Individual Material for which Customer Invoice is posted, is Obsolete. Also, you can verify the status of the fixed asset and it is Retired, which means you cannot sell this asset to the customer.-Resolution-As the Individual Material is Obsolete, you have to cancel the Customer Invoice using below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents sub-view.-Search for your Source Document ID DEF.-Click Source Document ID.-Click Cancel. -You can find canceled Customer Invoice in the Source Documents view.-Click Action - View Business Transaction.-In the new screen, choose Mark as Irrelevant.-This will mark the Reversal as well as the Original Source Document as Irrelevant in Accounting.-Keywords-Customer invoice not possible; individual material ABC is obsolete, unposted source document, individual material is obsolete

Title: Migration Error: "Account determination group missing for supplier ABC and company XYZ"
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate the account transaction data, the following error message occurs during import simulation:-"Account determination group missing for supplier ABC and company XYZ". (ABC and XYZ represents the Supplier ID and Company ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Click Execute Migration.-Select your uploaded migration file and click Process File.-The following error occurs in the Simulate Import window: Account determination group missing for supplier ABC and company XYZ.-Cause-There is no Account Determination Group maintained for some of the employees in the migration template.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you need to maintain the account determination group for the employees that you are using in the Migration template for Open Item Payables and perform the migration again:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select one of the following views: Implementation Projects view or the Overview.-Search and open the activity Migration of Suppliers.-Click Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool.-Once this is performed you will able to continue with the Migration of Open Item Payables.-Note: In the migration template for Open Item Payables, use the Creditor Type 2, which stands for Employees, and the same Employee ID in field Creditor ID that you have used during migration of employees or during creation of that employee.-Keywords-migration, account determination

Title: Deviating Holiday is not Displayed in Time File
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a Deviating Holiday Calendar to an employee, however the holidays assigned to this Holiday Calendar do not show in the employee Time File, neither in the Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar regular activity.-Alternatively, holidays configured as half-day are also not shown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check for the holiday on the Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar activity:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee ABC (where ABC represents the employee ID).-Click on the Actions button.-Click on Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar.-Click on the link of the Holiday Calendar name.-To check the issue from the employee Time File:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for employee ABC (where ABC represents the employee ID).-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently valid time profile from the table.-Click on the Show Holiday Calendar button.-In both cases, you are not able to see any holiday assigned by the Deviating Holiday Calendar.-Cause-The Deviating Holiday Calendar does not have a Working Day Calendar to be based off. This can be done by creating a Working Day Calendar which has the Holiday Calendar assigned.-The system requires a Working Day Calendar in order to identify the holidays to be considered in the Holiday Calendar.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to configure the holiday calendar and adjust existing employees:-Create a Working Day Calendar with the Holiday Calendar assignment:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for activity Working Day Calendar.-Click on the activity name to open it.-Click on Create New Working Day Calendars.-In the first step, add the country and click on the Next button.-In the second step, select the Holiday Calendar which is to be added to the employee as Deviating Holiday Calendar.-In the third step, set up the working days of the calendar.-Proceed with the Review and Confirmation steps of the wizard.--Ensure that the Employee Time Models configured to accept half-day holidays (note: This set of steps is only required if the Holiday Calendar contains Half-Day holidays):-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for employee ABC (where ABC represents the employee ID).-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently valid time profile.-On the panel below, navigate to the Work Schedule sub-tab.-Here you can see the information for the Daily Time Models assigned on the table Work Schedule below.-Open the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Time Models view.-Search for the daily time model found on step h.-Click on the Edit button.-Select the currently valid under the Validity Intervals table.-In the Details section the appears below, select Deviation On Half Day Off in the Show dropdown list.-Ensure that there is an entry in this table, so this daily model can accept half-day holidays.--Execute Day Closure Run for the employee to be updated:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Regular Tasks view.-Click on Run Day Closure for One Employee.-In the Employee Field, select the employee.-Select the checkbox for Start Time Valuation.-Click on the Run button.-In the Valuation Start Date, set the date as one day before the change needs to be applied.-Click on the Ok button.-After this, the holidays should be appearing in the employee work schedule.-Keywords-Deviating Holiday Calendar, Half-Day Holiday Calendar, Half Day Holiday Calendar, Working Day Calendar, Holiday Calendar

Title: Manual Value Conversion Required While Migrating a File Even Though the IDs Have Already Been Migrated
Content: Symptom-When migrating a file using Migration tool the value conversion for an ID is not recognized.-The target value filed for the Id is not auto filled even though that ID is already present in the system. -Key -> F4  help also does not have these value for the IDs conversion.-However when values are entered manually, the error is rectified/conversion is confirmed.-(In case you have huge number of records to be uploaded, It is tedious to map each and every IDmanually.)-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview subview.-Select the Activities option from the dropdown Show.-Search for the required Migration object.-Execute step by step migration. -At the Value Conversion step the Target Value description is empty for all the IDs. It has to be manually added one by one using the F4 help.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior. However we have a work around available for the Ids conversion following below mentioned step:-1. In the required MigrationTool select value help for Show and select a recent Completed File from the list.-2. Now select action at You Can Also -> Export Value Conversion to File.-3. Then Open the exported .trv file with MS-EXCEL and find the translation Object for which value conversion is required.-4. Add new lines for translation Object. Here you can enter all the source id and target ids under corresponding columns and save the .trv files. e.g.-     Column A -> Enter Source IDs,  -     Column B -> Enter Target IDs.- 5. Now in the Action ->You Can Also select Import Value conversion from File  to the same completed file with the above .trv file.-6. Once you finish the import of conversion file, then switch to the Not completed file and start executing the migration.-7. Here you can see all the target Value is populated automatically, you do not need to enter it manually one by one and the conversion objects-are still keeping the conversion value next time when you use this migration object except you have new ID created which does not exist in the system,-then you need to repeat above steps again if you do not want to manually enter target value.-NOTE: To edit the .trv file, You can use MS-Excel for Windows, but when pop-up to ask do you Want to Keep the Existing Format please select Yes.-(however do not use excel in MacBook, it will not work).-Keywords-Business Configuration, Migration of Customers, You Can Also,  Export Value Conversion to File, Import Value Conversion to File.-migration,value conversion,convert value step

Title: Error message: "Day is mandatory for period model; enter a valid value for day"
Content: Symptom-When creating a Daily Model, the system throws the following error messages:-"Value of daily hours must be between 0 and 24" or "Day is mandatory for period model; enter a valid value for day"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Models view.-Select New button.-Fill all required data.-Enter Daily Hours which is less than a hour (Example: 0,6 or 0,7)-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the system does not allow to enter value less than an hours for a day.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-It is expected that you enter either 1 hour or more than that for a day.-Keywords-Daily Model, Period Model

Title: Error Message “Purchase Order Item ABC not released for time confirmation” When Releasing Recorded Time
Content: Symptom-Even though purchase order XYZ has been selected for times recorded against the project task, when trying to release the times an error message with a different purchase order ID appears:-Purchase Order Item ABC not released for time confirmation-(where ABC and XYZ represents purchase order IDs) -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link under the Time section.-Input the time for the respective project task.-Select the Release button and choose the Selected Period option.-System throws the above error message.-Cause-The reason the system displays a different purchase order when you are trying to record times is because there are inactive times that have not been released yet.-If you choose to "Release All," it will also activate these inactive times. However, if the purchase order has already been completely delivered, the system will reject the activation of these times and prevent the "Release All" action.-Resolution-There are different possibilities to overcome this issue.-Resolution 1: If purchase order ABC is not yet finished, you can use the "Release All" option to release all the times.-Resolution 2: If purchase order ABC is marked as "Finished," it's advisable to choose the "Release Selected Period" option. This will only release the times within the currently selected period. However, it's recommended to review the inactive times before proceeding.-Resolution 3: You have the option to navigate within the Time Sheet. For those inactive times, you can edit them by clearing the cell (deleting the content). Subsequently create a new line for the selected task. The system will automatically populate it with the corresponding purchase order. This way, you can re-enter the previously deleted inactive times if needed.-Go to Edit Time Sheet under Self-Services Overview.-Find the date (DD.MM.YYYY) you want to modify, delete the previously entered time in the cell for that date, and press the Enter key.-Add a new line for the same task and input the times for the same date (DD.MM.YYYY).-Save these times and release them by clicking the "Release" button and selecting the "Selected Week" option.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Item, Wrong, ID

Title: Post Attachment Using OData Services

Title: Project Tasks Replicated from Business ByDesign to Concur
Content: Symptom-You noticed that some project tasks are not being replicated to Concur. When you review the logs in the Cost Object Outbound Runs View, it shows that "99 out of 99 objects" were replicated, but there is no way to confirm if a particular data was among those objects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Go to view Replication to Concur and select Cost Object Outbound runs.-Highlight the current active job and open it.-Resolution-Once you receive the success log of the cost object in Business ByDesign, you can effectively verify its replication status in Concur.-  To accomplish this, you can follow these steps:-Log in to Concur.-Navigate to Administration.-Proceed to the Expense section.-Choose List Management.-Keywords-Concur, Replication, Project Task, Log

Title: Error: No Accounting Notification Matches Period Item
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You don't know why the data flow verification for the business receipt Employee Time Calendar shows errors.-Error: No accounting notification matches period item. Period Item XXX (where XXX is the period Item ID).-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Click on Data Flow Verification Results-Select Open Results with Differences-Select Result ID where the Business Document One is equal to Employee Time Calendar-Click on Result ID-Click on Application Log ID-Select tab Results-Error: No accounting notification matches period item. Period Item XXX (where XXX is the period Item ID)-Click on tab Settings-You will find here the accounting transaction date or time frame. Take note of the time frame.-Cause-The issue is caused by errors between cross-system processes and the message flow between time & labour management and accounting. The communication process (i.e. time recording) is not possible. It might be caused by a blocked business receipt. This business receipt might be blocked by another business user or the same user.-Resolution-You can find more information about the business document differences as follows:-Log in to back end-Search for T.Code SRT_MONI-Enter the transaction date or time frame in the field Timestamp from and to Timestamp to-Set the Processing Status Group to Incomplete processing-In the section Sender information enter TimeAndLabourManagement as Party-Click on Execute-To resolve the business document differences, please refer to KBA 2605501 - Business Document Differences which are not Resolved by Synchronising and Repeat Check.-See Also-2605501 - Business Document Differences which are not Resolved by Synchronising and Repeat Check-Keywords-Fehler: Kein buchungsrelevanter Geschäftsvorfall entspricht der Zeitraumposition

Title: Approved Leave Hours not Reflecting in Time Account Balance
Content: Symptom-You have submitted a new Leave Request with the "Vacation" time type. The vacation has been approved by the manager, however Quantity field displays only the dates without showing any hours. Additionally, the requested leave has not been deducted from the employee's Vacation Balance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the required employee and open it.-Go to Employee Times tab.-You will notice that there is a record for an approved vacation, but the Quantity field for this record is blank.-Cause-This happens because there is no Work Schedule assigned for this Employee.-Resolution-To resolve this issue assign a Work Schedule to this employee's Time Profile:-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the current time profile.-Go to the Work Schedule sub-tab.-Assign a Work Schedule.-Click Save button.-Note: If the deduction remains at zero, you can proceed by running the "Run Day Closure for One Employee" under the Regular Tasks view.-Keywords-Leave Request, Approved, Missing, Employee Times, Vacation

Title: CPEL Proposed Posting Date Later Than Expense Posting Date Due To Service Period End Date
Content: Symptom-You have created supplier invoice item XYZ-X referencing to a project task of a Customer Project with Sales Integration with posting date in period AAA.YYYY.-The expense is being assigned to a sales order item (either automatically or manually in the Not Invoiced Times and Expenses Screen or the Customer Project Invoice Request). This expense assignment triggers the generation of Customer Project Expense List (CPEL) ABC. The CPEL, however cannot be posted to accounting but appears in the Unposted Source Documents view of the General Ledger workcenter. The proposed posting date of the CPEL ABC is in in a much later period ZZZ.YYYY.-Also, the source document's error message in the Messages table states: Period AAA in fiscal year YYYY closed for closing step Operational postings.-You have verified that the sales order item posting date of the Sales order item assigned to the project task that the supplier invoice item is referencing to - is not later than the invoice posting date.-As period AAA.YYYY has been already closed for Operational Postings you are now trying to post CPEL ABC in the following period BBB.YYYY. This is not possible due to the error message: Business transaction for accounting for Customer Project Expense List ABC, version X with alternate posting date not processed. Alternate posting date must be after proposed posting date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Source Documents view. By default the Unposted Source Documents are displayed.-Find the source document of type 555-Customer Project Expense List with ID ABC.-In the Proposed Posting Date column a date in period ZZZ.YYYY is displayed.-The error message in the Messages table states: Period AAA in fiscal year YYYY closed for closing step Operational postings.-As period AAA.YYYY is closed for operational postings you now try to post the document into period BBB.YYYY via Actions - Post Business Transaction to Another Period.-An error message appears: Business transaction for accounting for Customer Project Expense List ABC, version X with alternate posting date not processed. Alternate posting date must be after proposed posting date.-To verify the posting dates of all involved transactions press on the CPEL ID ABC in the Source Document ID column.-In the Reference Document field press on the link of supplier invoice XYZ. You ensure that the posting date of the invoice is in period AAA.YYYY.-In the Items table press on the link in the Sales Order Item Reference column to open the sales order. You also verify that the posting date of the sales order item is not later than the posting date of supplier invoice XYZ.-Therefore you expect the Proposed Posting Date of CPEL ABC to be the same as the posting date of supplier invoice XYZ.-Cause-The PROPOSED POSTING DATE of the CPEL source document is derived as the greatest of the expense incurrence dates. This date is derived from the expense incurrence period of the original expense, here, supplier invoice item XYZ-X referencing to Purchase Order item DEF-Y with service period ending in period ZZZ.YYYY.-The service end date is derived from the Finishing Date of the referenced project task.-To verify the end date of the expense incurrence period:-In supplier invoice XYZ navigate to the Items tab.-Select the respective Item and go to the Basic Data sub-tab.-Under Buyer Reference press on the Order ID/Item link DEF-Y.-In the Purchase Order Items -Basic Data tab you can see the Service Period ending on a date in period ZZZ.YYYY.-Now open the Account Assignment sub-tab and press on the Project Task link.-In the Project Overview, you can now identify the project's Finishing Date in period ZZZ.YYYY. This is the reason for the proposed posting date of CPEL ABC.-The POSTING DATE of a CPEL, however,  is derived from the posting date of the latest posting date of all involved transactions.-This means, that albeit the proposed posting date in period ZZZ.YYYY - the CPEL's posting date would have been in period AAA.YYYY (as per the expense posting date, here SIV XYZ) if the period AAA.YYYY had been open.-Resolution-Posting according to Expense Posting Date:-The easiest way to solve this issue is by opening period AAA.YYYY for Operational Postings and then post the source document:-After the period has been opened for operational postings navigate to the Source Documents view of the General Ledger workcenter.-Select CPEL ABC and press Actions - Post Business Transaction.-Albeit the proposed posting date in period ZZZ.YYYY the CPEL has now been posted in period AAA.YYYY according to the latest posting date of all involved transactions, here of supplier invoice XYZ.-Posting to Another Period:-If it is not possible to open period AAA.YYYY for Operational Postings anymore forward a case to Support who will request our Development team to post the CPEL in period BBB.YYYY from the backend.-Prevent the proposed posting date to be derived from Customer Project Finishing Date:-Restrict the service period of the Purchase Request to a date in period AAA.YYYY: -In the Project Management workcenter navigate to the Projects view.-Select the respective Customer Project and press Edit - Products.-In the Products tab go to the Products Overview sub-tab. -Select the respective Service and press Create Purchase Request. Then select any of the displayed options, e.g. For Released Project Task.-In the pop-up window the Details - General Data tab should be displayed.*-In the Delivery To field enter a date in period AAA.YYYY. This date will be the service period end date of the resulting purchase order item, or else, the expense incurrence period end date of which the CPEL's proposed posting is going to be derived for follow-up documents.*-*You can define/amend the service period end date also in the resulting purchase order as long as there has been no follow-up document created.-Keywords-CPEL, customer project expense list, proposed posting date

Title: Display Currency Conversion fields as parameters in custom report
Content: Symptom-Display Currency and Display Currency - Conversion Date fields are not appearing as parameters in the selection tab for customozied report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center. -Go to Design Reports view.-Open the custom report created.-In Selection tab, the parameters 'Display Currency and Display Currency - Conversion Date' cannot be seen or added.-Cause-If none of the key figures in the report do not have currency conversion maintained as Conversion Type, the Display Currency fields cannot be seen as parameters in report.-Resolution-Currency conversion happens at Restricted or Calculated key figure. You need to select any of the key figure group or any custom key figure which involves currency conversion. This can be defined while creating the key figure in properties tab. Below are the steps to be performed:-i) Goto Business Analytics Work Center-ii) Design Key figures-iii) Click on New-iv) Select the data source on which you creating the custom report-v) Either create restricted or calculated key figure-vi) Click next > Go to Properties tab-vii) Under Conversion> Conversion Type > Currency Conversion-viii) Review and Click on Finish-Now, in report wizard of the report add this key figure under select key figures. You can see these fields 'Display Currency and Display Currency - Conversion Date' added in Define Variables tab by default on selecting the key figure. If you open the report, these fields will appear in the selection tab.-Keywords-Display Currency, Display Currency-Conversion Date, Parameter, Report

Title: Time Recording Method Shows Blank Data in Time Sheet View
Content: Symptom-You are looking for time recording method for active employees under Time Sheets view. However no records found in the Time Recording Method column on the Time Recording - Time Sheet screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Time Recording view.-Select Time Sheet sub view.-Select Active Employees.-Time Recording Method column is blank for few employees.-Cause-The default setting in Advanced mode under Time Administration Data is "1 Week Before" for Period Selection. However, because the start date of the Time Profile for these employees is MM.DD.YYYY, the time recording method is not being displayed.-Resolution-To view the time recording method for these employees, make sure to select "Current Week" in the Period Selection field.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Time Recordings view.-Select the Time Sheet sub view.-Select Active Employees.-Click on the "Advanced Filter" icon located next to the Search field.-Under the section Time Administration Data section, you can see that in the field "Period Selection" is currently set to '1 Week Before'.-Change the period selection to 'Current Week.-Select Go.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Method, Missing, Time Sheet, Blank

Title: Wrong Reporting Line Unit in Resource Calendar - My Area Report
Content: Symptom-The employee is being displayed under the wrong reporting line unit in report Resource Calendar - My Area Report -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Reports View.-Search "Resource Calendar - My Area" and open it.-Select desired Reporting Line Unit and the respective Employee.-Cause-When reviewing an employee's information in Personnel Administration, you can observe in the Organizational Assignments section that the employee was previously linked to a different Reporting Line Unit. Consequently, if the Reporting Line Units are different in all records, the Analytics report will show the employee listed under all the Reporting Line Units they were previously assigned to.-Resolution-Expected system behavior. -Keywords-My Area, Report, Line Unit, Org

Title: Invoice is not included in Central Bank Reporting
Content: Symptom-Customer or Supplier Invoice ABC does not appear in Central Bank Reporting View. (ABC stands for Customer or Supplier Invoice ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables/Receivables work center.-Go to Central Bank Reporting view.-Search for ID ABC, you will notice that there's not an Invoice with this ID.-Cause-Since Invoice ABC was cancelled in the same month before it was reported to the authorities, the line item is deleted from the Central Bank Reporting worklist.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-Central Bank Reporting-Keywords-Central Bank Reporting, Payables, Receivables, Invoice

Title: Is it Possible to Change the Date for Domain Certificate Renewal?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer has requested SAP to postpone or bring forward the date for Domain Certificate Renewal.-This request usually comes after the customers are informed of this operation via communication e-mail with a message similar to the one below:-"Please be informed that the existing server certificate for below domains is being renewed as it is going to expire on XYZ" (where XYZ represents the validity date of the certificate)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-TheDdomain Certificate Renewal is an yearly maintenance task which happens at the central repository. Title: Error "Deferral Requires Accrual Method" when you create a Journal Entry Voucher for Sales Documents
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***WAITING FOR VALIDATION, if proven, change status to Released to Customer and remove this statement***-You get an error message: "Deferral Requires Accrual Method" when posting Journal Entry in associated with Sales Document, but, the revenue recognition is not scoped in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center navigate to Journal Entry Voucher View.-Select New - Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter All the values required.-Select Journal Entry Type is 0088-Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-The screen Variant is 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.-Sales Doc. Type is 114- Sales Order.-Sales Doc. ID is PQR(Here, PQR stands for the number of sales order).-Click Post or Simulate, and the error appears: Deferral Requires Accrual Method.-Resolution-As per Help documentation: Manual Entries for Sales Documents-If the Revenue Recognition is not scoped in your system, then, it is necessary to use P&L Accounts, i.e. COSEXP for cost or REVGAN for revenue.-If you would like to post with SO reference and would like to use an account of type OASSET or OLIAB then, you must assign an accrual method.-See Also-If the Revenue Recognition is scoped in your system, refer to the below KBA for additional information:-KBA 2813095 - Error "Deferral Requires Accrual Method" When You Create a Journal Entry Voucher for Sales Documents-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher; Manual Entry for Sales Documents; Deferral requires Accrual method, JEV,

Title: Extension Fields Cannot be Made Mandatory in Personnel Administration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer reported that they have created an extension field in the Biographical Data section of an Employee, however it is not possible to set the created fields as mandatory.-This behavior happens for employees with country Netherlands, Luxembourg and Switzerland.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the avatar icon on the top right of the screen.-Click on Key User Settings.-Click on Start Adaptation Mode.-Navigate to the Personal Data tab.-Enter the Biographical Data sub-tab.-Right-click on any field displayed in the Details section below.-Click on + Extension Fields.-Create or add an existing extension field through the Is Already Added checkbox.-Click on Close.-Right-click on the newly added field.-Here you can see that it is not possible to set the field as mandatory.-Cause-This is a limitation due to the design of the Personal Administration screen for the countries mentioned in the Symptom section.-Mandatory extension fields will not work where the field data is bound to a row of a table, even though such option to set as mandatory is provided in some cases. This can be checked in KBA 2372377 listed in the See Also section of this document.-Resolution-To fix this issue, the development team will be making design level changes which will unlock the fields to be set as mandatory.-The changes are scheduled to be deployed with the 2311 release of Business ByDesign.-See Also-2372377 - Limitations of HTML5 UI in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Personal, Employee File, View All, KUT

Title: Wrong Reporting Line Unit Shown for Employees in Resource Calendar - My Area Report
Content: Symptom-An employee is assigned to Reporting Line Unit A in Personnel Administration, however the Resource Calendar - My Area Report displays the employee under Reporting Line Unit B (where A and B Represent Reporting Line Units).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Work Center.-Go to Employees View.-When selecting the employee, Reporting Line Unit A, which is the correct one, is displayed.-After that go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Open Design Reports View.-Search for "Resource Calendar - My Area" and open it.-In the Employee field, choose the requested employee and select Reporting Line Unit as B.-The employee is displayed under Reporting Line Unit B.-When selecting Reporting Line Unit as A, the employee is also displayed.-Cause-Employee has been transferred from Reporting Line Unit B to A, therefore in analytical report will showcase the employee under all Reporting Line Units which that employee has already worked.-You can verify this by following the steps below:-Go to Personnel Administration Work Center.-Go to Employees View.-Select the employee and click Edit button.-Go to Employment tab.-Select Organizational Assignment subtab.-Check the Organizational Assignments.-  Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-Reporting Line Unit, Resource Calendar, My Area

Title: Total Hours Recorded Show Incorrect Value in Time Sheet
Content: Symptom-You are reviewing the time sheet of an employee, and notice that the Total Hours Recorded column for a specific day shows an incorrect value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Time Sheet view.-Search and select the employee.-Click on the Open Time Sheet button.-Navigate to the required week.-Here in the Time Sheet table, the column Total Hours Recorded show a different value than the sum of all times recorded for the employee on that day.-Note: The times considered for the time sheet can be checked by clicking on the day, then scrolling down to the Details table that opens on the bottom of the screen.-Cause-Employee is assigned to a time recording profile which has a break deduction configured.-Resolution-In order to check the time recording profile, follow the below steps:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search and select the employee.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently active time profile from the Time Profiles tab.-In the Basic Data panel below, check the Time Recording Profile.-To check the time recording profile configuration, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the activity "Time Types - X" (where X represents the country of the employee).-Enter the sub-activity Maintain Time Recording Profile.-From the Time Recording Profiles table, select the profile assigned to the employee.-Under the Working Time Rules table below, check for the option Minimum Break Deduction.-The minimum break deduction can be configured to automatically deduct a certain amount of time after the employee reaches a threshold of working times booked in a day. -For example, it is possible to configure that after an employee books 10 hours of working time, 1 hour will be automatically deducted from working times booked above these 10 hours.-This can also be configured in 2 separated methods:-Partial Break Deduction: The system deducts any time booked over the threshold, even if it does not complete the break duration. In the example above any time booked over 10 hours will be deducted, even if it does not complete 1 hour.-Full Break Deduction: The deduction will only happen if the times booked over the threshold complete the break duration. In the example above, the deduction will only happen if the employee books at least 1 hour over the normal 9 hours.-Keywords-TLM, Time File, Overtime

Title: Cancel Outbound Delivery of Past Date Without Opening Corresponding Period
Content: Symptom-When you trying to perform undo release to subsequently cancel the Outbound Delivery you will receive the message:-Confirmation not possible; posting on XX/YY/ZZZZ blocked by accounting (XX/YY/ZZZZ represents the date which the Confirmation is to be posted).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center and choose Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for Outbound Delivery XYZ (XYZ represents the Outbound Delivery ID).-Select your document and choose Undo Release from the drop-down of Actions button.-Cause-Since the period is closed for posting from accounting you get the above error message.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to cancel the outbound delivery and post to current period.-First you need to Set Process Control. To do so, following the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select view Master Data-->Companies. Select the relevant company.-Choose Set Process control button.-Choose Add Row button.-Select Process Control Status as Not Blocked, Business Process Group as Goods and Service Confirmation.-Entry Possible Until should be the date by which you want to do the reverse confirmation. Like if you are planning to do it today, then enter today's date.-From Posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ or the date before XX/YY/ZZZZ and To posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ  or any day after XX/YY/ZZZZ.-Finally choose Save and Close button.-Then Undo Release of the Outbound delivery which will create a Reversal(Goods and Activity Confirmation).-Note : It will not post into accounting yet but it will create a business task in General Ledger work center, where you need to select a new posting date for which accounting period is open. To do so, follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Closing Cockpit--> Closing-Relevant Tasks.-Choose Advance button. In the Related Source Document, enter reverse goods and activity confirmation ID and for Related Source Document Type select 55 - Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Choose Go button. You will get the relevant business task.-Now choose Post Business Transaction to Another Period from drop-down of ﻿Actions ﻿button. In the field Alternate Posting Date, enter a suitable date for which accounting period is currently open.-Post Reversal with Alternate Parameters:Select the check box.-Then choose OK button.-Note: If you select Post Reversal with Alternate Parameters check box, reversal of the GAC and reposting of GAC will get posted in the current period(as per date entered in the Alternate Posting Date field). If you have not selected this check box, then reversal of GAC will get posted on the same Posting date of Original GAC posting date and reposting of GAC will be posted on selected date.-Then perform adjustment confirmation against the warehouse order related to outbound delivery which will create an Adjustment Warehouse confirmation.-Now you will be able to cancel the outbound delivery successfully by following the below steps:-Go to Outbound Logistics work center and choose Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for Outbound Delivery XYZ.-Select your document and choose Cancel from the drop-down of Actions button.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Past Date, Corresponding Period, Process Control, Outbound Deliver

Title: Tenant Without IT Contact Maintained
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-After sending the incident to hosting team requesting the initial credentials of a new tenant, you could receive an answer saying there is no IT contact maintained on the mentioned tenant.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is related when customers have not updated an IT contact for your company, the contact person exist but job title in ICP tool is in blank or not updated.-Resolution-Continue to send the incident to Provisioning team with IT contact details to resend the credentials.-Check to do from your end:-Ensure the customer ID is mapped to the tenant URL correctly i.e the tenant belongs to the same customer who has requested it. Can be checked in the SPC.-Ensure that the IT contact Email ID domain is same as the customer domain. Can be checked in the BCP.-Scenario 1: If the IT contact is maintained in the tenant or in SPC we will send the incident to Operations requesting to resend/reset the initial user credentials.-Scenario 2: If the IT contact is NOT maintained in the tenant or in SPC, then we need to inform the customer to get in touch with their CEE (Customer Engagement Executive) to make the changes in the order level.-                     Upon confirmation from the CEE, customer can resend the incident to us. Then we need to re-validate the same in tenant or in SPC. If the contact is updated we will send the incident to Operations for further processing and resending/resetting the credentials.-Scenario 3: For any escalated situation where the CEE/CSM/AE reached out to incident owner asking to re-send/reset the credentials.-                     In this case SE needs to get an email for the request from the CEE/CSM/AE, attach the same email in the incident and then send it to operations.-NOTE: Support will not create any GCO ticket requesting change any contact details in customer master data.-Keywords-IT Contact, Maintained, ICP, SPC, C4C, BYD

Title: South Africa: Customer Account Statement Form Template Is Wrong
Content: Symptom-As of SAP Business ByDesign 2308 Upgrade, the Customer Account Statement form template that is being fetched by the system in Customer Account Statement Run is wrong. It's no longer the form template that you were using in previous system versions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2308--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Account Statement view.-Select the respective Run ID and click View Report Run Results.-Move to Attachments tab and open respective file.-Here you notice that the form template used is wrong. It is not the one you have been using prior to the system upgrade.-Cause-The reason for the issue is that a new Form Template Group has been introduced to South Africa along with SAP Business ByDesign 2308 Upgrade, which is template group G15 - Customer Account Statement.-This is mentioned in section South Africa of What's New in Financial Management documentation for ByDesign 2308.-Link: 2308 - What's New - South Africa - Customer Account Statement -This new template group is now the one for Customer Account Statement document, which used to be mapped to Form Template Group F05. Since in F05 you have configured custom form template ABC (ABC means the custom form template), with the system upgrade it is no longer being fetched for Customer Account Statement document.-Resolution-To solve the issue, please follow the steps below:- Go to the Application and User Management - Form Template Maintenance work center view.- Search by template group F05.- Find custom form template ABC, for Country/Region 'South Africa' and Language 'English'.- Click Download button (a ".zip" file will be downloaded to your computer).- Extract the file in your computer so you have access to the ".XDP" file that is inside the zipped file.- Now search by template group G15.- Select the row of standard template 'Customer Account Statement', for Country/Region 'South Africa' and Language 'English'.- Click Upload -> To Replace Existing Variant.- Browse and select the XDP file you've downloaded.- Save your changes.-Click Publish-As a result, in the next Customer Account Statement Run the new template version will be used.-Keywords-ZA, South Africa, G15, F05, Customer Account Statement, XDP

Title: Supplier Invoices not Processed on a 1099-Misc Tax Reporting
Content: Symptom-You wish to issue the 1099-Misc forms in the system, however no invoices are being processed by the run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Withholding Tax Return Runs view.-Create the tax run with the 1099 related tax arrangement.-The tax run did not process any invoices, hence the tax return is not created.-Cause-You missed a master data set up for this tax scenario, hence withholding tax was not processed within the invoices.-Resolution-In order for the system to properly generate a tax return for 1099 reporting, there are settings in your master data that need to be made.- The below master data objects carry attributes that are specific to Withholding tax:-Company Tax Arrangement: The company should be marked to withhold tax. Refer to the Withholding Tax Required checkbox in your Tax Authority master data. -Supplier: The Supplier is subject to withholding. Note that if for the US, for example, you do not withhold amounts but report payments with 1099-Misc, select No backup withholding. If you have to withhold a certain percentage, select Liable to withholding. This is maintained in the supplier master data -> Financial Data -> Tax Data -> Withholding Tax Classifications. -Product: The product is relevant to withholding. Go to the Material or Service master data, choose View All, then go to Taxes tab. Maintain the required data in the Withholding Tax Classification section. -If the supplier invoice does not have a product ID assigned to it, the Withholding tax code is not populated automatically. You can, however, maintain a Withholding Tax Code in the Supplier's master data, in the Withholding tax Classifications section, field Withholding Tax Income Type. The information maintained here is then defaulted to the supplier invoice when no product ID is selected.-After posting and paying the invoice, you can go to the Tax Management work center and open the Withholding Tax Item report. The report displays all payments relevant for withholding tax for a specific period. The display includes the underlying invoices, the withholding tax amounts, and the tax base amounts relating to each payment.-Note that this setup is valid from the date that you do the changes. In case you have not classified your supplier as being relevant to withhold taxes, the tax amount would not be accounted with the invoices. The amount, however, can be entered manually as a Manual Tax Entry. Please, refer to the SAP Business ByDesign Help Document Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries Quick Guide.-Keywords-Tax Management. Withholding Tax. WHT. 1099. Supplier Invoicing.

Title: Not Possible to Filter Account Hierarchy Table Header
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer is reporting that it is not possible to apply a table header filter in the Account Hierarchy table while in edit mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Product Data work center.-Enter the Product Categories view.-Click on the Maintain Product Categories button.-In the new screen, click on the table header (either on the Product Category ID or the Product Category column).-Here you can see that it is not possible to filter for specific values, only change the ordering.-Cause-This feature is currently not supported, since there is a technical constraint with the mapping of the fields to the display table.-Resolution-The system works as expected-Keywords-Filter, UI, Head, Sort

Title: Message: No Text for UUID {XYZ} for Project Responsible
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- * ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** * -"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-In certain FIN reports you expect to see an employee ID or perhaps an unassigned (#) ID but instead you see message No Text for UUID {XYZ}.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Reports View.-Search for the Report (For example:  Project Cost and Revenue by Project) and open it.-In the selection, fill in the necessary fields.-Add field X Responsible (For example: Project Responsible).-The field X Responsible displays "No Text for UUID {XYZ}" instead of data expected.-Cause-The root cause is not yet found but it's an issue on the HCM side with the ACL (access control list) of the Employee BO.-Steps to confirm it's this issue:-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Load EMPLOYEE BO.-Load by Query ->Identification->Query by employee attributes and fill the EmployeeID/content field and search.-Navigate to root.-Navigate from root to ACCESS_CONTROL_LIST node.-Navigate to ENTRY - there will be no record here.-Resolution-Please note that this shouldn’t be done using the indicator “All Employees” because there are too many employees. One employee or multiple employees is the way to go.-To correct the issue, go to transaction SE38 and load report AP_PAD_ADJUST_ACL_ENTRIES.-After that execute the report as above and then check the steps 1 to 6 again - there should be records there now. On the UI, the actual values should appear rather than the long UUID string.

Title: When Creating a Sales Document from Web Service There is no Customized Party Role in the WSDL File
Content: Symptom-The WSDL file to create a Web Service Sales Order does not have a customized Party Role field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Service Explorer view.-Select Maintain Sales Orders.-Click on Download WSDL.- Customized party role does not exist in the WSDL file.-Cause-Resolution-This is the system behaviour.-Custom Party Roles cannot be passed via the Web service since this is not available in the web service and cannot be added.-Keywords-file, download, web service, party role, custom, customized, sales, field.

Title: Error "Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY" During Time Recording for Employee
Content: Symptom-When trying to book time using the Timesheet in Employee Self-Service you are receiving the error:-"Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home Work Center.-Select Self-Services and choose Self-Services Overview.-Select Edit Time Sheet link (The error may occur here).-Go to the respective week, input the time for a day.-Select the Save button.-System throws the above error message.-Cause-If the error occurs once you click in Time Sheet link (step 3).-Cause 1: The Employee does not have a Job or Org unit assigned to him. But, the employee is assigned to the Projects. The trigger for the time agreement is the staffing to the Project.-If the error occurs when saving (step 6).-Cause 2: When Time and Labor Management is added to the business scope, Time Agreements for all existing employees should be generated by the system automatically. This may not happen in the system if a corresponding job had not been scheduled.-Because of this, the following issues can occur in the system:-Error Valid Time Agreement does not exist on DD/MM/YYYY while recording times in Time Sheet.-Your employee ID is missing in the Time Administration work center.-Work Agreement does not exist for your employee ID in the Personnel Administration work center.-Resolution-Solution for case 1: If the error occurs once you click in Time Sheet link (step 3);- Add the Job and Org unit to the employee and then try to open the time sheet. If you still get the error, remove the employee from one of the projects, save and then add them back to the same project.-Solution for case 2: If the error occurs when saving (step 6);-The corresponding job needs to be triggered manually to create the Work Agreements, which should be done by SAP.-Please raise a case to SAP to trigger the backend job manually.-After the job is run, you should find the Time Agreements for all employees available in the system. Additionally, the manually triggered job also creates tasks of Complete Time Data (Hire) which appear under the Work view of the Time Administration work center. Using these tasks, the time data of the employees can be completed.-Keywords-Time agreement, Self services, Time sheet

Title: Dump While Posting Concur Expense Report in ByDesign due to Tax Configuration
Content: Symptom-When posting Expense Report XYZ (where XYZ represents the Expense Report ID) from Concur, the system throws a dump error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur view.-Go to the Expense Reports subview.-Click on Post for Expense Report XYZ.-The system Dumps.-Cause-Tax Configuration is missing for the Country/Region.-Download the JSON and search for the tax code (In the JSON check the "taxReclaimCode" tags and the "taxCode" tags)-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Overview-Open the Activity: Tax on Goods and Services.-For the specific  Country/Region, there is no configuration maintained for tax code.-Resolution-Written approval is required to mark the Expense Report as Failed from the backend.--Once the approval is obtained, send the posting confirmation as Failed to Concur, make the necessary amendments, and resubmit the Expense Report.-See Also-2903403 - Dump While Posting Concur Expense Report in ByDesign -Keywords-Concur, Posting, Expense reports, Dump, Exception-cl_aptc_tax_postprocessor,cl_aptc_tax_c

Title: Error "Start Date Can't Be Changed Because of Manual adjustments on Time Account" During Migration of Time and Labor Management
Content: Symptom-You are trying to complete migration of Time and Labor Management, but the following error message occurs:-"Start Date can't be changed because of Manual adjustments on time account"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview view.-Search and open activity Migration of Employee and User Data.-Click link to Migrate time and labor management data using the migration tool.-Select a migration file available in the Source Files table or upload a new one by clicking the Upload button.-Click Execute Migration, then Execute Migration Step by Step.-Proceed with the migration until the third step (Simulate), where error occurs.-Cause-There might be 2 causes for this issue:-Cause 1: You cannot change the Time Profile and do a Manual Adjustment in the same file.-Cause 2: The date in the Time File Start Date field of the migration template is different than the date in the time file of the employee(s) being migrated.-To check this, please follow the below instructions:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Search and select the employee(s) being migrated.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-In the Time Profile section, you can check the Start Date — if this value is different than what was entered in the migration template, the error message will occur.-Resolution-Solution for cause 1: As a workaround, you can change the start of the Time Profile to the desired date and then upload the Manual Adjustments via Web Service. This way you will need to create your own Communication Scenario and add this Web Service to it. Then you will be able to do mass change in your Manual Adjustment.-More details can be checked in the documentation of Inbound Service ManageEmployeeTimeAccountsCustomAdjustmentsIn.-The other option is to do it manually in the UI.-Solution for cause 2: Change the date in the migration template in order to match the date maintained in the time file of the employee(s).-See Also-2202839 - Incorrect Time Profile Start Date of Employees-Keywords-Migration, Labor management, Employee, Changes, Time, Manual Adjustment, Web Service

Title: Error message: Country India Is Not Relevant For This Business Transaction. Select a Different Company.
Content: Symptom-While creating New Withholding Tax Base Amount Entry for country India, you receive an Error message: 'Country India is not relevant for this business transaction. Select a different company.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work center.-Go to Manual Tax Entries View.-Go to Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries.-Click New - Tax Entry.-Enter the Company (Maintained for India) and press 'Enter' key.-The error message appears: 'Country India is not relevant for this business transaction. Select a different company.'-Cause-Please note that this feature of Manual Tax entry for Withholding Tax is not applicable for country India.-Reason behind this is that Manual Tax Entry allows only modification of tax base amount where the tax amount is zero (0). So, there is no posting of tax amount possible through this.-Resolution-The current scenario can be handled through a manual Journal Entry Voucher whereby you can directly post the Withholding Tax to the respective TDS (Tax Deduction at Source) account. This however, will not be picked in the Withholding Tax challan return. It has to be paid separately and then adjusted against the return of that period.-This is intended system behavior. The same applies for companies in other localizations for which Manual Tax Entries for withholding tax are not supported.-Keywords-Country India Is Not Relevant For This Business Transaction. Select a Different Company.,

Title: Time Account Accrual Rules Based On Validity
Content: Symptom-Your are making a change to the accrual rate on a particular time account within the employee account and would like to have the Time Account Accrual Rules Based On Validity-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Workcenter-Employees view-Search and open time file of an employee-Go to Time Profile tab-Under Details' session click on Time Account Rules sub-tab-Select the Time Account-Under Details session, Accrual/Entitlement Rules' tab, you want to know if the accrual rules can be defined based on the validity.-Cause-The accrual rules can be defined based on the validity as well. You can select or enter the validity period for a time account rule and define the required rules.-In the event of changes in company policy that affect these rules, you can define a new validity period and assign new rule values through the Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Overview-3. Search for Time Account-4. Open Time Accounts (depending on your required country)-5. Click on the link Maintain Time Account Rules-6. The new rules as per the validity period can be maintained.-Keywords-Time Account, Rule, Validity, Accrual

Title: Reports in Human Capital Management Not Show Data of All the Employees
Content: Symptom-In any Human Capital Management (HCM) work center, reports display only information about a fraction of employees. Specifically only the employees reporting directly to the HCM administrator are taken into account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to any HCM work center, e.g. the 'Personnel Administration'.-Go to Reports view.-Open report Employee Turnover Analysis.-Only a subset of all the employees shows up in the report.-Cause-You are allowed to see only the data of those employees directly reporting to you.-Resolution-The system works as designed. A manager is able to view only his/her employees alone in the reporting.-Keywords-Report, Manager, HCM, Employees

Title: Web Service Query Returns Incorrect Number of Records
Content: Symptom-You are using a webservice to query business objects from the system via SOAP. Although the query is executed successfully, the amount or records brought by the query is not the same as the number of objects in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Communication Arrangement view.-Click on the communication scenario name hyperlink.-Select the relevant query from the Included Operations section.-Click on the Download WSDL button to save the file.-Open your SOAP client (such as SOAP UI).-Create a new SOAP project and import the downloaded WSDL.-Open the project and search for the required query (for example, FindByIdentification).-Fulfill the XML payload with the request needed.-Enter the user credentials in the SOAP project.-Execute the request.-Cause-By default, the standard webservice queries in Business ByDesign restricts the results to 100.-Resolution-You can set the property QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator to true in the XML payload. You can also set property QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue to a high number in order to accommodate all the existing records.-Both fields can be found in the ProcessingConditions section of the query web service XML request. This way the webservice should return the desired number of records.-Keywords-Queryemployeein, Web Service, Processing Conditions,

Title: How to Check if a Tenant Request or Restore Point has been Scheduled/Confirmed
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--Once you request a new test tenant, production tenant or restore point on the Service Control Center Work Center, the request will be replicated to SAP internal systems.-Hence, you would like to confirm if the request has been acknowledged or confirmed by SAP side.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can be checking the status of the requests that have been scheduled on your system directly.-Please follow the steps below:-Go to the Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to the Systems View.-Highlight the respective system.-Click on the button "View".-Check for the "Service Requests for this System" section.-Cloud for Customer system:-ByDesign system:-You can also change the filter to "All Requests" which will show requests with "Completed" and "In Process" status.-See Also-Available Restore Points-A restore point is a snapshot of the system data that is saved at a specific point in time. In the event of a problem, you can request that the system data be restored to this point in time. This section shows the restore points that are available to you and when exactly they were created.-Please refer to the KBA: 2505081 - How to Find Restore Point ID in the System.-  Contractual Maintenance Period (CMP)-You can also be checking the maintenance period, as agreed in your contract. The maintenance period consists of the day the maintenance is to be carried out, the start time, and the duration of the maintenance. It is the reserved downtime which SAP deploys Hotfixes, Emergency Patches and other Maintenance Activities every week.--After release 1905 all customers are able to monitor their requests via Service Control Center work center.-If the request reached us successfully, then it will be on the view "Service Requests". We do not monitor service requests via incidents, in case our operations team face any issue during the process, they will open an internal incident and our support team will contact you directly.-Take a look on the below KBA and check how to proceed to check the service requests.-2799608 - How to check Existing Service Request Details in C4C /ByD-Keywords-tenant, system, request, c4c, byd, schedule, acknowledge, follow up, restore, point, CMP, contractual, maintenance, period

Title: No Time Recording Visible in the Time Sheet of a Particular Employee
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, want to verify the hours worked by an employee. When you look at the employee's timesheet, you see that there is no information available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Time Recording view and go to the Time Sheet sub view.-Select the respective employee.-Click Open Time Sheet button.-Time Sheet opens up but no data is found.-Cause-The employee has been terminated, so it is not possible to see his/her previous time recordings in the timesheet. This is the system's designed behavior.-Resolution-You can check the time recordings of a terminated employee in his/her time file as follows:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Choose All Employees in the Show field.-Search for the employee and click Edit button.-Go to the Employee Times tab, input the Date From/To, check All Recorded Times.-Here you can find the times of the employee which he/she recorded before leaving the organization.-Keywords-Time Admistrator, Time Recording, Missing, Times

Title: Key Figures like Actual, Planned and Remaining Work Hours Shows As 0.00 h Value in Customer Project Overview Report
Content: Symptom-When you run the Customer Project Overview Report for some customer projects the key figures like Actual, Planned and Remaining Work Hours shows as 0.00 h value in Customer Project Overview Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for Customer Project Overview Report and select it.-Click Edit With button and select Web Browser.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the key figures like Actual, Planned and Remaining Work Hours are shows as zero value in the Customer Project Overview Report.-Or-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Reports view and click List subview.-Search for Customer Project Overview Report and select it.-Click View With button and select Web Browser.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the key figures like Actual, Planned and Remaining Work Hours are shows as zero value in the Customer Project Overview Report.-Cause-The key figures like Actual Work, Planned Work and Remaining Work are only shown for the customer projects which are linked to Sales Orders that are Released. Hence projects which are of type customer projects without sales integration (Customer Project w/o Sales Integration) will not show these key figures and shows as zero value in Customer Project Overview Report.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Customer Project Overview, Key Figures, Hours

Title: Missing Value Help for Time Types in Excel Upload for Time Recordings
Content: Symptom-When you use the Excel add-in to upload times for employees, the value help for the "Time Types" column in the Excel template doesn't display any data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Time Recording view and Time Sheet sub view.-Highlight an employee and click Action button and choose Upload Times from Microsoft Excel option.-In the Excel, highlight a cell of Time Types column and select look up value. The list is empty.-Cause-The value help for the time type is both time and country-specific.-Resolution-You should set the country first (e.g., DE for Germany) in the header of Excel. Once the country is set, the value help should provide appropriate time types for the specified country.-Keywords-Value Help, Excel, Time, Time Type, Time Administration

Title: Unable to see old Time Recordings from Employee After Rehire with Reinstatement Enabled
Content: Symptom-You have rehired an employee with the Reinstatement checkbox enabled. Upon checking the employee Time file, you notice that all the information from the previous year disappeared.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To re-hire the Employee XYZ with Reinstatement enabled:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-On the query dropdown list, select All Employees.-Search and select the respective Employee.-Click on the Actions button.-Click on the Rehire Employee button.-Fill the required fields.-Under the section Special Conditions, check the option Reinstatement.-Click on the Save and Close button.-Note: Ensure that the Hire Date selected is at least one day after the last Termination Date.-To check the Time entries of the Employee:-Go to Time Administration workcenter.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the Employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Employee Times tab.-Here you are unable to see the old time recordings.-Cause-The Work agreement for the Employee on the first employment period is different from the Work agreement after the rehire process. This happens because the Time agreement is created on the basis of the Work agreement. Since these are different, the Time agreements are also different. Hence the Time files are also different for the Employee XYZ in both the periods.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-To see the recorded times of the first employment period, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Time Administration workcenter.-Enter the Employees view.-In the query dropdown list, select All Employees.-Search for the Employee. The search will return at least two entries.-Select the entry with the validity period of the first employment period.-In this entry, you will be able to see the Time Agreement and Employee Times booked on the period of the first employment.-In case you want to record times (for example, vacation days taken between the termination and the rehiring), this can be done in the time file of the terminated employment period.-Keywords-Reinstatement, Rehire, Work agreement, Special Conditions, TLM
