Title: Supplier or Service Agent is not Transferred from Project to Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You created a Purchase Request from within a Project, you filled in the Preferred Service Agent field or the Preferred Supplier field. In the Purchase Requests and Orders work center, the Service Agent or Supplier has not been assigned to the corresponding Purchase Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select a project and press the Edit button.-In the Maintain Project window, go to the Work and Requests tab.-Press the Create Purchase Request button.-Fill in the Preferred Supplier field or the Preferred Service Agent field.-Press the Finish button.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.- Select the relevant purchase request and press the Edit button.- Go to the Source of Supply tab.- You notice the Supplier field is empty.-Cause-This is desired behaviour of the system. When you create a purchase request from a project, you can only enter a preferred supplier or respectively preferred service agent. If you open the corresponding purchase request in the Purchase Requests and Orders work center, you'll notice that the Preferred Supplier field or Preferred Service Agent field is filled in correctly. There you can choose to copy the preferred supplier or preferred service agent to the Supplier field. Alternatively you can choose another source of supply.-Resolution-You can set up the automatic creation of purchase orders as well. You need to ensure that a contract exists for the Service ID or Material ID. Then follow these steps:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Define Automatic Document Creation link under Common Tasks.-Press the Edit button and then the Append button.-Choose the relevant Product Category and the creation option: Create purchase order automatically.-Keywords-Project to Purchase Request, Supplier, Service Agent, Projects

Title: Error Message: Account DEF: Balance in company currency is not zero
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to clear open items for G/L Account ABC and you receive error message:-'Account DEF: Balance in company currency is not zero'. (Here DEF and ABC are two different G/L accounts).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Click General Ledger Accounts view.-Find the G/L Account ABC.-Click Edit and Select the Open Items on Selected Account.-Select the open line items and click Clear.-You receive error message:-'Account DEF: Balance in company currency is not zero. Save Failed.'-Cause-You have assigned the Open Item Reference ID to some of the open items for the G/L account DEF as well. However Balance in company currency for such items is not zero.-When you try to clear the items for the G/L account ABC having Open Item Reference ID as GHI (GHI means the Open Item Reference ID), system checks for all open item assigned to the same Open Item Reference ID and since for the G/L account DEF it's not balancing to zero (0), system throws the error message.-You can also check G/L Accounts - Line Items report to check the difference for Debit Amount Company Currency and Credit Amount Company currency for both G/L accounts.-Resolution-The issue can be resolved by maintaining the different Open Item Reference ID for both the G/L Accounts or assigning the Open Item Reference ID such that it balance to zero (0).-To Remove the Open Item Reference ID follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Click General Ledger Accounts view.-Find the G/L account and click Edit.-Select the Open Items on Selected Account.-Click Remove assignment.-To assign the existing Open Item Reference ID follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center-Click General Ledger Accounts view-Find the G/L account-Click Edit and select the Open Items on Selected Account-Click Assign and select Assign Existing Open Item Reference-Once Balance in company currency for the particular open item reference is zero, you will be able to clear the items.-See Also-2134010 - Unable To Clear Open Items In G/L Account-Keywords-Open items on selected account, G/L accounts, Clear, Balance in company currency is not zero

Title: Unable To Clear Open Items In G/L Account
Content: Symptom-You are trying to clear G/L Account line items with Balance in Company Currency zero but the Clear option is not enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Click General Ledger Accounts view.-Find the G/L Account.-Click Edit and Select the Open Items on Selected Account.-Select the open line items.-You can see that the Balance in Company Currency is Zero but clear option is not enabled.-Cause-The issue is occurs because the Open Item Reference ID is not matching for both the line items. While clearing two or more items, below two things need to be checked:-Open Item Reference ID must be same for all the line items or there should not be any Open Item Reference ID assigned to the selected items.-Balance in Company Currency must be Zero.-Resolution-The issue can be resolved by first removing the assignment and then assign the existing open item reference ID.-Step -1: To remove the assignment for the open item, follow the below steps:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Click General Ledger Accounts view.-Find the G/L Account and click Edit.-Select the Open Item on Selected Account.-Click Remove assignment.-Step -2: To assign the existing open item reference ID follow the below steps:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Click General Ledger Accounts view.-Find the G/L Account.-Click Edit and select the Open Items on Selected Account.-Click Assign and select Assign Existing Open Item Reference.- After following the above steps check the Balance in Company Currency which should be Zero. Now you can see that the clear option is enabled and will allow you to clear the line items.-See Also-2134225 - Error Message: Account 123: Balance in company currency is not zero-Keywords-open items; Balance in Company Currency; open item reference ID

Title: Not all Customer Projects are shown in the Customer Project Overview Report.
Content: Symptom-When you run the Customer Project Overview Report it will not show all Customer Projects existing in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Choose the Reports view and click on List sub view.-Choose all reports in Show field and filter with Customer Project Overview Report in the Find field.-Open the Customer Project Overview Report in web browser.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the Customer Project Overview Report will not show all Customer Projects existing in the system.-Or-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Reports view and click on List sub view.-Choose all reports in Show field and filter with Customer Project Overview Report in the Find field.-Open the Customer Project Overview Report in web browser.-Choose Go button.-Here you will be able to see the Customer Project Overview Report will not show all Customer Projects existing in the system-This can be verified from Project Management work center to see all the listed projects.-Go to Project management work center.-Click on Projects view.-Select All Project in show field and click GO.-Here, you can see numerous projects listed are of type Customer Project with Sales Integration and Customer Projects without Sales Integration.-Cause-This report only shows the Customer Projects which are linked to Sales Orders and the Sales Order should be released. If a Sales Order is linked to a Project and is still In Preparation status, you will not be able to see this project in the report.-However if the project is of type Customer Project without Sales Integration, then you will be able to see this project in the report as well.-Resolution-The report is working fine as system designed behavior.-Keywords-Customer Project, Project, Customer Project Overview Report

Title: Expense Report Cannot be Posted Due to Error Message 'posting is partially blocked'
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Expense Report, however, when attempting to finish it, the system raises an error message informing that the period is partially blocked. Furthermore, the posting date is within the process control set for the accounting period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self Service Overview subview.-Click New Expense Report, in the Expenses section.-Fill out the expense report according to your needs.-Click Finish.-The following error message is raised:-'Expense report cannot be posted on date XXX: posting partially blocked'. (XXX represents the expense report's posting date).-Cause-The Expense Report's posting date is before the Posting Date for Migration. The message informing that the period is partially blocked is raised when the actual transaction date is before the Posting Date for Migration.-Resolution-You have to set the Posting Date for Migration so that it dates back the expense report's posting date.-In order to change the Posting Date for Migration, please follow the below steps:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Companies subview.-Choose the appropriate company and click Actions -> Set Posting Date for Migration.-Select a functional migration date. You should be able to put it back to the latest migration date that was actually used in your system.-Click OK.-You should now be able to create your expense report.-Note that if you cannot change the Posting Date for Migration, you may change the expense report's Posting Date ﻿so that it dates after the migration date.-Keywords-Posting Date for Migration; expense report; partially blocked

Title: Unable to Create Outgoing Check Due to the Error: 'No check lot for automatic payment exist for bank account XYZ'
Content: Symptom-You try to create a new outgoing check, but it fails, and the system returns the error: 'No check lot for automatic payment exist for bank account XYZ'.-(XYZ represents the bank account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can follow the below steps to reproduce the error:-Go to the Payables work center and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Select Account ID DEF (DEF represents the account ID) and then click "View" button.-Select the Open Item on the list and then click "Pay Manually By" button.-Choose "Outgoing Check" option.-Enter the bank account ID ABC (ABC represents the bank account ID) and total payment amount.-Choose Complete Bank Data, then you will see the following error message:--'No check lot for automatic payment exist for bank account XYZ'-Cause-From the error message that 'No check lot for automatic payments exist for bank account XYZ', we can see the check lot is not defined as automatic payments.--If you want to use checks on automatic payments, you need to maintain the related check lot.-Resolution-You can do the below steps to maintain the necessary settings:-Go to work center Cash and Liquidity Management.-Select view Master Data.-Select subview My Banks.-Open the Bank ID ABC.-Go to tab Bank Accounts.-Choose Bank Account Number XYZ.-Choose subtab Check Lot.-You need to mark the Used for Automatic Check Numbering. You need to mark this if you wish to use this check lot in automatic payments.-Then choose Save.-Keywords-Outgoing Check, automatic payment, bank account,

Title: Missing Edit Time Sheet in Home Work Center
Content: Symptom-You are missing Edit Time Sheet option in Home work center-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Enter the Self Services Overview view.-Here you can see that under the Time section, there is no link for Edit Time Sheet.-Cause-There could be 2 main causes for this behavior:-During project scoping you did not select the option "Do you want your employees to record their working times using an employee self-service time sheet?", therefore none of the users are able to see Edit Time Sheet in Home work center.-There is a UI switch on the business role level disabling this option.-Resolution-To check on the Business Configuration option:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the view Implementation Projects.-Select your implementation project and click Edit Project Scope (alternatively, click on View Active Scope in case there are no projects open).-Navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Click on Show and then on All Elements.-Expand the element Human Resources.-Click on the element Time Recording.-On the right panel, under question group Time Recording Self-services, mark the checkbox for the question "Do you want your employees to record their working times using an employee self-service time sheet?".-Proceed in the wizard until you confirm your project scope.-After logging out and entering the system again, the link should be visible to the users.-If your project is already live, you also need to merge the changes done via activity Merge Scoping and Fine-Tuning Changes with Production.-To check the UI Switch in the business role:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Business Roles view.-Select the business role assigned to the user and click on Edit.-Navigate to the UI Switches tab.-Here you would see an entry with identifier as SS_EDITTIMESHEET_DISABLE and description as "Removes the Edit Time Sheet link from Self-Services Overview".-See Also-KBA: 1922087 - How to Create a Change Project and its Lifecycle 1922087-Keywords-not available, visible, cannot, ESS

Title: Unable to Find The Inbound Delivery Details in the Goods Receipt Tracking Report
Content: Symptom-Inbound Delivery details are not visible in the Goods Receipt Tracking Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open the Report "Goods Receipt Tracking".-Enter the required details.-Choose Apply.-Information Message triggered: "No report data available to display; check the selection".-Cause-The "Goods Receipt Tracking" Report provides an overview of all Goods Receipts by supplier, product, or account assignment.-Buyers can use this report to monitor Goods Receipt values, prices, quantities, and the corresponding Goods Receipt status.-Therefore, data related to Inbound Deliveries is not included and is not expected to be visible in this report.-Resolution-For information related to Inbound Deliveries, refer to the "Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items" Report.-This Report provides detailed transactional data for Inbound Delivery documents, including product line items, quantities, identified stock, product requirement specifications, and status information.-Keywords-Reports; Inbound Delivery; Goods Receipt Tracking Report; No Report Data; Available; Display; Check Selection; Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Error for Contracts - CM_FIA_PERIOD_LOCK Exception
Content: Symptom-You have performed the Revenue Recognition Run for the contract AAA (AAA represents the Contract ID) and Revenue Recognition run finishes with the below error message:-'Please create an incident, reason "An exception with the type CM_FIA_PERIOD_LOCK occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause"'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition view and select the run in question.-Click Log Result link.-Navigate to Messages tab.-You can see the error message:-'Please create an incident, reason "An exception with the type CM_FIA_PERIOD_LOCK occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor decleared in a RAISING clause"'-Cause-You are working with a customized fiscal year variant. The error is triggered as the end date of Contract AAA is set to YYYY (YYYY represents Fiscal Year ID). However, the accounting periods of fiscal year YYYY are not maintained in the Other Fiscal Year fine tune activity.-When working with a customized fiscal year variant then all accounting periods until the end date of the contract must be maintained in Fine Tuning.-Resolution-You must maintain the period details for the used fiscal year variant for all accounting periods until the end date of contract AAA:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Access the Other Fiscal Year fine tune activity. -Search for the Fiscal Year Variant for the relevant Company and Set of Books.-Go to the Period Details tab.-Maintain the period details to include the future end date of the contract. For example if you contract End date is 31.07.2028, maintain Fiscal and period details up to this date.-Once you have maintained the above information complete a new Revenue Recognition Run.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition run, Contracts, CM_FIA_PERIOD_LOCK, Variant Fiscal Year

Title: Time Recording Cannot be Edited or Deleted
Content: Symptom-You want to remove or edit a time recording of an employee, however the time recording is grayed out and Remove button is not enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Choose Time Recording view.-Choose Time Sheet subview.-Edit the employee XYZ (XYZ represents the employee ID).-Go to Employee Times tab.-Here the entry is read-only and the Remove button is grayed out.-Cause-Causes:-1) The time type which concerns the time entry you selected has not been activated for usage in the employee time sheet or in the Time File of the Time Administration, therefore all the recordings for the given time type appear as read-only.-2) The project against which the employee is recording time has status Completed, Closed or Stopped. The Project can be found in Labor Information tab under Employee Times.-3) The Time Recording is marked as Not Allowed for the project task against which the employee is recording time hence the time recording cannot be changed.-Resolution-For Cause "1", follow the steps below:-You will need to activate the time type via Business Configuration.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find the activity Time Types - XX (XX represents the country abbreviation)-Click Change Immediately.-On the screen that opens, click Maintain Employee Time Types, under Employee Time Types section.-Choose the concerned time type.-In the Service Activation tab, you will be able to flag the time type for Time Sheet and Time Administration.-Save your changes.-Open the user's time sheet again.-For Cause "2", follow the steps below:-Go to Project Management Work center.-Choose Projects view.-Choose Projects subview.-Choose show All Projects.-Search for Project ABC (ABC represents the Project ID against which the employee XYZ is recording time).-Choose Edit.-Go to Project Plan.-Go to Project Status field.-Revoke the status and make it to released.-Click Save.-Now you will be able to edit or remove the Employee Times.-For Cause "3", follow the steps below:-Go to Project Management Work center.-Choose Projects view.-Choose Projects subview.-Choose show All Projects.-Search for Project ABC (ABC represents the Project ID against which the employee XYZ is recording time).-Choose Edit.-Go to Project Plan.-Choose Project Task which is assigned to the employee XYZ.-Choose the field Time Recording and change the field from Not Allowed to Approval Required or No Approval Required as per your requirement.-Click Save button.-Now you will be able to edit or remove the Employee Times.-Keywords-Time Recording, Employee Times, Projects, Grayed Out, Remove, button, Time Sheet, Read-only

Title: How to find the Open Tasks for Purchase Order Acknowledgement
Content: Symptom-How and Where to find the Open Tasks for Purchase Order Acknowledgement -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view -Search for the Purchase Order ABC-Purchase Order Acknowledgement XXX is visible -Resolution-Open task for a Purchase Order can be found in 2 places:-A) In Purchase Order view-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the Open Tasks from the drop down, all the open tasks related to Purchase Orders will be visible here-B) In Overview view-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Overview view-Under Purchase Orders tab , select Open Tasks-Open Tasks will be visible here -Keywords-Open task for a Purchase Order, PO Acknowledgement task

Title: Time Recording Method is Set by Default as Exception-Based
Content: Symptom-You have replicated the Employee XYZ for the first time to ByDesign and in Time Profile you see that time recording method for the employee XYZ is set by default to Exception-Based (where XYZ represents the Employee)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Sheet view.-Select the Employee XYZ.-Click Open Time Sheet button.-Click You can also on top right corner and select Open Time Profile.-Click Time Profile tab > Basic Data sub tab.-You notice that for the employee XYZ Time Recording Method set by default to Exception-based.-Cause-At the time of initial hiring of employees if you don't set the Time Recording Method flag, hence the system by default consider the Exception-based method.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Nevertheless, you can change it manually from Exception-based to Positive via below steps.-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time sheet view.-Select the Employee XYZ.-Click on Open Time Sheet tab.-Click on You can also from top right corner > Click on Open Time File.-Go to Time Profile > Basic Data tab.-Time Recording Method: Select radio button for Positive method.-Keywords-Time Recording, Method, Positive, Exception-based

Title: Supplier Master Data - Communication For Remittance Advice
Content: Symptom-In a supplier invoice you unflagged the Remittance Advice Required box.-In addition, you try to change the data in the Remittance Advice To field under the Communication - Addresses tab,  but you cannot change it or save your changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Payables Work Center.-Go to Suppliers view and select the respective Supplier ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier ID).-Press Edit - Financial Data.-Navigate to Payment Data tab.-Under Advice Control unflag the Remittance Advice Required box.-Navigate to Communication - Addresses tab.-Here it is not possible to remove the standard setting Yes from the field Remittance Advice To.-Cause-As long as the Remittance Advice Required box is unflagged in Financial Data - Payment Data no payment advice will be created.-The information under the Communication - Addresses tab is only additional information should it be necessary to send remittance advices in the future.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Supplier Master Data, Communication, Remittance Advice,

Title: Looping When Trying to Access the System via Single Sign-on
Content: Symptom-You are trying to access the system with the SSO credentials, however the system is looping between the SAP Business ByDesign and the IDP server.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Try to access the SAP Business ByDesign with SSO configuration.-Cause-It migh have two different causes for this scenario:-ACS URL, where it's not correct as per the SP metadata file.-The other possibility is related to the Include Assertion Consumer Service URL, where it's wrongly selected. -Resolution-Please change the ACS endpoint according to the SP metadata, for example: 'https://my123456-sso.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/runtime'-Please uncheck the 'Include Assertion Consumer Service URL' option that is maintained in the Configure Single Sign-On View and then Identity Provider screen.-See Also-Single Sign-On (SSO) with SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-SSO, Single Sign-On, Not Working, Looping, Cannot Access, Unable, Back and Forth, IDP, Identity Provider.

Title: Delete Account Button is Disabled while Trying to Delete a Time Account in Time Profile
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, want to delete a Time Account in the Time Profile tab in employee's time file. But the Remove button may be disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select respective employee and select the Edit button.-Go to Time Profile tab and select Time Account Rules sub-tab.-Highlight the Time Account and the Remove button is disabled.-Cause-If there are postings/adjustments against the time account, then the Remove button is disabled so deletion is impossible.-Resolution-This is system designed behavior.-To enable the Remove button, the existing postings/adjustments on this time account must be removed. After that you should be able to delete the Account Assignment under the Time Account Rules in the Details section of the Time Profile tab.-Keywords-Delete, Time Account, Time Profile, Remove

Title: A few tabs are missing in the Personnel File of an employee
Content: Symptom-You notice that a few tabs are missing under Personal Data of an employee's Personnel File (for example: Disability, Regulatory Compliance, IDs, Additional Data).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the relevant employee.-Click Edit.-Go to Personal Data tab.-You see a few sub-tabs missing.-Cause-The structure and content of your employee's Personnel Files vary, depending on the country in which they were hired and the current scope of your HR solution.-Please note that these tabs are not related to the country that has been scoped in the system. They are related to the country where each employee has been hired.-You can find below a few examples of countries that require specific data for its employees:-Disability: China, Germany, France, United Kingdom, India, United States.-Regulatory Compliance: China.-IDs: China, France, United Kingdom.-Additional Data: China.-Once an employee is hired in one of the above mentioned countries, they will have the respective tab(s).-Resolution-Standard system behavior.-See Also-Quick Guide for Employees (in Personnel Administration)-The Personnel File--Keywords-employee master data, tabs missing, personal data

Title: How to link a Purchase Order to a Sales Order, for a To-Stock scenario
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order is not getting linked to a Sales Order -or-Sales Order is not getting created from a Purchase Order for To-Stock scenario-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Order work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the Purchase Order number and open items tab-Select a line item, Account assignment tab is not available -In the document flow tab of the Purchase Order, no Sales Order is linked to this Purchase Order.-Cause-The Purchase Orders are for To-Stock items. To-Stock items will not have an Accounting Assignment. In a To-Stock Procurement scenario, no Account Assignment is done to a Cost Center or any other cost object like Sales Order, Project, etc... In such a case, the postings happen to the G/L accounts according to the Account Determination group maintained for the corresponding material and supplier. The costs are not explicitly incurred against any cost object and hence one does not see the cost object ID in the Journal Entry. This is the correct behavior. The postings happen to the inventory account of the business residence where the material is going to be stocked.-Resolution-The only scenario where we have a direct link between a Sales Order and a Purchase Order is the Third-Party-Order Process (TPOP), but here the material never touches the own warehouse, but is directly shipped from the Supplier to the Customer.-Another way of establishing the link between Sales Order and purchase Order is by using the product specification as outlined in this blog post Modelling make-to-order using product specifications | SAP Blogs . This approach will also work for Purchasing scenarios, not just only for Production scenarios.-See Also-Please refer the blog on Intercompany scenario-SAP Business ByDesign Intercompany Process Automation-Keywords-TO- Sock Intercompany scenario, Link Purchase order to Sales order

Title: Error Message Raised when Closing January
Content: Symptom-You are trying to close January and received this error:-Closing of period 001 not possible: Previous fiscal year not closed.-The previous year is already close, the Carry Forward Posted as well Result Posted are already checked under Edit Fiscal Years.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps for the error message being raised:-1.   Go to General Ledger work center-2.   Go to Common Tasks-3.   Go to Open and Close Periods View-4.   Select January which is the year you want to close-5.   Press Close Period button-6.   Error:-Closing of period 001 not possible: Previous fiscal year not closed.-  Steps to check the details on the closing process:-1.   Go to General Ledger work center-2.   Go to Master Data View-3.   Go to Sets of Books and Assigned Companies subview-4.   Select the company ID-5.   Press button Edit Fiscal Years-6.   It is possible see the previous year has the bellow details:-Fiscal Year Status: 3 – Blocked-Carry Forward Posted: Check box selected-Result Posted: Check box selected-1.   Go to General Ledger work center-2.   Go to Common Tasks-3.   Go to Open and Close Periods View-4.   Select January of the year you want to close-5.   Details:-Period Status: 1 - Not Blocked-First Allowed Step: 010 - Operational postings-Last Allowed Step: 080 - Adjusting entries for income stat. by nature of expenses-6. Select December of the previous year-7. Details:-Period Status: 3 – Blocked-First Allowed Step: 990 - Closing balance-Last Allowed Step: 990 - Closing balance-Cause-The selected criteria for the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step are not correct for December and January.-Due to this the Balance Carryforward runs must be reversed in order to allow again the changes.-Resolution-The correct status for December should be:-First Allowed Step: 001 - Opening balance-Last Allowed Step: 991 - Profit and loss calculation of retained earning-The correct status for January should be:-First Allowed Step: 001 - Opening balance-Last Allowed Step: 020 - Closing entries-As the Balance carryforward has two steps:-Balance Carryforward Step 1: Carry Forward G/L Account Balances-Balance Carryforward Step 2: Calculate and Carry Forward Profit/Loss-To be able to change the First and Last Allowed Step of December you must open this month.-If you try open December the button Open Period is graeyest, because you already performed the Balance Carryforward run.-So you need to reverse the Balance Carryforward for the previous year processing in the reverse order it was initially executed (step 2 has to be reversed first then step 1).-After reversing, you should be able to open December, and then change the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step as bellow:-First Allowed Step: 001 - Opening balance-Last Allowed Step: 991 - Profit and loss calculation of retained earning-Re-run the Balance Carryforward run previously reversed (step 1 then step 2).-And then close again previous fiscal year – December.-Keywords-Balance Carryforward, Closing period

Title: How to Add a New Payment Term And How To Change the Current Payment Terms
Content: Symptom-Adding a new Payment Term or changing the current Payment Term.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can reproduce the issue by following the steps below:-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Edit Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of a sales order).-Under payment the new payment terms need to added.-Cause-If you need to create/update a new payment term you need to add this option in the Activity Accounts in Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-We can follow the below steps and add/update new payment terms in sales orders:-Your project is Complete (after go-live):-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity: Accounts and click "Change Immediately" button. -Click "Maintain Payment Terms".-Add row -> Here you can maintain the payment terms.-Click Save.-Your Project is in Process:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project.-Select Activity List.-Go to the Fine Tune Step.-Select the Fine tuning activity "Accounts".-Click "Maintain Payment Terms".-Add row -> Here you can maintain the payment terms.-Click Save.-Keywords-New Payment Term, Current Payment Terms, Sales Order-payment term

Title: Overtime is not Calculated for Employee in Timesheet
Content: Symptom-You have set up the Compensation file with Hourly and Overtime Compensation components, and assigned the Time Recording Profile to an employee. However you notice that the Overtime is not calculated for this employee in their Time Sheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Enter Time Sheet view.-Search for the employee and select it.-Click on the Open Time Sheet button.-Navigate to the Review and Correct tab.-In the Time Recording Completeness table, you can see the time recordings without the overtime calculated.-Cause-The employee time profile may have been changed and not completed. Therefore, Planned Working Time is not calculated.-Overtime calculation is based on the planned hours set for the employee, so this information is required for the overtime calculation.-Resolution-Please maintain the Time Model and the Time Accounts in the new Time Profile of the Employee.-This can be done following the below steps:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently valid Time Profile.-On the panel below, enter the Work Schedule tab.-Select the Work Schedule from the dropdown list.-In case the work schedule was set as Predefined, select the Time Model from the value help.-In case the work schedule was set as Individual, define a work schedule in the Individual Work Schedule table below.-Click on the Save button.-With the same time profile selected, enter the Time Account Rules sub-tab.-Click on the Add Row button and maintain the Time Accounts.-Click on the Save button.-Keywords-Overtime, Compensation, Time Statement, Time Sheet

Title: Time Account Balance is not Carried Forward to the Following Year
Content: Symptom-You are working on the time file of an employee, and notice that times such as special leaves are not getting carried forward to the following recurrence period, even if the time account is configured with a Carry Forward rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for Employee XYZ (where XYZ represents the Employee ID).-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Account Balances tab.-Here you can see that a new recurrence period already started (hence a new time account was created), however the balance of the previous period is not getting carried forward to the new account.-Cause-The balance shown in the time accounts is affected by the Posting Type set in the Time Account rules:-If the posting type of the time is set as Entitlement, the time account balance is shown until the validity end date of the current account for time accounts of type Recurrent, and until the end of the current year for time accounts of type Permanent.-If the posting type of the time is set as Accrual, the time account balance is shown as of the current date.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-Leave, TLM, Type, Rule, Deferred

Title: Error Message: 'No Bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number, national bank code, and currency XYZ'
Content: Symptom-The system rejects the upload of a bank statement with the following error message: 'No Bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number, national bank code, and currency XYZ.'-(XYZ represents the currency)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Navigate to the File Management view and choose Inbound Files.-Select New and Inbound File.-Select the file containing the bank statement(s) via Add for the selected house bank.-Press Start File Upload.-Cause-The error is an indication that the house bank master data as maintained in the system conflicts with the house bank information as recorded in the bank file. Depending on the specificity of the error message, discrepancies can occur in relation to validity definitions, bank account number, national bank identifiers and currencies.-Resolution-Check the validity of the house bank definition for a relevant bank statement date.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Enter the Master Data view and choose My Banks.-Edit the relevant house bank and access the Bank Accounts via Edit. Here you can check the validity of a particular bank account in terms of time intervals and currency restrictions.-Take a note of the Bank Account Number.-From the tab General you can access the Bank ID and the information as maintained in the Bank Directory. Here take a note of the National Bank Code.-Compare these definitions with the data contained in the bank file either by editing the file or by employing a pertinent file reader. Depending on the result either the described definitions have to be adapted or the bank issuing the file has to be consulted.-Keywords-Bank Statement, account number, national bank code, currency, bank account, Upload, Inbound File,

Title: Employee is not Visible in Team Calendar
Content: Symptom-You are set up as a manager, however are not able to view a specific employee in your Team Calendar.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Under the Common Tasks section, click on Launch Team Calendar.-In the Team Calendar list, you are not able to see the Employee.-Cause-The employee does not have a Time Model assigned in their time profile.-Resolution-In order to check and assign a Time Model to the employee, please below steps:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search and select the employee.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently valid time profile row from the table.-On the panel below, navigate to the Work Schedule sub-tab.-In the Work Schedule field, select either Predefined or Individual.-In case the work schedule selected is Predefined, select a Time Model from the value help field.-In case the work schedule selected is Individual, create a work schedule in the table Individual Work Schedule and assign Daily Models for each working day.-Click on the Save button.-Once the above steps are completed in the system, the Manager will be able to see the employee in his Team Calendar.-Keywords-Team Calendar, Managing My Area, MMA, Time Sheet

Title: Some Protected Element in Inference (Constraint) BO_A1S_FIN_ADGR_TAX_CN AND BP_A1S_FI Contradict With Each Other
Content: Symptom-Your system went live already and you have previously scoped the Country China in a test system of your change project. You now want to descope this localization again but an error message appears:-Some protected element in inference (constraint) BO_A1S_FIN_ADGR_TAX_CN AND BP_A1S_FI contradict with each other.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the test system of your change project:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project and click Edit Project Scope button.-Press Edit Countries.-Now de-select China, i.e. move China from the right (Selected Countries) table to the left (Available Countries) table.-Click OK.-Click Next.-An error message appears: Some protected element in inference (constraint) BO_A1S_FIN_ADGR_TAX_CN AND BP_A1S_FI contradict with each other.-Cause-This error message when deselecting China appears as a specific setting, Account Determination Groups for Taxes - China (BO_A1S_FIN_ADGR_TAX_CN) is in scope as the country China is in scope. In a Live system this setting is protected. It can only be switched on but not switched off.-Resolution-The only solution here is to cancel the change project from the project list in the test tenant in case the current setting should not be merged. Otherwise you need to re-create the change project for all other pending changes.-To cancel the project-Navigate to the Business Configuration workcenter and here to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project and press Cancel Project.-Keywords-China, Project, Descope, Countries, De-scope

Title: Material From Stock Checkbox is not Enabled.
Content: Symptom-From Stock checkbox is not enabled in material of a project task hence unable to flag From Stock material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project management work center.-Select Projects view.-Select Project XYZ and Edit-> Project Plan (XYZ stands for Project ID).-Navigate to relevant project task.-Go to Material tab here you can see From Stock checkbox is grayed out for some material.-Cause-Once the material actual quantity is updated the From Stock checkbox is not enabled and the system will not allowed to change the material process type.-It means that you have already consumed the material as Non stock in the project hence the From Stock option is grayed out.-Resolution-System works as expected.-Keywords-From Stock, Project, Project Task, Material

Title: Error Message: Accnt Initial Data Carryforward - XYZ in ABC Chart of Accounts not Permitted for Posting Using Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You are migrating General Ledger Account Balances and received the below error message:-Accnt Initial Data Carryforward - XYZ in ABC Chart of Accounts not permitted for posting using journal entry voucher-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Process the file and during simulate import you get the error.-Accnt Initial Data Carryforward - XYZ in ABC Chart of Accounts not permitted for posting using journal entry voucher-Cause-When you migrate G/L account balances, the amounts are posted on the G/L accounts of the corresponding sub ledgers.-The G/L account balances will also be forwarded automatically to Migration Clearing Accounts.-Here the system will not post to the corresponding sub-ledgers due to a G/L account posting-block stating Only automatic postings allowed.--Below are some Examples of sub ledgers of G/L accounts:-Initial Data Carryforward - Accounts Payables-Initial Data Carryforward - Accounts Receivables-Initial Data Carryforward - Asset Account-Initial Data Carryforward - Cash Account-Initial Data Carryforward - Open Items Payable-Initial Data Carryforward - Inventory--Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select a G/L in question and go to the view G/L Account Posting Block and select All Postings Allowed from the dropdown.-Also change the corrresponding sub-ledgers G/L Account Posting Block to All Postings Allowed.-Save.-Now you are able to migrate the G/L account balances.

Title: Buying Company Condition in Purchase Order's Approval
Content: Symptom-The Purchase Order is not being sent to Approval because the condition 'Buying Company' is not being correctly maintained. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center. -Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the ID of the Purchase Order).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Approval tab.-The Purchase Order was not sent to approval as expected. -Cause-The condition 'Buying Company' in the approval's process only accepts the Buying Company's ID and not the name. So if in Purchase Order the Buying Company is maintained as 'XYZ - Company Name', the condition needs to be maintained as 'XYZ' oy 'XYZ*'. -Resolution-The steps to maintain the condition correctly is mentioned below:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view.-Select the Approval process regarding Purchase Orders. -Click in Copy button. -Select the step and the condition regarding Buying Company field. -Maintain the company's ID in the field, for example 'Buying company matches pattern XYZ'. -Save it. -Edit the validity of the Draft to publish it. -Keywords-Approval process, Purchase Order, Buying Company, Company

Title: Initial User Credentials Not Received for SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Customer did not receive the Initial User credential email or request to resend Initial User credential.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Initial User Credential will be sent only to maintained IT contact Email ID.-Resolution-Kindly create an incident in Service Now with Service offering as "SPC Operation" and Handover Service as ” SAAS BYD C4C PROV L2 - Provisioning – L2 Operations.-Provisioning team will resend the handover email to the IT contact with the Initial User credentials.-Keywords-initial credential, initial password, initial access, login,login failed,wrong credential,password expired,resend credential,reset credential.

Title: Time Sheet Shows Incorrect Overtime
Content: Symptom-You are checking the time sheet of an employee and notice that there is overtime set for this employee, even though he/she has booked only the regular scheduled hours.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Sheet view.-Search for the employee which you want to check the times booked.-Select the employee and click Open Time Sheet button.-Go to Review and Correct tab and then select the week which you want to check.-See that there are  overtime hours, even though the employee has maintained his/her regular schedule.-Cause-Employee has maintained time with some gaps or outside the working hours, for example, the employee's schedule is from 08:00 to 16:00, but the employee has maintained the times as below:-07:30:00 - 08:45:00-08:45:00 - 10:15:00-10:15:00 - 11:00:00-12:00:00 - 15:30:00-Since the employee's working hours are set from 08:00 to 16:00, anything outside this working hours will be set as overtime.-Resolution-The employees have to maintain their working hours accordingly to the times they are working.-Keywords-Overtime, Time Sheet, Working Hours, Incorrect

Title: The Notification Opportunity Stalled is Sent to Multiple Employees
Content: Symptom-The notification Opportunity Stalled is being sent to multiple employees.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Task Distribution view.-Go to Business Task Management sub-view.-You can see that the notification for Stalled Opportunities has been sent to Multiple Persons.-Cause-If an opportunity remains too long in a certain phase, then it is said to be stalled. In this case, the system notifies the manager of the sales representative who is responsible for the opportunity. This type of notification has priority high as a default. A notification of this type expires automatically 14 days after it has been created.--Normally, the relevant sales manager receives this notification in his/her Inbox in the Home work center. In case the manager is not maintained for the employee responsible the notification is sent to all business users.-Resolution-You should maintain the manager for the employee responsible of the affected opportunity.-For your reference, you have the possibility to disable completely this notification in your system.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the Active Project and click Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine Tune tab.-Open all activities.-Click on the activity business task management for new business and uncheck the second option Notification for stalled opportunities. If you cannot see the activity business task management for new business, you will need to add it in the Add optional Activities--Secondly, you could as well define an alternative approver in your system who should receive the notification in the future.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Task Distribution view.-Go to  Employee Work Distribution sub-view.-Select Alternate approver for Sales Quote. -Keywords-Stalled, Opportunity, Task Distribution, Notification

Title: How to Reverse Intracompany Bank-to-Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-You wrongly create an intra-company bank to bank transfer XYZ, the outgoing bank transfer is already Confirmed, while the incoming bank transfer is still In Transfer. You try to reverse the incoming bank transfer, but the system gives an error message: Cancel of XYZ not possible; outgoing bank transfer already confirmed.-XYZ means the bank to bank transfer ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, and choose the Payment Monitor view.-Show all payments, and select the document ID XYZ.-You can see there are an incoming bank transfer and an outgoing bank transfer with the same document ID XYZ, and the same amount.-The incoming bank transfer is still In Transfer, while the outgoing bank transfer is already Confirmed.-Choose the incoming bank transfer, and click Reverse.-The system gives an error message: 'Cancel of XYZ not possible; outgoing bank transfer already confirmed'.-Cause-Because the outgoing bank transfer and the incoming bank transfer are created in pair, if one is confirmed, the other cannot be reversed then.-Resolution-So in order to reverse the intra-company bank-to-bank transfer, first of all, you have to reverse the confirmed outgoing bank transfer XYZ:-From the details of the outgoing bank transfer XYZ, check the bank statement that confirms this outgoing bank transfer.-From the bank statement, you could see that the outgoing bank transfer is confirmed by the payment allocation ABC (ABC means the payment allocation ID).-Click this payment allocation ABC, and reverse it.-A new payment allocation DEF is created (DEF is the payment allocation ID), at the same time, the outgoing bank transfer XYZ is set from Confirmed back to In Transfer.-Select the outgoing bank transfer XYZ, and set it back to Not Transferred.-After that, reverse it, and then both the incoming and outgoing bank transfer will be set as Canceled.-About the newly created payment allocation DEF, you can click Mark as Return under Actions, the amount will be credited back to the account.-Keywords-bank-to-bank transfer; b2b; mark as return

Title: Value Conversion In Migration Not Loading
Content: Symptom-During migration activity, system does not load Value Conversion.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Select any Migration activity.-Execute step by step migration.-Go to Step 2: Convert Values.-Click the value conversion task, the link is not loading.-Cause-User setting issue.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search for any Migration activity.-Enter it.-Select the relevant file.-Execute step by step migration.-Go to Step 2: Convert Values.-For worklist, select "Show: All Tasks".-Click any Edit Value Conversion task (except the affected one).-You are redirected to a new screen, then perform right click anywhere in the table.-Go to "User Settings".-Now click "More".-Under "User Settings For Table", choose "Reset User Settings for the Running Application".-Keywords-Value Conversion, Convert Values, Migration, Edit value conversion, not loading

Title: The Meaning of Retraining Status for Scanned Invoices
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded a scanned invoice and want to understand what the status of the Retraining Status means. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Scanning view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the invoice's ID). -Check the column Retraining Status. -You can see that the status is 'Not Started', 'Rejected Due To Personal Data' or 'Accepted for Retraining'. -Cause-The Retraining Status shows the status of the feedback of reviewed values to update the model based on the corrected values.-To make sure that your tenant is sending the feedback, please ensure that the following question is scoped: "Do you want to train the ML model with the user values via feedback integration ?". The steps to scoped it are mentioned below:  -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation.-Click in Edit project scope button.-Click in Next until reach Questions.-Expand Purchasing.-Expand Supplier Invoicing.-Scope the question "Do you want to train the ML model with the user values via feedback integration ?"-Resolution-Retraining Status is used when we send feedback of reviewed values to update the model based on the corrected values. The Retraining Status when on initial stage has status 'Not Started'. The Machine Learning firstly checks if there is any personal data in the file. Once the check is done, the status changes to either 'Rejected Due To Personal Data' or 'Accepted for Retraining'. -Firstly the user needs to Review the scanned values. Based on the defined Invoice Scanning Algorithm (DOX), the scanned values are mapped to the fields automatically. Also the user needs to confirm in the checkbox that the Review 'Does not contain Personal Data'. Please refrain that this does not mean that the DOX will automatically accept the feedback values. DOX will firstly check the Personal Data on its algorithm, so if there is Personal Data, it will be rejected (This is not determined by ByDesign). -Also only saving the Reviewed Values does not trigger the feedback to DOX Server. The user needs to create a Supplier Invoice based on the Reviewed Values. It may take a few minutes but after that the Retraining Status should be updated. The Machine Learning algorithm will take its own time to process it. -ByDesign sends the feedback to DOX Sever but the processing of it is done by DOX's Machine Learning. -See Also-KBA: 3320686 - Retraining Status of Scanned invoice is ‘Rejected Due To Personal Data'-Keywords-Invoice Scanning; Scanned Invoice; Machine Learning; Retraining; Model

Title: Future Time Accounts Appear in the Employee Time File
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a recurring time account to an employee, and you notice that there is an entry of time account created for the next year (for example, if the current year is 2023, you see entries for the time account for 2023 and 2024).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Account Balances tab.-Here you can see that the time account configured appears as an entry for the current year, and also there is an entry for the following year.-Cause-When a time account is assigned to an employee, a time valuation is automatically executed, which is responsible for creating the instances in the Time Account Balances tab.-The creation of these instances is done up to the end of the next year (with a variation depending on the Period Closure date).-As an example, if the Period Closure date is in March of 2023, you will be able to see the instance of 2023 up until March 2024.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-TLM, Profile, File, Schedule, Time Type

Title: Deviating Holiday Calendar is not Working Properly
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a Deviating Holiday Calendar for an employee, but the holidays from this calendar are not reflecting in the employee's time account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center and access Employees view.-Search for the employee which you want to check and select it, then click Edit button.-Go to tab Time Profile and select the current time profile.-Click Show Holiday Calendar.-There are no holidays maintained.-Cause-The Deviating Holiday Calendar has not been assigned to any working day calendar, then the holidays assigned to it will not be assigned to the employees.-Resolution-In order for the holidays from the Deviating Holiday Calendar to be displayed properly in the employee's time file, you must assign it to a working day calendar.-This can be done by following the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center and access the Overview view.-Select the activity Working Day Calendar and click Open or Change Immediately.-Select option Maintain an existing working day calendar.-Select the working day calendar which you want to assign the holiday calendar and click Next.-In the Holiday Calendar field, select your deviating holiday calendar.-Click Next button until you reach the Review step and then click Finish.-Keywords-Deviating Holiday, Holiday, Calendar, Missing,

Title: Substitute Employee Cannot see the Details of the Substituted Employee in Team Calendar
Content: Symptom-You have set up a substitution in the system, for example with employee A being the substitute of employee B (where A and B represent the employee IDs). However when employee A logs into the system and enters the Team Calendar via workcenter Managing My Area, they cannot find employee B (even though the employees who respond to employee B are visible).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Substitutions view.-Click on the New button, then click on Substitution.-Set up a substitution by setting the employee to be substituted, and the employee substitute.-Click on Save and Close.-Log in as the substitute employee.-Go to Managing My Area workcenter.-Under the Common Tasks section, click on Launch Team Calendar.-Here in the employee list, you are not able to see the employee being substituted.-Cause-The substitution of an Employee does not give authorization to the substitute to see the details of the Employee which is being substituted. Only employees who report to the substituted employee are visible, as the substitute is working on behalf of the employee.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-Team Calendar, Substitute, Managing My Area, Task

Title: Recording With Same Start and End Time and Same Date Leads to a 24 Hours Recording
Content: Symptom-For Time Recordings with same Start / End Time and same Start / End Date, the system calculates 24 hours instead of 0 hours as visible in the Time File of the affected employee. This occurs whether the time is automatically recorded or manually entered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Time Administration work center.-2. Select Employees view.-3. Select an Employee and click Edit button.-4. Go to Employee Times tab.-5. Add Row and enter any Time Type.-6. Enter same Start / End Time and same Start / End Date (For example: Time as 10:00/10:00 and Date as 01.08.2023/ 01.08.2023)-7. Select Save.-8. You see Quantity as 24 Hour(s)-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign expects valid times to be created and does not expect to receive zero time recordings. Therefore the system is designed to span at least a day boundary if the Start Time is after or equal to the End Time.-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected. In case time punches happened by mistake, they need to be removed before being sent to SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Start, End Time, End Date, Quantity

Title: Unexpected Balance in G/L Accounts - Line Items Report for an Opening or Closing - Balance Sheet G/L Account
Content: Symptom-The Account Balance for G/L Account AAA (of account type Opening or closing  - balance sheet) displayed in General Ledger - General Ledger Accounts work center view is not matching with the G/L Accounts - Line Items report -> key figure Balance Company Currency for the same G/L Account and accounting period.-AAA means the G/L Account ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger - General Ledger Accounts work center view.-Check the balance for G/L Account AAA for respective Company, Set of Books and current accounting period: notice that the balance is zero.-Now run the G/L Accounts - Line Items report for same combination of Company, Set of Books and G/L Account and enter Accounting Period/Year as Current Fiscal Year.-Enter key figures Debit Amount Company Currency, Credit Amount Company Currency and Balance Company Currency.-Notice that there's a difference between Debit Amount and Credit Amount, which ends up in a Balance in Company Currency.-Here you expected Balance Company Currency to be zero.-Cause-Only Balance Carryforward step 1 - Carry forward accounts has been executed for referred company and set of books.-Resolution-Execute Balance Carryforward step 2 - Calculate and carry forward profit/loss for referred company and set of books.-Afterwards the Balance Company Currency in G/L Accounts - Line Items report should be cleared for G/L Account AAA.-See Also-Help Document: Balance Carryforward-Keywords-G/L Accounts - Line Items; account balance; Opening or closing  - balance sheet; Balance Company Currency; bcf; balance carryforward

Title: Error Message While Clearing Open Items in a G/L Account: Account XYZ: Balance in company currency is not zero
Content: Symptom-While attempting to clear open items on a G/L Account, you select the open items you want to clear and ensure that the Balance in Company Currency is zero, however, upon executing the Clear action the system throws error message:-'Account XYZ: Balance in company currency is not zero.'-XYZ means the G/L Account ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the General Ledger Accounts view.-Search for the respective G/L Account XYZ and click Edit > Open Items on Selected Account. -Select at least two open items with the same Open Item Reference ID and ensure that calculated Balance in Company Currency is zero.-Click Clear.-Enter a Posting Date and click OK.-Error message is thrown:-'Account XYZ: Balance in company currency is not zero.'-Cause-Here the system considers all the open items with the same Open Item Reference ID irrespective of whether you've selected all these items and irrespective of the G/L Account.-In other words it means that if you've selected two open items totaling a Balance in Company Currency of zero but there's at least one more open item with same Open Item Reference ID in this same G/L Account or in another G/L Account the system will take this item into consideration and the calculated balance won't be zero.-This is the expected behavior of the system. Partial clearing of an Open Item Reference ID is not supported and, additionally, the Open Item Reference ID is only cleared when all assigned line items are selected and all items are balanced to zero.-Resolution-There are two possibilities for solving this issue: to remove the Open Item Reference ID from the open item(s) you won't select to clear or to select the open item(s) with same Open Item Reference ID during the clearing.-To remove the Open Item Reference ID, please follow the steps below:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the General Ledger Accounts view.-Search for the respective G/L Account XYZ and click Edit > Open Items on Selected Account.-Select the item(s) you want to remove the open item reference ID assignment.-Click Remove Assignment.- Remark: you might have more open items with same Open Item Reference ID in a G/L Account other than XYZ. You need to remove the assignment of these items as well.-To select the open item(s) with same Open Item Reference ID during the clearing please follow the steps below:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the General Ledger Accounts view.-Search for the respective G/L Account XYZ and click Edit > Open Items on Selected Account.-Select all the items with same Open Item Reference ID and ensure that Balance in Company Currency is zero.-Click Clear, enter Posting Date and click OK.-If you've selected all the open items with the same reference and the Balance in Company Currency is zero you'll be able to post the clearing successfully.-See Also-2134225 - Error Message: Account 123 Balance in Company Currency is not Zero-This Knowledge Base Article covers the specific scenario where you have additional open items with same Open Item Reference ID in different G/L Accounts.-2134010 - Unable To Clear Open Items In GL Account-This Knowledge Base Article covers the scenario where the Clear button is grayed out.-Keywords-open items; balance in company currency; g/l account

Title: Day Closure Run Executed at Incorrect Time
Content: Symptom-In Time Administration work center the Recurrence of the Day Closure Run is scheduled to run daily at time XXX. But the run is also executed at time YYY on the same day. This happens although only one Day Closure ID is scheduled on a daily basis (where XXX and YYY represent hours).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Time Administration work center.-2. Select Regular Tasks view.-3. Under the section Time Valuations, select the link Administer Day Closure Runs.-4. Show All Runs and mark the row containing the active Day Closure ID.-5. Show last 100 Logs.-6. You see that Logs are executed at time XXX but also at time YYY.-Cause-At least one more job for the Day Closure Run is executed. This job may be created by another user.-Resolution-1. Go to Time Administration work center.-2. Select Regular Tasks view.-3. Under the section Time Valuations, select the link Administer Day Closure Runs.-4. Show All Runs and mark the row containing the active Day Closure ID.-5. Choose View Jobs.-6. Cancel all jobs with time YYY.-Keywords-Day Closure, Run, Time, Schedule

Title: Error 'Action could not be executed' Appears While Creating Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You are creating a shopping cart from the Home work center and system throws an error message while moving to first step Selecting Products.-Error: Action could not be executed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view.-Go to Self-Services Overview subview.-Select the Go Shopping or Go Shopping (Advanced) link under the Shopping section.-In Step 1, Select Products enter some values.-Error appears.-Cause-Shopping cart is not in scoped anymore.-Resolution-You can scope shopping cart from the below steps:-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Edit Project Scope.-Go to step 3 Scoping.-Select Purchasing.-Select the checkbox Shopping Carts.-Finish the scoping.-Keywords-Shopping Cart, Self-Services, Products

Title: Task 'Complete Time Data (hire)' Not Going to the Time Administrator's Inbox
Content: Symptom-When an employee is hired, a task to complete the time file data is generated and it should be sent to the time administrator.-This task may not reach the time administrator's inbox because the responsible person cannot be determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Assumption: An employee has been hired.-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Work view.-There is no task to complete the time data for the just hired employee.-The responsible person for the task could not be determined and the task can be seen here:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select the Utilities view.-Select the common task Business Task Management.-Where all the tasks without responsible person are listed.-Cause-The Organizational Structure is not configured properly.-Specifically, this is caused by that the responsibility for Time and Labor Management is not assigned to the correct org unit or there is no employee associated.-Resolution-It is necessary to assign the responsibility for Time Administration to the desired org unit:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select the desired org unit and select the button Edit.-Select the tab Functions.-Check the Human Resources checkbox under Human Resources section.-Select the button Activate and choose Activate All.-Select the button Save and Close.-Keywords-Time Data, Task, Hire, Work View

Title: Vacation Does Not Deduct Weekends from Time Account Balance
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement that vacation periods should also account weekend days when deducting from the vacation time account balance. For example, if an employee takes a 1 week vacation, it must deduct 7 days of the vacation time account balance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It is currently not possible to configure the system to include days off when deducting from the time account balance.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-You can use manual adjustments in the time account balances to manually deduct days from the time account.-To do so, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Account Balances tab.-Select the desired time account.-On the panel below the time accounts table, navigate to the Adjustments sub-tab.-Click on the button Add Row.-In the quantity field, you can input a negative number to deduct the required amount from the time account balance.-Keywords-time model, total balance, weekends, saturday, sunday, employee, weekdays, manual

Title: After Posting the Goods and Services Receipt Neither a Fixed Asset nor an Individual Material Are Created
Content: Symptom-During asset procurement, you expected the system to post a fixed asset acquisition automatically after you posted a purchase order and a goods and services receipt, however neither a fixed asset nor an individual material were created.-This Knowledge Base Article is based on the fixed asset acquisition scenario 'Automatic posting from a purchase order after goods receipt' described in the help document 'Individual Materials and Acquisitions'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have created a purchase order with Account Assignment CC - Cost Center.-You have defined threshold values for capitalizing fixed assets and low-value assets (fine tuning activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets).-You have specified derivation rules for asset class determination. In other words you have linked the Company ID to a Product Category ID and a Fixed Asset Class (fine tuning activity Fixed Asset Classes > Asset Class Determination option).-For the specific fixed asset class you have determined default values for the depreciation method and useful life, which can be transferred automatically to a new fixed asset (fine tuning activity Fixed Asset Classes > Edit fixed asset classes option).-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to Receipts and Returns > Show by Documents view.-Open the goods and services receipt you've posted to the purchase order with account assignment Cost Center created previously.-Click View All and go to the Items tab.-Under Basic Data tab, notice that neither a fixed asset nor an individual material were created.-In addition to that, checking the journal entry created for the goods and service receipt you notice that the G/L Account debited is not the one assigned to Fixed Assets Historical Costs (Fixed Assets subledger) as you expected.-Cause-While creating the goods and service receipt you didn't opt to create a New Individual Material, which then triggers the checks for the prerequisites described in the section above for the creation of a new fixed asset.-Resolution-The system will only create a new individual material and its fixed asset and post the acquisition value to the individual material automatically if you select the New Individual Materials option before posting the goods and service receipt:-Go to Goods and Services Receipt work center.-Go to Purchase Orders to Be Delivered > Show by Documents view.-Select the purchase order created and click New Goods and Services Receipt.-Under Items section, click New Individual Materials button (notice that an Individual Material section is displayed).-Click Post.-If all the prerequisites are fulfilled, a new individual material and its fixed asset are created by the system and the acquisition value is posted to the individual material.-In addition to that, if you check the journal entry created you'll see that the G/L Account debited is now the one assigned to Fixed Assets Historical Cost (Fixed Assets subledger).-See Also- Help Document: Individual Materials and Acquisitions-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipt, Fixed Asset, Individual Material, Purchase Order, Acquisitions

Title: Purchase Order Items Not Cleared by GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You execute the GR/IR clearing run for a purchase order item. But the run does not generate any clearings for the item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center. -Open the GR/IR Clearing view.-Select the run XXX (XXX is the GR/IR Clearing Run ID).-Open the Log Result.-Check the Processed Successfully tab.-The purchase order item you are looking for is missing. -Cause-Cause1: Purchase Orders items are not being considered by the GR/IR clearing run when no delivery or invoice relevant transactions have occurred for the item since the last run. Or, if the item is not marked for final clearing.-By default, this flag is automatically set when the purchase order item is fully delivered and fully invoiced. Should an item to be finished before it has been fully delivered or invoiced, the item can be manually marked for final clearing.-You can manually mark for final clearing when:-An item is not completed delivered or invoiced.-No further transactions are expected for the item.-Cause2: Time recordings against the Purchase Order task are in 'In Approval' status.-Resolution-For cause1:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center. -Go to the Master Data view.-Go to the Purchasing Document Items subview.-Show All Purchase Order Items.-Find the respective purchase order item and select item. -Choose the Final Clearing button and select Mark. -Enter the final clearing date. -The item will be included in the next GR/IR Clearing Run, provided its final clearing date is in the accounting period selected for the run.-For cause2:-Please approve the time recordings against the Purchase Order task so that they are active and delivered.-See Also-Help Documents:-GR/IR Clearing Quick Guide.-Marked Final Clearing Date for Purchasing Document Items.-Keywords-Purchase Order, GR/IR Clearing, Purchase Order not included, Items not cleared, reverse, Inventory Valuation, manually finished, PO, amount awaiting invoice, Time Recordings

Title: Error "On YYYY.MM.DD duration of absences X exceeds planned working time Y"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to replicate an employee to SAP Business ByDesign, however the system raises the below error message:-"Error occurred during employee time data update, On YYYY.MM.DD duration of absences X exceeds planned working time Y" (where YYYY.MM.DD represents the date, and X and Y represents a duration of time, for example, 7hr).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Select an Employee.-Click on Replicate.-Cause-The error is raised because the time entry in the specified date of the replication file longer than the planned working time of the employee.-You can check this by following the steps below:-Click on the Time Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-On the panel below the time profiles, navigate to the Work Schedule sub-tab.-At the bottom you will see a table with the work schedule of the employees for each day of the week. Here it is possible to see the planned working time.-Resolution-You can fix the issue by opening the replication request, and changing the time recording to match the planned working time. To do so, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Employee Times tab.-Search for the time recording on the date shown in the error message.-Here you can change the time recording to match the planned working time.-Keywords-Replication, TLM, Time Model, Duration, Start Time, End Time

Title: Desired Type of Leave Not Available in New Leave Request
Content: Symptom-When you create a new leave request via self services, the Type of Leave needs to be specified. The options available in the dropdown list do not include all the desired time types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view and select Self-Services Overview.-Select the link New Leave Request.-Open Type of Leave dropdown list.-The desired type of leave may not be present among the available options in the dropdown list.-Cause-The desired Time Type has not been activated in the Fine Tuning.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view and select the current project.-Click Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Search for Time types - <Country>.-Open option Activate for Time Recording Services.-In Time Types for Leave Request, move all the desired Time Types from the section 'Deactivated Time Type' to 'Activated Time Types'.-Click Save and Close button.-Now you are able to select the desired Time Types in the New Leave Request guided activity.-Keywords-Leave request, Self-Service, Time type, Missing, Unavailable, Leave Request

Title: Public Holidays are not Displayed in the Employee's Timesheet
