Content: Symptom-Public holidays are missing from the time sheet of a specific employee, while another employee under the same Reporting Line Unit has them correctly displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Recording > Calendar / List view.-Search for the respective employee and click Edit.-Go to Calendar tab.-Search for a date that should be marked as Public Holiday and notice that it's not marked.-The same view is available in the employee's Time File on the Employee Times tab.-Now following the same steps for another employee of the same Reporting Line Unit you notice that the public holidays are correctly displayed.-Cause-The reason for public holidays not being displayed is because there is no Work Schedule assigned for the employee.-To resolve this issue, you must assign both a Work Schedule and a Time Model to the employee, so the correct holidays will be picked up. The system would be able to recognize which days are holidays by comparing with the planned times which come from the Work Schedule of the employee.-Once done, an execution of a correction run (Day Closure Run) for the respective employee is required.-Resolution-In order to maintain the Work Schedule and the Time Model to the employee, please follow the steps below:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the respective employee and click Edit.-Move to Time Profile tab.-Take note of the Start Date of the Time Profile.-Go to Work Schedule tab.-Select the Work Schedule (For example: Predefined).-Under Predefined Work Schedule section, select the Time Model.-Click Save and Close.-Now follow the steps below to execute the correction run to this employee (Day Closure Run):-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Regular Tasks view.-Under Time Valuations section, click Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Give the Employee ID.-Select Start Time Valuation and click Run.-Give the Valuation Start Date as the Time Profile Start Date, which you took note on item 5 of the steps to maintain Work Schedule + Time Model.-Click OK.-As a result, the public holidays should be correctly displayed to the employee.-Keywords-Public Holiday, Time Sheet, Employee, Calendar

Title: Cannot Change SEPA Mandate Type of Active SEPA Mandates
Content: Symptom-You have created SEPA Mandates incorrectly, and need to change the mandate type in order to send the correct files to your bank. You try to change the data in the Corporate Account Master Data, and via Migration Template, but it was not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click on the Receivables work center.-Enter the Customer Accounts view.-Search for the Account.-Click on the ID to open the account.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Financial Data tab.-Enter the Payment Data sub-tab.-In SEPA Mandates area, press Edit.-In the SEPA Mandate screen, the Mandate Type field is greyed out.-Cause-It is not allowed to change the Mandate Type field, either through the Account screen in the UI, neither via Mass Change using Data Migration and Mass Data Maintenance.-Resolution-You can either block this active mandate and create a new one. Or you can copy the Active mandate and change the Mandate Type in the new one and then block the previous, incorrect mandate.-To create a new SEPA Mandate, please refer to the SAP ByDesign Help Document Create a SEPA Direct Debit Mandate, linked in the See Also section of this KBA.-To block a SEPA Mandate:-In the Receivables work center go to the Customer Accounts view.-Select the respective customer account and open it.-Press View all.-Go to the Financial Data tab and Payment Data sub-tab.-In SEPA Mandates area, press Edit.-In the SEPA Mandate window, flag the option Blocked, in Mandate Data area.-Press Save.-To copy the SEPA Mandate:-In the Receivables work center go to the Customer Accounts view.-Select the customer account and open it.-Press View all.-Go to the Financial Data tab and Payment Data sub-tab.-In the SEPA Mandates area, press Copy.-Create the new SEPA Mandate with the correct type.-  See Also-Help Center Document - Create a SEPA Direct Debit Mandate-Keywords-change sepa mandate type, SEPA Mandate type field greyed out

Title: NotAssigned or # Values for Project-Related Characteristics in "Employee Times: Overtime Overview" Report
Content: Symptom-In the report Employee Times: Overtime Overview you have added characteristics related to projects, such as Project, Actual Project Start Date (Project), Project ID. However this project related characteristics are being shown as Not Assigned or # in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to List sub-view.-Open Employee Times: Overtime Overview report.-Click Go.-Add characteristics like Project, Actual Project Start Date (Project) or any other one related to projects.-You will see that the values related to the recently added characteristics will be displayed as NotAssigned or #.-Cause-The zero suppression is activated for key figures.-Resolution-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to List sub-view.-Open the report Employee Times: Overtime Overview.-Click on Go.-Click on Settings button.-Select Key Figures.-Go to the General tab.-Under the Zero Suppression section, set Apply Supression to Columns and Apply Supression to Rows as Do Not Suppress.-Uncheck the check box Apply Supression to Key Figure Group.-Running the report after making these changes will display the project details.--Note that only the data which is actually maintained will be displayed. The empty fields will be shown by # or NotAssigned.-Keywords-Overtime Overview, Report, Employee Times, Not Assigned

Title: Unable to Remove Human Resource Module from Scoping
Content: Symptom-You are trying to remove the Human Resource Module from the scope, however the checkbox of the Human Resource node is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the current implementation project.-Click on the button Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to step 3 - Scoping.-Select the node Human Resources and expand it.-Here you are not able to deselect the checkboxes, as they are greyed out.-Cause-The Human Resource module is comprised of Personal Administration, Time and Labor Management and Compensation.-Currently it is not possible to remove these sub-modules if the system has gone live, or if transaction data (for example, employee times) was already created.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-Descope, Unscope, Human Resource, TLM, HCM.

Title: Warning 'Contacts: value X in column Function from Business Card will be truncated' when Migrating Customers for SAP Customer OnDemand
Content: Symptom-When migrating Customer Data, system throws below warning message:-Contacts: value X in column Function from Business Card will be truncated; edit source value. (where X represents the value from template)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Open Migration of Customers for SAP Customer OnDemand activity.-Execute Migration of respective migration file.-Cause-The cause for this warning message is that the value entered in the column Function from Business Card exceeds more than 40 characters. As per system design, you can have a maximum of only 40 characters for this field.-Resolution-Correct the value to contain a maximum of 40 characters. This adjustment will prevent any potential issues during the migration process.-Keywords-SAP Customer OnDemand, Warning, Migration, Truncated

Title: No Time Account Type Available While Adding a New Time Account in Employee's Time File
Content: Symptom-There is no time account available for selection while trying to add a new Time Account (for example, Recurring or Permanent) to an employee in Time Account Balances tab of the employee's time file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the respective employee.-Click Edit.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Click New button.-On Time Account Type field, click the down arrow to open drop down list.-See the message: No items found.-Cause-You are trying to add a time account of Recurring or Permanent creation. Only Ad Hoc time accounts are eligible for selection using the New button on Time Account Balances tab because they are non-rule-based quota time accounts.-Resolution-If your aim is to enter a time account of Recurring or Permanent creation you should do so under Time Profile tab -> Time Account Rules.-Now if you want to assign an Ad Hoc time account to the employee indeed, after flagging the time account type as an Ad Hoc Account in the respective Business Configuration activity Time Accounts — <Country>, you should also enter the time account under Time Profile tab -> Time Account Rules. After that, the Ad Hoc time account will be eligible for selection on the Time Account Balances tab.-See Also-Create a New Ad Hoc Time Account-Keywords-Time Account, Time Account Balances, Time File, Recurring, Permanent

Title: In Time Sheet of the Employee, the Vacation Day is Marked Green Though Leave Request not yet Approved by the Manager
Content: Symptom-When you request for a leave, the vacation days are marked green in the overview calendar of the time sheet even if the manager has not approved the leave request yet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view.-Select Edit Time Sheet link.-In the overview calendar shown here, the days for which leaves have been requested are shown green. However, the corresponding leave request for those days has not been approved by the manager.-In order to verify whether the leave request is still 'In Approval', you can select the link 'Show Details' to see the request's current status.-Cause-The system works as designed.-In fact, the overview calendar within the time sheet of the employee is not meant to provide information on the status of a leave request. The green color in the overview calendar within the time sheet only means that some time records have been released for the day; it doesn't mean that the time records have been approved.-Resolution-In order to track the status of your leave requests, you should use the corresponding functionality within the Self-Services:-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services view.-Select Track My Leave Requests link.-Here you can see the details about your leave requests.-Keywords-Vacation, Leave Request, Green, Manager, Approval

Title: How to change the decimal places of a migration template file
Content: Symptom-You wonder how to change the decimal places of a migration template file-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Wc > Implementation Projects view > Open your activity list > Fine-tune > Perform Data Extraction > Download migration templates-Download and open the template file-You notice that it is not possible to change the decimal places of a column-Cause-The migration template file is protected to prevent unwanted changes- Resolution-Open the xml file with the Microsoft Excel-Go to File > Info-Under Protect Workbook, click Unprotect for all sheets-Now, you will be able to change the decimal places of the column-See Also-Data Migration-Keywords-migration, template, decimal, places

Title: Where to Find Employee's Leave Overview
Content: Symptom-This KBA explains how to access the leave overview of an employee, which includes information such as planned leaves, leaves taken, balance leaves, entitled days of holiday, and requested leaves, among others.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There are two ways to get the vacation overview:-1. To view details of single employee:-Go to work center Time Administration.-Select view Employees.-Select an Employee.-Select Edit.-In popup window, select tab Time Account Balances.-Here you are able to find Balance leaves, Leaves taken, Planned leaves and Entitlement of an employee.-2. To view details of all employees:-Go to work center Time Administration.-Select view Reports.-Select the report Time Accounts. A new screen pops up.  -In the report, move Employee from Free Characteristics to either Columns or Rows.-Now you are able to find Balance leaves, Leaves taken and Planned leaves of all employees.-See Also-For further information, please refer to:-Help Center | The Time File-Help Center | Time Accounts Report-Keywords-Leave, Overview, Time Account Balance

Title: Employee Time Shows on Report Even Though No Time Recording Was Done
Content: Symptom-The Employee Time report shows some time recordings for the employees, but they did not record any time explicitly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Reports View.-Select Employee Times report.-Cause-The employee has an Exception-Based time recording method assigned.-To check if an employee has Exception-Based recording enabled, follow the below steps:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the employee and click Edit button.-In General tab, there is a field called Time Recording Method.-The Exception-Based time recording method implies that the employee is supposed to record time only in case of exceptions to his working schedule (vacation, illness...).-If the employee does not record any time, the system will assume that he/she has been working according to the working schedule and will take the working schedule as recorded time.-Resolution-If this is not the behavior intended for the time recording, it is possible to change the recording method to Positive.-When a Positive recording method is selected, the employee is always supposed to record any sort of time proactively.-Steps to be followed:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the employee and click Edit button.-Go to Time Profile tab.-Select Basic Data sub-tab-Here, you can maintain the recording method for an employee.-Keywords-Report, Employee Times, Time Recording

Title: How to activate Evaluated Receipt Settlement checkbox
Content: Symptom-Evaluated Receipt Settlement checkmark in Purchase Order screen gets unchecked automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center-Go to New Purchase Order view-Enter the Supplier ID as ABC-Go to Items tab and choose the Materials to be ordered-Click on Evaluated Receipt Settlement check box, it will be automatically unchecked-Cause-Evaluated Receipt Settlement required checkbox is not maintained in Master Data of the Supplier ABC. -Resolution-Evaluated Receipt Settlement required check box can be checked in 2 places.-A) In Supplier Master Data-Go to the Supplier master data and open the Purchasing tab-Checkmark the box for Evaluated Receipt Settlement -B) In Business Configuration -Go to Business Configuration work center -Go to Overview view-Choose Activities in the dropdown and search for "Purchase Order Item Follow Up Document Settings"-Select the required Item type and the Process type -Checkmark the box for Evaluated Receipt Settlement and click on Save-With this, Evaluated Receipt Settlement will be automatically checked and it can be unchecked if it is not required.-Keywords-Evaluated Receipt Settlement, ERS check box, Purchase order ERS

Title: Business Object for Edit Percentage of Completion / BADI for Sales Accruals POC Calculation
Content: Symptom-You want to know the Business Object for edit percentage of completion for Sales Order Items.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-Business Object for editing percentage of completion is FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC (FinancialAccountingViewOfSalesAndServiceDocument) and the node is  ITSOB_MDATA_FOR_ACCR_CALC (ItemSetOfBooksManualDataForAccrualsCalculation) which is already PSM write released and can be used for developing desired business scenarios.-Additionally, there is a BADI already available: BADI_FIA_SLSL_ACCR_POC_PLAN (Get Plan Value for Sales Accruals POC Calculation) to influence the percentage of completion in revenue recognition through customer code. You may also use this if it fits your requirement.-Keywords-Business Objects for edit percentage of completion, BADI for sales accruals POC Calculation-bo for poc,badi for sales accruals poc calculation

Title: The Error Message "Create not possible; source object inconsistent" is Displayed in a Contract Document After Adding a Invoicing Unit
Content: Symptom-The error message "Create not possible; source object inconsistent" is displayed in a Contract document when trying to add a Invoicing Unit party role manually in the Involved Parties tab of the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Contracts View.-Select the Contracts sub View.-In the Search field, Search for the Contract XYZ (XYZ represents the Contract ID).-Select View All.-Navigate to Involved Parties tab.-Select Add Row Button.-In the Party Role column, Select Invoicing Unit.-In the Name column, Select the desired Invoicing Unit.-Select Save.-The error message "Create not possible; source object inconsistent" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The error message "Create not possible; source object inconsistent" is displayed when manually adding a Invoicing Unit in a Contract because a Invoice document has been already created and released for at least one of the Line items in the Contract document.-As the Invoicing Unit is defined whenever a Invoice document is created, a change in this party role could lead to inconsistencies and therefore the error message "Create not possible; source object inconsistent" is displayed as the system will not allow this change to be performed.-Resolution-As changing the Invoicing Unit in a Contract Document will only be possible if non of the items maintained in the contract were invoiced or partially invoiced, then in order to perform this change it will be required to cancel any existing invoice document generated from the Contract.-Note: If non of the items maintained in the contract were invoiced or partially invoiced, then the adding the Invoicing Unit party role in the contract will be already possible.-See Also-The following KBA also provides additional information regarding the determination Invoicing Unit:- 2457852 - Determination of Invoicing Unit in an Invoice which is Based on a Preceding Document-Keywords-create not possible; source object inconsistent, source object, inconsistent, invoicing unit, invoice unit, contract, manually, party role, involved parties

Title: Unable to Update Data via Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update Suppliers's data or any other Object via Migration Tool using the Enhance mode, although there is no error message, the data is not being created in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Then go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity Migration of Suppliers, for example, and open it.-Click Migrate suppliers using the migration tool.-Select the Template and click Execute Migration > Step by Step.-Execute all the steps, no error will appear.-Then check in the front end to confirm if the data was updated.-Cause-This scenario might be occurring because the Supplier ID maintained in the excel was coverted to an Internal ID during the initial migration. With that, the system updated the data over a different ID (Target ID).-To check the Conversion Values, please follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Then go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity Migration of Suppliers, for example, and open it.-SHow Completed File or All Files.-In the Action button, select the option Download Value Conversion.-The system will download a txt file where you can check the real ID that got updated.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior, as it was configured during the Initial Migration process.-See Also-2312869 - Frequently Asked Questions on Migration and its Processes-Keywords-Migration Tool, Value, Not Update, Not Working, Enhance, Value Conversion.

Title: Error 'Time type Actual hours worked only allowed for planned employee times' When Registering Employee Time Type
Content: Symptom-When editing a Time File for an employee and including Time Type as 'X - Actual hours worked' (X represents the Time Type ID), the following error message occurs:-'Time type Actual hours worked only allowed for planned employee times'-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search Employee ID.-Click Edit.-Go to the Employees Times Tab.-Click Add Row.-Include your Start Date.-Include your End Date.-Under the column Time Type include your reference which is X -Actual hours worked.-Error: Time type Actual hours worked only allowed for planned employee times.-Cause-The error message is triggered because your Time Type which is X -Actual Hours Worked, is marked as Relevance for Work Schedule and planned working time category is maintained as Core Time in Business Configuration.-Resolution-To do time recording for Time Type X -Actual Hours Worked planned working time category of this time type should be Productive Time and not Core Time.-Steps to change the Time Type:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation.-Click Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune phase.-Find activity Time Types – Mexico (If your scoped country is Mexico) and open it.-Click Maintain Employee Time Types.-Under the column Time Type select X -Actual hours worked and change the Time Type Category from Core Time to Productive Time.-Save and Close.-Keywords- Planned, Employee Times, Time Type, Actual Hours

Title: Post Tax Difference Check-box is Greyed Out in a New Invoice Summary Run
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new Invoice Summary Run, but the "Post Tax Difference" check-box is greyed out. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center. -Go to Invoice Summary Runs sub view. -Click "New" button. -In Control Parameters we can see that "Post Tax Difference" check-box is greyed out.-Cause-Expected system behavior. -You didn't maintain the scoping question "Do you want to enable automatic posting of tax difference for summary invoices?" in Edit Project Scope. -Resolution-To scope the following scoping question: "Do you want to enable automatic posting of tax difference for summary invoices?", please follow the steps below: -1. Go to the Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to the Implementation Projects view.-3. Select your project and choose Edit Project Scope.-4. Go to the Questions section, select the checkbox In Scope against the Business Option "Do you want to enable automatic posting of tax difference for summary invoices?" from the path: Cash Flow Management > Payables and Receivables Processing > Communication for Payables and Receivables Processing > Invoice Summary Processing for Japan.-5. Save the scoping.-Then you will see that the "Post Tax Difference" check-box is not greyed out anymore when creating a new Invoice Summary Run.-Keywords-Invoice Summary Run, New, Post Tax Difference, Receivables,

Title: Public Holidays Not Displayed on Employee Times Report
Content: Symptom-You have set up a Public Holiday on the Holiday Calendar for a specific Country. When you open the reports Employee Times: Weekly or Employee Times: Monthly, the Holiday hours are not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Enter the Design Reports view.-Search for either the report Employee Times: Weekly or Employee Times: Monthly.-Click on the report name to open it.-Enter the desired filtering.-Click on the Apply button.-Here you can see that the configured holiday is not included in the report results.-Cause-The reports Employee Times: Weekly and Employee Times: Monthly will show Recorded Times and Planned Working Times. Since there are no Planned hours for a Public holiday, no entries will be displayed for the holiday unless there are Times Recorded by employees on that day.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-Working Day Calendar, Data Source, TLM

Title: How to add Company Specific Help Document in the Help Center in SAP Business ByDesign (ByD)
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article (KBA) will help you on how you can add add a Company Specific Help document in the help center SAP Business ByDesign (ByD).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Before you go live, you as key user should prepare the Help Center content so that it meets the requirements of your end users. You can add your own documents that will appear under Company-Specific Help, such as process descriptions, golden business rules, or demos. As a key user, you can add company-specific help to the Help Center that is immediately visible and available to all end users.-Log in to Business ByDesign system.-Navigate to Help Center.-You can either add content to this screen or to all screens within the system.-To add company-specific content to a particular screen, click Add Company-Specific Content under You Can Also.-To add company-specific content to all screens, click Add Company-Specific Content for all Screens under You Can Also.-To add a new file, click  New and choose file.-Note:-By default, the system supports the following file types:-All Microsoft Office formats.-PDF-By default, the following file types are not supported:-HTML-XML-EXE-The maximum file size is restricted to 500 MB. Due to performance reasons, we recommend not to upload files larger than 20 MB.-To add a new link, click New and choose Link.-In the URL field, enter the URL of the file or link.-In the Name field, enter the name as it will appear in the Help Center.-In the Description field, enter a description of this file or link.-Note: -You can also remove the company-specific content you added.-"http://" must be prefix for the links in the URL field.-Special characters in URL are not supported.-See Also- Company-Specific Help Content Quick Guide-Keywords-Add Company Specific Help, Company Specific Help, Upload File, Upload Link, Valid URL, Help Center, You Can Also.

Title: In Which Report We can find the Contract Item which is Related to Contract and Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Trying to find the Contract Item field in Sales Order reports or in reports other than the Customer Contract Volume reports. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Navigate to the Reports view.-Open the Sales Order Volume report.-Navigate to the View section.-Click the Plus (+) icon under Row Fields to search for fields to add.-Search for the Contract Item field.-Observe that the Contract Item field is not available in the Sales Order Volume report.-Cause-The Contract Item field is not available in the Sales Order reports. The field is available only in the Customer Contract Volume and Customer Contract Volume with Price Components reports. -Resolution-The Contract Item field is available in the following reports:-Customer Contract Volume-Customer Contract Volume with Price Components-Steps to Find the Reports:-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Navigate to the Reports view.-Search for and open the Customer Contract Volume report or the Customer Contract Volume with Price Components report.-The Contract Item field can be found in the selected report.-Keywords-Report; Contract Item; Customer Contract Volume; Customer Contract Volume with Price Components

Title: Unable to Change any Parameter to Zero Using Mass Change for Materials
Content: Symptom-When trying to change a specific parameter value of a material to zero using the Mass Change feature, the value zero is not being displayed in the default cell. Instead, the cell appears empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select the list of materials and select Mass Change button.-Enter zero in a default cell for a particular parameter.-Select Enter key in the keyboard, the zero disappears.-Cause-The reason that zero (0) disappears is that zero (0) is always considered as a null value (no value is entered) in the default row. Hence it is not possible to change any parameter to zero (0) using Mass Change.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-If you want to change the value to Zero, you can directly change in the Material instead of using Mass Change.--Note: If you want to change the value to any integer value other than zero, you can use Mass Change functionality.-Keywords-Zero, 0, Mass Change, Material, Cell

Title: Error: 'Multiple Postings of a Record to Account Vacation on DD.MM.YYYY Not Permitted' When Trying to Approve Times
Content: Symptom-When trying to approve a time the Project Manager receives the following error message:-'Multiple postings of a record to account Vacation on DD.MM.YYYY not permitted'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Project Management Work Center.-2. Go to Approvals View.-3. Go to Time Recordings Sub-View.-4. Select a task.-5. Click Approve button.-6. System shows up error message saying 'Multiple Postings of a Record to Account Vacation on DD.MM.YYYY Not Permitted'-Cause-When a time recording is approved, the system evaluates all recording in the future as well for correctness. Hence while doing this the system found an inconsistency for the Time Type with Time Type Category Vacation.-To see the inconsistency, follow the steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search for activity Time Types - X.-Open it and choose Maintain Employee Time Types.-Find and select Time Type with Time Type Category Vacation.-You will find the following:--A) Under Time Account Posting tab, the Time Type is configured to post into Time Account: Vacation.-B) Under Special Posting Order tab, you will find an entry maintained.--Now, click Close button to return to Time Types - X activity.-Choose Maintain Time Account Posting Order.-Find the Posting Order you could see in the Special Posting Order tab of previous screen.-You will see that this posting order is configured to make a posting into Time Account Vacation.-So, system is trying to make two postings to Account Type Vacation.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search for activity Time Types - X.-Open it and choose Maintain Employee Time Types.-Find and select Time Type with Time Type Category Vacation.-Remove Account Type Vacation from either the Time Account tab or the Special Posting Order tab.-Keywords-Multiple Postings, Project, Manager, Approval, Time Recording

Title: Deviating Holiday Calendar Not Displayed in Employee's Time File
Content: Symptom-As a time administrator, you have the authority to maintain an employee's Public Holiday Calendar, which may differ from the one defined in the Working Day Calendar of the employee's organizational unit in Business Residence. However, you cannot view the deviating holiday calendar in the employee's time file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Work view.-Open the respective Complete Time Data (hire) task.-Click Next button to go to step 2 Define Work Schedule.-Select Deviating Holiday Calendar in Holiday Calendar Assignment.-You can set public holiday calendar here.-Then you want to check the Public Holiday Calendar in employee's time file:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the respective employee and the Edit button.-Go to the Time Profile tab. There is no field to show the defined Deviating Holiday Calendar.-Resolution-This is system designed behavior. You can see employee's Deviating Holiday Calendar as follows:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select the Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar link.-Or-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the respective employee.-Select Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar in the Actions button.-Keywords-Deviating Holiday, Public Holiday Calendar, Time file, Time Profile

Title: How to restrict balance confirmation Run to Specific Customer/Suppliers
Content: Symptom-You want to run a Balance Confirmation Run for specific list of Customers or Suppliers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2305--Resolution-Open Receivables/Payables work center.-Navigate to the Periodic tasks View, select Balance Confirmation Run.-Select New.-Select Balance Confirmation Run.-On the "Choose Type" tab-Select the option Restriction Type-Select "Manual Collection of Customer/Supplier"-Enter the other required data.-Select next and move onto Step 2: Restrictions.-Select the Company ID.-A list of Customer/Suppliers will appear on the bottom of the screen.-Select the Customer/Suppliers that you would like to complete a Balance Confirmation Run for by highlighting the required accounts and selecting the arrow to the left to move the accounts to the left hand side of the screen.-The run will complete for only the Customer/Supplier Accounts that are selected in the restricted area.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation Run, restricted, specific accounts

Title: Error Message 'Service ID is not valid' while Creating a New Service
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a New Service, system throws below error message:-'Service ID is not valid'-'Save Failed'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select New Service under Common Tasks.-Input the mandatory details and select Save button.-Cause-There might be different causes that results in this issue:-Cause 1: The Service ID entered is not in the range maintained in the Fine Tuning activity Number Range for Service.-This can be verified as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity Number Ranges for Service under Business Configuration Search.-In the new screen, you can find the number range maintained for Service.-Cause 2: In case, if you maintain Integer value in the Service ID field then the issue is because for Integer values the Number Range type maintained was Automatic.-Cause 3: If you maintain Alphabet value in the Service ID field then the issue is because for Alphabet values the Number Range type maintained was Automatic.-Resolution-The Service Agent ID should be entered based on the range maintained in the fine tuning activity Number Range for Service.-If you would like to have a number range which supports all combination of alphabetic, numeric, alphanumeric and special characters (_-/:\.) but with interval type as Manual, you can use the below number range for Service.--Start Number: 0--End Number: Z9999999999999999999Z--Interval Type: Manual--Note: End Number should start and end with 'Z' and you can define number of 9's based on the length of the Service.-Keywords-Service ID, Save Failed, Product, New Service

Title: Schedule a Balance Confirmation Run
Content: Symptom-You wish to schedule a customer Balance Confirmation to run (e.g. every first day of the month) and send the email to customer with their last month balance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center-Go to Balance Confirmation Run view-Create a new balance confirmation run.-You wish to create a recurrence pattern for this run still considering the given parameters.-Resolution-The recurrence pattern for the job can be created via Schedule button. Nevertheless, the balance confirmation has a fixed (and mandatory) parameter, which is the Cut-off data. This means that if you set the cut-off date for e.g. 31.10.YYYY and schedule the run for every month, in November and December you would have a back-dated parameter, which would not pick up the latest customer’s open items.-This is the designed system behavior. You may approach your implementation partner in order to explore enhacement options for your business needs via custon add-ons.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation Run,

Title: Maintained Employee Times Differs from Expected Time Postings by System
Content: Symptom-The maintained working times of the employees differ from the Time Account Balances posted by the system.-For example: Although a half-day vacation was approved and the working hours were maintained, both time amounts entries were summarized and posted to the Working Time Account. Consequently, you were expecting fewer hours to be posted by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Find the respective employee and click Edit button.-Go to Employee Times tab and click Show Last 6 Months.-You notice that the system has posted different times under the 'Accounts Posting' sub-tab compared to the entries in the 'Time Account Balances' sub-tab.-Cause-Verify whether Overtime rules are configured in the Business Configuration work center. Without Overtime Rules the standard system behaviour calculation is to add all maintained Time entries subtracted by the maintained Target Hours.-Resolution-You have to configure the Overtime Rule:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and highlight the activity Time Types - <country>.-Select Change Immediately button.-Select Maintain Time Recording Profile link.-Highlight the respective Profile Code.-Go to Overtime Rules sub-tab.-Highlight the respective row.-Select the Overtime Threshold sub-tab.-Here, you select Daily and configure the Overtime rules.-Save the changes.-You have to perform an Administer Day Closure Runs to activate the changes, as follows:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Regular Tasks.-Select Administer Day Closure Runs link.-See Also-For further information on how to administer Day Closure Runs, please refer to: Blog | Time Valuation: Correction Run-Keywords-Working Times, Time Account Balances, Different, Accounts Posting

Title: Time Account does not Appear in "Time Accounts: Monthly" Report and in "Time Account Balances"
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Time Accounts: Monthly from Business Analytics, and you notice that a time account assigned to an employee is missing in the report.-You also see that the time account does not appear in the Time Account Balances tab of the employee profile.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Enter the Design Reports view.-Search and open the report Time Accounts: Monthly.-Enter a search criteria (for example, the employee ID).-Click on the button Apply.-Here you can see the time accounts assigned to the employee, however some accounts are missing.-Cause-The Bookable From and Bookable To fields in the time account configuration are missing.-Resolution-In order to check and solve the issue, please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the activity Time Accounts - XYZ (where XYZ represents the relevant country name).-Open the sub activity Maintain Time Account Types.-Search for the missing account and select it.-Under the Details section on the bottom of the screen, maintain data for Bookable From and Bookable To.-Keywords-HCMTLMU02, Time Profile, Bookable

Title: Project Invoice Request Created from a Blocked Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have blocked a Sales Order for invoicing, however a Project Invoice Request is created based on the Invoice Scheduling.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Project Invoice Requests view.-Select the relevant Project Invoice Request and open it.-In the View All navigate to Items tab.-See that the Sales Order linked is the one that is blocked.-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select Sales Orders view.-Search for the relevant document and open it.-See that this Sales Order is blocked for Invoice with a reason.-Cause-The invoice block stops the creation of the Customer Invoice, which is a legal document, if the block is set in the Sales Order before Customer Invoice is created. Other documents like Project Invoice Requests are preparatory documents, not a legal document, hence the invoice block won't stop the creation of those documents.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. --If you want that the blocked Sales Order does not create a Project Invoice Request, you can set a reason for rejection on Sales Order item level if the item has not being delivered yet.-If you doesn't want to proceed with the created Project Invoice Request you can delete the document.-See Also-2983148 - Sales Order Invoice Request is Blocked-Keywords-Sales Order, Invoice Block, Project Invoice Request

Title: Unable to Escalate Manually Created Business Task
Content: Symptom-You notice that, as time passes and a manually created task becomes overdue, system does not create a escalation for it and there is no way to manually trigger a escalation either.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Manually created tasks are ad hoc tasks that are completely predefined and lack the necessary backend definitions to produce a escalation.-The only actions which can be performed with manually created tasks are Change Priority, Complete, Forward, Add Attachments etc.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-You can post a request for improvement to this onto our SAP Business ByDesign Continuous Influence session, which is reviewed by our Product Management teams when deciding which functionalities to add and/or enhance in future product versions. Additionally, you can check the feasibility for achieving this through a custom solution by either reaching out to your implementation partner or contacting our SAP Innovative Business Solutions team as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer:           -Contact your Account Executive.-Check the link for SAP Advisory Services. -Keywords-BTM, Task, Manually Created Task, Escalate, Escalation Task

Title: Error Message 'Sufficient Quota Required for Posting on DD.MM.YYYY to Account ABC' in Day Closure Run
Content: Symptom-In Time Administration Work Center, the Day Closure for an employee fails and the following error message appears:-"Creation of period closure date for employee ID XXX failed. Sufficient quota required for posting on DD.MM.YYYY to account ABC" (where XXX represents the employee ID and ABC the time account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Time Administration Work Center.-2. Select the Regular Tasks View.-3. Select the Administer Day Closure Runs subview.-4. Show All runs.-5. Find the respective run and click the Application Log ID.-6. Select the Results tab.-Cause-Cause 1: The error may appear when a sufficient amount of quota days has been adjusted to Account ABC, but a deduction posting already happened beforehand. For example vacation is posted before an adjustment of vacation days happened. Therefore the provided vacation days cannot be used for the vacation posting.-Cause 2: The error may appear, when an account starts mid-year or later. When employees are hired mid-year, you must manually assign a pro rata leave entitlement for the remainder of the current year. The system does not automatically calculate and assign a mid-year or mid-month accrual or entitlement. Therefore an adjustment needs to be set for an appropriate balance to allow vacation to be posted and deducted correctly from the Time Account.-Resolution-1. Go to Time Administration work center.-2. Select Employees view.-3. Select the respective Employee and click the Edit button.-4. Go to Time Account Balances tab.-5. Go to Adjustments subtab.-6. Change the start of Adjustments to a date before the first deduction posting happens, respectively assign an appropriate balance to allow vacation to be posted.-7. Perform a Day Closure Run for the Employee.-Keywords-Sufficient Quota, Posting, Day Closure Runs

Title: SSO is not Available in the field Local Service Provider under Configure Single Sign-On View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Title: Sales Order is Missing From Cost and Revenue - Sales Document Items Work Center View
Content: Symptom-Sales Order ABC is missing from Cost and Revenue - Sales Document Items work center view.-ABC means the Sales Order ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue - Sales Document Items work center view.-Search for Sales Order ID ABC.-Notice that no records are found.-Cause-The Sales Order ABC doesn't have any invoicing document created yet. Hence, there's no backend message created for accounting.-Resolution-System behaves as expected. As soon as an invoice document is created and tied to Sales Order ABC, the sales order will be displayed in Cost and Revenue - Sales Document Items Work Center View.-Keywords-sales order; sales documents; invoice; cost and revenue

Title: How to Select All the Invoices Available in Invoice Entry View
Content: Symptom-Selecting all the invoices available in the invoice entry view-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Kindly select supplier invoices not more than 100 lines, as it will create the system performance issue while creating invoice entry. Follow the below mentioned steps-Apply the advanced filter as required-Choose the top most supplier invoice-Scroll down until the supplier invoice you want to choose-Choose the last document holding SHIFT key-You can see all the data is selected including first and last supplier invoice-Keywords-Supplier invoice; Selecting multiple invoice-supplier invoice,selecting multiple invoice

Title: Acct XYZ in CoA ABC Cannot be Deleted/Changed; Transaction Data Exists
Content: Symptom-You are unable to change the G/L Account Type due to below error message.-Acct XYZ in CoA ABC Cannot be Deleted/Changed; Transaction Data Exists-(Here XYZ refers to G/L account) (ABC referes to Chart of Accounts)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select a G/L Account in question and go to the view G/L Account Type and change the required G/L Account Type.-Choose Save button and below error occurs:-Acct XYZ in CoA ABC Cannot be Deleted/Changed; Transaction Data Exists-Cause-The error is due to you cannot change the account type for a G/L account if the account is posted. An account is unposted if no postings were made to it or if all postings have been reversed.-Resolution-You need to reverse all posting by checking the below report.-Open the General Ledger work center.-Navigate to General Ledger Accounts view.-Enter a Company and Set of Books.-Enter the respective G/L Account and click on Go.-Select the G/L Account and click on View Line Items.-Important Note: If the G/L Account postings are items coming from Manual Journal Entry Vouchers of-type 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher, you will not experience this error. The system will allow you to change the G/L account type. 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher is therefore exempt from this transaction data error.-See Also-Help Center Document General Ledger Accounts Quick Guide ->Display and Edit Chart of Accounts->Account Type.-Keywords-Chart of Accounts. G/L Account. Account Type.

Title: Change of Material Detailed Description not Possible Through Migration
Content: Symptom- After migrating material data to the system, you have a requirement to change or add detailed description information.-However this section is not available in the Mass Data Maintenance tool, and the "Enhance already existing records" mode of the migration tool removes the respective description sheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently this is a limitation in the migration framework (both in the Migration Tool and Mass Data Maintenance).-Resolution-You can use the web service interface ManageMaterialIn in order to insert or update the material detailed description.-See Also-3097599 - Change of Material Description not possible via Migration Tool-Keywords-Product, Description, Migration, Details field

Title: Error: 'Tax number XYZ not correct as VAT Registration Number for country DEF'.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new Charge/Credit for supplier or customer account and you are facing the following error message: 'Tax number XYZ not correct as VAT Registration Number for country DEF'.-(XYZ represents the VAT Registration Number). -(DEF represents the Country). -Note: This scenario can be applied for Customer Account and Supplier Account, in this example we will use a supplier account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center. -Go to Supplier Accounts. -Select All Suppliers. -Search for Account ID: 123 (123 represents the Account ID). -Click View.-Click "New Charge/Credit" button. -Fill with all parameters. -In Tax Country/Region select the country DEF. -You will see the following error: -'Tax number XYZ not correct as VAT Registration Number for country DEF'-Cause-You are trying to use a different VAT Registration Number in the Supplier as maintained from Tax Authority: ABC (ABC represents the Tax Authority ID). In order to check the VAT Registration Number maintained in the Supplier and in the Tax Authority, please check the steps below: -To check the VAT Registration Number in the Supplier:-Go to Payables work center. -Go to Suppliers subview. -Select All Suppliers. -Search for Supplier ID: AAA (AAA represents the supplier ID). -Click "Edit" button > Financial Data. -Go to "Tax Data" subtab. -Here we can see the Tax Number: XYZ maintained. -To check the VAT Registration Number in the Tax Authority:-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Tax Authorities subview. -Open the Advanced filter. -Search for Company ID: BBB (BBB represents the company ID) that you are using in the supplier account. -Click "Go" button.-You will see the Tax Authority: ABC.-Click "Edit" button > Company Tax Arrangements. -Here we can see the VAT Registration Number maintained is different from the VAT Registration Number maintained in the Supplier.-Resolution-Expected system behavior. -You have to use the same VAT Registration Number in the supplier that you are using in the Tax Authority. -Keywords-VAT Registration Number, Supplier, Customer, Tax number.

Title: Cancel of Multiple Project Stock Order
Content: Symptom-You want to cancel multiple project stock order at a time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to project management work center-Go to Project Stock order view-Choose by documents-You can see the Project stock order status "In Process"-Cause-Project stock orders are in the status "In process"-Resolution-Project stock orders can be deleted only in "In preparation" status.-Keywords-Delete project stock order; Project stock order;-delete project stock order,project stock order

Title: Warning: 'Invoice AAA must be paid by/to partner BBB' Occurs When Changing Payee In a Payment Proposal
Content: Symptom-When you are editing a payment proposal, you are able to change the payee, and the system only gives a warning message instead of an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center. -Go to Payment Runs sub view. -Select Run ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Run ID) > Execution Details > Select All Logs > Click "View Payment Proposals" button. -Select the Payment ID: DEF (DEF represents the payment ID). -Click "Edit Proposal" button. -Change for other Payee.  -You will se a warning message instead of an error message: -'Invoice AAA must be paid by/to partner BBB'-(AAA represents the Invoice ID)-(BBB represents the Payee ID)-Cause-If the predefined payer/payee on the item differs from the one on Due Payment, the system will throw a warning as this might not be the user's intention. This warning shall only be shown for company-initiated payments. It's not a configuration activity. -Resolution-Expected system behavior.-Keywords-Payee, Warning Message, Invoice, Paid, Payment Proposal, Invoice must be paid by/to partner,

Title: How to Download and Setup Certificate-Based Logon
Content: Symptom-This document describes how to setup certificate-based authentication to log into Business ByDesign without entering user and password.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Download the root and intermediate certificates of SAP Business ByDesign tenant.-On the login page, click on the locker icon on the left of the tenant URL (on Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge).-Click on "Connection is Secure".-Click on "Certificate is valid".-Go to the Details tab.-Choose the root certificate.-Click on the Export button.-Save the file to local machine.-Do the same for the intermediate certificate.-Install the root and intermediate certificates of SAP Business ByDesign in the browser to establish a security connection between ByD tenant and the browser.-On the right of the URL, click on the three dots icon (on Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge).-Click on Settings.-In the Privacy and security section, click on Security.-Click on Manage Certificates. A new window will appear.-Navigate to the Trusted Root Certification Authorities tab.-Click Import.-In the opened window, click Next.-In the new screen, open the root certificate downloaded in step 1 (note: set the file explorer to display all formats).-Proceed until the end of the installation.-Navigate to the Intermediate Certification Authorities tab in Manage Certificates.-Repeat the step f to step i to install the intermediate certificate downloaded in step 1.-Assign personal certificate in the Business ByDesign tenant. The certificate used in this step is separated from the certificates downloaded in step 1 and 2. The prerequisite of certificate logon is that a personal certificate from SAP trusted entity has been installed in the Personal tab of Manage Certificates.-Log with the user and password in the tenant.-Click on the avatar icon.-Click on My Settings.-Click on the button Manage Certificates.-Click on the button Assign Logon Certificate.-On the new page, click on Continue.-After the process is completed, restart your browser.-After this setup, it will be possible to login Business ByDesign tenant without entering user and password. It is worth noting that this is a local setup, so the same process needs to be carried in other machines if needed.-Keywords-SSO, SSL, certificate

Title: Health Check Incident: Identity Authorisation Run Aborted Due to Locked Documents
Content: Symptom-The system triggers a health check message in your system with the below text:-Identity Authorisation Run aborted due to locked documents.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Cause-This health check case gets created when a key user does changes on one of the existing business roles, but the screen was not closed after this step. Due to this the run to update the changes got aborted.-Resolution-Once the user has closed the screen the run will be triggered again and will update the changes done on the business role.-Keywords-health check, business roles, aborted changes, Identitätsautorisierungslauf

Title: How to create Purchase Order Acknowledgment in bulk in SAP Business ByDesign system?
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to upload multiple purchase order acknowledgments for various purchase orders at a time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Select the respective purchase order and select the option New Purchase Order acknowledgment-This is time consuming when you have to create acknowledgment for multiple purchase orders-Resolution-You can use web services to create purchase order acknowledgment in bulk.-You can find all the APIs in this link: https://api.sap.com/package/BYD/soap-The Purchase order acknowledgment WSDL is under Manage Purchase Order Confirmation :-https://api.sap.com/api/PSM_ISI_R__SRMAP_II_LPURX_POP_PCO_IB/overview-Keywords-purchase order acknowledgment, PO confirmation, PO acknowledgment, bulk creation of purchase order acknowledgment, PO acknowledgment WSDL

Title: Severe error while opening a solution: System.ArgumentException: An item with the same key has already been added
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--You receive many errors in the SDK Error List :-Severe error while opening a solution: System.ArgumentException: An item with the same key has already been added.-- at System.ThrowHelper.ThrowArgumentException(ExceptionResource resource)-- at System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2.Insert(TKey key, TValue value, Boolean add)-- at System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2.Add(TKey key, TValue value)-- at SAP.CopernicusProjectView.XRepSynchronizer.XRepMapper.GetListOf LocksForUserInCurrentProject()-- at SAP.CopernicusProjectView.CopernicusProjectNode.RefreshLocks()-- at SAP.CopernicusProjectView.XRepSynchronizer.XRepMapper.OpenSolut ion(String solutionPath)-- at SAP.CopernicusProjectView.XRepSynchronizer.XRepMapper.GetSoluti onFromXRepository(String solutionName, String solutionVersion)-- at SAP.Copernicus.Core.RepositoryView.ContextMenu.ContextMenuHandl er.OpenSolution(SolutionNode selectedSolutionNode)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Case 1:-You receive these errors when opening a Solution.-Case 2:-You receive these errors when attempting to Activate a BO/XBO-Case 3:-You receive these errors when attempting to Refresh the solution-Cause-1) The cause of the issue can be that the affected Solution / Files are locked in the back-end.-2) Maybe a local cache inconsistency caused the issue.-Resolution-1) Please refer to the KBA 2525446 on how to check locks, and to remove these locks in XREP.-2) If there is no entries locked, please clear the content under the local folder C:\Users\<User ID>\Documents\CopernicusIsolatedShell\Projects.-* Note that if the solution is locked by an user, please ask the customer to unlock the solution by logging out the SDK from their side. Anyway, you should have the customer's consent to unlock the entries that are locked by end users.-See Also-2525446  - PDI Solution YABCD123_ is Locked by SAP_SUPP00N-Keywords-SDK Locked, Solution Locked, Can not open a solution

Title: Material Cost Estimate Result Is Different Than Expected
Content: Symptom-You have maintained an Inventory Cost amount (for example, 1.00 USD) in Material ID ABC master data valid for a specific period. However, when you execute a Material Cost Estimate containing Material ABC, the resulting cost estimate amount is different than you expected. (ABC stands for the Material ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Open Material Cost Estimates view.-Search for Material Cost Estimate DEF. (DEF stands for the Material Cost Estimate ID).-Click on the row of the Material Cost Estimate DEF and click on view.-In Costed Object ABC, you notice the Cost Estimate amount is different than expected (for example, 2.00 USD).-In Input section below, click on Material ABC.-In Valuation tab, you will notice that Inventory Cost maintained for the specific period is 1.00 USD.-Cause-For material ABC, the purchase list price has been maintained for the validity from period A to period B. Cost estimate has been run on a date between these periods. That is the reason cost estimate is picking the value different to the one maintained in Inventory Cost.-Since there are multiple possible sources of costs and prices for the individual items in a cost estimate, the system applies a valuation strategy during costing that defines the priority in which the costs or prices are selected. There is a valuation strategy for materials and another strategy for resources and services.-The selected cost or price is identified in the cost estimate as the Valuation Method.-Priority taken:-1. Planned cost from material's master data -2. Price from fixed source of supply-3. Price from contract-4. Price from price list-5. Inventory cost from material's master data-Resolution-If there is no Purchase Price List maintained for Material ABC, then Cost Estimate will apply the Inventory Cost maintained in the Material master data.-To do so, remove the Purchase Price List maintained for the Material ABC.-Steps:-1. Go to Product Portfolio work center.-2. Open List Prices view.-3. Search for ABC.-4. Select the relevant list price and click on Release > Cancel release. --After that, when executing a Cost Estimate for Material ABC, if it have a valid Inventory Cost maintained for the correspondent period, it will be applied.-See Also-3281592 - How the System Selects Purchase List Price When Running Material Cost Estimate-Material Cost Estimate Runs-Keywords-Cost Estimate, Material, Purchase Price List

Title: User Sessions in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You may receive a Health Check incident or an Internal Communication via email indicating a high number of user sessions from a specific tenant.-This Knowledge Base Article will help you understand the suggested number of user sessions that can be opened in a ByD tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The suggested number of user sessions in the system is a maximum of 25 sessions per user in SAP Business ByDesign.-If there are more than 25 sessions per user, it can cause performance issues in the system, affecting all the work centers.-These sessions refer to browser tabs that a user might have open on their screens. Unless the user closes these sessions, they remain in our backend, blocking memory unnecessarily.-Therefore, if you wish to use multiple user sessions, we kindly recommend closing the sessions that you are no longer using. By doing so, you will prevent performance issues in the system.-Keywords-User Sessions, Limit, Performance Issue, High Number, Poor Performance, Browser Tabs.

Title: "RFQ for Contract" is displayed as a default option under the RFQ type field
Content: Symptom-"RFQ for Contract" is defaulted in the RFQ types when new RFQ is created, even though contract is not scoped in business configuration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Select New Request for Quotation-Select view all-Under General Information->RFQ Process > RFQ type > system defaults to RFQ for Contract.-You have to manually select "RFQ for Purchase Order" from drop down if you do not want RFQ for contract.-Cause-Default RFQ type drop down logic is maintained in code level to display RFQ for contracts.-So, whether you scope this option or not , it will not impact the RFQ type drop down in this RFQ screen and will not remove "RFQ for contracts" from drop down while creating new RFQ document.-It is not possible to change existing standard logic at the moment. - Resolution-As of now, you need to select the  "RFQ for Purchase Order" option manually from the dropdown if you do not want "RFQ for Contract".-Keywords-RFQ for contract, RFQ for Purchase Order, RFQ type

Title: Goods and Services Receipt Expected checkbox greyed out for Limit Direct item
Content: Symptom-You've created a Purchase Order with a Limit Direct item and the checkbox for Goods and Services Receipt Expected is automatically checked and greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Purchase Order view-Search for the relevant document and open it-Navigate to Items tab-Select the item-In the Basic Data see that the checkbox Goods and Services Receipt Expected is checked and greyed out-Cause-Opening the Service Master Data you can see that the checkbox for Expense is marked, if you select this checkbox, the service will be treated as an expense for financial purposes.-Goods and services receipts are used as internal control documents to confirm the Expenses related to a Purchase Order.-This is a normal behavior for an expense item.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Limit Item, Expense Item, Goods and Services Receipt Expected

Title: Migration of Price List Throws Error "The combination of context elements is not supported"
Content: Symptom-You are migrating price lists using the migration tool, however in the simulation step you receive the error:-"The combination of context elements is not supported"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Migration of Price Lists.-Open the link Migrate Price Lists Using the Migration Tool.-On the new screen, select the migration file and click Execute Migration.-Select Execute Migration Step by Step.-In the simulation step, the error "The combination of context elements is not supported" is shown.-Cause-For the migration of price lists, certain fields should not be maintained in the template depending on the type of price list being imported (in some cases even if the field is marked as mandatory in the template)-As example:-For Price Lists for specific accounts, the Account ID field in the Items sheet should not be populated as it is filled in the General sheet.-For Price Lists where specific product IDs are defined in the Items sheet of the template, the Product Category ID field in the Items sheet should not be populated.-Resolution-Please adjust the template according to the type of price list being imported.-See Also-Help Center Document: Configuration: Migration of Discount Lists-2030884 - Error "The combination of context elements is not supported" During Migration of Price List-2774933 - Error Message "The combination of context elements is not supported" During Migration of Price List- Keywords-Price Lists, Migration, Descriptions, Business Configuration, Error csg_q, price lists, migration, descriptions, bu, the combination of context elements is n, migration, Prices are Inconsistent, releasing, not possible

Content: Symptom-Purchase Contract auto closure not happening -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting Work Center-Go to Contracts view-Search for the Contract to be closed  -The status of the Contract is Expired but it is not Closed -Cause-Due to backend inconsistency in the job created for the auto closure of the expired Purchase Contracts , they are not auto closed.-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to close the Purchase Contracts in UI:-Go to Sourcing and Contracting Work Center-Go to Contracts view-Search for the Contract to be closed and click on View all-Click on the button "Close Contract" to close the contract-Keywords-Purchase Contracts not closed, how to close Purchase Contracts, Purchase Contracts

Title: Baseline Plan Data Details Datasource Doesn't Display Data for Base Project ABC
Content: Symptom-The Data Source Baseline Plan Data Details (Data Source ID FINCACU09) doesn't display any data for Base Project ABC upon Preview action.-ABC is the Base Project ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Find date source Baseline Plan Data Details (data source ID FINCACU09) and click Preview.-In selection area, Base Project field, click the value help icon and enter project ABC.-Notice that the project is found, however, no data is displayed in the data source for it.-Cause-The preview of data source Baseline Plan Data Details doesn't display values for ABC base project because both Total Planned Cost and Total Planned Revenue are zero. -This can be checked by following the steps below:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select the row of Project ID ABC.-Under Details: ABC (respective project), check Total Plan Values section: here both Total Planned Cost and Total Planned Revenue are zero.-Resolution-The preview of data source Baseline Plan Data Details will show data for respective Base Project if at least Total Planned Cost or Total Planned Revenue figures are different than zero.-Keywords-total planned cost; total planned revenue; base project; FINCACU09; Baseline Plan Data Details

Title: Dump When Trying to Post Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-Whenever you try to post or simulate a Journal Entry Voucher an error is displayed:-'Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.'-Environment-SAB Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Journal Entry Vouchers View.-Search for the Journal Entry Voucher ID.-Click Edit.-Click Post or Simulate.-You will see the error message: 'Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.'-Cause-This issue could occur when the G/L account or account assignment on one of the lines has been changed, but for some reason, the system fails to trigger the necessary updates, resulting in an unexpected subledger account line item type.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, remove the lines and add them again from scratch.-The recommended approach is to create a new line with the desired G/L Account if a change is required, rather than modifying the existing line. This ensures a smoother process and minimizes the chances of encountering issues.-Keywords-Dump, Journal Entry Voucher, Post, Simulate, Error
