Title: Cannot Post Unposted Expense report with Error Message: Cost center XYZ not found
Content: Symptom-You have changed the Cost Center of a Expense Report and then inactivated the Cost Center, however system created an Unposted Source Document with following error message for previous Cost Center: Cost center XYZ not found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit View.-Go to the Source Documents Sub-view.-You will see an unposted source document with the error: Cost center XYZ not found.(XYZ Referes to Cost Center)-Cause-Since the Cost Center was used in the Expense Report, it needs to be activated to complete the posting. So, the only way to resolve the issue is re-activating the Cost Center.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to the Org Structures View.-Select the Cost Center and click on Edit.-Go to the Timelines Tab.-Adjust the validity of the Cost Center and then click on the Save button.-Keywords-Expense report, Cost center

Title: Manual Tax Entry, Manual Tax Entry reversal and Deviating Tax Due Date
Content: Symptom-When you have reversed a manual tax entry, the reversal tax entry is not counted in the same tax return than the reversed manual tax entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Manual Tax Entries view, Sales and Use Tax Entries / VAT Entries sub-view.-Click New and select the option Tax Entry.-Enter the mandatory data as well as the line items for the Posting Date and Tax Due Date: you enter, for example, Posting Date 01/01/2012 and Tax Due Date 31/12/2011.-Click Post.-Once the manual tax entry is posted you have to reverse it:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Manual Tax Entries view, Sales and Use Tax Entries / VAT Entries sub-view.-Select the Manual Tax Entry you want to reverse and Press the reverse button.-In the popup windows Input Parameters for Reverse enter the Posting Date of the reversal manual tax entry (the Posting Date of the reversal cannot be before the Posting Date of the reversed manual tax entry). You enter, for example, the 01/01/2012 as posting date of the reversal of the manual tax entry.-Click OK.-You can perform the tax return run for example for the period of December 2011.-The tax return for the period of December 2011 will integrate the initial manual tax entry created but not the reversal tax entry.-Cause-The relevant date for a tax item to be counted on the tax return is the Tax Due Date. The Tax Due Date of the initial reversed manual tax entry is entered when it is created in our example the 31/12/2011. However, this is different for the reversal of the manual tax entry. When you reverse a manual tax entry you only can specify the posting date of the reversal which cannot be before the posting of the reversed tax entry.-The Tax Due Date of the reversal is derived from the Posting Date of the reversal and is equal to it. In our example as the posting of the reversal tax entry is the 01/01/2012 the tax due date of the reversal is also 01/01/2012 therefore not matching the tax due date of the reversed tax entry set in our example to the 31/12/2011.-In case the tax due date of a manual tax entry is in a precedent period that its posting date it is not possible to have the tax due date on the reversal in the same period.-As a consequence, the reversal manual entry is not integrated in the same tax return than the reversed tax entry. In our example the reversed tax entry is counted in the tax return for December 2011, and the reversal tax entry is in the tax return for January 2012.-Resolution-You have three possibilities to correct the situation:-Let the situation as it is as it will compensate itself from one period to the other (in our example for December 2011 and January 2012).-Create a new manual tax entry with the same dates as the manual tax entry which has been reversed but with the debit and credit amounts switched and reverse it with the same reversal posting date as the first tax entry. This new tax entry would offset the effect of initial one in both periods (in our example December 2011 and January 2012).-Alternatively, SAP Support can change the Tax Due Date of the reversal in the system for you. If you opt for this possibility, open a case to SAP Support giving written authorization to SAP to do the changes from backend system.-Keywords-Tax, Tax Due Date, Reversal, Tax Return

Title: How to Download a File of G/L Accounts With Their Mapped / Assigned DATEV Accounts
Content: Symptom-You need to download a file / report to review the DATEV accounts with their assigned G/L accounts, or Tax Code Mapping details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can review the General Ledger Accounts with their DATEV Accounts as follows, but cannot download it:-Business Configuration.-View Activity DATEV Chart of Accounts and Tax Code Mapping.-Open Edit Account Mapping.-Here you find a list with General Ledger Accounts and their mapped DATEV - Accounts.-There is no option available to directly download this view as a file.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the view Reports view.-Open the report Configuration Change History.-Go to Fine-Tuning Settings tab.-Select the view drop down - All Activities.-Select the Fine-Tuning Activity "DATEV Chart of Accounts and Tax Code Mapping"-Select the button "Download Change Details".-Save the file.-Open the file and go to the last tab CHANGED KEYS - ALL VALUES.-Select the details that you require from the report.-Now you have an Excel file of the DATEV setting details that you require.-Keywords- DATEV Chart of Accounts and Tax Code Mapping, Excel, report

Title: Sales ledger line item missing Error during New Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You try to create a new Journal Entry Voucher(JEV), however gets an error message 'Sales ledger line item missing'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger Work Center.-Select New Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter Mandatory Values with JEV type 000888 and Screen Variant 634-Under line items add 2 line items with G/L accounts. -Enter Valid Cost Center value for required row and project task manually-Click Simulate button, error can be seen-Cause-The issue is due to Sales document is not maintained, which is mandatory for JEV type as mentioned above-Resolution-This is not an issue rather its the behaviour. In case, JEV is not sales related one then JEV can be created with type 00047 with variant 601. Else sales document is mandatory.-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, General Ledger

Title: Calculation of Depreciation Shows Different Amounts Than Expected
Content: Symptom-The Acquisition Cost for Fixed Asset XXX is 123, the Useful Life is ABC Years, the Depreciation Method is L010 - Str.-line from acq.value to 0.-You expect that the system calculates the depreciation as follows: Acquisition Cost divided by the number of years of Useful Life resulting in the same depreciation amount for each year of the Useful Life.-Instead the system calculates depreciation amounts you do not understand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Select the Fixed Asset XXX and click Edit - Values.-Navigate to the tab Depreciation Overview.-You can see the calculated depreciation for FA XXX for each year of the Useful Life.-Cause-The depreciation is calculated in accordance with the rounding rules in the work center Business Configuration:-Open the Business Configuration work center.-Select the fine-tune activity Fixed Assets Valuation View.-Navigate to the tab Rounding Rules.-You see that for the Net Book Value the Rounding Rule Arithmetic Rounding has been maintained.- Example: -Acquisition Cost of FA XXX: 803,32 EUR-Useful Life: 10 Years-Depreciation Method: L010 - Str.-line from acq.value to 0-You expect that the depreciation is calculated as follows:-Acquisition Cost 803,32 EUR divided by 10 Years Useful Life = 80,33 EUR per year of useful life.- Instead the system calculates the depreciation as follows:-Year 1: 81.32 EUR-Year 2: 81.00 EUR-Year 3: 81.00 EUR-Year 4: 81.00 EUR-Year 5: 81.00 EUR-Year 6: 81.00 EUR-Year 7: 81.00 EUR-Year 8: 81.00 EUR-Year 9: 81.00 EUR-Year 10: 74.00 EUR-Explanation of those amounts:-Acquisition Cost 803,32 EUR divided by 10 Years Useful Life = 80,33 EUR per year of useful life.-In accordance with the rounding rules this amount is rounded to 81,00 EUR per year of useful life.-The Cent amounts are added to the depreciation amount of the first year of useful life: 81,32 EUR.-For year 2 - 9 the depreciation amount is 81,00 EUR.-To achieve the net book value of 0,00 EUR, the depreciation amount for the last year of useful life is 74,00 EUR.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.- *These are the standard settings when the system is delivered to customers.-Keywords-depreciation overview; rounding; rounded; Arithmetic Rounding; recalculate adjustment; decimals-depreciation overview,rounded,rounding,arithmetic rounding,recalculate adjustment,decimals

Title: Error Message "No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy" When Trying to Save Time Recordings via Excel Add-in
Content: Symptom-Errors occur when trying to save time recordings or time recordings on a project for a service agent via Excel:-'No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy' (ABC represents the service agent ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work Center.-Select Time Sheet View.-Select any active employee.-Click Actions and select Upload Project Confirmations from Microsoft Excel.-Maintain the Excel template with proper data, log in the Business ByDesign add-in.-Click button Save Data to.-Excel Add-in throws error message: "No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy". -or-Go to Business Partner Data Work Center. -Select Service Agents View. -Find the relevant service agent. -Click Actions and select Record Times from Microsoft Excel. -Maintain the Excel template with proper data, log in the Business ByDesign add-in.-Click button Save Data to.-Excel Add-in throws error message: "No authorization to record times for employee ABC on dd.mm.yyyy". -Cause-If you are facing the issue in Time Administration Work Center:-Cause 1: The error occurs because a time agreement does not exist for service agent ABC.-If you are facing the issue in Business Partner Data Work Center:-Cause 2: The user you are logged in with does not have the relevant write access.-Resolution-Solution for cause 1:-Please create a time sheet for the service agent by following steps:-Go to Business Partner Data Work Center.-Go to Service Agents View.-Search for the relevant service agent.-Click Edit Time Sheet button.-Save.-After the time sheet be created for service agent ABC, you will be able to record project time confirmation for the service agent via Excel add-in.-Solution for cause 2:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center. -Select Business Users View. -Search for the relevant user. -Click Edit and Access Rights button. -Go to Access Restrictions tab. -Search for the Work Center View ID BPM_SERVICEAGENTS. -If the user has no access, they cannot upload times via the Excel add-in, in order to upload time recordings via Excel the write access has to be unrestricted.-Keywords-Excel, Add-in, Project, Time Recording, Service Agent, Authorization, 项目工时, 服务代理, 权限, プロジェクト

Title: Update via mass data maintenance fails with error: 'Update not possible; specified data ... does not exist' or 'Service Call' error
Content: Symptom-When trying to Import Customers or Suppliers using Mass Data Maintenance, system throws an error message, or does not perform the change. Examples:-Example 1: Error:  Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER-SALES_ARRANGEMENT with key DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL_CODE-CONTENT = `01` AND SALES_ORGANISATION_UUID-CONTENT =`ABC` does not exist-Example 2: Error:  Update not possible; specified data for SUPPLIER-PAYMENT_DATA with key COMPANY_ID = `XYZ` does not exist.-Example 3: The Validation is successful and says: No Invalid Data Found. But the import of some records fails with Service Call error-(Note: ABC represents a Sales Organisation and  XYZ represents a Company ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Select Import Customers or Suppliers and perform the action-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you are using Mass Data Maintenance to add new data for the Sales Data (example 1+3) or Payment  Data (example 2+3) sheet, which is not correct.--The Mass Data Maintenance is only used to modify the records. It will not create new entries. In order to create new entries in other sheets of the migration template for the already existing accounts, the migration tool needs to be used.-Resolution-Use the migration tool to create a file for the failed records of the Sales Data respectively Payment Data sheet, using method Migration Mode as Enhance already existing records, and proceed with the normal migration process.-Note: Mass Data Maintenance can only be used to modify existing data.-Keywords-fails, not possible, unable, try, attempt, does not work

Title: Time Type Actual Hours Worked Not Available for Time Recording
Content: Symptom-Time type Actual Hours Worked (for example: DE00001, US00001) is not available in the Employee Time Sheet for selection. Therefore actual working hours cannot be recorded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center. -Go to Employees view.-Select the relevant employee and click Edit button.-Go to Employee Times tab.-Click New button.-Open the dropdown list for the field Time Type under the tab General.-The Time Type Actual Hours Worked - US00001 may be not available for selection.-Cause-The system has been scoped in a particular way so that the time type Actual Hours Worked is not necessary.-Resolution-To ensure that time type Actual Hours Worked is in scope, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the current project and click Edit Project Scope button.-Go to step Questions by clicking Next button.-Expand Human Resources option and then expand Time and Labor Management.-Select Time Recording option.-Mark the checkbox for question "Do you have any employees for whom you only record exception time?" under the section Time Recording Methods.-Click Save button.-Keywords-Actual Hours Worked, Time Type, Time Administration

Title: Message 'Financials Assignment for Material ABC/Business Residence XYZ not specified' is Still Displayed After Valuation Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You have maintained account determination group and all other mandatory data in Material ABC  (ABC represents the ID of material)/Business Residence XYZ (XYZ stands for the ID of Business Residence), however message 'Financials Assignment for Material ABC/Business Residence XYZ not specified' is still displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Show All Materials and search for ABC.-Select Material ABC and click on Edit.-View tab Valuation.-Select the row of Business Residence XYZ.-You find Account Determination Group, Perpetual Cost Method and Cost are all maintained well, however, message 'Financials Assignment for Material ABC/Business Residence XYZ not specified' is still displayed.-Cause-The message is coming up because there is a task created manually on DD.MM.YYYY asking to maintain business residence XYZ for material ABC. If you go into the change history of the material, you can see that the business residence has been maintained for the material after DD.MM.YYYY. It means that the maintenance is after the task creation.-Resolution-You can manually close the task and then it will no longer appear.-Go to the Inventory valuation work center.-Go to the Work view.-Search for the task.-Click on the message 'Financials Assignment for Material ABC/Business Residence XYZ not specified' on top.-Click on Yes to confirm.-Keywords-Material,Business Residence,Financial Assignment

Title: How to enter unit price as a decimal point on the purchase order
Content: Symptom- Can the unit price be displayed as a decimal point on the purchase order?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Purchase Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-Enter Price Unit in Decimals-Cause-System does not allow to enter the Unit Price in Decimal Value-Resolution-The Price Unit must be always entered in Whole Number itself and no Decimal Values are allowed to be entered in Purchase Order.-The system will not accept any Decimal Value , as this is the System behavior.-Keywords-Decimal values in purchase order, unit price value, decimal number-decimal values in purchase order,unit price value

Title: Purchase order status is incorrect
Content: Symptom-You have created 3 deliveries for purchase order ABC (ABC represents for the purchase order ID). 2 of them are fully invoiced and 1 is not yet invoiced.-However you find the invoice status of purchase order is 'Invoiced', while you are expecting the invoice status to be 'Partially Invoiced'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Filter the list 'All Documents'.-Search and open the affected purchase order ABC.-The status of this purchase order is 'Finished', and the invoice status is 'Invoiced', while you are expecting the purchase order status to be 'Follow-Up Document Created' ,and the invoice status to be 'Partially Invoiced'.-Cause-The status of purchase order are set based on ordered quantity and not on actual delivered/invoiced quantity.-If the ordered quantity of purchase order ABC is 10.000 ea, and you have created 3 deliveries with total of 30.000 ea and 2 invoices correspondingly of 20.000 ea, even though the invoiced quantity is less then delivered quantity, purchase order shows fully delivered and fully invoiced, because both invoiced and delivered quantity are greater than the ordered quantity.-Once the delivery status shows 'Completely Delivered' and invoice status shows 'Invoiced', the purchase order status shows as 'Finished'.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Status, Invoiced, Partially Invoiced, Completely Delivered, Follow-Up Document Created, Finished, 采购订单状态

Title: Purchase request created from manual data entry has no requester ID/name proposed
Content: Symptom-Purchase request created from manual data entry has no requester ID/name proposed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-You have enable fields 'Requester ID' and 'Reuqester Name' in the list.-Search for purchase request XYZ (XYZ represents for the purchase request ID).-You find thre is no value displayed under 'Requester ID' and 'Reuqester Name' for purchase request XYZ.-Cause-The requester and recipient information are carried from shopping cart.-If the purchase request is created from scratch, no such value will it hold, hence it will keep blank.-Manual purchase request only have information like 'Buyer Responsible' and 'Created By'.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior.-See Also-3198180 - No approver determined for purchase request-Keywords-Requester ID, Reuqester Name, Purchase request, 采购申请，申请者编号，申请者姓名

Title: Error: 'Payment AAA: business partner name XYZ does not exist' Displayed in the Log of an Outbound File
Content: Symptom-The Outbound File in Liquidity Management work center presents status Error in File Creation.-The error message in Display Log is: 'Payment AAA: business partner name XYZ does not exist'.-AAA represents the Payment ID.-XYZ represents the Business Partner ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center-Go to the File Management view, and then choose the Outbound Files subview.-Select the file that is in status Error in File Creation, and choose Display Log.-Under the General tab, you see the error message: 'Payment AAA: business partner name XYZ does not exist'.-Cause-The Address details for one of the business partner is not maintained in the system.-This is the reason why an error message appeared, as the formatted name is picked from Address information for one of the payment document in Outbound File.-Resolution-You have to maintain the Address details using below steps:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Click Business Partners view.-Search for the Business Partner (XYZ) mentioned in the error message.-Click Edit.-Select option Addresses from dropdown list.-Fill the Address details and click Save.- You can create a new file for these payments after maintaining the Address details.-Keywords-Payment, Business partner name does not exist, outbound file, outgoing file, payment file, display log, payment media format

Title: Deferred Revenues not Realized for Sales Order Items of Service - Fixed Price Type
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-DO NOT USE - To be revised.-The accrual method as specified for the associated sales order item is event-based, for example 'Recognize at point of invoice'. Although Sales Order item XYZ-10 has been fully invoiced - revenues are not realized for a particular financial period after executing the revenue recognition run. (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The assigned accrual method can be tracked and modified under:-Cost and Revenue work center.-Enter the Sales Document Items view and select Sales Order item XYZ-10.-Choose the Accounting Data tab.-For the relevant Sets of Books IDs the Accrual Method is shown as 'Recognize at point of invoice'.-Still deferred revenues and cost of goods sold for a Sales Order item can be best illustrated under:-Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Reports view and choose List.-Open the report Sales Accruals.-Press Go and adjust the report parameters specifying Sales Document ID XYZ-10.-Under Deferrals (Revenue) Amount we see deferred amounts which should have been realized at the specified Key Date.-Cause-The status of the affected Sales Order is still In Process. The Item Type of Sales Order item XYZ-10 is 'Service - Fixed Price', e.g. 'Service - fixed price without actuals'.-The Revenue Recognition for for this item type works strictly quantity-based. This implies that the service execution for the item has to reflected in the status of Sales Order XYZ. This also is a prerequisite for the completion of the Sales Order.-Resolution-Modify the Sales Order status according to the service execution status. Sales Order item XYZ has to be released and the service execution completed if revenues associated with this Sales Order type shall be realized.-Edit Sales Order XYZ.-Click the Submit button and choose Confirm Service Execution.-Save the resulting Service Confirmation document and complete the sales order if applicable.-Subsequently the Revenue Recognition has to be repeated for the relevant fiscal period.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition, Deferred Revenues, Sales Order

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--You want to know which team is responsible for which Tenant Life-Cycle topics.-ByD Technology : SRD-CC-CI-CCS-C4C Cloud Migration: LOD-CRM-ADM-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Topic Scenario ByD Systems C4C Systems-Tenant-Lifecycle management-Tenant provisioning-Tenant decommissioning-Tenant refresh,-Tenant creation,-Tenant restore point creation -Tenant backup-ByD Technology C4C Cloud Migration-Service control center-Issues with the Service Control Center work center views-ByD Technology ByD Technology-User subscription   ByD Technology C4C Cloud Migration-Email notification-Any issues with initial user and password-Mass-email activation (DKIM)-System, upgrade and incident notifications-ByD Technology C4C Cloud Migration-Login issues-Business user lock issues-Password lock issues-Password forgotten link not working-ByD Technology-ByD Technology-Incident management   ByD Technology ByD Technology-Audit reports / security (system level reports)   ByD Technology C4C Cloud Migration-Help center   ByD Technology C4C Cloud Migration-Certificate-Any issues with updating a certificate-Any issues with renewing a certificate-ByD Technology C4C Cloud Migration-Certification issues in integration scenarios   ByD Technology C4C Integration-Attachment and output document extraction-Customer wants to terminate their SAP contract and request SAP to extract all of their data-ByD: 1801951 - Incident Processing - Data Extraction or Data Return-C4C: 3206602 - Handling of Data Extraction or Data Return Cloud for Customer Incidents-ByD Technology C4C Cloud Migration-Email issues-Email bouncing-Email not received by users-Email not sent by system-Emails are not reaching/ received when it was sent from any business document (Cause: DKIM not activated)-If certain users are not receiving any email then check with OPS whether the email addresses were listed on the account-level suppression list at the time that this email was sent. Title: Error 'Account determination is missing for item type Input Tax. Specify account determination in Chart of Accounts XYZ and Account Determination Profile PQR Column Path Tax->Input Tax->Input Tax,Item Type Input Tax.' Occurs When Posting Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a Supplier Invoice due to error:-'Account determination is missing for item type Input Tax. Specify account determination in Chart of Accounts XYZ and Account Determination Profile PQR Column Path Tax->Input Tax->Input Tax,Item Type Input Tax.'-XYZ stands for Chart of Accounts.-PQR stands for Account Determination Profile.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Click Post.-Error 'Account determination is missing for item type Input Tax. Specify account determination in Chart of Accounts XYZ and Account Determination Profile PQR Column Path Tax->Input Tax->Input Tax,Item Type Input Tax.' occurs.-Cause-Tax Code applied in the invoice is X-Domestic Purchase, Standard Rate, so for this tax code the applicable tax event is XY-Domestic Purchase.-For this Tax Event, the Account Determination Group maintained is ABC (under the activity Account Determination for Tax Events) and you have already maintained this account determination group under Account Determination in Chart of Accounts XYZ and Account Determination Profile PQR, Column Path Tax, Input Tax.-But, the above determination fails when your Company is in, for example, 'US - United States' and in the invoice the Tax Country is 'IE - Ireland', then we always treat the taxes as Tax Abroad. In this case then taxes are by default posted on Account Determination Group DEF which is for tax abroad.-X stands for Tax Code.-XY stands for Tax Event.-ABC stands for Account Determination Group.-DEF stands for Account Determination Group.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration work center, navigate to the fine-tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination (either via the Implementation project or via Overview).-Choose Account Determination, and then select Tax, Input Tax, Input Tax and click Add Row.-Under Account Determination Group for Taxable Event, enter the Account Determination Group DEF and the General Ledger Account YYY and save.-YYY stands for General Ledger Account.-Keywords-Account Determination is Missing for Item Type, Specify Account Determination, Tax abroad, Input Tax

Title: You are not able to scrap Fixed Asset as Cost center does not exist in profit center
Content: Symptom-You are not able to scrap Fixed Asset 123 (123 represents the Fixed Asset ID) due to error message Cost Center XYZ (XYZ represents the Cost Center) does not exist in Profit Center DEF (DEF represents the Profit Center).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Fixed Asset Work Center.-Select View/Subview Fixed Assets.-Select Fixed Asset 123 and click Manual Posting - Complete Scrapping.-Enter the respective data in fields Document Date, Posting Date, Description.-Use the default options Journal Entry Type 00059 - Manual Posting for Fixed Asset and Closing Step 010 - Operational postings.-Click Simulate, Journal Entry will be simulated successfully.-Click Back and then on Post.-You will see the following error message:-Error Message: Cost center XYZ does not exist in profit center DEF-Cause-The start date of the cost center is later than the start date for the assignment interval of the fixed asset.-Open Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Navigate to Master Data - Cost Centers.-Search for Cost Center XYZ.-You see that this Cost Center is valid from date dd.mm.yyyy onwards.-Open Fixed Asset Work Center.-Select View/Subview Fixed Assets and click Edit - Master Data.-Under Tab Basic Data you see that start date for the Assignment Interval of Fixed Asset 123 is earlier than dd.mm.yyyy.-Resolution-Open Fixed Asset Work Center.-Select View/SubviewFixed Assets and click Edit - Master Data.-Navigate to Sub-Tab Basic Data.-Under Header All Assignment Intervals click Add Row.-Add a new Assignment Interval with a date later than creation date of Cost Center XYZ.-Confirm with Save.-Afterwards you should be able to scrap the Fixed Asset.-This scenario only appears for migrated fixed assets.-If you create a fixed asset in SAP ByDesign it is not possible to create an assignment interval which is earlier than the start date of the cost center.-Keywords-Fixed Asset; Scrap; Cost Center; Profit Center; 00059 - Manual Posting for Fixed Asset; Closing Step 010 - Operational postings; Complete Scrapping;-manual depreciation

Title: Enter a Profit Center or Define a Default Profit Center For Subledger Without Subledger
Content: Symptom-You want to post a journal entry voucher for a general ledger accounts whose account assignment type is PRO-PROJECT TASK and you expect that the system uses the profit center that is assigned in the organizational structure to the responsible cost center of the project.-However, the system gives the error message Enter A Profit Center Or Define A Default Profit Center For Sub-ledger Without Sub-ledger.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Go to Journal Entry Vouchers sub view.-Create a new Journal Entry Voucher.-Select Journal Entry Type 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher and screen variant 601 - Journal Entry Voucher.-Add a row, specify the G/L Account, and make the debit assignment to project.-Add another row, and specify the G/L Account for the credit assignment.-The system gives the error message: Enter a profit center or define a default profit center for sub-ledger Without Sub-ledger.-Cause-Journal Entry Vouchers does not support this logic where Profit Center can be inherited from one item to another. Each item is responsible for deriving its own Profit Center. Hence if for an item there is no preceding document from which system can derive the Profit Center for E.g. project or cost center then a default Profit Cent needs to be maintained if the reporting principle is with balancing or with clearing.-Resolution-There are two ways to avoid the error message and post the Journal Entry Voucher.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Fine Tuning activity Profit Center Derivation.-Select Edit Default Profit Center.-For each company, you need to specify which profit center is derived by default for journal entry line items. You specify a default profit center for each sub-ledger. The system applies the particular default profit center whenever it cannot automatically derive a profit center from data stored in the source document and since we do not have any source we have to maintain this setting and if the GL Account selected in the Journal Entry Voucher lines belong to a miscellaneous ledger then select the sub-ledger as Without Sub-ledger or leave it as blank so that it applies to all.-or-Enter profit center manually and do not expect system to assign profit center based on account assignment PROJECT.-   Keywords

Title: No Records Found to Assign Contribution Margin Scheme in the Set of Books
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create Financial Reporting Structures and selected Copy from Template-You have selected Without Assignment and ignored assigning of Chart of Accounts to your Financial Reporting Structure and maintained only Functional areas, price components because you are following Income Statement by Function of Expense.-Or-If you try to Edit Set of Books you cannot find the Contribution Margin Scheme. It shows No Record found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work centre.-Access the Fine Tuning activity Set Of Books.-Click on Edit. -Go to Company Settings tab.-Here you cannot find the Contribution Margin Scheme.-It shows No Record Found. -Cause-Chart of Account assignment is missing in the Financial Reporting Structure that is created.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Fine Tuning activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select Edit Financial Reporting Structures.-Select Copy from Template-When ever you copy the template you need to select with assignments and add the Chart of Accounts too and fill the functional area and  price components and save the settings.-If the said steps are done then Contribution Margin Scheme will be available for selection in the dropdown to select in the Company Settings of Set of Books.-  Keywords-Set of Books, Contribution Margin Scheme

Title: SEPA Credit Transfer not Permitted When Creating Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-You are trying to execute, either manually or automatically, a SEPA Credit Transfer, however the system informs that the procedure is not allowed due to below error:-Pay. procedure SEPA Credit Transfer of account <bank account> not permitted for payments from <issuing country> to <beneficiary country>-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Open the supplier account monitor.-Select the concerned invoice and click Pay Manually By and select Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Post the bank transfer.-The following error is raised:  Pay. procedure SEPA Credit Transfer of account <bank account> not permitted for payments from <issuing country> to <beneficiary country>-Cause-The beneficiary's country is not assigned to the country group relevant for the SEPA payment format in business configuration.-Note:--SEPA credit transfer is only permitted for payments within the European Union. The Payer Bank and Payee Bank, both have to be in the EU.-Resolution-SEPA credit transfers can be made only to the list of countries assigned to the SEPA payments country group. Therefore, you have to maintain the country in the group as per below steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects and open the Activity List. Access the Fine Tuning phase. (If your system is live just navigate to the Overview view.)-Find the activity Outgoing Bank Transfer and open it/ or click Change Immediately.-On the screen that opens, click Edit Assignment of Payment Method Details to Payment Medium Formats.-Find the SEPA Credit Transfer medium format.-Refer to the Country Group column. The assigned group looks like 0000000004 - SEPA Payments.-Click Close.-Back on the Outgoing Bank Transfer activity, click Edit Country Groups.-Select 0000000004 - SEPA Payments from the list and add the beneficiary's country.-Save your changes.-After the above steps, the SEPA credit transfer procedure is be permitted between the company's and supplier's countries.-Keywords-bank statement, Kontoauszug,

Title: Delete Chart of Accounts - Error Messages on Account Assignments
Content: Symptom-You are not able to delete Chart of Accounts due to the below error messages:-'Value ABC in setting G/L Account Group: Account Assignment must also be entered in setting Chart of Accounts'.-'Value XXX in setting G/L Account Group: Account Assignment must also be entered in setting General Ledger Accounts'.-(Here ABC represents as Chart of Accounts and XXX represents as General Ledger Account)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select the Chart of Accounts and press Delete.-You get the below error messages:-'Value ABC in setting G/L Account Group: Account Assignment must also be entered in setting Chart of Accounts'.-'Value XXX in setting G/L Account Group: Account Assignment must also be entered in setting General Ledger Accounts'.-Cause-In the Budget Queries Fine Tune activity some G/L account assignments have not been removed from the G/L account groups for reporting setting.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Budget Queries Fine Tune activity, either from the Implementation Project or from the Business Configuration overview. -Select the Edit G/L account groups for reporting link. -In the new screen Search for G/L Accounts which is assigned to the G/L account groups in question. -Press Delete to remove the account assignment.-Now you are able to delete the Chart of Account.-Keywords-Delete Chart of Accounts, G/L account groups for reporting, Account assignment

Title: Tax Exchange Rate and Exchange Rate are Different on Journal Entry for Same Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-The value of the Tax Exchange Rate and the Exchange Rate in a Journal Entry are different for the same Customer Invoice. This is valid also for other Source Documents, such as Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Journal Entries Sub View.-Find the relevant Journal Entry and open it.-Go to the Journal Entry tab.-You find that the Exchange Rate and the Tax Exchange Rate are different for the Line Items for the same Source Document.-Cause-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search and open the activity Currency Conversion Profiles.-Here, for Business Transaction Group 'Customer Invoice' you can set the Conversion Type, Conversion Date (for example, '1 - Document Date') and Exchange Rate Type.-The Tax Exchange Rate is based on the exchange rate on the Tax Date in the Source Document. So in this case, the Tax Date and Document Date are different in the Source Document, and there are different rates valid on each date. This caused the different value in the Journal Entry for the Tax Exchange Rate.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Tax Exchange Rate; Exchange Rate; Journal Entry; Customer Invoice; Source Document-exchange rate,differences from exchange rate fluctuati,tax difference,customer invoice

Title: G/L Accounts - Line Items Report shows #(not assigned) value to a Posted Journal Entry Voucher(JEV) on Project Tasks
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Journal Entry Voucher(JEV) on Project Tasks but when you look at the report G/L Accounts - Line Items there is no Project Tasks assigned(#)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger work center-Open Reports and list-Search for report G/L Accounts - Line Items and open it-Enter data as per the journal entry voucher and project task is shown as not assigned(#)-Cause-The simulated JEV with reference to project task doesn't have the project task reflected in the Journal Entry(JE) created.-Reason being G/L accounts used are of type CSTGEN - Allocated Costs-Resolution-The type of the G/L account will determine whether the project task is getting included on the JE - if it's not on the JE, it won't be in the report. -The Project task assignment currently only works for account types as below.-Revenues / Gains,-Costs / Expenses,-Cost of Sales,-Other Assets,-Other Liabilities,-Accruals / Clearings,-Differences. - Keywords-G/L Accounts - Line Items, Financial Report, Journal Entry Voucher, Project task

Title: How to Find the Contact Communication Numbers in Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the business communication information like phone, mobile numbers in the contact master date. You want to know how the information is used in sales documents like sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Contacts view.-Open the contact ABC, you can see the phone and mobile are maintained.-You want to know where you can find the information in sales order.-Cause-In the sales order, you can find the Contact section in the General tab. The main contact is determined and shown here.-Phone number is displayed in the order, and you can click Address Details to show other business communication information such as Mobile.-Resolution-This is currently the designed behavior.-Keywords-contact; business communication information; sales order.

Title: Bank Data not Available as Workflow Rule Placeholder
Content: Symptom-You are configuring a workflow rule for the Suppliers object, however when defining the information that will be inserted in the notification, you see that it is not possible to include the bank data  information of the supplier in the message body.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management.-Enter the view Workflow Rules.-Click on the New button.-In the object, select Suppliers.-Proceed with the next steps until step 3 is reached.-In the Placeholders table, open the dropdown list for Field.-Here you can see that only "Bank Data Changed" indicator is available.-Cause-Bank data is considered sensitive information in the system. In case of notifications, it is not possible to ensure that only relevant people will be selected to receive the message, which could impose a security issue.-Resolution-Despite not being possible to explicitly display the bank data in the notification body, the Bank Data Changed indicator can be used and the changes in the data can be checked in the Changes tab of the supplier.-Keywords-Rule, Task, E-mail

Title: Landed Cost – Monitor and Set Clearing Status for Goods Receipts Report: Change Status to Open
Content: Symptom-You want to use the Landed Cost – Monitor and Set Clearing Status for Goods Receipts report (Report ID FININVU24_Q0001) to revert the Landed Cost Clearing Set Status from 'To Be Cleared' to 'Open', however, this option is not available in the report.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the Landed Cost – Monitor and Set Clearing Status for Goods Receipts report (Report ID FININVU24_Q0001).-Enter respective data selection.-Find the respective Landed Cost Clearing Set ID and notice that the Landed Cost Clearing Set Status is 'To Be Cleared'.-Left click over the respective Landed Cost Clearing And Component --> Execute Actions.-Notice that the only option available is 'Change Status to be Cleared'.-Cause-After the status has been set to 'To Be Cleared' it cannot be reverted.-Resolution-This report and the available action to set landed cost clearing sets to 'To be Cleared' is essential and critical for the overall landed cost process to ensure that landed cost variances and unplanned landed costs are cleared against the material ledger in a timely and responsible manner.-The report should be assigned to a business user who is very familiar with the landed cost processes in his company. It is not recommended to assign this report to an untrained business user because also these will have access to the critical action.-For more information, please check SAP Community Blog Post: Landed Costs in SAP Business ByDesign – Analytical Enhancements-See Also- Help Portal: Landed Costs Clearing Runs-Keywords-landed costs, to be cleared, open, po, purchasing document, clearing set status

Title: Possibility to create an expense report for an inactive employee
Content: Symptom-During the creation of an expense report, you notice that it is possible to create an expense report for a non active employee- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses Work Center > New Expense Report on Behalf-Enter the Employee ID XXXX -It is possible to create the expense report for an inactive employee- --Cause-The system allows the creation of the expense reports during the validity of the Expense arrangements even for inactive employees in order to support retroactively creation of expense reports in the past for inactive employees.-If you create an expense report or an expense on a date dd.mm.yyyy outside the validity of the expense arrangement the systems throws the error message "current expense arrangement does not allow expense reports with date dd.mm.yyyy. - Resolution-System behavior-If the you want to completely block inactive employee for creation of expense reports, you can block the employee via Information Lifecycle Management - Business Partners - Block Usage  -Keywords-expense report, inactive, employee

Title: No G/L Accounts Available for Selection for Credit for Internal Services and Debit for Internal Services
Content: Symptom-No G/L Accounts show up for selection for Costs subledger --> Service tab --> Credit for Internal Services and Debit for Internal Services columns.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Open Costs subledger.-Open Service tab.-For Credit for Internal Services and Debit for Internal Services columns, click the dropdown arrow to show the available G/L Accounts and notice the message 'No items found'.-Remark:-If you type any G/L Account and hit enter, system will throw the error:-'AAA is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.'-AAA means the G/L Account ID.-Cause-Only G/L Accounts of type CSTGEN - Allocated costs are allowed for Credit for Internal Services and Debit for Internal Service. Since there's no G/L Account defined in the system with G/L Account Type Allocated costs, the issue happens.-Resolution-Maintain the required CSTGEN - Allocated costs G/L Accounts in Chart of Accounts, then you can complete the account determination for Costs --> Service --> Credit for Internal Services and Debit for Internal Service.-See Also-Help Portal: Account Type-Keywords-costs; service; G/L account; CSTGEN; Allocated costs

Title: How to Enable Edit Exchange Rate view for Business User?
Content: Symptom-You want to enable Edit Exchange Rates view for Business User. But you cannot find the respective View in the User Access Rights.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks view you cannot find Edit Exchange Rates view. -You want to enable "Edit Exchange Rates" view for Business User. -Cause-There is no Specific Work center / View Name for "Edit Exchange Rates". However, this view is included in the Work Center / View Name - Sets of Books and Assigned Companies. If the user is assigned to "Sets of Books and Assigned Companies" view then the system will enable both Set of Books and Edit Exchange Rates in the General Ledger work center.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to assign "Sets of Books and Assigned Companies" view to Business User:-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Click on Business User view.-Search for the User ID.-Click on Edit -->Access Rights.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment tab. -Find the Work Center / View ID - FIN_GENERALLEDGER.-In the second column, you can find the Work Center / View Name - Sets of Books and Assigned Companies.Select the check box - Assigned to User.-Press Save. -This will enable Edit Exchange Rates view along with the Set of Books and Assigned Companies, under General Ledger work center.-Keywords-Edit Exchange Rates view, Missing Edit Exchange Rates view, General Ledger

Title: Customer Down Payment Creates Supplier Invoice In Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-While creating a Customer Down Payment Request for an intercompany process, system creates a Supplier Invoice instead of a Supplier Down Payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the Supplier Invoice's ID.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-You can see that the Supplier Invoice was created after the Customer Down Payment Request.-You expected that instead of the Supplier Invoice, it was created a Supplier Down Payment Request.-Cause-This scenario is the standard behavior. The system is working as expected.-Resolution-Currently this functionality is not supported in ByDesign. If you want system to create Supplier Down Payment, this can be taken as a new requirement and kindly post the idea in our Influence Platform:-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Intercompany; Customer Down Payment Request creates supplier invoice; Supplier Down Payment Request

Title: Time Posting Shows Different Time Type than the Expected
Content: Symptom-After an employee performs a time recording, you see the time type of the recording appearing as "Generated Premium" when opening the Time Account Balances report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to workcenter Business Analytics.-Enter the view Design Reports.-Search and open the report Time Account Balances.-Filter the report to find the employee time recording and execute the report.-Go to the view facet of the report.-Add the Time Type column.-Here you can see the value in the column displayed as "Generated Premium".-Cause-One possible cause for this behavior is that the time record is an overtime, and due to the rules in the time recording profile of the employee it is being calculated with a premium pay.-When a premium pay is generated because of a time recording profile setting, the system posts the time with an automatically created time type "Generated Premium".-Resolution-The system works as expected.-In order to check the time recording profile rules, please follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Enter the Overview view.-Search and open activity "Time Types - XYZ" (where XYZ represents the country code).-Enter the sub-activity "Maintain Time Recording Profile".-Here you can check the overtime rules, as well as the thresholds which will generate premium pays for the time recordings.-Keywords- premium pay, report, time account

Title: Tax Exchange Rate and Exchange Rate on the Same Journal Entry are Different
Content: Symptom-Tax Exchange Rate and Exchange Rate on the same Journal Entry are different and you expect them to be the same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Journal Entry.-Search and find Journal Entry ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Journal Entry ID).-Notice on the top of the posting Exchange rate displays as 123 (123 represents the Exchange Rate value).-Select the VAT related line item.-Under the line item details you will notice a line showing Tax Exchange Rate 456 (456 represents the Tax Exchange Rate value).-You want to know why the Exchange Rates are not the same for both the Tax Exchange rate and the Exchange Rate on the header of the Journal Entry.-Cause-The Tax Exchange Rate only appears on the Journal Entry if you have maintained Currency Conversion Type under the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-If there is a different Exchange Rate value to the Exchange rate it is because you have different values under Exchange Rate Type or Conversion Type in both the settings.-To compare you need to view the following settings:-1. To view the Tax Exchange rate settings:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the view Overview.-Search and find the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Select the option Define Currency Conversion Type.-Select the specific Country/Region.-Make note of the Exchange Rate Type and Conversion Type.-2. To view the settings for Exchange Rate for the Document:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the view Overview.-Search and find the activity Currency Conversion Profiles.-Select the relevant Currency Conversion Profile.-Select the relevant Business Transaction Type.-Make note of the Exchange Rate Type and Conversion Type.-The reason why you have different value in the Tax Exchange Rate compared to the Exchange Rate is because the settings in the Exchange Rate Type and Conversion Type in the above settings are not the same.-Resolution-The system behavior is correct and working as expected.-Should you wish for the Tax Exchange Rates to be the same as the Exchange rate you have two options:-Edit the Exchange Rate Type and Conversion Type to be the same in both.-or-Make sure that you have maintained currency rates that are the same for both Exchange Rate Type.-Keywords-Tax Exchange Rate, Exchange Rate, Conversion Type,

Title: Error: "Assignment Not Valid; Target Object Only Valid From DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY" While Migrating Personnel Administration Data
Content: Symptom-During migration of personnel administration data, the error message: "Assignment not valid; target object only valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY" is thrown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview.-Search for the Activity Migration Of Employee Data.-Select Open.-Select the link Migrate personnel administration data using migration tool.-Select the file and Execute Migration Step by Step.-Cause-There could be two possible causes for this error:-Cause 1: The hire date of the employee is not within the validity period of the organizational unit to which the employee is assigned.-For example: The employee hire date is: 01.01.2020 and the org unit is valid from: 01.03.2020.-Cause 2: The Job ID assigned to the employee in the migration template is set to a limited value instead of an unlimited value.-Resolution-Solution for cause 1: Ensure that the validity of the organizational unit assigned to the employee covers or includes the employee's hire date.-Solution for cause 2: Ensure that the validity of the Job ID matches the validity of the employee, or vice versa.-Keywords-Import, Unable, Fails, Basic employee, Job, Assignment, Personnel Administration, Migration

Title: Migrated Business Residence are Displaying as Deviating Business Residence
Content: Symptom-You have migrated an Organizational Structure through migration and defined the Business Residence for an Org Unit. In the migration template, you have filled this Business Residence for the child Org Units. But, in Organizational Management work center whichever Org Unit has this as Business Residence shows this as Deviating Business Residence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Open Org Structures -You see some of the Org Units Referred as "Deviating Business Residence Assignment" as shown below:-Cause-When you migrate an Org Unit using migration Template, the Business Residence is inherited from the Parent Org Unit. So, when you define the Org Unit as a Parent Org Unit then the child org units inherit the Business residence property.--Hence, it is not required to enter the values in the column Parent Business Residence Org Unit ID. You can fill this column only when you need to define the deviating Business Residence.-Resolution-To overcome the issue please follow the below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center-Open Org Structures -Go to Planning Area-Highlight the affected Org Unit-Remove the Business Residence(Currently belongs to field) & hit enter key, Business Residence is inherited from the Parent Org Unit -Now the system will determine the Business Residence automatically. Then you can activate the Org Units.-See Also-Deviating Business Residence Assignments-Keywords-Deviating Business Residence, Business Residence, Business Residence Assignment, Currently Belongs to, Org Unit, Org Structure.

Title: Technical Error in Simulation Step When Migrating Price Lists
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate price lists using the migration tool, the simulation step raises the following error message:-A Technical Error Occurred. Ensure the Key Field Combination in Price List is Correct, Before Reporting an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - 1805 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-In the Overview view, search for the activity Migration of Price Lists.-Click on Migrate Price Lists using the Migration tool.-Click on Upload -> Data from Migration Template.-Load the migration template.-Click on Execute Migration -> Step by Step.-Proceed to the step 3 - Simulation.-After the import simulation, the error message is raised.-Cause-This error is caused due to missing values in the fields "Sales Organization ID" and "Distribution Channel" in the general tab of the template.-Resolution-In order to migrate price lists using the migration tool, you need to provide the information for "Sales Organization ID" and "Distribution Channel".-If you have the requirement to create a price list without this information (so the price list is valid for all the sales organizations and distribution channels), you can migrate it with dummy values and remove them afterwards using the UI.-Keywords-migration workbench, migration activity, pricing

Title: Error 'Sign settings for this type of depreciation for the valuation view 001 of the set of books AAA for the fixed asset BBB is set to '0' in the business configuration; hence this type of depreciation posting is not allowed for this valuation view' Occurs When Posting Manual Depreciation
Content: Symptom-You need to do manual depreciation for fixed asset BBB (BBB represents the ID of fixed asset), but when posting, the system reports an error: "Sign settings for this type of depreciation for the valuation view 001 of the set of books AAA (AAA represents the set of books) for the fixed asset BBB is set to '0' in the business configuration; hence this type of depreciation posting is not allowed for this valuation view".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for Fixed Asset ID: BBB.-Select Fixed Asset ID BBB and click Manual Posting > Manual Depreciation.-Input Set of Books as AAA, Depreciation Type as 2 - Special Depreciation and other required parameters.-Click Post.-Error: "Sign settings for this type of depreciation for the valuation view 001 of the set of books AAA for the fixed asset BBB is set to '0' in the business configuration; hence this type of depreciation posting is not allowed for this valuation view" occurs.-Cause-Regarding fixed asset BBB, for set of books AAA and depreciation method L010-Str.-line from acq.value to 0, it is not possible to post special depreciation.-For every fixed asset, there are specific sign rules. These rules determine what kind of transactions can be completed, for example, Permitted Value Range e.g.: + Only Positive value range, - Only negative value range, * Positive or negative values permitted.-The settings that are against fixed asset BBB for set of books AAA and depreciation method L010 do not allow either positive or negative postings.-Resolution-You can view the settings that are against a fixed asset by following the below steps:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for Fixed Asset ID: BBB.-Select Fixed Asset BBB and click Edit-> Values.-Select Set of Books AAA.-Go to Values tab > click "Values" button and select Explain Values.-A PDF document Fixed Assets Depreciation Trace is generated.-Open the PDF document and find Sign Rules. Here you can see the rule for Special Depreciation = 0. This means that Special Depreciation is not permitted.-Keywords-Fixed Asset; Sign rule; depreciation; L010 - Str.-line from acq.value to 0; Special Depreciation;

Title: How to Troubleshoot Performance Issues in the Backend.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-How to troubleshoot performance issues in the backend.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Activities view.-Click the button "Show Calendar"-You noticed that  opening the  calendar from account management is taking much time.--Cause-To analyse the issue you would need to check STAD values in the backend.-Resolution-First of all Execute the steps to reproduce in the UI and wait until the system finished the loading.-Go to Transaction STAD.-In Filter Read Interval Fill the fields; Date, Time and Length.-In Filter Parameters Fill the fields: Client, User and Resp. Time.-Press Enter.-      In the next Screen you will be able to see all statistical details: user, Response Time, Name of the program....-If you double-click the Response Time (ms) value, you will be able so see it in more details.-  *********-After you can send this information to application development colleagues for further checking. If you do not know the component to forward the incident to, please check the steps below to find the responsible component:-Go to the Transaction MDRS.-Set Business Object.-Enter the value *Appointment_Activity* and hit on Enter on your keyboard.-Double-click in the Business Object name-Go to General data Section on the right Screen and click Field Package.-You will be able to see the right  Application component.-      Keywords-Performance, Backend, Troubleshoot, Investigate, MDRS, Slowdown, Trace, STAD

Title: Migration of Material Valuation Data Fails due to More than 2 Decimals in Material Cost
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Material Valuation Data but it fails since the Material Cost has more than 2 decimals.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and open the Migration of Material Valuation Data activity.-Select Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool link.-Highlight the file and select Execute Migration ﻿button.-Cause-You cannot enter more than 2 decimals for amounts. In SAP Business ByDesign all currencies are predefined according to ISO code list 4217. You can use the fine-tuning activity Currencies to view all currencies available in your system and the decimals which will be displayed for this currency.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-You can find the decimal level for the respective currency in below steps and change the Material Cost:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects.-Select your implementation project and press the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tuning step and search for the Currencies activity.-You cannot change the number of decimals displayed in the Display Decimal column for the predefined currencies.-Keywords-decimals, migration
