Content: Symptom-How to measure network bandwidth and latency-Resolution-There are tools available from within the SAP C4C tenant to measure the network bandwidth and latency from the browser to the C4C server. Here are the detail steps on how to use this tool.-1. To measure network latency-a. Open the tool using the following URL in any browser-https://cct.sde.cloud.sap/-You can perform the following activities through the tool : just click on the link, wait for 2 -5 secs.-2. On top right, you can find mail option click on the open in an e-mail. (attach the results to case)-Keywords-network bandwidth, latency

Title: Open Receivables/Payables required when automatically allocating a Payment to Customer/Supplier
Content: Symptom-Your expectation is that upon uploading a bank statement containing the accurate customer/supplier IDs automatic payment allocations to customer/supplier-accounts based on the Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines (e.g.: Rule Type: 5 - Supplier) is happening.-However, payment allocations remain in status 'In Process' and no automatic allocation is executed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can access relevant payment allocations either in:-Payment Management work center.-Navigate to Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant payment allocation.-- or via the posted bank statement.-Liquidity Management work center.-Bank Statements view.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and edit.-Follow the link Postprocessing required to access the relevant payment allocation.-Cause-For automatic payment allocations to customer/supplier account to happen there have to be relevant open payables/receivables, namely invoices, at the moment of the bank statement upload. The indication of a supplier/customer id in a bank statement transaction without potential candidate invoices for clearing is not considered strong enough to facilitate an automatic payment allocation to business partner.-Resolution-Make sure that open invoices as candidate documents for clearing do exist for a suppliers/customer - account when uploading a bank statement an automatic allocation to customer/supplier accounts is expected.-Keywords-Receivables; Payables; Payment; automatically; allocate; customer; supplier; open;

Title: Business Partners Generated for Companies Do Not Always Have the Same ID As Org Unit ID
Content: Symptom-In SAP Business ByDesign, setting an org unit as a company automatically generates a corresponding business partner.-You have created your organizational structure and activated it, but noticed that for some companies, the business partner ID is the same as the org unit's ID, while for others, it is different.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-For companies, the corresponding business partner ID is determined as below:-If the business partner ID is provided in the Internal Business Partner ID field of the org unit at the time of creation, then upon activation, that ID will be used.-If there is no business partner ID specified, then the org unit ID will be taken, as long as the org unit ID's length is ≤ 10 characters (and the org unit ID in question is within an External number range maintained in the General Business Partners fine-tuning activity of the Business Configuration).-If all of the above criteria are not met, then the business partner ID will be taken from the Internal automatic number range maintained in the General Business Partners fine-tuning activity of the Business Configuration.-The Business Partner ID cannot be changed afterwards.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-To specify the business partner ID directly in the org unit, please follow the instructions below. It is worth noting that this is only supported at the time of the creation of the org unit:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access the Edit Org Structures view under Common Tasks.-Select the org unit which you would like to set as a company.-Go to the General tab.-Click the External Business Identifiers link.-Here, you can enter the Internal Business Partner ID.-Keywords-Org Unit ID, Business Partner ID, Company, Different, Internal Business Partner ID

Title: Profit Center Missing On Reports
Content: Symptom-You are not able to see profit centers on Account Payables - Trial Balance report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger and select Reports.-Open the report Account Payables - Trial Balance.-Enter the values in the respective fields.-Move Profit Center from the Not Currently Shown to Rows.-Click Go.-Here you will see that none of the entry displayed in the report has profit center value assigned.-These steps are also applicable for the following reports.-Account Payables - Trial Balance-Account Receivables - Trial Balance-Account Payables - Line Items-Account Receivables - Line Items-Cause-You have maintained reporting principle Function of Cost and Profit center/segment for set of books. This reporting principle does not support profit center derivation and because of this profit center is not derived for the Supplier/Customer invoice.-Due to this report is not able to display data based on the profit center.-Resolution-If you would like supplier/customer invoice to derive the profit center you need to change the reporting principle to profit center or segment with clearing for the set of books.-To do so, follow the below steps.-Navigate to Business Configuration and select Implementation Project.-Select the implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search for activity Set Of Books and open it.-Select the appropriate set of books and click Edit.-Navigate to General tab and change the value of field Reporting Principle from the dropdown list.-Click Save.-After the changes are performed, all the account receivables/payables posting will derive profit center and these detail will be displayed in respective reports.-See Also-1828324 - Unable To Change Reporting Principle For The Set Of Books-Keywords-Report; Profit Center; Missing;

Title: Petty Cash Closed by Mistake and Cannot be Reopened
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Petty Cash account is closed by mistake and the user wants to activate it again. However the status of the Petty Cash account cannot be amended from the UI.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the view Petty Cash.-Select the dropdown view All Petty Cash.-Select Petty Cash account XYZ (XYZ represents the Petty Cash ID).-Status of Petty Cash account is Closed.-There is no option to change the status of the Petty Cash account.-Cause-Once you have changed the status of the Petty Cash to closed it can only be changed back to active by SAP back end change.-Resolution-To change the status of the Petty cash account follow the below steps:-Log into the STFK.-Go to the transaction SE38.-Enter the report: "FOP_OPEN_CLOSED_PETTYCASH".-Select execute.-Enter the Petty Cash ID and Company Code.-Click on Execute(F8).-Once you have completed the above step you need to reload the FSI view. This needs to be completed so the correct Petty Cash accounts show on the correct views within the UI.-Log into the STFK.-Go to the transaction GFSSTM.-Select the option for BO and enter: FOPXP_CSHSTR.-Choose the FSI View FOP_CSHSTR_VIEW.-Expand it and select "Root"->FOPXP_CSHSTR.-At the top of the screen Load, check the Number on the right side. If You find it in high range then perform the FSI view reload out of business hours. -Click on Persistence and Press Yes.-Press Refresh until you see the changes are applied.-Petty Cash is activated again and also available in the value help of active petty cash storages.-Keywords-Petty Cash status closed, Petty Cash, Liquidity Management, open petty cash; reopen petty cash

Title: The Bank Accounts Are Not Proposed Correctly During Automatic Payments
Content: Symptom-Your company has businesses with foreign suppliers whose company currencies are different from yours, so you set up different bank accounts with different currencies, and hope that during automatic payments, the system can propose the right bank accounts according to the currency codes in the supplier invoices. But the system does not react that way.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center and choose the Automatic Payments view.-Show All Payment Proposals.-Choose one payment proposal in which the transactional currency is not your company currency, and the Payment Method is Bank Transfer.-Choose Edit, and then go to the General Data tab.-You can see the Bank Account ID is XYZ.-Then go to the Liquidity Management work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Choose My Banks subview.-Choose the related bank, and then click Edit Bank Accounts.-Select the bank account XYZ and then go to the Account tab.-You can see the Currency of the Bank Account is not the same in the payment proposal.-XYZ means the Bank Account ID.-Cause-In the fine-tune activity Global Settings for Payment, select Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods, you can see that for the Payment Method International bank transfer, only bank account XYZ is maintained. As this bank account is set as the highest priority, so whenever an international bank transfer transaction happens, bank account XYZ is proposed.-Resolution-For the system to propose the right bank account, first of all, you have to change the prioritization if the bank account XYZ is not wanted with the highest priority. Then follow the steps below to maintain the master data:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Select My Banks subview.-Select the related bank, and choose Edit Bank Accounts.-Select the bank account XYZ, and then choose Alternative Currency tab.-To allow transactions to be processed in a currency other than the main bank account currency, specify that currency here. Note: if you do not specify any alternative currencies, then all currencies are allowed for the bank account.-Maintain the alternative currency for all the other bank accounts in this bank.-Meanwhile, if you keep an agreed amount on deposit with your bank, you should enter this amount in the Minimum Amount field.  Similarly, if you wish to keep an amount on deposit below a certain amount, you can enter this in the Maximum Amount field. These are not mandatory but they are used by the liquidity check and influence the bank account selection as well.-Keywords-bank account ID; currency; automatic payment

Title: Not Able to Migrate Date/Time Field in Migration of Service Orders
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Date/Time field in Migration of Service Orders and face the error message:-"'yyyy-mm-dd' is not a valid value; edit source value"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project.-Open Activity List.-Search for "Migration of Service Orders" and open it.-Open the relevant file.-Click on Execute Migration Step by Step.-The error is shown in the simulation step.-Cause-You have created extension fields of type GDT_GLOBAL_DATE_TIME (Timestamp) and for that type the input should be different. If you wish to use date format, the extension fields should be of type APC_V_DATE (Date).-Resolution-You have two options:-Change the type of the extension fields to Date (APC_V_DATE) and use date formats, or-Keep the GDT_GLOBAL_DATE_TIME (Timestamp) type and then the inputs should be in the following format: "YYYYMMDDHHMMSS".-Keywords-Workbench, Excel, Template

Title: Account Determination Error in Revenue Recognition Run
Content: Symptom-Error upon execution of Revenue Recognition Run:-'Account determination group ABC: G/L account missing for services'-ABC means the Account Determination Group ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Click Revenue Recognition Subview under Periodic Tasks.-Show All Revenue Recognition Runs.-Select the Revenue Recognition ID.-Click View.-Click Processed With Errors.-Click Go.-You will see errors on the revenue recognition:-Error: 'Account determination group ABC: G/L account missing for services'-Cause-There are missing definitions in the account determination. This error is thrown when internal services are processed and only during the Revenue Recognition Run.-Resolution-You need to maintain suitable G/L Accounts, as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project and click Open Activity List.-Click All.-Open the Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Costs under Account Determination.-Click Service tab.-Select the Account Determination Group which appears on the error message (in this case, ABC).-Here you see no Credit for Internal Services nor Debit for Internal Services maintained for Account Determination Group for Services ABC.-You need to maintain suitable account determination. After that, the issue shall not occur for the next Revenue Recognition Run.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition. Account Determination. Internal Services.

Title: Scoping Question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" is Missing in the Project Scope
Content: Symptom-The question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" is missing in the Project Scope.-In this way, Credit Card Payments cannot be set up in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project line.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the 4th option (Questions tab).-Expand Cash Flow Management.-Expand Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select the Payment Methods option.-Navigate to the last question under the Incoming Payments, scoping question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" is missing.-Cause-Setting-up point-to-point integration with Computop will not be possible with the deprecation from the February 2023 release of SAP Business ByDesign. However, for customers productively using the Computop integration there will be no changes. They will still be able to use the scenario and accept credit card payments via Computop point-to-point integration.-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign has been supporting point-to-point integration with very few payment service providers until now. This will be replaced by the SAP Digital Payments add-on which provides a central add-on, supporting multiple payment service providers out of the box, granting more flexibility and choice. Also, as SAP Digital Payments is integrated with many SAP products, there is only one central integration with the payment service provider. For detailed information about SAP Digital Payments, please refer to this blog.-See Also-Help Documents:-Customer Payments by Credit Card-About Integration with SAP Digital Payments Add-on-SAP Digital Payments Add-On-Keywords-Credit Card, Computop, Digital Payments

Title: Rejected Invoice Does Not Appear In GSTR-1/GSTR-2 VAT Return Run
Content: Symptom-You create a VAT Return Run ABC for Company DEF of Tax Type GSTR-1 or GSTR-2, for a specific period (E.g. From 01.03.2023 to 31.03.2023). In the created VAT Return GHI, you notice that one or more Invoices have Acceptance Status as "2 - Rejected".-You expect these Invoices to be present in a subsequent period (E.g. From 01.04.2023 to 31.04.2023) VAT Return Run of Tax Type GSTR-1 or GSTR-2 for Company ABC. But when you check the created VAT Return, they are not. (ABC, DEF and GHI stands for the VAT Return Run, Company and VAT Return IDs).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Open VAT Return Runs View.-Click on the row of Run ID DEF.-In below Details section, click on the dropdown and choose All Logs.-Click on Tax Return GHI.-In VAT Return GHI, go to Tax Return tab.-Here you notice that for one or more Invoices, Acceptance Status shows "2 - Rejected".-Then you execute a VAT Return Run with the same settings for the next period and you repeat the process above, but in the newly created VAT return, you don't see the Invoices that were rejected in the previous VAT Return.-Cause-This is expected system behavior.-Resolution-When you execute a VAT Return Run of Tax Type GSTR-3 for Company DEF, it will include all documents posted for a period regardless of the Status of the Items in GSTR-1 or GSTR-2.-See Also-Goods and Services Tax – India-Keywords-GSTR, VAT, India, Rejected

Title: France: Tax Payment Deferred Checkbox Is Not Automatically Selected in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-The Tax Payment Deferred checkbox is not automatically selected in a customer invoice where the Company and Tax Authority are from France but the customer account is based in other European country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Open the respective customer invoice.-Move to Items tab, Taxes subtab.-Under Tax Details section, notice that the Tax Payment Deferred checkbox is not marked.-In the present example, the Company and Tax Authority from the customer invoice are based in France.-The customer account is based in another European country, for example, Denmark. In such occasion, the tax decision tree determined tax code 530 - EU Sales - Services, Reverse Charge.-Remarks:-For the tax authority, the Authorization to Defer Tax checkbox has been marked in the Company Tax Arrangement, for the French company from the invoice.-In fine tuning activity Tax on Goods and Services - France, the Deferred Tax "True" has been maintained for respective business scenario, country/region, tax type and product type.-Cause-For customer invoices where the company is in France but the customer account is not France-based (for example, is based in Denmark), the Tax Payment Deferred checkbox will not be automatically marked.-The checkbox will only be automatically marked if both the Company/Tax Authority and customer account are based in France.-Resolution-System behaves as designed.-See Also-Help Portal: Tax Deferral for Customer Invoicing-KBA: 1834325 - Tax Payment Deferred Checkbox Is Not Selected in Customer Invoice-Keywords-Tax Payment Deferred; FR; France; authorization to defer tax; deferred tax

Title: Error "Enter Parent Reference Product ID" When Trying to Fill Parent Registered Product ID Field for a Registered Product
Content: Symptom-You are trying to fill Parent Registered Product ID field for a Registered Product but get the error message "Enter Parent Reference Product ID".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements work center.-Go to Registered Products view.-Enter the relevant product.-Click View All.-Fill the Parent Registered Product ID field in General tab.-The error message is thrown.-Cause-In order to fill the Parent Registered Product ID field, you also need to fill the Parent Reference Product field. Both fields may be hidden by default.-Resolution-You need to unhide both fields (Parent Registered Product ID and Parent Reference Product) using Adaptation Mode and then maintain cohesive information in both.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Registered Products Quick Guide-Keywords-add parenting registered products

Title: Not Possible to Nullify a Field in Material Master Data Using Mass Change
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to nullify (clear) a value entered in a field for Materials. However when trying to perform this operation using the Mass Change functionality, an error related to the cleared field appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data work center.-Enter the Materials view.-Select the materials to be updated.-Click on the button for Mass Change.-Delete the value of a field.-Click on Apply Mass Change and select either Selected or All objects.-Here an error message appears requesting the value in the field to be entered.-Cause-Currently it is not possible to nullify a value or a parameter in Material Master Data using Mass Change, Migration Tool or through Mass Data Maintenance functionalities.-Resolution-The Mass Change, Mass Data Maintenance and Migration Tool can be used to modify an existing value or enhance a blank field with a new value, however it is not possible to delete values using these tools.-Keywords-Migration, MDM, Mass Change, Update, Delete, Blank

Title: VAT Return Tax Box Descriptions Are In Dutch Language Instead of English
Content: Symptom-In a VAT Return for which the Country of Tax Authority is NL - Netherlands, the Tax Box Descriptions are in Dutch language, when the expected is English.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center. -Go to the VAT Returns view.-Open the respective VAT Return for the tax authority from NL - Netherlands.-Move to Tax Return tab.-Notice that the Tax Box Descriptions are in Dutch language when you expect English.-Cause-The English translation of own texts in Dutch are not under the standard scope of Dutch/English (NL/EN).-Resolution-To translate the texts from Dutch to English you might use the Customer Language Adaptation Tool.-See Also-Help Portal: Customer Language Adaptation Tool-Keywords-dutch, tax box description, english, translation

Title: The Entitlement is not Updated After Changing the Service Start Date
Content: Symptom-An employee's Service Start Date was changed, however, the Entitlement did not change accordingly.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work Center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the employee and click Edit button.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Select the current Time Account.-Nothing changed in Entitlement.-Cause-This could be happening because the accrual date for the Time Account is set as the start of the year, January 1st, which means that the entitlement for this year has already been granted.-Resolution-Changing the Service Start Date will result in a corresponding change to the entitlement for the upcoming year. By following the steps below, you can verify that the entitlement has been updated for the next year:-Go to Time Administration Work Center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the employee and click Edit button.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-In Time accounts panel, click Show button -> All.-You can see that the balance for the next Time Account is being displayed correctly. If you require this change to be applied for the current year, a manual adjustment can be made to the Time Account.-Keywords-Service Start Date, Balance, Entitlement, Time Account

Title: Error When Migrating Supplier Account Determination Group
Content: Symptom-Error occurs when trying to update the Account Determination Group for an employee (or a list of employees):-'Instance with the same key already exists'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Open Overview View.-Search and open Migration of Suppliers.-Click Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool.-Search for the relevant file and select it.-Click Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error occurs: 'Instance with the same key already exists'-Cause-The data you are attempting to load through the migration already exists for the employee.-Resolution-The data you are attempting to load through this migration already exists for the employee and currently it cannot be updated using this method. The migration only allows you to create a new assignment, but you cannot modify an employee's existing assignment to an account determination group.-Keywords-Migration, Account Determination Groups Payables, Migration of Suppliers

Title: How to Retrieve The Bridge Letter For Customers in Relation To ISAE 3204 Requests
Content: Symptom-You want to download the ISAE 3402 SOC 1/SOC 2 - Audit Report and a Bridge Letter for SAP Business ByDesign. -This is a legal requirement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-ISAE 3402 means International Standard for Assurance Engagements and is approached from a financial reporting perspective.-The ISAE 3402 reports are issued twice a year, the periods are the following:-HY1: 01. November - 30.April issued and available in July-HY2: 01.May - 31. October issued and available in December-In the scenario where you require a Bridge Letter for your auditors in January, you can request the Bridge Letter for November and December at the beginning of January.-Resolution-These reports are confidential documents, which may only be shared with existing SAP Cloud Customers who had live, financially-relevant systems during the last audit period.-Go to the SAP Cloud Trust Center  - Compliance Finder.-Searh with the terms - SAP Business ByDesign-Find the required report and click on it.-Click on hyperlink - "Request a copy of the SAP Business ByDesign" - You can find at the bottom of the page.-Fill in you details and send your report request.-You will receive an email in the following days with the required information via the SAP Cloud Trust Center.-Please note that you will have be asked to enter an SAP Contact Email Address. This would be your primary SAP contact address on SAP's side like your SAP Account Executive or a SAP Customer Support contact.-If you have bought the product from a partner, please contact them for this information.-See Also-SAP Cloud Trust Center: https://www.sap.com/about/trust-center/certification-compliance.html -Keywords-Audit Report, Bericht, Wirtschaftsprüfung, SOC, Bridge Letter

Title: Mexico Electronic Payment Document: Payment Assignment Value in UI Diverges From Payment Installment Number in SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-In Mexico Electronic Payment Document (CFDI Complimento ID), the Payment Assignment Value in UI (system frontend) diverges from Payment Installment Number in SDK Development Tool (SAP Cloud Applications Studio).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign 2302 Release-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Electronic Payment Documents view.-Search an open the respective CFDI Complimento ID.-Open Document List tab.-Select the row of respective Document ID and click Clearing Details tab.-Select the row of respective Clearing ID and check Clearing Item Overview tab.-Notice that Payment Assignment Value is "1".-In SAP Cloud Applications Studio, you check Payment Installment Number and notice that it shows "2".-BusinessObject: GLO_CFDI_EPAYMENTS_MX -> PaymentTaxDetails-Field Name: PaymentInstallmentNo-Cause-In the XML file, the Payment Installment Number is coming from the "Clearing Item Overview" tab in the E-payment Document, which has value "1".-BusinessObject: GLO_CFDI_EPAYMENTS_MX -> PaymentTaxDetails --> PaymentDueClearingItemDetails.-Field Name: PaymentInstallmentNo-In the SDK Development Tool (SAP Cloud Applications Studio), the Payment Installment Number is coming from the "Clearing Details" tab in the E-payment Document, which has value "2".-BusinessObject: GLO_CFDI_EPAYMENTS_MX -> PaymentTaxDetails-Field Name: PaymentInstallmentNo-Resolution-The Node: PaymentDueClearingItemDetails and Field Name: PaymentInstallmentNo is not PSM Released, that is why it is not appearing in the SDK Development Tool. Once the Field is PSM released, you will be able to check and compare the values correctly. SAP is planning to make the field PSM Released in future SAP Business ByDesign releases.-Keywords-CFDI Complimento ID; Mexico; Electronic Payment Document; PaymentInstallmentNo; SDK

Title: Purchase Order with Item Type To-Stock is Being Sent for Re-Approval
Content: Symptom-You created a Purchase Order with item type To-Stock and after a change you see that the Status has change to In Approval.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant document.-See that the document was sent for approval again.-Cause-When there is change on the Purchase Order Acknowledgement, then system would check your settings in Business Configuration activity "Automatic Accept Deviation on Purchase Order Acknowledgement". If the change meets your criteria, then system would automatically accept the deviation and update Purchase Order. If not meet the criteria, then system would request that the user manually accept or reject then change.--Once the deviation be accepted, Purchase Order values would be updated.-If in your system, Purchase Order header re-approval is in scope, and the changed Purchase Order meets the condition defined in PO approval process, then approval would be triggered.-Resolution-If you want to remove the header re-approval, please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project.-Click on Edit Project Scope.-Click on Next until step 4 - Questions.-Click on Purchasing dropdown.-Expand Purchase Request and Order Management.-Select Purchase Orders.-Under the Group Purchase Order Approvals select the scoping question "Do you want to use the header re-approval process for purchase orders?".-See that the question is In Scope, but there is a note on Overview that said: "Note: Re-approval is valid only for purchase orders with only non-stock and direct process types."-This note will be updated in a future release, because currently all Purchase Orders are submitted for re-approval at header level, so to prevent this please remove this question from scope and save the change in the Implementation Project.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Approval Process, To-Stock, Header re-approval

Title: SII VAT Return Remains as Returned
Content: Symptom-You have created a VAT return for SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) reporting, nevertheless, upon submitting the return, the Submission Status is changed to Returned after a while.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns view.-Show Reported Tax Returns Not Relevant For Payment.-Highlight the concerned return and click Submit.-The Submission Status remains as Returned.-Cause-The customer accounts for the invoices in this VAT return does not have a tax ID in the master data, hence the submission is failing.-In the web service monitoring, you may also find an error as follows: 'Codigo[4102].El XML no cumple el esquema. Falta informar campo obligatorio.: RegistroLRFacturasEmitidas'-In case you have access to the Application and User Management work center, follow below steps to check the web service call messages:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Communication Monitoring view-Show Rejected Web Service Calls-Resolution-Please, maintain the tax ID in the account master data follows:-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Requests view.-Find the concerned invoice.-Click to open the customer account master data.-In the View All mode, go to Financial Data tab.-Go to Tax Data subtab.-Maintain the tax ID for this account. After that, you may re-run/re-send the return.-As a precaution, you should always maintain tax IDs for all accounts used for invoicing, otherwise the returns may fail.-See Also-2500275 - VAT Return for SII Remains with Submission Status as In Preparation-Keywords-VAT Return, Returned, SoapFaultCode:4

Title: Multiple Rules For Overhead Distribution Run
Content: Symptom-You want to add multiple rules while creating a Over head Distribution Run, however system allows only one rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work center.-Under periodic tasks select Overhead distribution.-Select New Distribution Run.-Cause-Only one Distribution Rule is allowed for the Run.-Resolution-System supports only one active rule per run. If none of the rules are specified, then all the active rules are picked.-Keywords-Distribution rule; Distribution Run; Cost and Revenue; Multiple;

Title: Error Message 'Instance with the same key already exists' While Migrating Supplier
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate Supplier, system throws below error message:-'Instance with the same key already exists'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The cause for the issue could be, in the Payment sheet of the Migration file of Supplier, you might have maintained both Check and Bank Transfer for some of the Suppliers as Payment Method 1.-Resolution-You are allowed to maintain Payment Method 2. This is a hidden column. So you need to unhide the column D which is Payment Method 2, where you can enter the other Payment Method for the supplier.-For Example: For Supplier A, Payment Method 1 as Check and Payment Method 2 as Bank Transfer.-Keywords-supplier; migration; payment method

Title: Error Message: 'Cannot find goods and service receipt in accounting' - XI Message Restart Needed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- You are trying to post a Supplier Invoice or notice that the relevant Goods and Service Receipt is not posted. In General Ledger, you notice the following error message associated to the Supplier Invoice:-'Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order XYZ, item XYZ-1 in accounting.' (where ABC stands for the Goods and Services Receipt ID and XYZ the associated Purchase Order).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit View, select the Source Documents Subview.-Show: Unposted Source Documents.-Search for Goods and Service receipts ABC.-Supplier Invoice DEF (where DEF stands for the associated Supplier Invoice ID) is displayed.-The same error message is displayed in the Message Section: 'Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order XYZ, item XYZ-1 in accounting.'-Cause-There may be stuck XI messages associated to the Goods and Services Receipt:-From the Unposted Suppler Invoice in General Ledger:-Click the View button.-On the Supplier Invoice Screen, click View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow.-There is a Process Communication Error associated to the Goods and Services Receipt that prevents its posting. Since this document is expected, the posting of the Supplier Invoice cannot go through either.-Resolution-Connect to the backend, as follows:-Open Transaction SE38.-Search for program FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI and execute it.-Select the Operational Document Type and fill in the Document ID.-You can see that a stuck message is associated to the Goods and Service Receipt.-Click Actions and select Restart.-The message restarts and you can check in the UI that the Goods and Services Receipt is now posted.-You can now proceed with the posting of the Supplier Invoice from the Unposted Source Document by clicking on the Post button.-See Also-For more details on XI message restart from SE38, please see Internal KBA 2377340 - How to Check for XI Messages in the Backend with SE38 and FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI.-Keywords-SIV; GSR; SE38; FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI; XI; RESTART

Title: Error Message For Mandatory Account Assignment in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You create a new Supplier Invoice for a project. You enter all the information in the required fields. In the Item Details area you fill the G/L Account ABC (ABC represents the G/L Account ID),  maintain Project task as Account Assignment Type, and finally, the Project Task ID.-When you press Check, the below error message appears:-'Item X: Mandatory account assignment for account XYZ is missing: Cost Center'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Supplier Invoicing work center go to the Common Tasks and select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Add an Item.-Under Items Details section, fill Account Assignment Type as PRO - Project Task.-Then enter the Project Task ID.-Press Check.-The Error message appears: 'Item X: Mandatory account assignment for account XYZ is missing: Cost Center'.-Cause-For this G/L Account a Mandatory Account Assignment of type CC - Cost Center has been maintained whereas the Account Assignment type maintained in the invoice is Project Task.-Resolution-In order to assign the invoice expenses to a Project Task, remove the mandatory account assignment for the respective G/L Account:-In the Business Configuration work center go to your current project and find the Mandatory Account Assignment activity. (Or go to the Overview and open this activity from here).-Select the relevant Chart of Accounts.-Delete the setting which makes Cost Center type mandatory for the G/L Account in question.-Keywords-Mandatory Account Assignments. Cost Center. New Invoice. G/L Account.

Title: Tax Payment Deferred Checkbox Is Not Selected in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-The Customer Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the customer invoice) does not have the Tax Payment Deferred checkbox selected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Edit the Customer Invoice XYZ.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes sub-tab.- You can see in the Tax Details that the Tax Payment Deferred indicator is not selected, however you expect that this indicator is selected by default.-Cause-Companies that provide services in France may choose to defer tax payment until they receive payment for their services. To be entitled to do so, they have to obtain an authorization to defer tax from the tax authority. To indicate that your company was granted an authorization to defer tax, you should select the Authorization to Defer Tax option. This allows you to defer tax payments for certain services listed in a customer invoice until the payment is made.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select the Tax Authorities view.-Select the Company Tax Arrangement subview.-Select the tax authority ABC (ABC represents the identification of the tax authority for your company).-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Select the Company DEF (DEF represents the company (seller) used in the invoice XYZ).-Select the Tax Deferral tab.- Select the checkbox entitled Authorization to Defer Tax.-See Also- Help Portal: Tax Deferral for Customer Invoicing-Keywords-tax payment deferred; defer tax; customer invoice; France; tax authority; tax deferral

Title: System triggers error message "/BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA033" for failed Background Job.
Content: Symptom-When a Background Job is failed, System throws error message in the Job Log.-Error:Technical Error /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA033; Report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Background Jobs View.-In Show select  All Failed Jobs.-Select Go.-Select the Job and Select View Job Log.-A new window opens up with the Log and error message as follows:-Error:Technical Error /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA033; Report an case.-Cause-This error occurs as there is a sequence error occurred in the Runs, which can be checked as follows.-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Outbound Delivery Requests View.-In Show Select all Outbound Delivery Runs.-Select Go.-Select Application Log xxxxx-Navigate to Results tab.-Select Expand All.-Select and Expand Node Messages.-Check the sequenced error message.- Now you can further check this error message in order to find out the cause of the issue.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Error:Technical Error /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA033; Report an case, "/BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA033" for failed Background Job.

Title: Exception : CX_MBF_EXCEPTION:An exception occurred.Receiver system could not be determined.Receiver system could not be determined
Content: Symptom-You recieve an case with the following exception relating to a communication system.-Exception: CX_MBF_EXCEPTION:An exception occurred.Receiver system could not be determined.Receiver system could not be determined.-    Reproducing the Issue-- WoC: Application and User Management >> View: Web Service Message Monitoring-- Here you will find a Message with the Status 'Application Error'.-- The error text will display the error message 'CX_MBF_EXCEPTION:An exception occurred.Receiver system could not be determined.Receiver system could not be determined'-Cause-The cause for this can be due to the customer having created a new communication system with the same logic as the affected one. This means that the system cannot determine which Communication System is the correct one and will throw the exception.-Resolution-To resolve this, simply delete the second communication system or delete the Business System ID under Business Instances.-See Also-3500308910

Title: Information Required for Sales and Service Documents in CRM
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues in a sales document efficiently, we should gather the following information:-Work center and View in which the issue occurs.-Document ID of the affected Sales/Service Document.-Exact steps on how to reproduce the issue.-In case an error message occurs: Error message that occurs and the action that triggered the error message.-Changes that were performed.-What is the actual result and what is the expected result.-Is this issue a general issue or does this only occur for a specific user (in this case please provide the user).-In case the issue occurs when data is uploaded to your system please provide the respective file (migration template, excel file or SOAP request and SOAP response) as an attachment in the case. -Can this issue be reproduces and do we have the permission to reproduce this in your system in case data is changed or created (possibly in a test system). -Business Impact the issue has on your company or for your users.

Title: Exception/Dump "Unexpected Error During Backend Processing" On Saving the Changes to the Validity of the Org Unit
Content: Symptom-On changing the Valid From date to DD.MM.YYYY for the Org Unit XYZ (where XYZ represents the Organizational Unit) and saving the changes, system throws an Exception:-Unexpected error during backend processing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Go to Org Structures view-Select Edit-Select the Effective Date From DD1.MM1.YYYY1-Select Org Unit XYZ-Go to Timelines tab-Change the Valid From date to DD2.MM2.YYYY2-Select Save and Close-System loads for a while and throws an Exception-Cause-Exception occurs if the Start Date is changed on an existing Name node using multiple scripts. This is either done explicitly by changing the Name or implicitly by changing the Org Unit itself on the Timelines tab.-Resolution-You may follow the below steps:-Delete the Name in non-default script. This is achieved by setting the Effective Date to the Start Date of the Name instance and clear the Name field on the UI-Do the necessary Start Date change in the Timelines tab-Set the Effective Date to the new Start Date and re-enter the Name in the deviating script-In case you face issues while performing the above steps, open an case to SAP so that the required change in Validity for the Org Unit XYZ can be maintained via backend.-Keywords-Name instance, multiple scripts, Organizational Management, Org Structures

Title: How to Verify the Allowed Sender Domains in a Customer Tenant
Content: Symptom-You want to verify the allowed sender domains in your customer tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Following are the steps to verify the allowed sender domains maintained in your Business ByDesign system:-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Go to Overview View.-In the Search field, Search E-Mail and Fax Settings.-Select the option E-mail and Fax Settings.-Click Change Immediately or Open.-Click E-mail and Fax Settings.-The allowed sender domains will be displayed.-Note: In order to send e-mails through the system using this domains, it is required to enable a DKIM key for all the maintained domains.-See Also-Please refer to the Community link below for additional information on how to enable a DKIM key for sender domains:-Community Link: New Business ByDesign E-mail Infrastructure-Keywords-domain, e-mail settings, fax settings, customer tenant, dkim

Title: Leave does not Appear in Track My Leave Requests
Content: Symptom-A leave time entry was created for a user, however the user is not able to see the leave request in Self-Services Leave Request tracking.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Navigate to the Self-Services (or Self-Services Overview) view.-Under the section Time, click on Track My Leave Requests.-Here the user is not able to see the leave entry that was created.-Cause-There are 3 possible scenarios for the creation of a leave request, which cause different behaviors on the visibility of the request in the Self-Services page:-If the request was created by the user themselves, it will appear in the leave request tracking in Self-Services.-If the request was created by another user through the Time Administration work center and activated, it will not appear in Self-Services.-If the request was created by another user through the Time Administration work center and sent to approval (via Actions -> Submit to Approval), the leave request will also appear in the Self-Services page.-Resolution-The system works as expected-Keywords-Holiday, Vacation, Recording

Title: The value of amount on report Monitoring Invoices is different from the one on report Accounts Payable - Line Items
Content: Symptom-You find the value of <Net Amount in Company Currency> on report Monitoring Invoices is different from the value of <Credit Amount Company Currency> on report Accounts Payable - Line Items are different. You would like to why the differences and how these two values are determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Report - List View.-Open report Monitoring Invoices.-Enable the key figure Net Amount in Company Currency, and enter invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the supplier invoice ID). -Display Currency - Conversion Date as Today.-You find the value here is A (A represents the value of Net Amount in Company Currency).-Go to Payables Work Center.-Go to Report - List View.-Open report Accounts Payable - Line Items.-Enter Source Document ID XYZ, and Display Currency - Conversion Date as Today.-Check the value of Credit Amount Company Currency, it is B (B represents the value of Credit Amount Company Currency).-You would like to know why A is different from B.-Cause-You have manually determianed the expected exchange rate on invoice XYZ.-You can open the invoice and navigate to Exchange Rates Sub tab under General tab, to verify the rate you manually determianed.-B is calcualted from this exchange rate you manually determianed.-Regarding how A is calculated, Please refer to KBA 3331031 for more details.-Resolution-This is the current system design of report displaying.-See Also-KBA 3331031 - How the value of field Net Amount in Company Currency on report Monitoring Invoices is generated-Keywords-Monitoring Invoices, Accounts Payable - Line Items, Net Amount in Company Currency, Credit Amount Company Currency, Exchange Rate

Title: Field Script is not Available in the Migration of Customers
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer noticed that the field Script is missing in the Migration of Customers or any other Business Partner Migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2302 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center and then Overview view.-Search for the activity Migration of Customers and open it.-Click Migrate customers using the migration tool.-Click You Can Also > Download Migration Template.-Open the template and you will see that the field is not available.-Cause-Currently the migration of the Script dependent data for Customers and other Business Partners BOs is not supported.-Resolution-However, the development team can upload such data from the backend.-In case the customer needs to migrate script specific data, please send the attached excel file to the customer and then send the incident to development team responsible for the BO in order to perform such upload.-See Also-1900106 - Multiple Script(Kanji and Katakana) support for names and Address in Japanese-Keywords-Migration of Customers, Migration of Suppliers, Script, Field, Missing, Not Available, Unable, Migration Tool.

Title: Message: 'No object found for selection' In a GR/IR Clearing Run.
Content: Symptom-You have performed a GR/IR clearing run with a range of Purchasing Documents, and the run finished without errors. When you check the log result of the performed run you see that there is no executions, postings and you can see the following message in Messages tab: 'No object found for selection'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to GR/IR Clearing subview.-Select All GR/IR Clearing runs.-Search for Run ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Run ID). -Click "Log Result". -Go to Messages tab. -You will see the following information:-'No object found for selection'-Cause-One possible reason for this type of behavior is that in Data selection Purchase documents were provided with an Alphanumeric From value DEF (DEF represents the alphanumeric value) and Numeric To value 123 (123 represents the numeric value).-As per system design, it is not able to filter data between alphanumeric and numeric values. The same applies to alphabetic values.-Resolution-In this case you need to run the GR/IR Clearing run without combining alphanumeric and numeric values.  -One suggestion is create 2 runs, one with numeric From and To value and the other one with Alphanumeric from and To values.-Keywords-Inventory Valuation; GR/IR Clearing run; Purchase Document; GR/IR Clearing

Title: Outgoing Check is Displaying Wrong Default Language in the Preview Template
Content: Symptom-You have an outgoing check that is defaulted to English language, but the preferred language is configured to French, in the supplier master data. Now, when you preview the check the file is displayed in English.-In this scenario, we will use English and French languages as an example, but the same can be applied to other languages as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view. -Select All Payments. -Search for Document ID DEF (DEF represents the document ID). -Click Edit button. -Click You Can Also button -> Edit Output Settings for Check. -Here we can see that the Language as default is English but you expect French. -Cause-The system gives preference to house bank communication language (if it is defined) over supplier communication language.-Resolution-Here in this scenario house bank XYZ (XYZ represents the My Bank ID) has communication language as EN (English) hence the form is shown in English. To change this, please follow the steps below:-Go to Liquidity Management work center. -Go to Master Data view -> My Banks subview. -Search for My Bank ID XYZ and click Edit button -> General.-Go to Addresses Tab.-Change the communication language from English to French.-Save the changes.-Now preview the form and it should display in French language.-Keywords-Output Settings for Check; Language; Outgoing check

Title: Error Message When Assigning Payment File Structure to Payment Medium Format: Value in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree
Content: Symptom-You want to assign a payment file structure to a payment medium format in the Outgoing Bank Transfers fine tuning activity but you receive an error message while saving:-"Value XYZ in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree." (XYZ represents the payment file structure ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In the  Business Configuration work center access the Outgoing Bank Transfers fine tuning activity. -Press Edit assignment of payment file structures to the payment medium formats.-Press Add Row.-Enter the concerned payment medium format, character set and file structure ID-Press Save. -The error message "Value XYZ in setting DMEE Configuration must also be entered in setting Data Medium Exchange Engine Mapping Tree" appears.-Cause-The entered File Structure ID entered is incorrect, it does not exist among the Payment File Structures in the system.-Very likely you are assigning a customized file structure ID.  There might be a typo while assigning it to a Payment Medium Format (You might have entered ZCH_DTAA instead of ZCH_DTA).-Resolution-Please check and correct the File Structure ID entered. Once you enter the correct file structure you'll be able to save the assignment successfully.*-*However, if you have verified that the file structure ID is correct but the error still appears it is possible that the payment medium format mapping is not updated. In this case send an case to Product Support to request the payment medium format update and to connect the new file structure to the payment medium format.-Keywords-Payment File Structure. DMEE. Outgoing Bank Transfer. Implementation Project.

Title: '|Technical Response: : code : PERIOD_KEY_INVALID,message : Invalid period key HTTP code: 400' Error in VAT Return for UK
Content: Symptom-The submission of VAT Return for UK has failed with the error message:-'|Technical Response: : code : PERIOD_KEY_INVALID,message : Invalid period key HTTP code: 400'-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Open the respective VAT Return.-Click View All.-Under Submission Information section, notice the error:-'|Technical Response: : code : PERIOD_KEY_INVALID,message : Invalid period key HTTP code: 400'-Cause-The issue is happening as 2 open period keys are being received from HMRC (Her Majesty's Revenue and Customs, the tax authority of the UK government).-Resolution-Please get in touch with HMRC to check why 2 open period keys and are being sent to SAP Business ByDesign as a response back for VAT obligation API ( get period key ).-In an ideal setting, only one period key with status 'O' is received. In this case, 2 period keys were retrieved, system by default tried to use one of them as the period key and HMRC rejected the VAT submission citing the reason "INVALID_PERIOD_KEY".-In case you are not able to sort out the issue with HMRC, please report an incident to SAP Support with your permission to us to submit the VAT Return via backend system through debugging.-Keywords-VAT return; UK; MTD; HMRC; period key; period keys

Title: Error in Fixed Assets Values reports
Content: Symptom-When you try to run any report based on the data source Fixed Assets Values, such as: Schedule of Fixed Assets or Schedule of Fixed Assets - Australia report, it takes a few minutes to load the data and eventually you might come across the following dump error message which prevents the diaplay of the data:-Report cannot be opened; report an case.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Click on List in the sub view Reports.-Click on the Fixed Assets Values report (e.g. Schedule of Fixed Assets Australia).-In the selection parameters, provide all the mandatory fields.-Click on Go.-Cause-When the report runs for complete Fiscal year, it tries to render data relevant for all the Fixed Assets. So, the message Report Cannot Be Opened comes up because of the large amount of Fixed Assets in the system.-Resolution-Unfortunately at the moment we do not have a solution for the issue that occurs when the default selection is used. As a workaround you can set a range of Fixed Asset ID's in the selection parameter of report in order to fetch less transactional data.-You can use the restriction on Fixed Asset Class on the selection screen to reduce the amount of data. For example by using the below ranges:-Range 1 : ( 1 - 7000)-Range 2 : ( 7001 - 12000 )-Range 3 : ( 12001 - 16000 )-Range 4 : ( 16001 - 19000 )-If the full report data is required, you can download each range result via excel and put it together.- Keywords
