Title: Purchase Order with status In Approval is displayed in Inbound Logistics - Purchase Orders view
Content: Symptom-You are creating a New Supplier Delivery Notification and notice that a Purchase Order that it is still In Approval is being displayed in this screen as well, since the document is not confirmed yet you do not understand why this is happening.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Filter for All Purchase Orders by Selection.-Click to execute the query.-See that Purchase Order ABC is available to create a New Supplier Delivery Notification and that the status is Ordered. (ABC stands for the Purchase Order ID).-Navigate to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC.-See that document status is In Approval, but item status is Sent (or Acknowledgment Received).-Cause-This is a normal behavior, the system will displayed the Purchase Order because the document was already approved once.-When a Purchase Order is created (and approved if necessary) the system creates a snapshot of the document and send to the logistics area. This is why if you click on the Purchase Order ID in the screen Inbound Logistics - Purchase Order the document displayed will be Purchase Order Logistics Details: ABC and not only Purchase Order: ABC.-If you sent the document that was already ordered to approval again, the system will not delete this snapshot, but will updated (if necessary) when the approval is done. However if you try to create a New Supplier Delivery Notification for a document that is In Approval the system will displayed the error message: Changes not permitted; purchase order ABC is in approval.-Same error message will appear if you try to click on Post Goods Receipts or Post Goods Receipts as Planned button.-Resolution-To correct this and be able to create the Deliveries documents, please approve the Purchase Order.-Keywords-Purchase Order, New Supplier Delivery Notification, In Approval

Title: Error "File validation failed. Create an case" During Fixed Assets Migration
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate Fixed Assets, system throws below error message during migration step "a - Validate File":-"File validation failed. Create an case"-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview view.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link.-Select the respective Migration Unit.-Select Process File for the respective Migration File-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you might have maintained the incorrect date format for the dates maintained in the template.-Resolution-Try to correct the date format and repeat the validation again.-Keywords- fixed assets migration

Title: Business Configuration Inconsistencies Due to Missing Cost Center Types
Content: Symptom-The by SAP delivered Cost Center Types:-10 Production-20 Sales-30 Administration-40 Management-50 Research & Develop.-are the basis for many country-specific Accounting Content also provided by SAP, e.g. Functional Area Determination for the country specific Accounting Principles etc.-Whenever these cost center type entries are deleted in a customer system, this can lead to issues when new country content gets delivered as for a pre-localized country or a new country is scoped in the system.-Hence, even though these by SAP delivered Cost Center Types (10 to 50) can be removed in the BC activity Cost Center Types, it is not recommended to do so.-Reproducing the Issue-When trying to access the Business Configuration, the error Some technical issues and inconsistencies have been found in your solution profile. Please find additional information below.is shown.-In the detailed information the following error details (all or just a few of them) are provided:-Foreign key error in node A1S_FIN_FUNCADETFIAC_FDCOSTCTR; field COSTCENTRETYPE; Application component: AP-ACC-Value 10 in setting A1S_FIN_FUNCADETFIAC_FDCOSTCTR must also be entered in setting A1S_FIN_CCTYPES_/MOM/C_CCTYPE-Value 20 in setting A1S_FIN_FUNCADETFIAC_FDCOSTCTR must also be entered in setting A1S_FIN_CCTYPES_/MOM/C_CCTYPE-Value 30 in setting A1S_FIN_FUNCADETFIAC_FDCOSTCTR must also be entered in setting A1S_FIN_CCTYPES_/MOM/C_CCTYPE-Value 40 in setting A1S_FIN_FUNCADETFIAC_FDCOSTCTR must also be entered in setting A1S_FIN_CCTYPES_/MOM/C_CCTYPE-Value 50 in setting A1S_FIN_FUNCADETFIAC_FDCOSTCTR must also be entered in setting A1S_FIN_CCTYPES_/MOM/C_CCTYPE-  Cause-The delivered Cost Center Types 10 to 50 are part of every country-specific Accounting Content provided by SAP. Removing them or just part of them will cause foreign key issues whenever new accounting content gets provided or activated for the system, e.g. when scoping a new country.-Resolution-Do not remove these delivered Cost Center Types 10 to 50. In case you do not want them to be used, rename them with e.g. "DO NOT USE" or similar so that colleagues know that they shall not be used within your company and then add your own Cost Center Types and adapt Accounting Content etc according to your wishes.-  In case these Cost Center Types are already deleted and you can still access the Business Configuration:-Open the BC activity Cost Center Types and there use the button Restore Default:-You can select explicitly which configuration entries you want to have restored.-In case these Cost Center Types are already deleted and you cannot access the Business Configuration anymore yourself:-Please contact the Cloud Support via case and provide us also the approval to restore the missing default values. The development support team will then restore them, and once the inconsistencies are solved you can again access the Business Configuration and name these values according to your wishes.-

Title: Validation for Migration of Business Partner is Stuck at 1%
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate the Business Partner Relationships, but the Validation shows 1% progress for a long time and does not process further.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Business Partner-Select Migrate business partner relationships using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-Validation is still in progress and stuck at 1%-Cause-The locking issue may be due to the Add-on/ PDI solution that either on Modify or on Save, accesses the Customer data and requires locking the instances of Customers involved in the relationship. Therefore, you get some lock entries per relationship on the lock server.-For the relationship instance, the Customers involved and internal entries are required to prevent duplicates. This can lead to an overflow on the lock server and therefore, an issue.-Further, if you process/ create relationships that involve the same Customer in different sessions, locking problems can occur.-Resolution-If the issue is due to the Add-on/ PDI solution, you may seek assistance from your Implementation Partner who developed the Add-on/ PDI solution. Otherwise, report an case to SAP for further analysis.-Keywords-Business Partner Relationships, Migration of Business Partner, Business Partner, Validation stuck at 1%

Title: Changing the interval of the Outlook Addon auto sync
Content: Symptom-You recieve an case from a customer asking if the interval of the Auto Sync in the Outlook Addon can be changed.-Resolution-The Sync is by default set to occur every 2 minutes. Some customers may wish to increase the duration between synchorisations. This is possible by updating the registry of the Addon.-To do this, carry out the following steps:-- Copy the following script into notepad or wordpad. This can also be found in attachments:-Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00-[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\SAP\Business ByDesign FrontEnd\CD\ClientConfig\Trace]-"NotificationPollingInterval"="120000"-  - For NotificationPollingInterval, replace 120000 with 300000. This signifies 5 minutes, the longest interval you can set here.-- Following this, save the file to desktop but change the file extension from ".txt" to ".reg", then double click the file and accept the following changes.-- Doing this will update the Outlook Addon with the new value.-See Also-3500308266

Title: How to find the Selection criteria for a Key Figure in a report
Content: Symptom- You would like to know the Characteristic Selection criteria for a Key Figure in a report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For example we are selecting the report Sales Quote Funnel & Success Rate-Go to Business Analytics - Design Reports-Select Sales Quote Funnel & Success Rate-Click here to start the Report-Add the below fields the below Column Fields-Success Rate - Number of Accepted Quote Items (%)-Success Rate - Net Value of Accepted Quote Items (%)-You would like to know how Success Rate - Number of Accepted Quote Items (%) and Success Rate - Net Value of Accepted Quote Items (%) calculated.-Resolution-You can check the Selection criteria as below.-Go to Business Analytics - Design Reports-Select Sales Quote Funnel & Success Rate-Click on Documentation -Select the Object Name link below Used Key Figures-Under Components select the link Success Rate - Number of Accepted Quote Items (%)-Under Uses Component select the link Number of Accepted Quote Items-Under Restrictions system shows the selection criteria

Title: Information required for performance issues in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Checking with LOD-CRM-PRF Support Engineer Eduardo De Zotti whether this KBA remains valid***-This KBA informs what information is required by SAP Support to analyze a performance issue in SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Business ByDesign will be referred to as ByD in this KBA.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To process and analyze issues efficiently, SAP Support need the following information:-Is the internet connection used dedicated only to ByD or non-ByD users are also using same internet connection?-How many online users are generally present during office hours for the connection used for ByD? It may be possible if users are using services like youtube, downloading etc. which some time slows down the internet connection.-Access the tool https://cct.sde.cloud.sap/ for network bandwidth and latency tests. The following activities can be performed through the tool:-Easy Check: An automated test which checks your bandwidth and latency for a while and collects the results/statistics in an e-mail. You need to wait for < 2 minutes. You can update the case with this information.-Start Test: This check is to monitor the latency and download speed to and from SAP data centers.-Continuous Latency Test: This test is to continuously measure latency to SAP data centers. We recommend to do continuous latency tests for minimum 90 seconds to maximum 15 minutes-Send Results: You can send the results of the check through Send Results. The results and tests comparison open in an e-mail. You can update the case with this information.-Is performance slow in a particular application area (for example, CRM, SRM, HCM etc.)? Is the system slow during a specific time frame in a day or week?-Did you encounter a dump (system crash) when performing any of the steps above?-Does the issue occur with one user, some users or all the users?-Open the ByDesign system in your preferred browser without Add-ons and check if the system performance is better in your browser without Add-ons.-Does the issue occur in both Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Mozilla Firefox browsers?-Provide HTTP trace of the actions you have performed on the user interface. KBA '1431064 - How to take a HttpWatch trace in IE and Chrome' explains how to take the HTTP trace.-NOTE:-1) Avoid generic statements that the entire system performance is affected, since the analysis on the issue reported is completely dependent on the accuracy of the information provided.-2) Create a case for SAP Support from the affected system screen whenever possible.-Keywords-Performance, ByD, HTTP Trace

Title: When Creating a New Service Request Incident Category Values are not Populated.
Content: Symptom-When Creating a New Service Request case Category Values are not Populated When F4 Value Help is Pressed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Desk Work Center ;-Go to Common tasks and select new service request;-Enter a service category value under categorization section.-Select an case category value.- You will see the  message " No records found".-Cause-The category type selected is not  case type-Resolution-You can verify the following steps below:-Go to Service Entitlements Work Center ;-Go to the view Service Categories;-Select an service category and edit .-Click in the button View All-Go to Catalog Structure tab-In Category Name column click and Expand Service Category  values-On right hand side you can see the category type  after select any category ID-If the category type selected is not of case type, no values will be displayed in case Category field.-

Title: You Cannot Edit a Trip Type, Error Message: An error occured, try resuming your work, is raised
Content: Symptom-You try to edit the Trip Type of one of your Expense Report, however, the system keeps loading and raises an error message: An error occured,try resuming your work. If you still face issues open an case.-This issue happens in both Silverlight and HTML5.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Auditing work center-Go to the Expense Reports tab-Show All and Search for Expense Report XYZ (where XYZ stands for the Expense Report ID)-Click on the hyperlink on the ID-Navigate to the section Expense Report-In Expense Report Details open the scroll down menu for Trip Type-Change the current value to the one desired-The system keeps loading and error message An error occured, try resuming your work. If you still face issues open an case. is raised-Cause-You may be facing performance issues because one of your Partner Solution is not enabled correctly and triggers too many update requests on Business Object: ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT Node: RECEIPT-Resolution-You need to check that any Partner Solution that you have on Business Object: ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT Node: RECEIPT is optimised and that Event-AfterModify is not triggered too many times.-You may also want to mass-enable your scripts to avoid too many update requests-See Also-Check that updates are not stuck on Class CL_PDI_SFW_AS_ACCESS==========CP->GET_ASSOCIATIONS.

Title: Bank Directories Simulation Keep Showing 25% Progress for Long Time
Content: Symptom-When you are migrating Bank Directories, Import Simulation keeps showing 25% progress even after an hour or a day-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity for Bank Directories-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-The cause for the issue could be,-The data of Bank Directories in template lead to endless loop.-ROOT may not be entered in the template since the node ROOT will be created by the system automatically.-Bank Directory IDs should be created as parent itself on the first level, that means the field Parent Bank Directory ID must be initial and may not be filled with its own Bank Directory ID. For Example, your root hierarchy is Bank Directory ID 1 then the information in the Template should be filled as Bank Directory ID: 1 and Parent Bank Directory ID should left empty.-If you are creating a Bank Directory A which is the child of Root then do not enter any value in the Parent Bank Directory ID.-If you are creating a Bank Directory X which is a child of another Bank Directory Y then make sure that Bank Directory Y is already entered in the Template.-if you are creating a Bank Directory X which is a child of another Bank Directory Y then that ID Y should be maintained in the field Parent Bank Directory ID.-Resolution-Please report an case to SAP with your approval to cancel the Stuck Bank Directories migration.-Then you can correct the data in the Migration Template for Bank Directories as above and Execute the Migration.

Title: Error Appears While Creating New Manual Project Invoice Request for Project XYZ
Content: Symptom-System shows an error message while creating new Manual Project Invoice Request for project ID XYZ.-Error: The action NOTIFY_OF_CPIRIT_ASSGT is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Invoice Preparation view.-Select Not Invoiced Time and Expenses.-Select the relevant Project ID XYZ.-Select New -> Manual Project Invoice Request.-Fill the relevant details and go to step 5 - Refine Invoice Items.-Error appears.-Cause-Quantity conversions are not been maintained in the Material or Service master data.-For example: In the material/service master you have maintained the Sales unit of measure as h - Hour(s) & Purchasing unit of measure is maintained as wday - Working day(s). So in the General tab, under Quantity Conversions you have not maintained any quantity conversions between these two UoMs.-Resolution-You have to maintain the quantity conversions between these two unit measurements which are used in Sales & Purchasing.

Title: Reports Accounts Receivable - Open Items and Aging List for Receivables Show Different Amounts With Same Currency and Conversion Date
Content: Symptom-While comparing reports Accounts Receivable - Open Items and Aging List for Receivables for the same day e.g. 31.01.2018, the amounts are not equal when converting to Company Currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find Aging List for Receivables report.-Select:-Customer ABC.-Cut Off Date 31.01.2018.-Display Currency XYZ.-Display Currency 31.01.2018.-Source Document ID XXX shows amount 110 in Currency XYZ.-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find Accounts Receivable - Open Items report.-Select:-Customer ABC.-Key Date 31.01.2018.-Source Document ID XXX shows amount of 120 in Currency XYZ (considering the Foreign Currency Remeasurement of Receivables amount as well).-Codes used as example IDs:-Customer ID ABC.-Document ID XXX.-Currency XYZ.-Cause-This is the expected scenario.-The different amount that shows when comparing both reports is due to the different Rate Types used by the system on the Foreign Currency Remeasurement.-The amount in Accounts Receivable - Open Items shows the currency conversion from the transaction itself, the same can be checked in the Journal Entry.-The amount in Aging List for Receivables will change according to the selected Conversion Date.-Considering that the Exchange Rate was 1.3050 (for example) on the date of the Document, this is the Exchange Rate used in the report.-Resolution-However, due to the configuration done for the Foreign Currency Remeasurement of Receivables to use another Rate Type the two reports will show different amounts. Accounts Receivable - Open Items will show the Amount using Exchange Rate from Foreign Currency Remeasurement of Receivables while Aging List for Receivables will convert the Amount with the Default Exchange Rate from the selected Conversion Date.-To check this configuration, follow below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Payables and Receivables activity.-Click Edit foreign currency remeasurement methods.-Here it shows that the Rate Type DEF was selected for Method GHI.-Click Close.-Click Assign remeasurement method to accounting principle.-Here it shows that Accounting Principle JKL is assigned to Method GHI, with Rate Type DEF.-Codes used as example:-Rate Type DEF.-Method GHI.-Accounting Principle JKL.-Keywords-Exchange Rate, Reports, Accounts Receivable - Open Items, Aging List for Receivables, difference, Rate Type-reports,aging list for receivables,difference,rate type,accounts receivable - open items,exchange rate

Title: Cannot complete or delete decommissioning cockpit projects
Content: Symptom-While trying to delete or set status complete to a docommissiong cockpit project, you got below error even though no objects found in blocklist:- "Please remove all objects from Blocklist first"-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Cause-Code error-Resolution-First please check whether below note corrections are applicable to your solution manager system:--3088019 - Object List Blocklist Monitoring-3218537 - Object Still Exists in BLM error-If after implemented above notes issue persists, please try following steps:-1. Run the report AGS_SBLM_CHECK_AND_CLEAN in Solution Manager and select the option “Cleanup BLM for Existing DECOM Projects” and then select the relevant project you want to delete.-2. You can find the BLM Client ID and the related Statistical system in the field on the selection screen.-3. Now logon to the statistical system, open transaction SBLM_INTERNAL and select the related Blocklist Monitor Client.-4. Then click on Manage and remove all objects, that are in the list (e.g. Select all and click on Delete icon). Do not forget to activate the list.-5. Now go back to Solution Manager and run the report AGS_SBLM_CHECK_AND_CLEAN with the selections as in step 1.

Title: Deleting an Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You create an Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher by mistake and would like to delete it.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the General Ledger work centre.-2. Click on Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers under the Journal Entries subview.-3. Click on New and then IC Journal Entry Voucher.-4. Fill in all the required details and click on Post or Save.-Cause-Unlike Intra-Company Journal Entry Vouchers it is not possible to delete or void unposted Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers.-Resolution-If the Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher was already posted to accounting (Post button was used), the document can be reversed without any necessary action from support.-If the Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher was not yet posted (Save button was used), please create an case to support and request the deletion of the document.-Keywords

Title: What's New "New Password Security Policy for Business Users"
Content: Symptom-In this document explains SAP Password Security Policy for Business Users and some of the important related KBA's for the Security Policy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-What's New-"A new password security policy called S_BUSINESS_USER_V2 is now available in SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer, and the existing password security policy S_BUSINESS_USER is now deprecated. If you have set the S_BUSINESS_USER policy as the default, then after the upgrade the new S_BUSINESS_USER_V2 policy will be set as the default. However, if you have set any other password security policy as the default, the same setting will remain in the system."-The following are the improvements in the new password security policy as compared to the existing S_BUSINESS_USER policy.-Attribute-S_BUSINESS_USER-S_BUSINESS_USER_V2-Minimum number of characters-8-15-Password History-5-15-Is Default-Changed to No-Yes-Q & A:-1. Does this improvement affect existing Users?-Ans: This change will not affect existing users. If a user has password policy S_BUSINESS_USER, the password rules are still bound by the S_BUSINESS_USER policy. Customer can change the password policy assigned to a business user anytime from the Business User Edit Attributes screen.-2. For whom it will be impacted and How?-Ans: If a password policy is default, it means that any new employee hired in the system (or in other words, new business users created in the system), will have this particular password policy. In this case, previous default password policy is 'S_BUSINESS_USER'. Now if default password policy is set to 'S_BUSINESS_USER_V2', this does not affect the users having either of the password policies, it only means that for any new business users created in the system, the password policy 'S_BUSINESS_USER_V2' will be assigned as default.-3. My default security is not S_BUSINESS_USER but S_BUSINESS_USER_WITHOUT_PASSWORD. What would be the risk if I do not change those users (for integration) security policies to S_BUSINESS_USER_V2? Would the basic authentication loses its functionality?-S_BUSINESS_USER_V2 provides a much more stricter policy for passwords of Business User. That's where our recommendation is to move to new security policy. However, if there is no change done then system will continue to work.-4. When would be the full deprecation of S_BUSINESS_USER ?-As of now full deprecation of S_Business_user is not planned.. We will give at least one release notice in advance before stopping the support-5. Will there be any impact, If a user overwrite a security policy?-It is completley based on the user decision and business need. User can assign the desired password policy to a user anytime from Application and User Management -> Business Users -> Edit -> Attributes screen.-See Also-Important KBA's:-1881710 - Unable to change the parameters for SAP delivered security policy.-2949663 - Activate SHA256 Security Policy-2951799 - How To Export Security Policy and Business User Details-2462998 - How-to update the security policy of multiple business user-2820544 - All Users Able To Log Via SSO Regardless Security Policy-2608632 - Frequently Asked Questions on Identity and Access Management-2595989 - How to Enable Only SSO Login for Business Users-Help Portal Link:-SAP Business ByDesign What's New: New Password Security Policy for Business Users-SAP Cloud for Customer What's New: New Password Security Policy for Business Users-Security Policy Qucik Guide-Keywords-What's New, Security Policy, S_BUSINESS_USER_V2, Password Policy, Password Security Policy, IAM, Identity and Access Management, Business User, Password.

Title: Can't Find Leave Request Approval Task in Managing My Area
Content: Symptom-You are aware that an employee has submitted a leave request for approval, but the Managing My Area work center shows no tasks to be approved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Requester goes to the Home Work Center.-Go to the Self Services List View.-Go to the New Leave Request and confirm.-Approver goes to the Managing My Area Work Center and notices there is no Approval Task seen in the screen.-Cause-a. You need to be sure that the approver is the approval manager for the requester in the reporting line structure and check if the Leave Request Task question is scoped in the system.-b. Check if Manager is correctly assigned with the Access Rights for Time Approvals.-Resolution-a. To enable the Leave Request Task Question, you need to follow below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects.-Select the First Implementation project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Expand the Human Resources scoping element, then Time Administration.-Select the Approval option.-Enable scoping question "Would you like to send an explicit approval task for a leave request to the manager?"-Click Next to navigate to step 5 - Review.-Click Finish.-b. To assign Access Rights for Leave Approval, follow below steps:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Select Business User view-Search and Edit required Manager Access Rights-Go to Workcenter and view Assignment tab-Select Find and search MMA_TIMEADMINISTRATION and assign it to this user-  Keywords-Approval, Leave Request, Request, Managing My Area, MMA_TIMEADMINISTRATION

Title: A Technical Error Occurred: APDL_VAL 147. Report An Incident
Content: Symptom-When you create a New Parts Return Notification, system throws error message: A technical error occurred: APDL_VAL 147. Report an case.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to the Common Tasks View and choose New Parts Return Notification Subview.-New Window Opens up, now when you enter Delivery Notification ID.-System throws above error message.-Cause-You have not scoped Inbound Returns Handling in Inbound Logistics under Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics scoping element which enables you to define the process of receiving customer returns, repair returns and spare parts into a warehouse.-Resolution-Follow below mentioned steps in order to maintain Returns Handling option in Business Configuration work center:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and choose Edit Project Scope button.-In the guided activity, select Next option and naviagte to the step 3: Scoping.-Under Scoping Element, select and expand the Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics and then expand the Inbound Logistics element.-Here Mark the CheckBox for Inbound Returns Handling.-Choose Next button and navigate to guided activity,step4:Review Questions.-Here again expand the Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics scoping element and then expand the Inbound Logistics element.-Select the Returns Handling scoping element.-On the right side of the screen,it displays several questions for Returns Handling, here you can select the relevant Logistics Models according to your requirement.-Then choose the Next button and Finish the activity.

Title: Default Approver Determination for Expense Reports from Managers - Self- Approval is Not Allowed
Content: Symptom-In your system you work with an approval process for expense reports based on the Default Approval Process for Expense Reports. According to this process, employees who are the responsible manager, cost center manager or project responsible can approve their own expense reports.-In your system self-approval is not allowed. -You, as employee who is either the responsible manager, cost center manager or project responsible create an expense report and receive an approval task for it. However, you cannot approve your own expense report due to the error message "Self-approval not allowed".-You wish the cost center /project manager's line manager to receive the approval task. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To set up the approval process for expense reports: -In the Application and User Management go to the Approval Processes view.-Find the process for Expense Reports. -Press View. -In the Process Steps the Process Step 1-Default is defined with Work Distribution set to Approver of Highest Cost.-Under Conditions at least one condition appears for group 1: "Expense Report Approval Configuration Equal to Yes". -Self-Approval is not allowed in the system: -Access the Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management fine-tune task in the Business Configuration work center. -Choose the Edit self-approval and self-audit settings link. -Here, the Allow Self-Approval indicator is not selected for any country/region version. Or, there is no entry at all in the table. Or, the fine-tune activity might not even added to the project. Therefore, self-approval of expense reports is not allowed. -Log in with business user XYZ, which is defined as manager of cost center ABC (XYZ is the name/ID of the managing employee; ABC is the name/ID of the managing cost center). -Find the New Expense Report activity, for example in the Travel and Expense work center.-Maintain all the mandatory data. -Press Finish. Expense report XXX is created (XXX is the expense report ID). -An info message appears: ""Expense Report XXX saved and sent to XYZ for approval". -Go to the Approvals view of the Managing my Area work center. -Find the approval task for expense report XXX. -Press Approve. -An error message appears: "Self-approval is not allowed." You now wonder how this expense report shall be approved.-Cause-As the work distribution of the approval process is set to Approver of Highest Cost, the manager themself, here user XYZ, receive the approval task. But they cannot approve the task as self-approval is not allowed.-Resolution-You could maintain an alternative approver for expense reports:-In the Application and User Management go to the Employee work distribution view. -Select 'Alternative Approver for Expense Reports' and press Edit.-Add a rule and define the respective employee as alternative approver. -The alternative approver now receives an approval task for each expense report created for the company defined.-If you do not wish for the alternative user to receive approval task for every expense report but instead require the cost center/project manager's line manager to receive an approval task only when they create expense reports you can request Support to change the approval process to one of the following options:-System standard: the approver is cost center manager, project manager or sales order responsible depending on the major cost object (cost assignment of receipt items) of expense report;-Reporting line manager: the approver is claimer's reporting line manager no matter how the cost is allocated;-Standard with exception for cost center managers: approver determination is like standard, but if the employee of the expense report is also the cost center manager of the cost center covering the largest part of the expenses, then the line manager of the cost center manager is the approver instead;-Standard with exception for project managers: approver determination is like standard, but if the employee of the expense report is also the project manager of the project covering the largest part of the expenses, then the line manager of the project manager is the approver instead;-Standard with exception for both cost center and project managers: this is the combination of item 3 & 4. Neither cost center managers nor project managers can self-approve expense reports claimed by themselves. Their line managers have to approve the expense report instead.-Note: By default, the first option is active in all systems. If you need this system behavior to be changed, create an case. Explicitly specifywhich approval mechanism you'd like to use and provide SAP the permission to make this change through backend modification.-See Also-Review and Approval of Expense Reports-Keywords-approve expense report, manager expense report, line manager, approval process

Title: Error Message 'Pay Group Assignment validity must match Work Agreement validity' While Removing the Payroll Group
Content: Symptom-When you try to remove a Payroll Group Assignment of a particular Employee, system throws below error messages:-Removal of payroll group not allowed-Pay Group Assignment validity must match Work Agreement validity-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for Employee ID and Select Edit button.-Go to tab Employment and sub tab Payroll Group Assignment.-Select a Payroll Group and select Remove button.-Cause-There are couple of causes that may lead to this error message, they are-Cause 1:-The reason that you are not able to remove the Payroll Group for the Employee is that the Employee is already used in the Payroll Run and Data File Created was also created.--This can be verified as follows,--1. Go to Payroll Processing work center.-2. Select Payroll Run view.-3. Select the link of the Payroll Group under Payroll Group.-4. Go to Employee Data tab and All Employees sub tab.-5. Here, the employee is already assigned.--Hence, it is not possible to remove the Payroll group.-Cause 2:-The reason for this is that there is a check to ensure that the latest pay group assignment end date cannot be less than work agreement end date. Hence when the pay group XYZ is deleted the end date of latest pay group becomes a past date which is less than the end date of this employee's work agreement. Thus causing this error message.-Resolution-To overcome the issue, Delete both payroll group rows in the Personnel File of the employee and assign the employee to the correct payroll group again with the validity equal to the validity of the Work Agreement.-In case, if the payroll snapshot has been started for payroll group XYZ, then first remove the employee from the payroll snapshot. This should be performed from SAP side, hence report an case for this removal and also confirm whether this Payroll Group has already been sent to payroll(DATEV) or not.-

Title: How to Make More Rows Visible in Incidents at the same time
Content: Symptom-You can only see a small number of cases at the same time in your cases view.-Environment-HTML5 UI-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Administrator work center (HTML5 UI) and go to the General Settings facet > cases OR go to the Application and User Management work center (Silverlight UI)> cases.-2. You can see only a few cases at the same time.-Cause-Your system settings describe how many cases are displayed.-Resolution-For HTML5:-1. Click on Adapt > Edit Master Layout.-2. Hover over the section where the cases are displayed (until you have the blue frame highlighting the section as seen below).-3. Click the Change Properties icon (second from the right)-4. Select the number of rows you wish to have displayed.-  For Silverlight [this is the same for SAP Business By Design]:-1. Click on Adapt > Edit Master Layout.-2. Click on Adapt > Edit Screen.-3. Select case in Sections column.-4. Click Display Settings.-5. Select the number of visible rows you would like to see at the same time.

Title: Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create an Incident" While Migrating Personnel Administration Data
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Personnel Administration Data, system throws the below error message:-File validation failed. Create an case-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Employee Data.-Select Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File.-Cause-There could be many reasons that lead to this issue and one of the causes could be the length of the Employee IDs. The system expects a length of X characters.-You can check the allowed Number Range for Employees using the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Number Ranges for Employees and Service Agents-Resolution-Maintain the correct Employee IDs in the migration file and proceed with the migration activity.

Title: Information required by SAP when submitting cases related to performance for SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-In order for SAP to be able to process and analyse your issue efficiently, please provide the following information:-Are all the screens and user interactions in the C4C system slow or are you experiencing the performance issue only for certain screens?-Time frame and time zone when the problem has been observed the last time (by example, 01/18/2016 from 9AM to 3PM CET)-If the issue is specific to certain screens (by example, Open Account, Save Opportunity, Price Product, Save and Open Ticket), please provide us with a description of the exact step sequence, where you are facing the performance issue.-Attach the diagnostic test results , please refer to case document 2181520.-Please also provide us with the httpwatch trace of the step sequence in question. Please do not provide us with traces covering much more than the step sequence in question. Please follow the instructions given in case document 1431064.-Is this problem happening from mobile application?-NOTE:-1) We request you to avoid generic statements that the entire system performance is affected , since the analysis on the issue reported is completely dependent on the accuracy of the information provided-2) Please try creating the case from the system itself if possible.-

Title: Bank Statements Reversal via Background
Content: Symptom-You want to know when the system allows the reversal of a Bank Statement through background job.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To reverse the bank statement you follow the steps below:-Access the Liquidity Management work center.-Access the Bank Statements view.-Select the Bank Statement you want to reverse.-Press View All button.-Select the Reverse option.-Systems shows a pop-up with the warning message 'The bank statement you want to reverse contains to many items that are still allocated. We recomment that you reverse the bank statement in background.'-Select the option button Reverse in background.-Resolution-The system shows the pop-up when the bank statement has around a thousand line items.-With this, you have the option to run the job via backend (Reverse in background) and via frontend (Reverse immediately). If you choose to run the job via frontend, as the bank statement has too many items, the system will possibly time out.-Note that if you have a bank statement with several line items and the system crashes upon reversal, but no pop-up with Reverse in background option is shown, create an case to SAP Product Support.-Keywords-bank statement; bank reconciliation; reversal; reverse; background

Title: Actual Cost Rollup Run Error: Valuation with cost estimate of production lot failed
Content: Symptom-The Actual Cost Rollup Run ends with errors:-Valuation with cost estimate of production lot failed-Valuation with cost estimate of material failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select Actual Cost Rollup view.-Find the executed Actual Cost Rollup run in question.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-Error: 'Valuation with cost estimate of production lot failed', 'Valuation with cost estimate of material failed'.-Cause-Actual Cost Rollup run was performed before to the production confirmations of the related production lots included in the rollup run.-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Monitoring view.-Select the production lot in question.-Edit and navigate to Confirmations tab.-Notice that the latest confirmation Created On date is later to the rollup run Executed On date.-Also, for the material in question, the material actual costing was also done before these production confirmations.-Resolution-The WIP Clearing Run should be executed for these production lots and then Actual Cost Rollup run should be done again to get the expected results.-See Also-KBA 2615386 - Actual Cost Rollup Failed With Error Messages: 'Cost center has no cost' - 'Valuation with cost estimate Failed'-KBA 2890289 - Error 'Valuation with cost estimate of production lot ABC failed' Occurs in Actual Cost Rollup Run-Keywords-Actual cost rollup run, valuation with cost estimate of production lot

Title: Error Message: 'Account determination missing for item type Exchange Rate Differences from Purchasing'
Content: Symptom-When running the GR/IR Clearing run, system throws the error message: 'Account determination missing for item type Exchange Rate Differences from Purchasing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Select GR/IR Clearing subview.-Click New button and choose GR/IR Clearing Run.-Select the Company and Period/Year.-Click Start Now button.-Once the run is finished, Click Display Log button.-Navigate to Messages tab.-The error message is displayed: 'Account determination missing for item type Exchange Rate Differences from Purchasing'.-Cause-The cause of the issue is that the G/L Accounts for “Gain from Exchange Rate Differences” and “Loss from Exchange Rate Differences” were not maintained for the respective Account Determination Group for Materials under Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures , Account Determination.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center, choose Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Change immediately.-Under Account Determination, choose Inventories.-Select tab Differences and click Add Row.-Enter the respective Account Determination Group for Materials and G/L Accounts for 'Gain from Exchange Rate Differences' and 'Loss from Exchange Rate Differences' -Save the changes.-After this configuration is maintained, the issue should not recur in subsequent GR/IR Clearing Runs.-Keywords-GR/IR clearing run; gr/ir; exchange rate differences; purchasing; material; inventories

Title: Unable to Change Account Determination Group For An Existing Employee
Content: Symptom-You want to change the Account Determination Group for an employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables workcenter.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Select Show all Employees in the dropdown view.-Select employee ABC (ABC means the Employee ID).-You will find that the current account determination group is XXX (XXX means the Account Determination Group ID).-Cause-You cannot manually enter or change the account determination group for an employee from the UI (User Interface), as this is the standard behavior.-Resolution-The account determination group for employee is not maintained manually. The system will automatically determine the account determination group and this is always XXX. You can see this account determination group in fine tuning activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination > option Edit Account Determination Groups > Accounts Payable > Groups for Suppliers.-When the first expense report is generated for the employee and posted to accounting, then the account determination group will be triggered from the backend and the related ledger accounts is activated. But the account determination group for all employees will be XXX.-So if an employee account already has an account determination group assigned, it is not possible to change it from the UI.-If you'd like to have the employee account determination group changed, please report an case to SAP providing the Employee ID, the current account determination group (XXX) and the new account determination group.-The employee's account determination group can be changed from the system backend by SAP Support.-Keywords-account determination group, employee

Title: How to add More Parameters/Options for the Service Category and Incident Category Fields in a Service Request
Content: Symptom-Users need to determine whether additional options can be added to the Service Category and Case Category fields in a Service Request to support more specific categorization and classification of requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Service Desk work center.-Select the New Service Request common task.-In the Categorization section, locate the Case Category and Service Category fields.-Cause-The Service Category and Case Category values available in a Service Request are controlled by the released Service Category Catalog assigned to the Service Requests usage. Once a catalog is released, its existing category structure cannot be directly modified.-Therefore, to add or update the available categories, a new version of the existing Service Category Catalog must be created and released with the required category structure.-Resolution-The Service Category and Case Category options available in a Service Request are maintained through Service Category Catalogs in the Service Entitlements work center.-If a Service Category Catalog with the usage Service Requests has already been released, you cannot directly add new Service Categories or create another catalog with the same usage. Instead, you can create a new version of the existing catalog and add the required categories.-Follow these steps:-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Navigate to the Service Categories view.-Select the relevant Service Category Catalog.-Click New and select Version to create a new version of the catalog.-In the General tab, specify the date from which the new version should take effect.-In the Catalog Structure tab, add the required category names and define the hierarchy.-The highest-level categories in the hierarchy are displayed as Service Categories.-The lower-level categories are displayed as Case Categories.-After making the required changes, use Change Status to Release the new version of the catalog.-Once the new version is released and becomes effective, the newly maintained Service Categories and Case Categories will be available for selection in Service Requests.-Keywords-Service Category;Case Category; Service Category Catalog; Service Request; Service Category Catalog Version

Title: Error Message "Service call failed. Report an case" While Migrating Open Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate Open Sales Order, system throws below error message(s):-Service call failed; report an case.-Create not possible; source object inconsistent-Product ID does not exist-Schedule line type 1 is not valid-Jurisdiction code missing in address of Account ABC-Jurisdiction code missing in address of Business Partner XYZ.-Jurisdiction code missing in location address of role Ship To Location-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find the Migration of Open Sales Orders activity.-Select Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool.-Select the file.-Execute Migration Step by Step.-Resolution-Error Messages:--Product ID does not exist-Schedule line type 1 is not valid-The cause for this issue is that there are some Services in the Migration Template are not present in the system.--So, resolve the above error messages for the affected Sales Order, ensure that you have entered valid Service which exist in your system.-Error Messages:-Jurisdiction code missing in address of Account ABC-Jurisdiction code missing in address of Business Partner XYZ.-Jurisdiction code missing in location address of role Ship To Location-The cause for the above issue is that the respective Account, Business Partner and the address of Ship To is not maintained.--To fix this issue, please maintain the Jurisdiction code for the respective Account and Business Partner.-After correct this above information for the respective Sales Order, Please try to migrate this Migration file.

Title: Error Message "Service Call Failed; report an case" During Migration of Responsibilities
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Responsibilities, system throws below error message:-Service call failed; report an case-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Responsibilities.-Execute Migration of uploaded file.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be, in the sheet Work Distr. Rules Details, you might have entered values in the column From Name instead of entering it in From Code.-For every row who has the value Country Code in field Characteristic, the value should be there in the field From Code-Resolution-There could be multiple reason for the above issue, some of the cases are list below:-Case 1:-The cause for the issue could be, in the sheet Work Distr. Rules Details, you might have entered values in the column From Name instead of entering it in From Code.-For every row who has the value Country Code in field Characteristic, the value should be there in the field From Code-Resolution: Correct the data as suggested above and try migrating the file again.-Case 2:-The cause for the issue could be, that you might have entered wrong Technical name in the Characteristic* in Work Distr. Rules Details.-Resolution: The Characteristic field should contain fields like CITY_NAME, COMPANY, COUNTRY_CODE, POSTAL_CODE, REGION_CODE, ABC_CLASSIFICATION or INDUSTRY. Correct the source file and try migrating Responsibilities again.

Title: Error Message 'File validation failed. Create an case' While Migrating Open Items Payable
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate Open Items Payables, system throws below error message:-File validation failed. Create an case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Execute Migration for the respective unit.-Highlight the Migration File (Open Items Payable).-Select Process File.-Error message is thrown: 'File validation failed. Create an case'.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the date format used in some of the fields (for example, Document Date, Baseline Date) are incorrect.-Resolution-The date format which you enter in the migration template should match the date format in the system. Change the date format and try the migration.-Note: In case you are not able to change the date format in the migration template, then it might be because of regional date and time setting in the local system. This can be changed as follows:-Go to the Control Panel in your PC/laptop.-Open Change date, time or number format under Regional and Language.-Select Format tab.-Change the Short date.-Click Apply button.-Keywords- File validation failed; create an case; open items payable; open items receivable; date format

Title: Error Message "Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times" While Terminating an Employee
Content: Symptom-You are trying to terminate a relationship with an employee, but system rejects the save with the following error message:-"Termination failed. Cannot delimit time file validity; employee times exist; cancel times."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Regular Tasks view.-Click Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Select employee XYZ (where XYZ represents an actual employee ID).-Input mandatory information for the Last Working Day and Termination Category fields.-Click the Save (or Save and Close) button.-The error message will be displayed.-Cause-The system will not allow for the termination of an employee who has any time transaction recorded after its termination date. This can be one or more of the following:-Times with status Approved, In Approval or Active.-Temporary Work Schedule.-Manual Adjustments.-Set to Zero (Manual Adjustments).-Resolution-Please check below the steps to solve the issue, according to each cause:-Time with status Approved, In Approval or Active-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select employee XYZ.-Click Edit.-Go to Employee Times tab.-Set the Date From value to be the same as the Termination Date.-Remove any time with status Approved, In Approval or Active recorded from the selected date onwards..-Temporary work schedule-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Click Temporary Change of Work Schedule-Search for employee XYZ-Select and remove any temporary change whose Start Date is set after the intended Termination Date.-There might be cases where the temporary change End Date is set to Unlimited; in such cases, please make sure to delimit the End Date to a date not later than the termination date.-Manual adjustments-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select employee XYZ.-Click Edit.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Select a time account.-Under Details, select tab Adjustments.-Check for manual adjustments with Posting On date that overlaps with the intended Termination Date.-Remove all such adjustments.-Note: In case a time account has been removed from the employee time profile, manual adjustments may still block the employee termination even if the time account is not showing anymore. To remove these manual adjustments, you need to add the time account back to the time profile, then proceed from step #5 described above. After that, you can remove the time accounts again.-Set to Zero (Manual Adjustments)-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select employee XYZ.-Click Edit.-Go to Time Account Balances tab.-Check for any Time Account which has a manual adjustment of "Set to Zero." Also verify using Show > All Accounts.-Remove that manual adjustment as well.-Save the changes.-In case these actions do not solve the issue or you don't find any related transactions, open an case and sent it to SAP Product Support. The issue may be related to former transactions that are not visible in the UI.-See Also-2627024 - Error Message "Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times" While Changing Employee Hire Date -2974671 - Error Message "Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times" While Extending Termination Date of an Employee-Keywords-Cannot delimit time file validity, Terminate employee, Cancel times, Austritt fehlgeschlagen, Abgrenz Zeitdateigültigkeit n mögl; MitarbZeiten vorhanden; Zeiten storn

Title: Unable to Import Chart of Accounts from Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You upload your first Chart of Accounts using the option Import From Microsoft Excel, however when you select the template, you receive the error message:-An error occurred. Try resuming your work. If you still face issues, open an case.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the respective project and click on Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune Tab and search for activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on Open button.-Select Edit chart of accounts.-Click on Import from Microsoft Excel button.-Click on Browse, select the file and click on Open.-Error appears: An error occurred. Try resume your work. If you still face issues, open an case.-Cause-This error is appearing because you are not using the correct Import Template.-Resolution-Anytime that you want to upload a Chart of Accounts using the Import from Microsoft Excel option, you must download a new template, this can be done by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Implementation Projects subview.-Select the project and click on open activity list.-Navigate to Fine Tune and select the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on Edit chart of accounts.-Select Import from Microsoft Excel.-Select Download.-Make sure that you save the download file as .XML (XML DATA)-Then add all  required changes to this file.-Make sure you make all the changes in Columns E (Open Item Management) and F (G/L Account Posting Block) manually -> selecting the options from the dropdown.-Save this file again as an .XML (XML DATA).-Now, you can upload the amended file successfully.-Please note: Do not open this file again for editing before uploading, as this corrupts the data and you will not be able to upload it. You will have to do the whole process again.

Title: How to update the exchange rates via web service
Content: Symptom-You wonder how to automatically update the Exchange Rates in your system via web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The system offers the following Web Service API that enables you to connect external applications to your system to create or invalidate exchange rate information in your system-Web Service Name: ManageExchangeRateIn-Description: Manage Exchange Rates-Refer to the documentation below for further information:--Web Service APIs in SAP Business ByDesign-Manage Exchange Rates -Keywords-web site, API, import, exchange rates,

Title: Error Message "File validation failed. Create an case" While Migrating Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate Fixed Assets, system throws below error message:-File validation failed. Create an case-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity - Migration of Accounting Transaction Data-Execute Migration for the respective unit.-Highlight the Migration File (Fixed Assets)-Select Process File-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the date format used in some of the fields (EX: Start Date, End Date)are incorrect.-Resolution-The date format which you enter in the migration template should match the date format in the system. Change the date format and try the migration.-Note: In case, if you are not able to change the date format in the migration template then it might be because of regional date and time setting in the local system. This can be changed as follows,- 1. Go to Control Panel in your PC/laptop-2. Open Change date, time or number format under Regional and Language.-3. Format tab-4. Change the short date .-5. Apply button.

Title: Reconciliation Run Is Finishing With The Error Message: During Run The Error 'Application Runtime Exception; Report an Incident' Occurred
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Reconciliation Run that is presenting status Finished and processing status Error.-Upon checking the Log Result you see the error message During run the error 'Application runtime exception; report an case' occurred.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger workcenter.-Go to Periodic Tasks > Reconciliation view.-Select the row for the respective Run ID and under Details section, click Log Result hyperlink.-Go to Messages tab.-Here you will find the error message During run the error 'Application runtime exception; report an case' occurred.-Cause-This error message appearing indicates that a backend error occurred upon the execution of the respective job run.-Among other possible reasons, such backend error might have been caused due to a memory issue, which in turn was caused by a too large dataset selected for the run.-In the run's parameters, you need to check whether you have left blank the Set of Books field and if you have marked All Subledger as Subledger Selection.-If both conditions are met, the dataset can become excessively large to be supported by system's memory quantity, resulting in backend errors.-Resolution-When creating the Reconciliation Run, on Selection Data section you should select one Set of Books only.-If this change is not enough to prevent the error in a new execution of the run, you should also change the Subledger Selection by opting for a specific subledger instead of all.-This will create a smaller dataset and this memory issue should not occur.-Keywords-Reconciliation Run. General Ledger. Memory.

Title: Holding Company Above Other Existing Companies
Content: Symptom-Requirement: There are multiple companies as Org Structures and the requirement is to bring all of the under one holding company.-Resolution-The approach to achieve the requirement will be to create a new org structure with only one org unit defined as a company.-Following that you could cut and paste the concerned companies under the newly created one.-Please note: We advise you to have all necessary checks on all the companies to ensure that they are free of inconsistencies, before performing the above below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select the Edit button.-Select the New button and select Org Structure.-Provide appropriate name and ID, also flag the Company definition and provide the mandatory Main Address.-Select the first company you want to move under the newly created Company.-Select the small arrow (bottom-right) of the selected Org Unit to open its menu, select Edit Org Unit option, and select Cut.-Select the newly created Org Unit.-Drop-down the small arrow on it, select Edit Org Unit option, and Paste.-Follow the same action for the remaining companies[Steps 5 through 8].-Use the Check button to validate the Org Structure.-Select Activate button to activate the changes.-Note: If the Check for Inconsistencies in the org structures is to throw any veto error, please note that you can look for existing solutions or workarounds Case Document yourself.  To do so:-Select the Solution Search button from any case window. The Solution Search window opens.-Enter key terms from the error messages and select Go.-Check the displayed results and refine your search if necessary- If no relevant case documents are found, kindly create a new case from the same screen where the error occurs, so that Support can investigate into it's cause.-Keywords-company,org unit,companies,org structure,holding company

Title: You Are Not Able to Reverse the Balance Carryforward Run Because the Reversal Run Is Created Without Postings
Content: Symptom-After executing the Reverse Carryforward (either for step 2 - Calculate and carry forward profit/loss or step 1 - Carry forward accounts) it's noticed that the Carryforward Reversal run created doesn't generate any postings in the Postings tab.-In addition to that, it's noticed that the original Carryforward run is not marked as Reversed in the Balance Carryforward view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks, then Balance Carryforward view.-Open the respective Carryforward Reversal run.-Go to Postings tab.-Note that there are no postings displayed (for example: Journal Entries tab).-In addition to that, going back to the Balance Carryforward view and checking the original run it's noticed that the Reversed checkbox is not marked for it.-Cause-One of the set of books for which the original Balance Carryforward has been ran has been deactivated between the original run execution and the reversal run execution.-For example:-Original Balance Carryforward run step 2 - Calculate and carry forward profit/loss created/executed on DD.MM.YYYY-Set of Books ID 02 deactivated on DD+1.MM.YYYY-Reversal Balance Carryforward run step 2 - Calculate and carry forward profit/loss created/executed on DD+2.MM.YYYY-The deactivation of the set of books can be checked in the Integrate and Extend Business Configuration activity Set of Books, by clicking Edit in the respective Set of Books and checking the Changes tab.-Resolution-When a reversal of a Balance Carryforward run is executed, it will use the Company/Set of Books the original run used.-If between the execution of the original run and the reversal a set of books is set to be inactive, this issue will occur. The log section entries created for the original run will not match the ones created for the reversal and an exception will be thrown in the respective class/method in the backend of your system (not visible in the UI - User Interface).-In such case, report a case with your approval for SAP to create the reversal run(s) manually in the backend by skipping a specific verification. As a result, the run(s) is(are) created successfully.-Keywords-reverse the balance carryforward run; bcf; step 1; step 2; reversal; set of books; sob

Title: Purchase Orders Do Not Contain Taxes For Limit Items.
Content: Symptom-A Purchase Order XYZ has been created with a Limit item, but no taxes are calculated for the item.  -(XYZ represent the Purchase Order ID).  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Select the Purchase Order XYZ.-Click Edit.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the Limit item.-Select the sub-tab Taxes.-See that no taxes are calculated.-Cause-The system does not calculate taxes for Limit items. When a Limit item is added to a Purchase Order, the specific product being purchased is not known. The product is defined during the creation of the Goods and Service Receipt; therefore, no tax calculation is necessary for the Purchase Order.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Limit Item, Goods and Service Receipt, tax calculation

Title: Error: "service call failed, report an case" While Uploading Logistical Area in Data Migration
Content: Symptom-While uploading Logistical Area in Data Migration you receive below error messgae:-Service call failed, report an case-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Overview.-Search for Migration of Location & Logistic Area.-Execute Step by Step migrtion file.-Above error message appears in Simulation Stage.-Cause-This error occurs due to the data not correctly entered in the template. One of the issue could be because of wrong Storage Control Profile ID assigned to the LOAs.-Resolution-Storage control Profile ID does not exist, hence replace it with the correct ID.

Title: Error Message "Service call failed; report an case" While Migrating Time and Labor Management

Title: Create button greyed out in gpa_admin in SAP Solution Manager 7.2
Content: Symptom-The create button is greyed out in transaction gpa_admin.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-1. call transaction GPA_ADMIN-2. try to  click on create button is not possible, the button is greyed out-Cause-An Application Area needs to be chosen.-Resolution-check URL: https://wiki.scn.sap.com/wiki/display/SMSETUP/Create+Guided+Procedures+for+different+Application+Areas for documentation and chose an application area before creating a guided procedure in gpa_admin first.-Keywords-disable create button, gpa_admin

Title: Error in Supplier Invoice: /SRMAP/LSIV_SIV 393. Balance is bigger than permitted.
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice.-You get the error: A technical error occurred: /SRMAP/LSIV_SIV 393. Report an case. ; Invoice Accounting Notification ###: Balance ... is bigger than permitted.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the relevant invoice and press Check.-You get such an error: Balance 0,010000 Euro of the invoice is bigger than permitted.-Cause-The Tax Payable amount doesn't match the Tax Receivable amount.-You can check this on the supplier invoice. Go to the General tab and then the Taxes sub-tab. There, you can check that the amounts differ.-Resolution-We are working on a permanent solution.-To solve the issue immediately, you can change the tax code temporarily for the item and revert it. Afterward the Tax Payables will match the Tax Receivables and you can post the invoice:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the relevant invoice-Go to the General tab and then the Taxes sub-tab.-Change one tax amount to zero and press Enter.-The taxes are recalculated and Payables = Receivables.-The status of the invoice is Ready for Posting.-Choose Post.-Keywords-Supplier Invoicing, Supplier Invoice, Balance is bigger than permitted.-is bigger than permitted.,incoming,/srmap/lsiv_siv 393,invoice accounting notification

Title: The Scrapping of Fixed Assets is Not Possible - Depreciation positive (Austria)
Content: Symptom-Scrapping of Fixed Assets is not possible in the second half of the fiscal year due to an error message using a specific depreciation method for Austria (L055).-'An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset ABC Asset ABC val.view 1:  Error occurred while determining values to be posted for fixed asset ABC Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated'-(ABC stands for the Fixed Asset ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to the Fixed Assets View.-Search for the Fixed Asset ID ABC.-Select the Individual Material DEF (DEF stands for the Individual Material ID).-Click the Manual Posting - Complete Scrapping button.-Enter a date in the second half of the year in document date and posting date.-Use the default options Journal Entry Type 00059 - Manual Posting for Fixed Asset and Closing Step 010 - Operational postings.-Press Simulate.-Cause-The depreciation method L055 for Austria has the period control method configured against this depreciation control method 013.-According to this Period Control Method, retirement postings are included for depreciation calculation only if the posting falls on the first half of the fiscal year.-If the posting date of the retirement is in the 2nd half of the fiscal year, the retirement is not considered for depreciation calculation until the end of the fiscal year.-Resolution-There are two possible solutions:-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to the Fixed Assets View.-Click on Fixed Asset ABC.-Solution 1:-Click View All.-Navigate to Master Data and the Lifecycle data tab.-Change the Valuation Check Settings to No Checks.-Click on Save.-Post a Journal Entry Voucher as retirement posting.-Please note, though, that the retirement posting is posted but the system shows the depreciation values as pending until the end of the fiscal year. This is the expected system behavior due to the depreciation code L055.-If no further depreciation is required after the retirement posting date, proceed to Step 3 above and then:-Click on View all.-Change the interval of the depreciation.-The start date is the posting date of the retirement and the depreciation code is 0000 - No automatic depreciation.-Click on Save.-Trigger the retirement posting using a Journal Entry Voucher.-See Also-Using Depreciation Methods-Keywords-Fixed Assets, Austria, L055
