Title: Unexpected Item Being Shown In the Report Cash - Open Items
Content: Symptom-You see an unexpected amount opened in the Cash - Open Items report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Reports View.-Search and open the report Cash - Open Items.-Fill out the selection fields.-Click Go.-You will see an amount not expected in the report characteristics Debit Amount Company Currency or Credit Amount Company Currency.-Cause-System is working as expected. The amounts are not yet confirmed by a bank statement.-Resolution-The shown amount is not yet cleared by any Bank Statement. Once it is cleared with the Bank Statement, it will not show up in the Cash - Open Items report.-You can create new bank statements for your company via Liquidity Management work center.-Keywords- Cash - Open Items; FINGLAU10_Q0002; bank statement

Title: Not Possible to Create Service Agent from Existing Employee
Content: Symptom-You get an error while creating Business Partner as Service Agent : Maintain internal employees only via Master Data Replication work center.--The question Do you want to replicate employee data from external application or solution of your cloud solution?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Business Partner Data workcenter.-2. Select Business Partner view.-3. Search for required Business Partner.-4. Select Create As ,  Service Agent.-5. Select Save.-Error received as mentioned above.-Cause-The current model is that the Employee and Service Agent share the same instance. The BO is Employee and it has two Employment Type. Internal Employee and External Employee (Service Agent).--So there are information which is common for these two Employment Types.--If the Master Data Replication is active, these common nodes cannot be changed. Instead it should be replicated.-When Employee Replication is switched on, changes to employee data is only permitted via Master Data Replication workcenter. Hence, the above change is not permitted.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-Keywords-Business Partner, Service Agent, Employee

Title: ERM Error in Migration of Personnel Administration Data
Content: Symptom-You are adding Personnel Administration data for an employee of a certain country (hereby referred to as XYZ) using the Migration tool, but on the third step of the migration you encounter the following error message:-An MDCI implementation (from business object) has rejected the save-No country version for XYZ exists in ERM-Validity start date DD/MM/YYYY already used by another assignment set-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center, then to Overview.-Search for "migration of employee data".-Open the activity Migration of Employee Data - XYZ.-On the next screen, click the link to Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool.-In the migration tool, select the relevant template under Source Files.-If you haven't uploaded the file yet, find instructions for the same below.-Click Execute Migration > Execute Migration Step by Step.-Wait for the validation to conclude, then click Next.-Review the value conversion if necessary, then click Next.-Error occurs.-To upload a migration file:-In the migration tool, click the You Can Also link on the top-right corner of the screen.-Select the option to Download Migration Template.-Open the XML template that is downloaded and populate it with the relevant data, respecting mandatory fields and sheets.-Save the file.-Back in the migration tool, click Upload > Data from Migration Template.-Select your file in the browsing window and upload it.-Cause-This may happen due to the fact that the employee's hire date is outside the validity — either before the Valid From data or after the Valid To date — of all expense types for country XYZ. You can check this by doing the following:-Go to the Business Configuration work center, then to Overview.-Search for "expense reporting".-Open the activity Expense Reporting - XYZ.-On the next screen, click the link to Edit expense types.-Select any of the available expense types on the list.-Check the Valid From and Valid To dates under Details.-Resolution-If the employee's hire date is indeed outside the validity of the expense types, you can either:-Shift the hire date to be within the validity of the expense types.-Edit the expense types to encompass the employee's hire date (this will require an open implementation project or a change project).-PLEASE NOTE: for the second option mentioned above, the validity of an expense type cannot start before the validity of the country version, which is the default value and hardcoded in the system (e.g. 01.01.2006 for Germany and US). The employee's hire date, however, can still be set before that date.-If the validity of the expense types is already encompassing the employee's hire date and the error still occurs, please report an case to SAP Cloud Product Support for further analysis.-Keywords-MDCI implementation, ERM, Validity Start Date, Personnel Administration, Migration, ERM

Title: No Postings In The WIP Clearing Run For The Production Lot ABC
Content: Symptom-The Work-In-Process (WIP) Clearing Run is executed, but no journal entry postings are generated in the Postings tab.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation Workcenter.-Navigate to the Periodic Tasks -  WIP Clearing view.-Highlight the line of the respective run DEF (DEF means the Run ID) and press View to open the Log result.-Navigate to the Postings tab.-No journal entries created by the run.-Cause-The WIP Clearing Run is executed for accounting period A, while the production confirmation GHI (GHI is the Production Confirmation ID) associated with the production lot ABC (ABC is the Production Lot ID) is completed only in accounting period B (Production End Date of it is a date in period B).-This can also be verified using the Production Lots - Line Items report. The postings for the relevant production lot are shown in accounting period B and not in accounting period A.-Resolution-Each production confirmation sends a message from logistics to financials and results in a posting to Work in Process with reference to the production lot.-The confirmation mainly contains information about the actual quantities consumed. When financials has been informed of the relevant data, the system derives an account determination group for the production lot. This account determination group is then used in account determination for work in process and the work-in-process account.-Execute the WIP Clearing Run for the period in which the production confirmation is done which belongs to the production lot.-See Also-KBA 3637631 - No Postings In The WIP Clearing Run For a Production Lot-KBA 2773042 - No Postings Generated by WIP Clearing Run-Keywords-wip clearing, confirmation, production lot, postings, journal entry

Title: Extension Field Error: Retrieval of field properties failed
Content: Symptom-When you click the Field Definition link, while editing extension fields, you get the following error message: 'Retrieval of field properties failed'.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the screen where the Extension Field is located.-Click Adapt.-Click Edit Master layout.-Hover the mouse in the Extension Field.-Click in the Wrench Icon and select the Field Definition link.-The error message 'Retrieve Field Properties - Retrieval of field properties failed' will appear.-Cause-This error is shown only in PDI created Extension Fields or if your user is a development user.-Development users do not have permission to perform KUT changes.-Resolution-To change the field settings, you need to use the SDK (SAP Cloud Applications Studio) and edit the field.-If your business user does not have PDI access rights and still are receiving this error, please open an case providing the user name, the field name and exact location.-Keywords-Retrieval; Field; Properties; Failed; KUT; User; Development; PDI; Error; Extension;

Title: "No Suppliers - Script Changes imported successfully" Error in Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update Company ID for existing Suppliers using Mass Data Maintenance and you receive the following errors:-"No Suppliers - Script Changes imported successfully, 1 Suppliers - Script Changes failed."-"Update not possible; specified data for SUPPLIER-PAYMENT_DATA with key COMPANY_ID = XYZ does not exist" (where XYZ represents the Company ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click on the Export Suppliers link.-Export the Payment Data tab to CSV file and update the details for the Supplier.-Select Import Suppliers link and upload the file to the Payment Data tab.-Execute Data Import Immediately.-Error occurs.-Cause-The Supplier ID, Company ID and the Account Determination Group together form the key of a particular record, which will determine the data to be updated from the remaining fields in the CSV file.-Being the key fields, an entry with the combination of these fields must already exist in the system. Otherwise the record from the CSV cannot be fetched with the existing data for the Mass Data Maintenance operation and is interpreted as an update of the key fields, which is not supported.-The Mass Data Maintenance functionality purely depends on the key field values to perform the update of other fields.-Resolution-Using Mass Data Maintenance functionality, you can update data of the respective sheet which are not marked as key. Key fields are used to uniquely determine the records. Changing the key field would give you an error that the record is not found as the record with that key does not exist.-Keywords-Account Determination Group, Company ID, Suppliers, Import Suppliers

Title: How To Unlock A User C4C / BYD
Content: Symptom-This document will describe how to unlock your user in SAP Cloud for Customer and SAP Business ByDesign environments. This usually happens in cases where the user session was not finished and you try to open the same document which was opened before.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open an Object in a C4C / BYD system.-Click Edit.-Now turn off your internet connection.-Your user will be locking the object, even if you close the browser.-Cause-The lock system was created to avoid inconsistencies in the documents from BYD /C4C. Those could be caused by double editing of the same object. After one hour the lock should be removed.-Below you can find some situations where a document can be locked in the system:-A dump or screen freeze forces you to close a C4C session for example with the windows task manager.-If the browser dumps /stops working because windows has some trouble.-Mobile app crashes.-You are logged in on another device and a data record is still open in edit mode.-Resolution-You can remove the lock manually by following the following steps:-Open the logon screen, and enter the user name.-Enter a wrong password once (and press logon). The system will ask to check the credentials, and after the warning, enter the correct password.-After you enter correct password, system will display a list of previous locked sessions.-Check (tick) them all, and proceed to logon.-Now you can work on your locked objects. -See Also-KBA: 2809720 - Error: "Unlock failed. Please create an case to resolve it."-Keywords-C4C ;Lock ; BYD

Title: "Increase sequence no. with Seniority/Age for account X, rule Y from Z" Error When Configuring Time Account Rules
Content: Symptom-You are setting up Time Account Rules with multiple entries in the Accrual Rule table, however when saving the following error appears:-"Increase sequence no. with Seniority/Age for account X, rule Y from Z" (where X represents the time account ID, Y represents the code of the time account rule, and Z represents the "valid from" field of the time account rule)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration.-Navigate to the Overview view.-In the search bar, search and enter the activity "Time Accounts - X" (where X represents the desired country/region).-Enter the sub-activity "Maintain Time Account Rules".-Select an entry of time account rule, or create a new entry.-In the Details section on the bottom of the screen, enter a validity, accrual date and posting type.-In the Accrual Quantity field, select either "Depending on Seniority" or "Depending on Age".-In the sequence table, maintain multiple records for different seniority/age periods.-Click on the Save button.-Cause-If 10 or more entries are required, you need to explicitly set the sequence number characters to 2.-Resolution-For account rules with 1 to 9 entries, they can be maintained normally with the Sequence Number field from 1 to 9.-However if 10 or more entries are required, the Sequence Number field for the first 9 entries need to have a 0 as a prefix.-For example, a rule with 3 sequence entries may have sequence numbers as 1, 2 and 3. However if this rule needs 10 or more entries, then the sequence numbers must be maintained as 01, 02 and 03.-Keywords-Time Rule, Time Type, Deduction, Time Account Type

Title: Message: Start Date Set to DD.MM.YYYY (where DD.MM.YYYY is the original date)
Content: Symptom-You want to change Time Profile Start Date of an Employee XYZ (where XYZ represents the Employee). However when you change the Start Date and press enter in the keyboard, the system undoes the change and shows the information message.-Start Date set to DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select the Employees view-Select the Employee XYZ and choose Edit button-Go to the Time Profile tab-Under Time Profile section, change the Start Date to the desired date DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and press Enter-System undoes the change and shows the information message Start date set to DD.MM.YYYY (where DD.MM.YYYY is the original date)-Cause-Currently, it is not possible to change the Start Date of the first Time Profile of an Employee. It is defaulted to the beginning of the third month before the system date on which hiring is performed.-  Case 1:-When the Employee is hired from the system the Time Profile Start Date is defaulted to the first of third month in the past. If we hire an Employee on 15th February 2016 the Time Profile Start Date would be 1st December 2015. This was done considering the fact that the three months old time recordings would unnecessarily load the system.-For example:-Hiring performed on 15.07.2015-Hiring date is 13.05.2009-Time Profile Start Date is defaulted to 01.05.2015 (beginning of the third month before the system date on which hiring is performed).-The assumption here is that for such past dated hires, Employees shall not be recording time more than three months in past.-  Case 2:-In case of fresh hire, the Time agreement is created automatically by the system and it is expected that fresh Employees would not have more than three months old of transactional data.-  Case 3:-The Time Profile Start Date cannot be changed from the UI even if the Employee comes in the system through Migration.-If the Time Profile Start Date sent in the Migration file is equal to the Hire Date, the Time Profile Start Date is set as the Hire Date, even if this is more than three months in the past.-If the Time Profile Start Date sent in the Migration file is not equal to the Hire Date, the system defaults this to the first of three months in the past. The system always defaults the Time Profile Start Date to the first of three months in the past if the employee is hired from workcenter Personnel Administration.-The difference here is, during Migration the Time Profile Start Date can be given anything (which will always be equal to the hire date), as per your need and the system will accept an old date as well. But again this cannot be changed from the UI. You can give a date, six months old in the past in the Migration file and the system would accept this.-Resolution-If you have a requirement to change an employees Time Profile Start Date, the only option available is to create a Time Profile split. For example if you intend to start the Time Profile for a future date, you can delimit the current Time Profile and start the new Time Profile from said date. This is done in Time Administratrion -> Employees -> Edit Employee and go to Time Profile facet to edit said Time Profile.-Alternatively, if you have a scenario that differs from any of these suggestions, please create an case providing as many details as possible and SAP Support can check and assist you. Please note that there may not be any other options, but SAP Support can check and inform you of best way forward.-Keywords-Time Profile Start Date

Title: You Receive a Notification Regarding Renewal of Tenant Certificate or Mandate User Certificate (M-User) From SAP
Content: Symptom-You have received a notification either stating that your tenant certificate will expire soon or that the tenant certificate has been renewed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You will receive a notification in various locations:-In SAP Business ByDesign:-An case in the Application and User Management workcenter in the cases view.-A Business Task Notification in the Application and User Management workcenter, under the Business Task Management view.-An e-mail directly to the designated IT Contact Person listed first in the Service Control Center work center.- In SAP Cloud for Customer:-An case in the Administrator workcenter, under cases view.-A Notification task in the task bar under the Notification icon.-An e-mail directly to the designated IT Contact Person listed first in the Service Control Center work center.-Cause-The SAP Networking Team will renew the mandate certificate periodically and automatically.-Resolution-The renewal of the certificate itself does not require any action from your side. However, after you have received the confirmation that the mandate certificate has been renewed, check if you have inbound web services of the system that consumes the Authentication Method as SSL Certificate (Create and Download Key Pair). If yes, you have to perform the activity once again and take the new certificate and upload it in the target system from where you're trying to consume the web service.-Keywords-Renewal Notification, Tenant Certificate, Mandate Certificate, Mandate User Certificate, Tenant Certificate has been renewed, Tenant certificate is going to expire soon

Title: Service Call Error During Fixed Asset Migration
Content: Symptom-You are migrating fixed assets via migration tool, however a service call error occurs upon simulate import step.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and navigate to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the concerned migration unit and click Execute Migration.-Select the migration object for fixed assets and click Process File.-On the simulate import phase, you get the following error: Service call failed; report an case-Cause-One of the causes for a service call error is a missing set up for the currency being used in the migration file during asset creation.-Resolution-In this case, you need to maintain  the min/max amounts and define a value range in the currency used in the migration file for low-value assets for each accounting principle used by the company.-This range can be configured via below steps:- Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and navigate to the Fine-tune tab.-Open the activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-After maintaining the threshold values, save your changes and simulate the import again.-Keywords-fixed assets, migration, transactional data, fixed asset migration

Title: Error "Exchange rate for currency ABC and DEF missing" is raised when you execute a Dunning Run for Receivables
Content: Symptom-Error message "Exchange rate for currency ABC and DEF missing" is raised when you execute a Dunning Run for Receivables. (ABC and DEF stands for different currencies).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Click on Dunning Runs view.-Fill all the relevant data and execute the Run.-On the Application Log you will find that it finished with errors. Open it.-On Results tab, error message is raised:-"Exchange rate for currency ABC and DEF missing"-Cause-There are some possible causes that may lead to this error message, such as:-There is no Exchange Rate maintained between Currencies ABC and DEF.-One or more of the open items in the Customer Account ID XYZ are migrated invoices that have no Exchange Rate maintained and system is set to pick Invoice Exchange Rate at Dunning Strategies Activity. (XYZ stands for the Customer Account ID relevant for the Dunning Run).-To check if there is an Exchange Rate maintained between Currencies ABC and DEF:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, click on Edit Exchange Rates view.-You notice that there is no Exchange Rate maintained between Currencies ABC and DEF.-To check if there is one or more open items in the Customer Account ID XYZ that are migrated invoices that have no Exchange Rate maintained:-Go to Receivables work center.-Open Customer Accounts view.-Find and open Customer Account XYZ.-In Trade Receivables > Invoices / Payments, there is one or more open Invoices that are migrated and hence cannot be opened.-Open the corresponding Journal Entry.-You will notice that there is no Exchange Rate. -Then, follow these steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Overview view.-Search for Activity Dunning Strategies and open it.-Click on Edit Dunning Strategies.-In the corresponding Dunning Strategy, in Details section, General tab you notice that Exchange Rate is set to Invoice Exchange Rate.-The Exchange Rate in Activity Dunning Strategies is set to Invoice Exchange Rate. Since there is no Exchange Rate maintained in the Journal Entries of the migrated Invoices, the Dunning Run raises the error message.-Resolution-If there isn't an Exchange Rate maintained between Currencies ABC and DEF, create one through the following steps:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, click on Edit Exchange Rates view.-Click on Add Row and create an Exchange Rate between Currencies ABC and DEF with all relevant data.-Click on Save.-If there is one or more open items in the Customer Account ID XYZ that are migrated invoices that have no Exchange Rate maintained, change temporarily the Exchange Rate in Activity Dunning Strategies from Invoice Exchange Rate to Current Exchange Rate through the following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Overview view.-Search for Activity Dunning Strategies and open it.-Click on Edit Dunning Strategies.-In the corresponding Dunning Strategy, in Details section, General tab, change the Exchange Rate field to Current Exchange Rate.-Click on Save.-Then, go to General Ledger work center.-Open Edit Exchange Rates.-Set the Exchange Rate to the needed amount to match the values in the Invoice.-Execute the Dunning Run again for Customer XYZ. -It will process the Dunning without errors. If required, set Exchange Rate field back to Invoice Exchange Rate in your Dunning Strategies after this execution is complete.-See Also- 2660633 - Error Message 'Exchange rate for currency XYZ and missing' when you create Dunning Run-Keywords-Dunning, Exchange Rates, Currency.

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run: Key Date Valuation Amount is Not Calculated as Expected. No Gain Amount Calculated
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Run. When checking the Log Result for one or more set of books you realize that the Key Date Valuation Amount was not calculated as expected.-You were expecting a Gain Amount but the calculated Key Date Valuation Amount is the same as the Historic Valuation Amount, resulting in no gains.-This same scenario can be applied for Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Payables and Receivables Run as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks > Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Select the executed run and open the respective Log Result.-Move to the Remeasured Balances tab.-Here notice that the Key Date Valuation Amount is not a product of Balance Amount * Key Date Exchange Rate but is the same amount of Historic Valuation Amount. You were expecting a Gain Amount but there's no gain calculated and displayed.-Example of expected calculation:-Balance Amount = 112.81 EUR-Historic Valuation Amount = 81.15 GBP-Key Date Exchange Rate = 0.737-Key Date Valuation Amount = Balance Amount * Key Date Exchange Rate-Key Date Valuation Amount = 112.81 EUR * 0.737 = 83.14 GBP-Gain Amount = Key Date Valuation Amount - Historic Valuation Amount-Gain Amount = 83.14 GBP - 81.15 GBP = 1.99 GBP-Example of processed calculation:-Key Date Valuation Amount = Historic Valuation Amount-Key Date Valuation Amount = 81.15 GBP-Gain Amount = Key Date Valuation Amount - Historic Valuation Amount-Gain Amount = 81.15 GBP - 81.15 GBP = null (not displayed).-Cause-The reason for the processed calculation is the assignment of the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Method for the accounting principle tied to the respective set of books.-You are most likely using the foreign currency remeasurement method A002 Lowest value. The method A002 is usually assigned to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Principle 002 - Lower Value, which works as follows:-The system only revaluates if the remeasurement results in an expected loss. That is, profits resulting from the valuation are only displayed if they are realized on the closing key date. Losses, however, are displayed if they are not realized on the closing key date.-Following the example given in the previous section, the expected gain of 1.99 GBP would only be displayed if it was realized on the closing key date.-Resolution-You should check the settings by accessing the Business Configuration activity Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash and change them accordingly if they are not suitable to your needs.-For further information, please consult the help documents: Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Quick Guide and Configuration: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Payables, Receivables, Cash, and G/L Accounts.-See Also-Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Quick Guide-Quick Guide for Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs (Payables)-Quick Guide for Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs (Receivables)-Configuration: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Payables, Receivables, Cash, and G/L Accounts-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run; Cash; Gain; Lower Value; Receivables; Payables; Loss;

Title: How to Hide Activities in Self-Services Overview
Content: Symptom-You would like to know if it is possible to hide Activities in Self-Services Overview.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home Work Center.-Go to Self-Services Overview.-Here there are the activities that you would like to hide.-Resolution-It is possible to hide the activities via Business Role. In order to perform it, please follow the steps below:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business Role View.-Select the Business Role and open it.-Go to UI Switches Tab.-Click Add Row.-Click Value Help icon to search for the activity.-Here you can select the activities that you would like to disable.-When searching for the Activity in step 3, we recommend to search the activity between asterisks. For example: *Edit Payment Information*.-After that, all users assigned to the business role will have the selected activities disabled in Self-Services Overview.-Keywords-Hide, Disable, Activities, Self-Service, Self Service

Title: "legalEntity is a required field/association in Object Cost Center" Error When Replicating Org Units to Business ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY**-Customer reports that when they try to replicate org units from SAP SuccessFactors to SAP Business ByDesign, the response from the request shows the following error:-"legalEntity is a required field/association in Object Cost Center. with the index 0"-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This issue is currently being investigated by the development team together with the SuccessFactors team, in order to properly align the replication payloads between the two systems.-However currently this is a backlog item and there is no ETA for a permanent fix.-Resolution-As a workaround, please request the customer to follow the below steps in the SuccessFactors system to set the LegalEntity attribute as not required for the replication:-Go to “Configure Object Definition”.-In the first search field select “Object Definition” and in the second search field select “Cost Center”.-Select Take action.-Click on Make Correction.-Select Cost Center "LegalEntity" attribute "details", and change the “Required” attribute from "Yes" to "No".-Now go to OData API Metadata Refresh and Export.-Click on the Refresh button.-Keywords-Employee Central, EC, SF, RLU

Title: Surcharges Posted to the Same G/L Account
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a Surcharge for a customer invoice item.-For the Distribution Channel used Net is the Default Pricing Procedure. Therefore you expect that surcharges on invoice items are to be posted to a separate G/L account.-In the customer invoice journal entry you, however, notice two separate line items for the same Sales Revenue G/L Account, one for the invoice amount and one for the surcharge amount. You now wonder how to identify such surcharge postings in Accounting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Customer Invoicing workcenter navigate to the Invoice Documents view.-Find Customer Invoice XYZ and open it via Edit. Then press View All.-In the Pricing tab expand line item XYZ-XX.-You maintained List Price of, e.g. 100,00 LC.-You have added a Price component Surcharge (%) with an amount of 10, leading to a Price Component Value of 10,00 LC.-Navigate to the Document flow of the Customer Invoice XYZ.-To access the posting press on the Journal Entry icon.-In the Journal Entry you notice a posting to the respective Sales Revenue G/L account ABC over 100,00 LC and a second posting to the same Sales Revenue G/L account ABC over 10,00 LC. You expected this surcharge to be posted to a different G/L account.-Cause-In SAP ByDesign there is currently no possibility to allocate surcharges to separate G/L accounts.-Resolution-A feasible workaround here is to identify surcharges with the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report:-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Reports - List view and select the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report.-In the Profit Type field select 2-Invoice Profit.-Maintain all the mandatory information,i.e. Company and Contribution Margin Scheme.-Press Go.-From the Not Currently Shown section add Invoice as well as Price Component.-You can now identify your invoice XYZ with the List Price Price Component displaying the value of 100,00 LC and the Surcharge Price Component displaying the value of 10,00 LC (10 %).-Keywords-surcharges, accounts

Title: Planing Upload Error: Invalid Character in FinancialPlanData/ID
Content: Symptom-You are uploading the Planning/Budgeting for the year and end up getting the error as 'Invalid Character in FinancialPlanData/ID'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Planning view.-Choose New, Plan Version from Microsoft Excel and File upload.-Logon to SAP Business ByDesign dialog box and enter the details.-Click the button Save Data To.-Error: Invalid Character in FinancialPlanData/ID.-Cause-Plan Version Cell is Case-Sensitive and also got String Values coded in the backend for this column content.-Resolution-Format the Plan Version ID either with-Only numbers, for example 123456789-Only Capital letters, for example TEST (not test or Test).-A combination of numbers and words-Please Note: All number groups and word - number combinations must not have spaces:-Example:-Enter 123-456-789 or 123_456_789 (not 123 456 789)-Enter TEST-123 or TEST_123 (not TEST 123 or Test 123)-Keywords-Invalid Character E in FinancialPlanData/ID; Upload plan data; Plan version; Income statement; Microsoft excel-invalid character in financialplandata/i,upload plan data,plan version,income statement,microsoft excel

Title: Error Message: Closing of <Fiscal Year> not Possible, Depreciation Run has to be Started Before
Content: Symptom-When you try to close period 12 of a fiscal year or a fiscal year itself, regardless of if the Balance Carry Forward has been done or not, you cannot close it and the error message "Closing of <fiscal year> not possible, Depreciation Run has to be started before" is shown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Master Data view and Company sub-view.-Select the company for which you want to close period 12 of a fiscal year itself.-If you want to close the period 12 of a fiscal year, select the Open and Close Periods button.-Select period 12 of the fiscal year you want to close and click the Close Period button.-If you want to close the complete Fiscal Year, select the Edit Fiscal Years button.-Select the fiscal year you want to close and click the Close Fiscal Year button.-The error message "Closing of <fiscal year> not Possible, Depreciation Run has to be Started Before" is shown.-Cause-On the action of closing period 12 of a fiscal year or a fiscal year itself, system checks if the period 12 of the fiscal year can be closed without issue. In case of problem a veto check is raised in our case the veto refers to fixed asset depreciation. It is likely that some assets still need to be depreciated in the year you are trying to close period 12 or the full fiscal year itself.-Fixed assets should be depreciated for all the valuation views of all the set of books assigned to the company for which you want to close the period 12 or the fiscal year. In other words, the posted depreciation amount should equal the planned depreciation for all the valuation views of all the set of books assigned to the company for which you want to close the period 12 or the fiscal year.-Resolution-You need to check if any depreciation (irrespective of the valuation views) has been missed in the fiscal year you want to close period 12 of the fiscal year itself.-1) If the Balance Carry Forward has not been done, you can perform a Depreciation Run in Test Mode for the period 12 of the fiscal year you want to close and check the logs to see if any depreciation postings are simulated. You need to run this for all the valuation views of all the set of books assigned to the company for which you want to close period 12 or the fiscal year.-Go to the Fixed Asset work centre.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view and Depreciation sub-view.-Click the New button and select the option Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Enter the Data Selection for the new run.-Company: enter the company for which you want to perform the closing process.-Set of Books: leave the field empty therefore all set of books assigned to the company will be included.-Valuation View ID: leave the field empty therefore all Valuation Views assigned to all set of books assigned to the company will be included.-Mark the Test Run checkbox.-On completion of the test depreciation run open the Logs Results.-Go to the tab Postings to check if any simulated postings have been initiated.-Go to the tab Processed Fixed Assets to check which assets for which valuation view have been processed.-2) You can run the Depreciation report available in the Fixed Asset work centre to compare the Planned Depreciation and the Posted Depreciation.-Go to the Fixed Asset work centre.-Go to the Reports view and List sub-view.-Select the Depreciation report.-Enter the Variables to run the report.-Company: enter the company for which you want to perform the closing process.-Set of Books: you need to enter a set of books assigned to the company (you need to run the report for all set of books assigned to the concerned company, but you only can enter 1 set of books at a time)-Valuation View ID: you need to enter a valuation view assigned to the set of books entered previously (you need to run the report for all valuation views assigned to the entered set of books, but you only can enter one valuation view at a time).-Accounting Period/Year: enter the fiscal year you want to close or for which you want to close the period 12.-On running the report for the variables entered, change the default view, Planned Values, of the report to the view Posted / Planned Values.-Compare the posted depreciation amount and the planned depreciation amount for the selection entered in the report variables.-Optionally you can drill down to know which assets have not been depreciated by adding the Fixed Asset field from the Not Currently Shown area-If the test depreciation run performed has simulated postings or if you notice a difference between the posted depreciation amount and the planned depreciation amount in the Depreciation report, a Depreciation run has to be performed in update mode to post the initially missing depreciation.-Go to the Fixed Asset work centre.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view and Depreciation sub-view.-Click the New button and select the option Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Enter the Data Selection for the new run.-Company: enter the company for which you want to perform the closing process.-Set of Books: leave the field empty therefore all set of books assigned to the company will be included.-Valuation View ID: leave the field empty therefore all Valuation Views assigned to all set of books assigned to the company will be included.-Uncheck the Test Run flag.-On completion of the test depreciation run open the Logs Results.-Go to the tab Postings to check the postings initiated.-In case the Balance Carry Forward process has been completed; you need to reverse it completely to be able to perform the Depreciation run in update mode.-If, from a financial perspective, you do NOT detect any missing depreciation, create an case as the error message "Closing of <fiscal year> not possible, depreciation run has to be started before" is caused by another reason.-Keywords-depreciation run; fiscal year; balance carryforward; BCF; posted; planned

Title: PSM Request For System Administrative Data Under Identity Business Object
Content: Symptom-You need read access to the System Administrative Data fields under Identity business object.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Please check if a Reuse Library would serve the requirement. The Reuse Library would take Identity UUID as input and would return the System Administrative Data - "last change date time" and "last change by" fields as output.-More info about Reuse Library can be found in Working with the Studio Library.-Keywords-System Administrative Data, Identity

Title: System Crashes While Trying to Post Cancellation Customer Invoice to an Alternate Posting Date
Content: Symptom-The system crashes when trying to post a cancellation customer invoice to an alternate posting date.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view --> Unposted Source Documents list.-Find cancellation customer invoice ABC (ABC means the cancellation customer invoice ID).-Click Actions --> Post Business Transaction to Another Period.-Enter respective Alternate Posting Date that falls in an open accounting period.-Click OK.-System crashes.-Cause-One of the possible reasons is that a manual adjusting entry for accounts receivable (which means a journal entry voucher with Journal Entry Type -'00085 - Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable' and Business Transaction Type '627 - Manual Adjusting Entry for Accounts Rec.') is posted with reference to the original customer invoice DEF (DEF means the original customer invoice ID), which later has been canceled via ABC. Such adjustment posting prevents the posting of the cancellation customer invoice ABC.-Remark: the same issue might occur in the Payables side, which would have involved the following documents:-Original supplier invoice.-Manual adjusting entry for accounts payable (which means a journal entry voucher with type '00084 - Manual Entry for Accounts Payable' and Business Transaction Type '625 - Manual Adjusting Entry for Accounts Pay.').-Cancellation supplier invoice.-Resolution- The adjustment journal entry voucher should be reversed first. Once it's reversed, the cancellation invoice (either customer invoice or supplier invoice) can be posted.-SAP Product Management Team is working for a better handle of such issue so that the exception is treated and instead of a system crash an error message would be displayed informing about the existence of the manual adjustment journal entry voucher.-Keywords-SIV; CIV; cancellation invoice; JEV; manual adjustment; journal entry voucher

Title: How To Remove Auto Approval of Project Time and Expenses Created by Project Manager
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-No self- approval is required for project manager to approve time recorded against the project and expenses report created against project.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Choose the Approvals view.-Choose the Time Recordings subview for time recordings and Expenses and Purchases subview for expenses.-Here you can see that if Project manager records time against project and creates expense report against project, approver determined in the system is themselves only. Hence this employee will be able to approve his /her own expense report.-Cause-The approver of the project time recoding and expense report cannot be set by the user manually as it's automatically determined by the system. By default, the approver is project manager for both time and expenses.-You may have a requirement that for this case the approval task of time recording, and expense report should be sent to his/her reporting line manager.-Resolution-Case 1.-No Self – Approval to approve the time recordings done against the project by the Project Manager.-To overcome this issue, we have an option in SAP Business ByDesign where the project manager time recording would go to the project manager's Line manager for approval (Managing My Area -> Confirm Time Recording). This feature is enabled via a backend Business Configuration option.-First check in Business Configuration - Implementation Projects - Steps 4 Questions to see if the option is already available, click on Human Resources - Time and Labor Management - Approval and search for the question "Would you like to prevent automatic approval of project/task manager’s time recordings on their projects/tasks, and set their RLU manager as approver?" under Group: Self Approval for Time Recordings.-If the scoping question is not available, kindly forward the incident to development component SRD-HR-TLM and ask them to choose option: BO_OD_HCM_MAPL -Manager Approval for Project Lead's Project Time Recordings.-Case 2.-No Self – Approval to approve the expenses report created against the project by the Project Manager.-To overcome from this issue, we have an option in SAP Business ByDesign the project manager No self-approval for Cost Center/Project Manager neither cost center managers nor project managers can self-approve expense reports claimed by them. Their line managers have to approve the expense report instead. this feature is enabled via a backend report ERM_SET_APPROVAL_SWITCH option to do so kindly forward the incident to development component AP-ERM-ER or you can also change the settings from the backend;-1. Go to the backend system.-2. Run the transaction code SE38.-3. Enter the report ERM_SET_APPROVAL_SWITCH and Execute.-4. You can see the current ERM approval settings.-5. Choose radio button for one of below options according to customer requirement:-Line manager-No self- approval for CC Mngr-No self- approval for PRO Mngr-No self- approval for CC/PRO Mngr-6. Click execute.-See Also- 2409103 - Project Time Recordings Submitted by Project Manager are not Going for Approval -Keywords-Self approval of project Time recording, Self approval of project expense report, No self approval for Project Manager

Title: Error Message: 'New Time interval Must Start After Last Cost Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY' when Adding New Assignment Internal for a Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You're trying to add a new assignment interval for a fixed asset, however, the following error is displayed-New time interval must start after last cost posting date DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for the required fixed asset.-Click on Edit.-Go to master data tab > Basic data > All Assignments Interval >Add row > Enter the new date-Message error: New time interval must start after last cost posting date DD.MM.YYYY-Cause-You have already posted a Cost posting for the respective fixed asset, for example: Depreciation run.--Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-You can check if there is a Journal entry already posted for the fixed asset as follows:-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for the required fixed asset and open it.-Click on View All.-Go to Values tab > Journal subtab.-To solve the issue, the start date of the new Assignment Intervals must be on or after the last cost posting date.-Keywords-fixed asset, new assignment interval, valididity date, star date, FA

Title: Payment Allocation - Posting Date Must Not be Before Initial Migration Date
Content: Symptom-You want to release a payment allocation ID but an error message appears: Posting Date MM-DD-YYYY, must not before initial migration date MM-DD-YYYY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management workcenter.-Navigate to the Payment Allocation view.-Show All Payment Allocations and search for the specific ID.-Click Go.-Select Edit and then Release.-The error message appears: Posting Date MM-DD-YYYY, must not before initial migration date MM-DD-YYYY.-Cause-The Posting Date for Initial Migration is not set correctly.-To find out the Posting Date for Initial Migration:-Go to the General Ledger workcenter and navigate to the Master Data view.-Select the Companies subview.-Here the Posting Date for Initial Migration is displayed for your company/-ies.-Resolution-The initial migration date must be in the past when the company was initially migrated.-Create an case and request support to set the correct Posting Date for Initial Migration via backend correction.-Keywords-posting date for initial migration

Title: Unable to Cancel the Purchase Order due to System Crash
Content: Symptom-You are unable to cancel the Purchase Order because a dump is being triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID.-Click in Edit button.-Click in Cancel Purchase Order button. -The dump is triggered.-Cause-You need to ensure that the communication arrangement with the Supplier is successful. Otherwise the system prevents the cancellation being output by triggering the dump.-Following the steps below you can check if the communication arrangement is being maintained correctly:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to General tab.-Double-click in the Supplier ID.-Navigate to Communication tab.-Navigate to Collaboration subtab.-Click in Maintain XML Settings button.-Navigate to Technical Data tab.-Navigate to Outbound subtab.-Click in Check Connection button.-If you get the error messages below, the communication arrangement is not being maintained accordingly:-Checking connection failed-Ping failed-Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: Processing error in Internet Communication Framework: ("ICF Error when receiving the response: ICM_HTTP_TIMEOUT") ()-Resolution-First option: you can change the Output Channel for the canceled Purchase Order.-Open the Purchase Order.-Click in You Can Also button.-Maintain another Output Channel.-Second option: if you need to use the communication arrangement with the Supplier as XML, you need to maintain it accordingly.-Please check steps in 2604833 or 2926863 to correct the connection issue.-See Also-KBA: 2604833 - ICM_HTTP_CONNECTION_BROKEN Error When Checking Connection in Communication Arrangement-KBA: 2926863 - Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Internal Server Error (500) While Performing Check Connection to Success Factors-Keywords-Purchase Order, Cancel, Dump, Communication Arrangement, Supplier

Title: Data Extraction Of Customer Is Inconsistent For Tab Document Output Channels On Email Addresses
Content: Symptom-Data Extraction of Customer is Inconsistent for Tab Document Output Channels on e-mail addresses-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter.-Go to Data Extraction view.-Choose New.-Select Extraction Object: CUSTOMERS - Customers without selection criteria.-Select Activate and Run.-Download the extracted Data.-Open it using Excel.-Go to tab Document Output Channels.-Compare the displayed value for E-mail Settings with what is displayed in the UI for on particular Account ID: it is not consistent.-Cause-Currently the Data Extraction as well as the Migration can only handle one instance of the same recipient type code for e-mail channel per  document. For Example for a particular account for business document Sales Order Confirmation, there are more than one entry with recipient type TO.-Resolution-This feature is not available.-A workaround to get at least more correct extract result (with just a "TO" e-mail address) would be to skip the additional "TO" emails and extract only the "first" one. Then the extract file will work for the migration as well.-Alternatively, ByDesign offers the functionality of Multi-Channel Output. If this is scoped in the system, the Migration and the Data extraction also support multiple emails address per type of recipients.-The Multichannel for Document Output can be enabled as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select your project and click Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Open the Elements under the Path: Communication and Information Exchange -> Business Process Management -> Process-Integrated Input and Output Management.-In the group Enabling Multichannel for Document Output activate the following question:-Do you want to send the process-integrated output documents via multiple output channels?-See Also-2911155 - How to Define Multiple Output Channels-Keywords-Data Extraction of Customer, Document Output Channels, Customers without selection criteria

Title: Error Message 'Exchange rate for currency XYZ and missing' when you create Dunning Run
Content: Symptom-You create a Dunning Run but in the Application Log ID you have the error message 'Exchange rate for currency XYZ and missing' (XYZ represents the Currency in the Invoice) and the Run is not executed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables workcenter.-Go to the Dunning Runs view.-Click New > Dunning Run and follow the steps.-Click the Application Log ID in Execution Details.-You find the error message: 'Exchange rate for currency XYZ and missing'.-Cause-No Currency is maintained in the Activity Dunning Strategies.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Activity 'Dunning Strategies' and open it.-Click on Edit Dunning Strategies.-Add a currency in the subtab General, Dunning Currency.-See Also- 3322901 - Error message "Exchange rate for currency ABC and DEF missing" is raised when you execute a Dunning Run for Receivables.-Keywords-Dunning Strategies, Dunning Currency, Dunning Run-cycles de relance,mahnläufe,dunning strategies,dunning currency

Title: User Cannot Create New Business Users Or Service Agents Using Initial User
Content: Symptom-The user is not able to create new Business Users or Service Agents with initial user details.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The initial user does not have the Business Partners or Business Partner Data work center, depending on the SAP solution.-Cause-The initial user of a new tenant is required to finish and deploy the scoping before he can create a Service Agent.-Resolution-The access to Service Agent creation is possible only after confirming the milestone Scoping Completed. To do so, complete the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Select the relevant scope and click Finish.-After performing the above steps, the status of the First Implementation project in the Business Configuration work center is In Preparation. Now deploy the scope:-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Open the activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted and check the Design Accepted box, then click Confirm.-Close the activity.-Close the activity list.-A message is displayed in the middle of the Implementation Projects screen: “Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted in process.” Confirming the milestone can take up to 30 minutes to complete. Refresh the view periodically to check the status. Once finished, the message disappears, the Design Accepted milestone shows a green status and the First Implementation project status shows as Started. The initial user must log off and log back into the solution. Now the user has the Business Partners or Business Partner Data work center, depending on the SAP solution, in which he can create a Service Agent.-Note: if after doing all the above steps, the Initial User is still not be able to create a Service Agent, please report an case to SAP Support.-Keywords-Initial User, Create, Service Agent, First Implementation, Confirm Milestone, Design Accepted

Title: Aging List for Payables Report Key Figures Based on Default Company Currency Exchange Rate
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Aging List for Payables report (Report ID FINDUEU04_Q0006) is using the Default Company Currency exchange rate to calculate the Key Figures.-You want to use a Custom Company Currency exchange rate.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Go to the List sub view.-Find the Aging List for Payables report and open it.-Run the report.-Note: Display Currency field is defaulted to Default Company Currency.-Cause-This is the expected SAP Business ByDesign system behavior for the standard report Aging List for Payables.-Resolution-All Key Figures in Aging List for Payables report are based on Default Company Currency exchange rates.-In case the display currency is changed to a different currency, for example, EUR, few suppliers still shows the transaction currency. This is due to missing exchange rates maintained between the two currencies.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Aging List for Payables-SAP Help Portal: Currency Conversion Profiles-KBA 1950627 - Report Default Currency Different From the Company Currency-KBA 2411412 - Cash Position by Transaction Source Report Shows the Transaction Amount in USD Currency Which is not Expected-Keywords-Aging List; Payables; Report; Currency; Defaulted; Default; Payables; Conversion; Exchange; Rate

Title: Unable to Create a New Administrative Category Other Than Those Delivered by SAP
Content: Symptom-You would like to create a new Administrative Category other than those options pre-delivered by SAP (Hourly, Manager and Salaried Employee).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Regular Tasks work center view.-Select the tab for the relevant country/region.-Under Hiring section, select Hire Employee.-Fill the required fields.-Click Next.-Under the section Work Agreement Classification, select the drop-down for Administrative Category.-Only three options are available: Hourly, Manager and Salaried Employee.-Cause-For localized countries, it is not possible to create a new Administrative Category other than the three options delivered by SAP.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-In case of non-localized countries, please report an case to the Product Support so that the requirement can be checked with Globalization development.-Keywords-Administrative Category, Create, New, Non-Localized Countries

Title: Realized Revenue amount per Period Unexpected for Fix-Price Contract Item
Content: Symptom-You create a fix price contract item XYZ-XX in a foreign currency (XYZ-XX represents the contract item ID). -You assign a straight-line accrual method.-You check the Calculated Revenue per period in the foreign transaction currency and the Realised Revenue amounts in  local company currency:-For each period of the contract item's life span the same Calculated Revenue appears.-But the Realised Revenue amounts in company currency are different in each period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Sales Document Items view. -In the Accounting Data tab check the Revenues per Period table. -In the Calculated Revenue column the same amount appears for each period of the contract item's life span. -But in the Realised Revenue column the amounts appear very different in each period.-You try to translate the Calculated Revenue amounts into the Realised Revenue amounts, applying the respective valid exchange rate but the amounts are different. -Cause-When a contract item is maintained with a list price in a foreign currency then each revenue recognition run revalues the revenue to be realised based on the total contract item net value in company currency, valid on the posting date of the run.-The realised revenue is calculated as a delta of the net value to be realised in the period and the previously realised revenue. -So, comparing the calculated and realised revenue per period will not translate into transaction currency amount per period x Exchange Rate = Realised Revenue/ Company currency amount.-Example:-Company Currency: USD-Contract item XYZ-XX -Transaction Currency: EUR-Net Value: 12.000,00 EUR-This revenue is to be realised evenly across 12 periods: Calculated Revenue per period: 1.000,00 EUR -Period 1: -Exchange Rate EUR-USD: 1,194-Contract Iem Net value in company currency: 14.328,00 USD (12.000,00 EUR x  1,194) -Revenue to be realised per period: 1.194,00 USD (14.328,00 USD / 12)-Realised Revenue in period 1: 1.194,00 USD  [(14.328,00 USD / 12) x1]-Period 2: -Exchange Rate EUR-USD: 1,218-Contract item net value in company currency: 14.616,00 EUR (12.000,00 EUR x 1,218) -Revenue to be realised per period: 1.218,00 SUD (14.616,00 /12)-Revenue to be realised in period 2: 2.436,00 USD [(14.616,00 /12) x 2-Previously realised revenue (in period 1): 1.194,00 USD-Delta/Realised Revenue in period 2: 1.242,00 USD (2.436,00 USD - 1.194,00 USD)-Period 3: -Exchange Rate EUR-USD: 1,23-Contract item net value in company currency: 14.760,00 USD (12.000,00 EUR x 1,23)-Revenue to be realised per period: 1.230,00 (14.760,00 USD / 12)-Revenue to be realised in period 3: 3.690,00 USD [(14.760,00 USD / 12) x3]-Previously realised revenue: 2.436,00 USD-Delta/Realised Revenue in period 3: 1.254,00 USD-etc.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Once the contract item is completed (end date reached, invoicing status finished, fulfilment status finished) all deferrals or accruals posted due to exchange rate differences will be cleared with the following revenue recognition run.-See Also-Help Document: Revenue Recognition for Customer Contracts-KBA: 2609018 - How Exchange Rate is Derived for Different User's Time Zone-3095841 - IFRS 15 - Completed Customer Contract Item Still Considered For Revenue Recognition-Keywords-Revenue Recognition. Realised Revenue. Calculated Revenue. Contracts. Current Earned Revenues Amount. Total Revenue. Exchange Rate. Currency

Title: Cannot Post Warehouse Confirmation Because of Error: Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery ABC)
Content: Symptom-When the goods returned by customer arrive at the warehouse, you create a customer return notification, and then process the inbound delivery. After that you find out the related warehouse confirmation document is not posted to accounting due to the error message: Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery ABC).-ABC means the Inbound Delivery ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Not Posted Source Documents.-You can find there is a source document XYZ with the Source Document Type being 119 - Warehouse Confirmation-Choose View Business Transaction, the error message is  Referenced Customer Return Not Found (Inbound Delivery ABC).- or-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Work view.-You will see an open task with the Subject being Referenced Customer Return Not Found (Inbound Delivery ABC) or Referenced Customer Return Not Found.-Check the description of Referenced Customer Return Not Found (Inbound Delivery ABC), you can see: In the CRM Work Center, find the relevant customer return by searching via the inbound delivery reference give in the short text of this task. The inconsistency of the customer return needs to be resolved. Financial Accounting will then get informed and the goods receipt will be posted automatically. This task will then be completed automatically.-Cause-The customer return is not successfully sent to accounting due the following possible reasons:-Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing-Item XX: Customer invoice reference with ID DEF not valid; Reference with ID DEF and type customer invoice is not valid; Reference document missing for customer return HIJ-Tax Calculation failed-For the specified product and customer, the sales organization and distribution channel must match. Check the master data.-Resolution-In order to successfully post the warehouse confirmation document, first of all, follow the steps below to check the error message in the related customer return:-Go to the Sales Order work center, and then choose the Returns view.-Show All Returns, and then choose Advanced Search.-In the Reference ID field, enter the inbound delivery ID ABC, and then choose Go.-If there are no error messages in the customer return, you need to create an case to SAP to look at the issue in the backend.-Otherwise, you might see the following error messages:  -Error message: Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing, use KBA 1936639 - The Error Message "Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" is Triggered in a Customer Return .-Error message: Item XX: Customer invoice reference with ID DEF not valid; Reference with ID DEF and type customer invoice is not valid; Reference document missing for customer return HIJ, use KBA 1913150 - Unassigned Task has been Created for the Customer Return as well as 1818008 - How to Create a Customer Return without a Reference-Error message: For the specified product and customer, the sales organization and distribution channel must match. Check the master data. For the item with this error message, check the master data of the related product:-Go to the Product Data work center, choose the Materials view.-Select and edit the related product of the erroneous item.-You can see the maintained Distribution Chains.-Make sure the combination of the sales organization and the distribution channel in the customer return is maintained here.-After you fix all the issues in the customer return, choose Save. Then you can re-post the warehouse confirmation document XYZ:-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Not Posted Source Documents.-You can find there is a source document XYZ with the Source Document Type being 119 - Warehouse Confirmation.-Choose View Business Transaction, and then choose Post.-If the system gives you another error message saying the fiscal period is closed, you can try to post to another period, or re-open the closed period in order to post the document.-So far, the warehouse confirmation document can be posted; however, the status of the customer return might still be In Process. Because just fixing the issue in customer return and saving it cannot set the customer return to Completed if the customer return is released with a credit memo, and the credit memo is not posted yet.-You can then follow the steps below to set the customer return to Completed:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center, and select the Items to be Invoiced view.-Select the customer return, and then choose the Follow up button.-Create a credit memo, and on the new screen you can release the credit memo. This action automatically changes the status of the customer return to Completed.-If none of the above solutions can help you solve the issue, please create an case to report the issue.-Keywords-warehouse confirmation; customer return; unposted source document

Title: How to increase the log level for the Business ByDesing Excel Add-In
Content: Symptom-To troubleshoot issues with the Business ByDesign Add-In for Microsoft Excel, it could be necessary to increase the log level of the Add-In. This would produce more detailed log information. For performance reasons, this is not enabled by default.-Resolution-Create a text file locally with the following content and save it named "Severity_detailed.reg":-Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00-[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\SAP\Business ByDesign FrontEnd\CD\ClientConfig\Trace]-"Severity"="3"-[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\SAP\Business ByDesign FrontEnd\CD\ClientConfig\Trace]-"Severity"="3"-Double click the file Severity_detailed.reg and confirm the security warning.-Reproduce the issue in Excel.-Create a text file locally with the following content and save it named "Severity_normal.reg":-Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00-[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\SAP\Business ByDesign FrontEnd\CD\ClientConfig\Trace]-"Severity"="1"-[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\SAP\Business ByDesign FrontEnd\CD\ClientConfig\Trace]-"Severity"="1"-Double click the file Severity_ normal.reg and confirm the security warning.-For further analysis zip the following folders and attach them to an case:-Windows 7:        C:\Users\<<username>>\AppData\Roaming\SAP\-Windows Vista:   C:\Users\<< username >>\AppData\Roaming\SAP-Windows XP:      C:\Documents and Settings\<<username>>\ApplicationData\SAP\-Keywords

Title: Error "Cost Center XYZ Must Be Below a Profit Center. It Is Also Possible to Flag Both Definitions on The Same Org Unit"
Content: Symptom-When trying to check or activate your Org Structure, the system throws the below error messages:-Cost Center XYZ (XYZ represents the Org Unit ID) must be below a Profit Center. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same Org Unit.-Cost Center XYZ must be below a Business Residence. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same Org Unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organization Management work center.-Select the Org Structures view.-Click the Edit button.-Select the relevant Org Structure and click either Check Selected Structure or Activate Selected Structure.-The above-mentioned error messages occur.-Cause-The reason behind this error is because Org Unit XYZ is defined as a Cost Center, but is not under an Org Unit with Profit Center and Business Residence definitions.-Resolution-Please either move Org Unit XYZ to be below an Org Unit that is also a Profit Center and a Business Residence, or add these definitions to Org Unit XYZ's parent unit.-If the issue still occurs after that, please report an case.-Keywords-Below, Profit Center, Cost Center, Org Unit

Title: Is it Possible to Delete a Holiday from a Holiday Calender?
Content: Symptom-You have observed that an irrelevant holiday is included in the Holiday Calendar, and would like to know, whether this holiday can be deleted?-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-It is not possible to delete a holiday from SAP delivered calendar. This would cause problems to existing customers who are using this Holiday Calendar. But you can create your own Holiday calendar and exclude the irrelevant holiday (existing holiday calendar).-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation project view. -Select Open Activity list button.-Select Fine Tune chevron.-Select Working Day Calendar activity under Built-in support and services.-Select Create new Holiday Calendar under Main Actions.-Select the country from the list of countries and select the check box Use General Holiday Calendar template for selected country.-Select Next button.-Here you can, select or unselect the required holiday from the Holiday list.-To create a new holiday, Select the Add button. A new window pops up.-Fill in the Name, Description and Date. (You can Provide any name of your choice).-Select Ok button.-Select Finish to create a New Holiday Calendar.-You may want to assign newly created holiday calendar to a working day calendar. Select fine tuning activity Working Day Calendar.-Select Maintain an existing Working Day Calendar.-Here you need to select the Working Day Calendar. Note if you are using the SAP predelivered working day calendar, you are not allowed to update it. So you have to create your own working day calendar to use the newly created holiday calendar.-Select Next button.-Here you can assign the new holiday calendar and select Next button until step 5 (Review).-Select Finish button.-Note: In case the holiday is incorrect according to the current law, or a legal holiday is missing, please open an SAP case.-Keywords-impossible, unable, not able

Title: Not Able to Add Extension Field to Outgoing Bank Transfer and Outgoing Check Screen
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add an Extension Field to the Outgoing Bank Transfers and Outgoing Check, but you are not able to add it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the New Outgoing Bank Transfer common task.-Click on the Key User Settings.-Start the Adaptation Mode.-Click on the '+' sign on the bottom of the screen.-See that it is not possible to add an Extension Field.-Cause-For New Outgoing Bank Transfer and Outgoing Check screen, Payment Order and Bank Payment Order BO's are involved here. Bank Payment Order is currently not write-released for PSM due to the underlying complexity and the placement of the BO in the process-chain.-This is one of the factors that is checked to determine if extensibility is possible or not, and hence why you do not see it in Key User Settings > Start Adaptation Mode.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system.-Keywords-Extension Field, Outgoing Bank Transfer, add, create, not possible, Outgoing check

Title: When Checking Compensation tab there are Two Different Compensation Rates for Overtime
Content: Symptom-It has set a Default Time Profile on the Employee Time File and left the Premium Pay field blank on the timesheet. On the employee's timesheet the Compensation Tab reflects two different Compensation Rates for Overtime. The transaction is posting at the correct rate, however, the timesheet appears to show the time being posted twice, two different rates and you would like to understand the reason.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration Work Center.-Go to the Time Recording View.-Select the Employee and click Open Time Sheet.-Select any time and go to Compensation information sub tab.-Here we can see two entries.-Resolution-It might be occurring because it has been maintained a different option of "US0001 - Regular" in "Default Value for Premium Pay" in Default Values for Time Recording activity. As a result, the system will consider the chosen option as Premium Pay when no Premium Pay is selected while time recording by user.-In order to confirm that, please, follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search for Default Values for Time Recording and open it.-Check the option selected in Default Value for Premium Pay.-There it is possible to confirm the option maintained for Default Value for Premium Pay.-Keywords-Compensation information, Compensation Rates, Time, Time Sheet
