Title: 'Allocation to cust./supplier and GL only possible for bank statement item' Error While Posting Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-The error 'Allocation to cust./supplier and GL only possible for bank statement item' is displayed while posting a payment allocation.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Open the allocation ID AAA (AAA means the payment allocation ID).-Click Post-Error is displayed:-'Allocation to cust./supplier and GL only possible for bank statement item'-Cause-The allocation ID AAA does not have Preceding Document Type Bank Statement (for example, it could be Incoming Check, Manual Payment, Payment Advice, etc) and you have split the allocated amount between Customer/Supplier and G/L Account(s).-Resolution-The split of allocated amount to Customer/Supplier and G/L Account(s) is not allowed for any other source documents other than bank statements.-The system behaves as designed here.-Keywords-payment allocation; bank statement

Title: Employee Responsible for Sales Order is not the the same displayed in Created By for Purchase Order Third-Party
Content: Symptom-You create a third-party Sales Order and you notice that the Purchase Order released has a Created By different from the Employee Responsible in the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select Sales Order view.-Search for the relevant document and open it.-See that the Employee Responsible is Employee 1.-Navigate to Document Flow.-Open the Purchase Order linked.-See that the Created By is Employee 2.-In the Sales Orders navigate to Approval Process tab.-See that the approver is Employee 2.-Cause-In the Sales scenario the responsible is Employee 1, but as soon as Employee 2 approves this document the system releases the Purchase Order as part from third-party scenario, so the employee that trigger this release is the responsible, in this case the approver.-If the document did not go to approval the documents could have the same responsible, but in this case, the employee should be responsible for the Sales and the Purchase scenario.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-You can either provide access to both scenarios for the same employee or just leave it as it is.-Keywords-Sales Order, Purchase Order, Third-Party, Employee Responsible, Created By

Title: Notes From Goods and Services Receipt Are Not Carried to Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the Notes in the Goods Services Receipt for both Header and Item levels however those values are not carried to the Journal Entry.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to Receipts and Returns view.-Go to Show by Documents subview.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Goods and Services Receipt ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Navigate to Notes subtab.-You can see the Notes related to the item level here.-Navigate to Notes tab.-You can see the Notes related to the header level here.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-Click in the icon corresponding to the Goods and Services Receipt's Journal Entry.-In Line Items section, click in the line related to the Item of the Goods and Services Receipt.-You can see that the field 'Item Text' does not have the text maintained in the Notes.-Cause-The 'Item Text' field maintained in the Journal Entry of the Goods and Services Receipt has the same value of the 'Product Description' of the item. So if the Product Description of the Item is 'XYZ', the Item Text field will have the value of 'XYZ' as well.-We have screenshots of our internal system to illustrate this scenario. All the data informed is fictional and not related to reality.-The first screenshot shows the Goods and Services Receipt document and the item's Product Description:-The second screenshot shows the Goods and Services Receipt's Journal Entry. You can see that the 'Item Text' field has the same value of the 'Product Description' field shown in last picture:-Resolution-This scenario is the system's excepted behavior.-See Also-KBA: 3309757 - Text Fields in Journal Entry Does Not Match The Notes Of Supplier Invoice-KBA: 3170458 - Note on purchase order cannot be passed to supplier invoice-Keywords-Journal Entry; Goods and Services Receipt; Item Text; Notes

Title: Purchase Order Acknowledgment Status is not Updated by Purchase Order Interactive Form
Content: Symptom- Purchase Order Interactive form reply from supplier is not updating Purchase Order Acknowledgment status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the ABC (ABC means the Purchase Order ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-There is a Process Communication Error: Purchase Order ABC cannot process an update sent by an external consumer-Cause-The Global Location Number maintained for the Company has more than 13 characters.-Please follow the steps below:-Open Purchase Order ABC.-Navigate to General tab.-Double-click in the Company's ID.-You can check that customer has maintained Global Location Number XYZ (XYZ means the Global Location Number).-Resolution-Firstly please delete the current Global Location Number or maintain one which has 13 characters or less.-Secondly you can create an incident so Support side can cancel or restart the Process Communication Error in the backend. If you do not want to create an incident, after updating the Interactive form the Purchase Order Acknowledgment status will change to 'Acknowledgment Received'.-Keywords-Global Location Number; Purchase Order; Acknowledgment

Title: Payment Media Run Finishes in Error With Message '0 remittance advices not created'
Content: Symptom-A Payment Media Run finishes with Overall Status Errors Occurred and message '0 remittance advices not created'.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view --> Payment Media Runs subview.-Find the respective Run ID, Execution ID and Application Log ID.-Open the respective Application Log ID that shows Maximum Severity in red (3 - Error).-Notice the Overall Status Errors Occurred and the message '0 remittance advices not created'.-Your expectation is that the run managed to create the remittance advices.-Cause-There's a backend system crash recorded as a result of the run's execution. The reason for the crash is that there's no address maintained in the master data of the respective suppliers for which the remittance advices are to be created.-Resolution-An address should be maintained in the respective supplier(s) master data, under Communication tab > Addresses sub-tab.-After that, the payment media run should be executed again.-See Also- 2824062 - System Crashes While Previewing an Advice-Keywords-Advice; remittance advice; address; payment media run; PDF; FOPXF_PEXPL not valid

Title: When Checking Access Rights Change Logs there are Unrecognized Changes
Content: Symptom-You noticed that there are some changes in Access Rights Change tab performed by your user that are not recognized.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business Users View.-Select the User and click Edit -> Access Rights.-Go to Changes tab.-There are some change logs that are not recognized by you.-Cause-It might occur because changes were performed in Access Rights before, however they were not published. When updating the User the pending changes were also applied.-Resolution-Expected System Behavior.-Please make sure to review and publish the current access rights of the roles.-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go Business Roles View.-Select the requested Business Role and click Edit.-Click Assigned Users button -> Select Update users.-Keywords-Access Rights, Changes, Logs

Title: The Company Name is Displayed in English in the Closing Cockpit Though User is Logged in the Chinese System Environment
Content: Symptom-You've logged in Chinese in the Closing Cockpit, however the company name is displayed in English-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger workcenter-Closing Cockpit View and choose the Closing Cockpit Subview-Open the activity XXX and you find that the display language(English) is different than the system logon language(Chinese). -Cause-The reason is that while entering the specified data, the user had logged on with display language(English), hence data displayed is created in Display (English) though the system login language is different (Chinese)-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger workcenter-Closing Cockpit View and choose the Closing Cockpit Subview-Personalize Option Chose My settings-Regional settings and click on Language-Here the data entered with a different language rather than the scoped system envirnoment(language) and therefore the data will get displayed only in (English) even though the users logs in the different language and environment(Chinese)-Keywords-Closing Cockpit, Language, General Ledger.

Title: Payments Runs are Pending in Closing-Relevant Tasks
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the closing-relevant task list contains the payment runs that have already been finished.-Now, you would like to know how you can avoid having processed and finalized payment runs in the closing-relevant task list. You think that the payment runs shouldn't appear on that list when they are finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Closing Cockpit view.-You will see a list of tasks in process status with the following description: -'Review Supplier Payments in Payment Run XYZ'.-(XYZ represents the payment run ID).-Cause-One possible reason is that the tasks are created due to payment runs are postponed and voided several times.-You can check the payment runs following the steps below:-Go to Payables work center. -Go to Payment Runs subview. -Select All Payment Runs in the dropdown list. -Search for the Run ID XYZ. -You can see the payment run is voided. -The payment runs were voided and are in Obsolete status and system creates a task for this.-Resolution-You need to manually clear these tasks as they were generated because the payment runs were voided. You should not obsolete so many payment runs in general. Please check the steps below:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Closing-Relevant Tasks view.-Search for the task.-Click Actions button > Open details.-Open the payment run and click Actions -> Complete.-Click Save and close.-Now, you are able to close the task.-We request you to not obsolete the payment runs. Once you cancel, you need to check the relevant task immediately and close it.-Keywords-Closing Cockpit; Tasks; Review Supplier Payments in Payment Run; in process; Obsolete

Title: Balance is not Showing Correctly in Employee Time Accounts Report
Content: Symptom-In Employee Time Accounts Report the Balance is not showing correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Data Sources View.-Select Employee Time Accounts and click Preview button.-In Selection section, set the Employee and the Time Account Type.-In View section in Row Fields click + and select the following:-Employee ID-Posting Date-Time Account Processing Period End Date-Time Account Processing Period Start Date-Time Account Type-You will see Balance is being shown as 0,00.-Cause-The 'Preview' option in Business Analytics Work Center for data source does not allow the entry of a time series.-Resolution-Please try executing 'Time Account Balances' Report from the Time Administration Work Center which uses data source HCMTLMU06.-This data source can be used for custom report developments too or specific views can be created on the standard delivered report as mentioned above.-Keywords-Time Account Balances, Balances, Report, Wrong

Title: 'Output quantity exceeds input quantity' Error in Actual Cost Rollup Run
Content: Symptom- An error is raised upon execution of Actual Cost Rollup Run:-'Output quantity exceeds input quantity'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view -> Actual Cost Rollup subview.-Find the respective Run ID and Execution ID (which contain Error) and open it.-Move to Messages tab-Notice the error below for Material ID ABC (ABC means the Material ID):-'Output quantity exceeds input quantity'-Cause-The error indicates that the Material ABC has consumed more than the available inventory quantity which will lead to negative inventory quantity.-This can be checked by the on-hand quantity of referred material for the period in which the Actual Cost Rollup run has been executed.-Resolution-To correct the error, you need to add enough stock with back-dated posting before the consumptions were done which led to negative stock.-Keywords- actual cost rollup run; stock; quantity; inventory; material

Title: Text Fields in Journal Entry Does Not Match The Notes Of Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the Notes in the Supplier Invoice however those Notes are not carried to the resulting Journal Entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos.-Search for ABC (ABC is the ID of the Supplier Invoice).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Document Flow.-Open its Journal Entry.-Check the Header Text field.-Then check the value shown for Item Text field for each item.-You expected that the values would reflect the content of the notes maintained in ABC, but the values are different or they are blank.-Cause-The Header Text field retrieves data from the Supplier Invoice's Invoice Description field. This field is maintained in the invoice's General tab. If no data is maintained in Invoice Description, the Header Text will be blank.-The Item Text field retrieves data from the invoice's item Description. If the item does not have Description, the data is copied from the Header Text. If either is maintained, the field will be blank.-Resolution-This scenario is the designed system behavior.-See Also-KBA: 2827642 - Item Text in Journal Entry Does Not Match The Item Description Of The Source Document-KBA: 3170458 - Note on purchase order cannot be passed to supplier invoice-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Journal Entry; Header Text; Item Text; Notes

Title: RFQ sent from wrong E-Mail Address
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a specific E-Mail address for Created RFQ in Output Channel Selection, however RFQ are sent from a different E-Mail address.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Application and User Management-Select the view Output Channel Selection-Show Rules For > Created RFQ & click Go-From here you have maintained a specific Sender E-Mail-However, when RFQ are created and sent, the Sender E-Mail address is not the one you have maintained in Output Channel Selection-Cause-This is currently the expected system behaviour with Created RFQ, Canceled RFQ and Purchasing Contract.-The system will pick the E-Mail address from the Employee Responsible master data by default and will use it as the Sender E-Mail Address instead of what is maintained in Output Channel Selection-Resolution-Our Development Team is currently working to enhance this functionality such as the E-Mail address maintained in Output Channel Selection could be the one used by default for the 3 business objects mentioned.-This improvement will appear in future ByD release.-Keywords-Default Sender E-Mail, Created RFQ, Canceled RFQ, Purchasing Contract, Employee Responsible.

Title: Error message 'Commitment cannot exceed total commitment of employee in project' when planning hours in the Availability Calendar
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to add hours in your Availability Calendar you receive an error message 'Commitment cannot exceed total commitment of employee in project' for some projects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Resource Management work center (alternatively, this work center view can also be accessed through the Project Management work center).-Go to Resource Search view.-Search for the relevant user.-Click on Show Availability button.-Select the relevant line of the Project.-Enter the amount of hours and Hit enter on the keyboard.-See the error message "Commitment cannot exceed total commitment of employee in project".-Cause-The hours inserted in the availability calendar exceed the maximum commitment hours defined for the resource.-Resolution-In order to check the maximum commitment for a given resource, follow the below steps:-Project Management -> Resource Search (alternatively, this work center view can also be accessed through the Resource Management work center).-Select the resource and click on the Maintain Commitments button.-Here you can define how many hours per day the resource is allowed to work for a given project.-Keywords-Availability, Resource Management, Availability Calendar, Committed Work, Projects

Title: Error: Number range depleted while saving new Tax Authority
Content: Symptom-You try to create a new Tax Authority and get error message 'Number range depleted' when saving it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center-Select Tax Authorities view and hit new -> Tax authority-Enter Mandatory and Relevant data to see error message: Number range depleted-Cause-Depleted Internal Number range-Resolution-Increase the internal number range by following the below path.-Go to Business Configuration-Go to Overview-Search and open the activity General Business Partners.-Select Define Number Ranges for Business Partners.-Maintain the Internal number range to be sufficiently large, but without intersecting with the other ranges-Once this is done, save the new tax authority and it works without any errors.-Keywords-Number Range, Master Data, Tax Authority

Title: 'Posting date 00.00.0000 must not be before last retrmt date 99.99.9999 of fixed asset ABC' Error in Partial Transfer of Individual Material
Content: Symptom-You want to execute the Partial Transfer of Individual Material for asset ABC (ABC means the fixed asset ID). This asset has the Last Retirement Date set to 12.11.2022. However, you want to post the partial transfer on 01.10.2022.-System is showing the error messages:-Posting date 00.00.0000 must not be before last retrmt date 12.11.2022 of fixed asset ABC.-Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Go to Fixed Assets subview.-Search for asset ABC.-Click Manual Posting button and select Partial Transfer of Individual Material.-Fill in the necessary information.-Click Post button.-Errors are thrown:-Posting date 00.00.0000 must not be before last retrmt date 12.11.2022 of fixed asset ABC.-Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated.-Cause-No postings are permitted before the asset's Last Retirement Date.-The Last Retirement Date shows the date on which the last retirement posting occurred for this fixed asset, either partially or completely, due to a sale, a scrapping or a complete transfer, and can be checked in Master Data tab --> Life Cycle Data subtab of the referred asset.-Resolution-The transfer can only be posted after 12.11.2022.-Keywords-partial transfer; individual material; imat; last retirement date

Title: The "External Reference" field is Not Editable in Over-the-Counter Sale Transaction.
Content: Symptom-The External Reference field is not editable in Over-the-Counter sale transaction.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Over-the-Counter sales work center.-2. Create a new Over-the-Counter sales transaction from Common Tasks.-3. The external reference field is grayed out.-Cause-This is the designed behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-The field External Reference is not supported in the Over-the-Counter Sale transaction.-As a workaround you can create an extension field in the Over-the-Counter Sale UI to add the reference purchase order ID.--Additionally you can raise a new functionality request or can contact SAP Service Center for customization.

Title: Field "Payment Terms" that has been set as Mandatory is not Working as Expected in Supplier
Content: Symptom-You set Payment Terms field as mandatory in Supplier, however you noticed that it is possible to save the new Supplier without filling the field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base Work Center. -Go to Suppliers View.-Click add -> New Supplier.-In the Basic View the field Payment Terms is set as mandatory. If you try to save the new Supplier without filling the field, it does not work and the error message appears: Save rejected because field (Payment Terms) is defined as mandatory by key user.-If you click "View all" and if the user does not navigate or open the “Purchasing” tab, you can proceed to save the Supplier file without errors.-Cause-In the basic view, the field "Payment Terms" is rendered, so it is possible to check whether it is filled with a value and give the error message. After clicking "View all", the origin screen is over, and it starts with a new different screen. The mandatory of the field is captured only after it is rendered on the page. Therefore in the "General" view it is not possible to know that "Payment Terms" is a mandatory field and it can be saved successfully.-Resolution-Product limitation.-We would suggest creating a PDI extension which is registered to the SAVE event of the supplier/business partner.-Keywords-Mandatory Field, Payment Terms

Title: "No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between X and Y" Error in Custom Solution
Content: Symptom-You are performing operations related to Time Administration in a custom work center view, and the following error is raised when trying to save:-"No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between X and Y" (where X and Y represent two dates)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The employee which is being changed does not have a time account and time account rule assigned in the current time profile.-Resolution-In order to check and adjust the configuration, please follow the below steps:-Go to Time Administration.-Enter the view Employees.-Search for the employee and click on Edit.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently active time profile.-Scroll down and enter the sub-tab Time Account Rules.-Here you can check and assign time accounts for the employee, which are to be used in the operations of the custom solution.-See Also-3223421 - Service Confirmation Can't be Released with Error "No time file or org. assignment without gaps found between and"-Keywords-Time Sheet, Time Recording, PDI

Title: Report Invoice With Exceptions Shows Wrong Invoice Value
Content: Symptom-Total invoice value showing on report Invoices with Exceptions is not the same as the value shown on the actual invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Reports view.-Search for report Invoices with Exceptions.-Open it.-Fill the necessary data to find your Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC is the invoice's ID).-Click in Apply.-You can see that the total value for ABC is XYZ (XYZ is the total value of the invoice).-However if you open invoice ABC, the total value is actually PQR (PQR is a value that is different from XYZ). So the value in the report is wrong.-Cause-This scenario is a known limitation owing to the design of the underlying data source and report. There involves a significant effort which cannot be fixed as a bug.-Resolution-You can join the data sources Supplier Invoice Item Details (SRMIV_B03) and Invoice Exceptions (SRMIX_U01) to create a report to meet your requirements. Then you can get the data of invoice value and exception information as expected.-Keywords-Supplier invoice; Exception; Report; Data Source

Title: How to Check if a Customer Tenant is Located in a Multi-Tenant system or in a Private Tenant System in the Cloud Reporting Tool
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to check in the Cloud Reporting Tool if a tenant is located in a Multi-Tenant system or in a Private Tenant System.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Following are the two ways available to identify if a tenant is hosted in a multi-tenant system or in a private tenant system in the Cloud Reporting Tool.-First Method:-Go to Cloud Reporting Tool.-Search the URL of the customer tenant.-Select the system ID (SID).-Scroll down to Tenant Overview information. (This option is also available in the right tab for quick access).-If the tenants displayed in the Tenant Overview are all from the same customer, then the system is a private tenant system.-If the tenants displayed in the Tenant Overview are all from different customers, then the system is a multi-tenant system.-Second Method:-Go to Cloud Reporting Tool.-Search the URL of the customer tenant.-Select the system ID (SID).-Verify the Description field for the below information:-If the field Description shows the information MT system, then the system is a multi-tenant system.-If the field Description shows the customer name, then the system is a private system only for that customer.-Note: It is worth to mention that both methods will not always be available, but keep in mind that if one of the checks is valid, then is possible to guarantee the type of system where that tenant is located.-See Also-Please refer to the KBA below to find further tenant information in the Cloud Reporting Tool:-2512316 - How to check downtime(Planned/Unplanned Maintenance) for SuccessFactors and C4C/ByD customers-Keywords-cloud reporting tool, private system, multi-customer system, multi-tenant system, MT system, system ID, tenant URL.

Title: Time Recording Method not Available in API Node of Employee Time Agreement
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Unable to locate Time Recording Method in the backend Business Object Employee Time agreement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time sheet view.-Select the Employee XYZ.-Select Open Time Sheet tab.-Select You can also from top right corner > select Open Time File.-Go to Time Profile > Basic Data tab.-Time Recording Method is available -Here user can select and update the type of recording method (write)-Cause-The issues may be caused due to dependency, scoping logic, which is not possible for the write access-Time Recording Method works on the combination of two nodes.-1. Navigation- BO TIMX_AGREEMENT -> ROOT -> ITEM -> ITEM_PERIOD_PROVISIONS -> ITEM_PERIOD_TIM_REC_PROV- Nodes - COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE-2. Logic:-if COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND is true and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE is Null Then it is Positive-if COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND is true and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE is 1 Then it is Positive with Terminal Integration-if COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND is False and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE is Null Then it is Exception-based-Resolution-On any client system, it is not possible to PSM release Write type to the fields that choose the Time recording method.-The two fields mentioned are tightly coupled via logic and scoping comes into play when terminal integration is used on any BYD system.-The 2nd logic of positive with terminal integration ( Node EE_time_event_usage_code ) involves some settings in the time recording profile as well, for which there are no checks in the BO level. The logic for the time recording method is provided via the UI and not the Business object.-Therefore if ‘Write’ access was provided, the possibilities for inconsistencies to be created is high and therefore it cannot be offered in the standard solution.-See Also-Jira: [BYDDEV-2762] Multiple Batch / Bin STO Scenario - SAPJIRA -Keywords-Time recording , Write access, Employee Time Agreement

Title: No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_SALES_LEDGER_ACCOUNT
Content: Symptom-Not able to post Goods and Activity Confirmation due following error message:-'No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_SALES_LEDGER_ACCOUNT'-(Or)-'No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_SALES_LEDGER_ACCOUNT'-(Or)-'No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_PRODUCTION_LACCT'-XYZ means Set of Books ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find the unposted source document with error-No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_SALES_LEDGER_ACCOUNT (Or)-No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_SALES_LEDGER_ACCOUNT (Or)-No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_PRODUCTION_LACCT-Cause-You have not maintained the valuation data for at least one material which is being used in the respective Goods and Activity Confirmation. The following scenarios are possible in this case:-Either the inventory cost is not maintained at all or it is zero for the posting date of Goods and Activity Confirmation.-The inventory cost is maintained, but it is not valid for the posting date of Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Resolution-You should maintain material cost valuation data which is valid during the respective Source Document (Production Confirmation, Goods and Activity Confirmation or any other) proposed posting date and for the respective combination of company and business residence, as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find and open the respective unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Check if any of the Line Items has Identified Stock ID maintained.-In case it's maintained, click the ID and copy Product Specification ID displayed on the top.-Now open Product-ID ABC of the source document and click Valuation tab (ABC means the Material ID)-Select line item having Business Residence of the goods and activity confirmation and click Maintain Product Specification Valuation button.-Search for Product Specification ID as per step 5 and notice that for Set of Books XYZ the Valid From is outside the Proposed Posting Date of the source document.-In case no Identified Stock ID is maintained, just open the respective Product-ID/Material and check if cost is maintained under Valuation tab for the respective business residence and Proposed Posting Date.-Keywords-General Ledger; Unposted Source Document; GAC; Goods and Activity Confirmation; Issue for Service Confirmation; Valuation; Cost; Logistics Area ID; Product-ID; Identified Stock; FAI2D_VALUATION:003, Production Confirmation

Title: Field Document/Item ID not available under Details in the view Customer Invoicing - Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-When you open the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Requests view and select an Invoice you see that in details the field Document/Item ID is not being displayed in the table.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Requests view.-Filter for To Be Invoiced Invoice Requests.-Select an Invoice with the Invoice Requests Type as Sales Order Invoice Request.-See that under Details the field Document/Item ID is not being displayed.-Cause-This field is displayed accordingly with the Invoice Requests Type, when the invoice is created from a document that is not your source document the field will show up, e.g. Service Confirmation Invoice, Schedule Invoice Request, Customer Project Invoice Request will show the field, but document types as Sales Order Invoice Request, Manual Credit Memo Request, Over-the-Counter Sale, Manual Invoice Request will not show the field Document/Item ID because they are the source document.-See screenshots:-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Invoice Request, Document ID, Item ID, Details, OWL

Title: How to Download the Full Chain Certificate From SAP Business ByDesign System to Use in Peppol
Content: Symptom-You need to download the full chain certificate from SAP Business ByDesign system in order to upload the same in PEPPOL dashboard connect to service option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-It is possible to export certificate from browser and all chain certificate can be exported from main certificate which you can use for communication, as follows:-Open Google Chrome.-Login in the system.-Click the padlock next to the URL.-Select Connection is secure.-Click Certificate is valid.-Go to Details tab.-In Certificate Hierarchy, select option *.businessbydesign.cloud.sap.-Click Export. -Keywords-Certificate, Peppol, How to

Title: Receivables Balance Confirmation: Credit Memo ID is switched by Invoice ID in the generated PDF
Content: Symptom-You ran a Balance Confirmation for a customer, and when checking the Balances and Documents tab you realize that a Credit Memo has been included. However, when opening the Account Statement PDF you notice that the Document ID of the credit memo you just saw has been replaced by a different ID, an Invoice ID displayed under Invoice Number column.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center-Go to Customers > Balance Confirmation view-Open the concerned Balance Confirmation ID-Go to Balances and Documents tab-Here, notice that a Credit Memo is listed (Credit Memo Document ID is displayed)-Click Preview > Send Options-Click over the Template Name (e.g. Account Statement with Due Date List)-Open the PDF.-Here, notice that instead of Credit Memo Document ID, the system displays an Invoice ID under Invoice Number column.-However, all the data corresponds to the Credit Memo (e.g. Invoice Date, Original Amount, Due Date, etc.), so the system only switched the Credit Memo ID by the Invoice ID.-Cause-The concerned Credit Memo has been created as a follow up of the Invoice, and that is the reason why the system displays the Invoice ID instead of Credit Memo ID (this can be checked in the Document Flow of the Credit Memo).-For Credit Memos created as a follow up of Customer Invoices the system will always show the Invoice ID in the Balance Confirmation PDF.-If the Credit Memo is not created as a follow up of an invoice, then system displays the Credit Memo ID in the Balance Confirmation PDF.-Resolution-The system behaves as expected.-This logic has been added to Business ByDesign on January/2015 after feedback from several customers.-Keywords-Receivables Balance Confirmation, Balance Confirmation, Credit Memo ID , PDF, Invoice ID.

Title: Inconsistent Sales Quote ID and Preceding Opportunity ID Displayed in Sales Quote Item Data Source [CRMCQTIB]
Content: Symptom-In a scenario where you wish to display Sales Quote IDs and Preceding Opportunity IDs in the Sales Quote Item Data Source, some data is shown as '#' instead of the expected value.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Open the Design Reports view.-Search for Data Source 'Sales Quote Item'.-Highlight it and click on Preview -Under Selection, filter by Sales Quote IDs ABC, DEF and GHI (Where ABC, DEF and GHI represent IDs of multiple Sales Quotes).-Under View, remove the fields from the Columns and add fields 'Sales Quote' and 'Preceding Opportunity'.-Run the Report.- You see that some of the IDs are displayed correctly, but others are displayed as '#' (For both Sales Quote IDs and Preceding Opportunity IDs).- The same is also true if filtering by Preceding Opportunity ID instead of Sales Quote ID.-Cause-This is how the system checks the IDs in this Data Source:-First, the system takes the Sales Quote Items and checks for Opportunities which are linked to that item.-Then, the system checks if the Sales Quote itself is consistent.-If the items have no reference to the Opportunity, the Data Source will show the ID as '#'.- So, we have 3 cases where the ID will be shown as '#':-If the Sales Quotes have no items that reference an Opportunity (For example: If the items in the Sales Quote have been added manually, instead of being carried over from an Opportunity).-If the Sales Quote has no items.-If the Sales Quote is inconsistent.- This happens because the Data Source is based on the Sales Quote Items, and not the Sales Quote itself.-Resolution-  This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Item, Preceding, Data Source, CRMCQTIB, Opportunity, Inconsistent, Not Showing, Not available, Pound, Hashtag

Title: Error: 'You Are Not Authorized to Change the Data'
Content: Symptom-You are facing the following error message 'You Are Not Authorized to Change the Data' when you select work center view PQR (PQR is the name of the work center view/ sub-view).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to XXX (XXX represents the work center name) work center.-Select the view PQR (PQR is the name of the work center view/ sub-view).-You face the error: You are not authorized to change the data.-Cause-Case 1--The user is not given the proper Write Access for the work center view PQR.-Case 2--There is an access conflict with respect to the particular work center view PQR. It means that, the Write Access for the work center view PQR, which can be accessed from different work centers is not the same. Due to this there is a conflict with respect to the Write Access and the error 'You are not authorized to change the data' is encountered.-Resolution-Case 1--Give the proper Write Access for the work center view PQR.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Users sub-view under User and Access Management view.-Search for the user USER01 (USER01 refers to the business user).-Select Edit.-Select Access Rights.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-Provide the relevant Write Access for the work center view PQR.-Save the changes.-Case 2-Give the same Write Access for work centers from where the view PQR can be accessed.-Keywords-Access rights; authorization; access restrictions; change the data

Title: Incorrect Provision Date in Not Invoiced Time and Expenses for Service Item
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Provision Date for a Service Item in Not Time and Expenses view gives a date that is not expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Select Project ABC.-Click Edit Time and Expenses Button.-Find the Time and Expense Item.-Notice that the Provision Date is DD.MM.YYYY, which is not the date that you had expected.-Cause-The source of the Time and Expense item is the Supplier Invoice.-When the Cost Distribution item is missing from the Supplier Invoice item, (i.e. the Service Item has no Time Recording or Goods and Service Receipt), the system picks the Provision Date of the item in Not Invoice Time and Expenses view from the end date of the Service Period maintained in the corresponding Purchase Order Item.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-To check the Service Period end date maintained in Purchase Order:-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search, Open and View All of Purchase Order XYZ.-Navigate to Items tab.-Navigate to Basic Data subtab.-Search for field  "Service Period To".-The date maintained here will be the Provision Date maintained in Not Time and Expenses.-Keywords-Not Invoiced Time and Expenses, Provision Date, Service, Project, Supplier Invoice, Time Recording

Title: How to Retrieve Historical Data of all User Activities
Content: Symptom-You require a report which includes information for users activities in ByDesign System like which workcenter was accessed, what type of activity was performed and when the user was logged in to the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-ByDesign does not provide such data of the workcenters accessed and all the data seen/modified by each logon user.-Resolution-The available options in ByDesign are the following.-Read Access Logging - to log access to sensitive personal data to comply with data privacy laws like GDPR. This needs to be enabled and configured as you need. Please find more details at help document Read Access Logging.--Change History - this displays the changes on the business documents tracked by this functionality. This can be accessed on supported business documents by opening the individual document (like sales order, etc.) and going to the Changes tab in the UI, if that is available for respective Business Object/Document.--The report User Logon Details will only show the last logon date and time of Users.-See Also-KBA 2656176 - How to Get User Logon History-Keywords-User Activity Report, Historical Data, Read Access Logging, Change History
