Title: How to Download Business ByDesign Mobile App for Android in China Mainland
Content: Symptom-You want to download Business ByDesign Mobile App for Android but find cannot access Google Play Store in China Mainland-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-The application is also published in the Tencent App Store.-You can search for SAP Business ByDesign Mobile in the Tencent App Store to download the application.-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App, Download, Google Play Store, Tencent App Store

Title: Error Message While Executing Journal Statutory Report: Report size exceeds defined limits; use Schedule or Schedule and Print
Content: Symptom-While executing a Journal statutory report you receive the error message Report size exceeds defined limits; use Schedule or Schedule and Print.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > Statutory Reports view.-Open one of the available Journal reports (report is country-based so the availability depends on the countries you have scoped).-Click New > Blank Report Run.-Enter the required Report Parameters and Run Details.-Click Next.-Error message is thrown: Report size exceeds defined limits; use Schedule or Schedule and Print.-Cause-When you create a new Journal statutory report and click Next, the system evaluates if the total number of journal entries is within the allowable limit that can be handled in the foreground (1000 journal entries).--If yes it will go to next screen and generate records.-If no it will force you to run the report in a background job, by using the Schedule or Schedule and Print functionality.-With this approach the system avoids a session timeout dump. In background mode the system is able to render all the records into multiple PDF documents.-Resolution-The solution is to use either Schedule or Schedule and Print options. Don't forget to always mark the 'Generate PDF' check-box too.-In addition to that, for better performance we also recommend to generate the report on a monthly basis in background mode and outside your regular business hours.-Keywords-statutory report; journal; size exceeds; schedule; print

Title: "Exchange rate XXX / YYY on ZZ/ZZ/ZZZZ missing for currency conversion" Error In Intercompany Scenario.
Content: Symptom-In your Intercompany Scenario, you notice that there is a Process Communication Error in the Sales/Service Order. Upon further inspection, the error is related to an unexpected Currency Conversion that has not been maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In a Sales Order scenario:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Select and Open Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID involved in the Intercompany Scenario).-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Click the red icon representing the Process Communication Error.-You see error Sales Order ABC cannot create a Purchase Request.- In a Service Order scenario:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Open the Service Order Processing view.-Select and Open Service Order ABC (ABC represents the Service Order ID involved in the Intercompany Scenario).-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Click the red icon representing the Process Communication Error.-You see error Service Order ABC cannot create a Purchase Request.- Then, following these steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Process Communication Errors view.-Change the Filter to Open Errors with Incidents.-Select the Process Communication Error for document ABC (ABC represents your Sales/Service Order ID).- You can see that the error is "Exchange rate XXX / YYY on ZZ/ZZ/ZZZZ missing for currency conversion" (XXX/YYY represents the currency and ZZ/ZZ/ZZZZ represents the date).- However, you don't expect this currency conversion to be necessary for this scenario.-Cause-This happens because the fulfillment for the Sales/Service Order is External, so when the Purchase Request is created, the Seller (Of the Purchase Request) becomes the Supplier (From the Sales/Service Order), and the Buyer (Of the Purchase Request) becomes the Account (From the Sales/Service Order).- -The default currency for the Supplier is XXX and that of Buyer is YYY, so the system requires the currency conversion to be maintained for tax calculations.-Resolution-To prevent this issue in future cases, you will need to maintain the requested currency conversion. This can be done by following these steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Click on the Edit Exchange Rates common task.-Click on Add Row.-Maintain the relevant information.-If this is already happening to a document, after performing these steps:-If the currency for the item can still be changed you can solve the issue via a dummy change for the currency by changing the currency to any currency (Do not hit enter) and add the original currency again and now hit enter.-Otherwise you will need to raise an incident to SAP detailing the Sales/Service Order ID so we can make this scenario consistent from a Backend perspective.-See Also- 1961446 - Error Message : Exchange rate Country/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion-Keywords-Intercompany ; Sales Order ; Service Order ; Purchase Request ; Currency Conversion

Title: Warning Message: Invoice ABC blocked for payments
Content: Symptom-You have marked the Supplier Invoice for Payment Block and when you try to create a payment then the system shows warning message instead of error and allow you to create a payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Click on Supplier Accounts view.-Select the Supplier account and Click View.-Select the open Invoice ABC and click on Item Details.-Here, you have maintained Payment Block Reason and ticked Payment Block. -Go to Supplier Accounts view and select the open Invoice ABC.-Click on Pay Manually By - Outgoing Bank Transfer. -You will be navigated to Outgoing Bank Transfer screen and you see the warning message - Invoice ABC blocked for payments.-Maintain all the details and Post the payment. -The Payment is posted successfully.-Resolution-Basically, the Payment Block option is used, when you do not want the system to capture Invoice in the automatic Payment (Payment Run). If you create a Manual Payment, then the system shows only warning message instead of error and allow you to post the payment. The Payment Block option do not work for Manual Payment.-Keywords-Payment Block. Clearing. Supplier Invoice. Payment Run.

Title: Activate DKIM Based Sending
Content: Symptom-Customer wants to change the Return Path for the emails sent from the system, due to several security reasons.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Send or check any sent e-mail from the system-Open the e-mail message using Outlook, for example-You will see that the From e-mail is the one configured inside the system (you can configure this under Business Configuration > E-mail and Fax Settings activity)-With the message opened, click on File-Select Properties-Copy the contents of the section Internet Headers-Search for the tag Return-Path-You will see that is set as dsn@my******.mail.sapbydesign.com-Cause-This setting is defined by the e-mail server.-Resolution-The Return-Path ﻿cannot be set manually or by Hosting.-Keywords-e-mail, DKIM, reply addres,

Title: Incorrect Cost Center Assigned to Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You notice that there is an incorrect Cost Center assigned to Expense Report created on behalf of a user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expense work center.-Search for the employee XXXX.-Open the Expense Report.-Click Edit.-You will see that the cost center being picked is ABC instead of XYZ.-Cause-The Cost Center maintained in the Expense Arrangement for the Employee XXXX is incorrect.-Resolution-In order to correct the cost assignment in the employee's expense arrangement, please follow the below steps-Go to Travel and Expense work center.-Navigate to Expense Arrangement view.-Search the employee: XXXX.-Click Edit.-Select the row that is Active from DD-MM-YYYY to Unlimited-Go to corresponding Cost Assignment.-Change the Cost Center ABC to Cost Center XYZ.-Click Save and Close.-Now, when you create a New Expense Report on Behalf, you will see that the Cost Center being picked is XYZ.-Keywords-inactive, cost object, expense, report, New Expense Report on Behalf, CC

Title: How to Check a Customer Production and Test Tenants in Cloud Reporting Tool
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to check the customer production and test tenants in the Cloud Reporting Tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In the Cloud Reporting Tool is possible to check all the tenants owned by a specific customer and also additional information regarding their tenants.-Following are the steps to verify the customer Productive tenants in the cloud reporting tool:-Go to Cloud Reporting Tool.-Search the customer URL.-Select the Tenant ID.-In the field Customer Name, select the customer name.-Scroll down to Productive Tenant information section. (This option is also available in the right tab for quick access)-All customer production tenants will be displayed in this section.-Following are the steps to verify the customer Non-Productive/Test tenants in the cloud reporting tool:-Go to Cloud Reporting Tool.-Search the customer URL.-Select the Tenant ID.-In the field Customer Name, select the customer name.-Scroll down to Non-Productive Tenant information section. (This option is also available in the right tab for quick access)-All customer Non-Productive/test tenants will be displayed in this section.-In both sections is possible to check a quick view of all the relevant information regarding the productive and the non-produtive/test tenants.-The below information will be displayed in this sections: -Tenant ID.-System ID (SID).-System Role/Product (For ByDesign tenants the System Role/Product will be BYD).-Data Center.-System Type/Business Type.-Created On.-Status.-Tenant Name (URL)-NOTE: Additional information will also be displayed in this sections, however the ones listed above are the most relevant during incident handling.-See Also-Please refer to the KBAs below for addition details on how to find further information on the Cloud Reporting Tool:-3307155 - How to Check if a Customer Tenant is Located in a Multi-Tenant system or in a Private Tenant System in the Cloud Reporting Tool-2512316 - How to check downtime(Planned/Unplanned Maintenance) for SuccessFactors and C4C/ByD customers-3308586 - How to Check the Data Center Location in the Cloud Reporting Tool-Keywords-cloud reporting tool, tenant ID, production tenant, test tenant, customer tenant, customer URL, non-productive tenant

Title: How to Check the Data Center Location in the Cloud Reporting Tool
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to check the data center location of a customer tenant in the Cloud Reporting Tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Following are the steps to verify the data center location of a customer tenant in the Cloud Reporting Tool.-Go to Cloud Reporting Tool.-Search the URL of customer tenant.-Select the System ID.-In the field Data Center, select the data center name.-In the field City Name is possible to check the city where the data center is located.-Note: Keep in mind that if you search the data center through the section Productive tenants or Non-Productive tenants, the information displayed will always be an abbreviation of the real data center location, for instance if the data center is displayed as FR4, then the location will be Frankfurt.-See Also-Please refer to the KBAs below for further information regarding data centers:-2829404 - How to check the IP Range of the tenant based on Data Center in ByD and C4C-2570539 - IP Address for SAP Business ByDesign Data Centers-2795280 - Postal Address of Data Center-2512316 - How to check downtime(Planned/Unplanned Maintenance) for SuccessFactors and C4C/ByD customers-Keywords-cloud reporting tool, data center, system ID, tenant URL, customer tenant, location

Title: Supplier Invoice Scanning Files Move to Successful Folder But Do Not Appear in the Front End
Content: Symptom-You are unable to upload invoices using the Collaboration Window tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Firstly you upload the PDF file using the Collaboration Window tool. The log in the tool is showing as successful. However the file is not showing in the system as expected.-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Scanning view.-The files are not here.-Cause-You have a change project in the Implementation Projects that was merged but not activated.-Resolution-The activation step can be performed with the activity 'Activate Solution Capabilities' of the change project.-Once you have activated it, the Scanning process should work as expected.-See Also-KBA: 3260857 - Supplier Invoice Scanning Files Move to Upload Error Folder When You Upload Through SAP Collaboration Window Tool-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Invoice Scanning; Collaboration Window; Folder; Implementation Projects

Title: Account Disappears After Adding a Party Role in Responsibilities Tab
Content: Symptom-You noticed that after adding a Party Role to an Account, the account disappears from Accounts Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management Work Center.-Go to Accounts View.-Select the Account and click Edit button.-Go to Contacts tab and go to Responsibilities subtab.-Click Add Row.-Add a Party Role and select an Employee.-Click Save.-Search for the account again in Accounts Work Center.-The account disappeared-Cause-This system behavior might be occurring because access restrictions for the user and the access to accounts are maintained.-In order to check it, please follow the steps below:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business User View.-Search for the Employee that no longer sees the Account and select it.-Click Edit button -> Access Rights.-Go to Access Restrictions tab.-Search for Work Center ID BPM_ACCOUNTS.-Check if the Read and Write access is selected as Restricted.-Go to Detailed Restrictions subtab.-Check the Employee that are selected.-According to this, the user may only see accounts for which the employees are listed as employee responsible (or no employee responsible is listed at all).-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-See Also-Please also refer to the explanations in the documentation about access restrictions for accounts:-Help Center - Access Rights and Restrictions for Accounts-Keywords-party role; account; access rights; BPM_ACCOUNTS

Title: How to Check the CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) in Cloud Reporting Tool
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to check in the Cloud Reporting Tool the CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) of a customer tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Following are the steps to verify the CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) of a customer tenant in the Cloud Reporting Tool.-Go to Cloud Reporting Tool.-Search the URL of customer tenant.-Select the Tenant ID.-Scroll down until the field Contractual Maintenance.-The start date and duration of the CMP will be displayed in the Contractual Maintenance field.-See Also-Please refer to the KBAs below please for additional information regarding the CMP:-2512316 - How to check downtime(Planned/Unplanned Maintenance) for SuccessFactors and C4C/ByD customers-2502077 - How to check Customer's System CMP Downtime.-Keywords-cloud reporting tool, contractual maintenance period, CMP, tenant ID

Title: Cash - Open Items Report Shows Open Amount for a Techn. Clearing of Bank Clearing Account Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You checked the Cash - Open Items report and noticed that it shows an open amount for a journal entry of type Techn. Clearing of Bank Clearing Account. You checked the payment allocation related to this journal entry and see that it is posted.-You wish to understand why it still shows as an open amount in the Cash - Open Items report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open the Cash - Open Items report.-Apply the relevant selection criteria and execute the report.-You see that the report shows an amount as open item, corresponding to a journal entry type Techn. Clearing of Bank Clearing Account-You checked the corresponding payment allocation and the allocated payment and see that they are Posted and Completed respectively. You wish to understand why the amount still shows as open.-Cause-The amount shows as open, since one of the journal entry lines have no clearing details. You can check that by opening the journal entry and referring to the item's Details section (for both credit and debit sides). You notice that one of the sides does not have the 'Clearing for Document ID' reference.-In this case, the payment allocation allocated the amount with a bank advice, which in turn has a tax authority as business partner. Since the payer/payee is a tax authority, the amount gets allocated to 8 - Tax payables or receivables and a tax payment is automatically created.-This tax payment remains In Preparation, hence the amount still shows as open in the Cash report.-Resolution-You need to post the tax payment accordingly. You can find the related tax payment as follows:-Go to Tax Management work center. -Go to Tax Payment view.-Check the In Preparation tax payments by the amount and company.-Once you find the payment, you need to post it against a tax return and accept any differences, if any.-Keywords-Tax Payment. Payment Allocation. Tax Management.

Title: Point-Of-Sale Transaction Paid by Credit Card
Content: Symptom-You are creating a POS (Point-Of-Sale) transaction with credit card data in ByD, however there is no credit card assigned to the customer account. You would like to understand the processing of such transactions in ByD and how to add the credit card to the account.-The following error in the POS could also be related to these questions:-'Credit card ID not valid'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-In general, for POS integration, the customer's master data should always be in sync and available according to the used payment method. Therefore, if the customer makes a purchase using a credit card and the credit card data is entered into the external system. This data includes the credit card token and type as well as the ID of the customer. The customer master data, including the credit card data, needs to be available in the SAP Business ByDesign system so that the credit card transaction can be assigned to this customer and processed correctly.-To have a credit card assigned to the customer account, you can a) maintain it via web service or b) have the credit card tokenized from within ByD.-Maintain it via web service.-If you don't want to tokenize the credit card via the ByD integration with the payment service provider, you could have a look at the ManagePaymentCardIn web service. This should allow you to create credit card tokens in ByD that were already tokenized by the service provider outside ByD--Have the credit card tokenized from within ByD.-This is done through the customer account master date via the button 'Register with Computop' or 'Register with Digital Payments', depending who is your payment service provider. To tokenize a card from within ByD, the integration with one of these payment service providers must be in place.-As for the Digital Payments integration, if you want to enable that, you need to talk to Digital Payments, sign a contract, agree to their license agreements, procure a license, setup the digital payments system and accounts required and in this process you would get a client ID, client URL, client secret that can be maintained in the OAUTH client registration in ByD. (fine-tune activity Integration with SAP Digital Payments Add-on)-Computop does not use OAUTH registration, but also requires a master data an integration to be done. See help document Customer Payments by Credit Card.-Note that, the settlement options will also impact on the payment service provider integration with ByD. For POS credit card payment, the credit card payment can either a) be settled in the external system, or b) the payment data can be transferred to the system before settlement takes place:-A credit card payment settled in an external system.-In this case, the information transferred to Financial Management includes the settled payment data. The payment can be tracked in the Payment Management work center, Payment Monitor view. The status is either In Transfer, or Confirmed once the incoming payment has been confirmed by a bank statement.--A credit card payment not settled in an external system.-In this case, the information transferred to Financial Management includes the data of the payment that has not yet been settled. In the Payment Monitor view, the status of the payment is Ready for Transfer. Start the settlement of the credit card payment by clicking Actions for Credit Cards and then Settle. This initiates the standard credit card settlement process. The payment is sent to the clearing house that will process the payment and ensure that the payment amount will be transferred to your bank account.-For more details on other scenarios of Credit Card Without Customer Data and Other Payment Cards, Online Payment Service, Mixed Payment Methods and Gift Certificates, please refer to help document Point-of-Sale Transaction Processing in Financial Management-See Also-3301469 - Over-the-Counter (OTC) Transactions Paid By Credit Card-2037449 - Missing Register With Service Provider Button-Keywords-Point of Sale. POS. CCO. Customer Check-Out. Credit Card. Settlement. Authorization. Sales Transaction. Customer Check Out.

Title: You Can't Find Key Figure "Quantity" and "Net Value" when Download Data Source in CSV format for Report "Sales Order Analysis".
Content: Symptom- Key Figure "Quantity" and "Net Value" are missing when Download Data Source in CSV format for Report "Sales Order Analysis".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center, open Report View, then open the report "Sales Order Analysis"-Select Company as "ABC" (where ABC stands for Company you have selected); Reporting Period as "Last Month"-Start the report-You can see the Key Figure "Quantity" and "Net Value"-Click Share button, then Download Data Source in CSV format-Open the downloaded file in Excel-You can find that the Key Figure column "Quantity" and "Net Value" are missing -Cause-For the Report ID: /SFL0000Q/SOA; Report Name: Sales order analysis; Data Source ID: CRMSLOIB, the key figure "Quantity" and "Net Value" available in report are not coming from the datasource directly, but are defined as restricted key figures.-These key figures are not considered in the download of data source.-Resolution-The key figure "Quantity" and "Net Value" are not missing when Download Report in CSV Format or Report in MS Excel in XML Format. You can make use of these two report formats.-Keywords- Sales Order Analysis, Key Figure, Quantity, Net Value

Title: Availability of the Employee Shows the Weekend as a Business Day
Content: Symptom-Although the Employee does not work on weekends, as shown in the Work Schedule, the Availability Calendar show the weekend as a Business Day.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management - Resource Search.-Search for the required Employee.-Click Show Availability.-Check the weekends for the selected Employee.-Cause-Employee was added to a project on DD.MM.YYYY with planned hours to be worked, set for the task, for the employee. At this time, the employee did not have a Work Schedule assigned so the spread of the planned work on the project was spread across all the days.-This action set Saturday and Sunday as non working days but the planned hours to be worked on, on the project are not redistributed automatically as mentioned in the documentation under the heading ‘Redistribute Planned Work for..’ provided in this Link.---Resolution-This is a case which can be corrected by the "Redistribute Planned Hours for -> Task Service/ Period Plan" action available in the resource calendar.--In order to fix this scenario, you can follow the steps below:-Go to the Resource Management work center.-Then go to the  Resource Search.-Search for the required Employee.-Click Show Availability.-Select the Task Service/Period Plan which has distribution on the weekends as well.-Click "Redistribute Planned Hours for".-Task Srvice/Period Plan.-Click Save.-Keywords-Show Availability, Availability Calendar, Employee, Weekend, Wrong Assignment, Business Day, Resource Search.

Title: Changed Adressee Data for Employees are Not Taken Over in New Shopping Carts
Content: Symptom-Why are changed master data for employees such as address data are not taken over in new shopping cart?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new shopping cart:-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self Service view and open the Self-Services Overview subview. -Open the Link Go Shopping (Advanced).-In the Delivery Address copied from Recipient section the system displays the incorrect delivery address.- Cause-The delivery address in a new shopping cart is based on the last shopping cart which the employee created and released before. Therefore, the change has to be triggered manually in the shopping cart if required.-Resolution-This is the standard system behaviour.-To trigger the changes in a shopping cart you have to remove the Recipient and enter it again. This will refresh the defaulting and the address from master data would be displayed.-Keywords-shopping cart,delivery address copied from recipient

Title: Fields are Missing in Business Role Query Section
Content: Symptom-In the Business Roles view, Status and Obsolete flag fields are not available in the advanced filter/query section-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Click on Business Role view.-Click on Advanced filter.- You see Status and Obsolete flag fields are not available in the advanced filter/query section-Cause-These fields cannot be added to the advanced filter area which is not a part of the query parameters and the roles can be viewed in UI based on the status currently using the available default sets-Resolution-Since this is a new requirement, please create a requirement in the below requirement portal link-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/-See Also-2531650 - New Customer Request for Additional Feature or Function in SAP standard software-Keywords-Business role, status, Obsolete flag, advanced filter-business role, status, obsolete flag, ad

Title: How to Reapprove Suppier Master
Content: Symptom-You want to trigger the reapproval for supplier master.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently approval for supplier master can only be triggered during the creation, any changes after first approval there is no approval.-Resolution-This is a new requirement.-You can register it in Customer Influence for SAP Business ByDesign at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Supplier master, approval

Title: Service Start Date does not Show Expected Value for Rehiring
Content: Symptom-You have rehired an employee, and notice that the field Service Start Date does not show the expected date according to the set date in the rehire process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration.-Navigate to the Regular Tasks view.-Click on Rehire Employee.-Perform the rehire of a previously terminated employee.-After the process is finished, you can see the unexpected date in the field Service Start Date in the employee screen.-Cause-The Service Start Date field will behave differently when the "Reinstatement" option is turned on.-Resolution-If service start date is not filled during the rehire and ‘Reinstatement’ is unchecked, the service start date will be the same as the rehire date of the employee.-However if ‘Reinstatement’ is checked, the previous length of services is also to be considered for calculating the service start date.-As an example, if an employee was initially hired on 01.01 and terminated on 10.01, it has a total of 10 service days.-In case you rehire this employee on 01.05, there are 2 possibilities for the Service Start Date:-If the Reinstatement option is checked, the service start date will be backed 10 days, so it would display 20.04.-If Reinstatement is not checked, the date will show normally as 01.05-Keywords-Reinstatement, re-hire, termination

Title: "Positive distribution percentage is mandatory for product XYZ" When Activating Kit Product for Purchasing
Content: Symptom-You are trying to activate a Kit Product for purchasing, however when changing the status, the system raises the following error messages:-"Positive distribution percentage is mandatory for product XYZ" (where XYZ represents the Product ID)-"Distribution percentage is not 100% for kit ABC" (where ABC represents the ID of the Kit)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Navigate to the Products View.-Search for the kit product and click on Edit.-Go to the Purchasing tab.-In the Status dropdown list, select value "Active".-Here the error message is raised.-Cause-In order to activate a Kit Product, the Distribution Percentage of the products within must sum to 100%, and the individual percentages need to be positive.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In order to check and fix the issue, follow the below steps:-Go to Product Data.-Navigate to the view Kit Item List.-Search the Kit Product ID and open it.-Here you can see that the Distribution Percentage column for each product does not sum to 100%, or there are negative percentages for certain products within.-Keywords-Kit, Purchasing, Master Data

Title: Column Filter does not Work in Mass Change Screen
Content: Symptom-You are performing Mass Change for an object, and the column filtering does not work for the objects selected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Taking as an example the Mass Change for the Material object:-Go to Product Data.-Navigate to the Materials view.-Select the desired materials and click on Mass Change.-In the Mass Change screen, click on the column header for any column and try to filter for a specific value.-Here you can see that the filter does not work.-Cause-Column filtering in the Mass Change screen is currently not supported in Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. You need to perform any required filtering before entering the Mass Change screen.-Keywords-Field, Table, Row

Title: Exception In Supplier Invoice That The Date Of The Document Must Be Before The Due and Baseline Date
Content: Symptom-Exception in the supplier invoice "The date of this document must be before the due date and the baseline date for payment, which you can find under Payment Details."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the New Invoice Without Purchase Order common tasks.-Fill the necessary fields.-Select a future date for Invoice Date field.-Select a date before invoice date to the Due Date field.-Post the Supplier Invoice.-Check that it was created with an exception: The date of this document must be before the due date and the baseline date for payment, which you can find under Payment Details.-Cause-The Invoice Date must be before the Due Date and Baseline Date.-Resolution-This is a system behavior. When the Invoice Date is in a future date, after the Due and Baseline Date, system will create the exception. To fix the error, either you need to change the invoice date to DD.MM.YYYY or enter Baseline Date for Payment  as DD.MM.YYYY.-You can also have the same error for Customer Invoice.-Notes: The Baseline Date is a date you expect to complete a certain milestone, that is, a validation date for the payment terms. This date determines the permitted cash discount or when the invoice is due.-The Due Date is when something needs to be finalized, paid for, etc.-Keywords-Exception; Supplier Invoice; Customer Invoice; Due Date; Baseline Date; Invoice Date;The date of this document must be before the due date and the baseline date for payment,

Title: Not Possible to See Holiday Calendar for Service Agents
Content: Symptom-After creating a service agent and performing the organizational assignment, you are not able to locate where to maintain a holiday calendar for the agent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently service agents do not support holiday calendars. In a normal scenario the service agents are hired as external workforce, so holiday calendars would be defined by the external company, instead of the ones created in the system.-Resolution-System works as expected-Keywords-working, schedule

Title: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Transactions Paid By Credit Card
Content: Symptom-You have created an Overt-the-Counter (OTC) transaction and selected payment method as credit card. However, you either do not find the option to add a new credit card or the authorization fails.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales view.-Open the respective transaction.-In the General tab, under Payment section, select credit card.-Click Check Authorization.-You either see no credit card available for selection or when checking the authorization, it fails with the following error: 'Technical error in payment authorization; report an incident'-Cause-There are a few reasons for the credit card authorization to fail. The most common one happens due to missing/incomplete integration with a payment service provider (Computop or Digital Payments). Since the system does not have the complete master data yet it cannot establish a connection and communicate the authorization details.-Overall, you can check if the master data is complete by checking if the Register with Computop or Register with Digital Payments button is enabled in the customer account master data, as follows:-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the master data of the relevant customer account.-Go to Financial Data -> Bank Data.-Under Credit Card section, check weather the Register with Computop or Register with Digital Payments are available and working.-This is a good indication that the master data is complete.-Via these buttons, you're also able to register a new credit card to be used in the OTC transaction.-Resolution-Therefore, you need to revise the credit card integration setup. You can refer to help document Customer Payments by Credit Card.-For the Over-the-Counter scenario, if you choose the payment method as Credit Card, then the system understands that you are using SAP Business ByDesign to initiate the credit card transactions (register the card, authorization and settlement) from within ByD. For that to happen, an integration with a payment service provider must exist.-If you have already an agreement with a payment service provided to manage credit card transactions and this is being done from outside ByD, then you can select the payment method as external payment for the over-the-counter transaction. Once it gets released, an Incoming External Payment entry is automatically created in the payment monitor.-See Also-3294535 - Point-Of-Sale Transaction Paid by Credit Card-2037449 - Missing Register With Service Provider Button-Keywords-Over-the-Counter. Credit Card. Authorization.

Title: Error message: Balances Differ for Country, Tax Type, Tax Event and Tax Rate
Content: Symptom-The error "Balances Differ for Country, Tax Type, Event and Rate" is displayed when executing the Reconciliation Report in the General Ledger work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Reconciliation subview.-Show All Reconciliation runs and find run AAA (AAA here represents reconciliation run ID).-Open the application log of the reconciliation run. -Go to the Tax tab and here to the VAT/Sales Tax Balances sub-tab. -An Absolute Difference appears for the Balance in Register, Balance in Ledger values.-Cause-The Balance in Register value gets cleared when the respective return is released, whereas the Balance in Ledger value gets cleared when a tax return is paid.-The balance in the Tax Ledger can be cleared by posting the payment against the corresponding VAT Return. Please note that the Balance in Tax Ledger will be cleared as of the Posting Date of the Tax Payment.-To compare the tax balances in the Tax Register with the balances in the Tax Accounts as of a specific key date, the VAT/Sales Tax Reconciliation Report can be used.-Possible reason for the discrepancy include:-One or more documents were created/changed/cancelled after the VAT Return was submitted. This can be verified in the Open VAT/Sales Tax Items report using the relevant key date.-Resolution-To resolve the difference, execute a Correction VAT Return Run for the period corresponding to the key date. This will recalculate the tax amounts and align the balances between the Tax Register and the Tax Accounts.-Keywords-balance in tax ledger, balance in tax register, reconciliation report Tax, Balances Differ for Country, Tax Type, Event and Rate-balance in tax ledger,balance in tax register,reconciliation report tax error
