Title: Unable To Preview Financial Data Sources
Content: Symptom-When previewing a Financial Data source, one or more of the following errors may occur:-Unexpected error on period-dependent action.-Contract violation: No data but end_of_data <> tru (data source name)-Error reading the data of datasource-Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Click Design Data Sources under the Data Sources sub view.-Search for any financial data source, for example, Fixed Assets and individual Materials Values and click the Preview button.-Click GO.-One or more of the above errors are displayed.-Cause-For financial data sources, parameters such as Company/Set of Books/Fiscal Year Variant/Key Date etc.. are mandatory.-When a financial data source is previewed in Business Analytics these mandatory selection parameters are not applied and in return the data source will not fetch any data.-Resolution-As financial data sources cannot be previewed it is best practice to check in the Design Reports section of Business Analytics if there is a report based on the data source you want to preview.-They are available in list of data sources in Business Analytics only to be reused in custom data sources/custom reports.-Keywords-Data source preview, Design Data Sources, Reports, FIN, Finance, Data Source, mandatory-data source,design report

Title: Supplier Cash Discount Posted to Original Expense Account - Supplier Invoice with Purchase Order/Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-You create a Supplier Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice ID) from Purchase Order item XXX-XX (XXX-XX represents the Purchase Order Item ID) for a non-stock material acquisition after the Goods receipt has been posted.-The Supplier invoice gets cleared with a payment including a cash discount, either due to the applied payment terms or because a cash discount was maintained manually.-You notice that the Goods Receipt/ Invoice Receipt (GR/IR) Clearing run has posted the applied cash discount to the original expense account derived from the Purchase order item Product Category.-You expected the cash discount to be posted to a Difference account maintained in the Account Determination fine tune activity, section Accounts Payable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-conditions:-In the Fine Tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination under Account Determination - Accounts Payable in the Payment Differences tab you have maintained a G/L account in column Cash Discounts Earned.-The Supplier Invoice has been paid with a cash discount.-Steps to reproduce:-In the Inventory Valuation work center go to the GR/IR clearing view.-Select the relevant GR/IR clearing run and then enter its application log by clicking on Log Result in the Details section.-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab.-In the Only Posting Information or the Advanced Information sub-tab search for item XXX-XX in the Purchasing Document Item column.-In the Details section, under Offsetting Account, you notice that a Payment Difference, according to the applied cash discount, has been posted to the original Expense account rather than a payment difference account for payables.-Cause-In general, the cash discount posting depends on whether they are combined with a goods receipt.-Invoice receipt with goods receipt: The cash discount is posted through the GR/IR clearing activity.-Invoice receipt without goods receipt: The cash discount is posted to the original account in the journal entry for the supplier invoice, that is, to the expense account or to the fixed asset.-This posting logic is controlled by the settings maintained in the fine tune activity Posting Control Profiles for Procurement Processes.-However, it is possible to set up the posting control in a way that cash discounts are posted to a specific payment difference account maintained in the mentioned Account Determination activity.-Resolution-Create a new posting control profile for procurement processes and assign it to the respective accounting principles:-In the Business Configuration work center open the Fine Tune activity Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (either with a change project or from the Implementation Projects view and here in the Fine Tune phase).-You might have to add this activity to the project - Choose Add to Project and then choose Open.-In the new window first go to the Posting Control Profiles for Procurement Processes task.-To create a new posting control profile, copy the General Posting Profile: Choose Copy, change the Posting profile ID and the profile description.-In the sub-tabs underneath you can maintain the payment difference posting settings for three procurement options: Procure for Consumption, Procure to Stock, Procure to Fixed Assets.-If you do not want cash discounts to be posted to the original expense account, navigate, for instance, to the Procure for Consumption tab and  select 1-Cash Discount.-Untick the box in the Post to Original Expense Account column.-Press Save and Close.-Now open the task Generally Accepted Accounting Principles-In the new window, you can assign the new Posting Control Profile to the respective accounting principles.-Press Save and Close.-If you now create a supplier invoice, even without goods and service receipt, then the cash discount maintained in the payment clearing will be posted to the cash discount account that you have maintained in the Account Determination activity in Fine Tuning.-See Also-1816316-Supplier Cash Discount Posted to Original Expense Account-Keywords-cash discount, original expense account, payment difference account, accounts payable, procurement for consumption, outgoing payment clearing, supplier invoice with purchase order

Title: Payment Approval Task is Triggered Even Though Below the Threshold
Content: Symptom-You have created threshold values for payment approval tasks, however the system still triggers the approval although it would be below the threshold.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Click New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Create the payment with amount below the threshold in BRL currency, for example.-When you post the payment an approval task is created, however no approval would be required.-Cause-You have set up a multi-level approval threshold for different currencies, which can be seen as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Business Task Management for Payment and Liquidity Management.-Click Payment approvals for outgoing payments.-You have the rules set up similar to below example:-Sequence Company ID Company Name Payment Method User ID User Name Threshold Amount-1 1000         10.000.000 EUR-2 1000         10.000.000 USD-3 1000         10.000.000 GBP-The rule inputs are Company ID, Payment Method and User ID. Therefore, when company ID alone is passed it just take the first entry (for EUR currency). Even though you create a payment in BRL the rule is validated for EUR and then the system tries to convert it from EUR to BRL currency, however the exchange rate is missing in the system.-Resolution-In order to avoid this situation, please revise your payment approval rules. It is also recommended to maintain the BRL/EUR exchange rate, considering the above example.-Keywords-payment approval; outgoing payments; threshold amount

Title: How to Add Mandatory Approval Process for Petty Cash Payments
Content: Symptom-You want to apply a mandatory Approval Process for Petty Cash Payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It is assumed that the petty cash payments are small expenses or receipts and there is no approval needed for such small payments.-Hence a conventional approval process does not apply to petty cash payments.-Resolution-Alternate solution:-Though there is no Approval Process for Petty Cash, there is a concept of authorizing the petty cash payments for certain business users.-Please follow the below steps for the same:-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to Master Data View.-Go to Petty Cash Sub View.-Click New, then choose Petty Cash.-On the New Petty Cash screen, enter the Basic Data for your new petty cash fund.-In addition to the Petty Cash ID, you specify the Currency. For example, A Petty Cash Fund can be created in only one currency. If you want to process your cash payments in different currencies, you need to create additional Petty Cash Funds.-You also need to enter the Account Determination Group.-If you want to assign responsibility for the New Petty Cash Fund to a specific person, enter their name in the Responsible Employee field.-If you want this person to be the only person allowed to work with this Petty Cash Fund, select the Restricted Authorization checkbox.-Click Save.-Keywords- petty cash; approval; restricted authorization; responsible employee; approval process

Title: Migration Mode: Modify Already Existing Records Missing in Migration of Materials
Content: Symptom-The migration mode Modify Already Existing Records is not found in the Migration Tool for materials.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Show All Configuration Elements and Find the activity: Migration of Materials.-Select Migrate materials using the Migration tool.-Upload the migration file.-Select the Properties button.-Unable to find the migration mode Modify Already Existing Records.-Cause-The Modify Already Existing Records mode of migration has been removed as this mode has been replaced with a functionality in the Mass Data Maintenance work center. This can be used to modify the Materials.-Resolution-The requirement can be fulfilled through Mass Data Maintenance work center and the steps are as follows:-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select Link for Export Materials.-Add the required Materials and select OK.-Go to General tab.-Select <export> for the columns which needs change.-Select Export Data to CSV File button.-In the Excel file, change/add the values for those fields and save the changes, and close the file.-Close the Export Materials screen.-Upload the file and Execute Data Import.-Proceed with data validation and import.-Please note: Currently, we do not support the functionality to nullify values.-See Also-KBA: 1989198 Is it Possible to Nullify a Value in a Field in Material Master Data-Keywords-Migration of Materials, Material Migration, Product Migration-existing,already,migration,modify

Title: E-mail Address Does Not Appear in the Business User View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The e-mail address is not appearing in the Business User view, even when the Workplace Data is already maintained in the Personnel Administration work center.-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Business User view.-Search for the affected Business User ID.-Once you select the Business User, the e-mail address is empty.-Cause-There is an inconsistency in the BO Identity, and the e-mail address is not being updated in the Business User view.-Resolution-To solve this problem, you can follow the steps below in the backend:-Go to the IAM_TOOLS transaction code.-Then click Check/Update Address of Identity.-Maintain the Technical User ID in the User ID.-Unflag Test Mode.-Click Execute.-Note: In case you want to see if there are more users affected by this issue, you can execute report with test mode enabled, but don't maintain any User ID. With that, the system will shown all the affected Technical Users.-See Also-2616642 - Unable to Generate New Password From the Forgot Password Link-1891041 - E-Mail Activate Subscriptions For Business Task Management Is Grayed Out-Keywords-E-mail Address, Does not appear, Not appearing, Empty, Not visible, Business User, Application and User Management.e-mail activate activation subscription

Title: Project Task Not Assigned to the Correct Sales Order Item in Expense Assignment Posting
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a specific sales order item XYZ to a project task.-For this project task you create a supplier invoice which is being cleared with a payment.-The system created a clearing posting. Here the project task is assigned correctly to the sales order item XYZ.-After the clearing posting the expense assignment is being changed where the project task is assigned to a different sales order item ABC even though this sales order item is not connected at all to either the supplier invoice item or the project task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Verify the sales order item assignment in the project:-In the Project Management workcenter navigate to the Projects view.-Select the respective project and click on the project id to open the project.-Click View All and navigate to the Sales Tracking tab.-Find the project task and verify that it is assigned to sales order item XYZ.-Verify the project task assignment in the supplier invoice:-In the Supplier Invoicing workcenter navigate to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Find the respective supplier invoice and click on its document id to open it and then press View All.-In the Items tab, select the respective item and navigate to the Cost Distribution tab.-Here, under Account Assignment you verify that the invoice item is assigned to the correct project task as well as your sales order item XYZ.- Check the clearing, for instance via the document flow (You could also find the clearing the supplier account monitor in the Payables workcenter):-In the supplier invoice navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Find the Clearing and click on the little Journal Entry button to open the journal entry.-Here you verify that all expenses are posted and assigned correctly.-Verify all the expense assignments of your project task to sales order items, for instance in the Projects- Line Items report:-In the Project Management workcenter navigate to the Reports-List view-Open the Projects-Line Items report-Maintain all mandatory characteristics as well as the project in question-Add the characteristics Sales Document Items and Project Task to the rows.-Now you notice another Expense Assignment to Sales Document transaction and here the supplier invoice item and project task are assigned to a different sales order item ABC.  -Cause-In scoping the default assignment rule for project-based sales order is activated. This way all time and expense items are assigned to a sales order item, even when there is no match with the existing rule.-In the case of expense assignment resulting from a supplier invoice posting the suitable sales order item is evaluated by trying to match-the source-the employee-the product category-If none of these specifications are found in the respective assignment rule then the system assigns the first project based sales order item by default.-Resolution-You can either descope the default assignment rule or you create a manual assignment rule so that the correct sales order item is selected:-Descope the default assignment rule:-In the Business Configuration workcenter go to the Implementation Projects view and select the current project.-Press Edit Project Scope.-Continue to step 4 Questions.-Under scoping element Sales select Customer Invoicing and here select Project Invoicing.-Find the question Do you want to use default assignment rules for the first project based sales order item as a fallback? and untick the box in the In Scope Column.-Review and then finish the project scope.-Now the solution will not create a default assignment rule and unassigned project tasks need to be assigned manually:-In the Project Management workcenter, go the Invoice Preparation: Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Find the respective project and press Edit Time and Expense.-Here you can assign sales order items to unassigned project tasks. Assignments can also be changed here.-Create a manual assignment rule:-In the Project Management workcenter, go the Invoice Preparation: Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Find the respective project and press Edit Time and Expense.-Now click on Edit Assignment Rules and select View All Rules.-In this task, you can see all the rules the solution automatically creates according to the settings you made for the project tasks.-You will also find an automatic rule here where only the first project based sales order item is provided. For all other entries an asterix (*) is maintained. This is the default assignment rule.-Press Add Row.-Maintain the respective project task in the General Parameters.-In the Time and Expense Parameter select Product Category and maintain the relevant product category.-You can also enter a source in the General Parameters and/or an employee in the Party Parameters.-Now assign the respective sales order item under Assignment.-At last, and most importantly move your new rule above the default assignment rule by clicking on the Move Up button. Only this way the manual rule will be identified before the default assignment rule.-Press Close.-Back in the Edit Time and Expenses screen press Save.-See Also-2611112 - Incurred Costs on Customer Sales Project Realized on the Wrong Project Task-Keywords-project task; sales order; project based sales order item; assignment rule

Title: Value of Extension Field is Not Being Shown in the Customer Account Monitor Which Has Been Extended and Maintained in the Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have extended and maintained the value of extension field in the customer invoice. But the value is not being shown in the Customer Account Monitor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Find and open Invoice ABC (where ABC stands for the Customer Invoice).-You can see the value of Extension Field XYZ (where XYZ stands for the Extension Field) has been maintained.-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Customer Accounts View.-Search for Customer Account EFG (where EFG stands for the Customer Account).-Click View.-You can see the value of Extension Field XYZ is not being shown for Customer Invoice ABC.-Cause-The Extension Field XYZ has been extended.-Open the Adaptation Mode.-Check the Extension Field XYZ.-Click Further Usage of Extension Field XYZ.-Check Extension Scenarios.-"Customer Invoice - General Information to Trade Receivables Payables Register – Item" has been checked.-The Extension Field is passed from Customer Invoice to Customer Account Monitor when the Invoice is released. The Extension Field is passed through the XML message. Once the Invoice is released it ideally should be modified. In any case, as the Invoice was already sent to accounting and to FIN operations, it will not be sent again.-In this case, the Extension Field is updated after the Invoice has been released.-Open the Invoice ABC.-Navigate to the Changes tab.-You can see the User maintained the value for Extension Field XYZ on DD.MM.YYYY and this date is after the creation date of the Journal Entry.-Hence updates to Extension Field will not be passed to financials again.-Resolution-You can only cancel the Invoice ABC and re-create.-Please ensure that the Extension Field is maintained correctly before the creation of Journal Entry.-Keywords-Extension Field; Customer Invoice; Customer Account Monitor

Title: Desired G/L Account is Not Displayed in the Offsetting Account List During Manual Acquisition
Content: Symptom-You try to do Manual Posting - Acquisition of an existing fixed asset, in the new screen, you cannot find the desired G/L account from the Account list under Offsetting Account Assignment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center, and choose the Fixed Assets view.-Select the Fixed Assets subview.-Select the target fixed asset and choose Manual Posting and then Acquisition.-Check the proposed Document Date and Posting Date. You can enter a Description. You can change the proposed Closing Step.-Check the specified source individual material number.-Enter the Transaction Currency Amount.-From the Account list under Offsetting Account Assignment, try to find the desired G/L account, but it's not there.-Cause-G/L accounts of some G/L Account Types are not available for selection, for example Differences, Fixed assets, etc.-Resolution-You should choose a G/L Account that is available for selection, for example, of G/L Account Type Other assets.-In case you want to use a G/L Account belonging to an account type that is not compatible with Offsetting Account Assignment, you might consider changing the account type.-However, for such change some preconditions apply. Further information is available in help document, in section Changing the Account Type.-The system behaves as designed.-Keywords-manual posting; acquisition; offsetting account

Title: Non-Localized Country: Withholding Tax Return Run - Work Package ID System Error
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Withholding Tax Return Run for a non-localized country which finished in error:-'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident' (XYZ means an alphanumeric code for Work package ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > Withholding Tax Return Runs view.-Search for Run ID XXX (XXX means the Run ID).-Open the respective Application Log with Overall Status in red.-Under General tab, notice the error message: 'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.-Cause-In the respective solution in SAP Cloud Applications Studio, you have not maintained the Payment Attributes node for the concerned BC Set.-Resolution-You should maintain the Payment Attributes node in the BC Set for the respective solution, and after that, re-execute the Withholding Tax Return Run, which should finished successfully then.-See Also-For further information please refer to the Localization Toolkit, Category Tax > Subtopic Withholding Tax > Documentation How To enable Withholding Tax content for non-localized countries in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Keywords-Work package ID; 01O{HYIq7jY9mAjowIzudW; WHT; PDI; Business Configuration Set; BC SET; Payment Attributes;

Title: The Cash Discount of Supplier Invoice is Not Posted to the Desired Account
Content: Symptom-In the line item of the supplier invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice), Cash Discount Relevant checkbox is marked. You then post the supplier invoice to accounting, and have it cleared, but when you check the journal entry of the payment, you see that cash discount is not posted to the right account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project in question and choose Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the fine-tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination, choose Accounts Payables.-Go to the Payment Differences tab.-You can see that for all supplier groups, account ABC (ABC represents the Account) is maintained under the Cash Discount Earned column.-Then, go to the General Ledger work center, choose the Journal Entries view.-Select the journal entry of the payment, and check the details.-      You can see the posting of the payment credits the cash discount to an expense account DEF (DEF represents the expense account), which is not ABC as you expect.-Cause-When you pay a supplier invoice, the cash discount is posted using the gross procedure. The input tax is corrected automatically for the payment date of the invoice. How cash discounts are posted depends on whether they are combined with a goods receipt:-Invoice receipt with goods receipt: The cash discount is not posted until GR/IR clearing is performed.-Invoice receipt without goods receipt: The cash discount is posted to the original account in the journal entry for the supplier invoice, that is, to the expense account or to the fixed asset. -Resolution-As in this case, there is no goods receipt associated, so when you pay the supplier invoice, the cash discount is posted to the expense account in the journal entry of the supplier invoice XYZ.-In the supplier invoice XYZ, the cost is distributed to G/L account DEF, so after the posting of the supplier invoice, the system credits the payable account and debits the expense account DEF. This is why the system posts the cash discount to expense discount DEF.-Keywords-Cash Discount; Supplier Invoice; not posted; Account;

Title: The tab Assigned Users Displays 0 Users for all Licensed Users
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When accessing the Work Center Service Control Center under User Subscriptions, in a Parter Demo Tenant, the Assigned Users of the productive tenant are not listed, the tab Assigned Users displays 0 users for all Licensed Users.-The functionality to change old licenses to new licenses and to calculate new licenses with button 'Change License Model' is also not working.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Service Control Center.-Go to User Subscription.-Select in the dropdown By Date in Productive Systems.-In the tab 'Assigned Users' is displayed 0 users for all Licensed Users.-Resolution-The incident needs to be sent to the development team for correction, and also is required to change the component to SRD-CC-CI-CCS.-See Also-For additional information please refer to the below link:-PDF Document: FOR PARTNERS Simulate User types-Keywords-Licensed Users, Assigned Users, Old licenses, New licenses, Change License Model

Title: No Data Available in Standard Data Source: Valid Resource Actual Cost Components [FININVU17]
Content: Symptom-You are trying to fetch all the resource costs from the system and filter by status, but the data source FININVU17 with the description Valid Resource Actual Cost Components is not showing any data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center. -Go to Data Source view. -Search for the Data Source ID: FININVU17. -Click Preview button. -You will see that no data available.-Cause-In analytics report, the data source FININVU17 with description Valid Resource Actual Cost Components requires that you enable the scoping element for Actual Costing, which is not enabled.-You can follow the steps below to check the scoping element:-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Implementation Projects view. -Select the First Implementation. -Click Edit Project Scope. -Go to 3rd step - Scoping.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting > Inventory Valuation > Actual Costing.-Here you can see that this scoping element is not enabled.-Resolution-You need to enable the scoping element following the same steps mentioned above.-An alternative approach is to list the resources in the Cost and Revenue work center and view Resource Cost Rates. This shows the resource cost rates for different Set of Books and the data can be exported to Excel.-Keywords-FININVU17; Inventory Valuation; Actual Costing; Valid Resource Actual Cost Components; report; Data Source

Title: How Does the Field 'Paid/Received By' Work in the Petty Cash Journal?
Content: Symptom-You check the petty cash journal, and notice that there is a column 'Paid/Received By' and you would like to know how it works?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management Work Center.-Go to Petty Cash View.-Find petty cash ID AAA(AAA is the petty cash ID).-Click View Cash Journal-You see for document ID BB(BB is the document ID), the paid/received by is blank and you would like to know how it works?-Cause-The field Paid/Received By is mapped to Cash Payer / Cash Recipient on the incoming and outgoing payment transactions.-Resolution-When you create Incoming/Outgoing Cash Payment - Direct Posting to G/L Account and Incoming/Outgoing Cash Payment - Reference to Items, there is a field called Cash Payer/Cash Recipient, this information is reflected in the column Paid/Received By in the petty cash journal.-Keywords-paid/received by; cash recipient; cash payer; petty cash; cash journal.

Title: Error "Transfer Failed" When Trying to Transfer an Employee
Content: Symptom-The error message '"Transfer Failed" is occurring when trying to transfer an employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the employee.-Click Actions button and click Transfer Employee.-Select the transfer date.-Enter Organizational Unit and Job.-Click Save.-Error message "Transfer Failed" is displayed.-Cause-The issue could be caused because Replication has been descoped.-In a Replication scenario, the Administrative Category Code is not a field that is maintained and therefore, never gets sent into SAP Business ByDesign during a Replication Request. However, in standard Business ByDesign system with no replication, this is a Mandatory field during a Hire or Transfer scenario.-Resolution-It is necessary to manually maintain this Administrative Category for each affected Employee, since Replication has been descoped.-This can be done via Regular Tasks -> Change Administrative Category. The change date must be from the current/latest Work Agreement of the required Employee.-After that it should then be possible to Transfer the affected Employee(s).-Please note: There is no way to complete this process massively, each instance will need to be tackled manually using the above process.-Keywords- Transfer Failed, Replication, Transfer Employee

Title: The Deferred Revenue at the Point of Invoice is Different from the Revenue Recognized during Revenue Recognition
Content: Symptom-After the delivery of the products to the customer, you create a customer invoice and post it to accounting. The system automatically posts the amounts to the corresponding deferral accounts for revenues. You notice that the amount credited to the Deferred Revenues account is XXX. Then, during the period-end closing, you start the revenue recognition run to reset the revenue and expense deferrals, and make sure the related sales order item is processed successfully. But when you check the respective journal entry, you find that the amount debited to the Deferred Revenues account is YYY not XXX.-XXX means the amount credited to the Deferred Revenues account.-YYY means the amount debited to the Deferred Revenues account.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center, and choose the Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Open the customer invoice XYZ, and then choose View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Take a note of the sales order ID, which is ABC.-Open the corresponding journal entry of the customer invoice XYZ.-You can see that the amount credited to the Deferred Revenues account is XXX.-You then go to the Cost and Revenue work center, choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select Revenue Recognition subview.-Select the run executed for the same period of the posting date in the customer invoice XYZ.-Choose View and go to the Postings tab.-Open the journal entry, and you can see that for the item in sales document ABC, the amount debited to the Deferred Revenues account is YYY not XXX.-XYZ means the customer invoice ID.-ABC means the sales order ID.-Cause-During the creation of the customer invoice XYZ, the net price of the item is manually changed, which makes the net value in the customer invoice different from that in the sales order ABC, meanwhile, as the Accrual Method assigned to this sales order item is 2- Recognize revenue at point of delivery, so during the revenue recognition run, the system takes the planned value from the sales order instead of the real value in the customer invoice. This is why there is an amount difference between the financial document of the customer invoice and the revenue recognition posting.-Resolution-In order to clear the differences, there are two possible solutions:-If the sales order is still In Process, and the rest of the products are still about to be delivered, then there will be a final customer invoice associated. When the customer invoice is finally posted, the difference should be cleared.-If there are no further delivery and customer invoice expected, follow the steps below:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Master Data and Allocation view.-Select the sales order item for sales order ABC.-Choose Reassign, and then select Accrual Method.-Choose an accrual method of 4-Recognize revenue.-Then go to the Periodic Tasks view, select the Revenue Recognition subview.-Create a revenue recognition run for the same period.-The revenue will be recognized, and the difference should be cleared accordingly.-Keywords-Deferred Revenue; Point of Invoice; Revenue Recognized; Revenue Recognition

Title: Dump When Opening Employee Time Sheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When trying to edit the employee time sheet from the Self-Services, the system raises a short dump.-In the backend, it is possible to see 2 dumps. One is raised by the user trying to edit the time sheet, and the other is generated by the SAP_SYSTEM user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home -> Self-Services Overview.-Click on Edit Time Sheet.-Here the short dump is raised.-Cause-This issue may happen since the employee has no valid position after a certain date. This generally happens in replication scenarios where the employee replication request has no valid Reporting Line Unit after a certain date.-Resolution-Customer needs to check on the source system of the replication and ensure that the replication is assigning a valid Reporting Line Unit to the employee-Keywords-SF, TLM, Time Recording

Title: Howto Migrate "Alternative Employee ID" for Employee Data
Content: Symptom-You would like to migrate the field Alternative Employee ID, but you cannot find this field in the migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-The field can be found as follows:-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Select and edit an employee-Navigate to the tab Employment-In this screen, you can see the field Alternative Employee ID.-But when you go to the migration template of employee data, the field doesn't exist:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Click Open Activity List-Go to phase Integrate and Extend-Find the activity Migration of Employee Data-In the migration template, there is no field Alternative Employee ID.-Resolution-In the tab Personal Data of the migration template of employee data, you can find the main header Personal Identification, which contains the fields ID Card Type and ID Card Number.-If you wish to migrate alternative employee ID, you have to fill the field ID Card Type with the value HCM024 (code for alternative employee ID) and then enter the value for alternative employee ID into the field ID Card Number.-Note: In the current release the field is not available for Switzerland, this might be release in the future releases.-Keywords-Feld Alternative Personalnummer in Mitarbeiterstammdaten verfügbar, nicht auffindbar in Migration der Personalstammdaten und Mitarbeiterdaten, Alternative Employee ID, Missing, Not available.

Title: Wrong Mileage Reimbursement Amounts on Expense Report XYZ
Content: Symptom-You noticed that for Expense Report XYZ Preview, the Mileage distance in Reimbursement Details has been divided into two entries. (XYZ stands for the Expense Report ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Open Expense Reports view.-Search and open Expense Report XYZ.-Click on View All.-In General tab, click on Show More Mileage Information.-Here you have checked that the selection regarding Distance, Country/Region, Province, Vehicle Class, Vehicle Type is set as intended.-In the Review tab, you can see the Mileage Reimbursements amount and the Total Distance. By dividing it you notice that the Mileage Rate is different than expected.-Click on Preview, Reimbursement Details.-You notice that the Mileage distance has been divided into two entries.-Cause-Two or more Mileage Rates have been set for this specific Vehicle Type with different Miles/Km Limit in each Period. When the Miles/Km Limit is reached in the current Period, the system applies the next Mileage Rate available in this Expense Report.-To verify this settings:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Mileage Rates - <country> and click on Change Immediately. -Click on Edit mileage reimbursement rates.-For Vehicle Type AAA there are more than one entry, with different Miles/Km Limit and Reimbursement Rates; (AAA stands for the Vehicle Type);-In the Reimbursement Details, if you sum the Mileage distance to the Mileage Basis for Settlement you will get a greater amount than the Miles/Km Limit set in the Business Configuration. The remainder Mileage amount will be calculated according to the next Miles/Km Limit Reimbursement Rate.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior. Since in this Expense Report the Miles/Km Limit has been reached, the Report creates two separate Mileage amounts, one for each Mileage Rate.-Keywords-Expense Report. Mileage. Reimbursement.

Title: "123 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value." when creating new supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-You receive error "123 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value." when creating new supplier invoice. (123 represents the tax code you select)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to New Invoice Without Purchase Order or Create New Invoice Template under Common Tasks view.-Fill in supplier, buying company information and navigate to Items tab.-Select Tax Code as 123.-You receive error: 123 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.-Cause-You have created 2 tax codes with exactly the same tax event, tax type, tax rate type, and deductibility information in the system, and you also create 2 tax rates in the system, one of them is valid from a future date. You are expecting system picks different tax rate when selecting different tax code.-Resolution-There is no necessary to create 2 same tax code in the system. You can use the same tax code and you can update the tax rate by changing tax date field under Items tab, Taxes sub-tab, only if you have maintained corresponding tax rates for different valid dates via Business Configuration Activity: Tax on Goods and Services - Tax Rate Schedules.-You can obsolete tax code 123 as it is a duplicate one.-Keywords-"123 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value", Tax code, Supplier invoice, Supplier invoice template

Title: Error when replacing Team Member in Project
Content: Symptom-In Project, when selecting "Replace" button to replace a team member, this error message appears:-"Team member has recorded time to the project and cannot be replaced".-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Search and Open Project ABC-Navigate to Team and Staffing tab-Go to Teams subtab-Select the Team Member XYZ-Replace-Error message appears.-Cause-If you select "Staff by Team Member" under the view "Team and Staffing" you will see that Team Member XYZ already recorded actual work for the project ABC - this is the reason why they cannot be removed.-Resolution- This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Replace Team Member; Recorded Time to the Project

Title: Unexpected / Skipped Approver in Purchase Order Approval Process
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order or Supplier Invoice Approval Task is sent to unexpected Approver which is not following the Approval Process.-Or-An Approval step is skipped even when the condition satisfied.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For Purchase Order:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Create a Purchase Order ABC (ABC refers to Purchase Order ID).-Select the Approvals tab, there you will notice that the step 1 Approver is X, step 2 Approver is Y.-Submit the Purchase Order for Approval.-Approver X approves the Purchase Order, and the Purchase Order ABC status is updated to Sent. Step 2 Approval is skipped.-Navigate back to the Purchase Order ABC, to the Approval tab, only step 1 of the Approval Process is showing, step 2 has disappeared.-For Supplier Invoice:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Create a Supplier Invoice PQR (PQR refers to Supplier Invoice ID).-Select the Approvals tab, there you will notice that the step 1 Approver is X, step 2 Approver is Y.-Submit the Supplier Invoice for Approval. -Approver X approves the Supplier Invoice, and the Supplier Invoice PQR status is updated to Posted. Step 2 Approval is skipped.-Navigate back to the Supplier Invoice, to the Approval tab, only step 1 of the Approval Process is showing, step 2 has disappeared.-Cause-There can be multiple causes of this behavior, one of which is outlined below.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view-Search for Active Purchase Order or Supplier Invoice Approval Process -Skip Reapproval checkbox is enabled for expected steps (E.g: step 2).-Meanwhile,-Application and User Management work center-Go to Substitutions view-Here, Approver Y is substituted by Approver X, with a validity of Active.-Hence when the system is checking the necessity of step 2 in the Approval Process, it notices that the actual Approver should be Y's substitute X, who already approved the Purchase Order in earlier steps. As Skip Reapproval is in scope, the system skips step 2 and triggers the next step Approval (if there are any) or directly sends the order to the supplier (if no follow up approval steps are required).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-To have the approval in flow without skipping expected steps, Uncheck Skip Reapproval from the Approval Process, or deactivate the Substitution for the users according to your business case.-Keywords-Wrong Approver; Skipped Step; Substitution; Purchase Order; Approval Process;

Title: Error 'Gross Amount missing' in a Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Payment Allocation, but you are getting an error message 'Gross Amount missing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Allocation Management work center. -Go to Payment Allocation view. -Select All Payemet Allocations.-Search for Allocation ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Payment Allocation). -Click View All. -Check if the Customer/Supplier ID ABC (ABC represents the Customer/Supplier ID) and the Open Item are selected. -Click Post. -You will see the following error message: 'Gross Amount missing'.  -Cause-The issue is caused by the entry maintained under G/L Accounts tab with no amounts. You can check the same following the steps below:-Go to Payment Management work center. -Go to Payment Allocation view. -Select All Payment Allocations. -Search for Allocation ID XYZ. -Click View All. -Go to Allocation to G/L Account subtab.-Here you will see that an entry has been maintained for G/L Account DEF (DEF represents the G/L Account), however, no amounts were maintained (for example, no Debit Gross Amount or Credit Gross Amount).-Resolution-You should delete this entry mentioned above with the G/L Account with no amounts maintained. Once you remove this entry, you should be able to post the allocation.-Keywords-Payment Allocation; Gross Amount missing; G/L Account; post

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error
Content:
Symptom-You are trying to create a new Balance Confirmation Run, but when you try to restrict the selection of the Balance Confirmation run using Customer from / to the system shows an error.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center. -Go to Balance Confirmation Runs subview. -Click in New button > Balance Confirmation Run. -Go to the second step Restrictions. -In General Selection Criteria > select the desired company XYZ (XYZ represents the company ID).-Click in the value help icon of 'Customer from / to ID' and you will get the following error message: -Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-Details-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Response--500 SAP Internal Server Error--

500 SAP Internal Server Error

-Cause-One possible reason for this error is because the result set is too large for search criteria.-Resolution-You shouldn't click the value help icon for this company XYZ due to the huge dataset involved here, instead you can manually give the correct customer in the selection range and try scheduling the balance confirmation run.-If you are scheduling balance confirmation giving restriction type as Manual Collection of Customer/Supplier in the first step of the run, then search for the company and add it.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation Run; dump; 500 SAP Internal Server Error; new; Customer from / to ID; Restriction Type; Automated Selection of Customer/Supplier; Manual Collection of Customer/Supplier;

Title: Unable to Mark the Automatic Invoicing Checkbox in a Lease Contract
Content: Symptom-You are trying to mark the Automatic Invoicing checkbox in a lease contract, but you notice that checkbox is grayed out to mark.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Lease Contract Management work center. -Go to Lease Contract view. -Select All Lease Contracts. -Search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Lease Contract ID). -Go to Leased Objects tab. -You will see the checkbox Automatic Invoicing is grayed out.-Cause-It is not possible to mark the Automatic Invoicing checkbox in a Lease contract that it is already released.-Resolution-For Lease contracts with the status Released is not possible mark the checkbox anymore, just for Lease contracts with In-Preparation status or when you are creating a new one.-See Also-Create a Lease Contract-Lease Management Accounting: Configuration Guide-Lease Contract Quick Guide-Keywords-Lease Contract; Automatic Invoicing; checkbox

Title: An Error Occurred When Uploading Chart of Accounts
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have made adjustments to the G/L Accounts of a given chart of accounts. These adjustments were made via Excel file, however when you try to upload it, the system crashes.-***RELEASED INTERNALLY***-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit chart of accounts.-Select the relevant chart of accounts.-Click Import from Microsoft Excel.-Select the file to be imported.-Click Import.-The 'An Error Occurred' pop-up shows-up.-Cause-One of the reasons is that, in the Excel file, you have provided the Open Item Management column with values such as 'Yes' or 'No'. However, for this column, the system expects a Boolean input instead of 'yes' or 'no'.-The ST22 logs shows an exception being raised from CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICE_PROVIDER~EXECUTE_ACTION @ line 35-The Application Info section of the dump logs also shows the following info: 'The value N is not a valid logical value according to the XML format for ABAP'-Resolution-You need to review the file and maintain the OpenItemManagment column with a boolean indicator, where True is indicated by X and false with a space " "-Keywords-Chart of Accounts. Import.

Title: Filter Assign To in Purchase Request View it is not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-When you open the advanced filter in the Purchase Request view and select the Assign To as Sales Order and enter the Sales Order ID, the system does not show any results.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Filter for Open Purchase Requests.-Open Advanced Filter.-In Assigned To select Sales Order.-On Sales Order ID enter the relevant ID.-Click on Go.-See no records found.-Cause-The results will only show Purchase Request that has the Sales Order assigned as Account Assignment Type as you can see on the screenshot.-Even though the Sales Order is linked to the Purchase Request, the document has other type of Account Assignment rather than SLS - Sales Order. Hence, it will not be shown in the results of the search.-Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Request, Sales Order, Advanced Filter. Account Assignment.

Title: Unable to Generate Full Report of Supplier Data hence want to identify which Suppliers are missing in report
Content: Symptom-Unable to generate full report of supplier data hence you want to identify which Suppliers are missing in report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To view Complete Supplier data follow below steps and you can find total Suppliers available.-Go to Supplier Base work center and to Suppliers view-Show: All Suppliers-To Fetch the Supplier report,you follow below steps and notice only few number of Suppliers displayed and not all-Go to Supplier Base work center .-Select Reports view-Search for report 'Supplier Collaboration Data'-Open it-Click in Apply-The Report is not showing all suppliers.-Cause-Unfortunately the data source behind report "Supplier Collaboration Data" is not suitable to find "not existing" collaboration data.-The reason for that is, spoken from a database point of view, the data source uses existing collaboration data as an anchor and-then links supplier data to it.-As a consequence, if a supplier misses any collaboration data (such as output channel definitions), it won't appear at all in the report.-Resolution-We would recommend to create an own data source.-You can do this by following below Steps-1. Go to Business Analytics WorkCenter View-2. Select Design Data Source .-3. Create a "New" Data source as an OUTER join from (for example)-Data source SUPPLIER ("Supplier master data") joined to-Data source "Supplier Collaboration Data".-The JOIN condition is that the "Supplier" in "Supplier Master Data" equals "Supplier" in "Supplier Collaboration Data".-You could then select any interesting fields (which should be filled in case of existing collaboration data) as view fields and-use this data source to find supplier with empty (i.e. non-existing) collaboration data.-See Also-missing output channel selections;unable to generate a full report , Showing less supplier data-Keywords-missing output channel selections,unable to generate a full report,showing less supplier data

Title: Goods and Service Receipt Cancellation does not go to Approval
Content: Symptom-You have set up a condition in the approval process of Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) which should trigger once a GSR is canceled, but no approval task is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue--1--You have created an extension field through adaptation mode and names it "Canceled"-Once you cancel a GSR, this field will be maintained with "X" in the GSR cancellation.--2--Go to work center Application and User Management-Approval process view-Search and open the active approval process for GSR-From here, you have maintained a condition as per below:-If the field "Canceled" is equal to "X", an approval task will be created for a designated approver.-During the creation of the GSR Cancellation, you will find the right approver under Approval tab in the GSR Cancellation.-However, upon releasing the GSR Cancellation, the document get posted without going to approval.-Cause-For GSR, the approved notifications are always relevant, except messages from Employee time calendar and GSR cancellation.-Therefore, GSR cancellation approval task will not be triggered by the system.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour in the current version of Business ByDesign.-However, this scenario could be enabled through customized solution via PDI.-Please contact your add on partner for further information regarding a possible customized solution.-Keywords-Goods and Service Receipt Cancellation, Approval Process, Approval Task

Title: Trouble shooting transport number issue within Custom Code Management
Content: Symptom-You found deletion transport, backup transport, transport number column in Object List of Decommissioning Cockpit not updated-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-SM_WORKCENTER->Custom Code Management->Custom Code Retirement Decommissioning Cockpit-Resolution-1. Make sure latest versions of following notes are implemented:-SP7-SP9:-2820503 - Decommission Cockpit: Problem with Backing Up Objects 7.2 SP07--SP9-SP15:-3268416 - Object list: recomended for decommissioning status change--SP5-SP13:-3087366 - Transport Number Missing for function group in Object List

Title: Scanned Invoice Has Wrong Company ID
Content: Symptom-Wrong Buying Company ID appearing in both scanned values and reviewed values in Scanned invoice review screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Scanning view.-Click in Upload button.-Click in Browse button.-Select the PDF file.-Click in Start Process button.-Refresh the page until the document's status is not In Process.-Click in Review button.-The Buying Company ID is wrong.-The same issue also happens if the user uploads the file via Collaboration Window tool.-Cause-There are two possible reasons for this behavior.-Cause 1 - Scoped Question -The behavior of which company ID is picked to the Scanned Invoice depends if the question was scoped in the Implementation Projects. The question is: 'Do you want to default the company based on scanned value?'.-Firstly please check if this question is scoped:-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Implementation Projects view. -Select the implementation project. -Click in Edit Project Scope button. -Click in Next button until reach step '4 Questions'. -Expand Purchasing. -Expand Supplier Invoicing. -Select 'Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos'. -Check if the question "Do you want to default the company based on scanned value?" is scoped.-If this question is scoped, the Company ID will be picked from the Scanned Invoice file.-If this question is not scoped, the Company ID will be the taken from the user that uploaded the Scanned Invoice file.-Cause 2 - Company Address  -The address of company in PDF is different from Company address maintained in the ByD Master Data.-Another reason could be that there are two companies defined in Organizational Management work center and both Companies have the same names, definitions, functions, address. In general, system validates both Company names and address, functions, definitions to fetch the right company ID and name.-Resolution-Resolution for Cause 1 - If you need that the Company ID is the one that is maintained in the file, please maintain the question scoped. Otherwise, un-scope the question.-Resolution for Cause 2 - Please change the address of the Company in ByDesign to match the one in the PDF file. After, perform the Master Data Synchronization and wait for the Master Data to resync (it syncs every night). Then the user can upload the Scanned Invoice again.-Keywords-Scanned Invoice; Supplier Invoice; Collaboration Window; Wrong company ID

Title: System is Showing Withholding Taxes in One Line Only in a Supplier Invoice Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You notice that supplier invoice is grouping withholding taxes on the accounting entry, the invoice in this case for example has 3 entries, it should appear separately for each entry in the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Source Documents subview. -Select All Documents. -Search for the Document ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Document ID) in this case a Supplier Invoice. -Click View All. -Go to Document Flow tab and then click in the Journal Entry ABC (ABC represents the Journal Entry ID) of the Supplier Invoice.-Here you will see supplier invoice is grouping withholding taxes on the accounting entry.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior. Taxes in SAP Business ByDesign are always posted in an aggregated manner.-Resolution-As long as different supplier invoice items have same tax attributes (tax code, tax event, tax type, tax rate type) the taxes will be aggregated and posted. This is a standard behaviour.-There is only one exception, that is when the extension scenario between supplier invoice item and tax register split item is activated. Only in that case aggregation is stopped and individual line items are posted. But this rather an exception.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Withholding taxes; Tax; Accounting entry

Title: The Complete Scrapping of a Fixed Asset Still Posts to G/L Accounts Even Though the Net Book Value is Zero
Content: Symptom-You have fully depreciated an asset and want to set its status to Retired. You attempt to perform a complete scrapping, however you notice that the resulting journal entry for this complete scrapping is generating additional postings.-You would like to understand the reason for these postings, since the net book value is already zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Open the relevant asset.-Under the General tab, see that the Net Book Value is 0,00.-Click Manual Posting -> Complete Scrapping.-Simulate the Journal Entry.-In the journal entry, you see that the system credit and debit the fixed asset's acquisition cost. Since the net book value is zero, you would like to understand these postings.-Cause-This happens due to the nature of the Complete Scrapping posting. The complete scrapping usually means that you are removing the asset from your portfolio (due to fire, accident, etc) it is no longer to be used. Hence, the posting credits the historical cost account, debits accumulated/proportional depreciation and Loss from Scrapping accounts (netbook value).-In this case, you have e.g. migrated the asset with historical costs and full depreciation. Therefore, for this asset there is a debit balance in Historical Costs account and a credit balance in the Accumulated Depreciation account. Since it is a full depreciation, the net book value is zero.-Once you do a complete scrapping, the system will Credit the Historical Cost and debit the Accumulated Depreciation account. There will be no postings to Loss from Scrapping account, since the net book value is zero.-If the asset was not fully depreciated, the remaining asset's net book value would be debited to Loss from Scrapping account as the assets are retired at the current net book value excluding revenue.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior given the posting logic for depreciation and complete scrapping. You can find more details and examples in the help document Manual Postings in Fixed Assets in the section for Complete Scrapping.-You need to evaluate if the complete scrapping is the desired approach. Note that you can deactivate a fixed asset by setting the Deactivation Date under Master Data -> Life Cycle Data tab in the fixed asset's master data.-Keywords-Manual Posting. Depreciation. Complete Scrapping. Fixed Asset.

Title: Project Assignment Disappearing When Working with Resource Search View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY**-When opening a Resource Profile, the Project Assignment tab is visible briefly during the page loading process. Once the profile is fully loaded, the tab disappears automatically. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Resource Management work center.-Open the Resource Search view.-Select a resource.-Click Edit Resource Profile.-Observe that during page loading, the Project Assignment tab is visible.-Once loading is complete, the tab is no longer displayed.-Cause-The Project Assignment section within the Resource Profile is technically linked to the legacy (old) Resource Calendar framework.-For customers using the new Resource Calendar, this section is no longer supported. During UI runtime, the system evaluates the active calendar framework and applies calculation rules that automatically suppress obsolete UI sections related to the old calendar. As a result, the Project Assignment tab is hidden once the page fully loads.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior as per the standard design.-Keywords-Project Assignment tab disappears, Project Assignment not appearing, Resource Profile loaded, Resource Profile finishes loading, Project Assignment missing, SAP Business ByDesign

Title: Remaining Quantity not updating after Manual Change in Project
Content: Symptom-In Project, in "Material" subtab, you have maintained a manual change to a material's remaining stock.-However, when you create a Project Stock Order, deliver and consume this material, the remaining quantity value does not decrease.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search and Open Project ABC.-In Project Plan tab, under Gantt Chart subtab, select the project task for which you want to create a Project Stock Order.-Navigate to Materials subtab.-Notice you can see a blue arrow which indicates a manual change has been done.-However, each Project Stock Order created, delivered and consumed thereafter does not change the value manually maintained in the "Remaining Quantity" field.-Cause-A manual overwrite will remain in the field "Remaining Quantity" regardless of material delivery and consumption.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour in the current version of Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Remaining Quantity; Project Stock Order; Manual Change

Title: Error Message Manually Clearing a Supplier Invoice with a Down Payment: No Deductible Item Found For Difference Distribution or Invalid Difference Reason Code. Enter a Valid Difference Reason Code or Choose a Deductible Item to Distribute the Amount.
Content: Symptom-You want to manually clear a supplier invoice with a down payment where the invoice's amount is less than the down payment.-To distribute the payment difference amount to clear the Remaining Balance you click Apply Discount or Credit button, enter the difference amount and Payment Difference Reason, however, system throws the error message:-'No deductible item found for difference distribution or invalid difference reason code. Enter a valid difference reason code or choose a deductible item to distribute the amount'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center-Go to Supplier Accounts view-Open the concerned supplier account-Select the respective invoice(s) and the down payment and click Clear Manually-Click Apply Discount or Credit, enter respective Amount and Payment Difference Reason-Click OK-Error message is thrown:-'No deductible item found for difference distribution or invalid difference reason code. Enter a valid difference reason code or choose a deductible item to distribute the amount.'-Cause-On down payments, cash discounts are not allowed, therefore the error message is thrown.-While clearing the down payment request, the payment that was created has the discounts, but the down payment that is created cannot have these.-Resolution-To clear the Remaining Balance and post the clearing you should enter the invoice(s) amount as the Applied Net Amount for the down payment.-The down payment will then be in status Partially Cleared (down payment request items cannot be partially cleared, but down payments can be).-Finally, for the remaining amount you can create a new credit for that amount and clear against the remaining balance of the down payment.-For example, consider the data below and the steps executed:-Down Payment amount: 200,00 USD-Invoice amount: 150,00 USD-Remaining Balance: 50,00 USD-Enter the Invoice amount (150,00 USD) as the Down Payment Applied Net Amount.-As a result, the Remaining Balance is cleared (0,00 USD). Post the Clearing.-Consequently, the invoice is Cleared, and the down payment is Partially Cleared, with an open amount of 50,00 USD.-You can then create a credit of 50,00 USD (Supplier Credit) and clear against the remaining down payment (50,00 USD).-Remark: when the currencies of Down Payment and Invoices are different, then above solution won't work when taxes are involved.-See Also- KBA 2696553 - Error: 'Update for tax register failed for' while Clearing a Down Payment -Keywords-Clearing, Invoice, Down Payment

Title: Fiscal Year/Period is Missing for Company When Migrating Valuation Data
Content: Symptom-You are executing the material valuation migration, however the simulation step returns an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity Migration of Material Valuation Data.-Click to migrate using the migration tool.-Create a migration unit and execute a Migration Step-by-Step.-In the simulate step, an error is raised as follows: 'Fiscal year/period is missing for company <company ID and name> set of books <set of books ID> posting date <posting date>'-Cause-For this combination of company and set of books, you have a custom fiscal year variant from which the system derives the accounting periods and years for a given posting date.-In this case, you are uploading valuation data with validity from 01.03.2018 to 31.12.2018. Nevertheless, there is no accounting period and fiscal year defined, for example 31.12.2018 in your custom fiscal year variant. Hence, period and fiscal year cannot be derived for the date.-Resolution-In order to proceed with the migration of valuation data, please check the validity range of the uploaded data and make sure that the dates are mapped to an accounting period and fiscal year in the fiscal year variant.-To check which fiscal year variant is used:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Sets of Books and Assigned Companies.-Find the combination of company and set of books.-In the details section of this screen, the associated variant is displayed.-In order to adjust the fiscal year variant, please follow below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Find and open activity Other Fiscal Year.-With the activity open, click Period Details tab for the concerned fiscal year variant.-Maintain the mapping for the relevant dates and accounting period/year.-Save and Close-After that, you may simulate the inport of valuation data again.-Note that depending on the setup of the fiscal year variant, the required date would be mapped to an accounting period of the following year. In the example above mentioned, date 31.12.2018 could be mapped to 001/2019. In this case, you may also include the relevant fiscal year in the set of books, as follows:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Sets of Books and Assigned Companies.-Find the combination of company and set of books.-Click Edit Fiscal Year.-Add the required fiscal year if not added yet.-Keywords-Migration Tool. Material Valuation. Fiscal Year. Set of Books.

Title: Depreciation Run Does not Execute Postings For Migrated Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-You have migrated Fixed Assets for your company recently, with migration posting date set in the last period of the previous fiscal year XXXX. You are now starting the depreciation run for the first period of the current fiscal year, 001.YYYY.-You expect the depreciation run to generate deprecation postings. Instead, an information message appears: For the selected fixed assets, posting not required in set of books ABC (ABC stands for the respective set of books ID).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Fixed Assets workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks - Depreciation view.-Select the just executed deprecation run and press View.-In the Postings tab you notice that no postings have been generated.-In the Messages tab you are informed that For the selected fixed assets, posting [are] not required in set of books ABC.-  Cause-At the time of the Fixed Asset Migration the current fiscal year YYYY was created but all periods of this fiscal year were closed. Currently,in this situation,  the system stores all deprecation values in the last period of the fiscal year.-To verify this you can check the planned depreciation values in the Deprecation report:-In the Fixed Assets workscenter go to the Reports - List view.-Open the Depreciation report.-Maintain the respective Company, Set of Books and Valuation view.-In the Accounting Period/Year field select Current Fiscal Year.-Press Go.-Now add the characteristics Fixed Asset, Fiscal Year and Accounting Period from the Not Currently Shown section to the Rows section.-You will now see that the full depreciation amount of the current fiscal year is stored in the last fiscal period 012.YYYY.-Resolution-Currently, the following solution applies in this situation:-Once at least one of the current fiscal year accounting periods are open you can trigger a recalculation of the depreciation values by executing a recalculating depreciation run:-In the Fixed Assets workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks - Depreciation view.-Press New - Fixed Asset Depreciation Run.-Enter the Company.-In the Period/Year field enter period 999 and Year 9999.-This will trigger the recalculation of all fixed asset depreciation values. All amounts will be stored per period. Please note: The recalculation run does not generate any postings itself.-After the Recalculation run execute the Depreciation run for an actual accounting period of Fiscal year YYYY to post depreciation values.

Title: How to Expand All G/L Accounts in Financial Statements Report
Content: Symptom-You run the Financial Statement report and want to expand all G/L accounts as default every time the report is opened.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Analytics work center.-View Design Reports.-Open Design and Assign Reports.-Click Financial Statements.-Enter the required parameters.-Press Go.-You cannot view all the G/L accounts in the reports as a default view.-Resolution-To expand all Structure levels, you need to define hierarchy setting directly for the Balance Sheet And Income Statement Item:-Navigate to Business Analytics work center.-View Design Reports - Design and Assign Reports.-Open the Financial Statements report.-Enter the required parameters.-Go to View option.-Access the Characteristics Settings of the Balance Sheet And Income Statement Item (click the three little dots beside the characteristic and select Characteristic Settings).-Choose an option from the Initial Expansion Level column under Characteristics in Rows.-Under Hierarchy, in the Initial Expansion Level field select the expansion level of your choice (up to 10) or select Fully Expanded (up to 98 levels).-Press OK.-You can save the view by selecting View button and Save.-Set the saved view as default by selecting the Set as Default button.-Close and re-open the report and you should be able to see the report opening with the desired layout.-Keywords-Initial Expansion level; Financial Statements; Hierarchy level expansion; Fully Expanded; Report;

Title: Employees Are Not Able to View Holiday Calendar
Content: Symptom-Employees are unable to find the link View Holiday Calendar in the Self-Services Overview in Home work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time, not able to see the link View Holiday Calendar-Cause-Issue is because the below scoping question is not scoped in your system.-Do you want your employees to be able to view their time statement using self-service?-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select Edit Project Scope button-Go to Questions section-Expand Human Resources -Time and Labor Management-Time Recording-Scope the question Do you want your employees to be able to view their time statement using self-service?-Complete the scoping by selecting Confirm and Finish-Note: In case all settings are correct and -See Also-KBA: 3271830 - Holiday Calendars are not Available in the System-Keywords-View Holiday Calendar, Holiday Calendar

Title: Generating a Survey Summary - Survey Summary Not Found
Content: Symptom-You want to generate the summary of a Survey for a Lead or an Opportunity that has been completed, but you cannot find the summary document after its generation.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You have completed a Survey for a Lead or an Opportunity and you have clicked "Actions" > "Generate Survey Summary". You cannot see the Survey Summary Document.-Cause-The Pane "Survey Summary" is not visible. The summary document is only visible in the 'Survey Summary' pane.-Resolution-To see the summary document after you have clicked "Actions" > "Generate Survey Summary" in the Lead or Opportunity, the pane "Survey Summary" has to be added to the Survey facet via Adaptation:-Go to the Sales work centre-Go to the Leads or Opportunities view (as needed)-Go to the Survey Facet of the lead or opportunity that you generated the survey summary for-Start Adaptation mode-Select the Survey facet-Select the Survey Pane Variant-Go into the 'List Details'-Here, make the 'Survey Summary' pane visible.- The Summary Document is now available to download in the Survey Summary Pane.-

Title: Using Multiple Identity Providers In Single Sign On
Content: Symptom-You configured multiple Identity Providers (IDP's) in your system, but when your users are trying to login, it is always routed directly to the default one.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Title: Payment Curr. and Tax Return Arrangem. Curr. of Tax Authority XYZ Unequal
Content: Symptom-You try to post a Payment Allocation in which you have selected a tax authority XYZ under the field Customer/Supplier ID but you get the error-"Payment Curr. and Tax Return Arrangem. Curr. of Tax Authority XYZ Unequal".-(XYZ is the tax authority)-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select the Payment Allocations view.-Show all In Preparation allocations, and select the one in question.-Edit the Payment Allocation and navigate to Customer/Supplier tab.-Select the Tax Authority XYZ from the value help.-Cause-Company Tax Authority is registered in country/region CH - Switzerland, then the payments to tax authorities should be only in CHF currency and no other currency is allowed. In this case the payment allocation is made in USD, and if you simply try to change the currency in the payment allocation to CHF, then that is not allowed as it picks up the currency given in the corresponding Bank Statement.-Resolution-So the only way forward is to accept the Payment from Bank in CHF currency which is the same the currency of the Tax Authority XYZ. For this the statement needs to be reversed and created again. If you do not want to reverse the Bank Statement then you may allocate this payment to some other Customer/Supplier or you can select Tax Authority which is registered in US then system will be able to accept the payment in the payment allocation made from USD currency.-Keywords-Steuerbehörde, CH, Steuerzahlung, Kontoauszug, Payment Allocation, Tax Authority,

Title: Dunning Runs are Generating Reminder Letters Instead of Dunning Letters
Content: Symptom-You execute the Dunning Run and you notice that for invoices with a long time overdue it is being generated a Reminder Letter instead of a Dunning Letter as per defined in the number of days (Dunning Interval) in Dunning Strategies in Business Configuration Fine-Tune activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables  Work Center.-Go to Periodic Tasks View and then Dunning Runs.-Click on New button and select Dunning Run.-Complete the necessary data.-Click on Activate.-Click on Schedule.-Select Start Immediately.-Click on Save and Close button.-Show Active Dunning Runs.-Click on Go for refreshing.-Select the dunning just created.-In the Execution Details select the item with Processing status Finished.-Click on Display Log.-You will see the generated information.-Click on Close button.-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Dunning View.-Select a Dunning ID with In Preparation status.-Click on Preview button and select Dunning Letter.-You will see that a Reminder Letter is being generated whereas an invoice with a long time overdue has been selected.-Cause-Any invoice that is overdue more than the number of days (Dunning Interval) defined in the Dunning Strategies in Business Configuration Fine-Tune activity, the Reminder Letter will be first picked since it was maintained with Dunning Level 0.-Resolution-The system behavior is correct, when you execute the Dunning Run for the first time, system will go to Dunning Level 0 and will generate a Reminder Letter. Once the Reminder Letter is issued, the last Dunning date is set against the particular invoice and when you execute the Dunning Run again, it will go to the Level 1, following the sequence:-Dunning Level 0: Reminder Letter-Dunning Level 1: Dunning Letter-Dunning Level 2: Dunning Letter-And the same for next levels in case you have configured in your system.-Keywords-Dunning Interval. Dunning Run. Dunning.

Title: Report For Supplier Invoice Is Not Showing The Correct Net Amount
