Content: Symptom- Monitoring Invoice Report is not showing the correct value of net amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Open the Monitoring Invoices.-Filter for Invoice ID ABC and Display Currency as DD.MM.YYYY (ABC represts the invoice ID, DD represents the day, MM the month and YYYY the year).-Click on Apply.-System displays the net amount less than the corresponding value in supplier invoice.-Cause-System behavior.-Resolution-It is a system behavior as the report uses the middle rate to calculate the net amount.-The supplier invoice calculates the net amount using the ask rate, as maintained in the currency conversion profiles.-Keywords-Report; Supplier Invoice; Net Amount; Monitoring Invoices;

Title: The Status Of The Shopping Cart Is Partially Delivered Even The Purchase Order Is Finished
Content: Symptom- Manually Delivery Finished Purchase Order not reflected in the Delivery status of the Shopping Cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Filter for All Purchase Orders and open the advanced filter.-In Shopping Cart ID, search for ABC (ABC represents the Shopping Cart ID).-Open the Purchase Order DEF (DEF represents the Purchase Order ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Check the item number XX is Manually Finished (XX represents the item number that was manually finished).-Check the status for Shopping Cart is Partially Delivered.-Cause-When the Ordered Quantity in the Shopping Cart is more/greater than the Requested Quantity, system will not update the latest quantity from Purchase Order.-Resolution-System is not updating the Shopping Cart from Purchase Order quantity, so you can follow the steps bellow to change the Partially Delivered status for Shopping Cart to Complete Delivered:-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Services overview.-Access the Confirm Deliveries in Shopping Cart view.-Filter for the Shopping Cart ID ABC.-Click on Actions button.-Click on Manually Complete.-Keywords-Shopping Cart; Partially Delivered; Manually Delivered; Shopping Cart Status; Purchase Order;

Title: Withholding Tax Amount Not Displayed In Payment
Content: Symptom-You created a supplier invoice containing withholding tax. While creating a new payment for this invoice, the system does not show withholding tax on the payment screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Select the Supplier Accounts view.-Search for the supplier for which the invoice was posted.-Click on View.-Go to Trade Payables tab and Invoice/Payments Sub tab.-Search for the invoice.-Click on Pay Manually By and select the relevant payment method.-In the Open Items - grid, you will find the column for Withholding Tax Amount.-When you select the invoice, Withholding Tax Amount is 0,00 and does not show the value as displayed in the invoice.-This results in different value for the payment than the invoice.-Cause-Depending on the country, it is a legal requirement to have withholding tax due at the invoicing and not relevant for the down payments /payments.-Hence at invoice level, withholding tax will be calculated and posted in the supplier invoice's journal entry. Since withholding tax is accounted at invoice level, it does not calculate again at payment level.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. For some countries, withholding tax is relevant/posted at invoice level and for other countries it is relevant/posted at payment level.-In any case, the following formula should be consistent: Open Amount = Total Gross Amount - Withholding Tax Amount-Keywords-Withholding Tax. Supplier Invoice. Payment.

Title: No Application of Manual Journal Entry Vouchers of Type Payables/Receivables for Open Documents
Content: Symptom-You want to clear open payable documents employing the journal entry voucher functionality. As an offsetting transaction your are creating a journal entry voucher of the type Manual Entry for Accounts Payable referencing the offsetting payables document (e.g.: supplier invoice). After posting the Journal Entry Voucher your expectation is that the referenced item is cleared. However, the item is still showing as open in the supplier's account monitor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In work center General Ledger, open the sub-view Journal Entry Vouchers under Journal Entries.-Press New and open a new journal entry voucher.-As Journal Entry Type choose Manual Entry for Accounts Payable.-As Screen Variant choose Manual Adjusting Entry for Accounts Pay.-Type in appropriate parameters for G/L Account, Debit/Credit and the respective Supplier.-Choose the Source Document ID of the open item and the corresponding Source Document Type (for example: Supplier Invoice).-After adding at least one more balancing line you post the journal entry voucher. -Cause-The journal entry voucher functionality is not intended for the use of clearing open payables/receivables documents. Even when referencing open payables/receivables documents in Manual Entries for Accounts Payables/Receivables those entries do not clear those documents (for example: open invoices) but rather serve as adjustments in the context of period ending activities.-Resolution-Use the conventional clearing options for open payables/receivables in the account monitor, for example, clearing against payments. In case of deviating business scenarios choose the option of applying New Credit/Charge of several types in order to clear open items.-Go to work center Payables.-Choose Supplier Accounts under the view Suppliers and select the desired supplier account.-Via View you can list Open Items under the tab Trade Payables - Invoices / Payments.     -Highlight the respective open item(s) and press New Charge/Credit.-Apply the corresponding debit/credit entries against the payable item.-Keywords- Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable; Manual Entry for Accounts Payable

Title: 'There is already a country version ABC for country DEF.' Error in Create New Country/Region Version Screen
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a new country version in the activity Create New Country/Region Version the following error message appears:-'There is already a country version ABC for country DEF.'-ABC means the Country/Region Version.-DEF means the Country Name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune.-Open the Create New Country/Region Version activity.-Add a new country variant by filling out all mandatory fields.-Error is thrown:-'There is already a country version ABC for country DEF.'-Cause-Countries already scoped in the main scoping settings cannot be added as new variant in the Create New Country/Region Version activity.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.-Keywords- country version; travel solution; country/region

Title: Not Able to Clear a Document Due to an Error '500 SAP Internal Server Error'
Content: Symptom-You are facing a system crash when trying to do a manual clearing of some open item in a customer account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center. -Go to Customer Accounts subview. -Select All Customers. -Search for account ID XYZ (XYZ represents the customer account). -Click View. -Select the Open Items. -Click Clear Manually button. -You will see the following error message: - An error occurred-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-Details-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Response-500 SAP Internal Server Error-500 SAP Internal Server Error-Cause-One possible reason for the system is crashing because of the document selected (i.e. invoice) doesn't have tax lines maintained on its respective Tax sections:-Select the Open item that you would like to clear, in this case for example could be a customer invoice.-Click View All.-Go to Items tab > Taxes sub tab > Tax Details section, leading to the failure of register entries.-There are no Tax lines in the Invoice, hence system failed to do the clearing.-Resolution-If the document is already posted you should re-create the documents with the tax line items information, even though all the amounts are zero, the tax line item should be present, otherwise the system will crash due to such inconsistency.-SAP is not able to correct them from the backend system since they have already been completed.-Keywords-Clear Manually; Clear; Payables; Receivables; 500 SAP Internal Server Error; Dump

Title: The Service Confirmation is Dumping When it is Released
Content: Symptom-The Service Confirmation is dumping when you release with it Without Order Completion.-This also applies when the Approval Process is in scope and the Approval task is executed which also releases the Service Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repairs work center.-Go to the Service Confirmations view.-Show All Confirmations and Find ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the Service Confirmation ABC and choose Edit button.-Click on Release Button.-Select the option Order Without Order Completion.-The dump happens.-Cause-This is occurring because the Communication Arrangement DEF (Where DEF represents the ID of the Communication Arrangement) is not active. The status is currently "In Preparation".-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find GHI (Where GHI represents the ID of the Account).-Open the account GHI.-Go to the Communication tab.-Select the Collaboration subtab.-Select the Service Confirmation.-Select the Maintain XML Settings button.-The new screen will show Communication Arrangement: Service Order Integration.-Activate this Communication Arrangement.-Keywords-Service Order; Dump; Communication Arrangement; Without Order Completion;BUPA_NOT_FOUND; CO_APCRM_SRVC_GSA_CHG_OB; Shortcut not available: ServiceConfirmationProcessing

Title: SAP Internal Process Document - For CEE / CSM / SAP CPS-LIS Team
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document will help you understand the actions required by the CEE/CSM's and SAP CPS0-LIS team, when handling customer situations/incidents/emails. [SAP Internal]-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Resolution-Scenarios Actions To Be Performed Responsible-How can a customer request SAP to change the IT contact for a tenant, which is not yet accessible to the customer?-                                OR --What actions needs to be taken when no IT contact is available for the customer or a wrong email address of IT contact is maintained & customer requests SAP to resend the initial logon credentials to another email address?-                                OR --The key user / IT contact has left the organization and a new key user must be added as an IT contact in order to have admin rights?-        Customer needs to contact to his CSP (Customer Engagement Executive) in writing and request the above.-SAP CSP will then evaluate the request.  If the CSP confirms the IT contact change, he will create a ticket for GCO Order Management Team:-Link: https://sales.int.sap/index.html  -Content: “I, the CSP of customer xxx, herewith request to change the existing IT contact for all tenants of this customer to the following:-Name of IT contact: xxx -Email address of IT contact: xxx -Phone number of IT contact: xxx -(The old IT contact of Mr. xxx should be disabled.) The corresponding VB order number is xxx.  --I confirm that the above mentioned IT contact change is required and that it is correct. “-GCO Order Management Team will execute the changes and send confirmation to CSP.-Then CSP to send a mail to Support Customer Interaction Center (CIC).-Access: support.sap.com > contact us (blue box on right) > Non-technical assistance > Email CIC (direct link as of 2019 01) -Content: “Dear colleagues, the changes I triggered to change the IT contact have been successfully executed by our GCO Order Management Team. Could you please trigger the sending of the logon credentials to the maintained IT contact?” -CIC will create a P2 incident. Cloud Product Support dispatcher receives the incident and assigns it to the LIS team.-The CPS LIS team will process the incident by requesting to Operations to resend the credentials to all IT contacts maintained in the VB order. Operations team ensures sending the email and confirms back to CPS LIS team. CPS LIS team will send email to customer contact maintained in the incident, confirming that SAP has sent the email with the logon credentials to all maintained IT contacts, asking the customer to confirm reception of the email.-CSP/CSM-How can a customer change the IT contact, the Commercial Contact and/or the SAP Store buyer contact in a tenant himself?-  The following KBA describes how to create a new IT Contact from within the system:-2101230 - How To Create a Commercial Contact , IT Contact or SAP Store Buyer contact-The following KBAs describe how to modify IT contact information in the system:-2429016 - Modify IT Contact Information in BYD  -2502589 - Modify IT Contact Information in C4C  -Customer-How can a customer request SAP to resend the logon credentials (User ID + Password) for the “Initial User” to the IT contact, which is mentioned in the contract? (Note: the initial user is valid for 30 days only, after that it is locked)?-  We must have customer incident with the below details,-Customer Name: -Customer ID:  -Tenant URL: -Reason for resending the Initial Credentials: (e.g. Tenant delivered but Credentials are not received) -CPS LIS team will forward it to MS- System Setup/Termination queue for reset & resending the credentials to the IT contact.-  SAP-What actions does SAP CPS LIS team takes, when a customer requests SAP to unloack the pasword for a Key User?-  We advise customer with the below solution:-Password can be unlocked by another Key User (we will provide the key user details to customer if any) in the affected tenant. If not found then,  -                            OR-Based on criticality and exception situations i.e. If only one key user exists in the system, we will unlock password for the key user from our end. -Customer/SAP-What actions does SAP CPS LIS team takes, when a customer request SAP to unlock the password for the End User?-Customer Key User can reset the password for the End User. -NOTE: We from SAP will never unlock/reset the password for the Business User. -Customer-  Keywords-IT contact change, Change IT contact, Contact Modification, Key User Password Reset, Reset End User Password

Title: Bank Statement File Upload Failed - Errors related to Account Details, Closing Balance, Opening Balance, Sum of Debit/Credit Items, Bank Statement Currency
Content: Symptom-When uploading a bank statement file an error message is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management view.-Go to the Inbound Files sub view.-Perform the action New Inbound file to upload a new file.-You receive an error message.-Cause-The error messages received while uploading bank statements are due to incorrect Bank Statement File. You need to check with the bank for these inconsistencies in the file.-Resolution-No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number X, national bank code Y, and currency ZZZ found, Bank account missing or cannot be determined. Resolution: You need to correctly maintain the Bank data in the My Banks View Liquidity Management work center. Make sure that a bank is entered in the system with a bank account number, national bank code and currency as maintained in the file. The bank account should be active before the bank statement date specified in the file.-Closing balance X  must match opening balance Y of the next bank statement. Resolution: The closing balance of a bank statement must match the opening balance of the next bank statement. You need to check the balances with your bank to provide the correct information in the file.-Opening balance X  must match closing balance of the previous bank statement Y. Resolution: The opening balance of a bank statement must match the closing balance of the previous bank statement. You need to check the balances with your bank to provide the correct values in the file.-Calculated closing balance X is different from stated -Y. Resolution: The opening balance value is missing in the file.  Therefore the calculated closing balance is different from the actual closing balance entered in the file. You need to check the balances with your bank to provide the correct values in the file.-Sum of debit items X must match Total Debit Amount Y. Resolution: The total debit entered on header record level does not match the sum of all debit items in the bank statement. You need to check the balances with your bank to provide the correct values in the file.-Sum of credit items X must match Total Credit Amount Y. Resolution: The total credit maintained on header record level does not tally with the sum of all credit items in the bank statement. You need to check the balances with your bank to provide the correct values in the file.-Bank statement currency must match all other currencies on header. Resolution: The currency must be same for all the records on the header. The bank statement currency must be equal to the Opening balance currency, closing balance currency, Total debit amount currency and total credit amount currency. If there is no record present in the bank statement for above record types, the file can't be uploaded.  will not be able to match the currencies for the entire header.-Example:-In a BAI2 file, line 03 represents the statement header. The following record types can appear in the relevant bank statement file:-010-Opening Ledger-015-Closing Ledger-100-Total Credits-400-Total Debits-See Also-Please see also the following documentation for any issue related to BAI2 file formatting:-SAP Blog post: EBS – How to interpret a BAI2 file-US Bank documentation on BAI2 files format-Keywords-bai2 US; file upload; bank statement

Title: WIP Clearing Error Message: 'Account determination missing for item type Work in Process'
Content: Symptom-You have executed a WIP Clearing, which raised a missing account determination error for some production lots.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to WIP Clearing view.-Find and open the respective run.-Go to the Processed With Errors tab. -See the error for a given production lot: 'Account determination missing for item type Work in Process'.-Cause-The account determination group maintained in the material's master data is missing in the account determination.-Resolution-You need to maintain the account determination as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-For the relevant account determination profile, go to the Inventories subledger.-Go to the Inventory tab.-Maintain the account determination group and G/L Account mapping for column Work In Progress.-Save your changes.-If the error is still being raised, please send the incident to support to check the change log of the material valuation data. It can happen that there was another account determination group maintained for the material upon production lot processing. Therefore, the system would need the account determination for the previous account determination group for posting. Such change log for material valuation data can be checked by following the steps below.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Materials view.-Select the Material in question.-Click on Maintain Valuation Data and select Product Specification Valuation.-Click on View Changes.-You can find the change log.-Keywords-Production Lot. WIP. Work In Progress Clearing. Material Valuation Data.

Title: Amount in Time and Expenses/Project management.
Content: Symptom- Amount is missing in Time and Expenses view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-WoC Project Management.-Time and Expenses View.-Use filter "All Items".-From here you can see some entries without any value displayed under "Amount" field.-Cause-The Source Document Type of these entries is "Time Confirmation".-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-A Time confirmation only carries a quantity of time (Hours) but no amount; therefore no data will be displayed under Amount field in Time and Expense view.-Keywords- Project Management; Time and Expenses; Time Confirmation; No Amount

Title: No Error Occurs When Leaving an Extension Field Marked as Mandatory Empty in the Web Service of Maintain Accounts
Content: Symptom-You created an Extension Field in the Account Master Data and flagged the field as Mandatory. However when you create a new Account via Web Service and leaves this field empty, no error occurs.-You expects that the same error from the UI is shown in the web service side.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2208 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the payload via the web service of Maintain Accounts.-Cause-As long as you create the Account in Status "in Preparation", you will be able to save without the mandatory field.-However, if you create the Account with Lifecycle Status as "Active", then the web service call will result in an error.-Resolution-Create the Account with the field LifeCycle Status as Active, then the system will return the expected error message.-Keywords-Web service, Mandatory, Extension Field, No error, MaintainAccount, Empty, Blank.

Title: Value Conversion in Migration of Customers for Values Region / State Does not get Saved
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Customers using the Migration Tool.-You maintain a Value Conversion for the value Region and save it.-Then you proceed to the next scenario step: Simulation.-Here the system throws the error message 'Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks' with reference to the previously maintained and saved Region value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Search and open the activity Migration of Customers.-Select the Migrate Customers Using the Migration Tool link.-Select the Upload button and upload the file to be migrated.-Select the button Execute Migration then chose Execute Migration Step by Step.-In the Simulation step the system says 'Value conversion missing or incomplete; complete remaining tasks'.-This error is referring to the Region Value Conversion although it has been maintained and saved previously.-Cause-The mapping only recognizes Region/State names with the length of up to 6 characters. This means when entering for example ABCDEFGH in your file and filling out the Value Conversion correctly, internally the system stores only up to 6 characters ABCDEF.-This means, the next time you run through the Value Conversion, the system does not find any entry for ABCDEFGH.-Resolution-Please abbreviate State/Region names in your source file to not more than 6 characters. Then the mapping will work fine.-Keywords-Migration of Customers, Value Conversion, Migration von Kundendaten-migration of customers,value conversion

Title: Cannot Update Multi-Channel Collaboration for Suppliers Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update multi-channel collaboration data for a supplier using Mass Data Maintenance, but the template does not contain the necessary tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the link to Export Suppliers.-Use the filtering option to select the relevant supplier(s) to be updated.-Click Go to execute the query.-There's no tab for multi-channel collaboration to be exported.-Trying to update using the Collaboration tab will raise error message "Business feature Multiple Channels is in scope".-Cause-The tab for updating multi-channel collaboration data is currently not available in Mass Data Maintenance.-Resolution-When using Multi-Channel settings, neither the migration with mode “Enhance Already Existing Records” nor the mass data maintenance allows updating these settings.-Refer KBA 2825855-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, Multi-Channel Collaboration, Suppliers

Title: Balance Confirmations Not Printed After Executing the Balance Confirmation Run
Content: Symptom-You create a Balance Confirmation Run in the Work Center Receivables (the same applies to Balance Confirmation Runs in Work Center Payables)-and expect that the Balance Confirmations are printed on the configured printer, but there are no documents printed even though the run has been finished successfully.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Balance Confirmation Runs View.-Click New - Balance Confirmation Run.-Add all relevant information in the fields/choose available options via the radio buttons.-Go to Step 3 - Review and confirm with Finish.-No documents are printed, you check this as follows:-Open the Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to Input and Output Management View.-Choose Print Queues.-No documents related to the Balance Confirmation Run are shown in the print queue.-Cause-When the balance confirmation run is not executed in the Release Immediately mode, the statements are created in a Not Released status and not sent to output management for printing or e-mailing by the run.-You have to execute the printing manually.-Resolution-Run the Balance Confirmation Run in the Release Immediately mode:-Open the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Balance Confirmation Runs View.-Click New - Balance Confirmation Run.-Add all relevant information in the fields/choose available options via the radio buttons.-Flag the field Release Immediately.-Go to Step 3 - Review and confirm with Finish.-The balance confirmation statements will be sent to the default queue for printing.-The printing queue can be configured as follows:-Open the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Input and Output Management.-Choose Output Channel Selection.-Select Balance Confirmation from the Drop-Down-Menu beside the field Show Rules for.-Under the Header Output Channel you can configure the Printer and the Print Queue.-See Also-Create a Balance Confirmation Run-Keywords-Balance Confirmation; release immediately; output channel

Title: Error Password Logon no Longer Possible When the User Changed the Password and Tries to Access the System
Content: Symptom-The user just changed the password and the system is showing the error message below when she/he tries to access the system:-Password logon no longer possible - too many failed attempts-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2208 and higher.-SAP Cloud for Customer 2208 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Administrator work center or Application and User Management > Business Users view.-Search for the affected User.-Click Edit > Attributes.-Remove the flag of Password Locked and Change the Password.-Try to access the system with the affected user.-Error appears.-Cause-There can be multiple reasons for this issue:-Another device which was used before with a previous password tries to access the system as soon it connects to the network, it can be mobile device, laptop, check if any device is trying to login automatically.-Mostly devices with wireless access can cause this behavior. Remove all stored network of those devices with old password.-The old credentials might be saved on an application, like the Outlook Addin, Print Manager, etc.-Resolution-Make sure that the Old password is changed to the new Password from all the above-mentioned places.-In case issue is due to the Outlook Integration as the Old password is saved in the outlook plugin, in that case, when you change the password, make sure to change the SAP logon password in the Outlook plugin as well following the below steps.-1. Go to Outlook and Select-2. Select Logon-3. Enter the new Password in the Log On to SAP Cloud for Customer-4. Enter the New Password-IMPORTANT: In case you are not able to locate the place where the wrong password was set, quick remedy is to change the logon user ID to another ID (new) so that the incorrect logon attempts would not affect this user anymore.-Keywords-Cannot, Access, System, C4C, ByD, Password logon no longer possible, too many failed attempts, Business User.

Title: Not Possible to Update Safety Stock of a Material to Zero Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: EXTRACT_ERROR

Title: Mandatory Fields do not Raise Errors When Creating Accounts via Webservice
Content: Symptom-When creating an account in the system using a webservice, the request does not raise any errors when mandatory fields are not filled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Download the account webservice WSDL from Application and User Management -> Service Explorer.-Open the WSDL in a SOAP client, and fulfill the request with the account data.-Execute the request to create the account.-After the execution, you can see that no error was raised, and the new record was created.-Cause-The account is being created with status "In Preparation". In this status, the system allows for saving even with some mandatory fields not completed (for example, mandatory fields from the Address section of the account).-If the status of the account is passed through the webservice request as "Active", the respective errors related to the missing fields will be reported.-Resolution-System works as expected-Keywords-service interface, SOAP, manage accounts, maintainBundle

Title: Error Occurs on Sales Document 'Credit card blocked'
Content: Symptom-Error occurs in Sales Order and, or Customer Invoice Request Credit card blocked and the Invoice Request is Inconsistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Checking the Invoice Request:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the Invoice Request ID ABC. (ABC represents the Invoice Request ID).-Document shows with the Inconsistent status.-Click on the Check button.-Error: Credit card blocked.-Click on the Redetermine button, but message remains.-Checking the Sales Order predecessor from Customer Invoice Request:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Show All Sales Order and Find DEF (DEF represents the Sales Order ID).-Edit the Sales Order.-Error occurs Credit card blocked.-Cause-The credit card used in the Sales Order has expired.-Resolution-To fix the scenario, please, proceed with the steps bellow:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the account used in the Sales Order DEF).-Edit the account XYZ.-Go to the Financial Data tab.-Select the Bank Data sub-tab.-See the table Credit Cards.-Here select the credit card XXX and extend the date in Expiration Date column (XXX represents the credit card number).-Save the changes in account.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the Invoice Request ID ABC. (ABC represents the Invoice Request ID).-Click on the Check button.-Click on the Redetermine button.-The Invoice Request will be consistent to be invoiced.-See Also-2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-Keywords-Credit card blocked; Invoice Request; Inconsistent

Title: SEPA Payment File Information
Content: Symptom-You have generated an outgoing bank transfer in SEPA format.-You expected that the file has the payment ID or invoice ID in a different way that you can see on the xml file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Outbound Files view.-Select the outgoing file created for SEPA payment transfer.-Download the file.-You will see the following tags at the bottom of the file:-<PmtInf> <RmTInf><Ustrd>-These tags will have a value XXX that does not correspond to the expected one, such as Invoice ID, External Reference Number, etc.-Cause-SEPA file is generated with the mentioned tag filled with the values existing on Memo Line of the Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Memo Lines are generated automatically by the system according to the rules defined on Outgoing Bank Transfers activity, on Edit Payment Correspondence Profiles-Resolution-If you want to change the memo line for the SEPA payment medium format you should change the rules defined on the Payment Correspondence Profiles:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view and click the current open project.-On Fine-Tuning tab search for the activity Outgoing Bank Transfers and click Open.-Select the option Edit Payment Correspondence Profiles.-Select the row for the SEPA Credit Transfer and Direct Debit.-On the details panel, change the settings to generate memo lines with the desired value.-Keywords-SEPA, Payment

Title: The Customer Group Price List is not Getting Updated Automatically While Creating a Sales Document
Content: Symptom-When you create a Sales Document, the list price is not determined from the Price List e.g. the Customer Group Price List automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center-Select New Sales Order under Common Tasks.-Enter the Account and Distribution Channel.-Select the Items tab.-Select Add Row to add new item.-The list price is not updated for the item.-You find the List Price not populate automatically.-Cause-Following the steps bellow-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-In the Business Configuration Search, find Configure Price Strategy.-Open it and click Default Gross Pricing. -You can see that you have set Default Pricing Procedure as Gross for Direct Sales Distribution Channel.-Whereas, in Product and Service Portfolio, the Price List you have mentioned is for Net Pricing Procedure and not Gross.-Resolution-In order to correct this, you need to create a Customer Group Specific Gross Price List, this will pick up the price in your current configuration.-Keywords- Gross Pricing; Price Strategy; List Price; Net Pricing

Title: Substitution Manager not Able to View tasks of Actual Manager Under My Managing Area
Content: Symptom-You have a manager John , and manager Jane  has substituted his place.-However, manager Jane is not able to view  tasks of manager John in Manage My Area workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Substitutions view.-You can see manager John is substituted by manager Jane.-Open  Manage My Area of manager Jane -Go to Common Task view.-Select Employee Services on Behalf.-Manager Jane cannot see manager John's tasks .-Cause-The Manage My Area is the workcenter that is assigned typically to line managers, and the Call ESS on Behalf functionality is to enable managers to perform Employee Self Services activities on behalf of the employees who report directly to them.--When one manager Jane substitutes another manager John , the employees reporting to the manager John now appear in the Employee Services On Behalf list of Jane .-But manager John himself does not appear in the list, since manager John does not report to manager Jane and Manager John would appear in John manager's list only.-Resolution-If you want other employees(irrespective of Reporting Line Structure) to come into this Call Employee Services On Behalf list, then you have to code for it in PDI, using the enhancement spot MMA_ESS_ON_BEHALF (Manage My Area - Call Employee Services On Behalf).-See Also-  2856475 - The approval task does not show up in the substitute's approval list-Keywords-Substitution Manager, Manage My Area

Title: Inconsistent Filtering on Sales Order Invoicing Overview Screen
Content: Symptom- When filtering for the Project ID in the Sales Order Invoicing Overview screen the results shown are not what you expect.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Order Invoicing Overview.-Select Project ID ABC (where ABC represents the Project ID).-Select the Sales Order ID DEF (where DEF represents the Sales Order ID).-Select All for Invoicing Status.-You will notice that the system does not show Invoices with the Status Open.-Cause-The Sales Order Invoicing Overview is an Invoicing Overview, and therefore, when you filter by a project, it will provide only invoicing-relevant results; this means, it will provide only results where there is an existing invoice document in the system.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Sales Order Invoicing Overview, Filter, Search, Invoice, Project, View, Inconsistent, Missing, Unable

Title: How to Create/Edit Default Text in the E-mail Body for an Output Document
Content: Symptom-You would like to Create or Edit default text in the e-mail body for an output document such as Sales Order Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open one certain sales order.-Click You Can Also on the right top, and click Edit Output Settings.-In the new window, click E-Mail Text, you can see the default mail template.-You want to know how to maintain the mail default text.-Cause-The mail default text is hard coded in the backend. But you may upload a custom version.-Resolution-1. Go to Application and User Management  work centre.-2. Navigate to Form Template Maintenance View.-3. Show Active Forms and click Go.-4. Select any output document(Example: Sales Order Confirmation) .-5. Go to Actions from the drop-down select Create E-mail Template.-6. Select HTM/HTML file which can be used as an e-mail template and click Ok.-Note : The System only supports HTM/HTML file format uploads as E-mail Template.-See Also-In the current release, the system allows you to create e-mail templates in either the HTM or HTML file formats for the following form template groups:-Sales Order.-Sales Quote.-Purchase Order.-Customer Contract.-Invoice Request.-Remittance Advice.-Customer Invoice.-Expense Report.-Petty Cash Receipt.-Journal Entry Report.-Tax Return.-Data Privacy.-Third Party Logistics Outbound Request.-However if you try to create an e-mail template for any form template group covered above, the system will display an error message - E-mail templates not supported for this form template group.-Keywords-mail template; mail body; E-Mail Text

Title: Labor Cost Rate Run from Microsoft Excel: Set of Books Field is Missing
Content: Symptom-The Set of Books field is not available in Microsoft Excel template Upload Labor Cost Rates.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Labor Cost Rates view.-Click New Labor Cost Rate Run from Microsoft Excel.-Open the Microsoft Excel template downloaded (for example "ListofLaborCostRates__EN.xlsx").-Notice that there's no Set of Books field available.-Resolution-This feature is currently not available to update the Labor Cost Rate based on a particular Set of Books.-We suggest you to create an idea in the Continuous Influence Session for ByDesign.-The ideas can be voted by other customers and partners and the most voted ones might be collected to the product backlog for future versions.-Keywords-labor cost rate; Upload Labor Cost Rates; set of books

Title: Error When Generating Outbound File -File format is not consistent
Content: Symptom-You have created a new payment structure as a copy of another custom payment structure. When generating the outbound file, an error message appears: 'File format <payment structure ID> is not consistent'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Find the respective payment.-Generate a new outbound file via Actions button and/or open the existing file.-In the outbound file,  click Display Log.-You see the following error: 'File format <payment structure ID> is not consistent'-Cause-There are many reasons for the payment structure to be inconsistent. Once of them is a syntax error originated from the copy process, that is mostly just limited to the checkboxes of the file structure properties Carriage Return and Line Feed. Both of them can be easily corrected when editing the file structure after the copy.-Apart from that, the data source 'Sequence Number' may have been created with wrong reference to another tree node in backend during the copy.-Resolution-In order to fix these errors, you need to perform a dummy change in the payment file structure as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Outgoing Bank Transfer fine-tune activity. -Press Edit payment file structures.-Select and edit the affected payment structure.-In step 1, make a dummy change to the Carriage Return and Line Feed checkboxes (mark them if they are unmarked and vice versa).-Save your change.-Revert the change and save again.-Navigate to step 3.-Go through all Records and all Fields to check which ones have a filed with Data Source as Sequence Numbers.-For all fields with Sequence Number, change them to any other data source.-Save your changes.-Revert the changes (for example, assign Sequence Number as data source again) and save.-After the above, you can navigate to the Payment Monitor and trigger a new Outbound File for the relevant payment.-If the issue persists, raise an incident to support with the payment order ID and approval for support to create new outbound files.-Keywords-Payment Structure. Payment File. Outbound File. Outgoing Bank Transfer.

Title: Employee Time Type Validity can Only be Changed for Certain Types
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When managing employee time types, you notice that for standard time types only certain entries such as "Generated Premium" can have their validity changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration -> Overview.-Search for the activity "Time Types - XYZ" (where XYZ is the respective country of the times being managed).-Open the activity and click on the sub-activity Maintain Time Types.-In the list of types, you can see that only some entries can have the validity changed. -Cause-A time type can have its validity changed as long as it is not set with any value in the column "Relevance for Work Schedules". This column creates a dependency, since the value signals that the time type is explicitly used for time recording.-In the case of time types such as "Generated Premium", it has the time type category as "Valuation Result", so it does not make sense to be used for time recording, and hence it is not maintained as "Relevant for Work Schedules".-Resolution-The system works as expected.-In some cases, the customers may want to change the validity of a certain time type to remove it from the time recording. In these scenarios, the best option is to directly deactivate the time type following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration -> Overview.-Search for the activity "Time Types - XYZ" (where XYZ is the respective country of the times being managed).-Open the activity and enter the sub-activity "Activate for Time Recording Services".-In this sub-activity, the customers can select which time types will be available for time recording for each situation (such as Time Administration, Employee Self-Service, etc.).-Keywords-ESS, expire, valid to, valid from

Title: Error When Trying to Maintain a New Row for National Insurance Data "Employee must be aged between 16 and 60"
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the error message below when trying to add a new row for National Insurance Data:-Employee must be aged between 16 and 60.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2208 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Then go to the Employees view.-Search for the affected employee.-Click Edit.-Go to the Social Insurance Data tab.-Then go to the National Insurance Data tab.-Click Add Row.-Enter the required details.-Click Save.-System shows the error message.-Cause-Current behavior in the system has age limit determined based on gender. For males it's between 16 and 65 and for female it's between 16 and 60 for Category A.-Resolution-In case the Employee is under the rules above, kindly raise an incident to Support as a backend correction is required.-See Also-Country/Region-Specific Features-Keywords-Error, Employee, National Insurance Data, Employee must be aged between 16 and 60, Social Insurance Data, National Insurance Data tab.

Title: Balance Difference Between Cash Position and Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You have checked the cash position of your company and compared with the items in transit shown in step two for the concerned bank statement. Nevertheless, you noticed that there is a differetrece between the disbursement figure in the report to the amount in the bank statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Create a new Bank Statement or open an existing one In Preparation.-Go to step 2 - Select Items.-You'll see that all in transit items in the bank statement sums up a given amount.-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open the Cash Position by Transaction Source.-You'll see that the collections and disbursements does not match with what is shown in the bank statement.-Cause-There are a few things that may cause a discrepancy between the cash position and what is shown in the bank:-The bank statement in step 2 only considers In Transfer items, whereas the Cash Position also considers payment that are Ready for Transfer.-The bank value date in the e.g. Outgoing Check is also considered in different ways by the bank statement and the Cash Position. The bank statement in step 2 will bring all the payments in transfer where the document date is less or equal the statement date. The payments fetched in step 2 are optional to select, since there can be a scenario where an outgoing check is confirmed/got cleared with bank before the bank value date, hence user should have the option to select this check while creating a bank statement. Therefore, the bank statement with statement date less than expected bank value date gets this as an optional item to select the check. Nevertheless, in Cash position report there is a condition written on Value Date. selection, i.e. an aggregation happens on all records with Expected bank value date greater than or equal to given value date.-Resolution-For the first bullet point in the above section, the payment shall be set to In Transfer status in order to be fetched by the bank statement.-In the second point we have the expected system behavior, which is due to the aggregation in the Value Date selection parameter. In this case, you need to change the Value Date to be on or after the Expected Bank Value Date of the payment so that it's shown in the report.-Keywords-value date; expected bank value date; outgoing check; cash position

Title: Error "Time Information of Employee XYZ Already Created" During Migration of Time and Labor Management Data
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate time administration data using the Migration of Time and Labor Management Data, but system raises error "Time information of employee XYZ already created" (where XYZ stands for an actual employee ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration > Overview work center view.-Search for "migration of employee data."-Open the fine-tuning activity for the relevant employee's country/region of employment (e.g. Migration of Employee Data - Germany).-Click the "Migrate time and labor management data using the migration tool" link.-Click Upload Data > Data from Migration Template.-If you have already uploaded the migration file, skip to step 8.-In the prompt, click Choose File and browse for the relevant file.-Once the file is selected, click Upload.-Select the file in the migration tool and click Execute Migration > Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error message is raised in step 3 - Simulate Import.-Cause-The Migration of Time Administration Data can only be used to add new records.-If a time file has been created for the employee, the system interprets this migration as an attempt to enhance/modify data, which is not supported through migration for Time and Labor Management data.-Resolution-Note: irrespective of the way you hire an employee a basic time profile would be created by default.-Scenario 1-When you hire an employee through Personal Administration via regular tasks, the only way to create the time file is manually in the Time Administration work center.-Scenario 2-When you migrate an employee through migration, if you do not edit the time file manually, then you can proceed with migrating time file via Migration of Time and Labor Management-Scenario 3-When you migrate an employee through migration, if you edit the time file manually, then it'll no longer be ossible to migrate the time file through Migration of Time and Labor Management. The remaining option is to modify the time file manually in the Time Administration work center-Keywords-Time information, already created, Migration of Time and Labor Management data, Time Administration

Title: You Didn't Receive E-mail after Accepting the Lead.
Content: Symptom-Your E-mail "YYY@XXX.com" (where YYY@XXX.com stands for your Email address) Didn't Receive E-mail after Accepting the Lead.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center, open Inbox view-Click "Subscribe to Tasks" button-Select New Business- Leads- Accept or Reject Lead <Lead ID> <Formatted Name of Sales Prospect>-You can see that E-Mail is selected which means you can receive the e-mail after accepting the lead.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Open Activity “E-Mail and Fax Settings”-You can find that in a Non-Productive System the button "Send all e-mails to this address" is maintained and the address is EEE@FFF.com (where EEE@FFF.com stands for the E-mail address maintained in the system)-Cause-The E-mail address maintained in the system is different from your expected one. In the Non-Productive System, all e-mails are sent to EEE@FFF.com.-Resolution-Change the maintained e-mail address.-Keywords-E-mail, Leads, Non-Productive System

Title: Incorrect Month Calendar Year on Sales Order Volume Report
Content: Symptom-When you run the report the month is, e.g., September but the report show orders created on October.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Reports view.-Search for the Report: Sales Orders Volume.-Open this Report.-Filter the Report by Month/Calendar Year e.g. September and year 2020.-Cause-It occurs due to difference in timestamp, as the data is stored in UTC, which would be 30th September 2020 16:00:00, for example, when converted from UTC + 8 for the referred Report.-The value for Month/Calendar Year field, from underlying data source, is stored based on the UTC timestamp, if no customer specific Business Configuration is maintained, as all the period information in CRM Application area are, in general, stored in UTC.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior.-Maintain a specific time zone. If you work in one time zone different from the one maintained in the configuration, it could lead to issues, specially if the users work in multiple time zones.-Keywords-Sales Order Volume, Report, CRM, Month

Title: You Can't Edit Output Settings if the Sales Order is completed.
Content: Symptom-Editing output settings is not possible after a sales order has been completed.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center and select sales order “ABC” (where ABC represents the selected sales order).-The status of sales order “ABC” is Completed.-Click the You Can Also button, the Edit Output Settings button is grayed out.-Select sales order “DEF” (where DEF represents another selected sales order).-The status of sales order “DEF” is In Process.-The Edit Output Settings button is available and can be clicked.-Cause- This is the current system design.-Resolution-When a sales order has the status Completed, the output settings cannot be edited and can only be previewed.-Keywords-Sales Order, Output Settings, Status, Completed, In Process, You Can Also, Grayed Out

Title: Supplier Approval is not Working for an Existing Business Partner That Was Extended to a Supplier
Content: Symptom-An existing bidder business partner was extended to also act as supplier using the supplier approval process, however this supplier is not subject to approval.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The process to add the supplier role to an already existing, active business partner (be it a bidder or a customer/account) and having that change under control of supplier approval process is currently not supported.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Supplier Approval, Approval Proccess, Business Partner, Customer

Title: Process Communication Error of Released Expense Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The expense report is released for reimbursement. However, a process communication error appears for this expense report in the document flow and no journal entry has been generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel And Expense work center and Expense Reports View.-Open the expense report in status of Released for Reimbursement.-Select View All, and go to tab Document Flow, you can see the process communication error there.-In the backend, you can find the stuck XI message with error Payment method is not valid.-Cause-The payment method in the employee's profile is Bank Transfer.-An expense report was created before the customer complimented the employee’s profile.-When an expense report is created for an employee for which no payment method has been maintained the payment method Check is being used by default. But, as this payment method is not used, the configuration for check payment is missing. The expense report is therefore blocked for payment.-Resolution-Ask the customer to cancel the expense report and create a new one. We can then mark the affected expense report as irrelevant from the backend.-Keywords- Expense Report; Travel And Expense; process communication error; XI message

Title: Cannot Switch off Partial Day From Drop Down List While Creating Leave Request
Content: Symptom-You are creating a leave request from the Home work center and there is an option to select the time stamp  i. e. Full Day, Half Day and Partial Day. Here you want to switch off the Partial Day selection from the drop down list. However, there is no option or settings to remove the entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Services view.-Go to the Self-Services Overview.-Go to the Time section and select New Leave Request.-In the 1st step Create, you can enter the Date along with Day. (Full Day, Half Day, Partial Day)-No settings to switch off the Partial Day.-Resolution-According to the designed system behaviour, this functionality is not available and there are no plans to add this enhacement in further releases.-Keywords-missing, can't, not possible, impossible

Title: India Tax Return Types GSTR-9, GSTR-9C and Form 24Q are Missing
Content: Symptom-The following tax return types for India are not available in the system:-GSTR-9-GSTR-9C -Form 24Q -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Form GSTR-9 is an annual return to be filed once for each financial year, by the registered taxpayers.-Form GSTR-9C is a reconciliation statement required to be furnished by a taxpayer whose turnover exceeds Rs.2 crore in a financial year while filing their annual return in form GSTR-9. The GSTR-9C can only be filed after the GSTR-9 has been filed.-For GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, you can use the available reports, as follows:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Reports --> List view.-Here you can find the reports India Purchase Register - India (Report ID: GLOTAXB11_Q0001) and Sales Register - India (Report ID: GLOTAXB13_Q0001) to get the details for GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C.  -Form 24Q is a statement for TDS from salaries.-The tax return type Form 24Q cannot be provided by SAP Business ByDesign as ByDesign currently does not support payroll as a functionality.-Keywords-tax return type; india; gstr9; gstr9c; form24q

Title: Price Calculation on Quote is Not Correct According to Unit Of Measure
Content: Symptom-You create a Sales Quote and entered the Price List manually, however, when you change UoM, the Price List does not multply according to the UoM. It keeps the same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business Work Center.-Click New Quote for Contract in Common Tasks view.-Enter the Account XYZ (XYZ Represents the ID of your Account ID).-Enter the Service ABC (ABC Represents the ID of your Service ID).-Set the UoM as Month.-Enter the Price List manually as 100.00 USD.-Enter the Sales Unit DEF (DEF Represents the ID of your Sales Unit ID).-Save the Document.-Close the Quote for Contract.-Open the Document.-Navigate to Items Tab.-Change the UoM as Year.-The Price List remains 100.00 USD.-Cause-When there is no Price List maintained for a service in the system and this has to be entered manually in the Quote, the list price entered is taken to be for the UoM maintained at that time.-So when you add a service and maintains the quantity as e.g. 7 months, the system applies month as the UoM for the service.-You then add the price 100.00, and the system takes this as the price for the UoM, which is one month. Any later changes to the quantity are adjusted accordingly. On the other hand, when you add a service and maintains the quantity as 1 year, the system applies year as the UoM for the service.-You then add the Price List as 100.00, and the system takes this as the price for the UoM, which is one year. Any later changes to the quantity are adjusted accordingly.-The system cannot know that the price entered is for one year, so it takes the UoM entered for the service in this document.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Quote; Quote for Contract; Price Calculation;

Title: WIP Run Does Not Consider By-Products
Content: Symptom-You have finished a production lot for the production of a main product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the main product ID) and a by-product ID ABC (ABC represents the by-product ID).-For both products the perpetual cost method Moving Average is maintained.-After executing the WIP Clearing Run you notice that the run updated the cost rate of the production lots main product but not of the by-product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Inventory Valuation workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks -  WIP Clearing view.-Highlight the line of the respective run ID AAA (AAA represents the run ID) and press View to open the Log result.-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab.-Here there are only postings displayed for main product XYZ but not for the By-product ABC.-Cause-This is standard ByDesign system behavior.  The WIP Clearing run only considers inventories from a lot that are maintained as main output materials.-Resolution-By-products resulting from the process of producing a main product are not considered a company's object and are therefore not included in the SCM planning process.-There are no production variance calculations needed here.  -For such by-products a standard cost rate rather than a moving average cost rate should be maintained in the inventory accounting data.-Keywords-WIP Clearing; WIP Clearing run; by-product; main product; inventory; production lot;

Title: Error Message When Deleting G/L Account from Chart of Accounts: Value in setting Assignment of GL-Accounts must also be entered in setting General Ledger Accounts
Content: Symptom-You want to delete a G/L Account in the Fine Tuning activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-When you save your changes you receive several error messages:-'Value XYZ* in setting Assignment of GL-Accounts must also be entered in setting General Ledger Accounts'-'Fin.rep. structure ABC** is inconsistent; correct it with export/ re-import'-'Save failed'-*XYZ means the G/L Account ID.-**ABC represents the Reporting Structure ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview sub view.-Find the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Select the hyperlink Edit Charts of Accounts.-Select the respective Chart of Accounts and filter for G/L Account XYZ.-Click Delete and then Save.-Several Error Messages appear such as:-'Value XYZ in setting Assignment of GL-Accounts must also be entered in setting General Ledger Accounts'-'Fin.rep. structure ABC is inconsistent; correct it with export/ re-import'-'Save failed'-Cause-The G/L Account XYZ cannot be deleted because it is still used in G/L Account mapping.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview sub view.-Find the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Select the hyperlink Edit G/L Account Mapping.-Select the respective Chart of Accounts and filter for G/L Account XYZ.-Delete the G/L Account mapping.-Go back and select the hyperlink Edit Charts of Accounts.-When you delete the G/L Account and save the changes no error message will appear.-Keywords-Sachkonto löschen, Kontenfindung, Sachkontenzuordnung, Sachkonto, GL Account, delete G/L account, charts of accounts

Title: "Suppliers from Microsoft Excel" Option not Available to Create Suppliers
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a new supplier, the button to create a supplier through Microsoft Excel is not available in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center and enter the Suppliers view.-Click on the New button.-You see that there is no option to Suppliers from Microsoft Excel.-Cause-The option to create suppliers from Excel is disabled if the Supplier Approval option is active in the system.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-Create Suppliers Using Microsoft Excel®-Keywords-Template, Upload, Excel

Title: Unable to Accept Deviation for PO Acknowledgment due Error Messages
Content: Symptom- You are unable to accept deviation of Purchase Order Acknowledgment because error messages are being triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order's ID.-Click in the Edit button. -Click in the link in the header: 'Check Deviating Purchase Order Acknowledgment'.-Click in Accept Deviation button.-You get the error message:-Price missing; price required for expected follow-up documents invoice or ERS.-Saving of purchase order changes not possible; changes inconsistent.-Cause-The List Price used in the Purchase Order does not have a scale beginning with 0.-Firstly, check what is the List Price in the Purchase Order:-Open the Purchase Order.-Navigate to Items tab.-Navigate to Prices subtab.-You can see that:-Price/Price Component: List Price-Description: ABC (ABC is the name of the List Price).-Then you can check the scale maintained for this List Price:-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to List Prices view.-Search for ABC.-Click in Edit button.-In Scales section, you can see that it is not maintained a scale starting from zero.-For example, the scale is starting to 10 each. However in the Purchase Order Acknowledgment the value for Acknowledged Quantity is 9 each. Since the Acknowledged Quantity is less than what is maintained in the List Price, the system triggers the error messages.-Resolution-You need to maintain a zero scale in the List Price (or at least a value which is lesser than the one maintained in the PO Acknowledgment):-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to List Prices view.-Filter for the List Price.-Click in Edit button.-Maintain a zero scale.-Save it.-Even if now the List Price is maintained with a zero scale, the deviation for the PO Acknowledgment still cannot be accepted. That's because the Purchase Order's item maintains the information of older List Price and its carried out to the new PO Acknowledgment. So the item should be canceled.-After changing the List Price, you can create a new item (in the same Purchase Order or in a new one) with the same information.-See Also-KBA: 1667840 - How to Create Purchase Order With Zero Price Line Item-KBA: 2131949 - Error Appears While Updating Delivery Date in the Purchase Order-Keywords-Purchase Order; Acknowledgment; List Price; Scale

Title: No Overhead Amount Calculated In the Production Lots - Overhead Absorption Run
Content: Symptom-You execute a Production Lots - Overhead Absorption Run. In the Processed Successfully tab of the run - you can see the Overhead Amount for the processed production lot shows as zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Production Lots - Overhead Absorption subview.-Select the run ABC that has just been performed, and choose View.-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab. -You can see the Overhead Amount for production lot XYZ is listed as zero.-ABC means the Absorption Run ID.-XYZ means the Production Lot ID.-Cause-You create overhead rules to specify how overhead is absorbed by production lots. If the required G/L account is not mapped in the calculation base then there is no relevant data for the Production Lots - Overhead Absorption Run to process hence you see overhead amount as zero.-Resolution-Ways to find if all the General Ledgers Accounts required are mapped:-You can consult the Production Lots - Line Items report for the production lot in question. You observe that G/L Accounts (Origin) DEF and GHI are listed here but not under Calculation Base in the corresponding Overhead Rule.-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Allocations view.-Select Overhead Rules and click Overhead Rule ID PQR and EDIT.- Now add the required G/L accounts, Account Determination Group and combinations and run the Production Lots - Overhead Absorption Run again.-DEF means a G/L Account (Origin) ID.-GHI means a G/L Account (Origin) ID.-PQR means an Overhead Rule ID.-Keywords-Overhead Absorption; Production lot; overhead rule; overhead rate; G/L account (origin); calculation base-overhead absorption,overhead rule,production lot,overhead rate,g/l account (origin),calculation base

Title: Extension Field 1 and Extension Field 2 Missing from Employee Times Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are working with the ManageEmployeeTimeIn web service and have noticed that SAP provided fields Extension Field 1 and Extension Field 2 cannot be found in the web service's request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Access the Communication Arragement work center view.-Select the communication scenario named Time Administration Integration.-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Technical Data tab.-Click the Edit Advanced Settings button.-Select the Manage Employee Actual Times service in the Inbound Communications table, then click Download WSDL.-Open the WSDL in a API testing software (such as Postman).-You can see that Extension Field 1 and Extension Field 2 are not available in the request.-Cause-Extension Field 1 and Extension Field 2 are currently not part of the ManageEmployeeTimeIn web service.-Hence, this is is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-System developers are working to provide web service support for Extension Field 1 and Extension Field 2 in a future product version.-Keywords-Extension Field 1, Extension Field 2, ManageEmployeeTimeIn, Manage Employee Actual Times, Time Administration Integration, WSDL

Title: Error Message: S09 is not a Valid Value for This Field. Enter a Valid Value
Content: Symptom-You are trying to preview a Supplier Invoice in the Approvals tab, and when you click the Preview button, the system triggers the following error messages:-S09 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.-Action failed-Action could not be executed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Select an Approve Supplier Invoice task (ERS Invoice).-Click on Preview button.-See the error messages:-S09 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.-Action failed-Action could not be executed-You can see that the system is stuck in generating preview.-Cause-This error occurred because S09 which is a code as per Template Group that it is not scoped in the system. It refers to ERS Notification Template which displays the preview for Evaluated Receipt Settlements.-To rectify this issue, you need to mark the checkbox for the Scoping Question "You can print or send evaluated receipt settlement (ERS) invoices." in Business Configuration settings under Implementation Projects in the First Implementation view.-Once you have enabled the Scoping Question then please check the template for ERS Notification under Form Template Maintenance view in Application and User Management work center and if needed you can Change Master Template Usage or even Create E-mail Template.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation Project and click Edit Project Scope.-Click the Next button until you get to step 4 Question.-Expand the Scoping Element Purchasing.-Expand Supplier Invoicing.-Select the Scoping Element Communication for Supplier Invoicing.-On the right side of the screen, please check the Question "You can print or send evaluated receipt settlement (ERS) invoices.".-Save the configuration.-Now Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance View.-Open the Advanced Filter.-In Template Name, select ERS Notification.-Click on Go.-Select the relevant Form Template.-Click on Actions and change if desirable.-After maintaining all these settings, you can preview the ERS invoice.-See Also-More information about Supplier Invoice Processing Using Evaluated Receipt Settlements (https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2ceefc33722d1014b361f0f3bf06de41.html?)-Keywords-S09, ERS Notification, Form Template

Title: No Prepayment Amount on VAT Return
Content: Symptom-You checked the VAT Return XYZ and noticed that there is no Tax Prepayment or Prepayment Amount on it (XYZ stands for the VAT Return ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Click VAT Returns under Tax Returns.-Show All Tax Returns.-Open the Tax Return ID XYZ.-There is no Prepayment Amount under Tax Payment Information.-Cause-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Click Tax Payments.-Show all Tax Payments.-Open the Tax Payment which should be picked by the VAT Return.-Click View All.-Check the Prepayment Data under Prepayments in the bottom of the screen.-The Clearing Due Date is from a different period than the VAT Return.-Resolution-Only a Tax Return which includes the same date than the Clearing Due Date of the Tax Payment will consider the prepayment.-The VAT Return cannot be from a different period than the Clearing Due Date of the Tax Payment, otherwise the prepayment will not be considered.-Hence, this is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Sondervorauszahlung 1/11; tax prepayment

Title: Error "Position XYZ must be/be under a reporting line unit from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY" During Migration of Employee Data
Content: Symptom-You receive the error below while migrating Employees' Personnel Administration Data:-"Position XYZ must be/be under a reporting line unit from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY" (XYZ represents the ID of the position)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1908 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Overview;-Search for Migration of Employee Data and click it;-Click the Activity and then 'Migrate Personnel Administration Data Using the Migration Tool';-Open the Migration Tool and click Upload > Data From Migration Template;-Select the XML file and Execute Migration Step by Step;-You will receive the mentioned error at the simulation step.-Cause-This error message is occurring because the Hire Date of the Employee is higher than the Validity of the Reporting Line Unit (Org Unit).-Resolution-The Hire Date of the Employee should be lesser or equal to the Reporting Line Unit's validity period.-Keywords-Error, Position, must be/be under a reporting line unit from, Migration of Employee Data.

Title: The View of Configure Single Sign-On is Missing under the Application and User Management Work Center
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the view of Configure Single Sign-On is missing for an user, when using the Application and User Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2208 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Search for the view of COnfigure Single Sign-On.-View is missing.-Cause-This is happening because the Work Center/View ID APPL_ADMINISTRATION_WCVIEW is not assigned to the user.-Resolution-You need to assign the Work Center/View ID APPL_ADMINISTRATION_WCVIEW to the User under the Access Rights view.-Keywords-Configure Single Sign-On, Missing, Application and User Management, View, Not able to find, Cannot, Find.

Title: Supplier Invoice Created From WebService has Wrong Net Amount
Content: Symptom-In your XML, you informed a value for Net Amount. However the Supplier Invoice created has a different value from the informed in the XML.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the invoice's ID.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the corresponding item.-You can see that the Net Amount is ABC. However in the XML used to create the invoice, the Net Amount is XYZ.-Cause-In XML it was used the tag <PurchaseOrderReference>. When the Supplier Invoice's XML references a Purchase Order, the system will take the value of Net Amount from the Purchase Order, and not from the XML.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can delete the Purchase Order references in your payload, then add the reference in the front end when the document is created.-Keywords-Net Amount, Supplier Invoice, Web Service, XML, Purchase Order, Reference

Title: Text displays as List Price Instead of Price List in Sales Overview.
Content: Symptom-Text displays as “List Price” instead of “Price List” in sales overview of the product. You would like to know how to change the text?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center-2. Go to Products View-3. Search for Product ID as required-4. Click on Show button and select Sales option-You observe text as List Price instead of Price List-Cause-The text will not be changed in the standard as list price is the price at which a product/service is sold at and price list is the master data that one maintains from which the list price is picked up for CRM documents.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-However, the text can be changed by going to adaption mode - Selecting General information and selecting the field that you want to change. Right click and change the text of the field.-The below steps can be followed-1. Click on the User Profile Icon-2. Click on Key user Settings-3. Select Start adaptation mode-4. Select General Information and the Field of Interest to transform and Change the field's text with a right-click-Keywords-Adaptation Mode, List Price, Price List, Sales, adaptation mode

Title: Service Agent Is Not Appearing in Resources Profiles After Being Set As Inactive
Content: Symptom-After inactivating a Service Agent the Service Agent is not appearing in Resources Profiles anymore.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Resource Management Work Center.-Go to the Resource Profiles View.-Search for the Service Agent that was inactive.-Service Agent is not found anymore.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior.-Resolution-In Resource Profiles View, you can only access information of all employees and service agents that are activated in the system and currently it is not possible to access information of the ones that have been inactivated.-Keywords-Service Agent, Inactive, Resource Profiles

Title: Columns For Notes and Attachments Not Displaying Any Information For Open Tasks
Content: Symptom-Open Tasks not displaying any information related to Notes and Attachments maintained in the document.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests or Purchase Orders view.-Filter for Open Tasks.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the task ID).-Check Columns for Notes and Attachments does not display any information.-Cause-The information is only displayed when there is a note/attachment in the task, system recognizes related to the task category and not the task title.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-The information will be only displayed when there are notes or any attachments in a task level and not in a document level.-The system will recognize following the task category and not the task title, so the icons will be displayed if there is information in the task.-Note: For more details, you can check the screenshots attached on this document.-Keywords-Attachments; Open Tasks; Icons; Information; Display; Notes; Tasks;
