Title: Error "Custom Code 1 missing" While Creating a New Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are facing the error message below while Creating a Purchase Order:-"Custom Code 1 missing".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Workcenter.-Purchase Orders View.-Open the affected PO and click Check.-You will receive the mentioned error message.-Cause-Open the Purchase Order and follow the steps below:-Go to View All.-Items.-Account Assignment.-Here you will see that the Generic Customer Code 1 is empty.-This is occurring because the Custom Code 1 was set up as Mandatory in the Account Assignment Types Activity.-Resolution-To correct this you have to change the Custom Code 1 as Optional in the Account Assignment Types Activity by following the steps below:--1. Go to Business Configuration work center;-2. Implementation Projects view;-3. Select the required Project and click Open Activity List;-4. Show All Activities and search for Account Assignment Types;-5. Open the Activity and then Maintain Account Assignment Types;-6. Select Account Assignment Type as ACC (General Ledger Account only);-7. In the Available Account Assignments, select Custom Code 1;-8. Change the Data Input Control to Optional.-See Also-For the same Error message while transferring an Employee to another Org Unit, please check the following KBA:-2609075 - Error "Custom Code 1 missing" While Transfering an Employee to Another Org Unit.-Keywords-Custom, Code, Purchase Order, Error, Account Assignment, Custom Code 1

Title: Error While Trying to Modify Withholding Tax Type and Rate Type Through Mass Data Maintenance for Suppliers
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to modify Withholding Tax Type and Rate Type through mass data maintenance for suppliers, there was a problem with the data import with the following error-"Script changes failed"-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center view-Select Import Suppliers link-Execute Data Import Immediately-Error occurs "Script changes failed"-Cause-These errors occur as the tax type is a part of the record key and the record key update from Mass Data Maintenance is not supported.-Resolution-The supplier withholding tax type cannot be updated through mass data maintenance. Since the tax type is a part of the record key, updating the tax type actually involves deleting the previous version and creating a new one.-Technically, the Mass Data Maintenance does not allow for this.-You can only modify the tax rate type using the Mass Data Maintenance.-See Also- KBA 2297838 - Errors While Trying to Update Company ID for a Supplier Using Mass Data Maintenance-Keywords- Mass data maintenance, suppliers, tax rate type, withholding tax type, record key

Title: Quantity Difference between Inventory Report and Material Inventories - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-You check the on-hand stock of materials in the Inventory Report and the quantity results of the Material Inventories - Line Items report. You notice different results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-To check the quantity in Inventory Report:-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Search and open Inventory Report (ID: SCMINVV02_Q0001).-Enter material AAA in the selection(AAA is the material ID).-Run the report and you see the On-Hand Stock is 100.00.-To check the quantity in the Material Inventories - Line Items report:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Search and open the Material Inventories - Line Items report (ID: FININVU01_Q0001).-Fill the mandatory fields, such as Company and Set of Books. -Run the report and you see the result of Valuation Quantity is 110.00.-Here, the 100.00 and 110.00 are just examples.-Cause-The difference appears because the Material Inventories - Line Items report is based on actual postings which do not necessarily always post to an inventory account. For example, the difference can be found via below path:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Search and open Material Inventories - Line Items report(ID: FININVU01_Q0001).-Enter Company XX, Set of Books YY, Material AAA(XX is the Company ID, YY is the ID of Set of Book).-Run the report and go to View.-Add fields Source Document ID, Source Document Type, Journal Entry Type and G/L Account to the report.-You see for the source document ID BBBB(BBB is the ID of source document), the source document type is Goods and Activity Confirmation, the journal entry type is Goods Issue without Reference, and there are two G/L Accounts shown here:-G/L Account CCCCCCCC(CCCCCCCC is the ID of G/L Account), the Valuation Quantity is -10.00.-G/L Account DDDDDDDD(DDDDDDDD is the ID of G/L Account), the Valuation Quantity is 10.00.-This document BBBB has 2 line items that equal 0, one of them is not showing unless you do above because DDDDDDDD is not an inventory account.-Resolution-If you want to verify the Valuation Quantities of the Material Inventories - Line Items report and the Inventory Report, you can filter G/L Account CCCCCCCC in the Material Inventories - Line Items report and the quantities would match.-Keywords-Material Inventories - Line Items. Inventory Report. valution quantity. on-hand stock. difference. SCMINVV02_Q0001. FININVU01_Q0001.

Title: Derivation of the Revenue Recognition Run Posting Date
Content: Symptom-You want to execute the Revenue Recognition Run for a specific posting date.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-2. Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-3. Select the Revenue Recognition subview.-4. Press New and choose Revenue Recognition Run.-There is no option to define a specific posting date here.-Cause-It is not possible to define a specific posting date for a revenue recognition run.-Resolution-The posting date of a revenue recognition run is derived from-- the last accounting period day if executed for a past accounting period,-- today's date if executed for the current accounting period,-- the first day of the accounting period if executed for a future accounting period.-Keywords-revenue recognition run posting date

Title: User Logon Activity Report Shows "Not Assigned" for all Users
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-** TO BE ARCHIVED **-Reason: Scoping question not available anymore-When executing the report for User Logon Activity, the column User ID shows the symbol "#" for all rows. Also the next column shows "Not Assigned" for all rows.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign - all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the Business Analytics work center.-Navigate to the Design Reports view.-Search for the User Logon Activity report and execute it.-After performing the selection, the column for User ID shows "#" and the next column appears as "Not Assigned". -Cause-This behavior happens because IP capture is not activated in the tenant. Without this feature, it is not possible to build the report with precise information about the user logon activities.-Resolution-In order to activate the IP capture, there is a scoping question that needs to be reviewed. The steps to reach it are the following:-Enter the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Topics view.-Select the project and click on Edit Scope.-Navigate to the step 3 - Scoping.-Expand the element Administration.-Check the box for the scoping element "Performance and Usage Monitoring".-Proceed to the step 4 - Questions.-Expand the element Administration, then expand Performance and Usage Monitoring.-Click on Performance and Usage Monitoring.-On the right panel of the screen, check the scoping question "Enabling this feature will capture individual User ID and Associated IP addresses of client devices for various usage and response times reporting".-Proceed to finish the scoping.-Keywords-unassigned, header

Title: Cannot Find Product in Demand Plan Using the Filter
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When using the filter in Demand Plan XXX to find the Product ABC. However, no record is found.-XXX = Demand Plan ID.-ABC = Product ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Demand Planning work center.-Select Demand Plans view.-Search for Demand Plan XXX.-Select the Demand Plan XXX.-Select Plan.-Click Show Filter Row.-Filter by Product ABC.-No Records Found-Cause-Is not possible to finding product ABC in Demand Plan XXX because there are spaces after the Product ID: "ABC                                                      "When openning the product, the ID does not contain the spaces.-Resolution-Is necessary to use the asterisk after the product ID by following the steps:-Go to Demand Planning work center.-Select Demand Plans view.-Search for Demand Plan XXX.-Select the Demand Plan XXX.-Select Plan.-Click Show Filter Row.-Filter by Product ABC*.-The ABC will be found.-Keywords-Filter-Spaces-filter,spaces

Title: G/L Line Items Report - France - Statutory Report Opening Balances of Accounts Displayed Incorrectly
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A G/L Line Items Report - France was executed for a specific Accounting Period and a specific range from G/L account ABC to G/L Account DEF.-In the Results list it's possible to check that the Opening Balance of certain G/L accounts is not correct. The same value as displayed in the Trial Balance report is expected, according to the closing balance of the previous accounting period.--ABC means G/L Account ID.-DEF means a different G/L Account ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go the Periodic Tasks - Statutory Reports view.-Select the G/L Line Items Report - France report link to open the report.-In step 1 - Selection maintain all mandatory information.-To maintain a G/L Account range, enter values into the G/L Account From/To fields.-Press Next to navigate to step 2 - View Results.-In the Accounts by Period table it is possible to check that the opening balance of certain G/L Accounts is not the same as displayed in the Trial Balance report for the same accounting period.-Cause-When a G/L Account range is maintained, i.e. when values are maintained in the G/L Account From/To fields the run is not able to identify the range correctly and inconsistencies, such as the incorrect G/L account opening balances can occur.-It is planned to correct this current system behaviour with the SAP Business ByDesign 1708 Release (August, 2017).-Resolution-Until this issue has been permanently fixed it is possible to display the G/L account balances correctly by not maintaining a G/L account range in the Selection step:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Periodic Tasks - Statutory Reports view.-Press on the G/L Line Items Report - France report link to open the report.-In step 1 - Selection maintain all mandatory information.-This time, keep the G/L Account From/ To fields empty.-Press Next to navigate to step 2 - View Results.-In the Accounts by Period table all G/L Accountopening balances appear correctly as per the Trial Balance report.

Title: Dump When Trying to Release Employee Times
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This KBA is not in use.-You are receiving a dump error message when trying to release employee times via Time Administration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Recording view and select Time Sheet sub-view.-Search All and select the desired employee.-Click Open Time Sheet button.-Select the required data and click Release button and Release selected week.-A dump will occur.-Cause-It is possible that an adjustment was made to the Time Account assigned to the employee.-For example: If the Time Account assigned to the employee was originally set up with a "bookable From" and "bookable To" dates from start of time account until 31st of March of the following year.-If an adjustment is made by the HR admin during this time, there might be subsequent changes in the Business Configuration of the Time Account. As a result, the bookable from date could change to a later date, causing the posting date to fall outside of the bookable period, leading to inconsistencies in the time accounts.-Resolution-In case you identify that your Time Account have a different bookable period than originally setup, you must perform the following steps to correct it.-Change BC for Time Account ZXXXXX Maintain Time Accounts 'Bookable From' to Start of Time account;-Remove the adjustment for Time Account ZXXXXX that is posted before the required date;-Change BC for Time account ZXXXXX Maintain Time Accounts 'Bookable From' back to the original date;-Run a correction run from the start of the employees time file;-Add back the adjustment for a posted date between the bookable periods of the time accounts.-Keywords-Dump, Release, Release selected week, employee times

Title: Difference in Posting Values between a Purchase Order and Material Inventory Valuation
Content: Symptom-When reviewing a journal entry related to a Warehouse Confirmation, the value posted to the Inventory Valuation G/L account differs from the value on the Purchase Order. A DIFFER G/L account is credited with the difference between the two amounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the General Ledger Work Centre and navigate to Journal Entries.-Search for and open the journal entry related to the Warehouse Confirmation.-Go to the Line Items tab.-The Inventory Valuation G/L account shows one amount, while the Purchase Order reflects a different amount.-A DIFFER G/L account is credited with the difference between the two values.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour. It occurs when the material uses the Perpetual Cost Method: Moving Average and the inventory quantity has dropped below zero. This can happen in either of the following situations:-Negative inventory is permitted on the logistics site.-A missing posting, or a mismatch between the posting sequence in accounting and logistics, has caused the inventory quantity to fall below zero unexpectedly.-Resolution-To understand how the posting value was calculated, follow these steps to review the cost history:-Open the Inventory Valuation Work Centre.-Navigate to Material Unit Costs under Master Data.-Select Show All Unit Costs and search for the relevant material.-Select the entry that matches both the relevant Business Residence and the applicable Valid From / Valid To period.-Click View Cost History.-In the Period/Year fields, enter the period in which the posting occurred.-Select the Source Document ID associated with the journal entry.-Locate the line for the relevant Goods Receipt from Suppliers. Note the Capitalised Quantity and the Resulting Inventory Quantity — the resulting quantity will be less than the capitalised quantity.-Check the previous line: the Resulting Inventory Quantity will show a negative value.-Explanation of the Posting Logic-Because the previous inventory quantity was negative and the Moving Average Cost Method is in use, the system first brings the inventory quantity back to zero, then values the remaining quantity using the Purchase Order unit cost.-Example:-Material JKL has a Resulting Inventory Quantity of −5 ea and a Resulting Inventory Value of −40 XX (where XX is the currency).-A Purchase Order is received for 10 ea of JKL, valued at 100 XX.-Step 1 : Cover the negative inventory value: The system brings the inventory value back to zero:- 0 − (−40) = 40 XX These 40 XX is deducted from the Purchase Order value.-Step 2:  Cover the negative inventory quantity:-5 units from the Purchase Order are consumed to bring the quantity back to zero, leaving 5 remaining units.-Step 3: Value the remaining units at the Purchase Order cost: 100 XX ÷ 10 ea = 10 XX/ea 5 ea × 10 XX/ea = 50 XX-Step 4: Calculate the final inventory posting: -(100 − 40) + (5 × 10) = 60 + 50 = 110 XX-Since the Purchase Order value is 100 XX, the 10 XX difference is posted to the relevant DIFFER G/L account.-See Also-For further information on Negative Inventories and Moving Average Cost Method, please refer to the help documentation available from the Help Centre of your system:- - Moving Average Cost Method- - Moving Average Calculation- - Negative Inventories

Title: Error: Gross amount balance not equal to zero
Content: Symptom-You are uploading Manual Tax Entries via MS Excel and you can see the error message: Gross amount balance not equal to zero.-NOTE: The error appears once you click 'Save data to' in Excel sheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Manual Tax Entries view and click VAT Entries subview.-Click New -> Tax Entry from Microsoft Excel.-You have downloaded the excel template and maintained data in the excel sheet.-Now you have clicked 'Save data to' option in excel sheet to upload Tax Entries in SAP ByDesign system.-Here, you can see the error message: Gross amount balance not equal to zero.-Cause-Here, system checks on following two points while uploading the Manual Tax Entries in SAP Business ByDesign system:-When you mention/enter the tax code in the excel sheet, then the Tax Amount must be calculated according to the Tax Rate maintained in the system. Additionally, if Tax Amount is '0.00', then also you have to mention '0.00'. Please ensure that the Tax Amount is calculated according to the Tax Rate maintained in the system.-Gross amount in the excel sheet must be Zero.-Debit Amount + Tax Amount =Credit Amount + Tax Amount = Gross Amount = Zero.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-upload manual tax entries; excel; gross amount balance; zero; 0

Title: How to Mass Change Employee Data Like Organisational Assignments
Content: Symptom-After a completed migration of employees with personnel administration data, you detect that employees are migrated with incorrect data, e.g. incorrect org assignments. You therefore want to mass update these employees with correct data. But you don't find any option to perform this action.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There is no standard option to option to perform a mass change of employee data, or to revert or repeat a migration.-Resolution-You can use SAP Business ByDesign embedded HCM capabilities to manage your employees. You may set up a communication arrangement to enable the following web services for personnel administration:-Hire an employee - ManagePersonnelHiringIn-Transfer an employee - ManagePersonnelTransferIn-Rehire an employee - ManagePersonnelRehireIn-Terminate an employee - ManagePersonnelLeavingIn-Manage an Employee - ManageEmployeeIn-Note: Due to complex backend logic, these services are not released to be available in the service explorer. But you can involve them into your scenario and they are e.g. visible via the following path:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Communication Scenarios view-Mark Personnel Administration line-Find the above mentioned operations-Note:-If source and target org units are in the same company, you can transfer the employee. In this case, use ManagePersonnelTransferIn. The transfer date must be at least on day later as the original hire date.-If source and target org unit are in different companies, you first need to terminate and then to rehire the employee. In this case, use ManagePersonnelLeavingIn and then ManagePersonnelRehireIn. The termination date can be the same as the original hire date. But the rehire date must be at least on day later.-Beyond Soap APIs, most employee data can be accessed using OData Services and custom web service APIs using the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-See Also-See e.g. help documents::-Communication Systems Quick Guide-Communication Arrangements Quick Guide-Communication Scenarios-Service Explorer Quick Guide-See e.g. blog:-Connect SAP ByDesign to best-of-breed HCM Solutions-Keywords-update, enhance, data, organizational, unit, structure, company, reporting line, completion

Title: Instance With Same Key (X) Already Exists
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-** INTERNAL USE ONLY **-Mass Data Run Oject (MDRO) run ID's are not visible in the Object Work List (OWL) or when you try to create a new MDRO, the system displays the below error message:-Instance With Same Key (X) Already Exists.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the System.-Navigate to the Custom Work Center created through Addon. Eg. MDRO UPLOAD.-Check the corresponding View. Eg. MDRO RUN.-Records are not visible in the Object Work List.-However if you click on New button and create a Run.-Choose the Run ID to be (X) for example.-Error pops up: Instance with same key (X) already exists.-Cause-There is an inconsistency between the Business Object and the Data Base (inconsistency with the secondary persistency), changes are not activated in the backend.-Resolution-Steps to resolve this issue:-Find the corresponding Mass Data Run Business Object (MDR BO) for the affected Custom UI screen that was created in the PDI custom solution. You can make use of technical information from Help and find the exact path. (2520626 - How to View Technical Information in Bydesign HTML5 )-Check if any entries exist for this affected MDR BO screen in SESFTS (use KBA 2571142 - How to Search for a Business Object in the Backend Transaction SESFTS )-If there are no records in SESFTS, then close the incident, telling the partner there are no values for this BO, and that is why none display in the frontend.-If there are records in SESFTS, but they do not show in the frontend, you will need to check the FSI Persistency of the affected BO FSI View, which will have the same name as the .run file. Follow the KBA 2655378 - How To Use The Backend Transaction GFSSTM  to see steps on how to check the load persistency, and if necessary, steps on how to reload the affected FSI view. -If there are errors when reloading the FSI Persistency, you may need to activate the FSI persistency in the VIEWBUILDER. Please see case 2 in KBA 2655230 - How To Use The Backend Transaction VIEWBUILDER  to see how to activate the FSI View.-Keywords-Instance, with, the, same key, already, exists, MDR, Mass, Data, Run, FSI, ViewBuilder, GFSSTM, reload, data, records, missing

Title: FIFO Cost Determination - 'No Valid Cost Accumulation Exists For Material with stock quantity ABC'
Content: Symptom-After you executed a FIFO Cost Determination Run for some materials, error messages appear stating 'No valid cost accumulations exist for XYZ (XYZ represents the material ID) with stock quantity ABC (ABC represents the stock quantity)'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to FIFO Cost Determination view.-Show all FIFO Cost Determination Runs and select the one that has the errors.-In the Processed with Errors tab as well as in the Messages tab you will see the error message mentioned.-'No valid cost accumulations exist for XYZ with stock quantity'-Cause-In the Run Parameters you selected Company Level in the Calculate FIFO Cost Based On field. The respective material(s) for which the error is displayed is a case of intercompany transfer of material (goods transfer), which is not picked when the run is executed at Company Level for the valuation selection.  When Company Level is selected, this kind of transfer on valuation of materials is not considered for FIFO Cost Determination Run.-Resolution-You need to execute the run using Business Residence Level for the valuation selection.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to FIFO Cost Determination  view.-Create a new FIFO Cost Determination Run.-Fill the necessary data and in the Calculate FIFO Costs Based On field select Business Residence Level.-Execute your run and check the results.-See Also-2690102 - Error Message: 'No valid cost accumulations exist for ABC with stock quantity XYZ ea'.-Keywords-FIFO; Material, Cost Determination; Inventory valuation; stock; stock quantity.

Title: Revenue Recognition Error: Derivation of planned costs not possible
Content: Symptom-When running a revenue recognition, you receive the error "Document item XYZ/XX: Derivation of planned costs not possible".-XYZ/XX represents the sales order ID/sales order Item ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Revenue Recognition subview.-Click the Revenue Recognition ID you need.-Go to the Messages tab.-You can see the error Document item XYZ/XX: Derivation of planned costs not possible.-Go to the Processed with Errors tab, search and open sales order item XYZ/XX.-Click View All.-Go to the Items tab.-The item is linked to a Project.-Cause-When using accrual method 102 - Recognize using cost-to-cost POC the estimated costs are derived from the planned cost of the sales order item. The error is reported when you did not maintain any planned costs (cost estimate) or if you maintained a cost estimate of 0,00 for the sales order item in the sales order Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Resolution-If the sales order item is not yet invoiced,-Open the sales order. -Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab. -Find item XYZ-XX and expand it. -Press Add Row and select Price Component Cost Estimate. -Enter a value higher than zero.-If the sales order item has already been invoiced, the pricing can no longer be updated in the sales order. In this case the POC must be manually maintained:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Sales Document Items view.-Search for your sales order reference and click the ID.-Use the button Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and option Edit Percentage of Completion to maintain PoC for the sales order items.-After these steps execute the revenue recognition run again. This time the run will recognize all values.-Keywords-revenue recognition; planned costs; pricing and invoicing; poc; percentage of completion

Title: How To Find The XI Message, Sender BO Instance, Accounting Notification From The Business Transaction
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In order to analyze the customer issue, you would like to find the XI message / Sender BO / Accounting Notification.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-1. log in to Backend.-2. Go to SE38 transaction.-3. Enter the Program name as: FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI.-4. Select Source code radio Button.-5. Click Execute Button or Press F8.-6. You will get the following screen for the selection of the Operational documents and display options.-In the operational document type, You need to enter the document type. (47 for expense report, 127 for supplier invoice, 28 for customer invoice and so on. Click the value help icon to get the list of values).-In the Operational document ID, enter the document ID.-Under the display option, Select Appropriate Radio Button.-XI message(s) – This will display XI message related to the document.-Sender BO Instance(s) – This will load the document on the sender B which would send the XI message to accounting. (for example: ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT – For expense report).-Accounting notification(S) – This will load the document on the FIA_ACC_NOTIF Bo and display the same.-7. Click Execute or Press F8.-Depending on the selection system will show the XI messages / Sender BO Instance / Accounting notification for the particular document.-See Also-2097164 - How To Find Old / Archived XI Message in the backend-3232920 - How to Simulate a Document Posting for Unposted Source Document-Keywords-How to; XI Message; Sender BO Instance; Accounting Notification; Business Transaction; FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI; SE38.-xi message,accounting notification

Title: 'Renumbered checks are not within number range of check lot' Error Message While Renumbering an Outgoing Check
Content: Symptom- An error message is displayed while renumbering an outgoing check:-'Renumbered checks are not within number range of check lot'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Find an Outgoing Check with External Reference AAA (AAA means the Check Number).-Click the gear icon and click Renumber.-Enter New Lowest Check Number as BBB and click OK.-Error is displayed:-'Renumbered checks are not within number range of check lot'-Cause-The Check Number BBB does not belong to the same Check Lot from which AAA has been picked.-Resolution-To renumber AAA, you should use a check number from the same Check Lot (same number range).-Keywords-check lot; renumber; outgoing check; external reference; FOP_OUTCHQ_BL:014

Title: G/L Account Balances Migration Errors
Content: Symptom-The migration of General Ledger Account Balances is not successful due to numerous errors:-For gen. Ledger Purposes, At Least One Debit And Credit Line Required.-Accnt Conversion: A/P Open Items In Chart Of Accounts XYZ Not Permitted For Posting Using Journal Entry Voucher.-Accnt PCA Balancing Dr/Cr In CoA XYZ Not Permitted For Posting Using Journal Entry Voucher.-XYZ means the Chart of Accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Process the file and during simulate import you get the errors.-Cause-ERROR 1: For gen. Ledger Purposes, At Least One Debit And Credit Line Required.-Migration of a G/L Accnt with zero balance is not possible.-ERROR 2: Accnt Conversion: A/P Open Items In Chart Of Accounts  XYZ Not Permitted For Posting Using Journal Entry Voucher.-If there is a posting block for the G/L Accnt then you get the ERROR 2.-ERROR 3: Accnt PCA Balancing Dr/Cr In CoA XYZ Not Permitted For Posting Using Journal Entry Voucher.-If the account type of the G/L Accnt is for example: PCCLEA - Profit center or segment clearing then you get ERROR 3.-Resolution-ERROR 1: For gen. Ledger Purposes, At Least One Debit And Credit Line Required.-When you enter the G/L accounts in the template the amount in currency should not be zero for this account, if you have any G/L accounts with such line delete it or add an amount for it.-ERROR 2: Accnt Conversion: A/P Open Items In Chart Of Accounts  XYZ Not Permitted For Posting Using Journal Entry Voucher.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select a G/L in question and go to the view G/L Account Posting Block and select All Postings Allowed from the dropdown.-Save.-ERROR 3: Accnt PCA Balancing Dr/Cr In CoA XYZ Not Permitted For Posting Using Journal Entry Voucher.-The G/L Accounts in migration depend upon the settings in the system. However the most prominent account types that you cannot use in migration are:--- OCLSBS - Opening or closing - balance sheet-- OCLSPL - Opening or closing - income statement-- PCCLEA - Profit center or segment clearing-- Migration clearing accounts-You cannot make manual postings to G/L accounts of the following account types: OCLSPL - Opening or Closing Income Statement, OCLSBS - Opening or Closing Balance Sheet, and PCCLEA- Profit Center or Segment Clearing.-These accounts are only used in the balance carry forward run for balance carry forward postings only.-Once you correct these then the above errors would not appear during migration of G/L balances.-Keywords-G/L balances; migration; JEV; journal entry voucher-migration of accounting transaction data,for gen. ledger purposes,one debit and credit line required

Title: Overhead Distribution Run Distributes Cost Center Costs Incorrectly
Content: Symptom-You want to distribute only a certain amount of a cost center A to another cost center B. The remaining costs shall stay on cost center A.-Therefore you create a distribution rule for cost centers and maintain cost center A as sender cost center.-As receiver cost center you maintain a certain percentage for cost center B and for the rest you maintain cost center A also as receiver (i.e. 30% cost center B, 70% cost center A).-After executing the Overhead Distribution Run you notice that the run distributed the costs of your sender cost center A incorrectly:-The total distribution amount  is much higher than the cost amount of your sender cost center-The run distributed 100% of the sender cost center A to receiver cost center B, instead of just a certain percentage (i.e. 30%)-The run distributed another amount (higher than the total cost amount of the sender cost center A) to and from the sender cost center A-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create Distribution Rule for Cost Centers-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Allocation view and there to the Distribution Rules subview.-Press New - Distribution Rule for Cost Centers.-In the first step, maintain the Sender cost center. By default the following settings are maintained: Press Next to select the Receivers (step 2)-Select Receiver Type: 2-Cost Centers-Distribution Basis: All costs-Select Cost Centers: Manually-Distribution Factors: Fixed-From the Available Cost Centers list, select the cost center that you want to distribute a certain percentage to, i.e. cost center B. And also select cost center A.-Press Next (step 3).-Enter the Distribution Factors for the selected cost centers, i.e. 0,3 for cost center B and 0,7 for cost center A.-Press Next (step 4).-Maintain a distribution rule ID XXX and description and, if you wish, the account determination group. Under Distribution Rule Assignment – Assign This Distribution Rule: Only to the current sender is maintained.-Press Next [step 6 (step 5 is skipped automatically)] and Finish.-Execute Overhead Distribution Run-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and here to the Overhead Distribution subview.-Press New-Distribution Run.-Maintain a run description and the company. Maintain your new distribution rule XXX and maintain the respective period/year.-Press Start Now to execute the run.-After the run is finished navigate to the log results and there to the Postings tab.-Here you notice that the costs of the sender cost center have been distributed incorrectly:-The total distribution amount  is much higher than the cost amount of your sender cost center-The run distributed 100% of the sender cost center A to receiver cost center B, instead of just a certain percentage (i.e. 30%)-The run distributed another amount (higher than the total cost amount of the sender cost center A) to and from the sender cost center A-Cause-Currently, overhead distribution only supports distribution 100% of the sender costs. Partial distribution is currently NOT supported.-The workaround of distributing a certain percentage to receiver cost center (i.e. 30%) and the rest back to the sender cost center (i.e. 70% does not work).-Instead, the overhead distribution run transfers 100% of the sender cost center A to the receiver cost center B. To achieve this it generates a posting of extra costs from the sender cost sender A back to the sender cost center A in order to achieve a 100% transfer of the costs to the receiver cost center B in a second posting.-Resolution-As only 100% overhead distribution is supported the following workaround can be used:-Use a dummy cost center and create two distribution rules. One for distributing a certain percentage from your sender cost center A to cost center B (i.e. 30%) and the dummy cost center C (70%). And a second one to distribute the costs of the dummy cost center C back to cost center A. Then execute two separate overhead distribution runs, first for your first and then for the second distribution rule. This way the 70% will be transferred back to your initial sender cost center.-Create a new cost center in your org structure or, alternatively, find a cost center for which no postings have been created.-A) Create the first distribution rule for cost centers - from cost center A to dummy cost center C-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Allocation view and there to the Distribution Rules subview.-Press New- Distribution Rule for Cost Centers.-In the first step, maintain the Sender cost center. By default the following settings are maintained:Press Next to select the Receivers (step 2)-Select Receiver Type: 2-Cost Centers-Distribution Basis: All costs-Select Cost Centers: Manually-Distribution Factors: Fixed-From the Available Cost Centers list, select the cost center that you want to distribute a certain percentage to, i.e. cost center B. And also select your dummy cost center C for the rest (i.e. 70%).-Press Next (step 3).-Enter the Distribution Factors for the selected cost centers, i.e. 0,3 for cost center B and 0,7 for the dummy cost center C.-Press Next (step 4).-Maintain a distribution rule ID XXX and description and, if you wish, the account determination group. Under Distribution Rule Assignment – Assign This Distribution Rule: Only to the current sender is maintained.-Press Next [step 6 (step 5 is skipped automatically)] and Finish.-B) Create the second distribution rule for cost centers - from the dummy cost center C back to cost center A-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Allocation view and there to the Distribution Rules subview.-Press New- Distribution Rule for Cost Centers.-In the first step, maintain the dummy cost center C as Sender cost center. By default the following settings are maintained:Press Next to select the Receivers (step 2)-Select Receiver Type: 2-Cost Centers-Distribution Basis: All costs-Select Cost Centers: Manually-Distribution Factors: Fixed-From the Available Cost Centers list, select cost center A.-Press Next (step 3).-Enter the Distribution Factor 1 for the selected cost center.-Press Next (step 4).-Maintain a distribution rule ID YYY and description and, if you wish, the account determination group. Under Distribution Rule Assignment – Assign This Distribution Rule: Only to the current sender is maintained.-Press Next [step 6 (step 5 is skipped automatically)] and Finish.- C) Execute two separate overhead distribution runs-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and here to the Overhead Distribution subview.-Press New-Distribution Run.-Maintain a run description and the company. Maintain the first distribution rule XXX and maintain the respective period/year.-Press Start Now to execute the run.-After the run is finished navigate to the log results and there to the Postings tab.-Here you can see that a certain percentage has been transferred to cost center B (i.e. 30%) and the rest was transferred to the dummy cost center C (ie.70%).-Now create a new run via New-Distribution Run.-Maintain a run description and the company. Maintain the second distribution rule YYY and maintain the respective period/year.-Press Start now to execute the run.-After the run is finished navigate to the log results and there to the Postings tab.-Here you can see that 100% of the costs of the dummy cost center C have been transferred to cost center A, so that, in the end, 70% of the initial costs of cost center A remain on cost center A.-Keywords-overhead distribution run; all costs

Title: Impossible to Finish a Customer Account Statement Run
Content: Symptom-You cannot finish a Customer Account Statement Run.-The status of the Run is Active and the Processing Status is In Process with no error message.-Click View Jobs and select Run Jobs, you can see that the status is Failed with the Error Description: Cancelled manually or by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Account Statement view.-Select a Run.-Click Schedule and select Immediately.-The Processing Status is In Process and does not change.-Click View Jobs.-Select Run Jobs-You can see the Error Description: Cancelled manually or by the system.-Cause-The Customer Account Statement Form Template should have no other details mentioned inside (Company, Country/Region, Balance Confirmation Type) than the Form template code and has to be first in sequence.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Form and Template Selection view.-Select Show Rules For: Balance Confirmation.-You have to have Customer Account Statement in the first line.-Click Edit.-Remove any information in the fields Company, Country/Region and Balance Confirmation Type.-Click Save and Close.-After these changes, you can Schedule again a Run for the Customer Account Statement.-See Also-Help Document:-Create a Customer Account Statement Run-Quick Guide for Customer Account Statements-Keywords-Customer Account Statement, South Africa, Form Template, cancelled manually or by the system-form template,customer account statement,south africa,cancelled manually or by the system

Title: How to Create a Registered Product Automatically via Outbound Delivery to Customer
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales order and released the outbound delivery. Then you want to know how to create a registered product automatically via outbound delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Select the business option "Automatic Product Registration" in business configuration (under Questions ->  Services -> Entitlement Management  Registered Products). Scope the question "Do you want the solution to automatically record registered products sold during the outbound delivery process?"-Ensure the product is "Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers" set in the product master data - "Serial Number Profile" field under general tab.-When delivering the goods to customer, maintain a serial number-After goods was issued to customer via outbound delivery, the registered product will be created automatically- It is also applicable to item type - Sales Kit.- Ensure the above setting has been maintained for the Sales Kit - Sub Item.-Keywords-Sales Kit, Registered Product, Outboudn Delivery

Title: How to Simulate a Document Posting for Unposted Source Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to simulate a document posting for an unposted source document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-Simulate feature is not present in the UI for pending Account Notifications.-Resolution-1. Open an STFK session for the customer system.-2. Open SE38 transaction.-3. In the Program field enter FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI.-4. Press Execute (a little clock item with a green check mark).-5. In the Operational Document Type field, enter the value help and select the type of document you are simulating the post.-6. In the Operational Document ID field, enter the document ID XYZ (XYZ represents the document ID).-7. In the Display Options section, select Account Notification(s).-8. Press Execute.-9. In the Test shell, choose Action button.-10. Click Reprocess Pending.-11. In the dialog window use date as 00.00.0000 to simulate the posting with the proposed posting date. You can change this date to simulate the posting with a desired posting date.-12. Execute it.-13. You will see the simulated document or the updated error message.-Note:-Make sure that you exit without saving, otherwise a SAP_SUPP* log will be recorded in customer system.-See Also-KBAs:-2096990 - How To Find The XI Message, Sender BO Instance, Accounting Notification From The Business Transaction-2097164 - How To Find Old / Archived XI Message in the backend-Keywords-How to; unposted source document; source document; simulate; FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI; SE38

Title: Unable to Combine Reverse Charge Tax Code to Other Tax Code in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create or save a Supplier Invoice because of error message: "You are not allowed to combine rev charge and non-rev charge tax codes".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to New Invoice Without Purchase Order view.-Insert the necessary information (Supplier, external document ID, etc.).-In Items section, for first item, you insert Tax Code which is Reverse Charge.-For the second item, you select a different Tax Code.-Click in Save button.-You get the error messages:-Save failed-You are not allowed to combine rev charge and non-rev charge tax codes-Cause-It is not possible to post Supplier Invoice which has items with tax code combining Reverse Charge Tax Code to another one. It is a legal requirement from the Local Legal Experts of Italy.-Resolution-Create an invoice for each Tax Code.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Reverse Charge Tax Code; Non-Reverse Charge Tax Code; Italy

Title: Free Cost Object Not Found in Free Cost Objects View Because it is Invalid
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the Free Cost Object you are looking for in the View Free Cost Objects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Workcenter Cost and Revenue.-Open the view Free Cost Objects.-Show All Cost Objects and search for the Cost Object-The results show "No records found".-Cause-The validity of the Free Cost Object has ended. In the view Free Cost Objects you can only see valid Cost Objects.-Resolution-If you want to navigate into the Cost Object and e.g. extend the validity, you can do this via the report Free Cost Object List.-Navigate to Workcenter Cost and Revenue-Select the view Reports - List-Open the report Free Cost Object List-Click Go and find your Cost Object-Click on the Cost Object and then on the arrow-Select View Cost Object-In the tab General you can extend the validity and save-Now you will be able to find the Cost Object again in the view Free Cost Objects-Keywords-Free Cost Object. Validty.

Title: Maintain Approval Options Link Not Visible in Time Type - <Country> Activity
Content: Symptom-You have done all prerequisites that are mentioned in the SAP help document Configuration: Maintain Approval Options, but the Maintain Approval Options link is still not visible in the Time Type - <Country> activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Overview view-Search for Time Type - <Country>-Select it and click on Open-Note: The link Maintain Approval Options is not there-Cause-The cause why the Maintain Approval Options link is missing in the fine tuning activity Time Type - <Country> is that the scoping question 'Would you like your managers to be able to review their employees' leave requests in the system' is not scoped'.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Implementation Projects view-Select current implementation project-Click on Edit Project Scope-Click on Next until Questions-Expand Human Resources-Expand Time and Labor Management-Select Approval-Tick the following scoping question 'Would you like your managers to be able to review their employees' leave requests in the system?'-Keywords-Maintain Approval Options not available, Time Type <Country>, fine tuning activity, Would you like your managers to be able to review their employees' leave requests in the system,

Title: Attachment from Product Master Data not Carried to Sourcing Request
Content: Symptom-When you create a Sourcing Request the attachments maintained in the product master data are not being sent to the subsquent documents.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-The attachment type in the product master data is selected as Standard Attachment in Document Type.-Resolution-Since the system considers the Standard as an internal information, this attachment will not be carried to other documents.-For the attachment to go in other documents, select Details for Supplier in the dropdown Document Type, as you can see in the image below:-Keywords-Sourcing Request. Material Master Data. Attachment.

Title: How to Configure Time Account Type with Recurrence Date Different to Calendar Year
Content: Symptom-You, as a time administrator, have a requirement to configure a time account type with a recurrence date different to calendar year, like matching company's fiscal year (e.g. from Feb 01 to Jan 31). You wonder how to achieve this.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click the Open Activity List view.-Select the Fine-Tune arrow, find the activity Time Accounts - <country name> and open it.-Select the Maintain Time Account Types link.-Select the respective time account type, set Recurrence to such as Annual, February 1 to January 31.-In the below Details, change the Bookable From and Bookable To to Start of time account and End of time account and select the Save and Close.-Select the Maintain Time Account Rules link.-Select the respective time account type, select the Add Row button in Details to add a new rule or select the existing rule.-In the Accrual Rule tab, set Accrual Date to Annually, February 1.-Fill in other fields, e.g. for Period End Rules, and select the Save and Close.-Keywords-Bookable, to, from,  End of, pf the following Year, of the 2nd year, period end rule, accrual rule,

Title: Error Message: 'No valid cost accumulations exist for ABC with stock quantity XYZ ea'.
Content: Symptom-After you executed FIFO Cost Determination run, you get the error message: 'No valid cost accumulations exist for ABC (ABC represents the material ID) with stock quantity XYZ(XYZ represents the quantity) ea'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks -> FIFO Cost Determination view.-Show all FIFO Cost Determination Runs and search for the erroneous Run ID.-In the Messages tab, you will see the error message: 'No valid cost accumulations exist for ABC with stock quantity XYZ ea'.-Cause-Error is due to two reasons:-Either you have not posted the cost for the Material.-There are no postings for the Material ID: ABC for the period in which the respective FIFO Cost Determination run was executed.-You can check in:-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Materials View.-Search for the Material ID: ABC.-Click View Cost History.-Enter the Period/Year and you will see no records exist for that period.-(or)-You have posted the cost for the Material for one Set of Books, whereas you have to execute the FIFO Cost Determination run for another Set of Books.-Resolution-You need to execute the FIFO Cost Determination run for the Correct Set of Books. (or)-You need to execute Material Cost Accumulation run at first and then re-execute FIFO Cost Determination run.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks -> Material Cost Accumulation view-Create a New Material Cost Accumulation Run.-Fill in all the necessary details and execute the run.-Check the Processed Successfully tab and you will see Material ID: ABC has been processed.-You now have to re-execute the FIFO Cost Determination run with the same selection parameters. You can see the run has been executed successfully without errors.-See Also-2113245 - FIFO Cost Determination - No Valid Cost Accumulation Exists For Material-Keywords-FIFO Cost Determination, Accumulation-no valid cost accumulations exist,fifo cost determination

Title: Purchase Order Invoicing Status not updated after Supplier Invoice being created
Content: Symptom-You have created and posted a Supplier Invoice (SIV) 123 against Purchase Order(PO) ABC, however the Invoicing status of the PO remains Not Invoiced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Select the view Purchase Order.-Search the PO ABC; you will notice the Invoicing Status being Not Invoiced despite the SIV 123 being correctly created and posted.-If now you open the PO ABC and go to Document Flow tab, you will also notice the SIV 123 is not present.-However, if you open the SIV 123 and open the Document Flow, you can see the PO ABC being present.-Cause-The PO ABC was migrated in your system but a Goods and Service Receipt (GSR) XYZ was also migrated with it (visible in the PO Document Flow).-You have created a SIV against the PO ABC instead of creating this SIV against the GSR XYZ.-Resolution-If you need to create a SIV for a migrated PO, please make sure that this PO does not come with a migrated GSR.-If it does, please do as follows when creating a SIV:-Select the Work Center Supplier Invoicing-Select the view Invoice Entry -Use the filter "All Deliveries to Be Invoiced"-Search the GSR related to your migrated PO-Click "New Invoice"-Once this SIV will be created and posted, the PO Invoicing Status will change from Not Invoiced to Partially Invoiced or Invoiced (this is according to the amount of delivered goods from GSR).-Also the newly created SIV will be present in the migrated PO Document Flow.-Keywords-Migrated Purchase Order, Migrated Goods and Service Receipt, Wrong Invoicing Status, Supplier Invoice

Title: Withholding Tax Calculation During Payment for Israel Country
Content: Symptom-You have posted Supplier Invoice for country Israel without WHT calculation. In the payment, the Withholding tax is not calculated as per the Tax Rate maintained in the Supplier master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work centre.-Post the Supplier Invoice without WHT Tax for Country Israel. -Go to the Payables work centre.-Click on the Supplier Accounts view.-Find the supplier of the invoice created in step 2, and click View.-Select the Invoice created in step 2 and click Pay Manually By.-Select the Payment method as per your requirement. -In the Payment Screen, you observe that the Withholding Tax is not calculated. -Cause-Israel has an exceptional requirement where in as per the country laws the withholding tax should be calculated at the time of payment and any calculation that happens at the time of invoicing should not be considered.-In the ByDesign system, to achieve this functionality a recalculation of withholding tax gets triggered at the time of payment, only if a supplier invoice has been issued which takes the current rate maintained in the supplier master.-Resolution-In order to calculate the Withholding Tax in the payment, you have to maintain the following:-Withholding tax rate in the Supplier Financial Data.-Post the supplier invoice with the Withholding tax code (the supplier invoice has to be posted before the payment).-Clear the payment with the supplier invoice.-The Journal entry of the payment will contain the withholding tax details.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Israel, WHT Calculation for Israel, Withholding Tax in Payment.

Title: Is it Possible to Change the Inventory Valuation UoM or Logistics UoM for a Material?
Content: Symptom-You would like to know whether it is possible to change the Inventory Valuation unit of measure (UoM) or the Logistics unit of measure for a material, as even after changing the base UoM, the Inventory Valuation and Logistics UoMs remain unchanged.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In the Valuation tab of a material, if you activate the Companies/Business Residence, then it is not possible to change the Inventory Valuation UoM after that. All the Business Residences used in the Valuation tab will take the same UoM as set for the first time.-A change is also not possible via Migration Tool or OData.-Similarly, in Logistics, Planning and Availability Confirmation tabs of the materials, it is not possible to change UoM once it is activated.-NOTE: Other than Sales and Purchsing, all other tabs are dependent on each other. Ex: if you have activated a Business Residence in Logistics, then you cannot edit the UoM in other tabs, ex.: Valuation.-This is the expected system behavior.-To overcome this situation, you can maintain the quantity conversion in the Material for the old UoM to a new UoM.-Go to the Product Data work center.-Access the Materials view.-Select the relevant material and click Edit.-In the General tab of that Material, you can maintain the quantity conversion between the old base UoM and new UoM or vice versa.-See Also-3120942 - Change Service UoM Leads to Error: 'Maintain conversions between UoMs ABC and XYZ'-Keywords-Change, UoM, Materials, Planning, Logistics, Valuation

Title: How to Remove Scanned Invoice in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You're unable to delete a scanned invoice in the front end.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go Invoice Scanning view. -Search for the document ID. -Select the document ID. -The Delete button is grayed out.-Cause-The document may be stuck in 'Scanning in Process', for example, so you're unable to delete the document in the front end.-Resolution-Open the backend. -Go to transaction SESFTS. -Insert the BO /SRMAP/SCAN_INV_STAGING.-Navigate to Load By Query and select ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Insert the document ID in field ID/content.-Click in Continue. -Select the document in BO Instance Structure. -Click in Actions button and select Remove. -Click in Save. -Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Scanned Invoice; Remove; Backend

Title: Cannot Find Tax Reporting Unit When Editing Company Tax Arrangement
Content: Symptom-You try to add a tax reporting unit of company tax arrangement but you cannot find it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can reproduce the issue with following steps:-Go to work center Tax Management, view Tax Authorities and subview Company Tax Arrangement.-Select Tax Authority XYZ and select Edit.-Select Add Row in tab Assigned Tax Reporting Units.-Use value help, but cannot find the unit you want to add.-  Cause-Reporting Unit value help is restricted by the company for which unit is assigned. If you open the value help of the tax reporting unit, and open Advanced option, you can see the company is input there by default.-Resolution-You need to remove the company input in the advanced search and search again for the tax reporting unit you want to add, then you find it.-Please note that tax Reporting Units is only visible for a few countries (United States, Germany, Austria, France, Switzerland and UK), also available for India too.-Keywords-tax reporting unit, tax authority, Company Tax Arrangement

Title: Error Message "Email Address XYZ Could Not Be Mapped to User" When Logging In Using Single Sign-On
Content: Symptom-You are using SSO with Microsoft Azure Active Directory and when trying to log in, you receive error message "E-mail address XYZ could not be mapped to user. Reason: No business partner found for e-mail address XYZ" (where XYZ stands for an actual e-mail address).-"E-mail address XYZ could not be mapped to user. Reason:Email address XYZ"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Try to log into the system using SSO.-2. Error message appears.-Cause-The e-mail ID being passed needs to be assigned to a user in the system, and not more than one.-This is because when the SAML assertion happens between the IDP and the SAP system, the IDP passes this e-mail ID to the SAP system. In case the same e-mail is used for no user or for multiple users, there is no way to figure out which user is requesting to log on. Hence, SSO will not work as the correct user cannot be determined.-Resolution-Ensure that the e-mail being passed is assigned to at least one user and one user only (i.e. users have unique e-mail IDs assigned to them in the system).-Keywords-SSO, Error, Mapped, Azure, Single, Sign, Email address, could not be mapped to user

Title: How to Clear Overpayment And Underpayment Differences In Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-In the Trade Payables account of the supplier, there is a payment whose amount is different from an open invoice item, now you want to manually clear these two items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier XYZ (XYZ stands for the Supplier ID), and then select View.-In the Trade Payables tab, show Open Items.-You can see a supplier invoice, and a payment whose amount is just a little different from the invoice.-Select these two items, and choose Clear Manually.-In the new screen, choose Clear.-     The system gives error message: Balance of XXX; clearing not possible.-XXX stands for the clearing balance.-Cause-As the balance in the clearing is not zero, so it is not possible to clear the invoice with the payment.-Resolution-If there is an overpayment, in order to successfully clear the payment and invoice all at once, follow the below:-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier XYZ, and then select View.-In the Trade Payables tab, show Open Items.-Select the Payment and invoice in question, and choose Clear Manually.-In the new screen, the two items are checked as Matched.-Select the payment item, and then drag down to the bottom of the screen.-In the Amount field, set the difference as Other Discounts/Credits, also specify Payment Difference Reason.-Choose Clear.-Both the payment and the invoice should be cleared now.-If there is an underpayment, in order to successfully clear the payment and invoice all at once, follow the below:-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier XYZ, and then select View.-In the Trade Payables tab, show Open Items.-Select the payment and invoice in question, and choose Clear Manually.-In the new screen, the two items are checked as Matched.-Select the invoice item, and then fill the difference in the Cash Discount column to set the balance to zero.-Choose Clear.-Both the payment and the invoice should be cleared now.-Keywords-Payables, Balance, Underpayment, Overpayment

Title: Exception in Supplier Invoice "Cost center ABC is not assigned to company 123 on dd.mm.yyyy"
Content: Symptom-While processing a Supplier Invoice, you have noticed an Exception to be processed under status description"Internal information is missing. To complete the invoice, add missing data":  "Cost center ABC is not assigned to company 123 on dd.mm.yyyy".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the work center Supplier Invoicing-Select the view Invoice and Credit Memo-Search, Open and click View All on Supplier Invoice XYZ-This Supplier Invoice is under status Exception-Go to the Exceptions tab, you will find the mentioned error message-Cause-The combination between the Account Assignment Type "IMAT" and the Individual Material selected needs to be fixed.-Resolution-From the same Supplier Invoice, select the Items tab-Select the Cost Distribution sub-tab-Next to the field Individual Material, click New-From the new window, you will find that the system will pick automatically the data present from the Supplier Invoice Individual Material & the Product Category-After clicking on "Save and Close", the exception becomes obsolete and the Supplier Invoice is now Ready for Posting-Keywords-Cost center ABC is not assigned to company 123 on dd.mm.yyyy", Supplier Invoice, Exception, Individual Material, IMAT, Account Assignment.

Title: Supplier Invoice's Approvers Listed in Invoices and Credit Memos View
Content: Symptom-You want the approvers from the Supplier Invoice to be shown in a column of the Supplier Invoice - Invoice and Credit memos view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-This is currently not possible, as the system do not store the approvers in the system until they have approved a task.-Resolution-When you open a document and navigate to the approval tab, this information is generated at runtime.-Hence the system could show previous approvers but not future approvers.-When step 1 is approved then step 2 is determined.-Keywords-Approval Process, Supplier Invoice

Title: Confirmed Quantity on Service Order is Not Getting Updated
Content: Symptom-The correct quantity should appear on the Service Order, but in you case all the items are with the confirmed quantity as 0.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders work center.-Go to Service Order Processing View.-Search for Service Order XYZ (XYZ is the ID of the Sales Order).-Edit the Service Order and click on View all.-Navigate to  Services and Spare Parts Tab.-Select Item 10 which of type Service- Time and Material.-You can under Delivery see the status Confirmed Quantity 0 Each.-You expect it to be 1ea to be maintained since you have created the Service Confirmation with quantity 1 ea.-Cause-In Service Order XYZ, items 10 are non-billable.-Non-billable items are not counted towards the Confirmed Quantity in the Service Order, because the Confirmed Quantity is the value used for invoicing. Since the items are non-billable, the are not to be invoiced and so they are not added to the Confirmed Quantity.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Non-billable; Confirmed Quantity; Service Order
