Title: How to Compare the Cost Center Assignment of the Expense Arrangement With the Organizational Assignment in Employee's Personnel File
Content: Symptom-You are reviewing the cost center assignment in the employee's expense arrangement and comparing with the organizational assignment in the employee's personnel file.-You have checked the Expense Arrangement report and see that it does not have the Cost Center characteristic.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open the Expense Arrangement report.-Execute the report for the relevant employees.-You notice that there is no characteristic for the Cost Center assignment that could be used to compare with the assignment in the personnel file.-Cause-At the moment, this characteristic is not available.-Resolution-You can evaluate the feasibility of developing a custom add-on solution to retrieve the Cost Center from the expense arrangements. The Cost Center ID in the Cost Assignment of an expense arrangement for an employee is PSM enabled as per below BO Path in the Studio:-ExpenseArrangement -> AssignmentSet -> AccountingCodingBlockDistribution (ROOT) -> AccountingCodingBlockAssignment -> element "CostCentreID"-Keywords-Expense Arrangement. Cost Center. Cost Centre. Personnel File. Work Agreement. Public Solution Modeling. PDI. Expense Report. Cloud Application Studio.

Title: Error "Item XXX: Cost center or project not permitted for this reason code" in Inventory Notification
Content: Symptom-In Inventory Notification YYY, the item XXX is inconsistent.-YYY = Inventory Notification ID-XXX - Line Item ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select Inventory Notifications view.-Find Notification YYY.-Open the Notification YYY. -Click View All.-Click Check. -The error is faced:-"Item XXX: Cost center or project not permitted for this reason code"-Cause-When the Reason is "Alignment with External Warehouse Stock", you do not need to select any Cost Center, since the stock is externally owned.-Resolution-You need to remove the Cost Center from the item following the steps:-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select Inventory Notifications view.-Find Notification YYY.-Open the Notification YYY. -Click View All.-Go to Line Items tab. -Remove the Cost Center from the item. -Save-Keywords-cost, error, stock

Title: Error In Posting a Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Payment Allocation XYZ (XYZ represents the Payment Allocation ID) and you are getting the error message:-'Account determination is missing for item type Withholding Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC: DEF Chart of Accounts and account determination profile . Column Path Tax->Withholding Tax->Withholding Tax, Item Type Withholding Tax.'-(ABC represents the Account Determination Profile)-(DEF represents the Chart of Accounts)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management Work center. -Go to Payment Allocation View. -Select All Payment Allocations. -Search for Payment Allocation XYZ.-Click View All. -Click Post. -You will see the following error message: -'Account determination is missing for item type Withholding Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC: DEF Chart of Accounts and account determination profile . Column Path Tax->Withholding Tax->Withholding Tax, Item Type Withholding Tax.'-Cause-You notice that the Withholding Tax tab is not appearing for configuration.-One possible reason is that there are no Countries assigned to the Account Determination Profile ABC, and for this reason the Withholding Tax tab is not appearing for configuration.-Resolution-You need to assign a country to the Account Determination Profile ABC, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Select Overview view.-Search for the activity: Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination. -Select Account Determination > Tax. -Select the Account Determination Profile ABC. -Click the button "Assign Countries/Regions to Profile".-Assign the Country that is missing. -See Also-Define Account Determination for Each Subledger-Keywords-Chart of Accounts; Financial Reporting Structures; Account Determination; Account determination is missing for item type Withholding Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC: DEF Chart of Accounts and account determination profile . Column Path Tax->Withholding Tax->Withholding Tax, Item Type Withholding Tax.; Payment Allocation; Payment Allocation error;

Title: Migration Mode Enhance Already Existing Record is Not Available for HR Objects
Content: Symptom-You are looking for migration mode Enhance Already Existing Data, but it is not available in the drop list while migrating Basic Employee Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration and select Implementation Projects-Open the activity list of your project-Search for Migration of Employee Data-Select Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool-Highlight any file of migration workbench-Select the button Properties-The option Enhance Already Existent Data is not available on field Migration Mode-  Resolution-The enhancement mode is not available for any Human Resource migration object.-See Also-KBA: 3234367 - How to Mass Change Employee Data Like Organisational Assignments-Keywords-mass change, update, employees-migration of employee data,enhance employee data,enhance mode

Title: Wrong Balance in Uploaded Credit Memo.
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded a Credit Memo in Business ByDesign through Excel File, but the balance is not correct on the front end.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select Work Center Supplier Invoicing.-Select the view Supplier Invoice and Credit Memo.-Find the newly uploaded Credit Memo.-From here you will find the Total Balance not matching the data used from the Excel File.-Cause-Wrong Item Type was selected in the Excel file.-Resolution-Open the Excel File.-Under Supplier Invoice Line, select the field Item Type.-Now select Credit Memo Item instead of Invoice Item.-After a new upload, the balance on the new Credit Memo will match the data from the Excel file and no error will be visible.-For the existing and already uploaded Credit Memo which show the balance error, select Action > Calculate Total Amount; it will solve the problem.-Keywords-Upload Credit Memo, Excel Upload, Item Type, Invoice Item, Credit Memo Item.

Title: Employee Is Able To Post Leave Request Even When Balance In Quota Account Is Negative
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that an employee is able to post a new leave request even when the balance of the respective quota account is less than zero (negative).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the negative quota of the time account:-Go to the Time Administration Work Center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for the desired employee and click Edit.-Go to the Time Account Balances tab.-You see that for your time account for vacation, the balance is negative; however, it is still possible to post new leave requests under Employee Self-Services.-Cause-In the fine-tuning activity "Time Accounts - ABC" (where ABC stands for the affect employee's actual country/region of employment), you see that for the relevant vacation time account type, the Check Limit and Minimum Balance Limit are not maintained.-Resolution-To correct this, please follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the fine-tuning activity "Time Accounts - ABC."-Click the link to Maintain Time Account Types.-Select the relevant time account type for vacation.-Edit the Check Limit and Minimum Balance Limit as desired.-Note: maintaining Check Limit option as Fixed Limit, but not defining a Minimum Balance Limit will still allow posting beyond zero, since the system will not know at which point to limit further postings.-See Also-Configuration: Maintain Time Account Types in SAP Help Portal.-Keywords-leave request, vacation, time account, negative balance, negative quota, check limit

Title: No Valid Bank and Payment Method Data when Paying an Invoice Manually with Direct Debit
Content: Symptom-You are trying to pay a customer invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the customer invoice) with incoming direct debit. When creating the payment you notice that the house bank data is not automatically filled under Bank Account ID. When trying to automatically fill the bank data you receive the error:-Bank account missing or not valid.-Payment method details are not determined.-When choosing the right bank account using the value help and matching payment and invoice you receive the error:-Bank value date missing.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Choose Customer Account ABC (ABC represents the Customer Account) and click View.-Enter the Customer Account Monitor.-Under Trade Receivables choose Invoices/Payments.-Select invoice XYZ and choose Pay Manually By / Direct Debit.-Click Complete Bank Data.-Go via View All and fill the Bank Processing Date and match the transactions.-Cause-The reason for the thrown errors becomes apparent when specifying the Payment Method Details under Further Details. When choosing SEPA Direct Debit now a different message shows as:-No mandate specified.-As suggested by the error there are problems regarding the validity of a SEPA mandate for this particular customer account.-Resolution-In order to evaluation the validity of the SEPA Mandate proceed as follows.-From the Customer Account Monitor, directly enter the account master data for customer account ABC.-Under Financial Data choose Payment Data.-Under SEPA Mandates you find the specifics for the applicable SEPA Mandate.-Check here whether the checkbox Blocked is set and/or the validity time frame of the mandate.-Either a new valid SEPA mandate has to be obtained from the customer or an alternative valid payment method has to be applied for this account.-Keywords- No Valid Bank and Payment Method Data when Paying an Invoice Manually with Direct Debit; Payment Method; Direct Debit; Bank account missing or not valid; Payment method details are not determined; Bank value date missing.

Title: How To Find Old / Archived XI Message in the backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to find the XI message. IF the XI messages are more than 3 months old, SRT_MONI transaction does not show any XI message.-Using the report FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI does not show any XI message for the Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-The SRT_MONI transaction shows the XI messages only for past 3 months. Old messages are not displayed using SRT_MONI or FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI report.-Resolution-1. log in to Backend.-2. Go to SE38.-3. Execute the report FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI with sender BO Instance(s) Radio Button. (For detailed steps can be found in the case document provided in the See Also Section).- 4. Copy the BO name and the NODE_ID.-5. Go to transaction SE16 (/OSE16 to open the new session).-6. Enter the table name: SPAF_BDOC_VIEW_1.-7. Click Table Contents or Press F7.-8. Enter the BO name in BO_NAME NDOE_ID in BO_ROOT_NODE_ID fields (values copied in step 2).-9. Click Execute.-10. Search for the column: MSGID.-11. Copy all the values in column MSGID.-12. Go to SRT_MONI (/OSRT_MONI to open the new session).-13. Enter the Values MSGID to message ID field (Enter all the values using multiple selection).-14. Click Execute.-Note:-In case the failed messages are not displayed, go to  Select Related Message > Sequence Message.-In case, after following the procedure, If you are still unable to find the Old Archived XI message. Send the incident to respective Expert Support queue.-See Also-2096990 - How To Find The XI Message, Sender BO Instance, Accounting Notification From The Business Transaction-3232920 - How to Simulate a Document Posting for Unposted Source Document-Keywords-How to; FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI; SE38; XI Message;-fia_accnotif_show_pi,srt_moni, xi messages

Title: Posting Date Invalid Due To Closed Accounting Period; Contact Accounting
Content: Symptom-You post a bank statement. During post processing you access a related payment allocation which displays the error message "Posting date invalid due to closed accounting period; contact Accounting."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-From the Show list select All Bank Statements.-Select the statement ID in question and choose Required in the Post Processing status collumn.-You automatically navigate to the related payment allocation showing the error message "Posting date invalid due to closed accounting period; contact Accounting."-Cause-The payment allocation cannot be posted as the accounting period of the payment allocation's posting date is blocked for posting.-Resolution-In case it is not an option to re-open a closed period - post the payment allocation to a date and period which are open for posting the transactions by referring to open & close periods-Select the Payment Allocation ID from Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center. -In the Payment Allocation screen press on view all. -Change the posting date to a period which is open for operational postings. -Press Post. -Keywords-Posting date invaud due to closed accounting period

Title: Error: Account Determination for Acct for Group not Defined for Reclassification for Reclassification of Payable Run.
Content: Symptom-You get the error message "Account determination for acct ABC for Group DEF <GHI> not defined for reclassification" in Reclassification of Payable run.-(ABC represents the account determination profile, DEF represents the group, GHI represents the payables account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Reclassification of Payable subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Search for Run XYZ (XYZ represents the run ID) and select it.-The Run ends in Error.-Click View.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-The error message displays "Account determination for acct ABC for Group DEF <GHI> not defined for reclassification".-Cause-You have not maintained the account GHI for reclassification under Payables Account for Account Determination in the business configuration.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click the Change Immediately.-Click the Accounts Payable link under Account Determination.-Select Account Determination Profile ABC.-Navigate to the Reclassification subtab.-Search for Account GHI under Payables Account.-The account is missing.-Resolution-You need to maintain the account GHI under Payables Account for Reclassification.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click the Change Immediately.-Click the Accounts Payable link under Account Determination.-Select Account Determination Profile ABC.-Navigate to the Reclassification subtab.-Click Add Row.-Here, maintain the relevant Account Determination Group and then the G/L-Account GHI.-Keywords-Reclassification run; Payables; 应付账款重分类运行.

Title: Dunning Run: 'Relevance messages per account skipped due to high number of accounts'
Content: Symptom-Although a dunning run shows no errors or warnings you find the message 'Relevance messages per account skipped due to high number of accounts' in the application log of a relevant dunning run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Under Periodic Tasks view choose Dunning Runs.-Highlight the relevant dunning run and open the Application Log.-Under tab Results you find the mentioned message with a Status showing as green.-Cause-This is no message indicating an error or a warning. In previous versions an excess of messages of sometimes limited informational value have been created in the application log of a dunning run (for example: 'No dunning created' or 'Dunning created'). Depending on the amount of processed accounts this sheer amount of messages could potentially affect the system's stability. Consequently a new feature has been introduced.-In case a dunning run exceeds a threshold of 100 accounts, the afore-mentioned messages are skipped and exchanged for the general informational message 'Relevance messages per account skipped due to high number of accounts'.-Other possible warning and error messages are not touched by this feature and will show in the application log regardless of the number of involved accounts.-Keywords-dunning run; dunning

Title: Release Payment Allocation of Overpayment
Content: Symptom-A Payment Allocation task is generated for the outgoing bank transfer payment to a supplier and you don't know how to release the Payment Allocation because the payment amount is not equal to the amount of all the open Invoices on the supplier Trade Payable Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-You get the payment allocation for the bank transfer XYZ (XYZ means the bank transfer ID), with status being In Preparation and the allocation is not happening automatically.-You edit this payment allocation, in the Customer/Supplier tab, select all the open invoices.-But the amount is not fully allocated, and the Release button is grayed out.-Cause-Because there is an overpayment left which makes the amount not fully allocated, so the Release button is not enabled.-Resolution-For the payment difference, you can click Assign Payment On Account to assign the extra payment directly on the supplier account:-In the new window, specify the Customer/Supplier ID.-Account Type and Payment Amount are automatically selected by the system.-In the Debit/Credit field, select Debit from the dropdown list.-Choose OK.-Now you should be able to release the payment allocation.-Keywords-payment allocation, overpayment, release

Title: How to Cancel Purchase Order's Item using Webservice
Content: Symptom-You want to cancel a Purchase Order item via web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can use the payload below to cancel a Purchase Order's item. ABC is the Purchase Order's ID and X is the Item's number.-<n0:PurchaseOrderBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<PurchaseOrderMaintainBundle actionCode="04" ItemListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">-<BusinessTransactionDocumentTypeCode>001</BusinessTransactionDocumentTypeCode>-<PurchaseOrderID>ABC</PurchaseOrderID>-<Item ItemImatListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true" actionCode="04">-<ItemID>X</ItemID>-<CancelItemPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>true</CancelItemPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>-</Item>-</PurchaseOrderMaintainBundle>-</n0:PurchaseOrderBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-If you need to cancel only the second item, ID Y for example, you can use the payload below:-<n0:PurchaseOrderBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<PurchaseOrderMaintainBundle actionCode="04" ItemListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">-<BusinessTransactionDocumentTypeCode>001</BusinessTransactionDocumentTypeCode>-<PurchaseOrderID>ABC</PurchaseOrderID>-<Item ItemImatListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true" actionCode="04">-<ItemID>X</ItemID>-</Item>-<Item ItemImatListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true" actionCode="04">-<ItemID>Y</ItemID>-<CancelItemPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>true</CancelItemPurchaseOrderActionIndicator>-</Item>-</PurchaseOrderMaintainBundle>-</n0:PurchaseOrderBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-You can change the payload's tags according to what you need.-Keywords- Payload, Webservice, Purchase Order, Cancel

Title: Draft indicator in Journal Entry Upload
Content: Symptom- You want to know how to add the draft indicator so that when user uploads the JEV excel template and to reflect in the system-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger WoC.-Select Journal Entry voucher and click on new JEV via Excel-Open the downloaded excel and Draft Field can be seen-Cause-The template is modified as per the guidelines mentioned in below blog, however the changed template is not updated in the system.-https://blogs.sap.com/2015/02/25/how-to-guide-for-journal-entry-voucher-excel-customization/-Resolution-Requirement can be achieved from customer side once you have modified template, you can upload it by following the below steps-1. Go To Application anohh sd User Management WoC-2. Microsoft Office Template maintenance view-3. Search for the template, you want to update-4. upload the template and save-Keywords-Journal entry voucher, Excel upload, Draft Indicator

Title: Not Due Invoices are not Showing in the Dunning Letter
Content: Symptom-When previewing a dunning proposal, you notice that not due invoices are not displaying in the dunning document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Select the relevant Dunning Proposal.-Click on Preview and choose Dunning Letter.-In the resulting preview, there is no grid containing not overdue invoices are displayed.-Cause-The reason is that you have not selected the Include Items Not Overdue check box in the business configuration and hence, the items are not showing in the dunning document.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the activity Dunning Strategies and choose Edit dunning strategies.-Select the relevant Dunning Strategy:Global Dunning Strategy.-Go to the General tab.-Select Include Items Not Overdue check box.-Choose Save button.-Now you will be able to view not due invoices in the dunning letter.-Keywords-Dunning Letter, Not due invoices are missing in Dunning letter, Dunning Proposal

Title: Missing the Withholding Tax Return File
Content: Symptom-You are trying to obtain a Withholding Tax Return file, but no file is generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Creating the Tax Return Run:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view > New Tax Return Run subview.-Select the Tax Return Arrangement ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the Tax Return Arrangement ID) and select the date.-Click Save > Set to Active > Schedule > Save and close > Save and Close.-A Tax Return will be generated.-Checking the Tax Return created:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Go to Withholding Tax Returns. -Select All Tax Returns. -Search for the Tax Return ID that was created.-Click View All > Release > Save. -Click Download in the Attachments tab. -You will see that there is no file to download. -Cause-You have to check if the supplier names are of length 30 characters or more and hence, they are being rejected by the system. There's a system constraint that does not allow suppliers of character length 30 or more.-You can check the information in the below steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Go to Withholding Tax Returns. -Select All Tax Returns.-Search for the Tax Return ID that was created.-Go to Tax Return tab.-You will see the details under Supplier column.-Resolution-You have to rename the suppliers with a reduced length name and reschedule the run.-Keywords-Tax Return File. Tax Return. Download. XML, File is missing for WHT return

Title: Wrong Date in Time and Expenses field in Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-It was created a Project Invoice Request based on an Invoice Schedule. Due to which you expect that the date of the time and expenses is the same as in the Invoice Schedule (Start Date and End Date).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-ABC is an example of date and XYZ is an example of month.-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Project Invoice Requests view.-Search for the Project Invoice Request ID.-Click in Edit button.-The document shows the information below:-Invoice Date: (date ABC)-Time and Expenses From/To: (blank) / (date ABC)-You expected that the time and expenses was from the first day of month XYZ until last day of month XYZ.-Cause-The dates of the Invoice Schedule (Start and End Date) are used in other scenarios, such as Contracts. The Project invoice Request will take the 'Not invoiced time and expenses' from the past until the date of the Invoice Date.-So it is the standard behavior that in the Project Invoice Request the system shows the date like in the example below:-Invoice Date: (date ABC)-Time and Expenses From/To: (blank) / (date ABC)-Resolution-System's standard behavior.-Keywords-Time and Expenses; Date; Project Invoice Request; Invoice Schedule

Title: Extension Field is not carried over from migrated Purchase Order to Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom- You expect that the extension field from a migrated Purchase Order is carried over to Supplier Invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID.-Click in New Invoice button.-You can see that the Extension field is blank.-Then:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID.-Click in Edit button.-You can see that the Extension field is filled.-Cause-The current version of the system does not support Extension fields for migrated Purchase Orders being carried over.-Resolution-You need to manually maintain the information for the follow-up documents created from the migrated document.-Keywords-Extension Field; Purchase Order; Migration Tool; Supplier Invoice

Title: Is it Possible to Enhance the Reporting Line Unit of Migrated Employees?
Content: Symptom-You have migrated the basic Employee data of some Employees but you have missed to provide the Reporting Line Unit. Hence, you would want to know whether there is a possibility to enhance those Employee's Reporting Line Unit through migration itself.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button by highlighting a Project.-Go to tab Integrate and Extend.-Search for the activity Migration of Employee Data - <Country> and open it.-Select the link Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool.-Resolution-It is not possible to enhance/update the Reporting Line Unit of the Employee who were migrated using the activity Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool.--To overcome the issue, you can provide the Org Unit ID while migrating these employees with the Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool, in the sheet Work Agreements.--Once, you complete the migration of Employees with Personnel Administration Data, you can find the Employees in Personnel Administration work center.-Keywords-mass change, update,

Title: Error message "Start Date Must Not Be Later Than End Date" During Rehire of Employee
Content: Symptom-You are trying to rehire an employee, but system raises error message "Rehire Activity Failed. Start date date must not be later than end date."-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees view.-Change selection to All Employees.-Locate and select the relevant employee that needs to be rehired.-Click the Actions button and choose Rehire Employee.-Fill in the mandatory details and click the Save button.-Error message is raised-Cause-The issue might be caused by an inconsistency in the Payroll Period Assignment "Valid From" date. This would have been caused as a result of a change in the hire date of the employee to something in the future.-For example: employee's hire date was changed from 02.05.2022 to 01.07.2022 (i.e. moved to a date in the future).-However, due to an inconsistency, the "Valid From" date from the employee's Payroll Period Assignment was not updated. This causes the error message raised during rehiring.-Resolution-With system version 2208, developers have delivered a fix which will ensure that the payroll period "Valid From" date is properly updated whenever there is a change in the employee's hire date. This will ensure no other employees become inconsistent going forward.-For employees that were already inconsistent before the fix was delivered, a manual correction to the Payroll Period Assignment "Valid From" date should be done, so that it matches the current hire date. To do this:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees view.-Change selection to All Employees.-Locate and select the relevant employee that needs to be rehired.-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Employment tab.-Navigate to the Payroll Group Assignment sub-tab.-Change the Valid From field of the Payroll Period Assignment so that it matches the employee's Hire Date from the Work Agreement sub-tab.-Keywords-Employee, Rehiring, Rehire Activity Failed, Start date date must not be later than end date, Payroll Period Assignment, Hire Date

Title: Document Cannot be Reversed and Reposted Because of Tax Item
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse and repost the Migrated Customer Invoice from the Source Documents in the General Ledger work center but you get the error message:-'Document Cannot be Reversed and Reposted Because of Tax Item'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents subview.-And search for your Source Document ID of the Customer Invoice.-Click Actions tab and select View Business Transaction.-Click button Reverse and Repost.-Error is thrown:-'Document Cannot be Reversed and Reposted Because of Tax Item'-Cause-The reason why reposting for Migrated items is not allowed is because some Tax-related Data Migration is not supported. Due to this, when the reposting of an open item happens it may not happen consistently and later you may run into issues.-Resolution-You can only Reverse a migrated Customer Invoice. Reverse and Repost is not allowed.-In case Reverse is also not an option for you, you may consider the below approach:-Go to Receivables work center and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customer Accounts subview.-Choose Customer XYZ (XYZ represents the Account ID), and then select View.-Click View and Monitor > Trade Receivables view and you will see on top New Charge/Credit option.-A New Charge/Credit item may be created in the account where the items have been wrongly posted. This New Charge/Credit item can be cleared with the erroneous items through Clear Manually. You may maintain a Description in the New Charge/Credit item that can indicate what it was created for.-Keywords-Save failed; Document Cannot be Reversed and Reposted Because of Tax Item; Reverse; Customer Invoice;

Title: Supplier Tax ID Column is Blank/Missing in Tax Return
Content: Symptom-I have created a tax return for Israel and noticed that the Withholding Tax ID is missing for a given supplier ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Tax Return view.-Open the respectice tax return run.-Go to Tax Return tab.-See that the Supplier Tax ID column is empty, even though you have maintained a tax ID in the supplier's master data.-Cause-In the supplier master data, the tax number ID is not maintained with type 'Company Legal ID'.  For IL 856 return type, tax ID used is company legal ID-Resolution-You need to maintain the tax number type as Company Legal ID. This can be done as follows:-Open the supplier master data.-Go to Financial Data tab.-Go to Tax Data subtab.-Under Tax Numbers section, maintain the tax number with type 'Company Legal ID'.-Keywords-Israel. Tax Return. Tax Management.

Title: System Exception is Raised When Paying a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are creating a payment for a supplier invoice invoice in the supplier account monitor. However, a system crash happens either upon payment or upon clearing manually the open item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the related supplier account monitor.-Select the desired open item.-Click Pay Manually by and select the relevant payment method.-A system crash occurs.-Cause-The issue happens upon payment because the system recalculates the withholding tax in this invoice and realizes that there is no associated product tax. Each withholding tax item in the invoice should have a corresponding product tax item. If this condition is not fulfilled an inconsistency is raised, triggering a system crash.-This can happen in cases where the invoice was migrated, where, in the migration template, only withholding tax is provided and no product tax (or the number of withholding tax items do not match the number of product tax items). The issue can also happen for invoices created in the system, for which the tax determination happens externally. Upon tax determination, the tax code is derived, but the tax details are not properly updated in the invoice.-If you open the supplier invoice and refer to the Items tab -> Taxes -> Tax Details. You see that, under Taxes section, no records are found. Whereas withholding taxes were correctly determined and created.-Resolution-In such cases, the invoice needs to be reversed and re-created with proper tax details. If the invoice has been migrated, you need to adjust the migration template and re-upload the file with the correct amount of withholding tax lines per product tax line. For not migrated invoices, the document needs to be re-created (Copy button can be used from Supplier Invoicing work center). Before posting the new invoice, make sure that product tax is being correctly derived from the external provider and properly calculated within the Taxes tab.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice. Withholding Tax. Product Tax. Payment. Supplier Account. Migration Tool. Taxes. Sales and Use Tax. CL_FOP_TAXRP_TAX_CALCULATOR.  CL_FOP_TAXRP_TAX_CALCULATOR=>BUILD_TAX_GROUPS

Title: Over-Delivery and Under-Delivery Tolerance fields are not showing for Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-You want to configure the fields 'Over-Delivery Tolerance' and 'Under-Delivery Tolerance' for Purchase Orders.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to New Purchase Order view.-Navigate to Items tab.-Click in Add Row button.-Navigate to Basic Data subtab. -The fields 'Over-Delivery Tolerance' and 'Under-Delivery Tolerance' are not showing here.-Cause-The fields are not configured to be shown for the documents. You can insert them in the Adaptation Mode.-Resolution-Follow the same steps in 'Reproducing the Issue'.-Start the Adaptation Mode.-Select Settings (In the Adaptation window).-Select the fields 'Over-Delivery Tolerance' and 'Under-Delivery Tolerance'.-Save it.-For better understanding, please check the screenshot below:-Keywords-Purchase Orders; Over-Delivery Tolerance; Under-Delivery Tolerance; Adaptation Mode

Title: Missing Legal Approval Step for E-invoicing
Content: Symptom-All invoices are supposed to have legal approval step but invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the Invoice ID) has missed this.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center. -Select the Invoice Documents view. -Select Customer Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the Invoice ID). -The Invoice XYZ is released already, without legal approval process.-Cause-As the Approval status for Customer Invoice XYZ is in 'Approval not Necessary', you would have pressed 'Skip Legal Approval'.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior-Keywords-E-invoicing; Legal Approval; Approve; Skip Legal Approval

Title: Error While Migrating Customers: "Number Range Depleted"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate new customers using the migration tool in business configuration, but the migration of some of the records fails with error message "Number range depleted".-This happens although their IDs meet the external number range, and other records with IDs of the same range don't show the error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration-Go to Overview-Select Migration of Customers activity-Select Migrate Customers using the Migration Tool-Select the related file-Migrate step by step-At Simulation or Import step, find error: "Number range depleted"-Cause-The external number range is relevant for accounts. The issue might be caused by the fact that some of the records are related to contacts, and IDs of contacts are always pulled from the internal number range. This range is exhausted.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration-Go to Overview-Search and open the activity General Business Partners.-Select Define Number Ranges for Business Partners.-Maintain the Internal number range  to be sufficiently large, but without intersecting with the other ranges-See Also- Error While Creating Business Partner: "Number Range Depleted"-Keywords-migrate, Customer, Customers, account, import, migration

Title: Warning "value XYZ column Inventory ID will be truncated; edit source value" Occurs During Fixed Asset Migration
Content: Symptom-You get the warning "value XYZ column Inventory ID will be truncated; edit source value" when you migrate fixed asset. And you notict the inventory ID you input in the migration template is within the field length mentioned in Field List.-In the migration template, it is mentioned the field length of Inventory ID is 60(25).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work centern and Overview view.-Search and open Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Select option:Migration of Accounting Transaction Data using the migration tool.-Select the respective migration file of fixed asset.-Select Fixed Assets-> Process file.-Execute migration step by step, and warning occurs during simulation.-However, in the migration template, it is mentioned the field length of Inventory ID is 60(25), and the Inventory ID in the file is within length of 60 characters.-Cause-The field allows 60 characters in database, but the fixed asset UI screens are limited to 25, so the migration template is limited in the same way. That's why you get the warning that the value you input for Inventory ID will be truncated.-Resolution-It is the UI design of fixed asset. Please keep the characters within 25.-See Also-KBA 2809141 - Documentation for Migration Object: Fixed Assets (extended)-Keywords-Inventory ID, Fixed Asset Migration, Field Length, Truncated

Title: Non Deductible VAT Wrongly Considered in Quarterly VAT Return for Italy
Content: Symptom-You have generated your quarterly VAT return, however the Total tax receivable amount in the tax return differs from total receivable tax amount in Reported VAT / Sales Tax Items report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns view.-Open the reported VAT return.-Go to Tax Returns tab.-Click Export -> To Microsoft Excel.-Open the exported excel file.-Filter the content to show only the 'Receivable' tax.-Sum the Tax Amount of all Receivable entries.-Note down the amount.-Open the report Reported VAT / Sales Tax Items.-Give all the relevant selection parameters to include data from this tax return ID in the report.-Filter by 'Receivable' tax and sum up the total receivable amount.-You noticed that the Total Receivable Amount from the Tax Return differs from the total receivable amount shown in the report for the same Tax Return ID.-Cause-This happens due to non-deductible items being considered in the run. The total tax amount you see in Tax Return tab is always aggregated one.-Resolution-If you want to see the deductible amounts follow the following path.-Open the return in Tax Return Tab.-Navigate to Details.-Go to personalisation mode and check the field Deductible Tax Amount.-This enables the field in the Details screen so that you know whether the tax amount is deductible or non-deductible.-Alternatevely, if there are too much data in the VAT Return and you are unable to check the details for each entry, you can check the same via Reported VAT / Sales Tax Items or Reported VAT / Sales Tax Items reports. Through these reports, you're able to pull the Deductible Tax Amount for the entries.-Keywords-Italy. Tax Return. Tax Management.

Title: Automatic Clearing Between Bank Advice Created via Web Service and Invoice is Not Working
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Bank Credit Advice via web service, using the Invoice ABC as reference, however you noticed that the system is not automatically clearing the items.-ABC means the Invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Customer Accounts subview.-Select the row of Account ID DEF (DEF means the Account ID) and click View.-Under Trade Receivables tab --> Invoices / Payments subtab, select Open Items list.-Notice that the Automatic Clearing did not occur.-Cause-The issue is occurring due one or more of the following root causes:-XML not correctly formatted.-Clearing Strategy configuration not correctly maintained.-Invoice isn't correctly referenced in the Bank Advice.-You are using the Business Partner as reference instead of using the Invoice.-Resolution-First of all, you need to check if your XML is well formatted accordingly with the instructions in the Help Document Inbound Service ManageBankAdviceIn. You can use the example given in the Help Document. Also, you need to make sure that the XML has the invoice, which you are trying to clear with the Bank Advice as reference.-I.e. <PaymentTransactionDestinatedInvoiceReference>- <ID>AB</ID>- </PaymentTransactionDestinatedInvoiceReference>-If you are using the Business Partner as reference, system will try to search in the Open Items of this Business Partner for an Open Item based on amount, with range of +- 5% of the Payment amount. In case there is a single Open Item found, them it will select that invoice, and in case of multiple it will not pick any Open Item.-If your XML is well formatted, or after correct your XML, you need to check if the clearing strategy is correctly configured in the system.-Also, under the Clearing Strategy you can flag the function "Allow Automatic clearing if No or Incorrect ref Number" if items not found using reference numbers are to be cleared automatically. This configuration means that in case of an unique found based only on amount then post the Allocation automatically or not. This configuration specifies that if no item can be found using a reference number, the system tries to identify an item using amounts specified in the memo line. If no amounts are specified in the memo line and the payment can be cleared with only one item, the payment amount is to be used for the search.-See Also-Help Documents:-Inbound Service ManageBankAdviceIn-Configuration: Clearing Strategies-2490272 - Automatic Clearing of Bank Advices via Web Service and Open Invoices-Keywords-ManageBankAdviceIn, Web-Service, Bank Credit Advice, XML, Customer Account, Receivables, Invoice, Business Partner, Automatic Clearing, Clearing Strategies.

Title: Error Message in Payment Allocation: 'Date YYY not in range of 100 years before today or 100 years after today'
Content: Symptom-When assigning a customer or supplier account to Customer/Supplier tab of a payment allocation, an error message is raised with reference to an invalid date (e.g. year in the date is 0202 instead of 2020)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Open the respective payment allocation.-In the Customer/Supplier tab, add the business partner ID.-In the Open Items table below, you notice that the dates related to the payment line are with the wrong year. For example: 01.02.0202 instead of 01.02.2020-If you try to allocate the amount and save the payment allocation, the following error is raised: 'Date 01.02.0202 not in range of 100 years before today or 100 years after today'.-Cause-This date is derived from the Bank Posting Date for the related bank statement item. To check the date, follow below steps:-From this payment allocation, note the bank statement ID and line item ID.-Open the respective bank statement in view all mode.-Go to Transactions tab.-Select the relevant line item ID.-In the Transaction Data subtab, refer to the Bank Posting Date being 01.02.0202.-If this bank statement was manually created, this date could have been wrongly maintained by the user in the Item Details in the third step of the bank statement creation. If the bank statement was automatically generated, check if the date is also wrongly maintained in the source inbound file.-Resolution-To fix this date and error, you need to reverse the bank statement and re-create it with the proper dates. You can also reverse only the related bank statement item by marking the payment allocation as a return.-For more details, please refer to the help document "Quick Guide for Payment Allocation" and section Reverse a Payment.-Keywords-Payment Allocation. Bank Statement. Bank Posting Date.

Title: Error Tax Exemption Certificate is not Usable when try to Release the Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you try to release the Invoice , you will get the error "Tax Exemption Certificate is not Usable" and "Save Failed"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents View.-Search for the Customer Invoice ABC (ABC is the ID Customer Invoice which you have created and used the Tax Exemption Certificate).-Edit the Customer Invoice ABC.-You can see that the Free Text line item Total is 50k EUR.-When you try to release the Invoice, you will get the error "Tax Exemption Certificate is not Usable" and "Save Failed".-As a result the Invoice is not released.-Cause-You are using free text line item in the Customer invoice.-We do not support Tax exemption certificates for free text line items.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Certificate is not Usable; Tax Exemption; Certificate;

Title: Missing Uploaded Attachment in Bank Transfer and Payment Orders
Content: Symptom-You are paying an open item manually via 'Other Payment Method' and adding an attachment to the payment. However, when executing the payment, the resulting payment order has no attachment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the respective customer account monitor.-Select an open item to be paid.-Click Pay Manually By -> Other Payment Method.-In the screen that opens, fill in the required data.-Go to the Attachments tab and upload the desired attachment.-Click to Execute this payment.-Once payment is executed, open the resulting payment order and/or e.g. Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Go to the Attachments tab.-You see that the uploaded attachment in step 7 is not available in this Bank Transfer. -Cause-This is actually the expected behavior, since the business objects in backend are different. When you create the manual payment via Payment Manually By -> Other Payment Methods and attach a file in the Payment screen that opens, you are creating and attaching a file to the DuePayment business object. Once the payment is executed, the system triggers the creation of the subsequent business objects for payments (PaymentOrder, Payment Register and e.g. BankPaymentOrder).-Since these are different business objects, the attachment folder is not copied over.-Resolution-If you create the payment via Pay Manually By -> Outgoing Bank Transfer and attach the file in the screen that opens, then you are creating the PaymentOrder and directly attaching the file to it.-Therefore, if you wish to see the attachment in the Outgoing Bank Transfer screen, please create the payment via Pay Manually By -> Outgoing Bank Transfer and attach the file to this business object. If you create and attach via Payment Manually By -> Other Payment Methods, the file remains only attached to the DuePayment object (accessible via Automatic Payments view).-Keywords-Attachments. Due Payment. Payment Order.

Title: Change Collector Is Having a Time Delay
Content: Symptom-When creating a Change Collector Execution for Supplier changes and selecting a date. For example: From 1st July 2022 until 30th September 2022, the execution should run at exactly midnight (12 am), however, the execution has a time delay.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Change Collector View.-Create a new execution and set the date.-Observe the time difference in the execution ID.-Cause-Change collector converts the input time to UTC, and this is the time considered for the start of the job.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-To clarify it with an example:- User inputs time as 01/07/2022 00:00 CEST.- Change Collector converts the same to UTC as 30/06/2022 22:00 (CEST 2 hours ahead of UTC).- It collects changes from 30/06/2022 00:00 (Start of the day).- When showing on UI, UTC is converted to CEST: 30/06/2022 00:00 CET -> 30/06/2022 02:00 CEST.- If the logon user time zone is UTC, it will be displayed only as 30/06/2022 00:00 CET. -There are tooltips explanation given on the Change Collector screen.-Keywords-Change Collector, Delay, Timezone

Title: PSM Release: Account Type of G/L Account
Content: Symptom-You want to have a read access to the Account Type of a specofoc G/L Account in the Chart of Accounts. You wonder what is the BO Path via Studio and if it is PSM released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-You can read the G/L Account Type via Cloud Application Studio with the following BO Path: ChartOfAccounts root -> Item node -> element is GeneralLedgerAccountTypeCode-The element is PSM enabled for read-only.-The queries are also PSM released.-Keywords-Public Solution Modeling. PDI. Add-on. Cloud Application Studio.

Title: Business User Shows Different Validity in the User List
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When searching for a business user in the business users list, you see that the validity appears as "01.01.0001/01.01.0001" instead of the correct validity that appears in the user attribute screen.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Administrator -> Business Users.-Search for a specific business user and select it.-Scroll down to check the Overview panel on the bottom of the screen.-Here you can see the incorrect validity being shown.-Cause-The issue happens because this is a new user, which was just created from an employee hiring process.-Resolution-In order to refresh the data that appears in the user list, perform a save in the user attributes page following the below steps:-Go to the work center Administrator -> Business Users.-Search for a specific business user and select it.-Click on Edit -> Attributes.-Click on Save and Close.-Now after reloading the page in the browser, the correct validity should appear in the user list.-Keywords-Valid From, Valid To, Unlimited

Title: Journal Entry Created From Payment Allocation Has No Lines For Tax Amount
Content: Symptom-You have a Journal Entry created with Source Document Type '81 - Payment Allocation'. You noticed that this Journal Entry does not have any lines for tax amounts and you expected it to have tax amounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Search for Journal Entry XYZ. (XYZ = Journal Entry ID)-Select the Journal Entry.-See that there is no posting line for tax value.-Cause-If you check the Source Document (in this case, the Payment Allocation), and go to the tab 'Allocation to G/L Account', you have two lines: One line in Debit, and one line in Credit. Both lines have the same Tax Amount.-There is no tax value in the Journal Entry XYZ because, in the Allocation to G/L Account, the sum of both Tax Amounts result in zero.-You can also see in the table Tax Totals, at the bottom of the page, that the Amount is zero, hence no tax amount will appear in the Journal Entry XYZ.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Tax Amount, Journal Entry, Payment Allocation, no tax line

Title: Payment Allocation Run Aborted (MDRO FOPXP_PAYALR aborted)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-There is Backend Dump and the Payment Allocation run was aborted. This issue will be generally reported via Health Check incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The Payment Allocation Run is executed in the backend whenever the Bank Statement is posted in the system. Customer will not see this issue in the UI, instead it will be reported via Health check Incident.-Cause-The Payment Allocation run was aborted but all the related allocations were posted. We can verify that there is no inconsistency in the system and close the incident accordingly.-Resolution-You need to follow the below mentioned steps to make sure that all the Payment Allocations are posted and there is no inconsistency in the System.-Login to Backend.-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO FOPXP_PAYALR -> Load By Node ID -> Root.-              4. Provide the UUID of the Run (this ID can be retrieved from the the message in SAP Incight for example: MDRO: FOPXP_PAYALR (921,00163E06F50A1ED4838BC95AE55F30F2)).-    5. Navigate to SEL_BY_PAL.-     6. You will see multiple records here for all the Payment Allocations Created by the Run.-     7. Copy all UUIDs in LOWB_PAL_UUID-CONTENT (LowerBoundaryPaymentAllocationUUID/content).-      8. Go to BO FOPXP_PAYAL in SESFTS -> Load by Node ID -> FOPXP_PAYALHD.-      9. Paste all the UUIDs got from step 7.-         10. Check the field STATUS-PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_LIFECYCLE_S (Status/LifeCycleStatusCode). If all the allocations are in status 2 = Posted, then there is no inconsistency in the customer system.-You could also go to ST22 transaction and check for any dump for the referred user and date. If there is no dump, then close the Incident.-Keywords-payment allocation run; MDRO FOPXP_PAYALR

Title: Service Performer is not Determined in a Service Quote
Content: Symptom-You cannot determine the Service Performer on Service Quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select New Service Quote under common task.-Enter the account ABC (ABC represents the identification number of the account).-Enter all relevant data.-Add service XYZ (XYZ represents the identification number of the service).-No service performer is found automatically, or the system proposes a service performer which is not expected.-Cause-Service Performer will not appear on Service Quote automatically, This is a known issue by SAP and this will be addressed in future release.-Resolution-As Workaround, It's necessary to have role Service Performer - Sales in Account Master Data.-The account dependent employee responsibilities are maintained directly in the account master data in the Account Management work center, in the Contacts tab, Relationships and Responsibilities sub tab under the Responsibilities section.-Relevant party roles are 'Service Performer - Sales'.-Service Performer-Evaluate account responsibilities (set in the Account Management work center) with party role 'Service Performer - Sales'-Evaluate responsibility 'Resp. to Determine Service Performer - Sales'-This will allow determination for the Service quote.-Keywords- Service quote; service performer;

Title: Shopping Cart not Cancelled Even Though the Purchase Request is Cancelled
Content: Symptom-Canceled Purchase Request did not change the Shopping Cart status-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Filter for All Purchase Requests.-Search for the relevant Purchase Request.-See that the Cancellation Status is Canceled but the Shopping Cart status is Released.-Cause-You have a Purchase Order with the status Ordered in the Document Flow of this Shopping Cart.-Resolution-There can be different scenarios:-First scenario:-You have a Document Flow with the Shopping Cart and the Purchase Request-In this case if you cancel the Purchase Request it will automatically cancel the Shopping Cart-Second scenario:-You have a Document Flow with Shopping Cart, Purchase Request and Purchase Order-In this case you there are two options:-1- Cancel the Purchase Request-This will cause a confusion, because only the Purchase Request will be canceled, since the Purchase Order comes after this document it will not be affected, also the Purchase Order will prevent the Shopping Cart of being canceled. Since the Purchase Order wasn't canceled you can proceed with the scenario, by creating a Goods and Service Receipt and a Supplier Invoice.-2- Cancel the Purchase Order-In this case, you can also cancel the Purchase Request, but since this document was canceled after the Purchase Order this will automatically cancel the Shopping Cart.-Overall, to automatically cancel the Shopping Cart you need to cancel all documents created after the Purchase Request, from the newest to the oldest until you reach the Purchase Request, following the Document Flow backwards.-Keywords-Shopping Cart. Purchase Order. Purchase Request.

Title: Unable to Edit the Notes in Project Stock Order
Content: Symptom-You cannot edit the Notes in the Project Stock Order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Project Stock Orders view.-Search for the Project ID.-Click in Edit button.-Select the item ID.-Navigate to Notes tab.-You cannot edit it because the field is grayed out.-Cause-You can only edit the Notes field when the Project Stock Order has status 'In Preparation'.-Resolution-Maintain the information in the Notes tab while it is still in In Preparation status.-Keywords-Project Stock Order, Notes, Projects

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement For General Ledger Accounts Option Missing
Content: Symptom-You want to use the new functionality in ByDesign FP2205 Foreign Currency Remeasurement for G/L Accounts. -However under the General Ledger Work Center this is not available.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-There is no option for Foreign Currency Remeasurement for G/L Accounts.-Cause-You need to add the option in scoping first.-Resolution- Go to the Business Configuration Work Center - Implementation Projects view.-Highlight First Implementation and click on Edit Project Scope.-Press Next until you get to Tab 4-Questions.-Expand Scoping Element Financial and Management Accounting.-Expand General Ledger.-Click on General Ledger.-Activate the scoping question "Do you remeasure foreign currency balances for general ledger accounts of type Other Assets / Other Liabilities?"-Press Next and confirm the scoping.-This makes the functionality "Foreign Currency Remeasurement for G/L Accounts" in Work Center General Ledger available for you.-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement, g/l account, Foreign Currency Remeasurement for General Ledger Accounts

Title: Tax Code Field is not Available in ERM for Non-Localized Countries
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find the Tax Code field while creating an Expense Report for Non-Localized Countries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Click New -> Expense Report on Behalf.-Choose an employee and navigate to the Next Step.-Under Expenses Tab click on Add row.-Select a Expense and enter required details.-Go to Expense Data tab.-You can see that Tax Code field is not available.-Cause-The reason is that there are no tax procedures are available in Expense Reimbursement for Non-Localized Countries.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can activate the Tax Calculation for Generic Country Version by following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Show All Current Projects.-Choose the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune chevron and find activity Tax Activation- Generic Country Version.-Choose Open and go to Define and edit tax code groups.-Click on Add Row tab and enter Country Version and Tax Code Groups.-Choose Save button.-Click on Edit expense types.-Maintain all required details for the respective Country Version.-Choose Save button.-Click on Activate tax calculation.-Select the Generic Country Version, enter the Tax Calculation Start Date and Choose Activate Tax Calculation.-Choose Save button.

Title: Payment Allocation Error 'No tax return arrangement specified for company ABC and tax authority XYZ'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to allocate a payment on the bank account to a tax authority so it can be allocated to the relevant tax return. However, you are receiving an error which says 'No tax return arrangement specified for company ABC and tax authority XYZ'.-ABC (ABC represents the company name).-XYZ (XYZ represents the tax authority ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center. -Go to Payment Allocation view. -Select All Payment Allocations. -Search for Payment Allocation DEF (DEF represents the Payment Allocation ID).-You will see the error message 'No tax return arrangement specified for company ABC and tax authority XYZ'.-Cause-One possible cause is that the Payment Relevant checkbox is not ticked on the Tax Return Arrangement in Tax Authority.-Resolution-You may create a new Tax Return Arrangement entry with the 'Payment Relevant' indicator ticked and/or change validity of current Tax Return Arrangement entry and put in another entry.-Go to Tax Management work center. -Go to Tax Authorities subview. -Search for the Tax Authority XYZ. -Click View All.-Go to Company Tax Arrangements tab > Tax Return Arrangements tab.-Click the Add Row button to add a new Tax Return Arrangement or configure the already existing one properly with the Payment Relevant checkbox ticked. -See Also-Tax Reporting Group-Tax Payments Quick Guide-Keywords-Payment allocation error; Payment allocation; No tax return arrangement specified for company and tax authority; Tax Authority; Payment Relevant;

Title: Error Occurs While Creating Service Levels: "Enter type of service, duration, or priority"
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs when creating a Service Level: Enter type of service, duration, or priority-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the the Service Level view.-Select the New Service Level.-Go to the Reaction Times tab and maintain a Milestone e.g. Milestone Due Date for Initial Response.-In the Details for Milestone click on Add Row.-Enter a Type of Service e.g.  Service Order - Initial Response, a Priority e.g. Immediate and a Net Labor Time e.g. 1 Hour(s).-Click on the Save button.-The following error occurs:-Save Failed.-Enter type of service, duration, or priority.-Cause-You only maintained one Priority for the Type of Service.-You must add a separate row for each priority and for each type of service which you select. For example if you have one types of service and four priorities, you should create a total of 4 rows.-Resolution-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the Service Level view.-Select New Service Level.-Go to the Reaction Times tab and maintain a Milestone e.g. Milestone Due Date for Initial Response.-Enter a Type of Service e.g.  Service Order - Initial Response, a Priority e.g. Immediate and a Net Labor Time e.g. 1 Hour(s).-Repeat this for all priorities Immediate, Urgent, Normal and Low.-Click on the Save button.-The Service Level will be saved successfully.-Keywords-Service Level; Error; CL_A1SCRM_SLO_MSG; 22

Title: Error 'Upload failed' Trying to Upload a Catalog Using a CSV File
Content: Symptom-Error 'Upload failed' when trying to upload a catalog using a CSV file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Catalogs view.-Click New button and select Supplier Catalog.-Enter the mandatory information.-Click Browse button.-Insert the file in TXT.-Click Import button. After some time see that the Import Status is Failed.-Click View Import Log.-See in the Description the message 'Upload failed'.-Cause-The file format being used is not correct.-Resolution-Do the import using the following steps:-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Choose Catalogs view.-Click Open catalog template file.-Type all necessary details.-Avoid pasting data in the first row, this can break the template.-Click Autofill ID.-Click Generate.-Click Save and Save it on your Desktop.-After saving, navigate to the file and open it, so you will be able to visualize the csv format with the data separated by semicolons.-Again go to Product Portfolio work center.-Choose Catalogs view.-Click button New.-Choose Supplier Catalog.-Enter catalog name and Supplier ID.-Click Browse and Choose same file that you saved earlier.-Click Import.-Keywords-Catalog. CSV file. Product Portfolio.

Title: Dunning Run Does Not Create Dunning Proposals With The Next Dunning Level
Content: Symptom-You created a dunning proposal for customer invoice ABC with dunning level 1.-After executing the dunning run next time you expect that a dunning proposal with dunning level 2 will be created for customer invoice ABC, but the customer invoice is still on dunning level 1 and no new dunning proposal has been created.-ABC means the customer invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Show Dunning Proposals in Status In Preparation.-There is no Dunning Proposal with Dunning Level 2 in Status In Preparation for Customer Invoice ABC.-Cause-The system behavior is in accordance with the dunning levels which have been maintained in Business Configuration work center, as follows:-Open the Business Configuration work center.-Search and open the activity Dunning Strategies and click Edit dunning strategies.-Select the respective Dunning Strategy.-Navigate to the tab Assigned Business Transactions to Be Dunned.-In the column Dunning Interval (In days) you can see the number of days which have been maintained between Dunning Levels.-Resolution-A dunning proposal with dunning level 2 will be created when you execute a dunning run after the number of days which have been maintained between dunning level 1 and dunning level 2.-Alternatively you can change the dunning intervals to create shorter dunning periods.-Keywords-dunning strategy; dunning levels; dunning step; dunning interval

Title: User is Unable to Approve Supplier Invoice Due Warning Message Triggering
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoice needs to be approved however when you try to approve it you face an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC is the ID of the Supplier Invoice).-Click in Edit button.-Click in the Header Message: 'Approve Supplier Invoice ABC'.-Click in Approve button.-You get the error messages:-RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn WRITE' on instance 'XXX' of 'BONodeProxy /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV ROOT' in context 'UIApplication /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/srm/siv/ivqafapproval.QA.uicomponent Operation Start'-RBAM: Skip operation 'BuiltIn WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV ROOT'-Cause-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for user XYZ (XYZ is the user that is trying to approve the Supplier Invoice).-Click in Edit button and select Access Rights.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-Select SRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS.-In Detailed Restrictions subtab, you can see that the user does not have Write Access for the Supplier Invoice's company.-Since the user does not have Write Access, they are unable to approve Supplier Invoices related to the specific company.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for user XYZ.-Click in Edit button and select Access Rights.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-Select SRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS.-In Detailed Restrictions subtab, click in the checkbox for Write Access for the Supplier Invoice's company.-After that, the user is able to approve the Supplier Invoice.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Approval, RBAM

Title: How To Reverse the Acquisition Posting of a Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-How to reverse the Acquisition posting of Fixed Asset XYZ created manually. (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In order to reverse the Acquisition posting of Fixed Asset XYZ, follow the steps below:-Navigate to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Go to the Fixed Assets subview.-Search with the Fixed Asset ID XYZ.-Click Edit.-Select Values.-Open the Journal tab.-Find the manual Acquisition posting to reverse.-Open the relevant Journal Entry Voucher hyperlink.-Click Edit button. -Click the Reverse button.-Click Ok.-If all conditions are satisfied for a consistent reversal, a reversal Journal Entry Voucher is posted. -Keywords-Fixed Assets, Acquisition, Posting, Reversal, Cancel.

Title: Unable to Submit Expense Report : G/L Account information missing/Settlement results cannot be calculated. Assign a valid cost assignment
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Expense Report. When attempting to finish it, the system raises an error message "G/L Account information missing/Settlement results cannot be calculated. Assign a valid cost assignment."-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Under Common Tasks select New Expense Report on Behalf.-Select an employee.-Fill the required expense items and other details.-Press Finish. -The error message "G/L Account information missing. Settlement results cannot be calculated. Assign a valid cost assignment" appears. -Cause-In the Expense Line Items tab a deviating cost assignment has been mainained without an account assignment type.-Resolution-Re-submit the expense report and when updating the Deviating Cost Assignments-If the cost is split, then make sure the total percentage must be equal to 100 %.-Maintain an Account Assignment Type ﻿for all expense items. -Keywords-G/L account information missing, expense report

Title: Supplier from Material's Master Data is not Showing in Purchase Request's Available Sources of Supply
Content: Symptom-The Supplier is maintained in the Material's Master Data. So you expect that this Supplier is shown in the Available Source of Supply for Purchase Requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Search for the Purchase Request ABC (ABC is the ID of the Purchase Request).-Click in Assign Source of Supply button.-In 'Available Sources of Supply for ABC' section, it doesn't show any supplier.-Cause-The Suppliers shown in the 'Available Sources of Supply' are not taken from the Material's Master Data.-They are taken from arrangements (such as contracts for example) and from references (information from documents created before). However if the document is older than 1 year, the Supplier won't be returned when assigning the Source of Supply.-Resolution-System standard behavior.-See Also-Help Portal: Source Determination-Keywords- Sources of Supply, Contract, Supplier, Purchase Request

Title: Extension Field Data Does Not Pass From Customer Invoice to Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You have an extension field in the Customer Invoice, and although you have checked the extension scenarios, the field in the Journal Entry is not correctly passed.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search and open ABC (ABC refers to the Customer Invoice ID).-See extension field with data "XYZ" (XYZ means the data that is filled in the extension field).-Go to Document Flow tab.-Open respective Journal Entry.-See extension field is empty.-You expected the "XYZ" to appear also in the Journal Entry.-Cause-When creating extension fields through the key user settings, the field has further usage scenarios that can be defined, and within this is extension scenarios. There is no extension scenario that takes fields from Customer Invoice to Journal Entry. The only extension scenario related to Financials takes the field and fills in in the TRP register item - so you can see the extension field filled if you view the line item details of the Customer Invoice through the Customer Account monitor, as that is where that extension scenario takes it.-Resolution-As a workaround you can see the extension field in the Customer Account monitor, in the Receivables work center. System is working as designed.-Keywords-Extension field, Journal Entry, Customer Invoice, data, extension scenario

Title: Material Cost Estimate Rollup Run Ends up in Application Runtime Exception
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -The customer has executed a Material Cost Estimate Rollup run and noticed a runtime exception message in the logs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Material Cost Estimate Rollup view.-Find the related run and open its execution.-Go to Messages tab. -Error: During run for company <company ID and name>, set of books <ID>, the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred-Cause-In backend transaction ST22 you noticed that there is a system crash being raised from CL_FIA_MCE_QS_CONTROLLER=>DO_DET_TRANS_QTY_STRUC_W_REF  at line 202 (before the FATAL EXCEPTION calls). In the application Info, the following is presented:-Triggering application component: AP-COS-MCE-CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:CL_FIA_MCE_DETERM_SERVICE=====CP, Include:CL_FIA_MCE_DETERM_SERVICE=====CM006, Position:1-Info: An exception with the type CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB, Program:CL_FIA_MCE_DETERM_SERVICE=====CP, Include:CL_FIA_MCE_DETERM_SERVICE=====CM006, Position:43-Info: The range of the statement to be passed to the database is too wide-The issue happens because the selection parameters within this run are too wide, hence returning an excessive number of records, which the run cannot support during processing.-Resolution-Therefore, the user would need to create a new Material Cost Estimate Rollup Run and narrow down the selection by Material, Product Category and/or Business Residence Parameters.-Keywords- Material Cost Estimate. Inventory Valuation. Memory. System Crash. Dump. rollup run

Title: Plan Data Upload via Excel Returns '1 Record(s) saved successfully to SAP Business ByDesign' but no new Plan Version is Created
Content: Symptom-You are importing a new plan version from Excel. The add-in returns a successful message, however you cannot find the new plan version in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the respective template for Plan data Upload (it can be downloaded via Cost and Revenue -> Planning -> New).-In the excel file, fill in the plan data accordingly.-Login to the tenant via the Excel add-in-Click Save Data To. -You'll see that Excel returns "1 Record(s) saved successfully to SAP Business ByDesign".-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Planning view.-You see no new plan versions.-Cause-An error message is being raised, but not returned by the Excel add-in due to an outdated version.-Resolution-You need to update your Excel add-in to the most recent version, as follows:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Download Center.-Select to download the Excel add-in.-After installing the most recent version, you can try to upload the data again and check what errors are preventing the new Plan creation.-Keywords-Planning. Cost and Revenue. Plan Data. Excel Add-in. Save Data To

Title: Site Field is Blank for Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-Purchase Request's Site field is not filled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Search for the ID of the Purchase Request.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Delivery subtab.-See that 'Site' is not filled-Cause-The Purchase Request was created via Bundling Run after a Sales Order as a third-party scenario. If you open the Sales Order related to this Purchase Request, you can check which is the Company of the document. Keep a note of the Company's ID.-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Click in Find button.-Search for the Company's ID.-Click in Locate.-You can see that this Company has more than one Business Residence.-If you navigate to Definitions tab for each Org Unit, you'll see that they have different associated Sites. For example, Org Unit A has associated site B, and Org Unit C has associated site D.-Resolution-If a company has more than one subordinate Business Residence, the system is unable to determine the Site in the Purchase Request. Instead of defaulting to an erroneous Site, the system will not default any.-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Site; Company; Purchase Request; Sales Order

Title: Leading Zeroes Are Truncated in the Material ID
Content: Symptom-You notice that when you create a material with an ID that has leading zeroes followed by numeric values, the leading zeros are truncated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select New Material under Common Tasks.-Enter a material ID with leading zeroes (for example, 000123).-Upon saving, the ID is saved only as 123 instead of 000123-Cause-If the material ID have alpha-conversion enabled, then the below mentioned behavior is the same for all alpha-conversion identifiers.-If you enter the material ID with leading zeroes followed by numeric values, the zeroes will be truncated.
