Content: Symptom-A country is not appearing in Preview of the Output Form in Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Filter for All Purchase Orders.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID).-Go to Output History tab.-Select the Output PDF.-In the Output Form you see no country details appearing under supplier address.-Cause-System behavior.-Resolution-When the ship-to and the recipient address are from the same country, the system will not show this information.-System will show the country in case of imports, so it will be able to calculate the specifics taxes, otherwise it will not show the country.-Keywords-Purchase Order. Output History. Country.

Title: No Results Shown For a Specific Invoice in VAT Reports
Content: Symptom-The report Open VAT / Sales Tax Items (Report ID FINTAXU09_Q003) is expected to show data related to a specific Customer Invoice. However, the report does not return any results and shows the message "No report data available to display; check the selection".-This scenario may also apply to the report All VAT / Sales Tax Items (Report ID FINTAXU09_Q003).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search and open the report Open VAT / Sales Tax Items. -Use the relevant selection criteria to search (e.g. Company, Tax Due Date, Tax Country/Region, Tax Event...).-Click on Apply button.-The following message is displayed: No report data available to display; check the selection-Cause-The invoice expected to be displayed in the report contains deferred tax line items.-Deferred tax becomes liable only when payment for the invoice is made. At that point, the tax amount moves from the deferred tax account to the actual tax account.-Since the invoice contains deferred tax line items, the tax due date remains empty for the invoice. Therefore, the invoice is not displayed in the report.-Resolution-Once payment is made for the invoice, the payment document will be shown in the report.-Keywords-VAT, report, No report data available, Sales Tax, invoice

Title: How to Create a RBAM Trace - Easy Steps
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-This document informs about the steps to trace user actions in the UI. An RBAM trace may be needed to analyze an authorization issue - for example if according to Access Restriction settings, a user is not permitted to perform an action, but can perform it nevertheless. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In the UI, log in with the affected user-Go to the view of the respective action-In the backend, go to transaction SRBAM-Select the link RBAM Explain-Select All Operations button * -Note: A new popup window will open-In the new window, maintain the (technical) User ID of the affected user in the Alias and Name field-In the new window, select the Continue Activation button-Note: The popup window will close-In the UI, perform the respective action-Select Save, in case this is part of the action to be analyzed-Directly afterwards go to the backend again-You will find a new line for this trace with the Activate (Spark Plug) symbol in the Status column - Task is Active and Running-To stop the trace, mark the line of this record and select the little flag symbol - (to Stop/Finish selected Tasks)-The flag appears in the Status column and the trace is finished-To see the information included, click on the entry in the Data column- Note:-While performing the actual trace (between Continue Activation and Stop/Finish) only perform the relevant action in the UI, so that no unnecessary info/data is included in the trace. -Always finish the trace in time, otherwise a health check may be created.-* the Operations button is not visible if the window size is too small. You may need to use full screen size to see it. Not to be confused with the menu item of the same name.-Keywords-perform, srbam

Title: Incurred Costs on Customer Sales Project Realized on the Wrong Service
Content: Symptom-You have created a customer project with sales integration and service AAA as sales order item. You have also manually added service BBB to the project and this service is not related to any sales order. When employees record time against the project task and the service BBB, the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report shows the corresponding costs incurred to service AAA instead.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure.-Run the report with proper selection parameters.-Bring the Product characteristic to the rows.-Refer to the project task to which employee has recorded time.-You see that the resulting internal service confirmation amount is shown for the selected project task and service AAA. However, the original employee time calendar is done against service BBB.-Cause-The service AAA is being derived from the sales order being assigned to the employee time calendar posting. You can refer to journal entry of the related employee calendar and check that there is a sales order assigned to the posting, from which the system determines service AAA.-Alternatively, it can happen that the employee time calendar is posted without determined a sales order in the journal entry. If the employee time calendar journal entry has no sales order assigned, then the costs are incurred in the selected product (service BBB) in the source expense. However, once a sales order is assigned to that expense, the system incurs the expense to the product of the respective sales order item via Customer Project Expense List posting, since during the expense realization the specifications of the Sales Order Items, such as the associated Project Task, Product or the Profit Center take priority over the assignment settings of the original, incurred expense.-Resolution-Therefore, when the expense does not have a sales order assigned yet, it gets incurred in the source service. However, when a sale order gets assigned (either via automatic rules or via customer project expense list posting) the product is derived from the sales order.-Note that the sales order assignment to an expense is a required step in such scenario. For more details, please refer to below help documents:-Edit Assignment Rules for Linking Project Tasks to Sales Order Items-Customer Projects-You can also refer to below KBA, which describes a similar scenario where the costs are incurred in a different project task.-2611112 - Incurred Costs on Customer Sales Project Realized on the Wrong Project Task-Keywords-Project Management. Not Invoiced Time and Expenses. Cost and Revenue. Internal Service Confirmation. Planned Cost. Incurred Cost. Services.

Title: No Journal Entry for Quarterly VAT Return for Italy
Content: Symptom-You have a Reported Quarterly VAT Return for Italy and noticed that there is no Journal Entry for this VAT Return. You wonder if this is the correct behavior or not.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to  VAT Returns view.-Find the related Quarterly VAT Return for Italy.-See that there is no journal entry for this tax return.-Resolution-It is the designed system behavior that the Quarterly VAT Return for Italy does not generate journal entries. Only a file gets created on releasing the tax return.-In help document Quarterly VAT Return — Italy  it also does not mention any posting/clearings to be done by this run. It only mentions that then run should be setup to generate an output file.-Keywords-Italy. VAT Return. Tax Management.

Title: Unable to filter Services in New Goods and Services Receipt Run
Content: Symptom-You are trying to filter a New Goods and Services Receipt Run with a Service ABC (ABC being the Service ID), but you cannot find any result.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select work center Goods and Services Receipts.-Select view "Goods and Services Receipts Run".-Click "New".-Select the tab Product.-Maintain "Including" in "Inclusing/Exclusion" field.-Search your service ABC under Product field: no result can be found.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-You can filter the goods and services receipts considered for the run based on:-Supplier-Company-Product-Product Category-However, filtering via Services is currently not possible.-Resolution-Should you need any new enhancement added to the software, feel free to directly submit a request for this feature to the correct decision makers at SAP via Customer Influence.-The Customer Influence site, https://influence.sap.com, allows customers to log Improvement Requests themselves and have the ability to work directly with our technology and development group.-See Also-Goods and Services Receipts Run Quick Guide-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2ddab085722d1014b1838a51560187a7.html?version=2202-Keywords- Goods and Services Receipt Run, Services

Title: Error 'Data import aborted' in Mass Data Maintenance For Import Customers
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When updating customers via Import Customers in Mass Data Maintenance work center, error message "Data import aborted" is displayed upon Execute Data Import, even when the validation file is successful ("Data validation finished successfully: No Invalid data found").-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance view.-Under Update Data from Local File, select the link in option Import Customers: Data Migration - Update Customers opens.-Click Execute Data Import.-After successful validation of the imported file, error message "Data import aborted" is displayed.-Cause-This could be caused by technical inconsistencies in the backend system, where it is necessary to refresh the Migration Objects.-Resolution-Access the backend system of customer's tenant and access the transaction code DMC_INC_CORR.-Select the Object SAP_A1S and Sub Project SAP_A1S01.-Check all the Migration Objects that is related to Customers (they begin with CUSTOMER*), using the option Check Object Consistency.-If for any Migration Object the message "Runtime object invalid; generate runtime object" is displayed, for this Migration Object, select the option Generate Run Time Object and check if it was executed successfully.-If for all Migration Objects that begins with CUSTOMER* are consistent, check if the error still persists.-If for some Migration Object an error occurs when trying to execute Generate Run Time Object (in this case, for Migration Object CUSTOMER_UPD001 error message appears:-"Error while generating runtime objects for CUSTOMER_UPD001-Conversion Object CUSTOMER_UPD001: structure PERSON_SCR_DEP_0380 doesn't include any fields")-Then try the following steps:-Execute option Cleanup Report.-Execute option Generate Conversion Rules, for which message "Rule not found; inconsistent data" might be displayed-Execute option No Semantic Descriptor exist.-Execute option Generate Conversion Rules.-And, at last, execute option Check Object Consistency to check if the Migration Object is now consistent.-Keywords-Data import aborted, Mass Data Maintenance, Data Migration, Import Customers, Update Customers, Data Import

Title: Cost Center in Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Foreign Currency Remeasurement run (for Payables, Receivables or Cash) and noticed that the system only shows Profit Center and/or Segment for Journal Entries. You would like to also see the corresponding Cost Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center. (or Receivables or Payment Management)-Go to Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Open the log of any run.-Go to Postings tab.-In the 'Accounts' or in the 'Journal Entries' subtab, you see that the system displays columns/fields for Profit Center and Segment, but not for Cost Center.-Cause-The foreign currency remeasurement run remeasures balances of balance sheet accounts, which usually cannot have cost center assigned. For example, the foreign currency remeasurement run for Payables/Receivables/Cash remeasures the balances of the Payables/Receivables/Cash G/L Accounts, which would have account type as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable or Cash.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior, since cost centers can only be assigned to G/L Accounts for cost and expenses.-See Also-For more details about G/L Account types, you can refer to help document Account Type

Title: Understanding Scheduling and Activation of Custom Adjustments for Time Accounts
Content: Symptom-This knowledge base article intends to explain the activation process of custom adjustments for time accounts, when they are executed and how to activate them immediately.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-What triggers the change to a custom adjustment (be it its activation or its deletion) is the "Save and Schedule for Activation" button.-Once the button has been clicked and the custom adjustment is already visible in the Customer Adjustments for Time Accounts screen, it is then possible to click the "View Activation Log" button. In the Activation Log screen, it is then possible to click the "Schedule Adjustments" button...-...which then allows to change the schedule to Start Immediately.-In case no changes to the schedule is done, the activation (or deletion) job is automatically scheduled two run 2 minutes after clicking the "Save and Schedule for Activation" button.-Keywords-Custom Adjustments, Time Account, Activation, Deletion, Schedule, Start Immediately

Title: How the Synchronization of Cost Assignments Between Expense Arrangement and Personnel Administration Works
Content: Symptom-You have transferred an employee to a new organizational assignment, however you noticed that the cost center assigned to the corresponding expense arrangement did not get automatically updated with the new cost center.-You expect that the organizational assignment in the personnel file should always be in sync with the cost assignment in the expense arrangement-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center. -Go to Employees view.-Find the employee and take note of the organizational assignment.-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense Arrangement view.-Open the related expense arrangement for the above employee.-You notice that the cost center assigned to the expense arrangement is not synchronized with the cost center of the employee's organizational assignment in Personnel Administration.-You want to understand how and when this synchronization happens.-Resolution-The synchronization versus manual change of expense arrangements works as follows:-In case of a personnel event (hiring, transfer, termination etc.) cost center in Expense Arrangement is synchronized with cost center assignment of position in Work Agreement. The Expense Arrangement and Work Agreement are in sync regarding cost center assignment.-If user has manually changed cost center assignment in expense arrangement so that the cost center in Expense Arrangement deviates from the cost center in Work Agreement, i.e. Expense and Work Agreement are no more in sync, then the synchronization doesn’t work anymore for all upcoming transfers.-If the user now corrects all manually changed Cost Assignments and all following deviating cost assignments so that all cost assignments in expense arrangement fit again 1:1 – regarding intervals and cost centers - to the cost assignments in work agreement, then the synchronization should work again for all upcoming transfers.-The sync works also fine if the cost assignment in the expense arrangement is empty, i.e. was deleted manually or sync was deactivated.-Changes of cost center assignments in Org Management only, without corresponding Personal Event, are not synchronized at all. Such changes will lead to deviations and to a stop of synchronization. In order to avoid this, for each changed cost center assignment of a position, the user has to create a corresponding personnel transfer or directly adapt the expense arrangement accordingly.  -Keywords-Expense Arrangement. Cost Center. Work Agreement.

Title: How to set the "from stock" field as Default to avoid checking it multiple times in Project?
Content: Symptom-You have multiple materials that you want to add in the project, and you want to check the "From Stock" field for all of them, so you want to set this checkbox as default to avoid adding them one by one.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management  work center-Select Projects view-Select the respective project and navigate to Project Plan-Navigate to sub-tab Materials-Select Add row-Check "From stock" checkbox for each item.-You want to avoid manual checking of this checkbox for each item.-Cause-As of now, it is not possible to set "From stock" checkbox as default from standard system. Since multiple customers use this functionality, it may not be feasible for all customers to set all items "from stock", hence this has to be done manually only at the moment.-Resolution-This field is PSM released, so you can check with PDI partner if they can set this as default as per your business usecase using add-on.-Keywords-"From stock" checkbox in project, set "From stock" checkbox as default, project materials

Title: Domain certificate renewal for SAP Cloud for Customer URLs (*.crm.ondemand.com) 2022
Content: Symptom-How to renew C4C Domain Certificate?-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Background-The existing server certificate for domain “*.crm.ondemand.com” is renewed as it is going to expire on Dec 16th, 2022.-Scope-You will be affected if either of the below scenarios are applicable to you:-Your browser does not have DigiCert Certificates.-You have an inbound communication integration to your C4C product.-The SSL certificates for your below URLs are scheduled to be updated with new certificates.-myxxxxxx.crm.ondemand.com and myxxxxxx-sso.crm.ondemand.com-If you have third-party integrations like web services/APIs in your Cloud for Customer tenants, you may be required to update the domain certificate. These updates should be conducted by your internal IT resources.-  Resolution-Download new certificate-To download the latest certificate, go to your tenant URL and download the certificate which was recently updated. Below are the steps we need to follow to get a certificate.-1. Access your C4C URL and click on “View site information” (Lock symbol)-2. Click on Certificate (Valid) option as below-3. New renewed Domain certificate will be available for download:-We can see the whole certificate chain in “Certification Path”:-  4. Click on “Details” tab and download the certificate to the desired path(local machine).-See Also-3199761 - FAQs -How to update/renew C4C Domain Certificate

Title: Private Certificate Change for One Company Triggers the Same Change for All Companies - SII Tax Reporting
Content: Symptom-This is a region specific KBA, applicable only for Spain.-There are two companies in the system and both have a Communication Arrangement for SII Tax Reporting. When changing the private certificate of one of these companies, the private certificate of the other company is also modified automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Communication Arrangements view.-Search for the Communication Arragement related to sending SII Tax Data to AEAT.-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Technical Data tab.-Click the Edit Credentials button.-Make the relevant changes and click OK.-Click the Save and Reactivate button.-Check the Communication Arrangement for the second company.-The same changes in the certificate were applied to the second company.-Cause-The automatic updation of Certificate from one company to another is because both the companies are using the same Communication System and Communication Arrangements. This is expected behaviour of the system.-Resolution-If different certificates are required for multiple companies, separate Communication Systems and Communication Arrangements must be created for each company.-For more details about the Communication Arrangement and Communication System creation on the Help Document "Communication Arrangement for SII - Spain".-See Also-Help Document Communication Arrangement for SII - Spain-Keywords-Private certificate, Spain, SII, tax declaration, AEAT

Title: Error "Revenue recognition master data for SoB XYZ not updated" in Revenue Recognition Run
Content: Symptom-You get error "Revenue recognition master data for SoB XYZ not updated" in Revenue Recognition run.-DEF stands for the Sales Document ID, AA is the document item. XYZ stands for Set of Books ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Revenue Recognition view.-Open log of the revenue recognition run in question.-Go to tab Messages, where you see the error "Revenue recognition master data for SoB XYZ not updated".-Cause-The error can occur due to sale documents being opened while revenue recogntion is executed.-This could happen when the user have the UI - User Interface Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data -> Recognized Costs and Revenue (for instance) being opened and in another tab they perform revenue recognition.-System cannot lock those documents during revenue recogntion. Then the error occurs.-Resolution-Please ensure no sales document is opened by any user when revenue recognition run is executed.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition

Title: No Contract Price Shown in Shopping Cart Process
Content: Symptom-Shopping Cart not showing the Contract Price during the creation of the cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view.-Click on Go Shopping.-Search for ABC (ABC refers to the product).-Select an item from the list.-Click on Next and Finish.-See that no Price is shown in the whole process of the Shopping Cart.-Cause-System behavior.-Resolution-As employee you have no access to the contracts that the company has with the supplier. The corresponding price will be shown from Purchase Request onwards.-The procurement team will decide which is the best supplier based on the company contracts.-Keywords-Shopping Cart. Price. Contracts.

Title: Acknowledged Price in Purchase Order Shows the Entire Price Instead of the Price per Unit
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order and now you need to create an acknowledgment, however the acknowledge price is shown as the total amount instead of the price per unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Filter for All Purchase Orders.-Search for the relevant document.-Click on New PO Acknowledgment.-Back in the Purchase Order go to Items tab.-See that the Total Net Value is different from the Acknowledged Price.-For example:-In the Purchase Order, the quantity is 1 unit and the Gross Price is $500 for 10 units but in the Purchase Order Acknowledgment the Acknowledged Price is $500 instead of $50.-Cause- System behavior.-Resolution-The system will enter the Gross Price in the Acknowledged Price.-In the example you can see that in the Purchase Order the Gross Price is $500, only the Net Value is $50.-So, in this case, to see the price per unit you will need to change the Gross Price from $500 / 10 unit to the price per unit.-Keywords-Purchase Order. Purchase Order Acknowledgment. Price. Order Confirmation.

Title: Some Details Cleared after Deactivation of an Org Unit
Content: Symptom-If any org unit in an org structure is deactivated, the system clears such information as: sales unit name, company name, department name. This details are also not replicated in reports.-Environment- SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Organizational Management work center-2. Select Org Structure view-3. Select any org unit-3. Open the selected org unit-4. End the validity of the selected unit and click on Save-5. Sales unit name, company name, department name & other details are not visible after saving the data-Cause-This is the designed feature. The name and address data are time dependent. When the valid to date is changed for the org unit, the valid to date of the name and address will be changed to the same date (default logic).-This means that the name may be not valid any more for the date/time when the org unit is checked.-As a result, there is no name valid which can be shown on the UI.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Deactivation of an Org Unit, End the validity of an Unit, Plant Name Clear after deactivation of plant

Title: Wrong Tax Determination Within Vertex or Avalara
Content: Symptom-You have a Vertex or Avalara integration currently active in your system, nevertheless you notice that for a very few cases the tax is not correctly determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Open a sales document for example, Customer Invoicing.-Go to Items tab.-In the Taxes section, tax is not as expected. You see the tax rates came from Vertex or Avalara.-Cause-There are different reasons for why a tax rate/code could be wrong or as not expected in the customer invoice/sales order.-One of the reasons is that you have maintained the house number and street in the field Address Line1 in the master data, which is not shared with Vertex or Avalara for tax determination.-For tax determination in Vertex the following fields are used from the master data: House Number, Street, City, State and ZIP.-Occasionally there are different tax rates within a zip code, which would require the House Number and Street. Nevertheless, since these data is maintained in the Address Line1 field, which is not sent over to Vertex/Avalara, the unexpected determination occurs.-Resolution-You need to maintain the House Number and Street that is in the Address Line1 in the corresponding dedicated fields in the master data for House Number and Street.-If you have several accounts that needs to be updated, you may consider the following steps:-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Export Data to Local File in CSV format for existing Customers or Suppliers.-Make changes to existing addresses. You have to maintain house numbers and streets in the excel for all those business partner addresses that have them in the address line 1 and not in house number or street fields.-Upload Data from Local File that is, the altered CSV containing house number and street for respective addresses.-When the upload is successful, the addresses are altered in the system in the expected format.-Since this is a mass data change, it is recommenced that you first test the change in a test environment before performing the steps in production.-Keywords-Vertex; Tax Determination; Tax Calculation; Address; Mass update; Avalara; Tax Rate; missing; Street; Region; Jurisdiction;

Title: Values Are Showing For Amount Awaiting Receipt in the GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary Report
Content: Symptom-You are running the report GR/IR - Balance Summary to check the clearing of purchases, applying a key date in the past.-Contrary to your expectation there are values shown in the column Amount Awaiting Receipt for a particular purchasing document XYZ although the affected line items are fully delivered and invoiced.-XYZ means the Purchasing Document ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Under Reports / List choose the report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary.-Select the relevant parameters for your report creation including purchasing document XYZ.-As Key Date you specify a date in the past.-Cause-One possible reason is that the corresponding Invoice Receipt for the affected purchasing document was received after the Key Date specified in the report.-Hence the amounts are showing as outstanding.-Resolution-Check and run the GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary for a Key Date that possibly includes the relevant Invoice Receipts.-The same applies for the other columns and parameters of this report (Amount Awaiting Invoice, Quantity Awaiting Invoice, Quantity Awaiting Receipt).-Keywords-GR/IR inventories; purchasing document

Title: Error message "Data from these columns will not be uploaded" in Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded a migration file in migration tool and you receive the following error:-  The file you are uploading includes the following column(s) that is not part of active source view:---- Field ABCD --------- Field EFGH ------Data from these columns will not be uploaded.-  Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Migration Tool-Select Upload->Data from Migration File-Upload your file-You receive the error described-  Cause-The fields informed on error message are not available for respective migration mode.-E.g: You are migrating data in mode Enhance already existing records, but the fields are available only for migration mode Add New Records.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.

Title: Manual Tax Entry or Invoice not Being Picked by the Tax Return Run
Content: Symptom-You have executed a tax return run and noted that a manual VAT entry, invoice or payment were not selected by the run, even though such documents have a taxable event assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Return Runs view.-Create and execute a new tax return.-In the resulting tax return, you notice that the expected manual tax entry, invoice or payment is not processed by the run.-Cause-The tax event associated to the tax posting from the manual tax entry or invoice is not mapped to the tax return type of the tax arrangement used in the tax return run.-To check this, you may follow below steps:-i) Check the tax arrangement's return type.-Open the VAT Return Run that you have executed.-Note down the used tax return arrangement.-Open the respective tax authority.-Go to Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Go to Tax Return Arrangements subtab.-Check the Tax Return Type of the Tax Return Arrangement from step 2.-ii) Check the tax event for the related document.-Open the respective document that you expect to be processed by the run.-Find the tax code and tax country.-Check the tax event for this tax code and country in fine-tune activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Alternately, you can open the document's journal entry and refer to the tax line posting.-iii) Check the tax event mapping to a tax return type.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the fine-tune activity Tax Returns for Goods and Services - <country>.-Click to check the Product Tax Return.-Select the tax return type that is associated to the tax return arrangement used in the tax return run.-In the Tax Event tab, search for the tax event used in the manual tax entry or invoice.-If the tax event is not mapped to the tax return type, the tax return run executed with tax company tax arrangement will no pick up the document.-Resolution-You need to find to which tax return type the assigned tax event is mapped to and execute a tax return run with a tax return arrangement with the respective tax return type.-If the tax event is not assigned to any tax return type, then it would be processed by the generic tax return, which uses tax return type 999 - Tax Return.  Tax return 999 only picks tax lines belonging to items that are not mapped to any other return.-Keywords-Tax Management. Product Tax. VAT Return. VAT Return Run.

Title: Poor Performance When Confirm Execution Button is Triggered in a Service Scenario.
Content: Symptom-Poor Performance When Confirm Execution Button is Triggered in a Service Scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Contracts view. -Select Contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Contract). -Click on the Confirm Execution button. -This then leads to a performance degradation in the system.-Cause-The Account has a large number of contact party records for the Sales Order (Around 1000 records).-These all have to be processed during the follow-up Service Confirmation, so this leads to a degradation in performance.-Resolution-Reduce the contact party list in the Account master data.-Keywords-Performance; Contact Party; Sales Order.

Title: Contract Scheduled Invoice Requests Not Created According to the Time Frame
Content: Symptom-Customer Contract just generates 2 Invoice Schedule and you were expecting to generate invoice time frame from e.g. 01.01.2022 until 01.12.2026.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work Center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open Contract AAA (Where AAA represents the Contract ID).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and then the Invoice Schedule subtab.-Expand all Items:-Items XX  -  has first invoice date on e.g. 01.01.2022 and the last one on 01.12.2026-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Requests view.-Search for Contract ID AAA.-You can see a Scheduled Invoice Request dated has two Invoice Request created.-Cause-When an invoice schedule is created, it is created for the dates within the item validity only. Therefore, we would expect for item XX that there are invoice schedule dates up to 01.01.2022 only, even though the end date of 01.12.2026 is maintained in the invoicing timeframe (recurrence pattern).-However, in this case, there are only two invoice schedule dates for item XX (covering the period of 01.01.2022 - 28.02.2022). This is because at the time the invoice schedule was created, the validity end date of item 10 was 28.02.2022. Then it was changed the end date of item 10 from 28.02.2022 to 30.04.2022.-Resolution-To update the invoice schedule, you would have needed to manually update the invoice schedule by deselecting item XX for the relevant recurrence pattern in "Edit Invoicing Timeframe", and then applying it again.-Keywords-recurrence pattern; Contract; Invoice Request;  Invoice Schedule

Title: Report Fund Financial Statements - Governmental Funds Shows no Records
Content: Symptom-You have executed the Fund Financial Statements - Governmental Funds report, but no records are shown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open and execute report Fund Financial Statements - Governmental Funds.-The report shows no records.-Cause-The selected Financial Reporting Structure as parameter in the report is not of type Balance Sheet nor Profit and Loss.-Resolution-In this report, only financial reporting structures related to balance sheet or PnL brings data.-To check the reporting structure type, follow below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click to open Financial Reporting Structures.-Select the reporting structure used in the report and refer to the Structure Type column. It should relate to either balance sheet type or Profit & Loss type.-Keywords-Fund Management. Public Sector. Financial Statement.

Title: Preceding Sales Quote is Shown as # For Sales Order Report
Content: Symptom- Preceding Sales Quote is Shown as # on Sales Order Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Select the CRMSLOIB Report.-Execute the report to view all Sales Orders.-Enter the parameters according to your business process.-Preceding Sales Quote is shown as # for sales order.-Cause-Since the items in Sales Order and Sales Quote don't match the report does not display any value.-Resolution- This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-CRMSLOIB; Sales Quote; Sales Order

Title: Error Message While Uploading Tax Data for Materials Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-1. The Tax details are not present for the Materials. Your requirement is to upload the Tax data for the Materials using Mass Data Maintenance. Upon executing the file, you receive the below error:-Update not possible; specified data for MATERIAL-DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION with key COUNTRY_CODE = `XX` AND TAX_RATE_TYPE_CODE-CONTE does not exist-2. Your requirement is to modify the existing Tax Rate Type for the Materials using Mass Data Maintenance. Upon executing the file, you receive the below error:-Update not possible; specified data for MATERIAL-DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION with key COUNTRY_CODE =`XX` AND REGION_CODE-CONTENT = `YY` AND TAX_RATE_TYPE_CODE-CONTENT = `Z` AND TAX_TYPE_CODE-CONTEN-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Select Export Materials link-Export the Taxes tab to CSV file and add the data in the field required fields-Select Import Materials link and upload the file to the Taxes tab-Execute Data Import Immediately-Error occurs-Cause-Mass Data Maintenance tool is used to modify already existing records, but it is not possible to upload new data in the system.-Resolution-1. To add Tax data in Materials, you can use the activity Migration of Materials with the migration mode: Enhance already existing records by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Materials-Choose Migrate materials using the migration tool-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen and Download Migration Template-Fill the necessary fields and upload the migration file in the migration tool-Select Properties and choose the migration mode: Enhance already existing records-Execute migration-Check the respective Materials to understand if the Tax data upload was successful-  2. You have not filled Region field in the template. Region is part of key information (Country, Region and Tax Type) and Tax data without Region cannot be updated. Update of tax details is possible from mass data maintenance , provided the keys(Country, Region and Tax Type) are filled completely.-Keywords-COUNTRY_CODE, Tax, REGION_CODE-CONTENT, Migration of Materials, MATERIAL-DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION, Tax Rate Type, TAX_RATE_TYPE_CODE-CONTENT

Title: Web Service Does Not Consider Correct Price List For a Sales Document
Content: Symptom-Web service does not consider correct Price List for a Sales Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Sales Orders.-Go to view Sales Orders.-Select the Sales Order XYZ ﻿with status In Preparation. (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID created via web service).-Click on Edit and View All buttons.-Navigate to Items Tab.-The Item List Price is not cheapest one according to maintained on the Price Lists.-Cause-In the payload, only account ID and product ID information is being provided. Based on this the system is only able to identify the Base Price List since Base PL needs only Product ID.-In order to get the Customer Group Specific List, Customer Group is a mandatory field which is not being passed in the payload and hence the system is not able to retrieve that information.-When we create any Sales Document, Sales Organization and Distribution Channel are automatically picked up, which in turn determines the Customer Group, so this issue will not happen when creating a Sales Doc.-Resolution-Since in the webservice we explicitly provide info about the fields, Customer Group Specific Price List would need Sales Org and Dist. Channel information to be provided in the payload for it to determine the Customer Group and fetch the correct price value in return.-Keywords-Base price list; Sales Order; Price List; Web Services; XML

Title: Expense Report for Business Trip Does Not Show Maximum Amount by Company Policy
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an Expense Report for the Business trip, but when you set up the amount no error message appears for the maximum amount by company policy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Click New > Expense Report on Behalf.-Select Business trip for Type of Expense Report.-In step 2, when you set up the amount for more than XYZ (XYZ represents the amount), no error message for the maximum amount appears.-Cause-In Business configuration the Business Trip is not maintained in Trip type.-Resolution-Maintain the Business Trip option in Trip type (Business Configuration > Fine-tune activity - Expense Reporting - AAA (AAA represents the Country).-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click Overview view.-Search for the fine tune activity - Expense Reporting – AAA (AAA represents the Country).-Click Edit expense types view.-Select the Available Expense Types or you can create a new clicking in “Add Row”.-You will see in Details: ABC (ABC represents the Expense Type that you selected).-Go to the Maximum Amount tab.-In "Trip Type" add the Business Trip value in dropdown and the other information as “Valid From”, “Valid to”, “Maximum/Default Amount”, “Currency” and “Condition”.-Keywords-Business trip. Expense Types. Trip type. maximum amount. Maximum/Default Amount. Expense report.

Title: How to Process an Incoming Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You have received a refund of a Tax Return from the Tax Authority and wish to process the Tax Payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the view of the concerned Tax Return, for example Sales and Use Tax Returns.-Open the relevant Tax Return. The Tax amount should be displayed without the minus sign, which means a Tax Receivable.-The Pay button is grayed out.-Cause-The Tax Authority issues your company a check when the Tax is receivable. In such cases, the check or Bank Transfer needs to be considered as a Tax Payment and be associated with one or more Tax Returns. This scenario of creating a Tax Due Payment based on a check or Bank Transfer that has already been initiated is an externally initiated Tax Due Payment, which means that the payment is created out of the Tax Management work center.-Resolution-In order to process your Tax Receivable, you have to manually initiate the payment and then associate it with a Tax Return.-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Click Create New Incoming Check under Common Tasks.-Specify the payment amount and select the payer as the Tax Authority.-Post the payment. A Tax Payment is created as well as a task of type Review and Release Tax Payment.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments view.-Open the newly created Tax Payment and match the relevant items (the VAT Returns).-In case you do not see the relevant VAT Return to match then open the Value Help under Tax Return Arrangement ID and select a different Tax Return Arrangement ID XYZ (where XYZ is the relevant Tax Return Arrangement ID).-Fill out the required fields and press Post or Accept.-Alternatively to step 6, you can open the Review and Release Tax Payment task on the Work view.-Additionally, Tax Payments can also be created directly via Bank Statements. See the help documentation below.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Documentation: Tax Payments Quick Guide-Keywords-VAT Return; Tax Payment; Tax Authority; match VAT Return to Tax Payment; Tax Return Arrangement ID; Steuermeldung; Steuerzahlung

Title: The user is not able to create Customer Invoice from the Invoice Request as the Invoice button is disabled
Content: Symptom-The user is not able to create a customer invoice or release the invoice request from the Invoice Requests View.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on in the system as user XYZ(XYZ is the user who is facing the issue)-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice requests-Select To Be Invoiced Invoice Requests from the drop down-You can see, the Invoice button is disabled.-Cause-You are not able to see create customer invoices in the system as the CRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS access right is not assigned to the user.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select View User and Access Management and sub view Business Users.-Show all Find XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the user).-Select XYZ click on Edit navigate to Access Rights.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment.-Drill down CRM_CUSTOMERINVOICING.-Here you can see that CRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS is not assigned to XYZ user.-Once the check box is tick and save.-You are now able to create invoices in the system.-Keywords-Access restriction; Invoice button disabled; customer invoice;CRM_INVOICESANDCREDITMEMOS; CRM_CUSTOMERINVOICING;

Title: You are Trying to Terminate Relationship with Employee and Receive Error: "Employee has Multiple Work Agreements; Specify Last Working Day"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to terminate a relationship with an employee but this is not finishing and shows the following message: "Employee has multiple work agreements; specify last working day".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Regular Tasks view.-Click Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Select the affected employee.-It will show message "Employee has multiple work agreements; specify last working day".-Cause-This can happen because the employee whose termination you are trying to complete has multiple work agreements.-Resolution-When doing termination, please follow with below steps:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Regular Tasks view.-Click Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Select the affected employee.-Provide termination date in the past and press Enter.-Fill rest of the field enabled and press Save.-If the rest of the fields below the termination date are not active and there is no possibility to select Termination Category, follow the steps below:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Find respective employee-Click on Edit and go to the tab Employment-You can change the Termination Date in the section Effective Dates-  Keywords-Personnel Administration; Employee, Termination, Work Agreement

Title: License Type Changes after the Activation of Access Restrictions
Content: Symptom-When activating access restrictions for a business role, the license type changes from self-service user to core user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to the Application and User Management work center-2.Go to the Business Roles subview-3.Select All Business Roles and find the relevant Business Role-4.Click on Edit-5.Go to the tab Access Restrictions-6.Find the Work Center View ID-7.Click on Actions Button and select Activate-8.The license type will change from Self-Service User to Core User-Cause-The user type of a role is calculated based on the user types of the included views. This calculation is independent from the access type (read or write access).-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-License Type,  Access Restrictions, elf-Service User, Core User

Title: Mass Reversal of Incorrect Migrated Financial Data
Content: Symptom-You have incorrectly migrated the financial data. Now you would like to remove the migrated data to enable a new financial data migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select Migration of Open Items Payable/Receivable.-Click Execute Migration.-Select your uploaded migration file and click Process File.-After Migration, you realized that data was incorrect and there is no way to remove the migrated data.-Cause-The removal of migrated data is not possible (this fact is described in a popup that has to be confirmed before you can start any data import). However, you can reverse all the migrated journal entries.-Resolution-We suggest following alternative approaches how you could move forward:-Falling back to the latest restore point (in case you had ordered any, for example, before starting with data migration).-Starting over with a fresh production system.-The migration postings can be reversed for each journal entry.-This can be done by reversing the accounting notification, as follows:-Open General Ledger work center -> Journal Entries view.-Select the journal entry for the source document ID from the receivables upload.-Click You can Also -> View Business Transaction for Accounting -> View All.-The screen "Business Transaction for Accounting" opens up where you see Reverse button.-By clicking the button, the journal entry and the open item in Customer Account Monitor (viewed on Receivables work center -> Customers view -> Customer Accounts subview) will be reversed.-The benefit of the strategies (1) and (2) are at hand, no redundant financial postings in the system, but of course this has a stronger impact onto your project plan. In case you are opting for (3), please test whether reversal of journal entries is sufficient for your business processes. In any case we recommend testing the migration in a test system before doing the migration in your production system. This applies also to any objects that you are planning to migrate in the upcoming days.-Keywords-Migration of Accounting Transaction Data; journal entries; reverse

Title: How to Complete Unassigned Items in Business Task Management
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You would like to know how you can complete unassigned items for tasks with the title cancellation of vacation/ meetings/ mentoring meetings approved etc.-You might observe in the application logs that the business task is inconsistent and that there no valid responsible person/organization.-You might observe that you are unable to assign the task to yourself.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Click on Business Task Management view-Select Unassigned Tasks-Enter Review Time Data as Process-Cause-A possible cause could be that the functionality 'Do you want to remove substitutions and authorizations for users whose validity date is in the past?' is scoped. if it is scoped, then all authorizations of the invalid users will be removed. Since the authorizations of the user were removed, all the notifications/tasks of this user set to unassigned.-You can verify the scoping by:-1. Go to Business Configuration Woc-2. Select Implementation Projects  View-3. Highlight the project and select Edit Project Scope-4. Navigate to Questions Built-in Services and Support > System Management > User and Access Management > Group: Remove authorization for invalid users: Do u want to remove substitutions and authorizations for users whose validity date is in the past.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management view-Click on Business Task Management view-Select Unassigned Items-Click on Advanced Filters-Click on More Filters next to Sent on-Enter the time period-Note: There are XXX unassigned items (where XXX stands for the number of the items).-Log in to backend-Open for SBTM_TASK_SEL-Enter same time period as enterd above for Creation Time-Enter Ready for Status-Enter HCM_TIM_TIM_NTF_CANC_APPROVED as Task Type-Enter a high number for Maximum No. of Hits-Click on Execute-Note: There are XXX unassigned items.-Now you can set all unassigned items to complete.-You will see different tasks in UI which are not available above.-Please select correct Task Type correspondingly.-Ex : Cancelled Rejected - HCM_TIM_TIM_NTF_CANC_REJECTED-Search with : HCM_TIM_TIM_NTF* and chose accordingly.-See Also-2935036 - Unable to Complete Unassigned Tasks Related to Review Time Data in Business Task Management view-Keywords-Zeitverwaltung, time administration, Storno-Informationen, cancellation of vacation, Mitarbeiter nicht mehr im Unternehmen tätig, complete unassigned items, Aufgaben abschließen, no valid responsible person, Do you want to remove substitutions and authorizations for users whose validity date is in the past,

Title: Party Role Determination in a Sales Document
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article explains how the party roles are determined in a sales document in SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The following 3 elements are taken into consideration for the determination of the Party Roles in a sales document such as a Sales Order:-The fine tuning activity Involved Parties for Sales Orders (in the example of a Sales Order) in your Business Configuration.-The Organizational Work Distribution rules in the Organizational Management.-The Employee Work Distribution rules in the Organizational Management.-To determine the Parties in a Sales Order you need to consider the determination rules in the fine tuning activity Involved Parties for Sales Orders for the following Parties:-A) Seller-B) Sales Unit-C) Employee Responsible-You can check the rules for each party role by selecting the party role and then clicking on the Maintain Determination button.-See Also-Blogs:-- Party Role Determination in a Sales Document: https://blogs.sap.com/2016/05/16/party-role-determination-in-a-sales-document/-- Party Role Determination in a Service Document: https://blogs.sap.com/2017/11/29/party-role-determination-in-a-service-document/-KBAs:-2695468 - Maintain Determinations for Customized Party Role-2638909 - Wrong Party Role Determination While Creating Sales Order-2626062 - Error Message: Party with role Sales Unit missing; maintain in Involved Parties tab-2414263 - Employee Responsible changes in Sales Orders Automatically-2234458 - The Automatic Determination of Sales Unit and Employee Responsible is not Working in Contract-1892958 - Automatic Determination of Sales Unit is not Happening in the Sales Order Even After Maintaing the Work Distribution Rule-1837827 - How to Define Customized Party Roles for Leads or Opportunities-1811256 - You get an Error Message in the Sales Order: Party with role Sales Employee missing-1589568 - The Default Bill-to Party is Not the One Expected in a Sales Order-1436885 - How to Determine Employee Responsible in a Sales Quote-1435095 - How to Determine Sales Unit in a Sales Order-1435056 - How to determine Employee Responsible in a Sales Order-1898128 - In an Invoice Document the Error "Sales data or pricing terms not found for account" is Triggered-Keywords-sales order, work distribution rules, organizational management, business configuration, involved parties

Title: 'Enter description' Error Message While Creating Journal Reporting - Belgium Run
Content: Symptom-Error message 'Enter description' is displayed while creating Journal Reporting - Belgium run, even though Run Description field has been maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the system in a language other than English (for example, NL).-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view -> Journal Reporting - Belgium subview.-Click New -> Journal Report Run.-Maintain all the mandatory fields, such as Run Description, Company, Set of Books, etc.-Click Save-Error messages are displayed:-'Save failed'-'Enter description'-Remark: in the example given, the error messages (such as work centers and views names) will be displayed in Dutch.-Error messages in Dutch:-'Opslaan mislukt'-'Omschrijving invoeren'-Cause-The respective Set of Books Description has not been maintained for the current logon language (in this case, NL).-Resolution-Enter Set of Books Description for the respective logon language in Set of Books Business Configuration activity.-Keywords-Journal Reporting - Belgium; set of books; description; NL; dutch; English; Opslaan mislukt; Omschrijving invoeren

Title: How to Troubleshoot a Content Issue in a Sales Form
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-How to troubleshoot a content issue in a sales form?-Reproducing the Issue-The customer is reporting a content issue with one of his sales form such as the Customer Invoicing form.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents.-Edit Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the invoice).-Select Preview.-You have identified that the content of the form is not correct.-Cause-One reason could be that the customer made a mistake when adapting the form.-Resolution-1. Identify the name of the template-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Edit Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the invoice).-Go to View All.-Go to the Output History tab.-You can find the name of the template in the output details, e.g. Test1- 2. Identify who created/modified the template (SAP or the Customer)-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance view.-Input the form template group (e.g. Customer Invoice).-Select the template Test1 for the corresponding country and language.-In the Administrative data you can see who has created the form (SAP or Customer).-Select Version you will see detail information about the last changes.-3. Preview the form in your local machine-pre-requisite: you will need to install Adobe Live Cycle Designer.-3.1 Create an XML file with the XML data from the output history-Go to the Output History tab.-Select View Data XML.-Select Download.-Save the XML file in your desktop.-3.2 Download the form template-Select the form template as per (2.).-Select Download.-Save the XDP file in your desktop.-3.3 Preview the form using Adobe Live Cycle Designer-Open the XDP form template using Adobe Live Cycle Designer.-Select Preview PDF > Form Properties > Preview.-Upload the XML File.-You should now be able to  preview the form in your local machine.-4. To whom the issue should be addressed ?-If the issue can be reproduced AND the form template is provided by SAP => Send the incident to CRM Support Or CRM Development.-If the issue can be reproduced AND the form template has been adapted :-Follow steps 1. 2. 3. for the corresponding SAP template (you can use the template from the hotfix or IRAS system).-In case there is no issue with the standard form template, please attach the XML and XDP file in the incident and explain to the customer that the issue is with the adaptation of the form.-=> The customer should contact the end user who has done the adaptation of the form.-  See Also-More information for Expert Support :-1. SESFTS - BO /DOC/OM_DETERM_RULE-You can cross check the Form Template Selection AND Output Selection (maintained in Form Template Selection view in the UI)-2. SE16 - /DOC/C_OM_FMT (SAP Standard Template)-3. SE16 - /DOC/C_OM_FMG (Form Template Group Description, eg. C41 : Customer Invoice)-4. Transaction: APXREP_BROWSER--Folder:-> Development-   > SAP_BYD -   > SAP_BYDGLO (country variant) > Customer Invoicing > Templates > Relevant template folder-  Starting with 0       :  Customer Template-Not starting with 0  :  Sap Template-You can then fetch the name of the template on the right side under Attributes-

Title: Restore Point is inactive after a Release Upgrade
Content: Symptom-You created a restore Point and the Restore Point is inactive after a Release Upgrade.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Any restore point taken previously would become obsolete/invalid, as soon as a release upgrade is performed on that system.-Resolution-Create  a New restore point.-Keywords-Restore Point, Restore point no working, restore point inactive

Title: How Credit Limit Check Works in Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You have enabled the Credit Limit Check function in the system and maintained necessary credit limit check data. While you are still wondering how system calculates the credit limit amount in a sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select  and open sales order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the sales order)-Click on the Check Credit Limit button.-The following information message appears:-Credit limit 5.000,00 USD exceeded by 7902.06 USD (5.000,00 USD represents the credit limit entered in the account master data and 7902.06 USD represents the amount by which the limit is exceeded)-Cause-The Credit Limit Check Amount displayed in the information message depends on the following:-Credit Limit Amount maintained in the account master data.-Credit Limit Check setting maintained in the Business Configuration. Activity: Credit Limit Check. -Account Balance of the open items in the receivables of the account. This is Invoiced Open Amount for the account.-Credit Limit is calculated as:-Credit Check Status = Credit Limit for account - ( Invoiced open amount + Total Net Value of the current order + Total Net Value of all not invoiced orders ).-You are able to check how system calculate the credit limit amount on this sales order by using Simulation of Credit Limit Check function.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the order you want to check, and click Action - Simulate Check Credit Limit button. -System opens the simulation result for the account, you shall check the result and all information used in the simulation. The simulation also displays all the not invoiced order lines, so that you can check which order lines are not invoiced and calculates in the simulation.-Result: Credit limit 5000.00 USD exceeded by 7902.06 USD-Credit Limit for account: 5,000.00 USD-Invoiced open amunt:386 USD-Total Net Value of current order (the system considers the amount only for the open items in the document): 2,440.00 USD-Total Net Value of all not invoiced order (the system considers all the not invoiced order besides the Net Value for the current order): 10,076.06 USD-Credit Check=5,000 - (386+2,440+10,076.06)=-7902.02.-Please Note: The Not Invoiced Orders will include items that are Invoiced but are not cleared in Financials as they are required for the caculation of the Invoiced open Amount-To Verify the credit limit amount proposed by system on the sales order, you need to check the following amounts.-You need to check the Limit Amount entered in the account master data:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Go to the Financial Data tab-The amount 5.000,00 USD is entered in the field Credit Limit.-You need to check the Invoiced Open Amount of the account:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the Customer Accounts view.-Select account ABC, customer balance shows 386.00 USD. -Please note: that the Invoiced Open Amount is determined from the receivables of the account and only the Posted Items are taken into consideration. The Statistical Items are not taken into consideration for the Invoiced Open Amount.-You need to check the Not Invoiced Orders from the order list in simulation screen. The list of orders is based on the scope selected in the business activity: Credit Limit Check.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the activity Credit Limit Check.-Here you can find 3 options on how the credit limit check is scoped for this system:-Check Current Document-(This check considers only the value of the current document).-Check Current Document and Other Open Orders-(This check considers other open sales order and service order items, which have not been invoiced).-Check Current Document and Other Open Orders Including Documents "In Preparation"-(This check considers additionally sales orders and service orders in status In preparation).-In our example, the Check Current Document and Other Open Orders is selected.-Resolution-This is how the credit limit check works in the system.-See Also-KBA 2392105 - Credit Limit Check in Sales Order is Incorrect-Support Portal Document: FAQs – Credit Limit Check in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Credit Limit Check; Sales Order;

Title: Production Lot not Considered in WIP Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You execute the Work in Progress (WIP) Clearing Run, but production lot XXX in status 'Finished' for the same accounting period has not been considered.-XXX means the production lot ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks - WIP Clearing.-Select the respective Run ID and click View.-Navigate to tab Processed Successfully.-You see that production Lot XXX has not been processed.-Cause-The amount of costs which went into the production of production lot XXX equal the amount of the output.-You can check this as follows:-Open the Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to the Reports - List and select the report Production Lots - Line Items.-Run the report for the respective Accounting Period and Production Lot XXX.-Add Business Transaction Type to Rows.-You see that the amounts for input costs* (for example, Goods Issue for Production, Internal Service Confirmation, Overhead Absorption) are balanced by the output** (for example, Goods Receipt from Production).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Production lots are only considered in the WIP Clearing Run if there is a difference between input and output amount(s).-*  Shown as positive amount-** Shown as negative amount-Keywords-WIP Clearing run, production lot, Production Lots - Line Items

Title: Error Message "User is Not Valid. Business Role Assignment Can't be Processed"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign business role(s) to a specific business user, but system is raising error message "User is not valid. Business role assignment can't be processed."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Users work center view-In SAP Cloud for Customer, this is under the Administrator work center-In SAP Business ByDesign, this is under the Application and User Management work center-Search for the respective user-Select it and click Edit, then select Access Rights-In the Edit Access Rights screen, navigate to the Business Role Assignment tab.-Check the box for one or more business roles to assign them.-Click Save.-Error message is raised.-Cause-The user is outside of the validity period.-Either it is no longer valid (current date is past the Valid To date) or it is not yet valid (current date is before the Valid From date).-Resolution-Please correct the user's validity in the Attributes section, by using the Valid To/From fields.-Once the user's validity covers the current date, it will be possible to assign business roles to that user.-Keywords-Business role assignment, Assign Business Roles, User is Not Valid, Business Role Assignment Can't be Processed

Title: Tax Exemption Reason '10 - Non-Taxable Within Tax Reporting Group' not Visible in the Business Partner's Master Data
Content: Symptom-You are in the supplier master data and tries to maintain the tax exemption reason 10 - Non-Taxable Within Tax Reporting Group. However, this exemption reason is not being shown in the dropdown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the respective supplier master data.-Go to Financial Data tab.-Go to Tax Data subtab.-Under Tax Exemptions, click add row.-Add the relevant country and tax type.-Open the dropdown for tax exemption reason and see that '10 - Non-Taxable Within Tax Reporting Group' is not available for selection.-Cause-Tax Exemption Reason 10 - Non-Taxable Within Tax Reporting Group does not require to be assign as exemption reason to a business partner-Resolution-In order to use this, the account should be maintained as subsidiary to the company under the company tax arrangement. Once this is done, you can create the respective invoices that the exemption reason shall apply.-Keywords-tax authority. customer invoice. supplier invoice. tax exemption reason.

Title: Error Message: Incompatible Migration Template; Upload an updated template, While Uploading a Fixed Asset (Extended) Migration File
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload a Migration file for Fixed Asset (extended), system throws below error message:-Incompatible Migration Template; Upload an updated template-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation project view.-Select a Change Project or Implementation project.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and open the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link.-Select Upload File button for Fixed Asset Migration Object.-Note: The Migration Template that you are try to upload is Fixed Asset (Extended).-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you are uploading the Fixed Asset (Extended) Migration Template into Fixed Asset Migration Object.-Resolution-If you want to upload this template then follow the below steps,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation project view.-Select a Change Project or Implementation project.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and open the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link.-Highlight Fixed Asset Migration Object row.-Select Actions button and choose Edit Unit.-Mark Use extended migration template for migration of fixed assets at the bottom of the pop up, as shown in the below screenshot:-Keywords- Fixed Asset (Extended), Incompatible Migration Template, Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity, Fixed Asset Migration, Edit Unit

Title: Unit of Measure in UoM Characteristics Tab Not Updatable via Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to edit the Unit of Measure field of a row under UoM Characteristics for Materials using the Mass Data Maintenance but, although the update completes successfully, the information is not being maintained in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center-Click link to Export Materials-Search for the Material you'd wish to update-Select the UoM Characteristics tab and click Export Data to CSV File-Open the CSV file, update the relevant information and then save the file-Go back to the Mass Data Maintenance work center and click the link to Import Materials-Browse for the CSV file, select the UoM Characteristics tab again and click Upload-Once the files finishes the data validation, click Execute Data Import; operation will finish successfully-Now go to Product Data > Materials and search for the relevant material-Open it and click View All-Go to the UoM Characteristics subtab under General tab-Unit of Measure data in the row has not been changed-Cause-The Unit of Measure is a key field under UoM Characteristics and it's not possible to change it through the Mass Data Maintenance. For example, if you have a row with Unit of Measure "meter" and want to change it to "roll", the Mass Data Maintenance cannot do that — the update will only finish successfully because the system interprets to be updating a row that already has "roll" as its Unit of Measure, even though it may not exist.-Resolution-The solution would be to add a new row with the desired Unit of Measure. This can be done through the Migration tool following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration > Overview-Search for the activity "Migration of Materials" and open it-Click the link to Migrate materials using the migration tool-Download the migration template from You Can Also-Add the relevant information to the template in the UoM Characteristics sheet and save-Upload the file to the Migration tool-Click Properties and change the mode to Enhance already existing records-Click Execute Migration Step by Step and proceed with the migration-Keywords-UoM Characteristics, update, UoM, materials, Mass Data Maintenance

Title: Cannot Update Price Components view Excel Add-In and/or Web Service
Content: Symptom-In this document we will use the Sale Order Excel Upload Template as an example:-You are trying to maintain price component data inside the template, however, you don't find valid/available fields to proceed with such action.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click New.-Select Sale Order from Microsoft Excel.-When the template opens, you do not find any available field to update price components.-Cause-Price component fields such as Total, Total Discount, Cost, Price Margin, Value Added Tax %, Total Net Value, Total Item Net Value and others cannot be updated via Microsoft Excel template or web service as these are calculated values.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Sale Order, Excel, Upload Template, Price Components, web service; webservice; cost; ManageCustomerQuoteIn; Cost Estimate; Quote; ManageSalesOrderIn; Changing Condition type not possible; the field is read-only

Title: Newly Created Company Name is Not Displayed in Companies View of General Ledger Work Center
Content: Symptom-The Company XYZ  (XYZ refers to the ID of the Company) is created and activated, with validity date as a date in the future. Although the Company is consistent, it does not appear in the General Ledger work center, Companies view, as well as other work centers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Companies view.-Search for Company XYZ.-No results are found.-Cause-For most of the organisational structure, we have two concepts of name - one is name, and one is current name. For most of the Financials screens, we get the "current" name node. In this case, there's no current name filled yet, because the company will only be valid in the future.-From that date onwards, the system will populate the current name and it will show correctly.-While creating org structures with Start Dates in the future, they may not behave as expected until their start date is reached.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. When the new Company reaches its validity date, it will then appear normally.-Keywords-Company, General Ledger, does not appear, no results, Companies, org structure.

Title: Error "Posting sales order item disabled; item completed" Occurs When Reversing Other Charge/Credit
Content: Symptom-You reverse an Other Charge/Credit, but get an error: "Posting sales order item disabled; item completed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customer Accounts View.-Search the customer account ABC.-Click View.-Find and open the document XYZ which is with document type Other Payable.-Open View All.-Click the button Reverse Other Charge/Credit; Then you get the error: "Posting sales order item disabled; item completed".-Cause-The Other Charge/Credit XYZ is referenced to Project Task DDD and Sales Order EEE; The status of the Sales Order EEE is completed(the status changed from In Process to Completed because you filled the Reason for Rejection in the sales order) which leads to the error.-To check the referenced Project Task DDD and Sales Order EEE:-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customer Accounts View.-Search the customer account ABC.-Click View.-Find and open the document XYZ which is with document type Other Payable.-Start adaption mode and tick the fields Project Task and Sales Order in the table of Account Assignment if necessary.-Now, you can see the Sales Order is EEE.-To check the status of the Sales Order EEE:-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-Search EEE and you will see the status of Sales Order EEE is Completed.-Open the Sales Order EEE, under tab General or tab Items, the field Reason for Rejection is filled.-Resolution-To reverse the Other Charge/Credit, you need to first change the status of the Sales Order to In Process:-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-Search and open the Sales Order EEE, under tab General or tab Items, remove the value in the field Reason for Rejection.-Click Enter and you will see the status of the Sales Order is In Process.-Click Save and Close.-Now, you can reverse the Other Charge/Credit XYZ.-Keywords-Posting sales order item disabled; item completed. Other Charge/Credit. 已禁用过账销售订单项目，项目已完成. 其他费用/贷项.

Title: Invoice Documents With Payment Deferred Indicator are Not Shown in Tax Reports
Content: Symptom-You are executing the All VAT/Sales Tax Items report and noticed that the invoices with tax payment deferral are not being shown, only the corresponding payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open and execute report All VAT/Sales Tax Items with proper selection parameters.-You see that all invoices with payment deferred are not being included, only the corresponding payment. Other invoices without payment deferred are being shown as expected.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior when the invoice has a tax payment deferred.  If you apply a tax deferral scheme, you cannot deduct this tax credit from your tax liabilities until you pay the invoice. Once you post the invoice, the system also posts the deferred amount to a special G/L Account for Deferred input tax. Only when the invoice payment is posted that the systems transfers the deferred tax amount to the regular input tax G/L Account.-Resolution-For invoices with Tax Payment Deferred, it's the payment document that is reported in the VAT Return. Hence, the reports shows the Payment instead of the Supplier Invoice for such cases.-See Also-Help Document: Tax Deferral Process for Supplier Invoicing-2467050 - All VAT/Sales Tax Items Report Does not Show All Customer Invoices-Keywords-Supplier Invoice. Customer invoice. Tax. Tax Deferral. Deferred Tax Payment. Tax Payment Deferred.

Title: Vacation Hours Do Not Show in the Recorded Employee Times Report
