Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the hour amount of time recordings of type Vacation or Leave are not shown in the Recorded Employee Times report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in as an Employee:-Go to the Home work center-Access the Employee Self-Services view-Click the Leave Request link-Record a leave request with standard time type "Vacation"-Log in as a Time Administrator:-Go to the Time Administration work center-Access the Reports view-Open the report Recorded Employee Times-Run it for the above employee-The Vacation entries are shown, but hours are not recorded-Cause-The Recorded Employee Times (HCMTLMB07_Q0001) report will not show any hours recorded for time type categories Leave or Vacation. Hence, you see the recorded times for these time types as 0,00.-The underlying business object which holds the data of this report is designed such that the Quantity for the full day recordings, including recordings spanning multiple days, is not allowed to be saved in the business object. Changes to the business object's design would have severe impact on the performance of the reports.-Resolution-Use the Employee Times: Overtime Overview report, as this shows the valuated results for each time recording and the hours will appear for all recordings.-Go to the Time Administration workcenter-Access the Reports view-Open the report Employee Times: Overtime Overview-You can also create a new report using the underlying MDAV of the Overtime report, which is HCMTLMU01. This MDAV will provide all the information that you require.-Keywords-Employee Time Recordings, Employee Times, Vacation Time Type, Reports

Title: Business User Access Restrictions Not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-You noticed that a certain business user in the system has access to data which should not be visible to them based on their access restrictions.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This issue may be caused by the fact that the business user (or the business role assigned to this business user) has one or more views from the PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT work center assigned.-PDI developers need unrestricted read and write access to the system. Therefore, the views from the PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT work center, when assigned, override any read or write access restriction set for other work centers.-Resolution-To solve this issue, please remove the PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT work center views (or the business role with these views assigned) from this user's access rights.-If this person will need to perform PDI development work, kindly consider creating a separate business user to be used specifically for this purpose, which can then be assigned to the PDI work center views or the relevant business role that has these views.-Keywords-write access, edit, restrictions, read access, access rights, restriction, work center, settings, PDI

Title: No Items When Creating A Withholding Tax Return Run for Italy
Content: Symptom-There are no items when creating a Withholding Tax Return Run for Italy, while there is a Supplier Invoice posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Tax Management.-Go to view Periodic Tasks -> Withholding Tax Return Runs.-Find the relevant Run ID.-See the Status is Active.-Scroll down to Application Log ID.-Click the Application Log ID.-On the new window, go to view Results and see the description:-No tax item exists for period DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-The reason for such system behavior is that the Invoices must be in Paid status to be picked while creating a Withholding Tax Return for Italy.-Resolution-You have to pay the respective Invoice and schedule the Withholding Tax Return again.-Keywords-Withholding tax, No items WHT.

Title: Material Cost Estimate Rollup XYZ Shows Warning "No Cost Estimates Selected"
Content: Symptom-You have executed the Material Cost Estimate Rollup XYZ (XYZ refers to the ID of the Material Cost Estimate Rollup), but it fails with error message "No cost estimate selected".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Material Cost Estimate Rollup view.-Select the run XYZ.-Go to Execution Details tab.-Open the latest execution.-Go to Messages tab.-See the warning message: "No cost estimates selected".-Cause-The reason for the error "No cost estimates selected" is because there is no valid Production Model on the dates used in the run.-Resolution-Maintain the Production Model for the respective date and material.-Keywords-No cost estimates selected, Material Cost Estimate Rollup, warning

Title: Recorded Employee Times Report Shows all the Time Recordings
Content: Symptom-Upon executing the report Recorded Employee Times (ID: HCMTLMB07_Q0001), the report shows all the time recordings, but not changes within these recordings. Canceled time recordings are still shown and this results in an incorrect overall working time for the day.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Reports view.-Find the report Recorded Employee Times.-Open the report.-Select the link to start the report.-In the Selection tab, provide the Employee ID and Key Date and apply.-In the View Tab on the top left, select the fields like Project, Project Task, Currency, and so on.-Select Apply.-The report Recorded Employee Times displays data of canceled time bookings.-Cause-The Status field is not enabled in the report. The report by default shows all times including Canceled time recordings.-Resolution-You can make the Active time recordings visible and remove the Canceled time recordings in the report's view by following the below steps:-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Reports view-Find the report Recorded Employee Times-Open the report-Select the link to start the report-In the Selection tab, provide the Employee ID and Key Date and apply-In the View tab, tick mark the required fields. Select the + button in the Row Selection and from the box window, select Status-Select Apply-In the Selection Tab on the top left, see the Status Field is now available and the Column Status is also visible in the report screen itself-The time recordings are now separated with Active and Canceled-In the Status field, select the dropdown box and select Active from the options, then Apply-Now the Canceled times have been removed and only Active ones are visible.-Keywords-Recorded Employee Times, Employee, Time recordings, Status, Time Administration, Canceled, Active, HCMTLMB07_Q0001

Title: Business Partner Record for Company is Not Available
Content: Symptom-You have marked an org unit as a company, but cannot find the business partner record which should be automatically created from it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common tasks.-Select an org unit.-Under the Details section, navigate to the Definitions tab.-Check the Company checkbox and enter the Country/Region of Registration.-Once the change is saved and activated:-Go to the Business Partner Data workcenter.-Access Business Partner view.-Search for the business partner using the company ID.-Search results shows that no records are found.-Cause-The ID of the business partner might differ from the ID of the org unit due to certain conditions (check the See Also section for more information).-In these cases, the new ID of the business partner will be taken from the General Business Partners number range.-Resolution-You can check what was the new ID selected for the business partner by doing the following:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Access the Org Structures work center view.-Select the relevant org Unit.-Under the Details section, navigate to the Definitions tab.-The Associated Business Partner field shows the new business partner's ID and name.-Using this ID, you will be able to locate the business partner in the Business Partner Data work center.-See Also-1694086 - Business Partners Generated for Companies Don't Always Have the Same ID As Org Unit ID

Title: Tax Return Status Changing Automatically to Completed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You notice that Tax Return ID AA  automatically changed status to Completed after you release Tax Return ID BB (for the same Tax Authority). No payments are assigned to Tax Return ID AA. Under Tax payment ID XX, you cannot see any option to select Tax Return ID AA. However, the amount of Tax Return ID AA and Tax Return ID BB is being calculated together once you select Tax Return ID BB in Tax payment ID ﻿XX﻿.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Tax Managment.-Subview Tax Return --> VAT Returns.-Show All Tax Returns.-Search for Country XX.-Result: Tax Return ID AA is completed however it shows Tax Payment Status as requested.-Tax Return ID BB is in status Reported (For same Country/Tax Authority/Company).-Go to Tax Payment.-Select relevant Tax Payment ID XX.-Result: Tax Payment ID XX, you can only select Tax Return ID BB and not Tax Return ID AA.-When you select Tax Return ID BB, the amount of Tax Return ID AA and BB is calculated together.-Cause-In Tax Management work center, Subview Tax Authority, under the effected Tax Authority you can see that in Company Tax Arrangements in tab Tax Return Arrangements, Carry Forward has been marked.- As per Help Document Tax Authorities Quick Guide:-The Carry Forward indicator is only relevant for certain countries, such as the US. Set this indicator if a receivable from the tax authority needs to be cleared in the subsequent period.-  This means the moment a new Tax Return ID is released, the previous Tax Return ID is put in Status completed since the system assumes that the Tax payment will be carried forward into the next period.-Resolution-Under Tax Return Arrangements for the effected Tax Authority, deselect Carry forward.-Reverse Tax Return ID BB (ensure that the Periods are Open before reversing).-Result: The moment you reverse Tax Return ID BB, Tax Return ID AA will go back to status Reported.-  Now you may create a new Tax Return ID and this time it will no longer effect Tax Return ID AA. For each Tax Return an individual payment must be cleared once Carry Forward is deselected.

Title: Time Recording Profile Missing from Employee's Time Profile
Content: Symptom-When you try to add a time recording profile to an employee, the time recording profiles you created are not displayed in the drop down list, even if they are already active in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration > Employees work center view.-Search for the relevant employee.-Select it and click Edit.-In the employee's time file, navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Click on the drop-down list of the Time Recording Profile field.-The time recording profile you were expecting is not shown in the list.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the start date of the employee is prior to the Valid From date of the time recording profile. Although there are some active time recording profiles in the system, they are not shown in the drop down list if their validity doesn't begin before the employee's start date.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-To edit the validity of the time recording profile, you can use the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Search for the Time Types fine-tuning activity of the relevant employee's country of employment (e.g. Time Types - Italy).-Open the activity list and then click the link Maintain Time Recording Profile.-Select the time recording profile you want to use and edit the Valid From" field to a date prior to the employee's start date.-Click Save (or Save and Close).-Keywords-time recording profile, missing, time profile, Time Types

Title: RBAM Error Message Displayed After User Login
Content: Symptom-After logging into the system and loading the home page, the following error message is displayed:-"RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on Instance XXXX of 'BONodeProxy <default> EST_EMP_WORK_CAL_QAF_CO <default> ROOT' in context 'UIApplication <default> /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/hcm/rpm/resourcefactsheetqaf.QA.uicomponent <default> <default> Operation <default> Start"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system with the normal user credentials.-After the Home page is loaded, the error message appears on the bottom of the screen.-Cause-This error is caused due to missing authorization for "Resource Search" to the specific user.-Resolution-In order to avoid the error message, define the write access of the "Resource Search" as unrestricted.-To do so, follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management.-Enter the Business Users view.-Search for the specific user which is facing the error.-Click Edit, then select Access Rights.-Navigate to the Access Restrictions tab.-Search for Resource Search and define the write access from the dropdown as "unrestricted".-Save and close.-If the user has Business Roles assigned, perform the below steps between steps 4 and 5:-Click the Business Role assigned to the user.-In the new screen with the business role definition, click View All.-Keywords-RBAM, Access restrictions

Title: Report Shows Expired Contracts as Active Contracts
Content: Symptom- The report Customer Contract Statistics (CRMCCOHHB) shows any number for 'No. Of Active Contracts' for Contracts which are already expired when zero is expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Contracts view.-Search for Contract ABC.-Click in the Edit button.-You can see that the Contract End Date has already passed and the Validity of the document is Expired.-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Reports view.-Open 'Customer Contract Statistics' report (Technical ID: CRMCCOHHB).-In View section put the Row Fields 'Contract' and 'Contract End Date'.-You can see that for Contract ABC the No. of Active Contracts is 1, for example, when 0 is expected.-Cause-This behavior is a technical limitation in the system. For these two cases the system doesn't work as expected:-Contract was canceled on a lesser month as compared to today's month.-Contract's End Date is at the end of the month. An automated BTM task took a little longer to execute and changed the validity status to expired on a timestamp greater than 12:00 of first day of the next month.-Resolution- There is no solution for these identified cases. The Development Team is working to resolve it in the future releases.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Customer Contract Statistics-Keywords-Contracts, End Date, Validity, Expired, Active Contracts, Report

Title: Payment Run Generates Single Payment When Pay Individually Flag is set
Content: Symptom-In the Supplier master data you have activated the Pay Individually functionality as you want the Payables Payment Run to create separate payments for each due invoice of  this supplier.-The payment run, however, does not split the payments but generates one payment for all due invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Supplier Base workcenter  navigate to the Suppliers view and find the respective supplier.-Pres Edit and select Financial Data.-Here, in the Payment Data subtab, under Payment set the Pay Individually flag.-Press Save and Close.-To trigger the automatic payments-navigate to the Payables workcenter and go to the Periodic Tasks - Payment Runs view.-Schedule a payment run including all open items of your supplier.-As the Pay Individually flag is set you expect the run to generate a separate payment for each due supplier invoice. Instead, the payment run creates a payment for all open invoices.-Cause-The system is designed in a way that the Pay Individually setting is active from the day of its activation*.-For all invoices created before this date the payment run will continue to accumulate all relevant invoices in one single payment.-For all invoices created on or after the Pay Individually flag has been set, the payment run will create separate payments.-Resolution-For all invoices, created before the Pay Individually setting has been activated, you need to manually create separate payments.-(*Please note The deactivation of this setting works the same way: Only for invoices created after the deactivation the payment run will accumulate all invoices into one single payment.)

Title: Manual Depreciation of Fixed Asset Is Not Permitted
Content: Symptom-When you create a manual depreciation of a fixed asset, the system gives error message: "Asset <XYZ> val. view <ABC>: Manual depreciation not permitted in calc. proc.".-XYZ means the fixed asset ID.-ABC means the valuation view ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Fixed Assets work center, choose Fixed Assets view.-In the Fixed Assets subview, select Fixed Asset XYZ.-Click Manual Posting and choose Manual Depreciation.-In the Depreciation Type field, enter either 1 Depreciation or 2 Special Depreciation.-Enter the other required information.-Click Simulate.-      The system returns error message: "Asset <XYZ> val. view <ABC>: Manual depreciation not permitted in calc. proc.".-Cause-Generally, the system posts 1 Depreciation or 2 Special Depreciation automatically, and 3 Write-downs can only be posted manually. The manual depreciation of 1 Depreciation or 2 Special Depreciation can only be posted if both of the two conditions are met:-The valuation view allows these depreciation types to be posted-The Depreciation Method maintained in the specified valuation view is 0000 No Automatic Depreciation or 0900 Manual Depreciation.-Since the Depreciation Method maintained is neither 0000 No Automatic Depreciation nor 0900 Manual Depreciation, it's not possible to post the manual depreciation of fixed asset XYZ with depreciation type 1 Depreciation or 2 Special Depreciation.-Resolution-To successfully post the manual depreciation of fixed asset XYZ, you have to change the deprecation type to 3 Write-Downs:-In the Fixed Assets work center, choose the Fixed Assets view.-In the Fixed Assets subview, select Fixed Asset XYZ.-Click Manual Posting and choose Manual Depreciation.-Enter the required information of Header and Set of Books.-Change the Depreciation Type to 3 Write down.-Enter other required information and click Post.-      The manual depreciation of the fixed asset XYZ should be posted successfully.-Keywords-manual posting; manual depreciation; special depreciation; write-down

Title: You Have Leave Requests in Approval, But No Approval Task Sent to The Approver
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that, although employees have submitted leave requests for approval, no approval task is generated to the approvers.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to My Requests subview.-The leave request in in approval, but no approval task was sent to the expected approver.-Cause-This is due to a mismatch in the Business Configuration scoping and the fine-tuning settings: the scoping question "Would you like to send an explicit approval task for a leave request to the manager?" is switched off, but the time type is marked as Approval from Line Manager Required in the Time Types fine-tuning activity under Maintain Approval Options.-Resolution-There are two possible solutions to this issue:-a. If you want leave requests to be activated without any approval-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Open the relevant fine-tuning activity for the country/region affected (i.e. Time Types - UK).-Access the Maintain Approval Options link.-Set approval option as Send Notification to Line Manager.-With this setting, leave requests will be activated as soon as they are released by the employees and the line manager will only receive a notification. For this, please ensure to have the scoping question "Would you like to just send a notification of a leave request to the manager?' added to implementation project's scope.-b. If you want leave requests to be approved by the line manager-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects.-Select the First Implementation project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Expand the Human Resources scoping element, then Time Administration.-Select the Approval option.-Enable scoping question "Would you like to send an explicit approval task for a leave request to the manager?"-Click Next to navigate to step 5 - Review.-Click Finish.-Keywords-Leave Approval , Approval , Leaves

Title: How to Delete Attachments in Item Level for Purchase Orders
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to delete the attachments of a Purchase Order in item level-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The customer wants to remove the attachments in item level however the Delete button is grayed out.-Cause-The Purchase Order is in 'Follow-Up Document Created' status. So you're only able to delete the attachments in the backend.-Resolution-Please make sure that the Purchase Order is not opened in the front end before starting the steps below.-Go to the backend.-Use transaction SESFTS. -Load BO by Proxy Name: /SRMAP/LPURX_PO-Below PurchaseOrder - Root, expand the Purchase Order's node ID.-Expand Item.-Select the expected item's node ID (Check the Purchase Order Item ID).-Expand the item's Node ID. -Expand ItemAttachmentFolder.-Select the attachment folder's node ID.-Select 'Set Edit Mode' (Pencil icon).-Select 'Delete BO Node Instance' (Recycle Bin icon).-Click in Save (Disk icon). -Then you can check in the front end if those attachments were deleted accordingly.-Those steps only allow you to delete all the attachments. It's not possible to choose what attachment to maintain / delete.-Keywords-Attachment; Purchase Order; Item

Title: No Fixed Asset is Created from Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are procuring a fixed asset via e.g. non-stock supplier invoice, however after posting the invoice, no fixed asset is created.-You ensured that:-The Cost Assignment is IMAT - Individual Material-The IMAT's product category is properly assigned to a fixed asset class.-The invoice line item amount is above the capitalization threshold.-Nevertheless, the asset is not being created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the respective invoice.-Go to Document Flow.-Open the resulting journal entry.-You notice that, even though the setup for fixed asset procurement is correct, no fixed assets got created.-Cause-The asset class to which the product category is assigned, is flagged as deactivated. Therefore, this asset class cannot be used for capitalization.-You can check the asset class deactivation as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Find and open activity Fixed Asset Classes.-On the screen that opens, click Asset Class deactivation.-See that the asset class assigned to the product category being used is flagged as deactivated.-Resolution-You either need to make the asset class active again or change the product category assignment to a currently active fixed asset class.-Keywords-Product Category. Expense Account. Fixed Asset subledger. Capitalization. Procurement.

Title: Modify Outbound File Resulting from Standard Payment File Structure
Content: Symptom-You are using the standard delivered payment file structures to generate outbound files, however your bank has requested some modifications to the file structure to comply with their bank-specific software. Rather than manually editing the file, you would like to copy the standard payment file structure and make manual adjustment via payment flexibility tool, however there is no option to copy the standard structures.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Click Edit payment file structures.-You see that there is no option to create a copy of the existing structures.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. Via Edit Payment File Structures, you are able to create and copy only your own structures.-Resolution-As an alternate solution, you can evaluate the feasibility of editing the resulting outbound file (generated with standard payment structure) via a custom add/PDI.-From the Studio, it is possible to update the file content of the generated file through the following path:  CompanyPaymentFileRegister (BO) --> OutgoingFile (Node) --> OutgoingFileAttachmentFolder (Node) --> Document (Node) --> FileContent (node) --> BinaryObject-Keywords-Payment File Structure. Outgoing bank transfer. PDI. Outbound File. Payment Monitor. Payment Medium Format. Payment Structure. Outgoung Bank Transfer.

Title: Not All Data Changes Are Available In The Change Log
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Changes tab of a record and notice that not all data changes are available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-For the sake of reproduction, we will focus on a property of the Supplier record in Business ByDesign. This behavior, however, applies to other records where change history is available in SAP Business ByDesign as well as in SAP Cloud for Customer.-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Access the Suppliers view.-Show All Suppliers.-Locate and open the relevant supplier record.-Go to the Communication tab.-Go to the Collaboration sub-tab.-Here, you are able to change the E-Mail address field.-Go to the Changes tab and click the Go button.-You are not able to see the change log for the E-Mail address value.-Cause-Not all data change is recorded in the change history. Additionally, the Changes tab in the UI will not display the entire change history in some cases, with certain logs being available only in the backend.-The framework is designed this way due to performance and data payload reasons.-Resolution-This is currently the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Changes, Not Recorded, Change History, Change Log, Performance

Title: Adobe LiveCycle Designer for SAP Business ByDesign Missing for Download
Content: Symptom-You wish to use Adobe LiveCycle Designer for SAP Business ByDesign, but it is missing in the list of additional software for download.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center-Access the Self-Services work center view-Under My Computer, click the link to Install Additional Software.-In the new screen, multiple additional software are listed, but Adobe LiveCycle Designer for SAP Business ByDesign is not found.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-Adobe LiveCycle Designer for SAP Business ByDesign can only be downloaded by system administrators. Hence, it is only available in the SAP Download Center.-To access it:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Under Business Flexibility, access the Download Center work center view.-Here you will find a list of additional software which includes Adobe LiveCycle Designer for SAP Business ByDesign.-If Adobe LiveCycle Designer for SAP Business ByDesign cannot be found here as well, please report an incident to SAP Product Support.-Keywords- Adobe LifeCycle Designer, Missing, Additional Software, Download Center

Title: Error When Creating New Quote via Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You are facing an 500 internal server error message when you are trying to create a New Sales/Service Quote or Sales Order using the Microsoft Excel template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will use Sales Quote as the document being created.-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Click the New button.-Select Sales Quote from Microsoft Excel.-Fill the template with the expected data.-Send the Excel file.-After some minutes, the system returns the 500 error.-Cause-The number of lines within the template exceeds the recommended threshold of 100 line items in a sales document for performance reasons.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-2891575 - Find the Cause for 500 Error during Excel Upload-2938699 - Unable to Upload Price List Via Excel-1923372 - Limitation on number of Items in CRM documents (Sales orders, Service Orders, Contracts, Quotes...)-SAP Business ByDesign Sizing Assessment Tool-Keywords-Sales Quote, Quote,  Microsoft Excel, Exception, 500 Error, Number, Line

Title: Weekly Maintenance and Upgrade Change Schedule in Private System Tenants
Content: Symptom-Your company is planning cutover activities, end month activities, data loads or any other task which will occur during the CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period) or upgrade phase.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-It is only possible to request for CMP freeze or change the upgrade date, if your tenants are placed in private systems. To proceed with such a request, open an incident to component SRD-CC-CI-CCS and inform that you have a private system and need to Freeze the CMP or - in case you want to change an upgrade date -  please provide us a new date in UTC time zone format.-We will forward your request to the Operations Team.-In case your tenants are placed in Multi-Customers systems and you would like to move them to private systems, please contact your account manager, SAP channel partner or SAP contact to discuss this.-Keywords-Upgrade, CMP Freeze, Change Upgrade, C4C, ByD

Title: All Possible Time Recording Statuses and Their Meaning
Content: Symptom-This knowledge base article lists all possible statuses for time recordings in the time sheets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The possible statuses are as follows:-Inactive: Time entry has been created, but not yet released for activation or approval.-Active: Time entry has been released without necessity for approval.-In Approval: Time entry has been released and is awaiting approval.-Approved: Time entry has been released and approved.-Rejected: Time entry has been released, but has been rejected.-Pending Change: Active, approved or rejected time entry has been changed, but not yet released.-Pending Cancellation: Active, approved or rejected time entry has been deleted, but not yet released-Cancellation - In Approval: Active, approved or rejected time entry has been deleted, released and is waiting for approval-Changes Rejected: Changes made on the time entry have been rejected.-Cancellation Rejected: Deletion of time entry has been rejected.-Cancelled: Time entry has been deleted (cancelled) and deletion has been approved.-Keywords-Time Entry, Time Recording, Status, Time Administration, Pending Changes, Pending Cancellation-in approval,rejected,active,approved,inactive,pending cancellation,pending change,changes rejected,cancellation rejected,cancellation - in approval,cancelled

Title: Change of Product Version Upgrade Schedule Not Possible for Multi-Tenant Systems
Content: Symptom-You would like to change the scheduled date for the product version upgrade to a later or earlier date and time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Once the product verison upgrade schedule is finalized, the scheduled date and time cannot be changed for multi-tenant systems.-Upgrades cannot be postponed or anticipated because SAP has multi-tenancy system infrastructure — hence, changing the date and time of the upgrade for one customer would affect other customer's schedule.-See Also-2522663 - How to Check the Product Upgrade Schedule in the System-2929110 - Weekly Maintenance and Upgrade Change Schedule in Private System Tenants-Keywords-Change product upgrade, Change version upgrade date, change upgrade schedule

Title: How to Find the FSI View Name for a Screen or Query
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This knowledge base article describes how to determine the FSI view name for a certain screen or query.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-NOTE: The steps in this KBA must not be performed in a customer system. Please execute steps in our IRAs.-Log on to the frontend and the backend of the tenant using the same user credentials.-Access backend transaction SE37-Enter function module TREX_EXT_SEARCH_CELL_TABLE and click Display-Set an external breakpoint in the first executable line by just clicking the Set/Delete External Breakpoint button.- In the frontend, access the relevant screen or trigger the relevant query.-The ABAP debugger starts. Double-click i_indexes in the left-hand column, then double-click I_INDEXES in the right-hand column.-Here, you can find the INDEX_ID (in this example:, ".c002:1fs:jdx_product_id_ovs_co").-Remove the section from the beginning of the INDEX_ID until after the first underscore (in this example, ".c002:1fs:jdx_") and what remains is the name of the FSI view.-Once done, go back to the debugger screen and remove the external breakpoint by selecting the code line in which it was set and clicking the Set/Delete External Breakpoint button again.-Keywords-Find, FSI View, Name, Determine, Query, Work Center, TREX_EXT_SEARCH_CELL_TABLE

Title: Error when upload Lead: 'You cannot change the data in Reason for Status'
Content: Symptom- You are unable to upload a lead in the Standard template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Marketing work center.-Go to Leads view.-Click in the New button and select Leads from Microsoft Excel. -Put the necessary information in your template. -Upload the file via Excel Add-In.-You get the error: '1 record(s) failed to save due to the errors: You cannot change the data in Reason for Status. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.'-Cause-You've maintained multiple fields that contribute to actions in the Lead process, such as Lead status Accepted or Qualified. So you're trying to have the lead accepted and handover.-However, to hand a Lead, you must have a Sales Employee maintained.-Resolution-Maintain a 'Employee Responsible - Sales' in your Excel template.-Keywords-Lead, Reason for Status, Excel, Template, Add-In

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Error Message Profit Center Missing: Profit Center Accounting Active From DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-While migrating Fixed Assets you get the following error messages during simulation:-"Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY."-"Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select the Migration Object Fixed Assets (extended).-Click Process File.-The following messages are displayed:-"Errors detected during import simulation-Import Simulation (Errors Found, Warnings Found)-Error detected in source record with key value.-Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY.-Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY. "-Cause-You have activated Profit Center and Segment accounting as the reporting principles of your set of books.-The profit center derivation does not work at migration stage. You have to maintain the profit center and segment in the template and migrate the data once again.-Resolution-You have to maintain the profit center and segment in the template and migrate the data once again.-The fields Profit Center ID and Segment ID are hidden in the Excel file of the migration file.-You need to unhide the rows and enter the data.-Alternatively, change the data directly in Step 1-Process file via Actions - Edit.-Keywords-fixed assets migration, Anlagen, migration, profit center accounting active, profit center missing

Title: Expense Arrangement is Missing Under Document Related Reports
Content: Symptom-In the Business Partners view of the Information Lifecycle Management work center, you observe that Expense Arrangement document is missing under document related reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Information Lifecycle Management work center.-Go to Business Partners View.-Search for the Business Partner 1234(represents Business Partner Id).-Click on View and Delete Disclosure List button.-Click on Document Related Reports-Only Expense Reports is showing up but not Expense Arrangement.-Cause-In the Business Partners view of the Information Lifecycle Management work center, under the View and Delete Disclosure List, only those reports that the user is authorized to access are displayed under Document Related Reports.-Resolution-You have to grant access to Travel and Expense work center to the user(here 1234).-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to User And Access Management View.-You need to go to Business User view, find the specific business user and click the Edit button, then select the Access Rights option. Once the new window opens, you will have the ability to manage the access rights manually for this specific business user, if he or she is not assigned to a business role (access provided by business role render individual access rights irrelevant).-See Also-Expense Reports Quick Guide-Keywords-Information Lifecycle Management, Expense reports, expense arrangement

Title: How to Create an Extension Field in a New Outgoing Check Document
Content: Symptom-You are the Key User and want to add an Extension Field in the Outgoing Check Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Click New Payment By -> New Outgoing Check.-Click View All.-Press Key user settings -> Start Adaptation Mode. -Select any field, for example Check Number field.-Click with the Right Mouse button and press Extension Fields.-Change the Business Context to 'Manual Payment - Payment Order Root'.-This will add an Extension Field in the Payment Order Business Object.-Click Create New Field.-Enter the relevant details.-Press Save.-Select the newly added field and maintain the 'Is Already Added' checkbox.-Click Show Further Usage.-In the new window, go to the Extension Scenarios tab.-Select the Extension Scenario 'Payment Order - Root - Outgoing Check - Outgoing Check Root'.-Click Add Field.-After this, the created Extension Field will flow from the Payment Order to the Outgoing Check Business Object.-Change the Business Context to 'Outgoing Check - Outgoing Check Root'.-The new Extension Field which was derived from the Payment Order would be visible.-Click Show Further Usage.-Go the Form Templates tab.-Select the required Outgoing Check Form.-Press Add Field and Edit.-Adjust the field in your Form according to your needs.-Click Close.-Click Publish.-Now the Extension Field would be available when creating a new Outgoing Check.-Keywords-Outgoing Check, Extension Field, Payment Order.

Title: Only Cost Center Available in Account Assignment Type Codelist
Content: Symptom-You create a journal entry voucher with type of 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher.-When you select G/L Account AAAAAA in the line item, you can see a lot of options in the Account Assignment Type codelist. However, when you select G/L Account BBBBBB, you notice there is only Cost Center available in the codelist of Account Assignment Type. (AAAAAA and BBBBBB represents the number of the G/L Account)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger and select common task New Manual Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter required fields.-Select Set of Books XYZ (XYZ stands for the ID of Set of Books).-Select Journal Entry Type as 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher and Screen Variant as 601 - Journal Entry Voucher.-Select G/L Account AAAAAA, you can see a lot of options in the Account Assignment Type codelist.-Then select G/L Account BBBBBB, you can only get Cost Center in the Account Assignment Type codelist.-Cause-Refer to business configuration activity Mandatory Account Assignments. For chart of accounts of Set of Books XYZ, G/L account BBBBBB is listed as having Cost Center as mandatory account assignment. It also has service order and customer contract - these types will not appear in the codelist for manual journal entry voucher though because they are specific for sales ledger, which doesn't have account assignment visible on the screen but derives it based on the entries in the line item.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Account Assignment Type, Manual Journal Entry Voucher, Mandatory Account Assignments

Title: Custom Productive Time Type for Overtime Deducts Hours
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom productive time type to be used by your employees when registering overtime, but this instead deducts hours from the total. -Or-You are unable to see Vacation Hours as expected in Credited Hours of the Time Statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This employee has an exception-based time recording method.-For exception-based time recording method, employees are expected to only record vacation, leaves and special time types — the productive time is automatically registered by the system based on the agreed working hours.-As such, if an employee with exception-based time recording and agreed working hours of 40h/week registers additional 10 hours using a productive time type, the system interprets this registered time is part of the agreed hours, only with a different definition. Instead of recording as 40 hours plus the 10 hours recorded manually, it will record the automatic productive time as 30 hours and use the time recorded manually to complete the 40 hours of the week that were agreed.--Absences are taken into consideration only up to the maximum of Daily Target Hours. Full day absences for exception-based time recorders are calculated for the working time account based on the daily average hours from the employees time profile.-Resolution-Please consider changing the employee to a positive time recording method (working hours are recorded manually by the employee). In this method, overtime recording is supported and works as expected.-Keywords-Overtime, Deduction, Productive time, Time Statement, Absence, Credited Hours, Target Hours

Title: Warning Message in VAT Return Run: 'Invoice ID missing'
Content: Symptom-You have executed a VAT Return Run and received the warning message 'Invoice ID missing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Select the relevant Tax Return Run.-Open the related Application Log.-Go to the Results tab.-The Overall Status is 'Warning Issued' and you can find the warning message 'Invoice ID missing'.-Cause-This warning message is raised for Expense Reports that have been created without the External Reference ID. This field is used as the Invoice ID in Expense Reports.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-In case the affected Expense Reports have to be submitted to the Tax Authority, then the Expense Report needs to be recreated with the External Reference ID information.-The External Reference ID field can be maintained in Expense Report -> Expenses tab.-Keywords-VAT Return Run, Application Log, Expense Report, Invoice, External Reference ID.

Title: Cannot Find an Employee in the Substitutions View
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set up a substitution, but when you try to enter an employee, it is not found by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Access the Substitutions work center view.-Click the New button, then select Substitutions.-Enter an employee in the Employee or the Substitute field.-Press Enter.-Employee is not found.-Alternatively:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Access the Substitutions work center view.-Click the New button, then select Substitutions.-Click the value help for the Employee field.-The relevant employee is not listed.-Cause-There can be multiple causes for this, such as, for example, if the employee is not active in the Personnel Administration work center (or Employee Data work center, if you're using replication).-If this is not the case, the cause can be that the employee's associated business user is not assigned to a Business Role.-Resolution-Substitutions in the system work by providing access rights to one employee from another employee's business role. As such, both of the involved employees' respective business users need to be assigned to a business role for the substitution to be enabled.-You can assign business roles to users in the Application and User Management work center, under the Business Roles work center view or within the business user's record in the Business Users work center view.-Keywords-employee, not found, substitutions-substitution,employee

Title: More Than 3 Years Open, Creation of Future Fiscal Year not Permitted When Opening New Fiscal Year
Content: Symptom-You are trying to open a new fiscal year in your company but system will not allow as the error message appears 'More than 3 years open, creation of future fiscal year is not permitted'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To create a New Fiscal Year-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Press Edit Fiscal Years button.-Press New Fiscal Year button.-Error message is raised: 'More than 3 years open, creation of future fiscal year is not permitted'.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign it is not allowed to keep more than 3 fiscal years open.-Resolution-You need to close at least one previous year in order to be able to open another fiscal year. To close the fiscal year, you can refer to Help Document 'Closing Activities - Year-End Closing' available at the Help Center of your system.-Keywords-Fiscal Year. Closing Activities. General Ledger. 3 years open. Mehr als 3 Jahre offen: Anlegen von zukünftigem Geschäftsjahr unzulässig.

Title: Search Filter For Partner Companies under Payables or Receivables Does not Work as Expected
Content: Symptom-You have selected the Partner Companies query under Supplier Accounts view, however not all partner companies are returned as expected in comparison to the Partner Companies list under General Ledger.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Change the query to Partner Companies.-You notice that number of entries returned differ from the number of Partner Companies shown under General Ledger -> Partner Companies.-Cause-The Partner Companies screen in General Ledger combines both companies within the org unit (and associated standard business partner) and also partner companies set up within the screen itself via New button. If the partner company is derived directly from the org unit then the system does not store a dedicated affiliation period, but derives the dates from the Org. Unit time lines. However, if the partner company is created in the screen itself the system allows an entry for From and To, which is then stored as affiliation in backend.-The query for Partner Companies in the Supplier Account view is build so that it searches only through the Partner Companies which has a dedicated affiliation period instead of a date derived from the Org. Unit. Therefore, only Partner Company entries created from the General Ledger -> Partner Companies screen are returned by this query.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-All the partner companies accounts will be correctly shown via the All Suppliers query, which also allows you to create and save a custom query.-Keywords-Supplier Account. Partner Company. General Ledger.

Title: Error Account determination for inventories is not defined in business configuration for account determination group - for Unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You notice the unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation ZZZ in the Source Documents view due to error message 'Account determination for inventories is not defined in business configuration for account determination group ABC'.-(ZZZ means the Goods and Activity Confirmation ID.-ABC means the Account Determination Group name.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation ZZZ.-Notice the error message: 'Account determination for inventories is not defined in business configuration for account determination group ABC'.-Cause-There is no G/L account assigned to Account Determination Group ABC for Gain from Inventory Revaluation and Loss from Inventory Revaluation of Inventories subledger.-The system has identified an inventory balance difference between the value at time of the Good and activity posting in a previous accounting period and the inventory balance in the current period.-This difference could, for example, have been caused by rounding and a different way of valuating outgoing stock (Qty * Resulting Inventory Value/ Resulting Inventory Quantity) and incoming stock (Qty * Resulting Inventory Cost).-Resolution-In the Business Configuration work center find and open the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination Fine Tune activity, either via Overview or from the Activity list of the Implementation Project.  -Under Account Determination select Inventories.-Navigate to the Gains and Losses tab.-Enter a row for Account Determination Group for Materials ABC and maintain a G/L account for both Gain from Inventory Revaluation and Loss from Inventory Revaluation.-Save the changes.-As a result, Goods and Activity Confirmation ZZZ can be posted from the Source Documents view of the General Ledger.-See Also-There may be another root cause of the same error, please refer to KBA 2869516.-Keywords-Goods and Activity Confirmation, GAC, Gain & Loss from Inventory Revaluation

Title: Revoking Period Not Possible: Only One Open Interval Allowed
Content: Symptom-You want to open the Period PPP+3/YYYY (PPP+3 stands for the period and YYYY stands for the year) for Set Of Books ABC (ABC stands for the Set of Books) but get the error message: Revoking period PPP+3 not possible: Only one open interval allowed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Open and Close Periods subview in Common Tasks view.-Enter the Company ID as XYZ (XYZ is the company ID) and the Set of Books as ABC and click Go.-Filter to Fiscal year YYYY and Accounting Period ID PPP+3.-Click Open Period.-You get the error message Revoking period PPP+3 not possible: Only one open interval allowed.-Cause-You are getting this error message as it is not allowed to open Periods which do not correspond to the same interval (an interval of three consecutive periods).-For example, Periods PPP/YYYY, PPP+1/YYYY and PPP+2/YYYY are three consecutive Periods which falls in one interval and are preceding Period PPP+3/YYYY.-If you have Period PPP/YYYY open and then the Periods PPP+1/YYYY and PPP+2/YYYY closed and you are trying to open Period PPP+3/YYYY, you will get this error message.-Resolution-You need to open the Periods PPP+1/YYYY and PPP+2/YYYY which corresponds to the interval of the Periods PPP/YYYY, PPP+1/YYYY and PPP+2/YYYYand then open the Period PPP+3/YYYY.-Keywords-open period; accounting period; revoking period

Title: How To Update a Change Project from Productive System
Content: Symptom-After doing immediate changes in the active workspace of your productive tenant after creating a change project, it is necessary to update the open change project with the data that has been changed to avoid inconsistences during merge back. This knowledge base article explains how to execute this operation.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Project work center view.-Click the link in the relevant change project's title.-In the new screen, click the Actions button.-Select option Update Project from Production option.-After the update is done, the change project should be consistent with the productive system.-Note: in case of a remote change project, these steps must be executed in the test tenant to which the change project was moved.-Keywords-Update Project from Production, Change Project, Immediate Change, Consistent

Title: Error "Material ID XYZ Not Valid; It Does Not Fall Within the Allowed Range" While Saving a New Material
Content: Symptom-You may have a requirement to define the Material ID by using alphanumeric and special characters. But while defining a new material, system throws following error message: "Material ID XYZ not valid; it does not fall within the allowed range" (where XYZ stands for an actual material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In Business ByDesign:-Go to Product Portfolio Work Center.-Select view Products.-Select By Materials subview.-Click New, to create a new product.-Enter a Material ID which is the combination of special characters and alphanumeric characters. For example: 1234-AB.-Fill other required fields with any data and click the Save button. -System throws above error message.-In Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Products work center.-Then go to the Product Administration view.-Click New, to create a new product.-Enter a Material ID which is the combination of special characters and alphanumeric characters. For example: 1234-AB.-Fill other required fields with any data and click the Save button.-System throws above error message.-Cause-If the setting for alphanumeric and special characters number ranges is not maintained in the fine-tuning activity Number Range for Materials, it is not possible to use alpha numeric characters/special characters for Material ID.-Resolution-Go to work center Business Configuration. -Access the Overview work center view.-Search and open fine-tuning activity Number Range for Materials.-Enter the length of the Material ID in the field Total Length (including prefix).-Fill the fields Start Number and End Number according to your requirements and make sure to set Interval Type as Manual-Now you are able to define the Material ID using alphanumeric and Special characters.-Please note that lexographic check is used for number ranges. Hence the length of the Number range cannot be limited for a particular length. -Please check the 'KBA 1867307 - Materials are Created With the IDs Which are Out of the Range Maintained in Business Configuration' for further details.-Below, you can find some examples on how to set up the number ranges:-Example 1:-Start Number: .-End Number: Z999Z-Interval Type: Manual-Then you can define Material ID like: 1X2-5, 5-01A, 1-99Z, A12J-Example 2:-Start Number: .-End Number: Z9999999Z-Interval Type: Manual-Then you can define Material ID like: 0X001A-1A, 1256-01AA, 10001-99Z, 9X1234Z99, A1236GHAG-Keywords-new material, create material, material number range, material ID not valid, allowed number range

Title: How to Find the Responsible Development Component for an Access Context
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This incident details how to determine the responsible component for a certain access context.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Firstly, in backend transaction SE11:-Enter Database Table RBAMCTXPROV.-Click the "Display" button.-Click the "Content" button.-If you now the ID of the access context, enter it in the ACCESS_CONTEXT field. Otherwise, skip this step.-Click the "Execute" button (or press the F8 key).-Copy the PROVIDER_CLASS for the relevant access context (in this example, 1010 - Employee). If you didn't know the access context ID, you can locate the relevant access context in the list by its name here.-Now go to transaction MDRS:-Click the "Repository Browser" button.-Select "Class / Interface" from the dropdown menu and paste the PROVIDER_CLASS value copied earlier.-Double-click the object name (in this case, CL_AP_ACXPROV_GENERIC).-Navigate to the "Properties" tab.-Double-click the package name (in this case, AP_RC_RBAM_ACCESS_CONTEXT).-In the next screen, you will find the responsible development component under the "Application Component" field. -Keywords-Access Context, Component, Development, RBAMCTXPROV-access context,component

Title: You are not Able to Remove the Standard Filters
Content: Symptom-You want to remove the standard filters from the OWL (Object Work List), however, you do not find any option available to perform such action.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will use the Sales Orders OWL.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click on the Filters icon. -You do not find any option to delete/remove the standard filters-Cause-Removing the standard filters from the system is currently not supported.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Filter, Access, Remove, Standard, Delete, OWL, Sales Order

Title: Different WIP Values are Shown When Comparing WIP Inventories Against G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reconcile the WIP Balances report with the G/L Account - Line Items for a specific accounting period. However, you note that the amounts are different in each report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design reports view.-Open the G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-Give the relevant company, set of books, G/L Account for WIP and accounting period (for example 008/2021).-Check the final balance for this period and G/L Account.-Open report WIP Inventories - Balance Summary.-Give the relevant company, set of books, G/L Account for WIP as in step 4. and Key Date as 31.08.2021 (last day of the selected period).-Execute the report and refer to the total WIP Value.-The WIP Value shown in the WIP Balance Summary report differs from the balance shown in the G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-Cause-This happens due to the current design of each report. The Balance Summary cannot be fully compared with reports where you enter a specific period, since a Key Date is used as selection instead of the period itself, which may not result is a precise match.-Resolution-In this case, you can refer to the Production Lots - Line Items report, which has a period-specific selection and can be compared with the G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-Keywords-WIP Clearing. G/L Account. Production Lot. Balance Summary.

Title: Sales Order is not Pulling Ship-To Address from Account
Content: Symptom-When clicking on the Address Details option from the Ship-To within a Sales Order, you expect to see the Ship-To options maintained under the Addresses subtab of the Communications tab from the Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Under the General tab, click on the Address Details hyperlink in Ship-to Section.-Click on the value box of the Address field. -The options which are being presented are not the options maintained under the account.-Cause-The system is not selecting or retrieving the data from the accounts Address subtab, since the Ship-To party is a different business partner and the system will retrieve the data maintained under the Ship-To business partner.-In this example we will use Account XYZ and Ship-To HIJ.-Under the Sales Order ABC, the account being used is Account XYZ and Ship-To HIJ.-When navigating to the Address subtab of the Account XYZ, you see several addresses which you have maintained a Yes for Ship-To.-However, the Ship-To party being used in the Sales Order ABC is HIJ, hence the system will retrieve the addresses information from the business partner HIJ and not from the Account XYZ.-  Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order, Ship-To, Address, Account, Wrong, Value, Business Partner

Title: How to See All PDI and KUT Extension Fields on a Node
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You wish to see how many custom and PDI/KUT extension fields are on a business object node.-In this document, we will cover:-Standard Business Objects.-Custom Business Objects.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You want to see the number of elements on a Business Object node.-You are searching for a specific Business Object element. -Resolution-The following guideline can be used in many different scenarios while troubleshooting issues.- Standard Business Objects:-Log into the backend of the affected tenant.-Go to the transaction SE16.-Enter the table name /EXT/L_HANA_TABLE.-  Copy the table name from the BO / Node combination you are searching for. Example: /1XT/D3807_***-Open a new window and go the transaction SE11.-Enter the table name in the field Database table and hit display.-You will now see all the KUT or PDI extension fields that are on that business object node.-  Custom (PDI) Business Object:-The following method is mainly used for PDI created business objects. This is because PDI created BO's will not show in the table /EXT/L_HANA_TABLE.-Log into the affected tenant.-Go to the transaction MDRS.-Filter for Business Objects.-Search for the BO which you want to investigate and select this.-Locate the Node you want to check and double click on to show the details.-You will see a section on the overview called 'Implementation Details'.-Copy the Tabel/View name and repeat steps 5 - 7 for Standard BO's above.-    Alternatively, you can search in SE11 for the custom BO using the PDI solution name. If you also do not find the standard business object in the HANA table, please follow the same steps in MDRS to locate the table name.-Knowing how to check this can be very beneficial and allow you to solve multiple issues regarding extensibility and PDI issues.-  Keywords-Business, Object, Standard, Custom, KUT, PDI, MDRS, HANA, SDK

Title: Information "Item ABC/XX excluded: Revenue recog for this item completed in SoB XYZ" in Revenue Recognition
Content: Symptom-You get the information "Revenue recog for this item completed in SoB XYZ" (XYZ stands for set of book ID) in one revenue recognition run. But the sales order item hasn't been completed for revenue recognition. The Revenue fully recognized indicator is not set.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center and Revenue Recognition view.-Open the run log and go to Messages, you can see such information.-Go to Cost and revenue work center and Sales Document Items view.-Find item ABC-XX and select it.-Navigate to the Accounting Data sub tab.-TheRevenue fully recognized indicator is not set. -Cause-In general, this information message appears when executing a revenue recognition run for a sales order which contains items that are already completed for revenue recognition. You can verify this in the Sales Document Items view where you will notice that the Revenue fully recognized indicator is set for the item.-However, in case the Revenue Accounting Contract functionality is activated for the set of books a situation can occur where the revenue recognition run notes this information, even though the Revenue Fully Recognized indicator is not set for the item.-This happens when the sales order item is connected to a revenue accounting contract which is associated with further sales document items that are not yet completed.-In this case, the run identifies the item as completed and therefore does not expect it to be further processed, but it will block the revenue fully recognized indictor from being set until all sales document items connected to the run are completed.-Say, there are SO item 1-10 and 2-10 in Revenue Recognition. And the message occurs for 1-10.-If the message appears for SO item 1-10 then this item’s status is completed and a final delivery and invoice date is maintained (sales doc items view in cost and revenue, Dates tab).-When the RAC functionality is active then the revrec no longer works on SO level but on RAC level.-If item 2-10 belongs to the same RAC but is not finished then the info message will appear for SO item 1-10. Its fully recognized indicator will not get set until also 2-10 is completed.-So with the RAC functionality all sales doc items associated with the RAC must be completed. The revenue fully recognized will then be set for all these items.-If an item of a RAC is completed but others are not yet completed, then the message appears. The completed item is excluded from being processed. However, the fully recognized indicator can only be set once all items of the same RAC are completed.-Resolution-Please monitor if all sales order items of the same RAC are recognized in separate revenue recognitionss-Keywords-Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting Contract

Title: How to Enable More Than Two Currencies for AP/AR Open Items Migration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-  ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are not able to migrate Open Items Payable or Receivable with more than two Currencies on the template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently it is only supported to migrate a Company Currency and a second Company Currency, for example two different Currencies for the migration of Open Items in accounting.-However, a Customer can have further Set of Books in other Currencies and wish to migrate them as well.-In Standard Excel Templates there are no columns for this and system also raise error messages due to the system logic if a customer attempt to proceed.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-However, there is a workaround that can be applied in order to migrate Open Items with more than two Currencies.-Pre-requisites:-Customer needs to maintain the template with the other Currencies.-Customer must ensure that there are historical Exchange Rates, for example an Exchange Rate maintained that is valid on the Migration Posting Date, from the main Currency to the other Currencies needed.-Written approval to proceed.-Product Support: Once the pre-requisites are fulfilled you can forward the Incident to DS Development - Component SRD-FIN-ACP.-***BELOW STEPS WILL ONLY BE PERFORMED BY DEVELOPMENT***-How to execute:-Request L7 Authorization.-Go to the Class CL_FAI2D_CREATE_ITEMS=>SET_AMOUNTS.-Comment the following code (currently between lines 95 and 114, but this can change).-Once the migration is completed, revert the changes using the L7 Authorization.-See Also-3125401 - Migrate Open Items Receivable/Payable With more Than Two Currencies - Currency Missing but Needed in Set of Books-Keywords-Migration of Accounting, Payable, Receivable, Open Item, Currency, Multiple Currencies.

Title: Employee Workplace Contact Address Not Updated Automatically Upon Change of Org Unit Address
Content: Symptom-You have changed the main address of an org unit in the system, but noticed that the Workplace Contact Data address of an employee assigned to that org unit was not updated automatically.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center-Click Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks-Set the Effective From date as desired.-Select org unit XYZ (where XYZ stands for an actual org unit ID).-In the org unit details, under the Address tab, edit the main address as desired.-Save and activate the change.-Now, go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Select an employee assigned to org unit XYZ and click Edit.-Navigate to the Employment, then to the Workplace Contact Data subtab.-Here, the address has not updated to the new address set for org unit XYZ.-Cause-Since there are several cases in which organizational changes are meant only as changes in the reporting line unit or manager reallocation, the employee workplace address does not change automatically when changing details in the employee's organization assignment.-This is a design decision in order to avoid incorrect changes in the employee addresses when performing minor organizational changes.-Resolution-You must edit the employee address directly in the Workplace Contact Data section of the employee record.-Additionally, you can edit multiple employee's Workplace Contact Data as follows:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center-Access the Employees work center view-In the object worklist, select multiple employees by clicking them while holding the Ctrl key pressed.-You can also select one employee and, while holding the Shift key press, click one employee multiple rows above or below the first one to select all employees between them.-Once the selection is completed, click Actions, then select Mass Change Workplace Contact Data.-Enter the new address in the fields and click Save (or Save and Close) to apply the change to all selected employees.-Keywords-Workplace Contact Data, Address, Employee, Org Unit, Change, Update, Automatically

Title: How to Bypass the Self-Service Access Restriction for Support Users via Backend (Emulate Business User)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to observe data or reproduce an issue which requires you to access self-service work centers and views, but when trying to do this with the suppor user, the system raises error message as "Technical users are not authorized to access Employee Self-Services" (in some views and reports, the data will not be shown).-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The below steps should be performed in the backend:-Note down the technical user ID of a business user which you intend to emulate (you can check this in Application and User Management > Business Users).-Login to backend with support user credentials.-Go to the Class Builder using transaction code SE24.-Enter the Object Type Class as CL_IDENTITY_FACTORY, then click the Display button.-Double click on the Method GET_OWN_IDENTITY highlighted below.-Set an external breakpoint (just click the button marked in the screenshot below or use option Set/Delete External Breakpoint).-Now go to the frontend UI and take the step to access the work center view (or the report) which you were not able to access with the support user.-The control switch to ABAP Debugger will open in the backend.-Double click on the SY-UNAME (line 7) and click the Edit icon highlighted in the below screenshot.-  Remove the SAP_SUPP ID and enter the business user technical ID which you noted down in step 1 (in this example, it is 0990F0LBLACK).- Press Enter to confirm the change, then press F8 button until the UI opens.-You will see the contents of this screen as if you were accessing it with the business user whose technical ID you used. You'll have to repeat steps 8 to 11 for every action you try to execute or new screen you try to open while emulating this user's access.-IMPORTANT: once done, remove the breakpoint set in step 6 by pressing the same button (or using the Set/Delete External Breakpoint option again).-Keywords-Emulate, Simulate, Business User, Bypass, Self-Service, SY-UNAME

Title: The Actual Cost Allocation Run did not Processed a Material as Expected
Content: Symptom-You executed an actual cost allocation run and you expect it to revaluate the inventories for a specific material. However, no postings occurred and the material is displayed under the Not Processed tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Actual Cost Allocation view.-Open the affected run.-Go to Not Processed tab.- See that a material is listed as not processed, whereas you expect the run to allocate the costs accordingly.-Cause-The Actual Cost Allocation Runs revaluate the inventories based on the difference between the preliminary postings to inventory or cost of goods sold and the actual costs calculated by actual cost rollup runs. If you check the figures calculated by the rollup runs, you see that there is no difference identified, hence no postings are made by the allocation run.- You can verify this as follows:-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Material Actual Costing view.-Search for the respective material and business residence.-Refer to the entries that have a Valid From that covers the accounting period/year selected in the allocation run.-Click Edit. -Once you open the material actual costing, you see that the Variance column is 0,00.-You can also refer to the Allocation tab and see that Preliminary Amount is the same as the Cosing Result. Therefore, there would be no cost allocation for the allocation run to process.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. For more details, you may refer to help documents Actual Cost Allocation Runs and Actual Cost Rollup.-Keywords-Actual Costing. Costing Result. Allocation Run. Inventory Valuation. Material.

Title: Error Message "Save Failed" When Trying to Remove an Employee's Bank Account
Content: Symptom-You would like to delete an existing bank account from an employee's payment information data, but when trying to save the changes, you receive error message "Save Failed" (which in some cases might be accompanied by message "Main bank account for bank transfer payment method missing").-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Search for the relevant employee.-Select the employee's record and click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Personal Data tab.-Next, navigate to the Payment Information subtab.-Select the only existing Bank Account row and click Delete.-Now, click Save or Save and Close.-The error message(s) will be raised.-Cause-For an employee whose payment method is set as Bank Transfer, there must always be one main bank account registered in their payment information data.-Resolution-There are two possible solutions for this scenario, depending on your intentions:-You can create a new bank account, set it as Main using the respective checkbox and then delete the previously existing one;-You can change the payment method of the employee for one which is not Bank Transfer, then delete the existing bank account.-Keywords-Employee, Payment Information, Bank Account, Delete, Save Failed

Title: Cannot Create a service Agent Using SAP INITIAL USER.
Content: Symptom-You not able to create a service agent using the SAP_INITIAL_USER.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the First Implementation Project and open the Activity List.-Open the activity Define Key Users for Project Team and select the option Create Service Agents.-The message will be displayed on the Screen.-Technical user does not have the correct access rights.-Cause-The activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted is not confirmed yet.-Once the activity is confirmed the SAP_INITIAL_USER will get all the necessaries access right required to create the service agent.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the First Implementation Project and open the Activity List.-Open the activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted and confirm it.- Please make sure you have done all the necessary changes at the scope before complete the Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted.-See Also-Work center >>HCM_RESOURCEMANAGEMENT view >> HCM_RESOURCEPROFILES.-Work center >> BPM_BUSINESSPARTNERDATA view>> BPM_BUSINESSPARTNERS , BPM_SUPPLIERSCENTRAL , BPM_SERVICEAGENTS.-Work center >>PRO_PROJECTMANAGEMENT  View >> SCM_SOURCEDETERMINATION.-Work center >> SCM_PLNGANDPRODNMASTERDATA View >> SCM_SOURCEDETERMINATION.-Work center >> SRM_SUPPLIERBASE View >> BPM_SERVICEAGENTS.-Keywords-Initial User, Service Agent

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Posts Negative Revenue After POC Change
Content: Symptom-You execute a revenue recognition run for sales order item XYZ-XX of project ABC (XYZ-XX represents the sales order item ID, ABC represents the project ID). -The sales order item is assigned to a POC based accrual method, for example 108-Recognize using Cost-to-Cost Project POC. -In the run's application log you notice a negative Current Recognized Revenue Amount. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find run XXX and open the Log Result.-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab.-Choose the Advanced Information tab and select POC-Based.-Find the entries for sales order items XYZ-XX.-In the Current Recognized Revenue Amount a negative value appears. -Cause-The Percentage of Completion (POC) has been reduced for the sales order item since the last update run.-When using POC based accrual methods then the due revenue is realized according to the calculated/manually maintained POC. The POC is calculated with the formula Actual Cost ÷ Planned Cost.-Example:-For Sales Order item XYZ-XX a Net Value (planned revenue) of 1000,00 LC (Local Currency) is calculated.-In a previous run a POC of 40% is to be used. Accordingly, 40% of the item's planned revenue are realized, 400,00 LC.-Later, the POC got reduced, either-manually or-by reducing the actual costs, for example due to expense reversals or manual journal entry adjustments-by increasing the planned cost (for accrual method 108 this means, further planned work or expenses, or materials were added to the project)-Now the POC of the sales order item is 30%.-The next revenue recognition run checks all previously posted values.-As the POC is now 30% only 30% of the sales order item's net value are due to be realized.-The run therefore reduces the revenue by 100,00 LC which appears as a negative figure,  -100,00 LC,  in the Current Recognized Revenue amount column.-Resolution-To analyze why the revenue recognition run calculates a negative amount in the Current Recognized Revenue amount column-1.
