Check the Revenue recognition history report:-In the Sales Documents Items view find Sales Order item XYZ-XX.-Press Revenue Recognition and choose Revenue Recognition History. -In the report check, the Total Earned Revenue amount of the update run executed before the run that recognized the negative revenue amount. -Take note of the run's ID. -2. Check the last Update run:-In the Revenue Recognition view, find the run which you just noted down.-Open the Application log and navigate to the Processed Successfully tab.-Choose the Advanced Information tab and select POC-Based.-Check the POC used and compare this with the POC used of the current run. -You'll notice that the POC previously used is higher than the POC used in your current run. -3. Find out why the POC has been reduced:-3.a. POC data of the sales order item:-In the Sales Document Items view find Sales Order item XYZ-XX.-Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and choose Percentage of Completion. -Compare the Last POC used value and the Calculated value: The calculated value could be lower than the last POC. Or a manual, lower POC is maintained. -3.b. Change log of the Sales Order item:-In the Sales Document Items view find Sales Order item XYZ-XX.-In the Administrative Data tab press on the View Changes link.-Check if there has been any manual change of the POC since the last update run. -3.c. Check if there are any reductions of the Actual Costs:-In the Sales Document Items view find Sales Order item XYZ-XX.-Press Reports and choose Sales Document - Line Items for Project. -Check if there have been any expense reversals or manual journal entry postings that reduced the actual cost of the project since the last update run. -Should you still not be sure why the POC used by the current run is lower than the POC used by the last update run contact support.-Keywords-negative current recognized revenue, POC, 108, 102

Title: Low Value Asset Deactivation not Possible by Scrapping
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are not able to deactivate Low Value Fixed Asset (LVA).-Disclaimer: "Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental".-Reproducing the Issue-Goto the Fixed Assets work center.-Navigate to the Fixed Asset view.-Show all Fixed Assets, find XXX and click Go.-Press Manual Posting - Complete Scrapping-Click on button Simulate.-You get an error message: An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset XXX. LowValueAsset YYY val.view - Deativation Not Possible; NBV >0-(XXX represents the Asset ID and YYY represents the name of the view path)-Cause-From a legal perspective - a divestiture of an LVA in Germany must not have any effect on the depreciation of that LVA. -There is no retirement posting in the valuation view of the Fixed Asset which is an LVA. Such assets are not deactivated as well.-Resolution-In the here applied scenario - this asset should not be classified as LVA.-Goto the work center Fixed Assets, view Fixed Assets.-Show all Fixed Assets, find XXX and press Start.-Press Edit - Master Data.-Change to tab Life Cycle Data.-Deactivate the checkbox Low-Value Asset on the right.-Press Save.-Now you have to cancel the Supplier Invoice and repost it. If you have done it via a manual Journal Entry Voucher cancel the Journal Entry Voucher and repost it. Then you can deactivate the Fixed Asset - in case  this has not been effected already automatically.

Title: No Separate Posting of Price Components in Journal Entry due to Gross Pricing
Content: Symptom-You create sales documents resulting in price reductions, such as discounts, and/ or surcharges, such as freight.-You expect that the respective  price components are separately posted to designated functional G/L accounts according to settings made in the Account Determination fine tune activity. The resulting customer invoice journal entry however does not show entries separating revenues from other price-components.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center go to the Journal Entries view. -In the search field, enter the customer invoice ID and Enter. -Access the journal entry. -You notice that there are no separate posting lines according to the discount and / or surcharge price components. -Cause-The Default Pricing is set to Gross:-In Fine Tuning access the Configure Price Strategy activity. -Select Default Pricing. -Here, Gross is selected for the relevant distribution channel. -Resolution-The default pricing setting does have implications for accounting, based on how line-items and price-components are computed. The default pricing is always Net, unless otherwise defined.-When selecting Gross Pricing,  entered freight charges are not posted separately to the designated freight G/L account.-Similarly, no separate posting lines are generated for price reductions.-Discounts or surcharges can be separately posted only when selecting the Net pricing procedure. When Gross pricing is active all components are accumulated in the sales revenue posting line.- Example:-Freight of 8,00 Net or 9,25 Gross (VAT rate 19%) / Unit--Pricing Procedure is Net:-Net Price:                                             100,00 EUR-Pricing Component - Freight:               8,00 EUR / Unit = 14,11 EUR-Value Added Tax (incl. Freight):          21,68 EUR*-Total:                                                   135,79 EUR*-In the resulting journal entry additional price-components are segregated after VAT.-Revenues:                                         100,00 EUR*-Freight/Other Revenues:                     14,11 EUR*-  Pricing Procedure is Gross:-Gross Price:                                        119,00 EUR        -Pricing Component - Gross Freight:    9,25 EUR / Unit = 16,31 EUR   -Value Added Tax (incl. Freight):         21,60 EUR*-Total:                                                  135,31 EUR*- In the resulting journal entry additional price-components are not segregated after VAT.-Revenues:                                         113,71 EUR*--* Differences in decimals are due to rounding logic in applied scenarios.-Keywords-gross pricing, net pricing, price components

Title: How to Read the Days Outstanding Key Figure in The Payment Statistics - Customers Report
Content: Symptom-You are checking the payment statistics of a certain customer in a certain period in the Payment Statistics - Customers report.-You notice a result in the Days Outstanding column but you can't figure out how this number has been calculated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Receivables workcenter navigate to the Reports - List view.-Open the Payment Statistics - Customers report.-In the Customer field select the respective customer.-In the Proposed Posting Date maintain a period span, e.g. Last 14 days.-Press Go.-A value is displayed in the Days Outstanding column but it is not clear how this value has been calculated.-Cause-The Days Outstanding key figure value is being calculated with the following formula:-Proposed Posting Date x Total Open Receivables - end of period/ Total Receivables in the period.-The parameters Total Open Receivables - end of period and Total Receivables in the period are not available in the report. They can't be added either.-Resolution-It is still possible to derive the Days Outstanding value:-A) Proposed Posting Date:-The Proposed Posting Date parameter represents the number of days within a period.-Example: For the relative selection value Last 14 days the value is 14.--Please note: If you select the Operator <=Less Than or Equal with date MM.DD.YYYY, then the report calculates the days, starting from 01.01.1999 up until MM.DD.YYYY.-Example: If you enter <=Less Than or Equal - 31.10.2014 then the Proposed Posting Date, i.e. number of days is 5783.-B)Total Open Receivables - End of period:-This parameter represents the total Outstanding Amount of all items that are still open at the end of the specified time span.-C)Total Receivables in the period:-This parameter represents the total sum of the Document Amount of all items that have been open during a specific time span.--To find the Document amount and the Outstanding amount values navigate to the Details of All Items - Customers report from the Payment Statistics - Customers report:-In the Receivables workcenter navigate to the Reports - List view.-Open the Payment Statistics - Customers report.-In the Customer field select the respective customer.-In the Proposed Posting Date maintain a period span, e.g. Last 14 days.-Press Go.-Now click into the cell displaying the Payment Amount.-A very small arrow appears in the bottom right corner of the cell.-Click on this arrow and select Details for All Items - Customers.-First note down the result in the Outstanding Amount column. This value represents the Total Open Receivable - End of Period parameter of the formula.-Then note down the result of the Document Amount column. This value represents the Total Open Receivable in the period parameter of the formula.-You can now calculate Proposed Posting Date x Outstanding Amount (result)/ Document Amount (result).-Example:-Proposed Posting Date: Last 14 days = 14-Days Outstanding result: 7-Navigate to the Details of All Items - Customers report-Outstanding Amount: -50,00 LC-Document Amount: -100 LC-Formula: 14 [Proposed Posting Date] x -50 [Outstanding Amount (result)] / -100 [Document Amount (result)] = 7. -Keywords-Payment Statistics. Days Outstanding.

Title: Extension Fields in Fixed Asset Do Not Show in Extended Migration Template
Content: Symptom-You have created extension fields in Fixed Asset General Information. But you cannot see them in the extended migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-You already have the extension fields in General Tab of Fixed Asset.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Select the Fixed Assets view.-Select the Fixed Assets.-Open any fixed asset.-You can see the extension fields you have created.-And you can download extended migration template of fixed asset.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project name and click on Open Activity List button.-On the Fine-Tune chevron search for the Perform Data Extraction activity and open it.-Select Download migration templates tittle.-Search for the Fixed Assets (extended) Migration Object, and click on Download.-The excel template will open. However, on the tab Master Data you are not able to see the new fields created on the Fixed Asset screen.-Cause-Only extension fields in the General Data section of the Basic Data will be added to extended migration template of fixed asset.-Resolution-You have to add the extension fields for the fixed asset in adaption mode to the General Data section of the Basic Data instead of other sections, such as the Detail Assignment section.-Keywords-Fixed Asset Migration, Extension Fields, 固定资产迁移，扩展字段

Title: Past Cleared Invoices are Still Shown in the Aging Report
Content: Symptom-The Aging List for Payables report is showing paid invoices for a given key date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Lists view.-Open the report Aging List for Payables.-Specify the parameters as required.-You see an outstanding amount, which belongs to an invoice and payment. Nevertheless, the invoice was suppose to be cleared at that point in time (Key Date).-Cause-There are some scenarios that lead to this behavior.-Example:-You have the invoice open and paid with an outgoing check with posting date on 01.11.2017. After that, the check was voided on 15.01.2018 and a replacement check was automatically created, which has then been reversed with cancellation on 15.01.0218.-On 01.02.2018 the invoice is cleared again.-Therefore, when checking the Aging List for Payables with key date on 31.12.2017, you expect the invoice and payment to not be shown, since it would had been cleared by the first check.-The Aging list checks the clearing date of the document and displays on the report based on this date. The invoice got cleared again in clearing on 01.02.2018, hence for any date before this the invoice would be shown on the report irrespective of any older clearings that it might have been initially locked in.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior of the report.-Keywords-Aging List for Payables. Payment cancellation. Clearing. Aging Report.

Title: Manual Dunning Level in Customer Account is not Considered in Dunning View
Content: Symptom-You have manually maintained a Dunning Level in Customer Account, however the system is using a different Dunning Level in Dunning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Select the relevant Account.-Click View.-Select the Invoice ABC. -Click Item Details.-The Dunning Level was manually set as 1.-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning View.-Select the relevant Dunning Proposal.-Click Edit.-The Document ABC had Dunning Level as 2, however you expected it should be 1 as per Item Details in Customer Account.-ABC - Invoice ID-Cause-This is happening because the Invoice ABC is already overdue and should already be on Dunning Level 3.-This is due to the Baseline Date that was used, for example 80 days ago.-When you manually set the Dunning Level on the Customer Account, the Run automatically moves it up a level because the Invoice is 80 days overdue and should therefore be at the highest Dunning Level.-Every time you execute the Run it is always going to move up one Level from what you have set until it reaches the highest Level.-It will not follow the Dunning Strategy in this case because it should already be at the highest Level. All the intervals defined in the Dunning Strategy have already passed.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Dunning Proposal, Dunning Level, Invoice ID.

Title: Sales Order Volume Report Does Not Update The Request Date.
Content: Symptom-Sales Order Volume Report is showing different Request Date that is shown on Sales Order document.-Environment-Sap Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Reports View.-Open the Sales Order Volume report.-In the selection choose the restriction for Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID for which you find the Request Date is different from Sales Order Volume Report).-In the View section,  click Add Field option to add Request Date in the View.-Run the report and you can see that the Request Date does not match with the Sales Order Request Date.-Cause-The data source you are reviewing is based with focus on the Item node.-Resolution-If you change the items in the sales order and hit refresh in the report, the data is refreshed.-If you change header details, you will not see this change until you re-open the report.-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order Volume Report; Request Date; Wrong Request Date;

Title: You are not Able to Select Project When Creating New Sales Quote and Use Creating with Reference Option
Content: Symptom-You want to create new sales quote and create with reference to project, but project is not listed in the reference type list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities view.-Open the oppoortunity ABC. Click View All button. (ABC represents the ID of an opprotunity)-Select Follow-Up Sales Quote, system creates new quote.-Click Create With Reference button, in the new screen, open Reference Type list, project is not there.-Cause- Once items are added in the new sales quote, you are not able to use Project as reference type.-Resolution-There are 2 possible solutions:-1, Manually add the project task on the item lines.-2, Remove all the items, then use 'create with reference option'-Keywords-Create with Reference; Sales Quote

Title: Error While Migrating Fixed Assets: 'Invalid/no local currency for item of set of books ABC valuation view XXX'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Fixed Assets and receive some error messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Migrating of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select Migration Object Fixed Assets.-Click Process File.-The following error messages are raised:-'Error detected in source record DEF'-'Invalid/no local currency for item set of books ABC valuation view XXX'-ABC - Set of Books ID-XXX - Valuation View ID-Cause-The relevant Company has two Set of Books with different currencies and you are using the lean Fixed Assets template for migration.-Resolution-As per the help document Configuration: Migration of Fixed Assets - In case the Set of Books have different currencies, the Extended Migration Template for Fixed Assets shall be used.-See Also- Help Document Configuration: Migration of Fixed Assets-Keywords-Migration, Fixed Assets, Currencies, Company, Set of Books.

Title: Error Happens When Run the Payload "Update not possible; existing data for ITEM not fully specified"
Content: Symptom-You expect to update the Service Confirmation via webservice, however, the response comes as error: Update not possible; existing data for ITEM not fully specified.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You run your payload e.g. (Note that all relevant values have been changed to a placeholder as 'XXXXXX')-<soapenv:Envelope-    xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"-    xmlns:glob="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-    <soapenv:Header/>-    <soapenv:Body>-        <glob:ServiceConfirmationBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-            <BasicMessageHeader/>-            <ServiceConfirmation ItemListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">-                <ID>XXXXXX</ID>-                <Item actionCode="02">-                    <UUID>XXXXXX</UUID>-                    <ID>XXXXXX</ID>-                    <Product actionCode="02">-                        <ProductInternalID>XXXXXX</ProductInternalID>-                        <QuantityMeasureUnitCode>XXXXXX</QuantityMeasureUnitCode>-                    </Product>-                    <ScheduleLine actionCode="02">-                        <Quantity unitCode="EA">XXXXXX</Quantity>-                        <UUID>XXXXXX</UUID>-                    </ScheduleLine>-                    </Item>-                </ServiceConfirmation>-            </glob:ServiceConfirmationBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-        </soapenv:Body>-    </soapenv:Envelope>-The response comes as error: Update not possible; existing data for ITEM not fully specified.-Cause- As per current logic when modification is being set for <ScheduleLine> then it is looking for alternate key as <Id> and that is not passed in payload.-Resolution-So please add <Id>ABC</Id> in ScheduleLine to avoid this error. (Where ABC represents the relevant ID for the scenario).-Follow example given below:-<ScheduleLine actionCode="02">- <Id>ABC</Id>-<Quantity unitCode="EA">XXXXXX</Quantity>-<UUID>XXXXXX</UUID>-</ScheduleLine>-Keywords-Service Confirmation; SOAP; Webservices; Update; Error; Payload;

Title: Cannot Edit Payment Method for Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You want to edit the Payment Method field of a Customer Invoice, however, the field is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the document ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice).-Click Edit.-Payment Method field is not available for editing.-Cause-The Payment Method field can only be maintained in two scenarios.-When creating the source document of the Customer Invoice.-For example, when creating the Sales Order document, you have the option to add the Payment Method which will be retrieved to the Invoice.-or-When creating a New Manual Invoice, you have the option to add the Payment Method which will be retrieved to the Invoice.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform and submit an idea.-Keywords-Payment Method, Customer Invoice, Disable, Grayed Out, Cannot Edit

Title: Error While Creating Expense Report: 'Mandatory account assignment for account ABC is Missing: Project Task'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an Expense Report and receive the error message 'Mandatory account assignment for account ABC is missing: Project Task'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select the relevant Expense Report ID.-Click Edit.-Click Submit.-System raises the following error messages:-'Expense report cannot be submitted because of errors in settlement'-'Mandatory account assignment for account ABC is missing: Project Task'.-ABC - Account Description-Cause-The reason for the error message is the settings in Business Configuration -> Account Assignment Types -> Maintain Account Assignment Types.-You have set the Account Assignment PRO for Project Task as mandatory for Expense Report or several Business Transactions including Expense Report.-As a consequence, each Cost Assignment in Expense Reports must have a Project Task.-However, in case the Expense Report has an Expense which is Paid by Company, then the system assigns to the main Cost Center independent on any Deviating Cost Assignment, for example Project Task.-Hence, setting Project to mandatory Account Assignment Type and Paid by Company Expenses together are not supported in Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-If the mandatory Account Assignment Type for Project is maintained it won't be possible to create Expense Reports with Expenses Paid by Company.-Keywords-Expense Report, Account Assignment, Project Task, Expenses Paid by Company.

Title: Update of Employee Address Through Web Service Causes Previous Data to Be Overwritten
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer reports that trying to update an existing employee with a new address using the ManageEmployeeIn web service causes the original address to be overwritten.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If the addressInformationListCompleteTransmissionIndicator is set to true in the request payload, the system whole address information node with the new data. This means that even if there are two addresses already created for this employee, they will both be deleted and only the address being passed in the payload will be left in place.-Resolution-Customer needs to set the addressInformationListCompleteTransmissionIndicator to false.-Note: should this cause error message "Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for EMPLOYEE_DATA-ADDRESS_INFORMATION - ADDRESS_INFORMATION_CTI", the customer will need to add the UUID of the ADDRESS_INFORMATION node to the payload.-Keywords-MaintainEmployeeIn, web service, address, replace, Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for EMPLOYEE_DATA-ADDRESS_INFORMATION - ADDRESS_INFORMATION_CTI

Title: Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound Not Set to Active by Default in Account Communication Data
Content: Symptom-You notice that, under the Communication tab of an account, the "Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound" document type is the only one not set as Active by default.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center-Access the Accounts work center view-Find and select the relevant account-Click the Edit button, then select General-Go to the Communication tab, and then select the Collaboration sub-tab-You can see that the Business Document "Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound" is not Active by default, whereas all other documents are set to Active.-Cause-This is currently the standard system behavior.-Resolution-Please check the SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence to submit a request for this functionality.-Alternative, you can create the Collaboration for the account using the "ManageCustomerIn" web service and set the Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound to Active in the same payload (check the See Also section for more information).-See Also-Documentation for inbound web service "ManageCustomerIn" in SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound, Active, Communication, Collaboration, Account

Title: Org Unit Categorization Missing in Customer Tenant
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports that they cannot locate the Org Unit Categorization functionality.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center-The Org Unit Categorization functionality should be available under the Common Tasks section, as in the screenshot below:-Cause-The Org Unit Categorization is currently a hidden functionality, activated upon customer request only by development team.-Resolution-Create an incident to the SRD-OM-OM development team along with the help document below, to activate the functionality in the relevant tenant.-Activate Organizational Unit Categorization Work Center for the Tenant - AP PLM/PRO - Wiki@SAP-Keywords-Org Unit Categorization, Missing, Functionality, Scope, Activate, SAP Business Bydesign

Title: Upload of Target Group via Excel is Generating a 500 SAP Internal Service Error
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a new Target Group using the Microsoft Excel with a high number of records and when trying to perform such, the system returns the 500 Error or it does not conclude the execution leading to timeout.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Marketing work center.-Select the Target Groups view.-Click New.-Select Target Group from Microsoft Excel.-Enter the expected master data.-Click Save data to.-System returns:-Error: 500 SAP Internal Service Error-Or-The execution does not conclude and times out-Cause-At the moment, it is recommended to create Target Groups with no more than 5000 records, so as to avoid system inconsistencies and allow a better performance.--Also, currently it is not supported the update use case through excel upload.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-In case you require to upload a Target Group with more than 5000 records, please use the A2X service available in the through the following:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Service Explorer view.-Search for ManageTargetGroupIn.-Here you will find the needed information to perform the creation via Webservice.-See Also-2920405 - Following Error Occurs when Exporting the Members of a Target Group: 500 SAP Internal Service Error-Keywords-Target Group, Error 500, Error, 500, Records, Marketing, Webservice

Title: 'Cost center missing' Error in Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-While posting a Payment Allocation you can get the error message: 'Cost center missing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocations view.-Select and edit the relevant payment allocation.-Go to the Allocation to G/L Account tab.-Enter the relevant data.-Click Post.-You get the error message: 'Cost center missing'.-Cause-While posting a Payment Allocation system takes Cost Center as a default Account Assignment Type. This is a hidden field in Personalization Mode. You need to enable the Account Assignment Type field from Personalization Mode and change the type to ACC - General Ledger Account only.-Resolution-To enable the Account Assignment Type field, kindly follow the below steps:-Go to the Payment Allocation screen.-Go to the Allocation to G/L Account tab.-On top of the screen, right-hand side, click the photo icon and click Start Personalization Mode.-Select the UI Element Unnamed Table.-Select the UI Element Account Assignment Type and mark the Visible checkbox.-Click Save.-Now, you can change the Account Assignment Type to ACC - General Ledger Account only.-Click Post.-As a result, the Payment Allocation is posted successfully.-Keywords-payment allocation; cost center missing; account assignment type; CC; ACC

Title: Start Date and End Date Not Being Filled For Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-When you are creating the credit memo, start date and end date not being filled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Centre.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Select and Invoice and click on the Follow-Up button and choose Credit Memo.-In the new Credit Memo, the Start Date and End Date is blank.-Cause- Functionally the start date and end date are not needed for a credit memo, cancellation invoices.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Credit Memo; Start Date; End Date; Cancellation invoices; Cancellation Inovice

Title: How To Create New Reasons for Payment Differences
Content: Symptom- You want to create new reasons for payment differences in fine tuning activity Reasons for Payment Differences-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the activity Reasons for Payment Differences.-Select a Country/Region, select a Grouping for Payment Differences.-Under Assigned Payment Differences Reasons table, click Add Row.-Notice that it's not possible to create a new Payment Difference Reason. You can only select one of the existing values using the dropdown arrow.-Resolution-Currently it is not possible to create new reasons for payment differences other than standard SAP delivered.-Keywords-reason; payment differences

Title: Open Items not Due For Payment are Being Included in a Payment Proposal by a Payment Run
Content: Symptom-You have created a payment run for a business partner with bill of exchange with/without acceptance maintained. However, you notice that not overdue items were picked up and there are different Net Due dates within the same payment proposal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Automatic Payments view.-Open the related payment proposal.-Go to Open Items tab.-In the open items table you notice that the system proposed documents that are not yet due for payment. You also notice different net due dates within the same proposal.-Cause-The payment run proposes payments for not overdue items when for the respective business partner has the payment method Bill of Exchange with/without acceptance maintained. If there are multiple invoices with different due dates then the system picks up the oldest invoice due date as the due date for all items for BoE payment processing.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. If you do not wish to propose payments for not due items, then the Bill of Exchange payment method needs to be removed from the accounts. In case Bill of Exchange is maintained, the payment run proposes payment for the not due open items.-Keywords-Bill of Exchange. BoE. Payment Run. View Payment Proposal. Customer Account. Credit Memo. Invoice. Open Item.

Title: Profit Overview by Key Figure Report Shows Key Figures as &T2&, &T3&
Content: Symptom-The key figure names in the columns is displayed as &T2&, &T3&, etc in the standard report Profit Overview by Key Figure when logged in e.g. English language. In e.g. Chinese login the key figure names are shown correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon in English. -Go to Business Analytics work center. -Go to Design Reports view.-Open Profit Overview by Key Figure.-Run the report.-Check key figure columns. The key figure names are &T2&,&T3& etc..-Logon in e.g. Chinese and follow the same steps. The key figure names are correctly shown.-Cause-The corresponding financial reporting structure (the contribution margin scheme in the report) has been uploaded only in Chinese language - even at the header level in English login, there's no description, and if you edit, there are no texts available.-The financial reporting structures can be checked as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit financial reporting structures.-Resolution-You need to translate the corresponding reporting structure to English. If the financial structure nodes don't have a corresponding node translated in target language, then texts cannot get picked in the report.-Keywords-Profit Overview. Chart of Account. Financial Statements. Reporting Structure.

Title: Advanced Search not Executing the Saved Query in the Object Value Selector
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Save Query is not working as expected in the value help/object value selector of Project Task for deviating cost assignment of an expense report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Create a new expense report on behalf of employee (any employee).-Go to the Expenses step.-Add a new expense row.-Under the details of this new expense row, click tab Deviating Cost Assignment.-Change the Account Assignment Type to e.g. Project Tasks.-Open the value help for the project task field.-Click to open the advanced search. You'll see that the Employee ID field is pre-populated.-Make the employee ID field blank and execute the query.-Click Save Query to save this query with employee ID blank.-Set it as default and to execute on selection.-Close the value help and open it again.-You see that saves query shows as selected, however the system seems to execute the default query instead with the employee ID populated.-Cause-In value help selections/object value selector the Save Query isn't supported, hence always the system's default selection query will be executed (in this case with the employee ID)-Resolution-This is the designed behavior of this framework.-See Also- 2067305 - Project Task not Selectable in Expense Report-Keywords-Expense Report. Employee. OVS.

Title: Error During Individual Material Scrapping, Complete Scrapping or While Posting Customer Invoice for Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-While doing one of below actions you receive error messages:-Complete Scrapping of Fixed Asset.-Individual Material Scrapping of Fixed Asset.-Post Customer Invoice of an IMAT (Individual Material)-Errors:-An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XXX-Asset XXX val. view YYY: Posting not possible; disposal amount is too high-Error occurred while determining values to be posted for fixed asset ZZZ - XXX-XXX - Represents the Fixed Asset ID.-YYY - Represents the View ID.-ZZZ - Represents the Company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-One possible scenario is:-Go to the Fixed Asset work center.-Go to the Fixed Asset view.-Select Fixed Asset XXX.-Click Actions - Complete Scrapping.-Click Post.-An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XXX-Asset XXX val. view YYY: Posting not possible; disposal amount is too high-Error occurred while determining values to be posted for fixed asset ZZZ - XXX-Cause-This can occur because a Credit and Debit Acquisition were posted for one of the IMATs to a Fiscal Year different than the original Acquisition Fiscal Year.-The system is not able to handle these calculations.-Resolution-To adjust this case, you need to Reverse the Journal Entry Voucher that posted the Credit Acquisition.-In case your need was to transfer an Amount to another IMAT we recommend you to check below scenario:-Create a second Fixed Asset.-Perform a Partial Transfer of the needed Amount from IMAT of Fixed Asset XXX to the new Fixed Asset.-After this is done you will be able to perform the action as per your specific scenario (Scrap or Customer Invoice).-Keywords-Fixed Asset; An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset; Posting not possible; disposal amount is too high; Error occurred while determining values to be posted for fixed asset-fixed asset,an error occured during depreciation,posting not possible,disposal amount is too high,error occurred while determining values

Title: How to Edit Fund and Function in a Sales Transaction
Content: Symptom-You have sent a Point-of-Sales Sales Transaction into the system and when opening the document, you expected to see Fund and Function and have the possibility to edit it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Sales Transaction under the Point-of-Sales view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Transaction).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Sales Items.-Select the item which you expect to see Fund and Function.--Fund and Function does not show under the item.-Cause-As of the 2108 upgrade, Fund and Function is editable under the Sales Transaction document. This can be performed by selecting the Revenue Assignment.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To solve this, please perform the following:-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Sales Transaction under the Point-of-Sales view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Transaction).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Sales Items.-Select the item 10.-Navigate to the Revenue Assignment subtab.-Expand Account Assignment Type.-Select General Ledger Account Only.-The system will allow you the option to enter the expected Fund and Function.--Select Project Task.-Enter Project XYZ (XYZ Represents the Project Task).-If a Fund and Function was assigned to the Project Task, this will be retrieved automatically to the line upon entering the task and the field will be disabled for editing.-  See Also- Fund and Function Assignment Quick Guide-Keywords-Fund, Function, Sales Transaction, Point-of-Sales, Sales, Point, Revenue Assignment

Title: Reference ID From Down Payment Request Gets Blank After Release
Content: Symptom-You have created a Down Payment Request with Sales Order Reference using webservice, and after releasing the Down Payment Request, the Reference ID field is blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To find the webservice:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer view.-Search for the web service ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-Select the button Download WSDL to download the WSDL file for the webservice.-Using a third party tool like SOAPUI, run the Request Payload:-Log in to the SOAPUI tool-Select File -> New SOAP Project.-In the Initial WSDL field, browse for the downloaded WSDL file for ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-Select Request 1.-Paste the Request payload.-At the bottom of the screen, select Auth (Basic).-Provide the relevant credentials and the domain.-Run the Request Payload.-To check the Down Payment Request in the system:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search and open the previously created Down Payment Request.-See that field Reference ID is filled with the Sales Order Reference ID.-Now you follow the same steps to release the Down Payment Request using webservice, and after checking in the system the field Reference ID is now empty.-Cause-The issue is caused by the use of both SalesOrderReference and ExternalReferenceID in the payload. Both these tags are related to the same node in the BO, and  hence it causes an inconsistency. Please note also that if you send only SalesOrderReference tag, BuyerParty tag must appear in the Payload, otherwise the same  error will happen.-Resolution-If you want to have the Down Payment to be associated to the Sales Order, Please use the SalesOrderReference tag only. This would be similar to the Create Down Payment button that would be seen in the UI of the Sales Order.-Keywords-Down Payment Request, SalesOrderReference, Reference ID, reference, empty, blank, release, Payload

Title: Supplier Account is Showing as Checking on the ACH File Instead of Savings
Content: Symptom-The ACH File is showing code 622 (checking account) instead of 632 (savings account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments.-Filter relevant Payer/Payee.-Select relevant Document ID.-Click relevant Outbound File ID.-Click View All.-Go to the Attachment tab.-Open File.-The file shows: 622XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, while you expected 632 since this is a Savings Account.-Cause-This happens due to missing digit in the Account information on the Supplier Account.-Resolution-To adjust this you need to add the Digit to the Account:-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Open relevant Supplier Account.-Go to Financial Data tab.-Go to the Bank Data sub-tab.-You notice here that the Check Digit is empty.-The check digit determines whether this account is Checking or Savings, if there is no Digit the system will assume it is a Checking Account.-To configure the Account as a Savings Account you need to add '02' in the Check Digit, anything else will result in a Savings being selected.-Keywords-Payment File, ACH, Checking Account, Savings Account-payment file,ach,checking account,savings account

Title: Migration of Open Payables: Item Amounts Must Be Positive
Content: Symptom-You are not able to migrate the object Open Items Payable due to error message.-Error detected in source record with key value ABCXYZ.-Item amounts must be positive.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview subview.-Search and open Activity: Migration of Accounting Transaction.-Click the Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link.-Select effected migration unit -> this is in status In Process and has the Title BCD (BCD is the title of the migration unit) for company XYZ (XYZ is the company ID).-Click the Execute Migration button.-Select the Open Items payable file and click the Process File button.-Simulate the Import-In the Log Details, you will find the error messages:-Error detected in source record with key value ABCXYZ.-Item amounts must be positive.-Cause-There are inconsistent values in the Source File. The amounts were entered with minus sign.-Resolution-Click Edit Source Record and edit the Amount field by entering positive amounts only because system uses the Transaction Type field to decide whether it must post the amount to the debit side or credit side.-          Keywords-Migratoin of open Payables

Title: You are not Able to Close a Payment in View All Mode due to Error: 'You are not authorized to change the data'
Content: Symptom-You notice that a user has no write access to Payment Monitor screen, however if they open a payment in View All mode and then click "X" to close the screen, the system raises an error that they do not have approval to change data. The user is then not able to close the payment (nor via Close button nor via "X" buttons).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon with a user with no write access to Payment Monitor.-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Open any In Transfer / Ready for Transfer / Confirmed  Payment in View All Mode.- You see that the Info message is raised: You are not authorized to change the data-Click to Close the payment.-The following error is also raised: 'You are not authorized to change the data'- You are then not able to close the payment.-Cause-This would be the current system design to in order to enforce the write access restriction. When you access the payment in View All mode, certain logic calls are made for which write access is required. If a user only has read access, they will encounter the mentioned error and the screen will remain open. This logic must process in the way it currently does and lack of write access will lead to this error.-Resolution-In order to close the payment screen, you can either use the Close All button ('X' button located at the bottom right side of the screen), which closes all tabs, or you can navigate back to the overview screen ('You can also' => 'Open overview'). From the overview, a user with read-only access is able to close the payment, as write access is not required to close the overview.-Keywords-Access Rights. Payment Monitor. Liquidity Management.

Title: Error: Length of bank account number must not exceed 10 characters
Content: Symptom-An error is raised when entering Employee Bank Account for New Zealand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Employee Data work center.-Go to the Employee view.-Find relevant ID.-Click Edit.-Go to the Personal Data tab.-Go to the Payment Information sub-tab.-Add Bank Account number.-Error will show: Length of bank account number must not exceed 10 characters.-Cause-This error occurs because the Bank and Branch part of the Bank Account are entered as well.-Resolution-The Bank Account has format as BB-RRRR-AAAAAAA-SSS-B - Bank-R-Branch-A-Account-S-Suffix-Only the Account and Suffix should be entered in the Bank Account field. The Bank and Branch are derived by the system from the National Bank Code.-Keywords-Bank Account, Employee, Length of bank account number must not exceed, New Zealand, NZ-bank account,employee,length of bank account number must not,new zealand,nz

Title: How to Add Standard Field to Excel
Content: Symptom-A standard field is missing in an Microsoft Excel® template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Follow the steps of the below blog post to enhance templates provided by SAP Business ByDesign in the application and user management work center:-How to Add a New Field to Existing Templates in SAP ByDesign-Keywords-not possible, not available, additional, not all, excel, import, export, file,

Title: How the System Calculates the Overhead Amounts for Production Lots?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have finished the actual cost allocation run AAAA for production lot HHH in period XXX.YYYY, when you check the overhead results, you want to know how the overhead results are calculated?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to Production Lot Actual Costing View.-Select All Costing Results.-Search the Production Lot ID HHH.-Click View.-Go to Overview.-Select the first line of the Production Lot ID HHH.-Go to Tab Overhead.-You will see the results.-Resolution-Below is one example of how the system calculates the results of overhead. The rest follows the same logic.-1.You see that the overhead result for G/L Account 66065550 is 652,30, the overhead rate is 223,78791%.-2. This result is caulculated based on the combination of the result for Resorce F2101-QT and the overhead rule which is 291,48*223,78791%=652,30.-3.Then you can check the calculation logic of the result for Resource F2101-QT. Open report Cost Center-Line items.-Find the total Charge for this cost center 210401 for the period/year XXX.YYYY is 704.557,83 CNY.-4.Keep checking the report Cost Center-Line items, from that the amount allocated to the resource F2101-QT is 7.088 CNY for 886 hours.-5.The amount allocated to all Internal Service Confirmations is 386.752,24 CNY for 23.800 hours.-6.The actual cost of resource F2101-QT = (amount allocated to resource F2101-QT/amount allocated to all internal serveice confirmations)*Charge for this cost center for the period/year XXX.YYYY = (7.088/386.752,24) * 704.557,83 = 12.912,42.-7.For production lot 1124, it used 20 hours so the actual cost for the production lot = (12.912,42/886) *20 = 291.48.-Keywords-production lot actual costing. overhead amount. resource. result. 生产跟踪单实际成本. 间接费用. 资源. 结果.

Title: Sweden Per Diem calculation rates
Content: Symptom-You have created an Expense Report and want to understand how Sweden Per Diem rates are calculated-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the view Expense Reports-Search and find Expense Report XYZ (XYZ represents the Expense report ID).-Under Reimbursements and Expense Summary Per Diem calculations are not as expected.-Cause-Per Diem calculation is based on different days for Sweden (Legal Requirement).-Resolution-Below is an explanation on the rates that you can see in Business Configuration.-Go to Business configuration work center-Search and find the activity: Per Diem Rates for Meals - Sweden-Here we can see a list of the rates.-The Trip Length codes have a huge decision on -To see how these Trip lengths effect the different rates you need to understand what the codes stand for, please see below explanation on the codes:-Trip Length 1 = one day trip-Trip Length 96 = First day of several day trip-Trip Length 97 = Last day of several day trip-Trip Length 98 = in between day < 24 hrs-Trip Length 99 = in between day = 24 hrs-Please also refer to the below examples:-Example 1:-Trip for 1 day, with traveling time duration for 12 hours.-Explanation: Here the trip is for one day, therefore 1st row of above mentioned configuration will decide the amount. For first day rates are mentioned as 0 there you get 0 amount in reimbursement.-Example 2:-Trip for more than one day that is calculating 480 SEK for 2 days.-Explanation: This trip is for several days so each of first day, last day and days in between will be used for reimbursement. Since this is only two day trip there is no days in between so first day and last day will give the total amount of 480. The rates will be picked from the row number 2, 3 for First day = 120 + 120 and from the row number 4, 5 for last day = 120 + 120. That is lunch, dinner (morning and evening meal) on day 1 and day 2 respectively.-  Example 3:-Trip with different date but time is 12 hours -here system is calculating 240 SEK. Trip dates/times dd.mm.yyyy 11:00 PM TO dd.mm.yyyy 09:00 AM-Explanation: This trip is for 12 hr in time duration but if you see it has day 1 and day 2. So again first day and last day rates will decide the total reimbursement amount. First day Starts at 11 PM (Dinner/Meal in night) so rates will be picked from Row number 3 = 120. Last day ends at 9 Am (Meal in morning) so rates will be picked from Row number 4 = 120-Keywords-Sweden, per diem, rates, Trip Length

Title: Generic VAT Return is Only Considering Customer Invoices.
Content: Symptom-You have created a VAT Return (Generic Return Type - 999) and expected that Supplier and Customer Invoices would be included, but only Customer Invoices were picked.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return view.-Select the relevant Tax Return.-Click View.-Go to the Tax Return tab.-Click Details.-There are only Customer Invoices, however you expected that Supplier Invoices should have been considered as well.-Cause-The Supplier Invoices you expected that should have been included in the Tax were posted the Tax Event ABC.-This Tax Event ABC is mapped to other(s) Tax Returns which are Payment Relevant. If any Tax Event is mapped with other Payment Relevant Tax Return Types it will not be picked by the Generic Return Type (999).-Resolution-In case you wish the Supplier Invoices to be considered by the Generic Return Type (999) it will be necessary to remove the Tax Event assignment from the other Tax Returns.-Keywords-VAT Return, Tax Event, Generic Return Type, Supplier Invoice, Customer Invoice.

Title: You Want to Use the Fixed Asset Capitalization Threshold in a PDI
Content: Symptom-You want to use the Fixed Asset Capitalization Threshold in a PDI (customization).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-This is already released through BO FIA_ACCPRINC and node FIA_ACCPR_CAPIT_FXA.-Keywords-PDI, customization, fixed assets, Fixed Asset Capitalization Threshold-pdi,customization,fixed assets,fixed asset capitalization threshold

Title: Is it Possible to Mass Change Material Description for Other Languages?
Content: Symptom-For a material or service, it is possible to maintain descriptions in other languages. You would like to know whether it is possible to perform a Mass Change for the descriptions in other languages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product portfolio work center.-Go to products or services view.-Select a list of Materials or Services and select Mass Change button.-In General, there is no column for Other Languages.-Cause-In current release, Material Description for other languages not available in the Mass Change screen.-Resolution-Please log in to respective language to maintain the description or use Mass Data Maintenance or Migration of Materials to maintain other languages.-See Also-3002637 - How to Mass Add New Material Description in Other Languages-Keywords-adapt not, able, unable, missing, available, unavailable

Title: When Uploading a Lockbox File it Stays In Process
Content: Symptom-You upload a Lockbox file and it remains 'In Process'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Click New - Inbound File.-Select File Type Lockbox.-Select relevant Company.-Select relevant Bank.-Click Add - File.-Select relevant File.-Click Add.-Click Start File Upload.-File remains In Process.-Cause-A possible cause for this is using the incorrect file extension.-Resolution-Adjust the file extension to .BAI and upload the file again.-Keywords-lockbox, in process, upload, lockbox file-lockbox,in process,upload,lockbox file

Title: Payment terms is not copied from Sales Order to Down Payment request
Content: Symptom-When you create a Down Payment request from the Sales Order, you expect that the Payment Terms in the Sales Order are copied to the down payment request. However the payment terms in the down payment request are not copied from Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders workcenter and navigate to Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order XYZ and Click on Create Down Payment. (XYZ is the Sales Order Document Id)-Enter the External reference and the Amount and click on Ok.-The Down Payment request ABC will be created. (ABC is the Down Payment Invoice Request Id)-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center and navigate to Invoice Requests View.-Search for the Down Payment Invoice Request ABC and click on Edit.-Check for the payment terms and you find that the payment terms in Down payment request ABC is not same as Sales Order XYZ.-Cause-The Payment terms used in Sales Order is not same as the payment terms maintained in the Account master. The Payment Terms in the Down Payment Request is always taken from the Account master data.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Note: System will consider only 'n days net' and 'Payable immediately' for the down payment requests.

Title: Total Invoiced Revenue is Empty in Project Overview
Content: Symptom-You are analyzing the Total Invoiced Revenue in Project Overview and expected to find posted amounts, however the result is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Open the relevant Project.-Click View All.-Go to the Project Overview tab.-The Total Invoiced Revenue is empty, however you expected to find the values from a Customer Invoice.-Cause-The Total Invoiced Revenue is empty in Project Overview because the Total Invoiced Revenue is zero due to a Journal Entry Voucher.-The Journal Entry Voucher in this case has the exact opposite amount from the Customer Invoice.-This can be checked in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure Report.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Project Overview, Invoiced Revenue, Journal Entry Voucher, Customer Invoice.

Title: SAP ByD Mobile App The Approver Does Not See The Approval Notes Entered In The PO
Content: Symptom- When using the SAP ByD Mobile applications in Hebrew, the approver does not see the approval notes entered in the PO.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-With device in Hebrew.-Open ByD App.-Go to Manager Approval tile.-Open Purchase orders.-Find a item to be approved.-First item has a note that is displayed in English but not in Hebrew.-Cause-This is the system expected beahvior.-Resolution-When recording notes for a business object such as “Purchase Order”, these are recorded and stored together with a language attribute, which is set according to the logon language of the user who creates the note. In case of the two existing notes for Purchase Order this attribute is “English”, i.e. the user who recorded the notes was logged on with language English at the time of recording. This attribute is set irrespective of the real language in which the notes are written, which is Hebrew here.-In the Mobile Approval Application, the existing notes are filtered based on this language attribute stored with the notes. As in this case this is set to English, the notes only appear when the approver is logged on in English as well, while they are filtered out when the approver logs on with a different language.--Keywords-Language Mobile App, Hebrew, Approval Notes.

Title: User is Not Able to Change The E-mail Subject.
Content: Symptom-You have released a Sales Document with an E-mail template to the customer. You expect to change the subject which shows with the structure: Account Name - Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice), however, you don't know the path to use.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Form Template maintenance view.-Find a Customer invoice.-Click Actions.-Either create an e-mail template or maintain an e-mail subject.-Result: the data format will be that which is maintained in the template.-Cause-If you look at the XML that is generated from the output, it would be the similar paths that you can see there.-Resolution-Check the XML structure from the order created and use the similar paths that you can see there.-Keywords- E-mail Template, e-mail Subject, date format.

Title: Error When Posting a Supplier Credit Memo: 'Currency conversion failed due to missing exchange rates. Maintain the exchange rates for conversion from ABC to DEF for Mid Rates'
Content: Symptom-Supplier Credit Memo is unposted due to the error 'Currency conversion failed due to missing exchange rates. Maintain the exchange rates for conversion from ABC to DEF for Mid Rate'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Select the relevant Supplier Credit Memo.-You can find the Supplier Credit Memo with the error message 'Currency conversion failed due to missing exchange rates. Maintain the exchange rates for conversion from ABC to DEF for Mid Rate'.-ABC - Source Currency-DEF - Target Currency-Cause-During the posting of the Supplier Credit Memo a Clearing is also being created.-The Exchange Rate Type being used for Clearing is XXX and there is no Exchange Rate maintained between Currency ABC and DEF for Exchange Rate Type XXX (only for Type YYY).-You can check the Exchange Rate Type for each Business Transaction in Business Configuration -> Currency Conversion Profiles activity.-XXX - Exchange Rate Type-Resolution-System is working as designed.-If the Exchange Rate for Exchange Rate Type XXX is maintained, then it will be possible to post the Supplier Credit Memo.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Supplier Credit Memo, Clearing, Exchange Rate, Exchange Rate Type, Currency.

Title: Confirmation Update Run is Affecting The Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You notice that on Changes tab, on Sales Order, there are many changes performed by the same user, but the user did not perform such changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Sales Orders work center.-Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC refers to Sales Order ID).-Navigate to Changes tab.-You will be able to see that a user has changed performed more than 50 changes within few minutes.-Cause-The user created the multiple jobs, Confirmation Update Run, that are finished/scheduled etc.-Resolution-1. Go to 'Outbound Logistics Control' work center.-2. Select view 'Automated Actions' and sub-view 'Confirmation Update Runs'.-3. Select the run defined by you and click on 'Edit' button.-You'll be able to see the user that is performing the changes on the Sales Order is the responsible/creator of this run.-You would need to check the run and adjust according to your business process to do not perform so many changes in the Sales Orders.-Keywords-Changes; Sales Orders; Mass Change; Confirmation Update Run;

Title: Sweden Per diem rate
Content: Symptom-You have created an Expense Report for country/region Sweden and expect to see Per Diem rates, however no Per Diem rates appear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Select the view Expense Reports-Search and find Expense Report XYZ (XYZ represents the Expense report ID).-Under Reimbursements and Expense Summary we cannot see any details for Per Diem.-However we expect to see Per Diem values appear here. -Cause-This is correct system behavior because the length of the Expense is for 1 day.-Sweden has specific rules that are in place for Per Diem and these have been maintained in the Business Configuration settings.-Resolution-To see the settings that have been maintained.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the view overview.-Search and find activity Per Diem Rates for Meals - Sweden.-Select the option: Edit per diem rates for meals based on time intervals-Go to the Statutory Rates tab.-Filter for Country/Region:SE - Sweden (case sensitive).-For Maximum Trip Length = 001 (meaning 1 day trips) there is no Per Diem Rate maintained.-As there is no Per Diem Rate maintained no rate will appear on the expense report.-Also please take into account any per diem deductions that may be added to expense trips greater than 1 day.-Keywords-Expense Report, Per Diem, Sweden, Per Diem rates

Title: In a Sales Order Item, Requested Date and Requested End Fields Have Different Formatting
Content: Symptom-In the Items tab of a Sales Order, you observe that midnight is formatted as 00:00 in the Requested Date and 24:00 in the Requested End.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents your Sales Order ID).-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Scroll down until you see the fields Requested Date and Requested End-If these fields are set to Midnight, you will see that Requested Date shows that time as 00:00, while Requested End shows it as 24:00.-Cause-This is the intended behaviour for these fields. This is done so there is no confusion regarding representing the start or end of a day.- The Requested Date starts with the beginning of the day and so the time stamp is 00:00, while the Requested End represents the end of the day and so the time stamp 24:00.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-It is currently not possible to change the default setting for the time stamp of the Requested Date. Only the default Date of the Requested Date can be changed in the Fine Tuning Activity Date Profiles.-This would be a new requirement. You can consult the following KBA on how to proceed: 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords- Sales Order ; Requested Date ; Requested End ; Date ; Time ; 00:00 ; 12:00

Title: Error: "Bank transfer ABC:missing Employer Ident Number (company tax arrangements)"
Content: Symptom-You are creating outbound files and the system is showing the status "Error in file creation" for Bank Transfer.-In Display Log option, the error message appears "Bank transfer ABC:missing Employer Ident Number (company tax arrangements)"  (where ABC represents the Bank Transfer ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the Outbound Files view.-Find file ID DEF and click Display Log (where DEF represents the Outbound File ID).-In the Messages tab, you will find the error message.-Cause-The Employer Identification Number is not maintained in the Tax Authority, and/or in Supplier/Customer master data.-Resolution-The Employer Identification Number must be maintained in the Tax Authority, as well as in the Supplier/Customer details.-Maintain the Tax Number Type 2 - Employer Identification Number and respective Tax Number in the account master data (Supplier or Customer) and in the Tax Authority > Company Tax Arrangements.-Keywords-NACHA; US ACH; Bank Transfer; Tax Number; Employer; Employer Identification Number; EIN; Tax Authority; Company Tax Arrangement

Title: System Dump When Executing Payment
Content: Symptom-When Executing Payment for Outgoing Check the system dumps.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Select relevant Payment ID.-Click Execute Payment.-System dumps.-Cause-If the Payment Method of this scenario is for Outgoing Check a possible cause is that there are no more available Check numbers in your Check Lot.-Resolution-To correct this a new Check Lot needs to be added to the Bank Account.-Keywords-check, payment, automatic payments, dump, outgoing check-check,payment,automatic payments,dump,outgoing check

Title: Error: Valuation level XXX of type Product Specification does not exist
Content: Symptom-There is an error received after the upload of a payload of Type ManageMaterialValuationDataIn.-XXX - Product Specification ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-After uploading a payload for ManageMaterialValuationDataIn you receive the error "Valuation level XXX of type Product Specification does not exist".-Cause-This occurs because a prerequisite is not completed for this Web Service as is mentioned on the Help Document-Product Valuation Level for Product Specification must already exist in the system at the time the web service is called.-Resolution-This information needs to be maintained previously in the Material:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Find relevant Material.-Click Edit.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Click Maintain Product Specification Valuation.-Add Product Specification XXX.-See Also-Help Document Inbound Service ManageMaterialValuationDataIn.-Keywords-ManageMaterialValuationDataIn, payload, webservice, Valuation level, of type Product Specification does not exist-managematerialvaluationdatain,payload,webservice,valuation level,of type product specification does not e,of type product specification,does not exist

Title: Error Messages Upon VAT Return Run Execution For OSS Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You have executed a VAT Return Run for tax return type OSS Tax Return that finished with following errors:-'Technical error; no tax types assigned to tax return type OSS Tax Return'-'Error in business configuration for tax return type OSS Tax Return'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2105-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Open respective run and application log.-Move to the Results tab.-Notice the error messages:-'Technical error; no tax types assigned to tax return type OSS Tax Return'-'Error in business configuration for tax return type OSS Tax Return'-Cause-Currently, OSS VAT return will not be possible. However, OSS return configuration is required to post OSS invoice so OSS return type was delivered in current release (SAP Business ByDesign 2105). Complete solution for OSS return will be delivered in 2108 release.-Resolution-Please execute OSS VAT return after SAP Business ByDesign 2108 upgrade.-Keywords-OSS Tax Return; tax return type; One Stop Shop

Title: Budget Category and Budget Check in Expense Reports
Content: Symptom-You want to provide budget category and have the budget check enabled in expense reports, as it's available for purchase orders and manual supplier invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2108 Release-Resolution-Budget category cannot be provided in expense reports and the budget check is also not enabled for expense reports.-However, you can check if you could make use of partner BADI BudgetCategoryDetermination to fill the budget category for journal entries of expense reports.-For budget check, ActiveBudgetControlUtilities.CheckBudgetAvailability API is made available which is also accessible for partners. Please check if this would work for you.-See Also-Help Document for SAP Business ByDesign 2108 Release: What's New in Financial Management > Section Active Budget Control for Public Sector Edition-Keywords-budget control; budget category; budget check; expense report

Title: 'Expense or revenue line item missing' Error in Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-When you try to post a Journal Entry Voucher with a reference to a Sales Order and a Project Task the system throws an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Step A.)-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Select the Journal Entry Vouchers View.-Select a Company and a Set of Books.-Choose Journal Entry Type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-Enter Screen Variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.-Closing Step is Operational Postings.-Select a Posting Date and a Document Date.-Step B.)-Press Add Row.-Choose a G/L Account-Enter Credit in Transaction Currency-Select Sales Doc. Type 114 - Sales Order.-Choose a Sales Doc. ID and a Sales Doc. Item ID-Repeat steps 1 to 5, in step 3 you enter a Debit in Transaction Currency.-Press Simulate.-Result: The following error message appears: Expense or revenue line item missing.-Cause-The system expects you to enter one or more Expense or Revenue Lines to post the Journal Entry Voucher. You just need to change the assignment of one line item from Sales Assignment to a Cost Center Assignment and then it will post correctly.-Keep in mind that if you change one line item to a Cost Center Assignment you have to use a G/L account which is allowed for the Account Type Costs/Expenses.-Resolution-Step A.)-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Select the Journal Entry Vouchers View.-Select a Company and a Set of Books.-Choose Journal Entry Type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-Enter Screen Variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.-Closing Step is Operational Postings.-Select a Posting Date and a Document Date.-Step B.)-Press Add Row.-Choose a G/L Account.-Enter Credit in Transaction Currency.-Select Sales Doc. Type 114 - Sales Order.-Choose a Sales Doc. ID and a Sales Doc. Item ID.-Press Add Row again.-Choose a G/L Account which is of Type Costs/Expense.-Enter a Debit in Transaction Currency.-Select a Cost Center.-Press Simulate or Post.-Now you are able to simulate or post the Journal Entry Voucher without any error message.-See Also-You can refer to the online help document Manual Entries for Sales Documents.-Keywords-Expense or Revenue Line Item missing; Journal Entry Voucher Error; Manual Entry for Sales Documents General Ledger

Title: Revenue Recognition Failed With Error Message: 'During run the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-  ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have executed a Revenue Recognition Run and receive the error message 'During run the error 'Application runtime exception; report an incident' occurred'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Select the relevant Run.-Click View.-Go to the Messages tab.-The mentioned error message is displayed.-Cause-Usually this error message generates a dump in the backend, you can use the below steps:-Log on to the backend and open transaction ST22.-Maintain the Date the Run was executed and the Technical User that created the Revenue Recognition Run.-Click Enter.-Open the dump.-Go to the Application Information section.-The below details are displayed:-'"CL_FIA_SLSLA_A_ACCRUAL_CALC" contains errors, which are described in the exception chain below. Please open a ticket to the responsible component "AP-ACC-SLS"!-Triggering application component: AP-ACC-SLS-Exception chain (click button "Unformatted Display" for all details):- 1. Info: Cannot determine account (origin), CM_FIA_COSTREVEL, Program:CL_FIA_SLSLA_ACCR_CRE- 2. Info: An exception with the type CM_FIA_COSTREVEL occurred, but was neither handled loca- 3. Info: Error during calculation of sales accruals: An exception with the type CM_FIA_COST- 4. Info: Application error: Exception while calling method EXECUTE of action ACCRUAL_CALC,- 5. Info: Internal application error of business object FIA_SALES_LEDGER_ACCOUNT, /BOPF/CX_F'-This dump happens when there is an Account Determination Group or G/L Account(s) missing for Costs in the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Resolution-First you need to identify the Sales Document included in the Revenue Recognition Run:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Select the erroneous Run.-Click View.-Go to the Data Selection tab.-Take a note of the Sales Document ID(s).-Then you can find all the involved Account Determination Groups in the scenario using the following steps:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Sales Document Items view.-Search for all Items of the Sales Document.-Select one Item at time.-Open the respective Product.-Click View All.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Take a note of the Account Determination Group (ADG).-Once you have all the Account Determination Groups for that Sales Order you can proceed as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Under Account Determination, click Costs.-Select Service tab.-Here you have to verify if all the ADGs that you took a note are already maintained and if they have Credit/Debit G/L Accounts for Internal Services.-Ask the customer to maintain an Account Determination Group with a Credit and Debit G/L Account for Internal Services. Then Revenue Recognition Run should be executed successfully.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition Run, Account Determination Group, Sales Document Items.

Title: Overhead Distribution Rule Warning: 'No values available for sender XXX in rule YYY'
Content: Symptom-You have set up a distribution rule with distribution factor as Fixed and Sender and Receiver Project/Project Task. However, when executing an overhead distribution run, the project task defined as Sender in the distribution rule has a warning under the Not Processed tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Overhead Distribution view.-Open the related overhead distribution run.-Go to Not Processed tab.-For distribution rule YYY, the following warning message is raised: No values available for sender XXX in rule YYY (YYY - distribution rule ID; XXX sender project/project task ID). However, when you check the Projects - Line items report, you see that there are postings towards the project.-Cause-The distribution rule has sender as the project header, however the costs are incurred in the project tasks. Currently there are no postings towards the project header itself as a task.-As per the standard design of the system, overhead distribution run for projects works when the corresponding rule has actual project task (on which cost is incurred) as sender. This is a right behavior as well, because in ByD project header is also considered as a task, so that user can distinguish the cost incurred on header from the cost incurred on its corresponding tasks.-In the Projects - Line Items report, you can bring the Project Task characteristic and check what project tasks are assigned to each posting.-Resolution-You need to set up the Distribution Rule with Sender as the project task that has the costs incurred. If you want to distribute costs from further tasks from this project, the corresponding tasks needs to be set up as Sender in the distribution rule.-If you create a distribution rule with the project header as sender, only the costs incurred in the project header as task are distributed.-Keywords-Overhead Distribution. Project Task. Cost. Incurred Costs. Distribution Rule.

Title: Bill of Exchange Payments Are Not Supported Within European Countries
Content: Symptom-You create a Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance payment involving two European countries but an error message appears:-"Pay. procedure Bill Of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance of account ABC not permitted for payments from DEF to GHI".-(ABC means the Bank Account ID. DEF means Country. GHI means Country.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Select the respective customer account and click View.-Select an open invoice and click Pay Manually By > Other Payment Methods.-Select Payment Method Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance.-Error message is thrown:-"Pay. procedure Bill Of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance of account ABC not permitted for payments from DEF to GHI"-For example, Country DEF = Spain and Country GHI - Belgium.-Cause-Currently, Bill Of Exchange (BoE) payments in SAP Business ByDesign are only supported for domestic payments.-Using the example of countries above, even if "Spain SEPA DD" format can be used in business world within European countries, this is currently not supported in combination with BoE in SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-System behaves as designed.-Keywords-boe; bill of exchange

Title: Amount Posted to Differences from Exchange Rate Fluctuation on Customer Invoice for one Set of Books
