Content: Symptom-You create a Customer Invoice and for one Set of Books there is a Posting to a G/L Account of Differences from Exchange Rate Fluctuation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Find the relevant Journal Entry.-Go to the Journal Entry tab.-There is a posting to the G/L Account of Differences from Exchange Rate Fluctuation.-Cause-This can be caused due to a different Exchange Rate Type used for the Customer Invoice Posting on this Set of Books.-To check this:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Currency Conversion Profiles activity.-Select the relevant Currency Conversion Profile for the Set of Books.-Filter the Business Transaction Type Customer Invoice.-Here the Exchange Rate Type is not 001 - Daily average rate.-Resolution-System is correct, it will use the 001 - Daily average rate for the Tax and calculate the difference for the different Exchange Rate Type used for the Currency Conversion Profile.-Keywords-tax difference, customer invoice, journal entry, Differences from Exchange Rate Fluctuation-tax difference,customer invoice,journal entry,differences from exchange rate fluctuati

Title: Split Open Items Disabled for Down Payments
Content: Symptom-You create a Down Payment in the customer and/or supplier account monitor. You notice that the Split Open Items is disabled for this document type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Account view.-Open supplier account monitor for the related supplier.-Select any open/partially cleared Down Payment.-Click Actions button.-You notice that the Split Open Items action is disabled.-Cause-A Down Payment item is created by Due Clearing when the Down Payment Request is cleared against a payment. Whenever the original clearing or the payment made against the down payment request is canceled, the Down Payment Request is open again and the Down Payment item is canceled.-If the Down Payment gets split, then the cancellation of the original payment/clearing would not be possible. In the event of a split Down Payment, there could be further inconsistencies upon posting subsequent clearings for the split items. Therefore, it has been decided to disable the Split action for Down Payments.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Accounts Payable. Accounts Receivables. Customer Account Monitor. Split Open Item.

Title: You Receive the Error 'No check storage exists for the company' When Uploading a Lockbox
Content: Symptom-You receive the error 'No check storage exists for the company' when uploading a Lockbox file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Click New - Inbound File.-Select File Type Lockbox.-Select relevant Company.-Select relevant Bank.-Click Add - File.-Select relevant File.-Click Add.-Click Start File Upload.-Error: No check storage exists for the company-Cause-This can be due to a leading zero on your Lockbox Number, the system will skip leading zeros on the file, hence you can remove the leading zero from your Lockbox Number.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Check Storages view.-Select relevant Check Storage ID.-Click Edit.-Remove any leading zeros from the Lockbox Number.-After this the system will upload the file with no errors.-Keywords-Lockbox Number, Check Storage, No check storage exists for the company, file upload-lockbox number,check storage,file upload,no check storage exists for the company

Title: Line Items Notes Are Disappearing
Content: Symptom-You have entered an item note on your sales document, but when you change the Org. Unit the notes are disappearing.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Orders document ABC (ABC represents your Sales Orders Document ID).-Click on Edit and View All button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Then navigate to Notes subtab.-Enter a note.-Navigate to Involved Parties tab.-Change the Org. Unit.-Go Back to Notes subtab.-Result: The notes disappeared.-Cause-This is a standard behavior as the re-determination of notes depends on Sales Unit change on the Involved Parties tab on the Sales Order document.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-Keywords-Sales Order; Notes; Item; Sales Unit

Title: For Automatically Created Outgoing Payments the Wrong House Bank Account is Allocated
Content: Symptom-When executing the Automatic Payment Run, an alternative house bank account is automatically pulled into the payment proposal.-Upon changing the house bank account to the default value as defined in the Business Configuration, Activity Global Settings for Payment / Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods, a system message appears suggesting that there is insufficient liquidity on the default bank account XYZ (XYZ means the Bank Account ID).-However, the last confirmed closing balance of bank account XYZ indicates that there are sufficient funds to allow for outgoing payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Filter for Payments In Preparation and click Edit, General Data tab, Bank Account ID.-Upon changing the Bank Account back to the default account the system message appears: "Not sufficient liquidity on house bank account XYZ."-Cause-The system determines the liquidity status of a bank account by taking into account the settings for house bank account XYZ, the last confirmed balance and unconfirmed or unallocated payments.-Based on those criteria the next logical house bank account for this company will be suggested in automatically created payments.-For Example:-In Work Center: Liquidity Management, View Bank Statements the current confirmed closing balance of house bank account XYZ is 10.000 EUR.-Bank Account 'XXX' has an Overdraft Limit of 0.00 EUR defined under:-Work Center Liquidity Management -> View Master Data -> My Bank -> House Bank ABC.-At the same time there is a total of 12.000 EUR outgoing payment amount which is in status 'In Transfer' resp. not allocated as listed in the Payment Monitor.-This results in an effectively negative liquidity status for this house bank account and any further outgoing payments are blocked for this account.-In Automatically Created Payments the system then consequently suggests the next house bank account exhibiting a positive liquidity for company ABC.-Resolution-The liquidity status of default house bank account XYZ has to be turned positive for the default settings in Automatically Created Payments to take effect.-This can be done by either allowing for a sufficient overdraft limit, clearing of unallocated payments or providing sufficient credit balance for this house bank account.-Keywords-Not sufficient liquidity on house bank account

Title: No Functional Area Could be Assigned from Cost Center Type for Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order with project assignment and expect the functional area to be derived from the cost center assigned to the related project. The functional are determination based on the cost center type is correctly maintained, however the purchase order ends up as an unposted source document due to missing functional are assignment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents view.-You find the purchase order unposted with the following error messages:-No functional area could be assigned-Derivation for accounting principle <ID>, chart of accounts <ID>, G/L account <ID>, Nonsales Object-Derivation for project task <ID>, cost center type <here the cost center type shows in blank>-Open the related purchase order.-Go to the Items tab and open the Account Assignment.-Open the project task maintained as account assignment.-Within the project task, click View All.-Go to Accounting tab.-Refer to the Responsible Unit field.-Double-click the responsible unit ID -Within the Org. unit screen that opens, click View All.-Go to Definitions tab.-You see that the responsible unit is a cost center and has cost center type e.g. 20 - Sales.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis-Click to edit the functional area determination.-Go to tab Determination Using Cost Center Types.-You see that the related cost center type is correctly mapped. Hence, you expect the system to determinate the functional area based on the cost center type. You do not want the determination to happen via G/L Account, reason why the functional are mapping is not done to the G/L Account mentioned in the error message.-Cause-The system is not being able to derive the cost center from the project, therefore you see in the error message that the cost center type is in blank. Since the cost center type cannot be derived, the functional area determination is not done.-This happens because the purchase order has a Delivery Date before the initial validity of the cost center attributes of this Org. Unit.-You can check Delivery Date in the purchase order line item itself. The cost center attributes for the Responsible unit in the project can be seen within the Timelines tab for that Org. Unit via Organizational Management work center.-Resolution-In order for the system to determine the functional area from the Cost Center type, the Delivery Date of the purchase order must be within the validity range of the cost center attribute of the related cost center.-Therefore, you can either change the delivery date (if still possible) or change the validity range of the cost center attributes of this cost center. This can be done via Organizational Management work center.-Keywords-Functional Area Determination. Cost Center Type. G/L Account. Purchase Order. Supplier Invoice. Project Management. Project Task. Source Document. Derivation for accounting principle

Title: An Org Unit That is Visible in Active Area is Missing in Planning Area
Content: Symptom-You have observed that a particular org unit which is visible in the Active Area is missing in the Planning Area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Active Area:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Access the Org Structures view.-Select Effective From Date as DD.MM.YYYY.-Click the Go button.-The Org unit XYZ is visible.-Planning Area:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Access the Edit Org Structures view.-Select Effective From Date as DD.MM.YYYY.-Click the Go button.-The Org unit XYZ is not visible.-(where DD.MM.YYYY represents a date in the day-month-year format and XYZ represents an actual org unit ID)-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you might have deleted org unit XYZ in the Planning Area, but have yet to activate this change.-This can be verified in the Changes tab of org unit XYZ in the Active Area.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Once you delete an org unit, it will disappear from the Planning Area and after activation of the deletion, it will disappear from the Active Area as well. The deletion will be considered by the system only AFTER its activation — while it's deleted only in the Planning Area, system will still consider this org unit active.-If you want to reverse this deletion in the Planning Area, then you can use the Roll Back functionality. Be aware that a Roll Back reverts all inactive changes and it won't revert a deletion that has already been activated.-Keywords-Org Unit, Delete, Planning Area, Active Area, Missing

Title: Invoice Requests in Status With Conflict - Invoice schedule item XX: quantity value has changed
Content: Symptom-An Invoice Requests which is based on a Contract is in status With Conflict and the corresponding Item has the status Conflict.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center. -Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select Invoice Request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice request). -The status of the invoice request is With Conflict and the item status is Conflict.-Click on the Check button the following warning is displayed:-Conflict in item XX; Invoice schedule item XX: quantity value has changed (XX represents the line item number).-Cause-The quantity was changed after the Invoice Request was already invoiced with Invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Invoice).-You can check this as follows:-Selecting the Invoice Request ABC. -Click on the Edit button. -Navigate to the Changes tab. -You will see the first change entry displays the invoicing of the invoice request. -In and entry after that you will see that the quantity of the item was changed e.g. from 9 to 12. -Invoice XYZ has the quantity 9 and the Invoice Request has the quantity 12 for the same item. This means that the quantity in the contract and the quantity of the invoice do not match and therefore you the Invoice Request is in status with Conflict.-Resolution-To solve the issue, you need to cancel Invoice XYZ and then invoice the Invoice Request ABC again with the correct quantity.-See Also-KBA 2921124 - Scheduled Invoice Requests in Status With Conflict-Keywords-Conflict; Invoice Request; Invoice Schedule; Quantity; Item; quantity; value; changed

Title: Error When Accessing Plan Data: You are not authorized to execute report Financial Plan Details
Content: Symptom-You access the Plan Data tab of a plan version and an authorization error is raised for the Financial Plan Details report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Planning view.-Open a plan version.-Go to Plan Data tab.-The following error is raised: You are not authorized to execute report Financial Plan Details-Cause-The report that is loaded in the Plan Data tab is not assigned to a work center/view that you user has access to.-Resolution-You need to assign the report Financial Plan Details (FINCACU17_QICP0001) to the work center/view or business role, as follows:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Find report ID FINCACU17_QICP0001.-Click Assign.-Assign to this report the work center/view that the user has access to. E.g. Cost and Revenue -> Planning.-After saving, you are able to access the report via Plan Data tab.-Keywords-Plan Data. Financial Planning. Cost and Revenue. Access Right.

Title: How to Upload Item Level Internal Comment and Customer Information via Excel
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to upload sales orders via Excel with item level internal comment and customer information.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Download New Sales Orders excel file.-Open the excel file, you do not know how to maintain the item level internal comment and customer information.-Cause-Below are the type code for text collection on item level:-item level internal comment: TextTypeCode=10011-item level customer information: TextTypeCode=10024-Resolution-Please maintain the correct type code and content text, then try the excel upload.-Keywords-Sales Order Upload; Excel Addin; Text Typce Code; Content Text

Title: Not Able to Change the Account Assignment Type to Profit Center
Content: Symptom-You are creating a supplier invoice and are not able to select the required Profit Center. Everything is going to the Default Profit Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the Invoice ID ABC (ABC means the Invoice ID).-Add the parameters.-Click Cost Distribution.-Add a G/L Account.-Account Assignment Type is filed automatically by the system and you cannot change it to Profit Center.-Cause-It is the current system behavior that the profit center does not come as account assignment type.-Currently, you cannot choose the Profit Center by adding it to the Account Assignment Type field. Also you can't add it in the fine tuning activity Mandatory Account Assignments as well.-Resolution-There is no technical issue with the system. This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords- profit center; account assignment type

Title: Error: 'Invalid calculation method due to change from/to daily calculation'
Content: Symptom-When tying to change the Depreciation Method to 0000 - No automatic depreciation an error is raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select related Fixed Asset ID.-Click Edit - Master Data.-Go to the Asset Valuation sub-tab.-Go to the Valuation Intervals sub-tab.-Click Add Row.-Add Start Date.-Change the Depreciation Method to 0000 - No automatic depreciation.-Invalid calculation method due to change from/to daily calculation-Cause-The error is raised when changing from daily calculation based depreciation method to a non-daily calculation or vice versa within one Fiscal Year.-The system will not allow it.-Resolution-If the need is to use 'No automatic depreciation' along with a daily depreciation method, the Depreciation Method should be '000D' instead of '0000'.-At this time, this is only available in France.-In case it does not appear in the Business Configuration, please scope in the country/region France.-The 000D is similar to 0000 except that it's marked with the daily depreciation flag "true" and hence it's the depreciation code to be used for such scenarios involving daily depreciation codes in other intervals.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Depreciation, no automatic depreciation, depreciation method-fixed asset,depreciation,no automatic depreciation,depreciation method

Title: Making Tax Digital-UK: Error: CLIENT_OR_AGENT_NOT_AUTHORISED
Content: Symptom-You release your UK Digital VAT Return and receive the Error Description:-|Technical Response: : code : CLIENT_OR_AGENT_NOT_AUTHORISED,message : The client and/or agent is not authorised. HTTP code: 403-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Select the VAT Returns subview.-Show All Tax Returns and search for the ID: XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the respective UK Tax Return).-Select View.-Under the tab Overview, here for the Submission Information, you have the Error Description:-|Technical Response: : code : CLIENT_OR_AGENT_NOT_AUTHORISED,message : The client and/or agent is not authorised. HTTP code: 403-Cause-The error: CLIENT_OR_AGENT_NOT_AUTHORISED occurs when either Client (SAP Business ByDesign) or Agent (Customer) is not authorized to submit the VAT Return.-Resolution-The activity "UK-Making Tax Digital" is user specific i.e account set up by one user will not be visible to other users. It has been developed in this manner so not every user has the authorization to change the valid account.-To correct this error, make sure the valid authorized person release the Tax Return.-Keywords-Making Tax Digital-UK, Tax Return, Digital Tax, VAT Return UK.

Title: Bank Statement Cannot be Reversed
Content: Symptom-You try to reverse a bank statement because the transaction confirmed in this bank statement is not desired, but the system gives the error message: 'Reverse not possible. There is at least one bank statement with a later date that has been already posted or uploaded and ready to be posted manually.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the Bank Statements view.-Select the Bank Statement you want to reverse.-Choose Reverse under Actions.  -The system shows the error message: Reverse not possible. There is at least one bank statement with a later date that has been already posted or uploaded and ready to be posted manually.-Cause-You can only reverse the very latest bank statement, as long as there are follow up bank statements, it's then not possible to reverse the bank statement, because it will affect the opening balances for all the follow-up bank statements.-Resolution-In order to successfully reverse the bank statement, you should reverse all the follow-up bank statements for the same bank account starting from the latest one.-If you do not want to reverse all the follow-up bank statements, you may consider creating new incoming or outgoing payments to balance the transactions in the bank statement to be reversed. For example, you confirm an outgoing bank transfer to a supplier in the bank statement to be reversed, now you can create an incoming bank transfer from the supplier, and confirm it in the new bank statement, in this way, the transactions are balanced, and you don't have to reverse all those follow up bank statements. Of course, outside of the Business ByDesign system, you should make sure the money is received from the supplier involved.-Keywords-bank statement; reverse

Title: Source Document Item ID does not match Source Doc ID
Content: Symptom-You have run a report for Journal Entry details. You have added in the characteristic: Source Doc. Item and Source Doc.ID.-You expect the IDs to match, however the Source Doc.Item ID does not match the Source Doc ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select a report that contains Journal Entry details, for Example report Journal (Report ID: FINGLAU03_Q0001).-Enter the required selection criteria.-Add the characteristics:-Journal Entry-Source Doc. ID-Source Doc. Item-For Journal Entry XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Journal Entry ID) you notice that Source Doc. Item does not match the ID under Source Doc. ID-You expect that the Source Doc Item would match the Source Doc ID.-Cause-Journal Entry XYZ is a cancellation posting. When a cancellation posting is posted to the system, it creates a new source document. However the Source Document Item is connected back to the original document that was posted.-Resolution-Correct and expected system behavior.-Keywords-Journal Entry, Source Doc. Item, Source Doc. ID, Source Doc does not match,

Title: Mexico Electronic Accounting Run: Transfer Node Not Filled For Cash Disbursement Journal Entries in Journal File XML
Content: Symptom-The XML file generated for a Mexico Electronic Accounting Run with report selection data Journal File has the Transfer node empty for Cash Disbursement journal entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Mexico Electronic Accounting view.-Select the respective Run ID and Application Log ID and click View Report Run Results.-Go to the Attachments tab and download the XML file.-Open the XML file and notice that Transfer Node fields, such as CtaOri15, CtaDest, BancoDestNal, etc are not filled for the respective journal entries (NumUnIdenPol).-Cause-In the respective Mexico Electronic Accounting Run the G/L Account entered in Report Selection Data section > G/L Account From/To field is of G/L Account Type other than Cash (for example, Payables).-Resolution-For Cash Disbursement Journal Entries a G/L Account of type Cash should be specified in the Mexico Electronic Accounting Run, otherwise, system won't be able to fetch the journal entries data and fill the Transfer Node in the XML file.-Keywords-mexico electronic accounting; journal file; transfer; transferencia; cash; xml

Title: Error: Account Determination is Missing for Item Type Output Tax
Content: Symptom-You try to post the Customer Invoice to accounting, but the system gives the following error message: Account determination is missing for Item Type Output Tax.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Closing-Relevant Tasks subview.-You can find there is a task that has the subject Account determination is missing for position type Output Tax.-Select the task and you can see the following description:  Account determination is missing for Item Type Output Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC: Chart of Accounts and account determination profile <ABC>. Column path Tax->Output Tax->Output Tax, Item Type Output Tax.-(Or)-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents subview.-Search for your Source Document ID, in this case the Source Document is a Customer Invoice.-Choose View Business Transaction, you can see the same error message: Account determination is missing for Item Type Output Tax.-Cause-The reason is that you have not maintained the Account Determination Group for Tax Events and Tax Account Determination.-Resolution-You need to maintain the Tax Account Determination by following the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open the activity Account Determination Groups for Tax Events.-Maintain the Account Determination group for respective Country and Account Determination Group.-Once you main the Account Determination Group for Tax Events, you need to maintain the Account Determination for Tax:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click View button.-Under Account Determination section select Tax.-Select your Account Determination Profile.-Go to the Output Tax tab.-Click Add Row button.-Maintain the Account Determination Group for Output Tax-Click Save and Close.-Now you are able to post the Unposted Source Document:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Search for your Source Document ID, in this case the source document is Customer Invoice.-Select the ID and click Actions -> Post Business Transaction.-Keywords-Unposted, Customer Invoice, Output Tax, Account Determination.

Title: Accounting Postings for WIP Clearing Run for Moving Average
Content: Symptom-You perform a WIP Clearing run. You notice postings on a difference account for Material valuated with the Moving Average perpetual cost method.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation workcenter.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the WIP Clearing run and search for the Run ID: ABC (ABC represents the Run ID).-Select the Run ID: ABC and navigate to the Postings tab.-For Material XYZ Moving Average is maintained the Perpetual Cost Method (XYZ represents the Material ID).-In the Application Log of the run you notice postings to G/L Accounts of type DIFFER (Differences). You expect the postings for materials with the Moving Average method to capitalize differences on the Inventory Account directly.-Cause-The WIP Clearing run allocates to Difference accounts for Materials with the Moving Average cost method when the inventory quantity is zero (0) for the Material; With zero quantity in inventory, inventory can in fact not be valuated. To verify the inventory quantity on the last day of the accounting period selected in the WIP clearing run check the Material Cost History for the Material in the Inventory Valuation work center.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Since there is no Inventory Quantity available on the Posting Date of the WIP Clearing run, identified Production Lot differences are posted to Difference Accounts rather than capitalized on the Inventory Ledger to immediately influence the Material's inventory cost.-Keywords-WIP Clearing, Moving Average, Difference Account, DIFFER Posting-moving average,wip clearing run,standard cost,differ

Title: How to Change the Tax Date When Invoicing the Outbound Delivery Invoice Requests from Migrated Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-When invoicing the outbound delivery invoice request, you find in some invoice requests the Tax Date on item level is not editable, but in some other outbound delivery invoice requests, it is editable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Reqeusts view.-Select the outbound delivery invoice request you want to edit and click Edit button to open it.-In Items tab, select one row. -Go to Taxes tab, the Tax Date field is grayed out, you are not able to change the value.-Cause-For migrated sales orders, the price and tax fields are marked as statistical , that is the reason they are read only. This behaviour is copied all the way till invoicing.-Besides it, if the invoice requests are from invoice scheduling, tax date is not editable.-Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior.-If you intend to change the tax date, you can 'Undo Release' of Outbound delivery,change the delivery and shippment date to the required value if possible and then release the outbound delivery and proceed with invoicing.-Tax date is derived from delivery date of outbound delivery.-Keywords-tax date; read only; grayed out; outbound delivery invoice request

Title: Error - You Cannot Enter a Date In a Prior Period for Set of Books ABC
Content: Symptom-You see the error message - "You cannot enter a date in a prior period for set of books ABC" while creating Actual Cost Release run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work centre-Click on Actual Cost Release view.-Click on New.-Select Actual Cost Release Run.-Enter the parameters:-Run Description-Company ID-Set Of Books-From Period/Year-Price Valid From-You see the error - You cannot enter a date in a prior period for set of books ABC. -Cause-The Actual Cost Release Run overwrites the actual cost in the materials’ master data for the current or future accounting periods with the cost calculated for preceding periods in the respective actual cost rollup runs.-In short, you cannot execute Actual Cost Release Run for the past. There is a check point in the Actual Cost Release Run creation to prevent calculation of Actual Cost for the past.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-2574497

Title: Fields in the Employee Lifecycle Events Report Are Not Showing Data Correctly
Content: Symptom-You are trying to check employee movements using the Employee Lifecycle Events report, but the Event Date, Event Date and Event Reason fields are not showing any data.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Access the Design Reports work center view.-Locate and open the report Employee Lifecycle Events.-Run the report with default settings.-The Event Date, Event Date and Event Reason fields will show "#" or "Not assigned", as seen in the screenshot below.-Cause- This is the standard system behavior.-The Employee Lifecycle Events fetches data based on the Key Date field. If no date or date range is provided, the report pulls data based on the current date — if no employee movements have been done in the current date, no data will be shown in the mentioned fields.-Resolution-Please set a date or date range in the Key Date field in the Selection tab before running the report.-You can also use the Event Type to select specific event types that should be displayed. To find this field, click the Additional Fields button in the Selection tab.-Keywords-Employee Lifecycle Events, Not Assigned, #, Event Type, Event Date, Event Reason

Title: Error During Balance Carryforward: The Balance Carryforward is not Possible. Execute Depreciation Under Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the below error messages when you execute balance carryforward:-'The balance carryforward is not possible. Execute Depreciation under Fixed Assets'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks View and Balance Carryforward subview.-Click new Carryforward Run.-Select the company and year for which you want to perform the balance carryforward.-Click Start Now and you can see the below error message:-The balance carryforward is not possible. Execute Depreciation under Fixed Assets-Cause-There are two possible reasons for the issue:-Depreciation has not been executed for some fixed assets and all valuation views.-Depreciation status is not refreshed for some fixed assets.-Resolution-You need to check if any depreciation (irrespective of the valuation views) has been missed in the fiscal year you want to close period 12 or the fiscal year itself.-You can run the Depreciation report available in the Fixed Asset work centre to compare the Planned Depreciation and the Posted Depreciation.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Reports view and List subview.-Select the Depreciation report.-Enter the Variables to run the report.-Company: enter the company for which you want to perform the closing process.-Set of Books: you need to enter a set of books assigned to the company (you need to run the report for all set of books assigned to the concerned company, but you only can enter one set of books at a time)-Valuation View ID:  you need to enter a valuation view assigned to the set of books entered previously (you need to run the report for all valuation views assigned to the entered set of books, but you only can enter one valuation view at a time).-Accounting Period/Year: enter the fiscal year you want to close or for which you want to close the period 12.-On running the report for the variables entered, change the default view, Planned Values, of the report to the view Posted / Planned Values.-Compare the posted depreciation amount and the planned depreciation amount for the selection entered in the report variables.-You check and find all depreciation is done. But system still has the error. Then it may be the depreciation status is not updated for some fixed asset.-You need to run a depreciation recalculation for all fixed assets. Before you do it, you need to close all the periods for the year which you want to run balance carry forward for but except period 12.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view and Depreciation subview.-Select to create a new depreciation with all fixed assets but input the year as 9999 and period as 999 (Recalculation Run).-Please execute the depreciation with update mode. With such run, the depreciation status of all fixed assets will be refreshed. Then you can run balance carry forward without errors.- In case the error persists, please Report an incident to SAP Support.-Keywords-Balance carryforward, Depreciation run, Fixed assets, Closing not possible

Title: Data Exported via Mass Data Maintenance is Displayed in the Wrong Columns
Content: Symptom-When exporting data through CSV format using the Mass Data Maintenance tool, some data is exported to the wrong columns of the file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Mass Data Maintenance view.-Enter the export selection screen of any object (e.g, Materials).-Select the objects to be exported and click Export to CSV File.-After downloading the file, open it using a CSV editor and check the data exported. -Cause-There are extension fields extended for the exported object which contain commas in the name/description.-This causes the CSV file generated to be inconsistent, and data will be displayed in different columns.-This scenario is also specific to each language. So if the extension field description is maintained only for language EN, for example, the issue will not happen when exporting the data while logged in other languages.-Resolution-Check the extension fields for the exported object and ensure that no comma is maintained in the name or description of the field.-Keywords-MDM, Mass Data Workbench

Title: Expense Report Remains in Status Released for Reimbursement Even After the Expenses are Paid Out
Content: Symptom-You see that the Expense Report is paid out in the system but the Status of the Expense Report is still Released for Reimbursement and not Reimbursed.-You want to know if the Status of Expense Report gets changed once the Expenses are paid out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Find Expense Report XYZ (XYZ means the Expense Report ID).-You could see that the Status is Released for Reimbursement.-Cause-Expense Report remains in Status Released for Reimbursement even if it is paid out.-Resolution-In order for you to check if the Expense Report is Reimbursed or not, you need to check the Reimbursement Status of the Expense Report.-Keywords- Expense Report, Reimbursement Status, Reimbursed.

Title: You Want To Change The G/L Account Type
Content: Symptom-You have created a G/L Account XXX for Chart of Accounts XYZ and you want to change the G/L Account Type (XXX means the G/L Account ID; XYZ means the Chart of Accounts ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation Project and click the Open Activity List.-Select the Fine Tune phase and then select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity from the activity list.-Click the Edit chart of accounts.-You have created a G/L Account XXX for Chart of Accounts XYZ and you want to change the G/L Account Type.-Resolution-You can change the G/L Account Type if there are no postings in the system. In case there are postings for the G/L Account you need to reverse all the postings and then change the G/L Account Type.-You should execute the report: G/L Accounts - Line Items to check if there are any postings made.-Keywords-G/L Account Type, Charts of Accounts-g/l account type

Title: The E-mail Domain of the Sender is Missing in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to send an e-mail from a Lead and when making the attempt, the system returns the error message: "The e-mail domain of the sender is missing in business configuration for e-mail and fax settings."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Leads view.-Select and open ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Lead).-Click the Follow-Up button.-Select E-Mail.-Try to send an e-mail.-Error appears:-The e-mail domain of the sender is missing in business configuration for e-mail and fax settings-  Cause-When maintaining the domain under the Fax and E-mail activity, you have added the @ sign in the beginning of the domain.-Example: @sap.com-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To correct this, kindly remover the @ sign from the domain.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity E-Mail and Fax Settings.-In the section Domain, change the domain:-Example:-From: @sap.com-To: sap.com-Keywords-E-mail, Sender, Missing, Business Configuration, Fax, Settings

Title: Error: 'Tax reporting unit of down payment differs from those of other items'
Content: Symptom-You are not able to clear a customer invoice with down payment because of the error message: 'Tax reporting unit of down payment differs from those of other items'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Choose any customer and click View.-In the Trade Receivables tab, show Open Items.-You can see a customer invoice and a down payment with the same account.-Select these two items and choose Clear Manually.-In the new manual clearing screen, the customer invoice is automatically unchecked, and the system gives the error message:-          'Tax reporting unit of down payment differs from those of other items.'-Cause-You cannot clear the documents against each other when the tax reporting units are different from each document.-Resolution-System will determine tax reporting unit automatically based on whether the items are goods or services. In order to overcome this issue you can follow either of these options:-Cancel and create new invoice which will match and equals the tax reporting unit of down payment.- or.-Go to the Customer Invoicing/Supplier Invoicing work center.-Show All Documents.-Find Document ID XXX (where XXX stands for the deviating payment).-Click Cancel.-The system creates a cancellation document and changes the status of the original invoice document to canceled.-Go to the Customer Invoicing/Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Invoice / New Invoice Without Purchase Order under common tasks.-Fill the required before posting.-Sales Process-For goods, the system determines the TRU from the Ship-from location.-For services, the system determines the TRU from the Bill-from party/ Invoicing Unit.-For projects and third party shipments, TRU is determined from Bill-from party /Invoicing unit.-Purchase Process-For goods, the system determines the TRU from the Ship-to location.-For services, the system determines the TRU from the Bill-to party.-Now you can select the correct Ship from/to, Invoicing unit etc., as required to match the same party that your down payment has and clear the invoice with down payment.- If the TRU in the invoice is correct you can follow the below option to correct the TRU in down payment:-     1. Cancel the down payment and create new down payment by cautiously selecting the party which will match TRU of your invoice-See Also-Refer to the help document Multiple Tax Registration – India for the details on how tax reporting unit is determined for goods and services.-Keywords-GST India, Tax Reporting Unit Of Down Payment Differs From Those Of Other Items, tax, supplier, customer, TRU, tax reporting unit

Title: Business Role activation failed in the target C4C system
Content: Symptom-Activation Failed error messages for few Business Roles in the transport logs-For example:-Failed to create business role XYZ-Failed to activate business role XYZ-Work center view ADMIN_IND_SETTINGS is no longer scoped Transport Object ID:ZXX:XX:XXXX:SECURITY-Assigning view ADMIN_IND_SETTINGS together with work center SEODADMINWCF not permitted Transport Object :ZXX:XX:XXXX:SECURITY-(where the XX value is a variable and the ADMIN_IND_SETTINGS could also be some other value)-Some of the roles we are able to transport successfully-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP C4C CORE 2105 / 804-Reproducing the Issue-Connect to the target tenant system-Go to Administrator-> Transport Management view -Open the desired transport ID-Go to Transport Logs-Cause-In this example, the target tenant system does not have the scoping enabled for the Industry Solution-Resolution-Connected to the target tenant system-Navigate to the Business Configuration Projects view-Select "Edit Scope"-Go to step 3: Scoping-Make sure that the Industry Solution box is checked-Hit next until the scoping is finished-Keywords-Activation failed UTM transport management activation error transport request error, missing scoping in the target system, missing view in the target system

Title: Error: "Invalid MovementCategory 08 with first acq./cap./depr. start date xx/yy/zzzz"
Content: Symptom-Error: Invalid MovementCategory 08 with first acq./cap./depr. start date xx/yy/zzzz, while trying to migrate Fixed Assets.-xx/yy/zzzz means the Initial Acquisition Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant change project.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Find and select the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select link: Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant Unit or Create Unit.-Upload the migration template.-Select the Execute Migration button.-Error message is thrown-Cause-The Initial Acquisition Date xx/yy/zzzz supplied for a certain record in the migration template is an earlier date than the Capitalization Date for that entry.-Resolution-Kindly ensure that the Capitalization Date maintained in the template is a later date than the Initial Acquisition Date for the respective records and re-trigger the migration.-Keywords-fixed assets migration; fixed assets (extended); movement category

Title: Unable to Delete the Row with VAT Form Box '06B - Intra-Community Deliveries' maintained for Tax Event '455 - EU Sale of Services, Reverse Charge'
Content: Symptom-You are unable to delete the row from VAT Form Box '06B - Intra-Community Deliveries' maintained in the Summary layout for Tax Event '455 - EU Sale of Services, Reverse Charge'.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and Select Tax Returns for Goods and Services - France.-Click Product Tax Return France.-In Tax Return Types, select '1 - Taxe Sur La Valeur Ajoutée (VAT Return)'.-Go to the Tax Event subtab.-Select the Tax Event '455 - EU Sale of Services, Reverse Charge'.-In the Summary layout, you can see two rows maintained and it is not possible to delete it.-Cause-There are 2 entries as the mapping entry for Tax Event 455 was changed from 06B to 05B due to a legal change requirement in the past.-The Valid From and Valid To dates for the mapping entries are not visible from the UI, just in the backend as follows:-05B - Other Non Taxable Transactions: 01.01.2019 to 31.12.9999-06B - Intra-Community Deliveries: 01.01.2010 to 31.12.2018-Resolution-System behaves as expected, the two rows 05B and 06B need to be maintained in the UI.-Documents created on or after 01.01.2019 with Tax Event '455 - EU Sale of Services, Reverse Charge' will get reported in Tax Form Box '05B' only.-Keywords-Tax Event 455, Form Box 05B, 06B, TAX Return France.

Title: Ad Hoc Time Account not Appearing for Selection in Employee Time File
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a custom ad hoc time account to an employee time file, the time account created is not available-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search and open the employee.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab of the employee.-In the Time Rules section on the bottom of the screen, add a new row.-In the time account selection, the ad hoc time account created is not available.-Cause-The issue happens because the time account starting validity on the Business configuration activity is after the start date of the employee time profile. So by the time the employee profile started, the time account still did not exist.-Resolution-In order to fix this scenario, you would need to add a new time file that covers the validity of the ad hoc time account periods or change the ad hoc time account periods to match the time that they require to assign to an employee.-Keywords-Adhoc, time rule

Title: Dunning Run No Dunning Proposals As Payables Exceed Receivables
Content: Symptom-You execute a dunning run and expect that due to open items in the customer account dunning proposals are created.-Instead, no dunning proposals are created by the dunning run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Receivables work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Navigate to the Dunning Runs subview.-Choose an Active Dunning Run or create a new Dunning Run.-Click Schedule button.-Schedule the run and confirm with Save and Close.-After executing the run:-Open the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Search for Customer ID of Customer XXX (XXX means the Customer for which the Dunning Run has been executed):-No Dunning Proposals are shown.-Check the Application Log of the Dunning Run as follows:-Open the Receivables work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Navigate to Dunning Runs subview.-Select the respective Dunning Run.-Open the Application Log under Execution Details by clicking on the Application Log ID.-Navigate to the Results tab.-The message Payables exceed receivables (company YYY, business partner XXX) is shown for Customer XXX (YYY stands for Company name).-Cause-The business logic of the dunning procedure is that the system compares the total amount of the payables with all due receivables for a business partner.-If the payables for the business partner exceed the receivables, no dunning proposal will be created.-Instead, the system shows the message 'Payables exceed receivables (company YYY, business partner XXX)'.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-dunning; payables; receivables; dunning procedure

Title: Standard Data Source - Activity Task (CRMTKAHB)
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Standard Data Source - Activity Task (CRMTKAHB) to retrieve  data for the following reports, but the same is not populated.-Activity Contact - Main Contact - Task-Activity Contact - Task-Activity Unit - Main Contact - Task-Employee Responsible - Main Contact - Task-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Data Sources subview, below Data Sources view.-Search for the data source CRMTKAHB.-Click Preview.-Go to the View tab.-Add the following fields as Rows:-Activity Contact - Main Contact - Task-Activity Contact - Task-Activity Unit - Main Contact - Task-Employee Responsible - Main Contact - Task-Go to the Selection tab.-Click the value box of the field Activity Contact - Task.-Enter the expected Task.-Click Apply-System returns the hashtag (#) symbol for the fields.-Cause-The report will only populate data in the entered fields, based on the "Related Contacts" information which has to be maintained in the task.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-To solve this, please maintain the Related Contacts data within the task.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Activities views.-Select the All Activity Tasks.-Select task ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Task).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Select any Party Role.-Navigate to the Related Contacts subtab.-Click Add Row.-Enter a name by clicking on the value box.-Click Save.-Now the value will update in the report.-Field name in the Report and in the Task:-Field Name in the Report: Activity Contact - Main Contact - Task-Field Name in the Task: Activity Contact-Field Name in the Report: Activity Contact - Task-Field Name in the Task: Account-Field Name in the Report: Main Contact - Task-Field Name in the Task: Organizational Unit-Field Name in the Report: Employee Responsible - Main Contact - Task-Field Name in the Task: Employee Responsible-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Standard Data Source, Activity Task, CRMTKAHB, Value, #, hashtag, Task

Title: Revenue Recognition Reversing Earned Revenues and Earned Invoice Quantity Upon Setting a Reason For Rejection in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales order of item type 'Product - delivery-based' with an external fulfillment for 900 ea of a given material.-The 3PL Purchase Order has been created, inbound and outbound deliveries as well as supplier invoice posted successfully for a partial delivery and partial invoice of 800 ea.-Since the accrual method of this sales order is 'Recognize at point of delivery', you ran a revenue recognition run, which as recognized the revenue and the cost of sales for the corresponding 800 ea.-You decide that this sales order will be fulfilled partially (e.g. due to stock shortage) and hence reduces the purchase order quantity to the already delivered quantity (800 ea). The purchase order gets finished and delivery completed. After that, you set a reason for rejection in the sales order item to cancel the pending 100 ea.-Once you execute revenue recognition again, the earned revenues amount and invoice quantity gets offset (-800 ea), which is not expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Revenue Recognition view.-Open the concerned run.-Go to Processed Successfully and check the related sales order.-You see that the earned revenues amount and invoice quantity were offset.-Cause-When setting a rejection reason in the sales order, it cancels the open quantity that is not delivered and respectively cancel the not invoiced quantity. In this case, the 800 ea were delivered, but not yet invoice. The customer invoice remains Not Released.-Since the accrual method is 'Recognize at point of delivery' and 800 are delivered, the revenue and the cost of sales are recognized. After that, the reason for rejection is set, however this action cancels the open quantity that is not delivered and respectively cancel the not invoiced quantity. In this case, the Invoice Process is not started and the 800 ea not invoiced, since the customer invoice is not released yet. Hence, upon a new revenue recognition you see the offset in the invoice quantity of -800 ea and in the earned revenues.-Resolution-You can release the customer invoice for the 800ea that were pending. This should set the invoice status to Finished in the sales order. Upon a new revenue recognition, the amounts shall be recognized.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition. Current Earned Revenues Amount. Current Earned Invoice Quantity. Sales Order. 3PL. External Fulfillment.

Title: You Cannot Change The Password For Your Own User
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the password of your own administrator user through the Application and User Management work center, but the password field is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Business Users work center view.-Search for your own user and select it.-Click Edit, then choose Attributes.-Notice that the Password field is missing.-Cause-You cannot change the password of your own user in the Application and User Management work center. This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-Log out of the system.-Enter your logon details (do not click Log On).-Click Change Password.-Enter your Current Password and the New Password.-Click Change.-Keywords-Change, Own, Password, User, Administrator, Application and User Management-own password,administrator

Title: Option Assign Account As Pledged is greyed out in the Account
Content: Symptom-You set a Corporate Account with the checkbox International Pledging for Austria, however the option to Assign Account As Pledged is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Find relevant Account.-Click View.-Click Actions.-The option Assign Account As Pledged is greyed out.-Cause-This occurs due to missing scoping question on the Project.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Click Next until you reach Step 4 - Questions.-Expand Cash Flow Management.-Expand Payables and Receivables Processing.-Select Reporting and Analytics for Payables and Receivables Processing.-Check Accounts Receivable - Pledging of Open Items.-After this is completed the option will be available.-Keywords-Austria, Pledging, Assign Account As Pledged

Title: Checks Not Printing Due To Error
Content: Symptom-When selecting Print Check Form the system dumps.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show Payments Ready for Transfer.-Select relevant Payment.-Click gear icon - Print Check Form.-Dump occurs.-Cause-This can happen due to missing Address on the Business Partner Account.-Resolution-To adjust this, the Address needs to be maintained in the Business Partner Account:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partners view.-Find the relevant Business Partner.-Click Edit - Addresses.-After this is maintained redo the steps to Print Check Form.-Keywords-Check, Payment, Print Check Form, dump, Crash-check,payment,print check form,dump,crash

Title: Some Time Recording Approval Tasks Are Missing in the Approvals View of the Managing My Area Work Center
Content: Symptom-You, as a line manager, find that some time recording approval tasks do not appear in the Approvals view of the Managing My Area work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Select the Approvals view.-Cause-Only the approval tasks for time recordings against time types belonging to time type category Vacation, Leave, Illness and Special Attendance will be sent to the Approvals view in Managing My Area. The approval task for time recordings on time types of time type category Productive Time, but not on project task can be seen by the Confirm Time Recording link under Common Tasks in Managing My Area. The approval task for time recordings on project task cannot be seen in Managing My Area work center. The project manager must go to Project Management work center, Approval view and Time Recordings subview to approve them.-Resolution-You can find the approval tasks for time recordings against time types belonging to other time type categories, such as Productive Time, as below:-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Select the Confirm Time Recordings under Common Tasks.-Keywords-approval, productive time, managing my area, missing

Title: 'Save canceled due to invalid data' Error While Adding Subsidiary in Company Tax Arrangement
Content: Symptom- Error messages upon adding a subsidiary in Company Tax Arrangement:-"Save canceled due to invalid data"-"Save failed"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements subview.-Select the row of Company ID AAA and click Edit.-Click Subsidiaries tab.-Click Add Row.-Enter Company ID BBB.-Click Save.-Error messages are displayed:-"Save canceled due to invalid data"-"Save failed"-Cause-The subsidiary Company ID BBB is not valid during the entire validity period of Company Tax Arrangement of Company ID AAA.-For example:-Company Tax Arrangement AAA Valid From "31.12.2020" to "Unlimited"-Subsidiary BBB Valid From "01.01.2021" to "Unlimited"-Resolution-The subsidiary BBB should be valid "as of" or "before" the Company Tax Arrangement AAA.-The Valid From date of BBB should be changed and activated in Organizational Management - Org Structures work center view.-Keywords-company tax arrangement; cta; valid from; subsidiary; subsidiaries

Title: Reverse/Change Depreciation from Right of Use (RoU) Asset
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to reverse or change the depreciation of a RoU (Right of Use asset) created through a lease contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Open the related RoU asset.-You see that the master data is not editable.-Resolution-The changes in the RoU asset depend on what you want to achieve. The changes in the RoU asset are done via changes in the corresponding lease contract. To retire this asset, you need to cancel the lease contract. A change in the depreciation amounts can only happen via a change in the lease agreement. In this case, you need to create a new lease contract version. This is to ensure that the lease contract and the RoU asset are always in sync. The base for the depreciation calculation of a ROU asset is given by the lease contract cash flow, not by any depreciation calculation within the RoU asset.-Keywords-IFRS16. Depreciation. Right of Use Asset. Fixed Asset. Lease Contract. Leasing.

Title: Purchase Order Field Missing in Time Entry Labor Information
Content: Symptom-You are checking the labor information of time entries maintained in the system and notice that the Purchase Order field is missing for some employees, even if the time type/project task used is the same.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center-Locate and select the relevant employee.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Employee Times tab.-Select the relevant time entry.-Under Details, navigate to tab Labor Information.-The Purchase Order field is missing.-Cause-The relevant employee is exclusively an internal employee. Only service agents are billable by purchase orders — hence, only service agents or employees who are also service agents will have the Purchase Order field shown under the Labor Information for their time entries.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-If you wish to make the relevant employee a service agent as well, so that they are also billable by purchase orders, please follow the below instructions:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Access the Business Partners work center view.-Search for the relevant employee.-Select the record and click Create As, then select Service Agent.-Keywords-labor information, purchase order, field, missing, employee, service agent, time recording
