Title: System Crash When Posting an Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You create and post an intercompany journal entry voucher but an Internal Server Error. HTTP 500 appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Open your In Preparation intercompany journal entry voucher or create a new one. -Press Post.-Cause-You have maintained and calculated taxes for one of the journal entry voucher line items, but for one of the line items the tax code is missing.-Resolution-Review this intercompany journal entry voucher and make sure that all the company entries have an associated tax code.-If no taxes are required for a given entry, a non-taxable tax code can be maintained.-Once the tax code is maintained, and if there are no other differences, the posting will work without any issues.-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, Intercompany

Title: Financial Statements Report Shows General Ledger Accounts that are not Assigned to the Reporting Structure
Content: Symptom-You run the Report: Financial Statements and you notice that General Ledger Accounts that are not assigned to the reporting structure show in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Report view.-Show All and search for Financial Statements.-Filter for the report ID: XYZ_XYZ (XYZ_XYZ stands for the ID of the report).-Click the report name.-Run the report with the required selections.-On the report generated, there appears some General Ledger Accounts that are not assigned to the reporting structure.-This report can also be opened in the General Ledger work center.-Cause-The not assigned General Ledger Accounts are not seen as part of the reporting structure. They are outside the reporting structure under Not Assigned node. This can be seen by selecting View > Financial Statement > Not Assigned Balance Sheet And In (s). This shows the balances on accounts not assigned to the reporting structure.-The General Ledger Accounts assigned to the reporting structure are Net Profit/Loss/Profit etc.-You can see this as part of the Financial Statements view which has hierarchical node structure.-All General Ledger Accounts will be shown in the report whether or not they are assigned to the given structure.-Resolution-This is how the report is designed and it is the correct system behavior.-Keywords-Financial Statements Report Structure, Structure de Rapport Financier

Title: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data - File Validation Failed. Create an Incident
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate Accounting Transaction Data with the migration tool.-The migration unit is created. All files are uploaded.-But in the first step, Process Files when trying to process an error message appears, 'File Validation Failed. Create an Incident' when processing the respective Migration object, such as Open Items Receivable or Open Items Payable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration work center, go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project and click Open Activity List.-In the Activity list, navigate to the Integrate and Extend phase.-Find the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity and open it.-Click the "Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool" link-Select the respective migration unit and then click Execute Migration.-In step 1 - Process Files, select the migration object (for example, Open Items Receivable).-Click Process File.-The error message "File validation failed. Create an Incident" appears.-Cause-This issue can be related to the date format used in some of the fields maintained in the migration file. Please see KBA 2149251 below for further instructions.-If this KBA does not solve the error, it might be necessary to refresh the involved migration objects.-Resolution-Should it not be possible to solve this error by maintaining the date formats, please send an incident to SAP Product Support and request a refresh of the Migration Object.-See Also-Refer to Knowledge Base Article 2149251-Keywords-File validation failed, migration of accounting transaction data, migration open items payable, open items receivable, Dateivalidierung ist fehlgeschlagen

Title: Posted Goods and Service Receipt Not Resulting In The Creation of a Low-Value Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-Creation of a Purchase Order assigning a new Individual Material (IMAT) and you expect the corresponding Low-Value Fixed Asset be created automatically.-But when checking the Goods and Service Receipt, it's not possible to identify the Item Details from the new Low-Value Fixed Asset.-And if you go to the Fixed Asset view, it's not possible to find the Fixed Asset ID created either.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries -> Journal Entries view.-Find the Journal Entry by searching with the Source Document ID for Goods and Service Receipt XXX (XXX represents the Goods Receipt ID).-Upon selecting the G/L Lines from the debit side of the Journal Entry, you can't find any Low-Value Fixed Asset ID in the Item Details.-Cause-The Product Category assigned for the Individual Material maintained in the Purchase Order is not assigned in the Fine-Tune setting on Fixed Asset Classes -> Asset Class Determination.-Resolution-Note that the Product Category maintained for the Purchase Order line item may be different than what you maintained for the Individual Material.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and Select the line from the Purchase Order in question.-Click Edit.-Navigate to Items tab and Account Assignment sub-tab.-Double-click the Individual Material ID that is already maintained.-Take note of the Product Category ID.-You must have maintained a Product Category during the Purchase Order's creation.-For this Product Category, you need to maintain the settings to assign it to the Asset Class.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Select the Fine-Tune tab.-Search for Fixed Asset Classes.-Click Open.-Click Asset Class Determination.-Maintain the settings for Company, Product Category and the Fixed Asset Class.-Click Save.-If you create a Purchase Order, Goods Receipt, or Supplier Invoice with a Product Category for Fixed Assets, the system will be able to create the corresponding Low-Value Fixed Asset automatically.-For this, the system uses the Fixed Asset Class you have assigned here.-See Also-2654709 - Posted Goods and Service Receipt Not Resulting In The Creation of Fixed Asset-Keywords- Low-Value Fixed Asset, Purchase Order, Fixed Asset, Individual Material

Title: Logic Behind the Limit Item Description in the Invoice Screen
Content: Symptom-You create a purchase order with two limit items but the invoice screen consolidates both the line item into one line item after the goods receipt creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Entry view.-Select the purchase order and select New Invoice button.-Cause-The Goods And Services Receipt is created with two line item with reference to first line item of purchase order with the descriptions:-Item 1: Mgmt Fee - ABCD - April-10677-Item 2: Mgmt Fee - Cahill - April-10677-Our system collects similar characters from both the line items into one external item. These strings are condensed and the maximum number of differing chars are exactly 6 chars.-The only difference in the description is "ABCD" vs. "Cahill". So these items were put together into an external item.-Resolution-You can see all items that are grouped into a single line item by selecting the By Goods Receipt option from the dropdown list of Group button.-Keywords-purchase order,goods receipt

Title: Error When Posting Expense Report Cancelation 'Proposed date DD.MM.YYYY of reversal must not be before original date DD.MM.YYYY'
Content: Symptom-When posting an Expense Report Cancellation the error below is received:-'Proposed date DD.MM.YYYY of reversal must not be before original date DD.MM.YYYY'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find relevant Expense Report.-Error: 'Proposed date 01.01.2021 of reversal must not be before original date 01.02.2021'.-01.01.2021 - example of Posting date for Expense Report.-01.02.2021 - example of date the Posting cannot take place before.-Cause-This error can occur if the Expense Report has a Clearing that relates to the Date 01.02.2021, hence the system tries to Reverse this Clearing at the same time of the Posting of the Expense Report Cancellation and since the Date is after the Posting Date the error is raised.-Resolution-To be able to use the chosen Posting Date for the Expense Report Cancellation, first Reverse the Clearing that is associated with this Expense Report.-Once this is done you should be able to Post the Reversal in 01.01.2021.-Keywords-Expense Report, Reversal, Cancellation, Proposed date, reversal must not be before original date-expense report,reversal,cancellation,proposed date,reversal must not be before original dat

Title: Profit Center Determined in the Journal Entry Voucher is not Valid
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Journal Entry Voucher with reference to sales document, however the wrong profit center is being derived from the sales unit in the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entry Voucher view.-Click New -> Journal Entry Voucher.-Select the journal entry type as 00088 and reference the relevant sales order in the credit/debit entries.-Fill all the remaining required information.-Simulate the journal entry and check the derived profit center.-You see that the profit center is not the expected one.-Additionally, if, for example, the profit center has been deactivated, you also find an error message upon simulation as follows: 'Profit center <profit center ID - name> determined for Journal Entry Voucher is not valid on <posting date>. Check the validity of profit center <profit center ID - name> in Organizational Management and your default profit centers in configuration'-Cause-The journal entry voucher considers the profit center that is in the financial accounting view of the sales document. In this case, the assigned profit center is not the expected one, although the sales unit has been updated in the sales order.-Resolution-You may verify and change the profit center assignment to the sales order as follows:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Sales Documents Items view.-Search for the concerned sales order.-In this view, you see the actual profit center assignment.-Highlight the entry and click Reassign to change the profit center assignment.-After that, the re-assigned profit center is derived in the journal entry voucher.

Title: Error While Releasing a Withholding Tax Return for Country Italy: 'Electronic submission for return type Withholding Tax Return - Payment not supported'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a Withholding Tax Return for Country Italy and receive an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Withholding Tax Return view.-Show All Tax Returns.-Select the relevant Tax Return ID.-Click Release.-System raises the error message 'Electronic submission for return type Withholding Tax Return - Payment not supported'.-Cause-In previous Releases the Tax Return Type 13 - Withholding Tax Return - Payment was used for Payment purposes and at the same time to generate the relevant File.-Starting in Release 2102, the Tax Return Type 13 - Withholding Tax Return - Payment can no longer be used for both Payment and File.-Resolution-After Release 2102, a new Withholding Tax Return Type (23 - Withholding Tax Return File) has been created with the only purpose of creating the file.-System is working as designed.-See Also-What's New in Financial Management - Release 2102-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return, Tax Type, Payment File, Electronic, Submission.

Title: Bank Statement Posting - Account Determination is Missing for Cash
Content: Symptom-You are not able to post a Bank Statement due to error message:-'Account determination is missing for cash. Define the account for chart of accounts XYZ, tab Cash Receipt - In Transit' field 'Cash Receipt - In Transit' field 'Cash Receipt - In Transit. Enter a general ledger account for the account determination group ABC and currency Euro.'-(XYZ represents the Account Determination Profile and ABC represents the Account Determination Group for Cash)-The status of the bank statement is In Preparation.-Instead of the usual numeric Document ID AAA (AAA represents the Bank Statement), the Document ID is TMP-BBB (TMP-BBB represents a temporary Bank Statement).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Open the respective Bank Statement and press Action - Post.-You receive the error message:-'Account determination is missing for cash. Define the account for chart of accounts XYZ, tab Cash Receipt - In Transit' field 'Cash Receipt - In Transit' field 'Cash Receipt - In Transit. Enter a general ledger account for the account determination group ABC and currency Euro.'-Cause-The Bank Statement contains one or more items with a payment method for which there is a Cash account determination required.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Under Account Determination choose Cash.-Select the Account Determination Profile XYZ.-Go to the Cash Receipt - In Transit tab.-Press Add Row and enter following data:-Account Determination Group for Cash: ABC.-Payment Method: Leave the field empty.-Currency: Leave the field empty.-Cash Receipt - In Transit: ID of the  G/L account Cash in Transit.-Confirm with Save.-You are now able to post the bank statement.-The status of the bank statement will change to Posted and the document ID will change from TMP-BBB to a numeric document ID.-Keywords-tmp, bank statement, Cash, in transit-tmp,account determination is missing for cas

Title: Is it Possible to Delete the Root Level of the Product Category Hierarchy?
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Product Category Hierarchy, but you are not able to delete the root level since the Delete button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Product Categories view from the relevant work center:-Product Data, in SAP Business ByDesign.-Products, in SAP Cloud for Customer.-Select the root Product Category.-Click the Maintain Product Categories button.-Select the top (root) Product Category and click the Actions button.-Here, the Delete button is disabled.-Cause-Once you create and save the root level of the Product Category, it is not possible to delete it. The reason for not allowing deletion of the root level is that it would generate inconsistencies in the system.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Additional points to observe regarding root product category:-Once a root product category is created, it is not possible to delete it;-Once a root product category is saved, it is not possible to change its ID;-For root category, you are only allowed to change the description;-It is not possible to create more than one root product category hierarchy.-Note: sub-categories can be deleted as long as they are not used by any products in the system.-Keywords-Product Category, Hierarchy, Delete, Root level, Change ID

Title: You Can't Find the Expected Compare Operator when you add an Extension Field as Condition in Approval Process for Quote or Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you add an Extension Field as Condition in Approval Process for Quote or Sales Order, the Compare Operator is not as expected. In the drop down list of the Compare Operator field, you can only find "Contains" and "Does not contain".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center- Approval Processes View-Select Approval Process: Quote-Click Copy-Click Add Group in Conditions session-Select the Extension Field ABC (where ABC stands for the Extension Field you have created) -In the drop down list of the Compare Operator field, you can only find "Contains" and "Does not contain"-Check the Extension Field: Has Calculation check box is checked-Cause-When you add an Extension Field as Condition in Approval Process for Quote or Sales Order, you can only select the Compare Operator as "Contains" or "Does not contain" even though the Field Type of this Extension Field is Amount, Decimal Number or Quantity.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-Extension Field, Approval Process for Quote, Compare Operator; Amount; Decimal Number; Quantity; Greater Than; Equal to; Less than; Condition; Parameter

Title: Exchange Rate History Analysis in Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer is reporting the application of an incorrect exchange rate in a business transaction.-Example:-After posting a supplier invoice in transaction currency USD the customer complains about a delta in company currency EUR. The expected result is an application of an exchange rate in line with the Exchange Rate History for the posting date of the invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center and enter Edit Exchange Rates in the Common Tasks view.-Click the button View Exchange Rate History.-In case the exchange rate is in format EUR/USD filter for Source Currency USD and Target Currency EUR.-The column Valid From shows the start of the validity period for a certain exchange rate EUR/USD in the past.-Cause-The Exchange Rate History as shown in the General Ledger work center currently does not suffice to provide enough information on which historic exchange rate has been effectively applied to a business transaction at a certain point in time. In order to elicit which exchange rate has in fact been applied we can conduct an analysis via backend.-Resolution-Login to backend.-Execute the transaction SESFTS.-Open the BO CER_EXCHANGE_RATE.-Load by Query / ROOT - QUERY_BY_CURRENCY_PAIR.-In the Maximum Rows  field enter -1. -In case the echange rate is in format EUR/USD, query for the following pair:-ExchangeRateUnitCurrencyCode: USD-ExchangeRateQuotedCurrencyCode: EUR-In the results pane the column REGISTER_DATE_TIME shows the exact time when a certain exchange rate has been maintained. In combination with the creation time of a relevant journal entry you can now determine which exchange rate has been valid and applied by the system in the past and whether this represents the correct system behavior.

Title: Error Message When Removing UK from Country Scope
Content: Symptom-You are trying to remove United Kingdom from the Implementation Project, however it ends up in error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Edit the project scope.-Remove UK from the selected list.-Go to Finish step.- Error: 'Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data. If error messages are displayed, resolve them before you proceed.'-Cause-Depending on the scenario, one of the reasons for this error message to be raised is that Domestic Wire Transfer and International Wire Transfer payment methods are assigned to the bank accounts.-Resolution-You need to remove the Domestic and International Wire Transfer from the bank accounts, as follows:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to My Banks view.-Select one bank and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Select the bank account and refer to the Payment Method tab.-Remove both Domestic Wire Transfer and International Wire Transfer from the Payment Method tab for all bank accounts.-After that, you shall be able to remove UK from scope.-Keywords-Bank Account. My Bank. Payment Method. GB. UK.

Title: Error Message 'Action not Possible; Transfer Records Exist for Selected Work Agreement' When Changing the Hire Date of an Employee
Content: Symptom-You, as a personnel Administrator, try to change the Hire Date of an employee. System may throw the following error message:-Action not possible; transfer records exist for selected work agreement-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Search the respective employee and choose the Edit button.-Select the Employment tab.-Select the Change Hire Date button and change the date.-Select the Save button.-Cause-The employee might have been terminated earlier and you have re-hired him/her after that.-You try to change the current hire date to a date that falls in his/her previous employment time period.-There was a transfer event for the employee. To see the transfer details, you can check the change history of the employee.-These will result in the above error message.-Resolution-For causes 1 and 2, you are required to enter a hire date that should be later than the last termination date.-For cause 3, once the transfer is done for the employee, the system does not allow changes to the hire date.-Keywords-change; hire date; error; employee; employment;-csg_q

Title: Cannot Remove the Product Assignment Indicator From a Product Category
Content: Symptom-You are trying to remove the Product Assignment indicator from a product category, but system raises error message: "Cannot undo Product Assignment for XYZ; there are products assigned to it" (where XYZ is stands for an actual product category ID).-Environment-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Access the Product Categories work center view.-Click Maintain Product Categories.-Select the appropriate product category.-Uncheck the Product Assignment box.-In SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Products work center.-Access the Product Categories work center view.-Click Maintain Product Categories.-Select the appropriate product category.-Uncheck the Product Assignment box.-Cause-If the product category is already assigned to some products, then you cannot remove the Product Assignment indicator.-In some cases, even though the product category doesn't have any materials or services assigned to it currently, it might have been previously assigned to some material and services and if there are still active transactional documents involving these materials, the indicator cannot be removed as well.-Resolution-If you still require to remove the Product Assignment indicator from this specific product category, please ensure that all products have been unassigned from it and all transactional documents involving products assigned to it are either completed or canceled.-Keywords-untick product category, no products assigned to product category, product assignment, product category,

Title: There is no Submit Option Available in VAT Return for UK With Tax Return Type VAT Return Correction
Content: Symptom-After creating VAT Return for UK and Releasing it, there is no button to Submit this VAT Return for Tax Return Type VAT Return Correction.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Click relevant Tax Return ID.-Click View All.-There is no option to Submit the VAT after it is Reported.-Cause-The VAT Return Correction is not supported by MTD API exposed by HMRC and hence submit is not available on the correction Return.-The correction process of a submitted Return is a manual process not followed through MTD.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-Keywords-VAT Return, GB, VAT Return Correction, correction, submit, UK, United Kingdom-vat return,gb,vat return correction,correction,submit,uk,united kingdom

Title: Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create An Incident" During Migration of Inventory
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports error message "File validation failed. Create an incident" when trying to complete the Migration of Inventory.-In the backend, transaction ST22, runtime error TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED is logged.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Locate and open fine-tuning activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click the link "Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool."-Select the relevant migration unit.-Click Execute Migration.-In the next screen, select the row for the Inventory migration object.-Click Process File.-Error occurs.-Cause-One possible cause for this issue might be that the dataset which the customer is trying to migrate is too large to be uploaded as a single file and it's exceeding the process memory.-Resolution-Please suggest for the customer to break the file into multiple files with a smaller amount of records each.-Keywords-File validation failed, migration, inventory, TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED

Title: Amounts are Different in the Journal Entries of the Standard Warehouse Confirmation and it's Adjustment Warehouse Confirmation for Same Material and Same Absolute Quantity.
Content: Symptom- Amounts are different in the Journal Entries of the Standard Warehouse Confirmation and it's Adjustment Warehouse Confirmation for the same material and the same absolute quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to By Warehouse Order view.-Search and open warehouse order AAA.-Go to Tab Confirmations.-There are 2 Confirmations: Confirmation ID BBB is the Standard confirmation for material XXX with quantity 100ea. Confirmation ID CCC is the Adjustment confirmation for material XXX with quantity -100ea which is to reverse the Standard confirmation BBB.-Go to Tab Document Flow.-Open the Journal Entry 123 of the confirmation BBB and the Journal Entry 456 of the confirmation CCC.-You will see the amount of  Journal Entry 123 is DDD, the amount of Journal Entry 456 is -EEE.-Cause-When the business transaction type is Goods Receipt from Supplier in the Journal Entry, then the amount of the Warehouse Confirmation is picked from the preceding Purchase Order.-Purchase Order ZZZ(preceding document of the Warehouse Order AAA) was modified between the posting of Confirmation BBB and CCC, currently the amount of the material changed to EEE in the Purchase Order ZZZ, so in the Adjustment Confirmation, the amount is -EEE.-Resolution-So if you would like the amount in the Adjustment Confirmation to be the same as the Standard confirmation BBB:-Firstly, create a new Adjustment Confirmation to reverse Adjustment Confirmation CCC.-Then, change the amount for material XXX in the Purchase Order ZZZ from EEE to DDD.-Last, create a new Adjustment Confirmation to reverse the Standard confirmation BBB.-Keywords-Goods Receipt from Supplier. Warehouse confiramtion. Adjustment Confiramtion. Amount. Journal Entry. 自供应商收货. 仓库确认. 调整确认. 金额. 分录.

Title: Error Message: 'Exception occurred. Contact your system administrator' when trying to Save the Journal Entry Voucher for Sales Template.
Content: Symptom-You want to Save Data to SAP Business ByDesign via the Journal Entry Voucher for Sales Template but an error appears: 'Exception occurred. Contact your system administrator'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view and Journal Entry Vouchers subview.-Click New and select Journal Entry Voucher for Sales from Microsoft Excel.-Open the Excel Worksheet.-Complete with the relevant data.-Click Save data to SAP Business ByDesign button from Excel Add-in.-The Error appears: 'Exception occurred. Contact your system administrator'.-Cause-The file is containing special characters (tabs, spaces, whitespace, ', or others) not supported to be uploaded into the system.-Resolution-Download a fresh template taking care to avoid any special character that may affect the upload.-Keywords-Corrupt Template, Journal Entry, Sales Template, Excel, Special Characters

Title: VAT Tax Return Run Error: No configuration for tax VAT, event XYZ, and rate ABC
Content: Symptom-You execute the VAT Return Run for a specific Tax Authority for Country DEF.-In the application log of the run,  you get the error message: No configuration for tax VAT, event XYZ, and rate ABC. (XYZ represents the Tax event ID; ABC represents the Tax Rate, for example Standard, Reduced, Zero; DEF represents the Country version).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks View.-Go to the VAT Return Runs subview.-Select the Run ID.-Click on the Application Log ID.-Go to the Results tab.-The message 'No configuration for tax VAT, event Exempt Domestic Sales of Goods and Service, and rate ABC' is displayed.-Cause-In the Tax Returns for Goods and Services Fine Tune activity for Country DEF the Summary Layout settings are missing the combination of VAT Tax Return Type, Tax Event XYZ and Tax Rate ABC.-Or tax rate used in for business transactions such as expense reports is inconsistent from the rates maintained in Tax Returns for Goods and Services Fine Tune activity.-Resolution-Maintain the relevant Tax Event - Tax Rate combination:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Tax Returns for Goods and Services - DEF activity, either via Overview or from the Activity list of the Implementation Project. -In the activity, select Product Tax Return DEF.-Choose Tax Return Type 1 - VAT Return.-Go to the Tax Event sub-tab.-Choose Tax Event XYZ.-In the Summary Layout table press Add Row and maintain a row with Tax Rate Type ABC. -If you found the combo of tax event and tax rate is already maintained per the steps above, the error is then caused by the 2nd root cause.-You can check and amend it with following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Tax Returns for Goods and Services - DEF activity, either via Overview or from the Activity list of the Implementation Project. -In the activity, select Product Tax Return DEF.-Choose Tax Return Type 1 - VAT Return.-Go to the Tax Event sub-tab.-Choose Tax Event XYZ.-In the Summary Layout table, you have maintained Tax Percentage, e.g, 5%.-Then, check the tax rate of VAT and Tax Rate Type ABC with following steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access Tax on Goods and Services, either via Overview or from the Activity list of the Implementation Project. -Go to Define Tax Rate Schedules,-You will see the tax rate of VAT and Tax Rate Type ABC is not 5%.-You need to either update the two tax rate to be the same or keep the tax rate in Tax Returns for Goods and Services - DEF activity as empty.-After that, execute the VAT Return Run again. This time no error will be reported.-See Also- 1815589 - No Configuration for tax Value Added Tax, Event Domestic Supply Of Goods And Services, and Rate Zero-Keywords-No configuration for tax, event and rate, VAT Tax Return error

Title: Report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary Key Figures Total of Quantity Awaiting Invoice and Quantity Awaiting Invoice not as Expected
Content: Symptom-When checking the Report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary you noted that the Amounts of Total of Quantity Awaiting Invoice and Quantity Awaiting Invoice are not as expected.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Click Report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary.-Add Selection (Company, Set of Books, Key date and relevant Purchase Order).-When adding the Total Quantity Invoiced and Total Quantity Received you have a remainder, for example:-Total Quantity Invoiced: 2000-Total Quantity Received: -1900-The expected is a -100 in Quantity Awaiting Receipt, however it shows -110 in Quantity Awaiting Receipt and -10 at Quantity Awaiting Invoice.-Cause-This happens because the Key Figure is not calculated by each Total, the system adds the information from all Journal Entries for each Key Figure separately.-For example:-Journal Entry XXX - Total Quantity Invoiced 1000 - Total Quantity Received -890 - Quantity Awaiting Receipt -110-Journal Entry YYY - Total Quantity Invoiced 1000 - Total Quantity Received -1010 - Quantity Awaiting Invoice -10-Hence the Report will show for the Purchase Order as follows:-Total Quantity Invoiced: 2000-Total Quantity Received:-1900-Quantity Awaiting Receipt: -110-Quantity Awaiting Invoice: -10-XXX and YYY represent a Journal Entry ID.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-Keywords-GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary, Total Quantity Invoiced, Total Quantity Received, Quantity Awaiting Receipt, Quantity Awaiting Invoice-gr/ir inventories - balance summary,total quantity invoiced,total quantity received,quantity awaiting receipt,quantity awaiting invoice

Title: Error While Migrating Balances of Bank Accounts: 'PAF ShortDump: An exception of the type 'CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB'
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Balances of Bank Accounts and receive some error messages, such as-'Error detected in source record XXX, YYY, ZZZ'-'PAF ShortDump: An exception of the type 'CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB' occurred that was not caught anywhere along the call hierarchy. It was neither handled locally nor declared with a RAISING clause'.-XXX - Bank Account Number-YYY - National Bank Code-ZZZ - IBAN-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Press Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select the Migration Object Balances of Bank Accounts.-Click Process File.-The error messages appear as above (Symptom).-Cause-The system identified two or more entries in the Migration File with the same Bank Account Number, IBAN or Currency.-In SAP Business ByDesign it is not possible to create multiple Bank Accounts for a Company with the same Currency, the same IBAN or Bank Account.-Resolution-To proceed with the migration of Balances of Bank Accounts, adjust the file in a way that there are no duplicate records, for example, an IBAN can only be assigned to one Bank Account.-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Migration, Balances, Bank Accounts, IBAN, Currency, Bank Account Number

Title: How to create a virtual system in SAP Solution Manager 7.2
Content: Symptom-Generate Technical System-Unable to read system data in transport domain-You need to learn how to create a virtual system in SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Problems with the configuration of virtual system in ChaRM cycle-Resolution-For define virtual system in SAP Solution Manager 7.2, the detailed configuration steps can be found in wiki page How to create a virtual system in SAP Solution Manager 7.2-See Also-2424198 - How to analyze errors "No consolidation system" and "No export system" - Solution Manager-2811220 -  Can an all Virtual System landscape be used with SolMan ChaRM?-2694735 - Virtual system can't be added during cCTS configuration - Solution Manager 7.2-1999716 - How to analyze CharM Check error of project for NON-ABAP systems-Keywords-Virtual, LMDB, Technical, SID

Title: Error While Releasing Withholding Tax Return: 'Electronic submission for return type 'Withholding Tax Return - Payment not supported'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a Withholding Tax Return for Country Italy and receive the error message 'Electronic submission for return type Withholding Tax Return - Payment not supported'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Withholding Tax Returns view.-Show All Tax Returns.-Select the relevant Tax Return.-Click Release.-The error message 'Electronic submission for return type Withholding Tax Return - Payment not supported' appears.-Cause-Before SAP Business ByDesign release 2102, the tax return type 13 - Withholding Tax Return was used to generate a file and also execute the payment.-From SAP Business ByDesign release 2102, the tax return type 13 - Withholding Tax Return - Payment can only be used for payment purposes.-Resolution-A new withholding tax return type has been created to generate the file, the Type 23 - Withholding Tax Return - File, which is available with SAP Business Bydesign version 2102.-See Also-What's New in Financial Management - Release 2102, section 'Italy'.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return, File, Payment, Tax Return Type, Italy

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice. Error: "Mandatory field for type XYZ missing".
Content: Symptom-You cannot post a supplier invoice due to the error: Item X: Mandatory field for type XYZ missing. You are unable to change the Cost Distribution for the Items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoice Entry.-Mark the relevant Purchase Order and choose New Invoice.-Fill in all mandatory data and choose Check or Post.-You get the error: Mandatory field for type XYZ missing.-Go to the tab Items and sub-tab Cost Distribution.-You cannot edit the Account Assignment for the item.-XYZ is the Account Assignment Type. For example Cost Center, Project Task, General Ledger Account only, Individual Material, Sales Order, Service Order, Customer Contract, Profit Center, ...-A possible field you would need to enter is Employee ID, Cost Center ID, G/L Account, ...-Cause-In the Business Configuration, Fine-Tuning Activity Account Assignment Types, you made an Account Assignment field mandatory for the particular Account Assignment Type. At the time you created the Purchase Order, this field was optional and was left blank. Upon creating the Supplier Invoice, the Account Assignment information are copied from the purchase order and cannot be edited. The invoice is inconsistent due to the missing value for the field.-Resolution-In the Fine-Tuning activity Account Assignment Types, make the field optional temporarily, post the pending affected invoices and then revert the change.-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Select the activity Account Assignment Types.-Mark the relevant Account Assignment Type.-Under Account Assignment, select "2 - Optional" for the field under Data Input Control.-Post the pending affected invoices and revert the change in the Business Configuration.-Keywords-error with account assignment type not filled

Title: GST India TCS Scenario: How to Post the Documents with TCS Tax Codes for Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-As per the new legal change, tax collected at source (TCS) must be collected at the time of receiving the sale consideration: As part of this change, while posting the invoice,-the TCS tax lines will be posted to the deferred/interim general ledger (GL) account,-the movement of the TCS tax lines from the interim GL account to actual GL account will occur at the time of invoice payment.-Going forward, an error will occur at the time of the invoice posting if you have not maintained the deferred/interim tax GL account for the output tax against the tax type TCS in the chart of accounts.-Error message: 'Account determination is missing for item type Deferred Output Tax'-Affected tax codes: 593 to 603 (both included)-Country: India-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select invoice request XYZ (XYZ represents name of the Invoice Request).-Choose the Invoice button and Release the document as an invoice. -The following error message appears: 'Account determination is missing for item type Deferred Output Tax.'-Cause-You are using TCS related tax codes in the Customer Invoice and you have not maintained the deferred/interim tax GL account for the output tax against the tax type TCS in the chart of accounts.-Resolution-SAP has delivered the following tax codes for TCS:-593 - Domestic Sale Interstate - IGST + TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-594 - Domestic Sale Intrastate - CGST + SGST + TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-595 - Domestic Sale UT - CGST + UTGST + TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-596 - Kerala Sale Intrastate - CGST + SGST + KFC + Compensation Cess + TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-597 - Merchant Export - Interstate - IGST + TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-598 - Merchant Export - Intrastate - CGST + SGST + TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-599 - Export Sale - IGST + TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-600 - Deemed Export Sale EOU - IGST + TCS - Taxable (Calc. incl. GST)-601 - Export Sale - IGST + TCS - LUT/Bond (Calc. incl. GST)-602 - GST Export Sale - SEZ including TCS (Calc. incl. GST)-603 - Sales to SEZ - IGST + TCS - LUT/Bond (Calc. incl. GST)-These tax codes are available in all tax code relevant documents such as customer invoice, credit memo, debit memo and down payments.-To post a document using the new tax codes, follow the steps below:-Prerequisite:-You have to maintain the deferred/interim tax GL account for output tax against the tax type TCS in the chart of accounts. To maintain this, follow the below steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select your implementation project and click on Open Activity List.-Select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine tuning activity.-Select Tax under Accounting Determination.-Find the Account Determination Profile and navigate to the Output Tax tab.-Maintain the GL account in the Deferred output tax against tax type TCS.-Process flow:-Create a customer invoice using the TCS tax code.-    2.  Once the invoice is released check the journal entry posting for the invoice. The TCS tax lines should get posted to deferred GL account.-   3. Once the invoice payment is done for the customer invoice, check in the journal entry to view TCS tax amounts move from interim GL account to actual GL account.-See Also-2975267 - You Expect a TCS Relevant Tax Code to Be Determined Automatically in a Sales Document-2977201 - TCS Field Missing in the Customer Invoice Form Template-Keywords-GST India TCS, TCS Tax codes for Customer invoicing, Account determination, Deferred Tax

Title: Error Message Upon Posting Manual Acquisition After Fixed Asset Migration: 'Posting date <year end date> must be in fiscal year <next year> for fixed asset <ID>'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a manual Acquisition at year end to a migrated asset, that has also been migrated at year end, however an error message is being raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Select the migrated asset and click Manual Postings -> Acquisition.-Fill in the required parameters and give posting date at year end (E.g. 31.12.2020). Note that this asset has also been migrated at year end (e.g. 31.12.2020).-Click Simulate.-Given the above dates as example, the error message is raised as follows: 'Posting date 31.12.2020 must be in fiscal year 2021 for fixed asset <ID>'-Cause-The asset to which you are trying to post an acquisition is a legacy asset. Meaning it has either been migrated via Migration tool or via Fixed Asset -> New -> Legacy Asset. Since the asset has been migrated with posting date as 31.12.2020, this is considered a year-end migration (meaning a migration after closing financial statements), hence no further manual postings can take place in 2020.-Resolution-Either use the Migration tab within the asset to make postings via migration in 31.12.2020 (if no postings already occurred) or a new asset would need to be created with a migration date not as 31.12.2020, so that it's not categorized as year end migration. Then you would be able to post in 2020.-Apart from that, any manual posting can only happen as of 2021, given the current example.-You can check/change the migration posting date via General Ledger -> Companies  and change it via Action -> Set Posting Date for Migration.-Obs: only new assets are affected by the change.-Keywords-Fixed Asset. Migration. Manual Posting. Acquisition.

Title: Loading data from C4C tenant to SAP BW is not working as expected
Content: Symptom--BW Reporting on C4C Data is currently not up to date-Loading of data from C4C productive tenant to SAP BW is not working as expected-Infopackage of Datasource OPPORTUNITY_ITEM doesn’t receive data-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-SAP NW BW 7.3-SAP NW BW 7.4-SAP NW BW 7.5-Reproducing the Issue-Run Infopackage of required datasource (e.g. OPPORTUNITY_ITEM datasource CODOPPIB)-Cause-The issue is happening because the method of ODP Extraction in BW has been changed from Direct to Open-Fetch. Errors are seen when the necessary steps to support this in the source SAP Cloud for Customer system may not have been completed.-Resolution-Review SAP Note 2346390 - BW DataSource on ByD MDAV ODP: use ODQ in ByD System-This Note contains corrective coding for using RSADMIN parameter RSDS_ODP_BYD_MODE.-The code may already be in your system so only the parameter will need updating-  Setup the parameter in table RSADMIN:-a) In transaction SE38, execute SAP_RSADMIN_MAINTAIN report -b) Search for parameter RSDS_ODP_BYD_MODE-c) Change the value to 'OPEN_FETCH'-  Reinitialize the delta InfoPackage-  Review SAP Note: 2256659 - ODQ: Real-time daemon not started (authorization missing)-Ensure the extraction user has the necessary authorization as explained-Keywords-C4C MDAV, CODOPPIB, SODQADM, ByDesign, ByD, data source,

Title: How to Cancel a Change Project without implement it
Content: Symptom-First verify if the project is only available in the Test system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You want to cancel a Change Project without implement it, but don't know how to proceed.-Resolution-In case the change project is only available in the test system, please logon on test system to perform the steps.-Logon into your ByD system.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click on the title hyperlink.-The project overview screen will load and the Cancel Option will be available.-Click on the Cancel Project option and the project will be canceled.-Once the project is canceled before the merge, no change will happen on the productive system.-Keywords-stop remove

Title: L060 - Fixed Asset Depreciation Starts After the Maintained Depreciation Start Date
Content: Symptom-A Fixed Asset has been capitalized via an acquisition transfer posting in period BBB.YYYY with Depreciation Method L060- Straight Line Method.-You maintained the Depreciation Start Date of the Fixed Asset in a period before the acquisition transfer posting, in period AAA.YYYY.-You therefore expect that the deprecation calculation will start from the depreciation start date in period AAA.YYYY.-Instead, the depreciation calculation only starts on the day of the acquisition transfer posting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Fixed Asset workcenter navigate to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the Fixed Asset, press Edit and select Values.-In the Values tab, under Valuation Values per Set of Books you can see that the Depreciation Start Date is maintained in period AAA.YYYY.-Now navigate to the Depreciation Overview sub-tab.-Here you notice that the Depreciation only starts in period BBB.YYYY, after the acquisition transfer posting.-Cause-Each depreciation method is assigned to a Period Control Method. For each Period Control Method a Period Control Key is assigned to each asset transaction. This period control key determines the (calculation) period from which a transaction, such as an acquisition or retirement, is included in the calculation of automatic depreciation.-The depreciation method L060-Straight Line Method is assigned to period control method 002.-For each transaction of period control method 002 the period control method key 01-Pro rata at period start date applies.-This means, that with this key the depreciation start or end date is always on the first day of the period in which the transaction, such as an acquisition or retirement, takes place.-Depreciation method L060 uses per day depreciation calculation  (Go to Fine Tuning > Depreciation Methods > Edit Depreciation Methods).-The following logic applies:-If a Fixed Asset is being acquired via an acquisition transfer posting the depreciation starts in the period of the acquisition posting with the calculation starting on the day of the acquisition transfer posting. Starting the depreciation calculation before the transfer date might cause double calculating the depreciation (in case there already exist depreciation posting for the transferred Fixed Asset).-Special Case: -If a Fixed Asset has been acquired via an acquisition transfer posting on the last day of the fiscal year then the depreciation calculation starts with the first day of the new fiscal year. It is then being assumed that the transfer has been deliberately posted  on the last day of the fiscal year to not interfere with previous depreciation values.-If a Fixed Asset is not acquired through a transfer posting (for example, a goods receipt or supplier invoice to generate a new Fixed Asset) then the maintained depreciation start date overrules the acquisition date for the depreciation calculation: Even though the actual depreciation would still start in the period of the acquisition (as per period control key 01) the amount to be depreciated is being calculated based on the maintained Depreciation Start Date.-Resolution-In order to consider the maintained depreciation start date for the depreciation calculation for a transferred fixed asset you need to assign a depreciation method to the Fixed Asset which is assigned to a period control method that uses period control keys which consider the first day of the Fiscal Year as the date relevant for depreciation calculation (for example, period control key 06- At the start of the year).-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Help Resources:-Period Control Methods and Keys, providing information on the period control keys assigned to the asset transaction depending on the respective period control method.-Using Depreciation Methods, explaining the logic of Depreciation methods and providing information on pre-delivered Depreciation methods per country.*-*In SAP ByDesign it is currently only possible to identify the period control methods assigned to the pre-delivered depreciation methods provided for the US, see SAP ByDesign Help document Depreciation Methods - US.-Keywords-L060; depreciation method; Straight Line Method-l060,depreciation method,straight line method

Title: Payment is Not Showing in Payment Proposal
Content: Symptom-A Payment that is showing on the Application Log of a Payment Run is not showing in the Payment Proposal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Payment Runs view.-Select relevant Run ID.-Click View Payment Proposal.-Payment XXX is not showing in this list.-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Payment Runs view.-Select relevant Run ID.-Click relevant Application Log.-Go to the Results tab.-Select relevant line for Supplier ID.-Payee ABC: payment strategy DEF-Payment with ID XXX created in GHI-ABC - Supplier ID-DEF - Payment Strategy description-XXX - Payment Proposal ID-GHI - Payment Proposal Currency-Cause-This occurs because the Payment Proposal was Voided by a user, and it can be checked with below steps:-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Show All Payment Proposals.-Find XXX.-Click Payment ID XXX for Payee ABC.-Click View All.-Go to the Changes tab.-Click Go.-There is a change that changes Payment Proposal Status from In Preparation to Void.-Voided Payment Proposals will not show under Payment Monitor view.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-Keywords-Payment Run, Payment, Payment Proposal, Void, missing payment-payment run,payment,payment proposal,void,missing payment

Title: Error Message "DD.MM.YYYY1 to DD.MM.YYYY2; Company Name of Main Address Incomplete for Org Unit ()"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to to check or activate an org unit/org structure, but system throws error message "DD.MM.YYYY1 to DD.MM.YYYY2; company name of main address incomplete for org unit ()" — where DD.MM.YYYY1 stands for an actual date in day-month-year format and DD.MM.YYYY2 stands for date posterior to DD.MM.YYYY1.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Select the relevant org unit.-Click either Check > Check Selected Structure or Activate > Activate Selected Structure.-Error occurs.-Cause-The cause for this error message is that Company Name is missing in the addresses of some of the org units for the time period specified in the error message.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, follow the below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective From date as DD.MM.YYYY1 (i.e. the earliest date mentioned in the error message).-Select the relevant org unit.-Go to the Addresses tab.-Maintain data for the Company Name field under Main Address.-Repeat the steps 4 to 6 for other affected Org units (if any).-Keywords-Company Name, Main Address, Incomplete, Org Unit

Title: Incorrect Bill-To Party in the Intercompany Supplier Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-System defaults an incorrect Bill-To party in the intercompany supplier invoice document.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Select Edit & navigate to the General tab.-In the Bill-To section, system defaults wrong party.-Cause-In case of intercompany scenario, the Supplier Invoice gets automatically created based on Customer Invoice document (B2B). In this case, customer invoice document itself contains the wrong Bill-To party ID & hence defaulted the same to Supplier Invoice document.-Resolution-You have to change the Bill-To in customer invoice document so that correct Bill-To will be defaulted in the supplier invoice document via B2B.

Title: Incorrect Time Profile Start Date of Employees
Content: Symptom-Today you have hired an employee with a past date hire (e.g. 13.05.2009) and the system defaulted his Time Profile Start Date to the beginning of 3rd month before today's date.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the respective employee and click Edit-Move to Time Profile tab-Under Time Profile section you can see that the date is maintained three months before hiring month.-Cause-Time Profile date is defaulted to the beginning of the 3rd month before the system date on which hiring is performed.-For example:-Hiring performed on 15.07.2015.-Hiring date is 13.05.2009.-Time Profile Start Date is defaulted to 01.05.2015 (beginning of the 3rd month before the system date on which hiring is performed).-The assumption here is that for such past dated hires, employees shall not be recording time more than 3 months in past.-Resolution-You can now chnage the Time Profile Date manually in UI.-You can change the Start Date to the desired date and save it.-You can also use Migration Tool to update Time Profile Start Date while the process of hiring and creating Time File data.-Exception: No Manual Adjustment possible in Time Account while modifying the Time Profile.-See Also-3036471 - You can`t to Migrate Time and Labor Management Data when doing Changes for Time Profile and Manual Adjustment

Title: Customer Invoice Request can be Created for In Approval Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You want to know why system allows Customer Invoice Request to be created for In Approval Sales Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center, Invoice Requests View-You can see Project Invoice Request ABC (where ABC stands for Project Invoice Request) is available for invoicing-However, the respective Sales Order XYZ (where XYZ stands for Sales Order) is In Approval.-Cause-In the Project Based Sales Order, the Delivery Status and Invoice Status are finished in project side.-So the approval of Sales Order can't control the status of Sales Order.-From Project perspective, the system won't check the approval status of the Sales Order when creating a new Project Invoice Request, but only check the respective project status.-You can generate Project invoice Request via Customer Invoicing Work Center-Project Invoicing View-Projects.-Resolution-This is the current system design-See Also- KBA 2873908 - CRM Scenario: Service - Fixed Price (Project) in Sales Order-Keywords-Sales Order, In Approval, Customer Invoice Request, Project, Project Invoice Request

Title: No Payment Created Though Payment Block has Expired - Customer Blocked for Payments
Content: Symptom-After executing the payment run for receivables you get the message XXX blocked for payments.-A payment block has been maintained for the particular customer, but the expiry date of the payment block is earlier than the execution date of the payment run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Receivables Work Center-Navigate to Payment Runs-Create a New - Payment Run-Go to Schedule Job  and start/schedule the job accordingly-Alternatively select an already existing Run ID and proceed as described above-After the execution of the run open the Application Log-Go to the tab Results-Choose the button Expand All-For Payer XXX you get the message: XXX blocked for payments-Open Receivables Work Center-Go to Customers - Customer Accounts and select the Customer Account XYZ-Click on View - View All-Navigate to the Financial Data - Payment Data tab-You see that a Payment Block has been maintained with a Payment Block Expire Date earlier than the execution date of the Payment Run-Cause-To avoid that payments are unintentionally created and posted, because a user forgot to extend the expiry date of the payment block, the payment block will even be considered when the expiry date is earlier than the execution date of the run.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-To have payments for customer XYZ considered for payments the row with the payment block has to be deleted from the customer's account:-Open Receivables Work Center.-Go to Customers - Customer Account and select the Customer Account XYZ.-Click on View - View All.-Navigate to the tab Financial Data - Payment Data.-Select the row containing the Payment Block and remove the Payment Block Reason. -You will see that the Expiry Date also disappears.-Click on Remove button to delete the row.-Confirm with Save.-If there are already postings for this customer and company, you cannot delete the row. In this case, you will delete only the Payment Block Reason (Expiry Date disappears automatically) and will save the changes.-Keywords-customer blocked for payments,expiry date of the payment block,execution date of the payment run

Title: How To Include The Extension Fields For Any Webservice In Inbound Direction
Content: Symptom-You want to add the extension field used in an inbound webservice to the corresponding business document.-Reproducing the Issue-Once you consume the webservice using an extension field, you want this extension field to be updated in the created business document.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to achieve this :-Go to the work center, where you have to create business document. For example Account Management in case you want to create accounts.-Open Account screen in Adaptation Mode.-Use menu Adapt->Edit Mode.-Select the extension field.-Open the link Further Usage for the selected field-Go to tab Services.-Select the webservice with direction Inbound-Press the Add button to add the field to the request structure.-This will also enhance the corresponding query

Title: Error When Migrating Inventory: 'An Exception was raised'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Inventory and receive an error in Step D - Verify Posting Preview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select Migration Object Inventory.-Click Process File.-In Step D - Verify Posting Preview, expand the affected G/L Account entry.-You find many Products with the message 'An exception was raised'.-Cause-The Inventory is based on the Material Valuation Data, for example the Accounting Determination and the Inventory Cost Valid On information on the Migration Posting Date.-There are Materials with Valid From Date as 01.02.2020 (for example) while the Posting Date for the Migration is 27.01.2020 (example).-Hence the system is not able to determine relevant Accounting information for some Materials on the Migration Posting Date.-Resolution-To successfully execute the Migration it is necessary to adjust the Inventory Cost Valid From Date of the affected Materials or change the Posting Date of the Migration.-See Also-SAP Knowledge Base Article 2082409 - Exception After Migrating Inventory - Cross Check Balances Preview for Migration-Keywords-Migration, Inventory, Product, Material, Valid From, Posting Date, Inventory Cost.

Title: Error 'No reported tax return to be corrected was found' When Executing a Correction VAT Return Run for GB
Content: Symptom-There is an error on VAT Return Run of Correction Run:-'No reported tax return to be corrected was found'.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Select relevant Run ID.-Click Application Log ID.-Go to the Results tab.-Error: 'No reported tax return to be corrected was found'.-Cause-A possible cause for country/region United Kingdom VAT Return Run is not unchecking the checkbox of Correction Run before changing the Tax Return Arrangement ID to the type of Tax Return Type 6 - VAT Return Correction.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Select the VAT Return to be corrected.-Go to Actions and then Schedule Correction Run.-Uncheck the checkbox Correction Run.-Change the Tax Return Arrangement ID to the one for Tax Return Type 6 - VAT Return Correction.-Once this is done the run will execute correctly.-Keywords-Tax Return, VAT Return, No reported tax return to be corrected was found, Correction Run

Title: Depreciation Run Reversing Depreciation Amounts Posted via Migration
Content: Symptom-You have migrated a fixed asset with depreciation in current year and depreciation method 0000 - No Automatic Depreciation. However, after executing a depreciation run, the run is reversing the migrated depreciation amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Depreciation run view.-Open the relevant depreciation run.-Go to Processed Successfully tab.-You see that the run has reversed the depreciation from the migrated asset, with depreciation method 0000. Since there were no previous automatic postings, you are not expecting the posted depreciation to be reversed.-Cause-Even though the depreciation method upon migration is 0000 - No Automatic Depreciation, the depreciation amount has been migrated with movement category e.g. "06 Periodic Depreciation, Revaluation and Interests"  and line item type "01205 Periodically Posted Regular Depreciation", which the system understands as automatic depreciation. Hence, with depreciation method 0000 being used, the run reverses the automatic depreciation.-Resolution-This would be the expected behavior. If the amount is related to manual depreciation, a more suitable movement category (e.g. 46 - Manual Depreciation) should have been used instead.-You can reverse the journal entries for this asset and then re-migrate with the proper values and movement categories. Alternatively, you can post the depreciation reversal via depreciation run and then try creating the manual postings to adjust the amounts accordingly.-You shall discuss this further from your end, with the relevant stakeholders, to explore additional workarounds, agree on the best approach and test the scenario thoroughly again before migrating content into production.-Keywords-Fixed asset. Depreciation. Migration Tool. Movement Category. Fixed Asset Extended. Migration Tool.

Title: Issue With Bank Statement ID Sequence
Content: Symptom-Case 1:-When a Bank Statement is created with ID XXX+1 there is a warning:-'Bank Statement ID XXX does not exist or has not been posted yet'.-Case 2:-When a Bank Statement is uploaded with Opening Balance different from Closing Balance from previous bank statement system does not give an error message.-XXX and XXX-1 - Reference to the Bank Statement ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Case 1:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Click New - Bank Statement.-Enter Company ID.-Enter Bank Account ID.-Warning: 'Bank Statement ID XXX does not exist or has not been posted yet'.-Case 2:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Show All Bank Statements.-Search for relevant Company and Bank Account ID.-The Bank Statement ID XXX+1 has Opening Balance different from Closing Balance of XXX.-Cause-This occurs because the system considers the numbering ID separated for each Fiscal Year.-And the system will not give an error when the Closing Balance from Fiscal Year 2019 (for example) is different from the Opening Balance from Fiscal Year 2020 (for example).-Resolution-System behavior is correct.-Keywords-Bank Statement, does not exist or has not been posted yet, opening balance, closing balance, Fiscal Year-bank statement,does not exist or has not been posted ye,opening balance,closing balance,fiscal year

Title: Error Message Upon Fixed Asset Migration: Calculation reference date is not in fiscal year
Content: Symptom-You are migrating fixed assets via extended template, however an error is raised when simulating the import in the migration tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and navigate to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the concerned migration unit and click Execute Migration.-Select the migration object for fixed assets and click Process File.-On the simulate import phase, you get the following error: Calculation reference date <DD-MM-YYYY> is not in fiscal year <YYYY>.-Cause-You are migrating fixed assets in the current year, however the Posting Date and Valuation Date in the Asset Posting Lines are not in accordance to compile a valid source xml file.-Resolution-In this current example, if you are migrating during a fiscal year you have to consider the Transaction Type and Line Item Type to fill out the valuation and posting dates.-For example, in situations such as:-Historical Cumulated Acquisitions: For transactions of type Migration of Accumulated Values (Current Year) and line item Historical Costs, the Posting Date and Valuation Date should be the first day of the current fiscal year.-Sum of depreciations during current fiscal year: For transactions of type Periodic Depreciation and line item Periodic Regular Depreciation, the Posting Date and Valuation Date should be the migration date.-Therefore, please, review and adjust the Valuation Date and Posting Date in your xml file and simulate the import again. You may find further examples in the Documentation sheet of your migration file.-Keywords-Fixed asset migration, posting date, cumulated acquisitions, current fiscal year.

Title: Financial Reporting Structure Shows Wrong/Unassigned Amounts to Functional Areas
Content: Symptom-You have created your reporting structure for Income Statement and assigned Functional Area to your G/L Accounts. However, when running the Financial Statement with your reporting structure, the system either displays unexpected amounts to some Functional Areas or shows some G/L Accounts as Not Assigned Balance Sheet And In (s).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open Financial Statements.-Select relevant company, set of books, fiscal year, periods and your income statement reporting structure.-Run the report.- You'll either see unexpected amounts to some functional areas and/or G/L Accounts as Not Assigned Balance Sheet And In (s).-Cause-The reporting structure is based on Functional Areas that are assigned to this structure. The report then clubs together the amounts based on the corresponding Functional Area assigned to each G/L Account Posting in the Journal Entries of the corresponding selection period.-The Functional Area determination in the Journal Entries happens based on the setup made in fine-tune activity "Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis" -> "Functional Area Determination". Hence, at the time of the journal entry posting the Functional Area is determined accordingly.-In this case, the G/L Account has been assigned to different functional areas and postings occurred in the meantime. Hence, for different journal entries the same G/L Account has different functional area assignment. Therefore, there are different G/L postings for this G/L Account with different Functional Area assignments in the selected period.-Depending on each posting it then gets assigned to a different Functional Area in the Financial Statement report. If the corresponding Functional Area is not assigned to the report, the amount in that G/L Account assigned to this specific functional area shows as Not Assigned Balance Sheet And In (s).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. In the Financial Statement report, you can change the View option (dropdown at the reports top bar) from "Financial Statement" to "G/L Accounts - Interactive List". This view option shows the concerning amounts per G/L Accounts for the selected period as well as to which Functional Area the G/L Account/Amounts were assigned upon posting. You can also further drill-down to other reports, using the navigation targets, to analyze the corresponding journal entries.-The Functional Area determination change log can be analyzed via Business Configuration work center, Reports View via report "Configuration Change History" for the Fine-Tuning Settings.-For the Functional Areas that are not assigned to the reporting structure yet, you can use the activity "Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination" to make the assignment.-Keywords-Income Statement. Reporting Structure.

Title: Is it Possible to Change Work Agreement of an Employee after Hiring?
Content: Symptom-You may have a requirement to change the work agreement of an employee after hiring, such as change it to Retiree, from Temporary to Permanent and so on. But system does not allow the change of employee's work agreement after the personnel file is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personal Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select an Employee XYZ.-Select button Edit and choose tab Employment.-Where it is not possible to change/edit Work Agreement.-Cause-The system does not allow to change/edit an employee's Work Agreement after hiring.-Resolution-The intended change can be done only via a combination of regular tasks Terminate Relationship with Employee and Rehire Employee.-Upon rehire, a new Work Agreement can be chosen. In this way an active employee can be turned into a Retiree or changing from Temporary to Permanent and so on.-Keywords-extend, unlimited,

Title: How To Delete or Rename a Product Category in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom- You have created a product category hierarchy and would like to know how to rename or delete product categories.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Renaming a Product Category:-It is possible to rename a product category and its sub-categories after they have been saved. The steps are as follows:-Go to the Product Data or the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Access the Product Categories work center view.-Click the Maintain Product Categories button.-Select the relevant product category.-Update the product category's description (field name: Product Category).-Click the Save and Close button.-Deleting a Product Category:-Please note that only node level product categories (or sub-categories) can be deleted. The root level product category cannot be deleted once saved.-Go to the Product Data or the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Access the Product Categories work center view.-Click the Maintain Product Categories button.-Select the relevant product category.-Click the Actions button and choose Delete.-Please note:-The sub-categories can be deleted only when the Product Assignment Indicator is unchecked.-If the indicator was checked in the past and there are some existing products assigned to the product category, then this indicator cannot be unchecked. The user has to go to each of these products and change the product category assignment.-If there are existing open documents (Sales Order, etc.) that already reference this product category, then the system will throw an error message.-See Also-1702679 - Is it Possible to Delete the Root Level of the Product Category Hierarchy?-Keywords-product, product category, delete, rename

Title: "Create not pos.; preceding doc. missing for tax determination"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The following message fails:-Sender Party: ReturnToSupplier-Receiver Interface Name: SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoiceVerificationIn-Error (English): "Create not pos.; preceding doc. missing for tax determination"-Error (German): "Anlegen nicht möglich; Vorgängerbeleg fehlt für Steuerfindung"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is a rare scenario. The return to supplier (RTS) was created out of a third-party customer return. Previously, a Purchase Order item was created with price zero and was not relevant for invoicing. Now when the RTS is finished, the follow-up decision 'Credit Memo' is selected for the item. This info is sent to Invoicing but it fails, because the item was unknown to invoicing before.-Resolution-This is of rare occurrence and the message can be processed via debugger. If it occurs more and more, we can do a code change.-Keywords-"Create not pos.; preceding doc. missing for tax determination"-missing for tax determination,create not pos,preceding doc

Title: Fixed Asset Created With no Cost Center nor Profit Center. Error Message: Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from
Content: Symptom-You are editing a fixed asset and noticed that the corresponding interval assignment has no cost center no profit center derived. Upon saving or trying to make any changes in this asset, errors are being raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Open the related fixed asset.-Go to Master Data -> Basic Data tab.- You see that the interval assignment is created but Cost Center, Profit Center and Segment are missing.-The following errors are being raised:-Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from <date>-Segment missing; segment reporting active from <date>-Cause-The interval assignment in the asset's master data is, in this scenario, derived from the supplier invoice document. In this case, the supplier invoice got posted with no cost center nor profit center references. Hence, the same were derived as blank for this asset's interval assignment.-The system allowed the posting without cost center and profit center reference because, at the journal entry creation date/time, the reporting principle assigned to the company's set of books was "Function of Expenses". By the definition of this reporting principle, no profit center is required for posting. This reporting principle has been later changed to another one, which would require the profit center upon posting, for example "Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg". Therefore, since this newly assigned reporting principle requires a profit center for postings, the errors are raised in the fixed asset's master, since no profit center was assigned.-Resolution-If you wish to keep using the reporting principle as "Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg" or any other that requires a profit center assignment, this asset and it's posting have to be re-created in light of the requirements of this reporting principle.-Note that if you try to reverse and repost in the invoice's journal entry or to cancel the invoice before reverting the change in the reporting principle, the same errors would be raised in the business transaction UI (reverse and repost) or, in case of cancelation, as process communication errors in backend.-To overcome this error, you'll need to change the reporting principle back to Function of Expense, reverse the postings, retire the asset and re-create the invoice in the proper reporting structure with cost center assignment (or at least a default profit center in business configuration).
