You may find the detailed steps below:-A) First you need to change the reporting principle back to "Function of Expense":-Go to Auditing work center and click View Set of Books.-Highlight the set of books assigned related to the company.-Under General tab, change the Reporting Principle to Function of expense.-Save.-B) Now, cancel the supplier invoice that capitalized the asset, as follows:-Go to Fixed Assets -> Fixed Assets.-Find and open concerned asset.-Go to Values tab and click Journal tab.-You see that the acquisition is done via a given invoice and journal entry.-Open this invoice.-Close the fixed asset to avoid any locking error.-In the invoice, click Cancel Invoice.-Post the cancellation invoice and make sure that a journal entry is created for this cancellation.-C) With the cancellation posted, you can deactivate the asset and set it as retired.-Go to Fixed Assets -> Fixed Assets.-Find and open concerned asset.- You see that acquisition and net book values are zero.-Go to Master Data tab -> Life Cycle Data subtab.-Set a Deactivation Date-Save your changes.- The asset shall change to Retired.-D) Change the reporting principle back to Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg (or other desired reporting principle).-Go to Auditing work center and click View Set of Books.-Highlight the set of books assigned related to the company.-Under General tab, change the Reporting Principle to Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg (or other desired reporting principle).-Save.-E) Create the invoice again.-The invoice can be created via Supplier Invoicing work center using the Copy function as copy of previous invoice.-When re-creating the invoice, please make sure to define the cost center along with a new individual material in the Cost Assignment tab.-The system shall post the journal entry with a cost center and derive the profit center from it. The same cost center and profit center are derived for the interval assignment in the new fixed asset.-Keywords-Profit Center. Segment. Interval Assignment. Acquisition. Fixed Asset. Indovodual Material. Default Profit Center. Cost Center.

Title: Profit Overview by Key Figure Report Missing Key Figures Values
Content: Symptom-You run the report Profit Overview by Key Figure and it shows values in all columns. But then you add key figure "Actual Entry Quantity" to report results. When you apply this change, it does empty all the other Key Figures of a report Profit Overview by Key Figure. You expect this Key Figure displays results without removing all results from other Key Figures.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to List view.-Select report Profit Overview by Key Figure.-You run the report with the relevant selection for your company.-Add Key figure Actual Entry Quantity.-You Apply the changes.-All the other Key Figures for financials go blank.-Cause-The Contribution Margin Scheme for all set of books is blank on the Set of Books view, under General Ledger work center. Generally this is set to P&L reporting structure. This is the reason why the report cannot resolve the request correctly. If the Contribution Margin Scheme is set, then it should fix the issue in the report.-As the information on Set of Books/Company Settings - Contribution Margin Scheme is not mandatory, this is probably the reason why it is not maintained, but to correct this behavior, you will have to maintain this attribute.-Resolution-To add the Contribution Margin Scheme to the Set of Books:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find the Set of Books activity.-Under the activity, select the Set of Books XYZ (where XYZ represents the Set of Books ID).-Select the Company ABC (where ABC represents the Company ID).-Click the Edit button.-Open the Company Settings tab.-Show the drop down menu for Margin Contribution Scheme.-Select the Margin Contribution Scheme value.-Select Save.-Run the report again.-See Also- 2682126 - Margin Contribution Scheme is Not Assigned in Data Source FINPRFU20 Profitability : Earned Profit Preview-Keywords-Profit Overview by Key Figure. FINPRFU30. Key Figure. Report. Cost and Revenue. Set of Books.

Title: How to Execute Change in Bank Charges Paid By for Employees for Roland Berger
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** / ***Customer Specific KBA*** - In case of any concerns, reach out to FIN support.-The customer Roland Berger Holding GmbH raised an incident asking to update new Employees Bank Charge codes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign. Only Applicable for customer Roland Berger Holding GmbH-Cause-The customer replicates Employees to the system and as per system logic the Bank Charge is set to BEN, while they need this empty to be able to use Sharing of Costs option.-Resolution-We can run program in the backend to correct this for the customer, however we need to confirm the changes first.-Step 1 - idetify the list of items to be corrected.-Log in the backend and open transaction SE16.-Give Table name as 'FOP_D_PAYAGR'.-Press Enter.-Input 'BEN' in 'BANKCHARGEBEARER' field and press Execute.-Save the file locally to XLS format. (This will be backup in case of any errors) by clicking on the button with the green arrow to the right 'Local File'.- Step 2 - Identify the IDs of the Employees to be corrected.-Highlight the column BUPA_GUID.-Copy the values and paste into Excel.-Open a new transaction window and go to SESFTS. -Go to Business Object: Business_Partner.-Load by Node ID -> ROOT-Copy the list from Excel (that you just pasted in). -Paste into the field that appears.-Execute.-Highlight all items and select Navigate -> Employee.-Highlight all items again and select Nagivate -> IDENTIFICATION.-Select column Business_Partner_ID - this is the ID of the employees that can be seen in the front end.-Send this list to the customer. Ask the customer to confirm that they are happy for this list of employees to be updated. -Step 3 - once you have received permission from customer that they are happy with the list that you provided.-Log in the backend and open transaction SE16.-Give Table name as 'FOP_D_PAYAGR'.-Press Enter.-Input 'BEN' in 'BANKCHARGEBEARER' field and press Execute.-Confirm that the numbers are the same as you previous reported, if they are the same please continue with below. If the numbers are not the same - please repeat the steps above.-Go to transaction SE38.-Input program name 'ZBANK_CHG_BEARER_UPD'.-Click Execute.-If this is successful it will show the count of records that where changed.-In case of some errors, kindly forward the saved file you backed up to Development component SRD-FIN-MOP.-Keywords- Bank Charges Paid By, Employee, Beneficiary, Roland Berger-roland berger,beneficiary,employee,bank charges paid by

Title: Error During Migration of E-mail Activities: CorrespondenceTransmissionStatusCode does not fit to InitiatorCode.
Content: Symptom-During the migration of e-mail activities the following error occurs: CorrespondenceTransmissionStatusCode does not fit to InitiatorCode.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select you respective project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Search for Migration of E-mail Activities and open it.-Click on the Migrate e-mail activities using the migration tool hyperlink.-Select your template and click on the Execute Migration ->  Execute Migration Step by Step button.-In step 1 during the validation of your file no errors are detected.-Go to step 2 and click on theEdit Value Conversion for Transmission Status hyperlink.-You are mapping the free text you entered in the Transmission Status field with the Transmission Status of the system using the value help.-After the Simulation you receive the following error message in the Simulation step: CorrespondenceTransmissionStatusCode does not fit to InitiatorCode-Cause-The error message occurs because the converted value does not map the free text of the field Transmission Status in the template to the description of the internal value but actually compares the free text entered in the field Transmission Status with the Target Description of the internal code to  define if the e-mail direction is inbound or outbound. Therefore the entered text in the field Transmission Status of the migration template has to be exactly the same as the value of the Target Description in the input help for our internal code.-Resolution-To solve this issue you can either upload a new migration template with the correct value in the Transmission Status field or Edit your existing template as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select you respective project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Search for Migration of E-mail Activities and open it.-Click on the Migrate e-mail activities using the migration tool hyperlink.-Select your template and click on the Action -> Edit button,-In the Transmission Status field enter one of the following values:-SENT-NOT TRANSMITTED-RECEIVED-Click on the Save and Close button.-Select your template and click on the Execute Migration ->  Execute Migration Step by Step button.-Go to step 2 and click on theEdit Value Conversion for Transmission Status hyperlink.-Ensure that the values you entered in the Transmission Status field are mapped with the Transmission Status of the system using the value help.-Continue with the migration.-The error will not occur anymore.,-Please note that the values of the Transmission Status field have to be SENT, NOT TRANSMITTED or RECEIVED in English language and cannot be translated to any other language.-See Also-In relation to SAP Cloud for Customer, see also KBA: 3036210 - How to Migrate E-Mails With Status Completed Using Data Workbench-Keywords-email emails

Title: Error Message Conversion method not available for company ABC and set of books DEF
Content: Symptom-When executing Foreign Currency Remeasurement For Cash an error message occurs:-'Conversion method not available for company ABC and set of books DEF'-ABC - Company ID-DEF - Set of Books-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Show All Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs.-Click relevant Run ID.-Go to the Messages tab.-Error: Conversion method not available for company ABC and set of books DEF-Cause-This is caused due to missing Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods on relevant Account Principle.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Select Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash activity.-Click Open.-Click Assign remeasurement method to accounting principle.-Select relevant Account Principle.-Click Add Row.-Maintain the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods.-After this is done re-execute the run.-See Also-Help Document: Configuration: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Payables and Receivables-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement, Method, Conversion method not available-foreign currency remeasurement,conversion method not available,method

Title: Point of Sales Transaction Account Determination Posting Error
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Point-of-Sale transaction, however an error message 'Account determination is missing for item type Sales Revenue. Specify account determination in chart of accounts <ABC> and account determination profile <DEF>. Column Path Sales->Revenues (Materials)->Sales Revenue, Item Type Sales Revenue' is raised.-(ABC represents the Chart of Accounts code, DEF represents the Account Determination profile).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Source Document.-Search and find Point-of-Sale document ID GHI (GHI represents the Point-of-Sale transaction ID).-Here we can see the error: 'Account determination is missing for item type Sales Revenue. Specify account determination in chart of accounts <ABC> and account determination profile <DEF>. Column Path Sales->Revenues (Materials)->Sales Revenue, Item Type Sales Revenue'.-Cause-The error appears because the account determination cannot be determined for the secondary processing of Sales items to the G/L Account (Origin). A Sales posting will post to the related Sales Account first and secondly to the GL Account Origin.-The item in question has no product maintained, and no business partner maintained.-Without either a Business Partner or Product maintained, a line in the Chart of Accounts, Sales Ledger for Revenue needs to be added, with blank values under Account Determination Group for Customers and blank value under Account Determination Group for Materials.-Resolution-Go to Business Confirmation work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Search and find the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination select Sales.-Select the Revenues Tab.-Maintain a line with blank values under Account Determination Group for Customers and blank value under Account Determination Group for Materials.-As Point-of-Sale transactions do not require the customer to be maintained, having the above setting is good practice to allow these transactions to post.-Keywords-POS, Point-of-Sale, Account Determination

Title: Completion of Project Invoice Request associated BTM tasks.
Content: Symptom-During creation of scheduled project invoice request system generates below tasks.-Task 1. Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request - Creation of project invoice request failed. Check the application log XXXXX (XXXXXX represents the application log ID).-Application Log: Expenses do not exist; CPIR not created.-Task2. Review and Release Project Invoice Request XYZ - Invoice schedule of sales order ABC created  project invoice request XYZ. Review and release the document (XYZ represents the Project Invoice Request ID and  ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose the Work view.-Here you will be able to see the below mentioned  BTM tasks in New status.-Task 1. Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request - Creation of project invoice request failed. Check the application log XXXXX (XXXXXX represents the application log ID).-Application Log: Expenses do not exist; CPIR not created-Task2. Review and Release Project Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ represents the Project Invoice Request ID). - Invoice schedule of sales order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID) created project invoice request XYZ. Review and release the document-Cause-Case1.-Task:  Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request - Creation of project invoice request failed. Check the application log XXXXX (XXXXXX represents the application log ID).-Application Log: Expenses do not exist; CPIR not created.-Expenses do not exist it means that there are no expenses available to create project invoice request.-If you are sure, you don’t expect any expenses might occur for the project, and then you have to delete those invoice schedule items from Sales Order so that it won’t consider for execution in future.-If the automatic invoice schedule creation executed the invoice schedule item, then it will result in an error task Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request - Creation of project invoice request failed. Check the application log XXXXX (XXXXXX represents the application log ID).-If the error task expense does not exist and if you are sure there will not be any expenses in future for this Sales Ordered so deleting the invoice schedule item and complete the BTM task form the front end.-Case 2.-Task  : Review and Release Project Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ represents the Project Invoice Request ID). - Invoice schedule of sales order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID) created project invoice request XYZ. Review and release the document.-Review and Release Project Invoice Request it means during the intercompany scheduled Invoicing process the system generated this task and the Project Invoice Request is automatically released.-Open the invoice and check if the project invoice request released then completes the task via front end.-Resolution-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose the Work view.-Choose the Task which you want to complete.-Choose the Action --> Set to Complete button.- Additional Information about this new functionality.-This is available for all sort of tasks displayed in that view.-Multi Select is enabled in the list. This gives user to select multiple tasks (Ctrl+ select or Shift + Select for group selection) and perform this operation.-Once the task is completed, If you open the corresponding application log after its completion, you can see the completion information as the Task has been completed by the user. -About Multi Select: Set to Complete" action will be enabled only for open tasks. Not for already completed tasks. During multi select, when you selects the completed task first and then set of other open tasks -the complete button will be still disabled. When you first selects an open task and then set of completed tasks, the button will be enabled still.-Keywords-Completion of Project Invoice Request, BTM task, Solve Issue When Creating Project Invoice Request, Review and Release Project Invoice Request,Project Invoice Request Not Created For a Sales Order

Title: Unable To See Amount in Credit From Previous Year While Previewing Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You executed the Tax Return Run for Tax Return Type - Summary Register.-Now, you are previewing the Tax Return and you observe the Credit from Previous Year field shows - 0,00 amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Select the VAT Returns subview.-Show All Tax Returns.-Search for the Tax Return Type - Summary Register.-Select the button Preview.-In the preview document, you see the Credit from Previous Years is 0,00.-Cause-Two possible reasons are:-You have not selected the option - Carry Forward in the Tax Return Arrangements.-You executed the Tax Return Run first time for Tax Return Type - Summary Register. As there is no previous year Tax Return, the system shows 0,00 amount in Credit from Previous Year field.-Some country/regions allow to manually edit this field, as for example Italy.-Resolution-This is the normal system behavior.-To select the option - Carry Forward please follow the below steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Access View Tax Authority.-Select the Tax Authority and Edit it.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Go to the Tax Return Arrangements tab.-Under Details, select the option - Carry Forward.-Click Save.-Once you select the option - Carry Forward, then system will automatically pick up the Credit amount from the previous year Tax Return and display in the current year Tax Return.-NOTE: At the moment SAP Business ByDesign system do not allow user to enter the amount manually in the Credit from Previous Year field. This is legally not allowed.-Keywords-Credit from Previous Year, Summary Register, Tax Return for Italy

Title: Error Message: Document ID 'XYZ' Includes Unallowed Character; Change The ID
Content: Symptom-You want to simulate the migration and the following message is displayed: Document ID 'XYZ' Includes Unallowed Character; Change The ID-XYZ means the Document ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity List for the project ABC (ABC means the Project Name).-Go to the Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click the hyperlink Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration unit and click the Execute Migration Button.-Click the Open Items Payable migration object.-Simulate the Migration and the error message will be displayed: 'Document ID 'XYZ' includes unallowed character; change the ID'-Cause-Unallowed characters are blank spaces, lower case letters, and special characters like #, *, %, & etc. or leading zero.-Resolution-Create a new source file with valid values for Document ID.-Upload the new source file to replace the previous version.-Keywords-data migration; open items payable; open items receivable

Title: Wrong Approver is Determined for Payment Approval Task
Content: Symptom-You have created an outgoing payment for a customer account and expect the approver maintained as Approver for Payables to receive the approval task. However, the task is assigned to the Approver for Receivables.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Open the concerned outgoing payment made to a customer account.-Via the change log, you see that the payment has been approved by Accounts Receivables clerk.-Cause-The payment approver is not determined by the direction of the payment order (incoming vs. outgoing) but if it is a customer, supplier or manual payment.-In this case the outgoing payment is for a customer account, hence the Approver for Receivables received the task.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior. In general, the payments' approvers are determined as follows:-For Customer payments, the approver is determined from Approver for Receivables. -For Supplier payments, the approver is determined from Approver for Payables.-For manual payments, the approver is determined from Approver for Liquidity Management.-The manual payments are payments created manually while Customer or Supplier payments are the automatic payments created via payment run from the respective work center.-For more details on each payment approval task type and how the approval process is set up, you may refer to the KBA 2063785 - How to Set Up Approval Process for Payments-See Also-2063785 - How to Set Up Approval Process for Payments-2495072 - How to Set Up Approval Task for Under and Over Payments-Keywords-Employee Work Distribution, Business Task Management, Payment Management, Liquidity Management, Approval Process, Approval Task, Incoming Payment, Outgoing payment, Outgoing Check, Outgoing Bank Transfer.

Title: Process Control Settings and its Impact to Accounting Period.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Understanding Process Control with an example of Customer invoicing to see how source document in the original application can be posted using the posting date.-The settings you make for the process control affect how the system behaves when checking the posting date in the source document, which is used in the original application.-In the process control area, the system checks whether a source document can be posted for the specified posting date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Possible scenarios while creating Customer Invoice.-Use Case Period Set Process Control Result-1 Not Blocked Blocked On Action Release, you'll get warning message Posting on MM/DD/YYYY blocked; release not possible-2 Not Blocked Not Blocked Finished-3 Blocked Not Blocked On Action Release, invoice get Released, but no posting to accounting. A task Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY is closed for closing step Operational postings' get created.-4 Blocked Blocked On Action Release, you'll get warning message Posting on MM/DD/YYYY blocked; release not possible.-  Explanation of User case 1.-In the Customer Invoicing work center we try to create a new manual customer invoice in the past date.-In General Ledger work center, in the view Open and Close Periods, you can see Period Status is Not Blocked.-In the General Ledger work center in the view Companies Set Process Control is Blocked.-    Explanation of Use Case 2.-In the Customer Invoicing work center you try to create a new manual customer invoice in the past date.-In the General Ledger work center, in the view Open and Close Period, you can see the Period Status is Not Blocked.-  In the General Ledger work center in the view Companies Set Process Control is Not Blocked.- Explanation of Use Case 3.-In the Customer Invoicing work center you tried to create a new manual customer invoice in the past date. And you were able to Release the invoice without any error. But this invoice in not yet posted into accounting. In the General Ledger work center, in view Closing Cockpit, the Source Document will be with the Status In Process with an error message with the description Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY is closed for closing step Operational postings.-  In the General Ledger work center in the view Closing Cockpit, the Source Document is with the Status In Process with an error message with the description: Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY is closed for closing step  Operational postings.-  Select Action and choose View Business Transaction.-A new window open up when you select Action and choose View Business Transaction.-If select Post you still get the same error message with the description: Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY is closed for closing step Operational postings.-  If you select Post to Another Period, you get an option to chose an alternative posting date in which the posting posting period is Not Blocked with a valid process control status.-In General Ledger work center, in the view Open and Close Periods, the Period Status is Blocked.-In General Ledger work center, in the view Companies, Set Process Control Status is Not Blocked.- Explanation of Use Case 4.-You try to create a Customer Invoice in past date where as the corresponding posting period and process control are with the Status Blocked. You will not be able to Release the Customer Invoice, you will get an warring message with the description: MM/DD/YYYY blocked; release not possible.-  In General Ledger work center, in the view Open and Close Period, you can observe that the Periods Status is Blocked.-  In the General Ledger work center in the view Companies you also observe that the Process Control Status is Blocked.-    See Also-Note: Here are few case document relevant to Process Control helpful in various application areas:-2625860 - Unable to Post Supplier Invoice due to Error Message: 'You cannot post the invoice on DD:MM:YYYY; this date is blocked for posting in financial accounting'-1642309 - Unable to Cancel Goods and Services Receipt-1648199 - How to Post Reverse Warehouse Confirmation Without Opening the Relevant Accounting Period-1603019 - Error Message: Confirmation not possible; positing on XX.YY.ZZZZ is blocked by accounting, While doing Inventory Adjustment

Title: Resource contains inconsistent financials data' Error Message for Unposted Production Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Production Confirmation DEF is unposted due to the error message 'Resource ABC contains inconsistent financials data' (DEF means the Production Confirmation ID; ABC means the Labor Resource ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Select the Unposted Source Documents view.-Find Production Confirmation DEF and notice the error message: 'Resource ABC contains inconsistent financials data'.-Cause-For this resource ABC, the cost rate was delimited as of a certain date (for example, 16.01.2021). When you delimit a cost rate, a new line gets created with a new cost rate, but is not automatically filled with cost rate and unit. So there's a cost rate now with validity from 17.01.2021, but there's no actual cost rate or unit value maintained, which is inconsistent. The posting date of Production Confirmation DEF is proposed as 18.01.2021 so this is the line that is being brought back.-Resolution-A valid cost rate must be maintained for the new line. In the above example, as of 17.01.2021.-Keywords-production confirmation; labor resource; valuation; cost rate; cost unit

Title: Deducible Tax Amount is Not Editable in a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are not able to manually change the Deductible Amount in a Supplier Invoice.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents.-Open the relevant Invoice.-Click View All.-Go to the Items tab -> Taxes sub-tab.-Change the Deductibility Amount from 100.00 EUR to 75.00 EUR (for example).-Click Check.-System automatically changes the Deductible Amount back to 100.00 EUR or the error message 'Item 1: Tax not yet calculated' is raised.-Cause-Currently it is not allowed to manually change the Deductible Amount in the system.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Only the Deductible Amount calculated by the system can be used.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Deductible Amount, Taxes.

Title: Unable to Add International Work Schedule for Employee
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set up the time configuration for an employee from outside the country/regions you have scoped in the Business Configuration, but find yourself unable to add international work schedule to this employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Select the relevant employee and click Edit.-In the new screen, navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Next, under the Details section, navigate to the Work Schedule tab.-Click the value help for the Time Model field; although international time models have already been created, no results will be displayed for selection here.-Cause-If the relevant employee is based on a country/region for which a localization has been provided by SAP, the system will expect you to scope this country/region and use the localized data. International versions of time types, time accounts, time models, and so on, are meant to be used only for country/regions that have not been localized yet.-Resolution-Please scope the employee's relevant country/regions and use the time data for that country/region in the employee's configuration.-See Also-Localization at SAP Business ByDesign: Frequently Asked Questions, in SAP Community (blog)-SAP Business ByDesign: Localization Roadmap and Outlook 2019, in SAP Community (blog)-Keywords-International work schedule, time model, employee, country not scoped

Title: Saved Org Structure is Missing in Organizational Management Work Center
Content: Symptom-You have created an Org structure and saved the same. But, now the structure is missing.-Cause-The reason that you are not able to view the saved org structure is that you might have used the ROLLBACK option. The Rollback option revert the org structure to last activation. So in this case, since the you haven't activated the org structure, all the creation and changes have been reverted to initial.-Resolution-When you have selected the rollback button, system throws a warning message Are you sure you want to roll back all pending organizational changes? Roll back deletes all changes made to the Organizational structure, and returns to the currently active version. It deletes organizational units that have not yet activated. This action has system-wide consequences and also affects org structure and units that are not currently shown on the screen. This action cannot be undone. To roll back click OK. To return to the previous screen click Cancel. If you clicked OK the action is triggered.--So in this case, it is not possible to undone the roll back which means the structure needs to rebuild.

Title: Withholding Tax Return 1099 MISC File Missing Data From Withholding Tax Return 1099 NEC
Content: Symptom-You have created a Withholding Tax Return with Type Miscellaneous Income (1099 Misc) - File and your expectation is that the generated Output File should have the details from Tax Return 1099-NEC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Withholding Tax Returns view.-Show All Tax Returns.-Select the relevant Tax Return with Type Miscellaneous Income (1099 Misc) - File.-Click View.-Go to the Attachments tab.-Open the file.-The file only contains information from the Withholding Tax Return 1099 Misc.-Cause-The file from Withholding Tax Return (1099 - MISC) will only have the details from Withholding Tax Return 1099 - MISC.-This happens because both 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC will have different Tax Forms and different Outputs Files based on the legal specifications.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-You will have to generate separated Tax Forms and separated files for 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC.-In order to generate the file for Tax Return 1099-NEC it is necessary to adjust the settings in Tax Authority using the steps below:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Select the relevant Tax Authority ID.-Click Edit -> Company Tax Arrangements.-Go to the Tax Return Arrangements sub-tab.-Select the relevant Tax Return Arrangement ID.-The Electronic Submission checkbox needs to be marked.-After that, you can execute a new Withholding Tax Return for this Tax Arrangement and the file 1099-NEC will be generated.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return, Tax Type, 1099, NEC, MISC, File.

Title: Freight Description is Missing on XML/Form
Content: Symptom-When you preview the Sales Order Form, the Freight description is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order number).-Select Preview button.-System is not showing the Freight Description.-Cause-The pricing procedure has Freight maintained but, it is not marked to be shown on item level or in item print form.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select the respective implementation project.-Click the Open Activity list button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click the Configure Pricing Procedure hyperlink.-Set the Freight to be shown on Item Level.-Save your changes.-The Freight will appear on your form.-Keywords-Freight; Form; Sales Orders; Price Strategy

Title: Standard Account Determination Groups for Payables and Receivables are not Deployed
Content: Symptom-You have started to set up the chart of accounts, however the standard account determination groups for Payables and Receivables are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit Account Determination Groups.-Check the Accounts Payable -> Groups for Suppliers and Accounts Receivable -> Groups for Customers.- No default account determination groups are maintained.-Click Restore Defaults -> No Records found.-Cause-The account determination groups for Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivables are not deployed since "Payables and Receivables Processing" is not scoped in the system, given that Customer Invoices, Expense and Reimbursement Management and Supplier Invoicing are not scoped as well.-Hence, the system would not need these account determinations if these business options are not scoped.-Resolution-In order to scope Payables and Receivables Processing to enable the Payables and Receivables account determination groups, you may refer to below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open project scope.-Go to Scoping phase.-Scope the options that activates Payables and Receivables Processing, such as Customer Invoices (under Sales), Expense and Reimbursement Management (under Travel and Expenses) and/or Supplier Invoicing (under Purchasing).-Save and deploy the changes.-Keywords-Account Determination Group. Char of Accounts. Implementation Project. Project Scope. Payables. Receivables.

Title: "Products w/ item group Expense - time and material not supported for location of srv provision On-Site" Error when Using Service Type XACT in Service Order
Content: Symptom-When adding a Service of type XACT (Expense - Time and Material) in a Service Order, the system is throwing error "Products w/ item group Expense - time and material not supported for location of srv provision On-Site", even though this scenario should be supported.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Open the Service Order Processing view.-Find Service Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Service Order ID).-Open it and click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab and add a new Service of type XACT.-The system will display error "Products w/ item group Expense - time and material not supported for location of srv provision On-Site" even if this item type should support the Location of Service Provision "On-Site".-Cause-The system is throwing this error due to a missing scoping configuration.-Resolution-To Scope the correct configuration, follow these steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Select the following path: Service > Product and Service Portfolio for Service and Repair > Offered Services.-Scope question "Do you intend to invoice expenses based on receipts that result from sales or services, taking actual costs from the service confirmation?"-Keywords-XACT, Expense, Service Order, Unable, Error, Issue, Supported, Unsupported

Title: Internal Comment in Customer Invoice is Not Available in the Template
Content: Symptom-You have added the Internal Comment in the General tab for the Customer Invoice, and you expect to see this note on the Invoice Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Navigate to the General tab, Internal Comment note is maintained.-Click on Preview, Internal Comment note does not appear.-Cause-Once Output template is used for external customers and the Internal Comment is supposed to be only visible to the internal team, it should not be shared with external customer, hence, it is not available in the template.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-If you want to maintain a note in the Customer Invoice Teamplate, it's necessary to use the Customer Information. It will appear in the XML, hence available in the template.-Keywords-Internal Comment, Customer Invoice, Template, XML, Customer Information

Title: Planning Report Does not Expand Fully as per Financial Reporting Structure
Content: Symptom-You have created a financial reporting structure with more than 10 hierarchy levels.-But when viewing the report in Microsoft Excel from the Planning view the report displays data only up until hierarchy level 10.-Example:-Your financial reporting structure has 10 structure items in hierarchical order, meaning 10 hierarchy levels.-You assigned accounts to each level.-This means that the accounts assigned to the 10th structure item are located in the 11th hierarchy level.-When you now view the report in Excel from the Planning view the assigned accounts are not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center navigate to the Planning View.-Select the plan that you would like to edit, e.g. the income statement report.-Click on the Excel icon in the Income Statement column to open the report.-Logon with your user credentials.-Now you notice that the report does not display any data after hierarchy level 10.-Cause-The expansion level in Microsoft Excel is set to 10. Therefore you can't see any data after hierarchy level 10.-Resolution-You can delete the expansion level as follows:-Make sure that the SAP Business ByDesign - View is visible on the right side of the Excel report-If you don't see it navigate to the SAP Business ByDesign tab on the top. Then go to Show/Hide and there select View.-On the very bottom of this view you see the command Retrieve Hierarchies Up to Expansion Level and a drop down menu which is set to 9 or 10.-In this drop down menu select the blank field.-This way you delete - or better set the expansion level to 98 - and the report now displays data after hierarchy level 10.-Keywords-financial reports, characteristics, hierarchy, level, Planning

Title: Profit Overview by Key Figure Report - Key Figures Not Displayed When Logged On in a Language Other Than English
Content: Symptom-You logon to the system in English language; You view the Profit Overview by Key Figure report. Here all key figures appear correctly.-You logon to the system in a different language, Japanese for instance; This time, the Profit Overview by Key Figure report. The key figures appear as empty fields. They are not translated to the language that you are logged in with.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the system in a language other than English, for example Japanese.-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Reports- List view.-Find and open the Profit Overview by Key Figure report.-In the Contribution Margin Scheme field, select ABC (ABC stands for the Contribution Margin Scheme ID).-You find that the key figures are not showing translated in Japanese.-Cause-The values in the Financial Reporting Structure ABC have not been maintained in the language that you are logged in with.-Resolution-In order to display all key figures in the desired logon language, you need to maintain all values in this language in the respective Financial Reporting Structure:-Logon to your system in the different language.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and find the Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis activity, either via Overview (if your system is already live) or through the First Implementation project in the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity.-In the new screen, click Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the Financial reporting structure with Key ABC and press Edit.-Press Expand All.-Maintain all structure items in the language that you are logged in with.-Press OK.-Then press Save and close.-Navigate back to the report and check if the key figures now appear in the desired language.-Keywords-Profit Overview by Key Figure, Japanese, Spanish, logon language

Title: No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_OVERHEAD_COST_LACCT
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are unable to post Goods and Activity Confirmation or other Inventory documents to Financials due to any of the following error messages.-'No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XXX, BO out FIA_PRODUCTION_LACCT, BO in FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT' or-'No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XXX, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_GL_ACCOUNT' or-'No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, BO in FIA_OVERHEAD_COST_LACCT'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents view.-Select the Goods and Activity Confirmation document which is in status In process.-You will see the error message 'No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_PRODUCTION_LACCT, BO in FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT under the section Messages'.-Cause-You have not maintained the valuation data for some materials which are being used in the Goods and activity confirmation. The following scenarios are possible in this case.-Either the inventory cost is not maintained at all or it is zero for the posting date of Goods and activity confirmation.-The inventory cost maintained, but it is not valid for the posting date of Goods and activity confirmation.-  Resolution-You have to maintain the inventory cost for all the materials being used in the Goods and Activity Confirmation. In case of few materials being used in the Goods and Activity Confirmation, you can manually check the validity of the inventory cost for the materials.-Generally these inventory documents will be created with the large number of line items and hence it is not feasible to manually validate the inventory cost of all the materials. You can find out the material for which inventory cost is missing from the backend.-Note: Please note that the following steps will only give you the first material for which inventory cost is missing. If there is more than one material for which inventory cost is missing, you will have to send the incident back to customer to maintain the cost for the first material. Then again we need to follow the same steps to find out the remaining materials for the missing cost. It is advisable to do a meeting with the customer and then follow these steps to find out the materials with missing cost. Customer can maintain the missing costs during the meeting and we can avoid sending incident back to customer many times for maintaining the cost.-Kindly follow the below mentioned steps to find out the materials for which the valuation data is missing.-Log on to backend via STFK.-Run Tcode SESFTS.-          Load the BO FIA_ACC_NOTIF-      Load by Query- ROOT- QUERY_BY_OPER_DOC  - Enter the Document ID in the OperationalDocumentFormattedID and Document Type Code-   You should find one document and click Actions- REPROCESS_PENDING- Click OK- You will get the same error in the backend-   Navigate to the ORIGIN_LOCATION and copy the BO_NODE_ID-  Select the AccountingNotification - Root and Navigate to ITEM_GROUP-    Navigate to  ITEM_GROUP_ITEM-   Select the Node ID Column and click AVL Functions- Find-You will find the Line Item ID for which Inventory Cost is missing.-    Now you can open the corresponding document in the UI and verify that inventory cost would be missing for the material in the LineItem ID.-Keywords-No value of subtransaction company, FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT, FIA_OVERHEAD_COST_LACCT

Title: Sorting is not Working in the Report Journal
Content: Symptom-When you click sorting in the report Journal, it's not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search and open report Journal.-Enter all the necessary values in the selections.-Click Apply.-In the report, click sorting for the column Posting Date which is located in the second column.-You will see that the documents are not sorted ascendingly or descendingly.-Cause-The behavior here is corret, the analysis pattern is internally based on a grid but not a table.-All columns are sorted from left to right.-The second column can only be sorted considering the order of the first column.-Resolution-In order to sort by your desired column, you can move the column to the first row.-Keywords-Journal; Sorting; 凭证日记账；排序.

Title: Cannot Use a Custom Exchange Rate Type for Expense Reports
Content: Symptom-You want to use a custom Exchange Rate Type for Expense Reports, however, system always pick up the Default Exchange Rate Type.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses Work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks > New Expense Report on Behalf.-Select an Employee, Type of Expense Report, Purpose and a Start Date.-Click Next button.-Add a new Expense.-System is calculating the Exchange Rate as per the Default Exchange Rate Type.-You like to use another Currency Conversion Profile created in the Business Configuration Fine Tune Activity Currency Conversion Profiles.-Cause-System does not support a different Exchange Rate Type as the Default Exchange Rate Type for expense reporting. The Default Exchange Rate Type is always 001.-Resolution-System behavior is correct.-Keywords-expense report, exchange rate, default exchange rate type, 001

Title: Missing Product Category from Sales Order Reference in G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-Product Category is not being derived from sales order and shows as not assigned in G/L Line Items report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Find the related journal entry.-Open the JE and open report G/L account - Line items from this journal entry.-In the report, bring the Product Category characteristic to the rows.-You see that the value is shows as # Not Assigned. You expect the report to show the product category being derived from the sales order reference, assigned to the journal entry item.-Cause- The report does not derive the Product nor Product Category from the sales order reference.-Resolution-When you open the menu to add new characteristics to the rows, you notice that some characteristics have an increased indent, being shown below another characteristic. For example:-This means that the Product Category, in this example, would be derived - if available - from the project task reference.-By checking the available product categories in the G/L Accounts - Line items report, we see that the report has not been designed to derive the product category from a sales order reference.-Keywords-Product Category. Journal Entry. General Legder. GL Line Items. Reports. Product Category.

Title: Almost all Numbers in Number Range are Reserved
Content: Symptom-You noticed that an incident has been created stating that almost all numbers in a given number range are reserved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Incidents view.-You noticed that the system created an incident with below description (Example):-Health Check Component: Cross-Application Services-Health Check Name: Number Range Depletion-Description: The system is running out of unique numbers for a particular number range. When this occurs, the system does not allow you to create a new business document or master data, depending on which number range is affected. You must extend your existing number range.-Number Range Profile Name: FIAADO -Number Range Type Name: FIAADO_0002 -Number Range Object Name: FIA_ACCDOC -Number Range Object Long Text: FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT -Number Range Subobject Name: 000001 -Year: 2018 -Interval Number: 50 -Remaining Percent Level: 0 % -Warn when less than % remain: 5 % -Number Range Profile Name: FIAADO -Number Range Type Name: FIAADO_0002 -Number Range Object Name: FIA_ACCDOC -Number Range Object Long Text: FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT -Number Range Subobject Name: 000001 -Year: 2018 -Interval Number: 60 -Remaining Percent Level: 0 % -Warn when less than % remain: 5 %-Cause-This is an automatic system alert, which aims to inform that for a specific document, its number range has almost no available numbers/IDs left, hence the related business transaction would not be created.-Resolution-Within the error description in the incident, there are two important fields: Number Range Object Long Text and Interval Number-The number range object in the above example is FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT, which stands for the business object of journal entries. The message also mentions the interval numbers 50 and 60 for year 2018.-Therefore, it is known that for fiscal year 2018 the system is running out of numbers for journal entries with interval numbers 50 and 60-To check and adjust the number ranges, please follow below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open the activity Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges.-Click Edit number range profiles for journal entries.-In this screen you'll be able to edit the number ranges.-Note that the IDs are fiscal year-dependent. Hence, for 2018 you may be running out of numbers for interval 50 but for 2019 there are still numbers available.-Keywords-Number Range. Journal Entry. Accounting Document.

Title: Error Message: Goods receipt not possible; individual material AAA is obsolete
Content: Symptom-You are not able to post Source Document ABC and not able to set the Task as Irrelevant either.-ABC means the source document ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Search for the source document ABC.-Click Actions button and select View Business Transaction option.-Click Mark as Irrelevant button.-Error message is thrown:-Goods receipt not possible; individual material AAA is obsolete-AAA means the individual material ID.-Cause-Marking a pair of Business Transactions for Accounting as irrelevant is only possible if all items of the document to be reversed are indeed reversed.-Resolution-You need to create a goods and services receipt reversal for document ABC, which will create another Business Transaction for Accounting in Processing Status 2-In Process.-After that, you should be able to mark the reversal document as irrelevant. The system will then automatically mark the original document as irrelevant to accounting too.-Keywords-individual material; obsolete; goods and services receipt; imat; gsr

Title: Technical Exception STRING_LENGTH_NEGATIVE While Uploading a Migration Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY**-While trying to upload a migration template to the migration tool, process fails with a 500 Internal Server Error screen.-In the backend, transaction ST22, there's a log for technical exception STRING_LENGTH_NEGATIVE with short text "Incorrect access to a string using a negative length".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Access the Overview work center view-Search and open the relevant migration fine-tuning activity.-Click the link to access the migration tool.-In the next screen, click the Upload button, then choose Data from Migration Template.-Select the relevant file and click Upload.-System raises the reported error message.-Cause-This issue can occur due to multiple reasons, all related to incorrect procedure during editing of the migration template that might have altered the formatting of the template, changed column headers or any similar occurrence.-Resolution-Please inform customer to download a new migration template from the migration tool and fill the data there, advising that if they use copy and paste functionality to fill the template, they should only use paste options that paste the values without formatting. Any other aspects of the template (column position, column headers etc.) should not be changed.-Keywords-STRING_LENGTH_NEGATIVE, Migration tool, negative length, 500 Internal Server Error

Title: Missing Discount Calculation Within Customer Invoice Payment
Content: Symptom-You make a Customer Invoice Payment that contains a payment term discount and you notice that the automatic discount is not calculated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work centre.-Use the Customer Accounts view.-Click the Account ID.-Select View.-Search for the customer invoice XXX (XXX stands for the customer invoice ID).-Select it and select the button Pay Manually by Incoming Check.-The Cash Discount is calculated at 0,00 (The Discount is not applied).-Cause-The discount is not calculated because the Cash Discount box is not selected.-Resolution-You need to select the Cash Discount box. The Cash Discount is only calculated when the Discount box  is set.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work centre.-Select the Invoice Document view.-Show All Invoice Documents and search for Invoice XXX.-Select Edit.-Select View All and select the tab Items.-On this page, the Cash Discount box needs to be ticked.-Keywords-Cash Discount, customer invoice, sales items, payment, receivables

Title: Bank Statement's Cleared Amount Mismatch The Difference Between Opening and Closing Balance
Content: Symptom-You have created bank statement XXX and maintained the closing balance for that period, however after reviewing the assigned payments you noticed that the cleared amount mismatch the difference between the Opening and Closing balance that you have calculated, which causes an unexpected difference and turns the bank statement into inconsistent status (XXX, YYY and ZZZ represent IDs in the system).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Open the bank statement XXX.-The Cleared Balance is bigger than the calculated difference between opening and closing balance.-Cause-Before creating the bank statement XXX, you have assigned one of the payments to another bank statement YYY. Since the payment was not confirmed yet, you were able to select the same payment again on bank statement XXX. When you posted bank statement YYY the payment in question got confirmed, however it was also being locked by bank statement XXX, which cause the inconsistency against the calculated balance for XXX.-Resolution-Since the difference is caused by a payment which was already confirmed, you may remove the concerned entry from the current bank statement by following the below steps:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Open bank statement XXX and go to the third step, 3-Create and Edit Items.-Identify the inconsistent payment. To do so, you may either search by the Difference amount or press the Check button. A warning message will be raised informing that the Item ZZZ is already selected in another payment allocation.-Select the Item ID ZZZ and press Delete. Note that you are able to select multiple line items and delete them in one go.-After the above steps, the bank statement should be consistent and the Cleared Balance matches the Opening and Closing balance difference that you've calculated.-Keywords-bank statement; cleared balance; difference

Title: Profit Center Missing in Data Carryforward Account - Migration of G/L Account Balances
Content: Symptom-While migrating General Ledger Account Balances it can seen that the profit center is missing for the offsetting data carryforward account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Click Journal Entries.-Select the Journal Entry and click edit.-Notice that the profit center is not updated for the data carryforward account which is an offsetting account.-Cause-One of the prerequisites before migrating G/L account balances is that the profit center is not carried or automatically assigned based on any account assignment to the offsetting data carryforward accounts.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Fine Tuning activity Profit Center Derivation.-Select Edit Default Profit Center.-For each company, a default profit center needs to be specified for journal entry line items. A default profit center is specified for each sub-ledger. The system applies the particular default profit center whenever it cannot automatically derive a profit center from data stored in the source document.-If no source document is available, this setting needs to be maintained. If the G/L account selected in the Journal Entry Voucher lines belongs to a miscellaneous ledger, the sub-ledger can be selected as Without Sub-ledger or left blank so that it applies to all.-Keywords-data migration; profit center; profit center derivation; default profit center, carryforward account, journal entry line item

Title: Error While Migrating Inventory: 'AAA not assigned to logistics unit BBB as standard material'
Content: Symptom-You are not able to proceed with the Inventory migration due to some error messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant Migration Unit.-Press Execute Migration.-Select Migration Object Inventory.-Click Process File.-The error message is displayed as follows: 'AAA not assigned to logistics unit BBB as standard material'.-AAA - Material ID-BBB - Logistics Unit ID-Cause-The reason for the error is that the Material ID AAA is not assigned to the Logistics Unit ID BBB as Standard Material.-Resolution-To proceed with the Inventory Migration it is necessary to assign the relevant Materials in Logistics Unit ID BBB.-You can refer to the steps below:-Go to the Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to the Logistics Units view.-Open the Logistics Unit BBB.-Go tot he Standard Products tab.-The necessary Materials can be added here.-Keywords-Migration, Inventory, Logistics Unit, Materials.

Title: No Journal Entry Created for Reported Withholding Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You have released and reported a Withholding Tax Return, but no Journal Entry was generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center. -Go to the Withholding Tax Returns view.-Select the relevant Tax Return.-Click View.-There is no Journal ID under the Accounting Information section.-Cause-The reason why no Journal Entry was created is that the Tax Amounts are zero.-You can check this using the steps below:-Go to the Tax Management work center. -Go to the Withholding Tax Returns view.-Select the relevant Tax Return.-Click View.-Check the Tax Return Amounts section.-In case these Amounts are zero there will be no Journal Entry.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return, Journal Entry, Tax Amounts, Accounting.

Title: Error on Revenue Recognition: Please create an incident, reason "An exception with the type CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW occurred, but was neither handled locally, nordeclared in a RAISING clause"
Content: Symptom-The Revenue Recognition Run fails with the below error:-Please create an incident, reason "An exception with the type CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW occurred, but was neither handled locally, nordeclared in a RAISING clause"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Navigate to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find the relevant Run ID.-Click View.-Go to the Messages tab.-Error: Please create an incident, reason "An exception with the type CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW occurred, but was neither handled locally, nordeclared in a RAISING clause"-Cause-The error occurred during the Percentage of Completion calculation due to a negative value, POC is calculated by dividing the Total Actual Cost by the Estimated Cost. This is leading to a figure that is out of range when doing an assignment in the code. The Actual Cost is usually only positive.-Resolution-In such cases it is advised to adjust the Cost manually, this can be found also on the Help Document Revenue Recognition for Project Sales:-If the calculated Total Estimated Project Cost is not considered appropriate for the Percentage of Completion (POC) calculation, an alternative value can be entered manually in the Sales Document Items view using the Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data → Edit Percentage of Completion option.-To maintain a manual total estimated project cost:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Open the Sales Document Items view.-In the Show field, select Sales Order Items.-Search for and select the relevant sales order.-Click Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and choose Percentage of Completion.-Enter the required value for the Total Estimated Project Cost and save the changes.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition, CX_SY_CONVERSION_OVERFLOW, exception, cx_sy_conversion_overflow,revenue recognition,exception. POC, Manual Revenue Recognition Data, Percentage of Completion, Sales Order Item, Total Actual Cost

Title: Unexpected Offset Cost Object Displayed in G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-While running the G/L Accounts - Line Items report you notice that system displays the same Offset Cost Object for all Journal Entry Items for a given Journal Entry.-The expectation is that for each Journal Entry Item in the report the same Cost Object of each journal entry item would be displayed as Offset Cost Object.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the G/L Accounts - Line Items Report.-Enter required data and make sure that you have added characteristics Journal Entry, Journal Entry Item and Offset Cost Object.-Execute the report.-Notice that for each Journal Entry Item of Journal Entry AAA (AAA means the Journal Entry ID) the system displays the same Offset Cost Object XYZ (XYZ means the Offset Cost Object).-While opening Journal Entry AAA you notice that XYZ is the Cost Object ID assigned to Journal Entry Item 1 (Line 1). The other items have different Cost Object IDs assigned.-Cause-The source document is a manual journal entry voucher and in JEV, system has no mean to group that a given credit and debit line is offsetting each other. It is not a semantic document in that sense. Your expectation is that line 1 and 2 are offsetting each other and hence offset cost object in line 2 should have cost object of 1, likewise, line 4 should have cost object entered in 3. However, there is no way that this is indicated to the system and we cannot always assume that 1 and 2 offset each other. Hence, system always takes one of the cost objects as offsetting cost object for the rest of the items.-Resolution-System behaves as per design.-Keywords-offset cost object; cost object; G/L Accounts - Line Items

Title: Error Message in Unposted Source Documents: Period AAA in fiscal year BBB closed for closing step Operational postings
Content: Symptom-In the General Ledger work center, under the Source Documents view, certain Unposted Source Documents appeared with the following error message:-'Period AAA (numeric value) in fiscal year BBB (numeric value) closed for closing step Operational postings'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit and click the Source Documents view.-In the Source Documents, filter for Unposted Source Documents.-A list of all Unposted Source Documents will appear with this error message.-Cause-The reason for this error message is that the financial document is being posted to a closed accounting period.-For example, a financial document may be created in the current period (DD/MM/YYYY) but posted with a posting date that falls in a previous accounting period. If that previous period is closed for Operational Postings (010) and only open for Closing Entries (020), the system cannot post the document.-As a result, the financial document remains unposted and appears in the Unposted Source Documents list within the Source Documents view of the General Ledger work center.-Resolution-Those unposted source documents can either be posted to the current open period or to the original past period after reopening the relevant posting period.-A. To post the unposted source documents in the current period, follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit View and select the Source Documents sub view.-In the Source Documents, filter for Unposted Source Documents.-A list of all Unposted Source Documents will appear, select the relevant unposted source document that displays the error message.-Click Actions and choose View Business Transaction.-In the Business Transaction for Accounting window, click Post to Another Period and select the current open period for posting.-B. To post the unposted source document in the old/past period, follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, open Open and Close Periods.-Enter the required selection criteria, such as Company ID and Set of Books, then click Go.-Select the accounting period that is currently blocked for posting and choose Open Period.-Open the period for Operational Postings (010).-Click Save and Close.-After reopening the period, return to the Business Transaction for Accounting window and click Post to manually post the unposted source document to the original accounting period.-Keywords-posting error, previous period posting error, GL posting blocked, period lock status, accounting calendar, manual posting adjustment, reopen closed month, fiscal period management, period-end processing, accounting period reopen procedure, posting date mismatch, prior month posting, closed month posting error

Title: How do the Reporting Recurrence and the Payment Recurrence Functionalities Work
Content: Symptom-You want to know how the Reporting Recurrence and the Payment Recurrence functionalities work.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Go to the Tax Authorities subview.-Select the relevant Tax Authority.-Click Edit and open the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Select the relevant Company.-Open the Tax Return Arrangements tab.-Select the relevant Tax Arrangement ID.-Note: You can find the Reporting Recurrence and Payment Recurrence fields under the Details area.-Resolution-The Reporting Recurrence and Payment Recurrence fields are only reporting relevant.-The above fields are available in the system as for certain countries the Reporting Recurrence and Payment Recurrence are part of their tax return file.-This means that no automatic tax returns or tax due payments are automatically created by setting these fields.-Keywords-Reporting Recurrence, Payment, Tax Return Arrangements, Company Tax, Tax Authority

Title: An Error Happens When Try to Use Price List Item With Scale 'Error during unit conversion from XX into XX'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to enter a Service Item in the Sales Order, but you are facing an error message such as "Error during unit conversion from XX into YY".-XX - represents the Unit of Measure that is being converted.-YY - represents the Unit of Measure that is converted to.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select the New Sales Order common task.-Enter the relevant information on the header level.-Navigate to the Items tab and enter the Product ID.-The system throws an error message.-Error message: Error during unit conversion from XX into YY.-Cause-You have scoped two dimensional scales but the master data was inconsistent for that.-Two dimensional scales are only meant to be for "Material Product". Two dimensional scales is a functionality used when you want to define pricing of a material on the Basis on Basic Unit of measurement such as EA, and the unit which defines weight of that material such as "kg".-There is not physical existence of a service so weight cannot be assigned to a service so 2-D scales cannot be used when service is concerned.-Resolution-You should to de-scoped 2-D scales from your system as you probably did not maintain any 2-D scales for any material or service. -Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Active Scope.-In the Step 4 - Questions, open General Business Data.-Select Sales Price and Discount list, then Sales Price and Discount list.-For Question: "Do you want to maintain prices in two dimensions (i.e. based on UoM and weight)?" needs to be deactivate.-Apply the 2D for the master data of the Product.-Keywords-2D scales, Sales Order, Error

Title: Different Type Codes for Balance Sheet and Income Statement Report
Content: Symptom-You are creating a balance sheet and income statement via Statutory Reports and would like to understand the difference between the following type codes:-Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement-Compare opening balance sheet, changes for income statement-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Statutory Reports view.-Click Balance Sheet and Income Statement.-Click New -> Blank Report Run.-Under Type Code field, you have a few options, out of which you would like more details on Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement and Compare opening balance sheet, changes for income statement.-Resolution-The following are the differences between the mentioned type codes:-Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement: It calculates the balance sheet amount from starting of the year to the mentioned period. The income statement will be calculated for the period mentioned. -Compare opening balance sheet, changes for income statement: It calculates the balance sheet amount from starting of the year to the mentioned period along with the opening balance(closing balance for previous year) for the GL account with the income statement calculated for the period mentioned.-Keywords-Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Type Code, Statutory Report.

Title: Tax item of doc. ABC of type Supplier Invoice, event Domestic Purchase and rate Social and Educational Services not assigned to box - Error in Tax Return Run for Italy
Content: Symptom-You execute a VAT return run for Italy. It fails with the error message 'Tax item of doc. ABC of type Supplier Invoice, event Domestic Purchase and rate Social and Educational Services not assigned to box'.-ABC means the supplier invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Select Run ID AAA (AAA means the VAT Return Run ID).-Open the respective application log.-See the error message in Results tab:-'Tax item of doc. ABC of type Supplier Invoice, event Domestic Purchase and rate Social and Educational Services not assigned to box'-Cause-In supplier invoice ABC a custom tax code is used, which in turn has been assigned to Tax Event 10 - Domestic Purchase. However, the Tax Event 10 is not assigned to Tax Return Type 1 - Summary Register, for Italy.-Resolution-The tax event to be assigned to the custom tax code in this case is 43 - Purchase of Social and Educ. Services from Social Cooperation. Law 208/2015.-Instead of using a custom code here, rather use the standard tax code 77 - Purchase of Social and Educ. Services from Social Cooperation. Law 208/2015, which is already tied to Tax Event 43 and Tax Rate Type 5 -  Social and Educational Services.-Keywords-Vat return run; Italy; Social and Educational Service; tax event 43; tax code 77; tax rate type 5; Summary Register; form box

Title: How to View Material Valuation Data Changes
Content: Symptom-You want to check certain Valuation Data changes of a Material such as a change of the Perpetual Cost Method.-You are trying to view the changes in the Product Master Data changes tab.-However, no Valuation Data change is visible here.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data Work Centre.-Click on Materials.-Show all Materials and search for XXX (XXX represents the Material ID).-Click on the Material ID and then View All.-Navigate to Changes tab.-Result: You cannot find information related to Valuation Data changes.-Cause-This is the current system behaviour. This type of information will only be available in the Maintain Valuation Data tab.-Resolution-In order to check Valuation data changes such as a Perpetual Cost Method change for a Material, please follow the below steps in the system:-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work Centre.-Go to Materials under Master Data View.-Show All Materials and Find XXX.-Select the Material line and click on Maintain Valuation Data.-Click on View Changes.-Result: You will have access to the exhaustive list of all Valuation Data changes such as Perpetual Cost Method changes that occurred for this specific Material.-Keywords

Title: Maintaining Number Ranges for Business Partners
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to maintain the number ranges for Accounts, Suppliers, Contacts, Business Partners. But, in Business Configuration work center, you are unable to find the fine-tuning activity to maintain number ranges with respect to each of these objects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Search for the fine-tuning activity to maintain the number ranges with respect to each of these objects Accounts, Suppliers, Contacts, Business Partners.-Unable to find the same.-Cause-To maintain the number ranges, there is no separate fine-tuning activity with respect to each of the objects like Accounts, Suppliers, Contacts, Business Partners.-Resolution-All types of Business Partners like Accounts, Suppliers, Contacts share the same number ranges.-You can maintain the number ranges for Accounts, Suppliers, Contacts and Business Partners in a single activity.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity General Business Partners-Select Define Number Ranges for Business Partners-Maintain the number ranges as required-Note:-It is not possible to create different number range specific for Accounts, Suppliers, Contacts, Business Partners.-When you create a Business Partner, you may use Internal number ranges if you want the system to automatically assign a number.-When you create a Business Partner, you may use External number ranges if you want to enter the number manually.-Create number ranges with sufficient intervals to avoid future complications.-Ensure that the intervals of internal and external number ranges do not overlap.-Ensure that the ID length specified is not shorter than the length of any IDs that are currently in use in the system.-Changing previously assigned number ranges can lead to problems in the system.-If a Business Partner is already available in system, you would not be able to change the number range interval as there is a Veto check in the backend that identifies that there is already a Business Partner in the system. So, the attempt is to change the interval to new values, where there is at least one number already used from this interval for an already existing Business Partner is not allowed because it would lead to collisions of numbers.-You may extend the End Number in the interval to a higher range. When you adapt the interval boundaries, ensure that they do not overlap with existing Business Partners and of course not with each other.
