This might require some tries because we would not be able to predict which IDs are already in use.-It is not possible to change or swap the number range between Manual and Automatic once the Business Partners are already uploaded.-It is not possible to delete the Master Data (Accounts, Suppliers, Contacts, Business Partners etc.) once they are created in the system.-The Internal number ranges are used automatically by the solution during productive use, for example, if you create the data manually using the regular work center UI.-We recommend that you use the predefined number ranges.-Change the predefined number ranges only if necessary and mind the consequences.-In the Migration Tool, for some objects, you choose whether you want to keep the IDs from the legacy system or whether you want to assign new IDs automatically. If you keep the IDs from the legacy system, make sure the number range defined in Fine-Tuning satisfies the requirements of the IDs. If assigning new IDs automatically, the total number of records must not exceed the number range defined in Fine-Tuning activity.-The External number Range from “A” to “ZZZZZZZZZZ” is not open for edit and cannot be changed. The allowed characters are: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-/:\. This interval allows to maintain alphanumerical IDs for Business Partners, but it must start with a letter. For example: “.A123” is not allowed but "A.123" is allowed.-Account IDs and Contact IDs-While migrating Accounts using the Migration of Customers, in the Convert Values step of the migration tool, you can decide if you want to keep the IDs from your legacy system as Account ID or if the system should automatically assign new Account IDs for all migrated records. The new numbers will be taken from the numeric internal number range.-For the Contact ID, the system automatically assigns new IDs for all migrated contacts. New Contact IDs will be generated based on the number range settings you defined using the General Business Partners activity in the Fine-Tune phase of the activity list. The new numbers will be taken from the numeric Internal number range.-Supplier IDs-While migrating Suppliers using the Migration of Suppliers, in the Convert Values step of the migration tool, you can decide if you want to keep the Supplier IDs from your legacy system or if the system should automatically assign new Supplier IDs for all migrated records. The new numbers will be taken from the numeric Internal number range.-Account IDs, Contact IDs and Supplier IDs-When you create using the webservices where you manually specify the IDs in the Request payload, the numbers will be taken from the External number range. When you create using the webservices where you do not specify the IDs in the Request payload, the numbers will be automatically taken from the Internal number range.-Keywords-Number Range, Account, Contact, Supplier, Business Partner, Internal, External

Title: After Uploading Project Time Recording via Excel, the Time Remains as "In Approval"
Content: Symptom-You are using the Excel Upload for Project Time Recording and notices that when following this approach, the Employee Time Sheet will have the Time for the specific date as “In Approval”, not approved.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This happens because general Employees or Users can use the Excel Upload for their own User, therefore we cannot skip the Approval Process while when someone is doing it via Time Administration Work Center, we know that the Time Administrator has all the rights to approve the records.-Resolution-This is system expected behavior.-Keywords-Excel; Project Time; Recording; Upload; Approval; Employee; Time Sheet

Title: Missing Filter for Different Types of Work Schedules in the Report: Employee Time Profile.
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to filter on different types of work schedules in the Report: Employee Time Profile.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently the filter for different types of work schedules is not enabled for this report. It is possible to achieve the same functionality by creating a customized report (Z-Report).-Resolution-Within a Z-Report, is possible to filter employees with the characteristic "Employee Time Planning Category" to get different types of Work Schedules such as Short-Time Work, Short-Term Planned and Long-Term Planned.-Keywords- Employee Time Profile, not able, unable, missing

Title: How to Reverse a Data Migration Journal Entry Resulting from Manually Created Inventory Data
Content: Symptom-You have created inventory data manually through the Inventory activity available in the Integrate and Extend phase of the Business Configuration activity list. Later on you noticed that you entered wrong data and want to reverse the resulting Journal Entry posted but don't know how to do that.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Manually enter inventory:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project and click Open Activity List.-Move to Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and open the activity Inventory.-Click Manually enter inventory.-Select the Stock Type (e. g. Warehouse Stock).-Enter required General Information and Line Items information.-Click Save.-This action generates a Confirmation ID XX, which is the Initial Balance Setting Confirmation XX.-Checking the related Journal Entry posted:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Go to Journal Entries subview.-Use the Advanced Search and search for Journal Entry Type: Data Migration, Related Source Document Type: Goods and Activity Confirmation and Related Source Document ID: the Confirmation ID XX generated previously.-You'll find the Data Migration Journal Entry.-Resolution-Since you have manually created inventory data, an Initial Balance Setting Confirmation document was created. This source document belongs to source document type Goods and Activity Confirmation. As per system standards, you need to reverse the source document in order to reverse the resulting journal entry.-To achieve that you should execute the common task Display / Reverse Goods And Activity Confirmation available on Internal Logistics work center:-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Common Tasks > Display / Reverse Goods And Activity Confirmation.-Show All Goods And Activity Confirmations.-Select Confirmation ID XX (notice the Reversal Status: Not Canceled).-Click Reverse Confirmation.-Your Confirmation ID XX has been reversed. Notice that Reversal Status has changed to Canceled.-Open Confirmation ID XX and take note of Reversal Confirmation ID YY.-To check the Reversal Journal Entry, simply go back to the Journal Entries subview of General Ledger work center and search for Journal Entry Type: Reversal of Data Migration and Related Source Document ID: the Reversal Confirmation ID YY just created.-As a result you have reversed the Confirmation ID XX and its resulting journal entry posted.-Keywords-Reverse Goods And Activity Confirmations. Data Migration. Inventory.

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Differs Between The Existing Set of Books
Content: Symptom-There's a company with two or more set of books.-After posting an acquisition for a fixed asset it's noticed that the calculated depreciation is different for the same period, between the different set of books.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Find the relevant asset.-Click Edit - Values.-Highlight the first set of books and check the Depreciation Overview tab for a specific fiscal period and fiscal year.-Highlight the second set of books and check the Depreciation Overview tab for the same fiscal year and period.-Notice that the depreciation amounts are different, even though all relevant dates and depreciation method are the same for both set of books.-Cause-The sets of books have different fiscal year variants, hence the acquisition posting gets accounted in different periods.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. The assigned fiscal year variant can be seen as follows:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Sets of Books and Assigned Companies.-Find the relevant company and set of books.-Refer to the Fiscal Year Variant field.- The journal entry of the corresponding acquisition posting for each set of books can be opened to check in what accounting period this entry has been accounted. This can be seen at the top of the screen of the journal entry. Note that apart from that, the asset depreciation may start at a different date or period depending on the period control method.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Period Control Methods and Keys-KBA 2265232 - Different Fixed Assets Amount Being Posted to Each Set of Books-Keywords-Depreciation, Fixed Asset, Depreciation Code, Acquisition, Supplier Invoice, Goods Receipt, Procurement.

Title: Legal Changes for Tax Return Type VAT Return are Effective as of MM-DD-YYYY. Adjust the Reporting Period
Content: Symptom-You create a tax return run for a specific period and year in the work center Tax Management. But the completion of the run fails and therefore the creation of the relevant VAT return is not possible. The system throws the following error message:-Legal changes for tax return type VAT Return are effective as of MM-DD-YYYY. Adjust the reporting period accordingly.-However, tax law has not been changed at the relevant date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the New Tax Return Run subview.-Enter a Run Description and relevant variables like Tax Return Arrangement ID, Period and Year.-Maintain first day of the maintained period as From date and last day of the period as To date.-As soon as the mentioned dates are entered the following error message occurs: Legal changes for tax return type VAT Return are effective as of MM-DD-YYYY. Adjust the reporting period accordingly. The date MM-DD-YYYY is included in the maintained time frame.-Cause-At least one tax event has been changed for the mentioned date and a dependent tax type has a Valid From date MM-DD-YYYY.  This is visible in the business configuration activity Tax Returns for Goods and Services for the relevant country under link Product Tax Return - XXX and tab Tax Event (XXX represents the relevant country name).-Resolution-To solve the issue, create two tax return runs for the specific period and year.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the New Tax Return Run subview.-Enter Run Description and relevant variables like Tax Return Arrangement ID, Period and Year.-Maintain first date of the period as From date and the day before MM-DD-YYYY as To date.-Select Save and Close-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Go to the New Tax Return Run subview.-Enter Run Description and relevant variables like Tax Return Arrangement ID, Period and Year.-Maintain MM-DD-YYYY as From date and the last day of the period as To date.-Select Save and Close-You are now able to activate and execute the tax return runs for the specific period and year without getting any error message.-Keywords-VAT return run; legal changes; tax return type; reporting period

Title: 'Cost of type Inventory Cost must be valid from first day of period' Error in Migration of Material Valuation Data
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Material Valuation Data but it fails due to the error message: 'Cost of type Inventory Cost must be valid from first day of period'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and open the Migration of Material Valuation Data activity.-Select Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool link.-Highlight the file and select Execute Migration ﻿button.-Error comes up in step 3 - Simulate Import.-Cause-You are trying to migrate Inventory Cost and for which the validity you chose is not from the first day of the accounting period.-Resolution-The following restrictions apply for manual creation as well as data migration:-Restriction for Inventory Cost cost type is that the Valid From date must be the first day of an accounting period.-Restriction for Book Value cost type is that the Valid From date must be the first day of an accounting period.-Restriction for Estimated Cost cost & Planned cost type is that the Valid From date can be any date after the first day of an accounting period.-Keywords- inventory cost; first day; material valuation data; migration-inventory cost,first day,material valuation data,migration

Title: Error: Entry In Mandatory Field Bank Charges Paid By For International Bank Transfer Missing
Content: Symptom-When processing the payment, you receive the error message: Entry in mandatory field Bank Charges Paid By for International bank transfer missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the Supplier accounts view.-Search for the supplier account and open it.-Go to the Trade Payables tab and then to the Invoice / Payments sub-tab.-Select the Invoice.-Click Pay Manually By and select Outgoing Bank transfer or Other Payment method.-Or-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the Automatic Payments view.-Search for the payment and open it.-Click on View All.-Click on Action and select Determine Payment Details.-Here you get the error message: Entry in mandatory field Bank Charges Paid By for International bank transfer missing.-Cause-You have not maintained a value in the field Bank Charges Paid By in  the supplier master data. This field is mandatory if you are processing the international bank transfer.-If you are processing domestic bank transfers, the system gives you an error due to fact that in the business configuration, you have maintained a higher priority for the international bank transfer over domestic bank transfer. For the bank account, international bank transfer is also an allowed payment procedure. The system will check all payment procedures and all payment formats maintained for the bank account and then tries to find the best suitable option. Hence when this check is executed, it failed to determine the value of field Bank Charges Paid By.-Resolution-If you intend to create international Bank transfer, You need to maintain "Bank Charges Paid By" in the supplier master data.-Go to the Payables Work center.-Select the Suppliers view.-Search for the Supplier.-Select the row.-Click Edit and select Financial Data / Payment Data.-Under the Instructions to the Bank for International Payments, maintain the value in the field Bank Charges Paid By.-If you intend to create domestic bank transfer, you need to change the priority of the payment methods in the business configuration.-Go to the Business configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select the project and click on Open Activity.-Go to Fine Tune tab.-Search for the Global Settings for Payment activity.-Click on Prioritize payment methods.-Maintain higher priority for the Domestic Bank Transfer then International Bank Transfer.-Click on Save.-Keywords

Title: Error Message "Action Not Possible; Transfer Records Exist For Selected Work Agreement" When Changing the Termination Date of An Employee
Content: Symptom-You want to change an employee's Termination Date from a future date to an earlier one, but system throws error message "Action not possible; transfer records exists for selected work agreement."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Find and select the relevant employee.-Click Edit.-In the new screen, navigate to the Employment tab.-Under Work Agreement, click the button Change Termination Date.-In the prompt, set a value for New Termination Date.-Click Ok.-Review changes and click Save.-Cause-This happens because the employee has been transferred at least once during their employment.-Once a transfer record exists for the employee, it's no longer possible to change the Termination Date to an earlier date using the Change Termination Date button in the Employment tab.-Resolution-For setting an earlier Termination Date, please use the following option:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Regular Tasks work center view.-Select the Terminate Relationship with Employee option.-Add the respective employee ID in the Employee field.-Set new Termination Date under the Termination Data section.-Keywords-Action Not Possible, Transfer Records Exist for Selected Work Agreement, Employee, Personnel Administration, Termination Date

Title: Different Billable Hours Selected even with the Same Amount of Hours
Content: Symptom- When approving an employee's time recording, the "Different Billable Hours" checkbox is checked, even though the amount of billable hours recorded is the same of the actual time recording.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management -> Approvals.-From the dropdown list, select All Time Recordings.-Select a time recording from an employee.-You can see that the Different Billable Hours checkbox is checked.-Cause-During the time recording in the employee self-service, the Billable Hours field was changed. This causes the checkbox to be checked, even if the amount of billable hours entered is the same.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-TLM, Project recording, time sheet

Title: Italy Spesometro - New Natura Codes effective 1st January 2021
Content: Symptom-You have submitted an erroneous Italy Spesometro tax return file to the tax authority as the Natura codes in the file are incorrect and the file has been rejected by the tax authority.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create supplier invoices, customer invoices and other relevant documents pertaining to your business needs.-Execute a tax return run for Italy Spesometro outgoing or incoming scenario.-Release the tax return and generate a file.-Check the Natura codes populated in the tax return file for the documents included in the file.-Cause-The Natura codes in the file are erroneous. The tax agency will not accept files with old Natura codes for documents with document date on or after Jan. 1st 2021.-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign does not support the coexistence of old and new Natura codes in the Spesometro tax return file. This may pose some issues for the files created out of the system from January 2021. SAP Business ByDesign will start generating only the new Natura codes in the files effective 18.01.2021 in SAP Business ByDesign FP2011. Until 17.01.2021, the system will generate files with only the old Natura codes.-According to the tax agency, the checking tool will check Natura codes based on the document date of each document included in the Spesometro file:-If the document date of the document is before 01.10.2020, then only the old Natura codes are accepted.-If the document date of the document is between 01.10.2020 and 31.12.2020 (both included), then both old and new Natura codes are accepted.-If the document date of the document is on or after 01.01.2021, then only the new Natura codes are accepted.-All documents with a document date in 2020 that are posted in 2021 (late submission cases) and reported via Spesometro tax returns on or after 18.01.2021 will be considered exceptions and you need to manually correct the Natura codes in the tax return file directly. SAP cannot provide any massdata or automatic solution for late reported data to the tax authority.-Considering the above cases and system behaviour, and to minimize any inconveniences, we strongly recommend to prepare for and generate Spesometro declarations on a monthly basis, in a timely manner, for October 2020 to December 2020 (both included). The Spesometro files with data posted for documents having a document date in 2021 can be managed (not necessarily) on a quarterly basis.-In short, the recommended timelines for submission of Spesometro files to the tax authority is as follows :-Spesometro data earlier than October 2020, documents having document date before 01.10.2020-  with old Natura codes-  Due date:  30.10.2020-  to be submitted to the tax authority by 31.12.2020 latest-Spesometro October 2020 data, documents having document date between 01.10.2020 and 31.10.2020 (both included)-   with old Natura codes-   Due date: 30.11.2020-  to be submitted to the tax authority by 31.12.2020 latest-Spesometro November 2020 data, documents having document date between 01.11.2020 and 30.11.2020 (both included)-   with old Natura codes-  Due date:  31.12.2020-  to be submitted to the tax authority by 31.12.2020 latest-Spesometro December 2020 data, documents having document date between 01.12.2020 and 31.12.2020 (both included)-   with new Natura codes-   Due date: 30.01.2021-

Title: Cash Discount is Not Automatically Applied on the Automatic Payment Created by Payment Run
Content: Symptom-You execute a payment run of Receivables. On one of the payment proposals, the cash discount of the open items are not calculated automatically even though Payment Term, for example, 10 days 2% cash discount, 20 days net (which means the buyer must pay within 20 days but receives 2% discount if he pays within 10 days from the invoice date), is assigned to these open invoices. You are sure that the payment date for this payment proposal is within 10 days from at least some invoice dates.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Show All Payment Proposals.-Select the Payment ID XYZ (XYZ is the payment ID), and choose Edit.-Under the General tab, you can see the Cash Discount is zero.-Check the Payment Date, and you can see it's within 10 days from the invoice dates of some invoices in the Open Items list.-Cause-The issue lies on Customer Invoicing side.-On the item level of the customer invoice, there is a check box option called Cash Discount. If Cash Discount is checked, a discount is allowed for the item. If it is not checked, no discount is allowed on the item.--Therefore if the check box on the item level is not checked, no possible cash discount will be considered even if the payment terms conditions suggest a potential discount if the invoice is paid within the timeframe defined in the payment terms.-  Resolution-To have the possible discount from the payment terms conditions to be visible as Cash Discount on the payment proposal, the check box Cash Discount on the item level in the customer invoice needs to be flagged.-As it is not possible to alter an already posted customer invoice, you have to cancel the existing invoice and create a new one with the check box flagged. If the invoice refers to a purchase order, canceling the invoice will make the purchase order available to be invoice again in the Item to Be Invoiced view within the Customer Invoicing work center.-  Keywords-customer invoice, payment allocation, payment terms, cash discount

Title: How to generate 1099-NEC Tax Return file for Country US?
Content: Symptom-You want to generate 1099-NEC Tax Return file for the suppliers whose Withholding Tax Income Type is 7 - Nonemployee Compensation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-With SAP ByDesign 2011 SPS02 release, you must generate the separate Tax Return - 1099-NEC by creating a new Tax Return Arrangement.-Go to Tax Management work centre.-Click on Tax Authority view. -Search for the Tax Authority. -Go to Company Tax Arrangements tab. -Go to Tax Return Arrangements tab.-Click on Add Row.-Enter the Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Select the Tax Return Type = 8 - Non Employee Compensation 1099-NEC.-Select the Person Responsible. -Fill the other data based on your business requirement. -Click on Save. -Now, you have to create a new Withholding Tax Return Run using below steps:-Go to Tax Management work centre.-Click on Withholding Tax Return Runs. -Click on New and Tax Return Run.-Select the Tax Return Arrangement ID (Created based on above steps).-Enter From/To Date. -Click on Set to Active. -Click on Schedule and Start Immediately. -Click on Save and Close. -The Withholding Tax Return - 1099-NEC will be generated.-Note: Until the last release of SAP ByDesign(2011 SPS01), the system was generating single form of 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC with single Tax Return Type - Miscellaneous Income (1099 Misc).-Keywords-How to generate 1099-NEC, 1099 NEC, 1099-MISC

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error When Uploading Files In Mass Data Maintenance - Internal Use
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer is trying to upload a file in Mass Data Maintenance, but the upload fails with the message 500 SAP Internal Server Error.-In backend transaction ST22, a technical exception is observed with the following short text: Exception condition "FORMAT_OF_FILE_FAILED" raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the link Import ABC (where ABC is the relevant business object for this operation).-Upload the relevant CSV file.-Error occurs.-Cause-Special characters like comma, question mark, period etc. may have been used in the upload file.-As the system identifies some of these characters in a file of CSV (comma-separated values) format as separators, this might cause the file to "break" into a wrong format, which leads to the technical exception mentioned previously.-Resolution-Review the CSV file for values in incorrect formatting and instruct customer to correct them for a successful upload.-See Also-2204393 - Common Issues With CSV Files in Data Workbench and Mass Data Maintenance-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, FORMAT_OF_FILE_FAILED

Title: Cost Centers - Plan/Actual Report: Plan Amount is Empty
Content: Symptom-When executing the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual report the Plan key figure column is showing empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Click Cost Centers - Plan/Actual.-Select relevant company.-Click Apply.-The Plan Key Figure column is showing empty.-Cause-The Cost Center was not maintained on the Planning:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Planning view.-Find Planning for Company for the relevant Year.-Click Edit.-Go to the Plan Data tab.-Click the engine button.-Click Analyze Data.-On the Report go to the View tab.-Click Plus on Row Fields.-Select Cost Center.-Click Ok.-There is no Cost Center assignment, the column is showing with a # symbol.-Resolution-This can be corrected by creating a new Planning with the relevant information.-Keywords-Cost Centers; Plan/Actual; Plan; Planning; Cost Centers - Plan/Actual; Cost and Revenue-cost centers,plan/actual,planning,plan,cost centers - plan/actual,cost and revenue

Title: Entry In Mandatory Field Bank Charges Paid By For International Bank Transfer Missing
Content: Symptom-When processing the payment, you receive the error message: Entry in mandatory field Bank Charges Paid By for International bank transfer missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the Automatic Payments view.-Search for the payment and open it.-Click on View All.-Click on Action and select Determine Payment Details.-Here you get the error message Entry in mandatory field Bank Charges Paid By for International bank transfer missing.-This payment is for expense reports and there is no option found to maintian Bank Charges Paid By in the bank details of the employee master data.-Cause-Although the employee expense expense reimbursement and the transactions of the Bank are in same country - still Bank Charges are proposed to be maintained and that too for payment method International Bank Transfer.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and navigate to Fine Tuning.-Choose the activity Global Settings for Payment.-Under Payment Method Priorities, Click on Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods.-The prioritized payment method in sequence is SEPA Credit Transfer and International bank transfer. IBAN and SWIFT/BIC code are mandatory for SEPA payments.-For the Employee ABC (ABC is the employee ID) there is no Swift Code maintained in their respective Bank Directory DEF (DEF is the Bank Directory ID).-Consequently the system cannot choose a SEPA payment here and that is the reason it is proposing the International Bank Transfer.-Resolution-It is advised to maintain SWIFT/BIC in the employee's respective bank directory to resolve this issue.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Directory view and Click on the Bank Directory ID.-In the General Tab maintain SWIFT/BIC and save it.-You may void proposal of your payment which is still with in-preparation status and try to create a new automatic payment after the said setting is maintained.-Keywords

Title: Technical Error Occurred During Posting of Organizational Center Changes for Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the cost center CCA (CCA stands for the current cost center in system) to cost center CCB (CCB stands for the new cost center) for the fixed asset AAA (AAA stands for the fixed asset ID).-You get the following error message:-"Technical error occurred during posting of organizational center changes for fixed asset AAA; report an incident."-"Save failed."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for Fixed Asset AAA and select it.-Click on Edit Master Data.-Navigate to the Basic Data subtab.-Under All Assignment intervals click on the Add Row button.-Under Details Assignment Interval, enter Start Date as DD.MM.YYYY and Cost Center as CCB.-Click Save.-You get the following error message:-"Technical error occurred during posting of organizational center changes for fixed asset AAA; report an incident."-"Save failed."-Resolution-You can solve this by performing a dummy save as follows:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for Fixed Asset AAA and select it.-Click on Edit Master Data.-Navigate to the Basic Data subtab.-Under All Assignment intervals click on the Add Row button.-Enter any date.-Delete the newly entered row.-The previous cost center assignment is set again to unlimited validity.-Click the Save button.-Again click the Add Row button.-Fill in the new organisation assignment details (Date as DD.MM.YYYY and cost center as CCB).-Click the Save button.-The cost center is now CCB with unlimited validity starting date DD.MM.YYYY.-if the issue persists, kindly open an incident with permission to perform the same changes from the frontend and backend.-Keywords-Fixed asset; Anlage; Kostenstelle; Cost center

Title: How to Set Up Approval Process for Payments
Content: Symptom-You wish to set up an approval process for payments based on a given threshold and user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-You can define threshold amounts for payment approvals depending on company, payment method, and user. No task will be created if the amount of the outgoing/incoming payment is below the specified threshold.--You can define this threshold for both incoming and outgoing payments following below steps.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Business Task Management for Payment and Liquidity Management activity.-Click either on Payment approvals for outgoing payments or Payment approvals for incoming payments.-On the screen that opens, you can set up the rules to trigger the approval task. If you want the approval process to be executed when a specific user initiates the payment, enter the name of the user in the User ID column.-After maintaining a threshold amount to trigger the approval process, you can define who is the approver, based on work distribution, as follows.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the  Employee Work Distribution view.-In the Finance and Administration business area, define the approvers within Approver for Liquidity Management.-The approval task is then sent to all approvers that you've maintained. If the task is completed by one of them, the payment gets approved. If there is no approver maintained, the task is sent to all authorized managers.- Note that although there is an approval process set, the scenario may vary depending upon your user's access rights.- In case there is no approver defined under the employee work distribution for liquidity management and:-You do not have access to the approvals view - MMA_CASHLIQUIDITYMANAGEMENT - in Managing My Area, the payment, if above the threshold, goes to approval.-You have access to MMA_CASHLIQUIDITYMANAGEMENT, the payment is posted with no approval task triggered. -In case there is an approver defined under the employee work distribution for liquidity management:-The approval task is triggered to the approver regardless of your access rights.-Note that the above setup concerns tasks of type 'Approve Manual Payment <payment ID> - <business partner ID> - <amount>'. Payment approval tasks can also be of type 'Approve Supplier Payment <payment ID> - <company ID> - <suplier ID> - <amount>' and 'Approve Customer Payment <payment ID> - <company ID> - <suplier ID> - <amount>'.-For the Approve Supplier Payment type, MMA_PAYABLES access right is required and the approver is defined under employee work distribution as Approver for Payables.-For the Approve Customer Payment type, MMA_RECEIVABLES access right is required and the approver is defined under employee work distribution as Approver for Receivables.-Keywords-Approval process. Employee work Distribution. Liquidity Management. Threshold. Bank transfer. Check.

Title: Unable to Delete Note In Supplier Master Data
Content: Symptom-You want to delete notes from a supplier's record, but find no way to achieve this.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Access the Suppliers work center view.-Find and open the relevant supplier.-Click the ID link to open the supplier.-In the supplier screen, click the View All button.-Navigate to the Notes tab.-Even in Edit mode, there is no button to delete or changing the content of existing notes.-Cause-Notes in the supplier master data can only be deleted by the user who created them.-Resolution-Ask the user responsible for the note creation to access the supplier record so they can delete and/or edit them as required.-Keywords-Delete, Edit, Note, Supplier

Title: Cannot Select G/L Account for Other Liabilities Account Determination - XXX is not a Valid Value for This Field
Content: Symptom-You experience the error message 'XXX is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value' when configuring Account Determination of Other Liabilities (XXX is the G/L Account ID).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity, either via the activity list of the Implementation project or via Overview.-Under Account Determination choose the General Ledger link. -Go to the Others tab.-Select 4 - Other Liabilities.-Press Add Row.-Add the respective Account Determination Group. -Select G/L Account XXX in Other Liabilities.-The error  'XXX is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value' appears.-Cause-The G/L Account Type of G/L Account XXX is not OLIAB- Other Liabilities.-Resolution-Either change the G/L Account Type of G/L Account XXX to Other Liabilities or use another G/L Account of type OLIAB-Other Liabilities.-Keywords-G/L Account is not a valid value for this field, Account Determination, Other Liabilities-is not a valid value for this field,account determination,other liabilities

Title: Task Description Field Shows # - Not Assigned in Project Plan Values Report
Content: Symptom-The characteristic Task Description shows value "#" (Not assigned) in the Project Plan Values report, while the expectation is that it shows the Description maintained for the project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open report Project Plan Values.-Enter required data, such as Project ABC (ABC means the Project ID).-Add the characteristic Task Description to the report.-Notice that for Project Task ID ABC-X (ABC-X means the Project Task ID) Task Description field shows value "#" (which means not assigned).-The expectation is that the report would show the Description maintained for the respective project, which can be seen by opening Project ABC from Project Management work center > Projects view > Project Plan tab.-Cause-The Task Description field is binded to the Description field in a Project Expense Item.-It means that Task Description will be populated in the report only when there's an Expense Item assigned to the respective Project Task ABC-X, and for such Expense Item, a Description has been maintained.-This can be seen as follows:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Open Project ID ABC.-In Project Plan tab > Gantt Chart sub-tab, select Project Task ID ABC-X.-Select the Expenses tab.-If there's an expense item maintained along with a description, such Description will be fetched by the Project Plan Values report.-Resolution-System behaves as designed.-Keywords-project plan values; FINCACU03_Q0001; task description; TASK_DESCRIPTION; expense item

Title: Is There a Way to Suppress the Customer Invoice Created for a Zero Price Service Order/Sales order
Content: Symptom-You want to suppress the creation of Customer Invoice for a zero price Service Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-Search for the invoice request XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice request).-Select the invoice request XYZ and choose Edit button.-At Item level the net value of the invoice is zero.-You want to suppress the creation of Customer Invoice where the price/net value is zero.-Cause-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-It is not possible to suppress the creation of Customer Invoice created for a zero price Service Order/Sales order

Title: Error Message: For Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung the Tax Number is Expected
Content: Symptom-You cannot select tax return type Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung in the Company Tax Arrangement of Tax Authority, Tax Country Germany.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements subview in the Tax Authorities view.-Search and select Tax Authority ABC (ABC is the tax authority ID), Company DEF (DEF is the company ID) and Tax Country Germany.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Tax Numbers subtab.-User has maintained the Tax Number Type 1 - VAT Registration Number.-Navigate to the Tax Return Arrangements subtab.-Enter Tax Return Arrangement ID and select Tax Return Type 1 - Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung.-Click Save.-You get the following error messages:-" Save failed.-For Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung the Tax Number is expected."-Cause-You have not maintained a Tax Number.-Resolution-You have to maintain a Tax Number for the Tax Authority:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements subview in the Tax Authorities view.-Search and select Tax Authority ABC, Company DEF and Tax Country Germany.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Tax Numbers subtab.-Click Add Row.-Select the Tax Number Type 5 - Tax Number.-Enter the tax number.-Click Save.-Navigate to the Tax Return Arrangements subtab.-Click Add Row.-Enter Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Select Tax Return Type as 1 - Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung.-Click Save.-Keywords- Tax Number, Steuernummer, Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung

Title: Error While Posting a Manual Clearing: 'Clearing amount must not be zero'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Manual Clearing and system raises the error message 'Clearing amount must not be zero'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Open the Customer Account ID.-Open the relevant Clearing ID.-Press View All.-The Clearing Status is Proposed and the mentioned error message is raised.-Cause-This error usually happens when one of the documents being cleared has an Applied Net Amount 0,00 which is not allowed.-Case 1: The Amount was maintained manually as zero.-Case 2: System is not able to calculate the Applied Net Amount because there is no Exchange Rate between the Currency of the Document ID YYY and the Currency of the Clearing.-YYY - Document ID.-Resolution-Case 1: In case the Amount was entered manually as 0,00, it is required to maintain an Applied Net Amount different than 0,00 (zero).-Case 2: If the system cannot complete the calculation due to missing Exchange Rate, you need to maintain a valid Exchange Rate in General Ledger -> Edit Exchange Rate.-Keywords-Manual Clearing, Invoice, Payment, Document, Net Applied Amount.

Title: Planned Revenue or Planned Cost From Project Not Showing in Project Planning Reports
Content: Symptom-When executing project planning reports, such as the Project Variance by Project report the Planned Revenue and Planned Cost are not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Click Project Variance by Project Report (for example).-Select relevant company.-Select relevant project.-Go to View.-Add Planned Cost and Planned Revenue Key Figures.-Click Apply.-Both Key Figures show no amount.-Cause-There are errors in the Project Plan Values. It can be checked as follows:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Find relevant project. You notice that the Error Status is red.-Click View Plan Values.-Select the Project Task ID that has red marker on Error Status.-Go to the Messages tab.-Resolution-Correct all errors existing in the Plan Values and click Valuate again.-Once the Error status of the Project and all its project tasks is green, the Planned Revenue / Cost amounts will appear correctly on the reports.-Keywords-Planned Revenue, Planned Cost, Project, Reports, Project Variance by Project-project,project variance by project,reports,planned revenue,planned cost

Title: Request Logon Certificate Button not available
Content: Symptom-You have noticed the Request Logon Certifiate button is not available in the My settings page.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click on the User Icon (Right top corner of the screen).-Click My Settings and go to Manage Certificates.-Request Logon Certificate button is not available.-Cause-The Request Logon Certificate is now disabled since SAP will not able to provide the certificate for user logon due to browser restrictions.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour from SAP Business ByDesign.-However, you can go to any trusted external CA and get that certificate to use the same to enable the certificate based authentication for an user.-Keywords-Logon Certificate

Title: Error: "Payment Method is Not Allowed" When Creates The Order Via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are using ManageSalesOrderIn web service to create a Sales Order, but you are getting an error message which says "Payment method is not allowed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You send your request via Soap UI or any other system using <ExternalPayment> tag, and you get the following error:-Payment method is not allowed.-Net volume for product missing.-Net weight for product missing.-Cause-The error will be raised if the Sales Order creation is not of type "Internet".-Resolution-It is standard behavior. You need to create the document manually via Business ByDeisgn system to not face the errors.-Keywords-Payment, Sales Order, Web Services, SOAP.

Title: Error While Maintaining SEPA Mandates in Account Master Data - No SEPA creditor ID specified for company
Content: Symptom-You cannot save the SEPA Mandates changes in Account Master Data due to the error message 'No SEPA creditor ID specified for company'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select the relevant Account ID.-Click Edit -> Financial Data.-Go to the Payment Data sub-tab.-Under SEPA Mandates section, click New/Edit.-In the new window, maintain the relevant information.-Press Save and Close to go back to Account view.-Click Save.-The error message 'No SEPA creditor ID specified for company' appears.-Cause-The SEPA Creditor ID is not maintained for the involved Company in Organizational Structure.-Resolution-You can maintain the SEPA Creditor ID using the steps below:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structure view.-Select the relevant Org Unit ID.-Press Edit.-Click External Business Identifiers, in General sub-tab.-A new window will pop up where the SEPA Creditor ID field is available to be maintained.-Click Save.-Press Activate -> Activate Selected Structure.-Keywords-SEPA, Creditor ID, Account, Org Structure

Title: On Expense Report The Unit Showing for Expense Category Private Car Expenses is Miles While Expected is Kilometers
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-The Unit is incorrectly showing when customer creates an Expense Report using the Expense Type for Expense Category Private car expenses.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Click New - Expense Report On Behalf.-Select relevant Employee.-Select Type of Expense Out-of-pocket.-Add Purpose.-Click Next.-Click Add Row.-Select any Expense Type relevant for Expense Category Private car expenses that shows a distance unit (miles or kilometers).-Under Other Details, the Number is showing as Miles, while customer expected Kilometers.-Cause-This is set on backend table ERMC_EXP_GRP_P field BASE_UNIT_DESCR and it may happen, that the distance unit is not as expected by the customer.-KMT (Km - Kilometers) is usually the Unit for all Countries except for GB01 and US01.-This can be checked in the backend on Transaction SE16.-Resolution-In case this is not as customer expected, meaning it shows Miles instead of Kilometers or vice versa, you can forward this to be further analyzed by Development if this can be adjusted.-Component SRD-FIN-ERM.-Keywords- Expense Report, Unit, Private car expenses, mileage, miles, kilometers, km, mi, Expense Type-expense report,unit,private car expenses,mileage,miles,kilometers,km,mi,expense type

Title: Unable to Locate Materials In The Mass Data Maintenance Value Help Search
Content: Symptom-When using the Mass Data Maintenance functionality, there are a few Material/Product IDs which do not show any data in the Export option, despite being certainly present in the system under the product-related work centers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the link to Export Materials-In the new screen, open the Material ID field's value help.-Search for the relevant material-No results found, even though the material is present in the Material view under the Product Data work center.-Cause-The value help has a max row count of 200. If the record is not present in the list of 200 values, then it will not show in the value help search. The same behavior is true for other fields in the Mass Data Maintenance functionality.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-You can manually search for the material by providing its ID directly in the field.-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the link to Export Materials.-Enter the required ID in the Material ID field (not in the value help).-Click the Go button.-The requried material is successfully fetched.-Keywords-Material, Not Found, Value Help, Mass Data Maintenance-material,not found,value help,mass data maintenance

Title: Sender AAA has already been fully credited using another distribution rule
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create New Distribution Rule for Cost Centers but you get the error:-'Sender AAA has already been fully credited using another distribution rule'-AAA means the sender Cost Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Open the Distribution Rules view.-Click New > Distribution Rule for Cost Centers.-In step 1 Enter Basic Data, fill the Sender Cost Center, Set of Books and 100% of Percentage to Distribute.-Click Next.-Error message is displayed: Sender AAA has already been fully credited using another distribution rule-Cause-When the Sender Cost Center is included in another distribution rule and the 100% Percentage of Distribute is reached, either by the existing distribution rule alone or by the sum of the existing one plus the one being created, system will throw the error message as the total cannot exceed 100%.-Resolution-Crosscheck the previous distribution rules and adjust the Percentage to Distribute to less than 100%, so that the remaining percentage up to a total of 100% can be used in the new distribution rule.-Keywords-sender cost center; Distribution Rule; percentage to distribute-sender cost center,percentage to distribute,sender has already been fully credited,distribution rule

Title: Assign Logon Certificate
Content: Symptom-This document will explain the steps required to install certificates for Certificate based Authentication-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The steps to assign the certificate are the following:-Install the certificate which has been received from your trusted provider on your PC.-After installing the certificate, it will appears under Personal certificates in your browser.-Now, login with that user and assign the Root certificate of log on certificate in "Edit Certificate Trust List" by navigating to Administrator--> Common Tasks.-Now,navigate to My Settings > Manage Certificates > Assign Logon Certificate.-Click on Assign Certificate and Continue.-Logoff from your tenant and close the browser.-Open the browser again and enter the tenant URL.-You will be logged via the certificate based authentication.-Keywords-certificate based authentication, assign logon certificate

Title: Posting Date Invalid Due to Closed Accounting Period; Contact Accounting
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a document (like a Bank statement, Bill of Exchange, new Charge Credit etc..) and you get the error message 'Posting date invalid due to closed accounting period; contact Accounting'  even though the Period is open.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The issue could happen while posting any document, bank statements are used as example here:-Go to the Liquidity Management work centre.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Search for Bank Statement ABC (ABC represents the bank statement ID) and select it.-Click the Statement ID ABC to open it and then View All.-The Bank statement is in Status In Preparation and the Consistency Status is Inconsistent.-The Statement date is DD.MM.YYYY.-The Bank Statement is for Company LMN (LMN represents the Company ID).-There is an error message: Posting date invalid due to closed accounting period; contact Accounting.-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Open and Close Periods subview in the Common Tasks view.-Check for Period MM for Year YYYY for Company LMN.-The Period is opened for Operational Postings and there is no Process Control block.-Cause-You are getting this error message because for this company you have already posted the Balance Carry Forward.-According to the Help Document Closing Fiscal Year: When balance carryforward is performed in the second step, the fiscal year is automatically locked against posting.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies subview in the Master Data view.-Search and select Company LMN.-Select Set of Books ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Set of Books for the Company LMN).-Click the Edit Fiscal Years button.-Under General for the year YYY, the Fiscal Year Status is Not Blocked but Carry Forward and Result has been marked as posted.-The First Day Of Fiscal Year and the Last Day Of Fiscal Year has been maintained.-Resolution-If you want to post the document, you have to reverse the Balance Carry Forward Run with step two and make sure that the concerned accounting period allows posting.-See Also-Refer to help document Closing Fiscal Years for more details.-Keywords-balance carryforward, balance carry forward, posting date invalid, closed accounting period, contact accounting

Title: Missing Account Determination for Cash Ledger When Posting a Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a bank statement, however the system is not able to determine the proper G/L Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Liquidity Management  work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Either create a new bank statement or open an existing one.-Fill out the required information and press Post.-The error message 'Account determination is missing for cash. Define the account for chart of accounts <Chart of Accounts>, tab <subledger tab> field <tab column>. Enter a general ledger account for the account determination group <account determination group> and currency'.-Cause-You are missing a balance sheet account for the account determination of cash disbursements or cash receipts related to the payment method concerned in the bank statement transactions.-Resolution-On the bank statement there is an item, which states that either money was received or money was sent from the bank account. These are the cash receipts or the cash disbursements. Once a bank statement is posted, posting occurs so that the balance sheet account for cash disbursements or cash receipts serves as an offsetting to a bank balance account. The debit/credit side collects all types of cash disbursements/receipts that were either issued from or received to any bank balance account. Therefore, a proper account determination has to be done as per underneath steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination section, open the Cash sub-ledger.-Refer to the error message and check whether the error concern the cash receipt or the cash disbursement tab.-Analyze the transactions on your bank statement and compare with the setup in the cash account determination. The G/L accounts are determined depending upon the Account Determination Group, Payment Method and Currency.-Maintain the G/L Account for the missing payment method.-Note:If the payment method in the bank statement is Other Outgoing Payment, for Cash Disbursements, or Other Incoming Payment, for Cash Receipts, in this case, the exact payment method is not available in the bank statement.however it is known that the money is received or sent. Considering this, you still have to post the transaction to accounting and hence it is necessary to maintain an account determination entry without a payment method, so that the posting to the G/L Accounts can happen.-Keywords-Account determination is missing for cash; post bank statement

Title: Error Message: VAT ID for ABC missing in document XYZ of type Payment
Content: Symptom-You get the error message VAT ID for ABC (where ABC is the corporate account) missing in document XYZ (where XYZ is the type of the document) of type Payment while creating an EC Sales List Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the EC Sales List Runs subview.-Perform the action New to create a new Run.-Enter the relevant information and Save and Close. This will take you back to the EC Sales List Runs screen.-Select the Run and perform the action Schedule.-You get the error message: 'VAT ID for ABC missing in document XYZ of type Payment'.-Cause-You have not maintained the VAT Registration Number for the Corporate Account ABC.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select the corporate account ABC.-Press Edit Financial Data and navigate to the tab Tax Data.-Here you have to maintain a valid VAT Registration Number.-Perform the EC Sales List Run again.-Note - If the Open Items receivables from where the tax is going to be collected are migrated open items, there is no possibility to Edit those open items. If you want to change these items, the only way forward is to reverse the documents and migrate them again.-Keywords-VAT ID; Sales list run; VAT registration number

Title: How to Check the Product Upgrade Schedule in the System
Content: Symptom-You would like to check when the tenant upgrade is scheduled in the system for Productive and Non-Productive tenants.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Follow the below steps to get the tenant upgrade details:-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Access the Maintenance Schedule > List view.-Change the selection to Productive Systems, Non-Productive Systems or All Systems depending on what you wish to check.-Set the Date From/To fields to the relevant time frame.-Click Go.-In the list, the entries with Type of Activity set as Update show the update schedules.-Please note: Once the upgrade is schedulded, the dates and time cannot be changed.-Keywords-Upgrade schedule, How to Check Upgrade, Product Upgrade-tenant version upgrade,tenant upgrade in system,product upgrade,upgrade schedule

Title: GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary: Report Entries not Cleared by GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You ran the GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary report and noticed a remaining balance for a given purchase order. This purchase order is not being shown as an item to be cleared by a GR/IR Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary.-You notice a remaining balance for a given purchase order. The expected result would be to show no records, meaning the items have been cleared via GR/IR run.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Purchasing Document Items view.-Use the Show filter as Items to be Cleared.-Search for the concerned purchase order.-You see that the purchase order is not shown as an Item to be Cleared.-If you use the Show All filter, you may find the purchase order with a Marked for Final Clearing Date, however in this case a previous GR/IR has already processed this purchase order.-Cause-As per GR/IR behavior, the run will always look for clearing possibilities comparing goods receipt / invoice receipt within the same clearing set. When an invoice is created, a clearing set is defined. Once a goods receipt is created and linked to this invoice, the clearing set IDs gets adjusted accordingly so that a proper match can be done - depending on the cost assignment.-There are different variances on this scenario. One of many examples can be illustrated as follows:-Via report GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary you have identified a remaining balance to be cleared off. For the given purchase order, the following sequence of events has happened:-Invoice (for 8 ea) XXX-X has been created before the goods receipt. Hence, clearing set for the invoice was set as XXX-X.1-After that, goods receipt YYY-Y got created for the total purchased quantity (e.g. 8 each). In this step the clearing set is updated from XXX-X.1 to YYY-Y.1 and contains both the invoice and the goods receipt.-A GR/IR run is executed and cleared the accounts based on clearing set YYY-Y.1.-Goods receipt YYY-Y got canceled.-A new GR/IR has been executed, which reversed the cleared postings and the amount/invoice (XXX-X) has been assigned back to clearing set XXX-X.1.-A chronological sequence of new goods receipt have been created with the partial quantities and the clearing sets have been updated, as follows:-GR AAA-A (4ea) -> Clearing set AAA-A.1-GR BBB-B (2ea) -> Clearing Set BBB-B.1-GR CCC-C (1ea) -> Clearing Set CCC-C.1-GR DDD-D (1ea) -> Clearing Set DDD-D.1-Therefore, there are currently 4 goods receipt delivering 8ea in total referencing one invoice for the 8ea. The references can be seen in the Cost Assignment tab of the supplier invoice.-Note that for each update on the clearing set, a new version of the supplier invoice is created in order to update accounting and create a corresponding journal entry to properly document the clearing set change.-In this case, when goods receipt DDD-D has been posted and a cost assignment in the invoice has been done referencing this document, a new version of the supplier invoice should have updated the remaining amount from clearing set XXX-X.1 to clearing set DDD-D.1 to be cleared on GR/IR. This change didn't happen because the corresponding supplier invoice version got stuck under General Ledger -> Source Documents. This remaining change from clearing sets is the amount that you see pending to be cleared in the GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary.-Resolution-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents view.-Search for unposted versions of supplier invoice XXX-X.-Post all the pending versions.-Once posted, the correct clearing set references will be made and you may execute GR/IR again.-Keywords-Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt Clearing Run. Purchase Order. GR/IR Clearing. Mark Final Clearing. Clearing Set. Supplier Invoice. Purchase Order. Balance. Invoice Receipt.

Title: Unable to Add Extension Fields to the Time Sheet View
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add an extension field to the Time Sheet work center view, but are unable to find this option in the Adaptation Mode menu.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Access the Time Sheet view.-Start Adaptation Mode.-Click the (+) action to add adaptation.-There's no option to add extension fields, only mashups.-Cause-It is currently not possible to add extension fields to the Time Sheet work center view, as the UI for Time Sheet is set up differently than other system screens, in such a way that does not allow for the extensibility framework to run in it.-Resolution-This is currently the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Time Sheet, Extension Field, Adaptation Mode

Title: Moving Average Cost after GR/IR Clearing or after WIP Clearing
Content: Symptom-After GR/IR Clearing or WIP Clearing, Moving Average Costs and Inventory Value of some Materials are not as expected.-Inventory Values and Moving Average Costs are too high, too low or zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The issue can be reproduced with the following preconditions:-- Material has Perpetual Cost Method "Moving Average".-- More than one clearing transaction in one run allocates values to the same Inventory Object (Material, Business Residence, Valuation Level).-- Total of reference quantities is higher than stock quantity of the specific Inventory Object.-Cause-The system behavior is correct.-The logic of inventory valuation of moving average cost materials is explained as follows:-When a process, like GR/IR Clearing, determines values that have to be posted to an inventory account each single line item is processed separately. This means that calculation is not done as a total, but for each line item.-The following example should explain it:-Material number 4711-Moving Average Cost, Stock Quantity = 50 EA,-Stock Value = 5000 USD-GR/IR Clearing determines 3 items with value differences for material 4711:-1. Value -400 USD, Reference Quantity 30 EA,-2. Value -100 USD, Reference Quantity 50 EA,-3. Value -200 USD, Reference Quantity 60 EA.-User might expect the following logic:-Total Value 700 USD, Reference Quantity 140 EA-Change of Inventory Value is -700 USD * 50 EA / 140 EA = -250 USD-Actually the system determines the following:-1. Value -400 USD, Reference Quantity 30 EA -> Change of Inventory Value -400 USD because Stock Coverage above 100%-2. Value -100 USD, Reference Quantity 50 EA -> Change of Inventory Value is -100 USD because again Stock Coverage is 100%-3. Value - 200 USD * 50 EA / 60 EA = 166,67 USD-So total change of Inventory Value is -666,67 USD.-Resolution-In order to avoid such effects it is recommended to conduct clearing transactions as close as possible to the Goods Receipts where the clearing belongs to.-Keywords-Inventory cost, moving average, GR/IR Clearing, WIP Clearing

Title: Error Message "Time Model Valid Between DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and DD2.MM2.YYYY2"
Content: Symptom-You are executing an HR operation with a certain employee, but the same is failing with error message "Time model valid between DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and DD2.MM2.YYYY2" (where DD1.MM1.YYYY1 stands for an actual date which is before DD2.MM2.YYYY2).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This can happen on different HR operations, but here is an example of how it can be reproduced when trying to terminate an employee:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Regular Tasks view.-Open the option Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Select the relevant employee.-Provide necessary information for the mandatory fields Last Working Day and Termination Category.-Click Save.-Error occurs.-Cause-This issue can occur when an employee is assigned to a work schedule that does not cover an employee's entire time profile. For example, the work schedule can be valid from a certain date (the date DD1.MM1.YYYY1 in the error message), but the employee's time profile starts on an earlier date. This means that, although the employee's time profile begins earlier than that, the employee's time model is only valid in the period where it overlaps with the work schedule's validity. While the employee's time model is in this inconsistent state, some HR operations cannot be completed.-Generally, it's not possible to assign a work schedule that does not cover the employee's time profile start date; that is: a work schedule that either starts at the same date or before the beginning of the employee's time profile validity. This means such a scenario usually occurs if the work schedule is edited after being assigned to the employee.-Resolution-Check the involved work schedule and take necessary action to ensure that there is not gap between the work schedule's validity and the employee's time profile validity, which would in turn set the employee's time model back to a consistent state.-Keywords-Time Model, Valid Between, Time Profile, Work Schedule

Title: Revenue From a Customer Invoice Posted to an Unexpected Profit Center
Content: Symptom-When checking the Journal Entry of a Customer Invoice, you notice that the Profit Center credited does not correspond to the Profit Center of the assigned Sales Unit of the related Sales Order/ Customer Contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Open Invoice ABC and check the Sales Unit in the Items tab (ABC represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Navigate to the Document Flow tab and open the Journal Entry of the Customer Invoice.-When checking the line(-s) posted to Revenue accounts, you notice that the credited Profit Center does not correspond to the Sales Unit used in the invoice. Checking the Sales Order Item assigned to this Customer Invoice confirms that it uses the expected Sales Unit.-Cause-The Profit Center of a Sales Order Item is, in general,  determined by its Sales Unit - This is done automatically only once at the creation of the item. If the Sales Unit of a Sales Order Item gets changed manually afterwards, the Profit Center remains in place and is still used in Customer Invoices referenced to this Sales Order Item.-Resolution-If you have made manual changes to the Sales Unit assignment of a Sales Order Item and want the change to be reflected in the Profit Center assignment as well, you have to perform the following manual correction:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Open the Sales Document Items view and find the relevant Sales Order or Customer Contract item(s).-Press Reassign and choose Profit Center.-Enter the required Profit Center.-Press OK.-As a result, all Customer Invoices referenced to this Sales Order Item will now use the updated Profit Center.-  See Also- 2065258 - Wrong Profit Center Derivation in Invoice Based on Sales Order-Keywords-profit center customer invoice, wrong profit center, sales unit, customer contract, sales order, profit center change in customer invoice

Title: Error Forecast start date is in future, no need of Roll Plan appears at the time of rolling the plan
Content: Symptom-System triggered Error Forecast start date is in future, no need of Roll Plan when rolling the  demand plan XYZ (XYZ represents demand plan).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Demand Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Demand Plans View-Select All Demand plans by Selection in Show field.-Search for Demand plan ABC and Select Go.-Select Roll and further select Roll Plan.-Error message appears  Forecast start date is in future, no need of Roll Plan. -Cause-As the Current date is already in period of History End Date. It is not correct to roll for forecast date which are in future.-Resolution-User should roll this particular demand plan only after History end date, preferable in after  1 month of History end date,This is the standard behaviour as designed.-Keywords-Error Forecast start date is in future, no need of Roll Plan appears at the time of rolling the plan,  Forecast start date is in future, no need of Roll Plan.

Title: Product Category Missing for Material in Project Cost and Revenue report
Content: Symptom-When evaluating a Project Cost and Revenue report, such as Project Cost and Revenue by Project or Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure-You notice the Product Category is displayed for some products but not for others. -You add the Product Category (Product) attribute to the report and notice that this attribute displays the Product Category for all Materials. -Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Reports -List view and open, for example, the Project Cost and Revenue by Project report (Alternatively open the report from the Design Reports view in the Business Analytics work center).  - Maintain Project ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID). -Press Apply.-In the View section, add the attributes Product and Product Category. As a result, the report displays the Product category for Product ABC but not for Product DEF (ABC and DEF are the IDs of two different Materials). -Go to the top right corner and select the Configure function. -Choose Add field.-Find the Product section and here add Product Category.-Press OK.-Result:-The Product Category attribute shows a value for Product ABC but not for Product DEF.-The Product Category (Product) attribute shows a value for Product ABC as well as DEF. -Cause-By default the report shows the Profit Analysis/Market Segment related attribute Product Category. This attribute derives its data from the Project Plan values:-In the Cost and Revenues work center go to the Projects view.-Find Project XYZ and press View Project Plan Values. -In the next screen you'l notice a value in the Planned Cost column. -Select the respective project task and go to the Materials sub-tab.-Here, material ABC is listed. Material DEF is not listed here. Therefore the Product Category appears for Material ABC in the report but not for Material DEF.-Resolution-The Product Category Attribute shows Profit Analysis related data in the Project Cost and Revenue report.-To verify this-open the Project Cost and Revenue report again. -Again add the Product and Product Category attributes from the View section. -Now check the actual data:-You'll see that for Product ABC only Planning related data appears, in the ITD Planned Cost column for example.-You'll see that for Product DEF there is no Planning related data appearing but actual cost values, in the ITD Incurred Cost column for example.-Conclusion:-As costs have been planned for Product ABC for Project XYZ the Marketing Segment related attribute Product Category shows a value.-As there are no costs planned for Product DEF the Project the Marketing Segment related attribute Product Category does not show any data. -Keywords-Product Category, Product, Project Cost and Revenue report

Title: How to Execute Revenue Recognition for BISNODE
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** / ***Customer Specific KBA*** - In case of any concerns, reach out to FIN support.-The customer Bisnode Deutschland GmbH raised an incident with specific dates, contracts and accounting periods asking support to execute revenue recognition.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign. Only Applicable for customer Bisnode Deutschland GmbH-Cause-The customer has some big contracts in the system, which end up making the revenue recognition unworkable via front end.-Resolution-We can execute the revenue recognition as per customer's request, excluding a few big contracts and allowing the run to go through via backend. In order to do so, please follow below steps:-Note that this report can only be executed only once in a day. So even if some mistake happens, the same report cannot be used anymore and one will have to reach out to dev. team for further discussion.-Pre-requisites:-You have an incident from Bisnode Deutschland GmbH asking for revenue recognition to be executed.-The customer has mentioned a specific date, account period and year on which the revenue recognition shall be executed.-The customer has mentioned the big contracts that have to be excluded.-How to execute:-Log on to backend an open transaction SE38.-Execute abap report Z_EXECUTE_REVREC_FOR_CONTRACTS.-Select the radio button Get all contracts.-In the Date field, give the date mentioned by the customer. You must execute the report on the exact date mentioned by the customer, around 16:00 or 17:00 CET of that day (unless otherwise specified by the customer).-Fill in the big contracts to be excluded from the selection.-Execute the report.-Click Check Job in SM37 and execute the selection. You shall see that a background job has been created as per below screenshot.-Wait until the above job is finished. It shall take approximately 10 to 15 minutes - but it may take way longer as well, depending on system's resources.-Go back to the abap report and select the radio button Check data before revrec run.-In the Filepath field, pass the filepath where you want to save the file.-Execute the report. It shall download an XML file containing a list of contracts.-Within the downloaded list, check if any of the excluded contracts (step 3b) are there. None of the excluded contracts shall be available in this log file.-If the excluded contracts are NOT in the XML logs, then you can select the radio button Run revrec.-Keep the Test Run checkbox as blank.-Fill in the year as specified by the customer in format YYYY.-Fill in the period specified by the customer in format MMM.-Execute the report.-Click the button Check Job in SM37 and execute the selection. You shall see that a background job has been created as per below screenshot.-Wait until above job is finished. It shall take approximately 2 hours.-Once the job is finished, check the run ID and inform the customer accordingly.-The run is always created with description: 'Executed by SAP; excluding few big contracts'.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition. Bisnode.

Title: Error Message: Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for journal entry AAA
Content: Symptom-You get the error message 'Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for Journal Entry AAA', while doing a Reconciliation Run.-AAA means the Journal Entry ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Reconciliation subview.-Select the run and perform the action View.-On the new screen navigate to the tab Messages.-You get the error message 'Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for Journal Entry AAA'.-Resolution-Case 1) Journal Entries exist where the source documents are having 100% discount:-In this case, you can ignore the error message. Since the journal entries have 100% discount, no tax line item will be posted although they are taxed by X%. Tax Calculation looks for the posted tax amounts for each line item that is taxed and compares with expected posted tax amount. Therefore the report shows inconsistencies on account level. The journal entry is consistent from VAT calculation point of view. You can also ignore difference caused by rounding errors.-Case 2) Journal Entries exist where the source documents are not having 100% discount:-In this case, create an incident and send to SAP Product Support for further analysis.-Keywords-Reconciliation Run; reconciliation report; tax ledger account; discount; journal entry; ignore-reconciliation run,reconciliation report,tax ledger account,discount,journal entry,ignore

Title: Extension Field has no Data Source to Extend
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field and would like to add it to a data source and report. However in the adaptation mode, no data sources are listed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Create an extension field.-Edit the field and click on Further Usage.-Go to the Reporting tab (Data Sources).-No data sources are listed here. The field cannot be added to reporting.-Cause-For a data source to be listed here, the access context of a data source has to match the business context in which the field was created.-Additionally, not all data sources enabled for extension fields. Among those that are enabled, not all are enabled for key figure extension fields. Extension fields will be key figures, if they are of type Quantity, Amount or Decimal.-Resolution-The data source list in the Further Usage screen always displays all data sources that match your extension field type and its business context. If a data source is not listed here, it cannot be extended with your field.-For new feature requests, please use the Influence forum:-ByD Influence Forum-C4C Influence Forum-See Also-In ByD, you can check the following help center documentation: Data Sources Enabled for Extension Fields.-Keywords-no data sources found, business context, extension field, analytics, report, data source

Title: Error No Matching Inventory Items Found When Performing Change of Stock for Externally Managed Locations
