Content: Symptom-While performing change of stock, error appears No matching inventory items found.*XYZ refers to Site id,&KLM refers to Product Id-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can reproduce the issue with following steps.-Go to Internal Logistic Work center.-In Common tasks, select Change of Stock.-Input site as XYZ and product as KLM.-Select any available identified stock.-Select Next, then you get the error. -No Matching Inventory Items Found-Cause-The site XYZ is an externally managed location.-For the externally managed locations, it is not possible to do the change of stock from the Internal Logistics work center.-Instead you have to perform the change of stock in the Third-party Logistics work center and select Common Tasks New Inventory Change in Externally Managed Location.--Resolution-You can follow steps below:-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-In Common tasks, select the option New Inventory Change in Externally Managed Location from the drop-down.-Fill in the required fields under the General tab.-Go to the Line Items tab, select the Add Row, enter the Item ID, Reason as Transfer and Movement Direction as Inventory Issue and other required details.-Enter values for Item Group ID column and fill in Product and Quantity columns too.-Now, select again Add Row button again, enter Item ID, Reason as Transfer, Movement Direction as Inventory Receipt. Here you have to enter the same values for Item Group ID which you have entered in the previous line item ID and fill in Product and Quantity columns too.-For the second line item, you have to either select the stock as Restricted or enter an Identified Stock ID as you are doing a change of stock.-Then select Save and Release the Inventory Notification.-Please note that the column Group Item ID may not show by default. You need to mark it as Visible in Personalize.-Keywords-No Matching Inventory Items Found, Change of stock, While performing change of stock, error appears No matching inventory items found , Found When Performing Change of Stock for Externally Managed Locations

Title: How to Change the SAML Signature Crypto Format
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-If the Identity Provider (IdP) which the customer is using does not support the standard SAP SAML Crypto format PKCS7 some issues will be faced when trying to perform the connection using single sign-on (SSO).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign -Cause-The reason for this is that the customer's IdP won't accept SAML signature in PKCS7 crypto format.-Instead it will require PKCS1 V1.5 format, which is also required by the XML Signature standard.-So this means that the IdP is correct according to the XML Signature standard.-Resolution-It is necessary to change to PKCS1 V1.5 format:-Go to transaction STRUST in backend.-At the menu click in Environment.-Select entry SSF Parameters.-Select entry SAML2 Service Provider - Signature.-Click at Details button.-Then change the value of field SSF Format from International Standard PKCS#7 to International Standard PKCS#1 (Standard Padding).-Click in Save.-Keywords-SAML, SSO, crypto format, PKCS#7, logout issue

Title: Total Mileage Reimbursement is Higher Than Expected for Expense Report
Content: Symptom-The Total Mileage Reimbursement is higher than you expected for Expense Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Click the relevant Expense Report.-Under Reimbursements and Expense Summary the Mileage Reimbursements is showing (for example) as 100 USD, while you expected 80 USD.-Cause-This difference is caused due to the Number of Passengers in the Mileage Information.-To check this press Show More Mileage Information in the Expense Report: The system will calculate the Distance with the Mileage Reimbursements Rates and the Passenger Reimbursement Rates.-Example:-Distance: 200 Miles-Mileage Reimbursements Rate: 0.40-Passenger Reimbursement Rates: 0.05-Number of Passengers: 2-200 * 0.40 = 80 USD-200 * 0.05 * 2 = 20 USD-Hence, the Total Mileage Reimbursements is 100 USD.-Resolution- This is the correct system behavior.-Keywords-Mileage Reimbursement, Expense Report, Mileage Reimbursements Rate-mileage reimbursement,expense report,mileage reimbursements rate

Title: Error: Bank Account Does Not Exist When Create Sales Order via Web Services
Content: Symptom-You are using ManageSalesOrderIn webservice to create a Sales Order, but you are facing an error: Bank account does not exist,  in the Response.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You send your request via Soap UI or any other system, and you get the following error:-Bank account does not exist.-Cause-Look specifically under the <PAYMENT_CONTROL> tag, you will see several tags maintained that are not present in your payload.-The most important tag here is: <PaymentProcessingCompanyID></PaymentProcessingCompanyID>.-Without this ID, the UUID of the bank account cannot be determined.-Resolution- Once the <PaymentProcessingCompanyID></PaymentProcessingCompanyID> is provided, the error is not raised.-Keywords-Sales Orders; Payment; Bank Account;

Title: Error: 'Change of category from 1 to 2 for account type XYZ not possible'
Content: Symptom-User is trying to change the time account type category but the system throws error: 'Change of category from 1 to 2 for account type XYZ not possible'.-XYZ = The name of the time account-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the fine-tuning activity 'Time Account - <country>' and open it.-Select Time Maintain Account Types to open it.-Try to change the category of one of the present records and then save.-The error: 'Change of category from 1 to 2 for account type XYZ not possible' is thrown.-Cause-It is not currently possible to change the time account type category. This functionality is not supported.-Resolution-It is suggested to create a new record and add the desired category to it.-Keywords-Time and Labor Management, Time Account, TLM

Title: Error: Balance of XXX; clearing not possible when Clearing Down Payment Request with Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to do a Manual Clearing of a Down Payment Request with an Invoice.-However, you are not being able to do so due Error Message: 'Balance of XXX; clearing not possible.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Customer Accounts sub view.-Select the Account ABC.-Click View.-Select the Down Payment Request and the Invoice which you want to clear.-Click Clear Manually.-Click Clear.-Error Message is displayed: 'Balance of XXX; clearing not possible'.-Cause-The amount of the Down Payment Request does not match the Invoice amount. Hence, you cannot clear the items.-Resolution-The down payment request cannot be partially cleared. You need to pay the Down Payment Request DEF first. After that, the Down Payment Request becomes a Down Payment. You can partially clear the Down Payment with an invoice.-See Also-Down Payment Received in Financials - Help Document-Refer to Knowledge Base Article 2476817 which explains a similar scenario-Keywords-Clear down payment request, Clearing Not Possible

Title: How to Move an Org Unit In and Out of an Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to properly move an org. unit from a hierarchy to another or from an org. structure to another org. structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select Common Task: Edit Org Structures.-Select the date in the Effective From field from which the change will be active in the system.-Select the relevant org. Unit that needs to be moved.-Select the small arrow (bottom-right) of the relevant org. unit to open its menu.-Click the Edit Org Unit option, then select Cut.-Highlight the target root org. unit under which this org. unit should to be placed.-Select the arrow in the target org. unit to open its menu.-Click the Edit Org Unit option, then select Paste; the previously selected org. unit will be placed beneath this one.-Use the Check button to validate the org. structure.-Select Activate to activate the changes.-Keywords-Move, Org Unit, Org Structure

Title: Public Solution Model Write Access Release for Business Object Nodes of Employee Business Object
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to create a custom solution to pseudonymize parts of Business ByDesign to grant access to users that normally must not see the original data, so you need to have write access to the fields that is not possible anymore to reidentify the "original" person behind.-Therefore, you want a Public Solution Model (PSM) Release for Write Access to some of the Business Object Nodes for Business Object EMPLOYEE.-BO Nodes:-EmployeeCurrentCommon.Person.BirthPlaceName-EmployeeCurrentCommon.Person.NationalityCountryCode-EmployeeCurrentCommon.Person.BirthDate-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-These Business Object Nodes are Read-Only released, therefore, it is not possible to update these attributes directly from a custom solution.-Resolution-As a solution, there are two web services that can be used via PDI which should meet your requirement. To find them, please follow the steps below:-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Communication Scenarios view.-Search for the Communication Scenario Personnel Administration.-Here, there are two web services: "Maintain Biographical Data" and "Maintain Employee Data", which can be used to update the attributes on the common node of the Business Object Employee.-Once you have a Communication Arrangement, you should be able to use one of the mentioned web services.-Obs.: Web service "Maintain Biographical Data" is a slim down version of "Maintain Employee Data".-Keywords-Public Solution Model, Employee, Read-Only, custom solution, BirthDate, BirthPlaceName, NationalityCountryCode

Title: Error "The combination of context elements is not supported" During Migration of Price List
Content: Symptom-When you migrate price list, you receive the error: "The combination of context elements is not supported" during the simulation step.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center .-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Migration of Price Lists.-Open link Migrate price lists using the migration tool.-On the new screen, click on Execute Migration > Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error occurs.-Cause-It's not possible to support customer group-specific or base price lists with optional Sales Organization and Distribution Channel. Only full key is supported, which means both Sales Organization and Distribution Channel have to be maintained in the migration file.-Please note that information for Sales Organization and Distribution Channel should NOT be maintained for customer-specific price lists, as the relevant information is already maintained in the account's Sales Data.-Resolution-If you don't want to maintain sales org and distribution channel, you can use below workaround :-Fill sales org and distribution channel details and make the validity dates in past for example 01.01.1999 to 01.01.1999 and proceed with upload-After the migration, go to work center Product and Service Portfolio-Go to view Price Lists -Click button Advance -Delete the From and To dates in the search fields, so that price list created in past comes up.-Copy the price list, remove sales org and distribution channel, correct the validity dates and save.-It's now possible to release the price list.-Furthermore, it is also possible to use the XLS write-back option which is also available in the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Also, for discount list in Account specific, there is no need to add Account ID at the Item level again. Kindly remove the entries maintained under Items->Account ID.-See Also-Help Center Document: Configuration: Migration of Discount Lists-2774933 - Error Message "The combination of context elements is not supported" During Migration of Price List-2763208 - Migration of Price List Throws Error "The combination of context elements is not supported-Keywords-context elements, migration, discount list, price list, error, Migration of Price Lists-csg_q,context elements, migration, discount li, migration of price lists

Title: Attendee Field in a New Appointment Does not Show Options Automatically
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Appointment in the system and when typing the attendees name in the Attendees field, the system does not show a drop-down with the options available, as it happens to others fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the New Appointment option from the Common Tasks.-Enter a value in the Attendee field; Ex: ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Attendee).--The system does not return any value.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-Attendee, New Appointment, Drop-down, Activity

Title: Multiple Sales Orders Are Considered in Revenue Recognition Run While Only One Is Expected
Content: Symptom-When executing a Revenue Recognition Run for one Sales Order, multiple Sales Orders are considered in the Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find the relevant Run ID.-Click View.-Go to the Data Selection.-Only one Sales Document of type Sales Order is selected.-Go to the Processed Successful tab.-Go to the relevant sub-tab.-Multiple Sales Orders are showing as processed.-Cause-A Sales Order that is associated to a Revenue Accounting Contract (RAC) was selected in the Run Selection.-Due to this, all the Sales Orders that are linked to the same Revenue Accounting Contract will be considered in the run.-When the Revenue Accounting Contract is active then the Revenue Recognition is no longer based on the Sales order but on the RAC and the associated Performance Obligations (POBs) so therefore all the items are processed.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition, Sales Order, RAC, Revenue Accounting Contract, SO-revenue recognition,sales order,rac,revenue accounting contract,so

Title: Error Message While Trying to Edit an Employee
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the error message below when trying to edit an Employee.-Master Data replication is in scope. Personal file changes are not allowed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2005 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Employee Data work center.-Go to the Employee view.-Show Active Employees and search for the required Employee ID.-Once you click Edit, system shows the error.-Cause-The error message is appearing because the Integration of Employee Data from External Application to Cloud Solution is scoped in the system.-Resolution-The scoping element Integration of Employee Data from External Application to Cloud Solution needs to be removed from the scoping of the project.-Please follow the steps below to solve this error message:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select the required project and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Scoping step.-Expand Human Resources.-Expand Personnel Administration.-Remove Integration of Employee Data from External Application to Cloud Solution.-See Also-2891178 - Payment Method Missing After Replicating Employee from Employee Central into SAP Business ByDesign System-Keywords-Error Message, Edit, Employee, Master Data replication, is in scope, personal file changes are not allowed.

Title: Cannot Change the Sequence of the Suggested Activities in an Opportunity.
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the Sales Phase sequence for a Sales Cycle under the configuration activity Sales Cycles and Phases, but the values under the Suggested Activities does not reflect the sequence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select New Opportunity option from Common Tasks.-Navigate to the Sales Activities tab.-Under Suggested Activities the sequence of the Sales Phase is not as expected.-Cause-The sequence maintained for the Suggested Activities follows the Sales Phase ID.-Example: 001, 002 or Z01, Z02.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-See Also-1828567 - Suggested Activities are Invisible on Opportunity UI-2939381 - Sales Phase Cannot Be Deleted in the Sales Cycles and Phases Activity-Keywords-Opportunity, Suggested Activities, Sales Activities, Sales Phase, Sales Cycle

Title: Missing UUID in XML File of Mexico Electronic Accounting Run
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Mexico Electronic Accounting Run for Journal File and noticed that the UUID (tag UUID_CFDI) field of a Payment is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Mexico Electronic Accounting view.-Select the relevant Run.-Show All Application Logs.-Click View Report Run Results.-Go to the Attachments tab.-Download the Journal File XML file.-When you open the XML file you verified that one or more Payments have no UUID as follows:-UUID_CFDI=""-Cause-The UUID field is maintained based on the Payment Approval ID.-In case the Payment Approval ID was not maintained, then UUID field will be empty in the XML File.-Resolution-You can maintain the Payment Approval ID using the following steps:-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Account view.-Open the relevant Supplier Account.-Select the related Payment.-Click Maintain Approval.-Here you can enter the Payment Approval ID.-See Also-Help Document Payment Approval Information for Outgoing Payments – Mexico-Keywords-UUID, Payment Approval, Mexico Electronic Run.

Title: Changes on Reimbursed Expense Report
Content: Symptom-Changes are allowed on Expense Reports with Released for Reimbursement status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expense work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Find the relevant Expense Report with status Pending Approval.-Click the View All button and select the Changes tab.-Click the Go button.- Note: The status of the expense report has changed from Released for Reimbursement to Not Submitted and from Not Submitted to Pending Approval.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-Changes are currently allowed on Expense Reports regardless of their status.-Any changes made on the Expense Report will need to be reviewed and approved again.-Keywords-expense report, travel and expense,  reimbursement, reimbursed, expense report issue-expense report,travel and expense,reimbursement,reimbursed,expense report issue

Title: Access Restriction for New Charge/Credit Under Payables and Receivables
Content: Symptom-You have set up a write restriction as No Access to work center view Receivables -> Customer Accounts. The aim is to prevent users from creating New Charge/Credit in the customer account monitors, but still being able to create New Charge/Credit for the supplier account monitor. However, even with the access restriction, users are able to create the charges and credits in both work centers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Find the respective user and Edit -> Access Rights.-Go to Access Restrictions tab.-Find the Customer Accounts work center view name.-Set the Write Access to No Access.-Find the Supplier Accounts work center view name.-Set the Write Access to Unrestricted.-Logon with the respective user who has the above authorizations/restrictions.-Go to Receivables -> Customer Accounts.-Open any customer account monitor.-Click New Charge/Credit.-You see that, even though there is a Write Access restriction as 'No Access', no error message is raised the New Charge/Credit can be created.-Cause-The action New Charge/Credit on both payables and receivables accounts, share the same floorplan. When a floorplan is shared between more than one workcenter view, the final access restriction is be based on the union of all the access restrictions provided from all the shared workcenter views.-In this scenario, the New Charge/Credit is shared between Payables and Receivables and the union of above access restriction setup has become unrestricted read and write access.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. If you wish to add a write restriction to New Charge/Credit screen, this restriction has to be applied in both Payables and Receivables work center views, so that an error is raised.-Keywords-Other Payables. Other Receivables. Customer Account. Supplier Account. Access Rights. Access Restrictions. Business Role.

Title: Lease Posting Run Error: Configuration For Account Determination Not Valid For General Ledger Service Charge in Profile
Content: Symptom-The Lease posting run ended with the following error messages:-" Configuration for account determination not valid for General Ledger Service Charge in profile <ABC>.-Other cashflow items related to lease contract DEF cannot be processed."-(ABC is the Account Determination Profile ID.)-(DEF is the Lease In contract ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to the Lease Posting Run subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Search for Lease Posting Run HIJ (HIJ is the lease posting run ID) and select it.-Under Log Details, the Run ended in error.-Select the Log Details and click View.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-You get the following error messages:-" Configuration for account determination not valid for General Ledger Service Charge in profile <ABC>.-Other cashflow items related to lease contract DEF cannot be processed."-Cause-You have not maintained G/L-Accounts for the Account Determination Group of the Object Type of the Lease contract.-You can check as follows:-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to the Lease Contracts view.-Search and select Lease In Contract DEF.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Leased Objects tab.-The Object Type is NOP (NOP is the object type ID/Name).-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Lease Management Accounting activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Account Determination Group for Lease Contract Object Type.-For the Lease Contract Object Type NOP, the Account Determination Group is QRS (QRS is the account determination group ID).-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click General Ledger under Account Determination.-Select Account Determination Profile ABC.-Navigate to the Lease Liability tab.-Under Account Determination Group for Lease Liability, the Account Determination Group QRS is missing.-Resolution-You can add the Account Determination Group QRS as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click General Ledger under Account Determination.-Select Account Determination Profile ABC.-Navigate to the Lease Liability tab.-Click Add Row.-Under Account Determination Group for Lease Liability, enter the Account Determination Group QRS.-Maintain also all the relevant G/L-Accounts in the fields Lease Liability, Service Charge, Interest Expense, Revaluation Gain/ Loss, Exchange Rate Difference and Rounding Difference.-The error message "Other cashflow items related to lease contract DEF cannot be processed" is a result of the first error message "Configuration for account determination not valid for General Ledger Service Charge in profile <ABC>".-It means that the contract DEF was not processed due to the error message  "Configuration for account determination not valid for General Ledger Service Charge in profile <ABC>".-See Also-Help Document: Lease Management Accounting: Configuration Guide-Keywords-Lease posting run, lease contract, Kontenfindungskonfiguration für Hauptbuch - Bearbeitungsgebühr in Profil <SKR3> nicht gültig; Leasingvertrag, Andere auf Leasingvertrag bezogene Cashflow-Pos. nicht verarbeitbar

Title: Revenue Per Period for a Contract Item Differs from a Gross Amount Per Period Calculation
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report to check the revenue per period of a contract item and used the standard key figure 'Gross Amounts (Document Currency)' to bring the values to the report. However, the amounts are different from the calculated amounts under Cost and Revenue when using accrual method 304 - Straight-line – prorate partial periods for fixed-price invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design reports view.-Open your custom report.-Run the report for the desired contract.-Include key figure 'Gross Amount (Document Currency)' or 'Net Amount (Document Currency)' and 'Month/Calendar Year'.-Navigate to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Sales document items.-Find the related contract.-Click the Accounting Data tab.-Refer to Revenues per Period in default Set of Books table.-You see that the amounts from the repot are different from the amounts shown under Cost and Revenue. You expect these amounts to be the same since the contract has accrual method 304 - Straight-line – prorate partial periods.-Cause-The key figure is based on CRM data source, which retrieves the amounts to be shown, per period, from a business object that calculates the amounts differently from the revenue distribution calculation based on an accrual method 304 in accounting.-To illustrate the differences, consider a contract item as follows:-Contract Duration: From 26.08.2020 to 25.08.2021-Contract Item amount: 18.600,00 USD--In accounting, the revenues per period will be calculated and distributed based on the logic of the accrual method, in this case 304 - Straight-line – prorate partial periods. For this accrual method, the system first calculates the revenue to be recognized for the partial periods based on the day rate and then the remaining revenue is distributed equally across the full periods. Therefore, for this illustration, it means:-Contract Duration: From 26.08.2020 to 25.08.2021 -> 365 days.-Hence, day rate for this item is 18.600,00 USD / 365  days = 50,9589... USD/day of calculated revenue.-Given the accrual method, the logic is to calculate the revenue for the partial periods first and then distribute the remaining amount equally for the remaining periods. In this case 008/2020 and 008/2021 are the incomplete periods.-008/2020 -> This period has only 6 days to be calculated (since start date is on the 26th): 6 * 50,9589... = 305,75 USD (rounded).-008/2021 -> This period has 25 days to be calculated (since end date is on the 25th):  25 * 50,9589... = 1.273,97 USD (rounded).-So, 18.600,00 USD - 305,75 USD - 1.273,97 USD = 17.020,28 USD left to be distributed equally amount the remaining periods.-Since 008/2020 and 008/2021 are already calculated, the remaining periods are from 009/2020 to 007/2021, which means 11 periods left.-Therefore, 17.020,28 USD / 11 periods left = 1547,30 USD-Hence, in accounting, based on the accrual method, you have revenue distribution as follows:-008/2020 -> 305,75 USD-009/2020 to 007/2021 -> 1547,30 USD each period-008/2021 -> 1.273,95 USD-Now, in your custom report, to bring the the values in you are using the key figure 'Gross Amount (Document Currency)'. This key figure is based on a CRM data source. Hence, the calculation of the amounts differ, as it also does not consider an accrual method standard. For this key figure, the system calculated the gross amount as follows:-It considers this contract length as 12 calendar months in total. Being August/2020 and August/2021 incomplete months.-The logic determines the amount per month (18.600,00 USD / 12 months = 1550,00) and distributes in sequence for each of month. For incomplete months, it calculate a fraction to be assigned based on the total of days for incomplete periods:-August/2020 -> number of days = 6-August/2021 -> number of days = 25-Total number of incomplete month days: 31 (25+6)-The distribution per period is done as follows:-If the month is incomplete (e.g. August/2020): amount per month * (number of days / total incomplete month days).-Hence, for August/2020 it is 1550,00 * (6 / 31) = 300 USD-If the month is complete (e.g. September/2020), then it gets the calculated amount per month: 1550,00 USD-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior, since the calculation is done differently for the key figure and in accounting, depending on the accrual method.-See Also-Help Document: Revenue Recognition for Customer Contracts-Keywords-Revenue Recognition. Accrual Method. Revenue Per period. Cost and Revenue. Gross Amount.

Title: How to Resolve Error: Cannot assign Expense Item to Invoice Item due to Incompatible Units of Measure (UoM)
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create Project Invoice Request due to error:-"Cannot assign expense item to invoice item due to incompatible units of measure (UoM). Check if the UoM can be converted. If conversion is not possible, assign the expense to another invoice item."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management Workcenter.-Select the view Invoice Preparation.-Select the subview Not Invoiced Time and Expenses.-Under All Active Customer Projects, Select relevant project.-Select New-> Manual Project Invoice Request.-Propose the invoice items -> Using Sales Order Items.-Navigate to Select Time and Expenses.-When you assign invoice items for item X, error encountered:-Cannot assign expense item to invoice item due to incompatible units of measure (UoM). Check if the UoM can be converted. If conversion is not possible, assign the expense to another invoice item.-Cause-It can be due to two reasons:-The UOM conversion is not maintained in Product Master Data.-If the UOM Conversion is maintained, then check if you have two same quantity units (for example, UOM as Y) with the same description in your system (description "YYY").-You can check this in Business Configuration -> Overview-> Quantities and Units of Measure -> Trading Units of Measurement -> search for description "YYY"-You can see two different codes for same unit "Y" with description "YYY".-Resolution-Please maintain the quantity conversion for the UOM in the Product Master data.-If UOM conversion is maintained but still you get the error, you have to maintain the conversion for both the units which have similar description in the product master data-(since both descriptions are similar, you cannot identify which description to choose, so enter the unique code of the units manually and press enter, system will pick the corresponding UOM)-OR-You can cancel and re-create the Goods and Services Receipts with the correct quantity unit.-Keywords-project invoice request; PIR; UOM; expense item; invoice item

Title: Un-posted Purchase Order Error Message: Business transaction for accounting for Purchase Order XXXX, version YY with alternate posting date not processed. Not relevant to journal entry creation
Content: Symptom-You've requested SAP to fix in the backend a purchase order affected by the error message Only one ItemAccountingCodingBlockDistribution.ROOT permitted. After the correction you are now trying to post the business transaction with an Alternate Posting Date but you are receiving the error message Business transaction for accounting for Purchase Order XXXX, version YY with alternate posting date not processed. Not relevant to journal entry creation.-XXXX stands for the purchase order ID.-YY stands for the source document version.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Select the row for the respective purchase order.-Click Actions and select Post Business Transaction to Another Period.-Enter Alternate Posting Date and Alternate Closing Step.-Click OK.-Error message is thrown: Business transaction for accounting for Purchase Order XXXX, version YY with alternate posting date not processed. Not relevant to journal entry creation.-Cause-A posting date is only meaningful for documents that create journal entries. A purchase order doesn't create journal entry, therefore the system throws the message Business transaction for accounting for Purchase Order XXXX, version YY with alternate posting date not processed. Not relevant to journal entry creation when you try to post it to a different period.--Resolution-After SAP have fixed the purchase order in the backend you should post it without changing the posting date, via Actions > Post Business Transaction.

Title: Wrong Language is Selected on Customer Invoice Template
Content: Symptom-The template is created for Accounts in XYZ (XYZ represents the preferred language), then you uploaded and published the template.-After this, once you preview the invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of invoice) which is newly created, you notice the language in invoice is not in XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents.-Find invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of invoice).-Select invoice ABC.-Choose Preview tab.-You identified that the language in invoice ABC is not XYZ.-Cause-The system uses the logon language of the user to determine the language of the form template.-If the invoice is not released yet, you can check which Account is used as Language Source and the Language determined when you click on the You Can Also Button and Select the Edit Output Document.-In the sub tab Output Details of the new window you can see the Business Partner used as Language Source and the respective Language which is determined.-Resolution-There are 3 options which you can use to address this scenario correctly:-Account Master Data Level:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Account view.-Edit Account DEF (DEF represents the account name of invoice ABC).-Click on the View All button.-Go to the General tab. The language can be maintained in the Main Communication Data.-Choose Save it.-It allows you to set a specific rule for the which template is used. Here for example you can select which would set the e.g. French language template for this scenario.-Customer Invoice Level:-Open the Customer Invoice Request LMN (LMN represents the ID of invoice request).-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Customer Invoice Requests view.-Find Customer Invoice Request LMN.-Click on the You Can Also button.-Click Edit Output Settings button.-Select the Template Required.-Template Selection Rules:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Input and Output Management view and select Form Template Selection sub view.-Select Customer Invoice from value help.-Select Form template code as Customer Invoice.-Here you can specify a set of rules which can determine which template is picked using the fields: Business Document, Seller and Bill to as a basis.-The first rule which is matched determines the selected document.-See Also-KBA: 2770998 - You Cannot Find a Specific Customer Invoice Form Language for a Country You Have Scoped-KBA: 1673082 - Wrong Language Determination in Customer Invoice-KBA: 2591499 - Error Message 'Form template variant Customer Invoice for language ABC and country DEF cannot be found'-Keywords-Form Template Language, Template Selection Rules, Output Channel

Title: Main Address is not Picked up on Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have maintained relationship between the Account ABC (ABC represents your Account ID). And the Business Partner DEF (DEF represents your Business Partner ID) with the relationship type "Has Ship-To Party".-When you create a new Sales Order the system automatically takes the defined Bussines Partner from the relationships of the Corporate Account instead of main address.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Search the Account ABC.-Select and click on Edit button.-Go to the Contacts tab and select the Relationships and Responsibilities sub tab.-Under the Relationships section you maintained relationship type as "Has Ship-To Party" and defined a Business Partner.-Cause-If in the Account master data "Has Ship-To Party" defined, then Sales Order will always pick this Business Partner as ship-to at the header level.-In case there are multiple Business Partners maintained with the Relationship Type Has Ship-To Party the system will determine the Business Partner with the Main indicator active.-If none of these have the Main indicator active. In this case the system will pick the first once added as Has Ship-To Party -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior-Keywords-Has Ship-To Party ; Sales Order ; Address ; Business Partner

Title: Access Rights Change Log Report Does Not Show Technical User Results
Content: Symptom-You cannot see results for a Technical User when accessing standard report Access Rights Change Log (Report ID CCAB03_Q001), however, you can see results for the same Technical User when accessing standard report All Current Access Rights (Report ID CCAB01_Q002).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for All Current Access Rights report.-Filter by respective Technical User.-You can see results.-In the Design Reports view, search for the Access Rights Change Log report.-Filter by the same respective Technical User.-You cannot see any results.-Cause-Access Rights Change Log report displays only those changes happened to the users which have the work center and view pair. Also, it shows the user only if there is a valid combination of changes happened to the user.-Resolution-This is the system standard behavior.-Keywords-Access Rights Change Log, All Current Access Rights, Technical User, Difference of Reports, CCAB03_Q001, CCAB01_Q002

Title: System Creates Supplier Invoice Versions After Goods and Service Receipt Posting
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice (SIV) for a purchase order and post it without having created a goods and service receipt (GSR)before.-Later you create a GSR for this purchase order.-You notice that the system created a second version of your supplier invoice and are therefore wondering if the invoice has now been posted twice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create Supplier Invoice without goods receipt:-In the Supplier invoicing workcenter navigate to the Invoice Entry view and select the respective purchse order. The invoicing status of the purchase order is Not Invoiced and the Delivery Status is Not Delivered.-Click New Invoice.-Maintain an invoice date and external document ID.-Then click Check.-An exception is raised as the GSR is missing. Click Show Exceptions and then choose Allow Post without Receipt Document.-The supplier invoice with ID XXX is created.-Later you need to create a goods and service receipt for the purchase order:-In the Goods and Sercice Receipts workcenter navigate to the Purchase Orders to Be Delivered: Show by Documents view.-Select the respective purchase order and click New Goods and Service Receipt.-Post the GSR.-You now notice that there exist two versions of your supplier invoice and you suspect that the invoice has been posted twice.-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Closing Cockpit: Source Documents view.-Open the Advanced Search.-In the Show field select All Source Documents.-In the Related Source Document ID field maintain the supplier invoice ID XXX.-In the Related Source Document Type field select 127-Supplier Invoice.-Now two versions of your supplier invoice appear.-Cause-In general supplier invoice clearing is registered based on the goods and service receipt. Whenever a supplier invoice is posted without goods and service receipt then the clearing between the supplier invoice and goods receipt will be registered based on the supplier invoice data.-As soon as the goods and service receipt is posted a new mechanism, called Invoice Match Process, happens in order to register the clearing based on the GSR.-In this case, as the invoice has already been posted, the invoice match identifies the goods and service receipt and therefore marks the clearing registration based on the supplier invoice as zero in order to transfer the invoice confirmed quantity to the goods and service receipt based clearing registration.-Resolution-Therefore the system creates an update/ a new version of the supplier invoice rather than a new posting.

Title: The Dunning Proposal is not generating and Output Attachment
Content: Symptom-After executing a Dunning Run the Dunning Proposal is not generating the Output in Output History.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Show All Dunning Proposals.-Find relevant Dunning ID.-Select Dunning ID.-Click Edit.-Go to Output History.-No Document is showing.-Cause-This can be caused due to missing e-mail address in the Customer Account. The Document is generated for the Output History only after the Queue item is set to Processed, and due to missing e-mail the item is not sent to the queue.-Resolution-Maintain the e-mail address in the Customer Account:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Find the relevant Account.-Click Customer Name.-Click View All.-Go to the Communication tab.-Go to the Addresses sub-tab.-Input E-Mail information.-Click Save.-After this is done you can generate a new Dunning.-Keywords-Dunning, Output History, e-mail, email, Dunning Run, Dunning Proposal-dunning,output history,e-mail,email,dunning run,dunning proposal

Title: Balances Differ for Country, Tax Type, Event and Rate
Content: Symptom-General Ledger Reconciliation Report for Tax shows Absolute Difference between the Tax Register and Tax Ledger under Withholding Tax Balances.-Error message will be shown as:-Balances differ for country XYZ (XYZ here represents Country), Tax Type, Tax Event and Tax Rate.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Reconciliation subview.-Show All Reconciliation runs and Find Run ID AAA (AAA here represents Reconciliation Run ID).-Go to LogResult of the Reconciliation Report.-Go to Tax and then to Withholding Tax Balances subtab.-You could see Absolute Difference between the Balances in Register and Balance in Ledger.-Cause-Balance in Tax Register gets cleared when the respective Withholding Tax Return is Released and Balance in Tax Ledger gets cleared when the Tax Return is Paid.-You can check the Withholding Tax Returns by the following Steps:-Go to the Tax Management Work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view and then to Withholding Tax Returns Subview.-Show All Tax Returns and Search for the respective Tax Return ID.-The Status of the Tax Return will be Reported which clears the Balance in Tax Register and it will be shown as zero. Since the Tax Return is not paid yet, the Balance in Tax Ledger remains causing the Absolute Difference.-Resolution-You have to pay against the respective Withholding Tax Return and the Balance in Tax Ledger will be cleared.-Please notice that the Balance in Tax Ledger will be cleared as of the Posting Date of the Tax Payment.-To compare the withholding tax balances in the tax register against the balances of the tax accounts for a key date you can use the Withholding Tax Reconciliation report.-Keywords-Reconciliation Report, Withholding Tax, Absolute Differences, Withholding Tax Reconciliation

Title: How to Activate Work Center Resource Management
Content: Symptom-The Resource Management work center is not visible, and no related scoping option is available in Business Configuration.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Open Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Project-Choose Edit Project Scope-Navigate to the Questions step-Search for Resource Management or Resource Availability Search-No option is found to enable the Resource Management work center-Cause-This is expected system behavior, as the Resource Management work center depends on Project Management and cannot be activated independently.-Resolution-Open Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Project-Choose Edit Project Scope-Navigate to the Questions step-Follow this path:-SAP Business / Project Management / Project Planning and Execution / Project Resource Management-Enable the question:-Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on Commitment Quantity of the employee from Projects Team and Staffing?-Complete and confirm the scoping changes-Once the scoping is completed, the Resource Management work center becomes available.-Keywords-resource management work center not visible, activate resource management, resource management scoping, project management dependency, business configuration resource management, SAP ByDesign configuration

Title: How Expense Report Approver Is Determined and Change Default Approver Determination Mechanism
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-RELEASED INTERNALLY-You want to know how the system determines the approver of an expense report and whether there is a way to change the system default approver determination mechanism.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The approver of expense report cannot be set by the user manually but automatically determined by the system. The system provides five possible ways to approve your expense report.-Standard: The approver is cost center manager, project manager or sales order responsible depending on the major cost object (cost assignment of receipt items) of expense report.-Reporting Line Manager:-The approver is claimer's reporting line manager no matter how the cost is allocated.-No Self-approval for Cost Center manager:-Standard with exception for cost center managers: approver determination is like standard, but if the employee of the expense report is also the cost center manager of the cost center covering the largest part of the expenses, then the line manager of the cost center manager is the approver instead.-No Self-approval for PRO manager:-Standard with exception for project managers: approver determination is like standard, but if the employee of the expense report is also the project manager of the project covering the largest part of the expenses, then the line manager of the project manager is the approver instead.-No Self-approval for Cost Center/ PRO manager:-Standard with exception for both cost center and project managers: this is the combination of item 3 & 4. Neither cost center managers nor project managers can self-approve expense reports claimed by themselves. Their line managers have to approve the expense report instead.-Before you apply the backend change, please make sure that the customer has maintained the default approval process for expense reports:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Approval Process view.-Click Approval Process for Expense Report.-Make sure that there is only One Step in Process Step.-Work Distributions needs to be set as 'Approver of Highest Cost' or 'Line Manager of Employee'.-The Conditions have to be 'Expense Report Approval Configuration Equal to Yes'.-Once the default is set and approval is granted, you can change the settings from the backend by following the below steps:-Go to the back-end system.-Run the transaction code SE38.-Enter the report ERM_SET_APPROVAL_SWITCH and Execute.-You can see the current ERM approval settings.-Select the desired option.-Click Execute.-No message will shows in the screen, but you can confirm the change on 'Current ERM approval settings'.-Note: There is no frontend user interface for customer to select the approver determination mechanism. The customer has to create an incident, in the incident explicitly specifying which approval mechanism they'd like to use and granting SAP the permission to change backend data if you want to change the approver determination mechanism rather than standard.-See Also-1944022 - Change Default Approver Determination For Expense Reports-1874937 - How to Update Existing Expense Report Approval Process-1665922 - How to Find the Current Expense Report Approver Determination Setting-2014502 - Multi-Step Approval Of Expense Report Is Not Released for Business ByDesign-2543238 - Approval Process for Expense Reports and How To Change it

Title: Cannot Change Date of Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You create and save a Bank Statement, but enter a wrong Statement Date. You want to change the Statement Date, however, the system does not allow you to change it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view, and find the Bank Statement in question which is still In Preparation.-Select View button to open the bank statement.-Try to change the Statement Date, however, system doesn't allow you to change it.-Cause-The Payment Allocations already exist for the bank statement. Therefore the system doesn't allow you to change the bank statement to avoid inconsistencies.-Resolution-The solution is to cancel the Payment Allocations and then you are able to change the Statement Date.-The solution is only for bank statements created manually (does not apply for uploaded bank statements).-Keywords-Bank Statement Date; posting date; payment allocation

Title: How Marketing Consent Works in Target Group Member Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You have maintained E-Mail as Disallowed status in Contact master data - Marketing Consent tab.-When maintaining member for a new target group, this contact is still be found even you have set the Channel Permission as Allowed in the search filter.-Environment- ByD 2008-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Marketing work center.-Create new Target Group.-Go to step:Select Memeber.-Show Corporate Accounts with Contacts view.-Select Channel Permission as "E-Mail Allowed" in Corporation Account section.-Click GO, you can see the contact ABC is listed in the result.  (ABC represents the ID of a contact)-Open the contact ABC master data, you will see the E-Mail is set as Disallowed in Marketing Consent.-You expect that this contact should not be allowed for mail channel and should not be listed in the result.-Cause-In target group member selection, you can set permission filter on corporate level or/and contact level.-The Channel Permission in Corporate Account section, considers the channel permission maintained in Account master data - marketing consent - channel table/list.-In Contact section, Contact Permission checks the general Contact Permission maintained in Contact master data (not the detailed channel permission for mail, post, etc)-In this case, the contact ABC belongs to account XYZ where channel permission is set to Allowed for E-Mail in the Marketing Consent tab. And the search filter is set on corporate level, hence, contact ABC is found and listed. (XYZ represents the ID of an account)-Resolution-You have to set proper permission in Account and Contact master data, then use the permission in target group member maintenance to get the expected result.-Keywords-marketing consent; chennel permission; contact permission; target group

Title: How to make the Time Series variable for Employee Times or Time Accounts reports?
Content: Symptom-You run one of the standard Employee Times or Time Accounts reports. You would like to choose a Time Series other than the preconfigured ones. For example, by default the Employee Times: Weekly report provides information on planned and recorded employee times in the last 4 weeks. You would however like to have a variable time range selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Time Administration-Select view Reports: List -Find the report Employee Times: Weekly-There is no variables selection for the time series. The report is executed without any variables selection.-Cause-The Employee Times or Time Accounts reports are configured with a fixed Time Series, in this example planned and recorded employee times in the last 4 weeks.-Resolution-In order to have a variable date selection according to above given example please create a customer report by following these steps:-Go to work center Business Analytics and select the view Design Reports.-Select New > Report.-In step 1 of the report wizard choose the data source Employee Times (HCMTLMU01).-In step 2 choose only the Key Figures you want to display (e.g. Recorded Time, Planned Working Time), but do not choose Time Series.-In step 3 choose only the Characteristics you want to display, but make sure to include characteristic Key Date.-In step 4 define a variable for the value selection of characteristic Key Date (Value Selection > Using Variable).-In step 5 configure this variable as Mandatory and choose Selection Type > Any Selection for possible entries. You may as well Maintain a Default Value that is used during startup of the report.-Finish the report definition. Assign the report to a corresponding work center and view (e.g. Time Administration -> Employees). Please note: It is important to mark the Key Date as mandatory since without this variable, the report may easily time out due to a high, unrestricted data volume. -Create a default layout and startup settings for the report as per your preferences. Make sure to include the characteristic Calendar Year/Week in columns or rows.-Generate the report from the assigned work center and choose an appropriate Operator for the Advanced Select Value Help of the variable Key Date (e.g. ...Between).-Keywords-time series, time line, zeitreihe, employee times, time accounts, weekly, monthly, yearly, aggregated, key date, variable, reports, business analytics
