Title: Error in Day Closure Run: “Creation of period closure date for employee XYZ failed. No valid offsetting acct found for source account ABC (YYYY.MM.DD - YYYY.MM.DD) on YYYY.MM.DD”
Content: Symptom-You are trying to execute correction run for Employee  XYZ (where XYZ represents the Employee) in Time Administration and system throws error messages that prevents you to Save it.-Creation of period closure date for employee XYZ failed. No valid offsetting acct found for source account ABC (YYYY.MM.DD - YYYY.MM.DD) on YYYY.MM.DD-*XYZ represents the Employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select the Regular Tasks view-Select Run Day Closure-Choose the Employee  XYZ and Set Period Closure Date-Select Save-Cause-Period End Rules for the Time Profile was not set to zero.-The error occurs because a back dated configuration change is made to the Time Account Period End Rules.-The Employee's Time Profile for the dates specified in the error does not have the Time Account assigned. Hence, it is unable to receive any balances as per the period end processing rules.-You need to identify, if you have intentionally unassigned the Time Account for the periods specified or if you do not require the Time Account assigned to the Employee for the time period specified.-Resolution-If you do not want the Time Account assigned to the employee going forward, then, set the Period End Rules for the Time Profile DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY for Employee XYZ to Set to Zero using the below steps. This will set the value for the year YYYY to zero.-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for Employee XYZ -Go to Time Profile tab-Select the Time Profile having the Start Date DD.MM.YYYY – End Date DD.MM.YYYY-Go to tab Time Account Rules-Select the Time Account ABC (where ABC represents the Time Account)-Go to tab Period End Rules and select Adjust Rules-Select the Posting Type Set to Zero-Select Save and Close -Else, if you want the Time Account included, then you have to assign the Time Account to the Employee's Time File.-Keywords- Creation of period closure date, Period End Rules

Title: Unable to Update Indicator Fields in Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are unable to update Indicator fields using the Mass Data Maintenance to value false (empty).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select the data object that you want to export.-Export the data.-Change the Indicator field from true (X) to false (empty).-Import the date back to the system using Mass Data Maintenance.-The new value for the field will not be updated in the UI.-Cause-Indicator fields are Boolean fields that can either have a true value — represented in Mass Data Maintenance and the Migration workbench as X — or a false value, which is when the field is empty.-The Mass Data Maintenance is a tool designed with the intention to update data already in the system. It ignores empty fields by default and because of that, changing an Indicator field from true (X) to false will not be interpreted by the tool, as the new value (empty) will not be considered a change.-Furthermore, standard Indicator fields (such as Main Contact in Account) will not even be shown to export in the Mass Data Maintenance.-Resolution-As workaround, please use the migration methods Modify or Replace Already Existing Records if they are available in the migration of the business object you are working with.-In case they are not available, use the web service related to this business object. You can find the necessary code list information in the SAP Global Data Type Catalog under the "See Also" section.-See Also-SAP Global Data Type Catalog-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, Indicator, Update-indicator,update

Title: Cannot Access Update Inventory Cost Run From Manual Update Inventory Cost Source Document
Content: Symptom-You are reviewing your journal entries and notice a posting with-          - Journal Entry Type: Manual Change of Material Cost-          - Related Source Document Type: Update Inventory Costs-You click the Source Document ID of this posting, expecting to navigate to the respective Update Inventory Cost run. However, the screen only displays the manual changes made. -To double-check this run you navigate to the Update Inventory Costs view in the Inventory Valuation work center. However, here you cannot find the run ID of this manual change either. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Find the concerned journal entry.-Click the Source Document ID: A list displaying the parameters of the manual changes is displayed. But you expect to navigate to the relevant Update Inventory Cost run. -Cause-The source document ID of the manual inventory cost change launches a table listing all parameters of this change to verify the resulting inventory valuation update.-Since this run is not created manually by a business user, but rather the result of a manual change of a material's inventory cost, the run's log is not listed in the Update Inventory Cost view of the Inventory Valuation work center. The actual Update Inventory Cost run in Inventory Valuation is used to overwrite material inventory costs based on the selected source cos type.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Manual Change of Material Cost, Update Inventory Cost, Update Inventory Cost run

Title: 'Revaluation is already done, Action Post_Adjustment not permitted' Warning Message in Actual Cost Allocation Run
Content: Symptom-You are executing the Actual Cost Allocation Run and there is a warning message 'Revaluation is already done, Action Post_Adjustment not permitted.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Actual Cost Allocation view.-Select the Run ID AAA (AAA represents the Run ID) and click View.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-Notice the warning message: 'Revaluation is already done, Action Post_Adjustment not permitted.'-Cause-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select the view Material Actual Costing and enter the Material ID in Question.-There is already an entry line with the posting status Posted, which updated the Allocation Amount.-Resolution-It is not possible to execute the actual cost rollup run and actual cost allocation run again for the Posted actual costing results. Any transactional data correction done after executing the allocation run for a given period must get adjusted by posting a manual correction.-Keywords-ACAR; actual cost allocation run; actual costing; revaluation; post_adjustment-acar,post_adjustment,actual costing,revaluation,actual cost allocation run

Title: External Reference Field Is Not Filled on Report Open VAT / Sales Tax Items
Content: Symptom-When creating a new charge / credit document and fill document using an external reference, you realize that document is not being shown under Report Open VAT / Sales Tax Items (Report ID: FINTAXU09_Q0001) not showing Customer Supplier Tax ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Customer Accounts View.-Search for Customer Account ABC (ABC stands for related Customer Account).-Create a new charge / credit.-Fill the document referring a related external reference.-Checking that document created has external reference.-Then check Report below:-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports.-Open the Open VAT / Sales Tax Items report.-Then, add external reference field.-External reference is not available.-Cause-The reason why you are not able to see this field is that documents of type Receivables / Payables entry, which are charge or credits, are not available under Open VAT / Sales Tax Items report. The source document field would have to be used to identify the document.-Resolution-This is current a system limitation. Report will show external reference when Type of external reference document is Invoices.-Keywords-external reference missing;-open VAT / Sales Tax Items

Title: Warehouse Confirmations Are Posting To General Ledger Account Gain/Loss From Purchase Price Differences Instead Of Inventory Account
Content: Symptom-You have posted a warehouse confirmation and expected that the value gets posted inventory general ledger account but instead it is posting to Gain/ Loss from Purchase Price Differences that is maintained under differences tab in the inventory sub-ledger.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Find the Journal Entry AAA (AAA indicates journal entry ID) and click view (Journal Entry type: Goods Receipt from Supplier; Source Document: Warehouse confirmation).-Click View and you will notice that there is certain amount to a G/L account which is from (Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination > Account Determination > Inventory > Differences) instead you expect that amount should only be posted to inventory account.-The journal entry of an affected document could look as follows:-Finished Product account Debit: 100.00-Purchase in Transit account Credit: 75.00-Gain/Loss from Purchase Price Differences account Credit: 25.00-Cause-Resulting Inventory Quantity / On-hand inventory quantity is zero as a result system has posted the purchase order price difference with inventory to the Gain/Loss from Purchase Price Difference G/L Account.-Resolution-The goods receipt updates the inventory cost with the value required at this point in time (mixed price).-The goods issue is posted with the value applicable at this point in time.-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Materials view and select the material XYZ (XYZ represents the material).-Click View Cost History.-Find the warehouse confirmation line and against the same line look for Resulting Inventory Quantity.-At the time of posting of this warehouse confirmation, the stock has got adjusted as there were already some goods issue posted before and with this goods receipt the remaining on-hand stock is zero. To further calculate the purchase price difference and it to the inventory cost itself due to the moving average method applied, system tries to valuate the differences to add it to the inventory but due to the situation that the on-hand stock (Resulting Inventory Quantity) resulting is zero, system posts the differences to the G/L Purchase Price Difference.-See Also-1911776 - Using the moving average cost for material valuation-Keywords-moving average cost calculation during warehouse confirmation posting.-moving average,warehouse confirmation posting to invent,purchase price difference instead of inv,resulting inventory cost

Title: Journal Entry External Reference ID Not Populating in the Journal Report
Content: Symptom-The Journal Entry External Reference is not populating in the Journal report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Journal report.-Enter the desired values on the Selection Screen and select GO.-Add some characteristics in order to fill the report with some data. For example, Journal Entry, Posting Date, G/L Account and Journal Entry Type.-Make sure the characteristics Source Document External Reference and External Reference ID (Journal Entry) are also visible in the report. (Note: the External Reference ID can be added via the Add Field function).-You notice that the Source Document External Reference and External Reference ID (Journal Entry) are shown as # (Not assigned) in the report.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed.-Resolution-The Journal report will display the External Reference values, for a Journal Entry, only if it is available from the Journal Entry document.-Usually the External Reference number is generated for Supplier or Customer Invoice Journal Entry Type so unless the Journal Entry matches these criteria the External Reference values will be shown as # (Not assigned) in the report.-The best way to check if the External Reference value is available on the Journal Entry is to navigate to the Journal Entry ID directly from the report.-Keywords-Journal entry, external reference, missing data, reporting, FINGLAU03_Q0001, journal entries

Title: How To Export Security Policy and Business User Details
Content: Symptom- You want to export a list of Information of Security Policy and Business User related.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Search for the User Logon Details Report.-Let the default selection be there and click the "click here to start the report".-After the results are fetched, click the View tab and then the plus symbol on the Row Fields and add the Row "Security Policy".-The above step should now have fetched all the data related to the users and their security policy and then these details can either be printed or shared.-Keywords-Security Policy; Export; Business User; Policies;

Title: Foreign Amount in Report Differs from Source Document Amount
Content: Symptom-You have posted documents in foreign currency. The journal entry of such documents does the currency exchange in order to hit the G/L Accounts in company currency. However, when executing the G/L Accounts - Line Item report you change the Display Currency to the foreign currency and the Display Currency Date to the exchange rate date considered in the journal entry. However, the converted figures in the report differ from the original transaction currency in the source document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center-Go to List view-Open the G/L Account - Line Item report-Change the Display Currency to e.g. USD and Display Currency Date as per source journal entry your are looking for in the report.-When executing the report the figures shown in USD are not equal to the amounts in the source document (in USD).-Cause-In order to better explain this scenario let's assume foreign currency as USD and company currency as EUR and a journal entry created on 05.04.2015-When you open the journal entry of the source document, you see that posting date is 03.04.2015 and exchange rate is 0,933, hence 1000,00 USD are 933,00 EUR in this example.-You need to check the exchange rate maintained in the system, as follows:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Click Edit Exchange Rates.-Click View Exchange Rate History.-Search for source currency as USD and target currency EUR.-In the returned list, search for the Valid From period that encompasses the posting date of the journal entry. Be aware that you must also consider the Created On column for the exchange rate validity. For the given posting date 03.04.2015 the system derived the exchange rate that is Valid From 01.04.2015. Such validity entry was created on 02.04.2015 hence at that date (05.04.2015) the valid exchange rate for 03.04.2015 is the entry from 01.04.2015 -> 0,933-After creating and posting the journal entry, the responsible user updated the exchange rate USD -> EUR to 0,988 with an entry valid from 03.04.2015. This entry was created on e.g. 20.04.2015-As for the G/L Account - Line Items report. When you specify the Display Currency - Conversion Date as 03.04.2015, the system will - today - look for the current currency exchange rate from USD to EUR for the date 03.04.2015. In this case, since the exchange rate with Valid From 03.04.2015 is already created, the system will uses the rate 0,988 and hence the amounts looks different. Since the journal entry used the exchange rate from 01.04.2016 as explained above.-Resolution-To check the G/L posting in the transaction currency, instead of changing the Display Currency, you shall add the Credit Amount Transaction Currency and Debit Amount Transaction Currency key figures, which can be included in the report as follows:-Open the report.-Click Settings -> Key Figures.-Highlight the mentioned key figures.-Move them to the Selected area.-Click OK.-Click GO.-The transaction currency key figures correctly reflect the foreign currency amount when the document was posted. The Display Currency is then subject to different exchange rates maintained in different dates.-Keywords-Line item Currency. Transaction Currency. G/L Acocunts - Line items. General Ledger. Exchange Rate.

Title: Premium Pay Data is Not Displayed in the Time Statement Report
Content: Symptom-You've created a company-specific Premium Pay Code and recorded time using this code. When running the Time Statement report you expect to see the recorded time under the Premium Pay section of the report, but this doesn't happen.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services > Self-Services Overview view.-Under Time section, click View Time Statement.-Select the concerned period (Month, Year, Start Date and End Date).-Click Preview.-Notice that the time recording you made with the respective Premium Pay Code assignment is not present under the Premium Pay section of the report.-Cause-When creating your company-specific Premium Pay Code in the fine-tuning activity Premium Pay - <Country> (e. g. Premium Pay - Germany) you have ticked the option Regular Time. When this option is marked the time recorded will be listed in the Day Overview section of the Time Statement report instead of coming in Premium Pay section.-Resolution-If you wish to give a premium pay for this time type then you have to uncheck the Regular Time option in the fine-tuning activity:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select your current project.-Click Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Search and open the respective Premium Pay - <Country> activity.-Click Maintain Premium Pay Type.-Select the respective Premium Pay Code and uncheck the Regular Time option.-Save your changes.-As a result the recorded time will be displayed in the Premium Pay section of the Time Statement report.

Title: How to Perform a Mass Extraction of Business Document Attachments
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have attached files with different formats (.CSV, .PDF, .MSG, .DOC etc) to some of your business documents e. g. Customer Invoice, Project Task etc. You want to perform a mass download of all the existing attachments from your system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select the invoice ID ABC and click Edit - View All.-Go to the General tab and select the Attachments sub-tab below.-You can download your attachment by using the Download button.-OR:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view.-Select the project ID DEF and click Edit - Project Plan.-Select the Gantt Chart sub-tab in order to display the corresponding project tasks.-Select the project task ID DEF-x and select the Attachments sub-tab below.-You can download your attachment by using the Download button.-This is the only possibility to download your attachments using the front end and these steps have to be performed for each and every business document in your system. Since you have a large number of business documents, this operation can be extremely time-consuming. You can not find any possibility to perform a mass download. This also applies to other attachments from other work centers in the Business ByDesign system.-    Cause-This is a known issue in SAP Business ByDesign. It is not possible to perform a mass download of the attachments by using the front end.-Resolution-A mass download of the business documents can only be performed from the backend, if you receive such requests from your customer. Please forward this type of request to hosting and the colleagues will perform the data extraction for you. They can use the report DMC_EXT_ATTACHMENT_BYD for this purpose.

Title: Cannot Find Account Determination Group for Product Category ABC for a Limit Item
Content: Symptom-You notice that a Purchase Order ABC (where ABC stands for the Purchase Order ID)  is showing up under Unposted Source Documents with the error message: Cannot Find Account Determination Group for Product Category XYZ (XYZ stand for the Category ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Show Unposted Source Documents list.-Select the row of the respective Purchase Order.-Notice the error message: Cannot find account determination group for product category XYZ.-Cause-In the purchase order you find an item with product type Limit.-Limit items are items that are assigned a maximum value limit rather than a price in a purchase document. A limit item is used in a shopping cart or purchase order when you do not know the details of the material or service you want or the quantity that you need.-When creating a limit item in a shopping cart or purchase order, a material, service, or related expense is not specified. This information is entered later in the goods and services receipt or supplier invoice. For example, if a service, such as a repair, needs to be done, but you do not know how many hours it will take, you can add a limit item to the purchase order and assign the maximum amount that the repair can cost.-The Purchase order doesn’t have Product Type details hence the system is failed to populate the product type since the Purchase order has the limit item.-  Resolution-Please check if there is a reference document like a Goods and Service Receipt for this item. In the Goods and Services Receipts and in the relevant Supplier Invoices here you need to enter the Product Type (material, service), Product ID (if available), delivered quantity, net price, and delivery date, service period, or expense period.-If there is a Goods and Services Receipt, then the Supplier Invoice will already contain all of the details of the limit item then it will pull the Product Type.-  See Also-Please see also Help document: Limit Items.-Keywords-purchase order, Bestellung, account determination, product category, Kontenfindungsgruppe für Produktkategorie nicht gefunden

Title: Indicator Field Unintentionally Unchecked After Migration
Content: Symptom-While updating records using the Migration tool, you have noticed tha an indicator field was unchecked by the migration despite no change having been done to said field in the migration template used.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-The indicator fields are Boolean fields, which can be checked (true) or unchecked (false). In the migration tool, this is represented by an X or a blank field. As such, when updating data using the migration tool, if a field is blank, the system will interpret this as setting the field to false.-This behavior applies to all indicator fields (standard or custom) for all migration objects. The system overwrites indicator field selections every time an existing record is enhanced and migrated.-Resolution-If you wish to retain the relevant selections in the system, you must maintain them again while enhancing the record. For example, to retain a particular customer as a prospect in the system, you must maintain the value X in the Prospect field before migrating the enhanced record.-Keywords-Indicator field, Removed, Unchecked, Checkbox, Prospect, Customer, Migration-indicator field,migration

Title: Ship-To Field in the Open Sales Orders Migration Template
Content: Symptom-You have maintained multiple ship-to addresses in the account master. When importing open sales orders by using migration template 'Open Sales Orders', you want to select different ship-to address of the account in item level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have downloaded "Open Sales Orders Migration Template" from Business Configuration work center.-Open the file and go to Items sheet. You are able to see the ship-to field on item level.-You want to know hwo to put the different ship-to address of the account on item.-Cause-The field Ship-to is a party ID instead of address details. System picks the address of Ship-to marked as Standard from this party ID. If it is not filled then it defaults to the account party ID.-It is not possible to select any other Ship-To address if the customer account has more than one Ship-To set.-Resolution-This the current system design.-Keywords-Migration of Open Sales Orders; Ship-To; Migrate; Sales Orders; Item

Title: Asset Under Construction Settlement Run Finishes With Message: There Are No Settlements To Be Posted For The Current Selection
Content: Symptom-You have executed an Asset under Construction Settlement Run expecting the system to settle the values from an Asset under Construction (AuC) into a final asset.-However, while checking the Messages tab of the respective run you notice the information message: There are no settlements to be posted for the current selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view Settlement subview.-Open the respective AuC Settlement Run.-Go to the Messages tab.-You can see the information message: There are no settlements to be posted for the current selection.-Cause-Among other reasons, the error message might have been thrown because the AuC you selected in the Data Selection of the run comes from data migration.-For AuC settlement the cost to be posted to final fixed asset should only come via a cost posting (not-migration), so it has to be a real cost posted into the system via a project task which is assigned to the AuC.-The costs which are posted to the AuC through any other way other than through a project task would not get settled into the final fixed asset.-Resolution-If the assumption raised in the section above fits to your case (meaning you have executed the Settlement Run for a migrated Asset under Construction), to transfer the costs to a fixed asset you can do a manual transfer from AuC to the fixed asset, instead of a settlement run.-Keywords-settlement run, Asset under Construction, account determination group, no postings

Title: Error Message : Determination Of Withholding Tax Code Failed for Country India Tax Event Withholding.
Content: Symptom-While posting supplier invoice with Withholding Tax code you get an error message: Determination Of Withholding Tax Code Failed for Country India Tax Event Withholding-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-2. Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-3. Select option All Documents in  Show field and type your desired document ID in Find field and click the Go button.-4. Select your document ID and click the Edit button.-5. Click View All button, go to Items tab.-6. Check line items where Tax code has chosen as 2 - Non Taxable Acquisition (Service).-7. Go to the Withholding Tax Details sub tab and you can see that system has automatically populated the Tax Rate as **%.-8. Click Check button and you get this error message:-Item 2: Determination of withholding tax code failed for country India tax event Withholding Tax--Cause-In the supplier master you have defined combination of Withholding Income Tax with Tax Rate Type as Others. But the same combination you have not maintained in the Business Configuration, under the activity Withholding Tax – India.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click Overview view.- Search for activity Withholding Tax - India, click Go button.-Click Open button.-You can see all withholding tax codes active currently.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune tab and select the activity Withholding Tax - India, click Go button.-Click Open button.-Click Check withholding tax codes, click Add Row and create your desired tax code under Available Tax Codes.-Go to Details tab and define your desired Tax Type, Tax Rate Type and Income Type.-Finally click Save and Close button.-Keywords-No Withholding tax, withholding tax empty, withholding tax not appearing

Title: Reporting Line Unit Manager is Displaying in Personnel File Instead of Cost Center Manager
Content: Symptom-You, as a personnel administrator, find that the Manager field in employee's personnel file actually shows the Reporting Line Unit manager of the employee, who may be different from his/her Cost Center manager.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-This is expected system behavior. Because, the personnel file always displays the Reporting Line unit not the Cost Center Manager.--If you flag an org unit as a reporting line unit then the manager of the org unit is a personnel manager. A personnel manager is responsible for employees’ work center assignments, personnel-related tasks, and purchasing approvals.--If no manager is assigned to a reporting line unit, the manager assigned to the next reporting line unit above it in the org structure takes on the responsibilities of the personnel manager.-Keywords-incorret, wrong

Title: You Are not Able to Mark the Checkbox Expense for a Service Item After Saving
Content: Symptom-You create a document with services Expense - Fixed price without actuals-When you add the service in a new sales order you get the error message-'Service product and item type code do not match.'-'Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To the Sales Order Workcenter.-Go To the New Sales Order View.-Fill out the mandatory data.-Go to the items tab and choose a service expense -Fixed price without actuals.-Now you see the error message:-'Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa'-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Services view.-Select All Services in the Show field.-Select and Edit service ID: Service: ABC (represents the service ID)-Go to the Sales Tab.-In Item Group field you can see the actual value to Fixed price without actuals-Go to General Tab.-Here you can see that the expense field is not marked as expense in the service master data.-Cause-The error message occurs because the item type of the service is XFIX - Expense - fixed price without actuals, but the Expense flag is not ticked in the service master data. Once a service is saved it is not possible to mark a service product as an expense service any more.-Resolution-You have to create a new service with the marked expense field.-Keywords-Service, Service product, Item Code, Fixed price, Festpreis, Checkbox

Title: Automatic Allocation of Self-Initiated Payments to Customer or Supplier Account instead of Payment Assignment
Content: Symptom-You created self initiated payments (for example, incoming direct debit) for customers (for example, by executing the receivables payment run). When uploading a bank statement reflecting those transactions you notice that these payments are not allocated to the corresponding customer account in the payment allocation tab Customer/Supplier. The same applies to outgoing direct debit payments to suppliers.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can access relevant payment allocation either in:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant payment allocation.-- or via the posted bank statement.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Open the Bank Statements view.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and edit.-Follow the link Postprocessing required to access the relevant payment allocation.-The relevant payment allocation is in status In Preparation.-Cause-Self-initiated payments, like incoming direct debit, are not intended to be posted against the business partner account since the actual payments are expected to be recorded in the system already. Instead the bank transactions should be matched and allocated against those candidate payments in the payment allocation.-There are however scenarios where self-initiated payments are supposed to be automatically allocated and cleared against a corresponding business partner account. In case the self-initiated payment has been executed in a previous legacy system this requirement might occur. In order to facilitate such a process the matching of external transaction code and applied payment method will have to be adjusted.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center and navigate to Fine Tuning.-Choose the activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements / Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Highlight the relevant Import Format (for example, MT940 UK).-In the bottom pane - definitions for External Transaction Codes and their corresponding Payment Methods are listed. For the External Transaction Code representing Direct Debit, Debit/Credit: Decrease/Increase - the Payment Method would have to be changed from Payment Processing - Of Outgoing Direct Debit or Payment Processing - Of Incoming Direct Debit to Outgoing Bank Transfer or Incoming Bank Transfer respectively. After uploading a bank statement and depending on applied matching rules defined in the activity Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines an automatic payment allocation and/or clearing against Customer/Supplier instead of Payment Assignment will be possible.-Keywords-automatic allocation, self initiated payments, payment assignment

Title: Cannot Edit the Time Sheet for Service Agent
Content: Symptom-You are trying to access the service agent time sheets to verify the hours entered against the project. However Edit Time Sheet button is grayed out in the Service Agents screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2005 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Service Agents view.-Select the relevant Service Agent.-Edit Time Sheet button is grayed out.-Cause-The user role was changed from Employee to Service Agent, or vice versa. In this case, the Time Recordings of the Service Agent are not accessible via Edit Time Sheet button.-Other Possibilities: Also system makes the Edit Time Sheet button inactive in the service agent screen:-If the service agent has not time agreement.-If the service agent is/was an internal employee.-If a service agent is no more internal employee it should not be possible to confirm the time through the service agent screen. Means if employee is converted in to service agent.-Resolution-The Employee can log in the system with his business user and follow steps below:-Go to the Home work center.-Go to ESS Timesheet.-Here the Employee can go all the way back to when he/she was still a Service Agent/Employee. -The Employee will be able to see the time recordings as well and make new ones. These time recordings will then go for approval and will be booked once it's approved by the manager.-Note: Please be reminded that these time recordings have to be approved by the approver as none of these recordings will show up in the Time administration work center.-Keywords-Service Agent, Time Sheet, Grayed Out, Time Recording, Time Administration, Record Times.

Title: Different Fixed Asset's Amount Being Posted to Each Set of Books
Content: Symptom-An asset is being retired via complete scrapping.-Asset's retirement must be posted for both (or more) of the company's set of books, however it's noticed that the amount being posted to the 'Loss from Fixed Asset Retirement - Account' differs from one set of books to another.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Highlight the concerned asset.-Click Manual Posting -> Complete Scrapping-Fill in the required data and simulate the Journal Entry.-Analyze the G/L Account postings in the simulated journal entries and notice different amounts for the set of books.-Cause-There are different depreciation methods assigned to the set of book's valuation views.-The difference in the loss values account is due to the period control settings for the corresponding depreciation methods, which behave differently depending on the kind of transaction (Retirement, Transfer, Acquisition and others) and period control method.-For example: the retirement being posting on 31.12.2015 (after mid-period).-In case the depreciation method for set of books XXX has a period control method 02, the period control key considered for a Retirement posting is 02-Pro rata up to mid period at period start.-This period control key states that the postings till mid-period only would be included for the current period's depreciation calculation.-However, the other set of books, YYY, has a depreciation method with period control method 01, hence a period control key for Retirement posting is 01-Pro rata at period start date, which, as per definition, includes the scrapping (retirement) posting within that period even if the posting happens on 31st.-Therefore, the difference is justifiable. For set of books XXX, the system calculates the depreciation for December as the scrapping (after mid-period) is not considered in this accounting period, which result is a smaller net book value rather than on set of books YYY, where the depreciation is not calculated for this period since the scrapping is considered even with posting on 31st.-Resolution-The system works as designed. -For further information consult SAP Help Portal - Period Control Methods and Keys-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Depreciation, Acquisition, Set of Books.

Title: Custom Payment File Structure has Header/Footer for Each Payment ID
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom payment file structure, however, when creating the output file for the payments you notice that the system creates one header and one footer for each payment transaction.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Assuming that you have already created the payment structure, performed the required master data mapping and setup, created the payment orders and triggered the outbound file creation, then:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Outbound Files view-Open the concerned files.-Download the payment file.-When you open file, you notice that there is one header and one footer for each payment document-Illustration:-//begin of file-HEADER-TRANSACTION-FOOTER-HEADER-TRANSACTION2-FOOTER-//end of file-Cause-You have adjusted the granularity of the payment media format so that a new logical message within the same file is open for each payment ID.-Resolution-If this is not the intended behavior, you may adjust it via below steps:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to Implementation Projects view-Open the activity list-Open activity Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Click Edit payment medium formats-Highlight the concerned payment medium format that uses your file structure.-Click tab Sort Sequence and Granularity of payments-Set up the sequence so that a new logical message is not created for each payment document ID-After saving your changes, you need to re-create the bank transfers and generate the outbound file.-Keywords-Payment File Structure, Payment medium Format,

Title: Bank Account Prioritization by Payment Currency
Content: Symptom-You have set up a prioritization rule for bank account based on amount and currency, however the system is not deriving the correct bank account based on these rules.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open the activity Global Settings for Payments.-Click Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods based on Amount.-In this screen, you have set up rules as follows:-Seq. Company Amount Payment Method Bank Account ID-1 * GE (0.00 USD) <Add> XXX-2 * GE (0.00 EUR) <Add> YYY-3 * GE (0.00 GBP) <Add> ZZZ-However, when e.g. creating an automatic payment for 50.00 EUR and 55.00 GBP instead of selecting bank accounts YYY and ZZZ respectively the system uses bank account XXX-Cause-The functionality of the prioritization of bank accounts based on Amount does not support currency code. It only works based on amount.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. There is no workaround to to set up the system to recommend a bank account for specific payment based on currency only.-Only by setting up the bank account in the bank master data would be enough to direct e.g. EUR payments to an EUR account, however this is not the only rule to be considered when finding a bank account. The house bank account is determined considering other aspects also like payers bank account, payers bank country, liquidity check, etc. and not purely by payment currency.

Title: Business User is Getting Created for Every New Internal Employee
Content: Symptom-You created/hired an internal employee in your system and observed that a business user was automatically created for it. Your expectation is that a user is only created when explicitly required, not by default.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Administrator work center;-Click the Employee link;-Create new employee;-Save the employee;-Back in the Administrator work center, click the Business Users link;-Searching for the created employee, you can see a business user was created for it.-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center;-Click the Hire Employee link;-Proceed with the hiring process;-Once done, go to the Application and User Management work center;-Click the Business Users link;-Searching for the hired employee, you can see a business user was created for it.-Cause-For internal employees, a business user is always created by default. These users don't count for the license fee calculation as they are not automatically valid — they only count if the validity is adopted, business roles get assigned, etc.-For external employees such as service agents and partner contacts, the user creation only happens on request.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Business User, Employee, Creation

Title: How to Change Signature Algorithm for SSO Functionality
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This document will guide you on how to Change Signature Algorithm for C4C/BYD tenants.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-By default, signature algorithm for C4C or BYD cloud application is set to SHA-1 and due to some inconsistency it cannot be changed via UI frontend.-Resolution-Login to C4C/BYD tenant.-Open a new browser tab with Link https://<C4C/BYD Host>/sap/bc/webdynpro/sap/saml2.-Navigate to Trusted Providers.-Navigate to Signature and Encryption.-Click Edit and navigate Digest Algorithm.-In Drop Down Select SHA-256.-Save.- Keywords-signature algorithm , SHA-1 , SHA-2, SSO-signature algorithm,sha-1

Title: Certificate Trust List Chain Incomplete
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded your certificate in Edit Certificate Trust List view. You have successfully uploaded the certificate but there is Chain Incomplete mark on your certificate. So you want to know what this mark indicates and how can this be corrected.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer and SA-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Administrator--> Common Tasks.-Select Edit Certificate Trust List view.-Click Upload.-Click Browse.-Select your certificate.-Click Open and Add.-Even though the message Certificate successfully uploaded is shown, the Chain Incomplete is marked on your certificate.-Cause-The certificate signed by (Certification Authorities) will have Root, Intermidiate and Child as the hierarchy.-So, based on the certificate which you uploaded, you need to upload the other 2 certificates for the chain to be completed.-Resolution-In your computer double click on your certificate.-Select Certification Path tab.-Verify how many certificates there are in the chain above your certificate and follow the step 4 on for each Certification Authority certificate you see in the certification path.-Select the Certification Authority certificate.-Click on View Certificate button.-Select Details tab.-Click on Copy to File button.-Follow the Certificate Export Wizard to copy the certification authority certificate and save it to your disk.-In the system navigate to Application and User Management.-Select Edit Certificate Trust List view.-Click Upload.-Click Browse.-Select the Certification Authority certificate you have exported previously.-Click Open and Add.-Your certificate appears now in the Certificate Trust List under its certification authority certificate without the chain incomplete mark.-Keywords-Certificate upload, Edit certificate trust list

Title: CRM Scenario: Expense - Time and Material (Project) in Sales Order
Content: Symptom- This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Expense - Time and Material (Project) item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Prerequisite to do Project Based Service/Product:-Edit Project Scope>Questions> Sales>Sell Project-Based Products and Services>Check question “You can sell project-based services.” And “You use sales orders to sell projects.”-1. Release Sales Order.-If you input the project based service in the Sales Order and you want to release the Sales Order directly, error message “Order not released; No project task is assigned to item 10” will be displayed.-This is because a project based item has to have a project assigned to it.-2. Create a Project related to this Sales Order by clicking the button 'Create Project' on the top of the screen.-After creating the project, you can save and release the Sales Order without any errors. The Status of Sales Order changed to open while other status on item level remains Not Started and Project Status as “In Planning”.-3. Release the project.-Back to the respective Sales Order. Releasing assigned project won’t affect Salas Order’s header status as well as on item level.-Note : Since this item type is Expense - time and material (project), Neither Service Confirmation no time recording is needed via the project.-Expense related item is not available in Time Recording. -The invoicing amount is based on the actual expense recorded in responsible person’s expense report.-4. Fulfill the Expense Report.-Via Home Work Center>Self-Services>Expenses>New Expense Report-In this case, I input the expense as 200 Euro which is different from the original price in Sales Order. In the Expenses step, link the project task to the expense.-Save the Expense Report and submit to approval.-Login as approver and approve Expense Report via Manage My Area >Approvals-5. Generate Project Inovice Request via Customer Invoicing work center -> Project Invoicing -> Projects view.-In the automatic generated project invoice, the List Price has been automatically fulfilled as 161.29 Euro. And you can find the total pricing as 200 Euro in Pricing sub tab.-The project details can be seen in Time and Expenses.-Save and release the Project Invoice Request.-6. Invoice the Project Invoice Request.-Back to the respective Sales Order. The header status changed to In Process. On the item level, the Invoice Status changed to In Process.-7. Complete delivery in Sales Order by completing related Project.-If you don’t have any expense to record in this project, you can complete the related project.-Back to the respective Sales Order, the Delivery Status changed to Finished.-8. Complete Invoicing via project invoice> Sales Orders> Change Status> Finish Invoicing.-Back to the respective Sales Order.-The header level of Sales Order has been changed to Completed as well as on item level.-Document flow as below:-See Also-KBA 2871686 - CRM Scenario: Expense - Fixed Price Without Actuals in Sales Order-KBA 2871738 - CRM scenario: Expense - Fixed Price (Project) in Sales Order-Keywords-Expense - Time and Material (Project); sales order; PXAT

Title: Completed Sales Orders Still Showing as Blocked in Sales Orders View
Content: Symptom-When checking the Blocked Sales Orders in your system, you notice that some of the Blocked documents are in Completed status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view. -Filter to Show Blocked Sales Orders.-You notice that the Blocked documents also include documents which are already Completed.-Cause-Since there is a Delivery Block in those Sales Order the Sales Orders appears in the Blocked Orders even though they are already completed.-Resolution-Follow these steps to see the Delivery Block which needs to be removed:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view. -Open Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the Blocked document with Completed status).-In the Delivery Section, find the field Delivery Block.-You will see the Delivery Block status of the document, which is what causes it to be shown among the Blocked Sales Orders.-Keywords-Blocked, Sales Order, Completed, Delivery Block

Title: How to collect Logs from ByDesign Excel Addin
Content: Symptom-This article will provide the steps on how to retrieve logs from Bydesign Excel Addin-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign and Excel-Cause-Possible scenario's for collecting logs:-Logon issue.-Installation issue-Resolution-Navigate to the tab SAP in Excel.-Click on Help.-Check the box "Increase Log level".-Reproduce the issue.-Now again, click on Help--> Show Log File Directory-Zip the logs folder-Attach it in the incident for further checks-Keywords-Bydesign Excel Logs

Title: After Fixed Asset Acquisition Posting, Depreciation is Calculated Differently for Each Set of Books
Content: Symptom-There's a company with two or more set of books and after posting a subsequent acquisition for a given asset, it's noticed that the calculated depreciation is different, between the set of books.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Find the relevant asset.-Click Edit -> Values.-Highlight the first set of books and check the Depreciation Overview tab for a specific fiscal fiscal year.-Highlight the second set of books and check the Depreciation Overview tab for the same fiscal year.-Notice that the depreciation amounts are different, even though all relevant dates and depreciation method are the same for both set of books.-Cause-Since the sets of books have different fiscal year variants, it may happen that the Capitalization Date of the asset falls in different fiscal years.-Whenever there is an acquisition posting, the system will compare the posting period of the acquisition with the posting period of the Capitalization Date. If the acquisition posting is in the same fiscal year as the Capitalization Date, then the depreciation calculation happens from the Depreciation Start Date.-Otherwise, if the acquisition posting is in a different fiscal year as the Capitalization Date, then the depreciation calculation will depend on the period control method/key for the depreciation method being used.-If the subsequent acquisition happens in the same fiscal year as the Capitalization Date it may also happen that the delta depreciation from previous periods gets cumulated in one period, depending on if the previous depreciation were posted and of periods are closed.-Resolution-The system works as designed for depreciation calculation for fixed assets.-See Also-KBA 2935106 - Fixed Asset Depreciation Differs Between the Existing Set of Books - SAP Business ByDesign -KBA 2265232 - Different Fixed Asset's Amount Being Posted to Each Set of Books-Keywords-Depreciation Difference. Depreciation Calculation. Depreciation Start Date. Depreciation Method. Depreciation Details. Acquisition. Period Control Method.

Title: Account Determination for Tax Payment
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Tax Payment against a Tax Return, and you want to understand the account determination of the Journal Entry posting. Why did the Tax Payment post to G/L Account XYZ (XYZ represents the GL Account code)?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select the view Tax Payments.-Select and open Tax Payment ABC (ABC represents the Tax Payment ID).-Click the Journal Entry ID DEF (DEF represents the Journal Entry ID).-You notice that the Journal Entry has posted to XYZ, when you expected it to post to GHI (GHI represents a GL Account code). GHI has been maintained in the Account Determination for TAX in Business Configuration.-Resolution-Tax Payment of a Tax Return does not use the account determination from Business Configuration activity Chart of Accounts: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Instead it looks at the Tax Return posting and the Tax Payment would post to the same G/L Account. The Tax Payment would just offset the accounts as given in the Journal Entry for the Tax Return.-If you look at the Tax Return Journal Entry, the G/L Accounts that were used should be the same that you can see in the Tax Payment Journal Entry.-Keywords-TAX, Tax Payment, Tax Account Determination, Tax Payment Account Determination

Title: Check Deposit Does Not Show to Be Confirmed in a Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You have a Check Deposit with status In Transfer, but it does not show to be confirmed in a Bank Statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks > New Bank Statement.-Complete the details.-Click Next.-The Check Deposit is not available for selection.-Cause-The currency of the Check is different than the currency of the Bank Account and no Exchange Rate has been maintained for these two currencies. So, in the payments inventory (Payment Register), the cash location amount is Zero.-These kind of transactions are not selected in step 2 of the Bank Statement.-Resolution-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to Common Tasks > New Bank Statement.-Complete the details.-Click Next until you reach the step 3.-Add the Bank Statement Item manually and click Required.-After this process, the original Check Deposit is displayed and allocated.-We also recommend to maintain the Exchange Rates in the system for future transactions.-Keywords-Check Deposit, Bank Satement, Incoing Check.

Title: How To Print the Employee Profile Form
Content: Symptom-You have seen the Employee Profile form in the Form Template Maintenance work center and would like to know from where in the system can you print or preview it.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Go to the Managing my Area work center.-Access the My Team work center view.-Open an employee record by clicking on its link.-In the employee details screen, click View All.-Once the screen loads with more details, click the Preview button.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Employee Profile, Print, Preview

Title: URL's that are required to configure SSO in IDP server
Content: Symptom-When configuring the C4C Tenant with SSO, there are certain configuration that needs to be done in IDP server as well such as-Audience Restriction-Assertion Consumer Service/ Receipient URL/ Destination URL-Single Logout Endpoint URL-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-These information are available in the SP Metadata file. The same has been indicated for your reference.-  NOTE: In certain cases, certain IDP might require slight changes in the mentioned URL's. At that time, it is best to check the IDP logs and modify the URL's accordingly.

Title: Financial Reporting Structures Missing for Year End Closing Report Run
Content: Symptom-You want to create a new Year-End Closing Report run but when trying to select the balance sheet and income statement structures nothing is being displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and select Export Year-End Closing File.-Press New- Year-End Closing Report Run.-Under Report Selection Data enter the Company, Set of Books, Fiscal Year and then select the Taxonomy.-Underneath in the Balance Sheet Structure as well as Income Statement Structure field there are no reporting structures available.-Cause-The financial reporting structures have not been assigned to the selected taxonomy.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Implementation Projects view, select the First Implementation Project and open the Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune phase, find the Electronic Financial Reporting activity and open it.  If your system is live you find this activity in the Overview. Press Change immediately to open and edit it.-Choose Edit taxonomies for electronic financial reporting.-In the top table select the respective Taxonomy ID.-In the table underneath maintain the Financial Reporting Structure Type(s) and assign the respective Financial Reporting Structure.-Press Save and Close.-It will now be possible to select the reporting structures for the Year-End Closing Report run.-

Title: Error Message When Posting Check Deposit
Content: Symptom-Error message when trying to post Check Deposit for currency XYZ:-'Account determination is missing for Cash. Define the account for chart of accounts ABC, tab Check Deposit - In Transit'.-XYZ means currency.-ABC means chart of accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Check Deposits sub view.-Open the Check Deposit DEF (DEF means the Check Deposit).-Try to release the same.-Error message is thrown: 'Account determination is missing for Cash. Define the account for chart of accounts ABC, tab Check Deposit - In Transit'.-Cause-The currency XYZ is not maintained in account determination.-Resolution-There are two possibilities to solve this issue:-Maintain the configuration for XYZ currency;-Maintain the configuration with the currency field blank. The blank entry means the default account determination if no other currency entry is found.-Check the following steps to maintain the correct configuration:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open the Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity List.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Navigate to the Account Determination section.-Select the Cash link.-Select the Account Determination Profile.-In the Cash Receipt - In Transit tab, click Add Row.-Maintain the account determination accordingly.-See Also-KBA 2032293 - Missing Account Determination for Cash Ledger When Posting a Bank Statement-KBA 2587056 - Bank Statement Posting - Account Determination is Missing for Cash-KBA 1822963 - Bank-to-Bank Transfer with Different Currencies - Account determination is missing for cash-Keywords-Cash Deposit, Charts of Accounts, Account Determination, Currency, Payment Method.

Title: Invalid Format of Dashboard name Under the Dashboards tab of a Business role
Content: Symptom-You want to know why there is an entry in the assigned dashboards at business role level with an invalid name.-You want to know if a dashboard is deleted from Manage Dashboards, will it be automatically removed from the Business roles to which it was assigned.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Insights Work center.-Open Manage Dashboards.-Delete the dashboard which is not required anymore.-Now go to Application and User Management work center and Open Business Roles.-Double Click on the Business Role ID. Click on View All.-Under the Dashboards tab. You will see the list of assigned dashboards.-You will find an entry in the Name column with an invalid format.-Cause-When a dashboard is deleted from the Insights work center, it does not get automatically removed from the Business Roles to which the dashboard was assigned.-As an indication that the dashboard is deleted you will see the name displayed in invalid format under the assigned Dashboards.-Example: C117018CB623B5883946F22DB9B560B40B742808-Resolution-You need to manually remove the deleted dashboard from the Assigned Dashboards. Follow the steps given below.-Go to Application and User Management work center and Open Business Roles.-Double Click on the Business Role ID. Click on View All.-Under the Dashboards tab. You will see the list of assigned dashboards.-Choose the dashboard name displayed in invalid format .-Click on the Remove Button.-Keywords-Deleted Dashboards, Dashboards, Invalid Name, manual, remove, Insight, manage dashboards, assigned, business roles

Title: The Migration Tool Does not Round-off Values as per the Specifications of the Extension Fields
Content: Symptom-The Migration does not display rounded off values in case of adapted migration templates with Extension Fields. It is expected to round-off the values of extension fields according to the specification of decimal places.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find and Open any of the Migration Activities.-Choose to Migrate using the migration tool.-Upload a populated migration template.-In the details section below, navigate to a tab that contains an Extension Field.-It's observed that the value maintained for that particular field, in the Formula Bar of Microsoft Excel is seen to be rounded off as per the specification provided for the extension field, in the spreadsheet. But however, when previewing it in the migration tool, the original value is displayed rather than it's rounded off form.-Resolution-The system is behaving according to its design. The migration tool has been configured to display the original value without rounding-off.-The migration can be continued as the value reflected in the system will also, as in the spreadsheet, be rounded-off to the precision specified for the particular field.-Keywords-precision,decimal,migration tool,extension field,round off

Title: Ship-To/Bill-To Not Automatically Shown in Some Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-When opening a Sales Order, you notice that sometimes checkbox "Show Ship-To/Bill-To" needs to be marked before Ship-To/Bill-To information is populated in the Sales Order screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find and Highlight Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Click the Edit button.-Under the Account section, you may need to click the "Show Ship-To/Bill-To" checkbox in order to load the Ship-To/Bill-To information.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior and this checkbox has been introduced to optimize the space in the UI screen.-It's functionality is to hide the Ship To/Bill To if these parties are same as that of the Account Party (So the Ship-To/Bill-To address is displayed either when this checkbox is checked or when the party is different from that of the Account Party).-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. The checkbox will hide the information only when it is the same as that of the Account Party.-Keywords-Ship to, Bill to, Show, Checkbox, Party, Information, Populated, Filled

Title: Error Message:Configuration of memo line text not found
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post an Outgoing Bank Transfer as there is an error message Configuration of memo line text not found-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management or Liquidity mangement work center.-Click on New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Fill the required data and click on Post.-System shows the below error message-Configuration of memo line text not found-Cause-You would need to maintain details for the correspondence profile to fix this error message.-Resolution-Go to the Business configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation project view.-Select the Implementation Project and click on Open activity list.-Navigate to the Fine tune tab.-Search and Open Activity : Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Click on Edit assignment of payment correspondence profiles to payment medium formats.-Select Row with the desired payment medium format.-Under the details section of the screen, Click on Add Row.-Maintain Payment Method and respective Payment Correspondance profile.-Keywords-Payment Correspondence profile, bank transfer, payment file.

Title: Purchase Register - India Report Shows Wrong Product Tax Base Amount
Content: Symptom-When running the Purchase Register - India report, key figure for Product Tax Base Amount in report shows wrong results when adding posting date either in selection or in characteristics as a column.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open the Purchase Register - India report.-In the selection parameters, give an invoice ID.-Run the report.-Refer to Product Tax Base Amount key figure and note the presented amounts.-In the selection parameters, give the invoice posting date as selection and/or add the Posting Date  characteristic to the report.-Observe that the Product Tax Base Amount doubled/tripled once the posting date was added.-Cause-The company for the respective invoice has multiple set of books, hence the amount is multiplied by the number of set of books since it is not being shown as a characteristic nor used as a selection parameter in the report.-Resolution-To display the correct amount, either: Use Set of Books as a selection parameter, or Add the Set of Books characteristic to the report.-Keywords-Purchase Register, India, Set of Books.

Title: Duplicate Entry Error When Creating new Supplier Invoice From Excel
Content: Symptom-You are attempting to create new Invoices via Microsoft Excel, but the system shows an error message: 'Duplicate entry. Fix errors and submit data again.'.-Consequently, the new Invoice is not created in the system as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Press New, and then Import from Microsoft Excel.-Logon to the system using the SAP Add-In.-Fill the Supplier Invoice Header and the Supplier Invoice Lines.-Press Save Data To.-The system displays the error message: Duplicate entry. Fix errors and submit data again.-Cause-The problem is caused by the fact that the upload template can only be used once. Once you have uploaded data with the template before, and you try to reuse it, the system will show the duplicate error. Even though you have deleted the visible data, some hidden fields still contain references to the previous upload, and so the system is reporting the data as duplicate.-Resolution-The simplest solution is to use a fresh template every time and not reuse the template after you have used it to upload Invoices.-Keywords-Fix, errors, submit, again, duplicate, entry, demand, plan, template

Title: You Create a GST Return for Australia And A Taxable Invoice Is Not Picked For The VAT As Expected
Content: Symptom-A GST Return XXX is created for Australia, and a taxable invoice is not picked up for VAT as expected.-(XXX represents the GST Return ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the GST Returns view.-Select Tax Return ID XXX.-Click Run ID YYY (YYY represents the Tax Return Run ID).-Go to the Tax Return tab.-Click Details.-The invoice expected to be picked up for this tax return is not included in the list.-Cause-The Tax Return ID XXX has Tax Return Type set as 999, which is a generic return type.-The Return Type 999 picks all the Tax Events which are not mapped to any other Tax Return Type and the Invoice Tax Event is mapped to different Tax Return Type.-As an example, use Tax Event 10 - GST Non-Capital Purchase and Tax Return Type XYZ (where XYZ is used as an example Tax Return Type).-The Tax Return Type used on the GST Tax Return can be viewed by following these steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the GST Returns view.-Select Tax Return ID XXX.-Click Run ID YYY.-Under area Tax Return Details you can see Tax Return Type: 999 - Tax Return.-The mapped Tax Return Types can be checked using the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects subview.-Click Open Activity List.-Show All Activities.-Find Tax Returns for Goods and Services - Australia.-Click Goods and Service Tax Return Australia.-Select Tax Return Type XYZ.-Click under tab Tax Event.-The list of Tax Events linked to this Tax Return Type can be found here, including, in this example, Tax Event 10 - GST Non-Capital Purchase.-Resolution-To change the Tax Return Arrangement to the Tax Return Type XYZ, please follow below steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Go to the Tax Authorities subview.-Select Tax Authority ID ABC (ABC means the Tax Authority ID).-Click Edit - Company Tax Arrangements.-Select the company in use.-Go to the Tax Return Arrangements sub-tab.-Edit Tax Return Type.-Click Save.-Now when creating GST Tax Return it will use Tax Return Type XYZ.-Keywords-gst return; tax return type; 999; tax authority; tax event; gst return; tax return type; tax authority; tax event; 999

Title: Is it Possible to Have Business Partner ID More Than 10 Characters
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to have a Business Partner (Accounts, Contacts and so on) ID with more than 10 characters but it is not possible to change the Total Length of the Business Partner more than 10 characters.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects View.-Select a project and select open Activity list button.-Select Fine-Tune chevron.-Select All Activities in the Show field.-Select General Business Partner activity.-Select Define Number Range for Business Partners link.-Here the Total Length is maintained as 10 and the field is read only.---Cause-This Filed is not editable and it is fixed to 10.-Resolution-The Total length of a Business Partner is fixed to 10 character and is the actual system behavior. In the same way manual or automatic settings cannot be changed for Business Partner.-Keywords-Total Length, Business Partner Length, ID length

Title: Payables Payment Run Warning: Proposal discarded; Incoming payment data missing
Content: Symptom-Have a credit memo as an open item for one of your suppliers. When executing a payment run, the system selects this credit memo for payment, but the resulting proposal remains Postponed and a warning message is raised in the application log.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Payment Run view.-Select the relevant payment run.-Open the application log and go to Results tab.-You see the following warning related to the credit memo: 'Proposal discarded; Incoming payment data missing for <supplier ID and name>'.-Cause-The credit memo for a supplier account being processed in a payment run would entail the creation of an incoming payment. In general, incoming payments are externally initiated, therefore, proposals for incoming payments are not created if the payment data for initiating the payments is missing.-Note it may also be the case that the credit memo got posted while the Pay Individually flag was checked in the supplier's master data.-Resolution-You can define an agreed payment method for this credit memo, as follows:-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the related supplier account monitor.-Highlight the open item for the credit memo.-Click Item Details.-Choose an agreed payment method and click save.-After that, if you execute the payment run again, a different warning may be raised as follows: '<ItemType> <ItemID> excluded; defined payment method is externally initiated'.-This means that the item has been excluded from the payment proposal because the payment method defined individually for the item is externally initiated.-Hence, if you wish to create payment for this credit memo you shall either click Pay Manually by via supplier account monitor or you may open the related payment proposal and reset the postpone status to then execute the status.-This is the expected system behavior to do not include credit items in the automatic payment run for suppliers.-See Also-2943623 - Credit Memos are not Proposed in Payment Run: Invoices Should be Paid Individually-Messages in the Payment Run Application Log-Keywords-Payment Run, Credit memo, Supplier, Payable, Trade Payables.

Title: Distribution Chain Not Valid: Enter Distribution Channel Error When Changing Sales Data For Account
Content: Symptom-When trying to edit the sales data in an account (to add or edit a new row in the Sales Data table), the system pops up the error:-"Distribution chain not valid: enter distribution channel"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Enter Account Management work center;-Navigate to Accounts view;-Search for account XYZ; (XYZ represents the account ID)-Enter the account and click View All;-Go to the Sales Data tab;-In the Sales Data table, add a new row and enter Sales Organization and Distribution Channel;-Once done, the system will raise the error message.-Cause-This issue is caused by the configuration of the Sales Organization work distribution, which contains a rule that makes the selected Distribution Channel to be invalid.-Resolution-To correct the issue changes in the Sales Organization work distribution rules need to be made.-To do so, you can refer to the attached Help Center document "Organizational Work Distribution Quick Guide".-See Also-Organizational Work Distribution Quick Guide, found in the system Help Center.-2219704 - Not able to Select a Distribution Channel in a Sales Document and the Sales Data in the Account-Keywords-Distribution Channel, Distribution Chain, Sales Data, Work Distribution Rule, Account Sales Data, Account Management

Title: How to Process System Monitoring Request
