Title: How to Enable Service Agents to Record Absences via an ESS Activity
Content: Symptom-You have one or both of the following requirements:-To enable service agents to record their absences via an ESS activity-To enable resource managers/project managers to record them from the resource profile-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view-3. Select Edit Project Scope-4. Go to the Questions step-5. Select Human Resources-6. Select Time and Labor Management-7. Select ﻿Time Recording-Resolution-You can scope the below question to enable service agents so record their absences via an ESS activity:-"Do you want your service agents to record absences without any approval workflow using employee self-service?"-Please note that this initiates a lean version of a leave request with the following characteristics:-It does not go for approval-A specific time type cannot be specified while applying for leave - it uses the SAP standard time type for such leave requests-It cannot be set up for collision with time types of other categories, like e.g. productive times-It is like an information about service agents unavailability for work and therefore useful from the service agent's availability calendar perspective only-Keywords-employee self service self-service not able unable not possible how to maintain leave request approval agent

Title: Transaction Currency Field Is Not Editable in New Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-The Transaction Currency field defaults to company currency and is not editable in a new journal entry voucher.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view > New Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter Company, and select Journal Entry Type 00084 - Manual Entry for Accounts Payable.-Select Screen Variant 626 - Manual Write-Up/Write-Down Accounts Pay.-Notice that Transaction Currency becomes read-only and an info message is displayed:-'Transaction currency has been changed to local currency'-The same behavior is observed for one more combination of Journal Entry Type and Screen Variant:-Journal Entry Type: 00085 - Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable-Screen Variant: 628 - Manual Write-Up/Write-Down Accounts Rec-Cause-The system behaves as designed. For the two combinations of Journal Entry Type and Screen Variant, the Transaction Currency defaults to Company Currency and cannot be edited.-Resolution-As a workaround, the New Charge/Credit function can be used from Supplier Account Monitor or Customer Account Monitor, respectively.-Keywords-jev; transaction currency; greyed out; grayed out; 00084; 00085; 626; 628; Manual Write-Up/Write-Down; New Charge/Credit

Title: How to Enter Withholding Tax Deduction by Customer
Content: Symptom-This document describes how to capture the tax deducted at source (TDS) or withholding tax deducted by the customer when entering an incoming payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Receivables work center.-Click Customers Accounts view.-Select option All Customers in the Show field, enter Account ID ABC (ABC means the Account ID) in the Find field and click Go button.-Select Account ID ABC and click View button.-Go to the Trade Receivables tab.-Click New Charge/Credit button and select the following parameters:-Charge/Credit: 2 - Customer Credit -In the G/L Account field: Tax G/L Account (for TDS deduction) -In the Net Amount field: TDS amount (deducted by the Customer)-Click Post button.-It will take you to the Trade Receivables tab, click the Refresh icon.-You can see the document for Customer Charge under the document type Other Payable.-Keywords-tds; tax deducted at source; withholding tax; customer-tax deducted at source,tds,withholding tax,customer

Title: Error: Combination of bank XYZ, company ABC, and bank account DEF already exists
Content: Symptom-While trying to save a new Outgoing Bank Transfer system gives the error Combination of bank XYZ, company ABC, and bank account DEF already exists﻿.-(XYZ is the Bank ID, ABC is the Company ID and DEF is the Bank account number.)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view and click New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Complete the necessary information.-Click the Save button.-System shows the error message Combination of bank XYZ, company ABC, and bank account DEF already exists.-Cause-There are two or more Bank Accounts using the same IBAN number.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the My Banks subview in the Master Data view.-Select the respective My Bank ID.-Click Edit and select Bank Accounts.-Check the Bank Accounts and remove the IBAN in case it is being used in more than one.-This is also valid when a Bank Account is with status Blocked.-Keywords-Bank account; Bankkonto

Title: Some of Time Recordings are Incomplete Instead of Complete Status - Part 1
Content: Symptom-You are reviewing time recording of employees and observed that some of recordings are Incomplete instead of Complete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Time Sheet view-Search and highlight an employee-Select Open Time Sheet button-Go to Review and Correct tab-Go to respective calendar week-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that the <N> hours might be going for Non-Credited. This can be further idetified using the daily model assigned to that employee has working time and Flextime Bandwith assigned to it for Regular Planned Working Time. There is no Flextime Bandwith for Deviation On Half Day Off.--In the employee's Time File > Time Profile > Time Account Rules > Working Time Account > Basic Data > Credited Times has Cap Outside Flextime Bandwidth. This is the reason that <N> hour is going to Non-Credited times.--Because there is no flextime bandwith and the cap is provided over the flextime bandwidth, which is not there in time model, the system considers all working times recorded on half days as outside the flextimes and hence it goes to Non-Credited Times.-This is the reason that the status is Incomplete-Resolution-There are two possibilities to overcome this issue:-1. Either maintain the Flextime Bandwith for Deviation On Half Day Off in the time model.-2. Or remove the Cap Outside Flextime Bandwidth from the Credited Times.-See Also-2926654 - Some of Time Recordings are Incomplete Instead of Complete Status - Part 2-Keywords-unvollständiger Status, Arbeitszeitblatt, incomplete status, time sheet, Zeiten korrekt erfasst, times recorded correctly,

Title: Question Related to Time Recording Terminals Integration is Missing in Scope
Content: Symptom-There is a requirement to implement the Time Recording Terminals integration, but the question related to it is not available in the scope of the project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center -Select Implementation Project view-Edit Project Scope -Go to step Questions-Select Human Resources-Select Time Labor Management and then Time Recording-The question Do you want to integrate Time Recording Terminals? is missing-Cause-The required configuration is missing in the tenant due to the country settings. Hence, the question is not visible-Resolution-It is not possible to add the terminal integration for time recording, as this feature is only supported for countries: Austria, Switzerland and Germany. In case this feature is required for another country, it's advised creating a post on our SAP Influence forum.-Influence Opportunity Homepage - Customer Influence -Keywords-Time Recording Terminals Integration, Scope, Business Configuration

Title: Invoice Posting Not Possible. Individual Material Is Retired
Content: Symptom-You have created a credit memo with costs assigned to an individual material, however the system informs that the individual material is retired.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents subview.-You see the unposted credit memo with the following errors:-Posting not possible; individual material <IMAT ID> already retired-Error in currency conversion for-During the creation of the credit memo, these errors are also raised as exceptions. It can happen that the responsible user decides to go through and accept the exception (see Exceptions tab) and send the post to accounting, which generates the unposted source documents with the same errors.-Cause-The credit memo was created with cost assignment to an individual material (IMAT). Nevertheless, the IMAT was not selected from the value help menu of the Individual Material field, which list the existing ones, instead a New individual material was created and assigned to this credit memo. Since a new individual material was assigned, this characterizes the asset procurement scenario. You cannot procure an asset with a credit memo. For further details, please refer to the SAP Business ByDesign documentation Individual Materials and Acquisitions and Asset Procurement in Purchasing.-Resolution-In order to have this scenario resolved, it is recommended to reverse the credit memos as per below steps.-Open the credit memo document in the View All mode.-Click Cancel Document. A new cancellation document is created.-Approve (if required) and post the cancellation.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents view..-You'll see that the cancellation document becomes an unposted source document as well. The error within this cancellation document informs that the reversed business transaction contain errors that have to be solved first.-Highlight the cancellation document created in the above steps.-Click Actions -> View Business Transaction.-On the screen that opens, click Mark as Irrelevant.-Result: The reversing business transaction and the reversed business transaction are set to irrelevant, thus these are not relevant unposted source documents anymore.-Nevertheless, since the IMAT was newly created from the credit memo and there is no fixed asset assignment, it currently has the In Preparation status. (You can open the credit memo and double-click the IMAT ID under Cost Distribution tab). Even the reversal of the concerned business transaction does not roll back the creation. Therefore, this IMAT remains created and can be used for a later procurement.-Keywords-asset procurement, fixed asset.

Title: How to Maintain Approval Options for Time Types of Different Time Type Categories
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to maintain approval options for different time type categories, like productive times, vacation, leave, illness and so on.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-For time types of category Vacation, Leave, Illness and Special Attendance, the approval options are maintained as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-Go to the Fine Tune chevron-Search and open the fine-tune activity Time Types – <Country name>-Select Maintain Approval Options link-The approval tasks for the above time types can be found in manager's Approvals view in Managing My Area work center.-For time types of category Productive Times and others, the approval option is configured centrally by a scoping question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-Select the Edit Project Scope button of the respective Project-Go to Questions step and select Human Resources, Time and Labor Management-Select Approvals and answer Yes for the question Would you like your managers to be able to approve or reject their employees' time sheets for the <Country> in the system?-The approval tasks for the above time types can be found in manager's Confirm Time Recordings view under Common Tasks in Managing My Area work center.-Keywords-Genehmigungen Genehmigung Zeit

Title: Variable "Balance Sheet And Income Statement Item" is invalid for value "ABC"
Content: Symptom-While executing Financial Statements - Preliminary Consolidation Elimination report, error message is displayed: Variable "Balance Sheet And Income Statement Item" is invalid for value "ABC".-ABC means a node in the referred financial reporting structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Reports - List view.-Search and open the Financial Statements - Preliminary Consolidation Elimination Report.-Select the appropriate parameters, including Financial Reporting Structure DEF (DEF means the Financial Reporting Structure ID).-Click Go.-Here, report shows error: Variable "Balance Sheet And Income Statement Item" is invalid for value "ABC".-Cause-The error occurs because the data is not maintained in Financial Reporting Structure DEF in the respective fine tuning activity.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click Implementation projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine Tune tab.-Search for activity Settings for Earned Profit Analysis.-Click Edit Financial Reporting Structure.-Select Financial Reporting Structure DEF and click Edit.-There are nodes with missing Fixed Structure Item. You have to assign all the Fixed Structure Items, save the changes, and then execute the report again.-See Also-2052832 - No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports-Keywords-FINGLAU04_Q0003; balance sheet; income statement item; fixed structure item

Title: Balance Confirmation Run Does not Work with Customer Country as Restriction Criteria
Content: Symptom-You have created a balance confirmation run and set the criteria for customer selection with a specific country, however no balance confirmations were generated.-You also notice that if no country is given the balance confirmations are created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Balance Confirmation runs.-Create a new balance confirmation run and under Restrictions step, in the section Choose Criteria for Customer select Business Partner Country and specify the country.-Create the run and schedule an execution.-No balance confirmations are created. If you select a customer account manually for the specified country and execute the run, the balance confirmation is then created.-Cause-The criteria for business partner filtering based on customer country only works if a Customer from / to ID range is defined. If this range is empty and only the country criteria is given, then the filtering criteria logic does not apply.-Resolution-When creating the balance confirmation run, in the Restrictions step, you need to specify the Customer from / to ID under General Selection Criteria section. Once this range is defined, the Choose Criteria for Customer based on customer country will apply for the specified range.-If you wish to select all customer accounts to then apply the Criteria for Customer based on Customer Country, you may sort the IDs (Ascending) e give the first ID as 'From' and the last ID as 'To' in the selection range. However, note that the value help shows only 500 entries at a time. Hence, if you have more than 500 customer accounts you may filter the accounts as follows, to assure that all are selected:-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the Advanced filter and select by Company ID.-In the result list, sort the Account ID Ascending.-Once the list is sorted, you may use the first and last IDs as a range within the balance confirmation run.-Our developers are working on enhancing this system logic, which is to be delivered in one of the future ByDesign releases.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation Run, Business Partner Country, Account Balance.

Title: Unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation - Account determination for inventories is not defined in business configuration for account determination group
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Goods and Activity Confirmation ZZZ appear sas unposted source document in the General Ledger due to the error message 'Account determination for inventories is not defined in business configuration for account determination group ABC'. (ZZZ means the Goods and Activity Confirmation ID, ABC means the Account Determination Group name)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation ZZZ.-Notice the error message: 'Account determination for inventories is not defined in business configuration for account determination group ABC'.-Cause-The Goods and Activity Confirmation ZZZ is an Inventory Difference Confirmation. There is a missing account determination setup for Account Determination Group for Material ABC in the Inventories subledger for Physical Inventories, either related to Inventory Differences*  or Inventory Revaluations **.-*Mainly caused by rounding and a different valuation logic for outgoing (Quantity x Resulting Inventory Value ÷ Resulting Inventory Quantity) and incoming stock (Quantity x Resulting Inventory Cost).-**Revaluations can occur when Goods and Activity confirmations are posted retrospectively.-Resolution-The required account determination setup is to be maintained, as follows:-In the Business Configuration work center access the  Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity, either from the Business Configuration Overview or from the Activity List of the Implementation Project. -Under Account Determination select Inventories.-Click Inventories subledger.-Move to Physical Inventory tab.-Enter a row for Account Determination Group for Materials ABC and maintain accounts for both Gain from Inventory Differences and Loss from Inventory Differences-Or select Gains and Losses tab and input G/L account Gain from Inventory Revaluation and Loss from Inventory Revaluation of the corresponding material account determination group.-Save the changes.-As a result, Goods and Activity Confirmation ZZZ could be posted.-Keywords-GAC; unposted Goods and Activity Confirmation; Inventory Difference Confirmation; Account determination for inventories is not defined

Title: Stores to Configuration Validation for Web Dispatchers

Title: Depreciation Method D20S - MACRS 3,5,7,10 Years W/Special Depr Incorrect
Content: Symptom-You want to change the depreciation method of a Fixed Asset to  to D20S-MACRS 3,5,7,10 years w/special depr.-You get the error message "Asset ABC valuation view: Depreciation method MACRS 3,5,7,10 years w/special depr incorrect".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Asset view.-Search for Fixed Asset ABC (ABC is the fixed asset ID) and select it.-Navigate to the Asset Valuation sub-tab in the Master Data tab.-Select the relevant Set of Books. The Current depreciation method is DEF (DEF is the depreciation method).-Change it to D205 -MACRS 3,5,7,10 years w/special depr.-You get the error message "Asset ABC valuation view: Depreciation method MACRS 3,5,7,10 years w/special depr incorrect".-To verify, if the Depreciation method D205 is correctly assigned to the used Accounting principle-go to the Business Configuration work center and access the Depreciation Methods Fine-Tune activity.-Press Edit Depreciation methods.-Search and select Depreciation Method D20S.-Navigate to the Assignment to Accounting Principles tab.-The depreciation method is assigned to the relevant Set of Books.-Cause-The Depreciation method D20S -  MACRS 3,5,7,10 years w/special depr incorrect is only valid for Fixed Assets with an Acquisition date until 31.12.2004.-This depreciation method is not valid for Fixed Assets acquired after this date.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-depreciation method; Abschreibungsmethode; D20S; fixed asset; Anlagen

Title: Time Account Accrual Varies In Quantity
Content: Symptom-You have configured a time account for periodic accrual (for example, adding 2 days to the account's balance on the first Tuesday of the month), but you have noticed that the quantity of the accrual changes in some of the periods or there are even cases where no accrual is done.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The option Stop Accrual at Upper Balance Limit might be enabled for this time account.-This allows you to determine an accrual limit that can't be surpassed. Following the example above (2 days on the first Tuesday of the month), if the account's balance is already at 29 days and it has an upper balance limit of 30 days: the accrual will only add one day to the account's balance in the next month and if the balance is not consumed — for example, by the employee using it for a leave — there will be no accrual in the following months until the balance lowers from the limit.-Resolution-If this is not wanted, please consider disabling this option from the time account by following the below instructions:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Search for "time accounts".-Access the activity specific to the relevant country/region.-Click the link to Maintain Time Account Rules.-In the next screen, locate and select the time account in question.-Navigate to the Accrual Rule tab.-Uncheck the Stop Accrual at Upper Balance Limit box.-Please note: upon changing any setting fine-tuning activities related to time administration, Time Valuation may need to be retriggered to ensure the employees' time profiles are updated with the new changes. To understand how to execute this, please check the help document Time Valuation.-Keywords-Accrual, Quantity, Upper Balance Limit

Title: The Employee ID Field is Deactivated and Cannot Be Modified while Creating a New Employee
Content: Symptom-When creating a new employee, the field Employee ID is deactivated and you are not able to assign the field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Administrator work center-Select the General Settings view-Select the Employees link-Click on the New button-Select the Employee option-Result: The field Employee ID is deactivated-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center-Select the Regular tasks view-Select the Country-Under Hiring, select Hire Employee-Result: The field Employee ID is deactivated-Cause-The system behaves according to the settings in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-In the Fine-Tune tab, you have the possibility to determine whether the employee ID needs to be assigned manually, or it is automatically generated by the system. Only if you choose the manual option, the Employee ID field is enabled for manual input. You can check the configuration for the Employee ID assignment type as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Project view-Select the project and click on the Open Activity List button-Select the Fine-Tune tab-Search for the activity Number Ranges for Employees and Service Agents and click on the link to open the activity-Select the Number Ranges for Employees option-Under the section Intervals you can define the type as Manual-Click on Save and Close-Keywords-Employee - Personel Administrator - Business Partner - Employee ID Field

ID).-Navigate to the General tab.-The company is DEF (DEF is the company ID).-Order Quantity is 12 months.-Navigate to the Accounting Data tab.-The Revenue Type is 5 - Customer Contracts (Fixed Price) Title: Automatically Created Reconciliation Runs Are Not Displayed in General Ledger - Reconciliation Work Center View
Content: Symptom-Reconciliation Runs which are automatically created by the system are not displayed in General Ledger - Reconciliation work center view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > Reconciliation Runs view.-Select All Reconciliation Runs from the show list.-Notice that there's no automatically executed Reconciliation Run displayed.-Cause-By default, the General Ledger - Reconciliation work center view only displays manual check and correction runs (Processing Modes Manual Check and Correction).-Resolution-To be able to see the automatic runs, the Processing Mode Automatic Check should be added via the Open Advanced Filter button (filter icon).-See Also-Help Document:-Reconciliation Quick Guide-Keywords-Reconciliation run; general ledger; processing mode; automatic check

Title: Holiday Request Cannot be Deducted From the Assigned Time Account.
Content: Symptom-This document describes a situation, where a vacation request cannot be deducted from the assigned time account.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center-Select the Self Services view-Select the New Leave Request link-Fill in From and To-Select the Next Button to display the deducted days-Now, to verify whether the system has taken the request into account or not.-Go to Time Administration work center-Select Employee view-Search for the relevant employee-Select Edit-Select the Time Account Balances-Underneath the Time Account Balances tab, select the actual time account assigned to the employee-Underneath the Details tab, select the Employee Times-Check the Start Date, End Date and the applied Time Type with Deduction Day(s)-Detect any inconsistency between the expected and actual number of days-Cause-The root cause of this issue is the fact that the assigned time account has a balance with less days than requested by the employee. Hence the missing days cannot be deducted.-It may occur that the system allows the deduction from another assigned time account instead of the actual assigned time account.-Employee times can be deducted from one or more time accounts, and if required, they can be deducted from multiple time account types in a specific sequence.-Resolution-Go to Time Administration work center-Select Employee view-Search for the relevant employee-Select Edit-Select the Time Account Balances-Underneath the Time Account Balances, select the initial assigned time account and select the Adjustments tab-Add row with quantity equal to the number of days needed to compensate the failure, with Posting Type as Manual Posting-Keywords-incorrect, does not work, remains, why, missing, same, count, counted

Title: Approval Date/Time of Expense Report is Different From Local System Time
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY -The date/time of approval of expense report displayed in the Preview/PDF is different from your local time maintained in the system (time is shown in UTC).-You want the date/time to be in the local time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Task Management subview in the Task Distribution view.-Search and select the Approve Expense Report ABC (ABC is the expense report ID) task.-The task status is completed.-Click open the task.-Navigate to the Progress tab.-The date/time of approval is displayed in local time.-You can open the Expense Report ABC by clicking Details tab or from the Travel and Expenses work center as follows:-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Search for Expense Report ABC and select it.-Click open the same.-Click Preview Reimbursement details.-Open the PDF.-The time of approval is different (in UTC).-Cause-The system is set up to show the date/time in UTC for approval task in the PDF/ Preview of Expense reports.-Resolution-With the 1911 Upgrade, you can change the time in the Preview/PDF by activating local time from backend.-Login to the Backend.-Use transaction SE16.-Enter Table HCF_I_SUP_PROC.-Click Create Entries Icon.-Enter GROUP ID: APERM-Enter SEMID: PDFTZ-Enter VALUE: X-Click the Save Icon.-  Check if the functionality has been activated:-Go back to the previous screen.-The Table Name is HCF_I_SUP_PROC.-Click the green Tick Icon.-Click Execute.-The following values are displayed:-GROUP_ID: APERM-SEMID: PDFTZ-VALUE: X-Please note that the functionality has to be activated for each tenant (productive/ test tenants).-Keywords-Zeiten Spesenabrechnung; Zeit der Genehmigung; time of approval; approval of expense report

Title: Transaction Source Undetermined in Cash Position by Transaction Source Report
Content: Symptom-For some lines the transaction source is Undetermined in the Cash Position by Transaction Source (FINPAYU03_Q0002) report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the List subview in the Reports view.-Search and select the Cash Position by Transaction Source (FINPAYU03_Q0002) report.-Run the report for the default parameters.-Bring in the Row fields Transaction Source, Source Document Number and Source Document Type.-For some bank statements, the Transaction Source is displayed as Undetermined.-Cause-The mentioned Document IDs with the corresponding bank statements have the payment allocations still as In Preparation (not posted).-The payment allocations of the mentioned Document IDs have to be posted for the transaction source to be derived.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Search and select Document ID ABC (ABC is the document ID) for Bank Account ID DEF (DEF is the bank account ID.).-The Bank Statement ID is HIJ (HIJ is the bank statement ID of the document ID ABC).-The status is Posted.-The Post Processing status is Required.-Click Required to open the bank statement HIJ.-Click View All.-Navigate to the Transactions tab.-Select the Line Item, click the Post Processing status Required.-This opens the payment allocation KLM (KLM is the payment allocation ID).-The status is In Preparation.-The payment allocation of the bank statement HIJ is not yet allocated.-As there is no allocation posted, no transaction source can be derived.-Resolution-You need to post the payment allocations.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Search and select Bank Statement ID HIJ for Bank Account ID DEF .-The Post Processing status is Required.-Click Required to open the bank statement HIJ.-Click View All.-Navigate to the Transactions tab.-Select the Line Item, click the Post Processing status Required.-This opens the payment allocation KLM.-Complete the allocation.-Click Post.-If the document is not relevant for posting reverse/ void or delete the same.-Keywords-Cash Position by Transaction Source; FINPAYU03_Q0002; transaction source

Title: Wrong Output File Generated for VAT Return in Israel
Content: Symptom-You have created a PCN VAT Return for ISR - Israel, however the resulting outbound file has the "R" code for some supplier invoices. You expect this code to be available in the outbound file only when the concerned invoice is a customs duty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center. -Go to VAT Return view.-Find and open the related tax return.-Go to the Attachments tab.-Download the .txt file.-In the file, you notice that for some supplier invoices the concerned row starts with the code "R", even though the invoice is not a customs duty.-Cause-The related invoice is not custom duty, however it has a tax event for import (201, 203 or 204). As per the VAT PCN874 design, for import of services scenario, which involves purchase of service from a foreign vendor and contains only base amount, that is zero tax amount should be reported with code 'R' in the file. For tax codes 201, 203 and 204 which are import scenarios, entry type will be filled with value 'R' in the file.-Resolution-The system works in accordance to VAT PCN874 design, since the "R" code is expected for invoices with tax events 201, 203 or 204.-If this behavior is not the expeted one, please send an incident to support and share the related legal documentation infoming the correct expectation/legal change. Based on that, this can be dicussed and evaluated with product management.-See Also-VAT Reporting — Israel-Keywords-VAT Return, PCN, Israel, Tax Management.

Title: Employee Appears in Resource Profile View, but not in Resource Search View of Resource Management Work Center, Even Though Job Not Excluded
Content: Symptom-An employee is visible in Resource Profile but not shown in Resource Search. The message “Working days are not determined; check work schedule for [employee]” is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Resource Management work center-Open Resource Profile view-Search for the employee and confirm that the employee is visible-Open Resource Search view-Search for the same employee and confirm that the employee is not listed-Cause-This is expected system behavior. The Resource Search view displays only employees who have available working time. Employees without maintained availability or working days are not shown in the search results.-Resolution-Check and maintain the employee’s availability:-Go to Resource Management work center-Open Resource Profile view-Search and open the employee-Click Edit, then open Resource Profile-Go to the Availability tab-Check the Resource Availability section-Ensure that working days and availability are properly maintained. If the employee still does not appear despite having availability, please raise an incident with SAP Support for further analysis. -See Also-2587216 - Filter for Basic Search in Resource Management Does Not Work As Expected-2920650 - Employee Appears in Resource Profile View, but not in Resource Search View of Resource Management Work Center-Keywords-employee not visible resource search, resource profile vs resource search, working days not determined, availability not maintained, employee availability issue, SAP ByDesign resource management

Title: Warning Message When Migrating Customer: 'Bill of exchange receivables details do not exist for payment method Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance'
Content: Symptom-You are migrating customer accounts with payment method as Bill of exchange without acceptance, but a warning message is being raised: 'Bill of exchange receivables details do not exist for payment method Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity list.-Open activity Migration of Customers and click Migrate customers using the migration tool.-Import your file and go to the Simulate step.-The warning message is raised as described in the symptom section.-This warning does not block the migration process.-Cause-The file you are migrating has one of the customers with Payment Method as Bill of exchange without acceptance. Whenever this payment method is added, the system also looks for a Bill Of Exchange Receivable Bank Account. In migration file, this is maintained under Payment Data tab in a hidden column for 'Sequence Number of Bank Data for BoE', which requires a sequence ID. In this case, the sequence ID is maintained in the mentioned column but missing under Bank Data tab.-Resolution-In the Bank Data tab of the Excel file, you need to maintain the customer's bank account data and a sequence ID must also be filled in column 'Sequence Number of Bank Data'. This ID should be a match with the ID maintained in the Payment Data tab for Sequence Number of Bank Data for BoE.-If this is correctly maintained, the warning message is not raised.-Keywords-BoE, Migration, Bill of Exchange.

Title: Employee Missing in the Employees View of Personnel Administration
Content: Symptom-You are searching for a particular employee in the Employees view of Personnel Administration work center, but cannot locate it, even though the same is available in the view through Advanced Search.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Input the Employee Name/ID in the Find box.-Select the Go button.-The message No records found is seen.-In the Employees view, select the Advanced option.-Use the Value Help for Employee ID.-The concerned employee can be found in the list.-Cause-The reason for this behavior is that only the basic data for this employee was created, but not the personnel file. This can happen in two ways:-Only the first part of the Migration of Employee Data was completed for this employee;-This employee was created when the system had a lean HCM module (no Personnel Administration), but the Personnel Administration work center was scoped at a later date.-Resolution-To correct this, please do the following:-Go to the Business Configuration work center;-Access the Overview;-Locate the activity Migration of Employee Data – XYZ (where XYZ stands for the country of the relevant employee);-Open this activity and use either one of the below options:-Migrate Personnel Administration data using the migration tool (use the migration template to create personnel files for multiple employees);-Manually create Personnel File using basic employee data (option better suited for single employees).-Keywords-Employee Missing, Advanced Search, No Personnel File, Employment, Can't find employee, Unable to find employee, Find Employee, employee search, Employee after hire, Employee after migration-not appearing,employees missing,employees view,no records found,search,not found

Title: The Report Schedule of Fixed Assets Does Not Show Transfer Postings
Content: Symptom-The report Schedule of Fixed Assets (FINFXAU01_Q0002) does not show the transfer postings.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the List subview in the Reports view.-Search and select Schedule of Fixed Assets (FINFXAU01_Q0002) report .-Run the report for the following parameters:-Company: ABC (ABC is the company ID).-Set of Books: DEF (DEF is the set of books ID).-Accounting Period/Year: any value.-The Key Figure Transfers does not show any values.-Cause-The "Transfer" column in the schedule of fixed assets shows the aggregate of all the transfer postings (transaction category with "Transfer" in their text) including the partial transfers only when the partial transfer's line item type is "Historical Costs".-For transaction line items with the line item type "Historical Costs: Current Year" the amount gets added to the "Acquisition" column rather than the "Transfer".-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-Only Transfer postings of line item type Historical costs are shown in Schedule of Fixed Assets report.-Transfer postings of line item type Historical Costs: Current Year are considered as acquisition postings and hence not shown in Schedule of Fixed Assets report.-This value would be shown in a different column called Acquisitions.-Keywords-Schedule of Fixed Assets; Umbuchung; Anlagenspiegel; transfer of fixed assets

Title: How to Set up an Incremental Amount in Lease Contract
Content: Symptom-You have created a lease contract and wish the contract amount to increase e.g. yearly.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to Lease Contract view.-Open the respective contract.-You would like to have the installment amount increased yearly.-Resolution-In the lease contract there is currently no field that you could use to increment the amount by a fixed percentage. The increments to the installment amount are done by adding a new row with the respective amount and setting the validity for the year, as follows:-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to Lease Contract view.-Open the respective contract.-Go to Lease Objects tab.-Highlight the lease object and go to Conditions tab.-In this tab, you can add rows with the condition type and amount and specify the Valid From and Valid To for that entry. You can create different entries with different amounts specifying the respective validity period.-The conditions shall be editable if the contract has not been valuated. If the contract is valuated (Ready for Release status), you can cancel the valuation, via Actions button, for the conditions become editable again-If the lease contract is already Released, the conditions for the lease object cannot be changed. Hence, a new contract version needs to be created, which can be done via Edit -> Click New Contract Version button. The new contract version requires an Effective Date that must be less than or equal to today's date. The effective data of a new contract version cannot be in the future.-Once the new version is created, you are be able to add a new lease installment amount for the object with different dates. However, note that the validity of this new entry can only be valid from on or after the effective date set for the new contract version.-For more details on what can be done in a new contract version, you may refer to help documentation Lease Contract Quick Guide-Keywords-Lease Contract. Lease-in. Installment.

Title: Released Invoice Does Not Appear in Customer Account Monitor
Content: Symptom-You created a customer invoice and released it. The document however does not appear in the Customer Account Monitor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center, and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customers Accounts subview.-Choose Customer XYZ (XYZ is the customer ID), and then select View.-In the Trade Receivables tab, show Open Items.-Search and select the Customer Invoice XXX (XXX is the customer invoice ID).-The posted invoice XXX does not appear in Customer Account Monitor. The invoice is posted and a journal entry has been created.-Cause-The released customer invoice is created from an Over-the-Counter(OTC) Sale.-You can see this in the Document Flow of the customer invoice.-For invoices created from Over-the-Counter(OTC) Sale, a scoping question exists which defines whether such invoices appear/not appear in the Customer Account Monitor.-You have not scoped and set this question as true for the scoping question "Do you want to create cleared items on customer accounts for invoices that are paid immediately, such as over-the-counter sales?"-You can check as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation Project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Step 4 Questions.-Select the scoping element Cash Flow Management and expand the subtab Payables and Receivables Processing.-Select Payments and Clearings.-The Question "Do you want to create cleared items on customer accounts for invoices that are paid immediately, such as over-the-counter sales?" is not scoped in the system.- Resolution-If you choose to set the above question as False then the released customer invoice will not appear in the account monitor.-If you set the scoping question as true then the released customer invoice will appear in the customer account monitor.-Keywords-over the counter sale; customer invoice; customer account monitor

Title: Error: GTIN XXX not Valid for UoM YYY; Checksum Digit is not Correct
Content: Symptom-You receive the following error message when trying to add a GTIN in the tab UoM Chanracteristics of a material. Error: GTIN XXX not valid for UoM YYY; checksum digit is not correct (while XXX is a GTIN number and YYY is an UoM).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center-Select Materials view-Find and select the material-Click on Edit button-Click on View All button-Go to General Tab-Navigate to the tab UoM Characteristics-Either click on Add Row or edit an existing GTIN-Click on Enter-Cause-The check digit (last digit) for global trade ID number are calculated by summing the odd position numbers and multiplying by 3, and then adding the sum of the even position numbers. The final digit of the result is subtracted from 10 to calculate the check digit (or left as is if already zero).-The error is caused because the GTIN you supplied is not in adherence to the above calculation.-Resolution-Maintain the GTIN with check digit as per the above mentioned calculation. If you need an example to understand the calculation better, you can find it on the official GS1 website:-You can find an example how to calculate the check digit here: https://www.gs1.org/services/how-calculate-check-digit-manually-You can also find a check digit calculator here: https://www.gs1.org/services/check-digit-calculator-Keywords-GTIN code, unit, migrate material master data,

Title: How to Check if TBT Tool is Consistent (Fixed Assets)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You want to check if the Total Balances Tool (TBT) is consistent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Login to the Backend.-Use transaction SE38.-Enter Program FXPRS_TBT_REBUILD.-Click Execute.-Enter Objectname: FIA_FXA_BALANCES_1-Click Execute.-Enter Organisational Centre ID: ABC (company ID of the fixed asset).-Enter Master Fixed Asset Identification: 00000000DEF (the fixed asset ID is DEF but zeroes must be added in front of it, otherwise data will not be pulled properly.)-Navigate to the Function section.-Select the "Compare items with totals" function.-Click Execute.-Click ok in the pop-up window.-There is some inconsistency in the data.-Repeat the same for objectnames:-FIA_FXA_BALANCES_2-FIA_FXA_BALANCES_3-Mention the same in incident and forward to development for analysis and correction.-Keywords-TBT; fixed assets; Anlage

Title: Payment Order Cannot be Cancelled - Cancellation of Tax Payment Failed
Content: Symptom-Even though you have already cancelled the relevant payment allocation it is not possible to cancel a tax payment as an error message appears: Payment order cannot be cancelled. Cancellation of tax payment failed.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Tax Management workcenter navigate to the Tax Payments view.-Select the tax payment that you want to cancel and click Reverse.-An error message appears: Payment order cannot be canceled; Cancellation of tax payment X failed.-In the Payment Management workcenter navigate to the Payment Monitor view. Filter for the payment allocation related to your tax payment, by filtering for the transaction amount for instance. You make sure that the respective payment allocation has already been cancelled.-Cause-It is not possible to cancel the tax payment as the related bank transfer got already issued. Or the the bank statement has already been confirmed. The status of the bank transfer is In Transfer.-Resolution-In the Payment Management workcenter navigate to the Payment Monitor view.-Filter for the ID of your tax payment (alternatively you can filter for the payment amount or the respective tax authority in the Payer/Payee Name column).-You notice that the status of the payment is In Transfer.-Choose Actions for Bank Transactions and select Set to not transferred.-Now navigate back to the Tax Management workcenter and here to the Tax Payments view.-Select the respective tax payment and press Reverse.-This time the reverse will be executed.-Keywords-Steuerzahlung stornieren; Tax paymnet; reverse

Title: Upload Manual Tax Entry: Assignment to Sales Order is Not Permitted
Content: Symptom-You cannot upload manual tax entries via Excel due to the following error message:-"Assignment to Sales Order is Not Permitted."-Or-"The following Error(s) occurred while saving data:-The underlying connection was closed: An unexpected error occurred on receive.-Total Number of Records Saved: 0."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Open the Microsoft excel file, you want to upload.-Navigate to the SAP Business ByDesign tab.-Login to the ByDesign system via Microsoft excel.-Click Save data to.-You get the error message:-"The following Error(s) occurred while saving data:-The underlying connection was closed: An unexpected error occurred on receive.-Total Number of Records Saved: 0."-Click Ok.-You have another pop-up window with the following message:-"0 Record(s) saved successfully to SAP Business ByDesign."-Click ok.-Or-You get the error message: "Assignment to Sales Order is Not Permitted."-Cause-In the excel file, when you select both Project Task and Sales Order references you have to choose the AccoutingCodingBlockTypeCode as PRO as system logic will determine it as SLS (sales order) which is not allowed to post according to the Business Configuration.-Assignment of sales order in a manual tax entry is not supported in Business ByDesign system.-As of now only the account assignment types ACC, CC, IMAT, PRFT and PRO are supported via manual tax entry.-You can see this setting under the following path:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view. -Search and select the Account Assignment Types activity. -Click on the same to open it or Click Change Immediately.-Click the Maintain Account Assignment Types link. -Search and select Account Assignment Type SLS. -Under Details, navigate to the Assignment to Business Transaction tab. -The business transaction type 794 -Cash Flow Expense and Receipt Explanation is not assigned-Resolution-You need to add the following columns to the excel to solve the issue:-SalesOrderItemId-AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode-In the column AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode you enter the value as PRO.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance subview in the Business Flexibility view.-Search and select the "Manual Tax Entries Upload" template.-Click Download.-Open the Microsoft Excel file Manual Tax Entries Upload.-Add in the columns SalesOrderItemId and AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode.-Enter all the required data.-In the AccountingCodingBlockTypeCode column, enter the value as PRO.-Click Save.-Navigate to the SAP Business ByDesign tab.-Login to SAP Business ByDesign from Microsoft Excel.-Click Save Data to.-The File is uploaded without any issues.-Keywords-manual tax entry upload; Manuelle Steuerbuchungen hochladen

Title: Error Message: Value YABCDE_XXX in setting A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT must also be entered in setting APC_C_TXDECLT
Content: Symptom-When deploying the business configuration in your SDK solution, the following error is prompted:-"Value YABCDE_XXX in setting A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT must also be entered in setting APC_C_TXDECLT" (where YABCDE_XXX refers to the solution ID and numeric value defined in the affected BCO)-The same error can be observed when the upgrade of the Implementation Project fails in the front-end UI.-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Open the PDI solution.-Right click on the solution in solution explorer and select Deploy Business Configuration.-Error Occurs.-Alternatively, the same error occurs if:-Login to UI.-Navigate to Business Configuration work center-> Implementation Projects View.-Click on Open Activity List.-Error Occurs.-Cause-This error happens when the value of TaxDeclarationTypeCode that you have defined in the TaxDeclarationProfile BCO is missing in the TaxDeclarationType BCO as this is the foreign key which links the two objects.-Resolution-You should maintain the same TaxDeclarationTypeCode value in the two affected Business Configuration Objects.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return Run; BC Set; Cloud Applications Studio; PDI; Tax Return Types

Title: Pay And Preview Button Grayed out For Service Tax Return
Content: Symptom-While filling service tax return, system is not allowing to complete tax return. The Pay and Preview button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Click on the Service / Excise Tax Returns subview in the Tax Returns view.-Select the All Tax Returns option in show field and click the Go button.-Select your desired Tax Return IDs and click on View button.-Service Tax Payment window will open and you can find that Pay and Preview button is grayed out.-Cause-Root cause of this issue is that your desired tax returns has completed status and the tax payments of the returns already in released status.-For already paid tax return the pay button will not be enabled.-Preview button will come only for tax returns that have form output.-For the service tax challan, there is no form output provided by SAP. That's the reason the preview button will not be enabled for Service Tax Challan return.-Resolution-System behaviour is correct.-See Also-2450663 - Tax Return is not Visible for Payment; Pay Button is Disabled-Tax Payments Quick Guide-VAT Returns Quick Guide-Keywords-Tax return; tax payment; pay button; Steuermeldung; Steuerzahlung; Steuer zahlen

Title: Balance Not Zero; Account Cannot be Closed
Content: Symptom-You are not able to close a bank account due to the error message "Balance not zero; account cannot be closed."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the My Banks subview in the Master Data view.-Search and select the Bank Account ABC (ABC is the bank account).-Click Edit, select Bank Accounts.-Select the Bank Account Number DEF (DEF is the bank account number) that you want to close.-Click Actions and select Close.-You get the error message "Balance not zero; account cannot be closed."-Cause-You still have unconfirmed payments in the Payment Monitor concerning such bank account.-You can check this with the Cash Position - Transaction Details report.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the List subview in the Reports view.-Search and select Cash Position - Transaction Details (FINPAYU03_Q0003) report.-Run the report.-The Transaction Amount is not zero.-Resolution-The bank account balance is not a simple matter of Confirmed payments.-The system, in fact, uses the confirmed bank account balance and the planned liquidity at a specified due date to calculate the relevant bank account balance.-This means that even an outgoing bank transfer yet to be transferred is captured when system calculates the bank account balance.-The Closing Cash Balance must be made zero and all the open payments must be either Canceled or Confirmed so that the account balance becomes Zero and hence allowable to be closed.-The payment transactions recorded within the system shall, of course, be supported by real life transactions.-See Also-2124362 - How to Create a New Bank Account Upon a Company Merge-Keywords-Bankkonto schliessen; close bank account

Title: Error When Creating New Bank to Bank Transfer: 'G12 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value'
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new bank to bank transfer, however you receive an error when posting the payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Under Common Tasks, click to create a new Bank to Bank Transfer.-Fill in the required information and click Preview. -The following errors are raised:-G12 is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value-Action failed-Cause- The error is being raised since the template group for bank to bank transfers (G12) is missing.-You can see that the template group is not available via below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Search for template group for bank to bank transfer.-Resolution-In order to make this template available, you need to scope the related question for Payment Forms in the scope of your implementation projects, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects.-Open the project scope and navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Expand Cash Flow Management -> Payment and Liquidity Management and click Communication for Payment and Liquidity.-Within this element, you find the related question 'You can print and send bank-to-bank transfer documents'.-Once this is scoped, the template group G12 becomes available under Application and user Management -> Form Template Maintenance and the error shall not happen upon clicking preview.-Keywords-Form Template. Bank to Bank Transfer. Payment Management.

Title: "Labor Resource Does Not Belong to Company" Error in Service Order
Content: Symptom-When trying to Complete Execution on a Service Order, you see error: Labor resource ABC does not belong to company DEF (Where ABC represents the Labor Resource ID, and DEF represents the Company ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Open the Service Order Processing view.-Open Service Order GHI (Where GHI represents a Service Order ID).-Click the View All button.-Click the Submit button and then Complete Execution.-You will see error: Labor resource ABC does not belong to company DEF.-Cause-This can happen for two reasons:-The Labor Resource really does not belong to the correct Cost Center.-The Labor Resource was correctly assigned, but the Validity is now over.-Resolution-Check the Labor Resource configuration:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Open the Resources view.-Open Labor Resource ABC.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-In the All Cost Center Assignments section, check the Validity and Cost Centers assigned.-If the Cost Center is assigned incorrectly: -You can edit the current assignment, or click the Add Row button in order to create a new one.-If the Validity is expired, you have two options:-Change the Requested Date on the Service Order header so that it's within the Validity of the Labor Resource.-Change the Validity of the Labor Resource to accomodate for the configured Requested Date in the Service Order header. -See Also-1692907 - In Your Sales Orders the Error Message : "Labor resource not available for service performer" is Triggered-1473402 - Labor Resource in customer service documents-Keywords-Labor Resource, Labour, Service Order, Not Belong to Company, Cost Center, Validity

Title: Tax Return is not Visible for Payment; Pay Button is Disabled
Content: Symptom-You have created a Reported tax payable return; however the reported tax return is not visible for payment in the Tax Payment. Furthermore, the Pay button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center-Go to the Tax Payments view-Open the relevant Tax Payment.-In the Open Tax Returns section, you did not find the correct tax return.-Go to the Sales and Use Tax Returns view.-Find the Reported tax return.-You see that the Pay button is grayed out.-Cause-Although this is a tax payable, the Total Payable/Receivable amount is Zero.-The previous tax return run resulted in a tax receivable from tax authority.-However, this tax receivable has been carried forward to the current tax return, which has a tax payable in the same amount.-Refer to the Carry Forward Amount field in the tax return.-Resolution-System behavior is correct. The externally created payments for this tax return can be canceled/reversed.-See Also-KBA 2040973- How to Process an Incoming Tax Return-SAP Help Portal: Tax Payments Quick Guide-Keywords-Tax return; tax payment; pay button; Steuermeldung; Steuerzahlung; Steuer zahlen

Title: Missing Customer Project Expense Under Time and Expenses for Project
Content: Symptom-You are revising the Customer Project Expense Lists (CPELs) and noticed that a few of them got assigned to the wrong sales order. When you try to find the expenses under the project, you do not find the related expense assigned to the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Journal Entries view.-Find the journal entry for the specific CPEL and open it.-In the Journal Entry, you see that the wrong sales order has been assigned.-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Select the relevant project and click Edit Time and Expenses.-Search for the sales order assigned to the CPEL.-You do not find the concerned expense item so that you can change the sales order assignment.-Cause-The expense item has already been invoiced, hence it doesn't show that up in the above screen and the sales order assignment cannot be changed.-Resolution-You can track the related project invoice request for this expense as follows:-Through the previously opened journal entry for the CPEL, find the sales order, project task and reference expense item (e.g. a goods and activity confirmation).-Go to Project Management work center. -Go to Project Invoice Requests view.-Show All Project Invoice Requests. -Through the advanced filter, search for Reference Project ID and Reference Sales Order ID.-You find a related project invoice request ID.-Click Edit and go to Items tab -> Invoice Items.-Select one line item.-Go to Time and Expenses tab.-Use Product ID and Project Tasks as filters in the table.-You find the concerned expense item corresponding to the item from goods and activity confirmation previously found in the journal entry (click Item Details to see the source document reference or add the column 'Reference Document' via Personalize menu).-In order to make this expense available under the Not Invoice Time and Expenses view for the project, you need to undo the invoicing process so that the expense becomes a Not Invoiced expense again.-See Also- 2091553 - Correctly Assigned Times and Expenses Are Missing in Not Invoiced Times and Expenses/ Project Invoicing-Keywords-CPEL. PIR. Gods Issue.

Title: For Period XXX and Set of Books YYYY, Closing Step ABC Must be Closed First
Content: Symptom-You create a new Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for period XXX (XXX is the period) in year YYYY, but the system gives error message: For period XXX and set of books YYYY, closing step ABC must be closed first.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Select the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs sub view under the Periodic Tasks view.-Click New and select Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Run.-Fill in all the details and click Start Now.-The system gives an error: For period XXX and set of books YYYY, closing step ABC must be closed first.-Cause-When a run is created with closing step 010 -Operational Postings, then a posting is made for the open item in the current period and a counter posting is made for the open item on the 1st day of the next period. If you want to close this open item in between, then this will not be possible if a posting is already made in the next period with closing step - 010 Operational Postings. To avoid this, you get the error message.-The Foreign Currency Remeasurement should be created with the closing step as 020 - Closing Entries and the period must also be closed for Operational postings. So make sure that the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step is 020-Closing Entries for the period(XXX) for which you have executed the run. For the next Accounting Period(YYYY),Please set the Last Allowed Step to 020 - Closing entries.--Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose Open and Close Periods under Common Tasks.-Choose the row of Accounting Period ID XXX, and set the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step to 020 - Closing entries.-Choose the row of Accounting Period ID YYYY, and set the Last Allowed Step to 020 - Closing entries.-Make sure that the period is not Blocked.-Go back to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run.-Create the run with closing step as “020 - Closing Entries” and choose Start Now.-The run should be successfully executed.-  Keywords-foreign currency remeasurement run

Title: Error : "com.sap.smd.wily.hostagent.action.TcpListenerAction - init(): destination not ready for action TCP_59XXX [EXCEPTION]Warning com.sap.smd.wily.hostagent.SapAgent - startActions(): Action TCP_59XXX cannot be started: destination not ready for action TCP_59XXX" While Business Object is not registered correctly
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In Business Object System on the Diagnostic Agent log you see the following error :-Sep 3, 2019 8:46:25 AM [Thread[Thread-1,5,main] ] Error com.sap.smd.wily.hostagent.action.TcpListenerAction - init(): destination not ready for action TCP_59XXX-[EXCEPTION]-com.sap.smd.wily.hostagent.TransientException: destination not ready for action TCP_59XXX-Sep 3, 2019 8:46:25 AM [Thread[Thread-1,5,main] ] Warning com.sap.smd.wily.hostagent.SapAgent - startActions(): Action TCP_59XXX cannot be started: destination not ready for action TCP_59XXX-Sep 3, 2019 8:46:25 AM [Thread[Thread-1,5,main] ] Error com.sap.smd.wily.hostagent.action.TcpListenerAction - init(): destination not ready for action TCP_64XX-[EXCEPTION]-com.sap.smd.wily.hostagent.TransientException: destination not ready for action TCP_64XX-Environment-Solution Manager 7.2-Business object -Reproducing the Issue-Go on the Diagnostic Agent log -You can see the log error on the Diagnostic Agent log folder-Cause-The agent port is not correctly configured in the ncs.conf file -Resolution-Reverify the agent port in file /usr/sap/xxx/sap_bobj/enterprise_xi40/conf/xxxx/ncs.conf while it should be port 6404, as you defined in the managed system configuration.-Reverify with the Netstat command if the port is reachabel from the managed system ?-Please change it, then do the following:-1) Access the Agent Administration-2) Access tab "Application Configuration"-3) Expand com.sap.smd.agent.application.wilyhost and select the SapAgentConfig.xml-4) Delete this file for the scope of agent impact-Rerun the managed system configuration, step "Introscope Host Adapter" for both the BOBJ and Data Services installed in this host. Besides that, check if ports 6391 and 6404 are being used by other applications in the OS level, if so, you may have to change this configuration to use other ports. And you also have to check what port is set in the BOBJ system itself. This can be done as described in our wiki: http://wiki.scn.sap.com/wiki/x/tAsLGg-Keywords

Title: Supplier Invoice is Correctly Submitted via SII Return Even Though no Tax Number is Maintained
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice for SII reporting, which got processed successfully even though no tax data was set up in the supplier's master.-You expect an error being raised in the SII return due to missing tax number, however the error is not raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns view.-Show all and find the concerned SII return.-Open the return and go to Tax Return tab.-You see a supplier invoice has been processed, even though there is no tax number for the associated business partner.-Cause-For non ES-Spain and non-EU suppliers, if there is no tax number maintained in the business partner, the supplier ID is sent as tax number in the field IDOTRO ID with IDOTRO ID type as 06 (Otro Documento Probatorio). Due to that, there is no error reported even though there is no tax number maintained for the supplier in the system-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Tax number. SII. Tax Data.

Title: Mileage Reimbursement Calculation for Canada Is Not Working
Content: Symptom-An employee working for a Canadian company created an expense report of type Business trip and added Mileage data. However, while checking the Reimbursement information you noticed that the system is not calculating Mileage Reimbursement (amount is zero).-This Case Document is relevant for Country version CA - Canada only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view and select the New Expense Report On Behalf  subview.-Enter an Employee who works for a Canadian company.-Enter the Type of Expense Report Business trip and a Purpose.-Enter a Start Date / End Date for the trip (Country Canada is automatically filled).-Under Mileage section, enter the Total Distance (km - Kilometer). Vehicle Class and Vehicle Type data are automatically filled.-Click Add More Mileage Information, enter a Canadian Province and click OK.-Now move up to phase 4 Review.-Under Reimbursements and Expense Summary section, notice that Mileage Reimbursements is 0.00 CAD, meaning that the system didn't calculate the Mileage data x the Reimbursement Rate defined for the Canadian Province.-Cause-The reason why the system is not calculating Mileage Reimbursement for Canada is the missing configuration for Vehicle Class in the Mileage Rates - Canada fine tuning activity in Business Configuration work center.-As of Business ByDesign 1502 release, in order to handle the Canadian Mileage requirement from Canadian Regulatory Authority (namely CRA), two vehicle classes i. e. Domestic travel and International travel were introduced into the Business Configuration set for Mileage accordingly. In response to this change, the system makes the field Vehicle Class mandatory as there are now values available to input for Vehicle Class.-Resolution-You need to set up the Vehicle Class accordingly in Mileage Rates - Canada fine tuning activity, as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Mileage Rates - Canada activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Edit mileage reimbursement rates.-The Per-kilometer Allowance Rates screen opens: select Unreasonable Rates or Reasonable Rates depending on where you have maintained your rates.-Copy the existing lines and define a Vehicle Class for each one (usually you'll have one line for each Per Diem Region).-Click Save and Close.-As a result, the system should correctly calculate the Mileage Reimbursement for Canada now.-  Keywords-mileage rates; reimbursement; expense reports; Fahrkosten; Fahrkosten Geld; Spesen

Content: Symptom-You want to know which documents are supported in approval process in CRM area and where to configure the approval relevant settings.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can find the supported documents/processes in CRM area.-#-Process Scope Question Path BC Activity Multi-Step Approval? Related KBA-1 Sales Quote-Sales -> New Business ->Quotes -> Approval for Quotes. -Question:Do you want to use a multi-step approval process for quotes?-Approval for Quotes Yes-2620629-2258753-2168007-2 Sales Order-Sales -> Selling Products and Services -> Sales Orders -> Approval for Sales Orders. -Question:Do you want to use a multi-step approval process for sales orders?-Approval for Sales Orders Yes-2807601-2638158-1658313-3 Customer Contract-Sales -> Selling Products and Services -> Customer Contracts -> Approval for Customer Contracts.-Question:Do you want to use a multi-step approval process for customer contracts?-  Yes-2766872-4 Service Order-Service -> Service and Repair -> Service Order. -Question:Do you want to use an approval process for service orders ?-  Yes  -5 Service Confirmation-Service -> Service and Repair -> Service Confirmation. -Question:Do you want to use an approval process for service confirmations?-  Yes-2116816-2623008-6 Customer Return-Sales -> Selling Products and Serivces -> Customer Returns -> Approval for Customer Returns. -Question:Do you want to set-up an approval process for your returns?-Approval for Customer Returns No 1969149-7 Manual Customer Invoice*-Sales -> Customer Invoicing -> Miscellaneous Invoicing. -Question:Do you want to set up approval process for manual customer invoices and credit memos?-  Yes-2627581-2737293-2725799-2489387-8 Price List and Discount List-General Business Data ->Product and Service Pricing -> Sales Price and Discount Lists. -Question:Do you want to set up an approval process for price and discount lists?-  No  -  For the Multi-Step approval processes, after enabled in Business Configuration project, you are able to find them in the Application and User Management work center -> Approval Processes view, where you can set up the detailed approval steps for example conditions and approvers.-Here is an example of how to set up multi-step approval process for Sales Order: 2853153 - How to Set up Multi-Step Approval Process for Sales Orders-For the non Multi-Step approval processes, you will need to follow the dedicated approval process describes below.-Customer Return: 1969149 How to set-up an Approval Process for Customer Returns-Price List and Discount List: 2083329 - Approval Process for Price list and Discount List.-*Please note that there is no Approval Processes for Customer Invoices with preceding documents or for Invoices based on External Customer Invoice Requests. The reason for this is that the Approval is assumed to be already done in the preceding document for example the Sales Order. Hence the approval process can only be set up for Manual Customer Invoices.-See Also-Sales Quote Approval related KBA:-2620629 - Sales Quote Approval Process tab not showing Approver-2168007 - Self Approval Of Sales Quotes Cannot Be Skipped-2258753 - Employee Does not Appear in the Direct Approvers List of the Sales Quote or Sales Order Approval Process-Sales Order Approval related KBA:-2807601 - Sales Order Approval Notifications are not Sent for the Approver.-2638158 - Approval Notes missing in the Sales Documents-1658313 - Sales Order Approval is Not Supported for B2B and A2A Orders-Customer Return Approval related KBA:-1969149 - How to set-up an Approval Process for Customer Returns-Customer Contract Approval related KBA:-2766872 - How to set-up an Approval Process for Customer Contract-Manual Invoice Approval related KBA:-2627581 - Approval Process for Cancellation Customer Invoice-2737293 - Approve Button is Not Shown in Approvals Work Center View for Manual Customer Invoice Task-2725799 - Approval Rule Works for Customer Invoice But Not Credit Memo-2489387 - Approval Process is not Triggered for External Customer Invoice Request-Service Confirmation Approval related KBA:-2116816 - How to Set up an Approval Process for Service Confirmation.-2623008 - Without Order Completion or With Order Completion Option not Available in Service Confirmation-Keywords-approval process; CRM; multi-step approval

Title: How To Stop Depreciation of Fixed Asset For a Period
Content: Symptom-Automatic Depreciation for a Fixed Asset needs to be skipped for a period of time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There is a possibility to change the Depreciation Method of the Valuation View Settings of an Asset so it won't Automatically Depreciate for a period, as Depreciation cannot be skipped at the Depreciation Run.-Open the Fixed Asset you want to stop Depreciation for.-Click View All.-Go to the Master Data tab.-Go to the Asset Valuation sub-tab.-If you need to change the same for another Valuation View redo steps (6 - 9) for each one.-Go to the Valuation Intervals tab.-Click Add Row.-Select Start Date* (date that you want Depreciation to stop).-Select Depreciation Method to 0000 - No automatic depreciation.-After all Valuation Views are done click Save.-As each scenario is unique we recommend that you discuss this change with your Accounting Team as well as test it in your Test Tenant before going forward with the change in Productive.-Depending on the Start Date you choose, Depreciation may still occur according to the previous Depreciation Method.-If the Start Date is from a date where Depreciation was already executed, the next run will post the amount in opposite direction.-*This date is the beginning of a period if the Depreciation Method is not configured for exact to date calculation. If the depreciation is configured for exact to date calculation, then choose any date. But in this case use Depreciation Method 000D - 000D is only available for certain countries.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Depreciation, Stop depreciation, skip depreciation-fixed asset,depreciation,stop depreciation,skip depreciation

Title: Manager Not Visible In Personnel File Of Org Unit Manager
Content: Symptom-The manager is missing for employees which are org unit manager in the personnel file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Click on Employees view-Search for relevant employee-Click on Edit-Click on Employment-Click on Organizational Assignment-Note: There is no manager assigned.-Cause- A possible cause why those org unit managers don't have a manager assigned in the personnel file could be that the org unit of the CEO is not marked as company and it is not one level above.-Resolution-The solution is to mark the organizational unit of the manager as a company and to make sure that it is at least one level above.-Keywords-Personaldatei, personnel file, kein Vorgesetzter, no manager, Genehmigungsaufgaben, approval tasks, keinen Genehmigenden ermittlen, no approver found,
