Title: The Automatic Determination of Sales Unit and Employee Responsible is not Working in Contract
Content: Symptom-The automatic determination of Sales Unit and Employee Responsible is not working in contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Create a new contract.-Add an account in the contract.-The sales unit and employee responsible has not been determined automatically.-Cause-The determination rule at Business Configuration and Organizational Work Distribution Rules are not maintained for contracts.-Resolution-Below are the details for dermination of Sales Unit in the Contract:-A. Business Configuration settings:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click on Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine Tune tab.-Search and open Involved Parties for Customer Contracts activity.-Select Sales Unit and click on Maintain Determinations.-You have below rules selected:-First Priority:Responsibility Sales Unit for Sales.-Second Priority: Functional Organizational Unit of Employee Responsible.-Third Priority: Organizational Unit from Org Model if only One Suitable Functional Unit Exits.-Now in your contracts, the sales unit is not getting determined because none of the above rule is getting fulfilled.-For First Priority: You have not maintained responsibility in Work Distribution Rules.-For Second Priority: Since the logged in user is not an employee, this cannot be applied.-Third Priority: There multiple functional units so this rule is also not applicable.-B. Set the Work Distribution rule using below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Go to the Organizational Work Distribution subview.-Select Sales Unit for Sales and press Edit button.-Choose Add Rule button and maintain the Org Unit Responsible by using value help.-Save your changes.-Below are the details on Automatic determination of Employee Responsible in the Contract:---A. Business Configuration settings:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click on Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine Tune tab.-Search and open Involved Parties for Customer Contracts activity.-Select Employee Responsible and choose Maintain Determinations.-You have below rules selected:-First Priority: Direct responsible of Account.-Second Priority: Responsibility Employee Responsible for Sales.-Third Priority: Logged on User.-Now in your contracts, the Employee Responsible is not getting determined because none of the above rule is getting fulfilled.-For First Priority: No direct Responsible Employee is maintained for the account.-For Second Priority: Since the logged in user is not an employee, this cannot be applied.-Third Priority: You have not maintained responsibility in Work Distribution Rules.-B. Set the Work Distribution rule using below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Go to the Employee Work Distribution subview.-Select Employee Responsible for Sales and choose Edit button.-Choose Add Rule button and maintain the Employee Responsible by using value help.-Save your changes.-C. Other option for automatic determination of employee is to maintain a employee responsible for account directly:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Open the account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Select the View All button.-Go to the Contacts tab.-Select the Responsibilities subtab.-Select the Add Row button.-Select the party role Employee Responsible - Sales and add an employee.-Save the changes.-With above configuration changes the determination of Employee and Sales unit will work automatically.-See Also-For further information please also find the following Blogs:-Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-Party Role Determination in a Service Document-Keywords-Party; Sales Unit; Employee Responsible; Contract

Title: Inventory Cost for Material Valuated by Moving Average Drops After GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You maintain the Perpetual Cost Method Moving Average for an externally procured material.-You purchase this material always for the same price of X,XX LC (X,XX represents the purchase price, LC stands for Local Currency).-The same cash discount of Y% (Y represents the percentage amount) was applied for the respective payments.-You expect that the inventory cost would never drop under or rise above the purchase price minus the cash discount: X,XX LC - Y %= lowest inventory cost.-Yet, you notice that the Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt Clearing (GR/IR) run has caused the inventory cost to drop lower than this expected amount in period MMM.YYYY (MMM.YYYY represents the accounting period).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Inventory Valuation work center navigate to the Master Data view and here to the Materials subview.-In the Find field type in the material ID and press Go.-Select the respective material - business residence combination.-Press View Cost History.-Navigate to the respective period MMM.YYYY.-You notice that the Business Transaction of type Goods Receipt/ Invoice Receipt Clearing caused the inventory cost to drop lower than the material purchase price minus the applied cash discount.-Cause-In general, the inventory cost of an externally procured material with the moving average cost method is being updated either by Goods Receipts from Supplier or by the GR/IR clearing run considering purchase order-related processes of goods receipt and invoice receipt.-For the GR/IR run ONLY the proportional variation still covered by the inventory quantity is calculated for the inventory.-This is intended to guarantee that the inventory cost is correct. The remainder of the variances is included in the price differences, meaning they are being directly posted to the profit and loss accounts defined for price differences.-This becomes significant when the GR/IR clearing run has to consider numerous clearings of goods receipts and invoice receipts for which price differences have been detected. For each clearing the GR/IR clearing run considers the existing stock on the day of the run.-This means that the value of this same stock is being repeatedly reduced causing the inventory cost to drop much lower than expected.-The GR/IR clearing run has not only an affect on the postings of the selected period but also on the values that were posted after this period. This way the inventory cost can drop even more.-Resolution-It is recommended to post consumptions which reduce the inventory quantity only after the GR/IR clearing run.-It should also be ensured that repeated clearings are not be performed on the same inventory quantity as this can result in a highly reduced inventory cost but also a highly inflated inventory cost (in case of positive price differences detected by the GR/IR clearing run).-This is, however, not always feasible.-Then it is possible to exclude certain price differences from being capitalized on the material/Inventory Ledger:-In the Business Configuration, find the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles  Fine Tune activity, either from the Overview or via the Activity List of the Implementation project. -Select the Posting Control Profiles for Procurement Processes link.-To edit the settings, you need to add a new Posting Control Profile by copying the existing profile: Press Copy.-Enter a profile ID starting with Z and an appropriate description.-Navigate to the Procure to Stock tab.-Here you can deselect all the price differences which shall not be capitalized anymore on the inventory cost, e.g. 1- Cash Discount.-Press Save and Close.-Now click the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles link.-Select your newly created Posting Control Profile for all the relevant Accounting Principles.-Press Save and Close.-The price differences between goods receipt value and invoice receipt value will now be posted to an Inventory Difference account.-From now on these difference will have to be manually posted on the respective balance sheet accounts at the end of the accounting period.-See Also-2621145- GR/IR Clearing is Posting to Purchase Price Difference Account-1911776- Using the moving average cost for material valuation-Keywords-Moving Average, Purchase Price Difference, GR/IR Clearing

Title: Accounts and Contacts download from Byd to Outlook
Content: Symptom-Unable to find My Accounts and My Contacts in the add-in folders in Outlook-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outlook.-Go to People Folder.-In the SAP Accounts and Contacts folder the data is not available.-Cause-Only the employees added as "Responsible" will be available in these folders-Resolution-Go to My contacts.-Open any Contact.-Click View all.-Go to Relationships tab.-Go to Responsibilities tab-There should be an Employee added here and Groupware Synchronization option should be checked.-Keywords-Outlook add-in, download accounts and contacts, SAP Accounts, SAP Contacts

Title: Withholding Tax Base Amount Entry is Crashing Upon Release
Content: Symptom-You are unable to release manual withholding tax entry due to system crash.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries view.-Create a new tax base entry with a transaction currency that differs from the tax country default currency.-Click Release.-Example: Tax country of manual entry is set as Israel, whose currency is ILS, but transaction currency is maintained as USD.-Cause-In the current system logic, the withholding tax base amount cannot be posted in a currency that differs from the default currency of the tax country.-Resolution-This functionality is being enhanced by development team.-For the meantime, you may apply a workaround as follows:-Perform the currency conversion outside the system, using the maintained conversion rates in General Ledger.-Create the Withholding tax base amount entry directly in the currency of the tax country. Considering the above example, create the manual tax entry in ILS instead of USD.-Keywords-Manual Tax Entry. Withholding tax. Base Amount. WHT Base Entry. Inconsistent transaction currency.

Title: Message: Missing Clock-Out Time
Content: Symptom-You are unable to complete two older messages for time administration.-Message: Missing clock-out time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Click on Messages view-Select Open Messages-Resolution-You have the following options to fix the issue:-You can complete the data. When completing the data, you will probably run into issues with closed accounting periods.-You can filter out the messages by using the Advanced Filter > More Filter> and add the message date with options < Less Than and tick the check box But exclude.-Going forward, you should monitors those messages on a regular basis and in a timely fashion.-Keywords-Fehlende Gehen Buchungen, nicht eliminieren, nicht mehr nachholen, Meldung auf erledigt setzen, time administration messages, missing clock-out time,

Title: Knowledge Base Article Approval
Content: Symptom-You are creating Knowledge Base Articles via Service Desk work center, however, you don't want to have the Approval for releasing the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Go to the Knowledge Base view.-Click on New button.-Complete the mandatory fields.-Click on Save.-Knowledge Base is In Preparation status.-Open the document created, then click on Change Status button.-Only option available is Start Approval.-Cause-There's a Fine-Tune Activity which determines if Knowldge Base Article will have or not Approval.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Open Activity List button.-Search for Knowledge Base Support activity.-Once you open the activity you can determine:-Knowledge Type;-If Approval is required;-Which Knowledge Type is default.-Note that it is just possible to have one Knowledge Type active (default). If you set to not have Approval, once you click on Change Status button, in the Knowledge Base Article document, the option Release will be available.-See Also-Help Document - Knowledge Base Quick Guide-Keywords-KBA ; Knowledge Base ; Knowledge Base Support ; Service Desk

Title: The Fixed Asset Depreciation Run is Always Scheduled not Finished
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-After setting depreciation runs for the desired period of different companies to run immediately, except for the run of one company, the status of all other runs is never changed from Scheduled to Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Depreciation subview.-Create New Depreciation Run for all the companies and enter the necessary data.-Choose Start Now.- Only the run for one company is Finished, for all other runs, even after quite a long time, the status is always Scheduled not Finished.-Cause-Log on to the backend, and check the batch jobs of the depreciation run creator using transaction code SM37. You can see lots of batch jobs are cancelled. After that, check the job log, and you can see the error message regarding authorization issue. Following this message, check the user's Access Rights, and it turns out that the user does not have read and write authorization for the Fixed Assets view and Depreciation view, also the user is only granted to have read and write access to the company for which the depreciation run can be executed successfully.-Resolution-In order to get the necessary access rights for the user to execute depreciation run, follow the steps below:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the User and Access Management view.-Select the Business Users and click on Edit Access Rights subview.-Navigate to the Access Restrictions tab.-Filter the Work Center Name by Fixed Assets.-Set the Read Access and Write Access to Unristricted.-Go to the Detailed Restrictions, for Access Group ID of each company, set Read Access and Write Access to Unristricted accordingly.-You should be able to successfully execute depreciation runs for all the companies.-Keywords-Eingeplant; Scheduled; Depreciation

Title: Error Message: "Time Agreement Item Deletion Not Possible; Employee Times Exist" During Termination of Employee
Content: Symptom-An attempt to terminate an employee leads to the error message: Time agreement item deletion not possible; employee times exist-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center-Select the Employee List view-Select the option Failed/Not Started in the show field and type-You see the error message as Time agreement item deletion not possible; employee times exist--Cause-When you create a new replication request for an employee, no time data is maintained and the flag Time Data Unchanged Indicator is false. So the system assumes that you want to delete all time related data of the employee, and not only delimit it to the termination date.-Resolution-You can either set the Time Data Unchanged Indicator to true (in this case only a delimitation of the time data will take place) or maintain the time data in the replication request accordingly.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Kündigung Mitarbeiter nicht möglich

Title: You Are Not Able to Migrate a Supplier With More Than Two Payment Methods
Content: Symptom-You are migrating suppliers to the system. You would like to maintain more than two payment methods in the migration template, however you are not able to find this option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select Open Activity List for the desired project-Go to Integrate and Extend phase-Open the Migration of Suppliers activity-Open the Migration Tool-Open the migration template-By unhiding the columns, you are able to find only two fields for Payment Methods-Cause-It is not possible to migrate more than two payment methods for a supplier. A third payment method must be entered manually through the system itself.-Resolution-System is presenting the expected behavior.-Keywords-activity, business configuration, column-migration of suppliers,maintain two payment methods

Title: Financial Reporting Structure Downloaded from ByDesign Fails to Open in Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-A Financial Reporting Structure downloaded from ByDesign fails to open in Microsoft Excel, with following error message:-'We found a problem with some content in 'ABC.xlsx'. Do you want us to try to recover as much as we can? If you trust the source of this workbook, click Yes.'-ABC means the file name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open fine tuning activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit financial reporting structures.-Click Add.-Enter required data and click OK.-Select the newly created structure.-Click Export to Microsoft Excel.-Open the file in Excel.-Error message is thrown: 'We found a problem with some content in 'ABC.xlsx'. Do you want us to try to recover as much as we can? If you trust the source of this workbook, click Yes.'-Cause-As per current design, system does not accept empty reporting structure to be changed and uploaded back to ByDesign (no automatic XML mapping happens in empty reporting structure downloaded in .xlsx format).-Resolution-An existing reporting structure (with data maintained) should be downloaded instead of an empty one, then the changes (add/remove structure) can be done in Excel, and finally uploaded back to ByDesign.-Keywords-financial reporting structure; microsoft excel; xlsx; xml

Title: Error in Fixed Assets - Period control configuration setting missing for period control key
Content: Symptom-You get error message while opening a Fixed Asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Find Fixed Asset with error.-Errors:-Period control configuration setting missing for period control key 'ABC' for the fiscal year variant of valuation view DEF of set of books GHI.-ABC references to one of the system Control Keys.-DEF references to the Valuation View ID.-GHI references to the Set of Books.-Cause-The Set of Books GHI has a Customized Fiscal Year Variant and there is missing configurations for Fixed Assets.-Resolution-To correct this error, maintain the configuration for this with below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Other Fiscal Year activity.-Select Other Fiscal Year activity.-Click Open.-Select the relevant Fiscal Year Variant.-Go to the Period Control for Fixed Assets.-Click Add Row.-Maintain configuration for the Period Control Key in the error message.-Click Save.-This error will no longer occur for this Period Control Key.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Period Control Key, Period control configuration setting missing-fixed asset,period control key,period control configuration setting mis

Title: Customer Invoice Does Not Appear in Output VAT Domestic Register Tax Return For Country Italy
Content: Symptom- You are conducting an Output VAT Domestic Register VAT Return for Italy but Customer Invoice ABC is missing in the preview of the VAT Return (where ABC is the Customer Invoice ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Go to the VAT Returns View.-Select VAT Returns in Preparation, search for XXX (where XXX is the VAT Return ID).-Press Preview.-You can see that Customer Invoice ABC is missing in the VAT Return. You expect it to be there.-Cause-The Customer Invoice ABC has a Tax Code YYY (where YYY is the Tax Code ID) with a corresponding Tax Event ZZZ (where ZZZ is the Tax Event ID). This Tax Event is a reverse charge Tax Event. For reverse charge Tax Events they will not appear in the Output VAT Domestic Register VAT Return for Italy.-Resolution-The system behavior is correct. The Customer Invoice with this Tax Event should not appear there.-Keywords-Output VAT Domestic Register, Italy Tax Return, VAT Return Italy, Reverse Charge Italy

Title: The Switch +/ - Sign Is Not Applied to The Analytics Reports
Content: Symptom-In the Financial Statement report, the Income from Operations values and all other income values, such as Net Revenue, Gross Revenue, Operating Profit and Gross Profit, are displayed negatively while all Cost of Goods Sold values show a positive figure.  -The expectation is that if the Switch +/-Sign field is ticked for the financial reporting structure item, it should reverse the sign of the respective amount in the financial statement report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Viewing the report:-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Report view.-Choose the Financial Statements report.-In the Edit Selection tab, select the respective financial reporting structure and click Go.  -You notice that the Income from Operations values on the report, and, in fact, all other income values (such as Net Revenue, Gross profit etc.) are displayed negative, and that all Cost of Goods Sold values are positive.-But you expected them to appear the other way around as you have ticket the Switch +/- sign box for these items in the financial reporting structure:-Financial Reporting Structure Settings:-Navigate to the Business Configuration workcenter and there to the Implementation Projects view and open the Activity List.-Choose the Fine-Tune phase and find the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Open this activity and then choose Edit financial reporting structures.-Select a structure of type Income Statement and click Edit or View.-For all income related items, such as Operating Profit, Gross Profit, Net Revenue or Gross Revenue you tick the box in the Switch +/-Sign column.-Click OK and then Save and Close.-The expectation is that in the Financial Statement report all income related items are displayed positively and all cost related items are displayed negatively.-Instead, the setting has no influence on the figures in the report.-Cause-The Switch +/- Sign feature is not available in analytical reports but is only intended for Statutory Reports.-Resolution-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks view and select the subview Statutory Reports.-To create an income statement report, click the link Balance Sheet and Income Statement report.-Here you can create your report according to your own requirements.-Keywords- Switch +/- Sign; financial reporting structure; analytical reports; statutory reports

Title: Unable to Delete Standard Account Determination Group due to Error
Content: Symptom- You are trying to delete SAP standard delivered account determination groups related to expense reports (e.g. A-7100), however error messages are raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit Account Determination Groups.-Under Costs -> Groups for General Expenses, highlight A-7100 - Travel expenses (general).-Click Delete.-The following messages are raised:-'Value A-7100 in setting Account Determination Group for Receipt Type must also be entered in setting G/L Accnt Det. Group For Expense Report'-'Change the setting in the 'Edit Account Determination Groups' screen of the 'Account Determination for Tax Events' activity'-'Change the setting in the 'Edit expense types' screen of the 'Create New Country Version' activity'-'Save failed'-Cause-You have set up a generic country version for expense and reimbursement management (ERM). Once this feature is used, it is not possible to delete the predefined account determination groups. Whenever a new generic country version is created this country version is generated out of a template which uses these predefined account determination groups. For that reason they need to remain in the system. Otherwise it would no longer be possible to create another generic country version. Hence, the errors are raised.-Resolution-Since the generic country feature is being used for expense and reimbursement management, the default account determination groups cannot be removed.-Keywords-Account Determination Group for Receipt Type, ADG. Generic Country Version. Expense Report.

Title: Budget Query Amount is Shown as Zero in Forecast Document Items Report
Content: Symptom- You have created and released a budget query, however when running the Forecast Document Items report, the amounts are shown as Zero ($0.00)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open and execute the Forecast Document Items.-You notice that amount for your budget query is zero (0.00)-Cause-When checking the Forecast Document Items report, the key figures Amt Comp Curr and Transaction Amount shows the balance of the budget query, which is zero due to credit and corresponding debit.-Resolution-To check further details of the corresponding amount, you may add to the report the characteristic for Debit/Credit.-Additionally, as per current design of forecasting logic, any change in the source documents (budget queries or purchase orders, etc) would trigger forecast document business object and would create entries in the backend for every change. When you bring row fields like Created On and Commitment Level in Forecast Document Items Report, you shall be able to narrow down to further entries that aggregates and balances amount to zero.-Keywords-Budget queries. Budget Query. Forecast Document.

Title: Some of the Fields are Missing in the Adaptation Mode
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to change the Properties of a particular field whereas the Field is missing in the Adaptation Mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The reason that you are not able to view the fields in the adaptation mode is that these fields are extension fields which have been added via PDI and therefore these fields will not be available in the adaptation mode.-Resolution-Any change to the PDI fields should be performed by the User who created them in the respective tools. User extensions can be edited in Business ByDesign itself in respective screen.-Keywords-PDI Fields, adaptation mode

Title: Paid By Company Option Missing In SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App
Content: Symptom-While using the SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App to submit expense reports you notice that, compared to submitting the expense report from the browser, the Paid by Company checkbox is missing when adding an expense item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Mobile app.-Go to My Launchpad.-Go to Home.-Click on Create Expense Reports.-Fill in the required data.-Under Expenses, add a new Expense.-You will see there is no "Paid by Company" checkbox available.-Cause-The mobile application does not offer a full match of all fields which are available on the desktop, but only a selection of the most important and most used fields.-Resolution-When selecting an expense type such as "Flight paid by company" which is configured accordingly, the flag is automatically set per default behind the scenes so that such an expense will be created with the "Paid by company" flag being set. This can be verified by creating an expense report with such an expense via the mobile app and checking it in the desktop.-The only use case which is not covered is if after selecting such an expense type the user wants to deselect the "Paid by company" flag. This is currently only possible via the desktop.-If you need this functionality urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the SAP Cloud Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by Cloud Service Center . You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of SAP Application Development site , choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea.-Keywords-Mobile app; Business In Focus; Expenses; ByD;

Title: Error: Bank Details of Payer/Payee do Not Exist
Content: Symptom-You are trying to execute an automatic payment via bank transfer. You get the error message: "Bank details of payer/payee <payee ID (name)> do not exist."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Find the concerned payment proposal.-Click Edit.-Set the Payment Method as Bank Transfer, if not specified yet.-You get the error message: "Bank details of payer/payee <payee ID (name)> do not exist."-Cause-The payee bank account data is not valid at the Payment Date, hence the payment cannot take place and the error message is raised.-Resolution-In order to process the bank transfer you need to change the validity period of the bank account.-You can change the validity of the bank account as follows:-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers subview.-Find the related supplier account and click Edit Financial Data.-Go to the Bank Data subtab.-Check the Valid From and the Valid To columns and adjust the validity period of the bank account details so that it is valid on the Payment date.-Alternatively, you can change the Payment Date so that it lies in the validity period of the bank account details.-Note that the Valid From column is hidden per default. It can be displayed through the Personalize menu, at the top of the screen.-The personalization is user specific, if you wish to display the column to all users, use the adaptation mode.-Keywords-payment porposal; Zahlungsvorschalg; Zahlungsdetails ermitteln

Title: 'Item ABC has both assignments and items; children not imported' Error Message Importing Financial Reporting Structure from Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-Error message is thrown upon importing a financial reporting structure from Microsoft Excel:-'Item ABC has both assignments and items; children not imported'-ABC means the financial reporting structure item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the structure you want to update by importing an updated version from Excel.-Click Import from Microsoft Excel.-Browse for the xml file.-Click OK.-Error message is thrown:-'Item ABC has both assignments and items; children not imported'-Cause-As per the design of financial reporting structure hierarchy, assignments and items together can't be allowed under one item.-For example, in the respective xml file, Item node contain Item 'Assets' and 'XYZ' (Accounts Assignment) in same hierarchy. Due to that, system didn't allow the import.-Resolution-The item 'XYZ' should be put under proper node, and then, the Import from Microsoft Excel function should be executed again.-Keywords-financial reporting structure; import from Microsoft Excel; item; node; itemtype; assignmenttype; account

Title: Existing US Sales Tax Jurisdiction Determination Rules are not Editable
Content: Symptom- The existing Tax Jurisdiction Determination Rules currently does not match your needs, however you are unable to change the settings.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and open activity Tax on Goods and Services - US.-Click Define Tax Jurisdiction Determination Rules.-You wish to edit existing entries e.g. Origination Taxation box and/or delete existing entries, however you are not able to make changes for such entries.-Cause-The highlighted entries are delivered as standard by SAP for that screen and cannot be changed.-Resolution-To adjust the tax jurisdiction determination rules as per your needs, you are able to add new rows are create your own rules with higher priority. For the custom entries, the corresponding button of creation, deletion and priority increase/decrease shall work as expected.-Keywords-Tax Jurisdiction Rules. Tax Determination.

Title: Canada: Incorrect Region is Displayed in Journal Entries Resulting From Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-An incorrect Region (state) is displayed in the journal entries created from an intercompany journal entry voucher (ICJEV) in Canada.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries > Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Open IC Journal Entry Voucher ID AAA (AAA means the Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher ID).-Click View All.-Under Line Items section, notice that State displayed is ABC (ABC means the State name).-Open the Journal Entry from the ICJEV.-Select a line item with a credit posting to the Taxes G/L Account.-Notice that Region displayed is not ABC, but DEF (DEF means the Region name).-Cause-The ICJEV AAA was created with State DEF, as a mistake. Later, the State was changed to ABC (correct one) and the ICJEV released. Under these circumstances, the system is not able to update the Region (state) in the Journal Entry and it stays as DEF.-Resolution-This is currently a system limitation.-As a workaround, when an ICJEV has been posted with such error, it can be reversed and a new entry can be created with correct State.-See Also-A similar limitation is observed in the Manual Tax Entry scenario for Canada.-Please check KBA 2885845 - Canada: Incorrect Region is Displayed in a Manual Tax Entry Journal Entry-Keywords-intercompany journal entry voucher; ICJEV; state; region; canada; CA

Title: UK MTD VAT Return Error: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located IN: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA
Content: Symptom-Approval Status of an UK Making Tax Digital VAT Return is Rejected and error message is raised:-'|No account determined for VRN ABC. Please check configuration.|Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located IN: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA'-ABC stands for the VAT Registration Number maintained for respective UK Tax Authority in the Company Tax Arrangement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Open the respective Tax Return ID.-Click View All.-Notice that the Approval Status is Rejected and Error Description is: |No account determined for VRN ABC. Please check configuration.|Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located IN: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA.-Cause-In fine tuning activity UK Making Tax Digital, the VAT Registration Number maintained under Authorized Accounts table is not the same as maintained in Company Tax Arrangement.-Resolution-The VAT Registration Number maintained in fine tuning activity UK Making Tax Digital should be exactly the same as the one maintained in Tax Authority > Company Tax Arrangement, including the prefix GB.-Once the correct number is maintained in the activity, the VAT Return should be successfully completed.-Keywords-UK MTD; MTD; Making Tax Digital; No account determined for VRN; REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA; Rejected

Title: How to Abort or Change a Tenant Request triggered from Service Control Center Work Center
Content: Symptom-A Service Request is triggered from the Service Control Center (SCC) Work Center for a tenant-related activity. -The Service Request may be related to activities such as: Tenant Refresh, Tenant Restore, New Tenant, Tenant Termination Other tenant-related requests. -After the request is triggered, there may be a requirement to change the request details, such as the requested date/time, or abort the request. However, the options to edit or abort the request are not available in the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Service Control Center Work Center.-Trigger a Service Request for a tenant-related activity. The request can be related to activities such as tenant refresh, restore, provisioning, or termination.-After the request is triggered, try to modify the request details or abort the request.-The options to modify or abort the request are not available.-Cause-This is expected behavior. -Once a tenant-related Service Request has been triggered from the Service Control Center Work Center, it cannot currently be modified or aborted directly through the service control center.-Resolution-If a Service Request that has already been triggered needs to be changed or aborted, raise an incident to the responsible component SRD-CC-CI-CCS or LOD-CRM-ADM. -Provide the relevant details of the Service Request, including: Tenant ID, Service Request details, Request type/activity, Requested date and time, Required change or cancellation Reason for the change or abort request.-The responsible team will review the request and take the necessary action.-Keywords-Service Request, Tenant Request, Service Control Center, SCC, Tenant Refresh, Tenant Restore, Tenant Provisioning, New Tenant, Tenant Termination, Tenant Decommissioning, Abort Request, Change Request

Title: Production Lot Is Not Showing in Production Variance Details Report
Content: Symptom-A Production Lot is not showing in Production Variance Details Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find Production Variance Details.-The Production Lot is not showing in the Report.-Cause-Rarely the calculate variance may not occur due to change errors/lock error with the Material Cost Estimate status.-Resolution-In such case if there are missing Production Lot Variance, you can trigger it manually as well.-You can select Production Lot from Inventory Valuation - Production Lot, and then click Calculate Variance.-See Also-Help Document Production Variance Analysis-Keywords-Production Lot; Variance; Material Cost Estimate; Production Variance

Title: Missing Notice Period in Hiring Process
Content: Symptom-You are unable to select a Notice Period while hiring an employee.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personel Administration workcenter.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select a Country and go to Next step.-Enter mandatory Fields in Personal Informaton and select Next.-In Hiring tab you are unable to select any value for Notice Period.-Cause-Only few countries have been assigned Notice Period in their Scoping:-Austria, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Switzerland, China, Germany, France, United Kingdom, India, Mexico & New Zealand-Resolution-Except for the Countries mentioned above, do not have the option to assign Notice Period to employees. Hence, the Activity Notice Period is missing from Business Configuration Activity List.-  Keywords-Personel Administration, Notice Period, Country, Missing notice period for countries

Title: Sales Document Item View Does Not Show Same UI in Test and Production Tenants
Content: Symptom-You access the Sales Documents Items view in the test tenant, and if you give one click in a document it shows Revenues per Period for Set of Books in the below Details area. If you do the exact same actions in production tenant, there is no data in this section, even though there is data in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Sales Document Items view.-Click once in a document.-The Details section will open below the list.-Go to Accounting Data tab.-In one tenant the Revenues per Period for Set of Books has data, and in the other, it doesn’t, even though in both tenants there is the same data to supply information to that field.-Cause-The system that does not show any information has SADL OWL for Sales Document Items. Here the functionality is such that, the details section, Revenues per Period works only for the default Set Of Books. The default Set Of Books not being the one for that document, does not have any accrual method assigned, hence, the Revenues per period does not show any value.--Whereas in the system that shows data, the OWL is non-SADL, hence the values are shown for the other Set of Books (not only the default) for which an accrual method has been assigned.-Resolution-If you want that both tenants show this data, regardless the set of books used, you must configure your tenants for the Non-SADL UIs configuration.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the current project.-Press Edit Project Scope button.-In step 4, open Built-in Services and Support > System Management > User Interface List Mode.-The questions will then appear.-Flag question ‘Do you want to use the object work list in the classic mode?’.-Keywords- SADL OWL, Sales Document Items, Revenue per Period, Cost and Revenue.

Title: General Tab in Fixed Asset Has Empty Fields
Content: Symptom-You have a Capitalized Fixed Asset and all information about Valuation Parameters are filled the respective fields and tabs. However, when you access the Fixed Asset, the Valuation Parameters section is empty either in Overview mode or under General tab, when you access View All mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Access Fixed Assets view.-Open the Fixed Asset in question.-You notice that the All Assignments Intervals section is empty in Overview mode and also in General tab.-Cause-The Fixed Asset is not valid as of current date. Under All Assignments Intervals, in Master Data - Basic Data tabs, you can see that the Valid To field is filled with a past date, which means that the Fixed Asset is not valid anymore.-Resolution-You need to adjust the time interval of the Assignment to a current date to display the details.-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Access Fixed Assets view.-Open the Fixed Asset in question.-Go to View All mode.-Go to Basic Data tab, under Master Data tab.-In All Assignments Intervals session, select Add Row.-Add information with Valid To field for the future.-This way the Fixed Asset will become valid again and the data will be displayed in the expected fields.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Validity, Empty, Data, Fields. Capitalized.

Title: Credit Memo Does Not Appear in Collection Cases
Content: Symptom- You are accessing your Collection Cases in the system and you notice that Invoices type Credit Memo doesn't generate cases in the list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Collection Cases view.-Search for the Credit Memo ID.-You cannot find the Case which refers to the Credit Memo that you are looking for.-Cause-The system doesn't generate a collection case for a Credit Memo Invoice, because this document is not intended for the customer to pay it. The Credit Memo usually is generated from an Invoice, or if created directly, refers to an Invoice.-Hence the Collection Case is already created to the original invoice and won’t be created again.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior, as Credit Memos are not chargeable documents.-Keywords-Credit Memo, Collection Cases, Invoice, Credit Note.

Title: Error ‘RFC not valid’ When Entering Tax Number Into Account
Content: Symptom-You are trying to enter the Tax Number in a Business Partner Account, but the system throws the following error message, even though the number is correct.- "RFC not valid"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Open the the Business Partner account.-Go to View All mode.-Under Financial Data tab, access Tax Data subtab.-Add Row for Tax Numbers.-Enter the respective country.-Enter Tax Number Type: RFC.-Enter the Tax Number.-When you save changes, the error message appears.-Cause-The account in question is maintained as a private account, and the RFC numbers that are being maintained have a length of 12 characters, which does not correspond. Either Tax Number or Type of Account need to be corrected.-Resolution-The RFC tax number is as follows:-For private accounts, the RFC numbers must have a length of 13 characters.-For corporate accounts, the RFC numbers must have a length of 12 characters.-Keywords-Business Partner Account, RFC, Tax Number.

Title: Accounting Principle Cannot be Removed From Valuation View
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the Valuation View in your Business Configuration has wrong Accounting Principle assigned to it, but you cannot remove it, because the following error messages appear when you try to delete it.-"No Valuation Views may be unassigned from Accounting Principle"-"Accounting principle already assigned to a set of books"-"At least one Fixed Asset using this Set of Books already exists"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter Business Configuration work center.-Access Overview view.-Search for Fixed Assets Valuation View activity.-Select the Valuation View.-Go to Assignment to Accounting Principle tab.-You see that the Accounting Principle maintained is wrong and try to change it, but the error messages appear.-Cause-You already have Fixed Assets for the Valuation Views. Hence, they cannot be deleted from Accounting Principle, not even from backend, as it would lead to inconsistencies in previous postings of the system.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior as the Accounting Principle has already been used for postings.-See Also-You can see further information on Help Document Configuration: Fixed Assets Valuation Views-Keywords- Accounting Principle, Valuation View.

Title: System Dump or Error When Entering Time Accounts
Content: Symptom-When you try to add time accounts when entering time data you receive a dump or get the below error:-An error occurred. Try resuming your work. If you still face issues, open an incidents.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Select the respective employee and open it-Click on Time Profile-Click on Time Account Rules-Note: When entering a time account type you get the dump/error.-Cause-You are trying to assign a time account, which has a Check Limit maintained as Fixed Limit. This is the reason the system throws a dump while adding the time account.-Resolution-Statistical Time Accounts should not have a Fixed Limit maintained. You need to remove the Check Limit and the Minimum Balance Limit and then add the time accounts.-See Also-Configuration: Maintain Time Account Types-Keywords-Dump while creating leave request, home work center, self - service overview, record time entries, system crash, fixed limits, mimimum balance,

Title: Depreciate Amount of Fixed Asset From Previous Fiscal Year Into Current Fiscal Year
Content: Symptom-You try to depreciate a Fixed Asset amount from the previous fiscal year into the current fiscal year but this is not possible in the system even when you change the Depreciation Start Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center.-Select the Fixed Assets View.-Show Capitalized Fixed Assets and Fixed Assets In Process and find XXX (where XXX represents the Fixed Assets in Process) and press Go.-Highlight the Fixed Asset XXX and press Edit - Values.-Switch to the tab Depreciation Overview.-You can see that the Depreciation Amounts start with, for example, April 2016. You expect that this amount must be posted in October 2017. But on march 2016 only a zero amount of depreciation is there which cannot be posted in 2017.-Cause-The reason why this depreciation has not been posted into the year 2017 is that you ran the Depreciation Run for period, for example, October 2017. In order to post the Depreciation you had to have carried out the depreciation run for 2016 (any period there). But since it is not possible to depreciate an amount from one fiscal year (2016) to another one (2017), this is designed system behavior and you have no possibility to post the amount from March 2016 to a 2017 period.-Resolution-This is desired system behavior. You can use a workaround which is not exactly a depreciation but a manual adjustment, as follows:-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center and Select the Fixed Assets View.-Select Fixed Asset in question XXX.-Press Manual Posting - Manual Depreciation.-Depreciation Type is 3 - Write-Down.-Relating to is 2 - Previous Years.-You can choose a valuation view.-Debit / Credit is set to Credit.-Leave the rest of the variables as they are.-This Manual Posting credits the Accumulated Depreciation Account and debits the Depreciation Expenses Account.-Keywords-Depreciation amount previous year current year; post Fixed Assets current year; manual depreciation write-down

Title: CRM Scenario: Service - Fixed Price Without Actuals in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Service - Fixed Price Without Actuals item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If you choose Service item type with fixed price without actuals, the Time Recording configuration won’t work during the document process.-1. Release Sales Order.-The status of sales order is now Open.-2. Complete Service Execution.-Since the item type is Service with fixed price without actuals, you can Complete Service Execution from Sales Order directly.-The status of Sales Order changed from Open to In Process. Delivery Status changed from Not Started to Finished.-3. Invoice the Sales Order Invoice Request.-This action will complete the Sales Order as well as the Service.-If you want to attach Service Confirmation to the Sales Order, you can Click “Confirm Service Execution” when Sales Order is at In Process Status.-This won’t affect the Delivery Status in Sales Order either on item level or on header level. If you want to complete the delivery, you still need to click Complete Service Execution.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Service - Fixed Price Without Actuals; SEFL; sales order

Title: CRM Scenario: Service - Time and Material in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Service - Time and Material item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Case 1: With Time Recording.-Enable the scope question in Business Configuration:-Edit Project Scope>Questions>Sales>Selling Products and Services>Sales Orders-1. Create and Release the Sales Order.-Status of Sales Order changed from In Preparation to Open.-2. Release to Service Execution.-Status of Sales Order changed from Open to In Process. Service Status changed to Released.-3. Click Confirm Service Execution from Sales Order.-Error message displayed: Copying referenced sales order item ID 3691-10 for service confirmation is not possible as it is enabled for time recording.-Since Time Recording for Sales Order has been activated, the assigned Service Performer need to accomplish time recording in his/her time for respective Sales Order.-4. Log in as delicate service performer via-Home Work Center>Self-Services Overview>Edit Time Sheet>Add Time Entry-Actions> Release-Back to respective Sales Order> Document Flow>A service confirmation has been automatically generated with status Finished.-5. Submit > Complete Service Execution-Delivery Status changed from In Process to Finished.-Invoice Status changed from Not Relevant to Not Started.-6. Invoice the Service Confirmation.-Back to respective Sales Order-All the status stays in Finished.-Case 2. Without Time Recording Enabled.-Edit Project Scope>Questions>Sales>Selling Products and Services>Sales Orders-Uncheck the question: Do you want to record time for sales orders?-1. Release the Sales Order.-2. Release to Service Execution-The Status of Sales Order changed from Open to In Process. Service Status is Released.-3. Confirm Service Execution> Release Service Confirmation With Order Completion-Back to respective Sales Order> Document Flow-Service Confirmation based Invoice Request has been generated.-Delivery Status changed to Finished.-If you release Service Confirmation Without Order Completion, you need to manually complete service in Sales Order.-If you release Service Confirmation With Order Completion, the Complete Service Execution button will be grey out.-4. Invoice Service Confirmation Invoice Request.-5. Back to respective Sales Order.-The status of Sales Order changed to Completed as well as on the item level.-Keywords-SECO; Service - Time and Material; Sales Order

Title: 'Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Costs>Exchange Rate Differences>Gain from Exchange Rate Differences.' Error Message in GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You are running the GR/IR Clearing Run and the error message is shown as:-'Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Costs>Exchange Rate Differences>Gain from Exchange Rate Differences.'-You have maintained G/L Account in Costs Subledger under Exchange Rate Differences even then the error message is shown.-XYZ means the Account Determination Group ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks View.-Go to the GR/IR Clearing Run subview.-Show All GR/IR Clearing Run and Find the respective Run ID.-Select the Run ID and Go to Details: Log files.-Choose Log Result as per the Set of Books Description.-Error message is shown as: Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Costs ->Exchange Rate Differences ->Gain from Exchange Rate Differences.-Cause-G/L Account should be maintained for Gain from Exchange Rate Differences for Account Determination Group XYZ under Inventories Subledger.-Resolution-You should maintain G/L Account for Gain from Exchange Rate Differences for Account Determination Group XYZ under Inventories Subledger by the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Go to Account Determination and then to Inventories.-Go to Differences tab.-Maintain G/L Accounts for Gain from Exchange Rate Differences and Loss from Exchange Rate Differences for Account Determination Group XYZ.-Once you have configured the above steps, execute the GR/IR Clearing Run again, as it should finished successfully.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing Run; account determination group; G/L acct missing for Costs; Exchange Rate; Inventories

Title: Unable to Maintain an Existing Holiday Calendar due to an Exception
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to update the Holiday Calendar for country XYZ (where XYZ represents a country). Upon saving the required changes to the Holiday Calendar, system throws an exception:-Initialization Failed-An unhandled exception occurred.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search the activity Working day calendar and select the button Change immediately-Select hyperlink Maintain an existing holiday calendar-Select the respective Holiday Calendar to be maintained-On the left section, select the row of the holiday to be changed-Select Edit-Select a holiday Type to define how the holiday should be calculated-Select the desired target date and select OK-Move the row changed to the right selection, to appear in the Selected Holidays list-Go to the next phase and confirm your changes-System throws an exception-Cause-When editing an existing holiday, you may have deleted or overwritten a holiday in the Holiday Calendar for the respective country.-Resolution-When editing an existing holiday, do not delete or overwrite a holiday, because it could already be used by other processes like for example the computation of holidays for employees.-In the fine-tuning activity Working Day Calendar, when you edit a holiday from the List of Holidays, you can select the Type of the holiday.-When the type Floating Holiday is selected, you should not overwrite an existing date, but add additional dates for subsequent years via the Add Row button.-When the type Fixed Day of Week is selected, for example, in case you want to define a holiday for the 4th Friday in December, then from the List of Holidays, select the holiday which you created for the 4th Friday in December. Edit it and select the type Fixed Day of Week and enter the holiday rule only once which will be valid for all years.-Keywords-Holiday Calendar, Maintain an existing holiday calendar, Floating Holiday, Fixed Day of Week

Title: Employees are Missing in Personnel Administration work center
Content: Symptom-CONSOLIDATED IN KBA #2058364-You have observed that some of the Employees are missing in Personnel Administration work center, even though the same Employees are available in Business Partner Data work center (Business Partner view)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Select Employees view-    or-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Business Partner view-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you have scoped HCM module into your system after adding those Employees in Business Partner Data work center.-Resolution-The actual system behavior is as follows,-If your system is not scoped for HCM module, the only way to add the Employees into your system is through Employees view of Business Partner Data work center. This type of system is called Lean HCM scoped system. These Employees will have just basic data and no work agreement related details.-When you scope HCM module, then the Personnel Administration work center will be enabled. But since the old employees have only basic employee data, those Employees will not be visible in the Personnel Administration work center. -To overcome this issue, you should add the HCM related data (work agreement, employment, etc.) for those Employees. This can be done as follows:-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to Implementation Projects view.-3. Click on the Implementation Project-3. Select tab Integrate and Extend.-4. Search for valid activity Migration of Employee Data - xx (xx stands for country)-5. Open this activity and you can use two functionalities for adding HCM data to an existing Employee:-a) Migrate Personnel Administration data using the migration tool (excel driven mass functionality) or-b) Manually create Personnel File using basic employee data (Screen driven for one Employee)-Once, you complete the migration of personnel administration data of those Employees will be visisble in the Personnel Administration work center. Then you can able to create Leave Request, Record Time and so on for those Employees.-  Frequently Asked Questions:-Is this standard functionality from SAP ByD?-Yes, because when you maintain an Employee in Business Partner Data work center, you are maintaining only the basic information of the Employee but when HCM is scoped Personnel Administration of those Employees are required to perform activities like leave request, Time recording, payroll data and so on.- Are you saying that basically because we didn't have Human Resources in scope for Phase I of the implementation, we are now faced with having to upload all the employee data again in Phase II?-If you scoped HCM in the phase 1, then the migration of Employees are of two steps:-1) Migration of Basic Employee and-2) Migration of personnel administration data.-Since, HCM is scoped in phase 2, you need to perform the second step directly since the basic data is already available. But, make use of personnel administration migration template to fulfill all data required for those employees.

To export it, click in the arrow on the More Functions button, then ALV Functions > Export Data;-----On the following pop-up, select Spreadsheet;-Click in the value help for the field File Name: change the file to XLS, name it, choose the folder where it should be downloaded and Save;-Finally, click Generate-Keywords-Product list report from backend

Title: CRM Scenario: Service - Time and Material (Project) in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Service - Time and Material (project) item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Prerequisite to do Project Based Service/Product:-Edit Project Scope>Questions> Sales>Sell Project-Based Products and Services>Check question “You can sell project-based services.” And “You use sales orders to sell projects.”-1. Release the Sales Order-If you’ve input the Project based service in the Sales Order and you want to release the Sales Order directly, error message “Order not released; No project task is assigned to item 10” will be displayed.-This is because a project based item has to have a project assigned to it.-2. Create Project.-Input the necessary information to create the project.-You will get information message “Project CPSO180 (3718) has been created. You can edit it as soon as you have saved the sales order.”-Now you can save and release the order. The Order Status changed to Open but in the drop down list, you find there is no option for you to release the Service item.-A project has been attached to the respective Sales Order with the Status In Planning.-Since this item type is Project Based, you need to accomplish the Service through the Project.-3. Release Project.-Back to the respective Sales Order’s Document Flow.-The Status of Project has been changed to Released while the status of Sales Order remains Open.-The Delivery Status on Item level remains Not Started.-4. Maintain the time recording for the project .-Login with Person Responsible of the Project(In this case, Sandra Moher), and record the time via Home> Self-Services Overview> Edit Time Sheet> Add Time Entry-In this case, I recorded 2 work days which is larger than the value in Sales Order.-Back to respective Sales Order-The status of Sales Order changed to In Process and Delivery Status changed from Not Started to In Process.-5. Generate Project invoice Request via Customer Invoicing WoC> Project Invoicing> Projects-6. Invoice the Project Invoice Request.-Since I’ve recorded 2 workdays in the time sheet, system counts this as 2 wdays and invoice the actual working time.-Back to respective Sales Order and found Invoice Status changed to In Process.-7. To make the invoice status to finished, you have to manually finish the invoicing in the project invoice> Sales Orders.-8. To make the order delivery status to finished, you have to complete the project.-Sales Order has completed.-In the Sales Order, the finished delivery value will always show the original value regardless the actual time recording.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-PBTM; service - time and material (project); sales order

Title: Is Introscope 9.7.1 installed on HP-UX for Solution Manager supported by SAP?
Content: Symptom-Is Introscope 9.7.1 installed on HP-UX for Solution Manager supported by SAP?-Environment-Solution Manager 7.1-Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Note - 2138309, SAP mention in the section Major Changes in Introscope 9.7 (Focus SAP Solution Manager):-"CA informed that they are discontinuing support for CA Introscope Enterprise Manager on Itanium and HP-UX platforms."-  Cause-In light of this, you would like to know if you can install the OS-independent installer for HP-Unix operating system and if SAP will support it in case of any issues?-Resolution-The statement in the SAP Note means CA does not deliver an EM installer with a bundled JVM for these platforms and does not test it there.-You can run a JAVA program on any platform as long the JVM fits.-So in this instance the ‘OS independent’ installer can be used.- For installing Introscope 9.7.1 on HP-UX we would recommend that you use the SAPJVM7- Keywords-Introscope EM-9.7.1-HP-UX-Solution Manager-OS Independent

Title: CRM Scenario: Expense - Time and Material in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Expense - Time and Material item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Pre-requisite to do Service item with Expense type in Sales Order.-Edit Project Scope>Questions> Sales> Sell Services> Check question:-Do you intend to invoice expenses based on receipts that result from sales or services, taking actual costs from the service confirmation?-You have Time Recording Enabled in your tenant: Edit Project Scope>Questions> Selling Products and Services> Sales Orders>-Question: Do you want to record time for sales orders?-1. Release Sales Order.-The Status of Sales Order changed to Open. (Quantity : 1 ea)-2. Release to Service Execution.-The Status of Sales Order changed to In Process.-3. You want to Confirm Service Execution directly from Sales Order-In this case, I entered the actual quantity as 2 and system will throw the warning message as” Item 10: Fulfilled quantity is greater than ordered quantity”.-4. Release Service Confirmation with Order Completion.-Back to the respective Sales Order. On item details, system recorded the actuals instead of initial value.-And the Delivery Status changed to Finished. Invoice Status changed from Not Relevant to Not Started.-5. Invoice Service Confirmation based on actuals.-The Status of Sales Order changed to Completed with completed status on item level as well.-Note: Different from SECO - Service - time and material,  Time Recording won’t affect the completion of Service Confirmation when item type is Expense - time and material.-See Also-KBA 2871686 - CRM Scenario: Expense - Fixed Price Without Actuals in Sales Order-KBA 2871738 - CRM scenario: Expense - Fixed Price (Project) in Sales Order-KBA 2873374 - CRM Scenario: Expense - Time and Material (Project) in Sales Order-Keywords-Expense - Time and Material; Sales Order; XACT

Title: Logon Certificate Override / Assignment
Content: Symptom-You want to override the logon certificate and/or assign the certificate to two users.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-There is no way to override the certificate logon once the certificate logon is selected. To sign in with a different user via regular log on kindly use the browser in incognito mode or another browser.-The same certificate can not be assigned to two users as the users need to be uniquely identified to gain access to the system. Having the same certificate can not determine the user uniquely.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.
