Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Troubleshooting guide – finding whether schedule rule is created-Purpose: When a ticket is created or updated, to find out whether a workflow schedule BO is created or not and what the activation time is.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Steps:-1) In the frontend of the system, get the ticket ID and go to the test shell (SESFTS) to find out the UUID of the ticket.-2) GO to /NSE11 to find out the schedule rule BO UUID.-  The table name is WKF_SCHEDULE_RULE_ROOT in SE11.-Click on Contents button (Ctrl+Shift+f10)-  Copy Node id and go to Test shell to find the exact workflow rule BO.-3) To to BO as WORKFLOW_SCHEDULE_BO and find the node id from previous SE11.-  You can find the activation date time.-  You can also find which workflow rule is activated.

Title: Segment and Profit Center Are Not Derived for Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-While creating a new Fixed Asset system throws an error that Segment and Profit Center do not belong to Cost Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the New Fixed Assets view.-Add Company.-Add Fixed Asset Class.-Select Assignment Type Cost Center.-Add Cost Center.-Add Valid From date.-Below errors occur:-Cost Center does not belong to segment on DD.MM.YYYY.-Cost Center does not belong to profit center on DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-Scoping Element Profit Center and Segment Accounting is not in Scope. Even if your Set of Book is using Reporting Principles that include Profit Center and Segment Reporting if the Element is not in Scope the system is not able to derive the information and the error occurs.-Resolution-To correctly scope the Scoping Element use below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation project.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Go to section 4 Questions.-Select Financial and Management Accounting.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting.-Select General Ledger.-Expand General Ledger.-Select General Ledger.-In Group Profit Center and Segment Accounting.-Mark checkbox In Scope for 'You can create financial reports based on segments and profit centers'.-Click Next.-Review and click Finish.-After this is scoped the error will no longer occur when creation Fixed Assets.-Keywords-Fixed Asset; Profit Center; Segment; Cost Center; Cost Center does not belong to segment; Cost Center does not belong to profit center-fixed asset,cost center,profit center,cost center does not belong to segment,segment,cost center does not belong to profit ce

Title: Contract Template Only Support Net Price
Content: Symptom-There is a customer contract ABC created from contract template, but you find the items in the contract template are not copied into the contract. Also, you find it is possible to manually enter these items into the contract ABC. Why these items are not copied from contract template into the contract ABC?-(ABC represents the ID of a customer contract and XYZ represents the ID and a contract template.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open one sales order and go to the Document Flow tab, contract ABC was created as follow-up document from the sales order.-Open Contract ABC, in Items tab, there is no item.-Go to the Document Flow tab, you can see the contract was created based on contract template XYZ. Open this template, there are items maintained. -You are wondering, why the items in the contract template XYZ are not copied into the contract ABC.-Cause-In the contract ABC, the price-in is Gross, this is determined based on the Default Gross Pricing settings in configuration activity:Configure Price Strategy.-While in the contract template, there is no Price-In indicator, it only supports Net. The items in the contract template are therefore using Net Pricing.-Hence, when the contract ABC created with Gross price-in, the items (using Net Pricing) are not copied. You are able to manually enter these items into the contact ABC and maintain gross price for them.-Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior.-See Also-KBA 2854031 - How Contract Works with Different Item Types-Keywords-contract template; customer contract; Price-In; Net; Gross

Title: Error: 'Valuation Cost Rates-Cost Unit': 'Hour(s)' is not a Valid Value; Edit Source Value"
Content: Symptom-While migrating Labor Resources in the Business Configuration work center, the following error message appears:-"'Valuation Cost Rates-Cost Unit': 'Hour(s)' is not a valid value; edit source value"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Overview-3. Search for Migration of Labor Resources-4. Upload the relevant migration file-5. Click Execute Migration Step by Step-6. Error: "Valuation Cost Rates-Cost Unit: 'Hour(s) is not a valid value; edit source value"-Cause-The reason for this error message is an incorrect value for the Cost Unit type, which is a text and should be a decimal number.-Resolution-According to the sheet Field List in the migration file, the Cost Unit type for Valuation Cost Rates should be a number (Length 10, Decimal 5). This value should be corrected.-Keywords-Cost Unit, Cost Rates, Migration of Labor Resources, Valuation Cost Rates-Cost Unit, valid value, edit source value-valuation cost rates-cost uni,valuation cost rates cost unit, 'hour(s)' is not a valid value,migration of labor resources

Title: In the Journal Entry from Service Confirmation, Posting Date Refers to the Fixed On Date in Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You want to know how system determines the Posting Date in the Journal Entry in case source document is Service Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Go to the Service Confirmation view.-Open Service Confirmation ABC and go to Services and Spare Parts - Time Reporting tab, the Start and End Date fields are both for example 2019-11-26. (ABC represents the ID of service confirmation)-Go to the Document Flow tab, click the Journal Entry icon in the service confirmation flow to open the corresponding Journal Entry. The Posting Date is a different date, for example 2019-12-04.-Cause-The Posting Date in Journal Entry refers to the Fixed On Date in the service confirmation.-In case the Fixed On date is not filled in service confirmation, the Fixed On date refers to the Creation On date which is 2019-12-04. Hence, in the following Journal Entry is 2019-12-04.-Resolution- This is the designed system behavior.-See Also-2661693 - Cancelling of Service Confirmation Not Possible Due to Error: Financial posting on fixed on date DD/MM/YYYY blocked-1523324 - Posting date in journal entry for service provision from CRM document-Keywords-Posting Date; Service Confirmation; Fixed On Date; Journal Entry

Title: Unable to Reverse Migration For a Capitalized Fixed Asset, Migration Journal Entry Vouchers involved
Content: Symptom-You want to reverse the migration for a capitalized fixed asset due to incorrect migration data, however, you face several error messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets subview.-Show All Fixed Assets and find capitalized Fixed Asset ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID).-View Fixed Asset XYZ and navigate to the Migration tab.-Click Reverse Migration.-You get several error messages such as:-An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ.-Asset XYZ val.view 1: Depreciation positive (or negative).-Journal Entry Voucher 123 cannot be reversed (123 represents the Journal Entry Voucher ID).-Save failed.-Cancellation accounting document missing.-Cause-Besides the common Migration, there are also manual Migration Journal Entry Vouchers posted to Fixed Asset XYZ.-These have to be reversed first before you can reverse the Migration.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entry Voucher subview.-Show All Journal Entry Vouchers and find Journal Entry Voucher 123.-Click Actions and then click Reverse.-Once you have reversed the manual posting for the Data Migration posted to the Fixed Asset XYZ, you can reverse the Migration.-Keywords-Anlagen, Migration stornieren, manueller Buchungsbeleg, manual posting, reverse

Title: Period Control Method of Depreciation Method L017
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the period control method of depreciation method L017 Str.-line from useful life,  SAP Delivered depreciation method for set of books Singapore GAAP and UAE GAAP.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Depreciation Methods activity.-Click Change Immediately or click on the Depreciation Methods activity to open the same.-Click Edit Depreciation Methods link.-Search for Depreciation Method L017 Str.-line from useful life.-There is no information on the period control method.-Resolution-For Depreciation Method L017 Str.-line from useful life, the Period Control Method is 009: 06/06/06/06 At year start (Major transactions at year start)-Refer to Help Document Period Control Methods and Keys-The period control function is used for each asset transaction to determine the (calculation) period from which the transaction is included in the calculation of automatic depreciation. Period control also defines the general start of depreciation at the time of the first asset acquisition.-Refer to Help Document Period Control-See Also-Using Depreciation Methods-Configuration: Other Fiscal Year (Fiscal Year Variant)-Keywords-Period control method and keys; depreciation method; fixed asset; fiscal year; Periodensteuerungsmethoden und Periodensteuerungsschlüssel; Abschreibung; Anlagen; Geschäftsjahrsvariante

Title: 'Posting scheme Purchase Order does not contain any data' Error Message for Unposted Purchase Order
Content: Symptom- Purchase Order AAA is unposted in General Ledger work center with error message: 'Posting scheme Purchase Order does not contain any data'-AAA means the Purchase Order ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Under Unposted Source Documents List, find Purchase Order AAA.-Notice the error message tied to it: Posting scheme Purchase Order does not contain any data.-Cause-The Posting Scheme data has been deleted in fine tuning activity Financial Forecast.-Resolution-The Posting Scheme data has to be reentered in the fine tuning activity, as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the row of respective implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open activity Financial Forecast.-Click Edit forecast posting schemes.-Notice that Posting Scheme XYZ is defined (XYZ means the Posting Scheme ID), however, there's no data under Posting Records section.-The required configuration (Posting Records Steps) should be maintained.-Save the changes.-As a result, Purchase Order AAA could be posted.-Remark: follow-up documents depending on posting of Purchase Order AAA (for example, a Warehouse Confirmation) will also fail to post to accounting due to the original issue.-For example, a Warehouse Confirmation will be unposted with error message:-Referenced Purchase Order AAA not found-Keywords-posting scheme; po; purchase order; forecast posting schemes; financial forecast; warehouse confirmation; wc

Title: CRM scenario: Expense - Fixed Price (Project) in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Expense - Fixed Price (Project) item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Prerequisite to do Project Based Service/Product:-Edit Project Scope>Questions> Sales>Sell Project-Based Products and Services>Check question “You can sell project-based services.” And “You use sales orders to sell projects.”-1. Release the Sales Order-If you input the project based service in the Sales Order and you want to release the Sales Order directly, error message “Order not released; No project task is assigned to item 10” will be displayed.-This is because a project based item has to have a project assigned to it.-2. Create Project-Input necessary information to create a project related to Sales Order.-After creating the Project, you can release Sales Order without any errors.-The Status of Sales Order changed to open while other status on item level remains Not Started. With Project Status as “In Planning”.-3. Released related project-Back to the respective Sales Order.-Releasing assigned project won’t affect Salas Order’s header status as well as on item level.-Note : Since this item type is Expense - fixed price (project), Neither Service Confirmation no time recording is needed via the project.-Expense related item is not available in Time Recording.-4. Completed Related Project.-5. Generate Project invoice Request via Customer Invoicing WoC> Project Invoicing> Projects-6. Release Project Invoice Request and Invoice the Invoice Request.-7. Back to the respective Sales Order.-The Status of Sales Order changed to In Process.-The Delivery Status changed to Finished after completing the project.-The Invoice Status changed to In Process.-8. To make the invoice status to finished, you have to manually finish the invoicing in the project invoice> Sales Orders> Change Status> Finish Invoicing.-Back to the respective Sales Order.-The Status of Sales Order changed to Completed as well as on item level.-See Also-KBA 2124548 - Create Project Button Is Disabled-KBA 2580384 - Products With Item Group Expense-Fixed Price Without Actuals not Supported

Title: Dunning process and Direct Debit
Content: Symptom-The dunning process does not include open items for which the payment method is direct debit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisites:-- Customers supposed to be dunned are paying by direct debit.-- A use case can be that payments are generated for some customers who are paying by direct debit. Some payments are not completed due to insufficient funds on your customers' accounts, hence related invoices are no longer cleared and appear as open items on the customers' account monitor.-Go to the Receivables work centre.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view then Dunning Runs subview.-Create a new dunning run, activate it and schedule it to be performed immediately.-Refresh Dunning Runs view. Select your dunning run executed, go to Execution Details zone and open the dunning run Logs.-In the logs no dunning document is found for open items which are supposed to be paid by direct debit.-Cause-By default the dunning run does not look through open items which are planned to be paid by direct debit.-Resolution-When you create the dunning run the Include Direct Debit Indicator has to be checked.-Keywords-dunning; direct debit; downpayment request; Anzahlungsanforderung; Mahnung

Title: CRM Scenario: Expense - Fixed Price Without Actuals in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how Expense - Fixed Price without Actuals item type works in sales order.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Pre-requisite to do Service item with Expense type in Sales Order.-Edit Project Scope>Questions> Sales> Sell Services> Check question:-Do you intend to invoice expenses based on receipts, that result from selling services, directly from the sales order using a fixed price?-1. Release Sales Order-The Status of Sales Order changed to Open.-2. Release to Service Execution-The Status of Sales Order changed to In Process.-Service Status changed to Released.-3. Complete Service Execution-The Delivery Status changed to Finished.-Due to the item type-- Expense - fixed price without actuals, you can skip the Service Confirmation step since system won’t consider actuals into Sales Order and invoice value will be fetched directly from Sales Order.-4. Invoice Sales Order Invoice Request-Back to the respective Sales Order, you can see Sales Order in Completed Status as well as on Item level.-Note:-Due to the item type-- Expense - fixed price without actuals, you can skip the Service Confirmation step since system won’t consider actuals into Sales Order and invoice value will be fetched directly from Sales Order. While the Confirm Service Execution tab is still available under the Submit dropdown list. You can attach Service Confirmation to Sales Order per business needs.-When creating service confirmation, no item details will be passed from sales order, you are able to manually add items and miantain price. This service confirmation will be visible in the document flow of the sales order.  Service Confirmation Invoice Request will be created after release it, and you are able to create invoice based on it. But service confirmation does not affect the delivery and invoice status of the sales order, becuase there is no reference on item level between service confimration and sales order.-As summary, the Expense - Fxied Price without Actuals item is delivery finished by manually click Complete Service Execution and invoice finished by invoicing the Sales Order Inovice Request.-See Also-KBA 2580384 - Products With Item Group Expense-Fixed Price Without Actuals not Supported-KBA 2871738 - CRM scenario: Expense - Fixed Price (Project) in Sales Order-Keywords-Sales Order; Expense; Expense - Fixed Price without Actuals; XFIX

Title: How to Determine Ship-From on Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-You want to be able to determine the Ship-From Party on Item level for a Sales Quote.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Under Common Task, select the New Sales Quote option.-Enter the relevant account and organizational information.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Enter the Product ABC (ABC represents your Product ID).-The Ship-From information is not shown in the Details tab.-Cause-The Ship-From information is not displayed because it is not Scoped in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project and click on the Edit Project Scope.-Click Next until you reach Step 4 - Questions.-Expand the Sales section.-Under Sales section, expand the New Business section.-Click on the Quotes option.-In the question section, activate the question: Do you want to receive product availability information during sales quote processing?.-Save.-After activating the scoping question the Ship-From Party is displayed in the Sales Quote and you are able to determine the availablity via the Check Availability button for the item.-Keywords-Ship-From; Sales Quote;

Title: Error Message When Uploading Bank Statement "No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XXX, national bank code YYY, and currency ZZZ found"
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload an electronic bank statement you receive the following error message 'No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XXX, national bank code YYY, and currency ZZZ found' even though all of them are active in the system, (where XXX represents the account number, YYY represents the national bank code and ZZZ represents the respective currency).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the WorkCenter Liquidity Management.-Subview Bank Statements.-Click the New button and then select the option Bank Statement Upload.-Maintain all your data.-Click the Start File Upload button.-Error message: No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XXX, national bank code YYY, and currency ZZZ found.-Cause-You have maintained two different Bank IDs for one Bank. The first is in status Obsolete while the other Bank ID is in status Active.-The system cannot differentiate which Bank ID is the correct one - hence it picks the Bank ID which was maintained first in the system. The same data such as Account Number, Description is the same in both Banks.-Resolution-To solve this issue you can either set the status from Obsolete to Active or maintain the data in a new Bank entry and update it accordingly:-Go to the WorkCenter Liquidity Management, Subview Master Data - My Banks.-Select the respective bank.-Click View All and navigate to the General tab.-Find the Bank ID XYZ - Bank Name (where XYZ represents the first Bank name).-Double click to open it.-You will see that the Bank Directory Entry for XYZ is in status Obsolete.-Click on the selection icon in the Bank ID field.-Search for the bank entry with the exact same name.-Select the bank ID ABC- Bank Name. (ABC represents the second bank name). -Double click on the Bank ID.-You will see that the Status is Active.-Account details are the same in both Bank entries.- Keywords-bank statement, Kontoauszug, bank directory, Bankverzeichnis, no bank account active, kein Bankkonto aktiv-bank statement upload,currency error,no active bank account

Title: How To Download Account Determination Settings to an XML File
Content: Symptom-You want to download your account determination overview (assignment of Chart of Accounts, Account Determination Profile, Account Determination Groups and G/L Accounts) to an XML file but don't know how to do it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can download your account determination settings following the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Under Account Determination section, click to open any subledger (for example: General Ledger).-Select one Account Determination Profile.-Click Download Account Determination Overview button.-As a result you will download an XML file containing your account determination settings for the concerned Account Determination Profile.-Keywords-account determination; account determination groups; subledgers

Title: Error While Creating Expense Report: 'Regular payment settings for employee not found'.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an Expense Report and receive an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Expense Report on Behalf.-Enter the relevant Employee ID.-Here system raises the error message 'Regular payment settings for employee ID ABC not found. Create regular payment settings in the Home work center -> Self-Services -> Compensation -> Edit Payment Information or contact your personnel administrator'.-ABC - Employee ID.-Cause-The error message is being raised because the Employee has no Main Bank Account maintained.-Resolution-You have to maintain a Main Bank Account for the respective Employee using the steps below:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Select the relevant employee.-Click Edit.-Go to the Personal Data tab -> Payment Information.-Here you need to mark the Main Bank Account checkbox.-Keywords-Expense Report. Employee. Main Bank Account.

Title: 'Action only possible for whole file XXX; select all payments in this file' Error Changing an Outgoing Bank Transfer to Not Transferred
Content: Symptom-You've created an outgoing payment file which contains several payments (for example, Outgoing Bank Transfers). Afterwards you realized that one of the payments is not correct and should be canceled, but while trying to change this payment's status from In Transfer to Ready For Transfer you receive the error message: 'Action only possible for whole file XXX; select all payments in this file'-XXX represents the Outbound File ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search for the respective Outgoing Bank Transfer you want to change the status.-Select it and click Actions for Bank Transactions > Set to Not Transferred.-Error message is thrown: 'Action only possible for whole file XXX; select all payments in this file'.-Cause-The error message is valid in this case. Since the outgoing payment file is In Release status all the payments contained in the file are In Transfer, and hence they should be Set to Not Transferred all together.-It is not possible to set only one payment to not transferred.-Resolution-There are two options to change the status of all payments from In Transfer to Ready For Transfer (which will allow you to reverse/cancel the single payment you wanted to afterwards).-A) Select all payments in the Payment Monitor and click Set to Not Transferred:-Go to the Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search for the respective Outbound File ID (use Advanced search)-Select all payments tied to the respective Outbound File ID and click Actions for Bank Transactions > Set to Not Transferred.-B) Discard the Outgoing File:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management > Outbound Files view-Search and select the respective Outbound File ID.-Click the gear icon (top of the screen, right-hand side) > Discard-The results of A and B are the same: the status of the payments (for example, Outgoing Bank Transfers) changes from In Transfer to Ready For Transfer and the status of the Outbound File changes from In Release to Release Discarded.-With a Ready For Transfer status you can now reverse/cancel the single payment you wanted initially.-Keywords-outbound file; outgoing file; payment file; not transferred; ready for transfer; discard; discarded

Title: Costs of Sales Not Realized According to Expense Posting Date
Content: Symptom-You create a Customer Sales Project XYZ from Sales Order ABC (XYZ represents the project ID and ABC the Sales Order from which the project is created). -You create an expense, such as an internal/external service confirmation, an expense report or a Supplier Invoice for customer sales project XYZ.-In Project Management you ensure that all expenses of project XYZ are assigned to Sales Order  item ABC-AA (ABC-AA represents an item of  Sales Order ABC).-You expect that the incurred expenses are realized in accounting period AAA.YYYY (AAA.YYYY represents an accounting period).-However, the Costs of Goods sold are not realized in period AAA.YYYY but in period BBB.YYYY (BBB.YYYY represents an accounting period after period AAA.YYYY). And the Revenue Recognition run reports the warning "Costs without assignment to a sales order exists for project ABC."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Reports - List view.-Open the Sales Documents - Line Items report and select the Sales Documents - Line Items view.-Filter for project ABC and press Go.-To easily view the business transactions belonging to the respective expenses move the two characteristics Associated Source Document Type and Associated Source Document ID to the top row.-Now you can see that the expenses are posted in period AAA.YYYY whereas the Expense Assignments to Sales Documents, the so called Customer Project Expense Lists (CPELs) are posted in period BBB.YYYY.-Cause-The Posting Date of  Sales Order Item ABC-AA is maintained in period BBB.YYYY.-For the creation of the Customer Project Expense List (CPEL), meaning the Expense Assignment to Sales Document, the system uses the latest posting date of all involved transactions:-If the posting date of a sales order item is later (in period BBB.YYYY) than the posting date of a Sales Project Expense (in AAA.YYYY) then the posting date of the sales order item is derived as posting date of the Expense Assignment: As a result,  the expense stays deferred in period AAA.YYYY and only gets realized in period BBB.YYYY. * Note: The proposed posting date of the CPEL source document will, however, be the earlier posting date of the expense in period AAA.YYYY.-And vice versa: If the posting date of the expense is after the posting date of the sales order item then the posting date of the expense is used (as this posting date is the latest posting date of all involved transactions). -Resolution-Only if you have created Sales Order ABC before Project XYZ and only if the CPEL was not reposted before and its Proposed Posting Date is still in period AAA.YYYY, it is possible to repost the expense assignment in period AAA.YYYY:-First you need to identify the CPELs that are to be reposted:-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Reports - List view.-Open the Sales Documents - Line Items report and select the Sales Documents - Line Items view.-Filter for project ABC and press Go.-Add the following characteristics to the Rows: Proposed Posting Date, Source Document Type, Source Document ID.-Filter for Proposed Posting Date in period AAA.YYYY.-In the Posting Date field filter for period BBB.YYYY.-Filter for Customer Project Expense List in the Source Document Type field.-Now you see the CPELs that have been posted in period BBB.YYYY which should have been posted in period AAA.YYYY.-Once you have identified all the CPELs that need to be reposted-Navigate to the General Ledger workcenter and here to Closing Cockpit - Source Documents view.-In the Show field select All Source Documents.-Open the Advanced Search.-In the Processing Status field select Finished.-In the Related Source Document Type field select 555- Customer Expense List.-To simplify the search even more you could filter for the Proposed Posting Date or period AAA.YYYY via the More Options function in the Proposed Posting Date field.-Press Go.-Select the first CPEL.-Press Actions - View Business Transaction.-In the new screen press Reverse and Repost to Another Period.-In the little pop-up window the Alternate Posting Date field automatically displays the proposed posting date in period AAA.YYYY.-Press OK.-This will create a cancelation posting of the CPEL in period BBB.YYYY and a new posting in period AAA.YYYY.-Now the expense as well as the expense assignment, the CPEL are posted in the same period AAA.YYYY.-*As mentioned, this approach, however, is not possible, if you have created the Sales order item after the expense was created or if the Proposed Posting Date of the CPEL already appears in period BBB.YYYY.-If the Proposed Posting date is set in period BBB.YYYY you either need to-Correct the posting date of the respective Sales order item.-Cancel the expense.-Recreate the expence.-Only then a new CPEL is being generated with the correct posting date in period AAA.YYYY.-Or, if you are not able to re-create the expense, then the only way to correct the postings, is by creating two journal entry vouchers of type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents with screen variant 633 - Man. Adjusting Entry for Sales Documents to manually-remove the costs in period BBB.YYYY and-to realize them in period AAA.YYYY.-Keywords-CPEL, Customer Project with Sales Integration, Revenue Recognition, Posting Date, Proposed Posting Sate, Sales Order Item, Supplier Invoice, Costs without assignment to a sales order exists

Title: Cannot Delete the Account Determination Group for Employees
Content: Symptom-You are not able to delete the Account Determination Group for Employees in Business Configuration as the Delete tab is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Projects and perform the action Open Activity List.-Select the Fine tuning activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit Account Determination Groups.-Under Accounts Payables select Groups for Suppliers.-Select the Group ID: 4050 for Employees and Delete tab is greyed out.-Resolution-The Account Determination Group for Employees cannot be deleted as it is a pre-delivered content and employees should always be available for any project.-Hence, SAP has delivered as non-deletable row.-Keywords-4050; Employees; Groups for Suppliers; Delete; greyed; grayed

Title: Tax Payment is Inconsistent
Content: Symptom-You cannot post tax payment with payment allocation ABC (ABC is the payment allocation ID) due to the following error messages:-"Tax Payment is inconsistent.-Release of tax payment failed.-Profit center DEF (DEF is the profit center ID) determined for Bank Statement XXX (XXX is the bank statement ID) is not valid on DD.MM.YYYY.-Check the validity of profit center DEF in Organizational Management and your default profit centers in configuration. "-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Search for Payment Allocation ABC and select it.-Click the Payment Allocation ID ABC to open the same and then View All.-Click Post.-The error messages are:-"Tax Payment is inconsistent.-Release of tax payment failed.-Profit center DEF (DEF is the profit center ID) determined for Bank Statement XXX (XXX is the bank statement ID) is not valid on DD.MM.YYYY.-Check the validity of profit center DEF in Organizational Management and your default profit centers in configuration. "-The allocated Payment Amount is NNN.NN Currency (NNN.NN is the amount).-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments view.-Search and select Tax Payment HIJ (HIJ is the tax payment ID) with Payment amount NNN.NN Currency.-The status is Release Discarded.-Click View.-The related Tax Returns ID is KLM (KLM is tax return ID).-Click the ID to open the VAT Return ID KLM.-Click View All.-Check the From and To dates. -Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Organizational Structures view.-Set the Date for today.-Search for Org Unit DEF.-The Unit cannot be found.-Set the Date as a date on or between the From and TO date of the VAT Return ID KLM.-Search for Org Unit DEF.-Click Locate.-Check Validity of the Org Unit.-The validity of the Org Unit ended before the date DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-The Org Unit is not active anymore.-You have to make sure that all payments/ activities are settled for an Org Unit before deactivating it.-Resolution-To make the payment, you need to extend the validity of the Org Unit so that the posting can go through.-See Also-1849029- How to Extend the Validity of an Org Unit to a Past date?-Keywords-Tax Payment; inconsistent; Organisationseinheit; Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung; Steuerzahlung

Title: Sale of Fixed Asset With Depreciation Method L017
Content: Symptom-You performed the sale of a fixed asset. You see that the Gain on Fixed Asset Sales is more than expected.-You are using the depreciation method L017 - Str.-line from useful life.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search for Asset ABC (ABC is the fixed asset ID) and select it.-The status is Retired.-Click Edit General.-Capitalization Date: DD/MM/YYYY.-Deactivation Date: DD/MM/YYYY+N (YYYY+N is N years after the capitalization year YYYY).-Depreciation Start Date: DD/MM/YYYY.-Depreciation Method: L017 - Str.-line from useful life.-Navigate to the Master Data tab and then to the Life Cycle Data subtab.-The Deactivation Date and the Last Retirement Date has been set as DD/MM/YYYY+N.-Navigate to the Values tab.-Select any set of book.-Navigate to  the Book Values subtab.-Please note that the values provided below are as an example:-Value type Opening balance  Posted To be posted Closing Balance-Acquisition Cost 12,150.00  -12,150.00 0.00 0.00 -Depreciation Calculated Automatically  -3,037.50 -1,518.75 1,518.75 -3,037.50-Depreciation Posted Manually -7,087.50 10,125.00   0.00- 3,037.50-  2,025.00 -3,543.75 1,518.75- 0.00-There is an open amount of 1,518.75 , which is yet to be posted and comes from Depreciation Calculated Automatically.-There is a balance of 2,025.00.-Go to the Depreciation Overview subtab.-In Fiscal Year YYYY+N, for the accounting period 0MM (0MM is the accounting period), the depreciation is being shown as 1,518.75.-The status is a yellow triangle, meaning depreciation posting has not gone through correctly.-Go to the Journal subtab.-Depreciation postings have been made from period 001/ YYYY+N (001 is the first accounting period of the year YYYY+N) to period 0MM.-Source Document DEF (DEF is the source document ID) with Journal entry HIJ (HIJ is the journal entry ID) is the customer invoice of sale.-Click the Journal entry ID to open the same.-This journal entry does not consider the accumulated Depreciation for fiscal year YYYY+N and the Gain on Fixed Asset Sales is posted as 2,025.00.-  You expect the following result:-Debit posting: AR-Trade Foreign 7,000.00-Credit posting: Tools and Equipments 12,150.00-Debit posting: Gain on FA sales 7,000.00-Credit posting: Gain on FA sales 506.25-Debit posting: Accumulated Depreciation - Tools and Equipments 11,643.75-  You see the following for Fiscal Year YYYY +N:-Book value Opening Balance is 2,025.00-This is derived from the year YYYY+N-1 (Closing Balance is 2,025.00).-12,150.00 - (3,037.50+7,087.50) = 2,025.00.-  Now for Fiscal year YYYY+N, you have posted depreciation for example 6 periods = 253.13*6 = 1,518.78-The gain you expect is 2,025.00 - 1,518.78 = 506.22.-  During the sale of fixed asset with customer invoice DEF, the accumulated depreciation for the fiscal year YYYY+N got reversed/ ignored.-  Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select Depreciation Methods activity.-Click on the same to open it.-Click the Edit Depreciation Methods link.-Search and select Depreciation Method L017 Str.-line from useful life.-Under Calculation Parameters, nothing special has been maintained.-Cause-You have maintained depreciation method L017 - Str.-line from useful life.-The process control method for this depreciation method is 009: 06/06/06/06 At year start (Major transactions at year start).-According to the Period Control Method 009: 06/06/06/06, the depreciation is always posted at the start of the year.-During the sale of the fixed asset with customer invoice the depreciation calculated at the start of the year is considered the rest is sort of ignored or reversed.-Resolution-In order to solve this issue you have to perform the following steps:-Reverse the customer invoice DEF and hence reactivate the Asset.-Create a new depreciation method with the correct period control key. Please refer to Help Documents:-Configuration: Depreciation Methods  -Using Depreciation Methods -Period Control -Period Control Methods and Keys-Configuration: Other Fiscal Year (Fiscal Year Variant) -In your reactivated Fixed asset, change the depreciation method to the new depreciation method.-Create a depreciation run (first in test mode and check the results).-Post the sales/ customer invoice.-Keywords-Period control method and keys; depreciation method; fixed asset; fiscal year; Periodensteuerungsmethoden und Periodensteuerungsschlüssel; Abschreibung; Anlagen; Geschäftsjahresvariante

Title: VAT Return Great Britain - Tax Event 200 has no Impact on Total Amount Reported in Tax Box 7
Content: Symptom-You create Supplier Invoice Items with Tax Code 13 [Imported Goods (Supplier Invoices)]. This Tax Code is mapped to Tax Event 200  [Imported Goods (Supplier Invoices)]. All tax amounts associated with this tax event are being routed to tax box 7 of the GB VAT Return. You create the VAT Return for Great Britain (GB) and notice that the amounts associated with tax event 200 appear in the Details tab of Tax Box 7. However, this figure does not impact the overall, total amount reported in Tax Box 7 in the Tax Return tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-Condition: You created Supplier Invoice Items with Tax Code 13 (Import of Goods),  mapped to Tax Event 200.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-In the Periodic Tasks view navigate to the VAT Return runs subview.-Press New and select Tax Return Run.-Fill all the mandatory fields and then schedule the run to either start immediately or at a certain time.-When the run has finished and the application log displays a Tax Return ID either click on this ID.-Or navigate to the Tax Returns - VAT Returns view.-Click on the ID of the respective VAT return. In the new screen press View All.-Navigate to the Tax Return tab.-Select the line of Tax Box 7 and take note of the Amount displayed here.-Press on the Details button.-You notice that the Base Amounts associated with Tax Event 200 do not impact the Amount displayed for Tax Box 7. You can verify this by calculating the base amounts of all displayed documents together and deduct the base amounts associated with tax event 200. The difference is the amount displayed in the Amount field of the Tax Return tab.-Cause-Tax Event 200 is not reported to Tax Box 7 as the event is a non-tax event. This means, the amount will not impact the figure in Tax Box 7. However, records/transactions with tax event 200/tax code 13 will still appear in the Details section of Tax Box 7 in the Tax Return tab.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior, amounts related to tax event 200 are not added to the total amount displayed in the Amount field of Tax Box 7.-Keywords-VAT return Great Britain, Tax Box 7, Tax Event 200, Difference Amount

Title: Error Message : Company ABC: Already Assigned To A Different Set Of Books
Content: Symptom-You want to assign a new Set of Book to the Company ABC (ABC is the Company ID).-You get the error message: "Company ABC: Already assigned to a different Set of Book."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click the Implementation Projects view.-Click the Open Activity list button.-Go to the Integrate and Extend tab-Search for the Set of Books Activity.-Select the Set of books or create new Set of Books.-Go to Company Settings tab.-Click Add.-Select the company ID ABC.-You get the error message: "Company ABC: Already assigned to a different Set of Books."-Cause-You can add new sets of books to a company if there are no journal entries in the existing set of books of this company.-The reason is to prevent inconsistencies in the further document processing.-A company can have multiple Set of Books assigned to it, but this activity needs to be performed before doing any postings in the system.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-Once postings are made in the system, you are not allowed to assign a new Set of Book to the company.-Keywords-Rechnungslegungswerk; Sachkontenzuordnung; set of books; assign new set of books to company

Title: How to check if the customer user has authorizations to assign BTM task
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-A business user is unable to assign the BTM task to themselves (Business User).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work Center Application and User management.-Select the Work Center view Task Distribution.-Select the sub view Business Task management.-Select the Unassigned items from Drop down menu.-Select a new task and click on button Assign item.-The Business user is not available in the value help to assign the Item.-Cause-The method CL_AP_FO_TASK_AUTH_CHECK=>GET_INSTANCE_AUTH_USERS is not returning the user who is logged in as authorized user.--When value help of "assign item" is selected the below given method "IF_ESF_PROVIDER_VALUE_SET~RETRIEVE_ACTION_VALUE_SET" is called which in turn calls the GET_INSTANCE_AUTH_USERS.-The method GET_INSTANCE_AUTH_USERS does not return the business user hence the task cannot be assigned to it.-Resolution-Please follow below mentioned steps to find out that user has the sufficient authorizations to assign the task :-1. Find the BTM Task ID and Type in the backend :-a).Go to transaction sbtm_task_sel-b).Find the task ID for relevant task.-c).Also copy the Task Type as a reference for the action on the next step.-2. Finding the Task relevant WOC view for user :-a).Go to transaction sbtm_ttd-b).Enter the task type from 1st step and click on Display.-c).Task Type Design window opens --d).Click on Display UI Association from menu bar (Shift +F12)-Task list views window opens which describes the necessary workcenter view required to assign this task. Copy this workcenter for next step.-3. Check the Necessary RBAM authorizations for assigned workcenter view   -a).Now go to transaction srbam-b).Select the "Standard Application -> RBAM User Role Assignments and Restrictions Display hyperlink.-c).In the  RBAM User Role Assignments and Restrictions Display window enter the user who is affected and execute it.-d).Open the workcenter found in step 2 by double click on that workcenter.-e).Click CTRL+F to find the task type and enter the "task type" from step 1-f).In the hits found open any rule by double click on it--In the column Condition position check for type GRANT and respective source OPER and Source name ID is available as Query, Retrieve and Execute In column Prefix of Literal Like-target.--It defines that the user has necessary authorizations to assign the task.-Action to Follow :-If the user does not have this authorizations than assign this authorizations to the user.-OR if the affected user have the necessary authorizations than forward the incident to component SRD-CC-BTM for analysis

Title: Account Determination is Missing for Position Type Exchange Rate Differences
Content: Symptom-While posting Customer Invoice, you get the error "Account determination is missing for position type Exchange Rate Differences."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Documents.-Select the customer invoice ABC (ABC is the customer invoice ID).-Click Edit.-Click Post.-You get the error message: "Account determination is missing for position type Exchange Rate Differences."-Cause-Account determination is missing in the corresponding item of your customer invoice.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Go to the Sub-ledger Tax.-Go to the Differences tab.-Here maintain account for account determination group for Exchange Rate Differences.-To determine the account determination group, check the items in your invoice and find the account determination group corresponding to them.-Keywords-Kontenfindung; account determination; exchange rate differences; Wechselkurs; Differenzen-account determination,kontenfindung,wechselkurs,differenzen,exchange rate differences

Title: Error Message: "Total Duration of All Recorded Times Exceeds 24 hrs on DD.MM.YYYY"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign the time model for the employee or you are trying to release the timesheet after adding additional hours and you receive the error message below:-Total duration of all recorded times exceeds 24 hrs on DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter-Go to Employees view-Select All Employees-Search for the employee-Click on Edit-Go to Time Profile tab-Go to Work Schedule tab and maintain the Work Schedule: Predefined-Select Time Model from the value help-System throws error- Or-Go to the Home work center-Select the Self-Services Overview view-Select the Edit Time Sheet link-Update the times and click on the Release button-System shows error-Cause-The error message is displayed because you have recorded more then 24 hours for the day in the timesheet. It is possible that some time recorded on that particular day is inactive.-Resolution-You need to ensure that the time recorded for the day does not exceed 24 hours. You may follow the below mentioned steps to remove the times which are inactive.-Go to Time Administration work center-Click on Employees view-Select All Employees-Search for the employee-Click on Edit-Go to Employee Times tab-Search for time entries-Select the inactive times-Click on Remove-Now you will be able to release the time recordings for the employee.-After following the above steps, if you are still not able to assign the time model for the employee, then end the validity of the existing time profile  to DD.MM.YYYYby following the steps below:-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Click on Edit-Go to Time Profile tab-Click on Add Row -Maintain a new Start Date: DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and End Date: Unlimited-Change the End Date of the existing Time Profile to DD.MM.YYYY-Click on Save-Now you will be able to assign the time model to the employee for the time profile with Start Date:  DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and End Date: Unlimited.-Note:-Even though the time recording you entered is less than 24 hours, if a time recording is spanning across two days, then total duration will be considered under the first day. For example, you record time from 2 am to 11 pm. You would like to add 6 more hours. 1 hours for the first day and 5 hours for the next day. If you do it in a single time entry, the system will calculate 6 hours to the 1st day and an error will occur that it is not allowed, because it is over 24 hours. You can only record 3 more hours for the first day, but not 6 hours. If you would like to record 6 hours, then you need to split it into a time entry for the first day and into a time entry for the next day.-Keywords-Total Duration, Total Duration of All Recorded Times Exceeds, Gesamtdauer aller erfassten Zeiten überschreitet 24 Stunden, Buchen von Mitarbeiterzeiten, erfassten Stunden entsprechen insgesamt nur 23 Stunden, keine Überschreitung der 24h,

Title: Production System Request Scenarios
Content: Symptom-You would like to request a new Production system, but you are unsure of your options.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center.-Select the Systems view.-Select Request Creation.-You have different options for tenant request scenario.-Resolution-For production system requests, only the below scenarios are available. This is because production systems cannot be requested with full master data copy.-1. Initial Production Tenant / Empty Production System-Data Source: Initial System        -This is relevant for initial implementation. This can be used after go-live but no merge back capability.-In this case, no solution profile nor data are copied from Source system (Test system) to the Target system (Production system).-Business Configuration settings: No.-Level 0 data: No.-Flexibility data: No.-Transactional data: No.-PDI Solutions created in the test tenant must be uploaded again in the Production Tenant.-  2. Production Tenant with Solution Profile Copy from Test Tenant-Data Source: Initial System (Copy Solution Profile)-In this case, data is copied from the Source system (Test Tenant) to the Target system (Production Tenant). No merge back capability.-Business Configuration settings: Yes.-Level 0 data: Yes.-Flexibility data: Yes.-Transactional data: No .-PDI solutions created in the Test Tenant must be uploaded again in the Production Tenant and scoped in Business Configuration. They are not copied automatically.-  When a solution profile is copied to a new production tenant, the following additional activities automatically occur:-Extension fields and screen layout adaptations made via key user tools are copied as long as there are no extension fields and/or screen layout adaptations already made in the new production tenant-Form adaptations are copied-In Business ByDesign tenant, the Level 0 data, master data is copied to a staging area where the user can choose to import the pre-populated data migration templates or ignore them.  -In Cloud for Customer tenant, the data are not copied to a staging area, but are directly imported to the target (production) tenant.-See Also-2136036-Keywords-production, tenant, new, request, source, target

Title: How to Perform a FSI Reload for e.g. Organisational Assignment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Example: A Manager is missing in the Employee view in Personnel Administration work center, although he is correctly assigned to the Employee and all relevant settings exist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-For an Employee the Manager column is not filled.-Cause-This system behavior may be caused by changes (for example in relation to a new hire) that did not reach the system (e.g. Organisational Assignment) correctly.-Resolution-Reassure that all settings are correct. If you can exclude other reasons for the system behavior, an FSI reload may solve the issue.l-Request a L6 support user and log on to Backend-Enter transaction GFSSTM-In the Fast Search View field enter A1S_PAD_SV_EMPLOYEE_OWL (for the given example)-Select Start-In the next screen, expand A1S_PAD_SV_EMPLOYEE_OWL (for the given example)-Mark the ORGANISATIONAL_ASSIGNMENT node (for the given example)-Press Persistence > Yes-After a minute or more press Refresh to check if the reload is complete, as visible in the End Date and Finish Time column.-Please be careful. The reload is time consuming, especially when a high amount of data is involved. In any case, check the issue with an experienced colleague before performing the steps. In case a high volume of data is involved: Ensure, that the node is not in use by the customer during the reload, e.g. by performing it outside the customers working hours.-Good to know: The steps are transferable to the reload of other nodes.-Keywords-FSI Reload; organisational management

Title: Error Message When Terminating Employee: Start Date Of Agreement Cannot Be Before Work Agreement Start Date
Content: Symptom-You attempt to terminate an employee. But system shows the error message: Start Date of Agreement Cannot be Before Work Agreement Start Date.-You already checked the employee’s work agreement date. It matched with the termination date accordingly.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go Personnel Administration Work Center-2. Navigate to Regular Tasks View-3. Select Terminate Relationship with Employee A under Termination-4. Employee A is maintained as Last Working Day date accordingly-Cause-Employee could have Business Partner Roles and could also have other Business Partner Roles with different Business Partner ID's. Status of Business Partner must match to termination date.-Resolution-1. Go to Business Partner Data or Account Management Workcenter-2. Navigate to Business Partners view-3. Find all related Business Partner roles and Business Partner ID of the Employee A-4. Check every Business Partner Roles of employee and change status to Obsolete to allow termination of Employee A-It is possible to reset the status to active of the Business Partner Roles of employee after termination of employee A, if the Business Partner will be used in future.-Keywords-Fehlermeldung "Startdatum Vereinbarung kann nicht vor Startdatum Arbeitsvertrag liegen", Kündigung eines Arbeitsnehmer nicht möglich

Title: Revenue Recognition Amount is Higher Than Expected for Customer Contract
Content: Symptom-Amount posted in Revenue Recognition is higher than expected for Customer Contract Item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find Run ID AAA (AAA means the Run ID).-Click View.-Go to the Processed Successfully tab.-Go to the Only Posting Information sub-tab.-Go to the Time Based sub-tab.-Find Customer Contract.-Customer Contract Item Current Earned Revenues Amount is greater than expected.-Cause-The End Date was changed by the date maintained on Cancellation Effective On for the Item in the Contract and it is a date earlier than the End Date set in the begging of the Customer Contract.-Before the change in the End Date the expected was (for example), a 24 months contract of 24.000 USD total, meaning 1.000 USD per month.-When the End Date got changed, the length of the Contract changed to 12 months. The system will recalculate the monthly amounts and post the total difference.-Considering that the Accrual Method is Straight-line – prorate partial periods, check below comparison:-End Date was 01.02.2020.-There were 11 posts of 1.000 USD until 01.01.2019.-End Date got changed by Cancellation Effective On date to 01.02.2019.-System recalculates the month amount to 2.000 USD.-Next Revenue Recognition will post 13.000 USD to correct the month amounts from previous months.-Resolution-This is the correct behavior of the system since version 1808.-Keywords-Revenue Recognition, End Date, Customer Contract, Accrual Method-end date,customer contract,revenue recognition,accrual method

Title: Payment Method Missing for Outgoing Payment Proposal
Content: Symptom-In the Payables work center, you click on Automatic Payments and find out that for one payment proposal, the Payment Method field is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Automatic Payments view.-Show All Payment Proposals.-For the Payment proposal in question, you can see the Payment Method is empty.-Choose Edit, you get the error message: Payment details must be determined.-Check the Financial Data in the master data of the concerned Payee, you can see both the payment methods: Check and Bank Transfer are available.-Cause-The payee of this payment proposal is in another country, so this is an international payment. For international payments, the field Bank Charges Paid By in the Financial Data tab of supplier master data, a mandatory field for international bank transfer, should be maintained. However in this case it is empty, so the system does not propose the payment method for the automatic payment.-Resolution-In order to have the system propose the Payment Method for this payee during the payment run, maintain Bank Charges Paid By in the Supplier master data. For already created payment proposals, you may either void or edit it to manually change the Payment Method.-Keywords-payment method missing, outgoing payment proposal.

Title: Full control mode in EMAdmin - how to update IP address of EM
Content: Symptom-Customer has migrate their EM server to a different IP address. The EM server name is unchanged.-When running the basic configuration, customer get the following warning message:-"Warning occured while updating the EM technical system in LMDB"-EM Instance <IP address>:<port> -> Cannot create Wily Technical System with name " ...-... caused by Instance already exists:- Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Environment-Solution Manager 7.1 SP 13-Resolution-For each EM installation maintained in Solution Manager, there is a "EM installation description" table.-The root cause of this issue is that there is a record in the "EM installation description" table that cannot be updated, because the hostname, port and Introscope version does not changed but only IP was.-Customer need to delete the old installation description before they can proceed, therefore they need to access the full control mode in EMAdmin:-/webdynpro/dispatcher/sap.com/tc~webadministrator~wilyadmin/EMAdmin?mode=Sap-Support

This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-update working hours,mass update working hours

Title: Dunning Letter Shows Different Behavior in the Overdue Days for not Overdue Items
Content: Symptom-While generating a Dunning Letter, the Table 1 calculates the Overdue Days based on the day the Dunning was created, while Table 2 (Other Open Items) calculates the Overdue Days based on the days remaining to reach the Due Date.-Please note that the Table 2 is enabled by accessing the Business Configuration Fine Tune Activity "Dunning Strategies" and selecting the box "Include Items Not Overdue".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Go to Dunning View.-Search and select Dunning ID XYZ(XYZ represents the ID of the Dunning).-Click on Preview > Dunning Letter.-System is calculating the Overdue Days differently from Table 1 to Table 2 (Other open items).-Table 1 calculates the Overdue Days based on the day the Dunning was created, while Table 2 (Other Open Items) calculates the Overdue Days based on the days remaining to reach the Due Date.-Cause-For the items in the Table 2 of Non-due or not Overdue Items, the overdue number of days are calculated based on the date when the Dunning Letter is being generated, since these documents are not part of the Dunning, the Dunning dates would not be relevant for them which is the case for the items being shown in Table 1 of items being dunned.-Example:-Table 1-Invoice: ABC (ABC represents the number of the invoice)-Overdue Days: 20-Table 2-Invoice: DEF (DEF represents the number of the invoice)-Overdue Days: -5-On the next day, results will be following:-Table 1-Invoice: ABC-Overdue Days: 20-Table 2-Invoice: DEF-Overdue Days: -4-Resolution-System behavior is correct.-Table 1 of the Dunning Letter will show the Overdue Days based on the day Dunning was created.-Table 2 of the Dunning Letter will show the Overdue Days based on days remaining to reach the due date.-Keywords-Dunning Letter, Dunning, Overdue Items

Title: Create as Supplier Option Greyed Out for Organization Business Partner
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a supplier from an existing business partner, the option is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - 1902 and above-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Business Partners view.-Select the business partner that you want to be a supplier.-Click on the button Create As.-Here, the option to create as supplier is not available.-Cause-This behavior happens because the approval process for suppliers is activated in the system. This feature was introduced in 1902, and disables the option to create a supplier from an existing business partner, as it would not trigger the approval process.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-In order to activate/deacivate the approval process for suppliers, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click on Edit Scope.-Proceed to step 4 - Questions.-Expand the options General Business Data -> Business Partners -> Handling of Business Partners.-Check/uncheck the question "Do you want to set up the approval process for suppliers?".-See Also-2556865 - Cannot Create a Business Partner Person as a Supplier-Keywords-Business Partner, Supplier, Person, Organization

Title: Tax Prepayment Must be Outgoing - How to Process an Incoming Tax Prepayment
Content: Symptom-You have received an incoming tax prepayment from your tax authority. You externally create this incoming tax prepayment. It now appears in status In Preparation in the Tax Payments view of the Tax Management workcenter.-When trying to post this incoming tax pre-payment, meaning with a positive amount, an error message appears: Tax prepayment must be outgoing.-How can this tax prepayment be posted as well as cleared according to the specified Clearing Due Date?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-Condition: You have externally generated an incoming tax prepayment from the Tax Authority via bank statement creation. This incoming payment now appears as tax payment in the Tax Management workcenter:-In  the Tax Management work center navigate to the Tax Payments view.-Select the incoming tax payment in status  In Preparation and press View.-Enter the Tax Return Arrangement ID.-In the Tax Payment Type field select Tax Prepayment.-Enter the Clearing Due Date.-Now enter a positive tax pre-payment amount and press Check or Post.-An error message appears: Tax prepayment must be outgoing.-Cause-In SAP ByDesign it is currently not allowed to post incoming bank transfers/ checks as tax prepayments as the system is programmed in a way that tax prepayments always have to be created a tax payables of a company to the tax authority.-Resolution-There is, however, a workaround to post the tax pre-payment as well as clearing it with the respective VAT return:-In the payment allocation of the incoming payment the amount needs to be credited directly to a G/L account.-When the tax return for the accounting period of the pre payment's clearing due date is being paid the tax pre-payment amount needs to be debited from the earlier used G/L account.-TO ALLOCATE THE INCOMING TAX PREPAYMENT AMOUNT:-The incoming tax prepayment needs to be cancelled/deleted: This can be achieved by cancelling its payment allocation.-To identify the payment allocation check the external reference of the tax prepayment. This is the ID of the respective bank statement ID.-The cancellation of the payment allocation triggers the creation of the new payment allocation in status In Preparation.-Lets assume you have received a tax prepayment of 200,00 EUR from the tax authority.-In the new payment allocation navigate to the Allocation to G/L account tab.-Select a G/L account of your choice and enter the taxprepayment amount of 200,00 EUR in the Credit Net Amount column.-Press Post.-TO CLEAR THE TAX PREPAYMENT AMOUNT WITH THE TAX RETURN:-Now you have released the tax return for which this tax prepayment is to be considered, most likely for the last period of the fiscal year.-If the tax amount of the tax return is a tax RECEIVABLE amount, i.e. a positive amount, lets say, 10.000,00 EUR, you will receive an incoming payment of the tax authority of the tax return amount minus the tax prepayment amount, i.e. 9.800,00 EUR:-In the payment allocation of the incoming payment first navigate to the Customer/Supplier tab.-In the Customer/Supplier ID field enter the ID of the tax authority.-In the Payment Allocated to field select 8 - Tax payables or receivables.-In the Allocated Amount field enter the full tax return amount, i.e. 10.000.00 EUR. The Allocated Amount on the top of the payment allocation is now higher than the Transaction Amount.-Now navigate to the Allocation to G/L account tab.-Here select the G/L account which you have used for the tax prepayment earlier.-Now enter the tax prepayment amount, i.e. 200,00 EUR in the Debit Net Amount field. Transaction Amount and Allocated Amount display the same amount.-Press Post.-If the tax amount of the tax return is a tax PAYABLE amount, i.e. a negative amount, lets say, -10.000,00 create an outgoing payment of the tax return amount plus the tax prepayment amount, i.e. 10.200,00 EUR.-In the payment allocation of the outgoing payment first navigate to the Customer/Supplier tab.-In the Customer/Supplier ID field enter the ID of the tax authority.-In the Payment Allocated to field select 8 - Tax payables or receivables.-In the Allocated Amount field enter the full tax return amount, i.e. -10.000.00 EUR. The Allocated Amount on the top of the payment allocation is now lower than the Transaction Amount.-Now navigate to the Allocation to G/L account tab.-Here select the G/L account which you have used for the tax prepayment earlier.-Now enter the tax prepayment amount, i.e. 200,00 EUR in the Debit Net Amount field. Transaction Amount and Allocated Amount display the same amount.-Press Post.-  Keywords-Tax Prepayment must be outgoing, incoming tax prepayment, assign tax return to tax payment
